description_ne: ऋग्वेदका सम्पूर्ण दश मण्डल — संहिता, पदपाठ र अर्थसहित।
description_en: The complete Rigveda across all ten Mandalas — samhita text, padapatha and English translation, broken down by Sukta.
source_en: Rigveda Samhita — Sanskrit (accented) and padapatha text with the H. H. Wilson English translation (1850–88, public domain)

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमी॑ळे पु॒रोहि॑तं य॒ज्ञस्य॑ दे॒वमृ॒त्विज॑म् । होता॑रं रत्न॒धात॑मम्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷe ǀ puráḥ-hitam ǀ yajñásya ǀ devám ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀhótāram ǀ ratna-dhā́tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorifyAgni, the high priest of the sacrifice, the divine, the ministrant, who presents the oblation (to the gods), and is the possessor of great wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः पूर्वे॑भि॒ॠषि॑भि॒रीड्यो॒ नूत॑नैरु॒त । स दे॒वाँ एह व॑क्षति
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ pū́rvebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ nū́tanaiḥ ǀ utá ǀsáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgniwho is to be celebrated by both ancient and modern sages conduct the gods hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निना॑ र॒यिम॑श्नव॒त्पोष॑मे॒व दि॒वेदि॑वे । य॒शसं॑ वी॒रव॑त्तमम्
shlokas.transliteration: agnínā ǀ rayím ǀ aśnavat ǀ póṣam ǀ evá ǀ divé-dive ǀyaśásam ǀ vīrávat-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThroughAgnithe worshipper obtains that affluence which increases day by day, which is the source of fame and multiplier of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यं य॒ज्ञम॑ध्व॒रं वि॒श्वत॑: परि॒भूरसि॑ । स इद्दे॒वेषु॑ गच्छति
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yám ǀ yajñám ǀ adhvarám ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ ási ǀsáḥ ǀ ít ǀ devéṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the unobstructed sacrifice of which you are on every side the protector, assuredly reaches the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ क॒विक्र॑तुः स॒त्यश्चि॒त्रश्र॑वस्तमः । दे॒वो दे॒वेभि॒रा ग॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǀ satyáḥ ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǀdeváḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the presenter of oblations, the attainer of knowledge, he who is true, renowned, and divine, come hither with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒ङ्ग दा॒शुषे॒ त्वमग्ने॑ भ॒द्रं क॑रि॒ष्यसि॑ । तवेत्तत्स॒त्यम॑ङ्गिरः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ tvám ǀ ágne ǀ bhadrám ǀ kariṣyási ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ tát ǀ satyám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever good you may,Agni, bestow upon the giver (of the oblation), that verily,Aṅgirasshall revert to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वाग्ने दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ दोषा॑वस्तर्धि॒या व॒यम् । नमो॒ भर॑न्त॒ एम॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ agne ǀ divé-dive ǀ dóṣā-vastaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ vayám ǀnámaḥ ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ imasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We approach you,Agni, with reverential homage in our thoughts, daily, both morning and evening.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राज॑न्तमध्व॒राणां॑ गो॒पामृ॒तस्य॒ दीदि॑विम् । वर्ध॑मानं॒ स्वे दमे॑
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jantam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ gopā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́divim ǀvárdhamānam ǀ své ǀ dáme ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the radiant, the protector of sacrifice, the constant illuminator of truth, increasing in your own dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पि॒तेव॑ सू॒नवेऽग्ने॑ सूपाय॒नो भ॑व । सच॑स्वा नः स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ sūnáve ǀ ágne ǀ su-upāyanáḥ ǀ bhava ǀsácasva ǀ naḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, be to us easy of access, as is a father to his son; be ever present with us for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॒वा या॑हि दर्शते॒मे सोमा॒ अरं॑कृताः । तेषां॑ पाहि श्रु॒धी हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ darśata ǀ imé ǀ sómāḥ ǀ áram-kṛtāḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ pāhi ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, plural asant to behold, approach; these libations are prepared for you drink of them; hear our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॑ उ॒क्थेभि॑र्जरन्ते॒ त्वामच्छा॑ जरि॒तार॑: । सु॒तसो॑मा अह॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ jarante ǀ tvā́m ǀ áccha ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀsutá-somāḥ ǀ ahaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, your praisers praise you with holy praises having poured outSomajuice, and knowing the (fit) season.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वायो॒ तव॑ प्रपृञ्च॒ती धेना॑ जिगाति दा॒शुषे॑ । उ॒रू॒ची सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ táva ǀ pra-pṛñcatī́ ǀ dhénā ǀ jigāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀurūcī́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, your approving speech comes to the giver (of the libation), and to many (others who invite you) to drink of theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒रा ग॑तम् । इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि
shlokas.transliteration: índravāyū íti ǀ imé ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ práyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀíndavaḥ ǀ vām ǀ uśánti ǀ hí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, these libations are poured out (for you); come hither with food (for us); verily the drops (of theSomajuice) await you both. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॒विन्द्र॑श्च चेतथः सु॒तानां॑ वाजिनीवसू । तावा या॑त॒मुप॑ द्र॒वत्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ cetathaḥ ǀ sutā́nām ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀtáu ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ dravát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, abiding in the sacrificial rite, you are aware of these libations; come both (then) quickly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॒विन्द्र॑श्च सुन्व॒त आ या॑त॒मुप॑ निष्कृ॒तम् । म॒क्ष्वि१॒॑त्था धि॒या न॑रा
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀmakṣú ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VāyuandIndra, come to the rite of the sacrificer, for thus, men, will completion be speedily (attained) by the ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रं हु॑वे पू॒तद॑क्षं॒ वरु॑णं च रि॒शाद॑सम् । धियं॑ घृ॒ताचीं॒ साध॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: mitrám ǀ huve ǀ pūtá-dakṣam ǀ váruṇam ǀ ca ǀ riśā́dasam ǀdhíyam ǀ ghṛtā́cīm ǀ sā́dhantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeMitra, of pure vigour, andVaruṇa, the devourer of foes; the joint accomplishers of the act bestowing water (on the earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॑ मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा । क्रतुं॑ बृ॒हन्त॑माशाथे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛta-vṛdhau ǀ ṛta-spṛśā ǀkrátum ǀ bṛhántam ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, augmenters of water, dispensers of water, you connect this perfect rite with its true (reward).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒वी नो॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा तुविजा॒ता उ॑रु॒क्षया॑ । दक्षं॑ दधाते अ॒पस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: kavī́ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ tuvi-jātáu ǀ uru-kṣáyā ǀdákṣam ǀ dadhāte íti ǀ apásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SapientMitraandVaruṇa, prosper our sacrifice and increase our strength; you are born for the benefit of many, you are the refuge of multitudes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ यज्व॑री॒रिषो॒ द्रव॑त्पाणी॒ शुभ॑स्पती । पुरु॑भुजा चन॒स्यत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ yájvarīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ drávatpāṇī íti drávat-pāṇī ǀ śúbhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀpúru-bhujā ǀ canasyátam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, cherishers of pious acts, long-armed, accept with outstretchedhandsthe sacrificial viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ पुरु॑दंससा॒ नरा॒ शवी॑रया धि॒या । धिष्ण्या॒ वन॑तं॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ púru-daṃsasā ǀ nárā ǀ śávīrayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀdhíṣṇyā ǀ vánatam ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, abounding in mighty acts, guides (of devotion), endowed with fortitude, listen with unaverted minds to our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दस्रा॑ यु॒वाक॑वः सु॒ता नास॑त्या वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । आ या॑तं रुद्रवर्तनी
shlokas.transliteration: dásrā ǀ yuvā́kavaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ rudravartanī íti rudra-vartanī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, destroyers of foes, exempt from untruth, leaders in the van of heroes, come to the mixed libations sprinkled on the lopped sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि चित्रभानो सु॒ता इ॒मे त्वा॒यव॑: । अण्वी॑भि॒स्तना॑ पू॒तास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀáṇvībhiḥ ǀ tánā ǀ pūtā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of wonderful splendour, come hither; these libations, ever pure, expressed by the fingers (of the priests) are desirous of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि धि॒येषि॒तो विप्र॑जूतः सु॒ताव॑तः । उप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि वा॒घत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ vípra-jūtaḥ ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀúpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, apprehended by the understanding and appreciated by the wise, approach and accept the prayers of the priest as he offers the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि॒ तूतु॑जान॒ उप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि हरिवः । सु॒ते द॑धिष्व न॒श्चन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀsuté ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ naḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FleetIndrawith the tawny coursers, come hither to the prayer (of the priest), and in this libation accept our (proffered) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतो॒ विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त । दा॒श्वांसो॑ दा॒शुष॑: सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ómāsaḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛtaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀdāśvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal Gods, protectors and supporters of men, bestowers (of rewards) come to the libation of the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒प्तुर॑: सु॒तमा ग॑न्त॒ तूर्ण॑यः । उ॒स्रा इ॑व॒ स्वस॑राणि
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ ganta ǀ tū́rṇayaḥ ǀusrā́ḥ-iva ǀ svásarāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the swift-moving universal Gods, the shedders of rain, come to the libation, as the solar rays come diligently tot he days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒स्रिध॒ एहि॑मायासो अ॒द्रुह॑: । मेधं॑ जुषन्त॒ वह्न॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ asrídhaḥ ǀ éhi-māyāsaḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀmédham ǀ juṣanta ǀ váhnayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the universal Gods, who are exempt from decay, omniscient, devoid of malice, and bearers of (riches), accept the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒व॒का न॒: सर॑स्वती॒ वाजे॑भिर्वा॒जिनी॑वती । य॒ज्ञं व॑ष्टु धि॒याव॑सुः
shlokas.transliteration: pāvakā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ vājínī-vatī ǀyajñám ǀ vaṣṭu ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySarasvatī, the purifier, the bestower of food, the recompenser of worship with wealth, be attracted by our offered viands to our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चो॒द॒यि॒त्री सू॒नृता॑नां॒ चेत॑न्ती सुमती॒नाम् । य॒ज्ञं द॑धे॒ सर॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: codayitrī́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ cétantī ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀyajñám ǀ dadhe ǀ sárasvatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, the inspirer of those who delight in truth, the instrumental uctress of the right-minded, has accepted our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो अर्ण॒: सर॑स्वती॒ प्र चे॑तयति के॒तुना॑ । धियो॒ विश्वा॒ वि रा॑जति
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ prá ǀ cetayati ǀ ketúnā ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, makes manifest by her acts a mighty river, and (in her own form) enlightens all understandings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒रू॒प॒कृ॒त्नुमू॒तये॑ सु॒दुघा॑मिव गो॒दुहे॑ । जु॒हू॒मसि॒ द्यवि॑द्यवि
shlokas.transliteration: surūpa-kṛtnúm ǀ ūtáye ǀ sudúghām-iva ǀ go-dúhe ǀjuhūmási ǀ dyávi-dyavi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Day by day we invoke the doer of good works for our protection, as a good cow for the milking (is called by the milker).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ न॒: सव॒ना ग॑हि॒ सोम॑स्य सोमपाः पिब । गो॒दा इद्रे॒वतो॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ sómasya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ piba ǀgo-dā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ revátaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker of theSomajuice, come to our (daily) rites, and drink of the libation; the satisfaction of (you who are) the bestower of riches, is verily (the cause of) the gift of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अथा॑ ते॒ अन्त॑मानां वि॒द्याम॑ सुमती॒नाम् । मा नो॒ अति॑ ख्य॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: átha ǀ te ǀ ántamānām ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áti ǀ khyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We recognize you in the midst of the right-minded, who are nearest to you; come to us; pass us not by to reveal (yourself to others).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परे॑हि॒ विग्र॒मस्तृ॑त॒मिन्द्रं॑ पृच्छा विप॒श्चित॑म् । यस्ते॒ सखि॑भ्य॒ आ वर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ ihi ǀ vígram ǀ ástṛtam ǀ índram ǀ pṛccha ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀyáḥ ǀ te ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go, worshipper, to the wise and uninjuredIndra, who bestows the best (of blessings) on your friends, and ask him of the (fitness of the) learned (priest who recites his praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ब्रु॑वन्तु नो॒ निदो॒ निर॒न्यत॑श्चिदारत । दधा॑ना॒ इन्द्र॒ इद्दुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ bruvantu ǀ naḥ ǀ nídaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ anyátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ārata ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ índre ǀ ít ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let our ministers, earnestly performing his worship, exclaim, Depart your revilers from hence and every other plural ce (where he is adored).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑: सु॒भगाँ॑ अ॒रिर्वो॒चेयु॑र्दस्म कृ॒ष्टय॑: । स्यामेदिन्द्र॑स्य॒ शर्म॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ su-bhágān ǀ aríḥ ǀ vocéyuḥ ǀ dasma ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀsyā́ma ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ śármaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of foes, let our enemies say we are prosperous; let men (congratulate us); may we ever abide, in the felicity (derived from the favour) ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एमा॒शुमा॒शवे॑ भर यज्ञ॒श्रियं॑ नृ॒माद॑नम् । प॒त॒यन्म॑न्द॒यत्स॑खम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ īm ǀ āśúm ǀ āśáve ǀ bhara ǀ yajña-śríyam ǀ nṛ-mā́danam ǀpatayát ǀ mandayát-sakham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer toIndra, the pervader (of every rite of libation), the juice that is present (at the three ceremonies), the grace of the sacrifice, the exhilarator of mankind, the perfecter of the act, the favourite of (that Indra) who gives happiness (to the offerer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य पी॒त्वा श॑तक्रतो घ॒नो वृ॒त्राणा॑मभवः । प्रावो॒ वाजे॑षु वा॒जिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ pītvā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ghanáḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having drunk,Śatakratu, of this (Somajuice), you became the slayer of theVṛtras; you defend the warrior in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ वाजे॑षु वा॒जिनं॑ वा॒जया॑मः शतक्रतो । धना॑नामिन्द्र सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǀ vājáyāmaḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀdhánānām ǀ indra ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer to you,Śatakratu, the mighty in battle, (sacrificial) food for the acquisition,Indra, of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो रा॒यो॒३॒॑ऽवनि॑र्म॒हान्त्सु॑पा॒रः सु॑न्व॒तः सखा॑ । तस्मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य गायत
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ avániḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ su-pāráḥ ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀtásmai ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing unto thatIndrawho is the protector of wealth, the mighty, the accomplisher of good deeds, the friend of the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वेता॒ नि षी॑द॒तेन्द्र॑म॒भि प्र गा॑यत । सखा॑य॒: स्तोम॑वाहसः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ ā́ ǀ ita ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten hither, friends, offering praises; sit down, and sing repeatedly the praises ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रू॒तमं॑ पुरू॒णामीशा॑नं॒ वार्या॑णाम् । इन्द्रं॒ सोमे॒ सचा॑ सु॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: puru-támam ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀíndram ǀ sóme ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the libation is poured forth, respectively praiseIndra, the discomfiter of many enemies, the lord of many blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॑ नो॒ योग॒ आ भु॑व॒त्स रा॒ये स पुरं॑ध्याम् । गम॒द्वाजे॑भि॒रा स न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ naḥ ǀ yóge ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ sáḥ ǀ púram-dhyām ǀgámat ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he be to us for the attainment of our objects; may he be to us for the acquisition of riches; may he be to us for the acquisition of knowledge; may he come to us with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ सं॒स्थे न वृ॒ण्वते॒ हरी॑ स॒मत्सु॒ शत्र॑वः । तस्मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य गायत
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ sam-sthé ǀ ná ǀ vṛṇváte ǀ hárī íti ǀ samát-su ǀ śátravaḥ ǀtásmai ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing to thatIndra, whose enemies in combat await not his coursers harnessed in his car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त॒पाव्ने॑ सु॒ता इ॒मे शुच॑यो यन्ति वी॒तये॑ । सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः
shlokas.transliteration: suta-pā́vne ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ vītáye ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These pureSomajuices, mixed with curds, are poured out for the satisfaction of the drinker of the libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑ स॒द्यो वृ॒द्धो अ॑जायथाः । इन्द्र॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य सुक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ vṛddháḥ ǀ ajāyathāḥ ǀíndra ǀ jyáiṣṭhyāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your,Indra, performer of good works, has suddenly become of augmented vigour for the sake of drinking the libation, and (maintaining) seniority (among the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ विशन्त्वा॒शव॒: सोमा॑स इन्द्र गिर्वणः । शं ते॑ सन्तु॒ प्रचे॑तसे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ viśantu ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀśám ǀ te ǀ santu ǀ prá-cetase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the object of praises, may these pervadingSomajuices enter into you; may they be propitious for your (attainment of) superior intelligence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां स्तोमा॑ अवीवृध॒न्त्वामु॒क्था श॑तक्रतो । त्वां व॑र्धन्तु नो॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ stómāḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ tvā́m ǀ ukthā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvā́m ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chants (of theSoma) have magnified you,Śatakratu, the hymns (of the Ṛk) have magnified you; may our praises magnify you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्षि॑तोतिः सनेदि॒मं वाज॒मिन्द्र॑: सह॒स्रिण॑म् । यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॑नि॒ पौंस्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: ákṣita-ūtiḥ ǀ sanet ǀ imám ǀ vā́jam ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǀyásmin ǀ víśvāni ǀ páuṃsyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, the unobstructed protector, enjoy these manifold (sacrificial) viands, in which all manly properties abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ मर्ता॑ अ॒भि द्रु॑हन्त॒नूना॑मिन्द्र गिर्वणः । ईशा॑नो यवया व॒धम्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ druhan ǀ tanū́nām ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ yavaya ǀ vadhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the object of praises, let no men do injury to our person ns; you are mighty, keep off violence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जन्ति॑ ब्र॒ध्नम॑रु॒षं चर॑न्तं॒ परि॑ त॒स्थुष॑: । रोच॑न्ते रोच॒ना दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ bradhnám ǀ aruṣám ǀ cárantam ǀ pári ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀrócante ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The circumstationed (inhabitants of thethree worlds) associate with (Indra), the mighty (Sun), the indestructive (fire), the moving (wind), and the lights that shine in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जन्त्य॑स्य॒ काम्या॒ हरी॒ विप॑क्षसा॒ रथे॑ । शोणा॑ धृ॒ष्णू नृ॒वाह॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ asya ǀ kā́myā ǀ hárī íti ǀ ví-pakṣasā ǀ ráthe ǀśóṇā ǀ dhṛṣṇū́ íti ǀ nṛ-vā́hasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They (the charioteers) harness to his car his two desirable coursers, plural ced on eitherhand, bay coloured, high-spirited, chief-bearing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के॒तुं कृ॒ण्वन्न॑के॒तवे॒ पेशो॑ मर्या अपे॒शसे॑ । समु॒षद्भि॑रजायथाः
shlokas.transliteration: ketúm ǀ kṛṇván ǀ aketáve ǀ péśaḥ ǀ maryāḥ ǀ apeśáse ǀsám ǀ uṣát-bhiḥ ǀ ajāyathāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mortals, you owe your (daily) birth (to such anIndra), who with the rays of the morning gives sense to the senseless, and to the formless form.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदह॑ स्व॒धामनु॒ पुन॑र्गर्भ॒त्वमे॑रि॒रे । दधा॑ना॒ नाम॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ áha ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ánu ǀ púnaḥ ǀ garbha-tvám ǀ ā-īriré ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereafter verily those who bear names invoked in holy rites (theMaruts) having seen the rain (about to be engendered), instrumental gated him to resume his embryo condition (in the clouds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ळु चि॑दारुज॒त्नुभि॒र्गुहा॑ चिदिन्द्र॒ वह्नि॑भिः । अवि॑न्द उ॒स्रिया॒ अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: vīḷú ǀ cit ǀ ārujatnú-bhiḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ váhni-bhiḥ ǀávindaḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with the conveyingMaruts, the traversers of plural ces difficult of access, yourIndra, have discovered the cows hidden in the cave.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒व॒यन्तो॒ यथा॑ म॒तिमच्छा॑ वि॒दद्व॑सुं॒ गिर॑: । म॒हाम॑नूषत श्रु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: deva-yántaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ matím ǀ áccha ǀ vidát-vasum ǀ gíraḥ ǀmahā́m ǀ anūṣata ǀ śrutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The reciters of praises praise the mighty (troop ofMaruts), who are celebrated, and conscious of the power of bestowing wealth, in like manner as they (glorify) the counsellor (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑ण॒ सं हि दृक्ष॑से संजग्मा॒नो अबि॑भ्युषा । म॒न्दू स॑मा॒नव॑र्चसा
shlokas.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ dṛ́kṣase ǀ sam-jagmānáḥ ǀ ábibhyuṣā ǀmandū́ íti ǀ samāná-varcasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May you be seen,Maruts, accompanied by the undauntedIndra; (both) rejoicing, and of equal splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न॒व॒द्यैर॒भिद्यु॑भिर्म॒खः सह॑स्वदर्चति । ग॒णैरिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्यै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: anavadyáiḥ ǀ abhídyu-bhiḥ ǀ makháḥ ǀ sáhasvat ǀ arcati ǀgaṇáiḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This right is performed in adoration of the powerfulIndra, along with the irreproachable, heavenward- tending, and amiable bands (of theMaruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑: परिज्म॒न्ना ग॑हि दि॒वो वा॑ रोच॒नादधि॑ । सम॑स्मिन्नृञ्जते॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ pari-jman ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀsám ǀ asmin ǀ ṛñjate ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore, circumambient (troop ofMaruts), come hither, whether from the region of the sky or from the solar sphere; for in this rite (the priest) fully recites your praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒तो वा॑ सा॒तिमीम॑हे दि॒वो वा॒ पार्थि॑वा॒दधि॑ । इन्द्रं॑ म॒हो वा॒ रज॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: itáḥ ǀ vā ǀ sātím ǀ ī́mahe ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ pā́rthivāt ǀ ádhi ǀíndram ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā ǀ rájasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke,Indra, whether he come from this earthly region, or from the heaven above, or from the vast firmament; that he may give (us) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मिद्गा॒थिनो॑ बृ॒हदिन्द्र॑म॒र्केभि॑र॒र्किण॑: । इन्द्रं॒ वाणी॑रनूषत
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ gāthínaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ índram ǀ arkébhiḥ ǀ arkíṇaḥ ǀíndram ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chanters (of theSoma) extolIndrawith songs, the reciters of the Ṛk with prayers, the priests of theYajuṣ, with texts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ इद्धर्यो॒: सचा॒ सम्मि॑श्ल॒ आ व॑चो॒युजा॑ । इन्द्रो॑ व॒ज्री हि॑र॒ण्यय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ háryoḥ ǀ sácā ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀíndraḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the blender of all things, comes verily with his steeds that are harnessed at his word; Indra, the richly-decorated, the wielder of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ दी॒र्घाय॒ चक्ष॑स॒ आ सूर्यं॑ रोहयद्दि॒वि । वि गोभि॒रद्रि॑मैरयत्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ dīrghā́ya ǀ cákṣase ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayat ǀ diví ǀví ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ airayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, to render all things visible, elevated the sun in the sky, and charged the cloud with (abundant) waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ वाजे॑षु नोऽव स॒हस्र॑प्रधनेषु च । उ॒ग्र उ॒ग्राभि॑रू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ ava ǀ sahásra-pradhaneṣu ǀ ca ǀugráḥ ǀ ugrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “InvincibleIndra, protect us in battles abounding in spoil, with insuperable defenceṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ व॒यं म॑हाध॒न इन्द्र॒मर्भे॑ हवामहे । युजं॑ वृ॒त्रेषु॑ व॒ज्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ vayám ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ índram ǀ árbhe ǀ havāmahe ǀyújam ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ vajríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndrafor great affluence, Indra for limited wealth; (our) ally, and wielder of the thunder-bolt against (our) enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ वृषन्न॒मुं च॒रुं सत्रा॑दाव॒न्नपा॑ वृधि । अ॒स्मभ्य॒मप्र॑तिष्कुतः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀ amúm ǀ carúm ǀ sátrā-dāvan ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀasmábhyam ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shedder of rain, granter of all desires, set open this cloud. You are never uncompliant with our (requests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तु॒ञ्जेतु॑ञ्जे॒ य उत्त॑रे॒ स्तोमा॒ इन्द्र॑स्य व॒ज्रिण॑: । न वि॑न्धे अस्य सुष्टु॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tuñjé-tuñje ǀ yé ǀ út-tare ǀ stómāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǀná ǀ vindhe ǀ asya ǀ su-stutím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever excellent praises are given to other dignities, they are (also the due) ofIndrathe thunderer; I do not know his fitting praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ यू॒थेव॒ वंस॑गः कृ॒ष्टीरि॑य॒र्त्योज॑सा । ईशा॑नो॒ अप्र॑तिष्कुतः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ ójasā ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The shedder of rain, the mighty lord, the always compliant, invests men with his strength, as a bull (defends) a herd of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एक॑श्चर्षणी॒नां वसू॑नामिर॒ज्यति॑ । इन्द्र॒: पञ्च॑ क्षिती॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ vásūnām ǀ irajyáti ǀíndraḥ ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who alone rules over men, over riches, and over the five (classes) of the dwellers on earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ वो वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॒ हवा॑महे॒ जने॑भ्यः । अ॒स्माक॑मस्तु॒ केव॑लः
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ hávāmahe ǀ jánebhyaḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ kévalaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for you,Indra, who is everywhere among men; may he be exclusively our own.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑ सान॒सिं र॒यिं स॒जित्वा॑नं सदा॒सह॑म् । वर्षि॑ष्ठमू॒तये॑ भर
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǀ rayím ǀ sa-jítvānam ǀ sadā-sáham ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, bring for our protection riches, most abundant, enjoyable, the source of victory, the humbler of our foes. [”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि येन॑ मुष्टिह॒त्यया॒ नि वृ॒त्रा रु॒णधा॑महै । त्वोता॑सो॒ न्यर्व॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ yéna ǀ muṣṭi-hatyáyā ǀ ní ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ ruṇádhāmahai ǀtvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ árvatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By which we may repel our enemies, whether (encountering them)handto hand, or on horse-back; ever protected by you. (muṣṭihatyayā = muṣṭiprahāreṇa) = lit. by striking with the fist; on horseback = with a horse (a reference to infantry and cavalry)].”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ त्वोता॑स॒ आ व॒यं वज्रं॑ घ॒ना द॑दीमहि । जये॑म॒ सं यु॒धि स्पृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vayám ǀ vájram ǀ ghanā́ ǀ dadīmahi ǀjáyema ǀ sám ǀ yudhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Defended by you,Indra, we possess a ponderous weapon, wherewith we may entirely conquer our opponents.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं शूरे॑भि॒रस्तृ॑भि॒रिन्द्र॒ त्वया॑ यु॒जा व॒यम् । सा॒स॒ह्याम॑ पृतन्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ śū́rebhiḥ ǀ ástṛ-bhiḥ ǀ índra ǀ tváyā ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀsasahyā́ma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With you for our ally,Indra, and (aided by) missile-hurling heroes, we are able to overcome (our foes) arrayed in hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ इन्द्र॑: प॒रश्च॒ नु म॑हि॒त्वम॑स्तु व॒ज्रिणे॑ । द्यौर्न प्र॑थि॒ना शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ ca ǀ nú ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ astu ǀ vajríṇe ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ prathinā́ ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty isIndra, and supreme; may magnitude ever (belong) to the bearer of the thunderbolt; may his strong (armies) be ever vast as the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मो॒हे वा॒ य आश॑त॒ नर॑स्तो॒कस्य॒ सनि॑तौ । विप्रा॑सो वा धिया॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sam-ohé ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ā́śata ǀ náraḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ sánitau ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ vā ǀ dhiyā-yávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever men have recourse toIndrain battle, or for the acquisition of offspring, and the wise who are desirous of understanding (obtain their desires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः कु॒क्षिः सो॑म॒पात॑मः समु॒द्र इ॑व॒ पिन्व॑ते । उ॒र्वीरापो॒ न का॒कुद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ kukṣíḥ ǀ soma-pā́tamaḥ ǀ samudráḥ-iva ǀ pínvate ǀurvī́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ kākúdaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The belly ofIndra, which quaffs theSomajuice abundantly, swells like the ocean, (and is ever) moist, like the ample fluids of the palate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ह्य॑स्य सू॒नृता॑ विर॒प्शी गोम॑ती म॒ही । प॒क्वा शाखा॒ न दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ gó-matī ǀ mahī́ ǀpakvā́ ǀ śā́khā ǀ ná ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily the words ofIndrato his worshipper are true, manifold, cow- conferring, and to be held in honour; (they are) like a branch (loaded with) ripe (fruit).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा हि ते॒ विभू॑तय ऊ॒तय॑ इन्द्र॒ माव॑ते । स॒द्यश्चि॒त्सन्ति॑ दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ ví-bhūtayaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́-vate ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ sánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Indra, your glories are at all times the protectors of every such worshipper as I am.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ह्य॑स्य॒ काम्या॒ स्तोम॑ उ॒क्थं च॒ शंस्या॑ । इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ kā́myā ǀ stómaḥ ǀ ukthám ǀ ca ǀ śáṃsyā ǀíndrāya ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily his chanted and recited praises are to be desired and repeated toIndra, that he may drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रेहि॒ मत्स्यन्ध॑सो॒ विश्वे॑भिः सोम॒पर्व॑भिः । म॒हाँ अ॑भि॒ष्टिरोज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ mátsi ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ somapárva-bhiḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ abhiṣṭíḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, and be regaled with all viands libations, and thence, mighty in strength, be victorious (over your foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एमे॑नं सृजता सु॒ते म॒न्दिमिन्द्रा॑य म॒न्दिने॑ । चक्रिं॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ चक्र॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ sṛjata ǀ suté ǀ mandím ǀ índrāya ǀ mandíne ǀcákrim ǀ víśvāni ǀ cákraye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The libation being prepared, present the exhilaratina and efficacious (draught) to the rejoicingIndra, the accomplisher of all things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मत्स्वा॑ सुशिप्र म॒न्दिभि॒: स्तोमे॑भिर्विश्वचर्षणे । सचै॒षु सव॑ने॒ष्वा
shlokas.transliteration: mátsva ǀ su-śipra ǀ mandí-bhiḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀsácā ǀ eṣú ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrawith the handsome chin, be plural ased with these animating praises; do your, who are to be reverenced by all mankind, (come) to these rites (with the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: असृ॑ग्रमिन्द्र ते॒ गिर॒: प्रति॒ त्वामुद॑हासत । अजो॑षा वृष॒भं पति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ásṛgram ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǀ práti ǀ tvā́m ǀ út ǀ ahāsata ǀájoṣāḥ ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ pátim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have addressed to you,Indra, the showerer (of blessings), the protector (of your worshipers), praises which have reached you, and of which you have approved.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं चो॑दय चि॒त्रम॒र्वाग्राध॑ इन्द्र॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । अस॒दित्ते॑ वि॒भु प्र॒भु
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ codaya ǀ citrám ǀ arvā́k ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ váreṇyam ǀásat ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ vi-bhú ǀ pra-bhú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural ce before us,Indra, precious and multiform riches, for enough and more than enough are assuredly yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मान्त्सु तत्र॑ चोद॒येन्द्र॑ रा॒ये रभ॑स्वतः । तुवि॑द्युम्न॒ यश॑स्वतः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ sú ǀ tátra ǀ codaya ǀ índra ǀ rāyé ǀ rábhasvataḥ ǀtúvi-dyumna ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentIndra, encourage us in this rite for the acquirement of wealth, for we are diligent and renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं गोम॑दिन्द्र॒ वाज॑वद॒स्मे पृ॒थु श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत् । वि॒श्वायु॑र्धे॒ह्यक्षि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ gó-mat ǀ indra ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ asmé íti ǀ pṛthú ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀviśvá-āyuḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, wealth beyond measure or calculation, inexhaustible, the source of cattle, of food, of all life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे धे॑हि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हद्द्यु॒म्नं स॑हस्र॒सात॑मम् । इन्द्र॒ ता र॒थिनी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dyumnám ǀ sahasra-sā́tamam ǀíndra ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ rathínīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, grant us great renown and wealth acquired in a thousand ways, and those (articles) of food (which are brought from the field) in carts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसो॒रिन्द्रं॒ वसु॑पतिं गी॒र्भिर्गृ॒णन्त॑ ऋ॒ग्मिय॑म् । होम॒ गन्ता॑रमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: vásoḥ ǀ índram ǀ vásu-patim ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀhóma ǀ gántāram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for the preservation of our property,Indra, the lord of wealth, the object of sacred verses, the repairer (to the plural ce of sacrifice), praising him with our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒तेसु॑ते॒ न्यो॑कसे बृ॒हद्बृ॑ह॒त एद॒रिः । इन्द्रा॑य शू॒षम॑र्चति
shlokas.transliteration: suté-sute ǀ ní-okase ǀ bṛhát ǀ bṛhaté ǀ ā́ ǀ ít ǀ aríḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ arcati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With libations repeatedly effused, the sacrificer glorifies the vast prowess ofIndra, the mighty, the dweller in (an eternal mansion).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गाय॑न्ति त्वा गाय॒त्रिणोऽर्च॑न्त्य॒र्कम॒र्किण॑: । ब्र॒ह्माण॑स्त्वा शतक्रत॒ उद्वं॒शमि॑व येमिरे
shlokas.transliteration: gā́yanti ǀ tvā ǀ gāyatríṇaḥ ǀ árcanti ǀ arkám ǀ arkíṇaḥ ǀbrahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ út ǀ vaṃśám-iva ǀ yemire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chanters (of theSoma) hymn you,Śatakratu; the reciters of the Ṛk praise you, who are worthy of praise; the Bra-hmaṇas raise you aloft, like a bamboo pole.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सानो॒: सानु॒मारु॑ह॒द्भूर्यस्प॑ष्ट॒ कर्त्व॑म् । तदिन्द्रो॒ अर्थं॑ चेतति यू॒थेन॑ वृ॒ष्णिरे॑जति
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ sā́noḥ ǀ sā́num ǀ ā́ ǀ áruhat ǀ bhū́ri ǀ áspaṣṭa ǀ kártvam ǀtát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ártham ǀ cetati ǀ yūthéna ǀ vṛṣṇíḥ ǀ ejati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the showever (of blessings), knows the object (of his worshipper), who has performed many acts of worship (with theSomagathered) on the ridges of the mountain, and (therefore) comes with the troop (ofMaruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि के॒शिना॒ हरी॒ वृष॑णा कक्ष्य॒प्रा । अथा॑ न इन्द्र सोमपा गि॒रामुप॑श्रुतिं चर
shlokas.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ keśínā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ kakṣya-prā́ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ girā́m ǀ úpa-śrutim ǀ cara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, drinker of theSoma, having put to your long-maned, vigorous, and well-conditioned steeds, come nigh to hear our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एहि॒ स्तोमाँ॑ अ॒भि स्व॑रा॒भि गृ॑णी॒ह्या रु॑व । ब्रह्म॑ च नो वसो॒ सचेन्द्र॑ य॒ज्ञं च॑ वर्धय
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ stómān ǀ abhí ǀ svara ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ ā́ ǀ ruva ǀbráhma ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ sácā ǀ índra ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ vardhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Vasu, (to this our rite); reply to our hymns, answer (to our praises), respond to (our prayers); be propitious,Indra, to our sacrifice, and (bestow upon us abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थमिन्द्रा॑य॒ शंस्यं॒ वर्ध॑नं पुरुनि॒ष्षिधे॑ । श॒क्रो यथा॑ सु॒तेषु॑ णो रा॒रण॑त्स॒ख्येषु॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ukthám ǀ índrāya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ várdhanam ǀ puruniḥ-sídhe ǀśakráḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ raráṇat ǀ sakhyéṣu ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hymn, the cause of increase, is to be repeated toIndra, the repeller of many foes, thatŚakramay speak (with kindness) to our sons and to our friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमित्स॑खि॒त्व ई॑महे॒ तं रा॒ये तं सु॒वीर्ये॑ । स श॒क्र उ॒त न॑: शक॒दिन्द्रो॒ वसु॒ दय॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ sakhi-tvé ǀ īmahe ǀ tám ǀ rāyé ǀ tám ǀ su-vī́rye ǀsáḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ śakat ǀ índraḥ ǀ vásu ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have recourse toIndrafor his friendship, for wealth, for perfect might; for he, the powerful Indra, conferring wealth, is able (to protect us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वि॒वृतं॑ सुनि॒रज॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वादा॑त॒मिद्यश॑: । गवा॒मप॑ व्र॒जं वृ॑धि कृणु॒ष्व राधो॑ अद्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: su-vivṛ́tam ǀ suniḥ-ájam ǀ índra ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ ít ǀ yáśaḥ ǀgávām ǀ ápa ǀ vrajám ǀ vṛdhi ǀ kṛṇuṣvá ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by you is food (rendered) everywhere abundant, easy of attainment, and assuredly perfect; wielder of the thunderbolt, set open the cow-pastures, and provide (ample) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि त्वा॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे ऋ॑घा॒यमा॑ण॒मिन्व॑तः । जेष॒: स्व॑र्वतीर॒पः सं गा अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ धूनुहि
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ tvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ṛghāyámāṇam ǀ ínvataḥ ǀjéṣaḥ ǀ sváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dhūnuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth are unable to sustain you when destroying your enemies; you may command the waters of heaven; send us lberally kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आश्रु॑त्कर्ण श्रु॒धी हवं॒ नू चि॑द्दधिष्व मे॒ गिर॑: । इन्द्र॒ स्तोम॑मि॒मं मम॑ कृ॒ष्वा यु॒जश्चि॒दन्त॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́śrut-karṇa ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀíndra ǀ stómam ǀ imám ǀ máma ǀ kṛṣvá ǀ yujáḥ ǀ cit ǀ ántaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Oh! your whose ears hear all things, listen quickly to my invocation; hold in your heart my praises; keep near to you this my hymn, as it were (the words of) a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॒ वृष॑न्तमं॒ वाजे॑षु हवन॒श्रुत॑म् । वृष॑न्तमस्य हूमह ऊ॒तिं स॑हस्र॒सात॑माम्
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́ṣan-tamam ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ havana-śrútam ǀvṛ́ṣan-tamasya ǀ hūmahe ǀ ūtím ǀ sahasra-sā́tamām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We know you, liberal rainer (of blessings), the hearer of our call in battles; we invoke the thousand-fold profitable protection of you, the showerer (of bounties).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसा॒नः सु॒तं पि॑ब । नव्य॒मायु॒: प्र सू ति॑र कृ॒धी स॑हस्र॒सामृषि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ kauśika ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǀnávyam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ sú ǀ tira ǀ kṛdhí ǀ sahasra-sā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly,Indra, sone ofKuśika, delighted drink the libation; prolong the life that merits commendation; make me, who am a Ṛṣi abundantly endowed (with possessions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ त्वा गिर्वणो॒ गिर॑ इ॒मा भ॑वन्तु वि॒श्वत॑: । वृ॒द्धायु॒मनु॒ वृद्ध॑यो॒ जुष्टा॑ भवन्तु॒ जुष्ट॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ tvā ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀvṛddhá-āyum ǀ ánu ǀ vṛ́ddhayaḥ ǀ júṣṭāḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ júṣṭayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these our praises be on all occasions around you, deserver of praise; may they augment the power of you, who are long-lived, and being agreeable to you, may they yield delight (to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिर॑: । र॒थीत॑मं र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नां॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ samudrá-vyacasam ǀ gíraḥ ǀrathí-tamam ǀ rathínām ǀ vā́jānām ǀ sát-patim ǀ pátim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All our praises magnifyIndra, expansive as the ocean, the most valiant of warriors who fight in chariots, the lord of food, the protector of the virtuous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ख्ये त॑ इन्द्र वा॒जिनो॒ मा भे॑म शवसस्पते । त्वाम॒भि प्र णो॑नुमो॒ जेता॑र॒मप॑राजितम्
shlokas.transliteration: sakhyé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ bhema ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀtvā́m ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ jétāram ǀ áparā-jitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Supported by your friendship,Indra, cherisher of strength, we have no fear, but glorify you, the conqueror, the unconquered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीरिन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तयो॒ न वि द॑स्यन्त्यू॒तय॑: । यदी॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ मंह॑ते म॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ dasyanti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀyádi ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ máṃhate ǀ maghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient liberalities ofIndra, his protections, will not be wanting to him who presents to the reciters of the hymns, wealth of food and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रां भि॒न्दुर्युवा॑ क॒विरमि॑तौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ कर्म॑णो ध॒र्ता व॒ज्री पु॑रुष्टु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: purā́m ǀ bhindúḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ámita-ojāḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ kármaṇaḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrawas born the destroyer of cities, ever young, ever wise, of unbounded strength, the sustainer of all pious acts, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the many-praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं व॒लस्य॒ गोम॒तोऽपा॑वरद्रिवो॒ बिल॑म् । त्वां दे॒वा अबि॑भ्युषस्तु॒ज्यमा॑नास आविषुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ valásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ápa ǀ avaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ bílam ǀtvā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ábibhyuṣaḥ ǀ tujyámānāsaḥ ǀ āviṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your, wielder of the thunderbolt, did open the cave ofVala, who had there concealed the cattle; and the gods whom he had oppressed, no longer feared when they had obtained you (for their ally).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवा॒हं शू॑र रा॒तिभि॒: प्रत्या॑यं॒ सिन्धु॑मा॒वद॑न् । उपा॑तिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो वि॒दुष्टे॒ तस्य॑ का॒रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ śūra ǀ rātí-bhiḥ ǀ práti ǀ āyam ǀ síndhum ǀ ā-vádan ǀúpa ǀ atiṣṭhanta ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǀ te ǀ tásya ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Attracted) by your bounties, I again come, Hero, to you, celebrating (your liberality) while offering this libation; the performers of the rite approach you, who are worthy of praise, for they have known your (munificence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒याभि॑रिन्द्र मा॒यिनं॒ त्वं शुष्ण॒मवा॑तिरः । वि॒दुष्टे॒ तस्य॒ मेधि॑रा॒स्तेषां॒ श्रवां॒स्युत्ति॑र
shlokas.transliteration: māyā́bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ māyínam ǀ tvám ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ áva ǀ atiraḥ ǀvidúḥ ǀ te ǀ tásya ǀ médhirāḥ ǀ téṣām ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ út ǀ tira ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your slewest,Indra, by stratagems, the wilyŚuṣṇa; the wise have known of this your (greatness); bestow upon them (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मीशा॑न॒मोज॑सा॒भि स्तोमा॑ अनूषत । स॒हस्रं॒ यस्य॑ रा॒तय॑ उ॒त वा॒ सन्ति॒ भूय॑सीः
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ójasā ǀ abhí ǀ stómāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀsahásram ǀ yásya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sánti ǀ bhū́yasīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The reciters of sacred hymns praise with all their might,Indra, the ruler of the world, whose bounties are (computed) by thousands or even more.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दू॒तं वृ॑णीमहे॒ होता॑रं वि॒श्ववे॑दसम् । अ॒स्य य॒ज्ञस्य॑ सु॒क्रतु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ dūtám ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ hótāram ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀasyá ǀ yajñásya ǀ su-krátum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We selectAgni, the messenger of the gods, their invoker, the possessor of all riches, the perfecter of this rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॑ग्निं॒ हवी॑मभि॒: सदा॑ हवन्त वि॒श्पति॑म् । ह॒व्य॒वाहं॑ पुरुप्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ hávīma-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ havanta ǀ viśpátim ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ puru-priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The offerers of oblations) invoke with their invocations,Agni, Agni, the lord of men, the bearer of offerings, the beloved of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ इ॒हा व॑ह जज्ञा॒नो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषे । असि॒ होता॑ न॒ ईड्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣe ǀási ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, genitive rated (by attrition), bring hither the gods to the clipped sacred grass; you are their invoker for us, and are to be adored.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताँ उ॑श॒तो वि बो॑धय॒ यद॑ग्ने॒ यासि॑ दू॒त्य॑म् । दे॒वैरा स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bodhaya ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ yā́si ǀ dūtyám ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you discharge the duty of messenger, arouse them desirous of the oblation; sit down with them on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृता॑हवन दीदिव॒: प्रति॑ ष्म॒ रिष॑तो दह । अग्ने॒ त्वं र॑क्ष॒स्विन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛ́ta-āhavana ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ práti ǀ sma ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀ daha ǀágne ǀ tvám ǀ rakṣasvínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, invoked by oblations of clarified butter, consume our adversaries, who are defended by evil spirits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निना॒ग्निः समि॑ध्यते क॒विर्गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्युवा॑ । ह॒व्य॒वाड्जु॒ह्वा॑स्यः
shlokas.transliteration: agnínā ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀhavya-vā́ṭ ǀ juhú-āsyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the ever young and wise, the guardian of the dwelling (of the sacrificer), the bearer of offerings, whose mouth is (the vehicle) of oblations, is kindled by Agni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विम॒ग्निमुप॑ स्तुहि स॒त्यध॑र्माणमध्व॒रे । दे॒वम॑मीव॒चात॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: kavím ǀ agním ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ satyá-dharmāṇam ǀ adhvaré ǀdevám ǀ amīva-cā́tanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise in the sacrifice,Agni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वाम॑ग्ने ह॒विष्प॑तिर्दू॒तं दे॑व सप॒र्यति॑ । तस्य॑ स्म प्रावि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ havíḥ-patiḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ deva ǀ saparyáti ǀtásya ǀ sma ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, be the protector of that offerr of oblations who worships you, the messenger of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्निं दे॒ववी॑तये ह॒विष्माँ॑ आ॒विवा॑सति । तस्मै॑ पावक मृळय
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agním ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ havíṣmān ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀtásmai ǀ pāvaka ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious,Pāvaka, to him, who, presenting oblations for the gratification of the celestials, approachesAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पावक दीदि॒वोऽग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ इ॒हा व॑ह । उप॑ य॒ज्ञं ह॒विश्च॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀúpa ǀ yajñám ǀ havíḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the bright, the purifier, bring hither the gods to our sacrifice, to our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒: स्तवा॑न॒ आ भ॑र गाय॒त्रेण॒ नवी॑यसा । र॒यिं वी॒रव॑ती॒मिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ gāyatréṇa ǀ návīyasā ǀrayím ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised with our newest hymn, bestow upon us riches and food, the source of progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॒ विश्वा॑भिर्दे॒वहू॑तिभिः । इ॒मं स्तोमं॑ जुषस्व नः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀimám ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, shining with pure radiance, and charged with all the invocations of the gods, be plural ased by this our praise.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: सुस॑मिद्धो न॒ आ व॑ह दे॒वाँ अ॑ग्ने ह॒विष्म॑ते । होत॑: पावक॒ यक्षि॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: sú-samiddhaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́n ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmate ǀhótaríti ǀ pāvaka ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are Susamiddha, invoker, purifier, bring hither the gods to the offerers of our oblation, and do your sacrifice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑मन्तं तनूनपाद्य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ नः कवे । अ॒द्या कृ॑णुहि वी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu-mantam ǀ tanū-napāt ǀ yajñám ǀ devéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ kave ǀadyá ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ vītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise (Agni) who areTanūnapāt(= devourer of clarified butter), present this day our well-favoured sacrifice to the gods for their food.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंस॑मि॒ह प्रि॒यम॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञ उप॑ ह्वये । मधु॑जिह्वं हवि॒ष्कृत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ ihá ǀ priyám ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀmádhu-jihvam ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́tam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the beloved Narāśamśa, the sweet-tongued, the offere of oblations, to this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ सु॒खत॑मे॒ रथे॑ दे॒वाँ ई॑ळि॒त आ व॑ह । असि॒ होता॒ मनु॑र्हितः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ sukhá-tame ǀ ráthe ǀ devā́n ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀási ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, (who are) Īḷita (= worshipped), bring hither the gods in an easy-moving chariot, for you are the invoker instrumental tuted by men.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: स्तृ॒णी॒त ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षग्घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठं मनीषिणः । यत्रा॒मृत॑स्य॒ चक्ष॑णम्
shlokas.transliteration: stṛṇītá ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ manīṣiṇaḥ ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cákṣaṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strew, learned priests, the sacred grass, well bound together (in bundles), and sprinkled with clarified butter, the semblance of ambrosia.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: वि श्र॑यन्तामृता॒वृधो॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर॑स॒श्चत॑: । अ॒द्या नू॒नं च॒ यष्ट॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ śrayantām ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀadyá ǀ nūnám ǀ ca ǀ yáṣṭave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the bright doors, the augmenters of sacrifice, (hitherto) unentered, be set open, for certainly today is the sacrifice to be made.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: नक्तो॒षासा॑ सु॒पेश॑सा॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञ उप॑ ह्वये । इ॒दं नो॑ ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: náktoṣásā ǀ su-péśasā ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀidám ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the lovely night and dawn to sit upon the sacred grass, at this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: ता सु॑जि॒ह्वा उप॑ ह्वये॒ होता॑रा॒ दैव्या॑ क॒वी । य॒ज्ञं नो॑ यक्षतामि॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ su-jihváu ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ kavī́ íti ǀyajñám ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣatām ǀ imám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I call the two eloquent divine and sage invokers (of the gods), that they may celebrate this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॒ सर॑स्वती म॒ही ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्म॑यो॒भुव॑: । ब॒र्हिः सी॑दन्त्व॒स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: íḷā ǀ sárasvatī ǀ mahī́ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ asrídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the three undecaying goddesses, givers of delight, Iḷā,Sarasvatī, andMahī(=Bhāratī), sit down upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्वष्टा॑रमग्रि॒यं वि॒श्वरू॑प॒मुप॑ ह्वये । अ॒स्माक॑मस्तु॒ केव॑लः
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ agriyám ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀasmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ kévalaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the chief and multiformTvaṣṭṛ(=Viśvakarmā); may he be solely ours.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ सृजा वनस्पते॒ देव॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒विः । प्र दा॒तुर॑स्तु॒ चेत॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ sṛja ǀ vanaspate ǀ déva ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀprá ǀ dātúḥ ǀ astu ǀ cétanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Present, divineVanaspati(= lord of the woods), our oblation to the gods, and may true knowledge be (the reward) of the giver.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Apri Deities (Idhma/Agni, Tanunapat, Narashamsa, Ila, Barhis, Divya Dvarah, Uphasanakta, Daivya Hotara, Sarasvati-Ila-Bharati, Tvashta, Vanaspati, Svahakriti)
shlokas.sanskrit: स्वाहा॑ य॒ज्ञं कृ॑णोत॒नेन्द्रा॑य॒ यज्व॑नो गृ॒हे । तत्र॑ दे॒वाँ उप॑ ह्वये
shlokas.transliteration: svā́hā ǀ yajñám ǀ kṛṇotana ǀ índrāya ǀ yájvanaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀtátra ǀ devā́n ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Perform the sacrifice conveyed throughSvāhā(= an exclamation used in pouring the oblation on the fire) toIndra, in the house of the worshipper; therefore I call the gods hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐभि॑रग्ने॒ दुवो॒ गिरो॒ विश्वे॑भि॒: सोम॑पीतये । दे॒वेभि॑र्याहि॒ यक्षि॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, to our adoration, and to our praises, with all these gods, to drink theSomajuice; and (do you) offer sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ कण्वा॑ अहूषत गृ॒णन्ति॑ विप्र ते॒ धिय॑: । दे॒वेभि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ vipra ǀ te ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kaṇvās (=medhāvinaḥ or sages; ṛtvija or officiating priests) invoke you, sapientAgni, and extol your deeds; come, Agni, Agni, with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू बृह॒स्पतिं॑ मि॒त्राग्निं पू॒षणं॒ भग॑म् । आ॒दि॒त्यान्मारु॑तं ग॒णम्
shlokas.transliteration: indravāyū́ íti ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ mitrā́ ǀ agním ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bhágam ǀādityā́n ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sacrifice (Agni), toIndra,Vāyu,Bṛhaspati,Mitra, Agni,PūṣanandBhaga, theĀdityas, and the troop ofMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ भ्रियन्त॒ इन्द॑वो मत्स॒रा मा॑दयि॒ष्णव॑: । द्र॒प्सा मध्व॑श्चमू॒षद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ bhriyante ǀ índavaḥ ǀ matsarā́ḥ ǀ mādayiṣṇávaḥ ǀdrapsā́ḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For all of you are poured out these juices, satisfying, exhilarating, sweet, falling in drops, or gathered in ladles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळ॑ते॒ त्वाम॑व॒स्यव॒: कण्वा॑सो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । ह॒विष्म॑न्तो अरं॒कृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷate ǀ tvā́m ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ káṇvāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀhavíṣmantaḥ ǀ aram-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise priests desirous of the protection (of the gods) having spread the sacred grass, presenting oblations, and offering ornaments, praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठा मनो॒युजो॒ ये त्वा॒ वह॑न्ति॒ वह्न॑यः । आ दे॒वान्त्सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtá-pṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ váhanti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the coursers who convey you, glossy-backed, and harnessed at will, bring the gods to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तान्यज॑त्राँ ऋता॒वृधोऽग्ने॒ पत्नी॑वतस्कृधि । मध्व॑: सुजिह्व पायय
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ yájatrān ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ pátnī-vataḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ su-jihva ǀ pāyaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, make those objects of veneration, augmenters of pious acts, (participant of the offering), together with their wives; give them, bright-tongued, to drink of theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये यज॑त्रा॒ य ईड्या॒स्ते ते॑ पिबन्तु जि॒ह्वया॑ । मधो॑रग्ने॒ वष॑ट्कृति
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ yé ǀ ī́ḍyāḥ ǀ té ǀ te ǀ pibantu ǀ jihváyā ǀmádhoḥ ǀ agne ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let those objects of veneration and of praise, drink with your tongue, of theSomajuice, at the moment of libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आकीं॒ सूर्य॑स्य रोच॒नाद्विश्वा॑न्दे॒वाँ उ॑ष॒र्बुध॑: । विप्रो॒ होते॒ह व॑क्षति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́kīm ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ rocanā́t ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ uṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀvípraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the wise invoker (of the gods) bring hither from the shining (sphere) of the sun, all the divinities awaking with the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvebhiḥ ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ ágne ǀ índreṇa ǀ vāyúnā ǀpíba ǀ mitrásya ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With all the gods, withIndra,Vāyuand the glories (rays) ofMitra(= various forms of Mitra), drink,Agnithe sweetSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं होता॒ मनु॑र्हि॒तोऽग्ने॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ सीदसि । सेमं नो॑ अध्व॒रं य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ sīdasi ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your,Agniappointed by man as the invoker (of the gods) are present at sacrifices; do you present this our oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा ह्यरु॑षी॒ रथे॑ ह॒रितो॑ देव रो॒हित॑: । ताभि॑र्दे॒वाँ इ॒हा व॑ह
shlokas.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ harítaḥ ǀ deva ǀ rohítaḥ ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke, divineAgni, your fleet and powerful mares, Rohits (tābhiḥ vaḍavābhiḥ = mares; rohit= red) to your chariott and by them hither bring the gods.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ सोमं॒ पिब॑ ऋ॒तुना त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्विन्द॑वः । म॒त्स॒रास॒स्तदो॑कसः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sómam ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ viśantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀmatsarā́saḥ ǀ tát-okasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, drink with Ṛtu (proper duty, also person nified divinity of a season) theSomajuice; let the satisfying drops entered into you, and there abide.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑त॒: पिब॑त ऋ॒तुना॑ पो॒त्राद्य॒ज्ञं पु॑नीतन । यू॒यं हि ष्ठा सु॑दानवः
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ píbata ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ potrā́t ǀ yajñám ǀ punītana ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, drink with Ṛtu from the sacrificial vase; consecrate the rite, for you are bountiful.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि य॒ज्ञं गृ॑णीहि नो॒ ग्नावो॒ नेष्ट॒: पिब॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ । त्वं हि र॑त्न॒धा असि॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yajñám ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ naḥ ǀ gnā́vaḥ ǀ néṣṭaríti ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ ási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neṣṭā(=Tvaṣṭā), with your spouse, commend our sacrifice to the gods; drink with Ṛtu, for you are possessed of riches.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ इ॒हा व॑ह सा॒दया॒ योनि॑षु त्रि॒षु । परि॑ भूष॒ पिब॑ ऋ॒तुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sādáya ǀ yóniṣu ǀ triṣú ǀpári ǀ bhūṣa ǀ píba ǀ ṛtúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, bring the gods hither, arrange them in three plural ces (Āhavanīya,DakṣiṇaandGārhapatya--three fires) decorate them; drink with Ṛtu.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: ब्राह्म॑णादिन्द्र॒ राध॑स॒: पिबा॒ सोम॑मृ॒तूँरनु॑ । तवेद्धि स॒ख्यमस्तृ॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: brā́hmaṇāt ǀ indra ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ ánu ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ sakhyám ǀ ástṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink theSomajuice,Indrafrom the precious vase of theBrāhmaṇa( = Brāhmanical wealth) after Ṛtu, for whom your friendship is uninterrupteḍ  brāhmaṇād-rādhasaḥ = lit. from brāhmanical wealth; explained as a costly or wealthy vessel: dhanabhūtāt pātrāt; brāhmaṇād =brāhmaṇācchaṃsi, one of the sixteen priests employed in sacrifices, who perhaps holds some ladle or vase in which the offering is presented: tasya sambandhyucchiṣṭascamasaḥ, the relation is the ladle that has the leavings].”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं दक्षं॑ धृतव्रत॒ मित्रा॑वरुण दू॒ळभ॑म् । ऋ॒तुना॑ य॒ज्ञमा॑शाथे
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ dákṣam ǀ dhṛta-vratā ǀ mítrāvaruṇā ǀ duḥ-dábham ǀṛtúnā ǀ yajñám ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, propitious to pious acts, be present with Ṛtu at our sacrifice, efficacious and undisturbed (by foes).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒वि॒णो॒दा द्रवि॑णसो॒ ग्राव॑हस्तासो अध्व॒रे । य॒ज्ञेषु॑ दे॒वमी॑ळते
shlokas.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ grā́va-hastāsaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀyajñéṣu ǀ devám ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) desirous of wealth, holding stones in theirhands, praise the divine (Agni) Draviṇodas (= Agni, donor of wealth), both in the primary (e.g.Agniṣṭoma) and subsidiary (e.g.Ukthya) sacrifices.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒वि॒णो॒दा द॑दातु नो॒ वसू॑नि॒ यानि॑ शृण्वि॒रे । दे॒वेषु॒ ता व॑नामहे
shlokas.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ yā́ni ǀ śṛṇviré ǀdevéṣu ǀ tā́ ǀ vanāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Draviṇodas give us riches that may be heard of; we ask them for the gods.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒वि॒णो॒दाः पि॑पीषति जु॒होत॒ प्र च॑ तिष्ठत । ने॒ष्ट्रादृ॒तुभि॑रिष्यत
shlokas.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ pipīṣati ǀ juhóta ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ tiṣṭhata ǀneṣṭrā́t ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ iṣyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Draviṇodas desires to drink with the Ṛtu from the cup ofNeṣṭā(=tvaṣṭāor one of 16 officiating priests); hasten, (priest, to the hall of offering); present the oblation, and depart.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: यत्त्वा॑ तु॒रीय॑मृ॒तुभि॒र्द्रवि॑णोदो॒ यजा॑महे । अध॑ स्मा नो द॒दिर्भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ turī́yam ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ dráviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀ yájāmahe ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since Draviṇodas, we adore you for the fourth time (i.e. in four ṛks) along with the Ṛtu; therefore be a benefactor unto us.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ पिब॑तं॒ मधु॒ दीद्य॑ग्नी शुचिव्रता । ऋ॒तुना॑ यज्ञवाहसा
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ píbatam ǀ mádhu ǀ dī́dyagnī íti dī́di-agnī ǀ śuci-vratā ǀṛtúnā ǀ yajña-vāhasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, performers of pious acts, bright with sacrificial fires, acceptors, with the Ṛtus, of the sacrifice drink the sweet draught.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ritu Devatas (Indra, Maruts, Tvashta, Agni, Mitra-Varuna, Dravinoda, Ashvinikumar, Garhapatya)
shlokas.sanskrit: गार्ह॑पत्येन सन्त्य ऋ॒तुना॑ यज्ञ॒नीर॑सि । दे॒वान्दे॑वय॒ते य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: gā́rha-patyena ǀ santya ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ yajña-nī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀdevā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of rewards (Agni= santya, from san, to give), being identified with the household fire, and partaker with Ṛtu of the sacrifice, worship the gods on behalf of their adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ वहन्तु॒ हर॑यो॒ वृष॑णं॒ सोम॑पीतये । इन्द्र॑ त्वा॒ सूर॑चक्षसः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vahantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, let your coursers hither bring you, bestower of desires, to drink theSomajuice; may (the priests), radiant as the Sun, (make you manifest).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा धा॒ना घृ॑त॒स्नुवो॒ हरी॑ इ॒होप॑ वक्षतः । इन्द्रं॑ सु॒खत॑मे॒ रथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ ghṛta-snúvaḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ ihá ǀ úpa ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀíndram ǀ sukhá-tame ǀ ráthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let his coursers conveyIndrain an easy moving chariot hither, where these grains (of parched barley), steeped in clarified butter, are strewn (upon the altar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ प्रा॒तर्ह॑वामह॒ इन्द्रं॑ प्रय॒त्य॑ध्व॒रे । इन्द्रं॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ prātáḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ índram ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀíndram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndraat the morning rite, we invoke him at the succeeding sacrifice, we invoke Indra to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सु॒तमा ग॑हि॒ हरि॑भिरिन्द्र के॒शिभि॑: । सु॒ते हि त्वा॒ हवा॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ keśí-bhiḥ ǀsuté ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hávāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to our libation with our long-maned steeds; the libation being poured out, we invoke you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेमं न॒: स्तोम॒मा ग॒ह्युपे॒दं सव॑नं सु॒तम् । गौ॒रो न तृ॑षि॒तः पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ úpa ǀ idám ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀgauráḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛṣitáḥ ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you accept this our praise, and come to this our sacrifice, for  which the libation is prepared; drink like a thirsty stag (gaura).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे सोमा॑स॒ इन्द॑वः सु॒तासो॒ अधि॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑ । ताँ इ॑न्द्र॒ सह॑से पिब
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀtā́n ǀ indra ǀ sáhase ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These drippingSomajuices are effused upon the sacred grass; drink them,Indra, (to recruit your) vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॒ स्तोमो॑ अग्रि॒यो हृ॑दि॒स्पृग॑स्तु॒ शंत॑मः । अथा॒ सोमं॑ सु॒तं पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ stómaḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ hṛdi-spṛ́k ǀ astu ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǀátha ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this our excellent hymn, touching your heart, be grateful to you, and thence drink the effused libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॒मित्सव॑नं सु॒तमिन्द्रो॒ मदा॑य गच्छति । वृ॒त्र॒हा सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: víśvam ǀ ít ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ gacchati ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the destroyer of enemies, repairs assuredly to every ceremony where the libation is poured out, to drink theSomajuice for (his) exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेमं न॒: काम॒मा पृ॑ण॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॑: शतक्रतो । स्तवा॑म त्वा स्वा॒ध्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀstávāma ǀ tvā ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Śatakratu, accomplish our desire with (the gift of) cattle and horse; profoundly meditating, we praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णयोर॒हं स॒म्राजो॒रव॒ आ वृ॑णे । ता नो॑ मृळात ई॒दृशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāváruṇayoḥ ǀ ahám ǀ sam-rā́joḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷātaḥ ǀ īdṛ́śe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I seek the protection of the sovereign rulers (= possessed of extensive dominion or shining very brilliantly),IndraandVaruṇa; may they both favour us accordingly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गन्ता॑रा॒ हि स्थोऽव॑से॒ हवं॒ विप्र॑स्य॒ माव॑तः । ध॒र्तारा॑ चर्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: gántārā ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávam ǀ víprasya ǀ mā́-vataḥ ǀdhartā́rā ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you are ever ready, guardians of mankind, to grant protection on the appeal of a minister such as I am.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒नु॒का॒मं त॑र्पयेथा॒मिन्द्रा॑वरुण रा॒य आ । ता वां॒ नेदि॑ष्ठमीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: anu-kāmám ǀ tarpayethām ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Satisfy us with wealth,IndraandVaruṇa, according to our desires; we desire you ever near us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वाकु॒ हि शची॑नां यु॒वाकु॑ सुमती॒नाम् । भू॒याम॑ वाज॒दाव्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́ku ǀ hí ǀ śácīnām ǀ yuvā́ku ǀ su-matīnā́m ǀbhūyā́ma ǀ vāja-dā́vnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mingled (libations; yuvāku = mixture of curds andghee; śacīnām, mixture of butter milk, water and meal) of our pious rites, the mingled yuvāku sumatīnām = (laudations) of our right-minded (= sumatīnām, priests, are prepared); may we be (included) among the givers of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: सहस्र॒दाव्नां॒ वरु॑ण॒: शंस्या॑नाम् । क्रतु॑र्भवत्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sahasra-dā́vnām ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ śáṃsyānām ǀkrátuḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrais a giver among the givers of thousands;Varuṇais to be praised among those who are deserving of laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तयो॒रिदव॑सा व॒यं स॒नेम॒ नि च॑ धीमहि । स्यादु॒त प्र॒रेच॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ ávasā ǀ vayám ǀ sanéma ǀ ní ǀ ca ǀ dhīmahi ǀsyā́t ǀ utá ǀ pra-récanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through their protection, we enjoy (riches) and heap them up, and still there is abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुण वाम॒हं हु॒वे चि॒त्राय॒ राध॑से । अ॒स्मान्त्सु जि॒ग्युष॑स्कृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huvé ǀ citrā́ya ǀ rā́dhase ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀ kṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you both,IndraandVaruṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुण॒ नू नु वां॒ सिषा॑सन्तीषु धी॒ष्वा । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ nú ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ sísāsantīṣu ǀ dhīṣú ǀ ā́ ǀasmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, quickly bestow happiness upon us, for our minds are devoted to you both.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॑मश्नोतु सुष्टु॒तिरिन्द्रा॑वरुण॒ यां हु॒वे । यामृ॒धाथे॑ स॒धस्तु॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ aśnotu ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ yā́m ǀ huvé ǀyā́m ǀ ṛdhā́the íti ǀ sadhá-stutim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the earnest priase which I offer toIndraandVaruṇareach you both--that conjoint praise which you (accepting), dignify.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो॒मानं॒ स्वर॑णं कृणु॒हि ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते । क॒क्षीव॑न्तं॒ य औ॑शि॒जः
shlokas.transliteration: somā́nam ǀ sváraṇam ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀkakṣī́vantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ auśijáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brahmaṇaspati(=Agni, connected with prayer) make the offerer of the libation illustrious among the gods, likeKakṣīvat, the son of Uśij (andDīrghatamas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो रे॒वान्यो अ॑मीव॒हा व॑सु॒वित्पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑नः । स न॑: सिषक्तु॒ यस्तु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ revā́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ amīva-hā́ ǀ vasu-vít ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sisaktu ǀ yáḥ ǀ turáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is opulent, the healer of disease, the acquirer of riches, the augmenter of nourishment, the prompt (bestower of rewards) be favourable to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॒: शंसो॒ अर॑रुषो धू॒र्तिः प्रण॒ङ्मर्त्य॑स्य । रक्षा॑ णो ब्रह्मणस्पते
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ práṇak ǀ mártyasya ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Brahmaṇaspati, so that no calumnious censure of a melevolent man may reach us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॑ वी॒रो न रि॑ष्यति॒ यमिन्द्रो॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑: । सोमो॑ हि॒नोति॒ मर्त्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀ yám ǀ índraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ hinóti ǀ mártyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The liberal man, whomIndra,Brahmaṇaspati, andSomaprotect, never perishes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तं ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते॒ सोम॒ इन्द्र॑श्च॒ मर्त्य॑म् । दक्षि॑णा पा॒त्वंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártyam ǀdákṣiṇā ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Brahmaṇaspati, and do you,Soma,IndraandDakṣiṇā(= present person nified as a feminine le divinity), protect that man from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सद॑स॒स्पति॒मद्भु॑तं प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्य॑म् । स॒निं मे॒धाम॑यासिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: sádasaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ ádbhutam ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀsaním ǀ medhā́m ǀ ayāsiṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I solicit understanding fromSadasaspati(=Agni, protector of the assembly), the wonderful, the friend ofIndra, the desirable, the bountiful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॑दृ॒ते न सिध्य॑ति य॒ज्ञो वि॑प॒श्चित॑श्च॒न । स धी॒नां योग॑मिन्वति
shlokas.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ ṛté ǀ ná ǀ sídhyati ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ caná ǀsáḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ yógam ǀ invati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Without whose aid the sacrifice even of the wise is not perfected; he pervades the association of our thoughts (or, the object of our pious acts; dhī =buddhi, understanding orkarma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदृ॑ध्नोति ह॒विष्कृ॑तिं॒ प्राञ्चं॑ कृणोत्यध्व॒रम् । होत्रा॑ दे॒वेषु॑ गच्छति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ṛdhnoti ǀ havíḥ-kṛtim ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ adhvarám ǀhótrā ǀ devéṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He rewrds the presenter of the oblation; he brings the sacrifice to its conclusion; (through him) our invocation reaches the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंसं॑ सु॒धृष्ट॑म॒मप॑श्यं स॒प्रथ॑स्तमम् । दि॒वो न सद्म॑मखसम्
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ su-dhṛ́ṣṭamam ǀ ápaśyam ǀ sapráthaḥ-tamam ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sádma-makhasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have beheld Nārāśaṃsa (i.e.Agnior the person nifiedyajñaor sacrifice at which men praise the gods), the most resolute, the most renowned, and radiant as the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॒ त्यं चारु॑मध्व॒रं गो॑पी॒थाय॒ प्र हू॑यसे । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ tyám ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǀ go-pīthā́ya ǀ prá ǀ hūyase ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earnestly are you invoked to this perfect rite, to drink theSomajuice; come,Agni, with theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि दे॒वो न मर्त्यो॑ म॒हस्तव॒ क्रतुं॑ प॒रः । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ táva ǀ krátum ǀ paráḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nor god nor man has power over a rite (dedicated) to you, who are mighty; come,Agni, with theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये म॒हो रज॑सो वि॒दुर्विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒द्रुह॑: । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ maháḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who all are divine (devāsaḥ = dyotamānāḥ, shining) and devoid of malignity and who know (how to cause the descent) of great waters; come,Agni, with the (sapta-gaṇāor all seven troops of)Maruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒ग्रा अ॒र्कमा॑नृ॒चुरना॑धृष्टास॒ ओज॑सा । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ānṛcúḥ ǀ ánādhṛṣṭāsaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are fierce, and send down rain (arka, from arc to worship; āpo vāarkaḥ(Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa10.6.5.2); hence, arka connotes water or rain), and are unsurpassed in strength; come,Agniwith theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये शु॒भ्रा घो॒रव॑र्पसः सुक्ष॒त्रासो॑ रि॒शाद॑सः । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ ghorá-varpasaḥ ǀ su-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are brilliant, of terrific forms, who are possessors of great wealth, and are devourers of the malevolent; come,Agniwith theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये नाक॒स्याधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वि दे॒वास॒ आस॑ते । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ nā́kasya ǀ ádhi ǀ rocané ǀ diví ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are divinities abiding in the radiant heaven above the sun; come,Agniwith theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ई॒ङ्खय॑न्ति॒ पर्व॑तान्ति॒रः स॑मु॒द्रम॑र्ण॒वम् । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ īṅkháyanti ǀ párvatān ǀ tiráḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ arṇavám ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who scatter the clouds, and agitate the sea (with waves): come,Agniwith theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ये त॒न्वन्ति॑ र॒श्मिभि॑स्ति॒रः स॑मु॒द्रमोज॑सा । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yé ǀ tanvánti ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ójasā ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who spread (through the firmament) along with the rays (of the sun) and with their strength agitate the ocean: come,Agni, with theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॑ पू॒र्वपी॑तये सृ॒जामि॑ सो॒म्यं मधु॑ । म॒रुद्भि॑रग्न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pūrvá-pītaye ǀ sṛjā́mi ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I pour out the sweetSomajuice for your drinking, (as) of old; come,Agniwith theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं दे॒वाय॒ जन्म॑ने॒ स्तोमो॒ विप्रे॑भिरास॒या । अका॑रि रत्न॒धात॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ devā́ya ǀ jánmane ǀ stómaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ āsayā́ ǀákāri ǀ ratna-dhā́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This hymn, the bestower of riches, has been addressed by the sages, with their own mouths, to the (class of) divinities having birth (lit. to the divine or brilliant birth; e.g.Ṛbhus--Ṛbhu,VibhuandVājawere pious men, who through penance became divinities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इन्द्रा॑य वचो॒युजा॑ तत॒क्षुर्मन॑सा॒ हरी॑ । शमी॑भिर्य॒ज्ञमा॑शत
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ índrāya ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ tatakṣúḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ hárī íti ǀśámībhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who created mentally forIndrathe horses that are harnessed (carved) at his words, have partaken of the sacrifice performed with holy acts. (śamībhiḥ = ceremonies; i.e. they have pervaded, appropriated or accepted the sacrifice peformed with tongs, ladles, and utensils; an intimation of the mechanical skills ofṚbhu).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तक्ष॒न्नास॑त्याभ्यां॒ परि॑ज्मानं सु॒खं रथ॑म् । तक्ष॑न्धे॒नुं स॑ब॒र्दुघा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tákṣan ǀ nā́satyābhyām ǀ pári-jmānam ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀtákṣan ǀ dhenúm ǀ sabaḥ-dúghām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They constructed for theNāsatyās, a universally-moving and easy car, and a cow yielding milk. (takṣan= atakṣan, lit. they (Ṛbhus) chipped or fabricated, mechanically, the appendages ofIndraandAśvin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: युवा॑ना पि॒तरा॒ पुन॑: स॒त्यम॑न्त्रा ऋजू॒यव॑: । ऋ॒भवो॑ वि॒ष्ट्य॑क्रत
shlokas.transliteration: yúvānā ǀ pitárā ǀ púnaríti ǀ satyá-mantrāḥ ǀ ṛju-yávaḥ ǀṛbhávaḥ ǀ viṣṭī́ ǀ akrata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheṚbhus, uttering unfailing prayers, endowed with rectitude, and succeeding (in all pious acts;viṣṭī= vyāptiyuktaḥ, i.e. encountering no opposition in all acts), made their (aged) parents young.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं वो॒ मदा॑सो अग्म॒तेन्द्रे॑ण च म॒रुत्व॑ता । आ॒दि॒त्येभि॑श्च॒ राज॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ agmata ǀ índreṇa ǀ ca ǀ marútvatā ǀādityébhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, the exhilarating juices are offered to you, along withIndra, attended by theMarutsand along with the brilliangĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यं च॑म॒सं नवं॒ त्वष्टु॑र्दे॒वस्य॒ निष्कृ॑तम् । अक॑र्त च॒तुर॒: पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ camasám ǀ návam ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ devásya ǀ níḥ-kṛtam ǀákarta ǀ catúraḥ ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheṚbhushave divided unto four the new ladle, the work of the divineTvaṣṭā(i.e. devasambandhiḥ takṣana.vyāpāraḥ= divinity whose duty in relations to gods is carpentry; cf. tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuḥśiṣyāḥṚbhavaḥ= Ṛbhus are the disciples of Tvaṣṭā; four ladles are an apparent reference to an innovation in the objects of libation for sharing).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॒ रत्ना॑नि धत्तन॒ त्रिरा साप्ता॑नि सुन्व॒ते । एक॑मेकं सुश॒स्तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rátnāni ǀ dhattana ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sā́ptāni ǀ sunvaté ǀékam-ekam ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they, moved by our praises, give to the offere of the libation many precious things, and perfect the thrice seven sacrifices”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑रयन्त॒ वह्न॒योऽभ॑जन्त सुकृ॒त्यया॑ । भा॒गं दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhārayanta ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ ábhajanta ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀbhāgám ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offerers (of sacrifices), they held (a moral existence); by their pious acts they obtained a share of sacrifices with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेन्द्रा॒ग्नी उप॑ ह्वये॒ तयो॒रित्स्तोम॑मुश्मसि । ता सोमं॑ सोम॒पात॑मा
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ stómam ǀ uśmasi ǀtā́ ǀ sómam ǀ soma-pā́tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoke hitherIndraandAgni, to whom we desire to present our praise; let them, who are both copious drinkers of theSomajuice, (accept the libation).”
