shlokas.sanskrit: ता य॒ज्ञेषु॒ प्र शं॑सतेन्द्रा॒ग्नी शु॑म्भता नरः । ता गा॑य॒त्रेषु॑ गायत
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsata ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ śumbhata ǀ naraḥ ǀtā́ ǀ gāyatréṣu ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise, men,IndraandAgni, in sacrifices, decorate them (with ornaments) and hymn them with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता मि॒त्रस्य॒ प्रश॑स्तय इन्द्रा॒ग्नी ता ह॑वामहे । सो॒म॒पा सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ prá-śastaye ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ tā́ ǀ havāmahe ǀsoma-pā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndraandAgni, for the benefit of our friend (the instrumental tutor of the rite), drinkers of theSomajuice, to drink the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रा सन्ता॑ हवामह॒ उपे॒दं सव॑नं सु॒तम् । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी एह ग॑च्छताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ugrā́ ǀ sántā ǀ havāmahe ǀ úpa ǀ idám ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀindrāgnī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the two who are fierce (to their foes) to attend the rite, where the libation is prepared;IndraandAgni, come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता म॒हान्ता॒ सद॒स्पती॒ इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ रक्ष॑ उब्जतम् । अप्र॑जाः सन्त्व॒त्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ mahā́ntā ǀ sádaspátī íti ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ubjatam ǀáprajāḥ ǀ santu ǀ atríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those two,IndraandAgniwho are mighty, and guardians of the assembly, render theRākṣasinnocuous, and may the devourers (of men) be destitute of progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेन॑ स॒त्येन॑ जागृत॒मधि॑ प्रचे॒तुने॑ प॒दे । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: téna ǀ satyéna ǀ jāgṛtam ǀ ádhi ǀ pra-cetúne ǀ padé ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By this unfailing sacrifice, by you rendered vigilant,IndraandAgni, in the station which affords knowledge (of the consequence of acts), and bestow upon us happiness.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्युजा॒ वि बो॑धया॒श्विना॒वेह ग॑च्छताम् । अ॒स्य सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-yújā ǀ ví ǀ bodhaya ǀ aśvínau ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchatām ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Awaken, theAśvins, associated for the morning sacrifice; let them both come hither to drink of thisSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: या सु॒रथा॑ र॒थीत॑मो॒भा दे॒वा दि॑वि॒स्पृशा॑ । अ॒श्विना॒ ता ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ su-ráthā ǀ rathí-tamā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ divi-spṛ́śā ǀaśvínā ǀ tā́ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the twoAśvins, who are both divine, the best of charioteers, riding in an excellent car and attaining heaven.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: या वां॒ कशा॒ मधु॑म॒त्यश्वि॑ना सू॒नृता॑वती । तया॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vām ǀ káśā ǀ mádhu-matī ǀ áśvinā ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vatī ǀtáyā ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, stir up (mimikṣatam = mix intimately, rapidly like a whip) the sacrifice with your whip that is wet the foam (of your horses), and lashing loudly.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि वा॒मस्ति॑ दूर॒के यत्रा॒ रथे॑न॒ गच्छ॑थः । अश्वि॑ना सो॒मिनो॑ गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vām ǀ ásti ǀ dūraké ǀ yátra ǀ ráthena ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀáśvinā ǀ somínaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The abode of the offerer of the libation is not far from you,Aśvins, going thither in your car.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यपाणिमू॒तये॑ सवि॒तार॒मुप॑ ह्वये । स चेत्ता॑ दे॒वता॑ प॒दम्
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-pāṇim ǀ ūtáye ǀ savitā́ram ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀsáḥ ǀ céttā ǀ devátā ǀ padám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “InvokeSavitā(Sun), the golden- handed, to protect me; he will appoint the station of the worshippers.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पां नपा॑त॒मव॑से सवि॒तार॒मुप॑ स्तुहि । तस्य॑ व्र॒तान्यु॑श्मसि
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ ávase ǀ savitā́ram ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ uśmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “GlorifySavitā, who is no friend to water, or our protection; we desire to celebrate his worship.(apāmnapāt= son of the waters).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भ॒क्तारं॑ हवामहे॒ वसो॑श्चि॒त्रस्य॒ राध॑सः । स॒वि॒तारं॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhaktā́ram ǀ havāmahe ǀ vásoḥ ǀ citrásya ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀsavitā́ram ǀ nṛ-cákṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeSavitā, the enlightener of men, the dispenser of various home-insuring wealth.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑य॒ आ नि षी॑दत सवि॒ता स्तोम्यो॒ नु न॑: । दाता॒ राधां॑सि शुम्भति
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǀ savitā́ ǀ stómyaḥ ǀ nú ǀ naḥ ǀdā́tā ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ śumbhati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sit down, friends;Savitāverily is to be praised by us, for he is the giver of riches.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ पत्नी॑रि॒हा व॑ह दे॒वाना॑मुश॒तीरुप॑ । त्वष्टा॑रं॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́nām ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀtváṣṭāram ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, bring hither the loving wives of the gods, andTvaṣṭā, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: आ ग्ना अ॑ग्न इ॒हाव॑से॒ होत्रां॑ यविष्ठ॒ भार॑तीम् । वरू॑त्रीं धि॒षणां॑ वह
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gnā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀ hótrām ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ bhā́ratīm ǀvárūtrīm ǀ dhiṣáṇām ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouthfulAgni, bring hither for our protection the wives (of the gods),Hotrā(wife of Agni or person nified invocation),Bhāratī(anĀditya), Varutrī (= varaṇīyā, chosen), andDhiṣaṇā(= vāc or vāg-devī, goddess of speech).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि नो॑ दे॒वीरव॑सा म॒हः शर्म॑णा नृ॒पत्नी॑: । अच्छि॑न्नपत्राः सचन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ maháḥ ǀ śármaṇā ǀ nṛ-pátnīḥ ǀácchinna-patrāḥ ǀ sacantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the goddesses, whose wings are unclipt the protectresses of mankind, favour us with perfection, and with entire felicity.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेन्द्रा॒णीमुप॑ ह्वये वरुणा॒नीं स्व॒स्तये॑ । अ॒ग्नायीं॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ indrāṇī́m ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ varuṇānī́m ǀ svastáye ǀagnā́yīm ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoke hither,Indrāṇī,Varuṇānī, andAgnāyī, for our welfare, and to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॒पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣatām ǀpipṛtā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ bhárīma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the great heven and the earth be plural ased to blend this sacrifice (with their own dews) and fill us with nutriment.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: तयो॒रिद्घृ॒तव॒त्पयो॒ विप्रा॑ रिहन्ति धी॒तिभि॑: । ग॒न्ध॒र्वस्य॑ ध्रु॒वे प॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ rihanti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀgandharvásya ǀ dhruvé ǀ padé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise taste, through their pious acts, theghee-resembling waters of these two, (abiding) in the permanent region of theGandharvas. (Antarikṣa, the sphere of gandharvas,yakṣasandapsarasas, the firmament between heaven and earth).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: स्यो॒ना पृ॑थिवि भवानृक्ष॒रा नि॒वेश॑नी । यच्छा॑ न॒: शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: syonā́ ǀ pṛthivi ǀ bhava ǀ anṛkṣarā́ ǀ ni-véśanī ǀyáccha ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earth be your wide-spreading, free from thorns, and our abiding plural ce; give us great happiness.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: अतो॑ दे॒वा अ॑वन्तु नो॒ यतो॒ विष्णु॑र्विचक्र॒मे । पृ॒थि॒व्याः स॒प्त धाम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ naḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ vi-cakramé ǀpṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ saptá ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gods preserve us (from that portion) of the earth whenceViṣṇu(aided) by the seven metres, stepped.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं विष्णु॒र्वि च॑क्रमे त्रे॒धा नि द॑धे प॒दम् । समू॑ळ्हमस्य पांसु॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ tredhā́ ǀ ní ǀ dadhe ǀ padám ǀsám-ūḷham ǀ asya ǀ pāṃsuré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viṣṇutraversed this (world); three times he plural nted his foot and the whole (world) was collected in the dust of his (footstep).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ प॒दा वि च॑क्रमे॒ विष्णु॑र्गो॒पा अदा॑भ्यः । अतो॒ धर्मा॑णि धा॒रय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ padā́ ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ dhāráyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viṣṇu, the preserver, the uninjurable, stepped three steps, upholding thereby righteous acts.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: विष्णो॒: कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्य॒: सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: víṣṇoḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ paśyata ǀ yátaḥ ǀ vratā́ni ǀ paspaśé ǀíndrasya ǀ yújyaḥ ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Behold the deeds ofViṣṇu, through which (the worshipper) has accomplished (pious) vows; he is the worthy friend ofIndra.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: तद्विष्णो॑: पर॒मं प॒दं सदा॑ पश्यन्ति सू॒रय॑: । दि॒वी॑व॒ चक्षु॒रात॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ paramám ǀ padám ǀ sádā ǀ paśyanti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀdiví-iva ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ ā́-tatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise ever contemplate that supreme station ofViṣṇu, as the eye ranges over the sky.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Ashvinikumar, Savita, Agni, Devinis, Indrani, Varunani, Agnayi, Dyavaprithivi, Vishnu
shlokas.sanskrit: तद्विप्रा॑सो विप॒न्यवो॑ जागृ॒वांस॒: समि॑न्धते । विष्णो॒र्यत्प॑र॒मं प॒दम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ sám ǀ indhate ǀvíṣṇoḥ ǀ yát ǀ paramám ǀ padám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise, ever vigilant and diligent in praise, amply glorify that which is the supreme station ofViṣṇu.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: ती॒व्राः सोमा॑स॒ आ ग॑ह्या॒शीर्व॑न्तः सु॒ता इ॒मे । वायो॒ तान्प्रस्थि॑तान्पिब
shlokas.transliteration: tīvrā́ḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ āśī́ḥ-vantaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀvā́yo íti ǀ tā́n ǀ prá-sthitān ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These sharp and blessing-bearingSomajuices are poured out; come,Vāyu, and drink of them as presented.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा दे॒वा दि॑वि॒स्पृशे॑न्द्रवा॒यू ह॑वामहे । अ॒स्य सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ divi-spṛ́śā ǀ indravāyū́ íti ǀ havāmahe ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke both the divinities abiding in heaven,IndraandVāyu, to drink of thisSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू म॑नो॒जुवा॒ विप्रा॑ हवन्त ऊ॒तये॑ । स॒ह॒स्रा॒क्षा धि॒यस्पती॑
shlokas.transliteration: indravāyū́ íti ǀ manaḥ-júvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ havante ǀ ūtáye ǀsahasra-akṣā́ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ pátī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise invoke, for their preservation,IndraandVāyu, who are swift as thought, have a thousand eyes, and are protectors of pious acts.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रं व॒यं ह॑वामहे॒ वरु॑णं॒ सोम॑पीतये । ज॒ज्ञा॒ना पू॒तद॑क्षसा
shlokas.transliteration: mitrám ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǀ váruṇam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀjajñānā́ ǀ pūtá-dakṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeMitraandVaruṇa, becoming present at the sacrifice, and of pure strength, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॒ यावृ॑ता॒वृधा॑वृ॒तस्य॒ ज्योति॑ष॒स्पती॑ । ता मि॒त्रावरु॑णा हुवे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ yáu ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ jyótiṣaḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀtā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ huve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeMitraandVaruṇa, who with true speech, are the encouragers of pious acts, and are lords of true lighṭ”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: वरु॑णः प्रावि॒ता भु॑वन्मि॒त्रो विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । कर॑तां नः सु॒राध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: váruṇaḥ ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ mitráḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀkáratām ǀ naḥ ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVaruṇabe our especial protector; mayMitradefend us with all defences; may they make us most opulent.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्व॑न्तं हवामह॒ इन्द्र॒मा सोम॑पीतये । स॒जूर्ग॒णेन॑ तृम्पतु
shlokas.transliteration: marútvantam ǀ havāmahe ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀsa-jū́ḥ ǀ gaṇéna ǀ tṛmpatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndra, attended by theMarutsto drink theSomajuice; may he, with his associates, be satisfied.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा॒ मरु॑द्गणा॒ देवा॑स॒: पूष॑रातयः । विश्वे॒ मम॑ श्रुता॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ márut-gaṇāḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ pū́ṣa-rātayaḥ ǀvíśve ǀ máma ǀ śruta ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineMaruts, of whomIndrais the chief andPūṣanis the donor, or benefactor; in what way, is not specified.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒त वृ॒त्रं सु॑दानव॒ इन्द्रे॑ण॒ सह॑सा यु॒जा । मा नो॑ दु॒:शंस॑ ईशत
shlokas.transliteration: hatá ǀ vṛtrám ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ sáhasā ǀ yujā́ ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsaḥ ǀ īśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal donors, along with the mighty and associatedIndra, destroyVṛtra; let not the evil one prevail against us.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑न्दे॒वान्ह॑वामहे म॒रुत॒: सोम॑पीतये । उ॒ग्रा हि पृश्नि॑मातरः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ havāmahe ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀugrā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke all the divineMaruts, who are fierce, and have the (many-   coloured) earth for their mother, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: जय॑तामिव तन्य॒तुर्म॒रुता॑मेति धृष्णु॒या । यच्छुभं॑ या॒थना॑ नरः
shlokas.transliteration: jáyatām-iva ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ marútām ǀ eti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀyát ǀ śúbham ǀ yāthána ǀ naraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whenever, leaders (of men), you accept an auspicious (offering), then the shout of theMarutsspreads with exultation, like (that) of conquerors.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒स्का॒राद्वि॒द्युत॒स्पर्यतो॑ जा॒ता अ॑वन्तु नः । म॒रुतो॑ मृळयन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: haskārā́t ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ pári ǀ átaḥ ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ naḥ ǀmarútaḥ ǀ mṛḷayantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, born from the brilliant lightning, everywhere preserve us, and make us happy.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: आ पू॑षञ्चि॒त्रब॑र्हिष॒माघृ॑णे ध॒रुणं॑ दि॒वः । आजा॑ न॒ष्टं यथा॑ प॒शुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pūṣan ǀ citrá-barhiṣam ǀ ā́ghṛṇe ǀ dharúṇam ǀ diváḥ ǀā́ ǀ aja ǀ naṣṭám ǀ yáthā ǀ paśúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resplendent and (swift) movingPūṣan, bring from heaven theSomajuice, in combination with the variegated sacred grass, as (a man brings back) an animal that was lost.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षा राजा॑न॒माघृ॑णि॒रप॑गूळ्हं॒ गुहा॑ हि॒तम् । अवि॑न्दच्चि॒त्रब॑र्हिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ ā́ghṛṇiḥ ǀ ápa-gūḷham ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀávindat ǀ citrá-barhiṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The resplendentPūṣanhas found the royal (Somajuice), although concealed, hidden in a secret plural ce, strewed amongst the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो स मह्य॒मिन्दु॑भि॒: षड्यु॒क्ताँ अ॑नु॒सेषि॑धत् । गोभि॒र्यवं॒ न च॑र्कृषत्
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ máhyam ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ yuktā́n ǀ anu-sésidhat ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ yávam ǀ ná ǀ carkṛṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily he has brought to me successively the six (seasons), connected with the drops (of theSomajuice) as (a husbandsman) repeatedly plural ughs (the earth) for barley.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒म्बयो॑ य॒न्त्यध्व॑भिर्जा॒मयो॑ अध्वरीय॒ताम् । पृ॒ञ्च॒तीर्मधु॑ना॒ पय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ambáyaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ ádhva-bhiḥ ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ adhvari-yatā́m ǀpṛñcatī́ḥ ǀ mádhunā ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mothers to us, who are desirous of sacrificing, the kindred (waters) flow by the paths (of sacrifice) qualifying the milk (of kine) with sweetnesṣ”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मूर्या उप॒ सूर्ये॒ याभि॑र्वा॒ सूर्य॑: स॒ह । ता नो॑ हिन्वन्त्वध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: amū́ḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sū́rye ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ sahá ǀtā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ hinvantu ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those waters which are contiguous to the Sun, and those with which the Sun is associated, be propitious to our rite.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पो दे॒वीरुप॑ ह्वये॒ यत्र॒ गाव॒: पिब॑न्ति नः । सिन्धु॑भ्य॒: कर्त्वं॑ ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ hvaye ǀ yátra ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ píbanti ǀ naḥ ǀsíndhu-bhyaḥ ǀ kártvam ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoke the divine waters in which our cattle drink; offer oblations to the following (streams).”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर॒मृत॑म॒प्सु भे॑ष॒जम॒पामु॒त प्रश॑स्तये । देवा॒ भव॑त वा॒जिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ap-sú ǀ bheṣajám ǀ apā́m ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastaye ǀdévāḥ ǀ bhávata ǀ vājínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ambrosia is in the waters; in the waters are medicinal herbs; therefore, divine (priest), be prompt in their praise.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्सु मे॒ सोमो॑ अब्रवीद॒न्तर्विश्वा॑नि भेष॒जा । अ॒ग्निं च॑ वि॒श्वश॑म्भुव॒माप॑श्च वि॒श्वभे॑षजीः
shlokas.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ me ǀ sómaḥ ǀ abravīt ǀ antáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀagním ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-śambhuvam ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-bheṣajīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somahas declared to me, 'all medicaments, as well asAgni, the benefactor of the universe, are in the waters'; the waters, contain all healing herbs.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑: पृणी॒त भे॑ष॒जं वरू॑थं त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ मम॑ । ज्योक्च॒ सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ pṛṇītá ǀ bheṣajám ǀ várūtham ǀ tanvé ǀ máma ǀjyók ǀ ca ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, bring to perfection all disease-dispelling medicaments for (the good of) my body, that I may long behold the sun.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दमा॑प॒: प्र व॑हत॒ यत्किं च॑ दुरि॒तं मयि॑ । यद्वा॒हम॑भिदु॒द्रोह॒ यद्वा॑ शे॒प उ॒तानृ॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ āpaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vahata ǀ yát ǀ kím ǀ ca ǀ duḥ-itám ǀ máyi ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ ahám ǀ abhi-dudróha ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ śepé ǀ utá ǀ ánṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, take away whatever sin has been (found) in me whether I have (knowingly) done wrong, or have pronounced imprecations (against holy men) or (have spoken) untruth.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॑ अ॒द्यान्व॑चारिषं॒ रसे॑न॒ सम॑गस्महि । पय॑स्वानग्न॒ आ ग॑हि॒ तं मा॒ सं सृ॑ज॒ वर्च॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ánu ǀ acāriṣam ǀ rásena ǀ sám ǀ agasmahi ǀpáyasvān ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ tám ǀ mā ǀ sám ǀ sṛja ǀ várcasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have this day entered into the waters; we have mingled with their essence;Agni, abiding in the waters, approach, and fill me, thus (bathed), with vigour.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Vayu, Indra-Vayu, Mitra-Varuna, Indra-Marutvan, Vishvedeva, Pushan, Apah, Agni
shlokas.sanskrit: सं मा॑ग्ने॒ वर्च॑सा सृज॒ सं प्र॒जया॒ समायु॑षा । वि॒द्युर्मे॑ अस्य दे॒वा इन्द्रो॑ विद्यात्स॒ह ऋषि॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ mā ǀ agne ǀ várcasā ǀ sṛja ǀ sám ǀ pra-jáyā ǀ sám ǀ ā́yuṣā ǀvidyúḥ ǀ me ǀ asya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vidyāt ǀ sahá ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, confer upon me vigour, progeny and life, so that the gods may know the (sacrifice) of this my (employer), andIndrawith the Ṛṣis, may know it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्य॑ नू॒नं क॑त॒मस्या॒मृता॑नां॒ मना॑महे॒ चारु॑ दे॒वस्य॒ नाम॑ । को नो॑ म॒ह्या अदि॑तये॒ पुन॑र्दात्पि॒तरं॑ च दृ॒शेयं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: kásya ǀ nūnám ǀ katamásya ǀ amṛ́tānām ǀ mánāmahe ǀ cā́ru ǀ devásya ǀ nā́ma ǀkáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahyái ǀ áditaye ǀ púnaḥ ǀ dāt ǀ pitáram ǀ ca ǀ dṛśéyam ǀ mātáram ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom, or of which divinity of the immortals, shall we invoke the auspicious name? who will give us to the greatAditithat I may again behold my father and my mother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्व॒यं प्र॑थ॒मस्या॒मृता॑नां॒ मना॑महे॒ चारु॑ दे॒वस्य॒ नाम॑ । स नो॑ म॒ह्या अदि॑तये॒ पुन॑र्दात्पि॒तरं॑ च दृ॒शेयं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ vayám ǀ prathamásya ǀ amṛ́tānām ǀ mánāmahe ǀ cā́ru ǀ devásya ǀ nā́ma ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahyái ǀ áditaye ǀ púnaḥ ǀ dāt ǀ pitáram ǀ ca ǀ dṛśéyam ǀ mātáram ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us invoke the auspicious name ofAgni, the first divinity of the immortals, that he may give us to the greatAditi, and that I may behold agin my father and my mother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॑ देव सवित॒रीशा॑नं॒ वार्या॑णाम् । सदा॑वन्भा॒गमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀsádā ǀ avan ǀ bhāgám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ever-protectingSavitā, we solicit (our) portion of you, who are the lord of affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यश्चि॒द्धि त॑ इ॒त्था भग॑: शशमा॒नः पु॒रा नि॒दः । अ॒द्वे॒षो हस्त॑योर्द॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ itthā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ nidáḥ ǀadveṣáḥ ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ dadhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That wealth which has been retained in yourhands, and is entitled to commendation, as exempt from envy or reproach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भग॑भक्तस्य ते व॒यमुद॑शेम॒ तवाव॑सा । मू॒र्धानं॑ रा॒य आ॒रभे॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhága-bhaktasya ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ út ǀ aśema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀmūrdhā́nam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā-rábhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We are assiduous in attaining the summit of affluence, through the protection of you, who are the possessor of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ते॑ क्ष॒त्रं न सहो॒ न म॒न्युं वय॑श्च॒नामी प॒तय॑न्त आ॒पुः । नेमा आपो॑ अनिमि॒षं चर॑न्ती॒र्न ये वात॑स्य प्रमि॒नन्त्यभ्व॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ná ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ manyúm ǀ váyaḥ ǀ caná ǀ amī́ íti ǀ patáyantaḥ ǀ āpúḥ ǀná ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ani-miṣám ǀ cárantīḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ vā́tasya ǀ pra-minánti ǀ ábhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These birds, that are flying (through the air), have not obtained,Varuṇa, your bodily strength or your prowess, or (are able to endure your) wrath; neither do these waters that flow increasingly, nor (do the gales) of wind, surpass your speed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒बु॒ध्ने राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ वन॑स्यो॒र्ध्वं स्तूपं॑ ददते पू॒तद॑क्षः । नी॒चीना॑: स्थुरु॒परि॑ बु॒ध्न ए॑षाम॒स्मे अ॒न्तर्निहि॑ताः के॒तव॑: स्युः
shlokas.transliteration: abudhné ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ vánasya ǀ ūrdhvám ǀ stū́pam ǀ dadate ǀ pūtá-dakṣaḥ ǀnīcī́nāḥ ǀ sthuḥ ǀ upári ǀ budhnáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ asmé íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ ní-hitāḥ ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ syuríti syuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The regalVaruṇa, of pure vigour (abiding) in the baseless (firmament), sustains on high a heap of light, the rays (of which) are pointed downwards, while their base is above; may they become concentrated in us as the sources of existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रुं हि राजा॒ वरु॑णश्च॒कार॒ सूर्या॑य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑त॒वा उ॑ । अ॒पदे॒ पादा॒ प्रति॑धातवेऽकरु॒ताप॑व॒क्ता हृ॑दया॒विध॑श्चित्
shlokas.transliteration: urúm ǀ hí ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu-etavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀapáde ǀ pā́dā ǀ práti-dhātave ǀ akaḥ ǀ utá ǀ apa-vaktā́ ǀ hṛdaya-vídhaḥ ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The regalVaruṇaverily made with the path of the sun, (by which) to travel on his daily course; a path to traverse in pathless (space); may he be the repeller of every afflicter of the heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं ते॑ राजन्भि॒षज॑: स॒हस्र॑मु॒र्वी ग॑भी॒रा सु॑म॒तिष्टे॑ अस्तु । बाध॑स्व दू॒रे निॠ॑तिं परा॒चैः कृ॒तं चि॒देन॒: प्र मु॑मुग्ध्य॒स्मत्
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ te ǀ rājan ǀ bhiṣájaḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ urvī́ ǀ gabhīrā́ ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ te ǀ astu ǀbā́dhasva ǀ dūré ǀ níḥ-ṛtim ǀ parācáiḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ énaḥ ǀ prá ǀ mumugdhi ǀ asmát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yours, O king, are a hundred and a thousand medicaments; may your favour, comprehensive and profound, be (with us); keep afar from usNirṛti, with unfriendly looks, and liberate us from whatever sin we may have committed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मी य ऋक्षा॒ निहि॑तास उ॒च्चा नक्तं॒ ददृ॑श्रे॒ कुह॑ चि॒द्दिवे॑युः । अद॑ब्धानि॒ वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑ वि॒चाक॑शच्च॒न्द्रमा॒ नक्त॑मेति
shlokas.transliteration: amī́ íti ǀ yé ǀ ṛ́kṣāḥ ǀ ní-hitāsaḥ ǀ uccā́ ǀ náktam ǀ dádṛśre ǀ kúha ǀ cit ǀ dívā ǀ īyuḥ ǀádabdhāni ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ vi-cā́kaśat ǀ candrámāḥ ǀ náktam ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These constellations plural ced on high, which are visible by night, and go elsewhere by day, are the undisturbed holy acts ofVaruṇa(and by his command) the moon moves resplendent by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त्वा॑ यामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वन्द॑मान॒स्तदा शा॑स्ते॒ यज॑मानो ह॒विर्भि॑: । अहे॑ळमानो वरुणे॒ह बो॒ध्युरु॑शंस॒ मा न॒ आयु॒: प्र मो॑षीः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ tvā ǀ yāmi ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ śāste ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀáheḷamānaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ ihá ǀ bodhi ǀ úru-śaṃsa ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ moṣīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praising you with (devout) prayer, I implore you for that (life) which the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice solicits with oblations;Varuṇa, undisdainful, bestow a thought upon us; much-lauded, take not away our existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिन्नक्तं॒ तद्दिवा॒ मह्य॑माहु॒स्तद॒यं केतो॑ हृ॒द आ वि च॑ष्टे । शुन॒:शेपो॒ यमह्व॑द्गृभी॒तः सो अ॒स्मान्राजा॒ वरु॑णो मुमोक्तु
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ náktam ǀ tát ǀ dívā ǀ máhyam ǀ āhuḥ ǀ tát ǀ ayám ǀ kétaḥ ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀśúnaḥśépaḥ ǀ yám ǀ áhvat ǀ gṛbhītáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mumoktu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (your praise) they repeat to me by night and by day; this knowledge speaks to my heart; may he whom the fettered Śunahśepas has invoked, may the regalVaruṇaset us free.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुन॒:शेपो॒ ह्यह्व॑द्गृभी॒तस्त्रि॒ष्वा॑दि॒त्यं द्रु॑प॒देषु॑ ब॒द्धः । अवै॑नं॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णः ससृज्याद्वि॒द्वाँ अद॑ब्धो॒ वि मु॑मोक्तु॒ पाशा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śúnaḥśépaḥ ǀ hí ǀ áhvat ǀ gṛbhītáḥ ǀ triṣú ǀ ādityám ǀ dru-padéṣu ǀ baddháḥ ǀáva ǀ enam ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sasṛjyāt ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ mumoktu ǀ pā́śān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śunahśepas, seized and bound to the three-footed tree, has invoked the son ofAditi; may the regalVaruṇa, wise and irresistible, liberate him; may he let loose his bonds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ ते॒ हेळो॑ वरुण॒ नमो॑भि॒रव॑ य॒ज्ञेभि॑रीमहे ह॒विर्भि॑: । क्षय॑न्न॒स्मभ्य॑मसुर प्रचेता॒ राज॒न्नेनां॑सि शिश्रथः कृ॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ te ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ áva ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀkṣáyan ǀ asmábhyam ǀ asura ǀ praceta íti pra-cetaḥ ǀ rā́jan ǀ énāṃsi ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇa, we deprecate your wrath with prostrations, with sacrifices, with oblations; averter of misfortune, wise and illustrious, be present amongst us, and mitigate the evils we have committed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मं श्र॑थाय । अथा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ut-tamám ǀ varuṇa ǀ pā́śam ǀ asmát ǀ áva ǀ adhamám ǀ ví ǀ madhyamám ǀ śrathaya ǀátha ǀ vayám ǀ āditya ǀ vraté ǀ táva ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ áditaye ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇa, loosen for me the upper, the middle, the lower band; so, son ofAditi, shall we, through faultlessness in the worship, become freed from siṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि ते॒ विशो॑ यथा॒ प्र दे॑व वरुण व्र॒तम् । मि॒नी॒मसि॒ द्यवि॑द्यवि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ víśaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ prá ǀ deva ǀ varuṇa ǀ vratám ǀminīmási ǀ dyávi-dyavi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as all people commit errors, so do we, divineVaruṇa, daily disfigure your worship by imperfections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ व॒धाय॑ ह॒त्नवे॑ जिहीळा॒नस्य॑ रीरधः । मा हृ॑णा॒नस्य॑ म॒न्यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadhā́ya ǀ hatnáve ǀ jihīḷānásya ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ hṛṇānásya ǀ manyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make us not the objects of death, through your fatal indignation, through the wrath of you so displeasured.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि मृ॑ळी॒काय॑ ते॒ मनो॑ र॒थीरश्वं॒ न संदि॑तम् । गी॒र्भिर्व॑रुण सीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ sám-ditam ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ sīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We soothe your mind,Varuṇa, by our praises, for our good, as a charioteer his weary steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॒ हि मे॒ विम॑न्यव॒: पत॑न्ति॒ वस्य॑इष्टये । वयो॒ न व॑स॒तीरुप॑
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ hí ǀ me ǀ ví-manyavaḥ ǀ pátanti ǀ vásyaḥ-iṣṭaye ǀváyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vasatī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My tranquil (meditations) revert to the desire of life, as birds hover around their nests. =vasyaiṣṭaye =vasumataḥ, precious (i.e. jīvasya, life's).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा क्ष॑त्र॒श्रियं॒ नर॒मा वरु॑णं करामहे । मृ॒ळी॒कायो॑रु॒चक्ष॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ kṣatra-śríyam ǀ náram ǀ ā́ ǀ váruṇam ǀ karāmahe ǀmṛḷīkā́ya ǀ uru-cákṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When for our happiness, shall we bring hitherVaruṇa, eminent in strength, the guide (of men), the regarder of many?”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदित्स॑मा॒नमा॑शाते॒ वेन॑न्ता॒ न प्र यु॑च्छतः । धृ॒तव्र॑ताय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ samānám ǀ āśāte íti ǀ vénantā ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ yucchataḥ ǀdhṛtá-vratāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Partake, (MitraandVaruṇa), of the common (oblation), being propitious to the giver and celebrator of this pious rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेदा॒ यो वी॒नां प॒दम॒न्तरि॑क्षेण॒ पत॑ताम् । वेद॑ ना॒वः स॑मु॒द्रिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: véda ǀ yáḥ ǀ vīnā́m ǀ padám ǀ antárikṣeṇa ǀ pátatām ǀvéda ǀ nāváḥ ǀ samudríyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who knows the path of the birds flying through the air; he, abiding in the ocean, knows (also) the course of ships.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेद॑ मा॒सो धृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ द्वाद॑श प्र॒जाव॑तः । वेदा॒ य उ॑प॒जाय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: véda ǀ māsáḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ dvā́daśa ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀvéda ǀ yáḥ ǀ upa-jā́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who accepting the rites (dedicated to him) knows the twelve months and their productions and that which is supplementarily engendered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेद॒ वात॑स्य वर्त॒निमु॒रोॠ॒ष्वस्य॑ बृह॒तः । वेदा॒ ये अ॒ध्यास॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: véda ǀ vā́tasya ǀ vartaním ǀ uróḥ ǀ ṛṣvásya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀvéda ǀ yé ǀ adhi-ā́sate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who knows the path of the vast, the graceful, and the excellent wind, and who knows those who reside above.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ष॑साद धृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ वरु॑णः प॒स्त्या॒३॒॑स्वा । साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sasāda ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ pastyā́su ǀ ā́ ǀsā́m-rājyāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He,Varuṇa, the acceptor of holy rites, the doer of good deeds, has sat down amongs the (divine) progeny, to exercise supreme dominion (over them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अतो॒ विश्वा॒न्यद्भु॑ता चिकि॒त्वाँ अ॒भि प॑श्यति । कृ॒तानि॒ या च॒ कर्त्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ ádbhutā ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ abhí ǀ paśyati ǀkṛtā́ni ǀ yā́ ǀ ca ǀ kártvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through him, the sage beholds all the marvels that hav ebeen or will be wrought.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ वि॒श्वाहा॑ सु॒क्रतु॑रादि॒त्यः सु॒पथा॑ करत् । प्र ण॒ आयूं॑षि तारिषत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ su-páthā ǀ karat ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ tāriṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that very wise son ofAditi, keep us all our days in the right path, and prolong our lives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बिभ्र॑द्द्रा॒पिं हि॑र॒ण्ययं॒ वरु॑णो वस्त नि॒र्णिज॑म् । परि॒ स्पशो॒ नि षे॑दिरे
shlokas.transliteration: bíbhrat ǀ drāpím ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ vasta ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀpári ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇaclothes his well-nourished (person n), wearing golden armour, whence the (reflected)  rays are spread around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं दिप्स॑न्ति दि॒प्सवो॒ न द्रुह्वा॑णो॒ जना॑नाम् । न दे॒वम॒भिमा॑तयः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ dípsanti ǀ dipsávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ drúhvāṇaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀná ǀ devám ǀ abhí-mātayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A divine (being), whom enemies dare not to offend; nor the oppressors of mankind, nor the iniquitous, (venture to displease).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त यो मानु॑षे॒ष्वा यश॑श्च॒क्रे असा॒म्या । अ॒स्माक॑मु॒दरे॒ष्वा
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ cakré ǀ ásāmi ǀ ā́ ǀasmā́kam ǀ udáreṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who has distributed unlimited food to mankind, and especially to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ मे यन्ति धी॒तयो॒ गावो॒ न गव्यू॑ती॒रनु॑ । इ॒च्छन्ती॑रुरु॒चक्ष॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ me ǀ yanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ gávyūtīḥ ǀ ánu ǀicchántīḥ ǀ uru-cákṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My thoughts ever turn back to him who is beheld of many, as the kine return to the pastures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं नु वो॑चावहै॒ पुन॒र्यतो॑ मे॒ मध्वाभृ॑तम् । होते॑व॒ क्षद॑से प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ nú ǀ vocāvahai ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ me ǀ mádhu ǀ ā́-bhṛtam ǀhótā-iva ǀ kṣádase ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us together proclaim that my offering has been prepared, and that you, as if the offerer, accept the valued (oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दर्शं॒ नु वि॒श्वद॑र्शतं॒ दर्शं॒ रथ॒मधि॒ क्षमि॑ । ए॒ता जु॑षत मे॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dárśam ǀ nú ǀ viśvá-darśatam ǀ dárśam ǀ rátham ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀetā́ḥ ǀ juṣata ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have seen him whose appearance is grateful to all; I have beheld his chariot upon earth; he has accepted these my praiseṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं मे॑ वरुण श्रुधी॒ हव॑म॒द्या च॑ मृळय । त्वाम॑व॒स्युरा च॑के
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ me ǀ varuṇa ǀ śrudhi ǀ hávam ǀ adyá ǀ ca ǀ mṛḷaya ǀtvā́m ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear,Varuṇa, this my invocation; make us this day happy; I have appealed to you, hoping for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं विश्व॑स्य मेधिर दि॒वश्च॒ ग्मश्च॑ राजसि । स याम॑नि॒ प्रति॑ श्रुधि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ medhira ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ rājasi ǀsáḥ ǀ yā́mani ǀ práti ǀ śrudhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, who are possessed of wisdom, shine over heaven and earth, and all the world; do you hear and reply (to my prayers), with (promise of) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑त्त॒मं मु॑मुग्धि नो॒ वि पाशं॑ मध्य॒मं चृ॑त । अवा॑ध॒मानि॑ जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ut-tamám ǀ mumugdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ pā́śam ǀ madhyamám ǀ cṛta ǀáva ǀ adhamā́ni ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Loose us from the upper bonds, untie the centre and the lower, that we may live.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसि॑ष्वा॒ हि मि॑येध्य॒ वस्त्रा॑ण्यूर्जां पते । सेमं नो॑ अध्व॒रं य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: vásiṣva ǀ hí ǀ miyedhya ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of sustenance, assume your vestments (of light) and offer this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि नो॒ होता॒ वरे॑ण्य॒: सदा॑ यविष्ठ॒ मन्म॑भिः । अग्ने॑ दि॒वित्म॑ता॒ वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ naḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀágne ǀ divítmatā ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Propitiated) by brilliant strains, do your, ever-youthfulAgni, selected by us, become our ministrant priest, (invested) with radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ हि ष्मा॑ सू॒नवे॑ पि॒तापिर्यज॑त्या॒पये॑ । सखा॒ सख्ये॒ वरे॑ण्यः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ sūnáve ǀ pitā́ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ yájati ǀ āpáye ǀsákhā ǀ sákhye ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are verily as a loving father to a son, as a kinsman to a kinsman, as a friend to a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ ब॒र्ही रि॒शाद॑सो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । सीद॑न्तु॒ मनु॑षो यथा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀsī́dantu ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetVaruṇa,MitraandĀryaman, sit down upon our sacred grass, as they did at the sacrifice ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्व्य॑ होतर॒स्य नो॒ मन्द॑स्व स॒ख्यस्य॑ च । इ॒मा उ॒ षु श्रु॑धी॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rvya ǀ hotaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ mándasva ǀ sakhyásya ǀ ca ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śrudhi ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preceding sacrificer, be plural ased with this our sacrifice and with our friendship, and listen to these your praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि शश्व॑ता॒ तना॑ दे॒वंदे॑वं॒ यजा॑महे । त्वे इद्धू॑यते ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatā ǀ tánā ǀ devám-devam ǀ yájāmahe ǀtvé íti ǀ ít ǀ hūyate ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever we offer in repeated and plural ntiful oblation to any other deity, is assuredly offered to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒यो नो॑ अस्तु वि॒श्पति॒र्होता॑ म॒न्द्रो वरे॑ण्यः । प्रि॒याः स्व॒ग्नयो॑ व॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: priyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀpriyā́ḥ ǀ su-agnáyaḥ ǀ vayám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the lord of men, the sacrificing priest, the gracious, the chosen, be kind to us; may we, possessed of holy fires, be   loved of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒ग्नयो॒ हि वार्यं॑ दे॒वासो॑ दधि॒रे च॑ नः । स्व॒ग्नयो॑ मनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: su-agnáyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ vā́ryam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀsu-agnáyaḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the brilliant (priests), possessed of holy fires, have taken charge of our oblations, so we, with holy fires, pray to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अथा॑ न उ॒भये॑षा॒ममृ॑त॒ मर्त्या॑नाम् । मि॒थः स॑न्तु॒ प्रश॑स्तयः
shlokas.transliteration: átha ǀ naḥ ǀ ubháyeṣām ǀ ámṛta ǀ mártyānām ǀmitháḥ ǀ santu ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImmortalAgni, may the praises of mankind be henceforth mutually (the sources of happiness) to both, (to ourselves and to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑भिरग्ने अ॒ग्निभि॑रि॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒दं वच॑: । चनो॑ धाः सहसो यहो
shlokas.transliteration: víśvebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀcánaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, (accept) this sacrifice, and this our praise, with all your fires, and grant us (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वं॒ न त्वा॒ वार॑वन्तं व॒न्दध्या॑ अ॒ग्निं नमो॑भिः । स॒म्राज॑न्तमध्व॒राणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvam ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ vā́ra-vantam ǀ vandádhyai ǀ agním ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀsam-rā́jantam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I proceed) to address you, the soverign lord of sacrifice, with praises, (for you scatter our fores) like a horse (who brushes off flies with) his tail.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॑ नः सू॒नुः शव॑सा पृ॒थुप्र॑गामा सु॒शेव॑: । मी॒ढ्वाँ अ॒स्माकं॑ बभूयात्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ pṛthú-pragāmā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀmīḍhvā́n ǀ asmā́kam ǀ babhūyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, the son of strength, who moves everywhere fleetly, be propitious to us, and shower down (blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ दू॒राच्चा॒साच्च॒ नि मर्त्या॑दघा॒योः । पा॒हि सद॒मिद्वि॒श्वायु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ca ǀ āsā́t ǀ ca ǀ ní ǀ mártyāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀpāhí ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, who go everywhere, ever protect us, whether near or afar, from men seeking to do us injury.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ममू॒ षु त्वम॒स्माकं॑ स॒निं गा॑य॒त्रं नव्यां॑सम् । अग्ने॑ दे॒वेषु॒ प्र वो॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ saním ǀ gāyatrám ǀ návyāṃsam ǀágne ǀ devéṣu ǀ prá ǀ vocaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, announce to the gods this our offering, and these our newest hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ भज पर॒मेष्वा वाजे॑षु मध्य॒मेषु॑ । शिक्षा॒ वस्वो॒ अन्त॑मस्य
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhaja ǀ paraméṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ madhyaméṣu ǀśíkṣa ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ántamasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Procure for us the food that is in heaven and mid-air, and grant us the wealth that is on earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भ॒क्तासि॑ चित्रभानो॒ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा उ॑पा॒क आ । स॒द्यो दा॒शुषे॑ क्षरसि
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhaktā́ ǀ asi ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmáu ǀ upāké ǀ ā́ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ kṣarasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Citrabhānu, are the   distributor of riches, as the waves of a river are parted by interjacent (islets); you ever pour (rewards) upon the giver (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने पृ॒त्सु मर्त्य॒मवा॒ वाजे॑षु॒ यं जु॒नाः । स यन्ता॒ शश्व॑ती॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ agne ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ mártyam ǀ ávāḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ yám ǀ junā́ḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ yántā ǀ śáśvatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal whom you,Agni, protect in battle, whom you incite to combat, will always command (food).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑रस्य सहन्त्य पर्ये॒ता कय॑स्य चित् । वाजो॑ अस्ति श्र॒वाय्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ sahantya ǀ pari-etā́ ǀ káyasya ǀ cit ǀvā́jaḥ ǀ asti ǀ śravā́yyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one will ever be the vanquisher of this your worshipper, subduer of enemies, for notorious in his prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वाजं॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणि॒रर्व॑द्भिरस्तु॒ तरु॑ता । विप्रे॑भिरस्तु॒ सनि॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ astu ǀ tárutā ǀvíprebhiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sánitā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is worshipped by all men, convey us with horses through the battle; may he, (propitiated) by the priests, be the bestower (of bounties).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जरा॑बोध॒ तद्वि॑विड्ढि वि॒शेवि॑शे य॒ज्ञिया॑य । स्तोमं॑ रु॒द्राय॒ दृशी॑कम्
shlokas.transliteration: járā-bodha ǀ tát ǀ viviḍḍhi ǀ viśé-viśe ǀ yajñíyāya ǀstómam ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ dṛ́śīkam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Jarābodha, enter into the oblation for the completion of the sacrifice that benefits all mankind; the worshipper offers agreeable laudation to the terrible (Agni).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ म॒हाँ अ॑निमा॒नो धू॒मके॑तुः पुरुश्च॒न्द्रः । धि॒ये वाजा॑य हिन्वतु
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ ani-mānáḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketuḥ ǀ puru-candráḥ ǀdhiyé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ hinvatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the vast, illimitable, smoke- bannered, resplendentAgnibe plural ased with our rite, and grant us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रे॒वाँ इ॑व वि॒श्पति॒र्दैव्य॑: के॒तुः शृ॑णोतु नः । उ॒क्थैर॒ग्निर्बृ॒हद्भा॑नुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ revā́n-iva ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ naḥ ǀuktháiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bṛhát-bhānuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the lord of men, the invoker and messenger of the gods, the brilliant-rayed, hear us with our hymns, as a prince (listens to the bards).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नमो॑ म॒हद्भ्यो॒ नमो॑ अर्भ॒केभ्यो॒ नमो॒ युव॑भ्यो॒ नम॑ आशि॒नेभ्य॑: । यजा॑म दे॒वान्यदि॑ श॒क्नवा॑म॒ मा ज्याय॑स॒: शंस॒मा वृ॑क्षि देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: námaḥ ǀ mahát-bhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ arbhakébhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ yúvabhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ āśinébhyaḥ ǀyájāma ǀ devā́n ǀ yádi ǀ śaknávāma ǀ mā́ ǀ jyā́yasaḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛkṣi ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Veneration to the great gods, veneration to the lesser, veneration to the young, veneration to the old we worship (all) the gods as well as we are able; may I not omit the praise of the elder divinities.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ ग्रावा॑ पृ॒थुबु॑ध्न ऊ॒र्ध्वो भव॑ति॒ सोत॑वे । उ॒लूख॑लसुताना॒मवेद्वि॑न्द्र जल्गुलः
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ grā́vā ǀ pṛthú-budhnaḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ bhávati ǀ sótave ǀulū́khala-sutānām ǀ áva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ indra ǀ jalgulaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, as the broad-based stone is raised to express theSomajuice, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ द्वावि॑व ज॒घना॑धिषव॒ण्या॑ कृ॒ता । उ॒लूख॑लसुताना॒मवेद्वि॑न्द्र जल्गुलः
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ dváu-iva ǀ jaghánā ǀ adhi-savanyā́ ǀ kṛtā́ ǀulū́khala-sutānām ǀ áva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ indra ǀ jalgulaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, (in the rite) in which the two patters for containing the juice, as (broad as a woman's) hips, are employed, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ नार्य॑पच्य॒वमु॑पच्य॒वं च॒ शिक्ष॑ते । उ॒लूख॑लसुताना॒मवेद्वि॑न्द्र जल्गुलः
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ nā́rī ǀ apa-cyavám ǀ upa-cyavám ǀ ca ǀ śíkṣate ǀulū́khala-sutānām ǀ áva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ indra ǀ jalgulaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, (in the rite) in which the housewife repeats egress from and ingress into (the sacrificial chamber), recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ मन्थां॑ विब॒ध्नते॑ र॒श्मीन्यमि॑त॒वा इ॑व । उ॒लूख॑लसुताना॒मवेद्वि॑न्द्र जल्गुलः
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ mánthām ǀ vi-badhnáte ǀ raśmī́n ǀ yámitavái-iva ǀulū́khala-sutānām ǀ áva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ indra ǀ jalgulaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When they bind the churning-staff (with a cord), like reins to restrain (a horse),Indra, recognize and partake of the effusion of the mortar.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि त्वं गृ॒हेगृ॑ह॒ उलू॑खलक यु॒ज्यसे॑ । इ॒ह द्यु॒मत्त॑मं वद॒ जय॑तामिव दुन्दु॒भिः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ gṛhé-gṛhe ǀ úlūkhalaka ǀ yujyáse ǀihá ǀ dyumát-tamam ǀ vada ǀ jáyatām-iva ǀ dundubhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If indeed, O Mortar, you are present in every house, give forth (in this rite) a lusty sound, like the drum of a victorious host.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्म॑ ते वनस्पते॒ वातो॒ वि वा॒त्यग्र॒मित् । अथो॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे सु॒नु सोम॑मुलूखल
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ vanaspate ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ví ǀ vāti ǀ ágram ǀ ít ǀátho íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀ sunú ǀ sómam ǀ ulūkhala ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lorf of the forest, as the wind genitive ly blows before you, so do thou, O Mortar, prepare theSomajuice for the beverage ofIndra.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒य॒जी वा॑ज॒सात॑मा॒ ता ह्यु१॒॑च्चा वि॑जर्भृ॒तः । हरी॑ इ॒वान्धां॑सि॒ बप्स॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: āyajī́ ítyā-yajī́ ǀ vāja-sā́tamā ǀ tā́ ǀ hí ǀ uccā́ ǀ vi-jarbhṛtáḥ ǀhárī ivéti hárī-iva ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ bápsatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Implements of sacrifice, bestowers of food, loud-sounding, sport like the horses ofIndrachamping the grain.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: ता नो॑ अ॒द्य व॑नस्पती ऋ॒ष्वावृ॒ष्वेभि॑: सो॒तृभि॑: । इन्द्रा॑य॒ मधु॑मत्सुतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vanaspatī íti ǀ ṛṣváu ǀ ṛṣvébhiḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ sutam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you two forest lords, of plural asing form, prepare with agreeable libations our sweet (Soma) juices forIndra.”

shlokas.sukta_devata: Indra, Ulukhala, Ulukhala-Musala, Prajapati, Harishchandra, Soma
shlokas.sanskrit: उच्छि॒ष्टं च॒म्वो॑र्भर॒ सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ सृ॑ज । नि धे॑हि॒ गोरधि॑ त्व॒चि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ śiṣṭám ǀ camvóḥ ǀ bhara ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛja ǀní ǀ dhehi ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring the remains of theSomajuice upon the plural tters, sprinkle it upon the blades ofkuśagrass and plural ce the reminder upon the cow-hide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि स॑त्य सोमपा अनाश॒स्ता इ॑व॒ स्मसि॑ । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ satya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ anāśastā́ḥ-iva ǀ smási ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Veracious drinker of theSomajuice, although we be unworthy, do your,Indra, of boundless wealth enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिप्रि॑न्वाजानां पते॒ शची॑व॒स्तव॑ दं॒सना॑ । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: śíprin ǀ vājānām ǀ pate ǀ śácī-vaḥ ǀ táva ǀ daṃsánā ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your benevolence, handsome and mighty lord of food, endures for ever; therefore,Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ष्वा॑पया मिथू॒दृशा॑ स॒स्तामबु॑ध्यमाने । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ svāpaya ǀ mithu-dṛ́śā ǀ sastā́m ǀ ábudhyamāne íti ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cast asleep (the two feminine le messengers ofYama); looking at each other, let them sleep, never waking;Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒सन्तु॒ त्या अरा॑तयो॒ बोध॑न्तु शूर रा॒तय॑: । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: sasántu ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ bódhantu ǀ śūra ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who are our enemies, slumber, and those, O hero, who are our friends, be awake;Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑न्द्र गर्द॒भं मृ॑ण नु॒वन्तं॑ पा॒पया॑मु॒या । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ indra ǀ gardabhám ǀ mṛṇa ǀ nuvántam ǀ pāpáyā ǀ amuyā́ ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, destroy this ass, (our adversary), praising you with such discordant speech; and do your, Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पता॑ति कुण्डृ॒णाच्या॑ दू॒रं वातो॒ वना॒दधि॑ । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: pátāti ǀ kuṇḍṛṇā́cyā ǀ dūrám ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ vánāt ǀ ádhi ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us (adverse) breeze, with crooked course, alight afar off on the forest;Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वं॑ परिक्रो॒शं ज॑हि ज॒म्भया॑ कृकदा॒श्व॑म् । आ तू न॑ इन्द्र शंसय॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु शु॒भ्रिषु॑ स॒हस्रे॑षु तुवीमघ
shlokas.transliteration: sárvam ǀ pari-krośám ǀ jahi ǀ jambháya ǀ kṛkadāśvám ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śaṃsaya ǀ góṣu ǀ áśveṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀ sahásreṣu ǀ tuvi-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy every one that reviles us; slay every one that does us injury;Indra, of boundless wealth, enrich us with thousands of excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ व॒ इन्द्रं॒ क्रिविं॑ यथा वाज॒यन्त॑: श॒तक्र॑तुम् । मंहि॑ष्ठं सिञ्च॒ इन्दु॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ krívim ǀ yathā ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ śatá-kratum ǀmáṃhiṣṭham ǀ siñce ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us, who are desirous of food, satisfy this yourIndra, who is mighty, and of a hundred sacrifices, with drops (ofSomajuice), as a well (is filled)(with water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं वा॒ यः शुची॑नां स॒हस्रं॑ वा॒ समा॑शिराम् । एदु॑ नि॒म्नं न री॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ śúcīnām ǀ sahásram ǀ vā ǀ sám-āśirām ǀā́ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nimnám ǀ ná ǀ rīyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is (the recipient) of a hundred pure, and of a thousand distilled, (libations), come (to the rite), as water to low (plural ces).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यन्मदा॑य शु॒ष्मिण॑ ए॒ना ह्य॑स्यो॒दरे॑ । स॒मु॒द्रो न व्यचो॑ द॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ mádāya ǀ śuṣmíṇe ǀ enā́ ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ udáre ǀsamudráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vyácaḥ ǀ dadhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All which (libations), being accusative ulated for the gratification of the powerfulIndra, is contained in his belly, as water in the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमु॑ ते॒ सम॑तसि क॒पोत॑ इव गर्भ॒धिम् । वच॒स्तच्चि॑न्न ओहसे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ sám ǀ atasi ǀ kapótaḥ-iva ǀ garbha-dhím ǀvácaḥ ǀ tát ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ ohase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This libation is (prepared) for you; you approach it as a pigeon his pregnant (mate), for on that account do you accept our prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तो॒त्रं रा॑धानां पते॒ गिर्वा॑हो वीर॒ यस्य॑ ते । विभू॑तिरस्तु सू॒नृता॑
shlokas.transliteration: stotrám ǀ rādhānām ǀ pate ǀ gírvāhaḥ ǀ vīra ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀví-bhūtiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, lord of affluence, accepter of praise, may genitive ine prosperity be (the reward of him) who offers you laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वस्ति॑ष्ठा न ऊ॒तये॒ऽस्मिन्वाजे॑ शतक्रतो । सम॒न्येषु॑ ब्रवावहै
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ asmín ǀ vā́je ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀsám ǀ anyéṣu ǀ bravāvahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up,Śatakratu, for our defence in this conflict; we will talk together in other matters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: योगे॑योगे त॒वस्त॑रं॒ वाजे॑वाजे हवामहे । सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yóge-yoge ǀ taváḥ-taram ǀ vā́je-vāje ǀ havāmahe ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “On every occasion, in every engagement, we invoke as friends the most powerfulIndrafor our defence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ घा॑ गम॒द्यदि॒ श्रव॑त्सह॒स्रिणी॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । वाजे॑भि॒रुप॑ नो॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gha ǀ gamat ǀ yádi ǀ śrávat ǀ sahasríṇībhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀvā́jebhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If he hear our invocation, let him indeed come to us with numerous bounties, and with (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ प्र॒त्नस्यौक॑सो हु॒वे तु॑विप्र॒तिं नर॑म् । यं ते॒ पूर्वं॑ पि॒ता हु॒वे
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ pratnásya ǀ ókasaḥ ǀ huvé ǀ tuvi-pratím ǀ náram ǀyám ǀ te ǀ pū́rvam ǀ pitā́ ǀ huvé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the man (Indra), who visits many worshippers from his ancient dwelling-plural ce--you, Indra, whom my father formerly invoked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं वि॑श्ववा॒रा शा॑स्महे पुरुहूत । सखे॑ वसो जरि॒तृभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ ā́ ǀ śāsmahe ǀ puru-hūta ǀsákhe ǀ vaso íti ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We implore you as our friend, who are preferred and invoked by all, (to be favourable) to your worshippers, protector of dwellings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ शि॒प्रिणी॑नां॒ सोम॑पाः सोम॒पाव्ना॑म् । सखे॑ वज्रि॒न्त्सखी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ śipríṇīnām ǀ sóma-pāḥ ǀ soma-pā́vnām ǀsákhe ǀ vajrin ǀ sákhīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker ofSomajuice, wielder of the thunderbolt, O friend, (bestow upon) us, your friends, and drinkers of the Soma juice, (abundance of cows) with projecting jaws. (śipirṇīnām, genitive plural of the feminine nine śipriṇī, having a nose of a jaw; hence gavām andsamūha(of cows and a herd) are added].”

shlokas.sanskrit: तथा॒ तद॑स्तु सोमपा॒: सखे॑ वज्रि॒न्तथा॑ कृणु । यथा॑ त उ॒श्मसी॒ष्टये॑
shlokas.transliteration: táthā ǀ tát ǀ astu ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ sákhe ǀ vajrin ǀ táthā ǀ kṛṇu ǀyáthā ǀ te ǀ uśmási ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So be it, drinker of theSomajuice, wielder of the thunderbolt, our friend, that you will do, through your favour, whatever we desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रे॒वती॑र्नः सध॒माद॒ इन्द्रे॑ सन्तु तु॒विवा॑जाः । क्षु॒मन्तो॒ याभि॒र्मदे॑म
shlokas.transliteration: revátīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sadha-mā́de ǀ índre ǀ santu ǀ tuví-vājāḥ ǀkṣu-mántaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ mádema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So,Indra, rejoicing along with us, we may have (abundant food) and cows may be ours, robust and rich in milk, with which we may be happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ घ॒ त्वावा॒न्त्मना॒प्तः स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ धृष्णविया॒नः । ऋ॒णोरक्षं॒ न च॒क्र्यो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gha ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ tmánā ǀ āptáḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ iyānáḥ ǀṛṇóḥ ǀ ákṣam ǀ ná ǀ cakryóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O Dhṛṣnu, let some such divinity as you are, self-presented, promptly bestow, when solicited, (bounties) upon your praisers, as (they whirl) the axle of the wheels (of a car).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्दुव॑: शतक्रत॒वा कामं॑ जरितॄ॒णाम् । ऋ॒णोरक्षं॒ न शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ā́ ǀ kā́mam ǀ jaritṝṇā́m ǀṛṇóḥ ǀ ákṣam ǀ ná ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such wealth,Śatakratu, as your praisers desire, you bestow upon them, as the axle (revolves) with the movements (of the wagon).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शश्व॒दिन्द्र॒: पोप्रु॑थद्भिर्जिगाय॒ नान॑दद्भि॒: शाश्व॑सद्भि॒र्धना॑नि । स नो॑ हिरण्यर॒थं दं॒सना॑वा॒न्त्स न॑: सनि॒ता स॒नये॒ स नो॑ऽदात्
shlokas.transliteration: śáśvat ǀ índraḥ ǀ pópruthat-bhiḥ ǀ jigāya ǀ nā́nadat-bhiḥ ǀ śā́śvasat-bhiḥ ǀ dhánāni ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ hiraṇya-rathám ǀ daṃsánā-vān ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sanitā́ ǀ sanáye ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas ever won riches (from his foes), with his champing, neighing, and snorting (steeds); he, the abounding in acts, the bountiful, has given us as a gift a golden chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आश्वि॑ना॒वश्वा॑वत्ये॒षा या॑तं॒ शवी॑रया । गोम॑द्दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ aśvinau ǀ áśva-vatyā ǀ iṣā́ ǀ yātam ǀ śávīrayā ǀgó-mat ǀ dasrā ǀ híraṇya-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, come hither, with viands borne or many steeds. Dasrās, (let our dwelling) be filled with cattle and with gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नयो॑जनो॒ हि वां॒ रथो॑ दस्रा॒वम॑र्त्यः । स॒मु॒द्रे अ॑श्वि॒नेय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: samāná-yojanaḥ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dasrau ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀsamudré ǀ aśvinā ǀ ī́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasrās, your chariot, harnessed for both alike, is imperishable; it travels,Aśvins, through the air.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य१॒॑घ्न्यस्य॑ मू॒र्धनि॑ च॒क्रं रथ॑स्य येमथुः । परि॒ द्याम॒न्यदी॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ aghnyásya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ cakrám ǀ ráthasya ǀ yemathuḥ ǀpári ǀ dyā́m ǀ anyát ǀ īyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have one wheel on the top of the solid (mountain), while the other revolves in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्त॑ उषः कधप्रिये भु॒जे मर्तो॑ अमर्त्ये । कं न॑क्षसे विभावरि
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ te ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ kadha-priye ǀ bhujé ǀ mártaḥ ǀ amartye ǀkám ǀ nakṣase ǀ vibhā-vari ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, who are plural ased by praise, what mortal enjoy you, immortal? Whom, mighty one, do your affect?”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं हि ते॒ अम॑न्म॒ह्यान्ता॒दा प॑रा॒कात् । अश्वे॒ न चि॑त्रे अरुषि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ ámanmahi ǀ ā́ ǀ ántāt ǀ ā́ ǀ parākā́t ǀáśve ǀ ná ǀ citre ǀ aruṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Diffusive, many-tinted, brilliant (Uṣas), we know not (your limits), whether they be nigh or remote.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं त्येभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ वाजे॑भिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं नि धा॑रय
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ ní ǀ dhāraya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, approach with these viands, and perpetuate our wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो अङ्गि॑रा॒ ऋषि॑र्दे॒वो दे॒वाना॑मभवः शि॒वः सखा॑ । तव॑ व्र॒ते क॒वयो॑ विद्म॒नाप॒सोऽजा॑यन्त म॒रुतो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ áṅgirāḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ sákhā ǀtáva ǀ vraté ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ vidmanā́-apasaḥ ǀ ájāyanta ǀ marútaḥ ǀ bhrā́jat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, was th firstAṅgirasṚṣi, a divinity, you were the auspicious friend of the deities. In your rite the wise, the all-discerning, the bright-weaponedMarutswere engendered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो अङ्गि॑रस्तमः क॒विर्दे॒वानां॒ परि॑ भूषसि व्र॒तम् । वि॒भुर्विश्व॑स्मै॒ भुव॑नाय॒ मेधि॑रो द्विमा॒ता श॒युः क॑ति॒धा चि॑दा॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ pári ǀ bhūṣasi ǀ vratám ǀvi-bhúḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ bhúvanāya ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ dvi-mātā́ ǀ śayúḥ ǀ katidhā́ ǀ cit ǀ āyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, the first and chiefAṅgiras, grace the worship of the gods; sapient, maniforld, for the benefit of all the world, intelligent, the off-spring of two mothers, and reposing in various ways for the use of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो मा॑त॒रिश्व॑न आ॒विर्भ॑व सुक्रतू॒या वि॒वस्व॑ते । अरे॑जेतां॒ रोद॑सी होतृ॒वूर्येऽस॑घ्नोर्भा॒रमय॑जो म॒हो व॑सो
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ mātaríśvane ǀ āvíḥ ǀ bhava ǀ sukratū-yā́ ǀ vivásvate ǀárejetām ǀ ródasī íti ǀ hotṛ-vū́rye ǀ ásaghnoḥ ǀ bhārám ǀ áyajaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, pre-eminent over the wind, become manifest to the worshipper, in approbation of his worship. Heaven and earth tremble (at your power); you have sustained the burden in the rite for which the priest was appointed; your,Vasu, has worshipped the venerable (gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ मन॑वे॒ द्याम॑वाशयः पुरू॒रव॑से सु॒कृते॑ सु॒कृत्त॑रः । श्वा॒त्रेण॒ यत्पि॒त्रोर्मुच्य॑से॒ पर्या त्वा॒ पूर्व॑मनय॒न्नाप॑रं॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ mánave ǀ dyā́m ǀ avāśayaḥ ǀ purūrávase ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ sukṛ́t-taraḥ ǀśvātréṇa ǀ yát ǀ pitróḥ ǀ múcyase ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ pū́rvam ǀ anayan ǀ ā́ ǀ áparam ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your,Agni, has announced heaven toManu; you have more than requitedPurūravasdoing homage to you. When you are set free by the attrition of your parents, they bear you first to the east, then to the west (of the altar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वृष॒भः पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑न॒ उद्य॑तस्रुचे भवसि श्र॒वाय्य॑: । य आहु॑तिं॒ परि॒ वेदा॒ वष॑ट्कृति॒मेका॑यु॒रग्रे॒ विश॑ आ॒विवा॑ससि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanaḥ ǀ údyata-sruce ǀ bhavasi ǀ śravā́yyaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ pári ǀ véda ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtim ǀ éka-āyuḥ ǀ ágre ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā-vívāsasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your,Agni, are the showerer (of desires), the augmenter of the prosperity (of your worshipper); you are to be called upon as the ladle is lifted up; upon him who fully understands the invocation and makes the oblation, you, the provider of sustenance, first bestow light, and then upon all men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वृजि॒नव॑र्तनिं॒ नरं॒ सक्म॑न्पिपर्षि वि॒दथे॑ विचर्षणे । यः शूर॑साता॒ परि॑तक्म्ये॒ धने॑ द॒भ्रेभि॑श्चि॒त्समृ॑ता॒ हंसि॒ भूय॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vṛjiná-vartanim ǀ náram ǀ sákman ǀ piparṣi ǀ vidáthe ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀyáḥ ǀ śū́ra-sātā ǀ pári-takmye ǀ dháne ǀ dabhrébhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ sám-ṛtā ǀ háṃsi ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, excellently wise, you direct the man who follows improper paths, to acts that are fitted to reclaim him; you who, in the strife of heroes, (grateful to them) as widely- scattered wealth, destryed in the combat the mighty by the feeble.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तम॑ग्ने अमृत॒त्व उ॑त्त॒मे मर्तं॑ दधासि॒ श्रव॑से दि॒वेदि॑वे । यस्ता॑तृषा॒ण उ॒भया॑य॒ जन्म॑ने॒ मय॑: कृ॒णोषि॒ प्रय॒ आ च॑ सू॒रये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ agne ǀ amṛta-tvé ǀ ut-tamé ǀ mártam ǀ dadhāsi ǀ śrávase ǀ divé-dive ǀyáḥ ǀ tatṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ubháyāya ǀ jánmane ǀ máyaḥ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ práyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ sūráye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You sustain,Agni, that mortal (who worships you), in the best immortality by daily food; you bestow on the sage, who is desirous (of creatures) of both kinds of birth, happiness and sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने स॒नये॒ धना॑नां य॒शसं॑ का॒रुं कृ॑णुहि॒ स्तवा॑नः । ऋ॒ध्याम॒ कर्मा॒पसा॒ नवे॑न दे॒वैर्द्या॑वापृथिवी॒ प्राव॑तं नः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǀ yaśásam ǀ kārúm ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ stávānaḥ ǀṛdhyā́ma ǀ kárma ǀ apásā ǀ návena ǀ deváiḥ ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are praised by us for the sake of wealth, render illustrious the performer of the rite; may we improve the act by a new offspring (given by you). Preserve us, heaven and earth, along with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थ॒ आ दे॒वो दे॒वेष्व॑नवद्य॒ जागृ॑विः । त॒नू॒कृद्बो॑धि॒ प्रम॑तिश्च का॒रवे॒ त्वं क॑ल्याण॒ वसु॒ विश्व॒मोपि॑षे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ anavadya ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀtanū-kṛ́t ǀ bodhi ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ ca ǀ kāráve ǀ tvám ǀ kalyāṇa ǀ vásu ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ ūpiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IrreproachableAgni, a vigilant god amongst the gods, (abiding) in the proximity of (your) parents, and bestowing upon us embodied  (progeny), aweke us. Be well disposed to the offerer of the oblation; for you, auspicious Agni, grant all riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ प्रम॑ति॒स्त्वं पि॒तासि॑ न॒स्त्वं व॑य॒स्कृत्तव॑ जा॒मयो॑ व॒यम् । सं त्वा॒ राय॑: श॒तिन॒: सं स॑ह॒स्रिण॑: सु॒वीरं॑ यन्ति व्रत॒पाम॑दाभ्य
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ pitā́ ǀ asi ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́t ǀ táva ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ vayám ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ śatínaḥ ǀ sám ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ yanti ǀ vrata-pā́m ǀ adābhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are well disposed to us, you are our protector, you are the giver of life to us; we are your kinsmen. Uninjurable Agni, hundreds and thousands of treasures belong to you, who are the defender of pious acts and attended by good men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒ममा॒युमा॒यवे॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्व॒न्नहु॑षस्य वि॒श्पति॑म् । इळा॑मकृण्व॒न्मनु॑षस्य॒ शास॑नीं पि॒तुर्यत्पु॒त्रो मम॑कस्य॒ जाय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ prathamám ǀ āyúm ǀ āyáve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ náhuṣasya ǀ viśpátim ǀíḷām ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ mánuṣasya ǀ śā́sanīm ǀ pitúḥ ǀ yát ǀ putráḥ ǀ mámakasya ǀ jā́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods formerly made you,Agni, the living genitive ral of the mortalNahuṣa; they made Iḷā, the instrumental uctress ofManu, when the son of my father was born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ तव॑ देव पा॒युभि॑र्म॒घोनो॑ रक्ष त॒न्व॑श्च वन्द्य । त्रा॒ता तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑ये॒ गवा॑म॒स्यनि॑मेषं॒ रक्ष॑माण॒स्तव॑ व्र॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ deva ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ rakṣa ǀ tanváḥ ǀ ca ǀ vandya ǀtrātā́ ǀ tokásya ǀ tánaye ǀ gávām ǀ asi ǀ áni-meṣam ǀ rákṣamāṇaḥ ǀ táva ǀ vraté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are worthy to be praised, preserve us who are opulent with your bounties, and also the person ns (of our sons); you are the defender of cattle for the son of my son, who is ever assiduous in your worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ यज्य॑वे पा॒युरन्त॑रोऽनिष॒ङ्गाय॑ चतुर॒क्ष इ॑ध्यसे । यो रा॒तह॑व्योऽवृ॒काय॒ धाय॑से की॒रेश्चि॒न्मन्त्रं॒ मन॑सा व॒नोषि॒ तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ yájyave ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ aniṣaṅgā́ya ǀ catuḥ-akṣáḥ ǀ idhyase ǀyáḥ ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ avṛkā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ kīréḥ ǀ cit ǀ mántram ǀ mánasā ǀ vanóṣi ǀ tám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your, four-eyedAgni, blaze as the protector of the worshipper, who are athandfor the (security of the) uninterrupted (rite); you cherish in your mind the prayer of your adorer, who offers the oblation to you, the harmless, the benevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्न उरु॒शंसा॑य वा॒घते॑ स्पा॒र्हं यद्रेक्ण॑: पर॒मं व॒नोषि॒ तत् । आ॒ध्रस्य॑ चि॒त्प्रम॑तिरुच्यसे पि॒ता प्र पाकं॒ शास्सि॒ प्र दिशो॑ वि॒दुष्ट॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ uru-śáṃsāya ǀ vāgháte ǀ spārhám ǀ yát ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ paramám ǀ vanóṣi ǀ tát ǀādhrásya ǀ cit ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ ucyase ǀ pitā́ ǀ prá ǀ pā́kam ǀ śā́ssi ǀ prá ǀ díśaḥ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, desire (that the worshipper may acquire) that excellent wealth which is reqquisite for the many-commended priest; you are called the well-intentioned protector. You, who are all-wise, instrumental ucted the disciple, and (define) the points of the horizon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ प्रय॑तदक्षिणं॒ नरं॒ वर्मे॑व स्यू॒तं परि॑ पासि वि॒श्वत॑: । स्वा॒दु॒क्षद्मा॒ यो व॑स॒तौ स्यो॑न॒कृज्जी॑वया॒जं यज॑ते॒ सोप॒मा दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ práyata-dakṣiṇam ǀ náram ǀ várma-iva ǀ syūtám ǀ pári ǀ pāsi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀsvādu-kṣádmā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vasatáu ǀ syona-kṛ́t ǀ jīva-yājám ǀ yájate ǀ sáḥ ǀ upa-mā́ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you dend the man who gives presents (to the priests) on every side, like well-stitched armour. The man who keeps choice viands in his dwelling, and with them entertains (his guests), performs the sacrifice of life, and is the likeness of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒माम॑ग्ने श॒रणिं॑ मीमृषो न इ॒ममध्वा॑नं॒ यमगा॑म दू॒रात् । आ॒पिः पि॒ता प्रम॑तिः सो॒म्यानां॒ भृमि॑रस्यृषि॒कृन्मर्त्या॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ agne ǀ śaráṇim ǀ mīmṛṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ imám ǀ ádhvānam ǀ yám ǀ ágāma ǀ dūrā́t ǀāpíḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ somyā́nām ǀ bhṛ́miḥ ǀ asi ǀ ṛṣi-kṛ́t ǀ mártyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, forgive us this our negligence, this path in which we have gone astray; you are to be sought as the protector and encourager of those who offer suitable libations; you are the fulfiller (of the end of rites), you make yourself visible to mortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒नु॒ष्वद॑ग्ने अङ्गिर॒स्वद॑ङ्गिरो ययाति॒वत्सद॑ने पूर्व॒वच्छु॑चे । अच्छ॑ या॒ह्या व॑हा॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॒मा सा॑दय ब॒र्हिषि॒ यक्षि॑ च प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: manuṣvát ǀ agne ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ yayāti-vát ǀ sádane ǀ pūrva-vát ǀ śuce ǀáccha ǀ yāhi ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀ ā́ ǀ sādaya ǀ barhíṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PureAgni, who goes about (to receive oblations), go in your presence to the halll of sacrifice, as didManu, andAṅgiras, andYayāti, and others of old; bring hither the divine personnages, seat them on the sacred grass, and offer them grateful (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तेना॑ग्ने॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वावृधस्व॒ शक्ती॑ वा॒ यत्ते॑ चकृ॒मा वि॒दा वा॑ । उ॒त प्र णे॑ष्य॒भि वस्यो॑ अ॒स्मान्त्सं न॑: सृज सुम॒त्या वाज॑वत्या
shlokas.transliteration: eténa ǀ agne ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vavṛdhasva ǀ śáktī ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ cakṛmá ǀ vidā́ ǀ vā ǀutá ǀ prá ǀ neṣi ǀ abhí ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ sám ǀ naḥ ǀ sṛja ǀ su-matyā́ ǀ vā́ja-vatyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “.Agni, do your thrive through this our prayer, which we make according to our ability, according to our knowledge; do you, therefore, lead us to opulence, and endow us with right understanding securing (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ नु वी॒र्या॑णि॒ प्र वो॑चं॒ यानि॑ च॒कार॑ प्रथ॒मानि॑ व॒ज्री । अह॒न्नहि॒मन्व॒पस्त॑तर्द॒ प्र व॒क्षणा॑ अभिन॒त्पर्व॑तानाम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ nú ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ prá ǀ vocam ǀ yā́ni ǀ cakā́ra ǀ prathamā́ni ǀ vajrī́ ǀáhan ǀ áhim ǀ ánu ǀ apáḥ ǀ tatarda ǀ prá ǀ vakṣáṇāḥ ǀ abhinat ǀ párvatānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I declare the former valorous deeds ofIndra, which the thunderer has achieved; he clove the cloud; he cast the waters down (to earth); he broke (a way) for the torrents of the mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॒न्नहिं॒ पर्व॑ते शिश्रिया॒णं त्वष्टा॑स्मै॒ वज्रं॑ स्व॒र्यं॑ ततक्ष । वा॒श्रा इ॑व धे॒नव॒: स्यन्द॑माना॒ अञ्ज॑: समु॒द्रमव॑ जग्मु॒राप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áhan ǀ áhim ǀ párvate ǀ śiśriyāṇám ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ asmai ǀ vájram ǀ svaryám ǀ tatakṣa ǀvāśrā́ḥ-iva ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ syándamānāḥ ǀ áñjaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ áva ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He clove the cloud, seeking refuge on the mountain;Tvaṣṭa) sharpened his far-whirling bolt; the flowing waters quickly hastened to the ocean, like cows (hastening) to their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒षा॒यमा॑णोऽवृणीत॒ सोमं॒ त्रिक॑द्रुकेष्वपिबत्सु॒तस्य॑ । आ साय॑कं म॒घवा॑दत्त॒ वज्र॒मह॑न्नेनं प्रथम॒जामही॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣa-yámāṇaḥ ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ sómam ǀ trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ apibat ǀ sutásya ǀā́ ǀ sā́yakam ǀ maghávā ǀ adatta ǀ vájram ǀ áhan ǀ enam ǀ prathama-jā́m ǀ áhīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Impetuous as a bull, he quaffed theSomajuice, he drank of the libation at the triple sacrifice. Maghvan took his shaft, the thunderbolt, and with it struck the first born of the clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॒न्द्राह॑न्प्रथम॒जामही॑ना॒मान्मा॒यिना॒ममि॑ना॒: प्रोत मा॒याः । आत्सूर्यं॑ ज॒नय॒न्द्यामु॒षासं॑ ता॒दीत्ना॒ शत्रुं॒ न किला॑ विवित्से
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ áhan ǀ prathama-jā́m ǀ áhīnām ǀ ā́t ǀ māyínām ǀ ámināḥ ǀ prá ǀ utá ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀā́t ǀ sū́ryam ǀ janáyan ǀ dyā́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ tādī́tnā ǀ śátrum ǀ ná ǀ kíla ǀ vivitse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as you have divided the first-born of the clouds, you have destroyed the delusions of the deluders, and then engendering the sun, the dawn, the firmament, you have not left an enemy (to oppose you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॑न्वृ॒त्रं वृ॑त्र॒तरं॒ व्यं॑स॒मिन्द्रो॒ वज्रे॑ण मह॒ता व॒धेन॑ । स्कन्धां॑सीव॒ कुलि॑शेना॒ विवृ॒क्णाहि॑: शयत उप॒पृक्पृ॑थि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ vṛtra-táram ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀ índraḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vadhéna ǀskándhāṃsi-iva ǀ kúliśena ǀ ví-vṛkṇā ǀ áhiḥ ǀ śayate ǀ upa-pṛ́k ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With his vast destroying thunderbolt,Indrastruck the darkling mutilatedVṛtra; as the trunks of trees are felled by the axe, so lies Ahi prostrate on the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यो॒द्धेव॑ दु॒र्मद॒ आ हि जु॒ह्वे म॑हावी॒रं तु॑विबा॒धमृ॑जी॒षम् । नाता॑रीदस्य॒ समृ॑तिं व॒धानां॒ सं रु॒जाना॑: पिपिष॒ इन्द्र॑शत्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: ayoddhā́-iva ǀ duḥ-mádaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ juhvé ǀ mahā-vīrám ǀ tuvi-bādhám ǀ ṛjīṣám ǀná ǀ atārīt ǀ asya ǀ sám-ṛtim ǀ vadhā́nām ǀ sám ǀ rujā́nāḥ ǀ pipiṣe ǀ índra-śatruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The arrogantVṛtra, as if unequaled, defiedIndra, the mighty hero, the destroyer of many, the scatterer of foes; he has not escaped the contact of the fate (Indra's) enemies. The foe of Indra has crushed the (banks of the) rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पाद॑ह॒स्तो अ॑पृतन्य॒दिन्द्र॒मास्य॒ वज्र॒मधि॒ सानौ॑ जघान । वृष्णो॒ वध्रि॑: प्रति॒मानं॒ बुभू॑षन्पुरु॒त्रा वृ॒त्रो अ॑शय॒द्व्य॑स्तः
shlokas.transliteration: apā́t ǀ ahastáḥ ǀ apṛtanyat ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǀ asya ǀ vájram ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ jaghāna ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ vádhriḥ ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ búbhūṣan ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ vṛtráḥ ǀ aśayat ǀ ví-astaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having neitherhandnor foot, he defiedIndra, who struck him with the thunderbolt upon his mountain-like shoulder, like one emasculated who pretends to virility; thenVṛtra, mutilated of many members, slept.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒दं न भि॒न्नम॑मु॒या शया॑नं॒ मनो॒ रुहा॑णा॒ अति॑ य॒न्त्याप॑: । याश्चि॑द्वृ॒त्रो म॑हि॒ना प॒र्यति॑ष्ठ॒त्तासा॒महि॑: पत्सुत॒:शीर्ब॑भूव
shlokas.transliteration: nadám ǀ ná ǀ bhinnám ǀ amuyā́ ǀ śáyānam ǀ mánaḥ ǀ rúhāṇāḥ ǀ áti ǀ yanti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ vṛtráḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pari-átiṣṭhat ǀ tā́sām ǀ áhiḥ ǀ patsutaḥśī́ḥ ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters, that delight the minds (of men), flow over him, recumbent on this earth, as a river (bursts through) its broken (banks). Ahi has been prostrated beneath the feet of the waters, whichVṛtra, by his might, had obstructed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नी॒चाव॑या अभवद्वृ॒त्रपु॒त्रेन्द्रो॑ अस्या॒ अव॒ वध॑र्जभार । उत्त॑रा॒ सूरध॑रः पु॒त्र आ॑सी॒द्दानु॑: शये स॒हव॑त्सा॒ न धे॒नुः
shlokas.transliteration: nīcā́-vayāḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ vṛtrá-putrā ǀ índraḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǀ áva ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ jabhāra ǀút-tarā ǀ sū́ḥ ǀ ádharaḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ dā́nuḥ ǀ śaye ǀ sahá-vatsā ǀ ná ǀ dhenúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mother ofVṛtrawas bending over her son, whenIndrastruck her nether part with his shaft; so the mother was above and the son underneath, andDānuslept (with her son), like  a cow with its calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ष्ठन्तीनामनिवेश॒नानां॒ काष्ठा॑नां॒ मध्ये॒ निहि॑तं॒ शरी॑रम् । वृ॒त्रस्य॑ नि॒ण्यं वि च॑र॒न्त्यापो॑ दी॒र्घं तम॒ आश॑य॒दिन्द्र॑शत्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: átiṣṭhantīnām ǀ ani-veśanā́nām ǀ kā́ṣṭhānām ǀ mádhye ǀ ní-hitam ǀ śárīram ǀvṛtrásya ǀ niṇyám ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ dīrghám ǀ támaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aśayat ǀ índra-śatruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters carry off the nameless body ofVṛtra, tossed into the midst of the never- stopping, never-resting currents. The foe ofIndrahas slept a long darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒सप॑त्नी॒रहि॑गोपा अतिष्ठ॒न्निरु॑द्धा॒ आप॑: प॒णिने॑व॒ गाव॑: । अ॒पां बिल॒मपि॑हितं॒ यदासी॑द्वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अप॒ तद्व॑वार
shlokas.transliteration: dāsá-patnīḥ ǀ áhi-gopāḥ ǀ atiṣṭhan ǀ ní-ruddhāḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ paṇínā-iva ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀapā́m ǀ bílam ǀ ápi-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ā́sīt ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ ápa ǀ tát ǀ vavāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters, the wives of the destroyer, guarded by Ahi, stood obstructed, like the cows byPaṇis; but by layingVṛtra,Indraset open the cave that had confined them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्व्यो॒ वारो॑ अभव॒स्तदि॑न्द्र सृ॒के यत्त्वा॑ प्र॒त्यह॑न्दे॒व एक॑: । अज॑यो॒ गा अज॑यः शूर॒ सोम॒मवा॑सृज॒: सर्त॑वे स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvyaḥ ǀ vā́raḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ sṛké ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ prati-áhan ǀ deváḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀájayaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ájayaḥ ǀ śūra ǀ sómam ǀ áva ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ sártave ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the single resplendentVṛtrareturned the blow (which had been inflicted),Indra, by your thunderbolt, you became (furious), like a horse's tail. You have rescued the kine; you have won, Hero, theSomajuice; you have let loose the seven rivers to flow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नास्मै॑ वि॒द्युन्न त॑न्य॒तुः सि॑षेध॒ न यां मिह॒मकि॑रद्ध्रा॒दुनिं॑ च । इन्द्र॑श्च॒ यद्यु॑यु॒धाते॒ अहि॑श्चो॒ताप॒रीभ्यो॑ म॒घवा॒ वि जि॑ग्ये
