shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ asmai ǀ vi-dyút ǀ ná ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ sisedha ǀ ná ǀ yā́m ǀ míham ǀ ákirat ǀ hrādúnim ǀ ca ǀíndraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ yuyudhā́te íti ǀ áhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ utá ǀ aparī́bhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ ví ǀ jigye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neither the lightning nor the thunder (discharged byVṛtra), nor the rain which he showered, nor the thunderbolt, harmedIndra, when he and Ahi contended and Maghvat triumphed also over other (attacks).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहे॑र्या॒तारं॒ कम॑पश्य इन्द्र हृ॒दि यत्ते॑ ज॒घ्नुषो॒ भीरग॑च्छत् । नव॑ च॒ यन्न॑व॒तिं च॒ स्रव॑न्तीः श्ये॒नो न भी॒तो अत॑रो॒ रजां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: áheḥ ǀ yātā́ram ǀ kám ǀ apaśyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ hṛdí ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ jaghnúṣaḥ ǀ bhī́ḥ ǀ ágacchat ǀnáva ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ srávantīḥ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhītáḥ ǀ átaraḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When fear entered,Indra, into your heart when about to slay Ahi, what other destroyer of him did you look for, that, alarmed, you did traverse ninety and nine streams like a (swift) hawk?”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ या॒तोऽव॑सितस्य॒ राजा॒ शम॑स्य च शृ॒ङ्गिणो॒ वज्र॑बाहुः । सेदु॒ राजा॑ क्षयति चर्षणी॒नाम॒रान्न ने॒मिः परि॒ ता ब॑भूव
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ yātáḥ ǀ áva-sitasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ śámasya ǀ ca ǀ śṛṅgíṇaḥ ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ rā́jā ǀ kṣayati ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ arā́n ǀ ná ǀ nemíḥ ǀ pári ǀ tā́ ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThenIndra, the wilder of the thunderbolt, became the sovereign of all that is moveable or immoveable, of hornless and horned cattle; and as he abides the monarch of men, he comprehended all things (within him), as the circumference comprehends the spokes of a wheel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एताया॒मोप॑ ग॒व्यन्त॒ इन्द्र॑म॒स्माकं॒ सु प्रम॑तिं वावृधाति । अ॒ना॒मृ॒णः कु॒विदाद॒स्य रा॒यो गवां॒ केतं॒ पर॑मा॒वर्ज॑ते नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ita ǀ áyāma ǀ úpa ǀ gavyántaḥ ǀ índram ǀ asmā́kam ǀ sú ǀ prá-matim ǀ vavṛdhāti ǀanāmṛṇáḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ ā́t ǀ asyá ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ gávām ǀ kétam ǀ páram ǀ ā-várjate ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, let us get toIndra, (to recover our stolen cattle), for he, devoid of malice, exhilarates our minds; thereupon he will bestow upon us perfect knowledge of this wealth, (which consists) of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपेद॒हं ध॑न॒दामप्र॑तीतं॒ जुष्टां॒ न श्ये॒नो व॑स॒तिं प॑तामि । इन्द्रं॑ नम॒स्यन्नु॑प॒मेभि॑र॒र्कैर्यः स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ हव्यो॒ अस्ति॒ याम॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ ít ǀ ahám ǀ dhana-dā́m ǀ áprati-itam ǀ júṣṭām ǀ ná ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ vasatím ǀ patāmi ǀíndram ǀ namasyán ǀ upa-mébhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ yā́man ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I fly, like a hawk to its cherished nest, to thatIndrawho is to be invoked by his worshipper in battle, glorifying with excellent hymns, him who is invincible and the giver of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि सर्व॑सेन इषु॒धीँर॑सक्त॒ सम॒र्यो गा अ॑जति॒ यस्य॒ वष्टि॑ । चो॒ष्कू॒यमा॑ण इन्द्र॒ भूरि॑ वा॒मं मा प॒णिर्भू॑र॒स्मदधि॑ प्रवृद्ध
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sárva-senaḥ ǀ iṣu-dhī́n ǀ asakta ǀ sám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ajati ǀ yásya ǀ váṣṭi ǀcoṣkūyámāṇaḥ ǀ indra ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vāmám ǀ mā́ ǀ paṇíḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ asmát ǀ ádhi ǀ pra-vṛddha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The commander fo the whole host has bound his quiver (on his back); the lord drives the cattle (to the dwelling) of whom he plural ases. MightyIndra, bestowing upon us abundant wealth, take not advantage of us like a dealer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वधी॒र्हि दस्युं॑ ध॒निनं॑ घ॒नेनँ॒ एक॒श्चर॑न्नुपशा॒केभि॑रिन्द्र । धनो॒रधि॑ विषु॒णक्ते व्या॑य॒न्नय॑ज्वानः सन॒काः प्रेति॑मीयुः
shlokas.transliteration: vádhīḥ ǀ hí ǀ dásyum ǀ dhanínam ǀ ghanéna ǀ ékaḥ ǀ cáran ǀ upa-śākébhiḥ ǀ indra ǀdhánoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣuṇák ǀ té ǀ ví ǀ āyan ǀ áyajvānaḥ ǀ sanakā́ḥ ǀ prá-itim ǀ īyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Indra, you have slain the wealthy barbarian with your bold; your, singly assailing (him), although with auxiliaries (theMaruts) athand. Perceiving the impending manifold destructiveness of your bow, they, theSanakas, the neglecters of sacrifice, perished.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ चिच्छी॒र्षा व॑वृजु॒स्त इ॒न्द्राय॑ज्वानो॒ यज्व॑भि॒: स्पर्ध॑मानाः । प्र यद्दि॒वो ह॑रिवः स्थातरुग्र॒ निर॑व्र॒ताँ अ॑धमो॒ रोद॑स्योः
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ cit ǀ śīrṣā́ ǀ vavṛjuḥ ǀ té ǀ indra ǀ áyajvānaḥ ǀ yájva-bhiḥ ǀ spárdhamānāḥ ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ diváḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ ugra ǀ níḥ ǀ avratā́n ǀ adhamaḥ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The neglecters of sacrifice, contending with the sacrificers,Indra, fled with averted faces. Indra, fierce, unyielding, lord of steeds, (they appeared) when you did blow the disregarders of religion from off the heaven, and earth and sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑युत्सन्ननव॒द्यस्य॒ सेना॒मया॑तयन्त क्षि॒तयो॒ नव॑ग्वाः । वृ॒षा॒युधो॒ न वध्र॑यो॒ निर॑ष्टाः प्र॒वद्भि॒रिन्द्रा॑च्चि॒तय॑न्त आयन्
shlokas.transliteration: áyuyutsan ǀ anavadyásya ǀ sénām ǀ áyātayanta ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀvṛṣa-yúdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vádhrayaḥ ǀ níḥ-aṣṭāḥ ǀ pravát-bhiḥ ǀ índrāt ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ āyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The adherants ofVṛtra) encountered the army of the irreproachable (Indra); men of holy lives encouraged him. Scattered before him, conscious (of their inferiority), like the emasculated contending with men, they fled by precipitous paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमे॒तान्रु॑द॒तो जक्ष॑त॒श्चायो॑धयो॒ रज॑स इन्द्र पा॒रे । अवा॑दहो दि॒व आ दस्यु॑मु॒च्चा प्र सु॑न्व॒तः स्तु॑व॒तः शंस॑मावः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ etā́n ǀ rudatáḥ ǀ jákṣataḥ ǀ ca ǀ áyodhayaḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ indra ǀ pāré ǀáva ǀ adahaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dásyum ǀ uccā́ ǀ prá ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ āvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have destroyed them,Indra, whether weeping or laughing, on the farthest verge of the sky; you have consumed the robber, (having dragged him) from heaven, and have received the praises of the worshipper, praising you and offering libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒क्रा॒णास॑: परी॒णहं॑ पृथि॒व्या हिर॑ण्येन म॒णिना॒ शुम्भ॑मानाः । न हि॑न्वा॒नास॑स्तितिरु॒स्त इन्द्रं॒ परि॒ स्पशो॑ अदधा॒त्सूर्ये॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: cakrāṇā́saḥ ǀ pari-náham ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ híraṇyena ǀ maṇínā ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǀná ǀ hinvānā́saḥ ǀ titiruḥ ǀ té ǀ índram ǀ pári ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ adadhāt ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Decorated with gold and jewels, they were spreading over the circuit of the earth; but mighty as they were, they triumphed not overIndra; he dispersed them with the (rising) sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यदि॑न्द्र॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे अबु॑भोजीर्महि॒ना वि॒श्वत॑: सीम् । अम॑न्यमानाँ अ॒भि मन्य॑मानै॒र्निर्ब्र॒ह्मभि॑रधमो॒ दस्यु॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ábubhojīḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ sīm ǀámanyamānān ǀ abhí ǀ mányamānaiḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ brahmá-bhiḥ ǀ adhamaḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, as you enjoy both heaven and earth, investing the universe with your magnitude, you have blown away the robber with the prayers which are repeated on behalf of those who do not comprehend them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ये दि॒वः पृ॑थि॒व्या अन्त॑मा॒पुर्न मा॒याभि॑र्धन॒दां प॒र्यभू॑वन् । युजं॒ वज्रं॑ वृष॒भश्च॑क्र॒ इन्द्रो॒ निर्ज्योति॑षा॒ तम॑सो॒ गा अ॑दुक्षत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yé ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ántam ǀ āpúḥ ǀ ná ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ dhana-dā́m ǀ pari-ábhūvan ǀyújam ǀ vájram ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ cakre ǀ índraḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támasaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ adhukṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the waters descended not upon the ends of the earth, and overspread not that giver of affluence with its productions, thenIndra, the showerer, grasped his bolt, and with its brightness milked out the waters from the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ स्व॒धाम॑क्षर॒न्नापो॑ अ॒स्याव॑र्धत॒ मध्य॒ आ ना॒व्या॑नाम् । स॒ध्री॒चीने॑न॒ मन॑सा॒ तमिन्द्र॒ ओजि॑ष्ठेन॒ हन्म॑नाहन्न॒भि द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ akṣaran ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ asya ǀ ávardhata ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǀ nāvyā́nām ǀsadhrīcī́nena ǀ mánasā ǀ tám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhena ǀ hánmanā ǀ ahan ǀ abhí ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters flowed to provide the food ofIndra, but (Vṛtra) increased in the midst of the navigable (rivers); then Indra, with his fatal and powerful shaft, slew Vṛtra, whose thought were ever turned towards him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्या॑विध्यदिली॒बिश॑स्य दृ॒ळ्हा वि शृ॒ङ्गिण॑मभिन॒च्छुष्ण॒मिन्द्र॑: । याव॒त्तरो॑ मघव॒न्याव॒दोजो॒ वज्रे॑ण॒ शत्रु॑मवधीः पृत॒न्युम्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ avidhyat ǀ ilībíśasya ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ ví ǀ śṛṅgíṇam ǀ abhinat ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ índraḥ ǀyā́vat ǀ táraḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ yā́vat ǀ ójaḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ śátrum ǀ avadhīḥ ǀ pṛtanyúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraset free (the waters) obstructed by (Vṛtra), when sleeping in the caves of the earth, and slew the horned dryer up (of the world). You,Maghavan, with equal swiftness and strength, did kill with your thunderbolt the enemy defying you to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि सि॒ध्मो अ॑जिगादस्य॒ शत्रू॒न्वि ति॒ग्मेन॑ वृष॒भेणा॒ पुरो॑ऽभेत् । सं वज्रे॑णासृजद्वृ॒त्रमिन्द्र॒: प्र स्वां म॒तिम॑तिर॒च्छाश॑दानः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sidhmáḥ ǀ ajigāt ǀ asya ǀ śátrūn ǀ ví ǀ tigména ǀ vṛṣabhéṇa ǀ púraḥ ǀ abhet ǀsám ǀ vájreṇa ǀ asṛjat ǀ vṛtrám ǀ índraḥ ǀ prá ǀ svā́m ǀ matím ǀ atirat ǀ śā́śadānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The weapon ofIndrafell upon his adversaries; with his sharp and excellent (shaft) he destroyed their cities; he then reachedVṛtrawith his thunderbolt, and (by) slaying him, exhilarated his mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आव॒: कुत्स॑मिन्द्र॒ यस्मि॑ञ्चा॒कन्प्रावो॒ युध्य॑न्तं वृष॒भं दश॑द्युम् । श॒फच्यु॑तो रे॒णुर्न॑क्षत॒ द्यामुच्छ्वै॑त्रे॒यो नृ॒षाह्या॑य तस्थौ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́vaḥ ǀ kútsam ǀ indra ǀ yásmin ǀ cākán ǀ prá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ yúdhyantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dáśa-dyum ǀśaphá-cyutaḥ ǀ reṇúḥ ǀ nakṣata ǀ dyā́m ǀ út ǀ śvaitreyáḥ ǀ nṛ-sáhyāya ǀ tasthau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, have protectedKutsa, grateful for his praises; you have defended the excellentDaśadyuengaged in battle; the dust of your courser's hoofs ascended to heaven; the son of Śvita, (through your favour), rose up, to be again unborn by men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आव॒: शमं॑ वृष॒भं तुग्र्या॑सु क्षेत्रजे॒षे म॑घव॒ञ्छ्वित्र्यं॒ गाम् । ज्योक्चि॒दत्र॑ तस्थि॒वांसो॑ अक्रञ्छत्रूय॒तामध॑रा॒ वेद॑नाकः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́vaḥ ǀ śámam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ túgryāsu ǀ kṣetra-jeṣé ǀ magha-van ǀ śvítryam ǀ gā́m ǀjyók ǀ cit ǀ átra ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ akran ǀ śatru-yatā́m ǀ ádharā ǀ védanā ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have protected,Maghavan, the excellent son of Śvitā, when combating for his lands, and encouraged (by you) when immersed in water; do you inflict sharp pains on those of hostile minds, who have long stood (in enmity) against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिश्चि॑न्नो अ॒द्या भ॑वतं नवेदसा वि॒भुर्वां॒ याम॑ उ॒त रा॒तिर॑श्विना । यु॒वोर्हि य॒न्त्रं हि॒म्येव॒ वास॑सोऽभ्यायं॒सेन्या॑ भवतं मनी॒षिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ bhavatam ǀ navedasā ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ vām ǀ yā́maḥ ǀ utá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀyuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ yantrám ǀ himyā́-iva ǀ vā́sasaḥ ǀ abhi-āyaṃsényā ǀ bhavatam ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WiseAśvins, be present with us thrice today; vast is your vehicle, as well as your munificence; your union is like that of the shining (day) and dewy (night); (suffer yourselves) to be detained by the learned (priests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रय॑: प॒वयो॑ मधु॒वाह॑ने॒ रथे॒ सोम॑स्य वे॒नामनु॒ विश्व॒ इद्वि॑दुः । त्रय॑: स्क॒म्भास॑: स्कभि॒तास॑ आ॒रभे॒ त्रिर्नक्तं॑ या॒थस्त्रिर्व॑श्विना॒ दिवा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ paváyaḥ ǀ mádhu-vā́hane ǀ ráthe ǀ sómasya ǀ venā́m ǀ ánu ǀ víśve ǀ ít ǀ viduḥ ǀtráyaḥ ǀ skambhā́saḥ ǀ skabhitā́saḥ ǀ ā-rábhe ǀ tríḥ ǀ náktam ǀ yātháḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aśvinā ǀ dívā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three are the solid (wheels) of your abundance-bearing chariot, as all (the gods) have known (it to be), when attendant onVena, the beloved ofSoma; three are the columns plural ced (above it) for support, and in it thrice do you journey by night, and thrice by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒ने अह॒न्त्रिर॑वद्यगोहना॒ त्रिर॒द्य य॒ज्ञं मधु॑ना मिमिक्षतम् । त्रिर्वाज॑वती॒रिषो॑ अश्विना यु॒वं दो॒षा अ॒स्मभ्य॑मु॒षस॑श्च पिन्वतम्
shlokas.transliteration: samāné ǀ áhan ǀ tríḥ ǀ avadya-gohanā ǀ tríḥ ǀ adyá ǀ yajñám ǀ mádhunā ǀ mimikṣatam ǀtríḥ ǀ vā́ja-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ doṣā́ḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pinvatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thrice in one entire day do you repair the faults (of your worshippers); thrice today sprinkle the oblation with sweetness; and thrice, evening and morning,Aśvins, grant us strength-bestowing food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर्व॒र्तिर्या॑तं॒ त्रिरनु॑व्रते ज॒ने त्रिः सु॑प्रा॒व्ये॑ त्रे॒धेव॑ शिक्षतम् । त्रिर्ना॒न्द्यं॑ वहतमश्विना यु॒वं त्रिः पृक्षो॑ अ॒स्मे अ॒क्षरे॑व पिन्वतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ tríḥ ǀ ánu-vrate ǀ jáne ǀ tríḥ ǀ supra-avyé ǀ tredhā́-iva ǀ śikṣatam ǀtríḥ ǀ nāndyám ǀ vahatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ tríḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ akṣárā-iva ǀ pinvatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thrice,Aśvins, visit our dwelling, and the man who is well-disposed towards us; thrice repair to him who deserves your protection, and instrumental uct us in three-fold knowledge; thrice grant us gratifying (rewards); thrice shower upon us food, as (Indrapours down) rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो॑ र॒यिं व॑हतमश्विना यु॒वं त्रिर्दे॒वता॑ता॒ त्रिरु॒ताव॑तं॒ धिय॑: । त्रिः सौ॑भग॒त्वं त्रिरु॒त श्रवां॑सि नस्त्रि॒ष्ठं वां॒ सूरे॑ दुहि॒ता रु॑ह॒द्रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ tríḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ tríḥ ǀ utá ǀ avatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀtríḥ ǀ saubhaga-tvám ǀ tríḥ ǀ utá ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ naḥ ǀ tri-sthám ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ duhitā́ ǀ ā ǀ ruhat ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, thrice bestow upon us riches; thrice approach the divine rite; thrice preserve our intellects; thrice grant us prosperity, thrice food. The daughter of the sun has ascended your three-wheeled car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो॑ अश्विना दि॒व्यानि॑ भेष॒जा त्रिः पार्थि॑वानि॒ त्रिरु॑ दत्तम॒द्भ्यः । ओ॒मानं॑ शं॒योर्मम॑काय सू॒नव॑ त्रि॒धातु॒ शर्म॑ वहतं शुभस्पती
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ divyā́ni ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ tríḥ ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ tríḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dattam ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀomā́nam ǀ śam-yóḥ ǀ mámakāya ǀ sūnáve ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ śárma ǀ vahatam ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thrice grant us,Aśvins, the medicaments of heaven, and those of earth, and those of the firmament; give to my son the prosperity ofŚamyu; cherishers of wholesome (herbs), preserve the well-being of the three humours (of the body).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर्नो॑ अश्विना यज॒ता दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ परि॑ त्रि॒धातु॑ पृथि॒वीम॑शायतम् । ति॒स्रो ना॑सत्या रथ्या परा॒वत॑ आ॒त्मेव॒ वात॒: स्वस॑राणि गच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yajatā́ ǀ divé-dive ǀ pári ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ aśāyatam ǀtisráḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ rathyā ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ātmā́-iva ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ gacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, who are to be thrice worshipped, day by day, repose on the triple (couch of) sacred grass upon the earth, (that form the altar); car-borneNāsatyas, repair from afar to the threefold (plural ce of sacrifice), as the vital air to (living) bodies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर॑श्विना॒ सिन्धु॑भिः स॒प्तमा॑तृभि॒स्त्रय॑ आहा॒वास्त्रे॒धा ह॒विष्कृ॒तम् । ति॒स्रः पृ॑थि॒वीरु॒परि॑ प्र॒वा दि॒वो नाकं॑ रक्षेथे॒ द्युभि॑र॒क्तुभि॑र्हि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ saptámātṛ-bhiḥ ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ ā-hāvā́ḥ ǀ tredhā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀtisráḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ḥ ǀ upári ǀ pravā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nā́kam ǀ rakṣethe íti ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ hitám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, thrice with the seven mother-sttreams; the three rivers are ready; the triple oblation is prepared; rising above thethree worlds, you defend the sun in the sky, who is established for both night and day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ त्री च॒क्रा त्रि॒वृतो॒ रथ॑स्य॒ क्व१॒॑ त्रयो॑ व॒न्धुरो॒ ये सनी॑ळाः । क॒दा योगो॑ वा॒जिनो॒ रास॑भस्य॒ येन॑ य॒ज्ञं ना॑सत्योपया॒थः
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ trī́ ǀ cakrā́ ǀ tri-vṛ́taḥ ǀ ráthasya ǀ kvá ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ vandhúraḥ ǀ yé ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ yógaḥ ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ rā́sabhasya ǀ yéna ǀ yajñám ǀ nāsatyā ǀ upa-yātháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where,Nāsatyas, ae the three wheels of your triangular car? where the three fastenings and props (of the awning?) When will be the harnessing of the powerful ass, that you may come to the sacrifice?”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ना॑सत्या॒ गच्छ॑तं हू॒यते॑ ह॒विर्मध्व॑: पिबतं मधु॒पेभि॑रा॒सभि॑: । यु॒वोर्हि पूर्वं॑ सवि॒तोषसो॒ रथ॑मृ॒ताय॑ चि॒त्रं घृ॒तव॑न्त॒मिष्य॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ gácchatam ǀ hūyáte ǀ havíḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibatam ǀ madhu-pébhiḥ ǀ āsá-bhiḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ pū́rvam ǀ savitā́ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ citrám ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ íṣyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyas, to the sacrifice; the oblation is offered; drink the juice with mouths that relish the sweet savour. Before dawn, even,Savitāsend (to bring you) to the rite, your wonderful car shining with clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ना॑सत्या त्रि॒भिरे॑काद॒शैरि॒ह दे॒वेभि॑र्यातं मधु॒पेय॑मश्विना । प्रायु॒स्तारि॑ष्टं॒ नी रपां॑सि मृक्षतं॒ सेध॑तं॒ द्वेषो॒ भव॑तं सचा॒भुवा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ekādaśáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ madhu-péyam ǀ aśvinā ǀprá ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ tā́riṣṭam ǀ níḥ ǀ rápāṃsi ǀ mṛkṣatam ǀ sédhatam ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ bhávatam ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyas, with the thrice eleven divinities; come,Aśvins, to drink the oblation prolong our lives, efface our faults, restrain our enemies, and be ever with us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ अश्विना त्रि॒वृता॒ रथे॑ना॒र्वाञ्चं॑ र॒यिं व॑हतं सु॒वीर॑म् । शृ॒ण्वन्ता॑ वा॒मव॑से जोहवीमि वृ॒धे च॑ नो भवतं॒ वाज॑सातौ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ tri-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ arvā́ñcam ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀśṛṇvántā ǀ vām ǀ ávase ǀ johavīmi ǀ vṛdhé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Borne in your car that traverses thethree worlds, bring to usAśvins, present affluence, attended by (male) progeny; I call upon you both, listening to me, for protection; be to us for vigour in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह्वया॑म्य॒ग्निं प्र॑थ॒मं स्व॒स्तये॒ ह्वया॑मि मि॒त्रावरु॑णावि॒हाव॑से । ह्वया॑मि॒ रात्रीं॒ जग॑तो नि॒वेश॑नीं॒ ह्वया॑मि दे॒वं स॑वि॒तार॑मू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: hváyāmi ǀ agním ǀ prathamám ǀ svastáye ǀ hváyāmi ǀ mitrā́váruṇau ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀhváyāmi ǀ rā́trīm ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ni-véśanīm ǀ hváyāmi ǀ devám ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “InvokeAgnifirst, for protection: I invoke for protection,MitraandVaruṇa; invoke Night, who brings rest to the world; invoke the divineSavitāfor my preservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च । हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kṛṣṇéna ǀ rájasā ǀ vártamānaḥ ǀ ni-veśáyan ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ mártyam ǀ ca ǀhiraṇyáyena ǀ savitā́ ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ yāti ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ páśyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Revolving through the darkened firmament, arousing mortal and immortal, the divineSavitātravels in his golden chariot, beholding the (several) worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याति॑ दे॒वः प्र॒वता॒ यात्यु॒द्वता॒ याति॑ शु॒भ्राभ्यां॑ यज॒तो हरि॑भ्याम् । आ दे॒वो या॑ति सवि॒ता प॑रा॒वतोऽप॒ विश्वा॑ दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ti ǀ deváḥ ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yā́ti ǀ ut-vátā ǀ yā́ti ǀ śubhrā́bhyām ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ yāti ǀ savitā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ víśvā ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ bā́dhamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitātravels by an upward and by a downward path; deserving adoration, he journeys with two white horses; he comes hither from a distance, removing all sins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भीवृ॑तं॒ कृश॑नैर्वि॒श्वरू॑पं॒ हिर॑ण्यशम्यं यज॒तो बृ॒हन्त॑म् । आस्था॒द्रथं॑ सवि॒ता चि॒त्रभा॑नुः कृ॒ष्णा रजां॑सि॒ तवि॑षीं॒ दधा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí-vṛtam ǀ kṛ́śanaiḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ híraṇya-śamyam ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ bṛhántam ǀā́ ǀ asthāt ǀ rátham ǀ savitā́ ǀ citrá-bhānuḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ táviṣīm ǀ dádhānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many-rayed adorableSavitā, having power (to disperse) darkness from the world, has mounted his nigh-standing chariot, decorated with many kinds of golden ornaments, and furnished with golden yokes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि जना॑ञ्छ्या॒वाः शि॑ति॒पादो॑ अख्य॒न्रथं॒ हिर॑ण्यप्रउगं॒ वह॑न्तः । शश्व॒द्विश॑: सवि॒तुर्दैव्य॑स्यो॒पस्थे॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि तस्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ jánān ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ śiti-pā́daḥ ǀ akhyan ǀ rátham ǀ híraṇya-pra_ugam ǀ váhantaḥ ǀśáśvat ǀ víśaḥ ǀ savitúḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀ upá-sthe ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ tasthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His white-footed coursers, harnessed to his car with a golden yoke, have manifested light to manking. Men and all the regions are ever in the presence of divineSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो द्याव॑: सवि॒तुर्द्वा उ॒पस्थाँ॒ एका॑ य॒मस्य॒ भुव॑ने विरा॒षाट् । आ॒णिं न रथ्य॑म॒मृताधि॑ तस्थुरि॒ह ब्र॑वीतु॒ य उ॒ तच्चिके॑तत्
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ savitúḥ ǀ dváu ǀ upá-sthā ǀ ékā ǀ yamásya ǀ bhúvane ǀ virāṣā́ṭ ǀāṇím ǀ ná ǀ ráthyam ǀ amṛ́tā ǀ ádhi ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ ihá ǀ bravītu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tát ǀ cíketat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three are the spheres; two are in the proximity ofSavitā, one leads men to the dwelling ofYama. The immortal (luminaries) depend upon Savitā as a car upon the pin of the axle; let him who knows (the greatness of Savitā) declare it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि सु॑प॒र्णो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षाण्यख्यद्गभी॒रवे॑पा॒ असु॑रः सुनी॒थः । क्वे॒३॒॑दानीं॒ सूर्य॒: कश्चि॑केत कत॒मां द्यां र॒श्मिर॒स्या त॑तान
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ akhyat ǀ gabhīrá-vepāḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ su-nītháḥ ǀkvá ǀ idā́nīm ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ ciketa ǀ katamā́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ raśmíḥ ǀ asya ǀ ā́ ǀ tatāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Suparṇa, (the solar ray), deep-quivering, life-bestowing, well-directed, has illuminated the three regions. Where now isSūryaWho knows to what sphere his rays have extended?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ष्टौ व्य॑ख्यत्क॒कुभ॑: पृथि॒व्यास्त्री धन्व॒ योज॑ना स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न् । हि॒र॒ण्या॒क्षः स॑वि॒ता दे॒व आगा॒द्दध॒द्रत्ना॑ दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: aṣṭáu ǀ ví ǀ akhyat ǀ kakúbhaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ trī́ ǀ dhánva ǀ yójanā ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀhiraṇya-akṣáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ dádhat ǀ rátnā ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has lighted up the eight points of the horizon, the three regions of living beings, the seven rivers; may the golden-eyesSavitācome hither, bestowing upon the offerer of the oblation desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यपाणिः सवि॒ता विच॑र्षणिरु॒भे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरी॑यते । अपामी॑वां॒ बाध॑ते॒ वेति॒ सूर्य॑म॒भि कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ द्यामृ॑णोति
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-pāṇiḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ īyate ǀápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ bā́dhate ǀ véti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ abhí ǀ kṛṣṇéna ǀ rájasā ǀ dyā́m ǀ ṛṇoti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gold-handed, all-beholding,Savitātravels between the two regions of heaven and earth, dispels diseases, approaches the sun, and overspreads the sky with gloom, alternating radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यहस्तो॒ असु॑रः सुनी॒थः सु॑मृळी॒कः स्ववाँ॑ यात्व॒र्वाङ् । अ॒प॒सेध॑न्र॒क्षसो॑ यातु॒धाना॒नस्था॑द्दे॒वः प्र॑तिदो॒षं गृ॑णा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-hastaḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ su-nītháḥ ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ svá-vān ǀ yātu ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀapa-sédhan ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ yātu-dhā́nān ǀ ásthāt ǀ deváḥ ǀ prati-doṣám ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the golden-handed, life-bestowing, well-guiding, exhilarating, and affluentSavitā, be present (at the sacrifice); for the deity, if worshipped in the evening, it athand, driving awayrākṣasandyātudhānas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॒ पन्था॑: सवितः पू॒र्व्यासो॑ऽरे॒णव॒: सुकृ॑ता अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे । तेभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य प॒थिभि॑: सु॒गेभी॒ रक्षा॑ च नो॒ अधि॑ च ब्रूहि देव
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ savitaríti ǀ pūrvyā́saḥ ǀ areṇávaḥ ǀ sú-kṛtāḥ ǀ antárikṣe ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ su-gébhiḥ ǀ rákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ca ǀ brūhi ǀ deva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your paths,Savitā, are prepared of old, and free from dust, and well plural ced in the firmament; (coming) by those paths easy to be traversed, preserve us today. Deity, speak to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ य॒ह्वं पु॑रू॒णां वि॒शां दे॑वय॒तीना॑म् । अ॒ग्निं सू॒क्तेभि॒र्वचो॑भिरीमहे॒ यं सी॒मिद॒न्य ईळ॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ yahvám ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ viśā́m ǀ deva-yatī́nām ǀagním ǀ su-uktébhiḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ yám ǀ sīm ǀ ít ǀ anyé ǀ ī́ḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We implore with sacred hymns the mightyAgni, whom other (ṛṣis) also praise, for the benefit of you who are many people, worshipping the gods of you who are many people, worshipping the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जना॑सो अ॒ग्निं द॑धिरे सहो॒वृधं॑ ह॒विष्म॑न्तो विधेम ते । स त्वं नो॑ अ॒द्य सु॒मना॑ इ॒हावि॒ता भवा॒ वाजे॑षु सन्त्य
shlokas.transliteration: jánāsaḥ ǀ agním ǀ dadhire ǀ sahaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ te ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ avitā́ ǀ bháva ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ santya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have recourse toAgni, the augmenter of vigour; offering oblations, we worship you; do you liberal giver of food, be well disposed to us here this day, and be our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र त्वा॑ दू॒तं वृ॑णीमहे॒ होता॑रं वि॒श्ववे॑दसम् । म॒हस्ते॑ स॒तो वि च॑रन्त्य॒र्चयो॑ दि॒वि स्पृ॑शन्ति भा॒नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tvā ǀ dūtám ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ hótāram ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀmaháḥ ǀ te ǀ satáḥ ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ diví ǀ spṛśanti ǀ bhānávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We select you,Agni, the messenger and invoker of the gods, who are endowed with all knowledge. The flames of you, who are mighty and eternal, spread around the rays, touch of the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वास॑स्त्वा॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा सं दू॒तं प्र॒त्नमि॑न्धते । विश्वं॒ सो अ॑ग्ने जयति॒ त्वया॒ धनं॒ यस्ते॑ द॒दाश॒ मर्त्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: devā́saḥ ǀ tvā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sám ǀ dūtám ǀ pratnám ǀ indhate ǀvíśvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ jayati ǀ tváyā ǀ dhánam ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ dadā́śa ǀ mártyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The deitiesVaruṇa,MitraandAryamankindle you, (their) ancient messenger. The man who has offered you (oblations), obtains through you,Agni, universal wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रो होता॑ गृ॒हप॑ति॒रग्ने॑ दू॒तो वि॒शाम॑सि । त्वे विश्वा॒ संग॑तानि व्र॒ता ध्रु॒वा यानि॑ दे॒वा अकृ॑ण्वत
shlokas.transliteration: mandráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ ágne ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ asi ǀtvé íti ǀ víśvā ǀ sám-gatāni ǀ vratā́ ǀ dhruvā́ ǀ yā́ni ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ákṛṇvata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the giver of delight, the invoker and messenger of the gods, the domestic guardian of mankind; the good and durable actions which the gods perform are all aggregated in you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे इद॑ग्ने सु॒भगे॑ यविष्ठ्य॒ विश्व॒मा हू॑यते ह॒विः । स त्वं नो॑ अ॒द्य सु॒मना॑ उ॒ताप॒रं यक्षि॑ दे॒वान्त्सु॒वीर्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ su-bháge ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ hūyate ǀ havíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ utá ǀ aparám ǀ yákṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ su-vī́ryā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youthful and auspiciousAgni, whatever oblation may be presented to you, do you, well disposed towards us; either now or at any other time, convey it to the powerful gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं घे॑मि॒त्था न॑म॒स्विन॒ उप॑ स्व॒राज॑मासते । होत्रा॑भिर॒ग्निं मनु॑ष॒: समि॑न्धते तिति॒र्वांसो॒ अति॒ स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ gha ǀ īm ǀ itthā́ ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀ āsate ǀhótrābhiḥ ǀ agním ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ sám ǀ indhate ǀ titirvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this manner the devout adore you, who are such (as described), bright with your own radiance. Men, with (seven) ministrant priests, kindleAgni(with oblations), victorious over their enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घ्नन्तो॑ वृ॒त्रम॑तर॒न्रोद॑सी अ॒प उ॒रु क्षया॑य चक्रिरे । भुव॒त्कण्वे॒ वृषा॑ द्यु॒म्न्याहु॑त॒: क्रन्द॒दश्वो॒ गवि॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: ghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ataran ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apáḥ ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ cakrire ǀbhúvat ǀ káṇve ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ krándat ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The destroying (deities along with you) have slainVṛtra; they have made earth and heaven and the firmament the spacious dwelling-plural ce (of living creatures); mayAgni, possessed of wealth, when invoked, be a benefactor toKaṇva, like a horse that neighs in a conflict for cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ अ॑सि॒ शोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः । वि धू॒मम॑ग्ने अरु॒षं मि॑येध्य सृ॒ज प्र॑शस्त दर्श॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ sīdasva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ śócasva ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀví ǀ dhūmám ǀ agne ǀ aruṣám ǀ miyedhya ǀ sṛjá ǀ pra-śasta ǀ darśatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Take your seat,Agni, on the sacred grass, for you are mighty; shine forth, for you are devoted to the gods; adorable and excellent Agni, emit the moving and graceful smoke.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॑ दे॒वासो॒ मन॑वे द॒धुरि॒ह यजि॑ष्ठं हव्यवाहन । यं कण्वो॒ मेध्या॑तिथिर्धन॒स्पृतं॒ यं वृषा॒ यमु॑पस्तु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ mánave ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ ihá ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ havya-vāhana ǀyám ǀ káṇvaḥ ǀ médhya-atithiḥ ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ yám ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yám ǀ upa-stutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of oblations, (you are he) whom the gods detained for the sake ofManu; whom, giver of wealth,Kaṇva, the host of pious guests, has detained; whomIndradetained, and whom (now) some other worshipper has detained.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॒ग्निं मेध्या॑तिथि॒: कण्व॑ ई॒ध ऋ॒तादधि॑ । तस्य॒ प्रेषो॑ दीदियु॒स्तमि॒मा ऋच॒स्तम॒ग्निं व॑र्धयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ agním ǀ médhya-atithiḥ ǀ káṇvaḥ ǀ īdhé ǀ ṛtā́t ǀ ádhi ǀtásya ǀ prá ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ dīdiyuḥ ǀ tám ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́caḥ ǀ tám ǀ agním ǀ vardhayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rays of thatAgni, whomKaṇvamade more brilliant than the sun, pre-eminently shine; him do these our hymns, him do we, extol.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यस्पू॑र्धि स्वधा॒वोऽस्ति॒ हि तेऽग्ने॑ दे॒वेष्वाप्य॑म् । त्वं वाज॑स्य॒ श्रुत्य॑स्य राजसि॒ स नो॑ मृळ म॒हाँ अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ pūrdhi ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́pyam ǀtvám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ śrútyasya ǀ rājasi ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷa ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, giver of food, complete our treasures, for the friendship of the gods is obtainable through you. You are lord over famous viands; make us hapy, for you are great.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ षु ण॑ ऊ॒तये॒ तिष्ठा॑ दे॒वो न स॑वि॒ता । ऊ॒र्ध्वो वाज॑स्य॒ सनि॑ता॒ यद॒ञ्जिभि॑र्वा॒घद्भि॑र्वि॒ह्वया॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ tíṣṭha ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ savitā́ ǀūrdhváḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sánitā ǀ yát ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ vāghát-bhiḥ ǀ vi-hváyāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stand up erect for our protection, like the divineSavitā; erect, you are the giver of food, for which we invoke you with unguents, and priests (offering oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो न॑: पा॒ह्यंह॑सो॒ नि के॒तुना॒ विश्वं॒ सम॒त्रिणं॑ दह । कृ॒धी न॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वाञ्च॒रथा॑य जी॒वसे॑ वि॒दा दे॒वेषु॑ नो॒ दुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ketúnā ǀ víśvam ǀ sám ǀ atríṇam ǀ daha ǀkṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrdhvā́n ǀ caráthāya ǀ jīváse ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Erect, preserve us by knowledge from sin; consume every malignant spirit; raise us aloft, that we may pass (through the world); and that we may live, convey our sealth (of oblations) to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि नो॑ अग्ने र॒क्षस॑: पा॒हि धू॒र्तेररा॑व्णः । पा॒हि रीष॑त उ॒त वा॒ जिघां॑सतो॒ बृह॑द्भानो॒ यवि॑ष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ dhūrtéḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀpāhí ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ jíghāṃsataḥ ǀ bṛ́hadbhāno íti bṛ́hat-bhāno ǀ yáviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youthful and most resplendentAgni, protect us against evil spirits, and from the malevolent (man), who gives no gifts; protect us from noxious (animals), and from those who seek to kill us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घ॒नेव॒ विष्व॒ग्वि ज॒ह्यरा॑व्ण॒स्तपु॑र्जम्भ॒ यो अ॑स्म॒ध्रुक् । यो मर्त्य॒: शिशी॑ते॒ अत्य॒क्तुभि॒र्मा न॒: स रि॒पुरी॑शत
shlokas.transliteration: ghanā́-iva ǀ víṣvak ǀ ví ǀ jahi ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀ tápuḥ-jambha ǀ yáḥ ǀ asma-dhrúk ǀyáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ śíśīte ǀ áti ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ripúḥ ǀ īśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, with the burning rays, destroy entirely our foes, who make no gifts, as (potter's ware) with a club; let not one who is inimical to us, nor the man who attacks us with sharp weapons, prevail against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्व॑व्ने सु॒वीर्य॑म॒ग्निः कण्वा॑य॒ सौभ॑गम् । अ॒ग्निः प्राव॑न्मि॒त्रोत मेध्या॑तिथिम॒ग्निः सा॒ता उ॑पस्तु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ vavne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ agníḥ ǀ káṇvāya ǀ sáubhagam ǀagníḥ ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ mitrā́ ǀ utá ǀ médhya-atithim ǀ agníḥ ǀ sātáu ǀ upa-stutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis solicited for power-conferring (affluence); he has granted prosperity toKaṇva, he has protected our friends, as well as the (sage who was) the host of the holy and (every other) worshipper (who has had recourse to him) for riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निना॑ तु॒र्वशं॒ यदुं॑ परा॒वत॑ उ॒ग्रादे॑वं हवामहे । अ॒ग्निर्न॑य॒न्नव॑वास्त्वं बृ॒हद्र॑थं तु॒र्वीतिं॒ दस्य॑वे॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agnínā ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ugrá-devam ǀ havāmahe ǀagníḥ ǀ nayat ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ bṛhát-ratham ǀ turvī́tim ǀ dásyave ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke from afar, along withAgni,Turvaśa,YaduandUgradeva; let Agni, the arrester of the robber, bring hither Navavāstu,BṛhadrathaandTurvīti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ मनु॑र्दधे॒ ज्योति॒र्जना॑य॒ शश्व॑ते । दी॒देथ॒ कण्व॑ ऋ॒तजा॑त उक्षि॒तो यं न॑म॒स्यन्ति॑ कृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ mánuḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ jánāya ǀ śáśvate ǀdīdétha ǀ káṇve ǀ ṛtá-jātaḥ ǀ ukṣitáḥ ǀ yám ǀ namasyánti ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Manudetained you,Agni, (to give) light to the various races of mankind. Born for the sake of sacrifice, and satiated with oblations, you, whom men reverence, have blazed forKaṇva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षासो॑ अ॒ग्नेरम॑वन्तो अ॒र्चयो॑ भी॒मासो॒ न प्रती॑तये । र॒क्ष॒स्विन॒: सद॒मिद्या॑तु॒माव॑तो॒ विश्वं॒ सम॒त्रिणं॑ दह
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣā́saḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ áma-vantaḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ bhīmā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ práti-itaye ǀrakṣasvínaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ yātu-mā́vataḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ sám ǀ atríṇam ǀ daha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flames ofAgniare luminous, powerful, fearful, and not to be trusted. Ever assuredly and entirely consume the mighty spirits of evil and all our other adversarieṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्री॒ळं व॒: शर्धो॒ मारु॑तमन॒र्वाणं॑ रथे॒शुभ॑म् । कण्वा॑ अ॒भि प्र गा॑यत
shlokas.transliteration: krīḷám ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ rathe-śúbham ǀkáṇvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate,Kaṇvas, the aggregate strength of theMaruts, sportive, with horses, but shining in their car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये पृष॑तीभिॠ॒ष्टिभि॑: सा॒कं वाशी॑भिर॒ञ्जिभि॑: । अजा॑यन्त॒ स्वभा॑नवः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ pṛ́ṣatībhiḥ ǀ ṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ sākám ǀ vā́śībhiḥ ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀájāyanta ǀ svá-bhānavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, borne by spotted deer, were born self-radiant, with weapons, war-cries and decorations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेव॑ शृण्व एषां॒ कशा॒ हस्ते॑षु॒ यद्वदा॑न् । नि याम॑ञ्चि॒त्रमृ॑ञ्जते
shlokas.transliteration: ihá-iva ǀ śṛṇve ǀ eṣām ǀ káśāḥ ǀ hásteṣu ǀ yát ǀ vádān ǀní ǀ yā́man ǀ citrám ǀ ṛñjate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I hear the craking of the whips in theirhands, wonderfully inspiring (courage) in the fight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒: शर्धा॑य॒ घृष्व॑ये त्वे॒षद्यु॑म्नाय शु॒ष्मिणे॑ । दे॒वत्तं॒ ब्रह्म॑ गायत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀ tveṣá-dyumnāya ǀ śuṣmíṇe ǀdeváttam ǀ bráhma ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Address the god-given prayer to those who are your strength, the destroyers of foes, the powerful, possessed of brilliant reputation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शं॑सा॒ गोष्वघ्न्यं॑ क्री॒ळं यच्छर्धो॒ मारु॑तम् । जम्भे॒ रस॑स्य वावृधे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śaṃsa ǀ góṣu ǀ ághnyam ǀ krīḷám ǀ yát ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀjámbhe ǀ rásasya ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise the sportive and unresisted might of theMaruts, who were born amongst kine, and whose strength has been nourished by (the enjoyment of) the milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वो॒ वर्षि॑ष्ठ॒ आ न॑रो दि॒वश्च॒ ग्मश्च॑ धूतयः । यत्सी॒मन्तं॒ न धू॑नु॒थ
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ várṣiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ ántam ǀ ná ǀ dhūnuthá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which is the chief leader among you, agitators of heaven and earth, who shake all around like the top (of a tree)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि वो॒ यामा॑य॒ मानु॑षो द॒ध्र उ॒ग्राय॑ म॒न्यवे॑ । जिही॑त॒ पर्व॑तो गि॒रिः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ vaḥ ǀ yā́māya ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ dadhré ǀ ugrā́ya ǀ manyáve ǀjíhīta ǀ párvataḥ ǀ giríḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The house-holder, in dread of your fierce and violent approach, has plural nted a firm (buttress); for the many-ridged mountain is shattered (before you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: येषा॒मज्मे॑षु पृथि॒वी जु॑जु॒र्वाँ इ॑व वि॒श्पति॑: । भि॒या यामे॑षु॒ रेज॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ jujurvā́n-iva ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀbhiyā́ ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ réjate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At whose impetuous approach, earth trembles like an enfeebled monarch through dread (of his enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रं हि जान॑मेषां॒ वयो॑ मा॒तुर्निरे॑तवे । यत्सी॒मनु॑ द्वि॒ता शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sthirám ǀ hí ǀ jā́nam ǀ eṣām ǀ váyaḥ ǀ mātúḥ ǀ níḥ-etave ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ ánu ǀ dvitā́ ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stable is their birth plural ce, (the sky), yet the birds (are able) to issue from (the sphere of) their parent; for your strength is everywhere (divided between two--regions, or heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्ये सू॒नवो॒ गिर॒: काष्ठा॒ अज्मे॑ष्वत्नत । वा॒श्रा अ॑भि॒ज्ञु यात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ kā́ṣṭhāḥ ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ atnata ǀvāśrā́ḥ ǀ abhi-jñú ǀ yā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are the genitive rations of speech; they spread out the waters in their courses; they urge the lowing (cattle) to enter (the water) up to their knees (to drink).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॑द्घा दी॒र्घं पृ॒थुं मि॒हो नपा॑त॒ममृ॑ध्रम् । प्र च्या॑वयन्ति॒ याम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ dīrghám ǀ pṛthúm ǀ miháḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ámṛdhram ǀprá ǀ cyavayanti ǀ yā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They drive before them in their course, the long, vast, uninjurable, rain-retaining cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ यद्ध॑ वो॒ बलं॒ जनाँ॑ अचुच्यवीतन । गि॒रीँर॑चुच्यवीतन
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vaḥ ǀ bálam ǀ jánān ǀ acucyavītana ǀgirī́n ǀ acucyavītana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, as you have vigour, invogorate mankind; give animation to the clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्ध॒ यान्ति॑ म॒रुत॒: सं ह॑ ब्रुव॒तेऽध्व॒न्ना । शृ॒णोति॒ कश्चि॑देषाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ yā́nti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ha ǀ bruvate ǀ ádhvan ǀ ā́ ǀśṛṇóti ǀ káḥ ǀ cit ǀ eṣām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wherever theMarutspass, they fill the way with clamour; every one hears their (noise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र या॑त॒ शीभ॑मा॒शुभि॒: सन्ति॒ कण्वे॑षु वो॒ दुव॑: । तत्रो॒ षु मा॑दयाध्वै
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yāta ǀ śī́bham ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ sánti ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ vaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀtátro íti ǀ sú ǀ mādayādhvai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly, with your swift (vehicles); the offerings of thekaṇvasare prepared; be plural ased with them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ति॒ हि ष्मा॒ मदा॑य व॒: स्मसि॑ ष्मा व॒यमे॑षाम् । विश्वं॑ चि॒दायु॑र्जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásti ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ mádāya ǀ vaḥ ǀ smási ǀ sma ǀ vayám ǀ eṣām ǀvíśvam ǀ cit ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offering is prepared for your gratification; we are your (worshipper), that we may live all our life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कद्ध॑ नू॒नं क॑धप्रियः पि॒ता पु॒त्रं न हस्त॑योः । द॒धि॒ध्वे वृ॑क्तबर्हिषः
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ kadha-priyaḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ putrám ǀ ná ǀ hástayoḥ ǀdadhidhvé ǀ vṛkta-barhiṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are fond of praise, and for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, when will you take us by bothhandsas a father does his son?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व॑ नू॒नं कद्वो॒ अर्थं॒ गन्ता॑ दि॒वो न पृ॑थि॒व्याः । क्व॑ वो॒ गावो॒ न र॑ण्यन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ nūnám ǀ kát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ártham ǀ gánta ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀkvá ǀ vaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇyanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where indeed are you (at present)? When will your arrival take plural ce? Pass from the heaven, not from the earth. Where do they worship you cry (to you) like cattle?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व॑ वः सु॒म्ना नव्यां॑सि॒ मरु॑त॒: क्व॑ सुवि॒ता । क्वो॒३॒॑ विश्वा॑नि॒ सौभ॑गा
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sumnā́ ǀ návyāṃsi ǀ márutaḥ ǀ kvá ǀ suvitā́ ǀkvó íti ǀ víśvāni ǀ sáubhagā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where,Maruts, are your new treasures? Where your valuable (riches)? Where all your auspicious (gifts)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्यू॒यं पृ॑श्निमातरो॒ मर्ता॑स॒: स्यात॑न । स्तो॒ता वो॑ अ॒मृत॑: स्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ yūyám ǀ pṛśni-mātaraḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ syā́tana ǀstotā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ syāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That you, sons ofPṛśni, may become mortals, and your panegyrist become immortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा वो॑ मृ॒गो न यव॑से जरि॒ता भू॒दजो॑ष्यः । प॒था य॒मस्य॑ गा॒दुप॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀ jaritā́ ǀ bhūt ǀ ájoṣyaḥ ǀpathā́ ǀ yamásya ǀ gāt ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never may your worshipper be indifferent to you, as a deer (is never indifferent) to pasture, so that he may not tread the path ofYama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु ण॒: परा॑परा॒ निॠ॑तिर्दु॒र्हणा॑ वधीत् । प॒दी॒ष्ट तृष्ण॑या स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ párā-parā ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ duḥ-hánā ǀ vadhīt ǀpadīṣṭá ǀ tṛ́ṣṇayā ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the most powerful and indestructibleNirṛtidestroy us; let him perish with our (evil) desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यं त्वे॒षा अम॑वन्तो॒ धन्व॑ञ्चि॒दा रु॒द्रिया॑सः । मिहं॑ कृण्वन्त्यवा॒ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ tveṣā́ḥ ǀ áma-vantaḥ ǀ dhánvan ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ rudríyāsaḥ ǀmíham ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ avātā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In truth the brilliant and vigorousMaruts, cherishes byRudra, send down rain without wind upon the desert.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒श्रेव॑ वि॒द्युन्मि॑माति व॒त्सं न मा॒ता सि॑षक्ति । यदे॑षां वृ॒ष्टिरस॑र्जि
shlokas.transliteration: vāśrā́-iva ǀ vi-dyút ǀ mimāti ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātā́ ǀ sisakti ǀyát ǀ eṣām ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ ásarji ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The lightning roars like a parent cow that bellows for its calf, and hence the rain is set free by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दिवा॑ चि॒त्तम॑: कृण्वन्ति प॒र्जन्ये॑नोदवा॒हेन॑ । यत्पृ॑थि॒वीं व्यु॒न्दन्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: dívā ǀ cit ǀ támaḥ ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ parjányena ǀ uda-vāhéna ǀyát ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ vi-undánti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They spread darkness over the day by a water-bearing cloud, and thence inundate the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्व॒नान्म॒रुतां॒ विश्व॒मा सद्म॒ पार्थि॑वम् । अरे॑जन्त॒ प्र मानु॑षाः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ svanā́t ǀ marútām ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ sádma ǀ pā́rthivam ǀárejanta ǀ prá ǀ mā́nuṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the roaring of theMaruts, every dwelling of earth (shakes), and men also tremble.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑तो वीळुपा॒णिभि॑श्चि॒त्रा रोध॑स्वती॒रनु॑ । या॒तेमखि॑द्रयामभिः
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ vīḷupāṇí-bhiḥ ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ ródhasvatīḥ ǀ ánu ǀyātá ǀ īm ǀ ákhidrayāma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, with stronghands, come along the beautifully-embanked rivers, with obstructed progress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रा व॑: सन्तु ने॒मयो॒ रथा॒ अश्वा॑स एषाम् । सुसं॑स्कृता अ॒भीश॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: sthirā́ḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ santu ǀ nemáyaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀsú-saṃskṛtāḥ ǀ abhī́śavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the felloes of your wheels be firm; may your cars and their steeds be steady, and your fingers well-skilled (to hold the reins).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ वदा॒ तना॑ गि॒रा ज॒रायै॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑म् । अ॒ग्निं मि॒त्रं न द॑र्श॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ vada ǀ tánā ǀ girā́ ǀ jarā́yai ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀagním ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ darśatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Declare in our presence, (priests), with voice attuned to praiseBrahmaṇaspati(lord of the sacriricial food),Agniand the beautifulMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒मी॒हि श्लोक॑मा॒स्ये॑ प॒र्जन्य॑ इव ततनः । गाय॑ गाय॒त्रमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mimīhí ǀ ślókam ǀ āsyé ǀ parjányaḥ-iva ǀ tatanaḥ ǀgā́ya ǀ gāyatrám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utter the verse that is in your mouths, spread it out like a cloud spreading rain; chant the measured hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन्द॑स्व॒ मारु॑तं ग॒णं त्वे॒षं प॑न॒स्युम॒र्किण॑म् । अ॒स्मे वृ॒द्धा अ॑सन्नि॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: vándasva ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀ tveṣám ǀ panasyúm ǀ arkíṇam ǀasmé íti ǀ vṛddhā́ḥ ǀ asan ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the host ofMaruts, brilliant, deserving of praise, entitled to adoration; may they be exalted by this our worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यदि॒त्था प॑रा॒वत॑: शो॒चिर्न मान॒मस्य॑थ । कस्य॒ क्रत्वा॑ मरुत॒: कस्य॒ वर्प॑सा॒ कं या॑थ॒ कं ह॑ धूतयः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ itthā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ śocíḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́nam ǀ ásyatha ǀkásya ǀ krátvā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ kásya ǀ várpasā ǀ kám ǀ yātha ǀ kám ǀ ha ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenMaruts, who make (all things) tremble, you direct your awful (vigour) downwards from afar, as light (descends from heaven), by whose worship by whose praise (are you attracted)? to what (plural ce of sacrifice), to whom, indeed, do you repair?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रा व॑: स॒न्त्वायु॑धा परा॒णुदे॑ वी॒ळू उ॒त प्र॑ति॒ष्कभे॑ । यु॒ष्माक॑मस्तु॒ तवि॑षी॒ पनी॑यसी॒ मा मर्त्य॑स्य मा॒यिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sthirā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ santu ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ parā-núde ǀ vīḷú ǀ utá ǀ prati-skábhe ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ táviṣī ǀ pánīyasī ǀ mā́ ǀ mártyasya ǀ māyínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strong be your weapons for driving away (your) foes, firm in resisting them; yours be the strength that merits praise, not (the strength) of a treacherous mortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ ह॒ यत्स्थि॒रं ह॒थ नरो॑ व॒र्तय॑था गु॒रु । वि या॑थन व॒निन॑: पृथि॒व्या व्याशा॒: पर्व॑तानाम्
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ sthirám ǀ hathá ǀ náraḥ ǀ vartáyatha ǀ gurú ǀví ǀ yāthana ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ ā́śāḥ ǀ párvatānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DirectingMaruts, when you demolish what is stable, when you scatter what is ponderous, then you make your way through the forest (trees) of earth and the defiles of the mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि व॒: शत्रु॑र्विवि॒दे अधि॒ द्यवि॒ न भूम्यां॑ रिशादसः । यु॒ष्माक॑मस्तु॒ तवि॑षी॒ तना॑ यु॒जा रुद्रा॑सो॒ नू चि॑दा॒धृषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ śátruḥ ǀ vividé ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀ ná ǀ bhū́myām ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ táviṣī ǀ tánā ǀ yujā́ ǀ rúdrāsaḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyers of foes, no adversary of yours is known above the heavens, nor (is any) upon earth; may your collective strength be quickly exerted, sons ofRudra, to humble (your enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वे॑पयन्ति॒ पर्व॑ता॒न्वि वि॑ञ्चन्ति॒ वन॒स्पती॑न् । प्रो आ॑रत मरुतो दु॒र्मदा॑ इव॒ देवा॑स॒: सर्व॑या वि॒शा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vepayanti ǀ párvatān ǀ ví ǀ viñcanti ǀ vánaspátīn ǀpró íti ǀ ārata ǀ marutaḥ ǀ durmádāḥ-iva ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ sárvayā ǀ viśā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They make the mountains tremble, they drive apart the forest-trees. Go, divineMaruts, whither you will, with all your progeny, like those intoxicated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॒ रथे॑षु॒ पृष॑तीरयुग्ध्वं॒ प्रष्टि॑र्वहति॒ रोहि॑तः । आ वो॒ यामा॑य पृथि॒वी चि॑दश्रो॒दबी॑भयन्त॒ मानु॑षाः
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ rátheṣu ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ ayugdhvam ǀ práṣṭiḥ ǀ vahati ǀ róhitaḥ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yā́māya ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ cit ǀ aśrot ǀ ábībhayanta ǀ mā́nuṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have harnessed the spotted deer to your chariot; the red deer yoked between them, (aids to) drag the car; the firmament listens for your coming, and men are alarmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॑ म॒क्षू तना॑य॒ कं रुद्रा॒ अवो॑ वृणीमहे । गन्ता॑ नू॒नं नोऽव॑सा॒ यथा॑ पु॒रेत्था कण्वा॑य बि॒भ्युषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ tánāya ǀ kám ǀ rúdrāḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀgánta ǀ nūnám ǀ naḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ yáthā ǀ purā́ ǀ itthā́ ǀ káṇvāya ǀ bibhyúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rudras, we have recourse to your assistance for the sake of our progeny; come quickly to the timidKaṇva, as you formerly came, for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्मेषि॑तो मरुतो॒ मर्त्ये॑षित॒ आ यो नो॒ अभ्व॒ ईष॑ते । वि तं यु॑योत॒ शव॑सा॒ व्योज॑सा॒ वि यु॒ष्माका॑भिरू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́-iṣitaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mártya-iṣitaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvaḥ ǀ ī́ṣate ǀví ǀ tám ǀ yuyota ǀ śávasā ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǀ ví ǀ yuṣmā́kābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Should any adversary, instrumental gated by you, or by man, assail us, withhold from him food and strength and your assistance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑मि॒ हि प्र॑यज्यव॒: कण्वं॑ द॒द प्र॑चेतसः । असा॑मिभिर्मरुत॒ आ न॑ ऊ॒तिभि॒र्गन्ता॑ वृ॒ष्टिं न वि॒द्युत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ásāmi ǀ hí ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ dadá ǀ pra-cetasaḥ ǀásāmi-bhiḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ gánta ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ná ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pracetasas, who are to be unreservedly worshipped, uphold (the sacrificer)Kaṇva; come to us,Maruts, with undivided protective assistance, as the lightning (bring) the rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॒म्योजो॑ बिभृथा सुदान॒वोऽसा॑मि धूतय॒: शव॑: । ऋ॒षि॒द्विषे॑ मरुतः परिम॒न्यव॒ इषुं॒ न सृ॑जत॒ द्विष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ásāmi ǀ ójaḥ ǀ bibhṛtha ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ ásāmi ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ śávaḥ ǀṛṣi-dvíṣe ǀ marutaḥ ǀ pari-manyáve ǀ íṣum ǀ ná ǀ sṛjata ǀ dvíṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bounteous givers, you enjoy unimpaired vigour; shakers (of the earth), you possess undiminished strength;Maruts, let loose your anger, like an arrow, upon the wrathful enemy of the ṛṣis.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ति॑ष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देव॒यन्त॑स्त्वेमहे । उप॒ प्र य॑न्तु म॒रुत॑: सु॒दान॑व॒ इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒शूर्भ॑वा॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ īmahe ǀúpa ǀ prá ǀ yantu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ índra ǀ prāśū́ḥ ǀ bhava ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise us, Brhmaṇaspati; devoted to the gods, we solicit you, bounteousMaruts, be nigh athand;Indra, be a partaker fo the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि स॑हसस्पुत्र॒ मर्त्य॑ उपब्रू॒ते धने॑ हि॒ते । सु॒वीर्यं॑ मरुत॒ आ स्वश्व्यं॒ दधी॑त॒ यो व॑ आच॒के
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ upa-brūté ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀsu-vī́ryam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ dádhīta ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā-caké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Man celebrates you, son of strength, for the wealth abandoned (by the foe).Maruts, may be who praises you obtain wealth, yielding excellent steeds and eminent vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रैतु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒: प्र दे॒व्ये॑तु सू॒नृता॑ । अच्छा॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॑ प॒ङ्क्तिरा॑धसं दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं न॑यन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ etu ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ prá ǀ devī́ ǀ etu ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀáccha ǀ vīrám ǀ náryam ǀ paṅktí-rādhasam ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ nayantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBrahmaṇaspatiapproach us;  may the goddess, speaker of truth, approach us; may the gods (drive away) every adversary, and present, conduct us to the sacrifice which is beneficial to man, and (abounds) with respectably-presented offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वा॒घते॒ ददा॑ति सू॒नरं॒ वसु॒ स ध॑त्ते॒ अक्षि॑ति॒ श्रव॑: । तस्मा॒ इळां॑ सु॒वीरा॒मा य॑जामहे सु॒प्रतू॑र्तिमने॒हस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vāgháte ǀ dádāti ǀ sūnáram ǀ vásu ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ ákṣiti ǀ śrávaḥ ǀtásmai ǀ íḷām ǀ su-vī́rām ǀ ā́ ǀ yajāmahe ǀ su-prátūrtim ǀ anehásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who presents to the ministrant (priest) wealth fit to be accepted, enjoys inexhaustible abundance; for him we worship, Iḷā, attended by brave warriors, inflicting much injury, receiving none.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नू॒नं ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्मन्त्रं॑ वदत्यु॒क्थ्य॑म् । यस्मि॒न्निन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा दे॒वा ओकां॑सि चक्रि॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nūnám ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ mántram ǀ vadati ǀ ukthyám ǀyásmin ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ókāṃsi ǀ cakriré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VerilyBrahmaṇaspatiproclaims the sacred prayer, in which the divinities,Indra,Varuṇa,MitraandAryaman, have made their abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिद्वो॑चेमा वि॒दथे॑षु श॒म्भुवं॒ मन्त्रं॑ देवा अने॒हस॑म् । इ॒मां च॒ वाचं॑ प्रति॒हर्य॑था नरो॒ विश्वेद्वा॒मा वो॑ अश्नवत्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ vocema ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ śam-bhúvam ǀ mántram ǀ devāḥ ǀ anehásam ǀimā́m ǀ ca ǀ vā́cam ǀ prati-háryatha ǀ naraḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ vāmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ aśnavat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us recite, gods, that felicitous and faultless prayer at sacrifices; if you, leaders, desire (to hear) this prayer, then will all that is to be spoken reach unto you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को दे॑व॒यन्त॑मश्नव॒ज्जनं॒ को वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषम् । प्रप्र॑ दा॒श्वान्प॒स्त्या॑भिरस्थितान्त॒र्वाव॒त्क्षयं॑ दधे
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ deva-yántam ǀ aśnavat ǀ jánam ǀ káḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣam ǀprá-pra ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ pastyā́bhiḥ ǀ asthita ǀ antaḥ-vā́vat ǀ kṣáyam ǀ dadhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, (exceptBrahmaṇaspati), may approach the man who is devoted to the gods, by whom the clipped sacred grass is spread; the giver of the oblation has proceeded with the priests (to the hall of sacrifice), for he has a dwelling (abounding) internally with precious things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ क्ष॒त्रं पृ॑ञ्ची॒त हन्ति॒ राज॑भिर्भ॒ये चि॑त्सुक्षि॒तिं द॑धे । नास्य॑ व॒र्ता न त॑रु॒ता म॑हाध॒ने नार्भे॑ अस्ति व॒ज्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ kṣatrám ǀ pṛñcītá ǀ hánti ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ bhayé ǀ cit ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ dadhe ǀná ǀ asya ǀ vartā́ ǀ ná ǀ tarutā́ ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ ná ǀ árbhe ǀ asti ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetBrahmaṇaspaticoncentrate his strength associated with the regal (divinities), he slays (the foe); in the time of danger he maintains his station; armed with the thunderbolt, there is no encourager nor discourager of him in a great battle or a small.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं रक्ष॑न्ति॒ प्रचे॑तसो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । नू चि॒त्स द॑भ्यते॒ जन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ rákṣanti ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀnú ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ dabhyate ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man whom the wiseVaruṇa,MitraandAryamanprotect quickly subdues (his foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं बा॒हुते॑व॒ पिप्र॑ति॒ पान्ति॒ मर्त्यं॑ रि॒षः । अरि॑ष्ट॒: सर्व॑ एधते
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ bāhútā-iva ǀ píprati ǀ pā́nti ǀ mártyam ǀ riṣáḥ ǀáriṣṭaḥ ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ edhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hw whom they heap (with riches), as if (collected) by his own arms; the man whom they defend from the malignant; every such man, safe from injury, prospers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि दु॒र्गा वि द्विष॑: पु॒रो घ्नन्ति॒ राजा॑न एषाम् । नय॑न्ति दुरि॒ता ति॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ duḥ-gā́ ǀ ví ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ ghnánti ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀnáyanti ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tiráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kings (Varuṇaetc.) first destroy their strongholds, and then the foes of those (who worship him), and put aside their evil deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒गः पन्था॑ अनृक्ष॒र आदि॑त्यास ऋ॒तं य॒ते । नात्रा॑वखा॒दो अ॑स्ति वः
shlokas.transliteration: su-gáḥ ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ anṛkṣaráḥ ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀná ǀ átra ǀ ava-khādáḥ ǀ asti ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, to you repairing to the sacrifice, the path is easy and free from thorns; no unworthy oblation is here prepared for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं य॒ज्ञं नय॑था नर॒ आदि॑त्या ऋ॒जुना॑ प॒था । प्र व॒: स धी॒तये॑ नशत्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ yajñám ǀ náyatha ǀ naraḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ ṛjúnā ǀ pathā́ ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhītáye ǀ naśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, guides, may the sacrifice which you come to by a straight path, be to you for your gratification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रत्नं॒ मर्त्यो॒ वसु॒ विश्वं॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑ । अच्छा॑ गच्छ॒त्यस्तृ॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ rátnam ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ víśvam ǀ tokám ǀ utá ǀ tmánā ǀáccha ǀ gacchati ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That mortal (whom you favour), exempt from harm, obtains all valuable wealth, and offspring like himself.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था रा॑धाम सखाय॒: स्तोमं॑ मि॒त्रस्या॑र्य॒म्णः । महि॒ प्सरो॒ वरु॑णस्य
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ rādhāma ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ stómam ǀ mitrásya ǀ aryamṇáḥ ǀmáhi ǀ psáraḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How, my friends, shall we recite priase (worthy) of the great glory ofMitra,VaruṇaandAryaman?”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा वो॒ घ्नन्तं॒ मा शप॑न्तं॒ प्रति॑ वोचे देव॒यन्त॑म् । सु॒म्नैरिद्व॒ आ वि॑वासे
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ghnántam ǀ mā́ ǀ śápantam ǀ práti ǀ voce ǀ deva-yántam ǀsumnáiḥ ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I do not denounce to you him who assails or reviles the man devoted to the gods. I rather propitiate you with offered wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं पू॑ष॒न्नध्व॑नस्तिर॒ व्यंहो॑ विमुचो नपात् । सक्ष्वा॑ देव॒ प्र ण॑स्पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ pūṣan ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ tira ǀ ví ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ vi-mucaḥ ǀ napāt ǀsákṣva ǀ deva ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣanm convey us over the road, remove the wicked (obsructer of the way). Son of the cloud, deity, go before us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॑: पूषन्न॒घो वृको॑ दु॒:शेव॑ आ॒दिदे॑शति । अप॑ स्म॒ तं प॒थो ज॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣan ǀ agháḥ ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ duḥśévaḥ ǀ ā-dídeśati ǀápa ǀ sma ǀ tám ǀ patháḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If a wicked (adversary),Pūṣan, a robber, or one who delights in evil, points out to us (the way we ought not to go), do you drive him from the road.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ त्यं प॑रिप॒न्थिनं॑ मुषी॒वाणं॑ हुर॒श्चित॑म् । दू॒रमधि॑ स्रु॒तेर॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyám ǀ pari-panthínam ǀ muṣīvā́ṇam ǀ huraḥ-cítam ǀdūrám ǀ ádhi ǀ srutéḥ ǀ aja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drive him far away, apart fom the road, the hinderer of our journey, a thief, a deceiver.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तस्य॑ द्वया॒विनो॒ऽघशं॑सस्य॒ कस्य॑ चित् । प॒दाभि ति॑ष्ठ॒ तपु॑षिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tásya ǀ dvayāvínaḥ ǀ aghá-śaṃsasya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀpadā́ ǀ abhí ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ tápuṣim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Trample with your feet upon the mischievous (body) of that evil-minded pilferer of both (what is present and what is absent), whoever he be.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तत्ते॑ दस्र मन्तुम॒: पूष॒न्नवो॑ वृणीमहे । येन॑ पि॒तॄनचो॑दयः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ dasra ǀ mantu-maḥ ǀ pūṣan ǀ ávaḥ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀyéna ǀ pitṝ́n ǀ ácodayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sagacious and handsomePūṣan, we solicit of you that protection wherewith you have encouraged the patriarchs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ नो विश्वसौभग॒ हिर॑ण्यवाशीमत्तम । धना॑नि सु॒षणा॑ कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ naḥ ǀ viśva-saubhaga ǀ híraṇyavāśīmat-tama ǀdhánāni ǀ su-sánā ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore do you, who are possessed of all prosperity and well-equipped with golden weapons, bestow upon us riches that may be liberally distributed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ नः स॒श्चतो॑ नय सु॒गा न॑: सु॒पथा॑ कृणु । पूष॑न्नि॒ह क्रतुं॑ विदः
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ naḥ ǀ saścátaḥ ǀ naya ǀ su-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ su-páthā ǀ kṛṇu ǀpū́ṣan ǀ ihá ǀ krátum ǀ vidaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lead us past our opponents; conduct us by an easy path; know,Pūṣan, how to protect us on this (journey).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि सू॒यव॑सं नय॒ न न॑वज्वा॒रो अध्व॑ने । पूष॑न्नि॒ह क्रतुं॑ विदः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ su-yávasam ǀ naya ǀ ná ǀ nava-jvāráḥ ǀ ádhvane ǀpū́ṣan ǀ ihá ǀ krátum ǀ vidaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lead us where there is abundant fodder; let there be no extreme heat by the way;Pūṣan, know to protect us on this (journey).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒ग्धि पू॒र्धि प्र यं॑सि च शिशी॒हि प्रास्यु॒दर॑म् । पूष॑न्नि॒ह क्रतुं॑ विदः
shlokas.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ pūrdhí ǀ prá ǀ yaṃsi ǀ ca ǀ śiśīhí ǀ prā́si ǀ udáram ǀpū́ṣan ǀ ihá ǀ krátum ǀ vidaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be favourable to us, fill us (with abundance), give us (all goood things), sharpen us (with vigour), fill our bellies,Pūṣan, know how to protect us on this (journey).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न पू॒षणं॑ मेथामसि सू॒क्तैर॒भि गृ॑णीमसि । वसू॑नि द॒स्ममी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ methāmasi ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀvásūni ǀ dasmám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We do not censurePūṣan, but praise him with hymns; we solicit the good-looking (Pūṣan) for riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कद्रु॒द्राय॒ प्रचे॑तसे मी॒ळ्हुष्ट॑माय॒ तव्य॑से । वो॒चेम॒ शंत॑मं हृ॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ prá-cetase ǀ mīḷhúḥ-tamāya ǀ távyase ǀvocéma ǀ śám-tamam ǀ hṛdé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When may we repeat a most grateful hymn to the wise, the most bountiful and mightyRudra, who is (cherished) in our hearts?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ नो॒ अदि॑ति॒: कर॒त्पश्वे॒ नृभ्यो॒ यथा॒ गवे॑ । यथा॑ तो॒काय॑ रु॒द्रिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ kárat ǀ páśve ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ gáve ǀyáthā ǀ tokā́ya ǀ rudríyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By which earth may (be induced to) grant the gifts ofRudrato our cattle, our people, our cows, and our progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ नो मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो॒ यथा॑ रु॒द्रश्चिके॑तति । यथा॒ विश्वे॑ स॒जोष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ rudráḥ ǀ cíketati ǀyáthā ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By whichMitraandVaruṇa, andRudraand all the gods, being gratified, may show us (favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गा॒थप॑तिं मे॒धप॑तिं रु॒द्रं जला॑षभेषजम् । तच्छं॒योः सु॒म्नमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: gāthá-patim ǀ medhá-patim ǀ rudrám ǀ jálāṣa-bheṣajam ǀtát ǀ śam-yóḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We ask the felicity ofŚaṃyu, fromRudra, the encourager of hymns, the protector of sacrifices, possessed of medicaments that confer delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः शु॒क्र इ॑व॒ सूर्यो॒ हिर॑ण्यमिव॒ रोच॑ते । श्रेष्ठो॑ दे॒वानां॒ वसु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śukráḥ-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ híraṇyam-iva ǀ rócate ǀśréṣṭhaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ vásuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who is so brilliant asŚaṃyu, who gratifies like gold, the best of the gods, the provider of habitations?”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॑: कर॒त्यर्व॑ते सु॒गं मे॒षाय॑ मे॒ष्ये॑ । नृभ्यो॒ नारि॑भ्यो॒ गवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ karati ǀ árvate ǀ su-gám ǀ meṣā́ya ǀ meṣyé ǀnṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ nā́ri-bhyaḥ ǀ gáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who bestows easily-obtained happiness on our steeds, our rams, our ewes, our men, our women, and our cows?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे सो॑म॒ श्रिय॒मधि॒ नि धे॑हि श॒तस्य॑ नृ॒णाम् । महि॒ श्रव॑स्तुविनृ॒म्णम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ soma ǀ śríyam ǀ ádhi ǀ ní ǀ dhehi ǀ śatásya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀmáhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, grant us prosperity more than (sufficient for) a hundred men, and much strength-engendering food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॑: सोमपरि॒बाधो॒ मारा॑तयो जुहुरन्त । आ न॑ इन्दो॒ वाजे॑ भज
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma-paribā́dhaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ juhuranta ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ vā́je ǀ bhaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the adversaries ofSoma, let not our enemies, harm us; cherish us,Indra, with (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यास्ते॑ प्र॒जा अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ पर॑स्मि॒न्धाम॑न्नृ॒तस्य॑ । मू॒र्धा नाभा॑ सोम वेन आ॒भूष॑न्तीः सोम वेदः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ párasmin ǀ dhā́man ǀ ṛtásya ǀmūrdhā́ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ soma ǀ venaḥ ǀ ā-bhū́ṣantīḥ ǀ soma ǀ vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are immortal, and abide in an excellent dwelling, have regard for your subjects, when at their head in the hall of sacrifice you observe them (engaed in) decorating you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ विव॑स्वदु॒षस॑श्चि॒त्रं राधो॑ अमर्त्य । आ दा॒शुषे॑ जातवेदो वहा॒ त्वम॒द्या दे॒वाँ उ॑ष॒र्बुध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ vívasvat ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ citrám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ amartya ǀā́ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ vaha ǀ tvám ǀ adyá ǀ devā́n ǀ uṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are immortal, and cognisant of all begotten things, bring from the dawn to the donor (of the oblation) wealth of many sorts, with an excellent habitation; bring hither today the gods awaking with the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जुष्टो॒ हि दू॒तो असि॑ हव्य॒वाह॒नोऽग्ने॑ र॒थीर॑ध्व॒राणा॑म् । स॒जूर॒श्विभ्या॑मु॒षसा॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म॒स्मे धे॑हि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ hí ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ási ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀsa-jū́ḥ ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ uṣásā ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Agni, are the accepted messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations, the vehicle of sacrifices; associated with Uṣas and theAśvins, bestow upon us abundant and invigorating food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्या दू॒तं वृ॑णीमहे॒ वसु॑म॒ग्निं पु॑रुप्रि॒यम् । धू॒मके॑तुं॒ भाऋ॑जीकं॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु य॒ज्ञाना॑मध्वर॒श्रिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: adyá ǀ dūtám ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ vásum ǀ agním ǀ puru-priyám ǀdhūmá-ketum ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkam ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ adhvara-śríyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We select todayAgni, the messenger, the giver of dwellings, the beloved of many, the smoke-bannered, the light-shedding, the protector of the worship of the worshipper at the break of day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं॒ यवि॑ष्ठ॒मति॑थिं॒ स्वा॑हुतं॒ जुष्टं॒ जना॑य दा॒शुषे॑ । दे॒वाँ अच्छा॒ यात॑वे जा॒तवे॑दसम॒ग्निमी॑ळे॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: śréṣṭham ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ átithim ǀ sú-āhutam ǀ júṣṭam ǀ jánāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀdevā́n ǀ áccha ǀ yā́tave ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ agním ǀ īḷe ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praiseAgniat the break of day, the best and youngest (of the gods), the guest (of man), the universally-invoked, who is friendly to the man that offers (oblations), who knows all that are born, that he may go (to bring) the other divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्त॒वि॒ष्यामि॒ त्वाम॒हं विश्व॑स्यामृत भोजन । अग्ने॑ त्रा॒तार॑म॒मृतं॑ मियेध्य॒ यजि॑ष्ठं हव्यवाहन
shlokas.transliteration: staviṣyā́mi ǀ tvā́m ǀ ahám ǀ víśvasya ǀ amṛta ǀ bhojana ǀágne ǀ trātā́ram ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ miyedhya ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ havya-vāhana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, immortal sustainer of the universe, bearer of oblations, deserving of adoration, I will praise you, who are exempt from death, the preserver of the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒शंसो॑ बोधि गृण॒ते य॑विष्ठ्य॒ मधु॑जिह्व॒: स्वा॑हुतः । प्रस्क॑ण्वस्य प्रति॒रन्नायु॑र्जी॒वसे॑ नम॒स्या दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: su-śáṃsaḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ mádhu-jihvaḥ ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀpráskaṇvasya ǀ pra-tirán ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ namasyá ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “JuvenileAgni, whose flames delight, who ar euniversally invoked, and are praised (by us) on behalf of the worshipper, understand (our wishes), and grantingPraskaṇvato live a lengthened life, do honour to the divine man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑रं वि॒श्ववे॑दसं॒ सं हि त्वा॒ विश॑ इ॒न्धते॑ । स आ व॑ह पुरुहूत॒ प्रचे॑त॒सोऽग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ इ॒ह द्र॒वत्
shlokas.transliteration: hótāram ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ víśaḥ ǀ indháte ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ puru-hūta ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ dravát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All people kindle you,Agni, the sacrificer, the omniscient; do you, Agni, who are invoked by many, quickly bring hither the sapient deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒वि॒तार॑मु॒षस॑म॒श्विना॒ भग॑म॒ग्निं व्यु॑ष्टिषु॒ क्षप॑: । कण्वा॑सस्त्वा सु॒तसो॑मास इन्धते हव्य॒वाहं॑ स्वध्वर
shlokas.transliteration: savitā́ram ǀ uṣásam ǀ aśvínā ǀ bhágam ǀ agním ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ kṣápaḥ ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ sutá-somāsaḥ ǀ indhate ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ su-adhvara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Object of holy rites, (bring hither) on the dawn following the night,Savitā, Uṣas andAśvins,BhagaandAgni; theKaṇvaspouring out libations, kindle the water of the burnt offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पति॒र्ह्य॑ध्व॒राणा॒मग्ने॑ दू॒तो वि॒शामसि॑ । उ॒ष॒र्बुध॒ आ व॑ह॒ सोम॑पीतये दे॒वाँ अ॒द्य स्व॒र्दृश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pátiḥ ǀ hí ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ ágne ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ ási ǀuṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ devā́n ǀ adyá ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the protector of the sacrifices of the people, and the messenger (of the gods); bring hither today the gods awaking at dawn, and contemplating the sun, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ पूर्वा॒ अनू॒षसो॑ विभावसो दी॒देथ॑ वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः । असि॒ ग्रामे॑ष्ववि॒ता पु॒रोहि॒तोऽसि॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॒ मानु॑षः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vibhāvaso íti vibhā-vaso ǀ dīdétha ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀási ǀ grā́meṣu ǀ avitā́ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ ási ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, visible to all, you have blazed after many preceding dawns, you are the protector (of people) in villages, you are the associate of man plural ced on the east (of the altar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ साध॑न॒मग्ने॒ होता॑रमृ॒त्विज॑म् । म॒नु॒ष्वद्दे॑व धीमहि॒ प्रचे॑तसं जी॒रं दू॒तमम॑र्त्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀ ágne ǀ hótāram ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀmanuṣvát ǀ deva ǀ dhīmahi ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ jīrám ǀ dūtám ǀ ámartyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We plural ce you,Agni, asManuplural ced you, who are the implement of sacrifice, the invoker, the ministering priest, very wise, the destroyer (of foes), immortal, the messenger (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्दे॒वानां॑ मित्रमहः पु॒रोहि॒तोऽन्त॑रो॒ यासि॑ दू॒त्य॑म् । सिन्धो॑रिव॒ प्रस्व॑नितास ऊ॒र्मयो॒ऽग्नेर्भ्रा॑जन्ते अ॒र्चय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ devā́nām ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ dūtyám ǀsíndhoḥ-iva ǀ prá-svanitāsaḥ ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ bhrājante ǀ arcáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, cherisher of friends, you are present as thePurohitaat a sacrifice, and discharge the mission of the gods, then your flames roar like the resounding billows of the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त्कर्ण॒ वह्नि॑भिर्दे॒वैर॑ग्ने स॒याव॑भिः । आ सी॑दन्तु ब॒र्हिषि॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा प्रा॑त॒र्यावा॑णो अध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ śrut-karṇa ǀ váhni-bhiḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sayā́va-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ sīdantu ǀ barhíṣi ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ prātaḥ-yā́vānaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, with sharp ears, hear me; letMitraandAryaman, and Aryaman, and (other) early-stirring deities, with all the accompanying oblation-bearing gods, sit down at the sacrifice upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ स्तोमं॑ म॒रुत॑: सु॒दान॑वोऽग्निजि॒ह्वा ऋ॑ता॒वृध॑: । पिब॑तु॒ सोमं॒ वरु॑णो धृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ऽश्विभ्या॑मु॒षसा॑ स॒जूः
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇvántu ǀ stómam ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀpíbatu ǀ sómam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ uṣásā ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the munificentMaruts, who have tongues of fire, and are encouragers of sacrifice, hear our praise; let the rite-fulfillingVaruṇa, with theAśvins, and with Uṣas, drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ वसूँ॑रि॒ह रु॒द्राँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ उ॒त । यजा॑ स्वध्व॒रं जनं॒ मनु॑जातं घृत॒प्रुष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vásūn ǀ ihá ǀ rudrā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ utá ǀyája ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ jánam ǀ mánu-jātam ǀ ghṛta-prúṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, do you, in this our rite, worship theVasus, theRudras, theĀdityas, or any other (living) being sprung fromManu, sacrificing well and sprinkling water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒ष्टी॒वानो॒ हि दा॒शुषे॑ दे॒वा अ॑ग्ने॒ विचे॑तसः । तान्रो॑हिदश्व गिर्वण॒स्त्रय॑स्त्रिंशत॒मा व॑ह
shlokas.transliteration: śruṣṭī-vā́naḥ ǀ hí ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǀtā́n ǀ rohit-aśva ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ tráyaḥ-triṃśatam ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily the discriminating gods are givers of rewards to the offerer (of oblations); lord of red coursers, propitiated by our praises, bring hither the three and thirty divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒य॒मे॒ध॒वद॑त्रि॒वज्जात॑वेदो विरूप॒वत् । अ॒ङ्गि॒र॒स्वन्म॑हिव्रत॒ प्रस्क॑ण्वस्य श्रुधी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: priyamedha-vát ǀ atri-vát ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ virūpa-vát ǀaṅgirasvát ǀ mahi-vrata ǀ práskaṇvasya ǀ śrudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, accomplisher of solemn acts, cognisant of all who are born, hear the invocation ofpraskaṇva, as you have heard those ofPriyamedhaofAtri, ofVirūpa, ofAṅgiras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑केरव ऊ॒तये॑ प्रि॒यमे॑धा अहूषत । राज॑न्तमध्व॒राणा॑म॒ग्निं शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: máhi-keravaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ priyá-medhāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀrā́jantam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ agním ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The performers of great ceremonies, the offerers of acceptable sacrifices, have invoked for (their protection),Agni, shining amidst the solemnities, with pure resplendence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृता॑हवन सन्त्ये॒मा उ॒ षु श्रु॑धी॒ गिर॑: । याभि॒: कण्व॑स्य सू॒नवो॒ हव॒न्तेऽव॑से त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛ́ta-āhavana ǀ santya ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śrudhi ǀ gíraḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ káṇvasya ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ hávante ǀ ávase ǀ tvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked by oblations, giver of rewards, listen to these praises with which the sons ofKaṇvainvoke you for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां चि॑त्रश्रवस्तम॒ हव॑न्ते वि॒क्षु ज॒न्तव॑: । शो॒चिष्के॑शं पुरुप्रि॒याग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ citraśravaḥ-tama ǀ hávante ǀ vikṣú ǀ jantávaḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśam ǀ puru-priya ǀ ágne ǀ havyā́ya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, granter of abundant sustenance, who are beloved of many, the sons of men invoke you, radiant-haired, to bear the oblation (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॒ होता॑रमृ॒त्विजं॑ दधि॒रे व॑सु॒वित्त॑मम् । श्रुत्क॑र्णं स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं॒ विप्रा॑ अग्ने॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ hótāram ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ dadhiré ǀ vasuvít-tamam ǀśrút-karṇam ǀ sapráthaḥ-tamam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ agne ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise have plural ced you,Agni, in (their) sacrifices as the invoker, the ministrant priest, the donor of vast wealth, the quick-hearing the far-renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ विप्रा॑ अचुच्यवुः सु॒तसो॑मा अ॒भि प्रय॑: । बृ॒हद्भा बिभ्र॑तो ह॒विरग्ने॒ मर्ता॑य दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ acucyavuḥ ǀ sutá-somāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀbṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ ágne ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (priests), with effused libations ofSomajuice, have summoned you, vast and brilliantAgni, to partake of the (sacrificial food) as they hold the oblation on the part of the individual who presents it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्याव्ण॑: सहस्कृत सोम॒पेया॑य सन्त्य । इ॒हाद्य दैव्यं॒ जनं॑ ब॒र्हिरा सा॑दया वसो
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-yā́vnaḥ ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ santya ǀihá ǀ adyá ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sādaya ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strength-genitive rated, giver of rewards, provider of dwellings, plural ce here today upon the sacred grass the morning-moving deities, or (other) deified being, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चं॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॒मग्ने॒ यक्ष्व॒ सहू॑तिभिः । अ॒यं सोम॑: सुदानव॒स्तं पा॑त ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀ ágne ǀ yákṣva ǀ sáhūti-bhiḥ ǀayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ tám ǀ pāta ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship with conjoint invocations,Agni, the present deified being; bounteous divinities, this is theSomajuice; drink it, for it was yesterday expressed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षो उ॒षा अपू॑र्व्या॒ व्यु॑च्छति प्रि॒या दि॒वः । स्तु॒षे वा॑मश्विना बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣó íti ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ápūrvyā ǀ ví ǀ ucchati ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀstuṣé ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The beloved Uṣas, until now unseen, scatters darkness from the sky;Aśvins, I greatly praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या द॒स्रा सिन्धु॑मातरा मनो॒तरा॑ रयी॒णाम् । धि॒या दे॒वा व॑सु॒विदा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dasrā́ ǀ síndhu-mātarā ǀ manotárā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀdhiyā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ vasu-vídā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are divine, of plural asing appearance, children of the sea, willing dispensers of wealth, and granters of dwellings (in recompense of) pious acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒च्यन्ते॑ वां ककु॒हासो॑ जू॒र्णाया॒मधि॑ वि॒ष्टपि॑ । यद्वां॒ रथो॒ विभि॒ष्पता॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: vacyánte ǀ vām ǀ kakuhā́saḥ ǀ jūrṇā́yām ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ pátāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since your chariot proceeds, (drawn) by your steeds, above the glorious heavens, your praises are proclaimed (by us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒विषा॑ जा॒रो अ॒पां पिप॑र्ति॒ पपु॑रिर्नरा । पि॒ता कुट॑स्य चर्ष॒णिः
shlokas.transliteration: havíṣā ǀ jāráḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ píparti ǀ pápuriḥ ǀ narā ǀpitā́ ǀ kúṭasya ǀ carṣaṇíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Aśvins); guides; the sun, (the evaporator) of the waters, the nourisher, the protector and beholder of the (solemn) rite, nourishes (the gods) with our oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दा॒रो वां॑ मती॒नां नास॑त्या मतवचसा । पा॒तं सोम॑स्य धृष्णु॒या
shlokas.transliteration: ādāráḥ ǀ vām ǀ matīnā́m ǀ nā́satyā ǀ mata-vacasā ǀpātám ǀ sómasya ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, accepting our praises, partake of the exhilaratingSoma, the animator of your minds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या न॒: पीप॑रदश्विना॒ ज्योति॑ष्मती॒ तम॑स्ति॒रः । ताम॒स्मे रा॑साथा॒मिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pī́parat ǀ aśvinā ǀ jyótiṣmatī ǀ támaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀtā́m ǀ asmé íti ǀ rāsāthām ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, grant us that invigorating food which may satisfy us, having dispelled the gloom (of want).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ ना॒वा म॑ती॒नां या॒तं पा॒राय॒ गन्त॑वे । यु॒ञ्जाथा॑मश्विना॒ रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nāvā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ yātám ǀ pārā́ya ǀ gántave ǀyuñjā́thām ǀ aśvinā ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come as a ship, to bear us over an ocean of praises; harness,Aśvins, your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रित्रं॑ वां दि॒वस्पृ॒थु ती॒र्थे सिन्धू॑नां॒ रथ॑: । धि॒या यु॑युज्र॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: arítram ǀ vām ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ tīrthé ǀ síndhūnām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ yuyujre ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your vessel, vaster than the sky, stops on the seashore; your chariot (waits on the land); the drops (ofSoma) are expressed for yor worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वस्क॑ण्वास॒ इन्द॑वो॒ वसु॒ सिन्धू॑नां प॒दे । स्वं व॒व्रिं कुह॑ धित्सथः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ kaṇvāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ síndhūnām ǀ padé ǀsvám ǀ vavrím ǀ kúha ǀ dhitsathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kaṇvas(ask this of theAśvins); (How) do the rays (of the sun proceed) from the sky? (How) does the dawn (rise) in the region of the waters? Where do you desire to manifest your own person ns?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑दु॒ भा उ॑ अं॒शवे॒ हिर॑ण्यं॒ प्रति॒ सूर्य॑: । व्य॑ख्यज्जि॒ह्वयासि॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aṃśáve ǀ híraṇyam ǀ práti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀví ǀ akhyat ǀ jihváyā ǀ ásitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There was light to irradiate the dawn; the sun (rose) like god; the fire shone with darkened flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑दु पा॒रमेत॑वे॒ पन्था॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ साधु॒या । अद॑र्शि॒ वि स्रु॒तिर्दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pārám ǀ étave ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sādhu-yā́ ǀádarśi ǀ ví ǀ srutíḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A fit path was made for the sun to go beyond the boundary (of night); the radiance of the luminary became visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त॒दिद॒श्विनो॒रवो॑ जरि॒ता प्रति॑ भूषति । मदे॒ सोम॑स्य॒ पिप्र॑तोः
shlokas.transliteration: tát-tat ǀ ít ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ práti ǀ bhūṣati ǀmáde ǀ sómasya ǀ pípratoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshipper acknowledges whatever boon he receives from theAśvins, satiate with the enjoyment ofSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒व॒सा॒ना वि॒वस्व॑ति॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒त्या गि॒रा । म॒नु॒ष्वच्छ॑म्भू॒ आ ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: vavasānā́ ǀ vivásvati ǀ sómasya ǀ pītyā́ ǀ girā́ ǀmanuṣvát ǀ śaṃbhū íti śam-bhū ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Causers of felicity, co-dwellers with your worshipper, as withManucome hither to drink ofSoma, and (accept) our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोरु॒षा अनु॒ श्रियं॒ परि॑ज्मनोरु॒पाच॑रत् । ऋ॒ता व॑नथो अ॒क्तुभि॑:
