shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śríyam ǀ pári-jmanoḥ ǀ upa-ā́carat ǀṛtā́ ǀ vanathaḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Uṣas follow the lustre of your approach, circumambientAśvins, and may you be plural ased with the oblations offered by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा पि॑बतमश्विनो॒भा न॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतम् । अ॒वि॒द्रि॒याभि॑रू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǀavidriyā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, may you both drink (the oblation), and bestow upon us happiness, through your irreproachable protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॒ मधु॑मत्तमः सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा । तम॑श्विना पिबतं ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यं ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǀtám ǀ aśvinā ǀ pibatam ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǀ dhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, encouragers of sacrifice, this most sweetSomais prepared for you; drink it of yesterday's expressing, and grant riches to the donor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒व॒न्धु॒रेण॑ त्रि॒वृता॑ सु॒पेश॑सा॒ रथे॒ना या॑तमश्विना । कण्वा॑सो वां॒ ब्रह्म॑ कृण्वन्त्यध्व॒रे तेषां॒ सु शृ॑णुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-vandhuréṇa ǀ tri-vṛ́tā ǀ su-péśasā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ vām ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ adhvaré ǀ téṣām ǀ sú ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, with your three-columned triangular car; theKaṇvasrepeat your praise at the sacrifice; graciously hear their invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ मधु॑मत्तमं पा॒तं सोम॑मृतावृधा । अथा॒द्य द॑स्रा॒ वसु॒ बिभ्र॑ता॒ रथे॑ दा॒श्वांस॒मुप॑ गच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ pātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǀátha ǀ adyá ǀ dasrā ǀ vásu ǀ bíbhratā ǀ ráthe ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, encouragers of sacrifice, drink this most sweetSoma; approach today the giver of the offering, you who are of plural asing aspects and bearers of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒ष॒ध॒स्थे ब॒र्हिषि॑ विश्ववेदसा॒ मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षतम् । कण्वा॑सो वां सु॒तसो॑मा अ॒भिद्य॑वो यु॒वां ह॑वन्ते अश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: tri-sadhasthé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ viśva-vedasā ǀ mádhvā ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣatam ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ vām ǀ sutá-somāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀ yuvā́m ǀ havante ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OmniscientAśvins, stationed on the thrice-heaped sacred grass, sprinkle the sacrifice with the sweet juice; the illustriousKaṇvas, with effused libations, invoke you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: कण्व॑म॒भिष्टि॑भि॒: प्राव॑तं यु॒वम॑श्विना । ताभि॒: ष्व१॒॑स्माँ अ॑वतं शुभस्पती पा॒तं सोम॑मृतावृधा
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ ā́vatam ǀ yuvám ǀ aśvinā ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ asmā́n ǀ avatam ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ pātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With such desired aids as you protectedKaṇvawith, do you, cherish of pious acts, preserve us; encouragers of sacrifice, drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒दासे॑ दस्रा॒ वसु॒ बिभ्र॑ता॒ रथे॒ पृक्षो॑ वहतमश्विना । र॒यिं स॑मु॒द्रादु॒त वा॑ दि॒वस्पर्य॒स्मे ध॑त्तं पुरु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: su-dā́se ǀ dasrā ǀ vásu ǀ bíbhratā ǀ ráthe ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ vahatam ǀ aśvinā ǀrayím ǀ samudrā́t ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhattam ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Good-lookingAśvins, as you brought in your car, bearers of wealth, abundance toSudās, so bring to us in the riches that many covet, whether from the firmament or the sky beyond.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्ना॑सत्या परा॒वति॒ यद्वा॒ स्थो अधि॑ तु॒र्वशे॑ । अतो॒ रथे॑न सु॒वृता॑ न॒ आ ग॑तं सा॒कं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ stháḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ turváśe ǀátaḥ ǀ ráthena ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ sākám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, whether you abide far off or close athand, come to us in your well-constructed car, with the rays of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चा॑ वां॒ सप्त॑योऽध्वर॒श्रियो॒ वह॑न्तु॒ सव॒नेदुप॑ । इषं॑ पृ॒ञ्चन्ता॑ सु॒कृते॑ सु॒दान॑व॒ आ ब॒र्हिः सी॑दतं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcā ǀ vām ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ adhvara-śríyaḥ ǀ váhantu ǀ sávanā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀíṣam ǀ pṛñcántā ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sīdatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your coursers, the grace of the sacrifice, bring you to be present at our rite; guides (of men) bestowing food upon the pious and liberal donor (of the offering), sit down on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेन॑ नास॒त्या ग॑तं॒ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । येन॒ शश्व॑दू॒हथु॑र्दा॒शुषे॒ वसु॒ मध्व॒: सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: téna ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ ráthena ǀ sū́rya-tvacā ǀyéna ǀ śáśvat ǀ ūháthuḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyas, with your sun-clad chariot, in which you have ever conveyed wealth to the donor (of the offering), to drink of the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थेभि॑र॒र्वागव॑से पुरू॒वसू॑ अ॒र्कैश्च॒ नि ह्व॑यामहे । शश्व॒त्कण्वा॑नां॒ सद॑सि प्रि॒ये हि कं॒ सोमं॑ प॒पथु॑रश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: ukthébhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ ávase ǀ puruvásū íti puru-vásū ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ ca ǀ ní ǀ hvayāmahe ǀśáśvat ǀ káṇvānām ǀ sádasi ǀ priyé ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ sómam ǀ papáthuḥ ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke with chanted and recited hymns, the very affluentAśvins, to be present for our protection. Have you not ever drunk theSomain the favoured dwelling of theKaṇvas?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ह वा॒मेन॑ न उषो॒ व्यु॑च्छा दुहितर्दिवः । स॒ह द्यु॒म्नेन॑ बृह॒ता वि॑भावरि रा॒या दे॑वि॒ दास्व॑ती
shlokas.transliteration: sahá ǀ vāména ǀ naḥ ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀsahá ǀ dyumnéna ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ rāyā́ ǀ devi ǀ dā́svatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, daughter of heaven, dawn upon us with riches; diffuser of light, dawn upon us with abundant food; bountiful goddess, dawn upon with wealth (of cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्विश्वसु॒विदो॒ भूरि॑ च्यवन्त॒ वस्त॑वे । उदी॑रय॒ प्रति॑ मा सू॒नृता॑ उष॒श्चोद॒ राधो॑ म॒घोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vatīḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ viśva-suvídaḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ cyavanta ǀ vástave ǀút ǀ īraya ǀ práti ǀ mā ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ códa ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abounding with horses, abounding with kine, bestowers of every sort of wealth, (the divinities of morning) are possessed of much that is necessary for the habitations (of men); Uṣas, speak to me kind words; send us the affluence of the wealthy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒वासो॒षा उ॒च्छाच्च॒ नु दे॒वी जी॒रा रथा॑नाम् । ये अ॑स्या आ॒चर॑णेषु दध्रि॒रे स॑मु॒द्रे न श्र॑व॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: uvā́sa ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchā́t ǀ ca ǀ nú ǀ devī́ ǀ jīrā́ ǀ ráthānām ǀyé ǀ asyāḥ ǀ ā-cáraṇeṣu ǀ dadhriré ǀ samudré ǀ ná ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine Uṣas has dwelt (in heaven of old); may she dawn today, the excitress of chariots which are harnessed at her coming, as those who are desirous of wealth (send ships) to sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॒ ये ते॒ प्र यामे॑षु यु॒ञ्जते॒ मनो॑ दा॒नाय॑ सू॒रय॑: । अत्राह॒ तत्कण्व॑ एषां॒ कण्व॑तमो॒ नाम॑ गृणाति नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ prá ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ yuñjáte ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀátra ǀ áha ǀ tát ǀ káṇvaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ káṇva-tamaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ gṛṇāti ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, at your comings wise men turn their minds to benefactions; of these men, the most wiseKaṇvaproclaims the fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ घा॒ योषे॑व सू॒नर्यु॒षा या॑ति प्रभुञ्ज॒ती । ज॒रय॑न्ती॒ वृज॑नं प॒द्वदी॑यत॒ उत्पा॑तयति प॒क्षिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gha ǀ yóṣā-iva ǀ sūnárī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ pra-bhuñjatī́ ǀjaráyantī ǀ vṛ́janam ǀ pat-vát ǀ īyate ǀ út ǀ pātayati ǀ pakṣíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, nourishing (all), comes daily like a matron, the directress (of household duties), conducting all transient (creatures) to decay; (at her coming) each biped stirs and she wakes up the birds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि या सृ॒जति॒ सम॑नं॒ व्य१॒॑र्थिन॑: प॒दं न वे॒त्योद॑ती । वयो॒ नकि॑ष्टे पप्ति॒वांस॑ आसते॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ वाजिनीवति
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yā́ ǀ sṛjáti ǀ sámanam ǀ ví ǀ arthínaḥ ǀ padám ǀ ná ǀ veti ǀ ódatī ǀváyaḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ te ǀ papti-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ āsate ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She animates the diligent, and sends clients (to their patrons); and shedder of dews, knows not delay; bestower of food, at your rising the soaring birds no longer suspend (their flight).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षायु॑क्त परा॒वत॒: सूर्य॑स्यो॒दय॑ना॒दधि॑ । श॒तं रथे॑भिः सु॒भगो॒षा इ॒यं वि या॑त्य॒भि मानु॑षान्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ ayukta ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ut-áyanāt ǀ ádhi ǀśatám ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ iyám ǀ ví ǀ yāti ǀ abhí ǀ mā́nuṣān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This auspicious Uṣas has harnessed (her vehicles) from afar, above the rising of the sun; and she comes gloriously upon man, with a hundred chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑मस्या नानाम॒ चक्ष॑से॒ जग॒ज्ज्योति॑ष्कृणोति सू॒नरी॑ । अप॒ द्वेषो॑ म॒घोनी॑ दुहि॒ता दि॒व उ॒षा उ॑च्छ॒दप॒ स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvam ǀ asyāḥ ǀ nanāma ǀ cákṣase ǀ jágat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ sūnárī ǀápa ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ maghónī ǀ duhitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchat ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All living beings adore her, that she may be visible; bringer of good, she lights up the world; the affluent daughter of heaven drives away the malevolent and disperses the absorbers (of moisture).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उष॒ आ भा॑हि भा॒नुना॑ च॒न्द्रेण॑ दुहितर्दिवः । आ॒वह॑न्ती॒ भूर्य॒स्मभ्यं॒ सौभ॑गं व्यु॒च्छन्ती॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāhi ǀ bhānúnā ǀ candréṇa ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀā-váhantī ǀ bhū́ri ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sáubhagam ǀ vi-ucchántī ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shine around, Uṣas, with cheering lustre, bringing us every day much happiness, and scattering darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य॒ हि प्राण॑नं॒ जीव॑नं॒ त्वे वि यदु॒च्छसि॑ सूनरि । सा नो॒ रथे॑न बृह॒ता वि॑भावरि श्रु॒धि चि॑त्रामघे॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ hí ǀ prā́ṇanam ǀ jī́vanam ǀ tvé íti ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ ucchási ǀ sūnari ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ráthena ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ śrudhí ǀ citra-maghe ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch, bringer of good, as you dawn, the breath and life of all (creatures) rest in you; diffuser of light, come to us with your spacious car; possessor of wondrous wealth, hear our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॒ वाजं॒ हि वंस्व॒ यश्चि॒त्रो मानु॑षे॒ जने॑ । तेना व॑ह सु॒कृतो॑ अध्व॒राँ उप॒ ये त्वा॑ गृ॒णन्ति॒ वह्न॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ hí ǀ váṃsva ǀ yáḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǀténa ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ adhvarā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, accept the (sacrificial) food which of many kinds exists among the human race, and thereby bring to the ceremony the pious, who offering oblations, praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑न्दे॒वाँ आ व॑ह॒ सोम॑पीतये॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षादुष॒स्त्वम् । सास्मासु॑ धा॒ गोम॒दश्वा॑वदु॒क्थ्य१॒॑मुषो॒ वाजं॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ tvám ǀsā́ ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhāḥ ǀ gó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ ukthyám ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, bring from the firmament all the gods, to drink theSoma, and to you yourself bestow upon us excellent and invigorating food, along with cattle and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्या॒ रुश॑न्तो अ॒र्चय॒: प्रति॑ भ॒द्रा अदृ॑क्षत । सा नो॑ र॒यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रं सु॒पेश॑समु॒षा द॑दातु॒ सुग्म्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásyāḥ ǀ rúśantaḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ práti ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ ádṛkṣata ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ su-péśasam ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ súgmyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that Uṣas whose bright auspicious rays are visible all around, grant us desirable, agreeable, and easily-attainable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये चि॒द्धि त्वामृष॑य॒: पूर्व॑ ऊ॒तये॑ जुहू॒रेऽव॑से महि । सा न॒: स्तोमाँ॑ अ॒भि गृ॑णीहि॒ राध॒सोष॑: शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ ūtáye ǀ juhūré ǀ ávase ǀ mahi ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómān ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable Uṣas, whom the ancient sages invoked for protection and for food, do you, (radiant) with pure light, (plural ased) by our offerings, accept our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॒ यद॒द्य भा॒नुना॒ वि द्वारा॑वृ॒णवो॑ दि॒वः । प्र नो॑ यच्छतादवृ॒कं पृ॒थु च्छ॒र्दिः प्र दे॑वि॒ गोम॑ती॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ bhānúnā ǀ ví ǀ dvā́rau ǀ ṛṇávaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ yacchatāt ǀ avṛkám ǀ pṛthú ǀ chardíḥ ǀ prá ǀ devi ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, since you have today set upon the two gates of heaven with light, grant us a spacious and secure habitation; bestow upon us, goddess, cattle and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं नो॑ रा॒या बृ॑ह॒ता वि॒श्वपे॑शसा मिमि॒क्ष्वा समिळा॑भि॒रा । सं द्यु॒म्नेन॑ विश्व॒तुरो॑षो महि॒ सं वाजै॑र्वाजिनीवति
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ viśvá-peśasā ǀ mimikṣvá ǀ sám ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀsám ǀ dyumnéna ǀ viśva-túrā ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ mahi ǀ sám ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable Uṣas, associate us with much and multiform wealth, and with abundant cattle, with all foe-confounding fame, and giver of sustenance, with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॑ भ॒द्रेभि॒रा ग॑हि दि॒वश्चि॑द्रोच॒नादधि॑ । वह॑न्त्वरु॒णप्स॑व॒ उप॑ त्वा सो॒मिनो॑ गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ bhadrébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀváhantu ǀ aruṇá-psavaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tvā ǀ somínaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, come by auspicious ways from above the bright (region of the) firmament; let the purple (kine) bring you to the dwelling of the offerr ofSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒पेश॑सं सु॒खं रथं॒ यम॒ध्यस्था॑ उष॒स्त्वम् । तेना॑ सु॒श्रव॑सं॒ जनं॒ प्रावा॒द्य दु॑हितर्दिवः
shlokas.transliteration: su-péśasam ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀ yám ǀ adhi-ásthāḥ ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ tvám ǀténa ǀ su-śrávasam ǀ jánam ǀ prá ǀ ava ǀ adyá ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, in the ample and beautiful chariot in which you ride, come today, daughter of heaven, to the pious offerer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वय॑श्चित्ते पत॒त्रिणो॑ द्वि॒पच्चतु॑ष्पदर्जुनि । उष॒: प्रार॑न्नृ॒तूँरनु॑ दि॒वो अन्ते॑भ्य॒स्परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: váyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ patatríṇaḥ ǀ dvi-pát ǀ cátuḥ-pat ǀ arjuni ǀúṣaḥ ǀ prá ǀ āran ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ ánu ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántebhyaḥ ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “White-complexioned Uṣas, upon your coming, bipeds and quadrupeds (are in motion), and the winged birds flock around from the boundaries of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यु॒च्छन्ती॒ हि र॒श्मिभि॒र्विश्व॑मा॒भासि॑ रोच॒नम् । तां त्वामु॑षर्वसू॒यवो॑ गी॒र्भिः कण्वा॑ अहूषत
shlokas.transliteration: vi-ucchántī ǀ hí ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā-bhā́si ǀ rocanám ǀtā́m ǀ tvā́m ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, Uṣas, dispersing the darkness, illumine the shining universe with your rays; such as you are,Kaṇvas, desirous of wealth, praise you with their hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तव॑: । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ devám ǀ vahanti ǀ ketávaḥ ǀdṛśé ǀ víśvāya ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His coursers bear on high the divine all-knowing Sun, that he may be seen by all (the worlds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ त्ये ता॒यवो॑ यथा॒ नक्ष॑त्रा यन्त्य॒क्तुभि॑: । सूरा॑य वि॒श्वच॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyé ǀ tāyávaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ nákṣatrā ǀ yanti ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀsū́rāya ǀ viśvá-cakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(At the approach) of the all-illuminating Sun, the constellations depart with the night, like thieves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदृ॑श्रमस्य के॒तवो॒ वि र॒श्मयो॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ । भ्राज॑न्तो अ॒ग्नयो॑ यथा
shlokas.transliteration: ádṛśram ǀ asya ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ ví ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ jánān ǀ ánu ǀbhrā́jantaḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His illuminating rays behold men in succession, like blazing fires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒रणि॑र्वि॒श्वद॑र्शतो ज्योति॒ष्कृद॑सि सूर्य । विश्व॒मा भा॑सि रोच॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: taráṇiḥ ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀ jyotiḥ-kṛ́t ǀ asi ǀ sūrya ǀvíśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāsi ǀ rocanám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Sūrya, outstrip all in speed; you are visible to all; you are the source of light; you shine throughout the entire firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒त्यङ्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑: प्र॒त्यङ्ङुदे॑षि॒ मानु॑षान् । प्र॒त्यङ्विश्वं॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: pratyáṅ ǀ devā́nām ǀ víśaḥ ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ út ǀ eṣi ǀ mā́nuṣān ǀpratyáṅ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You rise in the presence of theMaruts, you rise in the presence of mankind, and so as to be seen in the presence of the whole (region) of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येना॑ पावक॒ चक्ष॑सा भुर॒ण्यन्तं॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ । त्वं व॑रुण॒ पश्य॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ pāvaka ǀ cákṣasā ǀ bhuraṇyántam ǀ jánān ǀ ánu ǀtvám ǀ varuṇa ǀ páśyasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With that light with which you, the purifier and defender from evil, look upon this creature-bearing world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि द्यामे॑षि॒ रज॑स्पृ॒थ्वहा॒ मिमा॑नो अ॒क्तुभि॑: । पश्य॒ञ्जन्मा॑नि सूर्य
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ dyā́m ǀ eṣi ǀ rájaḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ áhā ǀ mímānaḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀpáśyan ǀ jánmāni ǀ sūrya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You traverse the vast ethereal space, measuring days and nights, and contemplating all that have birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त त्वा॑ ह॒रितो॒ रथे॒ वह॑न्ति देव सूर्य । शो॒चिष्के॑शं विचक्षण
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ tvā ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ váhanti ǀ deva ǀ sūrya ǀśocíḥ-keśam ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine and light-diffusingSūrya, your seven coursers bear you, bright-haired, in your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑क्त स॒प्त शु॒न्ध्युव॒: सूरो॒ रथ॑स्य न॒प्त्य॑: । ताभि॑र्याति॒ स्वयु॑क्तिभिः
shlokas.transliteration: áyukta ǀ saptá ǀ śundhyúvaḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ráthasya ǀ naptyáḥ ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ yāti ǀ sváyukti-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Sun has yoked the seven mares that safely draw his chariot, and comes with them self-harnessed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ ज्योति॒ष्पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vayám ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ út-taram ǀdevám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ áganma ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding the up-springing light above the darkness, we approach the divine Sun among the gods, the excellent light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒द्यन्न॒द्य मि॑त्रमह आ॒रोह॒न्नुत्त॑रां॒ दिव॑म् । हृ॒द्रो॒गं मम॑ सूर्य हरि॒माणं॑ च नाशय
shlokas.transliteration: ut-yán ǀ adyá ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ ā-róhan ǀ út-tarām ǀ dívam ǀhṛt-rogám ǀ máma ǀ sūrya ǀ harimā́ṇam ǀ ca ǀ nāśaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant with benevolent light, rising today and mountina into the highest heaven, do you O Sun, remove sickness of my heart, and the yellowness (of my body).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुके॑षु मे हरि॒माणं॑ रोप॒णाका॑सु दध्मसि । अथो॑ हारिद्र॒वेषु॑ मे हरि॒माणं॒ नि द॑ध्मसि
shlokas.transliteration: śúkeṣu ǀ me ǀ harimā́ṇam ǀ ropaṇā́kāsu ǀ dadhmasi ǀátho íti ǀ hāridravéṣu ǀ me ǀ harimā́ṇam ǀ ní ǀ dadhmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us transfer the yellowness (of my body) to the parrots, to the starlings, or to theharitāla(tree).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑गाद॒यमा॑दि॒त्यो विश्वे॑न॒ सह॑सा स॒ह । द्वि॒षन्तं॒ मह्यं॑ र॒न्धय॒न्मो अ॒हं द्वि॑ष॒ते र॑धम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ agāt ǀ ayám ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ víśvena ǀ sáhasā ǀ sahá ǀdviṣántam ǀ máhyam ǀ randháyan ǀ mó íti ǀ ahám ǀ dviṣaté ǀ radham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisĀdityahas risen with all (his) might, destroying my adversary, for I am unable to resist my enemy (sickness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्यं मे॒षं पु॑रुहू॒तमृ॒ग्मिय॒मिन्द्रं॑ गी॒र्भिर्म॑दता॒ वस्वो॑ अर्ण॒वम् । यस्य॒ द्यावो॒ न वि॒चर॑न्ति॒ मानु॑षा भु॒जे मंहि॑ष्ठम॒भि विप्र॑मर्चत
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ meṣám ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀ índram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ madata ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ arṇavám ǀyásya ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vi-cáranti ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ bhujé ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ abhí ǀ vípram ǀ arcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Anime with praises that ram, (Indra), who is adored by many, who is gratified by hymns, and is an ocean of wealth; whose good deeds spread abroad for the benefit of mankind, like the rays of light; worship the powerful and wise Indra, for the enjoyment of prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भीम॑वन्वन्त्स्वभि॒ष्टिमू॒तयो॑ऽन्तरिक्ष॒प्रां तवि॑षीभि॒रावृ॑तम् । इन्द्रं॒ दक्षा॑स ऋ॒भवो॑ मद॒च्युतं॑ श॒तक्र॑तुं॒ जव॑नी सू॒नृतारु॑हत्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ īm ǀ avanvan ǀ su-abhiṣṭím ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ antarikṣa-prā́m ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtam ǀíndram ǀ dákṣāsaḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ jávanī ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The protecting and fosteringṚbhushastened to the presence ofIndra, of graceful motion, and irradiating the firmament, imbued with vigour, the humiliator of his enemies, the performer of a hundred pious acts; and by them, encouraging words were uttered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं गो॒त्रमङ्गि॑रोभ्योऽवृणो॒रपो॒तात्र॑ये श॒तदु॑रेषु गातु॒वित् । स॒सेन॑ चिद्विम॒दाया॑वहो॒ वस्वा॒जावद्रि॑ग वावसा॒नस्य॑ न॒र्तय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ gotrám ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ avṛṇoḥ ǀ ápa ǀ utá ǀ átraye ǀ śatá-dureṣu ǀ gātu-vít ǀsaséna ǀ cit ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ avahaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ ājáu ǀ ádrim ǀ vavasānásya ǀ nartáyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have opened the cloud for theAṅgirasasyou have shown the way toAtri, who vexes his adversaries by a hundred doors (by a number ofyantras, means or contrivances); you have granted wealth, with food, toVimada; you are wielding your thunderbolt in defence of a worshipper engaged in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒पाम॑पि॒धाना॑वृणो॒रपाधा॑रय॒: पर्व॑ते॒ दानु॑म॒द्वसु॑ । वृ॒त्रं यदि॑न्द्र॒ शव॒साव॑धी॒रहि॒मादित्सूर्यं॑ दि॒व्यारो॑हयो दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ apā́m ǀ api-dhā́nā ǀ avṛṇoḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ádhārayaḥ ǀ párvate ǀ dā́nu-mat ǀ vásu ǀvṛtrám ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ śávasā ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀ áhim ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ sū́ryam ǀ diví ǀ ā́ ǀ arohayaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have opened the receptacle of the waters; you have detained in the mountain the treasure of the malignant; when you had slainVṛtra, the destryer, you made the sun visible in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं मा॒याभि॒रप॑ मा॒यिनो॑ऽधमः स्व॒धाभि॒र्ये अधि॒ शुप्ता॒वजु॑ह्वत । त्वं पिप्रो॑र्नृमण॒: प्रारु॑ज॒: पुर॒: प्र ऋ॒जिश्वा॑नं दस्यु॒हत्ये॑ष्वाविथ
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ ápa ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ adhamaḥ ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ ádhi ǀ śúptau ǀ ájuhvata ǀtvám ǀ píproḥ ǀ nṛ-manaḥ ǀ prá ǀ arujaḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ prá ǀ ṛjíśvānam ǀ dasyu-hátyeṣu ǀ āvitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, by the devices, have humbled the deceivers who presented oblations to their own mouths; propitious to men, you have destroyed the cities of Pipru, and have well defended Ṛjiśvan in robber-destroying (contest).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं कुत्सं॑ शुष्ण॒हत्ये॑ष्वावि॒थार॑न्धयोऽतिथि॒ग्वाय॒ शम्ब॑रम् । म॒हान्तं॑ चिदर्बु॒दं नि क्र॑मीः प॒दा स॒नादे॒व द॑स्यु॒हत्या॑य जज्ञिषे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ kútsam ǀ śuṣṇa-hátyeṣu ǀ āvitha ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ atithi-gvā́ya ǀ śámbaram ǀmahā́ntam ǀ cit ǀ arbudám ǀ ní ǀ kramīḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ sanā́t ǀ evá ǀ dasyu-hátyāya ǀ jajñiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have defendedKutsain fatal fights with Śuśna; you have destroyedŚambarain defence ofAtithigva; you have trodden with your foot upon the greatArbuda; frm remote times were you born for the destruction of oppressors.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे विश्वा॒ तवि॑षी स॒ध्र्य॑ग्घि॒ता तव॒ राध॑: सोमपी॒थाय॑ हर्षते । तव॒ वज्र॑श्चिकिते बा॒ह्वोर्हि॒तो वृ॒श्चा शत्रो॒रव॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ वृष्ण्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ víśvā ǀ táviṣī ǀ sadhryák ǀ hitā́ ǀ táva ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ soma-pīthā́ya ǀ harṣate ǀtáva ǀ vájraḥ ǀ cikite ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ vṛścá ǀ śátroḥ ǀ áva ǀ víśvāni ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In you,Indra, is all vigour fully concentrated; you will delight to drink theSoma; it is known by us that the thunderbolt is deposited in yourhands; cut off all prowess from the foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि जा॑नी॒ह्यार्या॒न्ये च॒ दस्य॑वो ब॒र्हिष्म॑ते रन्धया॒ शास॑दव्र॒तान् । शाकी॑ भव॒ यज॑मानस्य चोदि॒ता विश्वेत्ता ते॑ सध॒मादे॑षु चाकन
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ jānīhi ǀ ā́ryān ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ dásyavaḥ ǀ barhíṣmate ǀ randhaya ǀ śā́sat ǀ avratā́n ǀśā́kī ǀ bhava ǀ yájamānasya ǀ coditā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ sadha-mā́deṣu ǀ cākana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Discriminate between theĀryasand they who areDasyus; restraining those who perform no religious rites, compel them to submit to the performer of sacrifices; be you, who are powerful, the encourager of the sacrificer; I am desirous of celebrating all your deeds in ceremonies that give you satisfaction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑व्रताय र॒न्धय॒न्नप॑व्रताना॒भूभि॒रिन्द्र॑: श्न॒थय॒न्नना॑भुवः । वृ॒द्धस्य॑ चि॒द्वर्ध॑तो॒ द्यामिन॑क्षत॒: स्तवा॑नो व॒म्रो वि ज॑घान सं॒दिह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ánu-vratāya ǀ randháyan ǀ ápa-vratān ǀ ā-bhū́bhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ śnatháyan ǀ ánābhuvaḥ ǀvṛddhásya ǀ cit ǀ várdhataḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ínakṣataḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ vamráḥ ǀ ví ǀ jaghāna ǀ sam-díhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraabides, humbling the neglecters of holy acts in favour of those who observe them; and punishing those who turn away from his worship in favour of those who are present (with their praise); Vamra, while praising him, whether old or adolescent, and spreading through heaven, carried off the accusative ulated (materials of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तक्ष॒द्यत्त॑ उ॒शना॒ सह॑सा॒ सहो॒ वि रोद॑सी म॒ज्मना॑ बाधते॒ शव॑: । आ त्वा॒ वात॑स्य नृमणो मनो॒युज॒ आ पूर्य॑माणमवहन्न॒भि श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tákṣat ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ uśánā ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ródasī íti ǀ majmánā ǀ bādhate ǀ śávaḥ ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vā́tasya ǀ nṛ-manaḥ ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pū́ryamāṇam ǀ avahan ǀ abhí ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If Uṣanās should sharpen your vigour by his own, then would your might terrify by its intensity both heaven and earth. Friend of man, let the will harnessed steeds, with the velocity of the wind, convey you, replete (with vigour), to (partake of the sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्दि॑ष्ट॒ यदु॒शने॑ का॒व्ये सचाँ॒ इन्द्रो॑ व॒ङ्कू व॑ङ्कु॒तराधि॑ तिष्ठति । उ॒ग्रो य॒यिं निर॒पः स्रोत॑सासृज॒द्वि शुष्ण॑स्य दृंहि॒ता ऐ॑रय॒त्पुर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mándiṣṭa ǀ yát ǀ uśáne ǀ kāvyé ǀ sácā ǀ índraḥ ǀ vaṅkū́ íti ǀ vaṅku-tárā́ ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀugráḥ ǀ yayím ǀ níḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ srótasā ǀ asṛjat ǀ ví ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ dṛṃhitā́ḥ ǀ airayat ǀ púraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndrais delighted with acceptable hymns, he ascends (his car), drawn by more and more obliquely-curving coursers; fierce, he extracts the waters from the passing (cloud) in a torrent, and has overwhelmed the extensive cities ofŚuṣṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स्मा॒ रथं॑ वृष॒पाणे॑षु तिष्ठसि शार्या॒तस्य॒ प्रभृ॑ता॒ येषु॒ मन्द॑से । इन्द्र॒ यथा॑ सु॒तसो॑मेषु चा॒कनो॑ऽन॒र्वाणं॒ श्लोक॒मा रो॑हसे दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sma ǀ rátham ǀ vṛṣa-pā́neṣu ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǀ śāryātásya ǀ prá-bhṛtāḥ ǀ yéṣu ǀ mándase ǀíndra ǀ yáthā ǀ sutá-someṣu ǀ cākánaḥ ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ ślókam ǀ ā́ ǀ rohase ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You mount your chariot willingly,Indra, for the sake of drinking the libations; such as you delight in having been prepared (at the sacrifice of)Śāryāta; be plural ased with them, as you are gratified by the effusedSoma(at the sacrifices) of others, so do you obtain imperishable fame in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑दा॒ अर्भां॑ मह॒ते व॑च॒स्यवे॑ क॒क्षीव॑ते वृच॒यामि॑न्द्र सुन्व॒ते । मेना॑भवो वृषण॒श्वस्य॑ सुक्रतो॒ विश्वेत्ता ते॒ सव॑नेषु प्र॒वाच्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádadāḥ ǀ árbhām ǀ mahaté ǀ vacasyáve ǀ kakṣī́vate ǀ vṛcayā́m ǀ indra ǀ sunvaté ǀménā ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaśvásya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ pra-vā́cyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have given,Indra, the youthful Vṛcaya to the agedKakṣīvat, praising you and offering oblations; you,Śatakratu, wereMenā, the daughter ofVṛṣaṇaśva; all these your deeds are to be recited at your worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ अश्रायि सु॒ध्यो॑ निरे॒के प॒ज्रेषु॒ स्तोमो॒ दुर्यो॒ न यूप॑: । अ॒श्व॒युर्ग॒व्यू र॑थ॒युर्व॑सू॒युरिन्द्र॒ इद्रा॒यः क्ष॑यति प्रय॒न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ aśrāyi ǀ su-dhyáḥ ǀ nireké ǀ pajréṣu ǀ stómaḥ ǀ dúryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yū́paḥ ǀaśva-yúḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ ratha-yúḥ ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ kṣayati ǀ pra-yantā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas been had recourse to, that he may assist the pious in their distress. Praise by the Pajras, is (as stable) as thepostof a doorway. Indra, the giver of riches, who is possessed of (who desires to possess, expecting as gifts from the instrumental tutor of the ceremony) horses, cattle, chariots and wealth is present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं नमो॑ वृष॒भाय॑ स्व॒राजे॑ स॒त्यशु॑ष्माय त॒वसे॑ऽवाचि । अ॒स्मिन्नि॑न्द्र वृ॒जने॒ सर्व॑वीरा॒: स्मत्सू॒रिभि॒स्तव॒ शर्म॑न्त्स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ námaḥ ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ sva-rā́je ǀ satyá-śuṣmāya ǀ taváse ǀ avāci ǀasmín ǀ indra ǀ vṛjáne ǀ sárva-vīrāḥ ǀ smát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ śárman ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This adoration is offered to the shedder of rain, the self-resplendent, the possessor of true vigour, the mighty; may we be aided,Indra, in his conflict, by many heroes, and abide in a prosperoud (habitation, bestowed) by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं सु मे॒षं म॑हया स्व॒र्विदं॑ श॒तं यस्य॑ सु॒भ्व॑: सा॒कमीर॑ते । अत्यं॒ न वाजं॑ हवन॒स्यदं॒ रथ॒मेन्द्रं॑ ववृत्या॒मव॑से सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ sú ǀ meṣám ǀ mahaya ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀ śatám ǀ yásya ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ sākám ǀ ī́rate ǀátyam ǀ ná ǀ vā́jam ǀ havana-syádam ǀ rátham ǀ ā́ ǀ índram ǀ vavṛtyām ǀ ávase ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship well that ram who makes heaven known, whom a hundred worshippers at once are assiduous in praising. I imploreIndrawith many prayers to ascend the car, which hastens like a fleet courser to the sacrificer for my protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पर्व॑तो॒ न ध॒रुणे॒ष्वच्यु॑तः स॒हस्र॑मूति॒स्तवि॑षीषु वावृधे । इन्द्रो॒ यद्वृ॒त्रमव॑धीन्नदी॒वृत॑मु॒ब्जन्नर्णां॑सि॒ जर्हृ॑षाणो॒ अन्ध॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ párvataḥ ǀ ná ǀ dharúṇeṣu ǀ ácyutaḥ ǀ sahásram-ūtiḥ ǀ táviṣīṣu ǀ vavṛdhe ǀíndraḥ ǀ yát ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ávadhīt ǀ nadī-vṛ́tam ǀ ubján ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ járhṛṣāṇaḥ ǀ ándhasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndra, who delights in the sacrificial food, had slain the stream-obstructingVṛtra, and was pouring down the waters, he stood firm amid the torrents like a mountain, and endowed with a thousand means of protecting (his votaries) increased in vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि द्व॒रो द्व॒रिषु॑ व॒व्र ऊध॑नि च॒न्द्रबु॑ध्नो॒ मद॑वृद्धो मनी॒षिभि॑: । इन्द्रं॒ तम॑ह्वे स्वप॒स्यया॑ धि॒या मंहि॑ष्ठरातिं॒ स हि पप्रि॒रन्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ dvaráḥ ǀ dvaríṣu ǀ vavráḥ ǀ ū́dhani ǀ candrá-budhnaḥ ǀ máda-vṛddhaḥ ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǀíndram ǀ tám ǀ ahve ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ máṃhiṣṭha-rātim ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ pápriḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is victorious over his enemies, who is spread through the dewy (firmament), the root of happiness, who is exhilarated by theSomahim I invoke, the most bountifulIndra, along with learned priests, with a mind disposed to pious adoration, for he is the bestower of abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यं पृ॒णन्ति॑ दि॒वि सद्म॑बर्हिषः समु॒द्रं न सु॒भ्व१॒॑: स्वा अ॒भिष्ट॑यः । तं वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॒ अनु॑ तस्थुरू॒तय॒: शुष्मा॒ इन्द्र॑मवा॒ता अह्रु॑तप्सवः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yám ǀ pṛṇánti ǀ diví ǀ sádma-barhiṣaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ná ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ svā́ḥ ǀ abhíṣṭayaḥ ǀtám ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ ánu ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ śúṣmāḥ ǀ índram ǀ avātā́ḥ ǀ áhruta-psavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThaIndrawhom in heaven the libations sprinkled on the sacred grass replenish, as the kindred rivers hastening to it fill the ocean; that Indra whom theMaruts, the driers up of moisture, who are unobstructed, and of undistorted forms, attended as auxiliaries at the death ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि स्ववृ॑ष्टिं॒ मदे॑ अस्य॒ युध्य॑तो र॒घ्वीरि॑व प्रव॒णे स॑स्रुरू॒तय॑: । इन्द्रो॒ यद्व॒ज्री धृ॒षमा॑णो॒ अन्ध॑सा भि॒नद्व॒लस्य॑ परि॒धीँरि॑व त्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ svá-vṛṣṭim ǀ máde ǀ asya ǀ yúdhyataḥ ǀ raghvī́ḥ-iva ǀ pravaṇé ǀ sasruḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ yát ǀ vajrī́ ǀ dhṛṣámāṇaḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀ bhinát ǀ valásya ǀ paridhī́n-iva ǀ tritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His allies, exhilarated (by libations), preceded him, warring against the withholder of the rain, as rivers rush down declivities.Indra, animated by the sacrificial food, broke through the defences ofValaas didTritathrough the coverings (of the well).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परीं॑ घृ॒णा च॑रति तित्वि॒षे शवो॒ऽपो वृ॒त्वी रज॑सो बु॒ध्नमाश॑यत् । वृ॒त्रस्य॒ यत्प्र॑व॒णे दु॒र्गृभि॑श्वनो निज॒घन्थ॒ हन्वो॑रिन्द्र तन्य॒तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ īm ǀ ghṛṇā́ ǀ carati ǀ titviṣé ǀ śávaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vṛtvī́ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ budhnám ǀ ā́ ǀ aśayat ǀvṛtrásya ǀ yát ǀ pravaṇé ǀ duḥ-gṛ́bhiśvanaḥ ǀ ni-jaghántha ǀ hánvoḥ ǀ indra ǀ tanyatúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, you had smitten with my thunderbolt the check of the wide-extendedVṛtra, who, having obstructed the waters reposed in the region above the firmament, your fame spread afar, your prowess was renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह्र॒दं न हि त्वा॑ न्यृ॒षन्त्यू॒र्मयो॒ ब्रह्मा॑णीन्द्र॒ तव॒ यानि॒ वर्ध॑ना । त्वष्टा॑ चित्ते॒ युज्यं॑ वावृधे॒ शव॑स्त॒तक्ष॒ वज्र॑म॒भिभू॑त्योजसम्
shlokas.transliteration: hradám ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ ni-ṛṣánti ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ indra ǀ táva ǀ yā́ni ǀ várdhanā ǀtváṣṭā ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ yújyam ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ śávaḥ ǀ tatákṣa ǀ vájram ǀ abhíbhūti-ojasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hymns,Indra, that glorify you, attain unto you, as rivulets (flow into) a lake.Tvaṣṭāhas augmented your appropriate vigour; he has sharpened your bolt with overpowering might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒घ॒न्वाँ उ॒ हरि॑भिः सम्भृतक्रत॒विन्द्र॑ वृ॒त्रं मनु॑षे गातु॒यन्न॒पः । अय॑च्छथा बा॒ह्वोर्वज्र॑माय॒समधा॑रयो दि॒व्या सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: jaghanvā́n ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ saṃbhṛtakrato íti saṃbhṛta-krato ǀ índra ǀ vṛtrám ǀ mánuṣe ǀ gātu-yán ǀ apáḥ ǀáyacchathāḥ ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ vájram ǀ āyasám ǀ ádhārayaḥ ǀ diví ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, performer of holy acts, desirous of going to man, you with your steeds have slainVṛtra(have set free) the waters, have taken in yourhandsyour thunderbolt of metal, and have made the sun visible in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हत्स्वश्च॑न्द्र॒मम॑व॒द्यदु॒क्थ्य१॒॑मकृ॑ण्वत भि॒यसा॒ रोह॑णं दि॒वः । यन्मानु॑षप्रधना॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तय॒: स्व॑र्नृ॒षाचो॑ म॒रुतोऽम॑द॒न्ननु॑
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ svá-candram ǀ áma-vat ǀ yát ǀ ukthyám ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀ bhiyásā ǀ róhaṇam ǀ diváḥ ǀyát ǀ mā́nuṣa-pradhanāḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ nṛ-sā́caḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ámadan ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through fear (ofVṛtra, they, the worshippers), recited the suitable hymn of theBṛhat(Sāma), self-illuminating, strength-bestowing, and ascending to heaven; on which his allies, (theMaruts), combating for men, (guardians) of heaven, and vivifiers of mankind animatedIndra(to destroy him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यौश्चि॑द॒स्याम॑वाँ॒ अहे॑: स्व॒नादयो॑यवीद्भि॒यसा॒ वज्र॑ इन्द्र ते । वृ॒त्रस्य॒ यद्ब॑द्बधा॒नस्य॑ रोदसी॒ मदे॑ सु॒तस्य॒ शव॒साभि॑न॒च्छिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ áma-vān ǀ áheḥ ǀ svanā́t ǀ áyoyavīt ǀ bhiyásā ǀ vájraḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀvṛtrásya ǀ yát ǀ badbadhānásya ǀ rodasī íti ǀ máde ǀ sutásya ǀ śávasā ǀ ábhinat ǀ śíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The strong heaven was rent asunder with fear at the clamour of that Ahi, when you,Indra, was inspired by (drinking) the effused (Soma), and your thunderbolt in its vigour struck off the head ofVṛtra, the obstructor of heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदिन्न्वि॑न्द्र पृथि॒वी दश॑भुजि॒रहा॑नि॒ विश्वा॑ त॒तन॑न्त कृ॒ष्टय॑: । अत्राह॑ ते मघव॒न्विश्रु॑तं॒ सहो॒ द्यामनु॒ शव॑सा ब॒र्हणा॑ भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ dáśa-bhujiḥ ǀ áhāni ǀ víśvā ǀ tatánanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀátra ǀ áha ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ ví-śrutam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ánu ǀ śávasā ǀ barháṇā ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,Indra, the earth were of tenfold (its extent), and men multiplied every day, yet,Maghavan, your prowess would be equally renowned; the exploits achieved by your might would be spread abroad with the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒स्य पा॒रे रज॑सो॒ व्यो॑मन॒: स्वभू॑त्योजा॒ अव॑से धृषन्मनः । च॒कृ॒षे भूमिं॑ प्रति॒मान॒मोज॑सो॒ऽपः स्व॑: परि॒भूरे॒ष्या दिव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ asyá ǀ pāré ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ ví-omanaḥ ǀ svábhūti-ojāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ dhṛṣat-manaḥ ǀcakṛṣé ǀ bhū́mim ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ ójasaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ eṣi ǀ ā́ ǀ dívam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Firm-mindedIndra, abiding (secure) in your strength beyond the limit of the wide-expanded firmament, you have framed the earth for our preservation; you have been the type of vigour; you have encompassed the firmament and the sky as far as to the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं भु॑वः प्रति॒मानं॑ पृथि॒व्या ऋ॒ष्ववी॑रस्य बृह॒तः पति॑र्भूः । विश्व॒माप्रा॑ अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं महि॒त्वा स॒त्यम॒द्धा नकि॑र॒न्यस्त्वावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ bhuvaḥ ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ṛṣvá-vīrasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀvíśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ satyám ǀ addhā́ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ tvā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the type of the extended earth you are the lord of the vast god-frequent (svarga) verily with your bulk you fillest all the firmament of a truth, there is none other such as you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यस्य॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अनु॒ व्यचो॒ न सिन्ध॑वो॒ रज॑सो॒ अन्त॑मान॒शुः । नोत स्ववृ॑ष्टिं॒ मदे॑ अस्य॒ युध्य॑त॒ एको॑ अ॒न्यच्च॑कृषे॒ विश्व॑मानु॒षक्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ánu ǀ vyácaḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ ántam ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀná ǀ utá ǀ svá-vṛṣṭim ǀ máde ǀ asya ǀ yúdhyataḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ anyát ǀ cakṛṣe ǀ víśvam ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “you,Indra, of whom heaven and earth have not attained the amplitude; of whom the waters of heaven have not reached the limit; of whom, when warring with excited animation against the withholder of the rains, (his adversaries have not equalled the prowess); you alone have made everything else, (than yourself), dependent (upon you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आर्च॒न्नत्र॑ म॒रुत॒: सस्मि॑न्ना॒जौ विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अमद॒न्ननु॑ त्वा । वृ॒त्रस्य॒ यद्भृ॑ष्टि॒मता॑ व॒धेन॒ नि त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ प्रत्या॒नं ज॒घन्थ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́rcan ǀ átra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sásmin ǀ ājáu ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amadan ǀ ánu ǀ tvā ǀvṛtrásya ǀ yát ǀ bhṛṣṭi-mátā ǀ vadhéna ǀ ní ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ práti ǀ ānám ǀ jaghántha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsworshipped you in this (encounter); all the gods in this engagement imitated you in exultation, when you had struck the face ofVṛtrawith your angular and fatal (bolt).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्यू॒३॒॑ षु वाचं॒ प्र म॒हे भ॑रामहे॒ गिर॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ सद॑ने वि॒वस्व॑तः । नू चि॒द्धि रत्नं॑ सस॒तामि॒वावि॑द॒न्न दु॑:ष्टु॒तिर्द्र॑विणो॒देषु॑ शस्यते
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vā́cam ǀ prá ǀ mahé ǀ bharāmahe ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sádane ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀnú ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ rátnam ǀ sasatā́m-iva ǀ ávidat ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-stutíḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-déṣu ǀ śasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We ever offer fitting praise to the mightyIndra, in the dwelling of the worshpper, by which he (the deity) has quickly acquired riches, as (a thief) hastily hastily carried (off the property) of the sleeping. Praise ill expressed is not valued among the munificent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒रो अश्व॑स्य दु॒र इ॑न्द्र॒ गोर॑सि दु॒रो यव॑स्य॒ वसु॑न इ॒नस्पति॑: । शि॒क्षा॒न॒रः प्र॒दिवो॒ अका॑मकर्शन॒: सखा॒ सखि॑भ्य॒स्तमि॒दं गृ॑णीमसि
shlokas.transliteration: duráḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ duráḥ ǀ indra ǀ góḥ ǀ asi ǀ duráḥ ǀ yávasya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀśikṣā-naráḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ákāma-karśanaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ tám ǀ idám ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are the giver of horses, of cattle, or barley, the master and protector of wealth, the foremost in liberality, (the being) of many days; you disappoint not desires (addressed to you); you are a friend to our friend; such an Indra we praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शची॑व इन्द्र पुरुकृद्द्युमत्तम॒ तवेदि॒दम॒भित॑श्चेकिते॒ वसु॑ । अत॑: सं॒गृभ्या॑भिभूत॒ आ भ॑र॒ मा त्वा॑य॒तो ज॑रि॒तुः काम॑मूनयीः
shlokas.transliteration: śácī-vaḥ ǀ indra ǀ puru-kṛt ǀ dyumat-tama ǀ táva ǀ ít ǀ idám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ cekite ǀ vásu ǀátaḥ ǀ sam-gṛ́bhya ǀ abhi-bhūte ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā-yatáḥ ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ūnayīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise and resplendentIndra, the achiever of great deeds, the riches that are spread around are known to be yours; having collected them, victor (over your enemies), bring them to us; disappoint not the expectation of the worshipper who trusts in you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्द्युभि॑: सु॒मना॑ ए॒भिरिन्दु॑भिर्निरुन्धा॒नो अम॑तिं॒ गोभि॑र॒श्विना॑ । इन्द्रे॑ण॒ दस्युं॑ द॒रय॑न्त॒ इन्दु॑भिर्यु॒तद्वे॑षस॒: समि॒षा र॑भेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǀ ni-rundhānáḥ ǀ ámatim ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀíndreṇa ǀ dásyum ǀ daráyantaḥ ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǀ yutá-dveṣasaḥ ǀ sám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ rabhemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiated by these offerings, be these libations, dispel poverty with cattle and horses; may we subduing our adversary, and relived from enemies byIndra, (plural ased) by our libations, enjoy together abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑न्द्र रा॒या समि॒षा र॑भेमहि॒ सं वाजे॑भिः पुरुश्च॒न्द्रैर॒भिद्यु॑भिः । सं दे॒व्या प्रम॑त्या वी॒रशु॑ष्मया॒ गोअ॑ग्र॒याश्वा॑वत्या रभेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ indra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ rabhemahi ǀ sám ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ puru-candráiḥ ǀ abhídyu-bhiḥ ǀsám ǀ devyā́ ǀ prá-matyā ǀ vīrá-śuṣmayā ǀ gó-agrayā ǀ áśva-vatyā ǀ rabhemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, may we become possessed of riches, and of food; and with energies agreeable to many, and shining around, may we prosper through your divine favour, the source of prowess, of cattle and of horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते त्वा॒ मदा॑ अमद॒न्तानि॒ वृष्ण्या॒ ते सोमा॑सो वृत्र॒हत्ये॑षु सत्पते । यत्का॒रवे॒ दश॑ वृ॒त्राण्य॑प्र॒ति ब॒र्हिष्म॑ते॒ नि स॒हस्रा॑णि ब॒र्हय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ tvā ǀ mádāḥ ǀ amadan ǀ tā́ni ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ té ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ sat-pate ǀyát ǀ kāráve ǀ dáśa ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀ barhíṣmate ǀ ní ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ barháyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who were your allies, (theMaruts), brought you joy; protector of the pious, those libations and oblations (that were offered you on slayingVṛtra), yielded you delight, when you, unimpeded by foes, did destroy the ten thousand obstacles oposed to him who praised you and offered you oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒धा युध॒मुप॒ घेदे॑षि धृष्णु॒या पु॒रा पुरं॒ समि॒दं हं॒स्योज॑सा । नम्या॒ यदि॑न्द्र॒ सख्या॑ परा॒वति॑ निब॒र्हयो॒ नमु॑चिं॒ नाम॑ मा॒यिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yudhā́ ǀ yúdham ǀ úpa ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ eṣi ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ purā́ ǀ púram ǀ sám ǀ idám ǀ haṃsi ǀ ójasā ǀnámyā ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ sákhyā ǀ parā-váti ǀ ni-barháyaḥ ǀ námucim ǀ nā́ma ǀ māyínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Humiliator (of adversaries), you go from battle to battle, and destroy by your might city after city; with you foe-prostrating associate, (the thunderbolt), youIndra, did slay afar off the deceiver namedNamuci.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं कर॑ञ्जमु॒त प॒र्णयं॑ वधी॒स्तेजि॑ष्ठयातिथि॒ग्वस्य॑ वर्त॒नी । त्वं श॒ता वङ्गृ॑दस्याभिन॒त्पुरो॑ऽनानु॒दः परि॑षूता ऋ॒जिश्व॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ kárañjam ǀ utá ǀ parṇáyam ǀ vadhīḥ ǀ téjiṣṭhayā ǀ atithi-gvásya ǀ vartanī́ ǀtvám ǀ śatā́ ǀ váṅgṛdasya ǀ abhinat ǀ púraḥ ǀ ananu-dáḥ ǀ pári-sūtāḥ ǀ ṛjíśvanā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slainKarañjaandParṇayawith your bright gleaming spear, in the cause ofAtithigva; unaided, you did demolish the hundred cities of Vaṅgrida, when besieged by Ṛjiṣvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमे॒ताञ्ज॑न॒राज्ञो॒ द्विर्दशा॑ब॒न्धुना॑ सु॒श्रव॑सोपज॒ग्मुष॑: । ष॒ष्टिं स॒हस्रा॑ नव॒तिं नव॑ श्रु॒तो नि च॒क्रेण॒ रथ्या॑ दु॒ष्पदा॑वृणक्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ etā́n ǀ jana-rā́jñaḥ ǀ dvíḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ abandhúnā ǀ su-śrávasā ǀ upa-jagmúṣaḥ ǀṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ navatím ǀ náva ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ ní ǀ cakréṇa ǀ ráthyā ǀ duḥ-pádā ǀ avṛṇak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, renownedIndra, overthrown by your not-to-be- overtaken chariot-wheel, the twenty kings of men, who had come againstSuśravasunaided, and their sixty thousand and ninety-nine followers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमा॑विथ सु॒श्रव॑सं॒ तवो॒तिभि॒स्तव॒ त्राम॑भिरिन्द्र॒ तूर्व॑याणम् । त्वम॑स्मै॒ कुत्स॑मतिथि॒ग्वमा॒युं म॒हे राज्ञे॒ यूने॑ अरन्धनायः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ āvitha ǀ su-śrávasam ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ trā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ túrvayāṇam ǀtvám ǀ asmai ǀ kútsam ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ āyúm ǀ mahé ǀ rā́jñe ǀ yū́ne ǀ arandhanāyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, have preservedSuśravasby your succour, Turvayāṇa by your assistance; you have madeKutsa,Atithigva, and Ātu subject to the mighty though youthful Suśravas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒दृची॑न्द्र दे॒वगो॑पा॒: सखा॑यस्ते शि॒वत॑मा॒ असा॑म । त्वां स्तो॑षाम॒ त्वया॑ सु॒वीरा॒ द्राघी॑य॒ आयु॑: प्रत॒रं दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ut-ṛ́ci ǀ indra ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ te ǀ śivá-tamāḥ ǀ ásāma ǀtvā́m ǀ stoṣāma ǀ tváyā ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀ drā́ghīyaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protected by the gods, we remain,Indra, at the close of the sacrifice, your most fortunate friends; we praise you, as enjoying through you excellent offspring, and a long and prosperous life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अ॒स्मिन्म॑घवन्पृ॒त्स्वंह॑सि न॒हि ते॒ अन्त॒: शव॑सः परी॒णशे॑ । अक्र॑न्दयो न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ रोरु॑व॒द्वना॑ क॒था न क्षो॒णीर्भि॒यसा॒ समा॑रत
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ magha-van ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ áṃhasi ǀ nahí ǀ te ǀ ántaḥ ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ pari-náśe ǀákrandayaḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ róruvat ǀ vánā ǀ kathā́ ǀ ná ǀ kṣoṇī́ḥ ǀ bhiyásā ǀ sám ǀ ārata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Urge us not,Maghavan, to this iniquity, to these iniquitous conflicts, for the limit of your strength is not to be surpassed; you have made the waters of the rivers roar; how (is it possible) that the earth should be filled with terror?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्चा॑ श॒क्राय॑ शा॒किने॒ शची॑वते शृ॒ण्वन्त॒मिन्द्रं॑ म॒हय॑न्न॒भि ष्टु॑हि । यो धृ॒ष्णुना॒ शव॑सा॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे वृषा॑ वृष॒त्वा वृ॑ष॒भो न्यृ॒ञ्जते॑
shlokas.transliteration: árca ǀ śakrā́ya ǀ śākíne ǀ śácī-vate ǀ śṛṇvántam ǀ índram ǀ maháyan ǀ abhí ǀ stuhi ǀyáḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇúnā ǀ śávasā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛṣa-tvā́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ni-ṛñjáte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer adoration to the wise and powerfulŚakra; glorifying the listeningIndra, praise him who purifies both heaven and earth by his irresistible might, who is the sender of showers, and by his bounty gratifies our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्चा॑ दि॒वे बृ॑ह॒ते शू॒ष्यं१॒॑ वच॒: स्वक्ष॑त्रं॒ यस्य॑ धृष॒तो धृ॒षन्मन॑: । बृ॒हच्छ्र॑वा॒ असु॑रो ब॒र्हणा॑ कृ॒तः पु॒रो हरि॑भ्यां वृष॒भो रथो॒ हि षः
shlokas.transliteration: árca ǀ divé ǀ bṛhaté ǀ śūṣyám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ svá-kṣatram ǀ yásya ǀ dhṛṣatáḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ mánaḥ ǀbṛhát-śravāḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ barháṇā ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer exhilarating praises to the great and illustriousIndra, of whom, undaunted, the steady mind is concentrated in its own firmness; for he, who is of great renown, the giver of rain, the repeller of enemies, who is obeyed his steeds, the showerer (of bounties), is hastening hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तः सानु॑ कोप॒योऽव॒ त्मना॑ धृष॒ता शम्ब॑रं भिनत् । यन्मा॒यिनो॑ व्र॒न्दिनो॑ म॒न्दिना॑ धृ॒षच्छि॒तां गभ॑स्तिम॒शनिं॑ पृत॒न्यसि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sā́nu ǀ kopayaḥ ǀ áva ǀ tmánā ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ śámbaram ǀ bhinat ǀyát ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ vrandínaḥ ǀ mandínā ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ śitā́m ǀ gábhastim ǀ aśánim ǀ pṛtanyási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have shaken the summit of the spacious heaven; you have slainŚambaraby your resolute self; you have hurled with exulting and determined mind the sharp and bright-rayed thunderbolt against assembledAsuras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि यद्वृ॒णक्षि॑ श्वस॒नस्य॑ मू॒र्धनि॒ शुष्ण॑स्य चिद्व्र॒न्दिनो॒ रोरु॑व॒द्वना॑ । प्रा॒चीने॑न॒ मन॑सा ब॒र्हणा॑वता॒ यद॒द्या चि॑त्कृ॒णव॒: कस्त्वा॒ परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ yát ǀ vṛṇákṣi ǀ śvasanásya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ cit ǀ vrandínaḥ ǀ róruvat ǀ vánā ǀprācī́nena ǀ mánasā ǀ barháṇā-vatā ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ cit ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ tvā ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since you, loud-shouting, have poured the rain upon the brow of the breathing (wind), and (on the head) of the maturing and absorbing (sun), who shall prevent you from doing today (as you will), endowed with an unaltered and resolute mind?”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमा॑विथ॒ नर्यं॑ तु॒र्वशं॒ यदुं॒ त्वं तु॒र्वीतिं॑ व॒य्यं॑ शतक्रतो । त्वं रथ॒मेत॑शं॒ कृत्व्ये॒ धने॒ त्वं पुरो॑ नव॒तिं द॑म्भयो॒ नव॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ āvitha ǀ náryam ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀ tvám ǀ turvī́tim ǀ vayyám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvám ǀ rátham ǀ étaśam ǀ kṛ́tvye ǀ dháne ǀ tvám ǀ púraḥ ǀ navatím ǀ dambhayaḥ ǀ náva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have protectedNarya,Turvaśa,YaduandTurvīti, of the face ofVayya; you have protected their chariots and horses in the unavoidable engagement; you have demolished ninety-nine cities (ofŚambara).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॒ राजा॒ सत्प॑तिः शूशुव॒ज्जनो॑ रा॒तह॑व्य॒: प्रति॒ यः शास॒मिन्व॑ति । उ॒क्था वा॒ यो अ॑भिगृ॒णाति॒ राध॑सा॒ दानु॑रस्मा॒ उप॑रा पिन्वते दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ rā́jā ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ śūśuvat ǀ jánaḥ ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ práti ǀ yáḥ ǀ śā́sam ǀ ínvati ǀukthā́ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ abhi-gṛṇā́ti ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ dā́nuḥ ǀ asmai ǀ úparā ǀ pinvate ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That eminent person n, the cherisher of the pious, (he instrumental tutor of the ceremony), promotes his own prosperity, who, while offering oblations toIndra, pronounces his praise; or who, along with the offerings he presents, recites hymns (in honour of him); for him the bounteous Indra causes the clouds to rain from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑मं क्ष॒त्रमस॑मा मनी॒षा प्र सो॑म॒पा अप॑सा सन्तु॒ नेमे॑ । ये त॑ इन्द्र द॒दुषो॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ति॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं स्थवि॑रं॒ वृष्ण्यं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ásamam ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ásamā ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ prá ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ ápasā ǀ santu ǀ néme ǀyé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ dadúṣaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ máhi ǀ kṣatrám ǀ stháviram ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unequalled is his might; unequalled is his wisdom; may these drinkers of theSomabecome equal to him the pious act, for they,Indra, who present to you oblations, augment your vast strength and your manly vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्येदे॒ते ब॑हु॒ला अद्रि॑दुग्धाश्चमू॒षद॑श्चम॒सा इ॑न्द्र॒पाना॑: । व्य॑श्नुहि त॒र्पया॒ काम॑मेषा॒मथा॒ मनो॑ वसु॒देया॑य कृष्व
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ít ǀ eté ǀ bahulā́ḥ ǀ ádri-dugdhāḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǀ camasā́ḥ ǀ indra-pā́nāḥ ǀví ǀ aśnuhi ǀ tarpáya ǀ kā́mam ǀ eṣām ǀ átha ǀ mánaḥ ǀ vasu-déyāya ǀ kṛṣva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These copiousSomajuices, expressed with stones and contained in ladles, are prepared for you; they are the beverage ofIndra; quaff them; satiate your appetite with them; and then fix your mind on the wealth that is to be given (to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पाम॑तिष्ठद्ध॒रुण॑ह्वरं॒ तमो॒ऽन्तर्वृ॒त्रस्य॑ ज॒ठरे॑षु॒ पर्व॑तः । अ॒भीमिन्द्रो॑ न॒द्यो॑ व॒व्रिणा॑ हि॒ता विश्वा॑ अनु॒ष्ठाः प्र॑व॒णेषु॑ जिघ्नते
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ atiṣṭhat ǀ dharúṇa-hvaram ǀ támaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ jaṭháreṣu ǀ párvataḥ ǀabhí ǀ īm ǀ índraḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ vavríṇā ǀ hitā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ anu-sthā́ḥ ǀ pravaṇéṣu ǀ jighnate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The darkness obstructed the current of the waters; the cloud was within the belly ofVṛtra; butIndraprecipitated all the waters which the obstructor had concealed, in succession, down to the hollows (of the earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स शेवृ॑ध॒मधि॑ धा द्यु॒म्नम॒स्मे महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं ज॑ना॒षाळि॑न्द्र॒ तव्य॑म् । रक्षा॑ च नो म॒घोन॑: पा॒हि सू॒रीन्रा॒ये च॑ नः स्वप॒त्या इ॒षे धा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ śé-vṛdham ǀ ádhi ǀ dhāḥ ǀ dyumnám ǀ asmé íti ǀ máhi ǀ kṣatrám ǀ janāṣā́ṭ ǀ indra ǀ távyam ǀrákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ sūrī́n ǀ rāyé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ su-apatyái ǀ iṣé ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,Indra, increasing reputation; (bestow upon us) great, augmenting, and foe subduing strength; preserve us in affluence; cherish those who are wise; and supply us with wealth from which proceed excellent progeny and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॑दस्य वरि॒मा वि प॑प्रथ॒ इन्द्रं॒ न म॒ह्ना पृ॑थि॒वी च॒न प्रति॑ । भी॒मस्तुवि॑ष्माञ्चर्ष॒णिभ्य॑ आत॒पः शिशी॑ते॒ वज्रं॒ तेज॑से॒ न वंस॑गः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ varimā́ ǀ ví ǀ paprathe ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ mahnā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ caná ǀ práti ǀbhīmáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā-tapáḥ ǀ śíśīte ǀ vájram ǀ téjase ǀ ná ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The amplitude ofIndrawas vaster than the (space of) heaven; earth was not comparable to him in bulk; formidable and most mighty, he has been ever the afflicter (of the enemies of) those men (who worship him); he has his thunderbolt for sharpness, as a bull (his horns).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॑र्ण॒वो न न॒द्य॑: समु॒द्रिय॒: प्रति॑ गृभ्णाति॒ विश्रि॑ता॒ वरी॑मभिः । इन्द्र॒: सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑ वृषायते स॒नात्स यु॒ध्म ओज॑सा पनस्यते
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ ná ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ samudríyaḥ ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇāti ǀ ví-śritāḥ ǀ várīma-bhiḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀ vṛṣa-yate ǀ sanā́t ǀ sáḥ ǀ yudhmáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ panasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The firmament-abidingIndragraps the wide-spread waters with his comprehenisve faculties, as the ocean (receives the rivers); he rushes (impetuous) as a bull, todrikof theSoma; he, the warrior, even covets praise for his prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तमि॑न्द्र॒ पर्व॑तं॒ न भोज॑से म॒हो नृ॒म्णस्य॒ धर्म॑णामिरज्यसि । प्र वी॒र्ये॑ण दे॒वताति॑ चेकिते॒ विश्व॑स्मा उ॒ग्रः कर्म॑णे पु॒रोहि॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ párvatam ǀ ná ǀ bhójase ǀ maháḥ ǀ nṛmṇásya ǀ dhármaṇām ǀ irajyasi ǀprá ǀ vīryéṇa ǀ devátā ǀ áti ǀ cekite ǀ víśvasmai ǀ ugráḥ ǀ kármaṇe ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouIndra, have not (struck) the cloud for (your own) enjoyment; you rulest over those who are possessed of great wealth; that divinity is known by us to surpass all others in strength; the haughty (Indra) takes precedence of all gods, on account of his exploits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इद्वने॑ नम॒स्युभि॑र्वचस्यते॒ चारु॒ जने॑षु प्रब्रुवा॒ण इ॑न्द्रि॒यम् । वृषा॒ छन्दु॑र्भवति हर्य॒तो वृषा॒ क्षेमे॑ण॒ धेनां॑ म॒घवा॒ यदिन्व॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ váne ǀ namasyú-bhiḥ ǀ vacasyate ǀ cā́ru ǀ jáneṣu ǀ pra-bruvāṇáḥ ǀ indriyám ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ chánduḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kṣémeṇa ǀ dhénām ǀ maghávā ǀ yát ǀ ínvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily is glorified by adoring (sages) in the forest; he proclaims his beautiful vigour amongst men ; he is the granter of their wishes (to those who solicit him); he is the encourager of those who desire to worship (him), when the wealthy offerer of oblations, enjoying his protection, recites his praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इन्म॒हानि॑ समि॒थानि॑ म॒ज्मना॑ कृ॒णोति॑ यु॒ध्म ओज॑सा॒ जने॑भ्यः । अधा॑ च॒न श्रद्द॑धति॒ त्विषी॑मत॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ वज्रं॑ नि॒घनि॑घ्नते व॒धम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mahā́ni ǀ sam-ithā́ni ǀ majmánā ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ yudhmáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ jánebhyaḥ ǀádha ǀ caná ǀ śrát ǀ dadhati ǀ tvíṣi-mate ǀ índrāya ǀ vájram ǀ ni-ghánighnate ǀ vadhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrathe warrior, engages in many great conflicts for (the good of) man, with overwhelming prowess; when he hurls his fatal shaft, every one immediately has faith in the resplendent Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि श्र॑व॒स्युः सद॑नानि कृ॒त्रिमा॑ क्ष्म॒या वृ॑धा॒न ओज॑सा विना॒शय॑न् । ज्योतीं॑षि कृ॒ण्वन्न॑वृ॒काणि॒ यज्य॒वेऽव॑ सु॒क्रतु॒: सर्त॒वा अ॒पः सृ॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ śravasyúḥ ǀ sádanāni ǀ kṛtrímā ǀ kṣmayā́ ǀ vṛdhānáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ vi-nāśáyan ǀjyótīṃṣi ǀ kṛṇván ǀ avṛkā́ṇi ǀ yájyave ǀ áva ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ sártavái ǀ apáḥ ǀ sṛjat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ambitious of renown, destroying the well-built dwellings of theasuras, expanding like the earth, and setting the (heavenly) luminaries free from concealment, he, the performer of good deeds, enables the waters to flow for the benefit of his worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒नाय॒ मन॑: सोमपावन्नस्तु ते॒ऽर्वाञ्चा॒ हरी॑ वन्दनश्रु॒दा कृ॑धि । यमि॑ष्ठास॒: सार॑थयो॒ य इ॑न्द्र ते॒ न त्वा॒ केता॒ आ द॑भ्नुवन्ति॒ भूर्ण॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: dānā́ya ǀ mánaḥ ǀ soma-pāvan ǀ astu ǀ te ǀ arvā́ñcā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vandana-śrut ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀyámiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ sā́rathayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ kétāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dabhnuvanti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker ofSoma, may your mind incline to grant our desires; hearer of praises, let your coursers be present (at our sacrifice); your charioteers are skillful in restraining (your steeds); nor,Indra, can crafty (enemies) bearing arms prevail against you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप्र॑क्षितं॒ वसु॑ बिभर्षि॒ हस्त॑यो॒रषा॑ळ्हं॒ सह॑स्त॒न्वि॑ श्रु॒तो द॑धे । आवृ॑तासोऽव॒तासो॒ न क॒र्तृभि॑स्त॒नूषु॑ ते॒ क्रत॑व इन्द्र॒ भूर॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ápra-kṣitam ǀ vásu ǀ bibharṣi ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ áṣāḷham ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ tanví ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ dadhe ǀā́-vṛtāsaḥ ǀ avatā́sáḥ ǀ ná ǀ kartṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ te ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ indra ǀ bhū́rayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You hold in yourhandsunexhausted wealth; you, renowned (Indra), have irresistible strength in your body; your limbs are invested with (glorious) exploits, as well as (are surrounded by those who come for water); in your member, Indra, are many exploits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प्र पू॒र्वीरव॒ तस्य॑ च॒म्रिषोऽत्यो॒ न योषा॒मुद॑यंस्त भु॒र्वणि॑: । दक्षं॑ म॒हे पा॑ययते हिर॒ण्ययं॒ रथ॑मा॒वृत्या॒ हरि॑योग॒मृभ्व॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ prá ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ áva ǀ tásya ǀ camríṣaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣām ǀ út ǀ ayaṃsta ǀ bhurváṇiḥ ǀdákṣam ǀ mahé ǀ pāyayate ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ rátham ǀ ā-vṛ́tya ǀ hári-yogam ǀ ṛ́bhvasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Veracious (Indra) has risen up (as ardently) as a horse (approaches) a mare, to partake of the copious libations (contained) in the (sacrificial) ladles; having stayed his well-horsed, golden, and splendid chariot, heplies himself, capable of heroid (actions withSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं गू॒र्तयो॑ नेम॒न्निष॒: परी॑णसः समु॒द्रं न सं॒चर॑णे सनि॒ष्यव॑: । पतिं॒ दक्ष॑स्य वि॒दथ॑स्य॒ नू सहो॑ गि॒रिं न वे॒ना अधि॑ रोह॒ तेज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ gūrtáyaḥ ǀ neman-íṣaḥ ǀ párīṇasaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ná ǀ sam-cáraṇe ǀ saniṣyávaḥ ǀpátim ǀ dákṣasya ǀ vidáthasya ǀ nú ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ girím ǀ ná ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ roha ǀ téjasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His adorers, bearing oblations, are thronging round (him), as (merchants) covetous of gain crowd the ocean (in vessels) on a voyage ascend quickly, with a hymn to the powerfulIndra, the protector of the solemn sacrifice, as wome (climb) a mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तु॒र्वणि॑र्म॒हाँ अ॑रे॒णु पौंस्ये॑ गि॒रेर्भृ॒ष्टिर्न भ्रा॑जते तु॒जा शव॑: । येन॒ शुष्णं॑ मा॒यिन॑माय॒सो मदे॑ दु॒ध्र आ॒भूषु॑ रा॒मय॒न्नि दाम॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ turváṇiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ areṇú ǀ páuṃsye ǀ giréḥ ǀ bhṛṣṭíḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhrājate ǀ tujā́ ǀ śávaḥ ǀyéna ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ māyínam ǀ āyasáḥ ǀ máde ǀ dudhráḥ ǀ ābhū́ṣu ǀ ramáyat ǀ ní ǀ dā́mani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is quick in action, and mighty; his faultless and desructive prowess shines in manly (conflict) like the peak of a mountain (afar), with which, clothed in metal (armour), he, the supressor of the malignant, when exhilarated (bySoma), cast the wilyŚuṣṇainto prison and into bonds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वी यदि॒ तवि॑षी॒ त्वावृ॑धो॒तय॒ इन्द्रं॒ सिष॑क्त्यु॒षसं॒ न सूर्य॑: । यो धृ॒ष्णुना॒ शव॑सा॒ बाध॑ते॒ तम॒ इय॑र्ति रे॒णुं बृ॒हद॑र्हरि॒ष्वणि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: devī́ ǀ yádi ǀ táviṣī ǀ tvā́-vṛdhā ǀ ūtáye ǀ índram ǀ sísakti ǀ uṣásam ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇúnā ǀ śávasā ǀ bā́dhate ǀ támaḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ reṇúm ǀ bṛhát ǀ arhari-svániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine strength waits, like the sun upon the dawn, upon thatIndrawho is made more powerful for protection by you, (his worshipper), who with resolute vigour resists the gloom, and inflicts severe castigation uon his enemies, making them cry aloud (with pain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यत्ति॒रो ध॒रुण॒मच्यु॑तं॒ रजोऽति॑ष्ठिपो दि॒व आता॑सु ब॒र्हणा॑ । स्व॑र्मीळ्हे॒ यन्मद॑ इन्द्र॒ हर्ष्याह॑न्वृ॒त्रं निर॒पामौ॑ब्जो अर्ण॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yát ǀ tiráḥ ǀ dharúṇam ǀ ácyutam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ átisthipaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́tāsu ǀ barháṇā ǀsváḥ-mīḷhe ǀ yát ǀ máde ǀ indra ǀ hárṣyā ǀ áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ níḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ aubjaḥ ǀ arṇavám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “. When you, destroyingIndra, did distribute the (previously) hidden life-sustaining, undecaying waters through the different quarters of the heaven, then, animated (bySoma), you did engage in battle, and with exulting (prowess) slewVṛtra, and did send down an ocean of waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दि॒वो ध॒रुणं॑ धिष॒ ओज॑सा पृथि॒व्या इ॑न्द्र॒ सद॑नेषु॒ माहि॑नः । त्वं सु॒तस्य॒ मदे॑ अरिणा अ॒पो वि वृ॒त्रस्य॑ स॒मया॑ पा॒ष्या॑रुजः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ diváḥ ǀ dharúṇam ǀ dhiṣe ǀ ójasā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ mā́hinaḥ ǀtvám ǀ sutásya ǀ máde ǀ ariṇāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ samáyā ǀ pāṣyā́ ǀ arujaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, mightyIndra, send down from the heaven by your power, upon the realms of earth, the (world) sustaining rain; exhilarated (bySoma), you have expelled the waters (from the clouds), and have crushedVṛtraby a solid rock.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मंहि॑ष्ठाय बृह॒ते बृ॒हद्र॑ये स॒त्यशु॑ष्माय त॒वसे॑ म॒तिं भ॑रे । अ॒पामि॑व प्रव॒णे यस्य॑ दु॒र्धरं॒ राधो॑ वि॒श्वायु॒ शव॑से॒ अपा॑वृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ bṛhát-raye ǀ satyá-śuṣmāya ǀ taváse ǀ matím ǀ bhare ǀapā́m-iva ǀ pravaṇé ǀ yásya ǀ duḥ-dháram ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ viśvá-āyu ǀ śávase ǀ ápa-vṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer especial praise to the most bountiful, the excellent, th eopulent, the verily powerful and statelyIndra, whose irresistible impetuosity is like (the rush) of waters down a precipice, and by whom widely-diffused wealth is laid open (to his worshippers) to sustain (their) strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ ते॒ विश्व॒मनु॑ हासदि॒ष्टय॒ आपो॑ नि॒म्नेव॒ सव॑ना ह॒विष्म॑तः । यत्पर्व॑ते॒ न स॒मशी॑त हर्य॒त इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्र॒: श्नथि॑ता हिर॒ण्यय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ te ǀ víśvam ǀ ánu ǀ ha ǀ asat ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ nimnā́-iva ǀ sávanā ǀ havíṣmataḥ ǀyát ǀ párvate ǀ ná ǀ sam-áśīta ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ śnáthitā ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the world,Indra, was intent upon your worship; the oblations of the sacrificer (flowed) like water (falling) to a depth); for the fatal golden thunderbolt of Indra, when hurling it (against the foe), did not sleep upon the mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मै भी॒माय॒ नम॑सा॒ सम॑ध्व॒र उषो॒ न शु॑भ्र॒ आ भ॑रा॒ पनी॑यसे । यस्य॒ धाम॒ श्रव॑से॒ नामे॑न्द्रि॒यं ज्योति॒रका॑रि ह॒रितो॒ नाय॑से
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ bhīmā́ya ǀ námasā ǀ sám ǀ adhvaré ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhre ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pánīyase ǀyásya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ śrávase ǀ nā́ma ǀ indriyám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ákāri ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beautiful Uṣas, now present the oblation in this rite to the formidable, praise-deservingIndra, whose all-sustaining, celebrated, and characteristic radiance has impelled him hither and thither, (in quest) of (sacrificial) food, as (a charioteer drives) his horses (in various directions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे त॑ इन्द्र॒ ते व॒यं पु॑रुष्टुत॒ ये त्वा॒रभ्य॒ चरा॑मसि प्रभूवसो । न॒हि त्वद॒न्यो गि॑र्वणो॒ गिर॒: सघ॑त्क्षो॒णीरि॑व॒ प्रति॑ नो हर्य॒ तद्वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ té ǀ vayám ǀ puru-stuta ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ ā-rábhya ǀ cárāmasi ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀnahí ǀ tvát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sághat ǀ kṣoṇī́ḥ-iva ǀ práti ǀ naḥ ǀ harya ǀ tát ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Much-lauded and most opulentIndra, we are thy, who, relying (on your favour), approach you; accepter of praise, no other than you receie our commendations; be plural ased (with our address), as the earth (cherishes) her creatures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॑ त इन्द्र वी॒र्यं१॒॑ तव॑ स्मस्य॒स्य स्तो॒तुर्म॑घव॒न्काम॒मा पृ॑ण । अनु॑ ते॒ द्यौर्बृ॑ह॒ती वी॒र्यं॑ मम इ॒यं च॑ ते पृथि॒वी ने॑म॒ ओज॑से
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vīryám ǀ táva ǀ smasi ǀ asyá ǀ stotúḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǀánu ǀ te ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ vīryám ǀ mame ǀ iyám ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ neme ǀ ójase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great is your prowess,Indra; we are yours; satisfyMaghavan, the desires of this your worshipper, the vast heaven has acknowledged your might; this earth has been bowed down through your vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तमि॑न्द्र॒ पर्व॑तं म॒हामु॒रुं वज्रे॑ण वज्रिन्पर्व॒शश्च॑कर्तिथ । अवा॑सृजो॒ निवृ॑ता॒: सर्त॒वा अ॒पः स॒त्रा विश्वं॑ दधिषे॒ केव॑लं॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ párvatam ǀ mahā́m ǀ urúm ǀ vájreṇa ǀ vajrin ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ cakartitha ǀáva ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ ní-vṛtāḥ ǀ sártavái ǀ apáḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ víśvam ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ kévalam ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, thunderer, have shattered with your bolt the broad and massive cloud into fragments, and have sent down the waters that were confined in it, to flow (at will); verily you alone possess all power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू चि॑त्सहो॒जा अ॒मृतो॒ नि तु॑न्दते॒ होता॒ यद्दू॒तो अभ॑वद्वि॒वस्व॑तः । वि साधि॑ष्ठेभिः प॒थिभी॒ रजो॑ मम॒ आ दे॒वता॑ता ह॒विषा॑ विवासति
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ cit ǀ sahaḥ-jā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ní ǀ tundate ǀ hótā ǀ yát ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ábhavat ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀví ǀ sā́dhiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ mame ǀ ā́ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ havíṣā ǀ vivāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The strength-genitive rated, immortalAgniquickly issues forth, when he is the invoker of the gods, and the messenger (of the worshipper) (then proceeding) by suitable paths, he has made the firmament, and worships (the deities) in the sacrifice with oblationṣ  ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स्वमद्म॑ यु॒वमा॑नो अ॒जर॑स्तृ॒ष्व॑वि॒ष्यन्न॑त॒सेषु॑ तिष्ठति । अत्यो॒ न पृ॒ष्ठं प्रु॑षि॒तस्य॑ रोचते दि॒वो न सानु॑ स्त॒नय॑न्नचिक्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ svám ǀ ádma ǀ yuvámānaḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ tṛṣú ǀ aviṣyán ǀ ataséṣu ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ pruṣitásya ǀ rocate ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sā́nu ǀ stanáyan ǀ acikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “UndecayingAgni, combining his food (with his flame), and devouring it quickly, ascends the dry wood; the blaze of theconsuming (element) spreads like a (fleet) courser, and roars like a roaring (cloud) in the height of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रा॒णा रु॒द्रेभि॒र्वसु॑भिः पु॒रोहि॑तो॒ होता॒ निष॑त्तो रयि॒षाळम॑र्त्यः । रथो॒ न वि॒क्ष्वृ॑ञ्जसा॒न आ॒युषु॒ व्या॑नु॒षग्वार्या॑ दे॒व ऋ॑ण्वति
shlokas.transliteration: krāṇā́ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ rayiṣā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vikṣú ǀ ṛñjasānáḥ ǀ āyúṣu ǀ ví ǀ ānuṣák ǀ vā́ryā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortal, and resplendentAgni, the bearer of oblations, honoured by theRudrasand theVasusthe invoker of the gods, who presides over oblations and is the distributor of riches, praised by his worshippers, and admired like a chariot amongst mankind, accepts the oblations that are successively presented.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि वात॑जूतो अत॒सेषु॑ तिष्ठते॒ वृथा॑ जु॒हूभि॒: सृण्या॑ तुवि॒ष्वणि॑: । तृ॒षु यद॑ग्ने व॒निनो॑ वृषा॒यसे॑ कृ॒ष्णं त॒ एम॒ रुश॑दूर्मे अजर
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ vā́ta-jūtaḥ ǀ ataséṣu ǀ tiṣṭhate ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ juhū́bhiḥ ǀ sṛ́ṇyā ǀ tuvi-svániḥ ǀtṛṣú ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yáse ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ te ǀ éma ǀ rúśat-ūrme ǀ ajara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Excited by the wind, and roaring loudly,Agnipenetrates easily with his flames and diffusive (intensity) among the timber; when, undecaying and fiercely-blazing Agni, you rush rapidly like a bull amongst the forest trees, your path is blackened.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तपु॑र्जम्भो॒ वन॒ आ वात॑चोदितो यू॒थे न सा॒ह्वाँ अव॑ वाति॒ वंस॑गः । अ॒भि॒व्रज॒न्नक्षि॑तं॒ पाज॑सा॒ रज॑: स्था॒तुश्च॒रथं॑ भयते पत॒त्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tápuḥ-jambhaḥ ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́ta-coditaḥ ǀ yūthé ǀ ná ǀ sahvā́n ǀ áva ǀ vāti ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀabhi-vrájan ǀ ákṣitam ǀ pā́jasā ǀ rájaḥ ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ carátham ǀ bhayate ǀ patatríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flame-weaponed and breeze-excitedAgni, assailing the unexhaled moisture (of the trees), with all his strength, in a volume of fire, rushes triumphant (against all things) in the forest, like a bull, and all, whether stationary or moveable, are afraid of him as he flies along.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धुष्ट्वा॒ भृग॑वो॒ मानु॑षे॒ष्वा र॒यिं न चारुं॑ सु॒हवं॒ जने॑भ्यः । होता॑रमग्ने॒ अति॑थिं॒ वरे॑ण्यं मि॒त्रं न शेवं॑ दि॒व्याय॒ जन्म॑ने
shlokas.transliteration: dadhúḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ rayím ǀ ná ǀ cā́rum ǀ su-hávam ǀ jánebhyaḥ ǀhótāram ǀ agne ǀ átithim ǀ váreṇyam ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ śévam ǀ divyā́ya ǀ jánmane ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBhṛgusamongst men, for the sake of a divine birth, cherished you like a precious treasureAgni, who sacrifices for men, who are the invoker (of the gods), the (welcome) guest at sacrifices, and who are to be valued like an affectionate friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑रं स॒प्त जु॒ह्वो॒३॒॑ यजि॑ष्ठं॒ यं वा॒घतो॑ वृ॒णते॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ । अ॒ग्निं विश्वे॑षामर॒तिं वसू॑नां सप॒र्यामि॒ प्रय॑सा॒ यामि॒ रत्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: hótāram ǀ saptá ǀ juhváḥ ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ yám ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ vṛṇáte ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀagním ǀ víśveṣām ǀ aratím ǀ vásūnām ǀ saparyā́mi ǀ práyasā ǀ yā́mi ǀ rátnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship with oblations thatAgniwhom the seven invoking priests invite as the invoker of the gods; who is most worthy of worship at sacrifices, and who is the donor of all riches; I solicit of him wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छि॑द्रा सूनो सहसो नो अ॒द्य स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ मित्रमह॒: शर्म॑ यच्छ । अग्ने॑ गृ॒णन्त॒मंह॑स उरु॒ष्योर्जो॑ नपात्पू॒र्भिराय॑सीभिः
shlokas.transliteration: ácchidrā ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀágne ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ uruṣya ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́yasībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength, favourably-shiningAgni, grant to your worshipper on this occasion uninterrupted felicity; offspring of food, preserve him who praises you from sin with guards of metal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भवा॒ वरू॑थं गृण॒ते वि॑भावो॒ भवा॑ मघवन्म॒घव॑द्भ्य॒: शर्म॑ । उ॒रु॒ष्याग्ने॒ अंह॑सो गृ॒णन्तं॑ प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: bháva ǀ várūtham ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ vibhā-vaḥ ǀ bháva ǀ magha-van ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ śárma ǀuruṣyá ǀ agne ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Variously-shiningAgni, be a shelter to him who praises you; be prosperity,Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers of oblations); protect, Agni, your worshipper from sin; may Agni, who is rich with righteous acts, come (to us) quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒या इद॑ग्ने अ॒ग्नय॑स्ते अ॒न्ये त्वे विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॑ मादयन्ते । वैश्वा॑नर॒ नाभि॑रसि क्षिती॒नां स्थूणे॑व॒ जनाँ॑ उप॒मिद्य॑यन्थ
shlokas.transliteration: vayā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ te ǀ anyé ǀ tvé íti ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayante ǀváiśvānara ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ asi ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ sthū́ṇā-iva ǀ jánān ǀ upa-mít ǀ yayantha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever other fires there may be, they are but ramifications,Agni, of you; but they all rejoice, being immortal in you; you,Vaiśvānara, are the navel of men, and suppor tthem like a deep-plural nted column.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मू॒र्धा दि॒वो नाभि॑र॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्या अथा॑भवदर॒ती रोद॑स्योः । तं त्वा॑ दे॒वासो॑ऽजनयन्त दे॒वं वैश्वा॑नर॒ ज्योति॒रिदार्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: mūrdhā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavat ǀ aratíḥ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ajanayanta ǀ devám ǀ váiśvānara ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ít ǀ ā́ryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the head of heaven, the navel of earth, became the ruler over both earth and heaven; all the gods engendered you,Vaiśvānara, in the form of light, for the venerable sage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सूर्ये॒ न र॒श्मयो॑ ध्रु॒वासो॑ वैश्वान॒रे द॑धिरे॒ऽग्ना वसू॑नि । या पर्व॑ते॒ष्वोष॑धीष्व॒प्सु या मानु॑षे॒ष्वसि॒ तस्य॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sū́rye ǀ ná ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ dhruvā́saḥ ǀ vaiśvānaré ǀ dadhire ǀ agnā́ ǀ vásūni ǀyā́ ǀ párvateṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ yā́ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ási ǀ tásya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Treasures were deposited in theAgni,Vaiśvānara, like the permanent rays (of light) in the sun; you are the sovereign of all the treasures that exist in the mountains, in the herbs, in the waters, or amongst men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒ह॒ती इ॑व सू॒नवे॒ रोद॑सी॒ गिरो॒ होता॑ मनु॒ष्यो॒३॒॑ न दक्ष॑: । स्व॑र्वते स॒त्यशु॑ष्माय पू॒र्वीर्वै॑श्वान॒राय॒ नृत॑माय य॒ह्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhatī́ ivéti bṛhatī́-iva ǀ sūnáve ǀ ródasī íti ǀ gíraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ manuṣyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀsváḥ-vate ǀ satyá-śuṣmāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ nṛ́-tamāya ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “. Heaven and earth expanded as it were for their son. The experienced sacrificer recites, like a bard, many ancient and copious praises addressed to the graceful-moving, truly-vigorous, and all-guidingVaiśvānara.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॑त्ते बृह॒तो जा॑तवेदो॒ वैश्वा॑नर॒ प्र रि॑रिचे महि॒त्वम् । राजा॑ कृष्टी॒नाम॑सि॒ मानु॑षीणां यु॒धा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वरि॑वश्चकर्थ
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ prá ǀ ririce ǀ mahi-tvám ǀrā́jā ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ asi ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ yudhā́ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ cakartha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānara, who knows all that are born, your magnitude has exceeded that of the spacious heaven; you are the monarch ofmanu-descended men; you have regained for the gods in battle, the wealth (carries off by theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नू म॑हि॒त्वं वृ॑ष॒भस्य॑ वोचं॒ यं पू॒रवो॑ वृत्र॒हणं॒ सच॑न्ते । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो दस्यु॑म॒ग्निर्ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अधू॑नो॒त्काष्ठा॒ अव॒ शम्ब॑रं भेत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ vocam ǀ yám ǀ pūrávaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ sácante ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ agníḥ ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ ádhūnot ǀ kā́ṣṭhāḥ ǀ áva ǀ śámbaram ǀ bhet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I extol the greatness of that showerer of rain whom men celebrate as the slayer ofVṛtra; theAgni,Vaiśvānara, slew the stealer (of the waters) and sent them down (upon earth), and clove the (obstructing) cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो म॑हि॒म्ना वि॒श्वकृ॑ष्टिर्भ॒रद्वा॑जेषु यज॒तो वि॒भावा॑ । शा॒त॒व॒ने॒ये श॒तिनी॑भिर॒ग्निः पु॑रुणी॒थे ज॑रते सू॒नृता॑वान्
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ mahimnā́ ǀ viśvá-kṛṣṭiḥ ǀ bharát-vājeṣu ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀśāta-vaneyé ǀ śatínībhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-nīthé ǀ jarate ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānaraby his magnitude is all men, and is to be worshipped as the diffuser of manifold light in offerings of nutritious viands;Agni, the speaker of truth, praises with many commendationsPuruṇītha, the son of Śātavani.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वह्निं॑ य॒शसं॑ वि॒दथ॑स्य के॒तुं सु॑प्रा॒व्यं॑ दू॒तं स॒द्योअ॑र्थम् । द्वि॒जन्मा॑नं र॒यिमि॑व प्रश॒स्तं रा॒तिं भ॑र॒द्भृग॑वे मात॒रिश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: váhnim ǀ yaśásam ǀ vidáthasya ǀ ketúm ǀ supra-avyám ǀ dūtám ǀ sadyáḥ-artham ǀdvi-jánmānam ǀ rayím-iva ǀ pra-śastám ǀ rātím ǀ bharat ǀ bhṛ́gave ǀ mātaríśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mātariśvanbrought, as a friend, toBhṛgu, the celebratedVahni, the illuminato of sacrifices, the careful protector (of his votaries), the swift-moving messenger (of the gods), the offspring of two parents, (to be to him) as it were a precious treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य शासु॑रु॒भया॑सः सचन्ते ह॒विष्म॑न्त उ॒शिजो॒ ये च॒ मर्ता॑: । दि॒वश्चि॒त्पूर्वो॒ न्य॑सादि॒ होता॒पृच्छ्यो॑ वि॒श्पति॑र्वि॒क्षु वे॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śā́suḥ ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ mártāḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ cit ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ ní ǀ asādi ǀ hótā ǀ ā-pṛ́cchyaḥ ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both (gods and men) are the worshippers of this ruler; those who are to be desired (of the gods), and those who are mortal, beaing oblations; for this venerable invoker (of the gods), the lord of men, and distributor (of desired benefits), was plural ced by the officiating priests (upon the altar), before the sun was in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नव्य॑सी हृ॒द आ जाय॑मानम॒स्मत्सु॑की॒र्तिर्मधु॑जिह्वमश्याः । यमृ॒त्विजो॑ वृ॒जने॒ मानु॑षास॒: प्रय॑स्वन्त आ॒यवो॒ जीज॑नन्त
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ návyasī ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jā́yamānam ǀ asmát ǀ su-kīrtíḥ ǀ mádhu-jihvam ǀ aśyāḥ ǀyám ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀ vṛjáne ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ jī́jananta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our newest celebration come before thatAgni, who is sweet-tongued, and is to be engendered in the heart; whom men, the descendants ofManu, sacrificing and presenting oblations to him, beget in the time and battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शिक्पा॑व॒को वसु॒र्मानु॑षेषु॒ वरे॑ण्यो॒ होता॑धायि वि॒क्षु । दमू॑ना गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्दम॒ आँ अ॒ग्निर्भु॑वद्रयि॒पती॑ रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: uśík ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ adhāyi ǀ vikṣú ǀdámūnāḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the desirable, the purifying, the giver of dwellings, the excellent, the invoker (of the gods) has been plural ced (upon the altar) among men; may he be inimical (to our foes), the protector of (our) dwellings and the guardian of the treasures in (this) mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं पति॑मग्ने रयी॒णां प्र शं॑सामो म॒तिभि॒र्गोत॑मासः । आ॒शुं न वा॑जम्भ॒रं म॒र्जय॑न्तः प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ pátim ǀ agne ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsāmaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ gótamāsaḥ ǀāśúm ǀ ná ǀ vājam-bharám ǀ marjáyantaḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, born of the race ofGotama, praise you,Agni, with acceptable (hymns), as the lord of riches; rubbing you, the bearer of oblations, (as a rider rubs down), a horse; may he who has acquired wealth by sacred rites, come hither quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ प्र त॒वसे॑ तु॒राय॒ प्रयो॒ न ह॑र्मि॒ स्तोमं॒ माहि॑नाय । ऋची॑षमा॒याध्रि॑गव॒ ओह॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि रा॒तत॑मा
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ taváse ǀ turā́ya ǀ práyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ harmi ǀ stómam ǀ mā́hināya ǀṛ́cīṣamāya ǀ ádhri-gave ǀ óham ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ rātá-tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer adoration to that powerful, rapid, mighty, praise-meriting, and unobstructedIndra; adoration that is acceptable, and oblations that are grateful, as food (to a hungry man).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ प्रय॑ इव॒ प्र यं॑सि॒ भरा॑म्याङ्गू॒षं बाधे॑ सुवृ॒क्ति । इन्द्रा॑य हृ॒दा मन॑सा मनी॒षा प्र॒त्नाय॒ पत्ये॒ धियो॑ मर्जयन्त
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ práyaḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ yaṃsi ǀ bhárāmi ǀ āṅgūṣám ǀ bā́dhe ǀ su-vṛktí ǀíndrāya ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ pratnā́ya ǀ pátye ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ marjayanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer (oblations, acceptable as) food (to the hungry), to thatIndra; I raise (to him) exclamations that may be of efficacy in discomfiting (my foe); others (also) worship Indra, the ancient lord, in heart, in mind, and in understanding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ त्यमु॑प॒मं स्व॒र्षां भरा॑म्याङ्गू॒षमा॒स्ये॑न । मंहि॑ष्ठ॒मच्छो॑क्तिभिर्मती॒नां सु॑वृ॒क्तिभि॑: सू॒रिं वा॑वृ॒धध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ upa-mám ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ bhárāmi ǀ āṅgūṣám ǀ āsyéna ǀmáṃhiṣṭham ǀ ácchokti-bhiḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ sūrím ǀ vavṛdhádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer with my mouth a loud acclamation, with powerful and pure words of praise, to exalt him who is the type (of all), the giver (of good things), the great, the wise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ स्तोमं॒ सं हि॑नोमि॒ रथं॒ न तष्टे॑व॒ तत्सि॑नाय । गिर॑श्च॒ गिर्वा॑हसे सुवृ॒क्तीन्द्रा॑य विश्वमि॒न्वं मेधि॑राय
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stómam ǀ sám ǀ hinomi ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ tát-sināya ǀgíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ gírvāhase ǀ su-vṛktí ǀ índrāya ǀ viśvam-invám ǀ médhirāya ǁ
