shlokas.meaning_en: “I prepare praises fo rhim, as a carpenter constructs a car, (that the driver) may thence (obtain) food; praises well deserved, to him who is entitled to commendation, and excellent oblations to the wiseIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ सप्ति॑मिव श्रव॒स्येन्द्रा॑या॒र्कं जु॒ह्वा॒३॒॑ सम॑ञ्जे । वी॒रं दा॒नौक॑सं व॒न्दध्यै॑ पु॒रां गू॒र्तश्र॑वसं द॒र्माण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sáptim-iva ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ índrāya ǀ arkám ǀ juhvā́ ǀ sám ǀ añje ǀvīrám ǀ dāná-okasam ǀ vandádhyai ǀ purā́m ǀ gūrtá-śravasam ǀ darmā́ṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To propitiate thatIndrafor the sake of food, I combinepraise with utterance, as (a man harnesses) a horse (to a car), in order to celebrate the heroic, munificent, and food-conferring Indra, the destroyer of the cities (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ त्वष्टा॑ तक्ष॒द्वज्रं॒ स्वप॑स्तमं स्व॒र्यं१॒॑ रणा॑य । वृ॒त्रस्य॑ चिद्वि॒दद्येन॒ मर्म॑ तु॒जन्नीशा॑नस्तुज॒ता कि॑ये॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ takṣat ǀ vájram ǀ svápaḥ-tamam ǀ svaryám ǀ ráṇāya ǀvṛtrásya ǀ cit ǀ vidát ǀ yéna ǀ márma ǀ tuján ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ tujatā́ ǀ kiyedhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For thatIndra, verilyTvaṣṭāsharpened the well-acting, sure-aimed thunderbolt for the battle, with which fatal (weapon) the foe-subduing and mighty sovereign severed the limbs ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदु॑ मा॒तुः सव॑नेषु स॒द्यो म॒हः पि॒तुं प॑पि॒वाञ्चार्वन्ना॑ । मु॒षा॒यद्विष्णु॑: पच॒तं सही॑या॒न्विध्य॑द्वरा॒हं ति॒रो अद्रि॒मस्ता॑
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mātúḥ ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ pitúm ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ cā́ru ǀ ánnā ǀmuṣāyát ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ pacatám ǀ sáhīyān ǀ vídhyat ǀ varāhám ǀ tiráḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ ástā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly quaffing the libations, and devouring the grateful viands (presented) at the three (daily) sacrifices which are dedicated to the creator (of the world), he, the pervadere of the universe, stole the ripe (treasures of theasuras); the vanquisher (of his foes), the hurler of the thunderbolt, encountering pierced the cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ ग्नाश्चि॑द्दे॒वप॑त्नी॒रिन्द्रा॑या॒र्कम॑हि॒हत्य॑ ऊवुः । परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ज॑भ्र उ॒र्वी नास्य॒ ते म॑हि॒मानं॒ परि॑ ष्टः
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ gnā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ devá-patnīḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ arkám ǀ ahi-hátye ǀ ūvurítyūvuḥ ǀpári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ jabhre ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ ná ǀ asya ǀ té íti ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ pári ǀ sta íti staḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thatIndrathe women, the wives of the gods, addressed their hymns, on the destruction of Ahi; he encompasses the extensive heaven and earth; they two do not surpass your vastness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदे॒व प्र रि॑रिचे महि॒त्वं दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्य॒न्तरि॑क्षात् । स्व॒राळिन्द्रो॒ दम॒ आ वि॒श्वगू॑र्तः स्व॒रिरम॑त्रो ववक्षे॒ रणा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ evá ǀ prá ǀ ririce ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ antárikṣāt ǀsva-rā́ṭ ǀ índraḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ viśvá-gūrtaḥ ǀ su-aríḥ ǀ ámatraḥ ǀ vavakṣe ǀ ráṇāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His magnitude verily exceeds that of the heaven, and earth and sky;Indra, self-irradiating in his dwelling, equal to every exploit, engaged with no unworthy foe, and killed in conflict, calls to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदे॒व शव॑सा शु॒षन्तं॒ वि वृ॑श्च॒द्वज्रे॑ण वृ॒त्रमिन्द्र॑: । गा न व्रा॒णा अ॒वनी॑रमुञ्चद॒भि श्रवो॑ दा॒वने॒ सचे॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ evá ǀ śávasā ǀ śuṣántam ǀ ví ǀ vṛścat ǀ vájreṇa ǀ vṛtrám ǀ índraḥ ǀgā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ vrāṇā́ḥ ǀ avánīḥ ǀ amuñcat ǀ abhí ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dāváne ǀ sá-cetāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by his vigour, cut to pieces with his thunderboltVṛtra, the absorber (of moisture), and set free the preserving waters, like cows (recovered from thieves); and, consentient (to the wishes)of the giver of the oblation, (grants him) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदु॑ त्वे॒षसा॑ रन्त॒ सिन्ध॑व॒: परि॒ यद्वज्रे॑ण सी॒मय॑च्छत् । ई॒शा॒न॒कृद्दा॒शुषे॑ दश॒स्यन्तु॒र्वीत॑ये गा॒धं तु॒र्वणि॑: कः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tveṣásā ǀ ranta ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yát ǀ vájreṇa ǀ sīm ǀ áyacchat ǀīśāna-kṛ́t ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ daśasyán ǀ turvī́taye ǀ gādhám ǀ turváṇiḥ ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through his power, the rivers sport, since he has opened (a way for them) by his thunderbolt; establishing his supremacy and granting a (recompense) to the giver (of the oblation), he, the swift-moving provided a resting plural ce for Tūrvīti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ प्र भ॑रा॒ तूतु॑जानो वृ॒त्राय॒ वज्र॒मीशा॑नः किये॒धाः । गोर्न पर्व॒ वि र॑दा तिर॒श्चेष्य॒न्नर्णां॑स्य॒पां च॒रध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ vájram ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ kiyedhā́ḥ ǀgóḥ ǀ ná ǀ párva ǀ ví ǀ rada ǀ tiraścā́ ǀ íṣyan ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ apā́m ǀ carádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the quick moving and strength-endowed lord (of all), hurl your thunderbolt against thisVṛtraand sever his joints, as (butchers cut up) a cow, that the rains may issue from him, and the waters flow (over the earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदु॒ प्र ब्रू॑हि पू॒र्व्याणि॑ तु॒रस्य॒ कर्मा॑णि॒ नव्य॑ उ॒क्थैः । यु॒धे यदि॑ष्णा॒न आयु॑धान्यृघा॒यमा॑णो निरि॒णाति॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ brūhi ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǀ turásya ǀ kármāṇi ǀ návyaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀyudhé ǀ yát ǀ iṣṇānáḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ ṛghāyámāṇaḥ ǀ ni-riṇā́ti ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proclaim, with new hymns, the former exploits of that quick-movingIndra, when wielding his weapons in battle, he encounters and destroys his enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदु॑ भि॒या गि॒रय॑श्च दृ॒ळ्हा द्यावा॑ च॒ भूमा॑ ज॒नुष॑स्तुजेते । उपो॑ वे॒नस्य॒ जोगु॑वान ओ॒णिं स॒द्यो भु॑वद्वी॒र्या॑य नो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dṛḷhā́ḥ ǀ dyā́vā ǀ ca ǀ bhū́ma ǀ janúṣaḥ ǀ tujete íti ǀúpo íti ǀ venásya ǀ jóguvānaḥ ǀ oṇím ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ nodhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through fear of him, the stable mountains (are still), and through dread of his appearance, heaven and earth tremble; may,Nodhas, praising repeatedly the preserving power of that belovedIndra, be speedily (blessed) with vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा इदु॒ त्यदनु॑ दाय्येषा॒मेको॒ यद्व॒व्ने भूरे॒रीशा॑नः । प्रैत॑शं॒ सूर्ये॑ पस्पृधा॒नं सौव॑श्व्ये॒ सुष्वि॑माव॒दिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ ánu ǀ dāyi ǀ eṣām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vavné ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀprá ǀ étaśam ǀ sū́rye ǀ paspṛdhānám ǀ sáuvaśvye ǀ súsvim ǀ āvat ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him has that praise been offered which he, sole (victor over his foes), and lord of maniford wealth, prefers (to receive) from those (who praise him).Indrahas defended the pious sacrificerEtaśawhen contending withSūrya, the son ofSvaśva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ते॑ हारियोजना सुवृ॒क्तीन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ गोत॑मासो अक्रन् । ऐषु॑ वि॒श्वपे॑शसं॒ धियं॑ धाः प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ hāri-yojana ǀ su-vṛktí ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ gótamāsaḥ ǀ akran ǀā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ viśvá-peśasam ǀ dhíyam ǀ dhāḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, harnesser of steeds, the descendants ofGotamahave offered to you prayers of efficacy to secure your presence; bestow upon them every sort of affluence; may he who has acquired wealth by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र म॑न्महे शवसा॒नाय॑ शू॒षमा॑ङ्गू॒षं गिर्व॑णसे अङ्गिर॒स्वत् । सु॒वृ॒क्तिभि॑: स्तुव॒त ऋ॑ग्मि॒यायार्चा॑मा॒र्कं नरे॒ विश्रु॑ताय
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ manmahe ǀ śavasānā́ya ǀ śūṣám ǀ āṅgūṣám ǀ gírvaṇase ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀsuvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ ṛgmiyā́ya ǀ árcāma ǀ arkám ǀ náre ǀ ví-śrutāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We mediate likeAṅgiras, an acceptable adress to that powerful and praise-deservingIndra, who is to be adored by his worshippers (with prayers) of efficacy, to bring him to the ceremony; let us repeat a prayer to the celebrated leader of all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ म॒हे महि॒ नमो॑ भरध्वमाङ्गू॒ष्यं॑ शवसा॒नाय॒ साम॑ । येना॑ न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: पद॒ज्ञा अर्च॑न्तो॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गा अवि॑न्दन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ máhi ǀ námaḥ ǀ bharadhvam ǀ āṅgūṣyám ǀ śavasānā́ya ǀ sā́ma ǀyéna ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ pada-jñā́ḥ ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ávindan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, priests, offer to the vast and most powerful,Indra, earnest veneration, a chant fit to be sung aloud; for through him our forefathers, theAṅgirasas, worshipping him, and knowing the footmark, recovered (the stolen) cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒स्याङ्गि॑रसां चे॒ष्टौ वि॒दत्स॒रमा॒ तन॑याय धा॒सिम् । बृह॒स्पति॑र्भि॒नदद्रिं॑ वि॒दद्गाः समु॒स्रिया॑भिर्वावशन्त॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ ca ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ vidát ǀ sarámā ǀ tánayāya ǀ dhāsím ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ bhinát ǀ ádrim ǀ vidát ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ usríyābhiḥ ǀ vāvaśanta ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the search was set on foot byIndraand theAṅgirasas, Suramā secured food for her young; thenBṛhaspatislew the devourer and rescued the kine, and the gods, with the cattle, proclaimed their joy alouḍ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॒ष्टुभा॒ स स्तु॒भा स॒प्त विप्रै॑: स्व॒रेणाद्रिं॑ स्व॒र्यो॒३॒॑ नव॑ग्वैः । स॒र॒ण्युभि॑: फलि॒गमि॑न्द्र शक्र व॒लं रवे॑ण दरयो॒ दश॑ग्वैः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-stúbhā ǀ sáḥ ǀ stubhā́ ǀ saptá ǀ vípraiḥ ǀ svaréṇa ǀ ádrim ǀ svaryáḥ ǀ náva-gvaiḥ ǀsaraṇyú-bhiḥ ǀ phali-gám ǀ indra ǀ śakra ǀ valám ǀ ráveṇa ǀ darayaḥ ǀ dáśa-gvaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulIndra, who are to be gratified with a laudatory and well-accented hymn by the seven priests, whether engaged for nine months, or for ten; and, desirous of (safe) protection, you have terrified by your voice the divisible fructifying cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒णा॒नो अङ्गि॑रोभिर्दस्म॒ वि व॑रु॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ गोभि॒रन्ध॑: । वि भूम्या॑ अप्रथय इन्द्र॒ सानु॑ दि॒वो रज॒ उप॑रमस्तभायः
shlokas.transliteration: gṛṇānáḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ dasma ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ándhaḥ ǀví ǀ bhū́myāḥ ǀ aprathayaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sā́nu ǀ diváḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ úparam ǀ astabhāyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of foes, praised by theAṅgirasas, you have scattered the darkness with the dawn, and with the rays of the sun; you have made straight the elevations of the earth; you have strengthened the foundations of the ethereal region.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदु॒ प्रय॑क्षतममस्य॒ कर्म॑ द॒स्मस्य॒ चारु॑तममस्ति॒ दंस॑: । उ॒प॒ह्व॒रे यदुप॑रा॒ अपि॑न्व॒न्मध्व॑र्णसो न॒द्य१॒॑श्चत॑स्रः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ práyakṣa-tamam ǀ asya ǀ kárma ǀ dasmásya ǀ cā́ru-tamam ǀ asti ǀ dáṃsaḥ ǀupa-hvaré ǀ yát ǀ úparāḥ ǀ ápinvat ǀ mádhu-arṇasaḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The deeds of that gracefulIndraare most admirable; his exploits are most glorious, in that he has replenished the four rivers of sweet water, spread over the surface of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वि॒ता वि व॑व्रे स॒नजा॒ सनी॑ळे अ॒यास्य॒: स्तव॑मानेभिर॒र्कैः । भगो॒ न मेने॑ पर॒मे व्यो॑म॒न्नधा॑रय॒द्रोद॑सी सु॒दंसा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dvitā́ ǀ ví ǀ vavre ǀ saná-jā ǀ sánīḷe íti sá-nīḷe ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǀ stávamānebhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀbhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ méne íti ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ ádhārayat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is not to be attained by violence, but (is easily propitiated) by those who praise him with sacred hymns, parted twofold the eternal and united (sphered of heaven and earth); the gracefulIndracherished the heaven and earth, like the sun in the august and most excellent sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒नाद्दिवं॒ परि॒ भूमा॒ विरू॑पे पुन॒र्भुवा॑ युव॒ती स्वेभि॒रेवै॑: । कृ॒ष्णेभि॑र॒क्तोषा रुश॑द्भि॒र्वपु॑र्भि॒रा च॑रतो अ॒न्यान्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: sanā́t ǀ dívam ǀ pári ǀ bhū́ma ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ punaḥ-bhúvā ǀ yuvatī́ íti ǀ svébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀkṛṣṇébhiḥ ǀ aktā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ vápuḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ carataḥ ǀ anyā́-anyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Night and dawn), of various complexion, repeatedly born, but ever youthful, have traversed in their revolutions alternately, from a remote period, earth and heaven; night with her dark, dawn with her luminous limbs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सने॑मि स॒ख्यं स्व॑प॒स्यमा॑नः सू॒नुर्दा॑धार॒ शव॑सा सु॒दंसा॑: । आ॒मासु॑ चिद्दधिषे प॒क्वम॒न्तः पय॑: कृ॒ष्णासु॒ रुश॒द्रोहि॑णीषु
shlokas.transliteration: sánemi ǀ sakhyám ǀ su-apasyámānaḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ śávasā ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǀāmā́su ǀ cit ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ pakvám ǀ antáríti ǀ páyaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́su ǀ rúśat ǀ róhiṇīṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son of strength assiduous in good works, diligent in pious acts, retains his ancient friendship (for his votary). You, (Indra), provide within the yet immature cows, whether black or red, the mature and glossy milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒नात्सनी॑ळा अ॒वनी॑रवा॒ता व्र॒ता र॑क्षन्ते अ॒मृता॒: सहो॑भिः । पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॒ जन॑यो॒ न पत्नी॑र्दुव॒स्यन्ति॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ अह्र॑याणम्
shlokas.transliteration: sanā́t ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀ avánīḥ ǀ avātā́ḥ ǀ vratā́ ǀ rakṣante ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀpurú ǀ sahásrā ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ duvasyánti ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ áhrayāṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From a remote time the contiguous, unshifting, and unwearied fingers practise with (all) their energies many thousand acts of devotion (towardsIndra); and like the wives (of the gods), the protecting sisters worship him who is without shame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ना॒युवो॒ नम॑सा॒ नव्यो॑ अ॒र्कैर्व॑सू॒यवो॑ म॒तयो॑ दस्म दद्रुः । पतिं॒ न पत्नी॑रुश॒तीरु॒शन्तं॑ स्पृ॒शन्ति॑ त्वा शवसावन्मनी॒षाः
shlokas.transliteration: sanā-yúvaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ návyaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ dasma ǀ dadruḥ ǀpátim ǀ ná ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ uśántam ǀ spṛśánti ǀ tvā ǀ śavasā-van ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BeautifulIndra, who are to be praised with holy hymns, the pious who are desirous of holy rites, those who are anxious for riches, and those who are wise, repair to you with veneration; powerful Indra, their minds adhere to you, as affectionate wives to a loving husbaṇḍ+”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒नादे॒व तव॒ रायो॒ गभ॑स्तौ॒ न क्षीय॑न्ते॒ नोप॑ दस्यन्ति दस्म । द्यु॒माँ अ॑सि॒ क्रतु॑माँ इन्द्र॒ धीर॒: शिक्षा॑ शचीव॒स्तव॑ न॒: शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sanā́t ǀ evá ǀ táva ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ gábhastau ǀ ná ǀ kṣī́yante ǀ ná ǀ úpa ǀ dasyanti ǀ dasma ǀdyu-mā́n ǀ asi ǀ krátu-mān ǀ indra ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ śíkṣa ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ táva ǀ naḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BeautifulIndra, the riches that have long since been held in yourhandshave suffered neither loss nor diminution. You, Indra, are illustrious, addicted to good works, and resolute; enrich us, you who are diligent in action, by your acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ना॒य॒ते गोत॑म इन्द्र॒ नव्य॒मत॑क्ष॒द्ब्रह्म॑ हरि॒योज॑नाय । सु॒नी॒थाय॑ नः शवसान नो॒धाः प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: sanā-yaté ǀ gótamaḥ ǀ indra ǀ návyam ǀ átakṣat ǀ bráhma ǀ hari-yójanāya ǀsu-nīthā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ śavasāna ǀ nodhā́ḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyIndra,Nodhas, the son ofGotama, has composed for us this new hymn, (addressed) to you, who have been forever, who harness your coursers (to your car) and are the sure guide (of all). May he who has acquired wealth by propitious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं म॒हाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ यो ह॒ शुष्मै॒र्द्यावा॑ जज्ञा॒नः पृ॑थि॒वी अमे॑ धाः । यद्ध॑ ते॒ विश्वा॑ गि॒रय॑श्चि॒दभ्वा॑ भि॒या दृ॒ळ्हास॑: कि॒रणा॒ नैज॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ mahā́n ǀ indra ǀ yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀ dyā́vā ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ áme ǀ dhāḥ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ábhvā ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ dṛḷhā́saḥ ǀ kiráṇāḥ ǀ ná ǀ áijan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, you are the mighty one, who, becoming manifest in (the hour of) alarm, did sustain by your energies heaven and earth; then, through fear of you, all creatures, and the mountains, and all other vast and solid things, trembled, like the (tremulous) rays of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्धरी॑ इन्द्र॒ विव्र॑ता॒ वेरा ते॒ वज्रं॑ जरि॒ता बा॒ह्वोर्धा॑त् । येना॑विहर्यतक्रतो अ॒मित्रा॒न्पुर॑ इ॒ष्णासि॑ पुरुहूत पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ hárī íti ǀ indra ǀ ví-vratā ǀ véḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ vájram ǀ jaritā́ ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ dhāt ǀyéna ǀ aviharyatakrato ítyaviharyata-krato ǀ amítrān ǀ púraḥ ǀ iṣṇā́si ǀ puru-hūta ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, you harness your variously moving horses, your praiser plural ces your thunderbolt in yourhands, wherewith, accom;oisher of undesired acts, you assail your enemies, and glorified by many, destroy their numerous cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं स॒त्य इ॑न्द्र धृ॒ष्णुरे॒तान्त्वमृ॑भु॒क्षा नर्य॒स्त्वं षाट् । त्वं शुष्णं॑ वृ॒जने॑ पृ॒क्ष आ॒णौ यूने॒ कुत्सा॑य द्यु॒मते॒ सचा॑हन्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ satyáḥ ǀ indra ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ etā́n ǀ tvám ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ṣā́ṭ ǀtvám ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ vṛjáne ǀ pṛkṣé ǀ āṇáu ǀ yū́ne ǀ kútsāya ǀ dyu-máte ǀ sácā ǀ ahan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, the best of all beings, the assailer and humiliator (of your foes), the chief ot theṚbhus, the friend of man, the subduer of enemies, did aid the young and illustriousKutsa, and slew Śuṣna, in the deadly and close-fought fight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह॒ त्यदि॑न्द्र चोदी॒: सखा॑ वृ॒त्रं यद्व॑ज्रिन्वृषकर्मन्नु॒भ्नाः । यद्ध॑ शूर वृषमणः परा॒चैर्वि दस्यूँ॒र्योना॒वकृ॑तो वृथा॒षाट्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ codīḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ yát ǀ vajrin ǀ vṛṣa-karman ǀ ubhnā́ḥ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ śūra ǀ vṛṣa-manaḥ ǀ parācáiḥ ǀ ví ǀ dásyūn ǀ yónau ǀ ákṛtaḥ ǀ vṛthāṣā́ṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You verily did animate him to (acquire) such (renown) as that which, sender of rain and wielder of the thunderbolt, you (dis-acquire) when you slewVṛtra, and when, munificent hero, who easily conquer (your foes) you did put to fight theDasyusin battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह॒ त्यदि॒न्द्रारि॑षण्यन्दृ॒ळ्हस्य॑ चि॒न्मर्ता॑ना॒मजु॑ष्टौ । व्य१॒॑स्मदा काष्ठा॒ अर्व॑ते वर्घ॒नेव॑ वज्रिञ्छ्नथिह्य॒मित्रा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ dṛḷhásya ǀ cit ǀ mártānām ǀ ájuṣṭau ǀví ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ kā́ṣṭhāḥ ǀ árvate ǀ vaḥ ǀ ghanā́-iva ǀ vajrin ǀ śnathihi ǀ amítrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, who are unwilling to harm any resolute (mortal), set open all the quarters (of the horizon) to the horses of us who praise you, (when we are exposed) to the aversion (of our enemies); and, wielder of the thunderbolt, demolish our foes, as with a club.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां ह॒ त्यदि॒न्द्रार्ण॑सातौ॒ स्व॑र्मीळ्हे॒ नर॑ आ॒जा ह॑वन्ते । तव॑ स्वधाव इ॒यमा स॑म॒र्य ऊ॒तिर्वाजे॑ष्वत॒साय्या॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ árṇa-sātau ǀ sváḥ-mīḷhe ǀ náraḥ ǀ ājā́ ǀ havante ǀtáva ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ ā́ ǀ sa-maryé ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ atasā́yyā ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men invoke you, such as you are, in the thick-throned and wealth-bestowing conflict. May this your succour, powerfulIndra, ever be granted in war, worthy to be enjoyed (by warriors) in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह॒ त्यदि॑न्द्र स॒प्त युध्य॒न्पुरो॑ वज्रिन्पुरु॒कुत्सा॑य दर्दः । ब॒र्हिर्न यत्सु॒दासे॒ वृथा॒ वर्गं॒हो रा॑ज॒न्वरि॑वः पू॒रवे॑ कः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ saptá ǀ yúdhyan ǀ púraḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ puru-kútsāya ǀ dardaríti dardaḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ ná ǀ yát ǀ su-dā́se ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ várk ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ rājan ǀ várivaḥ ǀ pūráve ǀ káḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, warring on behalf ofPurukutsa, you did overturn the seven cities; you did cut off forSudāsawealth of Aṅhas, as if (it had been a tuft) of sacred grass, and did give it to him, O king, ever satiating you (with oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं त्यां न॑ इन्द्र देव चि॒त्रामिष॒मापो॒ न पी॑पय॒: परि॑ज्मन् । यया॑ शूर॒ प्रत्य॒स्मभ्यं॒ यंसि॒ त्मन॒मूर्जं॒ न वि॒श्वध॒ क्षर॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ deva ǀ citrā́m ǀ íṣam ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīpayaḥ ǀ pári-jman ǀyáyā ǀ śūra ǀ práti ǀ asmábhyam ǀ yáṃsi ǀ tmánam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ ná ǀ viśvádha ǀ kṣáradhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Increase, divineIndra, for us throughout the earth, abundant food, (that it may be as plural ntiful) as water, by which, hero, you bestow upon us (existence), as you cause water to flow on every side.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अका॑रि त इन्द्र॒ गोत॑मेभि॒र्ब्रह्मा॒ण्योक्ता॒ नम॑सा॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । सु॒पेश॑सं॒ वाज॒मा भ॑रा नः प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: ákāri ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ gótamebhiḥ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ ā́-uktā ǀ námasā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀsu-péśasam ǀ vā́jam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ naḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praises have been offered to you,Indra, by the sons ofGotama; (they have been) uttered with reverence (to you), borne (hither) by your steeds; grant us various sorts of food. May he who has acquired wealthy by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष्णे॒ शर्धा॑य॒ सुम॑खाय वे॒धसे॒ नोध॑: सुवृ॒क्तिं प्र भ॑रा म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । अ॒पो न धीरो॒ मन॑सा सु॒हस्त्यो॒ गिर॒: सम॑ञ्जे वि॒दथे॑ष्वा॒भुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ śárdhāya ǀ sú-makhāya ǀ vedháse ǀ nódhaḥ ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ su-hástyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sám ǀ añje ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ ā-bhúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer,Nodhas, earnest praise to the company of theMaruts, the senders of rain and ripeners of fruit, deserving of adoration. Composed, and with foldedhands, I utter the praises conceived in my mind, which are efficacious in sacred rites, (and flow rreadily) as the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते ज॑ज्ञिरे दि॒व ऋ॒ष्वास॑ उ॒क्षणो॑ रु॒द्रस्य॒ मर्या॒ असु॑रा अरे॒पस॑: । पा॒व॒कास॒: शुच॑य॒: सूर्या॑ इव॒ सत्वा॑नो॒ न द्र॒प्सिनो॑ घो॒रव॑र्पसः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ jajñire ǀ diváḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́saḥ ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ máryāḥ ǀ ásurāḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǀpāvakā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ sū́ryāḥ-iva ǀ sátvānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ drapsínaḥ ǀ ghorá-varpasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They were born handsome and vigorous from the sky, the sons ofRudra, the conquerors of their foes, pure from sin, and purifying (all), radiant as suns, powerful as evil spirits, diffusers of rain-drops, and of fearful forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युवा॑नो रु॒द्रा अ॒जरा॑ अभो॒ग्घनो॑ वव॒क्षुरध्रि॑गाव॒: पर्व॑ता इव । दृ॒ळ्हा चि॒द्विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पार्थि॑वा॒ प्र च्या॑वयन्ति दि॒व्यानि॑ म॒ज्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: yúvānaḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ abhok-hánaḥ ǀ vavakṣúḥ ǀ ádhri-gāvaḥ ǀ párvatāḥ-iva ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ prá ǀ cyavayanti ǀ divyā́ni ǀ majmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouthfulRudras, and undecaying destructive of those who do not worship (the gods), of unobstructed progress, and immoveable as mountains they are desirous of granting (the wishes of the worshipper), and by their strength agitate all substances, whether of heaven or of earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रैर॒ञ्जिभि॒र्वपु॑षे॒ व्य॑ञ्जते॒ वक्ष॑स्सु रु॒क्माँ अधि॑ येतिरे शु॒भे । अंसे॑ष्वेषां॒ नि मि॑मृक्षुॠ॒ष्टय॑: सा॒कं ज॑ज्ञिरे स्व॒धया॑ दि॒वो नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: citráiḥ ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ vápuṣe ǀ ví ǀ añjate ǀ vákṣaḥ-su ǀ rukmā́n ǀ ádhi ǀ yetire ǀ śubhé ǀáṃseṣu ǀ eṣām ǀ ní ǀ mimṛkṣuḥ ǀ ṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ sākám ǀ jajñire ǀ svadháyā ǀ diváḥ ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They decorate their person ns with various ornaments; they have plural ced, for elegance, brilliant (garlands) on their breasts; lances are borne upon their shoulders, and with them and their own strength have they been both, leaders, from the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒शा॒न॒कृतो॒ धुन॑यो रि॒शाद॑सो॒ वाता॑न्वि॒द्युत॒स्तवि॑षीभिरक्रत । दु॒हन्त्यूध॑र्दि॒व्यानि॒ धूत॑यो॒ भूमिं॑ पिन्वन्ति॒ पय॑सा॒ परि॑ज्रयः
shlokas.transliteration: īśāna-kṛ́taḥ ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀ vā́tān ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ akrata ǀduhánti ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ dhū́tayaḥ ǀ bhū́mim ǀ pinvanti ǀ páyasā ǀ pári-jrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enriching their worshipper, agitating the clouds, devourers of foes, they create the winds are lightnings by their power; the cirumambient and agitatingMarutsmilk heavenly udders, and sprinkle the earth with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिन्व॑न्त्य॒पो म॒रुत॑: सु॒दान॑व॒: पयो॑ घृ॒तव॑द्वि॒दथे॑ष्वा॒भुव॑: । अत्यं॒ न मि॒हे वि न॑यन्ति वा॒जिन॒मुत्सं॑ दुहन्ति स्त॒नय॑न्त॒मक्षि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: pínvanti ǀ apáḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ ā-bhúvaḥ ǀátyam ǀ ná ǀ mihé ǀ ví ǀ nayanti ǀ vājínam ǀ útsam ǀ duhanti ǀ stanáyantam ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The munificentMarutsscatter the nutritious waters, as priests at sacrifices the clarified butter; as grooms lead forth a horse, they bring forth the rain from the fleeting-cloud, and milk it, thundering, and unexhausted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हि॒षासो॑ मा॒यिन॑श्चि॒त्रभा॑नवो गि॒रयो॒ न स्वत॑वसो रघु॒ष्यद॑: । मृ॒गा इ॑व ह॒स्तिन॑: खादथा॒ वना॒ यदारु॑णीषु॒ तवि॑षी॒रयु॑ग्ध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: mahiṣā́saḥ ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ citrá-bhānavaḥ ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ svá-tavasaḥ ǀ raghu-syádaḥ ǀmṛgā́ḥ-iva ǀ hastínaḥ ǀ khādatha ǀ vánā ǀ yát ǀ ā́ruṇīṣu ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ áyugdhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vast, possessed of knowledge, bright-shining, like mountains in stability and quick in motion, you, like elephants, break down the forests when you put vigour into your ruddy (mares).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिं॒हा इ॑व नानदति॒ प्रचे॑तसः पि॒शा इ॑व सु॒पिशो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दसः । क्षपो॒ जिन्व॑न्त॒: पृष॑तीभिॠ॒ष्टिभि॒: समित्स॒बाध॒: शव॒साहि॑मन्यवः
shlokas.transliteration: siṃhā́ḥ-iva ǀ nānadati ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ piśā́ḥ-iva ǀ su-píśaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀkṣápaḥ ǀ jínvantaḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatībhiḥ ǀ ṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ ít ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ áhi-manyavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most wiseMarutsroar like lions; the all-knowing are graceful as the spotted deer, destroyign (their foes), delighting (their worshippers); of deadly strength in their anger, they come with their antelopes and their arms, (to defend the sacrificer) against interruption.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रोद॑सी॒ आ व॑दता गणश्रियो॒ नृषा॑चः शूरा॒: शव॒साहि॑मन्यवः । आ व॒न्धुरे॑ष्व॒मति॒र्न द॑र्श॒ता वि॒द्युन्न त॑स्थौ मरुतो॒ रथे॑षु वः
shlokas.transliteration: ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ vadata ǀ gaṇa-śriyaḥ ǀ nṛ́-sācaḥ ǀ śūrāḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ áhi-manyavaḥ ǀā́ ǀ vandhúreṣu ǀ amátiḥ ǀ ná ǀ darśatā́ ǀ vi-dyút ǀ ná ǀ tasthau ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are distinguished in troops, who are benevolent to men, who are heroes, and whose strength is deadly in your anger, you make heaven and earth resound (at your coming); your (glory) sits in the seat-furnished chariots, conspicuous as (a beautiful) form, or as the lovely lightning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्ववे॑दसो र॒यिभि॒: समो॑कस॒: सम्मि॑श्लास॒स्तवि॑षीभिर्विर॒प्शिन॑: । अस्ता॑र॒ इष्॑म दधिरे॒ गभ॑स्त्योरन॒न्तशु॑ष्मा॒ वृष॑खादयो॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ rayí-bhiḥ ǀ sám-okasaḥ ǀ sám-miślāsaḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ vi-rapśínaḥ ǀástāraḥ ǀ íṣum ǀ dadhire ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ anantá-śuṣmāḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-khādayaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMaruts, who are all-knowing, co-dwellers with wealth, combined with strength, loud-sounding, repellers of foes, of infinite prowess, whose weapon (of offence) isIndra, and who are leaders (of men), hold in theirhandsthe shaft.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒र॒ण्यये॑भिः प॒विभि॑: पयो॒वृध॒ उज्जि॑घ्नन्त आप॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ न पर्व॑तान् । म॒खा अ॒यास॑: स्व॒सृतो॑ ध्रुव॒च्युतो॑ दुध्र॒कृतो॑ म॒रुतो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयः
shlokas.transliteration: hiraṇyáyebhiḥ ǀ paví-bhiḥ ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ út ǀ jighnante ǀ ā-pathyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatān ǀmakhā́ḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀ sva-sṛ́taḥ ǀ dhruva-cyútaḥ ǀ dudhra-kṛ́taḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ bhrā́jat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Augmenters of rain, they drive with golden wheels the clouds asunder, as elephants (in a herd break down the trees in their way); they are honoured with sacrifices, visitants of the hall of offering, spontaneous assailers (of their foes), subverters of what are stable, immoveable themselves, and wearers of shining weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृषुं॑ पाव॒कं व॒निनं॒ विच॑र्षणिं रु॒द्रस्य॑ सू॒नुं ह॒वसा॑ गृणीमसि । र॒ज॒स्तुरं॑ त॒वसं॒ मारु॑तं ग॒णमृ॑जी॒षिणं॒ वृष॑णं सश्चत श्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛ́ṣum ǀ pāvakám ǀ vanínam ǀ ví-carṣaṇim ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnúm ǀ havásā ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀrajaḥ-túram ǀ tavásam ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀ ṛjīṣíṇam ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ saścata ǀ śriyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke with praise the foe-destroying, all-purifying, water-shedding, all-surveying band ofMaruts, the offspring ofRudra; (priests) to obtain prosperity, have recourse to the dust-raising and powerful band of Maruts, receiving libations from sacred vessels, and showering down (benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नू स मर्त॒: शव॑सा॒ जनाँ॒ अति॑ त॒स्थौ व॑ ऊ॒ती म॑रुतो॒ यमाव॑त । अर्व॑द्भि॒र्वाजं॑ भरते॒ धना॒ नृभि॑रा॒पृच्छ्यं॒ क्रतु॒मा क्षे॑ति॒ पुष्य॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǀ tastháu ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ā́vata ǀárvat-bhiḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharate ǀ dhánā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ā-pṛ́cchyam ǀ krátum ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ púṣyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man whom,Maruts, you defend with your protection, quickly surpasses all men in strength; with his horses he acquires food, and with his men, riches; he performs the required worship, and he prospers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒र्कृत्यं॑ मरुतः पृ॒त्सु दु॒ष्टरं॑ द्यु॒मन्तं॒ शुष्मं॑ म॒घव॑त्सु धत्तन । ध॒न॒स्पृत॑मु॒क्थ्यं॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिं तो॒कं पु॑ष्येम॒ तन॑यं श॒तं हिमा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: carkṛ́tyam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dustáram ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhattana ǀdhana-spṛ́tam ǀ ukthyám ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǀ tokám ǀ puṣyema ǀ tánayam ǀ śatám ǀ hímāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, grant to your wealthy (worshippers a son), eminent for good works, invincible in battle, illustrious, the annihilator (of his adversaries), the seizer of wealth, the deserver of praise, and all-discerning; may we cherish such a son and such a grandson for a hundred winterṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्ठि॒रं म॑रुतो वी॒रव॑न्तमृती॒षाहं॑ र॒यिम॒स्मासु॑ धत्त । स॒ह॒स्रिणं॑ श॒तिनं॑ शूशु॒वांसं॑ प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ sthirám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ ṛti-sáham ǀ rayím ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhatta ǀsahasríṇam ǀ śatínam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Maruts, durable riches, attended by posterity, and mortifying to our enemies; (riches) recknoned by hundreds and thousands, and ever increasing; may they who have acquired wealth by pious acts, come hither quickly in the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒श्वा न ता॒युं गुहा॒ चत॑न्तं॒ नमो॑ युजा॒नं नमो॒ वह॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: paśvā́ ǀ ná ǀ tāyúm ǀ gúhā ǀ cátantam ǀ námaḥ ǀ yujānám ǀ námaḥ ǀ váhantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2] The firm and plural cid divinites followed you,Agni, by your footmarks, when hiding in the hollow (of the water), like a thief (who has stolen) an animal; you, claiming oblations, and bearing them to the gods; all the deities who are entitled to worship, sit down near to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जोषा॒ धीरा॑: प॒दैरनु॑ ग्म॒न्नुप॑ त्वा सीद॒न्विश्वे॒ यज॑त्राः
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ padáiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀ úpa ǀ tvā ǀ sīdan ǀ víśve ǀ yájatrāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ दे॒वा अनु॑ व्र॒ता गु॒र्भुव॒त्परि॑ष्टि॒र्द्यौर्न भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ ǀ guḥ ǀ bhúvat ǀ páriṣṭiḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] The gods followed the traces of the fugitive; the search spread everywhere, and earth became like heaven; the waters swelled (to conceal him), who was much enlarged by praise, and was manifested as it were in the womb in the waters, the source of sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वर्ध॑न्ती॒माप॑: प॒न्वा सुशि॑श्विमृ॒तस्य॒ योना॒ गर्भे॒ सुजा॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: várdhanti ǀ īm ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ panvā́ ǀ sú-śiśvim ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ gárbhe ǀ sú-jātam ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ष्टिर्न र॒ण्वा क्षि॒तिर्न पृ॒थ्वी गि॒रिर्न भुज्म॒ क्षोदो॒ न श॒म्भु
shlokas.transliteration: puṣṭíḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇvā́ ǀ kṣitíḥ ǀ ná ǀ pṛthvī́ ǀ giríḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhújma ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śam-bhú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6]Agniis grateful as nourishment, vast as the earth, productive (of vegetable food), as a mountain, delightful as water; he is like a horse urged to a charge in battle and like flowing waters; who can arrest him?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यो॒ नाज्म॒न्त्सर्ग॑प्रतक्त॒: सिन्धु॒र्न क्षोद॒: क ईं॑ वराते
shlokas.transliteration: átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ájman ǀ sárga-prataktaḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ īm ǀ varāte ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒मिः सिन्धू॑नां॒ भ्राते॑व॒ स्वस्रा॒मिभ्या॒न्न राजा॒ वना॑न्यत्ति
shlokas.transliteration: jāmíḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ bhrā́tā-iva ǀ svásrām ǀ íbhyān ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀ vánāni ǀ atti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] He is the kind kinsman of the waters, like a brother to his sister; he consumes the forest as arājā(destroys) his enemies; when excited by the wind, he traverses the woods, and shears the hairs of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वात॑जूतो॒ वना॒ व्यस्था॑द॒ग्निर्ह॑ दाति॒ रोमा॑ पृथि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā́ta-jūtaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ ví ǀ ásthāt ǀ agníḥ ǀ ha ǀ dāti ǀ róma ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: श्वसि॑त्य॒प्सु हं॒सो न सीद॒न्क्रत्वा॒ चेति॑ष्ठो वि॒शामु॑ष॒र्भुत्
shlokas.transliteration: śvásiti ǀ ap-sú ǀ haṃsáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sī́dan ǀ krátvā ǀ cétiṣṭhaḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ uṣaḥ-bhút ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10] He breathes amidst the waters like a sitting swan; awakened at the dawn, he restores by his operations consciousness to men; he is a creator, likeSoma; born from the waters (where he lurked) like an animal with coiled-up limbs, he became enlarged and his light (spread) afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॒ न वे॒धा ऋ॒तप्र॑जातः प॒शुर्न शिश्वा॑ वि॒भुर्दू॒रेभा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-prajātaḥ ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ śíśvā ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ dūré-bhāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒यिर्न चि॒त्रा सूरो॒ न सं॒दृगायु॒र्न प्रा॒णो नित्यो॒ न सू॒नुः
shlokas.transliteration: rayíḥ ǀ ná ǀ citrā́ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ sam-dṛ́k ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ná ǀ prāṇáḥ ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sūnúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2]Agniwho is like wondrous wealth, like the all-surveying Sun, like vital breath, like a well-conducted son, like a rider-bearing steed, like a milk-yielding cow, who is pure and radiant, consumes the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तक्वा॒ न भूर्णि॒र्वना॑ सिषक्ति॒ पयो॒ न धे॒नुः शुचि॑र्वि॒भावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tákvā ǀ ná ǀ bhū́rṇiḥ ǀ vánā ǀ sisakti ǀ páyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒धार॒ क्षेम॒मोको॒ न र॒ण्वो यवो॒ न प॒क्वो जेता॒ जना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: dādhā́ra ǀ kṣémam ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ yávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pakváḥ ǀ jétā ǀ jánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] Like a secure mansion, he proects property; he (nourishes people) like barley; he is the conqueror of (hostile)) men; he is like a ṛṣi, the praiser (of the gods), eminent amongst (devout) person ns; as a spirited horse (goes to battle), he repairs delighted to the hall of sacrifice; may be bestow upon us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषि॒र्न स्तुभ्वा॑ वि॒क्षु प्र॑श॒स्तो वा॒जी न प्री॒तो वयो॑ दधाति
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ ná ǀ stúbhvā ǀ vikṣú ǀ pra-śastáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ ná ǀ prītáḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhāti ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒रोक॑शोचि॒: क्रतु॒र्न नित्यो॑ जा॒येव॒ योना॒वरं॒ विश्व॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: duróka-śociḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ ná ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ jāyā́-iva ǀ yónau ǀ áram ǀ víśvasmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6]Agniof unattainable brightness, is like a vigilant sacrificer; he is an ornament to all (in the sacrificial chamber), like a woman in a dwelling; when he shines with wonderful lustre, he is like the white (sun) or like a golden chariot amongst men, resplendent in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रो यदभ्रा॑ट् छ्वे॒तो न वि॒क्षु रथो॒ न रु॒क्मी त्वे॒षः स॒मत्सु॑
shlokas.transliteration: citráḥ ǀ yát ǀ ábhrāṭ ǀ śvetáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vikṣú ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rukmī́ ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ samát-su ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: सेने॑व सृ॒ष्टामं॑ दधा॒त्यस्तु॒र्न दि॒द्युत्त्वे॒षप्र॑तीका
shlokas.transliteration: sénā-iva ǀ sṛṣṭā́ ǀ ámam ǀ dadhāti ǀ ástuḥ ǀ ná ǀ didyút ǀ tveṣá-pratīkā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] He terrifies (his adversaries) like an army sent (against an enemy), or like the bright-pointed shaft of an archer.Agni, asYama, is all that is born; as Yama, all that will be born; he is the lover of maidens, the husband of wives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒मो ह॑ जा॒तो य॒मो जनि॑त्वं जा॒रः क॒नीनां॒ पति॒र्जनी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yamáḥ ǀ ha ǀ jātáḥ ǀ yamáḥ ǀ jáni-tvam ǀ jāráḥ ǀ kanī́nām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ jánīnām ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॑श्च॒राथा॑ व॒यं व॑स॒त्यास्तं॒ न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्त इ॒द्धम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ carā́thā ǀ vayám ǀ vasatyā́ ǀ ástam ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ nákṣante ǀ iddhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10] Let us approach that blazingAgniwith animal and vegetable offerings, as cows hasten to their stalls. He has tossed about his flames (in every direction), like running streams of water; the rays comingle (with the radiance) visible in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धु॒र्न क्षोद॒: प्र नीची॑रैनो॒न्नव॑न्त॒ गाव॒: स्व१॒॑र्दृशी॑के
shlokas.transliteration: síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ ainot ǀ návanta ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛ́śīke ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: वने॑षु जा॒युर्मर्ते॑षु मि॒त्रो वृ॑णी॒ते श्रु॒ष्टिं राजे॑वाजु॒र्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: váneṣu ǀ jāyúḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ mitráḥ ǀ vṛṇīté ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ ajuryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2] Born in the woods, the friend of man,Agniprotects his worshipper, as arājāfavours an able man; kind as a defender, prosperous as a performer of (good) works, may he, the invoker of the gods, the bearer of oblations, be propitious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेमो॒ न सा॒धुः क्रतु॒र्न भ॒द्रो भुव॑त्स्वा॒धीर्होता॑ हव्य॒वाट्
shlokas.transliteration: kṣémaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhadráḥ ǀ bhúvat ǀ su-ādhī́ḥ ǀ hótā ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: हस्ते॒ दधा॑नो नृ॒म्णा विश्वा॒न्यमे॑ दे॒वान्धा॒द्गुहा॑ नि॒षीद॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: háste ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ áme ǀ devā́n ǀ dhāt ǀ gúhā ǀ ni-sī́dan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] Holding in hishandall (sacrificial) wealth, and hiding in the hollows (of the waters), he filled the gods with alarm; the leaders, (the gods), the upholders of acts, then recognizeAgniwhen they have recited the prayers conceived in the heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दन्ती॒मत्र॒ नरो॑ धियं॒धा हृ॒दा यत्त॒ष्टान्मन्त्राँ॒ अशं॑सन्
shlokas.transliteration: vidánti ǀ īm ǀ átra ǀ náraḥ ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ yát ǀ taṣṭā́n ǀ mántrān ǀ áśaṃsan ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जो न क्षां दा॒धार॑ पृथि॒वीं त॒स्तम्भ॒ द्यां मन्त्रे॑भिः स॒त्यैः
shlokas.transliteration: ajáḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣā́m ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ tastámbha ǀ dyā́m ǀ mántrebhiḥ ǀ satyáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6] Like the unborn (sun) he sustains the earth and the firmament, and props up the heaven with true prayers;Agni, in whom is all sustenance, cherish the plural ces that are grateful to animals; repair (to the spots) where there is no pasturage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒या प॒दानि॑ प॒श्वो नि पा॑हि वि॒श्वायु॑रग्ने गु॒हा गुहं॑ गाः
shlokas.transliteration: priyā́ ǀ padā́ni ǀ paśváḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ agne ǀ guhā́ ǀ gúham ǀ gāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: य ईं॑ चि॒केत॒ गुहा॒ भव॑न्त॒मा यः स॒साद॒ धारा॑मृ॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ cikéta ǀ gúhā ǀ bhávantam ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ sasā́da ǀ dhā́rām ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] He who knowsAgnihidden in the hollows; he who approaches him as the maintainer of truth; those who, performing worship, repeat his praises, to them assuredly he promises affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ये चृ॒तन्त्यृ॒ता सप॑न्त॒ आदिद्वसू॑नि॒ प्र व॑वाचास्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yé ǀ cṛtánti ǀ ṛtā́ ǀ sápantaḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ vásūni ǀ prá ǀ vavāca ǀ asmai ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यो वी॒रुत्सु॒ रोध॑न्महि॒त्वोत प्र॒जा उ॒त प्र॒सूष्व॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ vīrút-su ǀ ródhat ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ utá ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ pra-sū́ṣu ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10] The wise, (first) honouringAgni, as they do a dwelling, worship him who implants their (peculiar) virtues in herbs, as progeny in their parents, and who, the source of knowledge and of all sustenance, (abides) in the domicile of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चित्ति॑र॒पां दमे॑ वि॒श्वायु॒: सद्मे॑व॒ धीरा॑: स॒म्माय॑ चक्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: cíttiḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ dáme ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ sádma-iva ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ sam-mā́ya ǀ cakruḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: श्री॒णन्नुप॑ स्था॒द्दिवं॑ भुर॒ण्युः स्था॒तुश्च॒रथ॑म॒क्तून्व्यू॑र्णोत्
shlokas.transliteration: śrīṇán ǀ úpa ǀ sthāt ǀ dívam ǀ bhuraṇyúḥ ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ carátham ǀ aktū́n ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇot ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2] The bearer (of the oblations),Agni, mixing them (with other ingredients), ascends to heaven, and clothes all things, moveable and immoveable, and the nights themselves, (with light), radiant amongst the gods, and in himself alone comprehending the virtues of all these (substances).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यदे॑षा॒मेको॒ विश्वे॑षां॒ भुव॑द्दे॒वो दे॒वानां॑ महि॒त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yát ǀ eṣām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ bhúvat ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: आदित्ते॒ विश्वे॒ क्रतुं॑ जुषन्त॒ शुष्का॒द्यद्दे॑व जी॒वो जनि॑ष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ víśve ǀ krátum ǀ juṣanta ǀ śúṣkāt ǀ yát ǀ deva ǀ jīváḥ ǀ jániṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] When, divineAgni, you are born living from the dry wood, (by attrition), then all (your worshippers) perform the sacred ceremony, and obtain verily true divinity by praising you, who are immortal, with hymns that reach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भज॑न्त॒ विश्वे॑ देव॒त्वं नाम॑ ऋ॒तं सप॑न्तो अ॒मृत॒मेवै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhájanta ǀ víśve ǀ deva-tvám ǀ nā́ma ǀ ṛtám ǀ sápantaḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ évaiḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॒ प्रेषा॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिर्वि॒श्वायु॒र्विश्वे॒ अपां॑सि चक्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ préṣāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ cakruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6] Praises are addressed to him who has repaired (to the solemnity); oblations (are offered) to him who has gone (to the sacrifice); in him is all sustenance, (and to him) have all (devout person ns) performed (the customary) rites. Do you,Agni, knowing (the thoughts of the worshipper), grant riches to him who presents to you oblations, or who wishes (to be able to present them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्तुभ्यं॒ दाशा॒द्यो वा॑ ते॒ शिक्षा॒त्तस्मै॑ चिकि॒त्वान्र॒यिं द॑यस्व
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ dā́śāt ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ te ǀ śíkṣāt ǀ tásmai ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ rayím ǀ dayasva ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॒ निष॑त्तो॒ मनो॒रप॑त्ये॒ स चि॒न्न्वा॑सां॒ पती॑ रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: hótā ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ mánoḥ ǀ ápatye ǀ sáḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ āsām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] You have abided with the descendants ofManuas the invoker (of the gods); you are indeed the lord of their possessions; they have desired (of you) procreative vigour in their bodies, and, associated with their own excellent offspring, they contemplate (all things) undisturbed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒च्छन्त॒ रेतो॑ मि॒थस्त॒नूषु॒ सं जा॑नत॒ स्वैर्दक्षै॒रमू॑राः
shlokas.transliteration: icchánta ǀ rétaḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ sám ǀ jānata ǀ sváiḥ ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुर्न पु॒त्राः क्रतुं॑ जुषन्त॒ श्रोष॒न्ये अ॑स्य॒ शासं॑ तु॒रास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ krátum ǀ juṣanta ǀ śróṣan ǀ yé ǀ asya ǀ śā́sam ǀ turā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10] Hastening to obey the commands ofAgni, like sons (obedient of the orders) of a father, they celebrate his worship; abounding in food, Agni sets open before them treasures that are the doorf of sacrifice; and he who delights in the sacrificial chamber has studded the sky with constellations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि राय॑ और्णो॒द्दुर॑: पुरु॒क्षुः पि॒पेश॒ नाकं॒ स्तृभि॒र्दमू॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aurṇot ǀ dúraḥ ǀ puru-kṣúḥ ǀ pipéśa ǀ nā́kam ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒क्रः शु॑शु॒क्वाँ उ॒षो न जा॒रः प॒प्रा स॑मी॒ची दि॒वो न ज्योति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śukráḥ ǀ śuśukvā́n ǀ uṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ jāráḥ ǀ paprā́ ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ jyótiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2] White-shining (Agni), like the (sun), the extinguisher of the dawn, is the illuminator (of all) and fills united (heaven and earth with light), like the lustre of the radiant (sun). You, as soon as manifested, have pervaded all the world with devout acts, being (both) the father and son of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ प्रजा॑त॒: क्रत्वा॑ बभूथ॒ भुवो॑ दे॒वानां॑ पि॒ता पु॒त्रः सन्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ prá-jātaḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ babhūtha ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ pitā́ ǀ putráḥ ǀ sán ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: वे॒धा अदृ॑प्तो अ॒ग्निर्वि॑जा॒नन्नूध॒र्न गोनां॒ स्वाद्मा॑ पितू॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vedhā́ḥ ǀ ádṛptaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vi-jānán ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ gónām ǀ svā́dma ǀ pitūnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] The wise, the humble, and discrimatingAgni, is the giver of flavour to food, as the udder of cows (gives sweetness to the milk); invited (to the ceremony), he sits in the sacrificial chamber, diffusing happiness like a benevolent man, amongst mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जने॒ न शेव॑ आ॒हूर्य॒: सन्मध्ये॒ निष॑त्तो र॒ण्वो दु॑रो॒णे
shlokas.transliteration: jáne ǀ ná ǀ śéva ǀ ā-hū́ryaḥ ǀ sán ǀ mádhye ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ duroṇé ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒त्रो न जा॒तो र॒ण्वो दु॑रो॒णे वा॒जी न प्री॒तो विशो॒ वि ता॑रीत्
shlokas.transliteration: putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ jātáḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ vājī́ ǀ ná ǀ prītáḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tārīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6] He diffuses happiness in a dwelling like a son(newly) born; he overcomes (opposing) men like an animated charger; whatever (divine) beings I may along with other men invoke (to the ceremony), you,Agni, assume all (their) celestial nature.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विशो॒ यदह्वे॒ नृभि॒: सनी॑ळा अ॒ग्निर्दे॑व॒त्वा विश्वा॑न्यश्याः
shlokas.transliteration: víśaḥ ǀ yát ǀ áhve ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ deva-tvā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aśyāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑ष्ट ए॒ता व्र॒ता मि॑नन्ति॒ नृभ्यो॒ यदे॒भ्यः श्रु॒ष्टिं च॒कर्थ॑
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ te ǀ etā́ ǀ vratā́ ǀ minanti ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ebhyáḥ ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ cakártha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] Never may (malignant spirits) interrupt those rites in which you have given the (hope of) reward to the person ns (who celebrate them) for should (such spirits) disturb your worship, then, assisted by followers like yourself, you put the intruders to flight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्तु ते॒ दंसो॒ यदह॑न्त्समा॒नैर्नृभि॒र्यद्यु॒क्तो वि॒वे रपां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ tú ǀ te ǀ dáṃsaḥ ǀ yát ǀ áhan ǀ samānáiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ yuktáḥ ǀ vivéḥ ǀ rápāṃsi ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒षो न जा॒रो वि॒भावो॒स्रः संज्ञा॑तरूप॒श्चिके॑तदस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: uṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ jāráḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ usráḥ ǀ sáṃjñāta-rūpaḥ ǀ cíketat ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10] MayAgni, who is possessed of manifold light, like the extinguisher of the dawn, the granter of dwellings, and of cognizable form, consider (the desires of) this, (his worshipper); (his rays), spontaneously bearing the oblation, open the doors (of the sacrificial chamber), and all spread through the visible heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्मना॒ वह॑न्तो॒ दुरो॒ व्यृ॑ण्व॒न्नव॑न्त॒ विश्वे॒ स्व१॒॑र्दृशी॑के
shlokas.transliteration: tmánā ǀ váhantaḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ ví ǀ ṛṇvan ǀ návanta ǀ víśve ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛ́śīke ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒नेम॑ पू॒र्वीर॒र्यो म॑नी॒षा अ॒ग्निः सु॒शोको॒ विश्वा॑न्यश्याः
shlokas.transliteration: vanéma ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-śókaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aśyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2] We solicit abundant (food)Agni, who is to be approached by meditation, and shines with pure light, pervades all holy rites, knowing well the acts that are to be addressed to the deities, and (those) which regulate) the birth of the human race.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दैव्या॑नि व्र॒ता चि॑कि॒त्वाना मानु॑षस्य॒ जन॑स्य॒ जन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ vratā́ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ mā́nuṣasya ǀ jánasya ǀ jánma ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: गर्भो॒ यो अ॒पां गर्भो॒ वना॑नां॒ गर्भ॑श्च स्था॒तां गर्भ॑श्च॒रथा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gárbhaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ vánānām ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sthātā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ caráthām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] (They offer oblations) on the mountain, or in the mansion, to thatAgni, who is within the waters within woods, and  within all moveable and immoveable things, immortal and performing pious acts, like a benevolent (prince) among his people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रौ॑ चिदस्मा अ॒न्तर्दु॑रो॒णे वि॒शां न विश्वो॑ अ॒मृत॑: स्वा॒धीः
shlokas.transliteration: ádrau ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ antáḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ viśā́m ǀ ná ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ su-ādhī́ḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि क्ष॒पावाँ॑ अ॒ग्नी र॑यी॒णां दाश॒द्यो अ॑स्मा॒ अर॑ सू॒क्तैः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣapā́-vān ǀ agníḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ dā́śat ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ áram ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[5-6]Agni, the lord of night, grants riches to the worshipper who adores him with sacred hymns. Agni, who are omniscient, and  know the origin of gods and men, protect all these (beings dwelling) upon earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता चि॑कित्वो॒ भूमा॒ नि पा॑हि दे॒वानां॒ जन्म॒ मर्ताँ॑श्च वि॒द्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ bhū́ma ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánma ǀ mártān ǀ ca ǀ vidvā́n ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: वर्धा॒न्यं पू॒र्वीः क्ष॒पो विरू॑पाः स्था॒तुश्च॒ रथ॑मृ॒तप्र॑वीतम्
shlokas.transliteration: várdhān ǀ yám ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ kṣapáḥ ǀ ví-rūpāḥ ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ ca ǀ rátham ǀ ṛtá-pravītam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8]Agni, whom many variously-tinted (mornings) and nights increase, whom, invested with truth, all moveable and immoveable things augment, has been propitiated, and is kindly seated at the holy rite, as the invoker (of the gods), and rendering all (pious) acts (productive) of reward.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरा॑धि॒ होता॒ स्व१॒॑र्निष॑त्तः कृ॒ण्वन्विश्वा॒न्यपां॑सि स॒त्या
shlokas.transliteration: árādhi ǀ hótā ǀ sváḥ ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ kṛṇván ǀ víśvāni ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ satyā́ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: गोषु॒ प्रश॑स्तिं॒ वने॑षु धिषे॒ भर॑न्त॒ विश्वे॑ ब॒लिं स्व॑र्णः
shlokas.transliteration: góṣu ǀ prá-śastim ǀ váneṣu ǀ dhiṣe ǀ bháranta ǀ víśve ǀ balím ǀ sváḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[9-10]Agni, confer excellence upon our valued cattle, and may all men bring us acceptable tribute; offering in many laces sacrifices to you, men receive riches from you, as (sons) from an aged father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि त्वा॒ नर॑: पुरु॒त्रा स॑पर्यन्पि॒तुर्न जिव्रे॒र्वि वेदो॑ भरन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tvā ǀ náraḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ saparyan ǀ pitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ jívreḥ ǀ ví ǀ védaḥ ǀ bharanta ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒धुर्न गृ॒ध्नुरस्ते॑व॒ शूरो॒ याते॑व भी॒मस्त्वे॒षः स॒मत्सु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sādhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ gṛdhnúḥ ǀ ástā-iva ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ yā́tā-iva ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ samát-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(MayAgni), who is like one who succeeds (in his undertakings), and acquires (what he wishes for), who is like a warrior casting a dart, and resembles a fearful adversary, who is brilliant in combats, (be to us a friend).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ प्र जि॑न्वन्नुश॒तीरु॒शन्तं॒ पतिं॒ न नित्यं॒ जन॑य॒: सनी॑ळाः । स्वसा॑र॒: श्यावी॒मरु॑षीमजुष्रञ्चि॒त्रमु॒च्छन्ती॑मु॒षसं॒ न गाव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ prá ǀ jinvan ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ uśántam ǀ pátim ǀ ná ǀ nítyam ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ śyā́vīm ǀ áruṣīm ǀ ajuṣran ǀ citrám ǀ ucchántīm ǀ uṣásam ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The contiguous fingers, loving the affectionateAgni, as wives love their own husbands, plural ase him (with offered oblations), and honour him, who is entitled to honour, (with gesticulations), as the rays of light (are assiduous in the service) of the dawn, which is (at first) dark, (then) glimmering, and (finally) radiant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ळु चि॑द्दृ॒ळ्हा पि॒तरो॑ न उ॒क्थैरद्रिं॑ रुज॒न्नङ्गि॑रसो॒ रवे॑ण । च॒क्रुर्दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तो गा॒तुम॒स्मे अह॒: स्व॑र्विविदुः के॒तुमु॒स्राः
shlokas.transliteration: vīḷú ǀ cit ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ rujan ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ ráveṇa ǀcakrúḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ asmé íti ǀ áharíti ǀ sváḥ ǀ vividuḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ usrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our forefathers, theAṅgirasas, by their praises (ofAgni), terrified the strong and daring devourer, (Paṇi), by the sound; they made for us a path to the vast heaven, and obtained accessible day, the ensign of day, (Āditya) and the cows (that had been stolen).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दध॑न्नृ॒तं ध॒नय॑न्नस्य धी॒तिमादिद॒र्यो दि॑धि॒ष्वो॒३॒॑ विभृ॑त्राः । अतृ॑ष्यन्तीर॒पसो॑ य॒न्त्यच्छा॑ दे॒वाञ्जन्म॒ प्रय॑सा व॒र्धय॑न्तीः
shlokas.transliteration: dádhan ǀ ṛtám ǀ dhanáyan ǀ asya ǀ dhītím ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ aryáḥ ǀ didhiṣváḥ ǀ ví-bhṛtrāḥ ǀátṛṣyantīḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ áccha ǀ devā́n ǀ jánma ǀ práyasā ǀ vardháyantīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They secured hi, (Agni, in the sacrificial chamber), they made his worship the source of wealth; whence opulent votaries preserve his fires and practise his rites. Free from all (other) desire, assiduous in his adoration, and sustaining gods and men by their offerings, they come into his presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मथी॒द्यदीं॒ विभृ॑तो मात॒रिश्वा॑ गृ॒हेगृ॑हे श्ये॒तो जेन्यो॒ भूत् । आदीं॒ राज्ञे॒ न सही॑यसे॒ सचा॒ सन्ना दू॒त्यं१॒॑ भृग॑वाणो विवाय
shlokas.transliteration: máthīt ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ ví-bhṛtaḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ gṛhé-gṛhe ǀ śyetáḥ ǀ jényaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀā́t ǀ īm ǀ rā́jñe ǀ ná ǀ sáhīyase ǀ sácā ǀ sán ǀ ā́ ǀ dūtyám ǀ bhṛ́gavāṇaḥ ǀ vivāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the diffusive vital air excitesAgni, he becomes bright and manifest in every mansion, and the instrumental tutor of the rite, imitatingBhṛgu, prevails on him to perform the function of messenger, as a prince who has become a friend sends an ambassador to his more powerful (conqueror).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हे यत्पि॒त्र ईं॒ रसं॑ दि॒वे करव॑ त्सरत्पृश॒न्य॑श्चिकि॒त्वान् । सृ॒जदस्ता॑ धृष॒ता दि॒द्युम॑स्मै॒ स्वायां॑ दे॒वो दु॑हि॒तरि॒ त्विषिं॑ धात्
shlokas.transliteration: mahé ǀ yát ǀ pitré ǀ īm ǀ rásam ǀ divé ǀ káḥ ǀ áva ǀ tsarat ǀ pṛśanyáḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀsṛját ǀ ástā ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ didyúm ǀ asmai ǀ svā́yām ǀ deváḥ ǀ duhitári ǀ tvíṣim ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (the worshipper) offers an oblation to his great and illustrious protector, the grasping (rākṣas), recognizing you,Agni, retires; but Agni, the archer, sends after him a blazing arrow from his dreadful bow, and the god bestows light upon his own daughter (the dawn).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व आ यस्तुभ्यं॒ दम॒ आ वि॒भाति॒ नमो॑ वा॒ दाशा॑दुश॒तो अनु॒ द्यून् । वर्धो॑ अग्ने॒ वयो॑ अस्य द्वि॒बर्हा॒ यास॑द्रा॒या स॒रथं॒ यं जु॒नासि॑
shlokas.transliteration: své ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ námaḥ ǀ vā ǀ dā́śāt ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀvárdho íti ǀ agne ǀ váyaḥ ǀ asya ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ yā́sat ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yám ǀ junā́si ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (the worshipper) kindles you in his own dwelling, and presents an oblation to you, daily desiring it, do you,Agni, augmented in two ways, (as middling and as best), increase his means of sustenance; may he whom you sen dwith his car to battle, return with wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं विश्वा॑ अ॒भि पृक्ष॑: सचन्ते समु॒द्रं न स्र॒वत॑: स॒प्त य॒ह्वीः । न जा॒मिभि॒र्वि चि॑किते॒ वयो॑ नो वि॒दा दे॒वेषु॒ प्रम॑तिं चिकि॒त्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ samudrám ǀ ná ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀná ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ cikite ǀ váyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ prá-matim ǀ cikitvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All (sacrificial) viands concentrate inAgni, as the seven great rivers flwo into the ocean; our food is not partaken of by our kinsmen, therefore do you, who know (all things), make our desires known to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यदि॒षे नृ॒पतिं॒ तेज॒ आन॒ट् छुचि॒ रेतो॒ निषि॑क्तं॒ द्यौर॒भीके॑ । अ॒ग्निः शर्ध॑मनव॒द्यं युवा॑नं स्वा॒ध्यं॑ जनयत्सू॒दय॑च्च
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ iṣé ǀ nṛ-pátim ǀ téjaḥ ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ śúci ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ní-siktam ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ abhī́ke ǀagníḥ ǀ śárdham ǀ anavadyám ǀ yúvānam ǀ su-ādhyám ǀ janayat ǀ sūdáyat ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that (digestive) faculty (ofAgni) with regards food, be imparted to the devout and illustrious protector of priests, as the source of virile vigour; and may Agni be born as (his) robust, irreproachable, youthful and intelligent son, and instrumental gate him (to acts of worship).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मनो॒ न योऽध्व॑नः स॒द्य एत्येक॑: स॒त्रा सूरो॒ वस्व॑ ईशे । राजा॑ना मि॒त्रावरु॑णा सुपा॒णी गोषु॑ प्रि॒यम॒मृतं॒ रक्ष॑माणा
shlokas.transliteration: mánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ éti ǀ ékaḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ īśe ǀrā́jānā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ supāṇī́ íti su-pāṇī́ ǀ góṣu ǀ priyám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ rákṣamāṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun, who traverses alone the path of heaven with the speed of thought, is at once lord of all treasures; the two kings,MitraandVaruṇa, with bounteoushands, are the guardians of the precious ambrosia of our cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अग्ने स॒ख्या पित्र्या॑णि॒ प्र म॑र्षिष्ठा अ॒भि वि॒दुष्क॒विः सन् । नभो॒ न रू॒पं ज॑रि॒मा मि॑नाति पु॒रा तस्या॑ अ॒भिश॑स्ते॒रधी॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ prá ǀ marṣiṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vidúḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sán ǀnábhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rūpám ǀ jarimā́ ǀ mināti ǀ purā́ ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dissolve not,Agni, our ancestral friendship, for you are cognizant of the past as well as of the present; in like manner as light (speeds over) the sky, so decay impairs (my body); think of me before that source of destruction (prevails).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि काव्या॑ वे॒धस॒: शश्व॑तस्क॒र्हस्ते॒ दधा॑नो॒ नर्या॑ पु॒रूणि॑ । अ॒ग्निर्भु॑वद्रयि॒पती॑ रयी॒णां स॒त्रा च॑क्रा॒णो अ॒मृता॑नि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ kā́vyā ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ kaḥ ǀ háste ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀagníḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ satrā́ ǀ cakrāṇáḥ ǀ amṛ́tāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, holding in hishandsmany good things for men, appropriates the prayers addressed to the eternal creator. Agni is the lord of riches, quickly bestowing (on those who praise him) all golden (gifts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे व॒त्सं परि॒ षन्तं॒ न वि॑न्दन्नि॒च्छन्तो॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॒ अमू॑राः । श्र॒म॒युव॑: पद॒व्यो॑ धियं॒धास्त॒स्थुः प॒दे प॑र॒मे चार्व॒ग्नेः
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ vatsám ǀ pári ǀ sántam ǀ ná ǀ vindan ǀ icchántaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǀśrama-yúvaḥ ǀ pada-vyáḥ ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ cā́ru ǀ agnéḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the immortals, and the unbewildered (Maruts), wishing for him who was (dear) to us as a son, and was everywhere around, discovered him not; oppressed with fatigue, wandering on foot, and cognizant of his acts, they stopped at the last beautiful (hiding) plural ce ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो यद॑ग्ने श॒रद॒स्त्वामिच्छुचिं॑ घृ॒तेन॒ शुच॑यः सप॒र्यान् । नामा॑नि चिद्दधिरे य॒ज्ञिया॒न्यसू॑दयन्त त॒न्व१॒॑: सुजा॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ śúcim ǀ ghṛténa ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ saparyā́n ǀnā́māni ǀ cit ǀ dadhire ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ ásūdayanta ǀ tanváḥ ǀ sú-jātāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Agni, as the pure (Maruts) worshipped you, (equally) pure, with clarified butter for three years, therefore they acquired names worthy (to be treated) at sacrifice, and, being regenerated obtained celestial bodies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रोद॑सी बृह॒ती वेवि॑दाना॒: प्र रु॒द्रिया॑ जभ्रिरे य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । वि॒दन्मर्तो॑ ने॒मधि॑ता चिकि॒त्वान॒ग्निं प॒दे प॑र॒मे त॑स्थि॒वांस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ vévidānāḥ ǀ prá ǀ rudríyā ǀ jabhrire ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀvidát ǀ mártaḥ ǀ nemá-dhitā ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ agním ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who are to be worshipped, (the gods), inquiring between the expansive heaven and earth (forAgni), recited (hymns) dedicated toRudra; the troop of mortal (Maruts), with (Indra), the shrer of half the oblation, knowing where Agni was hiding found him in his excellent retreat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं॒जा॒ना॒ना उप॑ सीदन्नभि॒ज्ञु पत्नी॑वन्तो नम॒स्यं॑ नमस्यन् । रि॒रि॒क्वांस॑स्त॒न्व॑: कृण्वत॒ स्वाः सखा॒ सख्यु॑र्नि॒मिषि॒ रक्ष॑माणाः
shlokas.transliteration: sam-jānānā́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sīdan ǀ abhi-jñú ǀ pátnī-vantaḥ ǀ namasyám ǀ namasyanníti namasyan ǀririkvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ kṛṇvata ǀ svā́ḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ ni-míṣi ǀ rákṣamāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods, discovering you, sat down, and with their wives paid reverntial adoration to you upon their knees. Secure on beholding their friend, of being protected, your friends, the gods, abandoned the rest of their bodies in sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिः स॒प्त यद्गुह्या॑नि॒ त्वे इत्प॒दावि॑द॒न्निहि॑ता य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । तेभी॑ रक्षन्ते अ॒मृतं॑ स॒जोषा॑: प॒शूञ्च॑ स्था॒तॄञ्च॒रथं॑ च पाहि
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ yát ǀ gúhyāni ǀ tvé íti ǀ ít ǀ padā́ ǀ avidan ǀ ní-hitā ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ rakṣante ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ paśū́n ǀ ca ǀ sthātṝ́n ǀ carátham ǀ ca ǀ pāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Devout men), competent to offer sacrifices, have known the thrice seven mystic rites comprised in you, and with them, worshipped you; do you, therefore, with like affection, protect their cattle, and all that (belongs to them), moveable or stationary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्वाँ अ॑ग्ने व॒युना॑नि क्षिती॒नां व्या॑नु॒षक्छु॒रुधो॑ जी॒वसे॑ धाः । अ॒न्त॒र्वि॒द्वाँ अध्व॑नो देव॒याना॒नत॑न्द्रो दू॒तो अ॑भवो हवि॒र्वाट्
shlokas.transliteration: vidvā́n ǀ agne ǀ vayúnāni ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ví ǀ ānuṣák ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ dhāḥ ǀantaḥ-vidvā́n ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ deva-yā́nān ǀ átandraḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ haviḥ-vā́ṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are cognizant of all things to be known, ever provide for the subsistence of men, grief-alleviating (food); so shall you be the diligent bearer of oblations, and messenger of the gods, knowing the paths between (earth and heaven), by which they travel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒ध्यो॑ दि॒व आ स॒प्त य॒ह्वी रा॒यो दुरो॒ व्यृ॑त॒ज्ञा अ॑जानन् । वि॒दद्गव्यं॑ स॒रमा॑ दृ॒ळ्हमू॒र्वं येना॒ नु कं॒ मानु॑षी॒ भोज॑ते॒ विट्
shlokas.transliteration: su-ādhyáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ saptá ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ ví ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ ajānan ǀvidát ǀ gávyam ǀ sarámā ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ ūrvám ǀ yéna ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ mā́nuṣī ǀ bhójate ǀ víṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven pure rivers that flow from heaven (are directed,Agni, by you; by you, the priests), skilled in sacrifices, knew the doors of the (cave where) the treasure, (their cattle), were concealed for youSaramādiscovered the abundant milk of the kine with which man, the progeny ofManu, still is nourished.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ये विश्वा॑ स्वप॒त्यानि॑ त॒स्थुः कृ॑ण्वा॒नासो॑ अमृत॒त्वाय॑ गा॒तुम् । म॒ह्ना म॒हद्भि॑: पृथि॒वी वि त॑स्थे मा॒ता पु॒त्रैरदि॑ति॒र्धाय॑से॒ वेः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yé ǀ víśvā ǀ su-apatyā́ni ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ kṛṇvānā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvā́ya ǀ gātúm ǀmahnā́ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ví ǀ tasthe ǀ mātā́ ǀ putráiḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ dhā́yase ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have been fed, (Agni, with oblations) ever since theĀdityas, devising a road to immortality; instrumental tuted all (the sacred rites) that secured them from failing and mother earth,Aditi, strove with her magnitude to uphold (the world), along with her mighty sons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ श्रियं॒ नि द॑धु॒श्चारु॑मस्मिन्दि॒वो यद॒क्षी अ॒मृता॒ अकृ॑ण्वन् । अध॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ न सृ॒ष्टाः प्र नीची॑रग्ने॒ अरु॑षीरजानन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ śríyam ǀ ní ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ cā́rum ǀ asmin ǀ diváḥ ǀ yát ǀ akṣī́ íti ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ákṛṇvan ǀádha ǀ kṣaranti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ agne ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ ajānan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The offerers of oblations) have plural ced in this (Agni) the graceful honours (of the ceremony), and the two portions of clarified butter that are the two eyes (of the sacrifice); then the immortals come from heaven, and your bright flames, Agni, spread in all directions like rushing rivers, and the gods perceive it (and rejoice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒यिर्न यः पि॑तृवि॒त्तो व॑यो॒धाः सु॒प्रणी॑तिश्चिकि॒तुषो॒ न शासु॑: । स्यो॒न॒शीरति॑थि॒र्न प्री॑णा॒नो होते॑व॒ सद्म॑ विध॒तो वि ता॑रीत्
shlokas.transliteration: rayíḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ pitṛ-vittáḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ su-pránītiḥ ǀ cikitúṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śā́suḥ ǀsyona-śī́ḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ ná ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀ hótā-iva ǀ sádma ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ tārīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, like patrimonial wealth, is the giver of food; he is a director, like the instrumental uctions of one learned in scripture; he rests in the sacrificial chamber like a welcome guest, and like an officiating priest, he brings prosperity on the house of the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो न यः स॑वि॒ता स॒त्यम॑न्मा॒ क्रत्वा॑ नि॒पाति॑ वृ॒जना॑नि॒ विश्वा॑ । पु॒रु॒प्र॒श॒स्तो अ॒मति॒र्न स॒त्य आ॒त्मेव॒ शेवो॑ दिधि॒षाय्यो॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ satyá-manmā ǀ krátvā ǀ ni-pā́ti ǀ vṛjánāni ǀ víśvā ǀpuru-praśastáḥ ǀ amátiḥ ǀ ná ǀ satyáḥ ǀ ātmā́-iva ǀ śévaḥ ǀ didhiṣā́yyaḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is like the divine Sun, who know the truth (of things), preserves by his actions (his votaries) in all encounters; like nature, he is unchangeable and, likesoul, is the source of happiness; he is ever to be cherished.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो न यः पृ॑थि॒वीं वि॒श्वधा॑या उप॒क्षेति॑ हि॒तमि॑त्रो॒ न राजा॑ । पु॒र॒:सद॑: शर्म॒सदो॒ न वी॒रा अ॑नव॒द्या पति॑जुष्टेव॒ नारी॑
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ viśvá-dhāyāḥ ǀ upa-kṣéti ǀ hitá-mitraḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀpuraḥ-sádaḥ ǀ śarma-sádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ anavadyā́ ǀ pátijuṣṭā-iva ǀ nā́rī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, like the divine (Sun), is the supporter of the universe, abides on earth like a prince, (surrounded by) faithful friends; in his presence, men sit down like sons in the dwelling of a parent, and (in purity he resembles) an irreproachable and beloved wife.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ नरो॒ दम॒ आ नित्य॑मि॒द्धमग्ने॒ सच॑न्त क्षि॒तिषु॑ ध्रु॒वासु॑ । अधि॑ द्यु॒म्नं नि द॑धु॒र्भूर्य॑स्मि॒न्भवा॑ वि॒श्वायु॑र्ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ náraḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ nítyam ǀ iddhám ǀ agne ǀ sácanta ǀ kṣitíṣu ǀ dhruvā́su ǀádhi ǀ dyumnám ǀ ní ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ asmin ǀ bháva ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such as you are,Agni, men preserve you constantly kindled in their dwellings, in secure plural ces, and offer upon you abundant (sacrificial) food; do you, in whom is all existence, be the bearer of riches (for our advantage).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि पृक्षो॑ अग्ने म॒घवा॑नो अश्यु॒र्वि सू॒रयो॒ दद॑तो॒ विश्व॒मायु॑: । स॒नेम॒ वाजं॑ समि॒थेष्व॒र्यो भा॒गं दे॒वेषु॒ श्रव॑से॒ दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ agne ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ áśyuḥ ǀ ví ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ dádataḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀsanéma ǀ vā́jam ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ aryáḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ devéṣu ǀ śrávase ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your opulent worshippers,Agni, obtain (abundant) food; may the learned (who praise you) and offer you (oblations), acquire long life; may we gain in battles booty from our foes, presenting their portion to the gods for (the acquisition of) renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॒ हि धे॒नवो॑ वावशा॒नाः स्मदू॑ध्नीः पी॒पय॑न्त॒ द्युभ॑क्ताः । प॒रा॒वत॑: सुम॒तिं भिक्ष॑माणा॒ वि सिन्ध॑वः स॒मया॑ सस्रु॒रद्रि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ hí ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ smát-ūdhnīḥ ǀ pīpáyanta ǀ dyú-bhaktāḥ ǀparā-vátaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀ ví ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ samáyā ǀ sasruḥ ǀ ádrim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cows, loving (Agni, who has come to thehall of sacrifice), sharing his splendour, have brought with full udders (their milk) to be drunk. The rivers, soliciting his good will, have flowed from a distance in the vicinity of the mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे अ॑ग्ने सुम॒तिं भिक्ष॑माणा दि॒वि श्रवो॑ दधिरे य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । नक्ता॑ च च॒क्रुरु॒षसा॒ विरू॑पे कृ॒ष्णं च॒ वर्ण॑मरु॒णं च॒ सं धु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ agne ǀ su-matím ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀ diví ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀnáktā ǀ ca ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ uṣásā ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ ca ǀ várṇam ǀ aruṇám ǀ ca ǀ sám ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods), who are entitled to worship, soliciting your good will, have entrusted to you, resplendentAgni, the (sacrificial) food, and, (for the due observance of sacred rites), they have made the night and morning of different colours, or black and purple.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यान्रा॒ये मर्ता॒न्त्सुषू॑दो अग्ने॒ ते स्या॑म म॒घवा॑नो व॒यं च॑ । छा॒येव॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं सिसक्ष्यापप्रि॒वान्रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́n ǀ rāyé ǀ mártān ǀ súsūdaḥ ǀ agne ǀ té ǀ syāma ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀchāyā́-iva ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ sisakṣi ǀ āpapri-vā́n ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antárikṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, mortals, whom you have directed (to the performance of sacrifices) for the sake of riches, become opulent; filling heaven and earth, and the firmament (with your radiance), you protect the whole world like a (sheltering) shade.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्व॑द्भिरग्ने॒ अर्व॑तो॒ नृभि॒र्नॄन्वी॒रैर्वी॒रान्व॑नुयामा॒ त्वोता॑: । ई॒शा॒नास॑: पितृवि॒त्तस्य॑ रा॒यो वि सू॒रय॑: श॒तहि॑मा नो अश्युः
shlokas.transliteration: árvat-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ árvataḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ vīrā́n ǀ vanuyāma ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀīśānā́saḥ ǀ pitṛ-vittásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ aśyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Defended,Agni, by you, may we destroy the horses (of your enemies) by (our) horses, their men by (our) men, their sons by (our) sons, and may our sons, learned and inheritors of ancestral wealth, live for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता ते॑ अग्न उ॒चथा॑नि वेधो॒ जुष्टा॑नि सन्तु॒ मन॑से हृ॒दे च॑ । श॒केम॑ रा॒यः सु॒धुरो॒ यमं॒ तेऽधि॒ श्रवो॑ दे॒वभ॑क्तं॒ दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ucáthāni ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ júṣṭāni ǀ santu ǀ mánase ǀ hṛdé ǀ ca ǀśakéma ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-dhúraḥ ǀ yámam ǀ te ǀ ádhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devá-bhaktam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these our praises, sapientAgni, be grateful to you, both in mind and heart; may we be competent to detain your well-supporting wealth, offering upon you their share of the (sacrificial food of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒प्र॒यन्तो॑ अध्व॒रं मन्त्रं॑ वोचेमा॒ग्नये॑ । आ॒रे अ॒स्मे च॑ शृण्व॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: upa-prayántaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ mántram ǀ vocema ǀ agnáye ǀāré ǀ asmé íti ǀ ca ǀ śṛṇvaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hastening to the sacrifice, let us repeat a prayer toAgni, who fears us from afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः स्नीहि॑तीषु पू॒र्व्यः सं॑जग्मा॒नासु॑ कृ॒ष्टिषु॑ । अर॑क्षद्दा॒शुषे॒ गय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ snī́hitīṣu ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ sam-jagmānā́su ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǀárakṣat ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ gáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, existing of old, has preserved wealth for the sacrificer, when malevolent men are assembled together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ब्रु॑वन्तु ज॒न्तव॒ उद॒ग्निर्वृ॑त्र॒हाज॑नि । ध॒नं॒ज॒यो रणे॑रणे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ bruvantu ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ út ǀ agníḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ ajani ǀdhanam-jayáḥ ǀ ráṇe-raṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let men praiseAgnias soon as genitive rated, the slayer ofVṛtra, and the winner of booty in many a battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ दू॒तो असि॒ क्षये॒ वेषि॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वी॒तये॑ । द॒स्मत्कृ॒णोष्य॑ध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ási ǀ kṣáye ǀ véṣi ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǀdasmát ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The sacrificer), in whose house you are the messenger of the gods, whose offering you convey for their food, and whose sacrifice you render acceptable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमित्सु॑ह॒व्यम॑ङ्गिरः सुदे॒वं स॑हसो यहो । जना॑ आहुः सुब॒र्हिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ su-havyám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ su-devám ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀjánāḥ ǀ āhuḥ ǀ su-barhíṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him,Aṅgiras, son of strength, men call forunate in his sacrifice, his deity, his oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ च॒ वहा॑सि॒ ताँ इ॒ह दे॒वाँ उप॒ प्रश॑स्तये । ह॒व्या सु॑श्चन्द्र वी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ca ǀ váhāsi ǀ tā́n ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǀ úpa ǀ prá-śastaye ǀhavyā́ ǀ su-candra ǀ vītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring hither, radiantAgni, the gods, to (receive) our praise and our oblations for their food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न योरु॑प॒ब्दिरश्व्य॑: शृ॒ण्वे रथ॑स्य॒ कच्च॒न । यद॑ग्ने॒ यासि॑ दू॒त्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yóḥ ǀ upabdíḥ ǀ áśvyaḥ ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ ráthasya ǀ kát ǀ caná ǀyát ǀ agne ǀ yā́si ǀ dūtyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whenever you go,Agni, on a mission of the gods, the neighing of the horses of your (swift) moving chariot, however audible is not heard.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वोतो॑ वा॒ज्यह्र॑यो॒ऽभि पूर्व॑स्मा॒दप॑रः । प्र दा॒श्वाँ अ॑ग्ने अस्थात्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ áhrayaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pū́rvasmāt ǀ áparaḥ ǀprá ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ agne ǀ asthāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who was formerly subject to a superior, having been protected,Agni, by you, now stands in your presence as an offerer (of oblations) without bashfulness, and supplied with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त द्यु॒मत्सु॒वीर्यं॑ बृ॒हद॑ग्ने विवाससि । दे॒वेभ्यो॑ देव दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dyu-mát ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ bṛhát ǀ agne ǀ vivāsasi ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ deva ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, divineAgni, you are desirous of bestowing upon the offerer (of oblations) to the gods, ample (wealth), brilliant, and giving vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षस्व॑ स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं॒ वचो॑ दे॒वप्स॑रस्तमम् । ह॒व्या जुह्वा॑न आ॒सनि॑
shlokas.transliteration: juṣásva ǀ sapráthaḥ-tamam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ devápsaraḥ-tamam ǀhavyā́ ǀ júhvānaḥ ǀ āsáni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept our most exhaustive prayers, propitiatory of the gods, accepting our oblations in your mouth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अथा॑ ते अङ्गिरस्त॒माग्ने॑ वेधस्तम प्रि॒यम् । वो॒चेम॒ ब्रह्म॑ सान॒सि
shlokas.transliteration: átha ǀ te ǀ aṅgiraḥ-tama ǀ agne ǀ vedhaḥ-tama ǀ priyám ǀvocéma ǀ bráhma ǀ sānasí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And then, most wiseAgni, chief of theAṅgiras, may we address (to you) an acceptable and gratifying prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्ते॑ जा॒मिर्जना॑ना॒मग्ने॒ को दा॒श्व॑ध्वरः । को ह॒ कस्मि॑न्नसि श्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ te ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ágne ǀ káḥ ǀ dāśú-adhvaraḥ ǀkáḥ ǀ ha ǀ kásmin ǀ asi ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who,Agni, is your kinsman amongst people? Who is worthy to offer you sacrifice? Who, indeed, are you and where do you abide?”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं जा॒मिर्जना॑ना॒मग्ने॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑सि प्रि॒यः । सखा॒ सखि॑भ्य॒ ईड्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ágne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ asi ǀ priyáḥ ǀsákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the kinsman of people. You are the protector of sacrificers. You are extolled by priests, since you are the friend of all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यजा॑ नो मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ यजा॑ दे॒वाँ ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् । अग्ने॒ यक्षि॒ स्वं दम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yája ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ yája ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀágne ǀ yákṣi ǀ svám ǀ dámam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship for us,MitraandVaruṇa; worship for us, all the gods; (celebrate) a great sacrifice; be present in your own dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का त॒ उपे॑ति॒र्मन॑सो॒ वरा॑य॒ भुव॑दग्ने॒ शंत॑मा॒ का म॑नी॒षा । को वा॑ य॒ज्ञैः परि॒ दक्षं॑ त आप॒ केन॑ वा ते॒ मन॑सा दाशेम
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ te ǀ úpa-itiḥ ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ várāya ǀ bhúvat ǀ agne ǀ śám-tamā ǀ kā́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀkáḥ ǀ vā ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ pári ǀ dákṣam ǀ te ǀ āpa ǀ kéna ǀ vā ǀ te ǀ mánasā ǀ dāśema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What approximation of the mind,Agni, to you, can be accomplished for our good; what can a hundred encomiums (effect); who, by sacrifices has obtained your might; with what intent may we offer you (oblations)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: एह्य॑ग्न इ॒ह होता॒ नि षी॒दाद॑ब्ध॒: सु पु॑रए॒ता भ॑वा नः । अव॑तां त्वा॒ रोद॑सी विश्वमि॒न्वे यजा॑ म॒हे सौ॑मन॒साय॑ दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ agne ǀ ihá ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ sīda ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ sú ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ bhava ǀ naḥ ǀávatām ǀ tvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśvaminvé íti viśvam-invé ǀ yája ǀ mahé ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, hither; invoker (of the gods), sit down; be our preceder; for you are irresistible; may the all-expansive heaven and earth defend you, that you may worship the gods to their great satisfaction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु विश्वा॑न्र॒क्षसो॒ धक्ष्य॑ग्ने॒ भवा॑ य॒ज्ञाना॑मभिशस्ति॒पावा॑ । अथा व॑ह॒ सोम॑पतिं॒ हरि॑भ्यामाति॒थ्यम॑स्मै चकृमा सु॒दाव्ने॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ víśvān ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ dhákṣi ǀ agne ǀ bháva ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ abhiśasti-pā́vā ǀátha ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sóma-patim ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ ātithyám ǀ asmai ǀ cakṛma ǀ su-dā́vne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utterly consume all therākṣasas,Agni, and be the protector of our sacrifices against interruption. Bring hither the guardian ofSoma, (Indra), with his steeds, that we may show hospitality to the giver of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒जाव॑ता॒ वच॑सा॒ वह्नि॑रा॒सा च॑ हु॒वे नि च॑ सत्सी॒ह दे॒वैः । वेषि॑ हो॒त्रमु॒त पो॒त्रं य॑जत्र बो॒धि प्र॑यन्तर्जनित॒र्वसू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prajā́-vatā ǀ vácasā ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ huvé ǀ ní ǀ ca ǀ satsi ǀ ihá ǀ deváiḥ ǀvéṣi ǀ hotrám ǀ utá ǀ potrám ǀ yajatra ǀ bodhí ǀ pra-yantaḥ ǀ janitaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke (you), who are the conveyor (of oblations), with your flames, with a hymn productive of progeny (to the worshipper); sit down here with the gods, and do you, who are deserving of worship, discharge the office ofHotā, or ofPotāand awaken us, you who are the depository and genitive rator of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ विप्र॑स्य॒ मनु॑षो ह॒विर्भि॑र्दे॒वाँ अय॑जः क॒विभि॑: क॒विः सन् । ए॒वा हो॑तः सत्यतर॒ त्वम॒द्याग्ने॑ म॒न्द्रया॑ जु॒ह्वा॑ यजस्व
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ víprasya ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áyajaḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sán ǀevá ǀ hotaríti ǀ satya-tara ǀ tvám ǀ adyá ǀ ágne ǀ mandráyā ǀ juhvā́ ǀ yajasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As at the sacrifice of the holyManu, you, a sage amongst sages, did worship the gods with oblations, so also,Agni, veracious invoker of the gods, do you today (present the oblations), with an exhilarating ladle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था दा॑शेमा॒ग्नये॒ कास्मै॑ दे॒वजु॑ष्टोच्यते भा॒मिने॒ गीः । यो मर्त्ये॑ष्व॒मृत॑ ऋ॒तावा॒ होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठ॒ इत्कृ॒णोति॑ दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ dāśema ǀ agnáye ǀ kā́ ǀ asmai ǀ devá-juṣṭā ǀ ucyate ǀ bhāmíne ǀ gī́ḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ hótā ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ít ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What (oblations) may we offer toAgni? What praise is addressed to the luminous (Agni) that is agreeable to the gods? that Agni who is immortal and observant of truth, who is the invoker of the gods, the performer of sacrifices, and who, (present) amongst men, conveys oblations to the deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑ध्व॒रेषु॒ शंत॑म ऋ॒तावा॒ होता॒ तमू॒ नमो॑भि॒रा कृ॑णुध्वम् । अ॒ग्निर्यद्वेर्मर्ता॑य दे॒वान्त्स चा॒ बोधा॑ति॒ मन॑सा यजाति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ hótā ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀagníḥ ǀ yát ǀ véḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ devā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ ca ǀ bódhāti ǀ mánasā ǀ yajāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring hither, with praises, him who is most constant in sacrifice, observant of truth, and the invoker (of the gods), forAgni, when he repairs to the gods on the part of man, knows those (who are to be worshipped), and worships them with reverence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि क्रतु॒: स मर्य॒: स सा॒धुर्मि॒त्रो न भू॒दद्भु॑तस्य र॒थीः । तं मेधे॑षु प्रथ॒मं दे॑व॒यन्ती॒र्विश॒ उप॑ ब्रुवते द॒स्ममारी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ krátuḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ máryaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhūt ǀ ádbhutasya ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀtám ǀ médheṣu ǀ prathamám ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruvate ǀ dasmám ǀ ā́rīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For he is the performer of rites, he is the destroyer and reviver (of all things), and, like a friend he is the donor of unattained wealth; all men reverencing the gods, and approaching the well-lookingAgni, repeat his name first in holy rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ नृ॒णां नृत॑मो रि॒शादा॑ अ॒ग्निर्गिरोऽव॑सा वेतु धी॒तिम् । तना॑ च॒ ये म॒घवा॑न॒: शवि॑ष्ठा॒ वाज॑प्रसूता इ॒षय॑न्त॒ मन्म॑
