shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ riśā́dāḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ vetu ǀ dhītím ǀtánā ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ śáviṣṭhāḥ ǀ vā́ja-prasūtāḥ ǀ iṣáyanta ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, who is the chief director of sacrifices, and the destroyer of enemies, accept our praise and worship with oblations, and may those who are affluent with great wealth, who are endowed with strength, and by whom the sacrificial food has been prepared, be desirous to offer adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वाग्निर्गोत॑मेभिॠ॒तावा॒ विप्रे॑भिरस्तोष्ट जा॒तवे॑दाः । स ए॑षु द्यु॒म्नं पी॑पय॒त्स वाजं॒ स पु॒ष्टिं या॑ति॒ जोष॒मा चि॑कि॒त्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ agníḥ ǀ gótamebhiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ astoṣṭa ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ eṣu ǀ dyumnám ǀ pīpayat ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sáḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ yāti ǀ jóṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ cikitvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus hasAgni, the celebrator of sacrifices, and by whom all things are known, been hymned by the pious descendant ofGotama; to them he has given the brightSomato drink, along with the sacrificial food, and gratified by our devotion, he obtains nutriment (for himself).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॒ गोत॑मा गि॒रा जात॑वेदो॒ विच॑र्षणे । द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि प्र णो॑नुमः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀdyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Knower and beholder of all that exists (jātanām veditaḥ).Gotamacelebrates you,Agni, with praise; we praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा॒ गोत॑मो गि॒रा रा॒यस्का॑मो दुवस्यति । द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि प्र णो॑नुमः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ gótamaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ rāyáḥ-kāmaḥ ǀ duvasyati ǀdyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you; that (Agni) whomGotama, desirous of riches, worships with praise, we offer adoration with commendatory (hymns).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा वाज॒सात॑ममङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध॑वामहे । द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि प्र णो॑नुमः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ vāja-sā́tamam ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀ havāmahe ǀdyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you, such as you are, the giver of abundant food, in like manner as didAṅgiras; we praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा वृत्र॒हन्त॑मं॒ यो दस्यूँ॑रवधूनु॒षे । द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि प्र णो॑नुमः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ vṛtrahán-tamam ǀ yáḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ ava-dhūnuṣé ǀdyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We praise you repeatedly with commendatory (hymns), who are the destroyer ofVṛtra, and who put theDasyusto flight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवो॑चाम॒ रहू॑गणा अ॒ग्नये॒ मधु॑म॒द्वच॑: । द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि प्र णो॑नुमः
shlokas.transliteration: ávocāma ǀ ráhūgaṇāḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vácaḥ ǀdyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The descendants of Rāhugaṇa have recited sweet speeches toAgni; we praise him repeatedly with commendatory (hymns).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यकेशो॒ रज॑सो विसा॒रेऽहि॒र्धुनि॒र्वात॑ इव॒ ध्रजी॑मान् । शुचि॑भ्राजा उ॒षसो॒ नवे॑दा॒ यश॑स्वतीरप॒स्युवो॒ न स॒त्याः
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-keśaḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-sāré ǀ áhiḥ ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ vā́taḥ-iva ǀ dhrájīmān ǀśúci-bhrājāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ návedāḥ ǀ yáśasvatīḥ ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ satyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The golden-hairedAgniis the agitator of the clouds when the rain is poured forth, and, moving with the swiftness of the wind, shines with a bright radiance. The mornings know not (of the showers, like honest (people), who, provided with food, are intent upon their own labours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ सुप॒र्णा अ॑मिनन्तँ॒ एवै॑: कृ॒ष्णो नो॑नाव वृष॒भो यदी॒दम् । शि॒वाभि॒र्न स्मय॑मानाभि॒रागा॒त्पत॑न्ति॒ मिह॑: स्त॒नय॑न्त्य॒भ्रा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ su-parṇā́ḥ ǀ aminanta ǀ évaiḥ ǀ kṛṣṇáḥ ǀ nonāva ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yádi ǀ idám ǀśivā́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ smáyamānābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ pátanti ǀ míhaḥ ǀ stanáyanti ǀ abhrā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The falling (rays), accompanied by the moving (Maruts), strike against (the cloud); the black shedder of rain has roared; when this is done, (the shower) comes with delightful and smiling (drops), the rain descends, the clouds thunder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॑मृ॒तस्य॒ पय॑सा॒ पिया॑नो॒ नय॑न्नृ॒तस्य॑ प॒थिभी॒ रजि॑ष्ठैः । अ॒र्य॒मा मि॒त्रो वरु॑ण॒: परि॑ज्मा॒ त्वचं॑ पृञ्च॒न्त्युप॑रस्य॒ योनौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ páyasā ǀ píyānaḥ ǀ náyan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ rájiṣṭhaiḥ ǀaryamā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀ tvácam ǀ pṛñcanti ǀ úparasya ǀ yónau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When this, (the lightning,Agni), nourishes the world with the milk of the rain, and conducts it by the most direct ways to (the enjoyment of) water, thenMitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand the circumambient (troop ofMaruts) pierce through the (investing) membrane into the womb of the cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑त॒ ईशा॑नः सहसो यहो । अ॒स्मे धे॑हि जातवेदो॒ महि॒ श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀasmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, sone of strength, lord of food and of cattle, give us abundant sustenance, you who know all that exists.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इ॑धा॒नो वसु॑ष्क॒विर॒ग्निरी॒ळेन्यो॑ गि॒रा । रे॒वद॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुर्वणीक दीदिहि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ īḷényaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀrevát ǀ asmábhyam ǀ puru-anīka ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the blazingAgni, who is wise, and the granter of dwellings, is to be praised by our hymns; oḥ! you whose mouth (glows) with many (flames), shine (propitiously, so) that food-providing wealth may be ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्ष॒पो रा॑जन्नु॒त त्मनाग्ने॒ वस्तो॑रु॒तोषस॑: । स ति॑ग्मजम्भ र॒क्षसो॑ दह॒ प्रति॑
shlokas.transliteration: kṣapáḥ ǀ rājan ǀ utá ǀ tmánā ǀ ágne ǀ vástoḥ ǀ utá ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tigma-jambha ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ daha ǀ práti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ShiningAgni, drive off (all disturbers of the rite), either by yourself or (your servants) whether by day or by night; sharp-visaged Agni, destroy therākṣasasentirely.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॑ नो अग्न ऊ॒तिभि॑र्गाय॒त्रस्य॒ प्रभ॑र्मणि । विश्वा॑सु धी॒षु व॑न्द्य
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ gāyatrásya ǀ prá-bharmaṇi ǀvíśvāsu ǀ dhīṣú ǀ vandya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who in all rites are to be praised, guard us with your protection, (propitiated) by the recitation of the metrical hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ अग्ने र॒यिं भ॑र सत्रा॒साहं॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । विश्वा॑सु पृ॒त्सु दु॒ष्टर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ rayím ǀ bhara ǀ satrā-sáham ǀ váreṇyam ǀvíśvāsu ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dustáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Agni, riches that dispel poverty that are desirable (to all), and cannot be taken (from us) in all encounters (with our foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ अग्ने सुचे॒तुना॑ र॒यिं वि॒श्वायु॑पोषसम् । मा॒र्डी॒कं धे॑हि जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-cetúnā ǀ rayím ǀ viśvā́yu-poṣasam ǀmārḍīkám ǀ dhehi ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Agni, for our livelihood, wealth, with sound understanding, conferring happiness, and sustaining (us) through life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पू॒तास्ति॒ग्मशो॑चिषे॒ वाचो॑ गोतमा॒ग्नये॑ । भर॑स्व सुम्न॒युर्गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ tigmá-śociṣe ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ gotama ǀ agnáye ǀbhárasva ǀ sumna-yúḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gotama, desirous of wealth, offers to the sharp-flamingAgnipure prayers and praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ अग्नेऽभि॒दास॒त्यन्ति॑ दू॒रे प॑दी॒ष्ट सः । अ॒स्माक॒मिद्वृ॒धे भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ abhi-dā́sati ǀ ánti ǀ dūré ǀ padīṣṭá ǀ sáḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ ít ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he,Agni, who annoys us, whether nigh or afar perish; and do you be to us (propitious) for our advancement.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ह॒स्रा॒क्षो विच॑र्षणिर॒ग्नी रक्षां॑सि सेधति । होता॑ गृणीत उ॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sahasra-akṣáḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sedhati ǀhótā ǀ gṛṇīte ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The thousand-eyed, all-beholding,Agni, drives away therākṣasas, and (praised by us) with holy hymns, he, the (invoker of the gods) celebrates their praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒त्था हि सोम॒ इन्मदे॑ ब्र॒ह्मा च॒कार॒ वर्ध॑नम् । शवि॑ष्ठ वज्रि॒न्नोज॑सा पृथि॒व्या निः श॑शा॒ अहि॒मर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: itthā́ ǀ hí ǀ sóme ǀ ít ǀ máde ǀ brahmā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ várdhanam ǀśáviṣṭha ǀ vajrin ǀ ójasā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ śaśāḥ ǀ áhim ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty wielder of the thunderbolt, when the priest had thus exalted you (by praise), and exhilaratingSoma(had been drunk), you did expel, by your vigour, Ahi from the earth, manifesting your own soverignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वा॑मद॒द्वृषा॒ मद॒: सोम॑: श्ये॒नाभृ॑तः सु॒तः । येना॑ वृ॒त्रं निर॒द्भ्यो ज॒घन्थ॑ वज्रि॒न्नोज॒सार्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ amadat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ śyená-ābhṛtaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀyéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ níḥ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ jaghántha ǀ vajrin ǀ ójasā ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That exceedingly exhilaratingSoma, which was brought by the hawk (from heaven), when poured forth, has exhilarated you, so that in your vigour, thunderer, you have struckVṛtrafrom the sky, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेह्य॒भी॑हि धृष्णु॒हि न ते॒ वज्रो॒ नि यं॑सते । इन्द्र॑ नृ॒म्णं हि ते॒ शवो॒ हनो॑ वृ॒त्रं जया॑ अ॒पोऽर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ihi ǀ abhí ǀ ihi ǀ dhṛṣṇuhí ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ vájraḥ ǀ ní ǀ yaṃsate ǀíndra ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀ hánaḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jáyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten, assail, subdue; your thunderbolt cannot fail; your vigour,Indra, destroys men; slayVṛtra, win the waters, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निरि॑न्द्र॒ भूम्या॒ अधि॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑घन्थ॒ निर्दि॒वः । सृ॒जा म॒रुत्व॑ती॒रव॑ जी॒वध॑न्या इ॒मा अ॒पोऽर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ indra ǀ bhū́myāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghantha ǀ níḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀsṛjá ǀ marútvatīḥ ǀ áva ǀ jīvá-dhanyāḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youu have struckVṛtrafrom off the earth and from heaven; (now) let loose the wind-bound, life-sustaining rain, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रस्य॒ दोध॑त॒: सानुं॒ वज्रे॑ण हीळि॒तः । अ॒भि॒क्रम्याव॑ जिघ्नते॒ऽपः सर्मा॑य चो॒दय॒न्नर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ dódhataḥ ǀ sā́num ǀ vájreṇa ǀ hīḷitáḥ ǀabhi-krámya ǀ áva ǀ jighnate ǀ apáḥ ǀ sármāya ǀ codáyan ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndignantIndra, encountering him, has struck with his bolt the jaw of the tremblingVṛtra, setting the waters free to flow, and manifesting his own soverignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ सानौ॒ नि जि॑घ्नते॒ वज्रे॑ण श॒तप॑र्वणा । म॒न्दा॒न इन्द्रो॒ अन्ध॑स॒: सखि॑भ्यो गा॒तुमि॑च्छ॒त्यर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ní ǀ jighnate ǀ vájreṇa ǀ śatá-parvaṇā ǀmandānáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ icchati ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas struck him on the temple with his hundred-edged thunderbolt, and, exulting, wishes to provide means of sustenance for his friends, manifesting his own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ तुभ्य॒मिद॑द्रि॒वोऽनु॑त्तं वज्रिन्वी॒र्य॑म् । यद्ध॒ त्यं मा॒यिनं॑ मृ॒गं तमु॒ त्वं मा॒यया॑वधी॒रर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ túbhyam ǀ ít ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ ánuttam ǀ vajrin ǀ vīryám ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ tyám ǀ māyínam ǀ mṛgám ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvám ǀ māyáyā ǀ avadhīḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cloud-borne,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, verily your prowess is undisputed, since you, with (superior) craft, have slain that deceptive deer, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ते॒ वज्रा॑सो अस्थिरन्नव॒तिं ना॒व्या॒३॒॑ अनु॑ । म॒हत्त॑ इन्द्र वी॒र्यं॑ बा॒ह्वोस्ते॒ बलं॑ हि॒तमर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ te ǀ vájrāsaḥ ǀ asthiran ǀ navatím ǀ nāvyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀmahát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vīryám ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ te ǀ bálam ǀ hitám ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your thunderbolts were scattered widely over ninety-and-nine rivers; great is your prowess, strength is deposited in your arms, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रं॑ सा॒कम॑र्चत॒ परि॑ ष्टोभत विंश॒तिः । श॒तैन॒मन्व॑नोनवु॒रिन्द्रा॑य॒ ब्रह्मोद्य॑त॒मर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sahásram ǀ sākám ǀ arcata ǀ pári ǀ stobhata ǀ viṃśatíḥ ǀśatā́ ǀ enam ǀ ánu ǀ anonavuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ út-yatam ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A thousand mortals worshipped him together, twenty have hymned (his praise); a hundred (sages) repeatedly glorify him; so,Indra, is the oblation lifted up, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रस्य॒ तवि॑षीं॒ निर॑ह॒न्त्सह॑सा॒ सह॑: । म॒हत्तद॑स्य॒ पौंस्यं॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अ॑सृज॒दर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ táviṣīm ǀ níḥ ǀ ahan ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀmahát ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ asṛjat ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraovercame by his strength the strength ofVṛtra; great is his manhood, wherewith, having slain Vṛtra, he lest loose the waters, manifesting his own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे चि॒त्तव॑ म॒न्यवे॒ वेपे॑ते भि॒यसा॑ म॒ही । यदि॑न्द्र वज्रि॒न्नोज॑सा वृ॒त्रं म॒रुत्वाँ॒ अव॑धी॒रर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ cit ǀ táva ǀ manyáve ǀ vépete íti ǀ bhiyásā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ vajrin ǀ ójasā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ marútvān ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This heaven and earth trembled, thunderer, at your wrath, when, attended by theMaruts, you slewVṛtraby your prowess, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वेप॑सा॒ न त॑न्य॒तेन्द्रं॑ वृ॒त्रो वि बी॑भयत् । अ॒भ्ये॑नं॒ वज्र॑ आय॒सः स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिराय॒तार्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vépasā ǀ ná ǀ tanyatā́ ǀ índram ǀ vṛtráḥ ǀ ví ǀ bībhayat ǀabhí ǀ enam ǀ vájraḥ ǀ āyasáḥ ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭiḥ ǀ āyata ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vṛtradeterred notIndraby his trembling or his clamour; the many-edged iron thunderbolt fell upon him; (Indra) manifesting his own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वृ॒त्रं तव॑ चा॒शनिं॒ वज्रे॑ण स॒मयो॑धयः । अहि॑मिन्द्र॒ जिघां॑सतो दि॒वि ते॑ बद्बधे॒ शवोऽर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vṛtrám ǀ táva ǀ ca ǀ aśánim ǀ vájreṇa ǀ sam-áyodhayaḥ ǀáhim ǀ indra ǀ jíghāṃsataḥ ǀ diví ǀ te ǀ badbadhe ǀ śávaḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you (Indra), did encounter with your boltVṛtraand the thunderbolt (which he hurled), then Indra, the strength of you determination to slay Ahi was displayed in the heavens, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि॒ष्ट॒ने ते॑ अद्रिवो॒ यत्स्था जग॑च्च रेजते । त्वष्टा॑ चि॒त्तव॑ म॒न्यव॒ इन्द्र॑ वेवि॒ज्यते॑ भि॒यार्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhi-stané ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ yát ǀ sthā́ḥ ǀ jágat ǀ ca ǀ rejate ǀtváṣṭā ǀ cit ǀ táva ǀ manyáve ǀ índra ǀ vevijyáte ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At your shout, wielder of the thunderbolt, all things, moveable or immoveable, trembled; evenTvaṣṭāshook with fear,Indra, at your wrath, manifesting your own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि नु याद॑धी॒मसीन्द्रं॒ को वी॒र्या॑ प॒रः । तस्मि॑न्नृ॒म्णमु॒त क्रतुं॑ दे॒वा ओजां॑सि॒ सं द॑धु॒रर्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ nú ǀ yā́t ǀ adhi-imási ǀ índram ǀ káḥ ǀ vīryā́ ǀ paráḥ ǀtásmin ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ójāṃsi ǀ sám ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We know not of a certainty the all-pervadingIndra; who (does know him, abiding) afar off in his strength? for in him have the gods concentrated riches, and worship, and power, manifesting his own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यामथ॑र्वा॒ मनु॑ष्पि॒ता द॒ध्यङ्धिय॒मत्न॑त । तस्मि॒न्ब्रह्मा॑णि पू॒र्वथेन्द्र॑ उ॒क्था सम॑ग्म॒तार्च॒न्ननु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́m ǀ átharvā ǀ mánuḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ dadhyáṅ ǀ dhíyam ǀ átnata ǀtásmin ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ índre ǀ ukthā́ ǀ sám ǀ agmata ǀ árcan ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as of old, so in whatever act of worshipAtharvanor fatherManu, or Dadhyañc engaged, their oblations and their hymns were all congregated in thatIndra, manifesting his own sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ मदा॑य वावृधे॒ शव॑से वृत्र॒हा नृभि॑: । तमिन्म॒हत्स्वा॒जिषू॒तेमर्भे॑ हवामहे॒ स वाजे॑षु॒ प्र नो॑ऽविषत्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ śávase ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ mahát-su ǀ ājíṣu ǀ utá ǀ īm ǀ árbhe ǀ havāmahe ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ aviṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the slayer ofVṛtra, has been augmented in strength and satisfaction by (the adoration of) men; we invoke him in great conflicts as well as in little conflicts; may he defend us in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असि॒ हि वी॑र॒ सेन्योऽसि॒ भूरि॑ पराद॒दिः । असि॑ द॒भ्रस्य॑ चिद्वृ॒धो यज॑मानाय शिक्षसि सुन्व॒ते भूरि॑ ते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ási ǀ hí ǀ vīra ǀ sényaḥ ǀ ási ǀ bhū́ri ǀ parā-dadíḥ ǀási ǀ dabhrásya ǀ cit ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śikṣasi ǀ sunvaté ǀ bhū́ri ǀ te ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, here,Indra, are a host; you are the giver of much booty; you are the exalter of the humble; you bestow (riches) on the worshipper who offers you oblations, for abundant is your wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदु॒दीर॑त आ॒जयो॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॑ धीयते॒ धना॑ । यु॒क्ष्वा म॑द॒च्युता॒ हरी॒ कं हन॒: कं वसौ॑ दधो॒ऽस्माँ इ॑न्द्र॒ वसौ॑ दधः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ut-ī́rate ǀ ājáyaḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǀ dhīyate ǀ dhánā ǀyukṣvá ǀ mada-cyútā ǀ hárī íti ǀ kám ǀ hánaḥ ǀ kám ǀ vásau ǀ dadhaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ indra ǀ vásau ǀ dadhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When battles arise, wealth devolves on the victor; yoke your horses, humblers of the pride (of the foe), that you may destroy one and enrich another; plural ce us,Indra, in affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॑ म॒हाँ अ॑नुष्व॒धं भी॒म आ वा॑वृधे॒ शव॑: । श्रि॒य ऋ॒ष्व उ॑पा॒कयो॒र्नि शि॒प्री हरि॑वान्दधे॒ हस्त॑यो॒र्वज्र॑माय॒सम्
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ mahā́n ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ śávaḥ ǀśriyé ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ upākáyoḥ ǀ ní ǀ śiprī́ ǀ hári-vān ǀ dadhe ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ vájram ǀ āyasám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty through sacrifice, formidable (to foes), partaking of the sacrificial food,Indrahas augmented his strength; plural asing in appearance, having a handsome chin, and possessing (bright) coursers, he grasps the metal thunder-bolt in his contiguoushandsfor (our) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑प्रौ॒ पार्थि॑वं॒ रजो॑ बद्ब॒धे रो॑च॒ना दि॒वि । न त्वावाँ॑ इन्द्र॒ कश्च॒न न जा॒तो न ज॑निष्य॒तेऽति॒ विश्वं॑ ववक्षिथ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ badbadhé ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diví ǀná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ indra ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ ná ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ná ǀ janiṣyate ǀ áti ǀ víśvam ǀ vavakṣitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has filled the space of earth and the firmament (with his glory); he has fixed the constellations in the sky; no one has been ever born, now will be born,Indra, like you; you have sustained the universe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒र्यो म॑र्त॒भोज॑नं परा॒ददा॑ति दा॒शुषे॑ । इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ शिक्षतु॒ वि भ॑जा॒ भूरि॑ ते॒ वसु॑ भक्षी॒य तव॒ राध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ parā-dádāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀíndraḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śikṣatu ǀ ví ǀ bhaja ǀ bhū́ri ǀ te ǀ vásu ǀ bhakṣīyá ǀ táva ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, the protector, who returns to the giver (of oblations) the food that is fit for mortals, bestow (such food) on us; distribute your wealth, which is abundant, so that I may obtain (a portion) of your riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मदे॑मदे॒ हि नो॑ द॒दिर्यू॒था गवा॑मृजु॒क्रतु॑: । सं गृ॑भाय पु॒रू श॒तोभ॑याह॒स्त्या वसु॑ शिशी॒हि रा॒य आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: máde-made ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ yūthā́ ǀ gávām ǀ ṛju-krátuḥ ǀsám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ purú ǀ śatā́ ǀ ubhayāhastyā́ ǀ vásu ǀ śiśīhí ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The upright performer of (pious) acts is the donor of herds of cattle to us, when receiving frequent enjoyment (from our libations); take up,Indra, with bothhands, many hundred (sorts) of treasure; sharpen (our intellects), bring us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒दय॑स्व सु॒ते सचा॒ शव॑से शूर॒ राध॑से । वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॑ पुरू॒वसु॒मुप॒ कामा॑न्त्ससृ॒ज्महेऽथा॑ नोऽवि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: mādáyasva ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ śávase ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhase ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ puru-vásum ǀ úpa ǀ kā́mān ǀ sasṛjmáhe ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enjoy along with us, O hero, the suffused libation for (the increase of our) strength and wealth; we know you (to be) the possessor of vast riches, and address to our desires; be, therefore, our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते त॑ इन्द्र ज॒न्तवो॒ विश्वं॑ पुष्यन्ति॒ वार्य॑म् । अ॒न्तर्हि ख्यो जना॑नाम॒र्यो वेदो॒ अदा॑शुषां॒ तेषां॑ नो॒ वेद॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ puṣyanti ǀ vā́ryam ǀantáḥ ǀ hí ǀ khyáḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ aryáḥ ǀ védaḥ ǀ ádāśuṣām ǀ téṣām ǀ naḥ ǀ védaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These, your creatures,Indra, cherish (the oblation) that may be partaken of by all; you, lord of all, know what are the riches of those men who make no offerings; bring their wealth to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॒ षु शृ॑णु॒ही गिरो॒ मघ॑व॒न्मात॑था इव । य॒दा न॑: सू॒नृता॑वत॒: कर॒ आद॒र्थया॑स॒ इद्योजा॒ न्वि॑न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ sú ǀ śṛṇuhí ǀ gíraḥ ǀ mágha-van ǀ mā́ ǀ átathāḥ-iva ǀyadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vataḥ ǀ káraḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ artháyāse ǀ ít ǀ yója ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach,Maghavan, and listen to our praises; be not different (from what you have hitherto been) since you have inspired us with true speech, you are solicited with it; therefore, quickly yoke your horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्ष॒न्नमी॑मदन्त॒ ह्यव॑ प्रि॒या अ॑धूषत । अस्तो॑षत॒ स्वभा॑नवो॒ विप्रा॒ नवि॑ष्ठया म॒ती योजा॒ न्वि॑न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: ákṣan ǀ ámīmadanta ǀ hí ǀ áva ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ adhūṣata ǀástoṣata ǀ svá-bhānavaḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ náviṣṭhayā ǀ matī́ ǀ yója ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Your worshippers) have eaten the food which you had given, and have rejoiced, and have trembled through their precious (bodies); self-illuminated sages have glorified you with commendable thoughts; therefore,Indra, quickly yoke your horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒सं॒दृशं॑ त्वा व॒यं मघ॑वन्वन्दिषी॒महि॑ । प्र नू॒नं पू॒र्णव॑न्धुरः स्तु॒तो या॑हि॒ वशाँ॒ अनु॒ योजा॒ न्वि॑न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-saṃdṛ́śam ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ mágha-van ǀ vandiṣīmáhi ǀprá ǀ nūnám ǀ pūrṇá-vandhuraḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ váśān ǀ ánu ǀ yója ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We praise you,Maghavan, who look benignly (upon all); thus praised by us, repair (in your car), filled with treasure, to those who desire your presence;Indra, quickly yoke your horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॒ तं वृष॑णं॒ रथ॒मधि॑ तिष्ठाति गो॒विद॑म् । यः पात्रं॑ हारियोज॒नं पू॒र्णमि॑न्द्र॒ चिके॑तति॒ योजा॒ न्वि॑न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ tám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rátham ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhāti ǀ go-vídam ǀyáḥ ǀ pā́tram ǀ hāri-yojanám ǀ pūrṇám ǀ indra ǀ cíketati ǀ yója ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he ascend that chariot which rains (blessings), and grants cattle, and which provides the vessel filled with the mixture ofSomaand grain; quickly,Indra, yoke your horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्तस्ते॑ अस्तु॒ दक्षि॑ण उ॒त स॒व्यः श॑तक्रतो । तेन॑ जा॒यामुप॑ प्रि॒यां म॑न्दा॒नो या॒ह्यन्ध॑सो॒ योजा॒ न्वि॑न्द्र ते॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuktáḥ ǀ te ǀ astu ǀ dákṣiṇaḥ ǀ utá ǀ savyáḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀténa ǀ jāyā́m ǀ úpa ǀ priyā́m ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ yója ǀ nú ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performer of many (holy) acts, let your steeds be harnessed on the right and on the left, and when exhilarated by the (sacrificial) food, repair in your chariot to your beloved wife; quickly,Indra, yoke your horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒नज्मि॑ ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा के॒शिना॒ हरी॒ उप॒ प्र या॑हि दधि॒षे गभ॑स्त्योः । उत्त्वा॑ सु॒तासो॑ रभ॒सा अ॑मन्दिषुः पूष॒ण्वान्व॑ज्रि॒न्त्समु॒ पत्न्या॑मदः
shlokas.transliteration: yunájmi ǀ te ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ keśínā ǀ hárī íti ǀ úpa ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀút ǀ tvā ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ rabhasā́ḥ ǀ amandiṣuḥ ǀ pūṣaṇ-vā́n ǀ vajrin ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pátnyā ǀ amadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I harness your long-maned steeds wiht (sacred prayers); depart; take the reins in yourhands; the effused and exciting juices have exhilarated you wilder of the thunderbolt; thus filled with nutriment, rejoice with your spouse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वति प्रथ॒मो गोषु॑ गच्छति सुप्रा॒वीरि॑न्द्र॒ मर्त्य॒स्तवो॒तिभि॑: । तमित्पृ॑णक्षि॒ वसु॑ना॒ भवी॑यसा॒ सिन्धु॒मापो॒ यथा॒भितो॒ विचे॑तसः
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vati ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ gacchati ǀ supra-avī́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇakṣi ǀ vásunā ǀ bhávīyasā ǀ síndhum ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who is well protected,Indra, by your cares, (and dwells) in a mansion where there are horses, is the first who goes to (that where there are) cows; enrich him with abundant riches, as the unconscious rivers flow in all directions to the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॒ न दे॒वीरुप॑ यन्ति हो॒त्रिय॑म॒वः प॑श्यन्ति॒ वित॑तं॒ यथा॒ रज॑: । प्रा॒चैर्दे॒वास॒: प्र ण॑यन्ति देव॒युं ब्र॑ह्म॒प्रियं॑ जोषयन्ते व॒रा इ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ hotríyam ǀ aváḥ ǀ paśyanti ǀ ví-tatam ǀ yáthā ǀ rájaḥ ǀprācáiḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ prá ǀ nayanti ǀ deva-yúm ǀ brahma-príyam ǀ joṣayante ǀ varā́ḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner, as the bright waters flow to the sacrificial ladle, so they (the gods) look down (upon it); as the diffusive light (descends to earth), the gods convey it, desirous of being presented to them by progressive (movements to the altar), and are impatient to enjoy it, filled with the oblation, as bridegrooms (long for their brides).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ द्वयो॑रदधा उ॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ वचो॑ य॒तस्रु॑चा मिथु॒ना या स॑प॒र्यत॑: । असं॑यत्तो व्र॒ते ते॑ क्षेति॒ पुष्य॑ति भ॒द्रा श॒क्तिर्यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ dváyoḥ ǀ adadhāḥ ǀ ukthyám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ yatá-srucā ǀ mithunā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ saparyátaḥ ǀásam-yattaḥ ǀ vraté ǀ te ǀ kṣeti ǀ púṣyati ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ śaktíḥ ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have associated,Indra, words of sacred praise with both (the grain and butter of oblation), plural ced together in ladles and jointly presented to you, so that (the sacrificer), undisturbed, remains (engaged) in your worship, and is prosperous; for to the sacrificer pouring out oblations (to you), auspicious power is granted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदङ्गि॑राः प्रथ॒मं द॑धिरे॒ वय॑ इ॒द्धाग्न॑य॒: शम्या॒ ये सु॑कृ॒त्यया॑ । सर्वं॑ प॒णेः सम॑विन्दन्त॒ भोज॑न॒मश्वा॑वन्तं॒ गोम॑न्त॒मा प॒शुं नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ áṅgirāḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ dadhire ǀ váyaḥ ǀ iddhá-agnayaḥ ǀ śámyā ǀ yé ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀsárvam ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ sám ǀ avindanta ǀ bhójanam ǀ áśva-vantam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAṅgirasasfirst prepared (forIndra) the sacrificial food, and then, with kindled fire, (worshipped him) with a most holy rite; they, the instrumental tutors (of the ceremony); acquired all the wealth ofPaṇi, comprising horses, and cows, and (other) animals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञैरथ॑र्वा प्रथ॒मः प॒थस्त॑ते॒ तत॒: सूर्यो॑ व्रत॒पा वे॒न आज॑नि । आ गा आ॑जदु॒शना॑ का॒व्यः सचा॑ य॒मस्य॑ जा॒तम॒मृतं॑ यजामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yajñáiḥ ǀ átharvā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ tate ǀ tátaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ venáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ajani ǀā́ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ājat ǀ uśánā ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ sácā ǀ yamásya ǀ jātám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ yajāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Atharvanfirst by sacrifices discovered the path (of the stolen cattle); then the bright sun, the cherisher of pious acts, was born. Atharvan regained the cattle;Kāvya(Uṣanās) was associated with him. Let us worship the immortal (Indra), who was born to restrain (theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒र्हिर्वा॒ यत्स्व॑प॒त्याय॑ वृ॒ज्यते॒ऽर्को वा॒ श्लोक॑मा॒घोष॑ते दि॒वि । ग्रावा॒ यत्र॒ वद॑ति का॒रुरु॒क्थ्य१॒॑स्तस्येदिन्द्रो॑ अभिपि॒त्वेषु॑ रण्यति
shlokas.transliteration: barhíḥ ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ su-apatyā́ya ǀ vṛjyáte ǀ arkáḥ ǀ vā ǀ ślókam ǀ ā-ghóṣate ǀ diví ǀgrā́vā ǀ yátra ǀ vádati ǀ kārúḥ ǀ ukthyáḥ ǀ tásya ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ abhi-pitvéṣu ǀ raṇyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether the holy grass be cut (for the rite) that brings down blessings, whether the priest repeats (the sacred) verse in the brilliant (sacrifice), whether the stone (that expresses theSoma) sound like the priest who repeats the hymn, on all these occasionsIndrarejoices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑वि॒ सोम॑ इन्द्र ते॒ शवि॑ष्ठ धृष्ण॒वा ग॑हि । आ त्वा॑ पृणक्त्विन्द्रि॒यं रज॒: सूर्यो॒ न र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śáviṣṭha ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ pṛṇaktu ǀ indriyám ǀ rájaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomahas been expressed,Indra, for you; potent humber (of your foes), approach; may vigour fill you (by Soma), as the sun fills the firmament with his rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मिद्धरी॑ वह॒तोऽप्र॑तिधृष्टशवसम् । ऋषी॑णां च स्तु॒तीरुप॑ य॒ज्ञं च॒ मानु॑षाणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ hárī íti ǀ vahataḥ ǀ ápratidhṛṣṭa-śavasam ǀṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ ca ǀ stutī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May his horses bearIndra, who is of irresistible prowess, to the praises and sacrifices of sages and of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ति॑ष्ठ वृत्रह॒न्रथं॑ यु॒क्ता ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ हरी॑ । अ॒र्वा॒चीनं॒ सु ते॒ मनो॒ ग्रावा॑ कृणोतु व॒ग्नुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ rátham ǀ yuktā́ ǀ te ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀarvācī́nam ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ grā́vā ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ vagnúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, ascend your chariot, for your horses have been yoked by prayer; may the stone (that bruises theSoma) attract, by its sound, your mind towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ममि॑न्द्र सु॒तं पि॑ब॒ ज्येष्ठ॒मम॑र्त्यं॒ मद॑म् । शु॒क्रस्य॑ त्वा॒भ्य॑क्षर॒न्धारा॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ साद॑ने
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ indra ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ ámartyam ǀ mádam ǀśukrásya ǀ tvā ǀ abhí ǀ akṣaran ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sádane ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, this excellent, immortal exhilarating libation, the dropf of which pellucid (beverage) flow towards you in the chamber of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य नू॒नम॑र्चतो॒क्थानि॑ च ब्रवीतन । सु॒ता अ॑मत्सु॒रिन्द॑वो॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ नमस्यता॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ nūnám ǀ arcata ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ ca ǀ bravītana ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ amatsuḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ namasyata ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer worship quickly toIndra; recite hymns (in his praise); let the effused drops exhilarate him; pay adoration to his superior strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॒ष्ट्वद्र॒थीत॑रो॒ हरी॒ यदि॑न्द्र॒ यच्छ॑से । नकि॒ष्ट्वानु॑ म॒ज्मना॒ नकि॒: स्वश्व॑ आनशे
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ tvát ǀ rathí-taraḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ yácchase ǀnákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ánu ǀ majmánā ǀ nákiḥ ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ ānaśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, you harness your horses, there is no one a better charioteer than you; no one is equal to you in strength; no one, although well-horsed, has overtaken you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एक॒ इद्वि॒दय॑ते॒ वसु॒ मर्ता॑य दा॒शुषे॑ । ईशा॑नो॒ अप्र॑तिष्कुत॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ङ्ग
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vi-dáyate ǀ vásu ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ aṅgá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who alone bestows wealth upon the man who offers him oblations, is the undisputed sovereign,Indra--ho!”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा मर्त॑मरा॒धसं॑ प॒दा क्षुम्प॑मिव स्फुरत् । क॒दा न॑: शुश्रव॒द्गिर॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ङ्ग
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ mártam ǀ arādhásam ǀ padā́ ǀ kṣúmpam-iva ǀ sphurat ǀkadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śuśravat ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ aṅgá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When all he trample with his foot upon the man who offers no oblations, as if upon a coiled-up snake; when willIndralisten to our praises? ho!”

shlokas.sanskrit: यश्चि॒द्धि त्वा॑ ब॒हुभ्य॒ आ सु॒तावाँ॑ आ॒विवा॑सति । उ॒ग्रं तत्प॑त्यते॒ शव॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ङ्ग
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ bahú-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sutá-vān ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀugrám ǀ tát ǀ patyate ǀ śávaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ aṅgá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, grant formidable strength to him who worships him, having libations prepared--ho!”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दोरि॒त्था वि॑षू॒वतो॒ मध्व॑: पिबन्ति गौ॒र्य॑: । या इन्द्रे॑ण स॒याव॑री॒र्वृष्णा॒ मद॑न्ति शो॒भसे॒ वस्वी॒रनु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: svādóḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ viṣu-vátaḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibanti ǀ gauryáḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ sa-yā́varīḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇā ǀ mádanti ǀ śobháse ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The white cows drink of the sweetSomathus poured forth, and associated with the bountifulIndra, for the sake of beauty, rejoice; abiding (in their stalls), they are expectant of his sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य पृशना॒युव॒: सोमं॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । प्रि॒या इन्द्र॑स्य धे॒नवो॒ वज्रं॑ हिन्वन्ति॒ साय॑कं॒ वस्वी॒रनु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ pṛśana-yúvaḥ ǀ sómam ǀ śrīṇanti ǀ pṛ́śnayaḥ ǀpriyā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vájram ǀ hinvanti ǀ sā́yakam ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of his contact, those bridled cows dilute theSomawith their milk; the kine that are loved ofIndradirect his destructive thunderbolt against his foes, abiding (in their stalls) expectant of his sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य॒ नम॑सा॒ सह॑: सप॒र्यन्ति॒ प्रचे॑तसः । व्र॒तान्य॑स्य सश्चिरे पु॒रूणि॑ पू॒र्वचि॑त्तये॒ वस्वी॒रनु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ námasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ saparyánti ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀvratā́ni ǀ asya ǀ saścire ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These intelligent kine reverence his prowess with the adoration (of their milk); they celebrate his manly exploits as an example to later (adversaries); abiding (in their stalls), expectant of his sovereignty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ दधी॒चो अ॒स्थभि॑र्वृ॒त्राण्यप्र॑तिष्कुतः । ज॒घान॑ नव॒तीर्नव॑
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ dadhīcáḥ ǀ asthá-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǀjaghā́na ǀ navatī́ḥ ǀ náva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, with the bones ofDadhīci, slew ninety times nineVṛtras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒च्छन्नश्व॑स्य॒ यच्छिर॒: पर्व॑ते॒ष्वप॑श्रितम् । तद्वि॑दच्छर्य॒णाव॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: icchán ǀ áśvasya ǀ yát ǀ śíraḥ ǀ párvateṣu ǀ ápa-śritam ǀtát ǀ vidat ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wishing for the horse's head hidden in the mountains, he found is Śaryaṇāvat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्राह॒ गोर॑मन्वत॒ नाम॒ त्वष्टु॑रपी॒च्य॑म् । इ॒त्था च॒न्द्रम॑सो गृ॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: átra ǀ áha ǀ góḥ ǀ amanvata ǀ nā́ma ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ apīcyám ǀitthā́ ǀ candrámasaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (solar rays) found on this occasion the light ofTvaṣṭāverily concealed in the mansion of the moving moon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒द्य यु॑ङ्क्ते धु॒रि गा ऋ॒तस्य॒ शिमी॑वतो भा॒मिनो॑ दुर्हृणा॒यून् । आ॒सन्नि॑षून्हृ॒त्स्वसो॑ मयो॒भून्य ए॑षां भृ॒त्यामृ॒णध॒त्स जी॑वात्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ adyá ǀ yuṅkte ǀ dhurí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ śímī-vataḥ ǀ bhāmínaḥ ǀ duḥ-hṛṇāyū́n ǀāsán-iṣūn ǀ hṛtsu-ásaḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhū́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ bhṛtyā́m ǀ ṛṇádhat ǀ sáḥ ǀ jīvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who yokes todya to the pole of the car (ofIndra) his vigorous and radiant steeds, whose fury is unbearable, in whose mouths are arrows, who trample on the hearts (of enemies), who give happiness (to friends). (The sacrificer) who praises their (performance of their) duties obtains (long) life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क ई॑षते तु॒ज्यते॒ को बि॑भाय॒ को मं॑सते॒ सन्त॒मिन्द्रं॒ को अन्ति॑ । कस्तो॒काय॒ क इभा॑यो॒त रा॒येऽधि॑ ब्रवत्त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ को जना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ īṣate ǀ tujyáte ǀ káḥ ǀ bibhāya ǀ káḥ ǀ maṃsate ǀ sántam ǀ índram ǀ káḥ ǀ ánti ǀkáḥ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ káḥ ǀ íbhāya ǀ utá ǀ rāyé ǀ ádhi ǀ bravat ǀ tanvé ǀ káḥ ǀ jánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who goes forth, (through dread of foes, whenIndrais athand); who is harmed (by his enemies); who is terrified; who is aware that Indra is present, who that he is night? What need is there that any one should importune Indra for his son, his elephant, his property, his person n, or his people?”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒ग्निमी॑ट्टे ह॒विषा॑ घृ॒तेन॑ स्रु॒चा य॑जाता ऋ॒तुभि॑र्ध्रु॒वेभि॑: । कस्मै॑ दे॒वा आ व॑हाना॒शु होम॒ को मं॑सते वी॒तिहो॑त्रः सुदे॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ agním ǀ īṭṭe ǀ havíṣā ǀ ghṛténa ǀ srucā́ ǀ yajātai ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ dhruvébhiḥ ǀkásmai ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vahān ǀ āśú ǀ hóma ǀ káḥ ǀ maṃsate ǀ vītí-hotraḥ ǀ su-deváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who praises the (sacrificial) fire, (lighted forIndra), or worships him with the oblation of clarified butter, presented in the ladle, according to the constant seasons? To whom do the gods quickly bring (the wealth) that has been called for? What sacrificer, engaged in offering oblations and favoured by the gods, thoroughly knows Indra?”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒ङ्ग प्र शं॑सिषो दे॒वः श॑विष्ठ॒ मर्त्य॑म् । न त्वद॒न्यो म॑घवन्नस्ति मर्डि॒तेन्द्र॒ ब्रवी॑मि ते॒ वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsiṣaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ mártyam ǀná ǀ tvát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ asti ǀ marḍitā́ ǀ índra ǀ brávīmi ǀ te ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful,Indra, be present and be favourable to the mortal (who adores you); there is no other giver of felicity,Maghavan, than you; hence, Indra, I recite your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा ते॒ राधां॑सि॒ मा त॑ ऊ॒तयो॑ वसो॒ऽस्मान्कदा॑ च॒ना द॑भन् । विश्वा॑ च न उपमिमी॒हि मा॑नुष॒ वसू॑नि चर्ष॒णिभ्य॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ asmā́n ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀ dabhan ǀvíśvā ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ upa-mimīhí ǀ mānuṣa ǀ vásūni ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Granter of dwellings, let not your treasury, let not your benefits, ever be detrimental to us. Friend of mankind, bring to us, who are acquainted with prayers, all sorts of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये शुम्भ॑न्ते॒ जन॑यो॒ न सप्त॑यो॒ याम॑न्रु॒द्रस्य॑ सू॒नव॑: सु॒दंस॑सः । रोद॑सी॒ हि म॒रुत॑श्चक्रि॒रे वृ॒धे मद॑न्ति वी॒रा वि॒दथे॑षु॒ घृष्व॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ śúmbhante ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ su-dáṃsasaḥ ǀródasī íti ǀ hí ǀ marútaḥ ǀ cakriré ǀ vṛdhé ǀ mádanti ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ ghṛ́ṣvayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutswho are going forth decorate themselves like feminine les; they are gliders (through the air), the sons ofRudra, and doers of good works by which they promote the welfare of earth and heaven; heroes, who grind (solid rocks), they delight in sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त उ॑क्षि॒तासो॑ महि॒मान॑माशत दि॒वि रु॒द्रासो॒ अधि॑ चक्रिरे॒ सद॑: । अर्च॑न्तो अ॒र्कं ज॒नय॑न्त इन्द्रि॒यमधि॒ श्रियो॑ दधिरे॒ पृश्नि॑मातरः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ukṣitā́saḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ āśata ǀ diví ǀ rudrā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ cakrire ǀ sádaḥ ǀárcantaḥ ǀ arkám ǀ janáyantaḥ ǀ indriyám ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They, inaugurated by the gods, have attained majesty; the sons ofRudrahave established their dwelling above the sky; glorify him (Indra) who merits to be glorified, they have inspired him with vigour; the sons ofPṛśnihave acquired dominion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोमा॑तरो॒ यच्छु॒भय॑न्ते अ॒ञ्जिभि॑स्त॒नूषु॑ शु॒भ्रा द॑धिरे वि॒रुक्म॑तः । बाध॑न्ते॒ विश्व॑मभिमा॒तिन॒मप॒ वर्त्मा॑न्येषा॒मनु॑ रीयते घृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mātaraḥ ǀ yát ǀ śubháyante ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ virúkmataḥ ǀbā́dhante ǀ víśvam ǀ abhi-mātínam ǀ ápa ǀ vártmāni ǀ eṣām ǀ ánu ǀ rīyate ǀ ghṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sonf of earth embellish themselves with ornaments, they shine resplendent in their person ns with (brilliant) decorations; they keep aloof every adversary; the waters follow their path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ये भ्राज॑न्ते॒ सुम॑खास ऋ॒ष्टिभि॑: प्रच्या॒वय॑न्तो॒ अच्यु॑ता चि॒दोज॑सा । म॒नो॒जुवो॒ यन्म॑रुतो॒ रथे॒ष्वा वृष॑व्रातास॒: पृष॑ती॒रयु॑ग्ध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yé ǀ bhrā́jante ǀ sú-makhāsaḥ ǀ ṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ pra-cyaváyantaḥ ǀ ácyutā ǀ cit ǀ ójasā ǀmanaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ yát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-vrātāsaḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ áyugdhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who are worthily worshipped shine with various weapons; incapable of being overthrown, they are the over-throwers (of mountains);Maruts, swift as thought, entrusted with the duty of sending rain, yoke the spotted deer to your cars.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यद्रथे॑षु॒ पृष॑ती॒रयु॑ग्ध्वं॒ वाजे॒ अद्रिं॑ मरुतो रं॒हय॑न्तः । उ॒तारु॒षस्य॒ वि ष्य॑न्ति॒ धारा॒श्चर्मे॑वो॒दभि॒र्व्यु॑न्दन्ति॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ rátheṣu ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ áyugdhvam ǀ vā́je ǀ ádrim ǀ marutaḥ ǀ raṃháyantaḥ ǀutá ǀ aruṣásya ǀ ví ǀ syanti ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ cárma-iva ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ undanti ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Maruts, urging on the cloud, for the sake of (providing) food, you have yoked the deer to your chariots, the drops fall from the radiant (sun), and moisten the earth, like a hide, with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॑ वहन्तु॒ सप्त॑यो रघु॒ष्यदो॑ रघु॒पत्वा॑न॒: प्र जि॑गात बा॒हुभि॑: । सीद॒ता ब॒र्हिरु॒रु व॒: सद॑स्कृ॒तं मा॒दय॑ध्वं मरुतो॒ मध्वो॒ अन्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ raghu-syádaḥ ǀ raghu-pátvānaḥ ǀ prá ǀ jigāta ǀ bāhú-bhiḥ ǀsī́data ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ urú ǀ vaḥ ǀ sádaḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ mādáyadhvam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your quick-paced, smooth-gliding coursers bear you (hither); and moving swiftly, come with yourhands(filled with good things); sit,Maruts, upon the broad seat of sacred grass, and regale yourselves with the sweet sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते॑ऽवर्धन्त॒ स्वत॑वसो महित्व॒ना नाकं॑ त॒स्थुरु॒रु च॑क्रिरे॒ सद॑: । विष्णु॒र्यद्धाव॒द्वृष॑णं मद॒च्युतं॒ वयो॒ न सी॑द॒न्नधि॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ avardhanta ǀ svá-tavasaḥ ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ nā́kam ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ urú ǀ cakrire ǀ sádaḥ ǀvíṣṇuḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ ā́vat ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sīdan ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Confiding in their own strength, they have increased in (power); they have attained heaven by their greatness, and have made (for themselves) a spacious abode; may they, for whomViṣṇudefends (the sacrifice) that bestows all desires and confers delight, come (quickly), like birds, and sit down upon the plural asant and sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शूरा॑ इ॒वेद्युयु॑धयो॒ न जग्म॑यः श्रव॒स्यवो॒ न पृत॑नासु येतिरे । भय॑न्ते॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना म॒रुद्भ्यो॒ राजा॑न इव त्वे॒षसं॑दृशो॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śū́rāḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ yúyudhayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jágmayaḥ ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ yetire ǀbháyante ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀ rā́jānaḥ-iva ǀ tveṣá-saṃdṛśaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like heroes, like combatants, like men anxious for food, the swift-moving (Maruts) have engaged in battles; all beings fear the Maruts, who are the leaders (of the rain), and awful of aspect, like princes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टा॒ यद्वज्रं॒ सुकृ॑तं हिर॒ण्ययं॑ स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिं॒ स्वपा॒ अव॑र्तयत् । ध॒त्त इन्द्रो॒ नर्यपां॑सि॒ कर्त॒वेऽह॑न्वृ॒त्रं निर॒पामौ॑ब्जदर्ण॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭā ǀ yát ǀ vájram ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭim ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ ávartayat ǀdhatté ǀ índraḥ ǀ nári ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ kártave ǀ áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ níḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ aubjat ǀ arṇavám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wields the well-made, golden, many-bladed thunderbolt, which the skillfulTvaṣṭāhas framed for him, that he may achieve great exploits in war. He has slainVṛtraand sent forth an ocean of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वं नु॑नुद्रेऽव॒तं त ओज॑सा दादृहा॒णं चि॑द्बिभिदु॒र्वि पर्व॑तम् । धम॑न्तो वा॒णं म॒रुत॑: सु॒दान॑वो॒ मदे॒ सोम॑स्य॒ रण्या॑नि चक्रिरे
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvám ǀ nunudre ǀ avatám ǀ té ǀ ójasā ǀ dadṛhāṇám ǀ cit ǀ bibhiduḥ ǀ ví ǀ párvatam ǀdhámantaḥ ǀ vāṇám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ máde ǀ sómasya ǀ ráṇyāni ǀ cakrire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By their power, they bore the well aloft, and clove asunder the mountain that obstructed their path; the munificentMaruts, blowing upon their pipe, have conferred, when exhilarated by theSoma, desirable (gifts upon the sacrificer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जि॒ह्मं नु॑नुद्रेऽव॒तं तया॑ दि॒शासि॑ञ्च॒न्नुत्सं॒ गोत॑माय तृ॒ष्णजे॑ । आ ग॑च्छन्ती॒मव॑सा चि॒त्रभा॑नव॒: कामं॒ विप्र॑स्य तर्पयन्त॒ धाम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: jihmám ǀ nunudre ǀ avatám ǀ táyā ǀ diśā́ ǀ ásiñcan ǀ útsam ǀ gótamāya ǀ tṛṣṇá-je ǀā́ ǀ gacchanti ǀ īm ǀ ávasā ǀ citrá-bhānavaḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ víprasya ǀ tarpayanta ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They brought the crooked well to the plural ce (where theMuniwas), and sprinkled the water upon the thirstyGotama; the variously-radiant (Maruts) come to his succour, gratifyinng the desire of the sage with life-sustaining (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या व॒: शर्म॑ शशमा॒नाय॒ सन्ति॑ त्रि॒धातू॑नि दा॒शुषे॑ यच्छ॒ताधि॑ । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तानि॑ मरुतो॒ वि य॑न्त र॒यिं नो॑ धत्त वृषणः सु॒वीर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sánti ǀ tri-dhā́tūni ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yacchata ǀ ádhi ǀasmábhyam ǀ tā́ni ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yanta ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ dhatta ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever blessings (are diffused) through thethree worlds, and are in your gift, do you bestow upon the donor (of the oblation), who addressed you with praise; bestow them, also,Maruts, upon us, and grant us, bestowers of all good, riches, whence springs prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ यस्य॒ हि क्षये॑ पा॒था दि॒वो वि॑महसः । स सु॑गो॒पात॑मो॒ जन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ hí ǀ kṣáye ǀ pāthá ǀ diváḥ ǀ vi-mahasaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ su-gopā́tamaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man in whose mansion, resplendentMaruts, descending from the sky, you drink (the libation), is provided with most able protectors.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञैर्वा॑ यज्ञवाहसो॒ विप्र॑स्य वा मती॒नाम् । मरु॑तः शृणु॒ता हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñáiḥ ǀ vā ǀ yajña-vāhasaḥ ǀ víprasya ǀ vā ǀ matīnā́m ǀmárutaḥ ǀ śṛṇutá ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, bearers of oblations, hear the invocation of the praises of the worshipper with or (without) sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वा॒ यस्य॑ वा॒जिनोऽनु॒ विप्र॒मत॑क्षत । स गन्ता॒ गोम॑ति व्र॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vā ǀ yásya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vípram ǀ átakṣata ǀsáḥ ǀ gántā ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And may he for whom ministrant priests have sharp-ended the sapient (troop of theMaruts), walk among pastures crowded with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य वी॒रस्य॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑ सु॒तः सोमो॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु । उ॒क्थं मद॑श्च शस्यते
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ vīrásya ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀukthám ǀ mádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ śasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The libation is poured out for the hero at the sacrifice, on the appointed days, and the hymn is repeated, and their (is excited).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य श्रो॑ष॒न्त्वा भुवो॒ विश्वा॒ यश्च॑र्ष॒णीर॒भि । सूरं॑ चित्स॒स्रुषी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śroṣantu ǀ ā́ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀsū́ram ǀ cit ǀ sasrúṣīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, victorious over all men, hear (the praises) of this (their worshipper), and may (abundant) food be obtained by him who praises them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीभि॒र्हि द॑दाशि॒म श॒रद्भि॑र्मरुतो व॒यम् । अवो॑भिश्चर्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ hí ǀ dadāśimá ǀ śarát-bhiḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vayám ǀávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enjoying the protection of you who behold all things, we have offered you,Maruts, (oblations) for many years.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒भग॒: स प्र॑यज्यवो॒ मरु॑तो अस्तु॒ मर्त्य॑: । यस्य॒ प्रयां॑सि॒ पर्ष॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: su-bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ astu ǀ mártyaḥ ǀyásya ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ párṣatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are to be especially worshipped, may the man whose offering you accept be ever prosperous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒श॒मा॒नस्य॑ वा नर॒: स्वेद॑स्य सत्यशवसः । वि॒दा काम॑स्य॒ वेन॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: śaśamānásya ǀ vā ǀ naraḥ ǀ svédasya ǀ satya-śavasaḥ ǀvidá ǀ kā́masya ǀ vénataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessors of true vigour, be cognizant of the wishes of him who praises you, and toils in your service, desirous of (your favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं तत्स॑त्यशवस आ॒विष्क॑र्त महित्व॒ना । विध्य॑ता वि॒द्युता॒ रक्ष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ tát ǀ satya-śavasaḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ karta ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǀvídhyata ǀ vi-dyútā ǀ rákṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessors of true vigour, you have displayed your might, with the lustre (of which) you have destroyed therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गूह॑ता॒ गुह्यं॒ तमो॒ वि या॑त॒ विश्व॑म॒त्रिण॑म् । ज्योति॑ष्कर्ता॒ यदु॒श्मसि॑
shlokas.transliteration: gū́hata ǀ gúhyam ǀ támaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yāta ǀ víśvam ǀ atríṇam ǀjyótiḥ ǀ karta ǀ yát ǀ uśmási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dissipate the concealing darkness; drive away every devouring (foe); show us the light we long for.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्व॑क्षस॒: प्रत॑वसो विर॒प्शिनोऽना॑नता॒ अवि॑थुरा ऋजी॒षिण॑: । जुष्ट॑तमासो॒ नृत॑मासो अ॒ञ्जिभि॒र्व्या॑नज्रे॒ के चि॑दु॒स्रा इ॑व॒ स्तृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá-tvakṣasaḥ ǀ prá-tavasaḥ ǀ vi-rapśínaḥ ǀ ánānatāḥ ǀ ávithurāḥ ǀ ṛjīṣíṇaḥ ǀjúṣṭa-tamāsaḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamāsaḥ ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānajre ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ usrā́ḥ-iva ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Annihilators (of adversaries) endowed with great strength, loud-shouting, unbending inseparable partakers of the evening oblation, constantly worshipped, and leaders (of the clouds), (theMaruts), by their person nal decorations,a re conspicuous (in the sky) like certain rays of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒ह्व॒रेषु॒ यदचि॑ध्वं य॒यिं वय॑ इव मरुत॒: केन॑ चित्प॒था । श्चोत॑न्ति॒ कोशा॒ उप॑ वो॒ रथे॒ष्वा घृ॒तमु॑क्षता॒ मधु॑वर्ण॒मर्च॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: upa-hvaréṣu ǀ yát ǀ ácidhvam ǀ yayím ǀ váyaḥ-iva ǀ marutaḥ ǀ kéna ǀ cit ǀ pathā́ ǀścótanti ǀ kóśāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ukṣata ǀ mádhu-varṇam ǀ árcate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Maruts, flying like birds along a certain path (of the sky), you collect the moving passing (clouds) in the nearest portions (of the firmament), then, coming into collision with your cars, they pour forth (the waters); therefore, do you shower upon your worshipper the honey-coloured rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रैषा॒मज्मे॑षु विथु॒रेव॑ रेजते॒ भूमि॒र्यामे॑षु॒ यद्ध॑ यु॒ञ्जते॑ शु॒भे । ते क्री॒ळयो॒ धुन॑यो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयः स्व॒यं म॑हि॒त्वं प॑नयन्त॒ धूत॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ eṣām ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ vithurā́-iva ǀ rejate ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ yuñjáte ǀ śubhé ǀté ǀ krīḷáyaḥ ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ bhrā́jat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǀ svayám ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ panayanta ǀ dhū́tayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When they assemble (the clouds) for the good work, earth trembles at their impetuous movements, like a wife (whose husband is away); sportive, capricious, armed with bright weapons, and agitating (the solid rocks) they manifest their inherent might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि स्व॒सृत्पृष॑दश्वो॒ युवा॑ ग॒णो॒३॒॑ऽया ई॑शा॒नस्तवि॑षीभि॒रावृ॑तः । असि॑ स॒त्य ऋ॑ण॒यावाने॑द्यो॒ऽस्या धि॒यः प्रा॑वि॒ताथा॒ वृषा॑ ग॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sva-sṛ́t ǀ pṛ́ṣat-aśvaḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ ayā́ ǀ īśānáḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtaḥ ǀási ǀ satyáḥ ǀ ṛṇa-yā́vā ǀ ánedyaḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ átha ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ gaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The troop ofMarutsis self-moving deer-borne, ever young, lords of this (earth), and invested with vigour; you, who are sincere liberators from debt, irreproachable, and shedders of rain, are the protectors of this our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुः प्र॒त्नस्य॒ जन्म॑ना वदामसि॒ सोम॑स्य जि॒ह्वा प्र जि॑गाति॒ चक्ष॑सा । यदी॒मिन्द्रं॒ शम्यृक्वा॑ण॒ आश॒तादिन्नामा॑नि य॒ज्ञिया॑नि दधिरे
shlokas.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ pratnásya ǀ jánmanā ǀ vadāmasi ǀ sómasya ǀ jihvā́ ǀ prá ǀ jigāti ǀ cákṣasā ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ índram ǀ śámi ǀ ṛ́kvāṇaḥ ǀ ā́śata ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ nā́māni ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ dadhire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We declare by our birth from our ancient sire, that the tongue (of praise) accompanies the manifesting (invocation of theMaruts) at the libations of theSoma; for, inasmuch as they stood by encouragingIndrain the conflict, they have acquired names that are to be recited at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒यसे॒ कं भा॒नुभि॒: सं मि॑मिक्षिरे॒ ते र॒श्मिभि॒स्त ऋक्व॑भिः सुखा॒दय॑: । ते वाशी॑मन्त इ॒ष्मिणो॒ अभी॑रवो वि॒द्रे प्रि॒यस्य॒ मारु॑तस्य॒ धाम्न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śriyáse ǀ kám ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ mimikṣire ǀ té ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ té ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ su-khādáyaḥ ǀté ǀ vā́śī-mantaḥ ǀ iṣmíṇaḥ ǀ ábhīravaḥ ǀ vidré ǀ priyásya ǀ mā́rutasya ǀ dhā́mnaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Combing with the solar rays, they have willingly poured down (rain) for the welfare (of mankind), and, hymned by the priests, have been plural ased partakers of the (sacrificial food); addressed with praises, moving swiftly, and exempt from fear they have become possessed of a station agreeable and suitable to theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वि॒द्युन्म॑द्भिर्मरुतः स्व॒र्कै रथे॑भिर्यात ऋष्टि॒मद्भि॒रश्व॑पर्णैः । आ वर्षि॑ष्ठया न इ॒षा वयो॒ न प॑प्तता सुमायाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vidyúnmat-bhiḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ su-arkáiḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ yāta ǀ ṛṣṭimát-bhiḥ ǀ áśva-parṇaiḥ ǀā́ ǀ várṣiṣṭhayā ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ paptata ǀ su-māyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Maruts, with your brilliant light-moving, well-weaponed, steed-harnessed chariots; doers of good deeds, descend like birds, (and bring us) abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते॑ऽरु॒णेभि॒र्वर॒मा पि॒शङ्गै॑: शु॒भे कं या॑न्ति रथ॒तूर्भि॒रश्वै॑: । रु॒क्मो न चि॒त्रः स्वधि॑तीवान्प॒व्या रथ॑स्य जङ्घनन्त॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ aruṇébhiḥ ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ piśáṅgaiḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ kám ǀ yānti ǀ rathatū́ḥ-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀrukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ citráḥ ǀ svádhiti-vān ǀ pavyā́ ǀ ráthasya ǀ jaṅghananta ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To what glorifier (of the gods) do they repair with their ruddy, tawny, car-bearing horses for his advantage? bright as burnished (gold), and armed with the thunderbolt, they furrow the earth with their chariot-wheels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒ये कं वो॒ अधि॑ त॒नूषु॒ वाशी॑र्मे॒धा वना॒ न कृ॑णवन्त ऊ॒र्ध्वा । यु॒ष्मभ्यं॒ कं म॑रुतः सुजातास्तुविद्यु॒म्नासो॑ धनयन्ते॒ अद्रि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śriyé ǀ kám ǀ vaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ vā́śīḥ ǀ medhā́ ǀ vánā ǀ ná ǀ kṛṇavante ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀyuṣmábhyam ǀ kám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ su-jātāḥ ǀ tuvi-dyumnā́saḥ ǀ dhanayante ǀ ádrim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, the threatening (weapons) are upon your person ns, (able to win) dominion; (to you) they praise lofty sacrifices, like (tall) trees; well-born Maruts, for you do wealthy worshippers enrich the stone (that grinds theSoma)].”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहा॑नि॒ गृध्रा॒: पर्या व॒ आगु॑रि॒मां धियं॑ वार्का॒र्यां च॑ दे॒वीम् । ब्रह्म॑ कृ॒ण्वन्तो॒ गोत॑मासो अ॒र्कैरू॒र्ध्वं नु॑नुद्र उत्स॒धिं पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: áhāni ǀ gṛ́dhrāḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ vārkāryā́m ǀ ca ǀ devī́m ǀbráhma ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ gótamāsaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ ūrdhvám ǀ nunudre ǀ utsa-dhím ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fortunate days have befallen you, (sons ofGotama), when thirsty, and have given lustre to the rite for which water was essential; the sons of Gotama, (offering) oblations with sacred hymns, have raised aloft the well (provided) for their dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तत्त्यन्न योज॑नमचेति स॒स्वर्ह॒ यन्म॑रुतो॒ गोत॑मो वः । पश्य॒न्हिर॑ण्यचक्रा॒नयो॑दंष्ट्रान्वि॒धाव॑तो व॒राहू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ tyát ǀ ná ǀ yójanam ǀ aceti ǀ sasváḥ ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gótamaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀpáśyan ǀ híraṇya-cakrān ǀ áyaḥ-daṃṣṭrān ǀ vi-dhā́vataḥ ǀ varā́hūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This hymn is known to be the same as that whichGotamarecitedMaruts, in your (praise) when he beheld you seated in your chariots with golden wheels, armed with weapons, hurrying hither and thither, and destroying your mightiest foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा स्या वो॑ मरुतोऽनुभ॒र्त्री प्रति॑ ष्टोभति वा॒घतो॒ न वाणी॑ । अस्तो॑भय॒द्वृथा॑सा॒मनु॑ स्व॒धां गभ॑स्त्योः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ syā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ anu-bhartrī́ ǀ práti ǀ stobhati ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ṇī ǀástobhayat ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ āsām ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is that praise,Maruts, which, suited (to your merits) glorifies every one of you. The speech of the priest has now glorified you, without difficulty, with sacred verses, since (you have plural ced) food in ourhands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ भ॒द्राः क्रत॑वो यन्तु वि॒श्वतोऽद॑ब्धासो॒ अप॑रीतास उ॒द्भिद॑: । दे॒वा नो॒ यथा॒ सद॒मिद्वृ॒धे अस॒न्नप्रा॑युवो रक्षि॒तारो॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ ádabdhāsaḥ ǀ ápari-itāsaḥ ǀ ut-bhídaḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ vṛdhé ǀ ásan ǀ ápra-āyuvaḥ ǀ rakṣitā́raḥ ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May auspicious works, unmolested, unimpeded, and subversive (of foes), come to us from every quarter; may the gods, turning not away from us, but granting us protection day by day, be ever with us for our advancement.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वानां॑ भ॒द्रा सु॑म॒तिॠ॑जूय॒तां दे॒वानां॑ रा॒तिर॒भि नो॒ नि व॑र्तताम् । दे॒वानां॑ स॒ख्यमुप॑ सेदिमा व॒यं दे॒वा न॒ आयु॒: प्र ति॑रन्तु जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: devā́nām ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ṛju-yatā́m ǀ devā́nām ǀ rātíḥ ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ní ǀ vartatām ǀdevā́nām ǀ sakhyám ǀ úpa ǀ sedima ǀ vayám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ tirantu ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the benevolent favour of the gods (be ours); may the bounty of the gods, ever approving of the upright, light upon us; may we obtain the friendship of the gods, and may the gods extend our days to longevity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तान्पूर्व॑या नि॒विदा॑ हूमहे व॒यं भगं॑ मि॒त्रमदि॑तिं॒ दक्ष॑म॒स्रिध॑म् । अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ वरु॑णं॒ सोम॑म॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्वती नः सु॒भगा॒ मय॑स्करत्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ pū́rvayā ǀ ni-vídā ǀ hūmahe ǀ vayám ǀ bhágam ǀ mitrám ǀ áditim ǀ dákṣam ǀ asrídham ǀaryamáṇam ǀ váruṇam ǀ sómam ǀ aśvínā ǀ sárasvatī ǀ naḥ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke them with an ancient text,Bhaga,Mitra,Aditi,Dakṣa, Asridh,Aryaman,Varuṇa,Soma, theAśvins; and may the graciousSarasvatīgrant us happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नो॒ वातो॑ मयो॒भु वा॑तु भेष॒जं तन्मा॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी तत्पि॒ता द्यौः । तद्ग्रावा॑णः सोम॒सुतो॑ मयो॒भुव॒स्तद॑श्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या यु॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhú ǀ vātu ǀ bheṣajám ǀ tát ǀ mātā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ tát ǀ pitā́ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀtát ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ soma-sútaḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ tát ǀ aśvinā ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǀ yuvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wind waft to us the grateful medicament; may mother earth, may father heaven, (convey) it (to us); may the stones that expressSoma, and are productive of plural asure (bring) it (to us);Aśvins, who are to be meditated upon, hear (our submission).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमीशा॑नं॒ जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॒स्पतिं॑ धियंजि॒न्वमव॑से हूमहे व॒यम् । पू॒षा नो॒ यथा॒ वेद॑सा॒मस॑द्वृ॒धे र॑क्षि॒ता पा॒युरद॑ब्धः स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ī́śānam ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ dhiyam-jinvám ǀ ávase ǀ hūmahe ǀ vayám ǀpūṣā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ védasām ǀ ásat ǀ vṛdhé ǀ rakṣitā́ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke that lord of living beings, that protector of things immoveable,Indra, who is to be propitiated by pious rites, for our protection; asPūṣanhas ever been our defender for the increase of our riches, so may he (continue) the unmolested guardian of our welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धश्र॑वाः स्व॒स्ति न॑: पू॒षा वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । स्व॒स्ति न॒स्तार्क्ष्यो॒ अरि॑ष्टनेमिः स्व॒स्ति नो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्दधातु
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛddhá-śravāḥ ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀsvastí ǀ naḥ ǀ tā́rkṣyaḥ ǀ áriṣṭa-nemiḥ ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ dadhātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, who listens to much praise, guard our welfare; mayPūṣan, who knows all things, guard our welfare; mayTārkṣya, with unblemished weapons, guard our welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृष॑दश्वा म॒रुत॒: पृश्नि॑मातरः शुभं॒यावा॑नो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ जग्म॑यः । अ॒ग्नि॒जि॒ह्वा मन॑व॒: सूर॑चक्षसो॒ विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒सा ग॑मन्नि॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: pṛ́ṣat-aśvāḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǀ śubham-yā́vānaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ jágmayaḥ ǀagni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ mánavaḥ ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gaman ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, whose coursers are spotted deer, who are the sons ofPṛśni, gracefully-moving frequenters of sacrifices, (seated) on the tongue ofAgni, regarders (of all), and radiant as the sun, may all the gods come hither for our preservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रं कर्णे॑भिः शृणुयाम देवा भ॒द्रं प॑श्येमा॒क्षभि॑र्यजत्राः । स्थि॒रैरङ्गै॑स्तुष्टु॒वांस॑स्त॒नूभि॒र्व्य॑शेम दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यदायु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ kárṇebhiḥ ǀ śṛṇuyāma ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ paśyema ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀsthiráiḥ ǀ áṅgaiḥ ǀ tustu-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśema ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us hear, gods, with our ears, what is good; objects of sacrifice, let us see with our eyes what is good; let us, engaged in your praises, enjoy, with firm limb and (sound) bodies, the term of life granted by the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तमिन्नु श॒रदो॒ अन्ति॑ देवा॒ यत्रा॑ नश्च॒क्रा ज॒रसं॑ त॒नूना॑म् । पु॒त्रासो॒ यत्र॑ पि॒तरो॒ भव॑न्ति॒ मा नो॑ म॒ध्या री॑रिष॒तायु॒र्गन्तो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ánti ǀ devāḥ ǀ yátra ǀ naḥ ǀ cakrá ǀ jarásam ǀ tanū́nām ǀputrā́saḥ ǀ yátra ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ bhávanti ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ madhyā́ ǀ ririṣata ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ gántoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since a hundred years were appointed (for the life of man), interpose not, gods, in the midst of our passing existence, by inflicting infirmity in our bodies so that our sons become our sires (i.e. let us not become so feeble and firm as to be, infants and to require the paternal care of our own sons].”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदि॑ति॒र्द्यौरदि॑तिर॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मदि॑तिर्मा॒ता स पि॒ता स पु॒त्रः । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अदि॑ति॒: पञ्च॒ जना॒ अदि॑तिर्जा॒तमदि॑ति॒र्जनि॑त्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: áditiḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ áditiḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ páñca ǀ jánāḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ jātám ǀ áditiḥ ǀ jáni-tvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aditiis heaven; Aditi is the firmament; Aditi is mother, father and son; Aditi is all the gods; Aditi is the five classes of people; Aditi is genitive ration and birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जु॒नी॒ती नो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो न॑यतु वि॒द्वान् । अ॒र्य॒मा दे॒वैः स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛju-nītī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ nayatu ǀ vidvā́n ǀaryamā́ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVaruṇaand the wiseMitralead us, by straight paths, (to our desires) andAryaman, rejoicing with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि वस्वो॒ वस॑वाना॒स्ते अप्र॑मूरा॒ महो॑भिः । व्र॒ता र॑क्षन्ते वि॒श्वाहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ vásavānāḥ ǀ té ǀ ápra-mūrāḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ rakṣante ǀ viśvā́hā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For they are the distributors of wealth (over the world); and never heedless, discharge their functions every day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ शर्म॑ यंसन्न॒मृता॒ मर्त्ये॑भ्यः । बाध॑माना॒ अप॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsan ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǀbā́dhamānāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they, who are immortal, bestow upon us mortals, happiness, annihilating our foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि न॑: प॒थः सु॑वि॒ताय॑ चि॒यन्त्विन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत॑: । पू॒षा भगो॒ वन्द्या॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ ciyántu ǀ índraḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀpūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vándyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorableIndra, theMaruts,Pūṣan, andBhaga, so direct our paths, (that they may lead) to the attainment of good gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ धियो॒ गोअ॑ग्रा॒: पूष॒न्विष्ण॒वेव॑यावः । कर्ता॑ नः स्वस्ति॒मत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ gó-agrāḥ ǀ pū́ṣan ǀ víṣṇo íti ǀ éva-yāvaḥ ǀkárta ǀ naḥ ǀ svasti-mátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣan,Viṣṇu,Maruts, make our rites restorative of our cattle; make us prosperous”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॒ वाता॑ ऋताय॒ते मधु॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः । माध्वी॑र्नः स॒न्त्वोष॑धीः
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀ mádhu ǀ kṣaranti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀmā́dhvīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ santu ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The winds bring sweet (rewards) to the sacrificer; the rivers bring sweet (waters); may the herbs yield sweetness to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॒ नक्त॑मु॒तोषसो॒ मधु॑म॒त्पार्थि॑वं॒ रज॑: । मधु॒ द्यौर॑स्तु नः पि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu ǀ náktam ǀ utá ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀmádhu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ astu ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May night and moring be sweet; may the region of the earth (lokā rajāṃsyucyate-Nirukta4.19) be full of sweetness; may the protecting heaven be sweet to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑मान्नो॒ वन॒स्पति॒र्मधु॑माँ अस्तु॒ सूर्य॑: । माध्वी॒र्गावो॑ भवन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu-mān ǀ naḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ astu ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀmā́dhvīḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVanaspatibe possessed of sweetness towards us; may the sun be imbued with sweetness; may the cattle be sweet to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ मि॒त्रः शं वरु॑ण॒: शं नो॑ भवत्वर्य॒मा । शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒: शं नो॒ विष्णु॑रुरुक्र॒मः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ śám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ aryamā́ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ uru-kramáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitrabe propitious to us; mayVaruṇa, mayAryaman, be propitious to us; mayIndraandBṛhaspatibe propitious to us; may the wide-steppingViṣṇube propitious to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म॒ प्र चि॑कितो मनी॒षा त्वं रजि॑ष्ठ॒मनु॑ नेषि॒ पन्था॑म् । तव॒ प्रणी॑ती पि॒तरो॑ न इन्दो दे॒वेषु॒ रत्न॑मभजन्त॒ धीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ prá ǀ cikitaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ tvám ǀ rájiṣṭham ǀ ánu ǀ neṣi ǀ pánthām ǀtáva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ devéṣu ǀ rátnam ǀ abhajanta ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, are thoroughly apprehended by our understanding; you lead us along a straight path; by your guidance,Indra, our righteous fathers obtained wealth among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म॒ क्रतु॑भिः सु॒क्रतु॑र्भू॒स्त्वं दक्षै॑: सु॒दक्षो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । त्वं वृषा॑ वृष॒त्वेभि॑र्महि॒त्वा द्यु॒म्नेभि॑र्द्यु॒म्न्य॑भवो नृ॒चक्षा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ tvám ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀtvám ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛṣa-tvébhiḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ dyumnébhiḥ ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, are the doer of good by holy acts; you are powerful by your energies, and know all things; you are the showerer (of benefits) by your bounties, and (are great) by your greatness; you, the guide of men, has been well nourished by sacrificial offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राज्ञो॒ नु ते॒ वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑ बृ॒हद्ग॑भी॒रं तव॑ सोम॒ धाम॑ । शुचि॒ष्ट्वम॑सि प्रि॒यो न मि॒त्रो द॒क्षाय्यो॑ अर्य॒मेवा॑सि सोम
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jñaḥ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ bṛhát ǀ gabhīrám ǀ táva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma ǀśúciḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitráḥ ǀ dakṣā́yyaḥ ǀ aryamā́-iva ǀ asi ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your acts are (like those) of the royalVaruṇa; your glory,Soma, is great and profound; you are the purifier (of all), like the belovedMitra; you are the augmenter of all, likeAryaman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॒ धामा॑नि दि॒वि या पृ॑थि॒व्यां या पर्व॑ते॒ष्वोष॑धीष्व॒प्सु । तेभि॑र्नो॒ विश्वै॑: सु॒मना॒ अहे॑ळ॒न्राज॑न्त्सोम॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृ॑भाय
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ diví ǀ yā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yā́ ǀ párvateṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvaiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ áheḷan ǀ rā́jan ǀ soma ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ ǀ gṛbhāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with all the glories (that are displayed) by you in heaven, on earth, in the mountains, in the plural nts, in the waters, do you, illustriousSoma, well-disposed towards us, and devoid of anger, accept our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑मासि॒ सत्प॑ति॒स्त्वं राजो॒त वृ॑त्र॒हा । त्वं भ॒द्रो अ॑सि॒ क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ utá ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀtvám ǀ bhadráḥ ǀ asi ǀ krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, are the protector, the soverign of the pious, or even the slayer ofVṛtra; you are holy sacrifice..”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं च॑ सोम नो॒ वशो॑ जी॒वातुं॒ न म॑रामहे । प्रि॒यस्तो॑त्रो॒ वन॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ váśaḥ ǀ jīvā́tum ǀ ná ǀ marāmahe ǀpriyá-stotraḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, fond of praise, the lord of plural nts, are life to us; if you will, we shall not die.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म म॒हे भगं॒ त्वं यून॑ ऋताय॒ते । दक्षं॑ दधासि जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ mahé ǀ bhágam ǀ tvám ǀ yū́ne ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀdákṣam ǀ dadhāsi ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You bestow,Soma, upon him who worships, you, whether old or young, wealth, what he may enjoy and live.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: सोम वि॒श्वतो॒ रक्षा॑ राजन्नघाय॒तः । न रि॑ष्ये॒त्त्वाव॑त॒: सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ rákṣa ǀ rājan ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀná ǀ riṣyet ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Defend us, royalSoma, from every one seeking to harm us; the friend of one like you can never perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॒ यास्ते॑ मयो॒भुव॑ ऊ॒तय॒: सन्ति॑ दा॒शुषे॑ । ताभि॑र्नोऽवि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: sóma ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, be our protector with those assistances which are sources of happiness to the donor (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒दं वचो॑ जुजुषा॒ण उ॒पाग॑हि । सोम॒ त्वं नो॑ वृ॒धे भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ upa-ā́gahi ǀsóma ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accepting this our sacrifice, and this our praise, approach,Soma, and be to us as the augmenter of our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑ गी॒र्भिष्ट्वा॑ व॒यं व॒र्धया॑मो वचो॒विद॑: । सु॒मृ॒ळी॒को न॒ आ वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: sóma ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ vardháyāmaḥ ǀ vacaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsu-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Acquainted with hymns, we elevate you with praises; do you, who are benignant, approach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒य॒स्फानो॑ अमीव॒हा व॑सु॒वित्पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑नः । सु॒मि॒त्रः सो॑म नो भव
shlokas.transliteration: gaya-sphā́naḥ ǀ amīva-hā́ ǀ vasu-vít ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanaḥ ǀsu-mitráḥ ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be unto us,Soma, the bestower of wealth, the remover of disease, the cognizant of riches, the augmenter of nutriment, an excellent friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑ रार॒न्धि नो॑ हृ॒दि गावो॒ न यव॑से॒ष्वा । मर्य॑ इव॒ स्व ओ॒क्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sóma ǀ rarandhí ǀ naḥ ǀ hṛdí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávaseṣu ǀ ā́ ǀmáryaḥ-iva ǀ své ǀ okyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, dwell happy in our hearts, like cattle in fresh pastures, like men in their own abodes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सो॑म स॒ख्ये तव॑ रा॒रण॑द्देव॒ मर्त्य॑: । तं दक्ष॑: सचते क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ soma ǀ sakhyé ǀ táva ǀ raráṇat ǀ deva ǀ mártyaḥ ǀtám ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ sacate ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The experienced sage commends the mortal who, through affection, divineSoma, praises you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु॒ष्या णो॑ अ॒भिश॑स्ते॒: सोम॒ नि पा॒ह्यंह॑सः । सखा॑ सु॒शेव॑ एधि नः
shlokas.transliteration: uruṣyá ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ sóma ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀsákhā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ edhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Soma, from calumny, preserve us from sin; plural ased with our service, be our friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व॒ समे॑तु ते वि॒श्वत॑: सोम॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । भवा॒ वाज॑स्य संग॒थे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ te ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀbháva ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sam-gathé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Increase,Soma, may vigour come to you from every side; be diligent in the supply of food (to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व मदिन्तम॒ सोम॒ विश्वे॑भिरं॒शुभि॑: । भवा॑ नः सु॒श्रव॑स्तम॒: सखा॑ वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ sóma ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ExultingSoma, increase with all twining plural nts; be to us a friend; well supplied with food, we may prosper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं ते॒ पयां॑सि॒ समु॑ यन्तु॒ वाजा॒: सं वृष्ण्या॑न्यभिमाति॒षाह॑: । आ॒प्याय॑मानो अ॒मृता॑य सोम दि॒वि श्रवां॑स्युत्त॒मानि॑ धिष्व
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ te ǀ páyāṃsi ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ yantu ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ sám ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀā-pyā́yamānaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ soma ǀ diví ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ut-tamā́ni ǀ dhiṣva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the milky juices flow around you; may sacrificial offerings and vigour be concentrated in the destroyer of foes; and, being fully nourished, do you provide,Soma, excellent viands in heaven for our immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॒ धामा॑नि ह॒विषा॒ यज॑न्ति॒ ता ते॒ विश्वा॑ परि॒भूर॑स्तु य॒ज्ञम् । ग॒य॒स्फान॑: प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीरोऽवी॑रहा॒ प्र च॑रा सोम॒ दुर्या॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ havíṣā ǀ yájanti ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ yajñám ǀgaya-sphā́naḥ ǀ pra-táraṇaḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ ávīra-hā ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ soma ǀ dúryān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whichever of your glories (men) worship with oblations, may our sacrifice be invested with them all; come to our mansions,Soma, who are the bestower of wealth, the transporter (over difficulties); attended by valiant heroes, the non-destroyer of progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ धे॒नुं सोमो॒ अर्व॑न्तमा॒शुं सोमो॑ वी॒रं क॑र्म॒ण्यं॑ ददाति । सा॒द॒न्यं॑ विद॒थ्यं॑ स॒भेयं॑ पितृ॒श्रव॑णं॒ यो ददा॑शदस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ dhenúm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ árvantam ǀ āśúm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ karmaṇyám ǀ dadāti ǀsadanyám ǀ vidathyám ǀ sabhéyam ǀ pitṛ-śrávaṇam ǀ yáḥ ǀ dádāśat ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him who present (offerings),Somagives a cow, a swift horse, and a son who is able in affairs, skilful in domestic concerns, assiduous in worship, eminent in society, and who is an honour to his father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अषा॑ळ्हं यु॒त्सु पृत॑नासु॒ पप्रिं॑ स्व॒र्षाम॒प्सां वृ॒जन॑स्य गो॒पाम् । भ॒रे॒षु॒जां सु॑क्षि॒तिं सु॒श्रव॑सं॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वामनु॑ मदेम सोम
shlokas.transliteration: áṣāḷham ǀ yut-sú ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ páprim ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ apsā́m ǀ vṛjánasya ǀ gopā́m ǀbhareṣu-jā́m ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ su-śrávasam ǀ jáyantam ǀ tvā́m ǀ ánu ǀ madema ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We rejoice,Soma, contemplating you, invincible in battle, triumphant amongst hosts, the granter of heaven, the giver of rain, the preserver of strength, born amidst sacrifices, occupying a brilliant dwelling, renowned and victorious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॒मा ओष॑धीः सोम॒ विश्वा॒स्त्वम॒पो अ॑जनय॒स्त्वं गाः । त्वमा त॑तन्थो॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षं॒ त्वं ज्योति॑षा॒ वि तमो॑ ववर्थ
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ soma ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ ajanayaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀtvám ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀ tvám ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ví ǀ támaḥ ǀ vavartha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, have genitive rated all these herbs, the water and the kine; you have spread out the spacious firmament; you have scattered darkness with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वेन॑ नो॒ मन॑सा देव सोम रा॒यो भा॒गं स॑हसावन्न॒भि यु॑ध्य । मा त्वा त॑न॒दीशि॑षे वी॒र्य॑स्यो॒भये॑भ्य॒: प्र चि॑कित्सा॒ गवि॑ष्टौ
shlokas.transliteration: devéna ǀ naḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ abhí ǀ yudhya ǀmā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ tanat ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ vīryásya ǀ ubháyebhyaḥ ǀ prá ǀ cikitsa ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine and potentSoma, bestow upon us, with your brilliant mind, a portion of wealth; may no (adversary) annoy you; you are supreme over the valour of (any) two (mutual) opponents; defend us (from our enemies) in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता उ॒ त्या उ॒षस॑: के॒तुम॑क्रत॒ पूर्वे॒ अर्धे॒ रज॑सो भा॒नुम॑ञ्जते । नि॒ष्कृ॒ण्वा॒ना आयु॑धानीव धृ॒ष्णव॒: प्रति॒ गावोऽरु॑षीर्यन्ति मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ akrata ǀ pū́rve ǀ árdhe ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ bhānúm ǀ añjate ǀniḥ-kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni-iva ǀ dhṛṣṇávaḥ ǀ práti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ yanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These divinities of the morning have spread light (over the world); they make manifest the light in the eastern portion of the firmament, brightening all things, like warriors burnishing their weapons; the radiant and progressing mothers (of the earth), they travel daily (on their course).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑पप्तन्नरु॒णा भा॒नवो॒ वृथा॑ स्वा॒युजो॒ अरु॑षी॒र्गा अ॑युक्षत । अक्र॑न्नु॒षासो॑ व॒युना॑नि पू॒र्वथा॒ रुश॑न्तं भा॒नुमरु॑षीरशिश्रयुः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ apaptan ǀ aruṇā́ḥ ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ su-āyújaḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ayukṣata ǀákran ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vayúnāni ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ rúśantam ǀ bhānúm ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ aśiśrayuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Their purple rays have readily shot upwards; they have yoked the easily-yoked and ruddy kine (to their car); the deities of the dawn have restored, as of yore, the consciousness (of sentient creatures), and bright-rayed have attended upon the glorious sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्च॑न्ति॒ नारी॑र॒पसो॒ न वि॒ष्टिभि॑: समा॒नेन॒ योज॑ने॒ना प॑रा॒वत॑: । इषं॒ वह॑न्तीः सु॒कृते॑ सु॒दान॑वे॒ विश्वेदह॒ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: árcanti ǀ nā́rīḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ viṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ samānéna ǀ yójanena ǀ ā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀíṣam ǀ váhantīḥ ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ áha ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The feminine le leaders (of the morning) illuminate with their inherent radiance the remotest parts (of the heaven), with a simultaneous effort, like warriors (with their shining arms in the van of battle), bringing every kind of food to the performer of good works, to the bountiful, and to the worshipper who presents libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ पेशां॑सि वपते नृ॒तूरि॒वापो॑र्णुते॒ वक्ष॑ उ॒स्रेव॒ बर्ज॑हम् । ज्योति॒र्विश्व॑स्मै॒ भुव॑नाय कृण्व॒ती गावो॒ न व्र॒जं व्यु१॒॑षा आ॑व॒र्तम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ péśāṃsi ǀ vapate ǀ nṛtū́ḥ-iva ǀ ápa ǀ ūrṇute ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ usrā́-iva ǀ bárjaham ǀjyótiḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ bhúvanāya ǀ kṛṇvatī́ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vrajám ǀ ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas cuts off the accusative ulated (glooms), as a barber (cuts off the hair); she bares her bosom as a cow yields her udder (to the milker); and, as cattle hasten to their pastures, she speeds to the east, and shedding light upon all the world, dissipates the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॒र्ची रुश॑दस्या अदर्शि॒ वि ति॑ष्ठते॒ बाध॑ते कृ॒ष्णमभ्व॑म् । स्वरुं॒ न पेशो॑ वि॒दथे॑ष्व॒ञ्जञ्चि॒त्रं दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता भा॒नुम॑श्रेत्
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ arcíḥ ǀ rúśat ǀ asyāḥ ǀ adarśi ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhate ǀ bā́dhate ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ ábhvam ǀsvárum ǀ ná ǀ péśaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ añján ǀ citrám ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ bhānúm ǀ aśret ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Her brilliant light is first seen towards (the east); it spreads and disperses the thick darkness; she anoints her beauty as the priests anoint the sacrificial food in sacrifices; the daughter of the sky awaits the glorious sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अता॑रिष्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्योषा उ॒च्छन्ती॑ व॒युना॑ कृणोति । श्रि॒ये छन्दो॒ न स्म॑यते विभा॒ती सु॒प्रती॑का सौमन॒साया॑जीगः
