shlokas.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchántī ǀ vayúnā ǀ kṛṇoti ǀśriyé ǀ chándaḥ ǀ ná ǀ smayate ǀ vi-bhātī́ ǀ su-prátīkā ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have crossed over the boundary of darkness. Uṣas restores the consciousness (of living beings); bright-shining, she smiles, like a flatterer to obtain favour, and, lovely in all her radiance, she has swallowed, for our delight the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भास्व॑ती ने॒त्री सू॒नृता॑नां दि॒वः स्त॑वे दुहि॒ता गोत॑मेभिः । प्र॒जाव॑तो नृ॒वतो॒ अश्व॑बुध्या॒नुषो॒ गोअ॑ग्राँ॒ उप॑ मासि॒ वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: bhā́svatī ǀ netrī́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ diváḥ ǀ stave ǀ duhitā́ ǀ gótamebhiḥ ǀprajā́-vataḥ ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ áśva-budhyān ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ gó-agrān ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliant daughter of the sky, the exciter of plural asant voices, is praised by the descendants ofGotama. Uṣas, grant us food associated with progeny and dependants, and distinguished by horses and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उष॒स्तम॑श्यां य॒शसं॑ सु॒वीरं॑ दा॒सप्र॑वर्गं र॒यिमश्व॑बुध्यम् । सु॒दंस॑सा॒ श्रव॑सा॒ या वि॒भासि॒ वाज॑प्रसूता सुभगे बृ॒हन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ tám ǀ aśyām ǀ yaśásam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ dāsá-pravargam ǀ rayím ǀ áśva-budhyam ǀsu-dáṃsasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ yā́ ǀ vi-bhā́si ǀ vā́ja-prasūtā ǀ su-bhage ǀ bṛhántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I obtain, Uṣas, that ample wealth with confers fame, posterity, troops of slaves, and is characterized by horses; which you, who abount in riches and are the giver of food, display, (when gratified) by hymns and holy sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑नि दे॒वी भुव॑नाभि॒चक्ष्या॑ प्रती॒ची चक्षु॑रुर्वि॒या वि भा॑ति । विश्वं॑ जी॒वं च॒रसे॑ बो॒धय॑न्ती॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ वाच॑मविदन्मना॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ devī́ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhi-cákṣya ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀvíśvam ǀ jīvám ǀ caráse ǀ bodháyantī ǀ víśvasya ǀ vā́cam ǀ avidat ǀ manāyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine (Uṣas), having lighted up the whole world, spreads, expanding with her radiance, towards the west, arousing all living creatures to their labours; she hears the speech of all endowed with thought.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॑:पुन॒र्जाय॑माना पुरा॒णी स॑मा॒नं वर्ण॑म॒भि शुम्भ॑माना । श्व॒घ्नीव॑ कृ॒त्नुर्विज॑ आमिना॒ना मर्त॑स्य दे॒वी ज॒रय॒न्त्यायु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ-punaḥ ǀ jā́yamānā ǀ purāṇī́ ǀ samānám ǀ várṇam ǀ abhí ǀ śúmbhamānā ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ kṛtnúḥ ǀ víjaḥ ǀ ā-minānā́ ǀ mártasya ǀ devī́ ǀ jaráyantī ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine and ancient Uṣas, born again and again and bright with unchanging hues, wastes away the life of a mortal, like the wife of a hunter cutting up and dividing the birds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यू॒र्ण्व॒ती दि॒वो अन्ताँ॑ अबो॒ध्यप॒ स्वसा॑रं सनु॒तर्यु॑योति । प्र॒मि॒न॒ती म॑नु॒ष्या॑ यु॒गानि॒ योषा॑ जा॒रस्य॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ वि भा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: vi-ūrṇvatī́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀ abodhi ǀ ápa ǀ svásāram ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ yuyoti ǀpra-minatī́ ǀ manuṣyā́ ǀ yugā́ni ǀ yóṣā ǀ jārásya ǀ cákṣasā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She has been seen illuminating the boundaries of the sky, and driving into disappearance the spontaneously-retiring (night); wearing away the ages of the human race, she shines with light like the bride of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒शून्न चि॒त्रा सु॒भगा॑ प्रथा॒ना सिन्धु॒र्न क्षोद॑ उर्वि॒या व्य॑श्वैत् । अमि॑नती॒ दैव्या॑नि व्र॒तानि॒ सूर्य॑स्य चेति र॒श्मिभि॑र्दृशा॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: paśū́n ǀ ná ǀ citrā́ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ prathānā́ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ aśvait ǀáminatī ǀ dáivyāni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ceti ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ dṛśānā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The affluent and adorable Uṣas has sent her rays abroad, as (a cowherd drives) the cattle (to pasture), and spreads expansive, like flowing water; she is beheld associated with the rays of the sun, unimpeding sacred ceremonies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उष॒स्तच्चि॒त्रमा भ॑रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ वाजिनीवति । येन॑ तो॒कं च॒ तन॑यं च॒ धाम॑हे
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ tát ǀ citrám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ asmábhyam ǀ vājinī-vati ǀyéna ǀ tokám ǀ ca ǀ tánayam ǀ ca ǀ dhā́mahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, possessor of food, bring us that various wealth by which we may sustain sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॑ अ॒द्येह गो॑म॒त्यश्वा॑वति विभावरि । रे॒वद॒स्मे व्यु॑च्छ सूनृतावति
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ihá ǀ go-mati ǀ áśva-vati ǀ vibhā-vari ǀrevát ǀ asmé íti ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ sūnṛtā-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Luminous Uṣas, possessor of cows and horses, true of speech, dawn here today upon this (ceremony), that is to bring us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि वा॑जिनीव॒त्यश्वाँ॑ अ॒द्यारु॒णाँ उ॑षः । अथा॑ नो॒ विश्वा॒ सौभ॑गा॒न्या व॑ह
shlokas.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ vājinī-vati ǀ áśvān ǀ adyá ǀ aruṇā́n ǀ uṣaḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of food, Uṣas, yoke, indeed, today your purple steeds and bring to us all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना व॒र्तिर॒स्मदा गोम॑द्दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवत् । अ॒र्वाग्रथं॒ सम॑नसा॒ नि य॑च्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ vartíḥ ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ gó-mat ǀ dasrā ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀarvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ sá-manasā ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, destroyers of foes, turn with favourable intentions your chariot towards our abode, which contains cattle and gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यावि॒त्था श्लोक॒मा दि॒वो ज्योति॒र्जना॑य च॒क्रथु॑: । आ न॒ ऊर्जं॑ वहतमश्विना यु॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáu ǀ itthā́ ǀ ślókam ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ jánāya ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ vahatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, who have sent adorable light from heaven to man, bring us strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एह दे॒वा म॑यो॒भुवा॑ द॒स्रा हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी । उ॒ष॒र्बुधो॑ वहन्तु॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ devā́ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ dasrā́ ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀuṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the steeds awakened at dawn bring hither, to drink theSoma, the divineAśvins, who are the givers o fhappiness, the destroyers of foes, seated in a golden chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमावि॒मं सु मे॑ शृणु॒तं वृ॑षणा॒ हव॑म् । प्रति॑ सू॒क्तानि॑ हर्यतं॒ भव॑तं दा॒शुषे॒ मय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ imám ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ hávam ǀpráti ǀ su-uktā́ni ǀ haryatam ǀ bhávatam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ máyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, showerers (of desires), favourably hear this my invocation, graciously accept my hymns, and bestow felicity on the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा॒ यो अ॒द्य वा॑मि॒दं वच॑: सप॒र्यति॑ । तस्मै॑ धत्तं सु॒वीर्यं॒ गवां॒ पोषं॒ स्वश्व्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ yáḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vām ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ saparyáti ǀtásmai ǀ dhattam ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ gávām ǀ póṣam ǀ su-áśvyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, grant to him who addresses this prayer to you both, store of cattle with sound strength and good horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा॒ य आहु॑तिं॒ यो वां॒ दाशा॑द्ध॒विष्कृ॑तिम् । स प्र॒जया॑ सु॒वीर्यं॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्य॑श्नवत्
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ dā́śāt ǀ havíḥ-kṛtim ǀsáḥ ǀ pra-jáyā ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnavat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, may he who offers you the oblation of clarified butter, enjoy sound strength, with progeny, through all his life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा॒ चेति॒ तद्वी॒र्यं॑ वां॒ यदमु॑ष्णीतमव॒सं प॒णिं गाः । अवा॑तिरतं॒ बृस॑यस्य॒ शेषोऽवि॑न्दतं॒ ज्योति॒रेकं॑ ब॒हुभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ céti ǀ tát ǀ vīryám ǀ vām ǀ yát ǀ ámuṣṇītam ǀ avasám ǀ paṇím ǀ gā́ḥ ǀáva ǀ atiratam ǀ bṛ́sayasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ ávindatam ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ékam ǀ bahú-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, that prowess of yours, by which you have carried off the cows that were the food ofPaṇi, is (well) known to us; you have slain the offspring of Bṛsya and you have obtained the luminary (the sun), for the benefit of the many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वमे॒तानि॑ दि॒वि रो॑च॒नान्य॒ग्निश्च॑ सोम॒ सक्र॑तू अधत्तम् । यु॒वं सिन्धूँ॑र॒भिश॑स्तेरव॒द्यादग्नी॑षोमा॒वमु॑ञ्चतं गृभी॒तान्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ etā́ni ǀ diví ǀ rocanā́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ sákratū íti sá-kratū ǀ adhattam ǀyuvám ǀ síndhūn ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ avadyā́t ǀ ágnīṣomau ǀ ámuñcatam ǀ gṛbhītā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two,AgniandSoma, acting together, have sustained these constallations in the sky; you have liberated the rivers that had been defiled from the notorious imputation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आन्यं दि॒वो मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ जभा॒राम॑थ्नाद॒न्यं परि॑ श्ये॒नो अद्रे॑: । अग्नी॑षोमा॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वावृधा॒नोरुं य॒ज्ञाय॑ चक्रथुरु लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ anyám ǀ diváḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ jabhāra ǀ ámathnāt ǀ anyám ǀ pári ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ádreḥ ǀágnīṣomā ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vavṛdhānā́ ǀ urúm ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, the wind brought one of you from heaven, a hawk carried off the other by force from the summit of the mountain; growing vast by praise, you have made the world wide for (the performance of) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा ह॒विष॒: प्रस्थि॑तस्य वी॒तं हर्य॑तं वृषणा जु॒षेथा॑म् । सु॒शर्मा॑णा॒ स्वव॑सा॒ हि भू॒तमथा॑ धत्तं॒ यज॑मानाय॒ शं योः
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ prá-sthitasya ǀ vītám ǀ háryatam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣéthām ǀsu-śármāṇā ǀ su-ávasā ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ átha ǀ dhattam ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, partake of the proffered oblation; be gracious to us; showerers (of desires), be plural ased; prosperous and diligent protectors, be propitious, and grant to the sacrificer health and exemption from illness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्नीषोमा॑ ह॒विषा॑ सप॒र्याद्दे॑व॒द्रीचा॒ मन॑सा॒ यो घृ॒तेन॑ । तस्य॑ व्र॒तं र॑क्षतं पा॒तमंह॑सो वि॒शे जना॑य॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agnī́ṣómā ǀ havíṣā ǀ saparyā́t ǀ devadrī́cā ǀ mánasā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀtásya ǀ vratám ǀ rakṣatam ǀ pātám ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ viśé ǀ jánāya ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, protect his sacrifice and defend him from illness, who, with a mind devoted to the gods, worships you with clarified butter and oblations; grant to the man engaged (in devotion) extreme felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा॒ सवे॑दसा॒ सहू॑ती वनतं॒ गिर॑: । सं दे॑व॒त्रा ब॑भूवथुः
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ sá-vedasā ǀ sáhūtī íti sá-hūtī ǀ vanatam ǀ gíraḥ ǀsám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ babhūvathuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, endowed with the like wealth, and invoked by a common invocation, share our praises, for you have (ever) been the chief of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमाव॒नेन॑ वां॒ यो वां॑ घृ॒तेन॒ दाश॑ति । तस्मै॑ दीदयतं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ anéna ǀ vām ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ghṛténa ǀ dā́śati ǀtásmai ǀ dīdayatam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, give ample (recompense) to him who presents to you both, this clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमावि॒मानि॑ नो यु॒वं ह॒व्या जु॑जोषतम् । आ या॑त॒मुप॑ न॒: सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomau ǀ imā́ni ǀ naḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ havyā́ ǀ jujoṣatam ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, bepleased with these our oblations, come to us together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑षोमा पिपृ॒तमर्व॑तो न॒ आ प्या॑यन्तामु॒स्रिया॑ हव्य॒सूद॑: । अ॒स्मे बला॑नि म॒घव॑त्सु धत्तं कृणु॒तं नो॑ अध्व॒रं श्रु॑ष्टि॒मन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīṣomā ǀ pipṛtám ǀ árvataḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pyāyantām ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ havya-sū́daḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ bálāni ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhattam ǀ kṛṇutám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ śruṣṭi-mántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandSoma, cherish our horses, and may our cows, affordin g(milk that yields butter for) oblations, be well nourished; give to us, who are affluent, strength (to perform) religious rites, and make our sacrifice productive of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं स्तोम॒मर्ह॑ते जा॒तवे॑दसे॒ रथ॑मिव॒ सं म॑हेमा मनी॒षया॑ । भ॒द्रा हि न॒: प्रम॑तिरस्य सं॒सद्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ stómam ǀ árhate ǀ jātá-vedase ǀ rátham-iva ǀ sám ǀ mahema ǀ manīṣáyā ǀbhadrā́ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ asya ǀ sam-sádi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him who is worthy of praise, and all-knowing, we construct, with our minds, this hymn, as (a workman makes) a car; happy is our understanding when engaged in his adoration; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वमा॒यज॑से॒ स सा॑धत्यन॒र्वा क्षे॑ति॒ दध॑ते सु॒वीर्य॑म् । स तू॑ताव॒ नैन॑मश्नोत्यंह॒तिरग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ ā-yájase ǀ sáḥ ǀ sādhati ǀ anarvā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ dádhate ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsáḥ ǀ tūtāva ǀ ná ǀ enam ǀ aśnoti ǀ aṃhatíḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, for whom you sacrifice, accomplishes (his objects), abides free from aggression, and enjoys (wealth, the source of) strength; he prospers, and poverty never approaches him; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒केम॑ त्वा स॒मिधं॑ सा॒धया॒ धिय॒स्त्वे दे॒वा ह॒विर॑द॒न्त्याहु॑तम् । त्वमा॑दि॒त्याँ आ व॑ह॒ तान्ह्यु१॒॑श्मस्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: śakéma ǀ tvā ǀ sam-ídham ǀ sādháya ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ adanti ǀ ā́-hutam ǀtvám ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ tā́n ǀ hí ǀ uśmási ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be able to kindle you; perfect the rite, for through you the gods partake of the offered oblations; bring hither theĀdityas, for we love them; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भरा॑मे॒ध्मं कृ॒णवा॑मा ह॒वींषि॑ ते चि॒तय॑न्त॒: पर्व॑णापर्वणा व॒यम् । जी॒वात॑वे प्रत॒रं सा॑धया॒ धियोऽग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhárāma ǀ idhmám ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ te ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ párvaṇā-parvaṇā ǀ vayám ǀjīvā́tave ǀ pra-tarám ǀ sādhaya ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We bring fuel, we offer oblations, reminding you of the successive seasons (of worship); do you thoroughly complete the rite, in order to prolong our lives; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शां गो॒पा अ॑स्य चरन्ति ज॒न्तवो॑ द्वि॒पच्च॒ यदु॒त चतु॑ष्पद॒क्तुभि॑: । चि॒त्रः प्र॑के॒त उ॒षसो॑ म॒हाँ अ॒स्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ caranti ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ dvi-pát ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ utá ǀ cátuḥ-pat ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀcitráḥ ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His genitive al (flames), the preservers of mankind, spread around, and both bipeds and quadrupeds are enlivened by his rays; shining with various lustre, and illuminating (the world by night), you are superior to the dawn; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ध्व॒र्युरु॒त होता॑सि पू॒र्व्यः प्र॑शा॒स्ता पोता॑ ज॒नुषा॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः । विश्वा॑ वि॒द्वाँ आर्त्वि॑ज्या धीर पुष्य॒स्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ utá ǀ hótā ǀ asi ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pra-śāstā́ ǀ pótā ǀ janúṣā ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ā́rtvijyā ǀ dhīra ǀ puṣyasi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the sacrificing or the invoking priest, you are the principal (presenter of the offering), the director (of the ceremonies), their performer, or by birth the family priest; thus conversant with all the priestly functions, you perform perfectly the rite; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वि॒श्वत॑: सु॒प्रती॑कः स॒दृङ्ङसि॑ दू॒रे चि॒त्सन्त॒ळिदि॒वाति॑ रोचसे । रात्र्या॑श्चि॒दन्धो॒ अति॑ देव पश्य॒स्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ su-prátīkaḥ ǀ sa-dṛ́ṅ ǀ ási ǀ dūré ǀ cit ǀ sán ǀ taḷít-iva ǀ áti ǀ rocase ǀrā́tryāḥ ǀ cit ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ áti ǀ deva ǀ paśyasi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are of graceful form, and alike on every side, and, although remote, shine as if nigh; you see, divineAgni, beyond the darkness of night; let us not, Agni suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वो॑ देवा भवतु सुन्व॒तो रथो॒ऽस्माकं॒ शंसो॑ अ॒भ्य॑स्तु दू॒ढ्य॑: । तदा जा॑नीतो॒त पु॑ष्यता॒ वचोऽग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rvaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀtát ǀ ā́ ǀ jānīta ǀ utá ǀ puṣyata ǀ vácaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, let the chariot of the offerer of the libation be foremost; let our denunciations overwhelm the wicked; understand and fulfil my words let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒धैर्दु॒:शंसाँ॒ अप॑ दू॒ढ्यो॑ जहि दू॒रे वा॒ ये अन्ति॑ वा॒ के चि॑द॒त्रिण॑: । अथा॑ य॒ज्ञाय॑ गृण॒ते सु॒गं कृ॒ध्यग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: vadháiḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsān ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ jahi ǀ dūré ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ánti ǀ vā ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ atríṇaḥ ǀátha ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ su-gám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overcome with your fatal (weapons) the wicked and the impious, all who are enemies, whether distant or near; and then provide an easy (path) for the sacrificer who praises you; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदयु॑क्था अरु॒षा रोहि॑ता॒ रथे॒ वात॑जूता वृष॒भस्ये॑व ते॒ रव॑: । आदि॑न्वसि व॒निनो॑ धू॒मके॑तु॒नाग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ áyukthāḥ ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ róhitā ǀ ráthe ǀ vā́ta-jūtā ǀ vṛṣabhásya-iva ǀ te ǀ rávaḥ ǀā́t ǀ invasi ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketunā ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you have yoked the bright red horses (ete vai devāśvāḥ:TaittirīyaSaṃhitā1.7.4.3), swift as the wind, to your car, your roar is like that of a bull, and you enwrap the forest trees with a banner of smoke; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्व॒नादु॒त बि॑भ्युः पत॒त्रिणो॑ द्र॒प्सा यत्ते॑ यव॒सादो॒ व्यस्थि॑रन् । सु॒गं तत्ते॑ ताव॒केभ्यो॒ रथे॒भ्योऽग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ svanā́t ǀ utá ǀ bibhyuḥ ǀ patatríṇaḥ ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ yavasa-ádaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ásthiran ǀsu-gám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ tāvakébhyaḥ ǀ rathebhyáḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At your roaring, even the birds are terrified; when your flames consuming the grass, have spread in all directions, (the wood) is easy of access to you and to your chariots; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाय॑सेऽवया॒तां म॒रुतां॒ हेळो॒ अद्भु॑तः । मृ॒ळा सु नो॒ भूत्वे॑षां॒ मन॒: पुन॒रग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ ava-yātā́m ǀ marútām ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀmṛḷá ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ bhū́tu ǀ eṣām ǀ mánaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this, (your adorer) enjoy the support ofMitraand ofVaruṇa; wonderful is the fury of theMaruts; (dwellers in the region) below (the heavens), encourage us, and may their minds again (be gracious) to us; let us not suffer injury,Agni, through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो दे॒वाना॑मसि मि॒त्रो अद्भु॑तो॒ वसु॒र्वसू॑नामसि॒ चारु॑रध्व॒रे । शर्म॑न्त्स्याम॒ तव॑ स॒प्रथ॑स्त॒मेऽग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asi ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ asi ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ táva ǀ sapráthaḥ-tame ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, brilliant (Agni), are the especial friend of the gods; you, who are graceful in the sacrifice are the confirmer of all riches; may we be present in your most spacious chamber of sacrifice; let us not, Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्ते॑ भ॒द्रं यत्समि॑द्ध॒: स्वे दमे॒ सोमा॑हुतो॒ जर॑से मृळ॒यत्त॑मः । दधा॑सि॒ रत्नं॒ द्रवि॑णं च दा॒शुषेऽग्ने॑ स॒ख्ये मा रि॑षामा व॒यं तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ te ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ své ǀ dáme ǀ sóma-āhutaḥ ǀ járase ǀ mṛḷayát-tamaḥ ǀdádhāsi ǀ rátnam ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ágne ǀ sakhyé ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣāma ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural asant is it to you when you are lighted in your own abode, and propitiated by libations, are praised (by the priests); then, much delighted, you give rewards and riches to the worshipper; let us not,Agni, suffer injury through your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वं सु॑द्रविणो॒ ददा॑शोऽनागा॒स्त्वम॑दिते स॒र्वता॑ता । यं भ॒द्रेण॒ शव॑सा चो॒दया॑सि प्र॒जाव॑ता॒ राध॑सा॒ ते स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ su-draviṇaḥ ǀ dádāśaḥ ǀ anāgāḥ-tvám ǀ adite ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀyám ǀ bhadréṇa ǀ śávasā ǀ codáyāsi ǀ prajā́-vatā ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ té ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Fortunate is the worshipper) to whom, (assiduos) in all pious works, you, possessor of riches, invisibleAgni, grant exemption from sin, whom you associate with auspicious strength, may he be (enriched) by you with wealth that comprehends progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वम॑ग्ने सौभग॒त्वस्य॑ वि॒द्वान॒स्माक॒मायु॒: प्र ति॑रे॒ह दे॑व । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ saubhaga-tvásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ tira ǀ ihá ǀ deva ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, divineAgni, who kno what is good fortune, on this occasion prolong our existence, and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi, ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वे विरू॑पे चरत॒: स्वर्थे॑ अ॒न्यान्या॑ व॒त्समुप॑ धापयेते । हरि॑र॒न्यस्यां॒ भव॑ति स्व॒धावा॑ञ्छु॒क्रो अ॒न्यस्यां॑ ददृशे सु॒वर्चा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dvé íti ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ carataḥ ǀ svárthe íti su-árthe ǀ anyā́-anyā ǀ vatsám ǀ úpa ǀ dhāpayete íti ǀháriḥ ǀ anyásyām ǀ bhávati ǀ svadhā́-vān ǀ śukráḥ ǀ anyásyām ǀ dadṛśe ǀ su-várcāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Two periods, of different complexions, revolve for their own purposes, and each in succession severally nourishes a son; in one,Hariis the receiver of oblations, in the other, the brilliantAgniis beheld.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दशे॒मं त्वष्टु॑र्जनयन्त॒ गर्भ॒मत॑न्द्रासो युव॒तयो॒ विभृ॑त्रम् । ति॒ग्मानी॑कं॒ स्वय॑शसं॒ जने॑षु वि॒रोच॑मानं॒ परि॑ षीं नयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ imám ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ janayanta ǀ gárbham ǀ átandrāsaḥ ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ ví-bhṛtram ǀtigmá-anīkam ǀ svá-yaśasam ǀ jáneṣu ǀ vi-rócamānam ǀ pári ǀ sīm ǀ nayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vigilant and youthful Ten beget, through the wind, this embryoAgni, inherent (in all beings), sharp-visaged, universally renowned, shining among men; him they conduct (to every dwelling).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॒ जाना॒ परि॑ भूषन्त्यस्य समु॒द्र एकं॑ दि॒व्येक॑म॒प्सु । पूर्वा॒मनु॒ प्र दिशं॒ पार्थि॑वानामृ॒तून्प्र॒शास॒द्वि द॑धावनु॒ष्ठु
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ jā́nā ǀ pári ǀ bhūṣanti ǀ asya ǀ samudré ǀ ékam ǀ diví ǀ ékam ǀ ap-sú ǀpū́rvām ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ díśam ǀ pā́rthivānām ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ pra-śā́sat ǀ ví ǀ dadhau ǀ anuṣṭhú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They contemplate three plural ces of his birth; one in the ocean, one in the heaven, one in the firmament; and, dividing the seasons of the year for the benefit of earthly creatures, he formed, in regular succession, the eastern quarteṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: क इ॒मं वो॑ नि॒ण्यमा चि॑केत व॒त्सो मा॒तॄर्ज॑नयत स्व॒धाभि॑: । ब॒ह्वी॒नां गर्भो॑ अ॒पसा॑मु॒पस्था॑न्म॒हान्क॒विर्निश्च॑रति स्व॒धावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ imám ǀ vaḥ ǀ niṇyám ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ mātṝ́ḥ ǀ janayata ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀbahvīnā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ apásām ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ mahā́n ǀ kavíḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ carati ǀ svadhā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which of you discerns the hiddenAgni? a son, he begets his mothers by oblations; the germ of many (waters), he issues from the ocrean, mighty and wise, the recipient of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒विष्ट्यो॑ वर्धते॒ चारु॑रासु जि॒ह्माना॑मू॒र्ध्वः स्वय॑शा उ॒पस्थे॑ । उ॒भे त्वष्टु॑र्बिभ्यतु॒र्जाय॑मानात्प्रती॒ची सिं॒हं प्रति॑ जोषयेते
shlokas.transliteration: āvíḥ-tyaḥ ǀ vardhate ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ āsu ǀ jihmā́nām ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ svá-yaśāḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀubhé íti ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ bibhyatuḥ ǀ jā́yamānāt ǀ pratīcī́ íti ǀ siṃhám ǀ práti ǀ joṣayete íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Appearing amongst them (the waters), the bright-shining (Agni) increases, rising above the flanks of the waving waters, spreading his own renown; both (heaven and earth) are alarmed, as the radiant Agni is born, and, approaching the lion, they pay him honour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे भ॒द्रे जो॑षयेते॒ न मेने॒ गावो॒ न वा॒श्रा उप॑ तस्थु॒रेवै॑: । स दक्षा॑णां॒ दक्ष॑पतिर्बभूवा॒ञ्जन्ति॒ यं द॑क्षिण॒तो ह॒विर्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ bhadré íti ǀ joṣayete íti ǀ ná ǀ méne íti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāśrā́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ dákṣāṇām ǀ dákṣa-patiḥ ǀ babhūva ǀ añjánti ǀ yám ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both the auspicious ones (day and night or two pieces of wood rubbed together to produce flame) wait upon him like two feminine le attendants, as lowing kine (follow their calves) by the paths (that they have gone); he has been the lord of might among the mighty, whom (the priests) on the right (of the altar) anoint.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्यं॑यमीति सवि॒तेव॑ बा॒हू उ॒भे सिचौ॑ यतते भी॒म ऋ॒ञ्जन् । उच्छु॒क्रमत्क॑मजते सि॒मस्मा॒न्नवा॑ मा॒तृभ्यो॒ वस॑ना जहाति
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ yaṃyamīti ǀ savitā́-iva ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sícau ǀ yatate ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ṛñján ǀút ǀ śukrám ǀ átkam ǀ ajate ǀ simásmāt ǀ návā ǀ mātṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vásanā ǀ jahāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like the sun, he stretches forth his arms, and the formidableAgni, decorating both heaven and earth (with brightness), labours (in his duties); he draws up from everything the essential (moisture), and clothes (the earth) with new vestments (derived) from his maternal (rains).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षं रू॒पं कृ॑णुत॒ उत्त॑रं॒ यत्स॑म्पृञ्चा॒नः सद॑ने॒ गोभि॑र॒द्भिः । क॒विर्बु॒ध्नं परि॑ मर्मृज्यते॒ धीः सा दे॒वता॑ता॒ समि॑तिर्बभूव
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ rūpám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ út-taram ǀ yát ǀ sam-pṛñcānáḥ ǀ sádane ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀkavíḥ ǀ budhnám ǀ pári ǀ marmṛjyate ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ sā́ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ sám-itiḥ ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated in the firmament with the moving waters, he assumes an excellent and lustrous form, and the wise sustainer (of all things) sweeps over the source (of the rains with his radiance), whence a concentration of light is spread abroad by the sportive deity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु ते॒ ज्रय॒: पर्ये॑ति बु॒ध्नं वि॒रोच॑मानं महि॒षस्य॒ धाम॑ । विश्वे॑भिरग्ने॒ स्वय॑शोभिरि॒द्धोऽद॑ब्धेभिः पा॒युभि॑: पाह्य॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: urú ǀ te ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ eti ǀ budhnám ǀ vi-rócamānam ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ dhā́ma ǀvíśvebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sváyaśaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ iddháḥ ǀ ádabdhebhiḥ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vast and victorious radiance of you, the mighty one, pervades the firmament;Agni, who have been kindled by us, preserve us with all your undiminished and protecting glories.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धन्व॒न्त्स्रोत॑: कृणुते गा॒तुमू॒र्मिं शु॒क्रैरू॒र्मिभि॑र॒भि न॑क्षति॒ क्षाम् । विश्वा॒ सना॑नि ज॒ठरे॑षु धत्ते॒ऽन्तर्नवा॑सु चरति प्र॒सूषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhánvan ǀ srótaḥ ǀ kṛṇute ǀ gātúm ǀ ūrmím ǀ śukráiḥ ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ nakṣati ǀ kṣā́m ǀvíśvā ǀ sánāni ǀ jaṭháreṣu ǀ dhatte ǀ antáḥ ǀ návāsu ǀ carati ǀ pra-sū́ṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He causes the waters to flow in a torrent through the sky, and with those pure waves he inundates the earth; he gathers all (articles of) food in the stomach, and for that purpose sojourns in the new-sprung parents (of the gain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नो॑ अग्ने स॒मिधा॑ वृधा॒नो रे॒वत्पा॑वक॒ श्रव॑स॒स वि भा॑हि । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ vṛdhānáḥ ǀ revát ǀ pāvaka ǀ śrávase ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are the purifier, growing with the fuel we have supplied, blaze for the sake of (securing) food to us, who are possessed of wealth; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॒त्नथा॒ सह॑सा॒ जाय॑मानः स॒द्यः काव्या॑नि॒ बळ॑धत्त॒ विश्वा॑ । आप॑श्च मि॒त्रं धि॒षणा॑ च साधन्दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratná-thā ǀ sáhasā ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ báṭ ǀ adhatta ǀ víśvā ǀā́paḥ ǀ ca ǀ mitrám ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ ca ǀ sādhan ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Engendered by force,Agniverily appropriates, as soon as born, the offerings of the sages; the waters and voice make him their friend, and the gods retain him as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पूर्व॑या नि॒विदा॑ क॒व्यता॒योरि॒माः प्र॒जा अ॑जनय॒न्मनू॑नाम् । वि॒वस्व॑ता॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ द्याम॒पश्च॑ दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pū́rvayā ǀ ni-vídā ǀ kavyátā ǀ āyóḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ajanayat ǀ mánūnām ǀvivásvatā ǀ cákṣasā ǀ dyā́m ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Propitiated) by the primitive laudatory hymn of Āyu, he created the progeny ofManus, and pervades, with his all-investing splendour, the heavens and the firmament; the gods retainAgnias the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॑ळत प्रथ॒मं य॑ज्ञ॒साधं॒ विश॒ आरी॒राहु॑तमृञ्जसा॒नम् । ऊ॒र्जः पु॒त्रं भ॑र॒तं सृ॒प्रदा॑नुं दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īḷata ǀ prathamám ǀ yajña-sā́dham ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́rīḥ ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ ṛñjasānám ǀūrjáḥ ǀ putrám ǀ bharatám ǀ sṛprá-dānum ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approachinghim,let all men adoreAgni, the chief (of the gods), the accomplisher of sacrifices, who is gratified by oblations and propitiated by praises--the offspring of food, the sustainer of (all men), the giver of continual gifts; the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ पुरु॒वार॑पुष्टिर्वि॒दद्गा॒तुं तन॑याय स्व॒र्वित् । वि॒शां गो॒पा ज॑नि॒ता रोद॑स्योर्दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ puruvā́ra-puṣṭiḥ ǀ vidát ǀ gātúm ǀ tánayāya ǀ svaḥ-vít ǀviśā́m ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ janitā́ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the dweller in the firmament, the nourisher with abundant benefits, the bestower ofsvarga, the protector of mankind, the progenitor of heaven and earth, instrumental uct my sons in the right way; the gods retain Agni as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नक्तो॒षासा॒ वर्ण॑मा॒मेम्या॑ने धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेकं॑ समी॒ची । द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: náktoṣásā ǀ várṇam ǀ āmémyāne ítyā-mémyāne ǀ dhāpáyete íti ǀ śíśum ǀ ékam ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀdyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The night and the day, mutually effacing each other's comlexion, give nourishment combined together, to one infant, who, radiant, shines between earth and heaven the gods retainAgnias the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यो बु॒ध्नः सं॒गम॑नो॒ वसू॑नां य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुर्म॑न्म॒साध॑नो॒ वेः । अ॒मृ॒त॒त्वं रक्ष॑माणास एनं दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ budhnáḥ ǀ sam-gámanaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúḥ ǀ manma-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ véríti véḥ ǀamṛta-tvám ǀ rákṣamāṇāsaḥ ǀ enam ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The source of opulence, the bestower of riches, the director of the sacrifice, the accomplisher of the desires (of the man) who has recourse to him; him the gods, preserving their immortality, retain as the giver of (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू च॑ पु॒रा च॒ सद॑नं रयी॒णां जा॒तस्य॑ च॒ जाय॑मानस्य च॒ क्षाम् । स॒तश्च॑ गो॒पां भव॑तश्च॒ भूरे॑र्दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाम्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ ca ǀ purā́ ǀ ca ǀ sádanam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ jātásya ǀ ca ǀ jā́yamānasya ǀ ca ǀ kṣā́m ǀsatáḥ ǀ ca ǀ gopā́m ǀ bhávataḥ ǀ ca ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhārayan ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods retainAgnias the giver of (sacrificial) wealth, who now is, and heretofore has been, the abode of riches, the receptacle of all that has been, and all that will be, born, and the preserver of all (that) exists, (as well as of all) that are coming into existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒वि॒णो॒दा द्रवि॑णसस्तु॒रस्य॑ द्रविणो॒दाः सन॑रस्य॒ प्र यं॑सत् । द्र॒वि॒णो॒दा वी॒रव॑ती॒मिषं॑ नो द्रविणो॒दा रा॑सते दी॒र्घमायु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ turásya ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ sánarasya ǀ prá ǀ yaṃsat ǀdraviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ rāsate ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Draviṇodā grant us (a portion) of moveable wealth; may Draviṇodā grant us (a portion) of that which is stationary; may Draviṇodā give us food attended byprogeny; may Draviṇodā bestow upon us long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नो॑ अग्ने स॒मिधा॑ वृधा॒नो रे॒वत्पा॑वक॒ श्रव॑स॒॒ वि भा॑हि । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ vṛdhānáḥ ǀ revát ǀ pāvaka ǀ śrávase ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus,Agni, who are the purifier gowing with the fuel (we have supplied), blaze for the sake of securing food to us, who are possessed of wealth and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घमग्ने॑ शुशु॒ग्ध्या र॒यिम् । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǀ ágne ǀ śuśugdhí ǀ ā́ ǀ rayím ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our sin,Agni, be repented of; manifest riches to us; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒क्षे॒त्रि॒या सु॑गातु॒या व॑सू॒या च॑ यजामहे । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: su-kṣetriyā́ ǀ sugātu-yā́ ǀ vasu-yā́ ǀ ca ǀ yajāmahe ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worship you for plural asant fields, for good roads, and for riches; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यद्भन्दि॑ष्ठ एषां॒ प्रास्माका॑सश्च सू॒रय॑: । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ bhándiṣṭhaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ prá ǀ asmā́kāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(in like manner as, among these your worshippers,Kutsa) is the pre-eminent panegyrist, so are our encomiasts (of you) the most distinguished; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यत्ते॑ अग्ने सू॒रयो॒ जाये॑महि॒ प्र ते॑ व॒यम् । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ jā́yemahi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as your worshippers (are blessed with descentants), so may we, (by repeating your praise), obtain posterity; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यद॒ग्नेः सह॑स्वतो वि॒श्वतो॒ यन्ति॑ भा॒नव॑: । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ agnéḥ ǀ sáhasvataḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ yánti ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since the victorious flames ofAgnipenetrate universally, may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि वि॑श्वतोमुख वि॒श्वत॑: परि॒भूरसि॑ । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ viśvataḥ-mukha ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ ási ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, whose countenance is turned to all sides, are our defender; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्विषो॑ नो विश्वतोमु॒खाति॑ ना॒वेव॑ पारय । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: dvíṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ viśvataḥ-mukha ǀ áti ǀ nāvā́-iva ǀ pāraya ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, whose countenance is turned to all sides, send off our adversaries, as if in a ship, (to the opposite shore); may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒: सिन्धु॑मिव ना॒वयाति॑ पर्षा स्व॒स्तये॑ । अप॑ न॒: शोशु॑चद॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ síndhum-iva ǀ nāváyā ǀ áti ǀ parṣa ǀ svastáye ǀápa ǀ naḥ ǀ śóśucat ǀ aghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you convey us in a ship across the sea, for our welfare; may our sin be repented of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म॒ राजा॒ हि कं॒ भुव॑नानामभि॒श्रीः । इ॒तो जा॒तो विश्व॑मि॒दं वि च॑ष्टे वैश्वान॒रो य॑तते॒ सूर्ये॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarásya ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǀ rā́jā ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ bhúvanānām ǀ abhi-śrī́ḥ ǀitáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ yatate ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we continue in the favour ofVaiśvānara, for verily he is the august sovereign of all beings; as soon as genitive rated from this (wood), he surveys the universe; he accompanies the rising sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒ष्टो दि॒वि पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्यां पृ॒ष्टो विश्वा॒ ओष॑धी॒रा वि॑वेश । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः सह॑सा पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः स नो॒ दिवा॒ स रि॒षः पा॑तु॒ नक्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ diví ǀ pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ sáhasā ǀ pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dívā ǀ sáḥ ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ pātu ǀ náktam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is present in the sky, and present upon earth, and who, present, has pervaded all herbs; may the AgniVaiśvānara, who is present in vigour, guard us night and day, against our enemies”

shlokas.sanskrit: वैश्वा॑नर॒ तव॒ तत्स॒त्यम॑स्त्व॒स्मान्रायो॑ म॒घवा॑नः सचन्ताम् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: váiśvānara ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ satyám ǀ astu ǀ asmā́n ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ sacantām ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānara, may this (your adoration be attended) by real (fruit); may precious treasure wait uon us, and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve them to us].”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒तवे॑दसे सुनवाम॒ सोम॑मरातीय॒तो नि द॑हाति॒ वेद॑: । स न॑: पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ ना॒वेव॒ सिन्धुं॑ दुरि॒तात्य॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: jātá-vedase ǀ sunavāma ǀ sómam ǀ arāti-yatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ dahāti ǀ védaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ parṣat ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ víśvā ǀ nāvā́-iva ǀ síndhum ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer oblations ofSomatoJātavedas, may he consume the wealth of those who feel enmity against us; may he transport us over all difficulties; mayAgniconvey us, as in a boat over a river, across all wickedness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यो वृषा॒ वृष्ण्ये॑भि॒: समो॑का म॒हो दि॒वः पृ॑थि॒व्याश्च॑ स॒म्राट् । स॒ती॒नस॑त्वा॒ हव्यो॒ भरे॑षु म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyebhiḥ ǀ sám-okāḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀsatīná-satvā ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ bháreṣu ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is the showerer of desires, who is co-dweller with (all) energies the supreme ruler over the vast heaven and earth, the sender of water, and to be invoked in battles; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्याना॑प्त॒: सूर्य॑स्येव॒ यामो॒ भरे॑भरे वृत्र॒हा शुष्मो॒ अस्ति॑ । वृष॑न्तम॒: सखि॑भि॒: स्वेभि॒रेवै॑र्म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ánāptaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya-iva ǀ yā́maḥ ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ ásti ǀvṛ́ṣan-tamaḥ ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ svébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he whose course, like that of the sun, is not to be overtaken, who in every battle is the slayer of his foes, the witherer (of opponents), who, with his swift-moving friends (the winds), is the most bountiful (of givers); mayIndra, associated with theMarutsbe our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न यस्य॒ रेत॑सो॒ दुघा॑ना॒: पन्था॑सो॒ यन्ति॒ शव॒साप॑रीताः । त॒रद्द्वे॑षाः सास॒हिः पौंस्ये॑भिर्म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ rétasaḥ ǀ dúghānāḥ ǀ pánthāsaḥ ǀ yánti ǀ śávasā ǀ ápari-itāḥ ǀtarát-dveṣāḥ ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ páuṃsyebhiḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, whose rays, powerful and unattainable issue forth like those of the sun, milking (the clouds); he who is victorious over his adversaries, triumphant by his manly energies; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अङ्गि॑रोभि॒रङ्गि॑रस्तमो भू॒द्वृषा॒ वृष॑भि॒: सखि॑भि॒: सखा॒ सन् । ऋ॒ग्मिभि॑ॠ॒ग्मी गा॒तुभि॒र्ज्येष्ठो॑ म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ bhūt ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sán ǀṛgmí-bhiḥ ǀ ṛgmī́ ǀ gātú-bhiḥ ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the swiftest among the swift, most bountiful amongst the bountiful, a friend with friends, venerable among those who claim veneration, and pre-eminent among those deserving of praise; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सू॒नुभि॒र्न रु॒द्रेभि॒ॠभ्वा॑ नृ॒षाह्ये॑ सास॒ह्वाँ अ॒मित्रा॑न् । सनी॑ळेभिः श्रव॒स्या॑नि॒ तूर्व॑न्म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sūnú-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ sasahvā́n ǀ amítrān ǀsá-nīḷebhiḥ ǀ śravasyā́ni ǀ tū́rvan ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty with theRudras, as if with his sons, victorious in battle over his enemies, and sending down with his co-dwellers (the waters which are productive of) food;Indra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑न्यु॒मीः स॒मद॑नस्य क॒र्तास्माके॑भि॒र्नृभि॒: सूर्यं॑ सनत् । अ॒स्मिन्नह॒न्त्सत्प॑तिः पुरुहू॒तो म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ manyu-mī́ḥ ǀ sa-mádanasya ǀ kartā́ ǀ asmā́kebhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sanat ǀasmín ǀ áhan ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, the represser of (hostile) wrath, the author of war, the protector of the good, the invoked of many, share with our people on this day the (light of the) sun; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमू॒तयो॑ रणय॒ञ्छूर॑सातौ॒ तं क्षेम॑स्य क्षि॒तय॑: कृण्वत॒ त्राम् । स विश्व॑स्य क॒रुण॑स्येश॒ एको॑ म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ raṇayat ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ tám ǀ kṣémasya ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ kṛṇvata ǀ trā́m ǀsáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ karúṇasya ǀ īśe ǀ ékaḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hi, his allies, theMaruts, animate in battle; him, men regard as the preserver of their property; he alone presides over every act of worship; mayIndra, associated with the Maruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑प्सन्त॒ शव॑स उत्स॒वेषु॒ नरो॒ नर॒मव॑से॒ तं धना॑य । सो अ॒न्धे चि॒त्तम॑सि॒ ज्योति॑र्विदन्म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ apsanta ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ ut-savéṣu ǀ náraḥ ǀ náram ǀ ávase ǀ tám ǀ dhánāya ǀsáḥ ǀ andhé ǀ cit ǀ támasi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ vidat ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him, a leader (to victory), his worshippers apply in contests of strength for protection and for wealth, as he grants them the light (of conquest) in the bewildering darkness (of battle); mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स स॒व्येन॑ यमति॒ व्राध॑तश्चि॒त्स द॑क्षि॒णे संगृ॑भीता कृ॒तानि॑ । स की॒रिणा॑ चि॒त्सनि॑ता॒ धना॑नि म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ savyéna ǀ yamati ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ dakṣiṇé ǀ sám-gṛbhītā ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀsáḥ ǀ kīríṇā ǀ cit ǀ sánitā ǀ dhánāni ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With his lefthandhe restrains the malignant, with his right he receives the (sacrificial) offerings; he is the giver of riches, (when propitiated) by one who celebrates his praise; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ग्रामे॑भि॒: सनि॑ता॒ स रथे॑भिर्वि॒दे विश्वा॑भिः कृ॒ष्टिभि॒र्न्व१॒॑द्य । स पौंस्ये॑भिरभि॒भूरश॑स्तीर्म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ grā́mebhiḥ ǀ sánitā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ vidé ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ kṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ nú ǀ adyá ǀsáḥ ǀ páuṃsyebhiḥ ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ áśastīḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, along with his attendants, is a benefactor; he is quickly recognized by all men today, through his chariots; by his manly energies he is victor over unruly (adversaries); mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जा॒मिभि॒र्यत्स॒मजा॑ति मी॒ळ्हेऽजा॑मिभिर्वा पुरुहू॒त एवै॑: । अ॒पां तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑यस्य जे॒षे म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ sam-ájāti ǀ mīḷhé ǀ ájāmi-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀapā́m ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ jeṣé ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked by many, he goes to battle with his kinsmen, or with (followers) not of his kindred; he secures the (triumph) of those who trust him, and of their sons and grandsons; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स व॑ज्र॒भृद्द॑स्यु॒हा भी॒म उ॒ग्रः स॒हस्र॑चेताः श॒तनी॑थ॒ ऋभ्वा॑ । च॒म्री॒षो न शव॑सा॒ पाञ्च॑जन्यो म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vajra-bhṛ́t ǀ dasyu-hā́ ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ sahásra-cetāḥ ǀ śatá-nīthaḥ ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀcamrīṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śávasā ǀ pā́ñca-janyaḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the wielder of the thunderbolt, the slayer of robbers, fearful and fierce, knowing many things, much eulogized and mighty, and like theSoma, inspiring the five classes of beings with vigour; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्य॒ वज्र॑: क्रन्दति॒ स्मत्स्व॒र्षा दि॒वो न त्वे॒षो र॒वथ॒: शिमी॑वान् । तं स॑चन्ते स॒नय॒स्तं धना॑नि म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ krandati ǀ smát ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ raváthaḥ ǀ śímī-vān ǀtám ǀ sacante ǀ sanáyaḥ ǀ tám ǀ dhánāni ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His thunderbolt draws cries (from his enemies), he is the sender of good waters, brilliant as (the luminary) of heaven, the thunderer, the promoter of beneficent acts, upon him do donations and riches attend; mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्याज॑स्रं॒ शव॑सा॒ मान॑मु॒क्थं प॑रिभु॒जद्रोद॑सी वि॒श्वत॑: सीम् । स पा॑रिष॒त्क्रतु॑भिर्मन्दसा॒नो म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ájasram ǀ śávasā ǀ mā́nam ǀ ukthám ǀ pari-bhuját ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ sīm ǀsáḥ ǀ pāriṣat ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, of whom the excellent measure (of all things), through strength, eternally and everywhere cherishes heaven and earth, propitiated by our acts, convey us beyond (evil); mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यस्य॑ दे॒वा दे॒वता॒ न मर्ता॒ आप॑श्च॒न शव॑सो॒ अन्त॑मा॒पुः । स प्र॒रिक्वा॒ त्वक्ष॑सा॒ क्ष्मो दि॒वश्च॑ म॒रुत्वा॑न्नो भव॒त्विन्द्र॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devátā ǀ ná ǀ mártāḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ caná ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ ántam ǀ āpúḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ pra-ríkvā ǀ tvákṣasā ǀ kṣmáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ marútvān ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nor gods, nor men, nor waters, have reached the limit of the strength of that beneficent (divinity) for he surpasses both earth and heaven by his foe-consuming (might); mayIndra, associated with theMaruts, be our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रो॒हिच्छ्या॒वा सु॒मदं॑शुर्लला॒मीर्द्यु॒क्षा रा॒य ऋ॒ज्राश्व॑स्य । वृष॑ण्वन्तं॒ बिभ्र॑ती धू॒र्षु रथं॑ म॒न्द्रा चि॑केत॒ नाहु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: rohít ǀ śyāvā́ ǀ sumát-aṃśuḥ ǀ lalāmī́ḥ ǀ dyukṣā́ ǀ rāyé ǀ ṛjrá-aśvasya ǀvṛ́ṣaṇ-vantam ǀ bíbhratī ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ rátham ǀ mandrā́ ǀ ciketa ǀ nā́huṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The red and black coursers, long-limbed, well-caparisoned, and celestial, an dharnessed, well-plural ased, to the yoke of the chariot in which the showerer of benefits is conveyed, for the enrichment ofṚjrāśva, an dis recognized amongst human hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तत्त्यत्त॑ इन्द्र॒ वृष्ण॑ उ॒क्थं वा॑र्षागि॒रा अ॒भि गृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑: । ऋ॒ज्राश्व॒: प्रष्टि॑भिरम्ब॒रीष॑: स॒हदे॑वो॒ भय॑मानः सु॒राधा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ tyát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ ukthám ǀ vārṣāgirā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀṛjrá-aśvaḥ ǀ práṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ ambarī́ṣaḥ ǀ sahá-devaḥ ǀ bháyamānaḥ ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, showerer (of benefits), the Vārṣāgirās,Ṛjrāśvaand his companions,Ambariṣa,Sahadeva, Bhayamāna, and Surādhās, address to you this propitiatory praise].”

shlokas.sanskrit: दस्यू॒ञ्छिम्यूँ॑श्च पुरुहू॒त एवै॑र्ह॒त्वा पृ॑थि॒व्यां शर्वा॒ नि ब॑र्हीत् । सन॒त्क्षेत्रं॒ सखि॑भिः श्वि॒त्न्येभि॒: सन॒त्सूर्यं॒ सन॑द॒पः सु॒वज्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dásyūn ǀ śímyūn ǀ ca ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ hatvā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ śárvā ǀ ní ǀ barhīt ǀsánat ǀ kṣétram ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ śvitnyébhiḥ ǀ sánat ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sánat ǀ apáḥ ǀ su-vájraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is invoked by many, attended by the moving (Maruts), having attacked theDasyusand the Śimyus, slew them with his thunderbolt; the thunderer then divided the fields with his white-complexioned friends, and rescued the sun and set free the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्वाहेन्द्रो॑ अधिव॒क्ता नो॑ अ॒स्त्वप॑रिह्वृताः सनुयाम॒ वाज॑म् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: viśvā́hā ǀ índraḥ ǀ adhi-vaktā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ ápari-hvṛtāḥ ǀ sanuyāma ǀ vā́jam ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndrabe daily our vindicator, and may we, with undiverted course, enjoy (abundant) food; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us].”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र म॒न्दिने॑ पितु॒मद॑र्चता॒ वचो॒ यः कृ॒ष्णग॑र्भा नि॒रह॑न्नृ॒जिश्व॑ना । अ॒व॒स्यवो॒ वृष॑णं॒ वज्र॑दक्षिणं म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ mandíne ǀ pitu-mát ǀ arcata ǀ vácaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kṛṣṇá-garbhāḥ ǀ niḥ-áhan ǀ ṛjíśvanā ǀavasyávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vájra-dakṣiṇam ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer adoration with oblations to him who is delighted (with praise), who, with Ṛjiśvan, destroyed the pregnant wives ofKṛṣṇa; desirous of protection, we invoke, to become our friend, him, who is the showerer (of benefits), who holds the thunderbolt in his righthand, attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो व्यं॑सं जाहृषा॒णेन॑ म॒न्युना॒ यः शम्ब॑रं॒ यो अह॒न्पिप्रु॑मव्र॒तम् । इन्द्रो॒ यः शुष्ण॑म॒शुषं॒ न्यावृ॑णङ्म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀ jahṛṣāṇéna ǀ manyúnā ǀ yáḥ ǀ śámbaram ǀ yáḥ ǀ áhan ǀ píprum ǀ avratám ǀíndraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ aśúṣam ǀ ní ǀ ávṛṇak ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke to be our friend,Indra, who is attended by theMaruts; he who, with increasing wrath, slew the mutilatedVṛtraandŚambara, and the unrighteous Pipru, and who extirpated the unabsorbableŚuṣṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पौंस्यं॑ म॒हद्यस्य॑ व्र॒ते वरु॑णो॒ यस्य॒ सूर्य॑: । यस्येन्द्र॑स्य॒ सिन्ध॑व॒: सश्च॑ति व्र॒तं म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ mahát ǀ yásya ǀ vraté ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀyásya ǀ índrasya ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ sáścati ǀ vratám ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke to become our friend,Indra, who is attended by theMaruts; whose great power (pervades) heaven and earth, in whose serviceVaruṇaandSūryaare steadfast, and whose commadn the rivers obey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अश्वा॑नां॒ यो गवां॒ गोप॑तिर्व॒शी य आ॑रि॒तः कर्म॑णिकर्मणि स्थि॒रः । वी॒ळोश्चि॒दिन्द्रो॒ यो असु॑न्वतो व॒धो म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ áśvānām ǀ yáḥ ǀ gávām ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ vaśī́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ āritáḥ ǀ kármaṇi-karmaṇi ǀ sthiráḥ ǀvīḷóḥ ǀ cit ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásunvataḥ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who is th elord over all horses and cattle, who is independent, who, propitiated by praise, is constant in every act, and who is the slayer of the obstinate abstainer from libations; we invoke to become our friend,Indra, attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो विश्व॑स्य॒ जग॑तः प्राण॒तस्पति॒र्यो ब्र॒ह्मणे॑ प्रथ॒मो गा अवि॑न्दत् । इन्द्रो॒ यो दस्यूँ॒रध॑राँ अ॒वाति॑रन्म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ jágataḥ ǀ prāṇatáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ brahmáṇe ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ávindat ǀíndraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ ádharān ǀ ava-átirat ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who is the lord of all moving and breathing creatures, who first recovered the (stolen) kine for theBrāhmaṇa, and who slew the humbledDasyus; we invoke to become our friend,Indra, attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः शूरे॑भि॒र्हव्यो॒ यश्च॑ भी॒रुभि॒र्यो धाव॑द्भिर्हू॒यते॒ यश्च॑ जि॒ग्युभि॑: । इन्द्रं॒ यं विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि सं॑द॒धुर्म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śū́rebhiḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ bhīrú-bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhā́vat-bhiḥ ǀ hūyáte ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ jigyúbhiḥ ǀíndram ǀ yám ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ sam-dadhúḥ ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who is to be invoked by the brave and by the timid, by the vanquished and by victors, and whom all eings plural ce before them (in their ites); we invoke to become our friend,Indra, attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रु॒द्राणा॑मेति प्र॒दिशा॑ विचक्ष॒णो रु॒द्रेभि॒र्योषा॑ तनुते पृ॒थु ज्रय॑: । इन्द्रं॑ मनी॒षा अ॒भ्य॑र्चति श्रु॒तं म॒रुत्व॑न्तं स॒ख्याय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: rudrā́ṇām ǀ eti ǀ pra-díśā ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ yóṣā ǀ tanute ǀ pṛthú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀíndram ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ abhí ǀ arcati ǀ śrutám ǀ marútvantam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The radiantIndraproceeds (along the firmament) with the manifestation of theRudras; through the Rudras, speech spreads with more expansive celerity, and praise glorifies the renowned Indra; him, attended by theMaruts, we invoke to become our friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑ मरुत्वः पर॒मे स॒धस्थे॒ यद्वा॑व॒मे वृ॒जने॑ मा॒दया॑से । अत॒ आ या॑ह्यध्व॒रं नो॒ अच्छा॑ त्वा॒या ह॒विश्च॑कृमा सत्यराधः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ marutvaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ avamé ǀ vṛjáne ǀ mādáyāse ǀátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ adhvarám ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ cakṛma ǀ satya-rādhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Attended by the winds, giver of true wealth, whether you may be plural ased (to dwell) in a stately mansion or in a lowly dwelling, come to our sacrifice; desirous of your presence, we offer you oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वा॒येन्द्र॒ सोमं॑ सुषुमा सुदक्ष त्वा॒या ह॒विश्च॑कृमा ब्रह्मवाहः । अधा॑ नियुत्व॒: सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॑र॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: tvā-yā́ ǀ indra ǀ sómam ǀ susuma ǀ su-dakṣa ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ cakṛma ǀ brahma-vāhaḥ ǀádha ǀ niyutvaḥ ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ mādayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of you,Indra, who are possessed of excellent strenghth, we pour forth to you libations desirous of you, who are obtained by prayer, we offer you oblations; therefore, do you, who are possessed of horses, sit down with plural asure upon the sacred grass, attended by theMaruts, at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒दय॑स्व॒ हरि॑भि॒र्ये त॑ इन्द्र॒ वि ष्य॑स्व॒ शिप्रे॒ वि सृ॑जस्व॒ धेने॑ । आ त्वा॑ सुशिप्र॒ हर॑यो वहन्तू॒शन्ह॒व्यानि॒ प्रति॑ नो जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: mādáyasva ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ ví ǀ syasva ǀ śípre íti ǀ ví ǀ sṛjasva ǀ dhéne íti ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ su-śipra ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ uśán ǀ havyā́ni ǀ práti ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rejoice,Indra, with the steeds who are of your nature; open your jaws, set wide your throat (to drinkSoma); let your horses bring you, who have a handsome chin, (hither), and, benignant towards us, be plural ased by our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्स्तो॑त्रस्य वृ॒जन॑स्य गो॒पा व॒यमिन्द्रे॑ण सनुयाम॒ वाज॑म् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: marút-stotrasya ǀ vṛjánasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ vayám ǀ índreṇa ǀ sanuyāma ǀ vā́jam ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protected by that destroyer (of foes), who is united in praise with theMaruts, we may receive sustenance fromIndra; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi-- ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां ते॒ धियं॒ प्र भ॑रे म॒हो म॒हीम॒स्य स्तो॒त्रे धि॒षणा॒ यत्त॑ आन॒जे । तमु॑त्स॒वे च॑ प्रस॒वे च॑ सास॒हिमिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वास॒: शव॑सामद॒न्ननु॑
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ te ǀ dhíyam ǀ prá ǀ bhare ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ asyá ǀ stotré ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ānajé ǀtám ǀ ut-savé ǀ ca ǀ pra-savé ǀ ca ǀ sasahím ǀ índram ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ amadan ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I address to you, who are mighty, this excellent hymn, because your understanding has been gratified by my praise; the gods have successively delighted that victoriousIndrawith the power (of praise), for the sake of prosperity and wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य श्रवो॑ न॒द्य॑: स॒प्त बि॑भ्रति॒ द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ पृथि॒वी द॑र्श॒तं वपु॑: । अ॒स्मे सू॑र्याचन्द्र॒मसा॑भि॒चक्षे॑ श्र॒द्धे कमि॑न्द्र चरतो वितर्तु॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ bibhrati ǀ dyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ darśatám ǀ vápuḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ sūryācandramásā ǀ abhi-cákṣe ǀ śraddhé ǀ kám ǀ indra ǀ carataḥ ǀ vi-tarturám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven rivers display his glory; heaven, and earth, and sky display his visible form; the sun and moon,Indra,perform their revolution, that we may see, and have faith in what we see.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं स्मा॒ रथं॑ मघव॒न्प्राव॑ सा॒तये॒ जैत्रं॒ यं ते॑ अनु॒मदा॑म संग॒मे । आ॒जा न॑ इन्द्र॒ मन॑सा पुरुष्टुत त्वा॒यद्भ्यो॑ मघव॒ञ्छर्म॑ यच्छ नः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sma ǀ rátham ǀ magha-van ǀ prá ǀ ava ǀ sātáye ǀ jáitram ǀ yám ǀ te ǀ anu-mádāma ǀ sam-gamé ǀājā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mánasā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ tvāyát-bhyaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, despatch your chariot to bring us wealth; that victorious car which,Indra, who are much praised by us in time of war, we rejoice to behold in battle; do you, Maghavan, grant happiness to those who are devoted to you. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ज॑येम॒ त्वया॑ यु॒जा वृत॑म॒स्माक॒मंश॒मुद॑वा॒ भरे॑भरे । अ॒स्मभ्य॑मिन्द्र॒ वरि॑वः सु॒गं कृ॑धि॒ प्र शत्रू॑णां मघव॒न्वृष्ण्या॑ रुज
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ jayema ǀ tváyā ǀ yujā́ ǀ vṛ́tam ǀ asmā́kam ǀ áṃśam ǀ út ǀ ava ǀ bháre-bhare ǀasmábhyam ǀ indra ǀ várivaḥ ǀ su-gám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ prá ǀ śátrūṇām ǀ magha-van ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ ruja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, having you for our ally, overcome our adversaries in every encounter; defend our portion; render riches easily attained by us; enfeebleMaghavan, the vigour of our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाना॒ हि त्वा॒ हव॑माना॒ जना॑ इ॒मे धना॑नां धर्त॒रव॑सा विप॒न्यव॑: । अ॒स्माकं॑ स्मा॒ रथ॒मा ति॑ष्ठ सा॒तये॒ जैत्रं॒ ही॑न्द्र॒ निभृ॑तं॒ मन॒स्तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: nā́nā ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hávamānāḥ ǀ jánāḥ ǀ imé ǀ dhánānām ǀ dhartaḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ sma ǀ rátham ǀ ā́ ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ sātáye ǀ jáitram ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ ní-bhṛtam ǀ mánaḥ ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the men who call upon you for your protection; mount your car to bring wealth to us, for your mind,Indra, is composed, and resolved of victory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गो॒जिता॑ बा॒हू अमि॑तक्रतुः सि॒मः कर्म॑न्कर्मञ्छ॒तमू॑तिः खजंक॒रः । अ॒क॒ल्प इन्द्र॑: प्रति॒मान॒मोज॒साथा॒ जना॒ वि ह्व॑यन्ते सिषा॒सव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: go-jítā ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ámita-kratuḥ ǀ simáḥ ǀ kárman-karman ǀ śatám-ūtiḥ ǀ khajam-karáḥ ǀakalpáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ ójasā ǀ átha ǀ jánāḥ ǀ ví ǀ hvayante ǀ sisāsávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your arms are the winners of cattle, your wisdom is unbounded, you are most excellent, the granter of a hundred aids in every rite; the author of war,Indrais uncontrolled; the type of strength; wherefore men, who are desirous of wealth, invoke him in various ways.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॑ श॒तान्म॑घव॒न्नुच्च॒ भूय॑स॒ उत्स॒हस्रा॑द्रिरिचे कृ॒ष्टिषु॒ श्रव॑: । अ॒मा॒त्रं त्वा॑ धि॒षणा॑ तित्विषे म॒ह्यधा॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जिघ्नसे पुरंदर
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śatā́t ǀ magha-van ǀ út ǀ ca ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǀ út ǀ sahásrāt ǀ ririce ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀamātrám ǀ tvā ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ titviṣe ǀ mahī́ ǀ ádha ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnase ǀ puram-dara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The food,Maghavan, (which is to be given by you) to men, may be more than sufficient for a hundred, oor for more, even, than a thousand; great praise has glorified you, who are without limit, whereupon you destroy your enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒वि॒ष्टि॒धातु॑ प्रति॒मान॒मोज॑सस्ति॒स्रो भूमी॑र्नृपते॒ त्रीणि॑ रोच॒ना । अती॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं ववक्षिथाश॒त्रुरि॑न्द्र ज॒नुषा॑ स॒नाद॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: triviṣṭi-dhā́tu ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ ójasaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ bhū́mīḥ ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀáti ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ vavakṣitha ǀ aśatrúḥ ǀ indra ǀ janúṣā ǀ sanā́t ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strong as a twice-twisted rope, you are the type of strength; protector of men, that are more than able to sustain the three spheres, the three luminaries, and all this world of beings,Indra, who have from birth ever been without a rival.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां दे॒वेषु॑ प्रथ॒मं ह॑वामहे॒ त्वं ब॑भूथ॒ पृत॑नासु सास॒हिः । सेमं न॑: का॒रुमु॑पम॒न्युमु॒द्भिद॒मिन्द्र॑: कृणोतु प्रस॒वे रथं॑ पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ devéṣu ǀ prathamám ǀ havāmahe ǀ tvám ǀ babhūtha ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sasahíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ kārúm ǀ upa-manyúm ǀ ut-bhídam ǀ índraḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ pra-savé ǀ rátham ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,Indra, the first among the gods; you have been the victor in battles; may Indra put foremost in the battle this our chariot, which is efficient, impetuous, and the uprooter (of all impediments).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं जि॑गेथ॒ न धना॑ रुरोधि॒थार्भे॑ष्वा॒जा म॑घवन्म॒हत्सु॑ च । त्वामु॒ग्रमव॑से॒ सं शि॑शीम॒स्यथा॑ न इन्द्र॒ हव॑नेषु चोदय
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ jigetha ǀ ná ǀ dhánā ǀ rurodhitha ǀ árbheṣu ǀ ājā́ ǀ magha-van ǀ mahát-su ǀ ca ǀtvā́m ǀ ugrám ǀ ávase ǀ sám ǀ śiśīmasi ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ hávaneṣu ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You conquer, and withhold not the booty; in trifling or in serious conflicts, we sharpen you, fierceMaghavan, for our defence; do you, therefore, inspirit us in our defiances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्वाहेन्द्रो॑ अधिव॒क्ता नो॑ अ॒स्त्वप॑रिह्वृताः सनुयाम॒ वाज॑म् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: viśvā́hā ǀ índraḥ ǀ adhi-vaktā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ ápari-hvṛtāḥ ǀ sanuyāma ǀ vā́jam ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndradaily be our vindicator, and may we, with undiverted course, enjoy abundant food; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त॑ इन्द्रि॒यं प॑र॒मं प॑रा॒चैरधा॑रयन्त क॒वय॑: पु॒रेदम् । क्ष॒मेदम॒न्यद्दि॒व्य१॒॑न्यद॑स्य॒ समी॑ पृच्यते सम॒नेव॑ के॒तुः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ paramám ǀ parācáiḥ ǀ ádhārayanta ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ idám ǀkṣamā́ ǀ idám ǀ anyát ǀ diví ǀ anyát ǀ asya ǀ sám ǀ īmíti ǀ pṛcyate ǀ samanā́-iva ǀ ketúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sages have formerly been possessed of this your supreme power,Indra, as if it were present with them, one light of whom shines upon the earth, the other in heaven, and both are in combination with each other, as banner (mingles with banner) in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स धा॑रयत्पृथि॒वीं प॒प्रथ॑च्च॒ वज्रे॑ण ह॒त्वा निर॒पः स॑सर्ज । अह॒न्नहि॒मभि॑नद्रौहि॒णं व्यह॒न्व्यं॑सं म॒घवा॒ शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ dhārayat ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ papráthat ǀ ca ǀ vájreṇa ǀ hatvā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sasarja ǀáhan ǀ áhim ǀ ábhinat ǀ rauhiṇám ǀ ví ǀ áhan ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He upholds, and has spread out, the earth; having struck (the clouds), he has extricated the waters; he has slain Ahi, he has piercedRauhiṇa, he has destroyed, by his prowess, the mutilated (Vṛtra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जा॒तूभ॑र्मा श्र॒द्दधा॑न॒ ओज॒: पुरो॑ विभि॒न्दन्न॑चर॒द्वि दासी॑: । वि॒द्वान्व॑ज्रि॒न्दस्य॑वे हे॒तिम॒स्यार्यं॒ सहो॑ वर्धया द्यु॒म्नमि॑न्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jātū́-bharmā ǀ śrat-dádhānaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ vi-bhindán ǀ acarat ǀ ví ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀvidvā́n ǀ vajrin ǀ dásyave ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǀ ā́ryam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ vardhaya ǀ dyumnám ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Armed with the thunderbolt, and confident in his strength, he has gone on destroying the cities of theDasyus. Thunderer, acknowledging (the praises of your worshipper) cast, for his sake, your shaft agains theDasyu, and augment the strength and glory of theĀrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदू॒चुषे॒ मानु॑षे॒मा यु॒गानि॑ की॒र्तेन्यं॑ म॒घवा॒ नाम॒ बिभ्र॑त् । उ॒प॒प्र॒यन्द॑स्यु॒हत्या॑य व॒ज्री यद्ध॑ सू॒नुः श्रव॑से॒ नाम॑ द॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ūcúṣe ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ imā́ ǀ yugā́ni ǀ kīrtényam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ nā́ma ǀ bíbhrat ǀupa-prayán ǀ dasyu-hátyāya ǀ vajrī́ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ nā́ma ǀ dadhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, possessing a name that is to be glorified, offers to him who celebrates it, these (revolving) ages of man; the thunderer, the scatterer (of his foes), sallying forth to destroy theDasyus, has obtained a name (renowned for victorious) prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॑स्ये॒दं प॑श्यता॒ भूरि॑ पु॒ष्टं श्रदिन्द्र॑स्य धत्तन वी॒र्या॑य । स गा अ॑विन्द॒त्सो अ॑विन्द॒दश्वा॒न्त्स ओष॑धी॒: सो अ॒पः स वना॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ asya ǀ idám ǀ paśyata ǀ bhū́ri ǀ puṣṭám ǀ śrát ǀ índrasya ǀ dhattana ǀ vīryā́ya ǀsáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avindat ǀ sáḥ ǀ avindat ǀ áśvān ǀ sáḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vánāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Behold this, the vast and extensive (might ofIndra); have confidence in his prowess; he has recovered the cattle, he has recovered the horses, the plural nts, the waters, the woods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॑कर्मणे वृष॒भाय॒ वृष्णे॑ स॒त्यशु॑ष्माय सुनवाम॒ सोम॑म् । य आ॒दृत्या॑ परिप॒न्थीव॒ शूरोऽय॑ज्वनो वि॒भज॒न्नेति॒ वेद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri-karmaṇe ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ satyá-śuṣmāya ǀ sunavāma ǀ sómam ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-dṛ́tya ǀ paripanthī́-iva ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ vi-bhájan ǀ éti ǀ védaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer theSomalibation to him who is the performer of many exploits, the best (of the gods), the showerer (of benefits), the possessor of true strength, the hero who, holding respect for wealth, takes it from him who performs no sacrifice, like a foot-pad (from a traveller), and proceeds (to give it) to the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदि॑न्द्र॒ प्रेव॑ वी॒र्यं॑ चकर्थ॒ यत्स॒सन्तं॒ वज्रे॒णाबो॑ध॒योऽहि॑म् । अनु॑ त्वा॒ पत्नी॑र्हृषि॒तं वय॑श्च॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अमद॒न्ननु॑ त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ indra ǀ prá-iva ǀ vīryám ǀ cakartha ǀ yát ǀ sasántam ǀ vájreṇa ǀ ábodhayaḥ ǀ áhim ǀánu ǀ tvā ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ hṛṣitám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amadan ǀ ánu ǀ tvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You did perform,Indra, a glorious deed, when you did awaken the sleeping Ahi with your thunderbolt; then the wives (of the gods), theMaruts, and all the gods, imitated your exultation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुष्णं॒ पिप्रुं॒ कुय॑वं वृ॒त्रमि॑न्द्र य॒दाव॑धी॒र्वि पुर॒: शम्ब॑रस्य । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: śúṣṇam ǀ píprum ǀ kúyavam ǀ vṛtrám ǀ indra ǀ yadā́ ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀ ví ǀ púraḥ ǀ śámbarasya ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as you have slainŚuṣṇa, Pipru,KuyavaandVṛtra, and destroyed the cities ofŚambara, therefore mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, grant us that (which we desire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: योनि॑ष्ट इन्द्र नि॒षदे॑ अकारि॒ तमा नि षी॑द स्वा॒नो नार्वा॑ । वि॒मुच्या॒ वयो॑ऽव॒सायाश्वा॑न्दो॒षा वस्तो॒र्वही॑यसः प्रपि॒त्वे
shlokas.transliteration: yóniḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ ni-sáde ǀ akāri ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīda ǀ svānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǀvi-múcya ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ava-sā́ya ǀ áśvān ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ váhīyasaḥ ǀ pra-pitvé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The altar has been raised,Indra, for your seat; hasten to sit upon it as a neighing horse (hastens to his stable); slackening the reins, and letting your coursers free, who, at the season of sacrifice, bear you night and day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ त्ये नर॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑ गु॒र्नू चि॒त्तान्त्स॒द्यो अध्व॑नो जगम्यात् । दे॒वासो॑ म॒न्युं दास॑स्य श्चम्न॒न्ते न॒ आ व॑क्षन्त्सुवि॒ताय॒ वर्ण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ tyé ǀ náraḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǀ guḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ tā́n ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ dā́sasya ǀ ścamnan ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣan ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ várṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These person ns have come toIndra(to solicit) his protection; may he quickly direct them on the way; may the gods repress the wrathof the destroyer, and bring to our solemnity the obviator of evil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ त्मना॑ भरते॒ केत॑वेदा॒ अव॒ त्मना॑ भरते॒ फेन॑मु॒दन् । क्षी॒रेण॑ स्नात॒: कुय॑वस्य॒ योषे॑ ह॒ते ते स्या॑तां प्रव॒णे शिफा॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ tmánā ǀ bharate ǀ kéta-vedāḥ ǀ áva ǀ tmánā ǀ bharate ǀ phénam ǀ udán ǀkṣīréṇa ǀ snātaḥ ǀ kúyavasya ǀ yóṣe íti ǀ haté íti ǀ té íti ǀ syātām ǀ pravaṇé ǀ śíphāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheAsura), knowing the wealth of others, carries it off of himself; present in the water, he carries off, of himself, the foam; the two wives ofKuyavabathe with the water; may they be drowned in the depths of theŚiphāriver.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒योप॒ नाभि॒रुप॑रस्या॒योः प्र पूर्वा॑भिस्तिरते॒ राष्टि॒ शूर॑: । अ॒ञ्ज॒सी कु॑लि॒शी वी॒रप॑त्नी॒ पयो॑ हिन्वा॒ना उ॒दभि॑र्भरन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: yuyópa ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ úparasya ǀ āyóḥ ǀ prá ǀ pū́rvābhiḥ ǀ tirate ǀ rā́ṣṭi ǀ śū́raḥ ǀañjasī́ ǀ kuliśī́ ǀ vīrá-patnī ǀ páyaḥ ǀ hinvānā́ḥ ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǀ bharante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The abiding-plural ce of the vagrant (Kuyava) was concealed (in the midst) of the water; the hero increases with the waters formerly (carried off), and is renowned (throughout the world); the Añjasī, kuliśī and Vīrapatni rivers, plural asing him with their substance, sustain him with their waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॒ यत्स्या नीथाद॑र्शि॒ दस्यो॒रोको॒ नाच्छा॒ सद॑नं जान॒ती गा॑त् । अध॑ स्मा नो मघवञ्चर्कृ॒तादिन्मा नो॑ म॒घेव॑ निष्ष॒पी परा॑ दाः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ yát ǀ syā́ ǀ nī́thā ǀ ádarśi ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áccha ǀ sádanam ǀ jānatī́ ǀ gāt ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ carkṛtā́t ǀ ít ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ maghā́-iva ǀ niṣṣapī́ ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since the track that leads to the dwelling of theDasyuhas been seen by us, as a cow knows the way to her stall, therefore do you,Maghavan, (defend us) from his repeated violence; do not you cast away as a libertine throws away wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं न॑ इन्द्र॒ सूर्ये॒ सो अ॒प्स्व॑नागा॒स्त्व आ भ॑ज जीवशं॒से । मान्त॑रां॒ भुज॒मा री॑रिषो न॒: श्रद्धि॑तं ते मह॒त इ॑न्द्रि॒याय॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ sū́rye ǀ sáḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ anāgāḥ-tvé ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ jīva-śaṃsé ǀmā́ ǀ ántarām ǀ bhújam ǀ ā́ ǀ ririṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śráddhitam ǀ te ǀ mahaté ǀ indriyā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Excite in us,Indra, veneration for the sun, for the waters, and for those who are worthy of the praise of living beings, as exempt from sin; injure not our offspring while yet in the womb, for our trust is in yourmighty power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ मन्ये॒ श्रत्ते॑ अस्मा अधायि॒ वृषा॑ चोदस्व मह॒ते धना॑य । मा नो॒ अकृ॑ते पुरुहूत॒ योना॒विन्द्र॒ क्षुध्य॑द्भ्यो॒ वय॑ आसु॒तिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ manye ǀ śrát ǀ te ǀ asmai ǀ adhāyi ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ codasva ǀ mahaté ǀ dhánāya ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ákṛte ǀ puru-hūta ǀ yónau ǀ índra ǀ kṣúdhyat-bhyaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ā-sutím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hence,Indra, I meditate on you; on his (your power) has our trust been plural ced; showerer (of benefits), direct us to great wealth; consign us not, you who are invoked by many, to a destitute dwelling; give, Indra, food and drink to the hungry.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ वधीरिन्द्र॒ मा परा॑ दा॒ मा न॑: प्रि॒या भोज॑नानि॒ प्र मो॑षीः । आ॒ण्डा मा नो॑ मघवञ्छक्र॒ निर्भे॒न्मा न॒: पात्रा॑ भेत्स॒हजा॑नुषाणि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadhīḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́ ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ priyā́ ǀ bhójanāni ǀ prá ǀ moṣīḥ ǀāṇḍā́ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ śakra ǀ níḥ ǀ bhet ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pā́trā ǀ bhet ǀ sahá-jānuṣāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm us not,Indra, abandon us not; deprive us not of the enjoyments that aare dear to us; injure not, affluentŚakra, our unborn offspring; harm not those who are capable (only of crawling) on their knees.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाङेहि॒ सोम॑कामं त्वाहुर॒यं सु॒तस्तस्य॑ पिबा॒ मदा॑य । उ॒रु॒व्यचा॑ ज॒ठर॒ आ वृ॑षस्व पि॒तेव॑ नः शृणुहि हू॒यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ṅ ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ sóma-kāmam ǀ tvā ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ tásya ǀ piba ǀ mádāya ǀuru-vyácāḥ ǀ jaṭháre ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇuhi ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come into our presence; they have called you, fond of theSoma; it is prepared; drink of it for your exhilaration; vast of limb, distend your stomach, and when invoked hear us, as a father (listens to the words of his sons).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रमा॑ अ॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तरा सु॑प॒र्णो धा॑वते दि॒वि । न वो॑ हिरण्यनेमयः प॒दं वि॑न्दन्ति विद्युतो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: candrámāḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ dhāvate ǀ diví ǀná ǀ vaḥ ǀ hiraṇya-nemayaḥ ǀ padám ǀ vindanti ǀ vi-dyutaḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The graceful-movingmoonspeeds along the middle region in the sky; bright golden rays (my eyes) behold not your abidding-plural ce. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्थ॒मिद्वा उ॑ अ॒र्थिन॒ आ जा॒या यु॑वते॒ पति॑म् । तु॒ञ्जाते॒ वृष्ण्यं॒ पय॑: परि॒दाय॒ रसं॑ दुहे वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: ártham ǀ ít ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ arthínaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jāyā́ ǀ yuvate ǀ pátim ǀtuñjā́te íti ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pari-dā́ya ǀ rásam ǀ duhe ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who seek for wealth, obtain it; a wife enjoys (the presence of) her husband, and from their union progeny is engendered. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु दे॑वा अ॒दः स्व१॒॑रव॑ पादि दि॒वस्परि॑ । मा सो॒म्यस्य॑ श॒म्भुव॒: शूने॑ भूम॒ कदा॑ च॒न वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ devāḥ ǀ adáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ áva ǀ pādi ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀmā́ ǀ somyásya ǀ śam-bhúvaḥ ǀ śū́ne ǀ bhūma ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never, Gods, may this (my ancestry), abiding above in heaven, be excluded (from it); never may we be in want (of a son), the cause of joy (to his progenitors), entitled to libations of theSoma. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञं पृ॑च्छाम्यव॒मं स तद्दू॒तो वि वो॑चति । क्व॑ ऋ॒तं पू॒र्व्यं ग॒तं कस्तद्बि॑भर्ति॒ नूत॑नो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: yajñám ǀ pṛcchāmi ǀ avamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ tát ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ví ǀ vocati ǀkvá ǀ ṛtám ǀ pūrvyám ǀ gatám ǀ káḥ ǀ tát ǀ bibharti ǀ nū́tanaḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I implore the first (of the gods), the object of sacrifice, that he will become my messenger, and narrate (my condition to the other deities). Where,Agni, is your former benevolence, what new being now possesses it? Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मी ये दे॑वा॒: स्थन॑ त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः । कद्व॑ ऋ॒तं कदनृ॑तं॒ क्व॑ प्र॒त्ना व॒ आहु॑तिर्वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: amī́ íti ǀ yé ǀ devāḥ ǀ sthána ǀ triṣú ǀ ā́ ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǀkát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ kát ǀ ánṛtam ǀ kvá ǀ pratnā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́-hutiḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, who are present in thethree worlds, who abide in the light of the sun, where now is your truth, where your untruth, where the ancient invocation (that I have addressed) to you? Heaven and earth, be conscious of (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कद्व॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ धर्ण॒सि कद्वरु॑णस्य॒ चक्ष॑णम् । कद॑र्य॒म्णो म॒हस्प॒थाति॑ क्रामेम दू॒ढ्यो॑ वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dharṇasí ǀ kát ǀ váruṇasya ǀ cákṣaṇam ǀkát ǀ aryamṇáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ áti ǀ krāmema ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where, deities, is your observance of the truth, where the (benignant) regard ofVaruṇa, where is the path of the mightyAryaman, (so that) we may overcome the malevolent? Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं सो अ॑स्मि॒ यः पु॒रा सु॒ते वदा॑मि॒ कानि॑ चित् । तं मा॑ व्यन्त्या॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ वृको॒ न तृ॒ष्णजं॑ मृ॒गं वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmi ǀ yáḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ suté ǀ vádāmi ǀ kā́ni ǀ cit ǀtám ǀ mā ǀ vyanti ǀ ā-dhyáḥ ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛṣṇá-jam ǀ mṛgám ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am he, Gods, who formerly recited (your praise) when the libation was poured out; yet sorrows assail me, like a wolf (that falls upon) a thirsty deer. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं मा॑ तपन्त्य॒भित॑: स॒पत्नी॑रिव॒ पर्श॑वः । मूषो॒ न शि॒श्ना व्य॑दन्ति मा॒ध्य॑: स्तो॒तारं॑ ते शतक्रतो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ mā ǀ tapanti ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ sapátnīḥ-iva ǀ párśavaḥ ǀmū́ṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śiśnā́ ǀ ví ǀ adanti ǀ mā ǀ ā-dhyáḥ ǀ stotā́ram ǀ te ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ribs (of the well close) round me, like the rival wives (of one husband); cares consume me,Śatakratu, although your worshipper, as a rat (gnaws a weaver's) threads. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मी ये स॒प्त र॒श्मय॒स्तत्रा॑ मे॒ नाभि॒रात॑ता । त्रि॒तस्तद्वे॑दा॒प्त्यः स जा॑मि॒त्वाय॑ रेभति वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: amī́ íti ǀ yé ǀ saptá ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ tátra ǀ me ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́-tatā ǀtritáḥ ǀ tát ǀ veda ǀ āptyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ jāmi-tvā́ya ǀ rebhati ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those which are the seven rays (of the sun), in them is my navel expanded;Trita, the son of the waters, knows that (it is so), and he praises them for his extrication (from the well). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मी ये पञ्चो॒क्षणो॒ मध्ये॑ त॒स्थुर्म॒हो दि॒वः । दे॒व॒त्रा नु प्र॒वाच्यं॑ सध्रीची॒ना नि वा॑वृतुर्वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: amī́ íti ǀ yé ǀ páñca ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀdeva-trā́ ǀ nú ǀ pra-vā́cyam ǀ sadhrīcīnā́ḥ ǀ ní ǀ vavṛtuḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
