shlokas.meaning_en: “May the five shedders (of benefits), who abide in the centre of the expanded heavens, having together conveyed my prayers quickly to the gods, (speedily) return. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प॒र्णा ए॒त आ॑सते॒ मध्य॑ आ॒रोध॑ने दि॒वः । ते से॑धन्ति प॒थो वृकं॒ तर॑न्तं य॒ह्वती॑र॒पो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: su-parṇā́ḥ ǀ eté ǀ āsate ǀ mádhye ǀ ā-ródhane ǀ diváḥ ǀté ǀ sedhanti ǀ patháḥ ǀ vṛ́kam ǀ tárantam ǀ yahvátīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rays of the sun abide in the surrounding centre of heaven; they drive back the wolf crossing the great waters from the path. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नव्यं॒ तदु॒क्थ्यं॑ हि॒तं देवा॑सः सुप्रवाच॒नम् । ऋ॒तम॑र्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः स॒त्यं ता॑तान॒ सूर्यो॑ वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: návyam ǀ tát ǀ ukthyám ǀ hitám ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ su-pravācanám ǀṛtám ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ satyám ǀ tatāna ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That new praiseworthy and commended (vigour) is seated in you, ye Gods, (by which) the rivers urge on the waters, and the sun diffuses his constant (light). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तव॒ त्यदु॒क्थ्यं॑ दे॒वेष्व॒स्त्याप्य॑म् । स न॑: स॒त्तो म॑नु॒ष्वदा दे॒वान्य॑क्षि वि॒दुष्ट॑रो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ táva ǀ tyát ǀ ukthyám ǀ devéṣu ǀ asti ǀ ā́pyam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sattáḥ ǀ manuṣvát ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ yakṣi ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worthy of praise,Agni, is that your relationship 9with the gods), do you, who are most wise, seated at our (solemnity) worship (the gods), as (at the sacrifice of)Manu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्तो होता॑ मनु॒ष्वदा दे॒वाँ अच्छा॑ वि॒दुष्ट॑रः । अ॒ग्निर्ह॒व्या सु॑षूदति दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॒ मेधि॑रो वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: sattáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ manuṣvát ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ susūdati ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that wise and liberalAgni, a sage amongst the gods, seated at our rite, as at the sacrifice ofManu, be the invoker of the deities, and offer them oblations. Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा॑ कृणोति॒ वरु॑णो गातु॒विदं॒ तमी॑महे । व्यू॑र्णोति हृ॒दा म॒तिं नव्यो॑ जायतामृ॒तं वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmā ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ gātu-vídam ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǀví ǀ ūrṇoti ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ matím ǀ návyaḥ ǀ jāyatām ǀ ṛtám ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇaperforms the rite of preservation; we desire him as guide of our way; (to him, the repeater of praise) addresses praise with his (whole) heart; may he who is entitled to laudation become our true (support). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒सौ यः पन्था॑ आदि॒त्यो दि॒वि प्र॒वाच्यं॑ कृ॒तः । न स दे॑वा अति॒क्रमे॒ तं म॑र्तासो॒ न प॑श्यथ वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: asáu ǀ yáḥ ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ diví ǀ pra-vā́cyam ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀná ǀ sáḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ati-kráme ǀ tám ǀ martāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ paśyatha ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun, who is avowedly made the path in heaven, is not to be disregarded, Gods, by you; but you, mortals, regard him not. Heaven and earth be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒तः कूपेऽव॑हितो दे॒वान्ह॑वत ऊ॒तये॑ । तच्छु॑श्राव॒ बृह॒स्पति॑: कृ॒ण्वन्नं॑हूर॒णादु॒रु वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: tritáḥ ǀ kū́pe ǀ áva-hitaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ havate ǀ ūtáye ǀtát ǀ śuśrāva ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ kṛṇván ǀ aṃhūraṇā́t ǀ urú ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Trita, fallen into the well, invokes the Gods for succour;Bṛhaspati, who liberates many from sin, heard (the submission). Heaven and earth, be conscious of this (my affliction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रु॒णो मा॑ स॒कृद्वृक॑: प॒था यन्तं॑ द॒दर्श॒ हि । उज्जि॑हीते नि॒चाय्या॒ तष्टे॑व पृष्ट्याम॒यी वि॒त्तं मे॑ अ॒स्य रो॑दसी
shlokas.transliteration: aruṇáḥ ǀ mā ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ yántam ǀ dadárśa ǀ hí ǀút ǀ jihīte ǀ ni-cā́yya ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ pṛṣṭi-āmayī́ ǀ vittám ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ rodasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Once, a tawny wolf beheld me faring on my way, and having seen me, rushed upon me, (rearing) as a carpenter, whose back aches (with stooping, standing erect in his work).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒नाङ्गू॒षेण॑ व॒यमिन्द्र॑वन्तो॒ऽभि ष्या॑म वृ॒जने॒ सर्व॑वीराः । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: enā́ ǀ āṅgūṣéṇa ǀ vayám ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ vṛjáne ǀ sárva-vīrāḥ ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By this recitation, may we, becoming possessed ofIndra, and strong with multiplied progeny, overcome our foes in battle; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi---ocean, earth and heaven, be gracious to us in this (request).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ मि॒त्रं वरु॑णम॒ग्निमू॒तये॒ मारु॑तं॒ शर्धो॒ अदि॑तिं हवामहे । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ agním ǀ ūtáye ǀ mā́rutam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ áditim ǀ havāmahe ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke, for our preservation,Indra,Mitra,Varuṇa,Agni, the might of theMaruts, andAditi; may they, who are bountiful and bestowers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त आ॑दित्या॒ आ ग॑ता स॒र्वता॑तये भू॒त दे॑वा वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑षु श॒म्भुव॑: । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ sarvá-tātaye ǀ bhūtá ǀ devāḥ ǀ vṛtra-tū́ryeṣu ǀ śam-bhúvaḥ ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sons ofAditi, come with all (your hosts) to battle; be to us the cause of happiness in combats, and may they, whoare bountiful and bestowers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑न्तु नः पि॒तर॑: सुप्रवाच॒ना उ॒त दे॒वी दे॒वपु॑त्रे ऋता॒वृधा॑ । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: ávantu ǀ naḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ su-pravācanā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ devī́ íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhā ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the Pitrṣ, who are easily to be praised protect us; and may the two divinities, heaven and earth, the promoters of sacrifices, and of whom, the gods are progeny, protect us; and may they, who are bountiful and givers of dwellings, extricate us from sin, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंसं॑ वा॒जिनं॑ वा॒जय॑न्नि॒ह क्ष॒यद्वी॑रं पू॒षणं॑ सु॒म्नैरी॑महे । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ vājínam ǀ vājáyan ǀ ihá ǀ kṣayát-vīram ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exciting him who is the praised of men and the giver of food, (to be present) at this rite, we solicit (also) with our praises him who is the purifier and destroyer of heroes; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of food, extricate us from sun, as a chariot from a defile”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते॒ सद॒मिन्न॑: सु॒गं कृ॑धि॒ शं योर्यत्ते॒ मनु॑र्हितं॒ तदी॑महे । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ naḥ ǀ su-gám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mánuḥ-hitam ǀ tát ǀ īmahe ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, always confer happiness upon us, we solicit that faculty of both (alleviating pain and obvitaing peril) implanted in you byManu; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings extricate us from all sins, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ कुत्सो॑ वृत्र॒हणं॒ शची॒पतिं॑ का॒टे निबा॑ळ्ह॒ ऋषि॑रह्वदू॒तये॑ । रथं॒ न दु॒र्गाद्व॑सवः सुदानवो॒ विश्व॑स्मान्नो॒ अंह॑सो॒ निष्पि॑पर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ kútsaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ śacī́-pátim ǀ kāṭé ǀ ní-bāḷhaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ ahvat ǀ ūtáye ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-gā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ pipartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kutsa, the ṛṣi, thrown into a well, has invoked to his succour,Indra, the slayer of enemies, the encourager of good works; may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वैर्नो॑ दे॒व्यदि॑ति॒र्नि पा॑तु दे॒वस्त्रा॒ता त्रा॑यता॒मप्र॑युच्छन् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: deváiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǀ deváḥ ǀ trātā́ ǀ trāyatām ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the goddess,Aditi, with the gods, protect us, and may the radiant guardian, (the sun), be vigilant fo rour protection; and may they, who are bountiful and the givers of dwellings, extricate us from all sin, as a chariot from a defile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृळ॒यन्त॑: । आ वो॒ऽर्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्यादं॒होश्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ práti ǀ eti ǀ sumnám ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ bhávata ǀ mṛḷayántaḥ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ arvā́cī ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vavṛtyāt ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ yā́ ǀ varivovít-tarā ǀ ásat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our sacrifice give satisfaction to the gods;Ādityas, be gracious, and may your good intentions be directed towards us, so as to be abundant source of affliction to the poor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒सा ग॑म॒न्त्वङ्गि॑रसां॒ साम॑भिः स्तू॒यमा॑नाः । इन्द्र॑ इन्द्रि॒यैर्म॒रुतो॑ म॒रुद्भि॑रादि॒त्यैर्नो॒ अदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यंसत्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gamantu ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ sā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ stūyámānāḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ indriyáiḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gods, who are to be lauded by the hymns of theAṅgirasas, come hither for our protection; mayIndrawith his treasures, theMarutswith the vital airs, andAditiwith theĀdityas(come and) give us felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॒ इन्द्र॒स्तद्वरु॑ण॒स्तद॒ग्निस्तद॑र्य॒मा तत्स॑वि॒ता चनो॑ धात् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ tát ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ tát ǀ agníḥ ǀ tát ǀ aryamā́ ǀ tát ǀ savitā́ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, mayVaruṇa, mayAgni, mayAryaman, maySavitā, bestow upon us that food (which we solicit); and mayMitra, Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, preserve it (to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॑न्द्राग्नी चि॒त्रत॑मो॒ रथो॑ वाम॒भि विश्वा॑नि॒ भुव॑नानि॒ चष्टे॑ । तेना या॑तं स॒रथं॑ तस्थि॒वांसाथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ citrá-tamaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vām ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ cáṣṭe ǀténa ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ sa-rátham ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsā ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, sitting together in your car, that wonderful car which illuminates all beings, approach and drink of the effusedSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याव॑दि॒दं भुव॑नं॒ विश्व॒मस्त्यु॑रु॒व्यचा॑ वरि॒मता॑ गभी॒रम् । तावाँ॑ अ॒यं पात॑वे॒ सोमो॑ अ॒स्त्वर॑मिन्द्राग्नी॒ मन॑से यु॒वभ्या॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́vat ǀ idám ǀ bhúvanam ǀ víśvam ǀ ásti ǀ uru-vyácā ǀ varimátā ǀ gabhīrám ǀtā́vān ǀ ayám ǀ pā́tave ǀ sómaḥ ǀ astu ǀ áram ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ mánase ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vast as is the whole universe in expanse, and profound indepth, such,IndraandAgni, may thisSomabe for you, sufficient for your desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒क्राथे॒ हि स॒ध्र्य१॒॑ङ्नाम॑ भ॒द्रं स॑ध्रीची॒ना वृ॑त्रहणा उ॒त स्थ॑: । तावि॑न्द्राग्नी स॒ध्र्य॑ञ्चा नि॒षद्या॒ वृष्ण॒: सोम॑स्य वृष॒णा वृ॑षेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: cakrā́the íti ǀ hí ǀ sadhryák ǀ nā́ma ǀ bhadrám ǀ sadhrīcīnā́ ǀ vṛtra-hanau ǀ utá ǀ sthaḥ ǀtáu ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ sadhryáñcā ǀ ni-sádya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have made your associated names renowned, since, slayers ofVṛtra, you have been allied (for his death); the showerers of benefits,IndraandAgni, are the two seated together (on the altar); receive (your portion) of theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धेष्व॒ग्निष्वा॑नजा॒ना य॒तस्रु॑चा ब॒र्हिरु॑ तिस्तिरा॒णा । ती॒व्रैः सोमै॒: परि॑षिक्तेभिर॒र्वागेन्द्रा॑ग्नी सौमन॒साय॑ यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddheṣu ǀ agníṣu ǀ ānajānā́ ǀ yatá-srucā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tistirāṇā́ ǀtīvráiḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ pári-siktebhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ ā́ ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ yātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The first being kindled the two (priests stand by) sprinkling the clarified butter from the ladles, which they raise, and spreading the sacred grass (upon the altar); therefore,IndraandAgni, come before us for our gratification, (attracted) by stimulatingSomasprinkled all round.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यानी॑न्द्राग्नी च॒क्रथु॑र्वी॒र्या॑णि॒ यानि॑ रू॒पाण्यु॒त वृष्ण्या॑नि । या वां॑ प्र॒त्नानि॑ स॒ख्या शि॒वानि॒ तेभि॒: सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ni ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ yā́ni ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ utá ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀyā́ ǀ vām ǀ pratnā́ni ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ śivā́ni ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever heroic exploits you ahve achieved whatever forms (you have created), whatever benefits (you have poured down), whatever ancient and fortunate friendships (you have contracted, come with them all), and drink of the effusedSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदब्र॑वं प्रथ॒मं वां॑ वृणा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽयं सोमो॒ असु॑रैर्नो वि॒हव्य॑: । तां स॒त्यां श्र॒द्धाम॒भ्या हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ábravam ǀ prathamám ǀ vām ǀ vṛṇānáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ásuraiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vi-hávyaḥ ǀtā́m ǀ satyā́m ǀ śraddhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come and witness the sincere faith with which, selecting you two, I first promised (you the libation); drink of the effused libation, for theSomais prepared by the priests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी॒ मद॑थ॒: स्वे दु॑रो॒णे यद्ब्र॒ह्मणि॒ राज॑नि वा यजत्रा । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ mádathaḥ ǀ své ǀ duroṇé ǀ yát ǀ brahmáṇi ǀ rā́jani ǀ vā ǀ yajatrā ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If, adorableIndraandAgni, you have ever been delighted (withlibations) in your own dwelling, in tha tof aBrāhmaṇa, or in that of a prince, then, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी॒ यदु॑षु तु॒र्वशे॑षु॒ यद्द्रु॒ह्युष्वनु॑षु पू॒रुषु॒ स्थः । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ yáduṣu ǀ turváśeṣu ǀ yát ǀ druhyúṣu ǀ ánuṣu ǀ pūrúṣu ǀ stháḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If,IndraandAgni, you are amongst men who are in offensive, malevolent, or tyrannical, or those who live (to fulfil the duties of life), or those who receive the fruits (of good deeds), then, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी अव॒मस्यां॑ पृथि॒व्यां म॑ध्य॒मस्यां॑ पर॒मस्या॑मु॒त स्थः । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ avamásyām ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ madhyamásyām ǀ paramásyām ǀ utá ǀ stháḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,IndraandAgni, you are in the lower, the central, or the upper region of the world, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी पर॒मस्यां॑ पृथि॒व्यां म॑ध्य॒मस्या॑मव॒मस्या॑मु॒त स्थः । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ paramásyām ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ madhyamásyām ǀ avamásyām ǀ utá ǀ stháḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,IndraandAgni, you are in the upper, central, or lower region of the world, come,showerers of benefits, hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी दि॒वि ष्ठो यत्पृ॑थि॒व्यां यत्पर्व॑ते॒ष्वोष॑धीष्व॒प्सु । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ diví ǀ stháḥ ǀ yát ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yát ǀ párvateṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,IndraandAgni, you are in heaven or upon earth, in the mountains, in the herbs, or in the waters, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you may be, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्राग्नी॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ मध्ये॑ दि॒वः स्व॒धया॑ मा॒दये॑थे । अत॒: परि॑ वृषणा॒वा हि या॒तमथा॒ सोम॑स्य पिबतं सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ mádhye ǀ diváḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ mādáyethe íti ǀátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ yātám ǀ átha ǀ sómasya ǀ pibatam ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,IndraandAgni, in the midst of the sky, on the rising of the sun, you may be exhilarated by your own splendour, yet, showerers of benefits, come hither from wherever you maybe, and drink of the effusedSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेन्द्रा॑ग्नी पपि॒वांसा॑ सु॒तस्य॒ विश्वा॒स्मभ्यं॒ सं ज॑यतं॒ धना॑नि । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ papi-vā́ṃsā ǀ sutásya ǀ víśvā ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sám ǀ jayatam ǀ dhánāni ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus,IndraandAgni, drinking deep of the libation, grant to us all (kinds of) wealth; and mayMitra,VaruṇaandAditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ह्यख्यं॒ मन॑सा॒ वस्य॑ इ॒च्छन्निन्द्रा॑ग्नी ज्ञा॒स उ॒त वा॑ सजा॒तान् । नान्या यु॒वत्प्रम॑तिरस्ति॒ मह्यं॒ स वां॒ धियं॑ वाज॒यन्ती॑मतक्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ hí ǀ ákhyam ǀ mánasā ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ icchán ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ jñāsáḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sa-jātā́n ǀná ǀ anyā́ ǀ yuvát ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ asti ǀ máhyam ǀ sáḥ ǀ vām ǀ dhíyam ǀ vāja-yántīm ǀ atakṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, desirous of wealth, I consider you, in my mind, as kinsmen and relations; the clear understanding you have given me, (is given) by no one else, and (so gifted), I have composed this hymn to you, intimating my wish for sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्र॑वं॒ हि भू॑रि॒दाव॑त्तरा वां॒ विजा॑मातुरु॒त वा॑ घा स्या॒लात् । अथा॒ सोम॑स्य॒ प्रय॑ती यु॒वभ्या॒मिन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ स्तोमं॑ जनयामि॒ नव्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśravam ǀ hí ǀ bhūridā́vat-tarā ǀ vām ǀ ví-jāmātuḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ syālā́t ǀátha ǀ sómasya ǀ prá-yatī ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ stómam ǀ janayāmi ǀ návyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have heard,IndraandAgni, that you are more munificent givers than an unworthy bridegroom, or the brother of a bride; therefore, as I offer youa Somalibation, I address you, Indra and Agni, with a new hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा च्छे॑द्म र॒श्मीँरिति॒ नाध॑मानाः पितॄ॒णां श॒क्तीर॑नु॒यच्छ॑मानाः । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॒ कं वृष॑णो मदन्ति॒ ता ह्यद्री॑ धि॒षणा॑या उ॒पस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ chedma ǀ raśmī́n ǀ íti ǀ nā́dhamānāḥ ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ śaktī́ḥ ǀ anu-yácchamānāḥ ǀindrāgní-bhyām ǀ kám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ madanti ǀ tā́ ǀ hí ǀ ádrī íti ǀ dhiṣáṇāyāḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never may we cut off the long line (of posterity); thus soliciting and asking for descendants endowed with the vigour of their progenitors, the (worshippers), begetting children, praiseIndraandAgnifor their happiness, and they two, destroyers of foes, are nigh (to hear this adoration).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वाभ्यां॑ दे॒वी धि॒षणा॒ मदा॒येन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ सोम॑मुश॒ती सु॑नोति । ताव॑श्विना भद्रहस्ता सुपाणी॒ आ धा॑वतं॒ मधु॑ना पृ॒ङ्क्तम॒प्सु
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́bhyām ǀ devī́ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ mádāya ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ sómam ǀ uśatī́ ǀ sunoti ǀtáu ǀ aśvinā ǀ bhadra-hastā ǀ supāṇī íti su-pāṇī ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāvatam ǀ mádhunā ǀ pṛṅktám ǀ ap-sú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sacred prayer, desiring your presence, offers to you both,IndraandAgni, for your exhilaration, theSomalibation; do you two, who have horses, handsome arms, and gracefulhands, come quickly and mix (the libation) with sweetness in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वामि॑न्द्राग्नी॒ वसु॑नो विभा॒गे त॒वस्त॑मा शुश्रव वृत्र॒हत्ये॑ । तावा॒सद्या॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑ य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्प्र च॑र्षणी मादयेथां सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀ taváḥ-tamā ǀ śuśrava ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀtáu ǀ ā-sádya ǀ barhíṣi ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀ prá ǀ carṣaṇī íti ǀ mādayethām ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have heard, (when you were present) at the division of the treasure (among the worshippers), that you two,IndraandAgni, were most vigorous in the destruction ofVṛtra; beholders of all things seated at this sacrifice upon the sacred grass, be exhilarated, (by drinking of the effused libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र च॑र्ष॒णिभ्य॑: पृतना॒हवे॑षु॒ प्र पृ॑थि॒व्या रि॑रिचाथे दि॒वश्च॑ । प्र सिन्धु॑भ्य॒: प्र गि॒रिभ्यो॑ महि॒त्वा प्रेन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॒नात्य॒न्या
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ pṛtanā-háveṣu ǀ prá ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ riricāthe íti ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀprá ǀ síndhu-bhyaḥ ǀ prá ǀ girí-bhyaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ prá ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ áti ǀ anyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Attending to the summons at the time of battle, you surpass all me (in magnitude); you are vaster than the earth, than the sky, than the rivers, than the mountains; you exceed all other existent things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भ॑रतं॒ शिक्ष॑तं वज्रबाहू अ॒स्माँ इ॑न्द्राग्नी अवतं॒ शची॑भिः । इ॒मे नु ते र॒श्मय॒: सूर्य॑स्य॒ येभि॑: सपि॒त्वं पि॒तरो॑ न॒ आस॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bharatam ǀ śíkṣatam ǀ vajrabāhū íti vajra-bāhū ǀ asmā́n ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ avatam ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀimé ǀ nú ǀ té ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ sa-pitvám ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́san ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring wealth, thunderers, and give it to us; protect us,IndraandAgni, by your deeds; may those rays of the sun, by which our forefathers have attained together a hevenly region, shine also upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुरं॑दरा॒ शिक्ष॑तं वज्रहस्ता॒स्माँ इ॑न्द्राग्नी अवतं॒ भरे॑षु । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: púram-darā ǀ śíkṣatam ǀ vajra-hastā ǀ asmā́n ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ avatam ǀ bháreṣu ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, wielders of the thunderbolt, overturners of cities, grant us wealth, defens us in battles; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be propitious to this (our prayer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒तं मे॒ अप॒स्तदु॑ तायते॒ पुन॒: स्वादि॑ष्ठा धी॒तिरु॒चथा॑य शस्यते । अ॒यं स॑मु॒द्र इ॒ह वि॒श्वदे॑व्य॒: स्वाहा॑कृतस्य॒ समु॑ तृप्णुत ऋभवः
shlokas.transliteration: tatám ǀ me ǀ ápaḥ ǀ tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tāyate ǀ púnaríti ǀ svā́diṣṭhā ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ ucáthāya ǀ śasyate ǀayám ǀ samudráḥ ǀ ihá ǀ viśvá-devyaḥ ǀ svā́hā-kṛtasya ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tṛpṇuta ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, the rite formerly celebrated by me is again repeated, and the melodious hymn is recited in your praise; in this ceremony, theSomais sufficient for all the gods; drink of it to your utmost content when offered on the fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒भो॒गयं॒ प्र यदि॒च्छन्त॒ ऐत॒नापा॑का॒: प्राञ्चो॒ मम॒ के चि॑दा॒पय॑: । सौध॑न्वनासश्चरि॒तस्य॑ भू॒मनाग॑च्छत सवि॒तुर्दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā-bhogáyam ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ icchántaḥ ǀ áitana ǀ ápākāḥ ǀ prā́ñcaḥ ǀ máma ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ āpáyaḥ ǀsáudhanvanāsaḥ ǀ caritásya ǀ bhūmánā ǀ ágacchata ǀ savitúḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Ṛbhus, you who are amongst my ancestors, yet immature (in wisdom), but desirous of enjoying (theSomalibations), retired to the forest to perform (penance), then, sons ofSudhanvan, throught he plural nitude of your completed (devotions), you came to the (sacrificial) hall of the worshipperSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्स॑वि॒ता वो॑ऽमृत॒त्वमासु॑व॒दगो॑ह्यं॒ यच्छ्र॒वय॑न्त॒ ऐत॑न । त्यं चि॑च्चम॒समसु॑रस्य॒ भक्ष॑ण॒मेकं॒ सन्त॑मकृणुता॒ चतु॑र्वयम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ savitā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ asuvat ǀ ágohyam ǀ yát ǀ śraváyantaḥ ǀ áitana ǀtyám ǀ cit ǀ camasám ǀ ásurasya ǀ bhákṣaṇam ǀ ékam ǀ sántam ǀ akṛṇuta ǀ cátuḥ-vayam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThenSavitābestowed upon you immortality, when you came to him, who is not to be concealed, and representd (your desire) to partake of the libations; and that ladle for the sacrificial viands which theAsurahad formed single, you made fourfold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒ष्ट्वी शमी॑ तरणि॒त्वेन॑ वा॒घतो॒ मर्ता॑स॒: सन्तो॑ अमृत॒त्वमा॑नशुः । सौ॒ध॒न्व॒ना ऋ॒भव॒: सूर॑चक्षसः संवत्स॒रे सम॑पृच्यन्त धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: viṣṭvī́ ǀ śámī ǀ taraṇi-tvéna ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ sántaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀsaudhanvanā́ḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǀ saṃvatsaré ǀ sám ǀ apṛcyanta ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with the priests, and quickly performing the holy rites, they, being yet mortals, acquired immortality and the son ofSudhanvan, theṚbhus, brilliant as the sun, became connected with the ceremonies (appropriated to the different season) of the year.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेत्र॑मिव॒ वि म॑मु॒स्तेज॑नेनँ॒ एकं॒ पात्र॑मृ॒भवो॒ जेह॑मानम् । उप॑स्तुता उप॒मं नाध॑माना॒ अम॑र्त्येषु॒ श्रव॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: kṣétram-iva ǀ ví ǀ mamuḥ ǀ téjanena ǀ ékam ǀ pā́tram ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ jéhamānam ǀúpa-stutāḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ nā́dhamānāḥ ǀ ámartyeṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ icchámānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lauded by the bystanders, theṚbhus, with a sharp weapon, meted outt the single sacrificial ladle, like a field (measured by a rod), soliciting the best (libations) and desiring (to participate of) sacrificial food amongs thte gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ म॑नी॒षाम॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य॒ नृभ्य॑: स्रु॒चेव॑ घृ॒तं जु॑हवाम वि॒द्मना॑ । त॒र॒णि॒त्वा ये पि॒तुर॑स्य सश्चि॒र ऋ॒भवो॒ वाज॑मरुहन्दि॒वो रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ antárikṣasya ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ srucā́-iva ǀ ghṛtám ǀ juhavāma ǀ vidmánā ǀtaraṇi-tvā́ ǀ yé ǀ pitúḥ ǀ asya ǀ saściré ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ aruhan ǀ diváḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To the leaders (of the sacrifice), dwelling in the firmament, we present, as with a ladle, the appointed clarified butter, and praise with knowledge thoseṚbhus, who, having equalled the velocityof the protector (of the universe, the sun), ascended to the region of heaven, through (the offerings) of (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुर्न॒ इन्द्र॒: शव॑सा॒ नवी॑यानृ॒भुर्वाजे॑भि॒र्वसु॑भि॒र्वसु॑र्द॒दिः । यु॒ष्माकं॑ देवा॒ अव॒साह॑नि प्रि॒ये॒३॒॑ऽभि ति॑ष्ठेम पृत्सु॒तीरसु॑न्वताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ návīyān ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ áhani ǀ priyé ǀ abhí ǀ tiṣṭhema ǀ pṛtsutī́ḥ ǀ ásunvatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most excellentṚbhuis in strength our defender; Ṛbhu, through gifts of food and of wealth, is our asylum; may he bestow them upon us, Gods, through your protection; may we, upon a favourable occasion, overcome the hosts of those who offer no libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निश्चर्म॑ण ऋभवो॒ गाम॑पिंशत॒ सं व॒त्सेना॑सृजता मा॒तरं॒ पुन॑: । सौध॑न्वनासः स्वप॒स्यया॑ नरो॒ जिव्री॒ युवा॑ना पि॒तरा॑कृणोतन
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ cármaṇaḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ apiṃśata ǀ sám ǀ vatséna ǀ asṛjata ǀ mātáram ǀ púnaríti ǀsáudhanvanāsaḥ ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ naraḥ ǀ jívrī íti ǀ yúvānā ǀ pitárā ǀ akṛṇotana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, you covered the cow with a hide, and reunited themother with the calf; sons ofSudhanvan, leaders (of sacrifice), through your good works you rendered your aged parents young.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाजे॑भिर्नो॒ वाज॑सातावविड्ढ्यृभु॒माँ इ॑न्द्र चि॒त्रमा द॑र्षि॒ राध॑: । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: vā́jebhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ ṛbhu-mā́n ǀ indra ǀ citrám ǀ ā́ ǀ darṣi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, associated with theṚbhus, supply us, in the distribution of viands, with food, and consent to bestow upon us wonderful riches; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, preserve them fo rus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तक्ष॒न्रथं॑ सु॒वृतं॑ विद्म॒नाप॑स॒स्तक्ष॒न्हरी॑ इन्द्र॒वाहा॒ वृष॑ण्वसू । तक्ष॑न्पि॒तृभ्या॑मृ॒भवो॒ युव॒द्वय॒स्तक्ष॑न्व॒त्साय॑ मा॒तरं॑ सचा॒भुव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tákṣan ǀ rátham ǀ su-vṛ́tam ǀ vidmanā́-apasaḥ ǀ tákṣan ǀ hárī íti ǀ indra-vā́hā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇvasū íti vṛ́ṣaṇ-vasū ǀtákṣan ǀ pitṛ́-bhyām ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ yúvat ǀ váyaḥ ǀ tákṣan ǀ vatsā́ya ǀ mātáram ǀ sacā-bhúvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheṚbhus, possessed of skill in their work, constructed (for theAśvins) a well-built car; they framed the vigorous horses bearingIndra; they gave youthful existence to their parents; they gave to the calf its accompanying mother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञाय॑ तक्षत ऋभु॒मद्वय॒: क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य सुप्र॒जाव॑ती॒मिष॑म् । यथा॒ क्षया॑म॒ सर्व॑वीरया वि॒शा तन्न॒: शर्धा॑य धासथा॒ स्वि॑न्द्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ takṣata ǀ ṛbhu-mát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ su-prajā́vatīm ǀ íṣam ǀyáthā ǀ kṣáyāma ǀ sárva-vīrayā ǀ viśā́ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ dhāsatha ǀ sú ǀ indriyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prepare fully for our sacrifice resplendent sacrificial food, and for our rite and for our strength, such nutriments as may be the cause of excellent progeny, so that we may live (surrounded) by vigorous descendants, such wealth do you confer upon us for our benefit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त॑क्षत सा॒तिम॒स्मभ्य॑मृभवः सा॒तिं रथा॑य सा॒तिमर्व॑ते नरः । सा॒तिं नो॒ जैत्रीं॒ सं म॑हेत वि॒श्वहा॑ जा॒मिमजा॑मिं॒ पृत॑नासु स॒क्षणि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ takṣata ǀ sātím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ sātím ǀ ráthāya ǀ sātím ǀ árvate ǀ naraḥ ǀsātím ǀ naḥ ǀ jáitrīm ǀ sám ǀ maheta ǀ viśváhā ǀ jāmím ǀ ájāmim ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sakṣáṇim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhusconductors (of sacrifice), bestow ample sustenance upon us, upon our chariots, upon our horses; let every one daily acknowledge our victorious wealth, and may we triumph in battle over our foes; whether strangers or kinsmen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भु॒क्षण॒मिन्द्र॒मा हु॑व ऊ॒तय॑ ऋ॒भून्वाजा॑न्म॒रुत॒: सोम॑पीतये । उ॒भा मि॒त्रावरु॑णा नू॒नम॒श्विना॒ ते नो॑ हिन्वन्तु सा॒तये॑ धि॒ये जि॒षे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhukṣáṇam ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀ ūtáye ǀ ṛbhū́n ǀ vā́jān ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀubhā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvínā ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ hinvantu ǀ sātáye ǀ dhiyé ǀ jiṣé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the mightyIndrafor protection, and theṚbhu,VājasandMarutsto drink theSoma, also bothMitra,Varuṇaand theAśvins; and may they direct us to opulence, to holy rites, and to victory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुर्भरा॑य॒ सं शि॑शातु सा॒तिं स॑मर्य॒जिद्वाजो॑ अ॒स्माँ अ॑विष्टु । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ bhárāya ǀ sám ǀ śiśātu ǀ sātím ǀ samarya-jít ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviṣṭu ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayṚbhusupply us with wealth for war; mayVāja, victorious in battle, protect us, and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, be propitious ot this our prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पू॒र्वचि॑त्तये॒ऽग्निं घ॒र्मं सु॒रुचं॒ याम॑न्नि॒ष्टये॑ । याभि॒र्भरे॑ का॒रमंशा॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ॒स्ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀ agním ǀ gharmám ǀ su-rúcam ǀ yā́man ǀ iṣṭáye ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ bháre ǀ kārám ǀ áṃśāya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise Heaven and Earth for preliminary meditation, (prior to the coming of theAśvins); I praise the hot and bright-shiningAgniupon their approach, (as preparatory) to their worship; with those appliances with which you sound the conch-shell in battle for your share (in the booty), with those aids, Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोर्दा॒नाय॑ सु॒भरा॑ अस॒श्चतो॒ रथ॒मा त॑स्थुर्वच॒सं न मन्त॑वे । याभि॒र्धियोऽव॑थ॒: कर्म॑न्नि॒ष्टये॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ su-bhárāḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ vacasám ǀ ná ǀ mántave ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ kárman ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earnest and exclusive adorers stand,Aśvins, round your car, (to benefit) by your bounty, as (disciples listen) to the words (of a teacher) for instrumental uction; with those aids with which you defend the pious who are engaged in acts of worship, come, Aśvins,wilingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं तासां॑ दि॒व्यस्य॑ प्र॒शास॑ने वि॒शां क्ष॑यथो अ॒मृत॑स्य म॒ज्मना॑ । याभि॑र्धे॒नुम॒स्वं१॒॑ पिन्व॑थो नरा॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ tā́sām ǀ divyásya ǀ pra-śā́sane ǀ viśā́m ǀ kṣayathaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ majmánā ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ dhenúm ǀ asvám ǀ pínvathaḥ ǀ narā ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the vigour infused from celestial nectar, you are able, leaders (of sacrifice), to rule over those beings (who people the three worldds); with those aids by which you gave (milk) to the barren cow, come,Aśvins, willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: परि॑ज्मा॒ तन॑यस्य म॒ज्मना॑ द्विमा॒ता तू॒र्षु त॒रणि॑र्वि॒भूष॑ति । याभि॑स्त्रि॒मन्तु॒रभ॑वद्विचक्ष॒णस्ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀ tánayasya ǀ majmánā ǀ dvi-mātā́ ǀ tūrṣú ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ vi-bhū́ṣati ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ tri-mántuḥ ǀ ábhavat ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which the circumambient (wind), endowed with the vigour of his son, the measurer of the two worlds (of heaven and earth), and swiftest of the swift, beautifies (all things), and by which (Kakṣīvat) became learned in the three kinds of sacrifice; with them come,Aśvins, willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभी॑ रे॒भं निवृ॑तं सि॒तम॒द्भ्य उद्वन्द॑न॒मैर॑यतं॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे । याभि॒: कण्वं॒ प्र सिषा॑सन्त॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ rebhám ǀ ní-vṛtam ǀ sitám ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ út ǀ vándanam ǀ áirayatam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ prá ǀ sísāsantam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you raised up from the water, Rebha, who had been cst bound (into a well), and alsoVandana(similarly circumstanced), to behold the sky; by which you protectedKaṇva, when longing to see the light; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒रन्त॑कं॒ जस॑मान॒मार॑णे भु॒ज्युं याभि॑रव्य॒थिभि॑र्जिजि॒न्वथु॑: । याभि॑: क॒र्कन्धुं॑ व॒य्यं॑ च॒ जिन्व॑थ॒स्ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ ántakam ǀ jásamānam ǀ ā-áraṇe ǀ bhujyúm ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ avyathí-bhiḥ ǀ jijinváthuḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ karkándhum ǀ vayyám ǀ ca ǀ jínvathaḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you rescuedAntaka, (when cast into) a deep (pool), and about to be destroyed; by which, inflicting no distress, you preservedBhujyu, and by which you relievedKarkandhuandVayya; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑: शुच॒न्तिं ध॑न॒सां सु॑षं॒सदं॑ त॒प्तं घ॒र्ममो॒म्याव॑न्त॒मत्र॑ये । याभि॒: पृश्नि॑गुं पुरु॒कुत्स॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ śucantí ǀ dhana-sā́m ǀ su-saṃsádam ǀ taptám ǀ gharmám ǀ omyā́-vantam ǀ átraye ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ pṛ́śni-gum ǀ puru-kútsam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you enrichedŚucanti, and gave him a handsome habitation, and rendered the scorching heat plural asurable toAtri, and by which you preserved Pṛśnigu andPurukutsa; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: शची॑भिर्वृषणा परा॒वृजं॒ प्रान्धं श्रो॒णं चक्ष॑स॒ एत॑वे कृ॒थः । याभि॒र्वर्ति॑कां ग्रसि॒ताममु॑ञ्चतं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ parā-vṛ́jam ǀ prá ǀ andhám ǀ śroṇám ǀ cákṣase ǀ étave ǀ kṛtháḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ vártikām ǀ grasitā́m ǀ ámuñcatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerers (of benefits), with those aids by which you enabled (the lame) Parāvṛj (to walk), the blind (Ṛjraśva) to see, and (the cripple)Śroṇato go, and by which you set free the quail when seized (by a wolf); with those aids,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: सिन्धुं॒ मधु॑मन्त॒मस॑श्चतं॒ वसि॑ष्ठं॒ याभि॑रजरा॒वजि॑न्वतम् । याभि॒: कुत्सं॑ श्रु॒तर्यं॒ नर्य॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ síndhum ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ ásaścatam ǀ vásiṣṭham ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ajarau ǀ ájinvatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ kútsam ǀ śrutáryam ǀ náryam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you caused the sweet stream to flow, by which you, who are exempt from decay, gratifiedVāsiṣṭha, and by which you protected (ṛṣis:)Kutsa,Śrutarya, andNarya; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hitheṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑र्वि॒श्पलां॑ धन॒साम॑थ॒र्व्यं॑ स॒हस्र॑मीळ्ह आ॒जावजि॑न्वतम् । याभि॒र्वश॑म॒श्व्यं प्रे॒णिमाव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ viśpálām ǀ dhana-sā́m ǀ atharvyám ǀ sahásra-mīḷhe ǀ ājáu ǀ ájinvatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ váśam ǀ aśvyám ǀ preṇím ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you enabled the opulent Viśpalā, when she was unable to move, to go to the battle rich in a thousand spoils, and by which you protected the devoutVaśa, the son ofAśva; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑: सुदानू औशि॒जाय॑ व॒णिजे॑ दी॒र्घश्र॑वसे॒ मध॒व कोशो॒ अक्ष॑रत् । क॒क्षीव॑न्तं स्तो॒तारं॒ याभि॒राव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀ auśijā́ya ǀ vaṇíje ǀ dīrghá-śravase ǀ mádhu ǀ kóśaḥ ǀ ákṣarat ǀkakṣī́vantam ǀ stotā́ram ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which, beauteous donors, the cloud (was made to) shed its sweet (water), for the sake of the merchantDīrghaśravas, the son of Uṣij, and by which you protected the devoutKakṣīvat; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभी॑ र॒सां क्षोद॑सो॒द्नः पि॑पि॒न्वथु॑रन॒श्वं याभी॒ रथ॒माव॑तं जि॒षे । याभि॑स्त्रि॒शोक॑ उ॒स्रिया॑ उ॒दाज॑त॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ rasā́m ǀ kṣódasā ǀ udnáḥ ǀ pipinváthuḥ ǀ anaśvám ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ā́vatam ǀ jiṣé ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ tri-śókaḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ ut-ā́jata ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you filled the (dry) river-bed”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: सूर्यं॑ परिया॒थः प॑रा॒वति॑ मन्धा॒तारं॒ क्षैत्र॑पत्ये॒ष्वाव॑तम् । याभि॒र्विप्रं॒ प्र भ॒रद्वा॑ज॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ pari-yātháḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ mandhātā́ram ǀ kṣáitra-patyeṣu ǀ ā́vatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ vípram ǀ prá ǀ bharát-vājam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you encompassed the sun, when afar off, (to extricate him from eclipse); by which you defendedMandhātāin (the discharge of) his soverign functions, and by whciḥ you protected the sageBharadvāja; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑र्म॒हाम॑तिथि॒ग्वं क॑शो॒जुवं॒ दिवो॑दासं शम्बर॒हत्य॒ आव॑तम् । याभि॑: पू॒र्भिद्ये॑ त्र॒सद॑स्यु॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ kaśaḥ-júvam ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ śambara-hátye ǀ ā́vatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhídye ǀ trasádasyum ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you defended the mighty and hospitableDivodāsa, (when, having undertaken) the death ofŚambara, he hid himself in the water (through fear of theasuras); by which you protectedTrasadasyuin war; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑र्व॒म्रं वि॑पिपा॒नमु॑पस्तु॒तं क॒लिं याभि॑र्वि॒त्तजा॑निं दुव॒स्यथ॑: । याभि॒र्व्य॑श्वमु॒त पृथि॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ vamrám ǀ vi-pipānám ǀ upa-stutám ǀ kalím ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ vittá-jānim ǀ duvasyáthaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ ví-aśvam ǀ utá ǀ pṛ́thim ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you preserved Vamra, praised by all around him, when drinking (the dews of the earth); by which you protectedKaliwhen he had taken a wife, andPṛthi,when had lost his horse; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑र्नरा श॒यवे॒ याभि॒रत्र॑ये॒ याभि॑: पु॒रा मन॑वे गा॒तुमी॒षथु॑: । याभि॒: शारी॒राज॑तं॒ स्यूम॑रश्मये॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ narā ǀ śayáve ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ átraye ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ mánave ǀ gātúm ǀ īṣáthuḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ śā́rīḥ ǀ ā́jatam ǀ syū́ma-raśmaye ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids, leaders (of sacrifices), which you afforded toŚayu, toAtri, and formerly toManu, anxious (to show them) the way (to escape from evil); with those by which you shot arrows (upon the foes) ofSyūmaraśmi; with them, Aśvis, willingly come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: पठ॑र्वा॒ जठ॑रस्य म॒ज्मना॒ग्निर्नादी॑देच्चि॒त इ॒द्धो अज्म॒न्ना । याभि॒: शर्या॑त॒मव॑थो महाध॒ने ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ páṭharvā ǀ jáṭharasya ǀ majmánā ǀ agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádīdet ǀ citáḥ ǀ iddháḥ ǀ ájman ǀ ā́ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ śáryātam ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WIth those aids by which Paddarvan shone with with strngth of orm in battle, like a blazing fire piled up (with fuel); by which you defendedŚaryātain war; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑रङ्गिरो॒ मन॑सा निर॒ण्यथोऽग्रं॒ गच्छ॑थो विव॒रे गोअ॑र्णसः । याभि॒र्मनुं॒ शूर॑मि॒षा स॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ ni-raṇyáthaḥ ǀ ágram ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ vi-varé ǀ gó-arṇasaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ mánum ǀ śū́ram ǀ iṣā́ ǀ sam-ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aṅgiras, (prise theAśvins); Aśvins, with those aids by which, with (gratified) minds, you delight (in praise), and thence preceded the gods to the cavern, to recover the stolen cattle; by which you sustained the heroicManuwith food; with them, Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: पत्नी॑र्विम॒दाय॑ न्यू॒हथु॒रा घ॑ वा॒ याभि॑ररु॒णीरशि॑क्षतम् । याभि॑: सु॒दास॑ ऊ॒हथु॑: सुदे॒व्यं१॒॑ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ ni-ūháthuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gha ǀ vā ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ aruṇī́ḥ ǀ áśikṣatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ ūháthuḥ ǀ su-devyám ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you gave a wife toVimada, by which you recovered the ruddy kine, by which you conferred excellent wealth uponSudās; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: शंता॑ती॒ भव॑थो ददा॒शुषे॑ भु॒ज्युं याभि॒रव॑थो॒ याभि॒रध्रि॑गुम् । ओ॒म्याव॑तीं सु॒भरा॑मृत॒स्तुभं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ śáṃtātī íti śáṃ-tātī ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ dadāśúṣe ǀ bhujyúm ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ádhri-gum ǀomyā́-vatīm ǀ su-bhárām ǀ ṛta-stúbham ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you are bestowers of happiness upon the donor (of oblations), by which you have protectedBhujyuandAdhrigu, and by which you have granted delighting and nourishing (food) toRitastubh; with them.Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑: कृ॒शानु॒मस॑ने दुव॒स्यथो॑ ज॒वे याभि॒र्यूनो॒ अर्व॑न्त॒माव॑तम् । मधु॑ प्रि॒यं भ॑रथो॒ यत्स॒रड्भ्य॒स्ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ kṛśā́num ǀ ásane ǀ duvasyáthaḥ ǀ javé ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ yū́naḥ ǀ árvantam ǀ ā́vatam ǀmádhu ǀ priyám ǀ bharathaḥ ǀ yát ǀ saráṭ-bhyaḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you defendedKṛśānuin battle, with which you succoured the horse of the youngPurukutsain speed, and by which you deliver the plural asant honey to the bees; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒र्नरं॑ गोषु॒युधं॑ नृ॒षाह्ये॒ क्षेत्र॑स्य सा॒ता तन॑यस्य॒ जिन्व॑थः । याभी॒ रथाँ॒ अव॑थो॒ याभि॒रर्व॑त॒स्ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ náram ǀ goṣu-yúdham ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ kṣétrasya ǀ sātā́ ǀ tánayasya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ ráthān ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you succoured the worshipper contending in war for cattle, by which you assist him in the acquisition of houses and wealth, by which you preserve his chariots and horses; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hitheṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: कुत्स॑मार्जुने॒यं श॑तक्रतू॒ प्र तु॒र्वीतिं॒ प्र च॑ द॒भीति॒माव॑तम् । याभि॑र्ध्व॒सन्तिं॑ पुरु॒षन्ति॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑रू॒ षु ऊ॒तिभि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ kútsam ǀ ārjuneyám ǀ śatakratū íti śata-kratū ǀ prá ǀ turvī́tim ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ dabhī́tim ǀ ā́vatam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ dhvasántim ǀ puru-sántim ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those aids by which you, who are worshipped in many rites, protectedKutsa, the son ofArjuna, as well asTurviti, Dhabhiti, Dhvasant, and Puruśanti; with them,Aśvins, come willingly hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप्न॑स्वतीमश्विना॒ वाच॑म॒स्मे कृ॒तं नो॑ दस्रा वृषणा मनी॒षाम् । अ॒द्यू॒त्येऽव॑से॒ नि ह्व॑ये वां वृ॒धे च॑ नो भवतं॒ वाज॑सातौ
shlokas.transliteration: ápnasvatīm ǀ aśvinā ǀ vā́cam ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ dasrā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ manīṣā́m ǀadyūtyé ǀ ávase ǀ ní ǀ hvaye ǀ vām ǀ vṛdhé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, sanctify our words with works; showerers (of benefits), subduers of foes (invigorate) our understandin g(for the sacred study); we invoke you both, in the last watch of the night, for our preservation; be to us for increase in the provision of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्युभि॑र॒क्तुभि॒: परि॑ पातम॒स्मानरि॑ष्टेभिरश्विना॒ सौभ॑गेभिः । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: dyú-bhiḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātam ǀ asmā́n ǀ áriṣṭebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ sáubhagebhiḥ ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cherish us,Aśvins, always, by night or day, with undiminished blessings; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this our (prayer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं श्रेष्ठं॒ ज्योति॑षां॒ ज्योति॒रागा॑च्चि॒त्रः प्र॑के॒तो अ॑जनिष्ट॒ विभ्वा॑ । यथा॒ प्रसू॑ता सवि॒तुः स॒वायँ॑ ए॒वा रात्र्यु॒षसे॒ योनि॑मारैक्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ jyótiṣām ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ citráḥ ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ ví-bhvā ǀyáthā ǀ prá-sūtā ǀ savitúḥ ǀ savā́ya ǀ evá ǀ rā́trī ǀ uṣáse ǀ yónim ǀ araik ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This most excellent luminary of all luminaries has arrived; the wonderful and diffusive manifester (of all things) has been born; in like manner as night is the offspring of the sun, so she becomes the birth-plural ce of the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रुश॑द्वत्सा॒ रुश॑ती श्वे॒त्यागा॒दारै॑गु कृ॒ष्णा सद॑नान्यस्याः । स॒मा॒नब॑न्धू अ॒मृते॑ अनू॒ची द्यावा॒ वर्णं॑ चरत आमिना॒ने
shlokas.transliteration: rúśat-vatsā ǀ rúśatī ǀ śvetyā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ áraik ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ kṛṣṇā́ ǀ sádanāni ǀ asyāḥ ǀsamānábandhū íti samāná-bandhū ǀ amṛ́te íti ǀ anūcī́ íti ǀ dyā́vā ǀ várṇam ǀ carataḥ ǀ āmināné ítyā-mināné ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The white-shining dawn, the parent of the sun, has arrived; dark night has sought her own abode; both allied to the same (sun), immortal, succeeding to each other, and mutually effacing each other's complexion, they traverse the heavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नो अध्वा॒ स्वस्रो॑रन॒न्तस्तम॒न्यान्या॑ चरतो दे॒वशि॑ष्टे । न मे॑थेते॒ न त॑स्थतुः सु॒मेके॒ नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे
shlokas.transliteration: samānáḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ svásroḥ ǀ anantáḥ ǀ tám ǀ anyā́-anyā ǀ carataḥ ǀ deváśiṣṭe íti devá-śiṣṭe ǀná ǀ methete íti ǀ ná ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ náktoṣásā ǀ sá-manasā ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The path of the sisters is unending; they travel it alternately, guided by the radiant (sun); combined in purpose, though of different forms, night and dawn, giving birth (to all things), obstruct not eachother, neither do they stand still.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भास्व॑ती ने॒त्री सू॒नृता॑ना॒मचे॑ति चि॒त्रा वि दुरो॑ न आवः । प्रार्प्या॒ जग॒द्व्यु॑ नो रा॒यो अ॑ख्यदु॒षा अ॑जीग॒र्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhā́svatī ǀ netrī́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ áceti ǀ citrā́ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀpra-árpya ǀ jágat ǀ ví ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ akhyat ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ajīgaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant guide of the speakers of truth, the many-tinted dawn, is recognized by us; she has opened our doors; having illuminated the world, she has made our riches manifest. Uṣās gives back all the regions (that had been swallowed up by night).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जि॒ह्म॒श्ये॒३॒॑ चरि॑तवे म॒घोन्या॑भो॒गय॑ इ॒ष्टये॑ रा॒य उ॑ त्वम् । द॒भ्रं पश्य॑द्भ्य उर्वि॒या वि॒चक्ष॑ उ॒षा अ॑जीग॒र्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: jihma-śyé ǀ cáritave ǀ maghónī ǀ ā-bhogáye ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ rāyé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvam ǀdabhrám ǀ páśyat-bhyaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ vi-cákṣe ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ajīgaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The opulent (dawn) arouses to exertion the man bowed down in sleep--one man to enjoyments, another to devotion, another to (the acquisition of) wealth; she has enabled those who were almost sightless to see distinctly. The expansive Uṣas has given back all the regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्ष॒त्राय॑ त्वं॒ श्रव॑से त्वं मही॒या इ॒ष्टये॑ त्व॒मर्थ॑मिव त्वमि॒त्यै । विस॑दृशा जीवि॒ताभि॑प्र॒चक्ष॑ उ॒षा अ॑जीग॒र्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: kṣatrā́ya ǀ tvam ǀ śrávase ǀ tvam ǀ mahīyái ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ tvam ǀ ártham-iva ǀ tvam ǀ ityái ǀví-sadṛśā ǀ jīvitā́ ǀ abhi-pracákṣe ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ajīgaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dawn rouses one man to acquire wealth, another to earn food, another to achieve greatness, another to sacrifices, another to his own (pursuits), another to activity, and lights all men to their various means of maintaining life. Uṣās has given back all the regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता प्रत्य॑दर्शि व्यु॒च्छन्ती॑ युव॒तिः शु॒क्रवा॑साः । विश्व॒स्येशा॑ना॒ पार्थि॑वस्य॒ वस्व॒ उषो॑ अ॒द्येह सु॑भगे॒ व्यु॑च्छ
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ práti ǀ adarśi ǀ vi-ucchántī ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ śukrá-vāsāḥ ǀvíśvasya ǀ ī́śānā ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ihá ǀ su-bhage ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter of heaven, young, white-robed, the mistress of all earthly treasure, is beheld dissipating the darkness. Auspicious Uṣās,shine upon us today in this (hall of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रा॒य॒ती॒नामन्वे॑ति॒ पाथ॑ आयती॒नां प्र॑थ॒मा शश्व॑तीनाम् । व्यु॒च्छन्ती॑ जी॒वमु॑दी॒रय॑न्त्यु॒षा मृ॒तं कं च॒न बो॒धय॑न्ती
shlokas.transliteration: parā-yatīnā́m ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ ā-yatīnā́m ǀ prathamā́ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀvi-ucchántī ǀ jīvám ǀ ut-īráyantī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ mṛtám ǀ kám ǀ caná ǀ bodháyantī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Following the path”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॒ यद॒ग्निं स॒मिधे॑ च॒कर्थ॒ वि यदाव॒श्चक्ष॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य । यन्मानु॑षान्य॒क्ष्यमा॑णाँ॒ अजी॑ग॒स्तद्दे॒वेषु॑ चकृषे भ॒द्रमप्न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ yát ǀ agním ǀ sam-ídhe ǀ cakártha ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ cákṣasā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀyát ǀ mā́nuṣān ǀ yakṣyámāṇān ǀ ájīgaríti ǀ tát ǀ devéṣu ǀ cakṛṣe ǀ bhadrám ǀ ápnaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣās, inasmuch as you have caused the sacred fire to be kindled, inasmuch as you have lighted the world with the light of the sun, inasmuch as you have wakened men to perform sacrifice, you have done good service to the godṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: किया॒त्या यत्स॒मया॒ भवा॑ति॒ या व्यू॒षुर्याश्च॑ नू॒नं व्यु॒च्छान् । अनु॒ पूर्वा॑: कृपते वावशा॒ना प्र॒दीध्या॑ना॒ जोष॑म॒न्याभि॑रेति
shlokas.transliteration: kíyati ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ samáyā ǀ bhávāti ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ vi-ūṣúḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ nūnám ǀ vi-ucchā́n ǀánu ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ kṛpate ǀ vāvaśānā́ ǀ pra-dī́dhyānā ǀ jóṣam ǀ anyā́bhiḥ ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For how long a period is it that the dawns have risen? for how long a period will they rise? still desirous to bring us light, Uṣās pursues the functions of those that have gone before, and, shining brightly, proceeds with the others (that are to follow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒युष्टे ये पूर्व॑तरा॒मप॑श्यन्व्यु॒च्छन्ती॑मु॒षसं॒ मर्त्या॑सः । अ॒स्माभि॑रू॒ नु प्र॑ति॒चक्ष्या॑भू॒दो ते य॑न्ति॒ ये अ॑प॒रीषु॒ पश्या॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: īyúḥ ǀ té ǀ yé ǀ pū́rva-tarām ǀ ápaśyan ǀ vi-ucchántīm ǀ uṣásam ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀasmā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ prati-cákṣyā ǀ abhūt ǀ ó íti ǀ té ǀ yanti ǀ yé ǀ aparī́ṣu ǀ páśyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those mortals who beheld the pristine Uṣās dawning have passed away; to us she is now visible, and they approach who may behold her in after times.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒व॒यद्द्वे॑षा ऋत॒पा ऋ॑ते॒जाः सु॑म्ना॒वरी॑ सू॒नृता॑ ई॒रय॑न्ती । सु॒म॒ङ्ग॒लीर्बिभ्र॑ती दे॒ववी॑तिमि॒हाद्योष॒: श्रेष्ठ॑तमा॒ व्यु॑च्छ
shlokas.transliteration: yavayát-dveṣāḥ ǀ ṛta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛte-jā́ḥ ǀ sumna-várī ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ īráyantī ǀsu-maṅgalī́ḥ ǀ bíbhratī ǀ devá-vītim ǀ ihá ǀ adyá ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ śréṣṭha-tamā ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The beings hostile (to acts of devotion) now withdraw, for she is the protectress of sacred rites, who is manifested for their performance; she is the giver of happiness, the awakener of plural asant voices, the enjoyer of felicity, and provider of food for the gods; most excellent Uṣās dawn today on this (sacrificial hall).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शश्व॑त्पु॒रोषा व्यु॑वास दे॒व्यथो॑ अ॒द्येदं व्या॑वो म॒घोनी॑ । अथो॒ व्यु॑च्छा॒दुत्त॑राँ॒ अनु॒ द्यून॒जरा॒मृता॑ चरति स्व॒धाभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śáśvat ǀ purā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ uvāsa ǀ devī́ ǀ átho íti ǀ adyá ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ āvaḥ ǀ maghónī ǀátho íti ǀ ví ǀ ucchāt ǀ út-tarān ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ ajárā ǀ amṛ́tā ǀ carati ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine Uṣās dawned continually in former times; the source of wealth, she still rises on this (world); so will she give light hereafter, through future days, for, exempt from decay or death, she goes on in her splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य१॒॑ञ्जिभि॑र्दि॒व आता॑स्वद्यौ॒दप॑ कृ॒ष्णां नि॒र्णिजं॑ दे॒व्या॑वः । प्र॒बो॒धय॑न्त्यरु॒णेभि॒रश्वै॒रोषा या॑ति सु॒युजा॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́tāsu ǀ adyaut ǀ ápa ǀ kṛṣṇā́m ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ devī́ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀpra-bodháyantī ǀ aruṇébhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ su-yújā ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine Uṣās lights up with her beams the quarters of the heavens; she has thrown off her gloomy form, and, awaking (those who sleep), comes in her car, drawn by purple steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒वह॑न्ती॒ पोष्या॒ वार्या॑णि चि॒त्रं के॒तुं कृ॑णुते॒ चेकि॑ताना । ई॒युषी॑णामुप॒मा शश्व॑तीनां विभाती॒नां प्र॑थ॒मोषा व्य॑श्वैत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā-váhantī ǀ póṣyā ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ citrám ǀ ketúm ǀ kṛṇute ǀ cékitānā ǀīyúṣīṇām ǀ upa-mā́ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ vi-bhātīnā́m ǀ prathamā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśvait ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bringing with her life-sustaining blessings, and giving consciousness (to the unconscious), she imparts (to the world) her wonderful radiance. The similitude of numerous dawns that have gone by, the first of the billiant (dawns that are to come), Uṣās has today appeared.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑र्ध्वं जी॒वो असु॑र्न॒ आगा॒दप॒ प्रागा॒त्तम॒ आ ज्योति॑रेति । आरै॒क्पन्थां॒ यात॑वे॒ सूर्या॒याग॑न्म॒ यत्र॑ प्रति॒रन्त॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īrdhvam ǀ jīváḥ ǀ ásuḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ ápa ǀ prá ǀ agāt ǀ támaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ eti ǀáraik ǀ pánthām ǀ yā́tave ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ áganma ǀ yátra ǀ pra-tiránte ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arise; inspiring life revives; darkness has departed; light approaches. Uṣās has opened the road for the sun to travel; let us repair to where they distribute food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्यूम॑ना वा॒च उदि॑यर्ति॒ वह्नि॒: स्तवा॑नो रे॒भ उ॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः । अ॒द्या तदु॑च्छ गृण॒ते म॑घोन्य॒स्मे आयु॒र्नि दि॑दीहि प्र॒जाव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: syū́manā ǀ vācáḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ váhniḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ rebháḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀadyá ǀ tát ǀ uccha ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ maghoni ǀ asmé íti ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ní ǀ didīhi ǀ prajā́-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerer of praise, the reciter of praise, celebrating the brilliant Uṣas, repeats the well-connected words (of theVeda). Possessor of affluence, dawn today upon him who praise you; bestow upon us food, whence progeny may be obtained.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या गोम॑तीरु॒षस॒: सर्व॑वीरा व्यु॒च्छन्ति॑ दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य । वा॒योरि॑व सू॒नृता॑नामुद॒र्के ता अ॑श्व॒दा अ॑श्नवत्सोम॒सुत्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sárva-vīrāḥ ǀ vi-ucchánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀvāyóḥ-iva ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ ut-arké ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ aśva-dā́ḥ ǀ aśnavat ǀ soma-sútvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who has offered the libation obtain, upon the conclusion of his praises, (enunciated), life the wind, (with speed), (the favour of) those Uṣasas who are givers of horses, and of cattle, and of progeny, and who shed light upon the mortal presenting to them (offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒ता दे॒वाना॒मदि॑ते॒रनी॑कं य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुर्बृ॑ह॒ती वि भा॑हि । प्र॒श॒स्ति॒कृद्ब्रह्म॑णे नो॒ व्यु१॒॑च्छा नो॒ जने॑ जनय विश्ववारे
shlokas.transliteration: mātā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ánīkam ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀpraśasti-kṛ́t ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ jáne ǀ janaya ǀ viśva-vāre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mother of the gods, rival ofAditi, illuminator of the sacrificer, mighty Uṣās, shine forth; approving of our prayer, dawn upon us. Do you, who are cherished by all, make us eminent among the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒त्रमप्न॑ उ॒षसो॒ वह॑न्तीजा॒नाय॑ शशमा॒नाय॑ भ॒द्रम् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ citrám ǀ ápnaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ váhanti ǀ ījānā́ya ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ bhadrám ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever valuable wealth the Uṣās convey is beneficial to the sacrificer and to the praiser. MayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth, and heaven, be favourable to this our prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा रु॒द्राय॑ त॒वसे॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑राय॒ प्र भ॑रामहे म॒तीः । यथा॒ शमस॑द्द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे॒ विश्वं॑ पु॒ष्टं ग्रामे॑ अ॒स्मिन्न॑नातु॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ taváse ǀ kapardíne ǀ kṣayát-vīrāya ǀ prá ǀ bharāmahe ǀ matī́ḥ ǀyáthā ǀ śám ǀ ásat ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ víśvam ǀ puṣṭám ǀ grā́me ǀ asmín ǀ anāturám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer these praises to the mightyRudra, with the braided hair, the destroyer of heroes, in order that health may be enjoyed by bipeds and quadrupeds, and that all being sin this villag may be (well) nourished and exempt from disease.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒ळा नो॑ रुद्रो॒त नो॒ मय॑स्कृधि क्ष॒यद्वी॑राय॒ नम॑सा विधेम ते । यच्छं च॒ योश्च॒ मनु॑राये॒जे पि॒ता तद॑श्याम॒ तव॑ रुद्र॒ प्रणी॑तिषु
shlokas.transliteration: mṛḷá ǀ naḥ ǀ rudra ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ máyaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ kṣayát-vīrāya ǀ námasā ǀ vidhema ǀ te ǀyát ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ yóḥ ǀ ca ǀ mánuḥ ǀ ā-yejé ǀ pitā́ ǀ tát ǀ aśyāma ǀ táva ǀ rudra ǀ prá-nītiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gracious to us,Rudra; grant us happiness, for we worship the destroyer of heroes with oblations; and, by your directions, Rudra, may we obtain that freedom from disease and exemption from dangers which our progenitor,Manu, bestowed upon us, (having obtained them form the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒श्याम॑ ते सुम॒तिं दे॑वय॒ज्यया॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑रस्य॒ तव॑ रुद्र मीढ्वः । सु॒म्ना॒यन्निद्विशो॑ अ॒स्माक॒मा च॒रारि॑ष्टवीरा जुहवाम ते ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: aśyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-matím ǀ deva-yajyáyā ǀ kṣayát-vīrasya ǀ táva ǀ rudra ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀsumna-yán ǀ ít ǀ víśaḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ā́ ǀ cara ǀ áriṣṭa-vīrāḥ ǀ juhavāma ǀ te ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rudra, showerer (of benefits), may we obtain, through our worship of the gods, the favour of you, who are the destroyer of heroes;come to our posterity, purposing to promote their happiness, while we, having our sons in safety, offer you oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षं व॒यं रु॒द्रं य॑ज्ञ॒साधं॑ व॒ङ्कुं क॒विमव॑से॒ नि ह्व॑यामहे । आ॒रे अ॒स्मद्दैव्यं॒ हेळो॑ अस्यतु सुम॒तिमिद्व॒यम॒स्या वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ vayám ǀ rudrám ǀ yajña-sā́dham ǀ vaṅkúm ǀ kavím ǀ ávase ǀ ní ǀ hvayāmahe ǀāré ǀ asmát ǀ dáivyam ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ asyatu ǀ su-matím ǀ ít ǀ vayám ǀ asya ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our preservation the illustriousRudra, the accomplisher of sacrifices, the tortuous, the wise; may he remove far from us his celestial wrath, for we earnestly solicit his favour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो व॑रा॒हम॑रु॒षं क॑प॒र्दिनं॑ त्वे॒षं रू॒पं नम॑सा॒ नि ह्व॑यामहे । हस्ते॒ बिभ्र॑द्भेष॒जा वार्या॑णि॒ शर्म॒ वर्म॑ च्छ॒र्दिर॒स्मभ्यं॑ यंसत्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ varāhám ǀ aruṣám ǀ kapardínam ǀ tveṣám ǀ rūpám ǀ námasā ǀ ní ǀ hvayāmahe ǀháste ǀ bíbhrat ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ śárma ǀ várma ǀ chardíḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke, from heaven, with reverence, him who has excellent food, who is radiant, and has braided hair, who is brilliant, and is to be ascertained (by sacred study), holding in hishandsexcellent medicaments; mayhe grant us health, defensive armour, and a (secure) dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं पि॒त्रे म॒रुता॑मुच्यते॒ वच॑: स्वा॒दोः स्वादी॑यो रु॒द्राय॒ वर्ध॑नम् । रास्वा॑ च नो अमृत मर्त॒भोज॑नं॒ त्मने॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृळ
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ pitré ǀ marútām ǀ ucyate ǀ vácaḥ ǀ svādóḥ ǀ svā́dīyaḥ ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ várdhanam ǀrā́sva ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ tmáne ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ mṛḷa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise, the sweetest of the sweet, and cause of increase (to the reciter), is addressed toRudra, the father of theMaruts; immortal Rudra, grant us food sufficient for mortals, and bestow happiness on me, my son, and my grandson.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ म॒हान्त॑मु॒त मा नो॑ अर्भ॒कं मा न॒ उक्ष॑न्तमु॒त मा न॑ उक्षि॒तम् । मा नो॑ वधीः पि॒तरं॒ मोत मा॒तरं॒ मा न॑: प्रि॒यास्त॒न्वो॑ रुद्र रीरिषः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́ntam ǀ utá ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ arbhakám ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ úkṣantam ǀ utá ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ukṣitám ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadhīḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ mā́ ǀ utá ǀ mātáram ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ rudra ǀ ririṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Injure not,Rudra, those amongst us who are old or young, who are capable of begetting, or who are begotten, nor a father, nor a mother, nor afflict our precious person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॑स्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ मा न॑ आ॒यौ मा नो॒ गोषु॒ मा नो॒ अश्वे॑षु रीरिषः । वी॒रान्मा नो॑ रुद्र भामि॒तो व॑धीर्ह॒विष्म॑न्त॒: सद॒मित्त्वा॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ āyáu ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áśveṣu ǀ ririṣaḥ ǀvīrā́n ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rudra ǀ bhāmitáḥ ǀ vadhīḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm us not,Rudra, in our sons or grandsons, or othermaledescendants, nor in our cattle, nor in our horses; inflamed with anger, kill not our valiant men, for we, presenting clarified butter perpetually invoke you. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ ते॒ स्तोमा॑न्पशु॒पा इ॒वाक॑रं॒ रास्वा॑ पितर्मरुतां सु॒म्नम॒स्मे । भ॒द्रा हि ते॑ सुम॒तिर्मृ॑ळ॒यत्त॒माथा॑ व॒यमव॒ इत्ते॑ वृणीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ te ǀ stómān ǀ paśupā́ḥ-iva ǀ ā́ ǀ akaram ǀ rā́sva ǀ pitaḥ ǀ marutām ǀ sumnám ǀ asmé íti ǀbhadrā́ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ mṛḷayát-tamā ǀ átha ǀ vayám ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I restore to you the praises (derived from you), as a shepherd (returns his sheep to their owner); father of theMaruts, bestow happiness upon me; your auspicious benignityis the cause of successive delight, therefore we especially solicit your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒रे ते॑ गो॒घ्नमु॒त पू॑रुष॒घ्नं क्षय॑द्वीर सु॒म्नम॒स्मे ते॑ अस्तु । मृ॒ळा च॑ नो॒ अधि॑ च ब्रूहि दे॒वाधा॑ च न॒: शर्म॑ यच्छ द्वि॒बर्हा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: āré ǀ te ǀ go-ghnám ǀ utá ǀ puruṣa-ghnám ǀ kṣáyat-vīra ǀ sumnám ǀ asmé íti ǀ te ǀ astu ǀmṛḷá ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ca ǀ brūhi ǀ deva ǀ ádha ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of heroes, may your cow-killing or man-slaying (weapon) be far away, and let the felicity granted by you be ours; favour us; speak, brilliant hero, in our behalf, and grant us, you who are mighty over the two (realms of heaven and earth), prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवो॑चाम॒ नमो॑ अस्मा अव॒स्यव॑: शृ॒णोतु॑ नो॒ हवं॑ रु॒द्रो म॒रुत्वा॑न् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: ávocāma ǀ námaḥ ǀ asmai ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ śṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ hávam ǀ rudráḥ ǀ marútvān ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of protection, we have said: reverence be to him; mayRudra, with theMaruts, hear our invocation; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this (our prayer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुद॑गा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः । आप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च
shlokas.transliteration: citrám ǀ devā́nām ǀ út ǀ agāt ǀ ánīkam ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ agnéḥ ǀā́ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ antárikṣam ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ātmā́ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thewonderful hostof rays has risen; th eye ofMitra,VaruṇaandAgni; the sun, thesoulof all that moves or is immoveable, has filled (with his glory) the heaven, the earth, and the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्यो॑ दे॒वीमु॒षसं॒ रोच॑मानां॒ मर्यो॒ न योषा॑म॒भ्ये॑ति प॒श्चात् । यत्रा॒ नरो॑ देव॒यन्तो॑ यु॒गानि॑ वितन्व॒ते प्रति॑ भ॒द्राय॑ भ॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: sū́ryaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ rócamānām ǀ máryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣām ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ paścā́t ǀyátra ǀ náraḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ yugā́ni ǀ vi-tanvaté ǀ práti ǀ bhadrā́ya ǀ bhadrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun follows the divine and brilliant Uṣā, as a man (follows a young and elegant) woman; at which season, pious men perform (the ceremonies established for) ages, worshipping the auspicious (sun), for the sake of good (reward).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा अश्वा॑ ह॒रित॒: सूर्य॑स्य चि॒त्रा एत॑ग्वा अनु॒माद्या॑सः । न॒म॒स्यन्तो॑ दि॒व आ पृ॒ष्ठम॑स्थु॒: परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी य॑न्ति स॒द्यः
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrā́ḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ éta-gvāḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyāsaḥ ǀnamasyántaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ asthuḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yanti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious, swift horses of the sun, well-limbed, road-traversing, who merit to be plural ased with praise, revernced byus, have ascended to the summit of the sky, and quickly circumambulate earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्सूर्य॑स्य देव॒त्वं तन्म॑हि॒त्वं म॒ध्या कर्तो॒र्वित॑तं॒ सं ज॑भार । य॒देदयु॑क्त ह॒रित॑: स॒धस्था॒दाद्रात्री॒ वास॑स्तनुते सि॒मस्मै॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ deva-tvám ǀ tát ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ madhyā́ ǀ kártoḥ ǀ ví-tatam ǀ sám ǀ jabhāra ǀyadā́ ǀ ít ǀ áyukta ǀ harítaḥ ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀ ā́t ǀ rā́trī ǀ vā́saḥ ǀ tanute ǀ simásmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such is the divinity, such is the majesty of the sun, that when he has set, he has withdrawn (into himself) the diffused (light which had been shed) upon the unfinished task; when he has unyoked his coursers from his car, then night extends the veiling darkness over all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्याभि॒चक्षे॒ सूर्यो॑ रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ द्योरु॒पस्थे॑ । अ॒न॒न्तम॒न्यद्रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॑: कृ॒ष्णम॒न्यद्ध॒रित॒: सं भ॑रन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ abhi-cákṣe ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ rūpám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ dyóḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀanantám ǀ anyát ǀ rúśat ǀ asya ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ anyát ǀ harítaḥ ǀ sám ǀ bharanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun, is the sight ofMitraandVaruṇa, displays his form (of brightness) in the middle of the heavens, and his rays extend, on onehand, his infinite and brilliant power, or, on the other, (by their departure), bring on the blackness of night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्या दे॑वा॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ निरंह॑सः पिपृ॒ता निर॑व॒द्यात् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑ति॒: सिन्धु॑: पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: adyá ǀ devāḥ ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ níḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ pipṛtá ǀ níḥ ǀ avadyā́t ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahantām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This day, gods, with the rising of the sun, deliver us from heinous sin; and mayMitra,Varuṇa,Aditi--ocean, earth and heaven, be favourable to this (our prayer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नास॑त्याभ्यां ब॒र्हिरि॑व॒ प्र वृ॑ञ्जे॒ स्तोमाँ॑ इयर्म्य॒भ्रिये॑व॒ वात॑: । यावर्भ॑गाय विम॒दाय॑ जा॒यां से॑ना॒जुवा॑ न्यू॒हतू॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: nā́satyābhyām ǀ barhíḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ vṛñje ǀ stómān ǀ iyarmi ǀ abhríyā-iva ǀ vā́taḥ ǀyáu ǀ árbhagāya ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ jāyā́m ǀ senā-júvā ǀ ni-ūhátuḥ ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as a worshipper strews the sacred grass for theNāsatyas, so do I urge on their laudations, as the wind drives on the clouds; they, who gave a bride to the youthfulVimada, and bore her away in their car, outstripping the rival host.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ळु॒पत्म॑भिराशु॒हेम॑भिर्वा दे॒वानां॑ वा जू॒तिभि॒: शाश॑दाना । तद्रास॑भो नासत्या स॒हस्र॑मा॒जा य॒मस्य॑ प्र॒धने॑ जिगाय
shlokas.transliteration: vīḷupátma-bhiḥ ǀ āśuhéma-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ devā́nām ǀ vā ǀ jūtí-bhiḥ ǀ śā́śadānā ǀtát ǀ rā́sabhaḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sahásram ǀ ājā́ ǀ yamásya ǀ pra-dháne ǀ jigāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas,borne by strong and rapid (steeds), and (urged) by the encouragements of the gods, the ass of you, thus instrumental gated, overcame a thousand (enemies) in conflict, in the war grateful toYama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुग्रो॑ ह भु॒ज्युम॑श्विनोदमे॒घे र॒यिं न कश्चि॑न्ममृ॒वाँ अवा॑हाः । तमू॑हथुर्नौ॒भिरा॑त्म॒न्वती॑भिरन्तरिक्ष॒प्रुद्भि॒रपो॑दकाभिः
shlokas.transliteration: túgraḥ ǀ ha ǀ bhujyúm ǀ aśvinā ǀ uda-meghé ǀ rayím ǀ ná ǀ káḥ ǀ cit ǀ mamṛ-vā́n ǀ áva ǀ ahāḥ ǀtám ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ naubhíḥ ǀ ātman-vátībhiḥ ǀ antarikṣaprút-bhiḥ ǀ ápa-udakābhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tugra, verily,Aśvins, sent (his son)Bhujyuto sea, as a dying man parts with his riches; but you brought him back in vessels of your own, floating over the ocean, and keeping out the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रः क्षप॒स्त्रिरहा॑ति॒व्रज॑द्भि॒र्नास॑त्या भु॒ज्युमू॑हथुः पतं॒गैः । स॒मु॒द्रस्य॒ धन्व॑न्ना॒र्द्रस्य॑ पा॒रे त्रि॒भी रथै॑: श॒तप॑द्भि॒: षळ॑श्वैः
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ kṣápaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ áhā ǀ ativrájat-bhiḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ bhujyúm ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ pataṅgáiḥ ǀsamudrásya ǀ dhánvan ǀ ārdrásya ǀ pāré ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ráthaiḥ ǀ śatápat-bhiḥ ǀ ṣáṭ-aśvaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Threenights, and three days,Nāsatyas, have you conveyedBhujyuin three rapid, revolving cars, having a hundred wheels, and drawn by six horses, along the dry bed of the ocean to the short of the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ना॒र॒म्भ॒णे तद॑वीरयेथामनास्था॒ने अ॑ग्रभ॒णे स॑मु॒द्रे । यद॑श्विना ऊ॒हथु॑र्भु॒ज्युमस्तं॑ श॒तारि॑त्रां॒ नाव॑मातस्थि॒वांस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: anārambhaṇé ǀ tát ǀ avīrayethām ǀ anāsthāné ǀ agrabhaṇé ǀ samudré ǀyát ǀ aśvinau ǀ ūháthuḥ ǀ bhujyúm ǀ ástam ǀ śatá-aritrān ǀ nā́vam ǀ ātasthi-vā́ṃsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “this exploit you achieved,Aśvins, in the ocean, where there is nothing to give support, nothing to rest upon,nothing to cling to, that you broughtBhujyu, sailing in a hundred-oared ship, to his father's house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॑श्विना द॒दथु॑: श्वे॒तमश्व॑म॒घाश्वा॑य॒ शश्व॒दित्स्व॒स्ति । तद्वां॑ दा॒त्रं महि॑ की॒र्तेन्यं॑ भूत्पै॒द्वो वा॒जी सद॒मिद्धव्यो॑ अ॒र्यः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ aśvinā ǀ dadáthuḥ ǀ śvetám ǀ áśvam ǀ aghá-aśvāya ǀ śáśvat ǀ ít ǀ svastí ǀtát ǀ vām ǀ dātrám ǀ máhi ǀ kīrtényam ǀ bhūt ǀ paidváḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, the white horse you gave toPedu, whose horses were indestrucible, was ever to him success; that, your precious gift, is always to be celebrated; the horse of Pedu, the scatterer (of enemies), is always to be invoked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं न॑रा स्तुव॒ते प॑ज्रि॒याय॑ क॒क्षीव॑ते अरदतं॒ पुरं॑धिम् । का॒रो॒त॒राच्छ॒फादश्व॑स्य॒ वृष्ण॑: श॒तं कु॒म्भाँ अ॑सिञ्चतं॒ सुरा॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ narā ǀ stuvaté ǀ pajriyā́ya ǀ kakṣī́vate ǀ aradatam ǀ púram-dhim ǀkārotarā́t ǀ śaphā́t ǀ áśvasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ kumbhā́n ǀ asiñcatam ǀ súrāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gave, leaders (of sacrifice), toKakṣīvat, of the race of Pajra, various knowledge; you filled from the hoof of your vigorous steed, as if from a cask, a hundred jars of wine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒मेना॒ग्निं घ्रं॒सम॑वारयेथां पितु॒मती॒मूर्ज॑मस्मा अधत्तम् । ऋ॒बीसे॒ अत्रि॑मश्वि॒नाव॑नीत॒मुन्नि॑न्यथु॒: सर्व॑गणं स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: hiména ǀ agním ǀ ghraṃsám ǀ avārayethām ǀ pitu-mátīm ǀ ū́rjam ǀ asmai ǀ adhattam ǀṛbī́se ǀ átrim ǀ aśvinā ǀ áva-nītam ǀ út ǀ ninyathuḥ ǀ sárva-gaṇam ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You quenched with cold (water) the blazing flames (that encompassedAtri), and supplied him with food-supported strength; you extricated him,Aśvins, from the dark (cavern) into which he had been thrown headlong and restored him to every kind of welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑व॒तं ना॑सत्यानुदेथामु॒च्चाबु॑ध्नं चक्रथुर्जि॒ह्मबा॑रम् । क्षर॒न्नापो॒ न पा॒यना॑य रा॒ये स॒हस्रा॑य॒ तृष्य॑ते॒ गोत॑मस्य
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ avatám ǀ nāsatyā ǀ anudethām ǀ uccā́-budhnam ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ jihmá-bāram ǀkṣáran ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pāyánāya ǀ rāyé ǀ sahásrāya ǀ tṛ́ṣyate ǀ gótamasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, you raised up the well, and made th ebase, which had been turned upwards, the curved mouth, so that the water issued for the beverage of the thirstyGotama, the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒जु॒रुषो॑ नासत्यो॒त व॒व्रिं प्रामु॑ञ्चतं द्रा॒पिमि॑व॒ च्यवा॑नात् । प्राति॑रतं जहि॒तस्यायु॑र्द॒स्रादित्पति॑मकृणुतं क॒नीना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: jujurúṣaḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ utá ǀ vavrím ǀ prá ǀ amuñcatam ǀ drāpím-iva ǀ cyávānāt ǀprá ǀ atiratam ǀ jahitásya ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ dasrā ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ pátim ǀ akṛṇutam ǀ kanī́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, you stripped off from the agedCyavanahis entire skin, as if it had been a coat of mail; you reversed,Dasras, the life of the sage who was without kindred, and constituted him the husband of many maidens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वां॑ नरा॒ शंस्यं॒ राध्यं॑ चाभिष्टि॒मन्ना॑सत्या॒ वरू॑थम् । यद्वि॒द्वांसा॑ नि॒धिमि॒वाप॑गूळ्ह॒मुद्द॑र्श॒तादू॒पथु॒र्वन्द॑नाय
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ rā́dhyam ǀ ca ǀ abhiṣṭi-mát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ várūtham ǀyát ǀ vidvā́ṃsā ǀ nidhím-iva ǀ ápa-gūḷham ǀ út ǀ darśatā́t ǀ ūpáthuḥ ǀ vándanāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, leaders, glorious was that exploit of yours, one to be celebrated, to be adored, to be desired by us, when, becoming aware (of the circumstance), you extricatedVandanā, (hidden), like a concealed treasure, from the (well) that was visible (to travellers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वां॑ नरा स॒नये॒ दंस॑ उ॒ग्रमा॒विष्कृ॑णोमि तन्य॒तुर्न वृ॒ष्टिम् । द॒ध्यङ्ह॒ यन्मध्वा॑थर्व॒णो वा॒मश्व॑स्य शी॒र्ष्णा प्र यदी॑मु॒वाच॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ sanáye ǀ dáṃsaḥ ǀ ugrám ǀ āvíḥ ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀdadhyáṅ ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ mádhu ǀ ātharvaṇáḥ ǀ vām ǀ áśvasya ǀ śīrṣṇā́ ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ uvā́ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I proclaim, leadeers (of sacriifce), for the skae of acquiring wealth, that inimitable deed which you performed, as the thunder (announces) rain, when provided by you with the head of a horse. Dadhyañc, the son ofAtharvan, taught you the mystic science.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजो॑हवीन्नासत्या क॒रा वां॑ म॒हे याम॑न्पुरुभुजा॒ पुरं॑धिः । श्रु॒तं तच्छासु॑रिव वध्रिम॒त्या हिर॑ण्यहस्तमश्विनावदत्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ájohavīt ǀ nāsatyā ǀ karā́ ǀ vām ǀ mahé ǀ yā́man ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀśrutám ǀ tát ǀ śā́suḥ-iva ǀ vadhri-matyā́ḥ ǀ híraṇya-hastam ǀ aśvinau ǀ adattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The intelligent (Vadhrimati) invoked you.Nāsatyas, who are the accom;ishers (of desires) and the protectors of many, with a sacred hymn; her prayer was heard, like (the instrumental uction of) a teacher, and you,Aśvins, gave to the wife of an impotent husband,Hiraṇyahasta, her son.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒स्नो वृक॑स्य॒ वर्ति॑काम॒भीके॑ यु॒वं न॑रा नासत्यामुमुक्तम् । उ॒तो क॒विं पु॑रुभुजा यु॒वं ह॒ कृप॑माणमकृणुतं वि॒चक्षे॑
shlokas.transliteration: āsnáḥ ǀ vṛ́kasya ǀ vártikām ǀ abhī́ke ǀ yuvám ǀ narā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ amumuktam ǀutó íti ǀ kavím ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ yuvám ǀ ha ǀ kṛ́pamāṇam ǀ akṛṇutam ǀ vi-cákṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, leaders, you liberated the quail from the mouth of the dog that had seized her, and you, who are the benefactors of many, have granted to the sage who praises you, to behold (true wisdom).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒रित्रं॒ हि वेरि॒वाच्छे॑दि प॒र्णमा॒जा खे॒लस्य॒ परि॑तक्म्यायाम् । स॒द्यो जङ्घा॒माय॑सीं वि॒श्पला॑यै॒ धने॑ हि॒ते सर्त॑वे॒ प्रत्य॑धत्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: carítram ǀ hí ǀ véḥ-iva ǀ ácchedi ǀ parṇám ǀ ājā́ ǀ khelásya ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǀsadyáḥ ǀ jáṅghām ǀ ā́yasīm ǀ viśpálāyai ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀ sártave ǀ práti ǀ adhattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The foot of (Vispalā, the wife of) Khela, was cut off, like the wing of a bird, in an engagement by night; immediately you gave her a metallic leg, that she might walk, the hidden treasure (of the enemy being the object of the conflict).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं मे॒षान्वृ॒क्ये॑ चक्षदा॒नमृ॒ज्राश्वं॒ तं पि॒तान्धं च॑कार । तस्मा॑ अ॒क्षी ना॑सत्या वि॒चक्ष॒ आध॑त्तं दस्रा भिषजावन॒र्वन्
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ meṣā́n ǀ vṛkyé ǀ cakṣadānám ǀ ṛjrá-aśvam ǀ tám ǀ pitā́ ǀ andhám ǀ cakāra ǀtásmai ǀ akṣī́ íti ǀ nāsatyā ǀ vi-cákṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ adhattam ǀ dasrā ǀ bhiṣajau ǀ anarván ǁ
