shlokas.meaning_en: “When his father caused,Ṛjrāśvā, as he was giving to a she-wolf a hundred sheep cut up in pieces, to become blind, you,Dasras, physicians (of the gods), gave him eyes (that had been) unable to find their way, with which he might see.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथं॑ दुहि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य॒ कार्ष्मे॑वातिष्ठ॒दर्व॑ता॒ जय॑न्ती । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अन्व॑मन्यन्त हृ॒द्भिः समु॑ श्रि॒या ना॑सत्या सचेथे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ duhitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ kā́rṣma-iva ǀ atiṣṭhat ǀ árvatā ǀ jáyantī ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ amanyanta ǀ hṛt-bhíḥ ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śriyā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sacethe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter of the sun ascended your car, (like a runner) to a goal; when you won (the race) with your swift horse, all the gods looked on with (anxious hearts), and you,Nāsatyas, were associated with glory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदया॑तं॒ दिवो॑दासाय व॒र्तिर्भ॒रद्वा॑जायाश्विना॒ हय॑न्ता । रे॒वदु॑वाह सच॒नो रथो॑ वां वृष॒भश्च॑ शिंशु॒मार॑श्च यु॒क्ता
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ áyātam ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ vartíḥ ǀ bharát-vājāya ǀ aśvinā ǀ háyantā ǀrevát ǀ uvāha ǀ sacanáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ca ǀ śiṃśumā́raḥ ǀ ca ǀ yuktā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Aśvins, being invited, you went to his dwelling (to give due rewards) toDivodāsa, offering oblations, then your helping chariot conveyed (food and) treasure, and the bull and the porpoise were yoked together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒यिं सु॑क्ष॒त्रं स्व॑प॒त्यमायु॑: सु॒वीर्यं॑ नासत्या॒ वह॑न्ता । आ ज॒ह्नावीं॒ सम॑न॒सोप॒ वाजै॒स्त्रिरह्नो॑ भा॒गं दध॑तीमयातम्
shlokas.transliteration: rayím ǀ su-kṣatrám ǀ su-apatyám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ váhantā ǀā́ ǀ jahnā́vīm ǀ sá-manasā ǀ úpa ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ dádhatīm ǀ ayātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, bearing strength and wealth with posterity and vigour-sustaining food, you came, with one intention, to the family ofJahnu, (provide) with (sacrificial) viands, and possessing a third portion of the daily (offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑विष्टं जाहु॒षं वि॒श्वत॑: सीं सु॒गेभि॒र्नक्त॑मूहथू॒ रजो॑भिः । वि॒भि॒न्दुना॑ नासत्या॒ रथे॑न॒ वि पर्व॑ताँ अजर॒यू अ॑यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: pári-viṣṭam ǀ jāhuṣám ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ sīm ǀ su-gébhiḥ ǀ náktam ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ rájaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvi-bhindúnā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ráthena ǀ ví ǀ párvatān ǀ ajarayū́ íti ǀ ayātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “UndecayingNāsatyas, you bore away by night, in your foe-overwhelming car,Jāhuṣa, surrounded on every side by (enemies), through practicable roads, and went to (inaccessible) mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑स्या॒ वस्तो॑रावतं॒ रणा॑य॒ वश॑मश्विना स॒नये॑ स॒हस्रा॑ । निर॑हतं दु॒च्छुना॒ इन्द्र॑वन्ता पृथु॒श्रव॑सो वृषणा॒वरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: ékasyāḥ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ āvatam ǀ ráṇāya ǀ váśam ǀ aśvinā ǀ sanáye ǀ sahásrā ǀníḥ ǀ ahatam ǀ ducchúnāḥ ǀ índra-vantā ǀ pṛthu-śrávasaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You preservedVaśa,Aśvins, (that he might obtain) in a single day a thousand acceptable gifts; showerers (of benefits), associated withIndra, you destroyed the malignant enemies ofPṛthuśravas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒रस्य॑ चिदार्च॒त्कस्या॑व॒तादा नी॒चादु॒च्चा च॑क्रथु॒: पात॑वे॒ वाः । श॒यवे॑ चिन्नासत्या॒ शची॑भि॒र्जसु॑रये स्त॒र्यं॑ पिप्यथु॒र्गाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śarásya ǀ cit ǀ ārcat-kásya ǀ avatā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ nīcā́t ǀ uccā́ ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ pā́tave ǀ vā́ríti vā́ḥ ǀśayáve ǀ cit ǀ nāsatyā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ jásuraye ǀ staryám ǀ pipyathuḥ ǀ gā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You raised the water from the bottom to the top of the well, for the drinking ofŚara, the son of Ṛcitka, and by your powers,Nāsatyas, you filled, for the sake of the wearyŚayu, the barren cow (with milk).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒व॒स्य॒ते स्तु॑व॒ते कृ॑ष्णि॒याय॑ ऋजूय॒ते ना॑सत्या॒ शची॑भिः । प॒शुं न न॒ष्टमि॑व॒ दर्श॑नाय विष्णा॒प्वं॑ ददथु॒र्विश्व॑काय
shlokas.transliteration: avasyaté ǀ stuvaté ǀ kṛṣṇiyā́ya ǀ ṛju-yaté ǀ nāsatyā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀpaśúm ǀ ná ǀ naṣṭám-iva ǀ dárśanāya ǀ viṣṇāpvám ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ víśvakāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, by your acts you restored toViśvaka, the son ofKṛṣṇa, soliciting your protection, adoring you, and a lover of rectitude, hs son Viṣṇāpu, (welcome) to his sight as an animal that has been lost.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ रात्री॒रशि॑वेना॒ नव॒ द्यूनव॑नद्धं श्नथि॒तम॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तः । विप्रु॑तं रे॒भमु॒दनि॒ प्रवृ॑क्त॒मुन्नि॑न्यथु॒: सोम॑मिव स्रु॒वेण॑
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ rā́trīḥ ǀ áśivena ǀ náva ǀ dyū́n ǀ áva-naddham ǀ śnathitám ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáríti ǀví-prutam ǀ rebhám ǀ udáni ǀ prá-vṛktam ǀ út ǀ ninyathuḥ ǀ sómam-iva ǀ sruvéṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, you raised up, likeSomain a ladle, Rebha, who for ten nights and nine days, had lain (in a well), bound with tight bonds, wounded, immersed, and suffering distress form the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वां॒ दंसां॑स्यश्विनाववोचम॒स्य पति॑: स्यां सु॒गव॑: सु॒वीर॑: । उ॒त पश्य॑न्नश्नु॒वन्दी॒र्घमायु॒रस्त॑मि॒वेज्ज॑रि॒माणं॑ जगम्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ dáṃsāṃsi ǀ aśvinau ǀ avocam ǀ asyá ǀ pátiḥ ǀ syām ǀ su-gávaḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀutá ǀ páśyan ǀ aśnuván ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ástam-iva ǀ ít ǀ jarimā́ṇam ǀ jagamyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus,Aśvins, have I declared your exploits; may I become the master (of this plural ce), having abundant cattle and a numerous progeny, and retaining my sight, and enjoying a long life; may I enter into old age, as (a master enters) his house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्व॒: सोम॑स्याश्विना॒ मदा॑य प्र॒त्नो होता वि॑वासते वाम् । ब॒र्हिष्म॑ती रा॒तिर्विश्रि॑ता॒ गीरि॒षा या॑तं नास॒त्योप॒ वाजै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ aśvinā ǀ mádāya ǀ pratnáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsate ǀ vām ǀbarhíṣmatī ǀ rātíḥ ǀ ví-śritā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ iṣā́ ǀ yātam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvinsfor your gratification by the plural asantSoma, your ancient worshipper adores you; the offering is poured upon the sacred gras, thehymn is ready (for repetition); come,Nāsatyas, with food and with vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वा॑मश्विना॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑या॒न्रथ॒: स्वश्वो॒ विश॑ आ॒जिगा॑ति । येन॒ गच्छ॑थः सु॒कृतो॑ दुरो॒णं तेन॑ नरा व॒र्तिर॒स्मभ्यं॑ यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā-jígāti ǀyéna ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ duroṇám ǀ téna ǀ narā ǀ vartíḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ yātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With that car,Aśvins, which, rapid as thought, drawn by good horses, appears before men, and withwhich you repair to the dwelling of the virtuous, come, leaders of (sacrifice), to our abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषिं॑ नरा॒वंह॑स॒: पाञ्च॑जन्यमृ॒बीसा॒दत्रिं॑ मुञ्चथो ग॒णेन॑ । मि॒नन्ता॒ दस्यो॒रशि॑वस्य मा॒या अ॑नुपू॒र्वं वृ॑षणा चो॒दय॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣim ǀ narau ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyam ǀ ṛbī́sāt ǀ átrim ǀ muñcathaḥ ǀ gaṇéna ǀminántā ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ áśivasya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ anu-pūrvám ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ codáyantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You liberated, leaders (of rites), the sageAtri, who was venerated by the five classes of men from the wicked prison, together with his troop (of children), destroying his enemies and baffling, showerers (of benefits), the devices of the malignantDasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वं॒ न गू॒ळ्हम॑श्विना दु॒रेवै॒ॠषिं॑ नरा वृषणा रे॒भम॒प्सु । सं तं रि॑णीथो॒ विप्रु॑तं॒ दंसो॑भि॒र्न वां॑ जूर्यन्ति पू॒र्व्या कृ॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: áśvam ǀ ná ǀ gūḷhám ǀ aśvinā ǀ duḥ-évaiḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ narā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ rebhám ǀ ap-sú ǀsám ǀ tám ǀ riṇīthaḥ ǀ ví-prutam ǀ dáṃsaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vām ǀ jūryanti ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of sacrifice), showerers (of benefits), you restored Rebha, cast by unassailable (enemies) into the water, and wounded, like a (sick) horse, by your (healing) skill; your ancient exploits do not fade (from recollection).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒षु॒प्वांसं॒ न निॠ॑तेरु॒पस्थे॒ सूर्यं॒ न द॑स्रा॒ तम॑सि क्षि॒यन्त॑म् । शु॒भे रु॒क्मं न द॑र्श॒तं निखा॑त॒मुदू॑पथुरश्विना॒ वन्द॑नाय
shlokas.transliteration: susupvā́ṃsam ǀ ná ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ná ǀ dasrā ǀ támasi ǀ kṣiyántam ǀśubhé ǀ rukmám ǀ ná ǀ darśatám ǀ ní-khātam ǀ út ǀ ūpathuḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vándanāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You extricated,Dasras, the sage (Vandanā) cast into a well, like a handsome and splendid ornament designed for embellishment, and (lying)Aśvins, like one sleepin gon the lap of the earth or like the sun disappearing in darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वां॑ नरा॒ शंस्यं॑ पज्रि॒येण॑ क॒क्षीव॑ता नासत्या॒ परि॑ज्मन् । श॒फादश्व॑स्य वा॒जिनो॒ जना॑य श॒तं कु॒म्भाँ अ॑सिञ्चतं॒ मधू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ pajriyéṇa ǀ kakṣī́vatā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ pári-jman ǀśaphā́t ǀ áśvasya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ jánāya ǀ śatám ǀ kumbhā́n ǀ asiñcatam ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That (exploit) of yours, leaders (of sacrifice), is to be celebrated,Nāsatyas, byKakṣīvat, of the race of Pajra, when you filled for the (expectant) man a hundred vases of sweet (liquors) from the hoof of your fleet horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं न॑रा स्तुव॒ते कृ॑ष्णि॒याय॑ विष्णा॒प्वं॑ ददथु॒र्विश्व॑काय । घोषा॑यै चित्पितृ॒षदे॑ दुरो॒णे पतिं॒ जूर्य॑न्त्या अश्विनावदत्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ narā ǀ stuvaté ǀ kṛṣṇiyā́ya ǀ viṣṇāpvám ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ víśvakāya ǀghóṣāyai ǀ cit ǀ pitṛ-sáde ǀ duroṇé ǀ pátim ǀ jū́ryantyai ǀ aśvinau ǀ adattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You restored, leaders (of sacrifices), Viṣṇāpu (his lost son) toViśvaka, the son ofKṛṣṇa, when he praised you; you bestowed,Aśvins, a husband uponGhoṣā, growing old and tarrying inher father's dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श्यावा॑य॒ रुश॑तीमदत्तं म॒हः क्षो॒णस्या॑श्विना॒ कण्वा॑य । प्र॒वाच्यं॒ तद्वृ॑षणा कृ॒तं वां॒ यन्ना॑र्ष॒दाय॒ श्रवो॑ अ॒ध्यध॑त्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śyā́vāya ǀ rúśatīm ǀ adattam ǀ maháḥ ǀ kṣoṇásya ǀ aśvinā ǀ káṇvāya ǀpra-vā́cyam ǀ tát ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ kṛtám ǀ vām ǀ yát ǀ nārsadā́ya ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ adhi-ádhattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gave,Aśvins, a lovely bride to Śyāvā; you gave sight toKaṇva, unable to see his way; showerers (of benefits), the deed is to be glorified by which you gave hearing to the son ofNṛṣad.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रू वर्पां॑स्यश्विना॒ दधा॑ना॒ नि पे॒दव॑ ऊहथुरा॒शुमश्व॑म् । स॒ह॒स्र॒सां वा॒जिन॒मप्र॑तीतमहि॒हनं॑ श्रव॒स्यं१॒॑ तरु॑त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: purú ǀ várpāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ dádhānā ǀ ní ǀ pedáve ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ āśúm ǀ áśvam ǀsahasra-sā́m ǀ vājínam ǀ áprati-itam ǀ ahi-hánam ǀ śravasyám ǀ tárutram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, who assume many forms, you gave toPedua swift horse, the bringer of a thousand (treasures), powerful, irresistible, the destroyer of foes, the object of praise, the bearer (over dangers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तानि॑ वां श्रव॒स्या॑ सुदानू॒ ब्रह्मा॑ङ्गू॒षं सद॑नं॒ रोद॑स्योः । यद्वां॑ प॒ज्रासो॑ अश्विना॒ हव॑न्ते या॒तमि॒षा च॑ वि॒दुषे॑ च॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ vām ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀ bráhma ǀ āṅgūṣám ǀ sádanam ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ pajrā́saḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ hávante ǀ yātám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ ca ǀ vidúṣe ǀ ca ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal givers, these your exploits are to be celebrated, and the resounding prayer propitiates you while abiding in heaven and earth; when the descendants of Pajra invite you,Aśvins, come with food, and grant strength to the sage (who worships you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सू॒नोर्माने॑नाश्विना गृणा॒ना वाजं॒ विप्रा॑य भुरणा॒ रद॑न्ता । अ॒गस्त्ये॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वावृधा॒ना सं वि॒श्पलां॑ नासत्यारिणीतम्
shlokas.transliteration: sūnóḥ ǀ mā́nena ǀ aśvinā ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ víprāya ǀ bhuraṇā ǀ rádantā ǀagástye ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vavṛdhānā́ ǀ sám ǀ viśpálām ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ariṇītam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, glorified by the praises of the son (of the jar), and giving food, nourishers (of men), to the sage (Bharadvāja), exalted byAgastyawithprayer, you restoredNāsatyas, Viṣpalā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुह॒ यान्ता॑ सुष्टु॒तिं का॒व्यस्य॒ दिवो॑ नपाता वृषणा शयु॒त्रा । हिर॑ण्यस्येव क॒लशं॒ निखा॑त॒मुदू॑पथुर्दश॒मे अ॑श्वि॒नाह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: kúha ǀ yā́ntā ǀ su-stutím ǀ kāvyásya ǀ dívaḥ ǀ napātā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ śayutrā́ ǀhíraṇyasya-iva ǀ kaláśam ǀ ní-khātam ǀ út ǀ ūpathuḥ ǀ daśamé ǀ aśvinā ǀ áhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wither were you going, sons of heaven, showerers (of benefits), when, on your way to the dwellingofKāvya, (to receive his) adoration, you raised up (Rebha),Aśvins, on the tenth day, like a buried vessel full of gold?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं च्यवा॑नमश्विना॒ जर॑न्तं॒ पुन॒र्युवा॑नं चक्रथु॒: शची॑भिः । यु॒वो रथं॑ दुहि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य स॒ह श्रि॒या ना॑सत्यावृणीत
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ cyávānam ǀ aśvinā ǀ járantam ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yúvānam ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ rátham ǀ duhitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sahá ǀ śriyā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ avṛṇīta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You rendered, by your power,Aśvins, the agedCyavanaagain young; the daughter of the sun,Nāsatyas, invested your chariot with beauty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं तुग्रा॑य पू॒र्व्येभि॒रेवै॑: पुनर्म॒न्याव॑भवतं युवाना । यु॒वं भु॒ज्युमर्ण॑सो॒ निः स॑मु॒द्राद्विभि॑रूहथुॠ॒ज्रेभि॒रश्वै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ túgrāya ǀ pūrvyébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ punaḥ-manyáu ǀ abhavatam ǀ yuvānā ǀyuvám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ árṇasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ ṛjrébhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dissipators of affliction, as you were praised with former praises byTugra, so were you again adored (by him), when you broughtBhujyusafe from the tossing ocean with swift ships and rapid horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजो॑हवीदश्विना तौ॒ग्र्यो वां॒ प्रोळ्ह॑: समु॒द्रम॑व्य॒थिर्ज॑ग॒न्वान् । निष्टमू॑हथुः सु॒युजा॒ रथे॑न॒ मनो॑जवसा वृषणा स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ájohavīt ǀ aśvinā ǀ taugryáḥ ǀ vām ǀ prá-ūḷhaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ avyathíḥ ǀ jaganvā́n ǀníḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ su-yújā ǀ ráthena ǀ mánaḥ-javasā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Th sun ofTugra, brought back by you,Aśvins, (to his father), glorified you whenhe ahd crossed the ocean in safety, and you bore him, showerers (of benefits), with your well-harnessed car, swift as thought, to safety.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजो॑हवीदश्विना॒ वर्ति॑का वामा॒स्नो यत्सी॒ममु॑ञ्चतं॒ वृक॑स्य । वि ज॒युषा॑ ययथु॒: सान्वद्रे॑र्जा॒तं वि॒ष्वाचो॑ अहतं वि॒षेण॑
shlokas.transliteration: ájohavīt ǀ aśvinā ǀ vártikā ǀ vām ǀ āsnáḥ ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ ámuñcatam ǀ vṛ́kasya ǀví ǀ jayúṣā ǀ yayathuḥ ǀ sā́nu ǀ ádreḥ ǀ jātám ǀ viṣvā́caḥ ǀ ahatam ǀ viṣéṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The quail glorified you,Aśvins, when you saved her from the mouth of the wolf; you carried off (Jāhuṣa) to the top of the mountain in your triumphant chariot; and slew the son of Viṣvāñc with a poisoned (arrow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं मे॒षान्वृ॒क्ये॑ मामहा॒नं तम॒: प्रणी॑त॒मशि॑वेन पि॒त्रा । आक्षी ऋ॒ज्राश्वे॑ अश्विनावधत्तं॒ ज्योति॑र॒न्धाय॑ चक्रथुर्वि॒चक्षे॑
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ meṣā́n ǀ vṛkyé ǀ mamahānám ǀ támaḥ ǀ prá-nītam ǀ áśivena ǀ pitrā́ ǀā́ ǀ akṣī́ íti ǀ ṛjrá-aśve ǀ aśvinau ǀ adhattam ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ andhā́ya ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ vi-cákṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You restored eyes toṚjrāśva, who, on presenting a hundred sheep to the she-wolf, had been condemned to darkness by his indignant father, and gave light to the blind, wherewith to behold all things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नम॒न्धाय॒ भर॑मह्वय॒त्सा वृ॒कीर॑श्विना वृषणा॒ नरेति॑ । जा॒रः क॒नीन॑ इव चक्षदा॒न ऋ॒ज्राश्व॑: श॒तमेकं॑ च मे॒षान्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ andhā́ya ǀ bháram ǀ ahvayat ǀ sā́ ǀ vṛkī́ḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ nárā ǀ íti ǀjāráḥ ǀ kanī́naḥ-iva ǀ cakṣadānáḥ ǀ ṛjrá-aśvaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ ékam ǀ ca ǀ meṣā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Desiring) that the enjoyment (arising from the perfection) of the senses (should be restored to the blind), the she-wolf invoked you, (saying), "Aśvins, showerers (of benefits), leaders (of sacrifices),Ṛjrāśva, (lavish) as a youthful gallant, (has given me) a hundred and one sheep, cutting them into fragments".”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही वा॑मू॒तिर॑श्विना मयो॒भूरु॒त स्रा॒मं धि॑ष्ण्या॒ सं रि॑णीथः । अथा॑ यु॒वामिद॑ह्वय॒त्पुरं॑धि॒राग॑च्छतं सीं वृषणा॒ववो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ ǀ vām ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ mayaḥ-bhū́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ srāmám ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǀ sám ǀ riṇīthaḥ ǀátha ǀ yuvā́m ǀ ít ǀ ahvayat ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agacchatam ǀ sīm ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, your powerful protection is the source of happiness; worthy of laudation, you have made whole the maimed; therefore, has the intelligent (Ghoṣā) called upon you; showerers (of benefits) come hither with your succours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधे॑नुं दस्रा स्त॒र्यं१॒॑ विष॑क्ता॒मपि॑न्वतं श॒यवे॑ अश्विना॒ गाम् । यु॒वं शची॑भिर्विम॒दाय॑ जा॒यां न्यू॑हथुः पुरुमि॒त्रस्य॒ योषा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhenum ǀ dasrā ǀ staryám ǀ ví-saktām ǀ ápinvatam ǀ śayáve ǀ aśvinā ǀ gā́m ǀyuvám ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ jāyā́m ǀ ní ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ puru-mitrásya ǀ yóṣām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras, you fille dthe milkless, barren, and emaciated cow ofŚayuwith milk; you brought, by your powers, the daughter ofPurumitra, as a wife, ofVimada.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यवं॒ वृके॑णाश्विना॒ वप॒न्तेषं॑ दु॒हन्ता॒ मनु॑षाय दस्रा । अ॒भि दस्युं॒ बकु॑रेणा॒ धम॑न्तो॒रु ज्योति॑श्चक्रथु॒रार्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: yávam ǀ vṛ́keṇa ǀ aśvinā ǀ vápantā ǀ íṣam ǀ duhántā ǀ mánuṣāya ǀ dasrā ǀabhí ǀ dásyum ǀ bákureṇa ǀ dhámantā ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, causing the barley to be sown (in the fields that had been prepared) by the plural ugh; milking (the clouds) for the sake ofManu; destroying theDasyuwith the thunderbolt; you have bestowed brilliant light upon theĀrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒थ॒र्व॒णाया॑श्विना दधी॒चेऽश्व्यं॒ शिर॒: प्रत्यै॑रयतम् । स वां॒ मधु॒ प्र वो॑चदृता॒यन्त्वा॒ष्ट्रं यद्द॑स्रावपिक॒क्ष्यं॑ वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ātharvaṇā́ya ǀ aśvinā ǀ dadhīcé ǀ áśvyam ǀ śíraḥ ǀ práti ǀ airayatam ǀsáḥ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu ǀ prá ǀ vocat ǀ ṛta-yán ǀ tvāṣṭrám ǀ yát ǀ dasrau ǀ api-kakṣyám ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You replaced,Aśvins, with the head of a horse, (the head of) Dadhyañc, the son ofAtharvan, and, true to his promise, he revealed to you the mystic knowledge which he had learned fromTvaṣṭā, and which was as a ligature of the waist to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सदा॑ कवी सुम॒तिमा च॑के वां॒ विश्वा॒ धियो॑ अश्विना॒ प्राव॑तं मे । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं ना॑सत्या बृ॒हन्त॑मपत्य॒साचं॒ श्रुत्यं॑ रराथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sádā ǀ kavī íti ǀ su-matím ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǀ vām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ me ǀasmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ nāsatyā ǀ bṛhántam ǀ apatya-sā́cam ǀ śrútyam ǀ rarāthām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SapientAśvins, I ever solicit your favour; protect all my religious duties, and grant,Nāsatyas, abundant and excellent wealth, together with offsprings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यहस्तमश्विना॒ ररा॑णा पु॒त्रं न॑रा वध्रिम॒त्या अ॑दत्तम् । त्रिधा॑ ह॒ श्याव॑मश्विना॒ विक॑स्त॒मुज्जी॒वस॑ ऐरयतं सुदानू
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-hastam ǀ aśvinā ǀ rárāṇā ǀ putrám ǀ narā ǀ vadhri-matyā́ḥ ǀ adattam ǀtrídhā ǀ ha ǀ śyā́vam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ví-kastam ǀ út ǀ jīváse ǀ airayatam ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LiberalAśvins, leaders (of sacrifices), you gave to Vadhṛmati her sonHiraṇyahasta; bounteous Aśvins, you restored to life the triply-mutilatedŚyāva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तानि॑ वामश्विना वी॒र्या॑णि॒ प्र पू॒र्व्याण्या॒यवो॑ऽवोचन् । ब्रह्म॑ कृ॒ण्वन्तो॑ वृषणा यु॒वभ्यां॑ सु॒वीरा॑सो वि॒दथ॒मा व॑देम
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ prá ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ avocan ǀbráhma ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vidátham ǀ ā́ ǀ vadema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These, your ancient exploits,Aśvins, our forefathers have celebrated, and we offer adoration to you, showerers (of benefits) repeating your praises, accompanied by our dependants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथो॑ अश्विना श्ये॒नप॑त्वा सुमृळी॒कः स्ववाँ॑ यात्व॒र्वाङ् । यो मर्त्य॑स्य॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑यान्त्रिवन्धु॒रो वृ॑षणा॒ वात॑रंहाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ śyená-patvā ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ svá-vān ǀ yātu ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀyáḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vā́ta-raṃhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your elegant and rich car, swift as a hawk, come,Aśvins, to our presence, fo rit as quick as the mind of man, surmounted, showerers (of benefits) by three columns, and rapid as the wind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒व॒न्धु॒रेण॑ त्रि॒वृता॒ रथे॑न त्रिच॒क्रेण॑ सु॒वृता या॑तम॒र्वाक् । पिन्व॑तं॒ गा जिन्व॑त॒मर्व॑तो नो व॒र्धय॑तमश्विना वी॒रम॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: tri-vandhuréṇa ǀ tri-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ tri-cakréṇa ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀpínvatam ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ jínvatam ǀ árvataḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vardháyatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ vīrám ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us with your tri-columnar, triangular, three-wheeled, and well-constructed car; replenish our cows (with milk), give spirit to our horses, and augment,Aśvins, our posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वद्या॑मना सु॒वृता॒ रथे॑न॒ दस्रा॑वि॒मं शृ॑णुतं॒ श्लोक॒मद्रे॑: । किम॒ङ्ग वां॒ प्रत्यव॑र्तिं॒ गमि॑ष्ठा॒हुर्विप्रा॑सो अश्विना पुरा॒जाः
shlokas.transliteration: pravát-yāmanā ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ dásrau ǀ imám ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ ślókam ǀ ádreḥ ǀkím ǀ aṅgá ǀ vām ǀ práti ǀ ávartim ǀ gámiṣṭhā ǀ āhúḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras(having come) with your quick-moving well-constructed car, hear this hymn, (recited by one) who reveres you; do not the ancient sages say that you are most prompt,Aśvins, (to avert) poverty from the worshipper?”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ श्ये॒नासो॑ अश्विना वहन्तु॒ रथे॑ यु॒क्तास॑ आ॒शव॑: पतं॒गाः । ये अ॒प्तुरो॑ दि॒व्यासो॒ न गृध्रा॑ अ॒भि प्रयो॑ नासत्या॒ वह॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ śyenā́saḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vahantu ǀ ráthe ǀ yuktā́saḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ pataṅgā́ḥ ǀyé ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ divyā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ gṛ́dhrāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ váhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your quick-moving, prancing steeds, rapid as hawks, yoked to your car, bear you,Aśvins, (hither), who, quick as (falling) water, like vultures flying through the air, convey you,Nāsatyas, to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथं॑ युव॒तिस्ति॑ष्ठ॒दत्र॑ जु॒ष्ट्वी न॑रा दुहि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य । परि॑ वा॒मश्वा॒ वपु॑षः पतं॒गा वयो॑ वहन्त्वरु॒षा अ॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ tiṣṭhat ǀ átra ǀ juṣṭvī́ ǀ narā ǀ duhitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀpári ǀ vām ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ vápuṣaḥ ǀ pataṅgā́ḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ aruṣā́ḥ ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of sacrifice), the youthful daughter ofSūryaascended, delighted, this your car; may your strong-bodied prancing, fleet, and shining horses, bring you near uṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वन्द॑नमैरतं दं॒सना॑भि॒रुद्रे॒भं द॑स्रा वृषणा॒ शची॑भिः । निष्टौ॒ग्र्यं पा॑रयथः समु॒द्रात्पुन॒श्च्यवा॑नं चक्रथु॒र्युवा॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vándanam ǀ airatam ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀ út ǀ rebhám ǀ dasrā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀníḥ ǀ taugryám ǀ pārayathaḥ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ púnaríti ǀ cyávānam ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ yúvānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By your deeds,Dasras, you raised upVandanā, and, showerers (of benefits), Rebha; you bore the son ofTugraover the sea, and madeCyavanayoung.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वमत्र॒येऽव॑नीताय त॒प्तमूर्ज॑मो॒मान॑मश्विनावधत्तम् । यु॒वं कण्वा॒यापि॑रिप्ताय॒ चक्षु॒: प्रत्य॑धत्तं सुष्टु॒तिं जु॑जुषा॒णा
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ átraye ǀ áva-nītāya ǀ taptám ǀ ū́rjam ǀ omā́nam ǀ aśvinau ǀ adhattam ǀyuvám ǀ káṇvāya ǀ ápi-riptāya ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ práti ǀ adhattam ǀ su-stutím ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You (gave relief) to the imprisonedAtri, (quenching the) scorching heat, and fed him with grateful food; solicitous of worthy praise, you gave sight ofKaṇva, blinded (by darkness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं धे॒नुं श॒यवे॑ नाधि॒तायापि॑न्वतमश्विना पू॒र्व्याय॑ । अमु॑ञ्चतं॒ वर्ति॑का॒मंह॑सो॒ निः प्रति॒ जङ्घां॑ वि॒श्पला॑या अधत्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ dhenúm ǀ śayáve ǀ nādhitā́ya ǀ ápinvatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀámuñcatam ǀ vártikām ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ práti ǀ jáṅghām ǀ viśpálāyāḥ ǀ adhattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You filled his cow with milk,Aśvins, for the ancientŚayu, when imploring (yoru aid); you liberated the quail from danger; you gave a leg to Viśpalā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श्वे॒तं पे॒दव॒ इन्द्र॑जूतमहि॒हन॑मश्विनादत्त॒मश्व॑म् । जो॒हूत्र॑म॒र्यो अ॒भिभू॑तिमु॒ग्रं स॑हस्र॒सां वृष॑णं वी॒ड्व॑ङ्गम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śvetám ǀ pedáve ǀ índra-jūtam ǀ ahi-hánam ǀ aśvinā ǀ adattam ǀ áśvam ǀjohū́tram ǀ aryáḥ ǀ abhí-bhūtim ǀ ugrám ǀ sahasra-sā́m ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vīḷú-aṅgam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gave toPedu,Aśvins, the white and foe-trampling steed which you had received fromIndra, loud-neighing (in battle), defying enemies, high-spirited, the acquirer of a thousand tresures, vigorous, and firm in body.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॑ नरा॒ स्वव॑से सुजा॒ता हवा॑महे अश्विना॒ नाध॑मानाः । आ न॒ उप॒ वसु॑मता॒ रथे॑न॒ गिरो॑ जुषा॒णा सु॑वि॒ताय॑ यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ sú ǀ ávase ǀ su-jātā́ ǀ hávāmahe ǀ aśvinā ǀ nā́dhamānāḥ ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vásu-matā ǀ ráthena ǀ gíraḥ ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ yātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earnestly we call you, leaders (of the sacrifice), such (as you have been described), and who are well born, to our succour, soliciting,Aśvins, wealth; contented with our laudations, come to us with your wealthy car, to brign us felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ श्ये॒नस्य॒ जव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेना॒स्मे या॑तं नासत्या स॒जोषा॑: । हवे॒ हि वा॑मश्विना रा॒तह॑व्यः शश्वत्त॒माया॑ उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śyenásya ǀ jávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ asmé íti ǀ yātam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀháve ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamā́yāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us, auspiciousNāsatyas, with the fresh velocity of a hawk; bearing an oblation, I invoke you,Aśvins, at the rising of the ever constant dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथं॑ पुरुमा॒यं म॑नो॒जुवं॑ जी॒राश्वं॑ य॒ज्ञियं॑ जी॒वसे॑ हुवे । स॒हस्र॑केतुं व॒निनं॑ श॒तद्व॑सुं श्रुष्टी॒वानं॑ वरिवो॒धाम॒भि प्रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ puru-māyám ǀ manaḥ-júvam ǀ jīrá-aśvam ǀ yajñíyam ǀ jīváse ǀ huve ǀsahásra-ketum ǀ vanínam ǀ śatát-vasum ǀ śruṣṭī-vā́nam ǀ varivaḥ-dhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiringfood, I invoke, (Aśvins), to support my life, your wonderful car, swift as thought, drawn by fleet horses, worthy of veneration, many-bannered, bringing rain, containing wealth, abundantly yielding delight, and conferring riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वा धी॒तिः प्रत्य॑स्य॒ प्रया॑म॒न्यधा॑यि॒ शस्म॒न्त्सम॑यन्त॒ आ दिश॑: । स्वदा॑मि घ॒र्मं प्रति॑ यन्त्यू॒तय॒ आ वा॑मू॒र्जानी॒ रथ॑मश्विनारुहत्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvā́ ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ práti ǀ asya ǀ prá-yāmani ǀ ádhāyi ǀ śásman ǀ sám ǀ ayante ǀ ā́ ǀ díśaḥ ǀsvádāmi ǀ gharmám ǀ práti ǀ yanti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ūrjā́nī ǀ rátham ǀ aśvinā ǀ aruhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon its moving, our minds have been raised on high in praise; our hymns reach (theAśvins). I sweeten the oblation; the assistants come nigh; Ūrjāni, (the daughter of the sun), has ascended, Aśvins, your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यन्मि॒थः प॑स्पृधा॒नासो॒ अग्म॑त शु॒भे म॒खा अमि॑ता जा॒यवो॒ रणे॑ । यु॒वोरह॑ प्रव॒णे चे॑किते॒ रथो॒ यद॑श्विना॒ वह॑थः सू॒रिमा वर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ mitháḥ ǀ paspṛdhānā́saḥ ǀ ágmata ǀ śubhé ǀ makhā́ḥ ǀ ámitāḥ ǀ jāyávaḥ ǀ ráṇe ǀyuvóḥ ǀ áha ǀ pravaṇé ǀ cekite ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ yát ǀ aśvinā ǀ váhathaḥ ǀ sūrím ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When devout and unnumbered (men), victorious in battle, mutually contending for wealth, come together, your car,Aśvins, is perceived on its downward course, in which you bear excellent (treasure) to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं भु॒ज्युं भु॒रमा॑णं॒ विभि॑र्ग॒तं स्वयु॑क्तिभिर्नि॒वह॑न्ता पि॒तृभ्य॒ आ । या॒सि॒ष्टं व॒र्तिर्वृ॑षणा विजे॒न्यं१॒॑ दिवो॑दासाय॒ महि॑ चेति वा॒मव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ bhurámāṇam ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ gatám ǀ sváyukti-bhiḥ ǀ ni-váhantā ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀyāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vi-jenyám ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ máhi ǀ ceti ǀ vām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You brought back to his ancestor (Bhujyu, who, borne by his own steeds, had perished), (but that you rescued him) with your self-harnessed horses, and sent showerers (o fbenefits), to his distant dwellign; and great was the succour whichit is know you rendered toDivodāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोर॑श्विना॒ वपु॑षे युवा॒युजं॒ रथं॒ वाणी॑ येमतुरस्य॒ शर्ध्य॑म् । आ वां॑ पति॒त्वं स॒ख्याय॑ ज॒ग्मुषी॒ योषा॑वृणीत॒ जेन्या॑ यु॒वां पती॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vápuṣe ǀ yuvā-yújam ǀ rátham ǀ vā́ṇī íti ǀ yematuḥ ǀ asya ǀ śárdhyam ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ pati-tvám ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ jagmúṣī ǀ yóṣā ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ jényā ǀ yuvā́m ǀ pátī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, your admirable (horses) bore the car which you had carnessed, (first) to the goal, for the sake of honour, and the damsel, who was the prize, came through  affection, to you, and acknowledged your (husbandship), saying, "you are (my) lords".”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं रे॒भं परि॑षूतेरुरुष्यथो हि॒मेन॑ घ॒र्मं परि॑तप्त॒मत्र॑ये । यु॒वं श॒योर॑व॒सं पि॑प्यथु॒र्गवि॒ प्र दी॒र्घेण॒ वन्द॑नस्ता॒र्यायु॑षा
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ rebhám ǀ pári-sūteḥ ǀ uruṣyathaḥ ǀ hiména ǀ gharmám ǀ pári-taptam ǀ átraye ǀyuvám ǀ śayóḥ ǀ avasám ǀ pipyathuḥ ǀ gávi ǀ prá ǀ dīrghéṇa ǀ vándanaḥ ǀ tāri ǀ ā́yuṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You preserved Rebha from the violence around him; you quenched with snow, forAtri, the scorching heat; you genitive rated milk in the cow ofŚayu; and (by you) wasVandanāendowed with prolonged life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं वन्द॑नं॒ निॠ॑तं जर॒ण्यया॒ रथं॒ न द॑स्रा कर॒णा समि॑न्वथः । क्षेत्रा॒दा विप्रं॑ जनथो विप॒न्यया॒ प्र वा॒मत्र॑ विध॒ते दं॒सना॑ भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ vándanam ǀ níḥ-ṛtam ǀ jaraṇyáyā ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ dasrā ǀ karaṇā́ ǀ sám ǀ invathaḥ ǀkṣétrāt ǀ ā́ ǀ vípram ǀ janathaḥ ǀ vipanyáyā ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ átra ǀ vidhaté ǀ daṃsánā ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SkillfulDasras, you restoredVandanā, when debilitated by old age, as a (wheelwright repairs a worn-out) car; (moved) by his praises, you brought forth the sage (Vāmadeva) from the womb; may your (glorious) deeds be (displayed) for him who in this plural ce offers you worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग॑च्छतं॒ कृप॑माणं परा॒वति॑ पि॒तुः स्वस्य॒ त्यज॑सा॒ निबा॑धितम् । स्व॑र्वतीरि॒त ऊ॒तीर्यु॒वोरह॑ चि॒त्रा अ॒भीके॑ अभवन्न॒भिष्ट॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ágacchatam ǀ kṛ́pamāṇam ǀ parā-váti ǀ pitúḥ ǀ svásya ǀ tyájasā ǀ ní-bādhitam ǀsváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀ ūtī́ḥ ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ áha ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ abhī́ke ǀ abhavan ǀ abhíṣṭayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You repaired to him who, aflicted by the abandonment of his own father, praised you from afar; hence your prompt and wonderful succours have been wished to be athand(by all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्या वां॒ मधु॑म॒न्मक्षि॑कारप॒न्मदे॒ सोम॑स्यौशि॒जो हु॑वन्यति । यु॒वं द॑धी॒चो मन॒ आ वि॑वास॒थोऽथा॒ शिर॒: प्रति॑ वा॒मश्व्यं॑ वदत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ mákṣikā ǀ arapat ǀ máde ǀ sómasya ǀ auśijáḥ ǀ huvanyati ǀyuvám ǀ dadhīcáḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsathaḥ ǀ átha ǀ śíraḥ ǀ práti ǀ vām ǀ áśvyam ǀ vadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That honey-seeking bee also murmured your praise; the son of Us;ij invokes you to the exhilaratin ofSoma; you conciliated the mind of Dadhyañc, so that, provided with the head of a horse, he taught you (the mystic science).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं पे॒दवे॑ पुरु॒वार॑मश्विना स्पृ॒धां श्वे॒तं त॑रु॒तारं॑ दुवस्यथः । शर्यै॑र॒भिद्युं॒ पृत॑नासु दु॒ष्टरं॑ च॒र्कृत्य॒मिन्द्र॑मिव चर्षणी॒सह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ pedáve ǀ puru-vā́ram ǀ aśvinā ǀ spṛdhā́m ǀ śvetám ǀ tarutā́ram ǀ duvasyathaḥ ǀśáryaiḥ ǀ abhí-dyum ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ dustáram ǀ carkṛ́tyam ǀ índram-iva ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, you gave toPeduthe white (horse) desired by many, the breaker-through of combatants, shining, unconquerable by foes in battle, fit for every work; likeIndra, the conquerer of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का रा॑ध॒द्धोत्रा॑श्विना वां॒ को वां॒ जोष॑ उ॒भयो॑: । क॒था वि॑धा॒त्यप्र॑चेताः
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ rādhat ǀ hótrā ǀ aśvinā ǀ vām ǀ káḥ ǀ vām ǀ jóṣe ǀ ubháyoḥ ǀkathā́ ǀ vidhāti ǀ ápra-cetāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What praise may propitiate you,Aśvins? who may give satisfaction to you both? how may an ignorant (man) pay fitting homage?”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्वांसा॒विद्दुर॑: पृच्छे॒दवि॑द्वानि॒त्थाप॑रो अचे॒ताः । नू चि॒न्नु मर्ते॒ अक्रौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: vidvā́ṃsau ǀ ít ǀ dúraḥ ǀ pṛcchet ǀ ávidvān ǀ itthā́ ǀ áparaḥ ǀ acetā́ḥ ǀnú ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ márte ǀ ákrau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus may an ignorant man inquire the means of worshipping the all-wise, for every (one) other (than theAśvins) is unknowing; they, the unconquered, quickly(show favour) to the man (who worships them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वि॒द्वांसा॑ हवामहे वां॒ ता नो॑ वि॒द्वांसा॒ मन्म॑ वोचेतम॒द्य । प्रार्च॒द्दय॑मानो यु॒वाकु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vidvā́ṃsā ǀ havāmahe ǀ vām ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vidvā́ṃsā ǀ mánma ǀ vocetam ǀ adyá ǀprá ǀ ārcat ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you, who know all things; may you, who are omniscient, declare to us today the praise tha tis acceptable; desirous of your presence, I reverence you, offering (oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि पृ॑च्छामि पा॒क्या॒३॒॑ न दे॒वान्वष॑ट्कृतस्याद्भु॒तस्य॑ दस्रा । पा॒तं च॒ सह्य॑सो यु॒वं च॒ रभ्य॑सो नः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ pṛcchāmi ǀ pākyā́ ǀ ná ǀ devā́n ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtasya ǀ adbhutásya ǀ dasrā ǀpātám ǀ ca ǀ sáhyasaḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ ca ǀ rábhyasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invite not the gods immature (in wisdom), but you,Dasras; drink of the wonderful and strength-giving burnt-offering, and make us vigorous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र या घोषे॒ भृग॑वाणे॒ न शोभे॒ यया॑ वा॒चा यज॑ति पज्रि॒यो वा॑म् । प्रैष॒युर्न वि॒द्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yā́ ǀ ghóṣe ǀ bhṛ́gavāṇe ǀ ná ǀ śóbhe ǀ yáyā ǀ vācā́ ǀ yájati ǀ pajriyáḥ ǀ vām ǀprá ǀ iṣa-yúḥ ǀ ná ǀ vidvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful is the hymn that was repeated by the son ofGhoṣā, and byBhṛgu, and with which hymn theAṅgirasasadore you; may the sage (kakṣīvat), desirous (of food), obtain it abundantly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒तं गा॑य॒त्रं तक॑वानस्या॒हं चि॒द्धि रि॒रेभा॑श्विना वाम् । आक्षी शु॑भस्पती॒ दन्
shlokas.transliteration: śrutám ǀ gāyatrám ǀ tákavānasya ǀ ahám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ rirébha ǀ aśvinā ǀ vām ǀā́ ǀ akṣī́ íti ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ dán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear the song of the stumbling (blind man), for verily,Aśvins, I glorify you, recovering my eyes (through you), who are protectors of good works”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं ह्यास्तं॑ म॒हो रन्यु॒वं वा॒ यन्नि॒रत॑तंसतम् । ता नो॑ वसू सुगो॒पा स्या॑तं पा॒तं नो॒ वृका॑दघा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ hí ǀ ā́stam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rán ǀ yuvám ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ niḥ-átataṃsatam ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vasū íti ǀ su-gopā́ ǀ syātam ǀ pātám ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́kāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have been givers of great riches; you have again caused them to disappear; do you, who are donors of dwellings, become our preservers; protect us from the felonous robber.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा कस्मै॑ धातम॒भ्य॑मि॒त्रिणे॑ नो॒ माकुत्रा॑ नो गृ॒हेभ्यो॑ धे॒नवो॑ गुः । स्त॒ना॒भुजो॒ अशि॑श्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kásmai ǀ dhātam ǀ abhí ǀ amitríṇe ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ akútra ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛhébhyaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ guḥ ǀstana-bhújaḥ ǀ áśiśvīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “deliver us not,Aśvins, to our enemies; never may our cows, who nourish us with their udders, stray from our houses, separated from their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒ही॒यन्मि॒त्रधि॑तये यु॒वाकु॑ रा॒ये च॑ नो मिमी॒तं वाज॑वत्यै । इ॒षे च॑ नो मिमीतं धेनु॒मत्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: duhīyán ǀ mitrá-dhitaye ǀ yuvā́ku ǀ rāyé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ mimītám ǀ vā́ja-vatyai ǀiṣé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ mimītam ǀ dhénu-mátyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who adore you obtain (wealth) for the support of their friends; direct us to opulence, bestowing food; direct us to food, associated with kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒श्विनो॑रसनं॒ रथ॑मन॒श्वं वा॒जिनी॑वतोः । तेना॒हं भूरि॑ चाकन
shlokas.transliteration: aśvínoḥ ǀ asanam ǀ rátham ǀ anaśvám ǀ vājínī-vatoḥ ǀténa ǀ ahám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ cākana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have obtained, without horses, the car of the food-bestowingAśvins, and expect (to gain) by it much (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स॑मह मा तनू॒ह्याते॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ । सो॒म॒पेयं॑ सु॒खो रथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ samaha ǀ mā ǀ tanu ǀ ūhyā́te ǀ jánān ǀ ánu ǀsoma-péyam ǀ su-kháḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (is he who has obtained you), wealth- bearing (car); augment (my prosperity); may the delightful car bear theSomabeverage (to theAśvins).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ स्वप्न॑स्य॒ निर्वि॒देऽभु॑ञ्जतश्च रे॒वत॑: । उ॒भा ता बस्रि॑ नश्यतः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ svápnasya ǀ níḥ ǀ vide ǀ ábhuñjataḥ ǀ ca ǀ revátaḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ básri ǀ naśyataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now am I disdainful of sleep, and of the rich man who benefits not others, for both (the morning sleep and the selfish rich man) quickly perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कदि॒त्था नॄँ: पात्रं॑ देवय॒तां श्रव॒द्गिरो॒ अङ्गि॑रसां तुर॒ण्यन् । प्र यदान॒ड्विश॒ आ ह॒र्म्यस्यो॒रु क्रं॑सते अध्व॒रे यज॑त्रः
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ itthā́ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ pā́tram ǀ deva-yatā́m ǀ śrávat ǀ gíraḥ ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ turaṇyán ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ harmyásya ǀ urú ǀ kraṃsate ǀ adhvaré ǀ yájatraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When willIndra, the protector of men and granter of riches, listen to the praises thus (recited) of theAṅgirasas, who are devoted to the gods? When he perceives the ministers of the master of the mansion, and is to be the object of worship in the sacrifice, he greatly exults.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तम्भी॑द्ध॒ द्यां स ध॒रुणं॑ प्रुषायदृ॒भुर्वाजा॑य॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ नरो॒ गोः । अनु॑ स्व॒जां म॑हि॒षश्च॑क्षत॒ व्रां मेना॒मश्व॑स्य॒ परि॑ मा॒तरं॒ गोः
shlokas.transliteration: stámbhīt ǀ ha ǀ dyā́m ǀ sáḥ ǀ dharúṇam ǀ pruṣāyat ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ dráviṇam ǀ náraḥ ǀ góḥ ǀánu ǀ sva-jā́m ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ cakṣata ǀ vrā́m ǀ ménām ǀ áśvasya ǀ pári ǀ mātáram ǀ góḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily upholds the heaven; he, the brilliant, the leader of the (stolen) herd, pours forth the flowing (water), for the sake of food; the mightyIndramanifests himself after his own daughter (the dawn); he made the feminine le of the horse unnaturally the mother of the cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नक्ष॒द्धव॑मरु॒णीः पू॒र्व्यं राट् तु॒रो वि॒शामङ्गि॑रसा॒मनु॒ द्यून् । तक्ष॒द्वज्रं॒ नियु॑तं त॒स्तम्भ॒द्द्यां चतु॑ष्पदे॒ नर्या॑य द्वि॒पादे॑
shlokas.transliteration: nákṣat ǀ hávam ǀ aruṇī́ḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ rā́ṭ ǀ turáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀtákṣat ǀ vájram ǀ ní-yutam ǀ tastámbhat ǀ dyā́m ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ náryāya ǀ dvi-pā́de ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, illuminating the purple (dawn), listen to the invocation (addressed to him) of old, daily besowing wealth upon the race ofAṅgiras; he has sharpened his fatal shaft; he has supported the heaven for the good of men, of quadrupeds, andbipeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य मदे॑ स्व॒र्यं॑ दा ऋ॒तायापी॑वृतमु॒स्रिया॑णा॒मनी॑कम् । यद्ध॑ प्र॒सर्गे॑ त्रिक॒कुम्नि॒वर्त॒दप॒ द्रुहो॒ मानु॑षस्य॒ दुरो॑ वः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ máde ǀ svaryám ǀ dāḥ ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ ápi-vṛtam ǀ usríyāṇām ǀ ánīkam ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ pra-sárge ǀ tri-kakúp ǀ ni-vártat ǀ ápa ǀ drúhaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣasya ǀ dúraḥ ǀ varíti vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the exhilaration of theSoma, you have restored the celebrated herd of cattle, hidden (in the cave), for the sake of sacrifice, (to theAṅgirasas); when,Indra, the threefold crest engages in combat, he opens the doors of the tyrannical descendants ofManu”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ पयो॒ यत्पि॒तरा॒वनी॑तां॒ राध॑: सु॒रेत॑स्तु॒रणे॑ भुर॒ण्यू । शुचि॒ यत्ते॒ रेक्ण॒ आय॑जन्त सब॒र्दुघा॑या॒: पय॑ उ॒स्रिया॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ páyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ pitárau ǀ ánītām ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ su-rétaḥ ǀ turáṇe ǀ bhuraṇyū́ íti ǀśúci ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ áyajanta ǀ sabaḥ-dúghāyāḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ usríyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When your parents, (heaven and earth), theprotectors (of the world), brought the nutritious and invigorating oblation to you, who are quick in act, and when they offered you the pure and precious milk of the cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ प्र ज॑ज्ञे त॒रणि॑र्ममत्तु॒ प्र रो॑च्य॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ न सूर॑: । इन्दु॒र्येभि॒राष्ट॒ स्वेदु॑हव्यैः स्रु॒वेण॑ सि॒ञ्चञ्ज॒रणा॒भि धाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ prá ǀ jajñe ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ mamattu ǀ prá ǀ roci ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́raḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ ā́ṣṭa ǀ svá-íduhavyaiḥ ǀ sruvéṇa ǀ siñcán ǀ jaráṇā ǀ abhí ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now isIndramanifested; may he, the over-comer (of his foes), grant us happiness,he, who shines brightly, like the sun of this dawn; may the excellentSoma, being sprinklled upon the plural ceof sacrifice with a ladle, (exhilarate us), by whom, presenting the oblations we had prepared, it was imbibed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वि॒ध्मा यद्व॒नधि॑तिरप॒स्यात्सूरो॑ अध्व॒रे परि॒ रोध॑ना॒ गोः । यद्ध॑ प्र॒भासि॒ कृत्व्याँ॒ अनु॒ द्यूनन॑र्विशे प॒श्विषे॑ तु॒राय॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-idhmā́ ǀ yát ǀ vaná-dhitiḥ ǀ apasyā́t ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ pári ǀ ródhanā ǀ góḥ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ pra-bhā́si ǀ kṛ́tvyān ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ ánarviśe ǀ paśu-íṣe ǀ turā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the bright-edged hatchet is ready for its work, the directing priest is able to have the victim bound in the sacrifice; whenIndra, you shine upon the days that are appropriated to sacred rites, then (success attends) upon the man who goes with his cart (for fuel), the driver (of cattle), or the active (shepherd).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ष्टा म॒हो दि॒व आदो॒ हरी॑ इ॒ह द्यु॑म्ना॒साह॑म॒भि यो॑धा॒न उत्स॑म् । हरिं॒ यत्ते॑ म॒न्दिनं॑ दु॒क्षन्वृ॒धे गोर॑भस॒मद्रि॑भिर्वा॒ताप्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: aṣṭā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́daḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ ihá ǀ dyumna-sáham ǀ abhí ǀ yodhānáḥ ǀ útsam ǀhárim ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mandínam ǀ dhukṣán ǀ vṛdhé ǀ gó-rabhasam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ vātā́pyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send hither your horses, the quaffers of the exhilarating libation; overcome, warrior, the adversary plural ndering us of our treasure; when they express with stones, for the increase (of your strength), the delightful, exhilarating, invigorating (Soma), to be overtaken by you, who are swifter than the wind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमा॑य॒सं प्रति॑ वर्तयो॒ गोर्दि॒वो अश्मा॑न॒मुप॑नीत॒मृभ्वा॑ । कुत्सा॑य॒ यत्र॑ पुरुहूत व॒न्वञ्छुष्ण॑मन॒न्तैः प॑रि॒यासि॑ व॒धैः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ āyasám ǀ práti ǀ vartayaḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ áśmānam ǀ úpa-nītam ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀkútsāya ǀ yátra ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vanván ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ anantáiḥ ǀ pari-yā́si ǀ vadháiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You did hurl your metal bolt upon the quick-moving (asura), the swift destroyer of foes, that was brought (to you) byṚbhufrom heaven; when you, who are worshipped by many, strikingŚuṣṇa, for the sake ofKutsa, did encompass him with numberless fatal (weapons).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रा यत्सूर॒स्तम॑सो॒ अपी॑ते॒स्तम॑द्रिवः फलि॒गं हे॒तिम॑स्य । शुष्ण॑स्य चि॒त्परि॑हितं॒ यदोजो॑ दि॒वस्परि॒ सुग्र॑थितं॒ तदाद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: purā́ ǀ yát ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ ápi-iteḥ ǀ tám ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ phali-gám ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǀśúṣṇasya ǀ cit ǀ pári-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ójaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ sú-grathitam ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ adarítyadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sun (had emerged) from the struggle with darkness, you did break, wielder of the thunderbolt, the cloud that had been his annoyance, and did under the well-fastened covering in whichŚuṣṇahad enveloped him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ त्वा म॒ही पाज॑सी अच॒क्रे द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ मदतामिन्द्र॒ कर्म॑न् । त्वं वृ॒त्रमा॒शया॑नं सि॒रासु॑ म॒हो वज्रे॑ण सिष्वपो व॒राहु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tvā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ pā́jasī íti ǀ acakré íti ǀ dyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ madatām ǀ indra ǀ kárman ǀtvám ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ sirā́su ǀ maháḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ sisvapaḥ ǀ varā́hum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then the vast, powerful, and immoveable earth and heaven animated you,Indra, to glorious needs, and you did hurl down into the waters, with your mightythunderbolt, the everywhere-spreading and destroyingVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ नर्यो॒ याँ अवो॒ नॄन्तिष्ठा॒ वात॑स्य सु॒युजो॒ वहि॑ष्ठान् । यं ते॑ का॒व्य उ॒शना॑ म॒न्दिनं॒ दाद्वृ॑त्र॒हणं॒ पार्यं॑ ततक्ष॒ वज्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ náryaḥ ǀ yā́n ǀ ávaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ tíṣṭha ǀ vā́tasya ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhān ǀyám ǀ te ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ uśánā ǀ mandínam ǀ dā́t ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ pā́ryam ǀ tatakṣa ǀ vájram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, friend of man, mount the horses whom you cherish, who are fleet as the wind, are easily yoked, and who bear (theri burden) well; you have sharpened the foe-destroying thunderbolt, the slayer ofVṛtra, which inspiring (weapon)Uśanas, the son ofKavi, gave you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सूरो॑ ह॒रितो॑ रामयो॒ नॄन्भर॑च्च॒क्रमेत॑शो॒ नायमि॑न्द्र । प्रास्य॑ पा॒रं न॑व॒तिं ना॒व्या॑ना॒मपि॑ क॒र्तम॑वर्त॒योऽय॑ज्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ramayaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ bhárat ǀ cakrám ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ayám ǀ indra ǀpra-ásya ǀ pārám ǀ navatím ǀ nāvyā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ kartám ǀ avartayaḥ ǀ áyajyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stop,Sūra, your yellow horses, for thisEtaśa,Indra, drags the wheel; having driven those who offer no sacrifices to the opposite bank of the ninety rivers, you compel them (to do) what is to be done.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अ॒स्या इ॑न्द्र दु॒र्हणा॑याः पा॒हि व॑ज्रिवो दुरि॒ताद॒भीके॑ । प्र नो॒ वाजा॑न्र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ अश्व॑बुध्यानि॒षे य॑न्धि॒ श्रव॑से सू॒नृता॑यै
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ duḥ-hánāyāḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ abhī́ke ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ áśva-budhyān ǀ iṣé ǀ yandhi ǀ śrávase ǀ sūnṛ́tāyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, bearer of the thunderbolt, preserve us from this (poverty), that is so difficult to be destroyed, and from misfortune in war; grant us riches, conspicuous for chariots, remarkable for horses, for the sake of food, of fame, and of truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा सा ते॑ अ॒स्मत्सु॑म॒तिर्वि द॑स॒द्वाज॑प्रमह॒: समिषो॑ वरन्त । आ नो॑ भज मघव॒न्गोष्व॒र्यो मंहि॑ष्ठास्ते सध॒माद॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ asmát ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ví ǀ dasat ǀ vā́ja-pramahaḥ ǀ sám ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ varanta ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhaja ǀ magha-van ǀ góṣu ǀ aryáḥ ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ te ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Famous for affluence,Indra, never may your favour be withdrawn from us; may food ever sustain us; opulentMaghavan, make us possessors of cattle, and may we, most assiduous in your adoration, be happy, together (with our families).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒: पान्तं॑ रघुमन्य॒वोऽन्धो॑ य॒ज्ञं रु॒द्राय॑ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ भरध्वम् । दि॒वो अ॑स्तो॒ष्यसु॑रस्य वी॒रैरि॑षु॒ध्येव॑ म॒रुतो॒ रोद॑स्योः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ pā́ntam ǀ raghu-manyavaḥ ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ bharadhvam ǀdiváḥ ǀ astoṣi ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ iṣudhyā́-iva ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Present, mild-tempered (priests), the sacrificial viands which you have prepared, to there warm-showeringRudra. I praise him who, with his heroid (followers) as (with shafts) from a quiver, expelled (theasuras) from heaven; and (I praise) theMaruts, (who abide) between heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पत्नी॑व पू॒र्वहू॑तिं वावृ॒धध्या॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ पुरु॒धा विदा॑ने । स्त॒रीर्नात्कं॒ व्यु॑तं॒ वसा॑ना॒ सूर्य॑स्य श्रि॒या सु॒दृशी॒ हिर॑ण्यैः
shlokas.transliteration: pátnī-iva ǀ pūrvá-hūtim ǀ vavṛdhádhyai ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ purudhā́ ǀ vídāne íti ǀstarī́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ átkam ǀ ví-utam ǀ vásānā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ śriyā́ ǀ su-dṛ́śī ǀ híraṇyaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Animated by our diversified praise, hasten, Morning and Night, to attend to our first invocation, as a wife (to the first call of her husband); and may the--Dawn, beautiful with the lustre of the (rising) Sun, and robbing like the Sun (her) vast expanse with golden rays, (come to our early rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒मत्तु॑ न॒: परि॑ज्मा वस॒र्हा म॒मत्तु॒ वातो॑ अ॒पां वृष॑ण्वान् । शि॒शी॒तमि॑न्द्रापर्वता यु॒वं न॒स्तन्नो॒ विश्वे॑ वरिवस्यन्तु दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: mamáttu ǀ naḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀ vasarhā́ ǀ mamáttu ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇ-vān ǀśiśītám ǀ indrāparvatā ǀ yuvám ǀ naḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ varivasyantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the circumambient divinity, the wearer of various forms, grant us delight; may the wind, the shedder of rain, grant us delight; do you,IndraandParvata, sharpen our (intellects), and may all the gods show us favour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या मे॑ य॒शसा॑ श्वेत॒नायै॒ व्यन्ता॒ पान्तौ॑शि॒जो हु॒वध्यै॑ । प्र वो॒ नपा॑तम॒पां कृ॑णुध्वं॒ प्र मा॒तरा॑ रास्पि॒नस्या॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ me ǀ yaśásā ǀ śvetanā́yai ǀ vyántā ǀ pā́ntā ǀ auśijáḥ ǀ huvádhyai ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ apā́m ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ mātárā ǀ rāspinásya ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whenever I, the son of Uśij, worship with my offerings (of food) those two (Aśvins) who eat and drink (of oblations and libations) at (the season) of the world-whitening (dawn); do you, Priests, glorify the grandson of the waters (Agni), and render (the divinities of the day and night) the mothers (as it were) of the man who repeats their praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॑ रुव॒ण्युमौ॑शि॒जो हु॒वध्यै॒ घोषे॑व॒ शंस॒मर्जु॑नस्य॒ नंशे॑ । प्र व॑: पू॒ष्णे दा॒वन॒ आँ अच्छा॑ वोचेय व॒सुता॑तिम॒ग्नेः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ruvaṇyúm ǀ auśijáḥ ǀ huvádhyai ǀ ghóṣā-iva ǀ śáṃsam ǀ árjunasya ǀ náṃśe ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ dāváne ǀ ā́ ǀ áccha ǀ voceya ǀ vasú-tātim ǀ agnéḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I, the son of Uśij, address to you (Aśvins) audible praises, in like manner asGhoṣāpraised you for the removal of her white-tinted (skin); I glorify (gods) the bountifulPūṣan(associated) with you, and I proclaim the munificence ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒तं मे॑ मित्रावरुणा॒ हवे॒मोत श्रु॑तं॒ सद॑ने वि॒श्वत॑: सीम् । श्रोतु॑ न॒: श्रोतु॑रातिः सु॒श्रोतु॑: सु॒क्षेत्रा॒ सिन्धु॑र॒द्भिः
shlokas.transliteration: śrutám ǀ me ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ hávā ǀ imā́ ǀ utá ǀ śrutam ǀ sádane ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ sīm ǀśrótu ǀ naḥ ǀ śrótu-rātiḥ ǀ su-śrótuḥ ǀ su-kṣétrā ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, hear these my invocations, and moreover listen to those (that are) everywhere (uttered) in the chamber of sacrifice; and maySindhu, the renowned bestower of wealth, hear us, (fertilizing our) broad fields with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒षे सा वां॑ वरुण मित्र रा॒तिर्गवां॑ श॒ता पृ॒क्षया॑मेषु प॒ज्रे । श्रु॒तर॑थे प्रि॒यर॑थे॒ दधा॑नाः स॒द्यः पु॒ष्टिं नि॑रुन्धा॒नासो॑ अग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ sā́ ǀ vām ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ rātíḥ ǀ gávām ǀ śatā́ ǀ pṛkṣá-yāmeṣu ǀ pajré ǀśrutá-rathe ǀ priyá-rathe ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ni-rundhānā́saḥ ǀ agman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise you,MitraandVaruṇa, for your gift of numerous cattle to the Pajra, and (from those praises) may abundant food (proceed). May (the gods), bestowing nourishment on me, come quickly unimpeded, (each) in his famous and favourite car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य स्तु॑षे॒ महि॑मघस्य॒ राध॒: सचा॑ सनेम॒ नहु॑षः सु॒वीरा॑: । जनो॒ यः प॒ज्रेभ्यो॑ वा॒जिनी॑वा॒नश्वा॑वतो र॒थिनो॒ मह्यं॑ सू॒रिः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ stuṣe ǀ máhi-maghasya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sácā ǀ sanema ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀjánaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pajrébhyaḥ ǀ vājínī-vān ǀ áśva-vataḥ ǀ rathínaḥ ǀ máhyam ǀ sūríḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I laud the treasures of that opulent (assemblyof the gods); may we, men who (are blessed) with excellent descendants, partake of them together; the assembly conferring upon the Pajras abundant food, has been my benefactor, and has made me the master of horses and chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जनो॒ यो मि॑त्रावरुणावभि॒ध्रुग॒पो न वां॑ सु॒नोत्य॑क्ष्णया॒ध्रुक् । स्व॒यं स यक्ष्मं॒ हृद॑ये॒ नि ध॑त्त॒ आप॒ यदीं॒ होत्रा॑भिॠ॒तावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: jánaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ abhi-dhrúk ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vām ǀ sunóti ǀ akṣṇayā-dhrúk ǀsvayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yákṣmam ǀ hṛ́daye ǀ ní ǀ dhatte ǀ ā́pa ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mman who does you wrong,MitraandVaruṇa, who injures you in any way, who does not present you with oblations, contracts for himself sickness in his heart; but he who, performing worship, (celebrates it) with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स व्राध॑तो॒ नहु॑षो॒ दंसु॑जूत॒: शर्ध॑स्तरो न॒रां गू॒र्तश्र॑वाः । विसृ॑ष्टरातिर्याति बाळ्ह॒सृत्वा॒ विश्वा॑सु पृ॒त्सु सद॒मिच्छूर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ dáṃ-sujūtaḥ ǀ śárdhaḥ-taraḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ gūrtá-śravāḥ ǀvísṛṣṭa-rātiḥ ǀ yāti ǀ bāḷha-sṛ́tvā ǀ víśvāsu ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ śū́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, borne by well-trained horses, endowed with surpassing strength, renowned above men, munificent in gifts, moves a hero, ever undaunted in all combats, (even) against mightymen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ ग्मन्ता॒ नहु॑षो॒ हवं॑ सू॒रेः श्रोता॑ राजानो अ॒मृत॑स्य मन्द्राः । न॒भो॒जुवो॒ यन्नि॑र॒वस्य॒ राध॒: प्रश॑स्तये महि॒ना रथ॑वते
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ gmánta ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ hávam ǀ sūréḥ ǀ śróta ǀ rājānaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ mandrāḥ ǀnabhaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ yát ǀ niravásya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ prá-śastaye ǀ mahinā́ ǀ rátha-vate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Royal bestowers of delight, listen to the invocation of (your) undying worshipper, and then come hither, that you who traverse the sky may be propitiated by the greatness of the (sacrificial) wealth presented to you by the sacrificer, who acknowledges no other protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं शर्धं॑ धाम॒ यस्य॑ सू॒रेरित्य॑वोच॒न्दश॑तयस्य॒ नंशे॑ । द्यु॒म्नानि॒ येषु॑ व॒सुता॑ती रा॒रन्विश्वे॑ सन्वन्तु प्रभृ॒थेषु॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ śárdham ǀ dhāma ǀ yásya ǀ sūréḥ ǀ íti ǀ avocan ǀ dáśa-tayasya ǀ náṃśe ǀdyumnā́ni ǀ yéṣu ǀ vasú-tātiḥ ǀ rarán ǀ víśve ǀ sanvantu ǀ pra-bhṛthéṣu ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have declared: we confer present vigour upon the worshipper (who invokes us) to partake of the (ibation). May all (the gods) in whom splendour and riches abound, bestow (abundant) food at (solemn) sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्दा॑महे॒ दश॑तयस्य धा॒सेर्द्विर्यत्पञ्च॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ यन्त्यन्ना॑ । किमि॒ष्टाश्व॑ इ॒ष्टर॑श्मिरे॒त ई॑शा॒नास॒स्तरु॑ष ऋञ्जते॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: mándāmahe ǀ dáśa-tayasya ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ dvíḥ ǀ yát ǀ páñca ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ yánti ǀ ánnā ǀkím ǀ iṣṭá-aśvaḥ ǀ iṣṭá-raśmiḥ ǀ eté ǀ īśānā́saḥ ǀ táruṣaḥ ǀ ṛñjate ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We rejoice tha tfor the satisfaction of the ten (organs of sense), the (priests) bearing the twice five (ladles of) sacrificial food, proceed (to the altar). What can Iṣṭaśva, (what can)Iṣṭaraśmi, (what can) those who are now lords of the earth, achieve (with respect) to the leaders of men, the conquerors of their foes?”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यकर्णं मणिग्रीव॒मर्ण॒स्तन्नो॒ विश्वे॑ वरिवस्यन्तु दे॒वाः । अ॒र्यो गिर॑: स॒द्य आ ज॒ग्मुषी॒रोस्राश्चा॑कन्तू॒भये॑ष्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-karṇam ǀ maṇi-grīvam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ tám ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ varivasyantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀaryáḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jagmúṣīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ cākantu ǀ ubháyeṣu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all the gods favour us with a person n decorated with golden earrings and jewel necklace; may the venerable (company of the deities) be propitiated by the praises issuing (from the mouth of the worshipper); may our offerings be acceptable to them, and (may they be plural ased) with both (our praises and offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वारो॑ मा मश॒र्शार॑स्य॒ शिश्व॒स्त्रयो॒ राज्ञ॒ आय॑वसस्य जि॒ष्णोः । रथो॑ वां मित्रावरुणा दी॒र्घाप्सा॒: स्यूम॑गभस्ति॒: सूरो॒ नाद्यौ॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: catvā́raḥ ǀ mā ǀ maśarśā́rasya ǀ śíśvaḥ ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ ā́yavasasya ǀ jiṣṇóḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ dīrghá-apsāḥ ǀ syū́ma-gabhastiḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ adyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The four (silly) sons of Maśar'śāra, the three of the victorious monarchĀyavasa(annoy) me. Let your spacious and bright-rayed chariot,MitraandVaruṇa, blaze (before them) like the sun (filling them with fear).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒थू रथो॒ दक्षि॑णाया अयो॒ज्यैनं॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒मृता॑सो अस्थुः । कृ॒ष्णादुद॑स्थाद॒र्या॒३॒॑ विहा॑या॒श्चिकि॑त्सन्ती॒ मानु॑षाय॒ क्षया॑य
shlokas.transliteration: pṛthúḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dákṣiṇāyāḥ ǀ ayoji ǀ ā́ ǀ enam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀkṛṣṇā́t ǀ út ǀ asthāt ǀ aryā́ ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ cíkitsantī ǀ mā́nuṣāya ǀ kṣáyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The spacious chariot of the graceful (dawn) has been harnessed; the immortal gods have ascended it; the noble and all-pervading Uṣā has risen up from the darkness, bringing health to human habitations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वा॒ विश्व॑स्मा॒द्भुव॑नादबोधि॒ जय॑न्ती॒ वाजं॑ बृह॒ती सनु॑त्री । उ॒च्चा व्य॑ख्यद्युव॒तिः पु॑न॒र्भूरोषा अ॑गन्प्रथ॒मा पू॒र्वहू॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rvā ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ bhúvanāt ǀ abodhi ǀ jáyantī ǀ vā́jam ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ sánutrī ǀuccā́ ǀ ví ǀ akhyat ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ punaḥ-bhū́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ agan ǀ prathamā́ ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “First of all the world is she awake, triumphing over transitory (darkness); the mighty, the giver (of light) from on high, she beholds (all things); ever youthful, ever reviving, she comes first to the invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य भा॒गं वि॒भजा॑सि॒ नृभ्य॒ उषो॑ देवि मर्त्य॒त्रा सु॑जाते । दे॒वो नो॒ अत्र॑ सवि॒ता दमू॑ना॒ अना॑गसो वोचति॒ सूर्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ bhāgám ǀ vi-bhájāsi ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ martya-trā́ ǀ su-jāte ǀdeváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ savitā́ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ vocati ǀ sū́ryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-born and divine Uṣā, who are the protectress of mortals; whatever share (of light) you apportion today to men, may the radiantSavitābedisposed (to confirm) the gift, and declar us free from sin; so that (he) the sun (may come to our sacrificial hall).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒हंगृ॑हमह॒ना या॒त्यच्छा॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ अधि॒ नामा॒ दधा॑ना । सिषा॑सन्ती द्योत॒ना शश्व॒दागा॒दग्र॑मग्र॒मिद्भ॑जते॒ वसू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: gṛhám-gṛham ǀ ahanā́ ǀ yāti ǀ áccha ǀ divé-dive ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́ma ǀ dádhānā ǀsísāsantī ǀ dyotanā́ ǀ śáśvat ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ ágram-agram ǀ ít ǀ bhajate ǀ vásūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ahana, charged with downward-bending (light), goes daily from house to house; she comes, perpetually diffusing light, and desirous of bestowing (benefits), and accepts the choicest portions of (the sacrificial) treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भग॑स्य॒ स्वसा॒ वरु॑णस्य जा॒मिरुष॑: सूनृते प्रथ॒मा ज॑रस्व । प॒श्चा स द॑घ्या॒ यो अ॒घस्य॑ धा॒ता जये॑म॒ तं दक्षि॑णया॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: bhágasya ǀ svásā ǀ váruṇasya ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ sūnṛte ǀ prathamā́ ǀ jarasva ǀpaścā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ daghyāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aghásya ǀ dhātā́ ǀ jáyema ǀ tám ǀ dákṣiṇayā ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣā, endowed with truth, who are the sister ofBhaga, the sister ofVaruṇa, be you hymned first (of the gods); then let the worker of iniquity depart, for we shall overcome him with our chariot, through your assistance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रतां सू॒नृता॒ उत्पुरं॑धी॒रुद॒ग्नय॑: शुशुचा॒नासो॑ अस्थुः । स्पा॒र्हा वसू॑नि॒ तम॒साप॑गूळ्हा॒विष्कृ॑ण्वन्त्यु॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īratām ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ út ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ út ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ śuśucānā́saḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀspārhā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ támasā ǀ ápa-gūḷhā ǀ āvíḥ ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let words of truth be spoken; let works of wisdom (be performed); let the blazing fires rise up, so that the many radiant Uṣā may make manifest the desirable treasures hidden by the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॒न्यदेत्य॒भ्य१॒॑न्यदे॑ति॒ विषु॑रूपे॒ अह॑नी॒ सं च॑रेते । प॒रि॒क्षितो॒स्तमो॑ अ॒न्या गुहा॑क॒रद्यौ॑दु॒षाः शोशु॑चता॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ anyát ǀ éti ǀ abhí ǀ anyát ǀ eti ǀ víṣurūpe íti víṣu-rūpe ǀ áhanī íti ǀ sám ǀ carete íti ǀpari-kṣítoḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ anyā́ ǀ gúhā ǀ akaḥ ǀ ádyaut ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ śóśucatā ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The twofold day proceeds unseparated; one (part going) forward, one backward; one of these two alternating (periods) effects the concealment (of things); the dawn illumines them with her radiant chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒दृशी॑र॒द्य स॒दृशी॒रिदु॒ श्वो दी॒र्घं स॑चन्ते॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाम॑ । अ॒न॒व॒द्यास्त्रिं॒शतं॒ योज॑ना॒न्येकै॑का॒ क्रतुं॒ परि॑ यन्ति स॒द्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śváḥ ǀ dīrghám ǀ sacante ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀanavadyā́ḥ ǀ triṃśátam ǀ yójanāni ǀ ékā-ekā ǀ krátum ǀ pári ǀ yanti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The same today, the same tomorrow, the irreproachable (dawn) precede the distant course ofVaruṇaby thirtyyojanas, and each in succession revolves in its (appointed) office.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒न॒त्यह्न॑: प्रथ॒मस्य॒ नाम॑ शु॒क्रा कृ॒ष्णाद॑जनिष्ट श्विती॒ची । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योषा॒ न मि॑नाति॒ धामाह॑रहर्निष्कृ॒तमा॒चर॑न्ती
shlokas.transliteration: jānatī́ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ prathamásya ǀ nā́ma ǀ śukrā́ ǀ kṛṣṇā́t ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ śvitīcī́ ǀṛtásya ǀ yóṣā ǀ ná ǀ mināti ǀ dhā́ma ǀ áhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ā-cárantī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The self-illumined dawn, announcing the declination of the first (portion) of the day, is born white-shining out of the gloom; cleansing (with the radiance) of the sun, she impairs not his splendour, but daily adds embellishment (to his lustre).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒न्ये॑व त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ शाश॑दानाँ॒ एषि॑ देवि दे॒वमिय॑क्षमाणम् । सं॒स्मय॑माना युव॒तिः पु॒रस्ता॑दा॒विर्वक्षां॑सि कृणुषे विभा॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: kanyā́-iva ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śā́śadānā ǀ éṣi ǀ devi ǀ devám ǀ íyakṣamāṇam ǀsam-smáyamānā ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ āvíḥ ǀ vákṣāṃsi ǀ kṛṇuṣe ǀ vi-bhātī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Goddess, manifest in person n like a maiden, you go to the resplendent and munificent (sun), and, like a youthful bride (beforeher husband), you uncover, smiling, yor bosom in his presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒सं॒का॒शा मा॒तृमृ॑ष्टेव॒ योषा॒विस्त॒न्वं॑ कृणुषे दृ॒शे कम् । भ॒द्रा त्वमु॑षो वित॒रं व्यु॑च्छ॒ न तत्ते॑ अ॒न्या उ॒षसो॑ नशन्त
shlokas.transliteration: su-saṃkāśā́ ǀ mātṛ́mṛṣṭā-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ āvíḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ kṛṇuṣe ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀbhadrā́ ǀ tvám ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ ná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ naśanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant as a bride decorated by her mother, you willingly display your person n to the view. Do you, auspicious Uṣā, remove the investing (gloom), for, other dawns than you do not disperse it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ यत॑माना र॒श्मिभि॒: सूर्य॑स्य । परा॑ च॒ यन्ति॒ पुन॒रा च॑ यन्ति भ॒द्रा नाम॒ वह॑माना उ॒षास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vatīḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ viśvá-vārāḥ ǀ yátamānāḥ ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀpárā ǀ ca ǀ yánti ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ yanti ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ nā́ma ǀ váhamānāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessed of horses, possessed of cows, existing through all time, vying with the rays of the sun (in dissipating darkness), auspicious dawns, sending down benefits (on mankind), pass away and again return.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ र॒श्मिम॑नु॒यच्छ॑माना भ॒द्रम्भ॑द्रं॒ क्रतु॑म॒स्मासु॑ धेहि । उषो॑ नो अ॒द्य सु॒हवा॒ व्यु॑च्छा॒स्मासु॒ रायो॑ म॒घव॑त्सु च स्युः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ raśmím ǀ anu-yácchamānā ǀ bhadrám-bhadram ǀ krátum ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhehi ǀúṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ su-hávā ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ asmā́su ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ maghávat-su ǀ ca ǀ syuríti syuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Co-operating with the rays of the true (sun), confirm in us every propitious act; earnestly invoked byus today, disperse, Uṣā, (the darkness), that wealth may devolve upon us, (already) affluent (in sacrificial treasures).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒षा उ॒च्छन्ती॑ समिधा॒ने अ॒ग्ना उ॒द्यन्त्सूर्य॑ उर्वि॒या ज्योति॑रश्रेत् । दे॒वो नो॒ अत्र॑ सवि॒ता न्वर्थं॒ प्रासा॑वीद्द्वि॒पत्प्र चतु॑ष्पदि॒त्यै
shlokas.transliteration: uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchántī ǀ sam-idhāné ǀ agnáu ǀ ut-yán ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ aśret ǀdeváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ savitā́ ǀ nú ǀ ártham ǀ prá ǀ asāvīt ǀ dvi-pát ǀ prá ǀ cátuḥ-pat ǀ ityái ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the (sacred) fire is kindled, Uṣā sheds abundant light, dispersing (the darkness) like the rising sun; may the divine Savitābestow upon usfor our use, wealth of both bipeds and quadrupeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमि॑नती॒ दैव्या॑नि व्र॒तानि॑ प्रमिन॒ती म॑नु॒ष्या॑ यु॒गानि॑ । ई॒युषी॑णामुप॒मा शश्व॑तीनामायती॒नां प्र॑थ॒मोषा व्य॑द्यौत्
shlokas.transliteration: áminatī ǀ dáivyāni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ pra-minatī́ ǀ manuṣyā́ ǀ yugā́ni ǀīyúṣīṇām ǀ upamā́ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ ā-yatīnā́m ǀ prathamā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unimpeding divine rites, although wearing away the ages of mankind, the dawn shines the similitude of the (mornings) that have passed, or that are to be forever, the first of those that are to come.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता प्रत्य॑दर्शि॒ ज्योति॒र्वसा॑ना सम॒ना पु॒रस्ता॑त् । ऋ॒तस्य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑ति सा॒धु प्र॑जान॒तीव॒ न दिशो॑ मिनाति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ práti ǀ adarśi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ vásānā ǀ samanā́ ǀ purástāt ǀṛtásya ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ sādhú ǀ prajānatī́-iva ǀ ná ǀ díśaḥ ǀ mināti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She, the daughter of heaven, is beheld in the east, gracious and arrayed in light; she travels steadily along the path of the sun, as if cognizant (of his plural asure), and damages not the quarters (of the horizon).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑ अदर्शि शु॒न्ध्युवो॒ न वक्षो॑ नो॒धा इ॑वा॒विर॑कृत प्रि॒याणि॑ । अ॒द्म॒सन्न स॑स॒तो बो॒धय॑न्ती शश्वत्त॒मागा॒त्पुन॑रे॒युषी॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ adarśi ǀ śundhyúvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ nodhā́ḥ-iva ǀ āvíḥ ǀ akṛta ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀadma-sát ǀ ná ǀ sasatáḥ ǀ bodháyantī ǀ śaśvat-tamā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā-īyúṣīṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She is beheld nigh athand, (radiant) as the breast of the illuminator (the sun); and, likeNodhas, has made manifest many plural asing (objects); like a matron she awakens (her) sleeping (children), and of all (feminine les who are) stirring betimes, she, the most unvarying, repeatedly appears.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वे॒ अर्धे॒ रज॑सो अ॒प्त्यस्य॒ गवां॒ जनि॑त्र्यकृत॒ प्र के॒तुम् । व्यु॑ प्रथते वित॒रं वरी॑य॒ ओभा पृ॒णन्ती॑ पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्था॑
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rve ǀ árdhe ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ aptyásya ǀ gávām ǀ jánitrī ǀ akṛta ǀ prá ǀ ketúm ǀví ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prathate ǀ vi-tarám ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhā́ ǀ pṛṇántī ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Born in the eastern quarter of the spacious firmament, she displays a banner of rays of light. plural ced on the lap of both parents (heaven and earth), filling them (with radiance), she enjoys vast and wide-spread renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदे॒षा पु॑रु॒तमा॑ दृ॒शे कं नाजा॑मिं॒ न परि॑ वृणक्ति जा॒मिम् । अ॒रे॒पसा॑ त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ शाश॑दाना॒ नार्भा॒दीष॑ते॒ न म॒हो वि॑भा॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ eṣā́ ǀ puru-támā ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀ ná ǀ ájāmim ǀ ná ǀ pári ǀ vṛṇakti ǀ jāmím ǀarepásā ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śā́śadānā ǀ ná ǀ árbhāt ǀ ī́ṣate ǀ ná ǀ maháḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily she, the wide-expanded Uṣā, neglects not (to give) the joy of sight to those of her own or of a different nature; visible in her faultless person n, and brightly shining, she passes not by the littleror the great.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्रा॒तेव॑ पुं॒स ए॑ति प्रती॒ची ग॑र्ता॒रुगि॑व स॒नये॒ धना॑नाम् । जा॒येव॒ पत्य॑ उश॒ती सु॒वासा॑ उ॒षा ह॒स्रेव॒ नि रि॑णीते॒ अप्स॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhrātā́-iva ǀ puṃsáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ garta-ārúgiva ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǀjāyā́-iva ǀ pátye ǀ uśatī́ ǀ su-vā́sāḥ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ hasrā́-iva ǀ ní ǀ riṇīte ǀ ápsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She goes to the west, as (a woman who has) no brother (repairs) to hermale(relatives); and like one ascending the hall (of justice) for the recovery of property, (she mounts in the sky to claim her lustre); and like a wife desirous to plural ase her husband, Uṣā puts on becoming attire, and smiling as it were, displays her charms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वसा॒ स्वस्रे॒ ज्याय॑स्यै॒ योनि॑मारै॒गपै॑त्यस्याः प्रति॒चक्ष्ये॑व । व्यु॒च्छन्ती॑ र॒श्मिभि॒: सूर्य॑स्या॒ञ्ज्य॑ङ्क्ते समन॒गा इ॑व॒ व्राः
shlokas.transliteration: svásā ǀ svásre ǀ jyā́yasyai ǀ yónim ǀ araik ǀ ápa ǀ eti ǀ asyāḥ ǀ praticákṣya-iva ǀvi-ucchántī ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ añjí ǀ aṅkte ǀ samanagā́ḥ-iva ǀ vrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sister (night) has prepared a birth-plural ce for her elder sister (day), and having amde it known to her, departs. Uṣā, dispersing the darkness with the rays of the sun, illumines the world, like congregated lightnings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒सां पूर्वा॑सा॒मह॑सु॒ स्वसॄ॑णा॒मप॑रा॒ पूर्वा॑म॒भ्ये॑ति प॒श्चात् । ताः प्र॑त्न॒वन्नव्य॑सीर्नू॒नम॒स्मे रे॒वदु॑च्छन्तु सु॒दिना॑ उ॒षास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: āsā́m ǀ pū́rvāsām ǀ áha-su ǀ svásṝṇām ǀ áparā ǀ pū́rvām ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ paścā́t ǀtā́ḥ ǀ pratna-vát ǀ návyasīḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ asmé íti ǀ revát ǀ ucchantu ǀ su-dínāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of all these sisters who have gone before, a successor daily follows the one that has preceded. So may new dawns, like the old, bringing fortunate days, shine upon us blessed with affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र बो॑धयोषः पृण॒तो म॑घो॒न्यबु॑ध्यमानाः प॒णय॑: ससन्तु । रे॒वदु॑च्छ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो मघोनि रे॒वत्स्तो॒त्रे सू॑नृते जा॒रय॑न्ती
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bodhaya ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ pṛṇatáḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ ábudhyamānāḥ ǀ paṇáyaḥ ǀ sasantu ǀrevát ǀ uccha ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ revát ǀ stotré ǀ sūnṛte ǀ jaráyantī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Awaken, wealth-abounding, Uṣā, those whose delight (in holy offerings); let the (niggard) traders, reluctant wake (for such a purpose), sleep on. Arise, opulent Uṣā, bearing wealth to the liberal (worshipper); speaker of truth, who are the waster away (of living creatures), arise, bearing wealth to him who praises you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवे॒यम॑श्वैद्युव॒तिः पु॒रस्ता॑द्यु॒ङ्क्ते गवा॑मरु॒णाना॒मनी॑कम् । वि नू॒नमु॑च्छा॒दस॑ति॒ प्र के॒तुर्गृ॒हंगृ॑ह॒मुप॑ तिष्ठाते अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ iyám ǀ aśvait ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ yuṅkté ǀ gávām ǀ aruṇā́nām ǀ ánīkam ǀví ǀ nūnám ǀ ucchāt ǀ ásati ǀ prá ǀ ketúḥ ǀ gṛhám-gṛham ǀ úpa ǀ tiṣṭhāte ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This youthful Uṣā, approached from the east; she harnesses her team of purple oxen. Assuredly she will disperse the darkness, a manifest sign (of day) in the firmament; the (sacred) fire is kindled in every dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॒ वय॑श्चिद्वस॒तेर॑पप्त॒न्नर॑श्च॒ ये पि॑तु॒भाजो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । अ॒मा स॒ते व॑हसि॒ भूरि॑ वा॒ममुषो॑ देवि दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ váyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ vasatéḥ ǀ apaptan ǀ náraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ pitu-bhā́jaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀamā́ ǀ saté ǀ vahasi ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vāmám ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At your dawning, (Uṣā), the various birds rise up from their nests, and men who have to earn their bread (quit their homes). You bring, divine (Uṣā), much wealth to the liberal mortal who is present in the chamber (of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्तो॑ढ्वं स्तोम्या॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ मेऽवी॑वृधध्वमुश॒तीरु॑षासः । यु॒ष्माकं॑ देवी॒रव॑सा सनेम सह॒स्रिणं॑ च श॒तिनं॑ च॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ástoḍhvam ǀ stomyāḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ me ǀ ávīvṛdhadhvam ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ devīḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ sanema ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ ca ǀ śatínam ǀ ca ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praiseworthy Uṣās, be glorified by this (my hymn); graciously disposed towards us, augment (our prosperity); and may we obtain, goddesses, through your favour, wealth; a hundred and a thousand fold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒ता रत्नं॑ प्रात॒रित्वा॑ दधाति॒ तं चि॑कि॒त्वान्प्र॑ति॒गृह्या॒ नि ध॑त्ते । तेन॑ प्र॒जां व॒र्धय॑मान॒ आयू॑ रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण सचते सु॒वीर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prātáríti ǀ rátnam ǀ prātaḥ-ítvā ǀ dadhāti ǀ tám ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ prati-gṛ́hya ǀ ní ǀ dhatte ǀténa ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ vardháyamānaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣeṇa ǀ sacate ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having come in the early morning, (Svanaya) presents precious (wealth), knowing it (to be worthy of acceptance); and having, (therefore), accepted it, (Kakṣīvat) brings it (to his father); wherewith the parent of excellent sons, maintaining his progeny, passes his life in the enjoyment of affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒गुर॑सत्सुहिर॒ण्यः स्वश्वो॑ बृ॒हद॑स्मै॒ वय॒ इन्द्रो॑ दधाति । यस्त्वा॒यन्तं॒ वसु॑ना प्रातरित्वो मु॒क्षीज॑येव॒ पदि॑मुत्सि॒नाति॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-gúḥ ǀ asat ǀ su-hiraṇyáḥ ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ asmai ǀ váyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ dadhāti ǀyáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ā-yántam ǀ vásunā ǀ prātaḥ-itvaḥ ǀ mukṣī́jayā-iva ǀ pádim ǀ ut-sinā́ti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he (theRājā) be rich in kine, in gold, in horses; mayIndragrant abundant food to him who delays you, returning home in the early morning, by costly gifts, as (a hunter arrests the) wandering (animals) by his snares.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आय॑म॒द्य सु॒कृतं॑ प्रा॒तरि॒च्छन्नि॒ष्टेः पु॒त्रं वसु॑मता॒ रथे॑न । अं॒शोः सु॒तं पा॑यय मत्स॒रस्य॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑रं वर्धय सू॒नृता॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́yam ǀ adyá ǀ su-kṛ́tam ǀ prātáḥ ǀ icchán ǀ iṣṭéḥ ǀ putrám ǀ vásu-matā ǀ ráthena ǀaṃśóḥ ǀ sutám ǀ pāyaya ǀ matsarásya ǀ kṣayát-vīram ǀ vardhaya ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous (of again beholding you), I have this day obtained you, who have done in the morning a good deed; the performer of a sacrifice with a wealth-laden car, refresh yoursel fwiththe effused libation of the exhilarating (Soma), and augment with sincere prayers (the prosperity) of the chief of the flourishing race.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वो मयो॒भुव॑ ईजा॒नं च॑ य॒क्ष्यमा॑णं च धे॒नव॑: । पृ॒णन्तं॑ च॒ पपु॑रिं च श्रव॒स्यवो॑ घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॒ उप॑ यन्ति वि॒श्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ kṣaranti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ ījānám ǀ ca ǀ yakṣyámāṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀpṛṇántam ǀ ca ǀ pápurim ǀ ca ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The copiously-yielding and joy-conferringkine, distil (their milk) for the celebration of the (Soma) sacrifice; and for him who has undertaken its celebration; the nutritious streams of butter coverage from every quarter towards him, who both propitiates (his progenitors), and benefits (mankind).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे अधि॑ तिष्ठति श्रि॒तो यः पृ॒णाति॒ स ह॑ दे॒वेषु॑ गच्छति । तस्मा॒ आपो॑ घृ॒तम॑र्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑व॒स्तस्मा॑ इ॒यं दक्षि॑णा पिन्वते॒ सदा॑
shlokas.transliteration: nā́kasya ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ śritáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛṇā́ti ǀ sáḥ ǀ ha ǀ devéṣu ǀ gacchati ǀtásmai ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ tásmai ǀ iyám ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ pinvate ǀ sádā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who propitiates (the gods), gives to the gods, and sits at ease upon the summit of heaven; to him the flowing waters bear their essence; to him this fertile (earth) ever yields abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दक्षि॑णावता॒मिदि॒मानि॑ चि॒त्रा दक्षि॑णावतां दि॒वि सूर्या॑सः । दक्षि॑णावन्तो अ॒मृतं॑ भजन्ते॒ दक्षि॑णावन्त॒: प्र ति॑रन्त॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dákṣiṇā-vatām ǀ ít ǀ imā́ni ǀ citrā́ ǀ dákṣiṇā-vatām ǀ diví ǀ sū́ryāsaḥ ǀdákṣiṇā-vantaḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ bhajante ǀ dákṣiṇā-vantaḥ ǀ prá ǀ tirante ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These wonderful (rewards) verily are for those who give (pious) donations; for the donors of (pious) gifts the suns shine in heaven; the givers of (pious) donations attain immortality; the givers of (pious) gifts prolong their (worldly) existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा पृ॒णन्तो॒ दुरि॑त॒मेन॒ आर॒न्मा जा॑रिषुः सू॒रय॑: सुव्र॒तास॑: । अ॒न्यस्तेषां॑ परि॒धिर॑स्तु॒ कश्चि॒दपृ॑णन्तम॒भि सं य॑न्तु॒ शोका॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ pṛṇántaḥ ǀ dúḥ-itam ǀ énaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aran ǀ mā́ ǀ jāriṣuḥ ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ su-vratā́saḥ ǀanyáḥ ǀ téṣām ǀ pari-dhíḥ ǀ astu ǀ káḥ ǀ cit ǀ ápṛṇantam ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ yantu ǀ śókāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who propitiate (the gods), never commit degrading sin; may those who praise the gods and observe holy vows, never experience decay; may some (honourable) individual ever be their defence; and may afflictions fall upon him who does not propitiate (the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अम॑न्दा॒न्त्स्तोमा॒न्प्र भ॑रे मनी॒षा सिन्धा॒वधि॑ क्षिय॒तो भा॒व्यस्य॑ । यो मे॑ स॒हस्र॒ममि॑मीत स॒वान॒तूर्तो॒ राजा॒ श्रव॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ámandān ǀ stómān ǀ prá ǀ bhare ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ síndhau ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣiyatáḥ ǀ bhāvyásya ǀyáḥ ǀ me ǀ sahásram ǀ ámimīta ǀ savā́n ǀ atū́rtaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ icchámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I repeat with a (willing) mind, the unreluctant praises ofBhavya, dwellingon th ebanks of theSindhu; a prince of unequalled (might), desirous of renown, who has enabled me to celebrate a thousand sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं राज्ञो॒ नाध॑मानस्य नि॒ष्काञ्छ॒तमश्वा॒न्प्रय॑तान्त्स॒द्य आद॑म् । श॒तं क॒क्षीवाँ॒ असु॑रस्य॒ गोनां॑ दि॒वि श्रवो॒ऽजर॒मा त॑तान
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ nā́dhamānasya ǀ niṣkā́n ǀ śatám ǀ áśvān ǀ prá-yatān ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́dam ǀśatám ǀ kakṣī́vān ǀ ásurasya ǀ gónām ǀ diví ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ ā́ ǀ tatāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From which genitive rous prince, soliciting (my acceptance), I,Kakṣīvat, unhesitatingly accepted a hundredniṣkas, a hundred vigorous steeds, and a hundred bulls, whereby he has spread his imperishable fame through heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ मा श्या॒वाः स्व॒नये॑न द॒त्ता व॒धूम॑न्तो॒ दश॒ रथा॑सो अस्थुः । ष॒ष्टिः स॒हस्र॒मनु॒ गव्य॒मागा॒त्सन॑त्क॒क्षीवाँ॑ अभिपि॒त्वे अह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ mā ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ svanáyena ǀ dattā́ḥ ǀ vadhū́-mantaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ ráthāsaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀṣaṣṭíḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ ánu ǀ gávyam ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ sánat ǀ kakṣī́vān ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ten chariots drawn by bay steeds, and carrying my wives, stood near me, given mebySvanaya; and a thousand and sixty cows followed; these, after a short interval of time, didKakṣīvatdeliver (to his father).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वा॒रिं॒शद्दश॑रथस्य॒ शोणा॑: स॒हस्र॒स्याग्रे॒ श्रेणिं॑ नयन्ति । म॒द॒च्युत॑: कृश॒नाव॑तो॒ अत्या॑न्क॒क्षीव॑न्त॒ उद॑मृक्षन्त प॒ज्राः
shlokas.transliteration: catvāriṃśát ǀ dáśa-rathasya ǀ śóṇāḥ ǀ sahásrasya ǀ ágre ǀ śréṇim ǀ nayanti ǀmada-cyútaḥ ǀ kṛśaná-vataḥ ǀ átyān ǀ kakṣī́vantaḥ ǀ út ǀ amṛkṣanta ǀ pajrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Forty bay horses, (harnessed) to the chariots, lead the procession in front of a thousand (followers). The Pajras, the kinsmen ofKakṣīvat, rub down the high-spirited steeds, decorated with golden trappings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वा॒मनु॒ प्रय॑ति॒मा द॑दे व॒स्त्रीन्यु॒क्ताँ अ॒ष्टाव॒रिधा॑यसो॒ गाः । सु॒बन्ध॑वो॒ ये वि॒श्या॑ इव॒ व्रा अन॑स्वन्त॒: श्रव॒ ऐष॑न्त प॒ज्राः
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rvām ǀ ánu ǀ prá-yatim ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ vaḥ ǀ trī́n ǀ yuktā́n ǀ aṣṭáu ǀ arí-dhāyasaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀsu-bándhavaḥ ǀ yé ǀ viśyā́ḥ-iva ǀ vrā́ḥ ǀ ánasvantaḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ áiṣanta ǀ pajrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have accepted a prior grant, (kinsmen), for you; three and eight harnessed chariots and cattle of incalculable value; may the kindred Pajras, like well-disposed relations, be desirous of acquiring renown by their abundant offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग॑धिता॒ परि॑गधिता॒ या क॑शी॒केव॒ जङ्ग॑हे । ददा॑ति॒ मह्यं॒ यादु॑री॒ याशू॑नां भो॒ज्या॑ श॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ā́-gadhitā ǀ pári-gadhitā ǀ yā́ ǀ kaśīkā́-iva ǀ jáṅgahe ǀdádāti ǀ máhyam ǀ yā́durī ǀ yā́śūnām ǀ bhojyā́ ǀ śatā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She, who, when her desires are assented to, clings as tenaciously as a feminine le weasel, and who is ripe for enjoyment, yields me infinite delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑प मे॒ परा॑ मृश॒ मा मे॑ द॒भ्राणि॑ मन्यथाः । सर्वा॒हम॑स्मि रोम॒शा ग॒न्धारी॑णामिवावि॒का
shlokas.transliteration: úpa-upa ǀ me ǀ párā ǀ mṛśa ǀ mā́ ǀ me ǀ dabhrā́ṇi ǀ manyathāḥ ǀsárvā ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ romaśā́ ǀ gandhā́rīṇām-iva ǀ avikā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach me, (husband); deem me not immature; I am covered with down like a eve of the gandhārins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं होता॑रं मन्ये॒ दास्व॑न्तं॒ वसुं॑ सू॒नुं सह॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ विप्रं॒ न जा॒तवे॑दसम् । य ऊ॒र्ध्वया॑ स्वध्व॒रो दे॒वो दे॒वाच्या॑ कृ॒पा । घृ॒तस्य॒ विभ्रा॑ष्टि॒मनु॑ वष्टि शो॒चिषा॒जुह्वा॑नस्य स॒र्पिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ hótāram ǀ manye ǀ dā́svantam ǀ vásum ǀ sūnúm ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ vípram ǀ ná ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀyá ǀ ūrdhváyā ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́cyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀghṛtásya ǀ ví-bhrāṣṭim ǀ ánu ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ śocíṣā ǀ ā-júhvānasya ǀ sarpíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I venerateAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the munificent, the giver of dwellings, the son of strength; he who knows all that exists, like a sage who is endowed with knowledge; who, the divine regenerator of sacrifices, through his lofty and reverntial devotion, covets for the gods the blaze of the liquefied butter which is offered in oblation with his flames.”
