shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras, your purpose is known; you would repair to heaven; your charioteers harness (your steeds) for your heavenward journey; the horses that injure not (the car) on your journey to heaven. We have plural ced you, Dasras, in your golden three-shafted chariot, going by an (easy) road to heaven, humiliators (of enemies), and principal regulators of the rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शची॑भिर्नः शचीवसू॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ दशस्यतम् । मा वां॑ रा॒तिरुप॑ दस॒त्कदा॑ च॒नास्मद्रा॒तिः कदा॑ च॒न
shlokas.transliteration: śácībhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śacīvasū íti śacī-vasū ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ daśasyatam ǀmā́ ǀ vām ǀ rātíḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dasat ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀ asmát ǀ rātíḥ ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enriched by holy rites, grant us, by day and night, (all good things), on account of our pious acts; never may your donations, never may our (donations), be withheld.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष॑न्निन्द्र वृष॒पाणा॑स॒ इन्द॑व इ॒मे सु॒ता अद्रि॑षुतास उ॒द्भिद॒स्तुभ्यं॑ सु॒तास॑ उ॒द्भिद॑: । ते त्वा॑ मन्दन्तु दा॒वने॑ म॒हे चि॒त्राय॒ राध॑से । गी॒र्भिर्गि॑र्वाह॒: स्तव॑मान॒ आ ग॑हि सुमृळी॒को न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣan ǀ indra ǀ vṛṣa-pā́nāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ imé ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ ádri-sutāsaḥ ǀ ut-bhídaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ ut-bhídaḥ ǀté ǀ tvā ǀ mandantu ǀ dāváne ǀ mahé ǀ citrā́ya ǀ rā́dhase ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ girvāhaḥ ǀ stávamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, showerer (of blessings), these effusedSoma, (expressed) by stones, and which have sprung (from mountain), are for your drinking; these libations have burst forth for you; may they satisfy you as an offering presented (in the hope of receiving) great and wonderful riches. Acceptor of laudations, come to us, glorified by our hymns; come to us well plural ased.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ षू णो॑ अग्ने शृणुहि॒ त्वमी॑ळि॒तो दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ब्रवसि य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्यो॒ राज॑भ्यो य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्यः । यद्ध॒ त्यामङ्गि॑रोभ्यो धे॒नुं दे॑वा॒ अद॑त्तन । वि तां दु॑ह्रे अर्य॒मा क॒र्तरी॒ सचाँ॑ ए॒ष तां वे॑द मे॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ śṛṇuhi ǀ tvám ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ bravasi ǀ yajñíyebhyaḥ ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ yajñíyebhyaḥ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ tyā́m ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ dhenúm ǀ devāḥ ǀ ádattana ǀví ǀ tā́m ǀ duhre ǀ aryamā́ ǀ kartári ǀ sácā ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ tā́m ǀ veda ǀ me ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, listen attentively when you are praised by us, and repeat (those praises) to the gods who are entitled to worship; to the royal (deities) entitled to worship; on which accoun tthe gods gave to theAṅgirasasthe cow whichAryamanmilked for (you), the maker (of all), together with the gods; that cow (the nature of which you have said), he, along with me, comprehends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु वो॑ अ॒स्मद॒भि तानि॒ पौंस्या॒ सना॑ भूवन्द्यु॒म्नानि॒ मोत जा॑रिषुर॒स्मत्पु॒रोत जा॑रिषुः । यद्व॑श्चि॒त्रं यु॒गेयु॑गे॒ नव्यं॒ घोषा॒दम॑र्त्यम् । अ॒स्मासु॒ तन्म॑रुतो॒ यच्च॑ दु॒ष्टरं॑ दिधृ॒ता यच्च॑ दु॒ष्टर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ asmát ǀ abhí ǀ tā́ni ǀ páuṃsyā ǀ sánā ǀ bhūvan ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ mā́ ǀ utá ǀ jāriṣuḥ ǀ asmát ǀ purā́ ǀ utá ǀ jāriṣuḥ ǀyát ǀ vaḥ ǀ citrám ǀ yugé-yuge ǀ návyam ǀ ghóṣāt ǀ ámartyam ǀasmā́su ǀ tát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ dustáram ǀ didhṛtá ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ dustáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never,Maruts, may your glorious energies be exerted against us; may our (riches) never diminish; never may our towns decay; and may whatever is wonderful, admirable immortal, or (whatever is recognized to be living), from its sound, that has been yours from age to age, (devolve) upon us; whatever is most difficult (of attainment) bestow upon us; whatever is most difficult (to be attained).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒ध्यङ्ह॑ मे ज॒नुषं॒ पूर्वो॒ अङ्गि॑राः प्रि॒यमे॑ध॒: कण्वो॒ अत्रि॒र्मनु॑र्विदु॒स्ते मे॒ पूर्वे॒ मनु॑र्विदुः । तेषां॑ दे॒वेष्वाय॑तिर॒स्माकं॒ तेषु॒ नाभ॑यः । तेषां॑ प॒देन॒ मह्या न॑मे गि॒रेन्द्रा॒ग्नी आ न॑मे गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: dadhyáṅ ǀ ha ǀ me ǀ janúṣam ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ áṅgirāḥ ǀ priyá-medhaḥ ǀ káṇvaḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ mánuḥ ǀ viduḥ ǀ té ǀ me ǀ pū́rve ǀ mánuḥ ǀ viduḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́-yatiḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ téṣu ǀ nā́bhayaḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ padéna ǀ máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ name ǀ girā́ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ name ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient Dadhyañc,Aṅgiras,Priyamedha,Kaṇva,Atri,Manu, have known my birth; they who were of old and Manu have known (my progenitors); for of them is long life amongst the gods, and in them is our existence; for the sake of their nigh station, I adore (the gods) with praise; I worshipIndraandAgniwith praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद्व॒निनो॑ वन्त॒ वार्यं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्यजति वे॒न उ॒क्षभि॑: पुरु॒वारे॑भिरु॒क्षभि॑: । ज॒गृ॒भ्मा दू॒रआ॑दिशं॒ श्लोक॒मद्रे॒रध॒ त्मना॑ । अधा॑रयदर॒रिन्दा॑नि सु॒क्रतु॑: पु॒रू सद्मा॑नि सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hótā ǀ yakṣat ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ vanta ǀ vā́ryam ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ yajati ǀ venáḥ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀ puru-vā́rebhiḥ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀjagṛbhmá ǀ dūré-ādiśam ǀ ślókam ǀ ádreḥ ǀ ádha ǀ tmánā ǀádhārayat ǀ araríndāni ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ purú ǀ sádmāni ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the invoker (of the gods) offer sacrifice, and may they, desirous of the offering, (partake of) the acceptable (libation);Bṛhaspatihimself, desiring (the libation), celebrates worship with libations; with copious and excellent libations. We catch from a distant quarter the sound of the stones, whereby the performer of pious acts has of himself secured the waters (of the clouds); the performer of pious acts (has secured) many habitations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये दे॑वासो दि॒व्येका॑दश॒ स्थ पृ॑थि॒व्यामध्येका॑दश॒ स्थ । अ॒प्सु॒क्षितो॑ महि॒नैका॑दश॒ स्थ ते दे॑वासो य॒ज्ञमि॒मं जु॑षध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ diví ǀ ékādaśa ǀ sthá ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ ékādaśa ǀ sthá ǀapsu-kṣítaḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ ékādaśa ǀ sthá ǀ té ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ imám ǀ juṣadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods who are eleven in heaven; who are eleven on earth; and who are eleven dwelling with glory in mid-air; may you be plural ased with our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वे॒दि॒षदे॑ प्रि॒यधा॑माय सु॒द्युते॑ धा॒सिमि॑व॒ प्र भ॑रा॒ योनि॑म॒ग्नये॑ । वस्त्रे॑णेव वासया॒ मन्म॑ना॒ शुचिं॑ ज्यो॒तीर॑थं शु॒क्रव॑र्णं तमो॒हन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vedi-sáde ǀ priyá-dhāmāya ǀ su-dyúte ǀ dhāsím-iva ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ yónim ǀ agnáye ǀvástreṇa-iva ǀ vāsaya ǀ mánmanā ǀ śúcim ǀ jyotíḥ-ratham ǀ śukrá-varṇam ǀ tamaḥ-hánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prepare a (fit) plural ce, as it were an offering, for the radiantAgni, who is seated on the altar, and fond of his station; strew the sacred, light-bearing, bright and gloom-dispelling (spot), with agreeable (kuśagrass), as with a garment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्वि॒जन्मा॑ त्रि॒वृदन्न॑मृज्यते संवत्स॒रे वा॑वृधे ज॒ग्धमी॒ पुन॑: । अ॒न्यस्या॒सा जि॒ह्वया॒ जेन्यो॒ वृषा॒ न्य१॒॑न्येन॑ व॒निनो॑ मृष्ट वार॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dvi-jánmā ǀ tri-vṛ́t ǀ ánnam ǀ ṛjyate ǀ saṃvatsaré ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ jagdhám ǀ īmíti ǀ púnaríti ǀanyásya ǀ āsā́ ǀ jihváyā ǀ jényaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ní ǀ anyéna ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ mṛṣṭa ǀ vāraṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni), the two-fold genitive rated, devours the triple (sacrificial) food, and when the year expires renovates what has been eaten; the showerer (of benefits) is invigorated (inone form), by eating with the tongue of another; in a different form the restrainer (of) all consumes the forest trees.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्ण॒प्रुतौ॑ वेवि॒जे अ॑स्य स॒क्षिता॑ उ॒भा त॑रेते अ॒भि मा॒तरा॒ शिशु॑म् । प्रा॒चाजि॑ह्वं ध्व॒सय॑न्तं तृषु॒च्युत॒मा साच्यं॒ कुप॑यं॒ वर्ध॑नं पि॒तुः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-prútau ǀ vevijé íti ǀ asya ǀ sa-kṣítau ǀ ubhā́ ǀ tarete íti ǀ abhí ǀ mātárā ǀ śíśum ǀprācā́-jihvam ǀ dhvasáyantam ǀ tṛṣu-cyútam ǀ ā́ ǀ sā́cyam ǀ kúpayam ǀ várdhanam ǀ pitúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both his associated mothers, blackened (by combustion), are in movement, and give birth to an infant, whose tongue (of flame glows) in the east; (who) dissipates darkness; (who) rapidly issues forth; (who) is readily developed; (who) is (ever) to be cherished, and is the augmenter (of the prosperity) of his parent, (the instrumental tutor of the rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मु॒मु॒क्ष्वो॒३॒॑ मन॑वे मानवस्य॒ते र॑घु॒द्रुव॑: कृ॒ष्णसी॑तास ऊ॒ जुव॑: । अ॒स॒म॒ना अ॑जि॒रासो॑ रघु॒ष्यदो॒ वात॑जूता॒ उप॑ युज्यन्त आ॒शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mumukṣváḥ ǀ mánave ǀ mānavasyaté ǀ raghu-drúvaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇá-sītāsaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ júvaḥ ǀasamanā́ḥ ǀ ajirā́saḥ ǀ raghu-syádaḥ ǀ vā́ta-jūtāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yujyante ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (flames ofAgni), light-moving, dark-tracked, quick (consuming), capricious, restless, plural ying lightly, fanned by the wind, wide-spreading, and ensuring liberation (to the devout), are kindled for (the benefit of) the pious reverencer of (holy) priests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आद॑स्य॒ ते ध्व॒सय॑न्तो॒ वृथे॑रते कृ॒ष्णमभ्वं॒ महि॒ वर्प॒: करि॑क्रतः । यत्सीं॑ म॒हीम॒वनिं॒ प्राभि मर्मृ॑शदभिश्व॒सन्त्स्त॒नय॒न्नेति॒ नान॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ asya ǀ té ǀ dhvasáyantaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ īrate ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ ábhvam ǀ máhi ǀ várpaḥ ǀ kárikrataḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ mahī́m ǀ avánim ǀ prá ǀ abhí ǀ mármṛśat ǀ abhi-śvasán ǀ stanáyan ǀ éti ǀ nā́nadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereupon those (flames ofAgni) extend together in all directions, dispersing gloom, and spreading great light along the path of darkness; when (Agni) illumines repeatedly the whole earth, and proceeds panting thundering, and roaring aloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूष॒न्न योऽधि॑ ब॒भ्रूषु॒ नम्न॑ते॒ वृषे॑व॒ पत्नी॑र॒भ्ये॑ति॒ रोरु॑वत् । ओ॒जा॒यमा॑नस्त॒न्व॑श्च शुम्भते भी॒मो न शृङ्गा॑ दविधाव दु॒र्गृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ṣan ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ babhrū́ṣu ǀ námnate ǀ vṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ róruvat ǀojāyámānaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ ca ǀ śumbhate ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śṛ́ṅgā ǀ davidhāva ǀ duḥ-gṛ́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He stoops down among the bushes as if embellishing them (with his lustre), and rushes roaring like a bull amongst (a herd of) cows; thence increasing in intensity, he enhances (the fierceness) of his form, and is difficult to be arrested as a formidable (animal), when he brandishes his horns. Like a bull amongst: vṛṣeva pantir abhyeti; patnir = pālayitrīḥ, those who cherish him,Agni, i.e., bushes, timber; patnī = a cow].”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सं॒स्तिरो॑ वि॒ष्टिर॒: सं गृ॑भायति जा॒नन्ने॒व जा॑न॒तीर्नित्य॒ आ श॑ये । पुन॑र्वर्धन्ते॒ अपि॑ यन्ति दे॒व्य॑म॒न्यद्वर्प॑: पि॒त्रोः कृ॑ण्वते॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sam-stíraḥ ǀ vi-stíraḥ ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāyati ǀ jānán ǀ evá ǀ jānatī́ḥ ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śaye ǀpúnaḥ ǀ vardhante ǀ ápi ǀ yanti ǀ devyám ǀ anyát ǀ várpaḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ kṛṇvate ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now hidden, now displayed, he seizes (on the fuel), as if understanding (the purpose of the worshipper), and even reposes amidst the conscious (flames); again they break forth, and repair to the divine (fire of sacrifice), blending with which they give a different (luminous)form to their parents, (heaven and earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॒ग्रुव॑: के॒शिनी॒: सं हि रे॑भि॒र ऊ॒र्ध्वास्त॑स्थुर्म॒म्रुषी॒: प्रायवे॒ पुन॑: । तासां॑ ज॒रां प्र॑मु॒ञ्चन्ने॑ति॒ नान॑द॒दसुं॒ परं॑ ज॒नय॑ञ्जी॒वमस्तृ॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ keśínīḥ ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ rebhiré ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ mamrúṣīḥ ǀ prá ǀ āyáve ǀ púnaríti ǀtā́sām ǀ jarā́m ǀ prá-muñcán ǀ eti ǀ nā́nadat ǀ ásum ǀ páram ǀ janáyan ǀ jīvám ǀ ástṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The curving tresses (of the flames) embrace him, (Agni), and when expiring spring aloft again to (greet) their coming (lord); rescuing them from decrepitude, he comes sounding aloud, genitive rating (in them) intenser animation and unimpaired vitality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒धी॒वा॒सं परि॑ मा॒तू रि॒हन्नह॑ तुवि॒ग्रेभि॒: सत्व॑भिर्याति॒ वि ज्रय॑: । वयो॒ दध॑त्प॒द्वते॒ रेरि॑ह॒त्सदानु॒ श्येनी॑ सचते वर्त॒नीरह॑
shlokas.transliteration: adhīvāsám ǀ pári ǀ mātúḥ ǀ rihán ǀ áha ǀ tuvi-grébhiḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ yāti ǀ ví ǀ jráyaḥ ǀváyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ pat-váte ǀ rérihat ǀ sádā ǀ ánu ǀ śyénī ǀ sacate ǀ vartaníḥ ǀ áha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Licking up the (verdant) vesture of the mother (of all things, earth), the rapid (Agni) proceeds with resounding existences; granting sustenance to (every) footed (creature); ever consuming (fuel), so that a blackened track follows (hispath).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मग्ने म॒घव॑त्सु दीदि॒ह्यध॒ श्वसी॑वान्वृष॒भो दमू॑नाः । अ॒वास्या॒ शिशु॑मतीरदीदे॒र्वर्मे॑व यु॒त्सु प॑रि॒जर्भु॑राणः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ agne ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dīdihi ǀ ádha ǀ śvásīvān ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀava-ásya ǀ śíśu-matīḥ ǀ adīdeḥ ǀ várma-iva ǀ yut-sú ǀ pari-járbhurāṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shine,Agni, in our opulent (abodes), vivifying, showering (blessings), bounteous, casting off infantine (glimmerings); blaze (fiercely), repelling repeatedly, like a coat of mail, (our enemies) in combats.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दम॑ग्ने॒ सुधि॑तं॒ दुर्धि॑ता॒दधि॑ प्रि॒यादु॑ चि॒न्मन्म॑न॒: प्रेयो॑ अस्तु ते । यत्ते॑ शु॒क्रं त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ रोच॑ते॒ शुचि॒ तेना॒स्मभ्यं॑ वनसे॒ रत्न॒मा त्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ agne ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ dúḥ-dhitāt ǀ ádhi ǀ priyā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ cit ǀ mánmanaḥ ǀ préyaḥ ǀ astu ǀ te ǀyát ǀ te ǀ śukrám ǀ tanváḥ ǀ rócate ǀ śúci ǀ téna ǀ asmábhyam ǀ vanase ǀ rátnam ǀ ā́ ǀ tvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this oblation,Agni, carefully plural ced upon the rugged but agreeable (pile of fuel), be most acceptable to you, so that the pure radiance of your person n may shine brightly, and you may grant us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथा॑य॒ नाव॑मु॒त नो॑ गृ॒हाय॒ नित्या॑रित्रां प॒द्वतीं॑ रास्यग्ने । अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒राँ उ॒त नो॑ म॒घोनो॒ जनाँ॑श्च॒ या पा॒रया॒च्छर्म॒ या च॑
shlokas.transliteration: ráthāya ǀ nā́vam ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛhā́ya ǀ nítya-aritrām ǀ pat-vátīm ǀ rāsi ǀ agne ǀasmā́kam ǀ vīrā́n ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ jánān ǀ ca ǀ yā́ ǀ pāráyāt ǀ śárma ǀ yā́ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow,Agni, upon our exfellent patron a boat ever fitted with oars and feet, (one that may render) our posterity prosperous, and may bear mankind across (the ocean of life) to felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी नो॑ अग्न उ॒क्थमिज्जु॑गुर्या॒ द्यावा॒क्षामा॒ सिन्ध॑वश्च॒ स्वगू॑र्ताः । गव्यं॒ यव्यं॒ यन्तो॑ दी॒र्घाहेषं॒ वर॑मरु॒ण्यो॑ वरन्त
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ukthám ǀ ít ǀ juguryāḥ ǀ dyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ca ǀ svá-gūrtāḥ ǀgávyam ǀ yávyam ǀ yántaḥ ǀ dīrghā́ ǀ áhā ǀ íṣam ǀ váram ǀ aruṇyáḥ ǀ varanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, be propitiated by this our earnest praise, and may heaven and earth, and the spontaneously-flowing (streams), provide for us the produce of the herd, and of the field; and may the purple coursers (of the dawn) bestow upon us abundant food through a length of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बळि॒त्था तद्वपु॑षे धायि दर्श॒तं दे॒वस्य॒ भर्ग॒: सह॑सो॒ यतो॒ जनि॑ । यदी॒मुप॒ ह्वर॑ते॒ साध॑ते म॒तिॠ॒तस्य॒ धेना॑ अनयन्त स॒स्रुत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ itthā́ ǀ tát ǀ vápuṣe ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatám ǀ devásya ǀ bhárgaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ jáni ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ úpa ǀ hvárate ǀ sā́dhate ǀ matíḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ anayanta ǀ sa-srútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, that visible radiance of the divine (Agni) has been so apprehended (by all, that it may be) for (the support of) the body, for which end it has been genitive rated by (bodily) strength; and that my mind may apprehend and apply (that radiance), they address the sacred prayers associated with oblations (to Agni).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒क्षो वपु॑: पितु॒मान्नित्य॒ आ श॑ये द्वि॒तीय॒मा स॒प्तशि॑वासु मा॒तृषु॑ । तृ॒तीय॑मस्य वृष॒भस्य॑ दो॒हसे॒ दश॑प्रमतिं जनयन्त॒ योष॑णः
shlokas.transliteration: pṛkṣáḥ ǀ vápuḥ ǀ pitu-mā́n ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śaye ǀ dvitī́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ saptá-śivāsu ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀtṛtī́yam ǀ asya ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ doháse ǀ dáśa-pramatim ǀ janayanta ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “First, he reposes (on the earth) as the digestive (faculty), the embodied, the accepter of food, the eternal secondly, (he dwells) among the seven auspicious mothers (of fertility); thirdly, the associated (regions) genitive rate him, delighting in the ten (quarters) of space, for the sake of milking this showerer (of rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: निर्यदीं॑ बु॒ध्नान्म॑हि॒षस्य॒ वर्प॑स ईशा॒नास॒: शव॑सा॒ क्रन्त॑ सू॒रय॑: । यदी॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिवो॒ मध्व॑ आध॒वे गुहा॒ सन्तं॑ मात॒रिश्वा॑ मथा॒यति॑
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ budhnā́t ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ várpasaḥ ǀ īśānā́saḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ kránta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ ánu ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ā-dhavé ǀ gúhā ǀ sántam ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ mathāyáti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As powerful priests extract by force (of prayer) thisAgnifrom his primitive seat, (for the evolution) of his mighty form; as the wind arouses him lurking in the hiding-plural ce (of the altar), for the sake of offering oblations now as of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यत्पि॒तुः प॑र॒मान्नी॒यते॒ पर्या पृ॒क्षुधो॑ वी॒रुधो॒ दंसु॑ रोहति । उ॒भा यद॑स्य ज॒नुषं॒ यदिन्व॑त॒ आदिद्यवि॑ष्ठो अभवद्घृ॒णा शुचि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ pitúḥ ǀ paramā́t ǀ nīyáte ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛkṣúdhaḥ ǀ vīrúdhaḥ ǀ dáṃ-su ǀ rohati ǀubhā́ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ janúṣam ǀ yát ǀ ínvataḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ ghṛṇā́ ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As from the excellence of the nutritious (offering) be, (Agni), is brought forth and the consumable branches rise amidst (the flames); and as both (the instrumental tutor of the rite and the priest) combine for his genitive ration, therefore has he been genitive rated, pure, youthful, and radiant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदिन्मा॒तॄरावि॑श॒द्यास्वा शुचि॒रहिं॑स्यमान उर्वि॒या वि वा॑वृधे । अनु॒ यत्पूर्वा॒ अरु॑हत्सना॒जुवो॒ नि नव्य॑सी॒ष्वव॑रासु धावते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ mātṝ́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aviśat ǀ yā́su ǀ ā́ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ áhiṃsyamānaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ vavṛdhe ǀánu ǀ yát ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ áruhat ǀ sanā-júvaḥ ǀ ní ǀ návyasīṣu ǀ ávarāsu ǀ dhāvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore has the brilliantAgnientered the maternal (quarters of space), amidst which pure, and unharmed, he had evolved into magnitude, so that he mounted (the bushes) plural ced before him, as he had (consumed others) prior to them, and runs rapidly among the more recent and inferior branches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदिद्धोता॑रं वृणते॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु॒ भग॑मिव पपृचा॒नास॑ ऋञ्जते । दे॒वान्यत्क्रत्वा॑ म॒ज्मना॑ पुरुष्टु॒तो मर्तं॒ शंसं॑ वि॒श्वधा॒ वेति॒ धाय॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ hótāram ǀ vṛṇate ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀ bhágam-iva ǀ papṛcānā́saḥ ǀ ṛñjate ǀdevā́n ǀ yát ǀ krátvā ǀ majmánā ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀ mártam ǀ śáṃsam ǀ viśvádhā ǀ véti ǀ dhā́yase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pious worshippers then adore the invoker (of the gods), for (the propitiation of) the dwellers in heaven, as (such men) adore a powerful prince, since the many-lauded, and all upholding (Agni) knows how by (holy) act and (bodily) strength to bring together the gods and their mortal worshipper for the sake of obtaining (mutual) sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यदस्था॑द्यज॒तो वात॑चोदितो ह्वा॒रो न वक्वा॑ ज॒रणा॒ अना॑कृतः । तस्य॒ पत्म॑न्द॒क्षुष॑: कृ॒ष्णजं॑हस॒: शुचि॑जन्मनो॒ रज॒ आ व्य॑ध्वनः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yát ǀ ásthāt ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ vā́ta-coditaḥ ǀ hvāráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vákvā ǀ jaráṇāḥ ǀ ánākṛtaḥ ǀtásya ǀ pátman ǀ dhakṣúṣaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇá-jaṃhasaḥ ǀ śúci-janmanaḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ví-adhvanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since the adorable (Agni), impelled by the wind, spreads in various directions, like an insincere and unrestrained chatterer, (who utters indiscriminate) praises, therefore the world is assiduous in the worship of him, the consumer of all, whose way is dark, who is pure of birth and follows various paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथो॒ न या॒तः शिक्व॑भिः कृ॒तो द्यामङ्गे॑भिररु॒षेभि॑रीयते । आद॑स्य॒ ते कृ॒ष्णासो॑ दक्षि सू॒रय॒: शूर॑स्येव त्वे॒षथा॑दीषते॒ वय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yātáḥ ǀ śíkva-bhiḥ ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ áṅgebhiḥ ǀ aruṣébhiḥ ǀ īyate ǀā́t ǀ asya ǀ té ǀ kṛṣṇā́saḥ ǀ dhakṣi ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ śū́rasya-iva ǀ tveṣáthāt ǀ īṣate ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a chariot drawn by ropes,Agni, set in movement by his own revolving members (his flames), proceeds to the heavens; the paths he traverses are blackened by smoke, as he consumes (the fuel), and (beasts and) birds fly from his radiance as (enemies fly from the prowess) of a hero.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॒ ह्य॑ग्ने॒ वरु॑णो धृ॒तव्र॑तो मि॒त्रः शा॑श॒द्रे अ॑र्य॒मा सु॒दान॑वः । यत्सी॒मनु॒ क्रतु॑ना वि॒श्वथा॑ वि॒भुर॒रान्न ने॒मिः प॑रि॒भूरजा॑यथाः
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ śāśadré ǀ aryamā́ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ ánu ǀ krátunā ǀ viśvá-thā ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ arā́n ǀ ná ǀ nemíḥ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ ájāyathāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By you,Agni;Varuṇa, observant of his duties andMitraandAryaman, bountiful divinities, are animated, so that yo have been born comprehending them all universally in all (their) functions, and encompassing (them all) as the circumference (encompasses) the spokes (of a wheel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने शशमा॒नाय॑ सुन्व॒ते रत्नं॑ यविष्ठ दे॒वता॑तिमिन्वसि । तं त्वा॒ नु नव्यं॑ सहसो युवन्व॒यं भगं॒ न का॒रे म॑हिरत्न धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀ rátnam ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ devá-tātim ǀ invasi ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ nú ǀ návyam ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yuvan ǀ vayám ǀ bhágam ǀ ná ǀ kāré ǀ mahi-ratna ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most youthfulAgni, for the good of him who praises you and offers you libations, you make the precious (offering) acceptable to the gods; new-born of strength we glorify you who are to be lauded; to whom rich offerings (are to be presented); (we glorify you) in (our) hymn as (men eulogize) a powerful prince.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे र॒यिं न स्वर्थं॒ दमू॑नसं॒ भगं॒ दक्षं॒ न प॑पृचासि धर्ण॒सिम् । र॒श्मीँरि॑व॒ यो यम॑ति॒ जन्म॑नी उ॒भे दे॒वानां॒ शंस॑मृ॒त आ च॑ सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ ná ǀ su-ártham ǀ dámūnasam ǀ bhágam ǀ dákṣam ǀ ná ǀ papṛcāsi ǀ dharṇasím ǀraśmī́n-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ yámati ǀ jánmanī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ devā́nām ǀ śáṃsam ǀ ṛté ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as you confer upon us riches, (so you bestow upon us) a well-disposed, docile, and energetic (son); the receptacle (of learning and other merits), one who is the performer of holy rites,Agni, who regulates as it were his own rays, (and the condition) both (his) births, (or heaven and earth), he regulates at (our) sacrifice the adoration of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑: सु॒द्योत्मा॑ जी॒राश्वो॒ होता॑ म॒न्द्रः शृ॑णवच्च॒न्द्रर॑थः । स नो॑ नेष॒न्नेष॑तमै॒रमू॑रो॒ऽग्निर्वा॒मं सु॑वि॒तं वस्यो॒ अच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ su-dyótmā ǀ jīrá-aśvaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ candrá-rathaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ neṣat ǀ néṣa-tamaiḥ ǀ ámūraḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ suvitám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is one with light, who has fleet horses, the invoker (of the gods), full of joy, and borne in a golden chariot, listen to us; may that irresistible, yet plural cableAgni, conduct us, by the most efficacious (means), to that desirable and accessible (heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ता॑व्य॒ग्निः शिमी॑वद्भिर॒र्कैः साम्रा॑ज्याय प्रत॒रं दधा॑नः । अ॒मी च॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो व॒यं च॒ मिहं॒ न सूरो॒ अति॒ निष्ट॑तन्युः
shlokas.transliteration: ástāvi ǀ agníḥ ǀ śímīvat-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ sā́m-rājyāya ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀamī́ íti ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀ míham ǀ ná ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ áti ǀ níḥ ǀ tatanyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, possessing eminent (fitness) for supreme sovereignty, has been glorified by us, with holy rites (śimīśaktiḥ:Nirukta2.1.24), and with hymns. Let all who are presen1, as well as we ourselves, enriched (by his favour), shout aloud (the praise of Agni), as (loudly as) the sun (causes) the rain-cloud (to thunder).”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अग्न॒ आ व॑ह दे॒वाँ अ॒द्य य॒तस्रु॑चे । तन्तुं॑ तनुष्व पू॒र्व्यं सु॒तसो॑माय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́n ǀ adyá ǀ yatá-sruce ǀtántum ǀ tanuṣva ǀ pūrvyám ǀ sutá-somāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are samiddha, bring the gods today (to the worshipper), whose ladle is uplifted; extent (the merit of) former sacrificer to the giver (of the offering), by whom theSomais poured forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तव॑न्त॒मुप॑ मासि॒ मधु॑मन्तं तनूनपात् । य॒ज्ञं विप्र॑स्य॒ माव॑तः शशमा॒नस्य॑ दा॒शुष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtá-vantam ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ tanū-napāt ǀyajñám ǀ víprasya ǀ mā́-vataḥ ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tanūnapāt, be present at this well-flavoured and cutter-fed sacrifice, (the offering) of a pious offerer (of oblations); glorifying you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑: पाव॒को अद्भु॑तो॒ मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षति । नरा॒शंस॒स्त्रिरा दि॒वो दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ mádhvā ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣati ǀnárāśáṃsaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure, purifying, wonderful Narāśaṃsa, an adorable god among gods, (having come) from heaven, thrice mixes the sacrifice with the sweet (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळि॒तो अ॑ग्न॒ आ व॒हेन्द्रं॑ चि॒त्रमि॒ह प्रि॒यम् । इ॒यं हि त्वा॑ म॒तिर्ममाच्छा॑ सुजिह्व व॒च्यते॑
shlokas.transliteration: īḷitáḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ índram ǀ citrám ǀ ihá ǀ priyám ǀiyám ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ matíḥ ǀ máma ǀ áccha ǀ su-jihva ǀ vacyáte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are Iḷita, bring hitherIndra, the wonderful, the beloved; this my praise is recited, bright-tongued, before you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तृ॒णा॒नासो॑ य॒तस्रु॑चो ब॒र्हिर्य॒ज्ञे स्व॑ध्व॒रे । वृ॒ञ्जे दे॒वव्य॑चस्तम॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stṛṇānā́saḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ yajñé ǀ su-adhvaré ǀvṛñjé ǀ devávyacaḥ-tamam ǀ índrāya ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests, bearing ladles, are strewing the sacred grass in this holy sacrifice, to prepare a god-frequented and well-spread abode forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि श्र॑यन्तामृता॒वृध॑: प्र॒यै दे॒वेभ्यो॑ म॒हीः । पा॒व॒कास॑: पुरु॒स्पृहो॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर॑स॒श्चत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ śrayantām ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ pra-yái ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀpāvakā́saḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the bright, separable doors, the augmenters of sacrifice, the purifiers of rites, the desired of many, be set open for the gods to enter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भन्द॑माने॒ उपा॑के॒ नक्तो॒षासा॑ सु॒पेश॑सा । य॒ह्वी ऋ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तरा॒ सीद॑तां ब॒र्हिरा सु॒मत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhándamāne íti ǀ úpāke íti ǀ náktoṣásā ǀ su-péśasā ǀyahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātárā ǀ sī́datām ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ su-mát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beautiful night and morning, ever hymned, ever associated, progeny (yahuḥsunuḥ--Nirukta2.2.11) (of time), parents of sacrifice, sit down of your own good will on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्वा जुगु॒र्वणी॒ होता॑रा॒ दैव्या॑ क॒वी । य॒ज्ञं नो॑ यक्षतामि॒मं सि॒ध्रम॒द्य दि॑वि॒स्पृश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mandrá-jihvā ǀ jugurváṇī íti ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ kavī́ íti ǀyajñám ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣatām ǀ imám ǀ sidhrám ǀ adyá ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two plural asing-tongued receivers of praise, the divine and sage invokers (of the gods), officiate today at this our sacrifice, which confers (rewards) and attains heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑र्दे॒वेष्वर्पि॑ता॒ होत्रा॑ म॒रुत्सु॒ भार॑ती । इळा॒ सर॑स्वती म॒ही ब॒र्हिः सी॑दन्तु य॒ज्ञिया॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ árpitā ǀ hótrā ǀ marút-su ǀ bhā́ratī ǀíḷā ǀ sárasvatī ǀ mahī́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the purehotā, plural ced among the gods, andBhāratī, among theMaruts, and may the adorable Iḷā,Sarasvatī,Mahī, sit down upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॑स्तु॒रीप॒मद्भु॑तं पु॒रु वारं॑ पु॒रु त्मना॑ । त्वष्टा॒ पोषा॑य॒ वि ष्य॑तु रा॒ये नाभा॑ नो अस्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ turī́pam ǀ ádbhutam ǀ purú ǀ vā ǀ áram ǀ purú ǀ tmánā ǀtváṣṭā ǀ póṣāya ǀ ví ǀ syatu ǀ rāyé ǀ nā́bhā ǀ naḥ ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayTvaṣṭā, favourably disposed towards us, send to us, for our nourishment and prosperity, the quick (falling), wonderful, abundant (water), in the centre (of the cloud, effecting), of itself much (good).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒व॒सृ॒जन्नुप॒ त्मना॑ दे॒वान्य॑क्षि वनस्पते । अ॒ग्निर्ह॒व्या सु॑षूदति दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॒ मेधि॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: ava-sṛján ǀ úpa ǀ tmánā ǀ devā́n ǀ yakṣi ǀ vanaspate ǀagníḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ susūdati ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ médhiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, here present of your own accord, convey our offerings to the gods; the divine and intelligentAgniaccepts (the oblations) for the deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒ष॒ण्वते॑ म॒रुत्व॑ते वि॒श्वदे॑वाय वा॒यवे॑ । स्वाहा॑ गाय॒त्रवे॑पसे ह॒व्यमिन्द्रा॑य कर्तन
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣaṇ-váte ǀ marútvate ǀ viśvá-devāya ǀ vāyáve ǀsvā́hā ǀ gāyatrá-vepase ǀ havyám ǀ índrāya ǀ kartana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests), present the oblation withsvāhātoIndra, in the form ofGāyatra, along withPūṣanand theMaruts; also to the assembled gods, and theVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वाहा॑कृता॒न्या ग॒ह्युप॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वी॒तये॑ । इन्द्रा ग॑हि श्रु॒धी हवं॒ त्वां ह॑वन्ते अध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: svā́hā-kṛtāni ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ úpa ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǀíndra ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ tvā́m ǀ havante ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach,Indra, to partake of the oblations consecrated withsvāhā; approach and hear the invocation, as they invoke you to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तव्य॑सीं॒ नव्य॑सीं धी॒तिम॒ग्नये॑ वा॒चो म॒तिं सह॑सः सू॒नवे॑ भरे । अ॒पां नपा॒द्यो वसु॑भिः स॒ह प्रि॒यो होता॑ पृथि॒व्यां न्यसी॑ददृ॒त्विय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ távyasīm ǀ návyasīm ǀ dhītím ǀ agnáye ǀ vācáḥ ǀ matím ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnáve ǀ bhare ǀapā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀ priyáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ní ǀ ásīdat ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer devoutly toAgni, the son of strength, an invigorating and most new sacrifice, with words of adoration; (that Agni), the grandson of the waters, who, (present) in due season, the friend and ministering priest (of the sacrificer), sits upon the altar with (many) good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जाय॑मानः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन्या॒विर॒ग्निर॑भवन्मात॒रिश्व॑ने । अ॒स्य क्रत्वा॑ समिधा॒नस्य॑ म॒ज्मना॒ प्र द्यावा॑ शो॒चिः पृ॑थि॒वी अ॑रोचयत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀ āvíḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ mātaríśvane ǀasyá ǀ krátvā ǀ sam-idhānásya ǀ majmánā ǀ prá ǀ dyā́vā ǀ śocíḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ arocayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as born, what that (Agni) manifested to Matariśvan in the highest atmosphere, and his radiance, kindled by vigorous effort, spread through heaven and earth. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य त्वे॒षा अ॒जरा॑ अ॒स्य भा॒नव॑: सुसं॒दृश॑: सु॒प्रती॑कस्य सु॒द्युत॑: । भात्व॑क्षसो॒ अत्य॒क्तुर्न सिन्ध॑वो॒ऽग्ने रे॑जन्ते॒ अस॑सन्तो अ॒जरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ tveṣā́ḥ ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ asyá ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ su-saṃdṛ́śaḥ ǀ su-prátīkasya ǀ su-dyútaḥ ǀbhā́-tvakṣasaḥ ǀ áti ǀ aktúḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ rejante ǀ ásasantaḥ ǀ ajárāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His radiance is undecaying; the rays of him who is of plural asing aspect, are everywhere visible and bright; the intensely shining, all-pervading, unceasing, undecaying (rays) ofAgni, desist not (from their functions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमे॑रि॒रे भृग॑वो वि॒श्ववे॑दसं॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या भुव॑नस्य म॒ज्मना॑ । अ॒ग्निं तं गी॒र्भिर्हि॑नुहि॒ स्व आ दमे॒ य एको॒ वस्वो॒ वरु॑णो॒ न राज॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ ā-īriré ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ majmánā ǀagním ǀ tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ hinuhi ǀ své ǀ ā́ ǀ dáme ǀ yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to his own abode with hymns thatAgni, the possessor of all riches, whom the descendants ofBhṛguplural ced by the strength of all beings upon the navel of the earth; for, likeVaruṇa, he reigns sole (monarch) over (all) treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यो वरा॑य म॒रुता॑मिव स्व॒नः सेने॑व सृ॒ष्टा दि॒व्या यथा॒शनि॑: । अ॒ग्निर्जम्भै॑स्तिगि॒तैर॑त्ति॒ भर्व॑ति यो॒धो न शत्रू॒न्त्स वना॒ न्यृ॑ञ्जते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ várāya ǀ marútām-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀ sénā-iva ǀ sṛṣṭā́ ǀ divyā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ aśániḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ jámbhaiḥ ǀ tigitáiḥ ǀ atti ǀ bhárvati ǀ yodháḥ ǀ ná ǀ śátrūn ǀ sáḥ ǀ vánā ǀ ní ǀ ṛñjate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who, like the roaring of the winds, like a victorious host, like the thunderbolt in heaven, is not to be arrested, devours and destroys (our foes) with sharpened teeth (bharva hiṃsāyām; bharvatirattikarmā:Nirukta9.23), and, as a warrior (annihilates his enemies), he, (Agni), lays waste the woods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विन्नो॑ अ॒ग्निरु॒चथ॑स्य॒ वीरस॒द्वसु॑ष्कु॒विद्वसु॑भि॒: काम॑मा॒वर॑त् । चो॒दः कु॒वित्तु॑तु॒ज्यात्सा॒तये॒ धिय॒: शुचि॑प्रतीकं॒ तम॒या धि॒या गृ॑णे
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ucáthasya ǀ vī́ḥ ǀ ásat ǀ vásuḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā-várat ǀcodáḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ tutujyā́t ǀ sātáye ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ śúci-pratīkam ǀ tám ǀ ayā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgnibe ever desirous of our praise; may the giver of wealth satisfy our utmost expectation with riches; may the inspirer (of our devotion) hasten our rites to fruition. I glorify him, the radiant-limbed (Agni), with this laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तप्र॑तीकं व ऋ॒तस्य॑ धू॒र्षद॑म॒ग्निं मि॒त्रं न स॑मिधा॒न ऋ॑ञ्जते । इन्धा॑नो अ॒क्रो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ दीद्य॑च्छु॒क्रव॑र्णा॒मुदु॑ नो यंसते॒ धिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtá-pratīkam ǀ vaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhūḥ-sádam ǀ agním ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ṛñjate ǀíndhānaḥ ǀ akráḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ dī́dyat ǀ śukrá-varṇām ǀ út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ yaṃsate ǀ dhíyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kindler (of the sacrificial fire) propitiatesAgni, of glistening form; the upholder of your ceremony, like a friend; well kindled and well supplied (with fuel); blazing brightly at holy rites, he illumines our pure and pious observances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप्र॑युच्छ॒न्नप्र॑युच्छद्भिरग्ने शि॒वेभि॑र्नः पा॒युभि॑: पाहि श॒ग्मैः । अद॑ब्धेभि॒रदृ॑पितेभिरि॒ष्टेऽनि॑मिषद्भि॒: परि॑ पाहि नो॒ जाः
shlokas.transliteration: ápra-yucchan ǀ áprayucchat-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ śagmáiḥ ǀádabdhebhiḥ ǀ ádṛpitebhiḥ ǀ iṣṭe ǀ ánimiṣat-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ pāhi ǀ naḥ ǀ jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, never heedless (of us), guard us with never heedless, auspicious, and joy-bestowing cares; do you, who are desired (by all), protect us, and those born of us, with unobstructed unovercome, and never slumbering (vigilance).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एति॒ प्र होता॑ व्र॒तम॑स्य मा॒ययो॒र्ध्वां दधा॑न॒: शुचि॑पेशसं॒ धिय॑म् । अ॒भि स्रुच॑: क्रमते दक्षिणा॒वृतो॒ या अ॑स्य॒ धाम॑ प्रथ॒मं ह॒ निंस॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: éti ǀ prá ǀ hótā ǀ vratám ǀ asya ǀ māyáyā ǀ ūrdhvā́m ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ śúci-peśasam ǀ dhíyam ǀabhí ǀ srúcaḥ ǀ kramate ǀ dakṣiṇā-āvṛ́taḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ prathamám ǀ ha ǀ níṃsate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ministering priest, (qualified) by experience, and possessing exalted and graceful devotion,proceeds (to celebrate) his, (Agni's), worship, having circumambulated (the altar), he takes up the ladles which are first to present theoblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भीमृ॒तस्य॑ दो॒हना॑ अनूषत॒ योनौ॑ दे॒वस्य॒ सद॑ने॒ परी॑वृताः । अ॒पामु॒पस्थे॒ विभृ॑तो॒ यदाव॑स॒दध॑ स्व॒धा अ॑धय॒द्याभि॒रीय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dohánāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ yónau ǀ devásya ǀ sádane ǀ pári-vṛtāḥ ǀapā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ví-bhṛtaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ā́ ǀ ávasat ǀ ádha ǀ svadhā́ḥ ǀ adhayat ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ī́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The drops of rain, enveloped (by the solar rays), are renewed in the dwelling of the divine (sun), their birth-plural ce; when he, (Agni), abides cherished on the lap of the waters, then (the world) drinks the nectareous (rain), with which he, (as the lightning), associates.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युयू॑षत॒: सव॑यसा॒ तदिद्वपु॑: समा॒नमर्थं॑ वि॒तरि॑त्रता मि॒थः । आदीं॒ भगो॒ न हव्य॒: सम॒स्मदा वोळ्हु॒र्न र॒श्मीन्त्सम॑यंस्त॒ सार॑थिः
shlokas.transliteration: yúyūṣataḥ ǀ sá-vayasā ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ vápuḥ ǀ samānám ǀ ártham ǀ vi-táritratā ǀ mitháḥ ǀā́t ǀ īm ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ vóḷhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmī́n ǀ sám ǀ ayaṃsta ǀ sā́rathiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two (priests, the hotī andadhvaryu), of equal honour, and alike assiduous, labouring mutually for a common object, combine the form ofAgni(with their respective functions); whereupon he to whom the oblation is to be offered, collects the drops (of clarified butter), asBhaga(accepts the worship of all), or as a charioteer (gathers the reins of the horses) that draw (the car).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमीं॒ द्वा सव॑यसा सप॒र्यत॑: समा॒ने योना॑ मिथु॒ना समो॑कसा । दिवा॒ न नक्तं॑ पलि॒तो युवा॑जनि पु॒रू चर॑न्न॒जरो॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गा
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ īm ǀ dvā́ ǀ sá-vayasā ǀ saparyátaḥ ǀ samāné ǀ yónā ǀ mithunā́ ǀ sám-okasā ǀdívā ǀ ná ǀ náktam ǀ palitáḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ ajani ǀ purú ǀ cáran ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, whom the two, a pair of equal power, dwelling in the same plural ce, and engaged in the same ceremony, worship night and day; he, whether old or young, has been engendered for the sake of mortal couples, accepting many (oblations), and exempt from decay.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमीं॑ हिन्वन्ति धी॒तयो॒ दश॒ व्रिशो॑ दे॒वं मर्ता॑स ऊ॒तये॑ हवामहे । धनो॒रधि॑ प्र॒वत॒ आ स ऋ॑ण्वत्यभि॒व्रज॑द्भिर्व॒युना॒ नवा॑धित
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ vríśaḥ ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ havāmahe ǀdhánoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛṇvati ǀ abhivrájat-bhiḥ ǀ vayúnā ǀ návā ǀ adhita ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers intertwined propitiate that divine (Agni), whom we mortals invoke for protection; he darts (his rays) like swift (arrows) from a bow, and accepts the new praises (uttered) by those who crowd round the altar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्य॑ग्ने दि॒व्यस्य॒ राज॑सि॒ त्वं पार्थि॑वस्य पशु॒पा इ॑व॒ त्मना॑ । एनी॑ त ए॒ते बृ॑ह॒ती अ॑भि॒श्रिया॑ हिर॒ण्ययी॒ वक्व॑री ब॒र्हिरा॑शाते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ divyásya ǀ rā́jasi ǀ tvám ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ paśupā́ḥ-iva ǀ tmánā ǀénī íti ǀ te ǀ eté íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ abhi-śríyā ǀ hiraṇyáyī íti ǀ vákvarī íti ǀ barhíḥ ǀ āśāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, reign over (the dweller in) heaven, and over those of earth, according to thine own (will), as a herdsman over his (herd), and those two, (heaven and earth), bright, vast, adorable, beneficent, and sounding (agreeably), partake of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ जु॒षस्व॒ प्रति॑ हर्य॒ तद्वचो॒ मन्द्र॒ स्वधा॑व॒ ऋत॑जात॒ सुक्र॑तो । यो वि॒श्वत॑: प्र॒त्यङ्ङसि॑ दर्श॒तो र॒ण्वः संदृ॑ष्टौ पितु॒माँ इ॑व॒ क्षय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ juṣásva ǀ práti ǀ harya ǀ tát ǀ vácaḥ ǀ mándra ǀ svádhā-vaḥ ǀ ṛ́ta-jāta ǀ súkrato íti sú-krato ǀyáḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ ási ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ sám-dṛṣṭau ǀ pitumā́n-iva ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who confers happiness, who accepts oblations, who was born for sacrifice, and are the performer of good works, be plural ased (with this rite), attend to this prayer; for you are in presence of all (the world), are visible (to all), are plural asant in their sight, and are their refuge, like a (bountiful) distributor of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं पृ॑च्छता॒ स ज॑गामा॒ स वे॑द॒ स चि॑कि॒त्वाँ ई॑यते॒ सा न्वी॑यते । तस्मि॑न्त्सन्ति प्र॒शिष॒स्तस्मि॑न्नि॒ष्टय॒: स वाज॑स्य॒ शव॑सः शु॒ष्मिण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ pṛcchata ǀ sáḥ ǀ jagāma ǀ sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ sáḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ īyate ǀ sáḥ ǀ nú ǀ īyate ǀtásmin ǀ santi ǀ pra-śíṣaḥ ǀ tásmin ǀ iṣṭáyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ask (ofAgniwhat you desire), for he goes (everywhere), he knows (all things); possessed of intelligence, he proceeds (to ascertain what is to be done), and is had recourse to (by his worshippers); for in him is the power of restraining (unreasonable desires) in him (is the power of granting) enjoyment; he is the giver of food and of strength; the protector of the mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमित्पृ॑च्छन्ति॒ न सि॒मो वि पृ॑च्छति॒ स्वेने॑व॒ धीरो॒ मन॑सा॒ यदग्र॑भीत् । न मृ॑ष्यते प्रथ॒मं नाप॑रं॒ वचो॒ऽस्य क्रत्वा॑ सचते॒ अप्र॑दृपितः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ pṛcchanti ǀ ná ǀ simáḥ ǀ ví ǀ pṛcchati ǀ svéna-iva ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ yát ǀ ágrabhīt ǀná ǀ mṛṣyate ǀ prathamám ǀ ná ǀ áparam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ krátvā ǀ sacate ǀ ápra-dṛpitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They ask ofAgni, but no one asks improperly; for a sensible man (replies to solicitation) as he has determined in his own mind; Agni tolerates not a speech that anticipates (his reply), nor endures a rejoinder; he who is devoid of arrogance is favoured by his protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिद्ग॑च्छन्ति जु॒ह्व१॒॑स्तमर्व॑ती॒र्विश्वा॒न्येक॑: शृणव॒द्वचां॑सि मे । पु॒रु॒प्रै॒षस्ततु॑रिर्यज्ञ॒साध॒नोऽच्छि॑द्रोति॒: शिशु॒राद॑त्त॒ सं रभ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ gacchanti ǀ juhváḥ ǀ tám ǀ árvatīḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ ékaḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ me ǀpuru-praiṣáḥ ǀ táturiḥ ǀ yajña-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ ácchidra-ūtiḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ adatta ǀ sám ǀ rábhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him the (sacrificial) ladles are directed; to him (our) praises are addressed; he alone hears all my prayers; be is the instrumental gator of many, the transporter (across the world), the instrumental ument of sacrifice, the unintermitting preserver (of mankind), and (genitive le as) an infant; provided with the preparations (of sacrifice), he accepts libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒स्थायं॑ चरति॒ यत्स॒मार॑त स॒द्यो जा॒तस्त॑त्सार॒ युज्ये॑भिः । अ॒भि श्वा॒न्तं मृ॑शते ना॒न्द्ये॑ मु॒दे यदीं॒ गच्छ॑न्त्युश॒तीर॑पिष्ठि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: upa-sthā́yam ǀ carati ǀ yát ǀ sam-ā́rata ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ tatsāra ǀ yújyebhiḥ ǀabhí ǀ śvāntám ǀ mṛśate ǀ nāndyé ǀ mudé ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ gácchanti ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ api-sthitám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (the priest) proceeds to effect his development, he is (at once) manifested; and as soon as engendered, is associated with his objects; he provides for the gratification (of his worshipper), plural cidly engaged in the agreeable (rite), when the (oblations) that desire (his acceptance) reach him present (at the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॑ मृ॒गो अप्यो॑ वन॒र्गुरुप॑ त्व॒च्यु॑प॒मस्यां॒ नि धा॑यि । व्य॑ब्रवीद्व॒युना॒ मर्त्ये॑भ्यो॒ऽग्निर्वि॒द्वाँ ऋ॑त॒चिद्धि स॒त्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ápyaḥ ǀ vanargúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tvací ǀ upa-másyām ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀví ǀ abravīt ǀ vayúnā ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛta-cít ǀ hí ǀ satyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the searcher, the accessible, the dweller in woods, has been plural ced (amidst the fuel), as in the similitude of (an enveloping) skin; the wiseAgni, the appreciater of sacrifice, the veracious, has declared to mortals (the knowledge of) their religious duties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒मू॒र्धानं॑ स॒प्तर॑श्मिं गृणी॒षेऽनू॑नम॒ग्निं पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॑ । नि॒ष॒त्तम॑स्य॒ चर॑तो ध्रु॒वस्य॒ विश्वा॑ दि॒वो रो॑च॒नाप॑प्रि॒वांस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-mūrdhā́nam ǀ saptá-raśmim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ ánūnam ǀ agním ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀni-sattám ǀ asya ǀ cárataḥ ǀ dhruvásya ǀ víśvā ǀ diváḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ āpapri-vā́ṃsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the three-headed, seven-rayedAgni, who is sibject to no diminution, seated on the lap of his parents, (heaven and earth); and gratifying all (desires); as the universal radiance of the divine (Agni), whether moving or stationary, (spreads around).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षा म॒हाँ अ॒भि व॑वक्ष एने अ॒जर॑स्तस्थावि॒तऊ॑तिॠ॒ष्वः । उ॒र्व्याः प॒दो नि द॑धाति॒ सानौ॑ रि॒हन्त्यूधो॑ अरु॒षासो॑ अस्य
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ abhí ǀ vavakṣe ǀ ene íti ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ tasthau ǀ itáḥ-ūtiḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀurvyā́ḥ ǀ padáḥ ǀ ní ǀ dadhāti ǀ sā́nau ǀ rihánti ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great showerer (of benefits) has pervaded these two (worlds); undecaying and adorable, he is (ever) present, bestowing protection; he plural ces his foot on the summit of the earth, and his radiant (flames) lick the udder (of the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नं व॒त्सम॒भि सं॒चर॑न्ती॒ विष्व॑ग्धे॒नू वि च॑रतः सु॒मेके॑ । अ॒न॒प॒वृ॒ज्याँ अध्व॑नो॒ मिमा॑ने॒ विश्वा॒न्केताँ॒ अधि॑ म॒हो दधा॑ने
shlokas.transliteration: samānám ǀ vatsám ǀ abhí ǀ saṃcárantī íti saṃ-cárantī ǀ víṣvak ǀ dhenū́ íti ǀ ví ǀ carataḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀanapa-vṛjyā́n ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ mímāne íti ǀ víśvān ǀ kétān ǀ ádhi ǀ maháḥ ǀ dádhāne íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(there are) two well-disposed cows together approaching their common progeny, and fully nourishing (him); pointingout the paths that are free from all that is to be avoided, and possessing more than the great intelligence (necessary for his development).”

shlokas.sanskrit: धीरा॑सः प॒दं क॒वयो॑ नयन्ति॒ नाना॑ हृ॒दा रक्ष॑माणा अजु॒र्यम् । सिषा॑सन्त॒: पर्य॑पश्यन्त॒ सिन्धु॑मा॒विरे॑भ्यो अभव॒त्सूर्यो॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: dhī́rāsaḥ ǀ padám ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ nayanti ǀ nā́nā ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ rákṣamāṇāḥ ǀ ajuryám ǀsísāsantaḥ ǀ pári ǀ apaśyanta ǀ síndhum ǀ āvíḥ ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Experienced sages (kavayaḥ: ye vā anūcāste kavayaḥ--AitareyaBrāhmaṇa2.2) bring the invincible (Agni), to his station (onthe altar); cherishing him in manifold (ways) in their hearts; desirous of propitiating him, they worshipthe (boon) shedding (Agni); and to those men he is manifest as the Sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒दृ॒क्षेण्य॒: परि॒ काष्ठा॑सु॒ जेन्य॑ ई॒ळेन्यो॑ म॒हो अर्भा॑य जी॒वसे॑ । पु॒रु॒त्रा यदभ॑व॒त्सूरहै॑भ्यो॒ गर्भे॑भ्यो म॒घवा॑ वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः
shlokas.transliteration: didṛkṣéṇyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kā́ṣṭhāsu ǀ jényaḥ ǀ īḷényaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ árbhāya ǀ jīváse ǀpuru-trā́ ǀ yát ǀ ábhavat ǀ sū́ḥ ǀ áha ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ gárbhebhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is willing to be seen in the (ten) regions (of space); the victorious, the adorable, the source of life to great and small; inasmuch as in many plural ces the opulent (possessor of sacrificial food), who is visible to all, is the parent of that (pious) progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था ते॑ अग्ने शु॒चय॑न्त आ॒योर्द॑दा॒शुर्वाजे॑भिराशुषा॒णाः । उ॒भे यत्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ दधा॑ना ऋ॒तस्य॒ साम॑न्र॒णय॑न्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ śucáyantaḥ ǀ āyóḥ ǀ dadāśúḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ āśuṣāṇā́ḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ yát ǀ toké íti ǀ tánaye ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sā́man ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How have your shining and evaporating (rays),Agni, supported life (and supplied) food; so that, enjoying both, the devout (worshippers), possessing sons and grandsons, may repeat the hymns of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बोधा॑ मे अ॒स्य वच॑सो यविष्ठ॒ मंहि॑ष्ठस्य॒ प्रभृ॑तस्य स्वधावः । पीय॑ति त्वो॒ अनु॑ त्वो गृणाति व॒न्दारु॑स्ते त॒न्वं॑ वन्दे अग्ने
shlokas.transliteration: bódha ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ máṃhiṣṭhasya ǀ prá-bhṛtasya ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀpī́yati ǀ tvaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ tvaḥ ǀ gṛṇāti ǀ vandā́ruḥ ǀ te ǀ tanvám ǀ vande ǀ agne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youthful (Agni), to whom oblations are due, appreciate this my reverential and earnest praise; one man reviles (you), another propitiates (you); I, your worshipper, glorify, your person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये पा॒यवो॑ मामते॒यं ते॑ अग्ने॒ पश्य॑न्तो अ॒न्धं दु॑रि॒तादर॑क्षन् । र॒रक्ष॒ तान्त्सु॒कृतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒ दिप्स॑न्त॒ इद्रि॒पवो॒ नाह॑ देभुः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ māmateyám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ andhám ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ árakṣan ǀrarákṣa ǀ tā́n ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀ dípsantaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áha ǀ debhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your fostering (rays),Agni, beholding the blind son ofMamatā, relieved him of the affliction; he who knows all things protect the pious, and (their) malevolent enemies are unable to do them harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ अग्ने॒ अर॑रिवाँ अघा॒युर॑राती॒वा म॒र्चय॑ति द्व॒येन॑ । मन्त्रो॑ गु॒रुः पुन॑रस्तु॒ सो अ॑स्मा॒ अनु॑ मृक्षीष्ट त॒न्वं॑ दुरु॒क्तैः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ árari-vān ǀ agha-yúḥ ǀ arāti-vā́ ǀ marcáyati ǀ dvayéna ǀmántraḥ ǀ gurúḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ astu ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ánu ǀ mṛkṣīṣṭa ǀ tanvám ǀ duḥ-uktáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When a wicked (man), with twofold (malignity of thought and speech), obstructing our offerings, and refraining from gifts (himself), reviles us, may his prayer be heavy on him, and involve his person n (in the consequences of) his evil words.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वा॒ यः स॑हस्य प्रवि॒द्वान्मर्तो॒ मर्तं॑ म॒र्चय॑ति द्व॒येन॑ । अत॑: पाहि स्तवमान स्तु॒वन्त॒मग्ने॒ माकि॑र्नो दुरि॒ताय॑ धायीः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ sahasya ǀ pra-vidvā́n ǀ mártaḥ ǀ mártam ǀ marcáyati ǀ dvayéna ǀátaḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ stavamāna ǀ stuvántam ǀ ágne ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́ya ǀ dhāyīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, Son of Strength, a man skilful (in deception) assails another man with a doubly (malignant prayer), do you,Agni, duly propitiated, protect him who worships you (from its effects); consign us not to misfortune.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मथी॒द्यदीं॑ वि॒ष्टो मा॑त॒रिश्वा॒ होता॑रं वि॒श्वाप्सुं॑ वि॒श्वदे॑व्यम् । नि यं द॒धुर्म॑नु॒ष्या॑सु वि॒क्षु स्व१॒॑र्ण चि॒त्रं वपु॑षे वि॒भाव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: máthīt ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ viṣṭáḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ hótāram ǀ viśvá-apsum ǀ viśvá-devyam ǀní ǀ yám ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ manuṣyā́su ǀ vikṣú ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ citrám ǀ vápuṣe ǀ vibhā́-vam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wind, penetrating (amidst the fuel), has excited (Agni), the invoker (of the gods), the multiform, the minister of all the deities, whom they have established amongst mortal worshippers for the accomplishment of sacrifice, like the wonderful and variously radiant sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒दा॒नमिन्न द॑दभन्त॒ मन्मा॒ग्निर्वरू॑थं॒ मम॒ तस्य॑ चाकन् । जु॒षन्त॒ विश्वा॑न्यस्य॒ कर्मोप॑स्तुतिं॒ भर॑माणस्य का॒रोः
shlokas.transliteration: dadānám ǀ ít ǀ ná ǀ dadabhanta ǀ mánma ǀ agníḥ ǀ várūtham ǀ máma ǀ tásya ǀ cākan ǀjuṣánta ǀ víśvāni ǀ asya ǀ kárma ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ bháramāṇasya ǀ kāróḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not (my enemies) prevail against me, when presenting acceptable (oblations), for (Agni) is desirous of my so offered adoration, and all they (the gods) are gratified by the (pious) acts of me, the reciter of their praise, and the celebrator (of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नित्ये॑ चि॒न्नु यं सद॑ने जगृ॒भ्रे प्रश॑स्तिभिर्दधि॒रे य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । प्र सू न॑यन्त गृ॒भय॑न्त इ॒ष्टावश्वा॑सो॒ न र॒थ्यो॑ रारहा॒णाः
shlokas.transliteration: nítye ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ yám ǀ sádane ǀ jagṛbhré ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀprá ǀ sú ǀ nayanta ǀ gṛbháyantaḥ ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ rarahāṇā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him, whom the worshippers lay hold of in his perpetual abode, they detain by their praises, and the holders convey him diligently to the sacrifice, as rapid coursers, harnessed to a car, (bear the rider to his destination).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रूणि॑ द॒स्मो नि रि॑णाति॒ जम्भै॒राद्रो॑चते॒ वन॒ आ वि॒भावा॑ । आद॑स्य॒ वातो॒ अनु॑ वाति शो॒चिरस्तु॒र्न शर्या॑मस॒नामनु॒ द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: purū́ṇi ǀ dasmáḥ ǀ ní ǀ riṇāti ǀ jámbhaiḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ rocate ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀā́t ǀ asya ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vāti ǀ śocíḥ ǀ ástuḥ ǀ ná ǀ śáryām ǀ asanā́m ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The destroyer, (Agni), consumes numerous (trees) by his flames, and shares with manifold radiance in the forest; the favouring wind blows (the flames) onwards day by day, like the swift arrows (śaryāiṣavaḥ śaramayyaḥ--Nirukta5.4) of an archer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं रि॒पवो॒ न रि॑ष॒ण्यवो॒ गर्भे॒ सन्तं॑ रेष॒णा रे॒षय॑न्ति । अ॒न्धा अ॑प॒श्या न द॑भन्नभि॒ख्या नित्या॑स ईं प्रे॒तारो॑ अरक्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ riṣaṇyávaḥ ǀ gárbhe ǀ sántam ǀ reṣaṇā́ḥ ǀ reṣáyanti ǀandhā́ḥ ǀ apaśyā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ dabhan ǀ abhi-khyā́ ǀ nítyāsaḥ ǀ īm ǀ pretā́raḥ ǀ arakṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The blind (of intellect), or those who see not (physically), detract not from his glory, whom no enemies no malevolent adversaries, harm, even whilst yet in (his) embryo (condition), for his constant encouragers defend him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हः स रा॒य एष॑ते॒ पति॒र्दन्नि॒न इ॒नस्य॒ वसु॑नः प॒द आ । उप॒ ध्रज॑न्त॒मद्र॑यो वि॒धन्नित्
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǀ pátiḥ ǀ dán ǀ ináḥ ǀ inásya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ padé ǀ ā́ ǀúpa ǀ dhrájantam ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ vidhán ǀ ít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the lord of great wealth, the granter (of desires) comes (to the plural ce of sacrifice); he, the lord of lords, comes to the plural ce of affluence, (the altar); the stones prepare (the libation fo rhim) as he approaches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यो वृषा॑ न॒रां न रोद॑स्यो॒: श्रवो॑भि॒रस्ति॑ जी॒वपी॑तसर्गः । प्र यः स॑स्रा॒णः शि॑श्री॒त योनौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ narā́m ǀ ná ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ásti ǀ jīvápīta-sargaḥ ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ sasrāṇáḥ ǀ śiśrītá ǀ yónau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who is, as it were, the genitive rator of men as well as of heaven and earth, of whom creation has imbibed life, abides with his glories; he it is who, entering into the womb (of being), procreates (all living creatures).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यः पुरं॒ नार्मि॑णी॒मदी॑दे॒दत्य॑: क॒विर्न॑भ॒न्यो॒३॒॑ नार्वा॑ । सूरो॒ न रु॑रु॒क्वाञ्छ॒तात्मा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ púram ǀ nā́rmiṇīm ǀ ádīdet ǀ átyaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ nabhanyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǀsū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ rurukvā́n ǀ śatá-ātmā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is wise, and goes (wheresoever he will), like the rapid ethereal (wind), has lighted up the delightful spot, (the altar), and, identical with many forms, is radiant as the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्वि॒जन्मा॒ त्री रो॑च॒नानि॒ विश्वा॒ रजां॑सि शुशुचा॒नो अ॑स्थात् । होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अ॒पां स॒धस्थ॑श
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dvi-jánmā ǀ trī́ ǀ rocanā́ni ǀ víśvā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ śuśucānáḥ ǀ asthāt ǀhótā ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ sadhá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He the twice-born, illuminating the three bright (regions), and shining over all the lustrous spheres, the adorable invoker of the gods, is present at the plural ce where the waters are collected.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स होता॒ यो द्वि॒जन्मा॒ विश्वा॑ द॒धे वार्या॑णि श्रव॒स्या । मर्तो॒ यो अ॑स्मै सु॒तुको॑ द॒दाश॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ dvi-jánmā ǀ víśvā ǀ dadhé ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ śravasyā́ ǀmártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ su-túkaḥ ǀ dadā́śa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the offerer of oblations, who is of twofold birth; and, through desire of (sacrificial) food, has in his keeping all good things; the man who presents offerings to him is the parent of excellent offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु त्वा॑ दा॒श्वान्वो॑चे॒ऽरिर॑ग्ने॒ तव॑ स्वि॒दा । तो॒दस्ये॑व शर॒ण आ म॒हस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: purú ǀ tvā ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ voce ǀ aríḥ ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ svit ǀ ā́ ǀtodásya-iva ǀ śaraṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ mahásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Presenting many offerings, I address you,Agni, ever coming into your presence (like a servant) in the dwelling of a mighty master.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑नि॒नस्य॑ ध॒निन॑: प्रहो॒षे चि॒दर॑रुषः । क॒दा च॒न प्र॒जिग॑तो॒ अदे॑वयोः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ aninásya ǀ dhanínaḥ ǀ pra-hoṣé ǀ cit ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ caná ǀ pra-jígataḥ ǀ ádeva-yoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I ask you also to withhold your favour) from (those) two godless (person ns), from the rich man, who acknowledging you not as his lord, is chary of gifts at sacred rites, and from him who rarely praises (the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स च॒न्द्रो वि॑प्र॒ मर्त्यो॑ म॒हो व्राध॑न्तमो दि॒वि । प्रप्रेत्ते॑ अग्ने व॒नुष॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ candráḥ ǀ vipra ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ vrā́dhan-tamaḥ ǀ diví ǀprá-pra ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageAgni, the mortal (who propitiates you) becomes a moon in heaven, the most eminent of the great (deities); may we, therefore, ever be in an especial manner your worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रं न यं शिम्या॒ गोषु॑ ग॒व्यव॑: स्वा॒ध्यो॑ वि॒दथे॑ अ॒प्सु जीज॑नन् । अरे॑जेतां॒ रोद॑सी॒ पाज॑सा गि॒रा प्रति॑ प्रि॒यं य॑ज॒तं ज॒नुषा॒मव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mitrám ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ śímyā ǀ góṣu ǀ gavyávaḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ ap-sú ǀ jī́janan ǀárejetām ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pā́jasā ǀ girā́ ǀ práti ǀ priyám ǀ yajatám ǀ janúṣām ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth have been terrified by the strength and the noise (of him), whom pious worshippers, desirous of acquiring cattle, have genitive rated by their (sacred) acts, amidst the waters (of the firmament), at the sacrifice, as a friend for the preservation of living beings, the benefactor (of man), and entitled to adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्ध॒ त्यद्वां॑ पुरुमी॒ळ्हस्य॑ सो॒मिन॒: प्र मि॒त्रासो॒ न द॑धि॒रे स्वा॒भुव॑: । अध॒ क्रतुं॑ विदतं गा॒तुमर्च॑त उ॒त श्रु॑तं वृषणा प॒स्त्या॑वतः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vām ǀ puru-mīḷhásya ǀ somínaḥ ǀ prá ǀ mitrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ dadhiré ǀ su-ābhúvaḥ ǀádha ǀ krátum ǀ vidatam ǀ gātúm ǀ árcate ǀ utá ǀ śrutam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ pastyá-vataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since they, (the priests), like friends, have prepared for you both, (MitraandVaruṇaa libation) of the abundantly-flowing and spontaneousSoma, therefore do you consent to come to the rite of the worshipper, and listen, showerers (of blessings), to the (prayers of the) householdeṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ भूषन्क्षि॒तयो॒ जन्म॒ रोद॑स्योः प्र॒वाच्यं॑ वृषणा॒ दक्ष॑से म॒हे । यदी॑मृ॒ताय॒ भर॑थो॒ यदर्व॑ते॒ प्र होत्र॑या॒ शिम्या॑ वीथो अध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ bhūṣan ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ jánma ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ pra-vā́cyam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ dákṣase ǀ mahé ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ bhárathaḥ ǀ yát ǀ árvate ǀ prá ǀ hótrayā ǀ śímyā ǀ vīthaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For the sake (of obtaining) great vigour, showerers (of benefits), men glorify your birth from heaven and earth, which is to be extolled, inasmuch as you bestow (his desires) upon the worshipper (as the reward) of his sacrifice, and accept the rite (that is solemnized) with praise and oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सा क्षि॒तिर॑सुर॒ या महि॑ प्रि॒य ऋता॑वानावृ॒तमा घो॑षथो बृ॒हत् । यु॒वं दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तो दक्ष॑मा॒भुवं॒ गां न धु॒र्युप॑ युञ्जाथे अ॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sā́ ǀ kṣitíḥ ǀ asurā ǀ yā́ ǀ máhi ǀ priyā́ ǀ ṛ́ta-vānau ǀ ṛtám ǀ ā́ ǀ ghoṣathaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀyuvám ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ ā-bhúvam ǀ gā́m ǀ ná ǀ dhurí ǀ úpa ǀ yuñjāthe íti ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful divinities, most acceptable to you both is that spot, (where you are worshipped); accepters of sacrifice, proclaim the great ceremony (as duly performed); for you two connect the efficacious and comprehensive rise with the vast heaven, like a cow with a burden.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही अत्र॑ महि॒ना वार॑मृण्वथोऽरे॒णव॒स्तुज॒ आ सद्म॑न्धे॒नव॑: । स्वर॑न्ति॒ ता उ॑प॒रता॑ति॒ सूर्य॒मा नि॒म्रुच॑ उ॒षस॑स्तक्व॒वीरि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ íti ǀ átra ǀ mahinā́ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ṛṇvathaḥ ǀ areṇávaḥ ǀ tújaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sádman ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀsváranti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ upará-tāti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ ni-mrúcaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ takvavī́ḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You bring (the cattle) to their acceptable (pasture) upon earth, whence the milk-yielding cows, protected by your power, return unharmed to their stalls; they cry to the sun (in heaven) above, both at evening and at dawn, as one (cries aloud) who detects a thief.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑मृ॒ताय॑ के॒शिनी॑रनूषत॒ मित्र॒ यत्र॒ वरु॑ण गा॒तुमर्च॑थः । अव॒ त्मना॑ सृ॒जतं॒ पिन्व॑तं॒ धियो॑ यु॒वं विप्र॑स्य॒ मन्म॑नामिरज्यथः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ keśínīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ mítra ǀ yátra ǀ váruṇa ǀ gātúm ǀ árcathaḥ ǀáva ǀ tmánā ǀ sṛjátam ǀ pínvatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ víprasya ǀ mánmanām ǀ irajyathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tresses ofAgniminister,MitraandVaruṇa, to your sacrifice, when you honour (with your presence) the sacrificial chamber; send down of your own accord (the rain), and prosper our offerings, for you have command over the praise of the pious men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॑ य॒ज्ञैः श॑शमा॒नो ह॒ दाश॑ति क॒विर्होता॒ यज॑ति मन्म॒साध॑नः । उपाह॒ तं गच्छ॑थो वी॒थो अ॑ध्व॒रमच्छा॒ गिर॑: सुम॒तिं ग॑न्तमस्म॒यू
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ ha ǀ dā́śati ǀ kavíḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yájati ǀ manma-sā́dhanaḥ ǀúpa ǀ áha ǀ tám ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ vītháḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ áccha ǀ gíraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ gantam ǀ asmayū́ ítyasma-yū́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to the devout (worshipper), who, glorifying you, and providing (all that is) acceptable, presents you with oblations; (to him), the sage, the invoker, who offers you worship; accept his sacrifice; favourably disposed towards us, (accept) our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां य॒ज्ञैः प्र॑थ॒मा गोभि॑रञ्जत॒ ऋता॑वाना॒ मन॑सो॒ न प्रयु॑क्तिषु । भर॑न्ति वां॒ मन्म॑ना सं॒यता॒ गिरोऽदृ॑प्यता॒ मन॑सा रे॒वदा॑शाथे
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjate ǀ ṛ́ta-vānā ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ prá-yuktiṣu ǀbháranti ǀ vām ǀ mánmanā ǀ sam-yátā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ádṛpyatā ǀ mánasā ǀ revát ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accepter of sacrifices, you are the first whom (worshippers) propitiate with offerings, the produce of the cow; like (the application) of the mind (in the first instrumental nce) to the results (of the senses); hymns (prompted) by thoughts wholly intent upon you, celebrate (your praise); do you, with humble minds, bestow upon us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रे॒वद्वयो॑ दधाथे रे॒वदा॑शाथे॒ नरा॑ मा॒याभि॑रि॒तऊ॑ति॒ माहि॑नम् । न वां॒ द्यावोऽह॑भि॒र्नोत सिन्ध॑वो॒ न दे॑व॒त्वं प॒णयो॒ नान॑शुर्म॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: revát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhāthe íti ǀ revát ǀ āśāthe íti ǀ nárā ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ itá-ūti ǀ mā́hinam ǀná ǀ vām ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ deva-tvám ǀ paṇáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀ maghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You distribute food, accompanied by riches; you bestow upon us, leaders (of sacrifice), wealth, ample, and defended by your wise provisions; the days with the nights have not attained your divinity; neither have the rivers, nor have theasuras, and they have not obtained (your) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं वस्त्रा॑णि पीव॒सा व॑साथे यु॒वोरच्छि॑द्रा॒ मन्त॑वो ह॒ सर्गा॑: । अवा॑तिरत॒मनृ॑तानि॒ विश्व॑ ऋ॒तेन॑ मित्रावरुणा सचेथे
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ pīvasā́ ǀ vasāthe íti ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ácchidrāḥ ǀ mántavaḥ ǀ ha ǀ sárgāḥ ǀáva ǀ atiratam ǀ ánṛtāni ǀ víśvā ǀ ṛténa ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sacethe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RobustMitraandVaruṇa, you wear vestments (of light); your natures are to be regarded as without defect; you annihilate all untruths; you associate (us) with sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तच्च॒न त्वो॒ वि चि॑केतदेषां स॒त्यो मन्त्र॑: कविश॒स्त ऋघा॑वान् । त्रि॒रश्रिं॑ हन्ति॒ चतु॑रश्रिरु॒ग्रो दे॑व॒निदो॒ ह प्र॑थ॒मा अ॑जूर्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ caná ǀ tvaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ciketat ǀ eṣām ǀ satyáḥ ǀ mántraḥ ǀ kavi-śastáḥ ǀ ṛ́ghāvān ǀtriḥ-áśrim ǀ hanti ǀ cátuḥ-aśriḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ deva-nídaḥ ǀ ha ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ ajūryan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He amongst those (who are your followers), who observes truth, who is considerate, who is commended by the wise, who is able to (inflict) harm, carefully weighs (the means whereby), fierce and well-armed, he slays (a foe) less efficiently accoutred, and (by which) the revilers of the gods, however mighty, may perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पादे॑ति प्रथ॒मा प॒द्वती॑नां॒ कस्तद्वां॑ मित्रावरु॒णा चि॑केत । गर्भो॑ भा॒रं भ॑र॒त्या चि॑दस्य ऋ॒तं पिप॒र्त्यनृ॑तं॒ नि ता॑रीत्
shlokas.transliteration: apā́t ǀ eti ǀ prathamā́ ǀ pat-vátīnām ǀ káḥ ǀ tát ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǀgárbhaḥ ǀ bhārám ǀ bharati ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ ṛtám ǀ píparti ǀ ánṛtam ǀ ní ǀ tārīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who knows,MitraandVaruṇa, that it is your doing, that the footless dawn is the precursor of footed beings; and that your infant (progeny, the sun), sustains the burden of this (world); he diffuses (the) truth (of light), and disperses the falsehood (of darkness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒यन्त॒मित्परि॑ जा॒रं क॒नीनां॒ पश्या॑मसि॒ नोप॑नि॒पद्य॑मानम् । अन॑वपृग्णा॒ वित॑ता॒ वसा॑नं प्रि॒यं मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: pra-yántam ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ jārám ǀ kanī́nām ǀ páśyāmasi ǀ ná ǀ upa-nipádyamānam ǀánava-pṛgṇā ǀ ví-tatā ǀ vásānam ǀ priyám ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We behold the lover of the maiden (dawns), ever in movement, never resting for an instrumental nt, wearing inseparable and diffusive (radiance), the beloved abode ofMitraandVaruṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न॒श्वो जा॒तो अ॑नभी॒शुरर्वा॒ कनि॑क्रदत्पतयदू॒र्ध्वसा॑नुः । अ॒चित्तं॒ ब्रह्म॑ जुजुषु॒र्युवा॑न॒: प्र मि॒त्रे धाम॒ वरु॑णे गृ॒णन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: anaśváḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ anabhīśúḥ ǀ árvā ǀ kánikradat ǀ patayat ǀ ūrdhvá-sānuḥ ǀacíttam ǀ bráhma ǀ jujuṣuḥ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ prá ǀ mitré ǀ dhā́ma ǀ váruṇe ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Without steeds, without stay, (he is nevertheless) borne swift-moving and loud-sounding; he travels, ascending higher and higher, connecting the inconceivable mystery (of sacred rites) with the radiance (abiding) inMitraandVaruṇa, (which men), eulogizing, glorify.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ धे॒नवो॑ मामते॒यमव॑न्तीर्ब्रह्म॒प्रियं॑ पीपय॒न्त्सस्मि॒न्नूध॑न् । पि॒त्वो भि॑क्षेत व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वाना॒साविवा॑स॒न्नदि॑तिमुरुष्येत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ māmateyám ǀ ávantīḥ ǀ brahma-príyam ǀ pīpayan ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǀpitváḥ ǀ bhikṣeta ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ āsā́ ǀ ā-vívāsan ǀ áditim ǀ uruṣyet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the cow, propitious to the devout son ofMamatā, be possessed of well-filled udders; knowing the rites (necessary to be performed), let him beg (the residue) of the offerings for his eating, and worshipping (you both) complete the perfect (ceremony).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ मित्रावरुणा ह॒व्यजु॑ष्टिं॒ नम॑सा देवा॒वव॑सा ववृत्याम् । अ॒स्माकं॒ ब्रह्म॒ पृत॑नासु सह्या अ॒स्माकं॑ वृ॒ष्टिर्दि॒व्या सु॑पा॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ havyá-juṣṭim ǀ námasā ǀ devau ǀ ávasā ǀ vavṛtyām ǀasmā́kam ǀ bráhma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sahyāḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ divyā́ ǀ su-pārā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineMitraandVaruṇa, may I render the oblation acceptable to you with reverence and prayer; may the sacred rite enable us (to overcome) in battles, and may the heavenly rain be to us the means of satisfying our wants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यजा॑महे वां म॒हः स॒जोषा॑ ह॒व्येभि॑र्मित्रावरुणा॒ नमो॑भिः । घृ॒तैर्घृ॑तस्नू॒ अध॒ यद्वा॑म॒स्मे अ॑ध्व॒र्यवो॒ न धी॒तिभि॒र्भर॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: yájāmahe ǀ vām ǀ maháḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀghṛtáiḥ ǀ ghṛtasnū íti ghṛta-snū ǀ ádha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ asmé íti ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ bháranti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyMitraandVaruṇa, dispensers of butter, we worship you, rejoicing, with oblations; with reverential homage, and with (offerings of) water; so that our ministrant priests may propitiate you by (our) devotions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रस्तु॑तिर्वां॒ धाम॒ न प्रयु॑क्ति॒रया॑मि मित्रावरुणा सुवृ॒क्तिः । अ॒नक्ति॒ यद्वां॑ वि॒दथे॑षु॒ होता॑ सु॒म्नं वां॑ सू॒रिर्वृ॑षणा॒विय॑क्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá-stutiḥ ǀ vām ǀ dhā́ma ǀ ná ǀ prá-yuktiḥ ǀ áyāmi ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ su-vṛktíḥ ǀanákti ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ hótā ǀ sumnám ǀ vām ǀ sūríḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ íyakṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purpose of worshipping you,MitraandVaruṇa, is not the performance, but (even by so much) I may attain to your glory, and there is acquittance (of my duty); for when the priest offers you oblations in sacrifices, then the pious man, showerers (of benefits), being desirous of worshipping you, (obtains) felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पी॒पाय॑ धे॒नुरदि॑तिॠ॒ताय॒ जना॑य मित्रावरुणा हवि॒र्दे । हि॒नोति॒ यद्वां॑ वि॒दथे॑ सप॒र्यन्त्स रा॒तह॑व्यो॒ मानु॑षो॒ न होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: pīpā́ya ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ jánāya ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ haviḥ-dé ǀhinóti ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ vidáthe ǀ saparyán ǀ sáḥ ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the productive cow,MitraandVaruṇa, furnish abundant nutriment to the pious man who presents you with oblations, as when Rātahavya, glorifying you, propitiates you in the solemnity, like the ministrant priest of a man (who instrumental tutes the rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वां॑ वि॒क्षु मद्या॒स्वन्धो॒ गाव॒ आप॑श्च पीपयन्त दे॒वीः । उ॒तो नो॑ अ॒स्य पू॒र्व्यः पति॒र्दन्वी॒तं पा॒तं पय॑स उ॒स्रिया॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vām ǀ vikṣú ǀ mádyāsu ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ca ǀ pīpayanta ǀ devī́ḥ ǀutó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ dán ǀ vītám ǀ pātám ǀ páyasaḥ ǀ usríyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine cows, and the waters, supply you with (sacrificial) food, for the prosperity of the people whom you favour; or may (Agni), the former protector of this (our patron), be the donor (of the oblation); eat (of the butter and curds), drink of the milk of the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विष्णो॒र्नु कं॑ वी॒र्या॑णि॒ प्र वो॑चं॒ यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे रजां॑सि । यो अस्क॑भाय॒दुत्त॑रं स॒धस्थं॑ विचक्रमा॒णस्त्रे॒धोरु॑गा॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: víṣṇoḥ ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ prá ǀ vocam ǀ yáḥ ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ vi-mamé ǀ rájāṃsi ǀyáḥ ǀ áskabhāyat ǀ út-taram ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ vi-cakramāṇáḥ ǀ tredhā́ ǀ uru-gāyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earnetly I glorify the exploits ofViṣṇu, who made thethree worlds; who sustained the lofty aggregate site (of the spheres); thrice traversing (the whole); who is praised by the exalted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तद्विष्णु॑: स्तवते वी॒र्ये॑ण मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः । यस्यो॒रुषु॑ त्रि॒षु वि॒क्रम॑णेष्वधिक्षि॒यन्ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tát ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ stavate ǀ vīryéṇa ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ kucaráḥ ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀyásya ǀ urúṣu ǀ triṣú ǀ vi-krámaṇeṣu ǀ adhi-kṣiyánti ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viṣṇuis therefore glorified, that by his prowess he is like a fearful, ravenous, and mountain-haunting wild beast, and because of that in his three paces all worlds abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र विष्ण॑वे शू॒षमे॑तु॒ मन्म॑ गिरि॒क्षित॑ उरुगा॒याय॒ वृष्णे॑ । य इ॒दं दी॒र्घं प्रय॑तं स॒धस्थ॒मेको॑ विम॒मे त्रि॒भिरित्प॒देभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ víṣṇave ǀ śūṣám ǀ etu ǀ mánma ǀ giri-kṣíte ǀ uru-gāyā́ya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀyáḥ ǀ idám ǀ dīrghám ǀ prá-yatam ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vi-mamé ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ít ǀ padébhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May acceptable vigour attendViṣṇu, who abides in prayer, the hymned of many, the showerer (of benefits), who alone made, by three steps, this spacious and durable aggregate (of thethree worlds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्री पू॒र्णा मधु॑ना प॒दान्यक्षी॑यमाणा स्व॒धया॒ मद॑न्ति । य उ॑ त्रि॒धातु॑ पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यामेको॑ दा॒धार॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ trī́ ǀ pūrṇā́ ǀ mádhunā ǀ padā́ni ǀ ákṣīyamāṇā ǀ svadháyā ǀ mádanti ǀyáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ ékaḥ ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose three imperishable paces, filled with ambrosia, delight (mankind) with sacred food; who verily alone upholds the three elements, and earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॑स्य प्रि॒यम॒भि पाथो॑ अश्यां॒ नरो॒ यत्र॑ देव॒यवो॒ मद॑न्ति । उ॒रु॒क्र॒मस्य॒ स हि बन्धु॑रि॒त्था विष्णो॑: प॒दे प॑र॒मे मध्व॒ उत्स॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ asya ǀ priyám ǀ abhí ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ aśyām ǀ náraḥ ǀ yátra ǀ deva-yávaḥ ǀ mádanti ǀuru-kramásya ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ bándhuḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ útsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I attain his favourite path, in which god-seeking men delight; (the path) of that wide-steppingViṣṇu, in whose exalted station there is a (perpetual) flow of felicity; for to such a degree is he the friend (of the pious).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॒ वास्तू॑न्युश्मसि॒ गम॑ध्यै॒ यत्र॒ गावो॒ भूरि॑शृङ्गा अ॒यास॑: । अत्राह॒ तदु॑रुगा॒यस्य॒ वृष्ण॑: पर॒मं प॒दमव॑ भाति॒ भूरि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ vā́stūni ǀ uśmasi ǀ gámadhyai ǀ yátra ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ bhū́ri-śṛṅgāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀátra ǀ áha ǀ tát ǀ uru-gāyásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ paramám ǀ padám ǀ áva ǀ bhāti ǀ bhū́ri ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We pary (toViṣṇu) that you may both go to those regions where the many-pointed and wide-spreading rays (of light expand); for here the supreme station of the many-hymned, the showerer (of benefits), shines (with) great (splendour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒: पान्त॒मन्ध॑सो धियाय॒ते म॒हे शूरा॑य॒ विष्ण॑वे चार्चत । या सानु॑नि॒ पर्व॑ताना॒मदा॑भ्या म॒हस्त॒स्थतु॒रर्व॑तेव सा॒धुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ pā́ntam ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ dhiyā-yaté ǀ mahé ǀ śū́rāya ǀ víṣṇave ǀ ca ǀ arcata ǀyā́ ǀ sā́nuni ǀ párvatānām ǀ ádābhyā ǀ maháḥ ǀ tasthátuḥ ǀ árvatā-iva ǀ sādhúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer your nutritious viands to the great hero, (Indra), who is plural ased by praise, and toViṣṇu, the two invincible deities who ride upon the radiant summit of the clouds as upon a well-trained steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षमि॒त्था स॒मर॑णं॒ शिमी॑वतो॒रिन्द्रा॑विष्णू सुत॒पा वा॑मुरुष्यति । या मर्त्या॑य प्रतिधी॒यमा॑न॒मित्कृ॒शानो॒रस्तु॑रस॒नामु॑रु॒ष्यथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ itthā́ ǀ sam-áraṇam ǀ śímī-vatoḥ ǀ índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ uruṣyati ǀyā́ ǀ mártyāya ǀ prati-dhīyámānam ǀ ít ǀ kṛśā́noḥ ǀ ástuḥ ǀ asanā́m ǀ uruṣyáthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, the devout worshipper glorifies the radiant approach of you two, who are the granters of desires, and who bestow upon the mortal who worships you an immediately-receivable (reward), through the distribution of that fire which is the scatterer (of desired blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता ईं॑ वर्धन्ति॒ मह्य॑स्य॒ पौंस्यं॒ नि मा॒तरा॑ नयति॒ रेत॑से भु॒जे । दधा॑ति पु॒त्रोऽव॑रं॒ परं॑ पि॒तुर्नाम॑ तृ॒तीय॒मधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ vardhanti ǀ máhi ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ ní ǀ mātárā ǀ nayati ǀ rétase ǀ bhujé ǀdádhāti ǀ putráḥ ǀ ávaram ǀ páram ǀ pitúḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ ádhi ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (oblations) augment his (Indra's), mighty manhood, by which he fits the parents (of all creatures heaven and earth), for genitive ration and enjoyment; whereby, in the upper region of the sky, the son has an inferior and superior appellation, and a third (name) of father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त॒दिद॑स्य॒ पौंस्यं॑ गृणीमसी॒नस्य॑ त्रा॒तुर॑वृ॒कस्य॑ मी॒ळ्हुष॑: । यः पार्थि॑वानि त्रि॒भिरिद्विगा॑मभिरु॒रु क्रमि॑ष्टोरुगा॒याय॑ जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát-tat ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀ inásya ǀ trātúḥ ǀ avṛkásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ít ǀ vígāma-bhiḥ ǀ urú ǀ krámiṣṭa ǀ uru-gāyā́ya ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore, verily, we celebrate the manhood of that lord (of all), the preserver, the innocuous, the vigorous who traversed the three regions with three wide steps in different directions for the many-praised (preservation of) existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वे इद॑स्य॒ क्रम॑णे स्व॒र्दृशो॑ऽभि॒ख्याय॒ मर्त्यो॑ भुरण्यति । तृ॒तीय॑मस्य॒ नकि॒रा द॑धर्षति॒ वय॑श्च॒न प॒तय॑न्तः पत॒त्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dvé íti ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ krámaṇe íti ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ abhi-khyā́ya ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ bhuraṇyati ǀtṛtī́yam ǀ asya ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣati ǀ váyaḥ ǀ caná ǀ patáyantaḥ ǀ patatríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Man glorifying (Viṣṇu), tracks two steps of that heaven-beholding (deity), but he apprehends not the third; nor can the soaring-winged birds (pursue it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒तुर्भि॑: सा॒कं न॑व॒तिं च॒ नाम॑भिश्च॒क्रं न वृ॒त्तं व्यतीँ॑रवीविपत् । बृ॒हच्छ॑रीरो वि॒मिमा॑न॒ ऋक्व॑भि॒र्युवाकु॑मार॒: प्रत्ये॑त्याह॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: catúḥ-bhiḥ ǀ sākám ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ ná ǀ vṛttám ǀ vyátīn ǀ avīvipat ǀbṛhát-śarīraḥ ǀ vi-mímānaḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ ákumāraḥ ǀ práti ǀ eti ǀ ā-havám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He causes, by his gyrations, ninety and four periodical revolutions, like a circular wheel, vast of body, and evolving in many forms, through the praises (addressed to him); ever young, though not infantine, he comes at our invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भवा॑ मि॒त्रो न शेव्यो॑ घृ॒तासु॑ति॒र्विभू॑तद्युम्न एव॒या उ॑ स॒प्रथा॑: । अधा॑ ते विष्णो वि॒दुषा॑ चि॒दर्ध्य॒: स्तोमो॑ य॒ज्ञश्च॒ राध्यो॑ ह॒विष्म॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: bháva ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ śévyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-āsutiḥ ǀ víbhūta-dyumnaḥ ǀ eva-yā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀádha ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ vidúṣā ǀ cit ǀ árdhyaḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ca ǀ rā́dhyaḥ ǀ havíṣmatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be (to us),Viṣṇu, like a friend, the giver of happiness, the acepter of oblations, abounding with food, the granter of protection, and every way accessible; on which account your praise is to be repeatedly recited by the wise, and your worship to be celebrated by the offerer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः पू॒र्व्याय॑ वे॒धसे॒ नवी॑यसे सु॒मज्जा॑नये॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ ददा॑शति । यो जा॒तम॑स्य मह॒तो महि॒ ब्रव॒त्सेदु॒ श्रवो॑भि॒र्युज्यं॑ चिद॒भ्य॑सत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀ vedháse ǀ návīyase ǀ sumát-jānaye ǀ víṣṇave ǀ dádāśati ǀyáḥ ǀ jātám ǀ asya ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ máhi ǀ brávat ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yújyam ǀ cit ǀ abhí ǀ asat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who presents (offerings) toViṣṇu, the ancient, the creator, the recent, the self-born; he who celebrates the great birth of that mighty one; he verily possessed of abundance, attains (the station) that is to be sought (by all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ स्तोतारः पू॒र्व्यं यथा॑ वि॒द ऋ॒तस्य॒ गर्भं॑ ज॒नुषा॑ पिपर्तन । आस्य॑ जा॒नन्तो॒ नाम॑ चिद्विवक्तन म॒हस्ते॑ विष्णो सुम॒तिं भ॑जामहे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stotāraḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ yáthā ǀ vidá ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gárbham ǀ janúṣā ǀ pipartana ǀā́ ǀ asya ǀ jānántaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ cit ǀ vivaktana ǀ maháḥ ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ su-matím ǀ bhajāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hymners, propitiate of your own accord that ancientViṣṇu, since you know him as the germ of sacrifice, cognizant of his greatness, celebrate his name; may we, Viṣṇu, enjoy your favour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑स्य॒ राजा॒ वरु॑ण॒स्तम॒श्विना॒ क्रतुं॑ सचन्त॒ मारु॑तस्य वे॒धस॑: । दा॒धार॒ दक्ष॑मुत्त॒मम॑ह॒र्विदं॑ व्र॒जं च॒ विष्णु॒: सखि॑वाँ अपोर्णु॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ asya ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ tám ǀ aśvínā ǀ krátum ǀ sacanta ǀ mā́rutasya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀdādhā́ra ǀ dákṣam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ ahaḥ-vídam ǀ vrajám ǀ ca ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ sákhi-vān ǀ apa-ūrṇuté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The royalVaruṇaassociates (himself) with the sacrifice of the pious worshipper, assisted by the company of the priests; theAśvins(unite with it);Viṣṇu, with his friend (Indra), possesses supreme heaven-conferring power, and sits upon the clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो वि॒वाय॑ स॒चथा॑य॒ दैव्य॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ विष्णु॑: सु॒कृते॑ सु॒कृत्त॑रः । वे॒धा अ॑जिन्वत्त्रिषध॒स्थ आर्य॑मृ॒तस्य॑ भा॒गे यज॑मान॒माभ॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vivā́ya ǀ sacáthāya ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ sukṛ́t-taraḥ ǀvedhā́ḥ ǀ ajinvat ǀ tri-sadhastháḥ ǀ ā́ryam ǀ ṛtásya ǀ bhāgé ǀ yájamānam ǀ ā́ ǀ abhajat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineViṣṇu, the best of the doers of good deeds, who came to the pious instrumental tutor of the rite, to assist (at its celebration), knowing (the desire of the worshipper), and present at the three connected periods (of worship), shows favour to teArya, and admits the author if the ceremony to a share of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अबो॑ध्य॒ग्निर्ज्म उदे॑ति॒ सूर्यो॒ व्यु१॒॑षाश्च॒न्द्रा म॒ह्या॑वो अ॒र्चिषा॑ । आयु॑क्षाताम॒श्विना॒ यात॑वे॒ रथं॒ प्रासा॑वीद्दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता जग॒त्पृथ॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: ábodhi ǀ agníḥ ǀ jmáḥ ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ candrā́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ arcíṣā ǀáyukṣātām ǀ aśvínā ǀ yā́tave ǀ rátham ǀ prá ǀ asāvīt ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ jágat ǀ pṛ́thak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis awakened upon earth; the Sun rises; the spreading dawn, exhilarating (all) by her radiance, has dispersed (the darkness); harness, (therefore),Aśvinsyour chariot, to come (to the sacrifice), that the divineSavitāmay animate allbeings to (the performance of) their several (duties).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्यु॒ञ्जाथे॒ वृष॑णमश्विना॒ रथं॑ घृ॒तेन॑ नो॒ मधु॑ना क्ष॒त्रमु॑क्षतम् । अ॒स्माकं॒ ब्रह्म॒ पृत॑नासु जिन्वतं व॒यं धना॒ शूर॑साता भजेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ yuñjā́the íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ aśvinā ǀ rátham ǀ ghṛténa ǀ naḥ ǀ mádhunā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ukṣatam ǀasmā́kam ǀ bráhma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ jinvatam ǀ vayám ǀ dhánā ǀ śū́ra-sātā ǀ bhajemahi ǁ
