shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ etám ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ síndhuṣu ǀ plavám ǀ ātman-vántam ǀ pakṣíṇam ǀ taugryā́ya ǀ kám ǀyéna ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ niḥ-ūháthuḥ ǀ su-paptaní ǀ petathuḥ ǀ kṣódasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You constructed a plural asant, substantial winged bark, borne on the ocean waters for the son ofTugra, by which, with minddevoted to the gods, you bore him up, and quickly descending (from the sky), you made a path for him across the great waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑विद्धं तौ॒ग्र्यम॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर॑नारम्भ॒णे तम॑सि॒ प्रवि॑द्धम् । चत॑स्रो॒ नावो॒ जठ॑लस्य॒ जुष्टा॒ उद॒श्विभ्या॑मिषि॒ताः पा॑रयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: áva-viddham ǀ taugryám ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ anārambhaṇé ǀ támasi ǀ prá-viddham ǀcátasraḥ ǀ nā́vaḥ ǀ jáṭhalasya ǀ júṣṭāḥ ǀ út ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ iṣitā́ḥ ǀ pārayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Four ships launched into the midst of the receptable (of the waters), sent by theAśvins, brought safe to shore the son ofTugra, who had been cast headlong into the waters (by his foes), and plural nged in extricable darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कः स्वि॑द्वृ॒क्षो निःष्ठि॑तो॒ मध्ये॒ अर्ण॑सो॒ यं तौ॒ग्र्यो ना॑धि॒तः प॒र्यष॑स्वजत् । प॒र्णा मृ॒गस्य॑ प॒तरो॑रिवा॒रभ॒ उद॑श्विना ऊहथु॒: श्रोम॑ताय॒ कम्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ svit ǀ vṛkṣáḥ ǀ níḥ-sthitaḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ árṇasaḥ ǀ yám ǀ taugryáḥ ǀ nādhitáḥ ǀ pari-ásasvajat ǀparṇā́ ǀ mṛgásya ǀ patároḥ-iva ǀ ā-rábhe ǀ út ǀ aśvinā ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ śrómatāya ǀ kám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What was the tree that was stationed in the midst of the ocean, to which the supplicating son ofTugraclung; as leaves (are caught hold of) for the support of a falling animal; you,Aśvins, bore him up to safety, to your great renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वां॑ नरा नासत्या॒वनु॑ ष्या॒द्यद्वां॒ माना॑स उ॒चथ॒मवो॑चन् । अ॒स्माद॒द्य सद॑सः सो॒म्यादा वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ nāsatyau ǀ ánu ǀ syāt ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ mā́nāsaḥ ǀ ucátham ǀ ávocan ǀasmā́t ǀ adyá ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ somyā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praise which your devout adorers have uttered be acceptable to you,Nāsatyas, leaders (in pious rites); be propitiated today by the libations of our assembly, that we may obtain food, strength and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं यु॑ञ्जाथां॒ मन॑सो॒ यो जवी॑यान्त्रिवन्धु॒रो वृ॑षणा॒ यस्त्रि॑च॒क्रः । येनो॑पया॒थः सु॒कृतो॑ दुरो॒णं त्रि॒धातु॑ना पतथो॒ विर्न प॒र्णैः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ yuñjāthām ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ yáḥ ǀ tri-cakráḥ ǀyéna ǀ upa-yātháḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ duroṇám ǀ tri-dhā́tunā ǀ patathaḥ ǀ víḥ ǀ ná ǀ parṇáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerers of benefits, harness the car which has three benches, three wheels, and is as quick as thought; with which, embellished with three metals, you come to the dwelling of the pious (worshipper), and in which you travel like a bird with wings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वृद्रथो॑ वर्तते॒ यन्न॒भि क्षां यत्तिष्ठ॑थ॒: क्रतु॑म॒न्तानु॑ पृ॒क्षे । वपु॑र्वपु॒ष्या स॑चतामि॒यं गीर्दि॒वो दु॑हि॒त्रोषसा॑ सचेथे
shlokas.transliteration: su-vṛ́t ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vartate ǀ yán ǀ abhí ǀ kṣā́m ǀ yát ǀ tíṣṭhathaḥ ǀ krátu-mantā ǀ ánu ǀ pṛkṣé ǀvápuḥ ǀ vapuṣyā́ ǀ sacatām ǀ iyám ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitrā́ ǀ uṣásā ǀ sacethe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your easy-rolling car alights upon the earth, where favourable to the sacred rite, you stop for the sake of the (sacrificial) food; may this hymn, promotive of your person nal (welfare), be associated with your forms, and do you unite with the dawn, the daughter of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ति॑ष्ठतं सु॒वृतं॒ यो रथो॑ वा॒मनु॑ व्र॒तानि॒ वर्त॑ते ह॒विष्मा॑न् । येन॑ नरा नासत्येष॒यध्यै॑ व॒र्तिर्या॒थस्तन॑याय॒ त्मने॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tiṣṭhatam ǀ su-vṛ́tam ǀ yáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vām ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ni ǀ vártate ǀ havíṣmān ǀyéna ǀ narā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ iṣayádhyai ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātháḥ ǀ tánayāya ǀ tmáne ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ascend your rolling car, which approaches the sacred rite of the offerer of the oblation; the car in which,Nāsatyas, leaders, you purpose to come to the sacrifice, and proceed to the dwelling (of the worshipper), for (bestowing upon him) offspring, and for his own (good).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा वां॒ वृको॒ मा वृ॒कीरा द॑धर्षी॒न्मा परि॑ वर्क्तमु॒त माति॑ धक्तम् । अ॒यं वां॑ भा॒गो निहि॑त इ॒यं गीर्दस्रा॑वि॒मे वां॑ नि॒धयो॒ मधू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vām ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ vṛkī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣīt ǀ mā́ ǀ pári ǀ varktam ǀ utá ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhaktam ǀayám ǀ vām ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ dásrau ǀ imé ǀ vām ǀ ni-dháyaḥ ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the wolf, let not the she-wolf, harm me safe (in your protection); abandon me not, nor deliver me (to another). This your share (of the offering) is prepared; this prayer,Dasras, (is addressed) to you; these treasures ofSomaare for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां गोत॑मः पुरुमी॒ळ्हो अत्रि॒र्दस्रा॒ हव॒तेऽव॑से ह॒विष्मा॑न् । दिशं॒ न दि॒ष्टामृ॑जू॒येव॒ यन्ता मे॒ हवं॑ नास॒त्योप॑ यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ gótamaḥ ǀ puru-mīḷháḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ dásrā ǀ hávate ǀ ávase ǀ havíṣmān ǀdíśam ǀ ná ǀ diṣṭā́m ǀ ṛjuyā́-iva ǀ yántā ǀ ā́ ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gotama, Purimiḷha,Atri, (each) offering oblations, invokes you for his protection; like unto a wayfarer, who (makes for his intended direction) by a straight (path) do you,Dasras, come (direct) to my invocation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अता॑रिष्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्य प्रति॑ वां॒ स्तोमो॑ अश्विनावधायि । एह या॑तं प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑र्वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ práti ǀ vām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ adhāyi ǀā́ ǀ ihá ǀ yātam ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Through your aid)Aśvins, we cross over this (limit of) darkness; to you this (our) hymn has been addressed; come hither by the paths traversed by the gods, that we may obtain food, and strength, and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वा॑म॒द्य ताव॑प॒रं हु॑वेमो॒च्छन्त्या॑मु॒षसि॒ वह्नि॑रु॒क्थैः । नास॑त्या॒ कुह॑ चि॒त्सन्ता॑व॒र्यो दि॒वो नपा॑ता सु॒दास्त॑राय
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ táu ǀ aparám ǀ huvema ǀ ucchántyām ǀ uṣási ǀ váhniḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀnā́satyā ǀ kúha ǀ cit ǀ sántau ǀ aryáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nápātā ǀ sudā́ḥ-tarāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you two, (Aśvins), today; the same two on any other day; when the morning dawns.Nāsatyas, grandsons of heaven, wherever you may be, the pious reciter (of the hymn) invokes you with praises on behalf of the liberal donor (of the offering).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे ऊ॒ षु वृ॑षणा मादयेथा॒मुत्प॒णीँर्ह॑तमू॒र्म्या मद॑न्ता । श्रु॒तं मे॒ अच्छो॑क्तिभिर्मती॒नामेष्टा॑ नरा॒ निचे॑तारा च॒ कर्णै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ mādayethām ǀ út ǀ paṇī́n ǀ hatam ǀ ūrmyā́ ǀ mádantā ǀśrutám ǀ me ǀ ácchokti-bhiḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ éṣṭā ǀ narā ǀ ní-cetārā ǀ ca ǀ kárṇaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerers (of benefits), rejoicing in (our) libations), make us happy, and destroy the niggard (withholder) of offerings; hear, leaders, with your ears, my praises addressed to you with pure words, for you are seekers (after praise), you are retentive (of laudation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒ये पू॑षन्निषु॒कृते॑व दे॒वा नास॑त्या वह॒तुं सू॒र्याया॑: । व॒च्यन्ते॑ वां ककु॒हा अ॒प्सु जा॒ता यु॒गा जू॒र्णेव॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ भूरे॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śriyé ǀ pūṣan ǀ iṣukṛ́tā-iva ǀ devā́ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vahatúm ǀ sūryā́yāḥ ǀvacyánte ǀ vām ǀ kakuhā́ḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ yugā́ ǀ jūrṇā́-iva ǀ váruṇasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAśvins, in whom is no untruth, (darting) like arrows to acquire glory, and to carry offSūrya, to you are addressed the prayers that are recited at holy rites, for (the completion of) the uninterrupted, sin-removing (sacrifice), as ancient ages (offered them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे सा वां॑ माध्वी रा॒तिर॑स्तु॒ स्तोमं॑ हिनोतं मा॒न्यस्य॑ का॒रोः । अनु॒ यद्वां॑ श्रव॒स्या॑ सुदानू सु॒वीर्या॑य चर्ष॒णयो॒ मद॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ sā́ ǀ vām ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ rātíḥ ǀ astu ǀ stómam ǀ hinotam ǀ mānyásya ǀ kāróḥ ǀánu ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀ su-vī́ryāya ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ mádanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Receivers of the oblation, may your liberality be displayed towards us; be plural ased with the hymn of the venerable author, so that men may honour the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, as (they honour) you, liberal donors, for the sake of renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वां॒ स्तोमो॑ अश्विनावकारि॒ माने॑भिर्मघवाना सुवृ॒क्ति । या॒तं व॒र्तिस्तन॑याय॒ त्मने॑ चा॒गस्त्ये॑ नासत्या॒ मद॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ akāri ǀ mā́nebhiḥ ǀ magha-vānā ǀ su-vṛktí ǀyātám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ tánayāya ǀ tmáne ǀ ca ǀ agástye ǀ nāsatyā ǀ mádantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, possessors of wealth, this sin-removing hymn has been addressed to you, together with respectful (oblations);Nāsatyasbe favourable toAgastya; come to his dwelling for (conferring on him) progeny, and for his own (good).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अता॑रिष्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्य प्रति॑ वां॒ स्तोमो॑ अश्विनावधायि । एह या॑तं प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑र्वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ práti ǀ vām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ adhāyi ǀā́ ǀ ihá ǀ yātam ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Through your aid),Aśvins, we cross over the limit of darkness; to you this (our hymn) has been addressed; come hither by the path traversed by thd gods, thatwe may obtain food, strength and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒त॒रा पूर्वा॑ कत॒राप॑रा॒योः क॒था जा॒ते क॑वय॒: को वि वे॑द । विश्वं॒ त्मना॑ बिभृतो॒ यद्ध॒ नाम॒ वि व॑र्तेते॒ अह॑नी च॒क्रिये॑व
shlokas.transliteration: katarā́ ǀ pū́rvā ǀ katarā́ ǀ áparā ǀ ayóḥ ǀ kathā́ ǀ jāté íti ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ ví ǀ veda ǀvíśvam ǀ tmánā ǀ bibhṛtaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ nā́ma ǀ ví ǀ vartete íti ǀ áhanī íti ǀ cakríyā-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which of these two, (Heaven and Earth), is prior which posterior; how were they engendered; (declare), sages, who knows this? verily, you uphold the universe of itself, and the days (and nights) revolve as if they had wheels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरिं॒ द्वे अच॑रन्ती॒ चर॑न्तं प॒द्वन्तं॒ गर्भ॑म॒पदी॑ दधाते । नित्यं॒ न सू॒नुं पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́rim ǀ dvé íti ǀ ácarantī íti ǀ cárantam ǀ pat-vántam ǀ gárbham ǀ apádī íti ǀ dadhāte íti ǀnítyam ǀ ná ǀ sūnúm ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Footless and motionless, they sustain numerous moving and footed races, as a son is even (nursed) on the lap of his parents; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ने॒हो दा॒त्रमदि॑तेरन॒र्वं हु॒वे स्व॑र्वदव॒धं नम॑स्वत् । तद्रो॑दसी जनयतं जरि॒त्रे द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: aneháḥ ǀ dātrám ǀ áditeḥ ǀ anarvám ǀ huvé ǀ sváḥ-vat ǀ avadhám ǀ námasvat ǀtát ǀ rodasī íti ǀ janayatam ǀ jaritré ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I solicit ofAditi, wealth, without pain or decay, like heaven (in fullness of enjoyment), exempt from injury, and abounding in food; grant, Heaven and Earth, such wealth to him who praises you; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑प्यमाने॒ अव॒साव॑न्ती॒ अनु॑ ष्याम॒ रोद॑सी दे॒वपु॑त्रे । उ॒भे दे॒वाना॑मु॒भये॑भि॒रह्नां॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: átapyamāne íti ǀ ávasā ǀ ávantī íti ǀ ánu ǀ syāma ǀ ródasī íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀubhé íti ǀ devā́nām ǀ ubháyebhiḥ ǀ áhnām ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we ever be (devoted to) that Heaven and Earth, who are not subject to annoyance, who satisfy (all beings) with food, who have the gods (and men) for sons, and who are both endowed with the double (condition) of the divine days (and nights); defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great (danger).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं॒गच्छ॑माने युव॒ती सम॑न्ते॒ स्वसा॑रा जा॒मी पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॑ । अ॒भि॒जिघ्र॑न्ती॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ नाभिं॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: saṃgácchamāne íti sam-gácchamāne ǀ yuvatī́ íti ǀ sámante íti sám-ante ǀ svásārā ǀ jāmī́ íti ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀabhijíghrantī ítyabhi-jíghrantī ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ nā́bhim ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Going always together, equally young, and of the like termination, sisters, and kindred, and scenting the navel of the world, plural ced on their lap as its parents; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒र्वी सद्म॑नी बृह॒ती ऋ॒तेन॑ हु॒वे दे॒वाना॒मव॑सा॒ जनि॑त्री । द॒धाते॒ ये अ॒मृतं॑ सु॒प्रती॑के॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: urvī́ íti ǀ sádmanī íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ ṛténa ǀ huvé ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávasā ǀ jánitrī íti ǀdadhā́te íti ǀ yé íti ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ suprátīke íti su-prátīke ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke to the sacrifice, for the preservation of gods (and men), the two vast, all-supporting, and mighty parents (of the rain and corn); who, beautiful in form, sustain ambrosial (showers); defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒र्वी पृ॒थ्वी ब॑हु॒ले दू॒रेअ॑न्ते॒ उप॑ ब्रुवे॒ नम॑सा य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन् । द॒धाते॒ ये सु॒भगे॑ सु॒प्रतू॑र्ती॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: urvī́ íti ǀ pṛthvī́ íti ǀ bahulé íti ǀ dūréante íti dūré-ante ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ námasā ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀdadhā́te íti ǀ yé íti ǀ subháge íti su-bháge ǀ suprátūrtī íti su-prátūrtī ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with reverence, at this sacrifice, (the two), who are vast, expansive, multiform, infinite, auspicious;who support (all beings) by their bounty; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वान्वा॒ यच्च॑कृ॒मा कच्चि॒दाग॒: सखा॑यं वा॒ सद॒मिज्जास्प॑तिं वा । इ॒यं धीर्भू॑या अव॒यान॑मेषां॒ द्यावा॒ रक्ष॑तं पृथिवी नो॒ अभ्वा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: devā́n ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ cakṛmá ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ vā ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ jā́ḥ-patim ǀ vā ǀiyám ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ bhūyāḥ ǀ ava-yā́nam ǀ eṣām ǀ dyā́vā ǀ rákṣatam ǀ pṛthivī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhvāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this sacrifice be the means of expiating those offences which we may have committed against the gods, against a friend at any time, against a son-in-law; defend us, Heaven and Earth, from great danger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा शंसा॒ नर्या॒ माम॑विष्टामु॒भे मामू॒ती अव॑सा सचेताम् । भूरि॑ चिद॒र्यः सु॒दास्त॑राये॒षा मद॑न्त इषयेम देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ śáṃsā ǀ náryā ǀ mā́m ǀ aviṣṭām ǀ ubhé íti ǀ mā́m ǀ ūtī́ íti ǀ ávasā ǀ sacetām ǀbhū́ri ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sudā́ḥ-tarāya ǀ iṣā́ ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ iṣayema ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May both these, accepting praise, and friendly to man, be favourable to me; may they both be associated as guardians for my protection; deities, we your adorers, propitiating you with (sacrificial) food, desire ample (wealth), for the sake of makign liberal donations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं दि॒वे तद॑वोचं पृथि॒व्या अ॑भिश्रा॒वाय॑ प्रथ॒मं सु॑मे॒धाः । पा॒ताम॑व॒द्याद्दु॑रि॒ताद॒भीके॑ पि॒ता मा॒ता च॑ रक्षता॒मवो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ divé ǀ tát ǀ avocam ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ abhi-śrāvā́ya ǀ prathamám ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀpātā́m ǀ avadyā́t ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ abhī́ke ǀ pitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ ca ǀ rakṣatām ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with understanding, I repeat to Heaven and Earth this initial praise, to be heard around; may paternal (heaven) and maternal (earth) preserve us from reprehensible iniquity; and ever nigh defend us with their protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं द्या॑वापृथिवी स॒त्यम॑स्तु॒ पित॒र्मात॒र्यदि॒होप॑ब्रु॒वे वा॑म् । भू॒तं दे॒वाना॑मव॒मे अवो॑भिर्वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ satyám ǀ astu ǀ pítaḥ ǀ mā́taḥ ǀ yát ǀ ihá ǀ upa-bruvé ǀ vām ǀbhūtám ǀ devā́nām ǀ avamé íti ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this (hymn), Heaven and Earth,be successful; (the hymn) which, Father and Mother, I repeat to you both on this occasion; be ever with your protection in the proximity of those who praise you; that we may obtain food, strength, and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒ इळा॑भिर्वि॒दथे॑ सुश॒स्ति वि॒श्वान॑रः सवि॒ता दे॒व ए॑तु । अपि॒ यथा॑ युवानो॒ मत्स॑था नो॒ विश्वं॒ जग॑दभिपि॒त्वे म॑नी॒षा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-śastí ǀ viśvā́naraḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ etu ǀápi ǀ yáthā ǀ yuvānaḥ ǀ mátsatha ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ jágat ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ manīṣā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineSavitā, the benefactor of all men, come benignantly to our solemnity, together with the divinities of earth, and do you, who are (always) young, willingly present at our sacrifice, exhilarate us, as (you exhilarate) the whole world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्व॒ आस्क्रा॑ गमन्तु दे॒वा मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णः स॒जोषा॑: । भुव॒न्यथा॑ नो॒ विश्वे॑ वृ॒धास॒: कर॑न्त्सु॒षाहा॑ विथु॒रं न शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ā́skrāḥ ǀ gamantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀbhúvan ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ vṛdhā́saḥ ǀ káran ǀ su-sáhā ǀ vithurám ǀ ná ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all the triumphant gods,Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaequally well plural ased, come (to our rite); may they all be propitious to us; may they not leave us in want of food, after overcoming (our foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं॑ वो॒ अति॑थिं गृणीषे॒ऽग्निं श॒स्तिभि॑स्तु॒र्वणि॑: स॒जोषा॑: । अस॒द्यथा॑ नो॒ वरु॑णः सुकी॒र्तिरिष॑श्च पर्षदरिगू॒र्तः सू॒रिः
shlokas.transliteration: préṣṭham ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ agním ǀ śastí-bhiḥ ǀ turváṇiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀásat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ su-kīrtíḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀ parṣat ǀ ari-gūrtáḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise with hymns, (O gods), your best beloved guest,Agni, who is prompt (to partake of the oblation) and who is well plural ased along (with you); so that (thereby)Varuṇa, the possessor of renown, the subduer of foes, the animator (of men), may fill us with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ व॒ एषे॒ नम॑सा जिगी॒षोषासा॒नक्ता॑ सु॒दुघे॑व धे॒नुः । स॒मा॒ने अह॑न्वि॒मिमा॑नो अ॒र्कं विषु॑रूपे॒ पय॑सि॒ सस्मि॒न्नूध॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣe ǀ námasā ǀ jigīṣā́ ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ sudúghā-iva ǀ dhenúḥ ǀsamāné ǀ áhan ǀ vi-mímānaḥ ǀ arkám ǀ víṣu-rūpe ǀ páyasi ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I approach you, (deities), with reverence, night and day, in the hope of overcoming (sin), as (willingly), as a genitive tle cow (comes to be milked), mixing (for you) on the appropriate day the (sacrificial) food, (consisting) of multiform (preparations) of milk (genitive rated) from the same udder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॒३॒॑ मय॑स्क॒: शिशुं॒ न पि॒प्युषी॑व वेति॒ सिन्धु॑: । येन॒ नपा॑तम॒पां जु॒नाम॑ मनो॒जुवो॒ वृष॑णो॒ यं वह॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ pipyúṣī-iva ǀ veti ǀ síndhuḥ ǀyéna ǀ nápātam ǀ apā́m ǀ junā́ma ǀ manaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ yám ǀ váhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May,Ahirbudhnyagrant us happiness; maySindhucome, nourishing us as a (cow her) calf, whereby we may propitiate the grandson of the waters, (Agni), whom the clouds, swift as thought, convey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑ ईं॒ त्वष्टा ग॒न्त्वच्छा॒ स्मत्सू॒रिभि॑रभिपि॒त्वे स॒जोषा॑: । आ वृ॑त्र॒हेन्द्र॑श्चर्षणि॒प्रास्तु॒विष्ट॑मो न॒रां न॑ इ॒ह ग॑म्याः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ īm ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ā́ ǀ gantu ǀ áccha ǀ smát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀā́ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǀ tuvíḥ-tamaḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ ihá ǀ gámyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or mayTvaṣṭācome to this sacrifice, equally well plural ased with those who praise (him) at the excellent (rite) at which he is present; may the most potentIndra, the protector of man, the destroyer ofVṛtra, come to the (solemnity) of our leaders.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑ ईं म॒तयोऽश्व॑योगा॒: शिशुं॒ न गाव॒स्तरु॑णं रिहन्ति । तमीं॒ गिरो॒ जन॑यो॒ न पत्नी॑: सुर॒भिष्ट॑मं न॒रां न॑सन्त
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ īm ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ áśva-yogāḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ táruṇam ǀ rihanti ǀtám ǀ īm ǀ gíraḥ ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ surabhíḥ-tamam ǀ narā́m ǀ nasanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For our minds, yoked together like horses tend to the ever youthfulIndra, as cows to their calves; and the praises of men, (addressed) to him, are genitive rating most fragrant (fruit), as wives bear (children to their husbands).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑ ईं म॒रुतो॑ वृ॒द्धसे॑ना॒: स्मद्रोद॑सी॒ सम॑नसः सदन्तु । पृष॑दश्वासो॒ऽवन॑यो॒ न रथा॑ रि॒शाद॑सो मित्र॒युजो॒ न दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ īm ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vṛddhá-senāḥ ǀ smát ǀ ródasī íti ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ sadantu ǀpṛ́ṣat-aśvāsaḥ ǀ avánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀ mitra-yújaḥ ǀ ná ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may theMaruts, being of one mind, come from heaven and earth (to the sacrifice); they who are a mighty host, who have parti-coloured steeds, who are like protecting chariots, and who are devourers of foes may they come like friendly deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नु यदे॑षां महि॒ना चि॑कि॒त्रे प्र यु॑ञ्जते प्र॒युज॒स्ते सु॑वृ॒क्ति । अध॒ यदे॑षां सु॒दिने॒ न शरु॒र्विश्व॒मेरि॑णं प्रुषा॒यन्त॒ सेना॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ yát ǀ eṣām ǀ mahinā́ ǀ cikitré ǀ prá ǀ yuñjate ǀ pra-yújaḥ ǀ té ǀ su-vṛktí ǀádha ǀ yát ǀ eṣām ǀ su-díne ǀ ná ǀ śáruḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ íriṇam ǀ pruṣāyánta ǀ sénāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For, verily, their greatness is well known, (as) they diligently discharge their functions; by which their spot pours rain upon every arid soil, as light spreads (universally) on a fine day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो अ॒श्विना॒वव॑से कृणुध्वं॒ प्र पू॒षणं॒ स्वत॑वसो॒ हि सन्ति॑ । अ॒द्वे॒षो विष्णु॒र्वात॑ ऋभु॒क्षा अच्छा॑ सु॒म्नाय॑ ववृतीय दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ aśvínau ǀ ávase ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ svá-tavasaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sánti ǀadveṣáḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ áccha ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ vavṛtīya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiate theAśvinsandPūṣan, for my protection; (propitiate) those (deities), who are of independent powers, asViṣṇu, devoid of hatred,VāyuandṚbhukṣin, and may I influence the gods to be present for my felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं सा वो॑ अ॒स्मे दीधि॑तिर्यजत्रा अपि॒प्राणी॑ च॒ सद॑नी च भूयाः । नि या दे॒वेषु॒ यत॑ते वसू॒युर्वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ sā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ dī́dhitiḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ api-prā́ṇī ǀ ca ǀ sádanī ǀ ca ǀ bhūyāḥ ǀní ǀ yā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yátate ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Objects of admiration, may that wealth-abounding effulgence which manifests itself amongst the gods, give animation to our existence, and (permanence to) our dwellings; that we may (thence) obtain food, strength, and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुं नु स्तो॑षं म॒हो ध॒र्माणं॒ तवि॑षीम् । यस्य॑ त्रि॒तो व्योज॑सा वृ॒त्रं विप॑र्वम॒र्दय॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: pitúm ǀ nú ǀ stoṣam ǀ maháḥ ǀ dharmā́ṇam ǀ táviṣīm ǀyásya ǀ tritáḥ ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ví-parvam ǀ ardáyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify Pitu, the great, the upholder, the strong, by whose invigorating powerTritaslew themutilatedVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वादो॑ पितो॒ मधो॑ पितो व॒यं त्वा॑ ववृमहे । अ॒स्माक॑मवि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: svā́do íti ǀ pito íti ǀ mádho íti ǀ pito íti ǀ vayám ǀ tvā ǀ vavṛmahe ǀasmā́kam ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SavouryPitā; sweet pitā; we worship you; become our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नः पित॒वा च॑र शि॒वः शि॒वाभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । म॒यो॒भुर॑द्विषे॒ण्यः सखा॑ सु॒शेवो॒ अद्व॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ pito íti ǀ ā́ ǀ cara ǀ śiváḥ ǀ śivā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmayaḥ-bhúḥ ǀ adviṣeṇyáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ ádvayāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Pitā, auspicious with auspicious aids; a source of delight;not unpalatable; a friend well respected, and having none (but agreeable properties).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये पि॑तो॒ रसा॒ रजां॒स्यनु॒ विष्ठि॑ताः । दि॒वि वाता॑ इव श्रि॒ताः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ pito íti ǀ rásāḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ ánu ǀ ví-sthitāḥ ǀdiví ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ śritā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your flavours,Pitā, are diffused through the regions, as the winds are spread through the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये पि॑तो॒ दद॑त॒स्तव॑ स्वादिष्ठ॒ ते पि॑तो । प्र स्वा॒द्मानो॒ रसा॑नां तुवि॒ग्रीवा॑ इवेरते
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ pito íti ǀ dádataḥ ǀ táva ǀ svādiṣṭha ǀ té ǀ pito íti ǀprá ǀ svādmā́naḥ ǀ rásānām ǀ tuvigrī́vāḥ-iva ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (men),Pitā, (are the enjoyers of your bounty), who are your distributors, most sweet Pitā, (to others); they who are the relishers of your flavours, are as if they had stiff necks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे पि॑तो म॒हानां॑ दे॒वानां॒ मनो॑ हि॒तम् । अका॑रि॒ चारु॑ के॒तुना॒ तवाहि॒मव॑सावधीत्
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ pito íti ǀ mahā́nām ǀ devā́nām ǀ mánaḥ ǀ hitám ǀákāri ǀ cā́ru ǀ ketúnā ǀ táva ǀ áhim ǀ ávasā ǀ avadhīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The thoughts of the mighty gods are fixed,Pitā, upon you; by your kind and intelligent assistance, (Indra) slew Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒दो पि॑तो॒ अज॑गन्वि॒वस्व॒ पर्व॑तानाम् । अत्रा॑ चिन्नो मधो पि॒तोऽरं॑ भ॒क्षाय॑ गम्याः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adáḥ ǀ pito íti ǀ ájagan ǀ vivásva ǀ párvatānām ǀátra ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ madho íti ǀ pito íti ǀ áram ǀ bhakṣā́ya ǀ gamyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Pitā, this (product) of the water-wealthy clouds, (the rain), arrives; then do you, sweet Pitā, be athandwith sufficiency for our eating.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒पामोष॑धीनां परिं॒शमा॑रि॒शाम॑हे । वाता॑पे॒ पीव॒ इद्भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ apā́m ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ pariṃśám ǀ ā-riśā́mahe ǀvā́tāpe ǀ pī́vaḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And since we enjoy the abundance of the waters and the plural nts; therefore, Body, do you grow fat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ सोम॒ गवा॑शिरो॒ यवा॑शिरो॒ भजा॑महे । वाता॑पे॒ पीव॒ इद्भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ soma ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǀ yáva-āśiraḥ ǀ bhájāmahe ǀvā́tāpe ǀ pī́vaḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And since we enjoy,Soma, your mixture with boiled milk or boiled barley; therefore, Body, do you grow fat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒र॒म्भ ओ॑षधे भव॒ पीवो॑ वृ॒क्क उ॑दार॒थिः । वाता॑पे॒ पीव॒ इद्भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: karambháḥ ǀ oṣadhe ǀ bhava ǀ pī́vaḥ ǀ vṛkkáḥ ǀ udārathíḥ ǀvā́tāpe ǀ pī́vaḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vegetable cake of fried meal, do you be substantial, wholesome, and invigorating; and, Body, do you grow fat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं पि॑तो॒ वचो॑भि॒र्गावो॒ न ह॒व्या सु॑षूदिम । दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा सध॒माद॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ त्वा सध॒माद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ pito íti ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ havyā́ ǀ susūdima ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǀ asmábhyam ǀ tvā ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We extract from you,Pitā, by our praises, (the sacrificial food), as cows yield butter for oblation; from you, who are exhilarating to the gods; exhilarating also to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अ॒द्य रा॑जसि दे॒वो दे॒वैः स॑हस्रजित् । दू॒तो ह॒व्या क॒विर्व॑ह
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ rājasi ǀ deváḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sahasra-jit ǀdūtáḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You shine today, divine conqueror of thousands, kindled by the priests; do you, who are the sapient messenger (of the gods), convey (to them) our oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तनू॑नपादृ॒तं य॒ते मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञः सम॑ज्यते । दध॑त्सह॒स्रिणी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tánū-napāt ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀ mádhvā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajyate ǀdádhat ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableTanūnapātproceeds to the rite and combines with the oblation, bearing (for the sacrificer) infinite (abundance of) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒जुह्वा॑नो न॒ ईड्यो॑ दे॒वाँ आ व॑क्षि य॒ज्ञिया॑न् । अग्ने॑ सहस्र॒सा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: ā-júhvānaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ yajñíyān ǀágne ǀ sahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are to be glorified, bring hither, being invoked by us, the adorable gods, for you are the donor of thousands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒चीनं॑ ब॒र्हिरोज॑सा स॒हस्र॑वीरमस्तृणन् । यत्रा॑दित्या वि॒राज॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: prācī́nam ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ sahásra-vīram ǀ astṛṇan ǀyátra ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ vi-rā́jatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the power (of their prayers) they have strewn the sacred grass, the seat of numerous heroes, pointing to the east; on which,Ādityas, you are manifest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒राट् स॒म्राड्वि॒भ्वीः प्र॒भ्वीर्ब॒ह्वीश्च॒ भूय॑सीश्च॒ याः । दुरो॑ घृ॒तान्य॑क्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: vi-rā́ṭ ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ vi-bhvī́ḥ ǀ pra-bhvī́ḥ ǀ bahvī́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ bhū́yasīḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀdúraḥ ǀ ghṛtā́ni ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have sprinkled water on the doors (of the hall of sacrifice), which are variously and perfectly radiant, manifold, excellent, many, and numerous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒रु॒क्मे हि सु॒पेश॒साधि॑ श्रि॒या वि॒राज॑तः । उ॒षासा॒वेह सी॑दताम्
shlokas.transliteration: surukmé íti su-rukmé ǀ hí ǀ su-péśasā ǀ ádhi ǀ śriyā́ ǀ vi-rā́jataḥ ǀuṣásau ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ sīdatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the brilliant and beautiful Day and Night, who shine with surpassing lustre, sit down here (upon the sacred grass).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒मा हि सु॒वाच॑सा॒ होता॑रा॒ दैव्या॑ क॒वी । य॒ज्ञं नो॑ यक्षतामि॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: prathamā́ ǀ hí ǀ su-vā́casā ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ kavī́ íti ǀyajñám ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣatām ǀ imám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let these two chief, well-spoken, divine sages, the invokers (of the gods), perform this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भार॒तीळे॒ सर॑स्वति॒ या व॒: सर्वा॑ उपब्रु॒वे । ता न॑श्चोदयत श्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: bhā́rati ǀ íḷe ǀ sárasvati ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ upa-bruvé ǀtā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ codayata ǀ śriyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bhāratī, Iḷā,Sarasvatī, I invoke you all, that you may direct us to prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ हि प्र॒भुः प॒शून्विश्वा॑न्त्समान॒जे । तेषां॑ नः स्फा॒तिमा य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ hí ǀ pra-bhúḥ ǀ paśū́n ǀ víśvān ǀ sam-ānajé ǀtéṣām ǀ naḥ ǀ sphātím ǀ ā́ ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tvaṣṭā, who is the master (in fashioning) the forms (of beings), has made all animals distinct; grant us, (Tvaṣṭa), their increase.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ त्मन्या॑ वनस्पते॒ पाथो॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑: सृज । अ॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यानि॑ सिष्वदत्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tmányā ǀ vanaspate ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sṛja ǀagníḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ sisvadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, deliver of yourself the victim to the gods, so thatAgnimay taste the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒गा अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वानां॑ गाय॒त्रेण॒ सम॑ज्यते । स्वाहा॑कृतीषु रोचते
shlokas.transliteration: puraḥ-gā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ gāyatréṇa ǀ sám ǀ ajyate ǀsvā́hā-kṛtīṣu ǀ rocate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the preceder of the gods”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् । यु॒यो॒ध्य१॒॑स्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भूयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑उक्तिं विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ náya ǀ su-páthā ǀ rāyé ǀ asmā́n ǀ víśvāni ǀ deva ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀyuyodhí ǀ asmát ǀ juhurāṇám ǀ énaḥ ǀ bhū́yiṣṭhām ǀ te ǀ námaḥ-uktim ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, knowing all kinds of knowledge, lead us by good ways to wealth; remove from from us the sun that would force us astray, that we may offer to you most ample adoratioṇ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वं पा॑रया॒ नव्यो॑ अ॒स्मान्त्स्व॒स्तिभि॒रति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ । पूश्च॑ पृ॒थ्वी ब॑हु॒ला न॑ उ॒र्वी भवा॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शं योः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tvám ǀ pāraya ǀ návyaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ víśvā ǀpū́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ pṛthvī́ ǀ bahulā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ urvī́ ǀ bháva ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableAgni, convey us by the sacred sets (of worship), beyond all evil ways; may our city be spacious; our land be extensive; be the bestower of happiness upon our offspring, upon our sons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वम॒स्मद्यु॑यो॒ध्यमी॑वा॒ अन॑ग्नित्रा अ॒भ्यम॑न्त कृ॒ष्टीः । पुन॑र॒स्मभ्यं॑ सुवि॒ताय॑ देव॒ क्षां विश्वे॑भिर॒मृते॑भिर्यजत्र
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tvám ǀ asmát ǀ yuyodhi ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀ ánagni-trāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ámanta ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀpúnaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ deva ǀ kṣā́m ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ amṛ́tebhiḥ ǀ yajatra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, do you remove from us disease, and those men who, unprotected by Agni, are adverse to us; and, adorable divinity (visit) the earth, with all the immortals, for our welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि नो॑ अग्ने पा॒युभि॒रज॑स्रैरु॒त प्रि॒ये सद॑न॒ आ शु॑शु॒क्वान् । मा ते॑ भ॒यं ज॑रि॒तारं॑ यविष्ठ नू॒नं वि॑द॒न्माप॒रं स॑हस्वः
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ájasraiḥ ǀ utá ǀ priyé ǀ sádane ǀ ā́ ǀ śuśukvā́n ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ bhayám ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ nūnám ǀ vidat ǀ mā́ ǀ aparám ǀ sahasvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cherish us,Agni, with incessant bounties; shine always in your favourite abode; let no danger, youngest (of the gods), assails your worshipper today; nor, mighty one, let t assail him any other season.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अ॒ग्नेऽव॑ सृजो अ॒घाया॑वि॒ष्यवे॑ रि॒पवे॑ दु॒च्छुना॑यै । मा द॒त्वते॒ दश॑ते॒ मादते॑ नो॒ मा रीष॑ते सहसाव॒न्परा॑ दाः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ áva ǀ sṛjaḥ ǀ aghā́ya ǀ aviṣyáve ǀ ripáve ǀ ducchúnāyai ǀmā́ ǀ datváte ǀ dáśate ǀ mā́ ǀ adáte ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ríṣate ǀ sahasā-van ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abandon us not,Agni, to a wicked, voracious, malevolent foe; (abandon us) not to one who has fangs, and who bites; nor to one without teeth; nor to the malignant; nor give us up, powerful Agni, to disgrace.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि घ॒ त्वावाँ॑ ऋतजात यंसद्गृणा॒नो अ॑ग्ने त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ वरू॑थम् । विश्वा॑द्रिरि॒क्षोरु॒त वा॑ निनि॒त्सोर॑भि॒ह्रुता॒मसि॒ हि दे॑व वि॒ष्पट्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ gha ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ ṛta-jāta ǀ yaṃsat ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ agne ǀ tanvé ǀ várūtham ǀvíśvāt ǀ ririkṣóḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ ninitsóḥ ǀ abhi-hrútām ǀ ási ǀ hí ǀ deva ǀ viṣpáṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, born for sacrifice, (a man) praising you, who are excellent, for (the sake of cherishing) his body, becomes such as you are; exempts himself from all who are inclined to harm or revile him; for you, Agni, are the especial adversary of those who do wrong.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ताँ अ॑ग्न उ॒भया॒न्वि वि॒द्वान्वेषि॑ प्रपि॒त्वे मनु॑षो यजत्र । अ॒भि॒पि॒त्वे मन॑वे॒ शास्यो॑ भूर्मर्मृ॒जेन्य॑ उ॒शिग्भि॒र्नाक्रः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tā́m ǀ agne ǀ ubháyān ǀ ví ǀ vidvā́n ǀ véṣi ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yajatra ǀabhi-pitvé ǀ mánave ǀ śā́syaḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ marmṛjényaḥ ǀ uśík-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ akráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableAgni, you are sagacious, and in a short time discriminate between both those men (who do and do not worshhip you); approach the worshipper at the proper time, and be compliant (with his wishes); like an instrumental tutor of the rite, (who is directed) by the desires (of the priests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवो॑चाम नि॒वच॑नान्यस्मि॒न्मान॑स्य सू॒नुः स॑हसा॒ने अ॒ग्नौ । व॒यं स॒हस्र॒मृषि॑भिः सनेम वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ávocāma ǀ ni-vácanāni ǀ asmin ǀ mā́nasya ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ sahasāné ǀ agnáu ǀvayám ǀ sahásram ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sanema ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We address our pious prayers to you,Agni, the son of prayer, the subduer of foes; may we procure, by these sacred supplications, infinite wealth, that we may thence obtain food, strength and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न॒र्वाणं॑ वृष॒भं म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्वं॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॑ वर्धया॒ नव्य॑म॒र्कैः । गा॒था॒न्य॑: सु॒रुचो॒ यस्य॑ दे॒वा आ॑शृ॒ण्वन्ति॒ नव॑मानस्य॒ मर्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: anarvā́ṇam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ mandrá-jihvam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ vardhaya ǀ návyam ǀ arkáiḥ ǀgāthānyáḥ ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ā-śṛṇvánti ǀ návamānasya ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests), augment by your hymnsBṛhaspati, who deserts not (his worshipper); the showerer (of benefits) the plural asant-tongued, the adorable; of whom resplendent gods and men, (the ministers) of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, emulous in sacred songs, proclaim (the praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमृ॒त्विया॒ उप॒ वाच॑: सचन्ते॒ सर्गो॒ न यो दे॑वय॒तामस॑र्जि । बृह॒स्पति॒: स ह्यञ्जो॒ वरां॑सि॒ विभ्वाभ॑व॒त्समृ॒ते मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ṛtvíyāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ sacante ǀ sárgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-yatā́m ǀ ásarji ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ áñjaḥ ǀ várāṃsi ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ábhavat ǀ sám ǀ ṛté ǀ mātaríśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hymns of the (rainy) season are addressed to him, who is verily the creator (of the rain), and has granted it (to the prayers) of the devout; for thatBṛhaspatiis the manifester (of all), the expansive wind that (dispensing) blessings has been produced for (the diffusion of) water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑स्तुतिं॒ नम॑स॒ उद्य॑तिं च॒ श्लोकं॑ यंसत्सवि॒तेव॒ प्र बा॒हू । अ॒स्य क्रत्वा॑ह॒न्यो॒३॒॑ यो अस्ति॑ मृ॒गो न भी॒मो अ॑र॒क्षस॒स्तुवि॑ष्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa-stutim ǀ námasaḥ ǀ út-yatim ǀ ca ǀ ślókam ǀ yaṃsat ǀ savitā́-iva ǀ prá ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀasyá ǀ krátvā ǀ ahanyáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ arakṣásaḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is ready (to accept) the offered praise, the presentation of the homage, the hymn, as the sun (is ready) to put forth his rays; by the acts of him whom therākṣasas(oppose not), the daily (revolving sun) exists, and he is strong as a fearful beast of prey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य श्लोको॑ दि॒वीय॑ते पृथि॒व्यामत्यो॒ न यं॑सद्यक्ष॒भृद्विचे॑ताः । मृ॒गाणां॒ न हे॒तयो॒ यन्ति॑ चे॒मा बृह॒स्पते॒रहि॑मायाँ अ॒भि द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ diví ǀ īyate ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yaṃsat ǀ yakṣa-bhṛ́t ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀmṛgā́ṇām ǀ ná ǀ hetáyaḥ ǀ yánti ǀ ca ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ bṛ́haspáteḥ ǀ áhi-māyān ǀ abhí ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gloryof thisBṛhaspatispreads through heaven and earth like the sun; receiving worship, and giving intelligence, he bestows (the rewards of sacrifice); like the weapons of the hunters, so these (weapons) of Bṛhaspati fall daily upon the workers of guile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये त्वा॑ देवोस्रि॒कं मन्य॑मानाः पा॒पा भ॒द्रमु॑प॒जीव॑न्ति प॒ज्राः । न दू॒ढ्ये॒३॒॑ अनु॑ ददासि वा॒मं बृह॑स्पते॒ चय॑स॒ इत्पिया॑रुम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ tvā ǀ deva ǀ usrikám ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀ pāpā́ḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ upa-jī́vanti ǀ pajrā́ḥ ǀná ǀ duḥ-dhyé ǀ ánu ǀ dadāsi ǀ vāmám ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ cáyase ǀ ít ǀ píyārum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineBṛhaspati, you do not bestow desired (wealth) upon those stupid (men), who, sinful and mean subsist, considering you, who are auspicious, as an old ox; but you favour him who offers (you) libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्रैतु॑: सू॒यव॑सो॒ न पन्था॑ दुर्नि॒यन्तु॒: परि॑प्रीतो॒ न मि॒त्रः । अ॒न॒र्वाणो॑ अ॒भि ये चक्ष॑ते॒ नोऽपी॑वृता अपोर्णु॒वन्तो॑ अस्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: su-práituḥ ǀ su-yávasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ duḥ-niyántuḥ ǀ pári-prītaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitráḥ ǀanarvā́ṇaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ cákṣate ǀ naḥ ǀ ápi-vṛtāḥ ǀ apa-ūrṇuvántaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be a (plural asant) way to him who goes well and makes good offerings, like the affectionate friend of (a ruler who) restrains the bad; and may those sinless men who instrumental uct us, although yet enveloped (by ignorance), stand extricated from their covering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यं स्तुभो॒ऽवन॑यो॒ न यन्ति॑ समु॒द्रं न स्र॒वतो॒ रोध॑चक्राः । स वि॒द्वाँ उ॒भयं॑ चष्टे अ॒न्तर्बृह॒स्पति॒स्तर॒ आप॑श्च॒ गृध्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yám ǀ stúbhaḥ ǀ avánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yánti ǀ samudrám ǀ ná ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ ródha-cakrāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ubháyam ǀ caṣṭe ǀ antáḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ táraḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ca ǀ gṛ́dhraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whom praises (necessarily) proceed, as men (assemble round a master); as rivers, rolling between their banks, flow to the ocean; that wiseBṛhaspatigreedy (after rain), and stationary in the midst, contemplates both (the ferry and the water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा म॒हस्तु॑विजा॒तस्तुवि॑ष्मा॒न्बृह॒स्पति॑र्वृष॒भो धा॑यि दे॒वः । स न॑: स्तु॒तो वी॒रव॑द्धातु॒ गोम॑द्वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ maháḥ ǀ tuvi-jātáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ deváḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ dhātu ǀ gó-mat ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ iṣám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ jīrá-dānum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So,Bṛhaspati, the mighty, be beneficent, the powerful, the showerer (of benefits), the divine, has been glorified; praised by us, may he make us possessed of progeny and cattle, that hence we may obtain food, strength and long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कङ्क॑तो॒ न कङ्क॒तोऽथो॑ सती॒नक॑ङ्कतः । द्वाविति॒ प्लुषी॒ इति॒ न्य१॒॑दृष्टा॑ अलिप्सत
shlokas.transliteration: káṅkataḥ ǀ ná ǀ káṅkataḥ ǀ átho íti ǀ satīná-kaṅkataḥ ǀdváu ǀ íti ǀ plúṣī íti ǀ íti ǀ ní ǀ adṛ́ṣṭāḥ ǀ alipsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some creature of little venom, some creature of great venom; or some venomous aquatic reptile; creatures of two kinds, both destructive (of life),or (poisonous) unseen creatures, have anointed me with their poison.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒दृष्टा॑न्हन्त्याय॒त्यथो॑ हन्ति पराय॒ती । अथो॑ अवघ्न॒ती ह॒न्त्यथो॑ पिनष्टि पिंष॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: adṛ́ṣṭān ǀ hanti ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ átho íti ǀ hanti ǀ parā-yatī́ ǀátho íti ǀ ava-ghnatī́ ǀ hanti ǀ átho íti ǀ pinaṣṭi ǀ piṃṣatī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(the antidote), coming (to the bitten person n), destroys the unseen (venomous creatures); departing (it destroys them); deprived (of substance), it destroys them (by its odour); being ground, it pulverises them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒रास॒: कुश॑रासो द॒र्भास॑: सै॒र्या उ॒त । मौ॒ञ्जा अ॒दृष्टा॑ वैरि॒णाः सर्वे॑ सा॒कं न्य॑लिप्सत
shlokas.transliteration: śarā́saḥ ǀ kúśarāsaḥ ǀ darbhā́saḥ ǀ sairyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀmauñjā́ḥ ǀ adṛ́ṣṭāḥ ǀ vairiṇā́ḥ ǀ sárve ǀ sākám ǀ ní ǀ alipsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Blades of)śarāgrass, (of) kuśarā, (of)darbha, (of) sairyā, (of)muñja, (of)vīraṇa, all (the haunt) of unseen (venomous creatures), have together anointed me (with their venom).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि गावो॑ गो॒ष्ठे अ॑सद॒न्नि मृ॒गासो॑ अविक्षत । नि के॒तवो॒ जना॑नां॒ न्य१॒॑दृष्टा॑ अलिप्सत
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ go-sthé ǀ asadan ǀ ní ǀ mṛgā́saḥ ǀ avikṣata ǀní ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ní ǀ adṛ́ṣṭāḥ ǀ alipsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cows had lain down in their stalls; the wild beasts had retreated (to their lairs); the senses of men were at rest; when the unseen (venomous creatures) anointed me (with their venom).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒त उ॒ त्ये प्रत्य॑दृश्रन्प्रदो॒षं तस्क॑रा इव । अदृ॑ष्टा॒ विश्व॑दृष्टा॒: प्रति॑बुद्धा अभूतन
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ práti ǀ adṛśran ǀ pra-doṣám ǀ táskarāḥ-iva ǀádṛṣṭāḥ ǀ víśva-dṛṣṭāḥ ǀ práti-buddhāḥ ǀ abhūtana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or they may be discovered (in the dark), as thieves in the (dusk of) evening; for although they be unseen, yet all are seen by them; therefore, men, be vigilant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यौर्व॑: पि॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी मा॒ता सोमो॒ भ्रातादि॑ति॒: स्वसा॑ । अदृ॑ष्टा॒ विश्व॑दृष्टा॒स्तिष्ठ॑ते॒लय॑ता॒ सु क॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ bhrā́tā ǀ áditiḥ ǀ svásā ǀádṛṣṭāḥ ǀ víśva-dṛṣṭāḥ ǀ tíṣṭhata ǀ iláyata ǀ sú ǀ kam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven, (serpents), is your father; Earth, your mother;Soma, your brother;Aditi, your sister; unseen all-seeing abide (in your own holes); enjoy (your own) good plural asure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अंस्या॒ ये अङ्ग्या॑: सू॒चीका॒ ये प्र॑कङ्क॒ताः । अदृ॑ष्टा॒: किं च॒नेह व॒: सर्वे॑ सा॒कं नि ज॑स्यत
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ áṃsyāḥ ǀ yé ǀ áṅgyāḥ ǀ sūcī́kāḥ ǀ yé ǀ pra-kaṅkatā́ḥ ǀádṛṣṭāḥ ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ ihá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sárve ǀ sākám ǀ ní ǀ jasyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (who move with their) shoulders, those (who move with their) bodies, those who sting with sharp fangs, those who are virulently venomous; what do you here, you unseen, depart together far from us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्पु॒रस्ता॒त्सूर्य॑ एति वि॒श्वदृ॑ष्टो अदृष्ट॒हा । अ॒दृष्टा॒न्त्सर्वा॑ञ्ज॒म्भय॒न्त्सर्वा॑श्च यातुधा॒न्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ purástāt ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ eti ǀ viśvá-dṛṣṭaḥ ǀ adṛṣṭa-hā́ ǀadṛ́ṣṭān ǀ sárvān ǀ jambháyan ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ ca ǀ yātu-dhānyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-seeing Sun rises in the east, the destroyer of the unseen, driving away all the unseen (venomous creatures), and all evil spirits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑पप्तद॒सौ सूर्य॑: पु॒रु विश्वा॑नि॒ जूर्व॑न् । आ॒दि॒त्यः पर्व॑तेभ्यो वि॒श्वदृ॑ष्टो अदृष्ट॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ apaptat ǀ asáu ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ purú ǀ víśvāni ǀ jū́rvan ǀādityáḥ ǀ párvatebhyaḥ ǀ viśvá-dṛṣṭaḥ ǀ adṛṣṭa-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Sun has risen on high, destroying all the many (poisons);Āditya, the all-seeing, the destroyer of the unseen, (rises) for (the good of) living beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्ये॑ वि॒षमा स॑जामि॒ दृतिं॒ सुरा॑वतो गृ॒हे । सो चि॒न्नु न म॑राति॒ नो व॒यं म॑रामा॒रे अ॑स्य॒ योज॑नं हरि॒ष्ठा मधु॑ त्वा मधु॒ला च॑कार
shlokas.transliteration: sū́rye ǀ viṣám ǀ ā́ ǀ sajāmi ǀ dṛ́tim ǀ súrā-vataḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀsáḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ ná ǀ marāti ǀ nó íti ǀ vayám ǀ marāma ǀ āré ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ tvā ǀ madhulā́ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I deposit the poison in the solar orb, like a leather bottle in the house of a vendor of spirits; verily, that adorable (Sun) never dies; nor, (through his favour), shall we die (of the venom); for, though afar off, yet drawn by his coursers, he will overtake (the poison); the science of antidoes converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒य॒त्ति॒का श॑कुन्ति॒का स॒का ज॑घास ते वि॒षम् । सो चि॒न्नु न म॑राति॒ नो व॒यं म॑रामा॒रे अ॑स्य॒ योज॑नं हरि॒ष्ठा मधु॑ त्वा मधु॒ला च॑कार
shlokas.transliteration: iyattikā́ ǀ śakuntikā́ ǀ sakā́ ǀ jaghāsa ǀ te ǀ viṣám ǀsó íti ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ ná ǀ marāti ǀ nó íti ǀ vayám ǀ marāma ǀ āré ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ tvā ǀ madhulā́ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That little insignifcant bird has swallowed your venom; she does not die; nor shall we die; for, although afar off, yet drawn by his coursers, (the Sun) will overtake (the poison); the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिः स॒प्त वि॑ष्पुलिङ्ग॒का वि॒षस्य॒ पुष्य॑मक्षन् । ताश्चि॒न्नु न म॑रन्ति॒ नो व॒यं म॑रामा॒रे अ॑स्य॒ योज॑नं हरि॒ष्ठा मधु॑ त्वा मधु॒ला च॑कार
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ viṣpuliṅgakā́ḥ ǀ viṣásya ǀ púṣyam ǀ akṣan ǀtā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ ná ǀ maranti ǀ nó íti ǀ vayám ǀ marāma ǀ āré ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ tvā ǀ madhulā́ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the thrice-seven sparks (ofAgni) consume the influence of the venom; they verily do not perish;nor shall we die; for, although afar off, the Sun, drawn by his coursers, will overtake the poison; the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒वा॒नां न॑वती॒नां वि॒षस्य॒ रोपु॑षीणाम् । सर्वा॑सामग्रभं॒ नामा॒रे अ॑स्य॒ योज॑नं हरि॒ष्ठा मधु॑ त्वा मधु॒ला च॑कार
shlokas.transliteration: navānā́m ǀ navatīnā́m ǀ viṣásya ǀ rópuṣīṇām ǀsárvāsām ǀ agrabham ǀ nā́ma ǀ āré ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ tvā ǀ madhulā́ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I recite the names of ninety and nine (rivers), the destroyers of poison; although afar off, (the Sun), drawn by his coursers, will overtake the poison; the science of antidotes has converted you, (Poison), to ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिः स॒प्त म॑यू॒र्य॑: स॒प्त स्वसा॑रो अ॒ग्रुव॑: । तास्ते॑ वि॒षं वि ज॑भ्रिर उद॒कं कु॒म्भिनी॑रिव
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ mayūryáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ viṣám ǀ ví ǀ jabhrire ǀ udakám ǀ kumbhínīḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the thrice-seven peahens, the seven-sister rivers, carry off, (O Body), your poison, as maidens, with pitchers, carry away water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒य॒त्त॒कः कु॑षुम्भ॒कस्त॒कं भि॑न॒द्म्यश्म॑ना । ततो॑ वि॒षं प्र वा॑वृते॒ परा॑ची॒रनु॑ सं॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: iyattakáḥ ǀ kuṣumbhakáḥ ǀ takám ǀ bhinadmi ǀ áśmanā ǀtátaḥ ǀ viṣám ǀ prá ǀ vavṛte ǀ párācīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sam-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the insignificant mongoose (carry off) your venom, (Poison); if not, I will crush the vile (creature) with a stone; so may the poison depart (from my body) and go to distant regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒षु॒म्भ॒कस्तद॑ब्रवीद्गि॒रेः प्र॑वर्तमान॒कः । वृश्चि॑कस्यार॒सं वि॒षम॑र॒सं वृ॑श्चिक ते वि॒षम्
shlokas.transliteration: kuṣumbhakáḥ ǀ tát ǀ abravīt ǀ giréḥ ǀ pra-vartamānakáḥ ǀvṛ́ścikasya ǀ arasám ǀ viṣám ǀ arasám ǀ vṛścika ǀ te ǀ viṣám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hastening forth at the command (ofAgastya), thus spoke the mongoose: the venom of the scorpion is innocuous; scorpion, your venom is innocuous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ द्युभि॒स्त्वमा॑शुशु॒क्षणि॒स्त्वम॒द्भ्यस्त्वमश्म॑न॒स्परि॑ । त्वं वने॑भ्य॒स्त्वमोष॑धीभ्य॒स्त्वं नृ॒णां नृ॑पते जायसे॒ शुचि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ āśuśukṣáṇiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ pári ǀtvám ǀ vánebhyaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ jāyase ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sovereign of men,Agni, you are born for the days (of sacrifice), pure and all-irradiating, from the waters, from the stones, from trees, and from plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवा॑ग्ने हो॒त्रं तव॑ पो॒त्रमृ॒त्वियं॒ तव॑ ने॒ष्ट्रं त्वम॒ग्निदृ॑ताय॒तः । तव॑ प्रशा॒स्त्रं त्वम॑ध्वरीयसि ब्र॒ह्मा चासि॑ गृ॒हप॑तिश्च नो॒ दमे॑
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ agne ǀ hotrám ǀ táva ǀ potrám ǀ ṛtvíyam ǀ táva ǀ neṣṭrám ǀ tvám ǀ agnít ǀ ṛta-yatáḥ ǀtáva ǀ pra-śāstrám ǀ tvám ǀ adhvari-yasi ǀ brahmā́ ǀ ca ǀ ási ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dáme ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YoursAgni, is the office of theHotā, of thePotā, of theṚtvij, of theNeṣṭā; you are theAgnīdhraof the devout; yours is the functionof the Praśāstā; you are theAdhvaryu(adhvaryu radhvarayur adhvaram kāmayata iti vā (Nirukta1.8) and theBrahmā; and the householder in our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृष॒भः स॒ताम॑सि॒ त्वं विष्णु॑रुरुगा॒यो न॑म॒स्य॑: । त्वं ब्र॒ह्मा र॑यि॒विद्ब्र॑ह्मणस्पते॒ त्वं वि॑धर्तः सचसे॒ पुरं॑ध्या
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ satā́m ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ uru-gāyáḥ ǀ namasyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ brahmā́ ǀ rayi-vít ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ tvám ǀ vidhartaríti vi-dhartaḥ ǀ sacase ǀ púram-dhyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, areIndra, the showerer (of bounties) on the good; you are adorableViṣṇu, the hymned of many; youBrahmaṇaspati, areBrahmā, the possessor of riches; you, the author of various (conditions) are associated with wisdom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो धृ॒तव्र॑त॒स्त्वं मि॒त्रो भ॑वसि द॒स्म ईड्य॑: । त्वम॑र्य॒मा सत्प॑ति॒र्यस्य॑ स॒म्भुज॒द त्वमंशो॑ वि॒दथे॑ देव भाज॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ tvám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ bhavasi ǀ dasmáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ yásya ǀ sam-bhújam ǀ tvám ǀ áṃśaḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ deva ǀ bhājayúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the royalVaruṇa, observant of holy vows; you are the adorableMitra, the destroyer (of foes); you areAryaman, the protector of the virtuous, whose (liberality) is enjoyed by all; you are a portion (of the sun); be the distributor (of good things), divine (Agni), at our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ त्वष्टा॑ विध॒ते सु॒वीर्यं॒ तव॒ ग्नावो॑ मित्रमहः सजा॒त्य॑म् । त्वमा॑शु॒हेमा॑ ररिषे॒ स्वश्व्यं॒ त्वं न॒रां शर्धो॑ असि पुरू॒वसु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ vidhaté ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ táva ǀ gnā́vaḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ sa-jātyám ǀtvám ǀ āśu-hémā ǀ rariṣe ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ tvám ǀ narā́m ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ asi ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, areTvaṣṭā, (the giver) of great wealth to (your) worshipper; these praises are yours; do you, of benevolent power, (admit) our affinity; you, who are prompt to encourage (us), give us good (store of) horses; you, who abound with opulence, are the strength of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने रु॒द्रो असु॑रो म॒हो दि॒वस्त्वं शर्धो॒ मारु॑तं पृ॒क्ष ई॑शिषे । त्वं वातै॑ररु॒णैर्या॑सि शंग॒यस्त्वं पू॒षा वि॑ध॒तः पा॑सि॒ नु त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ rudráḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ tvám ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǀtvám ǀ vā́taiḥ ǀ aruṇáiḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ śam-gayáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ pāsi ǀ nú ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, areRudra, the expeller (of foes) from the expanse of heaven; you are the strength of theMaruts; you are supreme over (sacrificial) food; you, who are plural asantly domiciled (in the hall of sacrifice), go with ruddy horses, (fleet as) the wind; asPūṣan, you cherish, of yours own will, those who offer worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने द्रविणो॒दा अ॑रं॒कृते॒ त्वं दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता र॑त्न॒धा अ॑सि । त्वं भगो॑ नृपते॒ वस्व॑ ईशिषे॒ त्वं पा॒युर्दमे॒ यस्तेऽवि॑धत्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ aram-kṛ́te ǀ tvám ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀtvám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǀ tvám ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ dáme ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ávidhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are Draviṇodās, to him who honours you; you are the divineSavitā, the possessor of precious things; protector of men, you areBhaga, and rule over wealth; you are the cherisher of him who worships you in his dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ दम॒ आ वि॒श्पतिं॒ विश॒स्त्वां राजा॑नं सुवि॒दत्र॑मृञ्जते । त्वं विश्वा॑नि स्वनीक पत्यसे॒ त्वं स॒हस्रा॑णि श॒ता दश॒ प्रति॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ viśpátim ǀ víśaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ rā́jānam ǀ su-vidátram ǀ ṛñjate ǀtvám ǀ víśvāni ǀ su-anīka ǀ patyase ǀ tvám ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ dáśa ǀ práti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The people adore you,Agni, the protector of the people in their dwellings; they propitiate you as a benevolent sovereign; leader of a radiant host, you are lord over all offerings; you are the distributor of tens, and hundreds, and thousands (of good things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने पि॒तर॑मि॒ष्टिभि॒र्नर॒स्त्वां भ्रा॒त्राय॒ शम्या॑ तनू॒रुच॑म् । त्वं पु॒त्रो भ॑वसि॒ यस्तेऽवि॑ध॒त्त्वं सखा॑ सु॒शेव॑: पास्या॒धृष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ pitáram ǀ iṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ bhrātrā́ya ǀ śámyā ǀ tanū-rúcam ǀtvám ǀ putráḥ ǀ bhavasi ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ávidhat ǀ tvám ǀ sákhā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ pāsi ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Devout) men (worship) you,Agni, as a father, with sacred rites; they (cherish) you, who are the illumination of the body, with acts (of kindness), as a brother; you are as a son to him who propitiates you; and you protect us, a faithful and firm friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्न ऋ॒भुरा॒के न॑म॒स्य१॒॑स्त्वं वाज॑स्य क्षु॒मतो॑ रा॒य ई॑शिषे । त्वं वि भा॒स्यनु॑ दक्षि दा॒वने॒ त्वं वि॒शिक्षु॑रसि य॒ज्ञमा॒तनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ āké ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ kṣu-mátaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǀtvám ǀ ví ǀ bhāsi ǀ ánu ǀ dhakṣi ǀ dāváne ǀ tvám ǀ vi-śíkṣuḥ ǀ asi ǀ yajñám ǀ ā-tániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are (ever) resplendent, and are to be glorified when present; you are lord over all renowned food and riches; you shine brightly, and you consume (the oblation) for him who offers it; you are the especial accomplisher of the sacrifice, and bestower (of its rewards).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ अदि॑तिर्देव दा॒शुषे॒ त्वं होत्रा॒ भार॑ती वर्धसे गि॒रा । त्वमिळा॑ श॒तहि॑मासि॒ दक्ष॑से॒ त्वं वृ॑त्र॒हा व॑सुपते॒ सर॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ áditiḥ ǀ deva ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ tvám ǀ hótrā ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ vardhase ǀ girā́ ǀtvám ǀ íḷā ǀ śatá-himā ǀ asi ǀ dákṣase ǀ tvám ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ vasu-pate ǀ sárasvatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, divineAgni, areAditito the donor of the oblation; you areHotāandBhāratī, and thive by praise; you are Iḷā of a hundred winters to him who makes you gifts; you, lord of wealth, are the destroyer ofVṛtra,Sarasvatī.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ सुभृ॑त उत्त॒मं वय॒स्तव॑ स्पा॒र्हे वर्ण॒ आ सं॒दृशि॒ श्रिय॑: । त्वं वाज॑: प्र॒तर॑णो बृ॒हन्न॑सि॒ त्वं र॒यिर्ब॑हु॒लो वि॒श्वत॑स्पृ॒थुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ sú-bhṛtaḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ táva ǀ spārhé ǀ várṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ pra-táraṇaḥ ǀ bṛhán ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ rayíḥ ǀ bahuláḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, well-cherishedAgni, you are (the giver of) excellent food; in your desirable and delightful hues, beauties (abound) you (are) food; (you are) the transporter (beyond sin); you are mighty; you are wealth; you are manifold, and everhwhere diffused.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्न आदि॒त्यास॑ आ॒स्यं१॒॑ त्वां जि॒ह्वां शुच॑यश्चक्रिरे कवे । त्वां रा॑ति॒षाचो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ सश्चिरे॒ त्वे दे॒वा ह॒विर॑द॒न्त्याहु॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ āsyám ǀ tvā́m ǀ jihvā́m ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ cakrire ǀ kave ǀtvā́m ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ saścire ǀ tvé íti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ adanti ǀ ā́-hutam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheĀdityashave made you,Agni, their mouth; the pure (deities) have made you,Kavi, their tongue; the (gods), the givers of wealth, depdn upon you at sacrifices; they eat the offered oblation through you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे अ॑ग्ने॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॑सो अ॒द्रुह॑ आ॒सा दे॒वा ह॒विर॑द॒न्त्याहु॑तम् । त्वया॒ मर्ता॑सः स्वदन्त आसु॒तिं त्वं गर्भो॑ वी॒रुधां॑ जज्ञिषे॒ शुचि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ agne ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ adanti ǀ ā́-hutam ǀtváyā ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ svadante ǀ ā-sutím ǀ tvám ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ vīrúdhām ǀ jajñiṣe ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the benignant immortal gods eat the offered oblation through you, as their mouth; mortals taste the flavour (of all viands) through you; you are born pure the embryo of plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तान्त्सं च॒ प्रति॑ चासि म॒ज्मनाग्ने॑ सुजात॒ प्र च॑ देव रिच्यसे । पृ॒क्षो यदत्र॑ महि॒ना वि ते॒ भुव॒दनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी रोद॑सी उ॒भे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tā́n ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ práti ǀ ca ǀ asi ǀ majmánā ǀ ágne ǀ su-jāta ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ deva ǀ ricyase ǀpṛkṣáḥ ǀ yát ǀ átra ǀ mahinā́ ǀ ví ǀ te ǀ bhúvat ǀ ánu ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are associated,Agni, by your vigour, with those (gods); divine, well-born Agni, you exceed (them in strength); for the (sacrificial) food that is here prepared is, by your power, subsequently diffused through both regions, heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ गोअ॑ग्रा॒मश्व॑पेशस॒मग्ने॑ रा॒तिमु॑पसृ॒जन्ति॑ सू॒रय॑: । अ॒स्माञ्च॒ ताँश्च॒ प्र हि नेषि॒ वस्य॒ आ बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gó-agrām ǀ áśva-peśasam ǀ ágne ǀ rātím ǀ upa-sṛjánti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ ca ǀ tā́n ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ hí ǀ néṣi ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious are they who present, as a gift, to the reciters of your praises, an excellent cow and an excellent horse; do you,Agni, lead both us and them to the best of abodes, (or heaven), that we and our worthy descendants may repeat the solemn prayer to you at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञेन॑ वर्धत जा॒तवे॑दसम॒ग्निं य॑जध्वं ह॒विषा॒ तना॑ गि॒रा । स॒मि॒धा॒नं सु॑प्र॒यसं॒ स्व॑र्णरं द्यु॒क्षं होता॑रं वृ॒जने॑षु धू॒र्षद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñéna ǀ vardhata ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ agním ǀ yajadhvam ǀ havíṣā ǀ tánā ǀ girā́ ǀsam-idhānám ǀ su-prayásam ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ dyukṣám ǀ hótāram ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ dhūḥ-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exalt with sacrifice,Agni, who knows all that has been born; worship him with oblations, and with ample praise; him who is well kindled, well fed, much lauded, resplendent, the conveyer of oblations, the giver of strength (to the body).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॒ नक्ती॑रु॒षसो॑ ववाशि॒रेऽग्ने॑ व॒त्सं न स्वस॑रेषु धे॒नव॑: । दि॒व इ॒वेद॑र॒तिर्मानु॑षा यु॒गा क्षपो॑ भासि पुरुवार सं॒यत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ náktīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vavāśire ǀ ágne ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ svásareṣu ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀdiváḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ aratíḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣápaḥ ǀ bhāsi ǀ puru-vāra ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mornings and evenings,Agni, are desirous (of worshipping) you, as cows in their stalls long for their calves; adored of many, you, self-controlled, are verily spread through the sky; you (are present at all) the sacred rites of men, and shine brightly by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं दे॒वा बु॒ध्ने रज॑सः सु॒दंस॑सं दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्योर॑र॒तिं न्ये॑रिरे । रथ॑मिव॒ वेद्यं॑ शु॒क्रशो॑चिषम॒ग्निं मि॒त्रं न क्षि॒तिषु॑ प्र॒शंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ budhné ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ su-dáṃsasam ǀ diváḥpṛthivyóḥ ǀ aratím ǀ ní ǀ erire ǀrátham-iva ǀ védyam ǀ śukrá-śociṣam ǀ agním ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ kṣitíṣu ǀ pra-śáṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have stationed at the root of the world, thatAgniwho is of goodly appearance; the pervader of heaven and earth; who is to be known as a car (to convey men to their wishes); who shines with pure radiance, and who is to be honoured as a friend among mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॒क्षमा॑णं॒ रज॑सि॒ स्व आ दमे॑ च॒न्द्रमि॑व सु॒रुचं॑ ह्वा॒र आ द॑धुः । पृश्न्या॑: पत॒रं चि॒तय॑न्तम॒क्षभि॑: पा॒थो न पा॒युं जन॑सी उ॒भे अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ukṣámāṇam ǀ rájasi ǀ své ǀ ā́ ǀ dáme ǀ candrám-iva ǀ su-rúcam ǀ hvāré ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǀpṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ patarám ǀ citáyantam ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀ pātháḥ ǀ ná ǀ pāyúm ǀ jánasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have plural ced him in his solitary dwelling, who is shedding moisture upon the earth; resplendent as gold, traversing the firmament, animate with flames; and pervading the two parents (of all things, heaven and earth), like refreshing water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स होता॒ विश्वं॒ परि॑ भूत्वध्व॒रं तमु॑ ह॒व्यैर्मनु॑ष ऋञ्जते गि॒रा । हि॒रि॒शि॒प्रो वृ॑धसा॒नासु॒ जर्भु॑र॒द्द्यौर्न स्तृभि॑श्चितय॒द्रोद॑सी॒ अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ víśvam ǀ pári ǀ bhūtu ǀ adhvarám ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ṛñjate ǀ girā́ ǀhiri-śipráḥ ǀ vṛdhasānā́su ǀ járbhurat ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ citayat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, the presenter of oblations (to the gods), be around all sacrifices; men propitiate him with oblations and with praises, when blazing with radiant tresses among the growing plural nts, and enlivening heaven and earth (with his sparks), like the sky with stars.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ रे॒वत्स॑मिधा॒नः स्व॒स्तये॑ संदद॒स्वान्र॒यिम॒स्मासु॑ दीदिहि । आ न॑: कृणुष्व सुवि॒ताय॒ रोद॑सी॒ अग्ने॑ ह॒व्या मनु॑षो देव वी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ revát ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ svastáye ǀ sam-dadasvā́n ǀ rayím ǀ asmā́su ǀ dīdihi ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ágne ǀ havyā́ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ deva ǀ vītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are he who, for our good, are possessed of riches; kindled by us, blaze as the liberal donor of wealth to us; render heaven and earth propitious to us so that, divine Agni, (the gods) may partake of the oblations of the instrumental tutor of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा नो॑ अग्ने बृह॒तो दाः स॑ह॒स्रिणो॑ दु॒रो न वाजं॒ श्रुत्या॒ अपा॑ वृधि । प्राची॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ब्रह्म॑णा कृधि॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण शु॒क्रमु॒षसो॒ वि दि॑द्युतः
shlokas.transliteration: dā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀ duráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jam ǀ śrútyai ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀprā́cī íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ kṛdhi ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrám ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ didyutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,Agni, infinite possessions; grant us thousands (of cattle and dependents); open to us, for your reputation, the doors of abudance; make heaven and earth, propitiated by sacred prayer, favourable to us, and may the mornings light you up like the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इ॑धा॒न उ॒षसो॒ राम्या॒ अनु॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण दी॑देदरु॒षेण॑ भा॒नुना॑ । होत्रा॑भिर॒ग्निर्मनु॑षः स्वध्व॒रो राजा॑ वि॒शामति॑थि॒श्चारु॑रा॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ rā́myāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ dīdet ǀ aruṣéṇa ǀ bhānúnā ǀhótrābhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ viśā́m ǀ átithiḥ ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ āyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kindled at the beautiful dawn, (Agni) shines with brilliant lustre, like the sun; adored by the hymns of the worshipper, Agni, the king of men, (comes as) an agreeable guest to the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नो॑ अग्ने अ॒मृते॑षु पूर्व्य॒ धीष्पी॑पाय बृ॒हद्दि॑वेषु॒ मानु॑षा । दुहा॑ना धे॒नुर्वृ॒जने॑षु का॒रवे॒ त्मना॑ श॒तिनं॑ पुरु॒रूप॑मि॒षणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ pūrvya ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ pīpāya ǀ bṛhát-diveṣu ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀdúhānā ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ kāráve ǀ tmánā ǀ śatínam ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ iṣáṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Among men our praise,Agni, celebrate syou, who are first among the greatly-splendid immortals; (may it be to us) as a cow spontaneously yielding at sacrifices to the worshipper, infinite and multiform (blessings according to his) desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यम॑ग्ने॒ अर्व॑ता वा सु॒वीर्यं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वा चितयेमा॒ जनाँ॒ अति॑ । अ॒स्माकं॑ द्यु॒म्नमधि॒ पञ्च॑ कृ॒ष्टिषू॒च्चा स्व१॒॑र्ण शु॑शुचीत दु॒ष्टर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ agne ǀ árvatā ǀ vā ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vā ǀ citayema ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǀasmā́kam ǀ dyumnám ǀ ádhi ǀ páñca ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǀ uccā́ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ śuśucīta ǀ dustáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we manifest vigour among other men,Agni, through the steed and the food (which you have given); and may our unsurpassed wealth shine like the sun over (that of) the five classes of beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ बोधि सहस्य प्र॒शंस्यो॒ यस्मि॑न्त्सुजा॒ता इ॒षय॑न्त सू॒रय॑: । यम॑ग्ने य॒ज्ञमु॑प॒यन्ति॑ वा॒जिनो॒ नित्ये॑ तो॒के दी॑दि॒वांसं॒ स्वे दमे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sahasya ǀ pra-śáṃsyaḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ su-jātā́ḥ ǀ iṣáyanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀyám ǀ agne ǀ yajñám ǀ upa-yánti ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ nítye ǀ toké ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ své ǀ dáme ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VigorousAgni, hear (our prayers); for you are he who is to be lauded; to whom the well-born priests address (their hymns); and whom, entitled to worship, and radiant in thine own abode, the offerers of the oblation approach, for the sake of never-failing posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भया॑सो जातवेदः स्याम ते स्तो॒तारो॑ अग्ने सू॒रय॑श्च॒ शर्म॑णि । वस्वो॑ रा॒यः पु॑रुश्च॒न्द्रस्य॒ भूय॑सः प्र॒जाव॑तः स्वप॒त्यस्य॑ शग्धि नः
shlokas.transliteration: ubháyāsaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ te ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ agne ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ śármaṇi ǀvásvaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-candrásya ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ śagdhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, knowing all that is born, may we, both adorers and priests, be thine for the sake of felicity; and do you bestow upon us wealth of dwellings, of cattle, of much gold, of many dependents and virtuous offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ गोअ॑ग्रा॒मश्व॑पेशस॒मग्ने॑ रा॒तिमु॑पसृ॒जन्ति॑ सू॒रय॑: । अ॒स्माञ्च॒ ताँश्च॒ प्र हि नेषि॒ वस्य॒ आ बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gó-agrām ǀ áśva-peśasam ǀ ágne ǀ rātím ǀ upa-sṛjánti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ ca ǀ tā́n ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ hí ǀ néṣi ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious are they who present, as a gift, to the reciters of your praises, an excellent cow and an elegant horse; do you,Agni, lead us and them to the best of abodes, (or heaven), that we and our worthy descendants may repeat the solemn prayer to you at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निर्निहि॑तः पृथि॒व्यां प्र॒त्यङ्विश्वा॑नि॒ भुव॑नान्यस्थात् । होता॑ पाव॒कः प्र॒दिव॑: सुमे॒धा दे॒वो दे॒वान्य॑जत्व॒ग्निरर्ह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ asthāt ǀhótā ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yajatu ǀ agníḥ ǀ árhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the well-kindled, plural ced upon (the altar of) the earth, stands in the presence of all beings; the invoker (of the gods), the purifier, the ancient, the intelligent, the divine; let the venerable Agni minister to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंस॒: प्रति॒ धामा॑न्य॒ञ्जन्ति॒स्रो दिव॒: प्रति॑ म॒ह्ना स्व॒र्चिः । घृ॒त॒प्रुषा॒ मन॑सा ह॒व्यमु॒न्दन्मू॒र्धन्य॒ज्ञस्य॒ सम॑नक्तु दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsaḥ ǀ práti ǀ dhā́māni ǀ añján ǀ tisráḥ ǀ dívaḥ ǀ práti ǀ mahnā́ ǀ su-arcíḥ ǀghṛta-prúṣā ǀ mánasā ǀ havyám ǀ undán ǀ mūrdhán ǀ yajñásya ǀ sám ǀ anaktu ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the bright Narāśaṃsa, illuminating the receptacles (of the offering) making manifest by his greatness the three radiant (regions) and diffusing the oblation at the season of sacrifice with butter-dispensing purpose, satisfy the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळि॒तो अ॑ग्ने॒ मन॑सा नो॒ अर्ह॑न्दे॒वान्य॑क्षि॒ मानु॑षा॒त्पूर्वो॑ अ॒द्य । स आ व॑ह म॒रुतां॒ शर्धो॒ अच्यु॑त॒मिन्द्रं॑ नरो बर्हि॒षदं॑ यजध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: īḷitáḥ ǀ agne ǀ mánasā ǀ naḥ ǀ árhan ǀ devā́n ǀ yakṣi ǀ mā́nuṣāt ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ adyá ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ marútām ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ácyutam ǀ índram ǀ naraḥ ǀ barhi-sádam ǀ yajadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are the venerable īḷita, do you, with mind favourably disposed towards us, offer today sacrifice to the gods, before the human (ministrant priest) as such, bring hither the company of theMaruts, the undecayingIndra, to whom, seated on the sacred grass, do you priests offer worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: देव॑ बर्हि॒र्वर्ध॑मानं सु॒वीरं॑ स्ती॒र्णं रा॒ये सु॒भरं॒ वेद्य॒स्याम् । घृ॒तेना॒क्तं व॑सवः सीदते॒दं विश्वे॑ देवा आदित्या य॒ज्ञिया॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: déva ǀ barhiḥ ǀ várdhamānam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ stīrṇám ǀ rāyé ǀ su-bháram ǀ védī íti ǀ asyā́m ǀghṛténa ǀ aktám ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ sīdata ǀ idám ǀ víśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine grass, let theVasus, theVIśvedevas, the adorableĀditya, sit upon this flourishing, invigrating, well-grown, sacred grass, strewn for the sakeof wealth upon this altar, and sprinkled with butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि श्र॑यन्तामुर्वि॒या हू॒यमा॑ना॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीः सु॑प्राय॒णा नमो॑भिः । व्यच॑स्वती॒र्वि प्र॑थन्तामजु॒र्या वर्णं॑ पुना॒ना य॒शसं॑ सु॒वीर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ śráyantām ǀ urviyā́ ǀ hūyámānāḥ ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ supra-ayanā́ḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvyácasvatīḥ ǀ ví ǀ prathantām ǀ ajuryā́ḥ ǀ várṇam ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ yaśásam ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the divine doors, spacious and easily accessible, and to be saluted with prostrations, be set open; let them be celebrated as expansive, uninjurable, and conferring sanctity upon the illustrious class (of worshippers), possessed of virtuous progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒ध्वपां॑सि स॒नता॑ न उक्षि॒ते उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ व॒य्ये॑व रण्वि॒ते । तन्तुं॑ त॒तं सं॒वय॑न्ती समी॒ची य॒ज्ञस्य॒ पेश॑: सु॒दुघे॒ पय॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: sādhú ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ sanátā ǀ naḥ ǀ ukṣité íti ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ vayyā́-iva ǀ raṇvité íti ǀtántum ǀ tatám ǀ saṃváyantī íti sam-váyantī ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ péśaḥ ǀ sudúghe íti su-dúghe ǀ páyasvatī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In regard of our good deeds, Day and Night, perpetually reverenced, are interweaving in concert, like two famous feminine le weavers, the extended thread, (to complete) the web of the sacrifice, liberal yielders (of rewards), containers of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा वि॒दुष्ट॑र ऋ॒जु य॑क्षत॒: समृ॒चा व॒पुष्ट॑रा । दे॒वान्यज॑न्तावृतु॒था सम॑ञ्जतो॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॒ सानु॑षु त्रि॒षु
shlokas.transliteration: dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ vidúḥ-tarā ǀ ṛjú ǀ yakṣataḥ ǀ sám ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ vapúḥ-tarā ǀdevā́n ǀ yájantau ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ sám ǀ añjataḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nuṣu ǀ triṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the two divine invokers of the gods, the first (to be reverenced), most wise, sincerely worshipping with sacred texts, most excellent in form, offering homage to the gods in due season, present oblations in the three high plural ces upon the navel of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वती सा॒धय॑न्ती॒ धियं॑ न॒ इळा॑ दे॒वी भार॑ती वि॒श्वतू॑र्तिः । ति॒स्रो दे॒वीः स्व॒धया॑ ब॒र्हिरेदमच्छि॑द्रं पान्तु शर॒णं नि॒षद्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvatī ǀ sādháyantī ǀ dhíyam ǀ naḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ devī́ ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ viśvá-tūrtiḥ ǀtisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ idám ǀ ácchidram ǀ pāntu ǀ śaraṇám ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the three goddesses,Sarasvatī, perfecting our understanding, the divine iḷā, and all-impressiveBhāratī, having come to our dwelling, protect this faultless rite, (offered) for our welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒शङ्ग॑रूपः सु॒भरो॑ वयो॒धाः श्रु॒ष्टी वी॒रो जा॑यते दे॒वका॑मः । प्र॒जां त्वष्टा॒ वि ष्य॑तु॒ नाभि॑म॒स्मे अथा॑ दे॒वाना॒मप्ये॑तु॒ पाथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: piśáṅga-rūpaḥ ǀ su-bháraḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǀpra-jā́m ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ví ǀ syatu ǀ nā́bhim ǀ asmé íti ǀ átha ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ etu ǀ pā́thaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May a tawny-hued, well-grown (son), the bestower of food, active, manly, a worshipper of the gods, be born; mayTvaṣṭāprolong for us a continuous (line of) progeny, and may the food of the gods come also to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॒स्पति॑रवसृ॒जन्नुप॑ स्थाद॒ग्निर्ह॒विः सू॑दयाति॒ प्र धी॒भिः । त्रिधा॒ सम॑क्तं नयतु प्रजा॒नन्दे॒वेभ्यो॒ दैव्य॑: शमि॒तोप॑ ह॒व्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspátiḥ ǀ ava-sṛján ǀ úpa ǀ sthāt ǀ agníḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ sūdayāti ǀ prá ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀtrídhā ǀ sám-aktam ǀ nayatu ǀ pra-jānán ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ śamitā́ ǀ úpa ǀ havyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, who isVanaspati, approving (of our rite), approach; and by his especial acts fully dress the victim; may the divine immolator convey the burnt-offering to the gods, knowing it to have been thrice consecrated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तं मि॑मिक्षे घृ॒तम॑स्य॒ योनि॑र्घृ॒ते श्रि॒तो घृ॒तम्व॑स्य॒ धाम॑ । अ॒नु॒ष्व॒धमा व॑ह मा॒दय॑स्व॒ स्वाहा॑कृतं वृषभ वक्षि ह॒व्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtám ǀ mimikṣe ǀ ghṛtám ǀ asya ǀ yóniḥ ǀ ghṛté ǀ śritáḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ dhā́ma ǀanu-svadhám ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ mādáyasva ǀ svā́hā-kṛtam ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ vakṣi ǀ havyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I sprinkle the butter, for butter is his birth-plural ce; he is nourished by butter; butter is his radiance;Agni, showerer (of benefits), bring the gods to the offered oblation; exhilarate them; convey to them the offering that has been reverently sanctified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हु॒वे व॑: सु॒द्योत्मा॑नं सुवृ॒क्तिं वि॒शाम॒ग्निमति॑थिं सुप्र॒यस॑म् । मि॒त्र इ॑व॒ यो दि॑धि॒षाय्यो॒ भूद्दे॒व आदे॑वे॒ जने॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: huvé ǀ vaḥ ǀ su-dyótmānam ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ viśā́m ǀ agním ǀ átithim ǀ su-prayásam ǀmitráḥ-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ didhiṣā́yyaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́-deve ǀ jáne ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke, on your behalf, the resplendent, the sinlessAgni, the guest of mortals, the accepter of (sacrificial) food, who, knowing all that has been born, is like a friend, the supporter (of all beings) from men to gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं वि॒धन्तो॑ अ॒पां स॒धस्थे॑ द्वि॒ताद॑धु॒र्भृग॑वो वि॒क्ष्वा॒३॒॑योः । ए॒ष विश्वा॑न्य॒भ्य॑स्तु॒ भूमा॑ दे॒वाना॑म॒ग्निर॑र॒तिर्जी॒राश्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ vidhántaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ dvitā́ ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ āyóḥ ǀeṣáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ bhū́ma ǀ devā́nām ǀ agníḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ jīrá-aśvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBhṛgus, worshippingAgni, have twice made him manifest; (once) in the abode of the waters, and (once) among the sons of men; may that Agni, the sovereign of the gods, mounted on a rapid courser, ever overcome all (our foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दे॒वासो॒ मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु प्रि॒यं धु॑: क्षे॒ष्यन्तो॒ न मि॒त्रम् । स दी॑दयदुश॒तीरूर्म्या॒ आ द॒क्षाय्यो॒ यो दास्व॑ते॒ दम॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀ priyám ǀ dhuḥ ǀ kṣeṣyántaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitrám ǀsáḥ ǀ dīdayat ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ ū́rmyāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dakṣā́yyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dā́svate ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods, intending to dwell (in heaven), left, as a dear friend among the human races, thatAgni, who, present in the chamber of sacrifice, is bounteous to the donor of offerings, and shines on the nights when he is wished for.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य र॒ण्वा स्वस्ये॑व पु॒ष्टिः संदृ॑ष्टिरस्य हिया॒नस्य॒ दक्षो॑: । वि यो भरि॑भ्र॒दोष॑धीषु जि॒ह्वामत्यो॒ न रथ्यो॑ दोधवीति॒ वारा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ raṇvā́ ǀ svásya-iva ǀ puṣṭíḥ ǀ sám-dṛṣṭiḥ ǀ asya ǀ hiyānásya ǀ dhákṣoḥ ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ bháribhrat ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ jihvā́m ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthyaḥ ǀ dodhavīti ǀ vā́rān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cherishing ofAgniis as agreeable as (the cherishing) of one's self; (plural asant) is his appearance, when spreading abroad, and consuming (the fuel); he brandishes his flame among the bushes, as a chariot-horse lashes with his tail.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यन्मे॒ अभ्वं॑ व॒नद॒: पन॑न्तो॒शिग्भ्यो॒ नामि॑मीत॒ वर्ण॑म् । स चि॒त्रेण॑ चिकिते॒ रंसु॑ भा॒सा जु॑जु॒र्वाँ यो मुहु॒रा युवा॒ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ me ǀ ábhvam ǀ vanádaḥ ǀ pánanta ǀ uśík-bhyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ amimīta ǀ várṇam ǀsáḥ ǀ citréṇa ǀ cikite ǀ rám-su ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ jujurvā́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yúvā ǀ bhū́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose greatness my colleagues loudly extol; who has manifested his real form to the priests; who is recognized at oblations by his variegated radiance, and who, though frequently growing old, again and again becomes young.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो वना॑ तातृषा॒णो न भाति॒ वार्ण प॒था रथ्ये॑व स्वानीत् । कृ॒ष्णाध्वा॒ तपू॑ र॒ण्वश्चि॑केत॒ द्यौरि॑व॒ स्मय॑मानो॒ नभो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánā ǀ tatṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhā́ti ǀ vā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ pathā́ ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ svānīt ǀkṛṣṇá-adhvā ǀ tápuḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ ciketa ǀ dyáuḥ-iva ǀ smáyamānaḥ ǀ nábhaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who shines amidst the forests, as if satisfying himself (with food); who (rushes along), like water down a declivity, and thunders like a chariot (of war); dark-pathed consuming, yet delightful, he is regarded like the sky smiling with constellations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यो व्यस्था॑द॒भि दक्ष॑दु॒र्वीं प॒शुर्नैति॑ स्व॒युरगो॑पाः । अ॒ग्निः शो॒चिष्माँ॑ अत॒सान्यु॒ष्णन्कृ॒ष्णव्य॑थिरस्वदय॒न्न भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ví ǀ ásthāt ǀ abhí ǀ dhákṣat ǀ urvī́m ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ eti ǀ sva-yúḥ ǀ ágopāḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ śocíṣmān ǀ atasā́ni ǀ uṣṇán ǀ kṛṣṇá-vyathiḥ ǀ asvadayat ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is in many plural ces, who spreads over the whole earth, like an animal without a herdsman, that goes according to its own will;Agni, the bright-shining, consuming the dry bushes, by whom the pain of blackness (is inflicted on the trees), entirely drinks up (their moisture).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ते॒ पूर्व॒स्याव॑सो॒ अधी॑तौ तृ॒तीये॑ वि॒दथे॒ मन्म॑ शंसि । अ॒स्मे अ॑ग्ने सं॒यद्वी॑रं बृ॒हन्तं॑ क्षु॒मन्तं॒ वाजं॑ स्वप॒त्यं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ te ǀ pū́rvasya ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ ádhi-itau ǀ tṛtī́ye ǀ vidáthe ǀ mánma ǀ śaṃsi ǀasmé íti ǀ agne ǀ saṃyát-vīram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ kṣu-mántam ǀ vā́jam ǀ su-apatyám ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, your praise has been recited (by us) at the third (daily) sacrifice, as it was in the repetition on your first propitiation; give us,Agni, ample and notorious food, posterity, riches, such as may be the support of numerous dependents.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॒ यथा॑ गृत्सम॒दासो॑ अग्ने॒ गुहा॑ व॒न्वन्त॒ उप॑राँ अ॒भि ष्युः । सु॒वीरा॑सो अभिमाति॒षाह॒: स्मत्सू॒रिभ्यो॑ गृण॒ते तद्वयो॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ yáthā ǀ gṛtsa-madā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ gúhā ǀ vanvántaḥ ǀ úparān ǀ abhí ǀ syúríti syúḥ ǀsu-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀ smát ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ tát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By you, (Agni), may theGṛtsamadas, repeating your praise, become masters of the precious secret (treasures); so that they may be possessed of excellent dependents, and be able to resist (their) enemies; and do you give to (your) pious worshippers and to him who glorifies (you), such (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑जनिष्ट॒ चेत॑नः पि॒ता पि॒तृभ्य॑ ऊ॒तये॑ । प्र॒यक्ष॒ञ्जेन्यं॒ वसु॑ श॒केम॑ वा॒जिनो॒ यम॑म्
