shlokas.transliteration: hótā ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ cétanaḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀpra-yákṣan ǀ jényam ǀ vásu ǀ śakéma ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ yámam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “An invoker (of the gods), our instrumental uctor and protector has been born for the preservation of our patrons; may we, possessed of (sacrificial) food, be able to acquire worshipful, conquerable, and manageable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्मि॑न्त्स॒प्त र॒श्मय॑स्त॒ता य॒ज्ञस्य॑ ने॒तरि॑ । म॒नु॒ष्वद्दैव्य॑मष्ट॒मं पोता॒ विश्वं॒ तदि॑न्वति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ saptá ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ tatā́ḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ netári ǀmanuṣvát ǀ dáivyam ǀ aṣṭamám ǀ pótā ǀ víśvam ǀ tát ǀ invati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In whom, as conductor of the sacrifice, the seven rays are manifested, and who, as a humanPotā, officiate in the eighth plural ce to perfect every divine (rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒ध॒न्वे वा॒ यदी॒मनु॒ वोच॒द्ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ वेरु॒ तत् । परि॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑ ने॒मिश्च॒क्रमि॑वाभवत्
shlokas.transliteration: dadhanvé ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ ánu ǀ vócat ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ véḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tát ǀpári ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀ nemíḥ ǀ cakrám-iva ǀ abhavat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever (offerings the priest) presents, whatever prayers he recites, he, (Agni), knows them all; he comprehends all priestly acts, as the circumference (includes the spokes) of a wheel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒कं हि शुचि॑ना॒ शुचि॑: प्रशा॒स्ता क्रतु॒नाज॑नि । वि॒द्वाँ अ॑स्य व्र॒ता ध्रु॒वा व॒या इ॒वानु॑ रोहते
shlokas.transliteration: sākám ǀ hí ǀ śúcinā ǀ śúciḥ ǀ pra-śāstā́ ǀ krátunā ǀ ájani ǀvidvā́n ǀ asya ǀ vratā́ ǀ dhruvā́ ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǀ ánu ǀ rohate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure regulator (of the sacrifice) is born verily together with the holy act; the wise (worshipper) performs all his, (Agni's), prescribed rites in succession, as the branches spring (from a common stem).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य॒ वर्ण॑मा॒युवो॒ नेष्टु॑: सचन्त धे॒नव॑: । कु॒वित्ति॒सृभ्य॒ आ वरं॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ या इ॒दं य॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ várṇam ǀ āyúvaḥ ǀ néṣṭuḥ ǀ sacanta ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ tisṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ idám ǀ yayúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sister fingers, which are the kine of theNeṣṭā, are those which accomplish him, (Agni's), worship; and in various ways are combined for this purpose through the three (sacred fires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॑ मा॒तुरुप॒ स्वसा॑ घृ॒तं भर॒न्त्यस्थि॑त । तासा॑मध्व॒र्युराग॑तौ॒ यवो॑ वृ॒ष्टीव॑ मोदते
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ mātúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ svásā ǀ ghṛtám ǀ bhárantī ǀ ásthita ǀtā́sām ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ ā́-gatau ǀ yávaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭī́-iva ǀ modate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sister (vessel), bearing the clarified butter, is plural ced near the maternal (altar), theAdhvaryurejoices at their approach, like barley (at the fall of) rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वः स्वाय॒ धाय॑से कृणु॒तामृ॒त्विगृ॒त्विज॑म् । स्तोमं॑ य॒ज्ञं चादरं॑ व॒नेमा॑ ररि॒मा व॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sváḥ ǀ svā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ kṛṇutā́m ǀ ṛtvík ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀstómam ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ ā́t ǀ áram ǀ vanéma ǀ rarimá ǀ vayám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, the ministering priest, discharge the office of priest at his own ceremony; and may we worthily repeat (his) praise, and offer (him) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ वि॒द्वाँ अरं॒ कर॒द्विश्वे॑भ्यो यज॒तेभ्य॑: । अ॒यम॑ग्ने॒ त्वे अपि॒ यं य॒ज्ञं च॑कृ॒मा व॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vidvā́n ǀ áram ǀ kárat ǀ víśvebhyaḥ ǀ yajatébhyaḥ ǀayám ǀ agne ǀ tvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ yám ǀ yajñám ǀ cakṛmá ǀ vayám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And do you,Agni, (grant), that this wise (worshipper) may worthily offer (worship) to all the adorable (divinities), and that the sacrifice which we offer may also be perfected in you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां मे॑ अग्ने स॒मिध॑मि॒मामु॑प॒सदं॑ वनेः । इ॒मा उ॒ षु श्रु॑धी॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídham ǀ imā́m ǀ upa-sádam ǀ vaneríti vaneḥ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śrudhi ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, accept this my fuel, this my oblation; listen, well plural ased, to my praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या ते॑ अग्ने विधे॒मोर्जो॑ नपा॒दश्व॑मिष्टे । ए॒ना सू॒क्तेन॑ सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vidhema ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ áśvam-iṣṭe ǀenā́ ǀ su-ukténa ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we propitiate you,Agni, by this (oblation), grandsonof strength, (who are) gratified by prompt sacrifice, (may we plural ase you), well-born, by this hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ गी॒र्भिर्गिर्व॑णसं द्रविण॒स्युं द्र॑विणोदः । स॒प॒र्येम॑ सप॒र्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gírvaṇasam ǀ draviṇasyúm ǀ draviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀsaparyéma ǀ saparyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Granter of riches, may we, your worshippers, propitiate you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) wealth, and deserving of laudation, by our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स बो॑धि सू॒रिर्म॒घवा॒ वसु॑पते॒ वसु॑दावन् । यु॒यो॒ध्य१॒॑स्मद्द्वेषां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sūríḥ ǀ maghávā ǀ vásu-pate ǀ vásu-dāvan ǀyuyodhí ǀ asmát ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of wealth, giver of wealth, possessor of riches, who are wise, understand (our prayers), and scatter our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वस्परि॒ स नो॒ वाज॑मन॒र्वाण॑म् । स न॑: सह॒स्रिणी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(For you are) he (who gives) us rain from heaven; he (who gives) us undecaying strenght, he (who gives) us infinite (abundance of) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळा॑नायाव॒स्यवे॒ यवि॑ष्ठ दूत नो गि॒रा । यजि॑ष्ठ होत॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷānāya ǀ avasyáve ǀ yáviṣṭha ǀ dūta ǀ naḥ ǀ girā́ ǀyájiṣṭha ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youngest (of the gods), their messenger, their invoker, most deserving of worship, come, upon our praise, to him who offers (you) adoration, and is desirous of (your) protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्तर्ह्य॑ग्न॒ ईय॑से वि॒द्वाञ्जन्मो॒भया॑ कवे । दू॒तो जन्ये॑व॒ मित्र्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: antáḥ ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ī́yase ǀ vidvā́n ǀ jánma ǀ ubháyā ǀ kave ǀdūtáḥ ǀ jányā-iva ǀ mítryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageAgni, you penetrate the innermost (man), knowing the birth of both (the worshipper and the worshipped); like a messenger favourable to men, especially to his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वि॒द्वाँ आ च॑ पिप्रयो॒ यक्षि॑ चिकित्व आनु॒षक् । आ चा॒स्मिन्त्स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ piprayaḥ ǀ yákṣi ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀā́ ǀ ca ǀ asmín ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, who are all-wise, fulfil (our desire); do you, who are intelligent, worship (the gods) in order; and sit down on this sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं॑ यविष्ठ भार॒ताग्ने॑ द्यु॒मन्त॒मा भ॑र । वसो॑ पुरु॒स्पृहं॑ र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: śréṣṭham ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ bhārata ǀ ágne ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀváso íti ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youngest (of the gods),Agnidescendant ofBhārata, granter of dwellings, bring (to us) excellent, splendid and enviable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ अरा॑तिरीशत दे॒वस्य॒ मर्त्य॑स्य च । पर्षि॒ तस्या॑ उ॒त द्वि॒षः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ árātiḥ ǀ īśata ǀ devásya ǀ mártyasya ǀ ca ǀpárṣi ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ dviṣáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let no enemy prevail against us, whether of god or man; protect us from both such foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑ उ॒त त्वया॑ व॒यं धारा॑ उद॒न्या॑ इव । अति॑ गाहेमहि॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāḥ ǀ utá ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ udanyā́ḥ-iva ǀáti ǀ gāhemahi ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us, through your favour, overwhelm all our foes like torrents of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑: पावक॒ वन्द्योऽग्ने॑ बृ॒हद्वि रो॑चसे । त्वं घृ॒तेभि॒राहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ vándyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhát ǀ ví ǀ rocase ǀtvám ǀ ghṛtébhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purifier,Agni, holy, adorable, you shine exceedingly when (you are) worshipped with (oblations of) butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ असि भार॒ताग्ने॑ व॒शाभि॑रु॒क्षभि॑: । अ॒ष्टाप॑दीभि॒राहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asi ǀ bhārata ǀ ágne ǀ vaśā́bhiḥ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀaṣṭā́-padībhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, descendantofBharatā, you are entirely ours, when sacrificed to with pregnant kine, with barren cows, or bulls.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्र्व॑न्नः स॒र्पिरा॑सुतिः प्र॒त्नो होता॒ वरे॑ण्यः । सह॑सस्पु॒त्रो अद्भु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: drú-annaḥ ǀ sarpíḥ-āsutiḥ ǀ pratnáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀsáhasaḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Feeder upon fuel, to whom butter is offered (you are) the ancient, the invoker of the gods, the excellent son of strength, the wonderful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒ज॒यन्नि॑व॒ नू रथा॒न्योगाँ॑ अ॒ग्नेरुप॑ स्तुहि । य॒शस्त॑मस्य मी॒ळ्हुष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vājayán-iva ǀ nú ǀ ráthān ǀ yógān ǀ agnéḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀyaśáḥ-tamasya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise quickly the yoked chariot of the glorious and munificentAgni, like one who is desirous of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सु॑नी॒थो द॑दा॒शुषे॑ऽजु॒र्यो ज॒रय॑न्न॒रिम् । चारु॑प्रतीक॒ आहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ su-nītháḥ ǀ dadāśúṣe ǀ ajuryáḥ ǀ jaráyan ǀ arím ǀcā́ru-pratīkaḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, sagacious, invincible, and of graceful gait destroys, when propitiated, his foe, for him who presents (offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॑ श्रि॒या दमे॒ष्वा दो॒षोषसि॑ प्रश॒स्यते॑ । यस्य॑ व्र॒तं न मीय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śriyā́ ǀ dámeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ doṣā́ ǀ uṣási ǀ pra-śasyáte ǀyásya ǀ vratám ǀ ná ǀ mī́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who invested with radiance, is glorified, morning and evening, in (our) dwelling; whose worship is never neglected.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यः स्व१॒॑र्ण भा॒नुना॑ चि॒त्रो वि॒भात्य॒र्चिषा॑ । अ॒ञ्जा॒नो अ॒जरै॑र॒भि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānúnā ǀ citráḥ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ arcíṣā ǀañjānáḥ ǀ ajáraiḥ ǀ abhí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, many-tinted, shines with radiance, like the sun with (his) lustre, spreading (light) over (all) by his imperishable (flames).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्रि॒मनु॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म॒ग्निमु॒क्थानि॑ वावृधुः । विश्वा॒ अधि॒ श्रियो॑ दधे
shlokas.transliteration: átrim ǀ ánu ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǀ agním ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our praises have increased the self-irradiating devouringnAgni; he is possessed of all glory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेरिन्द्र॑स्य॒ सोम॑स्य दे॒वाना॑मू॒तिभि॑र्व॒यम् । अरि॑ष्यन्तः सचेमह्य॒भि ष्या॑म पृतन्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sómasya ǀ devā́nām ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ vayám ǀáriṣyantaḥ ǀ sacemahi ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, uninjured, be secure in the protection ofAgni,Indra,Somaand the gods, and confident in battle overcome (our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि होता॑ होतृ॒षद॑ने॒ विदा॑नस्त्वे॒षो दी॑दि॒वाँ अ॑सदत्सु॒दक्ष॑: । अद॑ब्धव्रतप्रमति॒र्वसि॑ष्ठः सहस्रम्भ॒रः शुचि॑जिह्वो अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ hótā ǀ hotṛ-sádane ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ dīdi-vā́n ǀ asadat ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀádabdhavrata-pramatiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sahasram-bharáḥ ǀ śúci-jihvaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the resplendent, the radiant, the very powerful; he who knows (how to maintain) his rites undisturbed; who is steady in (his own) plural ce, and is the cherisher of thousands, sit in the station of the invoking priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दू॒तस्त्वमु॑ नः पर॒स्पास्त्वं वस्य॒ आ वृ॑षभ प्रणे॒ता । अग्ने॑ तो॒कस्य॑ न॒स्तने॑ त॒नूना॒मप्र॑युच्छ॒न्दीद्य॑द्बोधि गो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ tvám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ pra-netā́ ǀágne ǀ tokásya ǀ naḥ ǀ táne ǀ tanū́nām ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀ dī́dyat ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits),Agni, be you our messenger (to the gods); our preserver from evil; the conveyer to us of wealth; the protector of our sons and grandsons, and of our person ns; understand (our prayer), ever heedful and resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒धेम॑ ते पर॒मे जन्म॑न्नग्ने वि॒धेम॒ स्तोमै॒रव॑रे स॒धस्थे॑ । यस्मा॒द्योने॑रु॒दारि॑था॒ यजे॒ तं प्र त्वे ह॒वींषि॑ जुहुरे॒ समि॑द्धे
shlokas.transliteration: vidhéma ǀ te ǀ paramé ǀ jánman ǀ agne ǀ vidhéma ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ ávare ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀyásmāt ǀ yóneḥ ǀ ut-ā́ritha ǀ yáje ǀ tám ǀ prá ǀ tvé íti ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ juhure ǀ sám-iddhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We adore you,Agni, in your loftiest birth-(plural ce), and with hymns in thine inferior station; I worship that seat whence you have issued; the priests have offered you, when kindled oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यज॑स्व ह॒विषा॒ यजी॑याञ्छ्रु॒ष्टी दे॒ष्णम॒भि गृ॑णीहि॒ राध॑: । त्वं ह्यसि॑ रयि॒पती॑ रयी॒णां त्वं शु॒क्रस्य॒ वच॑सो म॒नोता॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yájasva ǀ havíṣā ǀ yájīyān ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ deṣṇám ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ tvám ǀ śukrásya ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ manótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are the chief of sacrificers, worship (the gods) with the oblation, and earnestly commend to them the (sacrificial) food that is to be given (them); for you, indeed, are the soverign lord of riches; you are the appreciator of our pious prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भयं॑ ते॒ न क्षी॑यते वस॒व्यं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ जाय॑मानस्य दस्म । कृ॒धि क्षु॒मन्तं॑ जरि॒तार॑मग्ने कृ॒धि पतिं॑ स्वप॒त्यस्य॑ रा॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: ubháyam ǀ te ǀ ná ǀ kṣīyate ǀ vasavyám ǀ divé-dive ǀ jā́yamānasya ǀ dasma ǀkṛdhí ǀ kṣu-mántam ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ agne ǀ kṛdhí ǀ pátim ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BeautifulAgni, the two dwelling-plural ces (heaven and earth) of you, who are born day by day, never perish; confer upon him who praises you (abundant) food, and make him the master of riches, (supporting) virtuous offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सैनानी॑केन सुवि॒दत्रो॑ अ॒स्मे यष्टा॑ दे॒वाँ आय॑जिष्ठः स्व॒स्ति । अद॑ब्धो गो॒पा उ॒त न॑: पर॒स्पा अग्ने॑ द्यु॒मदु॒त रे॒वद्दि॑दीहि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ ánīkena ǀ su-vidátraḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ yáṣṭā ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́-yajiṣṭhaḥ ǀ svastí ǀádabdhaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ ágne ǀ dyu-mát ǀ utá ǀ revát ǀ didīhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you with this (your) host (of attendants), be of good promise to us; do you, the especial worshipper of the gods, their unassailable protector, as well as our preserver, light up (all) with shining and affluent well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जो॒हूत्रो॑ अ॒ग्निः प्र॑थ॒मः पि॒तेवे॒ळस्प॒दे मनु॑षा॒ यत्समि॑द्धः । श्रियं॒ वसा॑नो अ॒मृतो॒ विचे॑ता मर्मृ॒जेन्य॑: श्रव॒स्य१॒॑: स वा॒जी
shlokas.transliteration: johū́traḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ padé ǀ mánuṣā ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀśríyam ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ marmṛjényaḥ ǀ śravasyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableAgni, the first (of the gods) and their nourisher when kindled by man upon the altar; he who is clothed in radiance, is immortal, discriminating, food-bestowing, powerful; he is to be worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रू॒या अ॒ग्निश्चि॒त्रभा॑नु॒र्हवं॑ मे॒ विश्वा॑भिर्गी॒र्भिर॒मृतो॒ विचे॑ताः । श्या॒वा रथं॑ वहतो॒ रोहि॑ता वो॒तारु॒षाह॑ चक्रे॒ विभृ॑त्रः
shlokas.transliteration: śruyā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ citrá-bhānuḥ ǀ hávam ǀ me ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀśyāvā́ ǀ rátham ǀ vahataḥ ǀ róhitā ǀ vā ǀ utá ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ áha ǀ cakre ǀ ví-bhṛtraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, who is immortal, of manifold wisdom, and wonderful splendour, hear my invocation, (preferred) with all laudations; tawny, or red, or purple horses draw his car; he has been borne in various directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त्ता॒नाया॑मजनय॒न्त्सुषू॑तं॒ भुव॑द॒ग्निः पु॑रु॒पेशा॑सु॒ गर्भ॑: । शिरि॑णायां चिद॒क्तुना॒ महो॑भि॒रप॑रीवृतो वसति॒ प्रचे॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: uttānā́yām ǀ ajanayan ǀ sú-sūtam ǀ bhúvat ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-péśāsu ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀśíriṇāyām ǀ cit ǀ aktúnā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ápari-vṛtaḥ ǀ vasati ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have genitive rated (Agni) when soundly sleeping on his upturned (couch); that Agni who is an embryo in many (vegetable) forms, and who, (rendered manifest) by the oblations, abides conscious in the night, unenveloped by darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जिघ॑र्म्य॒ग्निं ह॒विषा॑ घृ॒तेन॑ प्रतिक्षि॒यन्तं॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ । पृ॒थुं ति॑र॒श्चा वय॑सा बृ॒हन्तं॒ व्यचि॑ष्ठ॒मन्नै॑ रभ॒सं दृशा॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: jígharmi ǀ agním ǀ havíṣā ǀ ghṛténa ǀ prati-kṣiyántam ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀpṛthúm ǀ tiraścā́ ǀ váyasā ǀ bṛhántam ǀ vyáciṣṭham ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ rabhasám ǀ dṛ́śānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer oblations with butter toAgni, who spreads through all regions, vast, expanding, with all-comprehending form, nourished (with sacrificial) food, powerful, conspicuous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वि॒श्वत॑: प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ जिघर्म्यर॒क्षसा॒ मन॑सा॒ तज्जु॑षेत । मर्य॑श्रीः स्पृह॒यद्व॑र्णो अ॒ग्निर्नाभि॒मृशे॑ त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ जर्भु॑राणः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pratyáñcam ǀ jigharmi ǀ arakṣásā ǀ mánasā ǀ tát ǀ juṣeta ǀmárya-śrīḥ ǀ spṛhayát-varṇaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ abhi-mṛ́śe ǀ tanvā́ ǀ járbhurāṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer oblations toAgni, who is present at all (sacrifices); may he accept (them), offered with an unhesitating mind, (to him) who is the refuge of man, endowed with any form that may be desired, blazing with a radiance (that it is) not (possible) to endure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ञे॒या भा॒गं स॑हसा॒नो वरे॑ण॒ त्वादू॑तासो मनु॒वद्व॑देम । अनू॑नम॒ग्निं जु॒ह्वा॑ वच॒स्या म॑धु॒पृचं॑ धन॒सा जो॑हवीमि
shlokas.transliteration: jñeyā́ḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ sahasānáḥ ǀ váreṇa ǀ tvā́-dūtāsaḥ ǀ manu-vát ǀ vadema ǀánūnam ǀ agním ǀ juhvā́ ǀ vacasyā́ ǀ madhu-pṛ́cam ǀ dhana-sā́ḥ ǀ johavīmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overpowering (your foes) with lustre, may you recognize your portion; may we, having you for our messenger, recite (praise) likeManu; desiring wealth, I offer oblation with the sacrificial ladle and with praises, to that entireAgni, who rewards (the worshipper) with the sweet (fruit) of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी हव॑मिन्द्र॒ मा रि॑षण्य॒: स्याम॑ ते दा॒वने॒ वसू॑नाम् । इ॒मा हि त्वामूर्जो॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ति वसू॒यव॒: सिन्ध॑वो॒ न क्षर॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ indra ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyaḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ te ǀ dāváne ǀ vásūnām ǀimā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣárantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hear (my) invocation; disregard it not; may we be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures; these oblations, designed to obtain wealth, flowing (abundantly) like rivers, bring to you augmented vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सृ॒जो म॒हीरि॑न्द्र॒ या अपि॑न्व॒: परि॑ष्ठिता॒ अहि॑ना शूर पू॒र्वीः । अम॑र्त्यं चिद्दा॒सं मन्य॑मान॒मवा॑भिनदु॒क्थैर्वा॑वृधा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: sṛjáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ápinvaḥ ǀ pári-sthitāḥ ǀ áhinā ǀ śūra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀámartyam ǀ cit ǀ dāsám ǀ mányamānam ǀ áva ǀ abhinat ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, you have set free the copious (waters) which were formerly arrested by Ahi, and which you have distributed; invogorated by hymns, you have cast down headlong the slave, conceiting himself immortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थेष्विन्नु शू॑र॒ येषु॑ चा॒कन्त्स्तोमे॑ष्विन्द्र रु॒द्रिये॑षु च । तुभ्येदे॒ता यासु॑ मन्दसा॒नः प्र वा॒यवे॑ सिस्रते॒ न शु॒भ्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ukthéṣu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ śūra ǀ yéṣu ǀ cākán ǀ stómeṣu ǀ indra ǀ rudríyeṣu ǀ ca ǀtúbhya ǀ ít ǀ etā́ḥ ǀ yā́su ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ prá ǀ vāyáve ǀ sisrate ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, these brilliant (laudations), in (the form of) hymns, in which you delight, and in (that of) the praises uttered by the worshipper by which you are gratified, are addressed to you, to bring you (to your sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒भ्रं नु ते॒ शुष्मं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्तः शु॒भ्रं वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोर्दधा॑नाः । शु॒भ्रस्त्वमि॑न्द्र वावृधा॒नो अ॒स्मे दासी॒र्विश॒: सूर्ये॑ण सह्याः
shlokas.transliteration: śubhrám ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀ śubhrám ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀśubhráḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ sahyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We are invigorating your brilliant strength (by our praises), and plural cing the thunderbolt in yourhands; do you,Indra, radiant, increasing in strenght, and (encouraged) by the sun, overpower, for our (good), the servile people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गुहा॑ हि॒तं गुह्यं॑ गू॒ळ्हम॒प्स्वपी॑वृतं मा॒यिनं॑ क्षि॒यन्त॑म् । उ॒तो अ॒पो द्यां त॑स्त॒भ्वांस॒मह॒न्नहिं॑ शूर वी॒र्ये॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ gúhyam ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ ápi-vṛtam ǀ māyínam ǀ kṣiyántam ǀutó íti ǀ apáḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ tastabhvā́ṃsam ǀ áhan ǀ áhim ǀ śūra ǀ vīryéṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, you have slain by your prow the glorified Ahi, hidden privy in a cave, lurking in concealment, covered by the waters in which he was abiding, and arresting the rains in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तवा॒ नु त॑ इन्द्र पू॒र्व्या म॒हान्यु॒त स्त॑वाम॒ नूत॑ना कृ॒तानि॑ । स्तवा॒ वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोरु॒शन्तं॒ स्तवा॒ हरी॒ सूर्य॑स्य के॒तू
shlokas.transliteration: stáva ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ utá ǀ stavāma ǀ nū́tanā ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀstáva ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ uśántam ǀ stáva ǀ hárī íti ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ketū́ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify,Indra, your mighty (deeds) of old; we glorify your (more) recent exploits; we praise the thunderbolt shining in your arms, and we celebrate the horses, the signs of (Indra as) the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरी॒ नु त॑ इन्द्र वा॒जय॑न्ता घृत॒श्चुतं॑ स्वा॒रम॑स्वार्ष्टाम् । वि स॑म॒ना भूमि॑रप्रथि॒ष्टारं॑स्त॒ पर्व॑तश्चित्सरि॒ष्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: hárī íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vājáyantā ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ svārám ǀ asvārṣṭām ǀví ǀ samanā́ ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ aprathiṣṭá ǀ áraṃsta ǀ párvataḥ ǀ cit ǀ sariṣyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your swift horses,Indra, have uttered a loud sound, announcing rain; the level earth anxiously expects its fall, as the gathering cloud has passed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि पर्व॑तः सा॒द्यप्र॑युच्छ॒न्त्सं मा॒तृभि॑र्वावशा॒नो अ॑क्रान् । दू॒रे पा॒रे वाणीं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्त॒ इन्द्रे॑षितां ध॒मनिं॑ पप्रथ॒न्नि
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ párvataḥ ǀ sādi ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀ sám ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ akrān ǀdūré ǀ pāré ǀ vā́ṇīm ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀ índra-iṣitām ǀ dhamánim ǀ paprathan ǀ ní ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cloud, not heedless (of its office), is suspended (in the sky); resonant with maternal (waters), it has spread about; (the winds), augmenting the sound in the distant horizon; have promulgated the voice uttered byIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ म॒हां सिन्धु॑मा॒शया॑नं माया॒विनं॑ वृ॒त्रम॑स्फुर॒न्निः । अरे॑जेतां॒ रोद॑सी भिया॒ने कनि॑क्रदतो॒ वृष्णो॑ अस्य॒ वज्रा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ síndhum ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ māyā-vínam ǀ vṛtrám ǀ asphurat ǀ níḥ ǀárejetām ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bhiyāné íti ǀ kánikradataḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vájrāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightyIndrahas shattered the guilefulVṛtrareposing in the cloud;heaven and earth shook, alarmed at the thundering bolt of the showerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरो॑रवी॒द्वृष्णो॑ अस्य॒ वज्रोऽमा॑नुषं॒ यन्मानु॑षो नि॒जूर्वा॑त् । नि मा॒यिनो॑ दान॒वस्य॑ मा॒या अपा॑दयत्पपि॒वान्त्सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: ároravīt ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ ámānuṣam ǀ yát ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ ni-jū́rvāt ǀní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ dānavásya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ ápādayat ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The thunderbolt of the showerer roared aloud, when (Indra), the friend of man, sought to slay the enemy of mankind. Drinking theSoma, he (Indra), baffled the devices of the guilefulDānava.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॑पि॒बेदि॑न्द्र शूर॒ सोमं॒ मन्द॑न्तु त्वा म॒न्दिन॑: सु॒तास॑: । पृ॒णन्त॑स्ते कु॒क्षी व॑र्धयन्त्वि॒त्था सु॒तः पौ॒र इन्द्र॑माव
shlokas.transliteration: píba-piba ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ sómam ǀ mándantu ǀ tvā ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀpṛṇántaḥ ǀ te ǀ kukṣī́ íti ǀ vardhayantu ǀ itthā́ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pauráḥ ǀ índram ǀ āva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink, hero,Indra, drink theSoma;may the exhilarating juices delight you; may they, distending your flanks, augment (your prowess), and in this manner may the replenishing effused libation satisfy Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे इ॒न्द्राप्य॑भूम॒ विप्रा॒ धियं॑ वनेम ऋत॒या सप॑न्तः । अ॒व॒स्यवो॑ धीमहि॒ प्रश॑स्तिं स॒द्यस्ते॑ रा॒यो दा॒वने॑ स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ indra ǀ ápi ǀ abhūma ǀ víprāḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ vanema ǀ ṛta-yā́ ǀ sápantaḥ ǀavasyávaḥ ǀ dhīmahi ǀ prá-śastim ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ te ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dāváne ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, your pious (worshipper), abide in you; approaching you with devotion, may we enjoy (the reward of) our adoration; desirous of protection, we meditate your glorification; may we ever be (thought worthy) of the gift of your treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्याम॒ ते त॑ इन्द्र॒ ये त॑ ऊ॒ती अ॑व॒स्यव॒ ऊर्जं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्तः । शु॒ष्मिन्त॑मं॒ यं चा॒कना॑म देवा॒स्मे र॒यिं रा॑सि वी॒रव॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: syā́ma ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ ūtī́ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ vardháyantaḥ ǀśuṣmín-tamam ǀ yám ǀ cākánāma ǀ deva ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ rāsi ǀ vīrá-vantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, (through) your (favour),Indra, be such as those are, who, desirous of your protection, augment (by their praises) your vigour; divine (Indra), you grant the wealth which we desire, (the source of) great power and of (numerous) progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रासि॒ क्षयं॒ रासि॑ मि॒त्रम॒स्मे रासि॒ शर्ध॑ इन्द्र॒ मारु॑तं नः । स॒जोष॑सो॒ ये च॑ मन्दसा॒नाः प्र वा॒यव॑: पा॒न्त्यग्र॑णीतिम्
shlokas.transliteration: rā́si ǀ kṣáyam ǀ rā́si ǀ mitrám ǀ asmé íti ǀ rā́si ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́rutam ǀ naḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ vāyávaḥ ǀ pānti ǀ ágra-nītim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You grant a habitation; you grant friends; you grant us,Indra, the strength of theMaruts; the winds, who, propitious and exulting, drink copiously of the first offering (of theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यन्त्विन्नु येषु॑ मन्दसा॒नस्तृ॒पत्सोमं॑ पाहि द्र॒ह्यदि॑न्द्र । अ॒स्मान्त्सु पृ॒त्स्वा त॑रु॒त्राव॑र्धयो॒ द्यां बृ॒हद्भि॑र॒र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: vyántu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ yéṣu ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ tṛpát ǀ sómam ǀ pāhi ǀ drahyát ǀ indra ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ tarutra ǀ ávardhayaḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ bṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let those in whom you are delighted repair (to the libation), and do you,Indra, confiding, drink the satiatingSoma; liberator (from evil), associated with the mighty and adorable (Maruts), augment our prosperity, and (that of) heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्त॒ इन्नु ये ते॑ तरुत्रो॒क्थेभि॑र्वा सु॒म्नमा॒विवा॑सान् । स्तृ॒णा॒नासो॑ ब॒र्हिः प॒स्त्या॑व॒त्त्वोता॒ इदि॑न्द्र॒ वाज॑मग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhántaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ tarutra ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ sumnám ǀ ā-vívāsān ǀstṛṇānā́saḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ pastyá-vat ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ vā́jam ǀ agman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberator (from evil), they who worship you, the giver of happiness, with holy hymns, quickly become great; they who strew the sacred grass (in honour of you) are protected by you, and, together with their famiies, obtain (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रेष्विन्नु शू॑र मन्दसा॒नस्त्रिक॑द्रुकेषु पाहि॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र । प्र॒दोधु॑व॒च्छ्मश्रु॑षु प्रीणा॒नो या॒हि हरि॑भ्यां सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ugréṣu ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ śūra ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀpra-dódhuvat ǀ śmáśruṣu ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀ yāhí ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ sutásya ǀ pītím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, exulting in the solemn Trikadruka rites quaff theSoma, and repeatedly shaking it from your beard, repair, well plural ased with your steeds, to the drinking of the effused libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धि॒ष्वा शव॑: शूर॒ येन॑ वृ॒त्रम॒वाभि॑न॒द्दानु॑मौर्णवा॒भम् । अपा॑वृणो॒र्ज्योति॒रार्या॑य॒ नि स॑व्य॒तः सा॑दि॒ दस्यु॑रिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: dhiṣvá ǀ śávaḥ ǀ śūra ǀ yéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ava-ábhinat ǀ dā́num ǀ aurṇa-vābhám ǀápa ǀ avṛṇoḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀ ní ǀ savyatáḥ ǀ sādi ǀ dásyuḥ ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, keep up the strength wherewith you have crushedVṛtra, the spider-like son ofDānu, and let open the light to theĀrya; theDasyuhas been set aside on your lefthand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सने॑म॒ ये त॑ ऊ॒तिभि॒स्तर॑न्तो॒ विश्वा॒: स्पृध॒ आर्ये॑ण॒ दस्यू॑न् । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तत्त्वा॒ष्ट्रं वि॒श्वरू॑प॒मर॑न्धयः सा॒ख्यस्य॑ त्रि॒ताय॑
shlokas.transliteration: sánema ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tárantaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ryeṇa ǀ dásyūn ǀasmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ tvāṣṭrám ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ sākhyásya ǀ tritā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us honour those men, who, through your protection, surpass all their rivals, as theDasyus(are surpassed) by theArya; this (have you wrought) for us; you have slainViśvarūpa, the son ofTvaṣṭā, through friendship ofTrita.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य सु॑वा॒नस्य॑ म॒न्दिन॑स्त्रि॒तस्य॒ न्यर्बु॑दं वावृधा॒नो अ॑स्तः । अव॑र्तय॒त्सूर्यो॒ न च॒क्रं भि॒नद्व॒लमिन्द्रो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ suvānásya ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ tritásya ǀ ní ǀ árbudam ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ astarítyastaḥ ǀávartayat ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakrám ǀ bhinát ǀ valám ǀ índraḥ ǀ áṅgirasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invigorated (by the libation) of the exultingTrita, offering you theSoma, you have annihilatedArbuda;Indra, aided by theAṅgirasa, has whirled round his bolt, as the tun turns round his wheel, and slainBala.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation, which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (which he desires); grant it to us, your prisers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard (our prayer); so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो जा॒त ए॒व प्र॑थ॒मो मन॑स्वान्दे॒वो दे॒वान्क्रतु॑ना प॒र्यभू॑षत् । यस्य॒ शुष्मा॒द्रोद॑सी॒ अभ्य॑सेतां नृ॒म्णस्य॑ म॒ह्ना स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ evá ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ mánasvān ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ krátunā ǀ pari-ábhūṣat ǀyásya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ábhyasetām ǀ nṛmṇásya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who as soon as born,is the first (of the deities); who has done honour to the gods by his exploits; he, at whose might heaven and earth are alarmed, and (who is known) by the greatness of his strength, he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः पृ॑थि॒वीं व्यथ॑माना॒मदृं॑ह॒द्यः पर्व॑ता॒न्प्रकु॑पिताँ॒ अर॑म्णात् । यो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं विम॒मे वरी॑यो॒ यो द्यामस्त॑भ्ना॒त्स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ vyáthamānām ǀ ádṛṃhat ǀ yáḥ ǀ párvatān ǀ prá-kupitān ǀ áramṇāt ǀyáḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ vi-mamé ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ástabhnāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who fixed firm the moving earth; who tranquilized the incensed mountains; who spread the spacious firmament; who consolidated the heaven; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ह॒त्वाहि॒मरि॑णात्स॒प्त सिन्धू॒न्यो गा उ॒दाज॑दप॒धा व॒लस्य॑ । यो अश्म॑नोर॒न्तर॒ग्निं ज॒जान॑ सं॒वृक्स॒मत्सु॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ hatvā́ ǀ áhim ǀ áriṇāt ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀ yáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ut-ā́jat ǀ apa-dhā́ ǀ valásya ǀyáḥ ǀ áśmanoḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ agním ǀ jajā́na ǀ sam-vṛ́k ǀ samát-su ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who having destroyed Ahi, set free the seven rivers; who recovered the cows detained byBala; who genitive rated fire in the clouds; who is invincible in battle; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येने॒मा विश्वा॒ च्यव॑ना कृ॒तानि॒ यो दासं॒ वर्ण॒मध॑रं॒ गुहाक॑: । श्व॒घ्नीव॒ यो जि॑गी॒वाँल्ल॒क्षमाद॑द॒र्यः पु॒ष्टानि॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ imā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cyávanā ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ yáḥ ǀ dā́sam ǀ várṇam ǀ ádharam ǀ gúhā ǀ ákarítyakaḥ ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ jigīvā́n ǀ lakṣám ǀ ā́dat ǀ aryáḥ ǀ puṣṭā́ni ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, by whom all these perishable (regions) have been made; who consigned the base servile tribe to the cavern; who seizes triumphant the cherished (tresures) of the enemy, as a hunter (strikes) his prey; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं स्मा॑ पृ॒च्छन्ति॒ कुह॒ सेति॑ घो॒रमु॒तेमा॑हु॒र्नैषो अ॒स्तीत्ये॑नम् । सो अ॒र्यः पु॒ष्टीर्विज॑ इ॒वा मि॑नाति॒ श्रद॑स्मै धत्त॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ sma ǀ pṛcchánti ǀ kúha ǀ sáḥ ǀ íti ǀ ghorám ǀ utá ǀ īm ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ asti ǀ íti ǀ enam ǀsáḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ puṣṭī́ḥ ǀ víjaḥ-iva ǀ ā́ ǀ mināti ǀ śrát ǀ asmai ǀ dhatta ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, whom, terrible, they ask for, (saying), Where is he? or, verily, they say of him, he is not (in any one plural ce); but who, inflicting (chastisement), destroys the cherisshed (treasures) of the enemy; in him have faith; for he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो र॒ध्रस्य॑ चोदि॒ता यः कृ॒शस्य॒ यो ब्र॒ह्मणो॒ नाध॑मानस्य की॒रेः । यु॒क्तग्रा॑व्णो॒ योऽवि॒ता सु॑शि॒प्रः सु॒तसो॑मस्य॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ radhrásya ǀ coditā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kṛśásya ǀ yáḥ ǀ brahmáṇaḥ ǀ nā́dhamānasya ǀ kīréḥ ǀyuktá-grāvṇaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ su-śipráḥ ǀ sutá-somasya ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who is the encourager of the rich, and of the poor, and of the priest, who recites his praise, and is a suppliant; who, of goodly features, is the protector of him, who, with ready stones, expresses theSomajuice; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्याश्वा॑सः प्र॒दिशि॒ यस्य॒ गावो॒ यस्य॒ ग्रामा॒ यस्य॒ विश्वे॒ रथा॑सः । यः सूर्यं॒ य उ॒षसं॑ ज॒जान॒ यो अ॒पां ने॒ता स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ pra-díśi ǀ yásya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ grā́māḥ ǀ yásya ǀ víśve ǀ ráthāsaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ yáḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ jajā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ netā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, under whose control are horses and cattle, and villages, and all chariots; he who gave birth to the sun and to the dawn; and who is the leader of the waters; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं क्रन्द॑सी संय॒ती वि॒ह्वये॑ते॒ परेऽव॑र उ॒भया॑ अ॒मित्रा॑: । स॒मा॒नं चि॒द्रथ॑मातस्थि॒वांसा॒ नाना॑ हवेते॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ krándasī íti ǀ saṃyatī́ íti sam-yatī́ ǀ vihváyete íti vi-hváyete ǀ páre ǀ ávare ǀ ubháyāḥ ǀ amítrāḥ ǀsamānám ǀ cit ǀ rátham ǀ ātasthi-vā́ṃsā ǀ nā́nā ǀ havete íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom (two hosts), calling and mutually encountering, call upon; whom both adversaries, high and low, (appeal to); whom two (charioteers), standing in the same car, severally invoke; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॒न्न ऋ॒ते वि॒जय॑न्ते॒ जना॑सो॒ यं युध्य॑माना॒ अव॑से॒ हव॑न्ते । यो विश्व॑स्य प्रति॒मानं॑ ब॒भूव॒ यो अ॑च्युत॒च्युत्स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ vi-jáyante ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ yám ǀ yúdhyamānāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǀyáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ babhū́va ǀ yáḥ ǀ acyuta-cyút ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Without whom men do not conquer; whom, when engaged in conflict, they invoke for succour; he, who is the prototype of the universe and the caster down of the unyielding; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः शश्व॑तो॒ मह्येनो॒ दधा॑ना॒नम॑न्यमाना॒ञ्छर्वा॑ ज॒घान॑ । यः शर्ध॑ते॒ नानु॒ददा॑ति शृ॒ध्यां यो दस्यो॑र्ह॒न्ता स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ máhi ǀ énaḥ ǀ dádhānān ǀ ámanyamānān ǀ śárvā ǀ jaghā́na ǀyáḥ ǀ śárdhate ǀ ná ǀ anu-dádāti ǀ śṛdhyā́m ǀ yáḥ ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ hantā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who with the thunderbolt has destroyed many committing great sin, and offering (him) no homage; who grants not success to the confident; who is the slayer of theDasyus; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः शम्ब॑रं॒ पर्व॑तेषु क्षि॒यन्तं॑ चत्वारिं॒श्यां श॒रद्य॒न्ववि॑न्दत् । ओ॒जा॒यमा॑नं॒ यो अहिं॑ ज॒घान॒ दानुं॒ शया॑नं॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śámbaram ǀ párvateṣu ǀ kṣiyántam ǀ catvāriṃśyā́m ǀ śarádi ǀ anu-ávindat ǀojāyámānam ǀ yáḥ ǀ áhim ǀ jaghā́na ǀ dā́num ǀ śáyānam ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who discoveredŚambaradwelling in the mountains for forty years; who slew Ahi, growing in strength, and the sleeping son ofDānu; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः स॒प्तर॑श्मिर्वृष॒भस्तुवि॑ष्मान॒वासृ॑ज॒त्सर्त॑वे स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न् । यो रौ॑हि॒णमस्फु॑र॒द्वज्र॑बाहु॒र्द्यामा॒रोह॑न्तं॒ स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ saptá-raśmiḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀ ava-ásṛjat ǀ sártave ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀyáḥ ǀ rauhiṇám ǀ ásphurat ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ā-róhantam ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the seven-rayed, the showerer, the powerful, who let loose the seven rivers to flow; who, armed with the thunderbolt, crushedRauhiṇawhen scaling heaven; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावा॑ चिदस्मै पृथि॒वी न॑मेते॒ शुष्मा॑च्चिदस्य॒ पर्व॑ता भयन्ते । यः सो॑म॒पा नि॑चि॒तो वज्र॑बाहु॒र्यो वज्र॑हस्त॒: स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ namete íti ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ bhayante ǀyáḥ ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ ni-citáḥ ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, to whom heaven and earth bow down; he, at whose might the mountains are appalled; he, who is the drinker of theSoma, the firm (of frame), the adamant-armed, the wielder of the thunderbolt; he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सु॒न्वन्त॒मव॑ति॒ यः पच॑न्तं॒ यः शंस॑न्तं॒ यः श॑शमा॒नमू॒ती । यस्य॒ ब्रह्म॒ वर्ध॑नं॒ यस्य॒ सोमो॒ यस्ये॒दं राध॒: स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sunvántam ǀ ávati ǀ yáḥ ǀ pácantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ śáṃsantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ śaśamānám ǀ ūtī́ ǀyásya ǀ bráhma ǀ várdhanam ǀ yásya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ idám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who protects (the worshipper) offering the libation, or preparing (the mixed curds and butter), repeating his praise and soliciting his assistance, he, of whom the sacred prayer, the (offered)Soma, the (presented sacrificial) food, augment (the vigour); he, men, isIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सु॑न्व॒ते पच॑ते दु॒ध्र आ चि॒द्वाजं॒ दर्द॑र्षि॒ स किला॑सि स॒त्यः । व॒यं त॑ इन्द्र वि॒श्वह॑ प्रि॒यास॑: सु॒वीरा॑सो वि॒दथ॒मा व॑देम
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ pácate ǀ dudhráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ vā́jam ǀ dárdarṣi ǀ sáḥ ǀ kíla ǀ asi ǀ satyáḥ ǀvayám ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ viśváha ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vidátham ǀ ā́ ǀ vadema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are difficult of approach; you, verily, are a true (benefactor), who bestows (abundant) food upon him who offers the libation, who prepares (the mixed curds and butter); may we, enjoying your favour, blessed with progeny, daily repeat (your praises) at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तुर्जनि॑त्री॒ तस्या॑ अ॒पस्परि॑ म॒क्षू जा॒त आवि॑श॒द्यासु॒ वर्ध॑ते । तदा॑ह॒ना अ॑भवत्पि॒प्युषी॒ पयों॒ऽशोः पी॒यूषं॑ प्रथ॒मं तदु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtúḥ ǀ jánitrī ǀ tásyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ pári ǀ makṣú ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aviśat ǀ yā́su ǀ várdhate ǀtát ǀ āhanā́ḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ pipyúṣī ǀ páyaḥ ǀ aṃśóḥ ǀ pīyúṣam ǀ prathamám ǀ tát ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The season (of the rains) is the parent (of theSoma), which, as soon as born of her, enters into the waters in which it grows; thence it is fit for expression, as concentrating (the essence of the) water, and the juice of the Soma is especially to be praised (as the libation proper forIndra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ध्रीमा य॑न्ति॒ परि॒ बिभ्र॑ती॒: पयो॑ वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑य॒ प्र भ॑रन्त॒ भोज॑नम् । स॒मा॒नो अध्वा॑ प्र॒वता॑मनु॒ष्यदे॒ यस्ताकृ॑णोः प्रथ॒मं सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sadhrī́ ǀ īm ǀ ā́ ǀ yanti ǀ pári ǀ bíbhratīḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ viśvá-psnyāya ǀ prá ǀ bharanta ǀ bhójanam ǀsamānáḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ pra-vátām ǀ anu-syáde ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The aggregated (streams) come, bearing everywhere the water, and conveying it as sustenance for the asylum of all rivers, (the ocean); the samepath is (assigned) to all the descending (currents) to follow; and as he, who has (assigned) them (their course), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्वेको॑ वदति॒ यद्ददा॑ति॒ तद्रू॒पा मि॒नन्तद॑पा॒ एक॑ ईयते । विश्वा॒ एक॑स्य वि॒नुद॑स्तितिक्षते॒ यस्ताकृ॑णोः प्रथ॒मं सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vadati ǀ yát ǀ dádāti ǀ tát ǀ rūpā́ ǀ minán ǀ tát-apāḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ īyate ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ékasya ǀ vi-núdaḥ ǀ titikṣate ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (priest) announces (the offering) that he, (the instrumental tutor of the rite) presents; another performs the act that apportions the limbs (of the victim); a third corrects all the deficiencies of either, and as he, who has enjoyed these (functions), your, (Indra), are especially to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒जाभ्य॑: पु॒ष्टिं वि॒भज॑न्त आसते र॒यिमि॑व पृ॒ष्ठं प्र॒भव॑न्तमाय॒ते । असि॑न्व॒न्दंष्ट्रै॑: पि॒तुर॑त्ति॒ भोज॑नं॒ यस्ताकृ॑णोः प्रथ॒मं सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ vi-bhájantaḥ ǀ āsate ǀ rayím-iva ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ pra-bhávantam ǀ ā-yaté ǀásinvan ǀ dáṃṣṭraiḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ atti ǀ bhójanam ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Distributing nourishment to their progeny, they, (the householders), abide (in their dwellings), as if offering ample and sustaining wealth to a guest; constructing (useful works, a man) eats with his teeth the food (given him) by (his) protector and as he, who has enjoined these (things to be done), you, (Indra), are especially to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑कृणोः पृथि॒वीं सं॒दृशे॑ दि॒वे यो धौ॑ती॒नाम॑हिह॒न्नारि॑णक्प॒थः । तं त्वा॒ स्तोमे॑भिरु॒दभि॒र्न वा॒जिनं॑ दे॒वं दे॒वा अ॑जन॒न्त्सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ sam-dṛ́śe ǀ divé ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhautīnā́m ǀ ahi-han ǀ áriṇak ǀ patháḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ devám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ajanan ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as you have rendered earth visible to heaven, and have set open the path of the rivers by slaying Ahi; therefore the gods have rendered you divine by praises, as (men) invigorate a horse by water; (and) you are, (Indra), to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो भोज॑नं च॒ दय॑से च॒ वर्ध॑नमा॒र्द्रादा शुष्कं॒ मधु॑मद्दु॒दोहि॑थ । स शे॑व॒धिं नि द॑धिषे वि॒वस्व॑ति॒ विश्व॒स्यैक॑ ईशिषे॒ सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bhójanam ǀ ca ǀ dáyase ǀ ca ǀ várdhanam ǀ ārdrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ śúṣkam ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ dudóhitha ǀsáḥ ǀ śeva-dhím ǀ ní ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ vivásvati ǀ víśvasya ǀ ékaḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are he) who bestows both food and increase, and milk the dry nutritious (grain) from out of the humid stalk; he, who gives wealth to the worshipper, and are sole sovereign of the universe you are he, (Indra), who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः पु॒ष्पिणी॑श्च प्र॒स्व॑श्च॒ धर्म॒णाधि॒ दाने॒ व्य१॒॑वनी॒रधा॑रयः । यश्चास॑मा॒ अज॑नो दि॒द्युतो॑ दि॒व उ॒रुरू॒र्वाँ अ॒भित॒: सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ puṣpíṇīḥ ǀ ca ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ ádhi ǀ dā́ne ǀ ví ǀ avánīḥ ǀ ádhārayaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ca ǀ ásamāḥ ǀ ájanaḥ ǀ didyútaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ urúḥ ǀ ūrvā́n ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who have caused, by culture, the flowering and fruitful (plural nts) to spread over the field; who have genitive rated the various luminaries of heaven; and who, of vast bulk, comprehend vast (bodies); you are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ना॑र्म॒रं स॒हव॑सुं॒ निह॑न्तवे पृ॒क्षाय॑ च दा॒सवे॑शाय॒ चाव॑हः । ऊ॒र्जय॑न्त्या॒ अप॑रिविष्टमा॒स्य॑मु॒तैवाद्य पु॑रुकृ॒त्सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ nārmarám ǀ sahá-vasum ǀ ní-hantave ǀ pṛkṣā́ya ǀ ca ǀ dāsá-veśāya ǀ ca ǀ ávahaḥ ǀūrjáyantyāḥ ǀ ápari-viṣṭam ǀ āsyám ǀ utá ǀ evá ǀ adyá ǀ puru-kṛt ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, who are (famed for) many exploits, put on today an unclouded countenance, (as prepared) to slay Sahavasu, the son of Nṛmara, with the sharpened (edge of the thunderbolt), in defence of the (sacrificial) food, and for the destruction ofdasyu; you are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं वा॒ यस्य॒ दश॑ सा॒कमाद्य॒ एक॑स्य श्रु॒ष्टौ यद्ध॑ चो॒दमावि॑थ । अ॒र॒ज्जौ दस्यू॒न्त्समु॑नब्द॒भीत॑ये सुप्रा॒व्यो॑ अभव॒: सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ vā ǀ yásya ǀ dáśa ǀ sākám ǀ ā́ ǀ ádyaḥ ǀ ékasya ǀ śruṣṭáu ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ codám ǀ ā́vitha ǀarajjáu ǀ dásyūn ǀ sám ǀ unap ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ supra-avyáḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, for whose sole plural asure a thousand (steeds are ready); by whom all are to be fed; and who protects the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice); who, for the sake ofDabhīti, has caste theDasyusinto unfettered (captivity), and who are to be approached (by all), you are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वेदनु॑ रोध॒ना अ॑स्य॒ पौंस्यं॑ द॒दुर॑स्मै दधि॒रे कृ॒त्नवे॒ धन॑म् । षळ॑स्तभ्ना वि॒ष्टिर॒: पञ्च॑ सं॒दृश॒: परि॑ प॒रो अ॑भव॒: सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ít ǀ ánu ǀ rodhanā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ dadúḥ ǀ asmai ǀ dadhiré ǀ kṛtnáve ǀ dhánam ǀṣáṭ ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ vi-stíraḥ ǀ páñca ǀ sam-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ pári ǀ paráḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are he, from whose manhood all the rivers (have proceeded); to whom (the pious) have given (offerings); to whom, doer of mighty deeds, they have presented wealth; you are he, who have regulated the six expansive (objects), and are the protector of the five (races), that look up to you; you are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्र॒वा॒च॒नं तव॑ वीर वी॒र्यं१॒॑ यदेके॑न॒ क्रतु॑ना वि॒न्दसे॒ वसु॑ । जा॒तूष्ठि॑रस्य॒ प्र वय॒: सह॑स्वतो॒ या च॒कर्थ॒ सेन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑स्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-pravācanám ǀ táva ǀ vīra ǀ vīryám ǀ yát ǀ ékena ǀ krátunā ǀ vindáse ǀ vásu ǀjātū́-sthirasya ǀ prá ǀ váyaḥ ǀ sáhasvataḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ cakártha ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ víśvā ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your heroism, hero, is to be glorified, by which, with single effort, you have acquired wealth; (wherewith) the (sacrificial) food of (every) solemn and constant (ceremony is provided); for all (the acts) you have performed, you,Indra, are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर॑मय॒: सर॑पस॒स्तरा॑य॒ कं तु॒र्वीत॑ये च व॒य्या॑य च स्रु॒तिम् । नी॒चा सन्त॒मुद॑नयः परा॒वृजं॒ प्रान्धं श्रो॒णं श्र॒वय॒न्त्सास्यु॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áramayaḥ ǀ sára-apasaḥ ǀ tárāya ǀ kám ǀ turvī́taye ǀ ca ǀ vayyā́ya ǀ ca ǀ srutím ǀnīcā́ ǀ sántam ǀ út ǀ anayaḥ ǀ parā-vṛ́jam ǀ prá ǀ andhám ǀ śroṇám ǀ śraváyan ǀ sáḥ ǀ asi ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have provided a passage for the easy crossing of the flowing waters for Turvati andVayya; rendering (yourself) renowned, you have uplifted the blind and lame Paravṛj from the lowliness (of affliction); you are he who is to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्व॑सो दा॒नाय॒ राध॒: सम॑र्थयस्व ब॒हु ते॑ वस॒व्य॑म् । इन्द्र॒ यच्चि॒त्रं श्र॑व॒स्या अनु॒ द्यून्बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ vaso íti ǀ dānā́ya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ arthayasva ǀ bahú ǀ te ǀ vasavyám ǀíndra ǀ yát ǀ citrám ǀ śravasyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of riches, exert your ability to bestow wealth upon us; for yours is great affluence; may you,Indra, be disposed to grant us exceeding abundance day by day, so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at (our) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ भर॒तेन्द्रा॑य॒ सोम॒माम॑त्रेभिः सिञ्चता॒ मद्य॒मन्ध॑: । का॒मी हि वी॒रः सद॑मस्य पी॒तिं जु॒होत॒ वृष्णे॒ तदिदे॒ष व॑ष्टि
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ bhárata ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ ā́ ǀ ámatrebhiḥ ǀ siñcata ǀ mádyam ǀ ándhaḥ ǀkāmī́ ǀ hí ǀ vīráḥ ǀ sádam ǀ asya ǀ pītím ǀ juhóta ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ vaṣṭi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, bring theSomalibation forIndra; sprinkle with ladles the exhilarating beverage; he, the hero, is ever desirous of the draught; offer the libation to the showerer (of benefits), for, verily, he desires it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यो अ॒पो व॑व्रि॒वांसं॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॒घाना॒शन्ये॑व वृ॒क्षम् । तस्मा॑ ए॒तं भ॑रत तद्व॒शायँ॑ ए॒ष इन्द्रो॑ अर्हति पी॒तिम॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghā́na ǀ aśányā-iva ǀ vṛkṣám ǀtásmai ǀ etám ǀ bharata ǀ tat-vaśā́ya ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ arhati ǀ pītím ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, offer the libation to him who slew the rain-arrestingVṛtra, as (he strikes down) a tree with (his) thunderbolt; to him who desires it; andIndrais worthy of (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यो दृभी॑कं ज॒घान॒ यो गा उ॒दाज॒दप॒ हि व॒लं वः । तस्मा॑ ए॒तम॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ न वात॒मिन्द्रं॒ सोमै॒रोर्णु॑त॒ जूर्न वस्त्रै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dṛ́bhīkam ǀ jaghā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ut-ā́jat ǀ ápa ǀ hí ǀ valám ǀ váríti váḥ ǀtásmai ǀ etám ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ná ǀ vā́tam ǀ índram ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ūrṇuta ǀ jū́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ vástraiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, offer this libation, which, like the wind in the firmament, (is the cause of rain), to him who slew Dṛbhīka, destroyedBala, andliberated the cows; heapIndrawithSoma, as an old man (is covered) with garments.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ य उर॑णं ज॒घान॒ नव॑ च॒ख्वांसं॑ नव॒तिं च॑ बा॒हून् । यो अर्बु॑द॒मव॑ नी॒चा ब॑बा॒धे तमिन्द्रं॒ सोम॑स्य भृ॒थे हि॑नोत
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ úraṇam ǀ jaghā́na ǀ náva ǀ cakhvā́ṃsam ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ bāhū́n ǀyáḥ ǀ árbudam ǀ áva ǀ nīcā́ ǀ babādhé ǀ tám ǀ índram ǀ sómasya ǀ bhṛthé ǀ hinota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, propitiate, by the offering of theSomathatIndra, who slewUraṇa, displaying nine and ninety arms; and hurledArbudadown headlong.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यः स्वश्नं॑ ज॒घान॒ यः शुष्ण॑म॒शुषं॒ यो व्यं॑सम् । यः पिप्रुं॒ नमु॑चिं॒ यो रु॑धि॒क्रां तस्मा॒ इन्द्रा॒यान्ध॑सो जुहोत
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ sú ǀ áśnam ǀ jaghā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ aśúṣam ǀ yáḥ ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀyáḥ ǀ píprum ǀ námucim ǀ yáḥ ǀ rudhi-krā́m ǀ tásmai ǀ índrāya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, offer theSomato thatIndra, who slew Svaśna, the unabsorbableŚuṣṇa, and mutilated (Vṛtra), who destroyed Pipru,Namuciand Rudhikrā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यः श॒तं शम्ब॑रस्य॒ पुरो॑ बि॒भेदाश्म॑नेव पू॒र्वीः । यो व॒र्चिन॑: श॒तमिन्द्र॑: स॒हस्र॑म॒पाव॑प॒द्भर॑ता॒ सोम॑मस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śatám ǀ śámbarasya ǀ púraḥ ǀ bibhéda ǀ áśmanā-iva ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ varcínaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ apa-ávapat ǀ bhárata ǀ sómam ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, present theSomato him who, with the adamantine (thuderbolt), demolished the hundred ancient cities ofŚambara, and cast down the hundred thousand (descendants) of Varcin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यः श॒तमा स॒हस्रं॒ भूम्या॑ उ॒पस्थेऽव॑पज्जघ॒न्वान् । कुत्स॑स्या॒योर॑तिथि॒ग्वस्य॑ वी॒रान्न्यावृ॑ण॒ग्भर॑ता॒ सोम॑मस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śatám ǀ ā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ bhū́myāḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ávapat ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀkútsasya ǀ āyóḥ ǀ atithi-gvásya ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ní ǀ ávṛṇak ǀ bhárata ǀ sómam ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, present theSomato him, who, slaying hundreds and thousands (ofasuras), cast them down upon the lap of the earth; who destroyed the assailants ofKutsa, Āyu andAtithigva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यन्न॑रः का॒मया॑ध्वे श्रु॒ष्टी वह॑न्तो नशथा॒ तदिन्द्रे॑ । गभ॑स्तिपूतं भरत श्रु॒तायेन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमं॑ यज्यवो जुहोत
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ naraḥ ǀ kamáyādhve ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ váhantaḥ ǀ naśatha ǀ tát ǀ índre ǀgábhasti-pūtam ǀ bharata ǀ śrutā́ya ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ yajyavaḥ ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, leaders (of the ceremony), may you, quickly bringing the offering toIndra, receive that (recompense) which you may desire; solemnizing the sacrifice, offer theSoma, purified by expressing, to the renowned Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यव॒: कर्त॑ना श्रु॒ष्टिम॑स्मै॒ वने॒ निपू॑तं॒ वन॒ उन्न॑यध्वम् । जु॒षा॒णो हस्त्य॑म॒भि वा॑वशे व॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमं॑ मदि॒रं जु॑होत
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ kártana ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ asmai ǀ váne ǀ ní-pūtam ǀ váne ǀ út ǀ nayadhvam ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ hástyam ǀ abhí ǀ vāvaśe ǀ vaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ madirám ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, offer to him the prompt (libation); lift it up, purified with water, in the ladle; well plural ased, he desires it from yourhand; present the exhilaratingSomatoIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यव॒: पय॒सोध॒र्यथा॒ गोः सोमे॑भिरीं पृणता भो॒जमिन्द्र॑म् । वेदा॒हम॑स्य॒ निभृ॑तं म ए॒तद्दित्स॑न्तं॒ भूयो॑ यज॒तश्चि॑केत
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ góḥ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ īm ǀ pṛṇata ǀ bhojám ǀ índram ǀvéda ǀ ahám ǀ asya ǀ ní-bhṛtam ǀ me ǀ etát ǀ dítsantam ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ ciketa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, fill the bountifulIndrawith libations as the udder of a cow is filled with milk; so shall the adorable (Indra) fully comprehend (the liberality) of him who desires to present the gift, and shall say (to him), I acknowledge the secret (virtue) of this my (draught).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवो॒ यो दि॒व्यस्य॒ वस्वो॒ यः पार्थि॑वस्य॒ क्षम्य॑स्य॒ राजा॑ । तमूर्द॑रं॒ न पृ॑णता॒ यवे॒नेन्द्रं॒ सोमे॑भि॒स्तदपो॑ वो अस्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ kṣámyasya ǀ rā́jā ǀtám ǀ ū́rdaram ǀ ná ǀ pṛṇata ǀ yávena ǀ índram ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ tát ǀ ápaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, fill with libations, as a granary (is filled) with barley,Indra, who is the lord of the riches of heaven, of mid-heaven, of earth; and may such (pious) act be for your (good).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्व॑सो दा॒नाय॒ राध॒: सम॑र्थयस्व ब॒हु ते॑ वस॒व्य॑म् । इन्द्र॒ यच्चि॒त्रं श्र॑व॒स्या अनु॒ द्यून्बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ vaso íti ǀ dānā́ya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ arthayasva ǀ bahú ǀ te ǀ vasavyám ǀíndra ǀ yát ǀ citrám ǀ śravasyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of riches, exert your ability to bestow wealth upon us; for yours is great affluence; may, you,Indra, be disposed to grant us exceeding abundance day by day, so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र घा॒ न्व॑स्य मह॒तो म॒हानि॑ स॒त्या स॒त्यस्य॒ कर॑णानि वोचम् । त्रिक॑द्रुकेष्वपिबत्सु॒तस्या॒स्य मदे॒ अहि॒मिन्द्रो॑ जघान
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ gha ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ satyā́ ǀ satyásya ǀ káraṇāni ǀ vocam ǀtrí-kadrukeṣu ǀ apibat ǀ sutásya ǀ asyá ǀ máde ǀ áhim ǀ índraḥ ǀ jaghāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, I proclaim the great and authentic deeds of the mighty and true (Indra); of him who drank the effusedSomaat the Trikadruka rites, and in his exhilaration slew Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वं॒शे द्याम॑स्तभायद्बृ॒हन्त॒मा रोद॑सी अपृणद॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स धा॑रयत्पृथि॒वीं प॒प्रथ॑च्च॒ सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: avaṃśé ǀ dyā́m ǀ astabhāyat ǀ bṛhántam ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇat ǀ antárikṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ dhārayat ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ papráthat ǀ ca ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who fixed the heaven in unsupported (space) and filled the spacious firmament, and heaven and earth, (with light); he it is who has upheld, and has made the earth renowned; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सद्मे॑व॒ प्राचो॒ वि मि॑माय॒ मानै॒र्वज्रे॑ण॒ खान्य॑तृणन्न॒दीना॑म् । वृथा॑सृजत्प॒थिभि॑र्दीर्घया॒थैः सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: sádma-iva ǀ prā́caḥ ǀ ví ǀ mimāya ǀ mā́naiḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ khā́ni ǀ atṛṇat ǀ nadī́nām ǀvṛ́thā ǀ asṛjat ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ dīrgha-yātháiḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(He it is) who has measured the eastern (quarters) with measures like a chamber; who has dug with the thunderbolt the beds of the rivers, and has easily sent them forth by long-continued paths; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॑वो॒ळ्हॄन्प॑रि॒गत्या॑ द॒भीते॒र्विश्व॑मधा॒गायु॑धमि॒द्धे अ॒ग्नौ । सं गोभि॒रश्वै॑रसृज॒द्रथे॑भि॒: सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pra-voḷhṝ́n ǀ pari-gátya ǀ dabhī́teḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ adhāk ǀ ā́yudham ǀ iddhé ǀ agnáu ǀsám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Encountering the (asuras), carrying offDabhiti, he burnt all their weapons in a kindled fire, and enriched (the prince) with their cattle, their horses and their chariots; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॑ म॒हीं धुनि॒मेतो॑ररम्णा॒त्सो अ॑स्ना॒तॄन॑पारयत्स्व॒स्ति । त उ॒त्स्नाय॑ र॒यिम॒भि प्र त॑स्थु॒: सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ mahī́m ǀ dhúnim ǀ étoḥ ǀ aramṇāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ asnātṝ́n ǀ apārayat ǀ svastí ǀté ǀ ut-snā́ya ǀ rayím ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He tranquilized this great river, (so that it) might be crossed; he conveyed across it in safety (the sages) who had been unable to pass over it, and who, having crossed, proceeded to realize the wealthy they sought; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोद॑ञ्चं॒ सिन्धु॑मरिणान्महि॒त्वा वज्रे॒णान॑ उ॒षस॒: सं पि॑पेष । अ॒ज॒वसो॑ ज॒विनी॑भिर्विवृ॒श्चन्त्सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ údañcam ǀ síndhum ǀ ariṇāt ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ ánaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ pipeṣa ǀajavásaḥ ǀ javínībhiḥ ǀ vi-vṛścán ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By his great power he turned theSindhutowards the north; with his thunderbolt he ground to pieces the wagon of the dawn, scattering the tardy enemy with his swift forces; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वि॒द्वाँ अ॑पगो॒हं क॒नीना॑मा॒विर्भव॒न्नुद॑तिष्ठत्परा॒वृक् । प्रति॑ श्रो॒णः स्था॒द्व्य१॒॑नग॑चष्ट॒ सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ apa-gohám ǀ kanī́nām ǀ āvíḥ ǀ bhávan ǀ út ǀ atiṣṭhat ǀ parā-vṛ́k ǀpráti ǀ śroṇáḥ ǀ sthāt ǀ ví ǀ anák ǀ acaṣṭa ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conscious of the disappearance of the damsels, the (ṛṣi) Parivṛj, becoming manifest, stood up; the lame man overtook (them), the blind man beheld (them); in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भि॒नद्व॒लमङ्गि॑रोभिर्गृणा॒नो वि पर्व॑तस्य दृंहि॒तान्यै॑रत् । रि॒णग्रोधां॑सि कृ॒त्रिमा॑ण्येषां॒ सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: bhinát ǀ valám ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ párvatasya ǀ dṛṃhitā́ni ǀ airat ǀriṇák ǀ ródhāṃsi ǀ kṛtrímāṇi ǀ eṣām ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised by theAṅgirasas, he destroyedBala; he forced upon the firmshut(doors) of the mountain; he broke down their artificial defences; in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वप्ने॑ना॒भ्युप्या॒ चुमु॑रिं॒ धुनिं॑ च ज॒घन्थ॒ दस्युं॒ प्र द॒भीति॑मावः । र॒म्भी चि॒दत्र॑ विविदे॒ हिर॑ण्यं॒ सोम॑स्य॒ ता मद॒ इन्द्र॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: svápnena ǀ abhi-úpya ǀ cúmurim ǀ dhúnim ǀ ca ǀ jaghántha ǀ dásyum ǀ prá ǀ dabhī́tim ǀ āvaḥ ǀrambhī́ ǀ cit ǀ átra ǀ vivide ǀ híraṇyam ǀ sómasya ǀ tā́ ǀ máde ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain theDasyusCumuri andDhuni, having cast them into (profound) sleep; you have protectedDabhīti, while his chamberlain gained in that (contest) the gold (of theasuras); in the exhilaration of theSoma,Indrahas done these (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you the boon (that he desires); grant it to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑: स॒तां ज्येष्ठ॑तमाय सुष्टु॒तिम॒ग्नावि॑व समिधा॒ने ह॒विर्भ॑रे । इन्द्र॑मजु॒र्यं ज॒रय॑न्तमुक्षि॒तं स॒नाद्युवा॑न॒मव॑से हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ satā́m ǀ jyéṣṭhatamāya ǀ su-stutím ǀ agnáu-iva ǀ sam-idhāné ǀ havíḥ ǀ bhare ǀíndram ǀ ajuryám ǀ jaráyantam ǀ ukṣitám ǀ sanā́t ǀ yúvānam ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bear the libation for you to the best of the holy (gods, to be poured) on the kindled fire, (and I offer to him fitting praise); we invoke for (our) protection the ever-youthfulIndra, the undecaying, the causer of decay, sprinkled (with theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॒दिन्द्रा॑द्बृह॒तः किं च॒नेमृ॒ते विश्वा॑न्यस्मि॒न्त्सम्भृ॒ताधि॑ वी॒र्या॑ । ज॒ठरे॒ सोमं॑ त॒न्वी॒३॒॑ सहो॒ महो॒ हस्ते॒ वज्रं॒ भर॑ति शी॒र्षणि॒ क्रतु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ índrāt ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ īm ǀ ṛté ǀ víśvāni ǀ asmin ǀ sám-bhṛtā ǀ ádhi ǀ vīryā́ ǀjaṭháre ǀ sómam ǀ tanví ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ máhaḥ ǀ háste ǀ vájram ǀ bhárati ǀ śīrṣáṇi ǀ krátum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For without that mightyIndra, this (world) were nothing; in him all powers whatever are aggregated; he receives theSomainto his stomach, and in his body (exhibits) strength and energy; he bears the thunderbolt in hishand, and wisdom in his head.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न क्षो॒णीभ्यां॑ परि॒भ्वे॑ त इन्द्रि॒यं न स॑मु॒द्रैः पर्व॑तैरिन्द्र ते॒ रथ॑: । न ते॒ वज्र॒मन्व॑श्नोति॒ कश्च॒न यदा॒शुभि॒: पत॑सि॒ योज॑ना पु॒रु
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ kṣoṇī́bhyām ǀ pari-bhvé ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ ná ǀ samudráiḥ ǀ párvataiḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ráthaḥ ǀná ǀ te ǀ vájram ǀ ánu ǀ aśnoti ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ yát ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ pátasi ǀ yójanā ǀ purú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your might,Indra, is not to be overcome by (that of) heaven and earth; nor is your chariot (to be stopped) by oceans or by mountains; no one can escape from your thunderbolt, when you traverse many leagues with rapid (horses).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ ह्य॑स्मै यज॒ताय॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॒ क्रतुं॒ भर॑न्ति वृष॒भाय॒ सश्च॑ते । वृषा॑ यजस्व ह॒विषा॑ वि॒दुष्ट॑र॒: पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोमं॑ वृष॒भेण॑ भा॒नुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ asmai ǀ yajatā́ya ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǀ krátum ǀ bháranti ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ sáścate ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ yajasva ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀ píba ǀ indra ǀ sómam ǀ vṛṣabhéṇa ǀ bhānúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All men offer worship to that adorable, powerful, and munificent (Indra), who is associated (with praise); therefore, (do you), who are liberal and most wise, worship him with oblations; and drink, Indra, theSoma, together with the Sun, the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष्ण॒: कोश॑: पवते॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिर्वृ॑ष॒भान्ना॑य वृष॒भाय॒ पात॑वे । वृष॑णाध्व॒र्यू वृ॑ष॒भासो॒ अद्र॑यो॒ वृष॑णं॒ सोमं॑ वृष॒भाय॑ सुष्वति
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ kóśaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ vṛṣabhá-annāya ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ pā́tave ǀvṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ adhvaryū́ íti ǀ vṛṣabhā́saḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sómam ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ susvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The juice of the gratifying and exhilarating (Soma), the exciter (of) those who drink it, flows to the showerer (of benefits), the dispenser of food, for his beverage; the two priests, the sprinklers of the oblation; and the stones (that express the Soma), offer to the best (of the deities), the Soma, the shedder (of blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ ते॒ वज्र॑ उ॒त ते॒ वृषा॒ रथो॒ वृष॑णा॒ हरी॑ वृष॒भाण्यायु॑धा । वृष्णो॒ मद॑स्य वृषभ॒ त्वमी॑शिष॒ इन्द्र॒ सोम॑स्य वृष॒भस्य॑ तृप्णुहि
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ te ǀ vájraḥ ǀ utá ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛṣabhā́ṇi ǀ ā́yudhā ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ mádasya ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ índra ǀ sómasya ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ tṛpṇuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your thunderbolt,Indra, is the rainer (of bounties); your chariot, the showerer (of blessings); your two horses, the shedders (of desires); your weapons the diffusers (of wishes); you reign, showerer (of benefits), over the inebriatingSoma, the sprinkler (of delight); satiate yourself, Indra, with the good-diffusing Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ नावं॒ न सम॑ने वच॒स्युवं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा यामि॒ सव॑नेषु॒ दाधृ॑षिः । कु॒विन्नो॑ अ॒स्य वच॑सो नि॒बोधि॑ष॒दिन्द्र॒मुत्सं॒ न वसु॑नः सिचामहे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ nā́vam ǀ ná ǀ sámane ǀ vacasyúvam ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ yāmi ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ dádhṛṣiḥ ǀkuvít ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ ni-bódhiṣat ǀ índram ǀ útsam ǀ ná ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ sicāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Victorious in battle, (through) your (favour) I approach you, who are gratified by praise, in sacred rites with prayer, as a boat (to bear me over misfortune); mayIndralisten attentively to these our words; we pour out libations to Indra, (who is a receptacle) of treasure, as a well (is of water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रा स॑म्बा॒धाद॒भ्या व॑वृत्स्व नो धे॒नुर्न व॒त्सं यव॑सस्य पि॒प्युषी॑ । स॒कृत्सु ते॑ सुम॒तिभि॑: शतक्रतो॒ सं पत्नी॑भि॒र्न वृष॑णो नसीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: purā́ ǀ sam-bādhā́t ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ naḥ ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ ná ǀ vatsám ǀ yávasasya ǀ pipyúṣī ǀsakṛ́t ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ sám ǀ pátnībhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ nasīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conduct us beforehand away from evil, as a cow grazing in a meadow leads her calf (out of peril); may we,Śatakratu, envelop you, if but once, with acceptable praises, as youthful husbands (are embraced) by their wives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॑स्मै॒ नव्य॑मङ्गिर॒स्वद॑र्चत॒ शुष्मा॒ यद॑स्य प्र॒त्नथो॒दीर॑ते । विश्वा॒ यद्गो॒त्रा सह॑सा॒ परी॑वृता॒ मदे॒ सोम॑स्य दृंहि॒तान्यैर॑यत्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ asmai ǀ návyam ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀ arcata ǀ śúṣmāḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ pratná-thā ǀ ut-ī́rate ǀvíśvā ǀ yát ǀ gotrā́ ǀ sáhasā ǀ pári-vṛtā ǀ máde ǀ sómasya ǀ dṛṃhitā́ni ǀ áirayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Address, worshippers, after the manner ofAṅgiras, a new (hymn) to thatIndra, whose withering (energies) were developed of old; who, in the exhilaration of theSoma, forced open the obstructed and solid clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स भू॑तु॒ यो ह॑ प्रथ॒माय॒ धाय॑स॒ ओजो॒ मिमा॑नो महि॒मान॒माति॑रत् । शूरो॒ यो यु॒त्सु त॒न्वं॑ परि॒व्यत॑ शी॒र्षणि॒ द्यां म॑हि॒ना प्रत्य॑मुञ्चत
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ prathamā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ ójaḥ ǀ mímānaḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ átirat ǀśū́raḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ yut-sú ǀ tanvám ǀ pari-vyáta ǀ śīrṣáṇi ǀ dyā́m ǀ mahinā́ ǀ práti ǀ amuñcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that (Indra) be (excited), who, manifesting his energy, exerted his might for the first drinking of theSoma; a hero, who in combats protected his own person n and by his greatness sustained the heaven upon his head.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑कृणोः प्रथ॒मं वी॒र्यं॑ म॒हद्यद॒स्याग्रे॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ शुष्म॒मैर॑यः । र॒थे॒ष्ठेन॒ हर्य॑श्वेन॒ विच्यु॑ता॒: प्र जी॒रय॑: सिस्रते स॒ध्र्य१॒॑क्पृथ॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ vīryám ǀ mahát ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ ágre ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ śúṣmam ǀ áirayaḥ ǀrathe-sthéna ǀ hári-aśvena ǀ ví-cyutāḥ ǀ prá ǀ jīráyaḥ ǀ sisrate ǀ sadhryák ǀ pṛ́thak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Indra, you have displayed your first great prowess, when, (propitiated) by the prayer (of the worshipper), you have put forth your withering (vigour) in his presence; and when the congregated enemies (of the gods), hurled down by you in youur chariot, drawn by your horses, fled, scattered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ यो विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि म॒ज्मने॑शान॒कृत्प्रव॑या अ॒भ्यव॑र्धत । आद्रोद॑सी॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ वह्नि॒रात॑नो॒त्सीव्य॒न्तमां॑सि॒ दुधि॑ता॒ सम॑व्ययत्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ majmánā ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀ prá-vayāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ávardhata ǀā́t ǀ ródasī íti ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ atanot ǀ sī́vyan ǀ támāṃsi ǀ dúdhitā ǀ sám ǀ avyayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He indeed, the ancientIndra, making himself by his might sovereign over all worlds, became supreme over (all); and thenceforth sustaining heaven and earth, he overspread them with effulgence, and scattering the malignant glooms, he pervaded (all things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्रा॒चीना॒न्पर्व॑तान्दृंह॒दोज॑साधरा॒चीन॑मकृणोद॒पामप॑: । अधा॑रयत्पृथि॒वीं वि॒श्वधा॑यस॒मस्त॑भ्नान्मा॒यया॒ द्याम॑व॒स्रस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ prācī́nān ǀ párvatān ǀ dṛṃhat ǀ ójasā ǀ adharācī́nam ǀ akṛṇot ǀ apā́m ǀ ápaḥ ǀádhārayat ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ ástabhnāt ǀ māyáyā ǀ dyā́m ǀ ava-srásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By his strength, he fixed the wandering mountains; he directed the downward course of the waters; he upheld the earth, the nurse (of all creatures); and by his craft he stopped the heaven from falling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सास्मा॒ अरं॑ बा॒हुभ्यां॒ यं पि॒ताकृ॑णो॒द्विश्व॑स्मा॒दा ज॒नुषो॒ वेद॑स॒स्परि॑ । येना॑ पृथि॒व्यां नि क्रिविं॑ श॒यध्यै॒ वज्रे॑ण ह॒त्व्यवृ॑णक्तुवि॒ष्वणि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ áram ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ yám ǀ pitā́ ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ ā́ ǀ janúṣaḥ ǀ védasaḥ ǀ pári ǀyéna ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ní ǀ krívim ǀ śayádhyai ǀ vájreṇa ǀ hatvī́ ǀ ávṛṇak ǀ tuvi-svániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sufficient was he for (the protection of) this (world), which he, its defender, fabricated with his two arms for the sake of all mankind, over whom he was supreme by his wisdom; whereby, (also), he the loud-shouting, having struck Krivi (asura) with the thunderbolt, consigned him to (eternal) slumber on the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मा॒जूरि॑व पि॒त्रोः सचा॑ स॒ती स॑मा॒नादा सद॑स॒स्त्वामि॑ये॒ भग॑म् । कृ॒धि प्र॑के॒तमुप॑ मा॒स्या भ॑र द॒द्धि भा॒गं त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ येन॑ मा॒मह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: amājū́ḥ-iva ǀ pitróḥ ǀ sácā ǀ satī́ ǀ samānā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ iye ǀ bhágam ǀkṛdhí ǀ pra-ketám ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ daddhí ǀ bhāgám ǀ tanváḥ ǀ yéna ǀ mamáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a virtuous (maiden), growing old in the same dwelling with her parents, (claims from them her support), so come I to you for wealth; make it conspicuous, measure it, bring it (hither), grant (a sufficient) portion for my bodily sustenance, (such as that) wherewith you honour (your worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भो॒जं त्वामि॑न्द्र व॒यं हु॑वेम द॒दिष्ट्वमि॒न्द्रापां॑सि॒ वाजा॑न् । अ॒वि॒ड्ढी॑न्द्र चि॒त्रया॑ न ऊ॒ती कृ॒धि वृ॑षन्निन्द्र॒ वस्य॑सो नः
shlokas.transliteration: bhojám ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ vayám ǀ huvema ǀ dadíḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ vā́jān ǀaviḍḍhí ǀ indra ǀ citráyā ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ vṛṣan ǀ indra ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,Indra, the bestower of enjoyment; you grant food, Indra, (in requital of pious) works; protect us, Indra, with manifold protections; Indra, showerer (of benefits), render us affluent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon that he desires; grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒ता रथो॒ नवो॑ योजि॒ सस्नि॒श्चतु॑र्युगस्त्रिक॒शः स॒प्तर॑श्मिः । दशा॑रित्रो मनु॒ष्य॑: स्व॒र्षाः स इ॒ष्टिभि॑र्म॒तिभी॒ रंह्यो॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: prātáríti ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ návaḥ ǀ yoji ǀ sásniḥ ǀ cátuḥ-yugaḥ ǀ trí-kaśáḥ ǀ saptá-raśmiḥ ǀdáśa-aritraḥ ǀ manuṣyáḥ ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ iṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ ráṃhyaḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A laudable and pure sacrifice, has been instrumental tuted at dawn; having four pairs (of stones for bruising theSoma); three tones (of prayer); seven metres, and ten vessels; beneficial to man, conferring heaven, and sanctifiable with solemn rites and praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सास्मा॒ अरं॑ प्रथ॒मं स द्वि॒तीय॑मु॒तो तृ॒तीयं॒ मनु॑ष॒: स होता॑ । अ॒न्यस्या॒ गर्भ॑म॒न्य ऊ॑ जनन्त॒ सो अ॒न्येभि॑: सचते॒ जेन्यो॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ áram ǀ prathamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ dvitī́yam ǀ utó íti ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀanyásyāḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ anyé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ jananta ǀ sáḥ ǀ anyébhiḥ ǀ sacate ǀ jényaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That (sacrifice) is sufficient for him, (Indra), whether (offered) for the first, the second, or the third time; it is the bearer (of good) to man; other (priests) engender the embryo of a different (rite), but this victorious (sacrifice), the showerer (of benefits) combines with other (ceremonies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरी॒ नु कं॒ रथ॒ इन्द्र॑स्य योजमा॒यै सू॒क्तेन॒ वच॑सा॒ नवे॑न । मो षु त्वामत्र॑ ब॒हवो॒ हि विप्रा॒ नि री॑रम॒न्यज॑मानासो अ॒न्ये
shlokas.transliteration: hárī íti ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ ráthe ǀ índrasya ǀ yojam ǀ ā-yái ǀ su-ukténa ǀ vácasā ǀ návena ǀmó íti ǀ sú ǀ tvā́m ǀ átra ǀ bahávaḥ ǀ hí ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀ yájamānāsaḥ ǀ anyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I harness quickly and easily the horses to the car ofIndrafor its journey, by new and well-recited prayer; many wise (worshippers) are present here; let not other instrumental tutors of sacred rites tempt you (away).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ द्वाभ्यां॒ हरि॑भ्यामिन्द्र या॒ह्या च॒तुर्भि॒रा ष॒ड्भिर्हू॒यमा॑नः । आष्टा॒भिर्द॒शभि॑: सोम॒पेय॑म॒यं सु॒तः सु॑मख॒ मा मृध॑स्कः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dvā́bhyām ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ ā́ ǀ catúḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ṣaṭ-bhíḥ ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǀā́ ǀ aṣṭābhíḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ soma-péyam ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ su-makha ǀ mā́ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, when invoked, with two horses, or with four, or with six, or with eight, or with ten, to drink theSoma; object of worship, Soma is poured out; do not wrong (to the libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ विं॑श॒त्या त्रिं॒शता॑ याह्य॒र्वाङा च॑त्वारिं॒शता॒ हरि॑भिर्युजा॒नः । आ प॑ञ्चा॒शता॑ सु॒रथे॑भिरि॒न्द्रा ष॒ष्ट्या स॑प्त॒त्या सो॑म॒पेय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viṃśatyā́ ǀ triṃśátā ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ ā́ ǀ catvāriṃśátā ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀā́ ǀ pañcāśátā ǀ su-ráthebhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ ṣaṣṭyā́ ǀ saptatyā́ ǀ soma-péyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to our presence,Indra, having harnessed your car with twenty, thirty, or forty horses; or with fifty well-trained steeds; or with sixty or with seventy, Indra, to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आशी॒त्या न॑व॒त्या या॑ह्य॒र्वाङा श॒तेन॒ हरि॑भिरु॒ह्यमा॑नः । अ॒यं हि ते॑ शु॒नहो॑त्रेषु॒ सोम॒ इन्द्र॑ त्वा॒या परि॑षिक्तो॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ aśītyā́ ǀ navatyā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ ā́ ǀ śaténa ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ uhyámānaḥ ǀayám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ śuná-hotreṣu ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índra ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ pári-siktaḥ ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to our presence, conveyed by eighty, ninety, or a hundred horses; thisSomahas been poured into the goblet, Indra, for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॒ ब्रह्मे॑न्द्र या॒ह्यच्छा॒ विश्वा॒ हरी॑ धु॒रि धि॑ष्वा॒ रथ॑स्य । पु॒रु॒त्रा हि वि॒हव्यो॑ ब॒भूथा॒स्मिञ्छू॑र॒ सव॑ने मादयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: máma ǀ bráhma ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ áccha ǀ víśvā ǀ hárī íti ǀ dhurí ǀ dhiṣva ǀ ráthasya ǀpuru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ vi-hávyaḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǀ asmín ǀ śūra ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come hither,Indra, (having heard) my prayer; yoke your two universal steeds to the pole of your chariot; you have been the object of invocation in many ways by many (worshippers), but now, hero, be exhilarated in this (our) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न म॒ इन्द्रे॑ण स॒ख्यं वि यो॑षद॒स्मभ्य॑मस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा दुहीत । उप॒ ज्येष्ठे॒ वरू॑थे॒ गभ॑स्तौ प्रा॒येप्रा॑ये जिगी॒वांस॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ me ǀ índreṇa ǀ sakhyám ǀ ví ǀ yoṣat ǀ asmábhyam ǀ asya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ duhīta ǀúpa ǀ jyéṣṭhe ǀ várūthe ǀ gábhastau ǀ prāyé-prāye ǀ jigīvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never may my friendship withIndrabe disunited; may his liberality (ever) yield us (our desires); may we be within the excellent defence of (his protecting) arms; may we be victorious in every battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon that he desires; grant (it) to (us) your adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॑य्य॒स्यान्ध॑सो॒ मदा॑य॒ मनी॑षिणः सुवा॒नस्य॒ प्रय॑सः । यस्मि॒न्निन्द्र॑: प्र॒दिवि॑ वावृधा॒न ओको॑ द॒धे ब्र॑ह्म॒ण्यन्त॑श्च॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ápāyi ǀ asyá ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ mánīṣiṇaḥ ǀ suvānásya ǀ práyasaḥ ǀyásmin ǀ índraḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ ókaḥ ǀ dadhé ǀ brahmaṇyántaḥ ǀ ca ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It has been partaken (byIndra) for his exhilaration, of this agreeable (sacrificial) food, the libation of his devout (worshipper); thriving by which ancient (Soma),he has bestowed a (fitting) dwelling, where the adoring conductors (of the ceremony) abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य म॑न्दा॒नो मध्वो॒ वज्र॑ह॒स्तोऽहि॒मिन्द्रो॑ अर्णो॒वृतं॒ वि वृ॑श्चत् । प्र यद्वयो॒ न स्वस॑रा॒ण्यच्छा॒ प्रयां॑सि च न॒दीनां॒ चक्र॑मन्त
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀ áhim ǀ índraḥ ǀ arṇaḥ-vṛ́tam ǀ ví ǀ vṛścat ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ áccha ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀ nadī́nām ǀ cákramanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarated by theSoma,Indra, armed with the thunderbolt, severed the rain-confining cloud; whereupon the currents of the rivers proceeded (towards the ocean), like birds to their own nests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स माहि॑न॒ इन्द्रो॒ अर्णो॑ अ॒पां प्रैर॑यदहि॒हाच्छा॑ समु॒द्रम् । अज॑नय॒त्सूर्यं॑ वि॒दद्गा अ॒क्तुनाह्नां॑ व॒युना॑नि साधत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mā́hinaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ prá ǀ airayat ǀ ahi-hā́ ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǀájanayat ǀ sū́ryam ǀ vidát ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ aktúnā ǀ áhnām ǀ vayúnāni ǀ sādhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableIndra, the slayer of Ahi, sent the current of the waters towards the ocean; he genitive rated the sun; he discovered the cattle; he effected the manifestation of the days by light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॑प्र॒तीनि॒ मन॑वे पु॒रूणीन्द्रो॑ दाशद्दा॒शुषे॒ हन्ति॑ वृ॒त्रम् । स॒द्यो यो नृभ्यो॑ अत॒साय्यो॒ भूत्प॑स्पृधा॒नेभ्य॒: सूर्य॑स्य सा॒तौ
