shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ apratī́ni ǀ mánave ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ índraḥ ǀ dāśat ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrám ǀsadyáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ atasā́yyaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ paspṛdhānébhyaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To the presenter (ofthe libation)Indragives many unparalleled gifts; he slaysVṛtra; he who was the arbiter among his worshippers when contending for the possession of the Sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॑न्व॒त इन्द्र॒: सूर्य॒मा दे॒वो रि॑ण॒ङ्मर्त्या॑य स्त॒वान् । आ यद्र॒यिं गु॒हद॑वद्यमस्मै॒ भर॒दंशं॒ नैत॑शो दश॒स्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ índraḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ riṇak ǀ mártyāya ǀ stavā́n ǀā́ ǀ yát ǀ rayím ǀ guhát-avadyam ǀ asmai ǀ bhárat ǀ áṃśam ǀ ná ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ daśasyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineIndra, when lauded (byEtaśa), humbled the Sun (in behalf) of the mortal who offered to him the libation; for the munificent Etaśa presented him with mysterious and inestimable riches; as (a father gives) his portion (to a son).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स र॑न्धयत्स॒दिव॒: सार॑थये॒ शुष्ण॑म॒शुषं॒ कुय॑वं॒ कुत्सा॑य । दिवो॑दासाय नव॒तिं च॒ नवेन्द्र॒: पुरो॒ व्यै॑र॒च्छम्ब॑रस्य
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ randhayat ǀ sa-dívaḥ ǀ sā́rathaye ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ aśúṣam ǀ kúyavam ǀ kútsāya ǀdívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ náva ǀ índraḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ ví ǀ airat ǀ śámbarasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The radiantIndrasubjected toKutsa, his charioteer, (theasuras),Śuṣṇa, Aśuṣa, andKuyava; and, for the sake ofDivodāsa, demolished the ninety and nine cities ofŚambara.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा त॑ इन्द्रो॒चथ॑महेम श्रव॒स्या न त्मना॑ वा॒जय॑न्तः । अ॒श्याम॒ तत्साप्त॑माशुषा॒णा न॒नमो॒ वध॒रदे॑वस्य पी॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ ucátham ǀ ahema ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ ná ǀ tmánā ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀaśyā́ma ǀ tát ǀ sā́ptam ǀ āśuṣāṇā́ḥ ǀ nanámaḥ ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ ádevasya ǀ pīyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through desire of food,Indra, we, contributing to your vigour, spontaneously address to you (our) praise; secure of you, may we rely upon your friendship; hurl your thunderbolt against the godless Pīyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ते॑ गृत्सम॒दाः शू॑र॒ मन्मा॑व॒स्यवो॒ न व॒युना॑नि तक्षुः । ब्र॒ह्म॒ण्यन्त॑ इन्द्र ते॒ नवी॑य॒ इष॒मूर्जं॑ सुक्षि॒तिं सु॒म्नम॑श्युः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ gṛtsa-madā́ḥ ǀ śūra ǀ mánma ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vayúnāni ǀ takṣuḥ ǀbrahmaṇyántaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ sumnám ǀ aśyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus, hero, have theGṛtsamadas”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant it to us yor adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॒ वय॑ इन्द्र वि॒द्धि षु ण॒: प्र भ॑रामहे वाज॒युर्न रथ॑म् । वि॒प॒न्यवो॒ दीध्य॑तो मनी॒षा सु॒म्नमिय॑क्षन्त॒स्त्वाव॑तो॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ váyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ viddhí ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ bharāmahe ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ ná ǀ rátham ǀvipanyávaḥ ǀ dī́dhyataḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ sumnám ǀ íyakṣantaḥ ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We bring to you,Indra, (sacrificial) food, as one desiring food brings his wagon; regard us benevolently when glorifying you, rendering (you) illustrious by (our) praise, and soliciting such guides as you are to felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑ इन्द्र॒ त्वाभि॑रू॒ती त्वा॑य॒तो अ॑भिष्टि॒पासि॒ जना॑न् । त्वमि॒नो दा॒शुषो॑ वरू॒तेत्थाधी॑र॒भि यो नक्ष॑ति त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ tvā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ tvā-yatáḥ ǀ abhiṣṭi-pā́ ǀ asi ǀ jánān ǀtvám ǀ ináḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ varūtā́ ǀ itthā́-dhīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ nákṣati ǀ tvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Defend us),Indra, with your protections, for you are the defender against enemies of those men who rely upon you; you are the lord of the offerer (of the libation) and the repeller (of foes), and with these acts (protect) him who worships you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ युवेन्द्रो॑ जो॒हूत्र॒: सखा॑ शि॒वो न॒राम॑स्तु पा॒ता । यः शंस॑न्तं॒ यः श॑शमा॒नमू॒ती पच॑न्तं च स्तु॒वन्तं॑ च प्र॒णेष॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ índraḥ ǀ johū́traḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ śiváḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ astu ǀ pātā́ ǀyáḥ ǀ śáṃsantam ǀ yáḥ ǀ śaśamānám ǀ ūtī́ ǀ pácantam ǀ ca ǀ stuvántam ǀ ca ǀ pra-néṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that young, adorableIndra, ever be the friend, the benefactor, and protector of us, his worshipper; who, with his protection, may conduct (to the object of his worship) him who repeats (to him) prayer and praise, who prepares the oblation, and recites (his) commendations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ स्तुष॒ इन्द्रं॒ तं गृ॑णीषे॒ यस्मि॑न्पु॒रा वा॑वृ॒धुः शा॑श॒दुश्च॑ । स वस्व॒: कामं॑ पीपरदिया॒नो ब्र॑ह्मण्य॒तो नूत॑नस्या॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuṣe ǀ índram ǀ tám ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ yásmin ǀ purā́ ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀ śāśadúḥ ǀ ca ǀsáḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ pīparat ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ brahmaṇyatáḥ ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I laud thatIndra, I glorify him, in whom of old (his worshippers) prospered, and overcame (their enemies); may he, when solicited, gratify the desire of wealth of his present pious adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अङ्गि॑रसामु॒चथा॑ जुजु॒ष्वान्ब्रह्मा॑ तूतो॒दिन्द्रो॑ गा॒तुमि॒ष्णन् । मु॒ष्णन्नु॒षस॒: सूर्ये॑ण स्त॒वानश्न॑स्य चिच्छिश्नथत्पू॒र्व्याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ ucáthā ǀ jujuṣvā́n ǀ bráhmā ǀ tūtot ǀ índraḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣṇán ǀmuṣṇán ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ stavā́n ǀ áśnasya ǀ cit ǀ śiśnathat ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiated by the hymns of theAṅgirasas,Indragranted their prayer, and directed them on the way (to recover their cattle); carrying off the dawns by the (light of the) sun, he, animated by praise, demolished the ancient cities of Aśna.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ह॑ श्रु॒त इन्द्रो॒ नाम॑ दे॒व ऊ॒र्ध्वो भु॑व॒न्मनु॑षे द॒स्मत॑मः । अव॑ प्रि॒यम॑र्शसा॒नस्य॑ सा॒ह्वाञ्छिरो॑ भरद्दा॒सस्य॑ स्व॒धावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ha ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ deváḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ mánuṣe ǀ dasmá-tamaḥ ǀáva ǀ priyám ǀ arśasānásya ǀ sahvā́n ǀ śíraḥ ǀ bharat ǀ dāsásya ǀ svadhā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the renowned and gracefulIndra, who is verily divine, be present over men; may he, the vigorous conqueror of foes, cast down the precious head of the malignantDāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वृ॑त्र॒हेन्द्र॑: कृ॒ष्णयो॑नीः पुरंद॒रो दासी॑रैरय॒द्वि । अज॑नय॒न्मन॑वे॒ क्षाम॒पश्च॑ स॒त्रा शंसं॒ यज॑मानस्य तूतोत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kṛṣṇá-yonīḥ ǀ puram-daráḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ airayat ǀ ví ǀájanayat ǀ mánave ǀ kṣā́m ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ satrā́ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ tūtot ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the slayer ofVṛtra, the destroyer of cities, has scattered the black-sprung servile (hosts); he engendered the earth and the waters forManu; may he fulfill the entire prayer of the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मै॑ तव॒स्य१॒॑मनु॑ दायि स॒त्रेन्द्रा॑य दे॒वेभि॒रर्ण॑सातौ । प्रति॒ यद॑स्य॒ वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोर्धुर्ह॒त्वी दस्यू॒न्पुर॒ आय॑सी॒र्नि ता॑रीत्
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ tavasyám ǀ ánu ǀ dāyi ǀ satrā́ ǀ índrāya ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ árṇa-sātau ǀpráti ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ dhúḥ ǀ hatvī́ ǀ dásyūn ǀ púraḥ ǀ ā́yasīḥ ǀ ní ǀ tārīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vigour has been perpetually imparted toIndraby his worshippers (with oblations), for the sake of obtaining rain; for which purpose they have plural ced the thunderbolt in hishands, wherewith,having slain theDasyus, he has destroyed their metal cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं सा ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे दु॑ही॒यदि॑न्द्र॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑ । शिक्षा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ माति॑ ध॒ग्भगो॑ नो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀ duhīyát ǀ indra ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǀśíkṣa ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áti ǀ dhak ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That opulent donation which proceeds,Indra, from you, assuredly bestows upon him who praises you, the boon (that he desires); grant it to us yor adorers; do not you, who are the object of adoration, disregard our prayers; so that, blessed with worthy descendants, we may glorify you in this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्व॒जिते॑ धन॒जिते॑ स्व॒र्जिते॑ सत्रा॒जिते॑ नृ॒जित॑ उर्वरा॒जिते॑ । अ॒श्व॒जिते॑ गो॒जिते॑ अ॒ब्जिते॑ भ॒रेन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमं॑ यज॒ताय॑ हर्य॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: viśva-jíte ǀ dhana-jíte ǀ svaḥ-jíte ǀ satrā-jíte ǀ nṛ-jíte ǀ urvarā-jíte ǀaśva-jíte ǀ go-jíte ǀ ap-jíte ǀ bhara ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ yajatā́ya ǀ haryatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring the desiredSomato the adorableIndrathe lord of all, the lord of wealth, the lord of heaven, the perpetual lord, the lord of man, the lord of earth, the lord of horses, the lord of cattle, the lord of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि॒भुवे॑ऽभिभ॒ङ्गाय॑ वन्व॒तेऽषा॑ळ्हाय॒ सह॑मानाय वे॒धसे॑ । तु॒वि॒ग्रये॒ वह्न॑ये दु॒ष्टरी॑तवे सत्रा॒साहे॒ नम॒ इन्द्रा॑य वोचत
shlokas.transliteration: abhi-bhúve ǀ abhi-bhaṅgā́ya ǀ vanvaté ǀ áṣāḷhāya ǀ sáhamānāya ǀ vedháse ǀtuvi-gráye ǀ váhnaye ǀ dustárītave ǀ satrā-sáhe ǀ námaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer adoration toIndra, the overcomer, the destroyer, the munificent, the invincible, the all-enduring, the creator, the all-adorable; the sustainer, the unassailable, the ever-victorious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा॒सा॒हो ज॑नभ॒क्षो ज॑नंस॒हश्च्यव॑नो यु॒ध्मो अनु॒ जोष॑मुक्षि॒तः । वृ॒तं॒च॒यः सहु॑रिर्वि॒क्ष्वा॑रि॒त इन्द्र॑स्य वोचं॒ प्र कृ॒तानि॑ वी॒र्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: satrā-saháḥ ǀ jana-bhakṣáḥ ǀ janam-saháḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ yudhmáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ ukṣitáḥ ǀvṛtam-cayáḥ ǀ sáhuriḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ āritáḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vocam ǀ prá ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ vīryā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I proclaim the mighty exploits of thatIndra, who is, ever victorious; the benefactor of man, the overthrower of (the strong) man, the caster down (of foes), the warrior, who is gratified by our libations, the granter of desires, the subduer of enemies, the refuge of the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ना॒नु॒दो वृ॑ष॒भो दोध॑तो व॒धो ग॑म्भी॒र ऋ॒ष्वो अस॑मष्टकाव्यः । र॒ध्र॒चो॒दः श्नथ॑नो वीळि॒तस्पृ॒थुरिन्द्र॑: सुय॒ज्ञ उ॒षस॒: स्व॑र्जनत्
shlokas.transliteration: ananu-dáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ dódhataḥ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ gambhīráḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ ásamaṣṭa-kāvyaḥ ǀradhra-codáḥ ǀ śnáthanaḥ ǀ vīḷitáḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-yajñáḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ janat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unequalled in liberty, the showerer (of benefits), the slayer of the malevolent, profound, mighty, (endowed with) impenetrable sagacity, the dispenser of prosperity, the enfeebler (of foes), firm (of frame), vast (in bulk) the performer of pious acts,Indrahas given birth to the light of the morning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञेन॑ गा॒तुम॒प्तुरो॑ विविद्रिरे॒ धियो॑ हिन्वा॒ना उ॒शिजो॑ मनी॒षिण॑: । अ॒भि॒स्वरा॑ नि॒षदा॒ गा अ॑व॒स्यव॒ इन्द्रे॑ हिन्वा॒ना द्रवि॑णान्याशत
shlokas.transliteration: yajñéna ǀ gātúm ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ vividrire ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hinvānā́ḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀabhi-svárā ǀ ni-sádā ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ índre ǀ hinvānā́ḥ ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wiseUśijas, celebrating his praises, have obtained by their sacrifice, from the sender of water (knowledge) of the path (of their cattle); seeking the aid ofIndra, and celebrating his praises, they have acquired, whilst uttering hymns and offering adoration (valuable) treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ श्रेष्ठा॑नि॒ द्रवि॑णानि धेहि॒ चित्तिं॒ दक्ष॑स्य सुभग॒त्वम॒स्मे । पोषं॑ रयी॒णामरि॑ष्टिं त॒नूनां॑ स्वा॒द्मानं॑ वा॒चः सु॑दिन॒त्वमह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ śréṣṭhāni ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ dhehi ǀ cíttim ǀ dákṣasya ǀ su-bhagatvám ǀ asmé íti ǀpóṣam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ áriṣṭim ǀ tanū́nām ǀ svādmā́nam ǀ vācáḥ ǀ sudina-tvám ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, bestow upon us most excellent treasures; (give us) the reputation of ability (to celebrate sacred rites); grant us prosperity, increase of wealth, security of person n, sweetness of speech, and auspiciousness of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिक॑द्रुकेषु महि॒षो यवा॑शिरं तुवि॒शुष्म॑स्तृ॒पत्सोम॑मपिब॒द्विष्णु॑ना सु॒तं यथाव॑शत् । स ईं॑ ममाद॒ महि॒ कर्म॒ कर्त॑वे म॒हामु॒रुं सैनं॑ सश्चद्दे॒वो दे॒वं स॒त्यमिन्द्रं॑ स॒त्य इन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: trí-kadrukeṣu ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ yáva-āśiram ǀ tuvi-śúṣmaḥ ǀ tṛpát ǀ sómam ǀ apibat ǀ víṣṇunā ǀ sutám ǀ yáthā ǀ ávaśat ǀsáḥ ǀ īm ǀ mamāda ǀ máhi ǀ kárma ǀ kártave ǀ mahā́m ǀ urúm ǀ sáḥ ǀ enam ǀ saścat ǀ deváḥ ǀ devám ǀ satyám ǀ índram ǀ satyáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorable and powerful (Indra), partaking of theSoma, mixed with barley, effused at the Tṛkadruka rites, has drunk withViṣṇuas much as he wished; the draught has excited that great and mighty Indra to perform great deeds; may that divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma (pervade) the true Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ त्विषी॑माँ अ॒भ्योज॑सा॒ क्रिविं॑ यु॒धाभ॑व॒दा रोद॑सी अपृणदस्य म॒ज्मना॒ प्र वा॑वृधे । अध॑त्ता॒न्यं ज॒ठरे॒ प्रेम॑रिच्यत॒ सैनं॑ सश्चद्दे॒वो दे॒वं स॒त्यमिन्द्रं॑ स॒त्य इन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ tvíṣi-mān ǀ abhí ǀ ójasā ǀ krívim ǀ yudhā́ ǀ abhavat ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇat ǀ asya ǀ majmánā ǀ prá ǀ vavṛdhe ǀádhatta ǀ anyám ǀ jaṭháre ǀ prá ǀ īm ǀ aricyata ǀ sáḥ ǀ enam ǀ saścat ǀ deváḥ ǀ devám ǀ satyám ǀ índram ǀ satyáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereupon, resplendent, he has overcome Krivi in conflict by his prowess;he has filled heaven and earth (with his lustre), and has been invigorated by the efficacy of the draught; one portion he has taken to himself; the other he has distributed (to the gods); may that divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma, the true (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒कं जा॒तः क्रतु॑ना सा॒कमोज॑सा ववक्षिथ सा॒कं वृ॒द्धो वी॒र्यै॑: सास॒हिर्मृधो॒ विच॑र्षणिः । दाता॒ राध॑: स्तुव॒ते काम्यं॒ वसु॒ सैनं॑ सश्चद्दे॒वो दे॒वं स॒त्यमिन्द्रं॑ स॒त्य इन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sākám ǀ jātáḥ ǀ krátunā ǀ sākám ǀ ójasā ǀ vavakṣitha ǀ sākám ǀ vṛddháḥ ǀ vīryáiḥ ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀdā́tā ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ kā́myam ǀ vásu ǀ sáḥ ǀ enam ǀ saścat ǀ deváḥ ǀ devám ǀ satyám ǀ índram ǀ satyáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cognate with (pious) works and with power, you desire to support (the universe); mighty with heroic (energies); you are the subduer of the malevolent; (you are) the distinguisher (between the doer of good and ill); the giver of the substantial wealth he desires to him who praises you; may the divine (Soma) pervade the divine (Indra), the true Soma, the true (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्यन्नर्यं॑ नृ॒तोऽप॑ इन्द्र प्रथ॒मं पू॒र्व्यं दि॒वि प्र॒वाच्यं॑ कृ॒तम् । यद्दे॒वस्य॒ शव॑सा॒ प्रारि॑णा॒ असुं॑ रि॒णन्न॒पः । भुव॒द्विश्व॑म॒भ्यादे॑व॒मोज॑सा वि॒दादूर्ज॑ं श॒तक्र॑तुर्वि॒दादिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyát ǀ náryam ǀ nṛto íti ǀ ápaḥ ǀ indra ǀ prathamám ǀ pūrvyám ǀ diví ǀ pra-vā́cyam ǀ kṛtám ǀyát ǀ devásya ǀ śávasā ǀ prá ǀ áriṇāḥ ǀ ásum ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǀbhúvat ǀ víśvam ǀ abhí ǀ ádevam ǀ ójasā ǀ vidā́t ǀ ū́rjam ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ vidā́t ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the delighter (of all), the first act performed by you in ancient time was for the good of man, and deserving of renown in heaven, when, arresting by force the breath of the (enemy) of the gods, you did send down the rain; may Indra prevail by his prowess over all that is godless; mayŚatakratuobtain vigour; may he obtain (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒णानां॑ त्वा ग॒णप॑तिं हवामहे क॒विं क॑वी॒नामु॑प॒मश्र॑वस्तमम् । ज्ये॒ष्ठ॒राजं॒ ब्रह्म॑णां ब्रह्मणस्पत॒ आ न॑: शृ॒ण्वन्नू॒तिभि॑: सीद॒ साद॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: gaṇā́nām ǀ tvā ǀ gaṇá-patim ǀ havāmahe ǀ kavím ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ upamáśravaḥ-tamam ǀjyeṣṭha-rā́jam ǀ bráhmaṇām ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇván ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sīda ǀ sádanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke theBrahmaṇaspati, chief leaderof the (heavenly) bands; a sage of sage; aboundingbeyondmeasure in (every kind of) food;best lord of prayer; hearing our invocations, come with your protections, and sit down in the chamber of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वाश्चि॑त्ते असुर्य॒ प्रचे॑तसो॒ बृह॑स्पते य॒ज्ञियं॑ भा॒गमा॑नशुः । उ॒स्रा इ॑व॒ सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॑षा म॒हो विश्वे॑षा॒मिज्ज॑नि॒ता ब्रह्म॑णामसि
shlokas.transliteration: devā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ asurya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ yajñíyam ǀ bhāgám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀusrā́ḥ-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ maháḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ ít ǀ janitā́ ǀ bráhmaṇām ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, destroyer of theasuras, through you the intelligent gods have obtained the sacrificialportion; in like manner as the adorable sun genitive rates the (solar) rays by his radiance, so are you the genitive rator of all prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वि॒बाध्या॑ परि॒राप॒स्तमां॑सि च॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्तं॒ रथ॑मृ॒तस्य॑ तिष्ठसि । बृह॑स्पते भी॒मम॑मित्र॒दम्भ॑नं रक्षो॒हणं॑ गोत्र॒भिदं॑ स्व॒र्विद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vi-bā́dhya ǀ pari-rápaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ ca ǀ jyótiṣmantam ǀ rátham ǀ ṛtásya ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ bhīmám ǀ amitra-dámbhanam ǀ rakṣaḥ-hánam ǀ gotra-bhídam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having repelled revilers and (dispersed) the darkness you standBṛhaspati, on the radiant chariot of sacrifice, (which is) formidable (to foes), the humiliator of enemies, the destroyer of evil spirits, the cleaver of the clouds, the attainer of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒नी॒तिभि॑र्नयसि॒ त्राय॑से॒ जनं॒ यस्तुभ्यं॒ दाशा॒न्न तमंहो॑ अश्नवत् । ब्र॒ह्म॒द्विष॒स्तप॑नो मन्यु॒मीर॑सि॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ महि॒ तत्ते॑ महित्व॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: sunītí-bhiḥ ǀ nayasi ǀ trā́yase ǀ jánam ǀ yáḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ dā́śāt ǀ ná ǀ tám ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ aśnavat ǀbrahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ tápanaḥ ǀ manyu-mī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ máhi ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ mahi-tvanám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You lead men,Bṛhaspati, by virtuous instrumental uctions; you preserve them (from calamity); sin will never overtake him who presents (offerings) to you; you are the afflicter of him who hates (holy) prayers; you are the punisher of wrath; such is your great mightiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तमंहो॒ न दु॑रि॒तं कुत॑श्च॒न नारा॑तयस्तितिरु॒र्न द्व॑या॒विन॑: । विश्वा॒ इद॑स्माद्ध्व॒रसो॒ वि बा॑धसे॒ यं सु॑गो॒पा रक्ष॑सि ब्रह्मणस्पते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-itám ǀ kútaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ná ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ titiruḥ ǀ ná ǀ dvayāvínaḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ít ǀ asmāt ǀ dhvarásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ bādhase ǀ yám ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǀ rákṣasi ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man whom you,Brahmaṇaspati, a kind protector, defend, neither sorrow nor sin, nor adversaries nor dissemblers ever harm, for you drive away from him all injurious (things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ गो॒पाः प॑थि॒कृद्वि॑चक्ष॒णस्तव॑ व्र॒ताय॑ म॒तिभि॑र्जरामहे । बृह॑स्पते॒ यो नो॑ अ॒भि ह्वरो॑ द॒धे स्वा तं म॑र्मर्तु दु॒च्छुना॒ हर॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ pathi-kṛ́t ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ táva ǀ vratā́ya ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ jarāmahe ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ hváraḥ ǀ dadhé ǀ svā́ ǀ tám ǀ marmartu ǀ ducchúnā ǀ hárasvatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Bṛhaspati, are our protector and the guide of (our) path; (you are) the discerner (of all things); we worship with praises for your adoration; may his own precipitate malice involve him (in destruction) who practises deceit against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वा॒ यो नो॑ म॒र्चया॒दना॑गसोऽराती॒वा मर्त॑: सानु॒को वृक॑: । बृह॑स्पते॒ अप॒ तं व॑र्तया प॒थः सु॒गं नो॑ अ॒स्यै दे॒ववी॑तये कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marcáyāt ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ arāti-vā́ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ sānukáḥ ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ ápa ǀ tám ǀ vartaya ǀ patháḥ ǀ su-gám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyái ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Turn aside from (the true) path,Bṛhaspati, the arrogant and savage man who advances to injure us, although unoffending and keep us in the right way for (the completion of) this offering to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रा॒तारं॑ त्वा त॒नूनां॑ हवाम॒हेऽव॑स्पर्तरधिव॒क्तार॑मस्म॒युम् । बृह॑स्पते देव॒निदो॒ नि ब॑र्हय॒ मा दु॒रेवा॒ उत्त॑रं सु॒म्नमुन्न॑शन्
shlokas.transliteration: trātā́ram ǀ tvā ǀ tanū́nām ǀ havāmahe ǀ áva-spartaḥ ǀ adhi-vaktā́ram ǀ asmayúm ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ deva-nídaḥ ǀ ní ǀ barhaya ǀ mā́ ǀ duḥ-évāḥ ǀ út-taram ǀ sumnám ǀ út ǀ naśan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, defender (from calamity), we invoke you, the protector of our person ns, the speaker of encouraging words and well disposed towards us; do you destroy the revilers of the gods; let not the malevolent attain supreme felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ व॒यं सु॒वृधा॑ ब्रह्मणस्पते स्पा॒र्हा वसु॑ मनु॒ष्या द॑दीमहि । या नो॑ दू॒रे त॒ळितो॒ या अरा॑तयो॒ऽभि सन्ति॑ ज॒म्भया॒ ता अ॑न॒प्नस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ su-vṛ́dhā ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ spārhā́ ǀ vásu ǀ manuṣyā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadīmahi ǀyā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dūré ǀ taḷítaḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ jambháya ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ anapnásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through you,Brahmaṇaspati, (our) benefactor, may we obtain desirable wealth from men destroy those (our) unrighteous enemies, whether nigh or far off, who prevail against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ व॒यमु॑त्त॒मं धी॑महे॒ वयो॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ पप्रि॑णा॒ सस्नि॑ना यु॒जा । मा नो॑ दु॒:शंसो॑ अभिदि॒प्सुरी॑शत॒ प्र सु॒शंसा॑ म॒तिभि॑स्तारिषीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ ut-tamám ǀ dhīmahe ǀ váyaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ pápriṇā ǀ sásninā ǀ yujā́ ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsaḥ ǀ abhi-dipsúḥ ǀ īśata ǀ prá ǀ su-śáṃsāḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ tāriṣīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through you,Bṛhaspati, (who are) the fulfiller of our desires; pure, and associated (with us), we possess excellent food; let not the wicked man who wishes to deceive us be our master; but let us, excelling in (pious) praises, attain (prosperity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ना॒नु॒दो वृ॑ष॒भो जग्मि॑राह॒वं निष्ट॑प्ता॒ शत्रुं॒ पृत॑नासु सास॒हिः । असि॑ स॒त्य ऋ॑ण॒या ब्र॑ह्मणस्पत उ॒ग्रस्य॑ चिद्दमि॒ता वी॑ळुह॒र्षिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ananu-dáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ jágmiḥ ǀ ā-havám ǀ níḥ-taptā ǀ śátrum ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sasahíḥ ǀási ǀ satyáḥ ǀ ṛṇa-yā́ḥ ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ ugrásya ǀ cit ǀ damitā́ ǀ vīḷu-harṣíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Brahmaṇaspati, who have no requiter (of your bounty), who are the showerer (of benefits), the repairer to combat, the consumer of foes, the victor in battles, you are true, the discharger of debts, the humiliator of the fierce and of the exulting.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदे॑वेन॒ मन॑सा॒ यो रि॑ष॒ण्यति॑ शा॒सामु॒ग्रो मन्य॑मानो॒ जिघां॑सति । बृह॑स्पते॒ मा प्रण॒क्तस्य॑ नो व॒धो नि क॑र्म म॒न्युं दु॒रेव॑स्य॒ शर्ध॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: ádevena ǀ mánasā ǀ yáḥ ǀ riṣaṇyáti ǀ śāsā́m ǀ ugráḥ ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ mā́ ǀ práṇak ǀ tásya ǀ naḥ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ ní ǀ karma ǀ manyúm ǀ duḥ-évasya ǀ śárdhataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not,Bṛhaspati, the murderous (weapon) of that man reach us, who, with unrighteous mind, seeks to harm us; who, fierce and arrogant, designs to kill (your) worshippers; may we baffle the wrath of the strong evil-doer].”

shlokas.sanskrit: भरे॑षु॒ हव्यो॒ नम॑सोप॒सद्यो॒ गन्ता॒ वाजे॑षु॒ सनि॑ता॒ धनं॑धनम् । विश्वा॒ इद॒र्यो अ॑भिदि॒प्स्वो॒३॒॑ मृधो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒र्वि व॑वर्हा॒ रथाँ॑ इव
shlokas.transliteration: bháreṣu ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádyaḥ ǀ gántā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ sánitā ǀ dhánam-dhanam ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ít ǀ aryáḥ ǀ abhi-dipsváḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavarha ǀ ráthān-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspatiis to be invoked in battles; he is to be approached with reverence; he who moves amidst combats, the distributor of repeated wealth; the lord Bṛhaspati has verily overturned all the assailing malignant (hosts), like chariots (overturned in battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेजि॑ष्ठया तप॒नी र॒क्षस॑स्तप॒ ये त्वा॑ नि॒दे द॑धि॒रे दृ॒ष्टवी॑र्यम् । आ॒विस्तत्कृ॑ष्व॒ यदस॑त्त उ॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ बृह॑स्पते॒ वि प॑रि॒रापो॑ अर्दय
shlokas.transliteration: téjiṣṭhayā ǀ tapanī́ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ tapa ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ nidé ǀ dadhiré ǀ dṛṣṭá-vīryam ǀāvíḥ ǀ tát ǀ kṛṣva ǀ yát ǀ ásat ǀ te ǀ ukthyám ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ ví ǀ pari-rápaḥ ǀ ardaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consume with your brightest (weapon) therākṣasas, who have held your witnessed prowess in disdain; manifest,Bṛhaspati, your glorified (vigour), such as it was (of old), and destroy those who speak against you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते॒ अति॒ यद॒र्यो अर्हा॑द्द्यु॒मद्वि॒भाति॒ क्रतु॑म॒ज्जने॑षु । यद्दी॒दय॒च्छव॑स ऋतप्रजात॒ तद॒स्मासु॒ द्रवि॑णं धेहि चि॒त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ áti ǀ yát ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árhāt ǀ dyu-mát ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ krátu-mat ǀ jáneṣu ǀyát ǀ dīdáyat ǀ śávasā ǀ ṛta-prajāta ǀ tát ǀ asmā́su ǀ dráviṇam ǀ dhehi ǀ citrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, born of truth, grant us that wonderful treasure, wherewith the pious man may worship exceedingly; that (wealth) which shines amongst men; which is endowed with lustre, (is) the means of (performing holy) rites, and invogirates (its possessor) with strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॑: स्ते॒नेभ्यो॒ ये अ॒भि द्रु॒हस्प॒दे नि॑रा॒मिणो॑ रि॒पवोऽन्ने॑षु जागृ॒धुः । आ दे॒वाना॒मोह॑ते॒ वि व्रयो॑ हृ॒दि बृह॑स्पते॒ न प॒रः साम्नो॑ विदुः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stenébhyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ abhí ǀ druháḥ ǀ padé ǀ nirāmíṇaḥ ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ ánneṣu ǀ jagṛdhúḥ ǀā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ óhate ǀ ví ǀ vráyaḥ ǀ hṛdí ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ ná ǀ paráḥ ǀ sā́mnaḥ ǀ viduḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deliver us not to the thieves, the enemies delighting in violence, who seize ever upon the food (of others); those who cherish in their hearts the abandonment (of the gods); (they),Bṛhaspati, who do not know the extent of (your) power (against evil spirits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑भ्यो॒ हि त्वा॒ भुव॑नेभ्य॒स्परि॒ त्वष्टाज॑न॒त्साम्न॑:साम्नः क॒विः । स ऋ॑ण॒चिदृ॑ण॒या ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑र्द्रु॒हो ह॒न्ता म॒ह ऋ॒तस्य॑ ध॒र्तरि॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśvebhyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ bhúvanebhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ájanat ǀ sā́mnaḥ-sāmnaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ṛṇa-cít ǀ ṛṇa-yā́ḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ druháḥ ǀ hantā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhartári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tvaṣṭāengendered you (chief) amongst all beings, (whence) you are the reciter of many a holy hymn:Brahmaṇaspatiacknowledges a debt to the performer of a sacred rite; he is the acquitter (of the debt), and the destoyer of the oppressor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ श्रि॒ये व्य॑जिहीत॒ पर्व॑तो॒ गवां॑ गो॒त्रमु॒दसृ॑जो॒ यद॑ङ्गिरः । इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा तम॑सा॒ परी॑वृतं॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ निर॒पामौ॑ब्जो अर्ण॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ śriyé ǀ ví ǀ ajihīta ǀ párvataḥ ǀ gávām ǀ gotrám ǀ ut-ásṛjaḥ ǀ yát ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀíndreṇa ǀ yujā́ ǀ támasā ǀ pári-vṛtam ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ níḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ aubjaḥ ǀ arṇavám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenBṛhaspati, descendant ofAṅgiras, for your glory,Parvatahad concealed the herd o fkine, you did set them free, and with thine associate,Indra, did send down the ocean of water which had been enveloped by darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ त्वम॒स्य य॒न्ता सू॒क्तस्य॑ बोधि॒ तन॑यं च जिन्व । विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ tvám ǀ asyá ǀ yantā́ ǀ su-uktásya ǀ bodhi ǀ tánayam ǀ ca ǀ jinva ǀvíśvam ǀ tát ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ ávanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brahmaṇaspati, who are the regulator of this (world), understand (the purport) of (our) hymn, and grant us posterity; for all is prosperous that the gods protect; (and therefore) may we blessed with excellent descendants, glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेमाम॑विड्ढि॒ प्रभृ॑तिं॒ य ईशि॑षे॒ऽया वि॑धेम॒ नव॑या म॒हा गि॒रा । यथा॑ नो मी॒ढ्वान्त्स्तव॑ते॒ सखा॒ तव॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ सीष॑ध॒: सोत नो॑ म॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ prá-bhṛtim ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ ayā́ ǀ vidhema ǀ návayā ǀ mahā́ ǀ girā́ ǀyáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́n ǀ stávate ǀ sákhā ǀ táva ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ sī́sadhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ matím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Bṛhaspati, as you rule (over all), accept this our propitiation; we worship you with this new and solemn hymn; since this your friend, our benefactor, celebrates you, do you fulfil our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नन्त्वा॒न्यन॑म॒न्न्योज॑सो॒ताद॑र्दर्म॒न्युना॒ शम्ब॑राणि॒ वि । प्राच्या॑वय॒दच्यु॑ता॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒रा चावि॑श॒द्वसु॑मन्तं॒ वि पर्व॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ nántvāni ǀ ánamat ǀ ní ǀ ójasā ǀ utá ǀ adardaḥ ǀ manyúnā ǀ śámbarāṇi ǀ ví ǀprá ǀ acyavayat ǀ ácyutā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ áviśat ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ ví ǀ párvatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are) thatBrahmaṇaspatiwho, by his might, has humbled those who deserved humiliation; who in his wrath rent the clouds asunder; who sent down the undescending (waters); and made way into the mountain (cave), opulent (in cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्दे॒वानां॑ दे॒वत॑माय॒ कर्त्व॒मश्र॑थ्नन्दृ॒ळ्हाव्र॑दन्त वीळि॒ता । उद्गा आ॑ज॒दभि॑न॒द्ब्रह्म॑णा व॒लमगू॑ह॒त्तमो॒ व्य॑चक्षय॒त्स्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ devā́nām ǀ devá-tamāya ǀ kártvam ǀ áśrathnan ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ ávradanta ǀ vīḷitā́ ǀút ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ājat ǀ ábhinat ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ valám ǀ ágūhat ǀ támaḥ ǀ ví ǀ acakṣayat ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That was the exploit, (performed) for the most divine of the gods, by which the firm (shutgates) were thrown open, the strong (barriers) were relaxed, (by him) who set the cows at liberty; who, by the (force of the) sacred prayer, destroyedBalawho dispersed the darkness and displayed the light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्मा॑स्यमव॒तं ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्मधु॑धारम॒भि यमोज॒सातृ॑णत् । तमे॒व विश्वे॑ पपिरे स्व॒र्दृशो॑ ब॒हु सा॒कं सि॑सिचु॒रुत्स॑मु॒द्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśma-āsyam ǀ avatám ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ mádhu-dhāram ǀ abhí ǀ yám ǀ ójasā ǀ átṛṇat ǀtám ǀ evá ǀ víśve ǀ papire ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ bahú ǀ sākám ǀ sisicuḥ ǀ útsam ǀ udríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That stone-like, solid, down-hanging, water-laden (cloud), whichBrahmaṇaspatihas with his strength divided, the universal solar rays have drunk up; but they have again shed together the showering and water-spreading (rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॒ ता का चि॒द्भुव॑ना॒ भवी॑त्वा मा॒द्भिः श॒रद्भि॒र्दुरो॑ वरन्त वः । अय॑तन्ता चरतो अ॒न्यद॑न्य॒दिद्या च॒कार॑ व॒युना॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sánā ǀ tā́ ǀ kā́ ǀ cit ǀ bhúvanā ǀ bhávītvā ǀ māt-bhíḥ ǀ śarát-bhiḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ varanta ǀ vaḥ ǀáyatantā ǀ carataḥ ǀ anyát-anyat ǀ ít ǀ yā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ vayúnā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, (worshipper), the constant and manifold (bounties ofBrahmaṇaspati), through months and through years, set open the gates of the future rains, and he has appointed those results of prayer, which the two regions mutually and without effort provide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि॒नक्ष॑न्तो अ॒भि ये तमा॑न॒शुर्नि॒धिं प॑णी॒नां प॑र॒मं गुहा॑ हि॒तम् । ते वि॒द्वांस॑: प्रति॒चक्ष्यानृ॑ता॒ पुन॒र्यत॑ उ॒ आय॒न्तदुदी॑युरा॒विश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhi-nákṣantaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ tám ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀ ni-dhím ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ paramám ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀté ǀ vidvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ prati-cákṣya ǀ ánṛtā ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ā́yan ǀ tát ǀ út ǀ īyuḥ ǀ ā-víśam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those sages, who searching on every side, discovered the precious treasure (of cattle) hidden in the cave of thePaṇis, having seen through the false (illusions of theasura), and again coming (thither) forced an entrance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑नः प्रति॒चक्ष्यानृ॑ता॒ पुन॒रात॒ आ त॑स्थुः क॒वयो॑ म॒हस्प॒थः । ते बा॒हुभ्यां॑ धमि॒तम॒ग्निमश्म॑नि॒ नकि॒: षो अ॒स्त्यर॑णो ज॒हुर्हि तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ prati-cákṣya ǀ ánṛtā ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀté ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ dhamitám ǀ agním ǀ áśmani ǀ nákiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asti ǀ áraṇaḥ ǀ jahúḥ ǀ hí ǀ tám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those sages, eminent for truth, having seen through the false (illusions of theasura), again pursued the main road thither, and with theirhandscast against the rock the destructive fire, which, till then, was not there.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तज्ये॑न क्षि॒प्रेण॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्यत्र॒ वष्टि॒ प्र तद॑श्नोति॒ धन्व॑ना । तस्य॑ सा॒ध्वीरिष॑वो॒ याभि॒रस्य॑ति नृ॒चक्ष॑सो दृ॒शये॒ कर्ण॑योनयः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-jyena ǀ kṣipréṇa ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ yátra ǀ váṣṭi ǀ prá ǀ tát ǀ aśnoti ǀ dhánvanā ǀtásya ǀ sādhvī́ḥ ǀ íṣavaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ásyati ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀ dṛśáye ǀ kárṇa-yonayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhateverBrahmaṇaspatiaims at with the truth-strung quick-darting bow, that (mark) he surely attains; holy are its arrows with which he shoots (intended) for the eyes of men, and having their abode in the ear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सं॑न॒यः स वि॑न॒यः पु॒रोहि॑त॒: स सुष्टु॑त॒: स यु॒धि ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑: । चा॒क्ष्मो यद्वाजं॒ भर॑ते म॒ती धनादित्सूर्य॑स्तपति तप्य॒तुर्वृथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sam-nayáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vi-nayáḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ yudhí ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀcākṣmáḥ ǀ yát ǀ vā́jam ǀ bhárate ǀ matī́ ǀ dhánā ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ tapati ǀ tapyatúḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He,Brahmaṇaspati, is the aggregator and subjugator (of objects); the family priest (of the gods) and the renowned in battle; the beholder (of all), who bestows food and desired treasures, whence the radiant sun shines without exertion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भु प्र॒भु प्र॑थ॒मं मे॒हना॑वतो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑: सुवि॒दत्रा॑णि॒ राध्या॑ । इ॒मा सा॒तानि॑ वे॒न्यस्य॑ वा॒जिनो॒ येन॒ जना॑ उ॒भये॑ भुञ्ज॒ते विश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhú ǀ pra-bhú ǀ prathamám ǀ mehánā-vataḥ ǀ bṛ́haspáteḥ ǀ su-vidátrāṇi ǀ rā́dhyā ǀimā́ ǀ sātā́ni ǀ venyásya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ jánāḥ ǀ ubháye ǀ bhuñjaté ǀ víśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expansive, vast, and excellent riches, are the attainable (bounties) ofBṛhaspati, the sender of the rain; these are the gifts of the adorable giver of food, whereby both (descriptions of worshippers) entering here enjoy (abundance).”

shlokas.sanskrit: योऽव॑रे वृ॒जने॑ वि॒श्वथा॑ वि॒भुर्म॒हामु॑ र॒ण्वः शव॑सा व॒वक्षि॑थ । स दे॒वो दे॒वान्प्रति॑ पप्रथे पृ॒थु विश्वेदु॒ ता प॑रि॒भूर्ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ávare ǀ vṛjáne ǀ viśvá-thā ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ vavákṣitha ǀsáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ práti ǀ paprathe ǀ pṛthú ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tā́ ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who is all-pervading and delighting, is willing to sustain by his strength the noble, worshipper, as well as one who is in low distress; greatly is thatBrahmaṇaspatirenowned amongst the gods, and therefore is he verily supreme above all (beings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वं॑ स॒त्यं म॑घवाना यु॒वोरिदाप॑श्च॒न प्र मि॑नन्ति व्र॒तं वा॑म् । अच्छे॑न्द्राब्रह्मणस्पती ह॒विर्नोऽन्नं॒ युजे॑व वा॒जिना॑ जिगातम्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvam ǀ satyám ǀ magha-vānā ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ít ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ caná ǀ prá ǀ minanti ǀ vratám ǀ vām ǀáccha ǀ indrābrahmaṇaspatī íti ǀ havíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ánnam ǀ yújā-iva ǀ vājínā ǀ jigātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All truth, lords of wealth, (IndraandBrahmaṇaspati), is (inherent) in you both; the waters injure not your rites; come to our presence (to receive) our oblations, like a pair of steeds (to receive) their provender.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ताशि॑ष्ठा॒ अनु॑ शृण्वन्ति॒ वह्न॑यः स॒भेयो॒ विप्रो॑ भरते म॒ती धना॑ । वी॒ळु॒द्वेषा॒ अनु॒ वश॑ ऋ॒णमा॑द॒दिः स ह॑ वा॒जी स॑मि॒थे ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ ā́śiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śṛṇvanti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ sabhéyaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ bharate ǀ matī́ ǀ dhánā ǀvīḷu-dvéṣāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ váśā ǀ ṛṇám ǀ ā-dadíḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ha ǀ vājī́ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The very swift horses (ofBrahmaṇaspati) listen to (our invocation); the priest of the assembly offers with praise the (sacrificial) wealth; may Brahmaṇaspati, the hater of the oppressor, accept (the payment of) the debt, agreeably to his plural asure; may he be the accepter of the (sacrificial) food presented at this ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पते॑रभवद्यथाव॒शं स॒त्यो म॒न्युर्महि॒ कर्मा॑ करिष्य॒तः । यो गा उ॒दाज॒त्स दि॒वे वि चा॑भजन्म॒हीव॑ री॒तिः शव॑सासर॒त्पृथ॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ páteḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ yathā-vaśám ǀ satyáḥ ǀ manyúḥ ǀ máhi ǀ kárma ǀ kariṣyatáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ut-ā́jat ǀ sáḥ ǀ divé ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ abhajat ǀ mahī́-iva ǀ rītíḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ asarat ǀ pṛ́thak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purpose ofBrahmaṇaspati, engaging in a great work, has been successful, according to his wish; for he it was who recovered (the stolen) cattle for (the dwellers in) heaven; and distrubuted them; so that of their own power they took different directions, like (the branches of) a mighty river.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णस्पते सु॒यम॑स्य वि॒श्वहा॑ रा॒यः स्या॑म र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ वय॑स्वतः । वी॒रेषु॑ वी॒राँ उप॑ पृङ्धि न॒स्त्वं यदीशा॑नो॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वेषि॑ मे॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ su-yámasya ǀ viśváhā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ váyasvataḥ ǀvīréṣu ǀ vīrā́n ǀ úpa ǀ pṛṅdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ yát ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ véṣi ǀ me ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we,Brahmaṇaspati, be daily in the possession of well-regulated and food-supplying wealth; do you add for us posterity to posterity, since you, who are the ruler (of all) accept my invocation with (offered sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ त्वम॒स्य य॒न्ता सू॒क्तस्य॑ बोधि॒ तन॑यं च जिन्व । विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ tvám ǀ asyá ǀ yantā́ ǀ su-uktásya ǀ bodhi ǀ tánayam ǀ ca ǀ jinva ǀvíśvam ǀ tát ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ ávanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brahmaṇaspati, who are the regulator of this (world), understand (the purport of) our hymn, and grant us posterity; for all is prosperous that the gods protect; (and therefore) may we, blessed with excellent descendants, glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्धा॑नो अ॒ग्निं व॑नवद्वनुष्य॒तः कृ॒तब्र॑ह्मा शूशुवद्रा॒तह॑व्य॒ इत् । जा॒तेन॑ जा॒तमति॒ स प्र स॑र्सृते॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índhānaḥ ǀ agním ǀ vanavat ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ kṛtá-brahmā ǀ śūśuvat ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ ít ǀjāténa ǀ jātám ǀ áti ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ sarsṛte ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kindling the fire, may (the worshipper) overcome the malevolent (disturbers of the rite); may he, repeating prayers, and laden with oblations, prosper; he whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associates, lives to behold the son of his son.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒रेभि॑र्वी॒रान्व॑नवद्वनुष्य॒तो गोभी॑ र॒यिं प॑प्रथ॒द्बोध॑ति॒ त्मना॑ । तो॒कं च॒ तस्य॒ तन॑यं च वर्धते॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vīrébhiḥ ǀ vīrā́n ǀ vanavat ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ rayím ǀ paprathat ǀ bódhati ǀ tmánā ǀtokám ǀ ca ǀ tásya ǀ tánayam ǀ ca ǀ vardhate ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Surrounded) by his descendants, may hesurpasthe malevolent descendants (of his adversaries), for he is famed for great wealth of cattle, and understands (all things) of himself; his sons and grandsons prosper whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धु॒र्न क्षोद॒: शिमी॑वाँ ऋघाय॒तो वृषे॑व॒ वध्रीँ॑र॒भि व॒ष्ट्योज॑सा । अ॒ग्नेरि॑व॒ प्रसि॑ति॒र्नाह॒ वर्त॑वे॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ śímī-vān ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ vádhrīn ǀ abhí ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ ójasā ǀagnéḥ-iva ǀ prá-sitiḥ ǀ ná ǀ áha ǀ vártave ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a river (washes away) its banks, so the devout worshipper, (ofBrahmaṇaspati), overpowers his enemies by his strength, as a bull (overcomes) an ox; like the spreading flame of fire, it is impossible to stop him, whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मा॑ अर्षन्ति दि॒व्या अ॑स॒श्चत॒: स सत्व॑भिः प्रथ॒मो गोषु॑ गच्छति । अनि॑भृष्टतविषिर्ह॒न्त्योज॑सा॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ arṣanti ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ gacchati ǀánibhṛṣṭa-taviṣiḥ ǀ hanti ǀ ójasā ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For him, the unobstructed rains of heaven descend; first among the devout, he acqires (wealth) in cattle; of irresistible vigour, he destroys his enemies by his strength, whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ इद्विश्वे॑ धुनयन्त॒ सिन्ध॒वोऽच्छि॑द्रा॒ शर्म॑ दधिरे पु॒रूणि॑ । दे॒वानां॑ सु॒म्ने सु॒भग॒: स ए॑धते॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ ít ǀ víśve ǀ dhunayanta ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ácchidrā ǀ śárma ǀ dadhire ǀ purū́ṇi ǀdevā́nām ǀ sumné ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ edhate ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, for him all rivers flow; him do uninterrupted and numerous plural asures await; blessed with the felicity of the gods, he ever prospers, whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जुरिच्छंसो॑ वनवद्वनुष्य॒तो दे॑व॒यन्निददे॑वयन्तम॒भ्य॑सत् । सु॒प्रा॒वीरिद्व॑नवत्पृ॒त्सु दु॒ष्टरं॒ यज्वेदय॑ज्यो॒र्वि भ॑जाति॒ भोज॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjúḥ ǀ ít ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ vanavat ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ deva-yán ǀ ít ǀ ádeva-yantam ǀ abhí ǀ asat ǀsupra-avī́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ vanavat ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dustáram ǀ yájvā ǀ ít ǀ áyájyoḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhajāti ǀ bhójanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sincere praiser (ofBrahmaṇaspati) verily overcome (his) enemies; may the worshipper of the gods overcome him assuredly who does not reverence them; may the propitiatir (of Brahmaṇaspati) overcome him who is difficult to be overcome in battles; may he who offers sacrifice appropriate the food of him who does not sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज॑स्व वीर॒ प्र वि॑हि मनाय॒तो भ॒द्रं मन॑: कृणुष्व वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ । ह॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व सु॒भगो॒ यथास॑सि॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पते॒रव॒ आ वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: yájasva ǀ vīra ǀ prá ǀ vihi ǀ manāyatáḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀhavíḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ásasi ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ páteḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer worship, O man, (toBrahmaṇaspati); proceed resolutely against those who are meditating (hostility); keep your mind firm in contending against foes; offer oblations whereby you may be prosperous; we also solicit the protection of Brahmaṇaspati.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इज्जने॑न॒ स वि॒शा स जन्म॑ना॒ स पु॒त्रैर्वाजं॑ भरते॒ धना॒ नृभि॑: । दे॒वानां॒ यः पि॒तर॑मा॒विवा॑सति श्र॒द्धाम॑ना ह॒विषा॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ jánena ǀ sáḥ ǀ viśā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ jánmanā ǀ sáḥ ǀ putráiḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharate ǀ dhánā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀ śraddhā́-manāḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who with a believing mind worshipsBrahmaṇaspati, the father of the gods, with oblations, he verily receives food, together with his sons, his kindred, his descendants, his people, and (obtains) riches together with (all) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑स्मै ह॒व्यैर्घृ॒तव॑द्भि॒रवि॑ध॒त्प्र तं प्रा॒चा न॑यति॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑: । उ॒रु॒ष्यती॒मंह॑सो॒ रक्ष॑ती रि॒षों॒३॒॑ऽहोश्चि॑दस्मा उरु॒चक्रि॒रद्भु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ ghṛtávat-bhiḥ ǀ ávidhat ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ prācā́ ǀ nayati ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀuruṣyáti ǀ īm ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ rákṣati ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ uru-cákriḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brahmaṇaspatileads by a straight path (to his reward), the worshipper who propitiates him with oblations of butter; he guards him against sin; he protects him from foes and from distress; and wonderful (in might) confers upon him many (favours).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा गिर॑ आदि॒त्येभ्यो॑ घृ॒तस्नू॑: स॒नाद्राज॑भ्यो जु॒ह्वा॑ जुहोमि । शृ॒णोतु॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा भगो॑ नस्तुविजा॒तो वरु॑णो॒ दक्षो॒ अंश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ādityébhyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-snūḥ ǀ sanā́t ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ juhvā́ ǀ juhomi ǀśṛṇótu ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tuvi-jātáḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ áṃśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I present continually, with the ladle (of speech), these oblation-dropping hymns to the royalĀdityas; mayMitra,Aryaman,Bhaga, the multi-presentVaruṇa, the powerfulAṃśa, hear us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं स्तोमं॒ सक्र॑तवो मे अ॒द्य मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णो जुषन्त । आ॒दि॒त्यास॒: शुच॑यो॒ धार॑पूता॒ अवृ॑जिना अनव॒द्या अरि॑ष्टाः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ stómam ǀ sá-kratavaḥ ǀ me ǀ adyá ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀādityā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dhā́ra-pūtāḥ ǀ ávṛjināḥ ǀ anavadyā́ḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those of equal exploits,Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇa, be plural ased today by this my praise; they who areĀdityas, luminous, purified by showers, who abandon none (that worship them), who are irreproachable unassailable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त आ॑दि॒त्यास॑ उ॒रवो॑ गभी॒रा अद॑ब्धासो॒ दिप्स॑न्तो भूर्य॒क्षाः । अ॒न्तः प॑श्यन्ति वृजि॒नोत सा॒धु सर्वं॒ राज॑भ्यः पर॒मा चि॒दन्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ gabhīrā́ḥ ǀ ádabdhāsaḥ ǀ dípsantaḥ ǀ bhūri-akṣā́ḥ ǀantáríti ǀ paśyanti ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ utá ǀ sādhú ǀ sárvam ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ paramā́ ǀ cit ǀ ánti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThoseĀdityas, mighty, profound, unsubdued, subduing, many-eyed, behold the innermost (thoughts of men), whether wicked or virtuous, whether far from or nigh to those royal (deities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: धा॒रय॑न्त आदि॒त्यासो॒ जग॒त्स्था दे॒वा विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पाः । दी॒र्घाधि॑यो॒ रक्ष॑माणा असु॒र्य॑मृ॒तावा॑न॒श्चय॑माना ऋ॒णानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhāráyantaḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ jágat ǀ sthā́ḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀdīrghá-dhiyaḥ ǀ rákṣamāṇāḥ ǀ asuryám ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ cáyamānāḥ ǀ ṛṇā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineĀdityasare the upholders (of all things), moveable or immoveable; the protectors of the universe; the provident in acts; the collectors of rain; the possessors of veracity; the acquitters of our debts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्यामा॑दित्या॒ अव॑सो वो अ॒स्य यद॑र्यमन्भ॒य आ चि॑न्मयो॒भु । यु॒ष्माकं॑ मित्रावरुणा॒ प्रणी॑तौ॒ परि॒ श्वभ्रे॑व दुरि॒तानि॑ वृज्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: vidyā́m ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ yát ǀ aryaman ǀ bhayé ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ mayaḥ-bhú ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ prá-nītau ǀ pári ǀ śvábhrā-iva ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ vṛjyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I be conscious,Ādityas, of this your protection, the cause of happiness (and security) in danger;Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa, may I, through your guidance, escape the sins which are like pitfalls (in my path).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒गो हि वो॑ अर्यमन्मित्र॒ पन्था॑ अनृक्ष॒रो व॑रुण सा॒धुरस्ति॑ । तेना॑दित्या॒ अधि॑ वोचता नो॒ यच्छ॑ता नो दुष्परि॒हन्तु॒ शर्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-gáḥ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ aryaman ǀ mitra ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ anṛkṣaráḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ ásti ǀténa ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ naḥ ǀ yácchata ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-parihántu ǀ śárma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa, easy is the path (you show us), and free from thorns, and plural asant; therefore,Ādityas(lead us) by (it); speak to us favourably, and grant us happiness difficult to be disturbed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिप॑र्तु नो॒ अदि॑ती॒ राज॑पु॒त्राति॒ द्वेषां॑स्यर्य॒मा सु॒गेभि॑: । बृ॒हन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ शर्मोप॑ स्याम पुरु॒वीरा॒ अरि॑ष्टाः
shlokas.transliteration: pípartu ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ rā́ja-putrā́ ǀ áti ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ aryamā́ ǀ su-gébhiḥ ǀbṛhát ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ śárma ǀ úpa ǀ syāma ǀ puru-vī́rāḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAditi, the mother of royal song, plural ce us beyond the malice (of our enemies); mayAryamanlead us by easy paths, and may we, blessed with many descendants, and safe from harm, attain the great happiness ofMitraandVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो भूमी॑र्धारय॒न्त्रीँरु॒त द्यून्त्रीणि॑ व्र॒ता वि॒दथे॑ अ॒न्तरे॑षाम् । ऋ॒तेना॑दित्या॒ महि॑ वो महि॒त्वं तद॑र्यमन्वरुण मित्र॒ चारु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ bhū́mīḥ ǀ dhārayan ǀ trī́n ǀ utá ǀ dyū́n ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ vratā́ ǀ vidáthe ǀ antáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀṛténa ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ tát ǀ aryaman ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ cā́ru ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They uphold thethree worlds, the three heavens, and in their sacrifices three ceremonies (are comprised); by truth,Ādityas, has your great might (been produced), such as is most excellent;Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa. (They uphold the three worlds: tisro bhumir dhārayan:bhūmi=loka, world, or sphere; earth, firmament, and heaven which the Ādityas support by supplying them with rain; the three heavens: trīḥ dyūn, the three luminous objects, dīptan; the threelokasabove the sky:mahar,jana,satya; or the three luminous deities:agni,vāyuandsūrya; three ceremonies: trīṇi vratā vidathe antar eṣām = lit. the three ceremonies in the sacrifice, in the midst of them; the three daily ceremonials are essentially one worship of the Ādityas; alternative meaning:in the midst of those worlds, there are three acts intended especially as the acts of the Ādityas, the absorption, retention, and redistribution of dew on rain].”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्री रो॑च॒ना दि॒व्या धा॑रयन्त हिर॒ण्यया॒: शुच॑यो॒ धार॑पूताः । अस्व॑प्नजो अनिमि॒षा अद॑ब्धा उरु॒शंसा॑ ऋ॒जवे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ divyā́ ǀ dhārayanta ǀ hiraṇyáyāḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dhā́ra-pūtāḥ ǀásvapna-jaḥ ǀ ani-miṣā́ḥ ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǀ uru-śáṃsāḥ ǀ ṛjáve ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheĀdityas, decorated with golden ornaments, brilliant, purified by showers, who never slumber, nor close their eyelids, who are unassailable, and praised by many, uphold the three bright heavenly regions for the sake of the upright man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वे॑षां वरुणासि॒ राजा॒ ये च॑ दे॒वा अ॑सुर॒ ये च॒ मर्ता॑: । श॒तं नो॑ रास्व श॒रदो॑ वि॒चक्षे॒ऽश्यामायूं॑षि॒ सुधि॑तानि॒ पूर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ víśveṣām ǀ varuṇa ǀ asi ǀ rā́jā ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ asura ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ mártāḥ ǀśatám ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ vi-cákṣe ǀ aśyā́ma ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ sú-dhitāni ǀ pū́rvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇa, destroyer of foes, you are the sovereign over all, whether they be gods or mortals; grant to us to behold a hundred years, and that we may enjoy lives such as were enjoyed by ancient (sages).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न द॑क्षि॒णा वि चि॑किते॒ न स॒व्या न प्रा॒चीन॑मादित्या॒ नोत प॒श्चा । पा॒क्या॑ चिद्वसवो धी॒र्या॑ चिद्यु॒ष्मानी॑तो॒ अभ॑यं॒ ज्योति॑रश्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ dakṣiṇā́ ǀ ví ǀ cikite ǀ ná ǀ savyā́ ǀ ná ǀ prācī́nam ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ paścā́ ǀpākyā́ ǀ cit ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ dhīryā́ ǀ cit ǀ yuṣmā́-nītaḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ aśyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neither is the righthandknown to us,Ādityas, nor is the left; neither is that which is in front, nor that which is behind, (discerned by me); givers of dwellings, may I, who an immature (in knowledge), and timid (in spirit), obtain, when guided by you, the light that is free from fear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो राज॑भ्य ऋत॒निभ्यो॑ द॒दाश॒ यं व॒र्धय॑न्ति पु॒ष्टय॑श्च॒ नित्या॑: । स रे॒वान्या॑ति प्रथ॒मो रथे॑न वसु॒दावा॑ वि॒दथे॑षु प्रश॒स्तः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ ṛtaní-bhyaḥ ǀ dadā́śa ǀ yám ǀ vardháyanti ǀ puṣṭáyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ nítyāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ revā́n ǀ yāti ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ráthena ǀ vasu-dā́vā ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ pra-śastáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who presents offerings to the royal and true (Ādityas); he whom their constant favours exalt; he proceeds, wealthy, renowned, munificent, and honoured, to sacrifices, in his chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑र॒पः सू॒यव॑सा॒ अद॑ब्ध॒ उप॑ क्षेति वृ॒द्धव॑याः सु॒वीर॑: । नकि॒ष्टं घ्न॒न्त्यन्ति॑तो॒ न दू॒राद्य आ॑दि॒त्यानां॒ भव॑ति॒ प्रणी॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ su-yávasāḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ kṣeti ǀ vṛddhá-vayāḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ tám ǀ ghnanti ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dūrā́t ǀ yáḥ ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ bhávati ǀ prá-nītau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure, unmolested, possessing (abundant) food and virtuous descendants, he dwells amidst fertilizing waters; no one, whether nigh or afar, harms him who is (safe) in the good guidance of theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदि॑ते॒ मित्र॒ वरु॑णो॒त मृ॑ळ॒ यद्वो॑ व॒यं च॑कृ॒मा कच्चि॒दाग॑: । उ॒र्व॑श्या॒मभ॑यं॒ ज्योति॑रिन्द्र॒ मा नो॑ दी॒र्घा अ॒भि न॑श॒न्तमि॑स्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ádite ǀ mítra ǀ váruṇa ǀ utá ǀ mṛḷa ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ cakṛmá ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀurú ǀ aśyām ǀ ábhayam ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ indra ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dīrghā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ naśan ǀ támisrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aditi,Mitra,Varuṇa, have pity upon us, even though we may have committed some offence against you; may I obtain,Indra, that great light which is free from peril; let not the protracted glooms (of night) envelop us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे अ॑स्मै पीपयतः समी॒ची दि॒वो वृ॒ष्टिं सु॒भगो॒ नाम॒ पुष्य॑न् । उ॒भा क्षया॑वा॒जय॑न्याति पृ॒त्सूभावर्धौ॑ भवतः सा॒धू अ॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ asmai ǀ pīpayataḥ ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ púṣyan ǀubhā́ ǀ kṣáyau ǀ ā-jáyan ǀ yāti ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ ubháu ǀ árdhau ǀ bhavataḥ ǀ sādhū́ íti ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both (heaven and earth) combined, cherish him (whom theĀdityasprotect); verily prosperous, he thrives, with the rain of heaven; victorious in battles, (he defends) both his own dwelling (and assails) that of his foe; to him both portions (of creation) are propitious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वो॑ मा॒या अ॑भि॒द्रुहे॑ यजत्रा॒: पाशा॑ आदित्या रि॒पवे॒ विचृ॑त्ताः । अ॒श्वीव॒ ताँ अति॑ येषं॒ रथे॒नारि॑ष्टा उ॒रावा शर्म॑न्त्स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ abhi-drúhe ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ pā́śāḥ ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ripáve ǀ ví-cṛttāḥ ǀaśvī́-iva ǀ tā́n ǀ áti ǀ yeṣam ǀ ráthena ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ uráu ǀ ā́ ǀ śárman ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableĀdityas, may I pass (safe) in your car from the illusions which (you devise) for the malignant, the snares which are spread for your foes, (in like manner) as a horseman (passes over a road); and thus may we abide secure in infinite felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माहं म॒घोनो॑ वरुण प्रि॒यस्य॑ भूरि॒दाव्न॒ आ वि॑दं॒ शून॑मा॒पेः । मा रा॒यो रा॑जन्त्सु॒यमा॒दव॑ स्थां बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyásya ǀ bhūri-dā́vnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vidam ǀ śū́nam ǀ āpéḥ ǀmā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rājan ǀ su-yámāt ǀ áva ǀ sthām ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I never (have to) represent,Varuṇa, the destittution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal Varuṇa, be devoid of well-regulated riches; (and) may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं क॒वेरा॑दि॒त्यस्य॑ स्व॒राजो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ सान्त्य॒भ्य॑स्तु म॒ह्ना । अति॒ यो म॒न्द्रो य॒जथा॑य दे॒वः सु॑की॒र्तिं भि॑क्षे॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ भूरे॑:
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ kavéḥ ǀ ādityásya ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ sánti ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ mahnā́ ǀáti ǀ yáḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ deváḥ ǀ su-kīrtím ǀ bhikṣe ǀ váruṇasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The worshipper repeats) this praise of the sage; the self-radiantĀditya; may he preside over all beings by his power; I beg for fame of the sovereignVaruṇa, a deity who, when much plural ased (is propitious) to hsi adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ व्र॒ते सु॒भगा॑सः स्याम स्वा॒ध्यो॑ वरुण तुष्टु॒वांस॑: । उ॒पाय॑न उ॒षसां॒ गोम॑तीनाम॒ग्नयो॒ न जर॑माणा॒ अनु॒ द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ vraté ǀ su-bhágāsaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ tustu-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀupa-áyane ǀ uṣásām ǀ gó-matīnām ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ járamāṇāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we,Varuṇa, deeply meditating on you, earnestly praising you, and (engaged) in your worship, be prosperous; glorifying you daily, like the fires (that are kindled in your honour) at the coming of the luminous dawns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ स्याम पुरु॒वीर॑स्य॒ शर्म॑न्नुरु॒शंस॑स्य वरुण प्रणेतः । यू॒यं न॑: पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धा अ॒भि क्ष॑मध्वं॒ युज्या॑य देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ syāma ǀ puru-vī́rasya ǀ śárman ǀ uru-śáṃsasya ǀ varuṇa ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀyūyám ǀ naḥ ǀ putrāḥ ǀ aditeḥ ǀ adabdhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣamadhvam ǀ yújyāya ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇa, chief guide (of men), may we abide in the felicity of you, who are endowed with great powers, and are glorified by many; divine sons ofAditi, unharmed (by foes), have compassion upon us through your benevolence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सी॑मादि॒त्यो अ॑सृजद्विध॒र्ताँ ऋ॒तं सिन्ध॑वो॒ वरु॑णस्य यन्ति । न श्रा॑म्यन्ति॒ न वि मु॑चन्त्ये॒ते वयो॒ न प॑प्तू रघु॒या परि॑ज्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sīm ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀ ṛtám ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ yanti ǀná ǀ śrāmyanti ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ mucanti ǀ eté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ paptuḥ ǀ raghu-yā́ ǀ pári-jman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheĀditya, the upholder, has created all this water; the rivers flow by the power ofVaruṇa; they never weary, they never stop; they have descended with swiftness, like birds upon the circumambient (earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि मच्छ्र॑थाय रश॒नामि॒वाग॑ ऋ॒ध्याम॑ ते वरुण॒ खामृ॒तस्य॑ । मा तन्तु॑श्छेदि॒ वय॑तो॒ धियं॑ मे॒ मा मात्रा॑ शार्य॒पस॑: पु॒र ऋ॒तोः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ mát ǀ śrathaya ǀ raśanā́m-iva ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ ṛdhyā́ma ǀ te ǀ varuṇa ǀ khā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀmā́ ǀ tántuḥ ǀ chedi ǀ váyataḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ mā́ ǀ mā́trā ǀ śāri ǀ apásaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ ṛtóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cast off from me sin,Varuṇa, as if it were a rope; may we obtain from you a channel (filled) with water; cut not the thread of me (engaged in) weaving pious works; blight not the elements of holy rites before the season (of their maturity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपो॒ सु म्य॑क्ष वरुण भि॒यसं॒ मत्सम्रा॒ळृता॒वोऽनु॑ मा गृभाय । दामे॑व व॒त्साद्वि मु॑मु॒ग्ध्यंहो॑ न॒हि त्वदा॒रे नि॒मिष॑श्च॒नेशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ápo íti ǀ sú ǀ myakṣa ǀ varuṇa ǀ bhiyásam ǀ mát ǀ sám-rāṭ ǀ ṛ́ta-vaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ mā ǀ gṛbhāya ǀdā́ma-iva ǀ vatsā́t ǀ ví ǀ mumugdhi ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ nahí ǀ tvát ǀ āré ǀ ni-míṣaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ī́śe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Keep off all danger from me,Varuṇa; supreme monarch, endowed with truth, bestow your favour upon me; cast off (from me) sin, like a tether from a calf; no one rules for the twinkling of an eye, apart from you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ व॒धैर्व॑रुण॒ ये त॑ इ॒ष्टावेन॑: कृ॒ण्वन्त॑मसुर भ्री॒णन्ति॑ । मा ज्योति॑षः प्रवस॒थानि॑ गन्म॒ वि षू मृध॑: शिश्रथो जी॒वसे॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadháiḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ énaḥ ǀ kṛṇvántam ǀ asura ǀ bhrīṇánti ǀmā́ ǀ jyótiṣaḥ ǀ pra-vasathā́ni ǀ ganma ǀ ví ǀ sú ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm us not,Varuṇa, with those destructive (weapons), repeller (of foes), demolish him who does evil at your sacrifice; let us not depart (before our time) from the regions of light; scatter the malevolent, that we may live.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नम॑: पु॒रा ते॑ वरुणो॒त नू॒नमु॒ताप॒रं तु॑विजात ब्रवाम । त्वे हि कं॒ पर्व॑ते॒ न श्रि॒तान्यप्र॑च्युतानि दूळभ व्र॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: námaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ te ǀ varuṇa ǀ utá ǀ nūnám ǀ utá ǀ aparám ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ bravāma ǀtvé íti ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ párvate ǀ ná ǀ śritā́ni ǀ ápra-cyutāni ǀ duḥ-dabha ǀ vratā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As we have offered adoration to you,Varuṇa, of old, in like manner as we offer it now, so may we offer it in future (to you), who are everywhere present; for in you, who are difficult of attainment, as in an (immoveable) mountain, all holy acts are assembled, and are not to be dissevered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पर॑ ऋ॒णा सा॑वी॒रध॒ मत्कृ॑तानि॒ माहं रा॑जन्न॒न्यकृ॑तेन भोजम् । अव्यु॑ष्टा॒ इन्नु भूय॑सीरु॒षास॒ आ नो॑ जी॒वान्व॑रुण॒ तासु॑ शाधि
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ ṛṇā́ ǀ sāvīḥ ǀ ádha ǀ mát-kṛtāni ǀ mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ rājan ǀ anyá-kṛtena ǀ bhojam ǀávi-uṣṭāḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ bhū́yasīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ jīvā́n ǀ varuṇa ǀ tā́su ǀ śādhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Discharge,Varuṇa, the debts (contracted), by my progenitors, and those now (contracted) by me; and may I not, royal Varuṇa, be dependent (on the debts contracted) by another; many are the mornings that have, as it were, indeed not dawned; make us, Varuṇa, alive in them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मे॑ राज॒न्युज्यो॑ वा॒ सखा॑ वा॒ स्वप्ने॑ भ॒यं भी॒रवे॒ मह्य॒माह॑ । स्ते॒नो वा॒ यो दिप्स॑ति नो॒ वृको॑ वा॒ त्वं तस्मा॑द्वरुण पाह्य॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ rājan ǀ yújyaḥ ǀ vā ǀ sákhā ǀ vā ǀ svápne ǀ bhayám ǀ bhīráve ǀ máhyam ǀ ā́ha ǀstenáḥ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ dípsati ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ vā ǀ tvám ǀ tásmāt ǀ varuṇa ǀ pāhi ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Varuṇa, against every peril which a kinsman or a friend threatens me with alarmed in sleep; or from a thief or a wolf that attempts to destroy us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माहं म॒घोनो॑ वरुण प्रि॒यस्य॑ भूरि॒दाव्न॒ आ वि॑दं॒ शून॑मा॒पेः । मा रा॒यो रा॑जन्त्सु॒यमा॒दव॑ स्थां बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyásya ǀ bhūri-dā́vnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vidam ǀ śū́nam ǀ āpéḥ ǀmā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rājan ǀ su-yámāt ǀ áva ǀ sthām ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I nver (have to) represent,Varuṇa, the destitution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal (Varuṇa), be devoid of well-regulated riches; and may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धृत॑व्रता॒ आदि॑त्या॒ इषि॑रा आ॒रे मत्क॑र्त रह॒सूरि॒वाग॑: । शृ॒ण्व॒तो वो॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ देवा॑ भ॒द्रस्य॑ वि॒द्वाँ अव॑से हुवे वः
shlokas.transliteration: dhṛ́ta-vratāḥ ǀ ā́dityāḥ ǀ íṣirāḥ ǀ āré ǀ mát ǀ karta ǀ rahasū́ḥ-iva ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀśṛṇvatáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dévāḥ ǀ bhadrásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ávase ǀ huve ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, upholders of pious works, and who are to be sought by all, remove sin far from me, like a woman delivered in secret; knowing,Mitra,Varuṇaand (universal) gods, the good that follows from your hearing our prayers, I invoke you for (our) protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं दे॑वा॒: प्रम॑तिर्यू॒यमोजो॑ यू॒यं द्वेषां॑सि सनु॒तर्यु॑योत । अ॒भि॒क्ष॒त्तारो॑ अ॒भि च॒ क्षम॑ध्वम॒द्या च॑ नो मृ॒ळय॑ताप॒रं च॑
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ devāḥ ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ ójaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ yuyota ǀabhi-kṣattā́raḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ca ǀ kṣámadhvam ǀ adyá ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷáyata ǀ aparám ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, gods, are intelligence, you are vigour; do you drive away the malevolent subduers (of enemies), overcome them entirely, and grant us felicity both now and in future.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमू॒ नु व॑: कृणवा॒माप॑रेण॒ किं सने॑न वसव॒ आप्ये॑न । यू॒यं नो॑ मित्रावरुणादिते च स्व॒स्तिमि॑न्द्रामरुतो दधात
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ vaḥ ǀ kṛṇavāma ǀ ápareṇa ǀ kím ǀ sánena ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ ā́pyena ǀyūyám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ adite ǀ ca ǀ svastím ǀ indrāmarutaḥ ǀ dadhāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What may we do for you, gods, either now, or in the future; what may we do,Vasus, by perpetual and practicable (acts of devotion); do you,Mitra,Varuṇa,Aditi,Indraand theMaruts, maintain our bell-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒ये दे॑वा यू॒यमिदा॒पय॑: स्थ॒ ते मृ॑ळत॒ नाध॑मानाय॒ मह्य॑म् । मा वो॒ रथो॑ मध्यम॒वाळृ॒ते भू॒न्मा यु॒ष्माव॑त्स्वा॒पिषु॑ श्रमिष्म
shlokas.transliteration: hayé ǀ devāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ ít ǀ āpáyaḥ ǀ stha ǀ té ǀ mṛḷata ǀ nā́dhamānāya ǀ máhyam ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ madhyama-vā́ṭ ǀ ṛté ǀ bhūt ǀ mā́ ǀ yuṣmā́vat-su ǀ āpíṣu ǀ śramiṣma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O Gods, you, verily, are our kinsmen; being so, grant felicity to me your suppliant; let not your chariot be tardy in coming to the sacrifice; let us never be weary of relatives such as you are.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒ एको॑ मिमय॒ भूर्यागो॒ यन्मा॑ पि॒तेव॑ कित॒वं श॑शा॒स । आ॒रे पाशा॑ आ॒रे अ॒घानि॑ देवा॒ मा माधि॑ पु॒त्रे विमि॑व ग्रभीष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ mimaya ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ kitavám ǀ śaśāsá ǀāré ǀ pā́śāḥ ǀ āré ǀ aghā́ni ǀ devāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ mā ǀ ádhi ǀ putré ǀ vím-iva ǀ grabhīṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Alone among you, I have committed many offences, (which correct) as a father corrects a naughty (son); far from me, gods, bebonds; far from be sins; size not upon me (your) son as (a fowler) catches a bird.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चो॑ अ॒द्या भ॑वता यजत्रा॒ आ वो॒ हार्दि॒ भय॑मानो व्ययेयम् । त्राध्वं॑ नो देवा नि॒जुरो॒ वृक॑स्य॒ त्राध्वं॑ क॒र्ताद॑व॒पदो॑ यजत्राः
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ bhavata ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ hā́rdi ǀ bháyamānaḥ ǀ vyayeyam ǀtrā́dhvam ǀ naḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ni-júraḥ ǀ vṛ́kasya ǀ trā́dhvam ǀ kartā́t ǀ ava-pádaḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable (deities), be present today, that, apprehensive of danger, I may feel sure of your healthy (support); protect us, gods, from the rapacity of the wolf; protect us, adorable (deities), from him who would work us misfortune.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माहं म॒घोनो॑ वरुण प्रि॒यस्य॑ भूरि॒दाव्न॒ आ वि॑दं॒ शून॑मा॒पेः । मा रा॒यो रा॑जन्त्सु॒यमा॒दव॑ स्थां बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyásya ǀ bhūri-dā́vnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vidam ǀ śū́nam ǀ āpéḥ ǀmā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rājan ǀ su-yámāt ǀ áva ǀ sthām ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I never (have to) represent,Varuṇa, the destitution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal (Varuṇa), be devoid of well-regulated riches, and may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं दे॒वाय॑ कृण्व॒ते स॑वि॒त्र इन्द्रा॑याहि॒घ्ने न र॑मन्त॒ आप॑: । अह॑रहर्यात्य॒क्तुर॒पां किया॒त्या प्र॑थ॒मः सर्ग॑ आसाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ devā́ya ǀ kṛṇvaté ǀ savitré ǀ índrāya ǀ ahi-ghné ǀ ná ǀ ramante ǀ ā́paḥ ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ yāti ǀ aktúḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ kíyati ǀ ā́ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sárgaḥ ǀ āsām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters cease not (to flow in libations) to the divineIndra, the sender of rain, the animator (of all), the slayer of Ahi; day by day proceeds the current of the waters; at what period of time was their first creation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वृ॒त्राय॒ सिन॒मत्राभ॑रिष्य॒त्प्र तं जनि॑त्री वि॒दुष॑ उवाच । प॒थो रद॑न्ती॒रनु॒ जोष॑मस्मै दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ धुन॑यो य॒न्त्यर्थ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ sínam ǀ átra ǀ ábhariṣyat ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ jánitrī ǀ vidúṣe ǀ uvāca ǀpatháḥ ǀ rádantīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ asmai ǀ divé-dive ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ ártham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His mother, (Aditi), declared to him the man who had offered (sacrificial) food toVṛtra;obedient to his plural asure, the rivers, tracing out their paths, flow day by day to their object, (the ocean).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो ह्यस्था॒दध्य॒न्तरि॒क्षेऽधा॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ प्र व॒धं ज॑भार । मिहं॒ वसा॑न॒ उप॒ हीमदु॑द्रोत्ति॒ग्मायु॑धो अजय॒च्छत्रु॒मिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ hí ǀ ásthāt ǀ ádhi ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ádha ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ vadhám ǀ jabhāra ǀmíham ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ hí ǀ īm ǀ ádudrot ǀ tigmá-āyudhaḥ ǀ ajayat ǀ śátrum ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as he had soared aloft above the firmamentIndrahurled againstVṛtrahis destructive (thunderbolt); enveloped in a cloud, he rushed upon Indra, but the wielder of the sharp-edged weapon triumphed over his foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते॒ तपु॒षाश्ने॑व विध्य॒ वृक॑द्वरसो॒ असु॑रस्य वी॒रान् । यथा॑ ज॒घन्थ॑ धृष॒ता पु॒रा चि॑दे॒वा ज॑हि॒ शत्रु॑म॒स्माक॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ tápuṣā ǀ áśnā-iva ǀ vidhya ǀ vṛ́ka-dvarasaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́n ǀyáthā ǀ jaghántha ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ jahi ǀ śátrum ǀ asmā́kam ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pierce,Bṛhaspati, with a radiant shaft,  as with a thunderbolt, the sons of theasuraguarding his gates; in like manner as you did formerly slayVṛtraby your own prowess, so do you now destroy our enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ क्षिप दि॒वो अश्मा॑नमु॒च्चा येन॒ शत्रुं॑ मन्दसा॒नो नि॒जूर्वा॑: । तो॒कस्य॑ सा॒तौ तन॑यस्य॒ भूरे॑र॒स्माँ अ॒र्धं कृ॑णुतादिन्द्र॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ kṣipa ǀ diváḥ ǀ áśmānam ǀ uccā́ ǀ yéna ǀ śátrum ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ni-jū́rvāḥ ǀtokásya ǀ sātáu ǀ tánayasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ardhám ǀ kṛṇutāt ǀ indra ǀ gónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are on high, cast down fromheaven the adamantine (thunderbolt), wherewith, when exhilarated, you did slay your foe; and make us affluent in the possession of many sons, and grandsons, and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र हि क्रतुं॑ वृ॒हथो॒ यं व॑नु॒थो र॒ध्रस्य॑ स्थो॒ यज॑मानस्य चो॒दौ । इन्द्रा॑सोमा यु॒वम॒स्माँ अ॑विष्टम॒स्मिन्भ॒यस्थे॑ कृणुतमु लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hí ǀ krátum ǀ vṛháthaḥ ǀ yám ǀ vanutháḥ ǀ radhrásya ǀ sthaḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ codáu ǀíndrāsomā ǀ yuvám ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ asmín ǀ bhayá-sthe ǀ kṛṇutam ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, eradicate the worker (of evil), whom you hate; be the encouragers of the liberal instrumental tutor of the rite; protect us in this plural ce of peril, and make the world (free from fear).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न मा॑ तम॒न्न श्र॑म॒न्नोत त॑न्द्र॒न्न वो॑चाम॒ मा सु॑नो॒तेति॒ सोम॑म् । यो मे॑ पृ॒णाद्यो दद॒द्यो नि॒बोधा॒द्यो मा॑ सु॒न्वन्त॒मुप॒ गोभि॒राय॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ mā ǀ tamat ǀ ná ǀ śramat ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ tandrat ǀ ná ǀ vocāma ǀ mā́ ǀ sunota ǀ íti ǀ sómam ǀyáḥ ǀ me ǀ pṛṇā́t ǀ yáḥ ǀ dádat ǀ yáḥ ǀ ni-bódhāt ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ sunvántam ǀ úpa ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ áyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let notIndravexme, or weary me, or make me slothful; never may we say (to another), do not offer theSoma; (for it is Indra) who will fulfil (my wishes), who will give (me riches), who will hear (my prayers), who will reward me, presenting libations, with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वति॒ त्वम॒स्माँ अ॑विड्ढि म॒रुत्व॑ती धृष॒ती जे॑षि॒ शत्रू॑न् । त्यं चि॒च्छर्ध॑न्तं तविषी॒यमा॑ण॒मिन्द्रो॑ हन्ति वृष॒भं शण्डि॑कानाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvati ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ marútvatī ǀ dhṛṣatī́ ǀ jeṣi ǀ śátrūn ǀtyám ǀ cit ǀ śárdhantam ǀ taviṣī-yámāṇam ǀ índraḥ ǀ hanti ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ śáṇḍikānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, do you protect us; associated with theMarutsand firm (of purpose), overcome our foes, whiilstIndraslays the chief of the Śaṇḍikas, defying him and confiding in his strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॒: सनु॑त्य उ॒त वा॑ जिघ॒त्नुर॑भि॒ख्याय॒ तं ति॑गि॒तेन॑ विध्य । बृह॑स्पत॒ आयु॑धैर्जेषि॒ शत्रू॑न्द्रु॒हे रीष॑न्तं॒ परि॑ धेहि राजन्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sánutyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ jighatnúḥ ǀ abhi-khyā́ya ǀ tám ǀ tigiténa ǀ vidhya ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ jeṣi ǀ śátrūn ǀ druhé ǀ ríṣantam ǀ pári ǀ dhehi ǀ rājan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Detecting him who is lying in ambush (against us), who is purposing our death, pierce him,Bṛhaspati, with your sharp (thunderbolt), and overthrow (our) enemies with (your) weapons; hurl, monarch, your destroying (shaft) against the oppressor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माके॑भि॒: सत्व॑भिः शूर॒ शूरै॑र्वी॒र्या॑ कृधि॒ यानि॑ ते॒ कर्त्वा॑नि । ज्योग॑भूव॒न्ननु॑धूपितासो ह॒त्वी तेषा॒मा भ॑रा नो॒ वसू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kebhiḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ śūra ǀ śū́raiḥ ǀ vīryā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ yā́ni ǀ te ǀ kártvāni ǀjyók ǀ abhūvan ǀ ánu-dhūpitāsaḥ ǀ hatvī́ ǀ téṣām ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Achieve, hero, along with our valiant heroes, the exploits that are to be achieved by you; long have (our enemies) been inflated (with pride); slay them, and bring to us their treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॒: शर्धं॒ मारु॑तं सुम्न॒युर्गि॒रोप॑ ब्रुवे॒ नम॑सा॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म् । यथा॑ र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नशा॑महा अपत्य॒साचं॒ श्रुत्यं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdham ǀ mā́rutam ǀ sumna-yúḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ námasā ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀyáthā ǀ rayím ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ náśāmahai ǀ apatya-sā́cam ǀ śrútyam ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of felicity,Maruts, I glorify with praise and homage you divine, manifest and congregated strength; that we may thereby daily enjoy distinguished affluence, accompanied by valiant dependants and posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ मित्रावरुणावतं॒ रथ॑मादि॒त्यै रु॒द्रैर्वसु॑भिः सचा॒भुवा॑ । प्र यद्वयो॒ न पप्त॒न्वस्म॑न॒स्परि॑ श्रव॒स्यवो॒ हृषी॑वन्तो वन॒र्षद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ avatam ǀ rátham ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ páptan ǀ vásmanaḥ ǀ pári ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ hṛ́ṣī-vantaḥ ǀ vana-sádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, associated with theĀdityas, theRudrasand theVasus, protect our (sacrificial) chariot, when (it goes) about (from one plural ce to another); like birds that fly down, seeking for food, rejoicing, and resting in the woods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्मा न॒ उद॑वता सजोषसो॒ रथं॑ देवासो अ॒भि वि॒क्षु वा॑ज॒युम् । यदा॒शव॒: पद्या॑भि॒स्तित्र॑तो॒ रज॑: पृथि॒व्याः सानौ॒ जङ्घ॑नन्त पा॒णिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ avata ǀ sa-joṣasaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vikṣú ǀ vāja-yúm ǀyát ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ pádyābhiḥ ǀ títrataḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ sā́nau ǀ jáṅghananta ǀ pāṇí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiated divinities, protect our chariot, gone forth in quest of food among the people, when the quick (horses), raising the dust with their paces, trample with their feet upon the high plural ces of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर्दि॒वः शर्धे॑न॒ मारु॑तेन सु॒क्रतु॑: । अनु॒ नु स्था॑त्यवृ॒काभि॑रू॒तिभी॒ रथं॑ म॒हे स॒नये॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ śárdhena ǀ mā́rutena ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀánu ǀ nú ǀ sthāti ǀ avṛkā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ rátham ǀ mahé ǀ sanáye ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or, may that all beholdingIndra, the accomplisher of great deeds, by the collective vigour of theMaruts, (coming) from heaven, protect our chariot with unassailable protection, (for the sake of securing to us) ample wealth and abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य दे॒वो भुव॑नस्य स॒क्षणि॒स्त्वष्टा॒ ग्नाभि॑: स॒जोषा॑ जूजुव॒द्रथ॑म् । इळा॒ भगो॑ बृहद्दि॒वोत रोद॑सी पू॒षा पुरं॑धिर॒श्विना॒वधा॒ पती॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ sakṣáṇiḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ gnā́bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ jūjuvat ǀ rátham ǀíḷā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ utá ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ aśvínau ǀ ádha ǀ pátī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or, may the divineTvaṣṭā, the defender of the world, together with the wives (of the gods), well plural ased, urge on the chariot; or may Iḷā, the resplendentBhaga, Heaven and Earth, the sagaciousPūṣan, and theAśvins, the two husbands (ofSūryā), urge on the chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये दे॒वी सु॒भगे॑ मिथू॒दृशो॒षासा॒नक्ता॒ जग॑तामपी॒जुवा॑ । स्तु॒षे यद्वां॑ पृथिवि॒ नव्य॑सा॒ वच॑: स्था॒तुश्च॒ वय॒स्त्रिव॑या उप॒स्तिरे॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé íti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ subháge íti su-bháge ǀ mithu-dṛ́śā ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ jágatām ǀ api-júvā ǀstuṣé ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ pṛthivi ǀ návyasā ǀ vácaḥ ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ ca ǀ váyaḥ ǀ trí-vayāḥ ǀ upa-stíre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or, may the two divine auspicious and mutually contemplating Day and Night, the animators of moving (creatures, urge it on); and, Earth and Heaven, whilst I praise you both with a new hymn, I offer you food of the standing (corn), although provided with the three (sorts of sacrificial) viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त व॒: शंस॑मु॒शिजा॑मिव श्म॒स्यहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॒३॒॑ऽज एक॑पादु॒त । त्रि॒त ऋ॑भु॒क्षाः स॑वि॒ता चनो॑ दधे॒ऽपां नपा॑दाशु॒हेमा॑ धि॒या शमि॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ uśíjām-iva ǀ śmasi ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ utá ǀtritáḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ āśu-hémā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śámi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We desire, gods, to repeat the praise of you, who are propitiated by praise; mayAhirbudhnya, Aja ekapād,Trita,Ṛbhukṣin,Savitā, bestow upon us food, and may the swift-moving grandson of the waters, (Agni, be gratified by) our praises and our worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता वो॑ व॒श्म्युद्य॑ता यजत्रा॒ अत॑क्षन्ना॒यवो॒ नव्य॑से॒ सम् । श्र॒व॒स्यवो॒ वाजं॑ चका॒नाः सप्ति॒र्न रथ्यो॒ अह॑ धी॒तिम॑श्याः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vaśmi ǀ út-yatā ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ átakṣan ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ návyase ǀ sám ǀśravasyávaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ cakānā́ḥ ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthyaḥ ǀ áha ǀ dhītím ǀ aśyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable (gods), I desire that these (my) earnest praises (should plural ase) you; men wishing for food, desirous of vigour, have constructed (hymns) for your celebration; may you hasten like a (swift) chariot-horse to our (pious) rite].”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य मे॑ द्यावापृथिवी ऋताय॒तो भू॒तम॑वि॒त्री वच॑स॒: सिषा॑सतः । ययो॒रायु॑: प्रत॒रं ते इ॒दं पु॒र उप॑स्तुते वसू॒युर्वां॑ म॒हो द॑धे
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ me ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ ṛta-yatáḥ ǀ bhūtám ǀ avitrī́ íti ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ sísāsataḥ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ té íti ǀ idám ǀ puráḥ ǀ úpastute ítyúpa-stute ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ dadhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and Earth, be the protectors of me your worshipper, anxious to propitiate you by worship and adoration, for of you two is abundant food; desiring riches, I glorify you both and celebrate you with great (laudation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ गुह्या॒ रिप॑ आ॒योरह॑न्दभ॒न्मा न॑ आ॒भ्यो री॑रधो दु॒च्छुना॑भ्यः । मा नो॒ वि यौ॑: स॒ख्या वि॒द्धि तस्य॑ नः सुम्नाय॒ता मन॑सा॒ तत्त्वे॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gúhyāḥ ǀ rípaḥ ǀ āyóḥ ǀ áhan ǀ dabhan ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ābhyáḥ ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀ ducchúnābhyaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ yauḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ viddhí ǀ tásya ǀ naḥ ǀ sumna-yatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ tát ǀ tvā ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the secret guile of man, (Indra), harm us by day (or night); leave us not subject to the malevolent, disunite us not from your frienship; regard us with the favourable thoughts that (spring) from it; we ask this (boon) of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहे॑ळता॒ मन॑सा श्रु॒ष्टिमा व॑ह॒ दुहा॑नां धे॒नुं पि॒प्युषी॑मस॒श्चत॑म् । पद्या॑भिरा॒शुं वच॑सा च वा॒जिनं॒ त्वां हि॑नोमि पुरुहूत वि॒श्वहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: áheḷatā ǀ mánasā ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ dúhānām ǀ dhenúm ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ asaścátam ǀpádyābhiḥ ǀ āśúm ǀ vácasā ǀ ca ǀ vājínam ǀ tvā́m ǀ hinomi ǀ puru-hūta ǀ viśváhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us, with benignant mind, the well-nourished and compactly-limbed cow, yielding milk, and conferring happiness; daily I glorify you, who are adored by many, quick in (your) steps, and rapid in (your) words.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒काम॒हं सु॒हवां॑ सुष्टु॒ती हु॑वे शृ॒णोतु॑ नः सु॒भगा॒ बोध॑तु॒ त्मना॑ । सीव्य॒त्वप॑: सू॒च्याच्छि॑द्यमानया॒ ददा॑तु वी॒रं श॒तदा॑यमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: rākā́m ǀ ahám ǀ su-hávām ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ huve ǀ śṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ bódhatu ǀ tmánā ǀsī́vyatu ǀ ápaḥ ǀ sūcyā́ ǀ ácchidyamānayā ǀ dádātu ǀ vīrám ǀ śatá-dāyam ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke, with suitable praise,Rākā, who is worthily invoked; may she, who is auspicious of good fortune, hear us, and spontaneously understand (our purpose); may she sew her work with an infallible needle; may she grant us excellent and opulent descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यास्ते॑ राके सुम॒तय॑: सु॒पेश॑सो॒ याभि॒र्ददा॑सि दा॒शुषे॒ वसू॑नि । ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सु॒मना॑ उ॒पाग॑हि सहस्रपो॒षं सु॑भगे॒ ररा॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ rāke ǀ su-matáyaḥ ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ dádāsi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásūni ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ upa-ā́gahi ǀ sahasra-poṣám ǀ su-bhage ǀ rárāṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rākā, with those your kind and gracious intentions, wherewith you grant riches to the donor (of oblations), approach us today; you who are auspicious of good fortune, favourably inclined, and bestowing a thousand blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिनी॑वालि॒ पृथु॑ष्टुके॒ या दे॒वाना॒मसि॒ स्वसा॑ । जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः
shlokas.transliteration: sínīvāli ǀ pṛ́thu-stuke ǀ yā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ási ǀ svásā ǀjuṣásva ǀ havyám ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ devi ǀ didiḍḍhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wide-hippedSinivālī, who are the sister of the gods, accept the offered oblation, and grant us, goddess, progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या सु॑बा॒हुः स्व॑ङ्गु॒रिः सु॒षूमा॑ बहु॒सूव॑री । तस्यै॑ वि॒श्पत्न्यै॑ ह॒विः सि॑नीवा॒ल्यै जु॑होतन
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ su-bāhúḥ ǀ su-aṅguríḥ ǀ su-sū́mā ǀ bahu-sū́varī ǀtásyai ǀ viśpátnyai ǀ havíḥ ǀ sinīvālyái ǀ juhotana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer the oblation to thatSinīvālī, the protectress of mankind who has beautiful arms, beautiful fingers, who is the parent of many children, and who has numerous children.”
