shlokas.sanskrit: या गु॒ङ्गूर्या सि॑नीवा॒ली या रा॒का या सर॑स्वती । इ॒न्द्रा॒णीम॑ह्व ऊ॒तये॑ वरुणा॒नीं स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ guṅgū́ḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ sinīvālī́ ǀ yā́ ǀ rākā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀindrāṇī́m ǀ ahve ǀ ūtáye ǀ varuṇānī́m ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke her who is Gaṅgū, who isSinīvālī, who isRākā, who isSarasvatī; (I invoke)Indrāṇīfor protection,Varuṇānīfor welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ पितर्मरुतां सु॒म्नमे॑तु॒ मा न॒: सूर्य॑स्य सं॒दृशो॑ युयोथाः । अ॒भि नो॑ वी॒रो अर्व॑ति क्षमेत॒ प्र जा॑येमहि रुद्र प्र॒जाभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ pitaḥ ǀ marutām ǀ sumnám ǀ etu ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sam-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ yuyothāḥ ǀabhí ǀ naḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ árvati ǀ kṣameta ǀ prá ǀ jāyemahi ǀ rudra ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Father of theMaruts”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाद॑त्तेभी रुद्र॒ शंत॑मेभिः श॒तं हिमा॑ अशीय भेष॒जेभि॑: । व्य१॒॑स्मद्द्वेषो॑ वित॒रं व्यंहो॒ व्यमी॑वाश्चातयस्वा॒ विषू॑चीः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-dattebhiḥ ǀ rudra ǀ śám-tamebhiḥ ǀ śatám ǀ hímāḥ ǀ aśīya ǀ bheṣajébhiḥ ǀví ǀ asmát ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀ cātayasva ǀ víṣūcīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nourished by the curative vegetables which are bestowed by you, may I live a hundred winters; extirpate mine enemies, my exceeding sin, and my manifold infirmities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठो॑ जा॒तस्य॑ रुद्र श्रि॒यासि॑ त॒वस्त॑मस्त॒वसां॑ वज्रबाहो । पर्षि॑ णः पा॒रमंह॑सः स्व॒स्ति विश्वा॑ अ॒भी॑ती॒ रप॑सो युयोधि
shlokas.transliteration: śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ jātásya ǀ rudra ǀ śriyā́ ǀ asi ǀ taváḥ-tamaḥ ǀ tavásām ǀ vajrabāho íti vajra-bāho ǀpárṣi ǀ naḥ ǀ pārám ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí-itīḥ ǀ rápasaḥ ǀ yuyodhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Rudra, are the chief of beings in glory; you, wielder of the thunderbolt, are the might of themighty; do you waft us in safety over (the ocean) of sin; repel all the assaults of iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा त्वा॑ रुद्र चुक्रुधामा॒ नमो॑भि॒र्मा दुःष्टु॑ती वृषभ॒ मा सहू॑ती । उन्नो॑ वी॒राँ अ॑र्पय भेष॒जेभि॑र्भि॒षक्त॑मं त्वा भि॒षजां॑ शृणोमि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ rudra ǀ cukrudhāma ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ dúḥ-stutī ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ mā́ ǀ sá-hūtī ǀút ǀ naḥ ǀ vīrā́n ǀ arpaya ǀ bheṣajébhiḥ ǀ bhiṣák-tamam ǀ tvā ǀ bhiṣájām ǀ śṛṇomi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us not provoke you,Rudra, to wrath by our (imperfect) adorations; nor, showerer (of benefits), by our unworthy praise, nor by our invocation (of other deities); invigorate our sons by your medicinal plural nts, for I hear that you are a chief physician amongst physicians.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हवी॑मभि॒र्हव॑ते॒ यो ह॒विर्भि॒रव॒ स्तोमे॑भी रु॒द्रं दि॑षीय । ऋ॒दू॒दर॑: सु॒हवो॒ मा नो॑ अ॒स्यै ब॒भ्रुः सु॒शिप्रो॑ रीरधन्म॒नायै॑
shlokas.transliteration: hávīma-bhiḥ ǀ hávate ǀ yáḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ áva ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ diṣīya ǀṛdūdáraḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyái ǀ babhrúḥ ǀ su-śípraḥ ǀ rīradhat ǀ manā́yai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I pacify by my praises thatRudra, who is worshipped with invocations and oblations; and never may he who is soft-bellied, of a tawny hue, and handsome chin; who is reverently invoked; subject us to that malevolent disposition (that purposes our destruction).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उन्मा॑ ममन्द वृष॒भो म॒रुत्वा॒न्त्वक्षी॑यसा॒ वय॑सा॒ नाध॑मानम् । घृणी॑व च्छा॒याम॑र॒पा अ॑शी॒या वि॑वासेयं रु॒द्रस्य॑ सु॒म्नम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ mā ǀ mamanda ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ tvákṣīyasā ǀ váyasā ǀ nā́dhamānam ǀghṛ́ṇi-iva ǀ chāyā́m ǀ arapā́ḥ ǀ aśīya ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāseyam ǀ rudrásya ǀ sumnám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the showerer of benefits, the lord of theMaruts, gratify me his suppliant with invogorating food; may I, free from sin, so propitiateRudra, that I may attain to his felicity, as a man, distressed by heat, (finds relief) in the shade.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ स्य ते॑ रुद्र मृळ॒याकु॒र्हस्तो॒ यो अस्ति॑ भेष॒जो जला॑षः । अ॒प॒भ॒र्ता रप॑सो॒ दैव्य॑स्या॒भी नु मा॑ वृषभ चक्षमीथाः
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ syáḥ ǀ te ǀ rudra ǀ mṛḷayā́kuḥ ǀ hástaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ bheṣajáḥ ǀ jálāṣaḥ ǀapa-bhartā́ ǀ rápasaḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀ abhí ǀ nú ǀ mā ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ cakṣamīthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where,Rudra, is your joy-dispendinghand, which is the healer and delighter (of all); showerer (of benefits), who are the dispeller of sins of the gods, quickly have compassion upon me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ब॒भ्रवे॑ वृष॒भाय॑ श्विती॒चे म॒हो म॒हीं सु॑ष्टु॒तिमी॑रयामि । न॒म॒स्या क॑ल्मली॒किनं॒ नमो॑भिर्गृणी॒मसि॑ त्वे॒षं रु॒द्रस्य॒ नाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ babhráve ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ śvitīcé ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ su-stutím ǀ īrayāmi ǀnamasyá ǀ kalmalīkínam ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇīmási ǀ tveṣám ǀ rudrásya ǀ nā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I address infinite and earnest praise to the showerer (of benefits), the cherisher (of all), the white-complexioned; adore the consumer (of sin), with prostrations; we glorify the illustrious name ofRudra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रेभि॒रङ्गै॑: पुरु॒रूप॑ उ॒ग्रो ब॒भ्रुः शु॒क्रेभि॑: पिपिशे॒ हिर॑ण्यैः । ईशा॑नाद॒स्य भुव॑नस्य॒ भूरे॒र्न वा उ॑ योषद्रु॒द्राद॑सु॒र्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sthirébhiḥ ǀ áṅgaiḥ ǀ puru-rū́paḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ babhrúḥ ǀ śukrébhiḥ ǀ pipiśe ǀ híraṇyaiḥ ǀī́śānāt ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ná ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ yoṣat ǀ rudrā́t ǀ asuryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Firm) with strong limbs, assuming many forms fierce, and tawny-coloured, he shines with brilliant golden ornaments; vigour is inseparable fromRudra, the supreme ruler and lord of this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्ह॑न्बिभर्षि॒ साय॑कानि॒ धन्वार्ह॑न्नि॒ष्कं य॑ज॒तं वि॒श्वरू॑पम् । अर्ह॑न्नि॒दं द॑यसे॒ विश्व॒मभ्वं॒ न वा ओजी॑यो रुद्र॒ त्वद॑स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: árhan ǀ bibharṣi ǀ sā́yakāni ǀ dhánva ǀ árhan ǀ niṣkám ǀ yajatám ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀárhan ǀ idám ǀ dayase ǀ víśvam ǀ ábhvam ǀ ná ǀ vái ǀ ójīyaḥ ǀ rudra ǀ tvát ǀ asti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worthy (of reverence), you bear arrows and a bow; worthy (of praise), you wear an adorable and omniform necklace; worthy (of adoration), you preseve all this vast universe; there is no one more powerful than you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒हि श्रु॒तं ग॑र्त॒सदं॒ युवा॑नं मृ॒गं न भी॒ममु॑पह॒त्नुमु॒ग्रम् । मृ॒ळा ज॑रि॒त्रे रु॑द्र॒ स्तवा॑नो॒ऽन्यं ते॑ अ॒स्मन्नि व॑पन्तु॒ सेना॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stuhí ǀ śrutám ǀ garta-sádam ǀ yúvānam ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ bhīmám ǀ upa-hatnúm ǀ ugrám ǀmṛḷá ǀ jaritré ǀ rudra ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ anyám ǀ te ǀ asmát ǀ ní ǀ vapantu ǀ sénāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the renownedRudra, riding in his car, ever youthful, destructive, fierce like a formidable wild beast; Rudra, propitiated by praise, grant happiness to him who praises (you), and let your hosts destroy him who is our adversary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒मा॒रश्चि॑त्पि॒तरं॒ वन्द॑मानं॒ प्रति॑ नानाम रुद्रोप॒यन्त॑म् । भूरे॑र्दा॒तारं॒ सत्प॑तिं गृणीषे स्तु॒तस्त्वं भे॑ष॒जा रा॑स्य॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: kumāráḥ ǀ cit ǀ pitáram ǀ vándamānam ǀ práti ǀ nanāma ǀ rudra ǀ upa-yántam ǀbhū́reḥ ǀ dātā́ram ǀ sát-patim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ stutáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ rāsi ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bow,Rudra, to you, approaching (our rite), as a boy to his father when pronouncing a blessing upon him; I glorify you, the giver of much (wealth), the protector of the virtuous; do you, thus glorified, bestow healing herbs upon me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वो॑ भेष॒जा म॑रुत॒: शुची॑नि॒ या शंत॑मा वृषणो॒ या म॑यो॒भु । यानि॒ मनु॒रवृ॑णीता पि॒ता न॒स्ता शं च॒ योश्च॑ रु॒द्रस्य॑ वश्मि
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śúcīni ǀ yā́ ǀ śám-tamā ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ mayaḥ-bhú ǀyā́ni ǀ mánuḥ ǀ ávṛṇīta ǀ pitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ yóḥ ǀ ca ǀ rudrásya ǀ vaśmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, I solicit of you those medicaments which are pure; those, showerers (of benefits), which give great plural asure; those which fonfer felicity; those which (our) sire,Manu, selected; and those (medicaments) ofRudrawhich are the alleviation (of disease), and defence (against danger).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णो हे॒ती रु॒द्रस्य॑ वृज्या॒: परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर्म॒ही गा॑त् । अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृळ
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ hetíḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ vṛjyāḥ ǀ pári ǀ tveṣásya ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ mahī́ ǀ gāt ǀáva ǀ sthirā́ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ tanuṣva ǀ mī́ḍhvaḥ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ mṛḷa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the javelin ofRudraavoid us; may the great displeasure of the radiant deity pass away (from us); showerer of benefits, turn away your strong (bow) from the wealthy (offerers of oblations), and bestow happiness upon (our) sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ब॑भ्रो वृषभ चेकितान॒ यथा॑ देव॒ न हृ॑णी॒षे न हंसि॑ । ह॒व॒न॒श्रुन्नो॑ रुद्रे॒ह बो॑धि बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ babhro íti ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ cekitāna ǀ yáthā ǀ deva ǀ ná ǀ hṛṇīṣé ǀ ná ǀ háṃsi ǀhavana-śrút ǀ naḥ ǀ rudra ǀ ihá ǀ bodhi ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cherisher of the world, showerer (of benefits), omniscient and divine (Rudra), hearer of our invocation, so consider us on this occasion, that you may not be irate, nor slay us; but that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धा॒रा॒व॒रा म॒रुतो॑ धृ॒ष्ण्वो॑जसो मृ॒गा न भी॒मास्तवि॑षीभिर॒र्चिन॑: । अ॒ग्नयो॒ न शु॑शुचा॒ना ऋ॑जी॒षिणो॒ भृमिं॒ धम॑न्तो॒ अप॒ गा अ॑वृण्वत
shlokas.transliteration: dhārāvarā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇú-ojasaḥ ǀ mṛgā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmā́ḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ arcínaḥ ǀagnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śuśucānā́ḥ ǀ ṛjīṣíṇaḥ ǀ bhṛ́mim ǀ dhámantaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avṛṇvata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMaruts, shedders of showers, endowed with resistless might, like formidable lions, reverencing (the world) by their energies, resplendent as fires, laden with water, and blowing about the wandering cloud, give vent to its (collected) rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावो॒ न स्तृभि॑श्चितयन्त खा॒दिनो॒ व्य१॒॑भ्रिया॒ न द्यु॑तयन्त वृ॒ष्टय॑: । रु॒द्रो यद्वो॑ मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसो॒ वृषाज॑नि॒ पृश्न्या॑: शु॒क्र ऊध॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ citayanta ǀ khādínaḥ ǀ ví ǀ abhríyāḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyutayanta ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀrudráḥ ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rukma-vakṣasaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ájani ǀ pṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ śukré ǀ ū́dhani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, golden-breastedMaruts, the vigorous (Rudra) begot you of the pure wombofPṛśnī, therefore they, the devourers (of their enemies), are conspicuous (by their ornaments), as the heavens are by the constellations; and, senders of rain, they are brilliant as the cloud-born (lightning).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षन्ते॒ अश्वाँ॒ अत्याँ॑ इवा॒जिषु॑ न॒दस्य॒ कर्णै॑स्तुरयन्त आ॒शुभि॑: । हिर॑ण्यशिप्रा मरुतो॒ दवि॑ध्वतः पृ॒क्षं या॑थ॒ पृष॑तीभिः समन्यवः
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣánte ǀ áśvān ǀ átyān-iva ǀ ājíṣu ǀ nadásya ǀ kárṇaiḥ ǀ turayante ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀhíraṇya-śiprāḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ dávidhvataḥ ǀ pṛkṣám ǀ yātha ǀ pṛ́ṣatībhiḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They sprinkle the wide-extended (lands) with water, as (men sprinkle) horses (when heated) in battles; and they rush along with swift (horses) on the skirts of the sounding (cloud);Maruts, golden-helmeted, andof one mind, agitating (the trees), come with your spotted deer to (receive the sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒क्षे ता विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना ववक्षिरे मि॒त्राय॑ वा॒ सद॒मा जी॒रदा॑नवः । पृष॑दश्वासो अनव॒भ्ररा॑धस ऋजि॒प्यासो॒ न व॒युने॑षु धू॒र्षद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pṛkṣé ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ vavakṣire ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ vā ǀ sádam ǀ ā́ ǀ jīrá-dānavaḥ ǀpṛ́ṣat-aśvāsaḥ ǀ anavabhrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ ṛjipyā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ dhūḥ-sádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prompt-givingMarutsever confer upon the (offerer of sacrificial) food, as upon a friend, all these (world-supporting) waters; they who have spotted deer for steeds, who are possessed of inexhaustible riches, and who, seated in their chariots, (proceed) amongst the moving (clouds), like horses going straight (to the goal).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्ध॑न्वभिर्धे॒नुभी॑ र॒प्शदू॑धभिरध्व॒स्मभि॑: प॒थिभि॑र्भ्राजदृष्टयः । आ हं॒सासो॒ न स्वस॑राणि गन्तन॒ मधो॒र्मदा॑य मरुतः समन्यवः
shlokas.transliteration: índhanva-bhiḥ ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀ rapśádūdha-bhiḥ ǀ adhvasmá-bhiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ bhrājat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǀā́ ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ gantana ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are of one mind, and are armed with shining lances, come with the bright, full-uddered kine, by obstructed paths, to partake of the exhilaration of the (Soma) juice, as swans (fly) to their nests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि मरुतः समन्यवो न॒रां न शंस॒: सव॑नानि गन्तन । अश्वा॑मिव पिप्यत धे॒नुमूध॑नि॒ कर्ता॒ धियं॑ जरि॒त्रे वाज॑पेशसम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ ná ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ sávanāni ǀ gantana ǀáśvām-iva ǀ pipyata ǀ dhenúm ǀ ū́dhani ǀ kártā ǀ dhíyam ǀ jaritré ǀ vā́ja-peśasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are of one mind, come to the food that is offered at (our) sacrifices, as (you come) to the praises of men; nourish the cow, (the cloud), so that it may be like a mare with a full udder, and render the pious rite productive of abundant food to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नो॑ दात मरुतो वा॒जिनं॒ रथ॑ आपा॒नं ब्रह्म॑ चि॒तय॑द्दि॒वेदि॑वे । इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ वृ॒जने॑षु का॒रवे॑ स॒निं मे॒धामरि॑ष्टं दु॒ष्टरं॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ dāta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ ráthe ǀ āpānám ǀ bráhma ǀ citáyat ǀ divé-dive ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ kāráve ǀ saním ǀ medhā́m ǀ áriṣṭam ǀ dustáram ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,Maruts, that (son) who shall enjoy abundance, and who shall be repeating your appropriate praises day by day to (induce) your coming; give food to those who praise you; to him who glorifies you in battles; (grant him) liberality, intelligence, and unimpaired unsurpassable vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्यु॒ञ्जते॑ म॒रुतो॑ रु॒क्मव॑क्ष॒सोऽश्वा॒न्रथे॑षु॒ भग॒ आ सु॒दान॑वः । धे॒नुर्न शिश्वे॒ स्वस॑रेषु पिन्वते॒ जना॑य रा॒तह॑विषे म॒हीमिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ yuñjáte ǀ marútaḥ ǀ rukmá-vakṣasaḥ ǀ áśvān ǀ rátheṣu ǀ bháge ǀ ā́ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀdhenúḥ ǀ ná ǀ śíśve ǀ svásareṣu ǀ pinvate ǀ jánāya ǀ rātá-haviṣe ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the golden-breasted munificentMaruts, yoke their horses to their chariots on an auspicious (occasion), they shed in their peculiar (directions) abundant food upon him who offers them oblations, as a cow (gives milk) to her calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ मरुतो वृ॒कता॑ति॒ मर्त्यो॑ रि॒पुर्द॒धे व॑सवो॒ रक्ष॑ता रि॒षः । व॒र्तय॑त॒ तपु॑षा च॒क्रिया॒भि तमव॑ रुद्रा अ॒शसो॑ हन्तना॒ वध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vṛká-tāti ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ ripúḥ ǀ dadhé ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ rákṣata ǀ riṣáḥ ǀvartáyata ǀ tápuṣā ǀ cakríyā ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ áva ǀ rudrāḥ ǀ aśásaḥ ǀ hantana ǀ vádharíti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, granters of dwellings, protect us from the malignity of the man who cherishes wolf-like enmity against us; encompass him with your burning diseases; ward off the murderous (weapon) of the devourer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रं तद्वो॑ मरुतो॒ याम॑ चेकिते॒ पृश्न्या॒ यदूध॒रप्या॒पयो॑ दु॒हुः । यद्वा॑ नि॒दे नव॑मानस्य रुद्रियास्त्रि॒तं जरा॑य जुर॒ताम॑दाभ्याः
shlokas.transliteration: citrám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́ma ǀ cekite ǀ pṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ yát ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ ápi ǀ āpáyaḥ ǀ duhúḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ nidé ǀ návamānasya ǀ rudriyāḥ ǀ tritám ǀ járāya ǀ juratā́m ǀ adābhyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, your marvellous energy is well known, whereby, seizing the udder of heaven, you milked it (of the rain, destroyed) the reviler of your worshipper, and (came), irresistible sons ofRudra, toTritafor the destruction of enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तान्वो॑ म॒हो म॒रुत॑ एव॒याव्नो॒ विष्णो॑रे॒षस्य॑ प्रभृ॒थे ह॑वामहे । हिर॑ण्यवर्णान्ककु॒हान्य॒तस्रु॑चो ब्रह्म॒ण्यन्त॒: शंस्यं॒ राध॑ ईमहे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ eva-yā́vnaḥ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ eṣásya ǀ pra-bhṛthé ǀ havāmahe ǀhíraṇya-varṇān ǀ kakuhā́n ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ brahmaṇyántaḥ ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you, mightyMaruts, who frequent such sacrifices (as this, to be present) at the offering of the diffusive and desirable (libation); lifting up our ladles, and reciting their praise, we solicit the golden-hued and lofty Maruts for excellent wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते दश॑ग्वाः प्रथ॒मा य॒ज्ञमू॑हिरे॒ ते नो॑ हिन्वन्तू॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु । उ॒षा न रा॒मीर॑रु॒णैरपो॑र्णुते म॒हो ज्योति॑षा शुच॒ता गोअ॑र्णसा
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ dáśa-gvāḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ūhire ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ hinvantu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ rāmī́ḥ ǀ aruṇáiḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ūrṇute ǀ maháḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ śucatā́ ǀ gó-arṇasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they, who, the first celebrators of the ten-months' rite, accomplished this sacrifice, reanimate us at the rising dawn; for as the dawn with purple rays drives away the night, so (do they scatter the darkness) with great, and pure, and mist-dispelling radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते क्षो॒णीभि॑ररु॒णेभि॒र्नाञ्जिभी॑ रु॒द्रा ऋ॒तस्य॒ सद॑नेषु वावृधुः । नि॒मेघ॑माना॒ अत्ये॑न॒ पाज॑सा सुश्च॒न्द्रं वर्णं॑ दधिरे सु॒पेश॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ kṣoṇī́bhiḥ ǀ aruṇébhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀni-méghamānāḥ ǀ átyena ǀ pā́jasā ǀ su-candrám ǀ várṇam ǀ dadhire ǀ su-péśasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They, theRudras, (equipped) with melodious (lutes), and decorated with purple ornaments, exult in the dwellings of the waters; and scattering the clouds with rappid vigour, they are endowed with delightful and beautiful forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताँ इ॑या॒नो महि॒ वरू॑थमू॒तय॒ उप॒ घेदे॒ना नम॑सा गृणीमसि । त्रि॒तो न यान्पञ्च॒ होतॄ॑न॒भिष्ट॑य आव॒वर्त॒दव॑राञ्च॒क्रियाव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ máhi ǀ várūtham ǀ ūtáye ǀ úpa ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ enā́ ǀ námasā ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀtritáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yā́n ǀ páñca ǀ hótṝn ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ ā-vavártat ǀ ávarān ǀ cakríyā ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Imploring them for ample wealth, and (having recourse to him) for protection, we glorify them with this praise; like the five chief priests whomTritadetained for the (performance of) the sacrifice, and to protect it with their weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यया॑ र॒ध्रं पा॒रय॒थात्यंहो॒ यया॑ नि॒दो मु॒ञ्चथ॑ वन्दि॒तार॑म् । अ॒र्वाची॒ सा म॑रुतो॒ या व॑ ऊ॒तिरो षु वा॒श्रेव॑ सुम॒तिर्जि॑गातु
shlokas.transliteration: yáyā ǀ radhrám ǀ pāráyatha ǀ áti ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ yáyā ǀ nidáḥ ǀ muñcátha ǀ vanditā́ram ǀarvā́cī ǀ sā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ ó íti ǀ sú ǀ vāśrā́-iva ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ jigātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, may that protection wherewith you convey the worshipper beyond sin, wherewith you rescue the reciter of your praise from the scoffer, be present with us; may your benign disposition tend towards us, like a lowing (cow towards her calf).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपे॑मसृक्षि वाज॒युर्व॑च॒स्यां चनो॑ दधीत ना॒द्यो गिरो॑ मे । अ॒पां नपा॑दाशु॒हेमा॑ कु॒वित्स सु॒पेश॑सस्करति॒ जोषि॑ष॒द्धि
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ īm ǀ asṛkṣi ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ vacasyā́m ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dadhīta ǀ nādyáḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ me ǀapā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ āśu-hémā ǀ kuvít ǀ sáḥ ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǀ karati ǀ jóṣiṣat ǀ hí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring food, I put forth this laudatory hymn; may the sounding and swift-moving grandson of the waters bestow abundant food upon me his worshipper; may he make us of goodly appearance, for verily he is propitiated by praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं स्व॑स्मै हृ॒द आ सुत॑ष्टं॒ मन्त्रं॑ वोचेम कु॒विद॑स्य॒ वेद॑त् । अ॒पां नपा॑दसु॒र्य॑स्य म॒ह्ना विश्वा॑न्य॒र्यो भुव॑ना जजान
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ sú ǀ asmai ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sú-taṣṭam ǀ mántram ǀ vocema ǀ kuvít ǀ asya ǀ védat ǀapā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ asuryásya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ jajāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us address to him the prayer that is conceived in our hearts, and may he fully understand (its purport); for he, the lord, the grandson of the waters, has genitive rated all beings by the greatness of his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॒न्या यन्त्युप॑ यन्त्य॒न्याः स॑मा॒नमू॒र्वं न॒द्य॑: पृणन्ति । तमू॒ शुचिं॒ शुच॑यो दीदि॒वांस॑म॒पां नपा॑तं॒ परि॑ तस्थु॒राप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ yánti ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ samānám ǀ ūrvám ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ pṛṇanti ǀtám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śúcim ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ apā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ pári ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some waters collect together (from the rain); others, (already collected on earth), unite with them; as rivers, they flow together to propitiate the ocean-fire; the pure waters are gathered round the pure and brilliant grandsons of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमस्मे॑रा युव॒तयो॒ युवा॑नं मर्मृ॒ज्यमा॑ना॒: परि॑ य॒न्त्याप॑: । स शु॒क्रेभि॒: शिक्व॑भी रे॒वद॒स्मे दी॒दाया॑नि॒ध्मो घृ॒तनि॑र्णिग॒प्सु
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ásmerāḥ ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ yúvānam ǀ marmṛjyámānāḥ ǀ pári ǀ yanti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ śukrébhiḥ ǀ śíkva-bhiḥ ǀ revát ǀ asmé íti ǀ dīdā́ya ǀ anidhmáḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ ap-sú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The young and modest (waters) wait upon the youth, assiduous in bathing him, and he, although unfed with fuel, yet cleansed with clarified butter, shines with bright rays amidst the waters, the abundance (may be) to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मै ति॒स्रो अ॑व्य॒थ्याय॒ नारी॑र्दे॒वाय॑ दे॒वीर्दि॑धिष॒न्त्यन्न॑म् । कृता॑ इ॒वोप॒ हि प्र॑स॒र्स्रे अ॒प्सु स पी॒यूषं॑ धयति पूर्व॒सूना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ tisráḥ ǀ avyathyā́ya ǀ nā́rīḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ didhiṣanti ǀ ánnam ǀkṛ́tāḥ-iva ǀ úpa ǀ hí ǀ pra-sarsré ǀ ap-sú ǀ sáḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ dhayati ǀ pūrva-sū́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “THree divine feminine les present food to that uninjurable divinity; as if formed in the waters they spread abroad, and he drinks the ambrosia of the first-created (elements).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्व॒स्यात्र॒ जनि॑मा॒स्य च॒ स्व॑र्द्रु॒हो रि॒षः स॒म्पृच॑: पाहि सू॒रीन् । आ॒मासु॑ पू॒र्षु प॒रो अ॑प्रमृ॒ष्यं नारा॑तयो॒ वि न॑श॒न्नानृ॑तानि
shlokas.transliteration: áśvasya ǀ átra ǀ jánima ǀ asyá ǀ ca ǀ sváḥ ǀ druháḥ ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ sam-pṛ́caḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ sūrī́n ǀāmā́su ǀ pūrṣú ǀ paráḥ ǀ apra-mṛṣyám ǀ ná ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ ví ǀ naśan ǀ ná ǀ ánṛtāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In him is the birth of the horse, of him is (the origin of) the world; do you, grandson of the (waters), protect the pious worshippers from the malevolence of the oppressor; those who give no offerings, those who practise untruths, attain not the inconceivable deity, whether abiding in the  immature or the perfect waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व आ दमे॑ सु॒दुघा॒ यस्य॑ धे॒नुः स्व॒धां पी॑पाय सु॒भ्वन्न॑मत्ति । सो अ॒पां नपा॑दू॒र्जय॑न्न॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर्व॑सु॒देया॑य विध॒ते वि भा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: své ǀ ā́ ǀ dáme ǀ su-dúghā ǀ yásya ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ svadhā́m ǀ pīpāya ǀ su-bhú ǀ ánnam ǀ atti ǀsáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ ūrjáyan ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ vasu-déyāya ǀ vidhaté ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the grandson of the waters, who abides in his own dwelling; of whom is the readily-milked cow; who augments the nectar (of the skies), and (thence) eats the sacrificial food; he, gathering strength in the midst of the waters, shines for the sake of conferring wealth upon his worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒प्स्वा शुचि॑ना॒ दैव्ये॑न ऋ॒तावाज॑स्र उर्वि॒या वि॒भाति॑ । व॒या इद॒न्या भुव॑नान्यस्य॒ प्र जा॑यन्ते वी॒रुध॑श्च प्र॒जाभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ śúcinā ǀ dáivyena ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ ájasraḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀvayā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ anyā́ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ asya ǀ prá ǀ jāyante ǀ vīrúdhaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All other beings are, as it were, branches of him, who, truthful, eternal, and vast, shines amid the waters with pure and divine (radiance); and the shrubs, with their products, are born (of him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पां नपा॒दा ह्यस्था॑दु॒पस्थं॑ जि॒ह्माना॑मू॒र्ध्वो वि॒द्युतं॒ वसा॑नः । तस्य॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ महि॒मानं॒ वह॑न्ती॒र्हिर॑ण्यवर्णा॒: परि॑ यन्ति य॒ह्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ ásthāt ǀ upá-stham ǀ jihmā́nām ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ vi-dyútam ǀ vásānaḥ ǀtásya ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ váhantīḥ ǀ híraṇya-varṇāḥ ǀ pári ǀ yanti ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The grandson of the waters has ascended the firmament above (the region) of the tortuously-moving (clouds), arrayed in lightning; the broad and golden-coloured (rivers) spread around, bearing (to all quarters) his exceeding glory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यरूप॒: स हिर॑ण्यसंदृग॒पां नपा॒त्सेदु॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्णः । हि॒र॒ण्यया॒त्परि॒ योने॑र्नि॒षद्या॑ हिरण्य॒दा द॑द॒त्यन्न॑मस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-rūpaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ híraṇya-sandṛk ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ híraṇya-varṇaḥ ǀhiraṇyáyāt ǀ pári ǀ yóneḥ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ hiraṇya-dā́ḥ ǀ dadati ǀ ánnam ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The grandson of the waters is of olden form, of golden aspect, of golden hue, and (shines) seated upon a seat of gold; the givers of gold (at solemn rites) present to him (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॒स्यानी॑कमु॒त चारु॒ नामा॑पी॒च्यं॑ वर्धते॒ नप्तु॑र॒पाम् । यमि॒न्धते॑ युव॒तय॒: समि॒त्था हिर॑ण्यवर्णं घृ॒तमन्न॑मस्य
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ asya ǀ ánīkam ǀ utá ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀ apīcyám ǀ vardhate ǀ náptuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀyám ǀ indháte ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ itthā́ ǀ híraṇya-varṇam ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ánnam ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beautiful is his form (of aggregated lustre, beautiful) is the name of the grandson of the waters; (both) flourish, though  hidden (by the clouds); the youthful w2aters collectively kindle the golden-coloured divinity in the firmament, for water is his food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मै ब॑हू॒नाम॑व॒माय॒ सख्ये॑ य॒ज्ञैर्वि॑धेम॒ नम॑सा ह॒विर्भि॑: । सं सानु॒ मार्ज्मि॒ दिधि॑षामि॒ बिल्मै॒र्दधा॒म्यन्नै॒: परि॑ वन्द ऋ॒ग्भिः
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ bahūnā́m ǀ avamā́ya ǀ sákhye ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ námasā ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀsám ǀ sā́nu ǀ mā́rjmi ǀ dídhiṣāmi ǀ bílmaiḥ ǀ dádhāmi ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ pári ǀ vande ǀ ṛk-bhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him our friend, the first of many (deities), we offer worship with sacrifices, oblations, and prostration; I decorate the high plural ce (of his presence); I nourish him with fuel; I sustain him with (sacrificial) viands; I glorify him with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॒ वृषा॑जनय॒त्तासु॒ गर्भं॒ स ईं॒ शिशु॑र्धयति॒ तं रि॑हन्ति । सो अ॒पां नपा॒दन॑भिम्लातवर्णो॒ऽन्यस्ये॑वे॒ह त॒न्वा॑ विवेष
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ajanayat ǀ tā́su ǀ gárbham ǀ sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ dhayati ǀ tám ǀ rihanti ǀsáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ ánabhimlāta-varṇaḥ ǀ anyásya-iva ǀ ihá ǀ tanvā́ ǀ viveṣa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vigorous, he has genitive rated himself as an embryo in those (waters); he is their infant; he sucks them; they bedew him (with moisture); the grandson of the waters of untarnished splendour has descended to this (earth) in the form of a different (fire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मिन्प॒दे प॑र॒मे त॑स्थि॒वांस॑मध्व॒स्मभि॑र्वि॒श्वहा॑ दीदि॒वांस॑म् । आपो॒ नप्त्रे॑ घृ॒तमन्नं॒ वह॑न्तीः स्व॒यमत्कै॒: परि॑ दीयन्ति य॒ह्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: asmín ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀ adhvasmá-bhiḥ ǀ viśváhā ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀā́paḥ ǀ náptre ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ánnam ǀ váhantīḥ ǀ svayám ǀ átkaiḥ ǀ pári ǀ dīyanti ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The abundant waters, bearing sustenance to their grandson, flow round him with spontaneous movements; when abiding in his supreme sphere, and shining daily with imperishable (rays).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयां॑समग्ने सुक्षि॒तिं जना॒यायां॑समु म॒घव॑द्भ्यः सुवृ॒क्तिम् । विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áyāṃsam ǀ agne ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ jánāya ǀ áyāṃsam ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ su-vṛktím ǀvíśvam ǀ tát ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ ávanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have come,Agni, to you, (the giver) of good dwellings, for the sake of offspring; I have come with a propitiatory hymn for the sake of the opulent (offerers of oblations); may all the good which the gods defend (be ours); that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॑ हिन्वा॒नो व॑सिष्ट॒ गा अ॒पोऽधु॑क्षन्त्सी॒मवि॑भि॒रद्रि॑भि॒र्नर॑: । पिबे॑न्द्र॒ स्वाहा॒ प्रहु॑तं॒ वष॑ट्कृतं हो॒त्रादा सोमं॑ प्रथ॒मो य ईशि॑षे
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ vasiṣṭa ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ádhukṣan ǀ sīm ǀ ávi-bhiḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀpíba ǀ indra ǀ svā́hā ǀ prá-hutam ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtam ǀ hotrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ sómam ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́śiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The libation) that is being presented,Indra, to you, comprises the (products of the) cow, and he (consecrated) water; and the leaders (of the rite) have expressed it with stones, and strained it through woollen (filters); do you, Indra, who are the first (of the gods), and rule (over the world), drink theSomaoffered by theHotā, and sanctified by the exclamationssvāhāand vaṣat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञैः सम्मि॑श्ला॒: पृष॑तीभिॠ॒ष्टिभि॒र्याम॑ञ्छु॒भ्रासो॑ अ॒ञ्जिषु॑ प्रि॒या उ॒त । आ॒सद्या॑ ब॒र्हिर्भ॑रतस्य सूनवः पो॒त्रादा सोमं॑ पिबता दिवो नरः
shlokas.transliteration: yajñáiḥ ǀ sám-miślāḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatībhiḥ ǀ ṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ śubhrā́saḥ ǀ añjíṣu ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀā-sádya ǀ barhíḥ ǀ bharatasya ǀ sūnavaḥ ǀ potrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ sómam ǀ pibata ǀ divaḥ ǀ naraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, together worshipped with sacrifices, standing in the car drawn by spotted mares, radiant with lances, and delighted by ornaments, sons ofBharata, leaders in the firmament, seated on the sacred grass, drink theSomapresented by thePotā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मेव॑ नः सुहवा॒ आ हि गन्त॑न॒ नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ सदतना॒ रणि॑ष्टन । अथा॑ मन्दस्व जुजुषा॒णो अन्ध॑स॒स्त्वष्ट॑र्दे॒वेभि॒र्जनि॑भिः सु॒मद्ग॑णः
shlokas.transliteration: amā́-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ su-havāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ gántana ǀ ní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatana ǀ ráṇiṣṭana ǀátha ǀ mandasva ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ tváṣṭaḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ sumát-gaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are devoutly invoked, come to us together, and, seated on the sacrificial grass, enjoy your rest; and then,Tvaṣṭā, who head a brilliant cohort (come) with the gods and their wives, and rejoice being plural ased with the (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ व॑क्षि दे॒वाँ इ॒ह वि॑प्र॒ यक्षि॑ चो॒शन्हो॑त॒र्नि ष॑दा॒ योनि॑षु त्रि॒षु । प्रति॑ वीहि॒ प्रस्थि॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॒ पिबाग्नी॑ध्रा॒त्तव॑ भा॒गस्य॑ तृप्णुहि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ vipra ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǀ uśán ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ní ǀ sada ǀ yóniṣu ǀ triṣú ǀpráti ǀ vīhi ǀ prá-sthitam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ píba ǀ ā́gnīdhrāt ǀ táva ǀ bhāgásya ǀ tṛpṇuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageAgni, bring hither the gods, and sacrifice to them; invoker of the gods, propitious to us, sit down in the three altars; accept the libation ofSomathat is offered to you, from theAgnidhraand be satisfied with your portion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य ते॑ त॒न्वो॑ नृम्ण॒वर्ध॑न॒: सह॒ ओज॑: प्र॒दिवि॑ बा॒ह्वोर्हि॒तः । तुभ्यं॑ सु॒तो म॑घव॒न्तुभ्य॒माभृ॑त॒स्त्वम॑स्य॒ ब्राह्म॑णा॒दा तृ॒पत्पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ te ǀ tanváḥ ǀ nṛmṇa-várdhanaḥ ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀtúbhyam ǀ sutáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ ā́-bhṛtaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asya ǀ brā́hmaṇāt ǀ ā́ ǀ tṛpát ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (libation),Indra, is the augmenter of your bodily (vigour), favourable of old to the resistless strength of (your) arms; it is effused,Maghavan, for you; it is brought to you from theBrāhmaṇa; do you drink and be satisfied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षेथां॑ य॒ज्ञं बोध॑तं॒ हव॑स्य मे स॒त्तो होता॑ नि॒विद॑: पू॒र्व्या अनु॑ । अच्छा॒ राजा॑ना॒ नम॑ एत्या॒वृतं॑ प्रशा॒स्त्रादा पि॑बतं सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ bódhatam ǀ hávasya ǀ me ǀ sattáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ni-vídaḥ ǀ pūrvyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀáccha ǀ rā́jānā ǀ námaḥ ǀ eti ǀ ā-vṛ́tam ǀ pra-śāstrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ pibatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, both be gratified with the sacrifice; hear my invocation as the seatedHotārepeats in succession the ancient praises; the (sacrificial) food encompassed (by the priests), attends the royal pair drink, both of you, the sweetSomalibation, offered by the Praśāstā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्द॑स्व हो॒त्रादनु॒ जोष॒मन्ध॒सोऽध्व॑र्यव॒: स पू॒र्णां व॑ष्ट्या॒सिच॑म् । तस्मा॑ ए॒तं भ॑रत तद्व॒शो द॒दिर्हो॒त्रात्सोमं॑ द्रविणोद॒: पिब॑ ऋ॒तुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mándasva ǀ hotrā́t ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ pūrṇā́m ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ ā-sícam ǀtásmai ǀ etám ǀ bharata ǀ tat-vaśáḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ hotrā́t ǀ sómam ǀ draviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀ píba ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified, Draviṇodas, by the sacrificial food presented as the offering of theHotā; he desires, priests, a fall libation; present it to him, and influenced (by it, he will be your) benefactor; drink, Draviṇodas, along with the Ṛtus, theSoma, the offering of the Hotā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमु॒ पूर्व॒महु॑वे॒ तमि॒दं हु॑वे॒ सेदु॒ हव्यो॑ द॒दिर्यो नाम॒ पत्य॑ते । अ॒ध्व॒र्युभि॒: प्रस्थि॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑ पो॒त्रात्सोमं॑ द्रविणोद॒: पिब॑ ऋ॒तुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pū́rvam ǀ áhuve ǀ tám ǀ idám ǀ huve ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ pátyate ǀadhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ prá-sthitam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ potrā́t ǀ sómam ǀ draviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀ píba ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, whom I formerly invoked and whom I now invoke, is verily worthy of invocation, for he is renowned as a benefactor; theSomalibation has been brought by the priests; drink, Draviṇodās, along with the Ṛtus, the Soma, the offering of thePotā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मेद्य॑न्तु ते॒ वह्न॑यो॒ येभि॒रीय॒सेऽरि॑षण्यन्वीळयस्वा वनस्पते । आ॒यूया॑ धृष्णो अभि॒गूर्या॒ त्वं ने॒ष्ट्रात्सोमं॑ द्रविणोद॒: पिब॑ ऋ॒तुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: médyantu ǀ te ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ ī́yase ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ vīḷayasva ǀ vanaspate ǀā-yū́ya ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ abhi-gū́rya ǀ tvám ǀ neṣṭrā́t ǀ sómam ǀ draviṇaḥ-daḥ ǀ píba ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these your bearers, by whom you are borne along, be satisfied; lord of the forest, be firm, doing no injury, steadfast of resolve; come and being gracious, drink, Draviṇodas, along with the Ṛtus, theSoma, the offering of theNeṣṭā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॑द्धो॒त्रादु॒त पो॒त्राद॑मत्तो॒त ने॒ष्ट्राद॑जुषत॒ प्रयो॑ हि॒तम् । तु॒रीयं॒ पात्र॒ममृ॑क्त॒मम॑र्त्यं द्रविणो॒दाः पि॑बतु द्राविणोद॒सः
shlokas.transliteration: ápāt ǀ hotrā́t ǀ utá ǀ potrā́t ǀ amatta ǀ utá ǀ neṣṭrā́t ǀ ajuṣata ǀ práyaḥ ǀ hitám ǀturī́yam ǀ pā́tram ǀ ámṛktam ǀ ámartyam ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ pibatu ǀ drāviṇaḥ-dasáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether he has drunk theSomafrom the offering of theHotā; whether he has been exhilarated by the offering of thePotā; whether he has been plural ased with the (sacrificial) food presented as the act of theNeṣṭā; still let Draviṇodās quaff the unstrained ambrosial cup, the fourth offered by the priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्च॑म॒द्य य॒य्यं॑ नृ॒वाह॑णं॒ रथं॑ युञ्जाथामि॒ह वां॑ वि॒मोच॑नम् । पृ॒ङ्क्तं ह॒वींषि॒ मधु॒ना हि कं॑ ग॒तमथा॒ सोमं॑ पिबतं वाजिनीवसू
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ adyá ǀ yayyám ǀ nṛ-vā́hanam ǀ rátham ǀ yuñjāthām ǀ ihá ǀ vām ǀ vi-mócanam ǀpṛṅktám ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ mádhunā ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ gatám ǀ átha ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke today,Aśvins, your rolling car conveying (you), the leaders (of the rite); and setting yu down before us; mix the oblations with the sweet juice; come you are affluent with (abundant) food, and drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जोष्य॑ग्ने स॒मिधं॒ जोष्याहु॑तिं॒ जोषि॒ ब्रह्म॒ जन्यं॒ जोषि॑ सुष्टु॒तिम् । विश्वे॑भि॒र्विश्वाँ॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ वसो म॒ह उ॒शन्दे॒वाँ उ॑श॒तः पा॑यया ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: jóṣi ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídham ǀ jóṣi ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ jóṣi ǀ bráhma ǀ jányam ǀ jóṣi ǀ su-stutím ǀvíśvebhiḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ ṛtúnā ǀ vaso íti ǀ maháḥ ǀ uśán ǀ devā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ pāyaya ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be plural ased,Agni, with the fuel; be plural ased with the oblation; be plural ased with the sacred prayer that is good for man; be plural ased with holy praise, asylum of all; Agni, willing (to accept oblations), render all the great gods desirous (of the same), and with them all, and with the Ṛtu drink the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता स॒वाय॑ शश्वत्त॒मं तद॑पा॒ वह्नि॑रस्थात् । नू॒नं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वि हि धाति॒ रत्न॒मथाभ॑जद्वी॒तिहो॑त्रं स्व॒स्तौ
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ savā́ya ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ tát-apāḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ asthāt ǀnūnám ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ dhā́ti ǀ rátnam ǀ átha ǀ ā́ ǀ abhajat ǀ vītí-hotram ǀ svastáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In truth, the divineSavitā, the bearer (of the world), has perpetually been present for the genitive ration (of mankind), for such is his office; verily he grants wealth to the pious (worshippers); may he, therefore, bestow upon the offerer of the oblation (sufficient) for his well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य॒ हि श्रु॒ष्टये॑ दे॒व ऊ॒र्ध्वः प्र बा॒हवा॑ पृ॒थुपा॑णि॒: सिस॑र्ति । आप॑श्चिदस्य व्र॒त आ निमृ॑ग्रा अ॒यं चि॒द्वातो॑ रमते॒ परि॑ज्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ hí ǀ śruṣṭáye ǀ deváḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ prá ǀ bāhávā ǀ pṛthú-pāṇiḥ ǀ sísarti ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ vraté ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-mṛgrāḥ ǀ ayám ǀ cit ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ramate ǀ pári-jman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine, vast-handed (Savitā), having risen, stretches forth his arms for the delight of all; the purifying waters (flow) for (the fulfilment of) his rites, and this circumambient air sports (in the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒शुभि॑श्चि॒द्यान्वि मु॑चाति नू॒नमरी॑रम॒दत॑मानं चि॒देतो॑: । अ॒ह्यर्षू॑णां चि॒न्न्य॑याँ अवि॒ष्यामनु॑ व्र॒तं स॑वि॒तुर्मोक्यागा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: āśú-bhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ yā́n ǀ ví ǀ mucāti ǀ nūnám ǀ árīramat ǀ átamānam ǀ cit ǀ étoḥ ǀahyárṣūṇām ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ ayān ǀ aviṣyā́m ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ savitúḥ ǀ mókī ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The moving (Sun) is liberated by his rapid rays; verily he has stopped the traveller from his journey; he restraisn the desire of warriors for combat, for night follows (the cessation of) the function ofSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॒: सम॑व्य॒द्वित॑तं॒ वय॑न्ती म॒ध्या कर्तो॒र्न्य॑धा॒च्छक्म॒ धीर॑: । उत्सं॒हाया॑स्था॒द्व्यृ१॒॑तूँर॑दर्धर॒रम॑तिः सवि॒ता दे॒व आगा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: púnaríti ǀ sám ǀ avyat ǀ ví-tatam ǀ váyantī ǀ madhyā́ ǀ kártoḥ ǀ ní ǀ adhāt ǀ śákma ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀút ǀ sam-hā́ya ǀ asthāt ǀ ví ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ adardhaḥ ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She, (Night), enwraps the extended (world) like (a woman) weaving (a garment); the prudent man lays aside the work he is able (to execute) in the midst (of his labour); but all spring up (from repose) when the divine, unwearied Sun, who has divided the seasons, again appears.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नानौकां॑सि॒ दुर्यो॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्वि ति॑ष्ठते प्रभ॒वः शोको॑ अ॒ग्नेः । ज्येष्ठं॑ मा॒ता सू॒नवे॑ भा॒गमाधा॒दन्व॑स्य॒ केत॑मिषि॒तं स॑वि॒त्रा
shlokas.transliteration: nā́nā ǀ ókāṃsi ǀ dúryaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhate ǀ pra-bhaváḥ ǀ śókaḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀjyéṣṭham ǀ mātā́ ǀ sūnáve ǀ bhāgám ǀ ā́ ǀ adhāt ǀ ánu ǀ asya ǀ kétam ǀ iṣitám ǀ savitrā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The engendered domestic radiance ofAgnispreads through various dwellings, and presides over all (sorts of sacrificial) food; the mother, (Dawn), has assigned to her son, (Agni), the best portion (at sacrifices), which is the manifestation of him imparted bySavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒माव॑वर्ति॒ विष्ठि॑तो जिगी॒षुर्विश्वे॑षां॒ काम॒श्चर॑ताम॒माभू॑त् । शश्वाँ॒ अपो॒ विकृ॑तं हि॒त्व्यागा॒दनु॑ व्र॒तं स॑वि॒तुर्दैव्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: sam-ā́vavarti ǀ ví-sthitaḥ ǀ jigīṣúḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ cáratām ǀ amā́ ǀ abhūt ǀśáśvān ǀ ápaḥ ǀ ví-kṛtam ǀ hitvī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ savitúḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The warrior, eager for victory, who has gone forth (to battle), turns back; (for) home is the desire of  moving beiings; abandoning his half-wrought toil, the labourer returns (home) when the function of the divineSavitā(is suspended).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ हि॒तमप्य॑म॒प्सु भा॒गं धन्वान्वा मृ॑ग॒यसो॒ वि त॑स्थुः । वना॑नि॒ विभ्यो॒ नकि॑रस्य॒ तानि॑ व्र॒ता दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्मि॑नन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ hitám ǀ ápyam ǀ ap-sú ǀ bhāgám ǀ dhánva ǀ ánu ǀ ā́ ǀ mṛgayásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthuḥ ǀvánāni ǀ ví-bhyaḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ tā́ni ǀ vratā́ ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ minanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The animals search in dry plural ces for the water element which has been collected in the firmament by you; the woods are assigned (by you) to the birds; no one obstructs these functions of the divineSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒द्रा॒ध्यं१॒॑ वरु॑णो॒ योनि॒मप्य॒मनि॑शितं नि॒मिषि॒ जर्भु॑राणः । विश्वो॑ मार्ता॒ण्डो व्र॒जमा प॒शुर्गा॑त्स्थ॒शो जन्मा॑नि सवि॒ता व्याक॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yāt-rādhyám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yónim ǀ ápyam ǀ áni-śitam ǀ ni-míṣi ǀ járbhurāṇaḥ ǀvíśvaḥ ǀ mārtāṇḍáḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúḥ ǀ gāt ǀ stha-śáḥ ǀ jánmāni ǀ savitā́ ǀ ví ǀ ā́ ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ever-goingVaruṇagrants a cool, accessible and agreeable plural ce (of rest), to all moving (creatures) on the closing of the eyes (ofSavitā), and every bird and every beast repairs to its lair when Savitā has dispersed (all) beings in various directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यस्येन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो॒ न मि॒त्रो व्र॒तम॑र्य॒मा न मि॒नन्ति॑ रु॒द्रः । नारा॑तय॒स्तमि॒दं स्व॒स्ति हु॒वे दे॒वं स॑वि॒तारं॒ नमो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitráḥ ǀ vratám ǀ aryamā́ ǀ ná ǀ minánti ǀ rudráḥ ǀná ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ tám ǀ idám ǀ svastí ǀ huvé ǀ devám ǀ savitā́ram ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invite to this plural ce, with reverential salutations, for my good, that divineSavitā, whose functions neitherIndra, norVaruṇa, norMitranorAryamannorRudranor the enemies (of the gods), impede.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भगं॒ धियं॑ वा॒जय॑न्त॒: पुरं॑धिं॒ नरा॒शंसो॒ ग्नास्पति॑र्नो अव्याः । आ॒ये वा॒मस्य॑ संग॒थे र॑यी॒णां प्रि॒या दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: bhágam ǀ dhíyam ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ púram-dhim ǀ nárāśáṃsaḥ ǀ gnā́ḥpátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avyāḥ ǀā-ayé ǀ vāmásya ǀ sam-gathé ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, who is adored by men, the protector of the wives (of the gods), preserve us; when worshipping his, who is auspicious, the object of meditation, and the all wise; may we be the beloved of the divineSavitā, that we may (thence be successful) in the accusative ulation of wealth and the acquisition of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्दि॒वो अ॒द्भ्यः पृ॑थि॒व्यास्त्वया॑ द॒त्तं काम्यं॒ राध॒ आ गा॑त् । शं यत्स्तो॒तृभ्य॑ आ॒पये॒ भवा॑त्युरु॒शंसा॑य सवितर्जरि॒त्रे
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ diváḥ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ dattám ǀ kā́myam ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gāt ǀśám ǀ yát ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ āpáye ǀ bhávāti ǀ uru-śáṃsāya ǀ savitaḥ ǀ jaritré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that desirable wealth which is granted to us,Savitā, by you, proceed from the sky, from the waters from the earth; and may the happiness (which belongs) to the race of those who eulogise you, devolve upon me, repeating diligently your praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्रावा॑णेव॒ तदिदर्थं॑ जरेथे॒ गृध्रे॑व वृ॒क्षं नि॑धि॒मन्त॒मच्छ॑ । ब्र॒ह्माणे॑व वि॒दथ॑ उक्थ॒शासा॑ दू॒तेव॒ हव्या॒ जन्या॑ पुरु॒त्रा
shlokas.transliteration: grā́vāṇā-iva ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ ártham ǀ jarethe íti ǀ gṛ́dhrā-iva ǀ vṛkṣám ǀ nidhi-mántam ǀ áccha ǀbrahmā́ṇā-iva ǀ vidáthe ǀ uktha-śásā ǀ dūtā́-iva ǀ hávyā ǀ jányā ǀ puru-trā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Descend,Aśvins, like falling stones, for the purpose (of destroying our foes); hasten to the presence of the wealth-possessing (worshippers), like vultures to a tree; like twoBrāhmaṇasrepeating hymns, (be present) at the sacrifice, and come like (royal) messengers in the land, welcomed by many people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्यावा॑णा र॒थ्ये॑व वी॒राजेव॑ य॒मा वर॒मा स॑चेथे । मेने॑ इव त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ शुम्भ॑माने॒ दम्प॑तीव क्रतु॒विदा॒ जने॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-yā́vānā ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ vīrā́ ǀ ajā́-iva ǀ yamā́ ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ sacethe íti ǀméne ivéti méne-iva ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śúmbhamāne íti ǀ dámpatī ivéti dámpatī-iva ǀ kratu-vídā ǀ jáneṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Moving at dawn like two heroes in a cr; like a pair of goats; like two women lovely inform, or like husband and wife; come together, knowing (how sacred) ites (are to be celebrated) amongst men, (to bestow) happiness (on the worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृङ्गे॑व नः प्रथ॒मा ग॑न्तम॒र्वाक्छ॒फावि॑व॒ जर्भु॑राणा॒ तरो॑भिः । च॒क्र॒वा॒केव॒ प्रति॒ वस्तो॑रुस्रा॒र्वाञ्चा॑ यातं र॒थ्ये॑व शक्रा
shlokas.transliteration: śṛ́ṅgā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ gantam ǀ arvā́k ǀ śapháu-iva ǀ járbhurāṇā ǀ táraḥ-bhiḥ ǀcakravākā́-iva ǀ práti ǀ vástoḥ ǀ usrā ǀ arvā́ñcā ǀ yātam ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ śakrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “COme to us, the first (before other gods), like a pair of horns, or like two hoofs, travelling with rapid (steps); like a pair ofcakravākas, awaiting day; overthrower of foes, like warriors in cars, able (to perform all things), come to our presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ना॒वेव॑ नः पारयतं यु॒गेव॒ नभ्ये॑व न उप॒धीव॑ प्र॒धीव॑ । श्वाने॑व नो॒ अरि॑षण्या त॒नूनां॒ खृग॑लेव वि॒स्रस॑: पातम॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: nāvā́-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ pārayatam ǀ yugā́-iva ǀ nábhyā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ upadhī́ ivétyupadhī́-iva ǀ pradhī́ ivéti pradhī́-iva ǀśvā́nā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ áriṣaṇyā ǀ tanū́nām ǀ khṛ́galā-iva ǀ vi-srásaḥ ǀ pātam ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bear us across (the sea of life), like two vessels, or (over difficult plural ces), like the poles of a car, the axles, the spokes, the fellies (of two wheels). Be like two dogs, warding off injury to our person ns, and, like two coats of mail, defend us from decay.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाते॑वाजु॒र्या न॒द्ये॑व री॒तिर॒क्षी इ॑व॒ चक्षु॒षा या॑तम॒र्वाक् । हस्ता॑विव त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ शम्भ॑विष्ठा॒ पादे॑व नो नयतं॒ वस्यो॒ अच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: vā́tā-iva ǀ ajuryā́ ǀ nadyā́-iva ǀ rītíḥ ǀ akṣī́ ivétyakṣī́-iva ǀ cákṣuṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀhástau-iva ǀ tanvé ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhā ǀ pā́dā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ nayatam ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Irresistible as two winds, rapid as two rivers; and quick of sight, come like two eyes before us; like twohands; like two feet; subservient to the well-being of our bodies, conduct us to (the acquisition) of excellent (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओष्ठा॑विव॒ मध्वा॒स्ने वद॑न्ता॒ स्तना॑विव पिप्यतं जी॒वसे॑ नः । नासे॑व नस्त॒न्वो॑ रक्षि॒तारा॒ कर्णा॑विव सु॒श्रुता॑ भूतम॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: óṣṭhau-iva ǀ mádhu ǀ āsné ǀ vádantā ǀ stánau-iva ǀ pipyatam ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǀnā́sā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ rakṣitā́rā ǀ kárṇau-iva ǀ su-śrútā ǀ bhūtam ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like two lips uttering sweet words, like two breasts yielding nourishment for our existence; be to us like two noses, preserving our person ns, and like two ears for the hearing of agreeable (sounds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हस्ते॑व श॒क्तिम॒भि सं॑द॒दी न॒: क्षामे॑व न॒: सम॑जतं॒ रजां॑सि । इ॒मा गिरो॑ अश्विना युष्म॒यन्ती॒: क्ष्णोत्रे॑णेव॒ स्वधि॑तिं॒ सं शि॑शीतम्
shlokas.transliteration: hástā-iva ǀ śaktím ǀ abhí ǀ sandadī́ íti sam-dadī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣā́mā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajatam ǀ rájāṃsi ǀimā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuṣma-yántīḥ ǀ kṣṇótreṇa-iva ǀ svá-dhitim ǀ sám ǀ śiśītam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like twohands,Aśvins, be ever investing us with vigour; like heaven and earth, bestow upon us rain; give sharpness to the praises that are addressed to you, as they whet an axe upon a grindstone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तानि॑ वामश्विना॒ वर्ध॑नानि॒ ब्रह्म॒ स्तोमं॑ गृत्सम॒दासो॑ अक्रन् । तानि॑ नरा जुजुषा॒णोप॑ यातं बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ várdhanāni ǀ bráhma ǀ stómam ǀ gṛtsa-madā́saḥ ǀ akran ǀtā́ni ǀ narā ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheGṛtsamadashave composed this prayer, these praises,Aśvins, for your exaltation; be propitiated by them, leaders of ceremonies, and come hither; that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑पूषणा॒ जन॑ना रयी॒णां जन॑ना दि॒वो जन॑ना पृथि॒व्याः । जा॒तौ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पौ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वन्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sómāpūṣaṇā ǀ jánanā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ jánanā ǀ diváḥ ǀ jánanā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀjātáu ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopáu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaandPūṣaṇ, you two are the genitive rators of riches, the genitive rators of heaven, the genitive rators of earth; as soon as born you are the guardians of the whole world; the gods have made you the source of immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मौ दे॒वौ जाय॑मानौ जुषन्ते॒मौ तमां॑सि गूहता॒मजु॑ष्टा । आ॒भ्यामिन्द्र॑: प॒क्वमा॒मास्व॒न्तः सो॑मापू॒षभ्यां॑ जनदु॒स्रिया॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: imáu ǀ deváu ǀ jā́yamānau ǀ juṣanta ǀ imáu ǀ támāṃsi ǀ gūhatām ǀ ájuṣṭā ǀābhyā́m ǀ índraḥ ǀ pakvám ǀ āmā́su ǀ antáríti ǀ somāpūṣá-bhyām ǀ janat ǀ usríyāsu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods) propitiate these two divinities at the moment of the ir birth, for they drive away the disagreeable glooms; with these two,SomaandPūṣaṇ,Indragenitive rates the mature (milk) in the immature heifers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑पूषणा॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानं॑ स॒प्तच॑क्रं॒ रथ॒मवि॑श्वमिन्वम् । वि॒षू॒वृतं॒ मन॑सा यु॒ज्यमा॑नं॒ तं जि॑न्वथो वृषणा॒ पञ्च॑रश्मिम्
shlokas.transliteration: sómāpūṣaṇā ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́nam ǀ saptá-cakram ǀ rátham ǀ áviśva-minvam ǀviṣu-vṛ́tam ǀ mánasā ǀ yujyámānam ǀ tám ǀ jinvathaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ páñca-raśmim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaandPūṣaṇ, showerers (of benefits)m direct towards us the seven-wheeled car, the measure of the spheres, undistinguishable from the universe, everywhere existing, (guided) by five reins, and to be harnessed by the mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒व्य१॒॑न्यः सद॑नं च॒क्र उ॒च्चा पृ॑थि॒व्याम॒न्यो अध्य॒न्तरि॑क्षे । ताव॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुरु॒वारं॑ पुरु॒क्षुं रा॒यस्पोषं॒ वि ष्य॑तां॒ नाभि॑म॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: diví ǀ anyáḥ ǀ sádanam ǀ cakré ǀ uccā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ antárikṣe ǀtáu ǀ asmábhyam ǀ puru-vā́ram ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ ví ǀ syatām ǀ nā́bhim ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of them, (Pūṣaṇ), has made his dwelling above in the heaven; the other (Soma), upon earth, and in the firmament; may they both grant us much-desired and much-commended abundant wealth of cattle, the source to us (of enjoyment).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑न्य॒न्यो भुव॑ना ज॒जान॒ विश्व॑म॒न्यो अ॑भि॒चक्षा॑ण एति । सोमा॑पूषणा॒वव॑तं॒ धियं॑ मे यु॒वाभ्यां॒ विश्वा॒: पृत॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ anyáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ jajā́na ǀ víśvam ǀ anyáḥ ǀ abhi-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ eti ǀsómāpūṣaṇau ǀ ávatam ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ yuvā́bhyām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of you, (Soma) has genitive rated all beings; the other proceeds looking upon the universe: Soma andPūṣaṇ, protect my (pious) rite; through you, may we overcome all the hosts of our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धियं॑ पू॒षा जि॑न्वतु विश्वमि॒न्वो र॒यिं सोमो॑ रयि॒पति॑र्दधातु । अव॑तु दे॒व्यदि॑तिरन॒र्वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dhíyam ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ jinvatu ǀ viśvam-inváḥ ǀ rayím ǀ sómaḥ ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ dadhātu ǀávatu ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ anarvā́ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayPūṣaṇ, who is the benefactor of all, be propitious to (this pious) rite; maySoma, the lord of wealth, grant us affluence; mayAditi, who is without an adversary, protect us, so that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify (you) at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वायो॒ ये ते॑ सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथा॑स॒स्तेभि॒रा ग॑हि । नि॒युत्वा॒न्त्सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀ ráthāsaḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀniyútvān ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, whose are a thousand chariots, and theNiyutsteeds, come to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒युत्वा॑न्वाय॒वा ग॑ह्य॒यं शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते । गन्ता॑सि सुन्व॒तो गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: niyútvān ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ayám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ayāmi ǀ te ǀgántā ǀ asi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu,of theNiyutsteds, approach; this bright (juice) has been accepted by you, for you go to the dwelling of the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒क्रस्या॒द्य गवा॑शिर॒ इन्द्र॑वायू नि॒युत्व॑तः । आ या॑तं॒ पिब॑तं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: śukrásya ǀ adyá ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ niyútvataḥ ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ píbatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites),IndraandVāyu, lords of theNiyutsteeds, come and drink today the mixture of milk and of the pureSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा । ममेदि॒ह श्रु॑तं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǀmáma ǀ ít ǀ ihá ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This libation is offered to you,MitraandVaruṇa, cherishers of truth; hear, verily, this my present invocatioṇ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॑ना॒वन॑भिद्रुहा ध्रु॒वे सद॑स्युत्त॒मे । स॒हस्र॑स्थूण आसाते
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jānau ǀ ánabhi-druhā ǀ dhruvé ǀ sádasi ǀ ut-tamé ǀsahásra-sthūṇe ǀ āsāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sovereigns, exercising no oppression, sit down in this substantial and elegant hall, (built) with a thousand columns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता स॒म्राजा॑ घृ॒तासु॑ती आदि॒त्या दानु॑न॒स्पती॑ । सचे॑ते॒ अन॑वह्वरम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ ghṛtā́sutī íti ghṛtá-āsutī ǀ ādityā́ ǀ dā́nunaḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀsácete íti ǀ ánava-hvaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these two universal monarchs, fed with clarified butter, sons ofAditi, lords of liberality, show favour to their sincere (worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोम॑दू॒ षु ना॑स॒त्याश्वा॑वद्यातमश्विना । व॒र्ती रु॑द्रा नृ॒पाय्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ nāsatyā ǀ áśva-vat ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀvartíḥ ǀ rudrā ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, in whom there is no untruth;Rudras, go by the (direct) road to (the sacrifice at which the libation) is to be drunk by the leaders (of sacred rite), for which (the offerer may receive the reward of) cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यत्परो॒ नान्त॑र आद॒धर्ष॑द्वृषण्वसू । दु॒:शंसो॒ मर्त्यो॑ रि॒पुः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yát ǀ páraḥ ǀ ná ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ ā-dadhárṣat ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀduḥ-śáṃsaḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ ripúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerers of wealth, (bring to us) such (riches) that the malevolent man, or foe, whether he be far off or nigh, may not take (it) away.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता न॒ आ वो॑ळ्हमश्विना र॒यिं पि॒शङ्ग॑संदृशम् । धिष्ण्या॑ वरिवो॒विद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǀ rayím ǀ piśáṅga-sandṛśam ǀdhíṣṇyā ǀ varivaḥ-vídam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResoluteAśvins, bring to us riches of various sorts, and wealth begetting wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ङ्ग म॒हद्भ॒यम॒भी षदप॑ चुच्यवत् । स हि स्थि॒रो विच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ aṅgá ǀ mahát ǀ bhayám ǀ abhí ǀ sát ǀ ápa ǀ cucyavat ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sthiráḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, dissipate all great and overpowering danger, for he is resolute, and the beholder of all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्च मृ॒ळया॑ति नो॒ न न॑: प॒श्चाद॒घं न॑शत् । भ॒द्रं भ॑वाति नः पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ mṛḷáyāti ǀ naḥ ǀ ná ǀ naḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ aghám ǀ naśat ǀbhadrám ǀ bhavāti ǀ naḥ ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IfIndraprovide for our happiness, evil will not come behidn us, good will be before us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ आशा॑भ्य॒स्परि॒ सर्वा॑भ्यो॒ अभ॑यं करत् । जेता॒ शत्रू॒न्विच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ā́śābhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sárvābhyaḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ karat ǀjétā ǀ śátrūn ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetIndra, the beholder of all, the conqueror of foes, send us security from all quarters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त शृणु॒ता म॑ इ॒मं हव॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्नि षी॑दत
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ śṛṇutá ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal gods, come hither; hear this my invocation; sit down upon this sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ती॒व्रो वो॒ मधु॑माँ अ॒यं शु॒नहो॑त्रेषु मत्स॒रः । ए॒तं पि॑बत॒ काम्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tīvráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ayám ǀ śuná-hotreṣu ǀ matsaráḥ ǀetám ǀ pibata ǀ kā́myam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This sharp, savoury, exhilarating (beverage), is (prepared) for you by the Śunahotras; drink of it at your plural asure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा॒ मरु॑द्गणा॒ देवा॑स॒: पूष॑रातयः । विश्वे॒ मम॑ श्रुता॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ márut-gaṇāḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ pū́ṣa-rātayaḥ ǀvíśve ǀ máma ǀ śruta ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, of whomIndrais the chief; divinities, of whomPūṣan. is benefactor; do you all hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अम्बि॑तमे॒ नदी॑तमे॒ देवि॑तमे॒ सर॑स्वति । अ॒प्र॒श॒स्ता इ॑व स्मसि॒ प्रश॑स्तिमम्ब नस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: ámbi-tame ǀ nádī-tame ǀ dévi-tame ǀ sárasvati ǀapraśastā́ḥ-iva ǀ smasi ǀ prá-śastim ǀ amba ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, best of mothers, best of rivers, best of goddesses, we are, as it were, of no repute; grant us, mother, distinction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे विश्वा॑ सरस्वति श्रि॒तायूं॑षि दे॒व्याम् । शु॒नहो॑त्रेषु मत्स्व प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ víśvā ǀ sarasvati ǀ śritā́ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ devyā́m ǀśuná-hotreṣu ǀ matsva ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ devi ǀ didiḍḍhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In you,Sarasvatī, who are divine, all existences are collected; rejoice, goddess, among the Śunahotras, grant us, goddess, progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ सरस्वति जु॒षस्व॑ वाजिनीवति । या ते॒ मन्म॑ गृत्सम॒दा ऋ॑तावरि प्रि॒या दे॒वेषु॒ जुह्व॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ sarasvati ǀ juṣásva ǀ vājinī-vati ǀyā́ ǀ te ǀ mánma ǀ gṛtsa-madā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vari ǀ priyā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ júhvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, abounding in food, abounding in water, be propitiated by these oblations, which theGṛtsamadasoffer as acceptable to you, and precious of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेतां॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ श॒म्भुवा॑ यु॒वामिदा वृ॑णीमहे । अ॒ग्निं च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ itām ǀ yajñásya ǀ śam-bhúvā ǀ yuvā́m ǀ ít ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀagním ǀ ca ǀ havya-vā́hanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two, (Heaven and Earth), who confer good fortune upon the sacrifice, proceed (to the altar); for verily, we implore you both (to com), as well asAgnithe bearer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावा॑ नः पृथि॒वी इ॒मं सि॒ध्रम॒द्य दि॑वि॒स्पृश॑म् । य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ यच्छताम्
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ imám ǀ sidhrám ǀ adyá ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǀyajñám ǀ devéṣu ǀ yacchatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and Earth, bear to the gods today our heaven aspiring sacrifice, the means of obtainingsvarga.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑मु॒पस्थ॑मद्रुहा दे॒वाः सी॑दन्तु य॒ज्ञिया॑: । इ॒हाद्य सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ upá-stham ǀ adruhā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀihá ǀ adyá ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorable gods, devoice of malice, sit down today nigh to you both to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कनि॑क्रदज्ज॒नुषं॑ प्रब्रुवा॒ण इय॑र्ति॒ वाच॑मरि॒तेव॒ नाव॑म् । सु॒म॒ङ्गल॑श्च शकुने॒ भवा॑सि॒ मा त्वा॒ का चि॑दभि॒भा विश्व्या॑ विदत्
shlokas.transliteration: kánikradat ǀ janúṣam ǀ pra-bruvāṇáḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ aritā́-iva ǀ nā́vam ǀsu-maṅgálaḥ ǀ ca ǀ śakune ǀ bhávāsi ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ kā́ ǀ cit ǀ abhi-bhā́ ǀ víśvyā ǀ vidat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Crying repeatedly, and foretelling what will come to pass, (thekapiñjala) gives (due) direction to its voice, as a helmsman (guides) a boat; be ominous, bird, of good fortune, and may no calamity whatever befall you from any quarter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा त्वा॑ श्ये॒न उद्व॑धी॒न्मा सु॑प॒र्णो मा त्वा॑ विद॒दिषु॑मान्वी॒रो अस्ता॑ । पित्र्या॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिशं॒ कनि॑क्रदत्सुम॒ङ्गलो॑ भद्रवा॒दी व॑दे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ út ǀ vadhīt ǀ mā́ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vidat ǀ íṣu-mān ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ástā ǀpítryām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-díśam ǀ kánikradat ǀ su-maṅgálaḥ ǀ bhadra-vādī́ ǀ vada ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May no kite, no eagle, kill you; may no archer armed with arrows, reach you; crying repeatedly, in the region of thePitā, be ominous of good fortune; proclaimer of good luck, speak to us on this occasion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ क्रन्द दक्षिण॒तो गृ॒हाणां॑ सुम॒ङ्गलो॑ भद्रवा॒दी श॑कुन्ते । मा न॑: स्ते॒न ई॑शत॒ माघशं॑सो बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ kranda ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ gṛhā́ṇām ǀ su-maṅgálaḥ ǀ bhadra-vādī́ ǀ śakunte ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stenáḥ ǀ īśata ǀ mā́ ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bird, who are ominous of good fortune, the proclaimer of good luck, cry from the south of our dwellings; may no thief, no evil-doer prevail agains tus; that blessed with excellent descendants we may worthily praise you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒द॒क्षि॒णिद॒भि गृ॑णन्ति का॒रवो॒ वयो॒ वद॑न्त ऋतु॒था श॒कुन्त॑यः । उ॒भे वाचौ॑ वदति साम॒गा इ॑व गाय॒त्रं च॒ त्रैष्टु॑भं॒ चानु॑ राजति
shlokas.transliteration: pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vádantaḥ ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ śakúntayaḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ vā́cau ǀ vadati ǀ sāmagā́ḥ-iva ǀ gāyatrám ǀ ca ǀ tráistubham ǀ ca ǀ ánu ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the birds in quest of their food, according to the season, proclaim their circumambulations like the celebrators (of sacred rites); he utters both notes, as the chanter of thesāmarecites the gayatrī and tṛṣṭubh, and delights (the hearers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒द्गा॒तेव॑ शकुने॒ साम॑ गायसि ब्रह्मपु॒त्र इ॑व॒ सव॑नेषु शंससि । वृषे॑व वा॒जी शिशु॑मतीर॒पीत्या॑ स॒र्वतो॑ नः शकुने भ॒द्रमा व॑द वि॒श्वतो॑ नः शकुने॒ पुण्य॒मा व॑द
shlokas.transliteration: udgātā́-iva ǀ śakune ǀ sā́ma ǀ gāyasi ǀ brahmaputráḥ-iva ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ śaṃsasi ǀvṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ vājī́ ǀ śíśu-matīḥ ǀ api-ítya ǀ sarvátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śakune ǀ bhadrám ǀ ā́ ǀ vada ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śakune ǀ púṇyam ǀ ā́ ǀ vada ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You sing, Bird, like theudgatāchanting thesāma; you murmur like the brahmaputra at sacrifices; like a horse (neighing) when approaching a mare do you proclaim (aloud) to us good fortune from every quarter; proclaim aloud prosperity to us from every direction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒वदँ॒स्त्वं श॑कुने भ॒द्रमा व॑द तू॒ष्णीमासी॑नः सुम॒तिं चि॑किद्धि नः । यदु॒त्पत॒न्वद॑सि कर्क॒रिर्य॑था बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā-vádan ǀ tvám ǀ śakune ǀ bhadrám ǀ ā́ ǀ vada ǀ tūṣṇī́m ǀ ā́sīnaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ cikiddhi ǀ naḥ ǀyát ǀ ut-pátan ǀ vádasi ǀ karkaríḥ ǀ yathā ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When uttering your cry, O Bird, proclaim good fortune; when sitting silently cherish kind thoughts towards us; when you cry as you are flying, let the sound be like that of a lute; so that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily praise you at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य मा त॒वसं॒ वक्ष्य॑ग्ने॒ वह्निं॑ चकर्थ वि॒दथे॒ यज॑ध्यै । दे॒वाँ अच्छा॒ दीद्य॑द्यु॒ञ्जे अद्रिं॑ शमा॒ये अ॑ग्ने त॒न्वं॑ जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: sómasya ǀ mā ǀ tavásam ǀ vákṣi ǀ agne ǀ váhnim ǀ cakartha ǀ vidáthe ǀ yájadhyai ǀdevā́n ǀ áccha ǀ dī́dyat ǀ yuñjé ǀ ádrim ǀ śam-āyé ǀ agne ǀ tanvám ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Render me vigorous,Agni, since you have made me the bearer of theSomato offer it in the sacrifice; honouring the gods who are present, I take hold of the stone (to express Soma); I propitiate them; do you, Agni, protect my person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राञ्चं॑ य॒ज्ञं च॑कृम॒ वर्ध॑तां॒ गीः स॒मिद्भि॑र॒ग्निं नम॑सा दुवस्यन् । दि॒वः श॑शासुर्वि॒दथा॑ कवी॒नां गृत्सा॑य चित्त॒वसे॑ गा॒तुमी॑षुः
shlokas.transliteration: prā́ñcam ǀ yajñám ǀ cakṛma ǀ várdhatām ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ samít-bhiḥ ǀ agním ǀ námasā ǀ duvasyan ǀdiváḥ ǀ śaśāsuḥ ǀ vidáthā ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ gṛ́tsāya ǀ cit ǀ taváse ǀ gātúm ǀ īṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have performed,Agni, a successful sacrifice; may my praise magnify (you) as worshipping you with fuel and with reverence; (the gods) fromheaven desire the adoration of the pious, who are anxious to praise the adorable and mighty (Agni).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मयो॑ दधे॒ मेधि॑रः पू॒तद॑क्षो दि॒वः सु॒बन्धु॑र्ज॒नुषा॑ पृथि॒व्याः । अवि॑न्दन्नु दर्श॒तम॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर्दे॒वासो॑ अ॒ग्निम॒पसि॒ स्वसॄ॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: máyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ pūtá-dakṣaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ su-bándhuḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀávindan ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ darśatám ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agním ǀ apási ǀ svásṝṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods discovered the gracefulAgni(concealed) amidst the waters of the flowing (rivers), for the purpose of (sacred) acts; Agni, who is intelligent,of purified vigour, and friendly; who from his birth bestowed happiness on earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑र्धयन्त्सु॒भगं॑ स॒प्त य॒ह्वीः श्वे॒तं ज॑ज्ञा॒नम॑रु॒षं म॑हि॒त्वा । शिशुं॒ न जा॒तम॒भ्या॑रु॒रश्वा॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒ग्निं जनि॑मन्वपुष्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: ávardhayan ǀ su-bhágam ǀ saptá ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ śvetám ǀ jajñānám ǀ aruṣám ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀśíśum ǀ ná ǀ jātám ǀ abhí ǀ āruḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agním ǀ jániman ǀ vapuṣyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven great rivers augmented in might the auspicious, pure, and radiantAgnias soon as he was born, in like manner as mares (tend) the newborn foal; the gods cherished the body (of Agni) at his birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒क्रेभि॒रङ्गै॒ रज॑ आतत॒न्वान्क्रतुं॑ पुना॒नः क॒विभि॑: प॒वित्रै॑: । शो॒चिर्वसा॑न॒: पर्यायु॑र॒पां श्रियो॑ मिमीते बृह॒तीरनू॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: śukrébhiḥ ǀ áṅgaiḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ ā-tatanvā́n ǀ krátum ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ pavítraiḥ ǀśocíḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ mimīte ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ ánūnāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Spreading through the firmament with shining limbs, sanctifying the rite with intelligent and purifying (energies), and clothed with radiance, he bestows upon the worshiper abundant food and great and undiminished prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒व्राजा॑ सी॒मन॑दती॒रद॑ब्धा दि॒वो य॒ह्वीरव॑साना॒ अन॑ग्नाः । सना॒ अत्र॑ युव॒तय॒: सयो॑नी॒रेकं॒ गर्भं॑ दधिरे स॒प्त वाणी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vavrā́ja ǀ sīm ǀ ánadatīḥ ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ ávasānāḥ ǀ ánagnāḥ ǀsánāḥ ǀ átra ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ sá-yonīḥ ǀ ékam ǀ gárbham ǀ dadhire ǀ saptá ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnieverywhere repairs to the undevouring, undevoured (waters); the vast (offspring) of the firmament, not clothed, yet not naked, seven eternal ever youthfful rivers, sprung from the same source, received Agni as their common embryo.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्ती॒र्णा अ॑स्य सं॒हतो॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा घृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ स्र॒वथे॒ मधू॑नाम् । अस्थु॒रत्र॑ धे॒नव॒: पिन्व॑माना म॒ही द॒स्मस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ समी॒ची
shlokas.transliteration: stīrṇā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ sam-hátaḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpāḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀ sraváthe ǀ mádhūnām ǀásthuḥ ǀ átra ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ dasmásya ǀ mātárā ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aggregated in the womb of the waters, (his rays) spread abroad; and omniform, are here effective for the diffusion of the sweet (Soma), like kine full uddered; the mighty (Heaven and Earth) are the fitting parents of the gracefulAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒भ्रा॒णः सू॑नो सहसो॒ व्य॑द्यौ॒द्दधा॑नः शु॒क्रा र॑भ॒सा वपूं॑षि । श्चोत॑न्ति॒ धारा॒ मधु॑नो घृ॒तस्य॒ वृषा॒ यत्र॑ वावृ॒धे काव्ये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: babhrāṇáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ rabhasā́ ǀ vápūṃṣi ǀścótanti ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yátra ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ kā́vyena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength, sustained by all, you shine, possessing bright and rapid rays; when the vigorousAgniis magnified by praise, then the showers of sweet rain descend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुश्चि॒दूध॑र्ज॒नुषा॑ विवेद॒ व्य॑स्य॒ धारा॑ असृज॒द्वि धेना॑: । गुहा॒ चर॑न्तं॒ सखि॑भिः शि॒वेभि॑र्दि॒वो य॒ह्वीभि॒र्न गुहा॑ बभूव
shlokas.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ cit ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ viveda ǀ ví ǀ asya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ ví ǀ dhénāḥ ǀgúhā ǀ cárantam ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ yahvī́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ gúhā ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At his birth he knew the udder of his parent and let forth its torrents, and its speech (of thunder); there was no one to detect him, lurking in the deep, with his auspicious associates, (the winds), and the many (waters) of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुश्च॒ गर्भं॑ जनि॒तुश्च॑ बभ्रे पू॒र्वीरेको॑ अधय॒त्पीप्या॑नाः । वृष्णे॑ स॒पत्नी॒ शुच॑ये॒ सब॑न्धू उ॒भे अ॑स्मै मनु॒ष्ये॒३॒॑ नि पा॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ ca ǀ gárbham ǀ janitúḥ ǀ ca ǀ babhre ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ adhayat ǀ pī́pyānāḥ ǀvṛ́ṣṇe ǀ sapátnī íti sa-pátnī ǀ śúcaye ǀ sábandhū íti sá-bandhū ǀ ubhé íti ǀ asmai ǀ manuṣyé íti ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He cherishes the embryo of the parent (firmament), and of the genitive rator (of the world); he alone consumes many flourishing (plural nts); the associated brides (of the Sun, Heaven and Earth), who are kind to man, are both of kin to that pure showerer (of blessings); do you,Agni, ever preserve them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रौ म॒हाँ अ॑निबा॒धे व॑व॒र्धापो॑ अ॒ग्निं य॒शस॒: सं हि पू॒र्वीः । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑वशय॒द्दमू॑ना जामी॒नाम॒ग्निर॒पसि॒ स्वसॄ॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: uráu ǀ mahā́n ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ vavardha ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ agním ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀ aśayat ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ jāmīnā́m ǀ agníḥ ǀ apási ǀ svásṝṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The greatAgniincreases on the broad unbounded (firmament), for the waters supply abundant nutriment, and plural cid, he sleeps in the birth-plural ce of the waters for the service of the sister streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒क्रो न ब॒भ्रिः स॑मि॒थे म॒हीनां॑ दिदृ॒क्षेय॑: सू॒नवे॒ भाऋ॑जीकः । उदु॒स्रिया॒ जनि॑ता॒ यो ज॒जाना॒पां गर्भो॒ नृत॑मो य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: akráḥ ǀ ná ǀ babhríḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ mahī́nām ǀ didṛkṣéyaḥ ǀ sūnáve ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkaḥ ǀút ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ jánitā ǀ yáḥ ǀ jajā́na ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The invincibleAgni, the cherisher of the valiant in battle, the seen of all, shining by his own lustre, the genitive rator (of the world), the embryo of the waters, the chief of leaders, the mighty, is he who has begotton the waters for (the benefit of) the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पां गर्भं॑ दर्श॒तमोष॑धीनां॒ वना॑ जजान सु॒भगा॒ विरू॑पम् । दे॒वास॑श्चि॒न्मन॑सा॒ सं हि ज॒ग्मुः पनि॑ष्ठं जा॒तं त॒वसं॑ दुवस्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ gárbham ǀ darśatám ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ vánā ǀ jajāna ǀ su-bhágā ǀ ví-rūpam ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ cit ǀ mánasā ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ jagmúḥ ǀ pániṣṭham ǀ jātám ǀ tavásam ǀ duvasyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious timber has genitive rated the graceful and multiform embryo of the waters and the plural nts; the gods approached him with reverence, and worshipped the adorable and mighty (Agni) as soon as born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्त॒ इद्भा॒नवो॒ भाऋ॑जीकम॒ग्निं स॑चन्त वि॒द्युतो॒ न शु॒क्राः । गुहे॑व वृ॒द्धं सद॑सि॒ स्वे अ॒न्तर॑पा॒र ऊ॒र्वे अ॒मृतं॒ दुहा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhántaḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkam ǀ agním ǀ sacanta ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀgúhā-iva ǀ vṛddhám ǀ sádasi ǀ své ǀ antáḥ ǀ apāré ǀ ūrvé ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ dúhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty sins, like brilliant lightning, associate with the self-shiningAgni, great in his own abode, as if in a (deep) cavern, as they milk forth ambrosia into the boundless and vast ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळे॑ च त्वा॒ यज॑मानो ह॒विर्भि॒रीळे॑ सखि॒त्वं सु॑म॒तिं निका॑मः । दे॒वैरवो॑ मिमीहि॒ सं ज॑रि॒त्रे रक्षा॑ च नो॒ दम्ये॑भि॒रनी॑कैः
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ī́ḷe ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ su-matím ǀ ní-kāmaḥ ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ mimīhi ǀ sám ǀ jaritré ǀ rákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dámyebhiḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I, the instrumental tutor of the rite, worship you with oblations; desirous of your favour, I implore your friendship; grant, along with the gods, protection to him who praises you, preserve us with your well-regulated rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒क्षे॒तार॒स्तव॑ सुप्रणी॒तेऽग्ने॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ धन्या॒ दधा॑नाः । सु॒रेत॑सा॒ श्रव॑सा॒ तुञ्ज॑माना अ॒भि ष्या॑म पृतना॒यूँरदे॑वान्
shlokas.transliteration: upa-kṣetā́raḥ ǀ táva ǀ su-pranīte ǀ agne ǀ víśvāni ǀ dhányā ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀsu-rétasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ túñjamānāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanā-yū́n ǀ ádevān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approaching you, benevolentAgni, and performing all holy acts that are the cause of opulence, offering oblations with earnestness and in abundance, may we overcome the hostile hosts that are without gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दे॒वाना॑मभवः के॒तुर॑ग्ने म॒न्द्रो विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑नि वि॒द्वान् । प्रति॒ मर्ताँ॑ अवासयो॒ दमू॑ना॒ अनु॑ दे॒वान्र॑थि॒रो या॑सि॒ साध॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ agne ǀ mandráḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀpráti ǀ mártān ǀ avāsayaḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ devā́n ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ sā́dhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the commendable announcer of the gods, cognizant of all sacred rites; plural cid, you abide among mortals, and, like a charioteer, you follow the gods, accomplishing (their wishes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि दु॑रो॒णे अ॒मृतो॒ मर्त्या॑नां॒ राजा॑ ससाद वि॒दथा॑नि॒ साध॑न् । घृ॒तप्र॑तीक उर्वि॒या व्य॑द्यौद॒ग्निर्विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑नि वि॒द्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ duroṇé ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ rā́jā ǀ sasāda ǀ vidáthāni ǀ sā́dhan ǀghṛtá-pratīkaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ vidvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortal being has sat down in the dwelling of mortals, accomplishing (their) sacrifices;Agni, who is cognizant of all sacred rites, shines with expanded bulk when fed with clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ गहि स॒ख्येभि॑: शि॒वेभि॑र्म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: सर॒ण्यन् । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं ब॑हु॒लं संत॑रुत्रं सु॒वाचं॑ भा॒गं य॒शसं॑ कृधी नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gahi ǀ sakhyébhiḥ ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ saraṇyán ǀasmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ bahulám ǀ sám-tarutram ǀ su-vā́cam ǀ bhāgám ǀ yaśásam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us with friendly, auspicious, and mighty aids, you who are great and all-pervading; besto wupon us ample riches, safe from injury, well-spoken of, desirable, and renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता ते॑ अग्ने॒ जनि॑मा॒ सना॑नि॒ प्र पू॒र्व्याय॒ नूत॑नानि वोचम् । म॒हान्ति॒ वृष्णे॒ सव॑ना कृ॒तेमा जन्म॑ञ्जन्म॒न्निहि॑तो जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ jánima ǀ sánāni ǀ prá ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀ nū́tanāni ǀ vocam ǀmahā́nti ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ sávanā ǀ kṛtā́ ǀ imā́ ǀ jánman-janman ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I address to you,Agni, who are of old, these eternal as well as recent adorations; these solemn sacrifices are offered to the showerer of benefits, who in every birth is established (among men), cognizant of all that exists.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जन्म॑ञ्जन्म॒न्निहि॑तो जा॒तवे॑दा वि॒श्वामि॑त्रेभिरिध्यते॒ अज॑स्रः । तस्य॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: jánman-janman ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ viśvā́mitrebhiḥ ǀ idhyate ǀ ájasraḥ ǀtásya ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The undecayingJātavedas, who in every birth is established (among men), is kindled by theViśvāmitras; may we, (enjoying) his favour, ever be (held) in the auspicious good-will of that adorable (deity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं स॑हसाव॒न्त्वं नो॑ देव॒त्रा धे॑हि सुक्रतो॒ ररा॑णः । प्र यं॑सि होतर्बृह॒तीरिषो॒ नोऽग्ने॒ महि॒ द्रवि॑ण॒मा य॑जस्व
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ dhehi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀprá ǀ yaṃsi ǀ hotaḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ máhi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ā́ ǀ yajasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulAgni, (fulfiller) of good works, convey, rejoicing this our sacrifice towards the gods; invoker of the gods, bestow upon us abundant food; grant us, Agni, great wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॑ धि॒षणा॑मृता॒वृधे॑ घृ॒तं न पू॒तम॒ग्नये॑ जनामसि । द्वि॒ता होता॑रं॒ मनु॑षश्च वा॒घतो॑ धि॒या रथं॒ न कुलि॑श॒: समृ॑ण्वति
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ dhiṣáṇām ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhe ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pūtám ǀ agnáye ǀ janāmasi ǀdvitā́ ǀ hótāram ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ kúliśaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer toAgni, who isVaiśvānara, the augmenter of water, praise (as bland) as pure clarified butter; and the priests and the worshipper incite by their (pious) rites the invoker of the gods to his two-fold function, as a wheelwright fabricates a caṛ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रो॑चयज्ज॒नुषा॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे स मा॒त्रोर॑भवत्पु॒त्र ईड्य॑: । ह॒व्य॒वाळ॒ग्निर॒जर॒श्चनो॑हितो दू॒ळभो॑ वि॒शामति॑थिर्वि॒भाव॑सुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ rocayat ǀ janúṣā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ mātróḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ putráḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀhavya-vā́ṭ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀ duḥ-dábhaḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ átithiḥ ǀ vibhā́-vasuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By his birth he lighted up both heaven and earth; he was the praiseworthy son of his parents; the undecayingAgni, the bearer of oblations, the giver of food, the guest of men, the affluent in radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य॒ तरु॑षो॒ विध॑र्मणि दे॒वासो॑ अ॒ग्निं ज॑नयन्त॒ चित्ति॑भिः । रु॒रु॒चा॒नं भा॒नुना॒ ज्योति॑षा म॒हामत्यं॒ न वाजं॑ सनि॒ष्यन्नुप॑ ब्रुवे
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ táruṣaḥ ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agním ǀ janayanta ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǀrurucānám ǀ bhānúnā ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ mahā́m ǀ átyam ǀ ná ǀ vā́jam ǀ saniṣyán ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods (endowed) with intelligence, gave birth toAgniin the multiform rite by the exertion of preserving strength; desirous of food, I eulogise the great Agni, bright with solar effulgence, and (vigorous) as a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ म॒न्द्रस्य॑ सनि॒ष्यन्तो॒ वरे॑ण्यं वृणी॒महे॒ अह्र॑यं॒ वाज॑मृ॒ग्मिय॑म् । रा॒तिं भृगू॑णामु॒शिजं॑ क॒विक्र॑तुम॒ग्निं राज॑न्तं दि॒व्येन॑ शो॒चिषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mandrásya ǀ saniṣyántaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ áhrayam ǀ vā́jam ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀrātím ǀ bhṛ́gūṇām ǀ uśíjam ǀ kaví-kratum ǀ agním ǀ rā́jantam ǀ divyéna ǀ śocíṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring excellent food, inflicting no disgrace, we solicit the boon of the adorable (Vaiśvānara) fromAgni, the benefactor of theBhṛgus, the object of our desires, who is acquainted with past acts, and shines with celestial splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं सु॒म्नाय॑ दधिरे पु॒रो जना॒ वाज॑श्रवसमि॒ह वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । य॒तस्रु॑चः सु॒रुचं॑ वि॒श्वदे॑व्यं रु॒द्रं य॒ज्ञानां॒ साध॑दिष्टिम॒पसा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ dadhire ǀ puráḥ ǀ jánāḥ ǀ vā́ja-śravasam ǀ ihá ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀyatá-srucaḥ ǀ su-rúcam ǀ viśvá-devyam ǀ rudrám ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ sā́dhat-iṣṭim ǀ apásām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men with strewn holy grass, and uplifted ladles, plural ce before them this solemnity for the sake of obtaining happiness,Agni, the bestower of food, the resplendent, the benefactor of all the gods, the remover of sorrow, the perfecter of the (holy) acts of the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पाव॑कशोचे॒ तव॒ हि क्षयं॒ परि॒ होत॑र्य॒ज्ञेषु॑ वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषो॒ नर॑: । अग्ने॒ दुव॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नास॒ आप्य॒मुपा॑सते॒ द्रवि॑णं धेहि॒ तेभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pā́vaka-śoce ǀ táva ǀ hí ǀ kṣáyam ǀ pári ǀ hótaḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀágne ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ icchámānāsaḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀ dráviṇam ǀ dhehi ǀ tébhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, of purifying lustre, invoker of the gods, men desirous of worshipping (you), having strewn the sacred grass, repair to your appropriate abode at sacrifices; bestow upon them wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रोद॑सी अपृण॒दा स्व॑र्म॒हज्जा॒तं यदे॑नम॒पसो॒ अधा॑रयन् । सो अ॑ध्व॒राय॒ परि॑ णीयते क॒विरत्यो॒ न वाज॑सातये॒ चनो॑हितः
