shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇat ǀ ā́ ǀ sváḥ ǀ mahát ǀ jātám ǀ yát ǀ enam ǀ apásaḥ ǀ ádhārayan ǀsáḥ ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ pári ǀ nīyate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has filled both heaven and earth and the spacious firmament, he whom the performers of (sacred) rites have laid hold of as soon as born; he, the sage, the giver of food, is brought like a horse to the sacrificer, for (the sake of) obtaining food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒म॒स्यत॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं स्वध्व॒रं दु॑व॒स्यत॒ दम्यं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसम् । र॒थीॠ॒तस्य॑ बृह॒तो विच॑र्षणिर॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॑मभवत्पु॒रोहि॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: namasyáta ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ duvasyáta ǀ dábhyam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀrathī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavat ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reverence the bearer of oblations (to the gods), him whose sacrifice is acceptable; worship him by whom all that exists is known, who is friendly to our dwellings; forAgniis the conductor of the great sacrifice, the beholder of all, who has been plural ced in front of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो य॒ह्वस्य॑ स॒मिध॒: परि॑ज्मनो॒ऽग्नेर॑पुनन्नु॒शिजो॒ अमृ॑त्यवः । तासा॒मेका॒मद॑धु॒र्मर्त्ये॒ भुज॑मु लो॒कमु॒ द्वे उप॑ जा॒मिमी॑यतुः
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ yahvásya ǀ sam-ídhaḥ ǀ pári-jmanaḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ apunan ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ámṛtyavaḥ ǀtā́sām ǀ ékām ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ mártye ǀ bhújam ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dvé íti ǀ úpa ǀ jāmím ǀ īyatuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortals, desirous (of his presence), sanctified the three radiances of the great circumambientAgni; one of them they have plural ced in the world of mortals as the nourisher (of all); the other two have gone to the neighbouring sphere.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शां क॒विं वि॒श्पतिं॒ मानु॑षी॒रिष॒: सं सी॑मकृण्व॒न्त्स्वधि॑तिं॒ न तेज॑से । स उ॒द्वतो॑ नि॒वतो॑ याति॒ वेवि॑ष॒त्स गर्भ॑मे॒षु भुव॑नेषु दीधरत्
shlokas.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ kavím ǀ viśpátim ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ sám ǀ sīm ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ svá-dhitim ǀ ná ǀ téjase ǀsáḥ ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀ ni-vátaḥ ǀ yāti ǀ véviṣat ǀ sáḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ eṣú ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ dīdharat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Human beings, wishing for wealth, give brightnesss, (by their praises), to the lord of men, the wise (Agni), as they add lustre, (by polishing), to an axe; spreading everywhere, he goes alike through high and low plural ces, and has taken an embryo (condition) in these regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जि॑न्वते ज॒ठरे॑षु प्रजज्ञि॒वान्वृषा॑ चि॒त्रेषु॒ नान॑द॒न्न सिं॒हः । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः पृ॑थु॒पाजा॒ अम॑र्त्यो॒ वसु॒ रत्ना॒ दय॑मानो॒ वि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jinvate ǀ jaṭháreṣu ǀ prajajñi-vā́n ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ citréṣu ǀ nā́nadat ǀ ná ǀ siṃháḥ ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ pṛthu-pā́jāḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ rátnā ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits), genitive rated in (many) receptacles, flourishes, roaring in various (plural ces) like a lion;Vaiśvānara, the resplendent, the immortal, giving precious treasure to the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः प्र॒त्नथा॒ नाक॒मारु॑हद्दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठं भन्द॑मानः सु॒मन्म॑भिः । स पू॑र्व॒वज्ज॒नय॑ञ्ज॒न्तवे॒ धनं॑ समा॒नमज्मं॒ पर्ये॑ति॒ जागृ॑विः
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ pratná-thā ǀ nā́kam ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ bhándamānaḥ ǀ sumánma-bhiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ pūrva-vát ǀ janáyan ǀ jantáve ǀ dhánam ǀ samānám ǀ ájmam ǀ pári ǀ eti ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified by his adorers,Vaiśvānaraof old ascended to the heaven that is above the firmament bestowing wealth upon his (present) worshipper, as he did in former times; he travels, ever vigilant, the common path (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑नं य॒ज्ञियं॒ विप्र॑मु॒क्थ्य१॒॑मा यं द॒धे मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दि॒वि क्षय॑म् । तं चि॒त्रया॑मं॒ हरि॑केशमीमहे सुदी॒तिम॒ग्निं सु॑वि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānam ǀ yajñíyam ǀ vípram ǀ ukthyám ǀ ā́ ǀ yám ǀ dadhé ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ diví ǀ kṣáyam ǀtám ǀ citrá-yāmam ǀ hári-keśam ǀ īmahe ǀ su-dītím ǀ agním ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ návyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We implore for present riches, the many-moving tawny-rayed, resplendentAgni, whom mighty venerable, wise, adorable, and dwelling in the sky, the wind (brought down) and deposited (upon the earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचिं॒ न याम॑न्निषि॒रं स्व॒र्दृशं॑ के॒तुं दि॒वो रो॑चन॒स्थामु॑ष॒र्बुध॑म् । अ॒ग्निं मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अप्र॑तिष्कुतं॒ तमी॑महे॒ नम॑सा वा॒जिनं॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: śúcim ǀ ná ǀ yā́man ǀ iṣirám ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀ ketúm ǀ diváḥ ǀ rocana-sthā́m ǀ uṣaḥ-búdham ǀagním ǀ mūrdhā́nam ǀ diváḥ ǀ áprati-skutam ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǀ námasā ǀ vājínam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We implore with prayer the mightyAgni, the giver of food, the unrefusing, (seated on) the front of heaven; the radiant in the sacrifice, him who is to be sought (for by all), the beholder of all, the emblem of heaven, the dweller in light, who is to be awakened at dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रं होता॑रं॒ शुचि॒मद्व॑याविनं॒ दमू॑नसमु॒क्थ्यं॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिम् । रथं॒ न चि॒त्रं वपु॑षाय दर्श॒तं मनु॑र्हितं॒ सद॒मिद्रा॒य ई॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ śúcim ǀ ádvayāvinam ǀ dámūnasam ǀ ukthyám ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ citrám ǀ vápuṣāya ǀ darśatám ǀ mánuḥ-hitam ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit wealth of the adorable (Agni), the invoker of the gods, the pure, the single-minded, the munificent, the commendable, the beholder of all, who is many-coloured like a chariot, elegant in form, and always friendly to mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॑ पृथु॒पाज॑से॒ विपो॒ रत्ना॑ विधन्त ध॒रुणे॑ष॒च गात॑वे । अ॒ग्निर्हि दे॒वाँ अ॒मृतो॑ दुव॒स्यत्यथा॒ धर्मा॑णि स॒नता॒ न दू॑दुषत्
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ pṛthu-pā́jase ǀ vípaḥ ǀ rátnā ǀ vidhanta ǀ dharúṇeṣu ǀ gā́tave ǀagníḥ ǀ hí ǀ devā́n ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ duvasyáti ǀ átha ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ sanátā ǀ ná ǀ dūduṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Intelligent (worshippers), offer to the powerfulVaiśvānaraprecious things at holy rites, that they may go (the way of the good), for the immortalAgniworships the gods; therefore, let no one violate eternal duties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्तर्दू॒तो रोद॑सी द॒स्म ई॑यते॒ होता॒ निष॑त्तो॒ मनु॑षः पु॒रोहि॑तः । क्षयं॑ बृ॒हन्तं॒ परि॑ भूषति॒ द्युभि॑र्दे॒वेभि॑र॒ग्निरि॑षि॒तो धि॒याव॑सुः
shlokas.transliteration: antáḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dasmáḥ ǀ īyate ǀ hótā ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀkṣáyam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ pári ǀ bhūṣati ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The graceful messenger (of the gods) goes between heaven and earth; sitting (on the altar), and plural ced before men, he ornaments, the spacious chambers (of sacrifice) with his rays, animated by the gods, and affluent in wisdom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के॒तुं य॒ज्ञानां॑ वि॒दथ॑स्य॒ साध॑नं॒ विप्रा॑सो अ॒ग्निं म॑हयन्त॒ चित्ति॑भिः । अपां॑सि॒ यस्मि॒न्नधि॑ संद॒धुर्गिर॒स्तस्मि॑न्त्सु॒म्नानि॒ यज॑मान॒ आ च॑के
shlokas.transliteration: ketúm ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ vidáthasya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ agním ǀ mahayanta ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǀápāṃsi ǀ yásmin ǀ ádhi ǀ sam-dadhúḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ tásmin ǀ sumnā́ni ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise worship, with (pious) rites,Agni, the sign of sacrifices, the accomplishment of the solemnity, in whom the reciters of (his) praises have accusative ulated (their) acts (of devotion), and from whom the worshipper hopes for happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒ता य॒ज्ञाना॒मसु॑रो विप॒श्चितां॑ वि॒मान॑म॒ग्निर्व॒युनं॑ च वा॒घता॑म् । आ वि॑वेश॒ रोद॑सी॒ भूरि॑वर्पसा पुरुप्रि॒यो भ॑न्दते॒ धाम॑भिः क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: pitā́ ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítām ǀ vi-mā́nam ǀ agníḥ ǀ vayúnam ǀ ca ǀ vāghátām ǀā́ ǀ viveśa ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bhū́ri-varpasā ǀ puru-priyáḥ ǀ bhandate ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The parent of sacrifices, the invigorator of the wise, the end (of the rite), the instrumental uction of the priests,Agni, who has pervaded heaven and earth in many forms, the friend of man, wise, (and endowed) with splendours, is glorified (by the worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रम॒ग्निं च॒न्द्रर॑थं॒ हरि॑व्रतं वैश्वान॒रम॑प्सु॒षदं॑ स्व॒र्विद॑म् । वि॒गा॒हं तूर्णिं॒ तवि॑षीभि॒रावृ॑तं॒ भूर्णिं॑ दे॒वास॑ इ॒ह सु॒श्रियं॑ दधुः
shlokas.transliteration: candrám ǀ agním ǀ candrá-ratham ǀ hári-vratam ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ apsu-sádam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀvi-gāhám ǀ tū́rṇim ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtam ǀ bhū́rṇim ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ihá ǀ su-śríyam ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have plural ced in this world the delightfulAgniin a delightful chariot, the tawny-huedVaiśvānara, the sitter in the waters, the omniscient, the all-pervading, the endowed with energies, the cherisher, the illustrious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वेभि॒र्मनु॑षश्च ज॒न्तुभि॑स्तन्वा॒नो य॒ज्ञं पु॑रु॒पेश॑सं धि॒या । र॒थीर॒न्तरी॑यते॒ साध॑दिष्टिभिर्जी॒रो दमू॑ना अभिशस्ति॒चात॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀ jantú-bhiḥ ǀ tanvānáḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ puru-péśasam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀrathī́ḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ īyate ǀ sā́dhadiṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ jīráḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ abhiśasti-cā́tanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Perfecting the performance the multiform sacrifice of the worshipper, along with the gods to whom solemnities have been addressed, and together withthe priests,Agni, the charioteer, the swift-moving, the humble-minded, the destroyer of foes, passes along between (heaven and earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ जर॑स्व स्वप॒त्य आयु॑न्यू॒र्जा पि॑न्वस्व॒ समिषो॑ दिदीहि नः । वयां॑सि जिन्व बृह॒तश्च॑ जागृव उ॒शिग्दे॒वाना॒मसि॑ सु॒क्रतु॑र्वि॒पाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ járasva ǀ su-apatyé ǀ ā́yuni ǀ ūrjā́ ǀ pinvasva ǀ sám ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ naḥ ǀváyāṃsi ǀ jinva ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ca ǀ jāgṛve ǀ uśík ǀ devā́nām ǀ ási ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vipā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, praise (the gods that we may enjoy) good offspring and long life; propitiate them by libations; bestow upon us plural ntiful crops; ever vigilant, gran tfood to the respectable (instrumental tutor of this ceremony), for you are the desired of the gods, the object of the pious acts of the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्पतिं॑ य॒ह्वमति॑थिं॒ नर॒: सदा॑ य॒न्तारं॑ धी॒नामु॒शिजं॑ च वा॒घता॑म् । अ॒ध्व॒राणां॒ चेत॑नं जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ प्र शं॑सन्ति॒ नम॑सा जू॒तिभि॑र्वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: viśpátim ǀ yahvám ǀ átithim ǀ náraḥ ǀ sádā ǀ yantā́ram ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ uśíjam ǀ ca ǀ vāghátām ǀadhvarā́ṇām ǀ cétanam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsanti ǀ námasā ǀ jūtí-bhiḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leaderes (of holy rites) praise with prostration, for (the sake of) increase, the mighty lord of people, the guest (of men), the regulator eternally of acts, he desired of the priests, the exposition of sacrifices,Jātavedas, endowed with (divine) energies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भावा॑ दे॒वः सु॒रण॒: परि॑ क्षि॒तीर॒ग्निर्ब॑भूव॒ शव॑सा सु॒मद्र॑थः । तस्य॑ व्र॒तानि॑ भूरिपो॒षिणो॑ व॒यमुप॑ भूषेम॒ दम॒ आ सु॑वृ॒क्तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vibhā́-vā ǀ deváḥ ǀ su-ráṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ babhūva ǀ śávasā ǀ sumát-rathaḥ ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ bhūri-poṣíṇaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣema ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The resplendent and adorableAgni, riding in an auspicious chariot, has comprehended the whole earth by his vigour; let us glorify with fit praises the acts of that cherisher of multitudes in his own abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वैश्वा॑नर॒ तव॒ धामा॒न्या च॑के॒ येभि॑: स्व॒र्विदभ॑वो विचक्षण । जा॒त आपृ॑णो॒ भुव॑नानि॒ रोद॑सी॒ अग्न॒ू ता विश्वा॑ परि॒भूर॑सि॒ त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: váiśvānara ǀ táva ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ā́ ǀ cakre ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ svaḥ-vít ǀ ábhavaḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀjātáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ apṛṇaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ágne ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānara, I celebrate your energies, whereby, O sage, you have become omniscient; as soon as born,Agni, you have occupied the realms (of space), and heaven and earth, and have comprehended all these with yourself.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॑ दं॒सना॑भ्यो बृ॒हदरि॑णा॒देक॑: स्वप॒स्यया॑ क॒विः । उ॒भा पि॒तरा॑ म॒हय॑न्नजायता॒ग्निर्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी भूरि॑रेतसा
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarásya ǀ daṃsánābhyaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ áriṇāt ǀ ékaḥ ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ kavíḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ pitárā ǀ maháyan ǀ ajāyata ǀ agníḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ bhū́ri-retasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From acts that are acceptable toVaiśvānaracomes great (wealth); for he, the sage (Agni) alone, bestows (the reward) of zeal in (the performance of) his worship; adoring both his prolific friends, heaven and earth, Agni was born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मित्स॑मित्सु॒मना॑ बोध्य॒स्मे शु॒चाशु॑चा सुम॒तिं रा॑सि॒ वस्व॑: । आ दे॑व दे॒वान्य॒जथा॑य वक्षि॒ सखा॒ सखी॑न्त्सु॒मना॑ यक्ष्यग्ने
shlokas.transliteration: samít-samit ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ asmé íti ǀ śucā́-śucā ǀ su-matím ǀ rāsi ǀ vásvaḥ ǀā́ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ yajáthāya ǀ vakṣi ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhīn ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ agne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeatedly, kindled, (Agni), wake up favourably disposed; (endowed) with reiterated lustre, entertain the kind purpose of (granting us) wealth; bring, divine Agni, the gods to the sacrifice; do you, the friend (of the gods), minister, well-affected, to (your) parents.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं दे॒वास॒स्त्रिरह॑न्ना॒यज॑न्ते दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः । सेमं य॒ज्ञं मधु॑मन्तं कृधी न॒स्तनू॑नपाद्घृ॒तयो॑निं वि॒धन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ áhan ǀ ā-yájante ǀ divé-dive ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ tánū-napāt ǀ ghṛtá-yonim ǀ vidhántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tanūnapāt, whom the deities,Mitra,VaruṇaandAgni, worship daily thrice a day, render this our sacred rain-engendering sacrifice productive of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र दीधि॑तिर्वि॒श्ववा॑रा जिगाति॒ होता॑रमि॒ळः प्र॑थ॒मं यज॑ध्यै । अच्छा॒ नमो॑भिर्वृष॒भं व॒न्दध्यै॒ स दे॒वान्य॑क्षदिषि॒तो यजी॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dī́dhitiḥ ǀ viśvá-vārā ǀ jigāti ǀ hótāram ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ yájadhyai ǀáccha ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ vandádhyai ǀ sáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yakṣat ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yájīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the all-approved praise reach the invoker of the gods; may Iḷā first proceed to worship and to praise with prostrations the showerer (of benefits) in his presence; may the adorable (Agni), instrumental gated (by us), worship the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो वां॑ गा॒तुर॑ध्व॒रे अ॑कार्यू॒र्ध्वा शो॒चींषि॒ प्रस्थि॑ता॒ रजां॑सि । दि॒वो वा॒ नाभा॒ न्य॑सादि॒ होता॑ स्तृणी॒महि॑ दे॒वव्य॑चा॒ वि ब॒र्हिः
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ vām ǀ gātúḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ akāri ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ śocī́ṃṣi ǀ prá-sthitā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀdiváḥ ǀ vā ǀ nā́bhā ǀ ní ǀ asādi ǀ hótā ǀ stṛṇīmáhi ǀ devá-vyacāḥ ǀ ví ǀ barhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “An upward path has been prepared for you both in the sacrifice; the blazing oblations soar aloft; the invoker of the gods has sat down in the centre of the radiant (hall); let us strew the sacred grass for the seats of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त हो॒त्राणि॒ मन॑सा वृणा॒ना इन्व॑न्तो॒ विश्वं॒ प्रति॑ यन्नृ॒तेन॑ । नृ॒पेश॑सो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ प्र जा॒ता अ॒भी॒३॒॑मं य॒ज्ञं वि च॑रन्त पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ hotrā́ṇi ǀ mánasā ǀ vṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ ínvantaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ práti ǀ yan ǀ ṛténa ǀnṛ-péśasaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ prá ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ví ǀ caranta ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods who gratify the universe with rain are present at the seven offerings (of the ministering priests), when solicited with (sincerity of) mind; may the many deities who are engendered in sensible shapes at sacrifices come to this our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भन्द॑माने उ॒षसा॒ उपा॑के उ॒त स्म॑येते त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ विरू॑पे । यथा॑ नो मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो॒ जुजो॑ष॒दिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत्वाँ॑ उ॒त वा॒ महो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhándamāne íti ǀ uṣásau ǀ úpāke íti ǀ utá ǀ smayete íti ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀyáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ jújoṣat ǀ índraḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adored Day and Night, combined or separate, be manifest in bodily form, so thatMitra,Varuṇa,Indra, or (the latter), attended by theMaruts, may rejoice us by their glories.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा न्यृ॑ञ्जे स॒प्त पृ॒क्षास॑: स्व॒धया॑ मदन्ति । ऋ॒तं शंस॑न्त ऋ॒तमित्त आ॑हु॒रनु॑ व्र॒तं व्र॑त॒पा दीध्या॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ní ǀ ṛñje ǀ saptá ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ madanti ǀṛtám ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ té ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I propitiate the two chief divine invokers of the gods; the seven offerers of (sacrificial) food, expectant of water, gratify (Agni) with oblations; the illustrious observers of sacred rites have saluted him in every ceremony as (identifiable), verily, with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भार॑ती॒ भार॑तीभिः स॒जोषा॒ इळा॑ दे॒वैर्म॑नु॒ष्ये॑भिर॒ग्निः । सर॑स्वती सारस्व॒तेभि॑र॒र्वाक्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदं स॑दन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ bhā́ratībhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ deváiḥ ǀ manuṣyébhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀsárasvatī ǀ sārasvatébhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ idám ǀ sadantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBhāratī, associated with theBhāratīs; Iḷā with the gods and men; andAgni, andSarasvatīwith theSārasvatas; may the three goddesses sit down upon the sacred grass (strewn) before them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॑स्तु॒रीप॒मध॑ पोषयि॒त्नु देव॑ त्वष्ट॒र्वि र॑रा॒णः स्य॑स्व । यतो॑ वी॒रः क॑र्म॒ण्य॑: सु॒दक्षो॑ यु॒क्तग्रा॑वा॒ जाय॑ते दे॒वका॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ turī́pam ǀ ádha ǀ poṣayitnú ǀ déva ǀ tvaṣṭaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rarāṇáḥ ǀ syasvéti syasva ǀyátaḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ karmaṇyáḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ yuktá-grāvā ǀ jā́yate ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineTvaṣṭā, being well plural ased, give issue to our procreative vigour, whence (a son), manly, devout, vigorous, wielder of the (Soma-bruising) stone, and reverencing the gods, may be born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॑स्प॒तेऽव॑ सृ॒जोप॑ दे॒वान॒ग्निर्ह॒विः श॑मि॒ता सू॑दयाति । सेदु॒ होता॑ स॒त्यत॑रो यजाति॒ यथा॑ दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मानि॒ वेद॑
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspate ǀ áva ǀ sṛja ǀ úpa ǀ devā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ śamitā́ ǀ sūdayāti ǀsáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hótā ǀ satyá-taraḥ ǀ yajāti ǀ yáthā ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánimāni ǀ véda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, bring the gods nigh; mayAgni, the immolator, prepare the victim; let him who is truth officiate as the ministering priest, for, verily, he knows the birth of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ह्यग्ने समिधा॒नो अ॒र्वाङिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैः स॒रथं॑ तु॒रेभि॑: । ब॒र्हिर्न॑ आस्ता॒मदि॑तिः सुपु॒त्रा स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृता॑ मादयन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ índreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ turébhiḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ āstām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ su-putrā́ ǀ svā́hā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, kindled into flame, come to our presence in the same chariot withIndraand with the swift-moving gods; mayAditi, the mother of excellent sons, sit down on the sacred grass, and may the immortal gods be satisfied with the reverentially-offered oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॒ग्निरु॒षस॒श्चेकि॑ता॒नोऽबो॑धि॒ विप्र॑: पद॒वीः क॑वी॒नाम् । पृ॒थु॒पाजा॑ देव॒यद्भि॒: समि॒द्धोऽप॒ द्वारा॒ तम॑सो॒ वह्नि॑रावः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ agníḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ cékitānaḥ ǀ ábodhi ǀ vípraḥ ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀpṛthu-pā́jāḥ ǀ devayát-bhiḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvā́rā ǀ támasaḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sagaciousAgni, cognizant of the dawn, is awakened to (follow) the paths of the sages; the luminousVahni, kindled by the devout, has thrown open the gates of darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेद्व॒ग्निर्वा॑वृधे॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्गी॒र्भिः स्तो॑तॄ॒णां न॑म॒स्य॑ उ॒क्थैः । पू॒र्वीॠ॒तस्य॑ सं॒दृश॑श्चका॒नः सं दू॒तो अ॑द्यौदु॒षसो॑ विरो॒के
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ agníḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ stotṝṇā́m ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sam-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ sám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ adyaut ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-roké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableAgniis magnified by the hymns, the prayers, the praises, of (his) worshippers; emulating the many glories of the sun, the messenger (of the gods) shines forth at the glimmering of the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑य्य॒ग्निर्मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्ष्व१॒॑पां गर्भो॑ मि॒त्र ऋ॒तेन॒ साध॑न् । आ ह॑र्य॒तो य॑ज॒तः सान्व॑स्था॒दभू॑दु॒ विप्रो॒ हव्यो॑ मती॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhāyi ǀ agníḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ sā́dhan ǀā́ ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ sā́nu ǀ asthāt ǀ ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vípraḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the embryo of the waters, the friend (of the pious), accomplishing (all desires) with truth, has been plural ced (by the gods) among men, the descendants ofManu; desirable and adorable, he has taken his station on high, where the wise Agni is to receive the oblations of the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निर्भ॑वति॒ यत्समि॑द्धो मि॒त्रो होता॒ वरु॑णो जा॒तवे॑दाः । मि॒त्रो अ॑ध्व॒र्युरि॑षि॒रो दमू॑ना मि॒त्रः सिन्धू॑नामु॒त पर्व॑तानाम्
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ utá ǀ párvatānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, when kindled, isMitra; and, as Mitra, is the invoker (of the gods);VaruṇaisJātavedas; Mitra is the ministering priest; Damunas is the agitator (Vāyu); Mitra (is the associate) of rivers and mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पाति॑ प्रि॒यं रि॒पो अग्रं॑ प॒दं वेः पाति॑ य॒ह्वश्चर॑णं॒ सूर्य॑स्य । पाति॒ नाभा॑ स॒प्तशी॑र्षाणम॒ग्निः पाति॑ दे॒वाना॑मुप॒माद॑मृ॒ष्वः
shlokas.transliteration: pā́ti ǀ priyám ǀ ripáḥ ǀ ágram ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ yahváḥ ǀ cáraṇam ǀ sū́ryasya ǀpā́ti ǀ nā́bhā ǀ saptá-śīrṣāṇam ǀ agníḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ devā́nām ǀ upa-mā́dam ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The graceful (Agni) protects the primary station of the moving earth; mighty, he protects the path of the sun; he protects the seven-headed (troop of theMaruts) in the centre between heaven and earth; he protects the exhilarating (oblations) of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुश्च॑क्र॒ ईड्यं॒ चारु॒ नाम॒ विश्वा॑नि दे॒वो व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् । स॒सस्य॒ चर्म॑ घृ॒तव॑त्प॒दं वेस्तदिद॒ग्नी र॑क्ष॒त्यप्र॑युच्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ cakre ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀ víśvāni ǀ deváḥ ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀsasásya ǀ cárma ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ rakṣati ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty, divineAgniknowing all (things) that are to be known, made the commendable and beautiful water, the glossy skin, the station of the diffused slumbering (Agni), and, ever vigilant preserves it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ योनि॑म॒ग्निर्घृ॒तव॑न्तमस्थात्पृ॒थुप्र॑गाणमु॒शन्त॑मुशा॒नः । दीद्या॑न॒: शुचि॑ॠ॒ष्वः पा॑व॒कः पुन॑:पुनर्मा॒तरा॒ नव्य॑सी कः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yónim ǀ agníḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ asthāt ǀ pṛthú-pragānam ǀ uśántam ǀ uśānáḥ ǀdī́dyānaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ púnaḥ-punaḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ návyasī íti ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnihas taken his station in an asylum, brilliant, much-lauded, and as desirous (of receiving him) as he is (torepair to it); radiant, pure, vast and purifying, he repeatedly renovates his parents, (Heaven and Earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यो जा॒त ओष॑धीभिर्ववक्षे॒ यदी॒ वर्ध॑न्ति प्र॒स्वो॑ घृ॒तेन॑ । आप॑ इव प्र॒वता॒ शुम्भ॑माना उरु॒ष्यद॒ग्निः पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ vavakṣe ǀ yádi ǀ várdhanti ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀā́paḥ-iva ǀ pra-vátā ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǀ uruṣyát ǀ agníḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as genitive rated he is borne aloft by the plural nts, which grow flourishing by moisture, as the beautifying waters descend; may he, in the bosom of his parents, protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑ ष्टु॒तः स॒मिधा॑ य॒ह्वो अ॑द्यौ॒द्वर्ष्म॑न्दि॒वो अधि॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्याः । मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निरीड्यो॑ मात॒रिश्वा दू॒तो व॑क्षद्य॒जथा॑य दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stutáḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ yahváḥ ǀ adyaut ǀ várṣman ǀ diváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ ā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ vakṣat ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised and (nourished) by fuel, the mightyAgni, stationed on the (altar the) navel of the earth, in the form of the firmament, has shone (brightly); may the friendly and adorable Agni who respires in the mid-heaven, the messenger (of the gods), bring them to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑स्तम्भीत्स॒मिधा॒ नाक॑मृ॒ष्वो॒३॒॑ऽग्निर्भव॑न्नुत्त॒मो रो॑च॒नाना॑म् । यदी॒ भृगु॑भ्य॒: परि॑ मात॒रिश्वा॒ गुहा॒ सन्तं॑ हव्य॒वाहं॑ समी॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ astambhīt ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ nā́kam ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhávan ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǀ rocanā́nām ǀyádi ǀ bhṛ́gu-bhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ gúhā ǀ sántam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ sam-īdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightyAgni, being the best of the heavenly luminaries, sustained the heaven with radiance, when the wind kindled the bearer of oblations, (till then concealed) in a cave from theBhṛgus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र का॑रवो मन॒ना व॒च्यमा॑ना देव॒द्रीचीं॑ नयत देव॒यन्त॑: । द॒क्षि॒णा॒वाड्वा॒जिनी॒ प्राच्ये॑ति ह॒विर्भर॑न्त्य॒ग्नये॑ घृ॒ताची॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kāravaḥ ǀ mananā́ ǀ vacyámānāḥ ǀ devadrī́cīn ǀ nayata ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀdakṣiṇā-vā́ṭ ǀ vājínī ǀ prā́cī ǀ eti ǀ havíḥ ǀ bhárantī ǀ agnáye ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devout ministrants, who are to be inspired by prayer, bring forth (the ladle) destined for the worship of the gods, which is to be conveyed to the south (of the fire-altar), and which, charged with (sacrificial) food, pointed to the east, containing the oblation, and, filled with liquefied butter, proceeds toAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ जाय॑मान उ॒त प्र रि॑क्था॒ अध॒ नु प्र॑यज्यो । दि॒वश्चि॑दग्ने महि॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्या व॒च्यन्तां॑ ते॒ वह्न॑यः स॒प्तजि॑ह्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá ǀ rikthāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ nú ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀdeváḥ ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ vacyántām ǀ te ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ saptá-jihvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, as soon as born, occupy both heaven and earth; for you, to whom sacrifice is to be offered, exceed in magnitude the firmament and the earth; may your seven-tongued fires be glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यौश्च॑ त्वा पृथि॒वी य॒ज्ञिया॑सो॒ नि होता॑रं सादयन्त॒ि दमा॑य । यदी॒ विशो॒ मानु॑षीर्देव॒यन्ती॒: प्रय॑स्वती॒रीळ॑ते शु॒क्रम॒र्चिः
shlokas.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ hótāram ǀ sādayante ǀ dámāya ǀyádi ǀ víśaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ práyasvatīḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ śukrám ǀ arcíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The firmament and the earth and the adorable (gods) propitiate you their invoker, for the (completion of the) sacrifice, whenever the descendants ofManu, pious, and bearing oblations, glorify your radiant flame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हान्त्स॒धस्थे॑ ध्रु॒व आ निष॑त्तो॒ऽन्तर्द्यावा॒ माहि॑ने॒ हर्य॑माणः । आस्क्रे॑ स॒पत्नी॑ अ॒जरे॒ अमृ॑क्ते सब॒र्दुघे॑ उरुगा॒यस्य॑ धे॒नू
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ dyā́vā ǀ mā́hine íti ǀ háryamāṇaḥ ǀā́skre íti ǀ sapátnī íti sa-pátnī ǀ ajáre íti ǀ ámṛkte íti ǀ sabardúghe íti sabaḥ-dúghe ǀ uru-gāyásya ǀ dhenū́ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great and adorableAgniis firm seated on his spacious throne between heaven and earth; and the powerful fellow-brides (of the sun), the imperishable uninjurable (heaven and earth) are the two milk-yielding cows of the wide-extending (Agni).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्र॒ता ते॑ अग्ने मह॒तो म॒हानि॒ तव॒ क्रत्वा॒ रोद॑सी॒ आ त॑तन्थ । त्वं दू॒तो अ॑भवो॒ जाय॑मान॒स्त्वं ने॒ता वृ॑षभ चर्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vratā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀtvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ netā́ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great,Agni, are the deeds of you the mighty one; you have spread abroad by your power the heaven and earth; you have been the messenger (of the gods); as soon as begotten you have become the leader of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ वा के॒शिना॑ यो॒ग्याभि॑र्घृत॒स्नुवा॒ रोहि॑ता धु॒रि धि॑ष्व । अथा व॑ह दे॒वान्दे॑व॒ विश्वा॑न्त्स्वध्व॒रा कृ॑णुहि जातवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ vā ǀ keśínā ǀ yogyā́bhiḥ ǀ ghṛta-snúvā ǀ róhitā ǀ dhurí ǀ dhiṣva ǀátha ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devā́n ǀ deva ǀ víśvān ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harness with traces, to your car, your long-maned, ruddy (steeds, to come) to the sacrifice; bring hither, divineJātavedas, all the gods, and make them propitious to the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॒दा ते॑ रुचयन्त रो॒का उ॒षो वि॑भा॒तीरनु॑ भासि पू॒र्वीः । अ॒पो यद॑ग्न उ॒शध॒ग्वने॑षु॒ होतु॑र्म॒न्द्रस्य॑ प॒नय॑न्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ rucayanta ǀ rokā́ḥ ǀ uṣáḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ bhāsi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ uśádhak ǀ váneṣu ǀ hótuḥ ǀ mandrásya ǀ panáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Agni, you abide in the woods, consuming the waters at your plural asure, then your rays illuminate the heavens, and you shine like many former radiant dawns; the gods themselves commend (the brilliancy) of their praise-meriting invoker.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रौ वा॒ ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ मद॑न्ति दि॒वो वा॒ ये रो॑च॒ने सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः । ऊमा॑ वा॒ ये सु॒हवा॑सो॒ यज॑त्रा आयेमि॒रे र॒थ्यो॑ अग्ने॒ अश्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: uráu ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ antárikṣe ǀ mádanti ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ rocané ǀ sánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀū́māḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ su-hávāsaḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ ā-yemiré ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ agne ǀ áśvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The deities who sport in the spacious (firmament); those who are in the luminous sphere of heaven; the adorable Umas, who come when worthily invoked; the horses,Agni, that are fit for your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐभि॑रग्ने स॒रथं॑ याह्य॒र्वाङ्ना॑नार॒थं वा॑ वि॒भवो॒ ह्यश्वा॑: । पत्नी॑वतस्त्रिं॒शतं॒ त्रीँश्च॑ दे॒वान॑नुष्व॒धमा व॑ह मा॒दय॑स्व
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ nānā-rathám ǀ vā ǀ vi-bhávaḥ ǀ hí ǀ áśvāḥ ǀpátnī-vataḥ ǀ triṃśátam ǀ trī́n ǀ ca ǀ devā́n ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ mādáyasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With all these in one chariot,Agni, or in many (chariots), come to our presence, for your horses are able; bring the three and thirty divinities with their wives, for the sake of (the sacrificial) food, and exhilarate them (all with theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स होता॒ यस्य॒ रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी य॒ज्ञंय॑ज्ञम॒भि वृ॒धे गृ॑णी॒तः । प्राची॑ अध्व॒रेव॑ तस्थतुः सु॒मेके॑ ऋ॒ताव॑री ऋ॒तजा॑तस्य स॒त्ये
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ yajñám-yajñam ǀ abhí ǀ vṛdhé ǀ gṛṇītáḥ ǀprā́cī íti ǀ adhvarā́-iva ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ ṛtávarī ítyṛtá-varī ǀ ṛtá-jātasya ǀ satyé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the invoker (of the gods), whom the spacious heaven and earth glorify, for the sake of increase, at repeated sacrifices; charged with water, they await like holy rites, propitious to the real presence of him who is born of truth. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may our good-will ever be upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र य आ॒रुः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठस्य॑ धा॒सेरा मा॒तरा॑ विविशुः स॒प्त वाणी॑: । प॒रि॒क्षिता॑ पि॒तरा॒ सं च॑रेते॒ प्र स॑र्स्राते दी॒र्घमायु॑: प्र॒यक्षे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ ārúḥ ǀ śiti-pṛṣṭhásya ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ viviśuḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀpari-kṣítā ǀ pitárā ǀ sám ǀ carete íti ǀ prá ǀ sarsrāte íti ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-yákṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (rays) of the blackbacked, all-sustaining (Agni) have arisen, and pervaded the parents (earth and heaven) and the flowing rivers; the surrounding parents co-operate with him, and bestow long life for the sake of assiduous worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वक्ष॑सो धे॒नवो॒ वृष्णो॒ अश्वा॑ दे॒वीरा त॑स्थौ॒ मधु॑म॒द्वह॑न्तीः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ त्वा॒ सद॑सि क्षेम॒यन्तं॒ पर्येका॑ चरति वर्त॒निं गौः
shlokas.transliteration: divákṣasaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthau ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ váhantīḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ tvā ǀ sádasi ǀ kṣema-yántam ǀ pári ǀ ékā ǀ carati ǀ vartaním ǀ gáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sky-traversing steeds of the showerer (of benefits) are the kine (ofAgni); as he attains the divine (rivers), bearers of sweet (water). One sacred soudn glorifies you (Agni), who are desirous of repose, pacifying your flames) in the abode of the water (the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सी॑मरोहत्सु॒यमा॒ भव॑न्ती॒: पति॑श्चिकि॒त्वान्र॑यि॒विद्र॑यी॒णाम् । प्र नील॑पृष्ठो अत॒सस्य॑ धा॒सेस्ता अ॑वासयत्पुरु॒धप्र॑तीकः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sīm ǀ arohat ǀ su-yámāḥ ǀ bhávantīḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ rayi-vít ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀprá ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭhaḥ ǀ atasásya ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ avāsayat ǀ purudhá-pratīkaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Their lord has mounted on his well-trained mares the sagacious selector of treasures, the blackbacked, many-limbed (Agni) has granted them a plural ce of rest for the cherishing of (their) rapid speed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑ त्वा॒ष्ट्रमू॒र्जय॑न्तीरजु॒र्यं स्त॑भू॒यमा॑नं व॒हतो॑ वहन्ति । व्यङ्गे॑भिर्दिद्युता॒नः स॒धस्थ॒ एका॑मिव॒ रोद॑सी॒ आ वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ tvāṣṭrám ǀ ūrjáyantīḥ ǀ ajuryám ǀ stabhu-yámānam ǀ vahátaḥ ǀ vahanti ǀví ǀ áṅgebhiḥ ǀ didyutānáḥ ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ékām-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flowing (rivers) invigorating him, bear along the great son ofTvaṣṭā, the undecaying upholder (of the world), radiant with various forms in the vicinity (of the firmament);Agniis associated with heaven and earth, as (a husband with) one only wife.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒नन्ति॒ वृष्णो॑ अरु॒षस्य॒ शेव॑मु॒त ब्र॒ध्नस्य॒ शास॑ने रणन्ति । दि॒वो॒रुच॑: सु॒रुचो॒ रोच॑माना॒ इळा॒ येषां॒ गण्या॒ माहि॑ना॒ गीः
shlokas.transliteration: jānánti ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ aruṣásya ǀ śévam ǀ utá ǀ bradhnásya ǀ śā́sane ǀ raṇanti ǀdivaḥ-rúcaḥ ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ rócamānāḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ yéṣām ǀ gáṇyā ǀ mā́hinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men comprehend the service of the uninjurable showerer (of benefits), and exult in the commands of the mighty (Agni); their frequent and earnest hymns of praise, bright and radiant, are illuminating heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो पि॒तृभ्यां॑ प्र॒विदानु॒ घोषं॑ म॒हो म॒हद्भ्या॑मनयन्त शू॒षम् । उ॒क्षा ह॒ यत्र॒ परि॒ धान॑म॒क्तोरनु॒ स्वं धाम॑ जरि॒तुर्व॒वक्ष॑
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ pitṛ́-bhyām ǀ pra-vídā ǀ ánu ǀ ghóṣam ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahát-bhyām ǀ anayanta ǀ śūṣám ǀukṣā́ ǀ ha ǀ yátra ǀ pári ǀ dhā́nam ǀ aktóḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svám ǀ dhā́ma ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ vavákṣa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily (men) bring great delight toAgniby glorifying aloud the mighty parents (heaven and earth), when the shedder of rain approximates his own radiance to the worshipper, (wherewith) to invest the night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ध्व॒र्युभि॑: प॒ञ्चभि॑: स॒प्त विप्रा॑: प्रि॒यं र॑क्षन्ते॒ निहि॑तं प॒दं वेः । प्राञ्चो॑ मदन्त्यु॒क्षणो॑ अजु॒र्या दे॒वा दे॒वाना॒मनु॒ हि व्र॒ता गुः
shlokas.transliteration: adhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ pañcá-bhiḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāḥ ǀ priyám ǀ rakṣante ǀ ní-hitam ǀ padám ǀ véríti véḥ ǀprā́ñcaḥ ǀ madanti ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ ajuryā́ḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ánu ǀ hí ǀ vratā́ ǀ gúríti gúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seven sages with five ministering priests attend the station that is prepared for the rapid (Agni); the undecaying divine (sages), with their faces to the east, sprinkling (the libations), rejoice as they celebrate the worship of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा न्यृ॑ञ्जे स॒प्त पृ॒क्षास॑: स्व॒धया॑ मदन्ति । ऋ॒तं शंस॑न्त ऋ॒तमित्त आ॑हु॒रनु॑ व्र॒तं व्र॑त॒पा दीध्या॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ní ǀ ṛñje ǀ saptá ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ madanti ǀṛtám ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ té ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I propitiate the two first divine offerers of sacrifices; the seven (priests) rejoice with the libation; the illustrious celebrators of holy worship, reciting (his) praises, have calledAgnithe true (object) of every rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒षा॒यन्ते॑ म॒हे अत्या॑य पू॒र्वीर्वृष्णे॑ चि॒त्राय॑ र॒श्मय॑: सुया॒माः । देव॑ होतर्म॒न्द्रत॑रश्चिकि॒त्वान्म॒हो दे॒वान्रोद॑सी॒ एह व॑क्षि
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣa-yánte ǀ mahé ǀ átyāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ citrā́ya ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ su-yāmā́ḥ ǀdéva ǀ hotaḥ ǀ mandrá-taraḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ maháḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine invoker of the gods, the vast and widespreading rays shed (moisture) for you, the mighty, the victorius, the wonderful, the showerer (of benefits); do you who are all knowing, joy-bestowing, bring hither the great gods, and heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒क्षप्र॑यजो द्रविणः सु॒वाच॑: सुके॒तव॑ उ॒षसो॑ रे॒वदू॑षुः । उ॒तो चि॑दग्ने महि॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्याः कृ॒तं चि॒देन॒: सं म॒हे द॑शस्य
shlokas.transliteration: pṛkṣá-prayajaḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ ǀ su-vā́caḥ ǀ su-ketávaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ revát ǀ ūṣuḥ ǀutó íti ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ énaḥ ǀ sám ǀ mahé ǀ daśasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ever-moving (Agni) may the mornings rise for us, abounding with oblations, with pious prayers, and with auspicious signs, and conferring wealth; and do you with the might of your (diffusive flame), consume all sin on behalf of your respectable (worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your good-will ever be upon us (productive of benefit to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ञ्जन्ति॒ त्वाम॑ध्व॒रे दे॑व॒यन्तो॒ वन॑स्पते॒ मधु॑ना॒ दैव्ये॑न । यदू॒र्ध्वस्तिष्ठा॒ द्रवि॑णे॒ह ध॑त्ता॒द्यद्वा॒ क्षयो॑ मा॒तुर॒स्या उ॒पस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: añjánti ǀ tvā́m ǀ adhvaré ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ vánaspate ǀ mádhunā ǀ dáivyena ǀyát ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ tíṣṭhāḥ ǀ dráviṇā ǀ ihá ǀ dhattāt ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ mātúḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, the devout anoint you with sacred butter at the sacrifice; and whether you stand erect, or your abode be on the lap of this your mother (earth), grant us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धस्य॒ श्रय॑माणः पु॒रस्ता॒द्ब्रह्म॑ वन्वा॒नो अ॒जरं॑ सु॒वीर॑म् । आ॒रे अ॒स्मदम॑तिं॒ बाध॑मान॒ उच्छ्र॑यस्व मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhasya ǀ śráyamāṇaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ bráhma ǀ vanvānáḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ su-vī́ram ǀāré ǀ asmát ǀ ámatim ǀ bā́dhamānaḥ ǀ út ǀ śrayasva ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Standing on the east of the kindled (fire), dispensing food (as the source) of undecaying (health) and excellent progeny, keeping off our enemy at a distance, stand up for great auspiciousness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उच्छ्र॑यस्व वनस्पते॒ वर्ष्म॑न्पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ । सुमि॑ती मी॒यमा॑नो॒ वर्चो॑ धा य॒ज्ञवा॑हसे
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ śrayasva ǀ vanaspate ǀ várṣman ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀsú-mitī ǀ mīyámānaḥ ǀ várcaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be exalted,Vanaspatiupon this sacred spot of earth, being measured with careful measurement, and bestow food upon the offerer of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युवा॑ सु॒वासा॒: परि॑वीत॒ आगा॒त्स उ॒ श्रेया॑न्भवति॒ जाय॑मानः । तं धीरा॑सः क॒वय॒ उन्न॑यन्ति स्वा॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ मन॑सा देव॒यन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yúvā ǀ su-vā́sāḥ ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śréyān ǀ bhavati ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀtám ǀ dhī́rāsaḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ út ǀ nayanti ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well clad and hung with wreaths comes the youthful (pillar); most excellent it is as soon as genitive rated; steadfast and wise venerators of the gods, meditating piously in thei rminds, raise it up.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒तो जा॑यते सुदिन॒त्वे अह्नां॑ सम॒र्य आ वि॒दथे॒ वर्ध॑मानः । पु॒नन्ति॒ धीरा॑ अ॒पसो॑ मनी॒षा दे॑व॒या विप्र॒ उदि॑यर्ति॒ वाच॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: jātáḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀ sa-maryé ǀ ā́ ǀ vidáthe ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǀpunánti ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ vā́cam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Born (in the forest), and beautified in the sacrifice celebrated by men, it is (again) engendered for the sanctification of the days (of sacred rites); steadfast, active and intelligent (priests) consecrate it with intelligence, and the devout worshipper recites its praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यान्वो॒ नरो॑ देव॒यन्तो॑ निमि॒म्युर्वन॑स्पते॒ स्वधि॑तिर्वा त॒तक्ष॑ । ते दे॒वास॒: स्वर॑वस्तस्थि॒वांस॑: प्र॒जाव॑द॒स्मे दि॑धिषन्तु॒ रत्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́n ǀ vaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ ni-mimyúḥ ǀ vánaspate ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ vā ǀ tatákṣa ǀté ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ asmé íti ǀ didhiṣantu ǀ rátnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those (posts) which devout men have cut down, or which,Vanaspati, the axe has trimmed, may they standing resplendent with all their parts (entire) bestow upon us wealth with progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये वृ॒क्णासो॒ अधि॒ क्षमि॒ निमि॑तासो य॒तस्रु॑चः । ते नो॑ व्यन्तु॒ वार्यं॑ देव॒त्रा क्षे॑त्र॒साध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ vṛkṇā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀ ní-mitāsaḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ vyantu ǀ vā́ryam ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ kṣetra-sā́dhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thosepostswhich have been cut down upon the earth, and which have been fabricated by the priests, those which are the accomplishers of the sacrifice, convey our acceptable (offering) to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वः सुनी॒था द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स॒जोष॑सो य॒ज्ञम॑वन्तु दे॒वा ऊ॒र्ध्वं कृ॑ण्वन्त्वध्व॒रस्य॑ के॒तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ su-nīthā́ḥ ǀ dyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ antárikṣam ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ avantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ūrdhvám ǀ kṛṇvantu ǀ adhvarásya ǀ ketúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the leaders of the rite, the divineĀdityas,Rudras,Vasus, Heaven and Earth, the Earth, the firmament, well plural ased, protect our sacrifice; let them raise aloft the standard of the ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हं॒सा इ॑व श्रेणि॒शो यता॑नाः शु॒क्रा वसा॑ना॒: स्वर॑वो न॒ आगु॑: । उ॒न्नी॒यमा॑नाः क॒विभि॑: पु॒रस्ता॑द्दे॒वा दे॒वाना॒मपि॑ यन्ति॒ पाथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: haṃsā́ḥ-iva ǀ śreṇi-śáḥ ǀ yátānāḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀut-nīyámānāḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ yanti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arrayed in bright (garments), entire (in their parts), these pillars ranging in rows like swans, have come to us erected by pious sages on the east( of the fire); they proceed resplendent on the path of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृङ्गा॑णी॒वेच्छृ॒ङ्गिणां॒ सं द॑दृश्रे च॒षाल॑वन्त॒: स्वर॑वः पृथि॒व्याम् । वा॒घद्भि॑र्वा विह॒वे श्रोष॑माणा अ॒स्माँ अ॑वन्तु पृत॒नाज्ये॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: śṛ́ṅgāṇi-iva ǀ ít ǀ śṛṅgíṇām ǀ sám ǀ dadṛśre ǀ caṣā́la-vantaḥ ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀvāghát-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ vi-havé ǀ śróṣamāṇāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ pṛtanā́jyeṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Entire in all parts and girded with rings, they appear upon the earth like the horns of horned cattle; hearing (their praises) by the priests; may they protect us in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॑स्पते श॒तव॑ल्शो॒ वि रो॑ह स॒हस्र॑वल्शा॒ वि व॒यं रु॑हेम । यं त्वाम॒यं स्वधि॑ति॒स्तेज॑मानः प्रणि॒नाय॑ मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspate ǀ śatá-valśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ roha ǀ sahásra-valśāḥ ǀ ví ǀ vayám ǀ ruhema ǀyám ǀ tvā́m ǀ ayám ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ téjamānaḥ ǀ pra-ninā́ya ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, mount upwith a hundred branches, that we may mount with a thousand, you whom the sharpened hatchet has brought for great auspiciousness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑यस्त्वा ववृमहे दे॒वं मर्ता॑स ऊ॒तये॑ । अ॒पां नपा॑तं सु॒भगं॑ सु॒दीदि॑तिं सु॒प्रतू॑र्तिमने॒हस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vavṛmahe ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀapā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ su-bhágam ǀ su-dī́ditim ǀ su-prátūrtim ǀ anehásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, your mortal friends have recourse for our protection to you, the divine, the grandson of the waters, the auspicious, the resplendent, the accessible, the sinless.”

shlokas.sanskrit: काय॑मानो व॒ना त्वं यन्मा॒तॄरज॑गन्न॒पः । न तत्ते॑ अग्ने प्र॒मृषे॑ नि॒वर्त॑नं॒ यद्दू॒रे सन्नि॒हाभ॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: kā́yamānaḥ ǀ vanā́ ǀ tvám ǀ yát ǀ mātṝ́ḥ ǀ ájagan ǀ apáḥ ǀná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ pra-mṛ́ṣe ǀ ni-vártanam ǀ yát ǀ dūré ǀ sán ǀ ihá ǀ ábhavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous as you are of the forests since you have repaired to the maternal waters,Agni, your tarrying so far away is not to be endured; (in a moment) you are here with us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ तृ॒ष्टं व॑वक्षि॒थाथै॒व सु॒मना॑ असि । प्रप्रा॒न्ये यन्ति॒ पर्य॒न्य आ॑सते॒ येषां॑ स॒ख्ये असि॑ श्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ tṛṣṭám ǀ vavakṣitha ǀ átha ǀ evá ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ asi ǀprá-pra ǀ anyé ǀ yánti ǀ pári ǀ anyé ǀ āsate ǀ yéṣām ǀ sakhyé ǀ ási ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You wish exceedingly to convey satisfaction (to your worshippers) and are thereto well-disposed; of those in whose friendship you are cherished, some precede while others sit around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒यि॒वांस॒मति॒ स्रिध॒: शश्व॑ती॒रति॑ स॒श्चत॑: । अन्वी॑मविन्दन्निचि॒रासो॑ अ॒द्रुहो॒ऽप्सु सिं॒हमि॑व श्रि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: īyi-vā́ṃsam ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ śáśvatīḥ ǀ áti ǀ saścátaḥ ǀánu ǀ īm ǀ avindan ǀ ni-cirā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ siṃhám-iva ǀ śritám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The benignant and long-lived deities have discovered you,Agni, when required to go against their constant and assembled foes, hidden in the waters like a lion (in a cave).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒सृ॒वांस॑मिव॒ त्मना॒ग्निमि॒त्था ति॒रोहि॑तम् । ऐनं॑ नयन्मात॒रिश्वा॑ परा॒वतो॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ मथि॒तं परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sasṛvā́ṃsam-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ agním ǀ itthā́ ǀ tiráḥ-hitam ǀā́ ǀ enam ǀ nayat ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mathitám ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mātariśvantherefore brought for the gods from afar,Agni, hiding of himself, and genitive rated by attrition, as (a father brings back) a fugitive (son).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ मर्ता॑ अगृभ्णत दे॒वेभ्यो॑ हव्यवाहन । विश्वा॒न्यद्य॒ज्ञाँ अ॑भि॒पासि॑ मानुष॒ तव॒ क्रत्वा॑ यविष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ mártāḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vāhana ǀvíśvān ǀ yát ǀ yajñā́n ǀ abhi-pā́si ǀ mānuṣa ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of oblations,men apprehend you (thus concealed) for the service of the gods, and that you youngest (of the deities) and friendly to manking, may recompense by your acts all their pious rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्भ॒द्रं तव॑ दं॒सना॒ पाका॑य चिच्छदयति । त्वां यद॑ग्ने प॒शव॑: स॒मास॑ते॒ समि॑द्धमपिशर्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ bhadrám ǀ táva ǀ daṃsánā ǀ pā́kāya ǀ cit ǀ chadayati ǀtvā́m ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ paśávaḥ ǀ sam-ā́sate ǀ sám-iddham ǀ api-śarvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Auspicious is your worship for it prospers the ignorant (worshipper), wherefore animals reverence, youAgni, kindled in the beginning of the night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जु॑होता स्वध्व॒रं शी॒रं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषम् । आ॒शुं दू॒तम॑जि॒रं प्र॒त्नमीड्यं॑ श्रु॒ष्टी दे॒वं स॑पर्यत
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ juhota ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀāśúm ǀ dūtám ǀ ajirám ǀ pratnám ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ devám ǀ saparyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer oblations to the object of holy sacrifice, the brilliant purifier, who is dormant (in fuel); worship quietly the pervader (of the rite), the messenger (of the gods), the rapid, the ancient deity who is entitled to laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ श॒ता त्री स॒हस्रा॑ण्य॒ग्निं त्रिं॒शच्च॑ दे॒वा नव॑ चासपर्यन् । औक्ष॑न्घृ॒तैरस्तृ॑णन्ब॒र्हिर॑स्मा॒ आदिद्धोता॑रं॒ न्य॑सादयन्त
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ trī́ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ agním ǀ triṃśát ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ náva ǀ ca ǀ asaparyan ǀáukṣan ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ ástṛṇan ǀ barhíḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ hótāram ǀ ní ǀ asādayanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three thousand three hundred and thirty-nine divinities have worshippedAgni; they have sprinkled him with melted butter; they have spread for him the sacred grass; and have seated him upon it as their ministrant priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने मनी॒षिण॑: स॒म्राजं॑ चर्षणी॒नाम् । दे॒वं मर्ता॑स इन्धते॒ सम॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀdevám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ indhate ǀ sám ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the king of men;Agni, the divine; prudent mortals kindle you at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां य॒ज्ञेष्वृ॒त्विज॒मग्ने॒ होता॑रमीळते । गो॒पा ऋ॒तस्य॑ दीदिहि॒ स्वे दमे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ ágne ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǀgopā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dīdihi ǀ své ǀ dáme ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They praise you as the priest, the invoker (of the gods) at sacrifice; shine forth the protector of the pious rite in your own abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॒ यस्ते॒ ददा॑शति स॒मिधा॑ जा॒तवे॑दसे । सो अ॑ग्ने धत्ते सु॒वीर्यं॒ स पु॑ष्यति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ dádāśati ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ jātá-vedase ǀsáḥ ǀ agne ǀ dhatte ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ sáḥ ǀ puṣyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily who presents oblations to you, the knower of all things, he acquires (Agni) excellent progeny; he prospers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स के॒तुर॑ध्व॒राणा॑म॒ग्निर्दे॒वेभि॒रा ग॑मत् । अ॒ञ्जा॒नः स॒प्त होतृ॑भिर्ह॒विष्म॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ agníḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀañjānáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ hótṛ-bhiḥ ǀ havíṣmate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (Agni), the banner (flag) of sacrifices, offering oblations on the part of the worshiper through (the ministry of) the seven offering priests, come hither with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र होत्रे॑ पू॒र्व्यं वचो॒ऽग्नये॑ भरता बृ॒हत् । वि॒पां ज्योतीं॑षि॒ बिभ्र॑ते॒ न वे॒धसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hótre ǀ pūrvyám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ bharata ǀ bṛhát ǀvipā́m ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ bíbhrate ǀ ná ǀ vedháse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer to the ministeringAgnias if to the Creator (of the world), the great praise recited of old, for the sake of animating the energies of the pious (worshipper). ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं व॑र्धन्तु नो॒ गिरो॒ यतो॒ जाय॑त उ॒क्थ्य॑: । म॒हे वाजा॑य॒ द्रवि॑णाय दर्श॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ jā́yate ǀ ukthyáḥ ǀmahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ dráviṇāya ǀ darśatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May ourhymns exaltAgni, so that he may be born more worthy of praise, and may become manifest for the purpose of (bestowing) abundant food and riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रे दे॒वान्दे॑वय॒ते य॑ज । होता॑ म॒न्द्रो वि रा॑ज॒स्यति॒ स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ devā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǀhótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you are to be especially worshipped at the sacrifice; worship the gods (on behalf of) the devout (worshiper); you shine the invoker (of the gods) the exhilarator (of the pious) overcoming your foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पावक दीदिहि द्यु॒मद॒स्मे सु॒वीर्य॑म् । भवा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ अन्त॑मः स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdihi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀbháva ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, our purifier, light up for us a brilliant progeny; be ever nigh to those who praise you for their well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ विप्रा॑ विप॒न्यवो॑ जागृ॒वांस॒: समि॑न्धते । ह॒व्य॒वाह॒मम॑र्त्यं सहो॒वृध॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ sám ǀ indhate ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ámartyam ǀ sahaḥ-vṛ́dham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise, intelligent, and vigilant (worshipers) kindle you, such as you (have been described), the bearer of oblations, the immortal, genitive rated by strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ पु॒रोहि॑तोऽध्व॒रस्य॒ विच॑र्षणिः । स वे॑द य॒ज्ञमा॑नु॒षक्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ veda ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the invoker of the gods, the minister (of the gods), the supervisor of the sacrifice, understands the solemn rite in its due course.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ह॑व्य॒वाळम॑र्त्य उ॒शिग्दू॒तश्चनो॑हितः । अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या समृ॑ण्वति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ uśík ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sám ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatAgni, who is the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the desirer (of offerings), the messenger (of the gods), and is the receiver of sacrificial viands, is associated with understanding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या स चे॑तति के॒तुर्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ पू॒र्व्यः । अर्थं॒ ह्य॑स्य त॒रणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ cetati ǀ ketúḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀártham ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ taráṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the ancient banner (flag) of sacrifice, knows (all things) through understanding; his radiance traverses (the darkness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं सू॒नुं सन॑श्रुतं॒ सह॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसम् । वह्निं॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वत
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ sūnúm ǀ sána-śrutam ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀváhnim ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have madeAgni, who is the son of strength, the eternally-renowned, the knower of all that is born, the bearer (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदा॑भ्यः पुरए॒ता वि॒शाम॒ग्निर्मानु॑षीणाम् । तूर्णी॒ रथ॒: सदा॒ नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádābhyaḥ ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ viśā́m ǀ agníḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀtū́rṇiḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ návaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the preceder of human beings, (ever) alert, the vehicle of their offerings, is ever new, is unsusceptible of harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒ह्वान्विश्वा॑ अभि॒युज॒: क्रतु॑र्दे॒वाना॒ममृ॑क्तः । अ॒ग्निस्तु॒विश्र॑वस्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: sahvā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tuvíśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the most liberal contributor of food, is able to resist all assailants unharmed, the nourisher of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रयां॑सि॒ वाह॑सा दा॒श्वाँ अ॑श्नोति॒ मर्त्य॑: । क्षयं॑ पाव॒कशो॑चिषः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ vā́hasā ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ aśnoti ǀ mártyaḥ ǀkṣáyam ǀ pāvaká-śociṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FromAgniof purifying radiance the mortal presenter (of offerings) obtains by his conveyance (of them to the gods) abundant viands and a dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ सुधि॑ता॒ग्नेर॑श्याम॒ मन्म॑भिः । विप्रा॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ sú-dhitā ǀ agnéḥ ǀ aśyāma ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, endowed with intelligence, obtain all good things by our praises ofAgni, to whom all is known.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒ वाजे॑षु सनिषामहे । त्वे दे॒वास॒ एरि॑रे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ saniṣāmahe ǀtvé íti ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain,Agni, all precious things (as booty) in battles, since the gods are concentrated in you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तं सु॒तं गी॒र्भिर्नभो॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । अ॒स्य पा॑तं धि॒येषि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ sutám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀasyá ǀ pātam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, come to this acceptable libation, (brought) by our praises from heaven, and induced by (our) devotion to drink of it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी जरि॒तुः सचा॑ य॒ज्ञो जि॑गाति॒ चेत॑नः । अ॒या पा॑तमि॒मं सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ sácā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ jigāti ǀ cétanaḥ ǀayā́ ǀ pātam ǀ imám ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, the conscious sacrifice associated with the worshipper proceeds to you; (summoned) by this (invocation) drink the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑म॒ग्निं क॑वि॒च्छदा॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ जू॒त्या वृ॑णे । ता सोम॑स्ये॒ह तृ॑म्पताम्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ agním ǀ kavi-chádā ǀ yajñásya ǀ jūtyā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtā́ ǀ sómasya ǀ ihá ǀ tṛmpatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Urged by the energy of the sacrifice, I have recourse toIndraandAgni, the protectors of the pious; may they be satiated with theSomahere presented.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तो॒शा वृ॑त्र॒हणा॑ हुवे स॒जित्वा॒नाप॑राजिता । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी वा॑ज॒सात॑मा
shlokas.transliteration: tośā́ ǀ vṛtra-hánā ǀ huve ǀ sa-jítvānā ǀ áparā-jitā ǀindrāgnī́ íti ǀ vāja-sā́tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeIndraandAgni, the discomfiters of foes, the destroyers ofVṛtra, the victorious, the invincible, the bestowers of most abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॑मर्चन्त्यु॒क्थिनो॑ नीथा॒विदो॑ जरि॒तार॑: । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ इष॒ आ वृ॑णे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ arcanti ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ nītha-vídaḥ ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The reciters of prayers, the repeaters of praise, who are skilled in sacred song, worship you both; I have recourse toIndraandAgnifor food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी नव॒तिं पुरो॑ दा॒सप॑त्नीरधूनुतम् । सा॒कमेके॑न॒ कर्म॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ navatím ǀ púraḥ ǀ dāsá-patnīḥ ǀ adhūnutam ǀsākám ǀ ékena ǀ kármaṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, with one united effort you over-threw ninety cities ruled over by (your) foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ अप॑स॒स्पर्युप॒ प्र य॑न्ति धी॒तय॑: । ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ápasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ úpa ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgnithe pious ministers, are present at our holy rite, according to the wave of worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी तवि॒षाणि॑ वां स॒धस्था॑नि॒ प्रयां॑सि च । यु॒वोर॒प्तूर्यं॑ हि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ taviṣā́ṇi ǀ vām ǀ sadhá-sthāni ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀyuvóḥ ǀ ap-tū́ryam ǀ hitám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, in you, vigour and food are abiding together, and therefore in you is deposited the dispensing of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी रोच॒ना दि॒वः परि॒ वाजे॑षु भूषथः । तद्वां॑ चेति॒ प्र वी॒र्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀtát ǀ vām ǀ ceti ǀ prá ǀ vīryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, illuminators of heaven, be ever graced (with victory) in battles, for such your prowess proclaims.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ दे॒वाया॒ग्नये॒ बर्हि॑ष्ठमर्चास्मै । गम॑द्दे॒वेभि॒रा स नो॒ यजि॑ष्ठो ब॒र्हिरा स॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ agnáye ǀ bárhiṣṭham ǀ arca ǀ asmai ǀgámat ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests) utter devout (praises) to this your divineAgni, that so glorified he may come to us with gods, and sit down on the sacrificial grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॒ यस्य॒ रोद॑सी॒ दक्षं॒ सच॑न्त ऊ॒तय॑: । ह॒विष्म॑न्त॒स्तमी॑ळते॒ तं स॑नि॒ष्यन्तोऽव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vā ǀ yásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dákṣam ǀ sácante ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀhavíṣmantaḥ ǀ tám ǀ īḷate ǀ tám ǀ saniṣyántaḥ ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The observer of truth, of whom (are) heaven and earth, and whose vigour the protecting (deities) assist; him, the offerers of oblations adore, and those desirous of riches (have recourse) to him for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स य॒न्ता विप्र॑ एषां॒ स य॒ज्ञाना॒मथा॒ हि षः । अ॒ग्निं तं वो॑ दुवस्यत॒ दाता॒ यो वनि॑ता म॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yantā́ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ átha ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀagním ǀ tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ duvasyata ǀ dā́tā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánitā ǀ maghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the sage, is the director of those (who sacrifice), he is (the regulator) of sacrifices; worship him you (benefactor), the donor, who is the bestower of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒: शर्मा॑णि वी॒तये॒ऽग्निर्य॑च्छतु॒ शंत॑मा । यतो॑ नः प्रु॒ष्णव॒द्वसु॑ दि॒वि क्षि॒तिभ्यो॑ अ॒प्स्वा
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śármāṇi ǀ vītáye ǀ agníḥ ǀ yacchatu ǀ śám-tamā ǀyátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pruṣṇávat ǀ vásu ǀ diví ǀ kṣití-bhyaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgnibestow upon us prosperous dwellings for our maintenance, so that from him infinite wealth, whether it may be in heaven or from earth, or in the waters (may come to us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दी॒दि॒वांस॒मपू॑र्व्यं॒ वस्वी॑भिरस्य धी॒तिभि॑: । ऋक्वा॑णो अ॒ग्निमि॑न्धते॒ होता॑रं वि॒श्पतिं॑ वि॒शाम्
shlokas.transliteration: dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ ápūrvyam ǀ vásvībhiḥ ǀ asya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀṛ́kvāṇaḥ ǀ agním ǀ indhate ǀ hótāram ǀ viśpátim ǀ viśā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The devout kindle (the fire) with his wealth-obtaining rites, (to worship) the radiant, unprecededAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the protector of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ ब्रह्म॑न्नविष उ॒क्थेषु॑ देव॒हूत॑मः । शं न॑: शोचा म॒रुद्वृ॒धोऽग्ने॑ सहस्र॒सात॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhman ǀ aviṣaḥ ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ deva-hū́tamaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ śoca ǀ marút-vṛdhaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ sahasra-sā́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Perfect our prayer, invoker of the gods, as well as our hymns;Agni, who increases with the winds and the giver of thousands, augment our felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ रास्व स॒हस्र॑वत्तो॒कव॑त्पुष्टि॒मद्वसु॑ । द्यु॒मद॑ग्ने सु॒वीर्यं॒ वर्षि॑ष्ठ॒मनु॑पक्षितम्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ sahásra-vat ǀ toká-vat ǀ puṣṭi-mát ǀ vásu ǀdyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ ánupa-kṣitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us indeed,Agni, wealth (that may be counted) by thousands, and comprising offspring, nourishment, brilliant treasure, and vigour, and be infinite and inexhaustible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ होता॑ म॒न्द्रो वि॒दथा॑न्यस्थात्स॒त्यो यज्वा॑ क॒वित॑म॒: स वे॒धाः । वि॒द्युद्र॑थ॒: सह॑सस्पु॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः शो॒चिष्के॑शः पृथि॒व्यां पाजो॑ अश्रेत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ vidáthāni ǀ asthāt ǀ satyáḥ ǀ yájvā ǀ kaví-tamaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀvidyút-rathaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The invoker (of the gods), the exhilarator (of his worshippers), the true, the offerer of sacrifice, the most wise, the creator, is present at our sacred rites.Agni, the son of strength, whose chariot is the lightning, whose hair is flame, manifests his glory on the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अया॑मि ते॒ नम॑उक्तिं जुषस्व॒ ऋता॑व॒स्तुभ्यं॒ चेत॑ते सहस्वः । वि॒द्वाँ आ व॑क्षि वि॒दुषो॒ नि ष॑त्सि॒ मध्य॒ आ ब॒र्हिरू॒तये॑ यजत्र
shlokas.transliteration: áyāmi ǀ te ǀ námaḥ-uktim ǀ juṣasva ǀ ṛ́ta-vaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ cétate ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀvidvā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ vidúṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ satsi ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ yajatra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I utter to you the words of adoration, be plural ased by them observer of truth; endowed with strength, (they are addressed) to you who are the expounder (of sacred rites); wise (as you are), bring (hither) the wise; object of sacrifice, sit down in the midst upon the sacred grass for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्रव॑तां त उ॒षसा॑ वा॒जय॑न्ती॒ अग्ने॒ वात॑स्य प॒थ्या॑भि॒रच्छ॑ । यत्सी॑म॒ञ्जन्ति॑ पू॒र्व्यं ह॒विर्भि॒रा व॒न्धुरे॑व तस्थतुर्दुरो॒णे
shlokas.transliteration: drávatām ǀ te ǀ uṣásā ǀ vājáyantī íti ǀ agne ǀ vā́tasya ǀ pathyā́bhiḥ ǀ áccha ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ añjánti ǀ pūrvyám ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vandhúrā-iva ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ duroṇé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the good-bestowing day and night hasten to you while you,Agnimeet them on the paths of the wind; since (the priests) ever worship you preceding (them) with oblations, whilst they (united) like the pole (and the yoke of a wagon), abide successively in our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रश्च॒ तुभ्यं॒ वरु॑णः सह॒स्वोऽग्ने॒ विश्वे॑ म॒रुत॑: सु॒म्नम॑र्चन् । यच्छो॒चिषा॑ सहसस्पुत्र॒ तिष्ठा॑ अ॒भि क्षि॒तीः प्र॒थय॒न्त्सूर्यो॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ túbhyam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ arcan ǀyát ǀ śocíṣā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ tíṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ pratháyan ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VigorousAgni, youMitraandVaruṇa, and all theMaruts, offer praise; since, son of strength, you stand a sun, shedding your rays with lustre on manking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अ॒द्य र॑रि॒मा हि काम॑मुत्ता॒नह॑स्ता॒ नम॑सोप॒सद्य॑ । यजि॑ष्ठेन॒ मन॑सा यक्षि दे॒वानस्रे॑धता॒ मन्म॑ना॒ विप्रो॑ अग्ने
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ rarimá ǀ hí ǀ kā́mam ǀ uttāná-hastāḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádya ǀyájiṣṭhena ǀ mánasā ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ ásredhatā ǀ mánmanā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ agne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With upliftedhands, approaching you with reverence we present you today our oblation do you who are wise, worship the gods with most devout mind and with unwearied praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्धि पु॑त्र सहसो॒ वि पू॒र्वीर्दे॒वस्य॒ यन्त्यू॒तयो॒ वि वाजा॑: । त्वं दे॑हि सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं नो॑ऽद्रो॒घेण॒ वच॑सा स॒त्यम॑ग्ने
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ hí ǀ putra ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ devásya ǀ yánti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀtvám ǀ dehi ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ adroghéṇa ǀ vácasā ǀ satyám ǀ agne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From you, verily, son of strength, many and various benefactions and various kinds of food devolve upon the devout (worshipper) do you grant us,Agni, infinite wealth, and (a son) observant of truth, with speech devoid of guile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॑ दक्ष कविक्रतो॒ यानी॒मा देव॒ मर्ता॑सो अध्व॒रे अक॑र्म । त्वं विश्व॑स्य सु॒रथ॑स्य बोधि॒ सर्वं॒ तद॑ग्ने अमृत स्वदे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ dakṣa ǀ kavikrato íti kavi-krato ǀ yā́ni ǀ imā́ ǀ déva ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ ákarma ǀtvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ su-ráthasya ǀ bodhi ǀ sárvam ǀ tát ǀ agne ǀ amṛta ǀ svada ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (Agni), mighty and omniscient, these (are the offerings) which we mortals present to you in the sacrifice; do you be cognizant of every respectable worshipper, and partake, immortal of all (his offerings) on this occasion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि पाज॑सा पृ॒थुना॒ शोशु॑चानो॒ बाध॑स्व द्वि॒षो र॒क्षसो॒ अमी॑वाः । सु॒शर्म॑णो बृह॒तः शर्म॑णि स्याम॒ग्नेर॒हं सु॒हव॑स्य॒ प्रणी॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ pā́jasā ǀ pṛthúnā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ bā́dhasva ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀsu-śármaṇaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ śármaṇi ǀ syām ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ahám ǀ su-hávasya ǀ prá-nītau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant with great glory, repel the hostilerākṣasasandpiśācas; may I be in (the enjoyment) of the favour of the great (Agni), the giver of prosperity, and in the service of (him who is) easily invoked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अ॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ॒ त्वं सूर॒ उदि॑ते बोधि गो॒पाः । जन्मे॑व॒ नित्यं॒ तन॑यं जुषस्व॒ स्तोमं॑ मे अग्ने त॒न्वा॑ सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ tvám ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀjánma-iva ǀ nítyam ǀ tánayam ǀ juṣasva ǀ stómam ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ tanvā́ ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consider yourself our protector at the breaking of the dawn today and when the sun has risen;Agni, who is engendered with (embodied) form, be plural ased with my constant praise, as a father (is plural ased with) his son.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नृ॒चक्षा॑ वृष॒भानु॑ पू॒र्वीः कृ॒ष्णास्व॑ग्ने अरु॒षो वि भा॑हि । वसो॒ नेषि॑ च॒ पर्षि॒ चात्यंह॑: कृ॒धी नो॑ रा॒य उ॒शिजो॑ यविष्ठ
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ ánu ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́su ǀ agne ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀváso íti ǀ néṣi ǀ ca ǀ párṣi ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits),beholder of men, radiant amid darkness, shine,Agni, with abundant (rays) in due order; granter of dwellings, conduct us (to good), keep off all ill, and youngest (of all the gods), gratify our desires for wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अषा॑ळ्हो अग्ने वृष॒भो दि॑दीहि॒ पुरो॒ विश्वा॒: सौभ॑गा संजिगी॒वान् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ ने॒ता प्र॑थ॒मस्य॑ पा॒योर्जात॑वेदो बृह॒तः सु॑प्रणीते
shlokas.transliteration: áṣāḷhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ púraḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sáubhagā ǀ sam-jigīvā́n ǀyajñásya ǀ netā́ ǀ prathamásya ǀ pāyóḥ ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-pranīte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is irresistible and the showerer (of benefits), consume victorious all the cities (of the foe) and (all their) precious things; do you, the duly worshipped, the knower of all that is born, (be for us) the conductor of the first great preserving sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छि॑द्रा॒ शर्म॑ जरितः पु॒रूणि॑ दे॒वाँ अच्छा॒ दीद्या॑नः सुमे॒धाः । रथो॒ न सस्नि॑र॒भि व॑क्षि॒ वाज॒मग्ने॒ त्वं रोद॑सी नः सु॒मेके॑
shlokas.transliteration: ácchidrā ǀ śárma ǀ jaritaríti ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sásniḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vakṣi ǀ vā́jam ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer (of the world), do you who is endowed with intelligence and radiance celebrate many faultless sacred rites in honour of the gods, and restraining (your impatience), convey to them like a wagon our (sacrificial) food; illume (with your rays) the beautiful heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पी॑पय वृषभ॒ जिन्व॒ वाजा॒नग्ने॒ त्वं रोद॑सी नः सु॒दोघे॑ । दे॒वेभि॑र्देव सु॒रुचा॑ रुचा॒नो मा नो॒ मर्त॑स्य दुर्म॒तिः परि॑ ष्ठात्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pīpaya ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ jínva ǀ vā́jān ǀ ágne ǀ tvám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sudóghe íti su-dóghe ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ deva ǀ su-rúcā ǀ rucānáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ pári ǀ sthāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious, showerer (of benefits); grant (abundant) food,Agni; (make) heaven and earth yield us milk; divine (Agni), associated with the gods, shining with bright radiance, let not the ill-will of any mortal prevail against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, earth the giver of cattle the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॒ग्निः सु॒वीर्य॒स्येशे॑ म॒हः सौभ॑गस्य । रा॒य ई॑शे स्वप॒त्यस्य॒ गोम॑त॒ ईशे॑ वृत्र॒हथा॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ ī́śe ǀ maháḥ ǀ sáubhagasya ǀrāyáḥ ǀ īśe ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ vṛtra-háthānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisAgni, is the lord of heroism and of great good fortune; he is the lord of wealth comprising progeny and cattle; he is the lord of the slayers ofVṛtra;”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं न॑रो मरुतः सश्चता॒ वृधं॒ यस्मि॒न्राय॒: शेवृ॑धासः । अ॒भि ये सन्ति॒ पृत॑नासु दू॒ढ्यो॑ वि॒श्वाहा॒ शत्रु॑माद॒भुः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ saścata ǀ vṛ́dham ǀ yásmin ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ śé-vṛdhāsaḥ ǀabhí ǀ yé ǀ sánti ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ śátrum ǀ ā-dabhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, leaders (of rites), associate with this augmenter (of our prosperity), in whom (abide) riches contributing to felicity, you who (are victorious) over (your) enemies in battle, who daily humble (your) foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं नो॑ रा॒यः शि॑शीहि॒ मीढ्वो॑ अग्ने सु॒वीर्य॑स्य । तुवि॑द्युम्न॒ वर्षि॑ष्ठस्य प्र॒जाव॑तोऽनमी॒वस्य॑ शु॒ष्मिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ mī́ḍhvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀtúvi-dyumna ǀ várṣiṣṭhasya ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ anamīvásya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, opulentAgni, showerer (of benefits), prosper us with riches comprising vigour, numerous progeny health, and happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चक्रि॒र्यो विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि सा॑स॒हिश्चक्रि॑र्दे॒वेष्वा दुव॑: । आ दे॒वेषु॒ यत॑त॒ आ सु॒वीर्य॒ आ शंस॑ उ॒त नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: cákriḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ cákriḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yátate ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́rye ǀ ā́ ǀ śáṃse ǀ utá ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is the maker pevades all worlds; he the enduring maker (of all) bears our offerings to the gods; he is present with the devout (worshippers) and amidst th eheroism and the devotions of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अ॒ग्नेऽम॑तये॒ मावीर॑तायै रीरधः । मागोता॑यै सहसस्पुत्र॒ मा नि॒देऽप॒ द्वेषां॒स्या कृ॑धि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ámataye ǀ mā́ ǀ avī́ratāyai ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ agótāyai ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ mā́ ǀ nidé ǀ ápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consign us not,Agnito malignity; (doom) us not to the absence of posterity; nor, son of strength, to the want of cattle, nor to reproach; drive away (all) animosities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒ग्धि वाज॑स्य सुभग प्र॒जाव॒तोऽग्ने॑ बृह॒तो अ॑ध्व॒रे । सं रा॒या भूय॑सा सृज मयो॒भुना॒ तुवि॑द्युम्न॒ यश॑स्वता
shlokas.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ vā́jasya ǀ su-bhaga ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀsám ǀ rāyā́ ǀ bhū́yasā ǀ sṛja ǀ mayaḥ-bhúnā ǀ túvi-dyumna ǀ yáśasvatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AuspiciousAgni, bestow (upon us) at the rite, food (the source of) happiness and renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मि॒ध्यमा॑नः प्रथ॒मानु॒ धर्मा॒ सम॒क्तुभि॑रज्यते वि॒श्ववा॑रः । शो॒चिष्के॑शो घृ॒तनि॑र्णिक्पाव॒कः सु॑य॒ज्ञो अ॒ग्निर्य॒जथा॑य दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ sám ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ su-yajñáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The righteous (Agni) when first kindled on the several (altars) the object of adoration by all, whose hair is flame, and who is cleansed with butter, the purifier, the worthy-worshipped, is sprinkled with oblations for the worship of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथाय॑जो हो॒त्रम॑ग्ने पृथि॒व्या यथा॑ दि॒वो जा॑तवेदश्चिकि॒त्वान् । ए॒वानेन॑ ह॒विषा॑ यक्षि दे॒वान्म॑नु॒ष्वद्य॒ज्ञं प्र ति॑रे॒मम॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ áyajaḥ ǀ hotrám ǀ agne ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ diváḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀevá ǀ anéna ǀ havíṣā ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ manuṣvát ǀ yajñám ǀ prá ǀ tira ǀ imám ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you did offer the burnt-offering,Agni, (on behalf of) earth; as you,Jātavedas, who are cognizant (of sacred rites, did offer sacrifice on behalf) of heaven; so with this oblation worship the gods, and perfect this rite today (as you did) that ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीण्यायूं॑षि॒ तव॑ जातवेदस्ति॒स्र आ॒जानी॑रु॒षस॑स्ते अग्ने । ताभि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ यक्षि वि॒द्वानथा॑ भव॒ यज॑मानाय॒ शं योः
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ táva ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ā-jā́nīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ átha ǀ bhava ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three are your existencesJātavedas; three,Agni, are your parent dawns; with them offer the oblation of the gods, the knowing (his wishes) be the bestower of happiness on the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं सु॑दी॒तिं सु॒दृशं॑ गृ॒णन्तो॑ नम॒स्याम॒स्त्वेड्यं॑ जातवेदः । त्वां दू॒तम॑र॒तिं ह॑व्य॒वाहं॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वन्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ su-dītím ǀ su-dṛ́śam ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ namasyā́maḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ dūtám ǀ aratím ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Jātavedas, we venerate you, glorifying the brilliant, beautiful, adorableAgni; the gods have made you their messenger, the disinterested bearer of oblations, the centre of ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वद्धोता॒ पूर्वो॑ अग्ने॒ यजी॑यान्द्वि॒ता च॒ सत्ता॑ स्व॒धया॑ च श॒म्भुः । तस्यानु॒ धर्म॒ प्र य॑जा चिकि॒त्वोऽथ॑ नो धा अध्व॒रं दे॒ववी॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvát ǀ hótā ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ yájīyān ǀ dvitā́ ǀ ca ǀ sáttā ǀ svadháyā ǀ ca ǀ śam-bhúḥ ǀtásya ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ prá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ devá-vītau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the most diligent offerer of worship who is the presenter of oblations before you are and who in two plural ces (the middling and the best) seated with the sacrificial food is (the source of) happiness (to the worshippers); do you cognizant (of the objects of devotion), officiate in accordance with his piety, and thus render our rite acceptable to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भवा॑ नो अग्ने सु॒मना॒ उपे॑तौ॒ सखे॑व॒ सख्ये॑ पि॒तरे॑व सा॒धुः । पु॒रु॒द्रुहो॒ हि क्षि॒तयो॒ जना॑नां॒ प्रति॑ प्रती॒चीर्द॑हता॒दरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ úpa-itau ǀ sákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ sādhúḥ ǀpuru-drúhaḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ práti ǀ pratīcī́ḥ ǀ dahatāt ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be favourably disposedAgni, on approaching us (at this rite); be the fulfiller (of our objects) like a friend (to a friend) or parents (to a child); since men are the grievous oppressors of men, do you consume the foes who come against us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तपो॒ ष्व॑ग्ने॒ अन्त॑राँ अ॒मित्रा॒न्तपा॒ शंस॒मर॑रुष॒: पर॑स्य । तपो॑ वसो चिकिता॒नो अ॒चित्ता॒न्वि ते॑ तिष्ठन्ताम॒जरा॑ अ॒यास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tápo íti ǀ sú ǀ agne ǀ ántarān ǀ amítrān ǀ tápa ǀ śáṃsam ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ párasya ǀtápo íti ǀ vaso íti ǀ cikitānáḥ ǀ acíttān ǀ ví ǀ te ǀ tiṣṭhantām ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vex thoroughly,Agni, our assailing enemies, disappoint the purpose of the adversary who offers not worship; giver of dwellings, who are cognizant (of sacred rites), vex those who have no thought (of pious acts) so that your undecaying, all-pervading (rays), may ever abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ध्मेना॑ग्न इ॒च्छमा॑नो घृ॒तेन॑ जु॒होमि॑ ह॒व्यं तर॑से॒ बला॑य । याव॒दीशे॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वन्द॑मान इ॒मां धियं॑ शत॒सेया॑य दे॒वीम्
shlokas.transliteration: idhména ǀ agne ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ juhómi ǀ havyám ǀ tárase ǀ bálāya ǀyā́vat ǀ ī́śe ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ śata-séyāya ǀ devī́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous (of wealth) I offer to youAgni, an oblation with butter and with fuel for your speed and invigoration, praising you with a holy prayer as much as I am able; I propitiate you that you may render this praise resplendent with infinite treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उच्छो॒चिषा॑ सहसस्पुत्र स्तु॒तो बृ॒हद्वय॑: शशमा॒नेषु॑ धेहि । रे॒वद॑ग्ने वि॒श्वामि॑त्रेषु॒ शं योर्म॑र्मृ॒ज्मा ते॑ त॒न्वं१॒॑ भूरि॒ कृत्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ śocíṣā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ stutáḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ śaśamānéṣu ǀ dhehi ǀrevát ǀ agne ǀ viśvā́mitreṣu ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ marmṛjmá ǀ te ǀ tanvám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ kṛ́tvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up, son of strength, with your splendour when hymned, and bestow abundant food and wealth,Agni, upon the descendants ofViśvāmitracelebrating your praise; and grant them exemption from sickness and danger; encourager of pious works (Agni), we repeatedly sprinkle your substance (with milk and butter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒धि रत्नं॑ सुसनित॒र्धना॑नां॒ स घेद॑ग्ने भवसि॒ यत्समि॑द्धः । स्तो॒तुर्दु॑रो॒णे सु॒भग॑स्य रे॒वत्सृ॒प्रा क॒रस्ना॑ दधिषे॒ वपूं॑षि
shlokas.transliteration: kṛdhí ǀ rátnam ǀ su-sanitaḥ ǀ dhánānām ǀ sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ bhavasi ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀstotúḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ revát ǀ sṛprā́ ǀ karásnā ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ vápūṃṣi ǁ
