shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal donor (of riches) bestow upon us the most precious of treasures, for therefore is it,Agni, that you are kindled; you have aims promptly stretched forth, whose (radiant) forms (bestow) wealth on the dwelling of your fortunate adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं होता॑रं॒ प्र वृ॑णे मि॒येधे॒ गृत्सं॑ क॒विं वि॑श्व॒विद॒ममू॑रम् । स नो॑ यक्षद्दे॒वता॑ता॒ यजी॑यान्रा॒ये वाजा॑य वनते म॒घानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ hótāram ǀ prá ǀ vṛṇe ǀ miyédhe ǀ gṛ́tsam ǀ kavím ǀ viśva-vídam ǀ ámūram ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yájīyān ǀ rāyé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ vanate ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have recourse in this sacrifice toAgni, the invoker and praiser (of the gods), theintelligent, the all-knowing the unbeguiled; may he, the adorable, sacrificer for us to the gods, (and) accept the precious (offerings) we make for food and riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ अग्ने ह॒विष्म॑तीमिय॒र्म्यच्छा॑ सुद्यु॒म्नां रा॒तिनीं॑ घृ॒ताची॑म् । प्र॒द॒क्षि॒णिद्दे॒वता॑तिमुरा॒णः सं रा॒तिभि॒र्वसु॑भिर्य॒ज्ञम॑श्रेत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmatīm ǀ iyarmi ǀ áccha ǀ su-dyumnā́m ǀ rātínīm ǀ ghṛtā́cīm ǀpra-dakṣiṇít ǀ devá-tātim ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ sám ǀ rātí-bhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ aśret ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reverencing the gods, I plural ce before youAgni, the brilliant oblation-yielding, food-bestowing, butter-charged (offering); may you (propitiated) by the present wealth, sanctify (this) sacrifice by your circumambulation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तेजी॑यसा॒ मन॑सा॒ त्वोत॑ उ॒त शि॑क्ष स्वप॒त्यस्य॑ शि॒क्षोः । अग्ने॑ रा॒यो नृत॑मस्य॒ प्रभू॑तौ भू॒याम॑ ते सुष्टु॒तय॑श्च॒ वस्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ téjīyasā ǀ mánasā ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ utá ǀ śikṣa ǀ su-apatyásya ǀ śikṣóḥ ǀágne ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamasya ǀ prá-bhūtau ǀ bhūyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-stutáyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who isprotected,Agni, by you, becomes endowed with a most luminous mind; bestow upon him excellent progeny; may we ever be under the power of you who is the willing dispenser of riches; glorifying you (may we be) the receptacles of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरी॑णि॒ हि त्वे द॑धि॒रे अनी॒काग्ने॑ दे॒वस्य॒ यज्य॑वो॒ जना॑सः । स आ व॑ह दे॒वता॑तिं यविष्ठ॒ शर्धो॒ यद॒द्य दि॒व्यं यजा॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́rīṇi ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ dadhiré ǀ ánīkā ǀ ágne ǀ devásya ǀ yájyavaḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ devá-tātim ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ divyám ǀ yájāsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ministering priests have concentrated in youAgni, who are divine, many hosts (of flames); do you bring hither the gods, youngest (of the deities), that you may worship today the divine effulgence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्त्वा॒ होता॑रम॒नज॑न्मि॒येधे॑ निषा॒दय॑न्तो य॒जथा॑य दे॒वाः । स त्वं नो॑ अग्नेऽवि॒तेह बो॒ध्यधि॒ श्रवां॑सि धेहि नस्त॒नूषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ hótāram ǀ anájan ǀ miyédhe ǀ ni-sādáyantaḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avitā́ ǀ ihá ǀ bodhi ǀ ádhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dhehi ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as the attendant divine (priests) anoint you as the invoker of the gods to offer worship in the sacrifice, therefore do you assent to be our protector on this occasion, and grant abundant food to our descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमु॒षस॑म॒श्विना॑ दधि॒क्रां व्यु॑ष्टिषु हवते॒ वह्नि॑रु॒क्थैः । सु॒ज्योति॑षो नः शृण्वन्तु दे॒वाः स॒जोष॑सो अध्व॒रं वा॑वशा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ uṣásam ǀ aśvínā ǀ dadhi-krā́m ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ havate ǀ váhniḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀsu-jyótiṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇvantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearer (of the oblation) invokes with praises at the break of day,Agni, the dawn, theAśvins, and Dadhikra); may the resplendent divinities, desirous of our sacrifice, hear in unison (the invocation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्री ते॒ वाजि॑ना॒ त्री ष॒धस्था॑ ति॒स्रस्ते॑ जि॒ह्वा ऋ॑तजात पू॒र्वीः । ति॒स्र उ॑ ते त॒न्वो॑ दे॒ववा॑ता॒स्ताभि॑र्नः पाहि॒ गिरो॒ अप्र॑युच्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ trī́ ǀ te ǀ vājínā ǀ trī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ tisráḥ ǀ te ǀ jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-jāta ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀtisráḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ tanváḥ ǀ devá-vātāḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, born of sacrifice, three are your viands; three your abiding plural ces, three the tongue satisfying (thegods); three verily are your forms acceptable to the deities, and with them never heedless (of our wishes), bepropitious to our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ भूरी॑णि॒ तव॑ जातवेदो॒ देव॑ स्वधावो॒ऽमृत॑स्य॒ नाम॑ । याश्च॑ मा॒या मा॒यिनां॑ विश्वमिन्व॒ त्वे पू॒र्वीः सं॑द॒धुः पृ॑ष्टबन्धो
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ bhū́rīṇi ǀ táva ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ déva ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́ma ǀyā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ māyā́ ǀ māyínām ǀ viśvam-inva ǀ tvé íti ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ sam-dadhúḥ ǀ pṛṣṭabandho íti pṛṣṭa-bandho ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, knowing all that exists and distributor of food, many are the names of you who are immortal satisffier of all men, friend of the suppliant, the gods have deposited in you whatever are the delusions of the deluding (rākṣasas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्ने॒ता भग॑ इव क्षिती॒नां दैवी॑नां दे॒व ऋ॑तु॒पा ऋ॒तावा॑ । स वृ॑त्र॒हा स॒नयो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒: पर्ष॒द्विश्वाति॑ दुरि॒ता गृ॒णन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ bhágaḥ-iva ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ dáivīnām ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀsáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sanáyaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ gṛṇántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineAgniis the guide of devout men, as the sun is the regulator of the seasons; may he, the observer of truth, the slayer ofVṛtra, the ancient, the omniscient convey his adorer (safe) over all difficulties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्राम॒ग्निमु॒षसं॑ च दे॒वीं बृह॒स्पतिं॑ सवि॒तारं॑ च दे॒वम् । अ॒श्विना॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ भगं॑ च॒ वसू॑न्रु॒द्राँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ इ॒ह हु॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́m ǀ agním ǀ uṣásam ǀ ca ǀ devī́m ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ca ǀ devám ǀaśvínā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǀ vásūn ǀ rudrā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ihá ǀ huve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke to this rite, Dadhikrā,Agni, the divine Uṣas,Bṛhaspati, the divineSavitā, theAśvins,MitraandVaruṇa,Bhaga, theVasus, theRudras, andĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञम॒मृते॑षु धेही॒मा ह॒व्या जा॑तवेदो जुषस्व । स्तो॒काना॑मग्ने॒ मेद॑सो घृ॒तस्य॒ होत॒: प्राशा॑न प्रथ॒मो नि॒षद्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ dhehi ǀ imā́ ǀ havyā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀstokā́nām ǀ agne ǀ médasaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ hótaríti ǀ prá ǀ aśāna ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Convey our sacrifice,Jātavedas, to the immortals and do you accept these oblations;Agni, invoker (of the gods) seated (on the altar) first partake of the drops of the marrow and of the butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तव॑न्तः पावक ते स्तो॒काः श्चो॑तन्ति॒ मेद॑सः । स्वध॑र्मन्दे॒ववी॑तये॒ श्रेष्ठं॑ नो धेहि॒ वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtá-vantaḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ te ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ médasaḥ ǀsvá-dharman ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The drops of the marrow charged with butter fall, purifier, to you, at your own rite, for the food of the gods; therefore grant us excellent affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॑ स्तो॒का घृ॑त॒श्चुतोऽग्ने॒ विप्रा॑य सन्त्य । ऋषि॒: श्रेष्ठ॒: समि॑ध्यसे य॒ज्ञस्य॑ प्रावि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ víprāya ǀ santya ǀṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ yajñásya ǀ pra-avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The drops (of the marrow) dripping with butter are offered,Agni, to you who are wise; you the most excellent ṛṣi are kindled; be the protector of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॑ श्चोतन्त्यध्रिगो शचीवः स्तो॒कासो॑ अग्ने॒ मेद॑सो घृ॒तस्य॑ । क॒वि॒श॒स्तो बृ॑ह॒ता भा॒नुनागा॑ ह॒व्या जु॑षस्व मेधिर
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ ścotanti ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ stokā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ médasaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀkavi-śastáḥ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ medhira ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Irrepressible and powerful,Agni, the drops of marrow and of butter distil for you; therefore you, who are praised by sages, come with great splendour, and be plural ased ever intelligent Agni, with our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओजि॑ष्ठं ते मध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ प्र ते॑ व॒यं द॑दामहे । श्चोत॑न्ति ते वसो स्तो॒का अधि॑ त्व॒चि प्रति॒ तान्दे॑व॒शो वि॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ójiṣṭham ǀ te ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ médaḥ ǀ út-bhṛtam ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ dadāmahe ǀścótanti ǀ te ǀ vaso-íti ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ práti ǀ tā́n ǀ deva-śáḥ ǀ vihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We present to you the densest marrow that has been extracted for you from the interior (of the victim); grant of dwellings, the drops fall for you upon the skin; distribute them amongst the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सो अ॒ग्निर्यस्मि॒न्त्सोम॒मिन्द्र॑: सु॒तं द॒धे ज॒ठरे॑ वावशा॒नः । स॒ह॒स्रिणं॒ वाज॒मत्यं॒ न सप्तिं॑ सस॒वान्त्सन्त्स्तू॑यसे जातवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ sutám ǀ dadhé ǀ jaṭháre ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀsahasríṇam ǀ vā́jam ǀ átyam ǀ ná ǀ sáptim ǀ sasa-vā́n ǀ sán ǀ stūyase ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is thatAgniin whomIndra, desirous (of the oblation), plural ced the effusedSomafor (his own) belly; you are praised by us,Jātavedas, enjoying the sacrificial food of many sorts like a rapid courser (enjoying many plural asures in battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ दि॒वि वर्च॑: पृथि॒व्यां यदोष॑धीष्व॒प्स्वा य॑जत्र । येना॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒र्वा॑त॒तन्थ॑ त्वे॒षः स भा॒नुर॑र्ण॒वो नृ॒चक्षा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ diví ǀ várcaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ yajatra ǀyéna ǀ antárikṣam ǀ urú ǀ ā-tatántha ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableAgni, your radiance that is in the heaven, on the earth, in the plural nts, in the waters and wherewith you overspread the firmament, that is shining and resplendent, overlooking man (vast as) the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ दि॒वो अर्ण॒मच्छा॑ जिगा॒स्यच्छा॑ दे॒वाँ ऊ॑चिषे॒ धिष्ण्या॒ ये । या रो॑च॒ने प॒रस्ता॒त्सूर्य॑स्य॒ याश्चा॒वस्ता॑दुप॒तिष्ठ॑न्त॒ आप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ árṇam ǀ áccha ǀ jigāsi ǀ áccha ǀ devā́n ǀ ūciṣe ǀ dhíṣṇyāḥ ǀ yé ǀyā́ḥ ǀ rocané ǀ parástāt ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ avástāt ǀ upa-tíṣṭhante ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You move,Agni, to the vapour in heaven; you congregate the divinities who are the vital airs (of the body); you animate the waters in the bright region above the sun, as well as those that are in the firmament beneath.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒री॒ष्या॑सो अ॒ग्नय॑: प्राव॒णेभि॑: स॒जोष॑सः । जु॒षन्तां॑ य॒ज्ञम॒द्रुहो॑ऽनमी॒वा इषो॑ म॒हीः
shlokas.transliteration: purīṣyā́saḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ pravaṇébhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀjuṣántām ǀ yajñám ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ anamīvā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the benignant fires termed puriṣyās, together with the instrumental uments (that have dug the pits in which they are plural ced) combined, accept the sacrifice (and grant us) salutary and abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred ries, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निर्म॑थित॒: सुधि॑त॒ आ स॒धस्थे॒ युवा॑ क॒विर॑ध्व॒रस्य॑ प्रणे॒ता । जूर्य॑त्स्व॒ग्निर॒जरो॒ वने॒ष्वत्रा॑ दधे अ॒मृतं॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ-mathitaḥ ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ yúvā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ pra-netā́ ǀjū́ryat-su ǀ agníḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ átra ǀ dadhe ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Churned (by the friction of the sticks), duly plural ced in the sacrificial chamber, the young and sage leader of the rite,Jātavedas, the imperishableAgni, (blazing) amidst consuming forests, grants us on this occasion ambrosial (food).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अम॑न्थिष्टां॒ भार॑ता रे॒वद॒ग्निं दे॒वश्र॑वा दे॒ववा॑तः सु॒दक्ष॑म् । अग्ने॒ वि प॑श्य बृह॒ताभि रा॒येषां नो॑ ने॒ता भ॑वता॒दनु॒ द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: ámanthiṣṭām ǀ bhā́ratā ǀ revát ǀ agním ǀ devá-śravāḥ ǀ devá-vātaḥ ǀ su-dákṣam ǀágne ǀ ví ǀ paśya ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ abhí ǀ rāyā́ ǀ iṣā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ bhavatāt ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two sons ofBharata,Devaśravasand Devavāta, have churned the very powerful and wealth-bestowingAgni; look upon us, Agni, with vast riches, and be the bringer of food (to us) every day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ क्षिप॑: पू॒र्व्यं सी॑मजीजन॒न्त्सुजा॑तं मा॒तृषु॑ प्रि॒यम् । अ॒ग्निं स्तु॑हि दैववा॒तं दे॑वश्रवो॒ यो जना॑ना॒मस॑द्व॒शी
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ sīm ǀ ajījanan ǀ sú-jātam ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ priyám ǀagním ǀ stuhi ǀ daiva-vātám ǀ deva-śravaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ásat ǀ vaśī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers have genitive rated this ancient (Agni); praise,Devaśravas, this well-born, beloved (son) of his parents, genitive rated by Devavāta, Agni, who is the servant of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॑ दधे॒ वर॒ आ पृ॑थि॒व्या इळा॑यास्प॒दे सु॑दिन॒त्वे अह्ना॑म् । दृ॒षद्व॑त्यां॒ मानु॑ष आप॒यायां॒ सर॑स्वत्यां रे॒वद॑ग्ने दिदीहि
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhe ǀ váre ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ padé ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀdṛṣát-vatyām ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ āpayā́yām ǀ sárasvatyām ǀ revát ǀ agne ǀ didīhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I plural ce you in an excellent spot of earth on an auspicious day of days; do you,Agni, shine on the frequent (banks) of the Dṛṣadvati,ĀpayāandSarasvatīrivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ सह॑स्व॒ पृत॑ना अ॒भिमा॑ती॒रपा॑स्य । दु॒ष्टर॒स्तर॒न्नरा॑ती॒र्वर्चो॑ धा य॒ज्ञवा॑हसे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ sáhasva ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ ápa ǀ asya ǀdustáraḥ ǀ táran ǀ árātīḥ ǀ várcaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repel,Agni, (hostile) hosts; drive away (all) assailants; insuperable, foe-surpassing, give food to the instrumental tutor of this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॑ इ॒ळा समि॑ध्यसे वी॒तिहो॑त्रो॒ अम॑र्त्यः । जु॒षस्व॒ सू नो॑ अध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ iḷā́ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ vītí-hotraḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀjuṣásva ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni(who is) immortal and who is gratified by oblations, you are kindled upon the altar; be plural ased by this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ द्यु॒म्नेन॑ जागृवे॒ सह॑सः सूनवाहुत । एदं ब॒र्हिः स॑दो॒ मम॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ dyumnéna ǀ jāgṛve ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā-huta ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǀ máma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, vigilant (in the exercise of) your energy, take your seat when invoked on the sacred grass (strewn at) my (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिर॒ग्निभि॑र्दे॒वेभि॑र्महया॒ गिर॑: । य॒ज्ञेषु॒ य उ॑ चा॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ mahaya ǀ gíraḥ ǀyajñéṣu ǀ yé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ cāyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, with all the divine fires, respect the praises of those who in (their) sacrifices are (your especial) worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ दा दा॒शुषे॑ र॒यिं वी॒रव॑न्तं॒ परी॑णसम् । शि॒शी॒हि न॑: सूनु॒मत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ rayím ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ párīṇasam ǀśiśīhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnu-mátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, ample wealth and progeny to the donor (of the oblation); make us prosperous, possessed of offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ दि॒वः सू॒नुर॑सि॒ प्रचे॑ता॒स्तना॑ पृथि॒व्या उ॒त वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । ऋध॑ग्दे॒वाँ इ॒ह य॑जा चिकित्वः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ asi ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ tánā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀṛ́dhak ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is omniscient, and the discriminator (of acts), you are the son of heaven or the son of earth; do you who is intelligent worship severally the gods on this occasion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः स॑नोति वी॒र्या॑णि वि॒द्वान्त्स॒नोति॒ वाज॑म॒मृता॑य॒ भूष॑न् । स नो॑ दे॒वाँ एह व॑हा पुरुक्षो
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ sanoti ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sanóti ǀ vā́jam ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vaha ǀ purukṣo íti puru-kṣo ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wiseAgnibestows faculties (securing prosperity and descendants); adorning (the world with lustre) he gives (sacrificial food) to the immortals; Agni, (to whom) many oblations (are offered), bring hither to us the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॒श्वज॑न्ये॒ आ भा॑ति दे॒वी अ॒मृते॒ अमू॑रः । क्षय॒न्वाजै॑: पुरुश्च॒न्द्रो नमो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ viśvájanye íti viśvá-janye ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ amṛ́te íti ǀ ámūraḥ ǀkṣáyan ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ puru-candráḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the unbewildered, the ruler (of the world), the radiant, associated with vigour and food, illumines the divine immortal parents of all things, heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ इन्द्र॑श्च दा॒शुषो॑ दुरो॒णे सु॒ताव॑तो य॒ज्ञमि॒होप॑ यातम् । अम॑र्धन्ता सोम॒पेया॑य देवा
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ihá ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀámardhantā ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ devā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, do you andIndra, gods disdaining not (our rite), come to the sacrifice in the dwelling of the offerer of the libation to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ अ॒पां समि॑ध्यसे दुरो॒णे नित्य॑: सूनो सहसो जातवेदः । स॒धस्था॑नि म॒हय॑मान ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ apā́m ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ duroṇé ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀsadhá-sthāni ǀ maháyamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength,Jātavedasthe eternal traversing the inhabited regions with your protection, you are kindled in the dwelling of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रं मन॑सा॒ग्निं नि॒चाय्या॑ ह॒विष्म॑न्तो अनुष॒त्यं स्व॒र्विद॑म् । सु॒दानुं॑ दे॒वं र॑थि॒रं व॑सू॒यवो॑ गी॒र्भी र॒ण्वं कु॑शि॒कासो॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarám ǀ mánasā ǀ agním ǀ ni-cā́yya ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ anu-satyám ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀsu-dā́num ǀ devám ǀ rathirám ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ raṇvám ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We of the race ofKuśikaoffering oblations, desirous of wealth, having contemplated him in our minds, invoke with praises the divineVaiśvānara, the observer of truth, the cognizant of heaven, the bountiful, the charioteer, the frequenter (of sacrifices).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं शु॒भ्रम॒ग्निमव॑से हवामहे वैश्वान॒रं मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑नमु॒क्थ्य॑म् । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ मनु॑षो दे॒वता॑तये॒ विप्रं॒ श्रोता॑र॒मति॑थिं रघु॒ष्यद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ śubhrám ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ mātaríśvānam ǀ ukthyám ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ vípram ǀ śrótāram ǀ átithim ǀ raghu-syádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you for our own protection and for the devotions of mankind, the radiantAgni,Vaiśvānara, the illuminator of the firmament, the adorable lord of sacred rites, the wise, the hearer (of supplications), the guest (of man), the quick-moving.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वो॒ न क्रन्द॒ञ्जनि॑भि॒: समि॑ध्यते वैश्वान॒रः कु॑शि॒केभि॑र्यु॒गेयु॑गे । स नो॑ अ॒ग्निः सु॒वीर्यं॒ स्वश्व्यं॒ दधा॑तु॒ रत्न॑म॒मृते॑षु॒ जागृ॑विः
shlokas.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ krándan ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ kuśikébhiḥ ǀ yugé-yuge ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ dádhātu ǀ rátnam ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānarais kindled in every age by theKuśikasas a neighing foal (is nourished) by its mother; may thatAgni, vigilant among the immortals, give us wealth with excellent offspring and good horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र य॑न्तु॒ वाजा॒स्तवि॑षीभिर॒ग्नय॑: शु॒भे सम्मि॑श्ला॒: पृष॑तीरयुक्षत । बृ॒ह॒दुक्षो॑ म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दस॒: प्र वे॑पयन्ति॒ पर्व॑ताँ॒ अदा॑भ्याः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yantu ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ sám-miślāḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ ayukṣata ǀbṛhat-úkṣaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vepayanti ǀ párvatān ǀ ádābhyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the swift fires combined with the vigorous winds proceed to the pure (region of the water), uniting the drops (of rain); theMarutsirresistible, all-knowing, agitate the copious-shedding clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नि॒श्रियो॑ म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्वकृ॑ष्टय॒ आ त्वे॒षमु॒ग्रमव॑ ईमहे व॒यम् । ते स्वा॒निनो॑ रु॒द्रिया॑ व॒र्षनि॑र्णिजः सिं॒हा न हे॒षक्र॑तवः सु॒दान॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: agni-śríyaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ viśvá-kṛṣṭayaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tveṣám ǀ ugrám ǀ ávaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ vayám ǀté ǀ svānínaḥ ǀ rudríyāḥ ǀ varṣá-nirnijaḥ ǀ siṃhā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ heṣá-kratavaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fire-beautified, all-agitatingMaruts; we seek their fierce radiance for protection; they, the sons ofRudra, the bountiful Maruts, whose form is the rain, are loudlike roaring lions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्रातं॑व्रातं ग॒णंग॑णं सुश॒स्तिभि॑र॒ग्नेर्भामं॑ म॒रुता॒मोज॑ ईमहे । पृष॑दश्वासो अनव॒भ्ररा॑धसो॒ गन्ता॑रो य॒ज्ञं वि॒दथे॑षु॒ धीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vrā́tam-vrātam ǀ gaṇám-gaṇam ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ bhā́mam ǀ marútām ǀ ójaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀpṛ́ṣat-aśvāsaḥ ǀ anavabhrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ gántāraḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit the might of theMaruts, the irradiation ofAgniwith solemn prayers in every assembly and company (of worshippers); those Maruts who ahve partly-coloured steeds, who are dispensers of unfailing wealth, firm (of purpose), and frequenters of sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर॑स्मि॒ जन्म॑ना जा॒तवे॑दा घृ॒तं मे॒ चक्षु॑र॒मृतं॑ म आ॒सन् । अ॒र्कस्त्रि॒धातू॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानोऽज॑स्रो घ॒र्मो ह॒विर॑स्मि॒ नाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ asmi ǀ jánmanā ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ me ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ me ǀ āsán ǀarkáḥ ǀ tri-dhā́tuḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ ájasraḥ ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ asmi ǀ nā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I,Agni, am by birth endowed with knowledge of all that exists; clarified butter is my eye; ambrosia is my mouth; I am the living breath of threefold nature, the measure of the firmament, eternal warmth; I am also the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒भिः प॒वित्रै॒रपु॑पो॒द्ध्य१॒॑र्कं हृ॒दा म॒तिं ज्योति॒रनु॑ प्रजा॒नन् । वर्षि॑ष्ठं॒ रत्न॑मकृत स्व॒धाभि॒रादिद्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पर्य॑पश्यत्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-bhíḥ ǀ pavítraiḥ ǀ ápupot ǀ hí ǀ arkám ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ matím ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-jānán ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ rátnam ǀ akṛta ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ pári ǀ apaśyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, thoroughly comprehending the light that is to be understod by the heart, has purified himself (by the three) purifying (forms); he has made himself most excellent treasure by (these) self-manifestations, and has thence contemplated heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्स॒मक्षी॑यमाणं विप॒श्चितं॑ पि॒तरं॒ वक्त्वा॑नाम् । मे॒ळिं मद॑न्तं पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॒ तं रो॑दसी पिपृतं सत्य॒वाच॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śatá-dhāram ǀ útsam ǀ ákṣīyamāṇam ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ pitáram ǀ váktvānām ǀmeḷím ǀ mádantam ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ tám ǀ rodasī íti ǀ pipṛtam ǀ satya-vā́cam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth be kind to that stage who is as it were a many-cahnneled and inexhaustible stream (of knowledge); the parent (of his disciples), the collater of holy texts, rejoicing on the lap of his parents,, whose words are truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॒ वाजा॑ अ॒भिद्य॑वो ह॒विष्म॑न्तो घृ॒ताच्या॑ । दे॒वाञ्जि॑गाति सुम्न॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cyā ǀdevā́n ǀ jigāti ǀ sumnayúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The months, the half months, (the gods) who are the receivers of oblations, with the butter-yielding kine, preside over your rite; the sacrificer, desirous of prosperity, worships the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळे॑ अ॒ग्निं वि॑प॒श्चितं॑ गि॒रा य॒ज्ञस्य॒ साध॑नम् । श्रु॒ष्टी॒वानं॑ धि॒तावा॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ agním ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ girā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀśruṣṭī-vā́nam ǀ dhitá-vānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship with praise the wiseAgni, the accomplisher of sacrifice, the possessor of happiness, the repository of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ श॒केम॑ ते व॒यं यमं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ वा॒जिन॑: । अति॒ द्वेषां॑सि तरेम
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ śakéma ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ yámam ǀ devásya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀáti ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we offering oblations effect the detention of you is divine (until the completion of the rite), and may we (thereby) overcome all animosities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मि॒ध्यमा॑नो अध्व॒रे॒३॒॑ऽग्निः पा॑व॒क ईड्य॑: । शो॒चिष्के॑श॒स्तमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ agníḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ tám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit thatAgni, who is being kindled at the sacrifice, the purifier, the adorable, whose hair is flame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒थु॒पाजा॒ अम॑र्त्यो घृ॒तनि॑र्णि॒क्स्वा॑हुतः । अ॒ग्निर्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ हव्य॒वाट्
shlokas.transliteration: pṛthu-pā́jāḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the bright-shining, the immortal, the cleanser with clarified butter, the fitly-involved, the bearer of the oblation in the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं स॒बाधो॑ य॒तस्रु॑च इ॒त्था धि॒या य॒ज्ञव॑न्तः । आ च॑क्रुर॒ग्निमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ yajñá-vantaḥ ǀā́ ǀ cakruḥ ǀ agním ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exorcisers (of the demons), lifting up their ladles, and offering sacrifice, have called uponAgniby this ceremony for their protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑ दे॒वो अम॑र्त्यः पु॒रस्ता॑देति मा॒यया॑ । वि॒दथा॑नि प्रचो॒दय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: hótā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ eti ǀ māyáyā ǀvidáthāni ǀ pra-codáyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerer of the oblation, the divine, immortal,Agni, comes first (at the ceremony) directing solemnities by his experiences.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒जी वाजे॑षु धीयतेऽध्व॒रेषु॒ प्र णी॑यते । विप्रो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ साध॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: vājī́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ dhīyate ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ prá ǀ nīyate ǀvípraḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightyAgniis plural ced (foremost by the gods) in battle; he is brought forward reverently at holy rites; for he is the sage fulfiller of the sacrifice. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: धि॒या च॑क्रे॒ वरे॑ण्यो भू॒तानां॒ गर्भ॒मा द॑धे । दक्ष॑स्य पि॒तरं॒ तना॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhiyā́ ǀ cakre ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ bhūtā́nām ǀ gárbham ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhe ǀdákṣasya ǀ pitáram ǀ tánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has been made by the sacred rite, the choice (of the worshipper), who comprehends (within himself) the germ of all creatures, and whom the daughter ofDakṣa(receives) as the parent of the world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॑ दधे॒ वरे॑ण्यं॒ दक्ष॑स्ये॒ळा स॑हस्कृत । अग्ने॑ सुदी॒तिमु॒शिज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhe ǀ váreṇyam ǀ dákṣasya ǀ iḷā́ ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀágne ǀ su-dītím ǀ uśíjam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, strength-engendered, Iḷā (the daughter) ofDakṣahas sustained you, the desirable, the resplendent, and longing (for the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं य॒न्तुर॑म॒प्तुर॑मृ॒तस्य॒ योगे॑ व॒नुष॑: । विप्रा॒ वाजै॒: समि॑न्धते
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ yantúram ǀ ap-túram ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yóge ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀvíprāḥ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ sám ǀ indhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (priests) performers (of the ceremony) kindle with oblations for the due celebration of the rite,Agni, the regulator (of all), the sender of the rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑तमध्व॒रे दी॑दि॒वांस॒मुप॒ द्यवि॑ । अ॒ग्निमी॑ळे क॒विक्र॑तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ adhvaré ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀagním ǀ īḷe ǀ kaví-kratum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I adore at this sacrificeAgnithe grandson of (sacrificial) food, shining above in the firmament, the creation of the wise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळेन्यो॑ नम॒स्य॑स्ति॒रस्तमां॑सि दर्श॒तः । सम॒ग्निरि॑ध्यते॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: īḷényaḥ ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ darśatáḥ ǀsám ǀ agníḥ ǀ idhyate ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is to be worshipped with praise and with prostration, the dispeller of darkness, the beautiful, the showerer (of benefits) is kindled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषो॑ अ॒ग्निः समि॑ध्य॒तेऽश्वो॒ न दे॑व॒वाह॑नः । तं ह॒विष्म॑न्त ईळते
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣo íti ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ deva-vā́hanaḥ ǀtám ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerers of oblations glorify thatAgniwho is the showerer (of benefits) and is the bearer of the offerings to the gods as a horse (bears his rider to his home).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष॑णं त्वा व॒यं वृ॑ष॒न्वृष॑ण॒: समि॑धीमहि । अग्ने॒ दीद्य॑तं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ vṛṣan ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀágne ǀ dī́dyatam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits) we profusely offering (oblations) kindle you mighty and resplendentAgni, who is the sender of showers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ जु॒षस्व॑ नो ह॒विः पु॑रो॒ळाशं॑ जातवेदः । प्रा॒त॒:सा॒वे धि॑यावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ juṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀprātaḥ-sāvé ǀ dhiyāvaso íti dhiyā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, by whom all is known, who rewards pious acts with wealth, accept our cakes offered with butter at the morning worships.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळा अ॑ग्ने पच॒तस्तुभ्यं॑ वा घा॒ परि॑ष्कृतः । तं जु॑षस्व यविष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ pacatáḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀtám ǀ juṣasva ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cakes and butter are dressed,Agni, and verily prepared for you; accept them youngest (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ वी॒हि पु॑रो॒ळाश॒माहु॑तं ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम् । सह॑सः सू॒नुर॑स्यध्व॒रे हि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ vīhí ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǀsáhasaḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ asi ǀ adhvaré ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eat,Agni, the cakes and butter offered as the day disappears; you, son of strength, are stationed (by us) at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माध्यं॑दिने॒ सव॑ने जातवेदः पुरो॒ळाश॑मि॒ह क॑वे जुषस्व । अग्ने॑ य॒ह्वस्य॒ तव॑ भाग॒धेयं॒ न प्र मि॑नन्ति वि॒दथे॑षु॒ धीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́dhyandine ǀ sávane ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ ihá ǀ kave ǀ juṣasva ǀágne ǀ yahvásya ǀ táva ǀ bhāga-dhéyam ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ minanti ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WiseJātavedasaccept the cakes and butter offered in this sacrifice at the mid-day rite; prudent (worshippers), withhold not at solemn ceremonies the portion of you who are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ तृ॒तीये॒ सव॑ने॒ हि कानि॑षः पुरो॒ळाशं॑ सहसः सून॒वाहु॑तम् । अथा॑ दे॒वेष्व॑ध्व॒रं वि॑प॒न्यया॒ धा रत्न॑वन्तम॒मृते॑षु॒ जागृ॑विम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tṛtī́ye ǀ sávane ǀ hí ǀ kā́niṣaḥ ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā́-hutam ǀátha ǀ devéṣu ǀ adhvarám ǀ vipanyáyā ǀ dhā́ḥ ǀ rátna-vantam ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ jā́gṛvim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be plural ased,Agni, son of strength, with the cakes and butter offered at the third (daily sacrifice), and do you (propitiated) by praise convey the precious imperishable and awakening (oblation) to the immortal gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ वृधा॒न आहु॑तिं पुरो॒ळाशं॑ जातवेदः । जु॒षस्व॑ ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ vṛdhānáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀjuṣásva ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniwho isJātavedasand is thriving upon oblations accept the cakes the butter as the day disappears.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ती॒दम॑धि॒मन्थ॑न॒मस्ति॑ प्र॒जन॑नं कृ॒तम् । ए॒तां वि॒श्पत्नी॒मा भ॑रा॒ग्निं म॑न्थाम पू॒र्वथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásti ǀ idám ǀ adhi-mánthanam ǀ ásti ǀ pra-jánanam ǀ kṛtám ǀetā́m ǀ viśpátnīm ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ agním ǀ manthāma ǀ pūrvá-thā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This, the apparatus of attrition is ready; the genitive ration (of the flame) is ready; take up this (stick) the protectress of mankind, and let us churn the fire as has been done of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रण्यो॒र्निहि॑तो जा॒तवे॑दा॒ गर्भ॑ इव॒ सुधि॑तो ग॒र्भिणी॑षु । दि॒वेदि॑व॒ ईड्यो॑ जागृ॒वद्भि॑र्ह॒विष्म॑द्भिर्मनु॒ष्ये॑भिर॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: aráṇyoḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ gárbhaḥ-iva ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ garbhíṇīṣu ǀdivé-dive ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ jāgṛvát-bhiḥ ǀ havíṣmat-bhiḥ ǀ manuṣyébhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Jātavedashas been deposited in the two sticks as the embryo is deposited in pregnant women;Agniis to be adored day by day by vigilant men laden with oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त्ता॒नाया॒मव॑ भरा चिकि॒त्वान्त्स॒द्यः प्रवी॑ता॒ वृष॑णं जजान । अ॒रु॒षस्तू॑पो॒ रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॒ इळा॑यास्पु॒त्रो व॒युने॑ऽजनिष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: uttānā́yām ǀ áva ǀ bhara ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ prá-vītā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ jajāna ǀaruṣá-stūpaḥ ǀ rúśat ǀ asya ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ vayúne ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the intelligent priest plural ce the lower of the sticks with the face upwards, the upper (with the surface) downwards, so that quickly impregnated it may genitive rate the showerer (of benefits)Agni; then the bright blazing son of Iḷā whose light dissipates the darkness is born of the wood of attrition.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॑यास्त्वा प॒दे व॒यं नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ । जात॑वेदो॒ नि धी॑म॒ह्यग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: íḷāyāḥ ǀ tvā ǀ padé ǀ vayám ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀjā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhīmahi ǀ ágne ǀ havyā́ya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniwho isJātavedas, we plural ce you upon the earth in the centre, in the plural ce of Iḷā, for the purpose of receiving the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्थ॑ता नरः क॒विमद्व॑यन्तं॒ प्रचे॑तसम॒मृतं॑ सु॒प्रती॑कम् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॑द॒ग्निं न॑रो जनयता सु॒शेव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mánthata ǀ naraḥ ǀ kavím ǀ ádvayantam ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ su-prátīkam ǀyajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ prathamám ǀ purástāt ǀ agním ǀ naraḥ ǀ janayata ǀ su-śévam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conductors of the rite, produce by attrition the far-seeing, single-minded, intelligent, immortal, radiant-limbedAgni; genitive rate him, leaders (of the solemnity), in the first plural ce the chief standard of the sacrifice, who is the source of felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॒ मन्थ॑न्ति बा॒हुभि॒र्वि रो॑च॒तेऽश्वो॒ न वा॒ज्य॑रु॒षो वने॒ष्वा । चि॒त्रो न याम॑न्न॒श्विनो॒रनि॑वृत॒: परि॑ वृण॒क्त्यश्म॑न॒स्तृणा॒ दह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ mánthanti ǀ bāhú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ rocate ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀcitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yā́man ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ áni-vṛtaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṇakti ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ tṛ́ṇā ǀ dáhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When they rub (the sticks) with their arms the radiantAgnibursts forth from the wood like a fleet courser, and like the many-coloured car of theAśvinsunresisted in its course, Agni spreads wide around consuming stones and trees.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒तो अ॒ग्नी रो॑चते॒ चेकि॑तानो वा॒जी विप्र॑: कविश॒स्तः सु॒दानु॑: । यं दे॒वास॒ ईड्यं॑ विश्व॒विदं॑ हव्य॒वाह॒मद॑धुरध्व॒रेषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: jātáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ rocate ǀ cékitānaḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ kavi-śastáḥ ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀyám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ viśva-vídam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as bornAgni, shines intelligent, swift-moving, skilled in rites, praised by the wise, and liberal in gifts; (and it is he) whom the gods have held as the bearer of oblations at sacrifices, adorable and all-knowing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सीद॑ होत॒: स्व उ॑ लो॒के चि॑कि॒त्वान्त्सा॒दया॑ य॒ज्ञं सु॑कृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ । दे॒वा॒वीर्दे॒वान्ह॒विषा॑ यजा॒स्यग्ने॑ बृ॒हद्यज॑माने॒ वयो॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: sī́da ǀ hotaríti ǀ své ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loké ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ sādáya ǀ yajñám ǀ su-kṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ havíṣā ǀ yajāsi ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhát ǀ yájamāne ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offerer of oblations sit down in your own sphere, for you are cognizant (of holy acts), and station the instrumental tutor of the ceremony in the chief plural ce of the sacred rite; cherisher of the gods, worship the gods,Agni, and bestow abundant food on the founder of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒णोत॑ धू॒मं वृष॑णं सखा॒योऽस्रे॑धन्त इतन॒ वाज॒मच्छ॑ । अ॒यम॒ग्निः पृ॑तना॒षाट् सु॒वीरो॒ येन॑ दे॒वासो॒ अस॑हन्त॒ दस्यू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṇóta ǀ dhūmám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ ásredhantaḥ ǀ itana ǀ vā́jam ǀ áccha ǀayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛtanāṣā́ṭ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ yéna ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ásahanta ǀ dásyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Produce, friends, smoke, the showerer (of benefits); indefatigable person st in the contest with (Agni); the heroic Agni is able to encounter hosts, and by him the gods overcome their foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑ॠ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न॒ आ सी॒दाथा॑ नो वर्धया॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ yóniḥ ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ árocathāḥ ǀtám ǀ jānán ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ sīda ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ vardhaya ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This in every season,Agni, is your plural ce, whence, as soon as genitive rated, you have ever shone; knowing that to be so, Agni, there abide, and thrive by our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तनू॒नपा॑दुच्यते॒ गर्भ॑ आसु॒रो नरा॒शंसो॑ भवति॒ यद्वि॒जाय॑ते । मा॒त॒रिश्वा॒ यदमि॑मीत मा॒तरि॒ वात॑स्य॒ सर्गो॑ अभव॒त्सरी॑मणि
shlokas.transliteration: tanū́-nápāt ǀ ucyate ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ āsuráḥ ǀ nárāśáṃsaḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ yát ǀ vi-jā́yate ǀmātaríśvā ǀ yát ǀ ámimīta ǀ mātári ǀ vā́tasya ǀ sárgaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ sárīmaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (existing) as an embryo (in the wood),Agniis called Tanunapāt; when he is genitive rated (he is called) theasura-destroying narāśam,sa; when he has displayed (his energy) in the material firmament,Mātariśvan; and the creation of the wind is in his rapid motion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒नि॒र्मथा॒ निर्म॑थितः सुनि॒धा निहि॑तः क॒विः । अग्ने॑ स्वध्व॒रा कृ॑णु दे॒वान्दे॑वय॒ते य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: suniḥ-máthā ǀ níḥ-mathitaḥ ǀ su-nidhā́ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀágne ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ kṛṇu ǀ devā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is pronounced by reverential attrition, and deposited with reverential care, and who are far-seeing, render our rites (exempt from defects), and worship the gods (on behalf) of the devout worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजी॑जनन्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्या॑सोऽस्रे॒माणं॑ त॒रणिं॑ वी॒ळुज॑म्भम् । दश॒ स्वसा॑रो अ॒ग्रुव॑: समी॒चीः पुमां॑सं जा॒तम॒भि सं र॑भन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: ájījanan ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ asremā́ṇam ǀ taráṇim ǀ vīḷú-jambham ǀdáśa ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ púmāṃsam ǀ jātám ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ rabhante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mortals have begotten the immortals, the undecaying (Agni), the devourer of oblations, the conveyance (by which they cross over sin), the ten sister fingers intertwined proclaim him born as if it was amale(infant).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒प्तहो॑ता सन॒काद॑रोचत मा॒तुरु॒पस्थे॒ यदशो॑च॒दूध॑नि । न नि मि॑षति सु॒रणो॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ यदसु॑रस्य ज॒ठरा॒दजा॑यत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ saptá-hotā ǀ sanakā́t ǀ arocata ǀ mātúḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yát ǀ áśocat ǀ ū́dhani ǀná ǀ ní ǀ miṣati ǀ su-ráṇaḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ yát ǀ ásurasya ǀ jaṭhárāt ǀ ájāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who has seven ministering priests, shines eternally; when he has blazed upon the bosom and lap of his mother (earth), he is vociferous (with delight); day by day he never slumbers after he is born from the interior of the (spark) emitting wood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मि॒त्रा॒युधो॑ म॒रुता॑मिव प्र॒याः प्र॑थम॒जा ब्रह्म॑णो॒ विश्व॒मिद्वि॑दुः । द्यु॒म्नव॒द्ब्रह्म॑ कुशि॒कास॒ एरि॑र॒ एक॑एको॒ दमे॑ अ॒ग्निं समी॑धिरे
shlokas.transliteration: amitra-yúdhaḥ ǀ marútām-iva ǀ pra-yā́ḥ ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ít ǀ viduḥ ǀdyumná-vat ǀ bráhma ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ ékaḥ-ekaḥ ǀ dáme ǀ agním ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheKuśikas, the first-born ofBrahmā, armed against enemies like the energies of theMaruts, comprehend the universe; they have uttered the prayer accompanied by the oblation; they have one by one lightedAgniin this dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य त्वा॑ प्रय॒ति य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्होत॑श्चिकि॒त्वोऽवृ॑णीमही॒ह । ध्रु॒वम॑या ध्रु॒वमु॒ताश॑मिष्ठाः प्रजा॒नन्वि॒द्वाँ उप॑ याहि॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ tvā ǀ pra-yatí ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀ hótaríti ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ávṛṇīmahi ǀ ihá ǀdhruvám ǀ ayāḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ utá ǀ aśamiṣṭhāḥ ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, offerer of oblations, cognizant of rites, inasmuch as we have recourse to you today in this progressing sacrifice, therefore do you steadily convey (the offering to the gods), or tranquilly be at rest, and knowing (the purport of our acts), and wise (in all respects), approach (and accept) theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒च्छन्ति॑ त्वा सो॒म्यास॒: सखा॑यः सु॒न्वन्ति॒ सोमं॒ दध॑ति॒ प्रयां॑सि । तिति॑क्षन्ते अ॒भिश॑स्तिं॒ जना॑ना॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वदा कश्च॒न हि प्र॑के॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: icchánti ǀ tvā ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ sunvánti ǀ sómam ǀ dádhati ǀ práyāṃsi ǀtítikṣante ǀ abhí-śastim ǀ jánānām ǀ índra ǀ tvát ǀ ā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ hí ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearers of the libations desire you; your friends pour forth theSoma; they offer copious oblations; (supported by) you they endure patiently the calumny of men, for who is so renowned as you are.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॑ दू॒रे प॑र॒मा चि॒द्रजां॒स्या तु प्र या॑हि हरिवो॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । स्थि॒राय॒ वृष्णे॒ सव॑ना कृ॒तेमा यु॒क्ता ग्रावा॑णः समिधा॒ने अ॒ग्नौ
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ dūré ǀ paramā́ ǀ cit ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ tú ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀsthirā́ya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ sávanā ǀ kṛtā́ ǀ imā́ ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ sam-idhāné ǀ agnáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Master of tawny steeds, the remotest regions are not remote for you; then come quickly with your horses; to you the steady showerer (of benefits), these sacrifices are presented; the stones (for bruising theSoma) are ready, as the fire is being kindled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: सु॒शिप्रो॑ म॒घवा॒ तरु॑त्रो म॒हाव्रा॑तस्तुविकू॒र्मिॠघा॑वान् । यदु॒ग्रो धा बा॑धि॒तो मर्त्ये॑षु॒ क्व१॒॑ त्या ते॑ वृषभ वी॒र्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ su-śípraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ tárutraḥ ǀ mahā́-vrātaḥ ǀ tuvi-kūrmíḥ ǀ ṛ́ghāvān ǀyát ǀ ugráḥ ǀ dhā́ḥ ǀ bādhitáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ kvá ǀ tyā́ ǀ te ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), who areIndra, the wearer of the helmet, the professor of opulence, the conveyor (of men beyond the evil), the leader of the numerous troops (of theMaruts), the achiever of many great deeds, the devastation of hostile (regions), the terror of your foes, where are those heroic deeds (which you have performed) against the mortal (asuras) when opposed (by them in battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि ष्मा॑ च्या॒वय॒न्नच्यु॑ता॒न्येको॑ वृ॒त्रा चर॑सि॒ जिघ्न॑मानः । तव॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पर्व॑ता॒सोऽनु॑ व्र॒ताय॒ निमि॑तेव तस्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ cyaváyan ǀ ácyutāni ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ cárasi ǀ jíghnamānaḥ ǀtáva ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ya ǀ nímitā-iva ǀ tasthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alone casting down the firmly-footed (asuras) proceed, destroying theVṛtras, and obedient to your command the heaven and earth and the mountains stood as if immoveable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ताभ॑ये पुरुहूत॒ श्रवो॑भि॒रेको॑ दृ॒ळ्हम॑वदो वृत्र॒हा सन् । इ॒मे चि॑दिन्द्र॒ रोद॑सी अपा॒रे यत्सं॑गृ॒भ्णा म॑घवन्का॒शिरित्ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ ábhaye ǀ puru-hūta ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ avadaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sán ǀimé ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apāré íti ǀ yát ǀ sam-gṛbhṇā́ḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ kāśíḥ ǀ ít ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alone, when invoked by many, and the slayer ofVṛtra, by your prowess, did say firmly (to the gods), fear not!Indra, endowed with opulence, vast is your grasp, wherewith you have seized these unbounded regions, heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सू त॑ इन्द्र प्र॒वता॒ हरि॑भ्यां॒ प्र ते॒ वज्र॑: प्रमृ॒णन्ने॑तु॒ शत्रू॑न् । ज॒हि प्र॑ती॒चो अ॑नू॒चः परा॑चो॒ विश्वं॑ स॒त्यं कृ॑णुहि वि॒ष्टम॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pra-vátā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ vájraḥ ǀ pra-mṛṇán ǀ etu ǀ śátrūn ǀjahí ǀ pratīcáḥ ǀ anūcáḥ ǀ párācaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ satyám ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ viṣṭám ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let (your car),Indra, drawn by your horses (rush) downwards (upon theasuras); let your destroying thunder-bolt fall upon your enemies; slay those that assail in front or in rear, or that fly (from the combat); make the universe (the abode of) truth; (let such power) be concentrated in you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ धायु॒रद॑धा॒ मर्त्या॒याभ॑क्तं चिद्भजते गे॒ह्यं१॒॑ सः । भ॒द्रा त॑ इन्द्र सुम॒तिर्घृ॒ताची॑ स॒हस्र॑दाना पुरुहूत रा॒तिः
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ dhā́yuḥ ǀ ádadhāḥ ǀ mártyāya ǀ ábhaktam ǀ cit ǀ bhajate ǀ gehyám ǀ sáḥ ǀbhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ sahásra-dānā ǀ puru-hūta ǀ rātíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man to whom you grant, lord of power, (your good-will), enjoys unprecedented domestic (prosperity);Indra, who are invoked by many, your auspicous favour, which is obtained by oblations, is the giver of unbounded wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हदा॑नुं पुरुहूत क्षि॒यन्त॑मह॒स्तमि॑न्द्र॒ सं पि॑ण॒क्कुणा॑रुम् । अ॒भि वृ॒त्रं वर्ध॑मानं॒ पिया॑रुम॒पाद॑मिन्द्र त॒वसा॑ जघन्थ
shlokas.transliteration: sahá-dānum ǀ puru-hūta ǀ kṣiyántam ǀ ahastám ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀ kúṇārum ǀabhí ǀ vṛtrám ǀ várdhamānam ǀ píyārum ǀ apā́dam ǀ indra ǀ tavásā ǀ jaghantha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is invoked by many, grind to dust the reviling malevolentVṛtraopposing you, dwelling with the mother of theDānavas, and increasing in might, until having deprived him ofhandand foot, you have destroyed him by your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि सा॑म॒नामि॑षि॒रामि॑न्द्र॒ भूमिं॑ म॒हीम॑पा॒रां सद॑ने ससत्थ । अस्त॑भ्ना॒द्द्यां वृ॑ष॒भो अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मर्ष॒न्त्वाप॒स्त्वये॒ह प्रसू॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sāmanā́m ǀ iṣirā́m ǀ indra ǀ bhū́mim ǀ mahī́m ǀ apārā́m ǀ sádane ǀ sasattha ǀástabhnāt ǀ dyā́m ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ árṣantu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ ihá ǀ prá-sūtāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have fixed tranquil in its position the vast unbounded and wandering earth; the showerer (of benefits) has upheld the heaven and the firmament; let the waters engendered by you here descend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ला॒तृ॒णो व॒ल इ॑न्द्र व्र॒जो गोः पु॒रा हन्तो॒र्भय॑मानो॒ व्या॑र । सु॒गान्प॒थो अ॑कृणोन्नि॒रज॒ा गाः प्राव॒न्वाणी॑: पुरुहू॒तं धम॑न्तीः
shlokas.transliteration: alātṛṇáḥ ǀ valáḥ ǀ indra ǀ vrajáḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ hántoḥ ǀ bháyamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ āra ǀsu-gā́n ǀ patháḥ ǀ akṛṇot ǀ niḥ-áje ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ āvan ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ dhámantīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The heavy cloud, the receptacle of water, dreading you its destroyer, opened out before (you had cast your bolt); thenIndramade easily-traversed paths for the waters to issue, and desirable and loud sounding they proceeded to the (waters of the earth) invoked of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एको॒ द्वे वसु॑मती समी॒ची इन्द्र॒ आ प॑प्रौ पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् । उ॒तान्तरि॑क्षाद॒भि न॑: समी॒क इ॒षो र॒थीः स॒युज॑: शूर॒ वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ékaḥ ǀ dvé íti ǀ vásumatī íti vásu-matī ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀutá ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sam-īké ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ sa-yújaḥ ǀ śūra ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraalone has filled the two,both earth and heaven mutually combined, and abounding with wealth; do you hero, mounted in your car, come with your harnessed horses from the firmament, impatient to be near us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दिश॒: सूर्यो॒ न मि॑नाति॒ प्रदि॑ष्टा दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ हर्य॑श्वप्रसूताः । सं यदान॒ळध्व॑न॒ आदिदश्वै॑र्वि॒मोच॑नं कृणुते॒ तत्त्व॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: díśaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mināti ǀ prá-diṣṭāḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ háryaśva-prasūtāḥ ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ vi-mócanam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ tát ǀ tú ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūryaharms not the quarters (of the horizon), set open daily (for his journey), the progeny ofHaryaśva; when he has traversed the roads (he is to travel), then he lets loose his horses, for such is his office.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दिदृ॑क्षन्त उ॒षसो॒ याम॑न्न॒क्तोर्वि॒वस्व॑त्या॒ महि॑ चि॒त्रमनी॑कम् । विश्वे॑ जानन्ति महि॒ना यदागा॒दिन्द्र॑स्य॒ कर्म॒ सुकृ॑ता पु॒रूणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dídṛkṣante ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ aktóḥ ǀ vivásvatyāḥ ǀ máhi ǀ citrám ǀ ánīkam ǀvíśve ǀ jānanti ǀ mahinā́ ǀ yát ǀ ā́ ǀ ágāt ǀ índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ purū́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Al,l me are anxious to behold the great and variegated host (of the solar rays) at the issuing of the dawn after the night has been displaced; and when the morning has come, they recognize the many great and glorious acts ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॒ ज्योति॒र्निहि॑तं व॒क्षणा॑स्वा॒मा प॒क्वं च॑रति॒ बिभ्र॑ती॒ गौः । विश्वं॒ स्वाद्म॒ सम्भृ॑तमु॒स्रिया॑यां॒ यत्सी॒मिन्द्रो॒ अद॑धा॒द्भोज॑नाय
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ní-hitam ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ āmā́ ǀ pakvám ǀ carati ǀ bíbhratī ǀ gáuḥ ǀvíśvam ǀ svā́dma ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ usríyāyām ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ índraḥ ǀ ádadhāt ǀ bhójanāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A great light has been shed upon the rivers; the cow yet immature grazes, charged with the ripe (milk), forIndrahas plural ced in the cow all this collected sweetness for food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ दृह्य॑ यामको॒शा अ॑भूवन्य॒ज्ञाय॑ शिक्ष गृण॒ते सखि॑भ्यः । दु॒र्मा॒यवो॑ दु॒रेवा॒ मर्त्या॑सो निष॒ङ्गिणो॑ रि॒पवो॒ हन्त्वा॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ dṛ́hya ǀ yāma-kośā́ḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ śikṣa ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀduḥ-māyávaḥ ǀ duḥ-évāḥ ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ niṣaṅgíṇaḥ ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ hántvāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, be firm, for there are obstructors of your path; secure to the worshipper and his friends (the means of completing) the sacrifice; mortal enemies bearing bows, armed with mischievous weapons, and coming with evil intent, must be destroyed (by you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं घोष॑: शृण्वेऽव॒मैर॒मित्रै॑र्ज॒ही न्ये॑ष्व॒शनिं॒ तपि॑ष्ठाम् । वृ॒श्चेम॒धस्ता॒द्वि रु॑जा॒ सह॑स्व ज॒हि रक्षो॑ मघवन्र॒न्धय॑स्व
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ghóṣaḥ ǀ śṛṇve ǀ avamáiḥ ǀ amítraiḥ ǀ jahí ǀ ní ǀ eṣu ǀ aśánim ǀ tápiṣṭhām ǀvṛścá ǀ īm ǀ adhástāt ǀ ví ǀ ruja ǀ sáhasva ǀ jahí ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ randháyasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sound (of your bolt) has been heard by the approaching foes; hurl upon them the consuming thunder-bolt, cut them up by the root, oppose;Maghavan, overcome, slay therākṣasas, complete (the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वृ॑ह॒ रक्ष॑: स॒हमू॑लमिन्द्र वृ॒श्चा मध्यं॒ प्रत्यग्रं॑ शृणीहि । आ कीव॑तः सल॒लूकं॑ चकर्थ ब्रह्म॒द्विष्॒ तपु॑षिं हे॒तिम॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vṛha ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ sahá-mūlam ǀ indra ǀ vṛścá ǀ mádhyam ǀ práti ǀ ágram ǀ śṛṇīhi ǀā́ ǀ kī́vataḥ ǀ salalū́kam ǀ cakartha ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ tápuṣim ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural ck therākṣasas,Indra, by the root; cut as under the middle, blight the summit; to whatever remote (regions) you have driven the sinner, cast upon the enemy of theVedayour consuming weapon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्तये॑ वा॒जिभि॑श्च प्रणेत॒: सं यन्म॒हीरिष॑ आ॒सत्सि॑ पू॒र्वीः । रा॒यो व॒न्तारो॑ बृह॒तः स्या॑मा॒स्मे अ॑स्तु॒ भग॑ इन्द्र प्र॒जावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: svastáye ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀ sám ǀ yát ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā-sátsi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ vantā́raḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ asmé íti ǀ astu ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ indra ǀ prajā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Regulator (of the world, provide us) with horses for our welfare, and when you are seated near to us may we become mighty, enjoying abundant food, and ample riches, and may there be to us wealth accompanied by progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ भर॒ भग॑मिन्द्र द्यु॒मन्तं॒ नि ते॑ दे॒ष्णस्य॑ धीमहि प्ररे॒के । ऊ॒र्व इ॑व पप्रथे॒ कामो॑ अ॒स्मे तमा पृ॑ण वसुपते॒ वसू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ bhágam ǀ indra ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ ní ǀ te ǀ deṣṇásya ǀ dhīmahi ǀ pra-reké ǀūrváḥ-iva ǀ paprathe ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǀ vasu-pate ǀ vásūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us,Indra, splendid affluence; we rely on the bounty of you who are fond of giving; our desire is as insatiable as the fire of the ocean; appease it, lord of infinite riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं कामं॑ मन्दया॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॑श्च॒न्द्रव॑ता॒ राध॑सा प॒प्रथ॑श्च । स्व॒र्यवो॑ म॒तिभि॒स्तुभ्यं॒ विप्रा॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ वाह॑: कुशि॒कासो॑ अक्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ kā́mam ǀ mandaya ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ candrá-vatā ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ papráthaḥ ǀ ca ǀsvaḥ-yávaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vā́haḥ ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ akran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratify this our desire (of wealth) with cows, with horses, with shining treasure, and make us renowned; the wiseKuśikas, desirous of heaven, offer praise to youIndra, with pious (prayers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ गो॒त्रा द॑र्दृहि गोपते॒ गाः सम॒स्मभ्यं॑ स॒नयो॑ यन्तु॒ वाजा॑: । दि॒वक्षा॑ असि वृषभ स॒त्यशु॑ष्मो॒ऽस्मभ्यं॒ सु म॑घवन्बोधि गो॒दाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gotrā́ ǀ dardṛhi ǀ go-pate ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sanáyaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀdivákṣāḥ ǀ asi ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ satyá-śuṣmaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sú ǀ magha-van ǀ bodhi ǀ go-dā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, lord of cattle, (divide the clouds and send us) rain, whence nutritious food may come to us; showerer (of benefits), you are spread through the sky, and powerful through truth;Maghavan, consider yourself as our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndradistinguished in this combat; the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शास॒द्वह्नि॑र्दुहि॒तुर्न॒प्त्यं॑ गाद्वि॒द्वाँ ऋ॒तस्य॒ दीधि॑तिं सप॒र्यन् । पि॒ता यत्र॑ दुहि॒तुः सेक॑मृ॒ञ्जन्त्सं श॒ग्म्ये॑न॒ मन॑सा दध॒न्वे
shlokas.transliteration: śā́sat ǀ váhniḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ naptyám ǀ gāt ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́dhitim ǀ saparyán ǀpitā́ ǀ yátra ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ sékam ǀ ṛñján ǀ sám ǀ śagmyéna ǀ mánasā ǀ dadhanvé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sonless father, regulating (the contract), refers to his grandson, (the son) of his daughter, and relying on the efficiency of the rite, honours (his son-in-law) with valuable gifts; the father, trusting to the impregnation of the daughter, supports himself with a tranquil mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न जा॒मये॒ तान्वो॑ रि॒क्थमा॑रैक्च॒कार॒ गर्भं॑ सनि॒तुर्नि॒धान॑म् । यदी॑ मा॒तरो॑ ज॒नय॑न्त॒ वह्नि॑म॒न्यः क॒र्ता सु॒कृतो॑र॒न्य ऋ॒न्धन्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ jāmáye ǀ tā́nvaḥ ǀ rikthám ǀ araik ǀ cakā́ra ǀ gárbham ǀ sanitúḥ ǀ ni-dhā́nam ǀyádi ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ janáyanta ǀ váhnim ǀ anyáḥ ǀ kartā́ ǀ su-kṛ́toḥ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ṛndhán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(A son) born of the body, does not transfer (paternal) wealth to a sister; he has made (her) the recptacle of the embryo of the husband; if the parents procreate children (of either sex), one is the performer of holy acts, the other is to be enriched (with gifts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्ज॑ज्ञे जु॒ह्वा॒३॒॑ रेज॑मानो म॒हस्पु॒त्राँ अ॑रु॒षस्य॑ प्र॒यक्षे॑ । म॒हान्गर्भो॒ मह्या जा॒तमे॑षां म॒ही प्र॒वृद्धर्य॑श्वस्य य॒ज्ञैः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jajñe ǀ juhvā́ ǀ réjamānaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ putrā́n ǀ aruṣásya ǀ pra-yákṣe ǀmahā́n ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ jātám ǀ eṣām ǀ mahī́ ǀ pra-vṛ́t ǀ hári-aśvasya ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For the worship of the resplendent (Indra),Agni, glowing with flame, has begotten mighty sons; great was the germ, and great was their birth, and great was their efficacy, for the worship ofHaryaśva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि जैत्री॑रसचन्त स्पृधा॒नं महि॒ ज्योति॒स्तम॑सो॒ निर॑जानन् । तं जा॑न॒तीः प्रत्युदा॑यन्नु॒षास॒: पति॒र्गवा॑मभव॒देक॒ इन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ jáitrīḥ ǀ asacanta ǀ spṛdhānám ǀ máhi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ ajānan ǀtám ǀ jānatī́ḥ ǀ práti ǀ út ǀ āyan ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ gávām ǀ abhavat ǀ ékaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The victorious (Maruts) associated (withIndrawhen contending withVṛtra) perceived a great light issuing from the darkness. The dawns recognizing him (as the sun) arose, and Indra was the sole sovereign of the rays (of light).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ळौ स॒तीर॒भि धीरा॑ अतृन्दन्प्रा॒चाहि॑न्व॒न्मन॑सा स॒प्त विप्रा॑: । विश्वा॑मविन्दन्प॒थ्या॑मृ॒तस्य॑ प्रजा॒नन्नित्ता नम॒सा वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: vīḷáu ǀ satī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ atṛndan ǀ prācā́ ǀ ahinvan ǀ mánasā ǀ saptá ǀ víprāḥ ǀvíśvām ǀ avindan ǀ pathyā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pra-jānán ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven intelligent ages (theaṅgirasas) having ascertained that (the cows) were concealed in the strong (cavern), propitiated (Indra) by mental devotion; they recovered them all by the path of sacrifice; for Indra, knowing (their pious acts), and offering them homage, entered (the cave).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दद्यदी॑ स॒रमा॑ रु॒ग्णमद्रे॒र्महि॒ पाथ॑: पू॒र्व्यं स॒ध्र्य॑क्कः । अग्रं॑ नयत्सु॒पद्यक्ष॑राणा॒मच्छा॒ रवं॑ प्रथ॒मा जा॑न॒ती गा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: vidát ǀ yádi ǀ sarámā ǀ rugṇám ǀ ádreḥ ǀ máhi ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ sadhryák ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀágram ǀ nayat ǀ su-pádī ǀ ákṣarāṇām ǀ áccha ǀ rávam ǀ prathamā́ ǀ jānatī́ ǀ gāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenSaramādiscovered the broken (entrance) of the mountain, thenIndramade great and ample (provision) for her young, as previously (promised); then the sure-footed (animal), forest recognizing their lowing, proceeded, and came to the presence of the imperishable kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग॑च्छदु॒ विप्र॑तमः सखी॒यन्नसू॑दयत्सु॒कृते॒ गर्भ॒मद्रि॑: । स॒सान॒ मर्यो॒ युव॑भिर्मख॒स्यन्नथा॑भव॒दङ्गि॑राः स॒द्यो अर्च॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ágacchat ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vípra-tamaḥ ǀ sakhi-yán ǀ ásūdayat ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ gárbham ǀ ádriḥ ǀsasā́na ǀ máryaḥ ǀ yúva-bhiḥ ǀ makhasyán ǀ átha ǀ abhavat ǀ áṅgirāḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ árcan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most sage (Indra), desirous of the friendship of the (aṅgirasas), went to the cave, and the mountain yielded its contents to the valiant (deity), aided by the youthfulMaruts, equally wishing (to conciliate the sages); the destroyer (of theasuras) recovered (the cattle), and immediately aṅgirasas became his worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒तःस॑तः प्रति॒मानं॑ पुरो॒भूर्विश्वा॑ वेद॒ जनि॑मा॒ हन्ति॒ शुष्ण॑म् । प्र णो॑ दि॒वः प॑द॒वीर्ग॒व्युरर्च॒न्त्सखा॒ सखीँ॑रमुञ्च॒न्निर॑व॒द्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: satáḥ-sataḥ ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ puraḥ-bhū́ḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ veda ǀ jánima ǀ hánti ǀ śúṣṇam ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ árcan ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhīn ǀ amuñcat ǀ níḥ ǀ avadyā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is the type of all that is excellent the anticipator (of his foes), he who knows all that is born, who destroysŚuṣṇa, the far-seeing, the restorer of cattle may he, a friend coming from heaven, honouring us as his friends, be free from all reproach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ग॑व्य॒ता मन॑सा सेदुर॒र्कैः कृ॑ण्वा॒नासो॑ अमृत॒त्वाय॑ गा॒तुम् । इ॒दं चि॒न्नु सद॑नं॒ भूर्ये॑षां॒ येन॒ मासाँ॒ असि॑षासन्नृ॒तेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ gavyatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ seduḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ kṛṇvānā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvā́ya ǀ gātúm ǀidám ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ sádanam ǀ bhū́ri ǀ eṣām ǀ yéna ǀ mā́sān ǀ ásisāsan ǀ ṛténa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Theaṅgirasas, with minds intent on their cattle, (sat down to worshipIndra) with hymns, following the road to immortality; great was their person verance by which they sought for months to accomplish (their ends).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्पश्य॑माना अमदन्न॒भि स्वं पय॑: प्र॒त्नस्य॒ रेत॑सो॒ दुघा॑नाः । वि रोद॑सी अतप॒द्घोष॑ एषां जा॒ते नि॒ष्ठामद॑धु॒र्गोषु॑ वी॒रान्
shlokas.transliteration: sam-páśyamānāḥ ǀ amadan ǀ abhí ǀ svám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pratnásya ǀ rétasaḥ ǀ dúghānāḥ ǀví ǀ ródasī íti ǀ atapat ǀ ghóṣaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ jāté ǀ niḥ-sthā́m ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ vīrā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Contemplating their own (cattle) giving milk to their former progeny (theaṅgirasas) were delighted; their shouts spread through heaven and earth; they replaced the recovered kine in their plural ces, and stationed guards over the cows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जा॒तेभि॑र्वृत्र॒हा सेदु॑ ह॒व्यैरुदु॒स्रिया॑ असृज॒दिन्द्रो॑ अ॒र्कैः । उ॒रू॒च्य॑स्मै घृ॒तव॒द्भर॑न्ती॒ मधु॒ स्वाद्म॑ दुदुह॒अ जेन्या॒ गौः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jātébhiḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ út ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ índraḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀurūcī́ ǀ asmai ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ bhárantī ǀ mádhu ǀ svā́dma ǀ duduhe ǀ jényā ǀ gáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the slayer ofVṛtra,let loose the milch kine, assisted by theMaruts, born for his aid, and entitled to praises and oblations, and the excellent (cows) contributing abundantly to sacred offerings, and yielding the butter of libation, milked for him sweet (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒त्रे चि॑च्चक्रु॒: सद॑नं॒ सम॑स्मै॒ महि॒ त्विषी॑मत्सु॒कृतो॒ वि हि ख्यन् । वि॒ष्क॒भ्नन्त॒: स्कम्भ॑नेना॒ जनि॑त्री॒ आसी॑ना ऊ॒र्ध्वं र॑भ॒सं वि मि॑न्वन्
shlokas.transliteration: pitré ǀ cit ǀ cakruḥ ǀ sádanam ǀ sám ǀ asmai ǀ máhi ǀ tvíṣi-mat ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ khyán ǀvi-skabhnántaḥ ǀ skámbhanena ǀ jánitrī íti ǀ ā́sīnāḥ ǀ ūrdhvám ǀ rabhasám ǀ ví ǀ minvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They (theaṅgirasas) performing pious acts made for their protector a spacious and splendid abode which they celebrated; seated (at the sacrifice) and supporting with the pillar (of the firmament) the parents (of all things heaven and earth), they established the rapidIndraon high (in heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही यदि॑ धि॒षणा॑ शि॒श्नथे॒ धात्स॑द्यो॒वृधं॑ वि॒भ्वं१॒॑ रोद॑स्योः । गिरो॒ यस्मि॑न्ननव॒द्याः स॑मी॒चीर्विश्वा॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ तवि॑षी॒रनु॑त्ताः
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ ǀ yádi ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ śiśnáthe ǀ dhā́t ǀ sadyaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ vi-bhvám ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀgíraḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ anavadyā́ḥ ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ ánuttāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as our devout praise has appointed a thiriving ruler for the regulation of heaven and earth, to whom faultless and appropriate commendations (are due), therefore are all the energies ofIndraspontaneously exerted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मह्या ते॑ स॒ख्यं व॑श्मि श॒क्तीरा वृ॑त्र॒घ्ने नि॒युतो॑ यन्ति पू॒र्वीः । महि॑ स्तो॒त्रमव॒ आग॑न्म सू॒रेर॒स्माकं॒ सु म॑घवन्बोधि गो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ sakhyám ǀ vaśmi ǀ śaktī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛtra-ghné ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀmáhi ǀ stotrám ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ sūréḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ sú ǀ magha-van ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I wish,Indra, for your friendship, and (the exercise of) your powers;many heroes come to the slayer ofVṛtra; we offer to you, sage, great praise and oblations; consider yourself,Maghavan, as our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॒ क्षेत्रं॑ पु॒रु श्च॒न्द्रं वि॑वि॒द्वानादित्सखि॑भ्यश्च॒रथं॒ समै॑रत् । इन्द्रो॒ नृभि॑रजन॒द्दीद्या॑नः सा॒कं सूर्य॑मु॒षसं॑ गा॒तुम॒ग्निम्
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ kṣétram ǀ purú ǀ candrám ǀ vividvā́n ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ carátham ǀ sám ǀ airát ǀíndraḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ajanat ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǀ sākám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ gātúm ǀ agním ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wide fields, vast treasure, (spacious) pastures has the much-knowing (Indra) bestowed upon his friends; the radiant Indra with the leaders (of rites, theMaruts) genitive rated the sun, the dawn, the earth and fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पश्चि॑दे॒ष वि॒भ्वो॒३॒॑ दमू॑ना॒: प्र स॒ध्रीची॑रसृजद्वि॒श्वश्च॑न्द्राः । मध्व॑: पुना॒नाः क॒विभि॑: प॒वित्रै॒र्द्युभि॑र्हिन्वन्त्य॒क्तुभि॒र्धनु॑त्रीः
shlokas.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ cit ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ vi-bhváḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ prá ǀ sadhrī́cīḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ viśvá-candrāḥ ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ pavítraiḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ hinvanti ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ dhánutrīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This lowly-mindedIndrahas created the wide-spread, commingled, all-delighting waters; and they, purifying the sweet (libations) with the sage purifiers, and being benevolent (to all), proceed with (the revolutions) of days and nights.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ कृ॒ष्णे वसु॑धिती जिहाते उ॒भे सूर्य॑स्य मं॒हना॒ यज॑त्रे । परि॒ यत्ते॑ महि॒मानं॑ वृ॒जध्यै॒ सखा॑य इन्द्र॒ काम्या॑ ऋजि॒प्याः
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ kṛṣṇé íti ǀ vásudhitī íti vásu-dhitī ǀ jihāte íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀ yájatre íti ǀpári ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ vṛjádhyai ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ kā́myāḥ ǀ ṛjipyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two adorable (alternations of) day and night, upholding (all things) by the might of the sun, successively revolve; your sincere and acceptable friends (theMaruts) are ready to encounter (your foes) and maintain your greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पति॑र्भव वृत्रहन्त्सू॒नृता॑नां गि॒रां वि॒श्वायु॑र्वृष॒भो व॑यो॒धाः । आ नो॑ गहि स॒ख्येभि॑: शि॒वेभि॑र्म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: सर॒ण्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: pátiḥ ǀ bhava ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ girā́m ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gahi ǀ sakhyébhiḥ ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ saraṇyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, do you, who is long lived the showerer (of benefits), the giver of food, be the lord of our true praises, repairing (to the sacrifice), come to us great, with great, friendly, and auspicious protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ङ्गिर॒स्वन्नम॑सा सप॒र्यन्नव्यं॑ कृणोमि॒ सन्य॑से पुरा॒जाम् । द्रुहो॒ वि या॑हि बहु॒ला अदे॑वी॒: स्व॑श्च नो मघवन्त्सा॒तये॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀ námasā ǀ saparyán ǀ návyam ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ sányase ǀ purā-jā́m ǀdrúhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yāhi ǀ bahulā́ḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worshipping him with reverence, like anaṅgiras, I make the ancient (Indra) renovate to accept the oblation; destroy the many impious oppressors (of your worshippers) and bestow upon us,Maghavan, yours own (wealth) for our acceptance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मिह॑: पाव॒काः प्रत॑ता अभूवन्त्स्व॒स्ति न॑: पिपृहि पा॒रमा॑साम् । इन्द्र॒ त्वं र॑थि॒रः पा॑हि नो रि॒षो म॒क्षूम॑क्षू कृणुहि गो॒जितो॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: míhaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀ prá-tatāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ pipṛhi ǀ pārám ǀ āsām ǀíndra ǀ tvám ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ naḥ ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ makṣú-makṣu ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ go-jítaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You purifying water have been spread abroad; fill their beds for our welfare; riding on the car, defend us from the malevolent, and make us quickly the conquerors of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदे॑दिष्ट वृत्र॒हा गोप॑ति॒र्गा अ॒न्तः कृ॒ष्णाँ अ॑रु॒षैर्धाम॑भिर्गात् । प्र सू॒नृता॑ दि॒शमा॑न ऋ॒तेन॒ दुर॑श्च॒ विश्वा॑ अवृणो॒दप॒ स्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: ádediṣṭa ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ antáríti ǀ kṛṣṇā́n ǀ aruṣáiḥ ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ gāt ǀprá ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ diśámānaḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ dúraḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avṛṇot ǀ ápa ǀ svā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the slayer ofVṛtra, the lord of herds, has discovered the cattle, and by his radiant effulgence driven away the black (asuras), and indicating with veracity (to theaṅgirasas) the honest (kine), heshutthe gate uon all their own cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praise), terriblein battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ सोमं॑ सोमपते॒ पिबे॒मं माध्यं॑दिनं॒ सव॑नं॒ चारु॒ यत्ते॑ । प्र॒प्रुथ्या॒ शिप्रे॑ मघवन्नृजीषिन्वि॒मुच्या॒ हरी॑ इ॒ह मा॑दयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sómam ǀ soma-pate ǀ píba ǀ imám ǀ mā́dhyandinam ǀ sávanam ǀ cā́ru ǀ yát ǀ te ǀpra-prúthya ǀ śípre íti ǀ magha-van ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ vi-múcya ǀ hárī íti ǀ ihá ǀ mādayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, lord of theSoma, drink this Soma which is grateful to you at noon-day sacrifice,Maghavan, partake of the spiritless Soma, unyoke your horses, and filling their jaws (with fodder), exhilarate them at this ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गवा॑शिरं म॒न्थिन॑मिन्द्र शु॒क्रं पिबा॒ सोमं॑ ररि॒मा ते॒ मदा॑य । ब्र॒ह्म॒कृता॒ मारु॑तेना ग॒णेन॑ स॒जोषा॑ रु॒द्रैस्तृ॒पदा वृ॑षस्व
shlokas.transliteration: gó-āśiram ǀ manthínam ǀ indra ǀ śukrám ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǀbrahma-kṛ́tā ǀ mā́rutena ǀ gaṇéna ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ tṛpát ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, drink theSomamixed with milk, with butter-milk, or fresh; we offer it for your exhilaration, associated with the devout company of theMarutsand theRudras; drink it till you are satisfied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॒ शुष्मं॒ ये तवि॑षी॒मव॑र्ध॒न्नर्च॑न्त इन्द्र म॒रुत॑स्त॒ ओज॑: । माध्यं॑दिने॒ सव॑ने वज्रहस्त॒ पिबा॑ रु॒द्रेभि॒: सग॑णः सुशिप्र
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ yé ǀ táviṣīm ǀ ávardhan ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ indra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀmā́dhyandine ǀ sávane ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ píba ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ su-śipra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These are theMaruts,Indra, who, worshipping your prowess, augment your withering force (by their aid); attended by theRudras, drink, wielder of the thunder-bolt, and handsome-chinned, at the noon-day sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त इन्न्व॑स्य॒ मधु॑मद्विविप्र॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ शर्धो॑ म॒रुतो॒ य आस॑न् । येभि॑र्वृ॒त्रस्ये॑षि॒तो वि॒वेदा॑म॒र्मणो॒ मन्य॑मानस्य॒ मर्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vivipre ǀ índrasya ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ā́san ǀyébhiḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ vivéda ǀ amarmáṇaḥ ǀ mányamānasya ǀ márma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those were theMarutswho were the strength ofIndra, and genitive ly encouraged him; animated by whom he pierced the vital part ofVṛtra, fancying himself vulnerable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒नु॒ष्वदि॑न्द्र॒ सव॑नं जुषा॒णः पिबा॒ सोमं॒ शश्व॑ते वी॒र्या॑य । स आ व॑वृत्स्व हर्यश्व य॒ज्ञैः स॑र॒ण्युभि॑र॒पो अर्णा॑ सिसर्षि
shlokas.transliteration: manuṣvát ǀ indra ǀ sávanam ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ śáśvate ǀ vīryā́ya ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ hari-aśva ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ saraṇyú-bhiḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ árṇā ǀ sisarṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Phased with the sacrifice, as if it was that ofManu, drink,Indra, theSoma, for the sake of perpetual vigour; come, lord of the tawny steeds, with the adorableMaruts, and with the traversers (of the air); send down the waters (of the firmament) to (blend with) the waters of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒पो यद्ध॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अत्याँ॑ इव॒ प्रासृ॑ज॒: सर्त॒वाजौ । शया॑नमिन्द्र॒ चर॑ता व॒धेन॑ वव्रि॒वांसं॒ परि॑ दे॒वीरदे॑वम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ átyān-iva ǀ prá ǀ ásṛjaḥ ǀ sártavái ǀ ājáu ǀśáyānam ǀ indra ǀ cáratā ǀ vadhéna ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ pári ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ádevam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as you have slain with active strife the slumbering, darking, water-investingVṛtra, you have let forth the bright waters like horses (rushing) into battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यजा॑म॒ इन्नम॑सा वृ॒द्धमिन्द्रं॑ बृ॒हन्त॑मृ॒ष्वम॒जरं॒ युवा॑नम् । यस्य॑ प्रि॒ये म॒मतु॑र्य॒ज्ञिय॑स्य॒ न रोद॑सी महि॒मानं॑ म॒माते॑
shlokas.transliteration: yájāmaḥ ǀ ít ǀ námasā ǀ vṛddhám ǀ índram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ yúvānam ǀyásya ǀ priyé íti ǀ mamátuḥ ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ mamā́te íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore we sacrifice with reverence to the vast and mightyIndra, who is adorable, undecaying, young; whose magnitude the unbounded heaven and earth have not measures, nor can measure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ कर्म॒ सुकृ॑ता पु॒रूणि॑ व्र॒तानि॑ दे॒वा न मि॑नन्ति॒ विश्वे॑ । दा॒धार॒ यः पृ॑थि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां ज॒जान॒ सूर्य॑मु॒षसं॑ सु॒दंसा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ vratā́ni ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ víśve ǀdādhā́ra ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ jajā́na ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the gods cannot detract from the many glorious exploits, and pious works ofIndra; he who has upheld earth, and heaven, and the firmament, and who, the performer of great deeds, has engendered the sun and the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रो॑घ स॒त्यं तव॒ तन्म॑हि॒त्वं स॒द्यो यज्जा॒तो अपि॑बो ह॒ सोम॑म् । न द्याव॑ इन्द्र त॒वस॑स्त॒ ओजो॒ नाहा॒ न मासा॑: श॒रदो॑ वरन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ádrogha ǀ satyám ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ yát ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ ha ǀ sómam ǀná ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ indra ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áhā ǀ ná ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ varanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Doer of no wrong, such was your true greatness, that as soon as born, you have quaffed theSoma; neither the heavens, nor days, nor months, nor years, resist the force of you who is mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं स॒द्यो अ॑पिबो जा॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ मदा॑य॒ सोमं॑ पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । यद्ध॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आवि॑वेशी॒रथा॑भवः पू॒र्व्यः का॒रुधा॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ apibaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ indra ǀ mádāya ǀ sómam ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ áviveśīḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as born in the highest heaven, you have quaffed,Indra, theSomafor your exhilaration; and when you had pervaded the heaven and earth, you became the primary artificer (of creation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॒न्नहिं॑ परि॒शया॑न॒मर्ण॑ ओजा॒यमा॑नं तुविजात॒ तव्या॑न् । न ते॑ महि॒त्वमनु॑ भू॒दध॒ द्यौर्यद॒न्यया॑ स्फि॒ग्या॒३॒॑ क्षामव॑स्थाः
shlokas.transliteration: áhan ǀ áhim ǀ pari-śáyānam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ ojāyámānam ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ távyān ǀná ǀ te ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ánu ǀ bhūt ǀ ádha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ yát ǀ anyáyā ǀ sphigyā́ ǀ kṣā́m ǀ ávasthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, from whom many are born; you who is vigorous have slain Ahi, enveloping the slumbering water and confiding in his prowess; yet the heaven apprehended not your greatness as you remained concealing the earth by on eof your flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञो हि त॑ इन्द्र॒ वर्ध॑नो॒ भूदु॒त प्रि॒यः सु॒तसो॑मो मि॒येध॑: । य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑व य॒ज्ञिय॒: सन्य॒ज्ञस्ते॒ वज्र॑महि॒हत्य॑ आवत्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñáḥ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ várdhanaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ utá ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sutá-somaḥ ǀ miyédhaḥ ǀyajñéna ǀ yajñám ǀ ava ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ sán ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ te ǀ vájram ǀ ahi-hátye ǀ āvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This our sacrifice,Indra, is your augmentation, for the rite in which theSomais effused is acceptable to you do you who is deserving of worship protect the worshipper by (the efficacy of) the worship, and may this sacrifice strengthen your thunderbolt for the slaying of Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञेनेन्द्र॒मव॒सा च॑क्रे अ॒र्वागैनं॑ सु॒म्नाय॒ नव्य॑से ववृत्याम् । यः स्तोमे॑भिर्वावृ॒धे पू॒र्व्येभि॒र्यो म॑ध्य॒मेभि॑रु॒त नूत॑नेभिः
shlokas.transliteration: yajñéna ǀ índram ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ cakre ǀ arvā́k ǀ ā́ ǀ enam ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ návyase ǀ vavṛtyām ǀyáḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ pūrvyébhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ madhyamébhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanebhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshipper, by his conservatory sacrifice, has madeIndrapresent; may Ibring him to my presence to obtain new wealth, him who has been exalted by praise, whether ancient, medieval, or recent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒वेष॒ यन्मा॑ धि॒षणा॑ ज॒जान॒ स्तवै॑ पु॒रा पार्या॒दिन्द्र॒मह्न॑: । अंह॑सो॒ यत्र॑ पी॒पर॒द्यथा॑ नो ना॒वेव॒ यान्त॑मु॒भये॑ हवन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: vivéṣa ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ jajā́na ǀ stávai ǀ purā́ ǀ pā́ryāt ǀ índram ǀ áhnaḥ ǀáṃhasaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ pīpárat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ nāvā́-iva ǀ yā́ntam ǀ ubháye ǀ havante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the thought of glorifyingIndraentered my mind, then I gave birth (to his praises); may I laud him before encountering distant (evil) days, whereby he may guide us beyond sin; for those on both sides of us invoke him, as (those on either bank of a river hail) a passenger in a boat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपू॑र्णो अस्य क॒लश॒: स्वाहा॒ सेक्ते॑व॒ कोशं॑ सिसिचे॒ पिब॑ध्यै । समु॑ प्रि॒या आव॑वृत्र॒न्मदा॑य प्रदक्षि॒णिद॒भि सोमा॑स॒ इन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́-pūrṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ kaláśaḥ ǀ svā́hā ǀ séktā-iva ǀ kóśam ǀ sisice ǀ píbadhyai ǀsám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avavṛtran ǀ mádāya ǀ pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vase is filled for him (withSoma); welcomeIndra; I pour it out for you to drink, as a water-carrier (pours water) from his bag; may the grateful Soma flow in reverence round Indra for his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वा॑ गभी॒रः पु॑रुहूत॒ सिन्धु॒र्नाद्र॑य॒: परि॒ षन्तो॑ वरन्त । इ॒त्था सखि॑भ्य इषि॒तो यदि॒न्द्रा दृ॒ळ्हं चि॒दरु॑जो॒ गव्य॑मू॒र्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ gabhīráḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sántaḥ ǀ varanta ǀitthā́ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ cit ǀ árujaḥ ǀ gávyam ǀ ūrvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked of many, the deep ocean arrests you not, nor do the accompanying mountains (stay you); and therefore, summoned by your friends, you have repressed the strong flame abiding in the abyss.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पर्व॑तानामुश॒ती उ॒पस्था॒दश्वे॑ इव॒ विषि॑ते॒ हास॑माने । गावे॑व शु॒भ्रे मा॒तरा॑ रिहा॒णे विपा॑ट् छुतु॒द्री पय॑सा जवेते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ párvatānām ǀ uśatī́ íti ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ áśve ivétyáśve-iva ǀ vísite íti ví-site ǀ hā́samāne íti ǀgā́vā-iva ǀ śubhré íti ǀ mātárā ǀ rihāṇé íti ǀ ví-pāṭ ǀ śutudrī́ ǀ páyasā ǀ javete íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rushing from the flanks of the mountains, eager (to reach the sea) like two mares with loosened reins contending (with each other in speed), like two fair mother cows (hastening) to caress (their calves), the Vipās' andŚutudri, flow readily with (united) waterṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑षिते प्रस॒वं भिक्ष॑माणे॒ अच्छा॑ समु॒द्रं र॒थ्ये॑व याथः । स॒मा॒रा॒णे ऊ॒र्मिभि॒: पिन्व॑माने अ॒न्या वा॑म॒न्यामप्ये॑ति शुभ्रे
shlokas.transliteration: índreṣite ítīndra-iṣite ǀ pra-savám ǀ bhíkṣamāṇe íti ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ yāthaḥ ǀsamārāṇé íti sam-ārāṇé ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀ pínvamāne íti ǀ anyā́ ǀ vām ǀ anyā́m ǀ ápi ǀ eti ǀ śubhre íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Impelled byIndra, soliciting (his commands), you go to the ocean like charioteers (to their goal); flowing together, and swelling with (your) waves, bright (rivers) one of you proceeds to the other.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒ सिन्धुं॑ मा॒तृत॑मामयासं॒ विपा॑शमु॒र्वीं सु॒भगा॑मगन्म । व॒त्समि॑व मा॒तरा॑ संरिहा॒णे स॑मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ सं॒चर॑न्ती
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ síndhum ǀ mātṛ́-tamām ǀ ayāsam ǀ ví-pāśam ǀ urvī́m ǀ su-bhágām ǀ aganma ǀvatsám-iva ǀ mātárā ǀ saṃrihāṇé íti sam-rihāṇé ǀ samānám ǀ yónim ǀ ánu ǀ sañcárantī íti sam-cárantī ǁ
