shlokas.meaning_en: “I repaired to the most material river; I went to the wide auspicious Vipās', flowing together to a common receptacle, like parent cows (hastening to) caress the calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ना व॒यं पय॑सा॒ पिन्व॑माना॒ अनु॒ योनिं॑ दे॒वकृ॑तं॒ चर॑न्तीः । न वर्त॑वे प्रस॒वः सर्ग॑तक्तः किं॒युर्विप्रो॑ न॒द्यो॑ जोहवीति
shlokas.transliteration: enā́ ǀ vayám ǀ páyasā ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ yónim ǀ devá-kṛtam ǀ cárantīḥ ǀná ǀ vártave ǀ pra-saváḥ ǀ sárga-taktaḥ ǀ kim-yúḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ johavīti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rivers speak: Fertilizing (the land) with this (our) current, we are flowing to the receptacle which has been appointed by the deity (Indra); the course appointed for our going (permits) not of delay; of what is the sage desirious, that he addresses the rivers?”

shlokas.sanskrit: रम॑ध्वं मे॒ वच॑से सो॒म्याय॒ ऋता॑वरी॒रुप॑ मुहू॒र्तमेवै॑: । प्र सिन्धु॒मच्छा॑ बृह॒ती म॑नी॒षाव॒स्युर॑ह्वे कुशि॒कस्य॑ सू॒नुः
shlokas.transliteration: rámadhvam ǀ me ǀ vácase ǀ somyā́ya ǀ ṛ́ta-varīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ muhūrtám ǀ évaiḥ ǀprá ǀ síndhum ǀ áccha ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ ahve ǀ kuśikásya ǀ sūnúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viśvāmitraspeaks: Rivers, charged with water, rest a moment from your course at my request, who go to gather theSoma; I, the son ofKuśika, desirous of protection, address with earnest prayer especially the river before me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्माँ अ॑रद॒द्वज्र॑बाहु॒रपा॑हन्वृ॒त्रं प॑रि॒धिं न॒दीना॑म् । दे॒वो॑ऽनयत्सवि॒ता सु॑पा॒णिस्तस्य॑ व॒यं प्र॑स॒वे या॑म उ॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aradat ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ahan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ nadī́nām ǀdeváḥ ǀ anayat ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-pāṇíḥ ǀ tásya ǀ vayám ǀ pra-savé ǀ yāmaḥ ǀ urvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rivers speak;Indra, the wielder of the thunder-bolt, dug our channels when he slew Ahi the blocker-up of rivers; the divine and well-handedSavitāhas led us (on our path), and obedient tohis commands we flow (as) ample (streams).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वाच्यं॑ शश्व॒धा वी॒र्यं१॒॑ तदिन्द्र॑स्य॒ कर्म॒ यदहिं॑ विवृ॒श्चत् । वि वज्रे॑ण परि॒षदो॑ जघा॒नाय॒न्नापोऽय॑नमि॒च्छमा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: pra-vā́cyam ǀ śaśvadhā́ ǀ vīryám ǀ tát ǀ índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ yát ǀ áhim ǀ vi-vṛścát ǀví ǀ vájreṇa ǀ pari-sádaḥ ǀ jaghāna ǀ ā́yan ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ áyanam ǀ icchámānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viśvāmitraspeaks: Ever is that heroic exploit ofIndrato be celebrated when he cut Ahi to pieces, and with his thunderbolt destroyed the surrounding (obstructors of the rain), whence the waters proceed in the direction they desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तद्वचो॑ जरित॒र्मापि॑ मृष्ठा॒ आ यत्ते॒ घोषा॒नुत्त॑रा यु॒गानि॑ । उ॒क्थेषु॑ कारो॒ प्रति॑ नो जुषस्व॒ मा नो॒ नि क॑: पुरुष॒त्रा नम॑स्ते
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápi ǀ mṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ghóṣān ǀ út-tarā ǀ yugā́ni ǀukthéṣu ǀ kāro íti ǀ práti ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ní ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀ puruṣa-trā́ ǀ námaḥ ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rivers speak: Praiser ofIndra, forget not this speech, nor the worlds that (you have addressed to us) for future ages (to reverence); celebrator (of holy rites), be favourable to us in solemn prayers; treat us not after the (arrogant fashion) of men; salutation be to you!”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ षु स्व॑सारः का॒रवे॑ शृणोत य॒यौ वो॑ दू॒रादन॑सा॒ रथे॑न । नि षू न॑मध्वं॒ भव॑ता सुपा॒रा अ॑धोअ॒क्षाः सि॑न्धवः स्रो॒त्याभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ svasāraḥ ǀ kāráve ǀ śṛṇota ǀ yayáu ǀ vaḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ánasā ǀ ráthena ǀní ǀ sú ǀ namadhvam ǀ bhávata ǀ su-pārā́ḥ ǀ adhaḥ-akṣā́ḥ ǀ sindhavaḥ ǀ srotyā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viśvāmitraspeaks: Listen, sister (streams), kindly to him who praises you; who has come from afar with a waggon and chariot; bow down lowly; become easily fordable; remain, rivers, lower than the axle (of the wheel) with your currents.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ कारो शृणवामा॒ वचां॑सि य॒याथ॑ दू॒रादन॑सा॒ रथे॑न । नि ते॑ नंसै पीप्या॒नेव॒ योषा॒ मर्या॑येव क॒न्या॑ शश्व॒चै ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ kāro íti ǀ śṛṇavāma ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ yayā́tha ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ánasā ǀ ráthena ǀní ǀ te ǀ naṃsai ǀ pīpyānā́-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ máryāya-iva ǀ kanyā́ ǀ śaśvacái ǀ ta íti te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rivers speak: Hymner, we hear your words, that you have come from afar with a wagon and chariot; we bow down before you; like a woman nursing (her child), like a maiden bending to embrace a man, (so will we do) for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒ङ्ग त्वा॑ भर॒ताः सं॒तरे॑युर्ग॒व्यन्ग्राम॑ इषि॒त इन्द्र॑जूतः । अर्षा॒दह॑ प्रस॒वः सर्ग॑तक्त॒ आ वो॑ वृणे सुम॒तिं य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ sam-táreyuḥ ǀ gavyán ǀ grā́maḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ índra-jūtaḥ ǀárṣāt ǀ áha ǀ pra-saváḥ ǀ sárga-taktaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛṇe ǀ su-matím ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viśvāmitraspeaks: (Since), rivers, (you have allowed me to cross), so may theBharataspass over (your united stream); may the troop desiring to cross the water, permitted (by you), and impelled byIndra, pass; then let the course appinted for your going (be resumed); I have recourse to the favour of you who are worthy of adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अता॑रिषुर्भर॒ता ग॒व्यव॒: समभ॑क्त॒ विप्र॑: सुम॒तिं न॒दीना॑म् । प्र पि॑न्वध्वमि॒षय॑न्तीः सु॒राधा॒ आ व॒क्षणा॑: पृ॒णध्वं॑ या॒त शीभ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: átāriṣuḥ ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ gavyávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ábhakta ǀ vípraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ nadī́nām ǀprá ǀ pinvadhvam ǀ iṣáyantīḥ ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣáṇāḥ ǀ pṛṇádhvam ǀ yātá ǀ śī́bham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBharatāsseeking cattle passed over; the sage enjoyed the favour of the rivers; streams dispensing food, productive of wealth, spread abundance, fill (your beds), flow swiftly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिः शम्या॑ ह॒न्त्वापो॒ योक्त्रा॑णि मुञ्चत । मादु॑ष्कृतौ॒ व्ये॑नसा॒घ्न्यौ शून॒मार॑ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ śámyāḥ ǀ hantu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ yóktrāṇi ǀ muñcata ǀmā́ ǀ áduḥ-kṛtau ǀ ví-enasā ǀ aghnyáu ǀ śū́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ aratām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your waves (rivers) so flow that the pin of the yoke may be above (their) waters; leave the traces full, and may (the two streams), exempt from misfortune or defect, and uncensured, exhibit no (present) increase.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: पू॒र्भिदाति॑र॒द्दास॑म॒र्कैर्वि॒दद्व॑सु॒र्दय॑मानो॒ वि शत्रू॑न् । ब्रह्म॑जूतस्त॒न्वा॑ वावृधा॒नो भूरि॑दात्र॒ आपृ॑ण॒द्रोद॑सी उ॒भे
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀ ā́ ǀ atirat ǀ dā́sam ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ vidát-vasuḥ ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ śátrūn ǀbráhma-jūtaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ bhū́ri-dātraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ apṛṇat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the destroyer of cities, possessed of wealth manifesting (his greatness), merciless to his enemies has overspread the day with his radiance; attracted by prayer, increasing in bulk, and armed with many weapons, he has delighted both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒खस्य॑ ते तवि॒षस्य॒ प्र जू॒तिमिय॑र्मि॒ वाच॑म॒मृता॑य॒ भूष॑न् । इन्द्र॑ क्षिती॒नाम॑सि॒ मानु॑षीणां वि॒शां दैवी॑नामु॒त पू॑र्व॒यावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: makhásya ǀ te ǀ taviṣásya ǀ prá ǀ jūtím ǀ íyarmi ǀ vā́cam ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀíndra ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ asi ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ viśā́m ǀ dáivīnām ǀ utá ǀ pūrva-yā́vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Decorating you, I address sincere prayers to you who are adorable and mighty, for the sake of (obtaining) food; you,Indraare the preceder of men the descendants ofmanu, and of the descendants of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रम॑वृणो॒च्छर्ध॑नीति॒: प्र मा॒यिना॑ममिना॒द्वर्प॑णीतिः । अह॒न्व्यं॑समु॒शध॒ग्वने॑ष्वा॒विर्धेना॑ अकृणोद्रा॒म्याणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ avṛṇot ǀ śárdha-nītiḥ ǀ prá ǀ māyínām ǀ amināt ǀ várpa-nītiḥ ǀáhan ǀ ví-aṃsam ǀ uśádhak ǀ váneṣu ǀ āvíḥ ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ akṛṇot ǀ rāmyā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of glorious deeds, destroyedVṛtra; resistless in combat, he has overcome the deceivers resolved to consume him; he slew the mutilated (demon lurking) in the woods, and made manifest the (stolen) kine (that had been hidden) in the night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: स्व॒र्षा ज॒नय॒न्नहा॑नि जि॒गायो॒शिग्भि॒: पृत॑ना अभि॒ष्टिः । प्रारो॑चय॒न्मन॑वे के॒तुमह्ना॒मवि॑न्द॒ज्ज्योति॑र्बृह॒ते रणा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ áhāni ǀ jigā́ya ǀ uśík-bhiḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhiṣṭíḥ ǀprá ǀ arocayat ǀ mánave ǀ ketúm ǀ áhnām ǀ ávindat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ bṛhaté ǀ ráṇāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the giver ofsvarga, genitive rating the days, has subdued victorious with the eager (aṅgirasas) the hostile hosts, and illuminingfor man the banner of the days, he obtained light for the great conflict.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒स्तुजो॑ ब॒र्हणा॒ आ वि॑वेश नृ॒वद्दधा॑नो॒ नर्या॑ पु॒रूणि॑ । अचे॑तय॒द्धिय॑ इ॒मा ज॑रि॒त्रे प्रेमं वर्ण॑मतिरच्छु॒क्रमा॑साम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ tújaḥ ǀ barháṇāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀácetayat ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ jaritré ǀ prá ǀ imám ǀ várṇam ǀ atirat ǀ śukrám ǀ āsām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraentered the confiding hostile (hosts) like a man distributing many (gifts) to (his) leaders; he has animated these dawns for the worshipper, and heightened their bright radiance (by his own).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो म॒हानि॑ पनयन्त्य॒स्येन्द्र॑स्य॒ कर्म॒ सुकृ॑ता पु॒रूणि॑ । वृ॒जने॑न वृजि॒नान्त्सं पि॑पेष मा॒याभि॒र्दस्यूँ॑र॒भिभू॑त्योजाः
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ panayanti ǀ asya ǀ índrasya ǀ kárma ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀvṛjánena ǀ vṛjinā́n ǀ sám ǀ pipeṣa ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They celebrate many great and glorious exploits of this mightyIndra; he crushed the strong by his strength, and, of overpowering prowess, he overcame thedasyusby delusions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒धेन्द्रो॑ म॒ह्ना वरि॑वश्चकार दे॒वेभ्य॒: सत्प॑तिश्चर्षणि॒प्राः । वि॒वस्व॑त॒: सद॑ने अस्य॒ तानि॒ विप्रा॑ उ॒क्थेभि॑: क॒वयो॑ गृणन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: yudhā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǀvivásvataḥ ǀ sádane ǀ asya ǀ tā́ni ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of the virtuous, fulfiller of the wishes of men, he gave to the gods the wealth (that had been won) in fierce battle, and therefore far-seeing sages glorify those his exploits with praises in the dwelling of the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा॒साहं॒ वरे॑ण्यं सहो॒दां स॑स॒वांसं॒ स्व॑र॒पश्च॑ दे॒वीः । स॒सान॒ यः पृ॑थि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमामिन्द्रं॑ मद॒न्त्यनु॒ धीर॑णासः
shlokas.transliteration: satrā-sáham ǀ váreṇyam ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀ sasavā́ṃsam ǀ sváḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ devī́ḥ ǀsasā́na ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ índram ǀ madanti ǀ ánu ǀ dhī́-raṇāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devout worshippers propitiateIndra, the victorious, the excellent, the bestower of strength, the enjoyer of heaven and the divine waters, and who was the giver of the earth and heaven and this (firmament to their inhabitants).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒सानात्याँ॑ उ॒त सूर्यं॑ ससा॒नेन्द्र॑: ससान पुरु॒भोज॑सं॒ गाम् । हि॒र॒ण्यय॑मु॒त भोगं॑ ससान ह॒त्वी दस्यू॒न्प्रार्यं॒ वर्ण॑मावत्
shlokas.transliteration: sasā́na ǀ átyān ǀ utá ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sasāna ǀ índraḥ ǀ sasāna ǀ puru-bhójasam ǀ gā́m ǀhiraṇyáyam ǀ utá ǀ bhógam ǀ sasāna ǀ hatvī́ ǀ dásyūn ǀ prá ǀ ā́ryam ǀ várṇam ǀ āvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He gave horses, he gave also the sun, andIndragave also the many-nourishing cow; he gave golden treasure, and having destroyed thedasyus, he protected theāryatribe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ ओष॑धीरसनो॒दहा॑नि॒ वन॒स्पतीँ॑रसनोद॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । बि॒भेद॑ व॒लं नु॑नु॒दे विवा॒चोऽथा॑भवद्दमि॒ताभिक्र॑तूनाम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ asanot ǀ áhāni ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ asanot ǀ antárikṣam ǀbibhéda ǀ valám ǀ nunudé ǀ ví-vācaḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavat ǀ damitā́ ǀ abhí-kratūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrabestowed plural nts and days, he gave trees and the firmament,he divided the cloud, he scattered opponents, he was the tamer of adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तिष्ठा॒ हरी॒ रथ॒ आ यु॒ज्यमा॑ना या॒हि वा॒युर्न नि॒युतो॑ नो॒ अच्छ॑ । पिबा॒स्यन्धो॑ अ॒भिसृ॑ष्टो अ॒स्मे इन्द्र॒ स्वाहा॑ ररि॒मा ते॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tíṣṭha ǀ hárī íti ǀ ráthe ǀ ā́ ǀ yujyámānā ǀ yāhí ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀpíbāsi ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ abhí-sṛṣṭaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ índra ǀ svā́hā ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stay,Indra, having yoked the horses to the car, asVāyustops when he has put to his steds, and come to our presence; solicited by us to drink of theSoma, which with reverence we offer for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपा॑जि॒रा पु॑रुहू॒ताय॒ सप्ती॒ हरी॒ रथ॑स्य धू॒र्ष्वा यु॑नज्मि । द्र॒वद्यथा॒ सम्भृ॑तं वि॒श्वत॑श्चि॒दुपे॒मं य॒ज्ञमा व॑हात॒ इन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ ajirā́ ǀ puru-hūtā́ya ǀ sáptī íti ǀ hárī íti ǀ ráthasya ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ yunajmi ǀdravát ǀ yáthā ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ úpa ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ vahātaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I harness for you, who is invoked by many, the swift gliding horses to the shafts of the car, that they may bearIndrato this sacrifice that is prepared with all (that is required).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑ नयस्व॒ वृष॑णा तपु॒ष्पोतेम॑व॒ त्वं वृ॑षभ स्वधावः । ग्रसे॑ता॒मश्वा॒ वि मु॑चे॒ह शोणा॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे स॒दृशी॑रद्धि धा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ nayasva ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ tapuḥ-pā́ ǀ utá ǀ īm ǀ ava ǀ tvám ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀgrásetām ǀ áśvā ǀ ví ǀ muca ǀ ihá ǀ śóṇā ǀ divé-dive ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ addhi ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), giver of food, guide hither your vigorous horses, defending (us) against foes, and protect (your worshippers); here unharness the bay steeds, and give them fodder, and you eat daily suitable food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णा ते ब्रह्म॒युजा॑ युनज्मि॒ हरी॒ सखा॑या सध॒माद॑ आ॒शू । स्थि॒रं रथं॑ सु॒खमि॑न्द्राधि॒तिष्ठ॑न्प्रजा॒नन्वि॒द्वाँ उप॑ याहि॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmaṇā ǀ te ǀ brahma-yújā ǀ yunajmi ǀ hárī íti ǀ sákhāyā ǀ sadha-mā́de ǀ āśū́ íti ǀsthirám ǀ rátham ǀ su-khám ǀ indra ǀ adhi-tíṣṭhan ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I harness with prayer your horses, who are to be harnessed with prayer, who are allies and swift-paced in battle; arise, and all-knowingIndra, mounting on your firm and easy chariot, come to the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा ते॒ हरी॒ वृष॑णा वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठा॒ नि री॑रम॒न्यज॑मानासो अ॒न्ये । अ॒त्याया॑हि॒ शश्व॑तो व॒यं तेऽरं॑ सु॒तेभि॑: कृणवाम॒ सोमै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ vītá-pṛṣṭhā ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀ yájamānāsaḥ ǀ anyé ǀati-ā́yāhi ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ vayám ǀ te ǀ áram ǀ sutébhiḥ ǀ kṛṇavāma ǀ sómaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not other sacrifices attract your vigorous and smooth-backed steeds; disregarding others, come perpetually hither, that we may propitiate you sufficiently with effusedSomalibations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवा॒यं सोम॒स्त्वमेह्य॒र्वाङ्छ॑श्वत्त॒मं सु॒मना॑ अ॒स्य पा॑हि । अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे ब॒र्हिष्या नि॒षद्या॑ दधि॒ष्वेमं ज॒ठर॒ इन्दु॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pāhi ǀasmín ǀ yajñé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ ā́ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ dadhiṣvá ǀ imám ǀ jaṭháre ǀ índum ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thissomalibation is for you; come down, and well disposed, drink of it unceasingly; seated on the grass at this sacrifice, takeIndra, this (libation) into your belly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्ती॒र्णं ते॑ ब॒र्हिः सु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ सोम॑: कृ॒ता धा॒ना अत्त॑वे ते॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । तदो॑कसे पुरु॒शाका॑य॒ वृष्णे॑ म॒रुत्व॑ते॒ तुभ्यं॑ रा॒ता ह॒वींषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: stīrṇám ǀ te ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ḥ ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ áttave ǀ te ǀ hári-bhyām ǀtát-okase ǀ puru-śā́kāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ marútvate ǀ túbhyam ǀ rātā́ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sacred grass is strewn for you; theSoma,Indra, is poured forth; the grain wherewith to feed your horses is prepared; the oblations are offered to you abiding on the sacred grass, who is praised of many, and is the showerer (of benefits), attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं नर॒: पर्व॑ता॒स्तुभ्य॒माप॒: समि॑न्द्र॒ गोभि॒र्मधु॑मन्तमक्रन् । तस्या॒गत्या॑ सु॒मना॑ ऋष्व पाहि प्रजा॒नन्वि॒द्वान्प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ अनु॒ स्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ náraḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ sám ǀ indra ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ akran ǀtásya ǀ ā-gátya ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ṛṣva ǀ pāhi ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leaders (of the ceremony) have prepared for you,Indra, this (libation), sweetened with milk, the stones, the water; beautiful Indra, who is favourably disposed, and who is wise, knowing well (the worship) that is according to your peculiar paths, come and drink of this libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याँ आभ॑जो म॒रुत॑ इन्द्र॒ सोमे॒ ये त्वामव॑र्ध॒न्नभ॑वन्ग॒णस्ते॑ । तेभि॑रे॒तं स॒जोषा॑ वावशा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽग्नेः पि॑ब जि॒ह्वया॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: yā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ábhajaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sóme ǀ yé ǀ tvā́m ǀ ávardhan ǀ ábhavan ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ te ǀtébhiḥ ǀ etám ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ piba ǀ jihváyā ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated,Indra, with thoseMarutswith whom you have shared in the libation, who encouraged you (in battle), and are your attendant troop, drink, desirous of theSoma, along with them, with the tongue ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ पिब॑ स्व॒धया॑ चित्सु॒तस्या॒ग्नेर्वा॑ पाहि जि॒ह्वया॑ यजत्र । अ॒ध्व॒र्योर्वा॒ प्रय॑तं शक्र॒ हस्ता॒द्धोतु॑र्वा य॒ज्ञं ह॒विषो॑ जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ píba ǀ svadháyā ǀ cit ǀ sutásya ǀ agnéḥ ǀ vā ǀ pāhi ǀ jihváyā ǀ yajatra ǀadhvaryóḥ ǀ vā ǀ prá-yatam ǀ śakra ǀ hástāt ǀ hótuḥ ǀ vā ǀ yajñám ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableIndra, drink of the effused libation, either by your own effort, or through the tongue ofAgni; drink it,Śakra, offered by thehandof theadhvaryu, or accept the presentation of the oblation (from the hand) of theHotā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndradistinguished in this combat; the leader in the food bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मामू॒ षु प्रभृ॑तिं सा॒तये॑ धा॒: शश्व॑च्छश्वदू॒तिभि॒र्याद॑मानः । सु॒तेसु॑ते वावृधे॒ वर्ध॑नेभि॒र्यः कर्म॑भिर्म॒हद्भि॒: सुश्रु॑तो॒ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá-bhṛtim ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāḥ ǀ śáśvat-śaśvat ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ yā́damānaḥ ǀsuté-sute ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ várdhanebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kárma-bhiḥ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ sú-śrutaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is constantly seeking (association) with your allies (theMaruts) accept this, our offering (made) for the grant (from you of riches); for you are one who grows with augmenting energies, through reiterated libations, and has been renowned for glorious deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमा॑: प्र॒दिवो॒ विदा॑ना ऋ॒भुर्येभि॒र्वृष॑पर्वा॒ विहा॑याः । प्र॒य॒म्यमा॑ना॒न्प्रति॒ षू गृ॑भा॒येन्द्र॒ पिब॒ वृष॑धूतस्य॒ वृष्ण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ vídānāḥ ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-parvā ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀpra-yamyámānān ǀ práti ǀ sú ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ índra ǀ píba ǀ vṛ́ṣa-dhūtasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ToIndrahave libations been presented in the days of old, whereby he has become illustrious, the regulator of time, the granter of desires; accept, Indra, these prescribed (offerings), and drink of this auspicous (Soma), expressed by the stones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॒ वर्ध॑स्व॒ तव॑ घा सु॒तास॒ इन्द्र॒ सोमा॑सः प्रथ॒मा उ॒तेमे । यथापि॑बः पू॒र्व्याँ इ॑न्द्र॒ सोमाँ॑ ए॒वा पा॑हि॒ पन्यो॑ अ॒द्या नवी॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ várdhasva ǀ táva ǀ gha ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índra ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ imé ǀyáthā ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ pūrvyā́n ǀ indra ǀ sómān ǀ evá ǀ pāhi ǀ pányaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ návīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, and thrive; yours are these (present) libations, as were the primitive libations; you who is adorable, drink today the recent libations, as you drank those of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ अम॑त्रो वृ॒जने॑ विर॒प्श्यु१॒॑ग्रं शव॑: पत्यते धृ॒ष्ण्वोज॑: । नाह॑ विव्याच पृथि॒वी च॒नैनं॒ यत्सोमा॑सो॒ हर्य॑श्व॒मम॑न्दन्
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ámatraḥ ǀ vṛjáne ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ ugrám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ patyate ǀ dhṛṣṇú ǀ ójaḥ ǀná ǀ áha ǀ vivyāca ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ caná ǀ enam ǀ yát ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ hári-aśvam ǀ ámandan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The greatIndra, the victorious in battle, the defier of foes; his fierce strength and resolute vigour are exerted; verily the earth does not contain him, neither (does the heaven), when theSomalibations exhilarate the lord of the tawny steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ उ॒ग्रो वा॑वृधे वी॒र्या॑य स॒माच॑क्रे वृष॒भः काव्ये॑न । इन्द्रो॒ भगो॑ वाज॒दा अ॑स्य॒ गाव॒: प्र जा॑यन्ते॒ दक्षि॑णा अस्य पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ugráḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ sam-ā́cakre ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ kā́vyena ǀíndraḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vāja-dā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ prá ǀ jāyante ǀ dákṣiṇāḥ ǀ asya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty, fierce, auspiciousIndra, the showerer (of benefits), augments (in power) as he is animated for heroic (acts) by praise; his cattle are genitive rated givers of food; many are his donations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यत्सिन्ध॑वः प्रस॒वं यथाय॒न्नाप॑: समु॒द्रं र॒थ्ये॑व जग्मुः । अत॑श्चि॒दिन्द्र॒: सद॑सो॒ वरी॑या॒न्यदीं॒ सोम॑: पृ॒णति॑ दु॒ग्धो अं॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-savám ǀ yáthā ǀ ā́yan ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ jagmuḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ índraḥ ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ várīyān ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pṛṇáti ǀ dugdháḥ ǀ aṃśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the rivers pursue their course, the waters rush to the ocean like the drivers of cars (to a goal), so the vastIndra(hastens) from his dwelling (in the firmament), when the humble Som alibation propitiates him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रेण॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ याद॑माना॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमं॒ सुषु॑तं॒ भर॑न्तः । अं॒शुं दु॑हन्ति ह॒स्तिनो॑ भ॒रित्रै॒र्मध्व॑: पुनन्ति॒ धार॑या प॒वित्रै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: samudréṇa ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ yā́damānāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ sú-sutam ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀaṃśúm ǀ duhanti ǀ hastínaḥ ǀ bharítraiḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ punanti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pavítraiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the rivers are solicitious (to mix) with the ocean, so (are the priests) bearing the efficient libation toIndra; holding in theirhandsthey milk theSoma, and purify the sweet Soma (as they fall) indrops through the purifying filters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह्र॒दा इ॑व कु॒क्षय॑: सोम॒धाना॒: समी॑ विव्याच॒ सव॑ना पु॒रूणि॑ । अन्ना॒ यदिन्द्र॑: प्रथ॒मा व्याश॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अ॑वृणीत॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: hradā́ḥ-iva ǀ kukṣáyaḥ ǀ soma-dhā́nāḥ ǀ sám ǀ īmíti ǀ vivyāca ǀ sávanā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀánnā ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ví ǀ ā́śa ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The stomach ofIndra(is) as capacious (a receptacle) ofSoma, as a lake, for he has partaken of it at many sacrifices; and inasmuch as he has eaten the first (sacrificial) viands, he has been the slayer ofVṛtra, and has shared the Soma (with the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू भ॑र॒ माकि॑रे॒तत्परि॑ ष्ठाद्वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॒ वसु॑पतिं॒ वसू॑नाम् । इन्द्र॒ यत्ते॒ माहि॑नं॒ दत्र॒मस्त्य॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्ध॑र्यश्व॒ प्र य॑न्धि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ bhara ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ etát ǀ pári ǀ sthāt ǀ vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vásu-patim ǀ vásūnām ǀíndra ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mā́hinam ǀ dátram ǀ ásti ǀ asmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ hari-aśva ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly,Indra, bring (wealth); let no one impede you, for we know you to be the lord of wealth, of all treasures; and since, Indra, your greatness is munificence, therefore, lord of the tawny steeds, grant us (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे प्र य॑न्धि मघवन्नृजीषि॒न्निन्द्र॑ रा॒यो वि॒श्ववा॑रस्य॒ भूरे॑: । अ॒स्मे श॒तं श॒रदो॑ जी॒वसे॑ धा अ॒स्मे वी॒राञ्छश्व॑त इन्द्र शिप्रिन्
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǀ magha-van ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ índra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ śatám ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ dhāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vīrā́n ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ indra ǀ śiprin ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentIndra, receiver of the spiritlessSoma, give to us riches in universally desired quantity; grant us to live a hundred years; bestow upon us, Indra wiht the handsome chin, numerous posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat; the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वार्त्र॑हत्याय॒ शव॑से पृतना॒षाह्या॑य च । इन्द्र॒ त्वा व॑र्तयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: vā́rtra-hatyāya ǀ śávase ǀ pṛtanā-sáhyāya ǀ ca ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We excite you,Indra, to exert the strength that destroysVṛtra, and overpowers hostile armies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वा॒चीनं॒ सु ते॒ मन॑ उ॒त चक्षु॑: शतक्रतो । इन्द्र॑ कृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ वा॒घत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: arvācī́nam ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ utá ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀíndra ǀ kṛṇvántu ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your praisers,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, direct your mind and your eyes towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नामा॑नि ते शतक्रतो॒ विश्वा॑भिर्गी॒र्भिरी॑महे । इन्द्रा॑भिमाति॒षाह्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: nā́māni ǀ te ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ īmahe ǀíndra ǀ abhimāti-sáhye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We recite,Indra, who is worshipped in a hundred rites, (your many) names in all our hymns for strength to resist our foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒ष्टु॒तस्य॒ धाम॑भिः श॒तेन॑ महयामसि । इन्द्र॑स्य चर्षणी॒धृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: puru-stutásya ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ śaténa ǀ mahayāmasi ǀíndrasya ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We repeat the praise of the many-laudedIndrathe supporter of man, invested with a hundred glories.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ हन्त॑वे पुरुहू॒तमुप॑ ब्रुवे । भरे॑षु॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀbháreṣu ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you,Indra, who is invoked of many for the slaying ofVṛtra, and the granting of food (as the spoil) of battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाजे॑षु सास॒हिर्भ॑व॒ त्वामी॑महे शतक्रतो । इन्द्र॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ हन्त॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: vā́jeṣu ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ bhava ǀ tvā́m ǀ īmahe ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀíndra ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be victorious,Indra, in battles; we solicit you, object of many rites, to destroyVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यु॒म्नेषु॑ पृत॒नाज्ये॑ पृत्सु॒तूर्षु॒ श्रव॑स्सु च । इन्द्र॒ साक्ष्वा॒भिमा॑तिषु
shlokas.transliteration: dyumnéṣu ǀ pṛtanā́jye ǀ pṛtsutū́rṣu ǀ śrávaḥ-su ǀ ca ǀíndra ǀ sā́kṣva ǀ abhí-mātiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overcome,Indra, those who are adverse to us in riches, in battle, in hostile hosts, in strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒ष्मिन्त॑मं न ऊ॒तये॑ द्यु॒म्निनं॑ पाहि॒ जागृ॑विम् । इन्द्र॒ सोमं॑ शतक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: śuṣmín-tamam ǀ ná ǀ ūtáye ǀ dyumnínam ǀ pāhi ǀ jā́gṛvim ǀíndra ǀ sómam ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, object of many rites, for our preservation, the most invigorating, fame-conferring, sleep-dispelling,Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रि॒याणि॑ शतक्रतो॒ या ते॒ जने॑षु प॒ञ्चसु॑ । इन्द्र॒ तानि॑ त॒ आ वृ॑णे
shlokas.transliteration: indriyā́ṇi ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ jáneṣu ǀ pañcá-su ǀíndra ǀ tā́ni ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, object of many rites, I regard the organs of sense, that exist in the five races (of beings dependent) on you as yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग॑न्निन्द्र॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हद्द्यु॒म्नं द॑धिष्व दु॒ष्टर॑म् । उत्ते॒ शुष्मं॑ तिरामसि
shlokas.transliteration: ágan ǀ indra ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dyumnám ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ dustáram ǀút ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ tirāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the abundant (sacrificial) food (we offer) reach you,Indra; grant us wealth that may not easily be surpassed; we augment your vigour (by our offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वा॒वतो॑ न॒ आ ग॒ह्यथो॑ शक्र परा॒वत॑: । उ॒ लो॒को यस्ते॑ अद्रिव॒ इन्द्रे॒ह तत॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: arvā-vátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ átho íti ǀ śakra ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀūṃ íti ǀ lokáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ índra ǀ ihá ǀ tátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “COme to usŚakra, whether from afar or nigh; whatever,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, be your region, come from thence hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि तष्टे॑व दीधया मनी॒षामत्यो॒ न वा॒जी सु॒धुरो॒ जिहा॑नः । अ॒भि प्रि॒याणि॒ मर्मृ॑श॒त्परा॑णि क॒वीँरि॑च्छामि सं॒दृशे॑ सुमे॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ dīdhaya ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ su-dhúraḥ ǀ jíhānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ mármṛśat ǀ párāṇi ǀ kavī́n ǀ icchāmi ǀ sam-dṛ́śe ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeat (toIndra) pious praise, as a carpenter (plural nes the wood), and engaging (zealously in sacred rites), as a quick horse bearing well his burden; endowed with intelligence, and refllecting upon the future acts acceptable (to Indra), I desire to behold the sages (whohave gone to heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒नोत पृ॑च्छ॒ जनि॑मा कवी॒नां म॑नो॒धृत॑: सु॒कृत॑स्तक्षत॒ द्याम् । इ॒मा उ॑ ते प्र॒ण्यो॒३॒॑ वर्ध॑माना॒ मनो॑वाता॒ अध॒ नु धर्म॑णि ग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: inā́ ǀ utá ǀ pṛccha ǀ jánima ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ manaḥ-dhṛ́taḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ takṣata ǀ dyā́m ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ pra-nyáḥ ǀ várdhamānāḥ ǀ mánaḥ-vātāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ nú ǀ dhármaṇi ǀ gman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ask of the lords (of earth, the holy teachers), the birth of those deified sages, who with well-governed minds, and diligent in sacred rites, fabricated the heavens; and may these propitiatory (praises), augmenting (your power) and rapid as the wind, reach you at this solemn rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि षी॒मिदत्र॒ गुह्या॒ दधा॑ना उ॒त क्ष॒त्राय॒ रोद॑सी॒ सम॑ञ्जन् । सं मात्रा॑भिर्ममि॒रे ये॒मुरु॒र्वी अ॒न्तर्म॒ही समृ॑ते॒ धाय॑से धुः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sīm ǀ ít ǀ átra ǀ gúhyā ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ sám ǀ añjan ǀsám ǀ mā́trābhiḥ ǀ mamiré ǀ yemúḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ sámṛte íti sám-ṛte ǀ dhā́yase ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Comprehending hidden (mysteries) here on earth, they have, through their power, made manifest (the things of) heaven and earth; they have set limits to themby their elements; they connected them both mutually united, wide-spread and vast, and fixed the intermediate (firmament) to sustain them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒तिष्ठ॑न्तं॒ परि॒ विश्वे॑ अभूष॒ञ्छ्रियो॒ वसा॑नश्चरति॒ स्वरो॑चिः । म॒हत्तद्वृष्णो॒ असु॑रस्य॒ नामा वि॒श्वरू॑पो अ॒मृता॑नि तस्थौ
shlokas.transliteration: ā-tíṣṭhantam ǀ pári ǀ víśve ǀ abhūṣan ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ carati ǀ svá-rociḥ ǀmahát ǀ tát ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ ā́ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāni ǀ tasthau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They all ornamented (Indra) standing (in his car) and, clothed in beauty, he proceeds self-radiant; wonderful are the acts of that showerer (of benefits), the influencer (of consciences), who omniform, presides over the ambrosial (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: असू॑त॒ पूर्वो॑ वृष॒भो ज्याया॑नि॒मा अ॑स्य शु॒रुध॑: सन्ति पू॒र्वीः । दिवो॑ नपाता वि॒दथ॑स्य धी॒भिः क्ष॒त्रं रा॑जाना प्र॒दिवो॑ दधाथे
shlokas.transliteration: ásūta ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ jyā́yān ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ santi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀdívaḥ ǀ napātā ǀ vidáthasya ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ kṣatrám ǀ rājānā ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ dadhāthe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits), the preceder and elder (of the gods), genitive rated (the waters); they are the abundant allayers of his thirst; sovereignIndraandVaruṇa, grandsons of heaven, you possess the wealth (that is to be acquired) by the rites of the splendid sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ राजाना वि॒दथे॑ पु॒रूणि॒ परि॒ विश्वा॑नि भूषथ॒: सदां॑सि । अप॑श्य॒मत्र॒ मन॑सा जग॒न्वान्व्र॒ते ग॑न्ध॒र्वाँ अपि॑ वा॒युके॑शान्
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ rājānā ǀ vidáthe ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀ sádāṃsi ǀápaśyam ǀ átra ǀ mánasā ǀ jaganvā́n ǀ vraté ǀ gandharvā́n ǀ ápi ǀ vāyú-keśān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalIndraandVaruṇa, embellish the three universal sacrifices (and make them) full (of all requisites) for this celebration; you have gone to the rite, for I have beheld in my mind, at this solemnity, thegandharvaswith hair (waving) in the wind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिन्न्व॑स्य वृष॒भस्य॑ धे॒नोरा नाम॑भिर्ममिरे॒ सक्म्यं॒ गोः । अ॒न्यद॑न्यदसु॒र्यं१॒॑ वसा॑ना॒ नि मा॒यिनो॑ ममिरे रू॒पम॑स्मिन्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ dhenóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ mamire ǀ sákmyam ǀ góḥ ǀanyát-anyat ǀ asuryám ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ ní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ mamire ǀ rūpám ǀ asmin ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who, for (the sake of) the showerer (of benefits), milk the agreeable (produce) of the cow, (who is known) by (many) names, they invested with the diversified strength (of theasuras) and practising delusive art have deposited their own nature in him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिन्न्व॑स्य सवि॒तुर्नकि॑र्मे हिर॒ण्ययी॑म॒मतिं॒ यामशि॑श्रेत् । आ सु॑ष्टु॒ती रोद॑सी विश्वमि॒न्वे अपी॑व॒ योषा॒ जनि॑मानि वव्रे
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ me ǀ hiraṇyáyīm ǀ amátim ǀ yā́m ǀ áśiśret ǀā́ ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśvaminvé íti viśvam-invé ǀ ápi-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ jánimāni ǀ vavre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one (distinguishes) my golden lustre from that of thisSavitā, in which (lustre) he has taken refuge; gratified by pious praise, he cherishes the all-fostering heaven and earth as a woman cherishes her offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं प्र॒त्नस्य॑ साधथो म॒हो यद्दैवी॑ स्व॒स्तिः परि॑ णः स्यातम् । गो॒पाजि॑ह्वस्य त॒स्थुषो॒ विरू॑पा॒ विश्वे॑ पश्यन्ति मा॒यिन॑: कृ॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ pratnásya ǀ sādhathaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yát ǀ dáivī ǀ svastíḥ ǀ pári ǀ naḥ ǀ syātam ǀgopā́jihvasya ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ ví-rūpā ǀ víśve ǀ paśyanti ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two secure the great felicity of the ancient (worshipper), that which is happiness in heaven; do you (therefore) be even about us; all those who exercise illusion, contemplate the manifold expoits of the everlasting and blandly-speakingIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ म॒तिर्हृ॒द आ व॒च्यमा॒नाच्छा॒ पतिं॒ स्तोम॑तष्टा जिगाति । या जागृ॑विर्वि॒दथे॑ श॒स्यमा॒नेन्द्र॒ यत्ते॒ जाय॑ते वि॒द्धि तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ matíḥ ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vacyámānā ǀ áccha ǀ pátim ǀ stóma-taṣṭā ǀ jigāti ǀyā́ ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ śasyámānā ǀ índra ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ jā́yate ǀ viddhí ǀ tásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The praise that is prompted by the heart, and is uttered by the reciters of sacred hymns, proceeds to the presence of the lord, and is his awakener when repeated at the sacrifice; be cognizantIndra, of this praise, which is born for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॒दा पू॒र्व्या जाय॑माना॒ वि जागृ॑विर्वि॒दथे॑ श॒स्यमा॑ना । भ॒द्रा वस्त्रा॒ण्यर्जु॑ना॒ वसा॑ना॒ सेयम॒स्मे स॑न॒जा पित्र्या॒ धीः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ jā́yamānā ǀ ví ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ śasyámānā ǀbhadrā́ ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ árjunā ǀ vásānā ǀ sā́ ǀ iyám ǀ asmé íti ǀ sana-jā́ ǀ pítryā ǀ dhī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That praise which is begotten before (the dawn) of day is the awakener ofIndra, when repeated at the (morning) sacrifice; auspicious and clothed in white raiment is this our ancient and paternal hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒मा चि॒दत्र॑ यम॒सूर॑सूत जि॒ह्वाया॒ अग्रं॒ पत॒दा ह्यस्था॑त् । वपूं॑षि जा॒ता मि॑थु॒ना स॑चेते तमो॒हना॒ तपु॑षो बु॒ध्न एता॑
shlokas.transliteration: yamā́ ǀ cit ǀ átra ǀ yama-sū́ḥ ǀ asūta ǀ jihvā́yāḥ ǀ ágram ǀ pátat ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ ásthāt ǀvápūṃṣi ǀ jātā́ ǀ mithunā́ ǀ sacete íti ǀ tamaḥ-hánā ǀ tápuṣaḥ ǀ budhné ǀ ā́-itā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The parent of twins (the dawn), has brought forth the twin (Aśvins) on this occasion, (in the praise of whom) the tip of my tongue remains tremulous; they two, the dispersers of darkness, combine, assuming bodies as a pair (of twins) at the origin of the day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑रेषां निन्दि॒ता मर्त्ये॑षु॒ ये अ॒स्माकं॑ पि॒तरो॒ गोषु॑ यो॒धाः । इन्द्र॑ एषां दृंहि॒ता माहि॑नावा॒नुद्गो॒त्राणि॑ ससृजे दं॒सना॑वान्
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ ninditā́ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ yé ǀ asmā́kam ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ yodhā́ḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ dṛṃhitā́ ǀ mā́hina-vān ǀ út ǀ gotrā́ṇi ǀ sasṛje ǀ daṃsánā-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There are no revilers among men of those who were our progenitors and combatants for (the recovery of) the cattle; for the mightyIndra, the achiever of great deeds, liberated for them the numerous herds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑ ह॒ यत्र॒ सखि॑भि॒र्नव॑ग्वैरभि॒ज्ञ्वा सत्व॑भि॒र्गा अ॑नु॒ग्मन् । स॒त्यं तदिन्द्रो॑ द॒शभि॒र्दश॑ग्वै॒: सूर्यं॑ विवेद॒ तम॑सि क्षि॒यन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sákhā ǀ ha ǀ yátra ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ náva-gvaiḥ ǀ abhi-jñú ǀ ā́ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ anu-gmán ǀsatyám ǀ tát ǀ índraḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ dáśa-gvaiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ viveda ǀ támasi ǀ kṣiyántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A friend, accompanied by the faithful friends who had celebrated the nine months rite, and tracking the cows upon their knees, and in like manner accompanied by those ten who had accomplished the ten months' rite,Indramade manifest the true (light of the sun) (theretofore) dweling in (the) darkness (of the cave).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ मधु॒ सम्भृ॑तमु॒स्रिया॑यां प॒द्वद्वि॑वेद श॒फव॒न्नमे॒ गोः । गुहा॑ हि॒तं गुह्यं॑ गू॒ळ्हम॒प्सु हस्ते॑ दधे॒ दक्षि॑णे॒ दक्षि॑णावान्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ usríyāyām ǀ pat-vát ǀ viveda ǀ śaphá-vat ǀ náme ǀ góḥ ǀgúhā ǀ hitám ǀ gúhyam ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ háste ǀ dadhe ǀ dákṣiṇe ǀ dákṣiṇa-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indradiscovered the sweet milk secreted in the cow, and thereupon, brought forth (from their concealment) the herd (of cattle) having feet and having hoofs; munificent (in gifts), he held in his righthandthat which had been hidden in the cavern, which was concealed in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्योति॑र्वृणीत॒ तम॑सो विजा॒नन्ना॒रे स्या॑म दुरि॒ताद॒भीके॑ । इ॒मा गिर॑: सोमपाः सोमवृद्ध जु॒षस्वे॑न्द्र पुरु॒तम॑स्य का॒रोः
shlokas.transliteration: jyótiḥ ǀ vṛṇīta ǀ támasaḥ ǀ vi-jānán ǀ āré ǀ syāma ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ abhī́ke ǀimā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ soma-vṛddha ǀ juṣásva ǀ indra ǀ puru-támasya ǀ kāróḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The discriminating (Indra) has separated the light from the darkness; may we, removed afar from evil, be ever in security; Indra, drinker of theSoma, who is nurished by Soma, be plural ased with these praises of your worshipper who is the discomfiter of his foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्योति॑र्य॒ज्ञाय॒ रोद॑सी॒ अनु॑ ष्यादा॒रे स्या॑म दुरि॒तस्य॒ भूरे॑: । भूरि॑ चि॒द्धि तु॑ज॒तो मर्त्य॑स्य सुपा॒रासो॑ वसवो ब॒र्हणा॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: jyótiḥ ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǀ syāt ǀ āré ǀ syāma ǀ duḥ-itásya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀbhū́ri ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tujatáḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ su-pārā́saḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ barháṇā-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May light be spread throughout heaven and earth for (the promotion of the) sacrifice; may we be far removed from exceeding ill;Vasus, who are to be rendered present (by pious praise), bestow increasing affluence upon the men who is liberal of gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ त्वा वृष॒भं व॒यं सु॒ते सोमे॑ हवामहे । स पा॑हि॒ मध्वो॒ अन्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ vayám ǀ suté ǀ sóme ǀ havāmahe ǀsáḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,Indra, showerer (of benefits), to the effused libation; you drink of the exhilaratingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ क्रतु॒विदं॑ सु॒तं सोमं॑ हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पिबा वृ॑षस्व॒ तातृ॑पिम्
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ kratu-vídam ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ harya ǀ puru-stuta ǀpíba ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ tátṛpim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the praised of many, accept the effusedSoma, the conferrer of knowledge; drink, imbibe the satisfactory draught.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ प्र णो॑ धि॒तावा॑नं य॒ज्ञं विश्वे॑भिर्दे॒वेभि॑: । ति॒र स्त॑वान विश्पते
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhitá-vānam ǀ yajñám ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ stavāna ǀ viśpate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, lord of men, who is praised (by the devout) and aided by the gods, perfect this our sacrifice in which the oblation is offered (to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ सोमा॑: सु॒ता इ॒मे तव॒ प्र य॑न्ति सत्पते । क्षयं॑ च॒न्द्रास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ táva ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ sat-pate ǀkṣáyam ǀ candrā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, lord of the virtuous, these effusedSomajuices, exhilarating and brilliant, proceed to your abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒ष्वा ज॒ठरे॑ सु॒तं सोम॑मिन्द्र॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । तव॑ द्यु॒क्षास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: dadhiṣvá ǀ jaṭháre ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ váreṇyam ǀtáva ǀ dyukṣā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Receive,Indra, into your stomach this excellent effused libation, these bright (drops) abide with you in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गिर्व॑णः पा॒हि न॑: सु॒तं मधो॒र्धारा॑भिरज्यसे । इन्द्र॒ त्वादा॑त॒मिद्यश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: gírvaṇaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ajyase ǀíndra ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ ít ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is glorified with praise, drink this our libation, for you are sprinkled with the drops of the exhilarating (draught); the (sacrificial) food is verily purified by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्यु॒म्नानि॑ व॒निन॒ इन्द्रं॑ सचन्ते॒ अक्षि॑ता । पी॒त्वी सोम॑स्य वावृधे
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ índram ǀ sacante ǀ ákṣitā ǀpītvī́ ǀ sómasya ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliant and imperishable (Soma), offered by the worshipper, encompassesIndra; having drunk of the libation, he increases (in vigour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वा॒वतो॑ न॒ आ ग॑हि परा॒वत॑श्च वृत्रहन् । इ॒मा जु॑षस्व नो॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: arvā-vátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀimā́ḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, whether from nigh or from afar, come to us, accept these our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑न्त॒रा प॑रा॒वत॑मर्वा॒वतं॑ च हू॒यसे॑ । इन्द्रे॒ह तत॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ antarā́ ǀ parā-vátam ǀ arvā-vátam ǀ ca ǀ hūyáse ǀíndra ǀ ihá ǀ tátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you are called from nigh or from afar, or from mid-space, come hither,Indra, from thence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र म॒द्र्य॑ग्घुवा॒नः सोम॑पीतये । हरि॑भ्यां याह्यद्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ madryák ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀhári-bhyām ǀ yāhi ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, come to me with your horses, when invoked to drink theSomaat our (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्तो होता॑ न ऋ॒त्विय॑स्तिस्ति॒रे ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षक् । अयु॑ज्रन्प्रा॒तरद्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: sattáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǀ tistiré ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀáyujran ǀ prātáḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The invoking priest is seated at the proper season; the sacred grass woven together has been spread; the stones are plural ced in contact for the morning (libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ ब्रह्मवाहः क्रि॒यन्त॒ आ ब॒र्हिः सी॑द । वी॒हि शू॑र पुरो॒ळाश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ brahma-vāhaḥ ǀ kriyánte ǀ ā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sīda ǀvīhí ǀ śūra ǀ puroḷā́śam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of prayers, these prayers are offered (by us); sit down on the sacred grass; partake, hero, of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒र॒न्धि सव॑नेषु ण ए॒षु स्तोमे॑षु वृत्रहन् । उ॒क्थेष्वि॑न्द्र गिर्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: rarandhí ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ eṣú ǀ stómeṣu ǀ vṛtra-han ǀukthéṣu ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra,Indra, who is gratified by praise, be plural ased with these our praises and prayers at our (daily) sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒तय॑: सोम॒पामु॒रुं रि॒हन्ति॒ शव॑स॒स्पति॑म् । इन्द्रं॑ व॒त्सं न मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: matáyaḥ ǀ soma-pā́m ǀ urúm ǀ rihánti ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ pátim ǀíndram ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our praises caress the mightyIndra, the drinker of theSoma, as cows lick their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑न्दस्वा॒ ह्यन्ध॑सो॒ राध॑से त॒न्वा॑ म॒हे । न स्तो॒तारं॑ नि॒दे क॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mandasva ǀ hí ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ rā́dhase ǀ tanvā́ ǀ mahé ǀná ǀ stotā́ram ǀ nidé ǀ karaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be exhilarated bodily (by drinking) of the libation which we offer for the sake of ample wealth; expose not your adorer to reproach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमि॑न्द्र त्वा॒यवो॑ ह॒विष्म॑न्तो जरामहे । उ॒त त्वम॑स्म॒युर्व॑सो
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ jarāmahe ǀutá ǀ tvám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted,Indra, to you and offering oblations, we glorify you giver of dwellings; do you be favourably disposed to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मारे अ॒स्मद्वि मु॑मुचो॒ हरि॑प्रिया॒र्वाङ्या॑हि । इन्द्र॑ स्वधावो॒ मत्स्वे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ ví ǀ mumucaḥ ǀ hári-priya ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ yāhi ǀíndra ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ mátsva ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lover of horses,Indra, loosen not your steeds while far from us, but come (with them) to our presence; enjoyer of the offering, be exhilarated at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चं॑ त्वा सु॒खे रथे॒ वह॑तामिन्द्र के॒शिना॑ । घृ॒तस्नू॑ ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ tvā ǀ su-khé ǀ ráthe ǀ váhatām ǀ indra ǀ keśínā ǀghṛtásnū íti ghṛtá-snū ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your long-maned and sleek-coated steeds bring you down in your easy chariot to sit upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सु॒तमा ग॑हि॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र॒ गवा॑शिरम् । हरि॑भ्यां॒ यस्ते॑ अस्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ gó-āśiram ǀhári-bhyām ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to this our effusedSomamixed with milk and curds, with your horses (yoked to your car), which is favourably disposed to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमि॑न्द्र॒ मद॒मा ग॑हि बर्हि॒:ष्ठां ग्राव॑भिः सु॒तम् । कु॒विन्न्व॑स्य तृ॒प्णव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ indra ǀ mádam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ barhiḥ-sthā́m ǀ grā́va-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀkuvít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ tṛpṇávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to the exhilarating (Soma) expressed by the stones, poured upon the sacred grass; drink of it to satiety, for there is plural nty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑मि॒त्था गिरो॒ ममाच्छा॑गुरिषि॒ता इ॒तः । आ॒वृते॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ itthā́ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ máma ǀ áccha ǀ aguḥ ǀ iṣitā́ḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀā-vṛ́te ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May my praises, addressed from hence and in thi smanner, attainIndra, to bring him hither to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॒ स्तोमै॑रि॒ह ह॑वामहे । उ॒क्थेभि॑: कु॒विदा॒गम॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ havāmahe ǀukthébhiḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ ā-gámat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndrato this rite with prayers to drink theSoma; may he, repeatedly invoked, come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ सोमा॑: सु॒ता इ॒मे तान्द॑धिष्व शतक्रतो । ज॒ठरे॑ वाजिनीवसो
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ tā́n ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀjaṭháre ǀ vājinīvaso íti vājinī-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, theseSomaare poured out; take them,Śatakratu, into your stomach; you who is rich in (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॑ धनंज॒यं वाजे॑षु दधृ॒षं क॑वे । अधा॑ ते सु॒म्नमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ dhanam-jayám ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ dadhṛṣám ǀ kave ǀádha ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Far-seeingIndra, we know you to be victorious and winner of wealth in battles; therefore we ask of you riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ममि॑न्द्र॒ गवा॑शिरं॒ यवा॑शिरं च नः पिब । आ॒गत्या॒ वृष॑भिः सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ indra ǀ gó-āśiram ǀ yáva-āśiram ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ piba ǀā-gátya ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having come (to our rite) drink,Indra, this our (libation), effused by the stones, and mixed with milk and curds, and with barley.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्येदि॑न्द्र॒ स्व ओ॒क्ये॒३॒॑ सोमं॑ चोदामि पी॒तये॑ । ए॒ष रा॑रन्तु ते हृ॒दि
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ své ǀ okyé ǀ sómam ǀ codāmi ǀ pītáye ǀeṣáḥ ǀ rarantu ǀ te ǀ hṛdí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer to you,Indra, thisSomafor your drinking, to be taken into its proper receptacle;may it delight your heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑ प्र॒त्नमि॑न्द्र हवामहे । कु॒शि॒कासो॑ अव॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǀ pratnám ǀ indra ǀ havāmahe ǀkuśikā́saḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Descendants ofKuśa, desirous of protection, we invoke you,Indra, who is of old, to drink of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ह्य॒र्वाङुप॑ वन्धुरे॒ष्ठास्तवेदनु॑ प्र॒दिव॑: सोम॒पेय॑म् । प्रि॒या सखा॑या॒ वि मु॒चोप॑ ब॒र्हिस्त्वामि॒मे ह॑व्य॒वाहो॑ हवन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ úpa ǀ vandhure-sthā́ḥ ǀ táva ǀ ít ǀ ánu ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ soma-péyam ǀpriyā́ ǀ sákhāyā ǀ ví ǀ muca ǀ úpa ǀ barhíḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ imé ǀ havya-vā́haḥ ǀ havante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Descend to us riding in your car, for verily yours is this ancient libation; unharness your beloved and friendly (horses) near to the sacred grass, for these offerers of the oblation present it to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑हि पू॒र्वीरति॑ चर्ष॒णीराँ अ॒र्य आ॒शिष॒ उप॑ नो॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । इ॒मा हि त्वा॑ म॒तय॒: स्तोम॑तष्टा॒ इन्द्र॒ हव॑न्ते स॒ख्यं जु॑षा॒णाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā-śíṣaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀimā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ stóma-taṣṭāḥ ǀ índra ǀ hávante ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Passing by multitudes, come hither, nobleIndra, with your steeds, (to receive) our benedictions; for these praises, Indra, composed by the devout, invoke you propitiating your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं न॑मो॒वृधं॑ स॒जोषा॒ इन्द्र॑ देव॒ हरि॑भिर्याहि॒ तूय॑म् । अ॒हं हि त्वा॑ म॒तिभि॒र्जोह॑वीमि घृ॒तप्र॑याः सध॒मादे॒ मधू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ namaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ índra ǀ deva ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀahám ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ jóhavīmi ǀ ghṛtá-prayāḥ ǀ sadha-mā́de ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineIndra, come quickly with your steeds, and well plural ased, to our food-augmenting sacrifice; offering (sacred) food with butter, I invoke you verily with praises in the chamber of the sweet libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ च॒ त्वामे॒ता वृष॑णा॒ वहा॑तो॒ हरी॒ सखा॑या सु॒धुरा॒ स्वङ्गा॑ । धा॒नाव॒दिन्द्र॒: सव॑नं जुषा॒णः सखा॒ सख्यु॑: शृणव॒द्वन्द॑नानि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ca ǀ tvā́m ǀ etā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ váhātaḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ sákhāyā ǀ su-dhúrā ǀ su-áṅgā ǀdhānā́-vat ǀ índraḥ ǀ sávanam ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ vándanāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these two vigorous friendly burden-bearing and well-limbed steeds convey you hither, where,Indra, approving of the ceremony (in wihc the offering) is parched grain, may hear as a friend the praises of his friend (the worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विन्मा॑ गो॒पां कर॑से॒ जन॑स्य कु॒विद्राजा॑नं मघवन्नृजीषिन् । कु॒विन्म॒ ऋषिं॑ पपि॒वांसं॑ सु॒तस्य॑ कु॒विन्मे॒ वस्वो॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ शिक्षा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ mā ǀ gopā́m ǀ kárase ǀ jánasya ǀ kuvít ǀ rā́jānam ǀ magha-van ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀkuvít ǀ mā ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ papi-vā́ṃsam ǀ sutásya ǀ kuvít ǀ me ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ śíkṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of wealth, accept of the spiritlessSoma; make me the protector, or rather a monarch of men; make me verily a holy sage, a drinker of the libation; make me verily the possessor of imperishable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ बृ॒हन्तो॒ हर॑यो युजा॒ना अ॒र्वागि॑न्द्र सध॒मादो॑ वहन्तु । प्र ये द्वि॒ता दि॒व ऋ॒ञ्जन्त्याता॒: सुस॑म्मृष्टासो वृष॒भस्य॑ मू॒राः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ bṛhántaḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ yujānā́ḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ indra ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ vahantu ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ dvitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ṛñjánti ǀ ā́tāḥ ǀ sú-sammṛṣṭāsaḥ ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your mighty horses,Indra, harnessed (in your car), and alike exhilaarated (bySoma), bring you our presence, for they are the destroyers (of the foes) of the showerer (of benefits), and kindly rubbed by hishandthey traverse, going quickly, the regions of the sky, making them as it were twofold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ पिब॒ वृष॑धूतस्य॒ वृष्ण॒ आ यं ते॑ श्ये॒न उ॑श॒ते ज॒भार॑ । यस्य॒ मदे॑ च्या॒वय॑सि॒ प्र कृ॒ष्टीर्यस्य॒ मदे॒ अप॑ गो॒त्रा व॒वर्थ॑
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ píba ǀ vṛ́ṣa-dhūtasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yám ǀ te ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ uśaté ǀ jabhā́ra ǀyásya ǀ máde ǀ cyaváyasi ǀ prá ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ yásya ǀ máde ǀ ápa ǀ gotrā́ ǀ vavártha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, of the bountiful (libation) expressed by the beneficent (stones); that which the falcon has borne to you desiring it, in whose exhilaration you cast down (opposing) men, in whose exhilaration you have set open the clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndradistinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॑ अस्तु हर्य॒तः सोम॒ आ हरि॑भिः सु॒तः । जु॒षा॒ण इ॑न्द्र॒ हरि॑भिर्न॒ आ ग॒ह्या ति॑ष्ठ॒ हरि॑तं॒ रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ astu ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ indra ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ā́ ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ háritam ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this desirable and gratifyingSomaexpressed by the stones,by,Indra, for you ascend the verdant chariot, and with your tawny (steeds) come to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒र्यन्नु॒षस॑मर्चय॒: सूर्यं॑ ह॒र्यन्न॑रोचयः । वि॒द्वाँश्चि॑कि॒त्वान्ह॑र्यश्व वर्धस॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑ अ॒भि श्रिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: haryán ǀ uṣásam ǀ arcayaḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ haryán ǀ arocayaḥ ǀvidvā́n ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ hari-aśva ǀ vardhase ǀ índra ǀ víśvā ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring (theSoma), you honour the dawn; desirng the Soma, yu have lighted up the sun; knowing and discriminating (all our wishes), lord of the tawny steeds, you augment upon us all (sorts of) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यामिन्द्रो॒ हरि॑धायसं पृथि॒वीं हरि॑वर्पसम् । अधा॑रयद्ध॒रितो॒र्भूरि॒ भोज॑नं॒ ययो॑र॒न्तर्हरि॒श्चर॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́m ǀ índraḥ ǀ hári-dhāyasam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ hári-varpasam ǀádhārayat ǀ harítoḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ bhójanam ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ cárat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas upheld the yellow-rayed heaven; the verdant tinted earth; there is abundant pasture (for his steeds) in the two azure spheres of heaven and earth, between whichHaritravels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒ज्ञा॒नो हरि॑तो॒ वृषा॒ विश्व॒मा भा॑ति रोच॒नम् । हर्य॑श्वो॒ हरि॑तं धत्त॒ आयु॑ध॒मा वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोर्हरि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: jajñānáḥ ǀ háritaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ rocanám ǀhári-aśvaḥ ǀ háritam ǀ dhatte ǀ ā́yudham ǀ ā́ ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ hárim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The azure-coloured showerer (of benefits), illumes, as soon as born, the whole luminous region; the lord of the tawny steeds holds in hishandsthe yellow weapon, the destroying thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ ह॒र्यन्त॒मर्जु॑नं॒ वज्रं॑ शु॒क्रैर॒भीवृ॑तम् । अपा॑वृणो॒द्धरि॑भि॒रद्रि॑भिः सु॒तमुद्गा हरि॑भिराजत
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ haryántam ǀ árjunam ǀ vájram ǀ śukráiḥ ǀ abhí-vṛtam ǀápa ǀ avṛṇot ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ út ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ ājata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas uncovered the desirable white-coloured, fast-flowingSoma, effused by the expressing stones, and overlaid with the shining (milk and other liquids), in like manner as when, borne by his tawny steeds, he rescued the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ म॒न्द्रैरि॑न्द्र॒ हरि॑भिर्या॒हि म॒यूर॑रोमभिः । मा त्वा॒ के चि॒न्नि य॑म॒न्विं न पा॒शिनोऽति॒ धन्वे॑व॒ ताँ इ॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mandráiḥ ǀ indra ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yāhí ǀ mayū́raroma-bhiḥ ǀmā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ yaman ǀ vím ǀ ná ǀ pāśínaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dhánva-iva ǀ tā́n ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, with your exulting peacock-haired steeds; let no person ns detain you, as (fowlers) throwing snares catch a bird;pass them by (quickly) as (travellers cross) a desert.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒त्र॒खा॒दो व॑लंरु॒जः पु॒रां द॒र्मो अ॒पाम॒जः । स्थाता॒ रथ॑स्य॒ हर्यो॑रभिस्व॒र इन्द्रो॑ दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑दारु॒जः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛtra-khādáḥ ǀ valam-rujáḥ ǀ purā́m ǀ darmáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ajáḥ ǀsthā́tā ǀ ráthasya ǀ háryoḥ ǀ abhi-svaré ǀ índraḥ ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ ā-rujáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The evourer ofVṛtra, the fracturer of the cloud, the sender of the waters, the demolisher of cities,Indra, the destroyer of powerful enemies, has mounted his chariot to urge his horses to our presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒म्भी॒राँ उ॑द॒धीँरि॑व॒ क्रतुं॑ पुष्यसि॒ गा इ॑व । प्र सु॑गो॒पा यव॑सं धे॒नवो॑ यथा ह्र॒दं कु॒ल्या इ॑वाशत
shlokas.transliteration: gambhīrā́n ǀ udadhī́n-iva ǀ krátum ǀ puṣyasi ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀprá ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǀ yávasam ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ hradám ǀ kulyā́ḥ-iva ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You cherish the celebrator of the pious rite as you fill the deep seas (with water); or as a careful herdsman (cherishes) the cows; (you imbibe theSoma) as cows (obtain) fodder, (and the Soma juices) flow into you as rivulets flow into a lake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒स्तुजं॑ र॒यिं भ॒रांशं॒ न प्र॑तिजान॒ते । वृ॒क्षं प॒क्वं फल॑म॒ङ्कीव॑ धूनु॒हीन्द्र॑ स॒म्पार॑णं॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tújam ǀ rayím ǀ bhara ǀ áṃśam ǀ ná ǀ prati-jānaté ǀvṛkṣám ǀ pakvám ǀ phálam ǀ aṅkī́-iva ǀ dhūnuhi ǀ índra ǀ sam-pā́raṇam ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us riches, securing (us against foes), (as a father bestows) his portion on (a son) arrived at maturity; send down upon us,Indra, wealth adequate (to our desires), as a crookbringd down the ripe fruit from a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒युरि॑न्द्र स्व॒राळ॑सि॒ स्मद्दि॑ष्टि॒: स्वय॑शस्तरः । स वा॑वृधा॒न ओज॑सा पुरुष्टुत॒ भवा॑ नः सु॒श्रव॑स्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: sva-yúḥ ǀ indra ǀ sva-rā́ṭ ǀ asi ǀ smát-diṣṭiḥ ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taraḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are possessed of opulence,Indra; you are the lord of heaven, auspicious and renowned; may you who is adored of many, increasing in vigour, be to us a most (bountiful bestower) of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ध्मस्य॑ ते वृष॒भस्य॑ स्व॒राज॑ उ॒ग्रस्य॒ यून॒: स्थवि॑रस्य॒ घृष्वे॑: । अजू॑र्यतो व॒ज्रिणो॑ वी॒र्या॒३॒॑णीन्द्र॑ श्रु॒तस्य॑ मह॒तो म॒हानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yudhmásya ǀ te ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ ugrásya ǀ yū́naḥ ǀ sthávirasya ǀ ghṛ́ṣveḥ ǀájūryataḥ ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ índra ǀ śrutásya ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vast are the energies of you,Indra, the warrior, (the showerer of benefits), the lord of wealth, the fierce; who is (both) young and old; the overcomer of foes, the undecaying, the wielder of the thunderbolt, and who is mighty and renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ अ॑सि महिष॒ वृष्ण्ये॑भिर्धन॒स्पृदु॑ग्र॒ सह॑मानो अ॒न्यान् । एको॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ राजा॒ स यो॒धया॑ च क्ष॒यया॑ च॒ जना॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ mahiṣa ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyebhiḥ ǀ dhana-spṛ́t ǀ ugra ǀ sáhamānaḥ ǀ anyā́n ǀékaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ sáḥ ǀ yodháyā ǀ ca ǀ kṣayáya ǀ ca ǀ jánān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable and powerfulIndra, you are great and magnificent, overcoming adversaries by your prowess; you alone are lord of all the world; do you war (upon our enemies), and give safe dwellings to men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मात्रा॑भी रिरिचे॒ रोच॑मान॒: प्र दे॒वेभि॑र्वि॒श्वतो॒ अप्र॑तीतः । प्र म॒ज्मना॑ दि॒व इन्द्र॑: पृथि॒व्याः प्रोरोर्म॒हो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षादृजी॒षी
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ mā́trābhiḥ ǀ ririce ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀ prá ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ áprati-itaḥ ǀprá ǀ majmánā ǀ diváḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ uróḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The resplendent and every way unlimitedIndra, drinking the spiritlessSoma, far surpasses the elements, (far exceeds) the gods in power; he is more vast than heaven and earth, or the widespread spacious firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रुं ग॑भी॒रं ज॒नुषा॒भ्यु१॒॑ग्रं वि॒श्वव्य॑चसमव॒तं म॑ती॒नाम् । इन्द्रं॒ सोमा॑सः प्र॒दिवि॑ सु॒तास॑: समु॒द्रं न स्र॒वत॒ आ वि॑शन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: urúm ǀ gabhīrám ǀ janúṣā ǀ abhí ǀ ugrám ǀ viśvá-vyacasam ǀ avatám ǀ matīnā́m ǀíndram ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ná ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viśanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomadaily poured out enter into the vast and profundIndra, fierce from his birth, all-pervading, the protector of the pious (worshipper), as rivers flow into the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं सोम॑मिन्द्र पृथि॒वीद्यावा॒ गर्भं॒ न मा॒ता बि॑भृ॒तस्त्वा॒या । तं ते॑ हिन्वन्ति॒ तमु॑ ते मृजन्त्यध्व॒र्यवो॑ वृषभ॒ पात॒वा उ॑
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ pṛthivī́dyā́vā ǀ gárbham ǀ ná ǀ mātā́ ǀ bibhṛtáḥ ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀtám ǀ te ǀ hinvanti ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ mṛjanti ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ pā́tavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhichSoma,Indra, the heaven and earth, containing for you, as a mother contains the embryo; showerer (of benefits), the priests pour it out for you they purify it for your drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र वृष॒भो रणा॑य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑मनुष्व॒धं मदा॑य । आ सि॑ञ्चस्व ज॒ठरे॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिं त्वं राजा॑सि प्र॒दिव॑: सु॒ताना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: marútvān ǀ indra ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ráṇāya ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ mádāya ǀā́ ǀ siñcasva ǀ jaṭháre ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ tvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ asi ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sutā́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, attended by theMaruts, the showerer (of benefits), drink theSomaoffered after the other presentations, for your exhilaration for battle; take into your belly the (full) wave of the inebriating (Soma), for you are lord of libations from the days of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जोषा॑ इन्द्र॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॒: सोमं॑ पिब वृत्र॒हा शू॑र वि॒द्वान् । ज॒हि शत्रूँ॒रप॒ मृधो॑ नुद॒स्वाथाभ॑यं कृणुहि वि॒श्वतो॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ indra ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ sómam ǀ piba ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ śūra ǀ vidvā́n ǀjahí ǀ śátrūn ǀ ápa ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ nudasva ǀ átha ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero, rejoicing with and accompanied by the host ofMaruts, drink theSoma, for you are the slayer ofVṛtrathe sage; subdue our enemies, drive away the malevolent, make us safe on every side from peril.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ऋ॒तुभि॑ॠतुपाः पाहि॒ सोम॒मिन्द्र॑ दे॒वेभि॒: सखि॑भिः सु॒तं न॑: । याँ आभ॑जो म॒रुतो॒ ये त्वान्वह॑न्वृ॒त्रमद॑धु॒स्तुभ्य॒मोज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ ṛtu-pāḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǀ índra ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ naḥ ǀyā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ábhajaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ ánu ǀ áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ ójaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker of theSomain season, drink with your divine friend theMarutsthe Soma that is presented by us; those Maruts whose aid you have enjoyed (in battle), and who, following you have given you the strength whereby you have slainVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये त्वा॑हि॒हत्ये॑ मघव॒न्नव॑र्ध॒न्ये शा॑म्ब॒रे ह॑रिवो॒ ये गवि॑ष्टौ । ये त्वा॑ नू॒नम॑नु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्रा॒: पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोमं॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ tvā ǀ ahi-hátye ǀ magha-van ǀ ávardhan ǀ yé ǀ śāmbaré ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ yé ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀyé ǀ tvā ǀ nūnám ǀ anu-mádanti ǀ víprāḥ ǀ píba ǀ indra ǀ sómam ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who encouraged you,Maghavan, to slay Ahi, who (aided you) in the conflict withŚambara, and in the recovery of the cattle, and who, possessed of wisdom, contribute verily to your exhilaration, with them, the troop of themaruts, do youIndra, drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्व॑न्तं वृष॒भं वा॑वृधा॒नमक॑वारिं दि॒व्यं शा॒समिन्द्र॑म् । वि॒श्वा॒साह॒मव॑से॒ नूत॑नायो॒ग्रं स॑हो॒दामि॒ह तं हु॑वेम
shlokas.transliteration: marútvantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ ákava-arim ǀ divyám ǀ śāsám ǀ índram ǀviśva-sáham ǀ ávase ǀ nū́tanāya ǀ ugrám ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀ ihá ǀ tám ǀ huvema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke to this sacrifice for present protectionIndra, the chief of theMaruts, the showerer (of benefits) augmenting (in glory), overcoming many foes, divine regulator (of good and ill), the subduer of all (enemies), the fierce, the bestower of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यो ह॑ जा॒तो वृ॑ष॒भः क॒नीन॒: प्रभ॑र्तुमाव॒दन्ध॑सः सु॒तस्य॑ । सा॒धोः पि॑ब प्रतिका॒मं यथा॑ ते॒ रसा॑शिरः प्रथ॒मं सो॒म्यस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ ha ǀ jātáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ kanī́naḥ ǀ prá-bhartum ǀ āvat ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀsādhóḥ ǀ piba ǀ prati-kāmám ǀ yáthā ǀ te ǀ rása-āśiraḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ somyásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the showerer (of rain), who, as soon as born, is the object of affection, protect the offerer of the effused libation; drink at will,Indra, before (the other gods), of the pureSomamixed with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज्जाय॑था॒स्तदह॑रस्य॒ कामें॒ऽशोः पी॒यूष॑मपिबो गिरि॒ष्ठाम् । तं ते॑ मा॒ता परि॒ योषा॒ जनि॑त्री म॒हः पि॒तुर्दम॒ आसि॑ञ्च॒दग्रे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ jā́yathāḥ ǀ tát ǀ áhaḥ ǀ asya ǀ kā́me ǀ aṃśóḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ apibaḥ ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀtám ǀ te ǀ mātā́ ǀ pári ǀ yóṣā ǀ jánitrī ǀ maháḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ asiñcat ǀ ágre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “On the day on which you were born, you did drink at will the mountain-abiding nectar of thisSoma, for your youthful parent mother (Aditi), in the dwelling of your great sire (Kaśyapa), gave it to you before she gave the breast.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒स्थाय॑ मा॒तर॒मन्न॑मैट्ट ति॒ग्मम॑पश्यद॒भि सोम॒मूध॑: । प्र॒या॒वय॑न्नचर॒द्गृत्सो॑ अ॒न्यान्म॒हानि॑ चक्रे पुरु॒धप्र॑तीकः
shlokas.transliteration: upa-sthā́ya ǀ mātáram ǀ ánnam ǀ aiṭṭa ǀ tigmám ǀ apaśyat ǀ abhí ǀ sómam ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀpra-yaváyan ǀ acarat ǀ gṛ́tsaḥ ǀ anyā́n ǀ mahā́ni ǀ cakre ǀ purudhá-pratīkaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approaching his mother he asked for food, and beheld the acridSomaupon her bosom; eager he proceeds, dislodging the adversaries (of the gods); and, putting forth manifold (energy), he performed great (deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रस्तु॑रा॒षाळ॒भिभू॑त्योजा यथाव॒शं त॒न्वं॑ चक्र ए॒षः । त्वष्टा॑र॒मिन्द्रो॑ ज॒नुषा॑भि॒भूया॒मुष्या॒ सोम॑मपिबच्च॒मूषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ugráḥ ǀ turāṣā́ṭ ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǀ yathā-vaśám ǀ tanvám ǀ cakre ǀ eṣáḥ ǀtváṣṭāram ǀ índraḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ abhi-bhū́ya ǀ ā-múṣya ǀ sómam ǀ apibat ǀ camū́ṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fierce, rapid in assault, of overpowering strength he made his form obedient to his will; having overcomeTvaṣṭāby his innate (vigour), and carried off theSoma, he draink it (deposited) in the ladles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शंसा॑ म॒हामिन्द्रं॒ यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॒ आ कृ॒ष्टय॑: सोम॒पाः काम॒मव्य॑न् । यं सु॒क्रतुं॑ धि॒षणे॑ विभ्वत॒ष्टं घ॒नं वृ॒त्राणां॑ ज॒नय॑न्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: śáṃsa ǀ mahā́m ǀ índram ǀ yásmin ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ávyan ǀyám ǀ su-krátum ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ vibhva-taṣṭám ǀ ghanám ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ janáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify the mightyIndra, in whom all men, drinking theSoma, obtain their wishes; whom the powerful (heaven and earth) and the gods begot, the doer of great deeds, the slayer of theVṛtras, who was fashioned byVibhu(the creator).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं नु नकि॒: पृत॑नासु स्व॒राजं॑ द्वि॒ता तर॑ति॒ नृत॑मं हरि॒ष्ठाम् । इ॒नत॑म॒: सत्व॑भि॒र्यो ह॑ शू॒षैः पृ॑थु॒ज्रया॑ अमिना॒दायु॒र्दस्यो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ nú ǀ nákiḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀ dvitā́ ǀ tárati ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ hari-sthā́m ǀiná-tamaḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ pṛthu-jráyāḥ ǀ amināt ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ dásyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom, when borne by his steeds, foremost and eminent in battles, breaking in two the (hostile host), no one ever surpasses; supreme in a way, attended by his faithfulMaruts, and hastening to combat, he has destroyed with foe-withering (energies) the existence of theDasyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हावा॑ पृ॒त्सु त॒रणि॒र्नार्वा॑ व्यान॒शी रोद॑सी मे॒हना॑वान् । भगो॒ न का॒रे हव्यो॑ मती॒नां पि॒तेव॒ चारु॑: सु॒हवो॑ वयो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: sahá-vā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǀ vi-ānaśíḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mehánā-vān ǀbhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kāré ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vigorous, rushing through (hostile hosts), like a war-horse, he has pervaded heaven and earth, sending down rain; he is to be worshipped with oblations at the solemn (rite) likeBhaga; he is as the father of those who adore (him); he is beautiful, worthy of invocation, the bestower of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ध॒र्ता दि॒वो रज॑सस्पृ॒ष्ट ऊ॒र्ध्वो रथो॒ न वा॒युर्वसु॑भिर्नि॒युत्वा॑न् । क्ष॒पां व॒स्ता ज॑नि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य॒ विभ॑क्ता भा॒गं धि॒षणे॑व॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dhartā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ niyútvān ǀkṣapā́m ǀ vastā́ ǀ janitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ví-bhaktā ǀ bhāgám ǀ dhiṣáṇā-iva ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The upholder of heaven and of the firmament, the wind, like a chariot traversing the upper (region) accompanied by theVasus; the clother of the night (with gloom), the parent of the sun, the distributor of the portion (allotted to the pious), like the words (of the wealthy appropriating to all) the food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒: स्वाहा॑ पिबतु॒ यस्य॒ सोम॑ आ॒गत्या॒ तुम्रो॑ वृष॒भो म॒रुत्वा॑न् । ओरु॒व्यचा॑: पृणतामे॒भिरन्नै॒रास्य॑ ह॒विस्त॒न्व१॒॑: काम॑मृध्याः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ svā́hā ǀ pibatu ǀ yásya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ā-gátya ǀ túmraḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ marútvān ǀā́ ǀ uru-vyácāḥ ǀ pṛṇatām ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ asya ǀ havíḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ṛdhyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndradrink the libation; he of whom is theSoma, having come to the sacrifice; he who is the repeller (of adversaries), the showerer (of benefits), the lord of theMaruts; may he, the wide-pervading, be plural ased with these (sacrificial) viands; may the oblation be adequate to the wants of his body.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ सप॒र्यू ज॒वसे॑ युनज्मि॒ ययो॒रनु॑ प्र॒दिव॑: श्रु॒ष्टिमाव॑: । इ॒ह त्वा॑ धेयु॒र्हर॑यः सुशिप्र॒ पिबा॒ त्व१॒॑स्य सुषु॑तस्य॒ चारो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ saparyū́ íti ǀ javáse ǀ yunajmi ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀihá ǀ tvā ǀ dheyuḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ su-śipra ǀ píba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ cā́roḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I yoke (to your car), to bring you quickly, your two docile horses, whose speed you have of old employed; may your horses, handsomeIndra, bring you hither, and drink promptly of this well-effused agreeable libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोभि॑र्मिमि॒क्षुं द॑धिरे सुपा॒रमिन्द्रं॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ धाय॑से गृणा॒नाः । म॒न्दा॒नः सोमं॑ पपि॒वाँ ऋ॑जीषि॒न्त्सम॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुरु॒धा गा इ॑षण्य
shlokas.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ mimikṣúm ǀ dadhire ǀ su-pārám ǀ índram ǀ jyáiṣṭhyāya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀmandānáḥ ǀ sómam ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ sám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ purudhā́ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ iṣaṇya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His adorers support with cattle,Indra, who is willing to bestow upon them their desires, and ready to come to the sacrifice, for the sake of obtaining eminent prosperity and prolonged life; acceptor of the spiritlessSoma, who are the drinker of the Soma, and are exhilarated (by the draught), grant to us freely cattle in abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं कामं॑ मन्दया॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॑श्च॒न्द्रव॑ता॒ राध॑सा प॒प्रथ॑श्च । स्व॒र्यवो॑ म॒तिभि॒स्तुभ्यं॒ विप्रा॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ वाह॑: कुशि॒कासो॑ अक्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ kā́mam ǀ mandaya ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ candrá-vatā ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ papráthaḥ ǀ ca ǀsvaḥ-yávaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vā́haḥ ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ akran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratify this our desire (of wealth) with cows, with horses, with shining treasure, and make us renowned; the wiseKuśikas, desirous of heaven, offer praise of you,Indra, with pious (prayers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं हु॑वेम म॒घवा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑म॒स्मिन्भरे॒ नृत॑मं॒ वाज॑सातौ । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑मु॒ग्रमू॒तये॑ स॒मत्सु॒ घ्नन्तं॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सं॒जितं॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ huvema ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ índram ǀ asmín ǀ bháre ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ ugrám ǀ ūtáye ǀ samát-su ǀ ghnántam ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sam-jítam ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the opulentIndra, distinguished in this combat, the leader in the food-bestowing (strife), hearing (our praises), terrible in battles, the destroyer of foes, the conqueror of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒र्ष॒णी॒धृतं॑ म॒घवा॑नमु॒क्थ्य१॒॑मिन्द्रं॒ गिरो॑ बृह॒तीर॒भ्य॑नूषत । वा॒वृ॒धा॒नं पु॑रुहू॒तं सु॑वृ॒क्तिभि॒रम॑र्त्यं॒ जर॑माणं दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tam ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ ukthyám ǀ índram ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀvavṛdhānám ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀ járamāṇam ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let abundant praises celebrateIndra, the stay of man, the possessor of opulence, the adorable, prospering with increase, the invoked of many, the immortal, who is daily to be propitiated with sacred hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तक्र॑तुमर्ण॒वं शा॒किनं॒ नरं॒ गिरो॑ म॒ इन्द्र॒मुप॑ यन्ति वि॒श्वत॑: । वा॒ज॒सनिं॑ पू॒र्भिदं॒ तूर्णि॑म॒प्तुरं॑ धाम॒साच॑मभि॒षाचं॑ स्व॒र्विद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śatá-kratum ǀ arṇavám ǀ śākínam ǀ náram ǀ gíraḥ ǀ me ǀ índram ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀvāja-sánim ǀ pūḥ-bhídam ǀ tū́rṇim ǀ ap-túram ǀ dhāma-sā́cam ǀ abhi-sā́cam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praises constantly propitiateIndra, the object of many rites, the sender of rain, attended by theMaruts, the leader (of all), the giver of food, the destroyer of cities, the swift (in combat), the prompt (dispenser) of waters, the distributor of riches, the subduer of foes, the conferrer of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒क॒रे वसो॑र्जरि॒ता प॑नस्यतेऽने॒हस॒: स्तुभ॒ इन्द्रो॑ दुवस्यति । वि॒वस्व॑त॒: सद॑न॒ आ हि पि॑प्रि॒ये स॑त्रा॒साह॑मभिमाति॒हनं॑ स्तुहि
shlokas.transliteration: ā-karé ǀ vásoḥ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ panasyate ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ stúbhaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ duvasyati ǀvivásvataḥ ǀ sádane ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ pipriyé ǀ satrā-sáham ǀ abhimāti-hánam ǀ stuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the enfeebler (of adversaries), is praised as a mine of wealth; he is propitiated by righteous commendations; he is gratified in the dwelling of the offerer of oblations; glorify Indra, the conqueror, the destroyer of his enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒णामु॑ त्वा॒ नृत॑मं गी॒र्भिरु॒क्थैर॒भि प्र वी॒रम॑र्चता स॒बाध॑: । सं सह॑से पुरुमा॒यो जि॑हीते॒ नमो॑ अस्य प्र॒दिव॒ एक॑ ईशे
shlokas.transliteration: nṛṇā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ nṛ́-tamam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ vīrám ǀ arcata ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀsám ǀ sáhase ǀ puru-māyáḥ ǀ jihīte ǀ námaḥ ǀ asya ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ īśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests glorify you, heroic leader of men, with praises and with prayers;Indra, the author of many delusions, exerts himself for (the acquisition of) strength; he from of old is the lord of this (oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीर॑स्य नि॒ष्षिधो॒ मर्त्ये॑षु पु॒रू वसू॑नि पृथि॒वी बि॑भर्ति । इन्द्रा॑य॒ द्याव॒ ओष॑धीरु॒तापो॑ र॒यिं र॑क्षन्ति जी॒रयो॒ वना॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ niḥ-sídhaḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ purú ǀ vásūni ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ bibharti ǀíndrāya ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ rayím ǀ rakṣanti ǀ jīráyaḥ ǀ vánāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are his prohibitions (against evil enjoined) to men; many are the treasures that the earth enshrines; forIndrathe heavens, the plural nts, the waters, men and priests, preserve their riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ गिर॑ इन्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॑ स॒त्रा द॑धिरे हरिवो जु॒षस्व॑ । बो॒ध्या॒३॒॑पिरव॑सो॒ नूत॑नस्य॒ सखे॑ वसो जरि॒तृभ्यो॒ वयो॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ gíraḥ ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ satrā́ ǀ dadhire ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ juṣásva ǀbodhí ǀ āpíḥ ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ sákhe ǀ vaso íti ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Indra, (the pious) address prayers, and praises, and sacrifices; accept them, lord of horses; give all things, partake of this present oblation, and grant food to the worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ मरुत्व इ॒ह पा॑हि॒ सोमं॒ यथा॑ शार्या॒ते अपि॑बः सु॒तस्य॑ । तव॒ प्रणी॑ती॒ तव॑ शूर॒ शर्म॒न्ना वि॑वासन्ति क॒वय॑: सुय॒ज्ञाः
