shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ marutvaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǀ yáthā ǀ śāryāté ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀtáva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ táva ǀ śūra ǀ śárman ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsanti ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ su-yajñā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, accompanied, by theMaruts, drink theSomaat this ceremony as you have drunk of this libation of the son ofŚāryāti; your far-reaching and devout worshippers, being in security, adore you through their offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॑वशा॒न इ॒ह पा॑हि॒ सोमं॑ म॒रुद्भि॑रिन्द्र॒ सखि॑भिः सु॒तं न॑: । जा॒तं यत्त्वा॒ परि॑ दे॒वा अभू॑षन्म॒हे भरा॑य पुरुहूत॒ विश्वे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ ihá ǀ pāhi ǀ sómam ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ naḥ ǀjātám ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ pári ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ábhūṣan ǀ mahé ǀ bhárāya ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, who is gratified by theSoma, drink the Soma that has been effused by us, together with your friends, theMaruts, at this ceremony; you who is invoked of many, and whom all the gods equipped as soon as born for the great battle (with theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्तूर्ये॑ मरुत आ॒पिरे॒षोऽम॑न्द॒न्निन्द्र॒मनु॒ दाति॑वाराः । तेभि॑: सा॒कं पि॑बतु वृत्रखा॒दः सु॒तं सोमं॑ दा॒शुष॒: स्वे स॒धस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ap-tū́rye ǀ marutaḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ámandan ǀ índram ǀ ánu ǀ dā́ti-vārāḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ sākám ǀ pibatu ǀ vṛtra-khādáḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ své ǀ sadhá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, this is your friend for sending of the waters; they (the Maruts), the givers of strength, have yieldedIndragratification; may the devourer ofVṛtradrink with them the libation offered by the worshipper in his abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं ह्यन्वोज॑सा सु॒तं रा॑धानां पते । पिबा॒ त्व१॒॑स्य गि॑र्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ hí ǀ ánu ǀ ójasā ǀ sutám ǀ rādhānām ǀ pate ǀpíba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of riches, entitled to praise, this libation has been effused agreeably to (our) strength; do you drink of it quickly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ अनु॑ स्व॒धामस॑त्सु॒ते नि य॑च्छ त॒न्व॑म् । स त्वा॑ ममत्तु सो॒म्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ásat ǀ suté ǀ ní ǀ yaccha ǀ tanvám ǀsáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ mamattu ǀ somyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invigorate your body with theSomathat has been poured out as food for you; may it exhilarate you, delighting in the Soma draught.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ अश्नोतु कु॒क्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ शिर॑: । प्र बा॒हू शू॑र॒ राध॑से
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ aśnotu ǀ kukṣyóḥ ǀ prá ǀ indra ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ śíraḥ ǀprá ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this libation,Indra, penetrate to your flanks; may it, (aided) by prayer, reach your head; may it spread, hero, through your arms, (that they may distribute) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धा॒नाव॑न्तं कर॒म्भिण॑मपू॒पव॑न्तमु॒क्थिन॑म् । इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒तर्जु॑षस्व नः
shlokas.transliteration: dhānā́-vantam ǀ karambhíṇam ǀ apūpá-vantam ǀ ukthínam ǀíndra ǀ prātáḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Indra, at our morning sacrifice, this libation, combined with fresh barley, with parched grain and curds, and with cakes, and sanctified by holy prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळाशं॑ पच॒त्यं॑ जु॒षस्वे॒न्द्रा गु॑रस्व च । तुभ्यं॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ सिस्रते
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ pacatyám ǀ juṣásva ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ gurasva ǀ ca ǀtúbhyam ǀ havyā́ni ǀ sisrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Indra, the prepared cakes and butter; eat them eagerly; the oblations flow for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळाशं॑ च नो॒ घसो॑ जो॒षया॑से॒ गिर॑श्च नः । व॒धू॒युरि॑व॒ योष॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ghásaḥ ǀ joṣáyāse ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀvadhūyúḥ-iva ǀ yóṣaṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eat,Indra, our (offered) cakes and butter, derive enjoyment from our praises, as a lover from his mistress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळाशं॑ सनश्रुत प्रातःसा॒वे जु॑षस्व नः । इन्द्र॒ क्रतु॒र्हि ते॑ बृ॒हन्
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ sana-śruta ǀ prātaḥ-sāvé ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǀíndra ǀ krátuḥ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ bṛhán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, renowned of old, accept our cakes and butter, offered at dawn; for great are your deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य धा॒नाः पु॑रो॒ळाश॑मिन्द्र कृष्वे॒ह चारु॑म् । प्र यत्स्तो॒ता ज॑रि॒ता तूर्ण्य॑र्थो वृषा॒यमा॑ण॒ उप॑ गी॒र्भिरीट्टे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ indra ǀ kṛṣva ǀ ihá ǀ cā́rum ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ stotā́ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ tū́rṇi-arthaḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yámāṇaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Partake,Indra, of the barley and the delicious cakes and butter of the midday sacrifice, when your zealous worshipper, hastening to adore you, and eager as a bull, is present, and celebrates (yo) with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तृ॒तीये॑ धा॒नाः सव॑ने पुरुष्टुत पुरो॒ळाश॒माहु॑तं मामहस्व नः । ऋ॒भु॒मन्तं॒ वाज॑वन्तं त्वा कवे॒ प्रय॑स्वन्त॒ उप॑ शिक्षेम धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tṛtī́ye ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ sávane ǀ puru-stuta ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ mamahasva ǀ naḥ ǀṛbhu-mántam ǀ vā́ja-vantam ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ śikṣema ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is praised of many, accept readily from our friend of barley, and cakes, and butter, offered at the third (or evening) sacrifice; ladenwith sacrificial viands, we approach with praises to your sage Indra, who is accompanied by theṛbhusand byVāja.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒ष॒ण्वते॑ ते चकृमा कर॒म्भं हरि॑वते॒ हर्य॑श्वाय धा॒नाः । अ॒पू॒पम॑द्धि॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॒: सोमं॑ पिब वृत्र॒हा शू॑र वि॒द्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣaṇ-váte ǀ te ǀ cakṛma ǀ karambhám ǀ hári-vate ǀ hári-aśvāya ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀapūpám ǀ addhi ǀ sá-gaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ sómam ǀ piba ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ śūra ǀ vidvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have prepared the parched grain and curds for you, associated withPūṣan; the fried barley for you, lord of the tawny horses, associated with your steeds; attend by the troop ofMaruts, eat the cakes; hero, who is wise, and the slayer ofVṛtra, drink the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ धा॒ना भ॑रत॒ तूय॑मस्मै पुरो॒ळाशं॑ वी॒रत॑माय नृ॒णाम् । दि॒वेदि॑वे स॒दृशी॑रिन्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॒ वर्ध॑न्तु त्वा सोम॒पेया॑य धृष्णो
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀ bharata ǀ tū́yam ǀ asmai ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ vīrá-tamāya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀdivé-dive ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ várdhantu ǀ tvā ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer to him quickly (priests) the fried barley; offer to the most heroic of leaders the cakes and butter; may the like offerings, victoriousIndra, presented to you daily, augment your vigour for the drinking of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑पर्वता बृह॒ता रथे॑न वा॒मीरिष॒ आ व॑हतं सु॒वीरा॑: । वी॒तं ह॒व्यान्य॑ध्व॒रेषु॑ देवा॒ वर्धे॑थां गी॒र्भिरिळ॑या॒ मद॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: índrāparvatā ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráthena ǀ vāmī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vahatam ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀvītám ǀ havyā́ni ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ devā ǀ várdhethām ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ mádantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandParvata, bring hither, in a spacious car, delightful viands (genitive rative of) good progeny; partake, deities, of the oblations (offered)at (our) sacrifices, and gratified by the (sacrificial) food, be elevated by our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तिष्ठा॒ सु कं॑ मघव॒न्मा परा॑ गा॒: सोम॑स्य॒ नु त्वा॒ सुषु॑तस्य यक्षि । पि॒तुर्न पु॒त्रः सिच॒मा र॑भे त॒ इन्द्र॒ स्वादि॑ष्ठया गि॒रा श॑चीवः
shlokas.transliteration: tíṣṭha ǀ sú ǀ kam ǀ magha-van ǀ mā́ ǀ párā ǀ gāḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ nú ǀ tvā ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ yakṣi ǀpitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ sícam ǀ ā́ ǀ rabhe ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ svā́diṣṭhayā ǀ girā́ ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tarry a while contentedly,Maghavan(at our rite); go not away; for I offer to you (the libation) of the copiously-effusedSoma; powerfulIndra, I lay hold of the skirts (of your robe) with sweet-flavoured commendations, as a son (clings to the garment) of a father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शंसा॑वाध्वर्यो॒ प्रति॑ मे गृणी॒हीन्द्रा॑य॒ वाह॑: कृणवाव॒ जुष्ट॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्यज॑मानस्य सी॒दाथा॑ च भूदु॒क्थमिन्द्रा॑य श॒स्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: śáṃsāva ǀ adhvaryo íti ǀ práti ǀ me ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ índrāya ǀ vā́haḥ ǀ kṛṇavāva ǀ júṣṭam ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sīda ǀ átha ǀ ca ǀ bhūt ǀ ukthám ǀ índrāya ǀ śastám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adhvaryu, let us two offer praise; do you concur with me; let us address plural asing praise toIndra; sit down, Indra, on the sacred grass (prepared by) the instrumental tutor of the rite; and may our commendations be most acceptable to Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒येदस्तं॑ मघव॒न्त्सेदु॒ योनि॒स्तदित्त्वा॑ यु॒क्ता हर॑यो वहन्तु । य॒दा क॒दा च॑ सु॒नवा॑म॒ सोम॑म॒ग्निष्ट्वा॑ दू॒तो ध॑न्वा॒त्यच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: jāyā́ ǀ ít ǀ ástam ǀ magha-van ǀ sā́ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ yóniḥ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ tvā ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀyadā́ ǀ kadā́ ǀ ca ǀ sunávāma ǀ sómam ǀ agníḥ ǀ tvā ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ dhanvāti ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A man's wife,Maghavan, is hiw dwelling; verily she is his plural ce of birth; thither let your horses, harnessed (to your car), convey you; we prepare theSomaat the fit season; mayAgnicome as our messenger befor eyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ याहि मघव॒न्ना च॑ या॒हीन्द्र॑ भ्रातरुभ॒यत्रा॑ ते॒ अर्थ॑म् । यत्रा॒ रथ॑स्य बृह॒तो नि॒धानं॑ वि॒मोच॑नं वा॒जिनो॒ रास॑भस्य
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ yāhi ǀ magha-van ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ yāhi ǀ índra ǀ bhrātaḥ ǀ ubhayátra ǀ te ǀ ártham ǀyátra ǀ ráthasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ni-dhā́nam ǀ vi-mócanam ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ rā́sabhasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Depart,Maghavan; comeIndra; both ways, protector, there is a motive for you whether it be standing in your vast chariot, or liberating your neighing steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॒: सोम॒मस्त॑मिन्द्र॒ प्र या॑हि कल्या॒णीर्जा॒या सु॒रणं॑ गृ॒हे ते॑ । यत्रा॒ रथ॑स्य बृह॒तो नि॒धानं॑ वि॒मोच॑नं वा॒जिनो॒ दक्षि॑णावत्
shlokas.transliteration: ápāḥ ǀ sómam ǀ ástam ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ kalyāṇī́ḥ ǀ jāyā́ ǀ su-ráṇam ǀ gṛhé ǀ te ǀyátra ǀ ráthasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ni-dhā́nam ǀ vi-mócanam ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ dákṣiṇā-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you have drunk theSoma, then,Indra, go home; an auspicious life (abides) plural asantly in your dwelling; in either (case) there is the standing in your car or liberating the steeds for provender.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे भो॒जा अङ्गि॑रसो॒ विरू॑पा दि॒वस्पु॒त्रासो॒ असु॑रस्य वी॒राः । वि॒श्वामि॑त्राय॒ दद॑तो म॒घानि॑ सहस्रसा॒वे प्र ति॑रन्त॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ bhojā́ḥ ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ ví-rūpāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀviśvā́mitrāya ǀ dádataḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ sahasra-sāvé ǀ prá ǀ tirante ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (sacrificers) are theBhojas, of whom the diversifiedAṅgirasas(are the priests); and the heroic sons of the expeller (of the foes of the gods) from heaven, bestowing riches uponViśvāmitraat the sacrifice of a thousand (victims), prolong (his) life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रू॒पंरू॑पं म॒घवा॑ बोभवीति मा॒याः कृ॑ण्वा॒नस्त॒न्वं१॒॑ परि॒ स्वाम् । त्रिर्यद्दि॒वः परि॑ मुहू॒र्तमागा॒त्स्वैर्मन्त्रै॒रनृ॑तुपा ऋ॒तावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: rūpám-rūpam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ bobhavīti ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ pári ǀ svā́m ǀtríḥ ǀ yát ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ muhūrtám ǀ ā́ ǀ ágāt ǀ sváiḥ ǀ mántraiḥ ǀ ánṛtu-pāḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavanbecomes repeatedly (manifest) in various forms, practising delusions with respect to his own peculiar person n; and invoked by his appropriate prayers, he comes in a moment from heaven to the three (daily rites), and, although observant of seasons, is the drinker (of theSoma) irrespective of season.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ ऋषि॑र्देव॒जा दे॒वजू॒तोऽस्त॑भ्ना॒त्सिन्धु॑मर्ण॒वं नृ॒चक्षा॑: । वि॒श्वामि॑त्रो॒ यदव॑हत्सु॒दास॒मप्रि॑यायत कुशि॒केभि॒रिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ deva-jā́ḥ ǀ devá-jūtaḥ ǀ ástabhnāt ǀ síndhum ǀ arṇavám ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀviśvā́mitraḥ ǀ yát ǀ ávahat ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ ápriyāyata ǀ kuśikébhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great ṛṣi the genitive rator of the gods, the attracted by the deities, the overlooker of the leaders (at holy rites),Viśvāmitraattested the watery stream when he sacrificed forSudās;Indra, with theKuśikaswas plural ased.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हं॒सा इ॑व कृणुथ॒ श्लोक॒मद्रि॑भि॒र्मद॑न्तो गी॒र्भिर॑ध्व॒रे सु॒ते सचा॑ । दे॒वेभि॑र्विप्रा ऋषयो नृचक्षसो॒ वि पि॑बध्वं कुशिकाः सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: haṃsā́ḥ-iva ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ ślókam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ viprāḥ ǀ ṛṣayaḥ ǀ nṛ-cakṣasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ pibadhvam ǀ kuśikāḥ ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sages and saints overlookers of the leaders (of sacred rites),Kuśikas, when theSomais expresssed with stones at the sacrifice, then exhilarating (the gods) with praises, sing the holy strain (aloud) like (screaming) swans, and, together with the gods, drink the sweet juice of the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ प्रेत॑ कुशिकाश्चे॒तय॑ध्व॒मश्वं॑ रा॒ये प्र मु॑ञ्चता सु॒दास॑: । राजा॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑ङ्घन॒त्प्रागपा॒गुद॒गथा॑ यजाते॒ वर॒ आ पृ॑थि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ prá ǀ ita ǀ kuśikāḥ ǀ cetáyadhvam ǀ áśvam ǀ rāyé ǀ prá ǀ muñcata ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀrā́jā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaṅghanat ǀ prā́k ǀ ápāk ǀ údak ǀ átha ǀ yajāte ǀ váre ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach,Kuśikas, the steed ofSudās; animate (him), and let him loose to (win) riches (for theraja); for the king (of the gods) has slainVṛtrain the East, in the West, in the North, therefore let (Sudās) worship him in the best (regions) of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒मे रोद॑सी उ॒भे अ॒हमिन्द्र॒मतु॑ष्टवम् । वि॒श्वामि॑त्रस्य रक्षति॒ ब्रह्मे॒दं भार॑तं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ahám ǀ índram ǀ átustavam ǀviśvā́mitrasya ǀ rakṣati ǀ bráhma ǀ idám ǀ bhā́ratam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have madeIndraglorified by these two, heaven and earth, and this prayer ofViśvāmitraprotects the race ofBharata.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्वामि॑त्रा अरासत॒ ब्रह्मेन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ । कर॒दिन्न॑: सु॒राध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: viśvā́mitrāḥ ǀ arāsata ǀ bráhma ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀkárat ǀ ít ǀ naḥ ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheViśvāmitrashave addressed the prayer toIndra, the wielder of the thunderbolt; may he therefore render us very opulent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किं ते॑ कृण्वन्ति॒ कीक॑टेषु॒ गावो॒ नाशिरं॑ दु॒ह्रे न त॑पन्ति घ॒र्मम् । आ नो॑ भर॒ प्रम॑गन्दस्य॒ वेदो॑ नैचाशा॒खं म॑घवन्रन्धया नः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ te ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ kī́kaṭeṣu ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ā-śíram ǀ duhré ǀ ná ǀ tapanti ǀ gharmám ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ prá-magandasya ǀ védaḥ ǀ naicā-śākhám ǀ magha-van ǀ randhaya ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What do the cattle for you among theKīkaṭas; they yield no milk to mix with theSoma, they need not the vessel (for the libation); bring them to us; (bring also) the wealth of the son of the usurer, and give usMaghavan, (the possessions) of the low branches (of the community).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒स॒र्प॒रीरम॑तिं॒ बाध॑माना बृ॒हन्मि॑माय ज॒मद॑ग्निदत्ता । आ सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒ता त॑तान॒ श्रवो॑ दे॒वेष्व॒मृत॑मजु॒र्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sasarparī́ḥ ǀ ámatim ǀ bā́dhamānā ǀ bṛhát ǀ mimāya ǀ jamádagni-dattā ǀā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀ tatāna ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ajuryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter ofSūryagiven byJamadagnigliding everywhere and dissipating ignorance, has emitted a mighty (sound), and has diffused ambrosial imperishable food among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒स॒र्प॒रीर॑भर॒त्तूय॑मे॒भ्योऽधि॒ श्रव॒: पाञ्च॑जन्यासु कृ॒ष्टिषु॑ । सा प॒क्ष्या॒३॒॑ नव्य॒मायु॒र्दधा॑ना॒ यां मे॑ पलस्तिजमद॒ग्नयो॑ द॒दुः
shlokas.transliteration: sasarparī́ḥ ǀ abharat ǀ tū́yam ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyāsu ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǀsā́ ǀ pakṣyā́ ǀ návyam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ dádhānā ǀ yā́m ǀ me ǀ palasti-jamadagnáyaḥ ǀ dadúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May she, gliding everywhere, quickly bring us food (suited) to the five races of men; may she, the daughter of the sun whom the grey-hairedjamadagnisgave to me, (be) the bestower of new life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रौ गावौ॑ भवतां वी॒ळुरक्षो॒ मेषा वि व॑र्हि॒ मा यु॒गं वि शा॑रि । इन्द्र॑: पात॒ल्ये॑ ददतां॒ शरी॑तो॒ररि॑ष्टनेमे अ॒भि न॑: सचस्व
shlokas.transliteration: sthiráu ǀ gā́vau ǀ bhavatām ǀ vīḷúḥ ǀ ákṣaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ īṣā́ ǀ ví ǀ varhi ǀ mā́ ǀ yugám ǀ ví ǀ śāri ǀíndraḥ ǀ pātalyé íti ǀ dadatām ǀ śárītoḥ ǀ áriṣṭa-neme ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sacasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the horse be steady, the axle be strong, the pole be not defective, the yoke not be rotten; mayIndrapreserve the two yoke-pins from decay; car with uninjured felloes, be ready for us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बलं॑ धेहि त॒नूषु॑ नो॒ बल॑मिन्द्रान॒ळुत्सु॑ नः । बलं॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय जी॒वसे॒ त्वं हि ब॑ल॒दा असि॑
shlokas.transliteration: bálam ǀ dhehi ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ bálam ǀ indra ǀ anaḷút-su ǀ naḥ ǀbálam ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ jīváse ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ bala-dā́ḥ ǀ ási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give strength,Indra, to our bodies; give strength to our vehicles; (give) strength to our sons and grandsons; that they may live (long); for you are giver of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि व्य॑यस्व खदि॒रस्य॒ सार॒मोजो॑ धेहि स्पन्द॒ने शिं॒शपा॑याम् । अक्ष॑ वीळो वीळित वी॒ळय॑स्व॒ मा यामा॑द॒स्मादव॑ जीहिपो नः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vyayasva ǀ khadirásya ǀ sā́ram ǀ ójaḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ spandané ǀ śiṃśápāyām ǀákṣa ǀ vīḷo íti ǀ vīḷita ǀ vīḷáyasva ǀ mā́ ǀ yā́māt ǀ asmā́t ǀ áva ǀ jīhipaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fix firmly the substance of the khayar (axle), give solidity to theśiśu(floor) of the car; strong axle, strongly fixed by us, be strong; cast us not from out of our conveyance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॒स्मान्वन॒स्पति॒र्मा च॒ हा मा च॑ रीरिषत् । स्व॒स्त्या गृ॒हेभ्य॒ आव॒सा आ वि॒मोच॑नात्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ asmā́n ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ca ǀ hā́ḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ca ǀ ririṣat ǀsvastí ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛhébhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avasái ǀ ā́ ǀ vi-mócanāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this lord of the forest never desert us nor do us harm; may we travel prosperously home until the stopping (of the car), until the unharnessing (of the steeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒तिभि॑र्बहु॒लाभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य या॑च्छ्रे॒ष्ठाभि॑र्मघवञ्छूर जिन्व । यो नो॒ द्वेष्ट्यध॑र॒: सस्प॑दीष्ट॒ यमु॑ द्वि॒ष्मस्तमु॑ प्रा॒णो ज॑हातु
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ bahulā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ yāt-śreṣṭhā́bhiḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ śūra ǀ jinva ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dvéṣṭi ǀ ádharaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ padīṣṭa ǀ yám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dviṣmáḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prāṇáḥ ǀ jahātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, hero,possessor of wealth, protect us this day against our foes with many and excellent defences; may the vile wretch who hates us fall (before us); may the breath of life depart from him whom we hate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒र॒शुं चि॒द्वि त॑पति शिम्ब॒लं चि॒द्वि वृ॑श्चति । उ॒खा चि॑दिन्द्र॒ येष॑न्ती॒ प्रय॑स्ता॒ फेन॑मस्यति
shlokas.transliteration: paraśúm ǀ cit ǀ ví ǀ tapati ǀ śimbalám ǀ cit ǀ ví ǀ vṛścati ǀukhā́ ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ yéṣantī ǀ prá-yastā ǀ phénam ǀ asyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As (the tree) suffers pain from the axe, as the śimbal flower is (easily) cut off, as the injured cauldron leaking scatters foam, so may mine enemy perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न साय॑कस्य चिकिते जनासो लो॒धं न॑यन्ति॒ पशु॒ मन्य॑मानाः । नावा॑जिनं वा॒जिना॑ हासयन्ति॒ न ग॑र्द॒भं पु॒रो अश्वा॑न्नयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sā́yakasya ǀ cikite ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ lodhám ǀ nayanti ǀ páśu ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀná ǀ ávājinam ǀ vājínā ǀ hāsayanti ǀ ná ǀ gardabhám ǀ puráḥ ǀ áśvāt ǀ nayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men, (the might) of the destroyer is not known toyou; regarding him as a mere animal, they lead him away desirous (silently to complete his devotions); the wise condescend not to turn the foolish into ridicule, they do not lead the ass before the horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒म इ॑न्द्र भर॒तस्य॑ पु॒त्रा अ॑पपि॒त्वं चि॑कितु॒र्न प्र॑पि॒त्वम् । हि॒न्वन्त्यश्व॒मर॑णं॒ न नित्यं॒ ज्या॑वाजं॒ परि॑ णयन्त्या॒जौ
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ indra ǀ bharatásya ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ apa-pitvám ǀ cikituḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-pitvám ǀhinvánti ǀ áśvam ǀ áraṇam ǀ ná ǀ nítyam ǀ jyā-vā́jam ǀ pári ǀ nayanti ǀ ājáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These sons ofBharata,Indra, understand severance (from theVasiṣṭhas), not association (with them); they urge their steeds (against them) as against a constant foe; they bear a stout bow (for their destruction) in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं म॒हे वि॑द॒थ्या॑य शू॒षं शश्व॒त्कृत्व॒ ईड्या॑य॒ प्र ज॑भ्रुः । शृ॒णोतु॑ नो॒ दम्ये॑भि॒रनी॑कैः शृ॒णोत्व॒ग्निर्दि॒व्यैरज॑स्रः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ mahé ǀ vidathyā́ya ǀ śūṣám ǀ śáśvat ǀ kṛ́tvaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyāya ǀ prá ǀ jabhruḥ ǀśṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ dámyebhiḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǀ śṛṇótu ǀ agníḥ ǀ divyáiḥ ǀ ájasraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They recite repeatedly this gratifying praise to the great product of sacrifice (Agni); may he who is (endowed) with domestic radiance hear us; may the imperishable Agni, (endowed) with divine radiance, hear us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑ म॒हे दि॒वे अ॑र्चा पृथि॒व्यै कामो॑ म इ॒च्छञ्च॑रति प्रजा॒नन् । ययो॑र्ह॒ स्तोमे॑ वि॒दथे॑षु दे॒वाः स॑प॒र्यवो॑ मा॒दय॑न्ते॒ सचा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ mahé ǀ divé ǀ arca ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ me ǀ icchán ǀ carati ǀ pra-jānán ǀyáyoḥ ǀ ha ǀ stóme ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ saparyávaḥ ǀ mādáyante ǀ sácā ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Knowing their greatness, offer worship to the vast heaven and to the earth; my desire, wishing (for felicity) proceed (to them), in whose praise the gods,desirous of adoration, delight together with their worshippers at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोॠ॒तं रो॑दसी स॒त्यम॑स्तु म॒हे षु ण॑: सुवि॒ताय॒ प्र भू॑तम् । इ॒दं दि॒वे नमो॑ अग्ने पृथि॒व्यै स॑प॒र्यामि॒ प्रय॑सा॒ यामि॒ रत्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ rodasī íti ǀ satyám ǀ astu ǀ mahé ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ prá ǀ bhūtam ǀidám ǀ divé ǀ námaḥ ǀ agne ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ saparyā́mi ǀ práyasā ǀ yā́mi ǀ rátnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth, may your truth be ever inviolable; be propitious to us for the due completion of the rite; this adoration (Agni) is offered to heaven and earth; I worship (them) with (sacrificial) food; I solicit of them precious (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो हि वां॑ पू॒र्व्या आ॑विवि॒द्र ऋता॑वरी रोदसी सत्य॒वाच॑: । नर॑श्चिद्वां समि॒थे शूर॑सातौ ववन्दि॒रे पृ॑थिवि॒ वेवि॑दानाः
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ pūrvyā́ḥ ǀ ā-vividré ǀ ṛ́tavarī ítyṛta-varī ǀ rodasī íti ǀ satya-vā́caḥ ǀnáraḥ ǀ cit ǀ vām ǀ sam-ithé ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ vavandiré ǀ pṛthivi ǀ vévidānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth, endowed with truth, they who are the ancient declarers of the truth, have obtained from you (what they desired); and so, earth, men cognizant (of the greaness of you both) have worshipped you for the sake of triumphing over (hostile) heroes in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒द्धा वे॑द॒ क इ॒ह प्र वो॑चद्दे॒वाँ अच्छा॑ प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ का समे॑ति । ददृ॑श्र एषामव॒मा सदां॑सि॒ परे॑षु॒ या गुह्ये॑षु व्र॒तेषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ addhā́ ǀ veda ǀ káḥ ǀ ihá ǀ prá ǀ vocat ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ pathyā́ ǀ kā́ ǀ sám ǀ eti ǀdádṛśre ǀ eṣām ǀ avamā́ ǀ sádāṃsi ǀ páreṣu ǀ yā́ ǀ gúhyeṣu ǀ vratéṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who knows what is the truth, or who may here declare it? What is the proper path that leads to the gods? Their inferior abiding plural ces are beheld, as are those which (are situated) in superior mysterious rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विर्नृ॒चक्षा॑ अ॒भि षी॑मचष्ट ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॒ विघृ॑ते॒ मद॑न्ती । नाना॑ चक्राते॒ सद॑नं॒ यथा॒ वेः स॑मा॒नेन॒ क्रतु॑ना संविदा॒ने
shlokas.transliteration: kavíḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sīm ǀ acaṣṭa ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ víghṛte íti ví-ghṛte ǀ mádantī íti ǀnā́nā ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ sádanam ǀ yáthā ǀ véḥ ǀ samānéna ǀ krátunā ǀ saṃvidāné íti sam-vidāné ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The far-seeing beholder of mankind (the sun), surveys this heaven and earth, rejoicing when deficient in moisture in the womb of the waters (the firmament), both concurring in community (of function), although they occupy various dwellings, like the diversified nests of a bird.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒न्या वियु॑ते दू॒रेअ॑न्ते ध्रु॒वे प॒दे त॑स्थतुर्जाग॒रूके॑ । उ॒त स्वसा॑रा युव॒ती भव॑न्ती॒ आदु॑ ब्रुवाते मिथु॒नानि॒ नाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: samānyā́ ǀ víyute íti ví-yute ǀ dūréante íti dūré-ante ǀ dhruvé ǀ padé ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ jāgarū́ke íti ǀutá ǀ svásārā ǀ yuvatī́ íti ǀ bhávantī íti ǀ ā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bruvāte íti ǀ mithunā́ni ǀ nā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Common (in function), disjoined, of distant termination, they remain vigilant in a permanent station; being, as it were, sisters, and ever young; they therefore address each other by twin appellations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वेदे॒ते जनि॑मा॒ सं वि॑विक्तो म॒हो दे॒वान्बिभ्र॑ती॒ न व्य॑थेते । एज॑द्ध्रु॒वं प॑त्यते॒ विश्व॒मेकं॒ चर॑त्पत॒त्रि विषु॑णं॒ वि जा॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ít ǀ eté íti ǀ jánima ǀ sám ǀ viviktaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ bíbhratī íti ǀ ná ǀ vyathete íti ǀéjat ǀ dhruvám ǀ patyate ǀ víśvam ǀ ékam ǀ cárat ǀ patatrí ǀ víṣuṇam ǀ ví ǀ jātám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These two keep all born things discrete, and, although comprehending the great divinities, are not distressed; all moving and stationary beings rest upon one (basis), whether animals, or birds, or creatures of various kinds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॑ पुरा॒णमध्ये॑म्या॒रान्म॒हः पि॒तुर्ज॑नि॒तुर्जा॒मि तन्न॑: । दे॒वासो॒ यत्र॑ पनि॒तार॒ एवै॑रु॒रौ प॒थि व्यु॑ते त॒स्थुर॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: sánā ǀ purāṇám ǀ ádhi ǀ emi ǀ ārā́t ǀ maháḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ janitúḥ ǀ jāmí ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ yátra ǀ panitā́raḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ uráu ǀ pathí ǀ ví-ute ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I consider at present the eternal and ancient sisterhood to us of you, our great protectress and progenitrix, within whose vast and separated path your eulogists, the gods, travel in their chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं स्तोमं॑ रोदसी॒ प्र ब्र॑वीम्यृदू॒दरा॑: शृणवन्नग्निजि॒ह्वाः । मि॒त्रः स॒म्राजो॒ वरु॑णो॒ युवा॑न आदि॒त्यास॑: क॒वय॑: पप्रथा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ stómam ǀ rodasī íti ǀ prá ǀ bravīmi ǀ ṛdūdárāḥ ǀ śṛṇavan ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ paprathānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I repeat this hymn, heaven and earth, to you; and may the soft-bellied, fire-tonguedMitra, royalVaruṇa, the youthfulĀdityas, all cognizant of the past, and proclaiming (their own acts), hear it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यपाणिः सवि॒ता सु॑जि॒ह्वस्त्रिरा दि॒वो वि॒दथे॒ पत्य॑मानः । दे॒वेषु॑ च सवित॒: श्लोक॒मश्रे॒राद॒स्मभ्य॒मा सु॑व स॒र्वता॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-pāṇiḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-jihváḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǀdevéṣu ǀ ca ǀ savitaríti ǀ ślókam ǀ áśreḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ asmábhyam ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ sarvá-tātim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The golden-handed, soft-tonguedSavitāis descending from heaven (to be present) thrice (daily) at the sacrifice; accept, Savitā, the praise (recited) by the worshippers, and thereupon grant to us all our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒कृत्सु॑पा॒णिः स्ववाँ॑ ऋ॒तावा॑ दे॒वस्त्वष्टाव॑से॒ तानि॑ नो धात् । पू॒ष॒ण्वन्त॑ ऋभवो मादयध्वमू॒र्ध्वग्रा॑वाणो अध्व॒रम॑तष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: su-kṛ́t ǀ su-pāṇíḥ ǀ svá-vān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ deváḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ávase ǀ tā́ni ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāt ǀpūṣaṇ-vántaḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mādayadhvam ǀ ūrdhvá-grāvāṇaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ ataṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineTvaṣṭā, the able artificer, the dextrous-handed, the possessor of wealth, the observer of truth, bestow upon us those things (which are necessary) for our preservation;ṛbhus, associated withPūṣan, make us joyful, as they (the priests), with uplifted stones, prepare the sacred libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्युद्र॑था म॒रुत॑ ऋष्टि॒मन्तो॑ दि॒वो मर्या॑ ऋ॒तजा॑ता अ॒यास॑: । सर॑स्वती शृणवन्य॒ज्ञिया॑सो॒ धाता॑ र॒यिं स॒हवी॑रं तुरासः
shlokas.transliteration: vidyút-rathāḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ṛṣṭi-mántaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ máryāḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀsárasvatī ǀ śṛṇavan ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ dhā́ta ǀ rayím ǀ sahá-vīram ǀ turāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, whose cars are the lightning, who are armed with spears, resplendent, destroyers of foes, from whom the waters proceed, (who are) unresting and adorable, and maySarasvatīhear (my prayer); and may you (maruts), speedy in your liberality, bestow (upon us) riches and good offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विष्णुं॒ स्तोमा॑सः पुरुद॒स्मम॒र्का भग॑स्येव का॒रिणो॒ याम॑नि ग्मन् । उ॒रु॒क्र॒मः क॑कु॒हो यस्य॑ पू॒र्वीर्न म॑र्धन्ति युव॒तयो॒ जनि॑त्रीः
shlokas.transliteration: víṣṇum ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ puru-dasmám ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ bhágasya-iva ǀ kāríṇaḥ ǀ yā́mani ǀ gman ǀuru-kramáḥ ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ mardhanti ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ jánitrīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (our) praises and prayers, the causes of good fortune, attain at this sacrificeViṣṇu, the object of many rites; he, the wide-stepping; whose commands the many-blending regions of space, the genitive rators (of all beings), do not disobey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ विश्वै॑र्वी॒र्यै॒३॒॑: पत्य॑मान उ॒भे आ प॑प्रौ॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा । पु॒रं॒द॒रो वृ॑त्र॒हा धृ॒ष्णुषे॑णः सं॒गृभ्या॑ न॒ आ भ॑रा॒ भूरि॑ प॒श्वः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ víśvaiḥ ǀ vīryáiḥ ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀpuram-daráḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ dhṛṣṇú-seṇaḥ ǀ sam-gṛ́bhya ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ bhū́ri ǀ paśváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, invested with all energies, has filled both heaven and earth with his greatness; do you, who are the destroyer of cities, the slayer ofVṛtra, the leader of a conquering host, collect cattle and bestow them abundantly upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नास॑त्या मे पि॒तरा॑ बन्धु॒पृच्छा॑ सजा॒त्य॑म॒श्विनो॒श्चारु॒ नाम॑ । यु॒वं हि स्थो र॑यि॒दौ नो॑ रयी॒णां दा॒त्रं र॑क्षेथे॒ अक॑वै॒रद॑ब्धा
shlokas.transliteration: nā́satyā ǀ me ǀ pitárā ǀ bandhu-pṛ́cchā ǀ sa-jātyám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀyuvám ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ rayi-dáu ǀ naḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ dātrám ǀ rakṣethe íti ǀ ákavaiḥ ǀ ádabdhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, my protectors, inquirers (after the wishes) of your kinsman, beautiful is your cognate appellation ofAśvins; be to us the liberal donors of riches; do you, who are irresistible, protect the offerer (of the oblation) with unblameable (defences).]”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हत्तद्व॑: कवय॒श्चारु॒ नाम॒ यद्ध॑ देवा॒ भव॑थ॒ विश्व॒ इन्द्रे॑ । सख॑ ऋ॒भुभि॑: पुरुहूत प्रि॒येभि॑रि॒मां धियं॑ सा॒तये॑ तक्षता नः
shlokas.transliteration: mahát ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhávatha ǀ víśve ǀ índre ǀsákhā ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ priyébhiḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ sātáye ǀ takṣata ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sages acquainted with the past, excellent is that beautiful appellation under which you have both become gods in (the sphere of)Indra; do you, Indra, the invoked of many, a friend, (associated) with the belovedṛbhus, shape this prayer for our benefit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्य॒मा णो॒ अदि॑तिर्य॒ज्ञिया॒सोऽद॑ब्धानि॒ वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑ । यु॒योत॑ नो अनप॒त्यानि॒ गन्तो॑: प्र॒जावा॑न्नः पशु॒माँ अ॑स्तु गा॒तुः
shlokas.transliteration: aryamā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ ádabdhāni ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀyuyóta ǀ naḥ ǀ anapatyā́ni ǀ gántoḥ ǀ prajā́-vān ǀ naḥ ǀ paśu-mā́n ǀ astu ǀ gātúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAryaman,Aditi, the adorable (gods), and the unimpeded functions ofVaruṇa(protect) us; keep us from (following) the course unpropitious to offspring, and may our dwelling be abundant in progeny and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वानां॑ दू॒तः पु॑रु॒ध प्रसू॒तोऽना॑गान्नो वोचतु स॒र्वता॑ता । शृ॒णोतु॑ नः पृथि॒वी द्यौरु॒ताप॒: सूर्यो॒ नक्ष॑त्रैरु॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: devā́nām ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ purudhá ǀ prá-sūtaḥ ǀ ánāgān ǀ naḥ ǀ vocatu ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀśṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ utá ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ nákṣatraiḥ ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the messenger of the gods, engendered in many plural ces, everywhere proclaim us void of offence; may earth and heaven, the waters, the sun, and the vast firmament, with the constellation, hear us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ नो॒ वृष॑ण॒: पर्व॑तासो ध्रु॒वक्षे॑मास॒ इळ॑या॒ मद॑न्तः । आ॒दि॒त्यैर्नो॒ अदि॑तिः शृणोतु॒ यच्छ॑न्तु नो म॒रुत॒: शर्म॑ भ॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇvántu ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ dhruvá-kṣemāsaḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ mádantaḥ ǀādityáiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ yácchantu ǀ naḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ bhadrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the (divine) showerers (of benefits), the deities of the mountains, and those abiding in fixed habitations, propitiated by the sacrificial food, hear us; mayAditi, with theĀdityas, heqar us; may theMarutsgrant us auspicious felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सदा॑ सु॒गः पि॑तु॒माँ अ॑स्तु॒ पन्था॒ मध्वा॑ देवा॒ ओष॑धी॒: सं पि॑पृक्त । भगो॑ मे अग्ने स॒ख्ये न मृ॑ध्या॒ उद्रा॒यो अ॑श्यां॒ सद॑नं पुरु॒क्षोः
shlokas.transliteration: sádā ǀ su-gáḥ ǀ pitu-mā́n ǀ astu ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ mádhvā ǀ devāḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ sám ǀ pipṛkta ǀbhágaḥ ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ sakhyé ǀ ná ǀ mṛdhyāḥ ǀ út ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ aśyām ǀ sádanam ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our path ever be easy of going, and provided with food; sprinkle, gods, the plural nts with sweet water; (safe) in your friendship,Agni, may my fortune never be impaired, but may I occupy a dwelling (abounding) with riches and ample food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वद॑स्व ह॒व्या समिषो॑ दिदीह्यस्म॒द्र्य१॒॑क्सं मि॑मीहि॒ श्रवां॑सि । विश्वाँ॑ अग्ने पृ॒त्सु ताञ्जे॑षि॒ शत्रू॒नहा॒ विश्वा॑ सु॒मना॑ दीदिही नः
shlokas.transliteration: svádasva ǀ havyā́ ǀ sám ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ asmadryák ǀ sám ǀ mimīhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀvíśvān ǀ agne ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ tā́n ǀ jeṣi ǀ śátrūn ǀ áhā ǀ víśvā ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ dīdihi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Taste (Agni) the oblations, make manifest (for us) abundant food measure out the viands before us; you overcome all those (who are) our enemies in conflict;  favourably inclined towards us lighten up all our (ceremonies) day by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒षस॒: पूर्वा॒ अध॒ यद्व्यू॒षुर्म॒हद्वि ज॑ज्ञे अ॒क्षरं॑ प॒दे गोः । व्र॒ता दे॒वाना॒मुप॒ नु प्र॒भूष॑न्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: uṣásaḥ ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ yát ǀ vi-ūṣúḥ ǀ mahát ǀ ví ǀ jajñe ǀ akṣáram ǀ padé ǀ góḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ nú ǀ pra-bhū́ṣan ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the preceding dawns appear, the great imperishable (light) is engendered in the (firmament, the) sphere of the waters, and then the worshipper is alert to perform the rites (due to) the gods, for great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षू णो॒ अत्र॑ जुहुरन्त दे॒वा मा पूर्वे॑ अग्ने पि॒तर॑: पद॒ज्ञाः । पु॒रा॒ण्योः सद्म॑नोः के॒तुर॒न्तर्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ juhuranta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ pū́rve ǀ agne ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ pada-jñā́ḥ ǀpurāṇyóḥ ǀ sádmanoḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the gods,Agni, now do us harm, nor the ancient progenitors, who have come to know the degree (of divinity); nor the manifester of light between the two ancient dwellings (earth and heaven, the sun); for great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि मे॑ पुरु॒त्रा प॑तयन्ति॒ कामा॒: शम्यच्छा॑ दीद्ये पू॒र्व्याणि॑ । समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्नावृ॒तमिद्व॑देम म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ me ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ patayanti ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ śámi ǀ áccha ǀ dīdye ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǀsám-iddhe ǀ agnáu ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ vadema ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Variously do my manifold desires alight; present at the solemnity,  I recite ancient (hymns); when the fire is kindled we speak indeed the truth, for great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नो राजा॒ विभृ॑तः पुरु॒त्रा शये॑ श॒यासु॒ प्रयु॑तो॒ वनानु॑ । अ॒न्या व॒त्सं भर॑ति॒ क्षेति॑ मा॒ता म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: samānáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ ví-bhṛtaḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ śáye ǀ śayā́su ǀ prá-yutaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ ánu ǀanyā́ ǀ vatsám ǀ bhárati ǀ kṣéti ǀ mātā́ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The universal sovereign is conveyed to many directions; he sleeps in the plural ces of repose; he is connected with the forests; one mother (heaven) nourishes the child; the other (earth) gives him a dwelling; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒क्षित्पूर्वा॒स्वप॑रा अनू॒रुत्स॒द्यो जा॒तासु॒ तरु॑णीष्व॒न्तः । अ॒न्तर्व॑तीः सुवते॒ अप्र॑वीता म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā-kṣít ǀ pū́rvāsu ǀ áparāḥ ǀ anūrút ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jātā́su ǀ táruṇīṣu ǀ antáríti ǀantáḥ-vatīḥ ǀ suvate ǀ ápra-vītāḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Existing in ancient plural nts, abiding afterwards in new, he enters into the young (herbs) as soon as they are produced; unimpregnated they become pregnant and bear fruit; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒युः प॒रस्ता॒दध॒ नु द्वि॑मा॒ताब॑न्ध॒नश्च॑रति व॒त्स एक॑: । मि॒त्रस्य॒ ता वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑ म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śayúḥ ǀ parástāt ǀ ádha ǀ nú ǀ dvi-mātā́ ǀ abandhanáḥ ǀ carati ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀmitrásya ǀ tā́ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The child of two mothers sleeps in the west, but (in the morning) the single infant proceeds unobstructed (through the sky); these are the functions ofMitraandVaruṇa; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वि॒मा॒ता होता॑ वि॒दथे॑षु स॒म्राळन्वग्रं॒ चर॑ति॒ क्षेति॑ बु॒ध्नः । प्र रण्या॑नि रण्य॒वाचो॑ भरन्ते म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dvi-mātā́ ǀ hótā ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ ánu ǀ ágram ǀ cárati ǀ kṣéti ǀ budhnáḥ ǀprá ǀ ráṇyāni ǀ raṇya-vā́caḥ ǀ bharante ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The child of two mothers, the invoker of the gods at sacrifices, the universal sovereign, proceeds thenceforward (in the sky); the root (of all), he abides (in the houses of the pious); the reciters of plural asant (words) offer him agreeable (praises); great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शूर॑स्येव॒ युध्य॑तो अन्त॒मस्य॑ प्रती॒चीनं॑ ददृशे॒ विश्व॑मा॒यत् । अ॒न्तर्म॒तिश्च॑रति नि॒ष्षिधं॒ गोर्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śū́rasya-iva ǀ yúdhyataḥ ǀ antamásya ǀ pratīcī́nam ǀ dadṛśe ǀ víśvam ǀ ā-yát ǀantáḥ ǀ matíḥ ǀ carati ǀ niḥ-sídham ǀ góḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All (creatures) approaching too near his confines are beheld with their faces turned away as (an enemy) flies from a combatant; obvious (to all), he penetrates the water for its destruction; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि वे॑वेति पलि॒तो दू॒त आ॑स्व॒न्तर्म॒हाँश्च॑रति रोच॒नेन॑ । वपूं॑षि॒ बिभ्र॑द॒भि नो॒ वि च॑ष्टे म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ veveti ǀ palitáḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ āsu ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ carati ǀ rocanéna ǀvápūṃṣi ǀ bíbhrat ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In those (plural nts) the aged messenger (of the gods) constantly abides; mighty, he presses with the radiant (sun) through the region of space; assuming various forms, he looks (complacently) upon us; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विष्णु॑र्गो॒पाः प॑र॒मं पा॑ति॒ पाथ॑: प्रि॒या धामा॑न्य॒मृता॒ दधा॑नः । अ॒ग्निष्टा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि वेद म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: víṣṇuḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ paramám ǀ pāti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ priyā́ ǀ dhā́māni ǀ amṛ́tā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ veda ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pervading and protecting (all), possessing grateful and immortal radiance, he preserves the supreme path (or the rains), forAgniknows all these worlds; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाना॑ चक्राते य॒म्या॒३॒॑ वपूं॑षि॒ तयो॑र॒न्यद्रोच॑ते कृ॒ष्णम॒न्यत् । श्यावी॑ च॒ यदरु॑षी च॒ स्वसा॑रौ म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nā́nā ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ yamyā́ ǀ vápūṃṣi ǀ táyoḥ ǀ anyát ǀ rócate ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ anyát ǀśyā́vī ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ áruṣī ǀ ca ǀ svásārau ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The twin pair (day and night) adopt various forms; one of them shines brightly, the other is black; twin sisters are they, one black and the other white; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒ता च॒ यत्र॑ दुहि॒ता च॑ धे॒नू स॑ब॒र्दुघे॑ धा॒पये॑ते समी॒ची । ऋ॒तस्य॒ ते सद॑सीळे अ॒न्तर्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mātā́ ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ duhitā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhenū́ íti ǀ sabardúghe íti sabaḥ-dúghe ǀ dhāpáyete íti ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀṛtásya ǀ té íti ǀ sádasi ǀ īḷe ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where the mother and daughter, two productive kine, unite, they nourish each other; I worship them both in (the firmament), the dwelling of the waters great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्यस्या॑ व॒त्सं रि॑ह॒ती मि॑माय॒ कया॑ भु॒वा नि द॑धे धे॒नुरूध॑: । ऋ॒तस्य॒ सा पय॑सापिन्व॒तेळा॑ म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: anyásyāḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ rihatī́ ǀ mimāya ǀ káyā ǀ bhuvā́ ǀ ní ǀ dadhe ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ sā́ ǀ páyasā ǀ apinvata ǀ íḷā ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Licking the calf of the other, one of them lows aloud; the cow offers her udder for the one that is without mosture (the earth), and she (the earth) is refreshed by the milk of the rain; great and unequalles is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पद्या॑ वस्ते पुरु॒रूपा॒ वपूं॑ष्यू॒र्ध्वा त॑स्थौ॒ त्र्यविं॒ रेरि॑हाणा । ऋ॒तस्य॒ सद्म॒ वि च॑रामि वि॒द्वान्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pádyā ǀ vaste ǀ puru-rū́pā ǀ vápūṃṣi ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ tasthau ǀ tri-ávim ǀ rérihāṇā ǀṛtásya ǀ sádma ǀ ví ǀ carāmi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The earth wears bodies of many forms; she abides on high cherishing her year and a half old (calf); knowing the abode of the truth (the sun), I offer worship; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒दे इ॑व॒ निहि॑ते द॒स्मे अ॒न्तस्तयो॑र॒न्यद्गुह्य॑मा॒विर॒न्यत् । स॒ध्री॒ची॒ना प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ सा विषू॑ची म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: padé ivéti padé-iva ǀ níhite íti ní-hite ǀ dasmé ǀ antáríti ǀ táyoḥ ǀ anyát ǀ gúhyam ǀ āvíḥ ǀ anyát ǀsadhrīcīnā́ ǀ pathyā́ ǀ sā́ ǀ víṣūcī ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like two (distinguishing) impressions, they (day and night) are plural ced visible in the midst (between heaven and earth), one hidden, one manifest; the path (of both) is common, and that is universal (for good and evil) great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ धे॒नवो॑ धुनयन्ता॒मशि॑श्वीः सब॒र्दुघा॑: शश॒या अप्र॑दुग्धाः । नव्या॑नव्या युव॒तयो॒ भव॑न्तीर्म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ dhunayantām ǀ áśiśvīḥ ǀ sabaḥ-dúghāḥ ǀ śaśayā́ḥ ǀ ápra-dugdhāḥ ǀnávyāḥ-navyāḥ ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ bhávantīḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the kine without their young, abiding (in the heaven), and though unmilked, yet yielding milk and ever fresh and youthfu,l be shaken (so as to perform their functions); great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒न्यासु॑ वृष॒भो रोर॑वीति॒ सो अ॒न्यस्मि॑न्यू॒थे नि द॑धाति॒ रेत॑: । स हि क्षपा॑वा॒न्त्स भग॒: स राजा॑ म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ anyā́su ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ róravīti ǀ sáḥ ǀ anyásmin ǀ yūthé ǀ ní ǀ dadhāti ǀ rétaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣápā-vān ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the showerer roars in other (regions) he sends down the rain upon a different herd, for he is the victor, the auspicious, the sovereign; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒रस्य॒ नु स्वश्व्यं॑ जनास॒: प्र नु वो॑चाम वि॒दुर॑स्य दे॒वाः । षो॒ळ्हा यु॒क्ताः पञ्च॑प॒ञ्चा व॑हन्ति म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vīrásya ǀ nú ǀ su-áśvyam ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ vocāma ǀ vidúḥ ǀ asya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀṣoḷhā́ ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ páñca-pañca ǀ ā́ ǀ vahanti ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We proclaim, people, the wealth of the hero, (Indra), in horses; the gods know his (affluence); six, or five and five, harnessed to his car, convey him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वस्त्वष्टा॑ सवि॒ता वि॒श्वरू॑पः पु॒पोष॑ प्र॒जाः पु॑रु॒धा ज॑जान । इ॒मा च॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नान्यस्य म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ savitā́ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ pupóṣa ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ purudhā́ ǀ jajāna ǀimā́ ǀ ca ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ asya ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineTvaṣṭāthe impeller (of all), the multiform, has begotten and nourished a numerous progeny, for all these worlds are of him; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही समै॑रच्च॒म्वा॑ समी॒ची उ॒भे ते अ॑स्य॒ वसु॑ना॒ न्यृ॑ष्टे । शृ॒ण्वे वी॒रो वि॒न्दमा॑नो॒ वसू॑नि म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ airat ǀ camvā́ ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ té íti ǀ asya ǀ vásunā ǀ nyṛ́ṣṭe íti ní-ṛṣṭe ǀśṛṇvé ǀ vīráḥ ǀ vindámānaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has filled the two vast receptacles (heaven and earth) united (with creatures); they are both penetrated by his lustre; the hero spoiling the treasures (of the foe) is renowned; great and unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां च॑ नः पृथि॒वीं वि॒श्वधा॑या॒ उप॑ क्षेति हि॒तमि॑त्रो॒ न राजा॑ । पु॒र॒:सद॑: शर्म॒सदो॒ न वी॒रा म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ viśvá-dhāyāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ kṣeti ǀ hitá-mitraḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀpuraḥ-sádaḥ ǀ śarma-sádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our king, the nourisher of all, abides (in the firmament) nearest to this earthlike a benevolent friend; the valiant (Maruts) precede him (when abroad), and dwell in his mansion; great and unequalles is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒ष्षिध्व॑रीस्त॒ ओष॑धीरु॒तापो॑ र॒यिं त॑ इन्द्र पृथि॒वी बि॑भर्ति । सखा॑यस्ते वाम॒भाज॑: स्याम म॒हद्दे॒वाना॑मसुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: niḥ-sídhvarīḥ ǀ te ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ rayím ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ bibharti ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ te ǀ vāma-bhā́jaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ mahát ǀ devā́nām ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural nts,Indra, come to perfection by you; from you the waters (flow); earth bears her treasures for you; may we, your friends, be sharers of these blessings; great unequalled is the might of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ता मि॑नन्ति मा॒यिनो॒ न धीरा॑ व्र॒ता दे॒वानां॑ प्रथ॒मा ध्रु॒वाणि॑ । न रोद॑सी अ॒द्रुहा॑ वे॒द्याभि॒र्न पर्व॑ता नि॒नमे॑ तस्थि॒वांस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ ǀ minanti ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ vratā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ prathamā́ ǀ dhruvā́ṇi ǀná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ adrúhā ǀ vedyā́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ ni-náme ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neither the deceptive nor the resolute interrupt the primitive and permanent operations of the gods, nor do the innocuous heaven and earth (interrupt them), nor are the mountains standing (on the earth) to be bowed down.”

shlokas.sanskrit: षड्भा॒राँ एको॒ अच॑रन्बिभर्त्यृ॒तं वर्षि॑ष्ठ॒मुप॒ गाव॒ आगु॑: । ति॒स्रो म॒हीरुप॑रास्तस्थु॒रत्या॒ गुहा॒ द्वे निहि॑ते॒ दर्श्येका॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṣáṭ ǀ bhārā́n ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ácaran ǀ bibharti ǀ ṛtám ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ úpa ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀtisráḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ úparāḥ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ átyāḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ dvé íti ǀ níhite íti ní-hite ǀ dárśi ǀ ékā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One stationary (year) sustains six burdens (in the season); the (solar) rays spread through that true and extensive (term); three revolving spheres are severally above, two of which are plural ced in secret, and one is visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒पा॒ज॒स्यो वृ॑ष॒भो वि॒श्वरू॑प उ॒त त्र्यु॒धा पु॑रु॒ध प्र॒जावा॑न् । त्र्य॒नी॒कः प॑त्यते॒ माहि॑नावा॒न्त्स रे॑तो॒धा वृ॑ष॒भः शश्व॑तीनाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-pājasyáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ utá ǀ tri-udhā́ ǀ purudhá ǀ prajā́-vān ǀtri-anīkáḥ ǀ patyate ǀ mā́hina-vān ǀ sáḥ ǀ retaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tree-breasted, the showerer (of rain), the omniform, the three-uddered, the parent of multiform progeny, the possessor of magnitude, followed by three hosts (the year), advances, the vigorous impregnator of the perpetual plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भीक॑ आसां पद॒वीर॑बोध्यादि॒त्याना॑मह्वे॒ चारु॒ नाम॑ । आप॑श्चिदस्मा अरमन्त दे॒वीः पृथ॒ग्व्रज॑न्ती॒: परि॑ षीमवृञ्जन्
shlokas.transliteration: abhī́ke ǀ āsām ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ abodhi ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ ahve ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ aramanta ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ pṛ́thak ǀ vrájantīḥ ǀ pári ǀ sīm ǀ avṛñjan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The year) is awake, the path in the vicinity of those (plural nts); I call upon the beautiful name of theĀdityas; the divine waters wandering severally (now) give it delight, and (now) depart from it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्री ष॒धस्था॑ सिन्धव॒स्त्रिः क॑वी॒नामु॒त त्रि॑मा॒ता वि॒दथे॑षु स॒म्राट् । ऋ॒ताव॑री॒र्योष॑णास्ति॒स्रो अप्या॒स्त्रिरा दि॒वो वि॒दथे॒ पत्य॑मानाः
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ sindhavaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ utá ǀ tri-mātā́ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀṛtá-varīḥ ǀ yóṣaṇāḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rivers, the dwelling-plural ces of the intelligent gods are thrice three; the measurer of the three (worlds) is the sovereign at sacrifices; three feminine le (divinities) of the waters charged with the rains descend from heaven at the thrice (repeated) solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिरा दि॒वः स॑वित॒र्वार्या॑णि दि॒वेदि॑व॒ आ सु॑व॒ त्रिर्नो॒ अह्न॑: । त्रि॒धातु॑ रा॒य आ सु॑वा॒ वसू॑नि॒ भग॑ त्रातर्धिषणे सा॒तये॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitaḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ divé-dive ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ tríḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ vásūni ǀ bhága ǀ trātaḥ ǀ dhiṣaṇe ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savitā, descended from heaven, bestow upon us blessings thrice everyday;Bhaga, saviour, grant us thrice a day riches of three elements;Dhiṣaṇaenable us to acquire (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिरा दि॒वः स॑वि॒ता सो॑षवीति॒ राजा॑ना मि॒त्रावरु॑णा सुपा॒णी । आप॑श्चिदस्य॒ रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी रत्नं॑ भिक्षन्त सवि॒तुः स॒वाय॑
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ sosavīti ǀ rā́jānā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ supāṇī́ íti su-pāṇī́ ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ rátnam ǀ bhikṣanta ǀ savitúḥ ǀ savā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySavitābestow upon us wealth at the (three periods) of the day, for the well-handedMitraandVaruṇa, the waters, the vast heaven and earth, solicit precious things from the liberality of Savitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिरु॑त्त॒मा दू॒णशा॑ रोच॒नानि॒ त्रयो॑ राज॒न्त्यसु॑रस्य वी॒राः । ऋ॒तावा॑न इषि॒रा दू॒ळभा॑स॒स्त्रिरा दि॒वो वि॒दथे॑ सन्तु दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ ut-tamā́ ǀ duḥ-náśā ǀ rocanā́ni ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ rājanti ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ iṣirā́ḥ ǀ duḥ-dábhāsaḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ santu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three are the excellent  uninjurable bright regions, three scions of the powerful (year) are shining; practisers of truth, quick moving, of surpassing radiance; may the deities be present thrice daily at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मे॑ विवि॒क्वाँ अ॑विदन्मनी॒षां धे॒नुं चर॑न्तीं॒ प्रयु॑ता॒मगो॑पाम् । स॒द्यश्चि॒द्या दु॑दु॒हे भूरि॑ धा॒सेरिन्द्र॒स्तद॒ग्निः प॑नि॒तारो॑ अस्याः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ me ǀ vivikvā́n ǀ avidat ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ dhenúm ǀ cárantīm ǀ prá-yutām ǀ ágopām ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yā́ ǀ duduhé ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dhāséḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ tát ǀ agníḥ ǀ panitā́raḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the discriminatingIndraapprehend my glorification (of the gods), which is (free) as a cow, grazing alone, without a cowherd, one who is readily milked, yielding abundant nourishment, and of whomAgniand Indra (and we), are the commenders.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒: सु पू॒षा वृष॑णा सु॒हस्ता॑ दि॒वो न प्री॒ताः श॑श॒यं दु॑दुह्रे । विश्वे॒ यद॑स्यां र॒णय॑न्त दे॒वाः प्र वोऽत्र॑ वसवः सु॒म्नम॑श्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sú ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ su-hástā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ prītā́ḥ ǀ śaśayám ǀ duduhre ǀvíśve ǀ yát ǀ asyām ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ átra ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ aśyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandPūṣan, the showerers (of benefits) and happy-handedAśvins, well affected towards us, have milked the (cloud) reposing in heaven, wherefore,Vasus, universal deities, sporting on this (altar), may I here obtain the happiness derived from you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या जा॒मयो॒ वृष्ण॑ इ॒च्छन्ति॑ श॒क्तिं न॑म॒स्यन्ती॑र्जानते॒ गर्भ॑मस्मिन् । अच्छा॑ पु॒त्रं धे॒नवो॑ वावशा॒ना म॒हश्च॑रन्ति॒ बिभ्र॑तं॒ वपूं॑षि
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ icchánti ǀ śaktím ǀ namasyántīḥ ǀ jānate ǀ gárbham ǀ asmin ǀáccha ǀ putrám ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ caranti ǀ bíbhratam ǀ vápūṃṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural nts that desire for the showerer (Indra) the power (of sending rain) appreciate, when manifest, the embryo (blossom) deposited in him; the kine desirous of reward come to the presence of the calf, invested with many forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ विवक्मि॒ रोद॑सी सु॒मेके॒ ग्राव्णो॑ युजा॒नो अ॑ध्व॒रे म॑नी॒षा । इ॒मा उ॑ ते॒ मन॑वे॒ भूरि॑वारा ऊ॒र्ध्वा भ॑वन्ति दर्श॒ता यज॑त्राः
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ vivakmi ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ grā́vṇaḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ manīṣā́ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ mánave ǀ bhū́ri-vārāḥ ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ darśatā́ḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth, taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sacrifice, as these your graceful, adorable, and many-blessing rays (Agni) mount up for the good of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॑ जि॒ह्वा मधु॑मती सुमे॒धा अग्ने॑ दे॒वेषू॒च्यत॑ उरू॒ची । तये॒ह विश्वाँ॒ अव॑से॒ यज॑त्रा॒ना सा॑दय पा॒यया॑ चा॒ मधू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ jihvā́ ǀ mádhu-matī ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ ágne ǀ devéṣu ǀ ucyáte ǀ urūcī́ ǀtáyā ǀ ihá ǀ víśvān ǀ ávase ǀ yájatrān ǀ ā́ ǀ sādaya ǀ pāyáya ǀ ca ǀ mádhūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With your wide-spreading tongue,Agni, sweet and intelligent, which is renowned amongst the gods, bring hither all the adorable deities for our protection, and give them to drink of the sweet (libations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॑ अग्ने॒ पर्व॑तस्येव॒ धारास॑श्चन्ती पी॒पय॑द्देव चि॒त्रा । ताम॒स्मभ्यं॒ प्रम॑तिं जातवेदो॒ वसो॒ रास्व॑ सुम॒तिं वि॒श्वज॑न्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ párvatasya-iva ǀ dhā́rā ǀ ásaścantī ǀ pīpáyat ǀ deva ǀ citrā́ ǀtā́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ prá-matim ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ rā́sva ǀ su-matím ǀ viśvá-janyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, giver of dwellings, knower of all that exists, extend to us that benevolence which, unshared by others, cherishes us like the showers of the rain-cloud; that kindness which is beneficent for all mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धे॒नुः प्र॒त्नस्य॒ काम्यं॒ दुहा॑ना॒न्तः पु॒त्रश्च॑रति॒ दक्षि॑णायाः । आ द्यो॑त॒निं व॑हति शु॒भ्रया॑मो॒षस॒: स्तोमो॑ अ॒श्विना॑वजीगः
shlokas.transliteration: dhenúḥ ǀ pratnásya ǀ kā́myam ǀ dúhānā ǀ antáríti ǀ putráḥ ǀ carati ǀ dákṣiṇāyāḥ ǀā́ ǀ dyotaním ǀ vahati ǀ śubhrá-yāmā ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ aśvínau ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cow (the dawn) yields the desired milk to the ancient (Agni); the son of the south passes within (the firmament); the bright-houred (day) brings the illuminative (sun); the praiser awakes (to glorify) theAśvinspreceding the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒युग्व॑हन्ति॒ प्रति॑ वामृ॒तेनो॒र्ध्वा भ॑वन्ति पि॒तरे॑व॒ मेधा॑: । जरे॑थाम॒स्मद्वि प॒णेर्म॑नी॒षां यु॒वोरव॑श्चकृ॒मा या॑तम॒र्वाक्
shlokas.transliteration: su-yúk ǀ vahanti ǀ práti ǀ vām ǀ ṛténa ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ médhāḥ ǀjárethām ǀ asmát ǀ ví ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ cakṛma ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The well-yoked (horses) bear you both in your truth (preserving car); the offerings proceed towards you as (children to their parents); discard from us the disposition of the niggard; we have made ready for you our offering; come to our presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒युग्भि॒रश्वै॑: सु॒वृता॒ रथे॑न॒ दस्रा॑वि॒मं शृ॑णुतं॒ श्लोक॒मद्रे॑: । किम॒ङ्ग वां॒ प्रत्यव॑र्तिं॒ गमि॑ष्ठा॒हुर्विप्रा॑सो अश्विना पुरा॒जाः
shlokas.transliteration: suyúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀ dásrau ǀ imám ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ ślókam ǀ ádreḥ ǀkím ǀ aṅgá ǀ vām ǀ práti ǀ ávartim ǀ gámiṣṭhā ǀ āhúḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras, with well-yoked horses and well-constructed car, hear this praise of the worshipper, for have not the ancient sages declared you,Aśvins, to be most ready to come to the aid of the destitute?”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ म॑न्येथा॒मा ग॑तं॒ कच्चि॒देवै॒र्विश्वे॒ जना॑सो अ॒श्विना॑ हवन्ते । इ॒मा हि वां॒ गोऋ॑जीका॒ मधू॑नि॒ प्र मि॒त्रासो॒ न द॒दुरु॒स्रो अग्रे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ manyethām ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ évaiḥ ǀ víśve ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ havante ǀimā́ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ gó-ṛjīkā ǀ mádhūni ǀ prá ǀ mitrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ dadúḥ ǀ usráḥ ǀ ágre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with praise the beautiful heaven and earth taking inhandthe stones (to express the libation) at the sweet (Soma) juice mixed with milk, as friends (give gifts to friends); the sun is in advance, (therefore come to this rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒रः पु॒रू चि॑दश्विना॒ रजां॑स्याङ्गू॒षो वां॑ मघवाना॒ जने॑षु । एह या॑तं प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॒र्दस्रा॑वि॒मे वां॑ नि॒धयो॒ मधू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tiráḥ ǀ purú ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ āṅgūṣáḥ ǀ vām ǀ magha-vānā ǀ jáneṣu ǀā́ ǀ ihá ǀ yātam ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǀ dásrau ǀ imé ǀ vām ǀ ni-dháyaḥ ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eclipsing (by your splendour) many regions,Aśvins, (come hither); loud priase awaits you opulent (Aśvins) among men; come to this rite by the paths traversed by the gods; here,Dasras, are ample stores of the exhilarating (Soma) juices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रा॒णमोक॑: स॒ख्यं शि॒वं वां॑ यु॒वोर्न॑रा॒ द्रवि॑णं ज॒ह्नाव्या॑म् । पुन॑: कृण्वा॒नाः स॒ख्या शि॒वानि॒ मध्वा॑ मदेम स॒ह नू स॑मा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: purāṇám ǀ ókaḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ śivám ǀ vām ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ narā ǀ dráviṇam ǀ jahnā́vyām ǀpúnaríti ǀ kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ śivā́ni ǀ mádhvā ǀ madema ǀ sahá ǀ nú ǀ samānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your ancient friendship is desirable and auspicious; your wealth, leaders (of rites), is in the family ofJahnu; renewing that auspicious friendship, may we, your associates, delight you with the sweet (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना वा॒युना॑ यु॒वं सु॑दक्षा नि॒युद्भि॑ष्च स॒जोष॑सा युवाना । नास॑त्या ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यं जुषा॒णा सोमं॑ पिबतम॒स्रिधा॑ सुदानू
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ yuvám ǀ su-dakṣā ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ yuvānā ǀnā́satyā ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ asrídhā ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, endowed with power, ever young, in whom is no untruth, unwearied, munificent, accepters (of libations), drink withVāyuand your steeds, rejoicing together, of theSomalibation offered at the close of day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ परि॑ वा॒मिष॑: पुरू॒चीरी॒युर्गी॒र्भिर्यत॑माना॒ अमृ॑ध्राः । रथो॑ ह वामृत॒जा अद्रि॑जूत॒: परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी या॑ति स॒द्यः
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ pári ǀ vām ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ purūcī́ḥ ǀ īyúḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yátamānāḥ ǀ ámṛdhrāḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ ṛta-jā́ḥ ǀ ádri-jūtaḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yāti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, abundant (sacrificial) viands are presented to you, and blameless worshippers (salute you) with praises; your water-shedding car, attracted by the sacrificers, quickly compasses earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना मधु॒षुत्त॑मो यु॒वाकु॒: सोम॒स्तं पा॑त॒मा ग॑तं दुरो॒णे । रथो॑ ह वां॒ भूरि॒ वर्प॒: करि॑क्रत्सु॒ताव॑तो निष्कृ॒तमाग॑मिष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ madhusút-tamaḥ ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tám ǀ pātam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ duroṇé ǀráthaḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ bhū́ri ǀ várpaḥ ǀ kárikrat ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, this most sweetSomais mixed; drink it; come to (our) dwelling; your car, repeatedly bestowing wealth, is coming to the appointed plural ce of the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रो जना॑न्यातयति ब्रुवा॒णो मि॒त्रो दा॑धार पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् । मि॒त्रः कृ॒ष्टीरनि॑मिषा॒भि च॑ष्टे मि॒त्राय॑ ह॒व्यं घृ॒तव॑ज्जुहोत
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ jánān ǀ yātayati ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀmitráḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ áni-miṣā ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ havyám ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mitra, when praised, animates men to exertion;Indrasustains both the earth and heaven; Mitra looks upon men with unclosing eyes; offer to Mitra the oblations of clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स मि॑त्र॒ मर्तो॑ अस्तु॒ प्रय॑स्वा॒न्यस्त॑ आदित्य॒ शिक्ष॑ति व्र॒तेन॑ । न ह॑न्यते॒ न जी॑यते॒ त्वोतो॒ नैन॒मंहो॑ अश्नो॒त्यन्ति॑तो॒ न दू॒रात्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sáḥ ǀ mitra ǀ mártaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práyasvān ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ āditya ǀ śíkṣati ǀ vraténa ǀná ǀ hanyate ǀ ná ǀ jīyate ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ ná ǀ enam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ aśnoti ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dūrā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that mortal enjoy abundance,Mitra, who presents you,Āditya, (with offerings) at the sacred rite; protected by you he is not harmed; he is not overcome by any one; son reaches him not, either from afar or nigh.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न॒मी॒वास॒ इळ॑या॒ मद॑न्तो मि॒तज्ञ॑वो॒ वरि॑म॒न्ना पृ॑थि॒व्याः । आ॒दि॒त्यस्य॑ व्र॒तमु॑पक्षि॒यन्तो॑ व॒यं मि॒त्रस्य॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: anamīvā́saḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ mitá-jñavaḥ ǀ váriman ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀādityásya ǀ vratám ǀ upa-kṣiyántaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, exempt from disease, rejoicing in (abundant) food, roaming free over the wide (expanse) of the earth, diligent in the worship ofĀditya, ever be in the good favour ofMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं मि॒त्रो न॑म॒स्य॑: सु॒शेवो॒ राजा॑ सुक्ष॒त्रो अ॑जनिष्ट वे॒धाः । तस्य॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ su-kṣatráḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀtásya ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisMitrahas been engendered adorable and to be served, the sovereign (over all), endowed with vigour, the creator (of the universe); may we ever be in the good favour, in the auspicious approbation, of this adorable (Āditya).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ आ॑दि॒त्यो नम॑सोप॒सद्यो॑ यात॒यज्ज॑नो गृण॒ते सु॒शेव॑: । तस्मा॑ ए॒तत्पन्य॑तमाय॒ जुष्ट॑म॒ग्नौ मि॒त्राय॑ ह॒विरा जु॑होत
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádyaḥ ǀ yātayát-janaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀtásmai ǀ etát ǀ pánya-tamāya ǀ júṣṭam ǀ agnáu ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ havíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The greatĀditya, the animator of men to exertion, is to be approached with reverence; he is the giver of happiness to him who praises him; offer with fire the acceptable libation to that most glorifiableMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्य॑ चर्षणी॒धृतोऽवो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ सान॒सि । द्यु॒म्नं चि॒त्रश्र॑वस्तमम्
shlokas.transliteration: mitrásya ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́taḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ sānasí ǀdyumnám ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirable food and most renowned wealth are (the gifts) of the divineMitra, the supporter of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि यो म॑हि॒ना दिवं॑ मि॒त्रो ब॒भूव॑ स॒प्रथा॑: । अ॒भि श्रवो॑भिः पृथि॒वीम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ dívam ǀ mitráḥ ǀ babhū́va ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀabhí ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The renownedMitra, who by his might presides over heaven, is he who presides over the earth by (the gift of) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्राय॒ पञ्च॑ येमिरे॒ जना॑ अ॒भिष्टि॑शवसे । स दे॒वान्विश्वा॑न्बिभर्ति
shlokas.transliteration: mitrā́ya ǀ páñca ǀ yemire ǀ jánāḥ ǀ abhíṣṭi-śavase ǀsáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ víśvān ǀ bibharti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The five classes of men have repaired to the victoriousMitra, for he supports all the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रो दे॒वेष्वा॒युषु॒ जना॑य वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषे । इष॑ इ॒ष्टव्र॑ता अकः
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ āyúṣu ǀ jánāya ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣe ǀíṣaḥ ǀ iṣṭá-vratāḥ ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mitrais he who among tods and men bestows food as the reward of pious acts upon the man who has prepared (for him) the lopped sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेह॑ वो॒ मन॑सा ब॒न्धुता॑ नर उ॒शिजो॑ जग्मुर॒भि तानि॒ वेद॑सा । याभि॑र्मा॒याभि॒: प्रति॑जूतिवर्पस॒: सौध॑न्वना य॒ज्ञियं॑ भा॒गमा॑न॒श
shlokas.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ vaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ bandhútā ǀ naraḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tā́ni ǀ védasā ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ prátijūti-varpasaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ yajñíyam ǀ bhagám ǀ ānaśá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your connection (with the consequences of acts)ṛbhusis here (acknowledged) by the minds of all; desiring their share (of the sacrifice), oḥ men, they have come with a knowledge (of their claims) to these (rites); the sons ofSudhanvan, with the devices by which they are victorious over foes, you have accepted the share of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: शची॑भिश्चम॒साँ अपिं॑शत॒ यया॑ धि॒या गामरि॑णीत॒ चर्म॑णः । येन॒ हरी॒ मन॑सा नि॒रत॑क्षत॒ तेन॑ देव॒त्वमृ॑भव॒: समा॑नश
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ camasā́n ǀ ápiṃśata ǀ yáyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ gā́m ǀ áriṇīta ǀ cármaṇaḥ ǀyéna ǀ hárī íti ǀ mánasā ǀ niḥ-átakṣata ǀ téna ǀ deva-tvám ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ānaśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those faculties by which you have divided the ladles; with that intelligence wherewith you have covered the (dead) cow with skin; with that will by which you have fabricated the two horses (ofIndra); with those (means),ṛbhus, you have attained divinity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यमृ॒भव॒: समा॑नशु॒र्मनो॒र्नपा॑तो अ॒पसो॑ दधन्विरे । सौ॒ध॒न्व॒नासो॑ अमृत॒त्वमेरि॑रे वि॒ष्ट्वी शमी॑भिः सु॒कृत॑: सुकृ॒त्यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀ mánoḥ ǀ nápātaḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ dadhanvire ǀsaudhanvanā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ viṣṭvī́ ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Theṛbhus, the performers of (good) works, the grandsons of a man, have attained the friendship ofIndra, they have perpetuated (existence); the sons ofSudhanvanhave attained immortality; performers of pious acts influencing (the result), through their devotion (they have attained divinity) by their works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑ण याथ स॒रथं॑ सु॒ते सचाँ॒ अथो॒ वशा॑नां भवथा स॒ह श्रि॒या । न व॑: प्रति॒मै सु॑कृ॒तानि॑ वाघत॒: सौध॑न्वना ऋभवो वी॒र्या॑णि च
shlokas.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ yātha ǀ sa-rátham ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ átho íti ǀ váśānām ǀ bhavatha ǀ sahá ǀ śriyā́ ǀná ǀ vaḥ ǀ prati-mái ǀ su-kṛtā́ni ǀ vāghataḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go withIndrain his chariot when the libation is poured out, and be (welcomed) with honour by the (worshipper) desiring (your favour);ṛbhus, sons ofSudhanvan, bestowers (of the rewards of pious acts), your virtuous deeds, your great faculties, arenot to be mesured.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ ऋ॒भुभि॒र्वाज॑वद्भि॒: समु॑क्षितं सु॒तं सोम॒मा वृ॑षस्वा॒ गभ॑स्त्योः । धि॒येषि॒तो म॑घवन्दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे सौ॑धन्व॒नेभि॑: स॒ह म॑त्स्वा॒ नृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ vā́javat-bhiḥ ǀ sám-ukṣitam ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ saudhanvanébhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀ matsva ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, along with the food-bestowingṛbhus, accept with bothhandsthe (cup of the) effusedSomalibation; excitedMaghavan, by worship, rejoice with the human sons ofSudhanvanin the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ ऋभु॒मान्वाज॑वान्मत्स्वे॒ह नो॒ऽस्मिन्त्सव॑ने॒ शच्या॑ पुरुष्टुत । इ॒मानि॒ तुभ्यं॒ स्वस॑राणि येमिरे व्र॒ता दे॒वानां॒ मनु॑षश्च॒ धर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhu-mā́n ǀ vā́ja-vān ǀ matsva ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ sávane ǀ śácyā ǀ puru-stuta ǀimā́ni ǀ túbhyam ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ yemire ǀ vratā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the praised of many, associated withṚbhu, and withVāja, exult withŚaci, at this our sacrifice; these self-revolving (days) are devoted to you, as well as the ceremonies (addressed) to the gods, and the virtuous acts of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ ऋ॒भुभि॑र्वा॒जिभि॑र्वा॒जय॑न्नि॒ह स्तोमं॑ जरि॒तुरुप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञिय॑म् । श॒तं केते॑भिरिषि॒रेभि॑रा॒यवे॑ स॒हस्र॑णीथो अध्व॒रस्य॒ होम॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ vājáyan ǀ ihá ǀ stómam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñíyam ǀśatám ǀ kétebhiḥ ǀ iṣirébhiḥ ǀ āyáve ǀ sahásra-nīthaḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ hómani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, with the food-bestowingṚbhusrewarding (worship) with food, come hither to (receive) the reverential praise of the adorer, with a hundred quick-going steeds, the indications (of theMaruts); come to the burnt offering of the sacrifice, yielding a thousand blessings to the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॒ वाजे॑न वाजिनि॒ प्रचे॑ता॒: स्तोमं॑ जुषस्व गृण॒तो म॑घोनि । पु॒रा॒णी दे॑वि युव॒तिः पुरं॑धि॒रनु॑ व्र॒तं च॑रसि विश्ववारे
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ vā́jena ǀ vājini ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ maghoni ǀpurāṇī́ ǀ devi ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ carasi ǀ viśva-vāre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent Uṣas, giver of sustenance, possessed of intelligence, be propitiated by the praise of him who lauds you, (and worships) with (sacrificial) food; divine Uṣas, adored by all, who (though) ancient are (still) young, the object of manifold worship, you are present at the recurring (morning) rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॑ दे॒व्यम॑र्त्या॒ वि भा॑हि च॒न्द्रर॑था सू॒नृता॑ ई॒रय॑न्ती । आ त्वा॑ वहन्तु सु॒यमा॑सो॒ अश्वा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्णां पृथु॒पाज॑सो॒ ये
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ ámartyā ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀ candrá-rathā ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ īráyantī ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vahantu ǀ su-yámāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ híraṇya-varṇām ǀ pṛthu-pā́jasaḥ ǀ yé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, who are divine and immortal, mounted in a golden chariot, do you shine radiant causing to be head the sounds of truth; may your vigorous and well-trained horses bring you, who are golden-haired, (hither).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उष॑: प्रती॒ची भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वो॒र्ध्वा ति॑ष्ठस्य॒मृत॑स्य के॒तुः । स॒मा॒नमर्थं॑ चरणी॒यमा॑ना च॒क्रमि॑व नव्य॒स्या व॑वृत्स्व
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ ketúḥ ǀsamānám ǀ ártham ǀ caraṇīyámānā ǀ cakrám-iva ǀ navyasi ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, who spread over all the regions, you abide on high, the ensign of the immortal (sun), purposing to travel the same road, repeatedly turn back over new, (revolving) like a wheel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ स्यूमे॑व चिन्व॒ती म॒घोन्यु॒षा या॑ति॒ स्वस॑रस्य॒ पत्नी॑ । स्व१॒॑र्जन॑न्ती सु॒भगा॑ सु॒दंसा॒ आन्ता॑द्दि॒वः प॑प्रथ॒ आ पृ॑थि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ syū́ma-iva ǀ cinvatī́ ǀ maghónī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ svásarasya ǀ pátnī ǀsváḥ ǀ jánantī ǀ su-bhágā ǀ su-dáṃsāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ántāt ǀ diváḥ ǀ paprathe ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The opulent Uṣas, the bride of the far-darting (sun), throwing off (darkness) like a garment, proceeds; diffusing her own (lustre), auspicious, promoting sacred acts, she is renowned to the ends, she is renowned to the ends of the heaven and of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ वो दे॒वीमु॒षसं॑ विभा॒तीं प्र वो॑ भरध्वं॒ नम॑सा सुवृ॒क्तिम् । ऊ॒र्ध्वं म॑धु॒धा दि॒वि पाजो॑ अश्रे॒त्प्र रो॑च॒ना रु॑रुचे र॒ण्वसं॑दृक्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ bharadhvam ǀ námasā ǀ su-vṛktím ǀūrdhvám ǀ madhudhā́ ǀ diví ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ prá ǀ rocanā́ ǀ ruruce ǀ raṇvá-sandṛk ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, with your prostrations, due praise to the divine Uṣas, shining upon yoou; the repository of sweetness manifests her brightness aloft in the sky, and radiant and lovely lights the regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ताव॑री दि॒वो अ॒र्कैर॑बो॒ध्या रे॒वती॒ रोद॑सी चि॒त्रम॑स्थात् । आ॒य॒तीम॑ग्न उ॒षसं॑ विभा॒तीं वा॒ममे॑षि॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ भिक्ष॑माणः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-varī ǀ diváḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ abodhi ǀ ā́ ǀ revátī ǀ ródasī íti ǀ citrám ǀ asthāt ǀā-yatī́m ǀ agne ǀ uṣásam ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀ vāmám ǀ eṣi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ bhíkṣamāṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The possessor of truth is recognized in the sky by her rays; the possessor of wealth has taken a marvellous station in earth and heaven;Agni, soliciting alms of the radiant advancing Uṣas, you obtain your desired treasure (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ बु॒ध्न उ॒षसा॑मिष॒ण्यन्वृषा॑ म॒ही रोद॑सी॒ आ वि॑वेश । म॒ही मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य मा॒या च॒न्द्रेव॑ भा॒नुं वि द॑धे पुरु॒त्रा
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ budhné ǀ uṣásām ǀ iṣaṇyán ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀmahī́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ māyā́ ǀ candrā́-iva ǀ bhānúm ǀ ví ǀ dadhe ǀ puru-trā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of rain, the sun), urging on the lawn, at the root of the truthful (day) has pervaded the vast heaven and earth; the mighty Uṣas, the golden light, as it were, ofMitraandVaruṇa, diffuses her lustre in different directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ वां भृ॒मयो॒ मन्य॑माना यु॒वाव॑ते॒ न तुज्या॑ अभूवन् । क्व१॒॑ त्यदि॑न्द्रावरुणा॒ यशो॑ वां॒ येन॑ स्मा॒ सिनं॒ भर॑थ॒: सखि॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ bhṛmáyaḥ ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀ yuvā́-vate ǀ ná ǀ tújyāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀkvá ǀ tyát ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ vām ǀ yéna ǀ sma ǀ sínam ǀ bhárathaḥ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, may these people who are relying upon you, and wandering about (in alarm), sustain no injury from a youthful (adversary); for where is that reputation (you enjoy) on account that you bestow sustenance on your friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमु॑ वां पुरु॒तमो॑ रयी॒यञ्छ॑श्वत्त॒ममव॑से जोहवीति । स॒जोषा॑विन्द्रावरुणा म॒रुद्भि॑र्दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या शृ॑णुतं॒ हवं॑ मे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ puru-támaḥ ǀ rayi-yán ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ ávase ǀ johavīti ǀsa-jóṣau ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ divā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀ me ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most diligent (in pious rites) this (your worshipper),IndraandVaruṇa, desirous of wealth, incessantly invokes, you for protection; associated with theMaruts, with heaven and earth, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे तदि॑न्द्रावरुणा॒ वसु॑ ष्याद॒स्मे र॒यिर्म॑रुत॒: सर्व॑वीरः । अ॒स्मान्वरू॑त्रीः शर॒णैर॑वन्त्व॒स्मान्होत्रा॒ भार॑ती॒ दक्षि॑णाभिः
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ tát ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ vásu ǀ syāt ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayíḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sárva-vīraḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ várūtrīḥ ǀ śaraṇáiḥ ǀ avantu ǀ asmā́n ǀ hótrā ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ dákṣiṇābhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May there be to us,IndraandVaruṇa, such wealth (as we covet); may there be,Maruts, to us wealth( of cattle) and numerous descendants; may the delightful (wives of the gods) shelter us with dwellings; mayHotāandBhāratī(enrich) us with gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते जु॒षस्व॑ नो ह॒व्यानि॑ विश्वदेव्य । रास्व॒ रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ juṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ viśva-devya ǀrā́sva ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, friend of all the gods, accept our oblations; grant precious treasures to the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑म॒र्कैर्बृह॒स्पति॑मध्व॒रेषु॑ नमस्यत । अना॒म्योज॒ आ च॑के
shlokas.transliteration: śúcim ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ namasyata ǀánāmi ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore the pureBṛhaspatiat sacrifices with hymns; I solicit of him unsurpassable strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ष॒भं च॑र्षणी॒नां वि॒श्वरू॑प॒मदा॑भ्यम् । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वरे॑ण्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ viśvá-rūpam ǀ ádābhyam ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits) on men, the omniform, the irreproachable, the excellentBṛhaspati.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं ते॑ पूषन्नाघृणे सुष्टु॒तिर्दे॑व॒ नव्य॑सी । अ॒स्माभि॒स्तुभ्यं॑ शस्यते
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ te ǀ pūṣan ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ deva ǀ návyasī ǀasmā́bhiḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ śasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine, resplendent,Pūṣan, this, your most recent laudation, is uttered by us to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तां जु॑षस्व॒ गिरं॒ मम॑ वाज॒यन्ती॑मवा॒ धिय॑म् । व॒धू॒युरि॑व॒ योष॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ juṣasva ǀ gíram ǀ máma ǀ vāja-yántīm ǀ ava ǀ dhíyam ǀvadhūyúḥ-iva ǀ yóṣaṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be plural ased by this my praise, and incline to this food-supplicating laudation as an excessively submissive (husband) to his wife.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो विश्वा॒भि वि॒पश्य॑ति॒ भुव॑ना॒ सं च॒ पश्य॑ति । स न॑: पू॒षावि॒ता भु॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ abhí ǀ vi-páśyati ǀ bhúvanā ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ páśyati ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatPūṣan, who looks upon all the worlds, who thoroughly contemplates them, be our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो न॑: प्रचो॒दया॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ savitúḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ bhárgaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ dhīmahi ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-codáyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We meditate on that desirable light of the divineSavitā, who influences our pious rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्व॒यं वा॑ज॒यन्त॒: पुरं॑ध्या । भग॑स्य रा॒तिमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ vayám ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǀbhágasya ǀ rātím ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of food, we solicit with praise of the divineSavitā, the gift of affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वं नर॑: सवि॒तारं॒ विप्रा॑ य॒ज्ञैः सु॑वृ॒क्तिभि॑: । न॒म॒स्यन्ति॑ धि॒येषि॒ताः
shlokas.transliteration: devám ǀ náraḥ ǀ savitā́ram ǀ víprāḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀnamasyánti ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devout and wise men, impelled by intelligence, adore the divineSavitāwith sacrifices and sacred hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ जिगाति गातु॒विद्दे॒वाना॑मेति निष्कृ॒तम् । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ jigāti ǀ gātu-vít ǀ devā́nām ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, knowing the right path, proceeds (by it); he goes to the excellent seat of the gods, the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे च प॒शवे॑ । अ॒न॒मी॒वा इष॑स्करत्
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ ca ǀ paśáve ǀanamīvā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ karat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySomagrant to us and to (our) biped and quadruped animals, wholesome food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॒मायु॑र्व॒र्धय॑न्न॒भिमा॑ती॒: सह॑मानः । सोम॑: स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ vardháyan ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ sáhamānaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySoma, prolonging our lives and overcoming our adversaries, sit down in our plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ मित्रावरुणा घृ॒तैर्गव्यू॑तिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा॒ रजां॑सि सुक्रतू
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀmádhvā ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ sukratū íti su-kratū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, sprinkle our cow-stalls with butter; performers of good works, (sprinkle) the worlds with honey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु॒शंसा॑ नमो॒वृधा॑ म॒ह्ना दक्ष॑स्य राजथः । द्राघि॑ष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता
shlokas.transliteration: uru-śáṃsā ǀ namaḥ-vṛ́dhā ǀ mahnā́ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ rājathaḥ ǀdrā́ghiṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ śuci-vratā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performers of pure rites, glorified by many, exalted by adoration, (celebrated) by prolonged praises, you reign by the greatness of (your) strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒णा॒ना ज॒मद॑ग्निना॒ योना॑वृ॒तस्य॑ सीदतम् । पा॒तं सोम॑मृतावृधा
shlokas.transliteration: gṛṇānā́ ǀ jamát-agninā ǀ yónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdatam ǀpātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified byJamadagni, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice (the altar); drink, augmenters (of the reward) of sacrifice, theSomalibation.”
