shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां ह्य॑ग्ने॒ सद॒मित्स॑म॒न्यवो॑ दे॒वासो॑ दे॒वम॑र॒तिं न्ये॑रि॒र इति॒ क्रत्वा॑ न्येरि॒रे । अम॑र्त्यं यजत॒ मर्त्ये॒ष्वा दे॒वमादे॑वं जनत॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ विश्व॒मादे॑वं जनत॒ प्रचे॑तसम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ sa-manyávaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ devám ǀ aratím ǀ ni-eriré ǀ íti ǀ krátvā ǀ ni-eriré ǀámartyam ǀ yajata ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ devám ǀ ā́-devam ǀ janata ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́-devam ǀ janata ǀ prá-cetasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since the emulous gods ever excite you,Agni, who are a deity swift of motion, (to contest), therefore do (your worshippers) urge you by their devotions (to bring the deities to their sacrifices); adorable Agni, they (the deities), have genitive rated you, immortal, divine, all-wise, as the present divinity among men; they have genitive rated you as the all-present and all-wise deity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स भ्रात॑रं॒ वरु॑णमग्न॒ आ व॑वृत्स्व दे॒वाँ अच्छा॑ सुम॒ती य॒ज्ञव॑नसं॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ य॒ज्ञव॑नसम् । ऋ॒तावा॑नमादि॒त्यं च॑र्षणी॒धृतं॒ राजा॑नं चर्षणी॒धृत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bhrā́taram ǀ váruṇam ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ su-matī́ ǀ yajñá-vanasam ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ yajñá-vanasam ǀṛtá-vānam ǀ ādityám ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tam ǀ rā́jānam ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́tam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to the presence of the worshippers,Agni, your brotherVaruṇa, as a participator fo the sacrifice, with a willing mind, the elder participator of the sacrifice; the ruler of the water, theĀditya, the supporter of men the sovereign venerated by mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखे॒ सखा॑यम॒भ्या व॑वृत्स्वा॒शुं न च॒क्रं रथ्ये॑व॒ रंह्या॒स्मभ्यं॑ दस्म॒ रंह्या॑ । अग्ने॑ मृळी॒कं वरु॑णे॒ सचा॑ विदो म॒रुत्सु॑ वि॒श्वभा॑नुषु । तो॒काय॑ तु॒जे शु॑शुचान॒ शं कृ॑ध्य॒स्मभ्यं॑ दस्म॒ शं कृ॑धि
shlokas.transliteration: sákhe ǀ sákhāyam ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ āśúm ǀ ná ǀ cakrám ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ ráṃhyā ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dasma ǀ ráṃhyā ǀágne ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ váruṇe ǀ sácā ǀ vidaḥ ǀ marút-su ǀ viśvá-bhānuṣu ǀtokā́ya ǀ tujé ǀ śuśucāna ǀ śám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dasma ǀ śám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Friendly and beautiful (Agni), bring your friend (Varruṇa) to our presence, as two strong horses convey the swift chariot along the road to its goal; you receive, Agni, the gratifying (oblation) together withVaruṇa, and with the all-illuminigMaruts; grant, brilliant Agni, happiness to our sons and grandsons; grant, beautiful Agni, happiness to ourselves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ वरु॑णस्य वि॒द्वान्दे॒वस्य॒ हेळोऽव॑ यासिसीष्ठाः । यजि॑ष्ठो॒ वह्नि॑तम॒: शोशु॑चानो॒ विश्वा॒ द्वेषां॑सि॒ प्र मु॑मुग्ध्य॒स्मत्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ devásya ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ áva ǀ yāsisīṣṭhāḥ ǀyájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ váhni-tamaḥ ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ prá ǀ mumugdhi ǀ asmát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May youAgni, who are wise, avert from us the wrath of the divineVaruṇa; do you, who are the most frequent sacrificer, the most diligent bearer (of oblations), the most resplendent liberate us from all animosities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं नो॑ अग्नेऽव॒मो भ॑वो॒ती नेदि॑ष्ठो अ॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । अव॑ यक्ष्व नो॒ वरु॑णं॒ ररा॑णो वी॒हि मृ॑ळी॒कं सु॒हवो॑ न एधि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avamáḥ ǀ bhava ǀ ūtī́ ǀ nédiṣṭhaḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀáva ǀ yakṣva ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇam ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ vīhí ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ edhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do youAgniour preserver bemost nigh to us with your protection at the breaking of this dawn; deprecateVaruṇafor us and propitiated (by our praise) feed upon the grateful (oblation), and be to us of auspicious invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य श्रेष्ठा॑ सु॒भग॑स्य सं॒दृग्दे॒वस्य॑ चि॒त्रत॑मा॒ मर्त्ये॑षु । शुचि॑ घृ॒तं न त॒प्तमघ्न्या॑याः स्पा॒र्हा दे॒वस्य॑ मं॒हने॑व धे॒नोः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śréṣṭhā ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ sam-dṛ́k ǀ devásya ǀ citrá-tamā ǀ mártyeṣu ǀśúci ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ taptám ǀ ághnyāyāḥ ǀ spārhā́ ǀ devásya ǀ maṃhánā-iva ǀ dhenóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The glance of this auspicious deity, directed towards men, is most excellent, most wonderful, acceptable (to all) as the pure warm butter (from the milk) of the cow (is acceptable) to the deity; as the gift of a cow (is to a man).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर॑स्य॒ ता प॑र॒मा स॑न्ति स॒त्या स्पा॒र्हा दे॒वस्य॒ जनि॑मान्य॒ग्नेः । अ॒न॒न्ते अ॒न्तः परि॑वीत॒ आगा॒च्छुचि॑: शु॒क्रो अ॒र्यो रोरु॑चानः
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ asya ǀ tā́ ǀ paramā́ ǀ santi ǀ satyā́ ǀ spārhā́ ǀ devásya ǀ jánimāni ǀ agnéḥ ǀananté ǀ antáríti ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ śúciḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ rórucānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These are the supreme, true, and desirable births of this divineAgni, invested (with radiance) in the unbounded (firmament); pure, bright, radiant lord (of all), may he come (to our) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स दू॒तो विश्वेद॒भि व॑ष्टि॒ सद्मा॒ होता॒ हिर॑ण्यरथो॒ रंसु॑जिह्वः । रो॒हिद॑श्वो वपु॒ष्यो॑ वि॒भावा॒ सदा॑ र॒ण्वः पि॑तु॒मती॑व सं॒सत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ sádma ǀ hótā ǀ híraṇya-rathaḥ ǀ rám-sujihvaḥ ǀrohít-aśvaḥ ǀ vapuṣyáḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ sádā ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ pitumátī-iva ǀ sam-sát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The messenger, the invoker (of the gods), riding in a golden chariot with a tongue of flame, he frequents all the chambers (of sacrifice); drawn by red horses embodied resplendent, always agreeable, as a delling well supplied with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स चे॑तय॒न्मनु॑षो य॒ज्ञब॑न्धु॒: प्र तं म॒ह्या र॑श॒नया॑ नयन्ति । स क्षे॑त्यस्य॒ दुर्या॑सु॒ साध॑न्दे॒वो मर्त॑स्य सधनि॒त्वमा॑प
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ cetayat ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yajñá-bandhuḥ ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ mahyā́ ǀ raśanáyā ǀ nayanti ǀsáḥ ǀ kṣeti ǀ asya ǀ dúryāsu ǀ sā́dhan ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ sadhani-tvám ǀ āpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with sacrifice, and knowing those men (who are engaged in good works), they lead him with the strong cord (of praise); he, the divineAgni, fulfilling (all desires), abides in the dwelling of this mortal, and obtains fellowhip in his wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तू नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्न॑यतु प्रजा॒नन्नच्छा॒ रत्नं॑ दे॒वभ॑क्तं॒ यद॑स्य । धि॒या यद्विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॒ अकृ॑ण्व॒न्द्यौष्पि॒ता ज॑नि॒ता स॒त्यमु॑क्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ nayatu ǀ pra-jānán ǀ áccha ǀ rátnam ǀ devá-bhaktam ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀdhiyā́ ǀ yát ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ákṛṇvan ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ janitā́ ǀ satyám ǀ ukṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that wiseAgniconduct us to that wealth which is desired by the devout; he whom all the immortals have created for (the performance of) sacred oblations, the most rresplendent, liberate us from all animosities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जा॑यत प्रथ॒मः प॒स्त्या॑सु म॒हो बु॒ध्ने रज॑सो अ॒स्य योनौ॑ । अ॒पाद॑शी॒र्षा गु॒हमा॑नो॒ अन्ता॒योयु॑वानो वृष॒भस्य॑ नी॒ळे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jāyata ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pastyā́su ǀ maháḥ ǀ budhné ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ yónau ǀapā́t ǀ aśīrṣā́ ǀ guhámānaḥ ǀ ántā ǀ ā-yóyuvānaḥ ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ nīḷé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is first engendered in the habitation (of the sacrificers); then upon his station, (the altar), the base of the vast firmament; without feet, without head, concealing his extremities, combining with smoke in the nest of the rain-cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शर्ध॑ आर्त प्रथ॒मं वि॑प॒न्याँ ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑ वृष॒भस्य॑ नी॒ळे । स्पा॒र्हो युवा॑ वपु॒ष्यो॑ वि॒भावा॑ स॒प्त प्रि॒यासो॑ऽजनयन्त॒ वृष्णे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ārta ǀ prathamám ǀ vipanyā́ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ nīḷé ǀspārháḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ vapuṣyáḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ saptá ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ ajanayanta ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiance has first proceeded to you, (Agni), who are glorified by praise, in the womb of the water, in the nest of the rain-cloud; the seven attached (priests) have engendered (praise) to the showerer (of benefits), who desirable, ever young, embodied, and resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॒मत्र॑ पि॒तरो॑ मनु॒ष्या॑ अ॒भि प्र से॑दुॠ॒तमा॑शुषा॒णाः । अश्म॑व्रजाः सु॒दुघा॑ व॒व्रे अ॒न्तरुदु॒स्रा आ॑जन्नु॒षसो॑ हुवा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ átra ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ seduḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ āśuṣāṇā́ḥ ǀáśma-vrajāḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ vavré ǀ antáḥ ǀ út ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ājan ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ huvānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this world, our mortal forefathers departed after instrumental tuting the sacred rite, when, calling upon the dawn, they extricated the milk-yielding kine, concealed among the rocks in the darkness (of the cave).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते म॑र्मृजत ददृ॒वांसो॒ अद्रिं॒ तदे॑षाम॒न्ये अ॒भितो॒ वि वो॑चन् । प॒श्वय॑न्त्रासो अ॒भि का॒रम॑र्चन्वि॒दन्त॒ ज्योति॑श्चकृ॒पन्त॑ धी॒भिः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ marmṛjata ǀ dadṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ tát ǀ eṣām ǀ anyé ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vocan ǀpaśvá-yantrāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kārám ǀ arcan ǀ vidánta ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ cakṛpánta ǀ dhībhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rending the rocks, they worshipped (Agni), and other (sages) taught everywhere their (acts); unprovided with the means of (extricating) the cattle, they glorified the author of success, whence they found the light, and were thus enabled (to worship him) with holy ceremonies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते ग॑व्य॒ता मन॑सा दृ॒ध्रमु॒ब्धं गा ये॑मा॒नं परि॒ षन्त॒मद्रि॑म् । दृ॒ळ्हं नरो॒ वच॑सा॒ दैव्ये॑न व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ gavyatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ dṛdhrám ǀ ubdhám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ yemānám ǀ pári ǀ sántam ǀ ádrim ǀdṛḷhám ǀ náraḥ ǀ vácasā ǀ dáivyena ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to (Agni), those leaders (of sacred rites), with minds intent upon (recovering) the cattle, forced open, by (the power) of divine prayer, the obstructing, compact, solid mountain confining the cows, a cow-pen full of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते म॑न्वत प्रथ॒मं नाम॑ धे॒नोस्त्रिः स॒प्त मा॒तुः प॑र॒माणि॑ विन्दन् । तज्जा॑न॒तीर॒भ्य॑नूषत॒ व्रा आ॒विर्भु॑वदरु॒णीर्य॒शसा॒ गोः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ manvata ǀ prathamám ǀ nā́ma ǀ dhenóḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ mātúḥ ǀ paramā́ṇi ǀ vindan ǀtát ǀ jānatī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ vrā́ḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ aruṇī́ḥ ǀ yaśásā ǀ góḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They first have comprehended the name of the kine, knowing the thrice seven excellent (forms) or the maternal (rhythm); then they glorified the conscious dawns and the purple dawn appeared with the radiance of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नेश॒त्तमो॒ दुधि॑तं॒ रोच॑त॒ द्यौरुद्दे॒व्या उ॒षसो॑ भा॒नुर॑र्त । आ सूर्यो॑ बृह॒तस्ति॑ष्ठ॒दज्राँ॑ ऋ॒जु मर्ते॑षु वृजि॒ना च॒ पश्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: néśat ǀ támaḥ ǀ dúdhitam ǀ rócata ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ út ǀ devyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ arta ǀā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ tiṣṭhat ǀ ájrān ǀ ṛjú ǀ márteṣu ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ páśyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The scattered darkness was destroyed; the firmament glowed with radiance; the lustre of the divine dawn arose; then the sun stood above the undecaying mountains, beholding all that was right or wrong among mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदित्प॒श्चा बु॑बुधा॒ना व्य॑ख्य॒न्नादिद्रत्नं॑ धारयन्त॒ द्युभ॑क्तम् । विश्वे॒ विश्वा॑सु॒ दुर्या॑सु दे॒वा मित्र॑ धि॒ये व॑रुण स॒त्यम॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ paścā́ ǀ bubudhānā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ akhyan ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ rátnam ǀ dhārayanta ǀ dyú-bhaktam ǀvíśve ǀ víśvāsu ǀ dúryāsu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mítra ǀ dhiyé ǀ varuṇa ǀ satyám ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereupon awaking, the (Aṅgirasas) beheld (the cattle set free), and seized upon the precious treasures; the universal gods then came to all (their) dwellings;MitraandVaruṇamay your truth be (kept) to him who worships (you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ वोचेय शुशुचा॒नम॒ग्निं होता॑रं वि॒श्वभ॑रसं॒ यजि॑ष्ठम् । शुच्यूधो॑ अतृण॒न्न गवा॒मन्धो॒ न पू॒तं परि॑षिक्तमं॒शोः
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ voceya ǀ śuśucānám ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ viśvá-bharasam ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀśúci ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ atṛṇat ǀ ná ǀ gávām ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pūtám ǀ pári-siktam ǀ aṃśóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I glorify the present radiantAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the supporter of the universe, most deserving of adoration, without milking the pure udder (of the cow), without the purified food of theSomaoffered in libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑षा॒मदि॑तिर्य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ विश्वे॑षा॒मति॑थि॒र्मानु॑षाणाम् । अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॒मव॑ आवृणा॒नः सु॑मृळी॒को भ॑वतु जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ víśveṣām ǀ átithiḥ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀagníḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā-vṛṇānáḥ ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgnibe theAditiof all those in whom sacrifice is offered; may he be the guest of all men; receiving the (sacrificial) food of the devout may he to whom all is known, be the bestower of felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मर्त्ये॑ष्व॒मृत॑ ऋ॒तावा॑ दे॒वो दे॒वेष्व॑र॒तिर्नि॒धायि॑ । होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो म॒ह्ना शु॒चध्यै॑ ह॒व्यैर॒ग्निर्मनु॑ष ईर॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ aratíḥ ǀ ni-dhā́yi ǀhótā ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ śucádhyai ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ īrayádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has beenplaced immortal among the mortals, the observer of truth, a deity triumphant among gods, the invoker of the gods, the most diligent sacrificer,Agni; he has been plural ced (upon the altar) to lighten (the ceremony) by his (lustre), and for the elevation of the worshipper, through oblations (in heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्वं सू॑नो सहसो नो अ॒द्य जा॒तो जा॒ताँ उ॒भयाँ॑ अ॒न्तर॑ग्ने । दू॒त ई॑यसे युयुजा॒न ऋ॑ष्व ऋजुमु॒ष्कान्वृष॑णः शु॒क्राँश्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tvám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ jātáḥ ǀ jātā́n ǀ ubháyān ǀ antáḥ ǀ agne ǀdūtáḥ ǀ īyase ǀ yuyujānáḥ ǀ ṛṣva ǀ ṛju-muṣkā́n ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ śukrā́n ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, genitive rated today at this our rite, as intermediate between both (gods and men) you proceed, the invoker (of the gods), harnessing, graceful Agni, your robust, vigorous, and resplendent steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्या॑ वृध॒स्नू रोहि॑ता घृ॒तस्नू॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ मन्ये॒ मन॑सा॒ जवि॑ष्ठा । अ॒न्तरी॑यसे अरु॒षा यु॑जा॒नो यु॒ष्माँश्च॑ दे॒वान्विश॒ आ च॒ मर्ता॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: átyā ǀ vṛdhasnū́ íti vṛdha-snū́ ǀ róhitā ǀ ghṛtásnū íti ghṛtá-snū ǀ ṛtásya ǀ manye ǀ mánasā ǀ jáviṣṭhā ǀantáḥ ǀ īyase ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ yuṣmā́n ǀ ca ǀ devā́n ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ mártān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I celebrate the ruddy, food-bestowing, water- shedding, and swifter-than-thought-going, steeds of him who is the truth; harnessing the brilliant pair (to your chariot), you pass between the deities of whom you are, and human worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ वरु॑णं मि॒त्रमे॑षा॒मिन्द्रा॒विष्णू॑ म॒रुतो॑ अ॒श्विनो॒त । स्वश्वो॑ अग्ने सु॒रथ॑: सु॒राधा॒ एदु॑ वह सुह॒विषे॒ जना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: aryamáṇam ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ eṣām ǀ índrāvíṣṇū íti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ utá ǀsu-áśvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-ráthaḥ ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaha ǀ su-havíṣe ǀ jánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessed,Agni, of good steeds, an excellent car, and abundant wealth, do you amidst these (worshippers) bring to the man who offers worthy oblations,Aryaman,Varuṇa,Mitra,Viṣṇu, theMaruts, or theAśvins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोमाँ॑ अ॒ग्नेऽवि॑माँ अ॒श्वी य॒ज्ञो नृ॒वत्स॑खा॒ सद॒मिद॑प्रमृ॒ष्यः । इळा॑वाँ ए॒षो अ॑सुर प्र॒जावा॑न्दी॒र्घो र॒यिः पृ॑थुबु॒ध्नः स॒भावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mān ǀ agne ǀ ávi-mān ǀ aśvī́ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ nṛvát-sakhā ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ apra-mṛṣyáḥ ǀíḷā-vān ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ asura ǀ prajā́-vān ǀ dīrgháḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ pṛthu-budhnáḥ ǀ sabhā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sacrifice,Agni, be productive of cows, of sheep, of horses, and celebrated by your worshipper, aided by the priests, be ever uninterrupted; may it, mighty Agni, be productive of food and progeny, long continued, affluent, wide based, and held in full assembly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त॑ इ॒ध्मं ज॒भर॑त्सिष्विदा॒नो मू॒र्धानं॑ वा त॒तप॑ते त्वा॒या । भुव॒स्तस्य॒ स्वत॑वाँ: पा॒युर॑ग्ने॒ विश्व॑स्मात्सीमघाय॒त उ॑रुष्य
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ idhmám ǀ jabhárat ǀ sisvidānáḥ ǀ mūrdhā́nam ǀ vā ǀ tatápate ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀbhúvaḥ ǀ tásya ǀ svá-tavān ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ agne ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ sīm ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀ uruṣya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the munificent recompenser of that man who, sweating (with toil), brings you fuel, and for your service causes his head to ache; protect him,Agnifrom every one that seeks to do him evil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ भरा॒दन्नि॑यते चि॒दन्नं॑ नि॒शिष॑न्म॒न्द्रमति॑थिमु॒दीर॑त् । आ दे॑व॒युरि॒नध॑ते दुरो॒णे तस्मि॑न्र॒यिर्ध्रु॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ दास्वा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ bhárāt ǀ ánni-yate ǀ cit ǀ ánnam ǀ ni-śíṣat ǀ mandrám ǀ átithim ǀ ut-ī́rat ǀā́ ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ inádhate ǀ duroṇé ǀ tásmin ǀ rayíḥ ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ astu ǀ dā́svān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May a son, firm in (devotion) and liberal (in offerings), be born to him who presents (sacrificial) food to you when needing food, who gives you constantly the exhilarating (Somajuice), who welcomes you as a guest, and devoutly kindles you in his mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वा॑ दो॒षा य उ॒षसि॑ प्र॒शंसा॑त्प्रि॒यं वा॑ त्वा कृ॒णव॑ते ह॒विष्मा॑न् । अश्वो॒ न स्वे दम॒ आ हे॒म्यावा॒न्तमंह॑सः पीपरो दा॒श्वांस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ doṣā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ uṣási ǀ pra-śáṃsāt ǀ priyám ǀ vā ǀ tvā ǀ kṛṇávate ǀ havíṣmān ǀáśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ své ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ hemyā́-vān ǀ tám ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ pīparaḥ ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preserve from sin the liberal sacrificer who glorifies you morning and evening, and presenting oblations, does what is acceptable to you in his own abode, like a horse with golden caparisons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्तुभ्य॑मग्ने अ॒मृता॑य॒ दाश॒द्दुव॒स्त्वे कृ॒णव॑ते य॒तस्रु॑क् । न स रा॒या श॑शमा॒नो वि यो॑ष॒न्नैन॒मंह॒: परि॑ वरदघा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ agne ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ dā́śat ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ kṛṇávate ǀ yatá-sruk ǀná ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ yoṣat ǀ ná ǀ enam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ pári ǀ varat ǀ agha-yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not him who makes offerings to youAgniwho are immortal, who with uplifted ladle pours out oblations repeating your praise, ever want riches, and let not the wickeness of a malevolent (foe) circumvent him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्वम॑ग्ने अध्व॒रं जुजो॑षो दे॒वो मर्त॑स्य॒ सुधि॑तं॒ ररा॑णः । प्री॒तेद॑स॒द्धोत्रा॒ सा य॑वि॒ष्ठासा॑म॒ यस्य॑ विध॒तो वृ॒धास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ adhvarám ǀ jújoṣaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀprītā́ ǀ ít ǀ asat ǀ hótrā ǀ sā́ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ ásāma ǀ yásya ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ vṛdhā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that prayer be agreeable to you,Agni, who are a gracious deity, (which is uttered) by the man with whose well-conducted sacrifice you are well plural ased young (of the gods), of whose (rites) when worshipping you may we be the promoters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चित्ति॒मचि॑त्तिं चिनव॒द्वि वि॒द्वान्पृ॒ष्ठेव॑ वी॒ता वृ॑जि॒ना च॒ मर्ता॑न् । रा॒ये च॑ नः स्वप॒त्याय॑ देव॒ दितिं॑ च॒ रास्वादि॑तिमुरुष्य
shlokas.transliteration: cíttim ǀ ácittim ǀ cinavat ǀ ví ǀ vidvā́n ǀ pṛṣṭhā́-iva ǀ vītā́ ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ mártān ǀrāyé ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ su-apatyā́ya ǀ deva ǀ dítim ǀ ca ǀ rā́sva ǀ áditim ǀ uruṣya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wiseAgnidiscriminate between virtue and vice between (virtuous and wicked) men, as a (groom distinguishes between) the strong and weak backs (of horses); enrich us with wealth accompanied by virtuous offspring; be bountiful to the liberal giver; shun him who gives not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विं श॑शासुः क॒वयोऽद॑ब्धा निधा॒रय॑न्तो॒ दुर्या॑स्वा॒योः । अत॒स्त्वं दृश्याँ॑ अग्न ए॒तान्प॒ड्भिः प॑श्ये॒रद्भु॑ताँ अ॒र्य एवै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kavím ǀ śaśāsuḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǀ ni-dhāráyantaḥ ǀ dúryāsu ǀ āyóḥ ǀátaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ dṛ́śyān ǀ agne ǀ etā́n ǀ paṭ-bhíḥ ǀ paśyeḥ ǀ ádbhutān ǀ aryáḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The unveiled sages abiding in the dwellings of man have glorified the sage (Agni); therefore, lord of sacrifice, you may proceed with swift-moving feet to behold the admirable and marvellous deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वा॒घते॑ सु॒प्रणी॑तिः सु॒तसो॑माय विध॒ते य॑विष्ठ । रत्नं॑ भर शशमा॒नाय॑ घृष्वे पृ॒थु श्च॒न्द्रमव॑से चर्षणि॒प्राः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vāgháte ǀ su-pránītiḥ ǀ sutá-somāya ǀ vidhaté ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀrátnam ǀ bhara ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ ghṛ́ṣve ǀ pṛthú ǀ candrám ǀ ávase ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, young of the gods, the satisfier of (the desires of) men, who are easily to be conducted (to the altar), bestow joy-yielding and abundant wealth for his preservation upon the worshipper who praises and worships you and offers you libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ ह॒ यद्व॒यम॑ग्ने त्वा॒या प॒ड्भिर्हस्ते॑भिश्चकृ॒मा त॒नूभि॑: । रथं॒ न क्रन्तो॒ अप॑सा भु॒रिजो॑ॠ॒तं ये॑मुः सु॒ध्य॑ आशुषा॒णाः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vayám ǀ agne ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ paṭ-bhíḥ ǀ hástebhiḥ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀrátham ǀ ná ǀ krántaḥ ǀ ápasā ǀ bhuríjoḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yemuḥ ǀ su-dhyáḥ ǀ āśuṣāṇā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore,Agni, when we labour for you withhandsand feet, and all our members, the pious performers of rites, (theAṅgirasas), exercise their arms in the work (of attrition), as wheelwrights fabricate a car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ मा॒तुरु॒षस॑: स॒प्त विप्रा॒ जाये॑महि प्रथ॒मा वे॒धसो॒ नॄन् । दि॒वस्पु॒त्रा अङ्गि॑रसो भवे॒माद्रिं॑ रुजेम ध॒निनं॑ शु॒चन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ mātúḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāḥ ǀ jā́yemahi ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀdiváḥ ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ bhavema ǀ ádrim ǀ rujema ǀ dhanínam ǀ śucántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we seven priests first in order engender from the material drawn the worshippers of the creator (Agni); may weAṅgirasasbe the sons of heaven, and, radiant, divide the wealth-continuing mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ यथा॑ नः पि॒तर॒: परा॑सः प्र॒त्नासो॑ अग्न ऋ॒तमा॑शुषा॒णाः । शुचीद॑य॒न्दीधि॑तिमुक्थ॒शास॒: क्षामा॑ भि॒न्दन्तो॑ अरु॒णीरप॑ व्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ párāsaḥ ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ ṛtám ǀ āśuṣāṇā́ḥ ǀśúci ǀ ít ǀ ayan ǀ dī́dhitim ǀ uktha-śásaḥ ǀ kṣā́mā ǀ bhindántaḥ ǀ aruṇī́ḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus,Agni, our excellent and ancient forefathers, celebrators of holy sacrifice, proceeded to (the region of) pure light, and, reciting prayers and dispersing gloom, they made manifest the purple (kine).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒कर्मा॑णः सु॒रुचो॑ देव॒यन्तोऽयो॒ न दे॒वा जनि॑मा॒ धम॑न्तः । शु॒चन्तो॑ अ॒ग्निं व॑वृ॒धन्त॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒र्वं गव्यं॑ परि॒षद॑न्तो अग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: su-kármāṇaḥ ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ áyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ jánima ǀ dhámantaḥ ǀśucántaḥ ǀ agním ǀ vavṛdhántaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūrvám ǀ gávyam ǀ pari-sádantaḥ ǀ agman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performers of good works, brilliant and devout, the praises of the gods have freed their birth from impurity, as (a smith heats) bronze; excitingAgni, elevatingIndra, and wandering about (in search), they have gone to the vast (hidden) herd of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यू॒थेव॑ क्षु॒मति॑ प॒श्वो अ॑ख्यद्दे॒वानां॒ यज्जनि॒मान्त्यु॑ग्र । मर्ता॑नां चिदु॒र्वशी॑रकृप्रन्वृ॒धे चि॑द॒र्य उप॑रस्या॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ kṣu-máti ǀ paśváḥ ǀ akhyat ǀ devā́nām ǀ yát ǀ jánima ǀ ánti ǀ ugra ǀmártānām ǀ cit ǀ urváśīḥ ǀ akṛpran ǀ vṛdhé ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ úparasya ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fierce (Agni), when (Indra) proclaimed the near presence of the herd of the kine of the divine (Aṅgirasas) as a herd of cattle in a well-stored stall, the progeny of mortals were thereby enabled (to perform pious acts), and the master of the family rendered competent to (provide for) the increase of posterity and (the support of) dependants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक॑र्म ते॒ स्वप॑सो अभूम ऋ॒तम॑वस्रन्नु॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः । अनू॑नम॒ग्निं पु॑रु॒धा सु॑श्च॒न्द्रं दे॒वस्य॒ मर्मृ॑जत॒श्चारु॒ चक्षु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ákarma ǀ te ǀ su-ápasaḥ ǀ abhūma ǀ ṛtám ǀ avasran ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀánūnam ǀ agním ǀ purudhā́ ǀ su-candrám ǀ devásya ǀ mármṛjataḥ ǀ cā́ru ǀ cákṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have worshipped you (Agni), and have thereby become the performers of a good work, adoring the full and variously delighting Agni, the beautiful lustre of the radiant divinity, when the brilliant dawns have arrayed (themselves) in light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता ते॑ अग्न उ॒चथा॑नि वे॒धोऽवो॑चाम क॒वये॒ ता जु॑षस्व । उच्छो॑चस्व कृणु॒हि वस्य॑सो नो म॒हो रा॒यः पु॑रुवार॒ प्र य॑न्धि
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ucáthāni ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ ávocāma ǀ kaváye ǀ tā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀút ǀ śocasva ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-vāra ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Creator,Agni, we have repeated these your praises to you who are all-wise; do you accept them;blaze aloft; make us opulent; do you who are worshipped by many bestow upon us ample wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॒ राजा॑नमध्व॒रस्य॑ रु॒द्रं होता॑रं सत्य॒यजं॒ रोद॑स्योः । अ॒ग्निं पु॒रा त॑नयि॒त्नोर॒चित्ता॒द्धिर॑ण्यरूप॒मव॑से कृणुध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ adhvarásya ǀ rudrám ǀ hótāram ǀ satya-yájam ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀagním ǀ purā́ ǀ tanayitnóḥ ǀ acíttāt ǀ híraṇya-rūpam ǀ ávase ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SecureAgni, the king of sacrifice, the afflicter (of foes), the invoker (of the gods), the distributor of food through heaven and earth, the golden-formed, for your protection before (surprised by) sudden death.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं योनि॑श्चकृ॒मा यं व॒यं ते॑ जा॒येव॒ पत्य॑ उश॒ती सु॒वासा॑: । अ॒र्वा॒ची॒नः परि॑वीतो॒ नि षी॑दे॒मा उ॑ ते स्वपाक प्रती॒चीः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ yóniḥ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ yám ǀ vayám ǀ te ǀ jāyā́-iva ǀ pátye ǀ uśatī́ ǀ su-vā́sāḥ ǀarvācīnáḥ ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīda ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ su-apāka ǀ pratīcī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is the altar which we have decorated for you, as a wife attached to her husband puts on elegant garments (to gratify him); maturer of good works, sit down in our presence invested (with radiance), while your flames incline towards you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒शृ॒ण्व॒ते अदृ॑पिताय॒ मन्म॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑से सुमृळी॒काय॑ वेधः । दे॒वाय॑ श॒स्तिम॒मृता॑य शंस॒ ग्रावे॑व॒ सोता॑ मधु॒षुद्यमी॒ळे
shlokas.transliteration: āśṛṇvaté ǀ ádṛpitāya ǀ mánma ǀ nṛ-cákṣase ǀ su-mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ vedhaḥ ǀdevā́ya ǀ śastím ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ śaṃsa ǀ grā́vā-iva ǀ sótā ǀ madhu-sút ǀ yám ǀ īḷé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeat, oḥ priest, the praise, the prayer, to the attentive, the affableAgni, the beholder of man, the giver of felicity, the divine, the immortal; to him whom the effuser of the libation, like the (bruising) stone, adores aloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं चि॑न्न॒: शम्या॑ अग्ने अ॒स्या ऋ॒तस्य॑ बोध्यृतचित्स्वा॒धीः । क॒दा त॑ उ॒क्था स॑ध॒माद्या॑नि क॒दा भ॑वन्ति स॒ख्या गृ॒हे ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ śámyai ǀ agne ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ bodhi ǀ ṛta-cit ǀ su-ādhī́ḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ te ǀ ukthā́ ǀ sadha-mā́dyāni ǀ kadā́ ǀ bhavanti ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ gṛhé ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouAgni, preside over this our rite; do you who are cognizant of truth, and the author of good works, recognize this our adoration, whenever these exhilarating prayers (are addressed) to you whenever friendly relations with you are (established) in our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था ह॒ तद्वरु॑णाय॒ त्वम॑ग्ने क॒था दि॒वे ग॑र्हसे॒ कन्न॒ आग॑: । क॒था मि॒त्राय॑ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ पृथि॒व्यै ब्रव॒: कद॑र्य॒म्णे कद्भगा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ ha ǀ tát ǀ váruṇāya ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ kathā́ ǀ divé ǀ garhase ǀ kát ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀkathā́ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ brávaḥ ǀ kát ǀ aryamṇé ǀ kát ǀ bhágāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Why,Agni, do you reproach us (for our sin) toVaruṇa, why to the heaven? what is our offence? why repeat it to the bountifulMitra, to earth, toAryaman, or toBhaga?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कद्धिष्ण्या॑सु वृधसा॒नो अ॑ग्ने॒ कद्वाता॑य॒ प्रत॑वसे शुभं॒ये । परि॑ज्मने॒ नास॑त्याय॒ क्षे ब्रव॒: कद॑ग्ने रु॒द्राय॑ नृ॒घ्ने
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ dhíṣṇyāsu ǀ vṛdhasānáḥ ǀ agne ǀ kát ǀ vā́tāya ǀ prá-tavase ǀ śubham-yé ǀpári-jmane ǀ nā́satyāya ǀ kṣé ǀ brávaḥ ǀ kát ǀ agne ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ nṛ-ghné ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Why repeat it when exalted in holy ceremonies? why tell it to the mighty, benevolent, circumambient, truthful wind? why,Agni, to earth, why to man-destroyingRudra?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था म॒हे पु॑ष्टिम्भ॒राय॑ पू॒ष्णे कद्रु॒द्राय॒ सुम॑खाय हवि॒र्दे । कद्विष्ण॑व उरुगा॒याय॒ रेतो॒ ब्रव॒: कद॑ग्ने॒ शर॑वे बृह॒त्यै
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ mahé ǀ puṣṭim-bharā́ya ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ kát ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ sú-makhāya ǀ haviḥ-dé ǀkát ǀ víṣṇave ǀ uru-gāyā́ya ǀ rétaḥ ǀ brávaḥ ǀ kát ǀ agne ǀ śárave ǀ bṛhatyái ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Why to the great and nutriment-conveyingPūṣan? why toRudra, the object of worship, the giver of the oblation (to the gods)? why to the many-hymnedViṣṇu? why tell our sin to the extensive year?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था शर्धा॑य म॒रुता॑मृ॒ताय॑ क॒था सू॒रे बृ॑ह॒ते पृ॒च्छ्यमा॑नः । प्रति॑ ब्र॒वोऽदि॑तये तु॒राय॒ साधा॑ दि॒वो जा॑तवेदश्चिकि॒त्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ marútām ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ kathā́ ǀ sūré ǀ bṛhaté ǀ pṛcchyámānaḥ ǀpráti ǀ bravaḥ ǀ áditaye ǀ turā́ya ǀ sā́dha ǀ diváḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Why tell it to the veracious company of theMaruts? why, even when asked, to the mighty sun? why repeat it toAditi, or to the swift wind? fulfil, all-knowingJātavedas, (the worship) of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॑ ऋ॒तं निय॑तमीळ॒ आ गोरा॒मा सचा॒ मधु॑मत्प॒क्वम॑ग्ने । कृ॒ष्णा स॒ती रुश॑ता धा॒सिनै॒षा जाम॑र्येण॒ पय॑सा पीपाय
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ṛtám ǀ ní-yatam ǀ īḷe ǀ ā́ ǀ góḥ ǀ āmā́ ǀ sácā ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pakvám ǀ agne ǀkṛṣṇā́ ǀ satī́ ǀ rúśatā ǀ dhāsínā ǀ eṣā́ ǀ jā́maryeṇa ǀ páyasā ǀ pīpāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I solicit,Agni, the milk of the cow, essential for the sacrifice; yet immature, (she possesses) the sweet and ripe (fluid); black though she be, yet with her white nutritious milk she maintains mankind in existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॒ हि ष्मा॑ वृष॒भश्चि॑द॒क्तः पुमाँ॑ अ॒ग्निः पय॑सा पृ॒ष्ठ्ये॑न । अस्प॑न्दमानो अचरद्वयो॒धा वृषा॑ शु॒क्रं दु॑दुहे॒ पृश्नि॒रूध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ cit ǀ aktáḥ ǀ púmān ǀ agníḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ pṛṣṭhyéna ǀáspandamānaḥ ǀ acarat ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ śukrám ǀ duduhe ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThemaleAgni, the showerer (of benefits), has been sprinkled by the genitive ine sustaining milk; the giver of food proceeds unswerving (from his course), and the sun, the shedder of rain, has milked the white (fluid) of the udder (of the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेनाद्रिं॒ व्य॑सन्भि॒दन्त॒: समङ्गि॑रसो नवन्त॒ गोभि॑: । शु॒नं नर॒: परि॑ षदन्नु॒षास॑मा॒विः स्व॑रभवज्जा॒ते अ॒ग्नौ
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ádrim ǀ ví ǀ asan ǀ bhidántaḥ ǀ sám ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ navanta ǀ góbhiḥ ǀśunám ǀ náraḥ ǀ pári ǀ sadan ǀ uṣásam ǀ āvíḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ jāté ǀ agnáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the sacrifice, theAṅgirasas, rending the mountain asunder, have thrown it open, and returned with the cows; the leaders (of holy rites) have arrived happily at the dawn, and the sun was manifest asAgniwas engendered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॑ दे॒वीर॒मृता॒ अमृ॑क्ता॒ अर्णो॑भि॒रापो॒ मधु॑मद्भिरग्ने । वा॒जी न सर्गे॑षु प्रस्तुभा॒नः प्र सद॒मित्स्रवि॑तवे दधन्युः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ámṛktāḥ ǀ árṇaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mádhumat-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀvājī́ ǀ ná ǀ sárgeṣu ǀ pra-stubhānáḥ ǀ prá ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ srávitave ǀ dadhanyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By sacrifice,Agni, the divine rivers, immortal, unobstructed, continue perpetually to flow with sweet waters, like a horse that is being urged in his speed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा कस्य॑ य॒क्षं सद॒मिद्धु॒रो गा॒ मा वे॒शस्य॑ प्रमिन॒तो मापेः । मा भ्रातु॑रग्ने॒ अनृ॑जोॠ॒णं वे॒र्मा सख्यु॒र्दक्षं॑ रि॒पोर्भु॑जेम
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kásya ǀ yakṣám ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ huráḥ ǀ gāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ veśásya ǀ pra-minatáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ āpéḥ ǀmā́ ǀ bhrā́tuḥ ǀ agne ǀ ánṛjoḥ ǀ ṛṇám ǀ veḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ ripóḥ ǀ bhujema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go not ever,Agni, to the sacrifice of any one who injures us; nor to that of a malevolent neighbour, nor to that of an (unnatural) relation; accept not the due (oblation) from an insincere brother; let us not derive enjoyment from the enemy of a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रक्षा॑ णो अग्ने॒ तव॒ रक्ष॑णेभी रारक्षा॒णः सु॑मख प्रीणा॒नः । प्रति॑ ष्फुर॒ वि रु॑ज वी॒ड्वंहो॑ ज॒हि रक्षो॒ महि॑ चिद्वावृधा॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: rákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ rákṣaṇebhiḥ ǀ rarakṣāṇáḥ ǀ su-makha ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀpráti ǀ sphura ǀ ví ǀ ruja ǀ vīḷú ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ jahí ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ cit ǀ vavṛdhānám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, worthily worshipped, counservator, conciliated (by our offerings), protect us with your protections; enlighten us; entirely extirpate our sin; overcome the great and exultingrākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्भ॑व सु॒मना॑ अग्ने अ॒र्कैरि॒मान्त्स्पृ॑श॒ मन्म॑भिः शूर॒ वाजा॑न् । उ॒त ब्रह्मा॑ण्यङ्गिरो जुषस्व॒ सं ते॑ श॒स्तिर्दे॒ववा॑ता जरेत
shlokas.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ bhava ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ agne ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ imā́n ǀ spṛśa ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀ śūra ǀ vā́jān ǀutá ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ sám ǀ te ǀ śastíḥ ǀ devá-vātā ǀ jareta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitiated,Agni, by these hymns, accept, hero, these (sacrificial) viands (presented) with praises; be plural ased,Aṅgiras, by our prayers; may the adoration addressed to the gods exalt you. (TaittirīyaSamhitā 10.62.5)”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता विश्वा॑ वि॒दुषे॒ तुभ्यं॑ वेधो नी॒थान्य॑ग्ने नि॒ण्या वचां॑सि । नि॒वच॑ना क॒वये॒ काव्या॒न्यशं॑सिषं म॒तिभि॒र्विप्र॑ उ॒क्थैः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ vidúṣe ǀ túbhyam ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ nīthā́ni ǀ agne ǀ niṇyā́ ǀ vácāṃsi ǀni-vácanā ǀ kaváye ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ áśaṃsiṣam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, creator, to you who are wise, acquainted with the past, I address, oḥ sage, these soliciting mysterious words, (these) ever-to-be-recited poems, together with praises and prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒णु॒ष्व पाज॒: प्रसि॑तिं॒ न पृ॒थ्वीं या॒हि राजे॒वाम॑वाँ॒ इभे॑न । तृ॒ष्वीमनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं द्रूणा॒नोऽस्ता॑सि॒ विध्य॑ र॒क्षस॒स्तपि॑ष्ठैः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṇuṣvá ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ prá-sitim ǀ ná ǀ pṛthvī́m ǀ yāhí ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ áma-vān ǀ íbhena ǀtṛṣvī́m ǀ ánu ǀ prá-sitim ǀ drūṇānáḥ ǀ ástā ǀ asi ǀ vídhya ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ tápiṣṭhaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Put forth your strength,Agni, as a fowler spreads a capacious snare; proceed like a king attended by his followers on his elephant; you are the scatterer (of your foes); following the swift-moving host consume therākṣasaswith your fiercest flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ भ्र॒मास॑ आशु॒या प॑त॒न्त्यनु॑ स्पृश धृष॒ता शोशु॑चानः । तपूं॑ष्यग्ने जु॒ह्वा॑ पतं॒गानसं॑दितो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ विष्व॑गु॒ल्काः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ bhramā́saḥ ǀ āśu-yā́ ǀ patanti ǀ ánu ǀ spṛśa ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀtápūṃṣi ǀ agne ǀ juhvā́ ǀ pataṅgā́n ǀ ásam-ditaḥ ǀ ví ǀ sṛja ǀ víṣvak ǀ ulkā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your swift and errant flames descend (on everyside); fierce-shining with vigour consume (the foe); scatter,Agni, with the ladle (of oblation), scorching flames and sparks, and brands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॒ स्पशो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ तूर्णि॑तमो॒ भवा॑ पा॒युर्वि॒शो अ॒स्या अद॑ब्धः । यो नो॑ दू॒रे अ॒घशं॑सो॒ यो अन्त्यग्ने॒ माकि॑ष्टे॒ व्यथि॒रा द॑धर्षीत्
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ sṛja ǀ tū́rṇi-tamaḥ ǀ bháva ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ viśáḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dūré ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ánti ǀ ágne ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ te ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are most rapid, direct your (flames) against opposing (rays), and, unresisted, become the protector of this your people against the calumniator who is remote or who is nigh; let no malevolent (foe) prevail against us (who are) your worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑ग्ने तिष्ठ॒ प्रत्या त॑नुष्व॒ न्य१॒॑मित्राँ॑ ओषतात्तिग्महेते । यो नो॒ अरा॑तिं समिधान च॒क्रे नी॒चा तं ध॑क्ष्यत॒सं न शुष्क॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ agne ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ práti ǀ ā́ ǀ tanuṣva ǀ ní ǀ amítrān ǀ oṣatāt ǀ tigma-hete ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ árātim ǀ sam-idhāna ǀ cakré ǀ nīcā́ ǀ tám ǀ dhakṣi ǀ atasám ǀ ná ǀ śúṣkam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sharp-weaponedAgni, rise up; spread wide (your flames) against (therākṣasas); entirely consume the foes; blazing Agni, burn down him who acts as an enemy towards us like a piece of dry timber.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो भ॑व॒ प्रति॑ वि॒ध्याध्य॒स्मदा॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व॒ दैव्या॑न्यग्ने । अव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि यातु॒जूनां॑ जा॒मिमजा॑मिं॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ bhava ǀ práti ǀ vidhya ǀ ádhi ǀ asmát ǀ āvíḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ dáivyāni ǀ agne ǀáva ǀ sthirā́ ǀ tanuhi ǀ yātu-jū́nām ǀ jāmím ǀ ájāmim ǀ prá ǀ mṛṇīhi ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up,Agni, chastise those who overpower us; manifest your divine energies; slacken the strone (bow strings) of the malignant kings; destroy those (who are hostile), whether kindred or unallied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ते॑ जानाति सुम॒तिं य॑विष्ठ॒ य ईव॑ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णे गा॒तुमैर॑त् । विश्वा॑न्यस्मै सु॒दिना॑नि रा॒यो द्यु॒म्नान्य॒र्यो वि दुरो॑ अ॒भि द्यौ॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ te ǀ jānāti ǀ su-matím ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́vate ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ gātúm ǀ áirat ǀvíśvāni ǀ asmai ǀ su-dínāni ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He experiences your good favour, young (of the gods), who offers praise to you aBrahman, coming quickly (to bestow felicity); to him are all prosperous days and wealth (of cattle) and treasures; do you as the lord of sacrifice, shine upon his dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेद॑ग्ने अस्तु सु॒भग॑: सु॒दानु॒र्यस्त्वा॒ नित्ये॑न ह॒विषा॒ य उ॒क्थैः । पिप्री॑षति॒ स्व आयु॑षि दुरो॒णे विश्वेद॑स्मै सु॒दिना॒ सास॑दि॒ष्टिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ astu ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ nítyena ǀ havíṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀpíprīṣati ǀ své ǀ ā́yuṣi ǀ duroṇé ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ asmai ǀ su-dínā ǀ sā́ ǀ asat ǀ iṣṭíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the liberal man ever be prosperous who propitiate you with constant oblations and praises; may all the days in his arduous life be prosperous, and may this (his) sacrifice be (productive of reward).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्चा॑मि ते सुम॒तिं घोष्य॒र्वाक्सं ते॑ वा॒वाता॑ जरतामि॒यं गीः । स्वश्वा॑स्त्वा सु॒रथा॑ मर्जयेमा॒स्मे क्ष॒त्राणि॑ धारये॒रनु॒ द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: árcāmi ǀ te ǀ su-matím ǀ ghóṣi ǀ arvā́k ǀ sám ǀ te ǀ vavā́tā ǀ jaratām ǀ iyám ǀ gī́ḥ ǀsu-áśvāḥ ǀ tvā ǀ su-ráthāḥ ǀ marjayema ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṣatrā́ṇi ǀ dhārayeḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I reverence your good favour,Agni; may this reiterated and resounding hymn convey due praise to your presence; may we be possessed of good horses and good cars, that we may pay you homage; and do you daily bestow upon us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्वा॒ भूर्या च॑रे॒दुप॒ त्मन्दोषा॑वस्तर्दीदि॒वांस॒मनु॒ द्यून् । क्रीळ॑न्तस्त्वा सु॒मन॑सः सपेमा॒भि द्यु॒म्ना त॑स्थि॒वांसो॒ जना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tvā ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ā́ ǀ caret ǀ úpa ǀ tmán ǀ dóṣā-vastaḥ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀkrī́ḷantaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ sapema ǀ abhí ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ jánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May every one of his own accord diligently worship you, shining in the (hall) morning and evening, every day; thus, sporting in our dwellings, (enjoying) the wealth (of hostile) man, may we with happy hearts worship you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वा॒ स्वश्व॑: सुहिर॒ण्यो अ॑ग्न उप॒याति॒ वसु॑मता॒ रथे॑न । तस्य॑ त्रा॒ता भ॑वसि॒ तस्य॒ सखा॒ यस्त॑ आति॒थ्यमा॑नु॒षग्जुजो॑षत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ su-hiraṇyáḥ ǀ agne ǀ upa-yā́ti ǀ vásu-matā ǀ ráthena ǀtásya ǀ trātā́ ǀ bhavasi ǀ tásya ǀ sákhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ātithyám ǀ ānuṣák ǀ jújoṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouAgni, are the protector of him who, possessed of good horses and a golden car, approaches you with a chariot laden with wealth; you are the friend of him who gratifies you be the due performance of hospitality to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो रु॑जामि ब॒न्धुता॒ वचो॑भि॒स्तन्मा॑ पि॒तुर्गोत॑मा॒दन्वि॑याय । त्वं नो॑ अ॒स्य वच॑सश्चिकिद्धि॒ होत॑र्यविष्ठ सुक्रतो॒ दमू॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ rujāmi ǀ bandhútā ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ tát ǀ mā ǀ pitúḥ ǀ gótamāt ǀ ánu ǀ iyāya ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ cikiddhi ǀ hótaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ dámūnāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoker (of the gods), young (of the deities) possessed of excellent wisdom, through the alliance (with you produced) by holy texts, which came to me from my fatherGotama, I demolish the powerful (demons); do you who are the humbler (of foes), be cognizant of our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्व॑प्नजस्त॒रण॑यः सु॒शेवा॒ अत॑न्द्रासोऽवृ॒का अश्र॑मिष्ठाः । ते पा॒यव॑: स॒ध्र्य॑ञ्चो नि॒षद्याग्ने॒ तव॑ नः पान्त्वमूर
shlokas.transliteration: ásvapna-jaḥ ǀ taráṇayaḥ ǀ su-śévāḥ ǀ átandrāsaḥ ǀ avṛkā́ḥ ǀ áśramiṣṭhāḥ ǀté ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ sadhryáñcaḥ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ naḥ ǀ pāntu ǀ amūra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-wiseAgni, may your protecting (rays), unslumbering alert, propitious, unslothful, benignant, unwearied, co-operating, having taken their plural ce (at this sacrifice), preserve us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये पा॒यवो॑ मामते॒यं ते॑ अग्ने॒ पश्य॑न्तो अ॒न्धं दु॑रि॒तादर॑क्षन् । र॒रक्ष॒ तान्त्सु॒कृतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒ दिप्स॑न्त॒ इद्रि॒पवो॒ नाह॑ देभुः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ māmateyám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ andhám ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ árakṣan ǀrarákṣa ǀ tā́n ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀ dípsantaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áha ǀ debhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those your protecting (rays),Agni, which, beholding (what had chanced), preserved the blind son ofMamatāfrom misfortune; he, knowing all things, cherished those benevolent (rays), and his enemies, intending to destroy him, wrought him no harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ व॒यं स॑ध॒न्य१॒॑स्त्वोता॒स्तव॒ प्रणी॑त्यश्याम॒ वाजा॑न् । उ॒भा शंसा॑ सूदय सत्यतातेऽनुष्ठु॒या कृ॑णुह्यह्रयाण
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ sa-dhanyáḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ táva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ aśyāma ǀ vā́jān ǀubhā́ ǀ śáṃsā ǀ sūdaya ǀ satya-tāte ǀ anuṣṭhuyā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ ahrayāṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are freed from shame, by you we are made opulent; by you we are protected; may we, through your guidance, attain abundant food; cherisher of truth, destroy both (sorts of calumniators), those who are nigh, those who are far off, and in due course fulfil (our desires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या ते॑ अग्ने स॒मिधा॑ विधेम॒ प्रति॒ स्तोमं॑ श॒स्यमा॑नं गृभाय । दहा॒शसो॑ र॒क्षस॑: पा॒ह्य१॒॑स्मान्द्रु॒हो नि॒दो मि॑त्रमहो अव॒द्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ vidhema ǀ práti ǀ stómam ǀ śasyámānam ǀ gṛbhāya ǀdáha ǀ aśásaḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ asmā́n ǀ druháḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ avadyā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we propitiate you,Agni, by this fuel; accept the praise that is recited by us; consume the unadoringrākṣasas; you are to be honoured by (your) friends, preserve us from the reproach of the oppressor and the reviler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॑ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ स॒जोषा॑: क॒था दा॑शेमा॒ग्नये॑ बृ॒हद्भाः । अनू॑नेन बृह॒ता व॒क्षथे॒नोप॑ स्तभायदुप॒मिन्न रोध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ kathā́ ǀ dāśema ǀ agnáye ǀ bṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀánūnena ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ vakṣáthena ǀ úpa ǀ stabhāyat ǀ upa-mít ǀ ná ǀ ródhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How may we present rejoicing (fit offering) toAgnithe showerer (of benefits); toVaiśvānara, he, who, bright with great lustre, sustains the heaven, with his entire vast and insupportable (bulk), as a pillar (sustains a roof).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नि॑न्दत॒ य इ॒मां मह्यं॑ रा॒तिं दे॒वो द॒दौ मर्त्या॑य स्व॒धावा॑न् । पाका॑य॒ गृत्सो॑ अ॒मृतो॒ विचे॑ता वैश्वान॒रो नृत॑मो य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ nindata ǀ yáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ máhyam ǀ rātím ǀ deváḥ ǀ dadáu ǀ mártyāya ǀ svadhā́-vān ǀpā́kāya ǀ gṛ́tsaḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reproach not the divine (Agni), who, accepting the oblation, has given this wealth to me, his mortal (worshipper) of mature (intellect); Agni, who is wise, immortal, discriminating, (who is)Vaiśvānara, chief conductor (of rites), the mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: साम॑ द्वि॒बर्हा॒ महि॑ ति॒ग्मभृ॑ष्टिः स॒हस्र॑रेता वृष॒भस्तुवि॑ष्मान् । प॒दं न गोरप॑गूळ्हं विवि॒द्वान॒ग्निर्मह्यं॒ प्रेदु॑ वोचन्मनी॒षाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ma ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ máhi ǀ tigmá-bhṛṣṭiḥ ǀ sahásra-retāḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀpadám ǀ ná ǀ góḥ ǀ ápa-gūḷham ǀ vividvā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ máhyam ǀ prá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vocat ǀ manīṣā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, filling both (the middling and most excellent condition), bright shining, of manifold vigour, the showerer of (benefits), the possessor of affluence, (who comprehends), by (his) wisdom the mysterious sacred hymn, as (they track) the footsteps of a (missing) cow, reveal (the sense) to me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ताँ अ॒ग्निर्ब॑भसत्ति॒ग्मज॑म्भ॒स्तपि॑ष्ठेन शो॒चिषा॒ यः सु॒राधा॑: । प्र ये मि॒नन्ति॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाम॑ प्रि॒या मि॒त्रस्य॒ चेत॑तो ध्रु॒वाणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ babhasat ǀ tigmá-jambhaḥ ǀ tápiṣṭhena ǀ śocíṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ minánti ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ priyā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ cétataḥ ǀ dhruvā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sharp-toothedAgni, possessed of excellent wealth, consume with his fierce radiance those (adversaries) who injure the firm and valued glories of the sapientVaruṇaandMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्रा॒तरो॒ न योष॑णो॒ व्यन्त॑: पति॒रिपो॒ न जन॑यो दु॒रेवा॑: । पा॒पास॒: सन्तो॑ अनृ॒ता अ॑स॒त्या इ॒दं प॒दम॑जनता गभी॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhrātáraḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ vyántaḥ ǀ pati-rípaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ duḥ-évāḥ ǀpāpā́saḥ ǀ sántaḥ ǀ anṛtā́ḥ ǀ asatyā́ḥ ǀ idám ǀ padám ǀ ajanata ǀ gabhīrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like women who have no brethren, going (about from their own to their father's house), women adverse to their lords going astray, so the wicked, false (in thought), false (in speech), they give birth to this deep abyss (of hell).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं मे॑ अग्ने॒ किय॑ते पाव॒कामि॑नते गु॒रुं भा॒रं न मन्म॑ । बृ॒हद्द॑धाथ धृष॒ता ग॑भी॒रं य॒ह्वं पृ॒ष्ठं प्रय॑सा स॒प्तधा॑तु
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ me ǀ agne ǀ kíyate ǀ pāvaka ǀ áminate ǀ gurúm ǀ bhārám ǀ ná ǀ mánma ǀbṛhát ǀ dadhātha ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ gabhīrám ǀ yahvám ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ práyasā ǀ saptá-dhātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purifier,Agni, bestow on me, not neglecting your worship, this acceptable and vast (wealth), like a heavy load on a feeble (bearer), together with invigorating food; (wealth), secure, abundant, tangible, and consisting of the seven elements.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिन्न्वे॒३॒॑व स॑म॒ना स॑मा॒नम॒भि क्रत्वा॑ पुन॒ती धी॒तिर॑श्याः । स॒सस्य॒ चर्म॒न्नधि॒ चारु॒ पृश्ने॒रग्रे॑ रु॒प आरु॑पितं॒ जबा॑रु
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ evá ǀ samanā́ ǀ samānám ǀ abhí ǀ krátvā ǀ punatī́ ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ aśyāḥ ǀsasásya ǀ cárman ǀ ádhi ǀ cā́ru ǀ pṛ́śneḥ ǀ ágne ǀ rupáḥ ǀ árupitam ǀ jábāru ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our (self) purifying praise, suited to his glory, and accompanied by worship, quickly attain to that omniform (Vaiśvānara) whose swift-ascending brilliant (orb) is stationed on the east of the earth, to mount, like the sun, above this immoveable heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वाच्यं॒ वच॑स॒: किं मे॑ अ॒स्य गुहा॑ हि॒तमुप॑ नि॒णिग्व॑दन्ति । यदु॒स्रिया॑णा॒मप॒ वारि॑व॒ व्रन्पाति॑ प्रि॒यं रु॒पो अग्रं॑ प॒दं वेः
shlokas.transliteration: pra-vā́cyam ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ kím ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ úpa ǀ niṇík ǀ vadanti ǀyát ǀ usríyāṇām ǀ ápa ǀ vā́ḥ-iva ǀ vrán ǀ pā́ti ǀ priyám ǀ rupáḥ ǀ ágram ǀ padám ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What objection (can be offered) to this my assertion, that they affirm that the milk of the kine, which (the milkers) obtain like water, is plural ced in concealment (byVaiśvānara), and cherishes the excellent and valued expanse of the wide earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दमु॒ त्यन्महि॑ म॒हामनी॑कं॒ यदु॒स्रिया॒ सच॑त पू॒र्व्यं गौः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒दे अधि॒ दीद्या॑नं॒ गुहा॑ रघु॒ष्यद्र॑घु॒यद्वि॑वेद
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ máhi ǀ mahā́m ǀ ánīkam ǀ yát ǀ usríyā ǀ sácata ǀ pūrvyám ǀ gáuḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ padé ǀ ádhi ǀ dī́dyānam ǀ gúhā ǀ raghu-syát ǀ raghu-yát ǀ viveda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I recognize this adorable assemblage of the great (deities), which from of old the milk-shedding cow affects, shining above the region of water, (the firmament), in secret; swift gliding, swift moving.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ द्युता॒नः पि॒त्रोः सचा॒साम॑नुत॒ गुह्यं॒ चारु॒ पृश्ने॑: । मा॒तुष्प॒दे प॑र॒मे अन्ति॒ षद्गोर्वृष्ण॑: शो॒चिष॒: प्रय॑तस्य जि॒ह्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ dyutānáḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ sácā ǀ āsā́ ǀ ámanuta ǀ gúhyam ǀ cā́ru ǀ pṛ́śneḥ ǀmātúḥ ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ ánti ǀ sát ǀ góḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ śocíṣaḥ ǀ prá-yatasya ǀ jihvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then, radiant in association with the parents, (heaven and earth), he is awakened (to drink) the agreeable secretion of the cow, and the tongue of the assiduous (performer of holy rites), the resplendent showerer (of benefits), approaching the excellent station of the maternal (cow), seeks to drink the milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं वो॑चे॒ नम॑सा पृ॒च्छ्यमा॑न॒स्तवा॒शसा॑ जातवेदो॒ यदी॒दम् । त्वम॒स्य क्ष॑यसि॒ यद्ध॒ विश्वं॑ दि॒वि यदु॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ यत्पृ॑थि॒व्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ voce ǀ námasā ǀ pṛcchyámānaḥ ǀ táva ǀ ā-śásā ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ yádi ǀ idám ǀtvám ǀ asyá ǀ kṣayasi ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ víśvam ǀ diví ǀ yát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dráviṇam ǀ yát ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Interrogated with respect, I declare the truth, that this (wealth is acquired),Jātavedas, by the praise of you; you rule over it, (over) all that (it may be), the wealth that is in heaven or on earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किं नो॑ अ॒स्य द्रवि॑णं॒ कद्ध॒ रत्नं॒ वि नो॑ वोचो जातवेदश्चिकि॒त्वान् । गुहाध्व॑नः पर॒मं यन्नो॑ अ॒स्य रेकु॑ प॒दं न नि॑दा॒ना अग॑न्म
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ dráviṇam ǀ kát ǀ ha ǀ rátnam ǀ ví ǀ naḥ ǀ vocaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀgúhā ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ paramám ǀ yát ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ réku ǀ padám ǀ ná ǀ nidānā́ḥ ǀ áganma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What is the value of this (wealth) to us? what is its advantage? inform us,Jātavedas, for you know; (tell us) what is the best (course) for us on this secret path, so that we may follow unreproached the direct road.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का म॒र्यादा॑ व॒युना॒ कद्ध॑ वा॒ममच्छा॑ गमेम र॒घवो॒ न वाज॑म् । क॒दा नो॑ दे॒वीर॒मृत॑स्य॒ पत्नी॒: सूरो॒ वर्णे॑न ततनन्नु॒षास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ maryā́dā ǀ vayúnā ǀ kát ǀ ha ǀ vāmám ǀ áccha ǀ gamema ǀ raghávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jam ǀkadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ várṇena ǀ tatanan ǀ uṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wha tis the limit, what are the objects, which is the desirable (end) to which we rush like swift (chargers) to the battle? when for us will the divine dawns, the brides of the immortal (sun), overspread (the world) with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒नि॒रेण॒ वच॑सा फ॒ल्ग्वे॑न प्र॒तीत्ये॑न कृ॒धुना॑तृ॒पास॑: । अधा॒ ते अ॑ग्ने॒ किमि॒हा व॑दन्त्यनायु॒धास॒ आस॑ता सचन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: aniréṇa ǀ vácasā ǀ phalgvéna ǀ pratī́tyena ǀ kṛdhúnā ǀ atṛpā́saḥ ǀádha ǀ té ǀ agne ǀ kím ǀ ihá ǀ vadanti ǀ anāyudhā́saḥ ǀ ásatā ǀ sacantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Men are) not satisfied by unproductive, frivolous, inconclusive, scanty speech; then what,Agni, do they here say to you? devoid of the implements (of worship), let them suffer from distress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य श्रि॒ये स॑मिधा॒नस्य॒ वृष्णो॒ वसो॒रनी॑कं॒ दम॒ आ रु॑रोच । रुश॒द्वसा॑नः सु॒दृशी॑करूपः क्षि॒तिर्न रा॒या पु॑रु॒वारो॑ अद्यौत्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śriyé ǀ sam-idhānásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ vásoḥ ǀ ánīkam ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ ruroca ǀrúśat ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ sudṛ́śīka-rūpaḥ ǀ kṣitíḥ ǀ ná ǀ rāyā́ ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ adyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For the prosperity of this (instrumental tutor of the rite), the host (of the flames) of the kindled (Agni), the showerer (of benefits), the giver of dwellings, has blazed in the hall (of sacrifice); clothed in radiance, beautiful in semblance, and glorified by many, he shines like a man with opulence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ षु णो॑ अध्वरस्य होत॒रग्ने॒ तिष्ठ॑ दे॒वता॑ता॒ यजी॑यान् । त्वं हि विश्व॑म॒भ्यसि॒ मन्म॒ प्र वे॒धस॑श्चित्तिरसि मनी॒षाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarasya ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ tíṣṭha ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yájīyān ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ víśvam ǀ abhí ǀ ási ǀ mánma ǀ prá ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ cit ǀ tirasi ǀ manīṣā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, ministrant of the sacrifice, do you who are entitled to worship, be above usin this offering to the gods; for you prevail over all that is desirable; you inspire the praise of the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमू॑रो॒ होता॒ न्य॑सादि वि॒क्ष्व१॒॑ग्निर्म॒न्द्रो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ प्रचे॑ताः । ऊ॒र्ध्वं भा॒नुं स॑वि॒तेवा॑श्रे॒न्मेते॑व धू॒मं स्त॑भाय॒दुप॒ द्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: ámūraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ asādi ǀ vikṣú ǀ agníḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ savitā́-iva ǀ aśret ǀ métā-iva ǀ dhūmám ǀ stabhāyat ǀ úpa ǀ dyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The unperplexed, the sagacious, exhilaratingAgni, the ministrant priest, has been plural ced among men for (the celebration of) sacrifices; like the sun, he spreads light above, and props the smoke above the sky like a pillar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ता सु॑जू॒र्णी रा॒तिनी॑ घृ॒ताची॑ प्रदक्षि॒णिद्दे॒वता॑तिमुरा॒णः । उदु॒ स्वरु॑र्नव॒जा नाक्रः प॒श्वो अ॑नक्ति॒ सुधि॑तः सु॒मेक॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yatā́ ǀ su-jūrṇíḥ ǀ rātínī ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ devá-tātim ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀút ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sváruḥ ǀ nava-jā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ akráḥ ǀ paśváḥ ǀ anakti ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ su-mékaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ladle filled (with butter) is prepared; prompt (in act), opulent (with the oblation), the multiplying (priest), conducting (the worship) of the gods, circumambulates (the fire); the newly-trimmedpostis set up, the impending shining axe falls upon the victims.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्ती॒र्णे ब॒र्हिषि॑ समिधा॒ने अ॒ग्ना ऊ॒र्ध्वो अ॑ध्व॒र्युर्जु॑जुषा॒णो अ॑स्थात् । पर्य॒ग्निः प॑शु॒पा न होता॑ त्रिवि॒ष्ट्ये॑ति प्र॒दिव॑ उरा॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: stīrṇé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sam-idhāné ǀ agnáu ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ asthāt ǀpári ǀ agníḥ ǀ paśu-pā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀ tri-viṣṭí ǀ eti ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ urāṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sacred grass is strewn and the fire is kindled, theAdhvaryurises, propitiating (the gods), andAgni, the offerer of the oblation, ancient and multiplying (the offering), thrice circumambulates (the victim) like a keeper of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ त्मना॑ मि॒तद्रु॑रेति॒ होता॒ग्निर्म॒न्द्रो मधु॑वचा ऋ॒तावा॑ । द्रव॑न्त्यस्य वा॒जिनो॒ न शोका॒ भय॑न्ते॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒ यदभ्रा॑ट्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ tmánā ǀ mitá-druḥ ǀ eti ǀ hótā ǀ agníḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ mádhu-vacāḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀdrávanti ǀ asya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śókāḥ ǀ bháyante ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ yát ǀ ábhrāṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the sacrificer, the exhilarator, the sweet-spoken, the object of sacrifice, moving measuredly, circumambulates (the victim) of his own (accord); the bright (rays) of him (fed) with (sacrificial) food, spread around; all the regions are alarmed when he blazes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा ते॑ अग्ने स्वनीक सं॒दृग्घो॒रस्य॑ स॒तो विषु॑णस्य॒ चारु॑: । न यत्ते॑ शो॒चिस्तम॑सा॒ वर॑न्त॒ न ध्व॒स्मान॑स्त॒न्वी॒३॒॑ रेप॒ आ धु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ su-anīka ǀ sam-dṛ́k ǀ ghorásya ǀ satáḥ ǀ víṣuṇasya ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀná ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ śocíḥ ǀ támasā ǀ váranta ǀ ná ǀ dhvasmā́naḥ ǀ tanví ǀ répaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright-shining,Agni, beautiful and auspicious is the semblance of you who are terrible and wide-spreading, for (the nights) hide not your splendour with darkness, nor do the malignant (spirits) inflict any injury on your person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यस्य॒ सातु॒र्जनि॑तो॒रवा॑रि॒ न मा॒तरा॑पि॒तरा॒ नू चि॑दि॒ष्टौ । अधा॑ मि॒त्रो न सुधि॑तः पाव॒को॒३॒॑ऽग्निर्दी॑दाय॒ मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ sā́tuḥ ǀ jánitoḥ ǀ ávāri ǀ ná ǀ mātárāpitárā ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ iṣṭáu ǀádha ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ dīdāya ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom, progenitor (of mankind), the benevolence is never checked; whose parents need not urge him to exertion; so that the well-satisfied, purifyingAgnishines like a friend among men, the descendants ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च॒ जीज॑नन्त्सं॒वसा॑ना॒: स्वसा॑रो अ॒ग्निं मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु । उ॒ष॒र्बुध॑मथ॒र्यो॒३॒॑ न दन्तं॑ शु॒क्रं स्वासं॑ पर॒शुं न ति॒ग्मम्
shlokas.transliteration: dvíḥ ǀ yám ǀ páñca ǀ jī́janan ǀ sam-vásānāḥ ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ agním ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀuṣaḥ-búdham ǀ atharyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dántam ǀ śukrám ǀ su-ā́sam ǀ paraśúm ǀ ná ǀ tigmám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, whom the twice five sisters dwelling among men, the descendants ofManu, have engendered, like feminine les, (awaking) him at dawn, feeding on oblations, brilliant of goodly aspect, and shharp as an axe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये अ॑ग्ने ह॒रितो॑ घृत॒स्ना रोहि॑तास ऋ॒ज्वञ्च॒: स्वञ्च॑: । अ॒रु॒षासो॒ वृष॑ण ऋजुमु॒ष्का आ दे॒वता॑तिमह्वन्त द॒स्माः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ agne ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ghṛta-snā́ḥ ǀ róhitāsaḥ ǀ ṛju-áñcaḥ ǀ su-áñcaḥ ǀaruṣā́saḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ ṛju-muṣkā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ devá-tātim ǀ ahvanta ǀ dasmā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your horses,Agni, breathing foam, red-coloured, straight-going well-plural ced, bright-shining, vigorous, well-membered, and of graceful form, are summoned to the worthy of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ह॒ त्ये ते॒ सह॑माना अ॒यास॑स्त्वे॒षासो॑ अग्ने अ॒र्चय॒श्चर॑न्ति । श्ये॒नासो॒ न दु॑वस॒नासो॒ अर्थं॑ तुविष्व॒णसो॒ मारु॑तं॒ न शर्ध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ha ǀ tyé ǀ te ǀ sáhamānāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀ tveṣā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀśyenā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ duvasanā́saḥ ǀ ártham ǀ tuvi-svanásaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ ná ǀ śárdhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those, your rays,Agni, triumphant, wide-spreading, radiant, adorable, go like hawk-faced horses (to their  goal), loud-sounding like the company of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अका॑रि॒ ब्रह्म॑ समिधान॒ तुभ्यं॒ शंसा॑त्यु॒क्थं यज॑ते॒ व्यू॑ धाः । होता॑रम॒ग्निं मनु॑षो॒ नि षे॑दुर्नम॒स्यन्त॑ उ॒शिज॒: शंस॑मा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: ákāri ǀ bráhma ǀ sam-idhāna ǀ túbhyam ǀ śáṃsāti ǀ ukthám ǀ yájate ǀ ví ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dhāḥ ǀhótāram ǀ agním ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ seduḥ ǀ namasyántaḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-kindledAgni, for you the prayer has been composed; may (the priest) propitiate (you) by (his) praise; the (sacrificer) offers worship; bestow upon us manifold (wealth); desiring (riches), men sit down adoring Agni, the invoker of the gods, the glorifier of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्य॑: । यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॑ वि॒शेवि॑शे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ihá ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ dhātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀyám ǀ ápnavānaḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ vi-rurucúḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ citrám ǀ vi-bhvám ǀ viśé-viśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This invoker of the gods and minister of frequent worship, who is to be glorified at sacrifices, has been plural ced first (of the gods) by the performers of the rite; theAgniwhom Apnavāna and otherBhṛguslighted in the woods for the sake of all men, marvellous (in his acts), and soverign (over all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ क॒दा त॑ आनु॒षग्भुव॑द्दे॒वस्य॒ चेत॑नम् । अधा॒ हि त्वा॑ जगृभ्रि॒रे मर्ता॑सो वि॒क्ष्वीड्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ kadā́ ǀ te ǀ ānuṣák ǀ bhúvat ǀ devásya ǀ cétanam ǀádha ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ jagṛbhriré ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ ī́ḍyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Agni, is the light of you, bright-shining, to be manifested; for therefore have mortals accepted you as to be worshipped among mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑नं॒ विचे॑तसं॒ पश्य॑न्तो॒ द्यामि॑व॒ स्तृभि॑: । विश्वे॑षामध्व॒राणां॑ हस्क॒र्तारं॒ दमे॑दमे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānam ǀ ví-cetasam ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀvíśveṣām ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ haskartā́ram ǀ dáme-dame ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Contemplating you in every dwelling, truthful intelligent, (brilliant with sparks) like the sky with stars, the perfecter of all sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒शुं दू॒तं वि॒वस्व॑तो॒ विश्वा॒ यश्च॑र्ष॒णीर॒भि । आ ज॑भ्रुः के॒तुमा॒यवो॒ भृग॑वाणं वि॒शेवि॑शे
shlokas.transliteration: āśúm ǀ dūtám ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀā́ ǀ jabhruḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavāṇam ǀ viśé-viśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have brought, for the sake of all people, the swift messenger of the worshipper (to the gods), who (rules) over all mankind, the manifester, the resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमीं॒ होता॑रमानु॒षक्चि॑कि॒त्वांसं॒ नि षे॑दिरे । र॒ण्वं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषं॒ यजि॑ष्ठं स॒प्त धाम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ hótāram ǀ ānuṣák ǀ cikitvā́ṃsam ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǀraṇvám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ saptá ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They (the worshippers) have seated him in his due order, the invoker (of the gods), the intelligent, the agreeable, the purifyingly-radiant, the performer of frequent sacrifice, (brilliant) with seven flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं शश्व॑तीषु मा॒तृषु॒ वन॒ आ वी॒तमश्रि॑तम् । चि॒त्रं सन्तं॒ गुहा॑ हि॒तं सु॒वेदं॑ कूचिद॒र्थिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ śáśvatīṣu ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ vītám ǀ áśritam ǀcitrám ǀ sántam ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ su-védam ǀ kūcit-arthínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him, abiding in the maternal (waters) and in the woods, loved, yet unapproached, wonderful, hidden in a cave, endowed with knowledge, seeking (oblations) from any quarter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒सस्य॒ यद्वियु॑ता॒ सस्मि॒न्नूध॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ धाम॑न्र॒णय॑न्त दे॒वाः । म॒हाँ अ॒ग्निर्नम॑सा रा॒तह॑व्यो॒ वेर॑ध्व॒राय॒ सद॒मिदृ॒तावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sasásya ǀ yát ǀ ví-yutā ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́man ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ véḥ ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom, when they desist from slumber, the devout propitiate in the abode of water at every sacrifice; the mightyAgni, to whom oblations are to be offered with reverence, who truthful always, accepts the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेर॑ध्व॒रस्य॑ दू॒त्या॑नि वि॒द्वानु॒भे अ॒न्ता रोद॑सी संचिकि॒त्वान् । दू॒त ई॑यसे प्र॒दिव॑ उरा॒णो वि॒दुष्ट॑रो दि॒व आ॒रोध॑नानि
shlokas.transliteration: véḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ dūtyā́ni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ubhé íti ǀ antáríti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ sam-cikitvā́n ǀdūtáḥ ǀ īyase ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā-ródhanāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who are all-knowing understand the functions of a messenger (of the gods) at the sacrifice; well informed of both heaven and earth and the intermediate (firmament), and a most intelligent, ancient, and amplifying envoy, you go up the ascents of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णं त॒ एम॒ रुश॑तः पु॒रो भाश्च॑रि॒ष्ण्व१॒॑र्चिर्वपु॑षा॒मिदेक॑म् । यदप्र॑वीता॒ दध॑ते ह॒ गर्भं॑ स॒द्यश्चि॑ज्जा॒तो भव॒सीदु॑ दू॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇám ǀ te ǀ éma ǀ rúśataḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ cariṣṇú ǀ arcíḥ ǀ vápuṣām ǀ ít ǀ ékam ǀyát ǀ ápra-vītā ǀ dádhate ǀ ha ǀ gárbham ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ jātáḥ ǀ bhávasi ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dūtáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dark is the path of you wo are bright; the light is before you; your moving radiance is the chief of (all luminous) bodies; when the present (worshippers) take up the germ (in the sticks of attrition) you are speedily genitive rated, and become indeed the messenger (of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यो जा॒तस्य॒ ददृ॑शान॒मोजो॒ यद॑स्य॒ वातो॑ अनु॒वाति॑ शो॒चिः । वृ॒णक्ति॑ ति॒ग्माम॑त॒सेषु॑ जि॒ह्वां स्थि॒रा चि॒दन्ना॑ दयते॒ वि जम्भै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ jātásya ǀ dádṛśānam ǀ ójaḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ anu-vā́ti ǀ śocíḥ ǀvṛṇákti ǀ tigmā́m ǀ ataséṣu ǀ jihvā́m ǀ sthirā́ ǀ cit ǀ ánnā ǀ dayate ǀ ví ǀ jámbhaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The light of the speedily-genitive rated is visible, and when the win fans the flame, he (Agni) spreads his blazing tongue among the trees, and with his (glowing) teeth consumes the standing (fuel, his) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तृ॒षु यदन्ना॑ तृ॒षुणा॑ व॒वक्ष॑ तृ॒षुं दू॒तं कृ॑णुते य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निः । वात॑स्य मे॒ळिं स॑चते नि॒जूर्व॑न्ना॒शुं न वा॑जयते हि॒न्वे अर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tṛṣú ǀ yát ǀ ánnā ǀ tṛṣúṇā ǀ vavákṣa ǀ tṛṣúm ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀvā́tasya ǀ meḷím ǀ sacate ǀ ni-jū́rvan ǀ āśúm ǀ ná ǀ vājayate ǀ hinvé ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When quickly, with rapid (radiance), he has carried off his food, the mightyAgnimakes (himself) the fleet messenger (of the worshipper); consuming (the fuel), he allies himself with the force of the wind, and as (a horseman) urges his fast steed, so the rapid going Agni, invigorates and urges (his flames).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒तं वो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दसं हव्य॒वाह॒मम॑र्त्यम् । यजि॑ष्ठमृञ्जसे गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: dūtám ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśvá-vedasam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ ámartyam ǀyájiṣṭham ǀ ṛñjase ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I propitiate you with praise, the messenger (of the gods), the omniscient, the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the chief sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि वेदा॒ वसु॑धितिं म॒हाँ आ॒रोध॑नं दि॒वः । स दे॒वाँ एह व॑क्षति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ véda ǀ vásu-dhitim ǀ mahā́n ǀ ā-ródhanam ǀ diváḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vakṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty one knows how to bestow the (desired) wealth (upon the worshipper); he knows the ascents of heaven; may he bring the gods hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वे॑द दे॒व आ॒नमं॑ दे॒वाँ ऋ॑ताय॒ते दमे॑ । दाति॑ प्रि॒याणि॑ चि॒द्वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā-námam ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛta-yaté ǀ dáme ǀdā́ti ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ cit ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the divine (Agni), knows how the gods are to be reverenced; to the sincere (worshipper) in his dwelling he gives wealth that is desired.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स होता॒ सेदु॑ दू॒त्यं॑ चिकि॒त्वाँ अ॒न्तरी॑यते । वि॒द्वाँ आ॒रोध॑नं दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dūtyám ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ antáḥ ǀ īyate ǀvidvā́n ǀ ā-ródhanam ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the invoker (of the gods), comprehending the deity of (their) messenger; and, knowing the ascent of the sky, he travels between earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते स्या॑म॒ ये अ॒ग्नये॑ ददा॒शुर्ह॒व्यदा॑तिभिः । य ईं॒ पुष्य॑न्त इन्ध॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ syāma ǀ yé ǀ agnáye ǀ dadāśúḥ ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǀyé ǀ īm ǀ púṣyantaḥ ǀ indhaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be they who propitiateAgniwith gifts of oblations, and who, cherishing him, feed him with fuel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते रा॒या ते सु॒वीर्यै॑: सस॒वांसो॒ वि शृ॑ण्विरे । ये अ॒ग्ना द॑धि॒रे दुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ rāyā́ ǀ té ǀ su-vī́ryaiḥ ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ śṛṇvire ǀyé ǀ agnā́ ǀ dadhiré ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are renowned for riches and for progeny, who, veneratingAgni, offer him oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे रायो॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ सं च॑रन्तु पुरु॒स्पृह॑: । अ॒स्मे वाजा॑स ईरताम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ sám ǀ carantu ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ vā́jāsaḥ ǀ īratām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many riches, envied by many, devolve upon us day by day, and (abundant) food await us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स विप्र॑श्चर्षणी॒नां शव॑सा॒ मानु॑षाणाम् । अति॑ क्षि॒प्रेव॑ विध्यति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ śávasā ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀáti ǀ kṣiprā́-iva ǀ vidhyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wiseAgnientirely obviate, by his powe,r the removable (ills) of men the descendants ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ मृ॒ळ म॒हाँ अ॑सि॒ य ई॒मा दे॑व॒युं जन॑म् । इ॒येथ॑ ब॒र्हिरा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ mṛḷá ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ ā́ ǀ deva-yúm ǀ jánam ǀiyétha ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, make us happy, for you are mighty, (you) who come to this devout man to sit down on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मानु॑षीषु दू॒ळभो॑ वि॒क्षु प्रा॒वीरम॑र्त्यः । दू॒तो विश्वे॑षां भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ duḥ-dábhaḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ pra-avī́ḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀdūtáḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgni, who is difficult to overcome, who is immortal, who is pre-eminent among men the descendants ofManu, becomes the messenger of all the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सद्म॒ परि॑ णीयते॒ होता॑ म॒न्द्रो दिवि॑ष्टिषु । उ॒त पोता॒ नि षी॑दति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sádma ǀ pári ǀ nīyate ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀutá ǀ pótā ǀ ní ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is conveyed into the sacrificial hall as theHotāto be adored at sacrifices, or as thePotāhe sits down (on the sacred grass).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ग्ना अ॒ग्निर॑ध्व॒र उ॒तो गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्दमे॑ । उ॒त ब्र॒ह्मा नि षी॑दति
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ gnā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ utó íti ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ dáme ǀutá ǀ brahmā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnimay be the officiating priest at the sacrifice, or the master of the house in the sacrificial chamber, or he sits down as theBrahman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेषि॒ ह्य॑ध्वरीय॒तामु॑पव॒क्ता जना॑नाम् । ह॒व्या च॒ मानु॑षाणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: véṣi ǀ hí ǀ adhvari-yatā́m ǀ upa-vaktā́ ǀ jánānām ǀhavyā́ ǀ ca ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, who are the director (of the ceremonial), accept the oblations of devoutly-worshipping men the descendants ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेषीद्व॑स्य दू॒त्यं१॒॑ यस्य॒ जुजो॑षो अध्व॒रम् । ह॒व्यं मर्त॑स्य॒ वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: véṣi ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ dūtyám ǀ yásya ǀ jújoṣaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀhavyám ǀ mártasya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are willing (to fulfil) the office of messenger for the mortal whose oblations at the sacrifice you are plural ased to convey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ जोष्यध्व॒रम॒स्माकं॑ य॒ज्ञम॑ङ्गिरः । अ॒स्माकं॑ शृणुधी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ joṣi ǀ adhvarám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ yajñám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ śṛṇudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be plural ased by our sacrifice; (be plural ased)Aṅgiras, by our offering hear our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ ते दू॒ळभो॒ रथो॒ऽस्माँ अ॑श्नोतु वि॒श्वत॑: । येन॒ रक्ष॑सि दा॒शुष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ te ǀ duḥ-dábhaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aśnotu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀyéna ǀ rákṣasi ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your inviolable car, whereby you defend the donors of oblations, be everywhere around us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तम॒द्याश्वं॒ न स्तोमै॒: क्रतुं॒ न भ॒द्रं हृ॑दि॒स्पृश॑म् । ऋ॒ध्यामा॑ त॒ ओहै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tám ǀ adyá ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ krátum ǀ ná ǀ bhadrám ǀ hṛdi-spṛ́śam ǀṛdhyā́ma ǀ te ǀ óhaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We celebrate you today,Agni, who are like a horse (in conveying our burden) with your praises, conveying (our wishes to the gods), and (who are) like a benefactor, propitious and affectionate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ ह्य॑ग्ने॒ क्रतो॑र्भ॒द्रस्य॒ दक्ष॑स्य सा॒धोः । र॒थीॠ॒तस्य॑ बृह॒तो ब॒भूथ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ krátoḥ ǀ bhadrásya ǀ dákṣasya ǀ sādhóḥ ǀrathī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be now the conveyer,Agni, of our auspicious, powerful, efficacious, truthful, and great sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्नो॑ अ॒र्कैर्भवा॑ नो अ॒र्वाङ्स्व१॒॑र्ण ज्योति॑: । अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिः सु॒मना॒ अनी॑कैः
shlokas.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ jyótiḥ ǀágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who like the sun are light, propitiated by these our hymns, come to our presence with all your hosts (of radiance).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒भिष्टे॑ अ॒द्य गी॒र्भिर्गृ॒णन्तोऽग्ने॒ दाशे॑म । प्र ते॑ दि॒वो न स्त॑नयन्ति॒ शुष्मा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ābhíḥ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ dā́śema ǀprá ǀ te ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ stanayanti ǀ śúṣmāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorifying you,Agni, today, with these our praises, may we offer you (oblations); your (flames), bright as those of the sun, roar aloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ स्वादि॒ष्ठाग्ने॒ संदृ॑ष्टिरि॒दा चि॒दह्न॑ इ॒दा चि॑द॒क्तोः । श्रि॒ये रु॒क्मो न रो॑चत उपा॒के
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ svā́diṣṭhā ǀ ágne ǀ sám-dṛṣṭiḥ ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ aktóḥ ǀśriyé ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ rocate ǀ upāké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your lovely radiance,Agni, whether by day or by night, shines upon (all objects) like an ornament (to give them) beauty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तं न पू॒तं त॒नूर॑रे॒पाः शुचि॒ हिर॑ण्यम् । तत्ते॑ रु॒क्मो न रो॑चत स्वधावः
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pūtám ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀ arepā́ḥ ǀ śúci ǀ híraṇyam ǀtát ǀ te ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ rocata ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of sustenance, (Agni), your favour is free from fault, like clarified butter; your pure and golden lustre shines like an ornament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒तं चि॒द्धि ष्मा॒ सने॑मि॒ द्वेषोऽग्न॑ इ॒नोषि॒ मर्ता॑त् । इ॒त्था यज॑मानादृतावः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ sánemi ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ inóṣi ǀ mártāt ǀitthā́ ǀ yájamānāt ǀ ṛta-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truthful,Agni, verily you remove from the mortal who instrumental tutes (your) worship, whatever sin has been committed (by him) of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शि॒वा न॑: स॒ख्या सन्तु॑ भ्रा॒त्राग्ने॑ दे॒वेषु॑ यु॒ष्मे । सा नो॒ नाभि॒: सद॑ने॒ सस्मि॒न्नूध॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śivā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ sántu ǀ bhrātrā́ ǀ ágne ǀ devéṣu ǀ yuṣmé íti ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ sádane ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our friendly and fraternal attentions to your deities prove fortunate; for such (attentions shown) in every sacrifice (form) our security in the sphere (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रं ते॑ अग्ने सहसि॒न्ननी॑कमुपा॒क आ रो॑चते॒ सूर्य॑स्य । रुश॑द्दृ॒शे द॑दृशे नक्त॒या चि॒दरू॑क्षितं दृ॒श आ रू॒पे अन्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sahasin ǀ ánīkam ǀ upāké ǀ ā́ ǀ rocate ǀ sū́ryasya ǀrúśat ǀ dṛśé ǀ dadṛśe ǀ nakta-yā́ ǀ cit ǀ árūkṣitam ǀ dṛśé ǀ ā́ ǀ rūpé ǀ ánnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulAgni, your auspicious radiance shines upon the proximity of the sun (by day); your bright and visible (lustre) is conspicuous by night, as the bland and plural asing food (of sacrifice, the oblation) becomes manifest in your form.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षा॑ह्यग्ने गृण॒ते म॑नी॒षां खं वेप॑सा तुविजात॒ स्तवा॑नः । विश्वे॑भि॒र्यद्वा॒वन॑: शुक्र दे॒वैस्तन्नो॑ रास्व सुमहो॒ भूरि॒ मन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sāhi ǀ agne ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ khám ǀ vépasā ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ stávānaḥ ǀvíśvebhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ vavánaḥ ǀ śukra ǀ deváiḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ su-mahaḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are engendered repeatedly, and glorified by sacrifice, set open heaven to him who offers you adoration; resplendent (Agni), bestow upon us that ample and acceptable (wealth), which, radiant (deity), you with all the gods, have given (to other worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद॑ग्ने॒ काव्या॒ त्वन्म॑नी॒षास्त्वदु॒क्था जा॑यन्ते॒ राध्या॑नि । त्वदे॑ति॒ द्रवि॑णं वी॒रपे॑शा इ॒त्थाधि॑ये दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ agne ǀ kā́vyā ǀ tvám ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ tvát ǀ ukthā́ ǀ jāyante ǀ rā́dhyāni ǀtvát ǀ eti ǀ dráviṇam ǀ vīrá-peśāḥ ǀ itthā́-dhiye ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerings (to the gods) are engendered,Agni, of you; from you (proceed) praises; from you effective prayers; from you come a vigorous frame and wealth to man who worships with sincerity and offers oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्वा॒जी वा॑जम्भ॒रो विहा॑या अभिष्टि॒कृज्जा॑यते स॒त्यशु॑ष्मः । त्वद्र॒यिर्दे॒वजू॑तो मयो॒भुस्त्वदा॒शुर्जू॑जु॒वाँ अ॑ग्ने॒ अर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ vājī́ ǀ vājam-bharáḥ ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ abhiṣṭi-kṛ́t ǀ jāyate ǀ satyá-śuṣmaḥ ǀtvát ǀ rayíḥ ǀ devá-jūtaḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǀ tvát ǀ āśúḥ ǀ jūju-vā́n ǀ agne ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From you, who are vigorous, to conveyer of oblations, the vast, the granter of what is desired, is born (a son) of real strength; from you comes wealth approved of by the gods, the source of happiness; from you,Agni, (is obtained) a swift unarrested horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मं दे॑व॒यन्तो॑ दे॒वं मर्ता॑ अमृत म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्वम् । द्वे॒षो॒युत॒मा वि॑वासन्ति धी॒भिर्दमू॑नसं गृ॒हप॑ति॒ममू॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ prathamám ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ devám ǀ bhártā ǀ amṛta ǀ mandrá-jihvam ǀdveṣaḥ-yútam ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsanti ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ dámūnasam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ ámūram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImmortalAgni, devout mortals worship with holy rites you the first deity (of the gods), whose tongue exhilarates (them), the dissipator of sin, the humiliator (of the demons) the lord of the mansion, the unperplexed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒रे अ॒स्मदम॑तिमा॒रे अंह॑ आ॒रे विश्वां॑ दुर्म॒तिं यन्नि॒पासि॑ । दो॒षा शि॒वः स॑हसः सूनो अग्ने॒ यं दे॒व आ चि॒त्सच॑से स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: āré ǀ asmát ǀ ámatim ǀ āré ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ āré ǀ víśvām ǀ duḥ-matím ǀ yát ǀ ni-pā́si ǀdoṣā́ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ agne ǀ yám ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ sácase ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, since you protect (your worshippers), far (remove) from us all iniquity; far (remove from us) sin; far (from us) all evil thoughts; for proeperous is he of whom you who are radiant by night promote the well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वाम॑ग्न इ॒नध॑ते य॒तस्रु॒क्त्रिस्ते॒ अन्नं॑ कृ॒णव॒त्सस्मि॒न्नह॑न् । स सु द्यु॒म्नैर॒भ्य॑स्तु प्र॒सक्ष॒त्तव॒ क्रत्वा॑ जातवेदश्चिकि॒त्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ inádhate ǀ yatá-sruk ǀ tríḥ ǀ te ǀ ánnam ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ sásmin ǀ áhan ǀsáḥ ǀ sú ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ pra-sákṣat ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who with uplifted ladle kindles you, and thrice every day presents to you the (sacrificial) food, knowing your glory,Jātavedas, to be invigorated by the act, surpass (all others) in riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ध्मं यस्ते॑ ज॒भर॑च्छश्रमा॒णो म॒हो अ॑ग्ने॒ अनी॑क॒मा स॑प॒र्यन् । स इ॑धा॒नः प्रति॑ दो॒षामु॒षासं॒ पुष्य॑न्र॒यिं स॑चते॒ घ्नन्न॒मित्रा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: idhmám ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ jabhárat ǀ śaśramāṇáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ agne ǀ ánīkam ǀ ā́ ǀ saparyán ǀsáḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀ práti ǀ doṣā́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ púṣyan ǀ rayím ǀ sacate ǀ ghnán ǀ amítrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, labouring diligently, brings you fuel, honouring,Agni, your great glory; he who kindles you in the evening and at dawn; he, prosperous and destroying his enemies, acquires riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरी॑शे बृह॒तः क्ष॒त्रिय॑स्या॒ग्निर्वाज॑स्य पर॒मस्य॑ रा॒यः । दधा॑ति॒ रत्नं॑ विध॒ते यवि॑ष्ठो॒ व्या॑नु॒षङ्मर्त्या॑य स्व॒धावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ īśe ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ kṣatríyasya ǀ agníḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ paramásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀdádhāti ǀ rátnam ǀ vidhaté ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānuṣák ǀ mártyāya ǀ svadhā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis the possessor of great strength of excellent food of riches, the young (of the gods); abounding in sustenance, he gives to the mortal who worships him precious (wealth) according to (his devotion).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि ते॑ पुरुष॒त्रा य॑वि॒ष्ठाचि॑त्तिभिश्चकृ॒मा कच्चि॒दाग॑: । कृ॒धी ष्व१॒॑स्माँ अदि॑ते॒रना॑गा॒न्व्येनां॑सि शिश्रथो॒ विष्व॑गग्ने
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ puruṣa-trā́ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ ácitti-bhiḥ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀkṛdhí ǀ sú ǀ asmā́n ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ánāgān ǀ ví ǀ énāṃsi ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǀ víṣvak ǀ agne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If, young (of the gods), with the inconsiderateness common to men, we have ever committed any offence against you, make us free from the defects of earth efface entirely,Agniour offences.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हश्चि॑दग्न॒ एन॑सो अ॒भीक॑ ऊ॒र्वाद्दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् । मा ते॒ सखा॑य॒: सद॒मिद्रि॑षाम॒ यच्छा॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शं योः
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ énasaḥ ǀ abhī́ke ǀ ūrvā́t ǀ devā́nām ǀ utá ǀ mártyānām ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ riṣāma ǀ yáccha ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not us,Agni, who are your friends, ever suffer harm from any great or comprehensive offence against either gods or men; bestow forgiveness upon our sons and grandsons, the reward of what has been well done.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ ह॒ त्यद्व॑सवो गौ॒र्यं॑ चित्प॒दि षि॒ताममु॑ञ्चता यजत्राः । ए॒वो ष्व१॒॑स्मन्मु॑ञ्चता॒ व्यंह॒: प्र ता॑र्यग्ने प्रत॒रं न॒ आयु॑:
