shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ gauryám ǀ cit ǀ padí ǀ sitā́m ǀ ámuñcata ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀevó íti ǀ sú ǀ asmát ǀ muñcata ǀ ví ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ tāri ǀ agne ǀ pra-tarám ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableVasus, in like manner as you have liberated the cow bound by the foot, so set us free entirely from sin; and may our existence,Agni, be prolonged.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मग्र॑मख्यद्विभाती॒नां सु॒मना॑ रत्न॒धेय॑म् । या॒तम॑श्विना सु॒कृतो॑ दुरो॒णमुत्सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॑षा दे॒व ए॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ agníḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ ágram ǀ akhyat ǀ vi-bhātīnā́m ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀyātám ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ duroṇám ǀ út ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ deváḥ ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Favourably-minded,Agnihas manifested (his might) in regard to the wealth-bestowing procession of the resplendent dawns; proceed,Aśvins, to the dwelling of the pious (worshipper); the divine sun rises with splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वं भा॒नुं स॑वि॒ता दे॒वो अ॑श्रेद्द्र॒प्सं दवि॑ध्वद्गवि॒षो न सत्वा॑ । अनु॑ व्र॒तं वरु॑णो यन्ति मि॒त्रो यत्सूर्यं॑ दि॒व्या॑रो॒हय॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aśret ǀ drapsám ǀ dávidhvat ǀ go-iṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sátvā ǀánu ǀ vratám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ yát ǀ sū́ryam ǀ diví ǀ ā-roháyanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitādiffuses his light on high, dispersing the dew, and like a vigorous (bull) ardent for the cow; thenVaruṇa, andMitra, and other (divinities), hasten to (fulfil) their offices when they elevate the sun in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं सी॒मकृ॑ण्व॒न्तम॑से वि॒पृचे॑ ध्रु॒वक्षे॑मा॒ अन॑वस्यन्तो॒ अर्थ॑म् । तं सूर्यं॑ ह॒रित॑: स॒प्त य॒ह्वीः स्पशं॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ जग॑तो वहन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ sīm ǀ ákṛṇvan ǀ támase ǀ vi-pṛ́ce ǀ dhruvá-kṣemāḥ ǀ ánava-syantaḥ ǀ ártham ǀtám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ harítaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ spáśam ǀ víśvasya ǀ jágataḥ ǀ vahanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seven great courses convey that sun, whom the (deities), occupants of enduring mansions, and not heedless (of their offices), have formed for the driving away of darkness, (and who is) the animator of the whole world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वहि॑ष्ठेभिर्वि॒हर॑न्यासि॒ तन्तु॑मव॒व्यय॒न्नसि॑तं देव॒ वस्म॑ । दवि॑ध्वतो र॒श्मय॒: सूर्य॑स्य॒ चर्मे॒वावा॑धु॒स्तमो॑ अ॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: váhiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ vi-háran ǀ yāsi ǀ tántum ǀ ava-vyáyan ǀ ásitam ǀ deva ǀ vásma ǀdávidhvataḥ ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ cárma-iva ǀ áva ǀ adhuḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (sun), you proceed with most powerful (horses), spreading your web (or rays), and cutting down the black abode (of night); the tremulous rays of the sun throw off the darknes which is spread like a skin over the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अना॑यतो॒ अनि॑बद्धः क॒थायं न्य॑ङ्ङुत्ता॒नोऽव॑ पद्यते॒ न । कया॑ याति स्व॒धया॒ को द॑दर्श दि॒वः स्क॒म्भः समृ॑तः पाति॒ नाक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ánāyataḥ ǀ áni-baddhaḥ ǀ kathā́ ǀ ayám ǀ nyáṅ ǀ uttānáḥ ǀ áva ǀ padyate ǀ ná ǀkáyā ǀ yāti ǀ svadháyā ǀ káḥ ǀ dadarśa ǀ diváḥ ǀ skambháḥ ǀ sám-ṛtaḥ ǀ pāti ǀ nā́kam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This sun, not far removed, and unobstructed, whether (looking) downwards or looking upwards, is harmed by no one; what is the power by which he travels? who has (truly) beheld him who, as the collective pillar of heaven, sustains the sky?”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॒ग्निरु॒षसो॑ जा॒तवे॑दा॒ अख्य॑द्दे॒वो रोच॑माना॒ महो॑भिः । आ ना॑सत्योरुगा॒या रथे॑ने॒मं य॒ज्ञमुप॑ नो यात॒मच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ agníḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ ákhyat ǀ deváḥ ǀ rócamānāḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ uru-gāyā́ ǀ ráthena ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The resplendentAgni, by whom all is known, has manifested (his might) in regard to the dawns radiant with lustre; far-goingNāsatyas, come with your car to this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वं के॒तुं स॑वि॒ता दे॒वो अ॑श्रे॒ज्ज्योति॒र्विश्व॑स्मै॒ भुव॑नाय कृ॒ण्वन् । आप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ वि सूर्यो॑ र॒श्मिभि॒श्चेकि॑तानः
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvám ǀ ketúm ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aśret ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ bhúvanāya ǀ kṛṇván ǀā́ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ antárikṣam ǀ ví ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ cékitānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitādisplays his banner on high, diffusing light through all worlds; contemplating (all things), the sun has filled heaven and earth and the firmament with his rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒वह॑न्त्यरु॒णीर्ज्योति॒षागा॑न्म॒ही चि॒त्रा र॒श्मिभि॒श्चेकि॑ताना । प्र॒बो॒धय॑न्ती सुवि॒ताय॑ दे॒व्यु१॒॑षा ई॑यते सु॒युजा॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: ā-váhantī ǀ aruṇī́ḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ mahī́ ǀ citrā́ ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ cékitānā ǀpra-bodháyantī ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ devī́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ īyate ǀ su-yújā ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great and intelligent dawn, variegated with (many-coloured) rays of purple tint, bringing opulence, has come with (her) lustre; the divine Uṣas, arousing (the sleepers), proceeds with her well-harnessed car (to distribute) felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ वहि॑ष्ठा इ॒ह ते व॑हन्तु॒ रथा॒ अश्वा॑स उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । इ॒मे हि वां॑ मधु॒पेया॑य॒ सोमा॑ अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे वृ॑षणा मादयेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ váhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ té ǀ vahantu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀimé ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ madhu-péyāya ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ mādayethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those robust and active horses bring you, (Aśvins), hither at the breaking of the dawn, and may theseSomajuices prepared, showerers (of benefits), for your drinking, exhilarate you at this (our sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अना॑यतो॒ अनि॑बद्धः क॒थायं न्य॑ङ्ङुत्ता॒नोऽव॑ पद्यते॒ न । कया॑ याति स्व॒धया॒ को द॑दर्श दि॒वः स्क॒म्भः समृ॑तः पाति॒ नाक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ánāyataḥ ǀ áni-baddhaḥ ǀ kathā́ ǀ ayám ǀ nyáṅ ǀ uttānáḥ ǀ áva ǀ padyate ǀ ná ǀkáyā ǀ yāti ǀ svadháyā ǀ káḥ ǀ dadarśa ǀ diváḥ ǀ skambháḥ ǀ sám-ṛtaḥ ǀ pāti ǀ nā́kam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This sun, not far removed and unobstructed, whether looking downwards or looking upwards, is harmed by no one; what is the power by which he travels? who has (truly) beheld him who, as the collective pillar of heaven, sustains the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ नो अध्व॒रे वा॒जी सन्परि॑ णीयते । दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ vājī́ ǀ sán ǀ pári ǀ nīyate ǀdeváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the invoker (of the gods), like a horse (that bears a burden), is brought to our sacrifice; a deity adorable among deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ त्रिवि॒ष्ट्य॑ध्व॒रं यात्य॒ग्नी र॒थीरि॑व । आ दे॒वेषु॒ प्रयो॒ दध॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ tri-viṣṭí ǀ adhvarám ǀ yā́ti ǀ agníḥ ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǀā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ práyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, thrice (a day), comes to our sacrifice like charioteer, bearing the sacrificial food to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ वाज॑पतिः क॒विर॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यान्य॑क्रमीत् । दध॒द्रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ vā́ja-patiḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ akramīt ǀdádhat ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage,Agni, the lord of food, has encompassed the oblation, giving precious things to the donor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं यः सृञ्ज॑ये पु॒रो दै॑ववा॒ते स॑मि॒ध्यते॑ । द्यु॒माँ अ॑मित्र॒दम्भ॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ sṛ́ñjaye ǀ puráḥ ǀ daiva-vāté ǀ sam-idhyáte ǀdyu-mā́n ǀ amitra-dámbhanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant as thisAgni, the subduer of foes, who is kindled on the (altar) of the cast as (he was kindled) forSṛñjaya, the son of Devavāta.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ घा वी॒र ईव॑तो॒ऽग्नेरी॑शीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । ति॒ग्मज॑म्भस्य मी॒ळ्हुष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ gha ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ īśīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀtigmá-jambhasya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the mortal who is strenuous (in worship) acquire authority over thisAgni, the sharp-rayed, the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमर्व॑न्तं॒ न सा॑न॒सिम॑रु॒षं न दि॒वः शिशु॑म् । म॒र्मृ॒ज्यन्ते॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ árvantam ǀ ná ǀ sānasím ǀ aruṣám ǀ ná ǀ diváḥ ǀ śíśum ǀmarmṛjyánte ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They diligently worship him daily who is like a horse (to convey oblations), who is liberal and resplendent as the son of heaven, (the sun).”

shlokas.sanskrit: बोध॒द्यन्मा॒ हरि॑भ्यां कुमा॒रः सा॑हदे॒व्यः । अच्छा॒ न हू॒त उद॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: bódhat ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ kumāráḥ ǀ sāha-devyáḥ ǀáccha ǀ ná ǀ hūtáḥ ǀ út ǀ aram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the prince, the son ofSahadeva, promised (to present) me with two horses, I withdrew not when called before him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या य॑ज॒ता हरी॑ कुमा॒रात्सा॑हदे॒व्यात् । प्रय॑ता स॒द्य आ द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ yajatā́ ǀ hárī íti ǀ kumārā́t ǀ sāha-devyā́t ǀprá-yatā ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “But immediately accepted those two excellent and well-trained horses from the prince, the son ofSahadeva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वां॑ देवावश्विना कुमा॒रः सा॑हदे॒व्यः । दी॒र्घायु॑रस्तु॒ सोम॑कः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vām ǀ devau ǀ aśvinā ǀ kumāráḥ ǀ sāha-devyáḥ ǀdīrghá-āyuḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómakaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAśvins, may this prince,Somaka, the son ofSahadeva, your (worshipper), enjoy long life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं यु॒वं दे॑वावश्विना कुमा॒रं सा॑हदे॒व्यम् । दी॒र्घायु॑षं कृणोतन
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ yuvám ǀ devau ǀ aśvinā ǀ kumārám ǀ sāha-devyám ǀdīrghá-āyuṣam ǀ kṛṇotana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAśvins, do you two make the prince, the son ofSahadeva, long-lived.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स॒त्यो या॑तु म॒घवाँ॑ ऋजी॒षी द्रव॑न्त्वस्य॒ हर॑य॒ उप॑ नः । तस्मा॒ इदन्ध॑: सुषुमा सु॒दक्ष॑मि॒हाभि॑पि॒त्वं क॑रते गृणा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ satyáḥ ǀ yātu ǀ maghá-vān ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀ drávantu ǀ asya ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ít ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ susuma ǀ su-dákṣam ǀ ihá ǀ abhi-pitvám ǀ karate ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the truthfulMaghavanthe accepter of the spiritlessSoma, come to us; may his horses hasten to us; to him we offer this sacrifice, the very potent beverage; may he grant the fulfilment of our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ स्य शू॒राध्व॑नो॒ नान्ते॒ऽस्मिन्नो॑ अ॒द्य सव॑ने म॒न्दध्यै॑ । शंसा॑त्यु॒क्थमु॒शने॑व वे॒धाश्चि॑कि॒तुषे॑ असु॒र्या॑य॒ मन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ sya ǀ śūra ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ánte ǀ asmín ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sávane ǀ mandádhyai ǀśáṃsāti ǀ ukthám ǀ uśánā-iva ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ asuryā́ya ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, set us free today to give you exhilaration at this sacrifice, as (they let loose a horse) at the end of the road; may the worshipper, likeUśanās, repeat an acceptable prayer to you, the knower (of all things), the destroyer of theasuras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विर्न नि॒ण्यं वि॒दथा॑नि॒ साध॒न्वृषा॒ यत्सेकं॑ विपिपा॒नो अर्चा॑त् । दि॒व इ॒त्था जी॑जनत्स॒प्त का॒रूनह्ना॑ चिच्चक्रुर्व॒युना॑ गृ॒णन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kavíḥ ǀ ná ǀ niṇyám ǀ vidáthāni ǀ sā́dhan ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yát ǀ sékam ǀ vi-pipānáḥ ǀ árcāt ǀdiváḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ jījanat ǀ saptá ǀ kārū́n ǀ áhnā ǀ cit ǀ cakruḥ ǀ vayúnā ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a sage (knowing) what is hidden, and fulfilling sacred rites, so the showerer (of benefits), quaffing copiously the effused (libation), exults (in the draught), and he genitive rates the seven efficient (rays) from heaven, which, being glorified, have made (manifest) the objects of (human) perception by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व१॒॑र्यद्वेदि॑ सु॒दृशी॑कम॒र्कैर्महि॒ ज्योती॑ रुरुचु॒र्यद्ध॒ वस्तो॑: । अ॒न्धा तमां॑सि॒ दुधि॑ता वि॒चक्षे॒ नृभ्य॑श्चकार॒ नृत॑मो अ॒भिष्टौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sváḥ ǀ yát ǀ védi ǀ su-dṛ́śīkam ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ máhi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ rurucuḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vástoḥ ǀandhā́ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ dúdhitā ǀ vi-cákṣe ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the vast luminous heaven manifested by the rays (of light) is displayed, then are (the deities) resplendent according to (their heavenly) abode; the chief of leaders, (Indra), in his approach has scattered the thick glooms so that men may see.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒व॒क्ष इन्द्रो॒ अमि॑तमृजी॒ष्यु१॒॑भे आ प॑प्रौ॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा । अत॑श्चिदस्य महि॒मा वि रे॑च्य॒भि यो विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना ब॒भूव॑
shlokas.transliteration: vavakṣé ǀ índraḥ ǀ ámitam ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ ví ǀ reci ǀ abhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ babhū́va ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, as the accepter of the staleSoma, sustains infinite greatness, and has filled both heaven and earth by his magnitude; therefore has the vastness of him who has surpassed all the regions, exceeded (the world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑नि श॒क्रो नर्या॑णि वि॒द्वान॒पो रि॑रेच॒ सखि॑भि॒र्निका॑मैः । अश्मा॑नं चि॒द्ये बि॑भि॒दुर्वचो॑भिर्व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ śakráḥ ǀ náryāṇi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ apáḥ ǀ rireca ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ ní-kāmaiḥ ǀáśmānam ǀ cit ǀ yé ǀ bibhidúḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavruríti vavruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Knowing all things profitable for men,Śakrahas, with his willing friends (theMaruts), sent forth the waters, for they, with (loud) shouts, divided the clouds, and, desiring (to fulfil) their office, set open the pasturage of the cows (of theAṅgirasas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पो वृ॒त्रं व॑व्रि॒वांसं॒ परा॑ह॒न्प्राव॑त्ते॒ वज्रं॑ पृथि॒वी सचे॑ताः । प्रार्णां॑सि समु॒द्रिया॑ण्यैनो॒: पति॒र्भव॒ञ्छव॑सा शूर धृष्णो
shlokas.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ párā ǀ ahan ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ te ǀ vájram ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sá-cetāḥ ǀprá ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ samudríyāṇi ǀ ainoḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ bhávan ǀ śávasā ǀ śūra ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your protecting thunderbolt has slainVṛtraobstructing the (issue of the waters), the conscious earth (co-operating) with you; valiant hero, preserver (of the regions), send down by your strength the waters of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पो यदद्रिं॑ पुरुहूत॒ दर्द॑रा॒विर्भु॑वत्स॒रमा॑ पू॒र्व्यं ते॑ । स नो॑ ने॒ता वाज॒मा द॑र्षि॒ भूरिं॑ गो॒त्रा रु॒जन्नङ्गि॑रोभिर्गृणा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ yát ǀ ádrim ǀ puru-hūta ǀ dárdaḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ sarámā ǀ pūrvyám ǀ te ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ netā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ā́ ǀ darṣi ǀ bhū́rim ǀ gotrā́ ǀ ruján ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked of many, when you had divided the cloud for (the escape of) the waters,Saramāappeared before you; and you, the bringer of abundant food, have shown us favour, dividing the clouds and glorified by theAṅgirasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ क॒विं नृ॑मणो गा अ॒भिष्टौ॒ स्व॑र्षाता मघव॒न्नाध॑मानम् । ऊ॒तिभि॒स्तमि॑षणो द्यु॒म्नहू॑तौ॒ नि मा॒यावा॒नब्र॑ह्मा॒ दस्यु॑रर्त
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ kavím ǀ nṛ-manaḥ ǀ gāḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀ sváḥ-sātā ǀ magha-van ǀ nā́dhamānam ǀūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ iṣaṇaḥ ǀ dyumná-hūtau ǀ ní ǀ māyā́-vān ǀ ábrahmā ǀ dásyuḥ ǀ arta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, who are honoured by men, you have repaired to the presence of the sage for (the sake of) bestowing (upon him) wealth, and when soliciting (you) in his need (for aid); defending (him) with your protection, the guileful, impiousDasyuhas been destroyed in the contest for the spoil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ द॑स्यु॒घ्ना मन॑सा या॒ह्यस्तं॒ भुव॑त्ते॒ कुत्स॑: स॒ख्ये निका॑मः । स्वे योनौ॒ नि ष॑दतं॒ सरू॑पा॒ वि वां॑ चिकित्सदृत॒चिद्ध॒ नारी॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dasyu-ghnā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ yāhi ǀ ástam ǀ bhúvat ǀ te ǀ kútsaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ ní-kāmaḥ ǀsvé ǀ yónau ǀ ní ǀ sadatam ǀ sá-rūpā ǀ ví ǀ vām ǀ cikitsat ǀ ṛta-cít ǀ ha ǀ nā́rī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With a mind resolved on killing theDasyu, you came (to his dwelling), andKutsawas eager for your friendship; now have you two alighted in his, (Indra's), habitation, and being entirely similar in form the truthful woman has been perplexed (to discriminate between you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यासि॒ कुत्से॑न स॒रथ॑मव॒स्युस्तो॒दो वात॑स्य॒ हर्यो॒रीशा॑नः । ऋ॒ज्रा वाजं॒ न गध्यं॒ युयू॑षन्क॒विर्यदह॒न्पार्या॑य॒ भूषा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́si ǀ kútsena ǀ sa-rátham ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ todáḥ ǀ vā́tasya ǀ háryoḥ ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀṛjrā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ná ǀ gádhyam ǀ yúyūṣan ǀ kavíḥ ǀ yát ǀ áhan ǀ pā́ryāya ǀ bhū́ṣāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You go withKutsain the same chariot, determined to defend him; (you) who are the tormentor (of foes), the lord of horses (of the speech) of the wind; on the same day wherein, yoking (to the car) the straight-going steeds, as if to receive food, the sage (Kutsa) has been enabled to cross over (the sea) of calamity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुत्सा॑य॒ शुष्ण॑म॒शुषं॒ नि ब॑र्हीः प्रपि॒त्वे अह्न॒: कुय॑वं स॒हस्रा॑ । स॒द्यो दस्यू॒न्प्र मृ॑ण कु॒त्स्येन॒ प्र सूर॑श्च॒क्रं वृ॑हताद॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: kútsāya ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ aśúṣam ǀ ní ǀ barhīḥ ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ kúyavam ǀ sahásrā ǀsadyáḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ prá ǀ mṛṇa ǀ kutsyéna ǀ prá ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ vṛhatāt ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ForKutsa, you have slain the unhappyŚuṣṇaand in the forepart of the day, attended by thousands (you have slain)Kuyavawith the thunderbolt; you have swiftly destroyed theDasyus, and you have cut them to pieces in the battle, with the wheel (of the chariot of) the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं पिप्रुं॒ मृग॑यं शूशु॒वांस॑मृ॒जिश्व॑ने वैदथि॒नाय॑ रन्धीः । प॒ञ्चा॒शत्कृ॒ष्णा नि व॑पः स॒हस्रात्कं॒ न पुरो॑ जरि॒मा वि द॑र्दः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ píprum ǀ mṛ́gayam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ ṛjíśvane ǀ vaidathinā́ya ǀ randhīḥ ǀpañcāśát ǀ kṛṣṇā́ ǀ ní ǀ vapaḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ átkam ǀ ná ǀ púraḥ ǀ jarimā́ ǀ ví ǀ dardaríti dardaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have subjugated Pipru and the mightyMṛgayāfor the sake of Ṛjiṣvan, the son of Vidathin, you have slain the fifty thousandKṛṣṇas; and, as old age (destroys) life, you have demolished the cities (ofŚambara).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर॑ उपा॒के त॒न्वं१॒॑ दधा॑नो॒ वि यत्ते॒ चेत्य॒मृत॑स्य॒ वर्प॑: । मृ॒गो न ह॒स्ती तवि॑षीमुषा॒णः सिं॒हो न भी॒म आयु॑धानि॒ बिभ्र॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sū́raḥ ǀ upāké ǀ tanvám ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ céti ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ várpaḥ ǀmṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ hastī́ ǀ táviṣīm ǀ uṣāṇáḥ ǀ siṃháḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ bíbhrat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “While having (your) person n in the proximity of the sun, your form becomes redolent of ambrosia, and you are like the deer-like elephant, consuming the strength (of the strong), and are like a terrible lion when wielding your weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ कामा॑ वसू॒यन्तो॑ अग्म॒न्त्स्व॑र्मीळ्हे॒ न सव॑ने चका॒नाः । श्र॒व॒स्यव॑: शशमा॒नास॑ उ॒क्थैरोको॒ न र॒ण्वा सु॒दृशी॑व पु॒ष्टिः
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ vasu-yántaḥ ǀ agman ǀ sváḥ-mīḷhe ǀ ná ǀ sávane ǀ cakānā́ḥ ǀśravasyávaḥ ǀ śaśamānā́saḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇvā́ ǀ sudṛ́śī-iva ǀ puṣṭíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Relying (uponIndra) for protection, and desirous of riches, (pious men) repair to him soliciting his presence in the sacrifice, as if in the battle, asking for food, celebrating his praise with hymns, for he is the refuge (of his worshippers), and resembles the grateful and lovely (goddess) of nutrition.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिद्व॒ इन्द्रं॑ सु॒हवं॑ हुवेम॒ यस्ता च॒कार॒ नर्या॑ पु॒रूणि॑ । यो माव॑ते जरि॒त्रे गध्यं॑ चिन्म॒क्षू वाजं॒ भर॑ति स्पा॒र्हरा॑धाः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ su-hávam ǀ huvema ǀ yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀyáḥ ǀ mā́-vate ǀ jaritré ǀ gádhyam ǀ cit ǀ makṣú ǀ vā́jam ǀ bhárati ǀ spārhá-rādhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us invoke that graciousIndrawho has made so many things good for man; who, bestowing enviable opulence, quickly brings acceptable food to a worshipper like me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒ग्मा यद॒न्तर॒शनि॒: पता॑ति॒ कस्मि॑ञ्चिच्छूर मुहु॒के जना॑नाम् । घो॒रा यद॑र्य॒ समृ॑ति॒र्भवा॒त्यध॑ स्मा नस्त॒न्वो॑ बोधि गो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: tigmā́ ǀ yát ǀ antáḥ ǀ aśániḥ ǀ pátāti ǀ kásmin ǀ cit ǀ śūra ǀ muhuké ǀ jánānām ǀghorā́ ǀ yát ǀ arya ǀ sám-ṛtiḥ ǀ bhávāti ǀ ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,indra, when in any conflict of men the sharp thunderbolt falls in the midst (of them), and when, lord there is a terrible battle, then the defender of our person ns is made known.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुवो॑ऽवि॒ता वा॒मदे॑वस्य धी॒नां भुव॒: सखा॑वृ॒को वाज॑सातौ । त्वामनु॒ प्रम॑ति॒मा ज॑गन्मोरु॒शंसो॑ जरि॒त्रे वि॒श्वध॑ स्याः
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ vāmá-devasya ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ avṛkáḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀtvā́m ǀ ánu ǀ prá-matim ǀ ā́ ǀ jaganma ǀ uru-śáṃsaḥ ǀ jaritré ǀ viśvádha ǀ syāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be you the protector of the pious acts ofVāmadeva; be you in battle an unfailing friend; we come to you, eminent in wisdom; may you be ever benignant to your praiser.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्नृभि॑रिन्द्र त्वा॒युभि॑ष्ट्वा म॒घव॑द्भिर्मघव॒न्विश्व॑ आ॒जौ । द्यावो॒ न द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि सन्तो॑ अ॒र्यः क्ष॒पो म॑देम श॒रद॑श्च पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ tvāyú-bhiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ maghávat-bhiḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ víśve ǀ ājáu ǀdyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sántaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ kṣapáḥ ǀ madema ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In every battle,Maghavan, may we, along with those men who trust in you and offer rich gifts, like those who are resplendent with riches, triumphing over their foes, glorify you many nights and years.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदिन्द्रा॑य वृष॒भाय॒ वृष्णे॒ ब्रह्मा॑कर्म॒ भृग॑वो॒ न रथ॑म् । नू चि॒द्यथा॑ नः स॒ख्या वि॒योष॒दस॑न्न उ॒ग्रो॑ऽवि॒ता त॑नू॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índrāya ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ bráhma ǀ akarma ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rátham ǀnú ǀ cit ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ vi-yóṣat ǀ ásat ǀ naḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ tanū-pā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore we offer to the vigorousIndra, the showerer (of benefits), holy adoration, that he may never withdraw his friendly (actions) from us, and that he may be our powerful protector, the defender of (our) person ns, as theBhṛgus(fabricate) a car (for use).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in (your) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं म॒हाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॑ ह॒ क्षा अनु॑ क्ष॒त्रं मं॒हना॑ मन्यत॒ द्यौः । त्वं वृ॒त्रं शव॑सा जघ॒न्वान्त्सृ॒जः सिन्धूँ॒रहि॑ना जग्रसा॒नान्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ mahā́n ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ ha ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kṣatrám ǀ maṃhánā ǀ manyata ǀ dyáuḥ ǀtvám ǀ vṛtrám ǀ śávasā ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ sṛjáḥ ǀ síndhūn ǀ áhinā ǀ jagrasānā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are mighty; the vast earth confesses to you (your) strength, as does the heaven; you have slainVṛtraby your vigour, you have set free the rivers arrested by Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ त्वि॒षो जनि॑मन्रेजत॒ द्यौ रेज॒द्भूमि॑र्भि॒यसा॒ स्वस्य॑ म॒न्योः । ऋ॒घा॒यन्त॑ सु॒भ्व१॒॑: पर्व॑तास॒ आर्द॒न्धन्वा॑नि स॒रय॑न्त॒ आप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tviṣáḥ ǀ jániman ǀ rejata ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ réjat ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ bhiyásā ǀ svásya ǀ manyóḥ ǀṛghāyánta ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ā́rdan ǀ dhánvāni ǀ saráyante ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the birth of you who are resplendent, trembled the heaven (and) trembled the earth through fear of your wrath; the mighty clouds were confined; they destroyed (the distress of drought), spreading the waters over the dry plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भि॒नद्गि॒रिं शव॑सा॒ वज्र॑मि॒ष्णन्ना॑विष्कृण्वा॒नः स॑हसा॒न ओज॑: । वधी॑द्वृ॒त्रं वज्रे॑ण मन्दसा॒नः सर॒न्नापो॒ जव॑सा ह॒तवृ॑ष्णीः
shlokas.transliteration: bhinát ǀ girím ǀ śávasā ǀ vájram ǀ iṣṇán ǀ āviḥ-kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ sahasānáḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀvádhīt ǀ vṛtrám ǀ vájreṇa ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sáran ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ jávasā ǀ hatá-vṛṣṇīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The subduer of foes, manifesting his energy and hurling his thunderbolt, shattered the mountain by his strength; he slewVṛtrawith the thunderbolt, exulting, and the waters whose obstructor was destroyed rushed forth with rapidity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वीर॑स्ते जनि॒ता म॑न्यत॒ द्यौरिन्द्र॑स्य क॒र्ता स्वप॑स्तमो भूत् । य ईं॑ ज॒जान॑ स्व॒र्यं॑ सु॒वज्र॒मन॑पच्युतं॒ सद॑सो॒ न भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-vī́raḥ ǀ te ǀ janitā́ ǀ manyata ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ kartā́ ǀ svápaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ bhūt ǀyáḥ ǀ īm ǀ jajā́na ǀ svaryám ǀ su-vájram ǀ ánapa-cyutam ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven, your progenitor, conceived (I have obtained) a worthy son; the maker ofIndrawas the accomplisher of a most excellent work; he who begot the adorable (Indra), armed with the thunderbolt, irremovable from his station, and endowed with greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एक॑ इच्च्या॒वय॑ति॒ प्र भूमा॒ राजा॑ कृष्टी॒नां पु॑रुहू॒त इन्द्र॑: । स॒त्यमे॑न॒मनु॒ विश्वे॑ मदन्ति रा॒तिं दे॒वस्य॑ गृण॒तो म॒घोन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ cyaváyati ǀ prá ǀ bhū́ma ǀ rā́jā ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀsatyám ǀ enam ǀ ánu ǀ víśve ǀ madanti ǀ rātím ǀ devásya ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All men, praising the munificence of the divineMaghavan, verily glorify him who alone casts downmany,Indra, the king of men, the adored of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा सोमा॑ अभवन्नस्य॒ विश्वे॑ स॒त्रा मदा॑सो बृह॒तो मदि॑ष्ठाः । स॒त्राभ॑वो॒ वसु॑पति॒र्वसू॑नां॒ दत्रे॒ विश्वा॑ अधिथा इन्द्र कृ॒ष्टीः
shlokas.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ abhavan ǀ asya ǀ víśve ǀ satrā́ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ mádiṣṭhāḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vásu-patiḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ dátre ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ adhithāḥ ǀ indra ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truly are all libations his, the inebriating draughts are truly most exhilarating to the mightyIndra; truly are you the lord of wealth, of (all sorts of) treasures; you, Indra, support all people by the gift (of riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमध॑ प्रथ॒मं जाय॑मा॒नोऽमे॒ विश्वा॑ अधिथा इन्द्र कृ॒ष्टीः । त्वं प्रति॑ प्र॒वत॑ आ॒शया॑न॒महिं॒ वज्रे॑ण मघव॒न्वि वृ॑श्चः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ádha ǀ prathamám ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ áme ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ adhithāḥ ǀ indra ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀtvám ǀ práti ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ áhim ǀ vájreṇa ǀ magha-van ǀ ví ǀ vṛścaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[7-8] (We praise) the slayer of many foes, the courageous, the discomfiter (of enemies), the great, the unbounded, the showerer (of benefits), the wielder of the bright thunderbolt, him who is the destroyer ofVṛtra, the bestower of food, the giver of wealth,Maghavan, the possessor of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा॒हणं॒ दाधृ॑षिं॒ तुम्र॒मिन्द्रं॑ म॒हाम॑पा॒रं वृ॑ष॒भं सु॒वज्र॑म् । हन्ता॒ यो वृ॒त्रं सनि॑तो॒त वाजं॒ दाता॑ म॒घानि॑ म॒घवा॑ सु॒राधा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: satrā-hánan ǀ dádhṛṣim ǀ túmram ǀ índram ǀ mahā́m ǀ apārám ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ su-vájram ǀhántā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ sánitā ǀ utá ǀ vā́jam ǀ dā́tā ǀ maghā́ni ǀ maghá-vā ǀ su-rā́dhāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वृत॑श्चातयते समी॒चीर्य आ॒जिषु॑ म॒घवा॑ शृ॒ण्व एक॑: । अ॒यं वाजं॑ भरति॒ यं स॒नोत्य॒स्य प्रि॒यास॑: स॒ख्ये स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vṛ́taḥ ǀ cātayate ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ājíṣu ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ ékaḥ ǀayám ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharati ǀ yám ǀ sanóti ǀ asyá ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisMaghavan, who destroys assembled hosts, is he who is renowned as chief in battles; he brings the food which he bestows (upon the worshipper); may we be held dear in his friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं शृ॑ण्वे॒ अध॒ जय॑न्नु॒त घ्नन्न॒यमु॒त प्र कृ॑णुते यु॒धा गाः । य॒दा स॒त्यं कृ॑णु॒ते म॒न्युमिन्द्रो॒ विश्वं॑ दृ॒ळ्हं भ॑यत॒ एज॑दस्मात्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ śṛṇve ǀ ádha ǀ jáyan ǀ utá ǀ ghnán ǀ ayám ǀ utá ǀ prá ǀ kṛṇute ǀ yudhā́ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ satyám ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ manyúm ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ bhayate ǀ éjat ǀ asmāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Indra), is renowned, whether conquering or slaying (his foes), or whether in conflict he recovers the cattle; when Indra truly entertains anger all that is stationary or moveable is in fear of him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समिन्द्रो॒ गा अ॑जय॒त्सं हिर॑ण्या॒ सम॑श्वि॒या म॒घवा॒ यो ह॑ पू॒र्वीः । ए॒भिर्नृभि॒र्नृत॑मो अस्य शा॒कै रा॒यो वि॑भ॒क्ता स॑म्भ॒रश्च॒ वस्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ índraḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ajayat ǀ sám ǀ híraṇyā ǀ sám ǀ aśviyā́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀebhíḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ asya ǀ śākáiḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀ sam-bharáḥ ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the lord of opulence, who has overcomemany (enemies), has completely won (their) cattle, (their) gold, (their) horses; chief leader by his energies, praised by these his worshippers, he is the distributor of riches, the bestower of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किय॑त्स्वि॒दिन्द्रो॒ अध्ये॑ति मा॒तुः किय॑त्पि॒तुर्ज॑नि॒तुर्यो ज॒जान॑ । यो अ॑स्य॒ शुष्मं॑ मुहु॒कैरिय॑र्ति॒ वातो॒ न जू॒तः स्त॒नय॑द्भिर॒भ्रैः
shlokas.transliteration: kíyat ǀ svit ǀ índraḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ eti ǀ mātúḥ ǀ kíyat ǀ pitúḥ ǀ janitúḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jajā́na ǀyáḥ ǀ asya ǀ śúṣmam ǀ muhukáiḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ná ǀ jūtáḥ ǀ stanáyat-bhiḥ ǀ abhráiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some portion (of his strength)Indraderives from his mother, some portion from his father; he who, though his progenitor, has begotten (the world), and animates its vigour repeatedly, as the wind is driven by thundering clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षि॒यन्तं॑ त्व॒मक्षि॑यन्तं कृणो॒तीय॑र्ति रे॒णुं म॒घवा॑ स॒मोह॑म् । वि॒भ॒ञ्ज॒नुर॒शनि॑माँ इव॒ द्यौरु॒त स्तो॒तारं॑ म॒घवा॒ वसौ॑ धात्
shlokas.transliteration: kṣiyántam ǀ tvam ǀ ákṣiyantam ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ íyarti ǀ reṇúm ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sam-óham ǀvi-bhañjanúḥ ǀ aśánimān-iva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ utá ǀ stotā́ram ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vásau ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are theMaghavanwho makes one man destitute, another prosperous, who (scatters from his worshipper) the accusative ulated dust (of sin), the destroyer (of foes), like the heaven with the thunderbolt, Maghavan conducts his worshipper to wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं च॒क्रमि॑षण॒त्सूर्य॑स्य॒ न्येत॑शं रीरमत्ससृमा॒णम् । आ कृ॒ष्ण ईं॑ जुहुरा॒णो जि॑घर्ति त्व॒चो बु॒ध्ने रज॑सो अ॒स्य योनौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ cakrám ǀ iṣaṇat ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ní ǀ étaśam ǀ rīramat ǀ sasṛmāṇám ǀā́ ǀ kṛṣṇáḥ ǀ īm ǀ juhurāṇáḥ ǀ jigharti ǀ tvacáḥ ǀ budhné ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ yónau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has hurled the wheel (of the chariot) of the sun, and has stoppedEtaśagoing forth to (battle); the dark undulating cloud bedews him, (staying) at the root of radiance in the regions of its waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असि॑क्न्यां॒ यज॑मानो॒ न होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásiknyām ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the sacrificer (pours the oblation) at night upon the fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒व्यन्त॒ इन्द्रं॑ स॒ख्याय॒ विप्रा॑ अश्वा॒यन्तो॒ वृष॑णं वा॒जय॑न्तः । ज॒नी॒यन्तो॑ जनि॒दामक्षि॑तोति॒मा च्या॑वयामोऽव॒ते न कोश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gavyántaḥ ǀ índram ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ víprāḥ ǀ aśva-yántaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀjani-yántaḥ ǀ jani-dā́m ǀ ákṣita-ūtim ǀ ā́ ǀ cyavayāmaḥ ǀ avaté ǀ ná ǀ kóśam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we (who are) wishing for cattle, for horses, for food, for wives, through his friendship induceIndra, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of wives, the unwearied granter of protection, to come down, as a bucket (is lowered) into a well.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रा॒ता नो॑ बोधि॒ ददृ॑शान आ॒पिर॑भिख्या॒ता म॑र्डि॒ता सो॒म्याना॑म् । सखा॑ पि॒ता पि॒तृत॑मः पितॄ॒णां कर्ते॑मु लो॒कमु॑श॒ते व॑यो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: trātā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ dádṛśānaḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ abhi-khyātā́ ǀ marḍitā́ ǀ somyā́nām ǀsákhā ǀ pitā́ ǀ pitṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ kártā ǀ īm ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ uśaté ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be our preserver, you who are looking (benevolently upon) all; a kinsman (to us); a supervisor (of all things), a bestower of felicity on those who are worthy (to offer) libations; a friend, a protector, a defender in the highest degree among defenders, a creator; (be you, who bestows) the world of heaven upon him who desires it, the giver to us of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒खी॒य॒ताम॑वि॒ता बो॑धि॒ सखा॑ गृणा॒न इ॑न्द्र स्तुव॒ते वयो॑ धाः । व॒यं ह्या ते॑ चकृ॒मा स॒बाध॑ आ॒भिः शमी॑भिर्म॒हय॑न्त इन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: sakhi-yatā́m ǀ avitā́ ǀ bodhi ǀ sákhā ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ stuvaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀvayám ǀ hí ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ cakṛmá ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Regard yourself as a protector of those who desire your friendship; be a friend deserving of commendation; grant,Indra, food to him who praises (you); suffering difficulties, we make our suppications to you, worshipping you with these holy rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒त इन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॒ यद्ध॑ वृ॒त्रा भूरी॒ण्येको॑ अप्र॒तीनि॑ हन्ति । अ॒स्य प्रि॒यो ज॑रि॒ता यस्य॒ शर्म॒न्नकि॑र्दे॒वा वा॒रय॑न्ते॒ न मर्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stutáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ bhū́rīṇi ǀ ékaḥ ǀ apratī́ni ǀ hanti ǀasyá ǀ priyáḥ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ yásya ǀ śárman ǀ nákiḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vāráyante ǀ ná ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndra, the possessor of opulence, is glorified, he singly destroys many unyielding foes; the worshipper is dear to him (who relies) on his protection, and neither gods nor men molest him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॒ इन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॑ विर॒प्शी कर॑त्स॒त्या च॑र्षणी॒धृद॑न॒र्वा । त्वं राजा॑ ज॒नुषां॑ धेह्य॒स्मे अधि॒ श्रवो॒ माहि॑नं॒ यज्ज॑रि॒त्रे
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ kárat ǀ satyā́ ǀ carṣaṇi-dhṛ́t ǀ anarvā́ ǀtvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ janúṣām ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǀ ádhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ mā́hinam ǀ yát ǀ jaritré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many-voicedIndra, the possessor of opulence, the supporter of men, the irresistible bestows upon us, when praised by us, assured (rewards); you, (Indra), are the king of men; grant to us abundantly that great fame which (is due) to (your) worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं पन्था॒ अनु॑वित्तः पुरा॒णो यतो॑ दे॒वा उ॒दजा॑यन्त॒ विश्वे॑ । अत॑श्चि॒दा ज॑निषीष्ट॒ प्रवृ॑द्धो॒ मा मा॒तर॑ममु॒या पत्त॑वे कः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ ánu-vittaḥ ǀ purāṇáḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ut-ájāyanta ǀ víśve ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ janiṣīṣṭa ǀ prá-vṛddhaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ mātáram ǀ amuyā́ ǀ páttave ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraspeaks: This is the old and recognized path by which all the gods are born; so, when full-grown, let him be born in the same manner; let him not cause the loss of this his mother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाहमतो॒ निर॑या दु॒र्गहै॒तत्ति॑र॒श्चता॑ पा॒र्श्वान्निर्ग॑माणि । ब॒हूनि॑ मे॒ अकृ॑ता॒ कर्त्वा॑नि॒ युध्यै॑ त्वेन॒ सं त्वे॑न पृच्छै
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ahám ǀ átaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ aya ǀ duḥ-gáhā ǀ etát ǀ tiraścátā ǀ pārśvā́t ǀ níḥ ǀ gamāni ǀbahū́ni ǀ me ǀ ákṛtā ǀ kártvāni ǀ yúdhyai ǀ tvena ǀ sám ǀ tvena ǀ pṛcchai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāmadevaspeaks: Let me not come forth by this path, for it is difficult (of issue); let me come forth obliquely from the side; many acts unperformed by others are to be accomplished by me; let me contend (in war) with one (enemy), in controversy with one opponent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रा॒य॒तीं मा॒तर॒मन्व॑चष्ट॒ न नानु॑ गा॒न्यनु॒ नू ग॑मानि । त्वष्टु॑र्गृ॒हे अ॑पिब॒त्सोम॒मिन्द्र॑: शतध॒न्यं॑ च॒म्वो॑: सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: parā-yatī́m ǀ mātáram ǀ ánu ǀ acaṣṭa ǀ ná ǀ ná ǀ ánu ǀ gāni ǀ ánu ǀ nú ǀ gamāni ǀtváṣṭuḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ apibat ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ śata-dhanyám ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, (Indra), has asserted (that it will) cause the death of my mother; let me not proceed by the usual way, but proceed quickly, according (to my will); in the dwelling ofTvaṣṭāIndra drank the costlySomafrom the vessels of the offerers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किं स ऋध॑क्कृणव॒द्यं स॒हस्रं॑ मा॒सो ज॒भार॑ श॒रद॑श्च पू॒र्वीः । न॒ही न्व॑स्य प्रति॒मान॒मस्त्य॒न्तर्जा॒तेषू॒त ये जनि॑त्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ yám ǀ sahásram ǀ māsáḥ ǀ jabhā́ra ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀnahí ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ ásti ǀ antáḥ ǀ jātéṣu ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ jáni-tvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aditispeaks: What irregular act has he committed whom (I, his mother), bore for a thousand months and for many years? there is no analogy between him and those who have been or will be born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒व॒द्यमि॑व॒ मन्य॑माना॒ गुहा॑क॒रिन्द्रं॑ मा॒ता वी॒र्ये॑णा॒ न्यृ॑ष्टम् । अथोद॑स्थात्स्व॒यमत्कं॒ वसा॑न॒ आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ज्जाय॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: avadyám-iva ǀ mányamānā ǀ gúhā ǀ akaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mātā́ ǀ vīryéṇa ǀ ní-ṛṣṭam ǀátha ǀ út ǀ asthāt ǀ svayám ǀ átkam ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāt ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deeming it disreputable (that he should be brought forth) in secret, his mother endowed (Indra) with (extraordinary) vigour; therefore, as soon as born he sprung up of his own accord, invested with splendour, and filled both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता अ॑र्षन्त्यलला॒भव॑न्तीॠ॒ताव॑रीरिव सं॒क्रोश॑मानाः । ए॒ता वि पृ॑च्छ॒ किमि॒दं भ॑नन्ति॒ कमापो॒ अद्रिं॑ परि॒धिं रु॑जन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ alalā-bhávantīḥ ǀ ṛtávarīḥ-iva ǀ sam-króśamānāḥ ǀetā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ pṛccha ǀ kím ǀ idám ǀ bhananti ǀ kám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ pari-dhím ǀ rujanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (rivers) flew murmuring as if, being filled with water, they were uttering sounds (of joy); ask them what is this they say; what is the encompassing cloud that the waters break through?”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमु॑ ष्विदस्मै नि॒विदो॑ भन॒न्तेन्द्र॑स्याव॒द्यं दि॑धिषन्त॒ आप॑: । ममै॒तान्पु॒त्रो म॑ह॒ता व॒धेन॑ वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अ॑सृज॒द्वि सिन्धू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ asmai ǀ ni-vídaḥ ǀ bhananta ǀ índrasya ǀ avadyám ǀ didhiṣante ǀ ā́paḥ ǀmáma ǀ etā́n ǀ putráḥ ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vadhéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ asṛjat ǀ ví ǀ síndhūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What do the sacred expiatory strains declare to me? the waters reeive the reproach ofIndra; my son has slainVṛtrawith the mighty thunderbolt; he has set those rivers free.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॑च्च॒न त्वा॑ युव॒तिः प॒रास॒ मम॑च्च॒न त्वा॑ कु॒षवा॑ ज॒गार॑ । मम॑च्चि॒दाप॒: शिश॑वे ममृड्यु॒र्मम॑च्चि॒दिन्द्र॒: सह॒सोद॑तिष्ठत्
shlokas.transliteration: mámat ǀ caná ǀ tvā ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ parā-ā́sa ǀ mámat ǀ caná ǀ tvā ǀ kuṣávā ǀ jagā́ra ǀmámat ǀ cit ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ śíśave ǀ mamṛḍyuḥ ǀ mámat ǀ cit ǀ índraḥ ǀ sáhasā ǀ út ǀ atiṣṭhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāmadevaspeaks: exulting one youthful mother brought you forth; exulting, Kuṣavā swallowed you; exulting, the waters gave delight to the infant;Indra, exulting, rose up by his strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॑च्च॒न ते॑ मघव॒न्व्यं॑सो निविवि॒ध्वाँ अप॒ हनू॑ ज॒घान॑ । अधा॒ निवि॑द्ध॒ उत्त॑रो बभू॒वाञ्छिरो॑ दा॒सस्य॒ सं पि॑णग्व॒धेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: mámat ǀ caná ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ ví-aṃsaḥ ǀ ni-vividhvā́n ǀ ápa ǀ hánū íti ǀ jaghā́na ǀádha ǀ ní-viddhaḥ ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ babhūvā́n ǀ śíraḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀ vadhéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vyaṃsa, exulting and striking (hard blows), smote you,Maghavan, upon the jaw; whereupon, being so smitten, you proved the stronger, and did crush the head of the slave with the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒ष्टिः स॑सूव॒ स्थवि॑रं तवा॒गाम॑नाधृ॒ष्यं वृ॑ष॒भं तुम्र॒मिन्द्र॑म् । अरी॑ळ्हं व॒त्सं च॒रथा॑य मा॒ता स्व॒यं गा॒तुं त॒न्व॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: gṛṣṭíḥ ǀ sasūva ǀ stháviram ǀ tavāgā́m ǀ anādhṛṣyám ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ túmram ǀ índram ǀárīḷham ǀ vatsám ǀ caráthāya ǀ mātā́ ǀ svayám ǀ gātúm ǀ tanvé ǀ icchámānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a helper bears a calf, his mother, (Aditi), boreIndra, mature (in years), strong, irresisitble, vigorous, energetic, invincible, (destined) to follow his own course, heedful of his person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त मा॒ता म॑हि॒षमन्व॑वेनद॒मी त्वा॑ जहति पुत्र दे॒वाः । अथा॑ब्रवीद्वृ॒त्रमिन्द्रो॑ हनि॒ष्यन्त्सखे॑ विष्णो वित॒रं वि क्र॑मस्व
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ mātā́ ǀ mahiṣám ǀ ánu ǀ avenat ǀ amī́ íti ǀ tvā ǀ jahati ǀ putra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀátha ǀ abravīt ǀ vṛtrám ǀ índraḥ ǀ haniṣyán ǀ sákhe ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ kramasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His mother inquired of the mightyIndra, have these deities deserted you, my son? then Indra andViṣṇu, my friend (if you) purpose slayingVṛtraexert your greatest prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्ते॑ मा॒तरं॑ वि॒धवा॑मचक्रच्छ॒युं कस्त्वाम॑जिघांस॒च्चर॑न्तम् । कस्ते॑ दे॒वो अधि॑ मार्डी॒क आ॑सी॒द्यत्प्राक्षि॑णाः पि॒तरं॑ पाद॒गृह्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ te ǀ mātáram ǀ vidhávām ǀ acakrat ǀ śayúm ǀ káḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ ajighāṃsat ǀ cárantam ǀkáḥ ǀ te ǀ deváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ mārḍīké ǀ āsīt ǀ yát ǀ prá ǀ ákṣiṇāḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ pāda-gṛ́hya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who has made your mother a widow? who has sought to slay the sleeping and the walking? what deity has been more gracious than you since you have slain the father, having seized him by the foot?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑र्त्या॒ शुन॑ आ॒न्त्राणि॑ पेचे॒ न दे॒वेषु॑ विविदे मर्डि॒तार॑म् । अप॑श्यं जा॒यामम॑हीयमाना॒मधा॑ मे श्ये॒नो मध्वा ज॑भार
shlokas.transliteration: ávartyā ǀ śúnaḥ ǀ āntrā́ṇi ǀ pece ǀ ná ǀ devéṣu ǀ vivide ǀ marḍitā́ram ǀápaśyam ǀ jāyā́m ǀ ámahīyamānām ǀ ádha ǀ me ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ ā́ ǀ jabhāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In extreme destitution I have cooked the entrails of a dog; I have not found a comforter among the gods; I have beheld my wife disrsepected; then the falcon, (Indra), has brought to me sweet water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा त्वामि॑न्द्र वज्रि॒न्नत्र॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वास॑: सु॒हवा॑स॒ ऊमा॑: । म॒हामु॒भे रोद॑सी वृ॒द्धमृ॒ष्वं निरेक॒मिद्वृ॑णते वृत्र॒हत्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ vajrin ǀ átra ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ su-hávāsaḥ ǀ ū́māḥ ǀmahā́m ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vṛddhám ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ níḥ ǀ ékam ǀ ít ǀ gṛṇate ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thuderbolt, all the protecting deities who are reverently invoked, and both the heaven and the earth, glorify you who are verily one alone, mighty, vast, and plural asing of aspect, for the destruction ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॑सृजन्त॒ जिव्र॑यो॒ न दे॒वा भुव॑: स॒म्राळि॑न्द्र स॒त्ययो॑निः । अह॒न्नहिं॑ परि॒शया॑न॒मर्ण॒: प्र व॑र्त॒नीर॑रदो वि॒श्वधे॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ asṛjanta ǀ jívrayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ indra ǀ satyá-yoniḥ ǀáhan ǀ áhim ǀ pari-śáyānam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vartanī́ḥ ǀ aradaḥ ǀ viśvá-dhenāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As elders (send forth their young), so the gods have sent you (againstVṛtra); thence you became,Indrawho is the abode of truth, the soverign of the world; you have slain the slumbering Ahi for (the release of) the water and have marked out (the channels of) all the delighting rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अतृ॑प्णुवन्तं॒ विय॑तमबु॒ध्यमबु॑ध्यमानं सुषुपा॒णमि॑न्द्र । स॒प्त प्रति॑ प्र॒वत॑ आ॒शया॑न॒महिं॒ वज्रे॑ण॒ वि रि॑णा अप॒र्वन्
shlokas.transliteration: átṛpṇuvantam ǀ ví-yatam ǀ abudhyám ǀ ábudhyamānam ǀ susupānám ǀ indra ǀsaptá ǀ práti ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ áhim ǀ vájreṇa ǀ ví ǀ riṇāḥ ǀ aparván ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “On the day of full moon you have slain with the thunderbolt the insatiable, unnerved, ignorant, unapprehending, slumbering Ahi, obstructing the gliding-downward-flowing (streams).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्षो॑दय॒च्छव॑सा॒ क्षाम॑ बु॒ध्नं वार्ण वात॒स्तवि॑षीभि॒रिन्द्र॑: । दृ॒ळ्हान्यौ॑भ्नादु॒शमा॑न॒ ओजोऽवा॑भिनत्क॒कुभ॒: पर्व॑तानाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ákṣodayat ǀ śávasā ǀ kṣā́ma ǀ budhnám ǀ vā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀdṛḷhā́ni ǀ aubhnāt ǀ uśámānaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ áva ǀ abhinat ǀ kakúbhaḥ ǀ párvatānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by his strength, has agitated the exhausted firmament, as wind, by its violent (gusts, agitates) the water; exulting in his strength, he has divided the solid (clouds), and has shattered the peaks of the mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्र द॑द्रु॒र्जन॑यो॒ न गर्भं॒ रथा॑ इव॒ प्र य॑युः सा॒कमद्र॑यः । अत॑र्पयो वि॒सृत॑ उ॒ब्ज ऊ॒र्मीन्त्वं वृ॒ताँ अ॑रिणा इन्द्र॒ सिन्धू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ dadruḥ ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ gárbham ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ yayuḥ ǀ sākám ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀátarpayaḥ ǀ vi-sṛ́taḥ ǀ ubjáḥ ǀ ūrmī́n ǀ tvám ǀ vṛtā́n ǀ ariṇāḥ ǀ indra ǀ síndhūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutshave hastened to you like mother to their young; like chariots they have rushed in along (with you); you,Indra, have satisfied the following streams; you have shattered the clouds; you have set free the obstructed rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं म॒हीम॒वनिं॑ वि॒श्वधे॑नां तु॒र्वीत॑ये व॒य्या॑य॒ क्षर॑न्तीम् । अर॑मयो॒ नम॒सैज॒दर्ण॑: सुतर॒णाँ अ॑कृणोरिन्द्र॒ सिन्धू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ mahī́m ǀ avánim ǀ viśvá-dhenām ǀ turvī́taye ǀ vayyā́ya ǀ kṣárantīm ǀáramayaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ éjat ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ su-taraṇā́n ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ indra ǀ síndhūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have made the vast, all-cherishing, and exuberant earth, delighted with (abundant) food, and tremulous water, for (the sake of)Turvītiand Vayyā; you have made the rivers easy to be crosseḍ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राग्रुवो॑ नभ॒न्वो॒३॒॑ न वक्वा॑ ध्व॒स्रा अ॑पिन्वद्युव॒तीॠ॑त॒ज्ञाः । धन्वा॒न्यज्राँ॑ अपृणक्तृषा॒णाँ अधो॒गिन्द्र॑: स्त॒र्यो॒३॒॑ दंसु॑पत्नीः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ nabhanváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vákvāḥ ǀ dhvasrā́ḥ ǀ apinvat ǀ yuvatī́ḥ ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀdhánvāni ǀ ájrān ǀ apṛṇak ǀ tṛṣāṇā́n ǀ ádhok ǀ índraḥ ǀ staryáḥ ǀ dáṃ-supatnīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas filled the youthful rivers, the parents of plural nty, the corroders (of their banks), like  armies destructive (of their foes); he has inundated the dry lands, and (satisfied) the thirsty travellers; he has milked the barren cows whom theasurashad become the lords of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीरु॒षस॑: श॒रद॑श्च गू॒र्ता वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अ॑सृज॒द्वि सिन्धू॑न् । परि॑ष्ठिता अतृणद्बद्बधा॒नाः सी॒रा इन्द्र॒: स्रवि॑तवे पृथि॒व्या
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ gūrtā́ḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ asṛjat ǀ ví ǀ síndhūn ǀpári-sthitāḥ ǀ atṛṇat ǀ badbadhānā́ḥ ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ srávitave ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having slainVṛtra, he has liberated many mornings and years (that had been) swallowed up by darkness, and has set the rivers free;Indrahas released the imprisoned rivers, encompassed (by the cloud), to flow upon the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒म्रीभि॑: पु॒त्रम॒ग्रुवो॑ अदा॒नं नि॒वेश॑नाद्धरिव॒ आ ज॑भर्थ । व्य१॒॑न्धो अ॑ख्य॒दहि॑माददा॒नो निर्भू॑दुख॒च्छित्सम॑रन्त॒ पर्व॑
shlokas.transliteration: vamrī́bhiḥ ǀ putrám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ adānám ǀ ni-véśanāt ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jabhartha ǀví ǀ andháḥ ǀ akhyat ǀ áhim ǀ ā-dadānáḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ bhūt ǀ ukha-chít ǀ sám ǀ aranta ǀ párva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of horses, you have brought the son of Agru from his dwelling, where he was being devoured by the ants; when extricated, although blind, he distinguished the serpent; and when he came forth the joints that had been sundered in the ant-hill were restrung.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ पूर्वा॑णि॒ कर॑णानि विप्रावि॒द्वाँ आ॑ह वि॒दुषे॒ करां॑सि । यथा॑यथा॒ वृष्ण्या॑नि॒ स्वगू॒र्तापां॑सि राज॒न्नर्यावि॑वेषीः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ káraṇāni ǀ vipra ǀ ā-vidvā́n ǀ āha ǀ vidúṣe ǀ kárāṃsi ǀyáthā-yathā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ svá-gūrtā ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ rājan ǀ náryā ǀ áviveṣīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage, (Vāmadeva), knowing, royalIndra, the ancient deeds of you who are all wise, has proclaimed the actions, such as you ahve performed them, genitive rative of rain, self-evolved, and beneficial to man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒ इन्द्रो॑ दू॒रादा न॑ आ॒साद॑भिष्टि॒कृदव॑से यासदु॒ग्रः । ओजि॑ष्ठेभिर्नृ॒पति॒र्वज्र॑बाहुः सं॒गे स॒मत्सु॑ तु॒र्वणि॑: पृत॒न्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ āsā́t ǀ abhiṣṭi-kṛ́t ǀ ávase ǀ yāsat ǀ ugráḥ ǀójiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ nṛ-pátiḥ ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀ sam-gé ǀ samát-su ǀ turváṇiḥ ǀ pṛtanyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the illustriousIndra, the granter of desires, come to us, whether from afar or nigh, for our protection; he who is the lord of men, armed with the thunderbolt, overcoming his foes in conflict and in combats, (attended) by the most illustrious (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒ इन्द्रो॒ हरि॑भिर्या॒त्वच्छा॑र्वाची॒नोऽव॑से॒ राध॑से च । तिष्ठा॑ति व॒ज्री म॒घवा॑ विर॒प्शीमं य॒ज्ञमनु॑ नो॒ वाज॑सातौ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yātu ǀ áccha ǀ arvācīnáḥ ǀ ávase ǀ rā́dhase ǀ ca ǀtíṣṭhāti ǀ vajrī́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vi-rapśī́ ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ánu ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, looking down upon us, come with his steeds to our presence for our protection and enrichment; may the mighty thunderer, the possessor of wealth, (aiding us) in battle, be present at this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं त्वम॒स्माक॑मिन्द्र पु॒रो दध॑त्सनिष्यसि॒ क्रतुं॑ नः । श्व॒घ्नीव॑ वज्रिन्त्स॒नये॒ धना॑नां॒ त्वया॑ व॒यम॒र्य आ॒जिं ज॑येम
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ indra ǀ puráḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ saniṣyasi ǀ krátum ǀ naḥ ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ vajrin ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ājím ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, plural cing us before you, shall receive this sacrifice, our holy offering; and as the huntsman (kills his game), may we, your worshippers, holder of the thunderbolt, for the acquisition of riches through you to be victorious in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शन्नु॒ षु ण॑: सु॒मना॑ उपा॒के सोम॑स्य॒ नु सुषु॑तस्य स्वधावः । पा इ॑न्द्र॒ प्रति॑भृतस्य॒ मध्व॒: समन्ध॑सा ममदः पृ॒ष्ठ्ये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: uśán ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ upāké ǀ sómasya ǀ nú ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀpā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ práti-bhṛtasya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ándhasā ǀ mamadaḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhyéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the giver of food, be near to us, favourably disposed; and anxious for our (good), drink of the effused, prepared, exhilaratingSoma, and be plural ased by the (sacrificial) food (offered with the noon-day hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यो र॑र॒प्श ऋषि॑भि॒र्नवे॑भिर्वृ॒क्षो न प॒क्वः सृण्यो॒ न जेता॑ । मर्यो॒ न योषा॑म॒भि मन्य॑मा॒नोऽच्छा॑ विवक्मि पुरुहू॒तमिन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rarápśé ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ návebhiḥ ǀ vṛkṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pakváḥ ǀ sṛ́ṇyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jétā ǀmáryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣām ǀ abhí ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ vivakmi ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a man boasting of his wife, I glorify thatIndrawho is invoked of many, who is hymned by recent sages (who is) like a tree with ripe fruit, like a victorious (warrior), skilful in arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रिर्न यः स्वत॑वाँ ऋ॒ष्व इन्द्र॑: स॒नादे॒व सह॑से जा॒त उ॒ग्रः । आद॑र्ता॒ वज्रं॒ स्थवि॑रं॒ न भी॒म उ॒द्नेव॒ कोशं॒ वसु॑ना॒ न्यृ॑ष्टम्
shlokas.transliteration: giríḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ svá-tavān ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sanā́t ǀ evá ǀ sáhase ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀā́-dartā ǀ vájram ǀ stháviram ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ udnā́-iva ǀ kóśam ǀ vásunā ǀ ní-ṛṣṭam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is vast and self-sustained like a mountain, the radiant and formidableIndra, born of old for the destruction (of the foes of the gods), the wielder of the ancient thunderbolt, charged with splendour, like a jar (filled) with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यस्य॑ व॒र्ता ज॒नुषा॒ न्वस्ति॒ न राध॑स आमरी॒ता म॒घस्य॑ । उ॒द्वा॒वृ॒षा॒णस्त॑विषीव उग्रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ दद्धि पुरुहूत रा॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yásya ǀ vartā́ ǀ janúṣā ǀ nú ǀ ásti ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ ā-marītā́ ǀ maghásya ǀut-vavṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ taviṣī-vaḥ ǀ ugra ǀ asmábhyam ǀ daddhi ǀ puru-hūta ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom there is no opposer by (reason of) his birth nor any destroyer of the wealth that accomplishes (pious works); powerful and resplendent (Indra), the invoked of many, do you who are the showerer (of benefits) bestow upon us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईक्षे॑ रा॒यः क्षय॑स्य चर्षणी॒नामु॒त व्र॒जम॑पव॒र्तासि॒ गोना॑म् । शि॒क्षा॒न॒रः स॑मि॒थेषु॑ प्र॒हावा॒न्वस्वो॑ रा॒शिम॑भिने॒तासि॒ भूरि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́kṣe ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ utá ǀ vrajám ǀ apa-vartā́ ǀ asi ǀ gónām ǀśikṣā-naráḥ ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ prahā́-vān ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ rāśím ǀ abhi-netā́ ǀ asi ǀ bhū́rim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You rule over the riches and the dwellings of men; you are the rescuer of the herd of cattle; you are the giver of the instrumental uction, the smiter in battles, and the distributor of great heaps of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कया॒ तच्छृ॑ण्वे॒ शच्या॒ शचि॑ष्ठो॒ यया॑ कृ॒णोति॒ मुहु॒ का चि॑दृ॒ष्वः । पु॒रु दा॒शुषे॒ विच॑यिष्ठो॒ अंहोऽथा॑ दधाति॒ द्रवि॑णं जरि॒त्रे
shlokas.transliteration: káyā ǀ tát ǀ śṛṇve ǀ śácyā ǀ śáciṣṭhaḥ ǀ yáyā ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ múhu ǀ kā́ ǀ cit ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀpurú ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ví-cayiṣṭhaḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ átha ǀ dadhāti ǀ dráviṇam ǀ jaritré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By what wisdom is he who is most wise renowned by that wherewith the mightyIndrarepeatedly does (great things); he is the especial effacer of the manifold sin of the worshipper, and bestows wealth upon his adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ मर्धी॒रा भ॑रा द॒द्धि तन्न॒: प्र दा॒शुषे॒ दात॑वे॒ भूरि॒ यत्ते॑ । नव्ये॑ दे॒ष्णे श॒स्ते अ॒स्मिन्त॑ उ॒क्थे प्र ब्र॑वाम व॒यमि॑न्द्र स्तु॒वन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ daddhí ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ dā́tave ǀ bhū́ri ǀ yát ǀ te ǀnávye ǀ deṣṇé ǀ śasté ǀ asmín ǀ te ǀ ukthé ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǀ vayám ǀ indra ǀ stuvántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm us not, but cherish us,Indra; bestow upon us that abundant wealth which it is yours to give to the donor (of the oblation); praising you, we celebrate you at this sacred rite, which is new and excellent, and (at which the oblation) is proper to be presented.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past) glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॒त्विन्द्रोऽव॑स॒ उप॑ न इ॒ह स्तु॒तः स॑ध॒माद॑स्तु॒ शूर॑: । वा॒वृ॒धा॒नस्तवि॑षी॒र्यस्य॑ पू॒र्वीर्द्यौर्न क्ष॒त्रम॒भिभू॑ति॒ पुष्या॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ávase ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ ihá ǀ stutáḥ ǀ sadha-mā́t ǀ astu ǀ śū́raḥ ǀvavṛdhānáḥ ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣatrám ǀ abhí-bhūti ǀ púṣyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndracome to us for protection, and being praised (by us), may the mighty hero be exhilarated along with (us) at this rite; he whose energies are many; may he, like the radiant sun, recruit his own overpowering vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्येदि॒ह स्त॑वथ॒ वृष्ण्या॑नि तुविद्यु॒म्नस्य॑ तुवि॒राध॑सो॒ नॄन् । यस्य॒ क्रतु॑र्विद॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ न स॒म्राट् सा॒ह्वान्तरु॑त्रो अ॒भ्यस्ति॑ कृ॒ष्टीः
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ ít ǀ ihá ǀ stavatha ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ tuvi-dyumnásya ǀ tuvi-rā́dhasaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀyásya ǀ krátuḥ ǀ vidathyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ sahvā́n ǀ tárutraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ásti ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the powerful leaders of that renowned and opulent (Indra), whose victorious and protecting energy rules over men, like a universal sovereign entitled to veneration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॒त्विन्द्रो॑ दि॒व आ पृ॑थि॒व्या म॒क्षू स॑मु॒द्रादु॒त वा॒ पुरी॑षात् । स्व॑र्णरा॒दव॑से नो म॒रुत्वा॑न्परा॒वतो॑ वा॒ सद॑नादृ॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ índraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ samudrā́t ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ púrīṣāt ǀsváḥ-narāt ǀ ávase ǀ naḥ ǀ marútvān ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ vā ǀ sádanāt ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, accompanied by theMarutscome quickly for our protection, from the heaven, from the earth, from the firmament, or from the waters; from the sphere of the sun, from (any) distant region, from the abode of the rains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थू॒रस्य॑ रा॒यो बृ॑ह॒तो य ईशे॒ तमु॑ ष्टवाम वि॒दथे॒ष्विन्द्र॑म् । यो वा॒युना॒ जय॑ति॒ गोम॑तीषु॒ प्र धृ॑ष्णु॒या नय॑ति॒ वस्यो॒ अच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sthūrásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stavāma ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ índram ǀyáḥ ǀ vāyúnā ǀ jáyati ǀ gó-matīṣu ǀ prá ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ náyati ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify, in solemn rites, thisIndrawho rules over substantial, abundant riches; who by his prowess is victor over (hostile) hosts; who by his munificence brings excellent (wealth) to the presence (of his worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ यो नमो॒ नम॑सि स्तभा॒यन्निय॑र्ति॒ वाचं॑ ज॒नय॒न्यज॑ध्यै । ऋ॒ञ्ज॒सा॒नः पु॑रु॒वार॑ उ॒क्थैरेन्द्रं॑ कृण्वीत॒ सद॑नेषु॒ होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ yáḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ námasi ǀ stabhāyán ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáyan ǀ yájadhyai ǀṛñjasānáḥ ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ índram ǀ kṛṇvīta ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the invoking priest bring to our dwellings that (Indra) who, firmly fixing the (world) returns food for (sacrificial food), and (utters) a voice enjoining (men) to worship; he who is to be propitiated by praises, who is adored by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धि॒षा यदि॑ धिष॒ण्यन्त॑: सर॒ण्यान्त्सद॑न्तो॒ अद्रि॑मौशि॒जस्य॒ गोहे॑ । आ दु॒रोषा॑: पा॒स्त्यस्य॒ होता॒ यो नो॑ म॒हान्त्सं॒वर॑णेषु॒ वह्नि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dhiṣā́ ǀ yádi ǀ dhiṣaṇyántaḥ ǀ saraṇyā́n ǀ sádantaḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ auśijásya ǀ góhe ǀā́ ǀ duróṣāḥ ǀ pāstyásya ǀ hótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ sam-váraṇeṣu ǀ váhniḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the repeaters of (his) commendations, abiding in the dwelling of the worshipper, approachIndrawith praise, may he who is our (great) sustainer in conflicts, whose wrath is difficult to be (appeased), becomes the ministering priest of the master of the house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा यदीं॑ भार्व॒रस्य॒ वृष्ण॒: सिष॑क्ति॒ शुष्म॑: स्तुव॒ते भरा॑य । गुहा॒ यदी॑मौशि॒जस्य॒ गोहे॒ प्र यद्धि॒ये प्राय॑से॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ bhārvarásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ sísakti ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ bhárāya ǀgúhā ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ auśijásya ǀ góhe ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ dhiyé ǀ prá ǀ áyase ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “True it is that this might of the son of the protector of the world, the showerer (of benefits), affects for his advantage the offerer of praise; it (prevails) in the secret (thoughts) of the worshipper, and in his dwelling, for (the accomplishment of his) pious acts, (the attainment of his) desires, and his delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यद्वरां॑सि॒ पर्व॑तस्य वृ॒ण्वे पयो॑भिर्जि॒न्वे अ॒पां जवां॑सि । वि॒दद्गौ॒रस्य॑ गव॒यस्य॒ गोहे॒ यदी॒ वाजा॑य सु॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ वह॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yát ǀ várāṃsi ǀ párvatasya ǀ vṛṇvé ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ jinvé ǀ apā́m ǀ jávāṃsi ǀvidát ǀ gaurásya ǀ gavayásya ǀ góhe ǀ yádi ǀ vā́jāya ǀ su-dhyáḥ ǀ váhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as he has opened the doors of the cloud, and has supplied the rapid courses of the waters with (additional) torrents, so when the pious have recourse toIndrafor food, he finds (it) in the haunt of theGauraandGavaya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा ते॒ हस्ता॒ सुकृ॑तो॒त पा॒णी प्र॑य॒न्तारा॑ स्तुव॒ते राध॑ इन्द्र । का ते॒ निष॑त्ति॒: किमु॒ नो म॑मत्सि॒ किं नोदु॑दु हर्षसे॒ दात॒वा उ॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ hástā ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ utá ǀ pāṇī́ íti ǀ pra-yantā́rā ǀ stuvaté ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ indra ǀkā́ ǀ te ǀ ní-sattiḥ ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ mamatsi ǀ kím ǀ ná ǀ út-ut ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ harṣase ǀ dā́tavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your auspicioushands,Indra, are the doers of good deeds; your two hands, Indra, are the extenders of wealth to him who praises you; what, Indra, is this delay? why do you not exhilarate us? why are you not delighted to make us gifts?”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा वस्व॒ इन्द्र॑: स॒त्यः स॒म्राड्ढन्ता॑ वृ॒त्रं वरि॑वः पू॒रवे॑ कः । पुरु॑ष्टुत॒ क्रत्वा॑ नः शग्धि रा॒यो भ॑क्षी॒य तेऽव॑सो॒ दैव्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ satyáḥ ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ várivaḥ ǀ pūráve ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀpúru-stuta ǀ krátvā ǀ naḥ ǀ śagdhi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ bhakṣīyá ǀ te ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus (glorified),Indra, who is faithful (to his word), the lord of wealth, the slayer ofVṛtra, bestows rihes on man; so you, the praised of many, give us riches for our pious acts, that I may eat of your divine food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever delighted in your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्न॒ इन्द्रो॑ जुजु॒षे यच्च॒ वष्टि॒ तन्नो॑ म॒हान्क॑रति शु॒ष्म्या चि॑त् । ब्रह्म॒ स्तोमं॑ म॒घवा॒ सोम॑मु॒क्था यो अश्मा॑नं॒ शव॑सा॒ बिभ्र॒देति॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ jujuṣé ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ váṣṭi ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ karati ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀbráhma ǀ stómam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sómam ǀ ukthā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ áśmānam ǀ śávasā ǀ bíbhrat ǀ éti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since the great and mightyIndrais propitiated by our (oblations), since he desires (them) from us, may he, the possessor of opulence, who comes wielding the thunderbolt of his strength, accept the (sacrificial) food, the hymn, theSomalibation, and the prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ वृष॑न्धिं॒ चतु॑रश्रि॒मस्य॑न्नु॒ग्रो बा॒हुभ्यां॒ नृत॑म॒: शची॑वान् । श्रि॒ये परु॑ष्णीमु॒षमा॑ण॒ ऊर्णां॒ यस्या॒: पर्वा॑णि स॒ख्याय॑ वि॒व्ये
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣandhim ǀ cátuḥ-aśrim ǀ ásyan ǀ ugráḥ ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ śácī-vān ǀśriyé ǀ páruṣṇīm ǀ uṣámāṇaḥ ǀ ū́rṇām ǀ yásyāḥ ǀ párvāṇi ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ vivyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits), casting with hishandsthe quadrangular bolt that causes rain, fierce, the chief of leaders, the achiever of (glorious) acts, is desirous of the prosperity of the investing Paruṣṇi (river), whose (bordering) districts he has frequented through regard.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो दे॒वो दे॒वत॑मो॒ जाय॑मानो म॒हो वाजे॑भिर्म॒हद्भि॑श्च॒ शुष्मै॑: । दधा॑नो॒ वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोरु॒शन्तं॒ द्याममे॑न रेजय॒त्प्र भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devá-tamaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ uśántam ǀ dyā́m ǀ ámena ǀ rejayat ǀ prá ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who diine, most divine, as soon as born (was endowed) with abundant viands, and great energies, holding in his arms the willing thunderbolt, and causing by his strength (both) heaven and earth to tremble.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॒ रोधां॑सि प्र॒वत॑श्च पू॒र्वीर्द्यौॠ॒ष्वाज्जनि॑मन्रेजत॒ क्षाः । आ मा॒तरा॒ भर॑ति शु॒ष्म्या गोर्नृ॒वत्परि॑ज्मन्नोनुवन्त॒ वाता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ródhāṃsi ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́t ǀ jániman ǀ rejata ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ bhárati ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ góḥ ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ pári-jman ǀ nonuvanta ǀ vā́tāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the high plural ces, and the many low paces, the heaven and the earth, trembled (through fear) of the mighty (Indra) at his birth; the strong (Indra) cherishes the parents of the moving (Sun), and the winds, like men, make a noise in their peregrination.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता तू त॑ इन्द्र मह॒तो म॒हानि॒ विश्वे॒ष्वित्सव॑नेषु प्र॒वाच्या॑ । यच्छू॑र धृष्णो धृष॒ता द॑धृ॒ष्वानहिं॒ वज्रे॑ण॒ शव॒सावि॑वेषीः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ tú ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mahā́ni ǀ víśveṣu ǀ ít ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ pra-vā́cyā ǀyát ǀ śūra ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ dadhṛṣvā́n ǀ áhim ǀ vájreṇa ǀ śávasā ǀ áviveṣīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of you,Indra, who are mighty, great are deeds, and to be proclaimed at all sacrifices, inasmuch as, high-minded hero, you, sustaining (the world), have by your strength slain Ahi with the resistless thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता तू ते॑ स॒त्या तु॑विनृम्ण॒ विश्वा॒ प्र धे॒नव॑: सिस्रते॒ वृष्ण॒ ऊध्न॑: । अधा॑ ह॒ त्वद्वृ॑षमणो भिया॒नाः प्र सिन्ध॑वो॒ जव॑सा चक्रमन्त
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ tú ǀ te ǀ satyā́ ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ víśvā ǀ prá ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ sisrate ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ ū́dhnaḥ ǀádha ǀ ha ǀ tvát ǀ vṛṣa-manaḥ ǀ bhiyānā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ jávasā ǀ cakramanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most powerfulIndra, all these, your exploits, are verily true: (through fear of you), the showerer (of benefits), the cows shed (milk) from their udders; then, benevolent-minded (Indra), the rivers, fearing you, flow with rapidity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्राह॑ ते हरिव॒स्ता उ॑ दे॒वीरवो॑भिरिन्द्र स्तवन्त॒ स्वसा॑रः । यत्सी॒मनु॒ प्र मु॒चो ब॑द्बधा॒ना दी॒र्घामनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं स्यन्द॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: átra ǀ áha ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ stavanta ǀ svásāraḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ mucáḥ ǀ badbadhānā́ḥ ǀ dīrghā́m ǀ ánu ǀ prá-sitim ǀ syandayádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then,Indra, lord of horses, the divine sister (rivers) praise (you) for your protection when you did set them free to flow, after having been impeded (byVṛtra) through a long confinement.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒पी॒ळे अं॒शुर्मद्यो॒ न सिन्धु॒रा त्वा॒ शमी॑ शशमा॒नस्य॑ श॒क्तिः । अ॒स्म॒द्र्य॑क्छुशुचा॒नस्य॑ यम्या आ॒शुर्न र॒श्मिं तु॒व्योज॑सं॒ गोः
shlokas.transliteration: pipīḷé ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ mádyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ śámī ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ śaktíḥ ǀasmadryák ǀ śuśucānásya ǀ yamyāḥ ǀ āśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmím ǀ tuvi-ójasam ǀ góḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilaratingSomajuice has been expressed; now may the curren flow to you, and may the expiatory power of the illustrious utterer of praise be directed towards us, as the quick rider holds firmly the reins of the steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे वर्षि॑ष्ठा कृणुहि॒ ज्येष्ठा॑ नृ॒म्णानि॑ स॒त्रा स॑हुरे॒ सहां॑सि । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ वृ॒त्रा सु॒हना॑नि रन्धि ज॒हि वध॑र्व॒नुषो॒ मर्त्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ várṣiṣṭhā ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ jyéṣṭhā ǀ nṛmṇā́ni ǀ satrā́ ǀ sahure ǀ sáhāṃsi ǀasmábhyam ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ su-hánāni ǀ randhi ǀ jahí ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “EnduringIndra, bestow upon us energies, excellent, superior, powerful; bring under subjection to us enemies deserving of death; demolish the weapon of the malevolent man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॒मित्सु शृ॑णुहि॒ त्वमि॑न्द्रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्राँ उप॑ माहि॒ वाजा॑न् । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ विश्वा॑ इषण॒: पुरं॑धीर॒स्माकं॒ सु म॑घवन्बोधि गो॒दाः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ít ǀ sú ǀ śṛṇuhi ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrā́n ǀ úpa ǀ māhi ǀ vā́jān ǀasmábhyam ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ iṣaṇaḥ ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ sú ǀ magha-van ǀ bodhi ǀ go-dā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear our praises,Indra, and bestow upon us many kinds of food; fulfil all our desires, and know yourself,Maghavan, to be to us the donor of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in (your) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था म॒हाम॑वृध॒त्कस्य॒ होतु॑र्य॒ज्ञं जु॑षा॒णो अ॒भि सोम॒मूध॑: । पिब॑न्नुशा॒नो जु॒षमा॑णो॒ अन्धो॑ वव॒क्ष ऋ॒ष्वः शु॑च॒ते धना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ mahā́m ǀ avṛdhat ǀ kásya ǀ hótuḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sómam ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀpíban ǀ uśānáḥ ǀ juṣámāṇaḥ ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ vavakṣé ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ śucaté ǀ dhánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In what manner may (any one) extol the mightyIndra? at the sacrifice of what worshipper may he, propitiated, be present, drinking the sacrificialSomabeverage, desirous of the (sacred) food, and plural ased (by the oblation)? the mighty Indra is borne (to the rite) for the purpose of bestowing brilliant wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॑स्य वी॒रः स॑ध॒माद॑माप॒ समा॑नंश सुम॒तिभि॒: को अ॑स्य । कद॑स्य चि॒त्रं चि॑किते॒ कदू॒ती वृ॒धे भु॑वच्छशमा॒नस्य॒ यज्यो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ asya ǀ vīráḥ ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǀ āpa ǀ sám ǀ ānaṃśa ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ asya ǀkát ǀ asya ǀ citrám ǀ cikite ǀ kát ǀ ūtī́ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhuvat ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ yájyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What hero has enjoyed his fellowship (in battle)? who has been a sharer in his benevolent thoughts? when does any one appreciate his wonderful bounty? when is he (presen) for the promotion of the prosperity of the man who glorifies and worships him?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था शृ॑णोति हू॒यमा॑न॒मिन्द्र॑: क॒था शृ॒ण्वन्नव॑सामस्य वेद । का अ॑स्य पू॒र्वीरुप॑मातयो ह क॒थैन॑माहु॒: पपु॑रिं जरि॒त्रे
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ śṛṇoti ǀ hūyámānam ǀ índraḥ ǀ kathā́ ǀ śṛṇván ǀ ávasām ǀ asya ǀ veda ǀkā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ úpa-mātayaḥ ǀ ha ǀ kathā́ ǀ enam ǀ āhuḥ ǀ pápurim ǀ jaritré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How is thatIndrahears (the worshipper) who invokes him? and, hearing, how does he know his necessities? what are his gifts of old; why have they termed him the fulfiller (of the desires) of him who offers praise?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था स॒बाध॑: शशमा॒नो अ॑स्य॒ नश॑द॒भि द्रवि॑णं॒ दीध्या॑नः । दे॒वो भु॑व॒न्नवे॑दा म ऋ॒तानां॒ नमो॑ जगृ॒भ्वाँ अ॒भि यज्जुजो॑षत्
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ asya ǀ náśat ǀ abhí ǀ dráviṇam ǀ dī́dhyānaḥ ǀdeváḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀ návedāḥ ǀ me ǀ ṛtā́nām ǀ námaḥ ǀ jagṛbhvā́n ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ jújoṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How does he who glorifiesIndra, and is diligent in his worship, although encountering opposition, obtain from him wealth? may the divine Indra be the appreciation of my praises, when accepting the sacrificial food he is propitiated towards me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था कद॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ दे॒वो मर्त॑स्य स॒ख्यं जु॑जोष । क॒था कद॑स्य स॒ख्यं सखि॑भ्यो॒ ये अ॑स्मि॒न्कामं॑ सु॒युजं॑ तत॒स्रे
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ kát ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ jujoṣa ǀkathā́ ǀ kát ǀ asya ǀ sakhyám ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ asmin ǀ kā́mam ǀ su-yújam ǀ tatasré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, in what manner, at the dawning of this morning, has the divineIndraaccepted the friendship of a mortal? when and in what manner, (is) his friendship (manifested) to the friends who have spread out the desirable and suitable (offering) before him?”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमादम॑त्रं स॒ख्यं सखि॑भ्यः क॒दा नु ते॑ भ्रा॒त्रं प्र ब्र॑वाम । श्रि॒ये सु॒दृशो॒ वपु॑रस्य॒ सर्गा॒: स्व१॒॑र्ण चि॒त्रत॑ममिष॒ आ गोः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ā́t ǀ ámatram ǀ sakhyám ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ bhrātrám ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǀśriyé ǀ su-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ vápuḥ ǀ asya ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ citrá-tamam ǀ iṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ góḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we in any manner proclaim your friendship for your friends? when may (we make known) your fraternal regard? the efforts of the well-lookingIndraare for the happiness of all; the wonderful form of the moving (Indra) is, like the sun, ever wished for.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्रुहं॒ जिघां॑सन्ध्व॒रस॑मनि॒न्द्रां तेति॑क्ते ति॒ग्मा तु॒जसे॒ अनी॑का । ऋ॒णा चि॒द्यत्र॑ ऋण॒या न॑ उ॒ग्रो दू॒रे अज्ञा॑ता उ॒षसो॑ बबा॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: drúham ǀ jíghāṃsan ǀ dhvarásam ǀ anindrā́m ǀ tétikte ǀ tigmā́ ǀ tujáse ǀ ánīkā ǀṛṇā́ ǀ cit ǀ yátra ǀ ṛṇa-yā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ dūré ǀ ájñātāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ babādhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resolving to kil the oppressing, malevolent (rākṣasi), not acknowledgingIndra, he sharpened his sharp weapons for (her) destruction, and the fierce (Indra) the canceller of debts, has kept afar the unknown dawns in which the debts (are to be paid).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॒ हि शु॒रुध॒: सन्ति॑ पू॒र्वीॠ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिर्वृ॑जि॒नानि॑ हन्ति । ऋ॒तस्य॒ श्लोको॑ बधि॒रा त॑तर्द॒ कर्णा॑ बुधा॒नः शु॒चमा॑न आ॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ hí ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītíḥ ǀ vṛjinā́ni ǀ hanti ǀṛtásya ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ badhirā́ ǀ tatarda ǀ kárṇā ǀ budhānáḥ ǀ śucámānaḥ ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the waters of ṛta; the adoration of ṛta destroys iniquities; the intelligent and brilliant praise of ṛta has opened the deaf (ears) of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ दृ॒ळ्हा ध॒रुणा॑नि सन्ति पु॒रूणि॑ च॒न्द्रा वपु॑षे॒ वपूं॑षि । ऋ॒तेन॑ दी॒र्घमि॑षणन्त॒ पृक्ष॑ ऋ॒तेन॒ गाव॑ ऋ॒तमा वि॑वेशुः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ dharúṇāni ǀ santi ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ candrā́ ǀ vápuṣe ǀ vápūṃṣi ǀṛténa ǀ dīrghám ǀ iṣaṇanta ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the stable, sustaining, delightful forms of the embodied ṛta; the ṛta are (the pious) expectant of food; by ṛta have the kine entered into the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं ये॑मा॒न ऋ॒तमिद्व॑नोत्यृ॒तस्य॒ शुष्म॑स्तुर॒या उ॑ ग॒व्युः । ऋ॒ताय॑ पृ॒थ्वी ब॑हु॒ले ग॑भी॒रे ऋ॒ताय॑ धे॒नू प॑र॒मे दु॑हाते
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ vanoti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ tura-yā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ gavyúḥ ǀṛtā́ya ǀ pṛthvī́ íti ǀ bahulé íti ǀ gabhīré íti ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ dhenū́ íti ǀ paramé íti ǀ duhāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (worshipper) subjecting ṛta (to his will) verily enjoys ṛta; the strength ṛta is (developed) with speed, and is desirous of (possessing) water; to ṛta belong the wide and profound heaven and earth; supreme kine, they yield their milk to ṛta.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का सु॑ष्टु॒तिः शव॑सः सू॒नुमिन्द्र॑मर्वाची॒नं राध॑स॒ आ व॑वर्तत् । द॒दिर्हि वी॒रो गृ॑ण॒ते वसू॑नि॒ स गोप॑तिर्नि॒ष्षिधां॑ नो जनासः
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ índram ǀ arvācīnám ǀ rā́dhase ǀ ā́ ǀ vavartat ǀdadíḥ ǀ hí ǀ vīráḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ vásūni ǀ sáḥ ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ niḥ-sídhām ǀ naḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What suitable praise may bring the son of strength,Indra, before us, to give us wealth; the hero, the lord of cattle, is the donor, oḥ man, of the wealth of his adversaries to him who glorifies him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॒ हव्य॒: स ईड्य॒: स सुष्टु॑त॒ इन्द्र॑: स॒त्यरा॑धाः । स याम॒न्ना म॒घवा॒ मर्त्या॑य ब्रह्मण्य॒ते सुष्व॑ये॒ वरि॑वो धात्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ satyá-rādhāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ ā́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ mártyāya ǀ brahmaṇyaté ǀ súsvaye ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He,Indra, is to be invoked for the destruction ofVṛtra; he, the deservedly praised, is to be worshipped; the real donor of wealth, he,Maghavan, gives wealth, (acquired) in battle, to the mortal offers him prayer and libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिन्नरो॒ वि ह्व॑यन्ते समी॒के रि॑रि॒क्वांस॑स्त॒न्व॑: कृण्वत॒ त्राम् । मि॒थो यत्त्या॒गमु॒भया॑सो॒ अग्म॒न्नर॑स्तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑यस्य सा॒तौ
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ náraḥ ǀ ví ǀ hvayante ǀ sam-īké ǀ ririkvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ kṛṇvata ǀ trā́m ǀmitháḥ ǀ yát ǀ tyāgám ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ ágman ǀ náraḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men verily call upon him in battle; the (devout) inflicters of austerity upon their person ns constitute him their preserver; when both (the worshipper and the priest) approach together the bountifulIndra, men (succeed) in (obtaining) the gift of sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्र॒तू॒यन्ति॑ क्षि॒तयो॒ योग॑ उग्राशुषा॒णासो॑ मि॒थो अर्ण॑सातौ । सं यद्विशोऽव॑वृत्रन्त यु॒ध्मा आदिन्नेम॑ इन्द्रयन्ते अ॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: kratu-yánti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ yóge ǀ ugra ǀ āśuṣāṇā́saḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǀ árṇa-sātau ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ávavṛtranta ǀ yudhmā́ḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ néme ǀ indrayante ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulIndra, men variously dispersed, come mutually together to celebrate sacred rites for the sake of obtaining rain; when men who are combatants assemble in battle, there are some of them who rely upon Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदिद्ध॒ नेम॑ इन्द्रि॒यं य॑जन्त॒ आदित्प॒क्तिः पु॑रो॒ळाशं॑ रिरिच्यात् । आदित्सोमो॒ वि प॑पृच्या॒दसु॑ष्वी॒नादिज्जु॑जोष वृष॒भं यज॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ ha ǀ néme ǀ indriyám ǀ yajante ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ paktíḥ ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ riricyāt ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ví ǀ papṛcyāt ǀ ásusvīn ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ jujoṣa ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ yájadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereupon some verily worship the powerful (Indra); thereupon one man prepares the buttered cake that he may offer it to (Indra); thereupon the offerer of theSomahe distinguishes from him who presents no libation; thereupon some one rejoices to worship the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒णोत्य॑स्मै॒ वरि॑वो॒ य इ॒त्थेन्द्रा॑य॒ सोम॑मुश॒ते सु॒नोति॑ । स॒ध्री॒चीने॑न॒ मन॒सावि॑वेन॒न्तमित्सखा॑यं कृणुते स॒मत्सु॑
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṇóti ǀ asmai ǀ várivaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ uśaté ǀ sunóti ǀsadhrīcī́nena ǀ mánasā ǀ ávi-venan ǀ tám ǀ ít ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ samát-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrabestows wealth upon him who offers a libation to him, desiring it, though in another sphere; and, with a humble mind, makes him who is devoted to him his friend in combats.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इन्द्रा॑य सु॒नव॒त्सोम॑म॒द्य पचा॑त्प॒क्तीरु॒त भृ॒ज्जाति॑ धा॒नाः । प्रति॑ मना॒योरु॒चथा॑नि॒ हर्य॒न्तस्मि॑न्दध॒द्वृष॑णं॒ शुष्म॒मिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sunávat ǀ sómam ǀ adyá ǀ pácāt ǀ paktī́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ bhṛjjā́ti ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀpráti ǀ manāyóḥ ǀ ucáthāni ǀ háryan ǀ tásmin ǀ dadhat ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraaccepting graciously the praises of his devoted (worshipper), who today pours out the libation to him who toasts the buttered cakes, or fries barley for Indra, exercises towards him the power that grants his desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒दा स॑म॒र्यं व्यचे॒दृघा॑वा दी॒र्घं यदा॒जिम॒भ्यख्य॑द॒र्यः । अचि॑क्रद॒द्वृष॑णं॒ पत्न्यच्छा॑ दुरो॒ण आ निशि॑तं सोम॒सुद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ sa-maryám ǀ ví ǀ ácet ǀ ṛ́ghāvā ǀ dīrghám ǀ yát ǀ ājím ǀ abhí ǀ ákhyat ǀ aryáḥ ǀácikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ pátnī ǀ áccha ǀ duroṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-śitam ǀ somasút-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the destroyer (of enemies) distinguishes a mortal foe; when the lord is engaged in the long (continued) battle, (his) bride summons to the dwelling the showerer (of benefits), encompassed by the offerers of the libation.”
