shlokas.sanskrit: भूय॑सा व॒स्नम॑चर॒त्कनी॒योऽवि॑क्रीतो अकानिषं॒ पुन॒र्यन् । स भूय॑सा॒ कनी॑यो॒ नारि॑रेचीद्दी॒ना दक्षा॒ वि दु॑हन्ति॒ प्र वा॒णम्
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́yasā ǀ vasnám ǀ acarat ǀ kánīyaḥ ǀ ávi-krītaḥ ǀ akāniṣam ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yán ǀsáḥ ǀ bhū́yasā ǀ kánīyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ arirecīt ǀ dīnā́ḥ ǀ dákṣāḥ ǀ ví ǀ duhanti ǀ prá ǀ vāṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A man has realized a small price for an article of great value, and again coming (to the buyer he says) this has not been sold; I require the full price; but he does not recover a small price by a large (equivalent); whether helpless or clever they adhere to their bargain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क इ॒मं द॒शभि॒र्ममेन्द्रं॑ क्रीणाति धे॒नुभि॑: । य॒दा वृ॒त्राणि॒ जङ्घ॑न॒दथै॑नं मे॒ पुन॑र्ददत्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ imám ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ máma ǀ índram ǀ krīṇāti ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jáṅghanat ǀ átha ǀ enam ǀ me ǀ púnaḥ ǀ dadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who buys him, myIndra, with ten kine? when he shall have slain (your) foes, then let (the purchaser) give him again to me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू ष्टु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ नू गृ॑णा॒न इषं॑ जरि॒त्रे न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ न पी॑पेः । अका॑रि ते हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॒ नव्यं॑ धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ stutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ jaritré ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pīperíti pīpeḥ ǀákāri ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified (in the past), glorified,Indra, at present, satisfy your worshipper with food, as rivers (are filled with water); lord of horses, a new hymn has been made for you; may we, possessed of chariots, be ever diligent in your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒द्य नर्यो॑ दे॒वका॑म उ॒शन्निन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यं जु॑जोष । को वा॑ म॒हेऽव॑से॒ पार्या॑य॒ समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्नौ सु॒तसो॑म ईट्टे
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ adyá ǀ náryaḥ ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǀ uśán ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ jujoṣa ǀkáḥ ǀ vā ǀ mahé ǀ ávase ǀ pā́ryāya ǀ sám-iddhe ǀ agnáu ǀ sutá-somaḥ ǀ īṭṭe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What friend of man, or worshipper of the gods, deserving the friendship ofIndra, has today enjoyed (it)? or what offerer of the libation on the kindled fire praises him (sufficiently) for his great and unbounded protection?”

shlokas.sanskrit: को ना॑नाम॒ वच॑सा सो॒म्याय॑ मना॒युर्वा॑ भवति॒ वस्त॑ उ॒स्राः । क इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यं॒ कः स॑खि॒त्वं को भ्रा॒त्रं व॑ष्टि क॒वये॒ क ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nanāma ǀ vácasā ǀ somyā́ya ǀ manāyúḥ ǀ vā ǀ bhavati ǀ váste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀkáḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ yújyam ǀ káḥ ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ káḥ ǀ bhrātrám ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ kaváye ǀ káḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who has reverenced with (suitable) words the (deity) worthy of the libation? who is devoted (to him)? who supports the cattle (given by him)? who desires the society ofIndra? who his friendship? who his fraternity? who (has recourse) to the sage Indra for protection?”

shlokas.sanskrit: को दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ अ॒द्या वृ॑णीते॒ क आ॑दि॒त्याँ अदि॑तिं॒ ज्योति॑रीट्टे । कस्या॒श्विना॒विन्द्रो॑ अ॒ग्निः सु॒तस्यां॒शोः पि॑बन्ति॒ मन॒सावि॑वेनम्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vṛṇīté ǀ káḥ ǀ ādityā́n ǀ áditim ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ īṭṭe ǀkásya ǀ aśvínau ǀ índraḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ aṃśóḥ ǀ pibanti ǀ mánasā ǀ ávi-venam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who solicits today the protection of the gods? who glorifies theĀdityas,Aditi, light? of whose effused libation to theAśvins,Indra,Agni, drink at will propitiated by his praise?”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मा॑ अ॒ग्निर्भार॑त॒: शर्म॑ यंस॒ज्ज्योक्प॑श्या॒त्सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्तम् । य इन्द्रा॑य सु॒नवा॒मेत्याह॒ नरे॒ नर्या॑य॒ नृत॑माय नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ agníḥ ǀ bhā́rataḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǀ jyók ǀ paśyāt ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǀyáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sunávāma ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǀ náre ǀ náryāya ǀ nṛ́-tamāya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the bearer of oblations, grant him felicity, and long behold the rising sun (in the dwelling of him) who says, let us offer libations toIndra, leader (of rites) the friend of man, the chief leader among leaders.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तं जि॑नन्ति ब॒हवो॒ न द॒भ्रा उ॒र्व॑स्मा॒ अदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यंसत् । प्रि॒यः सु॒कृत्प्रि॒य इन्द्रे॑ मना॒युः प्रि॒यः सु॑प्रा॒वीः प्रि॒यो अ॑स्य सो॒मी
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ jinanti ǀ bahávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dabhrā́ḥ ǀ urú ǀ asmai ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǀpriyáḥ ǀ su-kṛ́t ǀ priyáḥ ǀ índre ǀ manāyúḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ supra-avī́ḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ asya ǀ somī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him neither many nor few can molest; mayAditigrant him infinite happiness; the performer of pious acts is dear (toIndra); dear to Indra is he whose mind is intent upon him; dear is he who approaches him with homage; dear to him is the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्रा॒व्य॑: प्राशु॒षाळे॒ष वी॒रः सुष्वे॑: प॒क्तिं कृ॑णुते॒ केव॒लेन्द्र॑: । नासु॑ष्वेरा॒पिर्न सखा॒ न जा॒मिर्दु॑ष्प्रा॒व्यो॑ऽवह॒न्तेदवा॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: supra-avyáḥ ǀ prāśuṣā́ṭ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ súsveḥ ǀ paktím ǀ kṛṇute ǀ kévalā ǀ índraḥ ǀná ǀ ásusveḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ ná ǀ sákhā ǀ ná ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ duḥpra-avyáḥ ǀ ava-hantā́ ǀ ít ǀ ávācaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This hero,Indra, the prompt discomfiter (of foes), who is to be approached with homage, grants special maturity to the presenter of the libation; he is not the kinsman, nor friend, nor relative, of him who offers no libation (to him); he is difficult of access, and the punisher of him who repeats not (his) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न रे॒वता॑ प॒णिना॑ स॒ख्यमिन्द्रोऽसु॑न्वता सुत॒पाः सं गृ॑णीते । आस्य॒ वेद॑: खि॒दति॒ हन्ति॑ न॒ग्नं वि सुष्व॑ये प॒क्तये॒ केव॑लो भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ revátā ǀ paṇínā ǀ sakhyám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ásunvatā ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ gṛṇīte ǀā́ ǀ asya ǀ védaḥ ǀ khidáti ǀ hánti ǀ nagnám ǀ ví ǀ súsvaye ǀ paktáye ǀ kévalaḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), the drinker of the effusedSoma, contract no friendship with the wealthy trader who offers not any libation; he takes away his wealth; destroys him when destitute; but he is a special (friend) to him who presents the libation and oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ परेऽव॑रे मध्य॒मास॒ इन्द्रं॒ यान्तोऽव॑सितास॒ इन्द्र॑म् । इन्द्रं॑ क्षि॒यन्त॑ उ॒त युध्य॑माना॒ इन्द्रं॒ नरो॑ वाज॒यन्तो॑ हवन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ páre ǀ ávare ǀ madhyamā́saḥ ǀ índram ǀ yā́ntaḥ ǀ áva-sitāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀíndram ǀ kṣiyántaḥ ǀ utá ǀ yúdhyamānāḥ ǀ índram ǀ náraḥ ǀ vājayántaḥ ǀ havante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most exalted, the most humble, (invoke)Indra; the middle (classes) invoke Indra; those going, those stopping, (invoke) Indra; those dwelling at home, those going in battle, (invoke) Indra; men needing food invoke Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं मनु॑रभवं॒ सूर्य॑श्चा॒हं क॒क्षीवाँ॒ ऋषि॑रस्मि॒ विप्र॑: । अ॒हं कुत्स॑मार्जुने॒यं न्यृ॑ञ्जे॒ऽहं क॒विरु॒शना॒ पश्य॑ता मा
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ mánuḥ ǀ abhavam ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ca ǀ ahám ǀ kakṣī́vān ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ asmi ǀ vípraḥ ǀahám ǀ kútsam ǀ ārjuneyám ǀ ní ǀ ṛñje ǀ ahám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ uśánā ǀ páśyata ǀ mā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have beenManuandSūrya; I am the wise ṛṣi:Kakṣīvat; I have befriendedKutsa, the son ofArjuni; I am the far-seeingUśanās; so behold me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं भूमि॑मददा॒मार्या॑या॒हं वृ॒ष्टिं दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य । अ॒हम॒पो अ॑नयं वावशा॒ना मम॑ दे॒वासो॒ अनु॒ केत॑मायन्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ bhū́mim ǀ adadām ǀ ā́ryāya ǀ ahám ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀahám ǀ apáḥ ǀ anayam ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ máma ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kétam ǀ āyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I gave the earth to the venerable (Manu); I have bestowed rain upon the mortal who presents (oblations); I have let forth the sounding waters; the gods obey my will.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं पुरो॑ मन्दसा॒नो व्यै॑रं॒ नव॑ सा॒कं न॑व॒तीः शम्ब॑रस्य । श॒त॒त॒मं वे॒श्यं॑ स॒र्वता॑ता॒ दिवो॑दासमतिथि॒ग्वं यदाव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ púraḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ airam ǀ náva ǀ sākám ǀ navatī́ḥ ǀ śámbarasya ǀśata-tamám ǀ veśyám ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ yát ǀ ā́vam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarated (by theSomabeverage) I have destroyed the ninety and nine cities ofŚambara, the hundredth I gave to be occupied byDivodāsawhen I protected him,Atithigva, at his sacrifice. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु ष विभ्यो॑ मरुतो॒ विर॑स्तु॒ प्र श्ये॒नः श्ये॒नेभ्य॑ आशु॒पत्वा॑ । अ॒च॒क्रया॒ यत्स्व॒धया॑ सुप॒र्णो ह॒व्यं भर॒न्मन॑वे दे॒वजु॑ष्टम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ sáḥ ǀ ví-bhyaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ víḥ ǀ astu ǀ prá ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ śyenébhyaḥ ǀ āśu-pátvā ǀacakráyā ǀ yát ǀ svadháyā ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ havyám ǀ bhárat ǀ mánave ǀ devá-juṣṭam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this bird,Maruts, be pre-eminent over (other) hawks, since with a wheelless car the swift-winged bore theSoma, accepted by the gods, toManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भर॒द्यदि॒ विरतो॒ वेवि॑जानः प॒थोरुणा॒ मनो॑जवा असर्जि । तूयं॑ ययौ॒ मधु॑ना सो॒म्येनो॒त श्रवो॑ विविदे श्ये॒नो अत्र॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhárat ǀ yádi ǀ víḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ vévijānaḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ urúṇā ǀ mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ asarji ǀtū́yam ǀ yayau ǀ mádhunā ǀ somyéna ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vivide ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ átra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the bird, intimidating (its guardians), carried off from hence (theSoma) it was at large; (flying) swift as thought along the vast path (of the firmament), it went rapidly with the sweet Soma, and the hawks thence acquired the celebrity in this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जी॒पी श्ये॒नो दद॑मानो अं॒शुं प॑रा॒वत॑: शकु॒नो म॒न्द्रं मद॑म् । सोमं॑ भरद्दादृहा॒णो दे॒वावा॑न्दि॒वो अ॒मुष्मा॒दुत्त॑रादा॒दाय॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjīpī́ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ dádamānaḥ ǀ aṃśúm ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ śakunáḥ ǀ mandrám ǀ mádam ǀsómam ǀ bharat ǀ dadṛhāṇáḥ ǀ devá-vān ǀ diváḥ ǀ amúṣmāt ǀ út-tarāt ǀ ā-dā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The straight-flying hawk, conveying theSomafrom afar; the bird, attended by the gods, brought, resolute of purpose, the adorable exhilarating Soma, having taken it from that lofty heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दाय॑ श्ये॒नो अ॑भर॒त्सोमं॑ स॒हस्रं॑ स॒वाँ अ॒युतं॑ च सा॒कम् । अत्रा॒ पुरं॑धिरजहा॒दरा॑ती॒र्मदे॒ सोम॑स्य मू॒रा अमू॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: ā-dā́ya ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ abharat ǀ sómam ǀ sahásram ǀ savā́n ǀ ayútam ǀ ca ǀ sākám ǀátra ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ajahāt ǀ árātīḥ ǀ máde ǀ sómasya ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǀ ámūraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having taken it, the hawk brought theSomawith him to a thousand and ten thousand sacrifices, and this being provided, the performer of many (great) deeds, the unbewildered (Indra) destroyed, in the exhilaration of the Soma, (his) bewildered foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गर्भे॒ नु सन्नन्वे॑षामवेदम॒हं दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मानि॒ विश्वा॑ । श॒तं मा॒ पुर॒ आय॑सीररक्ष॒न्नध॑ श्ये॒नो ज॒वसा॒ निर॑दीयम्
shlokas.transliteration: gárbhe ǀ nú ǀ sán ǀ ánu ǀ eṣām ǀ avedam ǀ ahám ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánimāni ǀ víśvā ǀśatám ǀ mā ǀ púraḥ ǀ ā́yasīḥ ǀ arakṣan ǀ ádha ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ javásā ǀ níḥ ǀ adīyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being still in the germ, I have known all the births of these divinities in their order; a hundred bodies of metal confined me, but as a hawk I came forth with speed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न घा॒ स मामप॒ जोषं॑ जभारा॒भीमा॑स॒ त्वक्ष॑सा वी॒र्ये॑ण । ई॒र्मा पुरं॑धिरजहा॒दरा॑तीरु॒त वाताँ॑ अतर॒च्छूशु॑वानः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ gha ǀ sáḥ ǀ mā́m ǀ ápa ǀ jóṣam ǀ jabhāra ǀ abhí ǀ īm ǀ āsa ǀ tvákṣasā ǀ vīryéṇa ǀīrmā́ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ajahāt ǀ árātīḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā́tān ǀ atarat ǀ śū́śuvānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That embryo did not beguile me into satisfaction, but by the keen energy (of divine wisdom), I triumphed over it; the impeller of all, the sustainer of many, abandoned the foes (of knowledge), and, expanding, passed beyond the winds (of worldly troubles).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ यच्छ्ये॒नो अस्व॑नी॒दध॒ द्योर्वि यद्यदि॒ वात॑ ऊ॒हुः पुरं॑धिम् । सृ॒जद्यद॑स्मा॒ अव॑ ह क्षि॒पज्ज्यां कृ॒शानु॒रस्ता॒ मन॑सा भुर॒ण्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ yát ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ásvanīt ǀ ádha ǀ dyóḥ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ átaḥ ǀ ūhúḥ ǀ púram-dhim ǀsṛját ǀ yát ǀ asmai ǀ áva ǀ ha ǀ kṣipát ǀ jyā́m ǀ kṛśā́nuḥ ǀ ástā ǀ mánasā ǀ bhuraṇyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the hawk screamed (with exultation) on his descent from heaven, and (the guardians of theSoma) perceived that the Soma was (carried away) by it then, the archer ofKṛśānu, pursuing with the speed of thought, and stringing his bow, let fly an arrow against it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जि॒प्य ई॒मिन्द्रा॑वतो॒ न भु॒ज्युं श्ये॒नो ज॑भार बृह॒तो अधि॒ ष्णोः । अ॒न्तः प॑तत्पत॒त्र्य॑स्य प॒र्णमध॒ याम॑नि॒ प्रसि॑तस्य॒ तद्वेः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjipyáḥ ǀ īm ǀ índra-vataḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhujyúm ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ jabhāra ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ snóḥ ǀantáríti ǀ patat ǀ patatrí ǀ asya ǀ parṇám ǀ ádha ǀ yā́mani ǀ prá-sitasya ǀ tát ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The straight-flying hawk carried off theSomafrom above the vast heaven, as (theAśvinscarried off)Bhujyufrom the region ofIndra, and a falling feather from the middle of the bird dropped from him wounded in the conflict.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ श्वे॒तं क॒लशं॒ गोभि॑र॒क्तमा॑पिप्या॒नं म॒घवा॑ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑: । अ॒ध्व॒र्युभि॒: प्रय॑तं॒ मध्वो॒ अग्र॒मिन्द्रो॒ मदा॑य॒ प्रति॑ ध॒त्पिब॑ध्यै॒ शूरो॒ मदा॑य॒ प्रति॑ ध॒त्पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ śvetám ǀ kaláśam ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ aktám ǀ ā-pipyānám ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śukrám ǀ ándhaḥ ǀadhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ prá-yatam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ágram ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ práti ǀ dhat ǀ píbadhyai ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ práti ǀ dhat ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now mayMaghavanaccept the pure nutitious (sacrificial) food in a white pitcher, mixed with milk and curds, offered by the priests; the upper part of the sweet (beverage) to drink for his exhilaration; may the hero accept (it) to drink for (his) exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वा यु॒जा तव॒ तत्सो॑म स॒ख्य इन्द्रो॑ अ॒पो मन॑वे स॒स्रुत॑स्कः । अह॒न्नहि॒मरि॑णात्स॒प्त सिन्धू॒नपा॑वृणो॒दपि॑हितेव॒ खानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ soma ǀ sakhyé ǀ índraḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ mánave ǀ sa-srútaḥ ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀáhan ǀ áhim ǀ áriṇāt ǀ saptá ǀ síndhūn ǀ ápa ǀ avṛṇot ǀ ápihitā-iva ǀ khā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through that friendship,Soma, which has united you with your (friend)Indra, he has made the waters flow for man; he has slain Ahi; he has sent forth the seven rivers, and has opened theshut-up sources (of the streams).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वा यु॒जा नि खि॑द॒त्सूर्य॒स्येन्द्र॑श्च॒क्रं सह॑सा स॒द्य इ॑न्दो । अधि॒ ष्णुना॑ बृह॒ता वर्त॑मानं म॒हो द्रु॒हो अप॑ वि॒श्वायु॑ धायि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ ní ǀ khidat ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ índraḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ sáhasā ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀádhi ǀ snúnā ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ vártamānam ǀ maháḥ ǀ druháḥ ǀ ápa ǀ viśvá-āyu ǀ dhāyi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With you,Soma, for his ally,Indrahas quickly taken off by force the wheel of the chariot of the sun, abiding above with the vast and stationary (firmament); the everywhere going wheel (of the car) of the great oppressor has been taken away.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॒न्निन्द्रो॒ अद॑हद॒ग्निरि॑न्दो पु॒रा दस्यू॑न्म॒ध्यंदि॑नाद॒भीके॑ । दु॒र्गे दु॑रो॒णे क्रत्वा॒ न या॒तां पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॒ शर्वा॒ नि ब॑र्हीत्
shlokas.transliteration: áhan ǀ índraḥ ǀ ádahat ǀ agníḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ purā́ ǀ dásyūn ǀ madhyándināt ǀ abhī́ke ǀduḥ-gé ǀ duroṇé ǀ krátvā ǀ ná ǀ yātā́m ǀ purú ǀ sahásrā ǀ śárvā ǀ ní ǀ barhīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas slain theDasyus,Soma, in battle;Agnihas consumed them before the noon; he (Indra) has destroyed the whole of many thosands, as (robbers are the destroyers of those) going upon (their own) business, in a difficult and dangerous (plural ce).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्मात्सीमध॒माँ इ॑न्द्र॒ दस्यू॒न्विशो॒ दासी॑रकृणोरप्रश॒स्ताः । अबा॑धेथा॒ममृ॑णतं॒ नि शत्रू॒नवि॑न्देथा॒मप॑चितिं॒ वध॑त्रैः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasmāt ǀ sīm ǀ adhamā́n ǀ indra ǀ dásyūn ǀ víśaḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ apra-śastā́ḥ ǀábādhethām ǀ ámṛṇatam ǀ ní ǀ śátrūn ǀ ávindethām ǀ ápa-citim ǀ vádhatraiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, you have made theseDasyusdevoid of all (good qualities); you have made the races without rites abject; may you, (Somaand Indra), repel (and) destroy (your) enemies; accept (our) homage for their destruction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा स॒त्यं म॑घवाना यु॒वं तदिन्द्र॑श्च सोमो॒र्वमश्व्यं॒ गोः । आद॑र्दृत॒मपि॑हिता॒न्यश्ना॑ रिरि॒चथु॒: क्षाश्चि॑त्ततृदा॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ satyám ǀ magha-vānā ǀ yuvám ǀ tát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ ūrvám ǀ áśvyam ǀ góḥ ǀā́ ǀ adardṛtam ǀ ápi-hitāni ǀ áśnā ǀ riricáthuḥ ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ tatṛdānā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessors of wealth, destroyers of foes,IndraandSoma, it is indeed true that you have distributed great numbers of horses, and of the cattle which had been concealed and the land which you had recovered by your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: स्तु॒त उप॒ वाजे॑भिरू॒ती इन्द्र॑ या॒हि हरि॑भिर्मन्दसा॒नः । ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्यः सव॑ना पु॒रूण्या॑ङ्गू॒षेभि॑र्गृणा॒नः स॒त्यरा॑धाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ índra ǀ yāhí ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ āṅgūṣébhiḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ satyá-rādhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Honoured with accepted (sacrificial) viands, come,Indra, exulting, with your steeds, to our many rites, for our protection; you who are the lord, glorified by hymns, whose wealth is truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तद॑स्या॒ अन॑: शये॒ सुस॑म्पिष्टं॒ विपा॒श्या । स॒सार॑ सीं परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ yā́ti ǀ náryaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yajñám ǀsu-áśvaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ábhīruḥ ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ su-svānébhiḥ ǀ mádati ǀ sám ǀ ha ǀ vīráiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then her shattered wagon reposed (on the bank) of the Vipās' (river), and she departed from afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त सिन्धुं॑ विबा॒ल्यं॑ वितस्था॒नामधि॒ क्षमि॑ । परि॑ ष्ठा इन्द्र मा॒यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: śraváya ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ kárṇā ǀ vājayádhyai ǀ júṣṭām ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ díśam ǀ mandayádhyai ǀut-vavṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ rā́dhase ǀ túviṣmān ǀ kárat ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-tīrthā́ ǀ ábhayam ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have spread abroad upon the earth, by your contrivance, the swollenSindhuwhen arrested (on its course).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त शुष्ण॑स्य धृष्णु॒या प्र मृ॑क्षो अ॒भि वेद॑नम् । पुरो॒ यद॑स्य सम्पि॒णक्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ yáḥ ǀ gántā ǀ nā́dhamānam ǀ ūtī́ ǀ itthā́ ǀ vípram ǀ hávamānam ǀ gṛṇántam ǀúpa ǀ tmáni ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ dhurí ǀ āśū́n ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ni ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By valour you have carried off the wealth ofŚuṣṇa, when you had demolished his cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दा॒सं कौ॑लित॒रं बृ॑ह॒तः पर्व॑ता॒दधि॑ । अवा॑हन्निन्द्र॒ शम्ब॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vayám ǀ te ǀ syāma ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀbhejānā́saḥ ǀ bṛhát-divasya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā-kāyyásya ǀ dāváne ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain the slaveŚambara, the son Kulitara hurling him off the huge mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दा॒सस्य॑ व॒र्चिन॑: स॒हस्रा॑णि श॒ताव॑धीः । अधि॒ पञ्च॑ प्र॒धीँरि॑व
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain the five hundreds and thousands (of the followers) of the slave Varin, (surrounding) him like the fellies (round the spokes of the wheel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यं पु॒त्रम॒ग्रुव॒: परा॑वृक्तं श॒तक्र॑तुः । उ॒क्थेष्विन्द्र॒ आभ॑जत्
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, who areŚatakratu, have made Parāvṛj, the son of Agru, participant in sacred hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या तु॒र्वशा॒यदू॑ अस्ना॒तारा॒ शची॒पति॑: । इन्द्रो॑ वि॒द्वाँ अ॑पारयत्
shlokas.meaning_en: “The lord of acts, the wiseIndra, has borne across (their difficulties),TurvaśasandYadu, when denied inauguration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या स॒द्य आर्या॑ स॒रयो॑रिन्द्र पा॒रत॑: । अर्णा॑चि॒त्रर॑थावधीः
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain at once those twoĀryas,ArṇaandCitraratha, (dwellig) on the opposite (bank) of theSarayu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ द्वा ज॑हि॒ता न॑यो॒ऽन्धं श्रो॒णं च॑ वृत्रहन् । न तत्ते॑ सु॒म्नमष्ट॑वे
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तम॑श्म॒न्मयी॑नां पु॒रामिन्द्रो॒ व्या॑स्यत् । दिवो॑दासाय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्वा॑पयद्द॒भीत॑ये स॒हस्रा॑ त्रिं॒शतं॒ हथै॑: । दा॒साना॒मिन्द्रो॑ मा॒यया॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake ofDabhīti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घेदु॒तासि॑ वृत्रहन्त्समा॒न इ॑न्द्र॒ गोप॑तिः । यस्ता विश्वा॑नि चिच्यु॒षे
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नू॒नं यदि॑न्द्रि॒यं क॑रि॒ष्या इ॑न्द्र॒ पौंस्य॑म् । अ॒द्या नकि॒ष्टदा मि॑नत्
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒मंवा॑मं त आदुरे दे॒वो द॑दात्वर्य॒मा । वा॒मं पू॒षा वा॒मं भगो॑ वा॒मं दे॒वः करू॑ळती
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of foes, may the divineAryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑रिन्द्र॒ त्वदुत्त॑रो॒ न ज्यायाँ॑ अस्ति वृत्रहन् । नकि॑रे॒वा यथा॒ त्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ indra ǀ tvát ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ ná ǀ jyā́yān ǀ asti ǀ vṛtra-han ǀnákiḥ ǀ evá ǀ yáthā ǀ tvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There is no one,Indra, superior to you; no one more excellent (than you); slayer ofVṛtrathere is no one, verily, such as you are. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा ते॒ अनु॑ कृ॒ष्टयो॒ विश्वा॑ च॒क्रेव॑ वावृतुः । स॒त्रा म॒हाँ अ॑सि श्रु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakrā́-iva ǀ vavṛtuḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ śrutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily men are attached to you as are all the wheels (to the body of the wagon); in truth you are great and renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ च॒नेद॒ना त्वा॑ दे॒वास॑ इन्द्र युयुधुः । यदहा॒ नक्त॒माति॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ caná ǀ ít ǀ anā́ ǀ tvā ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ yuyudhuḥ ǀyát ǀ áhā ǀ náktam ǀ ā́ ǀ átiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily all the gods, with you (for) their strength, have warred (with theasuras); wherefore you have destroyed by day and by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रो॒त बा॑धि॒तेभ्य॑श्च॒क्रं कुत्सा॑य॒ युध्य॑ते । मु॒षा॒य इ॑न्द्र॒ सूर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ utá ǀ bādhitébhyaḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ kútsāya ǀ yúdhyate ǀmuṣāyáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In wihc (contests), for the sake ofKutsaand his allies, you hae stolen,Indra, the (wheel of the car) of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॑ दे॒वाँ ऋ॑घाय॒तो विश्वाँ॒ अयु॑ध्य॒ एक॒ इत् । त्वमि॑न्द्र व॒नूँरह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ áyudhyaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀtvám ǀ indra ǀ vanū́n ǀ áhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In which (contest) you singly indeed have warred with all those opposing the gods; you,Indra, have slain the malignant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रो॒त मर्त्या॑य॒ कमरि॑णा इन्द्र॒ सूर्य॑म् । प्राव॒: शची॑भि॒रेत॑शम्
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ utá ǀ mártyāya ǀ kám ǀ áriṇāḥ ǀ indra ǀ sū́ryam ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ étaśam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In which (contests),Indrayou have, for the sake of a mortal, discomfited the sun, and have protectedEtaśaby (your) exploits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमादु॒तासि॑ वृत्रह॒न्मघ॑वन्मन्यु॒मत्त॑मः । अत्राह॒ दानु॒माति॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ā́t ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ mágha-van ǀ manyumát-tamaḥ ǀátra ǀ áha ǀ dā́num ǀ ā́ ǀ atiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wherefore, slayer ofVṛtra, opulentIndra, have you thereupon become most incensed, and in consequence, have slain the son ofDanu(Vṛtra) in this firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तद्घेदु॒त वी॒र्य१॒॑मिन्द्र॑ च॒कर्थ॒ पौंस्य॑म् । स्त्रियं॒ यद्दु॑र्हणा॒युवं॒ वधी॑र्दुहि॒तरं॑ दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ utá ǀ vīryám ǀ índra ǀ cakártha ǀ páuṃsyam ǀstríyam ǀ yát ǀ duḥ-hanāyúvam ǀ vádhīḥ ǀ duhitáram ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as you have displayed such manly prowess, you have slain the woman, the daughter of the sky, when meditating mischief.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॑द्घा दुहि॒तरं॑ म॒हान्म॑ही॒यमा॑नाम् । उ॒षास॑मिन्द्र॒ सं पि॑णक्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ duhitáram ǀ mahā́n ǀ mahīyámānām ǀuṣásam ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouIndra, who are mighty, have enriched glorious dawn, the daughter of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपो॒षा अन॑सः सर॒त्सम्पि॑ष्टा॒दह॑ बि॒भ्युषी॑ । नि यत्सीं॑ शि॒श्नथ॒द्वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ánasaḥ ǀ sarat ǀ sám-piṣṭāt ǀ áha ǀ bibhyúṣī ǀní ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ śiśnáthat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The terrified Uṣas descended from the broken wagon when the (showerer of benefits) had smashed it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तद॑स्या॒ अन॑: शये॒ सुस॑म्पिष्टं॒ विपा॒श्या । स॒सार॑ सीं परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ asyāḥ ǀ ánaḥ ǀ śaye ǀ sú-sampiṣṭam ǀ ví-pāśi ǀ ā́ ǀsasā́ra ǀ sīm ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then her shattered wagon reposed (on the bank) of the Vipās' (river), and she departed from afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त सिन्धुं॑ विबा॒ल्यं॑ वितस्था॒नामधि॒ क्षमि॑ । परि॑ ष्ठा इन्द्र मा॒यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ síndhum ǀ vi-bālyám ǀ vi-tasthānā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀpári ǀ sthāḥ ǀ indra ǀ māyáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have spread abroad upon the earth, by your contrivance, the swollenSindhuwhen arrested (on its course).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त शुष्ण॑स्य धृष्णु॒या प्र मृ॑क्षो अ॒भि वेद॑नम् । पुरो॒ यद॑स्य सम्पि॒णक्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ prá ǀ mṛkṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ védanam ǀpúraḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ sam-piṇák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By valour you have carried off the wealth ofŚuṣṇa, when you had demolished his cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दा॒सं कौ॑लित॒रं बृ॑ह॒तः पर्व॑ता॒दधि॑ । अवा॑हन्निन्द्र॒ शम्ब॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dāsám ǀ kauli-tarám ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ párvatāt ǀ ádhi ǀáva ǀ ahan ǀ indra ǀ śámbaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain the slaveŚambara, the son Kulitara hurling him off the huge mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दा॒सस्य॑ व॒र्चिन॑: स॒हस्रा॑णि श॒ताव॑धीः । अधि॒ पञ्च॑ प्र॒धीँरि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dāsásya ǀ varcínaḥ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ avadhīḥ ǀádhi ǀ páñca ǀ pradhī́n-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain the five hundreds and thousands (of the followers) of the slave Varin, (surrounding) him like the fellies (round the spokes of the wheel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यं पु॒त्रम॒ग्रुव॒: परा॑वृक्तं श॒तक्र॑तुः । उ॒क्थेष्विन्द्र॒ आभ॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ putrám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ párā-vṛktam ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀukthéṣu ǀ índraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abhajat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, who areŚatakratu, have made Parāvṛj, the son of Agru, participant in sacred hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या तु॒र्वशा॒यदू॑ अस्ना॒तारा॒ शची॒पति॑: । इन्द्रो॑ वि॒द्वाँ अ॑पारयत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ turváśāyádū íti ǀ asnātā́rā ǀ śacī́-pátiḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ apārayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The lord of acts, the wiseIndra, has borne across (their difficulties),TurvaśasandYadu, when denied inauguration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या स॒द्य आर्या॑ स॒रयो॑रिन्द्र पा॒रत॑: । अर्णा॑चि॒त्रर॑थावधीः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́ryā ǀ saráyoḥ ǀ indra ǀ pārátaḥ ǀárṇācitrárathā ǀ avadhīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have slain at once those twoĀryas,ArṇaandCitraratha, (dwellig) on the opposite (bank) of theSarayu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ द्वा ज॑हि॒ता न॑यो॒ऽन्धं श्रो॒णं च॑ वृत्रहन् । न तत्ते॑ सु॒म्नमष्ट॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ dvā́ ǀ jahitā́ ǀ nayaḥ ǀ andhám ǀ śroṇám ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ áṣṭave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtrayou have restored the (one who was) blind, the (other who was) lame, both abandoned by their kin); (it is not possible) to exceed the happiness what is given by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तम॑श्म॒न्मयी॑नां पु॒रामिन्द्रो॒ व्या॑स्यत् । दिवो॑दासाय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ aśman-máyīnām ǀ purā́m ǀ índraḥ ǀ ví ǀ āsyat ǀdívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas overturned a hundred stone-built cities for Divodās, the donor of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्वा॑पयद्द॒भीत॑ये स॒हस्रा॑ त्रिं॒शतं॒ हथै॑: । दा॒साना॒मिन्द्रो॑ मा॒यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásvāpayat ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ sahásrā ǀ triṃśátam ǀ háthaiḥ ǀdāsā́nām ǀ índraḥ ǀ māyáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He put to sleep, by delusion, with his destructive (weapons), thirty thousand of the servile (races), for the sake ofDabhīti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घेदु॒तासि॑ वृत्रहन्त्समा॒न इ॑न्द्र॒ गोप॑तिः । यस्ता विश्वा॑नि चिच्यु॒षे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ samānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ cicyuṣé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, you are the same to all your worshippers, the lord of cattle, who cast down all these (your enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नू॒नं यदि॑न्द्रि॒यं क॑रि॒ष्या इ॑न्द्र॒ पौंस्य॑म् । अ॒द्या नकि॒ष्टदा मि॑नत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ nūnám ǀ yát ǀ indriyám ǀ kariṣyā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǀadyá ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ minat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, indeed,Indra, you excite your vigorous manhood, there is no one at the present time who may resist it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒मंवा॑मं त आदुरे दे॒वो द॑दात्वर्य॒मा । वा॒मं पू॒षा वा॒मं भगो॑ वा॒मं दे॒वः करू॑ळती
shlokas.transliteration: vamám-vāmam ǀ te ǀ ā-dure ǀ deváḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ aryamā́ ǀvāmám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vāmám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ deváḥ ǀ kárūḷatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of foes, may the divineAryamandistribute your precious wealth; (may)Pūṣa(bestow it), (may),Bhaga(bestow it); may the toothless deity bestow the desired wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कया॑ नश्चि॒त्र आ भु॑वदू॒ती स॒दावृ॑ध॒: सखा॑ । कया॒ शचि॑ष्ठया वृ॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ ūtī́ ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀkáyā ǀ śáciṣṭhayā ǀ vṛtā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By what means may he who is ever augmenting, who is wonderful, who is our friend, be present with us, by what most effective rite?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्त्वा॑ स॒त्यो मदा॑नां॒ मंहि॑ष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः । दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑दा॒रुजे॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ tvā ǀ satyáḥ ǀ mádānām ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ matsat ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ ā-rúje ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What genitive ine and most esteemed of the exhilarating juies of the (sacriiial) beverage may delight you to demolish the substantial treasures (of the foe)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी षु ण॒: सखी॑नामवि॒ता ज॑रितॄ॒णाम् । श॒तं भ॑वास्यू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhīnām ǀ avitā́ ǀ jaritṝṇā́m ǀśatám ǀ bhavāsi ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, the protector of us your friends and praisers, be present with a hundred protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी न॒ आ व॑वृत्स्व च॒क्रं न वृ॒त्तमर्व॑तः । नि॒युद्भि॑श्चर्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ cakrám ǀ ná ǀ vṛttám ǀ árvataḥ ǀniyút-bhiḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Induced) by the praise of men, return like a revolving wheel to us, dependent (upon your favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वता॒ हि क्रतू॑ना॒मा हा॑ प॒देव॒ गच्छ॑सि । अभ॑क्षि॒ सूर्ये॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: pra-vátā ǀ hí ǀ krátūnām ǀ ā́ ǀ ha ǀ padā́-iva ǀ gácchasi ǀábhakṣi ǀ sū́rye ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You come in a downward (direction) to sacfred rites, as if to your own station; I glorify you together with the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यत्त॑ इन्द्र म॒न्यव॒: सं च॒क्राणि॑ दधन्वि॒रे । अध॒ त्वे अध॒ सूर्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ manyávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ cakrā́ṇi ǀ dadhanviré ǀádha ǀ tvé íti ǀ ádha ǀ sū́rye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you praises, and these sacred rites,Indra, are addressed to you, they first belong to you and next toSūrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॒ हि त्वामा॒हुरिन्म॒घवा॑नं शचीपते । दाता॑र॒मवि॑दीधयुम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ āhúḥ ǀ ít ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ śacī-pate ǀdā́tāram ǀ ávi-dīdhayum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of holy acts, they call youMaghavan, the munificent, the resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॑ स॒द्य इत्परि॑ शशमा॒नाय॑ सुन्व॒ते । पु॒रू चि॑न्मंहसे॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀpurú ǀ cit ǀ maṃhase ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And verily you give promptly abundant wealth to him who praises you and offers you libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ष्मा॑ ते श॒तं च॒न राधो॒ वर॑न्त आ॒मुर॑: । न च्यौ॒त्नानि॑ करिष्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ śatám ǀ caná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ várante ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀná ǀ cyautnā́ni ǀ kariṣyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adversaries diminish not your hundred-fold opulence nor resist the energies of you opposing (them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माँ अ॑वन्तु ते श॒तम॒स्मान्त्स॒हस्र॑मू॒तय॑: । अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑ अ॒भिष्ट॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ te ǀ śatám ǀ asmā́n ǀ sahásram ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhíṣṭayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your hundred, your thousand, protections preserve us; may all (your) desires (be for our defence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माँ इ॒हा वृ॑णीष्व स॒ख्याय॑ स्व॒स्तये॑ । म॒हो रा॒ये दि॒वित्म॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ ihá ǀ vṛṇīṣva ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ svastáye ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ divítmate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Select us,Indra, on this occasion, for your friendship, for (our) welfare, for vast and splendid riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माँ अ॑विड्ढि वि॒श्वहेन्द्र॑ रा॒या परी॑णसा । अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ viśváhā ǀ índra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ párīṇasā ǀasmā́n ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Favour us,Indra, daily with infinite riches (protect) us with all protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ ताँ अपा॑ वृधि व्र॒जाँ अस्ते॑व॒ गोम॑तः । नवा॑भिरिन्द्रो॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tā́n ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀ vrajā́n ǀ ástā-iva ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀnávābhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With fresh protections,Indra, like a warrior, open for us those pastures filled with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ धृष्णु॒या रथो॑ द्यु॒माँ इ॒न्द्रान॑पच्युतः । ग॒व्युर॑श्व॒युरी॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ indra ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǀgavyúḥ ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our chariot,Indra, foe-repelling, brilliant unfailing, proceed (everywhere), possessing us of cattle and of horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मुत्त॒मं कृ॑धि॒ श्रवो॑ दे॒वेषु॑ सूर्य । वर्षि॑ष्ठं॒ द्यामि॑वो॒परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ kṛdhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ sūrya ǀvárṣiṣṭham ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ upári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūrya, make our fame exalted among the gods, as (you have plural ced) the sky, the shedder of most copious rain, above (all other regions). ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न॒स्माक॑म॒र्धमा ग॑हि । म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ardhám ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, slayer ofVṛtra, come to us quickly; you, who are mighty, (come) with mighty protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भृमि॑श्चिद्घासि॒ तूतु॑जि॒रा चि॑त्र चि॒त्रिणी॒ष्वा । चि॒त्रं कृ॑णोष्यू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhṛ́miḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ asi ǀ tū́tujiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ citra ǀ citríṇīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀcitrám ǀ kṛṇoṣi ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WonderfulIndra, wanderer at times (through space), you are verily the granter of (our) desires, and do what is marvellous for the protection (of those who are engaged) in wondrous works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒भ्रेभि॑श्चि॒च्छशी॑यांसं॒ हंसि॒ व्राध॑न्त॒मोज॑सा । सखि॑भि॒र्ये त्वे सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: dabhrébhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ śáśīyāṃsam ǀ háṃsi ǀ vrā́dhantam ǀ ójasā ǀsákhi-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvé íti ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You destroy by your might the fierce assailing foe, associated with the humble friends who are along with you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमि॑न्द्र॒ त्वे सचा॑ व॒यं त्वा॒भि नो॑नुमः । अ॒स्माँअ॑स्माँ॒ इदुद॑व
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvé íti ǀ sácā ǀ vayám ǀ tvā ǀ abhí ǀ nonumaḥ ǀasmā́n-asmān ǀ ít ǀ út ǀ ava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We,Indra, are along with you; we zealously glorify you; do verily protect us all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑श्चि॒त्राभि॑रद्रिवोऽनव॒द्याभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । अना॑धृष्टाभि॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ anavadyā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀánādhṛṣṭābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, do you come to us with wondrous, irreproachable, irresistible protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भू॒यामो॒ षु त्वाव॑त॒: सखा॑य इन्द्र॒ गोम॑तः । युजो॒ वाजा॑य॒ घृष्व॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: bhūyā́mo íti ǀ sú ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀyújaḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we,Indra, be the friends of one like you, possessed of cattle, allied (to him) for (the sake of) abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येक॒ ईशि॑ष॒ इन्द्र॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः । स नो॑ यन्धि म॒हीमिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ índra ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yandhi ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you alone,Indra, are lord over food combined with cattle; therefore do you grant us ample food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वा॑ वरन्ते अ॒न्यथा॒ यद्दित्स॑सि स्तु॒तो म॒घम् । स्तो॒तृभ्य॑ इन्द्र गिर्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ varante ǀ anyáthā ǀ yát ǀ dítsasi ǀ stutáḥ ǀ maghám ǀstotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “None change your purpose,Indra, object of laudation, when, being praised, you desire to bestow wealth upon the praisers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॒ गोत॑मा गि॒रानू॑षत॒ प्र दा॒वने॑ । इन्द्र॒ वाजा॑य॒ घृष्व॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ ánūṣata ǀ prá ǀ dāváne ǀíndra ǀ vā́jāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheGotamasglorify you,Indra, with praise, that you may grant wealth, and for the sake of abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ वोचाम वी॒र्या॒३॒॑ या म॑न्दसा॒न आरु॑जः । पुरो॒ दासी॑र॒भीत्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ vocāma ǀ vīryā́ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ árujaḥ ǀpúraḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ abhi-ítya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We proclaim your prowess, whereby exhilarated (by theSoma), and having gone against them, you have demolished the servile cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता ते॑ गृणन्ति वे॒धसो॒ यानि॑ च॒कर्थ॒ पौंस्या॑ । सु॒तेष्वि॑न्द्र गिर्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ te ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ yā́ni ǀ cakártha ǀ páuṃsyā ǀsutéṣu ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious celebrate your manly exploits,Indra, object of laudation, when the juices (of theSoma) are effused.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवी॑वृधन्त॒ गोत॑मा॒ इन्द्र॒ त्वे स्तोम॑वाहसः । ऐषु॑ धा वी॒रव॒द्यश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ávīvṛdhanta ǀ gótamāḥ ǀ índra ǀ tvé íti ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǀā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ dhāḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheGotamas, offerers of praise, exalt you,Indra; bestow upon them food and prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि शश्व॑ता॒मसीन्द्र॒ साधा॑रण॒स्त्वम् । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatām ǀ ási ǀ índra ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ tvám ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,Indra, you are the common property of (all) worshippers, we invoke you (such) as your are (for ourselves).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वा॒ची॒नो व॑सो भवा॒स्मे सु म॒त्स्वान्ध॑सः । सोमा॑नामिन्द्र सोमपाः
shlokas.transliteration: arvācīnáḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ bhava ǀ asmé íti ǀ sú ǀ matsva ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀsómānām ǀ indra ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of dwellings, be present with us; drinker of theSoma, be exhilarated by the beverage of the juices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ त्वा मती॒नामा स्तोम॑ इन्द्र यच्छतु । अ॒र्वागा व॑र्तया॒ हरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ tvā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ yacchatu ǀarvā́k ǀ ā́ ǀ vartaya ǀ hárī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praise (of us) who are devoted (to you),Indra, give you to us; guide your horses towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळाशं॑ च नो॒ घसो॑ जो॒षया॑से॒ गिर॑श्च नः । व॒धू॒युरि॑व॒ योष॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ghásaḥ ǀ joṣáyāse ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀvadhūyúḥ-iva ǀ yóṣaṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eat (Indra) our cakes and butter; be plural ased by our praises as a libertine (by the caresses) of a woman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रं॒ व्यती॑नां यु॒क्ताना॒मिन्द्र॑मीमहे । श॒तं सोम॑स्य खा॒र्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sahásram ǀ vyátīnām ǀ yuktā́nām ǀ índram ǀ īmahe ǀśatám ǀ sómasya ǀ khāryáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit,Indrafor a thousand well-trained, swift-going horses, for a hundred jars ofSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रा॑ ते श॒ता व॒यं गवा॒मा च्या॑वयामसि । अ॒स्म॒त्रा राध॑ एतु ते
shlokas.transliteration: sahásrā ǀ te ǀ śatā́ ǀ vayám ǀ gávām ǀ ā́ ǀ cyavayāmasi ǀasma-trā́ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ etu ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We seek to bring down from you thousands and hundreds of cattle; may riches come to us from you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॑ ते क॒लशा॑नां॒ हिर॑ण्यानामधीमहि । भू॒रि॒दा अ॑सि वृत्रहन्
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ te ǀ kaláśānām ǀ híraṇyānām ǀ adhīmahi ǀbhūri-dā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ vṛtra-han ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain from you, ten golden ewers, for you, slayer ofVṛtra, are a bountiful giver.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॑दा॒ भूरि॑ देहि नो॒ मा द॒भ्रं भूर्या भ॑र । भूरि॒ घेदि॑न्द्र दित्ससि
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri-dāḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dehi ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ dabhrám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀbhū́ri ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ ditsasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A bountiful giver are you,Indra; give bountifully to us; (give) not little; bring much; for verily you desire to give much.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भू॒रि॒दा ह्यसि॑ श्रु॒तः पु॑रु॒त्रा शू॑र वृत्रहन् । आ नो॑ भजस्व॒ राध॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: bhūri-dā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ śūra ǀ vṛtra-han ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhajasva ǀ rā́dhasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily you are renowned among many as a bountiful giver, hero, slayer ofVṛtra, make us sharers in wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ ब॒भ्रू वि॑चक्षण॒ शंसा॑मि गोषणो नपात् । माभ्यां॒ गा अनु॑ शिश्रथः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ babhrū́ íti ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ śáṃsāmi ǀ go-sanaḥ ǀ napāt ǀmā́ ǀ ābhyām ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WiseIndra, I praise your brown (horses); bestower of kine, (who are) not regardless (of your worshippers); with those two steeds terrify not our cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒नी॒न॒केव॑ विद्र॒धे नवे॑ द्रुप॒दे अ॑र्भ॒के । ब॒भ्रू यामे॑षु शोभेते
shlokas.transliteration: kanīnakā́-iva ǀ vidradhé ǀ náve ǀ dru-padé ǀ arbhaké ǀbabhrū́ íti ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ śobhete íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like two puppets on an arranged, new and slender stage, your two brown (steeds) are brilliant at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरं॑ म उ॒स्रया॒म्णेऽर॒मनु॑स्रयाम्णे । ब॒भ्रू यामे॑ष्व॒स्रिधा॑
shlokas.transliteration: áram ǀ me ǀ usrá-yāmne ǀ áram ǀ ánusra-yāmne ǀbabhrū́ íti ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ asrídhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your two innocuous brown (steeds) are sufficient at sacrifices for me, whether going (to them) in (a wagon drawn by) oxen, or going without (such) a conveyance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ऋ॒भुभ्यो॑ दू॒तमि॑व॒ वाच॑मिष्य उप॒स्तिरे॒ श्वैत॑रीं धे॒नुमी॑ळे । ये वात॑जूतास्त॒रणि॑भि॒रेवै॒: परि॒ द्यां स॒द्यो अ॒पसो॑ बभू॒वुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ṛbhú-bhyaḥ ǀ dūtám-iva ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣye ǀ upa-stíre ǀ śváitarīm ǀ dhenúm ǀ īḷe ǀyé ǀ vā́ta-jūtāḥ ǀ taráṇi-bhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́m ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ babhūvúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I send my prayer as a messenger to theṛbhus; I solicit (of them) the cow, the yielder of the white milk, for the dilution (of theSomalibation); for they, as swift as the wind, the doers of good works, were borne quickly across the firmament by rapid steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒दार॒मक्र॑न्नृ॒भव॑: पि॒तृभ्यां॒ परि॑विष्टी वे॒षणा॑ दं॒सना॑भिः । आदिद्दे॒वाना॒मुप॑ स॒ख्यमा॑य॒न्धीरा॑सः पु॒ष्टिम॑वहन्म॒नायै॑
shlokas.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ áram ǀ ákran ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhyām ǀ pári-viṣṭī ǀ veṣáṇā ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ sakhyám ǀ āyan ǀ dhī́rāsaḥ ǀ puṣṭím ǀ avahan ǀ manā́yai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theṛbhus, by honouring their parents with renovated (youth), and by other works, had achieved enough, they thereupon proceeded to the society of the gods, and, considerate, they bring nourishment to the devout (worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॒र्ये च॒क्रुः पि॒तरा॒ युवा॑ना॒ सना॒ यूपे॑व जर॒णा शया॑ना । ते वाजो॒ विभ्वाँ॑ ऋ॒भुरिन्द्र॑वन्तो॒ मधु॑प्सरसो नोऽवन्तु य॒ज्ञम्
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ yé ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ pitárā ǀ yúvānā ǀ sánā ǀ yū́pā-iva ǀ jaraṇā́ ǀ śáyānā ǀté ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǀ mádhu-psarasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avantu ǀ yajñám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they who rendered their decrepid and dropsy parents, when, like two dryposts, again perpetually young,Vāja, Vibhavan, andṚbhuassociated withIndra, drinkers of theSomajuice, protect our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सं॒वत्स॑मृ॒भवो॒ गामर॑क्ष॒न्यत्सं॒वत्स॑मृ॒भवो॒ मा अपिं॑शन् । यत्सं॒वत्स॒मभ॑र॒न्भासो॑ अस्या॒स्ताभि॒: शमी॑भिरमृत॒त्वमा॑शुः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ árakṣan ǀ yát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ mā́ḥ ǀ ápiṃśan ǀyát ǀ sam-vátsam ǀ abháran ǀ bhā́saḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ āśuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as for a year theṚbhuspreserved the (dead) cow, inasmuch as for a year they invested it with flesh, inasmuch as for a year they continued its beauty they obtained by their acts of immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्ये॒ष्ठ आ॑ह चम॒सा द्वा क॒रेति॒ कनी॑या॒न्त्रीन्कृ॑णवा॒मेत्या॑ह । क॒नि॒ष्ठ आ॑ह च॒तुर॑स्क॒रेति॒ त्वष्ट॑ ऋभव॒स्तत्प॑नय॒द्वचो॑ वः
shlokas.transliteration: jyeṣṭháḥ ǀ āha ǀ camasā́ ǀ dvā́ ǀ kara ǀ íti ǀ kánīyān ǀ trī́n ǀ kṛṇavāma ǀ íti ǀ āha ǀkaniṣṭháḥ ǀ āha ǀ catúraḥ ǀ kara ǀ íti ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ tát ǀ panayat ǀ vácaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The eldest said, let us make two ladles; the younger said, let us make three:Tvaṣṭā,Ṛbhus, has applauded your proposal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमू॑चु॒र्नर॑ ए॒वा हि च॒क्रुरनु॑ स्व॒धामृ॒भवो॑ जग्मुरे॒ताम् । वि॒भ्राज॑मानाँश्चम॒साँ अहे॒वावे॑न॒त्त्वष्टा॑ च॒तुरो॑ ददृ॒श्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ ūcuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ evá ǀ hí ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ etā́m ǀvi-bhrā́jamānān ǀ camasā́n ǀ áhā-iva ǀ ávenat ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ catúraḥ ǀ dadṛśvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The men, (theṚbhus), spoke the truth, for such (ladles) they made, and thereupon the Ṛbhus partook of that libation;Tvaṣṭā, beholding the four ladles, brilliant as day, was content.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वाद॑श॒ द्यून्यदगो॑ह्यस्याति॒थ्ये रण॑न्नृ॒भव॑: स॒सन्त॑: । सु॒क्षेत्रा॑कृण्व॒न्नन॑यन्त॒ सिन्धू॒न्धन्वाति॑ष्ठ॒न्नोष॑धीर्नि॒म्नमाप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dvā́daśa ǀ dyū́n ǀ yát ǀ ágohyasya ǀ ātithyé ǀ ráṇan ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sasántaḥ ǀsu-kṣétrā ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ ánayanta ǀ síndhūn ǀ dhánva ǀ ā́ ǀ atiṣṭhan ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ nimnám ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theṚbhus, reposing for twelve days, remained in the hospitality of the uncealable (sun) they rendered the fields fertile, they led forth the rivers, plural nts sprung upon the waste, and waters (spread over) the low (plural ces).”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ ये च॒क्रुः सु॒वृतं॑ नरे॒ष्ठां ये धे॒नुं वि॑श्व॒जुवं॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पाम् । त आ त॑क्षन्त्वृ॒भवो॑ र॒यिं न॒: स्वव॑स॒: स्वप॑सः सु॒हस्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ yé ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ su-vṛ́tam ǀ nare-sthā́m ǀ yé ǀ dhenúm ǀ viśva-júvam ǀ viśvá-rūpām ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ takṣantu ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ su-ávasaḥ ǀ su-ápasaḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thoseṚbhuswho constructed the firm-abiding wheel-conducting car; who formed the all-impelling multiform cow; they who are the bestowers of food, the doers of great deeds, and dexterous ofhand, fabricate our riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपो॒ ह्ये॑षा॒मजु॑षन्त दे॒वा अ॒भि क्रत्वा॒ मन॑सा॒ दीध्या॑नाः । वाजो॑ दे॒वाना॑मभवत्सु॒कर्मेन्द्र॑स्य ऋभु॒क्षा वरु॑णस्य॒ विभ्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ápaḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ ájuṣanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ krátvā ǀ mánasā ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀvā́jaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavat ǀ su-kármā ǀ índrasya ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ ví-bhvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods were plural ased by their works, illustrious in act and in thought;Vājawas the artificer of the gods,ṚbhukṣinofIndra, Vibhavan ofVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये हरी॑ मे॒धयो॒क्था मद॑न्त॒ इन्द्रा॑य च॒क्रुः सु॒युजा॒ ये अश्वा॑ । ते रा॒यस्पोषं॒ द्रवि॑णान्य॒स्मे ध॒त्त ऋ॑भवः क्षेम॒यन्तो॒ न मि॒त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ hárī íti ǀ medháyā ǀ ukthā́ ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ su-yújā ǀ yé ǀ áśvā ǀté ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhattá ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ kṣema-yántaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thoseṚbhuswho gratified the horses (ofIndra) by pious praise, who constructed for Indra his two docile steeds, bestow upon us satiety of riches, and wealth (of cattle), like those who devise prosperity for a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दाह्न॑: पी॒तिमु॒त वो॒ मदं॑ धु॒र्न ऋ॒ते श्रा॒न्तस्य॑ स॒ख्याय॑ दे॒वाः । ते नू॒नम॒स्मे ऋ॑भवो॒ वसू॑नि तृ॒तीये॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सव॑ने दधात
shlokas.transliteration: idā́ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ pītím ǀ utá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádam ǀ dhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ śrāntásya ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀté ǀ nūnám ǀ asmé íti ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ tṛtī́ye ǀ asmín ǀ sávane ǀ dadhāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods verily have given you the beverage at the (third sacrifice of the) day, and its exhilarqation, not through regard, but (as the gift of one) wearied out (by penance);Ṛbhus, who are so (eminent), grant us, verily, wealth at this third (diurnal) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुर्विभ्वा॒ वाज॒ इन्द्रो॑ नो॒ अच्छे॒मं य॒ज्ञं र॑त्न॒धेयोप॑ यात । इ॒दा हि वो॑ धि॒षणा॑ दे॒व्यह्ना॒मधा॑त्पी॒तिं सं मदा॑ अग्मता वः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ratna-dhéyā ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀidā́ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ devī́ ǀ áhnām ǀ ádhāt ǀ pītím ǀ sám ǀ mádāḥ ǀ agmata ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhu, Vibhvan,VājaandIndra, do you come to this our sacrifice, to distribute the precious things, for the divine work has indeed now desired the drinking (of theSoma) on the (appointed hours of the) days; therefore the exhilarating draughts are collected for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दा॒नासो॒ जन्म॑नो वाजरत्ना उ॒त ऋ॒तुभि॑ॠभवो मादयध्वम् । सं वो॒ मदा॒ अग्म॑त॒ सं पुरं॑धिः सु॒वीरा॑म॒स्मे र॒यिमेर॑यध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: vidānā́saḥ ǀ jánmanaḥ ǀ vāja-ratnāḥ ǀ utá ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mādayadhvam ǀsám ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǀ ágmata ǀ sám ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ su-vī́rām ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ īrayadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resplendent with (sacrificial) food, prescient of your (celestial) birth, be exhilarated,Ṛbhusalong with the Ṛtus; the inebriating draughts are collected for you as well as pious praise; do you confer upon us riches with excellent posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वो॑ य॒ज्ञ ऋ॑भवोऽकारि॒ यमा म॑नु॒ष्वत्प्र॒दिवो॑ दधि॒ध्वे । प्र वोऽच्छा॑ जुजुषा॒णासो॑ अस्थु॒रभू॑त॒ विश्वे॑ अग्रि॒योत वा॑जाः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ akāri ǀ yám ǀ ā́ ǀ manuṣvát ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ dadhidhvé ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ jujuṣāṇā́saḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ábhūta ǀ víśve ǀ agriyā́ ǀ utá ǀ vājāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This sacrifice,Ṛbhus, has been instrumental tuted for you, who are eminently resplendent, which you have accepted after the manner of men; before you have the propitiatory (libations) been plural ced, forVājas, you are all entitled to precedence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑दु वो विध॒ते र॑त्न॒धेय॑मि॒दा न॑रो दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य । पिब॑त वाजा ऋभवो द॒दे वो॒ महि॑ तृ॒तीयं॒ सव॑नं॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ vidhaté ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ idā́ ǀ naraḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀpíbata ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ dadé ǀ vaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now, leaders (of rites), the treasure that ought to be presented is to be given to the mortqal performing (the sacred rite), the offerer (of the libation); drink,Vājas(drink),Ṛbhus; I present it to you at the third solemn (diurnal) ceremony for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑जा या॒तोप॑ न ऋभुक्षा म॒हो न॑रो॒ द्रवि॑णसो गृणा॒नाः । आ व॑: पी॒तयो॑ऽभिपि॒त्वे अह्ना॑मि॒मा अस्तं॑ नव॒स्व॑ इव ग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ yāta ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣāḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ pītáyaḥ ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ áhnām ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ástam ǀ navasváḥ-iva ǀ gman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans, leaders (of rites), come to us eulogizing exceeding wealth; these draughts (ofSoma) proceed to you at the decline of day, like newly-delivered cows to their stalls.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑पातः शवसो यात॒नोपे॒मं य॒ज्ञं नम॑सा हू॒यमा॑नाः । स॒जोष॑सः सूरयो॒ यस्य॑ च॒ स्थ मध्व॑: पात रत्न॒धा इन्द्र॑वन्तः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ yātana ǀ úpa ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ námasā ǀ hūyámānāḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ sūrayaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ ca ǀ sthá ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pāta ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sons of strength, come to this sacrifice, invoked with veneration; givers of precious things, associated withIndra, with whom you are intelligent, participate in being gratified (by the libation), drink ofthe sweetSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जोषा॑ इन्द्र॒ वरु॑णेन॒ सोमं॑ स॒जोषा॑: पाहि गिर्वणो म॒रुद्भि॑: । अ॒ग्रे॒पाभि॑ॠतु॒पाभि॑: स॒जोषा॒ ग्नास्पत्नी॑भी रत्न॒धाभि॑: स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ indra ǀ váruṇena ǀ sómam ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀagre-pā́bhiḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ gnā́ḥpátnībhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhā́bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sympathizing in satisfaction withVaruṇa, drink,Indra, theSomajuice; drink it, you who are entitled to praise, sympathizing with theMaruts; drink, sympathizing with the first drinkers, with the drinkers (at the sacriices) of the Ṛtus; sympathizing with the protectresses of the wives (of the gods), the giver of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जोष॑स आदि॒त्यैर्मा॑दयध्वं स॒जोष॑स ऋभव॒: पर्व॑तेभिः । स॒जोष॑सो॒ दैव्ये॑ना सवि॒त्रा स॒जोष॑स॒: सिन्धु॑भी रत्न॒धेभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ mādayadhvam ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ párvatebhiḥ ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ dáivyena ǀ savitrā́ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhébhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, be exhilarated, sympathizing with theĀdityas, sympathizing with theParvatas, sympathizing with the divineSavitā, sympathizing with the wealth-bestowing (deities of the) rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॒श्विना॒ ये पि॒तरा॒ य ऊ॒ती धे॒नुं त॑त॒क्षुॠ॒भवो॒ ये अश्वा॑ । ये अंस॑त्रा॒ य ऋध॒ग्रोद॑सी॒ ये विभ्वो॒ नर॑: स्वप॒त्यानि॑ च॒क्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ aśvínā ǀ yé ǀ pitárā ǀ yé ǀ ūtī́ ǀ dhenúm ǀ tatakṣúḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ yé ǀ áśvā ǀyé ǀ áṃsatrā ǀ yé ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yé ǀ ví-bhvaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ su-apatyā́ni ǀ cakrúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, who by your assistance (gratiied) theAśvins, who (renovated your) parents, who (restored) the cow, who fabricated the horses, who made armour (for the gods), who separated earth and heaven, and who, the all-pervading leaders (of rites), accomplished (acts productive of) good results.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये गोम॑न्तं॒ वाज॑वन्तं सु॒वीरं॑ र॒यिं ध॒त्थ वसु॑मन्तं पुरु॒क्षुम् । ते अ॑ग्रे॒पा ऋ॑भवो मन्दसा॒ना अ॒स्मे ध॑त्त॒ ये च॑ रा॒तिं गृ॒णन्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ gó-mantam ǀ vā́ja-vantam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ rayím ǀ dhatthá ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀté ǀ agre-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhatta ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ rātím ǀ gṛṇánti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, who posses wealth, comprising cattle, food, progeny, dwellings, and abundant sustenance, do you, who are the first drinkers (of theSoma), bestow upon us, when exhilarated, (that wealth and upon those) who laud your liberality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नापा॑भूत॒ न वो॑ऽतीतृषा॒मानि॑:शस्ता ऋभवो य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन् । समिन्द्रे॑ण॒ मद॑थ॒ सं म॒रुद्भि॒: सं राज॑भी रत्न॒धेया॑य देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ápa ǀ abhūta ǀ ná ǀ vaḥ ǀ atītṛṣāma ǀ ániḥ-śastāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀsám ǀ índreṇa ǀ mádatha ǀ sám ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ ratna-dhéyāya ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhus, go not away; let us not leave you (thirsting); (be present) unreproached at this sacrifice; be exhilarated, deities, along withIndra, with theMaruts, and with (other) brilliant (divinities), for the distribution of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒होप॑ यात शवसो नपात॒: सौध॑न्वना ऋभवो॒ माप॑ भूत । अ॒स्मिन्हि व॒: सव॑ने रत्न॒धेयं॒ गम॒न्त्विन्द्र॒मनु॑ वो॒ मदा॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ bhūta ǀasmín ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ sávane ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ gámantu ǀ índram ǀ ánu ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come hither, sons of strength, sons ofSudhanvan;Ṛbhus, keep not away; may the exhilarating juices proceed to you at this sacrifice, after the munificentIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग॑न्नृभू॒णामि॒ह र॑त्न॒धेय॒मभू॒त्सोम॑स्य॒ सुषु॑तस्य पी॒तिः । सु॒कृ॒त्यया॒ यत्स्व॑प॒स्यया॑ चँ॒ एकं॑ विच॒क्र च॑म॒सं च॑तु॒र्धा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agan ǀ ṛbhūṇā́m ǀ ihá ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ ábhūt ǀ sómasya ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ pītíḥ ǀsu-kṛtyáyā ǀ yát ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ ca ǀ ékam ǀ vi-cakrá ǀ camasám ǀ catuḥ-dhā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The munificene of theṚbhuscome to me on this occasion, (since) there has been the drinking of the effusedSoma, in consequence of one ladle having been made fourfold by their dexterous and excellent work.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑कृणोत चम॒सं च॑तु॒र्धा सखे॒ वि शि॒क्षेत्य॑ब्रवीत । अथै॑त वाजा अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ पन्थां॑ ग॒णं दे॒वाना॑मृभवः सुहस्ताः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ akṛṇota ǀ camasám ǀ catuḥ-dhā́ ǀ sákhe ǀ ví ǀ śikṣa ǀ íti ǀ abravīta ǀátha ǀ aita ǀ vājāḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ pánthām ǀ gaṇám ǀ devā́nām ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ su-hastāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have made the ladle fourfold, and have said (toAgni), assent (to the division); therefore have you gone,Vājas, the path of the immortals; dexterous-handedṚbhus(you have joined) the company of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कि॒म्मय॑: स्विच्चम॒स ए॒ष आ॑स॒ यं काव्ये॑न च॒तुरो॑ विच॒क्र । अथा॑ सुनुध्वं॒ सव॑नं॒ मदा॑य पा॒त ऋ॑भवो॒ मधु॑नः सो॒म्यस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: kim-máyaḥ ǀ svit ǀ camasáḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ āsa ǀ yám ǀ kā́vyena ǀ catúraḥ ǀ vi-cakrá ǀátha ǀ sunudhvam ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǀ pātá ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ somyásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What sort of ladle was that which by skill you have made four? now pour forth theSomafor their exhilaration; drink,Ṛbhus, of the sweet Soma libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शच्या॑कर्त पि॒तरा॒ युवा॑ना॒ शच्या॑कर्त चम॒सं दे॑व॒पान॑म् । शच्या॒ हरी॒ धनु॑तरावतष्टेन्द्र॒वाहा॑वृभवो वाजरत्नाः
shlokas.transliteration: śácyā ǀ akarta ǀ pitárā ǀ yúvānā ǀ śácyā ǀ akarta ǀ camasám ǀ deva-pā́nam ǀśácyā ǀ hárī íti ǀ dhánu-tarau ǀ ataṣṭa ǀ indra-vā́hau ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vāja-ratnāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By your (marvellous) deeds you have made your parents youg; by your deeds you have made the ladle (fit) for the drinking of the gods; by your deeds you have made the two horses, the bearers ofIndra, swifter than (an arrow from) a bow,Ṛbhus, who are rich in (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो व॑: सु॒नोत्य॑भिपि॒त्वे अह्नां॑ ती॒व्रं वा॑जास॒: सव॑नं॒ मदा॑य । तस्मै॑ र॒यिमृ॑भव॒: सर्व॑वीर॒मा त॑क्षत वृषणो मन्दसा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sunóti ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ áhnām ǀ tīvrám ǀ vājāsaḥ ǀ sávanam ǀ mádāya ǀtásmai ǀ rayím ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ ā́ ǀ takṣata ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Distributors of food,Ṛbhus, showerers (of benefits), exhilarated (by theSomadraught), fabricated wealth, comprising all posterity for him who pours out for your exhilaration, the acrid libation at the deline of day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तः सु॒तम॑पिबो हर्यश्व॒ माध्यं॑दिनं॒ सव॑नं॒ केव॑लं ते । समृ॒भुभि॑: पिबस्व रत्न॒धेभि॒: सखीँ॒र्याँ इ॑न्द्र चकृ॒षे सु॑कृ॒त्या
shlokas.transliteration: prātáríti ǀ sutám ǀ apibaḥ ǀ hari-aśva ǀ mā́dhyandinam ǀ sávanam ǀ kévalam ǀ te ǀsám ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ pibasva ǀ ratna-dhébhiḥ ǀ sákhīn ǀ yā́n ǀ indra ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ su-kṛtyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink, lord of horses,Indra, the libation offered at dawn; the noon-day libation is alone for you; but (in the evening) drink with the munificentṚbhus, whom, Indra, you have made your friends by good deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये दे॒वासो॒ अभ॑वता सुकृ॒त्या श्ये॒ना इ॒वेदधि॑ दि॒वि नि॑षे॒द । ते रत्नं॑ धात शवसो नपात॒: सौध॑न्वना॒ अभ॑वता॒मृता॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ábhavata ǀ su-kṛtyā́ ǀ śyenā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ ádhi ǀ diví ǀ ni-sedá ǀté ǀ rátnam ǀ dhāta ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ sáudhanvanāḥ ǀ ábhavata ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, sons of strength, who have become gods by (your) good deeds, soaring aloft in the sky like falcons, bestow upon us riches; sons ofSudhanvan, you have become immortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्तृ॒तीयं॒ सव॑नं रत्न॒धेय॒मकृ॑णुध्वं स्वप॒स्या सु॑हस्ताः । तदृ॑भव॒: परि॑षिक्तं व ए॒तत्सं मदे॑भिरिन्द्रि॒येभि॑: पिबध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ sávanam ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ ákṛṇudhvam ǀ su-apasyā́ ǀ su-hastāḥ ǀtát ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ pári-siktam ǀ vaḥ ǀ etát ǀ sám ǀ mádebhiḥ ǀ indriyébhiḥ ǀ pibadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dexterous-handed, since you have instrumental tuted, through desire of good works, the third sacrifice, which is the bestower of wealth, therefore,Ṛbhus, drink this effusedSomawith exhilarated senseṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न॒श्वो जा॒तो अ॑नभी॒शुरु॒क्थ्यो॒३॒॑ रथ॑स्त्रिच॒क्रः परि॑ वर्तते॒ रज॑: । म॒हत्तद्वो॑ दे॒व्य॑स्य प्र॒वाच॑नं॒ द्यामृ॑भवः पृथि॒वीं यच्च॒ पुष्य॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: anaśváḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ anabhīśúḥ ǀ ukthyáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ tri-cakráḥ ǀ pári ǀ vartate ǀ rájaḥ ǀmahát ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ devyásya ǀ pra-vā́canam ǀ dyā́m ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ púṣyatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The glorious three-wheeled car (of theAśvinsmade,Ṛbhusby you) traverses the firmament without horses, without reins; great was that proclamation of your divine (power), by which, Ṛbhus, you cherish heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ ये च॒क्रुः सु॒वृतं॑ सु॒चेत॒सोऽवि॑ह्वरन्तं॒ मन॑स॒स्परि॒ ध्यया॑ । ताँ ऊ॒ न्व१॒॑स्य सव॑नस्य पी॒तय॒ आ वो॑ वाजा ऋभवो वेदयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ yé ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ su-vṛ́tam ǀ su-cétasaḥ ǀ ávi-hvarantam ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ dhyáyā ǀtā́n ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ asyá ǀ sávanasya ǀ pītáye ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ vedayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you respectfully,VājasandṚbhus, to drink of this libation, for you are the wise sages, who, by mental meditation, made the well-constructed undeviating car (of theAśvins).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वो॑ वाजा ऋभवः सुप्रवाच॒नं दे॒वेषु॑ विभ्वो अभवन्महित्व॒नम् । जिव्री॒ यत्सन्ता॑ पि॒तरा॑ सना॒जुरा॒ पुन॒र्युवा॑ना च॒रथा॑य॒ तक्ष॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ su-pravācanám ǀ devéṣu ǀ vi-bhvaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ mahi-tvanám ǀjívrī íti ǀ yát ǀ sántā ǀ pitárā ǀ sanā-júrā ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yúvānā ǀ caráthāya ǀ tákṣatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore,Vāja,Ṛbhu, Vibhvan, was your greatness proclaimed among the gods, that you made your aged and inform parents young (and able) to go (withere they would).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एकं॒ वि च॑क्र चम॒सं चतु॑र्वयं॒ निश्चर्म॑णो॒ गाम॑रिणीत धी॒तिभि॑: । अथा॑ दे॒वेष्व॑मृत॒त्वमा॑नश श्रु॒ष्टी वा॑जा ऋभव॒स्तद्व॑ उ॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ékam ǀ ví ǀ cakra ǀ camasám ǀ cátuḥ-vayam ǀ níḥ ǀ cármaṇaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ ariṇīta ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀátha ǀ devéṣu ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśa ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have made the single ladle fourfold; by your (marvellous) acts you have clothed the cow with a (new) hide; therefore you have obtained immortality among the gods; such acts,VājasandṚbhus, are to be eagerly glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भु॒तो र॒यिः प्र॑थ॒मश्र॑वस्तमो॒ वाज॑श्रुतासो॒ यमजी॑जन॒न्नर॑: । वि॒भ्व॒त॒ष्टो वि॒दथे॑षु प्र॒वाच्यो॒ यं दे॑वा॒सोऽव॑था॒ स विच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhutáḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ prathamáśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ vā́ja-śrutāsaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ájījanan ǀ náraḥ ǀvibhva-taṣṭáḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ pra-vā́cyaḥ ǀ yám ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ávatha ǀ sáḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From theṚbhusmay wealth, the best and most productive of food, (come to me); that which the leaders of rites renowned together with theVājas, have engendered; that which has been fabricated by Vibhvan and is to be celebrated at sacrifice; that which, deities you protect, that is to be beheld.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॒ज्यर्वा॒ स ऋषि॑र्वच॒स्यया॒ स शूरो॒ अस्ता॒ पृत॑नासु दु॒ष्टर॑: । स रा॒यस्पोषं॒ स सु॒वीर्यं॑ दधे॒ यं वाजो॒ विभ्वाँ॑ ऋ॒भवो॒ यमावि॑षुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ árvā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ vacasyáyā ǀ sáḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ástā ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ dustáraḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ sáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ dadhe ǀ yám ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ā́viṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is vigorous and skilled in war, he is a ṛṣi worthy of homage, he is a hero, the discomfiter of foes, invincible in battles, he is possessed of ample wealth, and (is blessed) with excellent posterity, whomVājaand Vibhvan, whom theṚbhusprotect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रेष्ठं॑ व॒: पेशो॒ अधि॑ धायि दर्श॒तं स्तोमो॑ वाजा ऋभव॒स्तं जु॑जुष्टन । धीरा॑सो॒ हि ष्ठा क॒वयो॑ विप॒श्चित॒स्तान्व॑ ए॒ना ब्रह्म॒णा वे॑दयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: śréṣṭham ǀ vaḥ ǀ péśaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatám ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ tám ǀ jujuṣṭana ǀdhī́rāsaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ vaḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ vedayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “An excellent and agreeable form has been assumed by you; (this is our own) praise;VājasandṚbhusbe gratified (thereby), for you are wise, experienced, and intelligent; such we make you known (to be) by this (our) prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यम॒स्मभ्यं॑ धि॒षणा॑भ्य॒स्परि॑ वि॒द्वांसो॒ विश्वा॒ नर्या॑णि॒ भोज॑ना । द्यु॒मन्तं॒ वाजं॒ वृष॑शुष्ममुत्त॒ममा नो॑ र॒यिमृ॑भवस्तक्ष॒ता वय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dhiṣáṇābhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vidvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ náryāṇi ǀ bhójanā ǀdyu-mántam ǀ vā́jam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-śuṣmam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ takṣata ǀ ā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you who are wise, (bestow) upon us, in requital of our praises, all enjoyments that are good for man and fabricate for us,Ṛbhus, riches and food, resplendent invigorating, overpowering (foes), and most excellent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह प्र॒जामि॒ह र॒यिं ररा॑णा इ॒ह श्रवो॑ वी॒रव॑त्तक्षता नः । येन॑ व॒यं चि॒तये॒मात्य॒न्यान्तं वाजं॑ चि॒त्रमृ॑भवो ददा नः
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ihá ǀ rayím ǀ rárāṇāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ takṣata ǀ naḥ ǀyéna ǀ vayám ǀ citáyema ǀ áti ǀ anyā́n ǀ tám ǀ vā́jam ǀ citrám ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ dada ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratified (by your worship), fabricate for us, on this occasion, progeny and wealth, and reputation, with numerous adherents; grant to us,Ṛbhus, abundant sustenance wherewith we may greatly excel others.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नो वाजा अध्व॒रमृ॑भुक्षा॒ देवा॑ या॒त प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑: । यथा॑ य॒ज्ञं मनु॑षो वि॒क्ष्वा॒३॒॑सु द॑धि॒ध्वे र॑ण्वाः सु॒दिने॒ष्वह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ ṛbhukṣāḥ ǀ dévāḥ ǀ yātá ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǀyáthā ǀ yajñám ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ āsú ǀ dadhidhvé ǀ raṇvāḥ ǀ su-díneṣu ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineVājas,Ṛbhus, come to our sacrifice by the path travelled by the gods, inasmuch as you, gracious (Ṛbhus), have maintained sacrifice among the people, (the progeny) ofManu, for (the sake of) securing the prosperous course of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते वो॑ हृ॒दे मन॑से सन्तु य॒ज्ञा जुष्टा॑सो अ॒द्य घृ॒तनि॑र्णिजो गुः । प्र व॑: सु॒तासो॑ हरयन्त पू॒र्णाः क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य हर्षयन्त पी॒ताः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ vaḥ ǀ hṛdé ǀ mánase ǀ santu ǀ yajñā́ḥ ǀ júṣṭāsaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ghṛtá-nirnijaḥ ǀ guḥ ǀprá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ harayanta ǀ pūrṇā́ḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ harṣayanta ǀ pītā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these sacrifices be (acceptable) to you in heart and mind; may today the sufficient (juices) mixed with butter to you; the full libations are prepared for you; may they, when drunk, animate you for glorious deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्र्यु॒दा॒यं दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यथा॑ व॒: स्तोमो॑ वाजा ऋभुक्षणो द॒दे व॑: । जु॒ह्वे म॑नु॒ष्वदुप॑रासु वि॒क्षु यु॒ष्मे सचा॑ बृ॒हद्दि॑वेषु॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-udāyám ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yáthā ǀ vaḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ dadé ǀ vaḥ ǀjuhvé ǀ manuṣvát ǀ úparāsu ǀ vikṣú ǀ yuṣmé íti ǀ sácā ǀ bṛhát-diveṣu ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the offering suited to the gods at the third (daily) sacrifice supports, you,Vājas, Ṛbhukṣans; as the praise (then recited supports you); therefore, likeManu, I offer you theSomajuice, along with the very radiant (deities) among the people assembled at the solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पीवो॑अश्वाः शु॒चद्र॑था॒ हि भू॒ताय॑:शिप्रा वाजिनः सुनि॒ष्काः । इन्द्र॑स्य सूनो शवसो नपा॒तोऽनु॑ वश्चेत्यग्रि॒यं मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: pī́vaḥ-aśvāḥ ǀ śucát-rathāḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhūtá ǀ áyaḥ-śiprāḥ ǀ vājinaḥ ǀ su-niṣkā́ḥ ǀíndrasya ǀ sūno íti ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ napātaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vaḥ ǀ ceti ǀ agriyám ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vājins, you are borne by stout horses mounted on a brilliant car, have jaws of metal and are possessed of treasures; sons ofIndra, grandsons of strength, this last sacrifice is for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुमृ॑भुक्षणो र॒यिं वाजे॑ वा॒जिन्त॑मं॒ युज॑म् । इन्द्र॑स्वन्तं हवामहे सदा॒सात॑मम॒श्विन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúm ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vā́je ǀ vājín-tamam ǀ yújam ǀíndrasvantam ǀ havāmahe ǀ sadā-sā́tamam ǀ aśvínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you, Ṛbhukṣans, for splendid wealth, mutually co-operating, most invigorating in war, affecting the senses, ever munificent, and comprehending horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेदृ॑भवो॒ यमव॑थ यू॒यमिन्द्र॑श्च॒ मर्त्य॑म् । स धी॒भिर॑स्तु॒ सनि॑ता मे॒धसा॑ता॒ सो अर्व॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ṛbhavaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ávatha ǀ yūyám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártyam ǀsáḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ astu ǀ sánitā ǀ medhá-sātā ǀ sáḥ ǀ árvatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the man whom you,ṚbhusandIndra, favour, be ever liberal by his acts, and possessed of a horse at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि नो॑ वाजा ऋभुक्षणः प॒थश्चि॑तन॒ यष्ट॑वे । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ सूरयः स्तु॒ता विश्वा॒ आशा॑स्तरी॒षणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ citana ǀ yáṣṭave ǀasmábhyam ǀ sūrayaḥ ǀ stutā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ā́śāḥ ǀ tarīṣáṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vājas, Ṛbhukṣaṇs, direct us in the way to sacrifice; for you, who are intelligent, being glorified (by us), are able to traverse all the quarters (of space).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नो॑ वाजा ऋभुक्षण॒ इन्द्र॒ नास॑त्या र॒यिम् । समश्वं॑ चर्ष॒णिभ्य॒ आ पु॒रु श॑स्त म॒घत्त॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ índra ǀ nā́satyā ǀ rayím ǀsám ǀ áśvam ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ purú ǀ śasta ǀ magháttaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vājas, Ṛbhukṣaṇs,Indra,Nāsatyas, command that ample wealth with horses be sent to men for their enrichment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो हि वां॑ दा॒त्रा सन्ति॒ पूर्वा॒ या पू॒रुभ्य॑स्त्र॒सद॑स्युर्नितो॒शे । क्षे॒त्रा॒सां द॑दथुरुर्वरा॒सां घ॒नं दस्यु॑भ्यो अ॒भिभू॑तिमु॒ग्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ dātrā́ ǀ sánti ǀ pū́rvā ǀ yā́ ǀ pūrú-bhyaḥ ǀ trasádasyuḥ ǀ ni-tośé ǀkṣetra-sā́m ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ urvarā-sā́m ǀ ghanám ǀ dásyu-bhyaḥ ǀ abhí-bhūtim ǀ ugrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Trasadasyuhas bestowed upon many the ancient (gifts) which were obtained by the liberal (prince) through your (favour, Heaven and Earth) you two have given a horse, a son, a weapon (for the destruction) of theDasyus, fierce and foe-subduing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वा॒जिनं॑ पुरुनि॒ष्षिध्वा॑नं दधि॒क्रामु॑ ददथुर्वि॒श्वकृ॑ष्टिम् । ऋ॒जि॒प्यं श्ये॒नं प्रु॑षि॒तप्सु॑मा॒शुं च॒र्कृत्य॑म॒र्यो नृ॒पतिं॒ न शूर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vājínam ǀ puruniḥ-sídhvānam ǀ dadhi-krā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ viśvá-kṛṣṭim ǀṛjipyám ǀ śyenám ǀ pruṣitá-psum ǀ āśúm ǀ carkṛ́tyam ǀ aryáḥ ǀ nṛ-pátim ǀ ná ǀ śū́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And you two have given the swift Dadhikrā, the repeller of many (foes), the defender of all men, the straight-going, the graceful-moving, the resplendent, the rapid, the destroyer of enemies like a heroic prince.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं सी॒मनु॑ प्र॒वते॑व॒ द्रव॑न्तं॒ विश्व॑: पू॒रुर्मद॑ति॒ हर्ष॑माणः । प॒ड्भिर्गृध्य॑न्तं मेध॒युं न शूरं॑ रथ॒तुरं॒ वात॑मिव॒ ध्रज॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ sīm ǀ ánu ǀ pravátā-iva ǀ drávantam ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ pūrúḥ ǀ mádati ǀ hárṣamāṇaḥ ǀpaṭ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛ́dhyantam ǀ medha-yúm ǀ ná ǀ śū́ram ǀ ratha-túram ǀ vā́tam-iva ǀ dhrájantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom all men, rejoicing, praise, rushing everywhere, as if down a precipice, springing with his feet like a hero eager for war, drawing a car, and going as swift as the wind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः स्मा॑रुन्धा॒नो गध्या॑ स॒मत्सु॒ सनु॑तर॒श्चर॑ति॒ गोषु॒ गच्छ॑न् । आ॒विॠ॑जीको वि॒दथा॑ नि॒चिक्य॑त्ति॒रो अ॑र॒तिं पर्याप॑ आ॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sma ǀ ā-rundhānáḥ ǀ gádhyā ǀ samát-su ǀ sánu-taraḥ ǀ cárati ǀ góṣu ǀ gácchan ǀāvíḥ-ṛjīkaḥ ǀ vidáthā ǀ ni-cíkyat ǀ tiráḥ ǀ aratím ǀ pári ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, opposing the mingled multitude in battles, rushes eager, passing through the regions, whose vigour is manifestl, who, understanding what is to be known, puts to shame the adversary of the (pious) man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मै॑नं वस्त्र॒मथिं॒ न ता॒युमनु॑ क्रोशन्ति क्षि॒तयो॒ भरे॑षु । नी॒चाय॑मानं॒ जसु॑रिं॒ न श्ये॒नं श्रव॒श्चाच्छा॑ पशु॒मच्च॑ यू॒थम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ enam ǀ vastra-máthim ǀ ná ǀ tāyúm ǀ ánu ǀ krośanti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ bháreṣu ǀnīcā́ ǀ áyamānam ǀ jásurim ǀ ná ǀ śyenám ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ca ǀ áccha ǀ paśu-mát ǀ ca ǀ yūthám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom men call after in battles, as after a thief carrying off a garment, or as (after) a hungry hawk pouncing (upon his prey); they call after him, hastening to obtain food, or a herd of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॑सु प्रथ॒मः स॑रि॒ष्यन्नि वे॑वेति॒ श्रेणि॑भी॒ रथा॑नाम् । स्रजं॑ कृण्वा॒नो जन्यो॒ न शुभ्वा॑ रे॒णुं रेरि॑हत्कि॒रणं॑ दद॒श्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ āsu ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sariṣyán ǀ ní ǀ veveti ǀ śréṇi-bhiḥ ǀ ráthānām ǀsrájam ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ jányaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śúbhvā ǀ reṇúm ǀ rérihat ǀ kiráṇam ǀ dadaśvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And who, issuing forth the first in those encounters, rushes in various directions with rows of chariots; like an elegant (courser), friendly to man, decorated with a garland, raising the dust, and champing his bit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य वा॒जी सहु॑रिॠ॒तावा॒ शुश्रू॑षमाणस्त॒न्वा॑ सम॒र्ये । तुरं॑ य॒तीषु॑ तु॒रय॑न्नृजि॒प्योऽधि॑ भ्रु॒वोः कि॑रते रे॒णुमृ॒ञ्जन्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ sáhuriḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ śúśrūṣamāṇaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sa-maryé ǀtúram ǀ yatī́ṣu ǀ turáyan ǀ ṛjipyáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ bhruvóḥ ǀ kirate ǀ reṇúm ǀ ṛñján ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And that swift (horse) enduring in battle, bestowing food, and doing service with his limbs, rushing swiftly upon the quick-moving (host of the enemy), going straight onward, and tossing up the dust, throws it above his brows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॑स्य तन्य॒तोरि॑व॒ द्योॠ॑घाय॒तो अ॑भि॒युजो॑ भयन्ते । य॒दा स॒हस्र॑म॒भि षी॒मयो॑धीद्दु॒र्वर्तु॑: स्मा भवति भी॒म ऋ॒ञ्जन्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ asya ǀ tanyatóḥ-iva ǀ dyóḥ ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ bhayante ǀyadā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ abhí ǀ sīm ǀ áyodhīt ǀ duḥ-vártuḥ ǀ sma ǀ bhavati ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ṛñján ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And the adversaries of that foe-destroying steed, like (those) of the brilliant thunderbolt, are alarmed; for when he contends, even against thousands on every side, then, rousing (his spirit), he is fearful and irresistible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॑स्य पनयन्ति॒ जना॑ जू॒तिं कृ॑ष्टि॒प्रो अ॒भिभू॑तिमा॒शोः । उ॒तैन॑माहुः समि॒थे वि॒यन्त॒: परा॑ दधि॒क्रा अ॑सरत्स॒हस्रै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ asya ǀ panayanti ǀ jánāḥ ǀ jūtím ǀ kṛṣṭi-práḥ ǀ abhí-bhūtim ǀ āśóḥ ǀutá ǀ enam ǀ āhuḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ vi-yántaḥ ǀ párā ǀ dadhi-krā́ḥ ǀ asarat ǀ sahásraiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men praise the overpowering rapidty of that fleet (steed), who is the accomplisher (of the desires) of mankind, and following him to battle, they have said, Dadhikrā with (his) thousands has gone forth against the foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ द॑धि॒क्राः शव॑सा॒ पञ्च॑ कृ॒ष्टीः सूर्य॑ इव॒ ज्योति॑षा॒पस्त॑तान । स॒ह॒स्र॒साः श॑त॒सा वा॒ज्यर्वा॑ पृ॒णक्तु॒ मध्वा॒ समि॒मा वचां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dadhi-krā́ḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ páñca ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ apáḥ ǀ tatāna ǀsahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ śata-sā́ḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ árvā ǀ pṛṇáktu ǀ mádhvā ǀ sám ǀ imā́ ǀ vácāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dadhikrā has spread abroad the five classes of beings by his strength, as the sun (diffuses) the waters by his radiance; may he, the giver of hundreds and thousands, associate these praises with agreeable (rewards).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒शुं द॑धि॒क्रां तमु॒ नु ष्ट॑वाम दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्या उ॒त च॑र्किराम । उ॒च्छन्ती॒र्मामु॒षस॑: सूदय॒न्त्वति॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒तानि॑ पर्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: āśúm ǀ dadhi-krā́m ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ stavāma ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ carkirāma ǀucchántīḥ ǀ mā́m ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sūdayantu ǀ áti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ parṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily we praise that swift Dadhikrā and scatter (proved before him) from heaven and earth; may the gloom-dispelling dawns preserve for me (all good things), and bear me beyond all evils.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हश्च॑र्क॒र्म्यर्व॑तः क्रतु॒प्रा द॑धि॒क्राव्ण॑: पुरु॒वार॑स्य॒ वृष्ण॑: । यं पू॒रुभ्यो॑ दीदि॒वांसं॒ नाग्निं द॒दथु॑र्मित्रावरुणा॒ ततु॑रिम्
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ carkarmi ǀ árvataḥ ǀ kratu-prā́ḥ ǀ dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ puru-vā́rasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀyám ǀ pūrú-bhyaḥ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ ná ǀ agním ǀ dadáthuḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ táturim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fulfiller of religious rites, I reiterate the praise of the great Dadhikrā, the liberal, many-honoured showerer (of benefits), whomMitraandVaruṇagave for the good of many, the transporter (beyond calamity), as brilliant asAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अश्व॑स्य दधि॒क्राव्णो॒ अका॑री॒त्समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्ना उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । अना॑गसं॒ तमदि॑तिः कृणोतु॒ स मि॒त्रेण॒ वरु॑णेना स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ ákārīt ǀ sám-iddhe ǀ agnáu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀánāgasam ǀ tám ǀ áditiḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ sáḥ ǀ mitréṇa ǀ váruṇena ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAditi, consentient withMitraandVaruṇarender him free from sin who has performed the worship of the steed Dadhikrā, when the fire has been kindled at the opening of the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्राव्ण॑ इ॒ष ऊ॒र्जो म॒हो यदम॑न्महि म॒रुतां॒ नाम॑ भ॒द्रम् । स्व॒स्तये॒ वरु॑णं मि॒त्रम॒ग्निं हवा॑मह॒ इन्द्रं॒ वज्र॑बाहुम्
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yát ǀ ámanmahi ǀ marútām ǀ nā́ma ǀ bhadrám ǀsvastáye ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ agním ǀ hávāmahe ǀ índram ǀ vájra-bāhum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “While we glorify the name of the great Dadhikrā the means of sustenance and of strength, the prosperity of those who praise (him), let us invoke (also) for our welfareVaruṇa,Mitra,Agni, andIndra, the bearer of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑मि॒वेदु॒भये॒ वि ह्व॑यन्त उ॒दीरा॑णा य॒ज्ञमु॑पप्र॒यन्त॑: । द॒धि॒क्रामु॒ सूद॑नं॒ मर्त्या॑य द॒दथु॑र्मित्रावरुणा नो॒ अश्व॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índram-iva ǀ ít ǀ ubháye ǀ ví ǀ hvayante ǀ ut-ī́rāṇāḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ upa-prayántaḥ ǀdadhi-krā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́danam ǀ mártyāya ǀ dadáthuḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ naḥ ǀ áśvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who are preparing for battle, those who are proceeding to sacrifice, both invoke (Dadhikra) as if (he was)Indra;MitraandVaruṇahave given to us the horse Dadhikrā as an encourager to man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्राव्णो॑ अकारिषं जि॒ष्णोरश्व॑स्य वा॒जिन॑: । सु॒र॒भि नो॒ मुखा॑ कर॒त्प्र ण॒ आयूं॑षि तारिषत्
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ akāriṣam ǀ jiṣṇóḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀsurabhí ǀ naḥ ǀ múkhā ǀ karat ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ tāriṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have celebrated the praise of Dadhikrā, the rapid and victorious stee; may he make our mouths fragrant, may he prolong our lives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्राव्ण॒ इदु॒ नु च॑र्किराम॒ विश्वा॒ इन्मामु॒षस॑: सूदयन्तु । अ॒पाम॒ग्नेरु॒षस॒: सूर्य॑स्य॒ बृह॒स्पते॑राङ्गिर॒सस्य॑ जि॒ष्णोः
