shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ carkirāma ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ mā́m ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sūdayantu ǀapā́m ǀ agnéḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ bṛ́haspáteḥ ǀ āṅgirasásya ǀ jiṣṇóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we repeatedly recite (the praise) of Dadhikrāvaṇ; may all rising dawns excite me (to the adoration) of the waters, ofAgni, of Uṣas, ofSūrya, ofBṛhaspati, and ofJiṣṇu, the son ofAṅgiras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सत्वा॑ भरि॒षो ग॑वि॒षो दु॑वन्य॒सच्छ्र॑व॒स्यादि॒ष उ॒षस॑स्तुरण्य॒सत् । स॒त्यो द्र॒वो द्र॑व॒रः प॑तंग॒रो द॑धि॒क्रावेष॒मूर्जं॒ स्व॑र्जनत्
shlokas.transliteration: sátvā ǀ bhariṣáḥ ǀ go-iṣáḥ ǀ duvanya-sát ǀ śravasyā́t ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ turaṇya-sát ǀsatyáḥ ǀ draváḥ ǀ dravaráḥ ǀ pataṅgaráḥ ǀ dadhi-krā́vā ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ sváḥ ǀ janat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Dadhikrāvaṇ, the active, the cherisher, the giver of cattle, who abides with the devout, the swift-going, be willing to accept (the sacrificial) food at the time of the desirable dawn; may he who is true, moving, rapid, and leaping like a grasshopper, produce (for us) food, strength and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्मा॑स्य॒ द्रव॑तस्तुरण्य॒तः प॒र्णं न वेरनु॑ वाति प्रग॒र्धिन॑: । श्ये॒नस्ये॑व॒ ध्रज॑तो अङ्क॒सं परि॑ दधि॒क्राव्ण॑: स॒होर्जा तरि॑त्रतः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ asya ǀ drávataḥ ǀ turaṇyatáḥ ǀ parṇám ǀ ná ǀ véḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vāti ǀ pra-gardhínaḥ ǀśyenásya-iva ǀ dhrájataḥ ǀ aṅkasám ǀ pári ǀ dadhi-krā́vṇaḥ ǀ sahá ǀ ūrjā́ ǀ táritrataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And after him who is quick-going, hastening, eager (to arrive at his goald, men) follow (as other birds pursue) the flight of a swift (bird) striving together to keep up by the side of Dadhikrāvan. the transporter (of others) as swift as a hawk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य वा॒जी क्षि॑प॒णिं तु॑रण्यति ग्री॒वायां॑ ब॒द्धो अ॑पिक॒क्ष आ॒सनि॑ । क्रतुं॑ दधि॒क्रा अनु॑ सं॒तवी॑त्वत्प॒थामङ्कां॒स्यन्वा॒पनी॑फणत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ kṣipaṇím ǀ turaṇyati ǀ grīvā́yām ǀ baddháḥ ǀ api-kakṣé ǀ āsáni ǀkrátum ǀ dadhi-krā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ sam-távītvat ǀ pathā́m ǀ áṅkāṃsi ǀ ánu ǀ ā-pánīphaṇat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And that horse bound by his neck, his flanks, his mouth, accelerates his paces; Dadhikrā increasing in vigour after the (sacred rite), following the windings of the roads, goes still more rapidly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हं॒सः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दुरोण॒सत् । नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद्व्यो॑म॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: haṃsáḥ ǀ śuci-sát ǀ vásuḥ ǀ antarikṣa-sát ǀ hótā ǀ vedi-sát ǀ átithiḥ ǀ duroṇa-sát ǀnṛ-sát ǀ vara-sát ǀ ṛta-sát ǀ vyoma-sát ǀ ap-jā́ḥ ǀ go-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-jā́ḥ ǀ adri-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is theHaṃsa, (the sun), dwelling;Vasu(the wind), dwelling in the firmament; the invoker of the gods (Agni), dwelling on the altar; the guest (of the worshipper), dweling in the house (as the culinary fire); the dweller among men, (as consciousness), the dweller in the most excellent (orbl, the sun), the dweller in truth, the dweller in the sky (the air), born in the waters, in the rays of light, in the verity (of manifestation) in the (eastern) mountain, the truth (itself).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒ को वां॑ वरुणा सु॒म्नमा॑प॒ स्तोमो॑ ह॒विष्माँ॑ अ॒मृतो॒ न होता॑ । यो वां॑ हृ॒दि क्रतु॑माँ अ॒स्मदु॒क्तः प॒स्पर्श॑दिन्द्रावरुणा॒ नम॑स्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ káḥ ǀ vām ǀ varuṇā ǀ sumnám ǀ āpa ǀ stómaḥ ǀ havíṣmān ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ hṛdí ǀ krátu-mān ǀ asmát ǀ uktáḥ ǀ paspárśat ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ námasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra(andVaruṇa), Varuṇa (and Indra), what praise of you accompanied by oblations may obtain for us felicity, (such as) the immortal invoker of the gods, (Agni, may bestow); may (the praise) which is addressed by us to you both, Indra and Varuṇa, sanctified by acts and prompted by veneration, touch your heartṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ ह॒ यो वरु॑णा च॒क्र आ॒पी दे॒वौ मर्त॑: स॒ख्याय॒ प्रय॑स्वान् । स ह॑न्ति वृ॒त्रा स॑मि॒थेषु॒ शत्रू॒नवो॑भिर्वा म॒हद्भि॒: स प्र शृ॑ण्वे
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ ha ǀ yáḥ ǀ váruṇā ǀ cakré ǀ āpī́ íti ǀ deváu ǀ mártaḥ ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ práyasvān ǀsáḥ ǀ hanti ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ śátrūn ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ śṛṇve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineIndraandVaruṇa, the mortal diligent in offering (you) sacrificial food, who has through friendship made you his kinsmen, destroys (his own) sins, and his enemies in battle; and by your great favours he becomes renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ ह॒ रत्नं॒ वरु॑णा॒ धेष्ठे॒त्था नृभ्य॑: शशमा॒नेभ्य॒स्ता । यदी॒ सखा॑या स॒ख्याय॒ सोमै॑: सु॒तेभि॑: सुप्र॒यसा॑ मा॒दयै॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ ha ǀ rátnam ǀ váruṇā ǀ dhéṣṭhā ǀ itthā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ śaśamānébhyaḥ ǀ tā́ ǀyádi ǀ sákhāyā ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ sutébhiḥ ǀ su-prayásā ǀ mādáyaite íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa(you are) most liberal givers of wealth to men praising you in various ways, when as friends well plural ed with (sacrificial) food, you are exhilarated by theSomajuice effused through friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ यु॒वं व॑रुणा दि॒द्युम॑स्मि॒न्नोजि॑ष्ठमुग्रा॒ नि व॑धिष्टं॒ वज्र॑म् । यो नो॑ दु॒रेवो॑ वृ॒कति॑र्द॒भीति॒स्तस्मि॑न्मिमाथाम॒भिभू॒त्योज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ yuvám ǀ varuṇā ǀ didyúm ǀ asmin ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ ugrā ǀ ní ǀ vadhiṣṭam ǀ vájram ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-évaḥ ǀ vṛkátiḥ ǀ dabhī́tiḥ ǀ tásmin ǀ mimāthām ǀ abhí-bhūti ǀ ójaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndraandVaruṇayou hurled the bright-shining and most mighty thunderbolt against this (our foe), who is difficult ot be resisted by us; (who is) rapacious, malevolent; grant us strength to overcome him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ यु॒वं व॑रुणा भू॒तम॒स्या धि॒यः प्रे॒तारा॑ वृष॒भेव॑ धे॒नोः । सा नो॑ दुहीय॒द्यव॑सेव ग॒त्वी स॒हस्र॑धारा॒ पय॑सा म॒ही गौः
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ yuvám ǀ varuṇā ǀ bhūtám ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ pretā́rā ǀ vṛṣabhā́-iva ǀ dhenóḥ ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duhīyat ǀ yávasā-iva ǀ gatvī́ ǀ sahásra-dhārā ǀ páyasā ǀ mahī́ ǀ gáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, be the exciters of this our praise, as the bull is of the cows; may that cow (of praise) yield us (reward), like a large cow that has gone forth to pasture, whose thousand channels (are filled) with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तो॒के हि॒ते तन॑य उ॒र्वरा॑सु॒ सूरो॒ दृशी॑के॒ वृष॑णश्च॒ पौंस्ये॑ । इन्द्रा॑ नो॒ अत्र॒ वरु॑णा स्याता॒मवो॑भिर्द॒स्मा परि॑तक्म्यायाम्
shlokas.transliteration: toké ǀ hité ǀ tánaye ǀ urvárāsu ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ dṛ́śīke ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ páuṃsye ǀíndrā ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ váruṇā ǀ syātām ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ dasmā́ ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndraandVaruṇa, the overthrowers (of foes), be around us with (their) protections; (that thereby we may have) good sons and grandsons, and fertile lands, and long life, and virility.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वामिद्ध्यव॑से पू॒र्व्याय॒ परि॒ प्रभू॑ती ग॒विष॑: स्वापी । वृ॒णी॒महे॑ स॒ख्याय॑ प्रि॒याय॒ शूरा॒ मंहि॑ष्ठा पि॒तरे॑व श॒म्भू
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ ávase ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀ pári ǀ prábhūtī íti prá-bhūtī ǀ go-íṣaḥ ǀ svāpī íti su-āpī ǀvṛṇīmáhe ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ priyā́ya ǀ śū́rā ǀ máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ śambhū́ íti śam-bhū́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of (possessing) cattlle, we have recourse to you,IndraandVaruṇa, for full protection, you who are powerful and kind as (kinsmen); we have recourse to you, adorable heroes, for (your) friendship and affection, (to you who are), like parents, givers of happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॒ धियोऽव॑से वाज॒यन्ती॑रा॒जिं न ज॑ग्मुर्युव॒यूः सु॑दानू । श्रि॒ये न गाव॒ उप॒ सोम॑मस्थु॒रिन्द्रं॒ गिरो॒ वरु॑णं मे मनी॒षाः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ vāja-yántīḥ ǀ ājím ǀ ná ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ yuva-yū́ḥ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀśriyé ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sómam ǀ asthuḥ ǀ índram ǀ gíraḥ ǀ váruṇam ǀ me ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal givers, those (our) praises soliciting (abundant) food have proceeded to you for (your) protection; longing for you as (soldiers long) for battle, and as cattle approach theSomafor (its) advantage, so my heartfelt hymns (approach)IndraandVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा इन्द्रं॒ वरु॑णं मे मनी॒षा अग्म॒न्नुप॒ द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑नाः । उपे॑मस्थुर्जो॒ष्टार॑ इव॒ वस्वो॑ र॒घ्वीरि॑व॒ श्रव॑सो॒ भिक्ष॑माणाः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ váruṇam ǀ me ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ ágman ǀ úpa ǀ dráviṇam ǀ icchámānāḥ ǀúpa ǀ īm ǀ asthuḥ ǀ joṣṭā́raḥ-iva ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ raghvī́ḥ-iva ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These my earnest praises approachIndraandVaruṇa, desirous to obtain wealth, as dependants attend (upon an opulent man) for the sake of riches, like humble (feminine les) begging for food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्व्य॑स्य॒ त्मना॒ रथ्य॑स्य पु॒ष्टेर्नित्य॑स्य रा॒यः पत॑यः स्याम । ता च॑क्रा॒णा ऊ॒तिभि॒र्नव्य॑सीभिरस्म॒त्रा रायो॑ नि॒युत॑: सचन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvyasya ǀ tmánā ǀ ráthyasya ǀ puṣṭéḥ ǀ nítyasya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǀtā́ ǀ cakrāṇáu ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ návyasībhiḥ ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ sacantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we of our own (right) be the masters of permanent riches, comprising horses, chariots, and nourishment; may those two, traversing (the regions), direct theirNiyutsteeds towards us, associating (them) with riches and with recent protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ बृहन्ता बृह॒तीभि॑रू॒ती इन्द्र॑ या॒तं व॑रुण॒ वाज॑सातौ । यद्दि॒द्यव॒: पृत॑नासु प्र॒क्रीळा॒न्तस्य॑ वां स्याम सनि॒तार॑ आ॒जेः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bṛhantā ǀ bṛhatī́bhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ índra ǀ yātám ǀ varuṇa ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀyát ǀ didyávaḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ pra-krī́ḷān ǀ tásya ǀ vām ǀ syāma ǀ sanitā́raḥ ǀ ājéḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyIndraandVaruṇa, come to us in battle with (your) powerful protections, and where the bright (weapons) plural y amidst the (hostile) hosts, may we triumph in that conflict (through) your (favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॑ द्वि॒ता रा॒ष्ट्रं क्ष॒त्रिय॑स्य वि॒श्वायो॒र्विश्वे॑ अ॒मृता॒ यथा॑ नः । क्रतुं॑ सचन्ते॒ वरु॑णस्य दे॒वा राजा॑मि कृ॒ष्टेरु॑प॒मस्य॑ व॒व्रेः
shlokas.transliteration: máma ǀ dvitā́ ǀ rāṣṭrám ǀ kṣatríyasya ǀ viśvá-āyoḥ ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀkrátum ǀ sacante ǀ váruṇasya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ rā́jāmi ǀ kṛṣṭéḥ ǀ upamásya ǀ vavréḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Twofold is my empire, that of the wholekṣatriyarace, and all the immortals are ours; the gods associate me with the acts ofVaruṇa; I rule over (those) of the proximate form of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ मह्यं॒ तान्य॑सु॒र्या॑णि प्रथ॒मा धा॑रयन्त । क्रतुं॑ सचन्ते॒ वरु॑णस्य दे॒वा राजा॑मि कृ॒ष्टेरु॑प॒मस्य॑ व॒व्रेः
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ máhyam ǀ tā́ni ǀ asuryā́ṇi ǀ prathamā́ ǀ dhārayanta ǀkrátum ǀ sacante ǀ váruṇasya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ rā́jāmi ǀ kṛṣṭéḥ ǀ upamásya ǀ vavréḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am the kingVaruṇa; on me (the gods) bestow those principal energies (that are) destructive of theasuras; (they) associate me with the worship of Varuṇa; I rule over (the nets) of the proximate form of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमिन्द्रो॒ वरु॑ण॒स्ते म॑हि॒त्वोर्वी ग॑भी॒रे रज॑सी सु॒मेके॑ । त्वष्टे॑व॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि वि॒द्वान्त्समै॑रयं॒ रोद॑सी धा॒रयं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ té íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ gabhīré íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀtváṣṭā-iva ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sám ǀ airayam ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dhāráyam ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I amIndra, I amVaruṇa, I am those two in greatness; (I am) the vast, profound, beautiful, heaven and earth; intelligent, I giveTvaṣṭā-like animation to all beings; I uphold earth and heaven].”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हम॒पो अ॑पिन्वमु॒क्षमा॑णा धा॒रयं॒ दिवं॒ सद॑न ऋ॒तस्य॑ । ऋ॒तेन॑ पु॒त्रो अदि॑तेॠ॒तावो॒त त्रि॒धातु॑ प्रथय॒द्वि भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ apáḥ ǀ apinvam ǀ ukṣámāṇāḥ ǀ dhāráyam ǀ dívam ǀ sádane ǀ ṛtásya ǀṛténa ǀ putráḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ utá ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ prathayat ǀ ví ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have distributed the moisture-shedding waters; I have upheld the sky as the abode of the water; by the water I have become the preserver of the water, the son ofAditi, illustrating the threefold elementary space.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मां नर॒: स्वश्वा॑ वा॒जय॑न्तो॒ मां वृ॒ताः स॒मर॑णे हवन्ते । कृ॒णोम्या॒जिं म॒घवा॒हमिन्द्र॒ इय॑र्मि रे॒णुम॒भिभू॑त्योजाः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́m ǀ náraḥ ǀ su-áśvāḥ ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ mā́m ǀ vṛtā́ḥ ǀ sam-áraṇe ǀ havante ǀkṛṇómi ǀ ājím ǀ maghá-vā ǀ ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ íyarmi ǀ reṇúm ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Warriors well mounted, ardent for contest invoke me; selected (combatants invoke) me in battle; I, the affluentIndra, instrumental gate the conflict, and, endowed with victorious prowess, I raise up the dust (in the battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं ता विश्वा॑ चकरं॒ नकि॑र्मा॒ दैव्यं॒ सहो॑ वरते॒ अप्र॑तीतम् । यन्मा॒ सोमा॑सो म॒मद॒न्यदु॒क्थोभे भ॑येते॒ रज॑सी अपा॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakaram ǀ nákiḥ ǀ mā ǀ dáivyam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ varate ǀ áprati-itam ǀyát ǀ mā ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ mamádan ǀ yát ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ bhayete íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ apāré íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have done all these (deeds); no one resists my divine, unsurpassed vigour; and when theSomajuices, when sacred songs, exhilarate me, then the unbounded heaven and earth are both alarmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दुष्टे॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ तस्य॒ ता प्र ब्र॑वीषि॒ वरु॑णाय वेधः । त्वं वृ॒त्राणि॑ शृण्विषे जघ॒न्वान्त्वं वृ॒ताँ अ॑रिणा इन्द्र॒ सिन्धू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: vidúḥ ǀ te ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ tásya ǀ tā́ ǀ prá ǀ bravīṣi ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vedhaḥ ǀtvám ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ śṛṇviṣe ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ tvám ǀ vṛtā́n ǀ ariṇāḥ ǀ indra ǀ síndhūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All beings recognize you (Varuṇa), and your, worshipper, address these (encomiums) to Varuṇa; you,Indra, are renowned as slayingVṛtra; you have set the obstructed rivers free to flow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॒मत्र॑ पि॒तर॒स्त आ॑सन्त्स॒प्त ऋष॑यो दौर्ग॒हे ब॒ध्यमा॑ने । त आय॑जन्त त्र॒सद॑स्युमस्या॒ इन्द्रं॒ न वृ॑त्र॒तुर॑मर्धदे॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ átra ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ té ǀ āsan ǀ saptá ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ dauḥ-gahé ǀ badhyámāne ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ ayajanta ǀ trasádasyum ǀ asyāḥ ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ vṛtra-túram ǀ ardha-devám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven ṛṣis were the protectors of this our (kingdom) when the son of Durgaha was in bonds; performing worship they obtained for (hisqueen) from the favour ofIndraandVaruṇa,Trasadasyu, like Indra the slayer of foes, dwelling near the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒कुत्सा॑नी॒ हि वा॒मदा॑शद्ध॒व्येभि॑रिन्द्रावरुणा॒ नमो॑भिः । अथा॒ राजा॑नं त्र॒सद॑स्युमस्या वृत्र॒हणं॑ ददथुरर्धदे॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-kútsānī ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ ádāśat ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀátha ǀ rā́jānam ǀ trasádasyum ǀ asyāḥ ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ ardha-devám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wife ofPurukutsapropitiated you two,IndraandVaruṇa, with oblations and prostrations, and therefore you gave her the kingTrasadasyu, the slayer of foes dwelling near the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒या व॒यं स॑स॒वांसो॑ मदेम ह॒व्येन॑ दे॒वा यव॑सेन॒ गाव॑: । तां धे॒नुमि॑न्द्रावरुणा यु॒वं नो॑ वि॒श्वाहा॑ धत्त॒मन॑पस्फुरन्तीम्
shlokas.transliteration: rāyā́ ǀ vayám ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ madema ǀ havyéna ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yávasena ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀtā́m ǀ dhenúm ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ yuvám ǀ naḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ dhattam ǀ ánapa-sphurantīm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, glorifying you both, be delighted by riches; may the gods be plural ased by oblations, the cows by pasture; and do you,IndraandVaruṇa, daily grant us that same cow, (riches) free from any imperfection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क उ॑ श्रवत्कत॒मो य॒ज्ञिया॑नां व॒न्दारु॑ दे॒वः क॑त॒मो जु॑षाते । कस्ये॒मां दे॒वीम॒मृते॑षु॒ प्रेष्ठां॑ हृ॒दि श्रे॑षाम सुष्टु॒तिं सु॑ह॒व्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śravat ǀ katamáḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ vandā́ru ǀ deváḥ ǀ katamáḥ ǀ juṣāte ǀkásya ǀ imā́m ǀ devī́m ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ préṣṭhām ǀ hṛdí ǀ śreṣāma ǀ su-stutím ǀ su-havyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which of those who are entitled to sacrifice will listen (to our prayers)? which of the gods will hear our praise? which will be propitiated (by it)? upon the heart of whom among the immortals may we impress the devout affectionate adoration, accompanied by sacred oblations?”

shlokas.sanskrit: को मृ॑ळाति कत॒म आग॑मिष्ठो दे॒वाना॑मु कत॒मः शम्भ॑विष्ठः । रथं॒ कमा॑हुर्द्र॒वद॑श्वमा॒शुं यं सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒तावृ॑णीत
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ mṛḷāti ǀ katamáḥ ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ katamáḥ ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ǀrátham ǀ kám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ dravát-aśvam ǀ āśúm ǀ yám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀ ávṛṇīta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who will make us happy? which of the gods is the most prompt to come to our sacrifice? which is the most willing to grant us felicity? what chariot do they say is quick and drawn by rapid steeds? That which the daughter ofSūryaselected.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू हि ष्मा॒ गच्छ॑थ॒ ईव॑तो॒ द्यूनिन्द्रो॒ न श॒क्तिं परि॑तक्म्यायाम् । दि॒व आजा॑ता दि॒व्या सु॑प॒र्णा कया॒ शची॑नां भवथ॒: शचि॑ष्ठा
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ dyū́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ śaktím ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǀdiváḥ ǀ ā́-jātā ǀ divyā́ ǀ su-parṇā́ ǀ káyā ǀ śácīnām ǀ bhavathaḥ ǀ śáciṣṭhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Moving, you proceed rapidly by day, asIndra, at the end of the night, (manifests his) power; descended from heaven, divine, of graceful motion, (Aśvins), by which of (your) acts are you most distinguished?”

shlokas.sanskrit: का वां॑ भू॒दुप॑माति॒: कया॑ न॒ आश्वि॑ना गमथो हू॒यमा॑ना । को वां॑ म॒हश्चि॒त्त्यज॑सो अ॒भीक॑ उरु॒ष्यतं॑ माध्वी दस्रा न ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ vām ǀ bhūt ǀ úpa-mātiḥ ǀ káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ gamathaḥ ǀ hūyámānā ǀkáḥ ǀ vām ǀ maháḥ ǀ cit ǀ tyájasaḥ ǀ abhī́ke ǀ uruṣyátam ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ dasrā ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What may be the fit measure (of your merits)? invoked by what praises do you come to us? who (can exist as) the object of your great wrath?Dasras, dispensers of sweet (water), defend us with your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु वां॒ रथ॒: परि॑ नक्षति॒ द्यामा यत्स॑मु॒द्राद॒भि वर्त॑ते वाम् । मध्वा॑ माध्वी॒ मधु॑ वां प्रुषाय॒न्यत्सीं॑ वां॒ पृक्षो॑ भु॒रज॑न्त प॒क्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: urú ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ pári ǀ nakṣati ǀ dyā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ samudrā́t ǀ abhí ǀ vártate ǀ vām ǀmádhvā ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ mádhu ǀ vām ǀ pruṣāyan ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ vām ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ bhurájanta ǀ pakvā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your chariot travels widely round the heaven until it plural ces you beyond the firmament; dispensers of sweet (water, the priests) are diluting theSomajuice with milk, that the boiled (barley) may be united with the libation offered to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धु॑र्ह वां र॒सया॑ सिञ्च॒दश्वा॑न्घृ॒णा वयो॑ऽरु॒षास॒: परि॑ ग्मन् । तदू॒ षु वा॑मजि॒रं चे॑ति॒ यानं॒ येन॒ पती॒ भव॑थः सू॒र्याया॑:
shlokas.transliteration: síndhuḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ rasáyā ǀ siñcat ǀ áśvān ǀ ghṛṇā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ pári ǀ gman ǀtát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ ajirám ǀ ceti ǀ yā́nam ǀ yéna ǀ pátī íti ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ sūryā́yāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flowing (stream) has sprinkled your steeds with moisture; the radiant horses (like) birds (in swiftness) pass on, bright with lustre; well known as that quick-moving chariot, whereby you became the lords ofSūrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेह॒ यद्वां॑ सम॒ना प॑पृ॒क्षे सेयम॒स्मे सु॑म॒तिर्वा॑जरत्ना । उ॒रु॒ष्यतं॑ जरि॒तारं॑ यु॒वं ह॑ श्रि॒तः कामो॑ नासत्या युव॒द्रिक्
shlokas.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ samanā́ ǀ papṛkṣé ǀ sā́ ǀ iyám ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vāja-ratnā ǀuruṣyátam ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ yuvám ǀ ha ǀ śritáḥ ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ yuvadrík ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the earnest praise, distributors of food, wherewith I associate you both like-minded at this sacrifice, be (beneficial) to us; do you protect your worshipper; my desire,Nāsatyas, directed towards you is gratified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वां॒ रथं॑ व॒यम॒द्या हु॑वेम पृथु॒ज्रय॑मश्विना॒ संग॑तिं॒ गोः । यः सू॒र्यां वह॑ति वन्धुरा॒युर्गिर्वा॑हसं पुरु॒तमं॑ वसू॒युम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ vayám ǀ adyá ǀ huvema ǀ pṛthu-jráyam ǀ aśvinā ǀ sám-gatim ǀ góḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ sūryā́m ǀ váhati ǀ vandhura-yúḥ ǀ gírvāhasam ǀ puru-támam ǀ vasu-yúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke,Aśvins, today, your rapid car, the associator of the solar ray; the banked car which bearsSūrya, vast, wealthy, and laden with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श्रिय॑मश्विना दे॒वता॒ तां दिवो॑ नपाता वनथ॒: शची॑भिः । यु॒वोर्वपु॑र॒भि पृक्ष॑: सचन्ते॒ वह॑न्ति॒ यत्क॑कु॒हासो॒ रथे॑ वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śríyam ǀ aśvinā ǀ devátā ǀ tā́n ǀ dívaḥ ǀ napātā ǀ vanathaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ vápuḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ váhanti ǀ yát ǀ kakuhā́saḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, grandsons of heaven, divinities, you enjoy that glory of your actions, that (sacrificial) food is administered to your person ns, and powerul horses draw you in your chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वा॑म॒द्या क॑रते रा॒तह॑व्य ऊ॒तये॑ वा सुत॒पेया॑य वा॒र्कैः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ वा व॒नुषे॑ पू॒र्व्याय॒ नमो॑ येमा॒नो अ॑श्वि॒ना व॑वर्तत्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ karate ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ vā ǀ suta-péyāya ǀ vā ǀ arkáiḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ vā ǀ vanúṣe ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀ námaḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ vavartat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What offer of oblations addresses you today with hymns for the sake (of obtaining) protection, for the drinking of theSoma, or for the ancient fulfilment of the sacrifice? what offer of adoration may bring youAśvinsmay bring you Aśvins (to this rite)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न पुरुभू॒ रथे॑ने॒मं य॒ज्ञं ना॑स॒त्योप॑ यातम् । पिबा॑थ॒ इन्मधु॑नः सो॒म्यस्य॒ दध॑थो॒ रत्नं॑ विध॒ते जना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: hiraṇyáyena ǀ purubhū íti puru-bhū ǀ ráthena ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀpíbāthaḥ ǀ ít ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ somyásya ǀ dádhathaḥ ǀ rátnam ǀ vidhaté ǀ jánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nāsatyas, who are manifold, come with your golden chariot to this sacrifice; drink of the sweetSomabeverage, and give precious things to the man who celebrates (your worship).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ यातं दि॒वो अच्छा॑ पृथि॒व्या हि॑र॒ण्यये॑न सु॒वृता॒ रथे॑न । मा वा॑म॒न्ये नि य॑मन्देव॒यन्त॒: सं यद्द॒दे नाभि॑: पू॒र्व्या वा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ diváḥ ǀ áccha ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyena ǀ su-vṛ́tā ǀ ráthena ǀmā́ ǀ vām ǀ anyé ǀ ní ǀ yaman ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ sám ǀ yát ǀ dadé ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to our presence, whether from heaven or earth, with your well-constructed golden chariot; let not other devout worshippers detain yhou, for a prior attraction awaits you (here).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ र॒यिं पु॑रु॒वीरं॑ बृ॒हन्तं॒ दस्रा॒ मिमा॑थामु॒भये॑ष्व॒स्मे । नरो॒ यद्वा॑मश्विना॒ स्तोम॒माव॑न्त्स॒धस्तु॑तिमाजमी॒ळ्हासो॑ अग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ dásrā ǀ mímāthām ǀ ubháyeṣu ǀ asmé íti ǀnáraḥ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ stómam ǀ ā́van ǀ sadhá-stutim ǀ āja-mīḷhā́saḥ ǀ agman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras, mete out for us both great opulence, comprising many descendants, since the leaders of the rite (the Purumīḷhas), have addressed to you,Aśvins, their praise, and the Ajamīḷhas have united with it their laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेह॒ यद्वां॑ सम॒ना प॑पृ॒क्षे सेयम॒स्मे सु॑म॒तिर्वा॑जरत्ना । उ॒रु॒ष्यतं॑ जरि॒तारं॑ यु॒वं ह॑ श्रि॒तः कामो॑ नासत्या युव॒द्रिक्
shlokas.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ samanā́ ǀ papṛkṣé ǀ sā́ ǀ iyám ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vāja-ratnā ǀuruṣyátam ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ yuvám ǀ ha ǀ śritáḥ ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ yuvadrík ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May you earn praise wherewith, distributors of food, I associate you both like-minded at this sacrifice, be (beneficial) to us; do you protect your worshipper; my desire,Nāsatyas, directed towards you is gratified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य भा॒नुरुदि॑यर्ति यु॒ज्यते॒ रथ॒: परि॑ज्मा दि॒वो अ॒स्य सान॑वि । पृ॒क्षासो॑ अस्मिन्मिथु॒ना अधि॒ त्रयो॒ दृति॑स्तु॒रीयो॒ मधु॑नो॒ वि र॑प्शते
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ yujyáte ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀ diváḥ ǀ asyá ǀ sā́navi ǀpṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ asmin ǀ mithunā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ dṛ́tiḥ ǀ turī́yaḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rapśate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun rises; your chariot, (Aśvins), traversing (the regions), is associated with the divine (orb) on the summit (of the eastern mountain in it are three analogous kinds of food, and the leather vessel of the sweetSomajuice appears as the fourth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वां॑ पृ॒क्षासो॒ मधु॑मन्त ईरते॒ रथा॒ अश्वा॑स उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु । अ॒पो॒र्णु॒वन्त॒स्तम॒ आ परी॑वृतं॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण शु॒क्रं त॒न्वन्त॒ आ रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vām ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ īrate ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀapa-ūrṇuvántaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pári-vṛtam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrám ǀ tanvántaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your food-bearing,Soma-laden, well-horsed chariots, appearing at the opening of the dawn, scattering the surrounding darkness like the sun, and spreading bright radiance over the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्व॑: पिबतं मधु॒पेभि॑रा॒सभि॑रु॒त प्रि॒यं मधु॑ने युञ्जाथां॒ रथ॑म् । आ व॑र्त॒निं मधु॑ना जिन्वथस्प॒थो दृतिं॑ वहेथे॒ मधु॑मन्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ pibatam ǀ madhu-pébhiḥ ǀ āsá-bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ priyám ǀ mádhune ǀ yuñjāthām ǀ rátham ǀā́ ǀ vartaním ǀ mádhunā ǀ jinvathaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ dṛ́tim ǀ vahethe íti ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink of theSomajuice, with mouths (fit for) imbibing the beverage; harness your beloved chariot for the Soma juice; (come to the dwelling) of the sacrifice; enliven the path with the Soma; bring,Aśvins, the leather vessels filled with the Soma-juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हं॒सासो॒ ये वां॒ मधु॑मन्तो अ॒स्रिधो॒ हिर॑ण्यपर्णा उ॒हुव॑ उष॒र्बुध॑: । उ॒द॒प्रुतो॑ म॒न्दिनो॑ मन्दिनि॒स्पृशो॒ मध्वो॒ न मक्ष॒: सव॑नानि गच्छथः
shlokas.transliteration: haṃsā́saḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ asrídhaḥ ǀ híraṇya-parṇāḥ ǀ uhúvaḥ ǀ uṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀuda-prútaḥ ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ mandi-nispṛ́śaḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mákṣaḥ ǀ sávanāni ǀ gacchathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to sacrifices as flies to honey, (with those horses) that are swift of speed, genitive le, unrefractory, golden-winged, bearers (of burden), wakers at dawn, dispensers of water, exulting and sipping theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒ध्व॒रासो॒ मधु॑मन्तो अ॒ग्नय॑ उ॒स्रा ज॑रन्ते॒ प्रति॒ वस्तो॑र॒श्विना॑ । यन्नि॒क्तह॑स्तस्त॒रणि॑र्विचक्ष॒णः सोमं॑ सु॒षाव॒ मधु॑मन्त॒मद्रि॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: su-adhvarā́saḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ usrā́ ǀ jarante ǀ práti ǀ vástoḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀyát ǀ niktá-hastaḥ ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ sómam ǀ susā́va ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ssacred fires, the instrumental uments of holy sacrifice the conveyers of libations, praise the associatedAśvinsat the break of day, when the observant (priest) the conductor of the rite, with washedhandshas expressed by the (grinding) stones the sweet-flavouredSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒के॒नि॒पासो॒ अह॑भि॒र्दवि॑ध्वत॒: स्व१॒॑र्ण शु॒क्रं त॒न्वन्त॒ आ रज॑: । सूर॑श्चि॒दश्वा॑न्युयुजा॒न ई॑यते॒ विश्वाँ॒ अनु॑ स्व॒धया॑ चेतथस्प॒थः
shlokas.transliteration: āke-nipā́saḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ dávidhvataḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrám ǀ tanvántaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀsū́raḥ ǀ cit ǀ áśvān ǀ yuyujānáḥ ǀ īyate ǀ víśvān ǀ ánu ǀ svadháyā ǀ cetathaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The near-advancing (rays), dispersing (the darkness) by the (light of day), are overspreading the firmament with lustre like the sun; the sun, harnessing his horses, (proceeds on his way); do you make known all his paths by (following) after (him) with sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॑मवोचमश्विना धियं॒धा रथ॒: स्वश्वो॑ अ॒जरो॒ यो अस्ति॑ । येन॑ स॒द्यः परि॒ रजां॑सि या॒थो ह॒विष्म॑न्तं त॒रणिं॑ भो॒जमच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ avocam ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀyéna ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ pári ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ yātháḥ ǀ havíṣmantam ǀ taráṇim ǀ bhojám ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrating (sacred) rites, I glorify you,Aśvins; well-horsed and undecaying is that chariot, whereby you quickly traverse the regions (of space), and come to (our sacrifice) abounding in oblations, promptly passing away, and the yielder of enjoyment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्रं॑ पिबा॒ मधू॑नां सु॒तं वा॑यो॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु । त्वं हि पू॑र्व॒पा असि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágram ǀ piba ǀ mádhūnām ǀ sutám ǀ vāyo íti ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ pūrva-pā́ḥ ǀ ási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink first,Vāyu, the effused libation of theSomaat the rites that secure heaven, for you verily are the first drinker.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तेना॑ नो अ॒भिष्टि॑भिर्नि॒युत्वाँ॒ इन्द्र॑सारथिः । वायो॑ सु॒तस्य॑ तृम्पतम्
shlokas.transliteration: śaténa ǀ naḥ ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ niyútvān ǀ índra-sārathiḥ ǀvā́yo íti ǀ sutásya ǀ tṛmpatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, who are drawn by theNiyuts, and haveIndrafor charioteer, come (for the fulfilment) of our numerous wishes, and do you (and Indra) drink of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ स॒हस्रं॒ हर॑य॒ इन्द्र॑वायू अ॒भि प्रय॑: । वह॑न्तु॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ sahásram ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀváhantu ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, may a thousand steeds, eager for food, bring you to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ हिर॑ण्यवन्धुर॒मिन्द्र॑वायू स्वध्व॒रम् । आ हि स्थाथो॑ दिवि॒स्पृश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ híraṇya-vandhuram ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ su-adhvarám ǀā́ ǀ hí ǀ sthā́thaḥ ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mount,IndraandVāyu, the golden-seated chariot, propitious to sacrifice, soaring to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथे॑न पृथु॒पाज॑सा दा॒श्वांस॒मुप॑ गच्छतम् । इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒हा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ráthena ǀ pṛthu-pā́jasā ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatam ǀíndravāyū íti ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, come with your very strong chariot to the sacrifice; come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑वायू अ॒यं सु॒तस्तं दे॒वेभि॑: स॒जोष॑सा । पिब॑तं दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: índravāyū íti ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ tám ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀpíbatam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, this (libation) is poured out sympathizing with the gods, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह प्र॒याण॑मस्तु वा॒मिन्द्र॑वायू वि॒मोच॑नम् । इ॒ह वां॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ pra-yā́nam ǀ astu ǀ vām ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ vi-mócanam ǀihá ǀ vām ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hither be your course; here,IndraandVāyu, be the letting of your horses loose, for your drinking of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वायो॑ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते॒ मध्वो॒ अग्रं॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु । आ या॑हि॒ सोम॑पीतये स्पा॒र्हो दे॑व नि॒युत्व॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ayāmi ǀ te ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ágram ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ spārháḥ ǀ deva ǀ niyútvatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified (by holy acts) I bring to you,Vāyu, theSoma, first (offered to you at sacrifices) that seek to gain heaven; deity, who are ever longed over, come with yourNiyutsteeds to drink the Soma juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्च वायवेषां॒ सोमा॑नां पी॒तिम॑र्हथः । यु॒वां हि यन्तीन्द॑वो नि॒म्नमापो॒ न स॒ध्र्य॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ vāyo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ sómānām ǀ pītím ǀ arhathaḥ ǀyuvā́m ǀ hí ǀ yánti ǀ índavaḥ ǀ nimnám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ sadhryák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, you are fit for the drinking of theseSomalibations, for the drops flow towards you as waters (run) together in a deep plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॒विन्द्र॑श्च शु॒ष्मिणा॑ स॒रथं॑ शवसस्पती । नि॒युत्व॑न्ता न ऊ॒तय॒ आ या॑तं॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ śuṣmíṇā ǀ sa-rátham ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀniyútvantā ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, who are lords of strength, vigorous and drawn by theNiyutsteeds, come (riding in) the same car; drink theSomafor our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वां॒ सन्ति॑ पुरु॒स्पृहो॑ नि॒युतो॑ दा॒शुषे॑ नरा । अ॒स्मे ता य॑ज्ञवाह॒सेन्द्र॑वायू॒ नि य॑च्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ sánti ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ narā ǀasmé íti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ yajña-vāhasā ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), conveyers of sacrifices,IndraandVāyu, give to us for the offer (of the oblation), thoseNiyutswho are your (steeds), and are desired of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒हि होत्रा॒ अवी॑ता॒ विपो॒ न रायो॑ अ॒र्यः । वाय॒वा च॒न्द्रेण॒ रथे॑न या॒हि सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: vihí ǀ hótrā ǀ ávītāḥ ǀ vípaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀvā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ candréṇa ǀ ráthena ǀ yāhí ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Vāyu, the oblations yet untested, like (a prince) the terrifier of foes; (bestow) upon the worshipper wealth; come with your brilliant car to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒र्यु॒वा॒णो अश॑स्तीर्नि॒युत्वाँ॒ इन्द्र॑सारथिः । वाय॒वा च॒न्द्रेण॒ रथे॑न या॒हि सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: niḥ-yuvānáḥ ǀ áśastīḥ ǀ niyútvān ǀ índra-sārathiḥ ǀvā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ candréṇa ǀ ráthena ǀ yāhí ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyu, who are the represser of calumnies, who are drawn by theNiyuts, and haveIndrafor your charioteer come with your brilliant car to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ कृ॒ष्णे वसु॑धिती ये॒माते॑ वि॒श्वपे॑शसा । वाय॒वा च॒न्द्रेण॒ रथे॑न या॒हि सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ kṛṣṇé íti ǀ vásudhitī íti vásu-dhitī ǀ yemā́te íti ǀ viśvá-peśasā ǀvā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ candréṇa ǀ ráthena ǀ yāhí ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dark nurses of wealth, the universal forms (heaven and earth), attend upon you; comeVāyuwith your brilliant car to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वह॑न्तु त्वा मनो॒युजो॑ यु॒क्तासो॑ नव॒तिर्नव॑ । वाय॒वा च॒न्द्रेण॒ रथे॑न या॒हि सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: váhantu ǀ tvā ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ yuktā́saḥ ǀ navatíḥ ǀ náva ǀvā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ candréṇa ǀ ráthena ǀ yāhí ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the ninety-nine steeds harnessed together, that are as swift as thought, convey you; come,Vāyu, with your brilliant car, to drink theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वायो॑ श॒तं हरी॑णां यु॒वस्व॒ पोष्या॑णाम् । उ॒त वा॑ ते सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथ॒ आ या॑तु॒ पाज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ śatám ǀ hárīṇām ǀ yuvásva ǀ póṣyāṇām ǀutá ǀ vā ǀ te ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ pā́jasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harness,Vāyu, a hundred plural mp steeds, or even a thousand, and let your chariot come with rapidity (hither).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं वा॑मा॒स्ये॑ ह॒विः प्रि॒यमि॑न्द्राबृहस्पती । उ॒क्थं मद॑श्च शस्यते
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vām ǀ āsyé ǀ havíḥ ǀ priyám ǀ indrābṛhaspatī íti ǀukthám ǀ mádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ śasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I present) the agreeable oblation to your mouths,IndraandBṛhaspati, and the hymn and the exhilarating beverage are offered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॒ परि॑ षिच्यते॒ सोम॑ इन्द्राबृहस्पती । चारु॒र्मदा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indrābṛhaspatī íti ǀcā́ruḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This deliciousSomais effused,IndraandBṛhaspati, for you, (your) drinking and exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्द्राबृहस्पती गृ॒हमिन्द्र॑श्च गच्छतम् । सो॒म॒पा सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indrābṛhaspatī íti ǀ gṛhám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ gacchatam ǀsoma-pā́ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandBṛhaspati, come to our dwelling, drinkers ofSoma, to drink the Soma juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे इ॑न्द्राबृहस्पती र॒यिं ध॑त्तं शत॒ग्विन॑म् । अश्वा॑वन्तं सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ indrābṛhaspatī íti ǀ rayím ǀ dhattam ǀ śata-gvínam ǀáśva-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant to us,IndraandBṛhaspatiriches comprising a hundred (cattle), a thousand horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒बृह॒स्पती॑ व॒यं सु॒ते गी॒र्भिर्ह॑वामहे । अ॒स्य सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrābṛ́haspátī íti ǀ vayám ǀ suté ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandBṛhaspati, we invoke you with praises, when the libation is effused, to drink of thisSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑मिन्द्राबृहस्पती॒ पिब॑तं दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे । मा॒दये॑थां॒ तदो॑कसा
shlokas.transliteration: sómam ǀ indrābṛhaspatī íti ǀ píbatam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀmādáyethām ǀ tát-okasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,IndraandBṛhaspati, theSoma; in the dwelling of the donor, and be exhilarated in his abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त॒स्तम्भ॒ सह॑सा॒ वि ज्मो अन्ता॒न्बृह॒स्पति॑स्त्रिषध॒स्थो रवे॑ण । तं प्र॒त्नास॒ ऋष॑यो॒ दीध्या॑नाः पु॒रो विप्रा॑ दधिरे म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tastámbha ǀ sáhasā ǀ ví ǀ jmáḥ ǀ ántān ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ tri-sadhastháḥ ǀ ráveṇa ǀtám ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ mandrá-jihvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient sages, illustrious, intelligent, have plural ced before (them) the plural asing-tonguedBṛhaspati, who propped up by (his) strength the ends of the earth, and who abides with noise in the three regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धु॒नेत॑यः सुप्रके॒तं मद॑न्तो॒ बृह॑स्पते अ॒भि ये न॑स्तत॒स्रे । पृष॑न्तं सृ॒प्रमद॑ब्धमू॒र्वं बृह॑स्पते॒ रक्ष॑तादस्य॒ योनि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dhuná-itayaḥ ǀ su-praketám ǀ mádantaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ naḥ ǀ tatasré ǀpṛ́ṣantam ǀ sṛprám ǀ ádabdham ǀ ūrvám ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ rákṣatāt ǀ asya ǀ yónim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, protect the fruit-yielding, progressive, uninjured ample sacrifice of this (your worshipp0er, at which) they who are the terrifiers (of foes), the delighters of you who are possessed of great wisdom, glorify (you) in our behalf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते॒ या प॑र॒मा प॑रा॒वदत॒ आ त॑ ऋत॒स्पृशो॒ नि षे॑दुः । तुभ्यं॑ खा॒ता अ॑व॒ता अद्रि॑दुग्धा॒ मध्व॑: श्चोतन्त्य॒भितो॑ विर॒प्शम्
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ yā́ ǀ paramā́ ǀ parā-vát ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ ṛta-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ ní ǀ seduḥ ǀtúbhyam ǀ khātā́ḥ ǀ avatā́ḥ ǀ ádri-dugdhāḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ vi-rapśám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (steeds),Bṛhaspati, which had come from that distant (region), the best (of all), have sat down in connection with the ceremony, and to you theSomajuices expressed by the stones flow copiously, (accompanied) by the sounds of praise, like deep wells that supply water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पति॑: प्रथ॒मं जाय॑मानो म॒हो ज्योति॑षः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । स॒प्तास्य॑स्तुविजा॒तो रवे॑ण॒ वि स॒प्तर॑श्मिरधम॒त्तमां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ jyótiṣaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀsaptá-āsyaḥ ǀ tuvi-jātáḥ ǀ ráveṇa ǀ ví ǀ saptá-raśmiḥ ǀ adhamat ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, when first being born in the highest heaven of supreme light, seven-mouthed, multiform, (combined) with sound, and seven-rayed, has subdued the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॒ष्टुभा॒ स ऋक्व॑ता ग॒णेन॑ व॒लं रु॑रोज फलि॒गं रवे॑ण । बृह॒स्पति॑रु॒स्रिया॑ हव्य॒सूद॒: कनि॑क्रद॒द्वाव॑शती॒रुदा॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-stúbhā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛ́kvatā ǀ gaṇéna ǀ valám ǀ ruroja ǀ phali-gám ǀ ráveṇa ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ havya-sū́daḥ ǀ kánikradat ǀ vā́vaśatīḥ ǀ út ǀ ājat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Aided) by the praised and brilliant troop (of theAṅgirasas), he destroyed with sound the mischievousBala,Bṛhaspati, shouting aloud, set free the boon-bestowing, oblation-supplying kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा पि॒त्रे वि॒श्वदे॑वाय॒ वृष्णे॑ य॒ज्ञैर्वि॑धेम॒ नम॑सा ह॒विर्भि॑: । बृह॑स्पते सुप्र॒जा वी॒रव॑न्तो व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ pitré ǀ viśvá-devāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ námasā ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ su-prajā́ḥ ǀ vīrá-vantaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus may we offer worship with sacrifices, with oblations, with praise, to the paternal, universal deity, the showerer (of benefits); and may we,Bṛhaspati, become possessed of riches, and be blessed with excellent progeny and valiant descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इद्राजा॒ प्रति॑जन्यानि॒ विश्वा॒ शुष्मे॑ण तस्थाव॒भि वी॒र्ये॑ण । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ यः सुभृ॑तं बि॒भर्ति॑ वल्गू॒यति॒ वन्द॑ते पूर्व॒भाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ rā́jā ǀ práti-janyāni ǀ víśvā ǀ śúṣmeṇa ǀ tasthau ǀ abhí ǀ vīryéṇa ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ yáḥ ǀ sú-bhṛtam ǀ bibhárti ǀ valgu-yáti ǀ vándate ǀ pūrva-bhā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That prince overcomes by his strength and prowess, all hostile people, who cherishes liberallyBṛhaspati, and glorifies and honours him as the first sharer (of the offering).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इत्क्षे॑ति॒ सुधि॑त॒ ओक॑सि॒ स्वे तस्मा॒ इळा॑ पिन्वते विश्व॒दानी॑म् । तस्मै॒ विश॑: स्व॒यमे॒वा न॑मन्ते॒ यस्मि॑न्ब्र॒ह्मा राज॑नि॒ पूर्व॒ एति॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ kṣeti ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ ókasi ǀ své ǀ tásmai ǀ íḷā ǀ pinvate ǀ viśva-dā́nīm ǀtásmai ǀ víśaḥ ǀ svayám ǀ evá ǀ namante ǀ yásmin ǀ brahmā́ ǀ rā́jani ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ éti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily he abides prosperous in his own abode; for him the earth bears fruit at all seasons; to him (his) subjects willingly pay homage, the prince, to whom theBrāhmaṇafirst, (duly reverenced), repairs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप्र॑तीतो जयति॒ सं धना॑नि॒ प्रति॑जन्यान्यु॒त या सज॑न्या । अ॒व॒स्यवे॒ यो वरि॑वः कृ॒णोति॑ ब्र॒ह्मणे॒ राजा॒ तम॑वन्ति दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: áprati-itaḥ ǀ jayati ǀ sám ǀ dhánāni ǀ práti-janyāni ǀ utá ǀ yā́ ǀ sá-janyā ǀavasyáve ǀ yáḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ brahmáṇe ǀ rā́jā ǀ tám ǀ avanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unopposed he is the master of the riches of hostile people, and of his own subjects; theRājāwho bestows riches upon theBrāhmaṇaseeking his protection him the gods protect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्च॒ सोमं॑ पिबतं बृहस्पते॒ऽस्मिन्य॒ज्ञे म॑न्दसा॒ना वृ॑षण्वसू । आ वां॑ विश॒न्त्विन्द॑वः स्वा॒भुवो॒ऽस्मे र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नि य॑च्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ bṛhaspate ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ mandasānā́ ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ viśantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ su-ābhúvaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, do you andIndra, both exulting and showering riches, drink theSomaat this sacrifice; may the all-pervading drops enter you; bestow upon us riches, comprising allmaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पत इन्द्र॒ वर्ध॑तं न॒: सचा॒ सा वां॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे । अ॒वि॒ष्टं धियो॑ जिगृ॒तं पुरं॑धीर्जज॒स्तम॒र्यो व॒नुषा॒मरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ indra ǀ várdhatam ǀ naḥ ǀ sácā ǀ sā́ ǀ vām ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ jajastám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vanúṣām ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati,Indra, elevate us; may the favourable disposition of you both be combined for us; protect our rites; be awake to our laudations, confound the arrogant (foes) of us who are the donors (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दमु॒ त्यत्पु॑रु॒तमं॑ पु॒रस्ता॒ज्ज्योति॒स्तम॑सो व॒युना॑वदस्थात् । नू॒नं दि॒वो दु॑हि॒तरो॑ विभा॒तीर्गा॒तुं कृ॑णवन्नु॒षसो॒ जना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ puru-támam ǀ purástāt ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ vayúna-vat ǀ asthāt ǀnūnám ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitáraḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ kṛṇavan ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ jánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This widely-spread and sense-bestowing light has sprung up in the east from out of the darkness; verily the brilliant Dawns, the daughters of heaven, are giving to man (the faculty to act).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्थु॑रु चि॒त्रा उ॒षस॑: पु॒रस्ता॑न्मि॒ता इ॑व॒ स्वर॑वोऽध्व॒रेषु॑ । व्यू॑ व्र॒जस्य॒ तम॑सो॒ द्वारो॒च्छन्ती॑रव्र॒ञ्छुच॑यः पाव॒काः
shlokas.transliteration: ásthuḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ mitā́ḥ-iva ǀ sváravaḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀví ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vrajásya ǀ támasaḥ ǀ dvā́rā ǀ ucchántīḥ ǀ avran ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many-limbed Dawns rise up in the east, like the pillars plural nted at sacrifices (round the altar); radiant and purifying, they are manifested, opening the gates of the obstructing gloom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छन्ती॑र॒द्य चि॑तयन्त भो॒जान्रा॑धो॒देया॑यो॒षसो॑ म॒घोनी॑: । अ॒चि॒त्रे अ॒न्तः प॒णय॑: सस॒न्त्वबु॑ध्यमाना॒स्तम॑सो॒ विम॑ध्ये
shlokas.transliteration: ucchántīḥ ǀ adyá ǀ citayanta ǀ bhojā́n ǀ rādhaḥ-déyāya ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ maghónīḥ ǀacitré ǀ antáríti ǀ paṇáyaḥ ǀ sasantu ǀ ábudhyamānāḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ ví-madhye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gloom-dispelling, affluent Dawns animate the pious worshippers to offer (sacrificial) treasure; may the churlish (traffickers) sleep on unawakened, in the unlovely depth of darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒वित्स दे॑वीः स॒नयो॒ नवो॑ वा॒ यामो॑ बभू॒यादु॑षसो वो अ॒द्य । येना॒ नव॑ग्वे॒ अङ्गि॑रे॒ दश॑ग्वे स॒प्तास्ये॑ रेवती रे॒वदू॒ष
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ sáḥ ǀ devīḥ ǀ sanáyaḥ ǀ návaḥ ǀ vā ǀ yā́maḥ ǀ babhūyā́t ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀyéna ǀ náva-gve ǀ áṅgire ǀ dáśa-gve ǀ saptá-āsye ǀ revatīḥ ǀ revát ǀ ūṣá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine Dawns, may your chariot, whether old or new, be frequent at this day's (worship), wherewith, affluent Dawns, possessing riches, (you shine) upon the seven-mouthed (troop of the)Aṅgirasas, the observers of the nine or ten days' rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं हि दे॑वीॠत॒युग्भि॒रश्वै॑: परिप्रया॒थ भुव॑नानि स॒द्यः । प्र॒बो॒धय॑न्तीरुषसः स॒सन्तं॑ द्वि॒पाच्चतु॑ष्पाच्च॒रथा॑य जी॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ hí ǀ devīḥ ǀ ṛtayúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ pari-prayāthá ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ sadyáḥ ǀpra-bodháyantīḥ ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀ sasántam ǀ dvi-pā́t ǀ cátuḥ-pāt ǀ caráthāya ǀ jīvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine Dawns, with horses that frequent sacrifices you quickly travel round the regions (of space); awake the sleeping being, whether biped or quadruped, to pursue (his functions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व॑ स्विदासां कत॒मा पु॑रा॒णी यया॑ वि॒धाना॑ विद॒धुॠ॑भू॒णाम् । शुभं॒ यच्छु॒भ्रा उ॒षस॒श्चर॑न्ति॒ न वि ज्ञा॑यन्ते स॒दृशी॑रजु॒र्याः
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ svit ǀ āsām ǀ katamā́ ǀ purāṇī́ ǀ yáyā ǀ vi-dhā́nā ǀ vi-dadhúḥ ǀ ṛbhūṇā́m ǀśúbham ǀ yát ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ jñāyante ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ ajuryā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where is that ancient one of those (Dawns), through whom the works of theṚbhuswere accomplished? For as the bright Dawns happily proceed, they are not distinguished, being alike and undecaying.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता घा॒ ता भ॒द्रा उ॒षस॑: पु॒रासु॑रभि॒ष्टिद्यु॑म्ना ऋ॒तजा॑तसत्याः । यास्वी॑जा॒नः श॑शमा॒न उ॒क्थैः स्तु॒वञ्छंस॒न्द्रवि॑णं स॒द्य आप॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ gha ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ āsuḥ ǀ abhiṣṭí-dyumnāḥ ǀ ṛtájāta-satyāḥ ǀyā́su ǀ ījānáḥ ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ stuván ǀ śáṃsan ǀ dráviṇam ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ā́pa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily those auspicious Dawns have been of old, rich with desired blessings, truthful (bestowers) of the results of sacrifice; at which the sacrificer, adoring with (silent) praise, glorifying (with hymns), has quickly obtained wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता आ च॑रन्ति सम॒ना पु॒रस्ता॑त्समा॒नत॑: सम॒ना प॑प्रथा॒नाः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ दे॒वीः सद॑सो बुधा॒ना गवां॒ न सर्गा॑ उ॒षसो॑ जरन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ caranti ǀ samanā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ samānátaḥ ǀ samanā́ ǀ paprathānā́ḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ budhānā́ḥ ǀ gávām ǀ ná ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They spread around of smilar form, (coming) from the east, (coming) from the same region alike renowned; the divine Dawns, arousing the assembly of the sacrifice are glorified like the (rays) creative of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता इन्न्वे॒३॒॑व स॑म॒ना स॑मा॒नीरमी॑तवर्णा उ॒षस॑श्चरन्ति । गूह॑न्ती॒रभ्व॒मसि॑तं॒ रुश॑द्भिः शु॒क्रास्त॒नूभि॒: शुच॑यो रुचा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ evá ǀ samanā́ ǀ samānī́ḥ ǀ ámīta-varṇāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ caranti ǀgū́hantīḥ ǀ ábhvam ǀ ásitam ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ rucānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those Dawns proceed verily all alike, of similar form, of infinite hues, pure, bright, illumining, concealing by their radiant person ns the very great gloom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒यिं दि॑वो दुहितरो विभा॒तीः प्र॒जाव॑न्तं यच्छता॒स्मासु॑ देवीः । स्यो॒नादा व॑: प्रति॒बुध्य॑मानाः सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: rayím ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaraḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ prajā́-vantam ǀ yacchata ǀ asmā́su ǀ devīḥ ǀsyonā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ prati-búdhyamānāḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine, resplendent daughters of heaven, bestow upon us wealth, comprehending progeny; awaking you for our benefit, may we be the lords of excellent descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वो॑ दिवो दुहितरो विभा॒तीरुप॑ ब्रुव उषसो य॒ज्ञके॑तुः । व॒यं स्या॑म य॒शसो॒ जने॑षु॒ तद्द्यौश्च॑ ध॒त्तां पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ दे॒वी
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaraḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀ yajñá-ketuḥ ǀvayám ǀ syāma ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ tát ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhattā́m ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ca ǀ devī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughters of heaven, resplendent Dawns, I address you (as) the announcer of the sacrificer; may we be (the possessors) of celebrity among men, and may heaven and the divine earth perpetuate (it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॒ ष्या सू॒नरी॒ जनी॑ व्यु॒च्छन्ती॒ परि॒ स्वसु॑: । दि॒वो अ॑दर्शि दुहि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ syā́ ǀ sūnárī ǀ jánī ǀ vi-ucchántī ǀ pári ǀ svásuḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ adarśi ǀ duhitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter of heaven has been seen; the kind conductress (of men), the parent (of benefits) shedding radiance upon (the departure of her) sister nighṭ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वे॑व चि॒त्रारु॑षी मा॒ता गवा॑मृ॒ताव॑री । सखा॑भूद॒श्विनो॑रु॒षाः
shlokas.transliteration: áśvā-iva ǀ citrā́ ǀ áruṣī ǀ mātā́ ǀ gávām ǀ ṛtá-varī ǀsákhā ǀ abhūt ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a beautiful mare, the radiant mother of the rays of light, the object of sacrifice, (she) is the friend of theAśvins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त सखा॑स्य॒श्विनो॑रु॒त मा॒ता गवा॑मसि । उ॒तोषो॒ वस्व॑ ईशिषे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sákhā ǀ asi ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ utá ǀ mātā́ ǀ gávām ǀ asi ǀutá ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ īśiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the friend of theAśvins; you are the mother of the rays of light; you, Uṣas, rule over riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒व॒यद्द्वे॑षसं त्वा चिकि॒त्वित्सू॑नृतावरि । प्रति॒ स्तोमै॑रभुत्स्महि
shlokas.transliteration: yavayát-dveṣasam ǀ tvā ǀ cikitvít ǀ sūnṛtā-vari ǀpráti ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ abhutsmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With praises we awaken you, you who are endowed with truth; you, baffler of animosities, the restorer of consciousness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ भ॒द्रा अ॑दृक्षत॒ गवां॒ सर्गा॒ न र॒श्मय॑: । ओषा अ॑प्रा उ॒रु ज्रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ adṛkṣata ǀ gávām ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious rays are visible like showers of rain, the dawn has filled (the world) with ample light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒प॒प्रुषी॑ विभावरि॒ व्या॑व॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ तम॑: । उषो॒ अनु॑ स्व॒धाम॑व
shlokas.transliteration: ā-paprúṣī ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ ví ǀ āvaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀúṣaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant Uṣas, filling (the world with light), you disperse the darkness with radiance; thereafter protect the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ द्यां त॑नोषि र॒श्मिभि॒रान्तरि॑क्षमु॒रु प्रि॒यम् । उष॑: शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dyā́m ǀ tanoṣi ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ urú ǀ priyám ǀúṣaḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You overspread, Uṣas, the heaven with rays, as well as the vast and beloved firmament with pure lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्वार्यं॑ म॒हद्वृ॑णी॒महे॒ असु॑रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसः । छ॒र्दिर्येन॑ दा॒शुषे॒ यच्छ॑ति॒ त्मना॒ तन्नो॑ म॒हाँ उद॑यान्दे॒वो अ॒क्तुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ vā́ryam ǀ mahát ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ ásurasya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀchardíḥ ǀ yéna ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yácchati ǀ tmánā ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ út ǀ ayān ǀ deváḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit of the divine, powerful, and intelligenSavitāthat desirable and ample (wealth), along with which he grants a dwelling to the offerer of the oblation of his own accord; may the great deity grant us such every day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो ध॒र्ता भुव॑नस्य प्र॒जाप॑तिः पि॒शङ्गं॑ द्रा॒पिं प्रति॑ मुञ्चते क॒विः । वि॒च॒क्ष॒णः प्र॒थय॑न्नापृ॒णन्नु॒र्वजी॑जनत्सवि॒ता सु॒म्नमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ prajā́-patiḥ ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ drāpím ǀ práti ǀ muñcate ǀ kavíḥ ǀvi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ pratháyan ǀ ā-pṛṇán ǀ urú ǀ ájījanat ǀ savitā́ ǀ sumnám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The supporter of heaven, the protector of the world, the wise (Savitā) puts on his golden armour discrimiator (of objects), filling (the world with light) Savitā has engendered great and laudable felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप्रा॒ रजां॑सि दि॒व्यानि॒ पार्थि॑वा॒ श्लोकं॑ दे॒वः कृ॑णुते॒ स्वाय॒ धर्म॑णे । प्र बा॒हू अ॑स्राक्सवि॒ता सवी॑मनि निवे॒शय॑न्प्रसु॒वन्न॒क्तुभि॒र्जग॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ ślókam ǀ deváḥ ǀ kṛṇute ǀ svā́ya ǀ dhármaṇe ǀprá ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ asrāk ǀ savitā́ ǀ sávīmani ǀ ni-veśáyan ǀ pra-suván ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ jágat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine (Savitā) fills (with radiance) the celestial and terrestrial regions, and boasts of his own function; Savitā puts forth his arms or (the work of) production, regulating the world, and animating it with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदा॑भ्यो॒ भुव॑नानि प्र॒चाक॑शद्व्र॒तानि॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ताभि र॑क्षते । प्रास्रा॑ग्बा॒हू भुव॑नस्य प्र॒जाभ्यो॑ धृ॒तव्र॑तो म॒हो अज्म॑स्य राजति
shlokas.transliteration: ádābhyaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ pra-cā́kaśat ǀ vratā́ni ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣate ǀprá ǀ asrāk ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ájmasya ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitāunrestrained, illumining the regions, protects the righteous acts (of men); he extends his arms for (the direction of) the people of the earth; observant of obligations, he rules over the wide world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर॒न्तरि॑क्षं सवि॒ता म॑हित्व॒ना त्री रजां॑सि परि॒भुस्त्रीणि॑ रोच॒ना । ति॒स्रो दिव॑: पृथि॒वीस्ति॒स्र इ॑न्वति त्रि॒भिर्व्र॒तैर॒भि नो॑ रक्षति॒ त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ savitā́ ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǀ trī́ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀtisráḥ ǀ dívaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ invati ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ vratáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣati ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savitā, encompassing them by his magnitude, pervades th three (divisions of the) firmament, thethree worlds, the three brilliant sphere, the three heavens, the threefold earth may he, by his three functions, of his own (plural asure) protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हत्सु॑म्नः प्रसवी॒ता नि॒वेश॑नो॒ जग॑तः स्था॒तुरु॒भय॑स्य॒ यो व॒शी । स नो॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता शर्म॑ यच्छत्व॒स्मे क्षया॑य त्रि॒वरू॑थ॒मंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát-sumnaḥ ǀ pra-savitā́ ǀ ni-véśanaḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaśī́ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that divineSavitā, who is the source of great happiness, the engenderer (of good works), the comprehender (of all beings), the regulator of both the moveable and the stationary, grant us happiness in thethree worlds, and (be) to us for the destruction of sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग॑न्दे॒व ऋ॒तुभि॒र्वर्ध॑तु॒ क्षयं॒ दधा॑तु नः सवि॒ता सु॑प्र॒जामिष॑म् । स न॑: क्ष॒पाभि॒रह॑भिश्च जिन्वतु प्र॒जाव॑न्तं र॒यिम॒स्मे समि॑न्वतु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agan ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ várdhatu ǀ kṣáyam ǀ dádhātu ǀ naḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-prajā́m ǀ íṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣapā́bhiḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ jinvatu ǀ prajā́-vantam ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ sám ǀ invatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineSavitāapproach along with the Ṛtus, prosper our dwelling, and bestow upon us good progeny and food; may he be favourable to us by night and by day; may he heap upon us wealth comprehending offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑द्दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता वन्द्यो॒ नु न॑ इ॒दानी॒मह्न॑ उप॒वाच्यो॒ नृभि॑: । वि यो रत्ना॒ भज॑ति मान॒वेभ्य॒: श्रेष्ठं॑ नो॒ अत्र॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ यथा॒ दध॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ vándyaḥ ǀ nú ǀ naḥ ǀ idā́nīm ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ upa-vā́cyaḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rátnā ǀ bhájati ǀ mānavébhyaḥ ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ dráviṇam ǀ yáthā ǀ dádhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitāhas been manifested; he is at once to be glorified by us; he is to be praised by the priests at the present (rite), and at the close (of the day), in order that he who apportions precious things to be descendants ofManumay bestow upon us, on this occasion, most excellent wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वेभ्यो॒ हि प्र॑थ॒मं य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्योऽमृत॒त्वं सु॒वसि॑ भा॒गमु॑त्त॒मम् । आदिद्दा॒मानं॑ सवित॒र्व्यू॑र्णुषेऽनूची॒ना जी॑वि॒ता मानु॑षेभ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ prathamám ǀ yajñíyebhyaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ suvási ǀ bhāgám ǀ ut-tamám ǀā́t ǀ ít ǀ dāmā́nam ǀ savitaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇuṣe ǀ anūcīnā́ ǀ jīvitā́ ǀ mā́nuṣebhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “First you engender for the adorable gods the best portion, immortality; then,Savitā, you set open (the day) to the donor (of the oblation), and (grant) successive existences to men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अचि॑त्ती॒ यच्च॑कृ॒मा दैव्ये॒ जने॑ दी॒नैर्दक्षै॒: प्रभू॑ती पूरुष॒त्वता॑ । दे॒वेषु॑ च सवित॒र्मानु॑षेषु च॒ त्वं नो॒ अत्र॑ सुवता॒दना॑गसः
shlokas.transliteration: ácittī ǀ yát ǀ cakṛmá ǀ dáivye ǀ jáne ǀ dīnáiḥ ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ prá-bhūtī ǀ puruṣatvátā ǀdevéṣu ǀ ca ǀ savitaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ suvatāt ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If,Savitā, through ignorance, through pride in feeble or powerful (dependants), or through human infirmity, we have committed (offence) against your divine person n, or against gods or men, do you on this occasion hold us to be unoffending.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न प्र॒मिये॑ सवि॒तुर्दैव्य॑स्य॒ तद्यथा॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं धारयि॒ष्यति॑ । यत्पृ॑थि॒व्या वरि॑म॒न्ना स्व॑ङ्गु॒रिर्वर्ष्म॑न्दि॒वः सु॒वति॑ स॒त्यम॑स्य॒ तत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ pra-míye ǀ savitúḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀ tát ǀ yáthā ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ dhārayiṣyáti ǀyát ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ váriman ǀ ā́ ǀ su-aṅguríḥ ǀ várṣman ǀ diváḥ ǀ suváti ǀ satyám ǀ asya ǀ tát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(It is) not (fit) to obstruct (the acts) of the divineSavitā, since by them he upholds the whole world, wheeby his gracioushandspreads fertility over the extent of the earth, and the magnitude of the heaven; such is his true (power).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठान्बृ॒हद्भ्य॒: पर्व॑तेभ्य॒: क्षयाँ॑ एभ्यः सुवसि प॒स्त्या॑वतः । यथा॑यथा प॒तय॑न्तो वियेमि॒र ए॒वैव त॑स्थुः सवितः स॒वाय॑ ते
shlokas.transliteration: índra-jyeṣṭhān ǀ bṛhát-bhyaḥ ǀ párvatebhyaḥ ǀ kṣáyān ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ suvasi ǀ pastyá-vataḥ ǀyáthā-yathā ǀ patáyantaḥ ǀ vi-yemiré ǀ evá ǀ evá ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ savitaríti ǀ savā́ya ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You elevate those, of whomIndrais chief, above the vast clouds; for these, (your worshippers), you provide dwelling (plural ces) filled in habitations; as when advancing they detained you, so in like manner at your command they stayed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॒ त्रिरह॑न्त्सवितः स॒वासो॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ सौभ॑गमासु॒वन्ति॑ । इन्द्रो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी सिन्धु॑र॒द्भिरा॑दि॒त्यैर्नो॒ अदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यंसत्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ tríḥ ǀ áhan ǀ savitaríti ǀ savā́saḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ sáubhagam ǀ ā-suvánti ǀíndraḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, heaven and earth,Sindhuwith the waters, andAditiwith theĀdityas, bestow happiness upon us, who, offering libations,Savitā, pour out the auspiciousSoma, day by day, thrice a day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को व॑स्त्रा॒ता व॑सव॒: को व॑रू॒ता द्यावा॑भूमी अदिते॒ त्रासी॑थां नः । सही॑यसो वरुण मित्र॒ मर्ता॒त्को वो॑ऽध्व॒रे वरि॑वो धाति देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ trātā́ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ varūtā́ ǀ dyā́vābhūmī íti ǀ adite ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǀsáhīyasaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ mártāt ǀ káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dhāti ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which of you,Vasus, is a defender? Which is a protector? Heaven and earth andAditipreserve us; defend us,MitraandVaruṇa, from the strong man; who is it, gods, that offers you wealth at the sacrifice?”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये धामा॑नि पू॒र्व्याण्यर्चा॒न्वि यदु॒च्छान्वि॑यो॒तारो॒ अमू॑राः । वि॒धा॒तारो॒ वि ते द॑धु॒रज॑स्रा ऋ॒तधी॑तयो रुरुचन्त द॒स्माः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ dhā́māni ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǀ árcān ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ ucchā́n ǀ vi-yotā́raḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǀvi-dhātā́raḥ ǀ ví ǀ té ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ ájasrāḥ ǀ ṛtá-dhītayaḥ ǀ rurucanta ǀ dasmā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (deities) who bestow ancient plural ces (of enjoyment on their worshippers), and (with minds) unperplexed, are the separators of light (from darkness); they, the eternal distributors (of rewards), grant (what is desired), and shine of plural asing aspect, the true (recompensers) of pious actṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र प॒स्त्या॒३॒॑मदि॑तिं॒ सिन्धु॑म॒र्कैः स्व॒स्तिमी॑ळे स॒ख्याय॑ दे॒वीम् । उ॒भे यथा॑ नो॒ अह॑नी नि॒पात॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ करता॒मद॑ब्धे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pastyā́m ǀ áditim ǀ síndhum ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ svastím ǀ īḷe ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ devī́m ǀubhé íti ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ áhanī íti ǀ ni-pā́taḥ ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ karatām ǀ ádabdhe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I adore the veneratedAditi, theSindhuand the divineSvastifor their friendship; (I praise you) both, Day and Night, that you may protect us unimpeded; night and morning do (what we desire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णश्चेति॒ पन्था॑मि॒षस्पति॑: सुवि॒तं गा॒तुम॒ग्निः । इन्द्रा॑विष्णू नृ॒वदु॒ षु स्तवा॑ना॒ शर्म॑ नो यन्त॒मम॑व॒द्वरू॑थम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ceti ǀ pánthām ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ suvitám ǀ gātúm ǀ agníḥ ǀíndrāviṣṇū íti ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ stávānā ǀ śárma ǀ naḥ ǀ yantam ǀ áma-vat ǀ várūtham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AryamanandVaruṇainstrumental uct us in the path (of worship);Agni, the lord of food points out the way to happiness;IndraandViṣṇu, being glorified, bestow upon us desirable prosperity comprehending descendants and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ पर्व॑तस्य म॒रुता॒मवां॑सि दे॒वस्य॑ त्रा॒तुर॑व्रि॒ भग॑स्य । पात्पति॒र्जन्या॒दंह॑सो नो मि॒त्रो मि॒त्रिया॑दु॒त न॑ उरुष्येत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ párvatasya ǀ marútām ǀ ávāṃsi ǀ devásya ǀ trātúḥ ǀ avri ǀ bhágasya ǀpā́t ǀ pátiḥ ǀ jányāt ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ mitríyāt ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have recourse to the protection ofParvata, of theMaruts, and of the divine protector,Bhaga; may the lord (Varuṇa) preserve us from human wretchedness, and mayMitradefend us with a friendly regard.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू रो॑दसी॒ अहि॑ना बु॒ध्न्ये॑न स्तुवी॒त दे॑वी॒ अप्ये॑भिरि॒ष्टैः । स॒मु॒द्रं न सं॒चर॑णे सनि॒ष्यवो॑ घ॒र्मस्व॑रसो न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ अप॑ व्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ rodasī íti ǀ áhinā ǀ budhnyéna ǀ stuvītá ǀ devī íti ǀ ápyebhiḥ ǀ iṣṭáiḥ ǀsamudrám ǀ ná ǀ sam-cáraṇe ǀ saniṣyávaḥ ǀ gharmá-svarasaḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine Heaven and Earth, I praise you together withAhirbudhnyafor those (good things that are) desired, as those desirous of acquiring (riches) praise the ocean on traversing it (in which) the sounding rivers disappear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वैर्नो॑ दे॒व्यदि॑ति॒र्नि पा॑तु दे॒वस्त्रा॒ता त्रा॑यता॒मप्र॑युच्छन् । न॒हि मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य धा॒सिमर्हा॑मसि प्र॒मियं॒ सान्व॒ग्नेः
shlokas.transliteration: deváiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǀ deváḥ ǀ trātā́ ǀ trāyatām ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀnahí ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhāsím ǀ árhāmasi ǀ pra-míyam ǀ sā́nu ǀ agnéḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineAditi, with the gods, preserve us; may the ever-attentive protecting (deity,Indra), protect us; we are not able to withhold the elevated (sacrificial) food ofMitra, ofVaruṇa, ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरी॑शे वस॒व्य॑स्या॒ग्निर्म॒हः सौभ॑गस्य । तान्य॒स्मभ्यं॑ रासते
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ īśe ǀ vasavyásya ǀ agníḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sáubhagasya ǀtā́ni ǀ asmábhyam ǀ rāsate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis lord over treasure; Agni (is lord) over great good fortune; may he bestow them upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उषो॑ मघो॒न्या व॑ह॒ सूनृ॑ते॒ वार्या॑ पु॒रु । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ वाजिनीवति
shlokas.transliteration: úṣaḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sū́nṛte ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀasmábhyam ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Opulent, Uṣas, truth-speaking, food-abounding, bestow upon us many good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्सु न॑: सवि॒ता भगो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । इन्द्रो॑ नो॒ राध॒सा ग॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySavitā,Bhaga,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,Indra, come to us with the wealth (that each bestow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒ह ज्येष्ठे॑ रु॒चा भ॑वतां शु॒चय॑द्भिर॒र्कैः । यत्सीं॒ वरि॑ष्ठे बृह॒ती वि॑मि॒न्वन्रु॒वद्धो॒क्षा प॑प्रथा॒नेभि॒रेवै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ihá ǀ jyéṣṭhe íti ǀ rucā́ ǀ bhavatām ǀ śucáyat-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ váriṣṭhe íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ vi-minván ǀ ruvát ǀ ha ǀ ukṣā́ ǀ paprathānébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vast and most excellent Heaven and Earth, be present with splendour at this (sacrifice, attracted) by sanctifying hymns; since that the showerer sounds everywhere with (his) heralds, the rapid (winds), passing through the two spacious and mighty (regions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वी दे॒वेभि॑र्यज॒ते यज॑त्रै॒रमि॑नती तस्थतुरु॒क्षमा॑णे । ऋ॒ताव॑री अ॒द्रुहा॑ दे॒वपु॑त्रे य॒ज्ञस्य॑ ने॒त्री शु॒चय॑द्भिर॒र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: devī́ íti ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ yajaté íti ǀ yájatraiḥ ǀ áminatī íti ǀ tasthatuḥ ǀ ukṣámāṇe íti ǀṛtávarī ítyṛtá-varī ǀ adrúhā ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ yajñásya ǀ netrī́ íti ǀ śucáyat-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine, adorable, benevolent, fertilizing, truthful, unoppressive Heaven and Earth, the leaders of sacrifice, whose sons are the gods, be present with the adorable gods, (attracted) by sanctifying hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इत्स्वपा॒ भुव॑नेष्वास॒ य इ॒मे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ज॒जान॑ । उ॒र्वी ग॑भी॒रे रज॑सी सु॒मेके॑ अवं॒शे धीर॒: शच्या॒ समै॑रत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ āsa ǀ yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ jajā́na ǀurvī́ íti ǀ gabhīré íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀ avaṃśé ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ śácyā ǀ sám ǀ airat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily he was the doer of a good work in the regions, who genitive rated these two, Heaven and Earth, and firm of purpose, gave an impulse by his deed to the two vast immoveable, beautiful, unsupported worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू रो॑दसी बृ॒हद्भि॑र्नो॒ वरू॑थै॒: पत्नी॑वद्भिरि॒षय॑न्ती स॒जोषा॑: । उ॒रू॒ची विश्वे॑ यज॒ते नि पा॑तं धि॒या स्या॑म र॒थ्य॑: सदा॒साः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ rodasī íti ǀ bṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ várūthaiḥ ǀ pátnīvat-bhiḥ ǀ iṣáyantī íti ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀurūcī́ íti ǀ víśve íti ǀ yajaté íti ǀ ní ǀ pātam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ sadā-sā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Heaven and Earth, vast, universal, adorable, united in satisfaction and disposed to give us food, protect us with our spacious dwelings, inhabited by our wives, and may we for our (pious) acts be possessed of chariots and slaves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वां॒ महि॒ द्यवी॑ अ॒भ्युप॑स्तुतिं भरामहे । शुची॒ उप॒ प्रश॑स्तये
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ máhi ǀ dyávī íti ǀ abhí ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ bharāmahe ǀśúcī íti ǀ úpa ǀ prá-śastaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer earnest praise you both resplendent (Heaven and Earth); we approach you who are pure to offer adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒ने त॒न्वा॑ मि॒थः स्वेन॒ दक्षे॑ण राजथः । ऊ॒ह्याथे॑ स॒नादृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: punāné íti ǀ tanvā́ ǀ mitháḥ ǀ svéna ǀ dákṣeṇa ǀ rājathaḥ ǀūhyā́the íti ǀ sanā́t ǀ ṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mutually sanctifying (each other) of your own substance you shine by your own power, and ever beat away the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ही मि॒त्रस्य॑ साधथ॒स्तर॑न्ती॒ पिप्र॑ती ऋ॒तम् । परि॑ य॒ज्ञं नि षे॑दथुः
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ íti ǀ mitrásya ǀ sādhathaḥ ǀ tárantī íti ǀ pípratī íti ǀ ṛtám ǀpári ǀ yajñám ǀ ní ǀ sedathuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty (Heaven and Earth), you fulfil the desires of your friend; distributing food and giving sustenance you have sat down at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पति॑ना व॒यं हि॒तेने॑व जयामसि । गामश्वं॑ पोषयि॒त्न्वा स नो॑ मृळाती॒दृशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: kṣétrasya ǀ pátinā ǀ vayám ǀ hiténa-iva ǀ jayāmasi ǀgā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ poṣayitnú ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷāti ǀ īdṛ́śe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With the master of the field, our friend, we triumph; may he bestow upon us cattle, horses, nourishment, for by such (gifts) he makes us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेत्र॑स्य पते॒ मधु॑मन्तमू॒र्मिं धे॒नुरि॑व॒ पयो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धुक्ष्व । म॒धु॒श्चुतं॑ घृ॒तमि॑व॒ सुपू॑तमृ॒तस्य॑ न॒: पत॑यो मृळयन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: kṣétrasya ǀ pate ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ ūrmím ǀ dhenúḥ-iva ǀ páyaḥ ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhukṣva ǀmadhu-ścútam ǀ ghṛtám-iva ǀ sú-pūtam ǀ ṛtásya ǀ naḥ ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ mṛḷayantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of the field, bestow upon us sweet abundant, (water), as the cow (yields her) milk, dropping like honey, blend as butter; may the lords of the water make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑मती॒रोष॑धी॒र्द्याव॒ आपो॒ मधु॑मन्नो भवत्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पति॒र्मधु॑मान्नो अ॒स्त्वरि॑ष्यन्तो॒ अन्वे॑नं चरेम
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu-matīḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ antárikṣam ǀkṣétrasya ǀ pátiḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ áriṣyantaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ enam ǀ carema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the herbs (of the field) be sweet for us; may the heavens, the waters, the firmament, be kind to us; may the lord of the field be gracious to us; let us, undeterred (by foes), have recourse to him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं वा॒हाः शु॒नं नर॑: शु॒नं कृ॑षतु॒ लाङ्ग॑लम् । शु॒नं व॑र॒त्रा ब॑ध्यन्तां शु॒नमष्ट्रा॒मुदि॑ङ्गय
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ vāhā́ḥ ǀ śunám ǀ náraḥ ǀ śunám ǀ kṛṣatu ǀ lā́ṅgalam ǀśunám ǀ varatrā́ḥ ǀ badhyantām ǀ śunám ǀ áṣṭrām ǀ út ǀ iṅgaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the oxen (draw) happily, the men (labour) happily; the plural ugh furrows happily; may the traces bind happily; wield the goad happily.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुना॑सीरावि॒मां वाचं॑ जुषेथां॒ यद्दि॒वि च॒क्रथु॒: पय॑: । तेने॒मामुप॑ सिञ्चतम्
shlokas.transliteration: śúnāsīrau ǀ imā́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ juṣethām ǀ yát ǀ diví ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀténa ǀ imā́m ǀ úpa ǀ siñcatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ŚunaandSīrabe plural ased by this our praise, and consequently sprinkle this (earth) with the water which you have reated in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाची॑ सुभगे भव॒ सीते॒ वन्दा॑महे त्वा । यथा॑ नः सु॒भगास॑सि॒ यथा॑ नः सु॒फलास॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́cī ǀ su-bhage ǀ bhava ǀ sī́te ǀ vándāmahe ǀ tvā ǀyáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ ásasi ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ su-phálā ǀ ásasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AuspiciousSītā, be present, we glorify you; that you may be propitious to us, that you may yield us abundant fruit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒: सीतां॒ नि गृ॑ह्णातु॒ तां पू॒षानु॑ यच्छतु । सा न॒: पय॑स्वती दुहा॒मुत्त॑रामुत्तरां॒ समा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ sī́tām ǀ ní ǀ gṛhṇātu ǀ tā́m ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ ánu ǀ yacchatu ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ páyasvatī ǀ duhām ǀ úttarām-uttarām ǀ sámām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndratake hold ofSītā; mayPūṣanguide her; may she, well stored with water, yield it as milk, year after year.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नं न॒: फाला॒ वि कृ॑षन्तु॒ भूमिं॑ शु॒नं की॒नाशा॑ अ॒भि य॑न्तु वा॒हैः । शु॒नं प॒र्जन्यो॒ मधु॑ना॒ पयो॑भि॒: शुना॑सीरा शु॒नम॒स्मासु॑ धत्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ naḥ ǀ phā́lāḥ ǀ ví ǀ kṛṣantu ǀ bhū́mim ǀ śunám ǀ kīnā́śāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yantu ǀ vāháiḥ ǀśunám ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ mádhunā ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śúnāsīrā ǀ śunám ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhattam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the plural ugh shares break up our land happily; may the plural ughman go happily with the oxen; mayParjanya(water the earth) with sweet showers happily; grant,ŚunaandSīra, prosperity to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रादू॒र्मिर्मधु॑माँ॒ उदा॑र॒दुपां॒शुना॒ सम॑मृत॒त्वमा॑नट् । घृ॒तस्य॒ नाम॒ गुह्यं॒ यदस्ति॑ जि॒ह्वा दे॒वाना॑म॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: samudrā́t ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ út ǀ ārat ǀ úpa ǀ aṃśúnā ǀ sám ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaṭ ǀghṛtásya ǀ nā́ma ǀ gúhyam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀ jihvā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sweet water swells up from the firmament; by the (solar) ray (man) obtains immortality; that which is he secret name of clarified butter is the tongue of the gods, the navel of ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं नाम॒ प्र ब्र॑वामा घृ॒तस्या॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे धा॑रयामा॒ नमो॑भिः । उप॑ ब्र॒ह्मा शृ॑णवच्छ॒स्यमा॑नं॒ चतु॑:शृङ्गोऽवमीद्गौ॒र ए॒तत्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ nā́ma ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ dhārayāma ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀúpa ǀ brahmā́ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ śasyámānam ǀ cátuḥ-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ avamīt ǀ gauráḥ ǀ etát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We celebrate the nameGhṛtaat this sacrifice, we offer it with adoration; may the four-hornedBrahmālisten to its being glorified; the fair-complexioned-deity perfect this rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वारि॒ शृङ्गा॒ त्रयो॑ अस्य॒ पादा॒ द्वे शी॒र्षे स॒प्त हस्ता॑सो अस्य । त्रिधा॑ ब॒द्धो वृ॑ष॒भो रो॑रवीति म॒हो दे॒वो मर्त्याँ॒ आ वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: catvā́ri ǀ śṛ́ṅgā ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ asya ǀ pā́dāḥ ǀ dvé íti ǀ śīrṣé íti ǀ saptá ǀ hástāsaḥ ǀ asya ǀtrídhā ǀ baddháḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ roravīti ǀ maháḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártyān ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Four are his horns; three are his feet; his heads are two, hishandsare seven; the triple-bound showerer (of benefits) roars aloud; the mighty deity has entered among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिधा॑ हि॒तं प॒णिभि॑र्गु॒ह्यमा॑नं॒ गवि॑ दे॒वासो॑ घृ॒तमन्व॑विन्दन् । इन्द्र॒ एकं॒ सूर्य॒ एकं॑ जजान वे॒नादेकं॑ स्व॒धया॒ निष्ट॑तक्षुः
shlokas.transliteration: trídhā ǀ hitám ǀ paṇí-bhiḥ ǀ guhyámānam ǀ gávi ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ánu ǀ avindan ǀíndraḥ ǀ ékam ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ékam ǀ jajāna ǀ venā́t ǀ ékam ǀ svadháyā ǀ níḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods discovered the Ghī concealed by thePaṇis, plural ced three-fold in the cow;Indragenitive rated one (portion),Sūryaanother, the (other gods) fabricated one from the resplendent (Agni), for the sake of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता अ॑र्षन्ति॒ हृद्या॑त्समु॒द्राच्छ॒तव्र॑जा रि॒पुणा॒ नाव॒चक्षे॑ । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्य॑ आसाम्
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ hṛ́dyāt ǀ samudrā́t ǀ śatá-vrajāḥ ǀ ripúṇā ǀ ná ǀ ava-cákṣe ǀghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cākaśīmi ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀ vetasáḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ āsām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These hundred-channeled showers fall from the heart-delighting firmament, unobserved by the hostile (cloud); I look upon these showers of Ghī, (and behold) the goldenVetasain the midst of them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्यक्स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः । ए॒ते अ॑र्षन्त्यू॒र्मयो॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ मृ॒गा इ॑व क्षिप॒णोरीष॑माणाः
shlokas.transliteration: samyák ǀ sravanti ǀ sarítaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ pūyámānāḥ ǀeté ǀ arṣanti ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ mṛgā́ḥ-iva ǀ kṣipaṇóḥ ǀ ī́ṣamāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They flow uninterruptedly like plural asing rivers, purified by the mind that is seated in the heart; these streams of Ghī descend (upon the fire), like deer flying from the hunter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धो॑रिव प्राध्व॒ने शू॑घ॒नासो॒ वात॑प्रमियः पतयन्ति य॒ह्वाः । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अरु॒षो न वा॒जी काष्ठा॑ भि॒न्दन्नू॒र्मिभि॒: पिन्व॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: síndhoḥ-iva ǀ pra-adhvané ǀ śūghanā́saḥ ǀ vā́ta-pramiyaḥ ǀ patayanti ǀ yahvā́ḥ ǀghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ kā́ṣṭhāḥ ǀ bhindán ǀ ūrmíbhiḥ ǀ pínvamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The stream of Ghī fall copious, swift as the wind, and rapid as the waters of a river down a declivity, breaking through the confining banks, and hurrying on with their waves, like a high-spirited steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्र॑वन्त॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषा॑: कल्या॒ण्य१॒॑: स्मय॑मानासो अ॒ग्निम् । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑: स॒मिधो॑ नसन्त॒ ता जु॑षा॒णो ह॑र्यति जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ pravanta ǀ sámanā-iva ǀ yóṣāḥ ǀ kalyāṇyáḥ ǀ smáyamānāsaḥ ǀ agním ǀghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ sam-ídhaḥ ǀ nasanta ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ haryati ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The streams of Ghī incline toAgnias devoted wives, auspicious and smiling, to a husband; they feed (the flame) like fuel, andJātavedas, propitiated, accepts them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒न्या॑ इव वह॒तुमेत॒वा उ॑ अ॒ञ्ज्य॑ञ्जा॒ना अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि । यत्र॒ सोम॑: सू॒यते॒ यत्र॑ य॒ज्ञो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि तत्प॑वन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: kanyā́ḥ-iva ǀ vahatúm ǀ étavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ añjí ǀ añjānā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cākaśīmi ǀyátra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sūyáte ǀ yátra ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tát ǀ pavante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I contemplate these streams of Ghī as they flow from where theSomais effused, where the sacrifice (is solemnized), as maidens decorating themselves with unguents to go to the bridegroom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्षत सुष्टु॒तिं गव्य॑मा॒जिम॒स्मासु॑ भ॒द्रा द्रवि॑णानि धत्त । इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं न॑यत दे॒वता॑ नो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॒ मधु॑मत्पवन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣata ǀ su-stutím ǀ gávyam ǀ ājím ǀ asmā́su ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ dhatta ǀimám ǀ yajñám ǀ nayata ǀ devátā ǀ naḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pavante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests) address the pious praise, (the source) of herds of cattle; bestow upon us auspicious riches; convey this our sacrifice to the gods, (where at) the streams of Ghī with sweetness descend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धाम॑न्ते॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑न॒मधि॑ श्रि॒तम॒न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे हृ॒द्य१॒॑न्तरायु॑षि । अ॒पामनी॑के समि॒थे य आभृ॑त॒स्तम॑श्याम॒ मधु॑मन्तं त ऊ॒र्मिम्
shlokas.transliteration: dhā́man ǀ te ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ ádhi ǀ śritám ǀ antáríti ǀ samudré ǀ hṛdí ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́yuṣi ǀapā́m ǀ ánīke ǀ sam-ithé ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́-bhṛtaḥ ǀ tám ǀ aśyāma ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ te ǀ ūrmím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The whole world, (Agni), finds an asylum in your effulgence, whether it be in the ocean, in the heart (of man), in the life (of living beings), in the assemblage of the waters, or in warfare; may we attain the sweet-flavoured wave which is established in your (essence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अबो॑ध्य॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॒ जना॑नां॒ प्रति॑ धे॒नुमि॑वाय॒तीमु॒षास॑म् । य॒ह्वा इ॑व॒ प्र व॒यामु॒ज्जिहा॑ना॒: प्र भा॒नव॑: सिस्रते॒ नाक॒मच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ábodhi ǀ agníḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ jánānām ǀ práti ǀ dhenúm-iva ǀ ā-yatī́m ǀ uṣásam ǀyahvā́ḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ vayā́m ǀ ut-jíhānāḥ ǀ prá ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ sisrate ǀ nā́kam ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis awakened by the fuel (supplied) by the priests at the dawn, approaching like a cow (to pasture); his flames rise up to the sky like stately (trees) throwing aloft their branches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अबो॑धि॒ होता॑ य॒जथा॑य दे॒वानू॒र्ध्वो अ॒ग्निः सु॒मना॑: प्रा॒तर॑स्थात् । समि॑द्धस्य॒ रुश॑ददर्शि॒ पाजो॑ म॒हान्दे॒वस्तम॑सो॒ निर॑मोचि
shlokas.transliteration: ábodhi ǀ hótā ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ asthāt ǀsám-iddhasya ǀ rúśat ǀ adarśi ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ deváḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ amoci ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offer of the oblation is awakened for the worship of the gods; favourably minded,Agnihas rise up with the dawn; the radiant vigour of the kindled (fire) is manifested; the great deity has been liberated from the darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदीं॑ ग॒णस्य॑ रश॒नामजी॑ग॒: शुचि॑रङ्क्ते॒ शुचि॑भि॒र्गोभि॑र॒ग्निः । आद्दक्षि॑णा युज्यते वाज॒यन्त्यु॑त्ता॒नामू॒र्ध्वो अ॑धयज्जु॒हूभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ gaṇásya ǀ raśanā́m ǀ ájīgaríti ǀ śúciḥ ǀ aṅkte ǀ śúci-bhiḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀā́t ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ yujyate ǀ vāja-yántī ǀ uttānā́m ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ adhayat ǀ juhū́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenAgnihas seized upon the (confining) girdle of the aggregated (world), then, bright-shining, he makes all manifest with brilliant rays; thereupon the precious food-desiring (oblations) is added (to the flame), and Agni, soaring aloft, drinks it as it is (spread out) recumbent by the ladles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमच्छा॑ देवय॒तां मनां॑सि॒ चक्षूं॑षीव॒ सूर्ये॒ सं च॑रन्ति । यदीं॒ सुवा॑ते उ॒षसा॒ विरू॑पे श्वे॒तो वा॒जी जा॑यते॒ अग्रे॒ अह्ना॑म्
