shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ áccha ǀ deva-yatā́m ǀ mánāṃsi ǀ cákṣūṃṣi-iva ǀ sū́rye ǀ sám ǀ caranti ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ súvāte íti ǀ uṣásā ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ śvetáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ jāyate ǀ ágre ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The minds of the devout turn toAgni, as the eyes (of men) look towards the sun; when the multiform (heaven and earth) bring him forth along with the dawn, he is born as a white courser in the beginning of the days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जनि॑ष्ट॒ हि जेन्यो॒ अग्रे॒ अह्नां॑ हि॒तो हि॒तेष्व॑रु॒षो वने॑षु । दमे॑दमे स॒प्त रत्ना॒ दधा॑नो॒ऽग्निर्होता॒ नि ष॑सादा॒ यजी॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: jániṣṭa ǀ hí ǀ jényaḥ ǀ ágre ǀ áhnām ǀ hitáḥ ǀ hitéṣu ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀdáme-dame ǀ saptá ǀ rátnā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ sasāda ǀ yájīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni), capable of birth, is born in the beginning of the days; radiant, he is deposited in the friendly woods, and then the adorable Agni, the offerer of the oblation, displaying seven precious (rays), is seated in every house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॒ न्य॑सीद॒द्यजी॑यानु॒पस्थे॑ मा॒तुः सु॑र॒भा उ॑ लो॒के । युवा॑ क॒विः पु॑रुनि॒ष्ठ ऋ॒तावा॑ ध॒र्ता कृ॑ष्टी॒नामु॒त मध्य॑ इ॒द्धः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ asīdat ǀ yájīyān ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mātúḥ ǀ surabháu ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loké ǀyúvā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ puruniḥ-stháḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ dhartā́ ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ utá ǀ mádhye ǀ iddháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableAgni, the offerer of the oblation, has sat down in a fragrant plural ce on the top of his mother (earth); youthful, wise, many-stationed, the celebrator of sacrifice, the sustainer (of all), kindled (he abides) among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र णु त्यं विप्र॑मध्व॒रेषु॑ सा॒धुम॒ग्निं होता॑रमीळते॒ नमो॑भिः । आ यस्त॒तान॒ रोद॑सी ऋ॒तेन॒ नित्यं॑ मृजन्ति वा॒जिनं॑ घृ॒तेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ tyám ǀ vípram ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ sādhúm ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ tatā́na ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ṛténa ǀ nítyam ǀ mṛjanti ǀ vājínam ǀ ghṛténa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They glorify at present withhymns thatAgniwho is intelligent, the fulfiller (of desires) at sacrifices, the offer of oblations, who has charged heaven and earth with water, and whom they always worship with clarified butter as the bestower of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒र्जा॒ल्यो॑ मृज्यते॒ स्वे दमू॑नाः कविप्रश॒स्तो अति॑थिः शि॒वो न॑: । स॒हस्र॑शृङ्गो वृष॒भस्तदो॑जा॒ विश्वाँ॑ अग्ने॒ सह॑सा॒ प्रास्य॒न्यान्
shlokas.transliteration: mārjālyáḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ své ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ kavi-praśastáḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀsahásra-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ tát-ojāḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ agne ǀ sáhasā ǀ prá ǀ asi ǀ anyā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Entitled to worship, he is worshipped in his own (abode); humble-minded, eminent among sages, our auspicious guest, the thousand-rayed, the showerer (of benefits), of well-known might, you,Agni, surpass all others in strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒द्यो अ॑ग्ने॒ अत्ये॑ष्य॒न्याना॒विर्यस्मै॒ चारु॑तमो ब॒भूथ॑ । ई॒ळेन्यो॑ वपु॒ष्यो॑ वि॒भावा॑ प्रि॒यो वि॒शामति॑थि॒र्मानु॑षीणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ agne ǀ áti ǀ eṣi ǀ anyā́n ǀ āvíḥ ǀ yásmai ǀ cā́ru-tamaḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǀīḷényaḥ ǀ vapuṣyáḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ priyáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ átithiḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Too) quickly,Agni, do you pass to others from him to whom you have been manifest; most beautiful, adorable, radiant, many-shining, the loved of people, the guest of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॑ भरन्ति क्षि॒तयो॑ यविष्ठ ब॒लिम॑ग्ने॒ अन्ति॑त॒ ओत दू॒रात् । आ भन्दि॑ष्ठस्य सुम॒तिं चि॑किद्धि बृ॒हत्ते॑ अग्ने॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ भ॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ bharanti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ balím ǀ agne ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ dūrā́t ǀā́ ǀ bhándiṣṭhasya ǀ su-matím ǀ cikiddhi ǀ bṛhát ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ bhadrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you, young (of the gods), men present oblations, whether nigh or from far; accept the praise of him who most extols you; for the felicity (which you confer).Agniis great, vast, auspicious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आद्य रथं॑ भानुमो भानु॒मन्त॒मग्ने॒ तिष्ठ॑ यज॒तेभि॒: सम॑न्तम् । वि॒द्वान्प॑थी॒नामु॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्ष॒मेह दे॒वान्ह॑वि॒रद्या॑य वक्षि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ adyá ǀ rátham ǀ bhānu-maḥ ǀ bhānu-mántam ǀ ágne ǀ tíṣṭha ǀ yajatébhiḥ ǀ sám-antam ǀvidvā́n ǀ pathīnā́m ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǀ haviḥ-ádyāya ǀ vakṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ascend today, radiantAgni, your resplendent, well-conducted chariot, together with the adorable (gods), cognizant of the ways (of worship), bring hither, by the vast firmament, the gods to partake of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवो॑चाम क॒वये॒ मेध्या॑य॒ वचो॑ व॒न्दारु॑ वृष॒भाय॒ वृष्णे॑ । गवि॑ष्ठिरो॒ नम॑सा॒ स्तोम॑म॒ग्नौ दि॒वी॑व रु॒क्ममु॑रु॒व्यञ्च॑मश्रेत्
shlokas.transliteration: ávocāma ǀ kaváye ǀ médhyāya ǀ vácaḥ ǀ vandā́ru ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀgáviṣṭhiraḥ ǀ námasā ǀ stómam ǀ agnáu ǀ diví-iva ǀ rukmám ǀ uru-vyáñcam ǀ aśret ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have uttered aloud this encomiastic praise to the wise, holy, vigorous (Agni), the showerer (of benefits);Gaviṣṭhiraoffers with reverence (this) praise to Agni like the wide-sojourning (sun), effulgent in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒मा॒रं मा॒ता यु॑व॒तिः समु॑ब्धं॒ गुहा॑ बिभर्ति॒ न द॑दाति पि॒त्रे । अनी॑कमस्य॒ न मि॒नज्जना॑सः पु॒रः प॑श्यन्ति॒ निहि॑तमर॒तौ
shlokas.transliteration: kumārám ǀ mātā́ ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ sám-ubdham ǀ gúhā ǀ bibharti ǀ ná ǀ dadāti ǀ pitré ǀánīkam ǀ asya ǀ ná ǀ minát ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ paśyanti ǀ ní-hitam ǀ aratáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The young mother cherishes her mutilated boy in secret, and gives him not up to the father; men behold not his mutilated form, but (see him) when plural ced before (them) in an unresting (position).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कमे॒तं त्वं यु॑वते कुमा॒रं पेषी॑ बिभर्षि॒ महि॑षी जजान । पू॒र्वीर्हि गर्भ॑: श॒रदो॑ व॒वर्धाप॑श्यं जा॒तं यदसू॑त मा॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: kám ǀ etám ǀ tvám ǀ yuvate ǀ kumārám ǀ péṣī ǀ bibharṣi ǀ máhiṣī ǀ jajāna ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ vavárdha ǀ ápaśyam ǀ jātám ǀ yát ǀ ásūta ǀ mātā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Young mother, what boy is this whom you, (become) a malevolent spirit, foster? The mighty (queen) has given him birth; the embryo has thrived through many years; I have seen him born as the mother brought him forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यदन्तं॒ शुचि॑वर्णमा॒रात्क्षेत्रा॑दपश्य॒मायु॑धा॒ मिमा॑नम् । द॒दा॒नो अ॑स्मा अ॒मृतं॑ वि॒पृक्व॒त्किं माम॑नि॒न्द्राः कृ॑णवन्ननु॒क्थाः
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-dantam ǀ śúci-varṇam ǀ ārā́t ǀ kṣétrāt ǀ apaśyam ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ mímānam ǀdadānáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ vipṛ́kvat ǀ kím ǀ mā́m ǀ anindrā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇavan ǀ anukthā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have seen him from a near plural ce, golden-toothed, bright-coloured, wielding (flames like) weapons, (when) offering to him the ambrosial, all-diffusing (oblation); what can those who acknowledge notIndra, who repeat not his praise, do unto me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेत्रा॑दपश्यं सनु॒तश्चर॑न्तं सु॒मद्यू॒थं न पु॒रु शोभ॑मानम् । न ता अ॑गृभ्र॒न्नज॑निष्ट॒ हि षः पलि॑क्नी॒रिद्यु॑व॒तयो॑ भवन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: kṣétrāt ǀ apaśyam ǀ sanutáríti ǀ cárantam ǀ su-mát ǀ yūthám ǀ ná ǀ purú ǀ śóbhamānam ǀná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ agṛbhran ǀ ájaniṣṭa ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀ páliknīḥ ǀ ít ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ bhavanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have seen him passing secretly from plural ce (to plural ce) like a herd (of cattle), shining brightly of his own accord; they apprehended not those (flames of his), but he has (again) been born, and they who had become grey-haired are (once more) young.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के मे॑ मर्य॒कं वि य॑वन्त॒ गोभि॒र्न येषां॑ गो॒पा अर॑णश्चि॒दास॑ । य ईं॑ जगृ॒भुरव॒ ते सृ॑ज॒न्त्वाजा॑ति प॒श्व उप॑ नश्चिकि॒त्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ me ǀ maryakám ǀ ví ǀ yavanta ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ yéṣām ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ áraṇaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́sa ǀyé ǀ īm ǀ jagṛbhúḥ ǀ áva ǀ té ǀ sṛjantú ǀ ā́ ǀ ajāti ǀ paśváḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who have disunited my people from the cattle? was there not for them an invincible protector? may they who have seized upon that (people) perish, for he who knows (our wishes) approaches to (protect) the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒सां राजा॑नं वस॒तिं जना॑ना॒मरा॑तयो॒ नि द॑धु॒र्मर्त्ये॑षु । ब्रह्मा॒ण्यत्रे॒रव॒ तं सृ॑जन्तु निन्दि॒तारो॒ निन्द्या॑सो भवन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: vasā́m ǀ rā́jānam ǀ vasatím ǀ jánānām ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ ní ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀbráhmāṇi ǀ átreḥ ǀ áva ǀ tám ǀ sṛjantu ǀ ninditā́raḥ ǀ níndyāsaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enemies have secreted amongmortals, the king of living beings, the asylum of men; may the prayers ofAtriset him free; may those who revile be reviled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुन॑श्चि॒च्छेपं॒ निदि॑तं स॒हस्रा॒द्यूपा॑दमुञ्चो॒ अश॑मिष्ट॒ हि षः । ए॒वास्मद॑ग्ने॒ वि मु॑मुग्धि॒ पाशा॒न्होत॑श्चिकित्व इ॒ह तू नि॒षद्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: śúnaḥ-śépam ǀ cit ǀ ní-ditam ǀ sahásrāt ǀ yū́pāt ǀ amuñcaḥ ǀ áśamiṣṭa ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀevá ǀ asmát ǀ agne ǀ ví ǀ mumugdhi ǀ pā́śān ǀ hótaríti ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ tú ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have liberated the fettered Śunahśepa from a thousand stakes, for he was patient in endurance; soAgni, free us from our bonds, having sat down here (at our sacrifice), intelligent offerer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हृ॒णी॒यमा॑नो॒ अप॒ हि मदैये॒: प्र मे॑ दे॒वानां॑ व्रत॒पा उ॑वाच । इन्द्रो॑ वि॒द्वाँ अनु॒ हि त्वा॑ च॒चक्ष॒ तेना॒हम॑ग्ने॒ अनु॑शिष्ट॒ आगा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: hṛṇīyámānaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ hí ǀ mát ǀ áiyeḥ ǀ prá ǀ me ǀ devā́nām ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ uvāca ǀíndraḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ánu ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ cacákṣa ǀ téna ǀ ahám ǀ agne ǀ ánu-śiṣṭaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When angered, (Agni), depart from me; the protector of the worship of the gods, (Indra), has spoken to me; the wise Indra has looked upon you, and instrumental ucted by him, I have come, Agni, to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ज्योति॑षा बृह॒ता भा॑त्य॒ग्निरा॒विर्विश्वा॑नि कृणुते महि॒त्वा । प्रादे॑वीर्मा॒याः स॑हते दु॒रेवा॒: शिशी॑ते॒ शृङ्गे॒ रक्ष॑से वि॒निक्षे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ agníḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ kṛṇute ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀprá ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ sahate ǀ duḥ-évāḥ ǀ śíśīte ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ rákṣase ǀ vi-níkṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, shines with great and varied radiance; he makes all things manifest by his might; he overcomes undivine malignant delusions; he sharpens his horns for the destruction of therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्वा॒नासो॑ दि॒वि ष॑न्त्व॒ग्नेस्ति॒ग्मायु॑धा॒ रक्ष॑से॒ हन्त॒वा उ॑ । मदे॑ चिदस्य॒ प्र रु॑जन्ति॒ भामा॒ न व॑रन्ते परि॒बाधो॒ अदे॑वीः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ svānā́saḥ ǀ diví ǀ santu ǀ agnéḥ ǀ tigmá-āyudhāḥ ǀ rákṣase ǀ hántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀmáde ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ prá ǀ rujanti ǀ bhā́māḥ ǀ ná ǀ varante ǀ pari-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My roaring (flames),Agni, be manifest in the sky as sharp weapons wherewith to slay therākṣasas; in his exhilaration his shining (rays) inflict (destruction), and undivine opposing (hosts) arrest him not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं ते॒ स्तोमं॑ तुविजात॒ विप्रो॒ रथं॒ न धीर॒: स्वपा॑ अतक्षम् । यदीद॑ग्ने॒ प्रति॒ त्वं दे॑व॒ हर्या॒: स्व॑र्वतीर॒प ए॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ te ǀ stómam ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ vípraḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ atakṣam ǀyádi ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ práti ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ háryāḥ ǀ sváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ena ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise have I, a devout worshipper, composed for you, (Agni), who are born with many (faculties), as a steady dexterous (artisan fabricates) a car; if, divine Agni, you approve of it, then may we obtain abundant flowing water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तु॒वि॒ग्रीवो॑ वृष॒भो वा॑वृधा॒नो॑ऽश॒त्र्व१॒॑र्यः सम॑जाति॒ वेद॑: । इती॒मम॒ग्निम॒मृता॑ अवोचन्ब॒र्हिष्म॑ते॒ मन॑वे॒ शर्म॑ यंसद्ध॒विष्म॑ते॒ मन॑वे॒ शर्म॑ यंसत्
shlokas.transliteration: tuvi-grī́vaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ aśatrú ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajāti ǀ védaḥ ǀíti ǀ imám ǀ agním ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ avocan ǀ barhíṣmate ǀ mánave ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǀ havíṣmate ǀ mánave ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many-necked, the showerer (of benefits), ever increasing, collects together the wealth of the enemy without opposition; the immortals have enjoinedAgnithat he will bestow happiness on the man who offers sacrifice; that he will bestow happiness on the man who offers oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने॒ वरु॑णो॒ जाय॑से॒ यत्त्वं मि॒त्रो भ॑वसि॒ यत्समि॑द्धः । त्वे विश्वे॑ सहसस्पुत्र दे॒वास्त्वमिन्द्रो॑ दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ jā́yase ǀ yát ǀ tvám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ bhavasi ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ víśve ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tvám ǀ índraḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are bornVaruṇa, you becomeMitrawhen kindled; in you, son of strength, are all the gods; you areIndra, son of strength, to the mortal who presents (oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑र्य॒मा भ॑वसि॒ यत्क॒नीनां॒ नाम॑ स्वधाव॒न्गुह्यं॑ बिभर्षि । अ॒ञ्जन्ति॑ मि॒त्रं सुधि॑तं॒ न गोभि॒र्यद्दम्प॑ती॒ सम॑नसा कृ॒णोषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ aryamā́ ǀ bhavasi ǀ yát ǀ kanī́nām ǀ nā́ma ǀ svadhā-van ǀ gúhyam ǀ bibharṣi ǀañjánti ǀ mitrám ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ ná ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ dámpatī íti dám-patī ǀ sá-manasā ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You areAryamanin relation to maidens; you bear, enjoy of sacrificial food, a mysterious name; they anoint you, like a welcome friend, with milk and butter, when you make husband and wife of one mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ श्रि॒ये म॒रुतो॑ मर्जयन्त॒ रुद्र॒ यत्ते॒ जनि॑म॒ चारु॑ चि॒त्रम् । प॒दं यद्विष्णो॑रुप॒मं नि॒धायि॒ तेन॑ पासि॒ गुह्यं॒ नाम॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ śriyé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ marjayanta ǀ rúdra ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ jánima ǀ cā́ru ǀ citrám ǀpadám ǀ yát ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ ni-dhā́yi ǀ téna ǀ pāsi ǀ gúhyam ǀ nā́ma ǀ gónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For your glory theMarutssweep (the firmament), when your birth,Rudra, is beautiful and wonderful; the middle step ofViṣṇuhas been plural ced, so you cherish the mysterious name of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ श्रि॒या सु॒दृशो॑ देव दे॒वाः पु॒रू दधा॑ना अ॒मृतं॑ सपन्त । होता॑रम॒ग्निं मनु॑षो॒ नि षे॑दुर्दश॒स्यन्त॑ उ॒शिज॒: शंस॑मा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ śriyā́ ǀ su-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ purú ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ sapanta ǀhótāram ǀ agním ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ seduḥ ǀ daśasyántaḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (Agni), gods, (made) comely by your glory, and bearing (the) great (affection), sip the ambrosia; men adore Agni, the conveyer of theburnt-offering, presenting oblations on behalfof the instrumental tutor of the rite, desirous of (its) reward.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वद्धोता॒ पूर्वो॑ अग्ने॒ यजी॑या॒न्न काव्यै॑: प॒रो अ॑स्ति स्वधावः । वि॒शश्च॒ यस्या॒ अति॑थि॒र्भवा॑सि॒ स य॒ज्ञेन॑ वनवद्देव॒ मर्ता॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tvát ǀ hótā ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ yájīyān ǀ ná ǀ kā́vyaiḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ asti ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀviśáḥ ǀ ca ǀ yásyāḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ bhávāsi ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajñéna ǀ vanavat ǀ deva ǀ mártān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There is no more venerable offerer of oblation,Agni, than you, nor (one) prior to you; neither, giver of food, is any one subsequent (tobe more glorified by hymns); the man of whom you are the guest destroys hostile men by sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यम॑ग्ने वनुयाम॒ त्वोता॑ वसू॒यवो॑ ह॒विषा॒ बुध्य॑मानाः । व॒यं स॑म॒र्ये वि॒दथे॒ष्वह्नां॑ व॒यं रा॒या स॑हसस्पुत्र॒ मर्ता॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ agne ǀ vanuyāma ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ búdhyamānāḥ ǀvayám ǀ sa-maryé ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ áhnām ǀ vayám ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ mártān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, desirous of wealth,Agni,and arousing you by oblations, secure in your protection, acquire (riches); may we (be victorious) in battle, (successful) in sacrifices every day; and may we, son of strength, obtain with richesmale(descendants).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॒ आगो॑ अ॒भ्येनो॒ भरा॒त्यधीद॒घम॒घशं॑से दधात । ज॒ही चि॑कित्वो अ॒भिश॑स्तिमे॒तामग्ने॒ यो नो॑ म॒र्चय॑ति द्व॒येन॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ énaḥ ǀ bhárāti ǀ ádhi ǀ ít ǀ aghám ǀ aghá-śaṃse ǀ dadhāta ǀjahí ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ abhí-śastim ǀ etā́m ǀ agne ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marcáyati ǀ dvayéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgniinflict (evil) upon the evil-doer, who commits offence, or wickedness against us; destroy, sagacious Agni, the calumniator who injures us in these two ways.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॒स्या व्युषि॑ देव॒ पूर्वे॑ दू॒तं कृ॑ण्वा॒ना अ॑यजन्त ह॒व्यैः । सं॒स्थे यद॑ग्न॒ ईय॑से रयी॒णां दे॒वो मर्तै॒र्वसु॑भिरि॒ध्यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ vi-úṣi ǀ deva ǀ pū́rve ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ ayajanta ǀ havyáiḥ ǀsam-sthé ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ ī́yase ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártaiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ idhyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Former (worshippers) constituting you, divine (Agni), the messenger (of the gods), have worshipped you with oblations at the dawn of day; when you proceed to the plural ce (of the aggregation) of the wealth (of sacrifice), bright-shining, kindled by the mortals who have given you an abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ स्पृधि पि॒तरं॒ योधि॑ वि॒द्वान्पु॒त्रो यस्ते॑ सहसः सून ऊ॒हे । क॒दा चि॑कित्वो अ॒भि च॑क्षसे॒ नोऽग्ने॑ क॒दाँ ऋ॑त॒चिद्या॑तयासे
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ spṛdhi ǀ pitáram ǀ yódhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ putráḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ūhé ǀkadā́ ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cakṣase ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ kadā́ ǀ ṛta-cít ǀ yātayāse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Convey him (to safety) in war, son of strength, who like a wise son offers to you (reverence) as to a father; when, sagaciousAgnido you look upon us; when, director of sacrifice, do you direct us (to good ways).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॒ नाम॒ वन्द॑मानो दधाति पि॒ता व॑सो॒ यदि॒ तज्जो॒षया॑से । कु॒विद्दे॒वस्य॒ सह॑सा चका॒नः सु॒म्नम॒ग्निर्व॑नते वावृधा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ nā́ma ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ dadhāti ǀ pitā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ yádi ǀ tát ǀ joṣáyāse ǀkuvít ǀ devásya ǀ sáhasā ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ agníḥ ǀ vanate ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorifying you, he offers the copious oblation, if, bestower of dwellings, you as a father are plural ased to accept it;Agni, ever augmenting, and desirous (to be friend), by hismight, the devout (worshipper, offering) copious oblations, bestows upon him happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒ङ्ग ज॑रि॒तारं॑ यविष्ठ॒ विश्वा॑न्यग्ने दुरि॒ताति॑ पर्षि । स्ते॒ना अ॑दृश्रन्रि॒पवो॒ जना॒सोऽज्ञा॑तकेता वृजि॒ना अ॑भूवन्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ víśvāni ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀstenā́ḥ ǀ adṛśran ǀ ripávaḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ ájñāta-ketāḥ ǀ vṛjinā́ḥ ǀ abhūvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, young (of the gods), verily you bear your adorer (safe) beyond all calamities; thieves have been detected, and hostile men with cover evil intentions, have been avoided (by us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे यामा॑सस्त्व॒द्रिग॑भूव॒न्वस॑वे वा॒ तदिदागो॑ अवाचि । नाहा॒यम॒ग्निर॒भिश॑स्तये नो॒ न रीष॑ते वावृधा॒नः परा॑ दात्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ yā́māsaḥ ǀ tvadrík ǀ abhūvan ǀ vásave ǀ vā ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ avāci ǀná ǀ áha ǀ ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ abhí-śastaye ǀ naḥ ǀ ná ǀ ríṣate ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ párā ǀ dāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (encomiums) are directed towards you, but perhaps an offence has thereby been uttered to (you), the giver of dwellings;mayAgni,augmenting (by our praise), yield us not up to the maligner or the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ वसु॑पतिं॒ वसू॑नाम॒भि प्र म॑न्दे अध्व॒रेषु॑ राजन् । त्वया॒ वाजं॑ वाज॒यन्तो॑ जयेमा॒भि ष्या॑म पृत्सु॒तीर्मर्त्या॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ vásu-patim ǀ vásūnām ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ mande ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ rājan ǀtváyā ǀ vā́jam ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ jayema ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtsutī́ḥ ǀ mártyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalAgni, I glorify at sacrifices you who are the lord of vast riches; may we who are in want of food obtain food through you, and (through you) may we overcome hosts of (hostile) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒व्य॒वाळ॒ग्निर॒जर॑: पि॒ता नो॑ वि॒भुर्वि॒भावा॑ सु॒दृशी॑को अ॒स्मे । सु॒गा॒र्ह॒प॒त्याः समिषो॑ दिदीह्यस्म॒द्र्य१॒॑क्सं मि॑मीहि॒ श्रवां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: havya-vā́ṭ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ su-dṛ́śīkaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀsu-gārhapatyā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ asmadryák ǀ sám ǀ mimīhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the undecayingAgni, the bearer of oblations, be a father to us, all-pervading and resplendent (may he be) to us of plural asing aspect; supply us plural ntifully with food in return for our well-maintained household fire grant us viand abundantly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शां क॒विं वि॒श्पतिं॒ मानु॑षीणां॒ शुचिं॑ पाव॒कं घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठम॒ग्निम् । नि होता॑रं विश्व॒विदं॑ दधिध्वे॒ स दे॒वेषु॑ वनते॒ वार्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ kavím ǀ viśpátim ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ śúcim ǀ pāvakám ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ agním ǀní ǀ hótāram ǀ viśva-vídam ǀ dadhidhve ǀ sáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vanate ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You (priests) possess the wise lord of human beings, the pure, the purifying,Agni, cherished with oblations of butter, the offer of the burnt-offering, the all-knowing; he among the gods bestows desirable (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षस्वा॑ग्न॒ इळ॑या स॒जोषा॒ यत॑मानो र॒श्मिभि॒: सूर्य॑स्य । जु॒षस्व॑ नः स॒मिधं॑ जातवेद॒ आ च॑ दे॒वान्ह॑वि॒रद्या॑य वक्षि
shlokas.transliteration: juṣásva ǀ agne ǀ íḷayā ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ yátamānaḥ ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀjuṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ sam-ídham ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ devā́n ǀ haviḥ-ádyāya ǀ vakṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitiated,Agni, sharing in satisfaction with Iḷā, viewing with the rays of the sun; be gratified,Jātavedas, by our fuel, and bring the gods to partake of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जुष्टो॒ दमू॑ना॒ अति॑थिर्दुरो॒ण इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञमुप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान् । विश्वा॑ अग्ने अभि॒युजो॑ वि॒हत्या॑ शत्रूय॒तामा भ॑रा॒ भोज॑नानि
shlokas.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀvíśvā ǀ agne ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ vi-hátya ǀ śatru-yatā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ bhójanāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proppitiated, lowly-minded, a guest in the dwelling, come, you who are wise, to this our sacrifice; having destroyedAgni, all our adversaries, bring off the possessions of those who bear us enmity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒धेन॒ दस्युं॒ प्र हि चा॒तय॑स्व॒ वय॑: कृण्वा॒नस्त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ स्वायै॑ । पिप॑र्षि॒ यत्स॑हसस्पुत्र दे॒वान्त्सो अ॑ग्ने पाहि नृतम॒ वाजे॑ अ॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: vedhéna ǀ dásyum ǀ prá ǀ hí ǀ cātáyasva ǀ váyaḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ svā́yai ǀpíparṣi ǀ yát ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ devā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ pāhi ǀ nṛ-tama ǀ vā́je ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Demolish,Agni, with your weapon, theDasyu, appropriating the sustenance to your own person n; and inasmuch, son of strength, as you satisfy the gods, so do you, Agni, chief of leaders, protect us in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अग्न उ॒क्थैर्वि॑धेम व॒यं ह॒व्यैः पा॑वक भद्रशोचे । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रं॒ समि॑न्वा॒स्मे विश्वा॑नि॒ द्रवि॑णानि धेहि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ vayám ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ pāvaka ǀ bhadra-śoce ǀasmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ sám ǀ inva ǀ asmé íti ǀ víśvāni ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ dhehi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worship you,Agni, with hymns; we (worship you), purifier, and of auspicious lustre, with oblations; bestow upon us all desired riches; bestow upon us all sorts of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मग्ने अध्व॒रं जु॑षस्व॒ सह॑सः सूनो त्रिषधस्थ ह॒व्यम् । व॒यं दे॒वेषु॑ सु॒कृत॑: स्याम॒ शर्म॑णा नस्त्रि॒वरू॑थेन पाहि
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ agne ǀ adhvarám ǀ juṣasva ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ tri-sadhastha ǀ havyám ǀvayám ǀ devéṣu ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ syāma ǀ śármaṇā ǀ naḥ ǀ tri-várūthena ǀ pāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Agni, our sacrifice; son of strength, the abider in the three regions, (accept our) oblation; may we be (regarded) among the goddess doers of good; cherish us with triply-protected felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑नि नो दु॒र्गहा॑ जातवेद॒: सिन्धुं॒ न ना॒वा दु॑रि॒ताति॑ पर्षि । अग्ने॑ अत्रि॒वन्नम॑सा गृणा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽस्माकं॑ बोध्यवि॒ता त॒नूना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-gáhā ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ síndhum ǀ ná ǀ nāvā́ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀágne ǀ atri-vát ǀ námasā ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You convey us,Jātavedas, across all intolerable evils, as (people are carried) over a river by a boat;Agni, who are glorified by us with reverence, such as (that shown) byAtri, know yourself the protector of our person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वा॑ हृ॒दा की॒रिणा॒ मन्य॑मा॒नोऽम॑र्त्यं॒ मर्त्यो॒ जोह॑वीमि । जात॑वेदो॒ यशो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धेहि प्र॒जाभि॑रग्ने अमृत॒त्वम॑श्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ kīríṇā ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ jóhavīmi ǀjā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhehi ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ aśyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as I who am a mortal earnestly invoke you who are an immortal, praising you with a devoted heart; therefore,Jātavedas, grant us food, and may I obtain immortality through my posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वं सु॒कृते॑ जातवेद उ लो॒कम॑ग्ने कृ॒णव॑: स्यो॒नम् । अ॒श्विनं॒ स पु॒त्रिणं॑ वी॒रव॑न्तं॒ गोम॑न्तं र॒यिं न॑शते स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ agne ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ syonám ǀaśvínam ǀ sáḥ ǀ putríṇam ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ rayím ǀ naśate ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon whatsoever performer of good works you,Agni, who areJātavedas, cast a favourable regard, he enjoys welfare, and riches, comprehending horses, cattle, sons andmaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सुस॑मिद्धाय शो॒चिषे॑ घृ॒तं ती॒व्रं जु॑होतन । अ॒ग्नये॑ जा॒तवे॑दसे
shlokas.transliteration: sú-samiddhāya ǀ śocíṣe ǀ ghṛtám ǀ tīvrám ǀ juhotana ǀagnáye ǀ jātá-vedase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer abundant butter to the replendent Susamiddha, toAgni, toJātavedas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंस॑: सुषूदती॒मं य॒ज्ञमदा॑भ्यः । क॒विर्हि मधु॑हस्त्यः
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsaḥ ǀ susūdati ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀkavíḥ ǀ hí ǀ mádhu-hastyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Narāśaṃsa animates this sacrifice he who is uninjurable, who verily is wise and sweet-handed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळि॒तो अ॑ग्न॒ आ व॒हेन्द्रं॑ चि॒त्रमि॒ह प्रि॒यम् । सु॒खै रथे॑भिरू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: īḷitáḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ índram ǀ citrám ǀ ihá ǀ priyám ǀsu-kháiḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agno, who are Īḷita, bring hither the wonderful and friendlyIndra, with his easy going chariots for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊर्ण॑म्रदा॒ वि प्र॑थस्वा॒भ्य१॒॑र्का अ॑नूषत । भवा॑ नः शुभ्र सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ū́rṇa-mradāḥ ǀ ví ǀ prathasva ǀ abhí ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ śubhra ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Grass), soft aswool, be spread; the worshippers praise you; be to us radiant (grass the source of) liberality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: देवी॑र्द्वारो॒ वि श्र॑यध्वं सुप्राय॒णा न॑ ऊ॒तये॑ । प्रप्र॑ य॒ज्ञं पृ॑णीतन
shlokas.transliteration: dévīḥ ǀ dvāraḥ ǀ ví ǀ śrayadhvam ǀ supra-ayanā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀprá-pra ǀ yajñám ǀ pṛṇītana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Open divine doors, our passages to preservation; fill full the sacrifice (with its rewards).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्रती॑के वयो॒वृधा॑ य॒ह्वी ऋ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ । दो॒षामु॒षास॑मीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: suprátīke íti su-prátīke ǀ vayaḥ-vṛ́dhā ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātárā ǀdoṣā́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify the evening and the morning lovely, food-bestowing, mighty, the mothers of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वात॑स्य॒ पत्म॑न्नीळि॒ता दैव्या॒ होता॑रा॒ मनु॑षः । इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञमा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́tasya ǀ pátman ǀ īḷitā́ ǀ dáivyā ǀ hótārā ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀimám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised (by us), divine invokers of the gods, come moving on the path of the wind, to this sacrifice of our patron.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इळा॒ सर॑स्वती म॒ही ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्म॑यो॒भुव॑: । ब॒र्हिः सी॑दन्त्व॒स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: íḷā ǀ sárasvatī ǀ mahī́ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ asrídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Iḷā,Sarasvatī,Mahī, the three goddesses who are the sources of happiness, sit down, benevolent, upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शि॒वस्त्व॑ष्टरि॒हा ग॑हि वि॒भुः पोष॑ उ॒त त्मना॑ । य॒ज्ञेय॑ज्ञे न॒ उद॑व
shlokas.transliteration: śiváḥ ǀ tvaṣṭaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ vi-bhúḥ ǀ póṣe ǀ utá ǀ tmánā ǀyajñé-yajñe ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ ava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tvaṣṭā, being propitious, you who are diffusive in kindness, come to your own accord protect us in repeated sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ वेत्थ॑ वनस्पते दे॒वानां॒ गुह्या॒ नामा॑नि । तत्र॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ गामय
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ véttha ǀ vanaspate ǀ devā́nām ǀ gúhyā ǀ nā́māni ǀtátra ǀ havyā́ni ǀ gamaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wherever you know,Vanaspati, the secret forms of the gods to be, thither convey the oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वाहा॒ग्नये॒ वरु॑णाय॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: svā́hā ǀ agnáye ǀ váruṇāya ǀ svā́hā ǀ índrāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsvā́hā ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The oblation is offered with reverence toAgni, toVaruṇa; with reverence toIndra, to theMaruts; with reverence to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं तं म॑न्ये॒ यो वसु॒रस्तं॒ यं यन्ति॑ धे॒नव॑: । अस्त॒मर्व॑न्त आ॒शवोऽस्तं॒ नित्या॑सो वा॒जिन॒ इष॑न स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ tám ǀ manye ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ ástam ǀ yám ǀ yánti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀástam ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ ástam ǀ nítyāsaḥ ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify thatAgniwho is the giver of dwellings; to whom, as to their home, the kine, the light-faced steeds, the constant offers of oblations, repair; do you, (Agni), bring food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॒ग्निर्यो वसु॑र्गृ॒णे सं यमा॒यन्ति॑ धे॒नव॑: । समर्व॑न्तो रघु॒द्रुव॒: सं सु॑जा॒तास॑: सू॒रय॒ इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ gṛṇé ǀ sám ǀ yám ǀ ā-yánti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀsám ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ raghu-drúvaḥ ǀ sám ǀ su-jātā́saḥ ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He isAgni, who is praised as the giver of dwellings, to whom the kine, the light-faced steeds, the well-born, devout worshippers repair; do you Agni, bring food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्हि वा॒जिनं॑ वि॒शे ददा॑ति वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिः । अ॒ग्नी रा॒ये स्वा॒भुवं॒ स प्री॒तो या॑ति॒ वार्य॒मिषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hí ǀ vājínam ǀ viśé ǀ dádāti ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ su-ābhúvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ prītáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ vā́ryam ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the all-beholding, gives, verily, to the man (who worships him, a son) possessing abundant food; Agni, when propitiated proceeds (to bestow) that wealth which is of its own nature precious; do you, Agni, bring food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ अग्न इधीमहि द्यु॒मन्तं॑ देवा॒जर॑म् । यद्ध॒ स्या ते॒ पनी॑यसी स॒मिद्दी॒दय॑ति॒ द्यवीषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ idhīmahi ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ deva ǀ ajáram ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ syā́ ǀ te ǀ pánīyasī ǀ sam-ít ǀ dīdáyati ǀ dyávi ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We kindle you, divineAgni, bright, undecaying so that your glorious blaze shines in heaven; do you bring food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ अग्न ऋ॒चा ह॒विः शुक्र॑स्य शोचिषस्पते । सुश्च॑न्द्र॒ दस्म॒ विश्प॑ते॒ हव्य॑वा॒ट् तुभ्यं॑ हूयत॒ इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ śúkrasya ǀ śociṣaḥ ǀ pate ǀsú-candra ǀ dásma ǀ víśpate ǀ hávya-vāṭ ǀ túbhyam ǀ hūyate ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you, radiantAgni, lord of light, giver of plural asure, destroyer (of foes), protector of man, the bearer of oblations, to you the oblation is offered with the sacred verse; do you bring to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो त्ये अ॒ग्नयो॒ऽग्निषु॒ विश्वं॑ पुष्यन्ति॒ वार्य॑म् । ते हि॑न्विरे॒ त इ॑न्विरे॒ त इ॑षण्यन्त्यानु॒षगिषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ tyé ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ agníṣu ǀ víśvam ǀ puṣyanti ǀ vā́ryam ǀté ǀ hinvire ǀ té ǀ invire ǀ té ǀ iṣaṇyanti ǀ ānuṣák ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These fires cherish all that is precious in the fires (of sacrifice); they give delight; they spread abroad; they crave perpetually (sacrificial) food; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये अ॑ग्ने अ॒र्चयो॒ महि॑ व्राधन्त वा॒जिन॑: । ये पत्व॑भिः श॒फानां॑ व्र॒जा भु॒रन्त॒ गोना॒मिषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ agne ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vrādhanta ǀ vājínaḥ ǀyé ǀ pátva-bhiḥ ǀ śaphā́nām ǀ vrajā́ ǀ bhuránta ǀ gónām ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your flamesAgni, fed with abundant food, increase, as, by their descent, they seek the pastures of the hoofed cattle; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नवा॑ नो अग्न॒ आ भ॑र स्तो॒तृभ्य॑: सुक्षि॒तीरिष॑: । ते स्या॑म॒ य आ॑नृ॒चुस्त्वादू॑तासो॒ दमे॑दम॒ इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: návāḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ su-kṣitī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀté ǀ syāma ǀ yé ǀ ānṛcúḥ ǀ tvā́-dūtāsaḥ ǀ dáme-dame ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to us who praise you, new dwellings, and (abundant) food; may we be those who worship you having you for a messenger (to the gods) in every house; bring Agni, food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे सु॑श्चन्द्र स॒र्पिषो॒ दर्वी॑ श्रीणीष आ॒सनि॑ । उ॒तो न॒ उत्पु॑पूर्या उ॒क्थेषु॑ शवसस्पत॒ इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ su-candra ǀ sarpíṣaḥ ǀ dárvī íti ǀ śrīṇīṣe ǀ āsáni ǀutó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ pupūryāḥ ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of delight, you receive into your mouth the two ladles (full) of butter; so may you fulfil (our desires), lord of strength, at our solemn rites; bring,Agni, food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वाँ अ॒ग्निम॑जुर्यमुर्गी॒र्भिर्य॒ज्ञेभि॑रानु॒षक् । दध॑द॒स्मे सु॒वीर्य॑मु॒त त्यदा॒श्वश्व्य॒मिषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ agním ǀ ajuryamuḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀdádhat ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ utá ǀ tyát ǀ āśu-áśvyam ǀ íṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus have they repaired toAgniwith praises and with sacrifices successively, and have established (the manner of his worship); and he has given usmaledescendants, and wealth of fleet horses; bring, Agni, food to your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑य॒: सं व॑: स॒म्यञ्च॒मिषं॒ स्तोमं॑ चा॒ग्नये॑ । वर्षि॑ष्ठाय क्षिती॒नामू॒र्जो नप्त्रे॒ सह॑स्वते
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ vaḥ ǀ samyáñcam ǀ íṣam ǀ stómam ǀ ca ǀ agnáye ǀvárṣiṣṭhāya ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ náptre ǀ sáhasvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Friends, offer fitting praise and food toAgni, the most liberal benefactor of men, the powerful son of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुत्रा॑ चि॒द्यस्य॒ समृ॑तौ र॒ण्वा नरो॑ नृ॒षद॑ने । अर्ह॑न्तश्चि॒द्यमि॑न्ध॒ते सं॑ज॒नय॑न्ति ज॒न्तव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kútra ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ sám-ṛtau ǀ raṇvā́ḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ nṛ-sádane ǀárhantaḥ ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ indhaté ǀ sam-janáyanti ǀ jantávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where is (the deity) upon whose presence the rejoicing conductors (of the ceremony) are offering homage in the hall of sacrifice, (he) whom they kindle, and living beings genitive rate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यदि॒षो वना॑महे॒ सं ह॒व्या मानु॑षाणाम् । उ॒त द्यु॒म्नस्य॒ शव॑स ऋ॒तस्य॑ र॒श्मिमा द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vánāmahe ǀ sám ǀ havyā́ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀutá ǀ dyumnásya ǀ śávasā ǀ ṛtásya ǀ raśmím ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When we present to him (sacrificial food), when (he accepts) the oblations of men, then the power of the brilliant (viands), he assumes the radiance of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स स्मा॑ कृणोति के॒तुमा नक्तं॑ चिद्दू॒र आ स॒ते । पा॒व॒को यद्वन॒स्पती॒न्प्र स्मा॑ मि॒नात्य॒जर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sma ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ ketúm ǀ ā́ ǀ náktam ǀ cit ǀ dūré ǀ ā́ ǀ saté ǀpāvakáḥ ǀ yát ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ prá ǀ sma ǀ minā́ti ǀ ajáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily he gives a signal by night to one who is far off, when he, the purifier, the undecaying, consumes the forest lords.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ स्म॒ यस्य॒ वेष॑णे॒ स्वेदं॑ प॒थिषु॒ जुह्व॑ति । अ॒भीमह॒ स्वजे॑न्यं॒ भूमा॑ पृ॒ष्ठेव॑ रुरुहुः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ sma ǀ yásya ǀ véṣaṇe ǀ svédam ǀ pathíṣu ǀ júhvati ǀabhí ǀ īm ǀ áha ǀ svá-jenyam ǀ bhū́ma ǀ pṛṣṭhā́-iva ǀ ruruhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At whose worship (the priests) pour the dripping (butter) upon the flames, and (the drops) mount upon the fire as if they were its own numerous offspring, as (boys ride) upon the back (of a father).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं मर्त्य॑: पुरु॒स्पृहं॑ वि॒दद्विश्व॑स्य॒ धाय॑से । प्र स्वाद॑नं पितू॒नामस्त॑तातिं चिदा॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ vidát ǀ víśvasya ǀ dhā́yase ǀprá ǀ svā́danam ǀ pitūnā́m ǀ ásta-tātim ǀ cit ǀ āyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him who is the desired of many, the (devout) man recognizes as the sustainer of all, the flavour of food, the provider of dwellings for men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा॒ धन्वाक्षि॑तं॒ दाता॒ न दात्या प॒शुः । हिरि॑श्मश्रु॒: शुचि॑दन्नृ॒भुरनि॑भृष्टतविषिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ dhánva ǀ ā́-kṣitam ǀ dā́tā ǀ ná ǀ dā́ti ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúḥ ǀhíri-śmaśruḥ ǀ śúci-dan ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ ánibhṛṣṭa-taviṣiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He crops the dry ground strewn (with grass and wood), like an animal grazing; he with a golden beard, with shining teeth, vast, and of irresistible strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑: ष्म॒ यस्मा॑ अत्रि॒वत्प्र स्वधि॑तीव॒ रीय॑ते । सु॒षूर॑सूत मा॒ता क्रा॒णा यदा॑न॒शे भग॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ sma ǀ yásmai ǀ atri-vát ǀ prá ǀ svádhitiḥ-iva ǀ rī́yate ǀsu-sū́ḥ ǀ asūta ǀ mātā́ ǀ krāṇā́ ǀ yát ǀ ānaśé ǀ bhágam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright as an axe is he to whom the (worshipper), likeAtri, proceeds (to offer worship); he whom his prolific mother has brought forth, bestowing (a benefactor on the world), when (Agni) obtains (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्ते॑ सर्पिरासु॒तेऽग्ने॒ शमस्ति॒ धाय॑से । ऐषु॑ द्यु॒म्नमु॒त श्रव॒ आ चि॒त्तं मर्त्ये॑षु धाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sarpiḥ-āsute ǀ ágne ǀ śám ǀ ásti ǀ dhā́yase ǀā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ dyumnám ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cittám ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, the accepter of the oblation, the upholder (of all), there is plural asure (from our praise); do you bestow upon these your worshippers wealth, and food and a heart (grateful for your favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॑ चिन्म॒न्युम॒ध्रिज॒स्त्वादा॑त॒मा प॒शुं द॑दे । आद॑ग्ने॒ अपृ॑ण॒तोऽत्रि॑: सासह्या॒द्दस्यू॑नि॒षः सा॑सह्या॒न्नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ cit ǀ manyúm ǀ adhríjaḥ ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ dade ǀā́t ǀ agne ǀ ápṛṇataḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ sasahyāt ǀ dásyūn ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ sasahyāt ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sage who is in this manner the offerer of exclusive praise (Agni, to you), accept the cattle which are to be given to you; and thereupon mayAtriovercome (hostile) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्न ऋता॒यव॒: समी॑धिरे प्र॒त्नं प्र॒त्नास॑ ऊ॒तये॑ सहस्कृत । पु॒रु॒श्च॒न्द्रं य॑ज॒तं वि॒श्वधा॑यसं॒ दमू॑नसं गृ॒हप॑तिं॒ वरे॑ण्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ ṛta-yávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀ pratnám ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀpuru-candrám ǀ yajatám ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ dámūnasam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Manifest of strength,Agni, ancient worshippers have kindled you of old for their preservation; you, the delighter of many, the adorable, the all-sustaining, the lowly-minded, the lord of the house, the excellent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ अति॑थिं पू॒र्व्यं विश॑: शो॒चिष्के॑शं गृ॒हप॑तिं॒ नि षे॑दिरे । बृ॒हत्के॑तुं पुरु॒रूपं॑ धन॒स्पृतं॑ सु॒शर्मा॑णं॒ स्वव॑सं जर॒द्विष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ átithim ǀ pūrvyám ǀ víśaḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǀbṛhát-ketum ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ su-śármāṇam ǀ su-ávasam ǀ jarat-víṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have established you, (Agni), their ancient guest, as the lord of the house; (you), the blazing-haired, the vast bannered, the multiform, the dispenser of wealth, the bestower of happiness, the kind protector, the destruction of decaying (trees).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ मानु॑षीरीळते॒ विशो॑ होत्रा॒विदं॒ विवि॑चिं रत्न॒धात॑मम् । गुहा॒ सन्तं॑ सुभग वि॒श्वद॑र्शतं तुविष्व॒णसं॑ सु॒यजं॑ घृत॒श्रिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ víśaḥ ǀ hotrā-vídam ǀ vívicim ǀ ratna-dhā́tamam ǀgúhā ǀ sántam ǀ su-bhaga ǀ viśvá-darśatam ǀ tuvi-svanásam ǀ su-yájam ǀ ghṛta-śríyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Human beings glorify you,Agni, the appreciator burnt-offerings, the discriminator (of truth), the main liberal giver of precious (things), abiding (awhile), auspicious one, in secret, (at other times) visible to all, loud sounding, offering worship, thriving upon clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने धर्ण॒सिं वि॒श्वधा॑ व॒यं गी॒र्भिर्गृ॒णन्तो॒ नम॒सोप॑ सेदिम । स नो॑ जुषस्व समिधा॒नो अ॑ङ्गिरो दे॒वो मर्त॑स्य य॒शसा॑ सुदी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ dharṇasím ǀ viśvádhā ǀ vayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ úpa ǀ sedima ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ yaśásā ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We approach you, all-sustainingAgni, adoring you in many ways with hymns and with prostrations; do you,Aṅgiras, when kindled, be propitious to us; may the divine (Agni be plural ased) by the (sacrificial) food (offered by the) worshippers, and by the bright flames (of his sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने पुरु॒रूपो॑ वि॒शेवि॑शे॒ वयो॑ दधासि प्र॒त्नथा॑ पुरुष्टुत । पु॒रूण्यन्ना॒ सह॑सा॒ वि रा॑जसि॒ त्विषि॒: सा ते॑ तित्विषा॒णस्य॒ नाधृषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ puru-rū́paḥ ǀ viśé-viśe ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhāsi ǀ pratná-thā ǀ puru-stuta ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ ánnā ǀ sáhasā ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ tvíṣiḥ ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ titviṣāṇásya ǀ ná ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the praised of many, you who are multiform, giver of old food to every mortal; you reign with strength over the various (sacrificial) viands; the splendour of you when blazing brightly is not rivalled (by any).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने समिधा॒नं य॑विष्ठ्य दे॒वा दू॒तं च॑क्रिरे हव्य॒वाह॑नम् । उ॒रु॒ज्रय॑सं घृ॒तयो॑नि॒माहु॑तं त्वे॒षं चक्षु॑र्दधिरे चोद॒यन्म॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānám ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ cakrire ǀ havya-vā́hanam ǀuru-jráyasam ǀ ghṛtá-yonim ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ tveṣám ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ codayát-mati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, young (of the deities), the gods have made you, when kindled, their messenger, the bearer of oblations; you, who are rapid in movement, and of whom butter is the source, they have made, when invoked, the brilliant eye (of the universe), instrumental gated by the understanding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने प्र॒दिव॒ आहु॑तं घृ॒तैः सु॑म्ना॒यव॑: सुष॒मिधा॒ समी॑धिरे । स वा॑वृधा॒न ओष॑धीभिरुक्षि॒तो॒३॒॑ऽभि ज्रयां॑सि॒ पार्थि॑वा॒ वि ति॑ष्ठसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ su-samídhā ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀsáḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ ukṣitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient seekers after happiness hav ekindled you,Agni, when invoked, (and fed you) with abundant fuel; and you (thereby) increasing, and supplied with shrubs, are dominat over all terrestrial viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने ह॒विष्म॑न्तो दे॒वं मर्ता॑स ईळते । मन्ये॑ त्वा जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ स ह॒व्या व॑क्ष्यानु॒षक्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ īḷate ǀmánye ǀ tvā ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ sáḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mortals bearing oblations glorify you,Agni, the divine; I praise you,Jātavedas, for that you convey successively oblations (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॒ दास्व॑त॒: क्षय॑स्य वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । सं य॒ज्ञास॒श्चर॑न्ति॒ यं सं वाजा॑सः श्रव॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ dā́svataḥ ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀsám ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ yám ǀ sám ǀ vā́jāsaḥ ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, is the invoker of the gods (on behalf of) him, the donor (of the oblation), the abode (of the fruit of good works), by whom the sacred grass has been strewn; (he) in whom congregate all sacrifices securing food and fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्म॒ यं शिशुं॑ यथा॒ नवं॒ जनि॑ष्टा॒रणी॑ । ध॒र्तारं॒ मानु॑षीणां वि॒शाम॒ग्निं स्व॑ध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ yám ǀ śíśum ǀ yathā ǀ návam ǀ jániṣṭa ǀ aráṇī íti ǀdhartā́ram ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ viśā́m ǀ agním ǀ su-adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He (it is) whom the two sticks have engendered like a new-born babe; the supporter of men and descendants ofManu, the fit object of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्म॑ दुर्गृभीयसे पु॒त्रो न ह्वा॒र्याणा॑म् । पु॒रू यो दग्धासि॒ वनाग्ने॑ प॒शुर्न यव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ duḥ-gṛbhīyase ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ hvāryā́ṇām ǀpurú ǀ yáḥ ǀ dágdhā ǀ ási ǀ vánā ǀ ágne ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are laid hold of with difficulty like the young of tortuously-twining (snakes); you who are the consumer of many forests, as an animal is of fodder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्म॒ यस्या॒र्चय॑: स॒म्यक्सं॒यन्ति॑ धू॒मिन॑: । यदी॒मह॑ त्रि॒तो दि॒व्युप॒ ध्माते॑व॒ धम॑ति॒ शिशी॑ते ध्मा॒तरी॑ यथा
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ yásya ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ samyák ǀ sam-yánti ǀ dhūmínaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ áha ǀ tritáḥ ǀ diví ǀ úpa ǀ dhmā́tā-iva ǀ dhámati ǀ śíśīte ǀ dhmātári ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom smoke-emitting, the flames intensely collect; then, when diffused in the three regions,Agniinflates himself in the firmament, like the blower of a bellows, and sharpens (his flames), as (the fire blazes from the blast) of the blower.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवा॒हम॑ग्न ऊ॒तिभि॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॑ च॒ प्रश॑स्तिभिः । द्वे॒षो॒युतो॒ न दु॑रि॒ता तु॒र्याम॒ मर्त्या॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ agne ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ ca ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀdveṣaḥ-yútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ turyā́ma ǀ mártyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the protections of you,Agni, the friend (of all), and by our praises (of you), may we pass safe from the evil acts of men, as if from malignant (enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नो॑ अग्ने अ॒भी नरो॑ र॒यिं स॑हस्व॒ आ भ॑र । स क्षे॑पय॒त्स पो॑षय॒द्भुव॒द्वाज॑स्य सा॒तय॑ उ॒तैधि॑ पृ॒त्सु नो॑ वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ abhí ǀ náraḥ ǀ rayím ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀsáḥ ǀ kṣepayat ǀ sáḥ ǀ poṣayat ǀ bhúvat ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáye ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulAgni, bestow upon us the instrumental tutors (of pious rites), that wealth (which we desire); may he discomfit (our foes); may he cherish us; may he ever ready to bestow upon us food; and do you, Agni, be present in battles for our succesṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ ओजि॑ष्ठ॒मा भ॑र द्यु॒म्नम॒स्मभ्य॑मध्रिगो । प्र नो॑ रा॒या परी॑णसा॒ रत्सि॒ वाजा॑य॒ पन्था॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ dyumnám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ párīṇasā ǀ rátsi ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pánthām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, of irresistible prowess, bring to us most powerful treasure; (invest us) with surrounding wealth; mark out the paths to abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने अद्भुत॒ क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य मं॒हना॑ । त्वे अ॑सु॒र्य१॒॑मारु॑हत्क्रा॒णा मि॒त्रो न य॒ज्ञिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ adbhuta ǀ krátvā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀtvé íti ǀ asuryám ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀ krāṇā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MarvellousAgni, (gratified) by our acts, (produce) in us greatness of vigour; in you abides the strength destroying evil spirits; you who are to be worshipped likeMitra, are the doer (of great deeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्न एषां॒ गयं॑ पु॒ष्टिं च॑ वर्धय । ये स्तोमे॑भि॒: प्र सू॒रयो॒ नरो॑ म॒घान्या॑न॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ eṣām ǀ gáyam ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ca ǀ vardhaya ǀyé ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Augment,Agni, our dwelling and prosperity, for the devout men (who have propitiated you) by their praises have acquired riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॑ग्ने चन्द्र ते॒ गिर॑: शु॒म्भन्त्यश्व॑राधसः । शुष्मे॑भिः शु॒ष्मिणो॒ नरो॑ दि॒वश्चि॒द्येषां॑ बृ॒हत्सु॑की॒र्तिर्बोध॑ति॒ त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ agne ǀ candra ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhánti ǀ áśva-rādhasaḥ ǀśúṣmebhiḥ ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ yéṣām ǀ bṛhát ǀ su-kīrtíḥ ǀ bódhati ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DelightfulAgni, those men who glorify you with hymns become rich in horses, and are invigorated with (foe-destroying) energies; and their great renown, spread through the firmament arouses (you) of your own accord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये अ॑ग्ने अ॒र्चयो॒ भ्राज॑न्तो यन्ति धृष्णु॒या । परि॑ज्मानो॒ न वि॒द्युत॑: स्वा॒नो रथो॒ न वा॑ज॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ agne ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ bhrā́jantaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀpári-jmānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ svānáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your bright and fierce flames,Agni, spread around like the circumambient lightning, and are like a rattling chariot rushing (into battle) for booty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ अग्न ऊ॒तये॑ स॒बाध॑सश्च रा॒तये॑ । अ॒स्माका॑सश्च सू॒रयो॒ विश्वा॒ आशा॑स्तरी॒षणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ūtáye ǀ sa-bā́dhasaḥ ǀ ca ǀ rātáye ǀasmā́kāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ā́śāḥ ǀ tarīṣáṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be prompt,Agni, for our protection, and for the gift of poverty-repelling (riches); and may our pious descendants be able to compass all their desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने अङ्गिरः स्तु॒तः स्तवा॑न॒ आ भ॑र । होत॑र्विभ्वा॒सहं॑ र॒यिं: स्तो॒तृभ्य॒: स्तव॑से च न उ॒तैधि॑ पृ॒त्सु नो॑ वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀhótaḥ ǀ vibhva-sáham ǀ rayím ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ stávase ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who areAṅgiras, glorified in the past, glorified (at present), invoker (of the gods), bring unto us riches (enabling us) to overcome the mighty; give to your praisers (ability) to praise you, and be (athand) for our success in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जन॑स्य गो॒पा अ॑जनिष्ट॒ जागृ॑विर॒ग्निः सु॒दक्ष॑: सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से । घृ॒तप्र॑तीको बृह॒ता दि॑वि॒स्पृशा॑ द्यु॒मद्वि भा॑ति भर॒तेभ्य॒: शुचि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: jánasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ návyase ǀghṛtá-pratīkaḥ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ divi-spṛ́śā ǀ dyu-mát ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ bharatébhyaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vigilant, the powerfulAgni, the protector of man, has been engendered for the present prosperity (of the world); fed with butter, (blazing) with intense (radiance) reaching to the sky, the pure Agni shines brilliantly for theBharatas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रोहि॑तम॒ग्निं नर॑स्त्रिषध॒स्थे समी॑धिरे । इन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैः स॒रथं॒ स ब॒र्हिषि॒ सीद॒न्नि होता॑ य॒जथा॑य सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ prathamám ǀ puráḥ-hitam ǀ agním ǀ náraḥ ǀ tri-sadhasthé ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀíndreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ sáḥ ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sī́dat ǀ ní ǀ hótā ǀ yajáthāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests have first kindled, in three plural ces,Agni, the banner of sacrifice, the family priests, (riding) in the same car withIndraand the gods; he, the performer of pious acts, the invoker (of the gods), has sat down on the sacred grass for the (celebration of the) rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑म्मृष्टो जायसे मा॒त्रोः शुचि॑र्म॒न्द्रः क॒विरुद॑तिष्ठो वि॒वस्व॑तः । घृ॒तेन॑ त्वावर्धयन्नग्न आहुत धू॒मस्ते॑ के॒तुर॑भवद्दि॒वि श्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ásam-mṛṣṭaḥ ǀ jāyase ǀ mātróḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ út ǀ atiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀghṛténa ǀ tvā ǀ avardhayan ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǀ dhūmáḥ ǀ te ǀ ketúḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ diví ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are born unobstructed of two mothers; pure, adorable, wise, you have sprung up from (the devotion of) the householder; they have augmented you with butter;Agni, to whom burnt-offerings are made, the smoke is your banner spread abroad in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ य॒ज्ञमुप॑ वेतु साधु॒याग्निं नरो॒ वि भ॑रन्ते गृ॒हेगृ॑हे । अ॒ग्निर्दू॒तो अ॑भवद्धव्य॒वाह॑नो॒ऽग्निं वृ॑णा॒ना वृ॑णते क॒विक्र॑तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ úpa ǀ vetu ǀ sādhu-yā́ ǀ agním ǀ náraḥ ǀ ví ǀ bharante ǀ gṛhé-gṛhe ǀagníḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǀ agním ǀ vṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ vṛṇate ǀ kaví-kratum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the fulfiller (of all desires) come to our sacrifice; men cherish Agni in every dwelling; Agni, the bearer of oblations, has become the messenger (of the gods); those adoring Agni adore him as the accomplisher of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्ये॒दम॑ग्ने॒ मधु॑मत्तमं॒ वच॒स्तुभ्यं॑ मनी॒षा इ॒यम॑स्तु॒ शं हृ॒दे । त्वां गिर॒: सिन्धु॑मिवा॒वनी॑र्म॒हीरा पृ॑णन्ति॒ शव॑सा व॒र्धय॑न्ति च
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ idám ǀ agne ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ hṛdé ǀtvā́m ǀ gíraḥ ǀ síndhum-iva ǀ avánīḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇanti ǀ śávasā ǀ vardháyanti ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, this most sweet speech (is addressed) may this praise be gratification of your heart; pious hymns fill you, and augment you with vigour, as large rivers (replenish) the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गुहा॑ हि॒तमन्व॑विन्दञ्छिश्रिया॒णं वने॑वने । स जा॑यसे म॒थ्यमा॑न॒: सहो॑ म॒हत्त्वामा॑हु॒: सह॑सस्पु॒त्रम॑ङ्गिरः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ ánu ǀ avindan ǀ śiśriyāṇám ǀ váne-vane ǀsáḥ ǀ jāyase ǀ mathyámānaḥ ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ mahát ǀ tvā́m ǀ āhuḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ putrám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAṅgirasasdiscovered you,Agni, hidden in secret, and taking refuge from wood to wood; you are genitive rated, being churned with great force; therefore they have called you,Aṅgiras, the son of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राग्नये॑ बृह॒ते य॒ज्ञिया॑य ऋ॒तस्य॒ वृष्णे॒ असु॑राय॒ मन्म॑ । घृ॒तं न य॒ज्ञ आ॒स्ये॒३॒॑ सुपू॑तं॒ गिरं॑ भरे वृष॒भाय॑ प्रती॒चीम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ bṛhaté ǀ yajñíyāya ǀ ṛtásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ ásurāya ǀ mánma ǀghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ yajñé ǀ āsyé ǀ sú-pūtam ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ pratīcī́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer to the great, the adorableAgni, the rain of water, the vigorous, the showerer (of benefits), the present acceptable praise, like well-purified butter (poured) at sacrifices into his mouth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं चि॑कित्व ऋ॒तमिच्चि॑किद्ध्यृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॒ अनु॑ तृन्धि पू॒र्वीः । नाहं या॒तुं सह॑सा॒ न द्व॒येन॑ ऋ॒तं स॑पाम्यरु॒षस्य॒ वृष्ण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ cikiddhi ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ tṛndhi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀná ǀ ahám ǀ yātúm ǀ sáhasā ǀ ná ǀ dvayéna ǀ ṛtám ǀ sapāmi ǀ aruṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who know (the purpose of) the sacrifice, assent to this rite; be favourable to the copious showers of water; (endowed) with strength, (I undertake) not (to obstruct) sacred acts, nor adjure the rite with both (truth and untruth), but (repeate the praise) of the resplendent showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कया॑ नो अग्न ऋ॒तय॑न्नृ॒तेन॒ भुवो॒ नवे॑दा उ॒चथ॑स्य॒ नव्य॑: । वेदा॑ मे दे॒व ऋ॑तु॒पा ऋ॑तू॒नां नाहं पतिं॑ सनि॒तुर॒स्य रा॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ṛtáyan ǀ ṛténa ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ návedāḥ ǀ ucáthasya ǀ návyaḥ ǀvéda ǀ me ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtu-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛtūnā́m ǀ ná ǀ ahám ǀ pátim ǀ sanitúḥ ǀ asyá ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, bestower of water, by what (act of) truth may you, who are adorable, be cognizant of our adoration; may the divine Agni, the guardian of the seasons, recognize me; (I know) him not (yet) as the lord of the riches of which I am the possessor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के ते॑ अग्ने रि॒पवे॒ बन्ध॑नास॒: के पा॒यव॑: सनिषन्त द्यु॒मन्त॑: । के धा॒सिम॑ग्ने॒ अनृ॑तस्य पान्ति॒ क आस॑तो॒ वच॑सः सन्ति गो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ripáve ǀ bándhanāsaḥ ǀ ké ǀ pāyávaḥ ǀ saniṣanta ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǀké ǀ dhāsím ǀ agne ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ pānti ǀ ké ǀ ásataḥ ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ santi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who,Agni, among your (followers) are the imprisoners of foes? who among them are the protectors (of men) the splendid distributors of gifts? who among them defend the asserters of untruth? who are the encouragers of evil deeds?”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑यस्ते॒ विषु॑णा अग्न ए॒ते शि॒वास॒: सन्तो॒ अशि॑वा अभूवन् । अधू॑र्षत स्व॒यमे॒ते वचो॑भिॠजूय॒ते वृ॑जि॒नानि॑ ब्रु॒वन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ te ǀ víṣuṇāḥ ǀ agne ǀ eté ǀ śivā́saḥ ǀ sántaḥ ǀ áśivāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀádhūrṣata ǀ svayám ǀ eté ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ṛju-yaté ǀ vṛjinā́ni ǀ bruvántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your friends,Agni, everywhere dispersed, were formerly unhappy (in abandoning your worship), but are again fortunate (by its renewal); may they who, with (censorious) words, impute fraudulent (practices) to me who pursue a straight path, bring eveil upon themselves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ अग्ने॒ नम॑सा य॒ज्ञमीट्ट॑ ऋ॒तं स पा॑त्यरु॒षस्य॒ वृष्ण॑: । तस्य॒ क्षय॑: पृ॒थुरा सा॒धुरे॑तु प्र॒सर्स्रा॑णस्य॒ नहु॑षस्य॒ शेष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ námasā ǀ yajñám ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǀ ṛtám ǀ sáḥ ǀ pāti ǀ aruṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀtásya ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ etu ǀ pra-sársrāṇasya ǀ náhuṣasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the dwelling of him,Agni, who celebrate your worship with reverence, of him who protects the sacrifice (offered) to the resplendent showerer (of benefits), be well stored; and may a virtuous successor of the man who diligently worships you come in his plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्च॑न्तस्त्वा हवाम॒हेऽर्च॑न्त॒: समि॑धीमहि । अग्ने॒ अर्च॑न्त ऊ॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: árcantaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀágne ǀ árcantaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adoring you,Agni, we invoke you, adoring you we kindle you, adoring you for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेः स्तोमं॑ मनामहे सि॒ध्रम॒द्य दि॑वि॒स्पृश॑: । दे॒वस्य॑ द्रविण॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ stómam ǀ manāmahe ǀ sidhrám ǀ adyá ǀ divi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀdevásya ǀ draviṇasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of wealth, we recite today the effectual praise of the divineAgni, (whose radiance) reaches the sky. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्जु॑षत नो॒ गिरो॒ होता॒ यो मानु॑षे॒ष्वा । स य॑क्ष॒द्दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ juṣata ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ hótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, who among men is the invoker of the gods, accept our praises; may he offer sacrifice to the divine beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने स॒प्रथा॑ असि॒ जुष्टो॒ होता॒ वरे॑ण्यः । त्वया॑ य॒ज्ञं वि त॑न्वते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀ asi ǀ júṣṭaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀtváyā ǀ yajñám ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are mighty and gracious, the (ministrant) priest, the desired (of all) through your worshippers complete the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने वाज॒सात॑मं॒ विप्रा॑ वर्धन्ति॒ सुष्टु॑तम् । स नो॑ रास्व सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ vāja-sā́tamam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ sú-stutam ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise worshippers exalt you,Agni, the bountiful giver of food, the deservedly lauded; do you bestow upon us excellent strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ ने॒मिर॒राँ इ॑व दे॒वाँस्त्वं प॑रि॒भूर॑सि । आ राध॑श्चि॒त्रमृ॑ञ्जसे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ nemíḥ ǀ arā́n-iva ǀ devā́n ǀ tvám ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀā́ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ citrám ǀ ṛñjase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you encompass the gods as the circumference (surrounds) the spokes (of a wheel); bestow manifold wealth upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं स्तोमे॑न बोधय समिधा॒नो अम॑र्त्यम् । ह॒व्या दे॒वेषु॑ नो दधत्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ stómena ǀ bodhaya ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀhavyā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ dadhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waken the immortalAgniwith praise, that, being kindled, he may bear our oblations to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ध्व॒रेष्वी॑ळते दे॒वं मर्ता॒ अम॑र्त्यम् । यजि॑ष्ठं॒ मानु॑षे॒ जने॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ īḷate ǀ devám ǀ mártāḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀyájiṣṭham ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mortals worship him, an immortal divinity, at their sacrifices, most adorable among the human race.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं हि शश्व॑न्त॒ ईळ॑ते स्रु॒चा दे॒वं घृ॑त॒श्चुता॑ । अ॒ग्निं ह॒व्याय॒ वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ hí ǀ śáśvantaḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ srucā́ ǀ devám ǀ ghṛta-ścútā ǀagním ǀ havyā́ya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Numerous (worshippers), pouring out butter from the (sacrificial) ladle, glorify him the divineAgni, that he may convey their oblation (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्जा॒तो अ॑रोचत॒ घ्नन्दस्यू॒ञ्ज्योति॑षा॒ तम॑: । अवि॑न्द॒द्गा अ॒पः स्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ arocata ǀ ghnán ǀ dásyūn ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀávindat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, as soon as born, blazes brightly, destroying thedasyus, and (dispersing) the darkness by his lustre; he has discovered the cows, the waters, the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमी॒ळेन्यं॑ क॒विं घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठं सपर्यत । वेतु॑ मे शृ॒णव॒द्धव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷényam ǀ kavím ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ saparyata ǀvétu ǀ me ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship the adorableAgni, the sage, whose summit blazes with butter; may he hear and comprehend my invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं घृ॒तेन॑ वावृधु॒: स्तोमे॑भिर्वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिम् । स्वा॒धीभि॑र्वच॒स्युभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ ghṛténa ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǀsu-ādhī́bhiḥ ǀ vacasyú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have augmented,Agni, the beholder of all, with oblations and with praises, along with the gods, the objects of pious meditation, desirous of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वे॒धसे॑ क॒वये॒ वेद्या॑य॒ गिरं॑ भरे य॒शसे॑ पू॒र्व्याय॑ । घृ॒तप्र॑सत्तो॒ असु॑रः सु॒शेवो॑ रा॒यो ध॒र्ता ध॒रुणो॒ वस्वो॑ अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vedháse ǀ kaváye ǀ védyāya ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ yaśáse ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀghṛtá-prasattaḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer praise toAgni, the creator, the far-seeing, the adorable, the renowned, the first (of the gods); he who is propitiated by oblations, the strong, the giver of happiness, the possessor of riches, the receiver of oblations, the bestower of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॑ ऋ॒तं ध॒रुणं॑ धारयन्त य॒ज्ञस्य॑ शा॒के प॑र॒मे व्यो॑मन् । दि॒वो धर्म॑न्ध॒रुणे॑ से॒दुषो॒ नॄञ्जा॒तैरजा॑ताँ अ॒भि ये न॑न॒क्षुः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ṛtám ǀ dharúṇam ǀ dhārayanta ǀ yajñásya ǀ śāké ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀdiváḥ ǀ dhárman ǀ dharúṇe ǀ sedúṣaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ jātáiḥ ǀ ájātān ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ nanakṣúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are detaining by sacrifice the true recipient (of offerings) in the most eminent plural ce of the ceremony, who brings together the leaders (of the rite), the unborn with the born, (or gods and men), as seated at the solemnity which is the stay of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ङ्हो॒युव॑स्त॒न्व॑स्तन्वते॒ वि वयो॑ म॒हद्दु॒ष्टरं॑ पू॒र्व्याय॑ । स सं॒वतो॒ नव॑जातस्तुतुर्यात्सि॒ङ्हं न क्रु॒द्धम॒भित॒: परि॑ ष्ठुः
shlokas.transliteration: aṃhaḥ-yúvaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ tanvate ǀ ví ǀ váyaḥ ǀ mahát ǀ dustáram ǀ pūrvyā́ya ǀsáḥ ǀ sam-vátaḥ ǀ náva-jātaḥ ǀ tuturyāt ǀ siṃhám ǀ ná ǀ kruddhám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who (present) to the chief (of the gods) the great food (of sacrifice), unattainable (by therākṣasas), enjoy forms exempt from defect; may that new-bornAgniscatter assembled (hosts); let them stand from around me as (deer avoid) an angry lion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒तेव॒ यद्भर॑से पप्रथा॒नो जनं॑जनं॒ धाय॑से॒ चक्ष॑से च । वयो॑वयो जरसे॒ यद्दधा॑न॒: परि॒ त्मना॒ विषु॑रूपो जिगासि
shlokas.transliteration: mātā́-iva ǀ yát ǀ bhárase ǀ paprathānáḥ ǀ jánam-janam ǀ dhā́yase ǀ cákṣase ǀ ca ǀváyaḥ-vayaḥ ǀ jarase ǀ yát ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ tmánā ǀ víṣu-rūpaḥ ǀ jigāsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, everywhere predominating, you cherish all men like a mother, and (are implored by all) to behold and to support them; and when, being detained, you mature every kind of food, then, multiform (Agni), you comprise (all beings) in yourself.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाजो॒ नु ते॒ शव॑सस्पा॒त्वन्त॑मु॒रुं दोघं॑ ध॒रुणं॑ देव रा॒यः । प॒दं न ता॒युर्गुहा॒ दधा॑नो म॒हो रा॒ये चि॒तय॒न्नत्रि॑मस्पः
shlokas.transliteration: vā́jaḥ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ pātu ǀ ántam ǀ urúm ǀ dógham ǀ dharúṇam ǀ deva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀpadám ǀ ná ǀ tāyúḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ citáyan ǀ átrim ǀ asparítyaspaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine,Agni, may the (sacrificial) food, the vast yielder (of benefits to men), the sustainer of riches, support the utmost of your vigour; and do you considering (the means of acquiring) great riches, like a thief keeping concealed the article (he has stolen), be propitious toAtri.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हद्वयो॒ हि भा॒नवेऽर्चा॑ दे॒वाया॒ग्नये॑ । यं मि॒त्रं न प्रश॑स्तिभि॒र्मर्ता॑सो दधि॒रे पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhānáve ǀ árca ǀ devā́ya ǀ agnáye ǀyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer abundant (sacrificial) food to the brilliant divineAgni, whom mortals have plural ced before them by praises as a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि द्युभि॒र्जना॑नां॒ होता॒ दक्ष॑स्य बा॒ह्वोः । वि ह॒व्यम॒ग्निरा॑नु॒षग्भगो॒ न वार॑मृण्वति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ hótā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀví ǀ havyám ǀ agníḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ram ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For thatAgni, (endowed) with the lustre of the strength of his arms, is the ministrant priest of mortals, who (presents) the oblation to the gods in succession, and likeBhagadistributes desirable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य स्तोमे॑ म॒घोन॑: स॒ख्ये वृ॒द्धशो॑चिषः । विश्वा॒ यस्मि॑न्तुवि॒ष्वणि॒ सम॒र्ये शुष्म॑माद॒धुः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ stóme ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ vṛddhá-śociṣaḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ yásmin ǀ tuvi-sváni ǀ sám ǀ aryé ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā-dadhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(May we be assiduous) in the praise, (and cherished) in the friendship of that very radiant possessor of wealth, on whom, loud-sounding and all-ruling, (his) universal (worshippers) have conferred vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ ह्य॑ग्न एषां सु॒वीर्य॑स्य मं॒हना॑ । तमिद्य॒ह्वं न रोद॑सी॒ परि॒ श्रवो॑ बभूवतुः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ eṣām ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ yahvám ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pári ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ babhūvatuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now verily,Agni, (be disposed) for bestowing excellent strength on these (your worshippers); heaven and earth have invested him with glory like the vast (sun).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू न॒ एहि॒ वार्य॒मग्ने॑ गृणा॒न आ भ॑र । ये व॒यं ये च॑ सू॒रय॑: स्व॒स्ति धाम॑हे॒ सचो॒तैधि॑ पृ॒त्सु नो॑ वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ vā́ryam ǀ ágne ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀyé ǀ vayám ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ dhā́mahe ǀ sácā ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified by us,Agni, come quickly, and bring us desirable wealth; we who (are your worshippers) we (who are your) adorers, offer you welcome together with oblations; be you favourable to us; be (our) success in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ य॒ज्ञैर्दे॑व॒ मर्त्य॑ इ॒त्था तव्यां॑समू॒तये॑ । अ॒ग्निं कृ॒ते स्व॑ध्व॒रे पू॒रुरी॑ळी॒ताव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ deva ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ távyāṃsam ǀ ūtáye ǀagním ǀ kṛté ǀ su-adhvaré ǀ pūrúḥ ǀ īḷīta ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, a mortal thus with sacrifices (calls upon you) who are endowed with lustre for protection;Puruadores Agni for protection when the sacred rite is solemnized.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॒ हि स्वय॑शस्तर आ॒सा वि॑धर्म॒न्मन्य॑से । तं नाकं॑ चि॒त्रशो॑चिषं म॒न्द्रं प॒रो म॑नी॒षया॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ hí ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taraḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ vi-dharman ǀ mányase ǀtám ǀ nā́kam ǀ citrá-śociṣam ǀ mandrám ǀ paráḥ ǀ manīṣáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performer of various functions, who are deservedly renowned, you praise by your words thatAgni, who is possessed of wonderful splendour, who is exempt from pain, who is adorable and supreme in understanding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य वासा उ॑ अ॒र्चिषा॒ य आयु॑क्त तु॒जा गि॒रा । दि॒वो न यस्य॒ रेत॑सा बृ॒हच्छोच॑न्त्य॒र्चय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ vái ǀ asáu ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ arcíṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ áyukta ǀ tujā́ ǀ girā́ ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ rétasā ǀ bṛhát ǀ śócanti ǀ arcáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is endowed with vigour, is (glorified) by praise, and by whose radiance, like that of the sky, the rays of light shine brightly; by his lustre, verily, (the sun is luminous).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य क्रत्वा॒ विचे॑तसो द॒स्मस्य॒ वसु॒ रथ॒ आ । अधा॒ विश्वा॑सु॒ हव्यो॒ऽग्निर्वि॒क्षु प्र श॑स्यते
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ krátvā ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǀ dasmásya ǀ vásu ǀ ráthe ǀ ā́ ǀádha ǀ víśvāsu ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ prá ǀ śasyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the worship of him who is plural asing of aspect, the provident (heap) wealth in their cars;Agni, to whom oblations are due, is then glorified by all people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू न॒ इद्धि वार्य॑मा॒सा स॑चन्त सू॒रय॑: । ऊर्जो॑ नपाद॒भिष्ट॑ये पा॒हि श॒ग्धि स्व॒स्तय॑ उ॒तैधि॑ पृ॒त्सु नो॑ वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ vā́ryam ǀ āsā́ ǀ sacanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ pāhí ǀ śagdhí ǀ svastáye ǀ utá ǀ edhi ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly, (Agni, give us) desirable (wealth), such as the devout, combining with (pious) praise, (obtain); son of strength (be favourable) to (my) desires; protect us (from calamity); be alert for our prosperity; come for our success in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तर॒ग्निः पु॑रुप्रि॒यो वि॒शः स्त॑वे॒ताति॑थिः । विश्वा॑नि॒ यो अम॑र्त्यो ह॒व्या मर्ते॑षु॒ रण्य॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-priyáḥ ǀ viśáḥ ǀ staveta ǀ átithiḥ ǀvíśvāni ǀ yáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ márteṣu ǀ ráṇyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetAgni, the beloved of many, the guest of man, be present at dawn; he who, immortal, desires the oblations of mortalṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वि॒ताय॑ मृ॒क्तवा॑हसे॒ स्वस्य॒ दक्ष॑स्य मं॒हना॑ । इन्द॒ि स ध॑त्त आनु॒षक्स्तो॒ता चि॑त्ते अमर्त्य
shlokas.transliteration: dvitā́ya ǀ mṛktá-vāhase ǀ svásya ǀ dákṣasya ǀ maṃhánā ǀíndum ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ ānuṣák ǀ stotā́ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ amartya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be (willing to make) a grant of your own strength toDvita, the bearer of the pure oblations; for he, immortalAgni, your diligent praiser, brings to you continually theSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वो॑ दी॒र्घायु॑शोचिषं गि॒रा हु॑वे म॒घोना॑म् । अरि॑ष्टो॒ येषां॒ रथो॒ व्य॑श्वदाव॒न्नीय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dīrghā́yu-śociṣam ǀ girā́ ǀ huve ǀ maghónām ǀáriṣṭaḥ ǀ yéṣām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśva-dāvan ǀ ī́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you bright-shining, through a long life, with praise, (for the benefit) of the affluent, that their chariot, giver of horses, may proceed unimpeded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रा वा॒ येषु॒ दीधि॑तिरा॒सन्नु॒क्था पान्ति॒ ये । स्ती॒र्णं ब॒र्हिः स्व॑र्णरे॒ श्रवां॑सि दधिरे॒ परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: citrā́ ǀ vā ǀ yéṣu ǀ dī́dhitiḥ ǀ āsán ǀ ukthā́ ǀ pā́nti ǀ yé ǀstīrṇám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sváḥ-nare ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dadhire ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Among whom the ceremonial of many kinds is observed; who perpetuate the sacred hymns by their recital; by them the sacrificial viands are plural ced upon the strewn grass (at the sacrifice which) leads (the worshipper) to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये मे॑ पञ्चा॒शतं॑ द॒दुरश्वा॑नां स॒धस्तु॑ति । द्यु॒मद॑ग्ने॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्कृ॑धि म॒घोनां॑ नृ॒वद॑मृत नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ me ǀ pañcāśátam ǀ dadúḥ ǀ áśvānām ǀ sadhá-stuti ǀdyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ kṛdhi ǀ maghónām ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ amṛta ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImmortalAgni, bestow upon those opulent men, who, upon (my) praise (of you), gave to me fifty horses, and brilliang, ample, and abundant food, (supporting numerous) dependants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑व॒स्थाः प्र जा॑यन्ते॒ प्र व॒व्रेर्व॒व्रिश्चि॑केत । उ॒पस्थे॑ मा॒तुर्वि च॑ष्टे
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ ava-sthā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ jāyante ǀ prá ǀ vavréḥ ǀ vavríḥ ǀ ciketa ǀupá-sthe ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unprosperous circumstances affect Vavri; may the accepter (of oblations) become cognizant (of them), as, reclining on the lap of his mother, he beholds all things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒हु॒रे वि चि॒तय॒न्तोऽनि॑मिषं नृ॒म्णं पा॑न्ति । आ दृ॒ळ्हां पुरं॑ विविशुः
shlokas.transliteration: juhuré ǀ ví ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ áni-miṣam ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ pānti ǀā́ ǀ dṛḷhā́m ǀ púram ǀ viviśuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who know (your power) invoke you incessantly and nourish (your) strength (by oblations); they dwell in an impregnable city.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ श्वै॑त्रे॒यस्य॑ ज॒न्तवो॑ द्यु॒मद्व॑र्धन्त कृ॒ष्टय॑: । नि॒ष्कग्री॑वो बृ॒हदु॑क्थ ए॒ना मध्वा॒ न वा॑ज॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śvaitreyásya ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ dyu-mát ǀ vardhanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀniṣká-grīvaḥ ǀ bṛhát-ukthaḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ mádhvā ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Living men, with collars of gold, earnest in praise, desirous of food, augment by this laudation the vigour of you abiding in the white firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒यं दु॒ग्धं न काम्य॒मजा॑मि जा॒म्योः सचा॑ । घ॒र्मो न वाज॑जठ॒रोऽद॑ब्ध॒: शश्व॑तो॒ दभ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: priyám ǀ dugdhám ǀ ná ǀ kā́myam ǀ ájāmi ǀ jāmyóḥ ǀ sácā ǀgharmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ja-jaṭharaḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ dábhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (Agni) with his two relatives, (heaven and earth), hear this faultless (praise), acceptable as milk; he who, like the mixed oblation, is filled with food, and unsubsdued, is ever the subduer of his foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रीळ॑न्नो रश्म॒ आ भु॑व॒: सं भस्म॑ना वा॒युना॒ वेवि॑दानः । ता अ॑स्य सन्धृ॒षजो॒ न ति॒ग्माः सुसं॑शिता व॒क्ष्यो॑ वक्षणे॒स्थाः
shlokas.transliteration: krī́ḷan ǀ naḥ ǀ raśme ǀ ā́ ǀ bhuvaḥ ǀ sám ǀ bhásmanā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ vévidānaḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ san ǀ dhṛṣájaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tigmā́ḥ ǀ sú-saṃśitāḥ ǀ vakṣyáḥ ǀ vakṣaṇe-sthā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant (Agni), who are made manifest by the wind and are sporting amidst theashes(of the forest), be present with us; and may the fierce fiery flames, destructive of foes, be genitive le to this your worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने वाजसातम॒ त्वं चि॒न्मन्य॑से र॒यिम् । तं नो॑ गी॒र्भिः श्र॒वाय्यं॑ देव॒त्रा प॑नया॒ युज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ agne ǀ vāja-sātama ǀ tvám ǀ cit ǀ mányase ǀ rayím ǀtám ǀ naḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ śravā́yyam ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ panaya ǀ yújam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That (sacrificial) wealth,Agni, bounteous giver of food, of which you approve, and which deserves to be commanded by our praises, do you convey to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॑ग्ने॒ नेरय॑न्ति ते वृ॒द्धा उ॒ग्रस्य॒ शव॑सः । अप॒ द्वेषो॒ अप॒ ह्वरो॒ऽन्यव्र॑तस्य सश्चिरे
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ agne ǀ ná ǀ īráyanti ǀ te ǀ vṛddhā́ḥ ǀ ugrásya ǀ śávasaḥ ǀápa ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ hváraḥ ǀ anyá-vratasya ǀ saścire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “may those prosperous men who do not offer oblations to you become destitute of great strength, and may (the followers) of other (thanVaidika) observances incur (your) enmity and punishment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑रं त्वा वृणीम॒हेऽग्ने॒ दक्ष॑स्य॒ साध॑नम् । य॒ज्ञेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यं गि॒रा प्रय॑स्वन्तो हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: hótāram ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ ágne ǀ dákṣasya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀyajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀ girā́ ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, Prayasvats, have recourse to you, the invoker (of the gods), the means of strength; we glorify you first at sacrifices with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒त्था यथा॑ त ऊ॒तये॒ सह॑सावन्दि॒वेदि॑वे । रा॒य ऋ॒ताय॑ सुक्रतो॒ गोभि॑: ष्याम सध॒मादो॑ वी॒रैः स्या॑म सध॒माद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: itthā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ te ǀ ūtáye ǀ sáhasā-van ǀ divé-dive ǀrāyé ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ syāma ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ syāma ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of strength, day by day so (provide) that we may enjoy your protection; doer of good deeds, may we (be deserving) of wealth through sacrifice, and may we be happy with cattle, happy withmaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒नु॒ष्वत्त्वा॒ नि धी॑महि मनु॒ष्वत्समि॑धीमहि । अग्ने॑ मनु॒ष्वद॑ङ्गिरो दे॒वान्दे॑वय॒ते य॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: manuṣvát ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ dhīmahi ǀ manuṣvát ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀágne ǀ manuṣvát ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LikeManu, we meditate,Agni, upon you; like Manu, we kindle you; worship the gods on behalf of the (worshipper), devout as Manu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि मानु॑षे॒ जनेऽग्ने॒ सुप्री॑त इ॒ध्यसे॑ । स्रुच॑स्त्वा यन्त्यानु॒षक्सुजा॑त॒ सर्पि॑रासुते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǀ ágne ǀ sú-prītaḥ ǀ idhyáse ǀsrúcaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ yanti ǀ ānuṣák ǀ sú-jāta ǀ sárpiḥ-āsute ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you are plural ased,Agni, you shine upon the human race; well-born, feeder upon clarified butter, the ladles are constantly uplifted to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे॑ स॒जोष॑सो दे॒वासो॑ दू॒तम॑क्रत । स॒प॒र्यन्त॑स्त्वा कवे य॒ज्ञेषु॑ दे॒वमी॑ळते
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ akrata ǀsaparyántaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ devám ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the consentient divinities have made you their messenger; therefore the pious worship you who are divine, wiseAgni, at sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वं वो॑ देवय॒ज्यया॒ग्निमी॑ळीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । समि॑द्धः शुक्र दीदिह्यृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मास॑दः स॒सस्य॒ योनि॒मास॑दः
shlokas.transliteration: devám ǀ vaḥ ǀ deva-yajyáyā ǀ agním ǀ īḷīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀsám-iddhaḥ ǀ śukra ǀ dīdihi ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǀ sasásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Man praises you, divineAgni, to convey his offerings to the gods; bright Agni, blaze when kindled; take your seat in the chamber (of sacrifice), in the chamber of the sincereSasa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वि॑श्वसामन्नत्रि॒वदर्चा॑ पाव॒कशो॑चिषे । यो अ॑ध्व॒रेष्वीड्यो॒ होता॑ म॒न्द्रत॑मो वि॒शि
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ viśva-sāman ǀ atri-vát ǀ árca ǀ pāvaká-śociṣe ǀyáḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ mandrá-tamaḥ ǀ viśí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing, Viśvasāman, likeAtri, (a hymn) to the dispenser of purifying light; (to him) who is to be praised at sacrifices, the invoker of the gods, the most adorable by man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य१॒॑ग्निं जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ दधा॑ता दे॒वमृ॒त्विज॑म् । प्र य॒ज्ञ ए॑त्वानु॒षग॒द्या दे॒वव्य॑चस्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ agním ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ dádhāta ǀ devám ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀprá ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ etu ǀ ānuṣák ǀ adyá ǀ devávyacaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cherish the divineAgni, by whom all that exists is known, the priest (of the rite); may the sacrifice most suitable for the gods duly this day proceed to them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒कि॒त्विन्म॑नसं त्वा दे॒वं मर्ता॑स ऊ॒तये॑ । वरे॑ण्यस्य॒ तेऽव॑स इया॒नासो॑ अमन्महि
shlokas.transliteration: cikitvít-manasam ǀ tvā ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀváreṇyasya ǀ te ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ iyānā́saḥ ǀ amanmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have recourse to you, divineAgni, who are of intelligent mind, for security; we praise you who are most excellent, seeking your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ चिकि॒द्ध्य१॒॑स्य न॑ इ॒दं वच॑: सहस्य । तं त्वा॑ सुशिप्र दम्पते॒ स्तोमै॑र्वर्ध॒न्त्यत्र॑यो गी॒र्भिः शु॑म्भ॒न्त्यत्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ cikiddhí ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ sahasya ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ su-śipra ǀ dam-pate ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ átrayaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ śumbhanti ǀ átrayaḥ ǁ
