shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, recognize the words of this our (laudation); handsome-chinned, lord of the dwelling, the sons ofAtriexalt you, such (as you are), by thei rpraise; they embellish you by their hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ सह॑न्त॒मा भ॑र द्यु॒म्नस्य॑ प्रा॒सहा॑ र॒यिम् । विश्वा॒ यश्च॑र्ष॒णीर॒भ्या॒३॒॑सा वाजे॑षु सा॒सह॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ sáhantam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ dyumnásya ǀ pra-sáhā ǀ rayím ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ āsā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ sasáhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow,Agni, uponDyumna, a son, overcoming foes by his prowess; one who may with glory subdue all men in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ग्ने पृतना॒षहं॑ र॒यिं स॑हस्व॒ आ भ॑र । त्वं हि स॒त्यो अद्भु॑तो दा॒ता वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ agne ǀ pṛtanā-sáham ǀ rayím ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ satyáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ dātā́ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyAgni, grant us a son able to encounter hosts; for you are true and wonderful, and the giver of food with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ हि त्वा॑ स॒जोष॑सो॒ जना॑सो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । होता॑रं॒ सद्म॑सु प्रि॒यं व्यन्ति॒ वार्या॑ पु॒रु
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀhótāram ǀ sádma-su ǀ priyám ǀ vyánti ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Allmen concurring in satisfaction, bearing the clipped sacred grass, solicit you, as the kind invoker of the gods, to the chambers (of sacrifice) for infinite wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर॒भिमा॑ति॒ सहो॑ द॒धे । अग्न॑ ए॒षु क्षये॒ष्वा रे॒वन्न॑: शुक्र दीदिहि द्यु॒मत्पा॑वक दीदिहि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ abhí-māti ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ dadhé ǀágne ǀ eṣú ǀ kṣáyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ revát ǀ naḥ ǀ śukra ǀ dīdihi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the (sage) on whom all men rely possess foe-subduing strength; radiantAgni, so shine in our habitation that they may abound in riches; shine, purifying Agni, dispensing light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वं नो॒ अन्त॑म उ॒त त्रा॒ता शि॒वो भ॑वा वरू॒थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀ utá ǀ trātā́ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ bhava ǀ varūthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[1-2]Agni, who are to be adored, be ever nigh to us, our protector and benefactor; do you, who are the giver of dwellings and dispenser of food, be present with us; bestow upon us most brilliant wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसु॑र॒ग्निर्वसु॑श्रवा॒ अच्छा॑ नक्षि द्यु॒मत्त॑मं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vásuḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vásu-śravāḥ ǀ áccha ǀ nakṣi ǀ dyumát-tamam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ बोधि श्रु॒धी हव॑मुरु॒ष्या णो॑ अघाय॒तः स॑मस्मात्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ uruṣyá ǀ naḥ ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀ samasmāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[3-4] Understand us,Agni; hear our invocation; defend us from all malevolent (people); most bright and resplendent Agni, we earnestly solicit you for the happiness (of ourselves) and our friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु॒म्नाय॑ नू॒नमी॑महे॒ सखि॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ śociṣṭha ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ nūnám ǀ īmahe ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ वो अ॒ग्निमव॑से दे॒वं गा॑सि॒ स नो॒ वसु॑: । रास॑त्पु॒त्र ऋ॑षू॒णामृ॒तावा॑ पर्षति द्वि॒षः
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ vaḥ ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ devám ǀ gāsi ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀrā́sat ǀ putráḥ ǀ ṛṣūṇā́m ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ parṣati ǀ dviṣáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate the divineAgnifor his protection; may he who presides over dwellings grant (our desires); may the son of the ṛṣis, the observers of truth, save us from those who hate us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि स॒त्यो यं पूर्वे॑ चिद्दे॒वास॑श्चि॒द्यमी॑धि॒रे । होता॑रं म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्व॒मित्सु॑दी॒तिभि॑र्वि॒भाव॑सुम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ satyáḥ ǀ yám ǀ pū́rve ǀ cit ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ īdhiré ǀhótāram ǀ mandrá-jihvam ǀ ít ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀ vibhā́-vasum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatAgniis true whom ancients, whom the gods have kindled, as the bright-tongued invoker of the gods, radiant with holy splendours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ धी॒ती वरि॑ष्ठया॒ श्रेष्ठ॑या च सुम॒त्या । अग्ने॑ रा॒यो दि॑दीहि नः सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र्वरेण्य
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dhītī́ ǀ váriṣṭhayā ǀ śréṣṭhayā ǀ ca ǀ su-matyā́ ǀágne ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ didīhi ǀ naḥ ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ vareṇya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, to be propitiated by praises, (gratified) by our choice and most excellent adoration and hymns, bestow upon us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वेषु॑ राजत्य॒ग्निर्मर्ते॑ष्वावि॒शन् । अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नो॒ऽग्निं धी॒भिः स॑पर्यत
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ rājati ǀ agníḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ ā-viśán ǀagníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǀ agním ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ saparyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnishines among the gods; Agni is present among mortals; Agni is the bearer of our oblations glorify Agni with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निस्तु॒विश्र॑वस्तमं तु॒विब्र॑ह्माणमुत्त॒मम् । अ॒तूर्तं॑ श्राव॒यत्प॑तिं पु॒त्रं द॑दाति दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ tuvíśravaḥ-tamam ǀ tuví-brahmāṇam ǀ ut-tamám ǀatū́rtam ǀ śravayát-patim ǀ putrám ǀ dadāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgnibestow upon the donor (of the oblation) son, abounding in food, abounding in devotion, excellent, unharmed, conferring honour upon his progenitors.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्द॑दाति॒ सत्प॑तिं सा॒साह॒ यो यु॒धा नृभि॑: । अ॒ग्निरत्यं॑ रघु॒ष्यदं॒ जेता॑र॒मप॑राजितम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ sát-patim ǀ sasā́ha ǀ yáḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ átyam ǀ raghu-syádam ǀ jétāram ǀ áparā-jitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgnibestow a son, the protector of the good, who, with his followers, may be victorious in battle; may he bestow a swift-footed steed, conquering, unconquered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वाहि॑ष्ठं॒ तद॒ग्नये॑ बृ॒हद॑र्च विभावसो । महि॑षीव॒ त्वद्र॒यिस्त्वद्वाजा॒ उदी॑रते
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā́hiṣṭham ǀ tát ǀ agnáye ǀ bṛhát ǀ arca ǀ vibhāvaso íti vibhā-vaso ǀmáhiṣī-iva ǀ tvát ǀ rayíḥ ǀ tvát ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ út ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That (praise) which best conveys (our veneration, is due) toAgni; affluent in splendour, grant us, (Agni), great (wealth), for from you vast riches and ample food proceed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ द्यु॒मन्तो॑ अ॒र्चयो॒ ग्रावे॑वोच्यते बृ॒हत् । उ॒तो ते॑ तन्य॒तुर्य॑था स्वा॒नो अ॑र्त॒ त्मना॑ दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ grā́vā-iva ǀ ucyate ǀ bṛhát ǀutó íti ǀ te ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ yathā ǀ svānáḥ ǀ arta ǀ tmánā ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant,Agni, are your rays; mighty are you termed, like the stone (that bruises theSoma), and your voice spontaneously spreads through the sky like thundeṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वाँ अ॒ग्निं व॑सू॒यव॑: सहसा॒नं व॑वन्दिम । स नो॒ विश्वा॒ अति॒ द्विष॒: पर्ष॑न्ना॒वेव॑ सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ agním ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ sahasānám ǀ vavandima ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ nāvā́-iva ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus, we Vasuyus, glorify the vigorousAgni; may he, the performer of great deeds, enable us to pass over all our enemies as (we cross a river) with a boat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ पावक रो॒चिषा॑ म॒न्द्रया॑ देव जि॒ह्वया॑ । आ दे॒वान्व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ pāvaka ǀ rocíṣā ǀ mandráyā ǀ deva ǀ jihváyā ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine purifier,Agni, with your radiant and plural asing tongue, bring hither and worship the gods”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ घृतस्नवीमहे॒ चित्र॑भानो स्व॒र्दृश॑म् । दे॒वाँ आ वी॒तये॑ वह
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ ghṛtasno íti ghṛta-sno ǀ īmahe ǀ cítrabhāno íti cítra-bhāno ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀdevā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vītáye ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Feeder upon butter, bright and variegated radiance we solicit you, the beholder of heaven, to (partake of) the (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒तिहो॑त्रं त्वा कवे द्यु॒मन्तं॒ समि॑धीमहि । अग्ने॑ बृ॒हन्त॑मध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: vītí-hotram ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀágne ǀ bṛhántam ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We kindle you at the sacrifice, wiseAgni, whose food is the oblation, who are brilliant and vast.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भि॒रा ग॑हि दे॒वेभि॑र्ह॒व्यदा॑तये । होता॑रं त्वा वृणीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀhótāram ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, with all the gods, to the donor (of the oblation); we have recourse to you as their invoker.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒त आग्ने॑ सु॒वीर्यं॑ वह । दे॒वैरा स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǀ ā́ ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ vaha ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To the instrumental tutor of the rite, pouring out the libation, bring excellent vigour; sit down with the gods upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मि॒धा॒नः स॑हस्रजि॒दग्ने॒ धर्मा॑णि पुष्यसि । दे॒वानां॑ दू॒त उ॒क्थ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sam-idhānáḥ ǀ sahasra-jit ǀ ágne ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ puṣyasi ǀdevā́nām ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ukthyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Victor over thousands, you favour, when kindled our holy rites, the honoured messenger of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य१॒॑ग्निं जा॒तवे॑दसं होत्र॒वाहं॒ यवि॑ष्ठ्यम् । दधा॑ता दे॒वमृ॒त्विज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ agním ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ hotra-vā́ham ǀ yáviṣṭhyam ǀdádhāta ǀ devám ǀ ṛtvíjam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ReverenceAgni, by whom all that is, is known, the bearer of oblations, the young of the gods, the divine, the ministrant priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र य॒ज्ञ ए॑त्वानु॒षग॒द्या दे॒वव्य॑चस्तमः । स्तृ॒णी॒त ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ etu ǀ ānuṣák ǀ adyá ǀ devávyacaḥ-tamaḥ ǀstṛṇītá ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sacrifice most solemnly offered by the devout duly proceed today (to the gods); spread the sacred grass for their seat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एदं म॒रुतो॑ अ॒श्विना॑ मि॒त्रः सी॑दन्तु॒ वरु॑णः । दे॒वास॒: सर्व॑या वि॒शा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ idám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ mitráḥ ǀ sīdantu ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ sárvayā ǀ viśā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, theAśvins,Mitra,Varuṇa, the gods, with all their attendants, sit down upon this grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन॑स्वन्ता॒ सत्प॑तिर्मामहे मे॒ गावा॒ चेति॑ष्ठो॒ असु॑रो म॒घोन॑: । त्रै॒वृ॒ष्णो अ॑ग्ने द॒शभि॑: स॒हस्रै॒र्वैश्वा॑नर॒ त्र्य॑रुणश्चिकेत
shlokas.transliteration: ánasvantā ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ mamahe ǀ me ǀ gā́vā ǀ cétiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀtraivṛṣṇáḥ ǀ agne ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ trí-aruṇaḥ ǀ ciketa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniwho are the protector of the good, most wise, powerful and opulent; Tryaruṇa, the son of Trivṛṣṇa, has become renowned,Vaiśvānara, in that he has bestowed upon me a pair of cattle with a wagon, and with them thousands of treasure. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मे॑ श॒ता च॑ विंश॒तिं च॒ गोनां॒ हरी॑ च यु॒क्ता सु॒धुरा॒ ददा॑ति । वैश्वा॑नर॒ सुष्टु॑तो वावृधा॒नोऽग्ने॒ यच्छ॒ त्र्य॑रुणाय॒ शर्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ śatā́ ǀ ca ǀ viṃśatím ǀ ca ǀ gónām ǀ hárī íti ǀ ca ǀ yuktā́ ǀ su-dhúrā ǀ dádāti ǀváiśvānara ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ ágne ǀ yáccha ǀ trí-aruṇāya ǀ śárma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,Vaiśvānara, who are deservedly praised and exaulted (by us), bestow happiness upon Tryaruṇa, who gives me hundreds (ofSuvarṇas), twenty cattle and a pair of burden-bearing horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ते॑ अग्ने सुम॒तिं च॑का॒नो नवि॑ष्ठाय नव॒मं त्र॒सद॑स्युः । यो मे॒ गिर॑स्तुविजा॒तस्य॑ पू॒र्वीर्यु॒क्तेना॒भि त्र्य॑रुणो गृ॒णाति॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ su-matím ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ náviṣṭhāya ǀ navamám ǀ trasádasyuḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀ tuvi-jātásya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ yukténa ǀ abhí ǀ trí-aruṇaḥ ǀ gṛṇā́ti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As Tryaruṇa, plural ased by the eulogies of me who has many children, presses with earnest (mind, gifts upon me), so does Trasadsyu, desirousAgni, of your valued favour through your exceeding praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो म॒ इति॑ प्र॒वोच॒त्यश्व॑मेधाय सू॒रये॑ । दद॑दृ॒चा स॒निं य॒ते दद॑न्मे॒धामृ॑ताय॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ íti ǀ pra-vócati ǀ áśva-medhāya ǀ sūráye ǀdádat ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ saním ǀ yaté ǀ dádat ǀ medhā́m ǀ ṛta-yaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenAśvamedhagives to him who solicits of him as a benefactor, saying (bestow wealth) upon me, and comes (to him) with a verse (in your praise), do you,Agni, grant intelligence to (theRājā) who wishes to offer sacrifice (to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ मा परु॒षाः श॒तमु॑द्ध॒र्षय॑न्त्यु॒क्षण॑: । अश्व॑मेधस्य॒ दाना॒: सोमा॑ इव॒ त्र्या॑शिरः
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ mā ǀ paruṣā́ḥ ǀ śatám ǀ ut-harṣáyanti ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀáśva-medhasya ǀ dā́nāḥ ǀ sómāḥ-iva ǀ trí-āśiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose hundred robust oxen yield me delight, as triple-mixedSoma, the offering ofAśvamedha(gratifies you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी शत॒दाव्न्यश्व॑मेधे सु॒वीर्य॑म् । क्ष॒त्रं धा॑रयतं बृ॒हद्दि॒वि सूर्य॑मिवा॒जर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ śata-dā́vni ǀ áśva-medhe ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀkṣatrám ǀ dhārayatam ǀ bṛhát ǀ diví ǀ sū́ryam-iva ǀ ajáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, bestow upon the munificentAśvamedhainfinite wealth with excellent posterity, undecaying as the sun in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निर्दि॒वि शो॒चिर॑श्रेत्प्र॒त्यङ्ङु॒षस॑मुर्वि॒या वि भा॑ति । एति॒ प्राची॑ वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ नमो॑भिर्दे॒वाँ ईळा॑ना ह॒विषा॑ घृ॒ताची॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ diví ǀ śocíḥ ǀ aśret ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ uṣásam ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀéti ǀ prā́cī ǀ viśvá-vārā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ī́ḷānā ǀ havíṣā ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, when kindled, spreads lustre through the firmament, and shines widely in the presence of the dawn; Viśvavārā, facing the east, glorifying the gods with praises, and bearing the ladle with the oblation, proceeds (to the sacred fire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मि॒ध्यमा॑नो अ॒मृत॑स्य राजसि ह॒विष्कृ॒ण्वन्तं॑ सचसे स्व॒स्तये॑ । विश्वं॒ स ध॑त्ते॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ यमिन्व॑स्याति॒थ्यम॑ग्ने॒ नि च॑ धत्त॒ इत्पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ rājasi ǀ havíḥ ǀ kṛṇvántam ǀ sacase ǀ svastáye ǀvíśvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ dráviṇam ǀ yám ǀ ínvasi ǀ ātithyám ǀ agne ǀ ní ǀ ca ǀ dhatte ǀ ít ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When about to be kindled,Agni, you rule over ambrosial (water); you are present with the offerer of the oblation for his welfare; he to whom you repair acquires universal wealth; he plural ces you, Agni the dues of hospitality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑ मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय॒ तव॑ द्यु॒म्नान्यु॑त्त॒मानि॑ सन्तु । सं जा॑स्प॒त्यं सु॒यम॒मा कृ॑णुष्व शत्रूय॒ताम॒भि ति॑ष्ठा॒ महां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ śárdha ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǀ táva ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ ut-tamā́ni ǀ santu ǀsám ǀ jaḥ-patyám ǀ su-yámam ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ śatru-yatā́m ǀ abhí ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ máhāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repress,Agni, (our foes to ensure our) exceeding prosperity; may your riches ever be excellent; preserve in concord the relation of man and wife, and overpower the energies of the hostile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धस्य॒ प्रम॑ह॒सोऽग्ने॒ वन्दे॒ तव॒ श्रिय॑म् । वृ॒ष॒भो द्यु॒म्नवाँ॑ असि॒ सम॑ध्व॒रेष्वि॑ध्यसे
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhasya ǀ prá-mahasaḥ ǀ agne ǀ vánde ǀ táva ǀ śríyam ǀvṛṣabháḥ ǀ dyumná-vān ǀ asi ǀ sám ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ idhyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise the glory,Agni, of you when kindled and blazing fiercely; you are the affluent showerer (of benefits), you are fitly lighted at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अग्न आहुत दे॒वान्य॑क्षि स्वध्वर । त्वं हि ह॑व्य॒वाळसि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǀ devā́n ǀ yakṣi ǀ su-adhvara ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ ási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are kindled and invoked, worship the gods at the holy rite, for you are the bearer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जु॑होता दुव॒स्यता॒ग्निं प्र॑य॒त्य॑ध्व॒रे । वृ॒णी॒ध्वं ह॑व्य॒वाह॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ juhota ǀ duvasyáta ǀ agním ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀvṛṇīdhvám ǀ havya-vā́hanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer worship and adoration toAgniwhen the sacrifice is solemnized; select the bearer of the oblation to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्र्य॑र्य॒मा मनु॑षो दे॒वता॑ता॒ त्री रो॑च॒ना दि॒व्या धा॑रयन्त । अर्च॑न्ति त्वा म॒रुत॑: पू॒तद॑क्षा॒स्त्वमे॑षा॒मृषि॑रिन्द्रासि॒ धीर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ trī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ divyā́ ǀ dhārayanta ǀárcanti ǀ tvā ǀ marútaḥ ǀ pūtá-dakṣāḥ ǀ tvám ǀ eṣām ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ dhī́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the adoration of the gods byManuthere are three effulgences, and they, (theMaruts), uphold three luminaries in heaven; the Maruts of pure energy worship you, for you,Indra, are their intelligent ṛṣi”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ यदीं॑ म॒रुतो॑ मन्दसा॒नमार्च॒न्निन्द्रं॑ पपि॒वांसं॑ सु॒तस्य॑ । आद॑त्त॒ वज्र॑म॒भि यदहिं॒ हन्न॒पो य॒ह्वीर॑सृज॒त्सर्त॒वा उ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mandasānám ǀ ā́rcan ǀ índram ǀ papi-vā́ṃsam ǀ sutásya ǀā́ ǀ adatta ǀ vájram ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ áhim ǀ hán ǀ apáḥ ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ sártavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theMarutsworshipIndra, exulting and drinking of the effused libation, he grasps the thunderbolt wherewith he destroys Ahi, and sets the abundant waters free to flow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ब्र॑ह्माणो मरुतो मे अ॒स्येन्द्र॒: सोम॑स्य॒ सुषु॑तस्य पेयाः । तद्धि ह॒व्यं मनु॑षे॒ गा अवि॑न्द॒दह॒न्नहिं॑ पपि॒वाँ इन्द्रो॑ अस्य
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ brahmāṇaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ me ǀ asya ǀ índraḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ peyāḥ ǀtát ǀ hí ǀ havyám ǀ mánuṣe ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ávindat ǀ áhan ǀ áhim ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or,mightyMaruts, and you also,Indra, drink of this my copiously-effused libation; then the offered libation obtains cattle for the offerer, and Indra, drinking of it, kills Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आद्रोद॑सी वित॒रं वि ष्क॑भायत्संविव्या॒नश्चि॑द्भि॒यसे॑ मृ॒गं क॑: । जिग॑र्ति॒मिन्द्रो॑ अप॒जर्गु॑राण॒: प्रति॑ श्व॒सन्त॒मव॑ दान॒वं ह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ skabhāyat ǀ sam-vivyānáḥ ǀ cit ǀ bhiyáse ǀ mṛgám ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀjígartim ǀ índraḥ ǀ apa-járgurāṇaḥ ǀ práti ǀ śvasántam ǀ áva ǀ dānavám ǀ hanníti han ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thereupon he fixed firmly heaven and earth, and resolutely advancing, filled (Vṛtra), like a deer, with terror, stripping off his covering,Indra, slew theDānava, endeavouring to hide, and panting with affright.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ क्रत्वा॑ मघव॒न्तुभ्यं॑ दे॒वा अनु॒ विश्वे॑ अददुः सोम॒पेय॑म् । यत्सूर्य॑स्य ह॒रित॒: पत॑न्तीः पु॒रः स॒तीरुप॑रा॒ एत॑शे॒ कः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ krátvā ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ víśve ǀ adaduḥ ǀ soma-péyam ǀyát ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ harítaḥ ǀ pátantīḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ satī́ḥ ǀ úparāḥ ǀ étaśe ǀ káríti káḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then, for this exploit, all the gods gave youMaghavan, in succession, theSomabeverage; whence you have retarded, for the sake ofEtaśa, the advancing horses of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नव॒ यद॑स्य नव॒तिं च॑ भो॒गान्त्सा॒कं वज्रे॑ण म॒घवा॑ विवृ॒श्चत् । अर्च॒न्तीन्द्रं॑ म॒रुत॑: स॒धस्थे॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ वच॑सा बाधत॒ द्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: náva ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ bhogā́n ǀ sākám ǀ vájreṇa ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vi-vṛścát ǀárcanti ǀ índram ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ tráistubhena ǀ vácasā ǀ bādhata ǀ dyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhereuponMaghavanhas destroyed with his thunderbolt at once his (Śambara's) ninety and nine cities; theMarutsglorifyingIndrain a common dwelling with theTriṣṭubhhymn, he destroyed the bright (city of theasura).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॒ सख्ये॑ अपच॒त्तूय॑म॒ग्निर॒स्य क्रत्वा॑ महि॒षा त्री श॒तानि॑ । त्री सा॒कमिन्द्रो॒ मनु॑ष॒: सरां॑सि सु॒तं पि॑बद्वृत्र॒हत्या॑य॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sákhā ǀ sákhye ǀ apacat ǀ tū́yam ǀ agníḥ ǀ asyá ǀ krátvā ǀ mahiṣā́ ǀ trī́ ǀ śatā́ni ǀtrī́ ǀ sākám ǀ índraḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ sutám ǀ pibat ǀ vṛtra-hátyāya ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To aid (the undertaking of) his friend,Agni, the friend (ofIndra) has quickly consumed three hundred buffaloes; and Indra, for the destruction ofVṛtra, has at once quaffed vessels ofSoma, offered byManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्री यच्छ॒ता म॑हि॒षाणा॒मघो॒ मास्त्री सरां॑सि म॒घवा॑ सो॒म्यापा॑: । का॒रं न विश्वे॑ अह्वन्त दे॒वा भर॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ यदहिं॑ ज॒घान॑
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ ǀ yát ǀ śatā́ ǀ mahiṣā́ṇām ǀ ághaḥ ǀ mā́ḥ ǀ trī́ ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ maghá-vā ǀ somyā́ ǀ ápāḥ ǀkārám ǀ ná ǀ víśve ǀ ahvanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ bháram ǀ índrāya ǀ yát ǀ áhim ǀ jaghā́na ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you had eaten the flesh of the three hundred buffaloes, when you who areMaghavanhad drunk the three vessels ofSoma, when he had slain Ahi, then all the gods summonedIndra, full of food, as if he had been a servant, to the battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शना॒ यत्स॑ह॒स्यै॒३॒॑रया॑तं गृ॒हमि॑न्द्र जूजुवा॒नेभि॒रश्वै॑: । व॒न्वा॒नो अत्र॑ स॒रथं॑ ययाथ॒ कुत्से॑न दे॒वैरव॑नोर्ह॒ शुष्ण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: uśánā ǀ yát ǀ sahasyáiḥ ǀ áyātam ǀ gṛhám ǀ indra ǀ jūjuvānébhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀvanvānáḥ ǀ átra ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yayātha ǀ kútsena ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ávanoḥ ǀ ha ǀ śúṣṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, you andUśanas, with vigorous and rapid courses went to the dwelling ofKutsa, then destroying his foes, you went in one chariot with Kutsa and the gods, and verily you have slainŚuṣṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रान्यच्च॒क्रम॑वृह॒: सूर्य॑स्य॒ कुत्सा॑या॒न्यद्वरि॑वो॒ यात॑वेऽकः । अ॒नासो॒ दस्यूँ॑रमृणो व॒धेन॒ नि दु॑र्यो॒ण आ॑वृणङ्मृ॒ध्रवा॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ anyát ǀ cakrám ǀ avṛhaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ kútsāya ǀ anyát ǀ várivaḥ ǀ yā́tave ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǀanā́saḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ amṛṇaḥ ǀ vadhéna ǀ ní ǀ duryoṇé ǀ avṛṇak ǀ mṛdhrá-vācaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have formerly detached one wheel (of the car) ofSūrya; another you have given toKutsawherewith to acquire wealth; with the thunderbolt you have confounded the voicelessDasyus, you have destroyed in battle the speech-bereft (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तोमा॑सस्त्वा॒ गौरि॑वीतेरवर्ध॒न्नर॑न्धयो वैदथि॒नाय॒ पिप्रु॑म् । आ त्वामृ॒जिश्वा॑ स॒ख्याय॑ चक्रे॒ पच॑न्प॒क्तीरपि॑ब॒: सोम॑मस्य
shlokas.transliteration: stómāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ gáuri-vīteḥ ǀ avardhan ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ vaidathinā́ya ǀ píprum ǀā́ ǀ tvā́m ǀ ṛjíśvā ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ cakre ǀ pácan ǀ paktī́ḥ ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ sómam ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praises of Gaurivīti exalt you; you have humbled Pipru for the son of Vidathin; Ṛjiśvan preparing dressed viands, has, through your friendship brought you (to his presence), and you have drunk of his libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नव॑ग्वासः सु॒तसो॑मास॒ इन्द्रं॒ दश॑ग्वासो अ॒भ्य॑र्चन्त्य॒र्कैः । गव्यं॑ चिदू॒र्वम॑पि॒धान॑वन्तं॒ तं चि॒न्नर॑: शशमा॒ना अप॑ व्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: náva-gvāsaḥ ǀ sutá-somāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀ dáśa-gvāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀgávyam ǀ cit ǀ ūrvám ǀ apidhā́na-vantam ǀ tám ǀ cit ǀ náraḥ ǀ śaśamānā́ḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The observers of the nine month's celebration, those of the ten months, pouring out libations, worshipIndrawith hymns; the leaders (of rites), glorifying him, have set open the cave (concealing the cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒थो नु ते॒ परि॑ चराणि वि॒द्वान्वी॒र्या॑ मघव॒न्या च॒कर्थ॑ । या चो॒ नु नव्या॑ कृ॒णव॑: शविष्ठ॒ प्रेदु॒ ता ते॑ वि॒दथे॑षु ब्रवाम
shlokas.transliteration: kathó íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ pári ǀ carāṇi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ vīryā́ ǀ magha-van ǀ yā́ ǀ cakártha ǀyā́ ǀ co íti ǀ nú ǀ návyā ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ prá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ bravāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although, knowing the heroic acts which,Maghavan, you have performed, how may I adequately offer you adoration; most mightyIndra, we ever celebrate sacred rites the recent exploits which you have achieved.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता विश्वा॑ चकृ॒वाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ भूर्यप॑रीतो ज॒नुषा॑ वी॒र्ये॑ण । या चि॒न्नु व॑ज्रिन्कृ॒णवो॑ दधृ॒ष्वान्न ते॑ व॒र्ता तवि॑ष्या अस्ति॒ तस्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakṛ-vā́n ǀ indra ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ápari-itaḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ vīryéṇa ǀyā́ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ vajrin ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ dadhṛṣvā́n ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ vartā́ ǀ táviṣyāḥ ǀ asti ǀ tásyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unmatched (by any), you have done,Indra, all these many (deeds) by your innate energy; wielder of the thunderbolt, whatever you, the humbler of (foes), have undertaken, there is no one the arrester of this your prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ ब्रह्म॑ क्रि॒यमा॑णा जुषस्व॒ या ते॑ शविष्ठ॒ नव्या॒ अक॑र्म । वस्त्रे॑व भ॒द्रा सुकृ॑ता वसू॒यू रथं॒ न धीर॒: स्वपा॑ अतक्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ bráhma ǀ kriyámāṇā ǀ juṣasva ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ návyāḥ ǀ ákarma ǀvástrā-iva ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ atakṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most mightyIndra, be plural ased to accept the prayers which we are about to offer, and the present praises which we repeat; firm, doing pious acts, and desirous of wealth; I have fabricated acceptable and pious works like (rich) garments, and like a chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ स्य वी॒रः को अ॑पश्य॒दिन्द्रं॑ सु॒खर॑थ॒मीय॑मानं॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । यो रा॒या व॒ज्री सु॒तसो॑ममि॒च्छन्तदोको॒ गन्ता॑ पुरुहू॒त ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ apaśyat ǀ índram ǀ sukhá-ratham ǀ ī́yamānam ǀ hári-bhyām ǀyáḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ sutá-somam ǀ icchán ǀ tát ǀ ókaḥ ǀ gántā ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where is that hero? who has seenIndraseated in his easy chariot travelling with his horses, the thunder, the invoked of many, who, desirous of the libation is proceeding with riches to the habitation (of his worshipper) for his preservation?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॑चचक्षं प॒दम॑स्य स॒स्वरु॒ग्रं नि॑धा॒तुरन्वा॑यमि॒च्छन् । अपृ॑च्छम॒न्याँ उ॒त ते म॑ आहु॒रिन्द्रं॒ नरो॑ बुबुधा॒ना अ॑शेम
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ acacakṣam ǀ padám ǀ asya ǀ sasváḥ ǀ ugrám ǀ ni-dhātúḥ ǀ ánu ǀ āyam ǀ icchán ǀápṛccham ǀ anyā́n ǀ utá ǀ té ǀ me ǀ āhuḥ ǀ índram ǀ náraḥ ǀ bubudhānā́ḥ ǀ aśema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have looked down upon the secret and fearful plural ce of his abiding; I have repaired, desiring him, (to the plural ce of) the self-sustainer; I have inquired (of him) from others; they, the leaders (of rites), the search after wisdom, have said to me, let us have recourse toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नु व॒यं सु॒ते या ते॑ कृ॒तानीन्द्र॒ ब्रवा॑म॒ यानि॑ नो॒ जुजो॑षः । वेद॒दवि॑द्वाञ्छृ॒णव॑च्च वि॒द्वान्वह॑ते॒ऽयं म॒घवा॒ सर्व॑सेनः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ vayám ǀ suté ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ índra ǀ brávāma ǀ yā́ni ǀ naḥ ǀ jújoṣaḥ ǀvédat ǀ ávidvān ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ ca ǀ vidvā́n ǀ váhate ǀ ayám ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sárva-senaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the libation is offered,Indra, we celebrate your exploits; those (exploits) which you have been praised (to achieve) for us; let him who is ignorant acquire knowledge (of them); let him who is acquainted (with them) make them known; thisMaghavan(is) the lord of hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थि॒रं मन॑श्चकृषे जा॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ वेषीदेको॑ यु॒धये॒ भूय॑सश्चित् । अश्मा॑नं चि॒च्छव॑सा दिद्युतो॒ वि वि॒दो गवा॑मू॒र्वमु॒स्रिया॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sthirám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ cakṛṣe ǀ jātáḥ ǀ indra ǀ véṣi ǀ ít ǀ ékaḥ ǀ yudháye ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǀ cit ǀáśmānam ǀ cit ǀ śávasā ǀ didyutaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vidáḥ ǀ gávām ǀ ūrvám ǀ usríyāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as genitive rated,Indra, you have made your mind resolved; you have gone alone to contend against numerous (foes); you have rent asunder the rock by your strength; you have rescued the herd of milk-yielding kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रो यत्त्वं प॑र॒म आ॒जनि॑ष्ठाः परा॒वति॒ श्रुत्यं॒ नाम॒ बिभ्र॑त् । अत॑श्चि॒दिन्द्रा॑दभयन्त दे॒वा विश्वा॑ अ॒पो अ॑जयद्दा॒सप॑त्नीः
shlokas.transliteration: paráḥ ǀ yát ǀ tvám ǀ paramáḥ ǀ ā-jániṣṭhāḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ śrútyam ǀ nā́ma ǀ bíbhrat ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ índrāt ǀ abhayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ajayat ǀ dāsá-patnīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you have been born most excellent and supreme, bearing a name widely renowned, then the gods have been in dread ofIndra, and he has subjugated all the waters, the brides of the slave (Vṛtra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्येदे॒ते म॒रुत॑: सु॒शेवा॒ अर्च॑न्त्य॒र्कं सु॒न्वन्त्यन्ध॑: । अहि॑मोहा॒नम॒प आ॒शया॑नं॒ प्र मा॒याभि॑र्मा॒यिनं॑ सक्ष॒दिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ít ǀ eté ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-śévāḥ ǀ árcanti ǀ arkám ǀ sunvánti ǀ ándhaḥ ǀáhim ǀ ohānám ǀ apáḥ ǀ ā-śáyānam ǀ prá ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ māyínam ǀ sakṣat ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These devotedMarutseulogise you with pious praise, and pour out to you the sacrificial food;Indrahas overcome by his device the guileful Ahi, harassing the gods and arresting the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षू मृधो॑ ज॒नुषा॒ दान॒मिन्व॒न्नह॒न्गवा॑ मघवन्त्संचका॒नः । अत्रा॑ दा॒सस्य॒ नमु॑चे॒: शिरो॒ यदव॑र्तयो॒ मन॑वे गा॒तुमि॒च्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ dā́nam ǀ ínvan ǀ áhan ǀ gávā ǀ magha-van ǀ sam-cakānáḥ ǀátra ǀ dāsásya ǀ námuceḥ ǀ śíraḥ ǀ yát ǀ ávartayaḥ ǀ mánave ǀ gātúm ǀ icchán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, who are glorified by us, assailing with the thunderbolt the antagonist (of the gods), you have slain those who were ever hostile (to you) from your birth; desiring to do good toManu, you have bruised the head of the slaveNamuci.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युजं॒ हि मामकृ॑था॒ आदिदि॑न्द्र॒ शिरो॑ दा॒सस्य॒ नमु॑चेर्मथा॒यन् । अश्मा॑नं चित्स्व॒र्यं१॒॑ वर्त॑मानं॒ प्र च॒क्रिये॑व॒ रोद॑सी म॒रुद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yújam ǀ hí ǀ mā́m ǀ ákṛthāḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ śíraḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ námuceḥ ǀ mathāyán ǀáśmānam ǀ cit ǀ svaryám ǀ vártamānam ǀ prá ǀ cakríyā-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily you have made me,Indra, your associate when grinding the head of the slaveNamucilike a sounding and rolling cloud; and the heaven and earth (have been caused) by theMaruts(to revolve like a wheel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्त्रियो॒ हि दा॒स आयु॑धानि च॒क्रे किं मा॑ करन्नब॒ला अ॑स्य॒ सेना॑: । अ॒न्तर्ह्यख्य॑दु॒भे अ॑स्य॒ धेने॒ अथोप॒ प्रैद्यु॒धये॒ दस्यु॒मिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stríyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ dāsáḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ cakré ǀ kím ǀ mā ǀ karan ǀ abalā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ sénāḥ ǀantáḥ ǀ hí ǀ ákhyat ǀ ubhé íti ǀ asya ǀ dhéne íti ǀ átha ǀ úpa ǀ prá ǀ ait ǀ yudháye ǀ dásyum ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The slave (Namuci) made women his weapons what will his feminine le hosts do unto me? The two his best beloved, (Indra) confined in the inner apartments, and then went forth to combat against theDasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समत्र॒ गावो॒ऽभितो॑ऽनवन्ते॒हेह॑ व॒त्सैर्वियु॑ता॒ यदास॑न् । सं ता इन्द्रो॑ असृजदस्य शा॒कैर्यदीं॒ सोमा॑स॒: सुषु॑ता॒ अम॑न्दन्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ átra ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ anavanta ǀ ihá-iha ǀ vatsáiḥ ǀ ví-yutāḥ ǀ yát ǀ ā́san ǀsám ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ asya ǀ śākáiḥ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ sú-sutāḥ ǀ ámandan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the cows were separated from their calves, they wandered about hither and thither; but when the well-offered libations had exhilarated hi, thenIndra, with his vigorous (maruts), reunited them (with their calves).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदीं॒ सोमा॑ ब॒भ्रुधू॑ता॒ अम॑न्द॒न्नरो॑रवीद्वृष॒भः साद॑नेषु । पु॒रं॒द॒रः प॑पि॒वाँ इन्द्रो॑ अस्य॒ पुन॒र्गवा॑मददादु॒स्रिया॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ sómāḥ ǀ babhrú-dhūtāḥ ǀ ámandan ǀ ároravīt ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ sádaneṣu ǀpuram-daráḥ ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ asya ǀ púnaḥ ǀ gávām ǀ adadāt ǀ usríyāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the libations effused byBabhruhad exhilarated him, the showerer (of benefits) shouted aloud in the combats;Indra, the destroyer fo cities, quaffing (theSoma), restored to him his milk-yielding cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रमि॒दं रु॒शमा॑ अग्ने अक्र॒न्गवां॑ च॒त्वारि॒ दद॑तः स॒हस्रा॑ । ऋ॒णं॒च॒यस्य॒ प्रय॑ता म॒घानि॒ प्रत्य॑ग्रभीष्म॒ नृत॑मस्य नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ idám ǀ ruśámāḥ ǀ agne ǀ akran ǀ gávām ǀ catvā́ri ǀ dádataḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀṛṇam-cayásya ǀ prá-yatā ǀ maghā́ni ǀ práti ǀ agrabhīṣma ǀ nṛ́-tamasya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Suśamās giving me four thousand cows,Agni, have done well; we have accepted the wealth, the donation of the leader of leaders rṇañcaya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒पेश॑सं॒ माव॑ सृज॒न्त्यस्तं॒ गवां॑ स॒हस्रै॑ रु॒शमा॑सो अग्ने । ती॒व्रा इन्द्र॑मममन्दुः सु॒तासो॒ऽक्तोर्व्यु॑ष्टौ॒ परि॑तक्म्यायाः
shlokas.transliteration: su-péśasam ǀ mā ǀ áva ǀ sṛjanti ǀ ástam ǀ gávām ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀ ruśámāsaḥ ǀ agne ǀtīvrā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ amamanduḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ aktóḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ pári-takmyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheRuśamās,Agni, have presented to me a beautiful abode, with thousands of cattle; the sharp libations have exhilaratedIndraupon the breaking up of the (gloom-) investing night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: औच्छ॒त्सा रात्री॒ परि॑तक्म्या॒ याँ ऋ॑णंच॒ये राज॑नि रु॒शमा॑नाम् । अत्यो॒ न वा॒जी र॒घुर॒ज्यमा॑नो ब॒भ्रुश्च॒त्वार्य॑सनत्स॒हस्रा॑
shlokas.transliteration: áucchat ǀ sā́ ǀ rā́trī ǀ pári-takmyā ǀ yā́ ǀ ṛṇam-cayé ǀ rā́jani ǀ ruśámānām ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ raghúḥ ǀ ajyámānaḥ ǀ babhrúḥ ǀ catvā́ri ǀ asanat ǀ sahásrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (gloom-) investing night has dispersed with the dawn (upon the appearance of) Ṛṇañcaya, therājāof theruśamās;Babhrubeing summoned, going like a fleet courser, has received the four thousand (cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: चतु॑:सहस्रं॒ गव्य॑स्य प॒श्वः प्रत्य॑ग्रभीष्म रु॒शमे॑ष्वग्ने । घ॒र्मश्चि॑त्त॒प्तः प्र॒वृजे॒ य आसी॑दय॒स्मय॒स्तम्वादा॑म॒ विप्रा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: cátuḥ-sahasram ǀ gávyasya ǀ paśváḥ ǀ práti ǀ agrabhīṣma ǀ ruśámeṣu ǀ agne ǀgharmáḥ ǀ cit ǀ taptáḥ ǀ pra-vṛ́je ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́sīt ǀ ayasmáyaḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ā́dāma ǀ víprāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have accepted,Agni, the four thousand cattle from theRuśamās; and the glowing, the golden ewer prepared for the solemnity, we who are wise have accepted it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ रथा॑य प्र॒वतं॑ कृणोति॒ यम॒ध्यस्था॑न्म॒घवा॑ वाज॒यन्त॑म् । यू॒थेव॑ प॒श्वो व्यु॑नोति गो॒पा अरि॑ष्टो याति प्रथ॒मः सिषा॑सन्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ráthāya ǀ pra-vátam ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ yám ǀ adhi-ásthāt ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vāja-yántam ǀyūthā́-iva ǀ paśváḥ ǀ ví ǀ unoti ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ áriṣṭaḥ ǀ yāti ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sísāsan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the possessor of opulence, directs downwards the car over which, intended (to receive sacrificial) viands, he presides; he proceeds unimpeded, the first of the gods, driving (his enemies before him), as a herdsman drives the herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प्र द्र॑व हरिवो॒ मा वि वे॑न॒: पिश॑ङ्गराते अ॒भि न॑: सचस्व । न॒हि त्वदि॑न्द्र॒ वस्यो॑ अ॒न्यदस्त्य॑मे॒नाँश्चि॒ज्जनि॑वतश्चकर्थ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ prá ǀ drava ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venaḥ ǀ píśaṅga-rāte ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sacasva ǀnahí ǀ tvát ǀ indra ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ anyát ǀ ásti ǀ amenā́n ǀ cit ǀ jáni-vataḥ ǀ cakartha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten to us, lord of horses; be not indifferent to us; distributor of manifold wealth, befriend us; for there is nothing else that is better,Indra, than you; you have given wives to those who were without women.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्यत्सह॒: सह॑स॒ आज॑निष्ट॒ देदि॑ष्ट॒ इन्द्र॑ इन्द्रि॒याणि॒ विश्वा॑ । प्राचो॑दयत्सु॒दुघा॑ व॒व्रे अ॒न्तर्वि ज्योति॑षा संववृ॒त्वत्तमो॑ऽवः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ yát ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ájaniṣṭa ǀ dédiṣṭe ǀ índraḥ ǀ indriyā́ṇi ǀ víśvā ǀprá ǀ acodayat ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ vavré ǀ antáḥ ǀ ví ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sam-vavṛtvát ǀ támaḥ ǀ avarítyavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the light (of the sun) overpowers the light (of the dawn)Indragrants all (sorts of) wealth (to the worshipper); he has liberated the kine from the interior of the obstructing (mountain); he dissipates the enveloping darkness with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन॑वस्ते॒ रथ॒मश्वा॑य तक्ष॒न्त्वष्टा॒ वज्रं॑ पुरुहूत द्यु॒मन्त॑म् । ब्र॒ह्माण॒ इन्द्रं॑ म॒हय॑न्तो अ॒र्कैरव॑र्धय॒न्नह॑ये॒ हन्त॒वा उ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánavaḥ ǀ te ǀ rátham ǀ áśvāya ǀ takṣan ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ vájram ǀ puru-hūta ǀ dyu-mántam ǀbrahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ índram ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ ávardhayan ǀ áhaye ǀ hántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheṚbhushave fabricated your car,Indra, the invoked of many, adapted to its horses;Tvaṣṭā(had made) your radiant thunderbolt; the venerable (Aṅgirasas), praising Indra with hymns, have given him vigour for the destruction of Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष्णे॒ यत्ते॒ वृष॑णो अ॒र्कमर्चा॒निन्द्र॒ ग्रावा॑णो॒ अदि॑तिः स॒जोषा॑: । अ॒न॒श्वासो॒ ये प॒वयो॑ऽर॒था इन्द्रे॑षिता अ॒भ्यव॑र्तन्त॒ दस्यू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ arkám ǀ árcān ǀ índra ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀanaśvā́saḥ ǀ yé ǀ paváyaḥ ǀ arathā́ḥ ǀ índra-iṣitāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ávartanta ǀ dásyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theMaruts, the showerers (of benefits), glorify you,Indra, the showerer (of desires), with praises, and the exulting stones delight (to bruise theSoma), then, without horses, without chariots, they, the purifying (Maruts), dispatched by Indra, have overcome theDasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ पूर्वा॑णि॒ कर॑णानि वोचं॒ प्र नूत॑ना मघव॒न्या च॒कर्थ॑ । शक्ती॑वो॒ यद्वि॒भरा॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे जय॑न्न॒पो मन॑वे॒ दानु॑चित्राः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ káraṇāni ǀ vocam ǀ prá ǀ nū́tanā ǀ magha-van ǀ yā́ ǀ cakártha ǀśákti-vaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vi-bhárāḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ jáyan ǀ apáḥ ǀ mánave ǀ dā́nu-citrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I celebrate,Maghavan, your ancient exploits, and those which you have newly achieved; wielder of the thunderbolt, subjugating both heaven and earth, you have distributed the wonderfully bountiful waters to man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिन्नु ते॒ कर॑णं दस्म वि॒प्राहिं॒ यद्घ्नन्नोजो॒ अत्रामि॑मीथाः । शुष्ण॑स्य चि॒त्परि॑ मा॒या अ॑गृभ्णाः प्रपि॒त्वं यन्नप॒ दस्यूँ॑रसेधः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ káraṇam ǀ dasma ǀ vipra ǀ áhim ǀ yát ǀ ghnán ǀ ójaḥ ǀ átra ǀ ámimīthāḥ ǀśúṣṇasya ǀ cit ǀ pári ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ agṛbhṇāḥ ǀ pra-pitvám ǀ yán ǀ ápa ǀ dásyūn ǀ asedhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Handsome and sagaciousIndra, this is your deed, that, slaying Ahi, you have here displayed your vigour; you have arrested the devices ofŚuṣṇaurging the combat; you have overcome theDasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒पो यद॑वे तु॒र्वशा॒यार॑मयः सु॒दुघा॑: पा॒र इ॑न्द्र । उ॒ग्रम॑यात॒मव॑हो ह॒ कुत्सं॒ सं ह॒ यद्वा॑मु॒शनार॑न्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ yádave ǀ turváśāyá ǀ áramayaḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ pāráḥ ǀ indra ǀugrám ǀ ayātam ǀ ávahaḥ ǀ ha ǀ kútsam ǀ sám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ uśánā ǀ áranta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, (abiding on the further bank), have rendered the fertilizing waters agreeable toYaduand Turvaśu; you two, (Indra andKutsa), have assailed the fierce (Śuṣṇa), and (having slain him), you have conveyed Kutsa (to his dwelling), andUśanāsand the gods have therefore honoured you both.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑कुत्सा॒ वह॑माना॒ रथे॒ना वा॒मत्या॒ अपि॒ कर्णे॑ वहन्तु । निः षी॑म॒द्भ्यो धम॑थो॒ निः ष॒धस्था॑न्म॒घोनो॑ हृ॒दो व॑रथ॒स्तमां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: índrākutsā ǀ váhamānā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ átyāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ kárṇe ǀ vahantu ǀníḥ ǀ sīm ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ dhámathaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ varathaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your steeds bring you both,IndraandKutsariding in one chariot, to the worshipper; you have expelled him (Śuṣṇa) from the waters, from his proper abode; you have driven the glooms (of ignorance) from the heart of the affluent (adorer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वात॑स्य यु॒क्तान्त्सु॒युज॑श्चि॒दश्वा॑न्क॒विश्चि॑दे॒षो अ॑जगन्नव॒स्युः । विश्वे॑ ते॒ अत्र॑ म॒रुत॒: सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ तवि॑षीमवर्धन्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́tasya ǀ yuktā́n ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ cit ǀ áśvān ǀ kavíḥ ǀ cit ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ajagan ǀ avasyúḥ ǀvíśve ǀ te ǀ átra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ táviṣīm ǀ avardhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sageAvasyuhas obtained docile horses, endowed (with the speed) of the wind; all your adorers,Indra, in this world, your friends, augment your vigour by their praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर॑श्चि॒द्रथं॒ परि॑तक्म्यायां॒ पूर्वं॑ कर॒दुप॑रं जूजु॒वांस॑म् । भर॑च्च॒क्रमेत॑श॒: सं रि॑णाति पु॒रो दध॑त्सनिष्यति॒ क्रतुं॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sū́raḥ ǀ cit ǀ rátham ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǀ pū́rvam ǀ karat ǀ úparam ǀ jūju-vā́ṃsam ǀbhárat ǀ cakrám ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ sám ǀ riṇāti ǀ puráḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ saniṣyati ǀ krátum ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, (Indra), has formerly arrested in battle the rapid chariot of the sun;Etaśahas born away the wheel, and (with it Indra) demolishes (his foes); may he, giving us precedence, be propitiated by our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आयं ज॑ना अभि॒चक्षे॑ जगा॒मेन्द्र॒: सखा॑यं सु॒तसो॑ममि॒च्छन् । वद॒न्ग्रावाव॒ वेदिं॑ भ्रियाते॒ यस्य॑ जी॒रम॑ध्व॒र्यव॒श्चर॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ayám ǀ janāḥ ǀ abhi-cákṣe ǀ jagāma ǀ índraḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ sutá-somam ǀ icchán ǀvádan ǀ grā́vā ǀ áva ǀ védim ǀ bhriyāte ǀ yásya ǀ jīrám ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ cáranti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, oḥ people, has come to see you, wishing to behold his friend the offerer of the libation; let us creaking stones, for whose rotation the priests hasten, supply the altar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये चा॒कन॑न्त चा॒कन॑न्त॒ नू ते मर्ता॑ अमृत॒ मो ते अंह॒ आर॑न् । वा॒व॒न्धि यज्यूँ॑रु॒त तेषु॑ धे॒ह्योजो॒ जने॑षु॒ येषु॑ ते॒ स्याम॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ cākánanta ǀ cākánanta ǀ nú ǀ té ǀ mártāḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ mó íti ǀ té ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aran ǀvavandhí ǀ yájyūn ǀ utá ǀ téṣu ǀ dhehi ǀ ójaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ yéṣu ǀ te ǀ syā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Immortal (Indra), let not the more wishing, anxiously wishing for you, fall into sin; be indeed plural ased with the sacrificers, and grant vigour to those men among whom may we be (especially) yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑र्द॒रुत्स॒मसृ॑जो॒ वि खानि॒ त्वम॑र्ण॒वान्ब॑द्बधा॒नाँ अ॑रम्णाः । म॒हान्त॑मिन्द्र॒ पर्व॑तं॒ वि यद्वः सृ॒जो वि धारा॒ अव॑ दान॒वं ह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ádardaḥ ǀ útsam ǀ ásṛjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ khā́ni ǀ tvám ǀ arṇavā́n ǀ badbadhānā́n ǀ aramṇāḥ ǀmahā́ntam ǀ indra ǀ párvatam ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ váríti váḥ ǀ sṛjáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ áva ǀ dānavám ǀ hanníti han ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, have rent the cloud asunder, you have set open the flood-gates, you have liberated the obstructed streams, you have opened the vast cloud, and have given vent to the showers, having slain theDānava.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमुत्साँ॑ ऋ॒तुभि॑र्बद्बधा॒नाँ अरं॑ह॒ ऊध॒: पर्व॑तस्य वज्रिन् । अहिं॑ चिदुग्र॒ प्रयु॑तं॒ शया॑नं जघ॒न्वाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ तवि॑षीमधत्थाः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ útsān ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ badbadhānā́n ǀ áraṃhaḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ párvatasya ǀ vajrin ǀáhim ǀ cit ǀ ugra ǀ prá-yutam ǀ śáyānam ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ indra ǀ táviṣīm ǀ adhatthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, thunder, (have set free) the obstructed clouds in their seasons; you have invigorated the strength of the cloud; fierceIndra, destroying the mighty Ahi when slumbering (in the waters), you have established the reputation of your prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यस्य॑ चिन्मह॒तो निर्मृ॒गस्य॒ वध॑र्जघान॒ तवि॑षीभि॒रिन्द्र॑: । य एक॒ इद॑प्र॒तिर्मन्य॑मान॒ आद॑स्माद॒न्यो अ॑जनिष्ट॒ तव्या॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tyásya ǀ cit ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ mṛgásya ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ jaghāna ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ apratíḥ ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ asmāt ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ távyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by his prowess, has annihilated the weapon of that mighty beast, from whom another more powerful conceiving himself one and unmatched was genitive rated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॑देषां स्व॒धया॒ मद॑न्तं मि॒हो नपा॑तं सु॒वृधं॑ तमो॒गाम् । वृष॑प्रभर्मा दान॒वस्य॒ भामं॒ वज्रे॑ण व॒ज्री नि ज॑घान॒ शुष्ण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ eṣām ǀ svadháyā ǀ mádantam ǀ miháḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ su-vṛ́dham ǀ tamaḥ-gā́m ǀvṛ́ṣa-prabharmā ǀ dānavásya ǀ bhā́mam ǀ vájreṇa ǀ vajrī́ ǀ ní ǀ jaghāna ǀ śúṣṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wielder of the thunderbolt, the render of the rain-cloud, has destroyed with his bolt the mightyŚuṣṇa, the wrath-born (son) of theDānava, the walker in darkness, the protector of there showering cloud, exhilarating himself with the food of these (living creatures).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॑दस्य॒ क्रतु॑भि॒र्निष॑त्तमम॒र्मणो॑ वि॒ददिद॑स्य॒ मर्म॑ । यदीं॑ सुक्षत्र॒ प्रभृ॑ता॒ मद॑स्य॒ युयु॑त्सन्तं॒ तम॑सि ह॒र्म्ये धाः
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ ní-sattam ǀ amarmáṇaḥ ǀ vidát ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ márma ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ prá-bhṛtā ǀ mádasya ǀ yúyutsantam ǀ támasi ǀ harmyé ǀ dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have discovered,Indra, by his acts, the secret vital part of him who thought himself invulnerable, when, powerful Indra, in the exhilaration of theSoma, they have detected him preparing for combat in his dark abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॑दि॒त्था क॑त्प॒यं शया॑नमसू॒र्ये तम॑सि वावृधा॒नम् । तं चि॑न्मन्दा॒नो वृ॑ष॒भः सु॒तस्यो॒च्चैरिन्द्रो॑ अप॒गूर्या॑ जघान
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ itthā́ ǀ katpayám ǀ śáyānam ǀ asūryé ǀ támasi ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀtám ǀ cit ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ uccáiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ apa-gū́rya ǀ jaghāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the showerer (of benefits) exhilarated by the effused juices, uplifting (his thunderbolt), has slain him enjoying the dews of the firmament, sleeping (amidst the waters), and thriving in sunless darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्यदिन्द्रो॑ मह॒ते दा॑न॒वाय॒ वध॒र्यमि॑ष्ट॒ सहो॒ अप्र॑तीतम् । यदीं॒ वज्र॑स्य॒ प्रभृ॑तौ द॒दाभ॒ विश्व॑स्य ज॒न्तोर॑ध॒मं च॑कार
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ mahaté ǀ dānavā́ya ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ yámiṣṭa ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ áprati-itam ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ vájrasya ǀ prá-bhṛtau ǀ dadā́bha ǀ víśvasya ǀ jantóḥ ǀ adhamám ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndraraised his powerful irresistible weapon against the mightyDānava, when he struck him with the blow of the thunderbolt, he made him the lowest of all creatures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॒दर्णं॑ मधु॒पं शया॑नमसि॒न्वं व॒व्रं मह्याद॑दु॒ग्रः । अ॒पाद॑म॒त्रं म॑ह॒ता व॒धेन॒ नि दु॑र्यो॒ण आ॑वृणङ्मृ॒ध्रवा॑चम्
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ árṇam ǀ madhu-pám ǀ śáyānam ǀ asinvám ǀ vavrám ǀ máhi ǀ ā́dat ǀ ugráḥ ǀapā́dam ǀ atrám ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vadhéna ǀ ní ǀ duryoṇé ǀ avṛṇak ǀ mṛdhrá-vācam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fierceIndraseized upon him, that vast moving (Vṛtra), when slumbering, (after) having drunk theSoma, subduing (his foes), and enveloping (the world), and then slew him with his great weapons in battle, footless, measureless, speechless.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॑स्य॒ शुष्मं॒ तवि॑षीं वरात॒ एको॒ धना॑ भरते॒ अप्र॑तीतः । इ॒मे चि॑दस्य॒ ज्रय॑सो॒ नु दे॒वी इन्द्र॒स्यौज॑सो भि॒यसा॑ जिहाते
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ asya ǀ śúṣmam ǀ táviṣīm ǀ varāte ǀ ékaḥ ǀ dhánā ǀ bharate ǀ áprati-itaḥ ǀimé ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ jráyasaḥ ǀ nú ǀ devī́ íti ǀ índrasya ǀ ójasaḥ ǀ bhiyásā ǀ jihāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who may resist the withering might of thatIndra; he, single and irresistible, carries off the riches (of the enemy); these two divine (beings, heaven and earth), proceed swiftly through fear of the strength of the quick-moving Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य॑स्मै दे॒वी स्वधि॑तिर्जिहीत॒ इन्द्रा॑य गा॒तुरु॑श॒तीव॑ येमे । सं यदोजो॑ यु॒वते॒ विश्व॑माभि॒रनु॑ स्व॒धाव्ने॑ क्षि॒तयो॑ नमन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ asmai ǀ devī́ ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ jihīte ǀ índrāya ǀ gātúḥ ǀ uśatī́-iva ǀ yeme ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ ójaḥ ǀ yuváte ǀ víśvam ǀ ābhiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́-vne ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ namanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine, self-sustaining (heaven) comes to him; the moving (earth), like a loving (wife), resigns herself toIndra; when he shares all his vigour with these (his people), then, in due succession, men offer reverence to the potent Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एकं॒ नु त्वा॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पाञ्च॑जन्यं जा॒तं शृ॑णोमि य॒शसं॒ जने॑षु । तं मे॑ जगृभ्र आ॒शसो॒ नवि॑ष्ठं दो॒षा वस्तो॒र्हव॑मानास॒ इन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ékam ǀ nú ǀ tvā ǀ sát-patim ǀ pā́ñca-janyam ǀ jātám ǀ śṛṇomi ǀ yaśásam ǀ jáneṣu ǀtám ǀ me ǀ jagṛbhre ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀ náviṣṭham ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ hávamānāsaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily I hear you as chief among men, the protector of the good, friendly to the five classes of beings, the begotten, the renowned; may my (progeny), representing (their wishes), and uttering, his praises night and day, propitiates the glorifiedIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा हि त्वामृ॑तु॒था या॒तय॑न्तं म॒घा विप्रे॑भ्यो॒ दद॑तं शृ॒णोमि॑ । किं ते॑ ब्र॒ह्माणो॑ गृहते॒ सखा॑यो॒ ये त्वा॒या नि॑द॒धुः काम॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ yātáyantam ǀ maghā́ ǀ víprebhyaḥ ǀ dádatam ǀ śṛṇómi ǀkím ǀ te ǀ brahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ gṛhate ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ ni-dadhúḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I hear of you influencing (creatures) according to the season, and giving riches to the pious; but what do your devoted friends (obtain), who have entrusted their desires,Indra, to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑ म॒हे त॒वसे॑ दीध्ये॒ नॄनिन्द्रा॑ये॒त्था त॒वसे॒ अत॑व्यान् । यो अ॑स्मै सुम॒तिं वाज॑सातौ स्तु॒तो जने॑ सम॒र्य॑श्चि॒केत॑
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ mahé ǀ taváse ǀ dīdhye ǀ nṝ́n ǀ índrāya ǀ itthā́ ǀ taváse ǀ átavyān ǀyáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ su-matím ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ stutáḥ ǀ jáne ǀ sa-maryáḥ ǀ cikéta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Feeble as I am, I offer praise to the great and vigorousIndra, for this purpose, (that he may grant) strength to (our) people; he who, associated with theMaruts, shows favour to this person n when praised for the sake of sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं न॑ इन्द्र धियसा॒नो अ॒र्कैर्हरी॑णां वृष॒न्योक्त्र॑मश्रेः । या इ॒त्था म॑घव॒न्ननु॒ जोषं॒ वक्षो॑ अ॒भि प्रार्यः स॑क्षि॒ जना॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ dhiyasānáḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ hárīṇām ǀ vṛṣan ǀ yóktram ǀ aśreḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ magha-van ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sakṣi ǀ jánān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, meditating upon us, fasten the traces of yourborses, (incited), showerer (of benefits), by those praises in which you have suitable delight, and do you therefore overcome (for us) hostile men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते त॑ इन्द्रा॒भ्य१॒॑स्मदृ॒ष्वायु॑क्तासो अब्र॒ह्मता॒ यदस॑न् । तिष्ठा॒ रथ॒मधि॒ तं व॑ज्रह॒स्ता र॒श्मिं दे॑व यमसे॒ स्वश्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ asmát ǀ ṛṣva ǀ áyuktāsaḥ ǀ abrahmátā ǀ yát ǀ ásan ǀtíṣṭha ǀ rátham ǀ ádhi ǀ tám ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ ā́ ǀ raśmím ǀ deva ǀ yamase ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, mightyIndra, those who, differing from us, and not united with you through their lack of devotion, are not yours; therefore, divine holder of of the thunderbolt, who are possessed of excellent horses, ascend the car, whose reins you guide, (to come to our sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रू यत्त॑ इन्द्र॒ सन्त्यु॒क्था गवे॑ च॒कर्थो॒र्वरा॑सु॒ युध्य॑न् । त॒त॒क्षे सूर्या॑य चि॒दोक॑सि॒ स्वे वृषा॑ स॒मत्सु॑ दा॒सस्य॒ नाम॑ चित्
shlokas.transliteration: purú ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sánti ǀ ukthā́ ǀ gáve ǀ cakártha ǀ urvárāsu ǀ yúdhyan ǀtatakṣé ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ cit ǀ ókasi ǀ své ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ samát-su ǀ dāsásya ǀ nā́ma ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as many praises are yours, therefore, combating for the sake of (shedding) water on fertile (lands), you have effected (the discomfiture of its obstructors); you, who are the showerer (of benefits), have on behalf of the sun, destroyed in his own dwelling the very name of (theasura),Dāsa, in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते त॑ इन्द्र॒ ये च॒ नर॒: शर्धो॑ जज्ञा॒ना या॒ताश्च॒ रथा॑: । आस्माञ्ज॑गम्यादहिशुष्म॒ सत्वा॒ भगो॒ न हव्य॑: प्रभृ॒थेषु॒ चारु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ náraḥ ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ jajñānā́ḥ ǀ yātā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ ráthāḥ ǀā́ ǀ asmā́n ǀ jagamyāt ǀ ahi-śuṣma ǀ sátvā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ pra-bhṛthéṣu ǀ cā́ruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We,Indra, are yours, and yours are they who are the leaders (of rites), promoters of (your) strength, and willing applicants (to you); all-powerful Indra, may adherents worthy of commendation and faithful, come to us, likeBhaga, in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒पृ॒क्षेण्य॑मिन्द्र॒ त्वे ह्योजो॑ नृ॒म्णानि॑ च नृ॒तमा॑नो॒ अम॑र्तः । स न॒ एनीं॑ वसवानो र॒यिं दा॒: प्रार्यः स्तु॑षे तुविम॒घस्य॒ दान॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: papṛkṣéṇyam ǀ indra ǀ tvé íti ǀ hí ǀ ójaḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ni ǀ ca ǀ nṛtámānaḥ ǀ ámartaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ énīm ǀ vasavānaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǀ prá ǀ aryáḥ ǀ stuṣe ǀ tuvi-maghásya ǀ dā́nam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorious,Indra, is your strength, exulting, immortal, and clothing (the world with light); do you give us riches, and brilliant wealth, and I will greatly praise the munificence of the opulent lord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑ इन्द्रो॒तिभि॑रव पा॒हि गृ॑ण॒तः शू॑र का॒रून् । उ॒त त्वचं॒ दद॑तो॒ वाज॑सातौ पिप्री॒हि मध्व॒: सुषु॑तस्य॒ चारो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ ava ǀ pāhí ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ śūra ǀ kārū́n ǀutá ǀ tvácam ǀ dádataḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ piprīhí ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ cā́roḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, with your protection defend us, praising and worshipping (you), and be propitiated (by drinking) of the well-effused and agreeableSomajuice that yields (a defensive) covering in combat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये मा॑ पौरुकु॒त्स्यस्य॑ सू॒रेस्त्र॒सद॑स्योर्हिर॒णिनो॒ ररा॑णाः । वह॑न्तु मा॒ दश॒ श्येता॑सो अस्य गैरिक्षि॒तस्य॒ क्रतु॑भि॒र्नु स॑श्चे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ mā ǀ pauru-kutsyásya ǀ sūréḥ ǀ trasádasyoḥ ǀ hiraṇínaḥ ǀ rárāṇāḥ ǀváhantu ǀ mā ǀ dáśa ǀ śyétāsaḥ ǀ asya ǀ gairi-kṣitásya ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ nú ǀ saśce ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those ten bright homes, the tift to me of the pious gold-possessingTrasadasyu, the son ofPurukutsa, of the raceof Girikṣita, convey me (to the sacrifice) and may I proceed quickly with the rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये मा॑ मारु॒ताश्व॑स्य॒ शोणा॒: क्रत्वा॑मघासो वि॒दथ॑स्य रा॒तौ । स॒हस्रा॑ मे॒ च्यव॑तानो॒ ददा॑न आनू॒कम॒र्यो वपु॑षे॒ नार्च॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ mā ǀ mārutá-aśvasya ǀ śóṇāḥ ǀ krátvā-maghāsaḥ ǀ vidáthasya ǀ rātáu ǀsahásrā ǀ me ǀ cyávatānaḥ ǀ dádānaḥ ǀ ānūkám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vápuṣe ǀ ná ǀ ārcat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may those bay, well-actioned horses, the donation ofVidhata, the son of Marutaśva, (convey me); or (may) the thousands (of treasure) which he was bestowing upon and giving to me, entitled to respect, and the ornaments which he presented (to decorate) the person n, (contribute to the ceremony).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये मा॑ ध्व॒न्य॑स्य॒ जुष्टा॑ लक्ष्म॒ण्य॑स्य सु॒रुचो॒ यता॑नाः । म॒ह्ना रा॒यः सं॒वर॑णस्य॒ ऋषे॑र्व्र॒जं न गाव॒: प्रय॑ता॒ अपि॑ ग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ mā ǀ dhvanyásya ǀ júṣṭāḥ ǀ lakṣmaṇyásya ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ yátānāḥ ǀmahnā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sam-váraṇasya ǀ ṛ́ṣeḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ prá-yatāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ gman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may the bright and active steeds bestowed upon me bydhvanya, the son ofLakṣmaṇa(bear me); the riches endowed with greatness, that have been presented, have passed (to the dwellings) of the ṚṣiSaṃvaraṇa, like cows to their stallṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजा॑तशत्रुम॒जरा॒ स्व॑र्व॒त्यनु॑ स्व॒धामि॑ता द॒स्ममी॑यते । सु॒नोत॑न॒ पच॑त॒ ब्रह्म॑वाहसे पुरुष्टु॒ताय॑ प्रत॒रं द॑धातन
shlokas.transliteration: ájāta-śatrum ǀ ajárā ǀ sváḥ-vatī ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́ ǀ ámitā ǀ dasmám ǀ īyate ǀsunótana ǀ pácata ǀ bráhma-vāhase ǀ puru-stutā́ya ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dadhātana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The undecaying, heaven-conferring, unlimited (sacrificial) food, goes to the tamer (of enemies), whose adversarie are unborn; therefore (priests) pour out (the libation), dress (the cakes and butter), diligently discharge (your offices) to him who is the accepter of prayer, who si glorified by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यः सोमे॑न ज॒ठर॒मपि॑प्र॒ताम॑न्दत म॒घवा॒ मध्वो॒ अन्ध॑सः । यदीं॑ मृ॒गाय॒ हन्त॑वे म॒हाव॑धः स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिमु॒शना॑ व॒धं यम॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ sómena ǀ jaṭháram ǀ ápiprata ǀ ámandata ǀ maghá-vā ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ mṛgā́ya ǀ hántave ǀ mahā́-vadhaḥ ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭim ǀ uśánā ǀ vadhám ǀ yámat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, who fills his belly with theSoma, to be exhilarated (by drinking) of the sweet-savoured beverage, whereupon he has lifted up his destructive thousand-edged weapon, desiring to slay (theasura) Mmṛga.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑स्मै घ्रं॒स उ॒त वा॒ य ऊध॑नि॒ सोमं॑ सु॒नोति॒ भव॑ति द्यु॒माँ अह॑ । अपा॑प श॒क्रस्त॑त॒नुष्टि॑मूहति त॒नूशु॑भ्रं म॒घवा॒ यः क॑वास॒खः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ghraṃsé ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ū́dhani ǀ sómam ǀ sunóti ǀ bhávati ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ áha ǀápa-apa ǀ śakráḥ ǀ tatanúṣṭim ǀ ūhati ǀ tanū́-śubhram ǀ maghá-vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ kava-sakháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who pours out the libation to thatIndra, by day or by night, undoubtely becomes illustrious;Śakradisregards tthe man who is proud of his descendants and vain of his person n, and who, though wealthy, is the friend of the base.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्याव॑धीत्पि॒तरं॒ यस्य॑ मा॒तरं॒ यस्य॑ श॒क्रो भ्रात॑रं॒ नात॑ ईषते । वेतीद्व॑स्य॒ प्रय॑ता यतंक॒रो न किल्बि॑षादीषते॒ वस्व॑ आक॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ávadhīt ǀ pitáram ǀ yásya ǀ mātáram ǀ yásya ǀ śakráḥ ǀ bhrā́taram ǀ ná ǀ átaḥ ǀ īṣate ǀvéti ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ prá-yatā ǀ yatam-karáḥ ǀ ná ǀ kílbiṣāt ǀ īṣate ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ā-karáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śakradoes not turn away from him whose father, whose mother, whose brother he has slain, but is willing to accept his offerings; the regulator (of acts), the bestower of riches, does not turn away from iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न प॒ञ्चभि॑र्द॒शभि॑र्वष्ट्या॒रभं॒ नासु॑न्वता सचते॒ पुष्य॑ता च॒न । जि॒नाति॒ वेद॑मु॒या हन्ति॑ वा॒ धुनि॒रा दे॑व॒युं भ॑जति॒ गोम॑ति व्र॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ pañcá-bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ ā-rábham ǀ ná ǀ ásunvatā ǀ sacate ǀ púṣyatā ǀ caná ǀjinā́ti ǀ vā ǀ ít ǀ amuyā́ ǀ hánti ǀ vā ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ deva-yúm ǀ bhajati ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He desires not (association in) enterprises with five or with ten; he associates not with the man who does not present libations; and cherishes not (his dependents) may, the terrifier (of foes) punishes him or slays him, but he plural ces the devout man in a pasturage stocked with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒त्वक्ष॑ण॒: समृ॑तौ चक्रमास॒जोऽसु॑न्वतो॒ विषु॑णः सुन्व॒तो वृ॒धः । इन्द्रो॒ विश्व॑स्य दमि॒ता वि॒भीष॑णो यथाव॒शं न॑यति॒ दास॒मार्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vi-tvákṣaṇaḥ ǀ sám-ṛtau ǀ cakram-āsajáḥ ǀ ásunvataḥ ǀ víṣuṇaḥ ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ damitā́ ǀ vi-bhī́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ yathā-vaśám ǀ nayati ǀ dā́sam ǀ ā́ryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thinning (his enemies) in battle, and accelerating the wheels (of his car), he turns away from him who offers no libation, and augments (the prosperity of) the offerer;Indra, the subduer of all, the formidable, the lord, conducts theDāsaat his plural asure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समीं॑ प॒णेर॑जति॒ भोज॑नं मु॒षे वि दा॒शुषे॑ भजति सू॒नरं॒ वसु॑ । दु॒र्गे च॒न ध्रि॑यते॒ विश्व॒ आ पु॒रु जनो॒ यो अ॑स्य॒ तवि॑षी॒मचु॑क्रुधत्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ īm ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ ajati ǀ bhójanam ǀ muṣé ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ bhajati ǀ sūnáram ǀ vásu ǀduḥ-gé ǀ caná ǀ dhriyate ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ purú ǀ jánaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ táviṣīm ǀ ácukrudhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He proceeds to plural nder the wealth of the (avaricious), and bestows the riches that are prized by man upon the donor (of the libation); every man is involved in great difficulty who provokes the might ofIndrato wrath.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यज्जनौ॑ सु॒धनौ॑ वि॒श्वश॑र्धसा॒ववे॒दिन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॒ गोषु॑ शु॒भ्रिषु॑ । युजं॒ ह्य१॒॑न्यमकृ॑त प्रवेप॒न्युदीं॒ गव्यं॑ सृजते॒ सत्व॑भि॒र्धुनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ jánau ǀ su-dhánau ǀ viśvá-śardhasau ǀ ávet ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ góṣu ǀ śubhríṣu ǀyújam ǀ hí ǀ anyám ǀ ákṛta ǀ pra-vepanī́ ǀ út ǀ īm ǀ gávyam ǀ sṛjate ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ dhúniḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndra, the possessor of opulence, discriminates between two men, both wealthy, and exerting themselves (against each other) for the sake of valuable cattle, he takes one of them as his associate, causing (his adversaries) to tremble, and the agitator (of the clouds), together with theMaruts, bestows upon him herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ह॒स्र॒सामाग्नि॑वेशिं गृणीषे॒ शत्रि॑मग्न उप॒मां के॒तुम॒र्यः । तस्मा॒ आप॑: सं॒यत॑: पीपयन्त॒ तस्मि॑न्क्ष॒त्रमम॑वत्त्वे॒षम॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sahasra-sā́m ǀ ā́gni-veśim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ śátrim ǀ agne ǀ upa-mā́m ǀ ketúm ǀ aryáḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀ pīpayanta ǀ tásmin ǀ kṣatrám ǀ áma-vat ǀ tveṣám ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I,Arya,Agni, praiseŚatri, the son ofAgniveśa, the bestower of thousands, a type for comparison; may the collected waters yield him abundance; may wealth and strength, and glory be upon him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ साधि॒ष्ठोऽव॑स॒ इन्द्र॒ क्रतु॒ष्टमा भ॑र । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ चर्षणी॒सहं॒ सस्निं॒ वाजे॑षु दु॒ष्टर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sā́dhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ índra ǀ krátuḥ ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀasmábhyam ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǀ sásnim ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ dustáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Perfect for our protection,Indra, that your act which is most effective, which is the subduer of men, holy, and difficult to be encountered in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र ते॒ चत॑स्रो॒ यच्छू॑र॒ सन्ति॑ ति॒स्रः । यद्वा॒ पञ्च॑ क्षिती॒नामव॒स्तत्सु न॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ yát ǀ śūra ǀ sánti ǀ tisráḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever protections,Indra, may be yours, whether four, or, hero, three, or those accorded to the five (classes) of men, bestow them freely upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तेऽवो॒ वरे॑ण्यं॒ वृष॑न्तमस्य हूमहे । वृष॑जूति॒र्हि ज॑ज्ञि॒ष आ॒भूभि॑रिन्द्र तु॒र्वणि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ vṛ́ṣan-tamasya ǀ hūmahe ǀvṛ́ṣa-jūtiḥ ǀ hí ǀ jajñiṣé ǀ ā-bhū́bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ turváṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the desirable protection of you, the most liberal showerer (of benefits); that (protection) which you, the distributor of rain, the quick destroyer (of foes), grant, (associated) with the present (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ ह्यसि॒ राध॑से जज्ञि॒षे वृष्णि॑ ते॒ शव॑: । स्वक्ष॑त्रं ते धृ॒षन्मन॑: सत्रा॒हमि॑न्द्र॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ rā́dhase ǀ jajñiṣé ǀ vṛ́ṣṇi ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀsvá-kṣatram ǀ te ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ mánaḥ ǀ satrā-hám ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the showerer (of benefits); you are born to (bestow) riches; your strength rains (blessings); your self-invigorated mind is the restrainer (of adversaies); your manhood,Indra, is the destroyer of multitudes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तमि॑न्द्र॒ मर्त्य॑ममित्र॒यन्त॑मद्रिवः । स॒र्व॒र॒था श॑तक्रतो॒ नि या॑हि शवसस्पते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ mártyam ǀ amitra-yántam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀsarva-rathā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ní ǀ yāhi ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, rider in all-pervading car, object of many rites, and lord of strength, proceed against the mortal who entertains hostility towards you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृ॑त्रहन्तम॒ जना॑सो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । उ॒ग्रं पू॒र्वीषु॑ पू॒र्व्यं हव॑न्ते॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀugrám ǀ pūrvī́ṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀ hávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, men with clipped sacred grass invoked you, who are fierce and foremost among many, for aid in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मिन्द्र दु॒ष्टरं॑ पुरो॒यावा॑नमा॒जिषु॑ । स॒यावा॑नं॒ धने॑धने वाज॒यन्त॑मवा॒ रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ indra ǀ dustáram ǀ puraḥ-yā́vānam ǀ ājíṣu ǀsa-yā́vānam ǀ dháne-dhane ǀ vāja-yántam ǀ ava ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Defend,Indra, our chariot, difficult (to be stopped), mingling foremost in combats, followed by attendants, and eagerly striving for repeated spoil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मि॒न्द्रेहि॑ नो॒ रथ॑मवा॒ पुरं॑ध्या । व॒यं श॑विष्ठ॒ वार्यं॑ दि॒वि श्रवो॑ दधीमहि दि॒वि स्तोमं॑ मनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ naḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ava ǀ púram-dhyā ǀvayám ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ vā́ryam ǀ diví ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dadhīmahi ǀ diví ǀ stómam ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to us; defend by yourprovidenceour car; we contemplate in you who, most mighty one, are divine, all desirable vigour; (to you), who are divine, we offer praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स आ ग॑म॒दिन्द्रो॒ यो वसू॑नां॒ चिके॑त॒द्दातुं॒ दाम॑नो रयी॒णाम् । ध॒न्व॒च॒रो न वंस॑गस्तृषा॒णश्च॑कमा॒नः पि॑बतु दु॒ग्धमं॒शुम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ cíketat ǀ dā́tum ǀ dā́manaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀdhanva-caráḥ ǀ ná ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀ tṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ cakamānáḥ ǀ pibatu ǀ dugdhám ǀ aṃśúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatIndrawho is the donor of wealth, who knows (how) to distribute riches, come (to our sacrifice) marching boldly like a warrior; and may he, being thirsty, and desirous (of the draught), drink of the effusedSomajuice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॒ हनू॑ हरिवः शूर॒ शिप्रे॒ रुह॒त्सोमो॒ न पर्व॑तस्य पृ॒ष्ठे । अनु॑ त्वा राज॒न्नर्व॑तो॒ न हि॒न्वन्गी॒र्भिर्म॑देम पुरुहूत॒ विश्वे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ hánū íti ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ śūra ǀ śípre íti ǀ rúhat ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatasya ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀánu ǀ tvā ǀ rājan ǀ árvataḥ ǀ ná ǀ hinván ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ madema ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero, lord of horses, may theSoma, ascend to your destructive jaw, as if to the summit of a mountain; may we all, royalIndra, who are invoked of many, give plural asure to you with our hymns, as to horses with fodder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒क्रं न वृ॒त्तं पु॑रुहूत वेपते॒ मनो॑ भि॒या मे॒ अम॑ते॒रिद॑द्रिवः । रथा॒दधि॑ त्वा जरि॒ता स॑दावृध कु॒विन्नु स्तो॑षन्मघवन्पुरू॒वसु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: cakrám ǀ ná ǀ vṛttám ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vepate ǀ mánaḥ ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ me ǀ ámateḥ ǀ ít ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀráthāt ǀ ádhi ǀ tvā ǀ jaritā́ ǀ sadā-vṛdha ǀ kuvít ǀ nú ǀ stoṣam ǀ magha-van ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, the invoked of many, my mind trembles through dread of poverty like a whirling wheel;Maghavan, ever prosperous, may your worshipper,Puruvasu, praise you promptly and abundantly, seated in your chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष ग्रावे॑व जरि॒ता त॑ इ॒न्द्रेय॑र्ति॒ वाचं॑ बृ॒हदा॑शुषा॒णः । प्र स॒व्येन॑ मघव॒न्यंसि॑ रा॒यः प्र द॑क्षि॒णिद्ध॑रिवो॒ मा वि वे॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ grā́vā-iva ǀ jaritā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ bṛhát ǀ āśuṣāṇáḥ ǀprá ǀ savyéna ǀ magha-van ǀ yáṃsi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ prá ǀ dakṣiṇít ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This your adorer,Indra, like the stone (that expresses theSomajuice), urges praise to you, participating in the great (reward); you bestow,Maghavan, riches with your lefthand, you bestow them, lord of horses, with the right be not reluctant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ त्वा॒ वृष॑णं वर्धतु॒ द्यौर्वृषा॒ वृष॑भ्यां वहसे॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । स नो॒ वृषा॒ वृष॑रथः सुशिप्र॒ वृष॑क्रतो॒ वृषा॑ वज्रि॒न्भरे॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vardhatu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhyām ǀ vahase ǀ hári-bhyām ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣa-rathaḥ ǀ su-śipra ǀ vṛ́ṣakrato íti vṛ́ṣa-krato ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vajrin ǀ bháre ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the effective eulogium melt you, the showerer (of benefits); you, the showerer, are borne (to the sacrifice) by vigorous steeds sender of rain, you of the handsome shin, wielder of the thunderbolt, showerer, whose car showers down (blessings), do you defend us in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो रोहि॑तौ वा॒जिनौ॑ वा॒जिनी॑वान्त्रि॒भिः श॒तैः सच॑माना॒वदि॑ष्ट । यूने॒ सम॑स्मै क्षि॒तयो॑ नमन्तां श्रु॒तर॑थाय मरुतो दुवो॒या
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ róhitau ǀ vājínau ǀ vājínī-vān ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ śatáiḥ ǀ sácamānau ǀ ádiṣṭa ǀyū́ne ǀ sám ǀ asmai ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ namantām ǀ śrutá-rathāya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ duvaḥ-yā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, may all men bow in obedience to that youthful Śrutaratha, the possessor of abundance, who has bestowed (upon us) two bay steeds accompanied by three hundred (cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं भा॒नुना॑ यतते॒ सूर्य॑स्या॒जुह्वा॑नो घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठ॒: स्वञ्चा॑: । तस्मा॒ अमृ॑ध्रा उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑च्छा॒न्य इन्द्रा॑य सु॒नवा॒मेत्याह॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ bhānúnā ǀ yatate ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ā-júhvānaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭhaḥ ǀ su-áñcāḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ámṛdhrāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ucchān ǀ yáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sunávāma ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The piously worshipped (Agni), when invoked, glistening with the oblation, vies with the splendour of the sun; may the dawns rise innoxious to him who says, let us offer oblations toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धाग्निर्वनवत्स्ती॒र्णब॑र्हिर्यु॒क्तग्रा॑वा सु॒तसो॑मो जराते । ग्रावा॑णो॒ यस्ये॑षि॒रं वद॒न्त्यय॑दध्व॒र्युर्ह॒विषाव॒ सिन्धु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sámiddha-agniḥ ǀ vanavat ǀ stīrṇá-barhiḥ ǀ yuktá-grāvā ǀ sutá-somaḥ ǀ jarāte ǀgrā́vāṇaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ iṣirám ǀ vádanti ǀ áyat ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ áva ǀ síndhum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whose fire is kindled, whose sacred grass is strewn, offers worship; he whose stone is uplifted, whoseSomajuice is effused, offers praise; the priests, of whom the stones utter the sounds of bruising, descends with the oblation (for previous ablution) to the stream.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒धूरि॒यं पति॑मि॒च्छन्त्ये॑ति॒ य ईं॒ वहा॑ते॒ महि॑षीमिषि॒राम् । आस्य॑ श्रवस्या॒द्रथ॒ आ च॑ घोषात्पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॒ परि॑ वर्तयाते
shlokas.transliteration: vadhū́ḥ ǀ iyám ǀ pátim ǀ icchántī ǀ eti ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ váhāte ǀ máhiṣīm ǀ iṣirā́m ǀā́ ǀ asya ǀ śravasyāt ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ ghoṣāt ǀ purú ǀ sahásrā ǀ pári ǀ vartayāte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bride (ofIndra), devoted to her lord, attends him (to the rite), who thus brings (with him) his accompanyingqueen; may his car convey to us ample food; may it sound loudly; may it scatter around many thousands (of riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न स राजा॑ व्यथते॒ यस्मि॒न्निन्द्र॑स्ती॒व्रं सोमं॒ पिब॑ति॒ गोस॑खायम् । आ स॑त्व॒नैरज॑ति॒ हन्ति॑ वृ॒त्रं क्षेति॑ क्षि॒तीः सु॒भगो॒ नाम॒ पुष्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ vyathate ǀ yásmin ǀ índraḥ ǀ tīvrám ǀ sómam ǀ píbati ǀ gó-sakhāyam ǀā́ ǀ satvanáiḥ ǀ ájati ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ kṣéti ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ púṣyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That prince suffers no evil in whose realmIndradrinks the sharpSomajuice mixed with milk; attended by faithful (followers), he moves (in all directions); he destroys his enemy, he protects his subjects enjoying prosperity, he cherishes the name of (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुष्या॒त्क्षेमे॑ अ॒भि योगे॑ भवात्यु॒भे वृतौ॑ संय॒ती सं ज॑याति । प्रि॒यः सूर्ये॑ प्रि॒यो अ॒ग्ना भ॑वाति॒ य इन्द्रा॑य सु॒तसो॑मो॒ ददा॑शत्
shlokas.transliteration: púṣyāt ǀ kṣéme ǀ abhí ǀ yóge ǀ bhavāti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ vṛ́tau ǀ saṃyatī́ íti sam-yatī́ ǀ sám ǀ jayāti ǀpriyáḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ priyáḥ ǀ agnā́ ǀ bhavāti ǀ yáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sutá-somaḥ ǀ dádāśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He cherishes (his kin); he (reigns) in welfare and prosperity; he is victorious in present and continuous (time); dear is he to the sun, dear toAgni, who, with prepared libation, offers it toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रोष्ट॑ इन्द्र॒ राध॑सो वि॒भ्वी रा॒तिः श॑तक्रतो । अधा॑ नो विश्वचर्षणे द्यु॒म्ना सु॑क्षत्र मंहय
shlokas.transliteration: uróḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ vi-bhvī́ ǀ rātíḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀádha ǀ naḥ ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ maṃhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraof many exploits, liberal is the distribution of your abundnat riches; therefore, all-beholder, possessor of excellent wealth, bestow upon us opulence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॑मिन्द्र श्र॒वाय्य॒मिषं॑ शविष्ठ दधि॒षे । प॒प्र॒थे दी॑र्घ॒श्रुत्त॑मं॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्ण दु॒ष्टर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ indra ǀ śravā́yyam ǀ íṣam ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ dadhiṣé ǀpaprathé ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamam ǀ híraṇya-varṇa ǀ dustáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although, most mightyIndra, you possess well-known abundance (of food), yet golden-hued (deity) it is most notoriously reported as difficult(to be procured).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुष्मा॑सो॒ ये ते॑ अद्रिवो मे॒हना॑ केत॒साप॑: । उ॒भा दे॒वाव॒भिष्ट॑ये दि॒वश्च॒ ग्मश्च॑ राजथः
shlokas.transliteration: śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ mehánā ǀ keta-sā́paḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ deváu ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ rājathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, yours are the strong (Maruts), who are adorable, and whose exploits are renowned; both divinities, (you and they), rule at plural asure over heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो नो॑ अ॒स्य कस्य॑ चि॒द्दक्ष॑स्य॒ तव॑ वृत्रहन् । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ नृ॒म्णमा भ॑रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ नृमणस्यसे
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀ dákṣasya ǀ táva ǀ vṛtra-han ǀasmábhyam ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ asmábhyam ǀ nṛ-manasyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, bring to us, your (worshippers), the wealth of any powerful (man) whatsoever, for you are disposed to enrich us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू त॑ आ॒भिर॒भिष्टि॑भि॒स्तव॒ शर्म॑ञ्छतक्रतो । इन्द्र॒ स्याम॑ सुगो॒पाः शूर॒ स्याम॑ सुगो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ te ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ śárman ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀíndra ǀ syā́ma ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǀ śū́ra ǀ syā́ma ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we,Śatakratu, speedily (partake of) your felicity through these our prayers; may we be well secured,Indra, (by you); may we be carefully protected, hero, by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र चित्र मे॒हनास्ति॒ त्वादा॑तमद्रिवः । राध॒स्तन्नो॑ विदद्वस उभयाह॒स्त्या भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ citra ǀ mehánā ǀ ásti ǀ tvā́-dātam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀrā́dhaḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ vidadvaso íti vidat-vaso ǀ ubhayāhastí ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WonderfulIndra, wielder of the thunderbolt, since precious treasure is to be distributed by you, bestow it, possessor of riches, with bothhands, upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्मन्य॑से॒ वरे॑ण्य॒मिन्द्र॑ द्यु॒क्षं तदा भ॑र । वि॒द्याम॒ तस्य॑ ते व॒यमकू॑पारस्य दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ mányase ǀ váreṇyam ǀ índra ǀ dyukṣám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀvidyā́ma ǀ tásya ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ ákūpārasya ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever food you consider desirable,Indra, bestow it; let us be to you (in the relation of your) gift of unlimited sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ दि॒त्सु प्र॒राध्यं॒ मनो॒ अस्ति॑ श्रु॒तं बृ॒हत् । तेन॑ दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑दद्रिव॒ आ वाजं॑ दर्षि सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ ditsú ǀ pra-rā́dhyam ǀ mánaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ śrutám ǀ bṛhát ǀténa ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ darṣi ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since your bountiful and praiseworthy will is notorious and vast, therefore, thunder, you have made ready for bestowing upon us substantial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मंहि॑ष्ठं वो म॒घोनां॒ राजा॑नं चर्षणी॒नाम् । इन्द्र॒मुप॒ प्रश॑स्तये पू॒र्वीभि॑र्जुजुषे॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: máṃhiṣṭham ǀ vaḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ rā́jānam ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀíndram ǀ úpa ǀ prá-śastaye ǀ pūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ jujuṣe ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With ancient (hymns) the pious approachIndra, to laud him who is most worthy of the beverage (the offering) of you who are opulent; (him) who is theking of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्मा॒ इत्काव्यं॒ वच॑ उ॒क्थमिन्द्रा॑य॒ शंस्य॑म् । तस्मा॑ उ॒ ब्रह्म॑वाहसे॒ गिरो॑ वर्ध॒न्त्यत्र॑यो॒ गिर॑: शुम्भ॒न्त्यत्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ásmai ǀ ít ǀ kā́vyam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ ukthám ǀ índrāya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀtásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bráhma-vāhase ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ átrayaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhanti ǀ átrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thatIndra, is the poetical and articulate prayer to be recited; to him the conveyers of pious praise, the sons ofAtri, raise their hymns; the sons of Atri illume their hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॒ह्यद्रि॑भिः सु॒तं सोमं॑ सोमपते पिब । वृष॑न्निन्द्र॒ वृष॑भिर्वृत्रहन्तम
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ soma-pate ǀ piba ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, (to our sacrifice); drink, lord of theSoma, of the juice expressed by the stones; showerer (of benefits), utter destroyer ofVṛtra, (come) with the showering (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ ग्रावा॒ वृषा॒ मदो॒ वृषा॒ सोमो॑ अ॒यं सु॒तः । वृष॑न्निन्द्र॒ वृष॑भिर्वृत्रहन्तम
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ grā́vā ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sutáḥ ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The stone is the showerer, the inebriation is the showerer, this effusedSomais the showerer; showerer (of benefits),Indra, utter destroyer ofVṛtra, come with the showering (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ त्वा॒ वृष॑णं हुवे॒ वज्रि॑ञ्चि॒त्राभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । वृष॑न्निन्द्र॒ वृष॑भिर्वृत्रहन्तम
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ huve ǀ vájrin ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effusing the libation, I invoke you, the showerer (of benefits), for your marvellous protections; showerer (of benefits),Indra, utter destroyer ofVṛtra, come with the showering (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जी॒षी व॒ज्री वृ॑ष॒भस्तु॑रा॒षाट् छु॒ष्मी राजा॑ वृत्र॒हा सो॑म॒पावा॑ । यु॒क्त्वा हरि॑भ्या॒मुप॑ यासद॒र्वाङ्माध्यं॑दिने॒ सव॑ने मत्स॒दिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjīṣī́ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ turāṣā́ṭ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ rā́jā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ soma-pā́vā ǀyuktvā́ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ úpa ǀ yāsat ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ mā́dhyandine ǀ sávane ǀ matsat ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the accepter of the spiritless libation, the wilder of the thunderbolt, the showerer (of benefits), the overcomer of quick- (flying foes), the mighty, the monarch, the slayer ofVṛtra, the drinker of theSoma, having harnessed his horses, come down (to us); mayIndrabe exhilarated at the mid-day sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्त्वा॑ सूर्य॒ स्व॑र्भानु॒स्तम॒सावि॑ध्यदासु॒रः । अक्षे॑त्रवि॒द्यथा॑ मु॒ग्धो भुव॑नान्यदीधयुः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ sūrya ǀ sváḥ-bhānuḥ ǀ támasā ǀ ávidhyat ǀ āsuráḥ ǀákṣetra-vit ǀ yáthā ǀ mugdháḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ adīdhayuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Sūrya, the son of theAsuraSvarbhānu, overspread you with darkness, the worlds were beheld like one bewildered knowing not his plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॑र्भानो॒रध॒ यदि॑न्द्र मा॒या अ॒वो दि॒वो वर्त॑माना अ॒वाह॑न् । गू॒ळ्हं सूर्यं॒ तम॒साप॑व्रतेन तु॒रीये॑ण॒ ब्रह्म॑णाविन्द॒दत्रि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sváḥ-bhānoḥ ǀ ádha ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ māyā́ ǀ aváḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ vártamānāḥ ǀ ava-áhan ǀgūḷhám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ támasā ǀ ápa-vratena ǀ turī́yeṇa ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ avindat ǀ átriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, you were dissipating those illusions ofSvarbhānuwhich were spread below the sun, thenAtri, by his fourth sacred prayer, discovered the sun concealed by the darkness impeding his functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा मामि॒मं तव॒ सन्त॑मत्र इर॒स्या द्रु॒ग्धो भि॒यसा॒ नि गा॑रीत् । त्वं मि॒त्रो अ॑सि स॒त्यरा॑धा॒स्तौ मे॒हाव॑तं॒ वरु॑णश्च॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ mā́m ǀ imám ǀ táva ǀ sántam ǀ atre ǀ irasyā́ ǀ drugdháḥ ǀ bhiyásā ǀ ní ǀ gārīt ǀtvám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ asi ǀ satyá-rādhāḥ ǀ táu ǀ mā ǀ ihá ǀ avatam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūryaspeaks: Let not the violator,Atri, through hunger, swallow with fearful (darkness) me who am yours; you areMitra, whose wealth is truth; do you and the royalVaruṇaboth protect me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्राव्णो॑ ब्र॒ह्मा यु॑युजा॒नः स॑प॒र्यन्की॒रिणा॑ दे॒वान्नम॑सोप॒शिक्ष॑न् । अत्रि॒: सूर्य॑स्य दि॒वि चक्षु॒राधा॒त्स्व॑र्भानो॒रप॑ मा॒या अ॑घुक्षत्
shlokas.transliteration: grā́vṇaḥ ǀ brahmā́ ǀ yuyujānáḥ ǀ saparyán ǀ kīríṇā ǀ devā́n ǀ námasā ǀ upa-śíkṣan ǀátriḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ diví ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ adhāt ǀ sváḥ-bhānoḥ ǀ ápa ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ aghukṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then theBrahman, (Atri), applying the stones together, propitiating the gods with praise, and adoring them with reverence, plural ced the eye ofSūryain the sky; he dispersed the delusions ofSvarbhānu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं वै सूर्यं॒ स्व॑र्भानु॒स्तम॒सावि॑ध्यदासु॒रः । अत्र॑य॒स्तमन्व॑विन्दन्न॒ह्य१॒॑न्ये अश॑क्नुवन्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ vái ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sváḥ-bhānuḥ ǀ támasā ǀ ávidhyat ǀ āsuráḥ ǀátrayaḥ ǀ tám ǀ ánu ǀ avindan ǀ nahí ǀ anyé ǀ áśaknuvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun, whom theAsura,Svarbhānu, had enveloped with darkness, the sons ofAtrisubsequently recovered; no others were able (to effect his release).”

shlokas.sanskrit: को नु वां॑ मित्रावरुणावृता॒यन्दि॒वो वा॑ म॒हः पार्थि॑वस्य वा॒ दे । ऋ॒तस्य॑ वा॒ सद॑सि॒ त्रासी॑थां नो यज्ञाय॒ते वा॑ पशु॒षो न वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛta-yán ǀ diváḥ ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ vā ǀ dé ǀṛtásya ǀ vā ǀ sádasi ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǀ yajña-yaté ǀ vā ǀ paśu-sáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jān ǁ
