shlokas.meaning_en: “Who,MitraandVaruṇa, desiring to sacrifice to you, (is able to do so)? do you, whether (abiding) in the region of heaven, or of the vast earth, or of the firmament, protect us, and give to the donor (of the oblation), and to the sacrificer, cattle and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो अर्य॒मायुरिन्द्र॑ ऋभु॒क्षा म॒रुतो॑ जुषन्त । नमो॑भिर्वा॒ ये दध॑ते सुवृ॒क्तिं स्तोमं॑ रु॒द्राय॑ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ āyúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀnámaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ dádhate ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ stómam ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those divinities,MitraandVaruṇa,Aryaman, Āyu,Indra,Ṛbhukṣin, theMarutswho accept pious praise, be plural ased by our adorations, partaking of the gratification afforded toRudra, the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ येष्ठा॑श्विना हु॒वध्यै॒ वात॑स्य॒ पत्म॒न्रथ्य॑स्य पु॒ष्टौ । उ॒त वा॑ दि॒वो असु॑राय॒ मन्म॒ प्रान्धां॑सीव॒ यज्य॑वे भरध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ yéṣṭhā ǀ aśvinā ǀ huvádhyai ǀ vā́tasya ǀ pátman ǀ ráthyasya ǀ puṣṭáu ǀutá ǀ vā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ásurāya ǀ mánma ǀ prá ǀ ándhāṃsi-iva ǀ yájyave ǀ bharadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you,Aśvins, the restrainers (of desire), for the acceleration ofyour chariot with the swiftness of the wind; (priests) offer praise and oblations to the celestial destroyer of life, to the accmplisher of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒क्षणो॑ दि॒व्यः कण्व॑होता त्रि॒तो दि॒वः स॒जोषा॒ वातो॑ अ॒ग्निः । पू॒षा भग॑: प्रभृ॒थे वि॒श्वभो॑जा आ॒जिं न ज॑ग्मुरा॒श्व॑श्वतमाः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sakṣáṇaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ káṇva-hotā ǀ tritáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀpūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ pra-bhṛthé ǀ viśvá-bhojāḥ ǀ ājím ǀ ná ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ āśváśva-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine accepter of sacrifice, of whom theKaṇvasare the priests,Tṛta,VāyuandAgni, concurring in satisfaction with (the ruler of) heaven, or (Sūryaand)PūṣanandBhaga, and they who are the protectors of the universe, (come quickly) to the sacrifice, as the fleet course rush to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ र॒यिं यु॒क्ताश्वं॑ भरध्वं रा॒य एषेऽव॑से दधीत॒ धीः । सु॒शेव॒ एवै॑रौशि॒जस्य॒ होता॒ ये व॒ एवा॑ मरुतस्तु॒राणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ yuktá-aśvam ǀ bharadhvam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ éṣe ǀ ávase ǀ dadhīta ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀsu-śévaḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ auśijásya ǀ hótā ǀ yé ǀ vaḥ ǀ évāḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ turā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, do you bring wealth comprising horses; to acquire and preserve riches the wise man offers you praise; may the ministrant priest, (Atri), of the son of Uśij (Kakṣīvat), be made happy by those swift-going (horses) which are the swift-going (horses), Maruts, of you who are rapid in motion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ वा॒युं र॑थ॒युजं॑ कृणुध्वं॒ प्र दे॒वं विप्रं॑ पनि॒तार॑म॒र्कैः । इ॒षु॒ध्यव॑ ऋत॒साप॒: पुरं॑धी॒र्वस्वी॑र्नो॒ अत्र॒ पत्नी॒रा धि॒ये धु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ ratha-yújam ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ devám ǀ vípram ǀ panitā́ram ǀ arkáiḥ ǀiṣudhyávaḥ ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhiyé ǀ dhuríti dhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prevail, (priests), by your prayers, onVāyu, the divine, the fulfiller of desires, the adorable, to harness his chariot; may the light-moving accepters of sacrifice, the lovely and excellent wives (of the gods), come hither to our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ व॒ एषे॒ वन्द्ये॑भिः शू॒षैः प्र य॒ह्वी दि॒वश्चि॒तय॑द्भिर॒र्कैः । उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ वि॒दुषी॑व॒ विश्व॒मा हा॑ वहतो॒ मर्त्या॑य य॒ज्ञम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ éṣe ǀ vándyebhiḥ ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ prá ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ diváḥ ǀ citáyat-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀuṣásānáktā ǀ vidúṣī ivéti vidúṣī-iva ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ ha ǀ vahataḥ ǀ mártyāya ǀ yajñám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty Day and Night, to you, along with the adorable (deities) of heaven, I present (the oblation) with prayers delighting and explicit; knowing, like two sages, all (that is required), do you bring (it) to the worshipper for his sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वो॑ अर्चे पो॒ष्याव॑तो॒ नॄन्वास्तो॒ष्पतिं॒ त्वष्टा॑रं॒ ररा॑णः । धन्या॑ स॒जोषा॑ धि॒षणा॒ नमो॑भि॒र्वन॒स्पतीँ॒रोष॑धी रा॒य एषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ arce ǀ poṣyā́-vataḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ vā́stoḥ ǀ pátim ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀdhányā ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ éṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify you, leaders (of rites), cherishers (of many), gratifying (with oblation, you)Tvaṣṭāthe lord of foundations, and the goddess of speech, bestower of opulence, and share in the satisfaction (of the other divinities); also the lords of the forest, and the herbs, that I may obtain riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तु॒जे न॒स्तने॒ पर्व॑ताः सन्तु॒ स्वैत॑वो॒ ये वस॑वो॒ न वी॒राः । प॒नि॒त आ॒प्त्यो य॑ज॒तः सदा॑ नो॒ वर्धा॑न्न॒: शंसं॒ नर्यो॑ अ॒भिष्टौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: tujé ǀ naḥ ǀ táne ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ santu ǀ svá-etavaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀpanitáḥ ǀ āptyáḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǀ várdhāt ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsam ǀ náryaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theParvatasbe (bountiful) to us in liberal donations; may they be favourable (to us) who are the establishers (of the world) like heroes; may the adored and adorable (deity), who is accessible (to all), who is friendly to man, ever grant us increase, being propitiated by our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष्णो॑ अस्तोषि भू॒म्यस्य॒ गर्भं॑ त्रि॒तो नपा॑तम॒पां सु॑वृ॒क्ति । गृ॒णी॒ते अ॒ग्निरे॒तरी॒ न शू॒षैः शो॒चिष्के॑शो॒ नि रि॑णाति॒ वना॑
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ astoṣi ǀ bhūmyásya ǀ gárbham ǀ tritáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ apā́m ǀ su-vṛktí ǀgṛṇīté ǀ agníḥ ǀ etári ǀ ná ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ śocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ ní ǀ riṇāti ǀ vánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with unqualified praise the embryo of the earth-fertilizing rain, the grandson of the waters,Agni, who is threefold, who rages (upon me) not, when travelling with (his) withering rays, but, bright-haired consumes the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था म॒हे रु॒द्रिया॑य ब्रवाम॒ कद्रा॒ये चि॑कि॒तुषे॒ भगा॑य । आप॒ ओष॑धीरु॒त नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ द्यौर्वना॑ गि॒रयो॑ वृ॒क्षके॑शाः
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ mahé ǀ rudríyāya ǀ bravāma ǀ kát ǀ rāyé ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ bhágāya ǀā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ avantu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ vánā ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ vṛkṣá-keśāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Howcan we offer (fit praise) to the mighty posterity ofRudra, or to the all-knowingBhaga, for (the sake of obtaining) riches; may the waters, may the plural nts, protect us, and the heaven, the woods, and the mountains, whose tresses are trees.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒णोतु॑ न ऊ॒र्जां पति॒र्गिर॒: स नभ॒स्तरी॑याँ इषि॒रः परि॑ज्मा । शृ॒ण्वन्त्वाप॒: पुरो॒ न शु॒भ्राः परि॒ स्रुचो॑ बबृहा॒णस्याद्रे॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjā́m ǀ pátiḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ tárīyān ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀśṛṇvántu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ srúcaḥ ǀ babṛhāṇásya ǀ ádreḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the lord of vigour, (Vāyu), hear our prayers, he who traverses the firmament, the circumambient; may the waters hear, bright as cities, flowing round the towering mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दा चि॒न्नु म॑हान्तो॒ ये व॒ एवा॒ ब्रवा॑म दस्मा॒ वार्यं॒ दधा॑नाः । वय॑श्च॒न सु॒भ्व१॒॑ आव॑ यन्ति क्षु॒भा मर्त॒मनु॑यतं वध॒स्नैः
shlokas.transliteration: vidá ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ mahāntaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vaḥ ǀ évāḥ ǀ brávāma ǀ dasmāḥ ǀ vā́ryam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀváyaḥ ǀ caná ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ áva ǀ yanti ǀ kṣubhā́ ǀ mártam ǀ ánu-yatam ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyMaruts, of goodly aspect, quickly hear (the praises) that we who repair to you repeat, offering acceptable (oblations); (the Maruts) coming hither, well disposed, come down to us, (destroying) with their weapons the mortals opposed to them, (overcome) by agitation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दैव्या॑नि॒ पार्थि॑वानि॒ जन्मा॒पश्चाच्छा॒ सुम॑खाय वोचम् । वर्ध॑न्तां॒ द्यावो॒ गिर॑श्च॒न्द्राग्रा॑ उ॒दा व॑र्धन्ताम॒भिषा॑ता॒ अर्णा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ jánma ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ áccha ǀ sú-makhāya ǀ vocam ǀvárdhantām ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ candrá-agrāḥ ǀ udā́ ǀ vardhantām ǀ abhí-sātāḥ ǀ árṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer adoration to the company of theMarutsdeserving of sacred sacrifice, to obtain the waters, whether born of heaven or earth; may my praises prosper; may the joy-bestowing heavens (flourish); may the rivers cherished (by the Maruts) be filled with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒देप॑दे मे जरि॒मा नि धा॑यि॒ वरू॑त्री वा श॒क्रा या पा॒युभि॑श्च । सिष॑क्तु मा॒ता म॒ही र॒सा न॒: स्मत्सू॒रिभि॑ॠजु॒हस्त॑ ऋजु॒वनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: padé-pade ǀ me ǀ jarimā́ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀ várūtrī ǀ vā ǀ śakrā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀsísaktu ǀ mātā́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ rasā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ smát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ ṛju-hástā ǀ ṛju-vániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praise has been continually proffered as a protectress, powerful with (the means of) preservation; may the maternal and venerable earth accept our (praises), and, (plural ased) with her pious (worshippers) be (to us) straight-handed, and the giver of good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था दा॑शेम॒ नम॑सा सु॒दानू॑नेव॒या म॒रुतो॒ अच्छो॑क्तौ॒ प्रश्र॑वसो म॒रुतो॒ अच्छो॑क्तौ । मा नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॑ रि॒षे धा॑द॒स्माकं॑ भूदुपमाति॒वनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ dāśema ǀ námasā ǀ su-dā́nūn ǀ eva-yā́ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áccha-uktau ǀ prá-śravasaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áccha-uktau ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ riṣé ǀ dhāt ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bhūt ǀ upamāti-vániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How may we (duly) worship the liberal (Maruts) with praise, how adore the Maruts with present praise in a fitting manner, the glorious Maruts with present praise? mayAhirbudhnyacontrive nor for our harm; may he be the destroyer (of our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॑ चि॒न्नु प्र॒जायै॑ पशु॒मत्यै॒ देवा॑सो॒ वन॑ते॒ मर्त्यो॑ व॒ आ दे॑वासो वनते॒ मर्त्यो॑ वः । अत्रा॑ शि॒वां त॒न्वो॑ धा॒सिम॒स्या ज॒रां चि॑न्मे॒ निॠ॑तिर्जग्रसीत
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ paśu-mátyai ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ vánate ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ vanate ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀátra ǀ śivā́m ǀ tanváḥ ǀ dhāsím ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ jarā́m ǀ cit ǀ me ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jagrasīta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal (sacrificer) worships you, gods, at all times for progeny and cattle; verily, gods, the mortal worships you; mayNirṛti, on this occasion, sustain my body with salutary food, and keep off decay.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तां वो॑ देवाः सुम॒तिमू॒र्जय॑न्ती॒मिष॑मश्याम वसव॒: शसा॒ गोः । सा न॑: सु॒दानु॑र्मृ॒ळय॑न्ती दे॒वी प्रति॒ द्रव॑न्ती सुवि॒ताय॑ गम्याः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ vaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ūrjáyantīm ǀ íṣam ǀ aśyāma ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ śásā ǀ góḥ ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀ mṛḷáyantī ǀ devī́ ǀ práti ǀ drávantī ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ gamyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineVasus, may we obtain from the adorable cow invigorating and mind-sustaining food; may that liberal and benignant goddess, hastening (I, her), come for our felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि न॒ इळा॑ यू॒थस्य॑ मा॒ता स्मन्न॒दीभि॑रु॒र्वशी॑ वा गृणातु । उ॒र्वशी॑ वा बृहद्दि॒वा गृ॑णा॒नाभ्यू॑र्ण्वा॒ना प्र॑भृ॒थस्या॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ yūthásya ǀ mātā́ ǀ smát ǀ nadī́bhiḥ ǀ urváśī ǀ vā ǀ gṛṇātu ǀurváśī ǀ vā ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ abhi-ūrṇvānā́ ǀ pra-bhṛthásya ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Iḷā, the mother of the herd, andUrvaśīwith the rivers, be favourable to us; may the bright-shining Urvaśī (come), commanding our devotion, and investing the worshipper with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिष॑क्तु न ऊर्ज॒व्य॑स्य पु॒ष्टेः
shlokas.transliteration: sísaktu ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjavyásya ǀ puṣṭéḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May she cherish us (as the servants) of our patron Ūrjavya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शंत॑मा॒ वरु॑णं॒ दीधि॑ती॒ गीर्मि॒त्रं भग॒मदि॑तिं नू॒नम॑श्याः । पृष॑द्योनि॒: पञ्च॑होता शृणो॒त्वतू॑र्तपन्था॒ असु॑रो मयो॒भुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śám-tamā ǀ váruṇam ǀ dī́dhitī ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ bhágam ǀ áditim ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyāḥ ǀpṛ́ṣat-yoniḥ ǀ páñca-hotā ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ átūrta-panthāḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our most animating praise, together with our offerings, successfully attainVaruṇa,Mitra,BhagaandAditi; may the ministrant of the five (vital airs,Vāyu), the dweller in the dappled (firmament), he whose path is unimpeded, who is the giver of life, the bestower of happiness, hear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ मे॒ स्तोम॒मदि॑तिर्जगृभ्यात्सू॒नुं न मा॒ता हृद्यं॑ सु॒शेव॑म् । ब्रह्म॑ प्रि॒यं दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यदस्त्य॒हं मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे॒ यन्म॑यो॒भु
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ me ǀ stómam ǀ áditiḥ ǀ jagṛbhyāt ǀ sūnúm ǀ ná ǀ mātā́ ǀ hṛ́dyam ǀ su-śévam ǀbráhma ǀ priyám ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀ ahám ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ yát ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAditiaccept my affectionate and devoted praise, as a mother (the endearments of) a son; the plural asing, delightful prayer that is approved of by the gods I address toVaruṇaandMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रय क॒वित॑मं कवी॒नामु॒नत्तै॑नम॒भि मध्वा॑ घृ॒तेन॑ । स नो॒ वसू॑नि॒ प्रय॑ता हि॒तानि॑ च॒न्द्राणि॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता सु॑वाति
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īraya ǀ kaví-tamam ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ unátta ǀ enam ǀ abhí ǀ mádhvā ǀ ghṛténa ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ prá-yatā ǀ hitā́ni ǀ candrā́ṇi ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ suvāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate, (priests), the most prophetic of the prophets; imbue him with the sweet libation, and may the divineSavitābestow upon us ample, beneficial and delightful riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑न्द्र णो॒ मन॑सा नेषि॒ गोभि॒: सं सू॒रिभि॑र्हरिव॒: सं स्व॒स्ति । सं ब्रह्म॑णा दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यदस्ति॒ सं दे॒वानां॑ सुम॒त्या य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ neṣi ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ sám ǀ svastí ǀsám ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ devá-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀ sám ǀ devā́nām ǀ su-matyā́ ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With a (willing) mind,Indra, you associate us with cattle, with pious (priests) and, lord of steeds, with prosperity, with (sacrificial) food that is agreeable to the gods, and with the favour of the adorable deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो भग॑: सवि॒ता रा॒यो अंश॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रस्य॑ सं॒जितो॒ धना॑नाम् । ऋ॒भु॒क्षा वाज॑ उ॒त वा॒ पुरं॑धि॒रव॑न्तु नो अ॒मृता॑सस्तु॒रास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ áṃśaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ sam-jítaḥ ǀ dhánānām ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ naḥ ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ turā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineBhaga,Savitā, the lord of wealth,Aṃśa,Indra(the slayer) ofVṛtra, (all) the conquerors of riches,Ṛbhukṣin,Vājaand also Purandhi, immortals, hastening (to our sacrifice) preserve us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्व॑तो॒ अप्र॑तीतस्य जि॒ष्णोरजू॑र्यत॒: प्र ब्र॑वामा कृ॒तानि॑ । न ते॒ पूर्वे॑ मघव॒न्नाप॑रासो॒ न वी॒र्यं१॒॑ नूत॑न॒: कश्च॒नाप॑
shlokas.transliteration: marútvataḥ ǀ áprati-itasya ǀ jiṣṇóḥ ǀ ájūryataḥ ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀná ǀ te ǀ pū́rve ǀ magha-van ǀ ná ǀ áparāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīryám ǀ nū́tanaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ āpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We celebrate the exploits of Marutvat, the unrecoiling, the victorious, the undecaying; neither the ancients,Maghavan, nor their successors, have attained your prowess, nor has any one recent attained it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ स्तुहि प्रथ॒मं र॑त्न॒धेयं॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॑ सनि॒तारं॒ धना॑नाम् । यः शंस॑ते स्तुव॒ते शम्भ॑विष्ठः पुरू॒वसु॑रा॒गम॒ज्जोहु॑वानम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ prathamám ǀ ratna-dhéyam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ sanitā́ram ǀ dhánānām ǀyáḥ ǀ śáṃsate ǀ stuvaté ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ ā-gámat ǀ jóhuvānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the first donor of precious treasure,Bṛhaspati, the distributor of riches, the bestower of great happiness upon him who recites or chants (his praise), who comes laden with ample wealth to his invoker.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवो॒तिभि॒: सच॑माना॒ अरि॑ष्टा॒ बृह॑स्पते म॒घवा॑नः सु॒वीरा॑: । ये अ॑श्व॒दा उ॒त वा॒ सन्ति॑ गो॒दा ये व॑स्त्र॒दाः सु॒भगा॒स्तेषु॒ राय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sácamānāḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ bṛ́haspate ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀyé ǀ aśva-dā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sánti ǀ go-dā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ vastra-dā́ḥ ǀ su-bhágāḥ ǀ téṣu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated,Bṛhaspati, with your protections, (men) are unharmed (by foes), and become opulent and blessed with descendants; may wealth devolve on those who are genitive rous, and givers of horses, of cows, of clothes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒स॒र्माणं॑ कृणुहि वि॒त्तमे॑षां॒ ये भु॒ञ्जते॒ अपृ॑णन्तो न उ॒क्थैः । अप॑व्रतान्प्रस॒वे वा॑वृधा॒नान्ब्र॑ह्म॒द्विष॒: सूर्या॑द्यावयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: vi-sarmā́ṇam ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ vittám ǀ eṣām ǀ yé ǀ bhuñjáte ǀ ápṛṇantaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀápa-vratān ǀ pra-savé ǀ vavṛdhānā́n ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ sū́ryāt ǀ yavayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Render transitory the riches of those who partake of enjoyment without giving satisfaction (to those who are eminent) by holy hymns; put apart from the sun those who perform not sacred rites, and who, though prospering in their posterity, are the adversaries of prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ओह॑ते र॒क्षसो॑ दे॒ववी॑तावच॒क्रेभि॒स्तं म॑रुतो॒ नि या॑त । यो व॒: शमीं॑ शशमा॒नस्य॒ निन्दा॑त्तु॒च्छ्यान्कामा॑न्करते सिष्विदा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ óhate ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ devá-vītau ǀ acakrébhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ní ǀ yāta ǀyáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śámīm ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ níndāt ǀ tucchyā́n ǀ kā́mān ǀ karate ǀ sisvidānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send,Maruts, into darkness with (cars) devoid of wheels, the man who invites therākṣasasto the food of the gods; (him also) who reviles me when offering praise to you; while sweating, he toils (to realize) vain desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ ष्टुहि॒ यः स्वि॒षुः सु॒धन्वा॒ यो विश्व॑स्य॒ क्षय॑ति भेष॒जस्य॑ । यक्ष्वा॑ म॒हे सौ॑मन॒साय॑ रु॒द्रं नमो॑भिर्दे॒वमसु॑रं दुवस्य
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-iṣúḥ ǀ su-dhánvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ kṣáyati ǀ bheṣajásya ǀyákṣva ǀ mahé ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ rudrám ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ devám ǀ ásuram ǀ duvasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise him who has the sure arrow, the strong bow, who presides over all sanitary drugs; worshipRudrafor a comprehensive and sound understanding; adore the powerful divinity with prostrations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दमू॑नसो अ॒पसो॒ ये सु॒हस्ता॒ वृष्ण॒: पत्नी॑र्न॒द्यो॑ विभ्वत॒ष्टाः । सर॑स्वती बृहद्दि॒वोत रा॒का द॑श॒स्यन्ती॑र्वरिवस्यन्तु शु॒भ्राः
shlokas.transliteration: dámūnasaḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ yé ǀ su-hástāḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ vibhva-taṣṭā́ḥ ǀsárasvatī ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ utá ǀ rākā́ ǀ daśasyántīḥ ǀ varivasyantu ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the dexterous-handed, humble-minded artist (of the gods, theṚbhus); may the wives of the showerer (Indra); may the rivers carved out byVibhu; maySarasvatīand the brilliantRākā, the illustrious granters of desires, be willing to grant us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सू म॒हे सु॑शर॒णाय॑ मे॒धां गिरं॑ भरे॒ नव्य॑सीं॒ जाय॑मानाम् । य आ॑ह॒ना दु॑हि॒तुर्व॒क्षणा॑सु रू॒पा मि॑ना॒नो अकृ॑णोदि॒दं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ mahé ǀ su-śaraṇā́ya ǀ medhā́m ǀ gíram ǀ bhare ǀ návyasīm ǀ jā́yamānām ǀyáḥ ǀ āhanā́ḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ rūpā́ ǀ minānáḥ ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ idám ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To the great protector, (Indra), I offer devout pious praise, new and originated (at this time); to him, the showerer, who, for his daughter (earth), giving form to the rivers, has provided this water for our (use).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑ष्टु॒तिः स्त॒नय॑न्तं रु॒वन्त॑मि॒ळस्पतिं॑ जरितर्नू॒नम॑श्याः । यो अ॑ब्दि॒माँ उ॑दनि॒माँ इय॑र्ति॒ प्र वि॒द्युता॒ रोद॑सी उ॒क्षमा॑णः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ stanáyantam ǀ ruvántam ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ pátim ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyāḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ abdi-mā́n ǀ udani-mā́n ǀ íyarti ǀ prá ǀ vi-dyútā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ukṣámāṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your pious praise, oḥ worshipper, assuredly reach the thundering, roaring lord of Iḷā, who, impelling the clouds and distributing the rain, proceeds, illuminating the heaven and earth with lightning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्तोमो॒ मारु॑तं॒ शर्धो॒ अच्छा॑ रु॒द्रस्य॑ सू॒नूँर्यु॑व॒न्यूँरुद॑श्याः । कामो॑ रा॒ये ह॑वते मा स्व॒स्त्युप॑ स्तुहि॒ पृष॑दश्वाँ अ॒यास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnū́n ǀ yuvanyū́n ǀ út ǀ aśyāḥ ǀkā́maḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ havate ǀ mā ǀ svastí ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ pṛ́ṣat-aśvān ǀ ayā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this hymn reach up to the presence of the might of theMarutsthe youthful sons ofRudra; the desire of riches incites me to holiness; glorify those who go to sacrifice on spotted steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रैष स्तोम॑: पृथि॒वीम॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ वन॒स्पतीँ॒रोष॑धी रा॒ये अ॑श्याः । दे॒वोदे॑वः सु॒हवो॑ भूतु॒ मह्यं॒ मा नो॑ मा॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी दु॑र्म॒तौ धा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ antárikṣam ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ aśyāḥ ǀdeváḥ-devaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ máhyam ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ duḥ-matáu ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रौ दे॑वा अनिबा॒धे स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: uráu ǀ devāḥ ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we ever, gods, enjoy great and uninterrupted felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॒श्विनो॒रव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेन मयो॒भुवा॑ सु॒प्रणी॑ती गमेम । आ नो॑ र॒यिं व॑हत॒मोत वी॒राना विश्वा॑न्यमृता॒ सौभ॑गानि
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we ever be participant of the unprecedented, joy-conferring and well-guided protection of theAśvins; bring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ धे॒नव॒: पय॑सा॒ तूर्ण्य॑र्था॒ अम॑र्धन्ती॒रुप॑ नो यन्तु॒ मध्वा॑ । म॒हो रा॒ये बृ॑ह॒तीः स॒प्त विप्रो॑ मयो॒भुवो॑ जरि॒ता जो॑हवीति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ tū́rṇi-arthāḥ ǀ ámardhantīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ yantu ǀ mádhvā ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vípraḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ jaritā́ ǀ johavīti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the kine, quick-moving, doing no harm, come to us, (laden) with their sweet fluid; the wise worshipper invokes the seven vast and joy-diffusing (rivers) for the sake of ample riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सु॑ष्टु॒ती नम॑सा वर्त॒यध्यै॒ द्यावा॒ वाजा॑य पृथि॒वी अमृ॑ध्रे । पि॒ता मा॒ता मधु॑वचाः सु॒हस्ता॒ भरे॑भरे नो य॒शसा॑वविष्टाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ námasā ǀ vartayádhyai ǀ dyā́vā ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ ámṛdhre íti ǀpitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ mádhu-vacāḥ ǀ su-hástā ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ naḥ ǀ yaśásau ǀ aviṣṭām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I purpose) to approach with pious praise, and with oblations, for (the sake of) uninjured heaven and earth may the paternal (heaven), and the sweet-spoken, free-handed, maternal (earth), both enjoying renown, defens us in every battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवश्चकृ॒वांसो॒ मधू॑नि॒ प्र वा॒यवे॑ भरत॒ चारु॑ शु॒क्रम् । होते॑व नः प्रथ॒मः पा॑ह्य॒स्य देव॒ मध्वो॑ ररि॒मा ते॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ cakṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ mádhūni ǀ prá ǀ vāyáve ǀ bharata ǀ cā́ru ǀ śukrám ǀhótā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ asyá ǀ déva ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, who are preparing (the libation), first offer toVāyuthe delightful and brilliant (Soma); and do you, divine Vāyu, like theHotā, first drink of this sweet juice, which we offer for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ क्षिपो॑ युञ्जते बा॒हू अद्रिं॒ सोम॑स्य॒ या श॑मि॒तारा॑ सु॒हस्ता॑ । मध्वो॒ रसं॑ सु॒गभ॑स्तिर्गिरि॒ष्ठां चनि॑श्चदद्दुदुहे शु॒क्रमं॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ yuñjate ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ádrim ǀ sómasya ǀ yā́ ǀ śamitā́rā ǀ su-hástā ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ rásam ǀ su-gábhastiḥ ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀ cániścadat ǀ duduhe ǀ śukrám ǀ aṃśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten express of the juice, (the fingers), and the two arms of the priests, which are the dexterous immolators of theSoma, take hold of the stone; the exulting, skilful-fingered (priest) milks the mountain-born juice of the sweet Soma, and that Soma (yields its) pure juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑वि ते जुजुषा॒णाय॒ सोम॒: क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य बृह॒ते मदा॑य । हरी॒ रथे॑ सु॒धुरा॒ योगे॑ अ॒र्वागिन्द्र॑ प्रि॒या कृ॑णुहि हू॒यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ te ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ mádāya ǀhárī íti ǀ ráthe ǀ su-dhúrā ǀ yóge ǀ arvā́k ǀ índra ǀ priyā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomahas been effused, (Indra), for your gratification, for (giving you) strength in action, and for your great exhilaration; therefore Indra, when invoked by us, put to your two beloved, docile, well-trained horses in your car, and come down.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ म॒हीम॒रम॑तिं स॒जोषा॒ ग्नां दे॒वीं नम॑सा रा॒तह॑व्याम् । मधो॒र्मदा॑य बृह॒तीमृ॑त॒ज्ञामाग्ने॑ वह प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ arámatim ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ gnā́m ǀ devī́m ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyām ǀmádhoḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ṛta-jñā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ agne ǀ vaha ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, being well plural asd with us, bring to us, by paths frequented by the gods, the divine (feminine le), Gnā, mighty and omnipresent, to whom oblations are offered with reverence, who is vast and cognizant of rites, to partake of the exhilaration of the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ञ्जन्ति॒ यं प्र॒थय॑न्तो॒ न विप्रा॑ व॒पाव॑न्तं॒ नाग्निना॒ तप॑न्तः । पि॒तुर्न पु॒त्र उ॒पसि॒ प्रेष्ठ॒ आ घ॒र्मो अ॒ग्निमृ॒तय॑न्नसादि
shlokas.transliteration: añjánti ǀ yám ǀ pratháyantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vapā́-vantam ǀ ná ǀ agnínā ǀ tápantaḥ ǀpitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ upási ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ agním ǀ ṛtáyan ǀ asādi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vessel which the priests, celebrating (it), supply with butter, as if roasting a marrow-yielding animal with fire, has been plural ced, desirous of the sacrifice, upon the fire, like a son upon the lap of his father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ म॒ही बृ॑ह॒ती शंत॑मा॒ गीर्दू॒तो न ग॑न्त्व॒श्विना॑ हु॒वध्यै॑ । म॒यो॒भुवा॑ स॒रथा या॑तम॒र्वाग्ग॒न्तं नि॒धिं धुर॑मा॒णिर्न नाभि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ mahī́ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ śám-tamā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ná ǀ gantu ǀ aśvínā ǀ huvádhyai ǀmayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ sa-ráthā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ gantám ǀ ni-dhím ǀ dhúram ǀ āṇíḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́bhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this adoring, earnest, and gratifying praise go like a messenger to summon theAśvinshither; come, Aśvins, givers of happiness, riding in one chariot, come down to the deposited (Soma), as the bolt (is essential) to the axle of the wagon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तव्य॑सो॒ नम॑उक्तिं तु॒रस्या॒हं पू॒ष्ण उ॒त वा॒योर॑दिक्षि । या राध॑सा चोदि॒तारा॑ मती॒नां या वाज॑स्य द्रविणो॒दा उ॒त त्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ távyasaḥ ǀ námaḥ-uktim ǀ turásya ǀ ahám ǀ pūṣṇáḥ ǀ utá ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ adikṣi ǀyā́ ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ coditā́rā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ yā́ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ draviṇaḥ-dáu ǀ utá ǀ tmán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer adoration to the powerful and rapidPūṣaṇ, and to (the powerful and rapid)Vāyu, who are both instrumental gators of the desire of wealth and of food, (who are both) distributors of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नाम॑भिर्म॒रुतो॑ वक्षि॒ विश्वा॒ना रू॒पेभि॑र्जातवेदो हुवा॒नः । य॒ज्ञं गिरो॑ जरि॒तुः सु॑ष्टु॒तिं च॒ विश्वे॑ गन्त मरुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vakṣi ǀ víśvān ǀ ā́ ǀ rūpébhiḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀyajñám ǀ gíraḥ ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ su-stutím ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ ganta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring hitherJātavedas, who are invoked by us all, theMaruts, under their several names and forms; come all you Maruts, with all your protecting faculties, to the sacrifice, the paises, and the adoration of the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तः पर्व॑ता॒दा सर॑स्वती यज॒ता ग॑न्तु य॒ज्ञम् । हवं॑ दे॒वी जु॑जुषा॒णा घृ॒ताची॑ श॒ग्मां नो॒ वाच॑मुश॒ती शृ॑णोतु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ párvatāt ǀ ā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ yajatā́ ǀ gantu ǀ yajñám ǀhávam ǀ devī́ ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ śagmā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ uśatī́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the radiantSarasvatīcome to the sacrifice from the heavens or the spacious firmament; may the goddess, the showerer of water, propitiated by our invocation, and desirous of our gratifying praises hear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वे॒धसं॒ नील॑पृष्ठं बृ॒हन्तं॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॒ सद॑ने सादयध्वम् । सा॒दद्यो॑निं॒ दम॒ आ दी॑दि॒वांसं॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्णमरु॒षं स॑पेम
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vedhásam ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭham ǀ bṛhántam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ sádane ǀ sādayadhvam ǀsādát-yonim ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ híraṇya-varṇam ǀ aruṣám ǀ sapema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests) plural ce the mightyBṛhaspati, the creator whose back is dark blue, in the chamber (of sacrifice); let us worship him who is seated in the interior of the mansion, everywhere shining, golden-hued, resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ध॑र्ण॒सिर्बृ॒हद्दि॑वो॒ ररा॑णो॒ विश्वे॑भिर्ग॒न्त्वोम॑भिर्हुवा॒नः । ग्ना वसा॑न॒ ओष॑धी॒रमृ॑ध्रस्त्रि॒धातु॑शृङ्गो वृष॒भो व॑यो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ bṛhát-divaḥ ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ gantu ǀ óma-bhiḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀgnā́ḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ tridhā́tu-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sustainer of all, (Agni), the greatly radiant, the delighter, come, with all his protecting (faculties), when invoked; he who is clothed with flames and with plural nts; who is irresistible; who has horns of three colours, the showerer (of benefits), the accepter of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒तुष्प॒दे प॑र॒मे शु॒क्र आ॒योर्वि॑प॒न्यवो॑ रास्पि॒रासो॑ अग्मन् । सु॒शेव्यं॒ नम॑सा रा॒तह॑व्या॒: शिशुं॑ मृजन्त्या॒यवो॒ न वा॒से
shlokas.transliteration: mātúḥ ǀ padé ǀ paramé ǀ śukré ǀ āyóḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ rāspirā́saḥ ǀ agman ǀsu-śévyam ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyāḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāsé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The holders of the (sacrificial) ladles, the ministrant priests of the man (who instrumental tutes the rite), have repaired to the bright and most excellent plural ce of the maternal (earth); offerers of the oblations, they foster the tender infant, (Agni), with worship, as people rub (the limbs of a child to promote his) existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हद्वयो॑ बृह॒ते तुभ्य॑मग्ने धिया॒जुरो॑ मिथु॒नास॑: सचन्त । दे॒वोदे॑वः सु॒हवो॑ भूतु॒ मह्यं॒ मा नो॑ मा॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी दु॑र्म॒तौ धा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ bṛhaté ǀ túbhyam ǀ agne ǀ dhiyā-júraḥ ǀ mithunā́saḥ ǀ sacanta ǀdeváḥ-devaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ máhyam ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ duḥ-matáu ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Married pairs, worn by devout rites; jointly offer abundant sacrificial food,Agni, to you who are mighty; may each individual divinity be successfully invoked by me; let them not take us into unfavourable thought.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रौ दे॑वा अनिबा॒धे स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: uráu ǀ devāḥ ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “[16-17] May we ever be participant of the unprecedent joy-conferring, and well-guiding protection of theAśvinsbring to us, immortal (Aśvins), riches,maleprogeny, and all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॒श्विनो॒रव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेन मयो॒भुवा॑ सु॒प्रणी॑ती गमेम । आ नो॑ र॒यिं व॑हत॒मोत वी॒राना विश्वा॑न्यमृता॒ सौभ॑गानि
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ पू॒र्वथा॑ वि॒श्वथे॒मथा॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठता॑तिं बर्हि॒षदं॑ स्व॒र्विद॑म् । प्र॒ती॒ची॒नं वृ॒जनं॑ दोहसे गि॒राशुं जय॑न्त॒मनु॒ यासु॒ वर्ध॑से
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ pratná-thā ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ viśvá-thā ǀ imá-thā ǀ jyeṣṭhá-tātim ǀ barhi-sádam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀpratīcīnám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ dohase ǀ girā́ ǀ āśúm ǀ jáyantam ǀ ánu ǀ yā́su ǀ várdhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manneer as the ancient (sages), those our predecessors, as all sages, and those of the present period (have obtained their wishes by his praise), so do you by praise extract (my desires) from him who is the oldest and best (of the gods), who is seated on the sacred grass, who is cognizant of heaven, coming to our presence, vigorous, swift, victorious, for by such praises you exalt him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒ये सु॒दृशी॒रुप॑रस्य॒ याः स्व॑र्वि॒रोच॑मानः क॒कुभा॑मचो॒दते॑ । सु॒गो॒पा अ॑सि॒ न दभा॑य सुक्रतो प॒रो मा॒याभि॑ॠ॒त आ॑स॒ नाम॑ ते
shlokas.transliteration: śriyé ǀ su-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ úparasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ vi-rócamānaḥ ǀ kakúbhām ǀ acodáte ǀsu-gopā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ná ǀ dábhāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ paráḥ ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ āsa ǀ nā́ma ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, (Indra), who are radiant in heaven, spread through the regions, for the good (of mankind), those the beautiful (waters) of the unyielding cloud; doer of good deeds, you are the preserver (of men), not (destined) for their detriment; you are superior to all delusions; you names abides in the world of truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यं॑ ह॒विः स॑चते॒ सच्च॒ धातु॒ चारि॑ष्टगातु॒: स होता॑ सहो॒भरि॑: । प्र॒सर्स्रा॑णो॒ अनु॑ ब॒र्हिर्वृषा॒ शिशु॒र्मध्ये॒ युवा॒जरो॑ वि॒स्रुहा॑ हि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: átyam ǀ havíḥ ǀ sacate ǀ sát ǀ ca ǀ dhā́tu ǀ ca ǀ áriṣṭa-gātuḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ sahaḥ-bháriḥ ǀpra-sársrāṇaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ barhíḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ yúvā ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ vi-srúhā ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, (Agni), is associated with the perpetual oblation that is the true (source of good); the sustainer of all, he is of unrestricted movement, the offerer (of burnt-offerings), the cherisher of strength; gliding especially over the sacred grass, the showerer (of benefits); an infant, a youth, exempt from decay, whose plural ce is among plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑ ए॒ते सु॒युजो॒ याम॑न्नि॒ष्टये॒ नीची॑र॒मुष्मै॑ य॒म्य॑ ऋता॒वृध॑: । सु॒यन्तु॑भिः सर्वशा॒सैर॒भीशु॑भि॒: क्रिवि॒र्नामा॑नि प्रव॒णे मु॑षायति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ eté ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ amúṣmai ǀ yamyáḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀsuyántu-bhiḥ ǀ sarva-śāsáiḥ ǀ abhī́śu-bhiḥ ǀ kríviḥ ǀ nā́māni ǀ pravaṇé ǀ muṣāyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These well-combined rays (of the sun) are descending with intent to proceed on the path (of the sacrifice), amplifiers of the ceremony for this (its instrumental tutor); operating with these swift-moving, all-regulating rays, he, (Āditya) steals the waters (that flow) in low plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं॒जर्भु॑राण॒स्तरु॑भिः सुते॒गृभं॑ वया॒किनं॑ चि॒त्तग॑र्भासु सु॒स्वरु॑: । धा॒र॒वा॒केष्वृ॑जुगाथ शोभसे॒ वर्ध॑स्व॒ पत्नी॑र॒भि जी॒वो अ॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: sam-járbhurāṇaḥ ǀ táru-bhiḥ ǀ sute-gṛ́bham ǀ vayākínam ǀ cittá-garbhāsu ǀ su-sváruḥ ǀdhāra-vākéṣu ǀ ṛju-gātha ǀ śobhase ǀ várdhasva ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jīváḥ ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Object of honest eulogies (Agni), you shine among the reciters of your praises when theSomais received at its effusion by the wooden (cups), and you accepting (the beverage), are animated by the heart-affecting (praises); giver of life, increase in the sacrifice your protecting flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒दृगे॒व ददृ॑शे ता॒दृगु॑च्यते॒ सं छा॒यया॑ दधिरे सि॒ध्रया॒प्स्वा । म॒हीम॒स्मभ्य॑मुरु॒षामु॒रु ज्रयो॑ बृ॒हत्सु॒वीर॒मन॑पच्युतं॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yādṛ́k ǀ evá ǀ dádṛśe ǀ tādṛ́k ǀ ucyate ǀ sám ǀ chāyáyā ǀ dadhire ǀ sidhráyā ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀmahī́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ uru-sā́m ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ ánapa-cyutam ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such as (the deity) is beheld, such is he said (to be); they abide with concentrated splendour in the waters; (may they bestow) upon us honourable and ample (riches) great energy, numerousmaleoffspring and undecaying vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेत्यग्रु॒र्जनि॑वा॒न्वा अति॒ स्पृध॑: समर्य॒ता मन॑सा॒ सूर्य॑: क॒विः । घ्रं॒सं रक्ष॑न्तं॒ परि॑ वि॒श्वतो॒ गय॑म॒स्माकं॒ शर्म॑ वनव॒त्स्वाव॑सुः
shlokas.transliteration: véti ǀ ágruḥ ǀ jáni-vān ǀ vái ǀ áti ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ sa-maryatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀghraṃsám ǀ rákṣantam ǀ pári ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śárma ǀ vanavat ǀ svá-vasuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sageSūrya, advancing, accompanied by his bride, (the dawn), proceeds boldly, intent on combat with his enemies; may he on whom riches are dependent, secure our entire felicity, (and grant) a brilliant and everywhere protecting mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्यायां॑सम॒स्य य॒तुन॑स्य के॒तुन॑ ऋषिस्व॒रं च॑रति॒ यासु॒ नाम॑ ते । या॒दृश्मि॒न्धायि॒ तम॑प॒स्यया॑ विद॒द्य उ॑ स्व॒यं वह॑ते॒ सो अरं॑ करत्
shlokas.transliteration: jyā́yāṃsam ǀ asyá ǀ yatúnasya ǀ ketúnā ǀ ṛṣi-svarám ǀ carati ǀ yā́su ǀ nā́ma ǀ te ǀyādṛ́śmin ǀ dhā́yi ǀ tám ǀ apasyáyā ǀ vidat ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svayám ǀ váhate ǀ sáḥ ǀ áram ǀ karat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (pious man) proceeds to you, most excellent (of the gods, who are indicated) by the sign of this moving (revolution); who are hymned by the ṛṣis in whose praises youyr name (is glorified); he obtains that blessing by his devotion, on whatsoever (his desire) has been fixed; and he also, who of his own accord offers (worship) acquires abundant (reward).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रमा॑सा॒मव॑ तस्थे अग्रि॒मा न रि॑ष्यति॒ सव॑नं॒ यस्मि॒न्नाय॑ता । अत्रा॒ न हार्दि॑ क्रव॒णस्य॑ रेजते॒ यत्रा॑ म॒तिर्वि॒द्यते॑ पूत॒बन्ध॑नी
shlokas.transliteration: samudrám ǀ āsām ǀ áva ǀ tasthe ǀ agrimā́ ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀ sávanam ǀ yásmin ǀ ā́-yatā ǀátra ǀ ná ǀ hā́rdi ǀ kravaṇásya ǀ rejate ǀ yátra ǀ matíḥ ǀ vidyáte ǀ pūta-bándhanī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chief of these (our praises) proceed to the ocean-like sun; that chamber of sacrifice fails not in which (his praises) are prolonged; there are heart's desire of the worshiper is not disappointed where the mind is known to be attached to the pure (sun).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि क्ष॒त्रस्य॑ मन॒सस्य॒ चित्ति॑भिरेवाव॒दस्य॑ यज॒तस्य॒ सध्रे॑: । अ॒व॒त्सा॒रस्य॑ स्पृणवाम॒ रण्व॑भि॒: शवि॑ष्ठं॒ वाजं॑ वि॒दुषा॑ चि॒दर्ध्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣatrásya ǀ manasásya ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǀ eva-vadásya ǀ yajatásya ǀ sádhreḥ ǀava-tsārásya ǀ spṛṇavāma ǀ ráṇva-bhiḥ ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ vā́jam ǀ vidúṣā ǀ cit ǀ árdhyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily (it to be glorified); let us, with the plural asant thoughts ofKṣatra,Manasa, Avada, Vajada, Sadhri and Avatsara, fill up the invigorating food (the portion) to be shared by the wise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्ये॒न आ॑सा॒मदि॑तिः क॒क्ष्यो॒३॒॑ मदो॑ वि॒श्ववा॑रस्य यज॒तस्य॑ मा॒यिन॑: । सम॒न्यम॑न्यमर्थय॒न्त्येत॑वे वि॒दुर्वि॒षाणं॑ परि॒पान॒मन्ति॒ ते
shlokas.transliteration: śyenáḥ ǀ āsām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ kakṣyáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ yajatásya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀsám ǀ anyám-anyam ǀ arthayanti ǀ étave ǀ vidúḥ ǀ vi-sā́nam ǀ pari-pā́nam ǀ ánti ǀ té ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Swift is the excessive and girth-distending inebriation of Viśvavārā,YajataandMāyin; (by drinking) of these (juices) they urge one another to drink; they find the copious draught the prompt giver of intoxication.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒दा॒पृ॒णो य॑ज॒तो वि द्विषो॑ वधीद्बाहुवृ॒क्तः श्रु॑त॒वित्तर्यो॑ व॒: सचा॑ । उ॒भा स वरा॒ प्रत्ये॑ति॒ भाति॑ च॒ यदीं॑ ग॒णं भज॑ते सुप्र॒याव॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sadā-pṛṇáḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ vadhīt ǀ bāhu-vṛktáḥ ǀ śruta-vít ǀ táryaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sácā ǀubhā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ várā ǀ práti ǀ eti ǀ bhā́ti ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ gaṇám ǀ bhájate ǀ suprayā́va-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Sadāpṛṇa,Yajata, Bahuvṛkta, Śrutavit,Tarya, associated with you, destoy, your foes; the ṛṣi obtains his desires in both (worlds), and shines brightly, whenever he adores with well-mingled (offerings and praises) the host (of heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त॒म्भ॒रो यज॑मानस्य॒ सत्प॑ति॒र्विश्वा॑सा॒मूध॒: स धि॒यामु॒दञ्च॑नः । भर॑द्धे॒नू रस॑वच्छिश्रिये॒ पयो॑ऽनुब्रुवा॒णो अध्ये॑ति॒ न स्व॒पन्
shlokas.transliteration: sutam-bharáḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ víśvāsām ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhiyā́m ǀ ut-áñcanaḥ ǀbhárat ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ rása-vat ǀ śiśriye ǀ páyaḥ ǀ anu-bruvāṇáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ eti ǀ ná ǀ svapán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sutambhara, is the ministrant priest of the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice, the causer of the upward ascent of all holy rites; the cow offers juicy (milk); the milk is distributed; announcing this in order (Avastāra) studies (the holy texts) without repose.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो जा॒गार॒ तमृच॑: कामयन्ते॒ यो जा॒गार॒ तमु॒ सामा॑नि यन्ति । यो जा॒गार॒ तम॒यं सोम॑ आह॒ तवा॒हम॑स्मि स॒ख्ये न्यो॑काः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ṛ́caḥ ǀ kāmayante ǀ yáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sā́māni ǀ yanti ǀyáḥ ǀ jāgā́ra ǀ tám ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ āha ǀ táva ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sakhyé ǀ ní-okāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him who is ever vigilant, holy verses desire; to him who is ever vigilant sacred songs proceed; him who is ever vigilant theSomathus addresses, I am always abiding in your fellowship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्जा॑गार॒ तमृच॑: कामयन्ते॒ऽग्निर्जा॑गार॒ तमु॒ सामा॑नि यन्ति । अ॒ग्निर्जा॑गार॒ तम॒यं सोम॑ आह॒ तवा॒हम॑स्मि स॒ख्ये न्यो॑काः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ṛ́caḥ ǀ kāmayante ǀ agníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sā́māni ǀ yanti ǀagníḥ ǀ jāgāra ǀ tám ǀ ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ āha ǀ táva ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sakhyé ǀ ní-okāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis ever vigilant, and him holy verses desire; Agni is ever vigilant, and to him sacred songs proceed; Agni is ever vigilant, and him theSomaaddresses, I am ever abiding in your fellowship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दा दि॒वो वि॒ष्यन्नद्रि॑मु॒क्थैरा॑य॒त्या उ॒षसो॑ अ॒र्चिनो॑ गुः । अपा॑वृत व्र॒जिनी॒रुत्स्व॑र्गा॒द्वि दुरो॒ मानु॑षीर्दे॒व आ॑वः
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra) recovered (the hidden cattle), hurling his thunderbolt from heaven at the prayers of theAṅgirasas; the rays of the approaching dawn are spread around; the divine sun, scattering the clustered gloom, has risen and set open the doors of (the habitations of) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि सूर्यो॑ अ॒मतिं॒ न श्रियं॑ सा॒दोर्वाद्गवां॑ मा॒ता जा॑न॒ती गा॑त् । धन्व॑र्णसो न॒द्य१॒॑: खादो॑अर्णा॒: स्थूणे॑व॒ सुमि॑ता दृंहत॒ द्यौः
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun distributes his radiance as it was a substance; the parent of the rays of light, (the dawn), knowing his approach, comes from the spacious (firmament); the rivers with running waters flow, breaking down their banks; the heaven is stable like a well-constructed pillar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा उ॒क्थाय॒ पर्व॑तस्य॒ गर्भो॑ म॒हीनां॑ ज॒नुषे॑ पू॒र्व्याय॑ । वि पर्व॑तो॒ जिही॑त॒ साध॑त॒ द्यौरा॒विवा॑सन्तो दसयन्त॒ भूम॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “To me, when offering praise, as to an ancient author of sacred songs, the burden of the cloud (descends); the cloud parts (with its burden); the sky performs (its office); he assiduously worshippingAṅgirasasare exhausted by much (adoration).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सू॒क्तेभि॑र्वो॒ वचो॑भिर्दे॒वजु॑ष्टै॒रिन्द्रा॒ न्व१॒॑ग्नी अव॑से हु॒वध्यै॑ । उ॒क्थेभि॒र्हि ष्मा॑ क॒वय॑: सुय॒ज्ञा आ॒विवा॑सन्तो म॒रुतो॒ यज॑न्ति
shlokas.meaning_en: “IIndraandAgni, I invoke you for my salvation with well-uttered words, agreeable to the gods; for verily, sages excelling in sacrifice, and diligently adoring, worship you with sacred songs, prompt as theMaruts(in devotion).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एतो॒ न्व१॒॑द्य सु॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ भवा॑म॒ प्र दु॒च्छुना॑ मिनवामा॒ वरी॑यः । आ॒रे द्वेषां॑सि सनु॒तर्द॑धा॒माया॑म॒ प्राञ्चो॒ यज॑मान॒मच्छ॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come today quickly; let us be engaged in pious acts; let us entirely annihilate the hostile; let us keep off all sacred enemies; let us hasten to the presence of the instrumental tutor of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एता॒ धियं॑ कृ॒णवा॑मा सखा॒योऽप॒ या मा॒ताँ ऋ॑णु॒त व्र॒जं गोः । यया॒ मनु॑र्विशिशि॒प्रं जि॒गाय॒ यया॑ व॒णिग्व॒ङ्कुरापा॒ पुरी॑षम्
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, friends, let us celebrate that solemn rite which was effectual in setting open the (secret) stalls of the (stolen) cattle; by whichManuovercame Viśiśipra; by which the merchant, going to the wood (for it), obtained the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनू॑नो॒दत्र॒ हस्त॑यतो॒ अद्रि॒रार्च॒न्येन॒ दश॑ मा॒सो नव॑ग्वाः । ऋ॒तं य॒ती स॒रमा॒ गा अ॑विन्द॒द्विश्वा॑नि स॒त्याङ्गि॑राश्चकार
shlokas.meaning_en: “At this sacrifice the stone (set in motion) by thehands(of the priests) makes a noise, whereby the nine-months ministrants celebrated the ten-months worship; whenSaramā, going to the ceremony, discovered the cattle, andAṅgirasrendered all the rites effective.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ अ॒स्या व्युषि॒ माहि॑नाया॒: सं यद्गोभि॒रङ्गि॑रसो॒ नव॑न्त । उत्स॑ आसां पर॒मे स॒धस्थ॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒था स॒रमा॑ विद॒द्गाः
shlokas.meaning_en: “When all theAṅgirasas, on the opening of this adorable dawn, came in contact with the (discovered) cattle, then milk and the rest were offered in the august assembly, forSaramāhad found cows by the path of truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो॑ यातु स॒प्ताश्व॒: क्षेत्रं॒ यद॑स्योर्वि॒या दी॑र्घया॒थे । र॒घुः श्ये॒नः प॑तय॒दन्धो॒ अच्छा॒ युवा॑ क॒विर्दी॑दय॒द्गोषु॒ गच्छ॑न्
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySūrya, lord of seven steeds, arrive, for he has a distant goal (to reach) by a tedious route; fleet as a hawk he pounces upon the offered (sacrificial) food; ever young and far-seeing, he shines, moving amidst rays of light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो॑ अरुहच्छु॒क्रमर्णोऽयु॑क्त॒ यद्ध॒रितो॑ वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठाः । उ॒द्ना न नाव॑मनयन्त॒ धीरा॑ आशृण्व॒तीरापो॑ अ॒र्वाग॑तिष्ठन्
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūryahas ascended above the glistening water, as soon as he has put to his bright-backed steeds; sage (worshippers) have drawn him, like a ship, across the sea; the waters hearing his commands, have come down.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धियं॑ वो अ॒प्सु द॑धिषे स्व॒र्षां ययात॑र॒न्दश॑ मा॒सो नव॑ग्वाः । अ॒या धि॒या स्या॑म दे॒वगो॑पा अ॒या धि॒या तु॑तुर्या॒मात्यंह॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer to you, (gods), for the sake of water, an all-bestowing sacrifice, whereby the nine-months ministrants have completed the ten-months rite; may we, by this sacrifice, be the protected of the gods; may we, by this sacrifice, cross over the boundaries of sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हयो॒ न वि॒द्वाँ अ॑युजि स्व॒यं धु॒रि तां व॑हामि प्र॒तर॑णीमव॒स्युव॑म् । नास्या॑ वश्मि वि॒मुचं॒ नावृत॒॒ पुन॑र्वि॒द्वान्प॒थः पु॑रए॒त ऋ॒जु ने॑षति
shlokas.transliteration: háyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ayuji ǀ svayám ǀ dhurí ǀ tā́m ǀ vahāmi ǀ pratáraṇīm ǀ avasyúvam ǀná ǀ asyāḥ ǀ vaśmi ǀ vi-múcam ǀ ná ǀ ā-vṛ́tam ǀ púnaḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ patháḥ ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ ṛjú ǀ neṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage, (Pratikṣatra), has, of his own accord, attached himself to the burden (of sacrifice), like a horse (to a chariot); I support that transcendent and preservative load; I do not desire release from it, nor yet its reiterated imposition; the sage, going first, conducts (men) by the right path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ इन्द्र॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ देवा॒: शर्ध॒: प्र य॑न्त॒ मारु॑तो॒त वि॑ष्णो । उ॒भा नास॑त्या रु॒द्रो अध॒ ग्नाः पू॒षा भग॒: सर॑स्वती जुषन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ índra ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dévāḥ ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ yanta ǀ mā́ruta ǀ utá ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀubhā́ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ rudráḥ ǀ ádha ǀ gnā́ḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ juṣanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,Indra,Varuṇa,Mitra, gods, confer (upon us) strength; or, company of theMaruts, orViṣṇu, (bestow it); and may both theNāsatyas,Rudra, the wives of the gods,Pūṣan,Bhaga,Sarasvatī, be plural ased (by our adoration).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी मि॒त्रावरु॒णादि॑तिं॒ स्व॑: पृथि॒वीं द्यां म॒रुत॒: पर्व॑ताँ अ॒पः । हु॒वे विष्णुं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॒ भगं॒ नु शंसं॑ सवि॒तार॑मू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: indrāgnī́ íti ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ áditim ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ marútaḥ ǀ párvatān ǀ apáḥ ǀhuvé ǀ víṣṇum ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ bhágam ǀ nú ǀ śáṃsam ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke for protectionIndraandAgni,MitraandVaruṇa,Aditi,Svar, Earth, Heaven, theMaruts, the clouds, the waters,Viṣṇu,Pūṣaṇ,BrahmaṇaspatiandSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ विष्णु॑रु॒त वातो॑ अ॒स्रिधो॑ द्रविणो॒दा उ॒त सोमो॒ मय॑स्करत् । उ॒त ऋ॒भव॑ उ॒त रा॒ये नो॑ अ॒श्विनो॒त त्वष्टो॒त विभ्वानु॑ मंसते
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ asrídhaḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karat ǀutá ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ utá ǀ rāyé ǀ naḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ utá ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ utá ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ánu ǀ maṃsate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or mayViṣṇugrant us felicity, or the innoxious wind, orSomathe bestower of riches; or may theṚbhus, theAśvins,Tvaṣṭā, or Vibhvan be favourably disposed to our enrichment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यन्नो॒ मारु॑तं॒ शर्ध॒ आ ग॑मद्दिविक्ष॒यं य॑ज॒तं ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑ । बृह॒स्पति॒: शर्म॑ पू॒षोत नो॑ यमद्वरू॒थ्यं१॒॑ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ divi-kṣayám ǀ yajatám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ yamat ǀ varūthyám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may the adorable, heaven-abiding company of theMaruts, come to us to take their seats on the sacred grass; or mayBṛhaspati,Pūṣaṇ,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, bestow upon us domestic happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये न॒: पर्व॑तासः सुश॒स्तय॑: सुदी॒तयो॑ न॒द्य१॒॑स्त्राम॑णे भुवन् । भगो॑ विभ॒क्ता शव॒साव॒सा ग॑मदुरु॒व्यचा॒ अदि॑तिः श्रोतु मे॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ naḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ su-śastáyaḥ ǀ su-dītáyaḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ trā́maṇe ǀ bhuvan ǀbhágaḥ ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀ śávasā ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ uru-vyácāḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śrotu ǀ me ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may the glorious mountains, the beneficient rivers, be to us for our preservation; mayBhaga, the apportioner of wealth, come with abundance and protection; may this wide-pervadingAditihear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑रुश॒तीर॑वन्तु न॒: प्राव॑न्तु नस्तु॒जये॒ वाज॑सातये । याः पार्थि॑वासो॒ या अ॒पामपि॑ व्र॒ते ता नो॑ देवीः सुहवा॒: शर्म॑ यच्छत
shlokas.transliteration: devā́nām ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ avantu ǀ naḥ ǀ tujáye ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ápi ǀ vraté ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devīḥ ǀ su-havāḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wives of the gods, desiring (our homage), defend us; may they so protect us that (we may obtain) vigorous (offspring) and abundant food; whether terrestrial, or those in charge of the waters (in the firmament), do you, goddesses, earnestly invoked, bestow upon us felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ग्ना व्य॑न्तु दे॒वप॑त्नीरिन्द्रा॒ण्य१॒॑ग्नाय्य॒श्विनी॒ राट् । आ रोद॑सी वरुणा॒नी शृ॑णोतु॒ व्यन्तु॑ दे॒वीर्य ऋ॒तुर्जनी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ gnā́ḥ ǀ vyantu ǀ devá-patnīḥ ǀ indrāṇī́ ǀ agnā́yī ǀ aśvínī ǀ rā́ṭ ǀā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ varuṇānī́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ vyántu ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛtúḥ ǀ jánīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or may the goddesses, the wives of the gods, accept (the offering);Indrāṇī,Agnāyī, the radiantAśvinīRodasi,Varuṇāni, may each hear (our prayer); may the goddesses partake (of the oblation); may the (person nified) season of the wives of the gods, accept it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒यु॒ञ्ज॒ती दि॒व ए॑ति ब्रुवा॒णा म॒ही मा॒ता दु॑हि॒तुर्बो॒धय॑न्ती । आ॒विवा॑सन्ती युव॒तिर्म॑नी॒षा पि॒तृभ्य॒ आ सद॑ने॒ जोहु॑वाना
shlokas.transliteration: prayuñjatī́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ eti ǀ bruvāṇā́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ bodháyantī ǀā-vívāsantī ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sádane ǀ jóhuvānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arousing (men to their labours), the adorable (Dawn) comes from the heaven, a mighty mother, the awakener of her daughter (earth); pious, ever young, and glorified (she comes), when invoked, to the chamber of sacrifice with the protcting (gods0.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जि॒रास॒स्तद॑प॒ ईय॑माना आतस्थि॒वांसो॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑म् । अ॒न॒न्तास॑ उ॒रवो॑ वि॒श्वत॑: सीं॒ परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी य॑न्ति॒ पन्था॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ajirā́saḥ ǀ tát-apaḥ ǀ ī́yamānāḥ ǀ ātasthi-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǀanantā́saḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ sīm ǀ pári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yanti ǀ pánthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rays (of light) extending round, fulfilling, their duty (of bringing on the day), abiding in contact with the orb of the immortal (sun), unlimited and diffusive, spread everywhere through heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षा स॑मु॒द्रो अ॑रु॒षः सु॑प॒र्णः पूर्व॑स्य॒ योनिं॑ पि॒तुरा वि॑वेश । मध्ये॑ दि॒वो निहि॑त॒: पृश्नि॒रश्मा॒ वि च॑क्रमे॒ रज॑सस्पा॒त्यन्तौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣā́ ǀ samudráḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ pū́rvasya ǀ yónim ǀ pitúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀmádhye ǀ diváḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ áśmā ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pāti ǀ ántau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of rain), the shedder of dew, the radiant and quick-going (car) has entered the region of the paternal east; the many-tinted and pervading (luminary) proceeds to both extremities of the firmament, (and so) preserves (the world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वार॑ ईं बिभ्रति क्षेम॒यन्तो॒ दश॒ गर्भं॑ च॒रसे॑ धापयन्ते । त्रि॒धात॑वः पर॒मा अ॑स्य॒ गावो॑ दि॒वश्च॑रन्ति॒ परि॑ स॒द्यो अन्ता॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: catvā́raḥ ǀ īm ǀ bibhrati ǀ kṣema-yántaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ gárbham ǀ caráse ǀ dhāpayante ǀtri-dhā́tavaḥ ǀ paramā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ caranti ǀ pári ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ ántān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The four (chief priests) sustain him (with oblation and praises), seeking their own welfare; the ten (regions of space) invigorate him, their embryo, to travel (his daily course); his three elementary rays swiftly traverse the boundaries of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं वपु॑र्नि॒वच॑नं जनास॒श्चर॑न्ति॒ यन्न॒द्य॑स्त॒स्थुराप॑: । द्वे यदीं॑ बिभृ॒तो मा॒तुर॒न्ये इ॒हेह॑ जा॒ते य॒म्या॒३॒॑ सब॑न्धू
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vápuḥ ǀ ni-vácanam ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ yát ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀdvé íti ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ bibhṛtáḥ ǀ mātúḥ ǀ anyé íti ǀ ihá-iha ǀ jāté íti ǀ yamyā́ ǀ sábandhū íti sá-bandhū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Behold), men, this indescribable form from which the rivers (spring), and where the waters dwell; when (form, the firmament), the two, (day and night), associated and equally allied, as well as other (seasons), born (of it, as of a parent), here and there sustain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि त॑न्वते॒ धियो॑ अस्मा॒ अपां॑सि॒ वस्त्रा॑ पु॒त्राय॑ मा॒तरो॑ वयन्ति । उ॒प॒प्र॒क्षे वृष॑णो॒ मोद॑माना दि॒वस्प॒था व॒ध्वो॑ य॒न्त्यच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tanvate ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ápāṃsi ǀ vástrā ǀ putrā́ya ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ vayanti ǀupa-prakṣé ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ módamānāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ vadhváḥ ǀ yanti ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him (worshippers) multiply praises and acts of adoration; for (him as for) a son, the (divine) mothers weave garments (of light); rejoicing in the contact of their impregnation, the wives of the sun, (the solar rays), come to our presence by the path of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॑स्तु मित्रावरुणा॒ तद॑ग्ने॒ शं योर॒स्मभ्य॑मि॒दम॑स्तु श॒स्तम् । अ॒शी॒महि॑ गा॒धमु॒त प्र॑ति॒ष्ठां नमो॑ दि॒वे बृ॑ह॒ते साद॑नाय
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ astu ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ tát ǀ agne ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ idám ǀ astu ǀ śastám ǀaśīmáhi ǀ gādhám ǀ utá ǀ prati-sthā́m ǀ námaḥ ǀ divé ǀ bṛhaté ǀ sádanāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this (hymn),MitraandVaruṇa, be valued (by you); may it,Agni, be valued (by you) as the means to us of happiness unmixed; may we (thence) obtain stability and permanence; reverence be to you and mighty asylum (of the universe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कदु॑ प्रि॒याय॒ धाम्ने॑ मनामहे॒ स्वक्ष॑त्राय॒ स्वय॑शसे म॒हे व॒यम् । आ॒मे॒न्यस्य॒ रज॑सो॒ यद॒भ्र आँ अ॒पो वृ॑णा॒ना वि॑त॒नोति॑ मा॒यिनी॑
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ya ǀ dhā́mne ǀ manāmahe ǀ svá-kṣatrāya ǀ svá-yaśase ǀ mahé ǀ vayám ǀā-menyásya ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ abhré ǀ ā́ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vṛṇānā́ ǀ vi-tanóti ǀ māyínī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When may we offer adoration to the benevolent splendour, strong in its own (strength), self-sustaining with food, deserving of worship; when the delusive (energy ofAgni), investing (the heavens), spreads the waters above the clouds over the unbounded firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॑त्नत व॒युनं॑ वी॒रव॑क्षणं समा॒न्या वृ॒तया॒ विश्व॒मा रज॑: । अपो॒ अपा॑ची॒रप॑रा॒ अपे॑जते॒ प्र पूर्वा॑भिस्तिरते देव॒युर्जन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ atnata ǀ vayúnam ǀ vīrá-vakṣaṇam ǀ samānyā́ ǀ vṛtáyā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀápo íti ǀ ápācīḥ ǀ áparāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ījate ǀ prá ǀ pū́rvābhiḥ ǀ tirate ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These dawns diffuse the consciousness that is apprehended by pious men, and (overspread) the whole world with uniform, investing (light); the devout man disregards the dawns which have turned back, and (those which) are to come, and improves (his understanding) by those which have proceeded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ग्राव॑भिरह॒न्ये॑भिर॒क्तुभि॒र्वरि॑ष्ठं॒ वज्र॒मा जि॑घर्ति मा॒यिनि॑ । श॒तं वा॒ यस्य॑ प्र॒चर॒न्त्स्वे दमे॑ संव॒र्तय॑न्तो॒ वि च॑ वर्तय॒न्नहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ grā́va-bhiḥ ǀ ahanyébhiḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ váriṣṭham ǀ vájram ǀ ā́ ǀ jigharti ǀ māyíni ǀśatám ǀ vā ǀ yásya ǀ pra-cáran ǀ své ǀ dáme ǀ sam-vartáyantaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ vartayan ǀ áhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Animated) by the libations offered by day and by night, (Indra) sharpens his vast thunderbolt against the beguiler (Vṛtra); he whose hundred (rays) attend him in his own abode, sending away, and bringing back (revolving) days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताम॑स्य री॒तिं प॑र॒शोरि॑व॒ प्रत्यनी॑कमख्यं भु॒जे अ॑स्य॒ वर्प॑सः । सचा॒ यदि॑ पितु॒मन्त॑मिव॒ क्षयं॒ रत्नं॒ दधा॑ति॒ भर॑हूतये वि॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ asya ǀ rītím ǀ paraśóḥ-iva ǀ práti ǀ ánīkam ǀ akhyam ǀ bhujé ǀ asya ǀ várpasaḥ ǀsácā ǀ yádi ǀ pitumántam-iva ǀ kṣáyam ǀ rátnam ǀ dádhāti ǀ bhára-hūtaye ǀ viśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I behold) the practice of that (Agni) as of a deputy (or axe); I celebrate the host (of rays) of that (resplendent) form, (designed) for the enjoyment (of mankind); if he be with (the worshipper), he bestows upon the man who invokes him at a sacrifice such opulence as a mansion abounding with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जि॒ह्वया॒ चतु॑रनीक ऋञ्जते॒ चारु॒ वसा॑नो॒ वरु॑णो॒ यत॑न्न॒रिम् । न तस्य॑ विद्म पुरुष॒त्वता॑ व॒यं यतो॒ भग॑: सवि॒ता दाति॒ वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jihváyā ǀ cátuḥ-anīkaḥ ǀ ṛñjate ǀ cā́ru ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yátan ǀ arím ǀná ǀ tásya ǀ vidma ǀ puruṣatvátā ǀ vayám ǀ yátaḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ dā́ti ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Blazing with his (fiery) tongue in the four quarters (of the horizon) he proceeds (to the sacrifice), wearing beautiful (lustre), the disperser of darkness, extirpating foes; we know him not (as endowed) with manhood, whereby this adorableSavitābestows desirable (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वं वो॑ अ॒द्य स॑वि॒तार॒मेषे॒ भगं॑ च॒ रत्नं॑ वि॒भज॑न्तमा॒योः । आ वां॑ नरा पुरुभुजा ववृत्यां दि॒वेदि॑वे चिदश्विना सखी॒यन्
shlokas.transliteration: devám ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣe ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǀ rátnam ǀ vi-bhájantam ǀ āyóḥ ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ vavṛtyām ǀ divé-dive ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ sakhi-yán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, (worshippers), I approach today the divineSavitāandBhaga, the distributors of precious (wealth) among men;Aśvins, (leaders of rites), enjoyers of many (good things), desiring your friendship, I solicit your daily presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ प्र॒याण॒मसु॑रस्य वि॒द्वान्त्सू॒क्तैर्दे॒वं स॑वि॒तारं॑ दुवस्य । उप॑ ब्रुवीत॒ नम॑सा विजा॒नञ्ज्येष्ठं॑ च॒ रत्नं॑ वि॒भज॑न्तमा॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ pra-yā́nam ǀ ásurasya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ devám ǀ savitā́ram ǀ duvasya ǀúpa ǀ bruvīta ǀ námasā ǀ vi-jānán ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ ca ǀ rátnam ǀ vi-bhájantam ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Knowing the approach of the expeller (of the foes of the gods from heaven), worship the divineSavitāwith holy hymns; praise him with reverence, distinguishing him as distributing precious (treasures) among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द॒त्र॒या द॑यते॒ वार्या॑णि पू॒षा भगो॒ अदि॑ति॒र्वस्त॑ उ॒स्रः । इन्द्रो॒ विष्णु॒र्वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निरहा॑नि भ॒द्रा ज॑नयन्त द॒स्माः
shlokas.transliteration: adatra-yā́ ǀ dayate ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ váste ǀ usráḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ áhāni ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ janayanta ǀ dasmā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣan,Bhaga,Aditibestow (severally) excellent viands; the fierce (sun) robes (himself with radiance); the good-looking (deities),Indra,Viṣṇu,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, give birth to happy days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नो॑ अन॒र्वा स॑वि॒ता वरू॑थं॒ तत्सिन्ध॑व इ॒षय॑न्तो॒ अनु॑ ग्मन् । उप॒ यद्वोचे॑ अध्व॒रस्य॒ होता॑ रा॒यः स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो॒ वाज॑रत्नाः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ anarvā́ ǀ savitā́ ǀ várūtham ǀ tát ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ iṣáyantaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀúpa ǀ yát ǀ vóce ǀ adhvarásya ǀ hótā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ vā́ja-ratnāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the irreproachableSavitā(grant) us that desirable (wealth); may the flowing rivers hasten to (convey) it to us; for which purpose I, the ministering priest of the sacrifice, repeat (pious praises); affluent in food, may we be the lords of (manifold) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये वसु॑भ्य॒ ईव॒दा नमो॒ दुर्ये मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे सू॒क्तवा॑चः । अवै॒त्वभ्वं॑ कृणु॒ता वरी॑यो दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्योरव॑सा मदेम
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ vásu-bhyaḥ ǀ ī́vat ǀ ā́ ǀ námaḥ ǀ dúḥ ǀ yé ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ sūktá-vācaḥ ǀáva ǀ etu ǀ ábhvam ǀ kṛṇutá ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ diváḥpṛthivyóḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ madema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May ample wealth devolve upon those who have presented victims to theVasus, and upon those who have repeated praises toMitraandVaruṇaconfer upon them, (gods), felicity, and may we rejoice in the protection of heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ ने॒तुर्मर्तो॑ वुरीत स॒ख्यम् । विश्वो॑ रा॒य इ॑षुध्यति द्यु॒म्नं वृ॑णीत पु॒ष्यसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśvaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ netúḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ vurīta ǀ sakhyám ǀvíśvaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ iṣudhyati ǀ dyumnám ǀ vṛṇīta ǀ puṣyáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let every man solicit the friendship of the divine leader (of heaven and sun); let every man desire (of him) riches; let him request affluence (wherewith) to nourish (his descendants).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते ते॑ देव नेत॒र्ये चे॒माँ अ॑नु॒शसे॑ । ते रा॒या ते ह्या॒३॒॑पृचे॒ सचे॑महि सच॒थ्यै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ te ǀ deva ǀ netaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ imā́n ǀ anu-śáse ǀté ǀ rāyā́ ǀ té ǀ hí ǀ ā-pṛ́ce ǀ sácemahi ǀ sacathyáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (leader of heaven), these (worshippers) are yours, and (so are they) who praise these (other gods); these (borth) we associate with opulence, we (seek) to unite with (our) desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अतो॑ न॒ आ नॄनति॑थी॒नत॒: पत्नी॑र्दशस्यत । आ॒रे विश्वं॑ पथे॒ष्ठां द्वि॒षो यु॑योतु॒ यूयु॑विः
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ átithīn ǀ átaḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ daśasyata ǀāré ǀ víśvam ǀ pathe-sthā́m ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ yuyotu ǀ yúyuviḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship, therefore, the leaders (of our rites), our guests, (the gods), and the wives (of the deities); may the (divine) discriminator drive to a distance every adversary, (and all our) enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ वह्नि॑र॒भिहि॑तो दु॒द्रव॒द्द्रोण्य॑: प॒शुः । नृ॒मणा॑ वी॒रप॒स्त्योऽर्णा॒ धीरे॑व॒ सनि॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ váhniḥ ǀ abhí-hitaḥ ǀ dudrávat ǀ dróṇyaḥ ǀ paśúḥ ǀnṛ-mánāḥ ǀ vīrá-pastyaḥ ǀ árṇā ǀ dhī́rā-iva ǀ sánitā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whence the victim fit to be bound, the subject (of the sacrifice), has been stationed (at the sacrificialpost); he, (Savitā), with mind well disposed towards the worshiper, the donor of dwellings and descendants is like a clever wife, the bestower (of wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष ते॑ देव नेता॒ रथ॒स्पति॒: शं र॒यिः । शं रा॒ये शं स्व॒स्तय॑ इष॒:स्तुतो॑ मनामहे देव॒स्तुतो॑ मनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ te ǀ deva ǀ netaríti ǀ ráthaḥpátiḥ ǀ śám ǀ rayíḥ ǀśám ǀ rāyé ǀ śám ǀ svastáye ǀ iṣaḥ-stútaḥ ǀ manāmahe ǀ deva-stútaḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leader (of heaven), may this your protecting chariot, laden with riches, (come for our) happiness; praisers of the honoured (Savitā), we glorify him for felicity through well-being; praisers of the gods, we glorify (them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॒ विश्वै॒रूमे॑भि॒रा ग॑हि । दे॒वेभि॑र्ह॒व्यदा॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǀ víśvaiḥ ǀ ū́mebhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, with all the protecting deities, to drink the libation; come with the gods”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋत॑धीतय॒ आ ग॑त॒ सत्य॑धर्माणो अध्व॒रम् । अ॒ग्नेः पि॑बत जि॒ह्वया॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ta-dhītayaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ sátya-dharmāṇaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀagnéḥ ǀ pibata ǀ jihváyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Gods who are) devoutly praised and worshipped in truth, come to the sacrifice, and drink the libation with the tongue ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विप्रे॑भिर्विप्र सन्त्य प्रात॒र्याव॑भि॒रा ग॑हि । दे॒वेभि॒: सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: víprebhiḥ ǀ vipra ǀ santya ǀ prātaryā́va-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sage and adorableAgni, come with the wise and early-stirring divinities to drink theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सोम॑श्च॒मू सु॒तोऽम॑त्रे॒ परि॑ षिच्यते । प्रि॒य इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutáḥ ǀ ámatre ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀpriyáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomajuice, effused into the ladles, is poured out into the vase, acceptable toIndraandVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाय॒वा या॑हि वी॒तये॑ जुषा॒णो ह॒व्यदा॑तये । पिबा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सो अ॒भि प्रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ vītáye ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀpíba ǀ sutásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Vāyu, propitious to the offerer of the libation, to partake of the sacrificial food, and drink of the effused juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्च वायवेषां सु॒तानां॑ पी॒तिम॑र्हथः । ताञ्जु॑षेथामरे॒पसा॑व॒भि प्रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ vā́yo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ sutā́nām ǀ pītím ǀ arhathaḥ ǀtā́n ǀ juṣethām ǀ arepásáu ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVāyu, you ought to tdrink these libations; be gratified by them, benevolent (divinities), and partake of the sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ता इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॒ सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः । नि॒म्नं न य॑न्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ऽभि प्रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀnimnám ǀ ná ǀ yanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices mixed with curds are poured out toIndraand toVāyu; the sacrificial viands proceed to you as rivers flow downwards.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जूर्विश्वे॑भिर्दे॒वेभि॑र॒श्विभ्या॑मु॒षसा॑ स॒जूः । आ या॑ह्यग्ने अत्रि॒वत्सु॒ते र॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jū́ḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ uṣásā ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ atri-vát ǀ suté ǀ raṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accompanied by all the gods, accompanied by theAśvins, and by Uṣas, comeAgni, and likeAtridelight in the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जूर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां स॒जूः सोमे॑न॒ विष्णु॑ना । आ या॑ह्यग्ने अत्रि॒वत्सु॒ते र॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jū́ḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇābhyām ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀ sómena ǀ víṣṇunā ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ atri-vát ǀ suté ǀ raṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accompanied byMitraandVaruṇa, accompanied bySomaandViṣṇu, come,Agniand likeAtri, delight in the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जूरा॑दि॒त्यैर्वसु॑भिः स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । आ या॑ह्यग्ने अत्रि॒वत्सु॒ते र॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jū́ḥ ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ vāyúnā ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ atri-vát ǀ suté ǀ raṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accompanied byĀdityaand theVasusaccompanied byIndranad byVāyu, come,Agni, and like,Atri, delight in the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति नो॑ मिमीताम॒श्विना॒ भग॑: स्व॒स्ति दे॒व्यदि॑तिरन॒र्वण॑: । स्व॒स्ति पू॒षा असु॑रो दधातु नः स्व॒स्ति द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी सु॑चे॒तुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ mimītām ǀ aśvínā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ anarváṇaḥ ǀsvastí ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ dadhātu ǀ naḥ ǀ svastí ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ su-cetúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theAśvinscontribute to our prosperity; mayBhaga, and the divineAditi(contribute) to (our) prosperity; may the irrestibleViṣṇu, the scatterer (of foes), bestow upon us prosperity; may the conscious Heaven and Earth (bestow upon us) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्तये॑ वा॒युमुप॑ ब्रवामहै॒ सोमं॑ स्व॒स्ति भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पति॑: । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ सर्व॑गणं स्व॒स्तये॑ स्व॒स्तय॑ आदि॒त्यासो॑ भवन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: svastáye ǀ vāyúm ǀ úpa ǀ bravāmahai ǀ sómam ǀ svastí ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ yáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ sárva-gaṇam ǀ svastáye ǀ svastáye ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorifyVāyufor prosperity,Somafor prosperity, he who is the protector of the world; (we praise)Bṛhaspati(attended by) all the companies (of the deities), for prosperity, and for our prosperity may theĀdityasbe ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा नो॑ अ॒द्या स्व॒स्तये॑ वैश्वान॒रो वसु॑र॒ग्निः स्व॒स्तये॑ । दे॒वा अ॑वन्त्वृ॒भव॑: स्व॒स्तये॑ स्व॒स्ति नो॑ रु॒द्रः पा॒त्वंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ svastáye ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ svastáye ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ svastáye ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all the gods be with us today for our prosperity mayAgni, the benefactor of all men, and giver of dwellings, (be with us) for (our) prosperity; may the divineṚbhusprotect us for (our) prosperity; mayRudrapreserve us from iniquity for (our) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति मि॑त्रावरुणा स्व॒स्ति प॑थ्ये रेवति । स्व॒स्ति न॒ इन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॑ स्व॒स्ति नो॑ अदिते कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ svastí ǀ pathye ǀ revati ǀsvastí ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ agníḥ ǀ ca ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ adite ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, grant us prosperity; path (of the firmament), and goddess of riches, (grant us) prosperity; mayIndraandAgni(grant us) prosperity;Aditi, bestow prosperity upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति पन्था॒मनु॑ चरेम सूर्याचन्द्र॒मसा॑विव । पुन॒र्दद॒ताघ्न॑ता जान॒ता सं ग॑मेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu ǀ carema ǀ sūryācandramásau-iva ǀpúnaḥ ǀ dádatā ǀ ághnatā ǀ jānatā́ ǀ sám ǀ gamemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we ever follow prosperously our path, like the sun and the moon; may we be associated with a requiting, grateful and recognisant (kinsman).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र श्या॑वाश्व धृष्णु॒यार्चा॑ म॒रुद्भि॒ॠक्व॑भिः । ये अ॑द्रो॒घम॑नुष्व॒धं श्रवो॒ मद॑न्ति य॒ज्ञिया॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śyāva-aśva ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ árca ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀyé ǀ adroghám ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ mádanti ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, worship with person verance,Śyāvāśva, to the praise-deservingMaruts; they who are adorable and delight in the daily offered and inoffensive sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि स्थि॒रस्य॒ शव॑स॒: सखा॑य॒: सन्ति॑ धृष्णु॒या । ते याम॒न्ना धृ॑ष॒द्विन॒स्त्मना॑ पान्ति॒ शश्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ sthirásya ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀté ǀ yā́man ǀ ā́ ǀ dhṛṣat-vínaḥ ǀ tmánā ǀ pānti ǀ śáśvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are the firm friends of steady vigour, who, proceeding resolute on their way, willingly protect (our) numerous (descendants).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते स्य॒न्द्रासो॒ नोक्षणोऽति॑ ष्कन्दन्ति॒ शर्व॑रीः । म॒रुता॒मधा॒ महो॑ दि॒वि क्ष॒मा च॑ मन्महे
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ syandrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ áti ǀ skandanti ǀ śárvarīḥ ǀmarútām ǀ ádha ǀ máhaḥ ǀ diví ǀ kṣamā́ ǀ ca ǀ manmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gliding along, and shedding moisture, they pass through the nights; therefore we now celebrate the might of theMaruts, manifested in both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्सु॑ वो दधीमहि॒ स्तोमं॑ य॒ज्ञं च॑ धृष्णु॒या । विश्वे॒ ये मानु॑षा यु॒गा पान्ति॒ मर्त्यं॑ रि॒षः
shlokas.transliteration: marút-su ǀ vaḥ ǀ dadhīmahi ǀ stómam ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀvíśve ǀ yé ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ pā́nti ǀ mártyam ǀ riṣáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We enjoin you, (priests), to offer earnestly praise and sacrifice to theMaruts, who through all human ages, protect the mortal worshipper from harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्ह॑न्तो॒ ये सु॒दान॑वो॒ नरो॒ असा॑मिशवसः । प्र य॒ज्ञं य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्यो दि॒वो अ॑र्चा म॒रुद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: árhantaḥ ǀ yé ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ásāmi-śavasaḥ ǀprá ǀ yajñám ǀ yajñíyebhyaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ arca ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer sacrifice to the adorableMaruts, who (have come) from heaven, who are worthy of worship, munificent leaders (of rites), and possessors of unequalled strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रु॒क्मैरा यु॒धा नर॑ ऋ॒ष्वा ऋ॒ष्टीर॑सृक्षत । अन्वे॑नाँ॒ अह॑ वि॒द्युतो॑ म॒रुतो॒ जज्झ॑तीरिव भा॒नुर॑र्त॒ त्मना॑ दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rukmáiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́ḥ ǀ ṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀánu ǀ enān ǀ áha ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ jájhjhatīḥ-iva ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ arta ǀ tmánā ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of the rains), the mightyMarutsshine with brilliant ornaments and weapons, and hurl javelin (at their foes, the clouds); the lightnings like roaring (torrents), daily follow the Maruts; the radiance of the resplendent (cohort) spontaneously breaks forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये वा॑वृ॒धन्त॒ पार्थि॑वा॒ य उ॒राव॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ आ । वृ॒जने॑ वा न॒दीनां॑ स॒धस्थे॑ वा म॒हो दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ vavṛdhánta ǀ pā́rthivāḥ ǀ yé ǀ uráu ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ā́ ǀvṛjáne ǀ vā ǀ nadī́nām ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMaruts, who are of the earth are augmented, so are those in the vast firmament; they increase in the force of the rivers, and in the aggregate of the spacious heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शर्धो॒ मारु॑त॒मुच्छं॑स स॒त्यश॑वस॒मृभ्व॑सम् । उ॒त स्म॒ ते शु॒भे नर॒: प्र स्य॒न्द्रा यु॑जत॒ त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ út ǀ śaṃsa ǀ satyá-śavasam ǀ ṛ́bhvasam ǀutá ǀ sma ǀ té ǀ śubhé ǀ náraḥ ǀ prá ǀ syandrā́ḥ ǀ yujata ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify the truth-invigorated and infinite strength of theMaruts, for they, the leaders (of the rains), gliding along, are labouring voluntarily for (our) good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्म॒ ते परु॑ष्ण्या॒मूर्णा॑ वसत शु॒न्ध्यव॑: । उ॒त प॒व्या रथा॑ना॒मद्रिं॑ भिन्द॒न्त्योज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ té ǀ páruṣṇyām ǀ ū́rṇāḥ ǀ vasata ǀ śundhyávaḥ ǀutá ǀ pavyā́ ǀ ráthānām ǀ ádrim ǀ bhindanti ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether they (abide) on the Paruṣṇi (river), or, purifying (all), they clothe themselves with light, or whether they break through the clouds with strength by the wheels of their chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑थयो॒ विप॑थ॒योऽन्त॑स्पथा॒ अनु॑पथाः । ए॒तेभि॒र्मह्यं॒ नाम॑भिर्य॒ज्ञं वि॑ष्टा॒र ओ॑हते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́pathayaḥ ǀ ví-pathayaḥ ǀ ántaḥ-pathāḥ ǀ ánu-pathāḥ ǀetébhiḥ ǀ máhyam ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ vi-stāráḥ ǀ ohate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Whether), following the paths that lead (to us), or that spread diversely, or those that sink into the hollows (of the mountain), or those that extend smoothly, they, (however) scattered, accept the sacrifice for my benefit, (when invoked by these appellations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ नरो॒ न्यो॑ह॒तेऽधा॑ नि॒युत॑ ओहते । अधा॒ पारा॑वता॒ इति॑ चि॒त्रा रू॒पाणि॒ दर्श्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ náraḥ ǀ ní ǀ ohate ǀ ádha ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ ohate ǀádha ǀ pā́rāvatāḥ ǀ íti ǀ citrā́ ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ dárśyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now, leaders (of the rains), they support (the world); now, blending together, they bear (the oblation) now, situated remote, (they uphold distant objects); so may their manifold forms be manifest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: छ॒न्द॒:स्तुभ॑: कुभ॒न्यव॒ उत्स॒मा की॒रिणो॑ नृतुः । ते मे॒ के चि॒न्न ता॒यव॒ ऊमा॑ आसन्दृ॒शि त्वि॒षे
shlokas.transliteration: chandaḥ-stúbhaḥ ǀ kubhanyávaḥ ǀ útsam ǀ ā́ ǀ kīríṇaḥ ǀ nṛtuḥ ǀté ǀ me ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ ná ǀ tāyávaḥ ǀ ū́māḥ ǀ āsan ǀ dṛśí ǀ tviṣé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The reciters of sacred metres, desirous of water, and celebrating (theMaruts), have drawn them to (provide) a well (forGotama); some of them (invisible) as thieves, have been my defenders; some have been (obvious) to view through the light (of life). ”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ष्वा ऋ॒ष्टिवि॑द्युतः क॒वय॒: सन्ति॑ वे॒धस॑: । तमृ॑षे॒ मारु॑तं ग॒णं न॑म॒स्या र॒मया॑ गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́ḥ ǀ ṛṣṭí-vidyutaḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀtám ǀ ṛṣe ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀ namasyá ǀ ramáya ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify, Ṛṣi, with grateful praise, the company of theMaruts, who are manifest, bright with lightning lances, who are wise, and the creators (of all things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छ॑ ऋषे॒ मारु॑तं ग॒णं दा॒ना मि॒त्रं न यो॒षणा॑ । दि॒वो वा॑ धृष्णव॒ ओज॑सा स्तु॒ता धी॒भिरि॑षण्यत
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ ṛṣe ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀ dānā́ ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ yoṣáṇā ǀdiváḥ ǀ vā ǀ dhṛṣṇavaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ stutā́ḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ iṣaṇyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach, Ṛṣi, with offerings and with praise, the company of theMarutslike a friend; come, sustaining (Maruts), with your strength, from heaven of (any other region), glorified by our hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू म॑न्वा॒न ए॑षां दे॒वाँ अच्छा॒ न व॒क्षणा॑ । दा॒ना स॑चेत सू॒रिभि॒र्याम॑श्रुतेभिर॒ञ्जिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ manvānáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ ná ǀ vakṣáṇā ǀdānā́ ǀ saceta ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ yā́ma-śrutebhiḥ ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorifying them promptly, desiring not to bring (other) deities to (his) presence, let (the worshipper) associate his gifts with those wise (divinities) renowned for their velocity, and distributors (of rewards).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये मे॑ बन्ध्वे॒षे गां वोच॑न्त सू॒रय॒: पृश्निं॑ वोचन्त मा॒तर॑म् । अधा॑ पि॒तर॑मि॒ष्मिणं॑ रु॒द्रं वो॑चन्त॒ शिक्व॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ me ǀ bandhu-eṣé ǀ gā́m ǀ vócanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ pṛ́śnim ǀ vocanta ǀ mātáram ǀádha ǀ pitáram ǀ iṣmíṇam ǀ rudrám ǀ vocanta ǀ śíkvasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To me, inquiring of their kindred, the sage (Maruts) have uttered a reply; they have declareePṛṣṇi(to be their) mother; the mighty ones have declared the food-bestowingRudra(to be their) father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त मे॑ स॒प्त शा॒किन॒ एक॑मेका श॒ता द॑दुः । य॒मुना॑या॒मधि॑ श्रु॒तमुद्राधो॒ गव्यं॑ मृजे॒ नि राधो॒ अश्व्यं॑ मृजे
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ me ǀ saptá ǀ śākínaḥ ǀ ékam-ekā ǀ śatā́ ǀ daduḥ ǀyamúnāyām ǀ ádhi ǀ śrutám ǀ út ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ gávyam ǀ mṛje ǀ ní ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ áśvyam ǀ mṛje ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the seven times seven all-potent (Maruts, aggregated as) a single troop, bestow upon me hundreds (of cattle) may I possess wealth of cows, renowned upon the (banks of) theYamunā; may I possess wealth of horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वे॑द॒ जान॑मेषां॒ को वा॑ पु॒रा सु॒म्नेष्वा॑स म॒रुता॑म् । यद्यु॑यु॒ज्रे कि॑ला॒स्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ veda ǀ jā́nam ǀ eṣām ǀ káḥ ǀ vā ǀ purā́ ǀ sumnéṣu ǀ āsa ǀ marútām ǀyát ǀ yuyujré ǀ kilāsyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who knows the birth of these (Maruts)? who has formerly been (participant) of the enjoyments of them (by whom) the spotted deer are harnessed (to their chariots)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐतान्रथे॑षु त॒स्थुष॒: कः शु॑श्राव क॒था य॑युः । कस्मै॑ सस्रुः सु॒दासे॒ अन्वा॒पय॒ इळा॑भिर्वृ॒ष्टय॑: स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ etā́n ǀ rátheṣu ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ śuśrāva ǀ kathā́ ǀ yayuḥ ǀkásmai ǀ sasruḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ ánu ǀ āpáyaḥ ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who has head them, when standing in their cars, (declare) whither they go? Upon what liberal worshipper do their kindred rains descend together with manifold food?”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते म॑ आहु॒र्य आ॑य॒युरुप॒ द्युभि॒र्विभि॒र्मदे॑ । नरो॒ मर्या॑ अरे॒पस॑ इ॒मान्पश्य॒न्निति॑ ष्टुहि
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ me ǀ āhuḥ ǀ yé ǀ ā-yayúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ máde ǀnáraḥ ǀ máryāḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǀ imā́n ǀ páśyan ǀ íti ǀ stuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To me have they spoken; they have come to me with radiant steeds to (drink) the exhilarating beverage; to them (they have said), when, beholding them, who are the formless leaders (of rites), and friends of man, repeat our prais.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॒ञ्जिषु॒ ये वाशी॑षु॒ स्वभा॑नवः स्र॒क्षु रु॒क्मेषु॑ खा॒दिषु॑ । श्रा॒या रथे॑षु॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ añjíṣu ǀ yé ǀ vā́śīṣu ǀ svá-bhānavaḥ ǀ srakṣú ǀ rukméṣu ǀ khādíṣu ǀśrāyā́ḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The praise of them) who are all self-irradiating splendid in ornaments, in arms, in garlands, in breast-plural tes, in bracelets, in chariots, in bows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्माकं॑ स्मा॒ रथाँ॒ अनु॑ मु॒दे द॑धे मरुतो जीरदानवः । वृ॒ष्टी द्यावो॑ य॒तीरि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́kam ǀ sma ǀ ráthān ǀ ánu ǀ mudé ǀ dadhe ǀ marutaḥ ǀ jīra-dānavaḥ ǀvṛṣṭī́ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ yatī́ḥ-iva ǁ
