shlokas.meaning_en: “I contemplate your chariots, munificentMaruts, with delight, like wandering lights in the rains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यं नर॑: सु॒दान॑वो ददा॒शुषे॑ दि॒वः कोश॒मचु॑च्यवुः । वि प॒र्जन्यं॑ सृजन्ति॒ रोद॑सी॒ अनु॒ धन्व॑ना यन्ति वृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yám ǀ náraḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ dadāśúṣe ǀ diváḥ ǀ kóśam ǀ ácucyavuḥ ǀví ǀ parjányam ǀ sṛjanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǀ dhánvanā ǀ yanti ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of the rain), munificent givers, they cause that which is the treasury (of water) to fall from the sky for (the benefit of) the donor (of the offering); they let loose the rain cloud, and the shedders of rain spread (everywhere) with (abundant) water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒तृ॒दा॒नाः सिन्ध॑व॒: क्षोद॑सा॒ रज॒: प्र स॑स्रुर्धे॒नवो॑ यथा । स्य॒न्ना अश्वा॑ इ॒वाध्व॑नो वि॒मोच॑ने॒ वि यद्वर्त॑न्त ए॒न्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tatṛdānā́ḥ ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ kṣódasā ǀ rájaḥ ǀ prá ǀ sasruḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ yathā ǀsyannā́ḥ ǀ áśvāḥ-iva ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ vi-mócane ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ vártante ǀ enyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gliding (torrents), issuing (from the clouds), overspread the firmament with water, as cows (yield milk), and like rapid horses let loose upon the road, the rivers rush in various directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑त मरुतो दि॒व आन्तरि॑क्षाद॒मादु॒त । माव॑ स्थात परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ amā́t ǀ utá ǀmā́ ǀ áva ǀ sthāta ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Maruts, from heaven, from the firmament, or from this (earth); tarry not far off.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा वो॑ र॒सानि॑तभा॒ कुभा॒ क्रुमु॒र्मा व॒: सिन्धु॒र्नि री॑रमत् । मा व॒: परि॑ ष्ठात्स॒रयु॑: पुरी॒षिण्य॒स्मे इत्सु॒म्नम॑स्तु वः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ rasā́ ǀ ánitabhā ǀ kúbhā ǀ krúmuḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ní ǀ rīramat ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sthāt ǀ saráyuḥ ǀ purīṣíṇī ǀ asmé íti ǀ ít ǀ sumnám ǀ astu ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not theRasa, the Anitabhā, theKubhā, or the wide-roving ocean delay you; let not the waterySarayuoppose you; may the happiness of your (approach) be ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॒: शर्धं॒ रथा॑नां त्वे॒षं ग॒णं मारु॑तं॒ नव्य॑सीनाम् । अनु॒ प्र य॑न्ति वृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdham ǀ ráthānām ǀ tveṣám ǀ gaṇám ǀ mā́rutam ǀ návyasīnām ǀánu ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise that brilliant company of theMaruts, who have your strength of recent chariots, you whom the rains attend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शर्धं॑शर्धं व एषां॒ व्रातं॑व्रातं ग॒णंग॑णं सुश॒स्तिभि॑: । अनु॑ क्रामेम धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śárdham-śardham ǀ vaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ vrā́tam-vrātam ǀ gaṇám-gaṇam ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀánu ǀ krāmema ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us wait with sacred praises and holy rites upon your several strength, and separate troop, and individual company.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्मा॑ अ॒द्य सुजा॑ताय रा॒तह॑व्याय॒ प्र य॑युः । ए॒ना यामे॑न म॒रुत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kásmai ǀ adyá ǀ sú-jātāya ǀ rātá-havyāya ǀ prá ǀ yayuḥ ǀenā́ ǀ yā́mena ǀ marútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To what well-born and oblation-giving (worshipper) will theMarutstoday in tthis their car?”

shlokas.sanskrit: येन॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय धा॒न्यं१॒॑ बीजं॒ वह॑ध्वे॒ अक्षि॑तम् । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्ध॑त्तन॒ यद्व॒ ईम॑हे॒ राधो॑ वि॒श्वायु॒ सौभ॑गम्
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ dhānyám ǀ bī́jam ǀ váhadhve ǀ ákṣitam ǀasmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ dhattana ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ī́mahe ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ viśvá-āyu ǀ sáubhagam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With the same (goodwill) that you bestow imperishable grain-seed upon a son or grandson, bestow it upon us, for we ask of you life-sustaining and auspicious wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अती॑याम नि॒दस्ति॒रः स्व॒स्तिभि॑र्हि॒त्वाव॒द्यमरा॑तीः । वृ॒ष्ट्वी शं योराप॑ उ॒स्रि भे॑ष॒जं स्याम॑ मरुतः स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ iyāma ǀ nidáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ hitvā́ ǀ avadyám ǀ árātīḥ ǀvṛṣṭvī́ ǀ sám ǀ yóḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ usrí ǀ bheṣajám ǀ syā́ma ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we overcomeour secret and reviling adversaries, having departed from iniquity by good deeds; may we possess,Maruts, through the rain (sent by you), unmixed happiness, water, cattle and herbs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒दे॒वः स॑महासति सु॒वीरो॑ नरो मरुत॒: स मर्त्य॑: । यं त्राय॑ध्वे॒ स्याम॒ ते
shlokas.transliteration: su-deváḥ ǀ samaha ǀ asati ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀyám ǀ trā́yadhve ǀ syā́ma ǀ té ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Renowned (host of)Maruts, leaders (of rites), that mortal is favoured by the gods, and blessed with progeny, whom you protet; may we be such as he is.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒हि भो॒जान्त्स्तु॑व॒तो अ॑स्य॒ याम॑नि॒ रण॒न्गावो॒ न यव॑से । य॒तः पूर्वाँ॑ इव॒ सखीँ॒रनु॑ ह्वय गि॒रा गृ॑णीहि का॒मिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stuhí ǀ bhojā́n ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ asya ǀ yā́mani ǀ ráṇam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀyatáḥ ǀ pū́rvān-iva ǀ sákhīn ǀ ánu ǀ hvaya ǀ girā́ ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ kāmínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise the givers of enjoyment, (theMaruts), at the sacrifice of this worshiper, (for they) delight in (pious praise) like cattle in fodder; wherefore call upon them as if upon friends; praise them, desirous of praise, with a sacred hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शर्धा॑य॒ मारु॑ताय॒ स्वभा॑नव इ॒मां वाच॑मनजा पर्वत॒च्युते॑ । घ॒र्म॒स्तुभे॑ दि॒व आ पृ॑ष्ठ॒यज्व॑ने द्यु॒म्नश्र॑वसे॒ महि॑ नृ॒म्णम॑र्चत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mā́rutāya ǀ svá-bhānavaḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ anaja ǀ parvata-cyúte ǀgharma-stúbhe ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṣṭha-yájvane ǀ dyumná-śravase ǀ máhi ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ arcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer praise to the company of theMaruts, the self-irradiating, the precipitators of mountains; present liberal oblations to the assuagers of heat, to those who come from the sky, to whom solemn rites are familiar, to the givers of abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ मरुतस्तवि॒षा उ॑द॒न्यवो॑ वयो॒वृधो॑ अश्व॒युज॒: परि॑ज्रयः । सं वि॒द्युता॒ दध॑ति॒ वाश॑ति त्रि॒तः स्वर॒न्त्यापो॒ऽवना॒ परि॑ज्रयः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ taviṣā́ḥ ǀ udanyávaḥ ǀ vayaḥ-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ aśva-yújaḥ ǀ pári-jrayaḥ ǀsám ǀ vi-dyútā ǀ dádhati ǀ vā́śati ǀ tritáḥ ǀ sváranti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ avánā ǀ pári-jrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your (cohort),Maruts, is conspicous, mighty shedding water and augmenting food; yoking your horse (to your cars), spreading everywhere, and combined with the lightning, the triple-stationed company roars aloud, and the circumambient waters fall upon the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्युन्म॑हसो॒ नरो॒ अश्म॑दिद्यवो॒ वात॑त्विषो म॒रुत॑: पर्वत॒च्युत॑: । अ॒ब्द॒या चि॒न्मुहु॒रा ह्रा॑दुनी॒वृत॑: स्त॒नय॑दमा रभ॒सा उदो॑जसः
shlokas.transliteration: vidyút-mahasaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ áśma-didyavaḥ ǀ vā́ta-tviṣaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ parvata-cyútaḥ ǀabda-yā́ ǀ cit ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hrāduni-vṛ́taḥ ǀ stanáyat-amāḥ ǀ rabhasā́ḥ ǀ út-ojasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMaruts(appear) radiant with lightning, leaders (of the rain), armed with weapons of adamant, blazing with the wind, the precipitators of mountains, the repeated distributors of water, wielders of the thunderbolt, roaring in concert, combining (to send rain), and of exceeding strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य१॒॑क्तून्रु॑द्रा॒ व्यहा॑नि शिक्वसो॒ व्य१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षं॒ वि रजां॑सि धूतयः । वि यदज्राँ॒ अज॑थ॒ नाव॑ ईं यथा॒ वि दु॒र्गाणि॑ मरुतो॒ नाह॑ रिष्यथ
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ aktū́n ǀ rudrāḥ ǀ ví ǀ áhāni ǀ śikvasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ ví ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀví ǀ yát ǀ ájrān ǀ ájatha ǀ nā́vaḥ ǀ īm ǀ yathā ǀ ví ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ná ǀ áha ǀ riṣyatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulRudras, you urge on the nights and days the firmament and the worlds; agitators (of all things), you toss the clouds like ships (in the sea), so (you throw down) the strong plural ces (of the enemy); but,Marutsyou do no harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वी॒र्यं॑ वो मरुतो महित्व॒नं दी॒र्घं त॑तान॒ सूर्यो॒ न योज॑नम् । एता॒ न यामे॒ अगृ॑भीतशोचि॒षोऽन॑श्वदां॒ यन्न्यया॑तना गि॒रिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vīryám ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mahi-tvanám ǀ dīrghám ǀ tatāna ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yójanam ǀétāḥ ǀ ná ǀ yā́me ǀ ágṛbhīta-śociṣaḥ ǀ ánaśva-dām ǀ yát ǀ ní ǀ áyātana ǀ girím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your prowess,Maruts, has spread wide your glory as the sun (sends afar his) radiance, or the white (horses of the gods travel far) in their course; of unbounded lustre, you close the cloud withholding the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभ्रा॑जि॒ शर्धो॑ मरुतो॒ यद॑र्ण॒सं मोष॑था वृ॒क्षं क॑प॒नेव॑ वेधसः । अध॑ स्मा नो अ॒रम॑तिं सजोषस॒श्चक्षु॑रिव॒ यन्त॒मनु॑ नेषथा सु॒गम्
shlokas.transliteration: ábhrāji ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ arṇasám ǀ móṣatha ǀ vṛkṣám ǀ kapanā́-iva ǀ vedhasaḥ ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ arámatim ǀ sa-joṣasaḥ ǀ cákṣuḥ-iva ǀ yántam ǀ ánu ǀ neṣatha ǀ su-gám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, dispensers of rain, your strength is manifested when, shaking the water-laden cloud, you let loose the shower; conjointly propitiated, conduct us by an easy path leading to prosperity, as the eye (shows the way).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न स जी॑यते मरुतो॒ न ह॑न्यते॒ न स्रे॑धति॒ न व्य॑थते॒ न रि॑ष्यति । नास्य॒ राय॒ उप॑ दस्यन्ति॒ नोतय॒ ऋषिं॑ वा॒ यं राजा॑नं वा॒ सुषू॑दथ
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ jīyate ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hanyate ǀ ná ǀ sredhati ǀ ná ǀ vyathate ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀná ǀ asya ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dasyanti ǀ ná ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ vā ǀ yám ǀ rā́jānam ǀ vā ǀ súsūdatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage, or the sovereign, whom you,Maruts, direct, is never overcome nor slain; he perishes not, nor suffers pain, nor undergoes injury, nor are his riches or his safety imperilled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒युत्व॑न्तो ग्राम॒जितो॒ यथा॒ नरो॑ऽर्य॒मणो॒ न म॒रुत॑: कब॒न्धिन॑: । पिन्व॒न्त्युत्सं॒ यदि॒नासो॒ अस्व॑र॒न्व्यु॑न्दन्ति पृथि॒वीं मध्वो॒ अन्ध॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: niyútvantaḥ ǀ grāma-jítaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ náraḥ ǀ aryamáṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ marútaḥ ǀ kabandhínaḥ ǀpínvanti ǀ útsam ǀ yát ǀ inā́saḥ ǀ ásvaran ǀ ví ǀ undanti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lords of theNiyutsteeds, overcomers of multitudes leaders (of rites), radiant as theĀdityas, are the dispensers of water; when sovereign lords, they fill the clouds, and, loud sounding, moisten the earth with sweet (watery) sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वत्व॑ती॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒रुद्भ्य॑: प्र॒वत्व॑ती॒ द्यौर्भ॑वति प्र॒यद्भ्य॑: । प्र॒वत्व॑तीः प॒थ्या॑ अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष्याः प्र॒वत्व॑न्त॒: पर्व॑ता जी॒रदा॑नवः
shlokas.transliteration: pravátvatī ǀ iyám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀ pravátvatī ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ prayát-bhyaḥ ǀpravátvatīḥ ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ antárikṣyāḥ ǀ pravátvantaḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ jīrá-dānavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This wide-extended earth is for theMaruts; the spacious heaven is for the spreading winds; the paths of the firmament are provided (for their course); for them the expanding clouds quickly bestow (their gifts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्म॑रुतः सभरसः स्वर्णर॒: सूर्य॒ उदि॑ते॒ मद॑था दिवो नरः । न वोऽश्वा॑: श्रथय॒न्ताह॒ सिस्र॑तः स॒द्यो अ॒स्याध्व॑नः पा॒रम॑श्नुथ
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sa-bharasaḥ ǀ svaḥ-naraḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ út-ite ǀ mádatha ǀ divaḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀná ǀ vaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ śrathayanta ǀ áha ǀ sísrataḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ asyá ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ aśnutha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Marutsof combined strength, leaders of the universe, guides of heaven, when the sun has risen you rejoice (in theSomabeverage), then your rapid steeds know no relaxation, but quickly you reach the limits of this road (to the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अंसे॑षु व ऋ॒ष्टय॑: प॒त्सु खा॒दयो॒ वक्ष॑स्सु रु॒क्मा म॑रुतो॒ रथे॒ शुभ॑: । अ॒ग्निभ्रा॑जसो वि॒द्युतो॒ गभ॑स्त्यो॒: शिप्रा॑: शी॒र्षसु॒ वित॑ता हिर॒ण्ययी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áṃseṣu ǀ vaḥ ǀ ṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ pat-sú ǀ khādáyaḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ-su ǀ rukmā́ḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ śúbhaḥ ǀagní-bhrājasaḥ ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ śíprāḥ ǀ śīrṣá-su ǀ ví-tatāḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lances (gleam),Maruts, upon your shoulders, anklets on your feet, golden cuirasses on your breasts, and pure (waters shine) in your chariots; lightning blazing with fire in yourhands, and golden tiarsa are towering on your heads.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नाक॑म॒र्यो अगृ॑भीतशोचिषं॒ रुश॒त्पिप्प॑लं मरुतो॒ वि धू॑नुथ । सम॑च्यन्त वृ॒जनाति॑त्विषन्त॒ यत्स्वर॑न्ति॒ घोषं॒ वित॑तमृता॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ nā́kam ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ágṛbhīta-śociṣam ǀ rúśat ǀ píppalam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhūnutha ǀsám ǀ acyanta ǀ vṛjánā ǀ átitviṣanta ǀ yát ǀ sváranti ǀ ghóṣam ǀ ví-tatam ǀ ṛta-yávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, when moving, you agitate the heaven of unchecked radiance, and (stir) the bright water; when you combine your energies and are shining brilliantly, and when purposing to send down rain, you utter a loud shout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्माद॑त्तस्य मरुतो विचेतसो रा॒यः स्या॑म र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ वय॑स्वतः । न यो युच्छ॑ति ति॒ष्यो॒३॒॑ यथा॑ दि॒वो॒३॒॑ऽस्मे रा॑रन्त मरुतः सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́-dattasya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vi-cetasaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ váyasvataḥ ǀná ǀ yáḥ ǀ yúcchati ǀ tiṣyáḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ diváḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ raranta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, who are possessed of chariots, intelligentMaruts, become (proprietors) of wealth, comprising food bestowed by you; of wealth that vanishes not, asTiṣya(declines not) from the sky; therefore, Maruts, gratify us with infinite (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं र॒यिं म॑रुतः स्पा॒र्हवी॑रं यू॒यमृषि॑मवथ॒ साम॑विप्रम् । यू॒यमर्व॑न्तं भर॒ताय॒ वाजं॑ यू॒यं ध॑त्थ॒ राजा॑नं श्रुष्टि॒मन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ rayím ǀ marutaḥ ǀ spārhá-vīram ǀ yūyám ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ avatha ǀ sā́ma-vipram ǀyūyám ǀ árvantam ǀ bharatā́ya ǀ vā́jam ǀ yūyám ǀ dhattha ǀ rā́jānam ǀ śruṣṭi-mántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You bestow,Maruts, wealth and enviable posterity; you protect the sage learned in theSāma; you grant horses and food to (me) the ministrant priest; you render a prince prosperous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वो॑ यामि॒ द्रवि॑णं सद्यऊतयो॒ येना॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण त॒तना॑म॒ नॄँर॒भि । इ॒दं सु मे॑ मरुतो हर्यता॒ वचो॒ यस्य॒ तरे॑म॒ तर॑सा श॒तं हिमा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ yāmi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ sadyaḥ-ūtayaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ tatánāma ǀ nṝ́n ǀ abhí ǀidám ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ marutaḥ ǀ haryata ǀ vácaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ tárema ǀ tárasā ǀ śatám ǀ hímāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore do I solicit wealth of you, who are prompt to grant protection, whereby we may multiply our descendants, as the sun (spreads wide his rays); be propitiated,Maruts, by this my praise, by the efficacy whereof may we pass over a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रय॑ज्यवो म॒रुतो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयो बृ॒हद्वयो॑ दधिरे रु॒क्मव॑क्षसः । ईय॑न्ते॒ अश्वै॑: सु॒यमे॑भिरा॒शुभि॒: शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: prá-yajyavaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ bhrā́jat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ rukmá-vakṣasaḥ ǀī́yante ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ su-yámebhiḥ ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableMaruts, armed with bright lances and cuirassed with golden breast-plural tes, enjoy vigorous existence; may the ears of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒यं द॑धिध्वे॒ तवि॑षीं॒ यथा॑ वि॒द बृ॒हन्म॑हान्त उर्वि॒या वि रा॑जथ । उ॒तान्तरि॑क्षं ममिरे॒ व्योज॑सा॒ शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: svayám ǀ dadhidhve ǀ táviṣīm ǀ yáthā ǀ vidá ǀ bṛhát ǀ mahāntaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ rājatha ǀutá ǀ antárikṣam ǀ mamire ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, you have of yourselves maintained your vigour according as you judge (fit); you shine most mighty and vast, and you pervade the firmament with your power; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒कं जा॒ताः सु॒भ्व॑: सा॒कमु॑क्षि॒ताः श्रि॒ये चि॒दा प्र॑त॒रं वा॑वृधु॒र्नर॑: । वि॒रो॒किण॒: सूर्य॑स्येव र॒श्मय॒: शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: sākám ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ sākám ǀ ukṣitā́ḥ ǀ śriyé ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀvi-rokíṇaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya-iva ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Born simultaneously, mighty, co-dispensers of moisture, they have grown exceedingly in glory; leaders (of rites), and radiant (are they) as the rays of the sun; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒भू॒षेण्यं॑ वो मरुतो महित्व॒नं दि॑दृ॒क्षेण्यं॒ सूर्य॑स्येव॒ चक्ष॑णम् । उ॒तो अ॒स्माँ अ॑मृत॒त्वे द॑धातन॒ शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: ā-bhūṣéṇyam ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mahi-tvanám ǀ didṛkṣéṇyam ǀ sū́ryasya-iva ǀ cákṣaṇam ǀutó íti ǀ asmā́n ǀ amṛta-tvé ǀ dadhātana ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your might,Maruts, is to be glorified; it is to be contemplated like the orb of the sun; sustain us ever in immortality; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रयथा मरुतः समुद्र॒तो यू॒यं वृ॒ष्टिं व॑र्षयथा पुरीषिणः । न वो॑ दस्रा॒ उप॑ दस्यन्ति धे॒नव॒: शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īrayatha ǀ marutaḥ ǀ samudratáḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ varṣayatha ǀ purīṣiṇaḥ ǀná ǀ vaḥ ǀ dasrāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dasyanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You send (the rain),Maruts, from the firmament; charged with the waters you shower down the rain; destroyers of foes, your kine are never dry; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदश्वा॑न्धू॒र्षु पृष॑ती॒रयु॑ग्ध्वं हिर॒ण्यया॒न्प्रत्यत्काँ॒ अमु॑ग्ध्वम् । विश्वा॒ इत्स्पृधो॑ मरुतो॒ व्य॑स्यथ॒ शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ áśvān ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ áyugdhvam ǀ hiraṇyáyān ǀ práti ǀ átkān ǀ ámugdhvam ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ít ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ví ǀ asyatha ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you yoke your spotted mares to the poles (of your chariots), you lay aside your golden breast-plural tes, for you dissipate all hostility; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न पर्व॑ता॒ न न॒द्यो॑ वरन्त वो॒ यत्राचि॑ध्वं मरुतो॒ गच्छ॒थेदु॒ तत् । उ॒त द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी या॑थना॒ परि॒ शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ ná ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ varanta ǀ vaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ ácidhvam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gácchatha ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tát ǀutá ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yāthana ǀ pári ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the mountains, let not the rivers, arrest you; whither you purpose, (Maruts), thither repair, and compass heaven and earth; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्पू॒र्व्यं म॑रुतो॒ यच्च॒ नूत॑नं॒ यदु॒द्यते॑ वसवो॒ यच्च॑ श॒स्यते॑ । विश्व॑स्य॒ तस्य॑ भवथा॒ नवे॑दस॒: शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ pūrvyám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ nū́tanam ǀ yát ǀ udyáte ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ śasyáte ǀvíśvasya ǀ tásya ǀ bhavatha ǀ návedasaḥ ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever (rite has been addressed to you),Maruts, of old; whatever is recent; whatever (hymn) is recited,Vasus, whatever prayer is repeated, do you be cognizant of all; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒ळत॑ नो मरुतो॒ मा व॑धिष्टना॒स्मभ्यं॒ शर्म॑ बहु॒लं वि य॑न्तन । अधि॑ स्तो॒त्रस्य॑ स॒ख्यस्य॑ गातन॒ शुभं॑ या॒तामनु॒ रथा॑ अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ vadhiṣṭana ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ bahulám ǀ ví ǀ yantana ǀádhi ǀ stotrásya ǀ sakhyásya ǀ gātana ǀ śúbham ǀ yātā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ráthāḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send us felicity,Maruts, harm us not; bestow upon us exceeding happiness; reward our adoration by your friendship; may the cars of the quick-moving (Maruts) arrive for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यम॒स्मान्न॑यत॒ वस्यो॒ अच्छा॒ निरं॑ह॒तिभ्यो॑ मरुतो गृणा॒नाः । जु॒षध्वं॑ नो ह॒व्यदा॑तिं यजत्रा व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ asmā́n ǀ nayata ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ níḥ ǀ aṃhatí-bhyaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀjuṣádhvam ǀ naḥ ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Maruts, conduct us to opulence; propitiated by our praises, extricate us from sin; accept, adorable (Maruts), our offered oblation, and may we be the possessors of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑न्त॒मा ग॒णं पि॒ष्टं रु॒क्मेभि॑र॒ञ्जिभि॑: । विशो॑ अ॒द्य म॒रुता॒मव॑ ह्वये दि॒वश्चि॑द्रोच॒नादधि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ śárdhantam ǀ ā́ ǀ gaṇám ǀ piṣṭám ǀ rukmébhiḥ ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀvíśaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ marútām ǀ áva ǀ hvaye ǀ diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke,Agni, the victorious company (of theMaruts) decorated with brilliant ornaments; (I invoke them), the people of the Maruts, to descend today from above the shining heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ चि॒न्मन्य॑से हृ॒दा तदिन्मे॑ जग्मुरा॒शस॑: । ये ते॒ नेदि॑ष्ठं॒ हव॑नान्या॒गम॒न्तान्व॑र्ध भी॒मसं॑दृशः
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ cit ǀ mányase ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀyé ǀ te ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ hávanāni ǀ ā-gáman ǀ tā́n ǀ vardha ǀ bhīmá-sandṛśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In whatever manner you honour the (Maruts,Agni) in your heart, may they come to me as benefactors; gratify, (by oblations), those fierce-looking Maruts, who most promptly come to your invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मी॒ळ्हुष्म॑तीव पृथि॒वी परा॑हता॒ मद॑न्त्येत्य॒स्मदा । ऋक्षो॒ न वो॑ मरुत॒: शिमी॑वाँ॒ अमो॑ दु॒ध्रो गौरि॑व भीम॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: mīḷhúṣmatī-iva ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ párā-hatā ǀ mádantī ǀ eti ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śímī-vān ǀ ámaḥ ǀ dudhráḥ ǀ gáuḥ-iva ǀ bhīma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the (people of the) earth having a powerful lord have recourse to him when oppressed (by others), so comes (the host of theMaruts) exulting to us; your company, Maruts, active as fire, is as difficult to be resisted as a formidable ox.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ये रि॒णन्त्योज॑सा॒ वृथा॒ गावो॒ न दु॒र्धुर॑: । अश्मा॑नं चित्स्व॒र्यं१॒॑ पर्व॑तं गि॒रिं प्र च्या॑वयन्ति॒ याम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ yé ǀ riṇánti ǀ ójasā ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-dhúraḥ ǀáśmānam ǀ cit ǀ svaryám ǀ párvatam ǀ girím ǀ prá ǀ cyavayanti ǀ yā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who with ease destroy (their foes) by their prowess, like horses difficult to be restrained, they send down by their movements the vast and sounding water-laden cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ति॑ष्ठ नू॒नमे॑षां॒ स्तोमै॒: समु॑क्षितानाम् । म॒रुतां॑ पुरु॒तम॒मपू॑र्व्यं॒ गवां॒ सर्ग॑मिव ह्वये
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ nūnám ǀ eṣām ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ sám-ukṣitānām ǀmarútām ǀ puru-támam ǀ ápūrvyam ǀ gávām ǀ sárgam-iva ǀ hvaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up (Maruts); verily by my praises I invoke the mighty and unpreceded (troop) of these exalted (maruts) like a heap of waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ङ्ग्ध्वं ह्यरु॑षी॒ रथे॑ यु॒ङ्ग्ध्वं रथे॑षु रो॒हित॑: । यु॒ङ्ग्ध्वं हरी॑ अजि॒रा धु॒रि वोळ्ह॑वे॒ वहि॑ष्ठा धु॒रि वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: yuṅgdhvám ǀ hí ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ yuṅgdhvám ǀ rátheṣu ǀ rohítaḥ ǀyuṅgdhvám ǀ hárī íti ǀ ajirā́ ǀ dhurí ǀ vóḷhave ǀ váhiṣṭhā ǀ dhurí ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke the bright steeds to the car, yoke the red steeds to the cars; yoke the swift pair of horses to bear the burden; the strong bearing to bear the burden.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य वा॒ज्य॑रु॒षस्तु॑वि॒ष्वणि॑रि॒ह स्म॑ धायि दर्श॒तः । मा वो॒ यामे॑षु मरुतश्चि॒रं क॑र॒त्प्र तं रथे॑षु चोदत
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ tuvi-svániḥ ǀ ihá ǀ sma ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatáḥ ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ marutaḥ ǀ cirám ǀ karat ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ rátheṣu ǀ codata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And let not that horse, bright-shining, loud-neighing, of graceful form, who has been plural ced (in harness), delay you,Maruts, on your journey; urge him on in the car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ नु मारु॑तं व॒यं श्र॑व॒स्युमा हु॑वामहे । आ यस्मि॑न्त॒स्थौ सु॒रणा॑नि॒ बिभ्र॑ती॒ सचा॑ म॒रुत्सु॑ रोद॒सी
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ nú ǀ mā́rutam ǀ vayám ǀ śravasyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ huvāmahe ǀā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ tastháu ǀ suráṇāni ǀ bíbhratī ǀ sácā ǀ marút-su ǀ rodasī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the food-laden chariot of theMaruts, in whichRodasistood with the Maruts, bearing the delicious (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॒: शर्धं॑ रथे॒शुभं॑ त्वे॒षं प॑न॒स्युमा हु॑वे । यस्मि॒न्त्सुजा॑ता सु॒भगा॑ मही॒यते॒ सचा॑ म॒रुत्सु॑ मीळ्हु॒षी
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdham ǀ rathe-śúbham ǀ tveṣám ǀ panasyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀyásmin ǀ sú-jātā ǀ su-bhágā ǀ mahīyáte ǀ sácā ǀ marút-su ǀ mīḷhuṣī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke that, your cohort, gracing the chariot, brilliant and adorable, amidst which the rain-bestowing (goddess), of goodly origin and auspicious, is worshipped together with theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रु॑द्रास॒ इन्द्र॑वन्तः स॒जोष॑सो॒ हिर॑ण्यरथाः सुवि॒ताय॑ गन्तन । इ॒यं वो॑ अ॒स्मत्प्रति॑ हर्यते म॒तिस्तृ॒ष्णजे॒ न दि॒व उत्सा॑ उद॒न्यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rudrāsaḥ ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ híraṇya-rathāḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ gantana ǀiyám ǀ vaḥ ǀ asmát ǀ práti ǀ haryate ǀ matíḥ ǀ tṛṣṇá-je ǀ ná ǀ diváḥ ǀ útsāḥ ǀ udanyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rudras, servants ofIndra, mutually kind, riding in golden cars, come to the accessible (sacrifice); this our praise is addressed to you; (come to us as you came) from heaven, (bringing) oozing water to the thirsty (Gotama) longing for moisture.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाशी॑मन्त ऋष्टि॒मन्तो॑ मनी॒षिण॑: सु॒धन्वा॑न॒ इषु॑मन्तो निष॒ङ्गिण॑: । स्वश्वा॑: स्थ सु॒रथा॑: पृश्निमातरः स्वायु॒धा म॑रुतो याथना॒ शुभ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́śī-mantaḥ ǀ ṛṣṭi-mántaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ su-dhánvānaḥ ǀ íṣu-mantaḥ ǀ niṣaṅgíṇaḥ ǀsu-áśvāḥ ǀ stha ǀ su-ráthāḥ ǀ pṛśni-mātaraḥ ǀ su-āyudhā́ḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yāthana ǀ śúbham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IntelligentMaruts, you are armed with swords, with lances, with bows with arrows, with quivers; you are well mounted and have handsome chariots; sons ofPṛṣṇiyou are well armed; come for our good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धू॒नु॒थ द्यां पर्व॑तान्दा॒शुषे॒ वसु॒ नि वो॒ वना॑ जिहते॒ याम॑नो भि॒या । को॒पय॑थ पृथि॒वीं पृ॑श्निमातरः शु॒भे यदु॑ग्रा॒: पृष॑ती॒रयु॑ग्ध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: dhūnuthá ǀ dyā́m ǀ párvatān ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ ní ǀ vaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ jihate ǀ yā́manaḥ ǀ bhiyā́ ǀkopáyatha ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ pṛśni-mātaraḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ yát ǀ ugrāḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ áyugdhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You agitate the clouds in the sky; (you give) wealth to the donor (of oblations); through fear of your approach the forests bow down; sons ofPṛṣṇi, you incense the earth when, for the purpose of (sending) water, you, fierce (Maruts), yoke your spotted steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वात॑त्विषो म॒रुतो॑ व॒र्षनि॑र्णिजो य॒मा इ॑व॒ सुस॑दृशः सु॒पेश॑सः । पि॒शङ्गा॑श्वा अरु॒णाश्वा॑ अरे॒पस॒: प्रत्व॑क्षसो महि॒ना द्यौरि॑वो॒रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vā́ta-tviṣaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ varṣá-nirnijaḥ ǀ yamā́ḥ-iva ǀ sú-sadṛśaḥ ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǀpiśáṅga-aśvāḥ ǀ aruṇá-aśvāḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǀ prá-tvakṣasaḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ dyáuḥ-iva ǀ urávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMaruts, radiant with light, purifiers of the rain, like twins of goodly aspect and graceful form, masters of tawny and of ruddy steeds, devoid of guile, thinners (of foes) and vast in magnitude as the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒द्र॒प्सा अ॑ञ्जि॒मन्त॑: सु॒दान॑वस्त्वे॒षसं॑दृशो अनव॒भ्ररा॑धसः । सु॒जा॒तासो॑ ज॒नुषा॑ रु॒क्मव॑क्षसो दि॒वो अ॒र्का अ॒मृतं॒ नाम॑ भेजिरे
shlokas.transliteration: puru-drapsā́ḥ ǀ añji-mántaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ tveṣá-sandṛśaḥ ǀ anavabhrá-rādhasaḥ ǀsu-jātā́saḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ rukmá-vakṣasaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ nā́ma ǀ bhejire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shedders of abundant showers, wearers of ornaments, munificent, of brilliant aspect, of inexhaustible wealth well descendent by birth, wearing golden breast-plural tes, entitled to adoration, (coming) from heaven, accept teḥ ambrosial oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ष्टयो॑ वो मरुतो॒ अंस॑यो॒रधि॒ सह॒ ओजो॑ बा॒ह्वोर्वो॒ बलं॑ हि॒तम् । नृ॒म्णा शी॒र्षस्वायु॑धा॒ रथे॑षु वो॒ विश्वा॑ व॒: श्रीरधि॑ त॒नूषु॑ पिपिशे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ áṃsayoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ bálam ǀ hitám ǀnṛmṇā́ ǀ śīrṣá-su ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ rátheṣu ǀ vaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ vaḥ ǀ śrī́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ pipiśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lances rest,Maruts, upon your shoulders; strength (of) foes-destroying power is seated in your arms; golden (tiaras) are on your heads, weapons are plural ced in your chariots, all glory is assembled in your limbs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोम॒दश्वा॑व॒द्रथ॑वत्सु॒वीरं॑ च॒न्द्रव॒द्राधो॑ मरुतो ददा नः । प्रश॑स्तिं नः कृणुत रुद्रियासो भक्षी॒य वोऽव॑सो॒ दैव्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ rátha-vat ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ candrá-vat ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ dada ǀ naḥ ǀprá-śastim ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛṇuta ǀ rudriyāsaḥ ǀ bhakṣīyá ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávasaḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, bestow upon us affluence, comprehending cattle, horses, cars, treasure, andmaledescendants; sons ofRudra, grant us distinction; may I ever enjoy your divine protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒ये नरो॒ मरु॑तो मृ॒ळता॑ न॒स्तुवी॑मघासो॒ अमृ॑ता॒ ऋत॑ज्ञाः । सत्य॑श्रुत॒: कव॑यो॒ युवा॑नो॒ बृह॑द्गिरयो बृ॒हदु॒क्षमा॑णाः
shlokas.transliteration: hayé ǀ náraḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǀ túvi-maghāsaḥ ǀ ámṛtāḥ ǀ ṛ́ta-jñāḥ ǀsátya-śrutaḥ ǀ kávayaḥ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ bṛ́hat-girayaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ ukṣámāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ho,Maruts, leaders (of rites), be propitious to us, you who are infinitely opulent, immortal, shedders of rain, renowned for truth, wise, young, greatly glorified, and worshipped with copious oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ नू॒नं तवि॑षीमन्तमेषां स्तु॒षे ग॒णं मारु॑तं॒ नव्य॑सीनाम् । य आ॒श्व॑श्वा॒ अम॑व॒द्वह॑न्त उ॒तेशि॑रे अ॒मृत॑स्य स्व॒राज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nūnám ǀ táviṣī-mantam ǀ eṣām ǀ stuṣé ǀ gaṇám ǀ mā́rutam ǀ návyasīnām ǀyé ǀ āśú-aśvāḥ ǀ áma-vat ǀ váhante ǀ utá ǀ īśire ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise today that brilliant company of the adorableMaruts, lords of swift horses, who pass along in strength, who, self-radiant, preside over the ambrosial rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षं ग॒णं त॒वसं॒ खादि॑हस्तं॒ धुनि॑व्रतं मा॒यिनं॒ दाति॑वारम् । म॒यो॒भुवो॒ ये अमि॑ता महि॒त्वा वन्द॑स्व विप्र तुवि॒राध॑सो॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ gaṇám ǀ tavásam ǀ khā́di-hastam ǀ dhúni-vratam ǀ māyínam ǀ dā́ti-vāram ǀmayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ámitāḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ vándasva ǀ vipra ǀ tuvi-rā́dhasaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore, priest, the resplendent and powerful company, whose arms (are decorated) with bracelets, whose function is the agitation (of the trees), who are wise, and by whom wealth is conferred; they who are bestowers of felicity, whose greatness is unbounded; glorify the opulent leaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॑ यन्तूदवा॒हासो॑ अ॒द्य वृ॒ष्टिं ये विश्वे॑ म॒रुतो॑ जु॒नन्ति॑ । अ॒यं यो अ॒ग्निर्म॑रुत॒: समि॑द्ध ए॒तं जु॑षध्वं कवयो युवानः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ uda-vāhā́saḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ yé ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ junánti ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ etám ǀ juṣadhvam ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ yuvānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the universalMaruts, who urge on the rain, come to you today laden with water; Maruts, who are wise and young, be plural ased by this fire which is kindled for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं राजा॑न॒मिर्यं॒ जना॑य विभ्वत॒ष्टं ज॑नयथा यजत्राः । यु॒ष्मदे॑ति मुष्टि॒हा बा॒हुजू॑तो यु॒ष्मत्सद॑श्वो मरुतः सु॒वीर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ rā́jānam ǀ íryam ǀ jánāya ǀ vibhva-taṣṭám ǀ janayatha ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀyuṣmát ǀ eti ǀ muṣṭi-hā́ ǀ bāhú-jūtaḥ ǀ yuṣmát ǀ sát-aśvaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableMaruts, you cause (a son) to be born to the man (who worships you), a ruler, an over-comer of foes, and modelled by Vibhvan; from you, Maruts, comes a valiant descendant, strong-fisted, mighty armed; from you (he acquires) an excellent steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रा इ॒वेदच॑रमा॒ अहे॑व॒ प्रप्र॑ जायन्ते॒ अक॑वा॒ महो॑भिः । पृश्ने॑: पु॒त्रा उ॑प॒मासो॒ रभि॑ष्ठा॒: स्वया॑ म॒त्या म॒रुत॒: सं मि॑मिक्षुः
shlokas.transliteration: arā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ ácaramāḥ ǀ áhā-iva ǀ prá-pra ǀ jāyante ǀ ákavāḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀpṛ́śneḥ ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mā́saḥ ǀ rábhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ sváyā ǀ matyā́ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sám ǀ mimikṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like the spokes of a wheel, none (of you) are inferior (to the rest), but equal as days (of like duration); the sons ofPṛṣṇiare born all alike, none inferior in splendour; rapid in speed, theMaruts, of their own free favour send down (the rains).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्प्राया॑सिष्ट॒ पृष॑तीभि॒रश्वै॑र्वीळुप॒विभि॑र्मरुतो॒ रथे॑भिः । क्षोद॑न्त॒ आपो॑ रिण॒ते वना॒न्यवो॒स्रियो॑ वृष॒भः क्र॑न्दतु॒ द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ prá ǀ áyāsiṣṭa ǀ pṛ́ṣatībhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ vīḷupaví-bhiḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀkṣódante ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ riṇaté ǀ vánāni ǀ áva ǀ usríyaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ krandatu ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Maruts, you come with stout-axled cars drawn by spotted steeds, then the waters descend, the forests are damaged,a nd the bright showerer (of the rain), influenced by the solar rays, may emit a downward sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रथि॑ष्ट॒ याम॑न्पृथि॒वी चि॑देषां॒ भर्ते॑व॒ गर्भं॒ स्वमिच्छवो॑ धुः । वाता॒न्ह्यश्वा॑न्धु॒र्या॑युयु॒ज्रे व॒र्षं स्वेदं॑ चक्रिरे रु॒द्रिया॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: práthiṣṭa ǀ yā́man ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ cit ǀ eṣām ǀ bhártā-iva ǀ gárbham ǀ svám ǀ ít ǀ śávaḥ ǀ dhuḥ ǀvā́tān ǀ hí ǀ áśvān ǀ dhurí ǀ ā-yuyujré ǀ varṣám ǀ svédam ǀ cakrire ǀ rudríyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “On their approach the earth becomes capable of fertility, and they deposit in her water as their germ, as the husband genitive rates the embryo of the child; they have harnessed their horses fleet as the wind; the sons ofRudrahave emitted their person iration, (the rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒ये नरो॒ मरु॑तो मृ॒ळता॑ न॒स्तुवी॑मघासो॒ अमृ॑ता॒ ऋत॑ज्ञाः । सत्य॑श्रुत॒: कव॑यो॒ युवा॑नो॒ बृह॑द्गिरयो बृ॒हदु॒क्षमा॑णाः
shlokas.transliteration: hayé ǀ náraḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǀ túvi-maghāsaḥ ǀ ámṛtāḥ ǀ ṛ́ta-jñāḥ ǀsátya-śrutaḥ ǀ kávayaḥ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ bṛ́hat-girayaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ ukṣámāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ho,Maruts, leaders (of rites), be propitious to us, you who are infinitely opulent, immortal, shedders of rain, renowned for truth, wise, young, greatly glorified, and worshipped with copious oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒: स्पळ॑क्रन्त्सुवि॒ताय॑ दा॒वनेऽर्चा॑ दि॒वे प्र पृ॑थि॒व्या ऋ॒तं भ॑रे । उ॒क्षन्ते॒ अश्वा॒न्तरु॑षन्त॒ आ रजोऽनु॒ स्वं भा॒नुं श्र॑थयन्ते अर्ण॒वैः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ spáṭ ǀ akran ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ dāváne ǀ árca ǀ divé ǀ prá ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ ṛtám ǀ bhare ǀukṣánte ǀ áśvān ǀ táruṣante ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svám ǀ bhānúm ǀ śrathayante ǀ arṇaváiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priest glorifies you,Maruts, for the good of the donor of the oblation; offer worship to the shining (heaven); I bring offerings to the earth; they, the Maruts, scatter the rapid (rain); they traverse the firmament; they combine their own radiance with (that of) the clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमा॑देषां भि॒यसा॒ भूमि॑रेजति॒ नौर्न पू॒र्णा क्ष॑रति॒ व्यथि॑र्य॒ती । दू॒रे॒दृशो॒ ये चि॒तय॑न्त॒ एम॑भिर॒न्तर्म॒हे वि॒दथे॑ येतिरे॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ámāt ǀ eṣām ǀ bhiyásā ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ejati ǀ náuḥ ǀ ná ǀ pūrṇā́ ǀ kṣarati ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ yatī́ ǀdūre-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ yé ǀ citáyante ǀ éma-bhiḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahé ǀ vidáthe ǀ yetire ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From their approach, the earth trembles with fear as a crowded boat goes quivering (through the water) visible from afar, they are recognized by their movements; theMaruts, leaders (of rites), pass between (heaven and earth) to the solemn sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गवा॑मिव श्रि॒यसे॒ शृङ्ग॑मुत्त॒मं सूर्यो॒ न चक्षू॒ रज॑सो वि॒सर्ज॑ने । अत्या॑ इव सु॒भ्व१॒॑श्चार॑वः स्थन॒ मर्या॑ इव श्रि॒यसे॑ चेतथा नरः
shlokas.transliteration: gávām-iva ǀ śriyáse ǀ śṛ́ṅgam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-sárjane ǀátyāḥ-iva ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ cā́ravaḥ ǀ sthana ǀ máryāḥ-iva ǀ śriyáse ǀ cetatha ǀ naraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You bear, for your decoration, an excellent (diadem) like the horn of cattle; as the sun, the eye (of day, dispenses light), so (are you diligent) in the distribution of the rains; graceful are you, and rapid as horses, and like (pious) mortals, you, leaders (of rites), consider (holy ceremonies) for their glory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वो॑ म॒हान्ति॑ मह॒तामुद॑श्नव॒त्कस्काव्या॑ मरुत॒: को ह॒ पौंस्या॑ । यू॒यं ह॒ भूमिं॑ कि॒रणं॒ न रे॑जथ॒ प्र यद्भर॑ध्वे सुवि॒ताय॑ दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahā́nti ǀ mahatā́m ǀ út ǀ aśnavat ǀ káḥ ǀ kā́vyā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ ha ǀ páuṃsyā ǀyūyám ǀ ha ǀ bhū́mim ǀ kiráṇam ǀ ná ǀ rejatha ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ bháradhve ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who may exalt the great excellences of you who are adorable? who may (offer you fitting) praises? who (glorify your) manly (deeds)? For you make the earth tremble like a ray (of light) when you confer the gift (of rain) for (the diffusion of) fertility.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑ इ॒वेद॑रु॒षास॒: सब॑न्धव॒: शूरा॑ इव प्र॒युध॒: प्रोत यु॑युधुः । मर्या॑ इव सु॒वृधो॑ वावृधु॒र्नर॒: सूर्य॑स्य॒ चक्षु॒: प्र मि॑नन्ति वृ॒ष्टिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áśvāḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ sá-bandhavaḥ ǀ śū́rāḥ-iva ǀ pra-yúdhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ utá ǀ yuyudhuḥ ǀmáryāḥ-iva ǀ su-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ prá ǀ minanti ǀ vṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resplendent as steeds, of one kindred, they engage in combat like valiant heroes; like (prosperous) men, they, the leaders (of rites), have increased (in power), and cover the eye of the sun with showers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते अ॑ज्ये॒ष्ठा अक॑निष्ठास उ॒द्भिदोऽम॑ध्यमासो॒ मह॑सा॒ वि वा॑वृधुः । सु॒जा॒तासो॑ ज॒नुषा॒ पृश्नि॑मातरो दि॒वो मर्या॒ आ नो॒ अच्छा॑ जिगातन
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ajyeṣṭhā́ḥ ǀ ákaniṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ut-bhídaḥ ǀ ámadhyamāsaḥ ǀ máhasā ǀ ví ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀsu-jātā́saḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ máryāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ jigātana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “None of them are older, none younger (than the others); the destroyers of (foes), none hold a middle (rank), but all excel in glory; honourable by birth havingPṛṣṇifor your mother, do you,Maruts, favourable to man, come from heaven to our presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वयो॒ न ये श्रेणी॑: प॒प्तुरोज॒सान्ता॑न्दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तः सानु॑न॒स्परि॑ । अश्वा॑स एषामु॒भये॒ यथा॑ वि॒दुः प्र पर्व॑तस्य नभ॒नूँर॑चुच्यवुः
shlokas.transliteration: váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ śréṇīḥ ǀ paptúḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ ántān ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sā́nunaḥ ǀ pári ǀáśvāsaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ ubháye ǀ yáthā ǀ vidúḥ ǀ prá ǀ párvatasya ǀ nabhanū́n ǀ acucyavuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like birds (that fly) in rows they pass along in their strength above the vast summit (of the sky) to the ends of the firmament; their horses have caused the waters of the cloud to descend, as both (gods and mortals) know.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मिमा॑तु॒ द्यौरदि॑तिर्वी॒तये॑ न॒: सं दानु॑चित्रा उ॒षसो॑ यतन्ताम् । आचु॑च्यवुर्दि॒व्यं कोश॑मे॒त ऋषे॑ रु॒द्रस्य॑ म॒रुतो॑ गृणा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: mímātu ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ vītáye ǀ naḥ ǀ sám ǀ dā́nu-citrāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ yatantām ǀā́ ǀ acucyavuḥ ǀ divyám ǀ kóśam ǀ eté ǀ ṛ́ṣe ǀ rudrásya ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the heaven and the earth yield (rain) for our sustenance; may the wonderfully bounteous dawns exert themselves (for our good); may these sons ofRudra, lauded, Ṛṣi, (by you), send down the celestial rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळे॑ अ॒ग्निं स्वव॑सं॒ नमो॑भिरि॒ह प्र॑स॒त्तो वि च॑यत्कृ॒तं न॑: । रथै॑रिव॒ प्र भ॑रे वाज॒यद्भि॑: प्रदक्षि॒णिन्म॒रुतां॒ स्तोम॑मृध्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷe ǀ agním ǀ su-ávasam ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ pra-sattáḥ ǀ ví ǀ cayat ǀ kṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀráthaiḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ bhare ǀ vājayát-bhiḥ ǀ pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ marútām ǀ stómam ǀ ṛdhyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I adore the protectingAgniwith hymns; may he, propitiated on this occasion, approve of our acts; offer (worship with praises), intended to obtain food; as if (proceeding) with cars (to the goal), circumambulating (the fire); may I exalt the praise of themaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ये त॒स्थुः पृष॑तीषु श्रु॒तासु॑ सु॒खेषु॑ रु॒द्रा म॒रुतो॒ रथे॑षु । वना॑ चिदुग्रा जिहते॒ नि वो॑ भि॒या पृ॑थि॒वी चि॑द्रेजते॒ पर्व॑तश्चित्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yé ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ pṛ́ṣatīṣu ǀ śrutā́su ǀ su-khéṣu ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀvánā ǀ cit ǀ ugrāḥ ǀ jihate ǀ ní ǀ vaḥ ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ cit ǀ rejate ǀ párvataḥ ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceMaruts, sons ofRudra, who ride in easy chariots (drawn by) celebrated steeds, (at your coming) the woods bow down with fear, the earth tremles, and the mountains (shake).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पर्व॑तश्चि॒न्महि॑ वृ॒द्धो बि॑भाय दि॒वश्चि॒त्सानु॑ रेजत स्व॒ने व॑: । यत्क्रीळ॑थ मरुत ऋष्टि॒मन्त॒ आप॑ इव स॒ध्र्य॑ञ्चो धवध्वे
shlokas.transliteration: párvataḥ ǀ cit ǀ máhi ǀ vṛddháḥ ǀ bibhāya ǀ diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ sā́nu ǀ rejata ǀ svané ǀ vaḥ ǀyát ǀ krī́ḷatha ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ṛṣṭi-mántaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ-iva ǀ sadhryáñcaḥ ǀ dhavadhve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mountain, vast and lofty (though it be), is alarmed at your noise, and the summit of the firmament trembles when, lance-armedMaruts, you are sporting; you rush along together like waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒रा इ॒वेद्रै॑व॒तासो॒ हिर॑ण्यैर॒भि स्व॒धाभि॑स्त॒न्व॑: पिपिश्रे । श्रि॒ये श्रेयां॑सस्त॒वसो॒ रथे॑षु स॒त्रा महां॑सि चक्रिरे त॒नूषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: varā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ raivatā́saḥ ǀ híraṇyaiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ pipiśre ǀśriyé ǀ śréyāṃsaḥ ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ rátheṣu ǀ satrā́ ǀ máhāṃsi ǀ cakrire ǀ tanū́ṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like wealthy bridegrooms who have decorated their person ns with golden (ornaments) and purifying waters, so the noble and powerfulMaruts, associated together in their chariots, have made great (preparation) in their several person ns for their embellishment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ज्ये॒ष्ठासो॒ अक॑निष्ठास ए॒ते सं भ्रात॑रो वावृधु॒: सौभ॑गाय । युवा॑ पि॒ता स्वपा॑ रु॒द्र ए॑षां सु॒दुघा॒ पृश्नि॑: सु॒दिना॑ म॒रुद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ajyeṣṭhā́saḥ ǀ ákaniṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ eté ǀ sám ǀ bhrā́taraḥ ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ sáubhagāya ǀyúvā ǀ pitā́ ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ su-dúghā ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ su-dínā ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are brothers, of whom no one is the elder, no one the younger, but who grew up together for their mutual prosperity; may their father,Rudra, ever youthful, the doer of good deeds, andPṛṣṇi, (their mother), easy to be milked, grant favourable days for (the sake of) theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदु॑त्त॒मे म॑रुतो मध्य॒मे वा॒ यद्वा॑व॒मे सु॑भगासो दि॒वि ष्ठ । अतो॑ नो रुद्रा उ॒त वा॒ न्व१॒॑स्याग्ने॑ वि॒त्ताद्ध॒विषो॒ यद्यजा॑म
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ut-tamé ǀ marutaḥ ǀ madhyamé ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ avamé ǀ su-bhagāsaḥ ǀ diví ǀ sthá ǀátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rudrāḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ágne ǀ vittā́t ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ yát ǀ yájāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AuspiciousMaruts, whether you abide in the upper, the middle, or \the lower heaven, (come),Rudras, to us from thence; and do you,Agni, accept the oblation which this day we offer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निश्च॒ यन्म॑रुतो विश्ववेदसो दि॒वो वह॑ध्व॒ उत्त॑रा॒दधि॒ ष्णुभि॑: । ते म॑न्दसा॒ना धुन॑यो रिशादसो वा॒मं ध॑त्त॒ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ váhadhve ǀ út-tarāt ǀ ádhi ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀté ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ dhatta ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are omniscient, since you andAgniabide above the summits of the upper (region) of the sky, do you who cause (your enemies) to tremble, and are the consumers of (our) foes, do you, being plural ased, bestow upon the sacrificer who offers you oblations desirable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ म॒रुद्भि॑: शु॒भय॑द्भि॒ॠक्व॑भि॒: सोमं॑ पिब मन्दसा॒नो ग॑ण॒श्रिभि॑: । पा॒व॒केभि॑र्विश्वमि॒न्वेभि॑रा॒युभि॒र्वैश्वा॑नर प्र॒दिवा॑ के॒तुना॑ स॒जूः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ śubháyat-bhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ sómam ǀ piba ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ gaṇaśrí-bhiḥ ǀpāvakébhiḥ ǀ viśvam-invébhiḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ pra-dívā ǀ ketúnā ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, drink theSoma-juice, rejoicing, along with theMaruts, resplendent, adorable, associated in troops, purifying all, animating and long-lived; drink,Vaiśvānara, who are identified with the ancient emblem (of flame).”

shlokas.sanskrit: के ष्ठा॑ नर॒: श्रेष्ठ॑तमा॒ य एक॑एक आय॒य । प॒र॒मस्या॑: परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ stha ǀ naraḥ ǀ śréṣṭha-tamāḥ ǀ yé ǀ ékaḥ-ekaḥ ǀ ā-yayá ǀparamásyāḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are you, most excellent leadeers (of rites), who come one by one from a region exceedingly remote?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ वोऽश्वा॒: क्वा॒३॒॑भीश॑वः क॒थं शे॑क क॒था य॑य । पृ॒ष्ठे सदो॑ न॒सोर्यम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ vaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ kvá ǀ abhī́śavaḥ ǀ kathám ǀ śeka ǀ kathā́ ǀ yaya ǀpṛṣṭhé ǀ sádaḥ ǀ nasóḥ ǀ yámaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where are your horses? where your reins? what is your capability? where are you going? The saddle is on the back (of the steeds), the bridle in their nostrils.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒घने॒ चोद॑ एषां॒ वि स॒क्थानि॒ नरो॑ यमुः । पु॒त्र॒कृ॒थे न जन॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: jagháne ǀ códaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ ví ǀ sakthā́ni ǀ náraḥ ǀ yamuḥ ǀputra-kṛthé ǀ ná ǀ jánayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The goad is (applied) to their flanks; the drivers force them to spread their thighs apart, like women in bringing forth children.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ वीरास एतन॒ मर्या॑सो॒ भद्र॑जानयः । अ॒ग्नि॒तपो॒ यथास॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ vīrāsaḥ ǀ itana ǀ máryāsaḥ ǀ bhádra-jānayaḥ ǀagni-tápaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ásatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heroes, friendly to man, of honourable birth, you are as if blazing with fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सन॒त्साश्व्यं॑ प॒शुमु॒त गव्यं॑ श॒ताव॑यम् । श्या॒वाश्व॑स्तुताय॒ या दोर्वी॒रायो॑प॒बर्बृ॑हत्
shlokas.transliteration: sánat ǀ sā́ ǀ áśvyam ǀ paśúm ǀ utá ǀ gávyam ǀ śatá-avayam ǀśyāvā́śva-stutāya ǀ yā́ ǀ dóḥ ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ upa-bárbṛhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She, (Śaśiyasī), who has thrown her arms round the hero Taranta, who was eulogized byŚyāvāśva, has given me cattle comprising horses, and cows, and hundreds of sheep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वा॒ स्त्री शशी॑यसी पुं॒सो भ॑वति॒ वस्य॑सी । अदे॑वत्रादरा॒धस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ strī́ ǀ śáśīyasī ǀ puṃsáḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ vásyasī ǀádeva-trāt ǀ arādhásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śaśīyasi, though a feminine le, is more excellent than a man who reverences not the gods, nor bestows wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि या जा॒नाति॒ जसु॑रिं॒ वि तृष्य॑न्तं॒ वि का॒मिन॑म् । दे॒व॒त्रा कृ॑णु॒ते मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yā́ ǀ jānā́ti ǀ jásurim ǀ ví ǀ tṛ́ṣyantam ǀ ví ǀ kāmínam ǀdeva-trā́ ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For she discerns one who suffers pain, one who is in want, or one desirous (of any thing), and directs her mind towards the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त घा॒ नेमो॒ अस्तु॑त॒: पुमाँ॒ इति॑ ब्रुवे प॒णिः । स वैर॑देय॒ इत्स॒मः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ gha ǀ némaḥ ǀ ástutaḥ ǀ púmān ǀ íti ǀ bruve ǀ paṇíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ váira-deye ǀ ít ǀ samáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And, eulogizing (him), I proclaim that the man, her (other) half is, (as it were), uncommended, for he is ever the same in munificent donations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त मे॑ऽरपद्युव॒तिर्म॑म॒न्दुषी॒ प्रति॑ श्या॒वाय॑ वर्त॒निम् । वि रोहि॑ता पुरुमी॒ळ्हाय॑ येमतु॒र्विप्रा॑य दी॒र्घय॑शसे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ me ǀ arapat ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ mamandúṣī ǀ práti ǀ śyāvā́ya ǀ vartaním ǀví ǀ róhitā ǀ puru-mīḷhā́ya ǀ yematuḥ ǀ víprāya ǀ dīrghá-yaśase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Young and affable, she has explained to me,Śyāvāśva, the road, and two ruddy horses have borne me to the valiant and renowned Purumīḷha.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मे॑ धेनू॒नां श॒तं वैद॑दश्वि॒र्यथा॒ दद॑त् । त॒र॒न्त इ॑व मं॒हना॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ dhenūnā́m ǀ śatám ǀ váidat-aśviḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ dádat ǀtarantáḥ-iva ǀ maṃhánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, the son of Vidadaśva, has given me a hundred (head) of cattle, and, like Taranta, many precious gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ईं॒ वह॑न्त आ॒शुभि॒: पिब॑न्तो मदि॒रं मधु॑ । अत्र॒ श्रवां॑सि दधिरे
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ īm ǀ váhante ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ píbantaḥ ǀ madirám ǀ mádhu ǀátra ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dadhire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (Maruts) who are brought hither by swift horses, drinking the inembriating juice, receive here gratification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येषां॑ श्रि॒याधि॒ रोद॑सी वि॒भ्राज॑न्ते॒ रथे॒ष्वा । दि॒वि रु॒क्म इ॑वो॒परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ śriyā́ ǀ ádhi ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vi-bhrā́jante ǀ rátheṣu ǀ ā́ ǀdiví ǀ rukmáḥ-iva ǀ upári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They by whose glory heaven and earth are surpassed; who shine splendid in their chariots like the radiant (sun) in the heaven above.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युवा॒ स मारु॑तो ग॒णस्त्वे॒षर॑थो॒ अने॑द्यः । शु॒भं॒यावाप्र॑तिष्कुतः
shlokas.transliteration: yúvā ǀ sáḥ ǀ mā́rutaḥ ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ tveṣá-rathaḥ ǀ ánedyaḥ ǀśubham-yā́vā ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That company ofMaruts, ever young, riding in bright chariots, irreproachable, auspicious, motive, unobstructed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वे॑द नू॒नमे॑षां॒ यत्रा॒ मद॑न्ति॒ धूत॑यः । ऋ॒तजा॑ता अरे॒पस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ veda ǀ nūnám ǀ eṣām ǀ yátra ǀ mádanti ǀ dhū́tayaḥ ǀṛtá-jātāḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who knows of a certainty their (abode), where the intimidators (of their foes) rejoice? born for (the distribution of) water, exempt from defects.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं मर्तं॑ विपन्यवः प्रणे॒तार॑ इ॒त्था धि॒या । श्रोता॑रो॒ याम॑हूतिषु
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ mártam ǀ vipanyavaḥ ǀ pra-netā́raḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀśrótāraḥ ǀ yā́ma-hūtiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of praise, you are the guides (to happiness) of the man who propitiates (you) by this pious rite; you are bearers of invocations to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॒ वसू॑नि॒ काम्या॑ पुरुश्च॒न्द्रा रि॑शादसः । आ य॑ज्ञियासो ववृत्तन
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ kā́myā ǀ puru-candrā́ḥ ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǀ vavṛttana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are destroyers of themaleviolent, abounding in wealth, and entitled to adoration, bestow upon us desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं मे॒ स्तोम॑मूर्म्ये दा॒र्भ्याय॒ परा॑ वह । गिरो॑ देवि र॒थीरि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ me ǀ stómam ǀ ūrmye ǀ dārbhyā́ya ǀ párā ǀ vaha ǀgíraḥ ǀ devi ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bear to Dārbhya, oḥ night, turning away (from me to him), this my eulogy (of theMaruts); convey my praises, goddess, as a charioteer (conveys the contents of his vehicle to their destination).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त मे॑ वोचता॒दिति॑ सु॒तसो॑मे॒ रथ॑वीतौ । न कामो॒ अप॑ वेति मे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ me ǀ vocatāt ǀ íti ǀ sutá-some ǀ rátha-vītau ǀná ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ ápa ǀ veti ǀ me ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And say on my behalf toRathavīti, when the libation is poured out, my love (for your daughter) does not depart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष क्षे॑ति॒ रथ॑वीतिर्म॒घवा॒ गोम॑ती॒रनु॑ । पर्व॑ते॒ष्वप॑श्रितः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ kṣeti ǀ rátha-vītiḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ ánu ǀpárvateṣu ǀ ápa-śritaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This opulentRathavītidwells upon the (banks of the)Gomatī(river), and has his home on (the skirts of) the (Himālaya) mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तेन॑ ऋ॒तमपि॑हितं ध्रु॒वं वां॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ यत्र॑ विमु॒चन्त्यश्वा॑न् । दश॑ श॒ता स॒ह त॑स्थु॒स्तदेकं॑ दे॒वानां॒ श्रेष्ठं॒ वपु॑षामपश्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛténa ǀ ṛtám ǀ ápi-hitam ǀ dhruvám ǀ vām ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yátra ǀ vi-mucánti ǀ áśvān ǀdáśa ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahá ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ tát ǀ ékam ǀ devā́nām ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ vápuṣām ǀ apaśyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have beheld the permanent orb of the sun, your (dwelling plural ce), concealed by water, where (the hymns of the pious) liberate (his) steeds; where a thousand rays abide together; the one most excellent of the (embodied) forms of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्सु वां॑ मित्रावरुणा महि॒त्वमी॒र्मा त॒स्थुषी॒रह॑भिर्दुदुह्रे । विश्वा॑: पिन्वथ॒: स्वस॑रस्य॒ धेना॒ अनु॑ वा॒मेक॑: प॒विरा व॑वर्त
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ īrmā́ ǀ tasthúṣīḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ duduhre ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ pinvathaḥ ǀ svásarasya ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ pavíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavarta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exceeding is that your greatness,MitraandVaruṇa, whereby the ever-moving sun has, through (succeeding) days, milked forth the stationary waters; you augment all the (world-illuming) rays of the self-revolving (sun); the one chariot of you two (perpetually) goes round.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑रयतं पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां मित्र॑राजाना वरुणा॒ महो॑भिः । व॒र्धय॑त॒मोष॑धी॒: पिन्व॑तं॒ गा अव॑ वृ॒ष्टिं सृ॑जतं जीरदानू
shlokas.transliteration: ádhārayatam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ mítra-rājānā ǀ varuṇā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀvardháyatam ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ pínvatam ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ áva ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ sṛjatam ǀ jīradānū íti jīra-dānū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalMitraandVaruṇa, you uphold, by your energies, earth and heaven; prompt benefactors, cause the plural nts to grow, give nourishment to the cattle, send down the rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॒मश्वा॑सः सु॒युजो॑ वहन्तु य॒तर॑श्मय॒ उप॑ यन्त्व॒र्वाक् । घृ॒तस्य॑ नि॒र्णिगनु॑ वर्तते वा॒मुप॒ सिन्ध॑वः प्र॒दिवि॑ क्षरन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ yatá-raśmayaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yantu ǀ arvā́k ǀghṛtásya ǀ niḥ-ník ǀ ánu ǀ vartate ǀ vām ǀ úpa ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ kṣaranti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your easily-harnessed horses bear you both (hither), and with well-guided reins come down; the embodied form of water follows you, the rivers flow as of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ श्रु॒ताम॒मतिं॒ वर्ध॑दु॒र्वीं ब॒र्हिरि॑व॒ यजु॑षा॒ रक्ष॑माणा । नम॑स्वन्ता धृतद॒क्षाधि॒ गर्ते॒ मित्रासा॑थे वरु॒णेळा॑स्व॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ śrutā́m ǀ amátim ǀ várdhat ǀ urvī́m ǀ barhíḥ-iva ǀ yájuṣā ǀ rákṣamāṇā ǀnámasvantā ǀ dhṛta-dakṣā ǀ ádhi ǀ gárte ǀ mítra ǀ ā́sāthe íti ǀ varuṇa ǀ íḷāsu ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Augmenting the well-known and ample form (of man), in like manner as the sacred grass is preserved by prayer, do you,MitraandVaruṇa, who are invigorated by (sacrificial) viands, and abound in food, ascend your car in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्र॑विहस्ता सु॒कृते॑ पर॒स्पा यं त्रासा॑थे वरु॒णेळा॑स्व॒न्तः । राजा॑ना क्ष॒त्रमहृ॑णीयमाना स॒हस्र॑स्थूणं बिभृथः स॒ह द्वौ
shlokas.transliteration: ákravi-hastā ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ paraḥ-pā́ ǀ yám ǀ trā́sāthe íti ǀ varuṇā ǀ íḷāsu ǀ antáríti ǀrā́jānā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ áhṛṇīyamānā ǀ sahásra-sthūṇam ǀ bibhṛthaḥ ǀ sahá ǀ dváu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be open-handed and benignant to the performer of pious acts, whom you protect in the midst of the plural ce of sacrifice; for you two, who are soverigns, and free from wrath, uphold together a mansion of a thousand columns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यनिर्णि॒गयो॑ अस्य॒ स्थूणा॒ वि भ्रा॑जते दि॒व्य१॒॑श्वाज॑नीव । भ॒द्रे क्षेत्रे॒ निमि॑ता॒ तिल्वि॑ले वा स॒नेम॒ मध्वो॒ अधि॑गर्त्यस्य
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-nirnik ǀ áyaḥ ǀ asya ǀ sthū́ṇā ǀ ví ǀ bhrājate ǀ diví ǀ aśvā́janī-iva ǀbhadré ǀ kṣétre ǀ ní-mitā ǀ tílvile ǀ vā ǀ sanéma ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ádhi-gartyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The substance (of their chariot) is of gold; its pillars are of metal, and it shines in the firmament like lightning; may we load the vehicle with the libation in an auspicious plural ce, or in the sacrificial hall, (where the columns) are erected.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यरूपमु॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टा॒वय॑:स्थूण॒मुदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य । आ रो॑हथो वरुण मित्र॒ गर्त॒मत॑श्चक्षाथे॒ अदि॑तिं॒ दितिं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-rūpam ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ áyaḥ-sthūṇam ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀā́ ǀ rohathaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ gártam ǀ átaḥ ǀ cakṣāthe íti ǀ áditim ǀ dítim ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the break of dawn, at the rising of the sun, ascendMitraandVaruṇa, your golden-bodied, metal-pillared car, and thence, behold the earth and its inhabitants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्बंहि॑ष्ठं॒ नाति॒विधे॑ सुदानू॒ अच्छि॑द्रं॒ शर्म॑ भुवनस्य गोपा । तेन॑ नो मित्रावरुणावविष्टं॒ सिषा॑सन्तो जिगी॒वांस॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ báṃhiṣṭham ǀ ná ǀ ati-vídhe ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀ ácchidram ǀ śárma ǀ bhuvanasya ǀ gopā ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ sísāsantaḥ ǀ jigīvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MunificentMitraandVaruṇa, protectors of the universe, (it is yours to grant) exceeding and perfect felicity, such as it is impossible to disturb; bless us with that (felicity), and may we ever be (possessed) of the riches we desire, and be confident of vicotry (over our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋत॑स्य गोपा॒वधि॑ तिष्ठथो॒ रथं॒ सत्य॑धर्माणा पर॒मे व्यो॑मनि । यमत्र॑ मित्रावरु॒णाव॑थो यु॒वं तस्मै॑ वृ॒ष्टिर्मधु॑मत्पिन्वते दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́tasya ǀ gopau ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ sátya-dharmāṇā ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀyám ǀ átra ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ tásmai ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pinvate ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Guardians of water, observers of truth, you ascend your car in the highest heaven; to him whom you,MitraandVaruṇa, protect, the rain sends down the sweet (shower) from the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्राजा॑व॒स्य भुव॑नस्य राजथो॒ मित्रा॑वरुणा वि॒दथे॑ स्व॒र्दृशा॑ । वृ॒ष्टिं वां॒ राधो॑ अमृत॒त्वमी॑महे॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि च॑रन्ति त॒न्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sam-rā́jau ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rājathaḥ ǀ mítrāvaruṇā ǀ vidáthe ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śā ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ vām ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ īmahe ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ tanyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Imperial rulers of this world, you shine,MitraandVaruṇa, at this sacrifice, the beholders of heaven; we ask of you the wealth (that is) rain, and immortality for your forms traverse earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्राजा॑ उ॒ग्रा वृ॑ष॒भा दि॒वस्पती॑ पृथि॒व्या मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ विच॑र्षणी । चि॒त्रेभि॑र॒भ्रैरुप॑ तिष्ठथो॒ रवं॒ द्यां व॑र्षयथो॒ असु॑रस्य मा॒यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: sam-rā́jau ǀ ugrā́ ǀ vṛṣabhā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vícarṣaṇī íti ví-carṣaṇī ǀcitrébhiḥ ǀ abhráiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tiṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rávam ǀ dyā́m ǀ varṣayathaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ māyáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Imperial and mighty showerers, lords of heaven and earth, beholders of the universe, you approach,MitraandVaruṇa, with variegated clouds to hear the sound (of your praises), and cause the sky to (send down) rain by the power of the emitter of showers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒या वां॑ मित्रावरुणा दि॒वि श्रि॒ता सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॑श्चरति चि॒त्रमायु॑धम् । तम॒भ्रेण॑ वृ॒ष्ट्या गू॑हथो दि॒वि पर्ज॑न्य द्र॒प्सा मधु॑मन्त ईरते
shlokas.transliteration: māyā́ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ diví ǀ śritā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ carati ǀ citrám ǀ ā́yudham ǀtám ǀ abhréṇa ǀ vṛṣṭyā́ ǀ gūhathaḥ ǀ diví ǀ párjanya ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your deevice,MitraandVaruṇa, is manifested in heaven, when the light (that is) the sun, your wonderful weapon, moves (in the firmament); him you invest in the sky with the cloud (and) with rain; and (your) sweet drops,Parjanya, fall (at their desire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॑ युञ्जते म॒रुत॑: शु॒भे सु॒खं शूरो॒ न मि॑त्रावरुणा॒ गवि॑ष्टिषु । रजां॑सि चि॒त्रा वि च॑रन्ति त॒न्यवो॑ दि॒वः स॑म्राजा॒ पय॑सा न उक्षतम्
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ yuñjate ǀ marútaḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ su-khám ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǀrájāṃsi ǀ citrā́ ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ tanyávaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sam-rājā ǀ páyasā ǀ naḥ ǀ ukṣatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsharness their easy-going chariot,MitraandVaruṇa, for (the emission of) water, as a hero (harnesses his war-car); their forms traverse the different spheres to distribute the rain; do you, therefore, supreme rulers, shed upon us water from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाचं॒ सु मि॑त्रावरुणा॒विरा॑वतीं प॒र्जन्य॑श्चि॒त्रां व॑दति॒ त्विषी॑मतीम् । अ॒भ्रा व॑सत म॒रुत॒: सु मा॒यया॒ द्यां व॑र्षयतमरु॒णाम॑रे॒पस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vā́cam ǀ sú ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ írā-vatīm ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ citrā́m ǀ vadati ǀ tvíṣi-matīm ǀabhrā́ ǀ vasata ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sú ǀ māyáyā ǀ dyā́m ǀ varṣayatam ǀ aruṇā́m ǀ arepásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cloud, (through your will),MitraandVaruṇa, utters a wonderful sound, indicative of radiance, and announcing (abundant) food; theMarutsthoroughly invest the clouds with (their) devices, and, (along with them), you two cause the purple and faultless sky to send down rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धर्म॑णा मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता व्र॒ता र॑क्षेथे॒ असु॑रस्य मा॒यया॑ । ऋ॒तेन॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं॒ वि रा॑जथ॒: सूर्य॒मा ध॑त्थो दि॒वि चित्र्यं॒ रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dhármaṇā ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ vipaḥ-citā ǀ vratā́ ǀ rakṣethe íti ǀ ásurasya ǀ māyáyā ǀṛténa ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ ví ǀ rājathaḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ dhatthaḥ ǀ diví ǀ cítryam ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Discerning, sagacious,MitraandVaruṇa, by your office you protect pious rites, through the power of the emitter of showers; you illumine the whole world with water; you sustain the sun, the adorable chariot in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वरु॑णं वो रि॒शाद॑समृ॒चा मि॒त्रं ह॑वामहे । परि॑ व्र॒जेव॑ बा॒ह्वोर्ज॑ग॒न्वांसा॒ स्व॑र्णरम्
shlokas.transliteration: váruṇam ǀ vaḥ ǀ riśā́dasam ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ mitrám ǀ havāmahe ǀpári ǀ vrajā́-iva ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ jaganvā́ṃsā ǀ sváḥ-naram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,MitraandVaruṇa, with this hymn; each the discomfiter of foes, the conductor to heaven, like (two herdsmen) driving, by (the strength of their) arms, the herds of cattle before them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता बा॒हवा॑ सुचे॒तुना॒ प्र य॑न्तमस्मा॒ अर्च॑ते । शेवं॒ हि जा॒र्यं॑ वां॒ विश्वा॑सु॒ क्षासु॒ जोगु॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ bāhávā ǀ su-cetúnā ǀ prá ǀ yantam ǀ asmai ǀ árcate ǀśévam ǀ hí ǀ jāryám ǀ vām ǀ víśvāsu ǀ kṣā́su ǀ jóguve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you two, with discriminatinghand, bestow upon me, your worshipper, (what I desire); for the desirable felicity (that is given by you) spreads through all lands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्नू॒नम॒श्यां गतिं॑ मि॒त्रस्य॑ यायां प॒था । अस्य॑ प्रि॒यस्य॒ शर्म॒ण्यहिं॑सानस्य सश्चिरे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nūnám ǀ aśyā́m ǀ gátim ǀ mitrásya ǀ yāyām ǀ pathā́ ǀásya ǀ priyásya ǀ śármaṇi ǀ áhiṃsānasya ǀ saścire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That I may now pursue the (right) direction, may I proceed by the path ofMitra, for all (good things) are aggregated in the happiness, (the gift) of that beloved and benignant (deity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वाभ्यां॑ मित्रावरुणोप॒मं धे॑यामृ॒चा । यद्ध॒ क्षये॑ म॒घोनां॑ स्तोतॄ॒णां च॑ स्पू॒र्धसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́bhyām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ upa-mám ǀ dheyām ǀ ṛcā́ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ kṣáye ǀ maghónām ǀ stotṝṇā́m ǀ ca ǀ spūrdháse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I obtain from you,MitraandVaruṇa, by my praise, such  wealth as to excite envy in the dwellings of the rich and the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ मित्र सुदी॒तिभि॒र्वरु॑णश्च स॒धस्थ॒ आ । स्वे क्षये॑ म॒घोनां॒ सखी॑नां च वृ॒धसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀsvé ǀ kṣáye ǀ maghónām ǀ sákhīnām ǀ ca ǀ vṛdháse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Mitra(come),Varuṇa, with your splendour to our assembly, and augment (the prosperity) of the affluent (worshipper), and of (those who are) your friends in their respective abodes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं नो॒ येषु॑ वरुण क्ष॒त्रं बृ॒हच्च॑ बिभृ॒थः । उ॒रु णो॒ वाज॑सातये कृ॒तं रा॒ये स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ naḥ ǀ yéṣu ǀ varuṇā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ bṛhát ǀ ca ǀ bibhṛtháḥ ǀurú ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ kṛtám ǀ rāyé ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,MitraandVaruṇa, bring us strength and abundant (food) for (those praises) which (we offer); be largely bountiful to us in food, in riches, in prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छन्त्यां॑ मे यज॒ता दे॒वक्ष॑त्रे॒ रुश॑द्गवि । सु॒तं सोमं॒ न ह॒स्तिभि॒रा प॒ड्भिर्धा॑वतं नरा॒ बिभ्र॑तावर्च॒नान॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: ucchántyām ǀ me ǀ yajatā́ ǀ devá-kṣatre ǀ rúśat-gavi ǀsutám ǀ sómam ǀ ná ǀ hastí-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ paṭ-bhíḥ ǀ dhāvatam ǀ narā ǀ bíbhratau ǀ arcanā́nasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deities who are to be worshipped at the sacrifice to the gods, at the (first) shining ray (of light) at dawn; behold mySomalibation poured out; hasten, with rapid steeds, leaders (of rites), propitious toArcanānas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यश्चि॒केत॒ स सु॒क्रतु॑र्देव॒त्रा स ब्र॑वीतु नः । वरु॑णो॒ यस्य॑ दर्श॒तो मि॒त्रो वा॒ वन॑ते॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ cikéta ǀ sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bravītu ǀ naḥ ǀváruṇaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ vā ǀ vánate ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who knows (how to honour you two) among the gods, is ghe performer of good works; let him, communicate (that knowledge) to us, he of whom the gracefulVaruṇaorMitraaccepts the laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि श्रेष्ठ॑वर्चसा॒ राजा॑ना दीर्घ॒श्रुत्त॑मा । ता सत्प॑ती ऋता॒वृध॑ ऋ॒तावा॑ना॒ जने॑जने
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ śréṣṭha-varcasā ǀ rā́jānā ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamā ǀtā́ ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhā ǀ ṛtá-vānā ǀ jáne-jane ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They two, verily excelling in radiance, royal (deities), who hear (invocations) from the greatest distance; lords of the virtuous, favourers of the sacrifice, are in movement (for the good of) each individual man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वा॑मिया॒नोऽव॑से॒ पूर्वा॒ उप॑ ब्रुवे॒ सचा॑ । स्वश्वा॑स॒: सु चे॒तुना॒ वाजाँ॑ अ॒भि प्र दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ ávase ǀ pū́rvau ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ sácā ǀsu-áśvāsaḥ ǀ sú ǀ cetúnā ǀ vā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approaching you, ancient (divinities), I invoke you together for protection; possessed of good steeds, (we praise you) who are provident to give us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रो अं॒होश्चि॒दादु॒रु क्षया॑य गा॒तुं व॑नते । मि॒त्रस्य॒ हि प्र॒तूर्व॑तः सुम॒तिरस्ति॑ विध॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́t ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ gātúm ǀ vanate ǀmitrásya ǀ hí ǀ pra-tū́rvataḥ ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ásti ǀ vidhatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mitragrants even to the sinful (worshipper) the (means of) repairing to his spacious dwelling; the favour of Mitra, the destroyer fo foes, is (granted) to (his) adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं मि॒त्रस्याव॑सि॒ स्याम॑ स॒प्रथ॑स्तमे । अ॒ने॒हस॒स्त्वोत॑यः स॒त्रा वरु॑णशेषसः
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ mitrásya ǀ ávasi ǀ syā́ma ǀ sapráthaḥ-tame ǀanehásaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtayaḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ váruṇa-śeṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we ever be in the comprehensive guardianship ofMitra, and, free from sin, enjoy, (Mitra), your protection, being at the same time the children ofVaruṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं मि॑त्रे॒मं जनं॒ यत॑थ॒: सं च॑ नयथः । मा म॒घोन॒: परि॑ ख्यतं॒ मो अ॒स्माक॒मृषी॑णां गोपी॒थे न॑ उरुष्यतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ mitrā ǀ imám ǀ jánam ǀ yátathaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ nayathaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ pári ǀ khyatam ǀ mó íti ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ go-pīthé ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You come,MitraandVaruṇa, to this man, and guide him (to his desires); deny us not when we are rich (in offerings); (deny us not), who are (the sons) of ṛṣis protect us in the presenting of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ चि॑कितान सु॒क्रतू॑ दे॒वौ म॑र्त रि॒शाद॑सा । वरु॑णाय ऋ॒तपे॑शसे दधी॒त प्रय॑से म॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ cikitāna ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀ deváu ǀ marta ǀ riśā́dasā ǀváruṇāya ǀ ṛtá-peśase ǀ dadhītá ǀ práyase ǀ mahé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Man, endowed with intelligence, (adore) the two deities, the performers of good deeds, the destroyers of foes; offer (oblations) to the adorable accepter of (sacrificial) food, toVaruṇa, whose form is water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि क्ष॒त्रमवि॑ह्रुतं स॒म्यग॑सु॒र्य१॒॑माशा॑ते । अध॑ व्र॒तेव॒ मानु॑षं॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण धा॑यि दर्श॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ávi-hrutam ǀ samyák ǀ asuryám ǀ ā́śāte íti ǀádha ǀ vratā́-iva ǀ mā́nuṣam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhāyi ǀ darśatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as you two are possessed of irresistible andasura-subduing strength, therefore has holy sacrifice been established among men, as the sun (has been plural ced) in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वा॒मेषे॒ रथा॑नामु॒र्वीं गव्यू॑तिमेषाम् । रा॒तह॑व्यस्य सुष्टु॒तिं द॒धृक्स्तोमै॑र्मनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ éṣe ǀ ráthānām ǀ urvī́m ǀ gávyūtim ǀ eṣām ǀrātá-havyasya ǀ su-stutím ǀ dadhṛ́k ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify you both, that your chariots may precede ours by a long distance; accepting the pious worship of Rātahavya with (his) praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ हि काव्या॑ यु॒वं दक्ष॑स्य पू॒र्भिर॑द्भुता । नि के॒तुना॒ जना॑नां चि॒केथे॑ पूतदक्षसा
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ kā́vyā ǀ yuvám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ adbhutā ǀní ǀ ketúnā ǀ jánānām ǀ cikéthe íti ǀ pūta-dakṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now, adorable and wonderful deities, (propitiated) by the former (praises) of (me, your) worshipper; do you, who are of pure vigour, consider with approving minds (the adoration) of these men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदृ॒तं पृ॑थिवि बृ॒हच्छ्र॑वए॒ष ऋषी॑णाम् । ज्र॒य॒सा॒नावरं॑ पृ॒थ्वति॑ क्षरन्ति॒ याम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ṛtám ǀ pṛthivi ǀ bṛhát ǀ śravaḥ-eṣé ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀjrayasānáu ǀ áram ǀ pṛthú ǀ áti ǀ kṣaranti ǀ yā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earth, in you is abundant water for the necessities of the Ṛṣis; the two active (deities) dispense by their movement sufficiently copious (rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्वा॑मीयचक्षसा॒ मित्र॑ व॒यं च॑ सू॒रय॑: । व्यचि॑ष्ठे बहु॒पाय्ये॒ यते॑महि स्व॒राज्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ īya-cakṣasā ǀ mítrā ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀvyáciṣṭhe ǀ bahu-pā́yye ǀ yátemahi ǀ sva-rā́jye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We and the devout (invoke) you,MitraandVaruṇa, who are far-seeing; may we proceed to your spacious and much frequented kingdom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बळि॒त्था दे॑व निष्कृ॒तमादि॑त्या यज॒तं बृ॒हत् । वरु॑ण॒ मित्रार्य॑म॒न्वर्षि॑ष्ठं क्ष॒त्रमा॑शाथे
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ itthā́ ǀ devā ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ā́dityā ǀ yajatám ǀ bṛhát ǀváruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ kṣatrám ǀ āśāthe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine sons ofAditi,Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, verily you are possessed, at the present time, of perfect, adorable, vast, exceeding strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं॑ हिर॒ण्ययं॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ सद॑थः । ध॒र्तारा॑ चर्षणी॒नां य॒न्तं सु॒म्नं रि॑शादसा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ yónim ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ sádathaḥ ǀdhartā́rā ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ yantám ǀ sumnám ǀ riśādasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you come,VaruṇaandMitra, to the delightful plural ce of sacrifice, then, supporters of men, destroyers of foes, you bring felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ हि वि॒श्ववे॑दसो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । व्र॒ता प॒देव॑ सश्चिरे॒ पान्ति॒ मर्त्यं॑ रि॒षः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀvratā́ ǀ padā́-iva ǀ saścire ǀ pā́nti ǀ mártyam ǀ riṣáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, who are possessed of omniscience, are all associated at our rites, as if in (their respective) station, and protect the worshipper from the malignant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि स॒त्या ऋ॑त॒स्पृश॑ ऋ॒तावा॑नो॒ जने॑जने । सु॒नी॒थास॑: सु॒दान॑वों॒ऽहोश्चि॑दुरु॒चक्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ jáne-jane ǀsu-nīthā́saḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ uru-cákrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They verily are observers of truth, distributors of water, protectors of holy rites among men; guides in the right way, liberal donors, and benefactors even of the sinner (who worships them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: को नु वां॑ मि॒त्रास्तु॑तो॒ वरु॑णो वा त॒नूना॑म् । तत्सु वा॒मेष॑ते म॒तिरत्रि॑भ्य॒ एष॑ते म॒तिः
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ vām ǀ mitra ǀ ástutaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ vā ǀ tanū́nām ǀtát ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǀ matíḥ ǀ átri-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǀ matíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which of you,MitraandVaruṇa, has not been celebrated in (our) praise, for therefore do our thoughts tend towards you; the thoughts of the lineage ofAtritend towards you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ मि॒त्राय॑ गायत॒ वरु॑णाय वि॒पा गि॒रा । महि॑क्षत्रावृ॒तं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ gāyata ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vipā́ ǀ girā́ ǀmáhi-kṣatrau ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing loud with lusty praise toMitraandVaruṇa; (come), mighty deities, to the great sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्राजा॒ या घृ॒तयो॑नी मि॒त्रश्चो॒भा वरु॑णश्च । दे॒वा दे॒वेषु॑ प्रश॒स्ता
shlokas.transliteration: sam-rā́jā ǀ yā́ ǀ ghṛtáyonī íti ghṛtá-yonī ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ ubhā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀdevā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ pra-śastā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, who are both sovereign rulers, originators of the rain, eminent deities among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता न॑: शक्तं॒ पार्थि॑वस्य म॒हो रा॒यो दि॒व्यस्य॑ । महि॑ वां क्ष॒त्रं दे॒वेषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaktam ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ divyásya ǀmáhi ǀ vām ǀ kṣatrám ǀ devéṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They two are able (to grant us) of great terrestrial and celestial riches; great is your might among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तमृ॒तेन॒ सप॑न्तेषि॒रं दक्ष॑माशाते । अ॒द्रुहा॑ दे॒वौ व॑र्धेते
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ ṛténa ǀ sápantā ǀ iṣirám ǀ dákṣam ǀ āśāte íti ǀadrúhā ǀ deváu ǀ vardhete íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rewarding with rain the holy rite, they favour the zealous worshipper; benevolent deities, may you prosper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ष्टिद्या॑वा री॒त्या॑पे॒षस्पती॒ दानु॑मत्याः । बृ॒हन्तं॒ गर्त॑माशाते
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣṭí-dyāvā ǀ rītí-āpā ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ dā́nu-matyāḥ ǀbṛhántam ǀ gártam ǀ āśāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Senders of rain from heaven, granters of desires, lords of sustenance, suited to the liberal donors (of oblations), they ascend their spacious car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्री रो॑च॒ना व॑रुण॒ त्रीँरु॒त द्यून्त्रीणि॑ मित्र धारयथो॒ रजां॑सि । वा॒वृ॒धा॒नाव॒मतिं॑ क्ष॒त्रिय॒स्यानु॑ व्र॒तं रक्ष॑माणावजु॒र्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ varuṇa ǀ trī́n ǀ utá ǀ dyū́n ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ mitra ǀ dhārayathaḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀvavṛdhānáu ǀ amátim ǀ kṣatríyasya ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ rákṣamāṇau ǀ ajuryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, you uphold the three realms of light, the three heavens, the three regions (of the earth), augmenting the force of the vigorous (indra) and protecting the imperishable rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इरा॑वतीर्वरुण धे॒नवो॑ वां॒ मधु॑मद्वां॒ सिन्ध॑वो मित्र दुह्रे । त्रय॑स्तस्थुर्वृष॒भास॑स्तिसृ॒णां धि॒षणा॑नां रेतो॒धा वि द्यु॒मन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: írā-vatīḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vām ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ mitra ǀ duhre ǀtráyaḥ ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ vṛṣabhā́saḥ ǀ tisṝṇā́m ǀ dhiṣáṇānām ǀ retaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, the cows are full o fmilk through your (command), and the rivers yield through your (will) sweet water; through you the three radiant receptacles and showerers of rain stand severally in their three spheres.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तर्दे॒वीमदि॑तिं जोहवीमि म॒ध्यंदि॑न॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य । रा॒ये मि॑त्रावरुणा स॒र्वता॒तेळे॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शं योः
shlokas.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ áditim ǀ johavīmi ǀ madhyándine ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀrāyé ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ ī́ḷe ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the divine and brightAditiat dawn, and at mid-day, when the sun is high; I worship you,MitraandVaruṇa, at all seasons, for the sake of riches, for sons and grandsons, for prosperity and happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ध॒र्तारा॒ रज॑सो रोच॒नस्यो॒तादि॒त्या दि॒व्या पार्थि॑वस्य । न वां॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृता॒ आ मि॑नन्ति व्र॒तानि॑ मित्रावरुणा ध्रु॒वाणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dhartā́rā ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ rocanásya ǀ utá ǀ ādityā́ ǀ divyā́ ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀná ǀ vām ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ minanti ǀ vratā́ni ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ dhruvā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship you two, divineĀdityas, who are upholders of the celestial and terrestrial worlds; the immortal gods impair not,MitraandVaruṇa, your eternal works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रू॒रुणा॑ चि॒द्ध्यस्त्यवो॑ नू॒नं वां॑ वरुण । मित्र॒ वंसि॑ वां सुम॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-urúṇā ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ ásti ǀ ávaḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ vām ǀ varuṇa ǀmítra ǀ váṃsi ǀ vām ǀ su-matím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I,MitraandVaruṇa, enjoy your favour through which there is assuredly protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॑ स॒म्यग॑द्रुह्वा॒णेष॑मश्याम॒ धाय॑से । व॒यं ते रु॑द्रा स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ samyák ǀ adruhvāṇā ǀ íṣam ǀ aśyāma ǀ dhā́yase ǀvayám ǀ té ǀ rudrā ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Benignant (deities), may we obtain from you, (who are) such (deities), food for our sustenance; may weRudras, be yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒तं नो॑ रुद्रा पा॒युभि॑रु॒त त्रा॑येथां सुत्रा॒त्रा । तु॒र्याम॒ दस्यू॑न्त॒नूभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pātám ǀ naḥ ǀ rudrā ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ trāyethām ǀ su-trātrā́ ǀturyā́ma ǀ dásyūn ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us with your protections; preserve us with kind preservation; may we, with our descendants, overcome theDasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा कस्या॑द्भुतक्रतू य॒क्षं भु॑जेमा त॒नूभि॑: । मा शेष॑सा॒ मा तन॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kásya ǀ adbhutakratū ítyadbhuta-kratū ǀ yakṣám ǀ bhujema ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀmā́ ǀ śéṣasā ǀ mā́ ǀ tánasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Workers of wondrous deeds, let us not depend upon the bounty of any other (than you), either in our person ns, or with our sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ गन्तं रिशादसा॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॑ ब॒र्हणा॑ । उपे॒मं चारु॑मध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ riśādasā ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ barháṇā ǀúpa ǀ imám ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, scatterers of foes, destroyers of enemies, come to this our accessible sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य॒ हि प्र॑चेतसा॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ राज॑थः । ई॒शा॒ना पि॑प्यतं॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ hí ǀ pra-cetasā ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ rā́jathaḥ ǀīśānā́ ǀ pipyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SagaciousMitraandVaruṇa, you reign over all bestow fullness, lords, upon our ancient rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सु॒तमा ग॑तं॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॑ दा॒शुष॑: । अ॒स्य सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀasyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,MitraandVaruṇa, to our effused libation to drink of theSomaof the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे व॒यं गी॒र्भिर्जु॑हुमो अत्रि॒वत् । नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ सदतं॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ vayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ juhumaḥ ǀ atri-vát ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeMitraandVaruṇawith hymns, like (our progenitor)Atri; do you sit down upon the sacred grass to drink theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्र॒तेन॑ स्थो ध्रु॒वक्षे॑मा॒ धर्म॑णा यात॒यज्ज॑ना । नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ सदतं॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: vraténa ǀ sthaḥ ǀ dhruvá-kṣemā ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ yātayát-janā ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Steady are you in your functions, whom men animate by (their) devotion; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रश्च॑ नो॒ वरु॑णश्च जु॒षेतां॑ य॒ज्ञमि॒ष्टये॑ । नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ सदतां॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ juṣétām ǀ yajñám ǀ iṣṭáye ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sadatam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitraandVaruṇa, accept wiht satisfaction our sacrifice; come and sit down upon the sacred grass to drink theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य स्थः प॑रा॒वति॒ यद॑र्वा॒वत्य॑श्विना । यद्वा॑ पु॒रू पु॑रुभुजा॒ यद॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ आ ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ stháḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ arvā-váti ǀ aśvinā ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ purú ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Aśvins, you are at present far, whether you are nigh, whether you are (straying) many plural ces, or whether you are in mid-air, do you, who partake of many offerings, come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्या पु॑रु॒भूत॑मा पु॒रू दंसां॑सि॒ बिभ्र॑ता । व॒र॒स्या या॒म्यध्रि॑गू हु॒वे तु॒विष्ट॑मा भु॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ purú ǀ dáṃsāṃsi ǀ bíbhratā ǀvarasyā́ ǀ yāmi ǀ ádhrigū ítyadhri-gū ǀ huvé ǀ tuvíḥ-tamā ǀ bhujé ǁ
