shlokas.meaning_en: “I approach you (to invite you) hither, you who are the encouragers of many; (who are) the achievers of many (great) exploits, most excellent and irresistible, I invoke you, who are most mighty, for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒र्मान्यद्वपु॑षे॒ वपु॑श्च॒क्रं रथ॑स्य येमथुः । पर्य॒न्या नाहु॑षा यु॒गा म॒ह्ना रजां॑सि दीयथः
shlokas.transliteration: īrmā́ ǀ anyát ǀ vápuṣe ǀ vápuḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ ráthasya ǀ yemathuḥ ǀpári ǀ anyā́ ǀ nā́huṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ dīyathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You hae arrested one luminous wheel of (your) car for illumining the form (of the sun), while with the other you traverse the spheres (to regulate) by your power the ages of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदू॒ षु वा॑मे॒ना कृ॒तं विश्वा॒ यद्वा॒मनु॒ ष्टवे॑ । नाना॑ जा॒ताव॑रे॒पसा॒ सम॒स्मे बन्धु॒मेय॑थुः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ enā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀ víśvā ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ ánu ǀ stáve ǀnā́nā ǀ jātáu ǀ arepásā ǀ sám ǀ asmé íti ǀ bándhum ǀ ā́ ǀ īyathuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praise, universal (deities), wherewith I laud you, be agreeable to you, as offered by this (your worshipper); and do yo, who are severally born, and free from blame bestow upon us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्वां॑ सू॒र्या रथं॒ तिष्ठ॑द्रघु॒ष्यदं॒ सदा॑ । परि॑ वामरु॒षा वयो॑ घृ॒णा व॑रन्त आ॒तप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ sūryā́ ǀ rátham ǀ tíṣṭhat ǀ raghu-syádam ǀ sádā ǀpári ǀ vām ǀ aruṣā́ḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ghṛṇā́ ǀ varante ǀ ā-tápaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenSūryahas ascended your ever easy-moving car, then bright-waving, resplendent rays (of light) encompass you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोरत्रि॑श्चिकेतति॒ नरा॑ सु॒म्नेन॒ चेत॑सा । घ॒र्मं यद्वा॑मरे॒पसं॒ नास॑त्या॒स्ना भु॑र॒ण्यति॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ átriḥ ǀ ciketati ǀ nárā ǀ sumnéna ǀ cétasā ǀgharmám ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ arepásam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ āsnā́ ǀ bhuraṇyáti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites),Atrirecognized (your benevolence) with (a grateful) mind on account of the relief (you afforded him), when,Nāsatyās, through his praise of you, he found the (fiery) heat innocuous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रो वां॑ ककु॒हो य॒यिः शृ॒ण्वे यामे॑षु संत॒निः । यद्वां॒ दंसो॑भिरश्वि॒नात्रि॑र्नराव॒वर्त॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: ugráḥ ǀ vām ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ yayíḥ ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ yā́meṣu ǀ sam-taníḥ ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ dáṃsaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ átriḥ ǀ narā ǀ ā-vavártati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your strong, lofty, moving, ever-progressing (ear) has been renowned at sacrifices ever since;Aśvins, leaders (of rites),Atriwas rescued by your acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्व॑ ऊ॒ षु म॑धूयुवा॒ रुद्रा॒ सिष॑क्ति पि॒प्युषी॑ । यत्स॑मु॒द्राति॒ पर्ष॑थः प॒क्वाः पृक्षो॑ भरन्त वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ madhu-yuvā ǀ rúdrā ǀ sísakti ǀ pipyúṣī ǀyát ǀ samudrā́ ǀ áti ǀ párṣathaḥ ǀ pakvā́ḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ bharanta ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mixers of theSomajuice,Rudras, (our) nutritious (adoration) bedews you will with the libation, when you traverse (the limits) of the firmament, and the prepared viands (of the sacrifice) support you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमिद्वा उ॑ अश्विना यु॒वामा॑हुर्मयो॒भुवा॑ । ता याम॑न्याम॒हूत॑मा॒ याम॒न्ना मृ॑ळ॒यत्त॑मा
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvā́m ǀ āhuḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀtā́ ǀ yā́man ǀ yāma-hū́tamā ǀ yā́man ǀ ā́ ǀ mṛḷayát-tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truly have they called you,Aśvins, the bestowers of felicity; such may you be when earnestly invoked to our sacrifice; bountiful bestowers of felicity at our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ वर्ध॑ना॒श्विभ्यां॑ सन्तु॒ शंत॑मा । या तक्षा॑म॒ रथाँ॑ इ॒वावो॑चाम बृ॒हन्नम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ várdhanā ǀ aśví-bhyām ǀ santu ǀ śám-tamā ǀyā́ ǀ tákṣāma ǀ ráthān-iva ǀ ávocāma ǀ bṛhát ǀ námaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these praises exalting theAśvinsbe productive of happiness, the praise that we fabricate as (a wheelwright) a car; we proclaim aloud fervent adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कूष्ठो॑ देवावश्विना॒द्या दि॒वो म॑नावसू । तच्छ्र॑वथो वृषण्वसू॒ अत्रि॑र्वा॒मा वि॑वासति
shlokas.transliteration: kū́-sthaḥ ǀ devau ǀ aśvinā ǀ adyá ǀ diváḥ ǀ manāvasū íti ǀtát ǀ śravathaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ átriḥ ǀ vām ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineĀdityas, affluent in praise, descended this day from heaven upon the earth, hear that (laudation), which, liberal showerers (of benefits),Atriever address to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुह॒ त्या कुह॒ नु श्रु॒ता दि॒वि दे॒वा नास॑त्या । कस्मि॒न्ना य॑तथो॒ जने॒ को वां॑ न॒दीनां॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: kúha ǀ tyā́ ǀ kúha ǀ nú ǀ śrutā́ ǀ diví ǀ devā́ ǀ nā́satyā ǀkásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ yatathaḥ ǀ jáne ǀ káḥ ǀ vām ǀ nadī́nām ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineNāsatyās, where are they? where are they heard if in heaven? to what worshipper do you come? who may be the associate of your praises?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कं या॑थ॒: कं ह॑ गच्छथ॒: कमच्छा॑ युञ्जाथे॒ रथ॑म् । कस्य॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि रण्यथो व॒यं वा॑मुश्मसी॒ष्टये॑
shlokas.transliteration: kám ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ kám ǀ ha ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ kám ǀ áccha ǀ yuñjāthe íti ǀ rátham ǀkásya ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ raṇyathaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ vām ǀ uśmasi ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whom do you proceed? to whom do you repair? to (go to) whose presence do you harness your car? by whose prayers are you gratified? We are anxious for your arrival.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पौ॒रं चि॒द्ध्यु॑द॒प्रुतं॒ पौर॑ पौ॒राय॒ जिन्व॑थः । यदीं॑ गृभी॒तता॑तये सिं॒हमि॑व द्रु॒हस्प॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: paurám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ uda-prútam ǀ páura ǀ paurā́ya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ gṛbhītá-tātaye ǀ siṃhám-iva ǀ druháḥ ǀ padé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pauras, send toPaurathe rain-shedding cloud drive it to him who is engaged in sacrifice, as (hunters chase) a lion in a forest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र च्यवा॑नाज्जुजु॒रुषो॑ व॒व्रिमत्कं॒ न मु॑ञ्चथः । युवा॒ यदी॑ कृ॒थः पुन॒रा काम॑मृण्वे व॒ध्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ cyávānāt ǀ jujurúṣaḥ ǀ vavrím ǀ átkam ǀ ná ǀ muñcathaḥ ǀyúvā ǀ yádi ǀ kṛtháḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kā́mam ǀ ṛṇve ǀ vadhváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You stripped off (his aged form) like a cuirass ffrom the decrepitCyavāna, so that, when you had rendered him again a youth, he attracted the desires of women.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ति॒ हि वा॑मि॒ह स्तो॒ता स्मसि॑ वां सं॒दृशि॑ श्रि॒ये । नू श्रु॒तं म॒ आ ग॑त॒मवो॑भिर्वाजिनीवसू
shlokas.transliteration: ásti ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ ihá ǀ stotā́ ǀ smási ǀ vām ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ śriyé ǀnú ǀ śrutám ǀ me ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A glorifier of you both is here; may we be (retained) in your sight for the sake of prosperity; hear today (my invocation); come hither with your protections, you who are affluent in food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को वा॑म॒द्य पु॑रू॒णामा व॑व्ने॒ मर्त्या॑नाम् । को विप्रो॑ विप्रवाहसा॒ को य॒ज्ञैर्वा॑जिनीवसू
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ vavne ǀ mártyānām ǀkáḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vipra-vāhasā ǀ káḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who among many mortals has this day (best) propitiated you? what wise man (has best propitiated you) who are reverenced by the wise? what (worshipper has best propitiated you) by sacrifice, you who are affluent in food?”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथो॒ रथा॑नां॒ येष्ठो॑ यात्वश्विना । पु॒रू चि॑दस्म॒युस्ति॒र आ॑ङ्गू॒षो मर्त्ये॒ष्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ráthānām ǀ yéṣṭhaḥ ǀ yātu ǀ aśvinā ǀpurú ǀ cit ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ āṅgūṣáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your car,Aśvins, the swiftest of the cars (of the gods), come hither well-disposed towards us, the discomfiter of numerous (foes), glorified among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शमू॒ षु वां॑ मधूयुवा॒स्माक॑मस्तु चर्कृ॒तिः । अ॒र्वा॒ची॒ना वि॑चेतसा॒ विभि॑: श्ये॒नेव॑ दीयतम्
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ madhu-yuvā ǀ asmā́kam ǀ astu ǀ carkṛtíḥ ǀarvācīnā́ ǀ vi-cetasā ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ śyenā́-iva ǀ dīyatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our repeated adoration of you two, who are desirous of the libation, be productive of felicity; descending to our presence, and exceeding in wisdom, travel with rapid (steeds), swift as two falcons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒ यद्ध॒ कर्हि॑ चिच्छुश्रू॒यात॑मि॒मं हव॑म् । वस्वी॑रू॒ षु वां॒ भुज॑: पृ॒ञ्चन्ति॒ सु वां॒ पृच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ kárhi ǀ cit ǀ śuśruyā́tam ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀvásvīḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ bhújaḥ ǀ pṛñcánti ǀ sú ǀ vām ǀ pṛ́caḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, wherever you may be, hear this invocation; the excellent sacrificial offerings, longing for your proximity, reach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ प्रि॒यत॑मं॒ रथं॒ वृष॑णं वसु॒वाह॑नम् । : स्तो॒ता वा॑मश्विना॒वृषि॒: स्तोमे॑न॒ प्रति॑ भूषति॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ priyá-tamam ǀ rátham ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vasu-vā́hanam ǀstotā́ ǀ vām ǀ aśvinau ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ stómena ǀ práti ǀ bhūṣati ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ṛṣi, your worshipper,Aśvins, graces your beloved chariot, the showerer (of benefits), the vehicle of wealth, with praises; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒त्याया॑तमश्विना ति॒रो विश्वा॑ अ॒हं सना॑ । दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी॒ सुषु॑म्ना॒ सिन्धु॑वाहसा॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ati-ā́yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ tiráḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ahám ǀ sánā ǀdásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ sú-sumnā ǀ síndhu-vāhasā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Passing by (other worshippers), come,Aśvins, hither, so that I may ever overcome all (adversaries);Dasras, riding in a golden chariot distributors of wealth, propellers of rivers, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ रत्ना॑नि॒ बिभ्र॑ता॒वश्वि॑ना॒ गच्छ॑तं यु॒वम् । रुद्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी जुषा॒णा वा॑जिनीवसू॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rátnāni ǀ bíbhratau ǀ áśvinā ǀ gácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀrúdrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, bring for us precious treasures;Rudras, riding in a golden chariot, propitiated (by sacrifice), affluent with food, masters of mystic lore, hear my invocatioṇ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ष्टुभो॑ वां वृषण्वसू॒ रथे॒ वाणी॒च्याहि॑ता । उ॒त वां॑ ककु॒हो मृ॒गः पृक्ष॑: कृणोति वापु॒षो माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: su-stúbhaḥ ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ ráthe ǀ vā́ṇīcī ǀ ā́-hitā ǀutá ǀ vām ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ vāpuṣáḥ ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer of wealth, the praise of your worshipper is addressed to your chariot; (to it), as well as to you, does this distinguished, devoted, embodied (adorer) offer sacrificial food; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बो॒धिन्म॑नसा र॒थ्ये॑षि॒रा ह॑वन॒श्रुता॑ । विभि॒श्च्यवा॑नमश्विना॒ नि या॑थो॒ अद्व॑याविनं॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bodhít-manasā ǀ rathyā́ ǀ iṣirā́ ǀ havana-śrútā ǀví-bhiḥ ǀ cyávānam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ní ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ ádvayāvinam ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With mind attentive (to praise), riding in cars, swift-moving, listening to invocations, you hastened with your steeds to the single-purposedcyavana; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ नरा मनो॒युजोऽश्वा॑सः प्रुषि॒तप्स॑वः । वयो॑ वहन्तु पी॒तये॑ स॒ह सु॒म्नेभि॑रश्विना॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ manaḥ-yújaḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ pruṣitá-psavaḥ ǀváyaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ pītáye ǀ sahá ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, leaders (of rites), may your horses, harnessed at will, of wondrous beauty, and of rapid course, bring you hither with good gifts to drink (of the proffered beverage); masters of mystic lore,hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒वेह ग॑च्छतं॒ नास॑त्या॒ मा वि वे॑नतम् । ति॒रश्चि॑दर्य॒या परि॑ व॒र्तिर्या॑तमदाभ्या॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinau ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchatam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venatam ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ arya-yā́ ǀ pári ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ adābhyā ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, come hither;Nāsatyas, be not unpropitious; invincible lords, come from hidden (regions) to our sacrificial hall; maste of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे अ॑दाभ्या जरि॒तारं॑ शुभस्पती । अ॒व॒स्युम॑श्विना यु॒वं गृ॒णन्त॒मुप॑ भूषथो॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ adābhyā ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀavasyúm ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “InvincibleAśvins, lords of water, favourAvasyu, glorifying you at this sacrifice; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑दु॒षा रुश॑त्पशु॒राग्निर॑धाय्यृ॒त्विय॑: । अयो॑जि वां वृषण्वसू॒ रथो॑ दस्रा॒वम॑र्त्यो॒ माध्वी॒ मम॑ श्रुतं॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ rúśat-paśuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ adhāyi ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǀáyoji ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dasrau ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ mā́dhvī íti ǀ máma ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dawn has come; theAgniof the season, blazing with the oblation has been plural ced (upon the altar); showerers of wealth, subduers of foes, your immortal chariot has been harnessed; masters of mystic lore, hear my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भा॑त्य॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मनी॑क॒मुद्विप्रा॑णां देव॒या वाचो॑ अस्थुः । अ॒र्वाञ्चा॑ नू॒नं र॑थ्ये॒ह या॑तं पीपि॒वांस॑मश्विना घ॒र्ममच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ agníḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ ánīkam ǀ út ǀ víprāṇām ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀarvā́ñcā ǀ nūnám ǀ rathyā ǀ ihá ǀ yātam ǀ pīpi-vā́ṃsam ǀ aśvinā ǀ gharmám ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnilight sup the face of the dawns; the devout praisers of the pious have risen up; therefore,Aśvins, lords of the chariot, descending, come hither today to the splendid sacrifice, perfect (in all its parts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न सं॑स्कृ॒तं प्र मि॑मीतो॒ गमि॒ष्ठान्ति॑ नू॒नम॒श्विनोप॑स्तुते॒ह । दिवा॑भिपि॒त्वेऽव॒साग॑मिष्ठा॒ प्रत्यव॑र्तिं दा॒शुषे॒ शम्भ॑विष्ठा
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ saṃskṛtám ǀ prá ǀ mimītaḥ ǀ gámiṣṭhā ǀ ánti ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvínā ǀ úpa-stutā ǀ ihá ǀdívā ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhā ǀ práti ǀ ávartim ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm not,Aśvins, the perfected (rite), but coming now most quickly, be glorified on this occasion; be present at the opening of the ay, with proection against destitution, and be prompt to bestow happiness upon the donor (of the offering).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ता या॑तं संग॒वे प्रा॒तरह्नो॑ म॒ध्यंदि॑न॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य । दिवा॒ नक्त॒मव॑सा॒ शंत॑मेन॒ नेदानीं॑ पी॒तिर॒श्विना त॑तान
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ sam-gavé ǀ prātáḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ madhyándine ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀdívā ǀ náktam ǀ ávasā ǀ śám-tamena ǀ ná ǀ idā́nīm ǀ pītíḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ ā́ ǀ tatāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you come at the (milking time) of the cattle, at the dawn of day, at noon, when the sun is high, or by day or by night, (come) with felicitious protection; the drinking of theSomahas not now extended beyond theAśvins. (whether you come: the day is divisible into two, three, five or fifteen parts; here the five-fold distinction is alluded to: uditā sūryasya = the afternoon, atyantapravṛddhasamayaḥaparāhṇaityarthaḥ; the drinking of the soma...Aśvins: nedānīm pītir aśvinā tatāna: legend-- the other gods refused to admit the participation of the Aśvins in the Soma libation at these hours, but on the present occasion they are not passed over; idānim api itaradevānām pānam na tanotyaśvinau vihāya, but now the drinking of the other gods does not extend, having omitted the two Aśvins]”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं हि वां॑ प्र॒दिवि॒ स्थान॒मोक॑ इ॒मे गृ॒हा अ॑श्विने॒दं दु॑रो॒णम् । आ नो॑ दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तः पर्व॑ता॒दाद्भ्यो या॑त॒मिष॒मूर्जं॒ वह॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ pra-dívi ǀ sthā́nam ǀ ókaḥ ǀ imé ǀ gṛhā́ḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ idám ǀ duroṇám ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ párvatāt ǀ ā́ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ yātam ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ váhantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This station,Aśvins, is your ancient abode; these are your mansions, this your dwelling; come from the vast firmament, (verspread) by clouds (filled) with water, bringing strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॒श्विनो॒रव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेन मयो॒भुवा॑ सु॒प्रणी॑ती गमेम । आ नो॑ र॒यिं व॑हत॒मोत वी॒राना विश्वा॑न्यमृता॒ सौभ॑गानि
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be united with theAśvinsby their special protection, which is the source of happiness and guide to good; bestow upon us, immortals, wealth and posterity; and all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्यावा॑णा प्रथ॒मा य॑जध्वं पु॒रा गृध्रा॒दर॑रुषः पिबातः । प्रा॒तर्हि य॒ज्ञम॒श्विना॑ द॒धाते॒ प्र शं॑सन्ति क॒वय॑: पूर्व॒भाज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-yā́vānā ǀ prathamā́ ǀ yajadhvam ǀ purā́ ǀ gṛ́dhrāt ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ pibātaḥ ǀprātáḥ ǀ hí ǀ yajñám ǀ aśvínā ǀ dadhā́te íti ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsanti ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ pūrva-bhā́jaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship the two who come first (of the gods) at dawn; let them drink before the greedy withholders (of the offering); for theAśvinsverily claim the morning sacrifice; the ardent sages praised them (at dawn).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तर्य॑जध्वम॒श्विना॑ हिनोत॒ न सा॒यम॑स्ति देव॒या अजु॑ष्टम् । उ॒तान्यो अ॒स्मद्य॑जते॒ वि चाव॒: पूर्व॑:पूर्वो॒ यज॑मानो॒ वनी॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ yajadhvam ǀ aśvínā ǀ hinota ǀ ná ǀ sāyám ǀ asti ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ ájuṣṭam ǀutá ǀ anyáḥ ǀ asmát ǀ yajate ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ pū́rvaḥ-pūrvaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ vánīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WOrship theAśvinsat early dawn; offer their oblations; the evening is not for the gods; it is unacceptable to them; and whether it be any other than ourselves who worship them or propitiates them, the worshipper who is foremost (in his devotion) is the most approved of.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यत्व॒ङ्मधु॑वर्णो घृ॒तस्नु॒: पृक्षो॒ वह॒न्ना रथो॑ वर्तते वाम् । मनो॑जवा अश्विना॒ वात॑रंहा॒ येना॑तिया॒थो दु॑रि॒तानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-tvak ǀ mádhu-varṇaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-snuḥ ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ váhan ǀ ā́ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vartate ǀ vām ǀmánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vā́ta-raṃhāḥ ǀ yéna ǀ ati-yātháḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your car,Aśvins, approaches, coated with gold, honey-tinted, water-shedding, laden with ambrosia, as quick as thought, as rapid as the wind, wherewith you pass over all obstacles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो भूयि॑ष्ठं॒ नास॑त्याभ्यां वि॒वेष॒ चनि॑ष्ठं पि॒त्वो रर॑ते विभा॒गे । स तो॒कम॑स्य पीपर॒च्छमी॑भि॒रनू॑र्ध्वभास॒: सद॒मित्तु॑तुर्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bhū́yiṣṭham ǀ nā́satyābhyām ǀ vivéṣa ǀ cániṣṭham ǀ pitváḥ ǀ rárate ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀsáḥ ǀ tokám ǀ asya ǀ pīparat ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ ánūrdhva-bhāsaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ tuturyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, in the appointment (of the offerings), presents to theNāsatyasthe most ample (share) of (the sacrificial) food, who gives (them) the largest portion of the viands, secures, by his acts, the welfare of his son, and ever has the advantage of those who light no sacred fires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॒श्विनो॒रव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेन मयो॒भुवा॑ सु॒प्रणी॑ती गमेम । आ नो॑ र॒यिं व॑हत॒मोत वी॒राना विश्वा॑न्यमृता॒ सौभ॑गानि
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ su-pránītī ǀ gamema ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ vahatam ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ amṛtā ǀ sáubhagāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be united with theAśvins, by their special protection, which is the source of happiness, the guide to good; bestow upon us, immortals, wealth and all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना॒वेह ग॑च्छतं॒ नास॑त्या॒ मा वि वे॑नतम् । हं॒सावि॑व पतत॒मा सु॒ताँ उप॑
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinau ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchatam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venatam ǀhaṃsáu-iva ǀ patatam ǀ ā́ ǀ sutā́n ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, come hither;Nāsatyas, be not ill-disposed; alight like two swans upon the effused libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना हरि॒णावि॑व गौ॒रावि॒वानु॒ यव॑सम् । हं॒सावि॑व पतत॒मा सु॒ताँ उप॑
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ hariṇáu-iva ǀ gauráu-iva ǀ ánu ǀ yávasam ǀhaṃsáu-iva ǀ patatam ǀ ā́ ǀ sutā́n ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like two deer,Aśvins, like two wild cattle on (fresh) pasture; like two swans alight upon the effused libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना वाजिनीवसू जु॒षेथां॑ य॒ज्ञमि॒ष्टये॑ । हं॒सावि॑व पतत॒मा सु॒ताँ उप॑
shlokas.transliteration: áśvinā ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ iṣṭáye ǀhaṃsáu-iva ǀ patatam ǀ ā́ ǀ sutā́n ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, affluent in food, be propitiated at your plural asure by the sacrifice; alight like two swans uon the effused libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्रि॒र्यद्वा॑मव॒रोह॑न्नृ॒बीस॒मजो॑हवी॒न्नाध॑मानेव॒ योषा॑ । श्ये॒नस्य॑ चि॒ज्जव॑सा॒ नूत॑ने॒नाग॑च्छतमश्विना॒ शंत॑मेन
shlokas.transliteration: átriḥ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ ava-róhan ǀ ṛbī́sam ǀ ájohavīt ǀ nā́dhamānā-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀśyenásya ǀ cit ǀ jávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ ā́ ǀ agacchatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ śám-tamena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch asAtri, escaping by your aid from the fire of chaff, conciliates you, like a wife soliciting the affection of a husband, therefore come with (your) propitious cars; with the new-born rapidity of the falcon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि जि॑हीष्व वनस्पते॒ योनि॒: सूष्य॑न्त्या इव । श्रु॒तं मे॑ अश्विना॒ हवं॑ स॒प्तव॑ध्रिं च मुञ्चतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ jihīṣva ǀ vanaspate ǀ yóniḥ ǀ sū́ṣyantyāḥ-iva ǀśrutám ǀ me ǀ aśvinā ǀ hávam ǀ saptá-vadhrim ǀ ca ǀ muñcatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Open,Vanaspati, like the womb of parturient feminine le; hear,Aśvins, my invocation; set Saptavadhri free.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भी॒ताय॒ नाध॑मानाय॒ ऋष॑ये स॒प्तव॑ध्रये । मा॒याभि॑रश्विना यु॒वं वृ॒क्षं सं च॒ वि चा॑चथः
shlokas.transliteration: bhītā́ya ǀ nā́dhamānāya ǀ ṛ́ṣaye ǀ saptá-vadhraye ǀmāyā́bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ vṛkṣám ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ acathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, by your devices sunder the wicker-work for (the liberation of the) terrified, imploring Ṛṣi, Saptavadhri.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ वात॑: पुष्क॒रिणीं॑ समि॒ङ्गय॑ति स॒र्वत॑: । ए॒वा ते॒ गर्भ॑ एजतु नि॒रैतु॒ दश॑मास्यः
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ puṣkaríṇīm ǀ sam-iṅgáyati ǀ sarvátaḥ ǀevá ǀ te ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ejatu ǀ niḥ-áitu ǀ dáśa-māsyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the wind ruffles the lake on every side, so may your womb be stimulated, and the conception of the months come forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ वातो॒ यथा॒ वनं॒ यथा॑ समु॒द्र एज॑ति । ए॒वा त्वं द॑शमास्य स॒हावे॑हि ज॒रायु॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vánam ǀ yáthā ǀ samudráḥ ǀ éjati ǀevá ǀ tvám ǀ daśa-māsya ǀ sahá ǀ áva ǀ ihi ǀ jarā́yuṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the wind, as the wood, as the ocean are agitated, so do you, gestation of ten months, invested with the uterine membranes, descend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ मासा॑ञ्छशया॒नः कु॑मा॒रो अधि॑ मा॒तरि॑ । नि॒रैतु॑ जी॒वो अक्ष॑तो जी॒वो जीव॑न्त्या॒ अधि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ mā́sān ǀ śaśayānáḥ ǀ kumāráḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ mātári ǀniḥ-áitu ǀ jīváḥ ǀ ákṣataḥ ǀ jīváḥ ǀ jī́vantyāḥ ǀ ádhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the boy who has reposed for ten months in the bosom of his mother come forth, alive, unharmed, living, from a living (parent).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हे नो॑ अ॒द्य बो॑ध॒योषो॑ रा॒ये दि॒वित्म॑ती । यथा॑ चिन्नो॒ अबो॑धयः स॒त्यश्र॑वसि वा॒य्ये सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: mahé ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ bodhaya ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ divítmatī ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ ábodhayaḥ ǀ satyá-śravasi ǀ vāyyé ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant Uṣas, wake up today for (the acquisition of) ample riches, in like manner as you have awakened us (of old); bright-born, and praised sincerely for (the gift of) horses, show favour tosatyaśravas, the son ofVayya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या सु॑नी॒थे शौ॑चद्र॒थे व्यौच्छो॑ दुहितर्दिवः । सा व्यु॑च्छ॒ सही॑यसि स॒त्यश्र॑वसि वा॒य्ये सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ su-nīthé ǀ śaucat-rathé ǀ ví ǀ áucchaḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀsā́ ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ sáhīyasi ǀ satyá-śravasi ǀ vāyyé ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, who have dawned uponSunitha, the son of Śucadratha, bright-born, and praised sincerely for (the gift of) horses, dawn upon the powerful son ofVayya,Satyaśravas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा नो॑ अ॒द्याभ॒रद्व॑सु॒र्व्यु॑च्छा दुहितर्दिवः । यो व्यौच्छ॒: सही॑यसि स॒त्यश्र॑वसि वा॒य्ये सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ābharát-vasuḥ ǀ ví ǀ uccha ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀyó íti ǀ ví ǀ áucchaḥ ǀ sáhīyasi ǀ satyá-śravasi ǀ vāyyé ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, who are the bringer of opulence, dawn upon us today, as, bright-born, and praised for (the gift of) horses, you have dawned upon the powerfulSatyaśravas, the son ofVayya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि ये त्वा॑ विभावरि॒ स्तोमै॑र्गृ॒णन्ति॒ वह्न॑यः । म॒घैर्म॑घोनि सु॒श्रियो॒ दाम॑न्वन्तः सुरा॒तय॒: सुजा॑त॒॑ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yé ǀ tvā ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀmagháiḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ su-śríyaḥ ǀ dā́man-vantaḥ ǀ su-rātáyaḥ ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerers of oblations who eulogize you, lustrous Uṣas, with sacred hymns, become prosperous with affluence, (through your favour), bestower of wealth, bright-born goddess, (who are) sincrely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि ते॑ ग॒णा इ॒मे छ॒दय॑न्ति म॒घत्त॑ये । परि॑ चि॒द्वष्ट॑यो दधु॒र्दद॑तो॒ राधो॒ अह्र॑यं॒ सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ gaṇā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ chadáyanti ǀ magháttaye ǀpári ǀ cit ǀ váṣṭayaḥ ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ dádataḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ áhrayam ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These, your assembled (worshippers), who stand before you to distribute wealth, entertain towards us kindly intentions, offering unlimited riches; bright-born goddess, (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐषु॑ धा वी॒रव॒द्यश॒ उषो॑ मघोनि सू॒रिषु॑ । ये नो॒ राधां॒स्यह्र॑या म॒घवा॑नो॒ अरा॑सत॒ सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ dhāḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ sūríṣu ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ áhrayā ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ árāsata ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent Uṣas, bestow upon these (yor) devout adorers food and posterity, so that, being opulent, they may, without stint, bestow riches upon us; bright-born goddess who are sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेभ्यो॑ द्यु॒म्नं बृ॒हद्यश॒ उषो॑ मघो॒न्या व॑ह । ये नो॒ राधां॒स्यश्व्या॑ ग॒व्या भज॑न्त सू॒रय॒: सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: tébhyaḥ ǀ dyumnám ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ maghoni ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ áśvyā ǀ gavyā́ ǀ bhájanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent Uṣas, bring wealth and abundant food to those who, liberal givers, bestow upon us riches with horses and cattle; bright-born goddess (who are) sincerely prised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ गोम॑ती॒रिष॒ आ व॑हा दुहितर्दिवः । सा॒कं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑: शु॒क्रैः शोच॑द्भिर॒र्चिभि॒: सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀsākám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ śukráiḥ ǀ śócat-bhiḥ ǀ arcí-bhiḥ ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, bring to us food and cattle together with the pure rays of the sun, and the radiant flames (of the kindled fires); bright-born goddess, (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यु॑च्छा दुहितर्दिवो॒ मा चि॒रं त॑नुथा॒ अप॑: । नेत्त्वा॑ स्ते॒नं यथा॑ रि॒पुं तपा॑ति॒ सूरो॑ अ॒र्चिषा॒ सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ uccha ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ cirám ǀ tanuthāḥ ǀ ápaḥ ǀná ǀ ít ǀ tvā ǀ stenám ǀ yáthā ǀ ripúm ǀ tápāti ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ arcíṣā ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, Dawn! delay not our (sacred) rite; let not the sun scorch you with his ray, as (a prince punishes) a thief, or (subdues) an enemy; bright-born goddess,(who are), sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॒द्वेदु॑ष॒स्त्वं भूयो॑ वा॒ दातु॑मर्हसि । या स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ विभावर्यु॒च्छन्ती॒ न प्र॒मीय॑से॒ सुजा॑ते॒ अश्व॑सूनृते
shlokas.transliteration: etā́vat ǀ vā ǀ ít ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ vā ǀ dā́tum ǀ arhasi ǀyā́ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ ucchántī ǀ ná ǀ pra-mī́yase ǀ sú-jāte ǀ áśva-sūnṛte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, Uṣas, are able to give (us) whatever, indeed, (has been solicited), and much (that has not been asked for); for, radiant (divinity), who are dawning upon your adorers, you are never cruel (to them);bright-born goddess (who are) sincerely praised for (the gift of) horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यु॒तद्या॑मानं बृह॒तीमृ॒तेन॑ ऋ॒ताव॑रीमरु॒णप्सुं॑ विभा॒तीम् । दे॒वीमु॒षसं॒ स्व॑रा॒वह॑न्तीं॒ प्रति॒ विप्रा॑सो म॒तिभि॑र्जरन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: dyutát-yāmānam ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ṛténa ǀ ṛtá-varīm ǀ aruṇá-psum ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀdevī́m ǀ uṣásam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ā-váhantīm ǀ práti ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise priests celebrate with hymns the divine, bright-chariot, expanded Dawn; worshipped with holy worship, purple-tinted, radiant, leading on the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा जनं॑ दर्श॒ता बो॒धय॑न्ती सु॒गान्प॒थः कृ॑ण्व॒ती या॒त्यग्रे॑ । बृ॒ह॒द्र॒था बृ॑ह॒ती वि॑श्वमि॒न्वोषा ज्योति॑र्यच्छ॒त्यग्रे॒ अह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ jánam ǀ darśatā́ ǀ bodháyantī ǀ su-gā́n ǀ patháḥ ǀ kṛṇvatī́ ǀ yāti ǀ ágre ǀbṛhat-rathā́ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ viśvam-invā́ ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ yacchati ǀ ágre ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The lovely Dawn, arousing man, goes before (the sun) preparing practicable paths, riding in a spacious chariot; vast, expanding everywhere, she diffuses light at the commencement of the days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा गोभि॑ररु॒णेभि॑र्युजा॒नास्रे॑धन्ती र॒यिमप्रा॑यु चक्रे । प॒थो रद॑न्ती सुवि॒ताय॑ दे॒वी पु॑रुष्टु॒ता वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ वि भा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ aruṇébhiḥ ǀ yujānā́ ǀ ásredhantī ǀ rayím ǀ ápra-āyu ǀ cakre ǀpatháḥ ǀ rádantī ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ devī́ ǀ puru-stutā́ ǀ viśvá-vārā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harnessing the purple oxen to her car, unwearied she renders riches perpetual; a goddess, praised of many, and cherished by all, she shines, manifesting the paths that lead to good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा व्ये॑नी भवति द्वि॒बर्हा॑ आविष्कृण्वा॒ना त॒न्वं॑ पु॒रस्ता॑त् । ऋ॒तस्य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑ति सा॒धु प्र॑जान॒तीव॒ न दिशो॑ मिनाति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ ví-enī ǀ bhavati ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ āviḥ-kṛṇvānā́ ǀ tanvám ǀ purástāt ǀṛtásya ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ sādhú ǀ prajānatī́-iva ǀ ná ǀ díśaḥ ǀ mināti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lucidly white is she, occupying the two (regions, the upper and middle firmament), and manifesting her person n from the east; she traverses the path of the sun as if knowing (his course), and harms not the quarters of the horizon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा शु॒भ्रा न त॒न्वो॑ विदा॒नोर्ध्वेव॑ स्ना॒ती दृ॒शये॑ नो अस्थात् । अप॒ द्वेषो॒ बाध॑माना॒ तमां॑स्यु॒षा दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता ज्योति॒षागा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ śubhrā́ ǀ ná ǀ tanváḥ ǀ vidānā́ ǀ ūrdhvā́-iva ǀ snātī́ ǀ dṛśáye ǀ naḥ ǀ asthāt ǀápa ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ bā́dhamānā ǀ támāṃsi ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “exhibiting her person n like a well-attired feminine le, she stands before our eyes, (gracefully) inclining like (a woman who has been) bathing; dispersing the hostile glooms, Uṣas, the daughter of heaven, comes with radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा प्र॑ती॒ची दु॑हि॒ता दि॒वो नॄन्योषे॑व भ॒द्रा नि रि॑णीते॒ अप्स॑: । व्यू॒र्ण्व॒ती दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि॒ पुन॒र्ज्योति॑र्युव॒तिः पू॒र्वथा॑कः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ yóṣā-iva ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ ní ǀ riṇīte ǀ ápsaḥ ǀvi-ūrṇvatī́ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ púnaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, the daughter of heaven, tending to the west puts forth her beauty like a (well-dressed) woman, bestowing precious treasures upon the offerer of adoration; she, ever youthful, brings back the light as (she has done) of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चित॑: । वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुतिः
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjáte ǀ mánaḥ ǀ utá ǀ yuñjate ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ víprasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀví ǀ hótrāḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ vayuna-vít ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ mahī́ ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ pári-stutiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise apply their minds; they perform sacred rites for the propitiation of the intelligent, great, adorableSavitā; he alone, knowing their functions, directs the priests; verily, great is the praise of the divine Savitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चते क॒विः प्रासा॑वीद्भ॒द्रं द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे । वि नाक॑मख्यत्सवि॒ता वरे॒ण्योऽनु॑ प्र॒याण॑मु॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ práti ǀ muñcate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ prá ǀ asāvīt ǀ bhadrám ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀví ǀ nā́kam ǀ akhyat ǀ savitā́ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-yā́nam ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wiseSavitācomprehends all forms (in himself); he has engendered what is good for biped and quadruped; the adorable Savitā has illumed the heaven, and shines in sequence to the passage of the Dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ प्र॒याण॒मन्व॒न्य इद्य॒युर्दे॒वा दे॒वस्य॑ महि॒मान॒मोज॑सा । यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे स एत॑शो॒ रजां॑सि दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता म॑हित्व॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ pra-yā́nam ǀ ánu ǀ anyé ǀ ít ǀ yayúḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devásya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ójasā ǀyáḥ ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ vi-mamé ǀ sáḥ ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “After the passage of which divine (being) the other deities proceed to (obtain) majesty with power; he who by his greatness has measured out the terrestrial regions the divineSavitā, (is) resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त या॑सि सवित॒स्त्रीणि॑ रोच॒नोत सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒: समु॑च्यसि । उ॒त रात्री॑मुभ॒यत॒: परी॑यस उ॒त मि॒त्रो भ॑वसि देव॒ धर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ yāsi ǀ savitaríti ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀ utá ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ ucyasi ǀutá ǀ rā́trīm ǀ ubhayátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ īyase ǀ utá ǀ mitráḥ ǀ bhavasi ǀ deva ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “eithe ryou traverse,Savitā, the three regions, or combine with the rays ofSūrya; or you pass between the night on eitherhand; or you, divine Savitā areMitra, through your (benevolent) functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तेशि॑षे प्रस॒वस्य॒ त्वमेक॒ इदु॒त पू॒षा भ॑वसि देव॒ याम॑भिः । उ॒तेदं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं॒ वि रा॑जसि श्या॒वाश्व॑स्ते सवित॒ स्तोम॑मानशे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ īśiṣe ǀ pra-savásya ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ utá ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ bhavasi ǀ deva ǀ yā́ma-bhiḥ ǀutá ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ śyāvá-aśvaḥ ǀ te ǀ savitaríti ǀ stómam ǀ ānaśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alone rule over (the actions of) living beings; you arePūṣan, divine (Savitā), by the movements; you are soverign over the whole world;Śyāvāśvaoffers praise, Savitā, to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वृ॑णीमहे व॒यं दे॒वस्य॒ भोज॑नम् । श्रेष्ठं॑ सर्व॒धात॑मं॒ तुरं॒ भग॑स्य धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ savitúḥ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ vayám ǀ devásya ǀ bhójanam ǀśréṣṭham ǀ sarva-dhā́tamam ǀ túram ǀ bhágasya ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit of the divineSavitāenjoyable (wealth) may we receive fromBhagathat which is excellent, all sustaining, destructive of foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॒ हि स्वय॑शस्तरं सवि॒तुः कच्च॒न प्रि॒यम् । न मि॒नन्ति॑ स्व॒राज्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ hí ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taram ǀ savitúḥ ǀ kát ǀ caná ǀ priyám ǀná ǀ minánti ǀ sva-rā́jyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nothing impairs the sovereignty of thisSavitā, which is most especially renowned and beloved.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑ सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता भग॑: । तं भा॒गं चि॒त्रमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ suvā́ti ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀtám ǀ bhāgám ǀ citrám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatSavitāwho isBhaga, bestows precious treasure on the donor of the offering; we solicit (of him) a valuable portion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्या नो॑ देव सवितः प्र॒जाव॑त्सावी॒: सौभ॑गम् । परा॑ दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्यं॑ सुव
shlokas.transliteration: adyá ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ savitaríti ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ sāvīḥ ǀ sáubhagam ǀpárā ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ suva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us today, divineSavitāaffluence with progeny, and drive away evil dreams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑नि देव सवितर्दुरि॒तानि॒ परा॑ सुव । यद्भ॒द्रं तन्न॒ आ सु॑व
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ párā ǀ suva ǀyát ǀ bhadrám ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Remove from us, divineSavitā, all misfortunes; bestow upon us that which is good,”

shlokas.sanskrit: अना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे । विश्वा॑ वा॒मानि॑ धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ánāgasaḥ ǀ áditaye ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ savé ǀvíśvā ǀ vāmā́ni ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us be void of offence towardsAditi, according to the will of the divineSavitā; may we be possessed of all-desired (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वि॒श्वदे॑वं॒ सत्प॑तिं सू॒क्तैर॒द्या वृ॑णीमहे । स॒त्यस॑वं सवि॒तार॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viśvá-devam ǀ sát-patim ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀsatyá-savam ǀ savitā́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify today with hymnsSavitā, the protector of the good, the observer of truth (identical with) all the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒मे उ॒भे अह॑नी पु॒र एत्यप्र॑युच्छन् । स्वा॒धीर्दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ áhanī íti ǀ puráḥ ǀ éti ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀsu-ādhī́ḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine object of meditation,Savitā, who ever vigilant, precedes both night and day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒मा विश्वा॑ जा॒तान्या॑श्रा॒वय॑ति॒ श्लोके॑न । प्र च॑ सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ ā-śrāváyati ǀ ślókena ǀprá ǀ ca ǀ suvā́ti ǀ savitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savitā, who proclaims his glory to all these living beings, and gives them life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ वद त॒वसं॑ गी॒र्भिरा॒भिः स्तु॒हि प॒र्जन्यं॒ नम॒सा वि॑वास । कनि॑क्रदद्वृष॒भो जी॒रदा॑नू॒ रेतो॑ दधा॒त्योष॑धीषु॒ गर्भ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ vada ǀ tavásam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ stuhí ǀ parjányam ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsa ǀkánikradat ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ jīrá-dānuḥ ǀ rétaḥ ǀ dadhāti ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ gárbham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I address the mightyParjanyawho is present; praise him with these hymns; worship him with reverence, him who is the thunderer, the showerer, the bountiful, who impregnates the plural nts with rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि वृ॒क्षान्ह॑न्त्यु॒त ह॑न्ति र॒क्षसो॒ विश्वं॑ बिभाय॒ भुव॑नं म॒हाव॑धात् । उ॒ताना॑गा ईषते॒ वृष्ण्या॑वतो॒ यत्प॒र्जन्य॑: स्त॒नय॒न्हन्ति॑ दु॒ष्कृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ vṛkṣā́n ǀ hanti ǀ utá ǀ hanti ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ bibhāya ǀ bhúvanam ǀ mahā́-vadhāt ǀutá ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ īṣate ǀ vṛ́ṣṇya-vataḥ ǀ yát ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ stanáyan ǀ hánti ǀ duḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He strikes down the trees, he destroys therākṣasas, he terrifies the whole world by his mighty weapon; even the innocent man flies from the sender of rain, whenParjanya, thundering, slays the wicked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒थीव॒ कश॒याश्वाँ॑ अभिक्षि॒पन्ना॒विर्दू॒तान्कृ॑णुते व॒र्ष्याँ॒३॒॑ अह॑ । दू॒रात्सिं॒हस्य॑ स्त॒नथा॒ उदी॑रते॒ यत्प॒र्जन्य॑: कृणु॒ते व॒र्ष्यं१॒॑ नभ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: rathī́-iva ǀ káśayā ǀ áśvān ǀ abhi-kṣipán ǀ āvíḥ ǀ dūtā́n ǀ kṛṇute ǀ varṣyā́n ǀ áha ǀdūrā́t ǀ siṃhásya ǀ stanáthāḥ ǀ út ǀ īrate ǀ yát ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ varṣyám ǀ nábhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a charioteer, urging his horses with his whip, brings into view the messenger (of war), soParjanya, (driving the clouds before him), makes manifest the messengers of the rain; the roaring of the lion-(like cloud) proclaims from afar that Parjanya overspreads the sky with rainy clouds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वाता॒ वान्ति॑ प॒तय॑न्ति वि॒द्युत॒ उदोष॑धी॒र्जिह॑ते॒ पिन्व॑ते॒ स्व॑: । इरा॒ विश्व॑स्मै॒ भुव॑नाय जायते॒ यत्प॒र्जन्य॑: पृथि॒वीं रेत॒साव॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ vā́nti ǀ patáyanti ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ út ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ jíhate ǀ pínvate ǀ sváḥ ǀírā ǀ víśvasmai ǀ bhúvanāya ǀ jāyate ǀ yát ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ rétasā ǀ ávati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The winds blow strong, the lightnings flash, the plural nts spring up, the firmament dissolves; earth becomes (fit) for all creatures whenParjanyafertilizes the soil with showers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ व्र॒ते पृ॑थि॒वी नन्न॑मीति॒ यस्य॑ व्र॒ते श॒फव॒ज्जर्भु॑रीति । यस्य॑ व्र॒त ओष॑धीर्वि॒श्वरू॑पा॒: स न॑: पर्जन्य॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ यच्छ
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ vraté ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ námnamīti ǀ yásya ǀ vraté ǀ śaphá-vat ǀ járbhurīti ǀyásya ǀ vraté ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpāḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ parjanya ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Parjanya, through whose function the earth is bowed down; through whose function hoofed cattle thrive; through whose function plural nts assume all kinds of forms, grant us great felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो नो॑ वृ॒ष्टिं म॑रुतो ररीध्वं॒ प्र पि॑न्वत॒ वृष्णो॒ अश्व॑स्य॒ धारा॑: । अ॒र्वाङे॒तेन॑ स्तनयि॒त्नुनेह्य॒पो नि॑षि॒ञ्चन्नसु॑रः पि॒ता न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rarīdhvam ǀ prá ǀ pinvata ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀarvā́ṅ ǀ eténa ǀ stanayitnúnā ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ apáḥ ǀ ni-siñcán ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send down for us,Maruts, the rain from heaven; drops of the rainy charger descend; come downParjanya, sprinkling water by this thundering (cloud); you who are the sender of rain, our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि क्र॑न्द स्त॒नय॒ गर्भ॒मा धा॑ उद॒न्वता॒ परि॑ दीया॒ रथे॑न । दृतिं॒ सु क॑र्ष॒ विषि॑तं॒ न्य॑ञ्चं स॒मा भ॑वन्तू॒द्वतो॑ निपा॒दाः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ kranda ǀ stanáya ǀ gárbham ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ udan-vátā ǀ pári ǀ dīya ǀ ráthena ǀdṛ́tim ǀ sú ǀ karṣa ǀ ví-sitam ǀ nyáñcam ǀ samā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀ ni-pādā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cry aloud over (the earth); thunder; impregnate the plural nts; traverse (the sky) with your water-laden chariot, draw open the tight-fastened, downward-turned water bag, and may the high and low plural ces be made level.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हान्तं॒ कोश॒मुद॑चा॒ नि षि॑ञ्च॒ स्यन्द॑न्तां कु॒ल्या विषि॑ताः पु॒रस्ता॑त् । घृ॒तेन॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी व्यु॑न्धि सुप्रपा॒णं भ॑वत्व॒घ्न्याभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́ntam ǀ kóśam ǀ út ǀ aca ǀ ní ǀ siñca ǀ syándantām ǀ kulyā́ḥ ǀ ví-sitāḥ ǀ purástāt ǀghṛténa ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ví ǀ undhi ǀ su-prapānám ǀ bhavatu ǀ aghnyā́bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Raise on high the mighty sheath (of rain), pour down (its contents); let the rivers flow unimpeded to the east; saturate with water both heaven and earth, and let there be abundant beverage for the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्प॑र्जन्य॒ कनि॑क्रदत्स्त॒नय॒न्हंसि॑ दु॒ष्कृत॑: । प्रती॒दं विश्वं॑ मोदते॒ यत्किं च॑ पृथि॒व्यामधि॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ parjanya ǀ kánikradat ǀ stanáyan ǀ háṃsi ǀ duḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀpráti ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ modate ǀ yát ǀ kím ǀ ca ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ádhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Parjanya, sounding loud and thundering, you destroy the wicked (clouds), this whole (world) rejoices, and all that is upon the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑र्षीर्व॒र्षमुदु॒ षू गृ॑भा॒याक॒र्धन्वा॒न्यत्ये॑त॒वा उ॑ । अजी॑जन॒ ओष॑धी॒र्भोज॑नाय॒ कमु॒त प्र॒जाभ्यो॑ऽविदो मनी॒षाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ávarṣīḥ ǀ varṣám ǀ út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ ákaḥ ǀ dhánvāni ǀ áti-etavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀájījanaḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ bhójanāya ǀ kám ǀ utá ǀ pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ avidaḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have rained; now check well the rain; you have made the deserts capable of being crossed; you have given birth to plural ns for (man's) enjoyment; verily you have obtained laudation from the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बळि॒त्था पर्व॑तानां खि॒द्रं बि॑भर्षि पृथिवि । प्र या भूमिं॑ प्रवत्वति म॒ह्ना जि॒नोषि॑ महिनि
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ itthā́ ǀ párvatānām ǀ khidrám ǀ bibharṣi ǀ pṛthivi ǀprá ǀ yā́ ǀ bhū́mim ǀ pravatvati ǀ mahnā́ ǀ jinóṣi ǀ mahini ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily you sustain here,Pṛthivi, the fracture of the mountains; mighty and most excellent, you are she who delight the earth by your greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तोमा॑सस्त्वा विचारिणि॒ प्रति॑ ष्टोभन्त्य॒क्तुभि॑: । प्र या वाजं॒ न हेष॑न्तं पे॒रुमस्य॑स्यर्जुनि
shlokas.transliteration: stómāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vi-cāriṇi ǀ práti ǀ stobhanti ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ yā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ná ǀ héṣantam ǀ perúm ǀ ásyasi ǀ arjuni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wanderer in various ways your worshippers hymn you with (sacred) songs; you who, bright-hued, tosses the swollen (cloud) like a neighing horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दृ॒ळ्हा चि॒द्या वन॒स्पती॑न्क्ष्म॒या दर्ध॒र्ष्योज॑सा । यत्ते॑ अ॒भ्रस्य॑ वि॒द्युतो॑ दि॒वो वर्ष॑न्ति वृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ yā́ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ kṣmayā́ ǀ dárdharṣi ǀ ójasā ǀyát ǀ te ǀ abhrásya ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ várṣanti ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who, with solid earth, sustain by your strength the forest lords, when the showers of your cloud fall from the shining sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒म्राजे॑ बृ॒हद॑र्चा गभी॒रं ब्रह्म॑ प्रि॒यं वरु॑णाय श्रु॒ताय॑ । वि यो ज॒घान॑ शमि॒तेव॒ चर्मो॑प॒स्तिरे॑ पृथि॒वीं सूर्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sam-rā́je ǀ bṛhát ǀ arca ǀ gabhīrám ǀ bráhma ǀ priyám ǀ váruṇāya ǀ śrutā́ya ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ jaghā́na ǀ śamitā́-iva ǀ cárma ǀ upa-stíre ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ sū́ryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer a solemn, profound, and acceptable prayer to the imperial and renownedVaruṇa, who has spread the firmament as a bed for the sun, as the immolator (spreads) the skin of the victim.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वने॑षु॒ व्य१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षं ततान॒ वाज॒मर्व॑त्सु॒ पय॑ उ॒स्रिया॑सु । हृ॒त्सु क्रतुं॒ वरु॑णो अ॒प्स्व१॒॑ग्निं दि॒वि सूर्य॑मदधा॒त्सोम॒मद्रौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: váneṣu ǀ ví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ tatāna ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvat-su ǀ páyaḥ ǀ usríyāsu ǀhṛt-sú ǀ krátum ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ agním ǀ diví ǀ sū́ryam ǀ adadhāt ǀ sómam ǀ ádrau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has extended the firmament over the tops of the trees, has given strength to horses, milk to cows, determination to the heart; he has plural ced fire in the waters, the sun in heaven, theSomain the mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नी॒चीन॑बारं॒ वरु॑ण॒: कव॑न्धं॒ प्र स॑सर्ज॒ रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । तेन॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ राजा॒ यवं॒ न वृ॒ष्टिर्व्यु॑नत्ति॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: nīcī́na-bāram ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ kávandham ǀ prá ǀ sasarja ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antárikṣam ǀténa ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ yávam ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ ví ǀ unatti ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇahas set free the (water of the) downward opening cloud for the (benefit of the) heaven, the earth, and the firmament, thence is the monarch of all the world, watering the soil as the rain bedews the barley.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒नत्ति॒ भूमिं॑ पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां य॒दा दु॒ग्धं वरु॑णो॒ वष्ट्यादित् । सम॒भ्रेण॑ वसत॒ पर्व॑तासस्तविषी॒यन्त॑: श्रथयन्त वी॒राः
shlokas.transliteration: unátti ǀ bhū́mim ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ yadā́ ǀ dugdhám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ váṣṭi ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀsám ǀ abhréṇa ǀ vasata ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ taviṣī-yántaḥ ǀ śrathayanta ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇawaters earth, mid-air, and heaven, when he plural ases (to send forth) the milk (of the cloud); thereupon the mountains cloth (their summits) withthe rain-cloud, and the hero, (Maruts), exulting in their strength, compel (the clouds) to relax.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मामू॒ ष्वा॑सु॒रस्य॑ श्रु॒तस्य॑ म॒हीं मा॒यां वरु॑णस्य॒ प्र वो॑चम् । माने॑नेव तस्थि॒वाँ अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ वि यो म॒मे पृ॑थि॒वीं सूर्ये॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ āsurásya ǀ śrutásya ǀ mahī́m ǀ māyā́m ǀ váruṇasya ǀ prá ǀ vocam ǀmā́nena-iva ǀ tasthi-vā́n ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ mamé ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I proclaim this great device of the renownedVaruṇa, the destroyer of theAsuras, who, abiding in the mid-heaven, has meted the firmament by the sun, as if by a measure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मामू॒ नु क॒वित॑मस्य मा॒यां म॒हीं दे॒वस्य॒ नकि॒रा द॑धर्ष । एकं॒ यदु॒द्ना न पृ॒णन्त्येनी॑रासि॒ञ्चन्ती॑र॒वन॑यः समु॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ kaví-tamasya ǀ māyā́m ǀ mahī́m ǀ devásya ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣa ǀékam ǀ yát ǀ udnā́ ǀ ná ǀ pṛṇánti ǀ énīḥ ǀ ā-siñcántīḥ ǀ avánayaḥ ǀ samudrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one has counteracted the device of the most sagacious divinity, whereby the lucid water-shedding rivers do not fill the ocean with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्य॒म्यं॑ वरुण मि॒त्र्यं॑ वा॒ सखा॑यं वा॒ सद॒मिद्भ्रात॑रं वा । वे॒शं वा॒ नित्यं॑ वरु॒णार॑णं वा॒ यत्सी॒माग॑श्चकृ॒मा शि॒श्रथ॒स्तत्
shlokas.transliteration: aryamyám ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitryám ǀ vā ǀ sákhāyam ǀ vā ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ bhrā́taram ǀ vā ǀveśám ǀ vā ǀ nítyam ǀ varuṇa ǀ áraṇam ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ sīm ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ śiśráthaḥ ǀ tát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If,Varuṇa, we have ever committed an offence against a benefactor, a friend, a companion, a brother, a near neighbour, or, Varuṇa, a dumb man, remove it from us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कि॒त॒वासो॒ यद्रि॑रि॒पुर्न दी॒वि यद्वा॑ घा स॒त्यमु॒त यन्न वि॒द्म । सर्वा॒ ता वि ष्य॑ शिथि॒रेव॑ दे॒वाधा॑ ते स्याम वरुण प्रि॒यास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kitavā́saḥ ǀ yát ǀ riripúḥ ǀ ná ǀ dīví ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ satyám ǀ utá ǀ yát ǀ ná ǀ vidmá ǀsárvā ǀ tā́ ǀ ví ǀ sya ǀ śithirā́-iva ǀ deva ǀ ádha ǀ te ǀ syāma ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If, like gamesters, who cheat at plural y, (we commit offences) knowingly, or (those) of which we know not, do you divineVaruṇa, extricate us from them all, as if from loosened (bonds), so that we may be dear, Varuṇa, to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ यमव॑थ उ॒भा वाजे॑षु॒ मर्त्य॑म् । दृ॒ळ्हा चि॒त्स प्र भे॑दति द्यु॒म्ना वाणी॑रिव त्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ yám ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ ubhā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ mártyam ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ bhedati ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ vā́ṇīḥ-iva ǀ tritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, the mortal whom you both protect scatters the substantial treasures (of his enemies), asTrita(fonfutes) the words (of his opponents).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या पृत॑नासु दु॒ष्टरा॒ या वाजे॑षु श्र॒वाय्या॑ । या पञ्च॑ चर्ष॒णीर॒भी॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी ता ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ dustárā ǀ yā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ śravā́yyā ǀyā́ ǀ páñca ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ tā́ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the two,IndraandAgni, who are irresistible in conflicts, who are renowned in battles, who protect the five (classes of) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तयो॒रिदम॑व॒च्छव॑स्ति॒ग्मा दि॒द्युन्म॒घोनो॑: । प्रति॒ द्रुणा॒ गभ॑स्त्यो॒र्गवां॑ वृत्र॒घ्न एष॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: táyoḥ ǀ ít ǀ áma-vat ǀ śávaḥ ǀ tigmā́ ǀ didyút ǀ maghónoḥ ǀpráti ǀ drúṇā ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ gávām ǀ vṛtra-ghné ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overpowering is the might of these two; the bright (lightning) is shining in thehandsofMaghavan, as they go toether in one chariot for the (recovery of the) cows and the destruction ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वा॒मेषे॒ रथा॑नामिन्द्रा॒ग्नी ह॑वामहे । पती॑ तु॒रस्य॒ राध॑सो वि॒द्वांसा॒ गिर्व॑णस्तमा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ éṣe ǀ ráthānām ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ havāmahe ǀpátī íti ǀ turásya ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ vidvā́ṃsā ǀ gírvaṇaḥ-tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you both,IndraandAgni, for (sending) your chariots to the combat, lords of moveable wealth, all-knowing, most deserving of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वृ॒धन्ता॒वनु॒ द्यून्मर्ता॑य दे॒वाव॒दभा॑ । अर्ह॑न्ता चित्पु॒रो द॒धेंऽशे॑व दे॒वावर्व॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vṛdhántau ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ mártāya ǀ deváu ǀ adábhā ǀárhantā ǀ cit ǀ puráḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ áṃśā-iva ǀ deváu ǀ árvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I adore you, irresistible deities for (the sake of obtaining) horses; you who are increasing day by day like mortals, who are worthy of worship, like twoĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॒महा॑वि ह॒व्यं शू॒ष्यं॑ घृ॒तं न पू॒तमद्रि॑भिः । ता सू॒रिषु॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हद्र॒यिं गृ॒णत्सु॑ दिधृत॒मिषं॑ गृ॒णत्सु॑ दिधृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ indrāgní-bhyām ǀ áhāvi ǀ havyám ǀ śūṣyám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pūtám ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀtā́ ǀ sūríṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ rayím ǀ gṛṇát-su ǀ didhṛtam ǀ íṣam ǀ gṛṇát-su ǀ didhṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The invigorating oblation has been offered, like theSoma-juice expressed by the sounding stones; do you bestow food uponthe pious; great riches upon those who praise you; bestow food also upon those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ म॒हे म॒तयो॑ यन्तु॒ विष्ण॑वे म॒रुत्व॑ते गिरि॒जा ए॑व॒याम॑रुत् । प्र शर्धा॑य॒ प्रय॑ज्यवे सुखा॒दये॑ त॒वसे॑ भ॒न्ददि॑ष्टये॒ धुनि॑व्रताय॒ शव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ víṣṇave ǀ marútvate ǀ giri-jā́ḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀprá ǀ śárdhāya ǀ prá-yajyave ǀ su-khādáye ǀ taváse ǀ bhandát-iṣṭaye ǀ dhúni-vratāya ǀ śávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the voice-born praises of Evayāmarut reach you,Viṣṇu, attended by theMaruts; (may they reach) the strong, the adorable, the brilliantly-adorned, the vigorous, praise-loving, cloud-scattering, quick-moving company of the Maruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये जा॒ता म॑हि॒ना ये च॒ नु स्व॒यं प्र वि॒द्मना॑ ब्रु॒वत॑ एव॒याम॑रुत् । क्रत्वा॒ तद्वो॑ मरुतो॒ नाधृषे॒ शवो॑ दा॒ना म॒ह्ना तदे॑षा॒मधृ॑ष्टासो॒ नाद्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ nú ǀ svayám ǀ prá ǀ vidmánā ǀ bruváte ǀ evayā́marut ǀkrátvā ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ śávaḥ ǀ dānā́ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ tát ǀ eṣām ǀ ádhṛṣṭāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Evayāmarut glorifies those who are manifested with the great (Indra), who appear spontaneously and speedily with the knowledge (that the sacrifice is prepared); your strength in action,Maruts, is not to be resisted, (though qualified) by (your) infinite liberality; you are immoveable as mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तः शृ॑ण्वि॒रे गि॒रा सु॒शुक्वा॑नः सु॒भ्व॑ एव॒याम॑रुत् । न येषा॒मिरी॑ स॒धस्थ॒ ईष्ट॒ आँ अ॒ग्नयो॒ न स्ववि॑द्युत॒: प्र स्य॒न्द्रासो॒ धुनी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ śṛṇviré ǀ girā́ ǀ su-śúkvānaḥ ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀná ǀ yéṣām ǀ írī ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ī́ṣṭe ǀ ā́ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ svá-vidyutaḥ ǀ prá ǀ syandrā́saḥ ǀ dhúnīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Evayāmarut, glorifies with praise those who, (coming) brilliant and happy from the vast heaven, hear (his invocation); in whose dwelling there is no one able to disturb them, and who, like self-radiant fires, are the impellers of the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स च॑क्रमे मह॒तो निरु॑रुक्र॒मः स॑मा॒नस्मा॒त्सद॑स एव॒याम॑रुत् । य॒दायु॑क्त॒ त्मना॒ स्वादधि॒ ष्णुभि॒र्विष्प॑र्धसो॒ विम॑हसो॒ जिगा॑ति॒ शेवृ॑धो॒ नृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ cakrame ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ uru-kramáḥ ǀ samānásmāt ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀyadā́ ǀ áyukta ǀ tmánā ǀ svā́t ǀ ádhi ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ ví-spardhasaḥ ǀ ví-mahasaḥ ǀ jígāti ǀ śé-vṛdhaḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That wide-spreading troop (ofMaruts) has issued from a spacious common dwelling-plural ce, (where) evayāmarut (awaits them) when their car has been spontaneously harnessed with its rapid horses; and, emulous, vigorous, and conferring happiness, they sally forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒नो न वोऽम॑वान्रेजय॒द्वृषा॑ त्वे॒षो य॒यिस्त॑वि॒ष ए॑व॒याम॑रुत् । येना॒ सह॑न्त ऋ॒ञ्जत॒ स्वरो॑चिष॒: स्थार॑श्मानो हिर॒ण्यया॑: स्वायु॒धास॑ इ॒ष्मिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: svanáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vaḥ ǀ áma-vān ǀ rejayat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ yayíḥ ǀ taviṣáḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀyéna ǀ sáhantaḥ ǀ ṛñjáta ǀ svá-rociṣaḥ ǀ sthā́ḥ-raśmānaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyāḥ ǀ su-āyudhā́saḥ ǀ iṣmíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the sound (of your approach,Maruts), which is mighty, the announcer of rain,t he shedder of light, diffusive, loud, alarm Evayāmarut; that sound wherewith, overcoming (your foes), you who are self-irradiating, lasting-rayed, ornamented with golden oranaments, self-weaponed, bestowing food, accomplish your functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पा॒रो वो॑ महि॒मा वृ॑द्धशवसस्त्वे॒षं शवो॑ऽवत्वेव॒याम॑रुत् । स्थाता॑रो॒ हि प्रसि॑तौ सं॒दृशि॒ स्थन॒ ते न॑ उरुष्यता नि॒दः शु॑शु॒क्वांसो॒ नाग्नय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: apāráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ vṛddha-śavasaḥ ǀ tveṣám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ avatu ǀ evayā́marut ǀsthā́tāraḥ ǀ hí ǀ prá-sitau ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ sthána ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyata ǀ nidáḥ ǀ śuśukvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ agnáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of vast strength, may your unbounded greatness, your brilliant vigour, protect Evayāmarut; for you are the regulators for overseeing (what is fit for) the limits of the sacrifice; preserve us from those who revile us, you, who are like blazing fires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते रु॒द्रास॒: सुम॑खा अ॒ग्नयो॑ यथा तुविद्यु॒म्ना अ॑वन्त्वेव॒याम॑रुत् । दी॒र्घं पृ॒थु प॑प्रथे॒ सद्म॒ पार्थि॑वं॒ येषा॒मज्मे॒ष्वा म॒हः शर्धां॒स्यद्भु॑तैनसाम्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ rudrā́saḥ ǀ sú-makhāḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ tuvi-dyumnā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǀ evayā́marut ǀdīrghám ǀ pṛthú ǀ paprathe ǀ sádma ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ yéṣām ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ śárdhāṃsi ǀ ádbhuta-enasām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thoseRudras, the objects of worship, like resplendent fires, protect Evayāmarut; they, whose ethereal dwelling, extended and wide, has been made illustrious (by them), and of whom, exempt from blame, the mighty energies (are manifested) in their courses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्वे॒षो नो॑ मरुतो गा॒तुमेत॑न॒ श्रोता॒ हवं॑ जरि॒तुरे॑व॒याम॑रुत् । विष्णो॑र्म॒हः स॑मन्यवो युयोतन॒ स्मद्र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ न दं॒सनाप॒ द्वेषां॑सि सनु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: adveṣáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ ā́ ǀ itana ǀ śróta ǀ hávam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀvíṣṇoḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ yuyotana ǀ smát ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ daṃsánā ǀ ápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ sanutáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, devoid of enmity, come to our proffered praise, hear the invocation of your adorer, Evayāmarut; do you, who are associated in the worship ofViṣṇudrive away, as warriors (scatter their enemies), our secret foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गन्ता॑ नो य॒ज्ञं य॑ज्ञियाः सु॒शमि॒ श्रोता॒ हव॑मर॒क्ष ए॑व॒याम॑रुत् । ज्येष्ठा॑सो॒ न पर्व॑तासो॒ व्यो॑मनि यू॒यं तस्य॑ प्रचेतस॒: स्यात॑ दु॒र्धर्त॑वो नि॒दः
shlokas.transliteration: gánta ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ yajñiyāḥ ǀ su-śámi ǀ śróta ǀ hávam ǀ arakṣáḥ ǀ evayā́marut ǀjyéṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ví-omani ǀ yūyám ǀ tásya ǀ pra-cetasaḥ ǀ syā́ta ǀ duḥ-dhártavaḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableMarutscome to our sacrifice, so that it may be prosperous; hear, undeterred byrākṣasas, the invocation of Evayāmarut; abiding like lofty mountains in mid-heaven, do you, who are profoundly wise, be ever intolerant of the reviler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्य॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो म॒नोता॒स्या धि॒यो अभ॑वो दस्म॒ होता॑ । त्वं सीं॑ वृषन्नकृणोर्दु॒ष्टरी॑तु॒ सहो॒ विश्व॑स्मै॒ सह॑से॒ सह॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ manótā ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ ábhavaḥ ǀ dasma ǀ hótā ǀtvám ǀ sīm ǀ vṛṣan ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ dustárītu ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ sáhase ǀ sáhadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YouAgni, are the first of the gods; a deity to whom their minds are devoted; plural asing of aspect, you are the invoker of the deities at this rite; showerer (of benefits), bestow upon us unsurpassable strength, where with to sustain all (hostile) prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ होता॒ न्य॑सीदो॒ यजी॑यानि॒ळस्प॒द इ॒षय॒न्नीड्य॒: सन् । तं त्वा॒ नर॑: प्रथ॒मं दे॑व॒यन्तो॑ म॒हो रा॒ये चि॒तय॑न्तो॒ अनु॑ ग्मन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ asīdaḥ ǀ yájīyān ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ padé ǀ iṣáyan ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ sán ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ náraḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ citáyantaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offerer of the oblation, frequent celebrator of sacrifice, now sit down on the foot-m ark of Iḷā, accepting the (sacrirficial) food, and being glorified; devout men, expectant of great riches, have recourse to you as to the first (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒तेव॒ यन्तं॑ ब॒हुभि॑र्वस॒व्यै॒३॒॑स्त्वे र॒यिं जा॑गृ॒वांसो॒ अनु॑ ग्मन् । रुश॑न्तम॒ग्निं द॑र्श॒तं बृ॒हन्तं॑ व॒पाव॑न्तं वि॒श्वहा॑ दीदि॒वांस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛtā́-iva ǀ yántam ǀ bahú-bhiḥ ǀ vasavyáiḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ rayím ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀrúśantam ǀ agním ǀ darśatám ǀ bṛhántam ǀ vapā́-vantam ǀ viśváhā ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who are assiduous in (worshipping) you for riches follow you, going with manyVasusby the path (of the firmament); you, the radiantAgni, of goodly aspect, mighty, fed with burnt-offerings, and blazing every day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒दं दे॒वस्य॒ नम॑सा॒ व्यन्त॑: श्रव॒स्यव॒: श्रव॑ आप॒न्नमृ॑क्तम् । नामा॑नि चिद्दधिरे य॒ज्ञिया॑नि भ॒द्रायां॑ ते रणयन्त॒ संदृ॑ष्टौ
shlokas.transliteration: padám ǀ devásya ǀ námasā ǀ vyántaḥ ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ āpan ǀ ámṛktam ǀnā́māni ǀ cit ǀ dadhire ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ bhadrā́yām ǀ te ǀ raṇayanta ǀ sám-dṛṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men desirous of food obtain abundance unopposed when repairing to the station of the divinity with oblations; and when delighting,Agni, in your auspicious presence, they repeat those your names which are to be uttered at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां व॑र्धन्ति क्षि॒तय॑: पृथि॒व्यां त्वां राय॑ उ॒भया॑सो॒ जना॑नाम् । त्वं त्रा॒ता त॑रणे॒ चेत्यो॑ भूः पि॒ता मा॒ता सद॒मिन्मानु॑षाणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ vardhanti ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ tvā́m ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀtvám ǀ trātā́ ǀ taraṇe ǀ cétyaḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men exalt you upon earth; they exalt you for both kinds of affluence, (cattle and treasure, which you bestow upon) men; you who extricate (us from evil) are to be known as our preserver, as the unfailing father and mother of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प॒र्येण्य॒: स प्रि॒यो वि॒क्ष्व१॒॑ग्निर्होता॑ म॒न्द्रो नि ष॑सादा॒ यजी॑यान् । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं दम॒ आ दी॑दि॒वांस॒मुप॑ ज्ञु॒बाधो॒ नम॑सा सदेम
shlokas.transliteration: saparyéṇyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ní ǀ sasāda ǀ yájīyān ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ dīdi-vā́ṃsam ǀ úpa ǀ jñu-bā́dhaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ sadema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is adorable, affectionate, the offerer of oblations among men, the giver of delight, the celebrator of worship, has sat down (upon the altar); let us approach you, kindled in our dwellings, on bended knees, with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं सु॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ नव्य॑मग्ने सुम्ना॒यव॑ ईमहे देव॒यन्त॑: । त्वं विशो॑ अनयो॒ दीद्या॑नो दि॒वो अ॑ग्ने बृह॒ता रो॑च॒नेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ su-dhyáḥ ǀ návyam ǀ agne ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀtvám ǀ víśaḥ ǀ anayaḥ ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ agne ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ rocanéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Intelligent, hoping for happiness, and devout, we glorify you, adorableAgni; do you, shining with exceeding lustre, lead men to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शां क॒विं वि॒श्पतिं॒ शश्व॑तीनां नि॒तोश॑नं वृष॒भं च॑र्षणी॒नाम् । प्रेती॑षणिमि॒षय॑न्तं पाव॒कं राज॑न्तम॒ग्निं य॑ज॒तं र॑यी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ kavím ǀ viśpátim ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ ni-tóśanam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀpréti-iṣaṇim ǀ iṣáyantam ǀ pāvakám ǀ rā́jantam ǀ agním ǀ yajatám ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We glorify) the lord of men of ever-existing men; the wise, the destroyer (of foes) the showerer (of benefits) on mankind, the moving, the bestower of food, the purifier, the resplendent,Agni, who is worshipped for (the sake of) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॑ग्न ईजे शश॒मे च॒ मर्तो॒ यस्त॒ आन॑ट् स॒मिधा॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिम् । य आहु॑तिं॒ परि॒ वेदा॒ नमो॑भि॒र्विश्वेत्स वा॒मा द॑धते॒ त्वोत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ īje ǀ śaśamé ǀ ca ǀ mártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ havyá-dātim ǀyáḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ pári ǀ veda ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ vāmā́ ǀ dadhate ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man,Agni, who worships you, who praises you, who offers oblations to you with kindled fuel, who presents burnt-offerings to you with prostrations, he verily, protected by you, obtains all desired wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा उ॑ ते॒ महि॑ म॒हे वि॑धेम॒ नमो॑भिरग्ने स॒मिधो॒त ह॒व्यैः । वेदी॑ सूनो सहसो गी॒र्भिरु॒क्थैरा ते॑ भ॒द्रायां॑ सुम॒तौ य॑तेम
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ máhi ǀ mahé ǀ vidhema ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ utá ǀ havyáiḥ ǀvédī ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ bhadrā́yām ǀ su-matáu ǀ yatema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you, mightyAgni, we offer exceeding adoration with prostrations, with fuel, with oblations; (we glorify you) on the altar, son of strength, with hymns and with prayers; may we be successful in our efforts (to gain) you auspicious favour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्त॒तन्थ॒ रोद॑सी॒ वि भा॒सा श्रवो॑भिश्च श्रव॒स्य१॒॑स्तरु॑त्रः । बृ॒हद्भि॒र्वाजै॒: स्थवि॑रेभिर॒स्मे रे॒वद्भि॑रग्ने वित॒रं वि भा॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ tatántha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śravasyáḥ ǀ tárutraḥ ǀbṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ sthávirebhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ revát-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, who have spread heaven and earth with light, who are the preserver (of man), and (who are) to be glorified with praises, shine brightly upon us with abundant food, and with substantial riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒वद्व॑सो॒ सद॒मिद्धे॑ह्य॒स्मे भूरि॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय प॒श्वः । पू॒र्वीरिषो॑ बृह॒तीरा॒रेअ॑घा अ॒स्मे भ॒द्रा सौ॑श्रव॒सानि॑ सन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-vát ǀ vaso íti ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhū́ri ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ paśváḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ āré-aghāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ sauśravasā́ni ǀ santu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessor of wealth, bestow upon us at all times opulence conjoined with dependants, and (grant) abundance of cattle to our sons and grandsons; may therefore be to us abundant food, satisfying our wishes, and free from blame; and may there be auspicious and reputable (means of subsistence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रूण्य॑ग्ने पुरु॒धा त्वा॒या वसू॑नि राजन्व॒सुता॑ ते अश्याम् । पु॒रूणि॒ हि त्वे पु॑रुवार॒ सन्त्यग्ने॒ वसु॑ विध॒ते राज॑नि॒ त्वे
shlokas.transliteration: purū́ṇi ǀ agne ǀ purudhā́ ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ rājan ǀ vasútā ǀ te ǀ aśyām ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ puru-vāra ǀ sánti ǀ ágne ǀ vásu ǀ vidhaté ǀ rā́jani ǀ tvé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalAgni, may I obtain from you your many and various treasures whereby to be enriched; for, Agni, who are the desired of multitudes, infinite are the riches (aggregated) in you, fit, monarch, for your worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि क्षैत॑व॒द्यशोऽग्ने॑ मि॒त्रो न पत्य॑से । त्वं वि॑चर्षणे॒ श्रवो॒ वसो॑ पु॒ष्टिं न पु॑ष्यसि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ kṣáita-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátyase ǀtvám ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ná ǀ puṣyasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alight,Agni, likeMitra, upon the oblation offered with the dry fuel; therefore, beholder of all, possessor of riches, you cherish us with food and nourishment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां हि ष्मा॑ चर्ष॒णयो॑ य॒ज्ञेभि॑र्गी॒र्भिरीळ॑ते । त्वां वा॒जी या॑त्यवृ॒को र॑ज॒स्तूर्वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀtvā́m ǀ vājī́ ǀ yāti ǀ avṛkáḥ ǀ rajaḥ-tū́ḥ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men verily worship you with sacrifice and with praises; the inoffensive sun, the sender of rain, the beholder of the universe, proceeds to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जोष॑स्त्वा दि॒वो नरो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुमि॑न्धते । यद्ध॒ स्य मानु॑षो॒ जन॑: सुम्ना॒युर्जु॒ह्वे अ॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jóṣaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ diváḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ indhate ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ syáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ sumna-yúḥ ǀ juhvé ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerers of praise, sympathizing in satisfaction, kindle you the banner of the sacrifice, when man, the descendant ofManu, desiring happiness, invokes you to the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋध॒द्यस्ते॑ सु॒दान॑वे धि॒या मर्त॑: श॒शम॑ते । ऊ॒ती ष बृ॑ह॒तो दि॒वो द्वि॒षो अंहो॒ न त॑रति
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́dhat ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ śaśámate ǀūtī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tarati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the mortal prosper who propitiates you (his) benefactor, by holy rites; through the protection of you who are resplendent, he overcomes those who hate him, as if they were mortal sins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मिधा॒ यस्त॒ आहु॑तिं॒ निशि॑तिं॒ मर्त्यो॒ नश॑त् । व॒याव॑न्तं॒ स पु॑ष्यति॒ क्षय॑मग्ने श॒तायु॑षम्
shlokas.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ ní-śitim ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ náśat ǀvayā́-vantam ǀ sáḥ ǀ puṣyati ǀ kṣáyam ǀ agne ǀ śatá-āyuṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal who feeds your consecrated burnt offering with fuel enjoys,Agni, a dwelling peopled with descendants, and a life of a hundred years.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षस्ते॑ धू॒म ऋ॑ण्वति दि॒वि षञ्छु॒क्र आत॑तः । सूरो॒ न हि द्यु॒ता त्वं कृ॒पा पा॑वक॒ रोच॑से
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣáḥ ǀ te ǀ dhūmáḥ ǀ ṛṇvati ǀ diví ǀ sán ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ā́-tataḥ ǀsū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ dyutā́ ǀ tvám ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ pāvaka ǀ rócase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure smoke of you the resplendent spreads through the firmament, matures (in clouds), and you, the purifier, shine with radiance like the sun, when propitiated by praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ हि वि॒क्ष्वीड्योऽसि॑ प्रि॒यो नो॒ अति॑थिः । र॒ण्वः पु॒री॑व॒ जूर्य॑: सू॒नुर्न त्र॑य॒याय्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ vikṣú ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ ási ǀ priyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀraṇváḥ ǀ purí-iva ǀ jū́ryaḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ trayayā́yyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are now to be praised among the people, for you are our well beloved guest, venerated like an elder in the city, and to be cherished like a son.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॒ हि द्रोणे॑ अ॒ज्यसेऽग्ने॑ वा॒जी न कृत्व्य॑: । परि॑ज्मेव स्व॒धा गयोऽत्यो॒ न ह्वा॒र्यः शिशु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ hí ǀ dróṇe ǀ ajyáse ǀ ágne ǀ vājī́ ǀ ná ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǀpárijmā-iva ǀ svadhā́ ǀ gáyaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hvāryáḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are manifested in the timber,Agni, by the act of attrition; you are the bearer (of the oblation) as a horse (is of his rider); you are like the circumsambient wind; you are food and dwelling; you are like a (newborn) babe, and variable (in movement) as a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं त्या चि॒दच्यु॒ताग्ने॑ प॒शुर्न यव॑से । धामा॑ ह॒ यत्ते॑ अजर॒ वना॑ वृ॒श्चन्ति॒ शिक्व॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyā́ ǀ cit ǀ ácyutā ǀ ágne ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀdhā́ma ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ajara ǀ vánā ǀ vṛścánti ǀ śíkvasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You consumeAgni, the unfallen (trees) as an animal (feeds) upon pasture, when, undecaying deity, the flames of you who are resplendent shear the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेषि॒ ह्य॑ध्वरीय॒तामग्ने॒ होता॒ दमे॑ वि॒शाम् । स॒मृधो॑ विश्पते कृणु जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यम॑ङ्गिरः
shlokas.transliteration: véṣi ǀ hí ǀ adhvari-yatā́m ǀ ágne ǀ hótā ǀ dáme ǀ viśā́m ǀsam-ṛ́dhaḥ ǀ viśpate ǀ kṛṇu ǀ juṣásva ǀ havyám ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You enter as the ministrant priest into the habitations of men who wish to perform sacrifice; render them prosperous, benefactor of mankind; be propitiated,aṅgiras, by the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ नो मित्रमहो देव दे॒वानग्ने॒ वोच॑: सुम॒तिं रोद॑स्योः । वी॒हि स्व॒स्तिं सु॑क्षि॒तिं दि॒वो नॄन्द्वि॒षो अंहां॑सि दुरि॒ता त॑रेम॒ ता त॑रेम॒ तवाव॑सा तरेम
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ ágne ǀ vócaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvīhí ǀ svastím ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, reverenced as a friend, who are abiding in heaven and earth, communicate our praise to the gods; conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity; and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome those (sins of a prior existence); may we overcome them by your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ स क्षे॑षदृत॒पा ऋ॑ते॒जा उ॒रु ज्योति॑र्नशते देव॒युष्टे॑ । यं त्वं मि॒त्रेण॒ वरु॑णः स॒जोषा॒ देव॒ पासि॒ त्यज॑सा॒ मर्त॒मंह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣeṣat ǀ ṛta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛte-jā́ḥ ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ naśate ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ te ǀyám ǀ tvám ǀ mitréṇa ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ déva ǀ pā́si ǀ tyájasā ǀ mártam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerer of sacrifice, born for religious rites, who lives devoted,Agni, to you, obtains abundant light, and is a man whom you, sympathizing in satisfaction withMitraandVaruṇa, protect by your shield from iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒जे य॒ज्ञेभि॑: शश॒मे शमी॑भिॠ॒धद्वा॑राया॒ग्नये॑ ददाश । ए॒वा च॒न तं य॒शसा॒मजु॑ष्टि॒र्नांहो॒ मर्तं॑ नशते॒ न प्रदृ॑प्तिः
shlokas.transliteration: ījé ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ śaśamé ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ ṛdhát-vārāya ǀ agnáye ǀ dadāśa ǀevá ǀ caná ǀ tám ǀ yaśásām ǀ ájuṣṭiḥ ǀ ná ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ mártam ǀ naśate ǀ ná ǀ prá-dṛptiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has presented (oblations) toAgni, the possessor of desired (wealth), sacrifices with (all) sacrifices, and is sanctified by (all) holy acts; him, the wand of excellent (posterity) does not afflict, nor does sin or pride affect a mortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूरो॒ न यस्य॑ दृश॒तिर॑रे॒पा भी॒मा यदेति॑ शुच॒तस्त॒ आ धीः । हेष॑स्वतः शु॒रुधो॒ नायम॒क्तोः कुत्रा॑ चिद्र॒ण्वो व॑स॒तिर्व॑ने॒जाः
shlokas.transliteration: sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ dṛśatíḥ ǀ arepā́ḥ ǀ bhīmā́ ǀ yát ǀ éti ǀ śucatáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀhéṣasvataḥ ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ayám ǀ aktóḥ ǀ kútra ǀ cit ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ vasatíḥ ǀ vane-jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the fearful flames of you, whose appearance is (as) faultless as (that of) the sun, spread on every side as (if they were) the lowing heifers of the night, then thisAgni, the asylum of all, genitive rated in the woods, is everywhere beautiful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒ग्मं चि॒देम॒ महि॒ वर्पो॑ अस्य॒ भस॒दश्वो॒ न य॑मसा॒न आ॒सा । वि॒जेह॑मानः पर॒शुर्न जि॒ह्वां द्र॒विर्न द्रा॑वयति॒ दारु॒ धक्ष॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tigmám ǀ cit ǀ éma ǀ máhi ǀ várpaḥ ǀ asya ǀ bhásat ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yamasānáḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀvi-jéhamānaḥ ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ jihvā́m ǀ dravíḥ ǀ ná ǀ dravayati ǀ dā́ru ǀ dhákṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sharp is his path, and his vast body shines like a horse champing fodder with his mouth, darting forth his tongue like a hatchet, and burning timber toashes, like a goldsmith who fuses (metal).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इदस्ते॑व॒ प्रति॑ धादसि॒ष्यञ्छिशी॑त॒ तेजोऽय॑सो॒ न धारा॑म् । चि॒त्रध्र॑जतिरर॒तिर्यो अ॒क्तोर्वेर्न द्रु॒षद्वा॑ रघु॒पत्म॑जंहाः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ástā-iva ǀ práti ǀ dhāt ǀ asiṣyán ǀ śíśīta ǀ téjaḥ ǀ áyasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhā́rām ǀcitrá-dhrajatiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aktóḥ ǀ véḥ ǀ ná ǀ dru-sádvā ǀ raghupátma-jaṃhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He casts (afar his flames) as an archer (his arrows), and sharpens when about to dart his radiance, as (a warrior whets) the edge of his metal (weapons), he who, variously moving, passes through the night, like the light-falling foot of a bird perched upon a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॑ रे॒भो न प्रति॑ वस्त उ॒स्राः शो॒चिषा॑ रारपीति मि॒त्रम॑हाः । नक्तं॒ य ई॑मरु॒षो यो दिवा॒ नॄनम॑र्त्यो अरु॒षो यो दिवा॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ rebháḥ ǀ ná ǀ práti ǀ vaste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ rarapīti ǀ mitrá-mahāḥ ǀnáktam ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dívā ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dívā ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like the adorable sun, he clothes himself with brilliant (rays); diffusing friendly light, he crackles with (his fame); (he it is) who is luminous by night, and who lights men (to their work) by day; who is immortal and radiant; who lights men by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न यस्य॑ विध॒तो नवी॑नो॒द्वृषा॑ रु॒क्ष ओष॑धीषु नूनोत् । घृणा॒ न यो ध्रज॑सा॒ पत्म॑ना॒ यन्ना रोद॑सी॒ वसु॑ना॒ दं सु॒पत्नी॑
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ návīnot ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ rukṣáḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ nūnot ǀghṛ́ṇā ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhrájasā ǀ pátmanā ǀ yán ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vásunā ǀ dám ǀ supátnī íti su-pátnī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom a sound is heard when scattering his rays like (that) of the sun; the brilliant showerer (of benefits) clamours among the (burning) plural nts; he who, moving not with a shifting, variable motion, but, humbling (our foes), fills the well-wedded earth and heaven with wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धायो॑भिर्वा॒ यो युज्ये॑भिर॒र्कैर्वि॒द्युन्न द॑विद्यो॒त्स्वेभि॒: शुष्मै॑: । शर्धो॑ वा॒ यो म॒रुतां॑ त॒तक्ष॑ ऋ॒भुर्न त्वे॒षो र॑भसा॒नो अ॑द्यौत्
shlokas.transliteration: dhā́yaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yújyebhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ vi-dyút ǀ ná ǀ davidyot ǀ svébhiḥ ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀśárdhaḥ ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ marútām ǀ tatákṣa ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ rabhasānáḥ ǀ adyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who (goes) with sacred (rays), as if with self-harnessed, well-governed (steeds), who shines like lightning with his own scorching (flames), who impairs the vigour of theMaruts, he glows radiant and rapid as the wide-shining sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ होत॒र्मनु॑षो दे॒वता॑ता य॒ज्ञेभि॑: सूनो सहसो॒ यजा॑सि । ए॒वा नो॑ अ॒द्य स॑म॒ना स॑मा॒नानु॒शन्न॑ग्न उश॒तो य॑क्षि दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ hotaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yájāsi ǀevá ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ samanā́ ǀ samānā́n ǀ uśán ǀ agne ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength, invoker (of the gods), in like manner as at the worship of the gods byManu, you did offer worship with sacrifice; so now,Agni, with willing mind, worship for us the assenting deities, regarding them as your equals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ वि॒भावा॑ च॒क्षणि॒र्न वस्तो॑र॒ग्निर्व॒न्दारु॒ वेद्य॒श्चनो॑ धात् । वि॒श्वायु॒र्यो अ॒मृतो॒ मर्त्ये॑षूष॒र्भुद्भूदति॑थिर्जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ cakṣáṇiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vástoḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vandā́ru ǀ védyaḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀviśvá-āyuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ uṣaḥ-bhút ǀ bhū́t ǀ átithiḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgni, who, like the illuminator of the day, is resplendent and cognizable (by all), gran us commendable food; he who is the life of all, immortal, who knows all that exists, who is our guest, waking among men at dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावो॒ न यस्य॑ प॒नय॒न्त्यभ्वं॒ भासां॑सि वस्ते॒ सूर्यो॒ न शु॒क्रः । वि य इ॒नोत्य॒जर॑: पाव॒कोऽश्न॑स्य चिच्छिश्नथत्पू॒र्व्याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ panáyanti ǀ ábhvam ǀ bhā́sāṃsi ǀ vaste ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukráḥ ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ inóti ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ áśnasya ǀ cit ǀ śiśnathat ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose great deeds his worshipers now celebrate, who is clothed with light, radiant as the sun, exempt from decay, the purifier, he illumes (all things), and destroys the ancient cities of the dispersed (evil beings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒द्मा हि सू॑नो॒ अस्य॑द्म॒सद्वा॑ च॒क्रे अ॒ग्निर्ज॒नुषाज्मान्न॑म् । स त्वं न॑ ऊर्जसन॒ ऊर्जं॑ धा॒ राजे॑व जेरवृ॒के क्षे॑ष्य॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: vadmā́ ǀ hí ǀ sūno íti ǀ ási ǀ adma-sádvā ǀ cakré ǀ agníḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ ájma ǀ ánnam ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrja-sane ǀ ū́rjam ǀ dhāḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ jeḥ ǀ avṛké ǀ kṣeṣi ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sons of strength, you are to be praised;Agni, sitting upon the (sacrificial) viands, has given (to his worshippers), from their birth, habitation and food giver of strength, bestow strength upon us; triumph like a prize, so that you may abide in our unassailed (dwelling).”

shlokas.sanskrit: निति॑क्ति॒ यो वा॑र॒णमन्न॒मत्ति॑ वा॒युर्न राष्ट्र्यत्ये॑त्य॒क्तून् । तु॒र्याम॒ यस्त॑ आ॒दिशा॒मरा॑ती॒रत्यो॒ न ह्रुत॒: पत॑तः परि॒ह्रुत्
shlokas.transliteration: ní-tikti ǀ yáḥ ǀ vāraṇám ǀ ánnam ǀ átti ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́ṣṭrī ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ aktū́n ǀturyā́ma ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā-díśām ǀ árātīḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hrútaḥ ǀ pátataḥ ǀ pari-hrút ǁ
