shlokas.meaning_en: “He who whets his (gloom) dispersing (radiance), who eats the (offered) oblation, a soverign likevāyu, overcomes the nights; may we prevail (over him) who is not a donor of the oblations that are due; (Agni), to you, and do you, (swift) as a horse be the destroyer of the foes assailing (us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सूर्यो॒ न भा॑नु॒मद्भि॑र॒र्कैरग्ने॑ त॒तन्थ॒ रोद॑सी॒ वि भा॒सा । चि॒त्रो न॑य॒त्परि॒ तमां॑स्य॒क्तः शो॒चिषा॒ पत्म॑न्नौशि॒जो न दीय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānumát-bhiḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ ágne ǀ tatántha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ bhāsā́ ǀcitráḥ ǀ nayat ǀ pári ǀ támāṃsi ǀ aktáḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ pátman ǀ auśijáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dī́yan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You over spread,Agni, heaven and earth with radiance, like the sun with his lustrous rays; the wonderful Agni disperses the glooms like the adored (sun) moving on his path, imbued with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां हि म॒न्द्रत॑ममर्कशो॒कैर्व॑वृ॒महे॒ महि॑ न॒: श्रोष्य॑ग्ने । इन्द्रं॒ न त्वा॒ शव॑सा दे॒वता॑ वा॒युं पृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑सा॒ नृत॑माः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ mandrá-tamam ǀ arka-śokáiḥ ǀ vavṛmáhe ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ śróṣi ǀ agne ǀíndram ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ śávasā ǀ devátā ǀ vāyúm ǀ pṛṇanti ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ nṛ́-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We celebrate you, who are most adorable, with sacred praises; hear,Agni, our laudation; the leaders (of rites) earnestly honour you with offerings, you, who are divine likeIndra, and likevāyuin strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ अग्नेऽवृ॒केभि॑: स्व॒स्ति वेषि॑ रा॒यः प॒थिभि॒: पर्ष्यंह॑: । ता सू॒रिभ्यो॑ गृण॒ते रा॑सि सु॒म्नं मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avṛkébhiḥ ǀ svastí ǀ véṣi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ párṣi ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ rāsi ǀ sumnám ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly conduct us,Agni, by unmolested paths, to riches and prosperity; (convey us) beyond sin; those delights which you give to your adorers (extend) to him who (now) glorifies you, and may we, living for a hundred winters, and blessed with excellent posterity, be happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हु॒वे व॑: सू॒नुं सह॑सो॒ युवा॑न॒मद्रो॑घवाचं म॒तिभि॒र्यवि॑ष्ठम् । य इन्व॑ति॒ द्रवि॑णानि॒ प्रचे॑ता वि॒श्ववा॑राणि पुरु॒वारो॑ अ॒ध्रुक्
shlokas.transliteration: huvé ǀ vaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ yúvānam ǀ ádrogha-vācam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀyáḥ ǀ ínvati ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ viśvá-vārāṇi ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ adhrúk ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you,Agni, the son of strength, the youthful, the irreproachable, the very young; you who are wise, the sought of many, the merciful, who bestows treasures acceptable to all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे वसू॑नि पुर्वणीक होतर्दो॒षा वस्तो॒रेरि॑रे य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । क्षामे॑व॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ यस्मि॒न्त्सं सौभ॑गानि दधि॒रे पा॑व॒के
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀkṣā́ma-iva ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yásmin ǀ sám ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ dadhiré ǀ pāvaké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright blazingAgni, invoker of the gods, to you the adorable deities have appropriated, by night and day, the riches (on the oblation); they have deposited in the purifer (Agni) all good things (agnau vāmamvasusam nyadadhata:TaittirīyaSaṃhitā1.5.1.1), as they have plural ced all beings upon earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं वि॒क्षु प्र॒दिव॑: सीद आ॒सु क्रत्वा॑ र॒थीर॑भवो॒ वार्या॑णाम् । अत॑ इनोषि विध॒ते चि॑कित्वो॒ व्या॑नु॒षग्जा॑तवेदो॒ वसू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ vikṣú ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sīdaḥ ǀ āsú ǀ krátvā ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀátaḥ ǀ inoṣi ǀ vidhaté ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānuṣák ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ vásūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, abide from of old in these people, and by your deeds have been (to them) the conveyer of good things; thence, sagejātavedas, you bestow continually wealth upon the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॒: सनु॑त्यो अभि॒दास॑दग्ने॒ यो अन्त॑रो मित्रमहो वनु॒ष्यात् । तम॒जरे॑भि॒र्वृष॑भि॒स्तव॒ स्वैस्तपा॑ तपिष्ठ॒ तप॑सा॒ तप॑स्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sánutyaḥ ǀ abhi-dā́sat ǀ agne ǀ yáḥ ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ vanuṣyā́t ǀtám ǀ ajárebhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ sváiḥ ǀ tápa ǀ tapiṣṭha ǀ tápasā ǀ tápasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, protector of (your) friends, who are most resplendent, blazing with radiance, consume with your own imperishable flames him who injures us abiding in secret, or when near to us design us harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ स॒मिधा॒ य उ॒क्थैर॒र्केभि॑: सूनो सहसो॒ ददा॑शत् । स मर्त्ये॑ष्वमृत॒ प्रचे॑ता रा॒या द्यु॒म्नेन॒ श्रव॑सा॒ वि भा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ yajñéna ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ arkébhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ dádāśat ǀsáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ amṛta ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ dyumnéna ǀ śrávasā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who propitiates you, son of strenght, with sacrifice, with fuel, with prayers, with praises, shines immortal amongst men, eminent in wisdom and possessed of splendid opulence and (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तत्कृ॑धीषि॒तस्तूय॑मग्ने॒ स्पृधो॑ बाधस्व॒ सह॑सा॒ सह॑स्वान् । यच्छ॒स्यसे॒ द्युभि॑र॒क्तो वचो॑भि॒स्तज्जु॑षस्व जरि॒तुर्घोषि॒ मन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tát ǀ kṛdhi ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ agne ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ bādhasva ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhasvān ǀyát ǀ śasyáse ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ aktáḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ tát ǀ juṣasva ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ ghóṣi ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accomplish quickly,Agni, that for which you are solicited; endowed with strength, oppose by strength our adversaries; be plural ased, you are anointed with radiance, by loud vociferation of your worshipper, by whom you are adored with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒श्याम॒ तं काम॑मग्ने॒ तवो॒ती अ॒श्याम॑ र॒यिं र॑यिवः सु॒वीर॑म् । अ॒श्याम॒ वाज॑म॒भि वा॒जय॑न्तो॒ऽश्याम॑ द्यु॒म्नम॑जरा॒जरं॑ ते
shlokas.transliteration: aśyā́ma ǀ tám ǀ kā́mam ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtī́ ǀ aśyā́ma ǀ rayím ǀ rayi-vaḥ ǀ su-vī́ram ǀaśyā́ma ǀ vā́jam ǀ abhí ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ aśyā́ma ǀ dyumnám ǀ ajara ǀ ajáram ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain through your protection,Agni, that which we desire; giver of riches, may we obtain of your riches and descendants; desiring food, may we obtain food; may we obtain, imperishable Agni, imperishable fame (through you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नव्य॑सा॒ सह॑सः सू॒नुमच्छा॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ गा॒तुमव॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नः । वृ॒श्चद्व॑नं कृ॒ष्णया॑मं॒ रुश॑न्तं वी॒ती होता॑रं दि॒व्यं जि॑गाति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ návyasā ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ áccha ǀ yajñéna ǀ gātúm ǀ ávaḥ ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀvṛścát-vanam ǀ kṛṣṇáyāmam ǀ rúśantam ǀ vītī́ ǀ hótāram ǀ divyám ǀ jigāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is desirous of food has recourse with a new sacrifice, approachable son of strength (Agni), to you the consumer of forests, the dark-pathed, the bright shining, the ministrant (to the gods) of (sacrificial) food, the divine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स श्वि॑ता॒नस्त॑न्य॒तू रो॑चन॒स्था अ॒जरे॑भि॒र्नान॑दद्भि॒र्यवि॑ष्ठः । यः पा॑व॒कः पु॑रु॒तम॑: पु॒रूणि॑ पृ॒थून्य॒ग्निर॑नु॒याति॒ भर्व॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ śvitānáḥ ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ rocana-sthā́ḥ ǀ ajárebhiḥ ǀ nā́nadat-bhiḥ ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ puru-támaḥ ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ pṛthū́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ anu-yā́ti ǀ bhárvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You who are) white-hued, vociferous, abiding in the firmament, (associated) with the imperishable, resounding (winds), the youngest (of the gods),Agni, who, purifying and most vast, proceeds, feeding upon numerous and substantial (forests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ते॒ विष्व॒ग्वात॑जूतासो अग्ने॒ भामा॑सः शुचे॒ शुच॑यश्चरन्ति । तु॒वि॒म्र॒क्षासो॑ दि॒व्या नव॑ग्वा॒ वना॑ वनन्ति धृष॒ता रु॒जन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ te ǀ víṣvak ǀ vā́ta-jūtāsaḥ ǀ agne ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ śuce ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ caranti ǀtuvi-mrakṣā́saḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ vánā ǀ vananti ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ rujántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PureAgni, your bright flames, fanned by the wind, spread wide in every diection, consuming abundant (fuel); divine, fresh-rising, they plural y upon the woods, enveloping them in lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॑ शु॒क्रास॒: शुच॑यः शुचिष्म॒: क्षां वप॑न्ति॒ विषि॑तासो॒ अश्वा॑: । अध॑ भ्र॒मस्त॑ उर्वि॒या वि भा॑ति या॒तय॑मानो॒ अधि॒ सानु॒ पृश्ने॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ śuciṣmaḥ ǀ kṣā́m ǀ vápanti ǀ ví-sitāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀádha ǀ bhramáḥ ǀ te ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ yātáyamānaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nu ǀ pṛ́śneḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, your bright rays, horses let loose (from the rein), shear the earth; your (band of flame), mounting above the high-lands of the many-tinted (earth), blazes fiercely.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ जि॒ह्वा पा॑पतीति॒ प्र वृष्णो॑ गोषु॒युधो॒ नाशनि॑: सृजा॒ना । शूर॑स्येव॒ प्रसि॑तिः क्षा॒तिर॒ग्नेर्दु॒र्वर्तु॑र्भी॒मो द॑यते॒ वना॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ jihvā́ ǀ pāpatīti ǀ prá ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ goṣu-yúdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ aśániḥ ǀ sṛjānā́ ǀśū́rasya-iva ǀ prá-sitiḥ ǀ kṣātíḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ duḥ-vártuḥ ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vánāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flame of the showerer (Agni), repeatedly descends like the hurled thunderbolt of the rescuer of the cattle; like the prowess of a hero is the destroying (energy) of Agni; irresistible and fearful, he consumes the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भा॒नुना॒ पार्थि॑वानि॒ ज्रयां॑सि म॒हस्तो॒दस्य॑ धृष॒ता त॑तन्थ । स बा॑ध॒स्वाप॑ भ॒या सहो॑भि॒: स्पृधो॑ वनु॒ष्यन्व॒नुषो॒ नि जू॑र्व
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ maháḥ ǀ todásya ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ tatantha ǀsáḥ ǀ bādhasva ǀ ápa ǀ bhayā́ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ vanuṣyán ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ jūrva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You overspread the accessible plural ces of the earth with light by the energy of you powerful, exciting (influence); do you disperse all perils, and, baffing (our) adversaries by your mighty (powers), destroy (our) foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स चि॑त्र चि॒त्रं चि॒तय॑न्तम॒स्मे चित्र॑क्षत्र चि॒त्रत॑मं वयो॒धाम् । च॒न्द्रं र॒यिं पु॑रु॒वीरं॑ बृ॒हन्तं॒ चन्द्र॑ च॒न्द्राभि॑र्गृण॒ते यु॑वस्व
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ citra ǀ citrám ǀ citáyantam ǀ asmé íti ǀ cítra-kṣatra ǀ citrá-tamam ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́m ǀcandrám ǀ rayím ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ bṛhántam ǀ cándra ǀ candrā́bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ yuvasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WonderfulAgni, of wonderful strength, bestower of delight, grant to us, and to him who praises you with gratifying (praises), wonderful, most wonderful riches, conferring fame, supplying food, comprehendingmaledescendants,d electable and infinite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् । क॒विं स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: mūrdhā́nam ǀ diváḥ ǀ aratím ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ ṛté ǀ ā́ ǀ jātám ǀ agním ǀkavím ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ átithim ǀ jánānām ǀ āsán ǀ ā́ ǀ pā́tram ǀ janayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have genitive rated vaśvānaraAgni, as the brow of heaven, the unceasing pervader of earth, born for (the celebration of) sacrifice, wise, imperial, the guest of men, in whose mouth (is) the vessel (that conveys the oblation to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाभिं॑ य॒ज्ञानां॒ सद॑नं रयी॒णां म॒हामा॑हा॒वम॒भि सं न॑वन्त । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रं र॒थ्य॑मध्व॒राणां॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुं ज॑नयन्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: nā́bhim ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ sádanam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ mahā́m ǀ ā-hāvám ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ navanta ǀvaiśvānarám ǀ rathyám ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ janayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The worshippers) glorify together, (Agni), the bond of sacrifices, the abode of riches, the great receptacle of burnt-offerings; the gods genitive rate vaśvānara, the conveyer of oblations, the emblem of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्विप्रो॑ जायते वा॒ज्य॑ग्ने॒ त्वद्वी॒रासो॑ अभिमाति॒षाह॑: । वैश्वा॑नर॒ त्वम॒स्मासु॑ धेहि॒ वसू॑नि राजन्त्स्पृह॒याय्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ vípraḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ vājī́ ǀ agne ǀ tvát ǀ vīrā́saḥ ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀváiśvānara ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhehi ǀ vásūni ǀ rājan ǀ spṛhayā́yyāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The offerer of (sacrificial) food becomes wise,Agni, from you heroes become the vanquishers of foes; therefore, do you, royalvaiśvānara, bestow upon us enviable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां विश्वे॑ अमृत॒ जाय॑मानं॒ शिशुं॒ न दे॒वा अ॒भि सं न॑वन्ते । तव॒ क्रतु॑भिरमृत॒त्वमा॑य॒न्वैश्वा॑नर॒ यत्पि॒त्रोरदी॑देः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ víśve ǀ amṛta ǀ jā́yamānam ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ navante ǀtáva ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ āyan ǀ váiśvānara ǀ yát ǀ pitróḥ ǀ ádīdeḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the worshippers together praise you, immortal,Agni, when born like an infant; when you shinevaiśvānara, between the parental (heaven and earth) they obtain immortality through your (sacred) rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वैश्वा॑नर॒ तव॒ तानि॑ व्र॒तानि॑ म॒हान्य॑ग्ने॒ नकि॒रा द॑धर्ष । यज्जाय॑मानः पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थेऽवि॑न्दः के॒तुं व॒युने॒ष्वह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: váiśvānara ǀ táva ǀ tā́ni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ mahā́ni ǀ agne ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣa ǀyát ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ávindaḥ ǀ ketúm ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,vaiśvānara, these your mighty deeds no one can resist; when born on the lap of your parents, you have stationed the banner of the days on the paths of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॒ विमि॑तानि॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ सानू॑नि दि॒वो अ॒मृत॑स्य के॒तुना॑ । तस्येदु॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॒नाधि॑ मू॒र्धनि॑ व॒या इ॑व रुरुहुः स॒प्त वि॒स्रुह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vaiśvānarásya ǀ ví-mitāni ǀ cákṣasā ǀ sā́nūni ǀ diváḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ ketúnā ǀtásya ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ádhi ǀ mūrdháni ǀ vayā́ḥ-iva ǀ ruruhuḥ ǀ saptá ǀ vi-srúhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The summits of the firmament are measured by the light ofvaiśvānara, the manifester of ambrosial (rain); all the regions are overspread (by the vapour) on his brow, and the seven gliding (streams) spring from thence like branches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यो रजां॒स्यमि॑मीत सु॒क्रतु॑र्वैश्वान॒रो वि दि॒वो रो॑च॒ना क॒विः । परि॒ यो विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि पप्र॒थेऽद॑ब्धो गो॒पा अ॒मृत॑स्य रक्षि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ ámimīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ ví ǀ diváḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀpári ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ paprathé ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ rakṣitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vaiśvānara, the performer of sacred acts, is he who made the regions; foreseeing (he has made) the luminaries of heaven, and has spread throughout all worlds; the irresistibel guardian (of all), the protector of ambrosial (rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒क्षस्य॒ वृष्णो॑ अरु॒षस्य॒ नू सह॒: प्र नु वो॑चं वि॒दथा॑ जा॒तवे॑दसः । वै॒श्वा॒न॒राय॑ म॒तिर्नव्य॑सी॒ शुचि॒: सोम॑ इव पवते॒ चारु॑र॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: pṛkṣásya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ aruṣásya ǀ nú ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ vocam ǀ vidáthā ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǀvaiśvānarā́ya ǀ matíḥ ǀ návyasī ǀ śúciḥ ǀ sómaḥ-iva ǀ pavate ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I commemorate promptly at the holy ceremony the might of the all-pervading jātavaedasa, the showerer, the radiant; new, pure, and graceful praise issues (from me) like thesomajuice (from the filter), toAgnivaiśvānara.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जाय॑मानः पर॒मे व्यो॑मनि व्र॒तान्य॒ग्निर्व्र॑त॒पा अ॑रक्षत । व्य१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षममिमीत सु॒क्रतु॑र्वैश्वान॒रो म॑हि॒ना नाक॑मस्पृशत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀ vratā́ni ǀ agníḥ ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ arakṣata ǀví ǀ antárikṣam ǀ amimīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ nā́kam ǀ aspṛśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatAgniwho, as soon as born in the highest heaven, the protector of sacred rites, protects the pious acts (of men), he has made he manifold firmament;vaiśvānara, the performer of good deeds, has attained heaven by his greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑स्तभ्ना॒द्रोद॑सी मि॒त्रो अद्भु॑तोऽन्त॒र्वाव॑दकृणो॒ज्ज्योति॑षा॒ तम॑: । वि चर्म॑णीव धि॒षणे॑ अवर्तयद्वैश्वान॒रो विश्व॑मधत्त॒ वृष्ण्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ astabhnāt ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ antaḥ-vā́vat ǀ akṛṇot ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀví ǀ cármaṇī ivéti cármaṇī-iva ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ avartayat ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ adhatta ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The friend (of all), the wonderful (agni), has upheld heaven and earth; he has hidden darkness within light; he has spread out the two sustaining (worlds, heaven and earth), like two skins;vaiśvānaracomprehends all (creaive) energy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षा अ॑गृभ्णत॒ विशो॒ राजा॑न॒मुप॑ तस्थुॠ॒ग्मिय॑म् । आ दू॒तो अ॒ग्निम॑भरद्वि॒वस्व॑तो वैश्वान॒रं मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǀ víśaḥ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ úpa ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ agním ǀ abharat ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightymarutshave seized upon him on the lap of the waters (in firmament), and men have acknowledged him as their adorable sovereign;mātariśvan, the messenger of the gods, has broughtAgnivaiśvānara(hither) from the distant (sphere of the) sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒गेयु॑गे विद॒थ्यं॑ गृ॒णद्भ्योऽग्ने॑ र॒यिं य॒शसं॑ धेहि॒ नव्य॑सीम् । प॒व्येव॑ राजन्न॒घशं॑समजर नी॒चा नि वृ॑श्च व॒निनं॒ न तेज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: yugé-yuge ǀ vidathyám ǀ gṛṇát-bhyaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ rayím ǀ yaśásam ǀ dhehi ǀ návyasīm ǀpavyā́-iva ǀ rājan ǀ aghá-śaṃsam ǀ ajara ǀ nīcā́ ǀ ní ǀ vṛśca ǀ vanínam ǀ ná ǀ téjasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To those,Agni, who repeat new (praises) to you, the object of their worship from age to age, grant riches and famous (posterity); strike don, undecaying, sovereign, the sinner with your blaze like the thunderbolt, as if he were a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मग्ने म॒घव॑त्सु धार॒याना॑मि क्ष॒त्रम॒जरं॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म् । व॒यं ज॑येम श॒तिनं॑ सह॒स्रिणं॒ वैश्वा॑नर॒ वाज॑मग्ने॒ तवो॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ agne ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhāraya ǀ ánāmi ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ajáram ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀvayám ǀ jayema ǀ śatínam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ váiśvānara ǀ vā́jam ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Agni, to us who are affluent in (offerings), wealth that cannot be taken away, that is exempt from decay, and that comprehends excellentmaledescendants may we obtain, Agnivaiśvānara, hundreds and thousands of viands through your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑ब्धेभि॒स्तव॑ गो॒पाभि॑रिष्टे॒ऽस्माकं॑ पाहि त्रिषधस्थ सू॒रीन् । रक्षा॑ च नो द॒दुषां॒ शर्धो॑ अग्ने॒ वैश्वा॑नर॒ प्र च॑ तारी॒: स्तवा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ádabdhebhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ gopā́bhiḥ ǀ iṣṭe ǀ asmā́kam ǀ pāhi ǀ tri-sadhastha ǀ sūrī́n ǀrákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dadúṣām ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ váiśvānara ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ tārīḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdoredAgni, present in thethree worlds, protect your worshippers with your irresistible protections, preserve the strength of us who offer (oblations); glorified (by us), Agnivaiśvānara, transport us (beyond evil).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॑श्च कृ॒ष्णमह॒रर्जु॑नं च॒ वि व॑र्तेते॒ रज॑सी वे॒द्याभि॑: । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो जाय॑मानो॒ न राजावा॑तिर॒ज्ज्योति॑षा॒ग्निस्तमां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: áhaḥ ǀ ca ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ áhaḥ ǀ árjunam ǀ ca ǀ ví ǀ vartete íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ vedyā́bhiḥ ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jā ǀ áva ǀ atirat ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ agníḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dark day and the light day revolve alternate, affecting (the world) by their recognizable (properties);Agnivaiśvānara, manifested like a prince, dispels darkness by his lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाहं तन्तुं॒ न वि जा॑ना॒म्योतुं॒ न यं वय॑न्ति सम॒रेऽत॑मानाः । कस्य॑ स्वित्पु॒त्र इ॒ह वक्त्वा॑नि प॒रो व॑दा॒त्यव॑रेण पि॒त्रा
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ahám ǀ tántum ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ jānāmi ǀ ótum ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ váyanti ǀ sam-aré ǀ átamānāḥ ǀkásya ǀ svit ǀ putráḥ ǀ ihá ǀ váktvāni ǀ paráḥ ǀ vadāti ǀ ávareṇa ǀ pitrā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I understand not the threads (of the warp), nor the threads of the woof, nor that (cloth) which those who are assiduous in united exertion weave; of what (man) may the son declare the words that are to be spoken in the next world, (instrumental ucted) by a father abiding below.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इत्तन्तुं॒ स वि जा॑ना॒त्योतुं॒ स वक्त्वा॑न्यृतु॒था व॑दाति । य ईं॒ चिके॑तद॒मृत॑स्य गो॒पा अ॒वश्चर॑न्प॒रो अ॒न्येन॒ पश्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ tántum ǀ sáḥ ǀ ví ǀ jānāti ǀ ótum ǀ sáḥ ǀ váktvāni ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ vadāti ǀyáḥ ǀ īm ǀ cíketat ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ aváḥ ǀ cáran ǀ paráḥ ǀ anyéna ǀ páśyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily knows the threads of the warp and or the woof, he speaks in due season what is to be said, who comprehends all this (universe); who is the protector of ambrosial water, sojourning both above and below, and contemplating (the world) under a different (manifestation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं होता॑ प्रथ॒मः पश्य॑ते॒ममि॒दं ज्योति॑र॒मृतं॒ मर्त्ये॑षु । अ॒यं स ज॑ज्ञे ध्रु॒व आ निष॒त्तोऽम॑र्त्यस्त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ वर्ध॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ hótā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ páśyata ǀ imám ǀ idám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ mártyeṣu ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ jajñe ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-sattaḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thisvaiśvānarais the first offerer of burnt offerings; behold him; this is the light immortal among mortals; he has been born in a bodily shape, immoveable, all-pervading, immortal, ever increasing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ध्रु॒वं ज्योति॒र्निहि॑तं दृ॒शये॒ कं मनो॒ जवि॑ष्ठं प॒तय॑त्स्व॒न्तः । विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः सम॑नस॒: सके॑ता॒ एकं॒ क्रतु॑म॒भि वि य॑न्ति सा॒धु
shlokas.transliteration: dhruvám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ní-hitam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ kám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jáviṣṭham ǀ patáyat-su ǀ antáríti ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ sá-ketāḥ ǀ ékam ǀ krátum ǀ abhí ǀ ví ǀ yānti ǀ sādhú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A steady light, swifter than thought, stationed among moving beings to show (the way) to happiness all the gods being of one mind, and of like wisdom, proceed respectfully to the presence of the one (chief) agent (vaiśvānara).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि मे॒ कर्णा॑ पतयतो॒ वि चक्षु॒र्वी॒३॒॑दं ज्योति॒र्हृद॑य॒ आहि॑तं॒ यत् । वि मे॒ मन॑श्चरति दू॒रआ॑धी॒: किं स्वि॑द्व॒क्ष्यामि॒ किमु॒ नू म॑निष्ये
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ me ǀ kárṇā ǀ patayataḥ ǀ ví ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ ví ǀ idám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ hṛ́daye ǀ ā́-hitam ǀ yát ǀví ǀ me ǀ mánaḥ ǀ carati ǀ dūré-ādhīḥ ǀ kím ǀ svit ǀ vakṣyā́mi ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ maniṣye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My ears are turned (to hear him), my eyes (to behold him); this light that is plural ced in the heart (seeks to know him); my mind, the receptable of distant (objects) hastens (towards him); what shall I declare him? How shall I comprehend him?”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॑नमस्यन्भिया॒नास्त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ तम॑सि तस्थि॒वांस॑म् । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो॑ऽवतू॒तये॒ नोऽम॑र्त्योऽवतू॒तये॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ anamasyan ǀ bhiyānā́ḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ támasi ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ avatu ǀ ūtáye ǀ naḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ avatu ǀ ūtáye ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the gods, alarmed, venerate you,Agni, abiding in darkness; mayvaiśvānarapreserve us with his protection; may the immortal Agni preserve us with his protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो वो॑ म॒न्द्रं दि॒व्यं सु॑वृ॒क्तिं प्र॑य॒ति य॒ज्ञे अ॒ग्निम॑ध्व॒रे द॑धिध्वम् । पु॒र उ॒क्थेभि॒: स हि नो॑ वि॒भावा॑ स्वध्व॒रा क॑रति जा॒तवे॑दाः
shlokas.transliteration: puráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mandrám ǀ divyám ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ pra-yatí ǀ yajñé ǀ agním ǀ adhvaré ǀ dadhidhvam ǀpuráḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ karati ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural ce before you at the progressive, uninterrupted sacrifice, the divine, adorable, perfectAgni, with prayers; for he, the resplendentjātavedas, makes us prosperous in sacred rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ द्युमः पुर्वणीक होत॒रग्ने॑ अ॒ग्निभि॒र्मनु॑ष इधा॒नः । स्तोमं॒ यम॑स्मै म॒मते॑व शू॒षं घृ॒तं न शुचि॑ म॒तय॑: पवन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dyu-maḥ ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀstómam ǀ yám ǀ asmai ǀ mamátā-iva ǀ śūṣám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ śúci ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ pavante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant, may-rayedAgni, invoker of the gods, kindled with many fires, (hear) this (praise) of men; which delightful praise, pure as the clarified butter (that has been filtered), his worshippers offer unto him asmamatā(formerly offered it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पी॒पाय॒ स श्रव॑सा॒ मर्त्ये॑षु॒ यो अ॒ग्नये॑ द॒दाश॒ विप्र॑ उ॒क्थैः । चि॒त्राभि॒स्तमू॒तिभि॑श्चि॒त्रशो॑चिर्व्र॒जस्य॑ सा॒ता गोम॑तो दधाति
shlokas.transliteration: pīpā́ya ǀ sáḥ ǀ śrávasā ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ yáḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ dadā́śa ǀ vípraḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀcitrā́bhiḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ citrá-śociḥ ǀ vrajásya ǀ sātā́ ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ dadhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He thrives in abundance among men, who, pious, presents toAgni(oblations) with prayers; the wonderfully radian Agni plural ces him with marvellous protection in the enjoyment of pasturage full of herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यः प॒प्रौ जाय॑मान उ॒र्वी दू॑रे॒दृशा॑ भा॒सा कृ॒ष्णाध्वा॑ । अध॑ ब॒हु चि॒त्तम॒ ऊर्म्या॑यास्ति॒रः शो॒चिषा॑ ददृशे पाव॒कः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ papráu ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ dūre-dṛ́śā ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ kṛṣṇá-adhvā ǀádha ǀ bahú ǀ cit ǀ támaḥ ǀ ū́rmyāyāḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ dadṛśe ǀ pāvakáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dark-pathed, as soon as genitive rated, filled with his afar-seen light the two spacious (worlds); he, the purifer, is now beheld dispersing with his radiance the thick glooms of night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू न॑श्चि॒त्रं पु॑रु॒वाजा॑भिरू॒ती अग्ने॑ र॒यिं म॒घव॑द्भ्यश्च धेहि । ये राध॑सा॒ श्रव॑सा॒ चात्य॒न्यान्त्सु॒वीर्ये॑भिश्चा॒भि सन्ति॒ जना॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ citrám ǀ puru-vā́jābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ágne ǀ rayím ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhehi ǀyé ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ anyā́n ǀ su-vī́ryebhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ jánān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow quickly,Agni, upon us who are affluent (in oblations), wondrous wealth), with abundant viands and protections, such as enrich other men with wealth with food, and withmaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं चनो॑ धा अग्न उ॒शन्यं त॑ आसा॒नो जु॑हु॒ते ह॒विष्मा॑न् । भ॒रद्वा॑जेषु दधिषे सुवृ॒क्तिमवी॒र्वाज॑स्य॒ गध्य॑स्य सा॒तौ
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ agne ǀ uśán ǀ yám ǀ te ǀ āsānáḥ ǀ juhuté ǀ havíṣmān ǀbharát-vājeṣu ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ ávīḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gádhyasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnidesirous (of the offering), accept this sacrifice, this food which the presenter (of the oblation), sitting down (before you), offers unto you; accept the blameless (praises) of thebhāradvāja(race), and favour them that they may obtain many sorts of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि द्वेषां॑सीनु॒हि व॒र्धयेळां॒ मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ inuhí ǀ vardháya ǀ íḷām ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Scatter (our enemies); augment our abundance; and may we, blessed with virtuousmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज॑स्व होतरिषि॒तो यजी॑या॒नग्ने॒ बाधो॑ म॒रुतां॒ न प्रयु॑क्ति । आ नो॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ नास॑त्या॒ द्यावा॑ हो॒त्राय॑ पृथि॒वी व॑वृत्याः
shlokas.transliteration: yájasva ǀ hotaḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yájīyān ǀ ágne ǀ bā́dhaḥ ǀ marútām ǀ ná ǀ prá-yukti ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ nā́satyā ǀ dyā́vā ǀ hotrā́ya ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ vavṛtyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं होता॑ म॒न्द्रत॑मो नो अ॒ध्रुग॒न्तर्दे॒वो वि॒दथा॒ मर्त्ये॑षु । पा॒व॒कया॑ जु॒ह्वा॒३॒॑ वह्नि॑रा॒साग्ने॒ यज॑स्व त॒न्वं१॒॑ तव॒ स्वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hótā ǀ mandrá-tamaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adhrúk ǀ antáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ vidáthā ǀ márteṣu ǀpāvakáyā ǀ juhvā́ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ ágne ǀ yájasva ǀ tanvám ǀ táva ǀ svā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: धन्या॑ चि॒द्धि त्वे धि॒षणा॒ वष्टि॒ प्र दे॒वाञ्जन्म॑ गृण॒ते यज॑ध्यै । वेपि॑ष्ठो॒ अङ्गि॑रसां॒ यद्ध॒ विप्रो॒ मधु॑ च्छ॒न्दो भन॑ति रे॒भ इ॒ष्टौ
shlokas.transliteration: dhányā ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ váṣṭi ǀ prá ǀ devā́n ǀ jánma ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ yájadhyai ǀvépiṣṭhaḥ ǀ áṅgirasām ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vípraḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ chandáḥ ǀ bhánati ǀ rebháḥ ǀ iṣṭáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदि॑द्युत॒त्स्वपा॑को वि॒भावाग्ने॒ यज॑स्व॒ रोद॑सी उरू॒ची । आ॒युं न यं नम॑सा रा॒तह॑व्या अ॒ञ्जन्ति॑ सुप्र॒यसं॒ पञ्च॒ जना॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádidyutat ǀ sú ǀ ápākaḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ ágne ǀ yájasva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ urūcī́ íti ǀāyúm ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ námasā ǀ rātá-havyāḥ ǀ añjánti ǀ su-prayásam ǀ páñca ǀ jánāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ञ्जे ह॒ यन्नम॑सा ब॒र्हिर॒ग्नावया॑मि॒ स्रुग्घृ॒तव॑ती सुवृ॒क्तिः । अम्य॑क्षि॒ सद्म॒ सद॑ने पृथि॒व्या अश्रा॑यि य॒ज्ञः सूर्ये॒ न चक्षु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛñjé ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ námasā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ agnáu ǀ áyāmi ǀ srúk ǀ ghṛtá-vatī ǀ su-vṛktíḥ ǀámyakṣi ǀ sádma ǀ sádane ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ áśrāyi ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ ná ǀ cákṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒श॒स्या न॑: पुर्वणीक होतर्दे॒वेभि॑रग्ने अ॒ग्निभि॑रिधा॒नः । रा॒यः सू॑नो सहसो वावसा॒ना अति॑ स्रसेम वृ॒जनं॒ नांह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: daśasyá ǀ naḥ ǀ puru-anīka ǀ hotaḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vavasānā́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ srasema ǀ vṛjánam ǀ ná ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्ये॒ होता॑ दुरो॒णे ब॒र्हिषो॒ राळ॒ग्निस्तो॒दस्य॒ रोद॑सी॒ यज॑ध्यै । अ॒यं स सू॒नुः सह॑स ऋ॒तावा॑ दू॒रात्सूर्यो॒ न शो॒चिषा॑ ततान
shlokas.transliteration: mádhye ǀ hótā ǀ duroṇé ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ rā́ṭ ǀ agníḥ ǀ todásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yájadhyai ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ dūrā́t ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śocíṣā ǀ tatāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the invoker of the gods, the lord of sacrifice, abides in the dwelling of the instrumental tutor of the rite, to offer sacrifice to heaven and earth; he, the son of strength, the observer of truth, has overspread (the world) from afar, like the sun, with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्मि॒न्त्वे स्वपा॑के यजत्र॒ यक्ष॑द्राजन्त्स॒र्वता॑तेव॒ नु द्यौः । त्रि॒ष॒धस्थ॑स्तत॒रुषो॒ न जंहो॑ ह॒व्या म॒घानि॒ मानु॑षा॒ यज॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ tvé íti ǀ sú ǀ ápāke ǀ yajatra ǀ yákṣat ǀ rājan ǀ sarvátātā-iva ǀ nú ǀ dyáuḥ ǀtri-sadhásthaḥ ǀ tatarúṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jáṃhaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yájadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable and resplendentAgni, to whom, mature in wisdom, the worshipper offers oblations at every sacred rite, do you, who are present in the three (worlds), move with the speed of the traverser (of the sky, the sun), to convey the valuable oblations of men (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेजि॑ष्ठा॒ यस्या॑र॒तिर्व॑ने॒राट् तो॒दो अध्व॒न्न वृ॑धसा॒नो अ॑द्यौत् । अ॒द्रो॒घो न द्र॑वि॒ता चे॑तति॒ त्मन्नम॑र्त्योऽव॒र्त्र ओष॑धीषु
shlokas.transliteration: téjiṣṭhā ǀ yásya ǀ aratíḥ ǀ vane-rā́ṭ ǀ todáḥ ǀ ádhvan ǀ ná ǀ vṛdhasānáḥ ǀ adyaut ǀadrogháḥ ǀ ná ǀ dravitā́ ǀ cetati ǀ tmán ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ avartráḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, whose pure and spreading flame blazes in the forest, shines with increasing intensity, like the sun on his (celestial) path; rushing like the innoxious (wind) among the plural nts, immortal, unimpeded, he lights up (all things) by his own (lustre).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सास्माके॑भिरे॒तरी॒ न शू॒षैर॒ग्निः ष्ट॑वे॒ दम॒ आ जा॒तवे॑दाः । द्र्व॑न्नो व॒न्वन्क्रत्वा॒ नार्वो॒स्रः पि॒तेव॑ जार॒यायि॑ य॒ज्ञैः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ asmā́kebhiḥ ǀ etári ǀ ná ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ stave ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀdrú-annaḥ ǀ vanván ǀ krátvā ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǀ usráḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ jārayā́yi ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who knows all that exists, is propitiated in our dwelling by our praises, like those gratifying (commendations which proceed) from one soliciting (a favour); feeder upon trees, consumer of forests, impetuous in act as the bull, the (progenitor of calves), he is glorified by the celebration of sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्मास्य पनयन्ति॒ भासो॒ वृथा॒ यत्तक्ष॑दनु॒याति॑ पृ॒थ्वीम् । स॒द्यो यः स्य॒न्द्रो विषि॑तो॒ धवी॑यानृ॒णो न ता॒युरति॒ धन्वा॑ राट्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ asya ǀ panayanti ǀ bhā́saḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ yát ǀ tákṣat ǀ anu-yā́ti ǀ pṛthvī́m ǀsadyáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ syandráḥ ǀ ví-sitaḥ ǀ dhávīyān ǀ ṛṇáḥ ǀ ná ǀ tāyúḥ ǀ áti ǀ dhánva ǀ rā́ṭ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They glorify his flames in this world; when, easily thinning the woods, they spread over the earth; he, who glides along unarrested, and rapid in movement as a fast flying thief, shines over the desert.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं नो॑ अर्व॒न्निदा॑या॒ विश्वे॑भिरग्ने अ॒ग्निभि॑रिधा॒नः । वेषि॑ रा॒यो वि या॑सि दु॒च्छुना॒ मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ arvan ǀ nídāyāḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ idhānáḥ ǀvéṣi ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ yāsi ǀ ducchúnāḥ ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quick-movingAgni, kindled with all (your) fires, (guard) us from reproach; you bestow rices, you scattered adversaries; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्विश्वा॑ सुभग॒ सौभ॑गा॒न्यग्ने॒ वि य॑न्ति व॒निनो॒ न व॒याः । श्रु॒ष्टी र॒यिर्वाजो॑ वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ दि॒वो वृ॒ष्टिरीड्यो॑ री॒तिर॒पाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ víśvā ǀ su-bhaga ǀ sáubhagāni ǀ ágne ǀ ví ǀ yānti ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vayā́ḥ ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀ diváḥ ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ rītíḥ ǀ apā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AuspiciousAgni, all good things proceed from you like branches (from the trunk) of a tree, renowned rices, vigour for the destruction of foes, the rain of heaven; you are to be glorified the sender of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं भगो॑ न॒ आ हि रत्न॑मि॒षे परि॑ज्मेव क्षयसि द॒स्मव॑र्चाः । अग्ने॑ मि॒त्रो न बृ॑ह॒त ऋ॒तस्यासि॑ क्ष॒त्ता वा॒मस्य॑ देव॒ भूरे॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ rátnam ǀ iṣé ǀ párijmā-iva ǀ kṣayasi ǀ dasmá-varcāḥ ǀágne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ási ǀ kṣattā́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ deva ǀ bhū́reḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are adorable, bestow upon us precious wealth; beautiful with radiance, you pass (around) like the circumambient (wind); you, divineAgni, are likemitra, the giver of abundant water and ample wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सत्प॑ति॒: शव॑सा हन्ति वृ॒त्रमग्ने॒ विप्रो॒ वि प॒णेर्भ॑र्ति॒ वाज॑म् । यं त्वं प्र॑चेत ऋतजात रा॒या स॒जोषा॒ नप्त्रा॒पां हि॒नोषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ hanti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ agne ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ví ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ bharti ǀ vā́jam ǀyám ǀ tvám ǀ pra-cetaḥ ǀ ṛta-jāta ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ náptrā ǀ apā́m ǀ hinóṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That man, the protector of the virtuous, destroys,Agni, his enemy by his strength, and baffles, intelligent, the might of (theasura)paṇi, whom you, the wise, the parent of the sacrifice, consentient with the grandson of the waters, encourage (in the hope of) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ सूनो सहसो गी॒र्भिरु॒क्थैर्य॒ज्ञैर्मर्तो॒ निशि॑तिं वे॒द्यान॑ट् । विश्वं॒ स दे॑व॒ प्रति॒ वार॑मग्ने ध॒त्ते धा॒न्यं१॒॑ पत्य॑ते वस॒व्यै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ní-śitam ǀ vedyā́ ǀ ā́naṭ ǀvíśvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ deva ǀ práti ǀ vā́ram ǀ agne ǀ dhatté ǀ dhānyám ǀ pátyate ǀ vasavyáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal who by praise, by prayers, by sacrifices, attracts, son of strength, your heightened (radiance) to the altar, enjoys all-sufficiency and corn, and abounds in wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता नृभ्य॒ आ सौ॑श्रव॒सा सु॒वीराग्ने॑ सूनो सहसः पु॒ष्यसे॑ धाः । कृ॒णोषि॒ यच्छव॑सा॒ भूरि॑ प॒श्वो वयो॒ वृका॑या॒रये॒ जसु॑रये
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sauśravasā́ ǀ su-vī́rā ǀ ágne ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ puṣyáse ǀ dhāḥ ǀkṛṇóṣi ǀ yát ǀ śávasā ǀ bhū́ri ǀ paśváḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vṛ́kāya ǀ aráye ǀ jásuraye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant, son of strength, to men (who praise you), those abundant viands and excellent descendants, (that may contribute) to their prosperity; grant also that copious sustenance from cattle, which by your strength you take away from a churlish and malignant adversary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒द्मा सू॑नो सहसो नो॒ विहा॑या॒ अग्ने॑ तो॒कं तन॑यं वा॒जि नो॑ दाः । विश्वा॑भिर्गी॒र्भिर॒भि पू॒र्तिम॑श्यां॒ मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vadmā́ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ ágne ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ vājí ǀ naḥ ǀ dāḥ ǀvíśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pūrtím ǀ aśyām ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, do you who are mighty be our councillor; give us sons and grandsons, together with food; may I, by all my praises, obtain the fulfilment of my desires; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, enjoy happiness for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्ना यो मर्त्यो॒ दुवो॒ धियं॑ जु॒जोष॑ धी॒तिभि॑: । भस॒न्नु ष प्र पू॒र्व्य इषं॑ वुरी॒ताव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: agnā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ jujóṣa ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀbhásat ǀ nú ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ vurīta ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the mortal who propitiatesAgniby devotion and worship, together with praises, quickly become distinguished as first (among men), and acquire ample food for the support (of his children).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरिद्धि प्रचे॑ता अ॒ग्निर्वे॒धस्त॑म॒ ऋषि॑: । अ॒ग्निं होता॑रमीळते य॒ज्ञेषु॒ मनु॑षो॒ विश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vedháḥ-tamaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀagním ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniverily is most wise; he is the chief performer of religious rites, a holy sage; the progeny of men glorify Agni as the invoker of the gods at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाना॒ ह्य१॒॑ग्नेऽव॑से॒ स्पर्ध॑न्ते॒ रायो॑ अ॒र्यः । तूर्व॑न्तो॒ दस्यु॑मा॒यवो॑ व्र॒तैः सीक्ष॑न्तो अव्र॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: nā́nā ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ávase ǀ spárdhante ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀtū́rvantaḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ vratáiḥ ǀ sī́kṣantaḥ ǀ avratám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The manifold treasures of the enemy (detached from them) are emulous,Agni, for the preservation (of your worshippers); men who worship you, triumphing over the spoiler, seek to shame him who celebrates no sacred rite by (their) observances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर॒प्सामृ॑ती॒षहं॑ वी॒रं द॑दाति॒ सत्प॑तिम् । यस्य॒ त्रस॑न्ति॒ शव॑सः सं॒चक्षि॒ शत्र॑वो भि॒या
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ apsā́m ǀ ṛti-sáham ǀ vīrám ǀ dadāti ǀ sát-patim ǀyásya ǀ trásanti ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ sam-cákṣi ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ bhiyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnibestows (upon his worshippers) amaledescendant, (the performer of good) works, the subduer of foes, the protector of the virtuous, at whose appearance his enemies tremble through fear of his prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्हि वि॒द्मना॑ नि॒दो दे॒वो मर्त॑मुरु॒ष्यति॑ । स॒हावा॒ यस्यावृ॑तो र॒यिर्वाजे॒ष्ववृ॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hí ǀ vidmánā ǀ nidáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártam ǀ uruṣyáti ǀsahá-vā ǀ yásya ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty and divineAgni, endowed with knowledge, protects the mortal from reproach whose rich (offerings) are unobstructed (by evil spirits), and unshared by other (offerers) at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ नो मित्रमहो देव दे॒वानग्ने॒ वोच॑: सुम॒तिं रोद॑स्योः । वी॒हि स्व॒स्तिं सु॑क्षि॒तिं दि॒वो नॄन्द्वि॒षो अंहां॑सि दुरि॒ता त॑रेम॒ ता त॑रेम॒ तवाव॑सा तरेम
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ ágne ǀ vócaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvīhí ǀ svastím ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, revered as a friend, who, abiding in heaven and earth, communicates our praise to the gods, conduct the offerer of adoration to domestic felicity, and may we overcome our adversaries, our iniquities, our difficulties; may we overcome them by your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ममू॒ षु वो॒ अति॑थिमुष॒र्बुधं॒ विश्वा॑सां वि॒शां पति॑मृञ्जसे गि॒रा । वेतीद्दि॒वो ज॒नुषा॒ कच्चि॒दा शुचि॒र्ज्योक्चि॑दत्ति॒ गर्भो॒ यदच्यु॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ uṣaḥ-búdham ǀ víśvāsām ǀ viśā́m ǀ pátim ǀ ṛñjase ǀ girā́ ǀvéti ǀ ít ǀ diváḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ jyók ǀ cit ǀ atti ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ácyutam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiate by praises this guest who wakes at dawn, the cherisher of all people, who on every occasion descends, pure of origin, from heaven, and, present as the embryo (in the wood of attrition), consumes immediately the offered (oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रं न यं सुधि॑तं॒ भृग॑वो द॒धुर्वन॒स्पता॒वीड्य॑मू॒र्ध्वशो॑चिषम् । स त्वं सुप्री॑तो वी॒तह॑व्ये अद्भुत॒ प्रश॑स्तिभिर्महयसे दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: mitrám ǀ ná ǀ yám ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ vánaspátau ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ ūrdhvá-śociṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ sú-prītaḥ ǀ vītá-havye ǀ adbhuta ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ mahayase ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WonderfulAgni, whom, adorable and upward flaming, thebhṛgusregard as a friend, deposited in the wood of (attrition), be plural ased withvītahavya, since you are glorified by (his) praise everyday.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं दक्ष॑स्यावृ॒को वृ॒धो भू॑र॒र्यः पर॒स्यान्त॑रस्य॒ तरु॑षः । रा॒यः सू॑नो सहसो॒ मर्त्ये॒ष्वा छ॒र्दिर्य॑च्छ वी॒तह॑व्याय स॒प्रथो॑ भ॒रद्वा॑जाय स॒प्रथ॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ avṛkáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ párasya ǀ ántarasya ǀ táruṣaḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yaccha ǀ vītá-havyāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ bharát-vājāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are unresisted, become the benefactor of him who is skilled (in sacred rites), his defender against a near of distant enemy; son of strength, who are ever renowned, grant wealth and a dwelling tovītahavya, the offerer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यु॒ता॒नं वो॒ अति॑थिं॒ स्व॑र्णरम॒ग्निं होता॑रं॒ मनु॑षः स्वध्व॒रम् । विप्रं॒ न द्यु॒क्षव॑चसं सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र्हव्य॒वाह॑मर॒तिं दे॒वमृ॑ञ्जसे
shlokas.transliteration: dyutānám ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ su-adhvarám ǀvípram ǀ ná ǀ dyukṣá-vacasam ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ aratím ǀ devám ǀ ṛñjase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiate with pious praises the radiantAgni, your guest, the guide to heaven, the invoker of the gods( at the sacrifice) ofmanu, the celebrator of holy rites, the speaker of brilliant words like a learned sage, the bearer of oblations (to the gods), the lord, the divine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒व॒कया॒ यश्चि॒तय॑न्त्या कृ॒पा क्षाम॑न्रुरु॒च उ॒षसो॒ न भा॒नुना॑ । तूर्व॒न्न याम॒न्नेत॑शस्य॒ नू रण॒ आ यो घृ॒णे न त॑तृषा॒णो अ॒जर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pāvakáyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ citáyantyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ kṣā́man ǀ rurucé ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhānúnā ǀtū́rvan ǀ ná ǀ yā́man ǀ étaśasya ǀ nú ǀ ráṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ghṛṇé ǀ ná ǀ tatṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Propitiate him) who shines upon the earth with purifying and enlightening lustre, as the dawns with ligt; him, who like (a warrior) discomfiting (his foes) quickly blazed forth in the contest in defence ofetaśa; him, who is satiated (with food), exempt from decay.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॑ग्निं वः स॒मिधा॑ दुवस्यत प्रि॒यम्प्रि॑यं वो॒ अति॑थिं गृणी॒षणि॑ । उप॑ वो गी॒र्भिर॒मृतं॑ विवासत दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॒ वन॑ते॒ हि वार्यं॑ दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॒ वन॑ते॒ हि नो॒ दुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ vaḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ duvasyata ǀ priyám-priyam ǀ vaḥ ǀ átithim ǀ gṛṇīṣáṇi ǀúpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ vivāsata ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vánate ǀ hí ǀ vā́ryam ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vánate ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship repeatedly the adorableAgniwith fuel (him) who is ever your dear friend, your guest; approach the immortal Agni with praises, for he, a god among gods, accepts our homage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धम॒ग्निं स॒मिधा॑ गि॒रा गृ॑णे॒ शुचिं॑ पाव॒कं पु॒रो अ॑ध्व॒रे ध्रु॒वम् । विप्रं॒ होता॑रं पुरु॒वार॑म॒द्रुहं॑ क॒विं सु॒म्नैरी॑महे जा॒तवे॑दसम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddham ǀ agním ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ girā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ śúcim ǀ pāvakám ǀ puráḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ dhruvám ǀvípram ǀ hótāram ǀ puru-vā́ram ǀ adrúham ǀ kavím ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ jātá-vedasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with praise the kindledAgni, pure purifying, permanent, (plural ced) before (us) at the sacrifice; let us celebrate with plural asant (hymns) the wise Agni, the invoker of the gods, the adored of many, the benevolent, the far-seeing, him who knows all that exists.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां दू॒तम॑ग्ने अ॒मृतं॑ यु॒गेयु॑गे हव्य॒वाहं॑ दधिरे पा॒युमीड्य॑म् । दे॒वास॑श्च॒ मर्ता॑सश्च॒ जागृ॑विं वि॒भुं वि॒श्पतिं॒ नम॑सा॒ नि षे॑दिरे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ dūtám ǀ agne ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ yugé-yuge ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ dadhire ǀ pāyúm ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ jā́gṛvim ǀ vi-bhúm ǀ viśpátim ǀ námasā ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, have gods and men in every age retained as their messenger, immortal bearer of oblations, beneficent, adorable; they have plural ced him with reverence (upon the altar), vigilant, pervading, the protector of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भूष॑न्नग्न उ॒भयाँ॒ अनु॑ व्र॒ता दू॒तो दे॒वानां॒ रज॑सी॒ समी॑यसे । यत्ते॑ धी॒तिं सु॑म॒तिमा॑वृणी॒महेऽध॑ स्मा नस्त्रि॒वरू॑थः शि॒वो भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhū́ṣan ǀ agne ǀ ubháyān ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ rájasī íti ǀ sám ǀ īyase ǀyát ǀ te ǀ dhītím ǀ su-matím ǀ ā-vṛṇīmáhe ǀ ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ tri-várūthaḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showing grace,Agni, to both (gods and men), and at each sacred rite the messenger of the gods, you traverse earth and heaven; inasmuch as we offer you worship and praise, therefore do you, who are the guardian of the three (regions), be auspicious to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं सु॒प्रती॑कं सु॒दृशं॒ स्वञ्च॒मवि॑द्वांसो वि॒दुष्ट॑रं सपेम । स य॑क्ष॒द्विश्वा॑ व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान्प्र ह॒व्यम॒ग्निर॒मृते॑षु वोचत्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ su-dṛ́śam ǀ su-áñcam ǀ ávidvāṃsaḥ ǀ vidúḥ-taram ǀ sapema ǀsáḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ víśvā ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ prá ǀ havyám ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́teṣu ǀ vocat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We of little wisdom adore the most wiseAgni, the well-formed, the well-looking the graceful-moving; may Agni, who knows all things that are to be known offer the sacrifice; may he announce the oblation to the immortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ग्ने पास्यु॒त तं पि॑पर्षि॒ यस्त॒ आन॑ट् क॒वये॑ शूर धी॒तिम् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ वा॒ निशि॑तिं॒ वोदि॑तिं वा॒ तमित्पृ॑णक्षि॒ शव॑सो॒त रा॒या
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ agne ǀ pāsi ǀ utá ǀ tám ǀ piparṣi ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ kaváye ǀ śūra ǀ dhītím ǀyajñásya ǀ vā ǀ ní-śitim ǀ vā ǀ út-itim ǀ vā ǀ tám ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇakṣi ǀ śávasā ǀ utá ǀ rāyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You cherish, you protect,Agni, that may who offers worship, hero, to you, the far-seeing; you reward with strength and with riches him (who undertakes) the instrumental tution, (who effects) the accomplishments of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वनुष्य॒तो नि पा॑हि॒ त्वमु॑ नः सहसावन्नव॒द्यात् । सं त्वा॑ ध्वस्म॒न्वद॒भ्ये॑तु॒ पाथ॒: सं र॒यिः स्पृ॑ह॒याय्य॑: सह॒स्री
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avadyā́t ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ dhvasman-vát ǀ abhí ǀ etu ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ sám ǀ rayíḥ ǀ spṛhayā́yyaḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Agni, from the malignant, preserve us, mighty one, from wickedness; may the offering come to you free from defects; may desirable riches, by your sands, (reach us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ गृ॒हप॑ति॒: स राजा॒ विश्वा॑ वेद॒ जनि॑मा जा॒तवे॑दाः । दे॒वाना॑मु॒त यो मर्त्या॑नां॒ यजि॑ष्ठ॒: स प्र य॑जतामृ॒तावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ víśvā ǀ veda ǀ jánima ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀdevā́nām ǀ utá ǀ yáḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajatām ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, is the invoker of the gods, the lord of the house, the ruler, who knows all that is, knows all existing beings; he is the mos assiduous worshipper among gods or men; let him who is observant of truth offer worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ यद॒द्य वि॒शो अ॑ध्वरस्य होत॒: पाव॑कशोचे॒ वेष्ट्वं हि यज्वा॑ । ऋ॒ता य॑जासि महि॒ना वि यद्भूर्ह॒व्या व॑ह यविष्ठ॒ या ते॑ अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yát ǀ adyá ǀ viśáḥ ǀ adhvarasya ǀ hotaríti ǀ pā́vaka-śoce ǀ véḥ ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ yájvā ǀṛtā́ ǀ yajāsi ǀ mahinā́ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ bhū́ḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vaha ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, minister of the sacrifice, bright wiht purifying lustre, approve of that (worship) which is this day celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite; you verily are the sacrificer, therefore address the worship (to the gods); and since by your greatness you are all-pervading, therefore, youngest (of the gods), accept the oblations which are today (presented) to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रयां॑सि॒ सुधि॑तानि॒ हि ख्यो नि त्वा॑ दधीत॒ रोद॑सी॒ यज॑ध्यै । अवा॑ नो मघव॒न्वाज॑साता॒वग्ने॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता त॑रेम॒ ता त॑रेम॒ तवाव॑सा तरेम
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ sú-dhitāni ǀ hí ǀ khyáḥ ǀ ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhīta ǀ ródasī íti ǀ yájadhyai ǀáva ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ ágne ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ tā́ ǀ tarema ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Look,Agni, upon the (sacrificial) viands duly deposited (upon the altar); heaven and earth detain you to sacrifice (to the gods); opulent Agni, protect us in battle, whereby we may pass safe over all evils; may we pass over those of a prior existence; may we pass over them by your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिः स्वनीक दे॒वैरूर्णा॑वन्तं प्रथ॒मः सी॑द॒ योनि॑म् । कु॒ला॒यिनं॑ घृ॒तव॑न्तं सवि॒त्रे य॒ज्ञं न॑य॒ यज॑मानाय सा॒धु
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ su-anīka ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ū́rṇā-vantam ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sīda ǀ yónim ǀkulāyínam ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ savitré ǀ yajñám ǀ naya ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sādhú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright-rayedAgni, sit down first with all the gods, upon the altar lined withwool, a nest (of perfumes) and suffused withghee, and rightly convey (to the deities) the sacrifice of the instrumental tutor of the rite, of the presenter of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ममु॒ त्यम॑थर्व॒वद॒ग्निं म॑न्थन्ति वे॒धस॑: । यम॑ङ्कू॒यन्त॒मान॑य॒न्नमू॑रं श्या॒व्या॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ atharva-vát ǀ agním ǀ manthanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀyám ǀ aṅku-yántam ǀ ā́ ǀ ánayan ǀ ámūram ǀ śyāvyā́bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests churn you,Agni, as was done byatharvan, and bring him from the glooms of night wandering deviously, but not bewildered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जनि॑ष्वा दे॒ववी॑तये स॒र्वता॑ता स्व॒स्तये॑ । आ दे॒वान्व॑क्ष्य॒मृताँ॑ ऋता॒वृधो॑ य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ पिस्पृशः
shlokas.transliteration: jániṣva ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ svastáye ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ devéṣu ǀ pispṛśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be born,Agni, at the sacrifice, for the welfare of the offerer (of oblation) to the gods; bring hither the immortal deities, the augmenters of the (sacred) rite present our sacrifice to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमु॑ त्वा गृहपते जनाना॒मग्ने॒ अक॑र्म स॒मिधा॑ बृ॒हन्त॑म् । अ॒स्थू॒रि नो॒ गार्ह॑पत्यानि सन्तु ति॒ग्मेन॑ न॒स्तेज॑सा॒ सं शि॑शाधि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ gṛha-pate ǀ janānām ǀ ágne ǀ ákarma ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ bṛhántam ǀasthūrí ǀ naḥ ǀ gā́rha-patyāni ǀ santu ǀ tigména ǀ naḥ ǀ téjasā ǀ sám ǀ śiśādhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of the house,Agni, we, among men, promote your increase bysomaor fuel; may our domestic fires be supplied with all that is essential; enliven us with brilliant radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने य॒ज्ञानां॒ होता॒ विश्वे॑षां हि॒तः । दे॒वेभि॒र्मानु॑षे॒ जने॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ hótā ǀ víśveṣām ǀ hitáḥ ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, have been appointed by the gods, the ministrant fo men, the descendants ofmanu, at all sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ म॒न्द्राभि॑रध्व॒रे जि॒ह्वाभि॑र्यजा म॒हः । आ दे॒वान्व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mandrā́bhiḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ jihvā́bhiḥ ǀ yaja ǀ maháḥ ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore do you at our sacrifice offer oblations to the great deities with exhilarating flames; bring hither the gods; offer them worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेत्था॒ हि वे॑धो॒ अध्व॑नः प॒थश्च॑ दे॒वाञ्ज॑सा । अग्ने॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ सुक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: véttha ǀ hí ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ ca ǀ deva ǀ áñjasā ǀágne ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, doere of great deeds, creator, you know (how to travel over) with speed (great) roads and (little) paths at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामी॑ळे॒ अध॑ द्वि॒ता भ॑र॒तो वा॒जिभि॑: शु॒नम् । ई॒जे य॒ज्ञेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ īḷe ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǀ bharatáḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ śunám ǀījé ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ yajñíyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bharata, with the presenters of the oblation, has joyfully praised you in your (two-fold capacity), and has worshipped you, the adorable, with sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॒मा वार्या॑ पु॒रु दिवो॑दासाय सुन्व॒ते । भ॒रद्वा॑जाय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ imā́ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ sunvaté ǀbharát-vājāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you have conferred these many blessings uponDivodāsawhen presenting libations, (so now grant them) to the (actual) offerer,Bharadvāja.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दू॒तो अम॑र्त्य॒ आ व॑हा॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म् । शृ॒ण्वन्विप्र॑स्य सुष्टु॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀśṛṇván ǀ víprasya ǀ su-stutím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hearing the adoration of the sage, do you, who are the immortal messenger, bring hither the celestial people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने स्वा॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ मर्ता॑सो दे॒ववी॑तये । य॒ज्ञेषु॑ दे॒वमी॑ळते
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀyajñéṣu ǀ devám ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pious mortals invoke you, divineAgni, at sacrifices, to convey their (sacrificial) food to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ प्र य॑क्षि सं॒दृश॑मु॒त क्रतुं॑ सु॒दान॑वः । विश्वे॑ जुषन्त का॒मिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ prá ǀ yakṣi ǀ sam-dṛ́śam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀvíśve ǀ juṣanta ǀ kāmínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify your splendour and the acts of you the liberal giver all who, (through your favour) enjoy their desires, glorify you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं होता॒ मनु॑र्हितो॒ वह्नि॑रा॒सा वि॒दुष्ट॑रः । अग्ने॒ यक्षि॑ दि॒वो विश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀágne ǀ yákṣi ǀ diváḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have been appointed bymanu, the invoker of the gods, the most wise bearer of oblations (to them) by your mouth; worship,Agni, the people of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आ या॑हि वी॒तये॑ गृणा॒नो ह॒व्यदा॑तये । नि होता॑ सत्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ vītáye ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀní ǀ hótā ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, to the (sacrificial) fod; being lauded, (come) to convey the oblation (to the gods); sit down as the ministrant priest upon the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ स॒मिद्भि॑रङ्गिरो घृ॒तेन॑ वर्धयामसि । बृ॒हच्छो॑चा यविष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ samít-bhiḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ vardhayāmasi ǀbṛhát ǀ śoca ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We augment you,Aṅgiras, with fuel and with butter; blaze fiercely, youngest (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पृ॒थु श्र॒वाय्य॒मच्छा॑ देव विवाससि । बृ॒हद॑ग्ने सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ śravā́yyam ǀ áccha ǀ deva ǀ vivāsasi ǀbṛhát ǀ agne ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, bestow upon us (wealth), excellent, great and (comprehending) worthymaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ पुष्क॑रा॒दध्यथ॑र्वा॒ निर॑मन्थत । मू॒र्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वा॒घत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ púṣkarāt ǀ ádhi ǀ átharvā ǀ níḥ ǀ amanthata ǀmūrdhnáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ vāghátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage,Atharvan, extracted you from upon the lotus-leaf, the head, the support of the universe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा द॒ध्यङ्ङृषि॑: पु॒त्र ई॑धे॒ अथ॑र्वणः । वृ॒त्र॒हणं॑ पुरंद॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dadhyáṅ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ putráḥ ǀ īdhe ǀ átharvaṇaḥ ǀvṛtra-hánam ǀ puram-darám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ṛṣi, Dadhyañc, the son ofAtharvan, kindled the slayer ofVṛtra, the destroyer of the cities ofAsuras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा पा॒थ्यो वृषा॒ समी॑धे दस्यु॒हन्त॑मम् । ध॒नं॒ज॒यं रणे॑रणे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ pāthyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sám ǀ īdhe ǀ dasyuhán-tamam ǀdhanam-jayám ǀ ráṇe-raṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The ṛṣi)Pāthya, the showerer, kindled you the destroyer of theDasyu, the winner of spoil in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एह्यू॒ षु ब्रवा॑णि॒ तेऽग्न॑ इ॒त्थेत॑रा॒ गिर॑: । ए॒भिर्व॑र्धास॒ इन्दु॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ brávāṇi ǀ te ǀ ágne ǀ itthā́ ǀ ítarāḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀebhíḥ ǀ vardhāse ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, that I may address to you other praises in this manner; augment with these libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ क्व॑ च ते॒ मनो॒ दक्षं॑ दधस॒ उत्त॑रम् । तत्रा॒ सद॑: कृणवसे
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ kvá ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ dadhase ǀ út-taram ǀtátra ǀ sádaḥ ǀ kṛṇavase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wheresoever, and upon whatsoever your mind is directed, you bestow uncommon vigour, and there you make your abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ते॑ पू॒र्तम॑क्षि॒पद्भुव॑न्नेमानां वसो । अथा॒ दुवो॑ वनवसे
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ pūrtám ǀ akṣi-pát ǀ bhúvat ǀ nemānām ǀ vaso íti ǀátha ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ vanavase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not your full (blaze) be distressing to the eye, giver of dwellings to your humble votaries, and therefore accept our worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग्निर॑गामि॒ भार॑तो वृत्र॒हा पु॑रु॒चेत॑नः । दिवो॑दासस्य॒ सत्प॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ agāmi ǀ bhā́rataḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ puru-cétanaḥ ǀdívaḥ-dāsasya ǀ sát-patiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the bearer, (of oblations), the destroyer of the enemies of Divopāsa, the cognizant of many, the protector of the good, has been brought hither (by our praises).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि विश्वाति॒ पार्थि॑वा र॒यिं दाश॑न्महित्व॒ना । व॒न्वन्नवा॑तो॒ अस्तृ॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ rayím ǀ dā́śat ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǀvanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Surpassing all earthly things, may he bestow upon us riches, destroying his enemies by his greatness, unresisted, unassailed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॑त्न॒वन्नवी॑य॒साग्ने॑ द्यु॒म्नेन॑ सं॒यता॑ । बृ॒हत्त॑तन्थ भा॒नुना॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratna-vát ǀ návīyasā ǀ ágne ǀ dyumnéna ǀ sam-yátā ǀbṛhát ǀ tatantha ǀ bhānúnā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, have overspread,Agni, this vast (firmament) with radiant concentrated lustre, recent like that of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑: सखायो अ॒ग्नये॒ स्तोमं॑ य॒ज्ञं च॑ धृष्णु॒या । अर्च॒ गाय॑ च वे॒धसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ stómam ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀárca ǀ gā́ya ǀ ca ǀ vedháse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing praise and offer sacrifice, my friends, to the foe-discomfiting, the creator,Agni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि यो मानु॑षा यु॒गा सीद॒द्धोता॑ क॒विक्र॑तुः । दू॒तश्च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ sī́dat ǀ hótā ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǀdūtáḥ ǀ ca ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgniindeed sit down (at our sacrifice), who in every age of man has been the invoker of the gods, doer of wise deeds, the messenger of the gods, the bearer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता राजा॑ना॒ शुचि॑व्रतादि॒त्यान्मारु॑तं ग॒णम् । वसो॒ यक्षी॒ह रोद॑सी
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ rā́jānā ǀ śúci-vratā ǀ ādityā́n ǀ mā́rutam ǀ gaṇám ǀváso íti ǀ yákṣi ǀ ihá ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of dwellings, worship on this occasion, the two regal divinities,MitraandVaruṇa, whose acts are holy, theĀdityas, the company of theMaruts, and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वस्वी॑ ते अग्ने॒ संदृ॑ष्टिरिषय॒ते मर्त्या॑य । ऊर्जो॑ नपाद॒मृत॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: vásvī ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sám-dṛṣṭiḥ ǀ iṣa-yaté ǀ mártyāya ǀū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ amṛ́tasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength,Agni, the glorious radiance of you who are immortal, bestows food upon (your) mortal worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॒ दा अ॑स्तु॒ श्रेष्ठो॒ऽद्य त्वा॑ व॒न्वन्त्सु॒रेक्णा॑: । मर्त॑ आनाश सुवृ॒क्तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ tvā ǀ vanván ǀ su-rékṇāḥ ǀmártaḥ ǀ ānāśa ǀ su-vṛktím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the donor (of the oblation), propitiating you by his acts today, be exalted, and (rendered) very opulent; may (such) mortal be diligent in (your) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते ते॑ अग्ने॒ त्वोता॑ इ॒षय॑न्तो॒ विश्व॒मायु॑: । तर॑न्तो अ॒र्यो अरा॑तीर्व॒न्वन्तो॑ अ॒र्यो अरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǀ iṣáyantaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀtárantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǀ vanvántaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those,Agni, who are protected by you, wishing for the whole (term of) life (obtain it), overcoming hostile assailants, destroying hostile assailants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निस्ति॒ग्मेन॑ शो॒चिषा॒ यास॒द्विश्वं॒ न्य१॒॑त्रिण॑म् । अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ वनते र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ tigména ǀ śocíṣā ǀ yā́sat ǀ víśvam ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀagníḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vanate ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, with his sharp flame, demolish the devourer (of the oblation); may Agni grant us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वीरं॑ र॒यिमा भ॑र॒ जात॑वेदो॒ विच॑र्षणे । ज॒हि रक्षां॑सि सुक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: su-vī́ram ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀjahí ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Jātavedas, all-beholdeer, bring us wealth with good posterity; doer of good deeds, destroy therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: पा॒ह्यंह॑सो॒ जात॑वेदो अघाय॒तः । रक्षा॑ णो ब्रह्मणस्कवे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ kave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preserve us,Jātavedas, from sin; enunciator of prayer, protect us from the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ अग्ने दु॒रेव॒ आ मर्तो॑ व॒धाय॒ दाश॑ति । तस्मा॑न्नः पा॒ह्यंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-évaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ vadhā́ya ǀ dā́śati ǀtásmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The malevolent mortal who threatens us with murderous weapon; defend us from him, and also from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तं दे॑व जि॒ह्वया॒ परि॑ बाधस्व दु॒ष्कृत॑म् । मर्तो॒ यो नो॒ जिघां॑सति
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tám ǀ deva ǀ jihváyā ǀ pári ǀ bādhasva ǀ duḥ-kṛ́tam ǀmártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Scatter, divineAgni, by your flame, that evil-doer, the man who seeks to kill us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒रद्वा॑जाय स॒प्रथ॒: शर्म॑ यच्छ सहन्त्य । अग्ने॒ वरे॑ण्यं॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: bharát-vājāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ sahantya ǀágne ǀ váreṇyam ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Subduer of foes, grant toBharadvājainfinite happiness and desirable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनद्द्रविण॒स्युर्वि॑प॒न्यया॑ । समि॑द्धः शु॒क्र आहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jaṅghanat ǀ draviṇasyúḥ ǀ vipanyáyā ǀsám-iddhaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, propitiated by praise, desirous of (sacrificial) affluence, kindled, bright, and fed with burnt-offerings, destroy all adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गर्भे॑ मा॒तुः पि॒तुष्पि॒ता वि॑दिद्युता॒नो अ॒क्षरे॑ । सीद॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: gárbhe ǀ mātúḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vi-didyutānáḥ ǀ akṣáre ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant in the embryo of the maternal (earth), on the imperishable (altar); the cherisher of the paternal (heaven), sitting on the seat of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑ प्र॒जाव॒दा भ॑र॒ जात॑वेदो॒ विच॑र्षणे । अग्ने॒ यद्दी॒दय॑द्दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: bráhma ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀágne ǀ yát ǀ dīdáyat ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us,Jātavedas, all-beholder, food with progeny; such (food) as is brilliant in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वा र॒ण्वसं॑दृशं॒ प्रय॑स्वन्तः सहस्कृत । अग्ने॑ ससृ॒ज्महे॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ raṇvá-sandṛśam ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀágne ǀ sasṛjmáhe ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strength-begottenAgni, we, offering (sacrificial) food, address praises to you who are of plural asing aspect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ च्छा॒यामि॑व॒ घृणे॒रग॑न्म॒ शर्म॑ ते व॒यम् । अग्ने॒ हिर॑ण्यसंदृशः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ chāyā́m-iva ǀ ghṛ́ṇeḥ ǀ áganma ǀ śárma ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀágne ǀ híraṇya-sandṛśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have recourse,Agni, to the shelter of you, the lustrous, the golden-feathered, as to the shade (of a tree).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒ग्र इ॑व शर्य॒हा ति॒ग्मशृ॑ङ्गो॒ न वंस॑गः । अग्ने॒ पुरो॑ रु॒रोजि॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugráḥ-iva ǀ śarya-hā́ ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀágne ǀ púraḥ ǀ rurójitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, who are like a fierce archer, or like a sharp-horned bull, have destroyed the cities (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यं हस्ते॒ न खा॒दिनं॒ शिशुं॑ जा॒तं न बिभ्र॑ति । वि॒शाम॒ग्निं स्व॑ध्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yám ǀ háste ǀ ná ǀ khādínam ǀ śíśum ǀ jātám ǀ ná ǀ bíbhrati ǀviśā́m ǀ agním ǀ su-adhvarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Worship) thatAgniwhom (the priests) bear in theirhandslike a new-born babe; the devourer (of the oblation), the (conveyer of the) holy sacrifices of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र दे॒वं दे॒ववी॑तये॒ भर॑ता वसु॒वित्त॑मम् । आ स्वे योनौ॒ नि षी॑दतु
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ devám ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ bhárata ǀ vasuvít-tamam ǀā́ ǀ své ǀ yónau ǀ ní ǀ sīdatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conduct the divine (Agni), the bestower of infinite wealth, to (receive charge of) the food of the gods; let him sit down on his appropriate seat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जा॒तं जा॒तवे॑दसि प्रि॒यं शि॑शी॒ताति॑थिम् । स्यो॒न आ गृ॒हप॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jātám ǀ jātá-vedasi ǀ priyám ǀ śiśīta ǀ átithim ǀsyoné ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛhá-patim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Welcome him) as soon as born, like a beloved guest, and plural ce the lord of the mansion upon the sacred (altar) whence wisdom is derived.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ यु॒क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वा॑सो देव सा॒धव॑: । अरं॒ वह॑न्ति म॒न्यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ yé ǀ táva ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ sādhávaḥ ǀáram ǀ váhanti ǀ manyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harness, divineAgni, your well-trained horses, who bear you quickly to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ नो या॒ह्या व॑हा॒भि प्रयां॑सि वी॒तये॑ । आ दे॒वान्त्सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ vītáye ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, to our presence, bring hither the gods to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑ग्ने भारत द्यु॒मदज॑स्रेण॒ दवि॑द्युतत् । शोचा॒ वि भा॑ह्यजर
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ agne ǀ bhārata ǀ dyu-mát ǀ ájasreṇa ǀ dávidyutat ǀśóca ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀ ajara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Blaze up,Agni, bearer of oblations; shine, undecaying Agni, radiant with undecaying lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ती यो दे॒वं मर्तो॑ दुव॒स्येद॒ग्निमी॑ळीताध्व॒रे ह॒विष्मा॑न् । होता॑रं सत्य॒यजं॒ रोद॑स्योरुत्ता॒नह॑स्तो॒ नम॒सा वि॑वासेत्
shlokas.transliteration: vītī́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ devám ǀ mártaḥ ǀ duvasyét ǀ agním ǀ īḷīta ǀ adhvaré ǀ havíṣmān ǀhótāram ǀ satya-yájam ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ uttāná-hastaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāset ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever mortal, offering oblations, worships a deity with (sacrificial) food, let him at the ceremony also worshipAgni, the invoker of heaven and earth, the sacrificer with truth; let him adore (Agni) with upliftedhands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ अग्न ऋ॒चा ह॒विर्हृ॒दा त॒ष्टं भ॑रामसि । ते ते॑ भवन्तू॒क्षण॑ ऋष॒भासो॑ व॒शा उ॒त
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ havíḥ ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ taṣṭám ǀ bharāmasi ǀté ǀ te ǀ bhavantu ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ ṛṣabhā́saḥ ǀ vaśā́ḥ ǀ utá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We offer to you,Agni, the oblation sanctified by the heart, and (identified) with the sacred verse may the vigorous bulls and the cows be (as such an oblation) to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दे॒वासो॑ अग्रि॒यमि॒न्धते॑ वृत्र॒हन्त॑मम् । येना॒ वसू॒न्याभृ॑ता तृ॒ळ्हा रक्षां॑सि वा॒जिना॑
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agriyám ǀ indháte ǀ vṛtrahán-tamam ǀyéna ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́-bhṛtā ǀ tṛḷhā́ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ vājínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods kindleAgnias the chief (of them); as the especial desroyer ofVṛtra; by whom the treasures (of theasuras) are carried off; by whom therākṣasasare destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॒ सोम॑म॒भि यमु॑ग्र॒ तर्द॑ ऊ॒र्वं गव्यं॒ महि॑ गृणा॒न इ॑न्द्र । वि यो धृ॑ष्णो॒ वधि॑षो वज्रहस्त॒ विश्वा॑ वृ॒त्रम॑मि॒त्रिया॒ शवो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ sómam ǀ abhí ǀ yám ǀ ugra ǀ tárdaḥ ǀ ūrvám ǀ gávyam ǀ máhi ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ indra ǀví ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ vádhiṣaḥ ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ amitríyā ǀ śávaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra, glorified by us, drink of theSoma, (animated) by which you have discovered the vast herd of cattle (stolen byPaṇis), and, overcomer of enemies, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have slain, by your strength all opposing foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॑ पाहि॒ य ऋ॑जी॒षी तरु॑त्रो॒ यः शिप्र॑वान्वृष॒भो यो म॑ती॒नाम् । यो गो॑त्र॒भिद्व॑ज्र॒भृद्यो ह॑रि॒ष्ठाः स इ॑न्द्र चि॒त्राँ अ॒भि तृ॑न्धि॒ वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ pāhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀ tárutraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śípra-vān ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀyáḥ ǀ gotra-bhít ǀ vajra-bhṛ́t ǀ yáḥ ǀ hari-sthā́ḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ citrā́n ǀ abhí ǀ tṛndhi ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink it,Indra, you who enjoy the flavourlessSoma; you who are the preserver, the handsome-chinned, the showerer (of benefits) on those who praise you; who are the breaker of mountains, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the curber of steeds, do you bestow upon us various food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा पा॑हि प्र॒त्नथा॒ मन्द॑तु त्वा श्रु॒धि ब्रह्म॑ वावृ॒धस्वो॒त गी॒र्भिः । आ॒विः सूर्यं॑ कृणु॒हि पी॑पि॒हीषो॑ ज॒हि शत्रूँ॑र॒भि गा इ॑न्द्र तृन्धि
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ pāhi ǀ pratná-thā ǀ mándatu ǀ tvā ǀ śrudhí ǀ bráhma ǀ vavṛdhásva ǀ utá ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀāvíḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ pīpihí ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ jahí ǀ śátrūn ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ tṛndhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink it as of old, and may it exhilarate ou; hear our prayer, and be exalted by our praises; make the sun visible, nourish us with food, destroy our enemies, rescue the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते त्वा॒ मदा॑ बृ॒हदि॑न्द्र स्वधाव इ॒मे पी॒ता उ॑क्षयन्त द्यु॒मन्त॑म् । म॒हामनू॑नं त॒वसं॒ विभू॑तिं मत्स॒रासो॑ जर्हृषन्त प्र॒साह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ tvā ǀ mádāḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ indra ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ imé ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ ukṣayanta ǀ dyu-mántam ǀmahā́m ǀ ánūnam ǀ tavásam ǀ ví-bhūtim ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ jarhṛṣanta ǀ pra-sáham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abounding in food,Indra, let these exhilarating draughts copiously bedew you, the resplendent; let the inebriating juices delight you who are mighty, deficient in no (excellence), powerful, manifold, the overcomer of foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येभि॒: सूर्य॑मु॒षसं॑ मन्दसा॒नोऽवा॑स॒योऽप॑ दृ॒ळ्हानि॒ दर्द्र॑त् । म॒हामद्रिं॒ परि॒ गा इ॑न्द्र॒ सन्तं॑ नु॒त्था अच्यु॑तं॒ सद॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वात्
shlokas.transliteration: yébhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ávāsayaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ dárdrat ǀmahā́m ǀ ádrim ǀ pári ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ sántam ǀ nutthā́ḥ ǀ ácyutam ǀ sádasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ svā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By which (juices) being exhilarated you have appointed the sun and the dawn (to their offices), driving away the solid (glooms); you have penetrated,Indra, the mountain, unmoved from its own seat, concealing the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ क्रत्वा॒ तव॒ तद्दं॒सना॑भिरा॒मासु॑ प॒क्वं शच्या॒ नि दी॑धः । और्णो॒र्दुर॑ उ॒स्रिया॑भ्यो॒ वि दृ॒ळ्होदू॒र्वाद्गा अ॑सृजो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀ āmā́su ǀ pakvám ǀ śácyā ǀ ní ǀ dīdharíti dīdhaḥ ǀáurṇoḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ usríyābhyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ út ǀ ūrvā́t ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ áṅgirasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By your wisdom, by your deeds, through your power, you have developed the mature (milk) in the immature (udders), you have opened the strong doors for the cattle (to come forth); associated withAṅgirasas, you have liberated the cows from their fold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒प्राथ॒ क्षां महि॒ दंसो॒ व्यु१॒॑र्वीमुप॒ द्यामृ॒ष्वो बृ॒हदि॑न्द्र स्तभायः । अधा॑रयो॒ रोद॑सी दे॒वपु॑त्रे प्र॒त्ने मा॒तरा॑ य॒ह्वी ऋ॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: paprā́tha ǀ kṣā́m ǀ máhi ǀ dáṃsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ urvī́m ǀ úpa ǀ dyā́m ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ indra ǀ stabhāyaḥ ǀádhārayaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ pratné íti ǀ mātárā ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have filled the wide earth,Indra. With (the power of) your deeds; you, the mighty one, have propped up the vast heaven; you have sustained the heaven and earth, whose children are the gods, (and who are) the old and mighty parents of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ पु॒र इ॑न्द्र दे॒वा एकं॑ त॒वसं॑ दधिरे॒ भरा॑य । अदे॑वो॒ यद॒भ्यौहि॑ष्ट दे॒वान्त्स्व॑र्षाता वृणत॒ इन्द्र॒मत्र॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ tvā ǀ víśve ǀ puráḥ ǀ indra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ékam ǀ tavásam ǀ dadhire ǀ bhárāya ǀádevaḥ ǀ yát ǀ abhí ǀ áuhiṣṭa ǀ devā́n ǀ sváḥ-sātā ǀ vṛṇate ǀ índram ǀ átra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the gods then plural ced you,Indra, as their mighty chief in front for battle; when the impious (asuras) assailed the deities; theMarutssupported Indra in the conflict.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ द्यौश्चि॑त्ते॒ अप॒ सा नु वज्रा॑द्द्वि॒तान॑मद्भि॒यसा॒ स्वस्य॑ म॒न्योः । अहिं॒ यदिन्द्रो॑ अ॒भ्योह॑सानं॒ नि चि॑द्वि॒श्वायु॑: श॒यथे॑ ज॒घान॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ ápa ǀ sā́ ǀ nú ǀ vájrāt ǀ dvitā́ ǀ anamat ǀ bhiyásā ǀ svásya ǀ manyóḥ ǀáhim ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ óhasānam ǀ ní ǀ cit ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ śayáthe ǀ jaghā́na ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The heaven bowed down in the two-fold dread of your thunderbolt, and your individual wrath, whenIndra, the giver of food, struck to the sleep (of death) the assailing Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ त्वष्टा॑ ते म॒ह उ॑ग्र॒ वज्रं॑ स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिं ववृतच्छ॒ताश्रि॑म् । निका॑मम॒रम॑णसं॒ येन॒ नव॑न्त॒महिं॒ सं पि॑णगृजीषिन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ te ǀ maháḥ ǀ ugra ǀ vájram ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭim ǀ vavṛtat ǀ śatá-aśrim ǀní-kāmam ǀ ará-manasam ǀ yéna ǀ návantam ǀ áhim ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀ ṛjīṣin ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra,Tvaṣṭāconstructed for you, the mighty one, the thousand-edged, the hundred-angled thunderbolt, wherewith you have crushed the ambitious audacious, loud-shouting Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वर्धा॒न्यं विश्वे॑ म॒रुत॑: स॒जोषा॒: पच॑च्छ॒तं म॑हि॒षाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ तुभ्य॑म् । पू॒षा विष्णु॒स्त्रीणि॒ सरां॑सि धावन्वृत्र॒हणं॑ मदि॒रमं॒शुम॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: várdhān ǀ yám ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pácat ǀ śatám ǀ mahiṣā́n ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀpūṣā́ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ dhāvan ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ madirám ǀ aṃśúm ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Indra, whom all theMaruts, alike plural ased, exalt, mayPūṣanandViṣṇudress for you a hundred buffaloes, and to him may the three streams flow with the inebriating, foe-destroyingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ क्षोदो॒ महि॑ वृ॒तं न॒दीनां॒ परि॑ष्ठितमसृज ऊ॒र्मिम॒पाम् । तासा॒मनु॑ प्र॒वत॑ इन्द्र॒ पन्थां॒ प्रार्द॑यो॒ नीची॑र॒पस॑: समु॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vṛtám ǀ nadī́nām ǀ pári-sthitam ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ apā́m ǀtā́sām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ pánthām ǀ prá ǀ ārdayaḥ ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ samudrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have set free the greatly obstructed and arrested water of the rivers, the flux of the waters; you have directed them,Indra, upon their downward paths; you have sent them rapidly down to the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ता विश्वा॑ चकृ॒वांस॒मिन्द्रं॑ म॒हामु॒ग्रम॑जु॒र्यं स॑हो॒दाम् । सु॒वीरं॑ त्वा स्वायु॒धं सु॒वज्र॒मा ब्रह्म॒ नव्य॒मव॑से ववृत्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ cakṛ-vā́ṃsam ǀ índram ǀ mahā́m ǀ ugrám ǀ ajuryám ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀsu-vī́ram ǀ tvā ǀ su-āyudhám ǀ su-vájram ǀ ā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ návyam ǀ ávase ǀ vavṛtyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our new prayer bring to our protection you,Indra, who are the maker of all these (things that exist); who are mighty, fierce, undecaying, the giver of strength, having excellent descendants, theMaruts, well-armed, the bearer of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ वाजा॑य॒ श्रव॑स इ॒षे च॑ रा॒ये धे॑हि द्यु॒मत॑ इन्द्र॒ विप्रा॑न् । भ॒रद्वा॑जे नृ॒वत॑ इन्द्र सू॒रीन्दि॒वि च॑ स्मैधि॒ पार्ये॑ न इन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ śrávase ǀ iṣé ǀ ca ǀ rāyé ǀ dhehi ǀ dyu-mátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ víprān ǀbharát-vāje ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sūrī́n ǀ diví ǀ ca ǀ sma ǀ edhi ǀ pā́rye ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, resplendentIndra, uphold us who are devout, for (the obtaining of) food, of sustenance, of nourishment, of wealth; bestow uponBharadvājapious posterity, with numerous attendants; be with us, Indra, every future day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या वाजं॑ दे॒वहि॑तं सनेम॒ मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ devá-hitam ǀ sanema ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, by this (praise), obtain food granted by the deity; may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ ष्टुहि॒ यो अ॒भिभू॑त्योजा व॒न्वन्नवा॑तः पुरुहू॒त इन्द्र॑: । अषा॑ळ्हमु॒ग्रं सह॑मानमा॒भिर्गी॒र्भिर्व॑र्ध वृष॒भं च॑र्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ abhíbhūti-ojāḥ ǀ vanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀáṣāḷham ǀ ugrám ǀ sáhamānam ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vardha ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise him who isIndra, the invoker of many, endowed with overpowering vigour, the destroyer (of foes), unharmed by them; exalt with these praises the irresistible, fierce, victorious Indra, the showerer (of benefits) upon mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यु॒ध्मः सत्वा॑ खज॒कृत्स॒मद्वा॑ तुविम्र॒क्षो न॑दनु॒माँ ऋ॑जी॒षी । बृ॒हद्रे॑णु॒श्च्यव॑नो॒ मानु॑षीणा॒मेक॑: कृष्टी॒नाम॑भवत्स॒हावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yudhmáḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ khaja-kṛ́t ǀ samát-vā ǀ tuvi-mrakṣáḥ ǀ nadanu-mā́n ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀbṛhát-reṇuḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ abhavat ǀ sahá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is ever the combatant, the donor, the engaged in battle, the sympathizer (with the sacrificer), the benefactor of many, the loud-sounding, the partaker of the stale libation, the stirrer up of dust (in strife), the chief protector of men the descendants ofManu, the endowed with strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह॒ नु त्यद॑दमायो॒ दस्यूँ॒रेक॑: कृ॒ष्टीर॑वनो॒रार्या॑य । अस्ति॑ स्वि॒न्नु वी॒र्यं१॒॑ तत्त॑ इन्द्र॒ न स्वि॑दस्ति॒ तदृ॑तु॒था वि वो॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ nú ǀ tyát ǀ adamayaḥ ǀ dásyūn ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ avanoḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀásti ǀ svit ǀ nú ǀ vīryám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ ná ǀ svit ǀ asti ǀ tát ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ ví ǀ vocaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are he who has quickly humbled theDasyus; you are the chief one who has given posterity to theArya;but,Indra, is not verily your power such? If it be not, then in due season confess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सदिद्धि ते॑ तुविजा॒तस्य॒ मन्ये॒ सह॑: सहिष्ठ तुर॒तस्तु॒रस्य॑ । उ॒ग्रमु॒ग्रस्य॑ त॒वस॒स्तवी॒योऽर॑ध्रस्य रध्र॒तुरो॑ बभूव
shlokas.transliteration: sát ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ tuvi-jātásya ǀ mánye ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ sahiṣṭha ǀ turatáḥ ǀ turásya ǀugrám ǀ ugrásya ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ távīyaḥ ǀ áradhrasya ǀ radhra-túraḥ ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yet, most mighty one, I believe that powre is verily always in you, who are manifest at many rites, and are the enemy of (our) enemies; (the power) that is fierce in the fierce one, most mighty in the mighty one, most unassailable in the subduer (of foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॑: प्र॒त्नं स॒ख्यम॑स्तु यु॒ष्मे इ॒त्था वद॑द्भिर्व॒लमङ्गि॑रोभिः । हन्न॑च्युतच्युद्दस्मे॒षय॑न्तमृ॒णोः पुरो॒ वि दुरो॑ अस्य॒ विश्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ pratnám ǀ sakhyám ǀ astu ǀ yuṣmé íti ǀ itthā́ ǀ vádat-bhiḥ ǀ valám ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀhán ǀ acyuta-cyut ǀ dasma ǀ iṣáyantam ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ asya ǀ víśvāḥ ǁ
