shlokas.meaning_en: “May that our ancient friendship with you ever endure; as when, along with theAṅgirasas, celebrating your praises, you, beautifulIndra, caster down of the immoveable (roks), did verily slayBala, hurling (his darts against you), and force open his cities, and all his gates.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि धी॒भिर्हव्यो॒ अस्त्यु॒ग्र ई॑शान॒कृन्म॑ह॒ति वृ॑त्र॒तूर्ये॑ । स तो॒कसा॑ता॒ तन॑ये॒ स व॒ज्री वि॑तन्त॒साय्यो॑ अभवत्स॒मत्सु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ ugráḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀ mahatí ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀsáḥ ǀ toká-sātā ǀ tánaye ǀ sáḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ vitantasā́yyaḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ samát-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra, maker of rules you are he who is to be invoked with praise in a great conflict; you are he (who is to be invoked) for sons and grandsons, he, the wielder of the thunderbolt, who is to be especially glorified in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॒ज्मना॒ जनि॑म॒ मानु॑षाणा॒मम॑र्त्येन॒ नाम्नाति॒ प्र स॑र्स्रे । स द्यु॒म्नेन॒ स शव॑सो॒त रा॒या स वी॒र्ये॑ण॒ नृत॑म॒: समो॑काः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ majmánā ǀ jánima ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ ámartyena ǀ nā́mnā ǀ áti ǀ prá ǀ sarsre ǀsáḥ ǀ dyumnéna ǀ sáḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ utá ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vīryéṇa ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ sám-okāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With immortal, foe-humiliating might he has promoted the (multiplied) birth of mankind; he, the chief of leaders, dwells in the same dwelling with fame, with strength, with riches, with heroism.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यो न मु॒हे न मिथू॒ जनो॒ भूत्सु॒मन्तु॑नामा॒ चुमु॑रिं॒ धुनिं॑ च । वृ॒णक्पिप्रुं॒ शम्ब॑रं॒ शुष्ण॒मिन्द्र॑: पु॒रां च्यौ॒त्नाय॑ श॒यथा॑य॒ नू चि॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ná ǀ muhé ǀ ná ǀ míthu ǀ jánaḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ sumántu-nāmā ǀ cúmurim ǀ dhúnim ǀ ca ǀvṛṇák ǀ píprum ǀ śámbaram ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ índraḥ ǀ purā́m ǀ cyautnā́ya ǀ śayáthāya ǀ nú ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is never perplexed, who is no engenderer of that which is in vain, whose name is renowned, who promptly (exerts himself) for the overturning of the cities (of theasuras), and for the destruction (of his foes); you, (Indra), have indeed slain Cumuri,Dhuni, Pipru,Śambara, andŚuṣṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒दाव॑ता॒ त्वक्ष॑सा॒ पन्य॑सा च वृत्र॒हत्या॑य॒ रथ॑मिन्द्र तिष्ठ । धि॒ष्व वज्रं॒ हस्त॒ आ द॑क्षिण॒त्राभि प्र म॑न्द पुरुदत्र मा॒याः
shlokas.transliteration: ut-ávatā ǀ tvákṣasā ǀ pányasā ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-hátyāya ǀ rátham ǀ indra ǀ tiṣṭha ǀdhiṣvá ǀ vájram ǀ háste ǀ ā́ ǀ dakṣiṇa-trā́ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ manda ǀ puru-datra ǀ māyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Endowed) with upward-rising, foe-thinning, and glorified (vigour), ascend your car for the destruction ofVṛtra; take the thunderbolt in your righthand, giver of wealth, baffle the devices (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्न शुष्कं॒ वन॑मिन्द्र हे॒ती रक्षो॒ नि ध॑क्ष्य॒शनि॒र्न भी॒मा । ग॒म्भी॒रय॑ ऋ॒ष्वया॒ यो रु॒रोजाध्वा॑नयद्दुरि॒ता द॒म्भय॑च्च
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ śúṣkam ǀ vánam ǀ indra ǀ hetī́ḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhakṣi ǀ aśániḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmā́ ǀgambhīráyā ǀ ṛṣváyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ rurója ǀ ádhvanayat ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ dambháyat ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner asAgniconsumes the dry forest, so,Indra, your weapon (destroys your enemies); as (formidable as you) fearful shaft, consume therākṣasas; you who have shouted aloud (in the combat) and demolished all evil things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स॒हस्रं॑ प॒थिभि॑रिन्द्र रा॒या तुवि॑द्युम्न तुवि॒वाजे॑भिर॒र्वाक् । या॒हि सू॑नो सहसो॒ यस्य॒ नू चि॒ददे॑व॒ ईशे॑ पुरुहूत॒ योतो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ túvi-dyumna ǀ tuvi-vā́jebhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀyāhí ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ puru-hūta ǀ yótoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Opulent,Indra, son of strength, the invoker of many, whose union (with energy) the impious is unable to disjoint, come down to us with thousands of riches by very powerful conveyances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तु॑विद्यु॒म्नस्य॒ स्थवि॑रस्य॒ घृष्वे॑र्दि॒वो र॑रप्शे महि॒मा पृ॑थि॒व्याः । नास्य॒ शत्रु॒र्न प्र॑ति॒मान॑मस्ति॒ न प्र॑ति॒ष्ठिः पु॑रुमा॒यस्य॒ सह्यो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tuvi-dyumnásya ǀ sthávirasya ǀ ghṛ́ṣveḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ rarapśe ǀ mahimā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀná ǀ asya ǀ śátruḥ ǀ ná ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ asti ǀ ná ǀ prati-sthíḥ ǀ puru-māyásya ǀ sáhyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vastness of the affluent, ancient (Indra), the demolisher (of foes), exceeds that of the heaven and the earth; there is no antagonist, no counterpart, no recipient of him abounding in wisdom, victorious (in war).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते॑ अ॒द्या कर॑णं कृ॒तं भू॒त्कुत्सं॒ यदा॒युम॑तिथि॒ग्वम॑स्मै । पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॒ नि शि॑शा अ॒भि क्षामुत्तूर्व॑याणं धृष॒ता नि॑नेथ
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ káraṇam ǀ kṛtám ǀ bhūt ǀ kútsam ǀ yát ǀ āyúm ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ asmai ǀpurú ǀ sahásrā ǀ ní ǀ śiśāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣā́m ǀ út ǀ tū́rvayāṇam ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ ninetha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That exploit is celebrated in the present day (which you have) achieved forKutsa, for Āyu, for Atithigvave; to him you have given many thousands (of riches), and you have quickly elevated Turvayāṇa over the earth by your power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ त्वाहि॑घ्ने॒ अध॑ देव दे॒वा मद॒न्विश्वे॑ क॒वित॑मं कवी॒नाम् । करो॒ यत्र॒ वरि॑वो बाधि॒ताय॑ दि॒वे जना॑य त॒न्वे॑ गृणा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tvā ǀ áhi-ghne ǀ ádha ǀ deva ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mádan ǀ víśve ǀ kaví-tamam ǀ kavīnā́m ǀkáraḥ ǀ yátra ǀ várivaḥ ǀ bādhitā́ya ǀ divé ǀ jánāya ǀ tanvé ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineIndra, all the gods have glorified you, the wisest of the wise, for the destruction of Ahi; when propitiated, you have given wealth to the distressed worshipper, and to his posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी तत्त॒ ओजोऽम॑र्त्या जिहत इन्द्र दे॒वाः । कृ॒ष्वा कृ॑त्नो॒ अकृ॑तं॒ यत्ते॒ अस्त्यु॒क्थं नवी॑यो जनयस्व य॒ज्ञैः
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ámartyāḥ ǀ jihate ǀ indra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀkṛṣvá ǀ kṛtno íti ǀ ákṛtam ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ ukthám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ janayasva ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The heaven and earth, and the immortal gods, acknowledge your might; doer of many deeds, do that which is yet undone by you, give birth to a new hymn at (your) sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ इन्द्रो॑ नृ॒वदा च॑र्षणि॒प्रा उ॒त द्वि॒बर्हा॑ अमि॒नः सहो॑भिः । अ॒स्म॒द्र्य॑ग्वावृधे वी॒र्या॑यो॒रुः पृ॒थुः सुकृ॑तः क॒र्तृभि॑र्भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ ā́ ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ amináḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀasmadryák ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ urúḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ sú-kṛtaḥ ǀ kartṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the greatIndra, who is as a monarch the fulfiller (of the desires) of men, come hither; may he who is mighty over the two (realms of space), uninjurable by (hostile) offers, increase (in capacity) for heroism in our presence; may he who is great (in body), eminent (in qualities), be honoured by the performers (of pious acts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑मे॒व धि॒षणा॑ सा॒तये॑ धाद्बृ॒हन्त॑मृ॒ष्वम॒जरं॒ युवा॑नम् । अषा॑ळ्हेन॒ शव॑सा शूशु॒वांसं॑ स॒द्यश्चि॒द्यो वा॑वृ॒धे असा॑मि
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ evá ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ sātáye ǀ dhāt ǀ bṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ yúvānam ǀáṣāḷhena ǀ śávasā ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ ásāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our praise encouragesIndrao munificence, the vast, quick-moving, undecaying, ever-youthful Indra, mighty with unsurpassable strength, who rapidly grows to greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒थू क॒रस्ना॑ बहु॒ला गभ॑स्ती अस्म॒द्र्य१॒॑क्सं मि॑मीहि॒ श्रवां॑सि । यू॒थेव॑ प॒श्वः प॑शु॒पा दमू॑ना अ॒स्माँ इ॑न्द्रा॒भ्या व॑वृत्स्वा॒जौ
shlokas.transliteration: pṛthū́ íti ǀ karásnā ǀ bahulā́ ǀ gábhastī íti ǀ asmadryák ǀ sám ǀ mimīhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀyūthā́-iva ǀ paśváḥ ǀ paśu-pā́ḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛtsva ǀ ājáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Extend towards us your long, active, and bountifulhands, (to bring us) food; be abot us, lowly-mindedIndra, in battle, as a herdsman (tends) the herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॒ इन्द्रं॑ च॒तिन॑मस्य शा॒कैरि॒ह नू॒नं वा॑ज॒यन्तो॑ हुवेम । यथा॑ चि॒त्पूर्वे॑ जरि॒तार॑ आ॒सुरने॑द्या अनव॒द्या अरि॑ष्टाः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ catínam ǀ asya ǀ śākáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ nūnám ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ huvema ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ pū́rve ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ ánedyāḥ ǀ anavadyā́ḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring sustenance, we invoke you, the renownedIndra, on this occasion, the destroyer (of enemies), together with his powerful allies (theMaruts); as his ancient adorers have been, (may we be), exempt from blame, irreproachable, unharmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धृ॒तव्र॑तो धन॒दाः सोम॑वृद्ध॒: स हि वा॒मस्य॒ वसु॑नः पुरु॒क्षुः । सं ज॑ग्मिरे प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ रायो॑ अस्मिन्त्समु॒द्रे न सिन्ध॑वो॒ याद॑मानाः
shlokas.transliteration: dhṛtá-vrataḥ ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ sóma-vṛddhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ vāmásya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ puru-kṣúḥ ǀsám ǀ jagmire ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ asmin ǀ samudré ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ yā́damānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In him who is observant of pious rites, who is a giver of wealth, who is exalted by theSoma, the (lord) of desirable riches, the distributor of food, (in him) the treasures fit (for his worshippers) congregate like rivers flowing into ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शवि॑ष्ठं न॒ आ भ॑र शूर॒ शव॒ ओजि॑ष्ठ॒मोजो॑ अभिभूत उ॒ग्रम् । विश्वा॑ द्यु॒म्ना वृष्ण्या॒ मानु॑षाणाम॒स्मभ्यं॑ दा हरिवो माद॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: śáviṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ śūra ǀ śávaḥ ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ ójaḥ ǀ abhi-bhūte ǀ ugrám ǀvíśvā ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dāḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mādayádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us, heroIndra, most vigorous vigour; subduer (of enemies, bestow upon us) most energetic and fierce energy; grant, lord of steeds, all the bright and invigorating (treasures) fit for men, to make us happy.”

shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ pṛtanāṣā́ṭ ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ índra ǀ tám ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀyéna ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ sātáu ǀ maṃsīmáhi ǀ jigīvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: вЂњImpart to us,Indra, that your invigorating exultatio which overcomes enemies, and is irresistible, where by, protected by you, triumphant we may glorify you for the sake of (obtaining) sons and grandsons.вЂќ

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ भर॒ वृष॑णं॒ शुष्म॑मिन्द्र धन॒स्पृतं॑ शूशु॒वांसं॑ सु॒दक्ष॑म् । येन॒ वंसा॑म॒ पृत॑नासु॒ शत्रू॒न्तवो॒तिभि॑रु॒त जा॒मीँरजा॑मीन्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ indra ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ su-dákṣam ǀyéna ǀ váṃsāma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śátrūn ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ jāmī́n ǀ ájāmīn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,Indra, vigorous strenght, the realizer of wealth, great and propitious, wherewith, thorugh your protection, we may destroy our enemies in battles, whether they be kinsmen or strangers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॒ शुष्मो॑ वृष॒भ ए॑तु प॒श्चादोत्त॒राद॑ध॒रादा पु॒रस्ता॑त् । आ वि॒श्वतो॑ अ॒भि समे॑त्व॒र्वाङिन्द्र॑ द्यु॒म्नं स्व॑र्वद्धेह्य॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ etu ǀ paścā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ uttarā́t ǀ adharā́t ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ índra ǀ dyumnám ǀ sváḥ-vat ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your invigorating srength come from the west, from the north, from the south, from the east; may it come to us from every quarter; grant us riches combined with felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒वत्त॑ इन्द्र॒ नृत॑माभिरू॒ती वं॑सी॒महि॑ वा॒मं श्रोम॑तेभिः । ईक्षे॒ हि वस्व॑ उ॒भय॑स्य राज॒न्धा रत्नं॒ महि॑ स्थू॒रं बृ॒हन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-vát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ nṛ́-tamābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ vaṃsīmáhi ǀ vāmám ǀ śrómatebhiḥ ǀī́kṣe ǀ hí ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ rājan ǀ dhā́ḥ ǀ rátnam ǀ máhi ǀ sthūrám ǀ bṛhántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We enjoy,Indra, through your guiding protection, desirable affluence along with descendants and reputation; grant us, sovereign, who rule over (earthly and heavenly) riches, vast, desirable and infinite treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒रुत्व॑न्तं वृष॒भं वा॑वृधा॒नमक॑वारिं दि॒व्यं शा॒समिन्द्र॑म् । वि॒श्वा॒साह॒मव॑से॒ नूत॑नायो॒ग्रं स॑हो॒दामि॒ह तं हु॑वेम
shlokas.transliteration: marútvantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ ákava-arim ǀ divyám ǀ śāsám ǀ índram ǀviśva-sáham ǀ ávase ǀ nū́tanāya ǀ ugrám ǀ sahaḥ-dā́m ǀ ihá ǀ tám ǀ huvema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke on this occasion for his present protection, thatIndrawho is attended by theMaruts; who is the showerer (of benefits); augmenting (in prowess); the unreviled of foes, radiant, ruling, all-subduing, fierce, the giver of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जनं॑ वज्रि॒न्महि॑ चि॒न्मन्य॑मानमे॒भ्यो नृभ्यो॑ रन्धया॒ येष्वस्मि॑ । अधा॒ हि त्वा॑ पृथि॒व्यां शूर॑सातौ॒ हवा॑महे॒ तन॑ये॒ गोष्व॒प्सु
shlokas.transliteration: jánam ǀ vajrin ǀ máhi ǀ cit ǀ mányamānam ǀ ebhyáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ randhaya ǀ yéṣu ǀ ásmi ǀádha ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ hávāmahe ǀ tánaye ǀ góṣu ǀ ap-sú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, humble that man who looks upon himself as the greatest among those men of whom I am; we invoke you now to (ascend) upon the earth at the time of battle, and for (the sake of obtaining) sond and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं त॑ ए॒भिः पु॑रुहूत स॒ख्यैः शत्रो॑:शत्रो॒रुत्त॑र॒ इत्स्या॑म । घ्नन्तो॑ वृ॒त्राण्यु॒भया॑नि शूर रा॒या म॑देम बृह॒ता त्वोता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ sakhyáiḥ ǀ śátroḥ-śatroḥ ǀ út-tare ǀ ít ǀ syāma ǀghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ubháyāni ǀ śūra ǀ rāyā́ ǀ madema ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked of many, may we, through these your friendly (praises), ever be superior to successive foes, destroying, oḥ hero, both (classes of) enemies, (kindred or unallied); and may we, protected by you, be happy with abundant riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यौर्न य इ॑न्द्रा॒भि भूमा॒र्यस्त॒स्थौ र॒यिः शव॑सा पृ॒त्सु जना॑न् । तं न॑: स॒हस्र॑भरमुर्वरा॒सां द॒द्धि सू॑नो सहसो वृत्र॒तुर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ bhū́ma ǀ aryáḥ ǀ tastháu ǀ rayíḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ jánān ǀtám ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásra-bharam ǀ urvarā-sā́m ǀ daddhí ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vṛtra-túram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, son of strength, grant us (a son), the possessor of thousands, the owner of cultivated lands, the usbduer of foes, the riches that may overcome men in battles by strength, as the radiant (sun) overspreads the earth by his rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न तुभ्य॒मन्वि॑न्द्र स॒त्रासु॒र्यं॑ दे॒वेभि॑र्धायि॒ विश्व॑म् । अहिं॒ यद्वृ॒त्रम॒पो व॑व्रि॒वांसं॒ हन्नृ॑जीषि॒न्विष्णु॑ना सचा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ túbhyam ǀ ánu ǀ indra ǀ satrā́ ǀ asuryám ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ víśvam ǀáhim ǀ yát ǀ vṛtrám ǀ apáḥ ǀ vavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ hán ǀ ṛjīṣin ǀ víṣṇunā ǀ sacānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Indra, as to the sun, all strength has verily been given by the gods; so that, drinker of the staleSoma, associated withViṣṇu, you mightiest slay the hostile Ahi obstructing the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तूर्व॒न्नोजी॑यान्त॒वस॒स्तवी॑यान्कृ॒तब्र॒ह्मेन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धम॑हाः । राजा॑भव॒न्मधु॑नः सो॒म्यस्य॒ विश्वा॑सां॒ यत्पु॒रां द॒र्त्नुमाव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tū́rvan ǀ ójīyān ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ távīyān ǀ kṛtá-brahmā ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛddhá-mahāḥ ǀrā́jā ǀ abhavat ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ somyásya ǀ víśvāsām ǀ yát ǀ purā́m ǀ dartnúm ǀ ā́vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndra, the destroyer, the most mighty, the strongest of the strong, the giver of food, the possessor of vast splendour, received (the thunderbolt), the shatterer of all the cities (of theasuras), he became the lord of the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तैर॑पद्रन्प॒णय॑ इ॒न्द्रात्र॒ दशो॑णये क॒वये॒ऽर्कसा॑तौ । व॒धैः शुष्ण॑स्या॒शुष॑स्य मा॒याः पि॒त्वो नारि॑रेची॒त्किं च॒न प्र
shlokas.transliteration: śatáiḥ ǀ apadran ǀ paṇáyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ átra ǀ dáśa-oṇaye ǀ kaváye ǀ arká-sātau ǀvadháiḥ ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ aśúṣasya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ pitváḥ ǀ ná ǀ arirecīt ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ prá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThePaṇis,Indra, fled, with hundres (ofasuras), from the sage, your worshipper (and ally) in battle; neither did e, (Indra), suffer the deceptions of the powerfulŚuṣṇato prevail over his weapons, nor did he (leave him) any of his sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो द्रु॒हो अप॑ वि॒श्वायु॑ धायि॒ वज्र॑स्य॒ यत्पत॑ने॒ पादि॒ शुष्ण॑: । उ॒रु ष स॒रथं॒ सार॑थये क॒रिन्द्र॒: कुत्सा॑य॒ सूर्य॑स्य सा॒तौ
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ druháḥ ǀ ápa ǀ viśvá-āyu ǀ dhāyi ǀ vájrasya ǀ yát ǀ pátane ǀ pā́di ǀ śúṣṇaḥ ǀurú ǀ sáḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ sā́rathaye ǀ kaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kútsāya ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sātáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenŚuṣṇapassed away upon the falling of the thunderbolt, then the universal strength of the great oppressor was annihilated, andIndraenlarged their common car for (the use of) his charioteerKutsa, for (the sake of) the worship of the sn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र श्ये॒नो न म॑दि॒रमं॒शुम॑स्मै॒ शिरो॑ दा॒सस्य॒ नमु॑चेर्मथा॒यन् । प्राव॒न्नमीं॑ सा॒प्यं स॒सन्तं॑ पृ॒णग्रा॒या समि॒षा सं स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ madirám ǀ aṃśúm ǀ asmai ǀ śíraḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ námuceḥ ǀ mathāyán ǀprá ǀ āvat ǀ námīm ǀ sāpyám ǀ sasántam ǀ pṛṇák ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ sám ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And the hawk bore toIndrathe exhilaratingSoma, when, bruising the head of the oppressorNamuci, and protecting the slumberingNami, the son ofSapya, he provided, for the weeell-being (of the sage), riches and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि पिप्रो॒रहि॑मायस्य दृ॒ळ्हाः पुरो॑ वज्रि॒ञ्छव॑सा॒ न द॑र्दः । सुदा॑म॒न्तद्रेक्णो॑ अप्रमृ॒ष्यमृ॒जिश्व॑ने दा॒त्रं दा॒शुषे॑ दाः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ píproḥ ǀ áhi-māyasya ǀ dṛḷhā́ḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ śávasā ǀ ná ǀ dardaríti dardaḥ ǀsú-dāman ǀ tát ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ apra-mṛṣyám ǀ ṛjíśvane ǀ dātrám ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have scatered by force, wielder of the thunderbolt, the strong cities of the deadly-deluding Pipru; you have given, bountifulIndra, uninjurable wealh to rijiṣvat, the donor of sacrificial gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वे॑त॒सुं दश॑मायं॒ दशो॑णिं॒ तूतु॑जि॒मिन्द्र॑: स्वभि॒ष्टिसु॑म्नः । आ तुग्रं॒ शश्व॒दिभं॒ द्योत॑नाय मा॒तुर्न सी॒मुप॑ सृजा इ॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vetasúm ǀ dáśa-māyam ǀ dáśa-oṇim ǀ tū́tujim ǀ índraḥ ǀ svabhiṣṭí-sumnaḥ ǀā́ ǀ túgram ǀ śáśvat ǀ íbham ǀ dyótanāya ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ná ǀ sīm ǀ úpa ǀ sṛja ǀ iyádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the granter of wished-for felicity, compelled the many-fraudulentEtaśaand Dasoṇi, Tūtuji,TugraandIbha, always to come submissively to (therājā)Dyotana, as a son (comes before a mother).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॒ स्पृधो॑ वनते॒ अप्र॑तीतो॒ बिभ्र॒द्वज्रं॑ वृत्र॒हणं॒ गभ॑स्तौ । तिष्ठ॒द्धरी॒ अध्यस्ते॑व॒ गर्ते॑ वचो॒युजा॑ वहत॒ इन्द्र॑मृ॒ष्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ vanate ǀ áprati-itaḥ ǀ bíbhrat ǀ vájram ǀ vṛtra-hánam ǀ gábhastau ǀtíṣṭhat ǀ hárī íti ǀ ádhi ǀ ástā-iva ǀ gárte ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ vahataḥ ǀ índram ǀ ṛṣvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearing in hishandthe foe-destroyig thunderbolt,Indra, unresisted, demolishing those his adversaries; he mounts his two-horse (car), as a warrior (ascends) his chariot; harnessed at a word, his steeds, convey the migty Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒नेम॒ तेऽव॑सा॒ नव्य॑ इन्द्र॒ प्र पू॒रव॑: स्तवन्त ए॒ना य॒ज्ञैः । स॒प्त यत्पुर॒: शर्म॒ शार॑दी॒र्दर्द्धन्दासी॑: पुरु॒कुत्सा॑य॒ शिक्ष॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sanéma ǀ te ǀ ávasā ǀ návyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ pūrávaḥ ǀ stavante ǀ enā́ ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀsaptá ǀ yát ǀ púraḥ ǀ śárma ǀ śā́radīḥ ǀ dárt ǀ hán ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ puru-kútsāya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Favoured) by your proection,Indra, we solicit new (wealth); by this adoration men glorify you at sacrifices, for that you have shattered with your bolt the seven cities ofŚarat, killing the opponents (of sacred rites), killing the opponents (of sacred rites), and giving (their spoils) toPurukutsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं वृ॒ध इ॑न्द्र पू॒र्व्यो भू॑र्वरिव॒स्यन्नु॒शने॑ का॒व्याय॑ । परा॒ नव॑वास्त्वमनु॒देयं॑ म॒हे पि॒त्रे द॑दाथ॒ स्वं नपा॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ varivasyán ǀ uśáne ǀ kāvyā́ya ǀpárā ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ anu-déyam ǀ mahé ǀ pitré ǀ dadātha ǀ svám ǀ nápātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of opulence, you,Indra, have been an ancient benefactor ofUśanas, the son ofKavi; having slain Navavāstva, you have given back his own grandson, who was (fit) to be restored o the grandfather.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं धुनि॑रिन्द्र॒ धुनि॑मतीॠ॒णोर॒पः सी॒रा न स्रव॑न्तीः । प्र यत्स॑मु॒द्रमति॑ शूर॒ पर्षि॑ पा॒रया॑ तु॒र्वशं॒ यदुं॑ स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ indra ǀ dhúni-matīḥ ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ srávantīḥ ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ samudrám ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ párṣi ǀ pāráya ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, who make (your enemies) tremble, have caused the waters, detained byDhuni, to flow like rushing rivers; so, hero, when, having crossed the ocean, you have reached the shore, you have brought over in safetyTurvaśaandYadu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ ह॒ त्यदि॑न्द्र॒ विश्व॑मा॒जौ स॒स्तो धुनी॒चुमु॑री॒ या ह॒ सिष्व॑प् । दी॒दय॒दित्तुभ्यं॒ सोमे॑भिः सु॒न्वन्द॒भीति॑रि॒ध्मभृ॑तिः प॒क्थ्य१॒॑र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ víśvam ǀ ājáu ǀ sastáḥ ǀ dhúnīcúmurī íti ǀ yā́ ǀ ha ǀ sísvap ǀdīdáyat ǀ ít ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ sunván ǀ dabhī́tiḥ ǀ idhmá-bhṛtiḥ ǀ pakthī́ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All this,Indra, has been your work in war; you have put to sleep, (in depth), the slumberingDhunīand Cumurī; and thereuponDabhīti, pouring the libation, preparing the oblation, and supplying the fuel, has glorified you withSomaofferings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पुरु॒तम॑स्य का॒रोर्हव्यं॑ वीर॒ हव्या॑ हवन्ते । धियो॑ रथे॒ष्ठाम॒जरं॒ नवी॑यो र॒यिर्विभू॑तिरीयते वच॒स्या
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puru-támasya ǀ kāróḥ ǀ hávyam ǀ vīra ǀ hávyāḥ ǀ havante ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ ajáram ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ ví-bhūtiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vacasyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These earnest adorations of the much-desiring worshipper glorify you, hero,Indra, who are adorable; mounted on your car, undecaying, ever new, and to whom the wealth (of sacrifice), the most excellent opulence, proceeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ स्तुष॒ इन्द्रं॒ यो विदा॑नो॒ गिर्वा॑हसं गी॒र्भिर्य॒ज्ञवृ॑द्धम् । यस्य॒ दिव॒मति॑ म॒ह्ना पृ॑थि॒व्याः पु॑रुमा॒यस्य॑ रिरि॒चे म॑हि॒त्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuṣe ǀ índram ǀ yáḥ ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ gírvāhasam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yajñá-vṛddham ǀyásya ǀ dívam ǀ áti ǀ mahnā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ puru-māyásya ǀ riricé ǀ mahi-tvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorifyi thatIndrawho is propitiated by praises, exalted by sacrifices, who knows all things; the magnitude of whom, the possessor of various wisdom, exceeds in vastness (that of) heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इत्तमो॑ऽवयु॒नं त॑त॒न्वत्सूर्ये॑ण व॒युन॑वच्चकार । क॒दा ते॒ मर्ता॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ धामेय॑क्षन्तो॒ न मि॑नन्ति स्वधावः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ támaḥ ǀ avayunám ǀ tatanvát ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ vayúna-vat ǀ cakāra ǀkadā́ ǀ te ǀ mártāḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ íyakṣantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who made the indistinct, wide-spreading darkness distinct with the sun; whenever, possessor of strength, mortals are seeking to adore the dwelling of you who are an immortal, they harm not (any living being).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ता च॒कार॒ स कुह॑ स्वि॒दिन्द्र॒: कमा जनं॑ चरति॒ कासु॑ वि॒क्षु । कस्ते॑ य॒ज्ञो मन॑से॒ शं वरा॑य॒ को अ॒र्क इ॑न्द्र कत॒मः स होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ sáḥ ǀ kúha ǀ svit ǀ índraḥ ǀ kám ǀ ā́ ǀ jánam ǀ carati ǀ kā́su ǀ vikṣú ǀkáḥ ǀ te ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ mánase ǀ śám ǀ várāya ǀ káḥ ǀ arkáḥ ǀ indra ǀ katamáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What is he, theIndrawho has done these deeds? What region does he frequent? Amog what people (does he abide)? What worship, Indra, gives satisfaction to your mind? What praise is able to gratify you? Which of your invokers (is most acceptable to you)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दा हि ते॒ वेवि॑षतः पुरा॒जाः प्र॒त्नास॑ आ॒सुः पु॑रुकृ॒त्सखा॑यः । ये म॑ध्य॒मास॑ उ॒त नूत॑नास उ॒ताव॒मस्य॑ पुरुहूत बोधि
shlokas.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ véviṣataḥ ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ puru-kṛt ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀyé ǀ madhyamā́saḥ ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǀ utá ǀ avamásya ǀ puru-hūta ǀ bodhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Doer of many deeds, these adders, born in former times, engaged in sacred rites, have been, as they are now, your friends; so have those of mediaeval and those of recent (date); therefore, invoked of many, take notice of your (present) humble (adorer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं पृ॒च्छन्तोऽव॑रास॒: परा॑णि प्र॒त्ना त॑ इन्द्र॒ श्रुत्यानु॑ येमुः । अर्चा॑मसि वीर ब्रह्मवाहो॒ यादे॒व वि॒द्म तात्त्वा॑ म॒हान्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ pṛcchántaḥ ǀ ávarāsaḥ ǀ párāṇi ǀ pratnā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ śrútyā ǀ ánu ǀ yemuḥ ǀárcāmasi ǀ vīra ǀ brahma-vāhaḥ ǀ yā́t ǀ evá ǀ vidmá ǀ tā́t ǀ tvā ǀ mahā́ntam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Humble (worshippers), adoring him, commemorate,Indra, your excellent, ancient, and glorious (deeds); so, hero, who are attracted by prayer, we praise you who are mighty, for those great actions with which we are acquained.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॒ पाजो॑ र॒क्षसो॒ वि त॑स्थे॒ महि॑ जज्ञा॒नम॒भि तत्सु ति॑ष्ठ । तव॑ प्र॒त्नेन॒ युज्ये॑न॒ सख्या॒ वज्रे॑ण धृष्णो॒ अप॒ ता नु॑दस्व
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthe ǀ máhi ǀ jajñānám ǀ abhí ǀ tát ǀ sú ǀ tiṣṭha ǀtáva ǀ pratnéna ǀ yújyena ǀ sákhyā ǀ vájreṇa ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ápa ǀ tā́ ǀ nudasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The strength of therākṣasasis concentrated against you; bear up well against that mighty manifested (effort); scatter them, valiant (Indra), with your old associate, your friend, the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तु श्रु॑धीन्द्र॒ नूत॑नस्य ब्रह्मण्य॒तो वी॑र कारुधायः । त्वं ह्या॒३॒॑पिः प्र॒दिवि॑ पितॄ॒णां शश्व॑द्ब॒भूथ॑ सु॒हव॒ एष्टौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ śrudhi ǀ indra ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ brahmaṇyatáḥ ǀ vīra ǀ kāru-dhāyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ āpíḥ ǀ pra-dívi ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ śáśvat ǀ babhū́tha ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ ā́-iṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Supporter of (your) worshippers, hero,Indra, listen (to the praises) of your present adorer, for you have always attended to invocations at sacrifices in ancient times, as the kinsman of our forefather.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रोतये॒ वरु॑णं मि॒त्रमिन्द्रं॑ म॒रुत॑: कृ॒ष्वाव॑से नो अ॒द्य । प्र पू॒षणं॒ विष्णु॑म॒ग्निं पुरं॑धिं सवि॒तार॒मोष॑धी॒: पर्व॑ताँश्च
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ūtáye ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ índram ǀ marútaḥ ǀ kṛṣva ǀ ávase ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀprá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ víṣṇum ǀ agním ǀ púram-dhim ǀ savitā́ram ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ párvatān ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiate today, for our protection and preservation,Varuṇa,Mitra,Indraand theMaruts,Pūṣan,Viṣṇu,Agni, of many rites,Savitā, the herbs, the mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒म उ॑ त्वा पुरुशाक प्रयज्यो जरि॒तारो॑ अ॒भ्य॑र्चन्त्य॒र्कैः । श्रु॒धी हव॒मा हु॑व॒तो हु॑वा॒नो न त्वावाँ॑ अ॒न्यो अ॑मृत॒ त्वद॑स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puru-śāka ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀśrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ huvatáḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ anyáḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ tvát ǀ asti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of great power, and to be devoutly worshipped, these your adorers glorify you with hymns; do you, who are invoked, hear the invocation of (him) invoking you, for there is no other divinity than you, immortal (Indra), such as you are.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू म॒ आ वाच॒मुप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान्विश्वे॑भिः सूनो सहसो॒ यज॑त्रैः । ये अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वा ऋ॑त॒साप॑ आ॒सुर्ये मनुं॑ च॒क्रुरुप॑रं॒ दसा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yájatraiḥ ǀyé ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ āsúḥ ǀ yé ǀ mánum ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ úparam ǀ dásāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly, son of strength, you who know (all things), upon my prayer; together with all the adorable (divinities); they who, with the tongue ofAgni, are partakers of the sacrifice, who renderedManu(victorious) over his adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ बोधि पुरए॒ता सु॒गेषू॒त दु॒र्गेषु॑ पथि॒कृद्विदा॑नः । ये अश्र॑मास उ॒रवो॒ वहि॑ष्ठा॒स्तेभि॑र्न इन्द्रा॒भि व॑क्षि॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ su-géṣu ǀ utá ǀ duḥ-géṣu ǀ pathi-kṛ́t ǀ vídānaḥ ǀyé ǀ áśramāsaḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhí ǀ vakṣi ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Constructor of paths, who are cognizant (of all things), be our preceder, whether in easy or difficult (ways); bring to us food,Indra, with those your (steeds), who are unwearied, large, and bearers of great burdens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एक॒ इद्धव्य॑श्चर्षणी॒नामिन्द्रं॒ तं गी॒र्भिर॒भ्य॑र्च आ॒भिः । यः पत्य॑ते वृष॒भो वृष्ण्या॑वान्त्स॒त्यः सत्वा॑ पुरुमा॒यः सह॑स्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ índram ǀ tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arce ǀ ābhíḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ pátyate ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇya-vān ǀ satyáḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ puru-māyáḥ ǀ sáhasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with these praises,Indra, who alone is to be invoked by man; who comes (to his worshippers) the showerer (of benefits), the vigorous, the observer of truth, the subduer of foes, the possessor of manifold knowledge, the mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तरो॒ नव॑ग्वाः स॒प्त विप्रा॑सो अ॒भि वा॒जय॑न्तः । न॒क्ष॒द्दा॒भं ततु॑रिं पर्वते॒ष्ठामद्रो॑घवाचं म॒तिभि॒: शवि॑ष्ठम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀnakṣat-dābhám ǀ táturim ǀ parvate-sthā́m ǀ ádrogha-vācam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ śáviṣṭham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him the seven sages, our ancient progenitors, performing the nine days' rite, were offerers of (sacrificial) food, celebrating with hymns the very strong (Indra), the humiliator of foes, the traverser of the heavens, he dweller in the clouds, whose commands are not to be disobeyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॑मह॒ इन्द्र॑मस्य रा॒यः पु॑रु॒वीर॑स्य नृ॒वत॑: पुरु॒क्षोः । यो अस्कृ॑धोयुर॒जर॒: स्व॑र्वा॒न्तमा भ॑र हरिवो माद॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īmahe ǀ índram ǀ asya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-vī́rasya ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ áskṛdhoyuḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ sváḥ-vān ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mādayádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit thatIndrafor wealth, comprehending numerous descendants, followers and much cattle, and which is undisturbed, imperishable, and the source of felicity, such riches, lord of steeds, bestow upon us to make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नो॒ वि वो॑चो॒ यदि॑ ते पु॒रा चि॑ज्जरि॒तार॑ आन॒शुः सु॒म्नमि॑न्द्र । कस्ते॑ भा॒गः किं वयो॑ दुध्र खिद्व॒: पुरु॑हूत पुरूवसोऽसुर॒घ्नः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ví ǀ vocaḥ ǀ yádi ǀ te ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ indra ǀkáḥ ǀ te ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ kím ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dudhra ǀ khidvaḥ ǀ púru-hūta ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ asura-ghnáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If,Indra, your worshippers have formerly obtained felicity, confer that also upon us; irresistible Indra, subduer of foes, invoked of many, abounding in wealth, what is the portion, what the offering (due) to you who are the slayer of theasuras?”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं पृ॒च्छन्ती॒ वज्र॑हस्तं रथे॒ष्ठामिन्द्रं॒ वेपी॒ वक्व॑री॒ यस्य॒ नू गीः । तु॒वि॒ग्रा॒भं तु॑विकू॒र्मिं र॑भो॒दां गा॒तुमि॑षे॒ नक्ष॑ते॒ तुम्र॒मच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ pṛcchántī ǀ vájra-hastam ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ índram ǀ vépī ǀ vákvarī ǀ yásya ǀ nú ǀ gī́ḥ ǀtuvi-grābhám ǀ tuvi-kūrmím ǀ rabhaḥ-dā́m ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣe ǀ nákṣate ǀ túmram ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whose ceremonial and eulogistic hymn is commemoratingIndra, the holder of the thunderbolt, seated in his car, the accepter of many, the doer of many great deeds, the bestower of strength, proceeds promptly to acquire happiness, and encounters (with confidence) the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या ह॒ त्यं मा॒यया॑ वावृधा॒नं म॑नो॒जुवा॑ स्वतव॒: पर्व॑तेन । अच्यु॑ता चिद्वीळि॒ता स्वो॑जो रु॒जो वि दृ॒ळ्हा धृ॑ष॒ता वि॑रप्शिन्
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ ha ǀ tyám ǀ māyáyā ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ manaḥ-júvā ǀ sva-tavaḥ ǀ párvatena ǀácyutā ǀ cit ǀ vīḷitā́ ǀ su-ojaḥ ǀ rujáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ vi-rapśin ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Self-invigoratedIndra, you have crushed by your knotted (thunderbolt), quick as thought, thatVṛtra, growing in strength by this cunning; very radiant and mighty (Indra), you have demolished by (your) irresistible (shaft) the unyielding, compact, and strong (cities of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वो॑ धि॒या नव्य॑स्या॒ शवि॑ष्ठं प्र॒त्नं प्र॑त्न॒वत्प॑रितंस॒यध्यै॑ । स नो॑ वक्षदनिमा॒नः सु॒वह्मेन्द्रो॒ विश्वा॒न्यति॑ दु॒र्गहा॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ návyasyā ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ pratnám ǀ pratna-vát ǀ pari-taṃsayádhyai ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vakṣat ǀ ani-mānáḥ ǀ su-váhnā ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-gáhāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I have undertaken) to spread around with a new hymn, as i was done of old, (the glory of) you, the ancient and most mighty (Indra); may that Indra, who is illimitable, and is a sure conveyance, bear us over all difficulties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जना॑य॒ द्रुह्व॑णे॒ पार्थि॑वानि दि॒व्यानि॑ दीपयो॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षा । तपा॑ वृषन्वि॒श्वत॑: शो॒चिषा॒ तान्ब्र॑ह्म॒द्विषे॑ शोचय॒ क्षाम॒पश्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ drúhvaṇe ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ divyā́ni ǀ dīpayaḥ ǀ antárikṣā ǀtápa ǀ vṛṣan ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ śocíṣā ǀ tā́n ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ śocaya ǀ kṣā́m ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make hot the regions of earth, of heaven, of mid air, for the oppressive race (of therākṣasas); showerer (of benefits), consume them everywhere with your radiance, make the heaven and the firmament (too) hot for the impious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुवो॒ जन॑स्य दि॒व्यस्य॒ राजा॒ पार्थि॑वस्य॒ जग॑तस्त्वेषसंदृक् । धि॒ष्व वज्रं॒ दक्षि॑ण इन्द्र॒ हस्ते॒ विश्वा॑ अजुर्य दयसे॒ वि मा॒याः
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ jánasya ǀ divyásya ǀ rā́jā ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tveṣa-sandṛk ǀdhiṣvá ǀ vájram ǀ dákṣiṇe ǀ indra ǀ háste ǀ víśvā ǀ ajurya ǀ dayase ǀ ví ǀ māyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright-flamingIndra, you are the king of the people of heaven, and of the moving races of earth; grasp in your righthandthe thunderbolt, wherewith, Indra, who are beyond all praise, you baffle all the devices (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सं॒यत॑मिन्द्र णः स्व॒स्तिं श॑त्रु॒तूर्या॑य बृह॒तीममृ॑ध्राम् । यया॒ दासा॒न्यार्या॑णि वृ॒त्रा करो॑ वज्रिन्त्सु॒तुका॒ नाहु॑षाणि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sam-yátam ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ svastím ǀ śatru-tū́ryāya ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ámṛdhrām ǀyáyā ǀ dā́sāni ǀ ā́ryāṇi ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ káraḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ su-túkā ǀ nā́huṣāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brin to us,Indra, concentrated, vast and unassailable prosperity beyond the reach of enemies, and by which, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have rendered human enemies, whetherDāsasorĀryas, easy to be overcome.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ नि॒युद्भि॑: पुरुहूत वेधो वि॒श्ववा॑राभि॒रा ग॑हि प्रयज्यो । न या अदे॑वो॒ वर॑ते॒ न दे॒व आभि॑र्याहि॒ तूय॒मा म॑द्र्य॒द्रिक्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vedhaḥ ǀ viśvá-vārābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǀná ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ várate ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ābhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ madryadrík ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked of many, creator, object of sacrifices, come to us with your all-admired steeds, whom neitherasuranor deity arrests; come with them quickly to our presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त इत्त्वं निमि॑श्ल इन्द्र॒ सोमे॒ स्तोमे॒ ब्रह्म॑णि श॒स्यमा॑न उ॒क्थे । यद्वा॑ यु॒क्ताभ्यां॑ मघव॒न्हरि॑भ्यां॒ बिभ्र॒द्वज्रं॑ बा॒ह्वोरि॑न्द्र॒ यासि॑
shlokas.transliteration: suté ǀ ít ǀ tvám ǀ ní-miślaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sóme ǀ stóme ǀ bráhmaṇi ǀ śasyámāne ǀ ukthé ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ yuktā́bhyām ǀ magha-van ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ bíbhrat ǀ vájram ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ indra ǀ yā́si ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, when theSomais being effused, the sacred hymn chanted, the prayer recited, be you prepared (to harness your horses), or,Maghavan, with your horses ready harnessed, come (hither), bearing the thunderbolt in yourhand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑ दि॒वि पार्ये॒ सुष्वि॑मिन्द्र वृत्र॒हत्येऽव॑सि॒ शूर॑सातौ । यद्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य बि॒भ्युषो॒ अबि॑भ्य॒दर॑न्धय॒: शर्ध॑त इन्द्र॒ दस्यू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ diví ǀ pā́rye ǀ súsvim ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ ávasi ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ bibhyúṣaḥ ǀ ábibhyat ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ indra ǀ dásyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or as, although engaged in heaven in the hero-animating conflict with foes, you protect the offerer of the libation, and humblest, undauntedIndra, theDasyus, the disturbers of the pious and terrified worshipper, (so do you come when thesomais effused.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पाता॑ सु॒तमिन्द्रो॑ अस्तु॒ सोमं॑ प्रणे॒नीरु॒ग्रो ज॑रि॒तार॑मू॒ती । कर्ता॑ वी॒राय॒ सुष्व॑य उ लो॒कं दाता॒ वसु॑ स्तुव॒ते की॒रये॑ चित्
shlokas.transliteration: pā́tā ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómam ǀ pra-nenī́ḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ ūtī́ ǀkártā ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ súsvaye ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ dā́tā ǀ vásu ǀ stuvaté ǀ kīráye ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndrabe the drinker of the effusedsoma, he who is the fierce conductor of the worshipper to security; may he be the donor of the world to the presenter of the libation, the giver of wealth to the man who adores him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गन्तेया॑न्ति॒ सव॑ना॒ हरि॑भ्यां ब॒भ्रिर्वज्रं॑ प॒पिः सोमं॑ द॒दिर्गाः । कर्ता॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॒ सर्व॑वीरं॒ श्रोता॒ हवं॑ गृण॒तः स्तोम॑वाहाः
shlokas.transliteration: gántā ǀ íyanti ǀ sávanā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ babhríḥ ǀ vájram ǀ papíḥ ǀ sómam ǀ dadíḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀkártā ǀ vīrám ǀ náryam ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ śrótā ǀ hávam ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ stóma-vāhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, with his steeds, come o us as many (daily) rites (as may be celebrated), bearing the thundeerbolt, drinking thesoma, bestowing cattle, granting manly and multiplied posterity, hearing the invocation of his adorer, and being the accenter of (our) praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्मै॑ व॒यं यद्वा॒वान॒ तद्वि॑विष्म॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ यो न॑: प्र॒दिवो॒ अप॒स्कः । सु॒ते सोमे॑ स्तु॒मसि॒ शंस॑दु॒क्थेन्द्रा॑य॒ ब्रह्म॒ वर्ध॑नं॒ यथास॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ásmai ǀ vayám ǀ yát ǀ vavā́na ǀ tát ǀ viviṣmaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ápaḥ ǀ káríti káḥ ǀsuté ǀ sóme ǀ stumási ǀ śáṃsat ǀ ukthā́ ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ várdhanam ǀ yáthā ǀ ásat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thatIndra, who of old has rendered us good offices, we address (the praise) that he is plural ased by; we celebrate him when thesomais effused, repeating the prayer that the (sacrificial) food (offered) to Indra may be for his augmentation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ हि च॑कृ॒षे वर्ध॑नानि॒ ताव॑त्त इन्द्र म॒तिभि॑र्विविष्मः । सु॒ते सोमे॑ सुतपा॒: शंत॑मानि॒ राण्ड्या॑ क्रियास्म॒ वक्ष॑णानि य॒ज्ञैः
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmāṇi ǀ hí ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ várdhanāni ǀ tā́vat ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ viviṣmaḥ ǀsuté ǀ sóme ǀ suta-pāḥ ǀ śám-tamāni ǀ rā́ndryā ǀ kriyāsma ǀ vákṣaṇāni ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since,Indra, you have made the (sacred) prayers (the means of) your augmentation, we address such to you, along with our praises; may we offer gratifying and acceptable eulogies to the drinker of the effused libation, with (our) sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ बोधि पुरो॒ळाशं॒ ररा॑ण॒: पिबा॒ तु सोमं॒ गोऋ॑जीकमिन्द्र । एदं ब॒र्हिर्यज॑मानस्य सीदो॒रुं कृ॑धि त्वाय॒त उ॑ लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀ píba ǀ tú ǀ sómam ǀ gó-ṛjīkam ǀ indra ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sīda ǀ urúm ǀ kṛdhi ǀ tvā-yatáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Indra, who are condescending, our cakes and butter; drink thesomamixed with curds; sit down upon this sacred grass (strewn by) the worshipper; grant ample possessions to him who depends on you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑न्दस्वा॒ ह्यनु॒ जोष॑मुग्र॒ प्र त्वा॑ य॒ज्ञास॑ इ॒मे अ॑श्नुवन्तु । प्रेमे हवा॑सः पुरुहू॒तम॒स्मे आ त्वे॒यं धीरव॑स इन्द्र यम्याः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mandasva ǀ hí ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ ugra ǀ prá ǀ tvā ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ imé ǀ aśnuvantu ǀprá ǀ imé ǀ hávāsaḥ ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ asmé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ iyám ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ ávase ǀ indra ǀ yamyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rejoice, fierceIndra, according to your plural asure; let these libations reach you; invoked of many, may these our invocations ascend to you; may this praise influence you for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॑: सखाय॒: सं यथा॑ सु॒तेषु॒ सोमे॑भिरीं पृणता भो॒जमिन्द्र॑म् । कु॒वित्तस्मा॒ अस॑ति नो॒ भरा॑य॒ न सुष्वि॒मिन्द्रोऽव॑से मृधाति
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ yáthā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ īm ǀ pṛṇata ǀ bhojám ǀ índram ǀkuvít ǀ tásmai ǀ ásati ǀ naḥ ǀ bhárāya ǀ ná ǀ súsvim ǀ índraḥ ǀ ávase ǀ mṛdhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Friends, when the libations are effused, do you satisfy that liberalIndrawith thesoma; let there be plural nty for him, that (he may provide) for our nourishmen; Indra never neglects the care of him who presents copious oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदिन्द्र॑: सु॒ते अ॑स्तावि॒ सोमे॑ भ॒रद्वा॑जेषु॒ क्षय॒दिन्म॒घोन॑: । अस॒द्यथा॑ जरि॒त्र उ॒त सू॒रिरिन्द्रो॑ रा॒यो वि॒श्ववा॑रस्य दा॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ suté ǀ astāvi ǀ sóme ǀ bharát-vājeṣu ǀ kṣáyat ǀ ít ǀ maghónaḥ ǀásat ǀ yáthā ǀ jaritré ǀ utá ǀ sūríḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ viśvá-vārasya ǀ dātā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus hasIndra, the lord of the opulent, been glorified by the Bhaāradvājas, upon the libation being effused, that he may be th director of his eulogist (to virtue), that Indra may be the giver of all desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ मद॒ इन्द्रे॒ श्लोक॑ उ॒क्था सचा॒ सोमे॑षु सुत॒पा ऋ॑जी॒षी । अ॒र्च॒त्र्यो॑ म॒घवा॒ नृभ्य॑ उ॒क्थैर्द्यु॒क्षो राजा॑ गि॒रामक्षि॑तोतिः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀ índre ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ sácā ǀ sómeṣu ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛjīṣī́ ǀarcatryáḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ girā́m ǀ ákṣita-ūtiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the rites at whichsoma(is offered) the exhilaration (produced) inIndrais a shower (of benefits to the offerer); so is the chanted hymn with the (recited) prayer, therefore the drinker of the soma, the partaker of the stale soma,Maghavan, is to be propitiated by men with praises; dweller in heaven, he is the lord of sacred songs, unwearied in the protection (of his votaries).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ततु॑रिर्वी॒रो नर्यो॒ विचे॑ता॒: श्रोता॒ हवं॑ गृण॒त उ॒र्व्यू॑तिः । वसु॒: शंसो॑ न॒रां का॒रुधा॑या वा॒जी स्तु॒तो वि॒दथे॑ दाति॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: táturiḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ śrótā ǀ hávam ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ urví-ūtiḥ ǀvásuḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ dāti ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The surpasser (of foes), a hero, the friend of man, the discriminator, the hearer of the invocation, the great protector of his adorers, the giver of dwelings, the ruler of men, the cherisher of his worshippers, the bestower of food, grants us, when glorified at the sacrifice, (abundant) sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्षो॒ न च॒क्र्यो॑: शूर बृ॒हन्प्र ते॑ म॒ह्ना रि॑रिचे॒ रोद॑स्योः । वृ॒क्षस्य॒ नु ते॑ पुरुहूत व॒या व्यू॒३॒॑तयो॑ रुरुहुरिन्द्र पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: ákṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakryóḥ ǀ śūra ǀ bṛhán ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ririce ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀvṛkṣásya ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vayā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ruruhuḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty hero, by your magnitude, (the exten) of heaven and earth is exceeded, as the axle by the (circumerfence of the) wheels; invoked of many, your numerous benefits,Indra, spread out like the branches of a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शची॑वतस्ते पुरुशाक॒ शाका॒ गवा॑मिव स्रु॒तय॑: सं॒चर॑णीः । व॒त्सानां॒ न त॒न्तय॑स्त इन्द्र॒ दाम॑न्वन्तो अदा॒मान॑: सुदामन्
shlokas.transliteration: śácī-vataḥ ǀ te ǀ puru-śāka ǀ śā́kāḥ ǀ gávām-iva ǀ srutáyaḥ ǀ sam-cáraṇīḥ ǀvatsā́nām ǀ ná ǀ tantáyaḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ dā́man-vantaḥ ǀ adāmā́naḥ ǀ su-dāman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accomplisher of many acts, the energies of you who are (ever) active (congregate from all directions), like the converging tracks of cattle; they are the bonds (of foes), themselves unfettered, munificentIndra, like the tethers of (many) calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्यद॒द्य कर्व॑रम॒न्यदु॒ श्वोऽस॑च्च॒ सन्मुहु॑राच॒क्रिरिन्द्र॑: । मि॒त्रो नो॒ अत्र॒ वरु॑णश्च पू॒षार्यो वश॑स्य पर्ये॒तास्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: anyát ǀ adyá ǀ kárvaram ǀ anyát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śváḥ ǀ ásat ǀ ca ǀ sát ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ā-cakríḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ váśasya ǀ pari-etā́ ǀ asti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraachieves one act today, another tomorrow, evil and good repeatedly; may he, andMitra,Varuṇa,Pūṣan,Arya, be on this occasion promoters of the desired result.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि त्वदापो॒ न पर्व॑तस्य पृ॒ष्ठादु॒क्थेभि॑रिन्द्रानयन्त य॒ज्ञैः । तं त्वा॒भिः सु॑ष्टु॒तिभि॑र्वा॒जय॑न्त आ॒जिं न ज॑ग्मुर्गिर्वाहो॒ अश्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tvát ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ párvatasya ǀ pṛṣṭhā́t ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ anayanta ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ sustutí-bhiḥ ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀ ājím ǀ ná ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ girvāhaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By praises and by sacrifices,Indra, (men) bring down (what they desire) from you, as the waters (descend) from the top of the mountain; desirous of food, they approach you, who are accessible to praise, with these their eulogies, as (eagerly as) coursers rush to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं जर॑न्ति श॒रदो॒ न मासा॒ न द्याव॒ इन्द्र॑मवक॒र्शय॑न्ति । वृ॒द्धस्य॑ चिद्वर्धतामस्य त॒नूः स्तोमे॑भिरु॒क्थैश्च॑ श॒स्यमा॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ járanti ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ava-karśáyanti ǀvṛddhásya ǀ cit ǀ vardhatām ǀ asya ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śasyámānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the person n of that vastIndra, celebrated by praises and prayers, ever increase; Indra, whom neither years nor months make old, nor days enfeeble.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वी॒ळवे॒ नम॑ते॒ न स्थि॒राय॒ न शर्ध॑ते॒ दस्यु॑जूताय स्त॒वान् । अज्रा॒ इन्द्र॑स्य गि॒रय॑श्चिदृ॒ष्वा ग॑म्भी॒रे चि॑द्भवति गा॒धम॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vīḷáve ǀ námate ǀ ná ǀ sthirā́ya ǀ ná ǀ śárdhate ǀ dásyu-jūtāya ǀ stavā́n ǀájrāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ṛṣvā́ḥ ǀ gambhīré ǀ cit ǀ bhavati ǀ gādhám ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified by us, he bows not down to the robust, nor to the resolute, nor to the person vering (worshipper) who is instrumental gated by the (irreligious)Dasyus; the lofty mountains are easy of access oIndra; to him there is a bottom in the (lowest) deep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒म्भी॒रेण॑ न उ॒रुणा॑मत्रि॒न्प्रेषो य॑न्धि सुतपाव॒न्वाजा॑न् । स्था ऊ॒ षु ऊ॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ती अरि॑षण्यन्न॒क्तोर्व्यु॑ष्टौ॒ परि॑तक्म्यायाम्
shlokas.transliteration: gambhīréṇa ǀ naḥ ǀ urúṇā ǀ amatrin ǀ prá ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ yandhi ǀ suta-pāvan ǀ vā́jān ǀsthā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ aktóḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulIndra, drinker of thesoma, (actuated) by a profound and comprehensive (purpose), grant us food and strength; be ever diligent, benevolent Indra, for our protection by day and by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सच॑स्व ना॒यमव॑से अ॒भीक॑ इ॒तो वा॒ तमि॑न्द्र पाहि रि॒षः । अ॒मा चै॑न॒मर॑ण्ये पाहि रि॒षो मदे॑म श॒तहि॑माः सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sácasva ǀ nāyám ǀ ávase ǀ abhī́ke ǀ itáḥ ǀ vā ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ pāhi ǀ riṣáḥ ǀamā́ ǀ ca ǀ enam ǀ áraṇye ǀ pāhi ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ mádema ǀ śatá-himāḥ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accompany,Indra, the leader in battle for his protection; defend him against a near (or distant) foe; protect him from an enemy, whether in (his) house or in a forest, and may we, blessed with excellentmaledescendants, be happy for a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या त॑ ऊ॒तिर॑व॒मा या प॑र॒मा या म॑ध्य॒मेन्द्र॑ शुष्मि॒न्नस्ति॑ । ताभि॑रू॒ षु वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॑ऽवीर्न ए॒भिश्च॒ वाजै॑र्म॒हान्न॑ उग्र
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ avamā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ paramā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ madhyamā́ ǀ indra ǀ śuṣmin ǀ ásti ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ avīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ ca ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ naḥ ǀ ugra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulIndra, with these (your protections), whether the protection be little, great or middlin, defend us for the destruction of our foes; supply us, fierce Indra, who are mighty, with those viands (that are needed).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आभि॒: स्पृधो॑ मिथ॒तीररि॑षण्यन्न॒मित्र॑स्य व्यथया म॒न्युमि॑न्द्र । आभि॒र्विश्वा॑ अभि॒युजो॒ विषू॑ची॒रार्या॑य॒ विशोऽव॑ तारी॒र्दासी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́bhiḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ mithatī́ḥ ǀ áriṣaṇyan ǀ amítrasya ǀ vyathaya ǀ manyúm ǀ indra ǀā́bhiḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ víṣūcīḥ ǀ ā́ryāya ǀ víśaḥ ǀ áva ǀ tārīḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Induced) by these (praises), protecting our assailing host, baffle,Indra, the wrath of the enemy; (induced) by them, overthrow, on the part of theĀrya, all the servile people everywhere abiding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ जा॒मय॑ उ॒त येऽजा॑मयोऽर्वाची॒नासो॑ व॒नुषो॑ युयु॒ज्रे । त्वमे॑षां विथु॒रा शवां॑सि ज॒हि वृष्ण्या॑नि कृणु॒ही परा॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ ájāmayaḥ ǀ arvācīnā́saḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ yuyujré ǀtvám ǀ eṣām ǀ vithurā́ ǀ śávāṃsi ǀ jahí ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ párācaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Annihilate,Indra, the strength of those who, whether kinsmen or unrelated, present themselves before us, exerting themselves as adversaries; enfeeble their prowess, put them to fight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शूरो॑ वा॒ शूरं॑ वनते॒ शरी॑रैस्तनू॒रुचा॒ तरु॑षि॒ यत्कृ॒ण्वैते॑ । तो॒के वा॒ गोषु॒ तन॑ये॒ यद॒प्सु वि क्रन्द॑सी उ॒र्वरा॑सु॒ ब्रवै॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: śū́raḥ ǀ vā ǀ śū́ram ǀ vanate ǀ śárīraiḥ ǀ tanū-rúcā ǀ táruṣi ǀ yát ǀ kṛṇváite íti ǀtoké ǀ vā ǀ góṣu ǀ tánaye ǀ yát ǀ ap-sú ǀ ví ǀ krándasī íti ǀ urvárāsu ǀ brávaite íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hero, (favoured by you), assuredly slays the (hostile) hero by his bodily prowess, when, both excelling in person nal strength, they strive together in conflict, or when, clamorous, they dispute for (the sake of) sons, of grandson, of cattle, of water, of land.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि त्वा॒ शूरो॒ न तु॒रो न धृ॒ष्णुर्न त्वा॑ यो॒धो मन्य॑मानो यु॒योध॑ । इन्द्र॒ नकि॑ष्ट्वा॒ प्रत्य॑स्त्येषां॒ विश्वा॑ जा॒तान्य॒भ्य॑सि॒ तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ tvā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ turáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ yodháḥ ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ yuyódha ǀíndra ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ práti ǀ asti ǀ eṣām ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ abhí ǀ asi ǀ tā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “But you (no one) resists, neither the hero, nor the fleet runner, nor the resolute, nor the combatant confiding (in his valour); neither of these,Indra, is a match for you; you are superior to all these person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑त्यत उ॒भयो॑र्नृ॒म्णम॒योर्यदी॑ वे॒धस॑: समि॒थे हव॑न्ते । वृ॒त्रे वा॑ म॒हो नृ॒वति॒ क्षये॑ वा॒ व्यच॑स्वन्ता॒ यदि॑ वितन्त॒सैते॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ patyate ǀ ubháyoḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ayóḥ ǀ yádi ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ hávante ǀvṛtré ǀ vā ǀ maháḥ ǀ nṛ-váti ǀ kṣáye ǀ vā ǀ vyácasvantā ǀ yádi ǀ vitantasáite íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of both these (disputants), that one acquires wealth whose priests invoke (Indra) at the sacrifice, whether the conten emulous for (the overthrow of) a powerful enemy, or for a dwelling peopled with dependants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्मा ते चर्ष॒णयो॒ यदेजा॒निन्द्र॑ त्रा॒तोत भ॑वा वरू॒ता । अ॒स्माका॑सो॒ ये नृत॑मासो अ॒र्य इन्द्र॑ सू॒रयो॑ दधि॒रे पु॒रो न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ éjān ǀ índra ǀ trātā́ ǀ utá ǀ bhava ǀ varūtā́ ǀasmā́kāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ nṛ́-tamāsaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ índra ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ puráḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore,Indra, when your people tremble (with fear), protect them; be to them a defender; may those who are our chief leaders be enjoyers (of your favour), as well as those (your) worshippers who have plural ced us foremost (to perform the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ ते दायि म॒ह इ॑न्द्रि॒याय॑ स॒त्रा ते॒ विश्व॒मनु॑ वृत्र॒हत्ये॑ । अनु॑ क्ष॒त्रमनु॒ सहो॑ यज॒त्रेन्द्र॑ दे॒वेभि॒रनु॑ ते नृ॒षह्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ te ǀ dāyi ǀ mahé ǀ indriyā́ya ǀ satrā́ ǀ te ǀ víśvam ǀ ánu ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀánu ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ánu ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ yajatra ǀ índra ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ te ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All (power) has been successively conceded verily to you,Indra, who are mighty, for the destruction of the foe; suitable vigour, suitable strength in battle (has been given) to you, adorable Indra, by the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॒: स्पृध॒: सम॑जा स॒मत्स्विन्द्र॑ रार॒न्धि मि॑थ॒तीरदे॑वीः । वि॒द्याम॒ वस्तो॒रव॑सा गृ॒णन्तो॑ भ॒रद्वा॑जा उ॒त त॑ इन्द्र नू॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ aja ǀ samát-su ǀ índra ǀ rarandhí ǀ mithatī́ḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀvidyā́ma ǀ vástoḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ bharát-vājāḥ ǀ utá ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ nūnám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So (glorified by us),Indra, animate us (to overcome) our enemies in battle; overthrow our pious, malevolent (foes), and may we,Bhāradvājas, praising you, assuredly possess habitations, with (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी न॑ इन्द्र॒ ह्वया॑मसि त्वा म॒हो वाज॑स्य सा॒तौ वा॑वृषा॒णाः । सं यद्विशोऽय॑न्त॒ शूर॑साता उ॒ग्रं नोऽव॒: पार्ये॒ अह॑न्दाः
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ hváyāmasi ǀ tvā ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáu ǀ vavṛṣāṇā́ḥ ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ víśaḥ ǀ áyanta ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀ ugrám ǀ naḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ pā́rye ǀ áhan ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear us,Indra, when, offering libations, we call  upon you for obtaining abundant food; grant us decided protection when on a future day men are assembling for battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां वा॒जी ह॑वते वाजिने॒यो म॒हो वाज॑स्य॒ गध्य॑स्य सा॒तौ । त्वां वृ॒त्रेष्वि॑न्द्र॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ तरु॑त्रं॒ त्वां च॑ष्टे मुष्टि॒हा गोषु॒ युध्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ vājī́ ǀ havate ǀ vājineyáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gádhyasya ǀ sātáu ǀtvā́m ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ indra ǀ sát-patim ǀ tárutram ǀ tvā́m ǀ caṣṭe ǀ muṣṭi-hā́ ǀ góṣu ǀ yúdhyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son ofVājini, (Bharadvāja), offering (sacrificial) viands, invokes you for (the sake of) acquiring obtainable and abundant food; (he invokes) you,Indra, the preserver of the good, the defender (from the wicked), when enemies (assail him); he depends upon you when, lifting up his fist, he is fighting for (his) cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं क॒विं चो॑दयो॒ऽर्कसा॑तौ॒ त्वं कुत्सा॑य॒ शुष्णं॑ दा॒शुषे॑ वर्क् । त्वं शिरो॑ अम॒र्मण॒: परा॑हन्नतिथि॒ग्वाय॒ शंस्यं॑ करि॒ष्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ kavím ǀ codayaḥ ǀ arká-sātau ǀ tvám ǀ kútsāya ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vark ǀtvám ǀ śíraḥ ǀ amarmáṇaḥ ǀ párā ǀ ahan ǀ atithi-gvā́ya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ kariṣyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have animated the sage with (the hope of) obtaining food; you have cut to piecesŚuṣṇaforKutsa, the donor of the oblation; you have struck off the head (ofŚambara), imagining himself invulnerable, intending to give plural asure to Atithigvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं रथं॒ प्र भ॑रो यो॒धमृ॒ष्वमावो॒ युध्य॑न्तं वृष॒भं दश॑द्युम् । त्वं तुग्रं॑ वेत॒सवे॒ सचा॑ह॒न्त्वं तुजिं॑ गृ॒णन्त॑मिन्द्र तूतोः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ rátham ǀ prá ǀ bharaḥ ǀ yodhám ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ yúdhyantam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dáśa-dyum ǀtvám ǀ túgram ǀ vetasáve ǀ sácā ǀ ahan ǀ tvám ǀ tújim ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ indra ǀ tūtoríti tūtoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have brought toVṛṣabhaa great war-chariot; you have protected him warring for ten days; you have slainTugraalong withVetasa; you have exalted Tuji glorifying you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तदु॒क्थमि॑न्द्र ब॒र्हणा॑ क॒: प्र यच्छ॒ता स॒हस्रा॑ शूर॒ दर्षि॑ । अव॑ गि॒रेर्दासं॒ शम्ब॑रं ह॒न्प्रावो॒ दिवो॑दासं चि॒त्राभि॑रू॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tát ǀ ukthám ǀ indra ǀ barháṇā ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahásrā ǀ śūra ǀ dárṣi ǀáva ǀ giréḥ ǀ dā́sam ǀ śámbaram ǀ han ǀ prá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the subduer (of foes), you have achieved a glorious (deed), inasmuch as you have scatered, hero, the hundreds and thousands (of the host ofŚambara), have slain the slave Śambara (when issuing) from the mountain, and have protectedDivodāsawith marvellous protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं श्र॒द्धाभि॑र्मन्दसा॒नः सोमै॑र्द॒भीत॑ये॒ चुमु॑रिमिन्द्र सिष्वप् । त्वं र॒जिं पिठी॑नसे दश॒स्यन्ष॒ष्टिं स॒हस्रा॒ शच्या॒ सचा॑हन्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ śraddhā́bhiḥ ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ cúmurim ǀ indra ǀ sisvap ǀtvám ǀ rajím ǀ píṭhīnase ǀ daśasyán ǀ ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ śácyā ǀ sácā ǀ ahan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Delighted by libations offered wiḥ faith, you have consigned Cumuri to the sleeop (of death) on behalf ofDabhīti, and bestowing (the maiden)Rajiupon Piṭhīnas, you have, by your contrivance, destroyed sixty thousand (warriors) at once.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं च॒न तत्सू॒रिभि॑रानश्यां॒ तव॒ ज्याय॑ इन्द्र सु॒म्नमोज॑: । त्वया॒ यत्स्तव॑न्ते सधवीर वी॒रास्त्रि॒वरू॑थेन॒ नहु॑षा शविष्ठ
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ caná ǀ tát ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ ānaśyān ǀ táva ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sumnám ǀ ójaḥ ǀtváyā ǀ yát ǀ stávante ǀ sadha-vīra ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ tri-várūthena ǀ náhuṣā ǀ śaviṣṭha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I, with my fellow-worshippers, obtain that your most excellent felicity and vigour, which, most mightyIndra, associate of heroes, the pious celebrate (as bestowed) by you, who are the humiliator (of foes), the protector of the three (worlds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अ॒स्यामि॑न्द्र द्यु॒म्नहू॑तौ॒ सखा॑यः स्याम महिन॒ प्रेष्ठा॑: । प्रात॑र्दनिः क्षत्र॒श्रीर॑स्तु॒ श्रेष्ठो॑ घ॒ने वृ॒त्राणां॑ स॒नये॒ धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyā́m ǀ indra ǀ dyumná-hūtau ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ mahina ǀ préṣṭhāḥ ǀprā́tardaniḥ ǀ kṣatra-śrī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ śréṣṭhaḥ ǀ ghané ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, adorableIndra, your friends, at this your worship, offered for (the acquisiiton of) wealth, be held most dear to you; may Kṣatraśrī, the son ofPratardana, (my patron), by most illustrious through the destruction of foes, and the attainment of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किम॑स्य॒ मदे॒ किम्व॑स्य पी॒ताविन्द्र॒: किम॑स्य स॒ख्ये च॑कार । रणा॑ वा॒ ये नि॒षदि॒ किं ते अ॑स्य पु॒रा वि॑विद्रे॒ किमु॒ नूत॑नासः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ asya ǀ máde ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ pītáu ǀ índraḥ ǀ kím ǀ asya ǀ sakhyé ǀ cakāra ǀráṇāḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ni-sádi ǀ kím ǀ té ǀ asya ǀ purā́ ǀ vividre ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What hasIndradone in the exhilaration of this (Soma)? What has he done on quaffing this (libation)? What has he done in friendship for this (Soma)? What have former, what have recent adorers obtained from you in the chamber of this (libation)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: सद॑स्य॒ मदे॒ सद्व॑स्य पी॒ताविन्द्र॒: सद॑स्य स॒ख्ये च॑कार । रणा॑ वा॒ ये नि॒षदि॒ सत्ते अ॑स्य पु॒रा वि॑विद्रे॒ सदु॒ नूत॑नासः
shlokas.transliteration: sát ǀ asya ǀ máde ǀ sát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ pītáu ǀ índraḥ ǀ sát ǀ asya ǀ sakhyé ǀ cakāra ǀráṇāḥ ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ni-sádi ǀ sát ǀ té ǀ asya ǀ purā́ ǀ vividre ǀ sát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nū́tanāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, in the exhilaration of this (Soma)Indrahas done a good deed; on quaffing the libation (he has done) a good deed; (he has done) a good deed in friendship for this Soma; former as well as recent adorers have obtained good of you in the chamber (of the libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि नु ते॑ महि॒मन॑: समस्य॒ न म॑घवन्मघव॒त्त्वस्य॑ वि॒द्म । न राध॑सोराधसो॒ नूत॑न॒स्येन्द्र॒ नकि॑र्ददृश इन्द्रि॒यं ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ mahimánaḥ ǀ samasya ǀ ná ǀ magha-van ǀ maghavat-tvásya ǀ vidmá ǀná ǀ rā́dhasaḥ-rādhasaḥ ǀ nū́tanasya ǀ índra ǀ nákiḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ indriyám ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We acknowledge no one,Maghavan, of greatness equal to yours, nor one of like affluence, nor one of equally glorifiable riches, none has (such as) your power been ever seen (in any other).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तत्त्यत्त॑ इन्द्रि॒यम॑चेति॒ येनाव॑धीर्व॒रशि॑खस्य॒ शेष॑: । वज्र॑स्य॒ यत्ते॒ निह॑तस्य॒ शुष्मा॑त्स्व॒नाच्चि॑दिन्द्र पर॒मो द॒दार॑
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ tyát ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ aceti ǀ yéna ǀ ávadhīḥ ǀ vará-śikhasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀvájrasya ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ ní-hatasya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ svanā́t ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ paramáḥ ǀ dadā́ra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such as your power (is) it has been comprehended (by us) as that wherewith you have slain the race of Varaśikha, when the boldest (of them) was demolished by the noise of your thunderbolt hurled with (all your) force.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वधी॒दिन्द्रो॑ व॒रशि॑खस्य॒ शेषो॑ऽभ्याव॒र्तिने॑ चायमा॒नाय॒ शिक्ष॑न् । वृ॒चीव॑तो॒ यद्ध॑रियू॒पीया॑यां॒ हन्पूर्वे॒ अर्धे॑ भि॒यसाप॑रो॒ दर्त्
shlokas.transliteration: vádhīt ǀ índraḥ ǀ vará-śikhasya ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ abhi-āvartíne ǀ cāyamānā́ya ǀ śíkṣan ǀvṛcī́vataḥ ǀ yát ǀ hari-yūpī́yāyām ǀ hán ǀ pū́rve ǀ árdhe ǀ bhiyásā ǀ áparaḥ ǀ dárt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Favouring Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna,Indradestroyed the varaśikha (people), killng the descendants of Vṛcīvat, (who were stationed) on the Hariyūpīya, on the eastern part, while the western (troop) was scattered through fear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिं॒शच्छ॑तं व॒र्मिण॑ इन्द्र सा॒कं य॒व्याव॑त्यां पुरुहूत श्रव॒स्या । वृ॒चीव॑न्त॒: शर॑वे॒ पत्य॑माना॒: पात्रा॑ भिन्दा॒ना न्य॒र्थान्या॑यन्
shlokas.transliteration: triṃśát-śatam ǀ varmíṇaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sākám ǀ yavyā́-vatyām ǀ puru-hūta ǀ śravasyā́ ǀvṛcī́vantaḥ ǀ śárave ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǀ pā́trā ǀ bhindānā́ḥ ǀ ni-arthā́ni ǀ āyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the invoked of many, thirty hundred mailed warriors (were collected) together on the Yavyāvatī, to acquire glory, but the Vṛcīvats advancing in a hostile manner, and breaking the sacrificial vessels, went to (their own) annihilation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ गावा॑वरु॒षा सू॑यव॒स्यू अ॒न्तरू॒ षु चर॑तो॒ रेरि॑हाणा । स सृञ्ज॑याय तु॒र्वशं॒ परा॑दाद्वृ॒चीव॑तो दैववा॒ताय॒ शिक्ष॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ gā́vau ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ suyavasyū́ íti su-yavasyū́ ǀ antáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ cárataḥ ǀ rérihāṇā ǀsáḥ ǀ sṛ́ñjayāya ǀ turváśam ǀ párā ǀ adāt ǀ vṛcī́vataḥ ǀ daiva-vātā́ya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whose bright prancing horses, delighted with choice fodder, proceed between (heaven and earth), gave upTurvaśatoSṛñjaya, subjecting the Vṛcīvats to the descendant of Devavāta (Abhyāvartin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्व॒याँ अ॑ग्ने र॒थिनो॑ विंश॒तिं गा व॒धूम॑तो म॒घवा॒ मह्यं॑ स॒म्राट् । अ॒भ्या॒व॒र्ती चा॑यमा॒नो द॑दाति दू॒णाशे॒यं दक्षि॑णा पार्थ॒वाना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dvayā́n ǀ agne ǀ rathínaḥ ǀ viṃśatím ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ vadhū́-mataḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ máhyam ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀabhi-āvartī́ ǀ cāyamānáḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ duḥ-náśā ǀ iyám ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ pārthavā́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The opulent supreme sovereign Abhyāvartin, the son of Cāyamāna, presents,Agni, to me two damsels riding in cars, and twenty cows; this donation of the descendant ofPṛthucannot be desroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ गावो॑ अग्मन्नु॒त भ॒द्रम॑क्र॒न्त्सीद॑न्तु गो॒ष्ठे र॒णय॑न्त्व॒स्मे । प्र॒जाव॑तीः पुरु॒रूपा॑ इ॒ह स्यु॒रिन्द्रा॑य पू॒र्वीरु॒षसो॒ दुहा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ agman ǀ utá ǀ bhadrám ǀ akran ǀ sī́dantu ǀ go-sthé ǀ raṇáyantu ǀ asmé íti ǀprajā́-vatīḥ ǀ puru-rū́pāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ dúhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the cows come and bring good fortune; let them lie down in (our) stalls and be plural ased with us; may the many-coloured kine here be parboiled milk forIndraon many dawns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ यज्व॑ने पृण॒ते च॑ शिक्ष॒त्युपेद्द॑दाति॒ न स्वं मु॑षायति । भूयो॑भूयो र॒यिमिद॑स्य व॒र्धय॒न्नभि॑न्ने खि॒ल्ये नि द॑धाति देव॒युम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ yájvane ǀ pṛṇaté ǀ ca ǀ śikṣati ǀ úpa ǀ ít ǀ dadāti ǀ ná ǀ svám ǀ muṣāyati ǀbhū́yaḥ-bhūyaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ vardháyan ǀ ábhinne ǀ khilyé ǀ ní ǀ dadhāti ǀ deva-yúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indragrants the desires of the man who offers to him sacrifice and praise; he ever bestows upon him wealth, and deprives him not of that which is his own; again and again increasing his riches, he plural ces the devout man in an inaccessible fortress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ता न॑शन्ति॒ न द॑भाति॒ तस्क॑रो॒ नासा॑मामि॒त्रो व्यथि॒रा द॑धर्षति । दे॒वाँश्च॒ याभि॒र्यज॑ते॒ ददा॑ति च॒ ज्योगित्ताभि॑: सचते॒ गोप॑तिः स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ naśanti ǀ ná ǀ dabhāti ǀ táskaraḥ ǀ ná ǀ āsām ǀ āmitráḥ ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadharṣati ǀdevā́n ǀ ca ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ yájate ǀ dádāti ǀ ca ǀ jyók ǀ ít ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ sacate ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the cows be lost; let no thief carry them away; let no hostile weapon fall upon them; may the master of the cattle be long possessed of hose with which he sacrifices, and which he presents to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ता अर्वा॑ रे॒णुक॑काटो अश्नुते॒ न सं॑स्कृत॒त्रमुप॑ यन्ति॒ ता अ॒भि । उ॒रु॒गा॒यमभ॑यं॒ तस्य॒ ता अनु॒ गावो॒ मर्त॑स्य॒ वि च॑रन्ति॒ यज्व॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ árvā ǀ reṇú-kakāṭaḥ ǀ aśnute ǀ ná ǀ saṃskṛta-trám ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀuru-gāyám ǀ ábhayam ǀ tásya ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ ví ǀ caranti ǀ yájvanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the dust-spurning (war) horse reach them nor let them fall in the way of sacrificial consecration let the cattle of the man who offers sacrifice wander about at large and without fear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गावो॒ भगो॒ गाव॒ इन्द्रो॑ मे अच्छा॒न्गाव॒: सोम॑स्य प्रथ॒मस्य॑ भ॒क्षः । इ॒मा या गाव॒: स ज॑नास॒ इन्द्र॑ इ॒च्छामीद्धृ॒दा मन॑सा चि॒दिन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ me ǀ acchān ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ prathamásya ǀ bhakṣáḥ ǀimā́ḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ janāsaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ icchā́mi ǀ ít ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ cit ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the cows be (for our) affluence; mayIndragrant me cattle; may the cows yield the food of the first libation; these cows, oḥ men, are the Indra, the Indra whom I desire with heart and mins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं गा॑वो मेदयथा कृ॒शं चि॑दश्री॒रं चि॑त्कृणुथा सु॒प्रती॑कम् । भ॒द्रं गृ॒हं कृ॑णुथ भद्रवाचो बृ॒हद्वो॒ वय॑ उच्यते स॒भासु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ gāvaḥ ǀ medayatha ǀ kṛśám ǀ cit ǀ aśrīrám ǀ cit ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ su-prátīkam ǀbhadrám ǀ gṛhám ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ bhadra-vācaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ sabhā́su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, cows, give us nourisment; render the emaciated, the unlovely body the reverse; do you, whose lowing is auspicious, make my dwelling prosperous; great is the abundance that is attributed to you in religious assemblies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒जाव॑तीः सू॒यव॑सं रि॒शन्ती॑: शु॒द्धा अ॒पः सु॑प्रपा॒णे पिब॑न्तीः । मा व॑: स्ते॒न ई॑शत॒ माघशं॑स॒: परि॑ वो हे॒ती रु॒द्रस्य॑ वृज्याः
shlokas.transliteration: prajā́-vatīḥ ǀ su-yávasam ǀ riśántīḥ ǀ śuddhā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ su-prapāné ǀ píbantīḥ ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ stenáḥ ǀ īśata ǀ mā́ ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vaḥ ǀ hetíḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ vṛjyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May you, cows, have many calves grazing upon good pasture, drinking pure water at accessible ponds; may no thief be your master; no beast of prey (assail you), and may the (fatal) weapon ofRudraavoid you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपे॒दमु॑प॒पर्च॑नमा॒सु गोषूप॑ पृच्यताम् । उप॑ ऋष॒भस्य॒ रेत॒स्युपे॑न्द्र॒ तव॑ वी॒र्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ idám ǀ upa-párcanam ǀ āsú ǀ góṣu ǀ úpa ǀ pṛcyatām ǀúpa ǀ ṛṣabhásya ǀ rétasi ǀ úpa ǀ indra ǀ táva ǀ vīryé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the nourishment of the cows be solicited, let the vigour of the bull (be requested),Indra, for your invigoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ वो॒ नर॑: स॒ख्याय॑ सेपुर्म॒हो यन्त॑: सुम॒तये॑ चका॒नाः । म॒हो हि दा॒ता वज्र॑हस्तो॒ अस्ति॑ म॒हामु॑ र॒ण्वमव॑से यजध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ vaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ sepuḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yántaḥ ǀ su-matáye ǀ cakānā́ḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ hí ǀ dātā́ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ mahā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ raṇvám ǀ ávase ǀ yajadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your priests, (oḥ worshippers), proppitiateIndrafor his friendship, offering great (praise), and desirous of his favour; for the wielder of the thunderbolt is the giver of vast (wealth); worship him, therefore, who is mighty and benevolent, (to obtain) his protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्मि॒न्हस्ते॒ नर्या॑ मिमि॒क्षुरा रथे॑ हिर॒ण्यये॑ रथे॒ष्ठाः । आ र॒श्मयो॒ गभ॑स्त्योः स्थू॒रयो॒राध्व॒न्नश्वा॑सो॒ वृष॑णो युजा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ háste ǀ náryāḥ ǀ mimikṣúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ rathe-sthā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ sthūráyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ádhvan ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ yujānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In whosehand(riches) good for man are accusative ulated, the chariot-mounted in a golden car; in whose arms the rays of light (are collected); whose vigorous horses, yoked (to his car, convey him) on the road (of the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒ये ते॒ पादा॒ दुव॒ आ मि॑मिक्षुर्धृ॒ष्णुर्व॒ज्री शव॑सा॒ दक्षि॑णावान् । वसा॑नो॒ अत्कं॑ सुर॒भिं दृ॒शे कं स्व१॒॑र्ण नृ॑तविषि॒रो ब॑भूथ
shlokas.transliteration: śriyé ǀ te ǀ pā́dā ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mimikṣuḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ śávasā ǀ dákṣiṇa-vān ǀvásānaḥ ǀ átkam ǀ surabhím ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ nṛto íti ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ babhūtha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They offer adoration at your feet to acquire prosperity, for you are the overthrower of enemies by (your) strength, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the bestower of donations; leader (of rites), you are like the rolling sun, wearing in the sight (of all) a graceful and ever moving form.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सोम॒ आमि॑श्लतमः सु॒तो भू॒द्यस्मि॑न्प॒क्तिः प॒च्यते॒ सन्ति॑ धा॒नाः । इन्द्रं॒ नर॑: स्तु॒वन्तो॑ ब्रह्मका॒रा उ॒क्था शंस॑न्तो दे॒ववा॑ततमाः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ā́miśla-tamaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ bhūt ǀ yásmin ǀ paktíḥ ǀ pacyáte ǀ sánti ǀ dhānā́ḥ ǀíndram ǀ náraḥ ǀ stuvántaḥ ǀ brahma-kārā́ḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ śáṃsantaḥ ǀ devávāta-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That libation is most perfectly mixed when, upon its being effused, the cakes are baked, and the barley is fried, and the priests, glorifyingIndra, offering the (sacrificial) food, and reciting holy prayers, are approaching most nigh to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॒ अन्त॒: शव॑सो धाय्य॒स्य वि तु बा॑बधे॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा । आ ता सू॒रिः पृ॑णति॒ तूतु॑जानो यू॒थेवा॒प्सु स॒मीज॑मान ऊ॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ ántaḥ ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ dhāyi ǀ asyá ǀ ví ǀ tú ǀ bābadhe ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ pṛṇati ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ ap-sú ǀ sam-ī́jamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No limit of your strength has been assigned; heaven and earth are intimidated by its greatness; the pious worshipper, hastening (to sacrifice), and earnestly performing worship, gratifies you with the offering, as (the cow-keeper satisfies) the herds with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदिन्द्र॑: सु॒हव॑ ऋ॒ष्वो अ॑स्तू॒ती अनू॑ती हिरिशि॒प्रः सत्वा॑ । ए॒वा हि जा॒तो अस॑मात्योजाः पु॒रू च॑ वृ॒त्रा ह॑नति॒ नि दस्यू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ astu ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ánūtī ǀ hiri-śipráḥ ǀ sátvā ǀevá ǀ hí ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ásamāti-ojāḥ ǀ purú ǀ ca ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ hanati ǀ ní ǀ dásyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus may the mightyIndrabe successfully invoked; he, the azure-chinned, the giver of wealth, whether by coming or not coming (to the sacrifice); and may he who is of unequalled strength destroy, as soon as manifested, many opposing (evil spirits) and (hostile)Dasyus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूय॒ इद्वा॑वृधे वी॒र्या॑यँ॒ एको॑ अजु॒र्यो द॑यते॒ वसू॑नि । प्र रि॑रिचे दि॒व इन्द्र॑: पृथि॒व्या अ॒र्धमिद॑स्य॒ प्रति॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́yaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ajuryáḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vásūni ǀprá ǀ ririce ǀ diváḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ardhám ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ práti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Again hasIndraincreased (in strength) for (the display of) heroism; he, the chief (of all), the undecayable, bestows riches (on his votaries); Indra surpasses heaven and earth; a mere portion of him is equal to both earth and heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ मन्ये बृ॒हद॑सु॒र्य॑मस्य॒ यानि॑ दा॒धार॒ नकि॒रा मि॑नाति । दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ सूर्यो॑ दर्श॒तो भू॒द्वि सद्मा॑न्युर्वि॒या सु॒क्रतु॑र्धात्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ manye ǀ bṛhát ǀ asuryám ǀ asya ǀ yā́ni ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mināti ǀdivé-dive ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ bhūt ǀ ví ǀ sádmāni ǀ urviyā́ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I now glorify his vast andasura-destroying (vigour); those exploits that he has determined (to achieve) no one can resist; (by him) the sun was made daily visible; and he, the doer of great deeds, spread out the spacious regions (of the universe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्या चि॒न्नू चि॒त्तदपो॑ न॒दीनां॒ यदा॑भ्यो॒ अर॑दो गा॒तुमि॑न्द्र । नि पर्व॑ता अद्म॒सदो॒ न से॑दु॒स्त्वया॑ दृ॒ळ्हानि॑ सुक्रतो॒ रजां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: adyá ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ tát ǀ ápaḥ ǀ nadī́nām ǀ yát ǀ ābhyaḥ ǀ áradaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ indra ǀní ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ adma-sádaḥ ǀ ná ǀ seduḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ rájāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At present, verily as of old, that act, (the liberation) of the rivers, is effective; whereby you have directed them on their course; the mountains have settled (at your command) like (men) seated at their meals; doer of great deeds, by you have the worlds been rendered stationary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमित्तन्न त्वावाँ॑ अ॒न्यो अ॒स्तीन्द्र॑ दे॒वो न मर्त्यो॒ ज्याया॑न् । अह॒न्नहिं॑ परि॒शया॑न॒मर्णोऽवा॑सृजो अ॒पो अच्छा॑ समु॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ tát ǀ ná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ anyáḥ ǀ asti ǀ índra ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ jyā́yān ǀáhan ǀ áhim ǀ pari-śáyānam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ áva ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily it is the truth,Indra, that there is no other such as you, no god nor mortal is (your) superior; you have slain Ahi obstructing the waters, you have set them free (to flow) to the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॒पो वि दुरो॒ विषू॑ची॒रिन्द्र॑ दृ॒ळ्हम॑रुज॒: पर्व॑तस्य । राजा॑भवो॒ जग॑तश्चर्षणी॒नां सा॒कं सूर्यं॑ ज॒नय॒न्द्यामु॒षास॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ víṣūcīḥ ǀ índra ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ arujaḥ ǀ párvatasya ǀrā́jā ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ sākám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ janáyan ǀ dyā́m ǀ uṣásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have set the obstructed waters free o flow in all directions; you have fractured the solid (barrier) of the cloud; you are lord over the people of the world, making manifest together the sun, the sky, and the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॒रेको॑ रयिपते रयी॒णामा हस्त॑योरधिथा इन्द्र कृ॒ष्टीः । वि तो॒के अ॒प्सु तन॑ये च॒ सूरेऽवो॑चन्त चर्ष॒णयो॒ विवा॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ rayi-pate ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ adhithāḥ ǀ indra ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀví ǀ toké ǀ ap-sú ǀ tánaye ǀ ca ǀ sū́re ǀ ávocanta ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ ví-vācaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, lord of riches, are the chief (soverign) over riches; you hold men in your twohands, and men glorify you with various praises for (the sake of obtaining) sons, and valiant grandsons, and rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्भि॒येन्द्र॒ पार्थि॑वानि॒ विश्वाच्यु॑ता चिच्च्यावयन्ते॒ रजां॑सि । द्यावा॒क्षामा॒ पर्व॑तासो॒ वना॑नि॒ विश्वं॑ दृ॒ळ्हं भ॑यते॒ अज्म॒न्ना ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ indra ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ víśvā ǀ ácyutā ǀ cit ǀ cyavayante ǀ rájāṃsi ǀdyā́vākṣā́mā ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ vánāni ǀ víśvam ǀ dṛḷhám ǀ bhayate ǀ ájman ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through fear of you,Indra, all the regions of the firmamet cause the unfallen (rain) to descend; the heavens, the earth, the mountains, the forests, all the solid (universe) is alarmed at your approach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं कुत्से॑ना॒भि शुष्ण॑मिन्द्रा॒शुषं॑ युध्य॒ कुय॑वं॒ गवि॑ष्टौ । दश॑ प्रपि॒त्वे अध॒ सूर्य॑स्य मुषा॒यश्च॒क्रमवि॑वे॒ रपां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ kútsena ǀ abhí ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ indra ǀ aśúṣam ǀ yudhya ǀ kúyavam ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀdáśa ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ ádha ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ muṣāyáḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ áviveḥ ǀ rápāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, withKutsa, have warred against the inexhaustibleŚuṣṇa; you have overthrownKuyavain battle; in conflict you have carried off the wheel (of the chariot) of the sun; you have driven away the malignant (spirits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं श॒तान्यव॒ शम्ब॑रस्य॒ पुरो॑ जघन्थाप्र॒तीनि॒ दस्यो॑: । अशि॑क्षो॒ यत्र॒ शच्या॑ शचीवो॒ दिवो॑दासाय सुन्व॒ते सु॑तक्रे भ॒रद्वा॑जाय गृण॒ते वसू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ śatā́ni ǀ áva ǀ śámbarasya ǀ púraḥ ǀ jaghantha ǀ apratī́ni ǀ dásyoḥ ǀáśikṣaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ śácyā ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ sunvaté ǀ suta-kre ǀ bharát-vājāya ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ vásūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have destroyed the hundred impregnable cities of theDasyu,Śambara, when sagaciousIndra, you, who are brought by the libation, have bestowed in your liberality riches uponDivodāsapresenting to you libations, and uponBharadvājahymning your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स स॑त्यसत्वन्मह॒ते रणा॑य॒ रथ॒मा ति॑ष्ठ तुविनृम्ण भी॒मम् । या॒हि प्र॑पथि॒न्नव॒सोप॑ म॒द्रिक्प्र च॑ श्रुत श्रावय चर्ष॒णिभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ satya-satvan ǀ mahaté ǀ ráṇāya ǀ rátham ǀ ā́ ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ bhīmám ǀyāhí ǀ pra-pathin ǀ ávasā ǀ úpa ǀ madrík ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ śruta ǀ śravaya ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leader of true heroes, possessor of infinite wealth, mount your formidable car for the arduous conflict; come to me, pursuer of a forward path, for my protection; do you who are renowned, proclaim (our renown) among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपू॑र्व्या पुरु॒तमा॑न्यस्मै म॒हे वी॒राय॑ त॒वसे॑ तु॒राय॑ । वि॒र॒प्शिने॑ व॒ज्रिणे॒ शंत॑मानि॒ वचां॑स्या॒सा स्थवि॑राय तक्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: ápūrvyā ǀ puru-támāni ǀ asmai ǀ mahé ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ taváse ǀ turā́ya ǀvi-rapśíne ǀ vajríṇe ǀ śám-tamāni ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ āsā́ ǀ sthávirāya ǀ takṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have fabricated with my mouth unprecedented, comprehensive, and gratifying praises to that mighty, heroic, powerful, rapid, adorable, and ancient wielder of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मा॒तरा॒ सूर्ये॑णा कवी॒नामवा॑सयद्रु॒जदद्रिं॑ गृणा॒नः । स्वा॒धीभि॒ॠक्व॑भिर्वावशा॒न उदु॒स्रिया॑णामसृजन्नि॒दान॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ ávāsayat ǀ ruját ǀ ádrim ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀsu-ādhī́bhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ út ǀ usríyāṇām ǀ asṛjat ǀ ni-dā́nam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has obtained the parent (worlds, heaven and earth), with the sun, for the sake of the sages, (heaṅgirasas), and, glorified (by them), he has shattered the mountain; repeatedly wished for by his adorers intently meditating (upon him), he has cast off the fetters of the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वह्नि॑भि॒ॠक्व॑भि॒र्गोषु॒ शश्व॑न्मि॒तज्ञु॑भिः पुरु॒कृत्वा॑ जिगाय । पुर॑: पुरो॒हा सखि॑भिः सखी॒यन्दृ॒ळ्हा रु॑रोज क॒विभि॑: क॒विः सन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ váhni-bhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ śáśvat ǀ mitájñu-bhiḥ ǀ puru-kṛ́tvā ǀ jigāya ǀpúraḥ ǀ puraḥ-hā́ ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ sakhi-yán ǀ dṛḷhā́ḥ ǀ ruroja ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the achiever of many deeds, together with his worshippers ever offering oblations upon bended knees, has overcome (theasuras) for (the rescue of) the cows; friendly with his friends (theaṅgirasas), far-seeing with the faqr-seeing, the destroyer of cities has demolished the strong cities (of the asuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नी॒व्या॑भिर्जरि॒तार॒मच्छा॑ म॒हो वाजे॑भिर्म॒हद्भि॑श्च॒ शुष्मै॑: । पु॒रु॒वीरा॑भिर्वृषभ क्षिती॒नामा गि॑र्वणः सुवि॒ताय॒ प्र या॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ nīvyā́bhiḥ ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ áccha ǀ maháḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀpuru-vī́rābhiḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), propitiated by the praise, come to him who glorifies you to make him happy among men with abundant food, with exceeding strength, and with young (mares) with numerous colts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सर्गे॑ण॒ शव॑सा त॒क्तो अत्यै॑र॒प इन्द्रो॑ दक्षिण॒तस्तु॑रा॒षाट् । इ॒त्था सृ॑जा॒ना अन॑पावृ॒दर्थं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे विविषुरप्रमृ॒ष्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sárgeṇa ǀ śávasā ǀ taktáḥ ǀ átyaiḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ turāṣā́ṭ ǀitthā́ ǀ sṛjānā́ḥ ǀ ánapa-vṛt ǀ ártham ǀ divé-dive ǀ viviṣuḥ ǀ apra-mṛṣyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with natural force possessed of (swift) horses,Indra, the overcomer of the adversaries, (sets free) the waters at the southern (declination); thus liberated the waters expand daily to the insatiable goal whence there is no returning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ओजि॑ष्ठ इन्द्र॒ तं सु नो॑ दा॒ मदो॑ वृषन्त्स्वभि॒ष्टिर्दास्वा॑न् । सौव॑श्व्यं॒ यो व॒नव॒त्स्वश्वो॑ वृ॒त्रा स॒मत्सु॑ सा॒सह॑द॒मित्रा॑न्
