shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ indra ǀ tám ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ dāḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀ su-abhiṣṭíḥ ǀ dā́svān ǀsáuvaśvyam ǀ yáḥ ǀ vanávat ǀ su-áśvaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ samát-su ǀ sasáhat ǀ amítrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits),Indra, grant us a son who shall be most vigorous, a delighter (of you by praise), a pious sacrificer, a liberal giver, who, mounted on a good steed, shall overthrow numerous good steeds, and conquer opposing enemies in combat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां ही॒३॒॑न्द्राव॑से॒ विवा॑चो॒ हव॑न्ते चर्ष॒णय॒: शूर॑सातौ । त्वं विप्रे॑भि॒र्वि प॒णीँर॑शाय॒स्त्वोत॒ इत्सनि॑ता॒ वाज॒मर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ ávase ǀ ví-vācaḥ ǀ hávante ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ śū́ra-sātau ǀtvám ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ paṇī́n ǀ aśāyaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ ít ǀ sánitā ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men of various speech invoke you,Indra, for their defence in war; you, with the sages (theaṅgirasas), have slain thePaṇis; protected by you, the liberal (worshipper) obtains food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ताँ इ॑न्द्रो॒भयाँ॑ अ॒मित्रा॒न्दासा॑ वृ॒त्राण्यार्या॑ च शूर । वधी॒र्वने॑व॒ सुधि॑तेभि॒रत्कै॒रा पृ॒त्सु द॑र्षि नृ॒णां नृ॑तम
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tā́n ǀ indra ǀ ubháyān ǀ amítrān ǀ dā́sā ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ā́ryā ǀ ca ǀ śūra ǀvádhīḥ ǀ vánā-iva ǀ sú-dhitebhiḥ ǀ átkaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ darṣi ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ nṛ-tama ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, hero,Indra, destroyed both (classes of) enemies, (both)DāsaandĀrya, adversaries; chief leader of leaders, you cut your foes in pieces in battles with well-plural ed weapons, as (wood-cutters fell) the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं न॑ इ॒न्द्राक॑वाभिरू॒ती सखा॑ वि॒श्वायु॑रवि॒ता वृ॒धे भू॑: । स्व॑र्षाता॒ यद्ध्वया॑मसि त्वा॒ युध्य॑न्तो ने॒मधि॑ता पृ॒त्सु शू॑र
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ ákavābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ sákhā ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhūḥ ǀsváḥ-sātā ǀ yát ǀ hváyāmasi ǀ tvā ǀ yúdhyantaḥ ǀ nemá-dhitā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ śūra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, who are all-pervading, be a friend, and a protector with irreproachable protections for our prosperity; when warring in number-thinning conflicts, we invoke you for the acquisition of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं न॑ इन्द्राप॒राय॑ च स्या॒ भवा॑ मृळी॒क उ॒त नो॑ अ॒भिष्टौ॑ । इ॒त्था गृ॒णन्तो॑ म॒हिन॑स्य॒ शर्म॑न्दि॒वि ष्या॑म॒ पार्ये॑ गो॒षत॑माः
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ aparā́ya ǀ ca ǀ syāḥ ǀ bháva ǀ mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀitthā́ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ mahínasya ǀ śárman ǀ diví ǀ syāma ǀ pā́rye ǀ gosá-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, now and at (all) other times be verily ours; be the bestower of happiness according to our condition; and in this maner, worshipping at dawn, and glorifying you, may we abide in the brilliant and unbounded felicity of you who are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं च॒ त्वे ज॒ग्मुर्गिर॑ इन्द्र पू॒र्वीर्वि च॒ त्वद्य॑न्ति वि॒भ्वो॑ मनी॒षाः । पु॒रा नू॒नं च॑ स्तु॒तय॒ ऋषी॑णां पस्पृ॒ध्र इन्द्रे॒ अध्यु॑क्था॒र्का
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ca ǀ tvé íti ǀ jagmúḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ tvát ǀ yanti ǀ vi-bhváḥ ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀpurā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ ca ǀ stutáyaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ paspṛdhré ǀ índre ǀ ádhi ǀ uktha-arkā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many praises,Indra, are concentrated in you; from you abundant comemndations diversely proceed; to you, formerly and at presen, the praises of the sages, their prayers and hymns, vie (in glorifying) Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒हू॒तो यः पु॑रुगू॒र्त ऋभ्वाँ॒ एक॑: पुरुप्रश॒स्तो अस्ति॑ य॒ज्ञैः । रथो॒ न म॒हे शव॑से युजा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽस्माभि॒रिन्द्रो॑ अनु॒माद्यो॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-hūtáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ puru-gūrtáḥ ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀ ékaḥ ǀ puru-praśastáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mahé ǀ śávase ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ asmā́bhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatIndraever be propitiated, by us who is the invoked of many, mighty and chief, especially honoured by sacrifices, and to whom, as to a conveyance, we are attached for (the attainment of) great strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं हिंस॑न्ति धी॒तयो॒ न वाणी॒रिन्द्रं॒ नक्ष॒न्तीद॒भि व॒र्धय॑न्तीः । यदि॑ स्तो॒तार॑: श॒तं यत्स॒हस्रं॑ गृ॒णन्ति॒ गिर्व॑णसं॒ शं तद॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ híṃsanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ índram ǀ nákṣanti ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ vardháyantīḥ ǀyádi ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ śatám ǀ yát ǀ sahásram ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ gírvaṇasam ǀ śám ǀ tát ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All praises contributing to his exaltation proceed toIndra, whom no acts, no words can harm, since hundreds and thousands of adorers glorify him who is entitled to praise, and so afford him gratification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्मा॑ ए॒तद्दि॒व्य१॒॑र्चेव॑ मा॒सा मि॑मि॒क्ष इन्द्रे॒ न्य॑यामि॒ सोम॑: । जनं॒ न धन्व॑न्न॒भि सं यदाप॑: स॒त्रा वा॑वृधु॒र्हव॑नानि य॒ज्ञैः
shlokas.transliteration: ásmai ǀ etát ǀ diví ǀ arcā́-iva ǀ māsā́ ǀ mimikṣáḥ ǀ índre ǀ ní ǀ ayāmi ǀ sómaḥ ǀjánam ǀ ná ǀ dhánvan ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ yát ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ hávanāni ǀ yajñáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mixedSomahas been prepared forIndra, (to be offered) on the day (of the sacrifice), with reverence-like adoration, when praises, together with offerings, yield him increase, as when water (revives) a man in a desert waste.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्मा॑ ए॒तन्मह्या॑ङ्गू॒षम॑स्मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य स्तो॒त्रं म॒तिभि॑रवाचि । अस॒द्यथा॑ मह॒ति वृ॑त्र॒तूर्य॒ इन्द्रो॑ वि॒श्वायु॑रवि॒ता वृ॒धश्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásmai ǀ etát ǀ máhi ǀ āṅgūṣám ǀ asmai ǀ índrāya ǀ stotrám ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ avāci ǀásat ǀ yáthā ǀ mahatí ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀ índraḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thisIndrahas this earnest eulogy been addressed by the devout, in order that the all-pervading Indra may be our defender and exalter in the great conflict with (our) foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा भु॑व॒न्रथ॑क्षयाणि॒ ब्रह्म॑ क॒दा स्तो॒त्रे स॑हस्रपो॒ष्यं॑ दाः । क॒दा स्तोमं॑ वासयोऽस्य रा॒या क॒दा धिय॑: करसि॒ वाज॑रत्नाः
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ bhuvan ǀ rátha-kṣayāṇi ǀ bráhma ǀ kadā́ ǀ stotré ǀ sahasra-poṣyám ǀ dāḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ stómam ǀ vāsayaḥ ǀ asya ǀ rāyā́ ǀ kadā́ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ karasi ǀ vā́ja-ratnāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When may our prayers (be with you) in your chariot? When will you grant to your adorer the (means of) maintaining thousands? When will you recompense my adoration with riches? When will you render sacred rites productive of food?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्हि॑ स्वि॒त्तदि॑न्द्र॒ यन्नृभि॒र्नॄन्वी॒रैर्वी॒रान्नी॒ळया॑से॒ जया॒जीन् । त्रि॒धातु॒ गा अधि॑ जयासि॒ गोष्विन्द्र॑ द्यु॒म्नं स्व॑र्वद्धेह्य॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: kárhi ǀ svit ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ vīrā́n ǀ nīḷáyāse ǀ jáya ǀ ājī́n ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ jayāsi ǀ góṣu ǀ índra ǀ dyumnám ǀ sváḥ-vat ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, will you bring together leaders with leaders, heroes with heroes, and give us victory in battles? When will you conquer from the enemy the threefold-food-supplying cattle? (When will you grant) us, Indra, diffusive wealth?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कर्हि॑ स्वि॒त्तदि॑न्द्र॒ यज्ज॑रि॒त्रे वि॒श्वप्सु॒ ब्रह्म॑ कृ॒णव॑: शविष्ठ । क॒दा धियो॒ न नि॒युतो॑ युवासे क॒दा गोम॑घा॒ हव॑नानि गच्छाः
shlokas.transliteration: kárhi ǀ svit ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ jaritré ǀ viśvá-psu ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀkadā́ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ yuvāse ǀ kadā́ ǀ gó-maghā ǀ hávanāni ǀ gacchāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, most vigorousIndra, will you grant your worshipper that food which is all-sufficing? When will you combine (in yourself) worship and praises? When will you render oblations productive of cattle?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स गोम॑घा जरि॒त्रे अश्व॑श्चन्द्रा॒ वाज॑श्रवसो॒ अधि॑ धेहि॒ पृक्ष॑: । पी॒पि॒हीष॑: सु॒दुघा॑मिन्द्र धे॒नुं भ॒रद्वा॑जेषु सु॒रुचो॑ रुरुच्याः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gó-maghāḥ ǀ jaritré ǀ áśva-candrāḥ ǀ vā́ja-śravasaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhehi ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀpīpihí ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ su-dúghām ǀ indra ǀ dhenúm ǀ bharát-vājeṣu ǀ su-rúcaḥ ǀ rurucyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Indra, to your adorer (abundant) food, productive of cattle, plural asant with horses, and renowned for vigour; multiply nourishment, and (cherish) the kine easily milked, and render them so that they may be resplendent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमा नू॒नं वृ॒जन॑म॒न्यथा॑ चि॒च्छूरो॒ यच्छ॑क्र॒ वि दुरो॑ गृणी॒षे । मा निर॑रं शुक्र॒दुघ॑स्य धे॒नोरा॑ङ्गिर॒सान्ब्रह्म॑णा विप्र जिन्व
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ vṛjánam ǀ anyáthā ǀ cit ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ yát ǀ śakra ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ gṛṇīṣé ǀmā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ aram ǀ śukra-dúghasya ǀ dhenóḥ ǀ āṅgirasā́n ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vipra ǀ jinva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Direct him who is actually our adversary into a different (course); mightyIndra, who are a hero, the destroyer (of enemies), therefore are you glorified; never may I desist from the praise of the giver of pure (gifts); satisfy, sage Indra, theaṅgirasaswith food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रा मदा॑स॒स्तव॑ वि॒श्वज॑न्याः स॒त्रा रायोऽध॒ ये पार्थि॑वासः । स॒त्रा वाजा॑नामभवो विभ॒क्ता यद्दे॒वेषु॑ धा॒रय॑था असु॒र्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: satrā́ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ táva ǀ viśvá-janyāḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ ádha ǀ yé ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ vā́jānām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀ yát ǀ devéṣu ǀ dhāráyathāḥ ǀ asuryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truly are your exhilarations beneficial to all men; truly are the riches which exist on earth (beneficial to all men); truly are you the distributor of food; wherefore you maintain vigour among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ प्र ये॑जे॒ जन॒ ओजो॑ अस्य स॒त्रा द॑धिरे॒ अनु॑ वी॒र्या॑य । स्यू॒म॒गृभे॒ दुध॒येऽर्व॑ते च॒ क्रतुं॑ वृञ्ज॒न्त्यपि॑ वृत्र॒हत्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ prá ǀ yeje ǀ jánaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ asya ǀ satrā́ ǀ dadhire ǀ ánu ǀ vīryā́ya ǀsyūma-gṛ́bhe ǀ dúdhaye ǀ árvate ǀ ca ǀ krátum ǀ vṛñjanti ǀ ápi ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshipper praises especially the strength of thatIndra, verily they rely upon him for heroic deeds; they offer sacrifices to him as the seizer of an uninterrupted series of foes, their assailant, their subduer, and also for the destruction ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं स॒ध्रीची॑रू॒तयो॒ वृष्ण्या॑नि॒ पौंस्या॑नि नि॒युत॑: सश्चु॒रिन्द्र॑म् । स॒मु॒द्रं न सिन्ध॑व उ॒क्थशु॑ष्मा उरु॒व्यच॑सं॒ गिर॒ आ वि॑शन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sadhrī́cīḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ páuṃsyāni ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ saścuḥ ǀ índram ǀsamudrám ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ukthá-śuṣmāḥ ǀ uru-vyácasam ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viśanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The associatedMaruts, heroic energies, virile strength, and theNiyutsteeds, attend uponIndra, and praises powerful in sacred song centre in him as rivers flow into the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रा॒यस्खामुप॑ सृजा गृणा॒नः पु॑रुश्च॒न्द्रस्य॒ त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ वस्व॑: । पति॑र्बभू॒थास॑मो॒ जना॑ना॒मेको॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ khā́m ǀ úpa ǀ sṛja ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ puru-candrásya ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ vásvaḥ ǀpátiḥ ǀ babhūtha ǀ ásamaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ékaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified by us,Indra, let flow the stream of much delighting, home-conferring affluence, for you are the unequalled lord of men, the sole sovereign of all the world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तु श्रु॑धि॒ श्रुत्या॒ यो दु॑वो॒युर्द्यौर्न भूमा॒भि रायो॑ अ॒र्यः । असो॒ यथा॑ न॒: शव॑सा चका॒नो यु॒गेयु॑गे॒ वय॑सा॒ चेकि॑तानः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ śrudhi ǀ śrútyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ duvaḥ-yúḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǀ abhí ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀásaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ yugé-yuge ǀ váyasā ǀ cékitānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear,Indra, (the praises) that may be heard (by you), you, who are gratified by our adoration, and, like the sun, (prevail) over the ample riches of the enemy; endowed with strength, being glorified in every age, rendered comprehensible by (sacrificial) food, be to us no other (than as such as you have been).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाग्रथं॑ वि॒श्ववा॑रं त उ॒ग्रेन्द्र॑ यु॒क्तासो॒ हर॑यो वहन्तु । की॒रिश्चि॒द्धि त्वा॒ हव॑ते॒ स्व॑र्वानृधी॒महि॑ सध॒माद॑स्ते अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ te ǀ ugra ǀ índra ǀ yuktā́saḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀkīríḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hávate ǀ sváḥ-vān ǀ ṛdhīmáhi ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra, let your harnessed steeds bring down your all-desired chariot; your devoted adorer verily invokes you; may we today, partaking of your exhilaration, increase today (in prosperity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो द्रोणे॒ हर॑य॒: कर्मा॑ग्मन्पुना॒नास॒ ऋज्य॑न्तो अभूवन् । इन्द्रो॑ नो अ॒स्य पू॒र्व्यः प॑पीयाद्द्यु॒क्षो मद॑स्य सो॒म्यस्य॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ dróṇe ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ kárma ǀ agman ǀ punānā́saḥ ǀ ṛ́jyantaḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀíndraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ papīyāt ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ mádasya ǀ somyásya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The greenSomaflows at our sacrifice, and purified, proceed direct into the pitcher; may the ancient illustriousIndra, the soverign of the exhilarating Soma libation, drink of this our offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒स॒स्रा॒णास॑: शवसा॒नमच्छेन्द्रं॑ सुच॒क्रे र॒थ्या॑सो॒ अश्वा॑: । अ॒भि श्रव॒ ऋज्य॑न्तो वहेयु॒र्नू चि॒न्नु वा॒योर॒मृतं॒ वि द॑स्येत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā-sasrāṇā́saḥ ǀ śavasānám ǀ áccha ǀ índram ǀ su-cakré ǀ rathyā́saḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀabhí ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ṛ́jyantaḥ ǀ vaheyuḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ví ǀ dasyet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the everwhere-going, straight-proceeding, chariot-bearing seeds, bring the mightyIndrauin his strong-wheeled car to our rite; let not the ambrosialSomawaste in the wind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वरि॑ष्ठो अस्य॒ दक्षि॑णामिय॒र्तीन्द्रो॑ म॒घोनां॑ तुविकू॒र्मित॑मः । यया॑ वज्रिवः परि॒यास्यंहो॑ म॒घा च॑ धृष्णो॒ दय॑से॒ वि सू॒रीन्
shlokas.transliteration: váriṣṭhaḥ ǀ asya ǀ dákṣiṇām ǀ iyarti ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ tuvikūrmí-tamaḥ ǀyáyā ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ pari-yā́si ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ maghā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ dáyase ǀ ví ǀ sūrī́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The very strongIndra, the performer of many great deeds, instrumental gates the donation of this (instrumental tutor of the ceremony) among the opulent, whereby, wielder of the thunderbolt, you remove sin, and, firm of purpose, bestow riches upon the worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ वाज॑स्य॒ स्थवि॑रस्य दा॒तेन्द्रो॑ गी॒र्भिर्व॑र्धतां वृ॒द्धम॑हाः । इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रं हनि॑ष्ठो अस्तु॒ सत्वा ता सू॒रिः पृ॑णति॒ तूतु॑जानः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sthávirasya ǀ dātā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vardhatām ǀ vṛddhá-mahāḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ hániṣṭhaḥ ǀ astu ǀ sátvā ǀ ā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ pṛṇati ǀ tū́tujānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrais the donor of substantial food; may the very illustrious Indra increase (in glory) through our praises; may Indra, the destroyer (of enemies), be the especial slayer ofVṛtra; may he, the animator the quick-mover, grant us those (riches which we desire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॑दि॒त उदु॑ नश्चि॒त्रत॑मो म॒हीं भ॑र्षद्द्यु॒मती॒मिन्द्र॑हूतिम् । पन्य॑सीं धी॒तिं दैव्य॑स्य॒ याम॒ञ्जन॑स्य रा॒तिं व॑नते सु॒दानु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ápāt ǀ itáḥ ǀ út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ citrá-tamaḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ bharṣat ǀ dyu-mátīm ǀ índra-hūtim ǀpányasīm ǀ dhītím ǀ dáivyasya ǀ yā́man ǀ jánasya ǀ rātím ǀ vanate ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the most marvellousIndradrink from this (our cup); may he acknowledge our earnest and brilliant invocation; may the munificent (Indra) accept the offering and the praiseworthy adoration at the sacrifice of the devout worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒राच्चि॒दा व॑सतो अस्य॒ कर्णा॒ घोषा॒दिन्द्र॑स्य तन्यति ब्रुवा॒णः । एयमे॑नं दे॒वहू॑तिर्ववृत्यान्म॒द्र्य१॒॑गिन्द्र॑मि॒यमृ॒च्यमा॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: dūrā́t ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ vasataḥ ǀ asya ǀ kárṇā ǀ ghóṣāt ǀ índrasya ǀ tanyati ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀā́ ǀ iyám ǀ enam ǀ devá-hūtiḥ ǀ vavṛtyāt ǀ madryák ǀ índram ǀ iyám ǀ ṛcyámānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reciting (his praise, the worshipper) calls aloud, that by the sound he may reach the ears ofIndra, although abiding afar off; may this invocation of the deity, inducing, him (to come), bring Indra to my presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वो॑ धि॒या प॑र॒मया॑ पुरा॒जाम॒जर॒मिन्द्र॑म॒भ्य॑नूष्य॒र्कैः । ब्रह्मा॑ च॒ गिरो॑ दधि॒रे सम॑स्मिन्म॒हाँश्च॒ स्तोमो॒ अधि॑ वर्ध॒दिन्द्रे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ paramáyā ǀ purā-jā́m ǀ ajáram ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣi ǀ arkáiḥ ǀbráhma ǀ ca ǀ gíraḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ sám ǀ asmin ǀ mahā́n ǀ ca ǀ stómaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vardhat ǀ índre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify you wiht hymns and with pious worship, the ancient undecayingIndra, for in him are oblations and praises concentrated, and great adoration is enhanced (when addressed to him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वर्धा॒द्यं य॒ज्ञ उ॒त सोम॒ इन्द्रं॒ वर्धा॒द्ब्रह्म॒ गिर॑ उ॒क्था च॒ मन्म॑ । वर्धाहै॑नमु॒षसो॒ याम॑न्न॒क्तोर्वर्धा॒न्मासा॑: श॒रदो॒ द्याव॒ इन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: várdhāt ǀ yám ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ utá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índram ǀ várdhāt ǀ bráhma ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ mánma ǀvárdha ǀ áha ǀ enam ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ aktóḥ ǀ várdhān ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, whom the sacrifice, whom the libation exalts, whom the oblation, the praises, the prayers, the adoration exalt, whom the course of day and night exalts, whom months, and years, and days exalt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ज॑ज्ञा॒नं सह॑से॒ असा॑मि वावृधा॒नं राध॑से च श्रु॒ताय॑ । म॒हामु॒ग्रमव॑से विप्र नू॒नमा वि॑वासेम वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ jajñānám ǀ sáhase ǀ ásāmi ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ rā́dhase ǀ ca ǀ śrutā́ya ǀmahā́m ǀ ugrám ǀ ávase ǀ vipra ǀ nūnám ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsema ǀ vṛtra-tū́ryeṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So, wiseIndra, may we today propitiate you who are manifested, to overcome (our foes), you who are greatly augmenting, mighty and free, for (the sake of) wealth, fame, and protection, and for the destruction of (our) enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रस्य॑ क॒वेर्दि॒व्यस्य॒ वह्ने॒र्विप्र॑मन्मनो वच॒नस्य॒ मध्व॑: । अपा॑ न॒स्तस्य॑ सच॒नस्य॑ दे॒वेषो॑ युवस्व गृण॒ते गोअ॑ग्राः
shlokas.transliteration: mandrásya ǀ kavéḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ váhneḥ ǀ vípra-manmanaḥ ǀ vacanásya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀápāḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tásya ǀ sacanásya ǀ deva ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ yuvasva ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ gó-agrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, of that our sweet, exhilarating, inspiring, celestial, fruit-yieldingSoma, commended by the wise, and entitled to praise and preparation; bestow upon him who glorifies you, divine (Indra), food, the chiefest of which is cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमु॑शा॒नः पर्यद्रि॑मु॒स्रा ऋ॒तधी॑तिभिॠत॒युग्यु॑जा॒नः । रु॒जदरु॑ग्णं॒ वि व॒लस्य॒ सानुं॑ प॒णीँर्वचो॑भिर॒भि यो॑ध॒दिन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ uśānáḥ ǀ pári ǀ ádrim ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtádhīti-bhiḥ ǀ ṛta-yúk ǀ yujānáḥ ǀruját ǀ árugṇam ǀ ví ǀ valásya ǀ sā́num ǀ paṇī́n ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yodhat ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Determined (to recover) the cattle hidden in the mountain, associated with the animated by (their) veracious (praise), this (Indra) fractured the infrangible rock ofBala, and overwhelmed thePaṇiswith reproaches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं द्यो॑तयद॒द्युतो॒ व्य१॒॑क्तून्दो॒षा वस्तो॑: श॒रद॒ इन्दु॑रिन्द्र । इ॒मं के॒तुम॑दधु॒र्नू चि॒दह्नां॒ शुचि॑जन्मन उ॒षस॑श्चकार
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ dyotayat ǀ adyútaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aktū́n ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ indra ǀimám ǀ ketúm ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ áhnām ǀ śúci-janmanaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma,Indra, (quaffed by you), has lighted up the unlustrous nights, and days and nights, and years; (the gods) of old have established it as the ensign of days, and it he made the dawns genitive rated in light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं रो॑चयद॒रुचो॑ रुचा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽयं वा॑सय॒द्व्यृ१॒॑तेन॑ पू॒र्वीः । अ॒यमी॑यत ऋत॒युग्भि॒रश्वै॑: स्व॒र्विदा॒ नाभि॑ना चर्षणि॒प्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ rocayat ǀ arúcaḥ ǀ rucānáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ vāsayat ǀ ví ǀ ṛténa ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀayám ǀ īyate ǀ ṛtayúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídā ǀ nā́bhinā ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This radiant (Indra) has illumined the non-radiant (worlds); he has pervaded many dawns with true lustre the benefactor of men moves in (a chariot) drawn by horses, harnessed by praise, laden with riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू गृ॑णा॒नो गृ॑ण॒ते प्र॑त्न राज॒न्निष॑: पिन्व वसु॒देया॑य पू॒र्वीः । अ॒प ओष॑धीरवि॒षा वना॑नि॒ गा अर्व॑तो॒ नॄनृ॒चसे॑ रिरीहि
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ pratna ǀ rājan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ pinva ǀ vasu-déyāya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ aviṣā́ ǀ vánāni ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ṛcáse ǀ rirīhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sovereign of old, do you, when glorified, bestow upon him who praises you, and to whom affluence is due abundant food; grant to the worshipper water, plural nts, inoxious woods, cattle, horses and men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ पिब॒ तुभ्यं॑ सु॒तो मदा॒याव॑ स्य॒ हरी॒ वि मु॑चा॒ सखा॑या । उ॒त प्र गा॑य ग॒ण आ नि॒षद्याथा॑ य॒ज्ञाय॑ गृण॒ते वयो॑ धाः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ píba ǀ túbhyam ǀ sutáḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ áva ǀ sya ǀ hárī íti ǀ ví ǀ muca ǀ sákhāyā ǀutá ǀ prá ǀ gāya ǀ gaṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ átha ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, (theSoma) that is effused for your exhilaration; stop your friendly steeds; let them loose; sitting in our society, respond to our hymns; give food to him who lauds and worships you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ पिब॒ यस्य॑ जज्ञा॒न इ॑न्द्र॒ मदा॑य॒ क्रत्वे॒ अपि॑बो विरप्शिन् । तमु॑ ते॒ गावो॒ नर॒ आपो॒ अद्रि॒रिन्दुं॒ सम॑ह्यन्पी॒तये॒ सम॑स्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ piba ǀ yásya ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ mádāya ǀ krátve ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ vi-rapśin ǀtám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádriḥ ǀ índum ǀ sám ǀ ahyan ǀ pītáye ǀ sám ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, of this (libation), of which you, mighty one, have drunk as soon as born, for excitement to (great) deeds; thatSomawhich the kine, the priests, the waters, the stones, combine to prepare for your drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्नौ सु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ सोम॒ आ त्वा॑ वहन्तु॒ हर॑यो॒ वहि॑ष्ठाः । त्वा॒य॒ता मन॑सा जोहवी॒मीन्द्रा या॑हि सुवि॒ताय॑ म॒हे न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhe ǀ agnáu ǀ suté ǀ indra ǀ sóme ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vahantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhāḥ ǀtvā-yatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ johavīmi ǀ índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ mahé ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fire is kindled; theSoma,Indra, is effused let your vigorous horses bring you hither; I invoke yo, Indra, with a mind wholly devoted to you; come for our great prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑हि॒ शश्व॑दुश॒ता य॑या॒थेन्द्र॑ म॒हा मन॑सा सोम॒पेय॑म् । उप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि शृणव इ॒मा नोऽथा॑ ते य॒ज्ञस्त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ वयो॑ धात्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ śáśvat ǀ uśatā́ ǀ yayātha ǀ índra ǀ mahā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ soma-péyam ǀúpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ śṛṇavaḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ átha ǀ te ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have ever gone (to similar rites); come now with a great mind disposed to drink theSoma; hear these our praises; may the worshipper present to you (sacrificial) food for (the nourishment of) your person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र दि॒वि पार्ये॒ यदृध॒ग्यद्वा॒ स्वे सद॑ने॒ यत्र॒ वासि॑ । अतो॑ नो य॒ज्ञमव॑से नि॒युत्वा॑न्त्स॒जोषा॑: पाहि गिर्वणो म॒रुद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ diví ǀ pā́rye ǀ yát ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ své ǀ sádane ǀ yátra ǀ vā ǀ ási ǀátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ávase ǀ niyútvān ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Indra, you abide in the distant heaven, in any other plural ce, or in your own abode, or whersoever (you may be), from thence do you, who are propitiated by praise, putting to your steeds, protect, together with theMaruts, well plural ased, our sacrifice, for our preservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहे॑ळमान॒ उप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञं तुभ्यं॑ पवन्त॒ इन्द॑वः सु॒तास॑: । गावो॒ न व॑ज्रि॒न्त्स्वमोको॒ अच्छेन्द्रा ग॑हि प्रथ॒मो य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: áheḷamānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñám ǀ túbhyam ǀ pavante ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀgā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrin ǀ svám ǀ ókaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ índra ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unirascible (Indra), come to the sacrifice; the effusedSomais purified for you; they flow, thunderer, (into the pitchers), as cows go to their stalls; come, Indra, the first of those who are to be worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॑ का॒कुत्सुकृ॑ता॒ या वरि॑ष्ठा॒ यया॒ शश्व॒त्पिब॑सि॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिम् । तया॑ पाहि॒ प्र ते॑ अध्व॒र्युर॑स्था॒त्सं ते॒ वज्रो॑ वर्ततामिन्द्र ग॒व्युः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ kākút ǀ sú-kṛtā ǀ yā́ ǀ váriṣṭhā ǀ yáyā ǀ śáśvat ǀ píbasi ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀtáyā ǀ pāhi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ sám ǀ te ǀ vájraḥ ǀ vartatām ǀ indra ǀ gavyúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, with that well-formed and expanded tongue wherewith you ever quaff the sweet (Soma); before you stands the ministrant priest; let your bolt, Indra,  designed (to recover) the cattle, be hurled (against your foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष द्र॒प्सो वृ॑ष॒भो वि॒श्वरू॑प॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ वृष्णे॒ सम॑कारि॒ सोम॑: । ए॒तं पि॑ब हरिवः स्थातरुग्र॒ यस्येशि॑षे प्र॒दिवि॒ यस्ते॒ अन्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ sám ǀ akāri ǀ sómaḥ ǀetám ǀ piba ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ ugra ǀ yásya ǀ ī́śiṣe ǀ pra-dívi ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ánnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This dropping, omniformSoma, the showerer (of benefits), has been duly prepared forIndra, the showerer (of rain); lord of steeds, ruler over all, mighty (Indra), drink this over which you have of old pressed, which is your food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒तः सोमो॒ असु॑तादिन्द्र॒ वस्या॑न॒यं श्रेया॑ञ्चिकि॒तुषे॒ रणा॑य । ए॒तं ति॑तिर्व॒ उप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञं तेन॒ विश्वा॒स्तवि॑षी॒रा पृ॑णस्व
shlokas.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ásutāt ǀ indra ǀ vásyān ǀ ayám ǀ śréyān ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ ráṇāya ǀetám ǀ titirvaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñám ǀ téna ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇasva ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: ह्वया॑मसि॒ त्वेन्द्र॑ याह्य॒र्वाङरं॑ ते॒ सोम॑स्त॒न्वे॑ भवाति । शत॑क्रतो मा॒दय॑स्वा सु॒तेषु॒ प्रास्माँ अ॑व॒ पृत॑नासु॒ प्र वि॒क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: hváyāmasi ǀ tvā ǀ ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ áram ǀ te ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ bhavāti ǀśátakrato íti śáta-krato ǀ mādáyasva ǀ sutéṣu ǀ prá ǀ asmā́n ǀ ava ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ prá ǀ vikṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,Indra, come down; may theSomabe sufficient for (the satisfaction of) your person n; exultŚatakratuwith the libations, defend us in combats, and against the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॑स्मै॒ पिपी॑षते॒ विश्वा॑नि वि॒दुषे॑ भर । अ॒रं॒ग॒माय॒ जग्म॒येऽप॑श्चाद्दघ्वने॒ नरे॑
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ asmai ǀ pípīṣate ǀ víśvāni ǀ vidúṣe ǀ bhara ǀaram-gamā́ya ǀ jágmaye ǀ ápaścāt-daghvane ǀ náre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, (priests), the libation to him who is desirous to drink; who knows all things; whose movements are all-sufficient; who goes readily (to sacrifices); the leader (of holy rites), following no one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एमे॑नं प्र॒त्येत॑न॒ सोमे॑भिः सोम॒पात॑मम् । अम॑त्रेभिॠजी॒षिण॒मिन्द्रं॑ सु॒तेभि॒रिन्दु॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ prati-étana ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ soma-pā́tamam ǀámatrebhiḥ ǀ ṛjīṣíṇam ǀ índram ǀ sutébhiḥ ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proceed to the presence of that deep quaffer of theSoma, with the Soma; to the vigorousIndrawith vessels (filed) with the efused libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॑ सु॒तेभि॒रिन्दु॑भि॒: सोमे॑भिः प्रति॒भूष॑थ । वेदा॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ मेधि॑रो धृ॒षत्तंत॒मिदेष॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ sutébhiḥ ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ prati-bhū́ṣatha ǀvéda ǀ víśvasya ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ tám-tam ǀ ít ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, with the effused and flowingSoma, you come into his presence, the sagacious (Indra) knows your wish, and the suppresser (of enemies) assuredly grants it, whateve it may be.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माअ॑स्मा॒ इदन्ध॒सोऽध्व॑र्यो॒ प्र भ॑रा सु॒तम् । कु॒वित्स॑मस्य॒ जेन्य॑स्य॒ शर्ध॑तो॒ऽभिश॑स्तेरव॒स्पर॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: asmái-asmai ǀ ít ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ ádhvaryo íti ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ sutám ǀkuvít ǀ samasya ǀ jényasya ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ ava-spárat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, priest, to him, and him (only) this libation of (sacrificial) food, and may he ever defend us against the malignity of every superable adversary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्यच्छम्ब॑रं॒ मदे॒ दिवो॑दासाय र॒न्धय॑: । अ॒यं स सोम॑ इन्द्र ते सु॒तः पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tyát ǀ śámbaram ǀ máde ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ randháyaḥ ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, in the exhilaration of which it is known that you have subduedŚambarafor (the sake of)Divodāsa, is poured out,Indra, for you; drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ तीव्र॒सुतं॒ मदं॒ मध्य॒मन्तं॑ च॒ रक्ष॑से । अ॒यं स सोम॑ इन्द्र ते सु॒तः पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tīvra-sútam ǀ mádam ǀ mádhyam ǀ ántam ǀ ca ǀ rákṣase ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, the exhilarating draught of which, when fresh effused (at dawn), or at noon, or at the last (or evening worship), you cherish, is poured out,Indra, for you; drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ गा अ॒न्तरश्म॑नो॒ मदे॑ दृ॒ळ्हा अ॒वासृ॑जः । अ॒यं स सोम॑ इन्द्र ते सु॒तः पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ máde ǀ dṛḷhā́ḥ ǀ ava-ásṛjaḥ ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, in the exhilaration of which you have liberated the cattle, firm (fastened) within the rock, is poured out,Indra, for you; drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ मन्दा॒नो अन्ध॑सो॒ माघो॑नं दधि॒षे शव॑: । अ॒यं स सोम॑ इन्द्र ते सु॒तः पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mā́ghonam ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ śávaḥ ǀayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sutáḥ ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, exhilarated (by drinking) of which (sacrificial) food you possessed the might ofMaghavan, is poured out,Indra, for you; drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो र॑यिवो र॒यिंत॑मो॒ यो द्यु॒म्नैर्द्यु॒म्नव॑त्तमः । सोम॑: सु॒तः स इ॑न्द्र॒ तेऽस्ति॑ स्वधापते॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rayi-vaḥ ǀ rayím-tamaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ dyumnávat-tamaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ svadhā-pate ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentIndra, theSomathat abounds with riches, and is most resplendent with glories, is poured out; it is your exhilaration, Indra, lord of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः श॒ग्मस्तु॑विशग्म ते रा॒यो दा॒मा म॑ती॒नाम् । सोम॑: सु॒तः स इ॑न्द्र॒ तेऽस्ति॑ स्वधापते॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śagmáḥ ǀ tuvi-śagma ǀ te ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dāmā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀsómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ svadhā-pate ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma, possessor of felicity, which gives you delight, and which is the bestower of riches on your votaries, is poured out; it is your exhilaration,Indra, lord of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येन॑ वृ॒द्धो न शव॑सा तु॒रो न स्वाभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । सोम॑: सु॒तः स इ॑न्द्र॒ तेऽस्ति॑ स्वधापते॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ vṛddháḥ ǀ ná ǀ śávasā ǀ turáḥ ǀ ná ǀ svā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ svadhā-pate ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma, whereby you are augmented in strength, and, together with your defenders, (theMaruts), are victorious (over your foes), is poured out; it is your exhilaration,Indra, lord of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यमु॑ वो॒ अप्र॑हणं गृणी॒षे शव॑स॒स्पति॑म् । इन्द्रं॑ विश्वा॒साहं॒ नरं॒ मंहि॑ष्ठं वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ ápra-hanam ǀ gṛṇīṣé ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ pátim ǀíndram ǀ viśva-sáham ǀ náram ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Worshippers), for you I glorify thatIndrawho disappointed not (his adorers); the lord of strength, the all-subduing, the leader (of rites), the most beautiful, the beholder of the universe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं व॒र्धय॒न्तीद्गिर॒: पतिं॑ तु॒रस्य॒ राध॑सः । तमिन्न्व॑स्य॒ रोद॑सी दे॒वी शुष्मं॑ सपर्यतः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ vardháyanti ǀ ít ǀ gíraḥ ǀ pátim ǀ turásya ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀtám ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ śúṣmam ǀ saparyataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine heaven and earth adore that vigour of his, which our hymns augment, the appropriator of the riches of the foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्व॑ उ॒क्थस्य॑ ब॒र्हणेन्द्रा॑योपस्तृणी॒षणि॑ । विपो॒ न यस्यो॒तयो॒ वि यद्रोह॑न्ति स॒क्षित॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ukthásya ǀ barháṇā ǀ índrāya ǀ upa-stṛṇīṣáṇi ǀvípaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ róhanti ǀ sa-kṣítaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Worshippers), the efficacy of your eulogy is to be manifested to thatIndra, whose protections, like (those) of a sensible man, are displayed as abiding along with him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवि॑द॒द्दक्षं॑ मि॒त्रो नवी॑यान्पपा॒नो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वस्यो॑ अचैत् । स॒स॒वान्त्स्तौ॒लाभि॑र्धौ॒तरी॑भिरुरु॒ष्या पा॒युर॑भव॒त्सखि॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: ávidat ǀ dákṣam ǀ mitráḥ ǀ návīyān ǀ papānáḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ acait ǀsasa-vā́n ǀ staulā́bhiḥ ǀ dhautárībhiḥ ǀ uruṣyā́ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, appreciates him who is skilled (in holy rites); a recent friend, quaffing (the libation), he heaps excellent (wealth) upon the devout; partaking of (the sacrificial) food, (and brought) by his robust agitators (of the earth, his steeds), he, through his benevolence, is a protector to his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒थि वे॒धा अ॑पायि श्रि॒ये मनां॑सि दे॒वासो॑ अक्रन् । दधा॑नो॒ नाम॑ म॒हो वचो॑भि॒र्वपु॑र्दृ॒शये॑ वे॒न्यो व्या॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ pathí ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ apāyi ǀ śriyé ǀ mánāṃsi ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ akran ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ maháḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vápuḥ ǀ dṛśáye ǀ venyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma, creator (of all), on the path of sacrifice, has been drunk; the worshippers have presented it to gratify the mind (ofIndra); may he, the humiliator (of his foes), possessing a vast body, propitiated by our praises, become manifest to our view.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यु॒मत्त॑मं॒ दक्षं॑ धेह्य॒स्मे सेधा॒ जना॑नां पू॒र्वीररा॑तीः । वर्षी॑यो॒ वय॑: कृणुहि॒ शची॑भि॒र्धन॑स्य सा॒ताव॒स्माँ अ॑विड्ढि
shlokas.transliteration: dyumát-tamam ǀ dákṣam ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǀ sédha ǀ jánānām ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǀvárṣīyaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ dhánasya ǀ sātáu ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviḍḍhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us most brilliant vigour; oppose the numerous enemies of your worshippers; gran us, for our pious acts, abundant food; secure us in the enjoyment of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ तुभ्य॒मिन्म॑घवन्नभूम व॒यं दा॒त्रे ह॑रिवो॒ मा वि वे॑नः । नकि॑रा॒पिर्द॑दृशे मर्त्य॒त्रा किम॒ङ्ग र॑ध्र॒चोद॑नं त्वाहुः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ túbhyam ǀ ít ǀ magha-van ǀ abhūma ǀ vayám ǀ dātré ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ venaḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ martya-trā́ ǀ kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ radhra-códanam ǀ tvā ǀ āhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, possessor of affluence, we have recourse to you, the bountiful, lord of steeds, be not unfavourable to us; no other kinsman is beheld (by us) among men; who else have they called yo the bestower of wealth?”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा जस्व॑ने वृषभ नो ररीथा॒ मा ते॑ रे॒वत॑: स॒ख्ये रि॑षाम । पू॒र्वीष्ट॑ इन्द्र नि॒ष्षिधो॒ जने॑षु ज॒ह्यसु॑ष्वी॒न्प्र वृ॒हापृ॑णतः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ jásvane ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ naḥ ǀ rarīthāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ revátaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ riṣāma ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ niḥ-sídhaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ jahí ǀ ásusvīn ǀ prá ǀ vṛha ǀ ápṛṇataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give us not up, showerer (of benefits), to the obstructor (of our rites); relying upon the friendship of you, lord of riches, may we be unharmed; many are the hindrances (opposed) to you among men; slay those who make no libations, root out those who present no offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॒भ्राणी॑व स्त॒नय॑न्निय॒र्तीन्द्रो॒ राधां॒स्यश्व्या॑नि॒ गव्या॑ । त्वम॑सि प्र॒दिव॑: का॒रुधा॑या॒ मा त्वा॑दा॒मान॒ आ द॑भन्म॒घोन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ abhrā́ṇi-iva ǀ stanáyan ǀ iyarti ǀ índraḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ áśvyāni ǀ gávyā ǀtvám ǀ asi ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ adāmā́naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dabhan ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AsIndra, when thundering rases the clouds, so he (heaps upon his worshippers) riches of horses and cattle; yo, Indra, are he ancient upholder of the sacrificer; let not the opulent wrong you, not presenting (oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यो वीर॒ प्र म॒हे सु॒ताना॒मिन्द्रा॑य भर॒ स ह्य॑स्य॒ राजा॑ । यः पू॒र्व्याभि॑रु॒त नूत॑नाभिर्गी॒र्भिर्वा॑वृ॒धे गृ॑ण॒तामृषी॑णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ vīra ǀ prá ǀ mahé ǀ sutā́nām ǀ índrāya ǀ bhara ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ rā́jā ǀyáḥ ǀ pūrvyā́bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ gṛṇatā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ministrant priests offer libations to the mightyIndra, for he is their king, he who has been exalted by the ancient and recent hymns of adoring sages.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य मदे॑ पु॒रु वर्पां॑सि वि॒द्वानिन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्राण्य॑प्र॒ती ज॑घान । तमु॒ प्र हो॑षि॒ मधु॑मन्तमस्मै॒ सोमं॑ वी॒राय॑ शि॒प्रिणे॒ पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ máde ǀ purú ǀ várpāṃsi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀ jaghāna ǀtám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ hoṣi ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ asmai ǀ sómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śipríṇe ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the exhilaration of thisSoma, the wiseIndra, irresistible, has destroyed numerous opposing enemies; offer the sweet-flavoured beverage to that hero, the handsome-chinned, to drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पाता॑ सु॒तमिन्द्रो॑ अस्तु॒ सोमं॒ हन्ता॑ वृ॒त्रं वज्रे॑ण मन्दसा॒नः । गन्ता॑ य॒ज्ञं प॑रा॒वत॑श्चि॒दच्छा॒ वसु॑र्धी॒नाम॑वि॒ता का॒रुधा॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: pā́tā ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómam ǀ hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ vájreṇa ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀgántā ǀ yajñám ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ áccha ǀ vásuḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ avitā́ ǀ kārú-dhāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndrabe the drinker of this effusedSoma, and, exhilarated by it, become the destroyer ofVṛtraby the thunderbolt; may he come, although from afar, to our sacrifice, (he who is) the giver of dwellings, the upholder of the celebrator (of religious).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं त्यत्पात्र॑मिन्द्र॒पान॒मिन्द्र॑स्य प्रि॒यम॒मृत॑मपायि । मत्स॒द्यथा॑ सौमन॒साय॑ दे॒वं व्य१॒॑स्मद्द्वेषो॑ यु॒यव॒द्व्यंह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ tyát ǀ pā́tram ǀ indra-pā́nam ǀ índrasya ǀ priyám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ apāyi ǀmátsat ǀ yáthā ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ devám ǀ ví ǀ asmát ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ yuyávat ǀ ví ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this ambrosia, the appropriate beverage ofIndra, of which is fond, be quaffed (by him), so that it may inspire the divinity with favourable feelings (towards us), and that he may remove from us our adversaries, and (all) iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ना म॑न्दा॒नो ज॒हि शू॑र॒ शत्रू॑ञ्जा॒मिमजा॑मिं मघवन्न॒मित्रा॑न् । अ॒भि॒षे॒णाँ अ॒भ्या॒३॒॑देदि॑शाना॒न्परा॑च इन्द्र॒ प्र मृ॑णा ज॒ही च॑
shlokas.transliteration: enā́ ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ jahí ǀ śūra ǀ śátrūn ǀ jāmím ǀ ájāmim ǀ magha-van ǀ amítrān ǀabhi-senā́n ǀ abhí ǀ ā-dédiśānān ǀ párācaḥ ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ mṛṇa ǀ jahí ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarated by it, valiantMaghavan, slay our unfriendly adversaries, whether kinsman or unrelated (to us); put to flight,Indra, hostile armies menacing us (with their weapons), and slay them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒सु ष्मा॑ णो मघवन्निन्द्र पृ॒त्स्व१॒॑स्मभ्यं॒ महि॒ वरि॑वः सु॒गं क॑: । अ॒पां तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑यस्य जे॒ष इन्द्र॑ सू॒रीन्कृ॑णु॒हि स्मा॑ नो अ॒र्धम्
shlokas.transliteration: āsú ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ asmábhyam ǀ máhi ǀ várivaḥ ǀ su-gám ǀ karíti kaḥ ǀapā́m ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ jeṣé ǀ índra ǀ sūrī́n ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ ardhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AffluentIndra, facilitate to us (the acquisition of) vast riches in these our battles; (enable us) to gain the victory; make us prosperous with rain, and with sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ हर॑यो॒ वृष॑णो युजा॒ना वृष॑रथासो॒ वृष॑रश्म॒योऽत्या॑: । अ॒स्म॒त्राञ्चो॒ वृष॑णो वज्र॒वाहो॒ वृष्णे॒ मदा॑य सु॒युजो॑ वहन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ yujānā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-rathāsaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-raśmayaḥ ǀ átyāḥ ǀasmatrā́ñcaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vajra-vā́haḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ mádāya ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ vahantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your vigorous steeds, harnessed of their own will, drawing your wish-bestowing chariot, guided by shower-yielding reins, quick-moving, hastening towards us, youthful, thunder-bearing, well-yoked, bring you to the hountiful, exhilarating (libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ वृष॒न्वृष॑णो॒ द्रोण॑मस्थुर्घृत॒प्रुषो॒ नोर्मयो॒ मद॑न्तः । इन्द्र॒ प्र तुभ्यं॒ वृष॑भिः सु॒तानां॒ वृष्णे॑ भरन्ति वृष॒भाय॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ vṛṣan ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ dróṇam ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ghṛta-prúṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ mádantaḥ ǀíndra ǀ prá ǀ túbhyam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ sutā́nām ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ bharanti ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), your vigorous water-shedding steeds, like the waves (of the sea), exulting, are harnessed to your car; for they, (the priests), offer to you, the showerer (of benefits), ever youthful, the libation of theSomaexpressed by the stones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑सि दि॒वो वृ॑ष॒भः पृ॑थि॒व्या वृषा॒ सिन्धू॑नां वृष॒भः स्तिया॑नाम् । वृष्णे॑ त॒ इन्दु॑र्वृषभ पीपाय स्वा॒दू रसो॑ मधु॒पेयो॒ वरा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ asi ǀ diváḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ síndhūnām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ stíyānām ǀvṛ́ṣṇe ǀ te ǀ índuḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ pīpāya ǀ svādúḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ madhu-péyaḥ ǀ várāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are the showerer of heaven, the bearer of earth, the feeder of the rivers, the supplier of the aggregated (waters); for you, showerer (of benefits), who are the most excellent shedder of rain, the sweetSoma, the honey-flavoured, is ready to be quaffed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं दे॒वः सह॑सा॒ जाय॑मान॒ इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा प॒णिम॑स्तभायत् । अ॒यं स्वस्य॑ पि॒तुरायु॑धा॒नीन्दु॑रमुष्णा॒दशि॑वस्य मा॒याः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ deváḥ ǀ sáhasā ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ yujā́ ǀ paṇím ǀ astabhāyat ǀayám ǀ svásya ǀ pitúḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ índuḥ ǀ amuṣṇāt ǀ áśivasya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divineSoma, withIndrafor its ally, crushed, as soon as genitive rated,Paṇiby force; this Soma baffled the devices and the weapons of the malignant secreter of (the stolen) wealth, (the cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॑कृणोदु॒षस॑: सु॒पत्नी॑र॒यं सूर्ये॑ अदधा॒ज्ज्योति॑र॒न्तः । अ॒यं त्रि॒धातु॑ दि॒वि रो॑च॒नेष॒॑ त्रि॒तेषु॑ विन्दद॒मृतं॒ निगू॑ळ्हम्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ akṛṇot ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ su-pátnīḥ ǀ ayám ǀ sū́rye ǀ adadhāt ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ antáríti ǀayám ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ diví ǀ rocanéṣu ǀ tritéṣu ǀ vindat ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ní-gūḷham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomamade the dawns happily wedded to the sun; this Soma plural ced the light within the solar orb; this (Soma) has found the threefold ambrosia hidden in heaven in the three bright regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि ष्क॑भायद॒यं रथ॑मयुनक्स॒प्तर॑श्मिम् । अ॒यं गोषु॒ शच्या॑ प॒क्वम॒न्तः सोमो॑ दाधार॒ दश॑यन्त्र॒मुत्स॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ví ǀ skabhāyat ǀ ayám ǀ rátham ǀ ayunak ǀ saptá-raśmim ǀayám ǀ góṣu ǀ śácyā ǀ pakvám ǀ antáríti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ dáśa-yantram ǀ útsam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma) has been fixed heaven and earth; this has harnessed the seven-rayed chariot (of the sun); this Soma has developed of its own will the mature deeply-organized secretion in the kind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आन॑यत्परा॒वत॒: सुनी॑ती तु॒र्वशं॒ यदु॑म् । इन्द्र॒: स नो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ánayat ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ sú-nītī ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀíndraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that youthfulIndra, who, by good guidance, broughtTurvaśaandYadufrom afar, (be) our friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वि॒प्रे चि॒द्वयो॒ दध॑दना॒शुना॑ चि॒दर्व॑ता । इन्द्रो॒ जेता॑ हि॒तं धन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: avipré ǀ cit ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ anāśúnā ǀ cit ǀ árvatā ǀíndraḥ ǀ jétā ǀ hitám ǀ dhánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indragives sustenance, even to the undevout he is the conqueror of wealh accusative ulated (by enemies) though (going against) them with a slow-paced steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हीर॑स्य॒ प्रणी॑तयः पू॒र्वीरु॒त प्रश॑स्तयः । नास्य॑ क्षीयन्त ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahī́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ prá-nītayaḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀná ǀ asya ǀ kṣīyante ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vast are his designs, manifold are his praises, his protections are never withdrawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑यो॒ ब्रह्म॑वाह॒सेऽर्च॑त॒ प्र च॑ गायत । स हि न॒: प्रम॑तिर्म॒ही
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ bráhma-vāhase ǀ árcata ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ gāyata ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ mahī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer worship and praises, friends, to him who is to be attracted by prayers; for he verily is our great intelligence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमेक॑स्य वृत्रहन्नवि॒ता द्वयो॑रसि । उ॒तेदृशे॒ यथा॑ व॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ékasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ avitā́ ǀ dváyoḥ ǀ asi ǀutá ǀ īdṛ́śe ǀ yáthā ǀ vayám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, you are the protector of one (adorer), or of two, and of such as we are.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नय॒सीद्वति॒ द्विष॑: कृ॒णोष्यु॑क्थशं॒सिन॑: । नृभि॑: सु॒वीर॑ उच्यसे
shlokas.transliteration: náyasi ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ uktha-śaṃsínaḥ ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ ucyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You remove (far from us) those who hate us; you prosper hose who repeat your praise; bestower of excellentmaledescendants, you are glorified by man”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्र॒ह्माणं॒ ब्रह्म॑वाहसं गी॒र्भिः सखा॑यमृ॒ग्मिय॑म् । गां न दो॒हसे॑ हुवे
shlokas.transliteration: brahmā́ṇam ǀ bráhma-vāhasam ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀgā́m ǀ ná ǀ doháse ǀ huve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke with hymnsIndra, our friends, who isBrahma, who is attracted by prayer and entitled to adoration, to milk him as a cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हस्त॑योरू॒चुर्वसू॑नि॒ नि द्वि॒ता । वी॒रस्य॑ पृतना॒षह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ víśvāni ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ ūcúḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ ní ǀ dvitā́ ǀvīrásya ǀ pṛtanā-sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In thehandsof whom, the eroic subduer of hostile armies, (the sages) have declared, are all the treasures in both (heaven and earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि दृ॒ळ्हानि॑ चिदद्रिवो॒ जना॑नां शचीपते । वृ॒ह मा॒या अ॑नानत
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ śacī-pate ǀvṛhá ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ anānata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, lord ofŚaci, demolish the strong (cities) of men; (battle), unbending (Indra) their devices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा सत्य सोमपा॒ इन्द्र॑ वाजानां पते । अहू॑महि श्रव॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ satya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ índra ǀ vājānām ǀ pate ǀáhūmahi ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VeraciousIndra, drinker of theSoma, provider of sustenance, we, desirous of food, invoke such as you are.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा॒ यः पु॒रासि॑थ॒ यो वा॑ नू॒नं हि॒ते धने॑ । हव्य॒: स श्रु॑धी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ ā́sitha ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ nūnám ǀ hité ǀ dháne ǀhávyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śrudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We invoke) you, such as you are, you who have been invocable of old, and who are now to be invoked for the wealth held (by the foe); hear our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धी॒भिरर्व॑द्भि॒रर्व॑तो॒ वाजाँ॑ इन्द्र श्र॒वाय्या॑न् । त्वया॑ जेष्म हि॒तं धन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dhībhíḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ indra ǀ śravā́yyān ǀtváyā ǀ jeṣma ǀ hitám ǀ dhánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Favoured) by you,Indra, (who are propitiated), by our hymns, (we ovecome) with our steeds the steeds (of the enemy), and we conquer abundant food, and the wealth held (by the foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑रु वीर गिर्वणो म॒हाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ धने॑ हि॒ते । भरे॑ वितन्त॒साय्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vīra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ indra ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀbháre ǀ vitantasā́yyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heroic and adorableIndra, verily you are mighty in battle, and victor of the wealth held (by the enemy).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या त॑ ऊ॒तिर॑मित्रहन्म॒क्षूज॑वस्त॒मास॑ति । तया॑ नो हिनुही॒ रथ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ amitra-han ǀ makṣújavaḥ-tamā ǀ ásati ǀtáyā ǀ naḥ ǀ hinuhi ǀ rátham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of enemies with that your velocity, which is of exceeding swiftness, impel our chariots (against the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रथे॑न र॒थीत॑मो॒ऽस्माके॑नाभि॒युग्व॑ना । जेषि॑ जिष्णो हि॒तं धन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ráthena ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ asmā́kena ǀ abhi-yúgvanā ǀjéṣi ǀ jiṣṇo íti ǀ hitám ǀ dhánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VictoriousIndra, who are the chief off charioteers, conquer the wealth that is held (by the enemy) with our assailing car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एक॒ इत्तमु॑ ष्टुहि कृष्टी॒नां विच॑र्षणिः । पति॑र्ज॒ज्ञे वृष॑क्रतुः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuhi ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀpátiḥ ǀ jajñé ǀ vṛ́ṣa-kratuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise thatIndrawho alone has been born the supervisor (of all), the lord of men, the giver of rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो गृ॑ण॒तामिदासि॑था॒पिरू॒ती शि॒वः सखा॑ । स त्वं न॑ इन्द्र मृळय
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ gṛṇatā́m ǀ ít ǀ ā́sitha ǀ āpíḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ sákhā ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who has ever been the friend of those who praise you, and the insurer of their happiness by your protection, grant us felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धि॒ष्व वज्रं॒ गभ॑स्त्यो रक्षो॒हत्या॑य वज्रिवः । सा॒स॒ही॒ष्ठा अ॒भि स्पृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dhiṣvá ǀ vájram ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ rakṣaḥ-hátyāya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀsasahīṣṭhā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, take the bolt in yourhandsfor the destruction ofrākṣasas, and uttely overthrow those who defy you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒त्नं र॑यी॒णां युजं॒ सखा॑यं कीरि॒चोद॑नम् । ब्रह्म॑वाहस्तमं हुवे
shlokas.transliteration: pratnám ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ yújam ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kīri-códanam ǀbráhma-vāhaḥ-tamam ǀ huve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the ancientIndra, the giver of iches, (our) friend, the encourager of his adorers, who is to be propitiated by prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि विश्वा॑नि॒ पार्थि॑वाँ॒ एको॒ वसू॑नि॒ पत्य॑ते । गिर्व॑णस्तमो॒ अध्रि॑गुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ víśvāni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ pátyate ǀgírvaṇaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ ádhri-guḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He alone rules over all terrestrial riches, he who is entitled to especial praise, he who is irresistible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ नि॒युद्भि॒रा पृ॑ण॒ कामं॒ वाजे॑भिर॒श्विभि॑: । गोम॑द्भिर्गोपते धृ॒षत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǀ kā́mam ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ aśví-bhiḥ ǀgómat-bhiḥ ǀ go-pate ǀ dhṛṣát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of cattle, (coming) with your mares, saisfy our desires completely with (abundant) food, with horses, and with kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वो॑ गाय सु॒ते सचा॑ पुरुहू॒ताय॒ सत्व॑ने । शं यद्गवे॒ न शा॒किने॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ gāya ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ puru-hūtā́ya ǀ sátvane ǀśám ǀ yát ǀ gáve ǀ ná ǀ śākíne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing praises, when your libation is poured out, to him who is the invoked of many, the subduer (of foes), giving him gratification, like (fresh pasture) to cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न घा॒ वसु॒र्नि य॑मते दा॒नं वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः । यत्सी॒मुप॒ श्रव॒द्गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ gha ǀ vásuḥ ǀ ní ǀ yamate ǀ dānám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ úpa ǀ śrávat ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The giver of dwellings verily withholds not the gift of food conjoined with cattle, when he hears our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒वित्स॑स्य॒ प्र हि व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तं दस्यु॒हा गम॑त् । शची॑भि॒रप॑ नो वरत्
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít-sasya ǀ prá ǀ hí ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ dasyu-hā́ ǀ gámat ǀśácībhiḥ ǀ ápa ǀ naḥ ǀ varat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then the desroyer of theDasyus, proceeds to the cattl-crowded folds of Kuvitsa, and by his acts opens them for us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा शतक्रतो॒ऽभि प्र णो॑नुवु॒र्गिर॑: । इन्द्र॑ व॒त्सं न मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonuvuḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀíndra ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, performer of many exploits, these our praises repeatedly recur to you as parent (cows) to their young.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒णाशं॑ स॒ख्यं तव॒ गौर॑सि वीर गव्य॒ते । अश्वो॑ अश्वाय॒ते भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: duḥ-náśam ǀ sakhyám ǀ táva ǀ gáuḥ ǀ asi ǀ vīra ǀ gavyaté ǀáśvaḥ ǀ aśva-yaté ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your friendship,Indra, is not easily lost; you, hero are (the giver of) cattle to him who desires cattle (of) horses him who desires horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑न्दस्वा॒ ह्यन्ध॑सो॒ राध॑से त॒न्वा॑ म॒हे । न स्तो॒तारं॑ नि॒दे क॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mandasva ǀ hí ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ rā́dhase ǀ tanvā́ ǀ mahé ǀná ǀ stotā́ram ǀ nidé ǀ karaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Delight your person n with the libation (offered) for the sake of treasure; subject not your worshipper to his reviler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा सु॒तेसु॑ते॒ नक्ष॑न्ते गिर्वणो॒ गिर॑: । व॒त्सं गावो॒ न धे॒नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ suté-sute ǀ nákṣante ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀvatsám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These our praises tend, as the libationsa are repeatedly poured out, eagerly to you who are gratified by praise, as the milch kine (hasten) to their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रू॒तमं॑ पुरू॒णां स्तो॑तॄ॒णां विवा॑चि । वाजे॑भिर्वाजय॒ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-támam ǀ purūṇā́m ǀ stotṝṇā́m ǀ ví-vāci ǀvā́jebhiḥ ǀ vāja-yatā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praises of many worshippers offered at the sacrifice, (accompanied) by (sacrificial) viands, invigorate you, destroyer of multitudes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मिन्द्र भूतु ते॒ स्तोमो॒ वाहि॑ष्ठो॒ अन्त॑मः । अ॒स्मान्रा॒ये म॒हे हि॑नु
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ indra ǀ bhūtu ǀ te ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀasmā́n ǀ rāyé ǀ mahé ǀ hinu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our most elevating praise be near,Indra, to you, and urge us to (the acquisition of) great riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॑ बृ॒बुः प॑णी॒नां वर्षि॑ष्ठे मू॒र्धन्न॑स्थात् । उ॒रुः कक्षो॒ न गा॒ङ्ग्यः
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ bṛbúḥ ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ várṣiṣṭhe ǀ mūrdhán ǀ asthāt ǀurúḥ ǀ kákṣaḥ ǀ ná ǀ gāṅgyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛbu presided over the high plural ces of thePaṇis, like the elevated bank of theGanges.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ वा॒योरि॑व द्र॒वद्भ॒द्रा रा॒तिः स॑ह॒स्रिणी॑ । स॒द्यो दा॒नाय॒ मंह॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ vāyóḥ-iva ǀ dravát ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ rātíḥ ǀ sahasríṇī ǀsadyáḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ máṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom, prompt as the wind, the liberal donation of thousands (of cattle) has been quickly given to (me) soliciting a gift.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्सु नो॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒र्य आ सदा॑ गृणन्ति का॒रव॑: । बृ॒बुं स॑हस्र॒दात॑मं सू॒रिं स॑हस्र॒सात॑मम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sádā ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀbṛbúm ǀ sahasra-dā́tamam ǀ sūrím ǀ sahasra-sā́tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom, therefore, we all, who are the profferers and bestowers of praise ever commend, as the pious Bṛbu, the donor of thousands (of cattle), the receiver of thousands (of laudations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवा॑महे सा॒ता वाज॑स्य का॒रव॑: । त्वां वृ॒त्रेष्वि॑न्द्र॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ नर॒स्त्वां काष्ठा॒स्वर्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ hávāmahe ǀ sātā́ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ kārávaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ indra ǀ sát-patim ǀ náraḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ kā́ṣṭhāsu ǀ árvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worshippers invoke you for the acquisition of food; you,Indra, the protector of the good, (do) men (invoke for aid) against enemies, and in plural ces where horses (encounter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं न॑श्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णु॒या म॒हः स्त॑वा॒नो अ॑द्रिवः । गामश्वं॑ र॒थ्य॑मिन्द्र॒ सं कि॑र स॒त्रा वाजं॒ न जि॒ग्युषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ citra ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ stavānáḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀgā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ rathyám ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ kira ǀ satrā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ná ǀ jigyúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wonderful wielder of the thunderbolt,Indra, the lord of clouds, mighty in resolution, being glorified by us, grant us cattle, and horses fit for chariots, as (you grant) abundant food to him who is victorious (in battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः स॑त्रा॒हा विच॑र्षणि॒रिन्द्रं॒ तं हू॑महे व॒यम् । सह॑स्रमुष्क॒ तुवि॑नृम्ण॒ सत्प॑ते॒ भवा॑ स॒मत्सु॑ नो वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ satrā-hā́ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ índram ǀ tám ǀ hūmahe ǀ vayám ǀsáhasra-muṣka ǀ túvi-nṛmṇa ǀ sát-pate ǀ bháva ǀ samát-su ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke thatIndrawho is the desroyer of mighty foes, the supervisor (of all things); do you, the many organed, the protector of the good, the distributor of wealth, be unto us (the insurer of) success in combats.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बाध॑से॒ जना॑न्वृष॒भेव॑ म॒न्युना॒ घृषौ॑ मी॒ळ्ह ऋ॑चीषम । अ॒स्माकं॑ बोध्यवि॒ता म॑हाध॒ने त॒नूष्व॒प्सु सूर्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: bā́dhase ǀ jánān ǀ vṛṣabhā́-iva ǀ manyúnā ǀ ghṛ́ṣau ǀ mīḷhé ǀ ṛcīṣama ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ sū́rye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such,Indra, as you are represented in holy texts, assail (our) adversaries with fierceness like (that of) a bull in close conflict; regard yourself as our defender in war, (that we may long enjoy) posterity, water, and the sight of the) sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ न॒ आ भ॑रँ॒ ओजि॑ष्ठं॒ पपु॑रि॒ श्रव॑: । येने॒मे चि॑त्र वज्रहस्त॒ रोद॑सी॒ ओभे सु॑शिप्र॒ प्राः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ pápuri ǀ śrávaḥ ǀyéna ǀ imé íti ǀ citra ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ su-śipra ǀ prā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, bring to us most excellent, most invigorating and nutritious food, wherewith, wonderful wielder of the thunderbolt, the handsome-chinned, you sustain both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामु॒ग्रमव॑से चर्षणी॒सहं॒ राज॑न्दे॒वेषु॑ हूमहे । विश्वा॒ सु नो॑ विथु॒रा पि॑ब्द॒ना व॑सो॒ऽमित्रा॑न्त्सु॒षहा॑न्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ugrám ǀ ávase ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǀ rā́jan ǀ devéṣu ǀ hūmahe ǀvíśvā ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vithurā́ ǀ pibdanā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ amítrān ǀ su-sáhān ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for protection you, royalIndra, who are mighty among the gods, tthe subduer of men; granter of dwellings, repel all evil spirits, and render our enemies easy of discomfiture.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ नाहु॑षी॒ष्वाँ ओजो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॑ कृ॒ष्टिषु॑ । यद्वा॒ पञ्च॑ क्षिती॒नां द्यु॒म्नमा भ॑र स॒त्रा विश्वा॑नि॒ पौंस्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ nā́huṣīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ca ǀ kṛṣṭíṣu ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀ dyumnám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ satrā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ páuṃsyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever strength and opulence (exist) among human beings, whatever be the sustenance of the five classes of men, bringIndrato us, as well (as) all great manly energies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑ तृ॒क्षौ म॑घवन्द्रु॒ह्यावा जने॒ यत्पू॒रौ कच्च॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ तद्रि॑रीहि॒ सं नृ॒षाह्ये॒ऽमित्रा॑न्पृ॒त्सु तु॒र्वणे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ tṛkṣáu ǀ magha-van ǀ druhyáu ǀ ā́ ǀ jáne ǀ yát ǀ pūráu ǀ kát ǀ ca ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀasmábhyam ǀ tát ǀ rirīhi ǀ sám ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ amítrān ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ turváṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever vigour,Maghavan, (existed) in Tṛkṣu, inDruhyu, inPuru, bestow fully upon us in conflicts with foes, so that we may destroy our enemies in war.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ त्रि॒धातु॑ शर॒णं त्रि॒वरू॑थं स्वस्ति॒मत् । छ॒र्दिर्य॑च्छ म॒घव॑द्भ्यश्च॒ मह्यं॑ च या॒वया॑ दि॒द्युमे॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ śaraṇám ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ svasti-mát ǀchardíḥ ǀ yaccha ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ máhyam ǀ ca ǀ yaváya ǀ didyúm ǀ ebhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give,Indra, to the affluent, and to me also, a sheltering and prosperous dwelling combining three elements, and defending in three ways and keep from them the blazing (weapon of our foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ग॑व्य॒ता मन॑सा॒ शत्रु॑माद॒भुर॑भिप्र॒घ्नन्ति॑ धृष्णु॒या । अध॑ स्मा नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणस्तनू॒पा अन्त॑मो भव
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ gavyatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ śátrum ǀ ā-dabhúḥ ǀ abhi-praghnánti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ tanū-pā́ḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AffluentIndra, propitiated by praise, be nigh o us, as the defender of our person ns (against those) who assail (us as) enemies, with a mind bent upon carrying off (our) cattle, or who assault us with arrogance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ स्मा नो वृ॒धे भ॒वेन्द्र॑ ना॒यम॑वा यु॒धि । यद॒न्तरि॑क्षे प॒तय॑न्ति प॒र्णिनो॑ दि॒द्यव॑स्ति॒ग्ममू॑र्धानः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhava ǀ índra ǀ nāyám ǀ ava ǀ yudhí ǀyát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ patáyanti ǀ parṇínaḥ ǀ didyávaḥ ǀ tigmá-mūrdhānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, be (favourable) at present to our success; protect our leader in battle when the feathered, sharp-pointed, shining shafts fall from the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ शूरा॑सस्त॒न्वो॑ वितन्व॒ते प्रि॒या शर्म॑ पितॄ॒णाम् । अध॑ स्मा यच्छ त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ तने॑ च छ॒र्दिर॒चित्तं॑ या॒वय॒ द्वेष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ śū́rāsaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ vi-tanvaté ǀ priyā́ ǀ śárma ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ yaccha ǀ tanvé ǀ táne ǀ ca ǀ chardíḥ ǀ acíttam ǀ yaváya ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When heroes rest their person ns (until abandoning) the plural asant abodes of their progenitors; grant us, for ourselves and our posterity, an unsuspected defence, and scatter our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ सर्गे॒ अर्व॑तश्चो॒दया॑से महाध॒ने । अ॒स॒म॒ने अध्व॑नि वृजि॒ने प॒थि श्ये॒नाँ इ॑व श्रवस्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ sárge ǀ árvataḥ ǀ codáyāse ǀ mahā-dhané ǀasamané ǀ ádhvani ǀ vṛjiné ǀ pathí ǀ śyenā́n-iva ǀ śravasyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(At the time) when, in the effort (made) in an arduous conflict, you urge our horses over an uneven road, like falcons darting upon their food through the difficult path (of the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धूँ॑रिव प्रव॒ण आ॑शु॒या य॒तो यदि॒ क्लोश॒मनु॒ ष्वणि॑ । आ ये वयो॒ न वर्वृ॑त॒त्यामि॑षि गृभी॒ता बा॒ह्वोर्गवि॑
shlokas.transliteration: síndhūn-iva ǀ pravaṇé ǀ āśu-yā́ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ yádi ǀ klóśam ǀ ánu ǀ sváni ǀā́ ǀ yé ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ várvṛtati ǀ ā́miṣi ǀ gṛbhītā́ḥ ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ gávi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rushing rapidly like rivers in their downward course and although neighing loudly through trro, they yet, tight-girthed, return repeatedly (to the conflict) for cattle, like birds darting on their prey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दुष्किला॒यं मधु॑माँ उ॒तायं ती॒व्रः किला॒यं रस॑वाँ उ॒तायम् । उ॒तो न्व१॒॑स्य प॑पि॒वांस॒मिन्द्रं॒ न कश्च॒न स॑हत आह॒वेषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: svādúḥ ǀ kíla ǀ ayám ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ utá ǀ ayám ǀ tīvráḥ ǀ kíla ǀ ayám ǀ rása-vān ǀ utá ǀ ayám ǀutó íti ǀ nú ǀ asyá ǀ papi-vā́ṃsam ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ sahate ǀ ā-havéṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savoury indeed is this (Soma); sweet is it, sharp, and full of flavour; no one is able to encounterIndrain battles after he has been quaffing this (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स्वा॒दुरि॒ह मदि॑ष्ठ आस॒ यस्येन्द्रो॑ वृत्र॒हत्ये॑ म॒माद॑ । पु॒रूणि॒ यश्च्यौ॒त्ना शम्ब॑रस्य॒ वि न॑व॒तिं नव॑ च दे॒ह्यो॒३॒॑ हन्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ svādúḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mádiṣṭhaḥ ǀ āsa ǀ yásya ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ mamā́da ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ yáḥ ǀ cyautnā́ ǀ śámbarasya ǀ ví ǀ navatím ǀ náva ǀ ca ǀ dehyáḥ ǀ hán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The savourySoma, drunk on this occasion, has been most exhilarating; by drinking of itIndrahas been elevated to the slaying ofVṛtra, and it has destroyed the numerous hosts ofŚambaraand the ninetynine cities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं मे॑ पी॒त उदि॑यर्ति॒ वाच॑म॒यं म॑नी॒षामु॑श॒तीम॑जीगः । अ॒यं षळु॒र्वीर॑मिमीत॒ धीरो॒ न याभ्यो॒ भुव॑नं॒ कच्च॒नारे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ me ǀ pītáḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ ayám ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ uśatī́m ǀ ajīgaríti ǀayám ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ urvī́ḥ ǀ amimīta ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ yā́bhyaḥ ǀ bhúvanam ǀ kát ǀ caná ǀ āré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomainspires my speech; this develops the desired intelligence; this sagacious (Soma) has created the six vast conditions, from which no creature is distinct.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स यो व॑रि॒माणं॑ पृथि॒व्या व॒र्ष्माणं॑ दि॒वो अकृ॑णोद॒यं सः । अ॒यं पी॒यूषं॑ ति॒सृषु॑ प्र॒वत्सु॒ सोमो॑ दाधारो॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ varimā́ṇam ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ varṣmā́ṇam ǀ diváḥ ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀayám ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ tisṛ́ṣu ǀ pravát-su ǀ sómaḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This it is which formed the expanse of the earth, the compactness of the heaven; thisSomahas deposited the ambrosia in its three principal (receptacles), and has upheld the spacious firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वि॑दच्चित्र॒दृशी॑क॒मर्ण॑: शु॒क्रस॑द्मनामु॒षसा॒मनी॑के । अ॒यं म॒हान्म॑ह॒ता स्कम्भ॑ने॒नोद्द्याम॑स्तभ्नाद्वृष॒भो म॒रुत्वा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vidat ǀ citra-dṛ́śīkam ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ śukrá-sadmanām ǀ uṣásām ǀ ánīke ǀayám ǀ mahā́n ǀ mahatā́ ǀ skámbhanena ǀ út ǀ dyā́m ǀ astabhnāt ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ marútvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This makes known the wonderfully beautiful and inspiring (solar) radiance) at the appearance of the dawns, whose dwelling is the firmament; this mighty (Soma) has sustained the heaven with a powerful support, th sender of rain, the leader of the winds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धृ॒षत्पि॑ब क॒लशे॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र वृत्र॒हा शू॑र सम॒रे वसू॑नाम् । माध्यं॑दिने॒ सव॑न॒ आ वृ॑षस्व रयि॒स्थानो॑ र॒यिम॒स्मासु॑ धेहि
shlokas.transliteration: dhṛṣát ǀ piba ǀ kaláśe ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ śūra ǀ sam-aré ǀ vásūnām ǀmā́dhyandine ǀ sávane ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ rayi-sthā́naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhehi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, who are the slayer of foes in contests for (the acquisition of) treasures, drink boldly from the pitcher; drink copiously at the noonday rite; receptacle of rices, bestow riches upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ प्र ण॑: पुरए॒तेव॑ पश्य॒ प्र नो॑ नय प्रत॒रं वस्यो॒ अच्छ॑ । भवा॑ सुपा॒रो अ॑तिपार॒यो नो॒ भवा॒ सुनी॑तिरु॒त वा॒मनी॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ puraetā́-iva ǀ páśya ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ naya ǀ pra-tarám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǀbháva ǀ su-pāráḥ ǀ ati-pārayáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bháva ǀ sú-nītiḥ ǀ utá ǀ vāmá-nītiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like one who goes before us,Indra, (on the road), look out, bring before us infinite wealth; be our conductor beyond the bounds (of want), convey us safely over (peril); be our careful guide, our gude to desirable (affluence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ मृ॒ळ मह्यं॑ जी॒वातु॑मिच्छ चो॒दय॒ धिय॒मय॑सो॒ न धारा॑म् । यत्किं चा॒हं त्वा॒युरि॒दं वदा॑मि॒ तज्जु॑षस्व कृ॒धि मा॑ दे॒वव॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: urúm ǀ naḥ ǀ lokám ǀ ánu ǀ neṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sváḥ-vat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ svastí ǀṛṣvā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sthávirasya ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ úpa ǀ stheyāma ǀ śaraṇā́ ǀ bṛhántā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make me happy,Indra; be plural ased to prolong my life; shapen my intellect like the edge of a metal sword; whatsoever, desirous (of propitiating) you, I may utter, be plural ased by it; render me the object of divine protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मवि॒तार॒मिन्द्रं॒ हवे॑हवे सु॒हवं॒ शूर॒मिन्द्र॑म् । ह्वया॑मि श॒क्रं पु॑रुहू॒तमिन्द्रं॑ स्व॒स्ति नो॑ म॒घवा॑ धा॒त्विन्द्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: váriṣṭhe ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vandhúre ǀ dhāḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhayoḥ ǀ śata-van ǀ áśvayoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀíṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ iṣā́m ǀ várṣiṣṭhām ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tārīt ǀ magha-van ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke, at repeated sacrifice,Indra, the preserver, the protector, the hero, who is easily propitiated, Indra, the powerful, the invoked of many; may Indra, the lord of affluence, bestow upon us prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ अवो॑भिः सुमृळी॒को भ॑वतु वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । बाध॑तां॒ द्वेषो॒ अभ॑यं कृणोतु सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ mṛḷá ǀ máhyam ǀ jīvā́tum ǀ iccha ǀ codáya ǀ dhíyam ǀ áyasaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhā́rām ǀyát ǀ kím ǀ ca ǀ ahám ǀ tvā-yúḥ ǀ idám ǀ vádāmi ǀ tát ǀ juṣasva ǀ kṛdhí ǀ mā ǀ devá-vantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the protecting, opulentIndrabe the bestower of felicity by his protections; may he, who is all-knower of felicity by his protections; may he, who is all-knowing, foil our adversaries; may he keep us out of danger, and may we be the possessors of excellent posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्य॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म । स सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मे आ॒राच्चि॒द्द्वेष॑: सनु॒तर्यु॑योतु
shlokas.transliteration: trātā́ram ǀ índram ǀ avitā́ram ǀ índram ǀ háve-have ǀ su-hávam ǀ śū́ram ǀ índram ǀhváyāmi ǀ śakrám ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ índram ǀ svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ dhātu ǀ índraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we continue in the favour of that adorable (deity) even in his auspicious good-will; may that protecting and opulentIndradrive far from us, into extinction, all those who hate us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ त्वे इ॑न्द्र प्र॒वतो॒ नोर्मिर्गिरो॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि नि॒युतो॑ धवन्ते । उ॒रू न राध॒: सव॑ना पु॒रूण्य॒पो गा व॑ज्रिन्युवसे॒ समिन्दू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ su-trā́mā ǀ svá-vān ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀbā́dhatām ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you the praises and prayers of the worshipper hasten like a torrent down a declivity; and you thunderer, aggregate the immense wealth (of sacrificial offerings), copious libations, and milk, and theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क ईं॑ स्तव॒त्कः पृ॑णा॒त्को य॑जाते॒ यदु॒ग्रमिन्म॒घवा॑ वि॒श्वहावे॑त् । पादा॑विव प्र॒हर॑न्न॒न्यम॑न्यं कृ॒णोति॒ पूर्व॒मप॑रं॒ शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǀsáḥ ǀ su-trā́mā ǀ svá-vān ǀ índraḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ ārā́t ǀ cit ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ yuyotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who may (adequately) praise him? Who may satisfy him? Who offer worthy adoration? Since Maghava is daily conscious of his own terrible (power); by his acts he makes first one and then the other precede and follow, as (a man) throws out his feet (alternately in walking).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒ण्वे वी॒र उ॒ग्रमु॑ग्रं दमा॒यन्न॒न्यम॑न्यमतिनेनी॒यमा॑नः । ए॒ध॒मा॒न॒द्विळु॒भय॑स्य॒ राजा॑ चोष्कू॒यते॒ विश॒ इन्द्रो॑ मनु॒ष्या॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ tvé íti ǀ indra ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ dhavante ǀurú ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ apáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ vajrin ǀ yuvase ǀ sám ǀ índūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The heroIndrais renowned; humiliating every formidable (foe), and repeatedly changing the plural ce of one (worshipper) with that of another; Indra, the enemy of the arrogant, the soverign of both (heaven and earth), calls again and again (to encourage) the men who are his worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॒ पूर्वे॑षां स॒ख्या वृ॑णक्ति वि॒तर्तु॑राणो॒ अप॑रेभिरेति । अना॑नुभूतीरवधून्वा॒नः पू॒र्वीरिन्द्र॑: श॒रद॑स्तर्तरीति
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ īm ǀ stavat ǀ káḥ ǀ pṛṇāt ǀ káḥ ǀ yajāte ǀ yát ǀ ugrám ǀ ít ǀ maghá-vā ǀ viśváhā ǀ ávet ǀpā́dau-iva ǀ pra-háran ǀ anyám-anyam ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ pū́rvam ǀ áparam ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrarejects the friendship of those who are formost (in pious acts), and, depositing them, associates with (their) inferiors; or (again) shaking off those who neglect his worship, Indra abides many years with those who serve him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रू॒पंरू॑पं॒ प्रति॑रूपो बभूव॒ तद॑स्य रू॒पं प्र॑ति॒चक्ष॑णाय । इन्द्रो॑ मा॒याभि॑: पुरु॒रूप॑ ईयते यु॒क्ता ह्य॑स्य॒ हर॑यः श॒ता दश॑
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇvé ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ugrám-ugram ǀ dama-yán ǀ anyám-anyam ǀ ati-nenīyámānaḥ ǀedhamāna-dvíṭ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ coṣkūyáte ǀ víśaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ manuṣyā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the prototype, has assumed various forms, and such is his form as that which (he adopts) for his manifestation; Indra, multiform by his illusion, proceeds (to his many worshippers), for the horses, yoked to his car are a thousand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒जा॒नो ह॒रिता॒ रथे॒ भूरि॒ त्वष्टे॒ह रा॑जति । को वि॒श्वाहा॑ द्विष॒तः पक्ष॑ आसत उ॒तासी॑नेषु सू॒रिषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ pū́rveṣām ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ vṛṇakti ǀ vi-tárturāṇaḥ ǀ áparebhiḥ ǀ eti ǀánanu-bhūtīḥ ǀ ava-dhūnvānáḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ tartarīti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoking his horses to his car,Tvaṣṭāshines in many plural ces here in thethree worlds; who (else), sojourning daily among his present worshippers, is their proector against adversaries?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग॒व्यू॒ति क्षेत्र॒माग॑न्म देवा उ॒र्वी स॒ती भूमि॑रंहूर॒णाभू॑त् । बृह॑स्पते॒ प्र चि॑कित्सा॒ गवि॑ष्टावि॒त्था स॒ते ज॑रि॒त्र इ॑न्द्र॒ पन्था॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: rūpám-rūpam ǀ práti-rūpaḥ ǀ babhūva ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ rūpám ǀ prati-cákṣaṇāya ǀíndraḥ ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ puru-rū́paḥ ǀ īyate ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ śatā́ ǀ dáśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have wandered, gods, into a desert where there is no track of cattle; the vast extant earth has become the protectress of murderers; direct us,Bṛhaspati, in our search for cattle; show the path,Indra, to your votary being astray.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वेदि॑वे स॒दृशी॑र॒न्यमर्धं॑ कृ॒ष्णा अ॑सेध॒दप॒ सद्म॑नो॒ जाः । अह॑न्दा॒सा वृ॑ष॒भो व॑स्न॒यन्तो॒दव्र॑जे व॒र्चिनं॒ शम्ब॑रं च
shlokas.transliteration: yujānáḥ ǀ harítā ǀ ráthe ǀ bhū́ri ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ihá ǀ rājati ǀkáḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ dviṣatáḥ ǀ pákṣaḥ ǀ āsate ǀ utá ǀ ā́sīneṣu ǀ sūríṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, becoming manifest from his abode (in the firmament), dissipates, day by day, the resembling glooms, (so that he may distinguish) the other portion, (or the day); and the showerer has slain the two wealth-seeking slaves, Varcin andŚambara, in (the country of) Udavraja.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒स्तो॒क इन्नु राध॑सस्त इन्द्र॒ दश॒ कोश॑यी॒र्दश॑ वा॒जिनो॑ऽदात् । दिवो॑दासादतिथि॒ग्वस्य॒ राध॑: शाम्ब॒रं वसु॒ प्रत्य॑ग्रभीष्म
shlokas.transliteration: agavyūtí ǀ kṣétram ǀ ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ devāḥ ǀ urvī́ ǀ satī́ ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ aṃhūraṇā́ ǀ abhūt ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ prá ǀ cikitsa ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀ itthā́ ǀ saté ǀ jaritré ǀ indra ǀ pánthām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prastoka has given to your worshipper,Indra, ten purses of gold, and ten horses, and we have accepted this treasure fromDivodāsa, the spoil won byAtithigvafromŚambara.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दशाश्वा॒न्दश॒ कोशा॒न्दश॒ वस्त्राधि॑भोजना । दशो॑ हिरण्यपि॒ण्डान्दिवो॑दासादसानिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: divé-dive ǀ sa-dṛ́śīḥ ǀ anyám ǀ árdham ǀ kṛṣṇā́ḥ ǀ asedhat ǀ ápa ǀ sádmanaḥ ǀ jā́ḥ ǀáhan ǀ dāsā́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vasnayántā ǀ udá-vraje ǀ varcínam ǀ śámbaram ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have received ten horses, ten purses, clothes, and ample food and ten lumps of gold fromDivodāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ रथा॒न्प्रष्टि॑मतः श॒तं गा अथ॑र्वभ्यः । अ॒श्व॒थः पा॒यवे॑ऽदात्
shlokas.transliteration: prastokáḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ dáśa ǀ kóśayīḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ adāt ǀdívaḥ-dāsāt ǀ atithi-gvásya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ śāmbarám ǀ vásu ǀ práti ǀ agrabhīṣma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvatthahas given toPāyuten chariots with their horses, and a hundred cows to the priests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॒ राधो॑ वि॒श्वज॑न्यं॒ दधा॑नान्भ॒रद्वा॑जान्त्सार्ञ्ज॒यो अ॒भ्य॑यष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ áśvān ǀ dáśa ǀ kóśān ǀ dáśa ǀ vástrā ǀ ádhi-bhojanā ǀdáśo íti ǀ hiraṇya-piṇḍā́n ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāt ǀ asāniṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son ofSṛñjayahas reverenced theBharadvājaswho have accepted such great wealth for the good of all men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॑स्पते वी॒ड्व॑ङ्गो॒ हि भू॒या अ॒स्मत्स॑खा प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीर॑: । गोभि॒: संन॑द्धो असि वी॒ळय॑स्वास्था॒ता ते॑ जयतु॒ जेत्वा॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ ráthān ǀ práṣṭi-mataḥ ǀ śatám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ átharva-bhyaḥ ǀaśvatháḥ ǀ pāyáve ǀ adāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Chariot made of the) forest lord, be strong of fabric; be our friend; be our protector, and be manned by warriors; you are wrapped with cow-hides; keep us steady; and may he who rides in you be victorious over conquered (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्योज॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्य॒: पर्याभृ॑तं॒ सह॑: । अ॒पामो॒ज्मानं॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रं॑ ह॒विषा॒ रथं॑ यज
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ viśvá-janyam ǀ dádhānān ǀ bharát-vājān ǀ sārñjayáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ayaṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship with oblations the chariot constructed of the substance of heaven and earth, the extracted essence of the forest lords; the velocity of the waters; the encompassed with the cow-hide; the thunderbolt (ofIndra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ म॒रुता॒मनी॑कं मि॒त्रस्य॒ गर्भो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॑: । सेमां नो॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं जुषा॒णो देव॑ रथ॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृ॑भाय
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspate ǀ vīḷú-aṅgaḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhūyā́ḥ ǀ asmát-sakhā ǀ pra-táraṇaḥ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ sám-naddhaḥ ǀ asi ǀ vīḷáyasva ǀ ā-sthātā́ ǀ te ǀ jayatu ǀ jétvāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, divine chariot, who are the thunderbolt ofIndra, the precursor of theMaruts, the embryo ofMitra, the navel ofVaruṇa, propitiated by this our sacrifice, accept the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ श्वासय पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां पु॑रु॒त्रा ते॑ मनुतां॒ विष्ठि॑तं॒ जग॑त् । स दु॑न्दुभे स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैर्दू॒राद्दवी॑यो॒ अप॑ सेध॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ ójaḥ ǀ út-bhṛtam ǀ vánaspáti-bhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́-bhṛtam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀapā́m ǀ ojmā́nam ǀ pári ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtam ǀ índrasya ǀ vájram ǀ havíṣā ǀ rátham ǀ yaja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “War-drum, fill with your sound both heaven and earth; and let all things, fixed or moveable, be aware of it; do you, who are associated withIndraand the gods, drive away our foes to the remotest distance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ क्र॑न्दय॒ बल॒मोजो॑ न॒ आ धा॒ निः ष्ट॑निहि दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः । अप॑ प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दु॒च्छुना॑ इ॒त इन्द्र॑स्य मु॒ष्टिर॑सि वी॒ळय॑स्व
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ marútām ǀ ánīkam ǀ mitrásya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ naḥ ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ déva ǀ ratha ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ ǀ gṛbhāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sound loud against the (hostile) host; animate our prowess; thunder aloud, terrifying the evil-minded; rapid, drum, those whose delight is to harm us; you are the fist ofIndra; inspire us with fierceness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आमूर॑ज प्र॒त्याव॑र्तये॒माः के॑तु॒मद्दु॑न्दु॒भिर्वा॑वदीति । समश्व॑पर्णा॒श्चर॑न्ति नो॒ नरो॒ऽस्माक॑मिन्द्र र॒थिनो॑ जयन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ śvāsaya ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ te ǀ manutām ǀ ví-sthitam ǀ jágat ǀsáḥ ǀ dundubhe ǀ sa-jū́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ dūrā́t ǀ dávīyaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ sedha ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Recover these our cattle,Indra; bring them back; the drum sounds repeatedly as a signal; our leaders, mounted on their steeds, assemble; may our warriors, riding in their cars, Indra, be victorious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञाय॑ज्ञा वो अ॒ग्नये॑ गि॒रागि॑रा च॒ दक्ष॑से । प्रप्र॑ व॒यम॒मृतं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसं प्रि॒यं मि॒त्रं न शं॑सिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñā́-yajñā ǀ vaḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ girā́-girā ǀ ca ǀ dákṣase ǀprá-pra ǀ vayám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ priyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ śaṃsiṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At every sacrifice (honour) the mightyAgniwith your reiterated praise, while we glorify him, the immortal, who knows all things, our dear friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑तं॒ स हि॒नायम॑स्म॒युर्दाशे॑म ह॒व्यदा॑तये । भुव॒द्वाजे॑ष्ववि॒ता भुव॑द्वृ॒ध उ॒त त्रा॒ता त॒नूना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ sáḥ ǀ hiná ǀ ayám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ dā́śema ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀbhúvat ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhúvat ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ utá ǀ trātā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son of strength, for he verily is propitious to us, to whom let us offer oblations as to the conveyer of them (to the gods); may he be our defender in battles; may he be our benefactor and the grandsire of our offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ ह्य॑ग्ने अ॒जरो॑ म॒हान्वि॒भास्य॒र्चिषा॑ । अज॑स्रेण शो॒चिषा॒ शोशु॑चच्छुचे सुदी॒तिभि॒: सु दी॑दिहि
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ vi-bhā́si ǀ arcíṣā ǀájasreṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucat ǀ śuce ǀ sudītí-bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are the showerer (of benefits), mighty, and exempt from decay, you shine with (great) splendour; you are resplendent, brilliant (Agni), with unfading lustre; shine forth with glorious rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो दे॒वान्यज॑सि॒ यक्ष्या॑नु॒षक्तव॒ क्रत्वो॒त दं॒सना॑ । अ॒र्वाच॑: सीं कृणुह्य॒ग्नेऽव॑से॒ रास्व॒ वाजो॒त वं॑स्व
