shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yájasi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ānuṣák ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ utá ǀ daṃsánā ǀarvā́caḥ ǀ sīm ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ agne ǀ ávase ǀ rā́sva ǀ vā́jā ǀ utá ǀ vaṃsva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You sacrifice to the mighty gods; sacrifice (for us) continually, for (sacrifice is perfected) by your wisdom and your acts; bring them down,Agni, for our salvation; present (to them) the sacrificial food, partake of it yourself.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमापो॒ अद्र॑यो॒ वना॒ गर्भ॑मृ॒तस्य॒ पिप्र॑ति । सह॑सा॒ यो म॑थि॒तो जाय॑ते॒ नृभि॑: पृथि॒व्या अधि॒ सान॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ gárbham ǀ ṛtásya ǀ píprati ǀsáhasā ǀ yáḥ ǀ mathitáḥ ǀ jā́yate ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are he) whom the waters, the mountains, the woods, nourish as the embryo of sacrifice; who, churned with strength by the performers (of the rite), are genitive rated in the highest plural ce of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यः प॒प्रौ भा॒नुना॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे धू॒मेन॑ धावते दि॒वि । ति॒रस्तमो॑ ददृश॒ ऊर्म्या॒स्वा श्या॒वास्व॑रु॒षो वृषा श्या॒वा अ॑रु॒षो वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ papráu ǀ bhānúnā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ dhūména ǀ dhāvate ǀ diví ǀtiráḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ ū́rmyāsu ǀ ā́ ǀ śyāvā́su ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who fills both heaven and earth with light, who mounts with smoke into the sky, this radiant showerer (of benefits) is beheld in the dark nights dispersing the gloom; this radiant showerer (of benefits) presides over the dark nights.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हद्भि॑रग्ने अ॒र्चिभि॑: शु॒क्रेण॑ देव शो॒चिषा॑ । भ॒रद्वा॑जे समिधा॒नो य॑विष्ठ्य रे॒वन्न॑: शुक्र दीदिहि द्यु॒मत्पा॑वक दीदिहि
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ arcí-bhiḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ deva ǀ śocíṣā ǀbharát-vāje ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ revát ǀ naḥ ǀ śukra ǀ dīdihi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ pāvaka ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine, resplendentAgni, youngest (of the gods), when kindled byBharadvāja, shines with many flames, with pure lustre, (conferring) riches upon us; shine, resplendent purifier.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑सां गृ॒हप॑तिर्वि॒शाम॑सि॒ त्वम॑ग्ने॒ मानु॑षीणाम् । श॒तं पू॒र्भिर्य॑विष्ठ पा॒ह्यंह॑सः समे॒द्धारं॑ श॒तं हिमा॑: स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ ये च॒ दद॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāsām ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀśatám ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ sam-eddhā́ram ǀ śatám ǀ hímāḥ ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ dádati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are the lord of the dwelling, and of all men the descendants ofManu; protect me, youngest (of the gods), when kindling you, with a hundred defences against iniquity; (grant me) a hundred winters, (as well as to those) who bestow gifts upon your worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑श्चि॒त्र ऊ॒त्या वसो॒ राधां॑सि चोदय । अ॒स्य रा॒यस्त्वम॑ग्ने र॒थीर॑सि वि॒दा गा॒धं तु॒चे तु न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ ūtyā́ ǀ váso íti ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ codaya ǀasyá ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ gādhám ǀ tucé ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wonderful (Agni), giver of dwellings, encourage us by (your) protection, and (the gift of) riches, for you are he conveyer, Agni, of this wealth; quickly bestow permanence upon our progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पर्षि॑ तो॒कं तन॑यं प॒र्तृभि॒ष्ट्वमद॑ब्धै॒रप्र॑युत्वभिः । अग्ने॒ हेळां॑सि॒ दैव्या॑ युयोधि॒ नोऽदे॑वानि॒ ह्वरां॑सि च
shlokas.transliteration: párṣi ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ partṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ádabdhaiḥ ǀ áprayutva-bhiḥ ǀágne ǀ héḷāṃsi ǀ dáivyā ǀ yuyodhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ádevāni ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You protect with uninjurable, irremovable defences (our) sons and grandsons; remove far from us celestial wrath and human malevolence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स॑खायः सब॒र्दुघां॑ धे॒नुम॑जध्व॒मुप॒ नव्य॑सा॒ वच॑: । सृ॒जध्व॒मन॑पस्फुराम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ sabaḥ-dúghām ǀ dhenúm ǀ ajadhvam ǀ úpa ǀ návyasā ǀ vácaḥ ǀsṛjádhvam ǀ ánapa-sphurām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach, friends the milk-yielding cow with a new song, and let her loose unharmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या शर्धा॑य॒ मारु॑ताय॒ स्वभा॑नवे॒ श्रवोऽमृ॑त्यु॒ धुक्ष॑त । या मृ॑ळी॒के म॒रुतां॑ तु॒राणां॒ या सु॒म्नैरे॑व॒याव॑री
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mā́rutāya ǀ svá-bhānave ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ámṛtyu ǀ dhúkṣata ǀyā́ ǀ mṛḷīké ǀ marútām ǀ turā́ṇām ǀ yā́ ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ eva-yā́varī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She who yields immortal food to the powerful, self-irradiating band of theMaruts, who (is anxious) for the gratiication of the self-moving Maruts, who traverse the sky with (the passing waters0, shedding delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒रद्वा॑जा॒याव॑ धुक्षत द्वि॒ता । धे॒नुं च॑ वि॒श्वदो॑हस॒मिषं॑ च वि॒श्वभो॑जसम्
shlokas.transliteration: bharát-vājāya ǀ áva ǀ dhukṣata ǀ dvitā́ ǀdhenúm ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-dohasam ǀ íṣam ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-bhojasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Milk forBharadvājathe twofold (blessing), the cow that gives milk to the universe, food that is sufficient for all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॒ इन्द्रं॒ न सु॒क्रतुं॒ वरु॑णमिव मा॒यिन॑म् । अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ न म॒न्द्रं सृ॒प्रभो॑जसं॒ विष्णुं॒ न स्तु॑ष आ॒दिशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ su-krátum ǀ váruṇam-iva ǀ māyínam ǀaryamáṇam ǀ ná ǀ mandrám ǀ sṛprá-bhojasam ǀ víṣṇum ǀ ná ǀ stuṣe ǀ ā-díśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise you, the (company ofMaruts), for the distribution of wealth; (the company that), likeIndra, is the achiever of great deeds; sagacious likeVaruṇa; adorable asAryamanand munificent asViṣṇu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षं शर्धो॒ न मारु॑तं तुवि॒ष्वण्य॑न॒र्वाणं॑ पू॒षणं॒ सं यथा॑ श॒ता । सं स॒हस्रा॒ कारि॑षच्चर्ष॒णिभ्य॒ आँ आ॒विर्गू॒ळ्हा वसू॑ करत्सु॒वेदा॑ नो॒ वसू॑ करत्
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́rutam ǀ tuvi-sváni ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ sám ǀ yáthā ǀ śatā́ ǀsám ǀ sahásrā ǀ kā́riṣat ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ gūḷhā́ ǀ vásu ǀ karat ǀ su-védā ǀ naḥ ǀ vásu ǀ karat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I now (glorify) the brilliant vigour of the company of theMaruts, loud-sounding, irresistible, cherishing, whereby hundreds and thousands (of treasures) are bestowed collectively upon men; may that (company) make hidden wealth manifes; may it render the wealth easily accessible to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मा॑ पूष॒न्नुप॑ द्रव॒ शंसि॑षं॒ नु ते॑ अपिक॒र्ण आ॑घृणे । अ॒घा अ॒र्यो अरा॑तयः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mā ǀ pūṣan ǀ úpa ǀ drava ǀ śáṃsiṣam ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ api-karṇé ǀ āghṛṇe ǀaghā́ḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten,Pūṣan, to me; (repel), bright deity, (all) deadly assailing foes; close at your side I repeat your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा का॑क॒म्बीर॒मुद्वृ॑हो॒ वन॒स्पति॒मश॑स्ती॒र्वि हि नीन॑शः । मोत सूरो॒ अह॑ ए॒वा च॒न ग्री॒वा आ॒दध॑ते॒ वेः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kākambī́ram ǀ út ǀ vṛhaḥ ǀ vánaspátim ǀ áśastīḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ nī́naśaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ utá ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ áharíti ǀ evá ǀ caná ǀ grīvā́ḥ ǀ ā-dádhate ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uproot not,Pūṣan, the forest lord with its progeny of crows; utterly destroy those who are my revilers; let not the adversary ensnare me, as (fowlers) set snares for birds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दृते॑रिव तेऽवृ॒कम॑स्तु स॒ख्यम् । अच्छि॑द्रस्य दध॒न्वत॒: सुपू॑र्णस्य दध॒न्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dṛ́teḥ-iva ǀ te ǀ avṛkám ǀ astu ǀ sakhyám ǀácchidrasya ǀ dadhan-vátaḥ ǀ sú-pūrṇasya ǀ dadhan-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your friendship be unbroken, like (the surface) of a skin without a flaw, containing curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रो हि मर्त्यै॒रसि॑ स॒मो दे॒वैरु॒त श्रि॒या । अ॒भि ख्य॑: पूष॒न्पृत॑नासु न॒स्त्वमवा॑ नू॒नं यथा॑ पु॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: paráḥ ǀ hí ǀ mártyaiḥ ǀ ási ǀ samáḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ utá ǀ śriyā́ ǀabhí ǀ khyaḥ ǀ pūṣan ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ áva ǀ nūnám ǀ yáthā ǀ purā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Supreme are you above mortals; equal in glory are you to the gods; therefore,Pūṣan, regard us (favourably) in battles; defend us at present as (you have defended) those of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒मी वा॒मस्य॑ धूतय॒: प्रणी॑तिरस्तु सू॒नृता॑ । दे॒वस्य॑ वा मरुतो॒ मर्त्य॑स्य वेजा॒नस्य॑ प्रयज्यवः
shlokas.transliteration: vāmī́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ prá-nītiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀdevásya ǀ vā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ vā ǀ ījānásya ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, agitators, especially to be adored, may your kind and true speech be our conductress; that plural asant (speech which is the guide) to desirable (wealth) for both gods and sacrificing mortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यश्चि॒द्यस्य॑ चर्कृ॒तिः परि॒ द्यां दे॒वो नैति॒ सूर्य॑: । त्वे॒षं शवो॑ दधिरे॒ नाम॑ य॒ज्ञियं॑ म॒रुतो॑ वृत्र॒हं शवो॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ वृत्र॒हं शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ carkṛtíḥ ǀ pári ǀ dyā́m ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ éti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀtveṣám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ nā́ma ǀ yajñíyam ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vṛ́tra-hám ǀ śávaḥ ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ vṛ́tra-hám ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose functions spread quickly round the heavens, like (the light of) the divine sun, since themarutspossess brillian, foe-humiliating, and adorable foe-destroying strength, most excellent foe-destroying strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒कृद्ध॒ द्यौर॑जायत स॒कृद्भूमि॑रजायत । पृश्न्या॑ दु॒ग्धं स॒कृत्पय॒स्तद॒न्यो नानु॑ जायते
shlokas.transliteration: sakṛ́t ǀ ha ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ajāyata ǀpṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ dugdhám ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ páyaḥ ǀ tát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ánu ǀ jāyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Once, indeed, was the heaven genitive rated; once was the earth born; once was the milk ofPṛśni(pṛśnayai vai payaso marutojātāḥ:TaittirīyaSaṃhitā2.2.11.4) drawn other than that was not similarly genitive rated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒षे जनं॑ सुव्र॒तं नव्य॑सीभिर्गी॒र्भिर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा सुम्न॒यन्ता॑ । त आ ग॑मन्तु॒ त इ॒ह श्रु॑वन्तु सुक्ष॒त्रासो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ jánam ǀ su-vratám ǀ návyasībhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ sumna-yántā ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ gamantu ǀ té ǀ ihá ǀ śruvantu ǀ su-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I commend with new hymns the man observant of his duty, and the beneficentMitraandVaruṇa; may they, the mighty ones, Varuṇa, Mitra, andAgni, come to our rite, and listen (to our praises).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शोवि॑श॒ ईड्य॑मध्व॒रेष्वदृ॑प्तक्रतुमर॒तिं यु॑व॒त्योः । दि॒वः शिशुं॒ सह॑सः सू॒नुम॒ग्निं य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुम॑रु॒षं यज॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: viśáḥ-viśaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ ádṛpta-kratum ǀ aratím ǀ yuvatyóḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ śíśum ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ agním ǀ yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ aruṣám ǀ yájadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I incite the worshipper) to offer worship toAgni, who is to be adored at the sacrifices of every ma; whose acts are free from arrogance; the lord of the two youthful (brides, heaven and earth); the child of heaven, the son of strength, the briliant symbol of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रु॒षस्य॑ दुहि॒तरा॒ विरू॑पे॒ स्तृभि॑र॒न्या पि॑पि॒शे सूरो॑ अ॒न्या । मि॒थ॒स्तुरा॑ वि॒चर॑न्ती पाव॒के मन्म॑ श्रु॒तं न॑क्षत ऋ॒च्यमा॑ने
shlokas.transliteration: aruṣásya ǀ duhitárā ǀ vírūpe íti ví-rūpe ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ anyā́ ǀ pipiśé ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ anyā́ ǀmithaḥ-túrā ǀ vicárantī íti vi-cárantī ǀ pāvaké íti ǀ mánma ǀ śrutám ǀ nakṣataḥ ǀ ṛcyámāne íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two daughters of the radiant (sun) of various form, of whom one glitters with stars, the other (is bright) with the sun, mutually opposed, proceeding diversely, purifying (all things), and entitled to our laudation, be plural ased by the praise they hear (from us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॒युमच्छा॑ बृह॒ती म॑नी॒षा बृ॒हद्र॑यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रं रथ॒प्राम् । द्यु॒तद्या॑मा नि॒युत॒: पत्य॑मानः क॒विः क॒विमि॑यक्षसि प्रयज्यो
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vāyúm ǀ áccha ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ bṛhát-rayim ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ ratha-prā́m ǀdyutát-yāmā ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ kavím ǀ iyakṣasi ǀ prayajyo íti pra-yajyo ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our earnest praise proceed to the presence ofVāyu, the possessor of vast riches, the desired of all, the filler of his chariot (with wealth for his worshippers); most adorable (Vāyu), who are riding in a radiant car, and driving yourNiyut(steeds), do you, who are far-seeing, show favour to the sage, (your adorer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मे॒ वपु॑श्छदयद॒श्विनो॒र्यो रथो॑ वि॒रुक्मा॒न्मन॑सा युजा॒नः । येन॑ नरा नासत्येष॒यध्यै॑ व॒र्तिर्या॒थस्तन॑याय॒ त्मने॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ me ǀ vápuḥ ǀ chadayat ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ virúkmān ǀ mánasā ǀ yujānáḥ ǀyéna ǀ narā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ iṣayádhyai ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātháḥ ǀ tánayāya ǀ tmáne ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that splendid car of theAśvins, which is harnessed at a thought, clothe my form (with radiance); that (car) with which,Nāsatyās, leaders of (rites), you go to the dwelling (of the worshipper) to fulfil his desires for his posterity and himself.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पर्ज॑न्यवाता वृषभा पृथि॒व्याः पुरी॑षाणि जिन्वत॒मप्या॑नि । सत्य॑श्रुतः कवयो॒ यस्य॑ गी॒र्भिर्जग॑तः स्थात॒र्जग॒दा कृ॑णुध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: párjanyavātā ǀ vṛṣabhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ púrīṣāṇi ǀ jinvatam ǀ ápyāni ǀsátya-śrutaḥ ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ jágat ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ParjanyaandVāta, showerers of rain, and from te firmament available waters; sageMaruts, hearers of the truth, establishers of the world, multiply the moveable (wealth of him) by whose praises (you are propitiated).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पावी॑रवी क॒न्या॑ चि॒त्रायु॒: सर॑स्वती वी॒रप॑त्नी॒ धियं॑ धात् । ग्नाभि॒रच्छि॑द्रं शर॒णं स॒जोषा॑ दुरा॒धर्षं॑ गृण॒ते शर्म॑ यंसत्
shlokas.transliteration: pā́vīravī ǀ kanyā́ ǀ citrá-āyuḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vīrá-patnī ǀ dhíyam ǀ dhāt ǀgnā́bhiḥ ǀ ácchidram ǀ śaraṇám ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ duḥ-ādhárṣam ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the purifying, amiable, gracefulSarasvatī, the bride of the hero, favour our pious rite; may she, together with the wives of the gods, well plural ased, bestow upon him who praises her a habitation free from defects and impenetrable (to wind and rain), and (grant him) felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒थस्प॑थ॒: परि॑पतिं वच॒स्या कामे॑न कृ॒तो अ॒भ्या॑नळ॒र्कम् । स नो॑ रासच्छु॒रुध॑श्च॒न्द्राग्रा॒ धियं॑धियं सीषधाति॒ प्र पू॒षा
shlokas.transliteration: patháḥ-pathaḥ ǀ pári-patim ǀ vacasyā́ ǀ kā́mena ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ānaṭ ǀ arkám ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsat ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ candrá-agrāḥ ǀ dhíyam-dhiyam ǀ sīsadhāti ǀ prá ǀ pūṣā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (the worshipper), influenced by the hope (of reward), approach with praise the adorable (Pūṣan), protector of all path; may he bestow upon us cows with golden horns; may Pūṣan bring to perfection our every rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒म॒भाजं॑ य॒शसं॑ वयो॒धां सु॑पा॒णिं दे॒वं सु॒गभ॑स्ति॒मृभ्व॑म् । होता॑ यक्षद्यज॒तं प॒स्त्या॑नाम॒ग्निस्त्वष्टा॑रं सु॒हवं॑ वि॒भावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: prathama-bhā́jam ǀ yaśásam ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́m ǀ su-pāṇím ǀ devám ǀ su-gábhastim ǀ ṛ́bhvam ǀhótā ǀ yakṣat ǀ yajatám ǀ pastyā́nām ǀ agníḥ ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ su-hávam ǀ vibhā́-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the illustriousAgni, the invoker of the gods, worship (with this oblation),Tvaṣṭā, the first divider (of forms), the renowned, the giver of food, the well-handed, the vast, the adored of householders, the readily invoked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुव॑नस्य पि॒तरं॑ गी॒र्भिरा॒भी रु॒द्रं दिवा॑ व॒र्धया॑ रु॒द्रम॒क्तौ । बृ॒हन्त॑मृ॒ष्वम॒जरं॑ सुषु॒म्नमृध॑ग्घुवेम क॒विने॑षि॒तास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvanasya ǀ pitáram ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ dívā ǀ vardháya ǀ rudrám ǀ aktáu ǀbṛhántam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ ajáram ǀ su-sumnám ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ huvema ǀ kavínā ǀ iṣitā́saḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ExaltRudra, the parent of the world, with these hmns by day; (exalt) Rudra (with them) by night; animated by the far-seeing, we invoke him, mighty, of plural asing aspect, undecaying, endowed with felicity, (the source of) prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यु॑वानः कवयो यज्ञियासो॒ मरु॑तो ग॒न्त गृ॑ण॒तो व॑र॒स्याम् । अ॒चि॒त्रं चि॒द्धि जिन्व॑था वृ॒धन्त॑ इ॒त्था नक्ष॑न्तो नरो अङ्गिर॒स्वत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yuvānaḥ ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ gantá ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ varasyā́m ǀacitrám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ jínvatha ǀ vṛdhántaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ nákṣantaḥ ǀ naraḥ ǀ aṅgirasvát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ever youthful wise, and adorableMaruts, come to the praise of your adorer; thus augmenting, leaders (of rites), and spreading (through the firmament), like rays (of light), refresh the scanty woods (with rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वी॒राय॒ प्र त॒वसे॑ तु॒रायाजा॑ यू॒थेव॑ पशु॒रक्षि॒रस्त॑म् । स पि॑स्पृशति त॒न्वि॑ श्रु॒तस्य॒ स्तृभि॒र्न नाकं॑ वच॒नस्य॒ विप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ taváse ǀ turā́ya ǀ ája ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ paśu-rákṣiḥ ǀ ástam ǀsáḥ ǀ pispṛśati ǀ tanví ǀ śrutásya ǀ stṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́kam ǀ vacanásya ǀ vípaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer adoration to the valiant, powerful, swift-movig (company of theMaruts), as the herdsman (drives his) herd to their stall; may that (company) appropriate to its own body the praises of the pious worshipper, as the firmament (is studded) with stars.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो रजां॑सि विम॒मे पार्थि॑वानि॒ त्रिश्चि॒द्विष्णु॒र्मन॑वे बाधि॒ताय॑ । तस्य॑ ते॒ शर्म॑न्नुपद॒द्यमा॑ने रा॒या म॑देम त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ तना॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ vi-mamé ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ tríḥ ǀ cit ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mánave ǀ bādhitā́ya ǀtásya ǀ te ǀ śárman ǀ upa-dadyámāne ǀ rāyā́ ǀ madema ǀ tanvā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be happy in a home, in riches, in person nn, in children, bestowd upon us by you,Viṣṇu, who with three (steps) made the terrestrial reions forManuwhen harassed (by theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॑ अ॒द्भिर॒र्कैस्तत्पर्व॑त॒स्तत्स॑वि॒ता चनो॑ धात् । तदोष॑धीभिर॒भि रा॑ति॒षाचो॒ भग॒: पुरं॑धिर्जिन्वतु॒ प्र रा॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ tát ǀ párvataḥ ǀ tát ǀ savitā́ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀtát ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ jinvatu ǀ prá ǀ rāyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAhirbudhnya(propitiated) by (our) hymns, andParvataandSavitāgive us food with water; may the bountiful (gods supply us), addition, with vegetable (grains); and may the all-wiseBhagabe propitious (to us) for (the acquisition of) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नु नो॑ र॒यिं र॒थ्यं॑ चर्षणि॒प्रां पु॑रु॒वीरं॑ म॒ह ऋ॒तस्य॑ गो॒पाम् । क्षयं॑ दाता॒जरं॒ येन॒ जना॒न्त्स्पृधो॒ अदे॑वीर॒भि च॒ क्रमा॑म॒ विश॒ आदे॑वीर॒भ्य१॒॑श्नवा॑म
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ rathyám ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́m ǀ puru-vī́ram ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gopā́m ǀkṣáyam ǀ dāta ǀ ajáram ǀ yéna ǀ jánān ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ca ǀ krámāma ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́-devīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ aśnávāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us, (universal gods), riches, comprehending chariots, numerous dependants, manymaleoffspring, (wealth) the giver of efficiency to the solemn rite, and a dwelling free from decay, wherewith we may overcome malevolent men and unrighteous (spirits), and afford support to those people who are devoted to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हु॒वे वो॑ दे॒वीमदि॑तिं॒ नमो॑भिर्मृळी॒काय॒ वरु॑णं मि॒त्रम॒ग्निम् । अ॒भि॒क्ष॒दाम॑र्य॒मणं॑ सु॒शेवं॑ त्रा॒तॄन्दे॒वान्त्स॑वि॒तारं॒ भगं॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: huvé ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ áditim ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ váruṇam ǀ mitrám ǀ agním ǀabhi-kṣadā́m ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ su-śévam ǀ trātṝ́n ǀ devā́n ǀ savitā́ram ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke with adorations, for the sake of felicity, the divineAditiadVaruṇa,MitraandAgni,Aryaman, the overthrower of foes, worthy of devotion,SavitāandBhaga, and (all) protecting divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ज्योति॑षः सूर्य॒ दक्ष॑पितॄननागा॒स्त्वे सु॑महो वीहि दे॒वान् । द्वि॒जन्मा॑नो॒ य ऋ॑त॒साप॑: स॒त्याः स्व॑र्वन्तो यज॒ता अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: su-jyótiṣaḥ ǀ sūrya ǀ dákṣa-pitṝn ǀ anāgāḥ-tvé ǀ su-mahaḥ ǀ vīhi ǀ devā́n ǀdvi-jánmānaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ sváḥ-vantaḥ ǀ yajatā́ḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RadiantSūrya, render the luminous deiies, who haveDakṣafor their progenitor, void of offence towards us; they who are twice born, desirous of sacrifice, observant of truth, possessors of wealth, deserving of worship, whose tongue isAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त द्या॑वापृथिवी क्ष॒त्रमु॒रु बृ॒हद्रो॑दसी शर॒णं सु॑षुम्ने । म॒हस्क॑रथो॒ वरि॑वो॒ यथा॑ नो॒ऽस्मे क्षया॑य धिषणे अने॒हः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ kṣatrám ǀ urú ǀ bṛhát ǀ rodasī íti ǀ śaraṇám ǀ susumne íti su-sumne ǀmaháḥ ǀ karathaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ dhiṣaṇe íti ǀ aneháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or bestow, Heaven and Earth, vast strength; give us, Earth and Heaven, a spacious habitation for our comfort; so arrange, that infinite wealth may be ours, remove, beneficent deities, iniquity from our abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ रु॒द्रस्य॑ सू॒नवो॑ नमन्ताम॒द्या हू॒तासो॒ वस॒वोऽधृ॑ष्टाः । यदी॒मर्भे॑ मह॒ति वा॑ हि॒तासो॑ बा॒धे म॒रुतो॒ अह्वा॑म दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ namantām ǀ adyá ǀ hūtā́saḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ árbhe ǀ mahatí ǀ vā ǀ hitā́saḥ ǀ bādhé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áhvāma ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sons ofRudra, givers of dwellings, the unsubdued, invoked on this occasion, stoop down to us, inasmuch as we call upon the divineMarutsthat they may be our helpers in difficulty, great or small.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒म्यक्ष॒ येषु॑ रोद॒सी नु दे॒वी सिष॑क्ति पू॒षा अ॑भ्यर्ध॒यज्वा॑ । श्रु॒त्वा हवं॑ मरुतो॒ यद्ध॑ या॒थ भूमा॑ रेजन्ते॒ अध्व॑नि॒ प्रवि॑क्ते
shlokas.transliteration: mimyákṣa ǀ yéṣu ǀ rodasī́ ǀ nú ǀ devī́ ǀ sísakti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ abhyardha-yájvā ǀśrutvā́ ǀ hávam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ yāthá ǀ bhū́ma ǀ rejante ǀ ádhvani ǀ prá-vikte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With whom the divine Heaven and Earth are associated; whomPūṣan, the rewarder (of his worshippers) with prosperity, honours; when,Maruts, having heard our invocation, you come hither, then on your several paths all beings tremble.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्यं वी॒रं गिर्व॑णसम॒र्चेन्द्रं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा जरित॒र्नवे॑न । श्रव॒दिद्धव॒मुप॑ च॒ स्तवा॑नो॒ रास॒द्वाजाँ॒ उप॑ म॒हो गृ॑णा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ vīrám ǀ gírvaṇasam ǀ arca ǀ índram ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ návena ǀśrávat ǀ ít ǀ hávam ǀ úpa ǀ ca ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ rā́sat ǀ vā́jān ǀ úpa ǀ maháḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise, worshipper, with a new hymn, that hero,Indra, who is deserving of praise; may he, so glorified hear our invocation; may he, so lauded, bestow upon us abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ॒मान॑मापो मानुषी॒रमृ॑क्तं॒ धात॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शं योः । यू॒यं हि ष्ठा भि॒षजो॑ मा॒तृत॑मा॒ विश्व॑स्य स्था॒तुर्जग॑तो॒ जनि॑त्रीः
shlokas.transliteration: omā́nam ǀ āpaḥ ǀ mānuṣīḥ ǀ ámṛktam ǀ dhā́ta ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ bhiṣájaḥ ǀ mātṛ́-tamāḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ jánitrīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, friendly to mankind, grant uninterrupted (life) preserving (food) for (the perpetuation of our) sons and grandsons; grant us security and the removal (of all evil), for you are more than maternal physicians; you are the parents of the stationary and moveable universe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता त्राय॑माणो॒ हिर॑ण्यपाणिर्यज॒तो ज॑गम्यात् । यो दत्र॑वाँ उ॒षसो॒ न प्रती॑कं व्यूर्णु॒ते दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ trā́yamāṇaḥ ǀ híraṇya-pāṇiḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǀyáḥ ǀ dátra-vān ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ prátīkam ǀ vi-ūrṇuté ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorable, golden-handedSavitā, the preserver, come to us; he, the munificent, who, like the opening of the dawn, displays desirable (riches) to the offerer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वं सू॑नो सहसो नो अ॒द्या दे॒वाँ अ॒स्मिन्न॑ध्व॒रे व॑वृत्याः । स्याम॒हं ते॒ सद॒मिद्रा॒तौ तव॑ स्याम॒ग्नेऽव॑सा सु॒वीर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ asmín ǀ adhvaré ǀ vavṛtyāḥ ǀsyā́m ǀ ahám ǀ te ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ rātáu ǀ táva ǀ syām ǀ agne ǀ ávasā ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And do you, son of strength, bring back today the deities to this our sacrifice; may  I be ever in (the enoyment of) your bounty; may I, through your protection,Agni, be blessed with excellentmaledescendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या मे॒ हव॒मा ज॑ग्म्यातं॒ नास॑त्या धी॒भिर्यु॒वम॒ङ्ग वि॑प्रा । अत्रिं॒ न म॒हस्तम॑सोऽमुमुक्तं॒ तूर्व॑तं नरा दुरि॒ताद॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ jagmyātam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ viprā ǀátrim ǀ ná ǀ maháḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ amumuktam ǀ tū́rvatam ǀ narā ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WiseNāsatyāscome quickly to my invocation (united) with holy acts; (extricate us) from thick darkness, as you did extricateAtri; protect us, leaders (of rites) from danger in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ रा॒यो द्यु॒मतो॒ वाज॑वतो दा॒तारो॑ भूत नृ॒वत॑: पुरु॒क्षोः । द॒श॒स्यन्तो॑ दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वासो॒ गोजा॑ता॒ अप्या॑ मृ॒ळता॑ च देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dyu-mátaḥ ǀ vā́ja-vataḥ ǀ dātā́raḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ nṛ-vátaḥ ǀ puru-kṣóḥ ǀdaśasyántaḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ gó-jātāḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ ca ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be unto us, gods, donors of splendid, invigorating riches, comprisingmaledescendants, and celebrated by many; celestialĀdityas, terrestrialVasus, offspring ofPṛśni, children of the waters, granting our desires, make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ रु॒द्रः सर॑स्वती स॒जोषा॑ मी॒ळ्हुष्म॑न्तो॒ विष्णु॑र्मृळन्तु वा॒युः । ऋ॒भु॒क्षा वाजो॒ दैव्यो॑ विधा॒ता प॒र्जन्या॒वाता॑ पिप्यता॒मिषं॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ mīḷhúṣmantaḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mṛḷantu ǀ vāyúḥ ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ vi-dhātā́ ǀ parjányāvā́tā ǀ pipyatām ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayRudraandSarasvatī, alike well plural ased andViṣṇuandVāyu, make us happy, sending rain; and Ribhukṣin, andVāja, and the divineVidhātā; and mayParjanyaandVātagrant us abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता भगो॑ नो॒ऽपां नपा॑दवतु॒ दानु॒ पप्रि॑: । त्वष्टा॑ दे॒वेभि॒र्जनि॑भिः स॒जोषा॒ द्यौर्दे॒वेभि॑: पृथि॒वी स॑मु॒द्रैः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ avatu ǀ dā́nu ǀ pápriḥ ǀtváṣṭā ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ samudráiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And may the divineSavitāandBhaga, and the grandson of the waters, (Agni), the prodigal of gifts, preserve us; and mayTvaṣṭāwith the gods, and Earth with the seas, (preserve us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्य॑: शृणोत्व॒ज एक॑पात्पृथि॒वी स॑मु॒द्रः । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा ऋ॑ता॒वृधो॑ हुवा॒नाः स्तु॒ता मन्त्रा॑: कविश॒स्ता अ॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ samudráḥ ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ huvānā́ḥ ǀ stutā́ḥ ǀ mántrāḥ ǀ kavi-śastā́ḥ ǀ avantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAhirbudhnya, Aja-ekapād, and Earth and Ocean, hear us; may the universal gods, who are exalted by sacrifice, they who are invoked and praised (by us), to whom mystical prayers are addressed, and who have been glorified by (ancient) sages, preserve us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नपा॑तो॒ मम॒ तस्य॑ धी॒भिर्भ॒रद्वा॑जा अ॒भ्य॑र्चन्त्य॒र्कैः । ग्ना हु॒तासो॒ वस॒वोऽधृ॑ष्टा॒ विश्वे॑ स्तु॒तासो॑ भूता यजत्राः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ nápātaḥ ǀ máma ǀ tásya ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ bharát-vājāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀgnā́ḥ ǀ hutā́saḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀ víśve ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ yajatrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus do my sons, of the race ofBharadvāja, worship the gods with sacred rites and holy hymns; and so, adorable (deities), may you, who are worshipped and glorified, the givers of dwellings, the invincible, universal gods, ever be adored, (together with your) wives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यच्चक्षु॒र्महि॑ मि॒त्रयो॒राँ एति॑ प्रि॒यं वरु॑णयो॒रद॑ब्धम् । ऋ॒तस्य॒ शुचि॑ दर्श॒तमनी॑कं रु॒क्मो न दि॒व उदि॑ता॒ व्य॑द्यौत्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ máhi ǀ mitráyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ éti ǀ priyám ǀ váruṇayoḥ ǀ ádabdham ǀṛtásya ǀ śúci ǀ darśatám ǀ ánīkam ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ diváḥ ǀ út-itā ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The expansive, illuminating, unobstructive, pure, and beautiful radiance of the sun, grateful toMitraandVaruṇa, having risen, shines like the ornament of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेद॒ यस्त्रीणि॑ वि॒दथा॑न्येषां दे॒वानां॒ जन्म॑ सनु॒तरा च॒ विप्र॑: । ऋ॒जु मर्ते॑षु वृजि॒ना च॒ पश्य॑न्न॒भि च॑ष्टे॒ सूरो॑ अ॒र्य एवा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: véda ǀ yáḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ vidáthāni ǀ eṣām ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánma ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ vípraḥ ǀṛjú ǀ márteṣu ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ páśyan ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ évān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who knows the three cognizable (worlds); the sage (who knows) the mysterious birth of the divinities (abiding in them); he who is beholding the good and evil acts of mortals, he, the sun, the lord, makes manifest their intentions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒ष उ॑ वो म॒ह ऋ॒तस्य॑ गो॒पानदि॑तिं मि॒त्रं वरु॑णं सुजा॒तान् । अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ भग॒मद॑ब्धधीती॒नच्छा॑ वोचे सध॒न्य॑: पाव॒कान्
shlokas.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gopā́n ǀ áditim ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ su-jātā́n ǀaryamáṇam ǀ bhágam ǀ ádabdha-dhītīn ǀ áccha ǀ voce ǀ sa-dhanyáḥ ǀ pāvakā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise you, protectors of the solemn sacrifice, the well-bornAditi,MitraandVaruṇaandAryamanandBhaga; I celebrate the gods whose acts are unimpeded, the bestowers of wealth, the dispensers of purity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रि॒शाद॑स॒: सत्प॑तीँ॒रद॑ब्धान्म॒हो राज्ञ॑: सुवस॒नस्य॑ दा॒तॄन् । यून॑: सुक्ष॒त्रान्क्षय॑तो दि॒वो नॄना॑दि॒त्यान्या॒म्यदि॑तिं दुवो॒यु
shlokas.transliteration: riśā́dasaḥ ǀ sát-patīn ǀ ádabdhān ǀ maháḥ ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ su-vasanásya ǀ dātṝ́n ǀyū́naḥ ǀ su-kṣatrā́n ǀ kṣáyataḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ yāmi ǀ áditim ǀ duvaḥ-yú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The scatterers of the malevolent, the defenders of the virtuous, the irresistible, the mighty lords, the donors of good dwellings, ever young, very powerful, omnipresent, leader of heaven, the sons ofĀditya; I have recourse toAditi, who is gratified by mine adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यौ॒३॒॑ष्पित॒: पृथि॑वि॒ मात॒रध्रु॒गग्ने॑ भ्रातर्वसवो मृ॒ळता॑ नः । विश्व॑ आदित्या अदिते स॒जोषा॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ शर्म॑ बहु॒लं वि य॑न्त
shlokas.transliteration: dyáuḥ ǀ pítaríti ǀ pṛ́thivi ǀ mā́taḥ ǀ ádhruk ǀ ágne ǀ bhrātaḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǀvíśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ bahulám ǀ ví ǀ yanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Father Heaven, innocent mother Earth, brotherAgni, and you,Vasus, grant us happiness; all you sons ofAditi, and you Aditi, alike well-plural ased, bestow upon us ample felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ वृका॑य वृ॒क्ये॑ समस्मा अघाय॒ते री॑रधता यजत्राः । यू॒यं हि ष्ठा र॒थ्यो॑ नस्त॒नूनां॑ यू॒यं दक्ष॑स्य॒ वच॑सो बभू॒व
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛ́kāya ǀ vṛkyé ǀ samasmai ǀ agha-yaté ǀ rīradhata ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū́nām ǀ yūyám ǀ dákṣasya ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ babhūvá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Subject us not, adorable (deities), to the robber or his wife; not to any one designing us harm; for you are the regulators of our person ns, of our strength, of our speech.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा व॒ एनो॑ अ॒न्यकृ॑तं भुजेम॒ मा तत्क॑र्म वसवो॒ यच्चय॑ध्वे । विश्व॑स्य॒ हि क्षय॑थ विश्वदेवाः स्व॒यं रि॒पुस्त॒न्वं॑ रीरिषीष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ énaḥ ǀ anyá-kṛtam ǀ bhujema ǀ mā́ ǀ tát ǀ karma ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ cáyadhve ǀvíśvasya ǀ hí ǀ kṣáyatha ǀ viśva-devāḥ ǀ svayám ǀ ripúḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ ririṣīṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us not suffer for the sin committed by another; let us not do that which,Vasus, you prohibit; you rule universal gods, over the universe; (so provide that) mine enemy may inflict injury on his own person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नम॒ इदु॒ग्रं नम॒ आ वि॑वासे॒ नमो॑ दाधार पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् । नमो॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॒ नम॑ ईश एषां कृ॒तं चि॒देनो॒ नम॒सा वि॑वासे
shlokas.transliteration: námaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ugrám ǀ námaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀ námaḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀnámaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ īśe ǀ eṣām ǀ kṛtám ǀ cit ǀ énaḥ ǀ námasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reverence be to the potent (company of universal gods); I offer (them) reverence; reverence sustains both earth and heaven; revernce be to the gods; reverence is sovereign over them; I expiate by reverence whatever sin may have been committed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ वो र॒थ्य॑: पू॒तद॑क्षानृ॒तस्य॑ पस्त्य॒सदो॒ अद॑ब्धान् । ताँ आ नमो॑भिरुरु॒चक्ष॑सो॒ नॄन्विश्वा॑न्व॒ आ न॑मे म॒हो य॑जत्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ vaḥ ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ pūtá-dakṣān ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pastya-sádaḥ ǀ ádabdhān ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ uru-cákṣasaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ víśvān ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ name ǀ maháḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable (deities), I venerate with reverential salutations all you who are mighty, the mighty, the regulators of your sacrifice, of pure vigour, dwellers in the chamber of worship, unsubdued, far-seeing, leaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि श्रेष्ठ॑वर्चस॒स्त उ॑ नस्ति॒रो विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता नय॑न्ति । सु॒क्ष॒त्रासो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निॠ॒तधी॑तयो वक्म॒राज॑सत्याः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ śréṣṭha-varcasaḥ ǀ té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ náyanti ǀsu-kṣatrā́saḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ṛtá-dhītayaḥ ǀ vakmarā́ja-satyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they, exceeding in splendour, so guide us, that all iniquities may disappear, they, the very powerfulVaruṇa,Mitra,Agni, practisers of truth, and faithful to those who are prominent in (their) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते न॒ इन्द्र॑: पृथि॒वी क्षाम॑ वर्धन्पू॒षा भगो॒ अदि॑ति॒: पञ्च॒ जना॑: । सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒: स्वव॑सः सुनी॒था भव॑न्तु नः सुत्रा॒त्रास॑: सुगो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ kṣā́ma ǀ vardhan ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ páñca ǀ jánāḥ ǀsu-śármāṇaḥ ǀ su-ávasaḥ ǀ su-nīthā́ḥ ǀ bhávantu ǀ naḥ ǀ su-trātrā́saḥ ǀ su-gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they,Indra, Earth,Pūṣan,Bhaga,Aditiand the five orders of beings, give increase to our habitations; may they be to us granters of happiness, bestowers of food, guides to good, our gracious defenders and preservers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू स॒द्मानं॑ दि॒व्यं नंशि॑ देवा॒ भार॑द्वाजः सुम॒तिं या॑ति॒ होता॑ । आ॒सा॒नेभि॒र्यज॑मानो मि॒येधै॑र्दे॒वानां॒ जन्म॑ वसू॒युर्व॑वन्द
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ sadmā́nam ǀ divyám ǀ náṃśi ǀ devāḥ ǀ bhā́rat-vājaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ yāti ǀ hótā ǀāsānébhiḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ miyédhaiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánma ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀ vavanda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the preseenter of the oblation,Bharadvāja, quickly obtain, gods, a celestial abode, as he solicits your good-will; the instrumental tutor of the ceremony, together with pious associates, desirous of riches, glorifies the assembly of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ त्यं वृ॑जि॒नं रि॒पुं स्ते॒नम॑ग्ने दुरा॒ध्य॑म् । द॒वि॒ष्ठम॑स्य सत्पते कृ॒धी सु॒गम्
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyám ǀ vṛjinám ǀ ripúm ǀ stenám ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-ādhyám ǀdaviṣṭhám ǀ asya ǀ sat-pate ǀ kṛdhí ǀ su-gám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drive away,Agni, to a distance the wicked, felonious, malignant enemy; grant us felicity, protector of the virtuous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्रावा॑णः सोम नो॒ हि कं॑ सखित्व॒नाय॑ वाव॒शुः । ज॒ही न्य१॒॑त्रिणं॑ प॒णिं वृको॒ हि षः
shlokas.transliteration: grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ sakhi-tvanā́ya ǀ vāvaśúḥ ǀjahí ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀ paṇím ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These our grinding stones are anxious,Soma, for your friendship; destroy the voraciousPaṇi, for verily he is a wolf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपि॒ पन्था॑मगन्महि स्वस्ति॒गाम॑ने॒हस॑म् । येन॒ विश्वा॒: परि॒ द्विषो॑ वृ॒णक्ति॑ वि॒न्दते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀkárta ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhvan ǀ ā́ ǀ su-gám ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ amā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have travelled along the road prosperously traversed and free from evil, and by which (a man) avoids adversaries and acquires wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तद्दि॒वा न पृ॑थि॒व्यानु॑ मन्ये॒ न य॒ज्ञेन॒ नोत शमी॑भिरा॒भिः । उ॒ब्जन्तु॒ तं सु॒भ्व१॒॑: पर्व॑तासो॒ नि ही॑यतामतिया॒जस्य॑ य॒ष्टा
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tát ǀ divā́ ǀ ná ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ ánu ǀ manye ǀ ná ǀ yajñéna ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ śámībhiḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀubjántu ǀ tám ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ní ǀ hīyatām ǀ ati-yājásya ǀ yaṣṭā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I do not regard it as worthy (of the gods) of heaven, or (those) of earth, as (fit to be compared) with the sacrifice (I offer) or with these (our) sacred rites; let, then, the mighty mountains overhelm him; let the employer of Atiyāja be ever degraded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ वा॒ यो म॑रुतो॒ मन्य॑ते नो॒ ब्रह्म॑ वा॒ यः क्रि॒यमा॑णं॒ निनि॑त्सात् । तपूं॑षि॒ तस्मै॑ वृजि॒नानि॑ सन्तु ब्रह्म॒द्विष॑म॒भि तं शो॑चतु॒ द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ mányate ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ kriyámāṇam ǀ nínitsāt ǀtápūṃṣi ǀ tásmai ǀ vṛjinā́ni ǀ santu ǀ brahma-dvíṣam ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ śocatu ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, may the energies of that man be enfeebled; may heaven consume that impious adversary who thinks himself superior to us, and who pretends to deprecate the worship that we offer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑न्तु॒ मामु॒षसो॒ जाय॑माना॒ अव॑न्तु मा॒ सिन्ध॑व॒: पिन्व॑मानाः । अव॑न्तु मा॒ पर्व॑तासो ध्रु॒वासोऽव॑न्तु मा पि॒तरो॑ दे॒वहू॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ soma ǀ gopā́m ǀ kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ āhuḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́m ǀ naḥ ǀkím ǀ aṅgá ǀ naḥ ǀ paśyasi ǀ nidyámānān ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ tápuṣim ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the opening dawns preserve me; may the swelling rivers preserve me; may the firm-set mountains preserve me; may the progenitors (present) at the invocation of the gods preserve me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्व॒दानीं॑ सु॒मन॑सः स्याम॒ पश्ये॑म॒ नु सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्तम् । तथा॑ कर॒द्वसु॑पति॒र्वसू॑नां दे॒वाँ ओहा॒नोऽव॒साग॑मिष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: ávantu ǀ mā́m ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ jā́yamānāḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ mā ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀávantu ǀ mā ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ dhruvā́saḥ ǀ ávantu ǀ mā ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ devá-hūtau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we at all seasons be possessed of sound minds; may we ever behold the rising sun; such may the affluent lord of riches, (Agni), render us, ever most ready to come (at our invocation), charged with our oblation to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ नेदि॑ष्ठ॒मव॒साग॑मिष्ठ॒: सर॑स्वती॒ सिन्धु॑भि॒: पिन्व॑माना । प॒र्जन्यो॑ न॒ ओष॑धीभिर्मयो॒भुर॒ग्निः सु॒शंस॑: सु॒हव॑: पि॒तेव॑
shlokas.transliteration: viśva-dā́nīm ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ páśyema ǀ nú ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǀtáthā ǀ karat ǀ vásu-patiḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ devā́n ǀ óhānaḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndrabe most prompt to come nigh for our protection, andSarasvatīdwelling with (tributary) rivers; mayParjanya, with the plural nts, be a giver of happiness; and mayAgni, worthily praised and earnestly invoked, (be to us) like a father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त शृणु॒ता म॑ इ॒मं हव॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्नि षी॑दत
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ pínvamānā ǀparjányaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhúḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-śáṃsaḥ ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, universal gods, hear this my invocationl; sit down upon this sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वो॑ देवा घृ॒तस्नु॑ना ह॒व्येन॑ प्रति॒भूष॑ति । तं विश्व॒ उप॑ गच्छथ
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ śṛṇutá ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, gods, to him who honours you with the butter drippling oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सू॒नवो॒ गिर॑: शृ॒ण्वन्त्व॒मृत॑स्य॒ ये । सु॒मृ॒ळी॒का भ॑वन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ghṛtá-snunā ǀ havyéna ǀ prati-bhū́ṣati ǀtám ǀ víśve ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sons of the immortal hear our praises, and be to us the givers of felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा ऋ॑ता॒वृध॑ ऋ॒तुभि॑र्हवन॒श्रुत॑: । जु॒षन्ता॒ युज्यं॒ पय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śṛṇvántu ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ yé ǀsu-mṛḷīkā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal gods, augmenters of sacrifice, listening to praises (uttered) at due seasons, accept your appropriate milk-offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तो॒त्रमिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुद्ग॑ण॒स्त्वष्टृ॑मान्मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । इ॒मा ह॒व्या जु॑षन्त नः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ havana-śrútaḥ ǀjuṣántām ǀ yújyam ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, with the company of theMaruts,Mitra, withTvaṣṭāandAryaman, accept our praise and these our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं नो॑ अग्ने अध्व॒रं होत॑र्वयुन॒शो य॑ज । चि॒कि॒त्वान्दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: stotrám ǀ índraḥ ǀ marút-gaṇaḥ ǀ tváṣṭṛ-mān ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀimā́ ǀ havyā́ ǀ juṣanta ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, invoker of the gods, cognizant (which of) the divine assembly (is he honoured), offer this our sacrifice according to the proper order.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ देवाः शृणु॒तेमं हवं॑ मे॒ ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ य उप॒ द्यवि॒ ष्ठ । ये अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वा उ॒त वा॒ यज॑त्रा आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ adhvarám ǀ hótaḥ ǀ vayuna-śáḥ ǀ yaja ǀcikitvā́n ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal gods, hear this my invocation, whether you be in the firmament or in the heaven; you who (receive oblations) by the tongue ofAgni, or are to be (otherwise) worshipped; seated on this sacred grass, be exhilarated (by theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा मम॑ शृण्वन्तु य॒ज्ञिया॑ उ॒भे रोद॑सी अ॒पां नपा॑च्च॒ मन्म॑ । मा वो॒ वचां॑सि परि॒चक्ष्या॑णि वोचं सु॒म्नेष्विद्वो॒ अन्त॑मा मदेम
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ śṛṇutá ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀ me ǀ yé ǀ antárikṣe ǀ yé ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀ sthá ǀyé ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ ā-sádya ǀ asmín ǀ barhíṣi ǀ mādayadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorable, universal deities, and both heaven and earth, and the grandson, of the waters, hear my praise; let me not utter words to be disregarded, but let us, (brought) most nigh unto you, rejoice in the happiness (you bestow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये के च॒ ज्मा म॒हिनो॒ अहि॑माया दि॒वो ज॑ज्ञि॒रे अ॒पां स॒धस्थे॑ । ते अ॒स्मभ्य॑मि॒षये॒ विश्व॒मायु॒: क्षप॑ उ॒स्रा व॑रिवस्यन्तु दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ máma ǀ śṛṇvantu ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ ca ǀ mánma ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ pari-cákṣyāṇi ǀ vocam ǀ sumnéṣu ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ ántamāḥ ǀ madema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those mighty deities, having power to destroy, whether they have been manifested upon earth or in heaven, or in the abode of the waters, bestow upon us and our posterity abundant sustenance both by night and day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नी॑पर्जन्या॒वव॑तं॒ धियं॑ मे॒ऽस्मिन्हवे॑ सुहवा सुष्टु॒तिं न॑: । इळा॑म॒न्यो ज॒नय॒द्गर्भ॑म॒न्यः प्र॒जाव॑ती॒रिष॒ आ ध॑त्तम॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ké ǀ ca ǀ jmā́ ǀ mahínaḥ ǀ áhi-māyāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ jajñiré ǀ apā́m ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀté ǀ asmábhyam ǀ iṣáye ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ kṣápaḥ ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ varivasyantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniandParjanya, prosper my pious acts; (accept), you who are reverently invoked, our praise at this sacrifice; one of you genitive rates food, the other posterity; grant us, therefore, food productive of descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्ती॒र्णे ब॒र्हिषि॑ समिधा॒ने अ॒ग्नौ सू॒क्तेन॑ म॒हा नम॒सा वि॑वासे । अ॒स्मिन्नो॑ अ॒द्य वि॒दथे॑ यजत्रा॒ विश्वे॑ देवा ह॒विषि॑ मादयध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágnīparjanyau ǀ ávatam ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ asmín ǀ háve ǀ su-havā ǀ su-stutím ǀ naḥ ǀíḷām ǀ anyáḥ ǀ janáyat ǀ gárbham ǀ anyáḥ ǀ prajā́-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhattam ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sacred grass is strewn, when the fire is kindled, and when I worship (you) with a hymn, and with profound veneration, then, adorable universal gods, rejoice in the oblation (offered) today at this our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमु॑ त्वा पथस्पते॒ रथं॒ न वाज॑सातये । धि॒ये पू॑षन्नयुज्महि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ pathaḥ ǀ pate ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀdhiyé ǀ pūṣan ǀ ayujmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣan, lord of paths, we attach you to us like a chariot, for (the sake of) bringing food, and of (accomplishing our) solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि नो॒ नर्यं॒ वसु॑ वी॒रं प्रय॑तदक्षिणम् । वा॒मं गृ॒हप॑तिं नय
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ náryam ǀ vásu ǀ vīrám ǀ práyata-dakṣiṇam ǀvāmám ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ naya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conduct us to a gracious householder, friendly to men, liberal in (bestowing) wealth, the giver of pious donations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदि॑त्सन्तं चिदाघृणे॒ पूष॒न्दाना॑य चोदय । प॒णेश्चि॒द्वि म्र॑दा॒ मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áditsantam ǀ cit ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ pū́ṣan ǀ dā́nāya ǀ codaya ǀpaṇéḥ ǀ cit ǀ ví ǀ mrada ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentPūṣan, instrumental gate the niggard to liberality, soften the heart of the miser.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि प॒थो वाज॑सातये चिनु॒हि वि मृधो॑ जहि । साध॑न्तामुग्र नो॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ patháḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ cinuhí ǀ ví ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǀsā́dhantām ǀ ugra ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PiercePūṣan, select (fit) roads for the passage of provisions; drive away all obstructors, (thieves, or the like), so that our holy rites may be accomplished.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ तृन्धि पणी॒नामार॑या॒ हृद॑या कवे । अथे॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ रन्धय
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ tṛndhi ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ ā́rayā ǀ hṛ́dayā ǀ kave ǀátha ǀ īm ǀ asmábhyam ǀ randhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pierce with a goad the hearts of the avaricious, wisePūṣan, and so render them complacent towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि पू॑ष॒न्नार॑या तुद प॒णेरि॑च्छ हृ॒दि प्रि॒यम् । अथे॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ रन्धय
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ pūṣan ǀ ā́rayā ǀ tuda ǀ paṇéḥ ǀ iccha ǀ hṛdí ǀ priyám ǀátha ǀ īm ǀ asmábhyam ǀ randhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pierce with a goad,Pūṣan, the heart of the avaricious; genitive rate genitive rosity in his heart, and so render him complacent towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रि॑ख किकि॒रा कृ॑णु पणी॒नां हृद॑या कवे । अथे॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ रन्धय
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rikha ǀ kikirā́ ǀ kṛṇu ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ hṛ́dayā ǀ kave ǀátha ǀ īm ǀ asmábhyam ǀ randhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abrade, wisePūṣan, the hearts of the avaricious; relax (their hardness), and so render them complacent towards us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यां पू॑षन्ब्रह्म॒चोद॑नी॒मारां॒ बिभ॑र्ष्याघृणे । तया॑ समस्य॒ हृद॑य॒मा रि॑ख किकि॒रा कृ॑णु
shlokas.transliteration: yā́m ǀ pūṣan ǀ brahma-códanīm ǀ ā́rām ǀ bíbharṣi ǀ āghṛṇe ǀtáyā ǀ samasya ǀ hṛ́dayam ǀ ā́ ǀ rikha ǀ kikirā́ ǀ kṛṇu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentPūṣan, with that food-propelling goad which you bear, abrade the heart of every miser, and render it relaxed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॒ अष्ट्रा॒ गो॑प॒शाघृ॑णे पशु॒साध॑नी । तस्या॑स्ते सु॒म्नमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ áṣṭrā ǀ gó-opaśā ǀ ā́ghṛṇe ǀ paśu-sā́dhanī ǀtásyāḥ ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentPūṣan, we ask of you the service of that your weapon, which is the guide of cows, the director of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॑ गो॒षणिं॒ धिय॑मश्व॒सां वा॑ज॒सामु॒त । नृ॒वत्कृ॑णुहि वी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ go-sánim ǀ dhíyam ǀ aśvasā́m ǀ vāja-sā́m ǀ utá ǀnṛ-vát ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ vītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make our pious worship productive of cows, of horses, of food, of dependants, for our enjoyment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं पू॑षन्वि॒दुषा॑ नय॒ यो अञ्ज॑सानु॒शास॑ति । य ए॒वेदमिति॒ ब्रव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ pūṣan ǀ vidúṣā ǀ naya ǀ yáḥ ǀ áñjasā ǀ anu-śā́sati ǀyáḥ ǀ evá ǀ idám ǀ íti ǀ brávat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us,Pūṣan, into communication with a wise man who may rightly direct us, who may even say, this is so.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ पू॒ष्णा ग॑मेमहि॒ यो गृ॒हाँ अ॑भि॒शास॑ति । इ॒म ए॒वेति॑ च॒ ब्रव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pūṣṇā́ ǀ gamemahi ǀ yáḥ ǀ gṛhā́n ǀ abhi-śā́sati ǀimé ǀ evá ǀ íti ǀ ca ǀ brávat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, by the favour ofPūṣan, come in communication with (the man) who may direct us to the houses (where our goods are secreted), and may say, verily these are they.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒ष्णश्च॒क्रं न रि॑ष्यति॒ न कोशोऽव॑ पद्यते । नो अ॑स्य व्यथते प॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣṇáḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ ná ǀ riṣyati ǀ ná ǀ kóśaḥ ǀ áva ǀ padyate ǀnó íti ǀ asya ǀ vyathate ǀ pavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The discus ofPūṣandoes not destroy; its sheath is not discarded, its edge harms not us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑स्मै ह॒विषावि॑ध॒न्न तं पू॒षापि॑ मृष्यते । प्र॒थ॒मो वि॑न्दते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ havíṣā ǀ ávidhat ǀ ná ǀ tám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ ápi ǀ mṛṣyate ǀprathamáḥ ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣaninflicts not the least injury on the man who propitiates him by oblations; he is the first who acquires wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षा गा अन्वे॑तु नः पू॒षा र॑क्ष॒त्वर्व॑तः । पू॒षा वाजं॑ सनोतु नः
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ etu ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ rakṣatu ǀ árvataḥ ǀpūṣā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sanotu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayPūṣancome to (guard) our cattle, ma Pūṣan protect our horses; may Pūṣan give us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूष॒न्ननु॒ प्र गा इ॑हि॒ यज॑मानस्य सुन्व॒तः । अ॒स्माकं॑ स्तुव॒तामु॒त
shlokas.transliteration: pū́ṣan ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ihi ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ stuvatā́m ǀ utá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Pūṣan, to (guard) the cattle of the instrumental tutor of the rite presenting libations, and also of us repeating (your) praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माकि॑र्नेश॒न्माकीं॑ रिष॒न्माकीं॒ सं शा॑रि॒ केव॑टे । अथारि॑ष्टाभि॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́kiḥ ǀ neśat ǀ mā́kīm ǀ riṣat ǀ mā́kīm ǀ sám ǀ śāri ǀ kévaṭe ǀátha ǀ áriṣṭābhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not,Pūṣan, our cattle perish; let them not be injured; let them not be hurt by falling into a well; come, therefore, along with them unharmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒ण्वन्तं॑ पू॒षणं॑ व॒यमिर्य॒मन॑ष्टवेदसम् । ईशा॑नं रा॒य ई॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇvántam ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ vayám ǀ íryam ǀ ánaṣṭa-vedasam ǀī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicitPūṣan, who hears (our eulogies); who is the averter (of poverty); the preserver of that which is not lost, the ruler (over all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूष॒न्तव॑ व्र॒ते व॒यं न रि॑ष्येम॒ कदा॑ च॒न । स्तो॒तार॑स्त इ॒ह स्म॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: pū́ṣan ǀ táva ǀ vraté ǀ vayám ǀ ná ǀ riṣyema ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀstotā́raḥ ǀ te ǀ ihá ǀ smasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we never suffer detriment when engaged,Pūṣan, in your worship; we are at this time your adorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ पू॒षा प॒रस्ता॒द्धस्तं॑ दधातु॒ दक्षि॑णम् । पुन॑र्नो न॒ष्टमाज॑तु
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ parástāt ǀ hástam ǀ dadhātu ǀ dákṣiṇam ǀpúnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ naṣṭám ǀ ā́ ǀ ajatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayPūṣanput forth his righthand(to restrain our cattle) from going astray; may we bring again to us that which has been lost.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एहि॒ वां वि॑मुचो नपा॒दाघृ॑णे॒ सं स॑चावहै । र॒थीॠ॒तस्य॑ नो भव
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ vā́m ǀ vi-mucaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ ā́ghṛṇe ǀ sám ǀ sacāvahai ǀrathī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come illusrious grandson ofPrajāpatito (me your) worshipper); let us two be associated; become the conveyer of our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒थीत॑मं कप॒र्दिन॒मीशा॑नं॒ राध॑सो म॒हः । रा॒यः सखा॑यमीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: rathí-tamam ǀ kapardínam ǀ ī́śānam ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit riches of our friend, (Pūṣan), the chief of charioteers, the wearer of a braid (of hair), the lord of infinite wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यो धारा॑स्याघृणे॒ वसो॑ रा॒शिर॑जाश्व । धीव॑तोधीवत॒: सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ dhā́rā ǀ asi ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ vásoḥ ǀ rāśíḥ ǀ aja-aśva ǀdhī́vataḥ-dhīvataḥ ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IllustriousPūṣan, you are a torrent of riches; you, who have a goat for your steed, are a heap of wealth; the friend of every worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षणं॒ न्व१॒॑जाश्व॒मुप॑ स्तोषाम वा॒जिन॑म् । स्वसु॒र्यो जा॒र उ॒च्यते॑
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣáṇam ǀ nú ǀ ajá-aśvam ǀ úpa ǀ stoṣāma ǀ vājínam ǀsvásuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ucyáte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorifyPūṣan, the rider of the goat, the giver of food, him who is called the gallant of his sister.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒तुर्दि॑धि॒षुम॑ब्रवं॒ स्वसु॑र्जा॒रः शृ॑णोतु नः । भ्रातेन्द्र॑स्य॒ सखा॒ मम॑
shlokas.transliteration: mātúḥ ǀ didhiṣúm ǀ abravam ǀ svásuḥ ǀ jāráḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ naḥ ǀbhrā́tā ǀ índrasya ǀ sákhā ǀ máma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorifyPūṣan, the husband of his mother; may the gallant of his sister hear us; may the brother ofIndrabe our friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आजास॑: पू॒षणं॒ रथे॑ निशृ॒म्भास्ते ज॑न॒श्रिय॑म् । दे॒वं व॑हन्तु॒ बिभ्र॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ajā́saḥ ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ ráthe ǀ ni-śṛmbhā́ḥ ǀ té ǀ jana-śríyam ǀdevám ǀ vahantu ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the harnessed goats, drawing the deity in his car, bring hitherPūṣan, the benefactor of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ए॑नमा॒दिदे॑शति कर॒म्भादिति॑ पू॒षण॑म् । न तेन॑ दे॒व आ॒दिशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ enam ǀ ā-dídeśati ǀ karambha-át ǀ íti ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀná ǀ téna ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā-díśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No (other) deity is indicated by him who declares the offering of mixed meal and butter to be intended forPūṣan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त घा॒ स र॒थीत॑म॒: सख्या॒ सत्प॑तिर्यु॒जा । इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जिघ्नते
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ gha ǀ sáḥ ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ sákhyā ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ yujā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the chief of charioteers, the protector of the virtuous,Indra, destroys his foes, with his friendPūṣanfor his ally.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तादः प॑रु॒षे गवि॒ सूर॑श्च॒क्रं हि॑र॒ण्यय॑म् । न्यै॑रयद्र॒थीत॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ adáḥ ǀ paruṣé ǀ gávi ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ cakrám ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀní ǀ airayat ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the impeller, the chief of charioteers, (Pūṣan) ever urges on that golden wheel (of his car) for the radiant sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य त्वा॑ पुरुष्टुत॒ ब्रवा॑म दस्र मन्तुमः । तत्सु नो॒ मन्म॑ साधय
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ tvā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ brávāma ǀ dasra ǀ mantu-maḥ ǀtát ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ mánma ǀ sādhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, intelligentPūṣan, of godly aspect, the praised of many, we celebrate you today, therefore grant us the desired wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं च॑ नो ग॒वेष॑णं सा॒तये॑ सीषधो ग॒णम् । आ॒रात्पू॑षन्नसि श्रु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ go-éṣaṇam ǀ sātáye ǀ sīsadhaḥ ǀ gaṇám ǀārā́t ǀ pūṣan ǀ asi ǀ śrutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratify this our assembly, desirous of cattle, by their acquisition; you,Pūṣan, are renowned afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ स्व॒स्तिमी॑मह आ॒रेअ॑घा॒मुपा॑वसुम् । अ॒द्या च॑ स॒र्वता॑तये॒ श्वश्च॑ स॒र्वता॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ svastím ǀ īmahe ǀ āré-aghām ǀ úpa-vasum ǀadyá ǀ ca ǀ sarvá-tātaye ǀ śváḥ ǀ ca ǀ sarvá-tātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We deserve of your well-being, remote from evil, approximate to wealth, both for the sake of genitive ral sacrifice today, for the sake of genitive ral sacrifice tomorrow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒ नु पू॒षणा॑ व॒यं स॒ख्याय॑ स्व॒स्तये॑ । हु॒वेम॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: índrā ǀ nú ǀ pūṣáṇā ǀ vayám ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ svastáye ǀhuvéma ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,IndraandPūṣan, for your friendship, for our well-being, and for the obtaining of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑म॒न्य उपा॑सद॒त्पात॑वे च॒म्वो॑: सु॒तम् । क॒र॒म्भम॒न्य इ॑च्छति
shlokas.transliteration: sómam ǀ anyáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ asadat ǀ pā́tave ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutám ǀkarambhám ǀ anyáḥ ǀ icchati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (of you) approaches to drink theSomapoured out into ladles, the other desires the buttered meal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जा अ॒न्यस्य॒ वह्न॑यो॒ हरी॑ अ॒न्यस्य॒ सम्भृ॑ता । ताभ्यां॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जिघ्नते
shlokas.transliteration: ajā́ḥ ǀ anyásya ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ anyásya ǀ sám-bhṛtā ǀtā́bhyām ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Goats are the bearers of the one, two well-fed horses of the other, and with them he destroys his foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रो॒ अन॑य॒द्रितो॑ म॒हीर॒पो वृष॑न्तमः । तत्र॑ पू॒षाभ॑व॒त्सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ánayat ǀ rítaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣan-tamaḥ ǀtátra ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ abhavat ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the showererIndrasends down the falling and mighty waters, there isPūṣanalong with him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तां पू॒ष्णः सु॑म॒तिं व॒यं वृ॒क्षस्य॒ प्र व॒यामि॑व । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ चा र॑भामहे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ pūṣṇáḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ vayám ǀ vṛkṣásya ǀ prá ǀ vayā́m-iva ǀíndrasya ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ rabhāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We depend upon the good-will ofPūṣan, and ofIndra, as (we cling) to the branches of a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्पू॒षणं॑ युवामहे॒ऽभीशूँ॑रिव॒ सार॑थिः । म॒ह्या इन्द्र॑ा स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ yuvāmahe ǀ abhī́śūn-iva ǀ sā́rathiḥ ǀmahyái ǀ índram ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We draw to us, for our great welfare,PūṣanandIndra, as a charioteer (pulls tight) his reins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒क्रं ते॑ अ॒न्यद्य॑ज॒तं ते॑ अ॒न्यद्विषु॑रूपे॒ अह॑नी॒ द्यौरि॑वासि । विश्वा॒ हि मा॒या अव॑सि स्वधावो भ॒द्रा ते॑ पूषन्नि॒ह रा॒तिर॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: śukrám ǀ te ǀ anyát ǀ yajatám ǀ te ǀ anyát ǀ víṣurūpe íti víṣu-rūpe ǀ áhanī íti ǀ dyáuḥ-iva ǀ asi ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ hí ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ ávasi ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ pūṣan ǀ ihá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of your forms, (Pūṣan), is luminous, one is venerable; so that the day is variously complexioned; for you are like the sun; verily, bestower of food, you protect all intelligence; may your auspicious liberality be manifested on this occasion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जाश्व॑: पशु॒पा वाज॑पस्त्यो धियंजि॒न्वो भुव॑ने॒ विश्वे॒ अर्पि॑तः । अष्ट्रां॑ पू॒षा शि॑थि॒रामु॒द्वरी॑वृजत्सं॒चक्षा॑णो॒ भुव॑ना दे॒व ई॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: ajá-aśvaḥ ǀ paśu-pā́ḥ ǀ vā́ja-pastyaḥ ǀ dhiyam-jinváḥ ǀ bhúvane ǀ víśve ǀ árpitaḥ ǀáṣṭrām ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ śithirā́m ǀ ut-várīvṛjat ǀ sam-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ deváḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rider of the goat, the protector of animals, in whose dwelling good is abundant, the propitiated by sacred rites, who has been plural ced over the whole (world), the divinePūṣan, brandishing his loosened goad, proceeds (in the sky), contemplating all beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यास्ते॑ पूष॒न्नावो॑ अ॒न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे हि॑र॒ण्ययी॑र॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ चर॑न्ति । ताभि॑र्यासि दू॒त्यां सूर्य॑स्य॒ कामे॑न कृत॒ श्रव॑ इ॒च्छमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ pūṣan ǀ nā́vaḥ ǀ antáríti ǀ samudré ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǀ antárikṣe ǀ cáranti ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ dūtyā́m ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ kā́mena ǀ kṛta ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ icchámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With thos your golden vessels, which navigate within the ocean-firmament, you discharge the office of messenger of the sun; desirous of the sacrificial food, you are propitiated by (that which is) willingly offered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षा सु॒बन्धु॑र्दि॒व आ पृ॑थि॒व्या इ॒ळस्पति॑र्म॒घवा॑ द॒स्मव॑र्चाः । यं दे॒वासो॒ अद॑दुः सू॒र्यायै॒ कामे॑न कृ॒तं त॒वसं॒ स्वञ्च॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ su-bándhuḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ dasmá-varcāḥ ǀyám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ádaduḥ ǀ sūryā́yai ǀ kā́mena ǀ kṛtám ǀ tavásam ǀ su-áñcam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣanis the kind kinsman of heaven and earth, the lord of food, the possessor of opulence, of goodly form; whom the gods gave toSūrya, vigorous, well-moving, propitiated by (that which is) willingly offered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नु वो॑चा सु॒तेषु॑ वां वी॒र्या॒३॒॑ यानि॑ च॒क्रथु॑: । ह॒तासो॑ वां पि॒तरो॑ दे॒वश॑त्रव॒ इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ जीव॑थो यु॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nú ǀ voca ǀ sutéṣu ǀ vām ǀ vīryā́ ǀ yā́ni ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀhatā́saḥ ǀ vām ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ devá-śatravaḥ ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ jī́vathaḥ ǀ yuvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the libation is effused I celebrate,IndraandAgni, your heroic exploits; the Pitaras, the enemies of the gods, have been slain by you, and you survive.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बळि॒त्था म॑हि॒मा वा॒मिन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ पनि॑ष्ठ॒ आ । स॒मा॒नो वां॑ जनि॒ता भ्रात॑रा यु॒वं य॒मावि॒हेह॑मातरा
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ itthā́ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ vām ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ pániṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀsamānáḥ ǀ vām ǀ janitā́ ǀ bhrā́tarā ǀ yuvám ǀ yamáu ǀ ihéha-mātarā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your greatness,IndraandAgni, is after this fashion, and is most deserving of praise; the same is your progenitor; twin brethren are you, having a mother everywhere present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ॒कि॒वांसा॑ सु॒ते सचाँ॒ अश्वा॒ सप्ती॑ इ॒वाद॑ने । इन्द्रा॒ न्व१॒॑ग्नी अव॑से॒ह व॒ज्रिणा॑ व॒यं दे॒वा ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: oki-vā́ṃsā ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ áśvā ǀ sáptī ivéti sáptī-iva ǀ ā́dane ǀíndrā ǀ nú ǀ agnī́ íti ǀ ávasā ǀ ihá ǀ vajríṇā ǀ vayám ǀ devā́ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You approach together, when the libation is effused, like two fleet coursers to their forage; we invoke todayIndraandAgni, deities armed with the thunderbolt, to this ceremony for our preservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॑न्द्राग्नी सु॒तेषु॑ वां॒ स्तव॒त्तेष्वृ॑तावृधा । जो॒ष॒वा॒कं वद॑तः पज्रहोषिणा॒ न दे॑वा भ॒सथ॑श्च॒न
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ sutéṣu ǀ vām ǀ stávat ǀ téṣu ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǀjoṣa-vākám ǀ vádataḥ ǀ pajra-hoṣiṇā ǀ ná ǀ devā ǀ bhasáthaḥ ǀ caná ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineIndraandAgni, augmenters of sacrifice by whom the acclamation (of praise) is received, you partake not of the (Soma) of him who, when the libation is effused, praises you (improperly), uttering unacceptable eulogies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ को अ॒स्य वां॒ देवौ॒ मर्त॑श्चिकेतति । विषू॑चो॒ अश्वा॑न्युयुजा॒न ई॑यत॒ एक॑: समा॒न आ रथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ káḥ ǀ asyá ǀ vām ǀ dévau ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ciketati ǀvíṣūcaḥ ǀ áśvān ǀ yuyujānáḥ ǀ īyate ǀ ékaḥ ǀ samāné ǀ ā́ ǀ ráthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What mortal, divineIndraandAgni, is a judge of that (your act), when one of you, harnessing his diversely-going horses, proceeds in the common car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी अ॒पादि॒यं पूर्वागा॑त्प॒द्वती॑भ्यः । हि॒त्वी शिरो॑ जि॒ह्वया॒ वाव॑द॒च्चर॑त्त्रिं॒शत्प॒दा न्य॑क्रमीत्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ apā́t ǀ iyám ǀ pū́rvā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ pat-vátībhyaḥ ǀhitvī́ ǀ śíraḥ ǀ jihváyā ǀ vā́vadat ǀ cárat ǀ triṃśát ǀ padā́ ǀ ní ǀ akramīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This footless (dawn),IndraandAgni, comes before the footed sleepers, animating the head (of living beings with consciousness), causing them to utter loud sounds with their tongues, and passing onwards she traverses thirty steps.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ हि त॑न्व॒ते नरो॒ धन्वा॑नि बा॒ह्वोः । मा नो॑ अ॒स्मिन्म॑हाध॒ने परा॑ वर्क्तं॒ गवि॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ tanvaté ǀ náraḥ ǀ dhánvāni ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ párā ǀ varktam ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, men verily stretch their bows with their arms, but do not you desert us contending for cattle in the great combat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ तप॑न्ति मा॒घा अ॒र्यो अरा॑तयः । अप॒ द्वेषां॒स्या कृ॑तं युयु॒तं सूर्या॒दधि॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ tápanti ǀ mā ǀ aghā́ḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǀápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛtam ǀ yuyutám ǀ sū́ryāt ǀ ádhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, murderous, aggressive enemies harasss us; drive away mine adversaries; separate them from (sight of) the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी यु॒वोरपि॒ वसु॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ पार्थि॑वा । आ न॑ इ॒ह प्र य॑च्छतं र॒यिं वि॒श्वायु॑पोषसम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ápi ǀ vásu ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ihá ǀ prá ǀ yacchatam ǀ rayím ǀ viśvā́yu-poṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, yours are both celestial and terrestrial treasures; bestow upon us, on this occasion, life-sustaining riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी उक्थवाहसा॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्हवनश्रुता । विश्वा॑भिर्गी॒र्भिरा ग॑तम॒स्य सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ uktha-vāhasā ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ havana-śrutā ǀvíśvābhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ asyá ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, who are to be attracted by hymns; you, who hear our invocation (accompanied) by praise and by all adorations, come hither to drink of thisSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्नथ॑द्वृ॒त्रमु॒त स॑नोति॒ वाज॒मिन्द्रा॒ यो अ॒ग्नी सहु॑री सप॒र्यात् । इ॒र॒ज्यन्ता॑ वस॒व्य॑स्य॒ भूरे॒: सह॑स्तमा॒ सह॑सा वाज॒यन्ता॑
shlokas.transliteration: śnáthat ǀ vṛtrám ǀ utá ǀ sanoti ǀ vā́jam ǀ índrā ǀ yáḥ ǀ agnī́ íti ǀ sáhurī íti ǀ saparyā́t ǀirajyántā ǀ vasavyásya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-tamā ǀ sáhasā ǀ vāja-yántā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He ovecomes his enemy, and acquires food, who worships the victoriousIndraandAgni, the lords of infinite opulence, most powerful in strength, desirous of (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता यो॑धिष्टम॒भि गा इ॑न्द्र नू॒नम॒पः स्व॑रु॒षसो॑ अग्न ऊ॒ळ्हाः । दिश॒: स्व॑रु॒षस॑ इन्द्र चि॒त्रा अ॒पो गा अ॑ग्ने युवसे नि॒युत्वा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ yodhiṣṭam ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ nūnám ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ agne ǀ ūḷhā́ḥ ǀdíśaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ indra ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ yuvase ǀ niyútvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, verily you have combated for (the recovery of) the cows, the waters, the sun, the dawns that had been carried away (by theasuras); you reunite, Indra (with the world), the quarters of the horizon, the sun, the wonderful waters, the dawns, the cattle and so do you, Agni, who have theNiyutsteeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वृ॑त्रहणा वृत्र॒हभि॒: शुष्मै॒रिन्द्र॑ या॒तं नमो॑भिरग्ने अ॒र्वाक् । यु॒वं राधो॑भि॒रक॑वेभिरि॒न्द्राग्ने॑ अ॒स्मे भ॑वतमुत्त॒मेभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vṛtra-hanā ǀ vṛtrahá-bhiḥ ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀ índra ǀ yātám ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ arvā́k ǀyuvám ǀ rā́dhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ákavebhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ ágne ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhavatam ǀ ut-tamébhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayers ofVṛtra,IndraandAgni, come down with foe-subduing energies, (to be invigorated) by (our) offerings; be manifest to us, Indra and Agni, with unblameable and most excellent riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हु॑वे॒ ययो॑रि॒दं प॒प्ने विश्वं॑ पु॒रा कृ॒तम् । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी न म॑र्धतः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ huve ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ idám ǀ papné ǀ víśvam ǀ purā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀindrāgnī́ íti ǀ ná ǀ mardhataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke those two, the whole of whose deeds of old have been celebrated;IndraandAgniharm us not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रा वि॑घ॒निना॒ मृध॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी ह॑वामहे । ता नो॑ मृळात ई॒दृशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ugrā́ ǀ vi-ghanínā ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ havāmahe ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷātaḥ ǀ īdṛ́śe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the fierceIndraandAgni, the slayers of enemies; may they give us success in similar warfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒तो वृ॒त्राण्यार्या॑ ह॒तो दासा॑नि॒ सत्प॑ती । ह॒तो विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hatáḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ā́ryā ǀ hatáḥ ǀ dā́sāni ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀhatáḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Counteract all oppressions (committed) by the pious; counteract all oppressions (committed) by the impious; protectors of the virtuous, destroy all those who hate us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी यु॒वामि॒मे॒३॒॑ऽभि स्तोमा॑ अनूषत । पिब॑तं शम्भुवा सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ yuvā́m ǀ imé ǀ abhí ǀ stómāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀpíbatam ǀ śam-bhuvā ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, these hymns glorify you both; drink, bestowers of happiness, the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वां॒ सन्ति॑ पुरु॒स्पृहो॑ नि॒युतो॑ दा॒शुषे॑ नरा । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ ताभि॒रा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ sánti ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ narā ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, leaders (of rites), whoseNiyutsteeds are desired by many, come with them to the donor (of the libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताभि॒रा ग॑च्छतं न॒रोपे॒दं सव॑नं सु॒तम् । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gacchatam ǀ narā ǀ úpa ǀ idám ǀ sávanam ǀ sutám ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come with them, leaders (of rites),”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॑ळिष्व॒ यो अ॒र्चिषा॒ वना॒ विश्वा॑ परि॒ष्वज॑त् । कृ॒ष्णा कृ॒णोति॑ जि॒ह्वया॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īḷiṣva ǀ yáḥ ǀ arcíṣā ǀ vánā ǀ víśvā ǀ pari-svájat ǀkṛṣṇā́ ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ jihváyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify thatAgniwho envelopes all the forest with flame, who blackens them with (his) tongue.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒द्ध आ॒विवा॑सति सु॒म्नमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ मर्त्य॑: । द्यु॒म्नाय॑ सु॒तरा॑ अ॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ iddhé ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀ sumnám ǀ índrasya ǀ mártyaḥ ǀdyumnā́ya ǀ su-tárāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal who presents the gratifying (oblation) toIndrain the kindled (fire), to him (Indra grants) acceptable waters for his sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता नो॒ वाज॑वती॒रिष॑ आ॒शून्पि॑पृत॒मर्व॑तः । इन्द्र॑म॒ग्निं च॒ वोळ्ह॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ āśū́n ǀ pipṛtam ǀ árvataḥ ǀíndram ǀ agním ǀ ca ǀ vóḷhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those two grant us strengthening food, and swift horses to convey (our offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा वा॑मिन्द्राग्नी आहु॒वध्या॑ उ॒भा राध॑सः स॒ह मा॑द॒यध्यै॑ । उ॒भा दा॒तारा॑वि॒षां र॑यी॒णामु॒भा वाज॑स्य सा॒तये॑ हुवे वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ vām ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ ā-huvádhyai ǀ ubhā́ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ sahá ǀ mādayádhyai ǀubhā́ ǀ dātā́rau ǀ iṣā́m ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ ubhā́ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáye ǀ huve ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you both,IndraandAgni, to be present at the sacrifice; and both together to be exhilarated by the (sacrificial) food; for you are both donors of food and riches, and therefore I invoke you both for the obtaining of sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ गव्ये॑भि॒रश्व्यै॑र्वस॒व्यै॒३॒॑रुप॑ गच्छतम् । सखा॑यौ दे॒वौ स॒ख्याय॑ श॒म्भुवे॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी ता ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyebhiḥ ǀ áśvyaiḥ ǀ vasavyáiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gacchatam ǀsákhāyau ǀ deváu ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ śam-bhúvā ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ tā́ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us with herds of cattle, with troops of horses, with ample treasures, divine friends,IndraandAgni; givers of happiness, we invoke you as such for your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी शृणु॒तं हवं॒ यज॑मानस्य सुन्व॒तः । वी॒तं ह॒व्यान्या ग॑तं॒ पिब॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ hávam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀvītám ǀ havyā́ni ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear,IndraandAgni, the instrumental tutor of the rite as he offers the libation; partake of the offering; come, quaff the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यम॑ददाद्रभ॒समृ॑ण॒च्युतं॒ दिवो॑दासं वध्र्य॒श्वाय॑ दा॒शुषे॑ । या शश्व॑न्तमाच॒खादा॑व॒सं प॒णिं ता ते॑ दा॒त्राणि॑ तवि॒षा स॑रस्वति
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ adadāt ǀ rabhasám ǀ ṛṇa-cyútam ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ vadhri-aśvā́ya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀyā́ ǀ śáśvantam ǀ ā-cakhā́da ǀ avasám ǀ paṇím ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ dātrā́ṇi ǀ taviṣā́ ǀ sarasvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She gave to the donor of the oblations, Vadhryaśva, a sonDivodāsaendowed with speed, and acquitting the debt (due to gods and progenitors), she who destroyed the churlis niggard, (thinking) only of himself, such are your bounties,Sarasvatī.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं शुष्मे॑भिर्बिस॒खा इ॑वारुज॒त्सानु॑ गिरी॒णां त॑वि॒षेभि॑रू॒र्मिभि॑: । पा॒रा॒व॒त॒घ्नीमव॑से सुवृ॒क्तिभि॒: सर॑स्वती॒मा वि॑वासेम धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ śúṣmebhiḥ ǀ bisakhā́ḥ-iva ǀ arujat ǀ sā́nu ǀ girīṇā́m ǀ taviṣébhiḥ ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀpārāvata-ghnī́m ǀ ávase ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ sárasvatīm ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsema ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With impetuous and mighty waves she breaks down the precipices of the mountains, like a digger for the lotus fibres; we adore for our protection, the praises and with sacred rites,Sarasvatīthe underminer of both her banks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वति देव॒निदो॒ नि ब॑र्हय प्र॒जां विश्व॑स्य॒ बृस॑यस्य मा॒यिन॑: । उ॒त क्षि॒तिभ्यो॒ऽवनी॑रविन्दो वि॒षमे॑भ्यो अस्रवो वाजिनीवति
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvati ǀ deva-nídaḥ ǀ ní ǀ barhaya ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ víśvasya ǀ bṛ́sayasya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀutá ǀ kṣití-bhyaḥ ǀ avánīḥ ǀ avindaḥ ǀ viṣám ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ asravaḥ ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy,Sarasvatī, the revilers of the gods, the offspring of the universal deluder,Bṛsaya; giver of sustenance, you have acquired for men the lands (seized by theasuras), and have showered water upon them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र णो॑ दे॒वी सर॑स्वती॒ वाजे॑भिर्वा॒जिनी॑वती । धी॒नाम॑वि॒त्र्य॑वतु
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ vājínī-vatī ǀdhīnā́m ǀ avitrī́ ǀ avatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineSarasvatī, the acceptress of (sacrificial) food, the protectress o her worshippers, sustain us with (abundant) viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त्वा॑ देवि सरस्वत्युपब्रू॒ते धने॑ हि॒ते । इन्द्रं॒ न वृ॑त्र॒तूर्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ devi ǀ sarasvati ǀ upa-brūté ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀíndram ǀ ná ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSarasvatī, protect him engaged in conflict for the sake of wealth, who glorifies you likeIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दे॑वि सरस्व॒त्यवा॒ वाजे॑षु वाजिनि । रदा॑ पू॒षेव॑ नः स॒निम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ devi ǀ sarasvati ǀ áva ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājini ǀráda ǀ pūṣā́-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ saním ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSarasvatī, abounding in food, protect us in combat, and, likePūṣan, give us gifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्या न॒: सर॑स्वती घो॒रा हिर॑ण्यवर्तनिः । वृ॒त्र॒घ्नी व॑ष्टि सुष्टु॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ ghorā́ ǀ híraṇya-vartaniḥ ǀvṛtra-ghnī́ ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ su-stutím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the fierceSarasvatī, riding in a golden chariot, the destructress of enemies, be plural ased by our earnest laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्या॑ अन॒न्तो अह्रु॑तस्त्वे॒षश्च॑रि॒ष्णुर॑र्ण॒वः । अम॒श्चर॑ति॒ रोरु॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: yásyāḥ ǀ anantáḥ ǀ áhrutaḥ ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ cariṣṇúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀámaḥ ǀ cárati ǀ róruvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May she whose might, infinite, undeviating, splendid, progressive, water-shedding, proceeds loud-sounding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा नो॒ विश्वा॒ अति॒ द्विष॒: स्वसॄ॑र॒न्या ऋ॒ताव॑री । अत॒न्नहे॑व॒ सूर्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ svásṝḥ ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-varī ǀátan ǀ áhā-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overcome all our adversaries, and bring to us her other water-laden sisters, as the ever-rolling sun (leads on) the days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑: प्रि॒या प्रि॒यासु॑ स॒प्तस्व॑सा॒ सुजु॑ष्टा । सर॑स्वती॒ स्तोम्या॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ priyā́ ǀ priyā́su ǀ saptá-svasā ǀ sú-juṣṭā ǀsárasvatī ǀ stómyā ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySarasvatī, who has seven sisters, who is dearest among those dear to us, and is fully propitiated, be ever adorable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒प॒प्रुषी॒ पार्थि॑वान्यु॒रु रजो॑ अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । सर॑स्वती नि॒दस्पा॑तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā-paprúṣī ǀ pā́rthivāni ǀ urú ǀ rájaḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀsárasvatī ǀ nidáḥ ǀ pātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySarasvatī, filing (with radiance) the expanse of earth and heaven, defend us from the reviled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒ष॒धस्था॑ स॒प्तधा॑तु॒: पञ्च॑ जा॒ता व॒र्धय॑न्ती । वाजे॑वाजे॒ हव्या॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: tri-sadhásthā ǀ saptá-dhātuḥ ǀ páñca ǀ jātā́ ǀ vardháyantī ǀvā́je-vāje ǀ hávyā ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abiding in thethree worlds, comprising seven elements, cherishing the five races (of beings), she is ever to be invoked in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र या म॑हि॒म्ना म॒हिना॑सु॒ चेकि॑ते द्यु॒म्नेभि॑र॒न्या अ॒पसा॑म॒पस्त॑मा । रथ॑ इव बृह॒ती वि॒भ्वने॑ कृ॒तोप॒स्तुत्या॑ चिकि॒तुषा॒ सर॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yā́ ǀ mahimnā́ ǀ mahínā ǀ āsu ǀ cékite ǀ dyumnébhiḥ ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ apásām ǀ apáḥ-tamā ǀráthaḥ-iva ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ vi-bhváne ǀ kṛtā́ ǀ upa-stútyā ǀ cikitúṣā ǀ sárasvatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She who is disinguished among them as eminent in greatness and in her glories; she who is the most impetuous of all other streams; she who as been created vast in capacity as a chariot, she,Sarasvatī, is to be glorified by the discree (worshippers)”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वत्य॒भि नो॑ नेषि॒ वस्यो॒ माप॑ स्फरी॒: पय॑सा॒ मा न॒ आ ध॑क् । जु॒षस्व॑ नः स॒ख्या वे॒श्या॑ च॒ मा त्वत्क्षेत्रा॒ण्यर॑णानि गन्म
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvati ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ neṣi ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ spharīḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhak ǀjuṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ veśyā́ ǀ ca ǀ mā́ ǀ tvát ǀ kṣétrāṇi ǀ áraṇāni ǀ ganma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Guide us,Sarasvatī, to precious wealth; reduce us no to insignificance; overwhelm us not with (excess of) water; be plural ased by our friendly (services) and access to our habitations, and let us not repair to plural ces unacceptable to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒षे नरा॑ दि॒वो अ॒स्य प्र॒सन्ता॒श्विना॑ हुवे॒ जर॑माणो अ॒र्कैः । या स॒द्य उ॒स्रा व्युषि॒ ज्मो अन्ता॒न्युयू॑षत॒: पर्यु॒रू वरां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: stuṣé ǀ nárā ǀ diváḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pra-sántā ǀ aśvínā ǀ huve ǀ járamāṇaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀyā́ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ usrā́ ǀ vi-úṣi ǀ jmáḥ ǀ ántān ǀ yúyūṣataḥ ǀ pári ǀ urú ǀ várāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise the two leaders of heaven, the presiders over this world; I invoke theAśvins, glorifying them with sacred hymns, them, who are ever the discomfiture (of foes), who at dawn scatter the investing glooms to the ends of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता य॒ज्ञमा शुचि॑भिश्चक्रमा॒णा रथ॑स्य भा॒नुं रु॑रुचू॒ रजो॑भिः । पु॒रू वरां॒स्यमि॑ता॒ मिमा॑ना॒पो धन्वा॒न्यति॑ याथो॒ अज्रा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ śúci-bhiḥ ǀ cakramāṇā́ ǀ ráthasya ǀ bhānúm ǀ rurucuḥ ǀ rájaḥ-bhiḥ ǀpurú ǀ várāṃsi ǀ ámitā ǀ mímānā ǀ apáḥ ǀ dhánvāni ǀ áti ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ ájrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Coming to the sacrifice with their bright splendours, they light up the lustre of (their) car; emitting vast and infinite radiance; they drive their horses over deserts (refreshing them) with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता ह॒ त्यद्व॒र्तिर्यदर॑ध्रमुग्रे॒त्था धिय॑ ऊहथु॒: शश्व॒दश्वै॑: । मनो॑जवेभिरिषि॒रैः श॒यध्यै॒ परि॒ व्यथि॑र्दा॒शुषो॒ मर्त्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yát ǀ áradhram ǀ ugrā ǀ itthā́ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ śáśvat ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀmánaḥ-javebhiḥ ǀ iṣiráiḥ ǀ śayádhyai ǀ pári ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceAśvins, from thhat humble mansion to which (you have repaired), you have ever borne with your desirable horses, as swift as thought, the pious worshippers in some manner (to heaven); let the injurer of the liberal man (be consigned by you) to (final) repose.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता नव्य॑सो॒ जर॑माणस्य॒ मन्मोप॑ भूषतो युयुजा॒नस॑प्ती । शुभं॒ पृक्ष॒मिष॒मूर्जं॒ वह॑न्ता॒ होता॑ यक्षत्प्र॒त्नो अ॒ध्रुग्युवा॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ návyasaḥ ǀ járamāṇasya ǀ mánma ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣataḥ ǀ yuyujānásaptī íti yuyujāná-saptī ǀśúbham ǀ pṛ́kṣam ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ váhantā ǀ hótā ǀ yakṣat ǀ pratnáḥ ǀ adhrúk ǀ yúvānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harnessing their horses, bringing excellent food, nourishment, and strength, they approach (to receive) the adoration of their recent worshipper; and may the benevolent ancient invoker of the gods (Agni) sacrifice to the ever youthful (deities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता व॒ल्गू द॒स्रा पु॑रु॒शाक॑तमा प्र॒त्ना नव्य॑सा॒ वच॒सा वि॑वासे । या शंस॑ते स्तुव॒ते शम्भ॑विष्ठा बभू॒वतु॑र्गृण॒ते चि॒त्ररा॑ती
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ valgū́ íti ǀ dasrā́ ǀ puruśā́ka-tamā ǀ pratnā́ ǀ návyasā ǀ vácasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀyā́ ǀ śáṃsate ǀ stuvaté ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhā ǀ babhūvátuḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ citrárātī íti citrá-rātī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship with a new hymn those two quick-moving good-looking ancient (Aśvins), the achievers of many exploits, who are the givers of great felicity to him who prays to (them), or praises (them); the bestowers of wondrous gifts on him who adores (them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता भु॒ज्युं विभि॑र॒द्भ्यः स॑मु॒द्रात्तुग्र॑स्य सू॒नुमू॑हथू॒ रजो॑भिः । अ॒रे॒णुभि॒र्योज॑नेभिर्भु॒जन्ता॑ पत॒त्रिभि॒रर्ण॑सो॒ निरु॒पस्था॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ bhujyúm ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ túgrasya ǀ sūnúm ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ rájaḥ-bhiḥ ǀareṇú-bhiḥ ǀ yójanebhiḥ ǀ bhujántā ǀ patatrí-bhiḥ ǀ árṇasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ upá-sthāt ǁ
