shlokas.meaning_en: “They bore up from te waters, from the ocean, by the winged horses attached to their car, (passing) by roads unsoiled by dust,Bhujyu, the son ofTugra; they (bore them) from out of the lap of the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ज॒युषा॑ रथ्या यात॒मद्रिं॑ श्रु॒तं हवं॑ वृषणा वध्रिम॒त्याः । द॒श॒स्यन्ता॑ श॒यवे॑ पिप्यथु॒र्गामिति॑ च्यवाना सुम॒तिं भु॑रण्यू
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ jayúṣā ǀ rathyā ǀ yātam ǀ ádrim ǀ śrutám ǀ hávam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vadhri-matyā́ḥ ǀdaśasyántā ǀ śayáve ǀ pipyathuḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ íti ǀ cyavānā ǀ su-matím ǀ bhuraṇyū íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Riders in your car, you have penetrated the mountain by your triumphant chariot; showerers (of benefits) you heard the invocation ofVadhrimatī; you have nourished, bountiful givers, the cow ofŚayu-- and in this manner displaying benevolence are you everywhere present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्रो॑दसी प्र॒दिवो॒ अस्ति॒ भूमा॒ हेळो॑ दे॒वाना॑मु॒त म॑र्त्य॒त्रा । तदा॑दित्या वसवो रुद्रियासो रक्षो॒युजे॒ तपु॑र॒घं द॑धात
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ rodasī íti ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ bhū́ma ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ utá ǀ martya-trā́ ǀtát ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ rudriyāsaḥ ǀ rakṣaḥ-yúje ǀ tápuḥ ǀ aghám ǀ dadhāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and Earth, Ādiyas,Vasus,Maruts, rende that dread ange of the gods which (has) of old (been directed) against mortals, destructive and fatal to him who is associated with therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ईं॒ राजा॑नावृतु॒था वि॒दध॒द्रज॑सो मि॒त्रो वरु॑ण॒श्चिके॑तत् । ग॒म्भी॒राय॒ रक्ष॑से हे॒तिम॑स्य॒ द्रोघा॑य चि॒द्वच॑स॒ आन॑वाय
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ rā́jānau ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ vi-dádhat ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ cíketat ǀgambhīrā́ya ǀ rákṣase ǀ hetím ǀ asya ǀ dróghāya ǀ cit ǀ vácase ǀ ā́navāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇarecognize him who of all the world worships the royal (Aśvins) in due season; he hurls his weapon against the strongrākṣasa, against the malignant menaces of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्त॑रैश्च॒क्रैस्तन॑याय व॒र्तिर्द्यु॒मता या॑तं नृ॒वता॒ रथे॑न । सनु॑त्येन॒ त्यज॑सा॒ मर्त्य॑स्य वनुष्य॒तामपि॑ शी॒र्षा व॑वृक्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ántaraiḥ ǀ cakráiḥ ǀ tánayāya ǀ vartíḥ ǀ dyu-mátā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ nṛ-vátā ǀ ráthena ǀsánutyena ǀ tyájasā ǀ mártyasya ǀ vanuṣyatā́m ǀ ápi ǀ śīrṣā́ ǀ vavṛktam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come with your shining and well-guided chariot, (fitted) with excellen wheels, to our dwelling, (to bestow upon us)maleoffspring; cut off with secret indignation the heads of those obstructing (the adoration) of the mortal (who worships you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑र॒माभि॑रु॒त म॑ध्य॒माभि॑र्नि॒युद्भि॑र्यातमव॒माभि॑र॒र्वाक् । दृ॒ळ्हस्य॑ चि॒द्गोम॑तो॒ वि व्र॒जस्य॒ दुरो॑ वर्तं गृण॒ते चि॑त्रराती
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paramā́bhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ madhyamā́bhiḥ ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ avamā́bhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀdṛḷhásya ǀ cit ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ ví ǀ vrajásya ǀ dúraḥ ǀ vartam ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ citrarātī íti citra-rātī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come down, whether with the most excellent, or middling, or inferiorNiyutsteeds; set upon the doors of the fast-shutstall of the cattle; eb bountiful to him who praises you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ त्या व॒ल्गू पु॑रुहू॒ताद्य दू॒तो न स्तोमो॑ऽविद॒न्नम॑स्वान् । आ यो अ॒र्वाङ्नास॑त्या व॒वर्त॒ प्रेष्ठा॒ ह्यस॑थो अस्य॒ मन्म॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ tyā́ ǀ valgū́ íti ǀ puru-hūtā́ ǀ adyá ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ná ǀ stómaḥ ǀ avidat ǀ námasvān ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vavárta ǀ préṣṭhā ǀ hí ǀ ásathaḥ ǀ asya ǀ mánman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where may our praise and oblations find today for a mesenger, those two splendid (Aśvins), the invoked of many, and bring theNāsatyāsto our presence? Be propitiated (Aśvins) by the adoration of this (your worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरं॑ मे गन्तं॒ हव॑नाया॒स्मै गृ॑णा॒ना यथा॒ पिबा॑थो॒ अन्ध॑: । परि॑ ह॒ त्यद्व॒र्तिर्या॑थो रि॒षो न यत्परो॒ नान्त॑रस्तुतु॒र्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: áram ǀ me ǀ gantam ǀ hávanāya ǀ asmái ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ píbāthaḥ ǀ ándhaḥ ǀpári ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yát ǀ páraḥ ǀ ná ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ tuturyā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised, that you may drink the (sacrificial)Soma, you come promptly upon this my invocation; keep guard around the dwelling against (all) advdrsaries, so that neither one that abides at a distance nor a neighbour may do us harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अका॑रि वा॒मन्ध॑सो॒ वरी॑म॒न्नस्ता॑रि ब॒र्हिः सु॑प्राय॒णत॑मम् । उ॒त्ता॒नह॑स्तो युव॒युर्व॑व॒न्दा वां॒ नक्ष॑न्तो॒ अद्र॑य आञ्जन्
shlokas.transliteration: ákāri ǀ vām ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ várīman ǀ ástāri ǀ barhíḥ ǀ supra-ayanátamam ǀuttāná-hastaḥ ǀ yuvayúḥ ǀ vavanda ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ nákṣantaḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ āñjan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(What is essential) for the copious effusion of the (sacrificial) food has been done for you; the very delicate sacred grass has been strewn; the (priest with) upliftedhandsdesirous o your presence praises you; the stones express (theSoma), designing it for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो वा॑म॒ग्निर॑ध्व॒रेष्व॑स्था॒त्प्र रा॒तिरे॑ति जू॒र्णिनी॑ घृ॒ताची॑ । प्र होता॑ गू॒र्तम॑ना उरा॒णोऽयु॑क्त॒ यो नास॑त्या॒ हवी॑मन्
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ vām ǀ agníḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ asthāt ǀ prá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ eti ǀ jūrṇínī ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀprá ǀ hótā ǀ gūrtá-manāḥ ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ áyukta ǀ yáḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ hávīman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis above for you; he is present at (your) sacrifices; the oblation flows diffusive and redolent of ghī; diligent and zealous is the ministrant priest who is engaged,Nāsatyās, in your invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॑ श्रि॒ये दु॑हि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य॒ रथं॑ तस्थौ पुरुभुजा श॒तोति॑म् । प्र मा॒याभि॑र्मायिना भूत॒मत्र॒ नरा॑ नृतू॒ जनि॑मन्य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ śriyé ǀ duhitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ rátham ǀ tasthau ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ śatá-ūtim ǀprá ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ māyinā ǀ bhūtam ǀ átra ǀ nárā ǀ nṛtū íti ǀ jániman ǀ yajñíyānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protectors of many, the daughter ofSūryaascended your chariot the defence of hundreds, for refuge sagacious leaders and guides, you have excelled by your devices (all others) at this appearance of the adorable (deities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श्री॒भिर्द॑र्श॒ताभि॑रा॒भिः शु॒भे पु॒ष्टिमू॑हथुः सू॒र्याया॑: । प्र वां॒ वयो॒ वपु॒षेऽनु॑ पप्त॒न्नक्ष॒द्वाणी॒ सुष्टु॑ता धिष्ण्या वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śrībhíḥ ǀ darśatā́bhiḥ ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ śubhé ǀ puṣṭím ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ sūryā́yāḥ ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vápuṣe ǀ ánu ǀ paptan ǀ nákṣat ǀ vā́ṇī ǀ sú-stutā ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have provided with these beautiful splendours, gratification for the enjoyment ofSūrya, your horses have descended for feliciy, deserving of praise, the laudation (of the sages) has reached you glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ वयोऽश्वा॑सो॒ वहि॑ष्ठा अ॒भि प्रयो॑ नासत्या वहन्तु । प्र वां॒ रथो॒ मनो॑जवा असर्जी॒षः पृ॒क्ष इ॒षिधो॒ अनु॑ पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ váyaḥ ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ váhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ vahantu ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ asarji ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ iṣídhaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your rapid burden-bearing steeds bring youNāsatyāsto the (sacrificial) food; your chariot swift as thought has dispensed substantial, desirable, abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु हि वां॑ पुरुभुजा दे॒ष्णं धे॒नुं न॒ इषं॑ पिन्वत॒मस॑क्राम् । स्तुत॑श्च वां माध्वी सुष्टु॒तिश्च॒ रसा॑श्च॒ ये वा॒मनु॑ रा॒तिमग्म॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: purú ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ deṣṇám ǀ dhenúm ǀ naḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ pinvatam ǀ ásakrām ǀstútaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vām ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ ca ǀ rásāḥ ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ ánu ǀ rātím ǀ ágman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protectors of many, vast (wealth) is to be distributed by you; give us then nutritious and invariable food. Givers of delight, there are to you, adorers, and fit praise, and libations, which are prepared to acknowledge your liberality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त म॑ ऋ॒ज्रे पुर॑यस्य र॒घ्वी सु॑मी॒ळ्हे श॒तं पे॑रु॒के च॑ प॒क्वा । शा॒ण्डो दा॑द्धिर॒णिन॒: स्मद्दि॑ष्टी॒न्दश॑ व॒शासो॑ अभि॒षाच॑ ऋ॒ष्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ me ǀ ṛjré íti ǀ púrayasya ǀ raghvī́ íti ǀ su-mīḷhé ǀ śatám ǀ peruké ǀ ca ǀ pakvā́ ǀśāṇḍáḥ ǀ dāt ǀ hiraṇínaḥ ǀ smát-diṣṭīn ǀ dáśa ǀ vaśā́saḥ ǀ abhi-sā́caḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two straight-going, light-moving, (mares) ofPurayabe mine; may the hundred cows belonging to Sumīḷha, may the dressed viands prepared byPerukabe for me; mayṢaṇḍabestow upon me ten handsome golden chariots, and obedient, valian, and well-favoured (dependants).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं वां॑ श॒ता ना॑सत्या स॒हस्राश्वा॑नां पुरु॒पन्था॑ गि॒रे दा॑त् । भ॒रद्वा॑जाय वीर॒ नू गि॒रे दा॑द्ध॒ता रक्षां॑सि पुरुदंससा स्युः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ vām ǀ śatā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sahásrā ǀ áśvānām ǀ puru-pánthāḥ ǀ giré ǀ dāt ǀbharát-vājāya ǀ vīra ǀ nú ǀ giré ǀ dāt ǀ hatā́ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ puru-daṃsasā ǀ syuríti syuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Purupanthā,Nāsatyās, grant to him who praises you, hundreds and thousands of horses; may he give them, heroes, toBharadvāja; achievers of great deeds, may therākṣasasbe slain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ सु॒म्ने वरि॑मन्त्सू॒रिभि॑: ष्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ sumné ǀ váriman ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ syām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I be associated with the pious in the abundant felicity bestowed by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑ श्रि॒य उ॒षसो॒ रोच॑माना॒ अस्थु॑र॒पां नोर्मयो॒ रुश॑न्तः । कृ॒णोति॒ विश्वा॑ सु॒पथा॑ सु॒गान्यभू॑दु॒ वस्वी॒ दक्षि॑णा म॒घोनी॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śriyé ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ rócamānāḥ ǀ ásthuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ná ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ rúśantaḥ ǀkṛṇóti ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthā ǀ su-gā́ni ǀ ábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vásvī ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ maghónī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The white and shining tints of the dawn have spread like the waves of the waters, for the beautifying (of the world); she renders all good roads easy to be traversed; she ho is replete with delight, excellence and health.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा द॑दृक्ष उर्वि॒या वि भा॒स्युत्ते॑ शो॒चिर्भा॒नवो॒ द्याम॑पप्तन् । आ॒विर्वक्ष॑: कृणुषे शु॒म्भमा॒नोषो॑ देवि॒ रोच॑माना॒ महो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrā́ ǀ dadṛkṣe ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ bhāsi ǀ út ǀ te ǀ śocíḥ ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ dyā́m ǀ apaptan ǀāvíḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣe ǀ śumbhámānā ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ rócamānā ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine Uṣas, you are seen auspicious; you shine afar; your bright rays spread over the sky, lovely and radiant with great (splndours), you display your person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वह॑न्ति सीमरु॒णासो॒ रुश॑न्तो॒ गाव॑: सु॒भगा॑मुर्वि॒या प्र॑था॒नाम् । अपे॑जते॒ शूरो॒ अस्ते॑व॒ शत्रू॒न्बाध॑ते॒ तमो॑ अजि॒रो न वोळ्हा॑
shlokas.transliteration: váhanti ǀ sīm ǀ aruṇā́saḥ ǀ rúśantaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ su-bhágām ǀ urviyā́ ǀ prathānā́m ǀápa ǀ ījate ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ástā-iva ǀ śátrūn ǀ bā́dhate ǀ támaḥ ǀ ajiráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vóḷhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ruddy and resplendent kine bear the auspicious, expanding, illustrious dawn; like a warrior, who, casting his darts, or a swift charger scattering enemies, she drives away the glooms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒गोत ते॑ सु॒पथा॒ पर्व॑तेष्ववा॒ते अ॒पस्त॑रसि स्वभानो । सा न॒ आ व॑ह पृथुयामन्नृष्वे र॒यिं दि॑वो दुहितरिष॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-gā́ ǀ utá ǀ te ǀ su-páthā ǀ párvateṣu ǀ avāté ǀ apáḥ ǀ tarasi ǀ svabhāno íti sva-bhāno ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ pṛthu-yāman ǀ ṛṣve ǀ rayím ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ iṣayádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yours are good roads and easy to be traversed in mountains and inaccessible plural ces; you pass self-irradiating over the waters; bring to us, daughter of heaven, in your spacious and beautiful chariot, desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा व॑ह॒ योक्षभि॒रवा॒तोषो॒ वरं॒ वह॑सि॒ जोष॒मनु॑ । त्वं दि॑वो दुहित॒र्या ह॑ दे॒वी पू॒र्वहू॑तौ मं॒हना॑ दर्श॒ता भू॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ yā́ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀ ávātā ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ váram ǀ váhasi ǀ jóṣam ǀ ánu ǀtvám ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ ha ǀ devī́ ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ maṃhánā ǀ darśatā́ ǀ bhūḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you Uṣas bring me opulence, for unoposed you bear with your oxen (wealth to your worshippers), according to your satisfaction; daughter of heaven, you who are divine, who are lovely, are to be worshipped at the first (daily) rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॒ वय॑श्चिद्वस॒तेर॑पप्त॒न्नर॑श्च॒ ये पि॑तु॒भाजो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । अ॒मा स॒ते व॑हसि॒ भूरि॑ वा॒ममुषो॑ देवि दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ váyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ vasatéḥ ǀ apaptan ǀ náraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ pitu-bhā́jaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀamā́ ǀ saté ǀ vahasi ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vāmám ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At your dawning, divine Uṣas, the birds spring up from their nests, and men who have to gain their sustenance (arise); you, divine Uṣas, bring ample wealth to the mortal who is nigh you, the offerer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा स्या नो॑ दुहि॒ता दि॑वो॒जाः क्षि॒तीरु॒च्छन्ती॒ मानु॑षीरजीगः । या भा॒नुना॒ रुश॑ता रा॒म्यास्वज्ञा॑यि ति॒रस्तम॑सश्चिद॒क्तून्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ syā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ divaḥ-jā́ḥ ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ ucchántī ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ ajīgaríti ǀyā́ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ rúśatā ǀ rāmyā́su ǀ ájñāyi ǀ tiráḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ cit ǀ aktū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This heaven-born daughter (of the sky), driving away the darkness for us, makes visible human beings; she who with bright lustre is perceived dissipating the glooms, and (extinguishing) the plural nets (shining) in the nights.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि तद्य॑युररुण॒युग्भि॒रश्वै॑श्चि॒त्रं भा॑न्त्यु॒षस॑श्च॒न्द्रर॑थाः । अग्रं॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ बृह॒तो नय॑न्ती॒र्वि ता बा॑धन्ते॒ तम॒ ऊर्म्या॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tát ǀ yayuḥ ǀ aruṇayúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ citrám ǀ bhānti ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ candrá-rathāḥ ǀágram ǀ yajñásya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ náyantīḥ ǀ ví ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ bādhante ǀ támaḥ ǀ ū́rmyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The DWns in beautiful chariots drawn by purple steeds in pairs, shine gloriously as hey proceed (along the heaven); bringing on the commencement of the great (morning) sacrifice, they disperse the darkness of the night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रवो॒ वाज॒मिष॒मूर्जं॒ वह॑न्ती॒र्नि दा॒शुष॑ उषसो॒ मर्त्या॑य । म॒घोनी॑र्वी॒रव॒त्पत्य॑माना॒ अवो॑ धात विध॒ते रत्न॑म॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: śrávaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ váhantīḥ ǀ ní ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀ mártyāya ǀmaghónīḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ dhāta ǀ vidhaté ǀ rátnam ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dawns, bringing fame, and food, sustenance, and strength to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation), abonding in wealth, and proceeding (through the sky), bestow upon the worshiper today food, withmaledescendants and riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दा हि वो॑ विध॒ते रत्न॒मस्ती॒दा वी॒राय॑ दा॒शुष॑ उषासः । इ॒दा विप्रा॑य॒ जर॑ते॒ यदु॒क्था नि ष्म॒ माव॑ते वहथा पु॒रा चि॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ vidhaté ǀ rátnam ǀ ásti ǀ idā́ ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀidā́ ǀ víprāya ǀ járate ǀ yát ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ní ǀ sma ǀ mā́-vate ǀ vahatha ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, Dawns, there is at present wealth to give to your worshiper, to the man offering (oblations) to the sage repeating your praise; if the praises (are accepted), then bring to him who is like me such wealth as has been formerly bestowed (upon myself).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दा हि त॑ उषो अद्रिसानो गो॒त्रा गवा॒मङ्गि॑रसो गृ॒णन्ति॑ । व्य१॒॑र्केण॑ बिभिदु॒र्ब्रह्म॑णा च स॒त्या नृ॒णाम॑भवद्दे॒वहू॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ adrisāno ítyadri-sāno ǀ gotrā́ ǀ gávām ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀví ǀ arkéṇa ǀ bibhiduḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ ca ǀ satyā́ ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ abhavat ǀ devá-hūtiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, Dawns, there is at presen wealh to give to your worshipper, to the man offering (oblations) to the sage repeating your praise; if the praises (are accepted), then bring to him who is like me such wealth as has been formerly bestowed (upon myself).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छा दि॑वो दुहितः प्रत्न॒वन्नो॑ भरद्वाज॒वद्वि॑ध॒ते म॑घोनि । सु॒वीरं॑ र॒यिं गृ॑ण॒ते रि॑रीह्युरुगा॒यमधि॑ धेहि॒ श्रवो॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ucchá ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaríti ǀ pratna-vát ǀ naḥ ǀ bharadvāja-vát ǀ vidhaté ǀ maghoni ǀsu-vī́ram ǀ rayím ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ rirīhi ǀ uru-gāyám ǀ ádhi ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, Uṣas, theAṅgirasasthrough your (favour) recover the herd of cattle from the summit of the mountain; by adoration and by prayer they have divided (the rock); unfailing was the praise of the gods uttered by the oleaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वपु॒र्नु तच्चि॑कि॒तुषे॑ चिदस्तु समा॒नं नाम॑ धे॒नु पत्य॑मानम् । मर्ते॑ष्व॒न्यद्दो॒हसे॑ पी॒पाय॑ स॒कृच्छु॒क्रं दु॑दुहे॒ पृश्नि॒रूध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vápuḥ ǀ nú ǀ tát ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ cit ǀ astu ǀ samānám ǀ nā́ma ǀ dhenú ǀ pátyamānam ǀmárteṣu ǀ anyát ǀ doháse ǀ pīpā́ya ǀ sakṛ́t ǀ śukrám ǀ duduhe ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the like-formed, benevolent, all-pervading, all humiliating troop (of theMaruts) be promptly with the prudent man; the troop that ever cherishes all that among mortals is designed to yield (them) advantage; and (at whose wil)Pṛśnigives milk from (her) bright udder once (in the year).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॒ग्नयो॒ न शोशु॑चन्निधा॒ना द्विर्यत्त्रिर्म॒रुतो॑ वावृ॒धन्त॑ । अ॒रे॒णवो॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑स एषां सा॒कं नृ॒म्णैः पौंस्ये॑भिश्च भूवन्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śóśucan ǀ idhānā́ḥ ǀ dvíḥ ǀ yát ǀ tríḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vavṛdhánta ǀareṇávaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyāsaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ sākám ǀ nṛmṇáiḥ ǀ páuṃsyebhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ bhūvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unsoiled by dust the golden chariots of thoseMaruts, who are shining like kindled fires, enlarging themselves (at will) twofold and threefold, and (charged) with riches and virile energies, are manifest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रु॒द्रस्य॒ ये मी॒ळ्हुष॒: सन्ति॑ पु॒त्रा याँश्चो॒ नु दाधृ॑वि॒र्भर॑ध्यै । वि॒दे हि मा॒ता म॒हो म॒ही षा सेत्पृश्नि॑: सु॒भ्वे॒३॒॑ गर्भ॒माधा॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: rudrásya ǀ yé ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ yā́n ǀ co íti ǀ nú ǀ dā́dhṛviḥ ǀ bháradhyai ǀvidé ǀ hí ǀ mātā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahī́ ǀ sā́ ǀ sā́ ǀ ít ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ su-bhvé ǀ gárbham ǀ ā́ ǀ adhāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They (who are) the sons of the showererRudra, whom the nursing (firmamen is able) to sustain, and of whom, the mighty ones, it is known that the greatPṛśnihas received the germ for the benefit (of man).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न य ईष॑न्ते ज॒नुषोऽया॒ न्व१॒॑न्तः सन्तो॑ऽव॒द्यानि॑ पुना॒नाः । निर्यद्दु॒ह्रे शुच॒योऽनु॒ जोष॒मनु॑ श्रि॒या त॒न्व॑मु॒क्षमा॑णाः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yé ǀ ī́ṣante ǀ janúṣaḥ ǀ áyā ǀ nú ǀ antáríti ǀ sántaḥ ǀ avadyā́ni ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀníḥ ǀ yát ǀ duhré ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ jóṣam ǀ ánu ǀ śriyā́ ǀ tanvám ǀ ukṣámāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who approach not to men any conveyance, being already in their hearts, purifying their defects; when brilliant they supply their milk (the rain) for the gratification (of their worshippers); they are watering the earth (manifesting their collective); from with splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू न येषु॑ दो॒हसे॑ चिद॒या आ नाम॑ धृ॒ष्णु मारु॑तं॒ दधा॑नाः । न ये स्तौ॒ना अ॒यासो॑ म॒ह्ना नू चि॑त्सु॒दानु॒रव॑ यासदु॒ग्रान्
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ ná ǀ yéṣu ǀ doháse ǀ cit ǀ ayā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nā́ma ǀ ghṛṣṇú ǀ mā́rutam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀná ǀ yé ǀ staunā́ḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀ áva ǀ yāsat ǀ ugrā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approaching nigh to whom, and repeating the mighty name of theMaruts, (the worshipper is able) quickly to obtain (his wishes); the liberal donor pacifies the angry Maruts, who are otherwise in their might the resistless plural nderers (of their wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त इदु॒ग्राः शव॑सा धृ॒ष्णुषे॑णा उ॒भे यु॑जन्त॒ रोद॑सी सु॒मेके॑ । अध॑ स्मैषु रोद॒सी स्वशो॑चि॒राम॑वत्सु तस्थौ॒ न रोक॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ dhṛṣṇú-senāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ yujanta ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ eṣu ǀ rodasī́ ǀ svá-śociḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ámavat-su ǀ tasthau ǀ ná ǀ rókaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “THose fierce and powerfully arrayed (Maruts) unite by their strength the two beautiful (regions) heaven and earth; in them, the self-radiant, heaven and earth abide; the obstruction (of light) dwells not in those mighty ones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ने॒नो वो॑ मरुतो॒ यामो॑ अस्त्वन॒श्वश्चि॒द्यमज॒त्यर॑थीः । अ॒न॒व॒सो अ॑नभी॒शू र॑ज॒स्तूर्वि रोद॑सी प॒थ्या॑ याति॒ साध॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: anenáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́maḥ ǀ astu ǀ anaśváḥ ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ ájati ǀ árathīḥ ǀanavasáḥ ǀ anabhīśúḥ ǀ rajaḥ-tū́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ sā́dhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your chariot,Maruts, be devoid of wickedness; that which (the worshipper) impels, and which without driver, without horses, without provender, without traces, scattering water and accomplishing (desires), traverses heaven and earth and the paths (of the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नास्य॑ व॒र्ता न त॑रु॒ता न्व॑स्ति॒ मरु॑तो॒ यमव॑थ॒ वाज॑सातौ । तो॒के वा॒ गोषु॒ तन॑ये॒ यम॒प्सु स व्र॒जं दर्ता॒ पार्ये॒ अध॒ द्योः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ asya ǀ vartā́ ǀ ná ǀ tarutā́ ǀ nú ǀ asti ǀ márutaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ávatha ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀtoké ǀ vā ǀ góṣu ǀ tánaye ǀ yám ǀ ap-sú ǀ sáḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ dártā ǀ pā́rye ǀ ádha ǀ dyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There is no propeller, no obstructer, of him, whom,Maruts, you protect in battle; he whom (you prosper) with sons, grandsons, cattle, and water, is in war the despoiler of the herds of his ardent (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र चि॒त्रम॒र्कं गृ॑ण॒ते तु॒राय॒ मारु॑ताय॒ स्वत॑वसे भरध्वम् । ये सहां॑सि॒ सह॑सा॒ सह॑न्ते॒ रेज॑ते अग्ने पृथि॒वी म॒खेभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ citrám ǀ arkám ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ turā́ya ǀ mā́rutāya ǀ svá-tavase ǀ bharadhvam ǀyé ǀ sáhāṃsi ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhante ǀ réjate ǀ agne ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ makhébhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer to the loud-sounding, quick-moving, self-invigorating company of theMaruts, excellent (sacrificial) food; (to them) who overcome strength by strength; the earth trembles,Agni, at the adorable (Maruts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्विषी॑मन्तो अध्व॒रस्ये॑व दि॒द्युत्तृ॑षु॒च्यव॑सो जु॒ह्वो॒३॒॑ नाग्नेः । अ॒र्चत्र॑यो॒ धुन॑यो॒ न वी॒रा भ्राज॑ज्जन्मानो म॒रुतो॒ अधृ॑ष्टाः
shlokas.transliteration: tvíṣi-mantaḥ ǀ adhvarásya-iva ǀ didyút ǀ tṛṣu-cyávasaḥ ǀ juhváḥ ǀ ná ǀ agnéḥ ǀarcátrayaḥ ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ bhrā́jat-janmānaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsare resplendent as if iluminators of the sacrifice, (bright) as he flames ofAgni; entitled are they to donation, and like heroes making (adversaries) tremble; brilliant are they from birth, and invincible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वृ॒धन्तं॒ मारु॑तं॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टिं रु॒द्रस्य॑ सू॒नुं ह॒वसा वि॑वासे । दि॒वः शर्धा॑य॒ शुच॑यो मनी॒षा गि॒रयो॒ नाप॑ उ॒ग्रा अ॑स्पृध्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vṛdhántam ǀ mā́rutam ǀ bhrā́jat-ṛṣṭim ǀ rudrásya ǀ sūnúm ǀ havásā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀdiváḥ ǀ śárdhāya ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ aspṛdhran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship with oblations that exalted company of theMaruts, the progeny ofRudra, armed with shining lances; the pure and earnest praises of the devout (adorer) are emulous in the invigoration (of the Maruts), as the clouds (vie in the emission of the rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑षां वः स॒तां ज्येष्ठ॑तमा गी॒र्भिर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा वावृ॒धध्यै॑ । सं या र॒श्मेव॑ य॒मतु॒र्यमि॑ष्ठा॒ द्वा जनाँ॒ अस॑मा बा॒हुभि॒: स्वैः
shlokas.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ vaḥ ǀ satā́m ǀ jyéṣṭha-tamā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vavṛdhádhyai ǀsám ǀ yā́ ǀ raśmā́-iva ǀ yamátuḥ ǀ yámiṣṭhā ǀ dvā́ ǀ jánān ǀ ásamā ǀ bāhú-bhiḥ ǀ sváiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I proceed) by my praises to exalt you,MiraandVaruṇa, the eldest of all existing things; you two, though not the same, are the irmest resrainers with your arms, and hold men back (from eil) as they check (horses) with reins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं मद्वां॒ प्र स्तृ॑णीते मनी॒षोप॑ प्रि॒या नम॑सा ब॒र्हिरच्छ॑ । य॒न्तं नो॑ मित्रावरुणा॒वधृ॑ष्टं छ॒र्दिर्यद्वां॑ वरू॒थ्यं॑ सुदानू
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ mát ǀ vām ǀ prá ǀ stṛṇīte ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ úpa ǀ priyā́ ǀ námasā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ áccha ǀyantám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ádhṛṣṭam ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ varūthyám ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This my praise is addressed to you both, and proceeds to you beloved (deities) together with the oblation; the sacred grass is spread before you; grant us,MitraandVaruṇaan unassailable dwelling, that through your favour, munificent divinities, may be a (secure) shelter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑तं मित्रावरुणा सुश॒स्त्युप॑ प्रि॒या नम॑सा हू॒यमा॑ना । सं याव॑प्न॒:स्थो अ॒पसे॑व॒ जना॑ञ्छ्रुधीय॒तश्चि॑द्यतथो महि॒त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ su-śastí ǀ úpa ǀ priyā́ ǀ námasā ǀ hūyámānā ǀsám ǀ yáu ǀ apnaḥ-stháḥ ǀ apásā-iva ǀ jánān ǀ śrudhi-yatáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yatathaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,MitraandVaruṇa, beloved by all, and invoked with reveence to the propitious ite, you who by your bounty support men labouring for sustenance as a work man (maintains himself) by work.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॒ न या वा॒जिना॑ पू॒तब॑न्धू ऋ॒ता यद्गर्भ॒मदि॑ति॒र्भर॑ध्यै । प्र या महि॑ म॒हान्ता॒ जाय॑माना घो॒रा मर्ता॑य रि॒पवे॒ नि दी॑धः
shlokas.transliteration: áśvā ǀ ná ǀ yā́ ǀ vājínā ǀ pūtábandhū íti pūtá-bandhū ǀ ṛtā́ ǀ yát ǀ gárbham ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bháradhyai ǀprá ǀ yā́ ǀ máhi ǀ mahā́ntā ǀ jā́yamānā ǀ ghorā́ ǀ mártāya ǀ ripáve ǀ ní ǀ dīdharíti dīdhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who (are) strong as horses, accepters or pious praise, observers of truth, whomAditiconceived; whom, mighty of the mighty at your birth and formidable to mortal foes, she bore.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ यद्वां॑ मं॒हना॒ मन्द॑मानाः क्ष॒त्रं दे॒वासो॒ अद॑धुः स॒जोषा॑: । परि॒ यद्भू॒थो रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी सन्ति॒ स्पशो॒ अद॑ब्धासो॒ अमू॑राः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ maṃhánā ǀ mándamānāḥ ǀ kṣatrám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀpári ǀ yát ǀ bhūtháḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ sánti ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ ádabdhāsaḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as all the gods equally plural ased and rejoicing in your greatness conferred strength upon you, and since you are pre-eminen over the wide heaven and earth, your courses are unobstructed, unimpeded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि क्ष॒त्रं धा॒रये॑थे॒ अनु॒ द्यून्दृं॒हेथे॒ सानु॑मुप॒मादि॑व॒ द्योः । दृ॒ळ्हो नक्ष॑त्र उ॒त वि॒श्वदे॑वो॒ भूमि॒माता॒न्द्यां धा॒सिना॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ kṣatrám ǀ dhāráyethe íti ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ dṛṃhéthe íti ǀ sā́num ǀ upamā́t-iva ǀ dyóḥ ǀdṛḷháḥ ǀ nákṣatraḥ ǀ utá ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ bhū́mim ǀ ā́ ǀ atān ǀ dyā́m ǀ dhāsínā ǀ āyóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You manifest vigour daily, you strengthen the summit of the sky as if with a pillar; the solid firmamen and the universal deity (the sun) replenish earth and heaven with the food of man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वि॒ग्रं धै॑थे ज॒ठरं॑ पृ॒णध्या॒ आ यत्सद्म॒ सभृ॑तयः पृ॒णन्ति॑ । न मृ॑ष्यन्ते युव॒तयोऽवा॑ता॒ वि यत्पयो॑ विश्वजिन्वा॒ भर॑न्ते
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vigrám ǀ dhaithe íti ǀ jaṭháram ǀ pṛṇádhyai ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ sádma ǀ sá-bhṛtayaḥ ǀ pṛṇánti ǀná ǀ mṛṣyante ǀ yuvatáyaḥ ǀ ávātāḥ ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ páyaḥ ǀ viśva-jinvā ǀ bhárante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two support the sage (worshipper), filling his belly when he and his dependants fill the sacrificial chamber; when sustainers of all, the rain (is sent down by you), and the young (rivers) are not obstructed, but, undried, diffuse (fertility) around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता जि॒ह्वया॒ सद॒मेदं सु॑मे॒धा आ यद्वां॑ स॒त्यो अ॑र॒तिॠ॒ते भूत् । तद्वां॑ महि॒त्वं घृ॑तान्नावस्तु यु॒वं दा॒शुषे॒ वि च॑यिष्ट॒मंह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ jihváyā ǀ sádam ǀ ā́ ǀ idám ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ satyáḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ bhū́t ǀtát ǀ vām ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ghṛta-annau ǀ astu ǀ yuvám ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ví ǀ cayiṣṭam ǀ áṃhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise man always (solicits) you his prayers for this (supply of water), when approaching you sincer in sacrifice; may your magnanimity be such that you, the feeders upon ghī, may exterminate sin in the donor (of the oblation);”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यद्वां॑ मित्रावरुणा स्पू॒र्धन्प्रि॒या धाम॑ यु॒वधि॑ता मि॒नन्ति॑ । न ये दे॒वास॒ ओह॑सा॒ न मर्ता॒ अय॑ज्ञसाचो॒ अप्यो॒ न पु॒त्राः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ spūrdhán ǀ priyā́ ǀ dhā́ma ǀ yuvá-dhitā ǀ minánti ǀná ǀ yé ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ óhasā ǀ ná ǀ mártāḥ ǀ áyajña-sācaḥ ǀ ápyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ putrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Exterminate also),MitraandVaruṇathose who emulously contending, disturb the rites that are agreeable and beneficial to you both; those divinities, those mortals, who are not diligent in adoration, those who performing works perform not sacrifices, those who do not propitiate you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यद्वाचं॑ की॒स्तासो॒ भर॑न्ते॒ शंस॑न्ति॒ के चि॑न्नि॒विदो॑ मना॒नाः । आद्वां॑ ब्रवाम स॒त्यान्यु॒क्था नकि॑र्दे॒वेभि॑र्यतथो महि॒त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yát ǀ vā́cam ǀ kīstā́saḥ ǀ bhárante ǀ śáṃsanti ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ ni-vídaḥ ǀ manānā́ḥ ǀā́t ǀ vām ǀ bravāma ǀ satyā́ni ǀ ukthā́ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ yatathaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the intelligent (priests) offer praise, then some of them, glorifying (Agniand other deities), recite the Nivid hymns; such being the case, we address to you sincere adoration, for in consequence of your greatness you do not associate with (other) divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वोरि॒त्था वां॑ छ॒र्दिषो॑ अ॒भिष्टौ॑ यु॒वोर्मि॑त्रावरुणा॒वस्कृ॑धोयु । अनु॒ यद्गाव॑: स्फु॒रानृ॑जि॒प्यं धृ॒ष्णुं यद्रणे॒ वृष॑णं यु॒नज॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: avóḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ vām ǀ chardíṣaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ áskṛdhoyu ǀánu ǀ yát ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sphurā́n ǀ ṛjipyám ǀ dhṛṣṇúm ǀ yát ǀ ráṇe ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ yunájan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon your approach,MitraandVaruṇa, protectors of the dwelling, your (bounty) is unlimited; when (your) praises are uttered, and the sacrificers add in the ceremony theSomathat inspires straightforwardness and resoluion, and is the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒ष्टी वां॑ य॒ज्ञ उद्य॑तः स॒जोषा॑ मनु॒ष्वद्वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषो॒ यज॑ध्यै । आ य इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णावि॒षे अ॒द्य म॒हे सु॒म्नाय॑ म॒ह आ॑व॒वर्त॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: śruṣṭī́ ǀ vām ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ út-yataḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ manuṣvát ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ yájadhyai ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ índrāváruṇau ǀ iṣé ǀ adyá ǀ mahé ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ mahé ǀ ā-vavártat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyIndraandVaruṇa, promptly has theSomareturned, engaged conscientiously (with the priests) to offer sacrifice to you to obtain food for him by whom, likeManu, the sacred grass has been clipped; he who (invited you hither) today for exceeding happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि श्रेष्ठा॑ दे॒वता॑ता तु॒जा शूरा॑णां॒ शवि॑ष्ठा॒ ता हि भू॒तम् । म॒घोनां॒ मंहि॑ष्ठा तुवि॒शुष्म॑ ऋ॒तेन॑ वृत्र॒तुरा॒ सर्व॑सेना
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ śréṣṭhā ǀ devá-tātā ǀ tujā́ ǀ śū́rāṇām ǀ śáviṣṭhā ǀ tā́ ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀmaghónām ǀ máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ tuvi-śúṣmā ǀ ṛténa ǀ vṛtra-túrā ǀ sárva-senā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two are the principal (divinities) at the worship of the gods; the distributors of wealth; the most vigorous of heroes; the most liberal among the opulent; possessed of vast strength; destroyers of foes by truth; entire hosts (of yourselves).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता गृ॑णीहि नम॒स्ये॑भिः शू॒षैः सु॒म्नेभि॒रिन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा चका॒ना । वज्रे॑णा॒न्यः शव॑सा॒ हन्ति॑ वृ॒त्रं सिष॑क्त्य॒न्यो वृ॒जने॑षु॒ विप्र॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ namasyébhiḥ ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ índrāváruṇā ǀ cakānā́ ǀvájreṇa ǀ anyáḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ sísakti ǀ anyáḥ ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ vípraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PraiseMitraandVaruṇa, renowned or all glorious energies and enjoyment; one of whom slaysVṛtrawith the thunderbolt, the other, intelligent by his might, comes to the aid (of the pious when) in difficulties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्नाश्च॒ यन्नर॑श्च वावृ॒धन्त॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ न॒रां स्वगू॑र्ताः । प्रैभ्य॑ इन्द्रावरुणा महि॒त्वा द्यौश्च॑ पृथिवि भूतमु॒र्वी
shlokas.transliteration: gnā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ náraḥ ǀ ca ǀ vavṛdhánta ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ svá-gūrtāḥ ǀprá ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ pṛthivi ǀ bhūtam ǀ urvī́ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When among mankind, bothmalesand feminine les, and when all the gods spontaneously striving glorify you,IndraandVaruṇa, you become pre-eminent in greatness over them, as do you, wide heaven and earth (surpass them also).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इत्सु॒दानु॒: स्ववाँ॑ ऋ॒तावेन्द्रा॒ यो वां॑ वरुण॒ दाश॑ति॒ त्मन् । इ॒षा स द्वि॒षस्त॑रे॒द्दास्वा॒न्वंस॑द्र॒यिं र॑यि॒वत॑श्च॒ जना॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀ svá-vān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ índrā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ varuṇā ǀ dā́śati ǀ tmán ǀiṣā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ taret ǀ dā́svān ǀ váṃsat ǀ rayím ǀ rayi-vátaḥ ǀ ca ǀ jánān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who spontaneously presents you,IndraandVaruṇa(oblations), is liberal, wealthy and upright; he has to prosper with the food of his adversary, and possess riches, and opulent descendants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं यु॒वं दा॒श्व॑ध्वराय देवा र॒यिं ध॒त्थो वसु॑मन्तं पुरु॒क्षुम् । अ॒स्मे स इ॑न्द्रावरुणा॒वपि॑ ष्या॒त्प्र यो भ॒नक्ति॑ व॒नुषा॒मश॑स्तीः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ yuvám ǀ dāśú-adhvarāya ǀ devā ǀ rayím ǀ dhattháḥ ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀasmé íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇau ǀ ápi ǀ syāt ǀ prá ǀ yáḥ ǀ bhanákti ǀ vanúṣām ǀ áśastīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that opulence comprising treasure and abundant food, which you besow, deities, upon the donor (of the oblation), that,IndraandVaruṇa, which baffles the calumnies of the malevolent, be ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑: सुत्रा॒त्रो दे॒वगो॑पाः सू॒रिभ्य॑ इन्द्रावरुणा र॒यिः ष्या॑त् । येषां॒ शुष्म॒: पृत॑नासु सा॒ह्वान्प्र स॒द्यो द्यु॒म्ना ति॒रते॒ ततु॑रिः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ su-trātráḥ ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ rayíḥ ǀ syāt ǀyéṣām ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sahvā́n ǀ prá ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ tiráte ǀ táturiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that opulence,IndraandVaruṇa, which is a sure defence, and of which the gods are the guardians, be ours, celebrating our praise, whose destroying prowess in battles victorious (over foes) speedily obscures (their) fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू न॑ इन्द्रावरुणा गृणा॒ना पृ॒ङ्क्तं र॒यिं सौ॑श्रव॒साय॑ देवा । इ॒त्था गृ॒णन्तो॑ म॒हिन॑स्य॒ शर्धो॒ऽपो न ना॒वा दु॑रि॒ता त॑रेम
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ pṛṅktám ǀ rayím ǀ sauśravasā́ya ǀ devā ǀitthā́ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ mahínasya ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ nāvā́ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine and glorifiedIndraandVaruṇa, quickly bestow upon us wealth for our felicity; and thus eulogising he strength of you two, mighty (deities), may we pass over all difficulties as (we cross) the waters with a boat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒म्राजे॑ बृह॒ते मन्म॒ नु प्रि॒यमर्च॑ दे॒वाय॒ वरु॑णाय स॒प्रथ॑: । अ॒यं य उ॒र्वी म॑हि॒ना महि॑व्रत॒: क्रत्वा॑ वि॒भात्य॒जरो॒ न शो॒चिषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sam-rā́je ǀ bṛhaté ǀ mánma ǀ nú ǀ priyám ǀ árca ǀ devā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ mahinā́ ǀ máhi-vrataḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ ná ǀ śocíṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeat acceptable and all-comprehensive praise to the imperial mighty divineVaruṇa, he who, endowed with greatness, with wisdom, and with splendour, illumines the spacious (heaven and earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा सुतपावि॒मं सु॒तं सोमं॑ पिबतं॒ मद्यं॑ धृतव्रता । यु॒वो रथो॑ अध्व॒रं दे॒ववी॑तये॒ प्रति॒ स्वस॑र॒मुप॑ याति पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ suta-pau ǀ imám ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ mádyam ǀ dhṛta-vratā ǀyuvóḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ práti ǀ svásaram ǀ úpa ǀ yāti ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, observant of holy duties, drinkers of theSoma, drink this exhilarating effused libation; your chariot approaches along the road to the sacrifice, (that you may partake) of the food of the gods and drink (the Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ मधु॑मत्तमस्य॒ वृष्ण॒: सोम॑स्य वृष॒णा वृ॑षेथाम् । इ॒दं वा॒मन्ध॒: परि॑षिक्तम॒स्मे आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ mádhumat-tamasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣethām ǀidám ǀ vām ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ pári-siktam ǀ asmé íti ǀ ā-sádya ǀ asmín ǀ barhíṣi ǀ mādayethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,IndraandVaruṇa, showerers (of benefits), of the most sweetSoma, the shedder (of blessings); this your Soma, is poured forth by us; sitting on the sacred grass, be exhilarated (by the draught).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं वां॒ कर्म॑णा॒ समि॒षा हि॑नो॒मीन्द्रा॑विष्णू॒ अप॑सस्पा॒रे अ॒स्य । जु॒षेथां॑ य॒ज्ञं द्रवि॑णं च धत्त॒मरि॑ष्टैर्नः प॒थिभि॑: पा॒रय॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ vām ǀ kármaṇā ǀ sám ǀ iṣā́ ǀ hinomi ǀ índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ ápasaḥ ǀ pāré ǀ asyá ǀjuṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀ áriṣṭaiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ pāráyantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I earnestly propitiate you,IndraandViṣṇu, by worship and (sacrificial) food; upon the completion of the ite, accept the sacrifice, and grant us wealth, conducting us by safe path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या विश्वा॑सां जनि॒तारा॑ मती॒नामिन्द्रा॒विष्णू॑ क॒लशा॑ सोम॒धाना॑ । प्र वां॒ गिर॑: श॒स्यमा॑ना अवन्तु॒ प्र स्तोमा॑सो गी॒यमा॑नासो अ॒र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ víśvāsām ǀ janitā́rā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ índrāvíṣṇū íti ǀ kaláśā ǀ soma-dhā́nā ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śasyámānāḥ ǀ avantu ǀ prá ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ gīyámānāsaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the prayers that are prepared to you reach you,IndraandViṣṇu; may the praises that are chanted reach you; you are the genitive rators of all praisses, pitchers recipient of theSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑विष्णू मदपती मदाना॒मा सोमं॑ यातं॒ द्रवि॑णो॒ दधा॑ना । सं वा॑मञ्जन्त्व॒क्तुभि॑र्मती॒नां सं स्तोमा॑सः श॒स्यमा॑नास उ॒क्थैः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ madapatī íti mada-patī ǀ madānām ǀ ā́ ǀ sómam ǀ yātam ǀ dráviṇo íti ǀ dádhānā ǀsám ǀ vām ǀ añjantu ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ sám ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ śasyámānāsaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, lords of the exhilaration, of the exhilaratingSoma, come to (drink) the Soma, bringing (with you) wealth; may the encomiums of the praises repeated along with the prayers anoint you completely with radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॒मश्वा॑सो अभिमाति॒षाह॒ इन्द्रा॑विष्णू सध॒मादो॑ वहन्तु । जु॒षेथां॒ विश्वा॒ हव॑ना मती॒नामुप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि शृणुतं॒ गिरो॑ मे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ abhimāti-sáhaḥ ǀ índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ vahantu ǀjuṣéthām ǀ víśvā ǀ hávanā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ gíraḥ ǀ me ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your equaly-spirited steeds,IndraandViṣṇu, the triumphant over enemies, bear you hither, be plural ased with all the invocations of your worshippers; hear my prayers and praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑विष्णू॒ तत्प॑न॒याय्यं॑ वां॒ सोम॑स्य॒ मद॑ उ॒रु च॑क्रमाथे । अकृ॑णुतम॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ वरी॒योऽप्र॑थतं जी॒वसे॑ नो॒ रजां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ tát ǀ panayā́yyam ǀ vām ǀ sómasya ǀ máde ǀ urú ǀ cakramāthe íti ǀákṛṇutam ǀ antárikṣam ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ áprathatam ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, that (exploit) is to be glorified, by which, in the exhilaration of theSoma, you have strode over the wide (space); you have traversed the wide firmament; you have declared the worlds (fit) for our existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑विष्णू ह॒विषा॑ वावृधा॒नाग्रा॑द्वाना॒ नम॑सा रातहव्या । घृता॑सुती॒ द्रवि॑णं धत्तम॒स्मे स॑मु॒द्रः स्थ॑: क॒लश॑: सोम॒धान॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ havíṣā ǀ vavṛdhānā́ ǀ ágra-advānā ǀ námasā ǀ rāta-havyā ǀghṛ́tāsutī íti ghṛ́ta-āsutī ǀ dráviṇam ǀ dhattam ǀ asmé íti ǀ samudráḥ ǀ sthaḥ ǀ kaláśaḥ ǀ soma-dhā́naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, feeders upon clarified butter, drinkers of he fermentedSoma, thriving upon oblations, accepting them offered with reverence, bestow upon us wealth; for you are an ocean, a pitcher, the receptacle of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑विष्णू॒ पिब॑तं॒ मध्वो॑ अ॒स्य सोम॑स्य दस्रा ज॒ठरं॑ पृणेथाम् । आ वा॒मन्धां॑सि मदि॒राण्य॑ग्म॒न्नुप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि शृणुतं॒ हवं॑ मे
shlokas.transliteration: índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ píbatam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ asyá ǀ sómasya ǀ dasrā ǀ jaṭháram ǀ pṛṇethām ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ madirā́ṇi ǀ agman ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀ me ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, agreeable of aspect, drink of this sweetSoma; fill with it your bellies; may the inebriating Soma reach you; hear my prayers, my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा जि॑ग्यथु॒र्न परा॑ जयेथे॒ न परा॑ जिग्ये कत॒रश्च॒नैनो॑: । इन्द्र॑श्च विष्णो॒ यदप॑स्पृधेथां त्रे॒धा स॒हस्रं॒ वि तदै॑रयेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ jigyathuḥ ǀ ná ǀ párā ǀ jayethe íti ǀ ná ǀ párā ǀ jigye ǀ kataráḥ ǀ caná ǀ enoḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ ca ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ yát ǀ ápaspṛdhethām ǀ tredhā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ ví ǀ tát ǀ airayethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have both (ever) been victorious; never have been conquered; neither of you two has been vanquished; with whomsoever you have contended you have thrice conquered thousands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तव॑ती॒ भुव॑नानामभि॒श्रियो॒र्वी पृ॒थ्वी म॑धु॒दुघे॑ सु॒पेश॑सा । द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा॒ विष्क॑भिते अ॒जरे॒ भूरि॑रेतसा
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtávatī íti ghṛtá-vatī ǀ bhúvanānām ǀ abhi-śríyā ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ pṛthvī́ íti ǀ madhudúghe íti madhu-dúghe ǀ su-péśasā ǀdyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ vískabhite íti ví-skabhite ǀ ajáre íti ǀ bhū́ri-retasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant Heaven and Earth, the asylum of created beings, you are spacious, manifold, water-yielding, lovely, separately fixed by the functions ofVaruṇa, undecaying, many-germed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑श्चन्ती॒ भूरि॑धारे॒ पय॑स्वती घृ॒तं दु॑हाते सु॒कृते॒ शुचि॑व्रते । राज॑न्ती अ॒स्य भुव॑नस्य रोदसी अ॒स्मे रेत॑: सिञ्चतं॒ यन्मनु॑र्हितम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásaścantī íti ǀ bhū́ridhāre íti bhū́ri-dhāre ǀ páyasvatī íti ǀ ghṛtám ǀ duhāte íti ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ śúcivrate íti śúci-vrate ǀrā́jantī íti ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rodasī íti ǀ asmé íti ǀ rétaḥ ǀ siñcatam ǀ yát ǀ mánuḥ-hitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uncollapsing, many-showering, water retaining, yielding moisture, beneficent, pure in act; do you two, Heaven and Earth, rulers over created beings, grant us vigour, that may be favourable to (the increase of) mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वा॑मृ॒जवे॒ क्रम॑णाय रोदसी॒ मर्तो॑ द॒दाश॑ धिषणे॒ स सा॑धति । प्र प्र॒जाभि॑र्जायते॒ धर्म॑ण॒स्परि॑ यु॒वोः सि॒क्ता विषु॑रूपाणि॒ सव्र॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ṛjáve ǀ krámaṇāya ǀ rodasī íti ǀ mártaḥ ǀ dadā́śa ǀ dhiṣaṇe íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ sādhati ǀprá ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ siktā́ ǀ víṣu-rūpāṇi ǀ sá-vratā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Firm-set Heaven and Earth, the mortal who has offered (oblations) for your straight-forward course, accomplishes (his objects), he prospers with progeny, and invigorated by your operation, many beings of various forms, but similar functions, are engendeed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तेन॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒भीवृ॑ते घृत॒श्रिया॑ घृत॒पृचा॑ घृता॒वृधा॑ । उ॒र्वी पृ॒थ्वी हो॑तृ॒वूर्ये॑ पु॒रोहि॑ते॒ ते इद्विप्रा॑ ईळते सु॒म्नमि॒ष्टये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛténa ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ abhī́vṛte ítyabhí-vṛte ǀ ghṛta-śríyā ǀ ghṛta-pṛ́cā ǀ ghṛta-vṛ́dhā ǀurvī́ íti ǀ pṛthvī́ íti ǀ hotṛ-vū́rye ǀ puróhite íti puráḥ-hite ǀ té íti ǀ ít ǀ víprāḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ sumnám ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are surrounded, Heaven and Earth, by water; you are the asylum of water; imbued with water; the augmenters of water; vast and manifold; you are first propitiated in the sacrifice; the pious pray to you for happiness, that the sacrifice (may be celebrated).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑ नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी मि॑मिक्षतां मधु॒श्चुता॑ मधु॒दुघे॒ मधु॑व्रते । दधा॑ने य॒ज्ञं द्रवि॑णं च दे॒वता॒ महि॒ श्रवो॒ वाज॑म॒स्मे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu ǀ naḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ mimikṣatām ǀ madhu-ścútā ǀ madhudúghe íti madhu-dúghe ǀ mádhuvrate íti mádhu-vrate ǀdádhāne íti ǀ yajñám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ devátā ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Heaven and Earth, the effusers of water, the milkers of water, dischargers of the functions of water, divinities, the promoters of sacrifice, the bestowers of wealth, of renown, of food, ofmaleposterity, combine together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊर्जं॑ नो॒ द्यौश्च॑ पृथि॒वी च॑ पिन्वतां पि॒ता मा॒ता वि॑श्व॒विदा॑ सु॒दंस॑सा । सं॒र॒रा॒णे रोद॑सी वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवा स॒निं वाजं॑ र॒यिम॒स्मे समि॑न्वताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ca ǀ pinvatām ǀ pitā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ viśva-vídā ǀ su-dáṃsasā ǀsaṃrarāṇé íti sam-rarāṇé ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśvá-śambhuvā ǀ saním ǀ vā́jam ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ sám ǀ invatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May father Heaven, may mother Earth, who are all-knowing, and doers of good deeds, grant us sustenance; may Heaven and Earth, mutually co-operating and promoting the happiness of all, bestow upon us posterity, food, and riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता हि॑र॒ण्यया॑ बा॒हू अ॑यंस्त॒ सव॑नाय सु॒क्रतु॑: । घृ॒तेन॑ पा॒णी अ॒भि प्रु॑ष्णुते म॒खो युवा॑ सु॒दक्षो॒ रज॑सो॒ विध॑र्मणि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ ayaṃsta ǀ sávanāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀghṛténa ǀ pāṇī́ íti ǀ abhí ǀ pruṣṇute ǀ makháḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine and benevolentSavitāputs forth his golden arms for (making) donations; the adorable, youthful, sagacious (deity), stretches out hishands, filled with water, in the various services of the world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ व॒यं स॑वि॒तुः सवी॑मनि॒ श्रेष्ठे॑ स्याम॒ वसु॑नश्च दा॒वने॑ । यो विश्व॑स्य द्वि॒पदो॒ यश्चतु॑ष्पदो नि॒वेश॑ने प्रस॒वे चासि॒ भूम॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: devásya ǀ vayám ǀ savitúḥ ǀ sávīmani ǀ śréṣṭhe ǀ syāma ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāváne ǀyáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ dvi-pádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ cátuḥ-padaḥ ǀ ni-véśane ǀ pra-savé ǀ ca ǀ ási ǀ bhū́manaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be among the progeny of the divineSavitā, and (have power) to offer him most excellent donations; for you are he who (are absolute) in the procreation and perpetuation of many (living beings), bipeds and quadrupeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वं शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् । हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घशं॑स ईशत
shlokas.transliteration: ádabdhebhiḥ ǀ savitaríti ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ adyá ǀ pári ǀ pāhi ǀ naḥ ǀ gáyam ǀhíraṇya-jihvaḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ návyase ǀ rákṣa ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ īśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Savitā, posper today our dwelling with uninjurable protections, confirming happiness; do you, who are golden-tongued, (be vigilant) for our present prosperity; protect us; let not any calumniator have power (to harm) us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता दमू॑ना॒ हिर॑ण्यपाणिः प्रतिदो॒षम॑स्थात् । अयो॑हनुर्यज॒तो म॒न्द्रजि॑ह्व॒ आ दा॒शुषे॑ सुवति॒ भूरि॑ वा॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ híraṇya-pāṇiḥ ǀ prati-doṣám ǀ asthāt ǀáyaḥ-hanuḥ ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ mandrá-jihvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ suvati ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vāmám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine, munificent, golden-handed, golden-jawed, adorable, sweet-spokenSavitā, rise regularly at the close of night; when he besows abundant and desirable (food) upon the donor of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदू॑ अयाँ उपव॒क्तेव॑ बा॒हू हि॑र॒ण्यया॑ सवि॒ता सु॒प्रती॑का । दि॒वो रोहां॑स्यरुहत्पृथि॒व्या अरी॑रमत्प॒तय॒त्कच्चि॒दभ्व॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ayān ǀ upavaktā́-iva ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-prátīkā ǀdiváḥ ǀ róhāṃsi ǀ aruhat ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ árīramat ǀ patáyat ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ ábhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySavitāput forth like an orator his golden well-formed arms; (he who), from the ends of the earth, ascends to the summit of the sky, and, moving along, delights every thing that is.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒मम॒द्य स॑वितर्वा॒ममु॒ श्वो दि॒वेदि॑वे वा॒मम॒स्मभ्यं॑ सावीः । वा॒मस्य॒ हि क्षय॑स्य देव॒ भूरे॑र॒या धि॒या वा॑म॒भाज॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: vāmám ǀ adyá ǀ savitaḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śváḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ vāmám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sāvīḥ ǀvāmásya ǀ hí ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ deva ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ayā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ vāma-bhā́jaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beget for us,Savitā, wealth today, wealth tomorrow, wealth day by day; you are the giver of ample wealth, of a (spacious) mansion; may we, by this praise, become partakers of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा॒ महि॒ तद्वां॑ महि॒त्वं यु॒वं म॒हानि॑ प्रथ॒मानि॑ चक्रथुः । यु॒वं सूर्यं॑ विवि॒दथु॑र्यु॒वं स्व१॒॑र्विश्वा॒ तमां॑स्यहतं नि॒दश्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ máhi ǀ tát ǀ vām ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ yuvám ǀ mahā́ni ǀ prathamā́ni ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀyuvám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ vividáthuḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ sváḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ támāṃsi ǀ ahatam ǀ nidáḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great,IndraandSoma, is that your greatness, for you have made great and principal (beings); you have made known (to men)Sūryaand the waters; you have dissipated the glooms and (desroyed) the revilers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा वा॒सय॑थ उ॒षास॒मुत्सूर्यं॑ नयथो॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह । उप॒ द्यां स्क॒म्भथु॒: स्कम्भ॑ने॒नाप्र॑थतं पृथि॒वीं मा॒तरं॒ वि
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ vāsáyathaḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ út ǀ sū́ryam ǀ nayathaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sahá ǀúpa ǀ dyā́m ǀ skambháthuḥ ǀ skámbhanena ǀ áprathatam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mātáram ǀ ví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, you have led on the dawns; you have upraised the sun with his splendour, you have propped up the sky with he supporting pillar (of the firmament); you have spread out the earth, the mother (of all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा॒वहि॑म॒पः प॑रि॒ष्ठां ह॒थो वृ॒त्रमनु॑ वां॒ द्यौर॑मन्यत । प्रार्णां॑स्यैरयतं न॒दीना॒मा स॑मु॒द्राणि॑ पप्रथुः पु॒रूणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomau ǀ áhim ǀ apáḥ ǀ pari-sthā́m ǀ hatháḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ánu ǀ vām ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ amanyata ǀprá ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ airayatam ǀ nadī́nām ǀ ā́ ǀ samudrā́ṇi ǀ paprathuḥ ǀ purū́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, you slew Ahi andVṛtra; the obstructer of the water; for which the heaven venerates you both; you have urged on the waters of the rivers until they have replenished numerous oceans.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा प॒क्वमा॒मास्व॒न्तर्नि गवा॒मिद्द॑धथुर्व॒क्षणा॑सु । ज॒गृ॒भथु॒रन॑पिनद्धमासु॒ रुश॑च्चि॒त्रासु॒ जग॑तीष्व॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ pakvám ǀ āmā́su ǀ antáḥ ǀ ní ǀ gávām ǀ ít ǀ dadhathuḥ ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀjagṛbháthuḥ ǀ ánapi-naddham ǀ āsu ǀ rúśat ǀ citrā́su ǀ jágatīṣu ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, you have deposited the mature (milk) in the immature udders of the kine; you have retained the white (secretion), although notshutup within those may-coloured cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा यु॒वम॒ङ्ग तरु॑त्रमपत्य॒साचं॒ श्रुत्यं॑ रराथे । यु॒वं शुष्मं॒ नर्यं॑ चर्ष॒णिभ्य॒: सं वि॑व्यथुः पृतना॒षाह॑मुग्रा
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ yuvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ tárutram ǀ apatya-sā́cam ǀ śrútyam ǀ rarāthe íti ǀyuvám ǀ śúṣmam ǀ náryam ǀ carṣaṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ vivyathuḥ ǀ pṛtanā-sáham ǀ ugrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, do you promptly bestow upon us preservative, renowned (riches), accompanied by offspring; for you, fierce (divinities), have disseminated among men, strength, useful to man, victorious over hostile acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑द्रि॒भित्प्र॑थम॒जा ऋ॒तावा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑राङ्गिर॒सो ह॒विष्मा॑न् । द्वि॒बर्ह॑ज्मा प्राघर्म॒सत्पि॒ता न॒ आ रोद॑सी वृष॒भो रो॑रवीति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ adri-bhít ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ āṅgirasáḥ ǀ havíṣmān ǀdvibárha-jmā ǀ prāgharma-sát ǀ pitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ roravīti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, who is the breaker of the mountain, the first-born (ofPrajāpati), the observer of truth, the descendant ofAṅgirasa, the partaker of the oblation, the traverser of two worlds, abiding in the region of light, is to us a father; he, the showerer, hunders and in heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जना॑य चि॒द्य ईव॑त उ लो॒कं बृह॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वहू॑तौ च॒कार॑ । घ्नन्वृ॒त्राणि॒ वि पुरो॑ दर्दरीति॒ जय॒ञ्छत्रूँ॑र॒मित्रा॑न्पृ॒त्सु साह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: jánāya ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́vate ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ devá-hūtau ǀ cakā́ra ǀghnán ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ví ǀ púraḥ ǀ dardarīti ǀ jáyan ǀ śátrūn ǀ amítrān ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ sáhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bṛhaspati, who has appointed a region for the man who attends diligently at divine worship, destroying impediments, conquering foes, overcoming enemies, demolished various cities (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पति॒: सम॑जय॒द्वसू॑नि म॒हो व्र॒जान्गोम॑तो दे॒व ए॒षः । अ॒पः सिषा॑स॒न्त्स्व१॒॑रप्र॑तीतो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒र्हन्त्य॒मित्र॑म॒र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajayat ǀ vásūni ǀ maháḥ ǀ vrajā́n ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ sísāsan ǀ sváḥ ǀ áprati-itaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ hánti ǀ amítram ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisBṛhaspatihas conquered the treasures (of the enemy), and the spacious pastures with the cattle; purposing to appropriate he waters (of the firmament), he destroys with sacred prayers the adversary of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑रुद्रा धा॒रये॑थामसु॒र्यं१॒॑ प्र वा॑मि॒ष्टयोऽर॑मश्नुवन्तु । दमे॑दमे स॒प्त रत्ना॒ दधा॑ना॒ शं नो॑ भूतं द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे
shlokas.transliteration: sómārudrā ǀ dhāráyethām ǀ asuryám ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ iṣṭáyaḥ ǀ áram ǀ aśnuvantu ǀdáme-dame ǀ saptá ǀ rátnā ǀ dádhānā ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtam ǀ dvi-páde ǀ śám ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaandRudra, confirm (in us the strength) ofasurasmay sacrifices in every dwelling adequately reach you; do you, possessors of the seven precious things, besow happiness upon us; happiness upon our bipeds and quadrupeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑रुद्रा॒ वि वृ॑हतं॒ विषू॑ची॒ममी॑वा॒ या नो॒ गय॑मावि॒वेश॑ । आ॒रे बा॑धेथां॒ निॠ॑तिं परा॒चैर॒स्मे भ॒द्रा सौ॑श्रव॒सानि॑ सन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sómārudrā ǀ ví ǀ vṛhatam ǀ víṣūcīm ǀ ámīvā ǀ yā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ ā-vivéśa ǀāré ǀ bādhethām ǀ níḥ-ṛtim ǀ parācáiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ sauśravasā́ni ǀ santu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaandRudra, expel the widespread sickness that has entered into our dwellings; keep offNirṛti, so that she may be far away, and may prosperous means of sustenance be ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑रुद्रा यु॒वमे॒तान्य॒स्मे विश्वा॑ त॒नूषु॑ भेष॒जानि॑ धत्तम् । अव॑ स्यतं मु॒ञ्चतं॒ यन्नो॒ अस्ति॑ त॒नूषु॑ ब॒द्धं कृ॒तमेनो॑ अ॒स्मत्
shlokas.transliteration: sómārudrā ǀ yuvám ǀ etā́ni ǀ asmé íti ǀ víśvā ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ bheṣajā́ni ǀ dhattam ǀáva ǀ syatam ǀ muñcátam ǀ yát ǀ naḥ ǀ ásti ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ baddhám ǀ kṛtám ǀ énaḥ ǀ asmát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaandRudra, grant all these medicamens for (the ailments of) our bodies; detach, set free, the perpetrated iniquity that has been bound up in our person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒ग्मायु॑धौ ति॒ग्महे॑ती सु॒शेवौ॒ सोमा॑रुद्रावि॒ह सु मृ॑ळतं नः । प्र नो॑ मुञ्चतं॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशा॑द्गोपा॒यतं॑ नः सुमन॒स्यमा॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: tigmá-āyudhau ǀ tigmáhetī íti tigmá-hetī ǀ su-śévau ǀ sómārudrau ǀ ihá ǀ sú ǀ mṛḷatam ǀ naḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ muñcatam ǀ váruṇasya ǀ pā́śāt ǀ gopāyátam ǀ naḥ ǀ su-manasyámānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sharp-weaponed, sharp-arrowed,  profoundly-honouredSomaandRudra, grant us happiness in this world; propitiated by our praise, preserve us; liberate us from the bonds ofVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जी॒मूत॑स्येव भवति॒ प्रती॑कं॒ यद्व॒र्मी याति॑ स॒मदा॑मु॒पस्थे॑ । अना॑विद्धया त॒न्वा॑ जय॒ त्वं स त्वा॒ वर्म॑णो महि॒मा पि॑पर्तु
shlokas.transliteration: jīmū́tasya-iva ǀ bhavati ǀ prátīkam ǀ yát ǀ varmī́ ǀ yā́ti ǀ sa-mádām ǀ upá-sthe ǀánāviddhayā ǀ tanvā́ ǀ jaya ǀ tvám ǀ sáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vármaṇaḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ pipartu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the mailed warrior advances in the front of battles, his form is like that of a cloud; with his body unwounded do you conquer; may the strength of the armous defend us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धन्व॑ना॒ गा धन्व॑ना॒जिं ज॑येम॒ धन्व॑ना ती॒व्राः स॒मदो॑ जयेम । धनु॒: शत्रो॑रपका॒मं कृ॑णोति॒ धन्व॑ना॒ सर्वा॑: प्र॒दिशो॑ जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: dhánvanā ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ dhánvanā ǀ ājím ǀ jayema ǀ dhánvanā ǀ tīvrā́ḥ ǀ sa-mádaḥ ǀ jayema ǀdhánuḥ ǀ śátroḥ ǀ apa-kāmám ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ dhánvanā ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we conquer the cattle (of the enemies) with the bow; with the bow may we be victorious in battle may we overcome our fierce-exulting (enemies) with the bow; may the bow disappoint the hope of the foe; may we subdue with the bow all (hostile) countries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒क्ष्यन्ती॒वेदा ग॑नीगन्ति॒ कर्णं॑ प्रि॒यं सखा॑यं परिषस्वजा॒ना । योषे॑व शिङ्क्ते॒ वित॒ताधि॒ धन्व॒ञ्ज्या इ॒यं सम॑ने पा॒रय॑न्ती
shlokas.transliteration: vakṣyántī-iva ǀ ít ǀ ā́ ǀ ganīganti ǀ kárṇam ǀ priyám ǀ sákhāyam ǀ pari-sasvajānā́ ǀyóṣā-iva ǀ śiṅkte ǀ ví-tatā ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánvan ǀ jyā́ ǀ iyám ǀ sámane ǀ pāráyantī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This bowstring, drawn tight upon the bow, and making way in battle, repeatedly approaches the ear (of the warrior), as if embracing its friend (the arrow), and proposing to say something agreeable, as a woman whispers (to her husband).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते आ॒चर॑न्ती॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषा॑ मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं बि॑भृतामु॒पस्थे॑ । अप॒ शत्रू॑न्विध्यतां संविदा॒ने आर्त्नी॑ इ॒मे वि॑ष्फु॒रन्ती॑ अ॒मित्रा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: té íti ǀ ācárantī ítyā-cárantī ǀ sámanā-iva ǀ yóṣā ǀ mātā́-iva ǀ putrám ǀ bibhṛtām ǀ upá-sthe ǀápa ǀ śátrūn ǀ vidhyatām ǀ saṃvidāné íti sam-vidāné ǀ ārtnī́ íti ǀ imé íti ǀ visphurántī íti vi-sphurántī ǀ amítrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two extremities of the bow, acting in concert, like a wife sympathizing (with her husband), uphold (the warrior), as a mother nurses her child upon her lap; and may they, moving concurrently, and harassing the foe, scatter his enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒ह्वी॒नां पि॒ता ब॒हुर॑स्य पु॒त्रश्चि॒श्चा कृ॑णोति॒ सम॑नाव॒गत्य॑ । इ॒षु॒धिः सङ्का॒: पृत॑नाश्च॒ सर्वा॑: पृ॒ष्ठे निन॑द्धो जयति॒ प्रसू॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: bahvīnā́m ǀ pitā́ ǀ bahúḥ ǀ asyá ǀ putráḥ ǀ ciścā́ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ sámanā ǀ ava-gátya ǀiṣu-dhíḥ ǀ sáṅkāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ ca ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀ ní-naddhaḥ ǀ jayati ǀ prá-sūtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The quiver, the parent of many, of whom many are the sons, clangs as it enters into the battle; slung at the back (of the warrior), prolific (of its shafts), it overcomes all shouting hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथे॒ तिष्ठ॑न्नयति वा॒जिन॑: पु॒रो यत्र॑यत्र का॒मय॑ते सुषार॒थिः । अ॒भीशू॑नां महि॒मानं॑ पनायत॒ मन॑: प॒श्चादनु॑ यच्छन्ति र॒श्मय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ráthe ǀ tíṣṭhan ǀ nayati ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ yátra-yatra ǀ kāmáyate ǀ su-sārathíḥ ǀabhī́śūnām ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ panāyata ǀ mánaḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ ánu ǀ yacchanti ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The skilful charioteer, standing in the car, derives his horses before him whatsoever he will; praise the efficacy of the reins, for the reins from the back (of the car compel the steeds) to follow the intention (of the driver).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ती॒व्रान्घोषा॑न्कृण्वते॒ वृष॑पाण॒योऽश्वा॒ रथे॑भिः स॒ह वा॒जय॑न्तः । अ॒व॒क्राम॑न्त॒: प्रप॑दैर॒मित्रा॑न्क्षि॒णन्ति॒ शत्रूँ॒रन॑पव्ययन्तः
shlokas.transliteration: tīvrā́n ǀ ghóṣān ǀ kṛṇvate ǀ vṛ́ṣa-pāṇayaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǀava-krā́mantaḥ ǀ prá-padaiḥ ǀ amítrān ǀ kṣiṇánti ǀ śátrūn ǀ ánapa-vyayantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The horses raising the dust with their hoofs, rushing on with the chariots, utter loud neighings, retreating not (from the charge), but trampling with their fore feet upon the enemies, they destroy them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒थ॒वाह॑नं ह॒विर॑स्य॒ नाम॒ यत्रायु॑धं॒ निहि॑तमस्य॒ वर्म॑ । तत्रा॒ रथ॒मुप॑ श॒ग्मं स॑देम वि॒श्वाहा॑ व॒यं सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ratha-vā́hanam ǀ havíḥ ǀ asya ǀ nā́ma ǀ yátra ǀ ā́yudham ǀ ní-hitam ǀ asya ǀ várma ǀtátra ǀ rátham ǀ úpa ǀ śagmám ǀ sadema ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ vayám ǀ su-manasyámānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The spoil borne off in his car, in which his weapons and armour are deposited, is the appropriate oblation of the warrior; therefore let us, exulting, daily do honour to the joy-bestowing car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दु॒षं॒सद॑: पि॒तरो॑ वयो॒धाः कृ॑च्छ्रे॒श्रित॒: शक्ती॑वन्तो गभी॒राः । चि॒त्रसे॑ना॒ इषु॑बला॒ अमृ॑ध्राः स॒तोवी॑रा उ॒रवो॑ व्रातसा॒हाः
shlokas.transliteration: svādu-saṃsádaḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ kṛcchre-śrítaḥ ǀ śákti-vantaḥ ǀ gabhīrā́ḥ ǀcitrá-senāḥ ǀ íṣu-balāḥ ǀ ámṛdhrāḥ ǀ satáḥ-vīrāḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ vrāta-sahā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The guards (of chariot), revelling in the savoury (spoil), distributors of food, protecors in calamity, armed with spears, resolute, beautifully arranged, strong in arrows, invincible, of heroic valour, robust, and conquerors of numerous hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्राह्म॑णास॒: पित॑र॒: सोम्या॑सः शि॒वे नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑ने॒हसा॑ । पू॒षा न॑: पातु दुरि॒तादृ॑तावृधो॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घशं॑स ईशत
shlokas.transliteration: brā́hmaṇāsaḥ ǀ pítaraḥ ǀ sómyāsaḥ ǀ śivé íti ǀ naḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ anehásā ǀpūṣā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pātu ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ ṛta-vṛdhaḥ ǀ rákṣa ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ aghá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ īśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thebrāhmaṇas, the progenitors presenters of theSoma, the observers of truth, protect us; may the faultless heaven and earth be propitious to us; mayPūṣanpreserve us from misfortune, let no calumniator prevail over us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प॒र्णं व॑स्ते मृ॒गो अ॑स्या॒ दन्तो॒ गोभि॒: संन॑द्धा पतति॒ प्रसू॑ता । यत्रा॒ नर॒: सं च॒ वि च॒ द्रव॑न्ति॒ तत्रा॒स्मभ्य॒मिष॑व॒: शर्म॑ यंसन्
shlokas.transliteration: su-parṇám ǀ vaste ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǀ dántaḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ sám-naddhā ǀ patati ǀ prá-sūtā ǀyátra ǀ náraḥ ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ drávanti ǀ tátra ǀ asmábhyam ǀ íṣavaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The arrow puts on a (feathery) wing; the (horn of the) deer is its point; it is bound with the sinews of the cow; it alights where directed; whenever men assemble or disperse, there may the shafts fall for an advantage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋजी॑ते॒ परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ नोऽश्मा॑ भवतु नस्त॒नूः । सोमो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवीतु॒ नोऽदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतु
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́jīte ǀ pári ǀ vṛṅdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ áśmā ǀ bhavatu ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ bravītu ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Straight-flying (arrow), defend us; may our bodies be stone; maySomaspeak to us encouragement; mayAditigrant us success.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ज॑ङ्घन्ति॒ सान्वे॑षां ज॒घनाँ॒ उप॑ जिघ्नते । अश्वा॑जनि॒ प्रचे॑त॒सोऽश्वा॑न्त्स॒मत्सु॑ चोदय
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jaṅghanti ǀ sā́nu ǀ eṣām ǀ jaghánān ǀ úpa ǀ jighnate ǀáśva-ajani ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ áśvān ǀ samát-su ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whip, with which the skilful (charioteers) last their thighs and scourge their flanks, urge the horses in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहि॑रिव भो॒गैः पर्ये॑ति बा॒हुं ज्याया॑ हे॒तिं प॑रि॒बाध॑मानः । ह॒स्त॒घ्नो विश्वा॑ व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान्पुमा॒न्पुमां॑सं॒ परि॑ पातु वि॒श्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áhiḥ-iva ǀ bhogáiḥ ǀ pári ǀ eti ǀ bāhúm ǀ jyā́yāḥ ǀ hetím ǀ pari-bā́dhamānaḥ ǀhasta-ghnáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ púmān ǀ púmāṃsam ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ward of the fore-arm protecting it from the abrasion of the bow-string, surrounds the arm like a snake with its convulutions; may the brave man, experienced in the arts of war, defend a combatant on every side.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आला॑क्ता॒ या रुरु॑शी॒र्ष्ण्यथो॒ यस्या॒ अयो॒ मुख॑म् । इ॒दं प॒र्जन्य॑रेतस॒ इष्वै॑ दे॒व्यै बृ॒हन्नम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́la-aktā ǀ yā́ ǀ rúru-śīrṣṇī ǀ átho íti ǀ yásyāḥ ǀ áyaḥ ǀ múkham ǀidám ǀ parjánya-retase ǀ íṣvai ǀ devyái ǀ bṛhát ǀ námaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise (be offered) to the large celestial arrow, the growth ofParjanya, whose point is anointed with venom, whose blade is iron.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑सृष्टा॒ परा॑ पत॒ शर॑व्ये॒ ब्रह्म॑संशिते । गच्छा॒मित्रा॒न्प्र प॑द्यस्व॒ मामीषां॒ कं च॒नोच्छि॑षः
shlokas.transliteration: áva-sṛṣṭā ǀ párā ǀ pata ǀ śáravye ǀ bráhma-saṃśite ǀgáccha ǀ amítrān ǀ prá ǀ padyasva ǀ mā́ ǀ amī́ṣām ǀ kám ǀ caná ǀ út ǀ śiṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arrow, wheted by charms, fly when discharged; go light among the adversaries, spare not one of the enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॑ बा॒णाः स॒म्पत॑न्ति कुमा॒रा वि॑शि॒खा इ॑व । तत्रा॑ नो॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒रदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतु वि॒श्वाहा॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ bāṇā́ḥ ǀ sam-pátanti ǀ kumārā́ḥ ǀ viśikhā́ḥ-iva ǀtátra ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where arrows alight like shaven-headed boys maybrahmaṇaspati, mayAditi, grant us happiness every day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मर्मा॑णि ते॒ वर्म॑णा छादयामि॒ सोम॑स्त्वा॒ राजा॒मृते॒नानु॑ वस्ताम् । उ॒रोर्वरी॑यो॒ वरु॑णस्ते कृणोतु॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वानु॑ दे॒वा म॑दन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: mármāṇi ǀ te ǀ vármaṇā ǀ chādayāmi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ rā́jā ǀ amṛ́tena ǀ ánu ǀ vastām ǀuróḥ ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ te ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ jáyantam ǀ tvā ǀ ánu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ madantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I cover your vital parts with armour; may the royalSomainvest you with ambrosia; mayVaruṇaamplify your ample felicity; may the gods rejoice (at beholding you) triumphant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॒: स्वो अर॑णो॒ यश्च॒ निष्ट्यो॒ जिघां॑सति । दे॒वास्तं सर्वे॑ धूर्वन्तु॒ ब्रह्म॒ वर्म॒ ममान्त॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ áraṇaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ níṣṭyaḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ tám ǀ sárve ǀ dhūrvantu ǀ bráhma ǀ várma ǀ máma ǀ ántaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whoever, whether an unfriendly relative or a stranger, desires to kill us, may all the gods destroy him; prayer is my best armour”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं नरो॒ दीधि॑तिभिर॒रण्यो॒र्हस्त॑च्युती जनयन्त प्रश॒स्तम् । दू॒रे॒दृशं॑ गृ॒हप॑तिमथ॒र्युम्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ náraḥ ǀ dī́dhiti-bhiḥ ǀ aráṇyoḥ ǀ hásta-cyutī ǀ janayanta ǀ pra-śastám ǀdūre-dṛ́śam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǀ atharyúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men genitive rate the excellent, far-gleaming maser of the mansion, the accessibleAgni, present in the twosticks by attrition with their fingers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॒ग्निमस्ते॒ वस॑वो॒ न्यृ॑ण्वन्त्सुप्रति॒चक्ष॒मव॑से॒ कुत॑श्चित् । द॒क्षाय्यो॒ यो दम॒ आस॒ नित्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ agním ǀ áste ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ṛṇvan ǀ su-praticákṣam ǀ ávase ǀ kútaḥ ǀ cit ǀdakṣā́yyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́sa ǀ nítyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dwellers have plural ced in the mansion, for its constant protection, that visibleAgni, who has beenfrom ever, who is to be honoured in every house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेद्धो॑ अग्ने दीदिहि पु॒रो नोऽज॑स्रया सू॒र्म्या॑ यविष्ठ । त्वां शश्व॑न्त॒ उप॑ यन्ति॒ वाजा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá-iddhaḥ ǀ agne ǀ dīdihi ǀ puráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ájasrayā ǀ sūrmyā́ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀtvā́m ǀ śáśvantaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ vā́jāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-kindled, youthfulAgni, shine before us with undecaying radiance; to you abundant sacrificialviands proceed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते अ॒ग्नयो॒ऽग्निभ्यो॒ वरं॒ निः सु॒वीरा॑सः शोशुचन्त द्यु॒मन्त॑: । यत्रा॒ नर॑: स॒मास॑ते सुजा॒ताः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ té ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ agní-bhyaḥ ǀ váram ǀ níḥ ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ śośucanta ǀ dyu-mántaḥ ǀyátra ǀ náraḥ ǀ sam-ā́sate ǀ su-jātā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those radiant fires, at which the well-bon sacrificers assemble, shine more brightly, and are morebountiful bestower of progeny (and other blessings), than the fires (of common life).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा नो॑ अग्ने धि॒या र॒यिं सु॒वीरं॑ स्वप॒त्यं स॑हस्य प्रश॒स्तम् । न यं यावा॒ तर॑ति यातु॒मावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: dā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ rayím ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ su-apatyám ǀ sahasya ǀ pra-śastám ǀná ǀ yám ǀ yā́vā ǀ tárati ǀ yātu-mā́vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VigorousAgni, grant to us, (in requital) of our praises, excellent riches, worthymaleoffspring, anddescendants; (wealth), which an enemy attemptin to assail, may not despoil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ यमेति॑ युव॒तिः सु॒दक्षं॑ दो॒षा वस्तो॑र्ह॒विष्म॑ती घृ॒ताची॑ । उप॒ स्वैन॑म॒रम॑तिर्वसू॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ yám ǀ éti ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ su-dákṣam ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ havíṣmatī ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀúpa ǀ svā́ ǀ enam ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom vigorous, the young damsel (the ladle) charged with the oblation, presenting the melted butter,day and night approaches; him, his own lustre approaches, favourable to (the bestowal of) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑ अ॒ग्नेऽप॑ द॒हारा॑ती॒र्येभि॒स्तपो॑भि॒रद॑हो॒ जरू॑थम् । प्र नि॑स्व॒रं चा॑तय॒स्वामी॑वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāḥ ǀ agne ǀ ápa ǀ daha ǀ árātīḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ tápaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ádahaḥ ǀ járūtham ǀprá ǀ ni-svarám ǀ cātayasva ǀ ámīvām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consume,Agni, all enemies; with the same flames with which you have consumed Jarūtha, drive awayfebrile disease.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्ते॑ अग्न इध॒ते अनी॑कं॒ वसि॑ष्ठ॒ शुक्र॒ दीदि॑व॒: पाव॑क । उ॒तो न॑ ए॒भिः स्त॒वथै॑रि॒ह स्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ idhaté ǀ ánīkam ǀ vásiṣṭha ǀ śúkra ǀ dī́di-vaḥ ǀ pā́vaka ǀutó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ staváthaiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eminent, pure, radiating purifier,Agni, be present (at the sacrifice) of him who lights up your blaze, andat ours, (who address you) with these praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ये ते॑ अग्ने भेजि॒रे अनी॑कं॒ मर्ता॒ नर॒: पित्र्या॑सः पुरु॒त्रा । उ॒तो न॑ ए॒भिः सु॒मना॑ इ॒ह स्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ bhejiré ǀ ánīkam ǀ mártāḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ pítryāsaḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀutó íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Patriarchal mortals, leaders or rites have shared,Agni, your radiance in many plural ces; (propitiated) bythese our (praises, as by theirs), be present at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे नरो॑ वृत्र॒हत्ये॑षु॒ शूरा॒ विश्वा॒ अदे॑वीर॒भि स॑न्तु मा॒याः । ये मे॒ धियं॑ प॒नय॑न्त प्रश॒स्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ náraḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ santu ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀyé ǀ me ǀ dhíyam ǀ panáyanta ǀ pra-śastā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those men who commend this my sacred rite, heroes, in battles with foes, overcome all impiousdevices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा शूने॑ अग्ने॒ नि ष॑दाम नृ॒णां माशेष॑सो॒ऽवीर॑ता॒ परि॑ त्वा । प्र॒जाव॑तीषु॒ दुर्या॑सु दुर्य
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ śū́ne ǀ agne ǀ ní ǀ sadāma ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ mā́ ǀ aśéṣasaḥ ǀ avī́ratā ǀ pári ǀ tvā ǀprajā́-vatīṣu ǀ dúryāsu ǀ durya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us not sit down,Agni, in an empty dwelling, (nor in those) of (other) men; let us not be withoutsuccessors; or, being withoutmaleposterity, let us, friend of dwellings, (by) worshipping you, (come to abide) inhouses filled with progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॒श्वी नित्य॑मुप॒याति॑ य॒ज्ञं प्र॒जाव॑न्तं स्वप॒त्यं क्षयं॑ नः । स्वज॑न्मना॒ शेष॑सा वावृधा॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ aśvī́ ǀ nítyam ǀ upa-yā́ti ǀ yajñám ǀ prajā́-vantam ǀ su-apatyám ǀ kṣáyam ǀ naḥ ǀsvá-janmanā ǀ śéṣasā ǀ vavṛdhānám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whatsoever sacrifice the lord of horses regularly repairs, render, (Agni), our dwelling blessed withprogeny, with excellent posterity, prospering with lineal successors.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि नो॑ अग्ने र॒क्षसो॒ अजु॑ष्टात्पा॒हि धू॒र्तेरर॑रुषो अघा॒योः । त्वा यु॒जा पृ॑तना॒यूँर॒भि ष्या॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ ájuṣṭāt ǀ pāhí ǀ dhūrtéḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀtvā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ pṛtanā-yū́n ǀ abhí ǀ syām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Agni, from the odiousrākṣasas; protect us from the malignant, the illiberal, the iniquitous;may I, with you for my ally, triumph over the hostile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेद॒ग्निर॒ग्नीँरत्य॑स्त्व॒न्यान्यत्र॑ वा॒जी तन॑यो वी॒ळुपा॑णिः । स॒हस्र॑पाथा अ॒क्षरा॑ स॒मेति॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ agnī́n ǀ áti ǀ astu ǀ anyā́n ǀ yátra ǀ vājī́ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vīḷú-pāṇiḥ ǀsahásra-pāthāḥ ǀ akṣárā ǀ sam-éti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that fire (kindled by me) surpass all other fires, at which a vigorous son, firm-handed, possessing athousand means (of living), co-operates in imperishable (praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेद॒ग्निर्यो व॑नुष्य॒तो नि॒पाति॑ समे॒द्धार॒मंह॑स उरु॒ष्यात् । सु॒जा॒तास॒: परि॑ चरन्ति वी॒राः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ni-pā́ti ǀ sam-eddhā́ram ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ uruṣyā́t ǀsu-jātā́saḥ ǀ pári ǀ caranti ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily is heAgni, who defends from the malevolent and from heinous sin (the worshipper) kindling (thefire); he (it is) whom the well-born worshippers adore.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सो अ॒ग्निराहु॑तः पुरु॒त्रा यमीशा॑न॒: समिदि॒न्धे ह॒विष्मा॑न् । परि॒ यमेत्य॑ध्व॒रेषु॒ होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ yám ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ít ǀ indhé ǀ havíṣmān ǀpári ǀ yám ǀ éti ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is theAgniinvoked in many plural ces; whom the prince, presenting oblations to, kindles, whom theministrant priest circumambulates at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे अ॑ग्न आ॒हव॑नानि॒ भूरी॑शा॒नास॒ आ जु॑हुयाम॒ नित्या॑ । उ॒भा कृ॒ण्वन्तो॑ वह॒तू मि॒येधे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ agne ǀ ā-hávanāni ǀ bhū́ri ǀ īśānā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ juhuyāma ǀ nítyā ǀubhā́ ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ vahatū́ íti ǀ miyédhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, may we, who are of exalted rank, offer many perpetual oblations, (employing) means,(prayer and praise), attracting you to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मो अ॑ग्ने वी॒तत॑मानि ह॒व्याज॑स्रो वक्षि दे॒वता॑ति॒मच्छ॑ । प्रति॑ न ईं सुर॒भीणि॑ व्यन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: imó íti ǀ agne ǀ vītá-tamāni ǀ havyā́ ǀ ájasraḥ ǀ vakṣi ǀ devá-tātim ǀ áccha ǀpráti ǀ naḥ ǀ īm ǀ surabhī́ṇi ǀ vyantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are imperishable, bear these most acceptable oblations to the presence of the assembly ofthe gods; and may our fragran (offering) gratify them severally.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अग्ने॒ऽवीर॑ते॒ परा॑ दा दु॒र्वास॒सेऽम॑तये॒ मा नो॑ अ॒स्यै । मा न॑: क्षु॒धे मा र॒क्षस॑ ऋतावो॒ मा नो॒ दमे॒ मा वन॒ आ जु॑हूर्थाः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avī́rate ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀ duḥ-vā́sase ǀ ámataye ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyái ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣudhé ǀ mā́ ǀ rakṣáse ǀ ṛta-vaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dáme ǀ mā́ ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ juhūrthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Relinquish us not,Agni, to the want ofmaleoffspring; nor to deficient clothing; nor to such desruction;leave us not to hunger, not to therākṣasas; expose us not, observer of truth, to evil, whether in the house or inthe forest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मे॒ ब्रह्मा॑ण्यग्न॒ उच्छ॑शाधि॒ त्वं दे॑व म॒घव॑द्भ्यः सुषूदः । रा॒तौ स्या॑मो॒भया॑स॒ आ ते॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ agne ǀ út ǀ śaśādhi ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ susūdaḥ ǀrātáu ǀ syāma ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon me,Agni, quickly, abundant wholesome food; send sustenance, divine Agni, to those whoare opulent in oblations; may we, both (priests and employer), be comprehended in your munificence; do youever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने सु॒हवो॑ र॒ण्वसं॑दृक्सुदी॒ती सू॑नो सहसो दिदीहि । मा त्वे सचा॒ तन॑ये॒ नित्य॒ आ ध॒ङ्मा वी॒रो अ॒स्मन्नर्यो॒ वि दा॑सीत्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ su-hávaḥ ǀ raṇvá-sandṛk ǀ su-dītī́ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ didīhi ǀmā́ ǀ tvé íti ǀ sácā ǀ tánaye ǀ nítye ǀ ā́ ǀ dhak ǀ mā́ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ asmát ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dāsīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shine wiḥ bright lustre,Agni, son of strength, you who are earnestly invoked, and of plural asant aspect;consume not the begotten son with whom you are associated; let not ourmaleoffspring, beneficial to man,perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ अग्ने दुर्भृ॒तये॒ सचै॒षु दे॒वेद्धे॑ष्व॒ग्निषु॒ प्र वो॑चः । मा ते॑ अ॒स्मान्दु॑र्म॒तयो॑ भृ॒माच्चि॑द्दे॒वस्य॑ सूनो सहसो नशन्त
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-bhṛtáye ǀ sácā ǀ eṣú ǀ devá-iddheṣu ǀ agníṣu ǀ prá ǀ vocaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ asmā́n ǀ duḥ-matáyaḥ ǀ bhṛmā́t ǀ cit ǀ devásya ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ naśanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Command not the fires kindled by the priests with which you are united to work as evil; let not thedispleasure, even in error, of you, the son of strength, who are divine, fall upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मर्तो॑ अग्ने स्वनीक रे॒वानम॑र्त्ये॒ य आ॑जु॒होति॑ ह॒व्यम् । स दे॒वता॑ वसु॒वनिं॑ दधाति॒ यं सू॒रिर॒र्थी पृ॒च्छमा॑न॒ एति॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-anīka ǀ revā́n ǀ ámartye ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā-juhóti ǀ havyám ǀsáḥ ǀ devátā ǀ vasu-vánim ǀ dadhāti ǀ yám ǀ sūríḥ ǀ arthī́ ǀ pṛcchámānaḥ ǀ éti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RadiantAgni, the mortal who offers oblations to the immortal becomes affluent; that deity (Agni) favoursthe presenter of (sacrificial) wealth, to whom the devout solicitant inquiring applies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो नो॑ अग्ने सुवि॒तस्य॑ वि॒द्वान्र॒यिं सू॒रिभ्य॒ आ व॑हा बृ॒हन्त॑म् । येन॑ व॒यं स॑हसाव॒न्मदे॒मावि॑क्षितास॒ आयु॑षा सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ suvitásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ rayím ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ bṛhántam ǀyéna ǀ vayám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ mádema ǀ ávi-kṣitāsaḥ ǀ ā́yuṣā ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are cognizant of our solemn and auspicious (worship), bring to the worshippers abundantriches, whereby, mighty Agni, we, blessed with uncontracted life, and excellentmaledesendants, may be happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मे॒ ब्रह्मा॑ण्यग्न॒ उच्छ॑शाधि॒ त्वं दे॑व म॒घव॑द्भ्यः सुषूदः । रा॒तौ स्या॑मो॒भया॑स॒ आ ते॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ agne ǀ út ǀ śaśādhi ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ susūdaḥ ǀrātáu ǀ syāma ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon me,Agni, quickly, abundant wholesome food; send sustenance, divine Agni, to those whoare opulent in oblaions; may we, both (priests and employer), be comprehended in your munificence; do you evercherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षस्व॑ नः स॒मिध॑मग्ने अ॒द्य शोचा॑ बृ॒हद्य॑ज॒तं धू॒ममृ॒ण्वन् । उप॑ स्पृश दि॒व्यं सानु॒ स्तूपै॒: सं र॒श्मिभि॑स्ततन॒: सूर्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: juṣásva ǀ naḥ ǀ sam-ídham ǀ agne ǀ adyá ǀ śóca ǀ bṛhát ǀ yajatám ǀ dhūmám ǀ ṛṇván ǀúpa ǀ spṛśa ǀ divyám ǀ sā́nu ǀ stū́paiḥ ǀ sám ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ tatanaḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified,Agni, by the (sacred fire) kindled by us today, emitting abundant adorable smoke; touchwith your scorching flames the celestial summit; combine with the rays of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒शंस॑स्य महि॒मान॑मेषा॒मुप॑ स्तोषाम यज॒तस्य॑ य॒ज्ञैः । ये सु॒क्रत॑व॒: शुच॑यो धियं॒धाः स्वद॑न्ति दे॒वा उ॒भया॑नि ह॒व्या
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsasya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ eṣām ǀ úpa ǀ stoṣāma ǀ yajatásya ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀyé ǀ su-krátavaḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ svádanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ubháyāni ǀ havyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We celebrate with sacrifices the greatness of the adorable Narāśaṃsa among those who aredivinities, the performers of good works, the bright-shining, the upholders of rites, who partake of both kinds ofoblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळेन्यं॑ वो॒ असु॑रं सु॒दक्ष॑म॒न्तर्दू॒तं रोद॑सी सत्य॒वाच॑म् । म॒नु॒ष्वद॒ग्निं मनु॑ना॒ समि॑द्धं॒ सम॑ध्व॒राय॒ सद॒मिन्म॑हेम
shlokas.transliteration: īḷényam ǀ vaḥ ǀ ásuram ǀ su-dákṣam ǀ antáḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ satya-vā́cam ǀmanuṣvát ǀ agním ǀ mánunā ǀ sám-iddham ǀ sám ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ mahema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us ever worship theAgniwho is to be adored by us; the mighty, the dextrous, the messengerpassing between heaven and earth, the speaker of truth, kindled (of old) byManu, as now by men, that (he maycome) to the solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प॒र्यवो॒ भर॑माणा अभि॒ज्ञु प्र वृ॑ञ्जते॒ नम॑सा ब॒र्हिर॒ग्नौ । आ॒जुह्वा॑ना घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठं॒ पृष॑द्व॒दध्व॑र्यवो ह॒विषा॑ मर्जयध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: saparyávaḥ ǀ bháramāṇāḥ ǀ abhi-jñú ǀ prá ǀ vṛñjate ǀ námasā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ agnáu ǀā-júhvānāḥ ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ pṛ́ṣat-vat ǀ ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ marjayadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshippers bearing the sacred grass offer it with reverence, upon their knees, toAgni; worshiphim, priests, with oblations, invoking him to (sit down) on the spotted (grass), smeared with clarified butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ वि दुरो॑ देव॒यन्तोऽशि॑श्रयू रथ॒युर्दे॒वता॑ता । पू॒र्वी शिशुं॒ न मा॒तरा॑ रिहा॒णे सम॒ग्रुवो॒ न सम॑नेष्वञ्जन्
shlokas.transliteration: su-ādhyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ áśiśrayuḥ ǀ ratha-yúḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀpūrvī́ íti ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ mātárā ǀ rihāṇé íti ǀ sám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sámaneṣu ǀ añjan ǁ
