shlokas.meaning_en: “The devout performers of holy rites, desirous of chariots, have had recourse to the doors (of thesacrificial chamber); (the ladles), plural ced to the east, are plural ing the fire withgheeat sacrifices, as the mothercows lick the calf, or as rivers (water the fields).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त योष॑णे दि॒व्ये म॒ही न॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ सु॒दुघे॑व धे॒नुः । ब॒र्हि॒षदा॑ पुरुहू॒ते म॒घोनी॒ आ य॒ज्ञिये॑ सुवि॒ताय॑ श्रयेताम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ yóṣaṇe íti ǀ divyé íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ uṣásānáktā ǀ sudúghā-iva ǀ dhenúḥ ǀbarhi-sádā ǀ puruhūté íti puru-hūté ǀ maghónī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yajñíye íti ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ śrayetām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the two youthful feminine les, the divine and mighty day and night, the invoked of many, the possessedof wealth, seated on the sacred grass, enitled to adoration, be with us like an easily-milked cow for our welfare.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विप्रा॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॒ मानु॑षेषु का॒रू मन्ये॑ वां जा॒तवे॑दसा॒ यज॑ध्यै । ऊ॒र्ध्वं नो॑ अध्व॒रं कृ॑तं॒ हवे॑षु॒ ता दे॒वेषु॑ वनथो॒ वार्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: víprā ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ kārū́ íti ǀ mánye ǀ vām ǀ jātá-vedasā ǀ yájadhyai ǀūrdhvám ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ kṛtam ǀ háveṣu ǀ tā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ vanathaḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am minded to adore you two sages, the ministrants at sacrifices of men, from celebrated, convey ouroffspring aloft, and acquire (for our use) the precious (treasures preserved) among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ भार॑ती॒ भार॑तीभिः स॒जोषा॒ इळा॑ दे॒वैर्म॑नु॒ष्ये॑भिर॒ग्निः । सर॑स्वती सारस्व॒तेभि॑र॒र्वाक्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदं स॑दन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bhā́ratī ǀ bháratībhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ íḷā ǀ deváiḥ ǀ manuṣyébhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀsárasvatī ǀ sārasvatébhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ idám ǀ sadantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBharati, associated with theBharatis; Iḷā with gods and men; andAgniandSarasvatīwith theSārasvatas; may the three goddesses sit down before us upon this sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॑स्तु॒रीप॒मध॑ पोषयि॒त्नु देव॑ त्वष्ट॒र्वि र॑रा॒णः स्य॑स्व । यतो॑ वी॒रः क॑र्म॒ण्य॑: सु॒दक्षो॑ यु॒क्तग्रा॑वा॒ जाय॑ते दे॒वका॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ turī́pam ǀ ádha ǀ poṣayitnú ǀ déva ǀ tvaṣṭaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rarāṇáḥ ǀ syasvéti syasva ǀyátaḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ karmaṇyáḥ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ yuktá-grāvā ǀ jā́yate ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineTvaṣṭā, being well-plural ased, give issue to our procreative vigour, whence (a son) manly,devout, vigorous, wielder of theSoma-bruising stone, and reverencing the gods, may be born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॑स्प॒तेऽव॑ सृ॒जोप॑ दे॒वान॒ग्निर्ह॒विः श॑मि॒ता सू॑दयाति । सेदु॒ होता॑ स॒त्यत॑रो यजाति॒ यथा॑ दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मानि॒ वेद॑
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspate ǀ áva ǀ sṛja ǀ úpa ǀ devā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ śamitā́ ǀ sūdayāti ǀsáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hótā ǀ satyá-taraḥ ǀ yajāti ǀ yáthā ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánimāni ǀ véda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vanaspati, bring the gods night; mayAgni, the immolator, prepare the victim; let him who is truthofficiate as the ministering priest, for verily he knows the birth of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ह्यग्ने समिधा॒नो अ॒र्वाङिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैः स॒रथं॑ तु॒रेभि॑: । ब॒र्हिर्न॑ आस्ता॒मदि॑तिः सुपु॒त्रा स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृता॑ मादयन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ índreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ turébhiḥ ǀbarhíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ āstām ǀ áditiḥ ǀ su-putrā́ ǀ svā́hā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, kindled (into flame), come to our presence in the same chariot withIndra, and with the swiftmoving gods; mayAditi, the mother of excellent sons, sit down on the sacred grass, and may the immortal godsbe satisfied with the reverentially-offered oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं वो॑ दे॒वम॒ग्निभि॑: स॒जोषा॒ यजि॑ष्ठं दू॒तम॑ध्व॒रे कृ॑णुध्वम् । यो मर्त्ये॑षु॒ निध्रु॑विॠ॒तावा॒ तपु॑र्मूर्धा घृ॒तान्न॑: पाव॒कः
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ devám ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ dūtám ǀ adhvaré ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀyáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ní-dhruviḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ tápuḥ-mūrdhā ǀ ghṛtá-annaḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Appoint (gods) the most adorable, divineAgni, consentient with (all other) fires, your messenger at thesacrifice; him who is permanently present among men, the observer of truth, who is crowned with flame, thepurifier, whose food is butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रोथ॒दश्वो॒ न यव॑सेऽवि॒ष्यन्य॒दा म॒हः सं॒वर॑णा॒द्व्यस्था॑त् । आद॑स्य॒ वातो॒ अनु॑ वाति शो॒चिरध॑ स्म ते॒ व्रज॑नं कृ॒ष्णम॑स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: próthat ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀ aviṣyán ǀ yadā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sam-váraṇāt ǀ ví ǀ ásthāt ǀā́t ǀ asya ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vāti ǀ śocíḥ ǀ ádha ǀ sma ǀ te ǀ vrájanam ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ asti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, like a neighing steed about to feed upon the forage, (Agni) springs up from the vast-enclosing(forest) then the wind fans his flame; and black, (Agni), is your course.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्यस्य॑ ते॒ नव॑जातस्य॒ वृष्णोऽग्ने॒ चर॑न्त्य॒जरा॑ इधा॒नाः । अच्छा॒ द्याम॑रु॒षो धू॒म ए॑ति॒ सं दू॒तो अ॑ग्न॒ ईय॑से॒ हि दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ náva-jātasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ ágne ǀ cáranti ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ idhānā́ḥ ǀáccha ǀ dyā́m ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ dhūmáḥ ǀ eti ǀ sám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ agne ǀ ī́yase ǀ hí ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kindled undecaying flames of you, the newly born, the showerer, rise up; the luminous smokespreads along the sky; and you,Agni, proceed as their messenger to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यस्य॑ ते पृथि॒व्यां पाजो॒ अश्रे॑त्तृ॒षु यदन्ना॑ स॒मवृ॑क्त॒ जम्भै॑: । सेने॑व सृ॒ष्टा प्रसि॑तिष्ट एति॒ यवं॒ न द॑स्म जु॒ह्वा॑ विवेक्षि
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ áśret ǀ tṛṣú ǀ yát ǀ ánnā ǀ sam-ávṛkta ǀ jámbhaiḥ ǀsénā-iva ǀ sṛṣṭā́ ǀ prá-sitiḥ ǀ te ǀ eti ǀ yávam ǀ ná ǀ dasma ǀ juhvā́ ǀ vivekṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The light of whom quickly spreads over the earth when with his teeth (of flame) he devours his food;your blaze rushes along like a charging host, whenAgni, of goodly aspect, you spread with your flame (amongthe trees) as if (they were) barley.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिद्दो॒षा तमु॒षसि॒ यवि॑ष्ठम॒ग्निमत्यं॒ न म॑र्जयन्त॒ नर॑: । नि॒शिशा॑ना॒ अति॑थिमस्य॒ योनौ॑ दी॒दाय॑ शो॒चिराहु॑तस्य॒ वृष्ण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ doṣā́ ǀ tám ǀ uṣási ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ agním ǀ átyam ǀ ná ǀ marjayanta ǀ náraḥ ǀni-śíśānāḥ ǀ átithim ǀ asya ǀ yónau ǀ dīdā́ya ǀ śocíḥ ǀ ā́-hutasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men cherish that youthfulAgniat evening and at dawn, as (they tend) a horse; lighting him as a guestin his proper station; the radiance of the showerer (of benefits), to whom the oblation is offered, shines brightly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒सं॒दृक्ते॑ स्वनीक॒ प्रती॑कं॒ वि यद्रु॒क्मो न रोच॑स उपा॒के । दि॒वो न ते॑ तन्य॒तुरे॑ति॒ शुष्म॑श्चि॒त्रो न सूर॒: प्रति॑ चक्षि भा॒नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: su-sandṛ́k ǀ te ǀ su-anīka ǀ prátīkam ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ rócase ǀ upāké ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀ eti ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ citráḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ práti ǀ cakṣi ǀ bhānúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentAgni, when you shine nigh athandlike gold, your appearance is beautiful; your mightissues like the thunderbolt from the firmament, and like the wonderful sun, you display your lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ व॒: स्वाहा॒ग्नये॒ दाशे॑म॒ परीळा॑भिर्घृ॒तव॑द्भिश्च ह॒व्यैः । तेभि॑र्नो अग्ने॒ अमि॑तै॒र्महो॑भिः श॒तं पू॒र्भिराय॑सीभि॒र्नि पा॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vaḥ ǀ svā́hā ǀ agnáye ǀ dā́śema ǀ pári ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀ ghṛtávat-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ havyáiḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ámitaiḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śatám ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́yasībhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When we present to you,Agni, the sacred offerings with oblations mixed with butter and milk, thenprotect us with those vast unbounded, innumerable golden cities and metals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वा॑ ते॒ सन्ति॑ दा॒शुषे॒ अधृ॑ष्टा॒ गिरो॑ वा॒ याभि॑र्नृ॒वती॑रुरु॒ष्याः । ताभि॑र्नः सूनो सहसो॒ नि पा॑हि॒ स्मत्सू॒रीञ्ज॑रि॒तॄञ्जा॑तवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ vā ǀ te ǀ sánti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vā ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ nṛ-vátīḥ ǀ uruṣyā́ḥ ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ smát ǀ sūrī́n ǀ jaritṝ́n ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength,Jātavedas, with those unobstructed (splendours) which belong to you, a munificentdonor, and with those praises wherewiḥ you protect people with their posterity, do you protect us yourworshippers and praisers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निर्यत्पू॒तेव॒ स्वधि॑ति॒: शुचि॒र्गात्स्वया॑ कृ॒पा त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ रोच॑मानः । आ यो मा॒त्रोरु॒शेन्यो॒ जनि॑ष्ट देव॒यज्या॑य सु॒क्रतु॑: पाव॒कः
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ yát ǀ pūtā́-iva ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ gā́t ǀ sváyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mātróḥ ǀ uśényaḥ ǀ jániṣṭa ǀ deva-yájyāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the brightAgni, radiant with his own diffusive lustre, issues (from the touchwood) like asharpened axe; and he who is desirable, the doer of great deeds, the purifier, is born of his two parents; (heappears) for the worship of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता नो॑ अग्ने॒ सौभ॑गा दिदी॒ह्यपि॒ क्रतुं॑ सु॒चेत॑सं वतेम । विश्वा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ गृण॒ते च॑ सन्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sáubhagā ǀ didīhi ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀ su-cétasam ǀ vatema ǀvíśvā ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ ca ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Illumine for us,Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be your praisers, and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑: शु॒क्राय॑ भा॒नवे॑ भरध्वं ह॒व्यं म॒तिं चा॒ग्नये॒ सुपू॑तम् । यो दैव्या॑नि॒ मानु॑षा ज॒नूंष्य॒न्तर्विश्वा॑नि वि॒द्मना॒ जिगा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śukrā́ya ǀ bhānáve ǀ bharadhvam ǀ havyám ǀ matím ǀ ca ǀ agnáye ǀ sú-pūtam ǀyáḥ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ janū́ṃṣi ǀ antáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vidmánā ǀ jígāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer your sacred oblation, and praise the bright and radiantAgni, who passes with wisdom between alldivine and human beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स गृत्सो॑ अ॒ग्निस्तरु॑णश्चिदस्तु॒ यतो॒ यवि॑ष्ठो॒ अज॑निष्ट मा॒तुः । सं यो वना॑ यु॒वते॒ शुचि॑द॒न्भूरि॑ चि॒दन्ना॒ समिद॑त्ति स॒द्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gṛ́tsaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ táruṇaḥ ǀ cit ǀ astu ǀ yátaḥ ǀ yáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ ájaniṣṭa ǀ mātúḥ ǀsám ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánā ǀ yuváte ǀ śúci-dan ǀ bhū́ri ǀ cit ǀ ánnā ǀ sám ǀ ít ǀ atti ǀ sadyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the sagaciousAgnibe our conductor from the time that he is orn, most youthful, of his mother; hewho, bright-toothed, attacks the forest, and quickly devours his abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य दे॒वस्य॑ सं॒सद्यनी॑के॒ यं मर्ता॑सः श्ये॒तं ज॑गृ॒भ्रे । नि यो गृभं॒ पौरु॑षेयीमु॒वोच॑ दु॒रोक॑म॒ग्निरा॒यवे॑ शुशोच
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ devásya ǀ sam-sádi ǀ ánīke ǀ yám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ śyetám ǀ jagṛbhré ǀní ǀ yáḥ ǀ gṛ́bham ǀ páuruṣeyīm ǀ uvóca ǀ duḥ-ókam ǀ agníḥ ǀ āyáve ǀ śuśoca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom mortals apprehend as white (shining) in the principal station of that divinity; he who assents tomanly adoration, and blazes for the good of man, and the discomfiture (of his foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं क॒विरक॑विषु॒ प्रचे॑ता॒ मर्ते॑ष्व॒ग्निर॒मृतो॒ नि धा॑यि । स मा नो॒ अत्र॑ जुहुरः सहस्व॒: सदा॒ त्वे सु॒मन॑सः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ákaviṣu ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀsáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ juhuraḥ ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ tvé íti ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This far-seeing, sagacious, immortalAgni, has been stationed among short-sighted mortals; harm usnot, vigorous Agni, in this world, that we may ever be devoted to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो योनिं॑ दे॒वकृ॑तं स॒साद॒ क्रत्वा॒ ह्य१॒॑ग्निर॒मृताँ॒ अता॑रीत् । तमोष॑धीश्च व॒निन॑श्च॒ गर्भं॒ भूमि॑श्च वि॒श्वधा॑यसं बिभर्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ yónim ǀ devá-kṛtam ǀ sasā́da ǀ krátvā ǀ hí ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ átārīt ǀtám ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ca ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ ca ǀ gárbham ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ bibharti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The herbs, and the trees, and the earth, contain as a germ that all- supportingAgni, who occupies aplace provided by the gods, that by his functions he may convey (the offerings) to the immortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईशे॒ ह्य१॒॑ग्निर॒मृत॑स्य॒ भूरे॒रीशे॑ रा॒यः सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ दातो॑: । मा त्वा॑ व॒यं स॑हसावन्न॒वीरा॒ माप्स॑व॒: परि॑ षदाम॒ मादु॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: ī́śe ǀ hí ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ dā́toḥ ǀmā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avī́rāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápsavaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sadāma ǀ mā́ ǀ áduvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnihas power to grant abundant food; he has power to grant riches withmaleposterity; vigorous Agni,let us not sit down before you devoid of sons, of beauty, of devotion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रि॒षद्यं॒ ह्यर॑णस्य॒ रेक्णो॒ नित्य॑स्य रा॒यः पत॑यः स्याम । न शेषो॑ अग्ने अ॒न्यजा॑तम॒स्त्यचे॑तानस्य॒ मा प॒थो वि दु॑क्षः
shlokas.transliteration: pari-sádyam ǀ hí ǀ áraṇasya ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ nítyasya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǀná ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ agne ǀ anyá-jātam ǀ asti ǀ ácetānasya ǀ mā́ ǀ patháḥ ǀ ví ǀ dukṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wealth is competent to the acquittance of debt; may we be masters of permanent riches; that is notoffspring which is begotten by another; alter not the paths (of the genitive ration) of a blockhead.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ग्रभा॒यार॑णः सु॒शेवो॒ऽन्योद॑र्यो॒ मन॑सा॒ मन्त॒वा उ॑ । अधा॑ चि॒दोक॒: पुन॒रित्स ए॒त्या नो॑ वा॒ज्य॑भी॒षाळे॑तु॒ नव्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ grábhāya ǀ áraṇaḥ ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ anyá-udaryaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ mántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀádha ǀ cit ǀ ókaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ eti ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ abhīṣā́ṭ ǀ etu ǀ návyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One not acquitting debts, although worthy of regard, yet begotten of another, is not to be contemplatedeven in the mind (as fit) for acceptance; for verily he returns to his own house; therefore let there come to us (ason) new- born, possessed of food, victorious over foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वनुष्य॒तो नि पा॑हि॒ त्वमु॑ नः सहसावन्नव॒द्यात् । सं त्वा॑ ध्वस्म॒न्वद॒भ्ये॑तु॒ पाथ॒: सं र॒यिः स्पृ॑ह॒याय्य॑: सह॒स्री
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ tvám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasā-van ǀ avadyā́t ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ dhvasman-vát ǀ abhí ǀ etu ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ sám ǀ rayíḥ ǀ spṛhayā́yyaḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, defend us against, the malignant; do you, who are endowed with strengt, (preserve us)from sin; may the (sacrificial) food come to you free from defect; may the riches that we desire come to us bythousands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता नो॑ अग्ने॒ सौभ॑गा दिदी॒ह्यपि॒ क्रतुं॑ सु॒चेत॑सं वतेम । विश्वा॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ गृण॒ते च॑ सन्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sáubhagā ǀ didīhi ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀ su-cétasam ǀ vatema ǀvíśvā ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ ca ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Illumine for us,Agni, these auspicious (riches); may we possess (a son) intelligent, the celebrator ofsacred rites; may all (good things) be to your praisers and to him who eulogizes (you); and do you ever cherishus with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राग्नये॑ त॒वसे॑ भरध्वं॒ गिरं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तये॑ पृथि॒व्याः । यो विश्वे॑षाम॒मृता॑नामु॒पस्थे॑ वैश्वान॒रो वा॑वृ॒धे जा॑गृ॒वद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ taváse ǀ bharadhvam ǀ gíram ǀ diváḥ ǀ aratáye ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ amṛ́tānām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ jāgṛvát-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer praise to the strongAgni, traversing without hindrance heaven and earth; he who (as)Vaiśvānaraprospers at the sacrifices of all the immortals, being associated with the awaking divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒ष्टो दि॒वि धाय्य॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्यां ने॒ता सिन्धू॑नां वृष॒भः स्तिया॑नाम् । स मानु॑षीर॒भि विशो॒ वि भा॑ति वैश्वान॒रो वा॑वृधा॒नो वरे॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: pṛṣṭáḥ ǀ diví ǀ dhā́yi ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ netā́ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ stíyānām ǀsáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ váreṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the leader of the rivers, the showerer of the waters, the radiant, has been stationed in thefirmament and upon earth;Viśvānaraaugmenting with the most excellent (oblation) shines upon human beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वद्भि॒या विश॑ आय॒न्नसि॑क्नीरसम॒ना जह॑ती॒र्भोज॑नानि । वैश्वा॑नर पू॒रवे॒ शोशु॑चान॒: पुरो॒ यद॑ग्ने द॒रय॒न्नदी॑देः
shlokas.transliteration: tvát ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ āyan ǀ ásiknīḥ ǀ asamanā́ḥ ǀ jáhatīḥ ǀ bhójanāni ǀváiśvānara ǀ pūráve ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ daráyan ǀ ádīdeḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through fear of you,Vaiśvānara, the dark-complexioned races, although of many minds, arrived,abandoning their possessions, when,Agni, shining uponPuru, you have blazed, consuming the cities of his foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ त्रि॒धातु॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौर्वैश्वा॑नर व्र॒तम॑ग्ने सचन्त । त्वं भा॒सा रोद॑सी॒ आ त॑त॒न्थाज॑स्रेण शो॒चिषा॒ शोशु॑चानः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ vratám ǀ agne ǀ sacanta ǀtvám ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀ ájasreṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VaiśvānaraAgni, the firmament, the earth, the heaven, combine in your worship; shining withundecaying splendour, you overspread heaven and earth with light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने ह॒रितो॑ वावशा॒ना गिर॑: सचन्ते॒ धुन॑यो घृ॒ताची॑: । पतिं॑ कृष्टी॒नां र॒थ्यं॑ रयी॒णां वै॑श्वान॒रमु॒षसां॑ के॒तुमह्ना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ harítaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sacante ǀ dhúnayaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀpátim ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ rathyám ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ uṣásām ǀ ketúm ǀ áhnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The horses (ofIndra), full of ardour, worship you,Agni; the praises (of men), dispersers (of iniquity),accompanied by oblations, (honour you), the lord of men, the conveyer of riches, theVaiśvānaraof dawns, themanifester of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे अ॑सु॒र्यं१॒॑ वस॑वो॒ न्यृ॑ण्व॒न्क्रतुं॒ हि ते॑ मित्रमहो जु॒षन्त॑ । त्वं दस्यूँ॒रोक॑सो अग्न आज उ॒रु ज्योति॑र्ज॒नय॒न्नार्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ asuryám ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ṛṇvan ǀ krátum ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀtvám ǀ dásyūn ǀ ókasaḥ ǀ agne ǀ ājaḥ ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ ā́ryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reverencer of friends,Agni, thVasushave concentrated vigour in you; they have been propitiated byyour acts; genitive rating vast splendour for theArya, do you, Agni, expel theDasyusfrom the dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जाय॑मानः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन्वा॒युर्न पाथ॒: परि॑ पासि स॒द्यः । त्वं भुव॑ना ज॒नय॑न्न॒भि क्र॒न्नप॑त्याय जातवेदो दश॒स्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ pári ǀ pāsi ǀ sadyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ bhúvanā ǀ janáyan ǀ abhí ǀ kran ǀ ápatyāya ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ daśasyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Born in the highest heaven, you ever drink (Soma) likeVāyu; genitive rating the waters, you thunder,granting (his wishes) to your offspring, the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताम॑ग्ने अ॒स्मे इष॒मेर॑यस्व॒ वैश्वा॑नर द्यु॒मतीं॑ जातवेदः । यया॒ राध॒: पिन्व॑सि विश्ववार पृ॒थु श्रवो॑ दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ agne ǀ asmé íti ǀ íṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ īrayasva ǀ váiśvānara ǀ dyu-mátīm ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀyáyā ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ pínvasi ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ pṛthú ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send to us,Agni, (who are)VaiśvānaraJātavedas, that brilliant sustenance whereby you conferwealth, and (grant), all-desired Agni, abundant food to the mortal, the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नो॑ अग्ने म॒घव॑द्भ्यः पुरु॒क्षुं र॒यिं नि वाजं॒ श्रुत्यं॑ युवस्व । वैश्वा॑नर॒ महि॑ न॒: शर्म॑ यच्छ रु॒द्रेभि॑रग्ने॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀ rayím ǀ ní ǀ vā́jam ǀ śrútyam ǀ yuvasva ǀváiśvānara ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaccha ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us who are affluent (in offerings),Agni, ample riches and renowned strength; associatedwith theRudras, with theVasus, grant us, AgniVaiśvānara, infinite happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒म्राजो॒ असु॑रस्य॒ प्रश॑स्तिं पुं॒सः कृ॑ष्टी॒नाम॑नु॒माद्य॑स्य । इन्द्र॑स्येव॒ प्र त॒वस॑स्कृ॒तानि॒ वन्दे॑ दा॒रुं वन्द॑मानो विवक्मि
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ prá-śastim ǀ puṃsáḥ ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ anu-mā́dyasya ǀíndrasya-iva ǀ prá ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ vánde ǀ dārúm ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ vivakmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I salute the demolisher (of cities), glorifying the excellence of the powerfulmale, the universal sovereignwho is the reverenced of all men; I proclaim his exploits (which are) like those of the mightyIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विं के॒तुं धा॒सिं भा॒नुमद्रे॑र्हि॒न्वन्ति॒ शं रा॒ज्यं रोद॑स्योः । पु॒रं॒द॒रस्य॑ गी॒र्भिरा वि॑वासे॒ऽग्नेर्व्र॒तानि॑ पू॒र्व्या म॒हानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: kavím ǀ ketúm ǀ dhāsím ǀ bhānúm ǀ ádreḥ ǀ hinvánti ǀ śám ǀ rājyám ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀpuram-darásya ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāse ǀ agnéḥ ǀ vratā́ni ǀ pūrvyā́ ǀ mahā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They propitiate the wise, the manifesting, the sustaining,t he enlightener of the pious, the giver ofhappiness, the sovereign of heaven and earth; I glorify the ancient and mighty works ofAgni, the demolisher ofcities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य॑क्र॒तून्ग्र॒थिनो॑ मृ॒ध्रवा॑चः प॒णीँर॑श्र॒द्धाँ अ॑वृ॒धाँ अ॑य॒ज्ञान् । प्रप्र॒ तान्दस्यूँ॑र॒ग्निर्वि॑वाय॒ पूर्व॑श्चका॒राप॑राँ॒ अय॑ज्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ akratū́n ǀ grathínaḥ ǀ mṛdhrá-vācaḥ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ aśraddhā́n ǀ avṛdhā́n ǀ ayajñā́n ǀprá-pra ǀ tā́n ǀ dásyūn ǀ agníḥ ǀ vivāya ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ áparān ǀ áyajyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgniutterly confound thoseDasyuswho perform no (sacred) rites, who are babblers defective inspeech, niggards, unbelievers; not honouring (Agni), offering no sacrifice; Agni preceding, has degrated thosewho instrumental tute no sacred ceremonies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑पा॒चीने॒ तम॑सि॒ मद॑न्ती॒: प्राची॑श्च॒कार॒ नृत॑म॒: शची॑भिः । तमीशा॑नं॒ वस्वो॑ अ॒ग्निं गृ॑णी॒षेऽना॑नतं द॒मय॑न्तं पृत॒न्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ apācī́ne ǀ támasi ǀ mádantīḥ ǀ prā́cīḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀtám ǀ ī́śānam ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ agním ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ ánānatam ǀ damáyantam ǀ pṛtanyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chief of leaders has, by the benefits (bestowed upon them), guided those praising (him) throughthe accusative ulated gloom (of night); I glorify thatAgni, the unbending lord of wealth, the tamer of adversarieṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो दे॒ह्यो॒३॒॑ अन॑मयद्वध॒स्नैर्यो अ॒र्यप॑त्नीरु॒षस॑श्च॒कार॑ । स नि॒रुध्या॒ नहु॑षो य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निर्विश॑श्चक्रे बलि॒हृत॒: सहो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dehyáḥ ǀ ánamayat ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aryá-patnīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ cakā́ra ǀsáḥ ǀ ni-rúdhya ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ cakre ǀ bali-hṛ́taḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightyAgni, who by his fatal (weapons) has baffled the devices (of theasuras), who has createdthe lawns, the birds of the sun, having coerced the people by his strength, has made them the tributaries ofNahuṣa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ शर्म॒न्नुप॒ विश्वे॒ जना॑स॒ एवै॑स्त॒स्थुः सु॑म॒तिं भिक्ष॑माणाः । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो वर॒मा रोद॑स्यो॒राग्निः स॑साद पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ śárman ǀ úpa ǀ víśve ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sasāda ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-stham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniVaiśvānara, whom all men approach with pious offerings, soliciting his favour for the sake of(obtaining felicity), has come to the excellent station (intermediate) between his parents, heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दे॒वो द॑दे बु॒ध्न्या॒३॒॑ वसू॑नि वैश्वान॒र उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य । आ स॑मु॒द्रादव॑रा॒दा पर॑स्मा॒दाग्निर्द॑दे दि॒व आ पृ॑थि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ dade ǀ budhnyā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀā́ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ ávarāt ǀ ā́ ǀ párasmāt ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ dade ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineAgniVaiśvānarahas removed from the firmament the investing (glooms) at the rising of thesun; he has removed them from the lower firmament of the earth, from the upper firmament of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ दे॒वं चि॑त्सहसा॒नम॒ग्निमश्वं॒ न वा॒जिनं॑ हिषे॒ नमो॑भिः । भवा॑ नो दू॒तो अ॑ध्व॒रस्य॑ वि॒द्वान्त्मना॑ दे॒वेषु॑ विविदे मि॒तद्रु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ devám ǀ cit ǀ sahasānám ǀ agním ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ hiṣe ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ tmánā ǀ devéṣu ǀ vivide ǀ mitá-druḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I propitiate with oblations the divine, vigorousAgni, rapid as a horse; do you, knowing (our desires), beour messenger of the sacrifice; he, the consumer of forests, is known spontaneously among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ह्यग्ने प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ अनु॒ स्वा म॒न्द्रो दे॒वानां॑ स॒ख्यं जु॑षा॒णः । आ सानु॒ शुष्मै॑र्न॒दय॑न्पृथि॒व्या जम्भे॑भि॒र्विश्व॑मु॒शध॒ग्वना॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agne ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svā́ḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀā́ ǀ sā́nu ǀ śúṣmaiḥ ǀ nadáyan ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ jámbhebhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ uśádhak ǀ vánāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, rejoicing by thine own paths, gratified by the friendship of the gods; roarind with witheringflames above the high plural ces of the earth; threatening to consume all the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒चीनो॑ य॒ज्ञः सुधि॑तं॒ हि ब॒र्हिः प्री॑णी॒ते अ॒ग्निरी॑ळि॒तो न होता॑ । आ मा॒तरा॑ वि॒श्ववा॑रे हुवा॒नो यतो॑ यविष्ठ जज्ञि॒षे सु॒शेव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prācī́naḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ hí ǀ barhíḥ ǀ prīṇīté ǀ agníḥ ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ viśvávāre íti viśvá-vāre ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ jajñiṣé ǀ su-śévaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sacrifice is presen; the sacred grass is strewn;Agnilauded is satisfied, and is the ministrant priestinvoking the all-desired parents of whom you, honoured Agni, the youngest (of the gods), are born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यो अ॑ध्व॒रे र॑थि॒रं ज॑नन्त॒ मानु॑षासो॒ विचे॑तसो॒ य ए॑षाम् । वि॒शाम॑धायि वि॒श्पति॑र्दुरो॒णे॒३॒॑ऽग्निर्म॒न्द्रो मधु॑वचा ऋ॒तावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ rathirám ǀ jananta ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀ ví-cetasaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀviśā́m ǀ adhāyi ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ agníḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ mádhu-vacāḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Judicious men promptly genitive rate at the sacred rite the directing (Agni), who (may convey) their(oblations); Agni, the lord of men, the giver of delight, the swee-spoken, the celebrator of sacrifices, has beenestablished in the dwelling of the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑दि वृ॒तो वह्नि॑राजग॒न्वान॒ग्निर्ब्र॒ह्मा नृ॒षद॑ने विध॒र्ता । द्यौश्च॒ यं पृ॑थि॒वी वा॑वृ॒धाते॒ आ यं होता॒ यज॑ति वि॒श्ववा॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásādi ǀ vṛtáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ā-jaganvā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ brahmā́ ǀ nṛ-sádane ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ca ǀ yám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ vavṛdhā́te íti ǀ ā́ ǀ yám ǀ hótā ǀ yájati ǀ viśvá-vāram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invester (with the priestly office), the bearer (of the oblation),Agni, the directing priest, the sustainer (ofall), is seated in the house of man, he whom heaven and earth extol, and whom, the desired of all, the ministrantpriests worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते द्यु॒म्नेभि॒र्विश्व॒माति॑रन्त॒ मन्त्रं॒ ये वारं॒ नर्या॒ अत॑क्षन् । प्र ये विश॑स्ति॒रन्त॒ श्रोष॑माणा॒ आ ये मे॑ अ॒स्य दीध॑यन्नृ॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ dyumnébhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ atiranta ǀ mántram ǀ yé ǀ vā ǀ áram ǀ náryāḥ ǀ átakṣan ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ víśaḥ ǀ tiránta ǀ śróṣamāṇāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ dī́dhayan ǀ ṛtásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These men nourish the universe with viands who offer (toAgni) fitting commendation; those people alsowho eagerly listen (to his laudation) augment (the plural nty of the world), as do these my (associates), who areglorifiers of this truthful (duty).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू त्वाम॑ग्न ईमहे॒ वसि॑ष्ठा ईशा॒नं सू॑नो सहसो॒ वसू॑नाम् । इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्य आनड्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ īmahe ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ īśānám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ānaṭ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WeVasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्धे राजा॒ सम॒र्यो नमो॑भि॒र्यस्य॒ प्रती॑क॒माहु॑तं घृ॒तेन॑ । नरो॑ ह॒व्येभि॑रीळते स॒बाध॒ आग्निरग्र॑ उ॒षसा॑मशोचि
shlokas.transliteration: indhé ǀ rā́jā ǀ sám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yásya ǀ prátīkam ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ ghṛténa ǀnáraḥ ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ágre ǀ uṣásām ǀ aśoci ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The royal (Agni), the mater (of the sacrifice), is kindled with praises, he whose person n is invoked with(offerings of) butter, whom men associated worship with oblations, Agni, who is lighted before the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमु॒ ष्य सुम॑हाँ अवेदि॒ होता॑ म॒न्द्रो मनु॑षो य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निः । वि भा अ॑कः ससृजा॒नः पृ॑थि॒व्यां कृ॒ष्णप॑वि॒रोष॑धीभिर्ववक्षे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ sú-mahān ǀ avedi ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀví ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ akarítyakaḥ ǀ sasṛjānáḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ kṛṣṇá-paviḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ vavakṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This greatAgnihas been known among men as invoker (of the gods), the giver of deligh, the mighty; hehas spread (in the firmament), he, the darkpathed at large upon the earth, is nourished by the plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कया॑ नो अग्ने॒ वि व॑सः सुवृ॒क्तिं कामु॑ स्व॒धामृ॑णवः श॒स्यमा॑नः । क॒दा भ॑वेम॒ पत॑यः सुदत्र रा॒यो व॒न्तारो॑ दु॒ष्टर॑स्य सा॒धोः
shlokas.transliteration: káyā ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ví ǀ vasaḥ ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ kā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ṛṇavaḥ ǀ śasyámānaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ bhavema ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ su-datra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vantā́raḥ ǀ dustárasya ǀ sādhóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By what oblation,Agni, do you clothe our praise? What offering do you, when glorified, accept? When,giver of good, may we be the possessors and enjoyers of perfect and unmolested riches?”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रप्रा॒यम॒ग्निर्भ॑र॒तस्य॑ शृण्वे॒ वि यत्सूर्यो॒ न रोच॑ते बृ॒हद्भाः । अ॒भि यः पू॒रुं पृत॑नासु त॒स्थौ द्यु॑ता॒नो दैव्यो॒ अति॑थिः शुशोच
shlokas.transliteration: prá-pra ǀ ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ bharatásya ǀ śṛṇve ǀ ví ǀ yát ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rócate ǀ bṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀabhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ pūrúm ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ tastháu ǀ dyutānáḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ śuśoca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisAgniis greatly celebrated by the instrumental tutor of the rite when he shines resplendent as the sun; hewho overcamePuruin battle, and shone glorious as the guest of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॒न्नित्त्वे आ॒हव॑नानि॒ भूरि॒ भुवो॒ विश्वे॑भिः सु॒मना॒ अनी॑कैः । स्तु॒तश्चि॑दग्ने शृण्विषे गृणा॒नः स्व॒यं व॑र्धस्व त॒न्वं॑ सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: ásan ǀ ít ǀ tvé íti ǀ ā-hávanāni ǀ bhū́ri ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǀstutáḥ ǀ cit ǀ agne ǀ śṛṇviṣe ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ svayám ǀ vardhasva ǀ tanvám ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In you,Agni, are many offerings; do you with all your flames be propitious; favourably hear (the praises)of the worshipper; and do you of auspicious manifestation being glorified, spontaneously magnify (your) person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं वच॑: शत॒साः संस॑हस्र॒मुद॒ग्नये॑ जनिषीष्ट द्वि॒बर्हा॑: । शं यत्स्तो॒तृभ्य॑ आ॒पये॒ भवा॑ति द्यु॒मद॑मीव॒चात॑नं रक्षो॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ śata-sā́ḥ ǀ sám-sahasram ǀ út ǀ agnáye ǀ janiṣīṣṭa ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀśám ǀ yát ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ āpáye ǀ bhávāti ǀ dyu-mát ǀ amīva-cā́tanam ǀ rakṣaḥ-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vasi.ṣṭha illustrious in both heaven and earth, rich with a hundred and a thousand (head of cattle), hasaddressed this hymn toAgni, that such fame- conferring disease-removing, fiend-destroying (laudation) may be(the means of) happiness to the eulogists and their kindred.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू त्वाम॑ग्न ईमहे॒ वसि॑ष्ठा ईशा॒नं सू॑नो सहसो॒ वसू॑नाम् । इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्य आनड्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ īmahe ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ īśānám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ānaṭ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WeVasiṣṭhasimplore you,Agni, son of strength, the lord of treasures, that you will quickly bestowfood upon thine adorers, who are affluent (in oblations), and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अबो॑धि जा॒र उ॒षसा॑मु॒पस्था॒द्धोता॑ म॒न्द्रः क॒वित॑मः पाव॒कः । दधा॑ति के॒तुमु॒भय॑स्य ज॒न्तोर्ह॒व्या दे॒वेषु॒ द्रवि॑णं सु॒कृत्सु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ábodhi ǀ jāráḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ kaví-tamaḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀdádhāti ǀ ketúm ǀ ubháyasya ǀ jantóḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ dráviṇam ǀ sukṛ́t-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waster away (of living creatures), the invoker (of the gods), the giver of delight, the wisest of thewise, the purifier, (Agni), has been manifested from the lap of the dawn; he gives consciousness to both classesof beings (men and animals), oblations to the gods, and wealth to the pious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॒क्रतु॒र्यो वि दुर॑: पणी॒नां पु॑ना॒नो अ॒र्कं पु॑रु॒भोज॑सं नः । होता॑ म॒न्द्रो वि॒शां दमू॑नास्ति॒रस्तमो॑ ददृशे रा॒म्याणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dúraḥ ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arkám ǀ puru-bhójasam ǀ naḥ ǀhótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ rāmyā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the doer of great deeds, who forced open the doors of thePaṇis, recovered for us the sacredfood-bestowing (herd of kine), he who is the invoker of the gods, the giver of delight to the lowly-minded, is seenof all people dissipating the gloom of the nights.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमू॑रः क॒विरदि॑तिर्वि॒वस्वा॑न्त्सुसं॒सन्मि॒त्रो अति॑थिः शि॒वो न॑: । चि॒त्रभा॑नुरु॒षसां॑ भा॒त्यग्रे॒ऽपां गर्भ॑: प्र॒स्व१॒॑ आ वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: ámūraḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ vivásvān ǀ su-saṃsát ǀ mitráḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀcitrá-bhānuḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ bhāti ǀ ágre ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unperplexed, far-seeing elevated, resplendent, right-directing, a friend, a guest, the bestower ofprosperity upon us, the wonderfully radiant he shines before the dawns, the embryo of the waters, he hasentered into the nascent plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळेन्यो॑ वो॒ मनु॑षो यु॒गेषु॑ समन॒गा अ॑शुचज्जा॒तवे॑दाः । सु॒सं॒दृशा॑ भा॒नुना॒ यो वि॒भाति॒ प्रति॒ गाव॑: समिधा॒नं बु॑धन्त
shlokas.transliteration: īḷényaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yugéṣu ǀ samana-gā́ḥ ǀ aśucat ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀsu-sandṛ́śā ǀ bhānúnā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ práti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sam-idhānám ǀ budhanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are to be glorified in (all) the ages of men; you,Jātavedas, who are illustrious whenengaged in battle; our praises wake up the kindling (Agni), him who shines with conspicuous splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ या॒हि दू॒त्यं१॒॑ मा रि॑षण्यो दे॒वाँ अच्छा॑ ब्रह्म॒कृता॑ ग॒णेन॑ । सर॑स्वतीं म॒रुतो॑ अ॒श्विना॒पो यक्षि॑ दे॒वान्र॑त्न॒धेया॑य॒ विश्वा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ dūtyám ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ brahma-kṛ́tā ǀ gaṇéna ǀsárasvatīm ǀ marútaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ apáḥ ǀ yákṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ ratna-dhéyāya ǀ víśvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repair,Agni, to the presence of the gods in your office of messenger, (sent) by the assembly engagedin prayer; neglect us not; offer worship toSarasvati, theMaruts, theAśvins, the waters, the universal gods, thatthey may bestow treasures (upon us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने समिधा॒नो वसि॑ष्ठो॒ जरू॑थं ह॒न्यक्षि॑ रा॒ये पुरं॑धिम् । पु॒रु॒णी॒था जा॑तवेदो जरस्व यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ járūtham ǀ han ǀ yákṣi ǀ rāyé ǀ púram-dhim ǀpuru-nīthā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ jarasva ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vasiṣṭhais kindling you,Agni; destroy the malignant; worship the object of many rites, (the company ofthe gods), on behalf of the wealthy (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), praise (the gods),Jātavedas, with manifoldpraises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒षो न जा॒रः पृ॒थु पाजो॑ अश्रे॒द्दवि॑द्युत॒द्दीद्य॒च्छोशु॑चानः । वृषा॒ हरि॒: शुचि॒रा भा॑ति भा॒सा धियो॑ हिन्वा॒न उ॑श॒तीर॑जीगः
shlokas.transliteration: uṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ jāráḥ ǀ pṛthú ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ dávidyutat ǀ dī́dyat ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, like the lover of the dawn (the sun), radiant, bright, resplendent, displays extensive lustre, theshowerer (of benefits), the receiver (of oblations), he shines with splendour, encouraging holy rites; he arouses(mankind), desiring (his presence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व१॒॑र्ण वस्तो॑रु॒षसा॑मरोचि य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒ना उ॒शिजो॒ न मन्म॑ । अ॒ग्निर्जन्मा॑नि दे॒व आ वि वि॒द्वान्द्र॒वद्दू॒तो दे॑व॒यावा॒ वनि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vástoḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ aroci ǀ yajñám ǀ tanvānā́ḥ ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mánma ǀagníḥ ǀ jánmāni ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ví ǀ vidvā́n ǀ dravát ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ deva-yā́vā ǀ vániṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, preceding the dawn, is radiant by day as the sun, and the priests celebrating the sacrifice repeathis praise; the divine, munificent Agni, the messenger (of the gods), cognizant of their birth, repairing to thedeities, hastens in various directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒ गिरो॑ म॒तयो॑ देव॒यन्ती॑र॒ग्निं य॑न्ति॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ भिक्ष॑माणाः । सु॒सं॒दृशं॑ सु॒प्रती॑कं॒ स्वञ्चं॑ हव्य॒वाह॑मर॒तिं मानु॑षाणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ gíraḥ ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ agním ǀ yanti ǀ dráviṇam ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀsu-sandṛ́śam ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ su-áñcam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ aratím ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devout praises and hymns, soliciting riches, proceed toAgni, who is of plural asant aspect, agreeableform, of graceful movement, the bearer of oblations, the ruler of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॑ नो अग्ने॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑ रु॒द्रं रु॒द्रेभि॒रा व॑हा बृ॒हन्त॑म् । आ॒दि॒त्येभि॒रदि॑तिं वि॒श्वज॑न्यां॒ बृह॒स्पति॒मृक्व॑भिर्वि॒श्ववा॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ bṛhántam ǀādityébhiḥ ǀ áditim ǀ viśvá-janyām ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ viśvá-vāram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consentient with theVasus,Agni, bring hitherIndra, with theRudras, the benevolentAditi, with theĀdityas andBṛhaspati, the desired of all, with the adorable (Aṅgirasas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रं होता॑रमु॒शिजो॒ यवि॑ष्ठम॒ग्निं विश॑ ईळते अध्व॒रेषु॑ । स हि क्षपा॑वाँ॒ अभ॑वद्रयी॒णामत॑न्द्रो दू॒तो य॒जथा॑य दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ agním ǀ víśaḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀsáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣápā-vān ǀ ábhavat ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ átandraḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men desiring him celebrate at sacrifices the youthfulAgni, the giver of delight, the invoker of the gods;he, the ruler of the night, has been the diligent envoy of the opulent (instrumental tutors of sacrifices) for the worship ofthe gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ अ॑स्यध्व॒रस्य॑ प्रके॒तो न ऋ॒ते त्वद॒मृता॑ मादयन्ते । आ विश्वे॑भिः स॒रथं॑ याहि दे॒वैर्न्य॑ग्ने॒ होता॑ प्रथ॒मः स॑दे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ adhvarásya ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ṛté ǀ tvát ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayante ǀā́ ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yāhi ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ní ǀ agne ǀ hótā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ sada ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great are you,Agni, the manifester of the solemnity without you the immortals do not rejoice; come inthe same chariot with all the gods; sit down here the chief, the ministrant priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामी॑ळते अजि॒रं दू॒त्या॑य ह॒विष्म॑न्त॒: सद॒मिन्मानु॑षासः । यस्य॑ दे॒वैरास॑दो ब॒र्हिर॒ग्नेऽहा॑न्यस्मै सु॒दिना॑ भवन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ īḷate ǀ ajirám ǀ dūtyā́ya ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀyásya ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ásadaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ agne ǀ áhāni ǀ asmai ǀ su-dínā ǀ bhavanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men offering oblations, ever solicit you the quick-going (to undertake) the office of their messenger, forto him, on whose sacred grass you sit with the gods, the days are prosperous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिश्चि॑द॒क्तोः प्र चि॑कितु॒र्वसू॑नि॒ त्वे अ॒न्तर्दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य । म॒नु॒ष्वद॑ग्न इ॒ह य॑क्षि दे॒वान्भवा॑ नो दू॒तो अ॑भिशस्ति॒पावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ cit ǀ aktóḥ ǀ prá ǀ cikituḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ tvé íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀmanuṣvát ǀ agne ǀ ihá ǀ yakṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In you,Agni, thrice in the day, (the priests) make manifest the treasures (of the oblation) for (the benefitof the) mortal donor; worship the gods on this occasion, Agni, as (you did) forManu; be our messenger, ourprotector against malignity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरी॑शे बृह॒तो अ॑ध्व॒रस्या॒ग्निर्विश्व॑स्य ह॒विष॑: कृ॒तस्य॑ । क्रतुं॒ ह्य॑स्य॒ वस॑वो जु॒षन्ताथा॑ दे॒वा द॑धिरे हव्य॒वाह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ īśe ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ kṛtásya ǀkrátum ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀ átha ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ havya-vā́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnipresides over the solemn rite, over every consecrated oblation; theVasusapproved of his acts;the gods have made him the bearer of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग्ने॑ वह हवि॒रद्या॑य दे॒वानिन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठास इ॒ह मा॑दयन्ताम् । इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं दि॒वि दे॒वेषु॑ धेहि यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ vaha ǀ haviḥ-ádyāya ǀ devā́n ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mādayantām ǀimám ǀ yajñám ǀ diví ǀ devéṣu ǀ dhehi ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, bring the gods to eat of the oblation; may they, of whomIndrais the chief, be delighted on thisoccasion; convey this sacrifice to the deities in heaven, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग॑न्म म॒हा नम॑सा॒ यवि॑ष्ठं॒ यो दी॒दाय॒ समि॑द्ध॒: स्वे दु॑रो॒णे । चि॒त्रभा॑नुं॒ रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरु॒र्वी स्वा॑हुतं वि॒श्वत॑: प्र॒त्यञ्च॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áganma ǀ mahā́ ǀ námasā ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ yáḥ ǀ dīdā́ya ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ své ǀ duroṇé ǀcitrá-bhānum ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ sú-āhutam ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pratyáñcam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us approach with profound reverence the youngest (of the gods), who shines when kindled in hisown abode; who is blazing wonderfully between heaven and earth, and, piously invoked, is coming from everyquarter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॒ह्ना विश्वा॑ दुरि॒तानि॑ सा॒ह्वान॒ग्निः ष्ट॑वे॒ दम॒ आ जा॒तवे॑दाः । स नो॑ रक्षिषद्दुरि॒ताद॑व॒द्याद॒स्मान्गृ॑ण॒त उ॒त नो॑ म॒घोन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ sahvā́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ stave ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣiṣat ǀ duḥ-itā́t ǀ avadyā́t ǀ asmā́n ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatAgniwho by his greatness is the overcomer of all evils, who is praised asJātavedasin the(sacrificial) chamber, protect us, glorifying him, and affluent (in oblations), from all sin and reproach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं वरु॑ण उ॒त मि॒त्रो अ॑ग्ने॒ त्वां व॑र्धन्ति म॒तिभि॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः । त्वे वसु॑ सुषण॒नानि॑ सन्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ utá ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agne ǀ tvā́m ǀ vardhanti ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ vásu ǀ su-sananā́ni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You areVaruṇa, you areMitra,Agni; theVasiṣṭhasaugment you with praises; may liberally distributedriches be (extant) in you, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राग्नये॑ विश्व॒शुचे॑ धियं॒धे॑ऽसुर॒घ्ने मन्म॑ धी॒तिं भ॑रध्वम् । भरे॑ ह॒विर्न ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रीणा॒नो वै॑श्वान॒राय॒ यत॑ये मती॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ agnáye ǀ viśva-śúce ǀ dhiyam-dhé ǀ asura-ghné ǀ mánma ǀ dhītím ǀ bharadhvam ǀbháre ǀ havíḥ ǀ ná ǀ barhíṣi ǀ prīṇānáḥ ǀ vaiśvānarā́ya ǀ yátaye ǀ matīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer praise and worshp toAgni, the enlightener of all, the accepter of pious rites, the destroyer of theAsuras; propitiating him, I now present the oblation on the sacred grass toVaiśvānara, the granter of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने शो॒चिषा॒ शोशु॑चान॒ आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ जाय॑मानः । त्वं दे॒वाँ अ॒भिश॑स्तेरमुञ्चो॒ वैश्वा॑नर जातवेदो महि॒त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ śocíṣā ǀ śóśucānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀtvám ǀ devā́n ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ amuñcaḥ ǀ váiśvānara ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, radiant with lustre, fill the heaven and earth (with light) as soon as born; you,Vaiśvānara,from whom wealth proceeds, has by your might liberated the gods from malevolent (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒तो यद॑ग्ने॒ भुव॑ना॒ व्यख्य॑: प॒शून्न गो॒पा इर्य॒: परि॑ज्मा । वैश्वा॑नर॒ ब्रह्म॑णे विन्द गा॒तुं यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: jātáḥ ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ví ǀ ákhyaḥ ǀ paśū́n ǀ ná ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ íryaḥ ǀ pári-jmā ǀváiśvānara ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ vinda ǀ gātúm ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you are born,Agni, the lord, the circumambient, you watch over all creatures as a herdsman overhis cattle; be willing,Vaiśvānara, to requite our praise, and do you cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मिधा॑ जा॒तवे॑दसे दे॒वाय॑ दे॒वहू॑तिभिः । ह॒विर्भि॑: शु॒क्रशो॑चिषे नम॒स्विनो॑ व॒यं दा॑शेमा॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ jātá-vedase ǀ devā́ya ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀhavíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ dāśema ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us, laden with oblations, offer worship with fuel and invocations of the gods to the divineJātavedas, to the purely lustrousAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अग्ने स॒मिधा॑ विधेम व॒यं दा॑शेम सुष्टु॒ती य॑जत्र । व॒यं घृ॒तेना॑ध्वरस्य होतर्व॒यं दे॑व ह॒विषा॑ भद्रशोचे
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ vidhema ǀ vayám ǀ dāśema ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ yajatra ǀvayám ǀ ghṛténa ǀ adhvarasya ǀ hotaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ deva ǀ havíṣā ǀ bhadra-śoce ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we perform your rites,Agni, with fuel; may we offer you, adorable Agni, pious praises; may we(gratify you), ministrant of the sacrifice, with clarified butter; divine Agni, of auspicious lustre, may we (worshipyou) with oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दे॒वेभि॒रुप॑ दे॒वहू॑ति॒मग्ने॑ या॒हि वष॑ट्कृतिं जुषा॒णः । तुभ्यं॑ दे॒वाय॒ दाश॑तः स्याम यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ devá-hūtim ǀ ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀtúbhyam ǀ devā́ya ǀ dā́śataḥ ǀ syāma ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to our sacrifice,Agni, with the gods, propitiated by the sanctified oblations; may we be theofferers (of worship) to you who are divine, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒सद्या॑य मी॒ळ्हुष॑ आ॒स्ये॑ जुहुता ह॒विः । यो नो॒ नेदि॑ष्ठ॒माप्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: upa-sádyāya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ āsyé ǀ juhuta ǀ havíḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ā́pyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer the oblation to the presentAgni, the showerer (of benefits); pour into the mouth of him who(bears) to us the nearest relationship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः पञ्च॑ चर्ष॒णीर॒भि नि॑ष॒साद॒ दमे॑दमे । क॒विर्गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्युवा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ páñca ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ni-sasā́da ǀ dáme-dame ǀkavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, juvenile, wise, the lord of the dwelling, abides with the five classes of men in every dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ वेदो॑ अ॒मात्य॑म॒ग्नी र॑क्षतु वि॒श्वत॑: । उ॒तास्मान्पा॒त्वंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ védaḥ ǀ amā́tyam ǀ agníḥ ǀ rakṣatu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀutá ǀ asmā́n ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he defend for us the wealth that has been acquired, and preserve us from iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नवं॒ नु स्तोम॑म॒ग्नये॑ दि॒वः श्ये॒नाय॑ जीजनम् । वस्व॑: कु॒विद्व॒नाति॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: návam ǀ nú ǀ stómam ǀ agnáye ǀ diváḥ ǀ śyenā́ya ǀ jījanam ǀvásvaḥ ǀ kuvít ǀ vanā́ti ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, to whom as to a (swift) hawk in heaven, I address this new hymn, bestow upon us amplewealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्पा॒र्हा यस्य॒ श्रियो॑ दृ॒शे र॒यिर्वी॒रव॑तो यथा । अग्रे॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ शोच॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: spārhā́ḥ ǀ yásya ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ rayíḥ ǀ vīrá-vataḥ ǀ yathā ǀágre ǀ yajñásya ǀ śócataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom, blazing in the front of the sacrifice, the enviable honours are to be seen, like the riches of aman havingmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेमां वे॑तु॒ वष॑ट्कृतिम॒ग्निर्जु॑षत नो॒ गिर॑: । यजि॑ष्ठो हव्य॒वाह॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ vetu ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtim ǀ agníḥ ǀ juṣata ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀyájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that most adorableAgni, the bearer of oblations, accept our offering, gratified by our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॑ नक्ष्य विश्पते द्यु॒मन्तं॑ देव धीमहि । सु॒वीर॑मग्न आहुत
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ nakṣya ǀ viśpate ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ deva ǀ dhīmahi ǀsu-vī́ram ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, the approachable; the lord of men, the invoked of all, we set you down (upon the altar), theresplendent, the righteously glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षप॑ उ॒स्रश्च॑ दीदिहि स्व॒ग्नय॒स्त्वया॑ व॒यम् । सु॒वीर॒स्त्वम॑स्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: kṣápaḥ ǀ usráḥ ǀ ca ǀ dīdihi ǀ su-agnáyaḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀsu-vī́raḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Blaze,Agni, night and day, that by you we may be possessed of sacred fires; may you, friendly to us,be righteously praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वा सा॒तये॒ नरो॒ विप्रा॑सो यन्ति धी॒तिभि॑: । उपाक्ष॑रा सह॒स्रिणी॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ sātáye ǀ náraḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀúpa ǀ ákṣarā ǀ sahasríṇī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise men approach with sacred rites for the acquisition of riches; perpetual, infinite (praise isaddressed to you);”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नी रक्षां॑सि सेधति शु॒क्रशो॑चि॒रम॑र्त्यः । शुचि॑: पाव॒क ईड्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sedhati ǀ śukrá-śociḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀśúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the bright, radiant, immortal, pure, purifying, adorableAgni, keep off therākṣasas].”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ राधां॒स्या भ॒रेशा॑नः सहसो यहो । भग॑श्च दातु॒ वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀbhágaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dātu ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength, who are the lord (of all), bestow riches upon us; and mayBhagagive us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने वी॒रव॒द्यशो॑ दे॒वश्च॑ सवि॒ता भग॑: । दिति॑श्च दाति॒ वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ca ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀdítiḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāti ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, give us food along withmaleissue, and may the divineSavitā,BhagaandDiti, give uswealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ रक्षा॑ णो॒ अंह॑स॒: प्रति॑ ष्म देव॒ रीष॑तः । तपि॑ष्ठैर॒जरो॑ दह
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ rákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ práti ǀ sma ǀ deva ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀtápiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ daha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preserve us,Agni, from sin; divine (Agni), who are exempt from decay, consume (our) foes with (your)hottest flames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ म॒ही न॒ आय॒स्यना॑धृष्टो॒ नृपी॑तये । पूर्भ॑वा श॒तभु॑जिः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ mahī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yasī ǀ ánādhṛṣṭaḥ ǀ nṛ́-pītaye ǀpū́ḥ ǀ bhava ǀ śatá-bhujiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are irresistibel, be to us, for the protection of our posterity, like the vast spacious,metal-walled cities (of therākṣasas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: पा॒ह्यंह॑सो॒ दोषा॑वस्तरघाय॒तः । दिवा॒ नक्त॑मदाभ्य
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ dóṣā-vastaḥ ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀdívā ǀ náktam ǀ adābhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “UninjurableAgni, dispeller of darkness, preserve us night and day from sin, and from the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ना वो॑ अ॒ग्निं नम॑सो॒र्जो नपा॑त॒मा हु॑वे । प्रि॒यं चेति॑ष्ठमर॒तिं स्व॑ध्व॒रं विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: enā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ agním ǀ námasā ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀpriyám ǀ cétiṣṭham ǀ aratím ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ víśvasya ǀ dūtám ǀ amṛ́tam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke for you with this hymn,Agni, the son of strength, the kind, the most knowing, the unobstructed;the fit object of sacred rites, the messenger of all the immortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स यो॑जते अरु॒षा वि॒श्वभो॑जसा॒ स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॑हुतः । सु॒ब्रह्मा॑ य॒ज्ञः सु॒शमी॒ वसू॑नां दे॒वं राधो॒ जना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ yojate ǀ aruṣā́ ǀ viśvá-bhojasā ǀ sáḥ ǀ dudravat ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀsu-bráhmā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ su-śámī ǀ vásūnām ǀ devám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ jánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he harness his brilliant protecting (steeds to his car), when earnestly invoked; may he hasten (tobring the gods); may the sacrificial wealth of the worshippers (proceed to) that deity who is the giver of abundantfood, the adorable, the doer of great deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑स्य शो॒चिर॑स्थादा॒जुह्वा॑नस्य मी॒ळ्हुष॑: । उद्धू॒मासो॑ अरु॒षासो॑ दिवि॒स्पृश॒: सम॒ग्निमि॑न्धते॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ śocíḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ ā-júhvānasya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀút ǀ dhūmā́saḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ divi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ sám ǀ agním ǀ indhate ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The radiance of that showerer (of benefits), repeatedly invoked, rises up, as does the fiery sky-lambentsmoke when men kindleAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ दू॒तं कृ॑ण्महे य॒शस्त॑मं दे॒वाँ आ वी॒तये॑ वह । विश्वा॑ सूनो सहसो मर्त॒भोज॑ना॒ रास्व॒ तद्यत्त्वेम॑हे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇmahe ǀ yaśáḥ-tamam ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vītáye ǀ vaha ǀvíśvā ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ marta-bhójanā ǀ rā́sva ǀ tát ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ ī́mahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We constitute you our most renowned messenger; bring the gods to partake (of the oblations); bestowupon us, son of strength, all human blessings; whatsoever we solicit of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने गृ॒हप॑ति॒स्त्वं होता॑ नो अध्व॒रे । त्वं पोता॑ विश्ववार॒ प्रचे॑ता॒ यक्षि॒ वेषि॑ च॒ वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀtvám ǀ pótā ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ yákṣi ǀ véṣi ǀ ca ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-desiredAgni, you are the lord of the mansion; you are the invoker of the gods; you are the assistantpriest; do you, who are wise, present (the oblation to the gods), and partake (of it yourself).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒धि रत्नं॒ यज॑मानाय सुक्रतो॒ त्वं हि र॑त्न॒धा असि॑ । आ न॑ ऋ॒ते शि॑शीहि॒ विश्व॑मृ॒त्विजं॑ सु॒शंसो॒ यश्च॒ दक्ष॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: kṛdhí ǀ rátnam ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ ási ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ śiśīhi ǀ víśvam ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ su-śáṃsaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ dákṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Doer of good deeds, bestow treasure upon the instrumental tutor of the solemnity, for you are the bestower oftreasure; inspire all the priests at our sacrifice; (prosper him) who, offering worthy praise, is prosperouṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे अ॑ग्ने स्वाहुत प्रि॒यास॑: सन्तु सू॒रय॑: । य॒न्तारो॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो॒ जना॑नामू॒र्वान्दय॑न्त॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ agne ǀ su-āhuta ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ santu ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀyantā́raḥ ǀ yé ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ūrvā́n ǀ dáyanta ǀ gónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, piously invoked, may those devout worshippers be dear to you, who are liberal, opulent, and thebestowers upon man of herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येषा॒मिळा॑ घृ॒तह॑स्ता दुरो॒ण आँ अपि॑ प्रा॒ता नि॒षीद॑ति । ताँस्त्रा॑यस्व सहस्य द्रु॒हो नि॒दो यच्छा॑ न॒: शर्म॑ दीर्घ॒श्रुत्
shlokas.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ íḷā ǀ ghṛtá-hastā ǀ duroṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ ápi ǀ prātā́ ǀ ni-sī́dati ǀtā́n ǀ trāyasva ǀ sahasya ǀ druháḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǀ yáccha ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ dīrgha-śrút ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Strength-bestowingAgni, protect from the oppressor and the revilers those in whose dwelling Iḷā,butter-handed, sits down satisfied, and grant to us felicity long renowned; Iḷā, butter-handed: iḷā ghṛtahastā= annarūpa havirlakṣaṇādevī, a goddess, the impersonation of food, that is, of sacrificial food, or theoblation person nified].”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॒न्द्रया॑ च जि॒ह्वया॒ वह्नि॑रा॒सा वि॒दुष्ट॑रः । अग्ने॑ र॒यिं म॒घव॑द्भ्यो न॒ आ व॑ह ह॒व्यदा॑तिं च सूदय
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mandráyā ǀ ca ǀ jihváyā ǀ váhniḥ ǀ āsā́ ǀ vidúḥ-taraḥ ǀágne ǀ rayím ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ ca ǀ sūdaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most wiseAgniis the bearer (of oblations), as the mouth of the gods with his graceful tongue (offlame); bring riches, Agni, to the affluent (in sacrifices); encourage the donor of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये राधां॑सि॒ दद॒त्यश्व्या॑ म॒घा कामे॑न॒ श्रव॑सो म॒हः । ताँ अंह॑सः पिपृहि प॒र्तृभि॒ष्ट्वं श॒तं पू॒र्भिर्य॑विष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ dádati ǀ áśvyā ǀ maghā́ ǀ kā́mena ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀtā́n ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ pipṛhi ǀ partṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ tvám ǀ śatám ǀ pūḥ-bhíḥ ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youngest (of the gods), protect with your protections from iniquity, (and reward) with numerous citiesthose who, through the desire of extended fame, bestow riches, comprehending horses and treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो वो॑ द्रविणो॒दाः पू॒र्णां वि॑वष्ट्या॒सिच॑म् । उद्वा॑ सि॒ञ्चध्व॒मुप॑ वा पृणध्व॒मादिद्वो॑ दे॒व ओ॑हते
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ pūrṇā́m ǀ vivaṣṭi ǀ ā-sícam ǀút ǀ vā ǀ siñcádhvam ǀ úpa ǀ vā ǀ pṛṇadhvam ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ohate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineAgni, the giver of wealth, desires the ladle filled full. Pour out (the contents), and replenish(the vessel), and then the deity bears (your oblations to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं होता॑रमध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ वह्निं॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वत । दधा॑ति॒ रत्नं॑ विध॒ते सु॒वीर्य॑म॒ग्निर्जना॑य दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ hótāram ǀ adhvarásya ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ váhnim ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvata ǀdádhāti ǀ rátnam ǀ vidhaté ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ agníḥ ǀ jánāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have made the wise (Agni) the ministrant priest, and bearer of the sacrifice. Agni giives to theman who performs the prescribed rite and presents (the offering), wealth, with virtuousmaleposterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ भव॑ सुष॒मिधा॒ समि॑द्ध उ॒त ब॒र्हिरु॑र्वि॒या वि स्तृ॑णीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ bháva ǀ su-samídhā ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ utá ǀ barhíḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ stṛṇītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be kindled,Agni, with suitable fuel; let the (priest) strew the plural ntiful sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त द्वार॑ उश॒तीर्वि श्र॑यन्तामु॒त दे॒वाँ उ॑श॒त आ व॑हे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ śrayantām ǀ utá ǀ devā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the willing doors and the chamber of sacrifice be thrown open; bring hither the willing gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ वी॒हि ह॒विषा॒ यक्षि॑ दे॒वान्त्स्व॑ध्व॒रा कृ॑णुहि जातवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ vīhí ǀ havíṣā ǀ yákṣi ǀ devā́n ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniJātavedas, repair to the gods, worship them with the oblation, render them plural ased by thesacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒ध्व॒रा क॑रति जा॒तवे॑दा॒ यक्ष॑द्दे॒वाँ अ॒मृता॑न्पि॒प्रय॑च्च
shlokas.transliteration: su-adhvarā́ ǀ karati ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ yákṣat ǀ devā́n ǀ amṛ́tān ǀ pipráyat ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayJātavedasrender the immortal gods, plural ased by the sacrifice; let him sacrifice (to them), andgratify them (with praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वंस्व॒ विश्वा॒ वार्या॑णि प्रचेतः स॒त्या भ॑वन्त्वा॒शिषो॑ नो अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: váṃsva ǀ víśvā ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀ praceta íti pra-cetaḥ ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ ā-śíṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us, sage,Agni, all desirable (riches); may the blessings (vouchsafed) to us this day besacrificed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामु॒ ते द॑धिरे हव्य॒वाहं॑ दे॒वासो॑ अग्न ऊ॒र्ज आ नपा॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ té ǀ dadhire ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ agne ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nápātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have made you,Agni, who are the son of strength, the bearer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते ते॑ दे॒वाय॒ दाश॑तः स्याम म॒हो नो॒ रत्ना॒ वि द॑ध इया॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ te ǀ devā́ya ǀ dā́śataḥ ǀ syāma ǀ maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rátnā ǀ ví ǀ dadhaḥ ǀ iyānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be the presenters (of offerings) to you who are divine; and you, the mighty one, being solicited,bestow upon us treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे ह॒ यत्पि॒तर॑श्चिन्न इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑ वा॒मा ज॑रि॒तारो॒ अस॑न्वन् । त्वे गाव॑: सु॒दुघा॒स्त्वे ह्यश्वा॒स्त्वं वसु॑ देवय॒ते वनि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ víśvā ǀ vāmā́ ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ ásanvan ǀtvé íti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ hí ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ tvám ǀ vásu ǀ deva-yaté ǀ vániṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our forefathers,Indra, glorifying you, have obtained all desirable (riches); in your gift are cows easy tobe milked, and horses, and you are the liberal donor of wealth to the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजे॑व॒ हि जनि॑भि॒: क्षेष्ये॒वाव॒ द्युभि॑र॒भि वि॒दुष्क॒विः सन् । पि॒शा गिरो॑ मघव॒न्गोभि॒रश्वै॑स्त्वाय॒तः शि॑शीहि रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jā-iva ǀ hí ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ kṣéṣi ǀ evá ǀ áva ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vidúḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sán ǀpiśā́ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ tvā-yatáḥ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ rāyé ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You dwell with your glories like arājāwith his wives;Maghavan, who are wise and experienced,(reward our) praises with the precious metals, with cows, with horses; conduct us who are dependent on yourriches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पस्पृधा॒नासो॒ अत्र॑ म॒न्द्रा गिरो॑ देव॒यन्ती॒रुप॑ स्थुः । अ॒र्वाची॑ ते प॒थ्या॑ रा॒य ए॑तु॒ स्याम॑ ते सुम॒तावि॑न्द्र॒ शर्म॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ paspṛdhānā́saḥ ǀ átra ǀ mandrā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sthuḥ ǀarvā́cī ǀ te ǀ pathyā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ etu ǀ syā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-matáu ǀ indra ǀ śárman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These gratifying and pious hymns, emulous (in earnestness), are addressed on this occasion to you,may the path of your riches lead downwards; may we,Indra, (diligent) in your praise, enjoy felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धे॒नुं न त्वा॑ सू॒यव॑से॒ दुदु॑क्ष॒न्नुप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि ससृजे॒ वसि॑ष्ठः । त्वामिन्मे॒ गोप॑तिं॒ विश्व॑ आ॒हा न॒ इन्द्र॑: सुम॒तिं ग॒न्त्वच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhenúm ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ su-yávase ǀ dúdhukṣan ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ sasṛje ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ gó-patim ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ āha ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ gantu ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of milking you like a milch cow at pasture,Vasiṣṭhahas let loose his prayers to you; everyone of my people proclaims you the lord of cattle; mayIndrabe present at our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्णां॑सि चित्पप्रथा॒ना सु॒दास॒ इन्द्रो॑ गा॒धान्य॑कृणोत्सुपा॒रा । शर्ध॑न्तं शि॒म्युमु॒चथ॑स्य॒ नव्य॒: शापं॒ सिन्धू॑नामकृणो॒दश॑स्तीः
shlokas.transliteration: árṇāṃsi ǀ cit ǀ paprathānā́ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ índraḥ ǀ gādhā́ni ǀ akṛṇot ǀ su-pārā́ ǀśárdhantam ǀ śimyúm ǀ ucáthasya ǀ návyaḥ ǀ śā́pam ǀ síndhūnām ǀ akṛṇot ǀ áśastīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The adorableIndramade the well-known deep waters (of the Paruṣṇi) fordable forSudāsa, andconverted the vehement awakening imprecation of the sacrificer into the calumnation of the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळा इत्तु॒र्वशो॒ यक्षु॑रासीद्रा॒ये मत्स्या॑सो॒ निशि॑ता॒ अपी॑व । श्रु॒ष्टिं च॑क्रु॒र्भृग॑वो द्रु॒ह्यव॑श्च॒ सखा॒ सखा॑यमतर॒द्विषू॑चोः
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ turváśaḥ ǀ yákṣuḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ rāyé ǀ mátsyāsaḥ ǀ ní-śitāḥ ǀ ápi-iva ǀśruṣṭím ǀ cakruḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ druhyávaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhāyam ǀ atarat ǀ víṣūcoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Turvaśa, who was presiding (at solemn rites), diligent in sacrifice, (went toSudāsa) for wealth; but likefishes restricted (to the element of water), theBhrigusandDruhyusquickly assailed them; of these twoeverywhere going the friend (of Sudāsa,Indra) rescued his friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॒क्थासो॑ भला॒नसो॑ भन॒न्तालि॑नासो विषा॒णिन॑: शि॒वास॑: । आ योऽन॑यत्सध॒मा आर्य॑स्य ग॒व्या तृत्सु॑भ्यो अजगन्यु॒धा नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pakthā́saḥ ǀ bhalānásaḥ ǀ bhananta ǀ ā́ ǀ álināsaḥ ǀ viṣāṇínaḥ ǀ śivā́saḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ánayat ǀ sadha-mā́ḥ ǀ ā́ryasya ǀ gavyā́ ǀ tṛ́tsu-bhyaḥ ǀ ajagan ǀ yudhā́ ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those who dress the oblation, those who pronounce auspicious words, those who abstain frompenance, those who bear horns (in theirhands), those who bestow happiness (on the world by sacrifice), glorifythatIndra, who recovered the cattle of theAryafrom the plural nderers, who slew the enemies in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒रा॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ अदि॑तिं स्रे॒वय॑न्तोऽचे॒तसो॒ वि ज॑गृभ्रे॒ परु॑ष्णीम् । म॒ह्नावि॑व्यक्पृथि॒वीं पत्य॑मानः प॒शुष्क॒विर॑शय॒च्चाय॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: duḥ-ādhyáḥ ǀ áditim ǀ sreváyantaḥ ǀ acetásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ jagṛbhre ǀ páruṣṇīm ǀmahnā́ ǀ avivyak ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǀ paśúḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ aśayat ǀ cā́yamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The evil-disposed and stupid (enemies ofSudāsa), crossing the humble Paruṣṇi river, have brokendown its banks; but he by his greatness pervades the earth, andKavi, the son of Cāyamana, like a fallingvictim, sleeps (in death).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒युरर्थं॒ न न्य॒र्थं परु॑ष्णीमा॒शुश्च॒नेद॑भिपि॒त्वं ज॑गाम । सु॒दास॒ इन्द्र॑: सु॒तुकाँ॑ अ॒मित्रा॒नर॑न्धय॒न्मानु॑षे॒ वध्रि॑वाचः
shlokas.transliteration: īyúḥ ǀ ártham ǀ ná ǀ ni-arthám ǀ páruṣṇīm ǀ āśúḥ ǀ caná ǀ ít ǀ abhi-pitvám ǀ jagāma ǀsu-dā́se ǀ índraḥ ǀ su-túkān ǀ amítrān ǀ árandhayat ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ vádhri-vācaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters followed their regular course to the Paruṣṇi, nor (wandered) beyond it; the quick courser(of the king) came to the accessible plural ces, andIndramade the idly-talking enemies, with their numerousprogeny, subject among men (toSudāsa).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒युर्गावो॒ न यव॑सा॒दगो॑पा यथाकृ॒तम॒भि मि॒त्रं चि॒तास॑: । पृश्नि॑गाव॒: पृश्नि॑निप्रेषितासः श्रु॒ष्टिं च॑क्रुर्नि॒युतो॒ रन्त॑यश्च
shlokas.transliteration: īyúḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávasāt ǀ ágopāḥ ǀ yathā-kṛtám ǀ abhí ǀ mitrám ǀ citā́saḥ ǀpṛ́śni-gāvaḥ ǀ pṛ́śni-nipreṣitāsaḥ ǀ śruṣṭím ǀ cakruḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ rántayaḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who ride on particoloured cattle, (theMaruts), despatched byPṛṣṇiand recalling theengagement made by them with their friend (Indra), came like cattle from the pasturage, when left without aherdsman; the exultingNiyutsteeds brought them quickly (against the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एकं॑ च॒ यो विं॑श॒तिं च॑ श्रव॒स्या वै॑क॒र्णयो॒र्जना॒न्राजा॒ न्यस्त॑: । द॒स्मो न सद्म॒न्नि शि॑शाति ब॒र्हिः शूर॒: सर्ग॑मकृणो॒दिन्द्र॑ एषाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ékam ǀ ca ǀ yáḥ ǀ viṃśatím ǀ ca ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ vaikarṇáyoḥ ǀ jánān ǀ rā́jā ǀ ní ǀ ástarityástaḥ ǀdasmáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sádman ǀ ní ǀ śiśāti ǀ barhíḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ sárgam ǀ akṛṇot ǀ índraḥ ǀ eṣām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The heroIndracreated theMaruts(for the assistance of therājā), who, ambitious of fame, slewone-and-twenty of the men on the two banks (of the Paruṣṇi), as a well-looking priest lops the sacred grass inthe chamber of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ श्रु॒तं क॒वषं॑ वृ॒द्धम॒प्स्वनु॑ द्रु॒ह्युं नि वृ॑ण॒ग्वज्र॑बाहुः । वृ॒णा॒ना अत्र॑ स॒ख्याय॑ स॒ख्यं त्वा॒यन्तो॒ ये अम॑द॒न्ननु॑ त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ śrutám ǀ kaváṣam ǀ vṛddhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ ánu ǀ druhyúm ǀ ní ǀ vṛṇak ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀvṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ átra ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ sakhyám ǀ tvā-yántaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ámadan ǀ ánu ǀ tvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the bearer of the thunderbolt, did drownŚruta,Kavaṣa,Vṛddhaand afterwardsDruhyu, in thewaters; for they,Indra, who are devoted to you, and glorify you, preferring your friendship, enjoy it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि स॒द्यो विश्वा॑ दृंहि॒तान्ये॑षा॒मिन्द्र॒: पुर॒: सह॑सा स॒प्त द॑र्दः । व्यान॑वस्य॒ तृत्स॑वे॒ गयं॑ भा॒ग्जेष्म॑ पू॒रुं वि॒दथे॑ मृ॒ध्रवा॑चम्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dṛṃhitā́ni ǀ eṣām ǀ índraḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ sáhasā ǀ saptá ǀ dardaríti dardaḥ ǀví ǀ ā́navasya ǀ tṛ́tsave ǀ gáyam ǀ bhāk ǀ jéṣma ǀ pūrúm ǀ vidáthe ǀ mṛdhrá-vācam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, in his might, quickly demolished all their strongholds, and their seven (kinds of) cities; he hasgiven the dwelling of the son of Anu to Tṛtsu; may we, (by propitiating Indra), conquer in battle the ill-speakingman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ग॒व्यवोऽन॑वो द्रु॒ह्यव॑श्च ष॒ष्टिः श॒ता सु॑षुपु॒: षट् स॒हस्रा॑ । ष॒ष्टिर्वी॒रासो॒ अधि॒ षड्दु॑वो॒यु विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य वी॒र्या॑ कृ॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ gavyávaḥ ǀ ánavaḥ ǀ druhyávaḥ ǀ ca ǀ ṣaṣṭíḥ ǀ śatā́ ǀ susupuḥ ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ sahásrā ǀṣaṣṭíḥ ǀ vīrā́saḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ duvaḥ-yú ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ vīryā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The warriors of the Anus andDruhyus, intending (to carry off the) cattle, (hostile) to the pious(Sudāsa) perished to the number of sixty-six thousand six hundred and sixty; such are all the glorious acts ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑णै॒ते तृत्स॑वो॒ वेवि॑षाणा॒ आपो॒ न सृ॒ष्टा अ॑धवन्त॒ नीची॑: । दु॒र्मि॒त्रास॑: प्रकल॒विन्मिमा॑ना ज॒हुर्विश्वा॑नि॒ भोज॑ना सु॒दासे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ eté ǀ tṛ́tsavaḥ ǀ véviṣāṇāḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ sṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ adhavanta ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀduḥ-mitrā́saḥ ǀ prakala-vít ǀ mímānāḥ ǀ jahúḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhójanā ǀ su-dā́se ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These hostile, Tṛtsus, ignorantly contending withIndra, fled routed as rapidly as rivers on a downwardcourse, and being discomfited, abandoned all their possessions toSudāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्धं वी॒रस्य॑ शृत॒पाम॑नि॒न्द्रं परा॒ शर्ध॑न्तं नुनुदे अ॒भि क्षाम् । इन्द्रो॑ म॒न्युं म॑न्यु॒म्यो॑ मिमाय भे॒जे प॒थो व॑र्त॒निं पत्य॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: ardhám ǀ vīrásya ǀ śṛta-pā́m ǀ anindrám ǀ párā ǀ śárdhantam ǀ nunude ǀ abhí ǀ kṣā́m ǀíndraḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ manyu-bhyáḥ ǀ mimāya ǀ bhejé ǀ patháḥ ǀ vartaním ǀ pátyamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas scattered over the earth the hostile rival of the hero (Sudāsa), the senior of Indra, theappropriator of the oblation; Indra has baffled the wrath of the wratfhful enemy, and the (foe) advancing on theway (against Sudāsa) has taken the path of flight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒ध्रेण॑ चि॒त्तद्वेकं॑ चकार सिं॒ह्यं॑ चि॒त्पेत्वे॑ना जघान । अव॑ स्र॒क्तीर्वे॒श्या॑वृश्च॒दिन्द्र॒: प्राय॑च्छ॒द्विश्वा॒ भोज॑ना सु॒दासे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ādhréṇa ǀ cit ǀ tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ékam ǀ cakāra ǀ siṃhyám ǀ cit ǀ pétvena ǀ jaghāna ǀáva ǀ sraktī́ḥ ǀ veśyā́ ǀ avṛścat ǀ índraḥ ǀ prá ǀ ayacchat ǀ víśvā ǀ bhójanā ǀ su-dā́se ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, has effected a valuable (donation) by a pauper; he has slain an old lion by a goat; he has cut theangles of the sacrificialpostwith a needle; he has given all the spoils (of the enemy) toSudāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शश्व॑न्तो॒ हि शत्र॑वो रार॒धुष्टे॑ भे॒दस्य॑ चि॒च्छर्ध॑तो विन्द॒ रन्धि॑म् । मर्ताँ॒ एन॑: स्तुव॒तो यः कृ॒णोति॑ ति॒ग्मं तस्मि॒न्नि ज॑हि॒ वज्र॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: śáśvantaḥ ǀ hí ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ raradhúḥ ǀ te ǀ bhedásya ǀ cit ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ vinda ǀ rándhim ǀmártān ǀ énaḥ ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ tigmám ǀ tásmin ǀ ní ǀ jahi ǀ vájram ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your numerous enemies,Indra, have been reduced to subjection, effect at some time or other thesubjugation of the turbulentBheda, who holds men praising you as guilty of wickedness; hurl, Indra, your sharpthuderbolt against him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आव॒दिन्द्रं॑ य॒मुना॒ तृत्स॑वश्च॒ प्रात्र॑ भे॒दं स॒र्वता॑ता मुषायत् । अ॒जास॑श्च॒ शिग्र॑वो॒ यक्ष॑वश्च ब॒लिं शी॒र्षाणि॑ जभ्रु॒रश्व्या॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́vat ǀ índram ǀ yamúnā ǀ tṛ́tsavaḥ ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ átra ǀ bhedám ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ muṣāyat ǀajā́saḥ ǀ ca ǀ śígravaḥ ǀ yákṣavaḥ ǀ ca ǀ balím ǀ śīrṣā́ṇi ǀ jabhruḥ ǀ áśvyāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dwellers on theYamunaand the Tṛtsus glorifiedIndrawhen he killedBhedain battle; the Ajas, theŚigrus, theYakṣas, offered him as a sacrifice the heads of the horses (killed in the combat).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त॑ इन्द्र सुम॒तयो॒ न राय॑: सं॒चक्षे॒ पूर्वा॑ उ॒षसो॒ न नूत्ना॑: । देव॑कं चिन्मान्यमा॒नं ज॑घ॒न्थाव॒ त्मना॑ बृह॒तः शम्ब॑रं भेत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ su-matáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ sam-cákṣe ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ná ǀ nū́tnāḥ ǀdévakam ǀ cit ǀ mānyamānám ǀ jaghantha ǀ áva ǀ tmánā ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ śámbaram ǀ bhet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your favours,Indra, and your bounties, whether old or new, cannot be counted like the (recurring)dawn; you have slainDevaka, the son of Mānyamāna, and of thine own will, has cast downŚambarafrom thevast (mountain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये गृ॒हादम॑मदुस्त्वा॒या प॑राश॒रः श॒तया॑तु॒र्वसि॑ष्ठः । न ते॑ भो॒जस्य॑ स॒ख्यं मृ॑ष॒न्ताधा॑ सू॒रिभ्य॑: सु॒दिना॒ व्यु॑च्छान्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ gṛhā́t ǀ ámamaduḥ ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ parā-śaráḥ ǀ śatá-yātuḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀná ǀ te ǀ bhojásya ǀ sakhyám ǀ mṛṣanta ǀ ádha ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ su-dínā ǀ ví ǀ ucchān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Parāśara, the destroyer of hundreds (ofrākṣasas), andVasiṣṭhathey who, devoted to you, haveglorified you in every dwelling, neglect not the friendship of you (their) benefactor; therefore prosperous daysdawn upon the pious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वे नप्तु॑र्दे॒वव॑तः श॒ते गोर्द्वा रथा॑ व॒धूम॑न्ता सु॒दास॑: । अर्ह॑न्नग्ने पैजव॒नस्य॒ दानं॒ होते॑व॒ सद्म॒ पर्ये॑मि॒ रेभ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: dvé íti ǀ náptuḥ ǀ devá-vataḥ ǀ śaté íti ǀ góḥ ǀ dvā́ ǀ ráthā ǀ vadhū́-mantā ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀárhan ǀ agne ǀ paija-vanásya ǀ dā́nam ǀ hótā-iva ǀ sádma ǀ pári ǀ emi ǀ rébhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praising the liberality ofSudāsa, the grandson of Devavat, the son ofPaijavana, the donor of twohundred cows, and of two chariots with two wives, I, worthy (of the gift), circumambulate you,Agni, like theministrant priest in the chamber (of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वारो॑ मा पैजव॒नस्य॒ दाना॒: स्मद्दि॑ष्टयः कृश॒निनो॑ निरे॒के । ऋ॒ज्रासो॑ मा पृथिवि॒ष्ठाः सु॒दास॑स्तो॒कं तो॒काय॒ श्रव॑से वहन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: catvā́raḥ ǀ mā ǀ paija-vanásya ǀ dā́nāḥ ǀ smát-diṣṭayaḥ ǀ kṛśanínaḥ ǀ nireké ǀṛjrā́saḥ ǀ mā ǀ pṛthivi-sthā́ḥ ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀ tokám ǀ tokā́ya ǀ śrávase ǀ vahanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Four (horses), having golden trappings, going steadily on a difficult road, celebrated on the earth, theexcellent and acceptable gifts (made) to me bySudāsa, the son ofPaijavana, bear me as a son (to obtain) foodand progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ श्रवो॒ रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरु॒र्वी शी॒र्ष्णेशी॑र्ष्णे विब॒भाजा॑ विभ॒क्ता । स॒प्तेदिन्द्रं॒ न स्र॒वतो॑ गृणन्ति॒ नि यु॑ध्याम॒धिम॑शिशाद॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antáḥ ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ śīrṣṇé-śīrṣṇe ǀ vi-babhā́ja ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀsaptá ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ ní ǀ yudhyāmadhím ǀ aśiśāt ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven worlds praise (Sudāsa) as if he wereIndra; him whose fame (spreads) through thespacious heaven and earth; who, munificent, has distributed (wealth) on every eminent person n, and (for him) theflowing (rivers) have destroyed Yudhyamadhi in war.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं न॑रो मरुतः सश्च॒तानु॒ दिवो॑दासं॒ न पि॒तरं॑ सु॒दास॑: । अ॒वि॒ष्टना॑ पैजव॒नस्य॒ केतं॑ दू॒णाशं॑ क्ष॒त्रम॒जरं॑ दुवो॒यु
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ saścata ǀ ánu ǀ dívaḥ-dāsam ǀ ná ǀ pitáram ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀaviṣṭána ǀ paija-vanásya ǀ kétam ǀ duḥ-náśam ǀ kṣatrám ǀ ajáram ǀ duvaḥ-yú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, leaders (of rites), attend upon this (prince) as you did uponDivodāsa, the father ofSudāsa;favour the prayers of the devout son of Pijavana, and may his strength be unimpaired, undecaying].”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ति॒ग्मशृ॑ङ्गो वृष॒भो न भी॒म एक॑: कृ॒ष्टीश्च्या॒वय॑ति॒ प्र विश्वा॑: । यः शश्व॑तो॒ अदा॑शुषो॒ गय॑स्य प्रय॒न्तासि॒ सुष्वि॑तराय॒ वेद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ cyaváyati ǀ prá ǀ víśvāḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀ ádāśuṣaḥ ǀ gáyasya ǀ pra-yantā́ ǀ asi ǀ susví-tarāya ǀ védaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is formidable as a sharp-horned bull, singly expels all men (from their stations); you who arethe despoiler of the ample wealth of him who makes no offerings are the giver of riches to the presenter offrequent oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह॒ त्यदि॑न्द्र॒ कुत्स॑माव॒: शुश्रू॑षमाणस्त॒न्वा॑ सम॒र्ये । दासं॒ यच्छुष्णं॒ कुय॑वं॒ न्य॑स्मा॒ अर॑न्धय आर्जुने॒याय॒ शिक्ष॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ indra ǀ kútsam ǀ āvaḥ ǀ śúśrūṣamāṇaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sa-maryé ǀdā́sam ǀ yát ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ kúyavam ǀ ní ǀ asmai ǀ árandhayaḥ ǀ ārjuneyā́ya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aiding him with your person n,Indra, you had defendedKutsain combat when you had subjugatedDāsa,ŚuṣṇaandKuyava, giving (their spoil) to that son ofArjuni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं धृ॑ष्णो धृष॒ता वी॒तह॑व्यं॒ प्रावो॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: सु॒दास॑म् । प्र पौरु॑कुत्सिं त्र॒सद॑स्युमाव॒: क्षेत्र॑साता वृत्र॒हत्ये॑षु पू॒रुम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ vītá-havyam ǀ prá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ su-dā́sam ǀprá ǀ páuru-kutsim ǀ trasádasyum ǀ āvaḥ ǀ kṣétra-sātā ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ pūrúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Undaunted (Indra), you had protected with all your protectionsSudāsa, the offerer of oblations; youhave protected in battles with enemies for the possession of the earthTrasadasyu, the son ofPurukutsa, andPuru.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नृभि॑र्नृमणो दे॒ववी॑तौ॒ भूरी॑णि वृ॒त्रा ह॑र्यश्व हंसि । त्वं नि दस्युं॒ चुमु॑रिं॒ धुनिं॒ चास्वा॑पयो द॒भीत॑ये सु॒हन्तु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ-manaḥ ǀ devá-vītau ǀ bhū́rīṇi ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ hari-aśva ǀ haṃsi ǀtvám ǀ ní ǀ dásyum ǀ cúmurim ǀ dhúnim ǀ ca ǀ ásvāpayaḥ ǀ dabhī́taye ǀ su-hántu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the lord of horses, who are honoured by men, have destroyed, along with theMaruts, numerousenemies at the sacrifice of the gods; you have put to sleep with the thunderbolt theDasyus, Chumuri, andDhuni,on behalf ofDabhīti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ च्यौ॒त्नानि॑ वज्रहस्त॒ तानि॒ नव॒ यत्पुरो॑ नव॒तिं च॑ स॒द्यः । नि॒वेश॑ने शतत॒मावि॑वेषी॒रह॑ञ्च वृ॒त्रं नमु॑चिमु॒ताह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ cyautnā́ni ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ tā́ni ǀ náva ǀ yát ǀ púraḥ ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ sadyáḥ ǀni-véśane ǀ śata-tamā́ ǀ aviveṣīḥ ǀ áhan ǀ ca ǀ vṛtrám ǀ námucim ǀ utá ǀ ahan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such, wielder of the thunderbolt, are your mighty powers, that when you had quickly destroyed ninetyand nine cities, you have occupied the hundredth as a plural ce of abode; you have slainVṛtra, you have also slainNamuci.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॒ ता त॑ इन्द्र॒ भोज॑नानि रा॒तह॑व्याय दा॒शुषे॑ सु॒दासे॑ । वृष्णे॑ ते॒ हरी॒ वृष॑णा युनज्मि॒ व्यन्तु॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि पुरुशाक॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sánā ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ bhójanāni ǀ rātá-havyāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ su-dā́se ǀvṛ́ṣṇe ǀ te ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ yunajmi ǀ vyántu ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ puru-śāka ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your favours,Indra, toSudāsa, the donor (of offerings), the presenter of oblations, are infinite;showerer (of benefits), I yoke for you (your vigorous) steeds; may our prayers reach you who are mighty, towhom many rites are addressed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा ते॑ अ॒स्यां स॑हसाव॒न्परि॑ष्टाव॒घाय॑ भूम हरिवः परा॒दै । त्राय॑स्व नोऽवृ॒केभि॒र्वरू॑थै॒स्तव॑ प्रि॒यास॑: सू॒रिषु॑ स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ asyā́m ǀ sahasā-van ǀ páriṣṭau ǀ aghā́ya ǀ bhūma ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ parā-dái ǀtrā́yasva ǀ naḥ ǀ avṛkébhiḥ ǀ várūthaiḥ ǀ táva ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ sūríṣu ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulIndra, lord of horses, let us not be exposed at this ceremony, addressed to you, to themurderous despoiler; protect us with impregnable defences; may we be held dear among your worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒यास॒ इत्ते॑ मघवन्न॒भिष्टौ॒ नरो॑ मदेम शर॒णे सखा॑यः । नि तु॒र्वशं॒ नि याद्वं॑ शिशीह्यतिथि॒ग्वाय॒ शंस्यं॑ करि॒ष्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: priyā́saḥ ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀ náraḥ ǀ madema ǀ śaraṇé ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀní ǀ turváśam ǀ ní ǀ yā́dvam ǀ śiśīhi ǀ atithi-gvā́ya ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ kariṣyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we,Maghavan, leaders in your adoration, regarded as dear friends, be happy in our homes; aboutto bestow felicity upon Atithigvan, humiliateTurvaśa; (humiliate) the son ofYadu.”
