shlokas.sanskrit: स॒द्यश्चि॒न्नु ते म॑घवन्न॒भिष्टौ॒ नर॑: शंसन्त्युक्थ॒शास॑ उ॒क्था । ये ते॒ हवे॑भि॒र्वि प॒णीँरदा॑शन्न॒स्मान्वृ॑णीष्व॒ युज्या॑य॒ तस्मै॑
shlokas.transliteration: sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀ náraḥ ǀ śaṃsanti ǀ uktha-śā́saḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀyé ǀ te ǀ hávebhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ paṇī́n ǀ ádāśan ǀ asmā́n ǀ vṛṇīṣva ǀ yújyāya ǀ tásmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leader (of rites), reciters of prayers, offer,Maghavan, prayers devoutly for your adoration; they bytheir praises have appropriated the wealth of the niggards; select us (as the objects) of your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते स्तोमा॑ न॒रां नृ॑तम॒ तुभ्य॑मस्म॒द्र्य॑ञ्चो॒ दद॑तो म॒घानि॑ । तेषा॑मिन्द्र वृत्र॒हत्ये॑ शि॒वो भू॒: सखा॑ च॒ शूरो॑ऽवि॒ता च॑ नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ stómāḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ nṛ-tama ǀ túbhyam ǀ asmadryáñcaḥ ǀ dádataḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀtéṣām ǀ indra ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ śiváḥ ǀ bhūḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ ca ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ ca ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Chief leader (of rites), these praises of man addressed to you revert to us, who are the offerers of(sacrificial) riches; do you be propitious to such men, (Indra), in conflicts with enemies; be their friend, their hero,and protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू इ॑न्द्र शूर॒ स्तव॑मान ऊ॒ती ब्रह्म॑जूतस्त॒न्वा॑ वावृधस्व । उप॑ नो॒ वाजा॑न्मिमी॒ह्युप॒ स्तीन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ stávamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ bráhma-jūtaḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vavṛdhasva ǀúpa ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ mimīhi ǀ úpa ǀ stī́n ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, glorified on the present occasion, and propitiated by praise, be amplified in your person n forour protection; bestow upon us food and habitations; and do you ever cherish us wiht blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रो ज॑ज्ञे वी॒र्या॑य स्व॒धावा॒ञ्चक्रि॒रपो॒ नर्यो॒ यत्क॑रि॒ष्यन् । जग्मि॒र्युवा॑ नृ॒षद॑न॒मवो॑भिस्त्रा॒ता न॒ इन्द्र॒ एन॑सो म॒हश्चि॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ugráḥ ǀ jajñe ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ svadhā́-vān ǀ cákriḥ ǀ ápaḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ yát ǀ kariṣyán ǀjágmiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ nṛ-sádanam ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ trātā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ énasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fierce and powerful (Indra) has been born for heroic (deeds); friendly to man, he is theaccomplisher of whatever act he undertakes to perform; ever youthful, he invests the (sacrificial) hall withdefences (against interruption); be our preserver, Indra, from heinous sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हन्ता॑ वृ॒त्रमिन्द्र॒: शूशु॑वान॒: प्रावी॒न्नु वी॒रो ज॑रि॒तार॑मू॒ती । कर्ता॑ सु॒दासे॒ अह॒ वा उ॑ लो॒कं दाता॒ वसु॒ मुहु॒रा दा॒शुषे॑ भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ índraḥ ǀ śū́śuvānaḥ ǀ prá ǀ āvīt ǀ nú ǀ vīráḥ ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ ūtī́ ǀkártā ǀ su-dā́se ǀ áha ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ dā́tā ǀ vásu ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, dilating in bulk, is the slayer ofVṛtra; the hero defends his worshipper promptly with hisprotection, whether he be the giver of dominion toSudāsa, or the donor repeatedly of wealth to the offerer (ofoblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ध्मो अ॑न॒र्वा ख॑ज॒कृत्स॒मद्वा॒ शूर॑: सत्रा॒षाड्ज॒नुषे॒मषा॑ळ्हः । व्या॑स॒ इन्द्र॒: पृत॑ना॒: स्वोजा॒ अधा॒ विश्वं॑ शत्रू॒यन्तं॑ जघान
shlokas.transliteration: yudhmáḥ ǀ anarvā́ ǀ khaja-kṛ́t ǀ samát-vā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ satrāṣā́ṭ ǀ janúṣā ǀ īm ǀ áṣāḷhaḥ ǀví ǀ āse ǀ índraḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ su-ójāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ víśvam ǀ śatru-yántam ǀ jaghāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A warrior who turns not back in battle, a combatant, one engaged in tumults, a hero, victorious over(his) foes from birth, invincible, of great vigour, thisIndrascatters (hostile) hosts and slays all (his) adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे चि॑दिन्द्र॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा प॑प्राथ॒ तवि॑षीभिस्तुविष्मः । नि वज्र॒मिन्द्रो॒ हरि॑वा॒न्मिमि॑क्ष॒न्त्समन्ध॑सा॒ मदे॑षु॒ वा उ॑वोच
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ cit ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ paprātha ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ tuviṣmaḥ ǀní ǀ vájram ǀ índraḥ ǀ hári-vān ǀ mímikṣan ǀ sám ǀ ándhasā ǀ mádeṣu ǀ vái ǀ uvoca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentIndra, you have filled both heaven and earth with your magnitutde, your energies; Indra, thelord of horses, brandishing the thunderbolt, is gratified at sacrifices by the (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ जजान॒ वृष॑णं॒ रणा॑य॒ तमु॑ चि॒न्नारी॒ नर्यं॑ ससूव । प्र यः से॑ना॒नीरध॒ नृभ्यो॒ अस्ती॒नः सत्वा॑ ग॒वेष॑ण॒: स धृ॒ष्णुः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ jajāna ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ ráṇāya ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ cit ǀ nā́rī ǀ náryam ǀ sasūva ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ senā-nī́ḥ ǀ ádha ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ ináḥ ǀ sátvā ǀ go-éṣaṇaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(His) progenitor begotIndra, the showerer (of benefits) for (the purpose of) war; his mother brought himforth the benefactor of man; the leader of armies who is chief over men, he is the lord, the conqueror, therecoverer of the kine, the subduer of foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू चि॒त्स भ्रे॑षते॒ जनो॒ न रे॑ष॒न्मनो॒ यो अ॑स्य घो॒रमा॒विवा॑सात् । य॒ज्ञैर्य इन्द्रे॒ दध॑ते॒ दुवां॑सि॒ क्षय॒त्स रा॒य ऋ॑त॒पा ऋ॑ते॒जाः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhreṣate ǀ jánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ reṣat ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ ghorám ǀ ā-vívāsāt ǀyajñáiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ índre ǀ dádhate ǀ dúvāṃsi ǀ kṣáyat ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ ṛta-pā́ḥ ǀ ṛte-jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who devotes his mind to the terribleIndranever falls (from his condition), nor will he perish; theprotector of sacred rites, the progeny of sacrifice, bestows riches on him who offers to Indra praises and prayerswith sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ पूर्वो॒ अप॑राय॒ शिक्ष॒न्नय॒ज्ज्याया॒न्कनी॑यसो दे॒ष्णम् । अ॒मृत॒ इत्पर्या॑सीत दू॒रमा चि॑त्र॒ चित्र्यं॑ भरा र॒यिं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ áparāya ǀ śíkṣan ǀ áyat ǀ jyā́yān ǀ kánīyasaḥ ǀ deṣṇám ǀamṛ́taḥ ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ āsīta ǀ dūrám ǀ ā́ ǀ citra ǀ cítryam ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That (wealth)Indra, which the prior has given to the posterior; which the elder may accept from theyounger; with which (the son) yet living dwells far away (separated from his father), confer, wonderful Indra, suchprecious riches upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त॑ इन्द्र प्रि॒यो जनो॒ ददा॑श॒दस॑न्निरे॒के अ॑द्रिव॒: सखा॑ ते । व॒यं ते॑ अ॒स्यां सु॑म॒तौ चनि॑ष्ठा॒: स्याम॒ वरू॑थे॒ अघ्न॑तो॒ नृपी॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ priyáḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ dádāśat ǀ ásat ǀ nireké ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ te ǀvayám ǀ te ǀ asyā́m ǀ su-matáu ǀ cániṣṭhāḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ várūthe ǀ ághnataḥ ǀ nṛ́-pītau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the man who is dear to you,Indra, present (oblations); may he be your friend, wielder of thethunderbolt, he (assiduous) in donations; may we be abounding in food through this favour of you who aredevoid of cruelty, (may we be in the enjoyment of) a dwelling giving shelter to men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्तोमो॑ अचिक्रद॒द्वृषा॑ त उ॒त स्ता॒मुर्म॑घवन्नक्रपिष्ट । रा॒यस्कामो॑ जरि॒तारं॑ त॒ आग॒न्त्वम॒ङ्ग श॑क्र॒ वस्व॒ आ श॑को नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ acikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ te ǀ utá ǀ stāmúḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ akrapiṣṭa ǀrāyáḥ ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ jaritā́ram ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ agan ǀ tvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ śakra ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śakaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Maghavan, this showeringSoma(libation) cries aloud; to you the worshipper has recitedpraises; the desire of riches has fallen upon thine adorer, do you, therefore,Śakra, bestow quickly upon uswealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑ इन्द्र॒ त्वय॑ताया इ॒षे धा॒स्त्मना॑ च॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो जु॒नन्ति॑ । वस्वी॒ षु ते॑ जरि॒त्रे अ॑स्तु श॒क्तिर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ tvá-yatāyai ǀ iṣé ǀ dhāḥ ǀ tmánā ǀ ca ǀ yé ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ junánti ǀvásvī ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ jaritré ǀ astu ǀ śaktíḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enable us,Indra, (to partake of) food granted by you, as well as those who, opulent (in sacrificialpresentations), spontaneously offer (you oblations); may there be power in thine adorer (to repeat) manylaudations; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑वि दे॒वं गोऋ॑जीक॒मन्धो॒ न्य॑स्मि॒न्निन्द्रो॑ ज॒नुषे॑मुवोच । बोधा॑मसि त्वा हर्यश्व य॒ज्ञैर्बोधा॑ न॒: स्तोम॒मन्ध॑सो॒ मदे॑षु
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright sacrificial food mixed with curds and milk has been poured out;Indradelights in it from his birth;lord of bay horses, we wake you up with sacrifices, acknowledge our praises in the exhilaration of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र य॑न्ति य॒ज्ञं वि॒पय॑न्ति ब॒र्हिः सो॑म॒मादो॑ वि॒दथे॑ दु॒ध्रवा॑चः । न्यु॑ भ्रियन्ते य॒शसो॑ गृ॒भादा दू॒रउ॑पब्दो॒ वृष॑णो नृ॒षाच॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “They repair to the sacrifice, they strew the sacred grass; the (grinding) stones at the ceremony are ofdifficulty suppressed noise; famous priests, whose voices are heard far off, bring the stones from the interior ofthe dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ स्रवि॑त॒वा अ॒पस्क॒: परि॑ष्ठिता॒ अहि॑ना शूर पू॒र्वीः । त्वद्वा॑वक्रे र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ न धेना॒ रेज॑न्ते॒ विश्वा॑ कृ॒त्रिमा॑णि भी॒षा
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, hero, have enabled the many waters arrested by Ahi to flow; by you the rivers rushed forth likecharioteers; all created worlds trembled through fear of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भी॒मो वि॑वे॒षायु॑धेभिरेषा॒मपां॑सि॒ विश्वा॒ नर्या॑णि वि॒द्वान् । इन्द्र॒: पुरो॒ जर्हृ॑षाणो॒ वि दू॑धो॒द्वि वज्र॑हस्तो महि॒ना ज॑घान
shlokas.meaning_en: “The formidable (Indra), knowing all actions beneficial to man, intimidated those (asuras) by hisweapons; Indra, exuling shook their cities; armed with his thunderbolt he slew them in his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न या॒तव॑ इन्द्र जूजुवुर्नो॒ न वन्द॑ना शविष्ठ वे॒द्याभि॑: । स श॑र्धद॒र्यो विषु॑णस्य ज॒न्तोर्मा शि॒श्नदे॑वा॒ अपि॑ गुॠ॒तं न॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not thrākṣasas,Indra, do us harm; let not the evil spirits do harm to our progeny, most powerful(Indra); let the sovereign lord, (Indra), exert himself (in the restraint) of disorderly beings, so that the unchastemay not disturb our rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि क्रत्वे॑न्द्र भू॒रध॒ ज्मन्न ते॑ विव्यङ्महि॒मानं॒ रजां॑सि । स्वेना॒ हि वृ॒त्रं शव॑सा ज॒घन्थ॒ न शत्रु॒रन्तं॑ विविदद्यु॒धा ते॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, by your function, preside over the beings (of earth); all the regions (of the world) do notsurpass your magnitude; by thine own strength you have slainVṛtra; no enemy has effected your destruction inbattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वाश्चि॑त्ते असु॒र्या॑य॒ पूर्वेऽनु॑ क्ष॒त्राय॑ ममिरे॒ सहां॑सि । इन्द्रो॑ म॒घानि॑ दयते वि॒षह्येन्द्रं॒ वाज॑स्य जोहुवन्त सा॒तौ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The older deities have confessed your vigour superior to their destructive strength,Indrahavingsubdued his foes, gives the rich spoils (to his worshippers); they invoke Indra to obtain food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: की॒रिश्चि॒द्धि त्वामव॑से जु॒हावेशा॑नमिन्द्र॒ सौभ॑गस्य॒ भूरे॑: । अवो॑ बभूथ शतमूते अ॒स्मे अ॑भिक्ष॒त्तुस्त्वाव॑तो वरू॒ता
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshipper has invoked you the sovereignIndra, for protection; protector of many, you have beento us the guardian of great fortune; be our defender against every overpowering (assailant).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑यस्त इन्द्र वि॒श्वह॑ स्याम नमोवृ॒धासो॑ महि॒ना त॑रुत्र । व॒न्वन्तु॑ स्मा॒ तेऽव॑सा समी॒के॒३॒॑ऽभी॑तिम॒र्यो व॒नुषां॒ शवां॑सि
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, daily increasing in reverence, be (regarded),Indra, (as) your friends; through the protection ofyou, surpasser in greatness, may (your worshippers) repulse the attack of the foe in battle, the strength of themalevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑ इन्द्र॒ त्वय॑ताया इ॒षे धा॒स्त्मना॑ च॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो जु॒नन्ति॑ । वस्वी॒ षु ते॑ जरि॒त्रे अ॑स्तु श॒क्तिर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enable us,Indra, (to partake of) food granted by you, as well as those who, opulent (in sacrificialpresentations), spontaneously offer the (oblations); may there be ability in thine adorer (to repeat) my laudations;and do you ever cherish us wiḥ blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॒ सोम॑मिन्द्र॒ मन्द॑तु त्वा॒ यं ते॑ सु॒षाव॑ हर्य॒श्वाद्रि॑: । सो॒तुर्बा॒हुभ्यां॒ सुय॑तो॒ नार्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ mándatu ǀ tvā ǀ yám ǀ te ǀ susā́va ǀ hari-aśva ǀ ádriḥ ǀsotúḥ ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ sú-yataḥ ǀ ná ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, theSoma; may it exhilarate you, that which the stone tightly held like a horse (by thereins), by the arms of the grinder, has expressed, lord of bay horses for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ मदो॒ युज्य॒श्चारु॒रस्ति॒ येन॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ हर्यश्व॒ हंसि॑ । स त्वामि॑न्द्र प्रभूवसो ममत्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ yújyaḥ ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ ásti ǀ yéna ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ hari-aśva ǀ háṃsi ǀsáḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀ mamattu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the exhilaratingSomawhich is fit for and suitable to you, by which, lord of bay horses, you slayVṛtra, exhilarate you,Indra, abounding in riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बोधा॒ सु मे॑ मघव॒न्वाच॒मेमां यां ते॒ वसि॑ष्ठो॒ अर्च॑ति॒ प्रश॑स्तिम् । इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ सध॒मादे॑ जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: bódha ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ magha-van ǀ vā́cam ǀ ā́ ǀ imā́m ǀ yā́m ǀ te ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ árcati ǀ prá-śastim ǀimā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ sadha-mā́de ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Understand thoroughly,Maghavan, this my speech, this praise of you, whichVasiṣṭharecites; bepleased by these prayers at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी हवं॑ विपिपा॒नस्याद्रे॒र्बोधा॒ विप्र॒स्यार्च॑तो मनी॒षाम् । कृ॒ष्वा दुवां॒स्यन्त॑मा॒ सचे॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ vi-pipānásya ǀ ádreḥ ǀ bódha ǀ víprasya ǀ árcataḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀkṛṣvá ǀ dúvāṃsi ǀ ántamā ǀ sácā ǀ imā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear the invocation of the (grinding) stone, (of me) repeatedly drinking (theSoma), comprehend thehymn of the adoring sage, and, friendly (with us), take to your near consideration these adorations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॒ गिरो॒ अपि॑ मृष्ये तु॒रस्य॒ न सु॑ष्टु॒तिम॑सु॒र्य॑स्य वि॒द्वान् । सदा॑ ते॒ नाम॑ स्वयशो विवक्मि
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ápi ǀ mṛṣye ǀ turásya ǀ ná ǀ su-stutím ǀ asuryásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀsádā ǀ te ǀ nā́ma ǀ sva-yaśaḥ ǀ vivakmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Knowing of your strength, I refrain not from the praise nor from the glorification of you, the destroyer (offoes), but ever proclaim your especial care.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॒ हि ते॒ सव॑ना॒ मानु॑षेषु॒ भूरि॑ मनी॒षी ह॑वते॒ त्वामित् । मारे अ॒स्मन्म॑घव॒ञ्ज्योक्क॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ sávanā ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǀ bhū́ri ǀ manīṣī́ ǀ havate ǀ tvā́m ǀ ít ǀmā́ ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ magha-van ǀ jyók ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the sacrifices offered,Maghavan, to you among mankind; constantly does worshipper indeedinvoke you; therefore be not far nor be a long time from us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्येदि॒मा सव॑ना शूर॒ विश्वा॒ तुभ्यं॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ वर्ध॑ना कृणोमि । त्वं नृभि॒र्हव्यो॑ वि॒श्वधा॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ ít ǀ imā́ ǀ sávanā ǀ śūra ǀ víśvā ǀ túbhyam ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ várdhanā ǀ kṛṇomi ǀtvám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ viśvádhā ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you, hero, I indeed offer these sacrifices, to you I address these elevating praises; you are to be inall ways invoked by the leaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू चि॒न्नु ते॒ मन्य॑मानस्य द॒स्मोद॑श्नुवन्ति महि॒मान॑मुग्र । न वी॒र्य॑मिन्द्र ते॒ न राध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ mányamānasya ǀ dasma ǀ út ǀ aśnuvanti ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ugra ǀná ǀ vīryám ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of goodly aspect, none attain the greatness of you who are to be honoured, nor, fierce Indra, yourheroism, nor your wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये च॒ पूर्व॒ ऋष॑यो॒ ये च॒ नूत्ना॒ इन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि ज॒नय॑न्त॒ विप्रा॑: । अ॒स्मे ते॑ सन्तु स॒ख्या शि॒वानि॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ca ǀ pū́rve ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ nū́tnāḥ ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ janáyanta ǀ víprāḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ te ǀ santu ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ śivā́ni ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your auspicious regards,Indra, be directed towards us, as they have been to those pious sages,ancient or recent, who have originated (your) praises, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ब्रह्मा॑ण्यैरत श्रव॒स्येन्द्रं॑ सम॒र्ये म॑हया वसिष्ठ । आ यो विश्वा॑नि॒ शव॑सा त॒तानो॑पश्रो॒ता म॒ ईव॑तो॒ वचां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ airata ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ índram ǀ sa-maryé ǀ mahaya ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ śávasā ǀ tatā́na ǀ upa-śrotā́ ǀ me ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ vácāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The sages) have offered prayers to (Indra) for food, worship Indra,Vasiṣṭhaat the sacrifice; may thatIndra who has spread out all (the regions) by his might, be the hearer of my words when approaching him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अया॑मि॒ घोष॑ इन्द्र दे॒वजा॑मिरिर॒ज्यन्त॒ यच्छु॒रुधो॒ विवा॑चि । न॒हि स्वमायु॑श्चिकि॒ते जने॑षु॒ तानीदंहां॒स्यति॑ पर्ष्य॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: áyāmi ǀ ghóṣaḥ ǀ indra ǀ devá-jāmiḥ ǀ irajyánta ǀ yát ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ ví-vāci ǀnahí ǀ svám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ cikité ǀ jáneṣu ǀ tā́ni ǀ ít ǀ áṃhāṃsi ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, the plural nts grow up, the sound (of praise) acceptable to the gods, (uttered) by theworshipper, has been raised; by no one among men, is his own life understood; convey us beyond all those sins(by which life is shortened).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒जे रथं॑ ग॒वेष॑णं॒ हरि॑भ्या॒मुप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि जुजुषा॒णम॑स्थुः । वि बा॑धिष्ट॒ स्य रोद॑सी महि॒त्वेन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्राण्य॑प्र॒ती ज॑घ॒न्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: yujé ǀ rátham ǀ go-éṣaṇam ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ jujuṣāṇám ǀ asthuḥ ǀví ǀ bādhiṣṭa ǀ syáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀ jaghanvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I harness (by praises) the kine-bestowing chariot (ofIndra) with his horses; (my) prayers have reachedhim who is plural ased (by devotion); he has surpassed in magnitude heaven and earth, slaying the unresistingenemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑श्चित्पिप्युः स्त॒र्यो॒३॒॑ न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्नृ॒तं ज॑रि॒तार॑स्त इन्द्र । या॒हि वा॒युर्न नि॒युतो॑ नो॒ अच्छा॒ त्वं हि धी॒भिर्दय॑से॒ वि वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ pipyuḥ ǀ staryáḥ ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ nákṣan ǀ ṛtám ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀyāhí ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áccha ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ dáyase ǀ ví ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the waters increase like young; may your worshippers,Indra, possess water (in abundance); comelike the wind with theNiyutsteeds, for you, (propitiated) by holy rites, verily bestow upon us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते त्वा॒ मदा॑ इन्द्र मादयन्तु शु॒ष्मिणं॑ तुवि॒राध॑सं जरि॒त्रे । एको॑ देव॒त्रा दय॑से॒ हि मर्ता॑न॒स्मिञ्छू॑र॒ सव॑ने मादयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ tvā ǀ mádāḥ ǀ indra ǀ mādayantu ǀ śuṣmíṇam ǀ tuvi-rā́dhasam ǀ jaritré ǀékaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ dáyase ǀ hí ǀ mártān ǀ asmín ǀ śūra ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these inebriating draughts exhilarate you,Indra; bestow upon the praiser (a son vigorous andwealthy); for you alone among the gods are compassionate to mortals; be exhilarated here at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदिन्द्रं॒ वृष॑णं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ वसि॑ष्ठासो अ॒भ्य॑र्चन्त्य॒र्कैः । स न॑: स्तु॒तो वी॒रव॑द्धातु॒ गोम॑द्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vájra-bāhum ǀ vásiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ arkáiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ pātu ǀ gó-mat ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this manner theVasiṣṭhasglorify with hymnsIndra, the showerer, the bearer of the thunderbolt; mayhe so glorified grant us wealth, comprisingmaleposterity and cattle; and do you ever cherish us with blessingṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: योनि॑ष्ट इन्द्र॒ सद॑ने अकारि॒ तमा नृभि॑: पुरुहूत॒ प्र या॑हि । असो॒ यथा॑ नोऽवि॒ता वृ॒धे च॒ ददो॒ वसू॑नि म॒मद॑श्च॒ सोमै॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “A plural ce has been prepared for you in the sacrificial chamber; proceed to it, invoked of many, along withthe leaders (of rites theMaruts), inasmuch as you are our protector, (promote our) prosperity; grant us riches; beexhilarated by theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒भी॒तं ते॒ मन॑ इन्द्र द्वि॒बर्हा॑: सु॒तः सोम॒: परि॑षिक्ता॒ मधू॑नि । विसृ॑ष्टधेना भरते सुवृ॒क्तिरि॒यमिन्द्रं॒ जोहु॑वती मनी॒षा
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your purpose,Indra, is apprehended, you who are mighty in the two (worlds); theSomais effused; thesweet juices are poured (into the vessels); this perfect praise uttered with loosened tongue propitiates Indra withrepeated invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दि॒व आ पृ॑थि॒व्या ऋ॑जीषिन्नि॒दं ब॒र्हिः सो॑म॒पेया॑य याहि । वह॑न्तु त्वा॒ हर॑यो म॒द्र्य॑ञ्चमाङ्गू॒षमच्छा॑ त॒वसं॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, Rijishin, from the sky, or from the firmament, to this sacred gras, to drink theSoma; let yourhorses bear you who are vigorous to my presence to (receive my) praise and for (thine) exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: स॒जोषा॒ ब्रह्म॑ जुषा॒णो ह॑र्यश्व याहि । वरी॑वृज॒त्स्थवि॑रेभिः सुशिप्रा॒स्मे दध॒द्वृष॑णं॒ शुष्म॑मिन्द्र
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of bay steeds, propitiated by our praise, come to us with all your protections, sharing insatisfaction, handsome-chinned, with the ancient (Maruts), overthrowing repeatedly (your) foes, and granting usa strong and vigorous (son).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्तोमो॑ म॒ह उ॒ग्राय॒ वाहे॑ धु॒री॒३॒॑वात्यो॒ न वा॒जय॑न्नधायि । इन्द्र॑ त्वा॒यम॒र्क ई॑ट्टे॒ वसू॑नां दि॒वी॑व॒ द्यामधि॑ न॒: श्रोम॑तं धाः
shlokas.meaning_en: “This invogorating praise, like a horse attached, to car, has been addressed to you who are mighty andfierce, the up-bearer (of the world); this thine adorer desires of you,Indra, riches; do you grant us sustenancenotorious as the sky in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑ इन्द्र॒ वार्य॑स्य पूर्धि॒ प्र ते॑ म॒हीं सु॑म॒तिं वे॑विदाम । इषं॑ पिन्व म॒घव॑द्भ्यः सु॒वीरां॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this manner,Indra, satisfy us (with the gift) of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yougreat giver; bestow upon us who are opulent (in offerings) food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ म॒ह इ॑न्द्रो॒त्यु॑ग्र॒ सम॑न्यवो॒ यत्स॒मर॑न्त॒ सेना॑: । पता॑ति दि॒द्युन्नर्य॑स्य बा॒ह्वोर्मा ते॒ मनो॑ विष्व॒द्र्य१॒॑ग्वि चा॑रीत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ maháḥ ǀ indra ǀ ūtī́ ǀ ugra ǀ sá-manyavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ sam-áranta ǀ sénāḥ ǀpátāti ǀ didyút ǀ náryasya ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ viṣvadryák ǀ ví ǀ cārīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra, when animated by like fierce armies, encounter them; let the bright (weapon) wielded bythe arms of you who are mighty and the friend of man descend for our protection; let not your all-pervading mindwander (away from us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि दु॒र्ग इ॑न्द्र श्नथिह्य॒मित्राँ॑ अ॒भि ये नो॒ मर्ता॑सो अ॒मन्ति॑ । आ॒रे तं शंसं॑ कृणुहि निनि॒त्सोरा नो॑ भर स॒म्भर॑णं॒ वसू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ duḥ-gé ǀ indra ǀ śnathihi ǀ amítrān ǀ abhí ǀ yé ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ amánti ǀāré ǀ tám ǀ śáṃsam ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ ninitsóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ sam-bháraṇam ǀ vásūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy,Indra, our adversaries in battle, those men who overpower us; remove far from us the calumnyof the reviler; bring to us abundance of treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं ते॑ शिप्रिन्नू॒तय॑: सु॒दासे॑ स॒हस्रं॒ शंसा॑ उ॒त रा॒तिर॑स्तु । ज॒हि वध॑र्व॒नुषो॒ मर्त्य॑स्या॒स्मे द्यु॒म्नमधि॒ रत्नं॑ च धेहि
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ te ǀ śiprin ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ sahásram ǀ śáṃsāḥ ǀ utá ǀ rātíḥ ǀ astu ǀjahí ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ mártyasya ǀ asmé íti ǀ dyumnám ǀ ádhi ǀ rátnam ǀ ca ǀ dhehi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May hundreds of your protections, handsome-chinned, be (secured) to the liberal donor (of oblations);may thousands of blessing be bestowed (upon me) as well as wealth; cast the fatal weapon on the mischievousmortal; grant us food and wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाव॑तो॒ ही॑न्द्र॒ क्रत्वे॒ अस्मि॒ त्वाव॑तोऽवि॒तुः शू॑र रा॒तौ । विश्वेदहा॑नि तविषीव उग्रँ॒ ओक॑: कृणुष्व हरिवो॒ न म॑र्धीः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-vataḥ ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ krátve ǀ ásmi ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ avitúḥ ǀ śūra ǀ rātáu ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ áhāni ǀ taviṣī-vaḥ ǀ ugra ǀ ókaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mardhīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am (in dependence),Indra, upon the acts of such as you are, upon the liberality of a protector, hero,such as you; vigorous and fierce Indra, give us a dwelling for all our days; lord of bay steeds, do us no harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुत्सा॑ ए॒ते हर्य॑श्वाय शू॒षमिन्द्रे॒ सहो॑ दे॒वजू॑तमिया॒नाः । स॒त्रा कृ॑धि सु॒हना॑ शूर वृ॒त्रा व॒यं तरु॑त्राः सनुयाम॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: kútsāḥ ǀ eté ǀ hári-aśvāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ índre ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ devá-jūtam ǀ iyānā́ḥ ǀsatrā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ su-hánā ǀ śūra ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ vayám ǀ tárutrāḥ ǀ sanuyāma ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (Vasiṣṭhas) are offering grateful (adoration) to the lord of bay steeds, soliciting the strengthassigned by the gods toIndra; make our enemies, Indra, easy to be overcome, and may we, safe from peril,enjoy abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑ इन्द्र॒ वार्य॑स्य पूर्धि॒ प्र ते॑ म॒हीं सु॑म॒तिं वे॑विदाम । इषं॑ पिन्व म॒घव॑द्भ्यः सु॒वीरां॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vā́ryasya ǀ pūrdhi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mahī́m ǀ su-matím ǀ vevidāma ǀíṣam ǀ pinva ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ su-vī́rām ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this manner,Indra, satisfy us with the gift of desirable (wealth); may we repeatedly experience yourgreat favour; bestow upon us who are opulent in offerings food withmaledescendants; do you ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न सोम॒ इन्द्र॒मसु॑तो ममाद॒ नाब्र॑ह्माणो म॒घवा॑नं सु॒तास॑: । तस्मा॑ उ॒क्थं ज॑नये॒ यज्जुजो॑षन्नृ॒वन्नवी॑यः शृ॒णव॒द्यथा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ásutaḥ ǀ mamāda ǀ ná ǀ ábrahmāṇaḥ ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀtásmai ǀ ukthám ǀ janaye ǀ yát ǀ jújoṣat ǀ nṛ-vát ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomauneffused delights notIndra; the effused juices plural ase notMaghavan, unaccompanied byprayer; therefore, I offer to him praise that he may be plural ased with; that, like a prince, he may listen to a novel(strain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थौ॑क्थे॒ सोम॒ इन्द्रं॑ ममाद नी॒थेनी॑थे म॒घवा॑नं सु॒तास॑: । यदीं॑ स॒बाध॑: पि॒तरं॒ न पु॒त्राः स॑मा॒नद॑क्षा॒ अव॑से॒ हव॑न्ते
shlokas.transliteration: ukthé-ukthe ǀ sómaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mamāda ǀ nīthé-nīthe ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ ná ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ samāná-dakṣāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaeffused with reiterated prayer delightsIndra; the effused juices, (offered) with repeatedpraise, (exhilarate)Maghavan; therefore, (the priests), combining together and making like exertion, invoke Indrafor protection, as sons (apply) to a father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒कार॒ ता कृ॒णव॑न्नू॒नम॒न्या यानि॑ ब्रु॒वन्ति॑ वे॒धस॑: सु॒तेषु॑ । जनी॑रिव॒ पति॒रेक॑: समा॒नो नि मा॑मृजे॒ पुर॒ इन्द्र॒: सु सर्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: cakā́ra ǀ tā́ ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ nūnám ǀ anyā́ ǀ yā́ni ǀ bruvánti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ sutéṣu ǀjánīḥ-iva ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ samānáḥ ǀ ní ǀ mamṛje ǀ púraḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sú ǀ sárvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such exploits as his worshippers, when theSomais effused, proclaim that he has achieved, let himnow perform; mayIndra, equal (to the task) and unaided, possess all the riches (of theasuras) as a husband hiswives.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा तमा॑हुरु॒त शृ॑ण्व॒ इन्द्र॒ एको॑ विभ॒क्ता त॒रणि॑र्म॒घाना॑म् । मि॒थ॒स्तुर॑ ऊ॒तयो॒ यस्य॑ पू॒र्वीर॒स्मे भ॒द्राणि॑ सश्चत प्रि॒याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ tám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ utá ǀ śṛṇve ǀ índraḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ maghā́nām ǀmithaḥ-túraḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhadrā́ṇi ǀ saścata ǀ priyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such have they proclaimed him;Indrais still celebrated as the distributor of riches, the transporter(beyond calamity), of whom many and emulous are the protections; may acceptable benefits attend us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा वसि॑ष्ठ॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॒ नॄन्कृ॑ष्टी॒नां वृ॑ष॒भं सु॒ते गृ॑णाति । स॒ह॒स्रिण॒ उप॑ नो माहि॒ वाजा॑न्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǀ nṝ́n ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ suté ǀ gṛṇāti ǀsahasríṇaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ māhi ǀ vā́jān ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus doesVasiṣṭhaglorifyIndra, the showerer (of benefits) upon the worshippers for the preservationof mankind; bestow upon us, (Indra), thousands of viands; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ नरो॑ ने॒मधि॑ता हवन्ते॒ यत्पार्या॑ यु॒नज॑ते॒ धिय॒स्ताः । शूरो॒ नृषा॑ता॒ शव॑सश्चका॒न आ गोम॑ति व्र॒जे भ॑जा॒ त्वं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ náraḥ ǀ nemá-dhitā ǀ havante ǀ yát ǀ pā́ryāḥ ǀ yunájate ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ nṛ́-sātā ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǀ bhaja ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men invokeIndrain battle when those actions which lead to victory are performed; do you who arehero, the benefactor of man, the desirer of prowess, plural ce us in possession of pastures abounding with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॑न्द्र॒ शुष्मो॑ मघवन्ते॒ अस्ति॒ शिक्षा॒ सखि॑भ्यः पुरुहूत॒ नृभ्य॑: । त्वं हि दृ॒ळ्हा म॑घव॒न्विचे॑ता॒ अपा॑ वृधि॒ परि॑वृतं॒ न राध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ te ǀ ásti ǀ śíkṣa ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ magha-van ǀ ví-cetāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǀ pári-vṛtam ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the invoked of many, give to those men who are your friends that strength which,Maghavan, is thine; you, Maghavan (has forced open) the firm (shut, gates of cities); discover, discrimiantor (oftruth), the treasure now concealed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ राजा॒ जग॑तश्चर्षणी॒नामधि॒ क्षमि॒ विषु॑रूपं॒ यदस्ति॑ । ततो॑ ददाति दा॒शुषे॒ वसू॑नि॒ चोद॒द्राध॒ उप॑स्तुतश्चिद॒र्वाक्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ jágataḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀ víṣu-rūpam ǀ yát ǀ ásti ǀtátaḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásūni ǀ códat ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ úpa-stutaḥ ǀ cit ǀ arvā́k ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrais lord of the earth and of men; (his is) the various wealth that exists upon the earth; thence hegives riches to the donor (of oblations); may he, glorified by us, bestow upon us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू चि॑न्न॒ इन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॒ सहू॑ती दा॒नो वाजं॒ नि य॑मते न ऊ॒ती । अनू॑ना॒ यस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा पी॒पाय॑ वा॒मं नृभ्यो॑ अ॒भिवी॑ता॒ सखि॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sá-hūtī ǀ dānáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ní ǀ yamate ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀánūnā ǀ yásya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ pīpā́ya ǀ vāmám ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ abhí-vītā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the affluent and liberal,Indra, upon being invoked together (with theMaruts), quickly bestow foodfor our reservation, he whose unlimited, experienced liberality yields desirable (wealth) to those men (who arehis) friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू इ॑न्द्र रा॒ये वरि॑वस्कृधी न॒ आ ते॒ मनो॑ ववृत्याम म॒घाय॑ । गोम॒दश्वा॑व॒द्रथ॑व॒द्व्यन्तो॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ indra ǀ rāyé ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ vavṛtyāma ǀ maghā́ya ǀgó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ rátha-vat ǀ vyántaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, grant quickly wealh for our enricment; may we attract your favour by our adoration; granting us(riches), comprising cattle and horses and chariots; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा॑ ण इ॒न्द्रोप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान॒र्वाञ्च॑स्ते॒ हर॑यः सन्तु यु॒क्ताः । विश्वे॑ चि॒द्धि त्वा॑ वि॒हव॑न्त॒ मर्ता॑ अ॒स्माक॒मिच्छृ॑णुहि विश्वमिन्व
shlokas.transliteration: bráhmā ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ arvā́ñcaḥ ǀ te ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ santu ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀvíśve ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ vi-hávanta ǀ mártāḥ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ ít ǀ śṛṇuhi ǀ viśvam-inva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are wise, come to our adoration; let your horses harnessed be before us; gratified of all(men), all mortals severally invoke you; hear, therefore, our (invocation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हवं॑ त इन्द्र महि॒मा व्या॑न॒ड्ब्रह्म॒ यत्पासि॑ शवसि॒न्नृषी॑णाम् । आ यद्वज्रं॑ दधि॒षे हस्त॑ उग्र घो॒रः सन्क्रत्वा॑ जनिष्ठा॒ अषा॑ळ्हः
shlokas.transliteration: hávam ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahimā́ ǀ ví ǀ ānaṭ ǀ bráhma ǀ yát ǀ pā́si ǀ śavasin ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀā́ ǀ yát ǀ vájram ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ háste ǀ ugra ǀ ghoráḥ ǀ sán ǀ krátvā ǀ janiṣṭhāḥ ǀ áṣāḷhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with strength, since you grant the prayers of the Ṛṣis, let your greatness,Indra, extend tothine invoker; and as, fierce deity, you hold the thunderbolt in yourhand, then formidable by your exploits youhave become invincible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ प्रणी॑तीन्द्र॒ जोहु॑वाना॒न्त्सं यन्नॄन्न रोद॑सी नि॒नेथ॑ । म॒हे क्ष॒त्राय॒ शव॑से॒ हि ज॒ज्ञेऽतू॑तुजिं चि॒त्तूतु॑जिरशिश्नत्
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ indra ǀ jóhuvānān ǀ sám ǀ yát ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ná ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ninétha ǀmahé ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ hí ǀ jajñé ǀ átūtujim ǀ cit ǀ tū́tujiḥ ǀ aśiśnat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since,Indra, by your guidance, you have conducted men, your zealous worshippers, over heaven andearth, you are born to (bestow) great wealth and strength, whence the presenter of offerings overcomes him whooffers them not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒भिर्न॑ इ॒न्द्राह॑भिर्दशस्य दुर्मि॒त्रासो॒ हि क्षि॒तय॒: पव॑न्ते । प्रति॒ यच्चष्टे॒ अनृ॑तमने॒ना अव॑ द्वि॒ता वरु॑णो मा॒यी न॑: सात्
shlokas.transliteration: ebhíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ daśasya ǀ duḥ-mitrā́saḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pávante ǀpráti ǀ yát ǀ cáṣṭe ǀ ánṛtam ǀ anenā́ḥ ǀ áva ǀ dvitā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ māyī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, with these days, (wealth), for unfriendly men approach; may the untruth which the wiseand sinlessVaruṇaobserves in us, (through your favour, Indra), doubly disappear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वो॒चेमेदिन्द्रं॑ म॒घवा॑नमेनं म॒हो रा॒यो राध॑सो॒ यद्दद॑न्नः । यो अर्च॑तो॒ ब्रह्म॑कृति॒मवि॑ष्ठो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us glorify that opulentIndra, that he may give us great and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the pious rites of the worshipper; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सोम॑ इन्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॑ सुन्व॒ आ तु प्र या॑हि हरिव॒स्तदो॑काः । पिबा॒ त्व१॒॑स्य सुषु॑तस्य॒ चारो॒र्ददो॑ म॒घानि॑ मघवन्निया॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sunve ǀ ā́ ǀ tú ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ tát-okāḥ ǀpíba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ sú-sutasya ǀ cā́roḥ ǀ dádaḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀ magha-van ǀ iyānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomais poured out,Indra, for you; come, lord of bay steeds, to that dwelling (where it isprepared), drink of the plural ntifully-effused and grateful (libation), give us,Maghavan, when solicited for them,riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑न्वीर॒ ब्रह्म॑कृतिं जुषा॒णो॑ऽर्वाची॒नो हरि॑भिर्याहि॒ तूय॑म् । अ॒स्मिन्नू॒ षु सव॑ने मादय॒स्वोप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि शृणव इ॒मा न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bráhman ǀ vīra ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ arvācīnáḥ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀasmín ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǀ úpa ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ śṛṇavaḥ ǀ imā́ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Magnified hero,Indra, approving of the sacred rite, come to us speedily with your steeds; be exhilaratedat this sacrifice; hear these our prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का ते॑ अ॒स्त्यरं॑कृतिः सू॒क्तैः क॒दा नू॒नं ते॑ मघवन्दाशेम । विश्वा॑ म॒तीरा त॑तने त्वा॒याधा॑ म इन्द्र शृणवो॒ हवे॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ te ǀ asti ǀ áram-kṛtiḥ ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśema ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ matī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tatane ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ ádha ǀ me ǀ indra ǀ śṛṇavaḥ ǀ hávā ǀ imā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What satisfaction is there to you from our hymns? When,Maghavan, may we indeed present to you(oblations)? I expatiate in all praises addressed to you; hear,Indra, these my invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो घा॒ ते पु॑रु॒ष्या॒३॒॑ इदा॑स॒न्येषां॒ पूर्वे॑षा॒मशृ॑णो॒ॠषी॑णाम् । अधा॒हं त्वा॑ मघवञ्जोहवीमि॒ त्वं न॑ इन्द्रासि॒ प्रम॑तिः पि॒तेव॑
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ gha ǀ té ǀ puruṣyā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ āsan ǀ yéṣām ǀ pū́rveṣām ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀádha ǀ ahám ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ johavīmi ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ prá-matiḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Friendly to man were those ancien Ṛṣis whose praise you have listened to; therefore, I repeatedlyinvoke you,Maghavan; you,Indra, are well affected towards us as a parent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वो॒चेमेदिन्द्रं॑ म॒घवा॑नमेनं म॒हो रा॒यो राध॑सो॒ यद्दद॑न्नः । यो अर्च॑तो॒ ब्रह्म॑कृति॒मवि॑ष्ठो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us glorify that opulentIndra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches, he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ देव॒ शव॑सा याहि शुष्मि॒न्भवा॑ वृ॒ध इ॑न्द्र रा॒यो अ॒स्य । म॒हे नृ॒म्णाय॑ नृपते सुवज्र॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्राय॒ पौंस्या॑य शूर
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ śávasā ǀ yāhi ǀ śuṣmin ǀ bháva ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ asyá ǀmahé ǀ nṛmṇā́ya ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ su-vajra ǀ máhi ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ páuṃsyāya ǀ śūra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine and powerful (Indra), come to us with your strength; be the augmenter of our riches; be to us,king of men, wielder of the thunderbolt, for (a source of) vigour, of great prowess, hero, of manhood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हव॑न्त उ त्वा॒ हव्यं॒ विवा॑चि त॒नूषु॒ शूरा॒: सूर्य॑स्य सा॒तौ । त्वं विश्वे॑षु॒ सेन्यो॒ जने॑षु॒ त्वं वृ॒त्राणि॑ रन्धया सु॒हन्तु॑
shlokas.transliteration: hávante ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ hávyam ǀ ví-vāci ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sātáu ǀtvám ǀ víśveṣu ǀ sényaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ tvám ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ randhaya ǀ su-hántu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Warriors invoke you, worthy to be invoked, in the variously clamorous (strife), for (the safety of their)person ns, and for the (long) enjoyment of the sun; you are a fit leader over all men; humble our enemies by thefatal (bolt).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहा॒ यदि॑न्द्र सु॒दिना॑ व्यु॒च्छान्दधो॒ यत्के॒तुमु॑प॒मं स॒मत्सु॑ । न्य१॒॑ग्निः सी॑द॒दसु॑रो॒ न होता॑ हुवा॒नो अत्र॑ सु॒भगा॑य दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: áhā ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ su-dínā ǀ vi-ucchā́n ǀ dádhaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ketúm ǀ upa-mám ǀ samát-su ǀní ǀ agníḥ ǀ sīdat ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ ná ǀ hótā ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ átra ǀ su-bhágāya ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, fortunate days arise, when you advance your emblem in battles, the strongAgni, theinvoker of the gods, summoning the gods hither for our benefit, sits down on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते त॑ इन्द्र॒ ये च॑ देव॒ स्तव॑न्त शूर॒ दद॑तो म॒घानि॑ । यच्छा॑ सू॒रिभ्य॑ उप॒मं वरू॑थं स्वा॒भुवो॑ जर॒णाम॑श्नवन्त
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ té ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ deva ǀ stávanta ǀ śūra ǀ dádataḥ ǀ maghā́ni ǀyáccha ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ várūtham ǀ su-ābhúvaḥ ǀ jaraṇā́m ǀ aśnavanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, divineIndra, who are yours, are they, hero, who are praising you and offering rich libations; grantto (your) pious (worshippers) an excellent abode; and may they, prosperous, attain old age.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वो॒चेमेदिन्द्रं॑ म॒घवा॑नमेनं म॒हो रा॒यो राध॑सो॒ यद्दद॑न्नः । यो अर्च॑तो॒ ब्रह्म॑कृति॒मवि॑ष्ठो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: vocéma ǀ ít ǀ índram ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ enam ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ árcataḥ ǀ bráhma-kṛtim ǀ áviṣṭhaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us glorify the opulentIndra, that he may give us vast and valuable riches; he who is the chiefprotector of the religious rites of the worshippers; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ माद॑नं॒ हर्य॑श्वाय गायत । सखा॑यः सोम॒पाव्ने॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ mā́danam ǀ hári-aśvāya ǀ gāyata ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ soma-pā́vne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing, friends, an exhilarating hymn toIndra, the lord of bay steeds, the drinker of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शंसेदु॒क्थं सु॒दान॑व उ॒त द्यु॒क्षं यथा॒ नर॑: । च॒कृ॒मा स॒त्यरा॑धसे
shlokas.transliteration: śáṃsa ǀ ít ǀ ukthám ǀ su-dā́nave ǀ utá ǀ dyukṣám ǀ yáthā ǀ náraḥ ǀcakṛmá ǀ satyá-rādhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeat to the liberalIndrasuch brilliant praise as other (men repeat); let us offer it to him who is affluentin truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑ इन्द्र वाज॒युस्त्वं ग॒व्युः श॑तक्रतो । त्वं हि॑रण्य॒युर्व॑सो
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ tvám ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtvám ǀ hiraṇya-yúḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, be willing to give us food; be willing,Śatakratu, to give us cattle; be willing, donor ofdwelling, to us gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमि॑न्द्र त्वा॒यवो॒ऽभि प्र णो॑नुमो वृषन् । वि॒द्धी त्व१॒॑स्य नो॑ वसो
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ vṛṣan ǀviddhí ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to you, showerer (of benefits), we glorify you; be cognizant, giver of dwellings, of this ourpraise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ नि॒दे च॒ वक्त॑वे॒ऽर्यो र॑न्धी॒ररा॑व्णे । त्वे अपि॒ क्रतु॒र्मम॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nidé ǀ ca ǀ váktave ǀ aryáḥ ǀ randhīḥ ǀ árāvṇe ǀtvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ krátuḥ ǀ máma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are lord, subject us not to the reviler, to the abuser, to the withholder of offerings; may myworship verily (find favour) with you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं वर्मा॑सि स॒प्रथ॑: पुरोयो॒धश्च॑ वृत्रहन् । त्वया॒ प्रति॑ ब्रुवे यु॒जा
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ várma ǀ asi ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ puraḥ-yodháḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀtváyā ǀ práti ǀ bruve ǀ yujā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer of enemies, you,Indra, are our armour, vast and our preceder in battle; with you for my ally I defy(the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ उ॒तासि॒ यस्य॒ तेऽनु॑ स्व॒धाव॑री॒ सह॑: । म॒म्नाते॑ इन्द्र॒ रोद॑सी
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ utá ǀ asi ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́varī íti svadhā́-varī ǀ sáhaḥ ǀmamnā́te íti ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You verily are great; and heaven and earth abounding with food, respect,Indra, your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ म॒रुत्व॑ती॒ परि॒ भुव॒द्वाणी॑ स॒याव॑री । नक्ष॑माणा स॒ह द्युभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ marútvatī ǀ pári ǀ bhúvat ǀ vā́ṇī ǀ sa-yā́varī ǀnákṣamāṇā ǀ sahá ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praises of your adorers, accompanying you (wherever you go), such as you are, and spreadingaround with radiance, reach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वास॒स्त्वान्विन्द॑वो॒ भुव॑न्द॒स्ममुप॒ द्यवि॑ । सं ते॑ नमन्त कृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvā́saḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ánu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ bhúvan ǀ dasmám ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀsám ǀ te ǀ namanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ascending libations proceed,Indra, to you, abiding in heaven, of goodly aspect; men bow inreverence before you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ म॒हे म॑हि॒वृधे॑ भरध्वं॒ प्रचे॑तसे॒ प्र सु॑म॒तिं कृ॑णुध्वम् । विश॑: पू॒र्वीः प्र च॑रा चर्षणि॒प्राः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ mahi-vṛ́dhe ǀ bharadhvam ǀ prá-cetase ǀ prá ǀ su-matím ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀvíśaḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ carṣaṇi-prā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring (libations) to the great (Indra), the giver of great (wealth); offer praise to the wise Indra; fulfiller (ofthe desires) of men, come to the people offering many (oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु॒व्यच॑से म॒हिने॑ सुवृ॒क्तिमिन्द्रा॑य॒ ब्रह्म॑ जनयन्त॒ विप्रा॑: । तस्य॑ व्र॒तानि॒ न मि॑नन्ति॒ धीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: uru-vyácase ǀ mahíne ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ índrāya ǀ bráhma ǀ janayanta ǀ víprāḥ ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sages engender sacred praise and (sacrificial) food for the wide- pervading, mightyIndra; theprudent impede not his functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ वाणी॒रनु॑त्तमन्युमे॒व स॒त्रा राजा॑नं दधिरे॒ सह॑ध्यै । हर्य॑श्वाय बर्हया॒ समा॒पीन्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ánutta-manyum ǀ evá ǀ satrā́ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ dadhire ǀ sáhadhyai ǀhári-aśvāya ǀ barhaya ǀ sám ǀ āpī́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praises truly enable the universal monarch,Indra, whose wrath is irresistible, to overcome (his foes);urge your kinsmen, (worthippers, to glorify) the lord of bay steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु त्वा॑ वा॒घत॑श्च॒नारे अ॒स्मन्नि री॑रमन् । आ॒रात्ता॑च्चित्सध॒मादं॑ न॒ आ ग॑ही॒ह वा॒ सन्नुप॑ श्रुधि
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ tvā ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ caná ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ ní ǀ rīraman ǀārā́ttāt ǀ cit ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀ sán ǀ úpa ǀ śrudhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not,Indra, (other) worshippers detain you far from us; come from whatever distance to ourassembly; present at this ceremony, hear our (prayers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे हि ते॑ ब्रह्म॒कृत॑: सु॒ते सचा॒ मधौ॒ न मक्ष॒ आस॑ते । इन्द्रे॒ कामं॑ जरि॒तारो॑ वसू॒यवो॒ रथे॒ न पाद॒मा द॑धुः
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ brahma-kṛ́taḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ mádhau ǀ ná ǀ mákṣaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀíndre ǀ kā́mam ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ ná ǀ pā́dam ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the libation is effused for you, these offerers of sacrifice swarm like flies around honey; the piouspraisers, desiring riches, fix their hope uponIndra, like a foot upon a chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यस्का॑मो॒ वज्र॑हस्तं सु॒दक्षि॑णं पु॒त्रो न पि॒तरं॑ हुवे
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ-kāmaḥ ǀ vájra-hastam ǀ su-dákṣiṇam ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ pitáram ǀ huve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of riches, I call upon the benevolent wielder of the thunderbolt, as a son upon a father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒म इन्द्रा॑य सुन्विरे॒ सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः । ताँ आ मदा॑य वज्रहस्त पी॒तये॒ हरि॑भ्यां या॒ह्योक॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ índrāya ǀ sunvire ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ mádāya ǀ vajra-hasta ǀ pītáye ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ yāhi ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheseSoma, mixed with curds, are poured out toIndra; come, wielder of the thunderbolt, with yourhorses of our dwelling, to drink there for (your) exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रव॒च्छ्रुत्क॑र्ण ईयते॒ वसू॑नां॒ नू चि॑न्नो मर्धिष॒द्गिर॑: । स॒द्यश्चि॒द्यः स॒हस्रा॑णि श॒ता दद॒न्नकि॒र्दित्स॑न्त॒मा मि॑नत्
shlokas.transliteration: śrávat ǀ śrút-karṇaḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vásūnām ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣat ǀ gíraḥ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ satā́ ǀ dádat ǀ nákiḥ ǀ dítsantam ǀ ā́ ǀ minat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, whose ear is ready to hear, listen to the suppliant for riches, and never disappoint ourprayers; he who is the giver of hundreds and thousands; may no one ever hinder him when willing to give.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वी॒रो अप्र॑तिष्कुत॒ इन्द्रे॑ण शूशुवे॒ नृभि॑: । यस्ते॑ गभी॒रा सव॑नानि वृत्रहन्त्सु॒नोत्या च॒ धाव॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ áprati-skutaḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ śūśuve ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ te ǀ gabhīrā́ ǀ sávanāni ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ sunóti ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhā́vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer ofVṛtra, the hero who offers sacrifices to you, who eagerly approaches you (with praises), he,(protected) byIndra, is unresisted (by anyone), and is honoured by men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भवा॒ वरू॑थं मघवन्म॒घोनां॒ यत्स॒मजा॑सि॒ शर्ध॑तः । वि त्वाह॑तस्य॒ वेद॑नं भजेम॒ह्या दू॒णाशो॑ भरा॒ गय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bháva ǀ várūtham ǀ magha-van ǀ maghónām ǀ yát ǀ sam-ájāsi ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀví ǀ tvā́-hatasya ǀ védanam ǀ bhajemahi ǀ ā́ ǀ duḥ-náśaḥ ǀ bhara ǀ gáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be a defence,Maghavan, to the wealthy (offerers in oblations), for you are the discomfiter of (our)adversaries; may we divide the spoil of the enemy slain by you, who are indestructible, bring it to our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒नोता॑ सोम॒पाव्ने॒ सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ । पच॑ता प॒क्तीरव॑से कृणु॒ध्वमित्पृ॒णन्नित्पृ॑ण॒ते मय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sunóta ǀ soma-pā́vne ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀpácata ǀ paktī́ḥ ǀ ávase ǀ kṛṇudhvám ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇán ǀ ít ǀ pṛṇaté ǀ máyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour out the libation toIndra, the thunderer, the drinker of theSoma; prepare the baked (cakes) tosatisfy him; do (what is agreeable to him), for he bestows happiness on (the worshipper) who plural ases them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा स्रे॑धत सोमिनो॒ दक्ष॑ता म॒हे कृ॑णु॒ध्वं रा॒य आ॒तुजे॑ । त॒रणि॒रिज्ज॑यति॒ क्षेति॒ पुष्य॑ति॒ न दे॒वास॑: कव॒त्नवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sredhata ǀ sominaḥ ǀ dákṣata ǀ mahé ǀ kṛṇudhvám ǀ rāyé ǀ ā-túje ǀtaráṇiḥ ǀ ít ǀ jayati ǀ kṣéti ǀ púṣyati ǀ ná ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ kavatnáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offerers of the libation, do not hesitate; be active; sacrifice to the mighty benefactor for the sake ofriches; the assiduous worshipper conquers (his enemies), dwells in a habitation, and prospers; the gods favournot the imperfect rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑: सु॒दासो॒ रथं॒ पर्या॑स॒ न री॑रमत् । इन्द्रो॒ यस्या॑वि॒ता यस्य॑ म॒रुतो॒ गम॒त्स गोम॑ति व्र॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ su-dā́saḥ ǀ rátham ǀ pári ǀ āsa ǀ ná ǀ rīramat ǀíndraḥ ǀ yásya ǀ avitā́ ǀ yásya ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gámat ǀ sáḥ ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one overturns, no one arrests the chariot of the liberal sacrificer; he, of whomIndrais the protector,of whom theMaruts(are the defenders), will walk in pastures filled with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गम॒द्वाजं॑ वा॒जय॑न्निन्द्र॒ मर्त्यो॒ यस्य॒ त्वम॑वि॒ता भुव॑: । अ॒स्माकं॑ बोध्यवि॒ता रथा॑नाम॒स्माकं॑ शूर नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: gámat ǀ vā́jam ǀ vājáyan ǀ indra ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ tvám ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ ráthānām ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śūra ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the man of whom you,Indra, are the protector, invigorating (you with praise), enjoy (abundant) food;be the preserver, hero, of our chariots, (the preserver) of our people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदिन्न्व॑स्य रिच्य॒तेंऽशो॒ धनं॒ न जि॒ग्युष॑: । य इन्द्रो॒ हरि॑वा॒न्न द॑भन्ति॒ तं रिपो॒ दक्षं॑ दधाति सो॒मिनि॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ricyate ǀ áṃśaḥ ǀ dhánam ǀ ná ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ hári-vān ǀ ná ǀ dabhanti ǀ tám ǀ rípaḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ dadhāti ǀ somíni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily (Indra's) share (of theSoma) exceeds (that of other deities) like the wealth of the victorious;enemies overcome not him, who is the lord of bay steeds, who gives strength to the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्त्र॒मख॑र्वं॒ सुधि॑तं सु॒पेश॑सं॒ दधा॑त य॒ज्ञिये॒ष्वा । पू॒र्वीश्च॒न प्रसि॑तयस्तरन्ति॒ तं य इन्द्रे॒ कर्म॑णा॒ भुव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: mántram ǀ ákharvam ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ su-péśasam ǀ dádhāta ǀ yajñíyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ caná ǀ prá-sitayaḥ ǀ taranti ǀ tám ǀ yáḥ ǀ índre ǀ kármaṇā ǀ bhúvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Address (toIndra), among the gods, the ample, well-uttered, and graceful prayer; many bonds entanglenot him who, by his devotion, abides in Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्तमि॑न्द्र॒ त्वाव॑सु॒मा मर्त्यो॑ दधर्षति । श्र॒द्धा इत्ते॑ मघव॒न्पार्ये॑ दि॒वि वा॒जी वाजं॑ सिषासति
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ tvā́-vasum ǀ ā́ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dadharṣati ǀśraddhā́ ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ magha-van ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǀ vājī́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sisāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What mortal,Indra, injures him who has you for his support? He who offers you (sacrificial) food,Maghavan, with faith, he obtains food on the day of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒घोन॑: स्म वृत्र॒हत्ये॑षु चोदय॒ ये दद॑ति प्रि॒या वसु॑ । तव॒ प्रणी॑ती हर्यश्व सू॒रिभि॒र्विश्वा॑ तरेम दुरि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: maghónaḥ ǀ sma ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ codaya ǀ yé ǀ dádati ǀ priyā́ ǀ vásu ǀtáva ǀ prá-nītī ǀ hari-aśva ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ tarema ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Animate (those men) for the destruction of their foes, who offer treasures which are dear to you, theabounder in wealth; may we, lord of bay steeds, along with (your) worshippers, pass over all difficulties by yourguidance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवेदि॑न्द्राव॒मं वसु॒ त्वं पु॑ष्यसि मध्य॒मम् । स॒त्रा विश्व॑स्य पर॒मस्य॑ राजसि॒ नकि॑ष्ट्वा॒ गोषु॑ वृण्वते
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ avamám ǀ vásu ǀ tvám ǀ puṣyasi ǀ madhyamám ǀsatrā́ ǀ víśvasya ǀ paramásya ǀ rājasi ǀ nákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ góṣu ǀ vṛṇvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yours,Indra, is the vast valuable wealth; you cherish the middling; you rule over all that which is themost precious; no one opposes you in (the recovering of the) cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं विश्व॑स्य धन॒दा अ॑सि श्रु॒तो य ईं॒ भव॑न्त्या॒जय॑: । तवा॒यं विश्व॑: पुरुहूत॒ पार्थि॑वोऽव॒स्युर्नाम॑ भिक्षते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ víśvasya ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ yé ǀ īm ǀ bhávanti ǀ ājáyaḥ ǀtáva ǀ ayám ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ pā́rthivaḥ ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ bhikṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are celebrated as the giver of wealth to all even where battles occur; all the people of theearth--desirous of protection, solicit you, the invoked of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ याव॑त॒स्त्वमे॒ताव॑द॒हमीशी॑य । स्तो॒तार॒मिद्दि॑धिषेय रदावसो॒ न पा॑प॒त्वाय॑ रासीय
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ yā́vataḥ ǀ tvám ǀ etā́vat ǀ ahám ǀ ī́śīya ǀstotā́ram ǀ ít ǀ didhiṣeya ǀ radavaso íti rada-vaso ǀ ná ǀ pāpa-tvā́ya ǀ rāsīya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If I were lord of as much (affluence) as you are,Indra, then might I support (your) worshippers,dispenser of wealth, and not squander it upon wickedness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिक्षे॑य॒मिन्म॑हय॒ते दि॒वेदि॑वे रा॒य आ कु॑हचि॒द्विदे॑ । न॒हि त्वद॒न्यन्म॑घवन्न॒ आप्यं॒ वस्यो॒ अस्ति॑ पि॒ता च॒न
shlokas.transliteration: śíkṣeyam ǀ ít ǀ maha-yaté ǀ divé-dive ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kuhacit-víde ǀnáhí ǀ tvát ǀ anyát ǀ magha-van ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ pitā́ ǀ caná ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I daily distribute wealth to the venerable wherever abiding; no other,Maghavan, than you is to besought by us; (no other is to us) a most excellent protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒रणि॒रित्सि॑षासति॒ वाजं॒ पुरं॑ध्या यु॒जा । आ व॒ इन्द्रं॑ पुरुहू॒तं न॑मे गि॒रा ने॒मिं तष्टे॑व सु॒द्र्व॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: taráṇiḥ ǀ ít ǀ sisāsati ǀ vā́jam ǀ púram-dhyā ǀ yujā́ ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ name ǀ girā́ ǀ nemím ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ su-drvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prompt offers (of praise), with solemn rites combined, acquires food; I bend down with adoration toyou,Indra, the invoker of many, as a carpenter bends the wooden circumference of the wheel.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न दु॑:ष्टु॒ती मर्त्यो॑ विन्दते॒ वसु॒ न स्रेध॑न्तं र॒यिर्न॑शत् । सु॒शक्ति॒रिन्म॑घव॒न्तुभ्यं॒ माव॑ते दे॒ष्णं यत्पार्ये॑ दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ duḥ-stutī́ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǀ ná ǀ srédhantam ǀ rayíḥ ǀ naśat ǀsu-śáktiḥ ǀ ít ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ mā́-vate ǀ deṣṇám ǀ yát ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A man acquires not wealth by unbecoming praise; affluence devolves not upon one obstructing(sacrifice) in you,Maghavan, is the power whereby bounty (may be shown) to such as I am on the day of libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॑ शूर नोनु॒मोऽदु॑ग्धा इव धे॒नव॑: । ईशा॑नम॒स्य जग॑तः स्व॒र्दृश॒मीशा॑नमिन्द्र त॒स्थुष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ śūra ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ ádugdhāḥ-iva ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀī́śānam ǀ asyá ǀ jágataḥ ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀ ī́śānam ǀ indra ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify you, hero, (Indra), the lord of all movable and stationary things, the beholder of the universe,with ladles filled (withSoma, like (the udders of) unmilked kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वावाँ॑ अ॒न्यो दि॒व्यो न पार्थि॑वो॒ न जा॒तो न ज॑निष्यते । अ॒श्वा॒यन्तो॑ मघवन्निन्द्र वा॒जिनो॑ ग॒व्यन्त॑स्त्वा हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā́-vān ǀ anyáḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́rthivaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ná ǀ janiṣyate ǀaśva-yántaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ gavyántaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No other such as you are, celestial or terrestrial, has been or will be born; desirous of horses, of food,of cattle affluentIndra, we invoke you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी ष॒तस्तदा भ॒रेन्द्र॒ ज्याय॒: कनी॑यसः । पु॒रू॒वसु॒र्हि म॑घवन्त्स॒नादसि॒ भरे॑भरे च॒ हव्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ satáḥ ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ índra ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ kánīyasaḥ ǀpuru-vásuḥ ǀ hí ǀ magha-van ǀ sanā́t ǀ ási ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ ca ǀ hávyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ElderIndra, bring that (wealth to me), being the junior, for,Maghavan, you have from the beginningbeen possessed of infinite treasure, and are to be adored at repeated sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॑ णुदस्व मघवन्न॒मित्रा॑न्त्सु॒वेदा॑ नो॒ वसू॑ कृधि । अ॒स्माकं॑ बोध्यवि॒ता म॑हाध॒ने भवा॑ वृ॒धः सखी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ nudasva ǀ magha-van ǀ amítrān ǀ su-védā ǀ naḥ ǀ vásu ǀ kṛdhi ǀasmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ avitā́ ǀ mahā-dhané ǀ bháva ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ sákhīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drive away,Maghavan, our enemies; render riches easy of acquisition; be our preserver in war; be theaugmenter of (the prosperity) of (your) friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ क्रतुं॑ न॒ आ भ॑र पि॒ता पु॒त्रेभ्यो॒ यथा॑ । शिक्षा॑ णो अ॒स्मिन्पु॑रुहूत॒ याम॑नि जी॒वा ज्योति॑रशीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ krátum ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pitā́ ǀ putrébhyaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀśíkṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ asmín ǀ puru-hūta ǀ yā́mani ǀ jīvā́ḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ aśīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us,Indra, wisdom, as a father (gives knowledge) to his sons; bestow wealth upon us on thisoccasion, you the invoked of many, so that we, living at the solemnity may (long) enjoy the light (of existence).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ अज्ञा॑ता वृ॒जना॑ दुरा॒ध्यो॒३॒॑ माशि॑वासो॒ अव॑ क्रमुः । त्वया॑ व॒यं प्र॒वत॒: शश्व॑तीर॒पोऽति॑ शूर तरामसि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ájñātāḥ ǀ vṛjánāḥ ǀ duḥ-ādhyáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ áśivāsaḥ ǀ áva ǀ kramuḥ ǀtváyā ǀ vayám ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ śáśvatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ tarāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let no unknown, wicked, malevolent, malignant (enemies) overpower us; may we, protected by you,cross over many waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्वि॒त्यञ्चो॑ मा दक्षिण॒तस्क॑पर्दा धियंजि॒न्वासो॑ अ॒भि हि प्र॑म॒न्दुः । उ॒त्तिष्ठ॑न्वोचे॒ परि॑ ब॒र्हिषो॒ नॄन्न मे॑ दू॒रादवि॑तवे॒ वसि॑ष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: śvityáñcaḥ ǀ mā ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ-kapardāḥ ǀ dhiyam-jinvā́saḥ ǀ abhí ǀ hí ǀ pra-mandúḥ ǀut-tíṣṭhan ǀ voce ǀ pári ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ ná ǀ me ǀ dūrā́t ǀ ávitave ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The white-complexioned accomplishers of holy ceremonies, wearing the lock of hair on the right side,have afforded me delight, when, rising up I call the leaders (of rites) to the sacred grass; theVasiṣṭhas, (mysons) should never be far from me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒रादिन्द्र॑मनय॒न्ना सु॒तेन॑ ति॒रो वै॑श॒न्तमति॒ पान्त॑मु॒ग्रम् । पाश॑द्युम्नस्य वाय॒तस्य॒ सोमा॑त्सु॒तादिन्द्रो॑ऽवृणीता॒ वसि॑ष्ठान्
shlokas.transliteration: dūrā́t ǀ índram ǀ anayan ǀ ā́ ǀ suténa ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vaiśantám ǀ áti ǀ pā́ntam ǀ ugrám ǀpā́śa-dyumnasya ǀ vāyatásya ǀ sómāt ǀ sutā́t ǀ índraḥ ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ vásiṣṭhān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Disgracing (Pāśadyumna), they brought from afar the fierceIndra, when drinking the ladle ofSomaathissacrifice, to (receive) the libation (ofSudāsa); Indra hastened from the effused Soma of Pāśadumna, theson of Vāyata, to theVasiṣṭhas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेन्नु कं॒ सिन्धु॑मेभिस्ततारे॒वेन्नु कं॑ भे॒दमे॑भिर्जघान । ए॒वेन्नु कं॑ दाशरा॒ज्ञे सु॒दासं॒ प्राव॒दिन्द्रो॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वो वसिष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ síndhum ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ tatāra ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ bhedám ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ jaghāna ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ dāśa-rājñé ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ índraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vaḥ ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the same manner was he, (Sudāsa) enabled by them easily to cross theSindhuriver; in the samemanner, through them he easily slew his foe; so in like manner,Vasiṣṭhas, through your prayers, did Indradefend Sudāsa in the war with the ten kings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जुष्टी॑ नरो॒ ब्रह्म॑णा वः पितॄ॒णामक्ष॑मव्ययं॒ न किला॑ रिषाथ । यच्छक्व॑रीषु बृह॒ता रवे॒णेन्द्रे॒ शुष्म॒मद॑धाता वसिष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: júṣṭī ǀ naraḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vaḥ ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ ákṣam ǀ avyayam ǀ ná ǀ kíla ǀ riṣātha ǀyát ǀ śákvarīṣu ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráveṇa ǀ índre ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ádadhāta ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By your prayers, leaders (of rites), is effected the gratificcation of your progenitors; I have set in motionthe axle (of the chariot); be no you intert, for by your sacred metres,Vasiṣṭhas, (chanted) with a loud voice, yousustain vigour inInda.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्द्यामि॒वेत्तृ॒ष्णजो॑ नाथि॒तासोऽदी॑धयुर्दाशरा॒ज्ञे वृ॒तास॑: । वसि॑ष्ठस्य स्तुव॒त इन्द्रो॑ अश्रोदु॒रुं तृत्सु॑भ्यो अकृणोदु लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ ít ǀ tṛṣṇá-jaḥ ǀ nāthitā́saḥ ǀ ádīdhayuḥ ǀ dāśa-rājñé ǀ vṛtā́saḥ ǀvásiṣṭhasya ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ aśrot ǀ urúm ǀ tṛ́tsu-bhyaḥ ǀ akṛṇot ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Suffering from thirst, soliciting (rain), supported (by the Tṛtsus) in the war with the tenrājās, (theVasiṣṭhas) madeIndraradiant as the sun; Indra heard (the praises) ofVasiṣṭhaglorifying him, and bestowed aspacious region on the Tṛtsus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒ण्डा इ॒वेद्गो॒अज॑नास आस॒न्परि॑च्छिन्ना भर॒ता अ॑र्भ॒कास॑: । अभ॑वच्च पुरए॒ता वसि॑ष्ठ॒ आदित्तृत्सू॑नां॒ विशो॑ अप्रथन्त
shlokas.transliteration: daṇḍā́ḥ-iva ǀ ít ǀ go-ájanāsaḥ ǀ āsan ǀ pári-chinnāḥ ǀ bharatā́ḥ ǀ arbhakā́saḥ ǀábhavat ǀ ca ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ tṛ́tsūnām ǀ víśaḥ ǀ aprathanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBharatas, inferior (to their foes), were shorn (of their possessions), like he staves for driving cattle,(stripped of their leaves and branches); butVasiṣṭhabecame their family priest, and the people of the Tṛtsusprospered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रय॑: कृण्वन्ति॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ रेत॑स्ति॒स्रः प्र॒जा आर्या॒ ज्योति॑रग्राः । त्रयो॑ घ॒र्मास॑ उ॒षसं॑ सचन्ते॒ सर्वाँ॒ इत्ताँ अनु॑ विदु॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ rétaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ā́ryāḥ ǀ jyótiḥ-agrāḥ ǀtráyaḥ ǀ gharmā́saḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ sacante ǀ sárvān ǀ ít ǀ tā́n ǀ ánu ǀ viduḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three shed moisture upon the regions, three are their glorious progeny, of which the chief is night;three communicators of warmth accompany the dawn; verily theVasiṣṭhasunderstand all these.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्य॑स्येव व॒क्षथो॒ ज्योति॑रेषां समु॒द्रस्ये॑व महि॒मा ग॑भी॒रः । वात॑स्येव प्रज॒वो नान्येन॒ स्तोमो॑ वसिष्ठा॒ अन्वे॑तवे वः
shlokas.transliteration: sū́ryasya-iva ǀ vakṣáthaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ samudrásya-iva ǀ mahimā́ ǀ gabhīráḥ ǀvā́tasya-iva ǀ pra-javáḥ ǀ ná ǀ anyéna ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vasiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ánu-etave ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The glory of theseVasi.ṣṭhas is like the splendour of the sun; their greatness as profound as (thedepth of) the ocean; your praise,Vasiṣṭhas, has the velocity of the wind; by no other can it be surpassed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त इन्नि॒ण्यं हृद॑यस्य प्रके॒तैः स॒हस्र॑वल्शम॒भि सं च॑रन्ति । य॒मेन॑ त॒तं प॑रि॒धिं वय॑न्तोऽप्स॒रस॒ उप॑ सेदु॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ niṇyám ǀ hṛ́dayasya ǀ pra-ketáiḥ ǀ sahásra-valśam ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ caranti ǀyaména ǀ tatám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ váyantaḥ ǀ apsarásaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ seduḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the wisdom seated in the heart theVasiṣṭhastraverse the hidden thousand branched world, andtheApsarasassit down wearing the vesture spread out byYama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्युतो॒ ज्योति॒: परि॑ सं॒जिहा॑नं मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ यदप॑श्यतां त्वा । तत्ते॒ जन्मो॒तैकं॑ वसिष्ठा॒गस्त्यो॒ यत्त्वा॑ वि॒श आ॑ज॒भार॑
shlokas.transliteration: vi-dyútaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ pári ǀ sam-jíhānam ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ yát ǀ ápaśyatām ǀ tvā ǀtát ǀ te ǀ jánma ǀ utá ǀ ékam ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ agástyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ viśáḥ ǀ ā-jabhā́ra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenMitraandVaruṇabeheld you,Vasiṣṭha, quitting the lustre of the lightning (for a different form),then one of your births (took plural ce), inasmuch asAgastyabore you from your (former) abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तासि॑ मैत्रावरु॒णो व॑सिष्ठो॒र्वश्या॑ ब्रह्म॒न्मन॒सोऽधि॑ जा॒तः । द्र॒प्सं स्क॒न्नं ब्रह्म॑णा॒ दैव्ये॑न॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः पुष्क॑रे त्वाददन्त
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ asi ǀ maitrāvaruṇáḥ ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ urváśyāḥ ǀ brahman ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ jātáḥ ǀdrapsám ǀ skannám ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ dáivyena ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ púṣkare ǀ tvā ǀ adadanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Vasiṣṭhayou are the son ofMitraandVaruṇa, born,Brahmā, of the will ofUrvaśī, after theseminal effusion; all the gods have sustained you, (endowed) with celestial and Vedic vigour in the lake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॑के॒त उ॒भय॑स्य प्रवि॒द्वान्त्स॒हस्र॑दान उ॒त वा॒ सदा॑नः । य॒मेन॑ त॒तं प॑रि॒धिं व॑यि॒ष्यन्न॑प्स॒रस॒: परि॑ जज्ञे॒ वसि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ pra-vidvā́n ǀ sahásra-dānaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ sá-dānaḥ ǀyaména ǀ tatám ǀ pari-dhím ǀ vayiṣyán ǀ apsarásaḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñe ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the sage, cognizant of both worlds, was the donor of thousands; he was verily donation; wearingthe vesture spread spread byYama,Vasiṣṭhawas born of theApsaras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्रे ह॑ जा॒तावि॑षि॒ता नमो॑भिः कु॒म्भे रेत॑: सिषिचतुः समा॒नम् । ततो॑ ह॒ मान॒ उदि॑याय॒ मध्या॒त्ततो॑ जा॒तमृषि॑माहु॒र्वसि॑ष्ठम्
shlokas.transliteration: satré ǀ ha ǀ jātáu ǀ iṣitā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ kumbhé ǀ rétaḥ ǀ sisicatuḥ ǀ samānám ǀtátaḥ ǀ ha ǀ mā́naḥ ǀ út ǀ iyāya ǀ mádhyāt ǀ tátaḥ ǀ jātám ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ āhuḥ ǀ vásiṣṭham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consecrated for the sacrifice, propitiated by praises, they,MitraandVaruṇa, poured a commoneffusion into the water-jar, from the midst of whichMānaarose, and from which also, they say,Vasiṣṭhawasborn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थ॒भृतं॑ साम॒भृतं॑ बिभर्ति॒ ग्रावा॑णं॒ बिभ्र॒त्प्र व॑दा॒त्यग्रे॑ । उपै॑नमाध्वं सुमन॒स्यमा॑ना॒ आ वो॑ गच्छाति प्रतृदो॒ वसि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: uktha-bhṛ́tam ǀ sāma-bhṛ́tam ǀ bibharti ǀ grā́vāṇam ǀ bíbhrat ǀ prá ǀ vadāti ǀ ágre ǀúpa ǀ enam ǀ ādhvam ǀ su-manasyámānāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ gacchāti ǀ pra-tṛdaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pratṛts,Agastyacomes to you; welcome him with devoted minds, and he in the foremost station directsthe reciter of the prayer, the chanter of the hymn, the grinder of the stone, and repeats (what is to be repeated).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शु॒क्रैतु॑ दे॒वी म॑नी॒षा अ॒स्मत्सुत॑ष्टो॒ रथो॒ न वा॒जी
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śukrā́ ǀ etu ǀ devī́ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ asmát ǀ sú-taṣṭaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May pure and divine praise proceed from us (to the gods) like a swift well-constructed chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दुः पृ॑थि॒व्या दि॒वो ज॒नित्रं॑ शृ॒ण्वन्त्यापो॒ अध॒ क्षर॑न्तीः
shlokas.transliteration: vidúḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janítram ǀ śṛṇvánti ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ádha ǀ kṣárantīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flowing waters having known the origin of earth and heaven; may they now hear (our praises).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑श्चिदस्मै॒ पिन्व॑न्त पृ॒थ्वीर्वृ॒त्रेषु॒ शूरा॒ मंस॑न्त उ॒ग्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ pínvanta ǀ pṛthvī́ḥ ǀ vṛtréṣu ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ máṃsante ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vast waters offer nourishment toIndra; fierce warriors (combating) with foes, glorify him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ धू॒र्ष्व॑स्मै॒ दधा॒ताश्वा॒निन्द्रो॒ न व॒ज्री हिर॑ण्यबाहुः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ asmai ǀ dádhāta ǀ áśvān ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrī́ ǀ híraṇya-bāhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke for him the horses of his chariot, theIndrais the wielder of the thunderbolt, the golden-armed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्र स्था॒ताहे॑व य॒ज्ञं याते॑व॒ पत्म॒न्त्मना॑ हिनोत
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ sthāta ǀ áha-iva ǀ yajñám ǀ yā́tā-iva ǀ pátman ǀ tmánā ǀ hinota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proceed to the sacrifice like one who goes along the road; proceed of your own accord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्मना॑ स॒मत्सु॑ हि॒नोत॑ य॒ज्ञं दधा॑त के॒तुं जना॑य वी॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tmánā ǀ samát-su ǀ hinóta ǀ yajñám ǀ dádhāta ǀ ketúm ǀ jánāya ǀ vīrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go of your own accord to battle; celebrate the significant and expiatory sacrifice for (the good of)mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑स्य॒ शुष्मा॑द्भा॒नुर्नार्त॒ बिभ॑र्ति भा॒रं पृ॑थि॒वी न भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ārta ǀ bíbharti ǀ bhārám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From the force of this (sacrifice) the sun rises; it sustains the burden (of the world) as (earth) supportsmany (beings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह्वया॑मि दे॒वाँ अया॑तुरग्ने॒ साध॑न्नृ॒तेन॒ धियं॑ दधामि
shlokas.transliteration: hváyāmi ǀ devā́n ǀ áyātuḥ ǀ agne ǀ sā́dhan ǀ ṛténa ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the gods,Agni, propitiating them by an inoffensive rite, I celebrate a pious act.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वो॑ दे॒वीं धियं॑ दधिध्वं॒ प्र वो॑ देव॒त्रा वाचं॑ कृणुध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ devī́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhidhvam ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer (worshippers) your heavenly worship; earnestly address your praises to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ च॑ष्ट आसां॒ पाथो॑ न॒दीनां॒ वरु॑ण उ॒ग्रः स॒हस्र॑चक्षाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ caṣṭe ǀ āsām ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀ nadī́nām ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ sahásra-cakṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fierceVaruṇa, the thousand-eyed, contemplates the water of these rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॑ रा॒ष्ट्रानां॒ पेशो॑ न॒दीना॒मनु॑त्तमस्मै क्ष॒त्रं वि॒श्वायु॑
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jā ǀ rāṣṭrā́nām ǀ péśaḥ ǀ nadī́nām ǀ ánuttam ǀ asmai ǀ kṣatrám ǀ viśvá-āyu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the king of kings; the beauty of the rivers his all-pervading strength is irresistible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवि॑ष्टो अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑सु वि॒क्ष्वद्युं॑ कृणोत॒ शंसं॑ निनि॒त्सोः
shlokas.transliteration: áviṣṭo íti ǀ asmā́n ǀ víśvāsu ǀ vikṣú ǀ ádyum ǀ kṛṇota ǀ śáṃsam ǀ ninitsóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us, gods, among all people; render extinct the calumny of the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्ये॑तु दि॒द्युद्द्वि॒षामशे॑वा यु॒योत॒ विष्व॒ग्रप॑स्त॒नूना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ etu ǀ didyút ǀ dviṣā́m ǀ áśevā ǀ yuyóta ǀ víṣvak ǀ rápaḥ ǀ tanū́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the blazing (weapons) of foes pass by innocuous; separate, (gods), universally (from us) the sin ofour bodies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवी॑न्नो अ॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यान्नमो॑भि॒: प्रेष्ठो॑ अस्मा अधायि॒ स्तोम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ávīt ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ havya-át ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ asmai ǀ adhāyi ǀ stómaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, the feeder on oblations, propitiated by our homage, protect us; to him has our praise beenaddressed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒जूर्दे॒वेभि॑र॒पां नपा॑तं॒ सखा॑यं कृध्वं शि॒वो नो॑ अस्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sa-jū́ḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápātam ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛdhvam ǀ śiváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify along with the gods our friend, the grandson of the waters; may he be propitious to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ब्जामु॒क्थैरहिं॑ गृणीषे बु॒ध्ने न॒दीनां॒ रज॑स्सु॒ षीद॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ap-jā́m ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ áhim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ budhné ǀ nadī́nām ǀ rájaḥ-su ǀ sī́dan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with hymns the disperser of the clouds in the firmament; the water-born, sitting among thewaters of the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॑ रि॒षे धा॒न्मा य॒ज्ञो अ॑स्य स्रिधदृता॒योः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ riṣé ǀ dhāt ǀ mā́ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ asya ǀ sridhat ǀ ṛta-yóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let notAhirbudhnyabe disposed to work us harm; let not the sacrifice of the worshipper bedisregarded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑ ए॒षु नृषु॒ श्रवो॑ धु॒: प्र रा॒ये य॑न्तु॒ शर्ध॑न्तो अ॒र्यः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ eṣú ǀ nṛ́ṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ dhuḥ ǀ prá ǀ rāyé ǀ yantu ǀ śárdhantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (the gods) bestow food upon our people; let foes contending for our riches perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तप॑न्ति॒ शत्रुं॒ स्व१॒॑र्ण भूमा॑ म॒हासे॑नासो॒ अमे॑भिरेषाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tápanti ǀ śátrum ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́ma ǀ mahā́-senāsaḥ ǀ ámebhiḥ ǀ eṣām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders of great armies, by the power of these (divinities), consume their foes, as he sun (scorches)the regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यन्न॒: पत्नी॒र्गम॒न्त्यच्छा॒ त्वष्टा॑ सुपा॒णिर्दधा॑तु वी॒रान्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ naḥ ǀ pátnīḥ ǀ gámanti ǀ áccha ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ su-pāṇíḥ ǀ dádhātu ǀ vīrā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the wives (of the gods) come before us, may the dextrousTvaṣṭāgrant usmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ न॒: स्तोमं॒ त्वष्टा॑ जुषेत॒ स्याद॒स्मे अ॒रम॑तिर्वसू॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ juṣeta ǀ syā́t ǀ asmé íti ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayTvaṣṭābe propitiated by this our praise; may he who is of comprehensive understanding beinclined to give us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता नो॑ रासन्राति॒षाचो॒ वसू॒न्या रोद॑सी वरुणा॒नी शृ॑णोतु । वरू॑त्रीभिः सुशर॒णो नो॑ अस्तु॒ त्वष्टा॑ सु॒दत्रो॒ वि द॑धातु॒ राय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsan ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ varuṇānī́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀvárūtrībhiḥ ǀ su-śaraṇáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ su-dátraḥ ǀ ví ǀ dadhātu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they who are the givers of gifts bestow upon us the treasure (we desire); mayRodasīandVaruṇānī hear (our supplications); may the genitive rousTvaṣṭātogether with these (our) protectresses, be oursure refuge; may they give us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नो॒ राय॒: पर्व॑ता॒स्तन्न॒ आप॒स्तद्रा॑ति॒षाच॒ ओष॑धीरु॒त द्यौः । वन॒स्पति॑भिः पृथि॒वी स॒जोषा॑ उ॒भे रोद॑सी॒ परि॑ पासतो नः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tát ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǀvánaspáti-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pári ǀ pāsataḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the mountains, the waters, the liberal (wives of the gods), the plural nts, also the heaven and theearth, consentient with the forest lords and both the heaven and earth, preserve for us those (coveted) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ तदु॒र्वी रोद॑सी जिहाता॒मनु॑ द्यु॒क्षो वरु॑ण॒ इन्द्र॑सखा । अनु॒ विश्वे॑ म॒रुतो॒ ये स॒हासो॑ रा॒यः स्या॑म ध॒रुणं॑ धि॒यध्यै॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tát ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ jihātām ǀ ánu ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ índra-sakhā ǀánu ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sahā́saḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ syāma ǀ dharúṇam ǀ dhiyádhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the vast heaven and earth consent, let the brilliantVaruṇa, of whomIndrais the friend consent; letall the victoriousMarutsconsent that we may be a recepacle for the retention of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॒ इन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निराप॒ ओष॑धीर्व॒निनो॑ जुषन्त । शर्म॑न्त्स्याम म॒रुता॑मु॒पस्थे॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ marútām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the herbs, the trees, be plural ased by our (praise); may we,(reclining) on the lap of theMaruts, enjoy felicity; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी भ॑वता॒मवो॑भि॒: शं न॒ इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा रा॒तह॑व्या । शमिन्द्रा॒सोमा॑ सुवि॒ताय॒ शं योः शं न॒ इन्द्रा॑पू॒षणा॒ वाज॑सातौ
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ bhavatām ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāváruṇā ǀ rātá-havyā ǀśám ǀ índrāsómā ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāpūṣáṇā ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndraandAgnibe (with us) with their protections for our hapiness; may Indra andVaruṇa, to whomoblations are offered, (be with us) for our happiness; may Indra andSomabe (with us) for our happiness, ourprosperity, our good; may Indra andPūṣanbe (with us) in battle for our triumph.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॒ भग॒: शमु॑ न॒: शंसो॑ अस्तु॒ शं न॒: पुरं॑धि॒: शमु॑ सन्तु॒ राय॑: । शं न॑: स॒त्यस्य॑ सु॒यम॑स्य॒ शंस॒: शं नो॑ अर्य॒मा पु॑रुजा॒तो अ॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ satyásya ǀ su-yámasya ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ puru-jātáḥ ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBhaga(promote) our happiness; may Śaṃsa be our happiness; may Purandhi be (with us for) ourhappiness; may riches be (a source of) happiness; may the benediction of the true and virtuous yield ushappiness; may the variously-manifestedAryamanbe (with us) for our felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ धा॒ता शमु॑ ध॒र्ता नो॑ अस्तु॒ शं न॑ उरू॒ची भ॑वतु स्व॒धाभि॑: । शं रोद॑सी बृह॒ती शं नो॒ अद्रि॒: शं नो॑ दे॒वानां॑ सु॒हवा॑नि सन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ dhātā́ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dhartā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ urūcī́ ǀ bhavatu ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀśám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ádriḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ su-hávāni ǀ santu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the creator be to us for happiness; may the discriminator (between virtue and vice,Varuṇa) be(with us) for our happiness; may the wide earth (contribute) with sustenance to our happiness; may the vastheaven and earth be (to us for) happiness; may the mountains (yield) us happiness; may our pious invocations ofthe gods secure us happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॑रनीको अस्तु॒ शं नो॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒श्विना॒ शम् । शं न॑: सु॒कृतां॑ सुकृ॒तानि॑ सन्तु॒ शं न॑ इषि॒रो अ॒भि वा॑तु॒ वात॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ jyótiḥ-anīkaḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇau ǀ aśvínā ǀ śám ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ su-kṛ́tām ǀ su-kṛtā́ni ǀ santu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vātu ǀ vā́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgni, whose countenance is light, be (with us) for our happiness; mayMitraandVaruṇa, may theAśvins be (present) for our felicity; may the virtuous be (promotive of) our happiness; may the restless wind blowfor our happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पू॒र्वहू॑तौ॒ शम॒न्तरि॑क्षं दृ॒शये॑ नो अस्तु । शं न॒ ओष॑धीर्व॒निनो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं नो॒ रज॑स॒स्पति॑रस्तु जि॒ष्णुः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ śám ǀ antárikṣam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ astu ǀ jiṣṇúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May heaven and earth, the first invoked, (promote) our happiness; may the firmament be happiness toour view; may the herbs, the trees, (yield) us happiness; may the victorious lord of the world, (Indra), be(favourable to) our felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ वसु॑भिर्दे॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ शमा॑दि॒त्येभि॒र्वरु॑णः सु॒शंस॑: । शं नो॑ रु॒द्रो रु॒द्रेभि॒र्जला॑ष॒: शं न॒स्त्वष्टा॒ ग्नाभि॑रि॒ह शृ॑णोतु
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ su-śáṃsaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ jálāṣaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ gnā́bhiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ śṛṇotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine (Indra), with theVasus, grant us happiness; may the justly-praisedVaruṇa, with theĀdityas, be (friendly to) our happiness; may the grief-assuagingRudra, with theRudras, be (for) our happiness;mayTvaṣṭā, with the wives of the gods, be (with us) for our happiness, and hear us at this solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॒: सोमो॑ भवतु॒ ब्रह्म॒ शं न॒: शं नो॒ ग्रावा॑ण॒: शमु॑ सन्तु य॒ज्ञाः । शं न॒: स्वरू॑णां मि॒तयो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं न॑: प्र॒स्व१॒॑: शम्व॑स्तु॒ वेदि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ bráhma ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ yajñā́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ svárūṇām ǀ mitáyaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ astu ǀ védiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theSomabe (offered for) our happiness; may the prayer be (uttered for) our happiness; may thestones (grind the Soma), the sacrifice be (solemnized for) our happiness; may the measured lengths of thesacrificialpostsbe (conducive to) our felicity; may the sacred grass be (strewn) for our happiness; may the altarbe (raised for) our happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॒: सूर्य॑ उरु॒चक्षा॒ उदे॑तु॒ शं न॒श्चत॑स्रः प्र॒दिशो॑ भवन्तु । शं न॒: पर्व॑ता ध्रु॒वयो॑ भवन्तु॒ शं न॒: सिन्ध॑व॒: शमु॑ स॒न्त्वाप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ uru-cákṣāḥ ǀ út ǀ etu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ dhruváyaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
