shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wide-seeing sun rise (for) our happines; may the four quarters of the horizon (exist for) ourfelicity; may the firm-set mountains be (for) our happiness; may the rivers, may the waters, be (diffused) for ourhappiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॒ अदि॑तिर्भवतु व्र॒तेभि॒: शं नो॑ भवन्तु म॒रुत॑: स्व॒र्काः । शं नो॒ विष्णु॒: शमु॑ पू॒षा नो॑ अस्तु॒ शं नो॑ भ॒वित्रं॒ शम्व॑स्तु वा॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ vratébhiḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-arkā́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavítram ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ astu ǀ vāyúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAditi, with holy observances, be (for) our happiness; may the glorifiedMarutsbe (friendly to) ourfelicity; mayViṣṇu, mayPūṣan, be (promoters of) our happiness; may the firmament be propitious to us; mayVāyu (blow for) our happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता त्राय॑माण॒: शं नो॑ भवन्तू॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः । शं न॑: प॒र्जन्यो॑ भवतु प्र॒जाभ्य॒: शं न॒: क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पति॑रस्तु श॒म्भुः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ trā́yamāṇaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ pra-jā́bhyaḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣétrasya ǀ pátiḥ ǀ astu ǀ śam-bhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine preservingSavitābe (radiant for) our happiness; may the opening dawns (break for)our happiness; mayParjanyabe (the granter of happiness) to our posterity; mayŚambhu, the lord of strength,be (the conferrer of) happiness upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ दे॒वा वि॒श्वदे॑वा भवन्तु॒ शं सर॑स्वती स॒ह धी॒भिर॑स्तु । शम॑भि॒षाच॒: शमु॑ राति॒षाच॒: शं नो॑ दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वा॒: शं नो॒ अप्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ viśvá-devāḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sahá ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ astu ǀśám ǀ abhi-sā́caḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine universal gods be (favourable) to our felicity; maySarasvatī, with holy rites, behappiness; may those who assist at sacrifices, those who are liberal of gifts. Be (conducive to) our happiness;may celestial, terrestrial and aquatic things be (subservient to) our happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं न॑: स॒त्यस्य॒ पत॑यो भवन्तु॒ शं नो॒ अर्व॑न्त॒: शमु॑ सन्तु॒ गाव॑: । शं न॑ ऋ॒भव॑: सु॒कृत॑: सु॒हस्ता॒: शं नो॑ भवन्तु पि॒तरो॒ हवे॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ satyásya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santu ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ háveṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the lords of truth be (propitious to) our happiness; may horses, may cattle, (contribute to) ourhappiness; may the virtuous, the dexterousṚbhus, be to us (for) felicity; may the progenitors be (promoters of)our happiness at the seasons of worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ अ॒ज एक॑पाद्दे॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ शं नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्य१॒॑: शं स॑मु॒द्रः । शं नो॑ अ॒पां नपा॑त्पे॒रुर॑स्तु॒ शं न॒: पृश्नि॑र्भवतु दे॒वगो॑पा
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ ajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ śám ǀ samudráḥ ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ perúḥ ǀ astu ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ devá-gopā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine Aja-Ekapād be (favourable to) our happiness; mayAhirbudhnya, may the firmament, be(promotive of) our happiness; may the grandson of the waters, the protector, be (the securer of) our felicity; mayPṛśni, of whom the gods are the guardians, be to us (a granter of) happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वो जुषन्ते॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्रि॒यमा॑णं॒ नवी॑यः । शृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ नो दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वासो॒ गोजा॑ता उ॒त ये य॒ज्ञिया॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀ idám ǀ bráhma ǀ kriyámāṇam ǀ návīyaḥ ǀśṛṇvántu ǀ naḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ gó-jātāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the Ādiyas, theRudras, theVasus, be gratified by this new and now repeated praise; maycelestial and terrestrial (beings), the progeny of the cow, (Pṛśni), and those who were entitled to worship, hearour (invocations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये दे॒वानां॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ मनो॒र्यज॑त्रा अ॒मृता॑ ऋत॒ज्ञाः । ते नो॑ रासन्तामुरुगा॒यम॒द्य यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ devā́nām ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ mánoḥ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ uru-gāyám ǀ adyá ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who are the most adorable divinities, those who were the adored ofManu, those who areimmortal, the observers of truth, bestow upon us this day (a son), of wide-spread renown; and do you evercherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्मै॑तु॒ सद॑नादृ॒तस्य॒ वि र॒श्मिभि॑: ससृजे॒ सूर्यो॒ गाः । वि सानु॑ना पृथि॒वी स॑स्र उ॒र्वी पृ॒थु प्रती॑क॒मध्येधे॑ अ॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bráhma ǀ etu ǀ sádanāt ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ví ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ sasṛje ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀví ǀ sā́nunā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sasre ǀ urvī́ ǀ pṛthú ǀ prátīkam ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ īdhe ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the prayer proceed from the nail of the sacrifice, forSūryawith his rays lets loose the waters; thespacious earth spreads (studded) with mountains, andAgniblazes on the extensive plural inṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सुवृ॒क्तिमिषं॒ न कृ॑ण्वे असुरा॒ नवी॑यः । इ॒नो वा॑म॒न्यः प॑द॒वीरद॑ब्धो॒ जनं॑ च मि॒त्रो य॑तति ब्रुवा॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ íṣam ǀ ná ǀ kṛṇve ǀ asurā ǀ návīyaḥ ǀináḥ ǀ vām ǀ anyáḥ ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ jánam ǀ ca ǀ mitráḥ ǀ yatati ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulMitraandVaruṇa, to you I offer this new praise as if it were (sacrificial) food; one of you,(Varuṇa). The invincible lord, is the guide to the path (of virtue) Mitra when praised animates men to exertioṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वात॑स्य॒ ध्रज॑तो रन्त इ॒त्या अपी॑पयन्त धे॒नवो॒ न सूदा॑: । म॒हो दि॒वः सद॑ने॒ जाय॑मा॒नोऽचि॑क्रदद्वृष॒भः सस्मि॒न्नूध॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vā́tasya ǀ dhrájataḥ ǀ rante ǀ ityā́ḥ ǀ ápīpayanta ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́dāḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sádane ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ ácikradat ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ sásmin ǀ ū́dhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The movements of the restless wind sport around; the milk-yielding kine are in good condition; theshowerer genitive rated in the dwelling of the mighty sun has cried aloud in that his plural ce of abiding, (the firmament).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रा य ए॒ता यु॒नज॒द्धरी॑ त॒ इन्द्र॑ प्रि॒या सु॒रथा॑ शूर धा॒यू । प्र यो म॒न्युं रिरि॑क्षतो मि॒नात्या सु॒क्रतु॑मर्य॒मणं॑ ववृत्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: girā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ etā́ ǀ yunájat ǀ hárī íti ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ priyā́ ǀ su-ráthā ǀ śūra ǀ dhāyū́ íti ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ rírikṣataḥ ǀ minā́ti ǀ ā́ ǀ su-krátum ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ vavṛtyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, (come to the sacrifice of the man) who, by his adoration, has harnessed (to your car) theseyour favourite, graceful and vigorous horses; may I bring hitherAryaman, the doer of good deeds, who baffles thewrath of the malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज॑न्ते अस्य स॒ख्यं वय॑श्च नम॒स्विन॒: स्व ऋ॒तस्य॒ धाम॑न् । वि पृक्षो॑ बाबधे॒ नृभि॒: स्तवा॑न इ॒दं नमो॑ रु॒द्राय॒ प्रेष्ठ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yájante ǀ asya ǀ sakhyám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ namasvínaḥ ǀ své ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́man ǀví ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ bābadhe ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ idám ǀ námaḥ ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ préṣṭham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the offerers of adoration, engaging (in pious acts), worship (Rudra) in their own hall of sacrifice,(solicitous) of his friendship; praised by the leaders (of rites), he lavishes food (upon them); this most acceptableadoration is addressed to Rudra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यत्सा॒कं य॒शसो॑ वावशा॒नाः सर॑स्वती स॒प्तथी॒ सिन्धु॑माता । याः सु॒ष्वय॑न्त सु॒दुघा॑: सुधा॒रा अ॒भि स्वेन॒ पय॑सा॒ पीप्या॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ sākám ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ saptáthī ǀ síndhu-mātā ǀyā́ḥ ǀ susváyanta ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ su-dhārā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ svéna ǀ páyasā ǀ pī́pyānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the seventh (stream),Sarasvatī, the mother of theSindhuand those rivers that flow copious andfertilizing, bestowing abundance of food, and nourishing (the people) by their waters come at once together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्ये नो॑ म॒रुतो॑ मन्दसा॒ना धियं॑ तो॒कं च॑ वा॒जिनो॑ऽवन्तु । मा न॒: परि॑ ख्य॒दक्ष॑रा॒ चर॒न्त्यवी॑वृध॒न्युज्यं॒ ते र॒यिं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyé ǀ naḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mandasānā́ḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ tokám ǀ ca ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ avantu ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ khyat ǀ ákṣarā ǀ cárantī ǀ ávīvṛdhan ǀ yújyam ǀ té ǀ rayím ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these joyous and swift-goingMarutsprotect our sacrifice and our offspring; let not the imperishablegoddess of speech, deserting us, speak (kindly) to our (adversaries); and may both (she and theMarut)associated augment our riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ म॒हीम॒रम॑तिं कृणुध्वं॒ प्र पू॒षणं॑ विद॒थ्यं१॒॑ न वी॒रम् । भगं॑ धि॒यो॑ऽवि॒तारं॑ नो अ॒स्याः सा॒तौ वाजं॑ राति॒षाचं॒ पुरं॑धिम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ arámatim ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ prá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ vidathyám ǀ ná ǀ vīrám ǀbhágam ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ avitā́ram ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ sātáu ǀ vā́jam ǀ rāti-sā́cam ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoke, (worshippers), the unresisting earth, and the adorable hero,Pūṣan; (invoke)Bhaga, theprotector of this our sacrifice, andVāja, the sustainer of old, the liberal of gifts to our solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒यं वो॑ मरुत॒: श्लोक॑ ए॒त्वच्छा॒ विष्णुं॑ निषिक्त॒पामवो॑भिः । उ॒त प्र॒जायै॑ गृण॒ते वयो॑ धुर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ ayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ etu ǀ áccha ǀ víṣṇum ǀ nisikta-pā́m ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀutá ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhuḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this praise come,Maruts, before you; (may it come) beforeViṣṇu, the guardian of the embryo,with his protecting faculties; may they both bestow upon (me), their adorer, progeny and food; and do you evercherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॒ वाहि॑ष्ठो वहतु स्त॒वध्यै॒ रथो॑ वाजा ऋभुक्षणो॒ अमृ॑क्तः । अ॒भि त्रि॑पृ॒ष्ठैः सव॑नेषु॒ सोमै॒र्मदे॑ सुशिप्रा म॒हभि॑: पृणध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vahatu ǀ stavádhyai ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀabhí ǀ trí-pṛṣṭháiḥ ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ máde ǀ su-śiprāḥ ǀ mahá-bhiḥ ǀ pṛṇadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vājas, possessors of energy, let your capacious, commendable, and unobstructed chariot bring you(hither); be satiated, handsome-chinned, with the copious triply-combined libation (poured out) for yourexhilaration at our sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं ह॒ रत्नं॑ म॒घव॑त्सु धत्थ स्व॒र्दृश॑ ऋभुक्षणो॒ अमृ॑क्तम् । सं य॒ज्ञेषु॑ स्वधावन्तः पिबध्वं॒ वि नो॒ राधां॑सि म॒तिभि॑र्दयध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ ha ǀ rátnam ǀ maghávat-su ǀ dhattha ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ ámṛktam ǀsám ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ svadhā-vantaḥ ǀ pibadhvam ǀ ví ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ dayadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Ṛbhukṣins, beholders of heaven, preserve unmolested the precious (treasure) for us who areaffluent (in sacrificial offerings); do you who are possessed of strengh, drink fully at (our) solemnities, and with(favourable) minds bestow upon us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒वोचि॑थ॒ हि म॑घवन्दे॒ष्णं म॒हो अर्भ॑स्य॒ वसु॑नो विभा॒गे । उ॒भा ते॑ पू॒र्णा वसु॑ना॒ गभ॑स्ती॒ न सू॒नृता॒ नि य॑मते वस॒व्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: uvócitha ǀ hí ǀ magha-van ǀ deṣṇám ǀ maháḥ ǀ árbhasya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀubhā́ ǀ te ǀ pūrṇā́ ǀ vásunā ǀ gábhastī íti ǀ ná ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ ní ǀ yamate ǀ vasavyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Maghavan, have determined what is to be given in the apportionment of much or of little wealth,for both yourhandsare full of treasure, and your sincere (promises) of riches do not restrain them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ स्वय॑शा ऋभु॒क्षा वाजो॒ न सा॒धुरस्त॑मे॒ष्यृक्वा॑ । व॒यं नु ते॑ दा॒श्वांस॑: स्याम॒ ब्रह्म॑ कृ॒ण्वन्तो॑ हरिवो॒ वसि॑ष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ svá-yaśāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sādhúḥ ǀ ástam ǀ eṣi ǀ ṛ́kvā ǀvayám ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ dāśvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, who areṚbhukṣin, and of especial renown, who, like food, are the fulfiller (of wants),come to the dwelling of the worshipper; lord of bay horses, may we,Vasiṣṭhas, be today the donors (of theofferings) to yo, the celebrators of your praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सनि॑तासि प्र॒वतो॑ दा॒शुषे॑ चि॒द्याभि॒र्विवे॑षो हर्यश्व धी॒भिः । व॒व॒न्मा नु ते॒ युज्या॑भिरू॒ती क॒दा न॑ इन्द्र रा॒य आ द॑शस्येः
shlokas.transliteration: sánitā ǀ asi ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ cit ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ víveṣaḥ ǀ hari-aśva ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀvavanmá ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ yújyābhiḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ kadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ daśasyeḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of bay horses, you are the giver of descending (wealth) to the donor (of the oblation), by whosesacred rites you are magnified; when may you bestow upon us riches; when may we be secure by yourappropriate protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒सय॑सीव वे॒धस॒स्त्वं न॑: क॒दा न॑ इन्द्र॒ वच॑सो बुबोधः । अस्तं॑ ता॒त्या धि॒या र॒यिं सु॒वीरं॑ पृ॒क्षो नो॒ अर्वा॒ न्यु॑हीत वा॒जी
shlokas.transliteration: vāsáyasi-iva ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ vácasaḥ ǀ bubodhaḥ ǀástam ǀ tātyā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ rayím ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ árvā ǀ ní ǀ uhīta ǀ vājī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indra, will you appreciate our praise; at present you establish us (your) adorers in our dwelling;let your swift horse, (influenced) by our protracted solemnity, convey to our abode riches,maleoffspring, andfood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि यं दे॒वी निॠ॑तिश्चि॒दीशे॒ नक्ष॑न्त॒ इन्द्रं॑ श॒रद॑: सु॒पृक्ष॑: । उप॑ त्रिब॒न्धुर्ज॒रद॑ष्टिमे॒त्यस्व॑वेशं॒ यं कृ॒णव॑न्त॒ मर्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yám ǀ devī́ ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ cit ǀ ī́śe ǀ nákṣante ǀ índram ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ su-pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀúpa ǀ tri-bandhúḥ ǀ jarát-aṣṭim ǀ eti ǀ ásvaveśam ǀ yám ǀ kṛṇávanta ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the upholder of the three regions, whom the divineNirṛtiacknowledges as ruler, whom abundantyears pass over, whom mortals detain from his own abode, approaches to (recruit) his decaying strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ राधां॑सि सवित स्त॒वध्या॒ आ रायो॑ यन्तु॒ पर्व॑तस्य रा॒तौ । सदा॑ नो दि॒व्यः पा॒युः सि॑षक्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ savitaríti ǀ stavádhyai ǀ ā́ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ párvatasya ǀ rātáu ǀsádā ǀ naḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ sisaktu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May riches worthy of laudation come,Savitā, to us; riches that are in the bestow ofParvata; may theheavenly protector (of all) preserve us; and, do you (Universal gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता य॑याम हिर॒ण्ययी॑म॒मतिं॒ यामशि॑श्रेत् । नू॒नं भगो॒ हव्यो॒ मानु॑षेभि॒र्वि यो रत्ना॑ पुरू॒वसु॒र्दधा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ yayāma ǀ hiraṇyáyīm ǀ amátim ǀ yā́m ǀ áśiśret ǀnūnám ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣebhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ rátnā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ dádhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitāhas diffused the golden radiance on high, of which he is the asylum; verilyBhagaisto be absorbed by men who, abounding in wealth, distributes treasures (among them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑ तिष्ठ सवितः श्रु॒ध्य१॒॑स्य हिर॑ण्यपाणे॒ प्रभृ॑तावृ॒तस्य॑ । व्यु१॒॑र्वीं पृ॒थ्वीम॒मतिं॑ सृजा॒न आ नृभ्यो॑ मर्त॒भोज॑नं सुवा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ savitaríti ǀ śrudhí ǀ asyá ǀ híraṇya-pāṇe ǀ prá-bhṛtau ǀ ṛtásya ǀví ǀ urvī́m ǀ pṛthvī́m ǀ amátim ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ suvānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise upSavitā; hear (our solicitations) upon the celebration of this ceremony, (you who are) diffusinglight over the spacious earth, and bestowing human enjoyment upon men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपि॑ ष्टु॒तः स॑वि॒ता दे॒वो अ॑स्तु॒ यमा चि॒द्विश्वे॒ वस॑वो गृ॒णन्ति॑ । स न॒: स्तोमा॑न्नम॒स्य१॒॑श्चनो॑ धा॒द्विश्वे॑भिः पातु पा॒युभि॒र्नि सू॒रीन्
shlokas.transliteration: ápi ǀ stutáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ astu ǀ yám ǀ ā́ ǀ cit ǀ víśve ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómān ǀ namasyáḥ ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dhāt ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ pātu ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ sūrī́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified be the divineSavitā, whom all the gods praise; may that adorable (diviniy) require our praises(with) food; may he always protect the devout with all his protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि यं दे॒व्यदि॑तिर्गृ॒णाति॑ स॒वं दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्जु॑षा॒णा । अ॒भि स॒म्राजो॒ वरु॑णो गृणन्त्य॒भि मि॒त्रासो॑ अर्य॒मा स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yám ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ gṛṇā́ti ǀ savám ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀabhí ǀ sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ abhí ǀ mitrā́saḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom the divineAditi, delighting at the birth of the divineSavitṛ, glorifies, whom the supremesoverigns,Varuṇa,Mitra,Āryaman, (and other gods) adore.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि ये मि॒थो व॒नुष॒: सप॑न्ते रा॒तिं दि॒वो रा॑ति॒षाच॑: पृथि॒व्याः । अहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्य॑ उ॒त न॑: शृणोतु॒ वरू॒त्र्येक॑धेनुभि॒र्नि पा॑तु
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ yé ǀ mitháḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ sápante ǀ rātím ǀ diváḥ ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀáhiḥ ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ várūtrī ǀ ékadhenu-bhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom those solicitous for wealth those enjoying (it), mutually worship, the benefactor of heaven andearth; mayAhirbudhnyahear us; may the protectress (the goddess of speech), cherish us with excellen cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ तन्नो॒ जास्पति॑र्मंसीष्ट॒ रत्नं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुरि॑या॒नः । भग॑मु॒ग्रोऽव॑से॒ जोह॑वीति॒ भग॒मनु॑ग्रो॒ अध॑ याति॒ रत्न॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ jā́ḥ-pátiḥ ǀ maṃsīṣṭa ǀ rátnam ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ iyānáḥ ǀbhágam ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ávase ǀ jóhavīti ǀ bhágam ǀ ánugraḥ ǀ ádha ǀ yāti ǀ rátnam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the protector of progeny, when solicited, consent to bestow upon us the precious (wealth of thedivineSavitā; the ardent (adorer) invokes repeatedlyBhagafor protection; the less ardent solicits Bhaga forwealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ भवन्तु वा॒जिनो॒ हवे॑षु दे॒वता॑ता मि॒तद्र॑वः स्व॒र्काः । ज॒म्भय॒न्तोऽहिं॒ वृकं॒ रक्षां॑सि॒ सने॑म्य॒स्मद्यु॑यव॒न्नमी॑वाः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ háveṣu ǀ devá-tātā ǀ mitá-dravaḥ ǀ su-arkā́ḥ ǀjambháyantaḥ ǀ áhim ǀ vṛ́kam ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sánemi ǀ asmát ǀ yuyavan ǀ ámīvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theVājins, with slackened speed, bringing excellent food, be (disposed) for our happiness, uponour invocations at the worship of the gods; destroying the murderer, the robber, therākṣasas, and keepingfrom us ancient maladies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाजे॑वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो॒ धने॑षु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः । अ॒स्य मध्व॑: पिबत मा॒दय॑ध्वं तृ॒प्ता या॑त प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vā́je-vāje ǀ avata ǀ vājinaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dháneṣu ǀ viprāḥ ǀ amṛtāḥ ǀ ṛta-jñāḥ ǀasyá ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibata ǀ mādáyadhvam ǀ tṛptā́ḥ ǀ yāta ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ deva-yā́naiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise, immortalVājins, observers of truth, defend us in every conflict, and for the sake of wealth; drinkof this sweet (Soma), be exhilarated (thereby) and satisfied; proceed by the paths traversed by the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो अ॒ग्निः सु॑म॒तिं वस्वो॑ अश्रेत्प्रती॒ची जू॒र्णिर्दे॒वता॑तिमेति । भे॒जाते॒ अद्री॑ र॒थ्ये॑व॒ पन्था॑मृ॒तं होता॑ न इषि॒तो य॑जाति
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ aśret ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ jūrṇíḥ ǀ devá-tātim ǀ eti ǀbhejā́te íti ǀ ádrī íti ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ pánthām ǀ ṛtám ǀ hótā ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ yajāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetAgni, risen on high, accept the praise of the worshipper; she who makes (all creatures) old, lookingto the west, goes to the sacrifice; the pious pair, like two riders in a chariot, follow the path (of the ceremony); lettheHotā, as enjoined, celebrate the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॑वृजे सुप्र॒या ब॒र्हिरे॑षा॒मा वि॒श्पती॑व॒ बीरि॑ट इयाते । वि॒शाम॒क्तोरु॒षस॑: पू॒र्वहू॑तौ वा॒युः पू॒षा स्व॒स्तये॑ नि॒युत्वा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vavṛje ǀ su-prayā́ḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ ā́ ǀ viśpátī ivéti viśpátī-iva ǀ bī́riṭe ǀ iyāte íti ǀviśā́m ǀ aktóḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ svastáye ǀ niyútvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The food-bestowing sacred grass of these (the worshippers) is strewn; may the two lords of people,Vāyuwith theNiyutsteeds, andPūṣan, invoked before the dawn upon the close of the night, appear now inthe firmament for the welfare of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्म॒या अत्र॒ वस॑वो रन्त दे॒वा उ॒राव॒न्तरि॑क्षे मर्जयन्त शु॒भ्राः । अ॒र्वाक्प॒थ उ॑रुज्रयः कृणुध्वं॒ श्रोता॑ दू॒तस्य॑ ज॒ग्मुषो॑ नो अ॒स्य
shlokas.transliteration: jmayā́ḥ ǀ átra ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ ranta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ uráu ǀ antárikṣe ǀ marjayanta ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀarvā́k ǀ patháḥ ǀ uru-jrayaḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ śrótā ǀ dūtásya ǀ jagmúṣaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineVasussport on this occasion upon the earth; the brilliant (Maruts) in the expansivefirmament are being worshipped; swift-moving deities, direct your paths towards us; hear (the words) of this ourmessenger, (Agni), approaching you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि य॒ज्ञेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑स॒ ऊमा॑: स॒धस्थं॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒भि सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः । ताँ अ॑ध्व॒र उ॑श॒तो य॑क्ष्यग्ने श्रु॒ष्टी भगं॒ नास॑त्या॒ पुरं॑धिम्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀ ū́māḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ víśve ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀtā́n ǀ adhvaré ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ agne ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ bhágam ǀ nā́satyā ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These universal adorable guardian deities occupy a common station at sacrifices; worship,Agni, thosedivinities, deservers (of oblations) at the ceremony, the swiftBhaga, theNāsatyāsand Purandhi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग्ने॒ गिरो॑ दि॒व आ पृ॑थि॒व्या मि॒त्रं व॑ह॒ वरु॑ण॒मिन्द्र॑म॒ग्निम् । आर्य॒मण॒मदि॑तिं॒ विष्णु॑मेषां॒ सर॑स्वती म॒रुतो॑ मादयन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ gíraḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ vaha ǀ váruṇam ǀ índram ǀ agním ǀā́ ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ áditim ǀ víṣṇum ǀ eṣām ǀ sárasvatī ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mādayantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BringAgni, whether from heaven or earth, the adorable deitiesMitra,Varuṇa,Indraand Agni,Āryaman,AditiandViṣṇu(for the good) of these (worshippers); and maySarasvatīand theMarutsbedelighted (by our offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒रे ह॒व्यं म॒तिभि॑र्य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ नक्ष॒त्कामं॒ मर्त्या॑ना॒मसि॑न्वन् । धाता॑ र॒यिम॑विद॒स्यं स॑दा॒सां स॑क्षी॒महि॒ युज्ये॑भि॒र्नु दे॒वैः
shlokas.transliteration: raré ǀ havyám ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ nákṣat ǀ kā́mam ǀ mártyānām ǀ ásinvan ǀdhā́ta ǀ rayím ǀ avi-dasyám ǀ sadā-sā́m ǀ sakṣīmáhi ǀ yújyebhiḥ ǀ nú ǀ deváiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The oblation is offered together with praises to the adorable deities; may (Agni), unaverse to the desireof mortals, be present; bestow (upon us gods), unwasting, all-benefiting riches; and may we today be associatedwith the assembled deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू रोद॑सी अ॒भिष्टु॑ते॒ वसि॑ष्ठैॠ॒तावा॑नो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः । यच्छ॑न्तु च॒न्द्रा उ॑प॒मं नो॑ अ॒र्कं यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ ródasī íti ǀ abhístute ítyabhí-stute ǀ vásiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀyácchantu ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth are now glorified by theVasiṣṭhas, as areVaruṇa, the objec of worship, and MitraandAgni; may they, the conferrers of joy, bestow upon us excellent food; and do you (all) ever cherish us withblessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ श्रु॒ष्टिर्वि॑द॒थ्या॒३॒॑ समे॑तु॒ प्रति॒ स्तोमं॑ दधीमहि तु॒राणा॑म् । यद॒द्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता सु॒वाति॒ स्यामा॑स्य र॒त्निनो॑ विभा॒गे
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ śruṣṭíḥ ǀ vidathyā́ ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ práti ǀ stómam ǀ dadhīmahi ǀ turā́ṇām ǀyát ǀ adyá ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ suvā́ti ǀ syā́ma ǀ asya ǀ ratnínaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the satisfaction derived from pious rites come to us as we contemplate the glorification of the swiftmoving (divinities); may we be included in the apportionment by that wealth-bestowing deity (of the riches) whichthe divineSavitāgoday distributes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्तन्नो॒ वरु॑णो॒ रोद॑सी च॒ द्युभ॑क्त॒मिन्द्रो॑ अर्य॒मा द॑दातु । दिदे॑ष्टु दे॒व्यदि॑ती॒ रेक्णो॑ वा॒युश्च॒ यन्नि॑यु॒वैते॒ भग॑श्च
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ca ǀ dyú-bhaktam ǀ índraḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ dadātu ǀdídeṣṭu ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ niyuváite íti ni-yuváite ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitraandVaruṇa, heaven and earth,IndraandĀryaman, give us that (wealth) which is meritedby brilliant (laudations); may the divineAditibe disposed to give us riches, whichVāyuandBhagamay preserveever in our keeping.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सेदु॒ग्रो अ॑स्तु मरुत॒: स शु॒ष्मी यं मर्त्यं॑ पृषदश्वा॒ अवा॑थ । उ॒तेम॒ग्निः सर॑स्वती जु॒नन्ति॒ न तस्य॑ रा॒यः प॑र्ये॒तास्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ugráḥ ǀ astu ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ yám ǀ mártyam ǀ pṛṣat-aśvāḥ ǀ ávātha ǀutá ǀ īm ǀ agníḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ junánti ǀ ná ǀ tásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ pari-etā́ ǀ asti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, whose steeds are the spotted deer, may the mortal whom you protect the resolute, be strong,for himAgniandSarasvatīalso defend, and there be no despoiler of his riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं हि ने॒ता वरु॑ण ऋ॒तस्य॑ मि॒त्रो राजा॑नो अर्य॒मापो॒ धुः । सु॒हवा॑ दे॒व्यदि॑तिरन॒र्वा ते नो॒ अंहो॒ अति॑ पर्ष॒न्नरि॑ष्टान्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ hí ǀ netā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mitráḥ ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ ápaḥ ǀ dhúríti dhúḥ ǀsu-hávā ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ anarvā́ ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ áti ǀ parṣan ǀ áriṣṭān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisVaruṇa, the leader of the rite, and the royalMitraandĀryaman, uphold my acts, and the divineunopposedAditi, earnestly invoked; may they convey us safe beyond evil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य दे॒वस्य॑ मी॒ळ्हुषो॑ व॒या विष्णो॑रे॒षस्य॑ प्रभृ॒थे ह॒विर्भि॑: । वि॒दे हि रु॒द्रो रु॒द्रियं॑ महि॒त्वं या॑सि॒ष्टं व॒र्तिर॑श्विना॒विरा॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ devásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ vayā́ḥ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ eṣásya ǀ pra-bhṛthé ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀvidé ǀ hí ǀ rudráḥ ǀ rudríyam ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ yāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ írā-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I propitiate with oblations the ramifications of that divine attainableViṣṇu, the showerer of benefits;Rudra, bestow upon us the magnificence of his nature; theAśvinshave come to our dwelling abond with(sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मात्र॑ पूषन्नाघृण इरस्यो॒ वरू॑त्री॒ यद्रा॑ति॒षाच॑श्च॒ रास॑न् । म॒यो॒भुवो॑ नो॒ अर्व॑न्तो॒ नि पा॑न्तु वृ॒ष्टिं परि॑ज्मा॒ वातो॑ ददातु
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ átra ǀ pūṣan ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ irasyaḥ ǀ várūtrī ǀ yát ǀ rāti-sā́caḥ ǀ ca ǀ rā́san ǀmayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāntu ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ pári-jmā ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ dadātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentPūṣan, oppose not (hindrance) on this occasion; may the protectress, (Sarasvatī) andthe liberal (wives of the gods), grant us wealth; may the ever-moving deities, the sources of happiness, protectus; may the circumambientVātasend us rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू रोद॑सी अ॒भिष्टु॑ते॒ वसि॑ष्ठैॠ॒तावा॑नो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः । यच्छ॑न्तु च॒न्द्रा उ॑प॒मं नो॑ अ॒र्कं यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ ródasī íti ǀ abhístute ítyabhí-stute ǀ vásiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀyácchantu ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth are now glorified by theVasiṣṭhas, as areVaruṇathe object of worship, and MitraandAgni; may they, the conferrers of joy, bestow upon us excellent food; and do you (all) ever cherish us withblessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तर॒ग्निं प्रा॒तरिन्द्रं॑ हवामहे प्रा॒तर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा प्रा॒तर॒श्विना॑ । प्रा॒तर्भगं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॑ प्रा॒तः सोम॑मु॒त रु॒द्रं हु॑वेम
shlokas.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ agním ǀ pratáḥ ǀ índram ǀ havāmahe ǀ pratáḥ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ prātáḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀpratáḥ ǀ bhágam ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ pratáḥ ǀ sómam ǀ utá ǀ rudrám ǀ huvema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke at dawnAgni; at dawnIndra; at dawnMitraandVaruṇa; at dawn theAśvins; at dawnBhaga,Pūṣan,Brahmaṇaspati; at dawnSomaandRudra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्जितं॒ भग॑मु॒ग्रं हु॑वेम व॒यं पु॒त्रमदि॑ते॒र्यो वि॑ध॒र्ता । आ॒ध्रश्चि॒द्यं मन्य॑मानस्तु॒रश्चि॒द्राजा॑ चि॒द्यं भगं॑ भ॒क्षीत्याह॑
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-jítam ǀ bhágam ǀ ugrám ǀ huvema ǀ vayám ǀ putrám ǀ áditeḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀādhráḥ ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ mányamānaḥ ǀ turáḥ ǀ cit ǀ rā́jā ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ bhágam ǀ bhakṣi ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke at dawn fierceBhaga, the son ofAditi, who is the sustainer (of the world), to whom the poorman praising him applies, saying, give (me wealth), to whom the opulent prince (addresses the same prayer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भग॒ प्रणे॑त॒र्भग॒ सत्य॑राधो॒ भगे॒मां धिय॒मुद॑वा॒ दद॑न्नः । भग॒ प्र णो॑ जनय॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॒र्भग॒ प्र नृभि॑र्नृ॒वन्त॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: bhága ǀ pránetaríti prá-netaḥ ǀ bhága ǀ sátya-rādhaḥ ǀ bhága ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ út ǀ ava ǀ dádat ǀ naḥ ǀbhága ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ janaya ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ bhága ǀ prá ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ-vántaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bhaga, chief leader of rites, Bhaga, faithful granting (our wishes), fructify ceremony, enrich us withcattle and horses; may we Bhaga, be eminent withmaledescendants and followers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तेदानीं॒ भग॑वन्तः स्यामो॒त प्र॑पि॒त्व उ॒त मध्ये॒ अह्ना॑म् । उ॒तोदि॑ता मघव॒न्त्सूर्य॑स्य व॒यं दे॒वानां॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ idā́nīm ǀ bhága-vantaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ utá ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ utá ǀ mádhye ǀ áhnām ǀutá ǀ út-itā ǀ magha-van ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ vayám ǀ devā́nām ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we now haveBhaga(for our lord), whether in the forenoon or mid- day, or at sun-rise; may we,Maghavan, enjoy the favour of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भग॑ ए॒व भग॑वाँ अस्तु देवा॒स्तेन॑ व॒यं भग॑वन्तः स्याम । तं त्वा॑ भग॒ सर्व॒ इज्जो॑हवीति॒ स नो॑ भग पुरए॒ता भ॑वे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: bhágaḥ ǀ evá ǀ bhága-vān ǀ astu ǀ devāḥ ǀ téna ǀ vayám ǀ bhága-vantaḥ ǀ syāma ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ bhaga ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ ít ǀ johavīti ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhaga ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ bhava ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBhaga, gods, be the possessor of opulence, and, through him, may we be possessed of wealth,every one verily repeatedly invokes you, Bhaga; do you, Bhaga, be our preceder at this solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॑ध्व॒रायो॒षसो॑ नमन्त दधि॒क्रावे॑व॒ शुच॑ये प॒दाय॑ । अ॒र्वा॒ची॒नं व॑सु॒विदं॒ भगं॑ नो॒ रथ॑मि॒वाश्वा॑ वा॒जिन॒ आ व॑हन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ namanta ǀ dadhikrā́vā-iva ǀ śúcaye ǀ padā́ya ǀarvācīnám ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ bhágam ǀ naḥ ǀ rátham-iva ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vahantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the dawn come to our sacrifice as a horse to a suitable station; as rapid steeds convey a chariot,so may the dawns bring to usBhaga, down- descending, charged with riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्न उ॒षासो॑ वी॒रव॑ती॒: सद॑मुच्छन्तु भ॒द्राः । घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना वि॒श्वत॒: प्रपी॑ता यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vatīḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vīrá-vatīḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ucchantu ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀghṛtám ǀ dúhānāḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ prá-pītāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “{Text is missing}”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ब्र॒ह्माणो॒ अङ्गि॑रसो नक्षन्त॒ प्र क्र॑न्द॒नुर्न॑भ॒न्य॑स्य वेतु । प्र धे॒नव॑ उद॒प्रुतो॑ नवन्त यु॒ज्याता॒मद्री॑ अध्व॒रस्य॒ पेश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ brahmā́ṇaḥ ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ nakṣanta ǀ prá ǀ krandanúḥ ǀ nabhanyásya ǀ vetu ǀprá ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ uda-prútaḥ ǀ navanta ǀ yujyā́tām ǀ ádrī íti ǀ adhvarásya ǀ péśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thebrāhmaṇas, theAṅgirasas, be everywhere present; may Krandanu be conscious of (our)adoration; may the rivers glide along, distributing water; may the pious couple (theyajamānaand his wife),conjointly appreciate the beauty of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒गस्ते॑ अग्ने॒ सन॑वित्तो॒ अध्वा॑ यु॒क्ष्वा सु॒ते ह॒रितो॑ रो॒हित॑श्च । ये वा॒ सद्म॑न्नरु॒षा वी॑र॒वाहो॑ हु॒वे दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मानि स॒त्तः
shlokas.transliteration: su-gáḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ sána-vittaḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ yuṅkṣvá ǀ suté ǀ harítaḥ ǀ rohítaḥ ǀ ca ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ sádman ǀ aruṣā́ḥ ǀ vīra-vā́haḥ ǀ huvé ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánimāni ǀ sattáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural asant,Agni, by your long-familiar path, invoke the libation; the bay, the ruddy horses, who, brilliantshining, are the conveyers of (you), the hero, to the hall of sacrifice, where seated, I invoke the companies of thegods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ वो य॒ज्ञं म॑हय॒न्नमो॑भि॒: प्र होता॑ म॒न्द्रो रि॑रिच उपा॒के । यज॑स्व॒ सु पु॑र्वणीक दे॒वाना य॒ज्ञिया॑म॒रम॑तिं ववृत्याः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ mahayan ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ririce ǀ upāké ǀyájasva ǀ sú ǀ puru-anīka ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ yajñíyām ǀ arámatim ǀ vavṛtyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (worshippers) offer you, (gods), this sacrifice, with prostrations; the ministrant priest, who is nearus repeating pious praise, excels (all others); worship well the gods; resplendent (Agni), make the venerableearth revolve.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒दा वी॒रस्य॑ रे॒वतो॑ दुरो॒णे स्यो॑न॒शीरति॑थिरा॒चिके॑तत् । सुप्री॑तो अ॒ग्निः सुधि॑तो॒ दम॒ आ स वि॒शे दा॑ति॒ वार्य॒मिय॑त्यै
shlokas.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ vīrásya ǀ revátaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ syona-śī́ḥ ǀ átithiḥ ǀ ā-cíketat ǀsú-prītaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sú-dhitaḥ ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ viśé ǀ dāti ǀ vā́ryam ǀ íyatyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenAgni, reposing at his ease in the dwelling of the liberal worshipper, is welcomed as a guest, thussuitable plural ced in the hall of sacrifice, he gives well-plural ased, desirable (wealth) to the people who approach him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं नो॑ अग्ने अध्व॒रं जु॑षस्व म॒रुत्स्विन्द्रे॑ य॒शसं॑ कृधी नः । आ नक्ता॑ ब॒र्हिः स॑दतामु॒षासो॒शन्ता॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा यजे॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ adhvarám ǀ juṣasva ǀ marút-su ǀ índre ǀ yaśásam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǀā́ ǀ náktā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sadatām ǀ uṣásā ǀ uśántā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ yaja ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified,Agni, by this our sacrifice; render our (worship) renowned amongIndraand theMaruts; letthe days and nights sit down on the sacred grass; worship (Agni), at this rite,MitraandVaruṇa, desiring (theoblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वाग्निं स॑ह॒स्यं१॒॑ वसि॑ष्ठो रा॒यस्का॑मो वि॒श्वप्स्न्य॑स्य स्तौत् । इषं॑ र॒यिं प॑प्रथ॒द्वाज॑म॒स्मे यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ agním ǀ sahasyám ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ rāyáḥ-kāmaḥ ǀ viśvá-psnyasya ǀ staut ǀíṣam ǀ rayím ǀ paprathat ǀ vā́jam ǀ asmé íti ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus hasVasiṣṭhawishing for riches, glorified the vigorousAgnifor the sake of every sort of wealth;may he bestow upon us food, rices, strength; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ देव॒यन्तो॑ अर्च॒न्द्यावा॒ नमो॑भिः पृथि॒वी इ॒षध्यै॑ । येषां॒ ब्रह्मा॒ण्यस॑मानि॒ विप्रा॒ विष्व॑ग्वि॒यन्ति॑ व॒निनो॒ न शाखा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ arcan ǀ dyā́vā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ iṣádhyai ǀyéṣām ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ ásamāni ǀ víprā ǀ víṣvak ǀ vi-yánti ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śā́khāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devout worshippers seek to attain you, gods, by praises at sacrifices; they (worship) the heaven andearth, they of whom the divesified adorations spread everywhere like th ebranches of trees.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र य॒ज्ञ ए॑तु॒ हेत्वो॒ न सप्ति॒रुद्य॑च्छध्वं॒ सम॑नसो घृ॒ताची॑: । स्तृ॒णी॒त ब॒र्हिर॑ध्व॒राय॑ सा॒धूर्ध्वा शो॒चींषि॑ देव॒यून्य॑स्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ etu ǀ hétvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ út ǀ yacchadhvam ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀstṛṇītá ǀ barhíḥ ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ sādhú ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ śocī́ṃṣi ǀ deva-yū́ni ǀ asthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the sacrifice proceed like a swift course (tot he gods); elevate, (priests), with one occurred, yourladles, charged with butter; spread for the solemnity the sacred grass;le the flames (of the burnt-offering) to thegods ascend on high.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ पु॒त्रासो॒ न मा॒तरं॒ विभृ॑त्रा॒: सानौ॑ दे॒वासो॑ ब॒र्हिष॑: सदन्तु । आ वि॒श्वाची॑ विद॒थ्या॑मन॒क्त्वग्ने॒ मा नो॑ दे॒वता॑ता॒ मृध॑स्कः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātáram ǀ ví-bhṛtrāḥ ǀ sā́nau ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ sadantu ǀā́ ǀ viśvā́cī ǀ vidathyā́m ǀ anaktu ǀ ágne ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devá-tātā ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the gods sit down on the summit of the sacred grass, like children nursed on the (lap of the) mother;let the full ladle,Agni, pour (the oblaion) on the sacrificial flame; give us not up to your adversaries in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते सी॑षपन्त॒ जोष॒मा यज॑त्रा ऋ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑: सु॒दुघा॒ दुहा॑नाः । ज्येष्ठं॑ वो अ॒द्य मह॒ आ वसू॑ना॒मा ग॑न्तन॒ सम॑नसो॒ यति॒ ष्ठ
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ sīṣapanta ǀ jóṣam ǀ ā́ ǀ yájatrāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ dúhānāḥ ǀjyéṣṭham ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ máhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vásūnām ǀ ā́ ǀ gantana ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ yáti ǀ sthá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorable deities, who are the bestowers of water, the shedders of showers, be fully propitiated(by our praises); may the most precious and commendable of your treasure (be ours) today; and do you with oneaccord come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नो॑ अग्ने वि॒क्ष्वा द॑शस्य॒ त्वया॑ व॒यं स॑हसाव॒न्नास्क्रा॑: । रा॒या यु॒जा स॑ध॒मादो॒ अरि॑ष्टा यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ vikṣú ǀ ā́ ǀ daśasya ǀ tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ sahasā-van ǀ ā́skrāḥ ǀrāyā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be glorifiedAgni; grant us (wealth) among the people; may we, vigorous Agni, ever be undeserted byyou, but always be rejoicing and unmolested in the possession of riches; and do you, (gods), ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्रां व॑: प्रथ॒मम॒श्विनो॒षस॑म॒ग्निं समि॑द्धं॒ भग॑मू॒तये॑ हुवे । इन्द्रं॒ विष्णुं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑मादि॒त्यान्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒पः स्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́m ǀ vaḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ aśvínā ǀ uṣásam ǀ agním ǀ sám-iddham ǀ bhágam ǀ ūtáye ǀ huve ǀíndram ǀ víṣṇum ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ ādityā́n ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For your preservation, (worshippers), I invoke, first, Dadhikrā, then theAśvins, the Dawn, the kindledAgni,Bhaga,Indra,Viṣṇu,Pūṣan,Brahmaṇaspati, theĀdityas, heaven and earth, the waters, the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्रामु॒ नम॑सा बो॒धय॑न्त उ॒दीरा॑णा य॒ज्ञमु॑पप्र॒यन्त॑: । इळां॑ दे॒वीं ब॒र्हिषि॑ सा॒दय॑न्तो॒ऽश्विना॒ विप्रा॑ सु॒हवा॑ हुवेम
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ námasā ǀ bodháyantaḥ ǀ ut-ī́rāṇāḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ upa-prayántaḥ ǀíḷām ǀ devī́m ǀ barhíṣi ǀ sādáyantaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ su-hávā ǀ huvema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arousing and animating Dadhikrā, proceeding diligently with the sacrifice; seating the divine Iḷā onthe sacred grass, let us invoke the intelligent and worthily-invokedAśvins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्रावा॑णं बुबुधा॒नो अ॒ग्निमुप॑ ब्रुव उ॒षसं॒ सूर्यं॒ गाम् । ब्र॒ध्नं माँ॑श्च॒तोर्वरु॑णस्य ब॒भ्रुं ते विश्वा॒स्मद्दु॑रि॒ता या॑वयन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́vāṇam ǀ bubudhānáḥ ǀ agním ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ uṣásam ǀ sū́ryam ǀ gā́m ǀbradhnám ǀ máṃścatóḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ babhrúm ǀ té ǀ víśvā ǀ asmát ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ yavayantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiating Dadhikrāvan, I glorifyAgni, Uṣas, the sun, the earth, the great brown horse ofVaruṇa,who is mindful of his adorers; may they put far away from us iniquities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒धि॒क्रावा॑ प्रथ॒मो वा॒ज्यर्वाग्रे॒ रथा॑नां भवति प्रजा॒नन् । सं॒वि॒दा॒न उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑णादि॒त्येभि॒र्वसु॑भि॒रङ्गि॑रोभिः
shlokas.transliteration: dadhi-krā́vā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ árvā ǀ ágre ǀ ráthānām ǀ bhavati ǀ pra-jānán ǀsam-vidānáḥ ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dadhikrāvan, the swift steed, the first (of horses), knowing (his office), is in the front of the chariots (ofthe gods), consentient with Uṣas, withSūrya, wiḥ theĀdityas, with theVasus, with theAṅgirasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दधि॒क्राः प॒थ्या॑मनक्त्वृ॒तस्य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑त॒वा उ॑ । शृ॒णोतु॑ नो॒ दैव्यं॒ शर्धो॑ अ॒ग्निः शृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ महि॒षा अमू॑राः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dadhi-krā́ḥ ǀ pathyā́m ǀ anaktu ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pánthām ǀ ánu-etavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀśṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǀ dáivyam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ śṛṇvántu ǀ víśve ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May Dadhikrā sprinkle our path (with water), that we may follow the road of sacrifice; mayAgni, thestrength of the gods, here our (invocation); may the mighty, unperplexed, universal deities hear it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दे॒वो या॑तु सवि॒ता सु॒रत्नो॑ऽन्तरिक्ष॒प्रा वह॑मानो॒ अश्वै॑: । हस्ते॒ दधा॑नो॒ नर्या॑ पु॒रूणि॑ निवे॒शय॑ञ्च प्रसु॒वञ्च॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ yātu ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-rátnaḥ ǀ antarikṣa-prā́ḥ ǀ váhamānaḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀháste ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ náryā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ ni-veśáyan ǀ ca ǀ pra-suván ǀ ca ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Borne by his steeds, may the divineSavitā, who is possessed of precious treasure, and filling thefirmament (with radiance), come hither, holding in hishandsmany things good for man, and (both) tranquilizingand animating living beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑स्य बा॒हू शि॑थि॒रा बृ॒हन्ता॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑ दि॒वो अन्ताँ॑ अनष्टाम् । नू॒नं सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा प॑निष्ट॒ सूर॑श्चिदस्मा॒ अनु॑ दादप॒स्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ śithirā́ ǀ bṛhántā ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀ anaṣṭām ǀnūnám ǀ sáḥ ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ paniṣṭa ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ ánu ǀ dāt ǀ apasyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the outspread, vast, and golden arms ofSavitāextend to the ends of the sky; verily his greatnessis glorified (by us); may the sun impart energy unto him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स घा॑ नो दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता स॒हावा सा॑विष॒द्वसु॑पति॒र्वसू॑नि । वि॒श्रय॑माणो अ॒मति॑मुरू॒चीं म॑र्त॒भोज॑न॒मध॑ रासते नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ naḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ sahá-vā ǀ ā́ ǀ sāviṣat ǀ vásu-patiḥ ǀ vásūni ǀvi-śráyamāṇaḥ ǀ amátim ǀ urūcī́m ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ ádha ǀ rāsate ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineSavitā, who is endowed with energy, the lord of treasure, bestow treasures upon usconcentrating infinite lustre; may he bestow upon us wealh, the source of the enjoyment of mortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा गिर॑: सवि॒तारं॑ सुजि॒ह्वं पू॒र्णग॑भस्तिमीळते सुपा॒णिम् । चि॒त्रं वयो॑ बृ॒हद॒स्मे द॑धातु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ savitā́ram ǀ su-jihvám ǀ pūrṇá-gabhastim ǀ īḷate ǀ su-pāṇím ǀcitrám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ asmé íti ǀ dadhātu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These praises glorify the eloquent-tongued, dextrous-handed, whosehandsare full (of wealth); may hebestow upon us manifold and abundant food; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा रु॒द्राय॑ स्थि॒रध॑न्वने॒ गिर॑: क्षि॒प्रेष॑वे दे॒वाय॑ स्व॒धाव्ने॑ । अषा॑ळ्हाय॒ सह॑मानाय वे॒धसे॑ ति॒ग्मायु॑धाय भरता शृ॒णोतु॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ sthirá-dhanvane ǀ gíraḥ ǀ kṣiprá-iṣave ǀ devā́ya ǀ svadhā́-vne ǀáṣāḷhāya ǀ sáhamānāya ǀ vedháse ǀ tigmá-āyudhāya ǀ bharata ǀ śṛṇótu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer these praises to the divineRudra, armed with the strong bow and fast-flying arrows, the bestowerof food, the invincible, the conqueror, the creator, the wielder of sharp weapons; may he hear our (praises).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि क्षये॑ण॒ क्षम्य॑स्य॒ जन्म॑न॒: साम्रा॑ज्येन दि॒व्यस्य॒ चेत॑ति । अव॒न्नव॑न्ती॒रुप॑ नो॒ दुर॑श्चरानमी॒वो रु॑द्र॒ जासु॑ नो भव
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣáyeṇa ǀ kṣámyasya ǀ jánmanaḥ ǀ sā́m-rājyena ǀ divyásya ǀ cétati ǀávan ǀ ávantīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ cara ǀ anamīváḥ ǀ rudra ǀ jā́su ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is known by his rule over those of terrestrial birth, by his sovereignty over those of celestial (origin);protecting our progeny,Rudra, propitiating you (by praise), come to our dwellings, and be to them a guardianagainst disease.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॑ दि॒द्युदव॑सृष्टा दि॒वस्परि॑ क्ष्म॒या चर॑ति॒ परि॒ सा वृ॑णक्तु नः । स॒हस्रं॑ ते स्वपिवात भेष॒जा मा न॑स्तो॒केषु॒ तन॑येषु रीरिषः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ didyút ǀ áva-sṛṣṭā ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ kṣmayā́ ǀ cárati ǀ pári ǀ sā́ ǀ vṛṇaktu ǀ naḥ ǀsahásram ǀ te ǀ su-apivāta ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tokéṣu ǀ tánayeṣu ǀ ririṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your blazing (weapon), which, discharged from heaven, traverses the earth, avoid us; thine,appeaser of the wind, are a thousand medicaments; inflict not evil upon our sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ वधी रुद्र॒ मा परा॑ दा॒ मा ते॑ भूम॒ प्रसि॑तौ हीळि॒तस्य॑ । आ नो॑ भज ब॒र्हिषि॑ जीवशं॒से यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadhīḥ ǀ rudra ǀ mā́ ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ bhūma ǀ prá-sitau ǀ hīḷitásya ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhaja ǀ barhíṣi ǀ jīva-śaṃsé ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harm us not,Rudra; abandon us not; let us not fall under the bondage of you when displeased; makeus partakers of the life-promotion sacrifice; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॒ यं व॑: प्रथ॒मं दे॑व॒यन्त॑ इन्द्र॒पान॑मू॒र्मिमकृ॑ण्वते॒ळः । तं वो॑ व॒यं शुचि॑मरि॒प्रम॒द्य घृ॑त॒प्रुषं॒ मधु॑मन्तं वनेम
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ yám ǀ vaḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ indra-pā́nam ǀ ūrmím ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀ iḷáḥ ǀtám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ śúcim ǀ ariprám ǀ adyá ǀ ghṛta-prúṣam ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ vanema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit from you, Waters, today, that pure, faultless, rain- shedding, sweet essence of the earth,which devout have first consecrated as theSomaforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमू॒र्मिमा॑पो॒ मधु॑मत्तमं वो॒ऽपां नपा॑दवत्वाशु॒हेमा॑ । यस्मि॒न्निन्द्रो॒ वसु॑भिर्मा॒दया॑ते॒ तम॑श्याम देव॒यन्तो॑ वो अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūrmím ǀ āpaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ vaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ avatu ǀ āśu-hémā ǀyásmin ǀ índraḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ mādáyāte ǀ tám ǀ aśyāma ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the swift-moving grandson of the Waters protect, Waters, your most sweet essence, wherewiḥ mayIndra and theVasusbe delighted; and may we, devoted to the gods, partake (of it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तप॑वित्राः स्व॒धया॒ मद॑न्तीर्दे॒वीर्दे॒वाना॒मपि॑ यन्ति॒ पाथ॑: । ता इन्द्र॑स्य॒ न मि॑नन्ति व्र॒तानि॒ सिन्धु॑भ्यो ह॒व्यं घृ॒तव॑ज्जुहोत
shlokas.transliteration: śatá-pavitrāḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ mádantīḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ yanti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ vratā́ni ǀ síndhu-bhyaḥ ǀ havyám ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ juhota ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine Waters, the purifiers of many, gratifying men with food, pursue the paths of the gods; theyimpede not the sacred rites ofIndra; offer, (priests), the butter-charged oblation to the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याः सूर्यो॑ र॒श्मिभि॑रात॒तान॒ याभ्य॒ इन्द्रो॒ अर॑दद्गा॒तुमू॒र्मिम् । ते सि॑न्धवो॒ वरि॑वो धातना नो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ ā-tatā́na ǀ yā́bhyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ áradat ǀ gātúm ǀ ūrmím ǀté ǀ sindhavaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dhātana ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, whom the sun has evaporized by his rays, for whomIndrahas opened a path by which toissue, bestow upon us wealth; and do you (also) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋभु॑क्षणो वाजा मा॒दय॑ध्वम॒स्मे न॑रो मघवानः सु॒तस्य॑ । आ वो॒ऽर्वाच॒: क्रत॑वो॒ न या॒तां विभ्वो॒ रथं॒ नर्यं॑ वर्तयन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́bhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ vājāḥ ǀ mādáyadhvam ǀ asmé íti ǀ naraḥ ǀ magha-vānaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ arvā́caḥ ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yātā́m ǀ ví-bhvaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ náryam ǀ vartayantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛbhu, (Vibhu), andVāja, leaders of rites, possessors of opulence, be exhilarated by our effused(libation); may your active and powerful (horses) bring to our presence your chariot, beneficial to mankiṇḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुॠ॒भुभि॑र॒भि व॑: स्याम॒ विभ्वो॑ वि॒भुभि॒: शव॑सा॒ शवां॑सि । वाजो॑ अ॒स्माँ अ॑वतु॒ वाज॑साता॒विन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा त॑रुषेम वृ॒त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ ví-bhvaḥ ǀ vibhú-bhiḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ śávāṃsi ǀvā́jaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ avatu ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ índreṇa ǀ yujā́ ǀ taruṣema ǀ vṛtrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty with theṚbhus, opulent with theVibhus, may we overcome by strength, the strength (of ourfoes); mayVājadefend us in battle; withIndra, our ally, may we destroy the enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते चि॒द्धि पू॒र्वीर॒भि सन्ति॑ शा॒सा विश्वाँ॑ अ॒र्य उ॑प॒रता॑ति वन्वन् । इन्द्रो॒ विभ्वाँ॑ ऋभु॒क्षा वाजो॑ अ॒र्यः शत्रो॑र्मिथ॒त्या कृ॑णव॒न्वि नृ॒म्णम्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ śāsā́ ǀ víśvān ǀ aryáḥ ǀ upará-tāti ǀ vanvan ǀíndraḥ ǀ ví-bhvā ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ śátroḥ ǀ mithatyā́ ǀ kṛṇavan ǀ ví ǀ nṛmṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They verily, (IndraandṚbhus), overcome multitudes by their prowess; they overcome all enemies inthe missile conflict; may Indra, Vibhvan,ṚbhukṣinandVāja, the subduers of foes, annihilate by their wrath thestrength of the enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू दे॑वासो॒ वरि॑वः कर्तना नो भू॒त नो॒ विश्वेऽव॑से स॒जोषा॑: । सम॒स्मे इषं॒ वस॑वो ददीरन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kartana ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtá ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ávase ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀsám ǀ asmé íti ǀ íṣam ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ dadīran ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us, deities, this day opulence; may you all, may you all, well- plural ased alike, be (ready) for ourprotection; may the exalted (Ṛbhus) bestow upon us food; and do you (all) ever cherish us with blessingṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रज्ये॑ष्ठाः सलि॒लस्य॒ मध्या॑त्पुना॒ना य॒न्त्यनि॑विशमानाः । इन्द्रो॒ या व॒ज्री वृ॑ष॒भो र॒राद॒ ता आपो॑ दे॒वीरि॒ह माम॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: samudrá-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ salilásya ǀ mádhyāt ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ yanti ǀ áni-viśamānāḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ vajrī́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ rarā́da ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mā́m ǀ avantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters, with their ocen-chief, proceed from the midst of the firmament, purifying (all things), flowingunceasingly; may the divine waters, whom the thunder-bearingIndra, the showerer, sent forth, protect me here(on earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या आपो॑ दि॒व्या उ॒त वा॒ स्रव॑न्ति ख॒नित्रि॑मा उ॒त वा॒ याः स्व॑यं॒जाः । स॒मु॒द्रार्था॒ याः शुच॑यः पाव॒कास्ता आपो॑ दे॒वीरि॒ह माम॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ srávanti ǀ khanítrimāḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ svayam-jā́ḥ ǀsamudrá-arthāḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mā́m ǀ avantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the waters that are in the sky, or those that flow (on the earth), those (whose channels) have beendug, or those that have sprung up spontaneously, and those that seek the ocean. All pure and purifying, maythose divine waters protect me here (on earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यासां॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ याति॒ मध्ये॑ सत्यानृ॒ते अ॑व॒पश्य॒ञ्जना॑नाम् । म॒धु॒श्चुत॒: शुच॑यो॒ याः पा॑व॒कास्ता आपो॑ दे॒वीरि॒ह माम॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yā́sām ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yā́ti ǀ mádhye ǀ satyānṛté íti ǀ ava-páśyan ǀ jánānām ǀmadhu-ścútaḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mā́m ǀ avantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those whose sovereign,Varuṇa, passes in the middle sphere, discriminating the truth and falsehod ofmankind; those shedding sweet showers, pure and purifying; may those divine waters protect me here (on earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यासु॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णो॒ यासु॒ सोमो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा यासूर्ज॒॒ मद॑न्ति । वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो यास्व॒ग्निः प्रवि॑ष्ट॒स्ता आपो॑ दे॒वीरि॒ह माम॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yā́su ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yā́su ǀ sómaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yā́su ǀ ū́rjam ǀ mádanti ǀvaiśvānaráḥ ǀ yā́su ǀ agníḥ ǀ prá-viṣṭaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mā́m ǀ avantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they in which their king,Varuṇa, in whichSoma, abides, in which the gods delight (to receive) thesacrificial food, into whichAgniVaiśvānaraentered, may those diine waters protect me here (on earth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मां मि॑त्रावरुणे॒ह र॑क्षतं कुला॒यय॑द्वि॒श्वय॒न्मा न॒ आ ग॑न् । अ॒ज॒का॒वं दु॒र्दृशी॑कं ति॒रो द॑धे॒ मा मां पद्ये॑न॒ रप॑सा विद॒त्त्सरु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mā́m ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ihá ǀ rakṣatam ǀ kulāyáyat ǀ vi-śváyat ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gan ǀajakā-vám ǀ duḥ-dṛ́śīkam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ mā́ ǀ mā́m ǀ pádyena ǀ rápasā ǀ vidat ǀ tsáruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, protect me here (in this world) let not the insidious and spreading (poison) reach me;may the equally malignant and undiscernible (venom) disappear; let not the tortuous (snake) recognize me by thesound of my footsteps.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वि॒जाम॒न्परु॑षि॒ वन्द॑नं॒ भुव॑दष्ठी॒वन्तौ॒ परि॑ कु॒ल्फौ च॒ देह॑त् । अ॒ग्निष्टच्छोच॒न्नप॑ बाधतामि॒तो मा मां पद्ये॑न॒ रप॑सा विद॒त्त्सरु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vi-jā́man ǀ páruṣi ǀ vándanam ǀ bhúvat ǀ aṣṭhīvántau ǀ pári ǀ kulpháu ǀ ca ǀ déhat ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ śócan ǀ ápa ǀ bādhatām ǀ itáḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ mā́m ǀ pádyena ǀ rápasā ǀ vidat ǀ tsáruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the brilliantAgnicounteract that poison which is genitive rated in the manifold knots (of trees) and thelike, or which is smeared upon the knees of ankles; let not the tortuous snake recognize me by the sound of myfootsteps.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्छ॑ल्म॒लौ भव॑ति॒ यन्न॒दीषु॒ यदोष॑धीभ्य॒: परि॒ जाय॑ते वि॒षम् । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा निरि॒तस्तत्सु॑वन्तु॒ मा मां पद्ये॑न॒ रप॑सा विद॒त्त्सरु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ śalmaláu ǀ bhávati ǀ yát ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ jā́yate ǀ viṣám ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀ tát ǀ suvantu ǀ mā́ ǀ mā́m ǀ pádyena ǀ rápasā ǀ vidat ǀ tsáruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The poison that is in theŚalmalītree, in the rivers, or which is genitive rated from plural nts, may theuniversal gods remove from hence; let not the tortuous (snake) recognize me by the sound of my footsteps.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याः प्र॒वतो॑ नि॒वत॑ उ॒द्वत॑ उद॒न्वती॑रनुद॒काश्च॒ याः । ता अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ पय॑सा॒ पिन्व॑मानाः शि॒वा दे॒वीर॑शिप॒दा भ॑वन्तु॒ सर्वा॑ न॒द्यो॑ अशिमि॒दा भ॑वन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ni-vátaḥ ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀ udan-vátīḥ ǀ anudakā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ páyasā ǀ pínvamānāḥ ǀ śivā́ḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ aśipadā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ aśimidā́ḥ ǀ bhavantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine rivers, whether flowing down declivities, in hollow plural ces, or upwards, whether filled withwater or dry, nourishing all with their water, be auspicious to us communicating not disease; may all the rivers beunproductive of harm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्याना॒मव॑सा॒ नूत॑नेन सक्षी॒महि॒ शर्म॑णा॒ शंत॑मेन । अ॒ना॒गा॒स्त्वे अ॑दिति॒त्वे तु॒रास॑ इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं द॑धतु॒ श्रोष॑माणाः
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́nām ǀ ávasā ǀ nū́tanena ǀ sakṣīmáhi ǀ śármaṇā ǀ śám-tamena ǀanāgā́ḥ-tvé ǀ aditi-tvé ǀ turā́saḥ ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ dadhatu ǀ śróṣamāṇāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, through the protection of theĀdityas, be in the enjoyment of a new and comfortable dwelling;may the swift-moving Ādityas, listening to our praises, preserve this their worshipper in sinlessness andindependence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्यासो॒ अदि॑तिर्मादयन्तां मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णो॒ रजि॑ष्ठाः । अ॒स्माकं॑ सन्तु॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पाः पिब॑न्तु॒ सोम॒मव॑से नो अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́saḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ mādayantām ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ rájiṣṭhāḥ ǀasmā́kam ǀ santu ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ píbantu ǀ sómam ǀ ávase ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theĀdityasandAditi, and the uprightMitra,Āryaman, andVaruṇa, be exhilarated (by thelibation); may the guardians of the world be ours also; may they drink theSomatoday for our preservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्या विश्वे॑ म॒रुत॑श्च॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाश्च॒ विश्व॑ ऋ॒भव॑श्च॒ विश्वे॑ । इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ग्निर॒श्विना॑ तुष्टुवा॒ना यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́ḥ ǀ víśve ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśve ǀíndraḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ tustuvānā́ḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All theĀdityas, all theMaruts, all the gods, all theṚbhus,Indra,Agni, and theAśvins, (have been)glorified (by us), do you all ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्यासो॒ अदि॑तयः स्याम॒ पूर्दे॑व॒त्रा व॑सवो मर्त्य॒त्रा । सने॑म मित्रावरुणा॒ सन॑न्तो॒ भवे॑म द्यावापृथिवी॒ भव॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́saḥ ǀ áditayaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ pū́ḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ martya-trā́ ǀsánema ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sánantaḥ ǀ bhávema ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ bhávantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, may we be independent;Vasus, (dwelling) among the gods, may your protection (extend) tomortals; offering (oblations to you),MitraandVaruṇa, may we partake (of your bounty); may we, heaven andearth exist (through your favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्तन्नो॒ वरु॑णो मामहन्त॒ शर्म॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय गो॒पाः । मा वो॑ भुजेमा॒न्यजा॑त॒मेनो॒ मा तत्क॑र्म वसवो॒ यच्चय॑ध्वे
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mamahanta ǀ śárma ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ bhujema ǀ anyá-jātam ǀ énaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ tát ǀ karma ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ yát ǀ cáyadhve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitraandVaruṇabestow upon us felicity; (may they), the guardians (of all men, bestow felicity)upon our sons and grandsons; let us not suffer (gods), for offences committed by another; let us not,Vasus, doany act by which you may be offended.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तु॒र॒ण्यवोऽङ्गि॑रसो नक्षन्त॒ रत्नं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुरि॑या॒नाः । पि॒ता च॒ तन्नो॑ म॒हान्यज॑त्रो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः सम॑नसो जुषन्त
shlokas.transliteration: turaṇyávaḥ ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ nakṣanta ǀ rátnam ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ iyānā́ḥ ǀpitā́ ǀ ca ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ yájatraḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAṅgirasas, prompt (in worship), soliciting him obtain preious (wealth) fromSavitā; may the mightyadorable parent, and the universal god alike favourable minded, approve (of the donation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र द्यावा॑ य॒ज्ञैः पृ॑थि॒वी नमो॑भिः स॒बाध॑ ईळे बृह॒ती यज॑त्रे । ते चि॒द्धि पूर्वे॑ क॒वयो॑ गृ॒णन्त॑: पु॒रो म॒ही द॑धि॒रे दे॒वपु॑त्रे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dyā́vā ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ īḷe ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ yájatre íti ǀté íti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ pū́rve ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ dadhiré ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Attended by a concourse (of priests) I worship the adorable and mighty Heaven and Earth withsacrifices and praises, those wo great ones of whom the gods are the sons, whom ancient sages glorifying haveformerly detained.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पू॑र्व॒जे पि॒तरा॒ नव्य॑सीभिर्गी॒र्भिः कृ॑णुध्वं॒ सद॑ने ऋ॒तस्य॑ । आ नो॑ द्यावापृथिवी॒ दैव्ये॑न॒ जने॑न यातं॒ महि॑ वां॒ वरू॑थम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pūrvajé íti pūrva-jé ǀ pitárā ǀ návyasībhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ sádane íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ dáivyena ǀ jánena ǀ yātam ǀ máhi ǀ vām ǀ várūtham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural ce before (us) in the hall of sacrifice, with new songs, the ancient parents (of all beings); come to us,Heaven and Earth, with the celestial people, for vast is your protecting (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो हि वां॑ रत्न॒धेया॑नि॒ सन्ति॑ पु॒रूणि॑ द्यावापृथिवी सु॒दासे॑ । अ॒स्मे ध॑त्तं॒ यदस॒दस्कृ॑धोयु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ ratna-dhéyāni ǀ sánti ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ su-dā́se ǀasmé íti ǀ dhattam ǀ yát ǀ ásat ǀ áskṛdhoyu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many, Heavan and Earth, are the treasures fit to be given to the pious donor (of the oblation); give to usthat wealth which is unlimited; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वास्तो॑ष्पते॒ प्रति॑ जानीह्य॒स्मान्त्स्वा॑वे॒शो अ॑नमी॒वो भ॑वा नः । यत्त्वेम॑हे॒ प्रति॒ तन्नो॑ जुषस्व॒ शं नो॑ भव द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे
shlokas.transliteration: vā́stoḥ ǀ pate ǀ práti ǀ jānīhi ǀ asmā́n ǀ su-āveśáḥ ǀ anamīváḥ ǀ bhava ǀ naḥ ǀyát ǀ tvā ǀ ī́mahe ǀ práti ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǀ śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǀ dvi-páde ǀ śám ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protector of the dwelling, recognize us; be to us an excellent abode the non-inflicter of disease;whatever we ask of you, be plural ased to grant; be the bestower of happiness on our bipeds and quadrupedṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: वास्तो॑ष्पते प्र॒तर॑णो न एधि गय॒स्फानो॒ गोभि॒रश्वे॑भिरिन्दो । अ॒जरा॑सस्ते स॒ख्ये स्या॑म पि॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रान्प्रति॑ नो जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: vā́stoḥ ǀ pate ǀ pra-táraṇaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ edhi ǀ gaya-sphā́naḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ indo íti ǀajárāsaḥ ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ syāma ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ putrā́n ǀ práti ǀ naḥ ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protector of the dwelling, be our preserver and the augmenter of our wealth; possessed of catle andhorses,Indra, may we, through your friendship, be exempt from decay; be favourable to us, like a father to hissons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वास्तो॑ष्पते श॒ग्मया॑ सं॒सदा॑ ते सक्षी॒महि॑ र॒ण्वया॑ गातु॒मत्या॑ । पा॒हि क्षेम॑ उ॒त योगे॒ वरं॑ नो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: vā́stoḥ ǀ pate ǀ śagmáyā ǀ sam-sádā ǀ te ǀ sakṣīmáhi ǀ raṇváyā ǀ gātu-mátyā ǀpāhí ǀ kṣéme ǀ utá ǀ yóge ǀ váram ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protector of the dwelling, may we be possessed of a comfortable, delightful, opulent abode, bestowedby you; protect our wealth, whether in possession or expectaion; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us withblessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मी॒व॒हा वा॑स्तोष्पते॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाण्या॑वि॒शन् । सखा॑ सु॒शेव॑ एधि नः
shlokas.transliteration: amīva-hā́ ǀ vāstoḥ ǀ pate ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ ā-viśán ǀsákhā ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ edhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protector of the dwelling, remover of disease, assuming all (kinds of) forms, be to us a friend, thegranter of happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑र्जुन सारमेय द॒तः पि॑शङ्ग॒ यच्छ॑से । वी॑व भ्राजन्त ऋ॒ष्टय॒ उप॒ स्रक्वे॑षु॒ बप्स॑तो॒ नि षु स्व॑प
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ arjuna ǀ sārameya ǀ datáḥ ǀ piśaṅga ǀ yácchase ǀví-iva ǀ bhrājante ǀ ṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ srákveṣu ǀ bápsataḥ ǀ ní ǀ sú ǀ svapa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “White offspring ofSaramā, with tawny limbs, althogh barking you display your teeth against me,bristling like lances in your gums, nevertheless, to quietly to sleep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्ते॒नं रा॑य सारमेय॒ तस्क॑रं वा पुनःसर । स्तो॒तॄनिन्द्र॑स्य रायसि॒ किम॒स्मान्दु॑च्छुनायसे॒ नि षु स्व॑प
shlokas.transliteration: stenám ǀ rāya ǀ sārameya ǀ táskaram ǀ vā ǀ punaḥ-sara ǀstotṝ́n ǀ índrasya ǀ rāyasi ǀ kím ǀ asmā́n ǀ ducchuna-yase ǀ ní ǀ sú ǀ svapa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offspring ofSaramā, returning (to the charge), attack the pilferer or the thief; why do you assail theworshippers ofIndra? Why do you intimidate us? Go quietly to sleep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सू॑क॒रस्य॑ दर्दृहि॒ तव॑ दर्दर्तु सूक॒रः । स्तो॒तॄनिन्द्र॑स्य रायसि॒ किम॒स्मान्दु॑च्छुनायसे॒ नि षु स्व॑प
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sūkarásya ǀ dardṛhi ǀ táva ǀ dardartu ǀ sūkaráḥ ǀstotṝ́n ǀ índrasya ǀ rāyasi ǀ kím ǀ asmā́n ǀ ducchuna-yase ǀ ní ǀ sú ǀ svapa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you rend the hog; let the hog rend you; why do you assail the worshippers ofIndra? Why do youintimidate us? Go quietly to sleep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सस्तु॑ मा॒ता सस्तु॑ पि॒ता सस्तु॒ श्वा सस्तु॑ वि॒श्पति॑: । स॒सन्तु॒ सर्वे॑ ज्ञा॒तय॒: सस्त्व॒यम॒भितो॒ जन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sástu ǀ mātā́ ǀ sástu ǀ pitā́ ǀ sástu ǀ śvā́ ǀ sástu ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀsasántu ǀ sárve ǀ jñātáyaḥ ǀ sástu ǀ ayám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the mother sleep let the father sleep, let the dog sleep, let the son-in-law sleep, let all the kindredsleep, let the people (who are stationed) around sleep.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आस्ते॒ यश्च॒ चर॑ति॒ यश्च॒ पश्य॑ति नो॒ जन॑: । तेषां॒ सं ह॑न्मो अ॒क्षाणि॒ यथे॒दं ह॒र्म्यं तथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ā́ste ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ cárati ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ páśyati ǀ naḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ sám ǀ hanmaḥ ǀ akṣā́ṇi ǀ yáthā ǀ idám ǀ harmyám ǀ táthā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who sits, or he who walks, or he who sees us, of these weshutup the eyes, so that they maybe as unconscious as the mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑शृङ्गो वृष॒भो यः स॑मु॒द्रादु॒दाच॑रत् । तेना॑ सह॒स्ये॑ना व॒यं नि जना॑न्त्स्वापयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ samudrā́t ǀ ut-ā́carat ǀténa ǀ sahasyéna ǀ vayám ǀ ní ǀ jánān ǀ svāpayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We put men to sleep through the irresisible might or the bull with a thousand horns, who rises out of theocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो॒ष्ठे॒श॒या व॑ह्येश॒या नारी॒र्यास्त॑ल्प॒शीव॑रीः । स्त्रियो॒ याः पुण्य॑गन्धा॒स्ताः सर्वा॑: स्वापयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: proṣṭhe-śayā́ḥ ǀ vahye-śayā́ḥ ǀ nā́rīḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ talpa-śī́varīḥ ǀstríyaḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ púṇya-gandhāḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ svāpayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We put to sleep all those women are lying in the courtyard in litter on the bed, the wom who aredecorated with holiday perfumes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क ईं॒ व्य॑क्ता॒ नर॒: सनी॑ळा रु॒द्रस्य॒ मर्या॒ अध॒ स्वश्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ īm ǀ ví-aktāḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀ rudrásya ǀ máryāḥ ǀ ádha ǀ su-áśvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who are these resplendent chiefs, the dwellers in one abode, the sons ofRudra, friends of man, atpresent well-mounted?”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॒र्ह्ये॑षां ज॒नूंषि॒ वेद॒ ते अ॒ङ्ग वि॑द्रे मि॒थो ज॒नित्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ janū́ṃṣi ǀ véda ǀ té ǀ aṅgá ǀ vidre ǀ mitháḥ ǀ janítram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one indeed knows their origin, they alone respectively know their birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि स्व॒पूभि॑र्मि॒थो व॑पन्त॒ वात॑स्वनसः श्ये॒ना अ॑स्पृध्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sva-pū́bhiḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǀ vapanta ǀ vā́ta-svanasaḥ ǀ śyenā́ḥ ǀ aspṛdhran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They go together by their own pure paths; roaring like the wind, and fleet as falcons, they mutually rivaleach other.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तानि॒ धीरो॑ नि॒ण्या चि॑केत॒ पृश्नि॒र्यदूधो॑ म॒ही ज॒भार॑
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ niṇyā́ ǀ ciketa ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ yát ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ mahī́ ǀ jabhā́ra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage may know those white-complexioned beings (theMaruts), whom the vastPṛṣṇiborn at herudder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा विट् सु॒वीरा॑ म॒रुद्भि॑रस्तु स॒नात्सह॑न्ती॒ पुष्य॑न्ती नृ॒म्णम्
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ ǀ víṭ ǀ su-vī́rā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ astu ǀ sanā́t ǀ sáhantī ǀ púṣyantī ǀ nṛmṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the people, through (the favours of) theMaruts, always victorious, possessed ofmaleposterity,and in the enjoyment of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यामं॒ येष्ठा॑: शु॒भा शोभि॑ष्ठाः श्रि॒या सम्मि॑श्ला॒ ओजो॑भिरु॒ग्राः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́mam ǀ yéṣṭhāḥ ǀ śubhā́ ǀ śóbhiṣṭhāḥ ǀ śriyā́ ǀ sám-miślāḥ ǀ ójaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsrapidly repair to the plural ce (of their destination), richly decorated with ornaments, investedwith beauty, terrible by their strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रं व॒ ओज॑: स्थि॒रा शवां॒स्यधा॑ म॒रुद्भि॑र्ग॒णस्तुवि॑ष्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: ugrám ǀ vaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ sthirā́ ǀ śávāṃsi ǀ ádha ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Terrible be your strength, steadfast your energies, prosperous be the company of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒भ्रो व॒: शुष्म॒: क्रुध्मी॒ मनां॑सि॒ धुनि॒र्मुनि॑रिव॒ शर्ध॑स्य धृ॒ष्णोः
shlokas.transliteration: śubhráḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ krúdhmī ǀ mánāṃsi ǀ dhúniḥ ǀ múniḥ-iva ǀ śárdhasya ǀ dhṛṣṇóḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorious is your vigour, unrelenting are your minds; (the exertion) of your irresistible force, the agitator(of the trees), is like (the manifold tone of the prayers of) amuni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सने॑म्य॒स्मद्यु॒योत॑ दि॒द्युं मा वो॑ दुर्म॒तिरि॒ह प्रण॑ङ्नः
shlokas.transliteration: sánemi ǀ asmát ǀ yuyóta ǀ didyúm ǀ mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ ihá ǀ práṇak ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Withhold from us your ancient blazing (weapon) let not your displeasure light upon us at this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒या वो॒ नाम॑ हुवे तु॒राणा॒मा यत्तृ॒पन्म॑रुतो वावशा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: priyā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ huve ǀ turā́ṇām ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ tṛpát ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke your beloved names,Maruts, destroyers (of foes), that they who are desirous of the offeringmay be satisfied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒यु॒धास॑ इ॒ष्मिण॑: सुनि॒ष्का उ॒त स्व॒यं त॒न्व१॒॑: शुम्भ॑मानाः
shlokas.transliteration: su-āyudhā́saḥ ǀ iṣmíṇaḥ ǀ su-niṣkā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ svayám ǀ tanváḥ ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearers are (theMaruts) of bright weapons, rapid are they in motion, wearers of brilliant ornaments,and self-radiators of their person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुची॑ वो ह॒व्या म॑रुत॒: शुची॑नां॒ शुचिं॑ हिनोम्यध्व॒रं शुचि॑भ्यः । ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमृ॑त॒साप॑ आय॒ञ्छुचि॑जन्मान॒: शुच॑यः पाव॒काः
shlokas.transliteration: śúcī ǀ vaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śúcīnām ǀ śúcim ǀ hinomi ǀ adhvarám ǀ śúci-bhyaḥ ǀṛténa ǀ satyám ǀ ṛta-sā́paḥ ǀ āyan ǀ śúci-janmānaḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure oblations be offered,Maruts, to you who are pure; the shedders of water proceed by truth to truth,pure, purifying, of pure birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अंसे॒ष्वा म॑रुतः खा॒दयो॑ वो॒ वक्ष॑स्सु रु॒क्मा उ॑पशिश्रिया॒णाः । वि वि॒द्युतो॒ न वृ॒ष्टिभी॑ रुचा॒ना अनु॑ स्व॒धामायु॑धै॒र्यच्छ॑मानाः
shlokas.transliteration: áṃseṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ khādáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ-su ǀ rukmā́ḥ ǀ upa-śiśriyāṇā́ḥ ǀví ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀ rucānā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́m ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ yácchamānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright ornaments,Maruts, are on your shoulders, shining (necklaces) are pendant on your breasts,glittering with rain, like lightnings, you are distributing the waters with your weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र बु॒ध्न्या॑ व ईरते॒ महां॑सि॒ प्र नामा॑नि प्रयज्यवस्तिरध्वम् । स॒ह॒स्रियं॒ दम्यं॑ भा॒गमे॒तं गृ॑हमे॒धीयं॑ मरुतो जुषध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ budhnyā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ īrate ǀ máhāṃsi ǀ prá ǀ nā́māni ǀ pra-yajyavaḥ ǀ tiradhvam ǀsahasríyam ǀ dámyam ǀ bhāgám ǀ etám ǀ gṛha-medhī́yam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ juṣadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your celestial splendours,Maruts, spread wide; objects of worship, you send down (the waters) thatbeat down (the dust); accept Maruts, this your portion of the domestic worship of the household multiplied athousand-fold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑ स्तु॒तस्य॑ मरुतो अधी॒थेत्था विप्र॑स्य वा॒जिनो॒ हवी॑मन् । म॒क्षू रा॒यः सु॒वीर्य॑स्य दात॒ नू चि॒द्यम॒न्य आ॒दभ॒दरा॑वा
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ stutásya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ adhi-ithá ǀ itthā́ ǀ víprasya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ hávīman ǀmakṣú ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ dāta ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ā-dábhat ǀ árāvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If,Maruts, you justly appreciate the praise of the devout offerer of (sacrificial) food, conjoined withoblations, then promptly bestow (upon us) riches, comprehending excellentmaleposterity, such as no unfriendlyman can take away.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्या॑सो॒ न ये म॒रुत॒: स्वञ्चो॑ यक्ष॒दृशो॒ न शु॒भय॑न्त॒ मर्या॑: । ते ह॑र्म्ये॒ष्ठाः शिश॑वो॒ न शु॒भ्रा व॒त्सासो॒ न प्र॑क्री॒ळिन॑: पयो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: átyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-áñcaḥ ǀ yakṣa-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubháyanta ǀ máryāḥ ǀté ǀ harmye-sthā́ḥ ǀ śíśavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ vatsā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-krīḷínaḥ ǀ payaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swift-movingMarutsare like rapid horses, shining like men gazing at a festival innocent as childrenin the (paternal) mansion, frolicsome as calves, they are the dispensers of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒श॒स्यन्तो॑ नो म॒रुतो॑ मृळन्तु वरिव॒स्यन्तो॒ रोद॑सी सु॒मेके॑ । आ॒रे गो॒हा नृ॒हा व॒धो वो॑ अस्तु सु॒म्नेभि॑र॒स्मे व॑सवो नमध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: daśasyántaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mṛḷantu ǀ varivasyántaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀāré ǀ go-hā́ ǀ nṛ-hā́ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ namadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the munificentMaruts, filling the beautiful heaven and earth with their glory, make us happy; yourfatal weapon, the render of clouds, the destroyer of men, be far from us; bend down to us,Vasus, with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॒ होता॑ जोहवीति स॒त्तः स॒त्राचीं॑ रा॒तिं म॑रुतो गृणा॒नः । य ईव॑तो वृषणो॒ अस्ति॑ गो॒पाः सो अद्व॑यावी हवते व उ॒क्थैः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ hótā ǀ johavīti ǀ sattáḥ ǀ satrā́cī ǀ rātím ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ī́vataḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ádvayāvī ǀ havate ǀ vaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praising your universal liberality,Maruts, the ministrant priest repeatedly worships you, seated (in thesacrificial chamber); he, showerers (of benefits), who is the guardian of the zealous (worshipper), he (the priest),who is void of insincerity, glorifies you with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे तु॒रं म॒रुतो॑ रामयन्ती॒मे सह॒: सह॑स॒ आ न॑मन्ति । इ॒मे शंसं॑ वनुष्य॒तो नि पा॑न्ति गु॒रु द्वेषो॒ अर॑रुषे दधन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ turám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ ramayanti ǀ imé ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ namanti ǀimé ǀ śáṃsam ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ ní ǀ pānti ǀ gurú ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ áraruṣe ǀ dadhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These,Maruts, give plural asure to the zealous (worshipper); these humble the strength of the strong man;they entertain severe displeasure towards the withholder of offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे र॒ध्रं चि॑न्म॒रुतो॑ जुनन्ति॒ भृमिं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ वस॑वो जु॒षन्त॑ । अप॑ बाधध्वं वृषण॒स्तमां॑सि ध॒त्त विश्वं॒ तन॑यं तो॒कम॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ radhrám ǀ cit ǀ marútaḥ ǀ junanti ǀ bhṛ́mim ǀ cit ǀ yáthā ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀápa ǀ bādhadhvam ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ dhattá ǀ víśvam ǀ tánayam ǀ tokám ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These,Maruts, encourage the prosperous man; they encourage the (poor) wanderer; they, asVasus,are plural ased (with you); showerers (of benefits), dissipate the darkness; grant us many sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा वो॑ दा॒त्रान्म॑रुतो॒ निर॑राम॒ मा प॒श्चाद्द॑घ्म रथ्यो विभा॒गे । आ न॑: स्पा॒र्हे भ॑जतना वस॒व्ये॒३॒॑ यदीं॑ सुजा॒तं वृ॑षणो वो॒ अस्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ dātrā́t ǀ marutaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ arāma ǀ mā́ ǀ paścā́t ǀ daghma ǀ rathyaḥ ǀ vi-bhāgé ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhé ǀ bhajatana ǀ vasavyé ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ su-jātám ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ásti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never,Maruts, may we be excluded from your bounty; let us not, lords of chariots, be last in itsapportionment; make us sharers in that desirable opulence which, showerers (of benefit), is born of you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यद्धन॑न्त म॒न्युभि॒र्जना॑स॒: शूरा॑ य॒ह्वीष्वोष॑धीषु वि॒क्षु । अध॑ स्मा नो मरुतो रुद्रियासस्त्रा॒तारो॑ भूत॒ पृत॑नास्व॒र्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ hánanta ǀ manyú-bhiḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ śū́rāḥ ǀ yahvī́ṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ rudriyāsaḥ ǀ trātā́raḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ aryáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When heroic men, filled with wrath, assemble for (the sake of conquering) many plural nts and people;then,Maruts, sons ofRudra, be our defenders in battles against our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॑ चक्र मरुत॒: पित्र्या॑ण्यु॒क्थानि॒ या व॑: श॒स्यन्ते॑ पु॒रा चि॑त् । म॒रुद्भि॑रु॒ग्रः पृत॑नासु॒ साळ्हा॑ म॒रुद्भि॒रित्सनि॑ता॒ वाज॒मर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ cakra ǀ marutaḥ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śasyánte ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀmarút-bhiḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sā́ḷhā ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ ít ǀ sánitā ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have bestowed,Maruts, many (benefits) on our forefathers, which praiseworthy (benefits) havebeen celebrated in former times; by the (favour of the) Maruts the fierce (warrior) is victorious in combats; by the(favour of the) Maruts the worshipper ever obtains food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे वी॒रो म॑रुतः शु॒ष्म्य॑स्तु॒ जना॑नां॒ यो असु॑रो विध॒र्ता । अ॒पो येन॑ सुक्षि॒तये॒ तरे॒माध॒ स्वमोको॑ अ॒भि व॑: स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ vīráḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ astu ǀ jánānām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀapáḥ ǀ yéna ǀ su-kṣitáye ǀ tárema ǀ ádha ǀ svám ǀ ókaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May ourmaleprogeny,Maruts, be vigorous, one who is intelligent, the scatterer of (hostile) men, bywhom we may cross the water (of enmity) to a secure dwelling; may we, your (servants), dwell in our own abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्न॒ इन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निराप॒ ओष॑धीर्व॒निनो॑ जुषन्त । शर्म॑न्त्स्याम म॒रुता॑मु॒पस्थे॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀśárman ǀ syāma ǀ marútām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Agni, the waters, the plural nts, the trees, be plural ased with us; may we recline inhappiness upon the lap of theMaruts; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्वो॑ वो॒ नाम॒ मारु॑तं यजत्रा॒: प्र य॒ज्ञेषु॒ शव॑सा मदन्ति । ये रे॒जय॑न्ति॒ रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी पिन्व॒न्त्युत्सं॒ यदया॑सुरु॒ग्राः
shlokas.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ mā́rutam ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ śávasā ǀ madanti ǀyé ǀ rejáyanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀ pínvanti ǀ útsam ǀ yát ǀ áyāsuḥ ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable (Maruts), the worshippers vigorously celebrate at sacrifices your appellation of company ofthe Maruts, they who cause the spacious heaven and earth to tremble, the clouds to rain, the move everywhereterrible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒चे॒तारो॒ हि म॒रुतो॑ गृ॒णन्तं॑ प्रणे॒तारो॒ यज॑मानस्य॒ मन्म॑ । अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्य वि॒दथे॑षु ब॒र्हिरा वी॒तये॑ सदत पिप्रिया॒णाः
shlokas.transliteration: ni-cetā́raḥ ǀ hí ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gṛṇántam ǀ pra-netā́raḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ mánma ǀasmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vītáye ǀ sadata ǀ pipriyāṇā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsverily are the benefactors of him who praises them, the gratifiers of the wishes of theinstitutor of the solemnity; do you, being plural ased, sit down today upon the grass at our ceremony, to partake (ofthe sacrificial food).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नैताव॑द॒न्ये म॒रुतो॒ यथे॒मे भ्राज॑न्ते रु॒क्मैरायु॑धैस्त॒नूभि॑: । आ रोद॑सी विश्व॒पिश॑: पिशा॒नाः स॑मा॒नम॒ञ्ज्य॑ञ्जते शु॒भे कम्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ etā́vat ǀ anyé ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ imé ǀ bhrā́jante ǀ rukmáiḥ ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viśva-píśaḥ ǀ piśānā́ḥ ǀ samānám ǀ añjí ǀ añjate ǀ śubhé ǀ kám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No other (deities give) such (good things) as theMaruts, as they shine with brilliant (ornaments),weapons and person ns; illumining heaven and earth, wide-radiating, they heighten their common lustre for (our)good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋध॒क्सा वो॑ मरुतो दि॒द्युद॑स्तु॒ यद्व॒ आग॑: पुरु॒षता॒ करा॑म । मा व॒स्तस्या॒मपि॑ भूमा यजत्रा अ॒स्मे वो॑ अस्तु सुम॒तिश्चनि॑ष्ठा
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́dhak ǀ sā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ didyút ǀ astu ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ puruṣátā ǀ kárāma ǀmā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ tásyām ǀ ápi ǀ bhūma ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that blazing (weapon) of your,Maruts, be far from us, although, through human infirmities, we offeryou offence; let us not, adorable Maruts, be exposed to your (shaft); may your favour the source of abundance,ever be shown to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ते चि॒दत्र॑ म॒रुतो॑ रणन्तानव॒द्यास॒: शुच॑यः पाव॒काः । प्र णो॑ऽवत सुम॒तिभि॑र्यजत्रा॒: प्र वाजे॑भिस्तिरत पु॒ष्यसे॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛté ǀ cit ǀ átra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ raṇanta ǀ anavadyā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ avata ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ prá ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ tirata ǀ puṣyáse ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMaruts, who are irreproachable, pure, and purifying, delight in this our ceremony; protect us,adorable Maruts, with favourable thoughts; be ever anxious to sustain us with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्तु॒तासो॑ म॒रुतो॑ व्यन्तु॒ विश्वे॑भि॒र्नाम॑भि॒र्नरो॑ ह॒वींषि॑ । ददा॑त नो अ॒मृत॑स्य प्र॒जायै॑ जिगृ॒त रा॒यः सू॒नृता॑ म॒घानि॑
