shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vyantu ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ nā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀdádāta ǀ naḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ jigṛtá ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the glorifiedMarutspartake of the oblations, they who, accompanied by the bending waters, arethe leaders of rites; bestow water, Maruts, upon our progeny, return suitable opulence for (the donation ofsacrificial) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स्तु॒तासो॑ मरुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती अच्छा॑ सू॒रीन्त्स॒र्वता॑ता जिगात । ये न॒स्त्मना॑ श॒तिनो॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ति यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ūtī́ ǀ áccha ǀ sūrī́n ǀ sarvá-tātā ǀ jigāta ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ tmánā ǀ śatínaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “GlorifiedMaruts, do you all come at the time of sacrifice to the presence of the worshippers along withyour protections, for you are they who, of your own will, multiply our hundreds; do you ever cherish us withblessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सा॑क॒मुक्षे॑ अर्चता ग॒णाय॒ यो दैव्य॑स्य॒ धाम्न॒स्तुवि॑ष्मान् । उ॒त क्षो॑दन्ति॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा नक्ष॑न्ते॒ नाकं॒ निॠ॑तेरवं॒शात्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sākam-úkṣe ǀ arcata ǀ gaṇā́ya ǀ yáḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀ dhā́mnaḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀutá ǀ kṣodanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ nákṣante ǀ nā́kam ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ avaṃśā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer worship to the company (of theMaruts), the associated dispensers of moisture, which is powerfulover the celestial region; the Maruts, by their greatness, oppress both heaven and earth; they spread from theearth and the firmament to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒नूश्चि॑द्वो मरुतस्त्वे॒ष्ये॑ण॒ भीमा॑स॒स्तुवि॑मन्य॒वोऽया॑सः । प्र ये महो॑भि॒रोज॑सो॒त सन्ति॒ विश्वो॑ वो॒ याम॑न्भयते स्व॒र्दृक्
shlokas.transliteration: janū́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ tveṣyéṇa ǀ bhī́māsaḥ ǀ túvi-manyavaḥ ǀ áyāsaḥ ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ utá ǀ sánti ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ bhayate ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́k ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Formidable, high-spirited, quick-movingMaruts, your birth is from the illustriousRudra; every gazer onthe sun is alarmed with the course of you who are pre-eminent in lustre and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हद्वयो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो दधात॒ जुजो॑ष॒न्निन्म॒रुत॑: सुष्टु॒तिं न॑: । ग॒तो नाध्वा॒ वि ति॑राति ज॒न्तुं प्र ण॑: स्पा॒र्हाभि॑रू॒तिभि॑स्तिरेत
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dadhāta ǀ jújoṣan ǀ ít ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-stutím ǀ naḥ ǀgatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ádhvā ǀ ví ǀ tirāti ǀ jantúm ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tireta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant,Maruts, to us who are affluent (in sacrificial offering) abundant food; accept complacently ourearnest praise; the path you follow is not hurtful to living beings; may it increase our (prosperity) by (your)desirable protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्मोतो॒ विप्रो॑ मरुतः शत॒स्वी यु॒ष्मोतो॒ अर्वा॒ सहु॑रिः सह॒स्री । यु॒ष्मोत॑: स॒म्राळु॒त ह॑न्ति वृ॒त्रं प्र तद्वो॑ अस्तु धूतयो दे॒ष्णम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ śatasvī́ ǀ yuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ árvā ǀ sáhuriḥ ǀ sahasrī́ ǀyuṣmā́-ūtaḥ ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ utá ǀ hanti ǀ vṛtrám ǀ prá ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ dhūtayaḥ ǀ deṣṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious man protected,Maruts, by you, is the possessor of hundreds; the assailant, overcomer (ofhis foes), protected by you, is the possessor of thousands; protected by you, the emperor slays his enemy; maythe wealth that is given, agitators, by you ever be abundant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताँ आ रु॒द्रस्य॑ मी॒ळ्हुषो॑ विवासे कु॒विन्नंस॑न्ते म॒रुत॒: पुन॑र्नः । यत्स॒स्वर्ता॑ जिहीळि॒रे यदा॒विरव॒ तदेन॑ ईमहे तु॒राणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ rudrásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ vivāse ǀ kuvít ǀ náṃsante ǀ marútaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀyát ǀ sasvártā ǀ jihīḷiré ǀ yát ǀ āvíḥ ǀ áva ǀ tát ǀ énaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ turā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I adore those sons of the showerer,Rudra; may theMaruts, repeatedly invoked, again come to us; maywe expiate (by praise) whatever we have committed secretly or openly against the swift-moving Maruts, by whichthey are displeased.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सा वा॑चि सुष्टु॒तिर्म॒घोना॑मि॒दं सू॒क्तं म॒रुतो॑ जुषन्त । आ॒राच्चि॒द्द्वेषो॑ वृषणो युयोत यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sā́ ǀ vāci ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ idám ǀ su-uktám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀārā́t ǀ cit ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ yuyota ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious praise of the opulentMarutshas been recited; may the Maruts be gratified by this hymn;remove far from us, showerers (of benefits), those who hate us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्राय॑ध्व इ॒दमि॑दं॒ देवा॑सो॒ यं च॒ नय॑थ । तस्मा॑ अग्ने॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्रार्य॑म॒न्मरु॑त॒: शर्म॑ यच्छत
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ trā́yadhve ǀ idám-idam ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ca ǀ náyatha ǀtásmai ǀ agne ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀ márutaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,Varuṇa,Mitra,Maruts, grant happiness, gods, to him whom you preserve from (the perils of) this(world), whom you guide here (to the paths of virtue).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्माकं॑ देवा॒ अव॒साह॑नि प्रि॒य ई॑जा॒नस्त॑रति॒ द्विष॑: । प्र स क्षयं॑ तिरते॒ वि म॒हीरिषो॒ यो वो॒ वरा॑य॒ दाश॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́kam ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ áhani ǀ priyé ǀ ījānáḥ ǀ tarati ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀprá ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ tirate ǀ ví ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ várāya ǀ dā́śati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through your protection, gods, the man who worships on an auspicious day overcomes hisadversaries; he who offers abundant (sacrificial) food to you to detain you (at his rite) enlarges his habitation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि व॑श्चर॒मं च॒न वसि॑ष्ठः परि॒मंस॑ते । अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्य म॑रुतः सु॒ते सचा॒ विश्वे॑ पिबत का॒मिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ caramám ǀ caná ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ pari-máṃsate ǀasmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ marutaḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ víśve ǀ pibata ǀ kāmínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vasiṣṭhaoverlooks not the very lowest among you;Maruts, who are desirous (of the libation), do youall drink together today of our effusedSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि व॑ ऊ॒तिः पृत॑नासु॒ मर्ध॑ति॒ यस्मा॒ अरा॑ध्वं नरः । अ॒भि व॒ आव॑र्त्सुम॒तिर्नवी॑यसी॒ तूयं॑ यात पिपीषवः
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtíḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ márdhati ǀ yásmai ǀ árādhvam ǀ naraḥ ǀabhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avart ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ návīyasī ǀ tū́yam ǀ yāta ǀ pipīṣavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your protection, leaders (of rites), yields no detriment to him whom you defend in battles; may yourlatest favour return to us; come quickly, eager to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ षु घृ॑ष्विराधसो या॒तनान्धां॑सि पी॒तये॑ । इ॒मा वो॑ ह॒व्या म॑रुतो र॒रे हि कं॒ मो ष्व१॒॑न्यत्र॑ गन्तन
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ ghṛṣvi-rādhasaḥ ǀ yātána ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ pītáye ǀimā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ raré ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ mó íti ǀ sú ǀ anyátra ǀ gantana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you whose riches are connected together come to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, forMaruts, Ioffer to you these oblations, therefore go not away to any other (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ च॑ नो ब॒र्हिः सद॑तावि॒ता च॑ नः स्पा॒र्हाणि॒ दात॑वे॒ वसु॑ । अस्रे॑धन्तो मरुतः सो॒म्ये मधौ॒ स्वाहे॒ह मा॑दयाध्वै
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sádata ǀ avitá ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhā́ṇi ǀ dā́tave ǀ vásu ǀásredhantaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ somyé ǀ mádhau ǀ svā́hā ǀ ihá ǀ mādayādhve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sit down on our sacred grass; come to bestow upon us desirable riches; doing no harm,Marutsdelightin the sweetSomalibation presented at this season.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒स्वश्चि॒द्धि त॒न्व१॒॑: शुम्भ॑माना॒ आ हं॒सासो॒ नील॑पृष्ठा अपप्तन् । विश्वं॒ शर्धो॑ अ॒भितो॑ मा॒ नि षे॑द॒ नरो॒ न र॒ण्वाः सव॑ने॒ मद॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: sasváríti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tanváḥ ǀ śúmbhamānāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ nī́la-pṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ apaptan ǀvíśvam ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ mā ǀ ní ǀ seda ǀ náraḥ ǀ ná ǀ raṇvā́ḥ ǀ sávane ǀ mádantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theMarutsyet unrevealed, decorating their person ns, descend like black-backed swans; let theentire company gather round me like happy men rejoicing together at a solemn rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ मरुतो अ॒भि दु॑र्हृणा॒युस्ति॒रश्चि॒त्तानि॑ वसवो॒ जिघां॑सति । द्रु॒हः पाशा॒न्प्रति॒ स मु॑चीष्ट॒ तपि॑ष्ठेन॒ हन्म॑ना हन्तना॒ तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ duḥ-hṛṇāyúḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ cittā́ni ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀdruháḥ ǀ pā́śān ǀ práti ǀ sáḥ ǀ mucīṣṭa ǀ tápiṣṭhena ǀ hánmanā ǀ hantana ǀ tám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man,Maruts, who wounds our feelings, he who, rebuked by all, yet seeks,Vasus, to kill us, hewoudl bind us in the wounds of (Varuṇa), the avenger (of iniquity), such a man do you destroy with a consumingfatal weapon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सांत॑पना इ॒दं ह॒विर्मरु॑त॒स्तज्जु॑जुष्टन । यु॒ष्माको॒ती रि॑शादसः
shlokas.transliteration: sā́m-tapanāḥ ǀ idám ǀ havíḥ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ tát ǀ jujuṣṭana ǀyuṣmā́ka ǀ ūtī́ ǀ riśādasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, desroyers of foes, this oblaion is designed for you; do you, who are the devourers of enemies,(coming) with your protections, graciously accept it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृह॑मेधास॒ आ ग॑त॒ मरु॑तो॒ माप॑ भूतन । यु॒ष्माको॒ती सु॑दानवः
shlokas.transliteration: gṛ́ha-medhāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ márutaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ápa ǀ bhūtana ǀyuṣmā́ka ǀ ūtī́ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Objects of domestic worship, munificentMaruts, come with your protections; go not away.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हेह॑ वः स्वतवस॒: कव॑य॒: सूर्य॑त्वचः । य॒ज्ञं म॑रुत॒ आ वृ॑णे
shlokas.transliteration: ihá-iha ǀ vaḥ ǀ sva-tavasaḥ ǀ kávayaḥ ǀ sū́rya-tvacaḥ ǀyajñám ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, of independent strength, who are far-seeing, glorious as the sun, come hither, come hither, Iinvoke you to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्र्य॑म्बकं यजामहे सु॒गन्धिं॑ पुष्टि॒वर्ध॑नम् । उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नान्मृ॒त्योर्मु॑क्षीय॒ मामृता॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: trí-ambakam ǀ yajāmahe ǀ su-gándhim ǀ puṣṭi-várdhanam ǀurvārukám-iva ǀ bándhanāt ǀ mṛtyóḥ ǀ mukṣīya ǀ mā́ ǀ amṛ́tāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worshipTryambaka, whose fame is fragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated fromdeath, and, like theurvārukafrom its stalk, but not to immortality; let us worshipTrayambaka, whose fame isfragrant, the augmenter of increase; may I be liberated from death like the urvāruka from its stalk, but not untoimmortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य सू॑र्य॒ ब्रवोऽना॑गा उ॒द्यन्मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय स॒त्यम् । व॒यं दे॑व॒त्रादि॑ते स्याम॒ तव॑ प्रि॒यासो॑ अर्यमन्गृ॒णन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sūrya ǀ brávaḥ ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ ut-yán ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ satyám ǀvayám ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ adite ǀ syāma ǀ táva ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ aryaman ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūrya, when rising today, declare the truḥ toMitraandVaruṇa, that we are void of sin; may we,Aditi,be (approved of) among the gods; praising you,Aryaman, may we be dear to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य मि॑त्रावरुणा नृ॒चक्षा॑ उ॒भे उदे॑ति॒ सूर्यो॑ अ॒भि ज्मन् । विश्व॑स्य स्था॒तुर्जग॑तश्च गो॒पा ऋ॒जु मर्ते॑षु वृजि॒ना च॒ पश्य॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ jmán ǀvíśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ca ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ṛjú ǀ márteṣu ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ ca ǀ páśyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSūrya, the beholder of man, rises,MitraandVaruṇa, upon both (heaven and earth), moving (inthe sky); he who is the preserver of all that is stationary or moveable, witnessing the upright acts or the sins ofmortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑क्त स॒प्त ह॒रित॑: स॒धस्था॒द्या ईं॒ वह॑न्ति॒ सूर्यं॑ घृ॒ताची॑: । धामा॑नि मित्रावरुणा यु॒वाकु॒: सं यो यू॒थेव॒ जनि॑मानि॒ चष्टे॑
shlokas.transliteration: áyukta ǀ saptá ǀ harítaḥ ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ váhanti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀdhā́māni ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ sám ǀ yáḥ ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ jánimāni ǀ cáṣṭe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has harnessed his seven bay steeds,MitraandVaruṇa, (to come) from your commondwelling-plural ce, (the firmament); the horses that, shedding water, convey thatSūryawho, friendly to you both,(contemplates all) regions, and looks carefully upon living creatures as (a herdsman) upon the herd.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वां॑ पृ॒क्षासो॒ मधु॑मन्तो अस्थु॒रा सूर्यो॑ अरुहच्छु॒क्रमर्ण॑: । यस्मा॑ आदि॒त्या अध्व॑नो॒ रद॑न्ति मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णः स॒जोषा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vām ǀ pṛkṣā́saḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ aruhat ǀ śukrám ǀ árṇaḥ ǀyásmai ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ rádanti ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For yo, (MitraandVaruṇa), the sweet-flavoured viands have been prepared; the sun has ascended theshining firmament, for whom theĀdityasand the consentient Mitra, Varuṇa,Aryamanmake ready paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे चे॒तारो॒ अनृ॑तस्य॒ भूरे॑र्मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णो॒ हि सन्ति॑ । इ॒म ऋ॒तस्य॑ वावृधुर्दुरो॒णे श॒ग्मास॑: पु॒त्रा अदि॑ते॒रद॑ब्धाः
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ cetā́raḥ ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sánti ǀimé ǀ ṛtásya ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ śagmā́saḥ ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These (deities),Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇa, are the detecters of much untruth; these unconquered sons ofAditi, dispensers of happiness, are magnified in the hall of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो दू॒ळभा॑सोऽचे॒तसं॑ चिच्चितयन्ति॒ दक्षै॑: । अपि॒ क्रतुं॑ सु॒चेत॑सं॒ वत॑न्तस्ति॒रश्चि॒दंह॑: सु॒पथा॑ नयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ duḥ-dábhāsaḥ ǀ acetásam ǀ cit ǀ citayanti ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀápi ǀ krátum ǀ su-cétasam ǀ vátantaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ su-páthā ǀ nayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These, the unsubduedMitra,VaruṇaandAryaman, animate with energies the unconscious (sleepers);repairing tot he intelligent performer (of pious acts), they lead (him), by safe pahs (to heaven), removing alliniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे दि॒वो अनि॑मिषा पृथि॒व्याश्चि॑कि॒त्वांसो॑ अचे॒तसं॑ नयन्ति । प्र॒व्रा॒जे चि॑न्न॒द्यो॑ गा॒धम॑स्ति पा॒रं नो॑ अ॒स्य वि॑ष्पि॒तस्य॑ पर्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ diváḥ ǀ áni-miṣā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ cikitvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ acetásam ǀ nayanti ǀpra-vrājé ǀ cit ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ gādhám ǀ asti ǀ pārám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ viṣpitásya ǀ parṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Beholding) with unclosing eyes, and cognizant (of the things) of heaven and earth, they conduct theignorant man (to duty); in the lowes depth of the river, (through them), there is a bottom; may they lead us to theopposite shore of the vast expanse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्गो॒पाव॒ददि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ भ॒द्रं मि॒त्रो यच्छ॑न्ति॒ वरु॑णः सु॒दासे॑ । तस्मि॒न्ना तो॒कं तन॑यं॒ दधा॑ना॒ मा क॑र्म देव॒हेळ॑नं तुरासः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ gopā́vat ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ bhadrám ǀ mitráḥ ǀ yácchanti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀtásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ tokám ǀ tánayam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ karma ǀ deva-héḷanam ǀ turāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Including our sons and grandsons in that preserving and auspicious felicity whichAditi,MitraandVaruṇa confer upon the liberal donor (of the oblation), may we never, acting precipitately, incur the displeasureof the deities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ वेदिं॒ होत्रा॑भिर्यजेत॒ रिप॒: काश्चि॑द्वरुण॒ध्रुत॒: सः । परि॒ द्वेषो॑भिरर्य॒मा वृ॑णक्तू॒रुं सु॒दासे॑ वृषणा उ लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ védim ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ yajeta ǀ rípaḥ ǀ kā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ varuṇa-dhrútaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀpári ǀ dvéṣaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ vṛṇaktu ǀ urúm ǀ su-dā́se ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let my adversary desecrate the altar by (ill-expressed) praises; repelled byVaruṇa, may he (undergo)various sufferings; mayAryamandefend us from those who hate us; confer, showerers (of benefits), a vastregion upon the liberal donor (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒स्वश्चि॒द्धि समृ॑तिस्त्वे॒ष्ये॑षामपी॒च्ये॑न॒ सह॑सा॒ सह॑न्ते । यु॒ष्मद्भि॒या वृ॑षणो॒ रेज॑माना॒ दक्ष॑स्य चिन्महि॒ना मृ॒ळता॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sasváríti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ sám-ṛtiḥ ǀ tveṣī́ ǀ eṣām ǀ apīcyéna ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhante ǀyuṣmát ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ vṛṣaṇaḥ ǀ réjamānāḥ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ cit ǀ mahinā́ ǀ mṛḷáta ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The association of these (three deities) is of mysterious lustre; by their secret strength they overcome(all enemies); showerers (of benefits), through fear (of you our opponents) are trembling; have mercy upon us inthe mightiness of your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ब्रह्म॑णे सुम॒तिमा॒यजा॑ते॒ वाज॑स्य सा॒तौ प॑र॒मस्य॑ रा॒यः । सीक्ष॑न्त म॒न्युं म॒घवा॑नो अ॒र्य उ॒रु क्षया॑य चक्रिरे सु॒धातु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ su-matím ǀ ā-yájāte ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáu ǀ paramásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀsī́kṣanta ǀ manyúm ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ urú ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ cakrire ǀ su-dhā́tu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These munificent (deities) conjointly accept the praise of the worshipper, and bestow a spaciousmansion for a dwelling upon him who, for the sake of food and excellent riches, devotes his mind to yourglorification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं दे॑व पु॒रोहि॑तिर्यु॒वभ्यां॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ मित्रावरुणावकारि । विश्वा॑नि दु॒र्गा पि॑पृतं ति॒रो नो॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ devā ǀ puráḥ-hitiḥ ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ akāri ǀvíśvāni ǀ duḥ-gā́ ǀ pipṛtam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ExcellentMitraandVaruṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वां॒ चक्षु॑र्वरुण सु॒प्रती॑कं दे॒वयो॑रेति॒ सूर्य॑स्तत॒न्वान् । अ॒भि यो विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ चष्टे॒ स म॒न्युं मर्त्ये॒ष्वा चि॑केत
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ vām ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ varuṇā ǀ su-prátīkam ǀ deváyoḥ ǀ eti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ tatanvā́n ǀabhí ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ cáṣṭe ǀ sáḥ ǀ manyúm ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Spreading arond the beautiful light,MitraandVaruṇa, of you two divinities,Sūryarises; he whobeholds all existing beings apprehends the acts of mortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वां॒ स मि॑त्रावरुणावृ॒तावा॒ विप्रो॒ मन्मा॑नि दीर्घ॒श्रुदि॑यर्ति । यस्य॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि सुक्रतू॒ अवा॑थ॒ आ यत्क्रत्वा॒ न श॒रद॑: पृ॒णैथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ sáḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ mánmāni ǀ dīrgha-śrút ǀ iyarti ǀyásya ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ sukratū íti su-kratū ǀ ávāthaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ krátvā ǀ ná ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ pṛṇáithe íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage, the solemnizer of sacrifice, the ancient hearer (of holy prayer), earnestly repeats,MitraandVaruṇa, your praises; he whose prayers, doers of good deeds, you favour, whose acts (of worship) yourecompense not for years.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रोरोर्मि॑त्रावरुणा पृथि॒व्याः प्र दि॒व ऋ॒ष्वाद्बृ॑ह॒तः सु॑दानू । स्पशो॑ दधाथे॒ ओष॑धीषु वि॒क्ष्वृध॑ग्य॒तो अनि॑मिषं॒ रक्ष॑माणा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ uróḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ diváḥ ǀ ṛṣvā́t ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sudānū íti su-dānū ǀspáśaḥ ǀ dadhāthe íti ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ yatáḥ ǀ áni-miṣam ǀ rákṣamāṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are vaster,MitraandVaruṇa, than the ample earth, vaster, bounteous donors, than the gloriousand expansive heaven; you maintain beauty in plural nts and in people, diligent observers of truth, and vigilantlyprotecting (us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शंसा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाम॒ शुष्मो॒ रोद॑सी बद्बधे महि॒त्वा । अय॒न्मासा॒ अय॑ज्वनाम॒वीरा॒: प्र य॒ज्ञम॑न्मा वृ॒जनं॑ तिराते
shlokas.transliteration: śáṃsa ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ badbadhe ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀáyan ǀ mā́sāḥ ǀ áyajvanām ǀ avī́rāḥ ǀ prá ǀ yajñá-manmā ǀ vṛjánam ǀ tirāte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise the splendour ofMitraandVaruṇa, whose strength, by its might, keeps heaven and earthasunder; may the days of those who differ not worship pass withoutmaledescendants; amy he who delights insacrifice increase in prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमू॑रा॒ विश्वा॑ वृषणावि॒मा वां॒ न यासु॑ चि॒त्रं ददृ॑शे॒ न य॒क्षम् । द्रुह॑: सचन्ते॒ अनृ॑ता॒ जना॑नां॒ न वां॑ नि॒ण्यान्य॒चिते॑ अभूवन्
shlokas.transliteration: ámūrā ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛṣaṇau ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ ná ǀ yā́su ǀ citrám ǀ dádṛśe ǀ ná ǀ yakṣám ǀdrúhaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ ánṛtā ǀ jánānām ǀ ná ǀ vām ǀ niṇyā́ni ǀ acíte ǀ abhūvan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unperplexed, all-pervading showerers (of benefits), these (praises) are for you, in which nothingsurprising, no adoration (worthy of you) is beheld; the insincere commendations of men serve as offences;eulogies of you, althogh offered in secret, are not unappreciated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ वां य॒ज्ञं म॑हयं॒ नमो॑भिर्हु॒वे वां॑ मित्रावरुणा स॒बाध॑: । प्र वां॒ मन्मा॑न्यृ॒चसे॒ नवा॑नि कृ॒तानि॒ ब्रह्म॑ जुजुषन्नि॒मानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ yajñám ǀ mahayam ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ huvé ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ mánmāni ǀ ṛcáse ǀ návāni ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ bráhma ǀ jujuṣan ǀ imā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer sacrifice to you two with praises, I invoke you,MitraandVaruṇa, when in trouble; may thepresent hymns be capable of gratifying you; may these (my) prayers be acceptable to you both.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं दे॑व पु॒रोहि॑तिर्यु॒वभ्यां॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ मित्रावरुणावकारि । विश्वा॑नि दु॒र्गा पि॑पृतं ति॒रो नो॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ deva ǀ puráḥ-hitiḥ ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mitrāvaruṇau ǀ akāri ǀvíśvāni ǀ duḥ-gā́ ǀ pipṛtam ǀ tiráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you, divineMitraandVaruṇa, to you this adoration at sacrifices is addressed; remove from us alldifficulties, and ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्सूर्यो॑ बृ॒हद॒र्चींष्य॑श्रेत्पु॒रु विश्वा॒ जनि॑म॒ मानु॑षाणाम् । स॒मो दि॒वा द॑दृशे॒ रोच॑मान॒: क्रत्वा॑ कृ॒तः सुकृ॑तः क॒र्तृभि॑र्भूत्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ arcī́ṃṣi ǀ aśret ǀ purú ǀ víśvā ǀ jánima ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀsamáḥ ǀ divā́ ǀ dadṛśe ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ sú-kṛtaḥ ǀ kartṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ bhūt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sūryaspreads his vast and numerous rays over all the crowds of men; shining bright by day, he isbeheld (by all) the same, the creator, the created, he is glorified by his worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सू॑र्य॒ प्रति॑ पु॒रो न॒ उद्गा॑ ए॒भिः स्तोमे॑भिरेत॒शेभि॒रेवै॑: । प्र नो॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय वो॒चोऽना॑गसो अर्य॒म्णे अ॒ग्नये॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sūrya ǀ práti ǀ puráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ gāḥ ǀ ebhíḥ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ etaśébhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vocaḥ ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ aryamṇé ǀ agnáye ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up before us,Sūrya, with your glorious white horses; declare us free from sin toMitra,Varuṇa,Aryaman, andAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि न॑: स॒हस्रं॑ शु॒रुधो॑ रदन्त्वृ॒तावा॑नो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः । यच्छ॑न्तु च॒न्द्रा उ॑प॒मं नो॑ अ॒र्कमा न॒: कामं॑ पूपुरन्तु॒ स्तवा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ radantu ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀyácchantu ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kā́mam ǀ pūpurantu ǀ stávānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVaruṇa,MitraandAgni, the alleviators of pain, the observers of truth, bestow upon us thousands(of riches); may they, the givers of delight, grant us excellent (food); glorified by us, many they fulfil our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावा॑भूमी अदिते॒ त्रासी॑थां नो॒ ये वां॑ ज॒ज्ञुः सु॒जनि॑मान ऋष्वे । मा हेळे॑ भूम॒ वरु॑णस्य वा॒योर्मा मि॒त्रस्य॑ प्रि॒यत॑मस्य नृ॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vābhūmī íti ǀ adite ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ jajñúḥ ǀ su-jánimānaḥ ǀ ṛṣve íti ǀmā́ ǀ héḷe ǀ bhūma ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ priyá-tamasya ǀ nṛṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indivisible and mighty heaven and earth protect us who, of fortunate birth, have knowledge of you both;let us not incur the displeasure ofVaruṇa, or ofVāyu, or ofMitra, the best beloved of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र बा॒हवा॑ सिसृतं जी॒वसे॑ न॒ आ नो॒ गव्यू॑तिमुक्षतं घृ॒तेन॑ । आ नो॒ जने॑ श्रवयतं युवाना श्रु॒तं मे॑ मित्रावरुणा॒ हवे॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bāhávā ǀ sisṛtam ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀ ghṛténa ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ jáne ǀ śravayatam ǀ yuvānā ǀ śrutám ǀ me ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ hávā ǀ imā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stretch forth your arms for the prolongation of our existence, bedew with water the pastures of ourcattle, render us honoured among men; ever youthfulMitraandVaruṇa, hear these my invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो अर्य॒मा न॒स्त्मने॑ तो॒काय॒ वरि॑वो दधन्तु । सु॒गा नो॒ विश्वा॑ सु॒पथा॑नि सन्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tmáne ǀ tokā́ya ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dadhantu ǀsu-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthāni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitra,Varuṇa,Aryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy of accessunto us; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वे॑ति सु॒भगो॑ वि॒श्वच॑क्षा॒: साधा॑रण॒: सूर्यो॒ मानु॑षाणाम् । चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य दे॒वश्चर्मे॑व॒ यः स॒मवि॑व्य॒क्तमां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ eti ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ viśvá-cakṣāḥ ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀcákṣuḥ ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ deváḥ ǀ cárma-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ sam-ávivyak ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspiciousSūryarises, the eye of all, the common (parent) of men; the divine eye ofMitraandVaruṇa, who breaks through the glooms as through (investing) skin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद्वे॑ति प्रसवी॒ता जना॑नां म॒हान्के॒तुर॑र्ण॒वः सूर्य॑स्य । स॒मा॒नं च॒क्रं प॑र्या॒विवृ॑त्स॒न्यदे॑त॒शो वह॑ति धू॒र्षु यु॒क्तः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ eti ǀ pra-savitā́ ǀ jánānām ǀ mahā́n ǀ ketúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀsamānám ǀ cakrám ǀ pari-āvívṛtsan ǀ yát ǀ etaśáḥ ǀ váhati ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ yuktáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The animator of men arises, the great rain-shedding banner ofSūryarolling on the universal wheel,which the white steeds yoked to his car drag along.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भ्राज॑मान उ॒षसा॑मु॒पस्था॑द्रे॒भैरुदे॑त्यनुम॒द्यमा॑नः । ए॒ष मे॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता च॑च्छन्द॒ यः स॑मा॒नं न प्र॑मि॒नाति॒ धाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhrā́jamānaḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ rebháiḥ ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ anu-madyámānaḥ ǀeṣáḥ ǀ me ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ cacchanda ǀ yáḥ ǀ samānám ǀ ná ǀ pra-minā́ti ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Delighted by the praises (of his worshippers), the radiant sun rises from the lap of the dawns; thatdivine sun gratifies my desires, who limits not the lustre that is common (to all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो रु॒क्म उ॑रु॒चक्षा॒ उदे॑ति दू॒रेअ॑र्थस्त॒रणि॒र्भ्राज॑मानः । नू॒नं जना॒: सूर्ये॑ण॒ प्रसू॑ता॒ अय॒न्नर्था॑नि कृ॒णव॒न्नपां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ uru-cákṣāḥ ǀ út ǀ eti ǀ dūré-arthaḥ ǀ taráṇiḥ ǀ bhrā́jamānaḥ ǀnūnám ǀ jánāḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ prá-sūtāḥ ǀ áyan ǀ árthāni ǀ kṛṇávan ǀ ápāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bright and glorious sun rises from the firmament far-going, traversing (the heavens), diffusing light;verily all beings animated bySūryaproceed and execute their assigned labours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रा॑ च॒क्रुर॒मृता॑ गा॒तुम॑स्मै श्ये॒नो न दीय॒न्नन्वे॑ति॒ पाथ॑: । प्रति॑ वां॒ सूर॒ उदि॑ते विधेम॒ नमो॑भिर्मित्रावरुणो॒त ह॒व्यैः
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ asmai ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dī́yan ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ pā́thaḥ ǀpráti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ vidhema ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ utá ǀ havyáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He travels the path which the immortals have prepared for his course, darting along like a hawk; weworship you,MitraandVaruṇa, when the sun has risen, with praises and oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो अर्य॒मा न॒स्त्मने॑ तो॒काय॒ वरि॑वो दधन्तु । सु॒गा नो॒ विश्वा॑ सु॒पथा॑नि सन्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tmáne ǀ tokā́ya ǀ várivaḥ ǀ dadhantu ǀsu-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ su-páthāni ǀ santu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitra,VaruṇaandAryamangrant affluence to us and to our posterity; may all paths be easy ofaccess to us, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वि क्षय॑न्ता॒ रज॑सः पृथि॒व्यां प्र वां॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ नि॒र्णिजो॑ ददीरन् । ह॒व्यं नो॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा सुजा॑तो॒ राजा॑ सुक्ष॒त्रो वरु॑णो जुषन्त
shlokas.transliteration: diví ǀ kṣáyantā ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ niḥ-níjaḥ ǀ dadīran ǀhavyám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ sú-jātaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ su-kṣatráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ruling over the water that are in heaven and earth, impelled by you, (the clouds) assume the form ofrain may the auspiciously manifestedMitra, the royalAryaman, the powerulVaruṇa, accept our oblatioṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रा॑जाना मह ऋतस्य गोपा॒ सिन्धु॑पती क्षत्रिया यातम॒र्वाक् । इळां॑ नो मित्रावरुणो॒त वृ॒ष्टिमव॑ दि॒व इ॑न्वतं जीरदानू
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rājānā ǀ mahaḥ ǀ ṛtasya ǀ gopā ǀ síndhupatī íti síndhu-patī ǀ kṣatriyā ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀíḷām ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ utá ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ áva ǀ diváḥ ǀ invatam ǀ jīradānū íti jīra-dānū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sovereigns, mighty preservers of water, powerful lords of rivers, come to our presence; send down tous munificentMitraandVaruṇa, from the firmament, sustenance and rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्तन्नो॒ वरु॑णो दे॒वो अ॒र्यः प्र साधि॑ष्ठेभिः प॒थिभि॑र्नयन्तु । ब्रव॒द्यथा॑ न॒ आद॒रिः सु॒दास॑ इ॒षा म॑देम स॒ह दे॒वगो॑पाः
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ prá ǀ sā́dhiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ nayantu ǀbrávat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ aríḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ iṣā́ ǀ madema ǀ sahá ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitra,Varuṇa, the divineAryaman, conduct us by the most practicable paths, then, (when wedesire their guidance), accordingly as Aryaman promises to the liberal donor (of oblations), may we, enjoying theprotection of the gods, rejoice in abundance, together with posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॒ गर्तं॒ मन॑सा॒ तक्ष॑दे॒तमू॒र्ध्वां धी॒तिं कृ॒णव॑द्धा॒रय॑च्च । उ॒क्षेथां॑ मित्रावरुणा घृ॒तेन॒ ता रा॑जाना सुक्षि॒तीस्त॑र्पयेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ gártam ǀ mánasā ǀ tákṣat ǀ etám ǀ ūrdhvā́m ǀ dhītím ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ dhāráyat ǀ ca ǀukṣéthām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛténa ǀ tā́ ǀ rājānā ǀ su-kṣitī́ḥ ǀ tarpayethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, bedew with water him who fabricates your chariot in his mind, offering high praise,the people well affected towards him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्तोमो॑ वरुण मित्र॒ तुभ्यं॒ सोम॑: शु॒क्रो न वा॒यवे॑ऽयामि । अ॒वि॒ष्टं धियो॑ जिगृ॒तं पुरं॑धीर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyáve ǀ ayāmi ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VaruṇaandMitra, this praise, pure as theSomalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman,(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ वां॒ सूर॒ उदि॑ते सू॒क्तैर्मि॒त्रं हु॑वे॒ वरु॑णं पू॒तद॑क्षम् । ययो॑रसु॒र्य१॒॑मक्षि॑तं॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ याम॑न्ना॒चिता॑ जिग॒त्नु
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ mitrám ǀ huve ǀ váruṇam ǀ pūtá-dakṣam ǀyáyoḥ ǀ asuryám ǀ ákṣitam ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ víśvasya ǀ yā́man ǀ ā-cítā ǀ jigatnú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sun has risen, I invokeMitraand you,Varuṇa, of pure vigour, whose imperishable andsuperior might is triumphant in the crowded conflict over all enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि दे॒वाना॒मसु॑रा॒ ताव॒र्या ता न॑: क्षि॒तीः क॑रतमू॒र्जय॑न्तीः । अ॒श्याम॑ मित्रावरुणा व॒यं वां॒ द्यावा॑ च॒ यत्र॑ पी॒पय॒न्नहा॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ devā́nām ǀ ásurā ǀ táu ǀ aryā́ ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ karatam ǀ ūrjáyantīḥ ǀaśyā́ma ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ vayám ǀ vām ǀ dyā́vā ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ pīpáyan ǀ áhā ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They verily are mighty among the gods; they are rulers; they bestow upon us a numerous posterity;may we obtain from you,MitraandVaruṇa, whether on earth or in heaven, and whereever the (passing) daysmay preserve us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता भूरि॑पाशा॒वनृ॑तस्य॒ सेतू॑ दुर॒त्येतू॑ रि॒पवे॒ मर्त्या॑य । ऋ॒तस्य॑ मित्रावरुणा प॒था वा॑म॒पो न ना॒वा दु॑रि॒ता त॑रेम
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ bhū́ri-pāśau ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ sétū íti ǀ duratyétū íti duḥ-atyétū ǀ ripáve ǀ mártyāya ǀṛtásya ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ pathā́ ǀ vām ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ nāvā́ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Holders are you of many fetters, barriers against the irreligious, invincible by hostile mortals; may wecross over all the danger,MitraandVaruṇa, by the path of sacrifice, to you, as (we cross over) water by a boat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ मित्रावरुणा ह॒व्यजु॑ष्टिं घृ॒तैर्गव्यू॑तिमुक्षत॒मिळा॑भिः । प्रति॑ वा॒मत्र॒ वर॒मा जना॑य पृणी॒तमु॒द्नो दि॒व्यस्य॒ चारो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ havyá-juṣṭim ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǀ íḷābhiḥ ǀpráti ǀ vām ǀ átra ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ pṛṇītám ǀ udnáḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ cā́roḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,MitraandVaruṇa, to our offered oblation sprinkle our plural ce of sacrifice with water and withviands (who) in this world (may present to you such) excellent (donations) that you may (thereby be induced to)gratify mankind with celestial and beautiful water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्तोमो॑ वरुण मित्र॒ तुभ्यं॒ सोम॑: शु॒क्रो न वा॒यवे॑ऽयामि । अ॒वि॒ष्टं धियो॑ जिगृ॒तं पुरं॑धीर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sómaḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyáve ǀ ayāmi ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VaruṇaandMitra, this praise, pure as theSomalibation, has been offered to you, and also,Aryaman(to you); protect our rites; be awake to our praises; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मि॒त्रयो॒र्वरु॑णयो॒: स्तोमो॑ न एतु शू॒ष्य॑: । नम॑स्वान्तुविजा॒तयो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ mitráyoḥ ǀ váruṇayoḥ ǀ stómaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ etu ǀ śūṣyáḥ ǀnámasvān ǀ tuvi-jātáyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this our propitiatory praise, accompanied by oblations, proceed to you,MitraandVaruṇa, ofreiterated manifestations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या धा॒रय॑न्त दे॒वाः सु॒दक्षा॒ दक्ष॑पितरा । अ॒सु॒र्या॑य॒ प्रम॑हसा
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dhāráyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ su-dákṣā ǀ dákṣa-pitarā ǀasuryā́ya ǀ prá-mahasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You whom the gods uphold for their invigoration, both mighty, masters of strength and of diffusiveradiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता न॑: स्ति॒पा त॑नू॒पा वरु॑ण जरितॄ॒णाम् । मित्र॑ सा॒धय॑तं॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sti-pā́ ǀ tanū-pā́ ǀ váruṇa ǀ jaritṝṇā́m ǀmítra ǀ sādháyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protectors of our dwellings, protectors of our person ns,MitraandVaruṇa, perfect the rites of youradorers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य सूर॒ उदि॒तेऽना॑गा मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता भग॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀsuvā́ti ǀ savitā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMitra, the destroyer of sin,Aryaman,Savitā,Bhaga, bestow (upon us), today at sun-rise what (wepray for).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्रा॒वीर॑स्तु॒ स क्षय॒: प्र नु याम॑न्त्सुदानवः । ये नो॒ अंहो॑ऽति॒पिप्र॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: supra-avī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ yā́man ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀyé ǀ naḥ ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ati-píprati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this our dwelling be well protected, liberal deities, on your departure, you who purify us from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्व॒राजो॒ अदि॑ति॒रद॑ब्धस्य व्र॒तस्य॒ ये । म॒हो राजा॑न ईशते
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ádabdhasya ǀ vratásya ǀ yé ǀmaháḥ ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ īśate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And who are sovereign over all, and, withAditi, preside over this unobstructed and great ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ वां॒ सूर॒ उदि॑ते मि॒त्रं गृ॑णीषे॒ वरु॑णम् । अ॒र्य॒मणं॑ रि॒शाद॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ mitrám ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ váruṇam ǀaryamáṇam ǀ riśā́dasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify you,MitraandVaruṇa, andAryaman, the consumer of enemies when the sun has risen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒या हि॑रण्य॒या म॒तिरि॒यम॑वृ॒काय॒ शव॑से । इ॒यं विप्रा॑ मे॒धसा॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: rāyā́ ǀ hiraṇya-yā́ ǀ matíḥ ǀ iyám ǀ avṛkā́ya ǀ śávase ǀiyám ǀ víprā ǀ medhá-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this praise (be effective) for unimpeached strength, alone with golden treasure; may it (beeffective), sages, for the fulfilment of (the objects of) the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते स्या॑म देव वरुण॒ ते मि॑त्र सू॒रिभि॑: स॒ह । इष॒॒ स्व॑श्च धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ syāma ǀ deva ǀ varuṇa ǀ té ǀ mitra ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ sahá ǀíṣam ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be thine, divineVaruṇa; may we, along with pious worshippers, be,Mitra, thine; may we obtainfood and water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒हव॒: सूर॑चक्षसोऽग्निजि॒ह्वा ऋ॑ता॒वृध॑: । त्रीणि॒ ये ये॒मुर्वि॒दथा॑नि धी॒तिभि॒र्विश्वा॑नि॒ परि॑भूतिभिः
shlokas.transliteration: bahávaḥ ǀ sū́ra-cakṣasaḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀtrī́ṇi ǀ yé ǀ yemúḥ ǀ vidáthāni ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ páribhūti-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Manifold radiant as the sun,Agni-tongued augmenters of sacrifice, you who have limited the threeuniversal sacrifices with comprehensive rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ये द॒धुः श॒रदं॒ मास॒मादह॑र्य॒ज्ञम॒क्तुं चादृच॑म् । अ॒ना॒प्यं वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा क्ष॒त्रं राजा॑न आशत
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yé ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ śarádam ǀ mā́sam ǀ ā́t ǀ áhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ aktúm ǀ ca ǀ ā́t ǀ ṛ́cam ǀanāpyám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ kṣatrám ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who have established the year, and then the month and the day, the sacrifice, the night, and the holytext, they, the royal deities,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, enjoy unrivalled might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वो॑ अ॒द्य म॑नामहे सू॒क्तैः सूर॒ उदि॑ते । यदोह॑ते॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा यू॒यमृ॒तस्य॑ रथ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ adyá ǀ manāmahe ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀyát ǀ óhate ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ ṛtásya ǀ rathyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore today at sunrise we solicit you with hymns for (wealth), whichVaruṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,bearers of water, you convey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑न ऋ॒तजा॑ता ऋता॒वृधो॑ घो॒रासो॑ अनृत॒द्विष॑: । तेषां॑ वः सु॒म्ने सु॑च्छ॒र्दिष्ट॑मे नर॒: स्याम॒ ये च॑ सू॒रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātāḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ghorā́saḥ ǀ anṛta-dvíṣaḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ vaḥ ǀ sumné ǀ succhardíḥ-tame ǀ naraḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accepters of rites, genitive rated for rites, augmenters of rites, fierce enemies of the neglecter of rites, maywe, as well as those men who are your adorers, be in (the enjoyment of) the highest felicity, all confirmed by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यद्द॑र्श॒तं वपु॑र्दि॒व ए॑ति प्रतिह्व॒रे । यदी॑मा॒शुर्वह॑ति दे॒व एत॑शो॒ विश्व॑स्मै॒ चक्ष॑से॒ अर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyát ǀ darśatám ǀ vápuḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ eti ǀ prati-hvaré ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ āśúḥ ǀ váhati ǀ deváḥ ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ víśvasmai ǀ cákṣase ǀ áram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That beautiful orb (of the sun) rises on the near margin of the sky as the swift, divine, white-coloured(steed) bears it along for the beholding of all men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शी॒र्ष्णःशी॑र्ष्णो॒ जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॒स्पतिं॑ स॒मया॒ विश्व॒मा रज॑: । स॒प्त स्वसा॑रः सुवि॒ताय॒ सूर्यं॒ वह॑न्ति ह॒रितो॒ रथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: śīrṣṇáḥ-śīrṣṇaḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ samáyā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀsaptá ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ sū́ryam ǀ váhanti ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ráthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven gliding steeds convey the sun, the lord of every individual moving or stationary thing,traversing the whole world in his chariot for the good (of all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तच्चक्षु॑र्दे॒वहि॑तं शु॒क्रमु॒च्चर॑त् । पश्ये॑म श॒रद॑: श॒तं जीवे॑म श॒रद॑: श॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ devá-hitam ǀ śukrám ǀ ut-cárat ǀpáśyema ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ jī́vema ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ śatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That pure eye (of the universe), beneficial of the gods, rises; may we behold it for a hundred years; maywe live a hundred years.”

shlokas.sanskrit: काव्ये॑भिरदा॒भ्या या॑तं वरुण द्यु॒मत् । मि॒त्रश्च॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: kā́vyebhiḥ ǀ adābhyā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ varuṇa ǀ dyu-mát ǀmitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unconquerable, resplendentVaruṇaandMitra, (induced) by our praises, come to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो धाम॑भिर्वरुण मि॒त्रश्चा या॑तम॒द्रुहा॑ । पिब॑तं॒ सोम॑मातु॒जी
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ adrúhā ǀpíbatam ǀ sómam ǀ ātujī́ ítyā-tujī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “genitive leMitraandVaruṇa, destroyers of foes, come from heaven with your glories, and drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑तं मित्रावरुणा जुषा॒णावाहु॑तिं नरा । पा॒तं सोम॑मृतावृधा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ juṣāṇáu ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ narā ǀpātám ǀ sómam ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,MitraandVaruṇa, leaders of rites, propitiated by the oblation, and drink theSoma, augmentersof the sacred rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ वां॒ रथं॑ नृपती ज॒रध्यै॑ ह॒विष्म॑ता॒ मन॑सा य॒ज्ञिये॑न । यो वां॑ दू॒तो न धि॑ष्ण्या॒वजी॑ग॒रच्छा॑ सू॒नुर्न पि॒तरा॑ विवक्मि
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ nṛpatī íti nṛ-patī ǀ jarádhyai ǀ havíṣmatā ǀ mánasā ǀ yajñíyena ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhiṣṇyau ǀ ájīgaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ pitárā ǀ vivakmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lords of men, (I approach) to adore your chariot with devout praise and oblation, I address it as if itwere a messenger to awaken you, adorable deities, as a son (addresses) his parents.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अशो॑च्य॒ग्निः स॑मिधा॒नो अ॒स्मे उपो॑ अदृश्र॒न्तम॑सश्चि॒दन्ता॑: । अचे॑ति के॒तुरु॒षस॑: पु॒रस्ता॑च्छ्रि॒ये दि॒वो दु॑हि॒तुर्जाय॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: áśoci ǀ agníḥ ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ úpo íti ǀ adṛśran ǀ támasaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ántāḥ ǀáceti ǀ ketúḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ śriyé ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kindled by us,Agniblazes, the extremities of the darkness are seen near athand, the banner (of thesun) is perceived rising with the glory on the east of the dawn, the daughter of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वां॑ नू॒नम॑श्विना॒ सुहो॑ता॒ स्तोमै॑: सिषक्ति नासत्या विव॒क्वान् । पू॒र्वीभि॑र्यातं प॒थ्या॑भिर॒र्वाक्स्व॒र्विदा॒ वसु॑मता॒ रथे॑न
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vām ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ sú-hotā ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ sisakti ǀ nāsatyā ǀ vivakvā́n ǀpūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ pathyā́bhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ svaḥ-vídā ǀ vásu-matā ǀ ráthena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Aśvins, the pious priest repeating (your praises) glorifies you,Nāsatyāswith hymns; cometherefore by formerly-trodden paths to our presence with your chariot, familiar with heaven, laden with treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वोर्वां॑ नू॒नम॑श्विना यु॒वाकु॑र्हु॒वे यद्वां॑ सु॒ते मा॑ध्वी वसू॒युः । आ वां॑ वहन्तु॒ स्थवि॑रासो॒ अश्वा॒: पिबा॑थो अ॒स्मे सुषु॑ता॒ मधू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: avóḥ ǀ vām ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǀ huvé ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ suté ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ vasu-yúḥ ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ vahantu ǀ sthávirāsaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ píbāthaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ sú-sutā ǀ mádhūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Relying on you,Aśvins, as protectors, desirous of wealth,Mādhvis, I invoke you when theSomaiseffused; may your stout horses bring you (hither); drink the sweet Soma poured out by us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राची॑मु देवाश्विना॒ धियं॒ मेऽमृ॑ध्रां सा॒तये॑ कृतं वसू॒युम् । विश्वा॑ अविष्टं॒ वाज॒ आ पुरं॑धी॒स्ता न॑: शक्तं शचीपती॒ शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: prā́cīm ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ devā ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ ámṛdhrām ǀ sātáye ǀ kṛtam ǀ vasu-yúm ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ vā́je ǀ ā́ ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaktam ǀ śacīpatī íti śacī-patī ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAśvins, render my sincere and undisturbed adoration, offered for the sake of riches, (efficacious)for their acquisition; preserve all my caculties in (the time of) battle; protectors of pious acts (influenced) by ouracts, bestow upon us (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वि॒ष्टं धी॒ष्व॑श्विना न आ॒सु प्र॒जाव॒द्रेतो॒ अह्र॑यं नो अस्तु । आ वां॑ तो॒के तन॑ये॒ तूतु॑जानाः सु॒रत्ना॑सो दे॒ववी॑तिं गमेम
shlokas.transliteration: aviṣṭám ǀ dhīṣú ǀ aśvinā ǀ naḥ ǀ āsú ǀ prajā́-vat ǀ rétaḥ ǀ áhrayam ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ tū́tujānāḥ ǀ su-rátnāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītim ǀ gamema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us,Aśvins, in these pious acts, may our procreative power fail not; but (through your favour)possessing sons and grandsons, distributing desired riches and enjoying ample wealth, may we accomplish theworship of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य वां॑ पूर्व॒गत्वे॑व॒ सख्ये॑ नि॒धिर्हि॒तो मा॑ध्वी रा॒तो अ॒स्मे । अहे॑ळता॒ मन॒सा या॑तम॒र्वाग॒श्नन्ता॑ ह॒व्यं मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ vām ǀ pūrvagátvā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ ni-dhíḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ rātáḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀáheḷatā ǀ mánasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ aśnántā ǀ havyám ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This treasure given by us has been plural ced,Mādhvis, before you, like (an envoy) who has come to thepresence (of a prince) for (acquiring his) friendship; come to our presence with benevolent thoughts, acceptingthe oblations offered among human beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑स्मि॒न्योगे॑ भुरणा समा॒ने परि॑ वां स॒प्त स्र॒वतो॒ रथो॑ गात् । न वा॑यन्ति सु॒भ्वो॑ दे॒वयु॑क्ता॒ ये वां॑ धू॒र्षु त॒रण॑यो॒ वह॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ékasmin ǀ yóge ǀ bhuraṇā ǀ samāné ǀ pári ǀ vām ǀ saptá ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ gāt ǀná ǀ vāyanti ǀ su-bhváḥ ǀ devá-yuktāḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ taráṇayaḥ ǀ váhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Nourishers of all, the chariot of you two, who are associated in a common purpose, traverses the sevenflowing (streams); the excellent horses harnessed by the gods, who bear you rapidly, careering in the car, arenever wearied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स॒श्चता॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो॒ हि भू॒तं ये रा॒या म॑घ॒देयं॑ जु॒नन्ति॑ । प्र ये बन्धुं॑ सू॒नृता॑भिस्ति॒रन्ते॒ गव्या॑ पृ॒ञ्चन्तो॒ अश्व्या॑ म॒घानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: asaścátā ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ yé ǀ rāyā́ ǀ magha-déyam ǀ junánti ǀprá ǀ yé ǀ bándhum ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǀ tiránte ǀ gávyā ǀ pṛñcántaḥ ǀ áśvyā ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious to those who are affluent (in oblations), who offer the wealth that is to be offered for thesake of riches; they who encourage a kinsman with kind commendations, distributing wealth of cattle and ofhorses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मे॒ हव॒मा शृ॑णुतं युवाना यासि॒ष्टं व॒र्तिर॑श्विना॒विरा॑वत् । ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि॒ जर॑तं च सू॒रीन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ yuvānā ǀ yāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ írā-vat ǀdhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ járatam ǀ ca ǀ sūrī́n ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ever youthfulAśvins, hear today my invocation; come Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared; grant wealth (to the offerer); elevate the worshipper and to you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ शु॑भ्रा यातमश्विना॒ स्वश्वा॒ गिरो॑ दस्रा जुजुषा॒णा यु॒वाको॑: । ह॒व्यानि॑ च॒ प्रति॑भृता वी॒तं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śubhrā ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-áśvā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ dasrā ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ yuvā́koḥ ǀhavyā́ni ǀ ca ǀ práti-bhṛtā ǀ vītám ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IllustriousAśvins, lords of handsome horses, come hither, propitiated; Dasrasā, by the praises of youradorer, and partake of our consecrated oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वा॒मन्धां॑सि॒ मद्या॑न्यस्थु॒ररं॑ गन्तं ह॒विषो॑ वी॒तये॑ मे । ति॒रो अ॒र्यो हव॑नानि श्रु॒तं न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ mádyāni ǀ asthuḥ ǀ áram ǀ gantam ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ vītáye ǀ me ǀtiráḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ hávanāni ǀ śrutám ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilarating viands have been prepared for you; come quickly to partake of my oblation;disregarding the invocations of an adversary, listen to ours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वां॒ रथो॒ मनो॑जवा इयर्ति ति॒रो रजां॑स्यश्विना श॒तोति॑: । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ सूर्यावसू इया॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ śatá-ūtiḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ sūryāvasū íti ǀ iyānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your chariot,Aśvins, in which you ride withSūrya, hastens towards us at our solicitations, traversingthe regions as swift as thought, and laden with a hundred blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ह॒ यद्वां॑ देव॒या उ॒ अद्रि॑रू॒र्ध्वो विव॑क्ति सोम॒सुद्यु॒वभ्या॑म् । आ व॒ल्गू विप्रो॑ ववृतीत ह॒व्यैः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ deva-yā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ádriḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ vívakti ǀ soma-sút ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǀā́ ǀ valgū́ íti ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vavṛtīta ǀ havyáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the stone, seeking to propitiate you two divinities, is raised aloft, and loudly sounds, expressingfor you theSoma, then the pious worshipper brings you back, beautiful divinities, by his oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्रं ह॒ यद्वां॒ भोज॑नं॒ न्वस्ति॒ न्यत्र॑ये॒ महि॑ष्वन्तं युयोतम् । यो वा॑मो॒मानं॒ दध॑ते प्रि॒यः सन्
shlokas.transliteration: citrám ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ bhójanam ǀ nú ǀ ásti ǀ ní ǀ átraye ǀ máhiṣvantam ǀ yuyotam ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ omā́nam ǀ dádhate ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wonderful, verily, is the wealth that is yours; you have liberated from the caveAtri, who is dear to you,and enjoys your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यद्वां॑ जुर॒ते अ॑श्विना भू॒च्च्यवा॑नाय प्र॒तीत्यं॑ हवि॒र्दे । अधि॒ यद्वर्प॑ इ॒तऊ॑ति ध॒त्थः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyát ǀ vām ǀ juraté ǀ aśvinā ǀ bhūt ǀ cyávānāya ǀ pratī́tyam ǀ haviḥ-dé ǀádhi ǀ yát ǀ várpaḥ ǀ itáḥ-ūti ǀ dhattháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such was your benevolence,Aśvins, toCyavana, praising and offering oblations, that you in requitalrescued his body from departure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यं भु॒ज्युम॑श्विना॒ सखा॑यो॒ मध्ये॑ जहुर्दु॒रेवा॑सः समु॒द्रे । निरीं॑ पर्ष॒दरा॑वा॒ यो यु॒वाकु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ aśvinā ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ jahuḥ ǀ duḥ-évāsaḥ ǀ samudré ǀníḥ ǀ īm ǀ parṣat ǀ árāvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yuvā́kuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When faithless friends had abandonedBhujyuin the midst of the ocean, you brought him to shore,devoted to and relying upon you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृका॑य चि॒ज्जस॑मानाय शक्तमु॒त श्रु॑तं श॒यवे॑ हू॒यमा॑ना । याव॒घ्न्यामपि॑न्वतम॒पो न स्त॒र्यं॑ चिच्छ॒क्त्य॑श्विना॒ शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́kāya ǀ cit ǀ jásamānāya ǀ śaktam ǀ utá ǀ śrutam ǀ śayáve ǀ hūyámānā ǀyáu ǀ aghnyā́m ǀ ápinvatam ǀ apáḥ ǀ ná ǀ staryám ǀ cit ǀ śaktī́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have granted (his desires) toVṛka, exhausted by his devotions; when called upon you havelistened toŚayu; you are they who have filled the barren cow (with milk) as (a river) with water; you have(endowed her) with strength,Aśvins, by your deeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य का॒रुर्ज॑रते सू॒क्तैरग्रे॑ बुधा॒न उ॒षसां॑ सु॒मन्मा॑ । इ॒षा तं व॑र्धद॒घ्न्या पयो॑भिर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ kārúḥ ǀ jarate ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀ ágre ǀ budhānáḥ ǀ uṣásām ǀ su-mánmā ǀiṣā́ ǀ tám ǀ vardhat ǀ aghnyā́ ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This your devoted worshipper, wwaking before the dawn, praises with hymns; nourish him with food,and let the cow (nourish him) with her milk; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथो॒ रोद॑सी बद्बधा॒नो हि॑र॒ण्ययो॒ वृष॑भिर्या॒त्वश्वै॑: । घृ॒तव॑र्तनिः प॒विभी॑ रुचा॒न इ॒षां वो॒ळ्हा नृ॒पति॑र्वा॒जिनी॑वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ badbadhānáḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yātu ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀghṛtá-vartaniḥ ǀ paví-bhiḥ ǀ rucānáḥ ǀ iṣā́m ǀ voḷhā́ ǀ nṛ-pátiḥ ǀ vājínī-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your golden chariot, drawn by your vigorous horses, blocking up heaven and earth, come to us,following the track of the waters, radiant with (glowing) wheels, laden with viands, the protector of men, thereceptacle of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑प्रथा॒नो अ॒भि पञ्च॒ भूमा॑ त्रिवन्धु॒रो मन॒सा या॑तु यु॒क्तः । विशो॒ येन॒ गच्छ॑थो देव॒यन्ती॒: कुत्रा॑ चि॒द्याम॑मश्विना॒ दधा॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ paprathānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ páñca ǀ bhū́ma ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ yuktáḥ ǀvíśaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ deva-yántīḥ ǀ kútra ǀ cit ǀ yā́mam ǀ aśvinā ǀ dádhānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Renowned among the five orders of beings, furnished with three benches, harnessed at will, may itcome hither; that (vehicle) wherewith you repair to devout mortals, whatsoever,Aśvins, directing your course.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वश्वा॑ य॒शसा या॑तम॒र्वाग्दस्रा॑ नि॒धिं मधु॑मन्तं पिबाथः । वि वां॒ रथो॑ व॒ध्वा॒३॒॑ याद॑मा॒नोऽन्ता॑न्दि॒वो बा॑धते वर्त॒निभ्या॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: su-áśvā ǀ yaśásā ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ dásrā ǀ ni-dhím ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ pibāthaḥ ǀví ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vadhvā́ ǀ yā́damānaḥ ǀ ántān ǀ diváḥ ǀ bādhate ǀ vartaní-bhyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-horsed and celebrated, come,Aśvins, to our presence; drink,Dasras, the sweet plural dge; yourchariot, conveying you, with your spouse, furrows with its two wheels the extremities of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोः श्रियं॒ परि॒ योषा॑वृणीत॒ सूरो॑ दुहि॒ता परि॑तक्म्यायाम् । यद्दे॑व॒यन्त॒मव॑थ॒: शची॑भि॒: परि॑ घ्रं॒समो॒मना॑ वां॒ वयो॑ गात्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ śríyam ǀ pári ǀ yóṣā ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ pári-takmyāyām ǀyát ǀ deva-yántam ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ ghraṃsám ǀ ománā ǀ vām ǀ váyaḥ ǀ gāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter ofSūryamade choice of your chariot at the approach of night; you defend the devoutworshipper by your deeds, when the resplendent (sacrificial) food proceeds to you to secure your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ह॒ स्य वां॑ रथिरा॒ वस्त॑ उ॒स्रा रथो॑ युजा॒नः प॑रि॒याति॑ व॒र्तिः । तेन॑ न॒: शं योरु॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ॒ न्य॑श्विना वहतं य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ syáḥ ǀ vām ǀ rathirā ǀ váste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ pari-yā́ti ǀ vartíḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ ní ǀ aśvinā ǀ vahatam ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Riders in the chariot,Aśvin, come for our participation and welfare to this our sacrifice, at the dawn ofday, with that chariot which is clothed in radiance, and which, when harnessed, traverses its (appointed) road.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॑ गौ॒रेव॑ वि॒द्युतं॑ तृषा॒णास्माक॑म॒द्य सव॒नोप॑ यातम् । पु॒रु॒त्रा हि वां॑ म॒तिभि॒र्हव॑न्ते॒ मा वा॑म॒न्ये नि य॑मन्देव॒यन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nárā ǀ gaurā́-iva ǀ vi-dyútam ǀ tṛṣāṇā́ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ sávanā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀpuru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ hávante ǀ mā́ ǀ vām ǀ anyé ǀ ní ǀ yaman ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders of rites, like (thirsty) cattle, thirsting for the radiant (Soma), hasten today to our sacrifice; inmany ceremonies do the pious propitiate you with praises; let not other devout worshippers detain you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं भु॒ज्युमव॑विद्धं समु॒द्र उदू॑हथु॒रर्ण॑सो॒ अस्रि॑धानैः । प॒त॒त्रिभि॑रश्र॒मैर॑व्य॒थिभि॑र्दं॒सना॑भिरश्विना पा॒रय॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ áva-viddham ǀ samudré ǀ út ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ árṇasaḥ ǀ ásridhānaiḥ ǀpatatrí-bhiḥ ǀ aśramáiḥ ǀ avyathí-bhiḥ ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pāráyantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You bore upBhujyu,Aśvins, from the waters, when cast into the sea, bearing him to shore by yourexertions with your undecaying, unwearied, unharassed horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मे॒ हव॒मा शृ॑णुतं युवाना यासि॒ष्टं व॒र्तिर॑श्विना॒विरा॑वत् । ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि॒ जर॑तं च सू॒रीन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ yuvānā ǀ yāsiṣṭám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ írā-vat ǀdhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ járatam ǀ ca ǀ sūrī́n ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ever youthfulAśvins, hear today this my invocation; come, Aśvins, to the dwelling where the oblation isprepared, grant wealth (to the offerer), elevate the worshipper, and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वि॑श्ववाराश्विना गतं न॒: प्र तत्स्थान॑मवाचि वां पृथि॒व्याम् । अश्वो॒ न वा॒जी शु॒नपृ॑ष्ठो अस्था॒दा यत्से॒दथु॑र्ध्रु॒वसे॒ न योनि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ viśva-vārā ǀ aśvinā ǀ gatam ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ tát ǀ sthā́nam ǀ avāci ǀ vām ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀáśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ śuná-pṛṣṭhaḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ ā́ ǀ yát ǀ sedáthuḥ ǀ dhruváse ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-adoredAśvins, come to our (sacrifice), to that plural ce on earth which has been designated yours,which, like a swift, broad-backed horse, awaits you, and on which you are seated as firmly as in a dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिष॑क्ति॒ सा वां॑ सुम॒तिश्चनि॒ष्ठाता॑पि घ॒र्मो मनु॑षो दुरो॒णे । यो वां॑ समु॒द्रान्त्स॒रित॒: पिप॒र्त्येत॑ग्वा चि॒न्न सु॒युजा॑ युजा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: sísakti ǀ sā́ ǀ vām ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǀ átāpi ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ samudrā́n ǀ sarítaḥ ǀ píparti ǀ éta-gvā ǀ cit ǀ ná ǀ su-yújā ǀ yujānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This excellent praise, redolent of food, propitiates you; the ewer has been heated in the dwelling of theworshipper, which, reaching you, fills the ocean and the rivers (through the rain it obtains), associating you (inthe rite), like two well-matched horses in a chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यानि॒ स्थाना॑न्यश्विना द॒धाथे॑ दि॒वो य॒ह्वीष्वोष॑धीषु वि॒क्षु । नि पर्व॑तस्य मू॒र्धनि॒ सद॒न्तेषं॒ जना॑य दा॒शुषे॒ वह॑न्ता
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ni ǀ sthā́nāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ dadhā́the íti ǀ diváḥ ǀ yahvī́ṣu ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ vikṣú ǀní ǀ párvatasya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ sádantā ǀ íṣam ǀ jánāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ váhantā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whatever plural ces you may descend,Aśvins, from heaven, whether amidst the spreading plural nts, oramong men, or sitting on the summit of the clouds, be the bearers of food to the man, the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒नि॒ष्टं दे॑वा॒ ओष॑धीष्व॒प्सु यद्यो॒ग्या अ॒श्नवै॑थे॒ ऋषी॑णाम् । पु॒रूणि॒ रत्ना॒ दध॑तौ॒ न्य१॒॑स्मे अनु॒ पूर्वा॑णि चख्यथुर्यु॒गानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: caniṣṭám ǀ devau ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ yát ǀ yogyā́ḥ ǀ aśnávaithe íti ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ rátnā ǀ dádhatau ǀ ní ǀ asmé íti ǀ ánu ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ cakhyathuḥ ǀ yugā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch, divineAśvins, as you accept that which is most acceptable in the plural nts and in the waters,and those (things) which are most suitable to you, (the offerings) of the Ṛṣis, therefore, bestowing upon usample riches, (favour us) as you have favoured, bestowing former couples.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒श्रु॒वांसा॑ चिदश्विना पु॒रूण्य॒भि ब्रह्मा॑णि चक्षाथे॒ ऋषी॑णाम् । प्रति॒ प्र या॑तं॒ वर॒मा जना॑या॒स्मे वा॑मस्तु सुम॒तिश्चनि॑ष्ठा
shlokas.transliteration: śuśru-vā́ṃsā ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ abhí ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ cakṣāthe íti ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀpráti ǀ prá ǀ yātam ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ jánāya ǀ asmé íti ǀ vām ǀ astu ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ cániṣṭhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, hearing the many prayers of the Ṛṣis, you look (favourably) upon (us); come to the sacrifice ofthis man, and may your desired favour be (shown) him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॑ य॒ज्ञो ना॑सत्या ह॒विष्मा॑न्कृ॒तब्र॑ह्मा सम॒र्यो॒३॒॑ भवा॑ति । उप॒ प्र या॑तं॒ वर॒मा वसि॑ष्ठमि॒मा ब्रह्मा॑ण्यृच्यन्ते यु॒वभ्या॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ havíṣmān ǀ kṛtá-brahmā ǀ sa-maryáḥ ǀ bhávāti ǀúpa ǀ prá ǀ yātam ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ vásiṣṭham ǀ imā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ ṛcyante ǀ yuvá-bhyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyās, to the excellentVasiṣṭha, the worshiper who, accompanied by the priests, ispresent, offering oblations and repeating praises; these prayers are recited to (bring) you (hither).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं म॑नी॒षा इ॒यम॑श्विना॒ गीरि॒मां सु॑वृ॒क्तिं वृ॑षणा जुषेथाम् । इ॒मा ब्रह्मा॑णि युव॒यून्य॑ग्मन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀimā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ yuva-yū́ni ǀ agman ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you) be gratified, showerers (of benefits), by this laudationmay these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ स्वसु॑रु॒षसो॒ नग्जि॑हीते रि॒णक्ति॑ कृ॒ष्णीर॑रु॒षाय॒ पन्था॑म् । अश्वा॑मघा॒ गोम॑घा वां हुवेम॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॒ शरु॑म॒स्मद्यु॑योतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ svásuḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ nák ǀ jihīte ǀ riṇákti ǀ kṛṣṇī́ḥ ǀ aruṣā́ya ǀ pánthām ǀáśva-maghā ǀ gó-maghā ǀ vām ǀ huvema ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ śárum ǀ asmát ǀ yuyotam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Night retires before the dawn, the sister (of theAśvins); the dark night leaves the path clear for theradiant (sun); upon you, who are affluent in horses, affluenet in cattle, we call day and night; keep away from usthe malevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒पाया॑तं दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य॒ रथे॑न वा॒मम॑श्विना॒ वह॑न्ता । यु॒यु॒तम॒स्मदनि॑रा॒ममी॑वां॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ माध्वी॒ त्रासी॑थां नः
shlokas.transliteration: upa-ā́yātam ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀ ráthena ǀ vāmám ǀ aśvinā ǀ váhantā ǀyuyutám ǀ asmát ǀ ánirām ǀ ámīvām ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ mādhvī íti ǀ trā́sīthām ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to the mortal, the donor (of oblations) bringing desired wealth in your chariot; keep afar from usfamine and sickness; day and night,Mādhvis, protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ रथ॑मव॒मस्यां॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ सुम्ना॒यवो॒ वृष॑णो वर्तयन्तु । स्यूम॑गभस्तिमृत॒युग्भि॒रश्वै॒राश्वि॑ना॒ वसु॑मन्तं वहेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rátham ǀ avamásyām ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ sumna-yávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vartayantu ǀsyū́ma-gabhastim ǀ ṛtayúk-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ vahethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your docile and vigorous (horses) bring hither your chariot at the approaching dawn; conducthither,Aśvins, your radiating, wealth-laden chariot, with your rain-bestowing steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॒ रथो॑ नृपती॒ अस्ति॑ वो॒ळ्हा त्रि॑वन्धु॒रो वसु॑माँ उ॒स्रया॑मा । आ न॑ ए॒ना ना॑स॒त्योप॑ यातम॒भि यद्वां॑ वि॒श्वप्स्न्यो॒ जिगा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ nṛpatī íti nṛ-patī ǀ ásti ǀ voḷhā́ ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ vásu-mān ǀ usrá-yāmā ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ viśvá-psnyaḥ ǀ jígāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With that chariot, lords of men, which is your vehicle, which has three benches, is laden with wealth,and is the precursor of day, comeNāsatyās, to us; with that chariot which traverses (the sky) as yourall-pervading form.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं च्यवा॑नं ज॒रसो॑ऽमुमुक्तं॒ नि पे॒दव॑ ऊहथुरा॒शुमश्व॑म् । निरंह॑स॒स्तम॑सः स्पर्त॒मत्रिं॒ नि जा॑हु॒षं शि॑थि॒रे धा॑तम॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ cyávānam ǀ jarásaḥ ǀ amumuktam ǀ ní ǀ pedáve ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ āśúm ǀ áśvam ǀníḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ támasaḥ ǀ spartam ǀ átrim ǀ ní ǀ jāhuṣám ǀ śithiré ǀ dhātam ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You exemptedCyavanafrom decay; you mountedPeduupon a swift charger; you extricatedAtrifromtorture and darkness; you replacedJāhuṣain his rebellious kingdom.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं म॑नी॒षा इ॒यम॑श्विना॒ गीरि॒मां सु॑वृ॒क्तिं वृ॑षणा जुषेथाम् । इ॒मा ब्रह्मा॑णि युव॒यून्य॑ग्मन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ iyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀimā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ yuva-yū́ni ǀ agman ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This adoration,Aśvins, this praise (is for you), be gratified, showerer (of benefits), by this laudation;may these eulogies, addressed to you, reach you; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ गोम॑ता नासत्या॒ रथे॒नाश्वा॑वता पुरुश्च॒न्द्रेण॑ यातम् । अ॒भि वां॒ विश्वा॑ नि॒युत॑: सचन्ते स्पा॒र्हया॑ श्रि॒या त॒न्वा॑ शुभा॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gó-matā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ráthena ǀ áśva-vatā ǀ puru-candréṇa ǀ yātam ǀabhí ǀ vām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ spārháyā ǀ śriyā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śubhānā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyās, with your cattle-giving, horse-bestowing, wealth- yielding chariot; all praises gatherround you, who are resplendent with admirable beauty of a person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ दे॒वेभि॒रुप॑ यातम॒र्वाक्स॒जोष॑सा नासत्या॒ रथे॑न । यु॒वोर्हि न॑: स॒ख्या पित्र्या॑णि समा॒नो बन्धु॑रु॒त तस्य॑ वित्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ráthena ǀyuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ samānáḥ ǀ bándhuḥ ǀ utá ǀ tásya ǀ vittam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sharing in satisfaction with the gods, come to our presence,Nāsatyās, with your chariot, for thefriendship (that prevails) between you and us is from our forefathers; a common ancestor (is ours); acknowledgehis affinity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ स्तोमा॑सो अ॒श्विनो॑रबुध्रञ्जा॒मि ब्रह्मा॑ण्यु॒षस॑श्च दे॒वीः । आ॒विवा॑स॒न्रोद॑सी॒ धिष्ण्ये॒मे अच्छा॒ विप्रो॒ नास॑त्या विवक्ति
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ abudhran ǀ jāmí ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ca ǀ devī́ḥ ǀā-vívāsan ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dhíṣṇye íti ǀ imé íti ǀ áccha ǀ vípraḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ vivakti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praises wakn up theAśvins, kindred adorations (arouse them) and the celestial dawns; the sage,addressing these laudations to the adorable heaven and earth glorifies theNāsatyāsin their presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि चेदु॒च्छन्त्य॑श्विना उ॒षास॒: प्र वां॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि का॒रवो॑ भरन्ते । ऊ॒र्ध्वं भा॒नुं स॑वि॒ता दे॒वो अ॑श्रेद्बृ॒हद॒ग्नय॑: स॒मिधा॑ जरन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ ca ǀ ít ǀ ucchánti ǀ aśvinau ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ bharante ǀūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aśret ǀ bṛhát ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ jarante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the dawns arise, your worshippers,Aśvins, profer you praises; the divineSavitācasts hissplendours on high; the fires, with their (kindled) fuel, greatly glorify you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॒श्चाता॑न्नास॒त्या पु॒रस्ता॒दाश्वि॑ना यातमध॒रादुद॑क्तात् । आ वि॒श्वत॒: पाञ्च॑जन्येन रा॒या यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yātam ǀ adharā́t ǀ údaktāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyena ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; (come),Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अता॑रिष्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्य प्रति॒ स्तोमं॑ देव॒यन्तो॒ दधा॑नाः । पु॒रु॒दंसा॑ पुरु॒तमा॑ पुरा॒जाम॑र्त्या हवते अ॒श्विना॒ गीः
shlokas.transliteration: átāriṣma ǀ támasaḥ ǀ pārám ǀ asyá ǀ práti ǀ stómam ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀpuru-dáṃsā ǀ puru-támā ǀ purā-jā́ ǀ ámartyā ǀ havate ǀ aśvínā ǀ gī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to the gods, and hymning their praise, we have crossed to the opposite shore of this (state of)darkness; the worshipper invokes theAśvins, the doers of many deeds, the most mighty, the first born, theimmortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्यु॑ प्रि॒यो मनु॑षः सादि॒ होता॒ नास॑त्या॒ यो यज॑ते॒ वन्द॑ते च । अ॒श्नी॒तं मध्वो॑ अश्विना उपा॒क आ वां॑ वोचे वि॒दथे॑षु॒ प्रय॑स्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ sādi ǀ hótā ǀ nā́satyā ǀ yáḥ ǀ yájate ǀ vándate ǀ ca ǀaśnītám ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ aśvinau ǀ upāké ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ voce ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ práyasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who is dear to you,Nāsatyās, the invoker of the gods, has taken his seat, he who offersworship and repeats praise; be near,Aśvins, and partake of the libation; supplied with food, I address you atsacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहे॑म य॒ज्ञं प॒थामु॑रा॒णा इ॒मां सु॑वृ॒क्तिं वृ॑षणा जुषेथाम् । श्रु॒ष्टी॒वेव॒ प्रेषि॑तो वामबोधि॒ प्रति॒ स्तोमै॒र्जर॑माणो॒ वसि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: áhema ǀ yajñám ǀ pathā́m ǀ urāṇā́ḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ juṣethām ǀśruṣṭīvā́-iva ǀ prá-iṣitaḥ ǀ vām ǀ abodhi ǀ práti ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ járamāṇaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praising (the gods), we preparers the sacrifice for their coming; showerers (of benefits), be propitiatedby this pious laudation; despatched like a swift messenger,Vasiṣṭhaarouses you, glorifying you with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॒ त्या वह्नी॑ गमतो॒ विशं॑ नो रक्षो॒हणा॒ सम्भृ॑ता वी॒ळुपा॑णी । समन्धां॑स्यग्मत मत्स॒राणि॒ मा नो॑ मर्धिष्ट॒मा ग॑तं शि॒वेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tyā́ ǀ váhnī íti ǀ gamataḥ ǀ víśam ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣaḥ-hánā ǀ sám-bhṛtā ǀ vīḷúpāṇī íti vīḷú-pāṇī ǀsám ǀ ándhāṃsi ǀ agmata ǀ matsarā́ṇi ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣṭam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ śivéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those two, the bearers (of oblations), approach our people, destroyers ofrākṣasas,well-nourished, strong-handed; accept our exhilarating (sacrificial) viands; injure us not, but come with goodfortune.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॒श्चाता॑न्नास॒त्या पु॒रस्ता॒दाश्वि॑ना यातमध॒रादुद॑क्तात् । आ वि॒श्वत॒: पाञ्च॑जन्येन रा॒या यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ ā́ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yātam ǀ adharā́t ǀ údaktāt ǀā́ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyena ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Nāsatyās, from the west, from the east; come,Aśvins, from the south, from the north, comefrom every quarter with riches beneficial for the five classes of men; and do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ वां॒ दिवि॑ष्टय उ॒स्रा ह॑वन्ते अश्विना । अ॒यं वा॑म॒ह्वेऽव॑से शचीवसू॒ विशं॑विशं॒ हि गच्छ॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vām ǀ díviṣṭayaḥ ǀ usrā́ ǀ havante ǀ aśvinā ǀayám ǀ vām ǀ ahve ǀ ávase ǀ śacīvasū íti śacī-vasū ǀ víśam-viśam ǀ hí ǀ gácchathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These pious praises glorify you, radiantAśvins; I call upon you, who are rich, in acts of preservation,for you reach out to every individual.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं चि॒त्रं द॑दथु॒र्भोज॑नं नरा॒ चोदे॑थां सू॒नृता॑वते । अ॒र्वाग्रथं॒ सम॑नसा॒ नि य॑च्छतं॒ पिब॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ citrám ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ bhójanam ǀ narā ǀ códethām ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vate ǀarvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ sá-manasā ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are possessed, leaders (of rites), of marvellous wealth; bestow upon him who sincerely praisesyou; alike favourable-minded, direct your chariot to our presence; drink the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑त॒मुप॑ भूषतं॒ मध्व॑: पिबतमश्विना । दु॒ग्धं पयो॑ वृषणा जेन्यावसू॒ मा नो॑ मर्धिष्ट॒मा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa ǀ bhūṣatam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǀdugdhám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ jenyāvasū íti ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mardhiṣṭam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, tarry near us, drink of the sweet libation; showerers (of benefits), by whom riches arewon, milk the rain (from the firmament); harm us not; come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑सो॒ ये वा॒मुप॑ दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हं यु॒वां दीय॑न्ति॒ बिभ्र॑तः । म॒क्षू॒युभि॑र्नरा॒ हये॑भिरश्वि॒ना दे॑वा यातमस्म॒यू
shlokas.transliteration: áśvāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ vām ǀ úpa ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ yuvā́m ǀ dī́yanti ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀmakṣuyú-bhiḥ ǀ narā ǀ háyebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ devā ǀ yātam ǀ asmayū́ ítyasma-yū́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yours are the horses that, conveying you, bring you to the dwelling to the donor (of the oblation); divineleader (of rites), favourable inclined towards us, come with your rapid steed”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ ह॒ यन्तो॑ अ॒श्विना॒ पृक्ष॑: सचन्त सू॒रय॑: । ता यं॑सतो म॒घव॑द्भ्यो ध्रु॒वं यश॑श्छ॒र्दिर॒स्मभ्यं॒ नास॑त्या
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ ha ǀ yántaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ sacanta ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ yaṃsataḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ chardíḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ nā́satyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious worshippers now approaching you unite to offer (you sacrificial) food; do you two,Nāsatyās, grant to us who are affluent (in offerings) enduring fame and dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये य॒युर॑वृ॒कासो॒ रथा॑ इव नृपा॒तारो॒ जना॑नाम् । उ॒त स्वेन॒ शव॑सा शूशुवु॒र्नर॑ उ॒त क्षि॑यन्ति सुक्षि॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ yayúḥ ǀ avṛkā́sáḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ nṛ-pātā́raḥ ǀ jánānām ǀutá ǀ svéna ǀ śávasā ǀ śūśuvuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣiyanti ǀ su-kṣitím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those worshippers, the benefactors of men, doing injury to none who go to you, like chariots (to thefarm), either prosper by their own strength, or inhabit an excellent abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यु१॒॑षा आ॑वो दिवि॒जा ऋ॒तेना॑विष्कृण्वा॒ना म॑हि॒मान॒मागा॑त् । अप॒ द्रुह॒स्तम॑ आव॒रजु॑ष्ट॒मङ्गि॑रस्तमा प॒थ्या॑ अजीगः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ divi-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ āviḥ-kṛṇvānā́ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀápa ǀ drúhaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ ájuṣṭam ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamā ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ajīgaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Dawn, the daughter of heaven, has risen; she comes, manifesting her magnificence in light; shescatters our foes as well as the odious darkness, and re-illuminates the paths thaat are to be trodden (by livingbeings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हे नो॑ अ॒द्य सु॑वि॒ताय॑ बो॒ध्युषो॑ म॒हे सौभ॑गाय॒ प्र य॑न्धि । चि॒त्रं र॒यिं य॒शसं॑ धेह्य॒स्मे देवि॒ मर्ते॑षु मानुषि श्रव॒स्युम्
shlokas.transliteration: mahé ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ bodhi ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ sáubhagāya ǀ prá ǀ yandhi ǀcitrám ǀ rayím ǀ yaśásam ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǀ dévi ǀ márteṣu ǀ mānuṣi ǀ śravasyúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be unto us today the cause of great felicity; bestow, Uṣas, (what is promotive) of great prosperity; giveus wonderful riches and reputation; grant, divine benefactrss of men, to mortals flourishingmaleposterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते त्ये भा॒नवो॑ दर्श॒ताया॑श्चि॒त्रा उ॒षसो॑ अ॒मृता॑स॒ आगु॑: । ज॒नय॑न्तो॒ दैव्या॑नि व्र॒तान्या॑पृ॒णन्तो॑ अ॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒ व्य॑स्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ tyé ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ darśatā́yāḥ ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aguḥ ǀjanáyantaḥ ǀ dáivyāni ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ā-pṛṇántaḥ ǀ antárikṣā ǀ ví ǀ asthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These wonderful, immortal rays of the beautifu Dawn appear, giving birth to the pious rites of divineworship, and filling the firmament, they spread around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा स्या यु॑जा॒ना प॑रा॒कात्पञ्च॑ क्षि॒तीः परि॑ स॒द्यो जि॑गाति । अ॒भि॒पश्य॑न्ती व॒युना॒ जना॑नां दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता भुव॑नस्य॒ पत्नी॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ syā́ ǀ yujānā́ ǀ parākā́t ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jigāti ǀabhi-páśyantī ǀ vayúnā ǀ jánānām ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ pátnī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exerting herself, she approaches rapidly from afar (to give light) to the five classes of men, witnessingthe thoughts of men, the daughter of heaven, the benefactress of living beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒जिनी॑वती॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ योषा॑ चि॒त्राम॑घा रा॒य ई॑शे॒ वसू॑नाम् । ऋषि॑ष्टुता ज॒रय॑न्ती म॒घोन्यु॒षा उ॑च्छति॒ वह्नि॑भिर्गृणा॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: vājínī-vatī ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yóṣā ǀ citrá-maghā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īśe ǀ vásūnām ǀṛ́ṣi-stutā ǀ jaráyantī ǀ maghónī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchati ǀ váhni-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brideSūrya, the distributress (of food), the possessor of wonderful wealth, she rules overtreasures (of every kind) of riches; hymned by the ṛṣis, the waster away of life, the mistress of opulence, sherises glorified by the offerers (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ द्युता॒नाम॑रु॒षासो॒ अश्वा॑श्चि॒त्रा अ॑दृश्रन्नु॒षसं॒ वह॑न्तः । याति॑ शु॒भ्रा वि॑श्व॒पिशा॒ रथे॑न॒ दधा॑ति॒ रत्नं॑ विध॒ते जना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ dyutānā́m ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ adṛśran ǀ uṣásam ǀ váhantaḥ ǀyā́ti ǀ śubhrā́ ǀ viśva-píśā ǀ ráthena ǀ dádhāti ǀ rátnam ǀ vidhaté ǀ jánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bright and wondrous steeds, conveying the resplendent Uṣas, are visible; she advances, radiantin her every-way-moving chariot; she bestows wealth upon the man who practises sacred rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्या स॒त्येभि॑र्मह॒ती म॒हद्भि॑र्दे॒वी दे॒वेभि॑र्यज॒ता यज॑त्रैः । रु॒जद्दृ॒ळ्हानि॒ दद॑दु॒स्रिया॑णां॒ प्रति॒ गाव॑ उ॒षसं॑ वावशन्त
shlokas.transliteration: satyā́ ǀ satyébhiḥ ǀ mahatī́ ǀ mahát-bhiḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ yajatā́ ǀ yájatraiḥ ǀruját ǀ dṛḷhā́ni ǀ dádat ǀ usríyāṇām ǀ práti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ vāvaśanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “True with the truthful, great with the great, divine with the deities, adorable with adorable, she dispersesthe solid (glooms), she displays (the pastures) of the cattle; all creatures, the cattle especially, are longing for theDawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॒ गोम॑द्वी॒रव॑द्धेहि॒ रत्न॒मुषो॒ अश्वा॑वत्पुरु॒भोजो॑ अ॒स्मे । मा नो॑ ब॒र्हिः पु॑रु॒षता॑ नि॒दे क॑र्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-mat ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ dhehi ǀ rátnam ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ áśva-vat ǀ puru-bhójaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ puruṣátā ǀ nidé ǀ kaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us, Uṣas, wealth, comprising cattle horses, abundant food, andmaleoffspring; let not oursacrifice incur reproach among men; and do you (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ज्योति॑र॒मृतं॑ वि॒श्वज॑न्यं वि॒श्वान॑रः सवि॒ता दे॒वो अ॑श्रेत् । क्रत्वा॑ दे॒वाना॑मजनिष्ट॒ चक्षु॑रा॒विर॑क॒र्भुव॑नं॒ विश्व॑मु॒षाः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ viśvá-janyam ǀ viśvā́naraḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aśret ǀkrátvā ǀ devā́nām ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ akaḥ ǀ bhúvanam ǀ víśvam ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSavitā, the leader of all, sends upwards the immortal, all- benefiting light; the eye of thegods has been manifested for (the celebration of) religious rites; the Dawn has made all creatures visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मे॒ पन्था॑ देव॒याना॑ अदृश्र॒न्नम॑र्धन्तो॒ वसु॑भि॒रिष्कृ॑तासः । अभू॑दु के॒तुरु॒षस॑: पु॒रस्ता॑त्प्रती॒च्यागा॒दधि॑ ह॒र्म्येभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ me ǀ pánthāḥ ǀ deva-yā́nāḥ ǀ adṛśran ǀ ámardhantaḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ íṣkṛtāsaḥ ǀábhūt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ketúḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ ádhi ǀ harmyébhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The paths that lead to the gods are beheld by me, innocuous and glorious with light; the banner ofUṣas is displayed in the east, she comes to the west, rising above high plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तानीदहा॑नि बहु॒लान्या॑स॒न्या प्रा॒चीन॒मुदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य । यत॒: परि॑ जा॒र इ॑वा॒चर॒न्त्युषो॑ ददृ॒क्षे न पुन॑र्य॒तीव॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ni ǀ ít ǀ áhāni ǀ bahulā́ni ǀ āsan ǀ yā́ ǀ prācī́nam ǀ út-itā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀyátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ jāráḥ-iva ǀ ā-cárantī ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ dadṛkṣé ǀ ná ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yatī́-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the days that have dawned before the rising of the sun, on which you, Uṣas, have beenbeheld like a wife going to an inconstant husband, and not like one deserting him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त इद्दे॒वानां॑ सध॒माद॑ आसन्नृ॒तावा॑नः क॒वय॑: पू॒र्व्यास॑: । गू॒ळ्हं ज्योति॑: पि॒तरो॒ अन्व॑विन्दन्त्स॒त्यम॑न्त्रा अजनयन्नु॒षास॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ít ǀ devā́nām ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ āsan ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ pūrvyā́saḥ ǀgūḷhám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ ánu ǀ avindan ǀ satyá-mantrāḥ ǀ ajanayan ǀ uṣásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those ancient sages, our ancestors, observant of truth, rejoicing together with the gods, discovered thehidden ligh, and, reciters of sincere prayers, they genitive rated the Dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒न ऊ॒र्वे अधि॒ संग॑तास॒: सं जा॑नते॒ न य॑तन्ते मि॒थस्ते । ते दे॒वानां॒ न मि॑नन्ति व्र॒तान्यम॑र्धन्तो॒ वसु॑भि॒र्याद॑मानाः
shlokas.transliteration: samāné ǀ ūrvé ǀ ádhi ǀ sám-gatāsaḥ ǀ sám ǀ jānate ǀ ná ǀ yatante ǀ mitháḥ ǀ té ǀté ǀ devā́nām ǀ ná ǀ minanti ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ámardhantaḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ yā́damānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the common herd (of cattle had been stolen) then, associating, they concurred, nor mutuallycontended; they obstructed not the sacrifices of the gods, but, unoffending, proceeded with the light (they hadrecovered).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ त्वा॒ स्तोमै॑रीळते॒ वसि॑ष्ठा उष॒र्बुध॑: सुभगे तुष्टु॒वांस॑: । गवां॑ ने॒त्री वाज॑पत्नी न उ॒च्छोष॑: सुजाते प्रथ॒मा ज॑रस्व
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ tvā ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ uṣaḥ-búdhaḥ ǀ su-bhage ǀ tustu-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀgávām ǀ netrī́ ǀ vā́ja-patnī ǀ naḥ ǀ uccha ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ su-jāte ǀ prathamā́ ǀ jarasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Auspicious Uṣas, theVasiṣṭhas, waking at dawn; and praising you, glorify you, glorify you with hymns;Uṣas, who are the conductress of the cattle (to pasture), the bestower of food, dawn upon us; shine, well-bornUṣas, the first (of the gods).”
