shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा ने॒त्री राध॑सः सू॒नृता॑नामु॒षा उ॒च्छन्ती॑ रिभ्यत॒॒ वसि॑ष्ठैः । दी॒र्घ॒श्रुतं॑ र॒यिम॒स्मे दधा॑ना यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ netrī́ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchántī ǀ ribhyate ǀ vásiṣṭhaiḥ ǀdīrgha-śrútam ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ dádhānā ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, the object of the sincere praises of the worshipper, is glorified when dawning, by the Vasiṣṭhasbestowing upon us far-famed riches; do you (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑ रुरुचे युव॒तिर्न योषा॒ विश्वं॑ जी॒वं प्र॑सु॒वन्ती॑ च॒रायै॑ । अभू॑द॒ग्निः स॒मिधे॒ मानु॑षाणा॒मक॒र्ज्योति॒र्बाध॑माना॒ तमां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ ruruce ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣā ǀ víśvam ǀ jīvám ǀ pra-suvántī ǀ carā́yai ǀábhūt ǀ agníḥ ǀ sam-ídhe ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ ákaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ bā́dhamānā ǀ támāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas shines radiant in the proximity (of the sun), like a youthful wife (in the presence of her husband),animating all existence to activity;Agniis to be kindled for the good of men; the light disperses the obstructingdarkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वं॑ प्रती॒ची स॒प्रथा॒ उद॑स्था॒द्रुश॒द्वासो॒ बिभ्र॑ती शु॒क्रम॑श्वैत् । हिर॑ण्यवर्णा सु॒दृशी॑कसंदृ॒ग्गवां॑ मा॒ता ने॒त्र्यह्ना॑मरोचि
shlokas.transliteration: víśvam ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀ út ǀ asthāt ǀ rúśat ǀ vā́saḥ ǀ bíbhratī ǀ śukrám ǀ aśvait ǀhíraṇya-varṇā ǀ sudṛ́śīka-sandṛk ǀ gávām ǀ mātā́ ǀ netrī́ ǀ áhnām ǀ aroci ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Advancing towards all, and spreading widely, the Dawn has risen; clothed in pure and brilliant vesture,she expands; of golden colour and of lovely radiance, she shines the parent of sounds, the leader of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वानां॒ चक्षु॑: सु॒भगा॒ वह॑न्ती श्वे॒तं नय॑न्ती सु॒दृशी॑क॒मश्व॑म् । उ॒षा अ॑दर्शि र॒श्मिभि॒र्व्य॑क्ता चि॒त्राम॑घा॒ विश्व॒मनु॒ प्रभू॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: devā́nām ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ su-bhágā ǀ váhantī ǀ śvetám ǀ náyantī ǀ su-dṛ́śīkam ǀ áśvam ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ adarśi ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ ví-aktā ǀ citrá-maghā ǀ víśvam ǀ ánu ǀ prá-bhūtā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious Uṣas, bearing the eye of the gods (the light), leading her white and beautiful courser(the sun), is belied, manifested by her rays, disributress of wonderful wealth, mighty over all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्ति॑वामा दू॒रे अ॒मित्र॑मुच्छो॒र्वीं गव्यू॑ति॒मभ॑यं कृधी नः । या॒वय॒ द्वेष॒ आ भ॑रा॒ वसू॑नि चो॒दय॒ राधो॑ गृण॒ते म॑घोनि
shlokas.transliteration: ánti-vāmā ǀ dūré ǀ amítram ǀ uccha ǀ urvī́m ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǀyaváya ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ vásūni ǀ codáya ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ maghoni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dawn, Uṣas, who are the bearer to us of desirable (wealth), and keep our adversary from us; renderthe wide earth free from peril; drive away those who hate us; bring to us treasures; bestow, opulent goddesswealth upon him who praises you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे श्रेष्ठे॑भिर्भा॒नुभि॒र्वि भा॒ह्युषो॑ देवि प्रति॒रन्ती॑ न॒ आयु॑: । इषं॑ च नो॒ दध॑ती विश्ववारे॒ गोम॒दश्वा॑व॒द्रथ॑वच्च॒ राध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ śréṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ devi ǀ pra-tirántī ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀíṣam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dádhatī ǀ viśva-vāre ǀ gó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ rátha-vat ǀ ca ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine Uṣas, illumine us with your brightest rays, prolonging our existence, bestowing upon us food,(and granting us), you who are adored by all, affluence, comprising cattle, horses, and chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यां त्वा॑ दिवो दुहितर्व॒र्धय॒न्त्युष॑: सुजाते म॒तिभि॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः । सास्मासु॑ धा र॒यिमृ॒ष्वं बृ॒हन्तं॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́n ǀ tvā ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ vardháyanti ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ su-jāte ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀsā́ ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhāḥ ǀ rayím ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ bṛhántam ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-manifested Uṣas, daughter of heaven, do you, whom theVasiṣṭhasmagnify with praises, bestowupon us brillian and infinite wealth; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ के॒तव॑: प्रथ॒मा अ॑दृश्रन्नू॒र्ध्वा अ॑स्या अ॒ञ्जयो॒ वि श्र॑यन्ते । उषो॑ अ॒र्वाचा॑ बृह॒ता रथे॑न॒ ज्योति॑ष्मता वा॒मम॒स्मभ्यं॑ वक्षि
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ adṛśran ǀ ūrdhvā́ḥ ǀ asyāḥ ǀ añjáyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ śrayante ǀúṣaḥ ǀ arvā́cā ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráthena ǀ jyótiṣmatā ǀ vāmám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ vakṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The first signs of the Dawn are visible, her rays are spreading not high; you bring us, Uṣas, desirable(riches) in your vast, descending and resplendent chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ षीम॒ग्निर्ज॑रते॒ समि॑द्ध॒: प्रति॒ विप्रा॑सो म॒तिभि॑र्गृ॒णन्त॑: । उ॒षा या॑ति॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ बाध॑माना॒ विश्वा॒ तमां॑सि दुरि॒ताप॑ दे॒वी
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ sīm ǀ agníḥ ǀ jarate ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ práti ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ bā́dhamānā ǀ víśvā ǀ támāṃsi ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ ápa ǀ devī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kindled fire increases everywhere, (and) the priests, glorifying (the dawn) with hymns; the divineUṣas comes, driving away all the evil glooms by her lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता उ॒ त्याः प्रत्य॑दृश्रन्पु॒रस्ता॒ज्ज्योति॒र्यच्छ॑न्तीरु॒षसो॑ विभा॒तीः । अजी॑जन॒न्त्सूर्यं॑ य॒ज्ञम॒ग्निम॑पा॒चीनं॒ तमो॑ अगा॒दजु॑ष्टम्
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ práti ǀ adṛśran ǀ purástāt ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ yácchantīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀájījanan ǀ sū́ryam ǀ yajñám ǀ agním ǀ apācī́nam ǀ támaḥ ǀ agāt ǀ ájuṣṭam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These luminous (beams of the) dawn are beheld in the east diffusing light; (the dawn) enger sacrifice,fire; the odious glooms, descending, disappear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अचे॑ति दि॒वो दु॑हि॒ता म॒घोनी॒ विश्वे॑ पश्यन्त्यु॒षसं॑ विभा॒तीम् । आस्था॒द्रथं॑ स्व॒धया॑ यु॒ज्यमा॑न॒मा यमश्वा॑सः सु॒युजो॒ वह॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: áceti ǀ diváḥ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ maghónī ǀ víśve ǀ paśyanti ǀ uṣásam ǀ vi-bhātī́m ǀā́ ǀ asthāt ǀ rátham ǀ svadháyā ǀ yujyámānam ǀ ā́ ǀ yám ǀ áśvāsaḥ ǀ su-yújaḥ ǀ váhanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The affluent daughter of heaven is perceived; all creatures behold the luminous dawn; she ascends herchariot laden with sustenance, which her easily- yoked horses draw.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ त्वा॒द्य सु॒मन॑सो बुधन्ता॒स्माका॑सो म॒घवा॑नो व॒यं च॑ । ति॒ल्वि॒ला॒यध्व॑मुषसो विभा॒तीर्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ tvā ǀ adyá ǀ su-mánasaḥ ǀ budhanta ǀ asmā́kāsaḥ ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀtilvilāyádhvam ǀ uṣasaḥ ǀ vi-bhātī́ḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent (in sacrificial offerings), actuated by one mind, we and ours awaken you, (Uṣas), today;luminous dawns, soften (the earth) with unctuous (dews) and do you, (gods) ever cherish us with blessingṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्यु१॒॑षा आ॑वः प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ जना॑नां॒ पञ्च॑ क्षि॒तीर्मानु॑षीर्बो॒धय॑न्ती । सु॒सं॒दृग्भि॑रु॒क्षभि॑र्भा॒नुम॑श्रे॒द्वि सूर्यो॒ रोद॑सी॒ चक्ष॑सावः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ āvaḥ ǀ pathyā́ ǀ jánānām ǀ páñca ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ bodháyantī ǀsusandṛ́k-bhiḥ ǀ ukṣá-bhiḥ ǀ bhānúm ǀ aśret ǀ ví ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cákṣasā ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas has dawned upon the paths of men, awaking the five classes of human beings; she has shedlight with her lustrous oxen; the sun makes heaven and earth manifest with radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑ञ्जते दि॒वो अन्ते॑ष्व॒क्तून्विशो॒ न यु॒क्ता उ॒षसो॑ यतन्ते । सं ते॒ गाव॒स्तम॒ आ व॑र्तयन्ति॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छन्ति सवि॒तेव॑ बा॒हू
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ añjate ǀ diváḥ ǀ ánteṣu ǀ aktū́n ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ yatante ǀsám ǀ te ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ támaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayanti ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ yacchanti ǀ savitā́-iva ǀ bāhū́ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The dawns send their rays to the ends of the sky. They advance like people arrayed like people (inmartial order); your rays, Uṣas, annihilate the darkness; they diffuse light asSavitā(spreads out) his arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॑दु॒षा इन्द्र॑तमा म॒घोन्यजी॑जनत्सुवि॒ताय॒ श्रवां॑सि । वि दि॒वो दे॒वी दु॑हि॒ता द॑धा॒त्यङ्गि॑रस्तमा सु॒कृते॒ वसू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūt ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ índra-tamā ǀ maghónī ǀ ájījanat ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀví ǀ diváḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ dadhāti ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamā ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ vásūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The supreme sovereign, the opulent uṣas, has risen; she has engendered food for our welfare; thedivine daughter of heaven, most prompt in movement, bestows treasures upon the pious worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताव॑दुषो॒ राधो॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ रास्व॒ याव॑त्स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ अर॑दो गृणा॒ना । यां त्वा॑ ज॒ज्ञुर्वृ॑ष॒भस्या॒ रवे॑ण॒ वि दृ॒ळ्हस्य॒ दुरो॒ अद्रे॑रौर्णोः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́vat ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ rāsva ǀ yā́vat ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ áradaḥ ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀyā́m ǀ tvā ǀ jajñúḥ ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ ráveṇa ǀ ví ǀ dṛḷhásya ǀ dúraḥ ǀ ádreḥ ǀ aurṇoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us as much wealth as you have bestowed upon thine adorers when (formerly) praised by them;you whom (your worshippers) welcomed with clamour, (loud as the bellowing) of a bull, when you had set openthe doors of the mountains (where the stolen cattle were confined).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वंदे॑वं॒ राध॑से चो॒दय॑न्त्यस्म॒द्र्य॑क्सू॒नृता॑ ई॒रय॑न्ती । व्यु॒च्छन्ती॑ नः स॒नये॒ धियो॑ धा यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: devám-devam ǀ rā́dhase ǀ codáyantī ǀ asmadryák ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ īráyantī ǀvi-ucchántī ǀ naḥ ǀ sanáye ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inspiring every individual devout (worshipper) with a desire for wealth, addressing to us the words oftruth, diffusing the light of morning, bestow upon us understanding (fit) for the acquisition of riches; and do you,(gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॒ स्तोमे॑भिरु॒षसं॒ वसि॑ष्ठा गी॒र्भिर्विप्रा॑सः प्रथ॒मा अ॑बुध्रन् । वि॒व॒र्तय॑न्तीं॒ रज॑सी॒ सम॑न्ते आविष्कृण्व॒तीं भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ uṣásam ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ abudhran ǀvi-vartáyantīm ǀ rájasī íti ǀ sámante íti sám-ante ǀ āviḥ-kṛṇvatī́m ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The piousVasiṣṭhas, first (of all worshippers) awaken with prayers and praises (each succeeding)dawn spreading over the like-bounded earth and heaven making all the regions manifest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा स्या नव्य॒मायु॒र्दधा॑ना गू॒ढ्वी तमो॒ ज्योति॑षो॒षा अ॑बोधि । अग्र॑ एति युव॒तिरह्र॑याणा॒ प्राचि॑कित॒त्सूर्यं॑ य॒ज्ञम॒ग्निम्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ syā́ ǀ návyam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ dádhānā ǀ gūḍhvī́ ǀ támaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ abodhi ǀágre ǀ eti ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ áhrayāṇā ǀ prá ǀ acikitat ǀ sū́ryam ǀ yajñám ǀ agním ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestowing new existence, dispersing the thick darkness by her radiance, the Dawn is awakened andlike an immodest dame, she comes before (the sun), and makes manifestSūrya, sacrifice andAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्न उ॒षासो॑ वी॒रव॑ती॒: सद॑मुच्छन्तु भ॒द्राः । घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना वि॒श्वत॒: प्रपी॑ता यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vatīḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ vīrá-vatīḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ucchantu ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀghṛtám ǀ dúhānāḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ prá-pītāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the auspicious dawns ever break upon us redolen of horses, of cattle, ofmaleposterity, sheddingmoisture, yielding everywhere abundance; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्यु॑ अदर्श्याय॒त्यु१॒॑च्छन्ती॑ दुहि॒ता दि॒वः । अपो॒ महि॑ व्ययति॒ चक्ष॑से॒ तमो॒ ज्योति॑ष्कृणोति सू॒नरी॑
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ adarśi ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ ucchántī ǀ duhitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀápo íti ǀ máhi ǀ vyayati ǀ cákṣase ǀ támaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ sūnárī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter of heaven is everywhere beheld advancing and shedding light; she drives away the deepdarkness that objects may meet the eye; the kind guide of man, she diffuses light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒स्रिया॑: सृजते॒ सूर्य॒: सचाँ॑ उ॒द्यन्नक्ष॑त्रमर्चि॒वत् । तवेदु॑षो॒ व्युषि॒ सूर्य॑स्य च॒ सं भ॒क्तेन॑ गमेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ sṛjate ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ sácā ǀ ut-yát ǀ nákṣatram ǀ arci-vát ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ vi-úṣi ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ca ǀ sám ǀ bhakténa ǀ gamemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the same time the sun sends forth his rays, and, rising, renders the plural nets luminous; so, Uṣas,upon your manifestation, and that ofSūrya, may we become possessed of sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ त्वा दुहितर्दिव॒ उषो॑ जी॒रा अ॑भुत्स्महि । या वह॑सि पु॒रु स्पा॒र्हं व॑नन्वति॒ रत्नं॒ न दा॒शुषे॒ मय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ tvā ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ jīrā́ḥ ǀ abhutsmahi ǀyā́ ǀ váhasi ǀ purú ǀ spārhám ǀ vanan-vati ǀ rátnam ǀ ná ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ máyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, prompt adorers, awaken you, Uṣas, daughter of heaven, bountiful divinity, who bring ampleand desirable (wealth) and happiness, like riches, to the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छन्ती॒ या कृ॒णोषि॑ मं॒हना॑ महि प्र॒ख्यै दे॑वि॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे । तस्या॑स्ते रत्न॒भाज॑ ईमहे व॒यं स्याम॑ मा॒तुर्न सू॒नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ucchántī ǀ yā́ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ maṃhánā ǀ mahi ǀ pra-khyái ǀ devi ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀtásyāḥ ǀ te ǀ ratna-bhā́jaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ vayám ǀ syā́ma ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ná ǀ sūnávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mighty goddess, who, scattering darkness, are endowed with power to arouse the world and make itvisible, we pray that we may be dear to you, the distributress of wealth, as sons are to a mother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तच्चि॒त्रं राध॒ आ भ॒रोषो॒ यद्दी॑र्घ॒श्रुत्त॑मम् । यत्ते॑ दिवो दुहितर्मर्त॒भोज॑नं॒ तद्रा॑स्व भु॒नजा॑महै
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ citrám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ yát ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamam ǀyát ǀ te ǀ divaḥ ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ marta-bhójanam ǀ tát ǀ rāsva ǀ bhunájāmahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring Uṣas, such wondrous wealth as may be long renowned; bestow, daughter of heaven, thatsustenance which is fit for mortals, such as we may enjoy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रव॑: सू॒रिभ्यो॑ अ॒मृतं॑ वसुत्व॒नं वाजाँ॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ गोम॑तः । चो॒द॒यि॒त्री म॒घोन॑: सू॒नृता॑वत्यु॒षा उ॑च्छ॒दप॒ स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śrávaḥ ǀ sūrí-bhyaḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ vasu-tvanám ǀ vā́jān ǀ asmábhyam ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀcodayitrī́ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tā-vatī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ucchat ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant to the pious immortal fame, conjoined with affluence; grant to us food and cattle; and may Uṣas,the encourager of the wealthy (sacrificer) the speaker of truth, drive away our foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा यु॒वम॑ध्व॒राय॑ नो वि॒शे जना॑य॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम् । दी॒र्घप्र॑यज्यु॒मति॒ यो व॑नु॒ष्यति॑ व॒यं ज॑येम॒ पृत॑नासु दू॒ढ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ yuvám ǀ adhvarā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ viśé ǀ jánāya ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǀdīrghá-prayajyum ǀ áti ǀ yáḥ ǀ vanuṣyáti ǀ vayám ǀ jayema ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, bestow upon this man, our employer, a spacious chamber for (the celebration of) thesacrifice; and may we subdue in conflicts such evil-minded person ns as may seek to injure him who has been longengaged (in your adoration).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्राळ॒न्यः स्व॒राळ॒न्य उ॑च्यते वां म॒हान्ता॒विन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा म॒हाव॑सू । विश्वे॑ दे॒वास॑: पर॒मे व्यो॑मनि॒ सं वा॒मोजो॑ वृषणा॒ सं बलं॑ दधुः
shlokas.transliteration: sam-rā́ṭ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ sva-rā́ṭ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ vām ǀ mahā́ntau ǀ índrāváruṇā ǀ mahā́vasū íti mahā́-vasū ǀvíśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-omani ǀ sám ǀ vām ǀ ójaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ sám ǀ bálam ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of you it titled supreme monarch, so is the other; mighty and most opulent are you,Indraand all thegods in the highest heaven, showerers (of benefits), have combined your united strength, (your) maid vigouṛ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्व॒पां खान्य॑तृन्त॒मोज॒सा सूर्य॑मैरयतं दि॒वि प्र॒भुम् । इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ मदे॑ अस्य मा॒यिनोऽपि॑न्वतम॒पित॒: पिन्व॑तं॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ apā́m ǀ khā́ni ǀ atṛntam ǀ ójasā ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ airayatam ǀ diví ǀ pra-bhúm ǀíndrāvaruṇā ǀ máde ǀ asya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ ápinvatam ǀ apítaḥ ǀ pínvatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, you have forced open by your strength the barriers of the waters; you haveestablishedSūryaas the lord in heaven; in the exhilaration of the inspiring (Soma) you have replenished the dry(beds of the rivers); do you also fulfil the objects of our sacred rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वामिद्यु॒त्सु पृत॑नासु॒ वह्न॑यो यु॒वां क्षेम॑स्य प्रस॒वे मि॒तज्ञ॑वः । ई॒शा॒ना वस्व॑ उ॒भय॑स्य का॒रव॒ इन्द्रा॑वरुणा सु॒हवा॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ ít ǀ yut-sú ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ yuvā́m ǀ kṣémasya ǀ pra-savé ǀ mitá-jñavaḥ ǀīśānā́ ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ su-hávā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearers (of offerings) invoke you,IndraandVaruṇa, in wars, in battles; on banded knees (theAṅgirasas invoke you) for the begetting of prosperity; and we, your worshippers, invoke you, who are entitled torespectful homage, the lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ यदि॒मानि॑ च॒क्रथु॒र्विश्वा॑ जा॒तानि॒ भुव॑नस्य म॒ज्मना॑ । क्षेमे॑ण मि॒त्रो वरु॑णं दुव॒स्यति॑ म॒रुद्भि॑रु॒ग्रः शुभ॑म॒न्य ई॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ yát ǀ imā́ni ǀ cakráthuḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ majmánā ǀkṣémeṇa ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇam ǀ duvasyáti ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ śúbham ǀ anyáḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, inasmuch as you have created by your might all these beings of the world, thereforeMitra worships Varuṇa for prosperity, while the other, the fierce Indra, associated with theMaruts, acquiresglory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हे शु॒ल्काय॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नु त्वि॒ष ओजो॑ मिमाते ध्रु॒वम॑स्य॒ यत्स्वम् । अजा॑मिम॒न्यः श्न॒थय॑न्त॒माति॑रद्द॒भ्रेभि॑र॒न्यः प्र वृ॑णोति॒ भूय॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: mahé ǀ śulkā́ya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ nú ǀ tviṣé ǀ ójaḥ ǀ mimāte íti ǀ dhruvám ǀ asya ǀ yát ǀ svám ǀájāmim ǀ anyáḥ ǀ śnatháyantam ǀ ā́ ǀ átirat ǀ dabhrébhiḥ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ prá ǀ vṛṇoti ǀ bhū́yasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In honour of (IndraandVaruṇa) the sacrificer and his wife for (the obtaining of) great wealth, confer (bytheir praises) that strength which is peculiar to each of them, and ever-enduring; one of them, (Varuṇa), destroysthe unfriendly man neglecting (his worship); the other, (Indra), with scanty (means), discomfits numerous(enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तमंहो॒ न दु॑रि॒तानि॒ मर्त्य॒मिन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ न तप॒: कुत॑श्च॒न । यस्य॑ देवा॒ गच्छ॑थो वी॒थो अ॑ध्व॒रं न तं मर्त॑स्य नशते॒ परि॑ह्वृतिः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ mártyam ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ ná ǀ tápaḥ ǀ kútaḥ ǀ caná ǀyásya ǀ devā ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ vītháḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ ná ǀ tám ǀ mártasya ǀ naśate ǀ pári-hvṛtiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sin contaminates not, difficulties assail not, nor distress at any time afflicts the mortal,IndraandVaruṇa, to whose sacrifices you, deities, go, and of which you approve; such a man ruin never destroyṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाङ्न॑रा॒ दैव्ये॒नाव॒सा ग॑तं शृणु॒तं हवं॒ यदि॑ मे॒ जुजो॑षथः । यु॒वोर्हि स॒ख्यमु॒त वा॒ यदाप्यं॑ मार्डी॒कमि॑न्द्रावरुणा॒ नि य॑च्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́k ǀ narā ǀ dáivyena ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ hávam ǀ yádi ǀ me ǀ jújoṣathaḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ sakhyám ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ ā́pyam ǀ mārḍīkám ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders of rites, come to our presence with divine protection; if you have any regard for me, hear myinvocation; verily your friendship, your affinity, is the source of happiness; grant them,IndraandVaruṇa(untous).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मिन्द्रावरुणा॒ भरे॑भरे पुरोयो॒धा भ॑वतं कृष्ट्योजसा । यद्वां॒ हव॑न्त उ॒भये॒ अध॑ स्पृ॒धि नर॑स्तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑यस्य सा॒तिषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ bháre-bhare ǀ puraḥ-yodhā́ ǀ bhavatam ǀ kṛṣṭi-ojasā ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ hávante ǀ ubháye ǀ ádha ǀ spṛdhí ǀ náraḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ tánayasya ǀ sātíṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, of irresistible strength, be our preceders in every encounter, for both (past andpresent) worshippers invoke you to defend them iin war, or for the acquisition of sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे इन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा द्यु॒म्नं य॑च्छन्तु॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑: । अ॒व॒ध्रं ज्योति॒रदि॑तेॠता॒वृधो॑ दे॒वस्य॒ श्लोकं॑ सवि॒तुर्म॑नामहे
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ dyumnám ǀ yacchantu ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀavadhrám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ ślókam ǀ savitúḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra,Varuṇa,MitraandAryamangrant us wealth and a large and spacious habitation; may thelustre ofAditi, the augmentress of sacrifice, be innoxious to us; we recite the praise of the divineSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां न॑रा॒ पश्य॑मानास॒ आप्यं॑ प्रा॒चा ग॒व्यन्त॑: पृथु॒पर्श॑वो ययुः । दासा॑ च वृ॒त्रा ह॒तमार्या॑णि च सु॒दास॑मिन्द्रावरु॒णाव॑सावतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ narā ǀ páśyamānāsaḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ prācā́ ǀ gavyántaḥ ǀ pṛthu-párśavaḥ ǀ yayuḥ ǀdā́sā ǀ ca ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ hatám ǀ ā́ryāṇi ǀ ca ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ávasā ǀ avatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, leaders (of rites), contemplating your affinity, and desirous of cattle, the worshippers,armed with large sickles, have proceeded to the east (to cut the sacred grass); destroy, Indra and Varuṇa, yourenemies, whether Dāsās orĀryāsand defendSudāsawith yor protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रा॒ नर॑: स॒मय॑न्ते कृ॒तध्व॑जो॒ यस्मि॑न्ना॒जा भव॑ति॒ किं च॒न प्रि॒यम् । यत्रा॒ भय॑न्ते॒ भुव॑ना स्व॒र्दृश॒स्तत्रा॑ न इन्द्रावरु॒णाधि॑ वोचतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ náraḥ ǀ sam-áyante ǀ kṛtá-dhvajaḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ ājā́ ǀ bhávati ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ priyám ǀyátra ǀ bháyante ǀ bhúvanā ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ tátra ǀ naḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ádhi ǀ vocatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where men assemble with uplifted banners, in whatever conflict, there is something unfavourable;where living beings, looking to heaven, are in fear, there,IndraandVaruṇa, speak tous (encouragement).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं भूम्या॒ अन्ता॑ ध्वसि॒रा अ॑दृक्ष॒तेन्द्रा॑वरुणा दि॒वि घोष॒ आरु॑हत् । अस्थु॒र्जना॑ना॒मुप॒ मामरा॑तयो॒ऽर्वागव॑सा हवनश्रु॒ता ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ bhū́myāḥ ǀ ántāḥ ǀ dhvasirā́ḥ ǀ adṛkṣata ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ diví ǀ ghóṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀásthuḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ úpa ǀ mā́m ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ ávasā ǀ havana-śrutā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ends of the earth are beheld laid waste; the clamour has ascended,IndraandVaruṇa, to heaven;the adversaries of my people approach me; having heard my invocation, come for my defence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा व॒धना॑भिरप्र॒ति भे॒दं व॒न्वन्ता॒ प्र सु॒दास॑मावतम् । ब्रह्मा॑ण्येषां शृणुतं॒ हवी॑मनि स॒त्या तृत्सू॑नामभवत्पु॒रोहि॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ vadhánābhiḥ ǀ apratí ǀ bhedám ǀ vanvántā ǀ prá ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ āvatam ǀbráhmāṇi ǀ eṣām ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávīmani ǀ satyā́ ǀ tṛ́tsūnām ǀ abhavat ǀ puráḥ-hitiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, you protectedSudāsa, overwhelming the yet unassailedBhedawith your fatalweapons; here the prayers of threse Tṛtsus in time of battle, so that my ministration may have borne them fruit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणाव॒भ्या त॑पन्ति मा॒घान्य॒र्यो व॒नुषा॒मरा॑तयः । यु॒वं हि वस्व॑ उ॒भय॑स्य॒ राज॒थोऽध॑ स्मा नोऽवतं॒ पार्ये॑ दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇau ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ tapanti ǀ mā ǀ aghā́ni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vanúṣām ǀ árātayaḥ ǀyuvám ǀ hí ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ rā́jathaḥ ǀ ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ avatam ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandVaruṇa, the murderous (weapons) of my enemy distressme; foes among the malignant(assail me); you two are sovereigns over both (celestial and terrestrial) wealth; protect us therefore, onthe day ofbattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां ह॑वन्त उ॒भया॑स आ॒जिष्विन्द्रं॑ च॒ वस्वो॒ वरु॑णं च सा॒तये॑ । यत्र॒ राज॑भिर्द॒शभि॒र्निबा॑धितं॒ प्र सु॒दास॒माव॑तं॒ तृत्सु॑भिः स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ havante ǀ ubháyāsaḥ ǀ ājíṣu ǀ índram ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ váruṇam ǀ ca ǀ sātáye ǀyátra ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ ní-bādhitam ǀ prá ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tṛ́tsu-bhiḥ ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both (Sudāsaand the Tṛtsus) call upon you two (IndraandVaruṇa), in combats for the acquisition ofwealth, when you defend Sudāsa, together with Tṛtsus, when attacked bythe tenrājās.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ राजा॑न॒: समि॑ता॒ अय॑ज्यवः सु॒दास॑मिन्द्रावरुणा॒ न यु॑युधुः । स॒त्या नृ॒णाम॑द्म॒सदा॒मुप॑स्तुतिर्दे॒वा ए॑षामभवन्दे॒वहू॑तिषु
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ sám-itāḥ ǀ áyajyavaḥ ǀ su-dā́sam ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ná ǀ yuyudhuḥ ǀsatyā́ ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ adma-sádām ǀ úpa-stutiḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ abhavan ǀ devá-hūtiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten confederated irreligiousrājāsdid not prevail,IndraandVaruṇa, againstSudāsa; the praiseof the leaders (of rites), the offerers of sacrificial food, was fruitful; the gods were present at their sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒श॒रा॒ज्ञे परि॑यत्ताय वि॒श्वत॑: सु॒दास॑ इन्द्रावरुणावशिक्षतम् । श्वि॒त्यञ्चो॒ यत्र॒ नम॑सा कप॒र्दिनो॑ धि॒या धीव॑न्तो॒ अस॑पन्त॒ तृत्स॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: dāśa-rājñé ǀ pári-yattāya ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ su-dā́se ǀ indrāvaruṇau ǀ aśikṣatam ǀśvityáñcaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ námasā ǀ kapardínaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ dhī́-vantaḥ ǀ ásapanta ǀ tṛ́tsavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gave vigour,IndraandVaruṇa, toSudāsawhen surrounded on all sides by the tenrājās(inthe country) where the pious Tṛtsus, walking in whiteness, and wearing braided hair, worshipped with oblationsand praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒त्राण्य॒न्यः स॑मि॒थेषु॒ जिघ्न॑ते व्र॒तान्य॒न्यो अ॒भि र॑क्षते॒ सदा॑ । हवा॑महे वां वृषणा सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र॒स्मे इ॑न्द्रावरुणा॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ anyáḥ ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ jíghnate ǀ vratā́ni ǀ anyáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣate ǀ sádā ǀhávāmahe ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of you destroys enemies inbattle, the other ever protects religious observances; we invoke you,showerers (of benefits), with praises; bestow upon us,IndraandVaruṇa, felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे इन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा द्यु॒म्नं य॑च्छन्तु॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑: । अ॒व॒ध्रं ज्योति॒रदि॑तेॠता॒वृधो॑ दे॒वस्य॒ श्लोकं॑ सवि॒तुर्म॑नामहे
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ dyumnám ǀ yacchantu ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀavadhrám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ ślókam ǀ savitúḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryamangrant us wealth and a large and spacious mansion; may the lustreofAditi, the augmentress (of sacrifice), be innoxious to us; we recite the praise of the divineSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ राजानावध्व॒रे व॑वृत्यां ह॒व्येभि॑रिन्द्रावरुणा॒ नमो॑भिः । प्र वां॑ घृ॒ताची॑ बा॒ह्वोर्दधा॑ना॒ परि॒ त्मना॒ विषु॑रूपा जिगाति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ rājānau ǀ adhvaré ǀ vavṛtyām ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ vām ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ dádhānā ǀ pári ǀ tmánā ǀ víṣu-rūpā ǀ jigāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalIndraandVaruṇa, I invite you to the sacrifice with oblations and with praise; the butter-dropping(ladle), held in ourhands, offers spontaneously (the oblation) to you who are of many forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वो रा॒ष्ट्रं बृ॒हदि॑न्वति॒ द्यौर्यौ से॒तृभि॑रर॒ज्जुभि॑: सिनी॒थः । परि॑ नो॒ हेळो॒ वरु॑णस्य वृज्या उ॒रुं न॒ इन्द्र॑: कृणवदु लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ rāṣṭrám ǀ bṛhát ǀ invati ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ yáu ǀ setṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ arajjú-bhiḥ ǀ sinītháḥ ǀpári ǀ naḥ ǀ héḷaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vṛjyāḥ ǀ urúm ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your vast kingdom of heaven gratifies (the world with rain), you who bind (the sinner) with bonds notmade of rope; may the wrath ofVaruṇapass away from us; mayIndraprepare for us a spacious region.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒तं नो॑ य॒ज्ञं वि॒दथे॑षु॒ चारुं॑ कृ॒तं ब्रह्मा॑णि सू॒रिषु॑ प्रश॒स्ता । उपो॑ र॒यिर्दे॒वजू॑तो न एतु॒ प्र ण॑: स्पा॒र्हाभि॑रू॒तिभि॑स्तिरेतम्
shlokas.transliteration: kṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ cā́rum ǀ kṛtám ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ sūríṣu ǀ pra-śastā́ ǀúpo íti ǀ rayíḥ ǀ devá-jūtaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ etu ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ spārhā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ tiretam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Render the sacrifices offered inour dwelling fruitful, the prayers uttered by the worshippers successful;may riches come to us sent by the gods; do you two give us increase by you desirable protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे इ॑न्द्रावरुणा वि॒श्ववा॑रं र॒यिं ध॑त्तं॒ वसु॑मन्तं पुरु॒क्षुम् । प्र य आ॑दि॒त्यो अनृ॑ता मि॒नात्यमि॑ता॒ शूरो॑ दयते॒ वसू॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ rayím ǀ dhattam ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ ánṛtā ǀ minā́ti ǀ ámitā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vásūni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,IndraandVaruṇa, riches desirable to all, together with a dwelling and abundant food,for the hero,Āditya, who punishes beings devoid of truth, gives (to the devout) unbounded treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यमिन्द्रं॒ वरु॑णमष्ट मे॒ गीः प्राव॑त्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ तूतु॑जाना । सु॒रत्ना॑सो दे॒ववी॑तिं गमेम यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ índram ǀ váruṇam ǀ aṣṭa ǀ me ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ tū́tujānā ǀsu-rátnāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītim ǀ gamema ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this my praise reachIndraandVaruṇa, and, earnestly offered (by me), preserve sons andgrandsons; let us, possessed of affluence, present (their) food to the gods; and do you, (duties), ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒नी॒षे वा॑मर॒क्षसं॑ मनी॒षां सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ वरु॑णाय॒ जुह्व॑त् । घृ॒तप्र॑तीकामु॒षसं॒ न दे॒वीं ता नो॒ याम॑न्नुरुष्यताम॒भीके॑
shlokas.transliteration: punīṣé ǀ vām ǀ arakṣásam ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ júhvat ǀghṛtá-pratīkām ǀ uṣásam ǀ ná ǀ devī́m ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ uruṣyatām ǀ abhī́ke ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer to you both adoration, uninterrupted byrākṣasas, presenting theSomatoIndraand toVaruṇa,-- (adoration), of which the members are radiant as the celestial dawn; may these two protect us at the time ofgoing to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्पर्ध॑न्ते॒ वा उ॑ देव॒हूये॒ अत्र॒ येषु॑ ध्व॒जेषु॑ दि॒द्यव॒: पत॑न्ति । यु॒वं ताँ इ॑न्द्रावरुणाव॒मित्रा॑न्ह॒तं परा॑च॒: शर्वा॒ विषू॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: spárdhante ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ deva-hū́ye ǀ átra ǀ yéṣu ǀ dhvajéṣu ǀ didyávaḥ ǀ pátanti ǀyuvám ǀ tā́n ǀ indrāvaruṇau ǀ amítrān ǀ hatám ǀ párācaḥ ǀ śárvā ǀ víṣūcaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the conflict where (combatants) strive against us, in those (contests) in which bright (weapons) fallupon the banners, do you two,IndraandVaruṇa, slay with your shaft those enemies who have been routed, andare scattered in various directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑श्चि॒द्धि स्वय॑शस॒: सद॑स्सु दे॒वीरिन्द्रं॒ वरु॑णं दे॒वता॒ धुः । कृ॒ष्टीर॒न्यो धा॒रय॑ति॒ प्रवि॑क्ता वृ॒त्राण्य॒न्यो अ॑प्र॒तीनि॑ हन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ svá-yaśasaḥ ǀ sádaḥ-su ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ váruṇam ǀ devátā ǀ dhúríti dhúḥ ǀkṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ dhāráyati ǀ prá-viktāḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ anyáḥ ǀ apratī́ni ǀ hanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSoma, flowing like water, self-renowned, (offered) at religious assemblies, supoortIndraandVaruṇa; of whom one regulates mankind, distinguished (as good or bad), and the other slays unresisted foeṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॒क्रतु॑ॠत॒चिद॑स्तु॒ होता॒ य आ॑दित्य॒ शव॑सा वां॒ नम॑स्वान् । आ॒व॒वर्त॒दव॑से वां ह॒विष्मा॒नस॒दित्स सु॑वि॒ताय॒ प्रय॑स्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ ṛta-cít ǀ astu ǀ hótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ādityā ǀ śávasā ǀ vām ǀ námasvān ǀā-vavártat ǀ ávase ǀ vām ǀ havíṣmān ǀ ásat ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ práyasvān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the devout worshipper derive benefit from sacrifice when offering adoration to you both, sons ofAditi (involved) with strength; he who, liberal of oblations invites you for your satisfaction, may he, possessingabundance, be in the enjoyment of happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यमिन्द्रं॒ वरु॑णमष्ट मे॒ गीः प्राव॑त्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ तूतु॑जाना । सु॒रत्ना॑सो दे॒ववी॑तिं गमेम यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ índram ǀ váruṇam ǀ aṣṭa ǀ me ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ tū́tujānā ǀsu-rátnāsaḥ ǀ devá-vītim ǀ gamema ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this my praise reachIndraandVaruṇa; and earnestly offered (by me), preserve sons andgrandsons; let us, possessed of affluence, present (their) food to the gods; and do you, (deities), ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धीरा॒ त्व॑स्य महि॒ना ज॒नूंषि॒ वि यस्त॒स्तम्भ॒ रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी । प्र नाक॑मृ॒ष्वं नु॑नुदे बृ॒हन्तं॑ द्वि॒ता नक्ष॑त्रं प॒प्रथ॑च्च॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhī́rā ǀ tú ǀ asya ǀ mahinā́ ǀ janū́ṃṣi ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ tastámbha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ cit ǀ urvī́ íti ǀprá ǀ nā́kam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ nunude ǀ bṛhántam ǀ dvitā́ ǀ nákṣatram ǀ papráthat ǀ ca ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Permanent in greatness are the births of thatVaruṇawho propped up the vast heaven and earth, whoappointed to (their) two-fold (task) the glorious sun and beautiful constellations, who spread out the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्वया॑ त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ सं व॑दे॒ तत्क॒दा न्व१॒॑न्तर्वरु॑णे भुवानि । किं मे॑ ह॒व्यमहृ॑णानो जुषेत क॒दा मृ॑ळी॒कं सु॒मना॑ अ॒भि ख्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sváyā ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sám ǀ vade ǀ tát ǀ kadā́ ǀ nú ǀ antáḥ ǀ váruṇe ǀ bhuvāni ǀkím ǀ me ǀ havyám ǀ áhṛṇānaḥ ǀ juṣeta ǀ kadā́ ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ khyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When may I in my person n converse with the deity? When may I (be admitted) to the heart ofVaruṇa?By what means may he, without displeasure, accept my oblation? When may I, rejoicing in mind, behold thatgiver of felicity?”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒च्छे तदेनो॑ वरुण दि॒दृक्षूपो॑ एमि चिकि॒तुषो॑ वि॒पृच्छ॑म् । स॒मा॒नमिन्मे॑ क॒वय॑श्चिदाहुर॒यं ह॒ तुभ्यं॒ वरु॑णो हृणीते
shlokas.transliteration: pṛcché ǀ tát ǀ énaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ didṛ́kṣu ǀ úpo íti ǀ emi ǀ cikitúṣaḥ ǀ vi-pṛ́ccham ǀsamānám ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ āhuḥ ǀ ayám ǀ ha ǀ túbhyam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ hṛṇīte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of beholding you,Varuṇa, I inquire what is my offence; I have gone to make inquiry of thewise; the sages verily have said the same thing to me: -- this Varuṇa is displeased with you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमाग॑ आस वरुण॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यत्स्तो॒तारं॒ जिघां॑ससि॒ सखा॑यम् । प्र तन्मे॑ वोचो दूळभ स्वधा॒वोऽव॑ त्वाने॒ना नम॑सा तु॒र इ॑याम्
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ āsa ǀ varuṇa ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ yát ǀ stotā́ram ǀ jíghāṃsasi ǀ sákhāyam ǀprá ǀ tát ǀ me ǀ vocaḥ ǀ duḥ-dabha ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ áva ǀ tvā ǀ anenā́ḥ ǀ námasā ǀ turáḥ ǀ iyām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What has that great wickedness been,Varuṇa, that you should seek to destroy the worshiper, yourfriend? Insuperable, resplendent Varuṇa, declare it to me, so that, freed from sin, I may quick approach you withveneration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ द्रु॒ग्धानि॒ पित्र्या॑ सृजा॒ नोऽव॒ या व॒यं च॑कृ॒मा त॒नूभि॑: । अव॑ राजन्पशु॒तृपं॒ न ता॒युं सृ॒जा व॒त्सं न दाम्नो॒ वसि॑ष्ठम्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ drugdhā́ni ǀ pítryā ǀ sṛja ǀ naḥ ǀ áva ǀ yā́ ǀ vayám ǀ cakṛmá ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀáva ǀ rājan ǀ paśu-tṛ́pam ǀ ná ǀ tāyúm ǀ sṛjá ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ dā́mnaḥ ǀ vásiṣṭham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Relax (the bonds) imosed by all the ill deeds of our fore-fathers, and those incurred (by the sins) whichwe have committed in our person ns; liberate, royalVaruṇa, like a calf from its tether,Vasiṣṭhalike a thiefnourishing the animal (he has stolen).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न स स्वो दक्षो॑ वरुण॒ ध्रुति॒: सा सुरा॑ म॒न्युर्वि॒भीद॑को॒ अचि॑त्तिः । अस्ति॒ ज्याया॒न्कनी॑यस उपा॒रे स्वप्न॑श्च॒नेदनृ॑तस्य प्रयो॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ dhrútiḥ ǀ sā́ ǀ súrā ǀ manyúḥ ǀ vi-bhī́dakaḥ ǀ ácittiḥ ǀásti ǀ jyā́yān ǀ kánīyasaḥ ǀ upa-aré ǀ svápnaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ít ǀ ánṛtasya ǀ pra-yotā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It is not our own choice,Varuṇa, not our condition, (that is the cause of our sinning); it is that which isintoxication, wrath, gambling, ignorance; there is a senior in the proximity of the junior; even a dream is aprovocation to sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरं॑ दा॒सो न मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ कराण्य॒हं दे॒वाय॒ भूर्ण॒येऽना॑गाः । अचे॑तयद॒चितो॑ दे॒वो अ॒र्यो गृत्सं॑ रा॒ये क॒वित॑रो जुनाति
shlokas.transliteration: áram ǀ dāsáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ karāṇi ǀ ahám ǀ devā́ya ǀ bhū́rṇaye ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀácetayat ǀ acítaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ gṛ́tsam ǀ rāyé ǀ kaví-taraḥ ǀ junāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberated from sin, I may perform diligent service, like a slave, to the divine showerer (of benefits), thesustainer of the world; may he, the divine lord, give intelligence to us who are devoid of understanding; may hewho is most wise, guide the worshipper to wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सु तुभ्यं॑ वरुण स्वधावो हृ॒दि स्तोम॒ उप॑श्रितश्चिदस्तु । शं न॒: क्षेमे॒ शमु॒ योगे॑ नो अस्तु यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sú ǀ túbhyam ǀ varuṇa ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ hṛdí ǀ stómaḥ ǀ úpa-śritaḥ ǀ cit ǀ astu ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣéme ǀ śám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ yóge ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this laudation, food-conferringVaruṇa, be taken to your heart; may success be ours in retainingwhat we have, and in acquiring more; and do you, (deities), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रद॑त्प॒थो वरु॑ण॒: सूर्या॑य॒ प्रार्णां॑सि समु॒द्रिया॑ न॒दीना॑म् । सर्गो॒ न सृ॒ष्टो अर्व॑तीॠता॒यञ्च॒कार॑ म॒हीर॒वनी॒रह॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: rádat ǀ patháḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ prá ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ samudríyā ǀ nadī́nām ǀsárgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sṛṣṭáḥ ǀ árvatīḥ ǀ ṛta-yán ǀ cakā́ra ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ avánīḥ ǀ áha-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇaprepared a path for the sun; he set free the waters of the rivers genitive rated in the firmament;hastening (to his task), as a horse let loose rushes to (a flock of) mares, he divided the great nights from thedays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒त्मा ते॒ वातो॒ रज॒ आ न॑वीनोत्प॒शुर्न भूर्णि॒र्यव॑से सस॒वान् । अ॒न्तर्म॒ही बृ॑ह॒ती रोद॑सी॒मे विश्वा॑ ते॒ धाम॑ वरुण प्रि॒याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ātmā́ ǀ te ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ navīnot ǀ paśúḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́rṇiḥ ǀ yávase ǀ sasa-vā́n ǀantáḥ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ imé íti ǀ víśvā ǀ te ǀ dhā́ma ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your spirit is the wind; he sends abroad the waters; he, the cherisher of the world, is the feeder on(ssacrificial) food, like an animal upon fodder; all your glories,Varuṇa, manifested between the vast andspacious heaven and earth, give delight (to all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ स्पशो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ स्मदि॑ष्टा उ॒भे प॑श्यन्ति॒ रोद॑सी सु॒मेके॑ । ऋ॒तावा॑नः क॒वयो॑ य॒ज्ञधी॑रा॒: प्रचे॑तसो॒ य इ॒षय॑न्त॒ मन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ smát-iṣṭāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ paśyanti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ suméke íti su-méke ǀṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ yajñá-dhīrāḥ ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ iṣáyanta ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The excellent spies ofVaruṇabehold the beautiful heaven and earth, as well as those (men) who, thecelebrators of rites, constant in sacrifice, wise and intelligent address (to him their) praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒वाच॑ मे॒ वरु॑णो॒ मेधि॑राय॒ त्रिः स॒प्त नामाघ्न्या॑ बिभर्ति । वि॒द्वान्प॒दस्य॒ गुह्या॒ न वो॑चद्यु॒गाय॒ विप्र॒ उप॑राय॒ शिक्ष॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: uvā́ca ǀ me ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ médhirāya ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ nā́ma ǀ ághnyā ǀ bibharti ǀvidvā́n ǀ padásya ǀ gúhyā ǀ ná ǀ vocat ǀ yugā́ya ǀ vípraḥ ǀ úparāya ǀ śíkṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Varuṇathus spoke to me, possessed of understanding; the cow (speech) has thrice sevenappellations; the wise and intelligent Varuṇa, giving instrumental uction to me, his worthy disciple, had declared themysteries of the plural ce (ofBrahma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो द्यावो॒ निहि॑ता अ॒न्तर॑स्मिन्ति॒स्रो भूमी॒रुप॑रा॒: षड्वि॑धानाः । गृत्सो॒ राजा॒ वरु॑णश्चक्र ए॒तं दि॒वि प्रे॒ङ्खं हि॑र॒ण्ययं॑ शु॒भे कम्
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ ní-hitāḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ asmin ǀ tisráḥ ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ úparāḥ ǀ ṣáṭ-vidhānāḥ ǀgṛ́tsaḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ cakre ǀ etám ǀ diví ǀ pra-īṅkhám ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ śubhé ǀ kám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In him are deposited the three heavens, the three earths with their six seasons are shown in him; themost adorable, royalVaruṇahas made this golden sun undulating in the sky, he has made it to diffuse light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ सिन्धुं॒ वरु॑णो॒ द्यौरि॑व स्थाद्द्र॒प्सो न श्वे॒तो मृ॒गस्तुवि॑ष्मान् । ग॒म्भी॒रशं॑सो॒ रज॑सो वि॒मान॑: सुपा॒रक्ष॑त्रः स॒तो अ॒स्य राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ síndhum ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dyáuḥ-iva ǀ sthāt ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śvetáḥ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀgambhīrá-śaṃsaḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ supārá-kṣatraḥ ǀ satáḥ ǀ asyá ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Radiant) as the sun,Varuṇaplural ced the ocean (in its bed) white as a drop (of water), vigorous as anantelope, objects of profound praise, distributor of water, the powerful transporter beyond sin, the ruler of thisexisting (world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मृ॒ळया॑ति च॒क्रुषे॑ चि॒दागो॑ व॒यं स्या॑म॒ वरु॑णे॒ अना॑गाः । अनु॑ व्र॒तान्यदि॑तेॠ॒धन्तो॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ mṛḷáyāti ǀ cakrúṣe ǀ cit ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ váruṇe ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀánu ǀ vratā́ni ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛdhántaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be free from sin against thatVaruṇa, who has compassion upon him who commits offence, wewho are duly observing the rites of the sonAditi; and do you, (gods), ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शु॒न्ध्युवं॒ वरु॑णाय॒ प्रेष्ठां॑ म॒तिं व॑सिष्ठ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ भरस्व । य ई॑म॒र्वाञ्चं॒ कर॑ते॒ यज॑त्रं स॒हस्रा॑मघं॒ वृष॑णं बृ॒हन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śundhyúvam ǀ váruṇāya ǀ préṣṭhām ǀ matím ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ bharasva ǀyáḥ ǀ īm ǀ arvā́ñcam ǀ kárate ǀ yájatram ǀ sahásra-magham ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ bṛhántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer pure and acceptable praise,Vasiṣṭhato the showerer,Varuṇa, he who makes the adorable(sun), the donor of thousands, the showerer (of benefits), the vast, manifest before (us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ न्व॑स्य सं॒दृशं॑ जग॒न्वान॒ग्नेरनी॑कं॒ वरु॑णस्य मंसि । स्व१॒॑र्यदश्म॑न्नधि॒पा उ॒ अन्धो॒ऽभि मा॒ वपु॑र्दृ॒शये॑ निनीयात्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ sam-dṛ́śam ǀ jaganvā́n ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ánīkam ǀ váruṇasya ǀ maṃsi ǀsváḥ ǀ yát ǀ áśman ǀ adhi-pā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ mā ǀ vápuḥ ǀ dṛśáye ǀ ninīyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hastening into his sight, may I (worthily) glorify the aggregated radiance ofVaruṇa, when he is theimbiber of the exhilarating beverage (expressed) by the stones; may he render my person n of goodly aspect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्रु॒हाव॒ वरु॑णश्च॒ नावं॒ प्र यत्स॑मु॒द्रमी॒रया॑व॒ मध्य॑म् । अधि॒ यद॒पां स्नुभि॒श्चरा॑व॒ प्र प्रे॒ङ्ख ई॑ङ्खयावहै शु॒भे कम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ ruhā́va ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ca ǀ nā́vam ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ samudrám ǀ īráyāva ǀ mádhyam ǀádhi ǀ yát ǀ apā́m ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ cárāva ǀ prá ǀ pra-īṅkhé ǀ īṅkhayāvahai ǀ śubhé ǀ kám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (I,Vasiṣṭha) andVaruṇaascend the ship together when we send it forth into the midst of theocean, when we proceed over the waters with swift (sailing vessels), then may we both undulate happily in theprosperous swing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसि॑ष्ठं ह॒ वरु॑णो ना॒व्याधा॒दृषिं॑ चकार॒ स्वपा॒ महो॑भिः । स्तो॒तारं॒ विप्र॑: सुदिन॒त्वे अह्नां॒ यान्नु द्याव॑स्त॒तन॒न्यादु॒षास॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vásiṣṭham ǀ ha ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ nāví ǀ ā́ ǀ adhāt ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ cakāra ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀstotā́ram ǀ vípraḥ ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀ yā́t ǀ nú ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ tatánan ǀ yā́t ǀ uṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SoVaruṇaplural cedVasiṣṭhain the ship, and by his mighty protection made the ṛṣi a doer of goodworks; the wise Varuṇa plural ced his worshipper in a fortunate day of days, he extended the passing days, thepassing nights.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ त्यानि॑ नौ स॒ख्या ब॑भूवु॒: सचा॑वहे॒ यद॑वृ॒कं पु॒रा चि॑त् । बृ॒हन्तं॒ मानं॑ वरुण स्वधावः स॒हस्र॑द्वारं जगमा गृ॒हं ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ tyā́ni ǀ nau ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ babhūvuḥ ǀ sácāvahe íti ǀ yát ǀ avṛkám ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀbṛhántam ǀ mā́nam ǀ varuṇa ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ sahásra-dvāram ǀ jagama ǀ gṛhám ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What has become of those our ancient friendships? Let us preserve them unimpaired as of old;food-bestowingVaruṇa, may I go to your vast comprehensive thousand-doored dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॒पिर्नित्यो॑ वरुण प्रि॒यः सन्त्वामागां॑सि कृ॒णव॒त्सखा॑ ते । मा त॒ एन॑स्वन्तो यक्षिन्भुजेम य॒न्धि ष्मा॒ विप्र॑: स्तुव॒ते वरू॑थम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sán ǀ tvā́m ǀ ā́gāṃsi ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ sákhā ǀ te ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ énasvantaḥ ǀ yakṣin ǀ bhujema ǀ yandhí ǀ sma ǀ vípraḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ várūtham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he your unvarying kin, who was ever dear, though committing offences against you, still be yourfriend; adorableVaruṇa, offending you, let us not enjoy (happiness); but do you, who are wise, bestow on yourworshipper a secure abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ध्रु॒वासु॑ त्वा॒सु क्षि॒तिषु॑ क्षि॒यन्तो॒ व्य१॒॑स्मत्पाशं॒ वरु॑णो मुमोचत् । अवो॑ वन्वा॒ना अदि॑तेरु॒पस्था॑द्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: dhruvā́su ǀ tvā ǀ āsú ǀ kṣitíṣu ǀ kṣiyántaḥ ǀ ví ǀ asmát ǀ pā́śam ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mumocat ǀávaḥ ǀ vanvānā́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ upá-sthāt ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “While dwelling in these durable worlds, mayVaruṇaloose our bonds; may we be enjoyers of theprotection (which has been given by him) from the lap ofAditi, and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessingṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु व॑रुण मृ॒न्मयं॑ गृ॒हं रा॑जन्न॒हं ग॑मम् । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ varuṇa ǀ mṛt-máyam ǀ gṛhám ǀ rājan ǀ ahám ǀ gamam ǀmṛḷá ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I never go, royalVaruṇa, to a house made of clay; grant me happiness, possessor of wealth, grantme happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदेमि॑ प्रस्फु॒रन्नि॑व॒ दृति॒र्न ध्मा॒तो अ॑द्रिवः । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ émi ǀ prasphurán-iva ǀ dṛ́tiḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhmātáḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀmṛḷá ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Varuṇa, I am throbbing as if (with awe) like an inflated skin, grant me happiness, possessor ofwealth, grant me happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्व॑: समह दी॒नता॑ प्रती॒पं ज॑गमा शुचे । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑
shlokas.transliteration: krátvaḥ ǀ samaha ǀ dīnátā ǀ prati-īpám ǀ jagama ǀ śuce ǀmṛḷá ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Opulent and pure (Varuṇa), if through infirmity I have done what is contrary (to the law), yet grant mehappiness, possessor of wealth, grant me happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पां मध्ये॑ तस्थि॒वांसं॒ तृष्णा॑विदज्जरि॒तार॑म् । मृ॒ळा सु॑क्षत्र मृ॒ळय॑
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ mádhye ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀ tṛ́ṣṇā ǀ avidat ǀ jaritā́ram ǀmṛḷá ǀ su-kṣatra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thirst distresses (me) your worshipper in the midst of the waters; grant me happiness, possessor ofwealth, grant me happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्किं चे॒दं व॑रुण॒ दैव्ये॒ जने॑ऽभिद्रो॒हं म॑नु॒ष्या॒३॒॑श्चरा॑मसि । अचि॑त्ती॒ यत्तव॒ धर्मा॑ युयोपि॒म मा न॒स्तस्मा॒देन॑सो देव रीरिषः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ kím ǀ ca ǀ idám ǀ varuṇa ǀ dáivye ǀ jáne ǀ abhi-drohám ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǀ cárāmasi ǀácittī ǀ yát ǀ táva ǀ dhárma ǀ yuyopimá ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tásmāt ǀ énasaḥ ǀ deva ǀ ririṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever the offence which we men commitVaruṇaagainst divine beings, whatever law of yours wemay through ignorance violate, do not you, divine Varuṇa, punish us on account of that iniquity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वी॑र॒या शुच॑यो दद्रिरे वामध्व॒र्युभि॒र्मधु॑मन्तः सु॒तास॑: । वह॑ वायो नि॒युतो॑ या॒ह्यच्छा॒ पिबा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सो॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vīra-yā́ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dadrire ǀ vām ǀ adhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀváha ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ áccha ǀ píba ǀ sutásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sweet and pureSomais offered to you, the heroVāyu, by the priests; therefore, harness yourNiyut steeds, come hither and drink of effused Soma for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒शा॒नाय॒ प्रहु॑तिं॒ यस्त॒ आन॒ट् छुचिं॒ सोमं॑ शुचिपा॒स्तुभ्यं॑ वायो । कृ॒णोषि॒ तं मर्त्ये॑षु प्रश॒स्तं जा॒तोजा॑तो जायते वा॒ज्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: īśānā́ya ǀ prá-hutim ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ śúcim ǀ sómam ǀ śuci-pāḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ vāyo íti ǀkṛṇóṣi ǀ tám ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ pra-śastám ǀ jātáḥ-jātaḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ vājī́ ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker of theSoma,Vāyu, you elevate him who among mortals offers to you who are the lord anexcellent oblation, the pure Soma; repeatedly born, he is born for the acquisition of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒ये नु यं ज॒ज्ञतू॒ रोद॑सी॒मे रा॒ये दे॒वी धि॒षणा॑ धाति दे॒वम् । अध॑ वा॒युं नि॒युत॑: सश्चत॒ स्वा उ॒त श्वे॒तं वसु॑धितिं निरे॒के
shlokas.transliteration: rāyé ǀ nú ǀ yám ǀ jajñátuḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ imé íti ǀ rāyé ǀ devī́ ǀ dhiṣáṇā ǀ dhāti ǀ devám ǀádha ǀ vāyúm ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ saścata ǀ svā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ śvetám ǀ vásu-dhitim ǀ nireké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His ownNiyutsteeds bear to the plural ce of poverty the white- complexioned dispenser of wealth,Vāyu,whom heaven and earth bore for the sake of riches, whom the divine language of praise sustains as a deity forthe sake of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छन्नु॒षस॑: सु॒दिना॑ अरि॒प्रा उ॒रु ज्योति॑र्विविदु॒र्दीध्या॑नाः । गव्यं॑ चिदू॒र्वमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रु॒स्तेषा॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिव॑: सस्रु॒राप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ucchán ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ su-dínāḥ ǀ ariprā́ḥ ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ vividuḥ ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀgávyam ǀ cit ǀ ūrvám ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavruḥ ǀ téṣām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sasruḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The blameless dawns (ushering) bright days have broken, and, shining radiantly, (theAṅgirasas) haveobtained the vast light (the sun); desirous (to recover it) they have obtained their wealth of cattle and the ancientwaters have subsequently issued for their good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते स॒त्येन॒ मन॑सा॒ दीध्या॑ना॒: स्वेन॑ यु॒क्तास॒: क्रतु॑ना वहन्ति । इन्द्र॑वायू वीर॒वाहं॒ रथं॑ वामीशा॒नयो॑र॒भि पृक्ष॑: सचन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ satyéna ǀ mánasā ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀ svéna ǀ yuktā́saḥ ǀ krátunā ǀ vahanti ǀíndravāyū íti ǀ vīra-vā́ham ǀ rátham ǀ vām ǀ īśānáyoḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pṛ́kṣaḥ ǀ sacante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (worshippers) illustrious by sincere adoration, assiduous in the discharge of their own duties,bring to you,IndraandVāyu, a hero-bearing chariot, and present to you, two soverigns, (sacrificial) fooḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒शा॒नासो॒ ये दध॑ते॒ स्व॑र्णो॒ गोभि॒रश्वे॑भि॒र्वसु॑भि॒र्हिर॑ण्यैः । इन्द्र॑वायू सू॒रयो॒ विश्व॒मायु॒रर्व॑द्भिर्वी॒रैः पृत॑नासु सह्युः
shlokas.transliteration: īśānā́saḥ ǀ yé ǀ dádhate ǀ sváḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ híraṇyaiḥ ǀíndravāyū íti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sahyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those munificent princes who confer upon us prosperity by gifts of cattle, horses, treasure, gold,overcome,IndraandVāyu, the entire existence (of their enemies) in contests with horses and with heroeṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्व॑न्तो॒ न श्रव॑सो॒ भिक्ष॑माणा इन्द्रवा॒यू सु॑ष्टु॒तिभि॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः । वा॒ज॒यन्त॒: स्वव॑से हुवेम यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: árvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀ indravāyū́ íti ǀ sustutí-bhiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀvāja-yántaḥ ǀ sú ǀ ávase ǀ huvema ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We,Vasiṣṭha, (bearing oblation) like horses (bearing burdens), soliciting food, desiring strength,invoke with praisesIndraandVāyufor (our) sure defence; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विद॒ङ्ग नम॑सा॒ ये वृ॒धास॑: पु॒रा दे॒वा अ॑नव॒द्यास॒ आस॑न् । ते वा॒यवे॒ मन॑वे बाधि॒तायावा॑सयन्नु॒षसं॒ सूर्ये॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ námasā ǀ yé ǀ vṛdhā́saḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ anavadyā́saḥ ǀ ā́san ǀté ǀ vāyáve ǀ mánave ǀ bādhitā́ya ǀ ávāsayan ǀ uṣásam ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those venerable worshippers, who by prompted and frequently (adoringVāyu) with reverence wereformerly free from reproach, have now illumined Uṣas and the sun for sacrificing to Vāyu and (the preservationof) embarrassed mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शन्ता॑ दू॒ता न दभा॑य गो॒पा मा॒सश्च॑ पा॒थः श॒रद॑श्च पू॒र्वीः । इन्द्र॑वायू सुष्टु॒तिर्वा॑मिया॒ना मा॑र्डी॒कमी॑ट्टे सुवि॒तं च॒ नव्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: uśántā ǀ dūtā́ ǀ ná ǀ dábhāya ǀ gopā́ ǀ māsáḥ ǀ ca ǀ pātháḥ ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀíndravāyū íti ǀ su-stutíḥ ǀ vām ǀ iyānā́ ǀ mārḍīkám ǀ īṭṭe ǀ suvitám ǀ ca ǀ návyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring (adoration), proceeding (in the sky), preservers of mankind, be not disposed,IndraandVāyu,to do us harm; protect us through many months and years; our sincere praise, addressed to you both, solicitshappiness and excellent wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पीवो॑अन्नाँ रयि॒वृध॑: सुमे॒धाः श्वे॒तः सि॑षक्ति नि॒युता॑मभि॒श्रीः । ते वा॒यवे॒ सम॑नसो॒ वि त॑स्थु॒र्विश्वेन्नर॑: स्वप॒त्यानि॑ चक्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: pī́vaḥ-annān ǀ rayi-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ śvetáḥ ǀ sisakti ǀ ni-yútām ǀ abhi-śrī́ḥ ǀté ǀ vāyáve ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthuḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ náraḥ ǀ su-apatyā́ni ǀ cakruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The white-complexionedVāyu, intelligent, glorious with theNiyutsteeds, favours those men who arewell fed, abounding in riches, for they with one mind stand everywhere, ready to (worship) him, and leaders ofrites, they perform all the ceremonies, that are productive of excellent offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याव॒त्तर॑स्त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ याव॒दोजो॒ याव॒न्नर॒श्चक्ष॑सा॒ दीध्या॑नाः । शुचिं॒ सोमं॑ शुचिपा पातम॒स्मे इन्द्र॑वायू॒ सद॑तं ब॒र्हिरेदम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́vat ǀ táraḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ yā́vat ǀ ójaḥ ǀ yā́vat ǀ náraḥ ǀ cákṣasā ǀ dī́dhyānāḥ ǀśúcim ǀ sómam ǀ śuci-pā ǀ pātam ǀ asmé íti ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ sádatam ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ idám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As much as is your rapidity of body, as much as is your vigour, as much as the leaders (of rites) areilluminated by wisdom, (to such extent), drinkers of the pure (Soma)IndraandVaruṇa., drink this our pure Soma,and sit down upon this sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒यु॒वा॒ना नि॒युत॑: स्पा॒र्हवी॑रा॒ इन्द्र॑वायू स॒रथं॑ यातम॒र्वाक् । इ॒दं हि वां॒ प्रभृ॑तं॒ मध्वो॒ अग्र॒मध॑ प्रीणा॒ना वि मु॑मुक्तम॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: ni-yuvānā́ ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ spārhá-vīrāḥ ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yātam ǀ arvā́k ǀidám ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ prá-bhṛtam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ágram ǀ ádha ǀ prīṇānā́ ǀ ví ǀ mumuktam ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Harnessing theNiyuts, whom the devout (worshippers) desire, to your common car, come,IndraandVāyu, hither; this the first (cup) of the sweetSomais prepared for you; and then, delighted (by the draught),liberate us (from sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वां॑ श॒तं नि॒युतो॒ याः स॒हस्र॒मिन्द्र॑वायू वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒: सच॑न्ते । आभि॑र्यातं सुवि॒दत्रा॑भिर॒र्वाक्पा॒तं न॑रा॒ प्रति॑भृतस्य॒ मध्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ vām ǀ śatám ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ viśvá-vārāḥ ǀ sácante ǀā́ ǀ ābhiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ su-vidátrābhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ pātám ǀ narā ǀ práti-bhṛtasya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to our presence,IndraandVāyu, with those munificentNiyutsteeds, who, the desired of all,wait upon you both by hundreds and thousands; drink, leaders (of rites), of the sweetSomaplural ced near (thealtar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्व॑न्तो॒ न श्रव॑सो॒ भिक्ष॑माणा इन्द्रवा॒यू सु॑ष्टु॒तिभि॒र्वसि॑ष्ठाः । वा॒ज॒यन्त॒: स्वव॑से हुवेम यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: árvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ bhíkṣamāṇāḥ ǀ indravāyū́ íti ǀ sustutí-bhiḥ ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀvāja-yántaḥ ǀ sú ǀ ávase ǀ huvema ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We,Vasiṣṭhas(bearing oblations) like horses (bearing burdens), soliciting food, desiring strength,invoke with praisesIndraandVāyufor our sure defence; do you ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑यो भूष शुचिपा॒ उप॑ नः स॒हस्रं॑ ते नि॒युतो॑ विश्ववार । उपो॑ ते॒ अन्धो॒ मद्य॑मयामि॒ यस्य॑ देव दधि॒षे पू॑र्व॒पेय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ bhūṣa ǀ śuci-pāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ te ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀ viśva-vāra ǀúpo íti ǀ te ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ mádyam ǀ ayāmi ǀ yásya ǀ deva ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ pūrva-péyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drinker of the pure (Soma),Vāyu, come to us as yourNiyutare thousands; oḥ, you who are desired ofall, I offer you, the exhilarating (sacrificial) food, of which you, deity, have the prior drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोता॑ जी॒रो अ॑ध्व॒रेष्व॑स्था॒त्सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॒ पिब॑ध्यै । प्र यद्वां॒ मध्वो॑ अग्रि॒यं भर॑न्त्यध्व॒र्यवो॑ देव॒यन्त॒: शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sótā ǀ jīráḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ asthāt ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ píbadhyai ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ agriyám ǀ bháranti ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prompt effuser of the libation offers theSomatoIndraand toVāyuto drink at the sacrifices, atwhich devout priests, according to their functions, bring to you two the first (portion) of the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र याभि॒र्यासि॑ दा॒श्वांस॒मच्छा॑ नि॒युद्भि॑र्वायवि॒ष्टये॑ दुरो॒णे । नि नो॑ र॒यिं सु॒भोज॑सं युवस्व॒ नि वी॒रं गव्य॒मश्व्यं॑ च॒ राध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǀ áccha ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ duroṇé ǀní ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ su-bhójasam ǀ yuvasva ǀ ní ǀ vīrám ǀ gávyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ ca ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With thoseNiyutsteeds, with which you go,Vāyu, to the donor (of the libation), waiting in this hall tooffer sacrifice, (come to us), and bestow upon us enjoyable riches, bestowmaleprogeny, and wealth,comprehending cattle, and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये वा॒यव॑ इन्द्र॒माद॑नास॒ आदे॑वासो नि॒तोश॑नासो अ॒र्यः । घ्नन्तो॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ सू॒रिभि॑: ष्याम सास॒ह्वांसो॑ यु॒धा नृभि॑र॒मित्रा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ vāyáve ǀ indra-mā́danāsaḥ ǀ ā́-devāsaḥ ǀ ni-tóśanāsaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ syāma ǀ sasahvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ amítrān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overcoming our enemies in war by our warriors, may we be the slayers of foes, through the pious(worshippers) who are the exhilarators ofIndraandVāyu, the reciters of divine hymns, the destroyers of theadversary.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ नि॒युद्भि॑: श॒तिनी॑भिरध्व॒रं स॑ह॒स्रिणी॑भि॒रुप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञम् । वायो॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सव॑ने मादयस्व यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ śatínībhiḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ sahasríṇībhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ yajñám ǀvā́yo íti ǀ asmín ǀ sávane ǀ mādayasva ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ComeVāyu, to our imperishable sacrifice, with hundreds and thousands ofNiyutsteeds, and beexhilarated at this ceremony; do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचिं॒ नु स्तोमं॒ नव॑जातम॒द्येन्द्रा॑ग्नी वृत्रहणा जु॒षेथा॑म् । उ॒भा हि वां॑ सु॒हवा॒ जोह॑वीमि॒ ता वाजं॑ स॒द्य उ॑श॒ते धेष्ठा॑
shlokas.transliteration: śúcim ǀ nú ǀ stómam ǀ náva-jātam ǀ adyá ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ vṛtra-hanā ǀ juṣéthām ǀubhā́ ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ su-hávā ǀ jóhavīmi ǀ tā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ uśaté ǀ dhéṣṭhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayers of enemies,IndraandAgni, be plural ased today by this pious and newly recited praise; repeatedlydo we invoke you both, who are worthy of invocation; you are the chief bestowers of food promptly upon him whosolicits (it of you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता सा॑न॒सी श॑वसाना॒ हि भू॒तं सा॑कं॒वृधा॒ शव॑सा शूशु॒वांसा॑ । क्षय॑न्तौ रा॒यो यव॑सस्य॒ भूरे॑: पृ॒ङ्क्तं वाज॑स्य॒ स्थवि॑रस्य॒ घृष्वे॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ sānasī́ íti ǀ śavasānā ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ sākam-vṛ́dhā ǀ śávasā ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsā ǀkṣáyantau ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ yávasasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ pṛṅktám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sthávirasya ǀ ghṛ́ṣveḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two are desired of all, the demolishers of (hostile) strength, augmenting together, increasing invigour, lords of the wealth of corn; do you grant us substantial invigorating food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑ ह॒ यद्वि॒दथं॑ वा॒जिनो॒ गुर्धी॒भिर्विप्रा॒: प्रम॑तिमि॒च्छमा॑नाः । अर्व॑न्तो॒ न काष्ठां॒ नक्ष॑माणा इन्द्रा॒ग्नी जोहु॑वतो॒ नर॒स्ते
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ vidátham ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ gúḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ prá-matim ǀ icchámānāḥ ǀárvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kā́ṣṭhām ǀ nákṣamāṇāḥ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ jóhuvataḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ té ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those sage offerers of oblations, who, desiring your favour, celebrate the sacrifice with holy rites,hasten to worship you, like horse to battle, repeatedly invokingIndraandAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गी॒र्भिर्विप्र॒: प्रम॑तिमि॒च्छमा॑न॒ ईट्टे॑ र॒यिं य॒शसं॑ पूर्व॒भाज॑म् । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी वृत्रहणा सुवज्रा॒ प्र नो॒ नव्ये॑भिस्तिरतं दे॒ष्णैः
shlokas.transliteration: gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ prá-matim ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǀ rayím ǀ yaśásam ǀ pūrva-bhā́jam ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ vṛtra-hanā ǀ su-vajrā ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ návyebhiḥ ǀ tiratam ǀ deṣṇáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious sage, desiring your favour, glorifies you with praises for the sake of formerly enjoyed riches,accompanied by celebrity;IndraandAgni, slayers ofVṛtra, bearers of the thunderbolt, exalt us with preciousdonations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यन्म॒ही मि॑थ॒ती स्पर्ध॑माने तनू॒रुचा॒ शूर॑साता॒ यतै॑ते । अदे॑वयुं वि॒दथे॑ देव॒युभि॑: स॒त्रा ह॑तं सोम॒सुता॒ जने॑न
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ mithatī́ íti ǀ spárdhamāne íti ǀ tanū-rúcā ǀ śū́ra-sātā ǀ yátaite íti ǀádeva-yum ǀ vidáthe ǀ devayú-bhiḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ hatam ǀ soma-sútā ǀ jánena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As two large, mutually defiant (armies), emulous in corporal vigour, may contend in war, so do youdestroy, by the devout, those who are not devoted to the gods in sacrifice, and, by the man who presentslibations, (him who does not offer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मामु॒ षु सोम॑सुति॒मुप॑ न॒ एन्द्रा॑ग्नी सौमन॒साय॑ यातम् । नू चि॒द्धि प॑रिम॒म्नाथे॑ अ॒स्माना वां॒ शश्व॑द्भिर्ववृतीय॒ वाजै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ sóma-sutim ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ indrāgnī íti ǀ saumanasā́ya ǀ yātam ǀnú ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ parimamnā́the íti pari-mamnā́the ǀ asmā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ śáśvat-bhiḥ ǀ vavṛtīya ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come with gracious minds,IndraandAgni, to this ourSomalibation; you are never regardless of us,therefore, I propitiate you with constant (sacrificial) viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॑ग्न ए॒ना नम॑सा॒ समि॒द्धोऽच्छा॑ मि॒त्रं वरु॑ण॒मिन्द्रं॑ वोचेः । यत्सी॒माग॑श्चकृ॒मा तत्सु मृ॑ळ॒ तद॑र्य॒मादि॑तिः शिश्रथन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ agne ǀ enā́ ǀ námasā ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ índram ǀ voceḥ ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ tát ǀ sú ǀ mṛḷa ǀ tát ǀ aryamā́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śiśrathantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Kindled,Agni, by this adoration, do you recommend us toMitra,Varuṇa, andIndra; whatever sin wemay have committed, do you expiate, and mayAryaman,Aditi(and Mitra) remove it (from us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता अ॑ग्न आशुषा॒णास॑ इ॒ष्टीर्यु॒वोः सचा॒भ्य॑श्याम॒ वाजा॑न् । मेन्द्रो॑ नो॒ विष्णु॑र्म॒रुत॒: परि॑ ख्यन्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ āśuṣāṇā́saḥ ǀ iṣṭī́ḥ ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ sácā ǀ abhí ǀ aśyāma ǀ vā́jān ǀmā́ ǀ índraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ pári ǀ khyan ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Diligently celebrating these rites, may we,Agni, (andIndra), at once arrive at your food; let not Indra,Viṣ.u, theMaruts, abandon us; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं वा॑म॒स्य मन्म॑न॒ इन्द्रा॑ग्नी पू॒र्व्यस्तु॑तिः । अ॒भ्राद्वृ॒ष्टिरि॑वाजनि
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ vām ǀ asyá ǀ mánmanaḥ ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ pūrvyá-stutiḥ ǀabhrā́t ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ-iva ǀ ajani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This chief praise,IndraandAgni, proceeds (copiously) from me your worshipper, like rain from a cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒णु॒तं ज॑रि॒तुर्हव॒मिन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ वन॑तं॒ गिर॑: । ई॒शा॒ना पि॑प्यतं॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇutám ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ hávam ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ vánatam ǀ gíraḥ ǀīśānā́ ǀ pipyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear,IndraandAgni, the invocation of the worshipper; accept his adoration. Recompense, lords, hispious acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा पा॑प॒त्वाय॑ नो न॒रेन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ माभिश॑स्तये । मा नो॑ रीरधतं नि॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ pāpa-tvā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ narā ǀ índrāgnī íti ǀ mā́ ǀ abhí-śastaye ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rīradhatam ǀ nidé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders of (rites),IndraandAgni, subject us not to wickedness, nor to calumny, nor to the reviler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑ अ॒ग्ना नमो॑ बृ॒हत्सु॑वृ॒क्तिमेर॑यामहे । धि॒या धेना॑ अव॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índre ǀ agnā́ ǀ námaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ su-vṛktím ǀ ā́ ǀ īrayāmahe ǀdhiyā́ ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring protection, we offer copious oblations and praise toIndraandAgni, and prayers with holy rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि शश्व॑न्त॒ ईळ॑त इ॒त्था विप्रा॑स ऊ॒तये॑ । स॒बाधो॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ śáśvantaḥ ǀ ī́ḷate ǀ itthā́ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀsa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many are the sages who propitiate (IndraandAgni) in this manner for (their) protection, mutuallystriving for the acquisition of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॑ गी॒र्भिर्वि॑प॒न्यव॒: प्रय॑स्वन्तो हवामहे । मे॒धसा॑ता सनि॒ष्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀmedhá-sātā ǀ saniṣyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eager to offer praise, bearing (sacrificial) food, desirous of wealth, we invoke you,IndraandAgni, withpraises, in the celebration of holy acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ अव॒सा ग॑तम॒स्मभ्यं॑ चर्षणीसहा । मा नो॑ दु॒:शंस॑ ईशत
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ asmábhyam ǀ carṣaṇi-sahā ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsaḥ ǀ īśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overcomers of (hostile) men,IndraandAgni, come wiḥ food (to be bestowed) upon us; let not themalevolent have power over us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा कस्य॑ नो॒ अर॑रुषो धू॒र्तिः प्रण॒ङ्मर्त्य॑स्य । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ kásya ǀ naḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ práṇak ǀ mártyasya ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not the malice of any hostile mortal reach us; gran us,IndraandAgni, felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोम॒द्धिर॑ण्यव॒द्वसु॒ यद्वा॒मश्वा॑व॒दीम॑हे । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ तद्व॑नेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀ vásu ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ áśva-vat ǀ ī́mahe ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tát ǀ vanemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit you both for wealth, comprising cattle, gold and horses; may we obtain it for you,IndraandAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सोम॒ आ सु॒ते नर॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी अजो॑हवुः । सप्ती॑वन्ता सप॒र्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ sóme ǀ ā́ ǀ suté ǀ náraḥ ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ ájohavuḥ ǀsápti-vantā ǀ saparyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When adoring leaders (of rites), invoke you two, lords of horses, on theSomabeing offered, (comehither).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थेभि॑र्वृत्र॒हन्त॑मा॒ या म॑न्दा॒ना चि॒दा गि॒रा । आ॒ङ्गू॒षैरा॒विवा॑सतः
shlokas.transliteration: ukthébhiḥ ǀ vṛtrahán-tamā ǀ yā́ ǀ mandānā́ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ girā́ ǀāṅgūṣáiḥ ǀ ā-vívāsataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utter destroyers ofVṛtra, exhilarated (by theSoma), you who are worshipped with prayers and hymnsand songs, (come hither).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताविद्दु॒:शंसं॒ मर्त्यं॒ दुर्वि॑द्वांसं रक्ष॒स्विन॑म् । आ॒भो॒गं हन्म॑ना हतमुद॒धिं हन्म॑ना हतम्
shlokas.transliteration: táu ǀ ít ǀ duḥ-śáṃsam ǀ mártyam ǀ dúḥ-vidvāṃsam ǀ rakṣasvínam ǀā-bhogám ǀ hánmanā ǀ hatam ǀ uda-dhím ǀ hánmanā ǀ hatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy with your fatal (weapons) the mortal who is malignant, ignorant, strong, rapacious; destroy himlike a water jar, with your weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र क्षोद॑सा॒ धाय॑सा सस्र ए॒षा सर॑स्वती ध॒रुण॒माय॑सी॒ पूः । प्र॒बाब॑धाना र॒थ्ये॑व याति॒ विश्वा॑ अ॒पो म॑हि॒ना सिन्धु॑र॒न्याः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kṣódasā ǀ dhā́yasā ǀ sasre ǀ eṣā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ dharúṇam ǀ ā́yasī ǀ pū́ḥ ǀpra-bā́badhānā ǀ rathyā́-iva ǀ yāti ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ anyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSarasvatī, firm as a city made of metal, flows rapidly with all sustaining water, sweeping away inits might all other waters, as a charioteer (clears the road).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एका॑चेत॒त्सर॑स्वती न॒दीनां॒ शुचि॑र्य॒ती गि॒रिभ्य॒ आ स॑मु॒द्रात् । रा॒यश्चेत॑न्ती॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ भूरे॑र्घृ॒तं पयो॑ दुदुहे॒ नाहु॑षाय
shlokas.transliteration: ékā ǀ acetat ǀ sárasvatī ǀ nadī́nām ǀ śúciḥ ǀ yatī́ ǀ girí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ samudrā́t ǀrāyáḥ ǀ cétantī ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ duduhe ǀ nā́huṣāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sarasvatī, chief and pure of rivers, flowing from the mountains to the ocean, understood the request ofNahuṣa, and distributing riches among the many existing beings, milked for him butter and water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॑वृधे॒ नर्यो॒ योष॑णासु॒ वृषा॒ शिशु॑र्वृष॒भो य॒ज्ञिया॑सु । स वा॒जिनं॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो दधाति॒ वि सा॒तये॑ त॒न्वं॑ मामृजीत
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ náryaḥ ǀ yóṣaṇāsu ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yajñíyāsu ǀsáḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dadhāti ǀ ví ǀ sātáye ǀ tanvám ǀ mamṛjīta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer Sarasvat, the friend of man, a showerer (of benefits), even while yet a child, continuallyincreases among his adorable wives (the rains); he bestows upon the affluent (worshippers) a vigorous son; hepurifies their person ns (to fit them) for the reception (of his bounties).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्या न॒: सर॑स्वती जुषा॒णोप॑ श्रवत्सु॒भगा॑ य॒ज्णे अ॒स्मिन् । मि॒तज्ञु॑भिर्नम॒स्यै॑रिया॒ना रा॒या यु॒जा चि॒दुत्त॑रा॒ सखि॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ úpa ǀ śravat ǀ su-bhágā ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀmitájñu-bhiḥ ǀ namasyáiḥ ǀ iyānā́ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yujā́ ǀ cit ǀ út-tarā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the auspicious and graciousSarasvatīhear (our praises) at this sacrifice, approached as she iswith reverence and with bended knees, and most liberal to her friends with the riches she possesses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा जुह्वा॑ना यु॒ष्मदा नमो॑भि॒: प्रति॒ स्तोमं॑ सरस्वति जुषस्व । तव॒ शर्म॑न्प्रि॒यत॑मे॒ दधा॑ना॒ उप॑ स्थेयाम शर॒णं न वृ॒क्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ júhvānāḥ ǀ yuṣmát ǀ ā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ práti ǀ stómam ǀ sarasvati ǀ juṣasva ǀtáva ǀ śárman ǀ priyá-tame ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stheyāma ǀ śaraṇám ǀ ná ǀ vṛkṣám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Presenting to you,Sarasvatī, these oblations with reverence (may we receive from you affluence); begratified by our praise and may we, being retained in your dearest felicity, ever recline upon you, as on asheltering tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमु॑ ते सरस्वति॒ वसि॑ष्ठो॒ द्वारा॑वृ॒तस्य॑ सुभगे॒ व्या॑वः । वर्ध॑ शुभ्रे स्तुव॒ते रा॑सि॒ वाजा॑न्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ sarasvati ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ dvā́rau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ su-bhage ǀ ví ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀvárdha ǀ śubhre ǀ stuvaté ǀ rāsi ǀ vā́jān ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AuspiciousSarasvatī, for youVasiṣṭhahas set open the two doors (the east and west) of sacrifice;white-complexioned (goddess), be magnified; bestow food on him who glorifies you; and do you (gods) evercherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हदु॑ गायिषे॒ वचो॑ऽसु॒र्या॑ न॒दीना॑म् । सर॑स्वती॒मिन्म॑हया सुवृ॒क्तिभि॒: स्तोमै॑र्वसिष्ठ॒ रोद॑सी
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ gāyiṣe ǀ vácaḥ ǀ asuryā́ ǀ nadī́nām ǀsárasvatīm ǀ ít ǀ mahaya ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ vasiṣṭha ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You chant,Vasiṣṭhaa powerful hymn to her who is the most mighty of rivers; worship, Vasiṣṭha withwell-selected praises,Sarasvatī, who is both in heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे यत्ते॑ महि॒ना शु॑भ्रे॒ अन्ध॑सी अधिक्षि॒यन्ति॑ पू॒रव॑: । सा नो॑ बोध्यवि॒त्री म॒रुत्स॑खा॒ चोद॒ राधो॑ म॒घोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ mahinā́ ǀ śubhre ǀ ándhasī íti ǀ adhi-kṣiyánti ǀ pūrávaḥ ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ avitrī́ ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ códa ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BeautifulSarasvatī, inasmuch as by your might men obtain both kinds of food, do you, our protectress,regard us; do you, the friend of theMaruts, bestow riches upon those who are affluent (in oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रमिद्भ॒द्रा कृ॑णव॒त्सर॑स्व॒त्यक॑वारी चेतति वा॒जिनी॑वती । गृ॒णा॒ना ज॑मदग्नि॒वत्स्तु॑वा॒ना च॑ वसिष्ठ॒वत्
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ ít ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ sárasvatī ǀ ákava-arī ǀ cetati ǀ vājínī-vatī ǀgṛṇānā́ ǀ jamadagni-vát ǀ stuvānā́ ǀ ca ǀ vasiṣṭha-vát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the auspiciousSarasvatībestow auspicious fortune upon us; may the faultless-movingfood-conferring (goddess) think of us; glorified (as you have been) by Jamadagnī, (be now) glorified byVasiṣṭha.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒नी॒यन्तो॒ न्वग्र॑वः पुत्री॒यन्त॑: सु॒दान॑वः । सर॑स्वन्तं हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: jani-yántaḥ ǀ nú ǀ ágravaḥ ǀ putri-yántaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀsárasvantam ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring wives, desiring sons, liberal of donations, approaching him, now worship Sarasvat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॑ सरस्व ऊ॒र्मयो॒ मधु॑मन्तो घृत॒श्चुत॑: । तेभि॑र्नोऽवि॒ता भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ sarasvaḥ ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those your waves Sarasvat, which are sweet-tasted, the distributors of water, be our protector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पी॒पि॒वांसं॒ सर॑स्वत॒: स्तनं॒ यो वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः । भ॒क्षी॒महि॑ प्र॒जामिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pīpi-vā́ṃsam ǀ sárasvataḥ ǀ stánam ǀ yáḥ ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀbhakṣīmáhi ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we recline upon the protuberant breast ofSarasvati. Which is visible to all; that we may possessprogeny and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञे दि॒वो नृ॒षद॑ने पृथि॒व्या नरो॒ यत्र॑ देव॒यवो॒ मद॑न्ति । इन्द्रा॑य॒ यत्र॒ सव॑नानि सु॒न्वे गम॒न्मदा॑य प्रथ॒मं वय॑श्च
shlokas.transliteration: yajñé ǀ diváḥ ǀ nṛ-sádane ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ yátra ǀ deva-yávaḥ ǀ mádanti ǀíndrāya ǀ yátra ǀ sávanāni ǀ sunvé ǀ gámat ǀ mádāya ǀ prathamám ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the sacrifice in the dwellings of man upon earth, where the devout leaders of (rites) rejoice, wherethe libations toIndraare poured out, there may he descend before (other gods) from heaven for his exhilaration;(may his) swift (horses approach).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दैव्या॑ वृणीम॒हेऽवां॑सि॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्नो मह॒ आ स॑खायः । यथा॒ भवे॑म मी॒ळ्हुषे॒ अना॑गा॒ यो नो॑ दा॒ता प॑रा॒वत॑: पि॒तेव॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dáivyā ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ ávāṃsi ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahe ǀ ā́ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀyáthā ǀ bhávema ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ ánāgāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dātā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ pitā́-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us solicit, friends divine protections, forBṛhaspatiaccepts our (oblations); so may we be withoutoffence towards that showerer (of benefits) whois our benefactor from afar, as a father (of a son).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ नम॑सा ह॒विर्भि॑: सु॒शेवं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॑ गृणीषे । इन्द्रं॒ श्लोको॒ महि॒ दैव्य॑: सिषक्तु॒ यो ब्रह्म॑णो दे॒वकृ॑तस्य॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ námasā ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ su-śévam ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀíndram ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ sisaktu ǀ yáḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ devá-kṛtasya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with homage and with oblations that most excellent and beneficentBrahmaṇaspati; may mypraise worthy of the deity, attain to the mightyIndra, who is the lord of the prayers offered by the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स आ नो॒ योनिं॑ सदतु॒ प्रेष्ठो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्वि॒श्ववा॑रो॒ यो अस्ति॑ । कामो॑ रा॒यः सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ तं दा॒त्पर्ष॑न्नो॒ अति॑ स॒श्चतो॒ अरि॑ष्टान्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yónim ǀ sadatu ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀkā́maḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ tám ǀ dāt ǀ párṣat ǀ naḥ ǀ áti ǀ saścátaḥ ǀ áriṣṭān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that best belovedBṛhaspati, who is the desired of all sit down in our hall of sacrifice; may hegratify our desire of riches and ofmaleposterity. Transporting us (at present) embarrassed uninjured beyond(the assaults of enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमा नो॑ अ॒र्कम॒मृता॑य॒ जुष्ट॑मि॒मे धा॑सुर॒मृता॑सः पुरा॒जाः । शुचि॑क्रन्दं यज॒तं प॒स्त्या॑नां॒ बृह॒स्पति॑मन॒र्वाणं॑ हुवेम
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ arkám ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ júṣṭam ǀ imé ǀ dhāsuḥ ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǀśúci-krandam ǀ yajatám ǀ pastyā́nām ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ anarvā́ṇam ǀ huvema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the first-born immortals (by his command) bestow upon us the food that is necessary for existence;let us invoke the unresistedBṛhaspati, to whom pure praises are addressed, he adored of householder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं श॒ग्मासो॑ अरु॒षासो॒ अश्वा॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॑ सह॒वाहो॑ वहन्ति । सह॑श्चि॒द्यस्य॒ नील॑वत्स॒धस्थं॒ नभो॒ न रू॒पम॑रु॒षं वसा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ śagmā́saḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ saha-vā́haḥ ǀ vahanti ǀsáhaḥ ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ nī́la-vat ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rūpám ǀ aruṣám ǀ vásānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May his powerful brilliant horses, wearing a lustrous form like (that of) the sun, acting together, bring(hither) that Bṛhaspai, in whom strength abides like that of a substantial mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि शुचि॑: श॒तप॑त्र॒: स शु॒न्ध्युर्हिर॑ण्यवाशीरिषि॒रः स्व॒र्षाः । बृह॒स्पति॒: स स्वा॑वे॒श ऋ॒ष्वः पु॒रू सखि॑भ्य आसु॒तिं करि॑ष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ śúciḥ ǀ śatá-patraḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śundhyúḥ ǀ híraṇya-vāśīḥ ǀ iṣiráḥ ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ su-āveśáḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ purú ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā-sutím ǀ káriṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He verily is pure, borne by numerous conveyances, he is the purifier armed with golden weapons, theobject of desire, the enjoyer of heaven; he,Bṛhaspatiis well domiciled, of goodly aspect, a most bountiful giverof ample food to his friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वी दे॒वस्य॒ रोद॑सी॒ जनि॑त्री॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॑ वावृधतुर्महि॒त्वा । द॒क्षाय्या॑य दक्षता सखाय॒: कर॒द्ब्रह्म॑णे सु॒तरा॑ सुगा॒धा
shlokas.transliteration: devī́ íti ǀ devásya ǀ ródasī íti ǀ jánitrī íti ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ vavṛdhatuḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀdakṣā́yyāya ǀ dakṣata ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ kárat ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ su-tárā ǀ su-gādhā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine heaven and earth, the genitive ratrices of the deity have by their might, given growth toBṛhaspati; magnify, friends, the magnifiable, and may he render (the waters) easy to be crossed and forded for(the attainment of) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं वां॑ ब्रह्मणस्पते सुवृ॒क्तिर्ब्रह्मेन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ अकारि । अ॒वि॒ष्टं धियो॑ जिगृ॒तं पुरं॑धीर्जज॒स्तम॒र्यो व॒नुषा॒मरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ vām ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ su-vṛktíḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀ akāri ǀaviṣṭám ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ jigṛtám ǀ púram-dhīḥ ǀ jajastám ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vanúṣām ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise has been offered as prayer to you both,BrahmaṇaspatiandIndra, the wielder of thethunderbolt; protect our ceremonies; hear our manifold praise; annihilate the assailing adversaries of yourworshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते यु॒वमिन्द्र॑श्च॒ वस्वो॑ दि॒व्यस्ये॑शाथे उ॒त पार्थि॑वस्य । ध॒त्तं र॒यिं स्तु॑व॒ते की॒रये॑ चिद्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ yuvám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ īśāthe íti ǀ utá ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀdhattám ǀ rayím ǀ stuvaté ǀ kīráye ǀ cit ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two,BṛhaspatiandIndraare lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasure; grant riches to theworshipper who praises you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यवोऽरु॒णं दु॒ग्धमं॒शुं जु॒होत॑न वृष॒भाय॑ क्षिती॒नाम् । गौ॒राद्वेदी॑याँ अव॒पान॒मिन्द्रो॑ वि॒श्वाहेद्या॑ति सु॒तसो॑ममि॒च्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryavaḥ ǀ aruṇám ǀ dugdhám ǀ aṃśúm ǀ juhótana ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ kṣitīnā́m ǀgaurā́t ǀ védīyān ǀ ava-pā́nam ǀ índraḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ ít ǀ yāti ǀ sutá-somam ǀ icchán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, priests, the shining effusedSomao him who is eminent (among) men; knowing better than theGaura where his distant drinking-plural ce (is to be found).Indracomes daily seeking for the offerer of the libatioṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्द॑धि॒षे प्र॒दिवि॒ चार्वन्नं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे पी॒तिमिद॑स्य वक्षि । उ॒त हृ॒दोत मन॑सा जुषा॒ण उ॒शन्नि॑न्द्र॒ प्रस्थि॑तान्पाहि॒ सोमा॑न्
