shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ pra-dívi ǀ cā́ru ǀ ánnam ǀ divé-dive ǀ pītím ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ vakṣi ǀutá ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ utá ǀ mánasā ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ uśán ǀ indra ǀ prá-sthitān ǀ pāhi ǀ sómān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural asantSomathat you,Indra, have quaffed in former days, you still desire to drink of daily;gratified in heart and mind, and wishing (our good), drink, Indra the Soma, that is plural ced before (you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒ज्ञा॒नः सोमं॒ सह॑से पपाथ॒ प्र ते॑ मा॒ता म॑हि॒मान॑मुवाच । एन्द्र॑ पप्राथो॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षं यु॒धा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वरि॑वश्चकर्थ
shlokas.transliteration: jajñānáḥ ǀ sómam ǀ sáhase ǀ papātha ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mātā́ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ uvāca ǀā́ ǀ indra ǀ paprātha ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀ yudhā́ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ cakartha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as born,Indrayou have drunk theSomafor your invigoration; your mother (Aditi) proclaimedyour greatness; hence you have filled the vast firmament. Indra, you have gained in battle treasure for the godṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्यो॒धया॑ मह॒तो मन्य॑माना॒न्त्साक्षा॑म॒ तान्बा॒हुभि॒: शाश॑दानान् । यद्वा॒ नृभि॒र्वृत॑ इन्द्राभि॒युध्या॒स्तं त्वया॒जिं सौ॑श्रव॒सं ज॑येम
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ yodháyāḥ ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ mányamānān ǀ sā́kṣāma ǀ tā́n ǀ bāhú-bhiḥ ǀ śā́śadānān ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vṛ́taḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhi-yúdhyāḥ ǀ tám ǀ tváyā ǀ ājím ǀ sauśravasám ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you enable us to encounter mighty and arrogant (enemies), we are competent to overcome themalignant by our (unarmed)handsalone; and when you,Indra, surrounded by your attendants (Maruts), fightagainst them, we shall triumph, aided by you (in) that glorious war.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेन्द्र॑स्य वोचं प्रथ॒मा कृ॒तानि॒ प्र नूत॑ना म॒घवा॒ या च॒कार॑ । य॒देददे॑वी॒रस॑हिष्ट मा॒या अथा॑भव॒त्केव॑ल॒: सोमो॑ अस्य
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ índrasya ǀ vocam ǀ prathamā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ prá ǀ nū́tanā ǀ maghá-vā ǀ yā́ ǀ cakā́ra ǀyadā́ ǀ ít ǀ ádevīḥ ǀ ásahiṣṭa ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ átha ǀ abhavat ǀ kévalaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ asya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I proclaim the ancient exploits ofIndrathe recent deeds thatMaghavanhas achieved; when indeed hehad overcome the undivine illusion, thenceforth theSomabecame his exclusive.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवे॒दं विश्व॑म॒भित॑: पश॒व्यं१॒॑ यत्पश्य॑सि॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य । गवा॑मसि॒ गोप॑ति॒रेक॑ इन्द्र भक्षी॒महि॑ ते॒ प्रय॑तस्य॒ वस्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ paśavyám ǀ yát ǀ páśyasi ǀ cákṣasā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀgávām ǀ asi ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ indra ǀ bhakṣīmáhi ǀ te ǀ prá-yatasya ǀ vásvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thine is all this animal world around you, which you illumine with the light of the sun; you,Indra, are theone lord of cattle, thence may we possess wealh bestowed by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॑स्पते यु॒वमिन्द्र॑श्च॒ वस्वो॑ दि॒व्यस्ये॑शाथे उ॒त पार्थि॑वस्य । ध॒त्तं र॒यिं स्तु॑व॒ते की॒रये॑ चिद्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspate ǀ yuvám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ divyásya ǀ īśāthe íti ǀ utá ǀ pā́rthivasya ǀdhattám ǀ rayím ǀ stuvaté ǀ kīráye ǀ cit ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You twoBṛhaspatiandIndraare lords of both celestial and terrestrial treasure; grant riches to theworshipper who praises you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रो मात्र॑या त॒न्वा॑ वृधान॒ न ते॑ महि॒त्वमन्व॑श्नुवन्ति । उ॒भे ते॑ विद्म॒ रज॑सी पृथि॒व्या विष्णो॑ देव॒ त्वं प॑र॒मस्य॑ वित्से
shlokas.transliteration: paráḥ ǀ mā́trayā ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vṛdhāna ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ánu ǀ aśnuvanti ǀubhé íti ǀ te ǀ vidma ǀ rájasī íti ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ víṣṇo íti ǀ deva ǀ tvám ǀ paramásya ǀ vitse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expanding with a body beyond all measure,Viṣṇumen comprehend not your magnitude; we knowthese your two worlds (computing) from the earth, but you, divine Viṣṇu, are cognisant of the highest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॑ विष्णो॒ जाय॑मानो॒ न जा॒तो देव॑ महि॒म्नः पर॒मन्त॑माप । उद॑स्तभ्ना॒ नाक॑मृ॒ष्वं बृ॒हन्तं॑ दा॒धर्थ॒ प्राचीं॑ क॒कुभं॑ पृथि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jātáḥ ǀ déva ǀ mahimnáḥ ǀ páram ǀ ántam ǀ āpa ǀút ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ nā́kam ǀ ṛṣvám ǀ bṛhántam ǀ dādhártha ǀ prā́cīm ǀ kakúbham ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No being that is or that has been born, divineViṣṇu, has attained the utmost limit of your magnitude bywhich you have upheld the vast and beautiful heaven, and sustained the eastern horizon of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इरा॑वती धेनु॒मती॒ हि भू॒तं सू॑यव॒सिनी॒ मनु॑षे दश॒स्या । व्य॑स्तभ्ना॒ रोद॑सी विष्णवे॒ते दा॒धर्थ॑ पृथि॒वीम॒भितो॑ म॒यूखै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: írāvatī ítīrā-vatī ǀ dhenumátī íti dhenu-mátī ǀ hí ǀ bhūtám ǀ suyavasínī íti su-yavasínī ǀ mánuṣe ǀ daśasyā́ ǀví ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ eté íti ǀ dādhártha ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ mayū́khaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth, abounding with food, abounding with cattle, yielding abundant fodder, you aredisposed to be liberal to the man (who praises you); you,Viṣṇu, have upheld these two heaven and earth, andhave secured the earth around with mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रुं य॒ज्ञाय॑ चक्रथुरु लो॒कं ज॒नय॑न्ता॒ सूर्य॑मु॒षास॑म॒ग्निम् । दास॑स्य चिद्वृषशि॒प्रस्य॑ मा॒या ज॒घ्नथु॑र्नरा पृत॒नाज्ये॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: urúm ǀ yajñā́ya ǀ cakrathuḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ janáyantā ǀ sū́ryam ǀ uṣásam ǀ agním ǀdā́sasya ǀ cit ǀ vṛṣa-śiprásya ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ jaghnáthuḥ ǀ narā ǀ pṛtanā́jyeṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two,IndraandViṣṇu, have made the spacious world for the sake of sacrifice, genitive rating the sun,the dawn,Agni; you leaders (of rites) have baffled the devices of the slave Vṛsaśipra in the conflict of hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑विष्णू दृंहि॒ताः शम्ब॑रस्य॒ नव॒ पुरो॑ नव॒तिं च॑ श्नथिष्टम् । श॒तं व॒र्चिन॑: स॒हस्रं॑ च सा॒कं ह॒थो अ॑प्र॒त्यसु॑रस्य वी॒रान्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāviṣṇū íti ǀ dṛṃhitā́ḥ ǀ śámbarasya ǀ náva ǀ púraḥ ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ śnathiṣṭam ǀśatám ǀ varcínaḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ ca ǀ sākám ǀ hatháḥ ǀ apratí ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandViṣṇu, you have demolished the ninety-nine strong cities ofŚambara; you have slain atonce, without resistance, the hundred thousand heroes of theAsuraVarcin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं म॑नी॒षा बृ॑ह॒ती बृ॒हन्तो॑रुक्र॒मा त॒वसा॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ती । र॒रे वां॒ स्तोमं॑ वि॒दथे॑षु विष्णो॒ पिन्व॑त॒मिषो॑ वृ॒जने॑ष्विन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ bṛhántā ǀ uru-kramā́ ǀ tavásā ǀ vardháyantī ǀraré ǀ vām ǀ stómam ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ pínvatam ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ample laudation is magnifying you two, who are mighty, wide- striding, endowed with strength; toyou two,ViṣṇuandIndra, I offer praise at sacrifices; grant us food (won) in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वष॑ट् ते विष्णवा॒स आ कृ॑णोमि॒ तन्मे॑ जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट ह॒व्यम् । वर्ध॑न्तु त्वा सुष्टु॒तयो॒ गिरो॑ मे यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: váṣaṭ ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ āsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ tát ǀ me ǀ juṣasva ǀ śipi-viṣṭa ǀ havyám ǀvárdhantu ǀ tvā ǀ su-stutáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ me ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer,Viṣṇu, the oblation plural ced before you with the exclamation Vaṣa: be plural ased,Śipiviṣṭa, withmy offering; may my laudatory hymns magnify you; and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू मर्तो॑ दयते सनि॒ष्यन्यो विष्ण॑व उरुगा॒याय॒ दाश॑त् । प्र यः स॒त्राचा॒ मन॑सा॒ यजा॑त ए॒ताव॑न्तं॒ नर्य॑मा॒विवा॑सात्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ mártaḥ ǀ dayate ǀ saniṣyán ǀ yáḥ ǀ víṣṇave ǀ uru-gāyā́ya ǀ dā́śat ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ satrā́cā ǀ mánasā ǀ yájāte ǀ etā́vantam ǀ náryam ǀ ā-vívāsāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal desirous of wealth quickly obtains it who presents (offerings) to the widely-renownedViṣṇu, who worships him with entirely devoted mind, who adores so great a benefactor of mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं वि॑ष्णो सुम॒तिं वि॒श्वज॑न्या॒मप्र॑युतामेवयावो म॒तिं दा॑: । पर्चो॒ यथा॑ नः सुवि॒तस्य॒ भूरे॒रश्वा॑वतः पुरुश्च॒न्द्रस्य॑ रा॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ su-matím ǀ viśvá-janyām ǀ ápra-yutām ǀ eva-yāvaḥ ǀ matím ǀ dāḥ ǀpárcaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ suvitásya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ áśva-vataḥ ǀ puru-candrásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viṣṇu, granter of desires, show to us that favourable disposition which is benevolent to all, unmixed(with exception), so that there may be to us the attainment of easily-acquire, ample, steed-comprising,all-delighting riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर्दे॒वः पृ॑थि॒वीमे॒ष ए॒तां वि च॑क्रमे श॒तर्च॑सं महि॒त्वा । प्र विष्णु॑रस्तु त॒वस॒स्तवी॑यान्त्वे॒षं ह्य॑स्य॒ स्थवि॑रस्य॒ नाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ etā́m ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ śatá-arcasam ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀprá ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ astu ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ távīyān ǀ tveṣám ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ sthávirasya ǀ nā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This deity, by his great power, traversed with three (steps) the many- lustrous earth; mayViṣṇu, themost powerful of the powerful rule over us, for illustrious is the name of the mighty one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि च॑क्रमे पृथि॒वीमे॒ष ए॒तां क्षेत्रा॑य॒ विष्णु॒र्मनु॑षे दश॒स्यन् । ध्रु॒वासो॑ अस्य की॒रयो॒ जना॑स उरुक्षि॒तिं सु॒जनि॑मा चकार
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ cakrame ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ etā́m ǀ kṣétrāya ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mánuṣe ǀ daśasyán ǀdhruvā́saḥ ǀ asya ǀ kīráyaḥ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ uru-kṣitím ǀ su-jánimā ǀ cakāra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisViṣṇutraversed the earth for a dwelling which he was desirous of giving to his eulogist; firm arethe people who are his praisers; he who is the engenderer of good has made a spacious dwelling (for hisworshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते॑ अ॒द्य शि॑पिविष्ट॒ नामा॒र्यः शं॑सामि व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् । तं त्वा॑ गृणामि त॒वस॒मत॑व्या॒न्क्षय॑न्तम॒स्य रज॑सः परा॒के
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ śipi-viṣṭa ǀ nā́ma ǀ aryáḥ ǀ śaṃsāmi ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ gṛṇāmi ǀ tavásam ǀ átavyān ǀ kṣáyantam ǀ asyá ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ parāké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ResplendentViṣṇu, I, the master of the offering, knowing the objects that are to be known, glorifytoday your name; I who am feeble, praise you who are powerful, dwelling in a remote region of this worlḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: किमित्ते॑ विष्णो परि॒चक्ष्यं॑ भू॒त्प्र यद्व॑व॒क्षे शि॑पिवि॒ष्टो अ॑स्मि । मा वर्पो॑ अ॒स्मदप॑ गूह ए॒तद्यद॒न्यरू॑पः समि॒थे ब॒भूथ॑
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ ít ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ pari-cákṣyam ǀ bhūt ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ vavakṣé ǀ śipi-viṣṭáḥ ǀ asmi ǀmā́ ǀ várpaḥ ǀ asmát ǀ ápa ǀ gūhaḥ ǀ etát ǀ yát ǀ anyá-rūpaḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ babhū́tha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What is to be proclaimed,Viṣṇu, of you, when you save. I amŚipiviṣṭa? Conceal not from us yourreal form, although you have engaged under a different form in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वष॑ट् ते विष्णवा॒स आ कृ॑णोमि॒ तन्मे॑ जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट ह॒व्यम् । वर्ध॑न्तु त्वा सुष्टु॒तयो॒ गिरो॑ मे यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: váṣaṭ ǀ te ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ āsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ tát ǀ me ǀ juṣasva ǀ śipi-viṣṭa ǀ havyám ǀvárdhantu ǀ tvā ǀ su-stutáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ me ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer,Viṣṇu, the oblation plural ced before you with the exclamationVaṣaṭ; be plural ased,Śipiviṣṭa, withmy offering; may my laudatory hymns magnify you and do you (gods) ever cherish us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो वाच॒: प्र व॑द॒ ज्योति॑रग्रा॒ या ए॒तद्दु॒ह्रे म॑धुदो॒घमूध॑: । स व॒त्सं कृ॒ण्वन्गर्भ॒मोष॑धीनां स॒द्यो जा॒तो वृ॑ष॒भो रो॑रवीति
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ prá ǀ vada ǀ jyótiḥ-agrāḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ etát ǀ duhré ǀ madhu-doghám ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ kṛṇván ǀ gárbham ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ roravīti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Recite the three sacred texts, preceded by light, which milk the water- yielding udder; for he, theshowerer, (thereby) becoming quickly manifest, loudly roars, engendering the (lightning) infant, the embryo of theplants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वर्ध॑न॒ ओष॑धीनां॒ यो अ॒पां यो विश्व॑स्य॒ जग॑तो दे॒व ईशे॑ । स त्रि॒धातु॑ शर॒णं शर्म॑ यंसत्त्रि॒वर्तु॒ ज्योति॑: स्वभि॒ष्ट्य१॒॑स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ várdhanaḥ ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ yáḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ jágataḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀsáḥ ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ śaraṇám ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǀ tri-vártu ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ su-abhiṣṭí ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who is the augmenter of plural nts, the increase of the waters, who rules divine over the wholeearth, bestow upon us a three-storied dwelling and felicity; may he grant us the desired light (of the sun) at thethree (bright) seasons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्त॒रीरु॑ त्व॒द्भव॑ति॒ सूत॑ उ त्वद्यथाव॒शं त॒न्वं॑ चक्र ए॒षः । पि॒तुः पय॒: प्रति॑ गृभ्णाति मा॒ता तेन॑ पि॒ता व॑र्धते॒ तेन॑ पु॒त्रः
shlokas.transliteration: starī́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvat ǀ bhávati ǀ sū́te ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvat ǀ yathā-vaśám ǀ tanvám ǀ cakre ǀ eṣáḥ ǀpitúḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇāti ǀ mātā́ ǀ téna ǀ pitā́ ǀ vardhate ǀ téna ǀ putráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One form ofParjanyais like a barren cow the other produces offspring, he takes whichever form hepleases; the mother receives the milk from the father thence the father, thence the son is nourished.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॑नि॒ भुव॑नानि त॒स्थुस्ति॒स्रो द्याव॑स्त्रे॒धा स॒स्रुराप॑: । त्रय॒: कोशा॑स उप॒सेच॑नासो॒ मध्व॑: श्चोतन्त्य॒भितो॑ विर॒प्शम्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ víśvāni ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ tasthúḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ tredhā́ ǀ sasrúḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀtráyaḥ ǀ kóśāsaḥ ǀ upa-sécanāsaḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ vi-rapśám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In whom all beings exist; thethree worldsabide; from whom the waters flow in three directions (east,west, and south); the three water-shedding masses of clouds (east, west, and north) pour the waters round themighty (Parjanya).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं वच॑: प॒र्जन्या॑य स्व॒राजे॑ हृ॒दो अ॒स्त्वन्त॑रं॒ तज्जु॑जोषत् । म॒यो॒भुवो॑ वृ॒ष्टय॑: सन्त्व॒स्मे सु॑पिप्प॒ला ओष॑धीर्दे॒वगो॑पाः
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ parjányāya ǀ sva-rā́je ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ astu ǀ ántaram ǀ tát ǀ jujoṣat ǀmayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ santu ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-pippalā́ḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise is addressed to the self-irradiatingParjanya; may it be plural ced in his heart; may he begratified by it; may the joy-diffusing rains be ours; may the plural nts cherished by the deiy be fruitful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रे॑तो॒धा वृ॑ष॒भः शश्व॑तीनां॒ तस्मि॑न्ना॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च । तन्म॑ ऋ॒तं पा॑तु श॒तशा॑रदाय यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ retaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ tásmin ǀ ātmā́ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ tasthúṣaḥ ǀ ca ǀtát ǀ mā ǀ ṛtám ǀ pātu ǀ śatá-śāradāya ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, the bull, be the impregnator of the perpetual plural ns, for in him is the vitality of both the fixed andmoveable (world); may the rain sent by him preserve me for a hundred years; and do you (gods) ever cherish uswith blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒र्जन्या॑य॒ प्र गा॑यत दि॒वस्पु॒त्राय॑ मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ । स नो॒ यव॑समिच्छतु
shlokas.transliteration: parjányāya ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀ diváḥ ǀ putrā́ya ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yávasam ǀ icchatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing aloud to the son of heaven,Parjanya, the sender of rain; may he be plural ased (to grant) us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो गर्भ॒मोष॑धीनां॒ गवां॑ कृ॒णोत्यर्व॑ताम् । प॒र्जन्य॑: पुरु॒षीणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ gávām ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ árvatām ǀparjányaḥ ǀ puruṣī́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is the cause of impregnation of plural nts, of cows, of mares, of women.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ इदा॒स्ये॑ ह॒विर्जु॒होता॒ मधु॑मत्तमम् । इळां॑ नः सं॒यतं॑ करत्
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ ít ǀ āsyé ǀ havíḥ ǀ juhóta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀíḷām ǀ naḥ ǀ sam-yátam ǀ karat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer verily to him by the mouth (of the gods,Agni), the most savoury oblation, so that he may yield usfood unfailingly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं॒व॒त्स॒रं श॑शया॒ना ब्रा॑ह्म॒णा व्र॑तचा॒रिण॑: । वाचं॑ प॒र्जन्य॑जिन्वितां॒ प्र म॒ण्डूका॑ अवादिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: saṃvatsarám ǀ śaśayānā́ḥ ǀ brāhmaṇā́ḥ ǀ vrata-cāríṇaḥ ǀvā́cam ǀ parjánya-jinvitām ǀ prá ǀ maṇḍū́kāḥ ǀ avādiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The frogs, likeBrāhmaṇas, observant of their vows, practising penance throughout the year, utteraloud praises agreeable toParjanya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒व्या आपो॑ अ॒भि यदे॑न॒माय॒न्दृतिं॒ न शुष्कं॑ सर॒सी शया॑नम् । गवा॒मह॒ न मा॒युर्व॒त्सिनी॑नां म॒ण्डूका॑नां व॒ग्नुरत्रा॒ समे॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: divyā́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ enam ǀ ā́yan ǀ dṛ́tim ǀ ná ǀ śúṣkam ǀ sarasī́ íti ǀ śáyānam ǀgávām ǀ áha ǀ ná ǀ māyúḥ ǀ vatsínīnām ǀ maṇḍū́kānām ǀ vagnúḥ ǀ átra ǀ sám ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the waters of the sky fall upon (the troop of frogs) sleeping in the (exhausted) lake like a drywater-skin; then rises together the croaking of the frogs, like the bellowing of cows when joined by their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदी॑मेनाँ उश॒तो अ॒भ्यव॑र्षीत्तृ॒ष्याव॑तः प्रा॒वृष्याग॑तायाम् । अ॒ख्ख॒ली॒कृत्या॑ पि॒तरं॒ न पु॒त्रो अ॒न्यो अ॒न्यमुप॒ वद॑न्तमेति
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ enān ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ávarṣīt ǀ tṛṣyā́-vataḥ ǀ prāvṛ́ṣi ǀ ā́-gatāyām ǀakhkhalīkṛ́tya ǀ pitáram ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ anyáḥ ǀ anyám ǀ úpa ǀ vádantam ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the rainy season has arrived, and (Parjanya) has sent the rain upon them, thirsty and longing (forits coming), then one frog meets another croaking (his congratulations) as a child (calls to) its father withinarticulate ejaculations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्यो अ॒न्यमनु॑ गृभ्णात्येनोर॒पां प्र॑स॒र्गे यदम॑न्दिषाताम् । म॒ण्डूको॒ यद॒भिवृ॑ष्ट॒: कनि॑ष्क॒न्पृश्नि॑: सम्पृ॒ङ्क्ते हरि॑तेन॒ वाच॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: anyáḥ ǀ anyám ǀ ánu ǀ gṛbhṇāti ǀ enoḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ pra-sargé ǀ yát ǀ ámandiṣātām ǀmaṇḍū́kaḥ ǀ yát ǀ abhí-vṛṣṭaḥ ǀ kániskan ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ sam-pṛṅkté ǀ háritena ǀ vā́cam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of these two congratulates the other as they are both delighting in the forthcoming of rain; thespeckled frog, leaping up repeatedly when moistened (by the shower), joins greetings with the green one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदे॑षाम॒न्यो अ॒न्यस्य॒ वाचं॑ शा॒क्तस्ये॑व॒ वद॑ति॒ शिक्ष॑माणः । सर्वं॒ तदे॑षां स॒मृधे॑व॒ पर्व॒ यत्सु॒वाचो॒ वद॑थ॒नाध्य॒प्सु
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ eṣām ǀ anyáḥ ǀ anyásya ǀ vā́cam ǀ śāktásya-iva ǀ vádati ǀ śíkṣamāṇaḥ ǀsárvam ǀ tát ǀ eṣām ǀ samṛ́dhā-iva ǀ párva ǀ yát ǀ su-vā́caḥ ǀ vádathana ǀ ádhi ǀ ap-sú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When one of you imitates the croaking of another as a learner (imitates) his teacher, when, loud crying,you converse (leaping) upon the waters, then the enire body is as it were developed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोमा॑यु॒रेको॑ अ॒जमा॑यु॒रेक॒: पृश्नि॒रेको॒ हरि॑त॒ एक॑ एषाम् । स॒मा॒नं नाम॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ विरू॑पाः पुरु॒त्रा वाचं॑ पिपिशु॒र्वद॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: gó-māyuḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ajá-māyuḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ háritaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ eṣām ǀsamānám ǀ nā́ma ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ ví-rūpāḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ pipiśuḥ ǀ vádantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One frog has the bellowing of a cow, another the bleating of a goat; one of them is speckled, one isgreen; designated by a common appellation, they are of various colours and croaking, show themselves innumerous plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रा॒ह्म॒णासो॑ अतिरा॒त्रे न सोमे॒ सरो॒ न पू॒र्णम॒भितो॒ वद॑न्तः । सं॒व॒त्स॒रस्य॒ तदह॒: परि॑ ष्ठ॒ यन्म॑ण्डूकाः प्रावृ॒षीणं॑ ब॒भूव॑
shlokas.transliteration: brāhmaṇā́saḥ ǀ ati-rātré ǀ ná ǀ sóme ǀ sáraḥ ǀ ná ǀ pūrṇám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ vádantaḥ ǀsaṃvatsarásya ǀ tát ǀ áharíti ǀ pári ǀ stha ǀ yát ǀ maṇḍūkāḥ ǀ prāvṛṣī́ṇam ǀ babhū́va ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LikeBrāhmaṇasat theSomalibation, at theAtirātrasacrifice, you are now croaking around thereplenished lake (throughout the night), for on that day of the year you frogs are everywhere about, when it is theday of the serving of the rains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रा॒ह्म॒णास॑: सो॒मिनो॒ वाच॑मक्रत॒ ब्रह्म॑ कृ॒ण्वन्त॑: परिवत्स॒रीण॑म् । अ॒ध्व॒र्यवो॑ घ॒र्मिण॑: सिष्विदा॒ना आ॒विर्भ॑वन्ति॒ गुह्या॒ न के चि॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: brāhmaṇā́saḥ ǀ somínaḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ akrata ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ parivatsarī́ṇam ǀadhvaryávaḥ ǀ gharmíṇaḥ ǀ sisvidānā́ḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ gúhyāḥ ǀ ná ǀ ké ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They utter a loud cry, likebrāhmaṇaswhen bearing theSomalibation, and reciting the perennialprayer; like ministrant priests with thegharmaoffering, they hid (in the hot weather) person iring (in their holes), butnow some of them appear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वहि॑तिं जुगुपुर्द्वाद॒शस्य॑ ऋ॒तुं नरो॒ न प्र मि॑नन्त्ये॒ते । सं॒व॒त्स॒रे प्रा॒वृष्याग॑तायां त॒प्ता घ॒र्मा अ॑श्नुवते विस॒र्गम्
shlokas.transliteration: devá-hitim ǀ jugupuḥ ǀ dvādaśásya ǀ ṛtúm ǀ náraḥ ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ minanti ǀ eté ǀsaṃvatsaré ǀ prāvṛ́ṣi ǀ ā́-gatāyām ǀ taptā́ḥ ǀ gharmā́ḥ ǀ aśnuvate ǀ vi-sargám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These leaders of rites observe the instrumental tutes of the gods and disregard not the (appropriate) season ofthe twelve month; as the year revolves, and the rains return then, scorched and heated, they obtain freedom(from their hiding- plural ces).”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोमा॑युरदाद॒जमा॑युरदा॒त्पृश्नि॑रदा॒द्धरि॑तो नो॒ वसू॑नि । गवां॑ म॒ण्डूका॒ दद॑तः श॒तानि॑ सहस्रसा॒वे प्र ति॑रन्त॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: gó-māyuḥ ǀ adāt ǀ ajá-māyuḥ ǀ adāt ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ adāt ǀ háritaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǀgávām ǀ maṇḍū́kāḥ ǀ dádataḥ ǀ śatā́ni ǀ sahasra-sāvé ǀ prá ǀ tirante ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the cow-toned, the goat-toned, the speckled, the green (frog, severally) grant us riches! May thefrogs in the fertilizing (season of the rain), bestowing upon us hundreds of cows, prolong (our) lives!”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा॒ तप॑तं॒ रक्ष॑ उ॒ब्जतं॒ न्य॑र्पयतं वृषणा तमो॒वृध॑: । परा॑ शृणीतम॒चितो॒ न्यो॑षतं ह॒तं नु॒देथां॒ नि शि॑शीतम॒त्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ tápatam ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ubjátam ǀ ní ǀ arpayatam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ tamaḥ-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀpárā ǀ śṛṇītam ǀ acítaḥ ǀ ní ǀ oṣatam ǀ hatám ǀ nudéthām ǀ ní ǀ śiśītam ǀ atríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, afflict, destroy therākṣasas; showerers (of benefits) cast down those who delight indarkness; put to flight the stupid (spirits); consume, slay, drive away, utterly extermiante the cannibals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा॒ सम॒घशं॑सम॒भ्य१॒॑घं तपु॑र्ययस्तु च॒रुर॑ग्नि॒वाँ इ॑व । ब्र॒ह्म॒द्विषे॑ क्र॒व्यादे॑ घो॒रच॑क्षसे॒ द्वेषो॑ धत्तमनवा॒यं कि॑मी॒दिने॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ sám ǀ aghá-śaṃsam ǀ abhí ǀ aghám ǀ tápuḥ ǀ yayastu ǀ carúḥ ǀ agnivā́n-iva ǀbrahma-dvíṣe ǀ kravya-áde ǀ ghorá-cakṣase ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ anavāyám ǀ kimīdíne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, fall upon the destructive (rākṣasa) and the performer of unprofitable acts, so that,consumed (by your wrath), he may perish like the offering cast into the fire; retain implacable hatred to the haterofbrāhmaṇas, the cannibal, the hideous, the vile (rākṣasa).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा दु॒ष्कृतो॑ व॒व्रे अ॒न्तर॑नारम्भ॒णे तम॑सि॒ प्र वि॑ध्यतम् । यथा॒ नात॒: पुन॒रेक॑श्च॒नोदय॒त्तद्वा॑मस्तु॒ सह॑से मन्यु॒मच्छव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ duḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀ vavré ǀ antáḥ ǀ anārambhaṇé ǀ támasi ǀ prá ǀ vidhyatam ǀyáthā ǀ ná ǀ átaḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ut-áyat ǀ tát ǀ vām ǀ astu ǀ sáhase ǀ manyu-mát ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, chastise the malignant (rākṣasas), having plural nged them in surrounding andinextricable darkness, so that not one of them may again issue from it; so may your wrathful might be triumphantover them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा व॒र्तय॑तं दि॒वो व॒धं सं पृ॑थि॒व्या अ॒घशं॑साय॒ तर्ह॑णम् । उत्त॑क्षतं स्व॒र्यं१॒॑ पर्व॑तेभ्यो॒ येन॒ रक्षो॑ वावृधा॒नं नि॒जूर्व॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ vartáyatam ǀ diváḥ ǀ vadhám ǀ sám ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ aghá-śaṃsāya ǀ tárhaṇam ǀút ǀ takṣatam ǀ svaryám ǀ párvatebhyaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ ni-jū́rvathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, disperse from heaven your fatal (weapon), the extirpator from earth of the malignant(rākṣasas) put forth from the clouds the consuming, (thunderbolt), wherewith you slay the increasing rākṣasarace.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा व॒र्तय॑तं दि॒वस्पर्य॑ग्नित॒प्तेभि॑र्यु॒वमश्म॑हन्मभिः । तपु॑र्वधेभिर॒जरे॑भिर॒त्रिणो॒ नि पर्शा॑ने विध्यतं॒ यन्तु॑ निस्व॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ vartáyatam ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ agni-taptébhiḥ ǀ yuvám ǀ áśmahanma-bhiḥ ǀtápuḥ-vadhebhiḥ ǀ ajárebhiḥ ǀ atríṇaḥ ǀ ní ǀ párśāne ǀ vidhyatam ǀ yántu ǀ ni-svarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandSoma, scatter around (your weapons) from the sky, pierce their sides with fiery searchingadamantine (weapons), so that they depart without a sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑सोमा॒ परि॑ वां भूतु वि॒श्वत॑ इ॒यं म॒तिः क॒क्ष्याश्वे॑व वा॒जिना॑ । यां वां॒ होत्रां॑ परिहि॒नोमि॑ मे॒धये॒मा ब्रह्मा॑णि नृ॒पती॑व जिन्वतम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāsomā ǀ pári ǀ vām ǀ bhūtu ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ matíḥ ǀ kakṣyā́ ǀ áśvā-iva ǀ vājínā ǀyā́m ǀ vām ǀ hótrām ǀ pari-hinómi ǀ medháyā ǀ imā́ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ nṛpátī ivéti nṛpátī-iva ǀ jinvatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the praise invest you,IndraandSoma, who are mighty, on every side, as a girth (encompasses) ahorse, that praise which I offer to you both with pure devotion; do you, like two kings, accept this my homage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ स्मरेथां तु॒जय॑द्भि॒रेवै॑र्ह॒तं द्रु॒हो र॒क्षसो॑ भङ्गु॒राव॑तः । इन्द्रा॑सोमा दु॒ष्कृते॒ मा सु॒गं भू॒द्यो न॑: क॒दा चि॑दभि॒दास॑ति द्रु॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ smarethām ǀ tujáyat-bhiḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ hatám ǀ druháḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ bhaṅgurá-vataḥ ǀíndrāsomā ǀ duḥ-kṛ́te ǀ mā́ ǀ su-gám ǀ bhūt ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ cit ǀ abhi-dā́sati ǀ druhā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come with rapid steeds, slay the oppressive mischievousrākṣasas; let there be no happiness, IndraandSoma, to the malignant, who harasses us with his oppression.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मा॒ पाके॑न॒ मन॑सा॒ चर॑न्तमभि॒चष्टे॒ अनृ॑तेभि॒र्वचो॑भिः । आप॑ इव का॒शिना॒ संगृ॑भीता॒ अस॑न्न॒स्त्वास॑त इन्द्र व॒क्ता
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ pā́kena ǀ mánasā ǀ cárantam ǀ abhi-cáṣṭe ǀ ánṛtebhiḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀā́paḥ-iva ǀ kāśínā ǀ sám-gṛbhītāḥ ǀ ásan ǀ astu ǀ ásataḥ ǀ indra ǀ vaktā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who with false calumnies maligns me behaving with a pure heart, may such a speaker offalsehoodIndra, cease to be, like water held in thehand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये पा॑कशं॒सं वि॒हर॑न्त॒ एवै॒र्ये वा॑ भ॒द्रं दू॒षय॑न्ति स्व॒धाभि॑: । अह॑ये वा॒ तान्प्र॒ददा॑तु॒ सोम॒ आ वा॑ दधातु॒ निॠ॑तेरु॒पस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ pāka-śaṃsám ǀ vi-hárante ǀ évaiḥ ǀ yé ǀ vā ǀ bhadrám ǀ dūṣáyanti ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀáhaye ǀ vā ǀ tā́n ǀ pra-dádātu ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā ǀ dadhātu ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySomagive to the serpent, or toss upon the lap ofNirṛti, those who with designing (accusative ations)person cute me, a speaker of sincerely, and those who by spiteful (calumnies) vilify all that is good in me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॒ रसं॒ दिप्स॑ति पि॒त्वो अ॑ग्ने॒ यो अश्वा॑नां॒ यो गवां॒ यस्त॒नूना॑म् । रि॒पुः स्ते॒नः स्ते॑य॒कृद्द॒भ्रमे॑तु॒ नि ष ही॑यतां त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ तना॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rásam ǀ dípsati ǀ pitváḥ ǀ agne ǀ yáḥ ǀ áśvānām ǀ yáḥ ǀ gávām ǀ yáḥ ǀ tanū́nām ǀripúḥ ǀ stenáḥ ǀ steya-kṛ́t ǀ dabhrám ǀ etu ǀ ní ǀ sáḥ ǀ hīyatām ǀ tanvā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he,Agni, who strives to destroy the essence of our food, of our horse, of our cattle, of our bodies--the adversary, the thief, the robber-- go to destruction, and be deprived both of person n and of progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रः सो अ॑स्तु त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ तना॑ च ति॒स्रः पृ॑थि॒वीर॒धो अ॑स्तु॒ विश्वा॑: । प्रति॑ शुष्यतु॒ यशो॑ अस्य देवा॒ यो नो॒ दिवा॒ दिप्स॑ति॒ यश्च॒ नक्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: paráḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ astu ǀ tanvā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ca ǀ tisráḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ḥ ǀ adháḥ ǀ astu ǀ víśvāḥ ǀpráti ǀ śuṣyatu ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ asya ǀ devāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dívā ǀ dípsati ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ náktam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he be deprived of bodily (existence) and of posterity; may he be cast down below all the threeworlds; may his reputation, Gods, be blighted who seeks our destruction by day or by night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वि॒ज्ञा॒नं चि॑कि॒तुषे॒ जना॑य॒ सच्चास॑च्च॒ वच॑सी पस्पृधाते । तयो॒र्यत्स॒त्यं य॑त॒रदृजी॑य॒स्तदित्सोमो॑ऽवति॒ हन्त्यास॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: su-vijñānám ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ jánāya ǀ sát ǀ ca ǀ ásat ǀ ca ǀ vácasī íti ǀ paspṛdhāte íti ǀtáyoḥ ǀ yát ǀ satyám ǀ yatarát ǀ ṛ́jīyaḥ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ sómaḥ ǀ avati ǀ hánti ǀ ásat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To the understanding man there is perfect discrimination, the words of truth and falsehood are mutuallyat variance; of these two,Somaverily cherishes that which is true and right; he destroys the false.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वा उ॒ सोमो॑ वृजि॒नं हि॑नोति॒ न क्ष॒त्रियं॑ मिथु॒या धा॒रय॑न्तम् । हन्ति॒ रक्षो॒ हन्त्यास॒द्वद॑न्तमु॒भाविन्द्र॑स्य॒ प्रसि॑तौ शयाते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vṛjinám ǀ hinoti ǀ ná ǀ kṣatríyam ǀ mithuyā́ ǀ dhāráyantam ǀhánti ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ hánti ǀ ásat ǀ vádantam ǀ ubháu ǀ índrasya ǀ prá-sitau ǀ śayāte íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somainstrumental gates not the wicked; he instrumental gates not the strong man dealing in falsehood; he destroys therākṣasa, he destroys the speaker of untruth; and both remain in the bondage ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑ वा॒हमनृ॑तदेव॒ आस॒ मोघं॑ वा दे॒वाँ अ॑प्यू॒हे अ॑ग्ने । किम॒स्मभ्यं॑ जातवेदो हृणीषे द्रोघ॒वाच॑स्ते निॠ॒थं स॑चन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ vā ǀ ahám ǀ ánṛta-devaḥ ǀ ā́sa ǀ mógham ǀ vā ǀ devā́n ǀ api-ūhé ǀ agne ǀkím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ hṛṇīṣe ǀ drogha-vā́caḥ ǀ te ǀ niḥ-ṛthám ǀ sacantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If I am one following false gods, if I approach the gods in vain, thenAgni(punishes me). If (we be notsuch, then) why,Jātavedas, are you angry with us? Let the utterers of falsehood incur your chastisement.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्या मु॑रीय॒ यदि॑ यातु॒धानो॒ अस्मि॒ यदि॒ वायु॑स्त॒तप॒ पूरु॑षस्य । अधा॒ स वी॒रैर्द॒शभि॒र्वि यू॑या॒ यो मा॒ मोघं॒ यातु॑धा॒नेत्याह॑
shlokas.transliteration: adyá ǀ murīya ǀ yádi ǀ yātu-dhā́naḥ ǀ ásmi ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ tatápa ǀ púruṣasya ǀádha ǀ sáḥ ǀ vīráiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ yūyāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ mógham ǀ yā́tu-dhāna ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I this day die if I am a spirit of ill, or if I have ever injured the life of any ma; may you be deprived(rākṣasa) of your ten sons, who have falsely called me by such an appellation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो माया॑तुं॒ यातु॑धा॒नेत्याह॒ यो वा॑ र॒क्षाः शुचि॑र॒स्मीत्याह॑ । इन्द्र॒स्तं ह॑न्तु मह॒ता व॒धेन॒ विश्व॑स्य ज॒न्तोर॑ध॒मस्प॑दीष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ áyātum ǀ yā́tu-dhāna ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ rakṣā́ḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ asmi ǀ íti ǀ ā́ha ǀíndraḥ ǀ tám ǀ hantu ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vadhéna ǀ víśvasya ǀ jantóḥ ǀ adhamáḥ ǀ padīṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndraslay with his mighty weapon him who calls me theYātudhāna, which I am not, therākṣasa, who says (of himself), I am pure; may he, the vilest of all beings, perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र या जिगा॑ति ख॒र्गले॑व॒ नक्त॒मप॑ द्रु॒हा त॒न्वं१॒॑ गूह॑माना । व॒व्राँ अ॑न॒न्ताँ अव॒ सा प॑दीष्ट॒ ग्रावा॑णो घ्नन्तु र॒क्षस॑ उप॒ब्दैः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yā́ ǀ jígāti ǀ khargálā-iva ǀ náktam ǀ ápa ǀ druhā́ ǀ tanvám ǀ gū́hamānā ǀvavrā́n ǀ anantā́n ǀ áva ǀ sā́ ǀ padīṣṭa ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ ghnantu ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ upabdáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the cruel feminine le fiend who, throwing off the concealment of her person n, wanders about at night likean owl, fall headlong down into the unbounded caverns; may the sones that grind theSomadestroy therākṣasas by their noise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि ति॑ष्ठध्वं मरुतो वि॒क्ष्वि१॒॑च्छत॑ गृभा॒यत॑ र॒क्षस॒: सं पि॑नष्टन । वयो॒ ये भू॒त्वी प॒तय॑न्ति न॒क्तभि॒र्ये वा॒ रिपो॑ दधि॒रे दे॒वे अ॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tiṣṭhadhvam ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ iccháta ǀ gṛbhāyáta ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ pinaṣṭana ǀváyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ bhūtvī́ ǀ patáyanti ǀ naktá-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ vā ǀ rípaḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ devé ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stay,Maruts, among the people, desirous (of protecting them); seize therākṣasas, grind them intopieces; whether you fly about like birds at night, or whether they have offered obstruction to the sacred sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑र्तय दि॒वो अश्मा॑नमिन्द्र॒ सोम॑शितं मघव॒न्त्सं शि॑शाधि । प्राक्ता॒दपा॑क्तादध॒रादुद॑क्ताद॒भि ज॑हि र॒क्षस॒: पर्व॑तेन
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vartaya ǀ diváḥ ǀ áśmānam ǀ indra ǀ sóma-śitam ǀ magha-van ǀ sám ǀ śiśādhi ǀprā́ktāt ǀ ápāktāt ǀ adharā́t ǀ údaktāt ǀ abhí ǀ jahi ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ párvatena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hurl,Indra, your thunderbolt from heaven; sanctify,Maghavan, (the worshipper) sharpened by theSoma; slay with the thunderbolt therākṣasas, on the eas, on the west, on the south, on the north.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒त उ॒ त्ये प॑तयन्ति॒ श्वया॑तव॒ इन्द्रं॑ दिप्सन्ति दि॒प्सवोऽदा॑भ्यम् । शिशी॑ते श॒क्रः पिशु॑नेभ्यो व॒धं नू॒नं सृ॑जद॒शनिं॑ यातु॒मद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ patayanti ǀ śvá-yātavaḥ ǀ índram ǀ dipsanti ǀ dipsávaḥ ǀ ádābhyam ǀśíśīte ǀ śakráḥ ǀ píśunebhyaḥ ǀ vadhám ǀ nūnám ǀ sṛjat ǀ aśánim ǀ yātumát-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They advance, accompanied by dogs; desirous to destroy him, they assail the indomitableIndra;Śakrawhets his thunderbolt for the miscreants; quickly let him hurl the bolt upon the fiends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ यातू॒नाम॑भवत्पराश॒रो ह॑वि॒र्मथी॑नाम॒भ्या॒३॒॑विवा॑सताम् । अ॒भीदु॑ श॒क्रः प॑र॒शुर्यथा॒ वनं॒ पात्रे॑व भि॒न्दन्त्स॒त ए॑ति र॒क्षस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ yātūnā́m ǀ abhavat ǀ parā-śaráḥ ǀ haviḥ-máthīnām ǀ abhí ǀ ā-vívāsatām ǀabhí ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śakráḥ ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vánam ǀ pā́trā-iva ǀ bhindán ǀ satáḥ ǀ eti ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas ever been the discomfiter of the evil spirits coming to obstruct (the rites of) the offerers ofoblations;Śakraadvances, crushing the presentrākṣasas, as a hatchet cuts down (the trees of) a forest, as (amallet smashes) the earthen vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उलू॑कयातुं शुशु॒लूक॑यातुं ज॒हि श्वया॑तुमु॒त कोक॑यातुम् । सु॒प॒र्णया॑तुमु॒त गृध्र॑यातुं दृ॒षदे॑व॒ प्र मृ॑ण॒ रक्ष॑ इन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: úlūka-yātum ǀ śuśulū́ka-yātum ǀ jahí ǀ śvá-yātum ǀ utá ǀ kóka-yātum ǀsuparṇá-yātum ǀ utá ǀ gṛ́dhra-yātum ǀ dṛṣádā-iva ǀ prá ǀ mṛṇa ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy the evil spirit, whether in the form of an owl, or of an owlet, of a dog, or of a duck, of a hawk orof a vulture; slay therākṣasas,Indra, (with the thunderbolt) as with a stone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ रक्षो॑ अ॒भि न॑ड्यातु॒माव॑ता॒मपो॑च्छतु मिथु॒ना या कि॑मी॒दिना॑ । पृ॒थि॒वी न॒: पार्थि॑वात्पा॒त्वंह॑सो॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षं दि॒व्यात्पा॑त्व॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ naṭ ǀ yātu-mā́vatām ǀ ápa ǀ ucchatu ǀ mithunā́ ǀ yā́ ǀ kimīdínā ǀpṛthivī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pā́rthivāt ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ divyā́t ǀ pātu ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not therākṣasasdo us harm; let the dawn drive away the pairs of evil spirits exclaiming, "Whatnote is this"; may the earth protect us from terrestrial, the firmament protect us from celestial, wickednesṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ ज॒हि पुमां॑सं यातु॒धान॑मु॒त स्त्रियं॑ मा॒यया॒ शाश॑दानाम् । विग्री॑वासो॒ मूर॑देवा ऋदन्तु॒ मा ते दृ॑श॒न्त्सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ jahí ǀ púmāṃsam ǀ yātu-dhā́nam ǀ utá ǀ stríyam ǀ māyáyā ǀ śā́śadānām ǀví-grīvāsaḥ ǀ mū́ra-devāḥ ǀ ṛdantu ǀ mā́ ǀ té ǀ dṛśan ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slay,Indra, theYātudhāna, whether in the form of a man, or of a woman doing mischief by herdeceptions; may those who sport in murder perish dissipated; let them not behold the rising sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ चक्ष्व॒ वि च॒क्ष्वेन्द्र॑श्च सोम जागृतम् । रक्षो॑भ्यो व॒धम॑स्यतम॒शनिं॑ यातु॒मद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ cakṣva ǀ ví ǀ cakṣva ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ jāgṛtam ǀrákṣaḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ vadhám ǀ asyatam ǀ aśánim ǀ yātumát-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, do you andIndraseverally watch (therākṣasas), be vary, be vigilant; hurl the thunderbolt atthe malignant rākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा चि॑द॒न्यद्वि शं॑सत॒ सखा॑यो॒ मा रि॑षण्यत । इन्द्र॒मित्स्तो॑ता॒ वृष॑णं॒ सचा॑ सु॒ते मुहु॑रु॒क्था च॑ शंसत
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ cit ǀ anyát ǀ ví ǀ śaṃsata ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyata ǀíndram ǀ ít ǀ stota ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǀ múhuḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ śaṃsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeat, friends, no other praise, be not hurtful (to yourselves); praise togetherIndra, the showerer (ofbenefits) when theSomais effused; repeately utter praise (to him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒व॒क्र॒क्षिणं॑ वृष॒भं य॑था॒जुरं॒ गां न च॑र्षणी॒सह॑म् । वि॒द्वेष॑णं सं॒वन॑नोभयंक॒रं मंहि॑ष्ठमुभया॒विन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ava-krakṣíṇam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ yathā ǀ ajúram ǀ gā́m ǀ ná ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǀvi-dvéṣaṇam ǀ sam-vánanā ǀ ubhayam-karám ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ ubhayāvínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A bull rushing (upon his foes), undecaying, like an ox, the overcomer of (hostile) men, the hater (ofadversaries), the venerable, the displayer of both (enmity and favour), the munificent, the distributor of both(celestial and terrestrial riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि त्वा॒ जना॑ इ॒मे नाना॒ हव॑न्त ऊ॒तये॑ । अ॒स्माकं॒ ब्रह्मे॒दमि॑न्द्र भूतु॒ तेऽहा॒ विश्वा॑ च॒ वर्ध॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ jánāḥ ǀ imé ǀ nā́nā ǀ hávante ǀ ūtáye ǀasmā́kam ǀ bráhma ǀ idám ǀ indra ǀ bhūtu ǀ te ǀ áhā ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ várdhanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although these people worship you,Indra, in many ways to (secure) your protection, (yet) may this ourprayer be throughout all days your magnification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि त॑र्तूर्यन्ते मघवन्विप॒श्चितो॒ऽर्यो विपो॒ जना॑नाम् । उप॑ क्रमस्व पुरु॒रूप॒मा भ॑र॒ वाजं॒ नेदि॑ष्ठमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ tartūryante ǀ magha-van ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vípaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀúpa ǀ kramasva ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ vā́jam ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sages (your worshippers),Maghavan, the overcomers (of foes), the terrifiers of (hostile) people,pass over various (calamities by your aid); come near and bring manysorts of food, and available for ourpreservation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हे च॒न त्वाम॑द्रिव॒: परा॑ शु॒ल्काय॑ देयाम् । न स॒हस्रा॑य॒ नायुता॑य वज्रिवो॒ न श॒ताय॑ शतामघ
shlokas.transliteration: mahé ǀ caná ǀ tvā́m ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ párā ǀ śulkā́ya ǀ deyām ǀná ǀ sahásrāya ǀ ná ǀ ayútāya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śatā́ya ǀ śata-magha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, I would not sell you for a large price, not for a thousand, nor for tenthousand, nor, opulent bearer of the thunderbolt, for a hundred.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वस्याँ॑ इन्द्रासि मे पि॒तुरु॒त भ्रातु॒रभु॑ञ्जतः । मा॒ता च॑ मे छदयथः स॒मा व॑सो वसुत्व॒नाय॒ राध॑से
shlokas.transliteration: vásyān ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ me ǀ pitúḥ ǀ utá ǀ bhrā́tuḥ ǀ ábhuñjataḥ ǀmātā́ ǀ ca ǀ me ǀ chadayathaḥ ǀ samā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ vasu-tvanā́ya ǀ rā́dhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are more precious,Indra, than my father, or than my brother, who is not affectionate; you, giver ofdwellings, are equal to my mother, for you both render me distinguished on account of celebrity and riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्वे॑यथ॒ क्वेद॑सि पुरु॒त्रा चि॒द्धि ते॒ मन॑: । अल॑र्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरंदर॒ प्र गा॑य॒त्रा अ॑गासिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ iyatha ǀ kvá ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀálarṣi ǀ yudhma ǀ khaja-kṛt ǀ puram-dara ǀ prá ǀ gāyatrā́ḥ ǀ agāsiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where have you gone? Where, indeed, are you now? Verily your mind (wanders) among many(worshippers); martial, valorousPurandara, come here; the chanters are singing (your praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रास्मै॑ गाय॒त्रम॑र्चत वा॒वातु॒र्यः पु॑रंद॒रः । याभि॑: का॒ण्वस्योप॑ ब॒र्हिरा॒सदं॒ यास॑द्व॒ज्री भि॒नत्पुर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ asmai ǀ gāyatrám ǀ arcata ǀ vavā́tuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ puram-daráḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ úpa ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sádam ǀ yā́sat ǀ vajrī́ ǀ bhinát ǀ púraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Raise the sacred chant to him who is the destroyer of the cities (of the foes) of his worshipper,(induced) by which may the thunderer come to sit down at the sacrifice of the sons ofKaṇva, and destroy thecities (of their enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॒ सन्ति॑ दश॒ग्विन॑: श॒तिनो॒ ये स॑ह॒स्रिण॑: । अश्वा॑सो॒ ये ते॒ वृष॑णो रघु॒द्रुव॒स्तेभि॑र्न॒स्तूय॒मा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ sánti ǀ daśa-gvínaḥ ǀ śatínaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǀáśvāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ raghu-drúvaḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly with those your horses which are vigorous and fleet, and which are traversers of tens, orhundreds, or thousands (of leagues).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्व१॒॑द्य स॑ब॒र्दुघां॑ हु॒वे गा॑य॒त्रवे॑पसम् । इन्द्रं॑ धे॒नुं सु॒दुघा॒मन्या॒मिष॑मु॒रुधा॑रामरं॒कृत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ adyá ǀ sabaḥ-dúghām ǀ huvé ǀ gāyatrá-vepasam ǀíndram ǀ dhenúm ǀ su-dúghām ǀ ányām ǀ íṣam ǀ urú-dhārām ǀ aram-kṛ́tam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke today the all-sufficientIndra, as the milch cow yielding abundant milk, of excellent motion, andeasy to be milked; or, as another (form), the vast-dropping, desirable (rain).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्तु॒दत्सूर॒ एत॑शं व॒ङ्कू वात॑स्य प॒र्णिना॑ । वह॒त्कुत्स॑मार्जुने॒यं श॒तक्र॑तु॒: त्सर॑द्गन्ध॒र्वमस्तृ॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tudát ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ étaśam ǀ vaṅkū́ íti ǀ vā́tasya ǀ parṇínā ǀváhat ǀ kútsam ǀ ārjuneyám ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ tsárat ǀ gandharvám ǀ ástṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenSūryaharassedEtaśa,Śatakratuconveyed (to his aid)Kutsa, the son ofArjuni, with his twoprancing horses (swift) as the wind, and stealthily approached the irresistibleGandharva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ते चि॑दभि॒श्रिष॑: पु॒रा ज॒त्रुभ्य॑ आ॒तृद॑: । संधा॑ता सं॒धिं म॒घवा॑ पुरू॒वसु॒रिष्क॑र्ता॒ विह्रु॑तं॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ cit ǀ abhi-śríṣaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ jatrú-bhyaḥ ǀ ā-tṛ́daḥ ǀsám-dhātā ǀ sam-dhím ǀ maghá-vā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ íṣkartā ǀ ví-hrutam ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who without healing materials before the flow of blood from the necks was the effecter of there-union, the opulentMaghavan, again makes whole the dissevered (parts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा भू॑म॒ निष्ट्या॑ इ॒वेन्द्र॒ त्वदर॑णा इव । वना॑नि॒ न प्र॑जहि॒तान्य॑द्रिवो दु॒रोषा॑सो अमन्महि
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ bhūma ǀ níṣṭyāḥ-iva ǀ índra ǀ tvát ǀ áraṇāḥ-iva ǀvánāni ǀ ná ǀ pra-jahitā́ni ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ duróṣāsaḥ ǀ amanmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we never be like the abject,Indra, through your favour, nor suffer affliction; may we never be likebranchless trees; for, thunderer, unconsumable (by foes) we glorify you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अम॑न्म॒हीद॑ना॒शवो॑ऽनु॒ग्रास॑श्च वृत्रहन् । स॒कृत्सु ते॑ मह॒ता शू॑र॒ राध॑सा॒ अनु॒ स्तोमं॑ मुदीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ámanmahi ǀ ít ǀ anāśávaḥ ǀ anugrā́saḥ ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀsakṛ́t ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ mahatā́ ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ ánu ǀ stómam ǀ mudīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neitherrashnor irate, we verily glorify you, slayer ofVṛtra, may we propitiate you, hero, for once (atleast) by our praise with great (sacrificial) wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॒ स्तोमं॒ मम॒ श्रव॑द॒स्माक॒मिन्द्र॒मिन्द॑वः । ति॒रः प॒वित्रं॑ ससृ॒वांस॑ आ॒शवो॒ मन्द॑न्तु तुग्र्या॒वृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ stómam ǀ máma ǀ śrávat ǀ asmā́kam ǀ índram ǀ índavaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ sasṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ mándantu ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If he hear our praise, then may our libations, flowing through the filter, dropping quickly, and diluted withconsecrated water, exhilarateIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्व१॒॑द्य स॒धस्तु॑तिं वा॒वातु॒: सख्यु॒रा ग॑हि । उप॑स्तुतिर्म॒घोनां॒ प्र त्वा॑व॒त्वधा॑ ते वश्मि सुष्टु॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ adyá ǀ sadhá-stutim ǀ vavā́tuḥ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀúpa-stutiḥ ǀ maghónām ǀ prá ǀ tvā ǀ avatu ǀ ádha ǀ te ǀ vaśmi ǀ su-stutím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly to-day to the collected laudation of your devoted friend; may the subsidiary praise ofwealthy (worshippers) reach you, but now I wish (to offer) your complete eulogy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोता॒ हि सोम॒मद्रि॑भि॒रेमे॑नम॒प्सु धा॑वत । ग॒व्या वस्त्रे॑व वा॒सय॑न्त॒ इन्नरो॒ निर्धु॑क्षन्व॒क्षणा॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sóta ǀ hí ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dhāvata ǀgavyā́ ǀ vástrā-iva ǀ vāsáyantaḥ ǀ ít ǀ náraḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ dhukṣan ǀ vakṣáṇābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Extract theSomawith the bruising stones, wash it with the consecrated waters; (for by so doing) theleaders (of the rain, theMaruts) clothing (the sky with clouds) as with vesture of the hide of the cow, milk, forth(the water) for the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ ज्मो अध॑ वा दि॒वो बृ॑ह॒तो रो॑च॒नादधि॑ । अ॒या व॑र्धस्व त॒न्वा॑ गि॒रा ममा जा॒ता सु॑क्रतो पृण
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ jmáḥ ǀ ádha ǀ vā ǀ diváḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀayā́ ǀ vardhasva ǀ tanvā́ ǀ girā́ ǀ máma ǀ ā́ ǀ jātā́ ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether come from the earth or the firmament, or the vast luminous (heaven), be magnified by this maydiffusive praise; satisfy,Śatakratu, (my) people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य॒ सु म॒दिन्त॑मं॒ सोमं॑ सोता॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । श॒क्र ए॑णं पीपय॒द्विश्व॑या धि॒या हि॑न्वा॒नं न वा॑ज॒युम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ sú ǀ madín-tamam ǀ sómam ǀ sota ǀ váreṇyam ǀśakráḥ ǀ enam ǀ pīpayat ǀ víśvayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hinvānám ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour out toIndrathe most exhilarating, the most excellentSoma, forŚakracherishes him who isdesirous of food, propitiating him by every pious act.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा त्वा॒ सोम॑स्य॒ गल्द॑या॒ सदा॒ याच॑न्न॒हं गि॒रा । भूर्णिं॑ मृ॒गं न सव॑नेषु चुक्रुधं॒ क ईशा॑नं॒ न या॑चिषत्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sómasya ǀ gáldayā ǀ sádā ǀ yā́can ǀ ahám ǀ girā́ ǀbhū́rṇim ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ cukrudham ǀ káḥ ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ná ǀ yāciṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I never, when importuning you in sacrifices with the effusion of theSomaand with praise, exciteyou like a ferocious lion to wrath; who (is there in the world) that does not solicit his lorḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: मदे॑नेषि॒तं मद॑मु॒ग्रमु॒ग्रेण॒ शव॑सा । विश्वे॑षां तरु॒तारं॑ मद॒च्युतं॒ मदे॒ हि ष्मा॒ ददा॑ति नः
shlokas.transliteration: mádena ǀ iṣitám ǀ mádam ǀ ugrám ǀ ugréṇa ǀ śávasā ǀvíśveṣām ǀ tarutā́ram ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ máde ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ dádāti ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(MayIndradrink) with invogorated strength, the strong exhilarating (Soma) offered with animating(laudation); for in his delight he gives us (a son) the overcomer of all (foes), the humbler of their pride.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शेवा॑रे॒ वार्या॑ पु॒रु दे॒वो मर्ता॑य दा॒शुषे॑ । स सु॑न्व॒ते च॑ स्तुव॒ते च॑ रासते वि॒श्वगू॑र्तो अरिष्टु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: śévāre ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ deváḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀsáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ ca ǀ stuvaté ǀ ca ǀ rāsate ǀ viśvá-gūrtaḥ ǀ ari-stutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine (Indra), the accomplisher of all aims, the glorified by his foes, gives vast treasures to themortal who presents offerings at the sacrifice, to him who pours out the libation, who hymns his praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑ याहि॒ मत्स्व॑ चि॒त्रेण॑ देव॒ राध॑सा । सरो॒ न प्रा॑स्यु॒दरं॒ सपी॑तिभि॒रा सोमे॑भिरु॒रु स्फि॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ mátsva ǀ citréṇa ǀ deva ǀ rā́dhasā ǀsáraḥ ǀ ná ǀ prāsi ǀ udáram ǀ sápīti-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ urú ǀ sphirám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come here,Indra, be exhilarated by the wonderful (libatory) affluence and with your fellow-troopers (theMaruts) fill with theSomayour vast belly, capacious as a lake,”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ स॒हस्र॒मा श॒तं यु॒क्ता रथे॑ हिर॒ण्यये॑ । ब्र॒ह्म॒युजो॒ हर॑य इन्द्र के॒शिनो॒ वह॑न्तु॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sahásram ǀ ā́ ǀ śatám ǀ yuktā́ḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀbrahma-yújaḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ indra ǀ keśínaḥ ǀ váhantu ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your thousand, your hundred steeds,Indrayoke to your golden chariot, harnessed by prayer, withflowing manes, bring you to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ रथे॑ हिर॒ण्यये॒ हरी॑ म॒यूर॑शेप्या । शि॒ति॒पृ॒ष्ठा व॑हतां॒ मध्वो॒ अन्ध॑सो वि॒वक्ष॑णस्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ ráthe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ hárī íti ǀ mayū́ra-śepyā ǀśiti-pṛṣṭhā́ ǀ vahatām ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ vivákṣaṇasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your two peacock-tailed, white-backed horses, yoked to your golden chariot, bring you to drink ofthe sweet praiseworthy libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॒ त्व१॒॑स्य गि॑र्वणः सु॒तस्य॑ पूर्व॒पा इ॑व । परि॑ष्कृतस्य र॒सिन॑ इ॒यमा॑सु॒तिश्चारु॒र्मदा॑य पत्यते
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ tú ǀ asyá ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ pūrvapā́ḥ-iva ǀpári-kṛtasya ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ ā-sutíḥ ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ patyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink you, who are worthy to be glorified, of this consecrated and juicy libation, like the first drinker(vāyu); this excellent effusion issues for your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य एको॒ अस्ति॑ दं॒सना॑ म॒हाँ उ॒ग्रो अ॒भि व्र॒तैः । गम॒त्स शि॒प्री न स यो॑ष॒दा ग॑म॒द्धवं॒ न परि॑ वर्जति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ daṃsánā ǀ mahā́m ǀ ugráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vratáiḥ ǀgámat ǀ sáḥ ǀ śiprī́ ǀ ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ yoṣat ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǀ hávam ǀ ná ǀ pári ǀ varjati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he who alone overcomes (enemies) through (the power of) religious observances, who by piousacts is rendered mighty and fierce, who is handsome- chinned, approach; may he never be remote; may he cometo our invocation; may he never abandon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं पुरं॑ चरि॒ष्ण्वं॑ व॒धैः शुष्ण॑स्य॒ सं पि॑णक् । त्वं भा अनु॑ चरो॒ अध॑ द्वि॒ता यदि॑न्द्र॒ हव्यो॒ भुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ púram ǀ cariṣṇvám ǀ vadháiḥ ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ sám ǀ piṇak ǀtvám ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ caraḥ ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have broken to pieces the moveable city ofŚuṣṇawith your weapons; you who are light havefollowed him; wherefore,Indra, you are in two ways to be worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॑ त्वा॒ सूर॒ उदि॑ते॒ मम॑ म॒ध्यंदि॑ने दि॒वः । मम॑ प्रपि॒त्वे अ॑पिशर्व॒रे व॑स॒वा स्तोमा॑सो अवृत्सत
shlokas.transliteration: máma ǀ tvā ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ máma ǀ madhyándine ǀ diváḥ ǀmáma ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ api-śarvaré ǀ vaso íti ǀ ā́ ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ avṛtsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May my prayers when the sun has risen, those also at noon, those also when evening arrives, bringyou back, giver of riches (to my sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒हि स्तु॒हीदे॒ते घा॑ ते॒ मंहि॑ष्ठासो म॒घोना॑म् । नि॒न्दि॒ताश्व॑: प्रप॒थी प॑रम॒ज्या म॒घस्य॑ मेध्यातिथे
shlokas.transliteration: stuhí ǀ stuhí ǀ ít ǀ eté ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ maghónām ǀninditá-aśvaḥ ǀ pra-pathī́ ǀ parama-jyā́ḥ ǀ maghásya ǀ medhya-atithe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise (me), praise (me), Medhyātithi, for among the wealthy we are the most liberal donors of wealthto you; (praise me as one) who outstrips a horse in speed, follows the right path, and bears the best arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यदश्वा॒न्वन॑न्वतः श्र॒द्धया॒हं रथे॑ रु॒हम् । उ॒त वा॒मस्य॒ वसु॑नश्चिकेतति॒ यो अस्ति॒ याद्व॑: प॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ áśvān ǀ vánan-vataḥ ǀ śraddháyā ǀ ahám ǀ ráthe ǀ ruhám ǀutá ǀ vāmásya ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ ciketati ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ yā́dvaḥ ǀ paśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When with faith I harness the docile horses in the car, (praise me), for the descendant ofYādu,possessed of cattle, know how to distribute desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ज्रा मह्यं॑ माम॒हे स॒ह त्व॒चा हि॑र॒ण्यया॑ । ए॒ष विश्वा॑न्य॒भ्य॑स्तु॒ सौभ॑गास॒ङ्गस्य॑ स्व॒नद्र॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛjrā́ ǀ máhyam ǀ mamahé ǀ sahá ǀ tvacā́ ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǀeṣáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ sáubhagā ǀ āsaṅgásya ǀ svanát-rathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Praise me, saying), "He who has presented riches to me with a golden purse; may this rattling chariotofAsaṅgacarry off all the treasures (of my enemy)".”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ प्लायो॑गि॒रति॑ दासद॒न्याना॑स॒ङ्गो अ॑ग्ने द॒शभि॑: स॒हस्रै॑: । अधो॒क्षणो॒ दश॒ मह्यं॒ रुश॑न्तो न॒ळा इ॑व॒ सर॑सो॒ निर॑तिष्ठन्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ plā́yogiḥ ǀ áti ǀ dāsat ǀ anyā́n ǀ ā-saṅgáḥ ǀ agne ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sahásraiḥ ǀádha ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ máhyam ǀ rúśantaḥ ǀ naḷā́ḥ-iva ǀ sárasaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ atiṣṭhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(So praise me, saying), "Asaṅga, the son of plural _yoga, has given more than others,Agni, by tens ofthousands; ten times the (number of) vigorous and brilliant oxen (given by him) to me, issue forth like the reeds ofa lake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्व॑स्य स्थू॒रं द॑दृशे पु॒रस्ता॑दन॒स्थ ऊ॒रुर॑व॒रम्ब॑माणः । शश्व॑ती॒ नार्य॑भि॒चक्ष्या॑ह॒ सुभ॑द्रमर्य॒ भोज॑नं बिभर्षि
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ asya ǀ sthūrám ǀ dadṛśe ǀ purástāt ǀ anastháḥ ǀ ūrúḥ ǀ ava-rámbamāṇaḥ ǀśáśvatī ǀ nā́rī ǀ abhi-cákṣya ǀ āha ǀ sú-bhadram ǀ arya ǀ bhójanam ǀ bibharṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śaśvatī, perceiving that the sings of manhood were restored, exclaims, "Joy, husband, you arecapable of enjoyment".”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं व॑सो सु॒तमन्ध॒: पिबा॒ सुपू॑र्णमु॒दर॑म् । अना॑भयिन्ररि॒मा ते॑
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vaso íti ǀ sutám ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sú-pūrṇam ǀ udáram ǀánābhayin ǀ rarimá ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give of dwellings (Indra), drink this effused libation till your belly is full, we offer it, undaunted (Indra), toyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृभि॑र्धू॒तः सु॒तो अश्नै॒रव्यो॒ वारै॒: परि॑पूतः । अश्वो॒ न नि॒क्तो न॒दीषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ áśnaiḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́raiḥ ǀ pári-pūtaḥ ǀáśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ niktáḥ ǀ nadī́ṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Washed by the priests, effused by the stones, purified by the woollen filter, like a horse cleansed in astream.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं ते॒ यवं॒ यथा॒ गोभि॑: स्वा॒दुम॑कर्म श्री॒णन्त॑: । इन्द्र॑ त्वा॒स्मिन्त्स॑ध॒मादे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ te ǀ yávam ǀ yáthā ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ svādúm ǀ akarma ǀ śrīṇántaḥ ǀíndra ǀ tvā ǀ asmín ǀ sadha-mā́de ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have made it sweet for you as the barley-cake mixing it with milk, and therefore,Indra, (I invoke)you to this social rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ इत्सो॑म॒पा एक॒ इन्द्र॑: सुत॒पा वि॒श्वायु॑: । अ॒न्तर्दे॒वान्मर्त्याँ॑श्च
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ít ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ suta-pā́ḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀantáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ mártyān ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraverily is the chief drinker of theSomaamong gods and men, the drinker of the effused libation, theaccepter of all kinds of offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं शु॒क्रो न दुरा॑शी॒र्न तृ॒प्रा उ॑रु॒व्यच॑सम् । अ॒प॒स्पृ॒ण्व॒ते सु॒हार्द॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ná ǀ dúḥ-āśīḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛprā́ḥ ǀ uru-vyácasam ǀapa-spṛṇvaté ǀ su-hā́rdam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We praise him) a universal kind-hearted (friend), whom the pureSoma, the mixture (of it) made withdifficulty, or other satisfying (offerings) do not displease.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोभि॒र्यदी॑म॒न्ये अ॒स्मन्मृ॒गं न व्रा मृ॒गय॑न्ते । अ॒भि॒त्सर॑न्ति धे॒नुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ anyé ǀ asmát ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ vrā́ḥ ǀ mṛgáyante ǀabhi-tsáranti ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom others pursue with offerings of milk and curds as hunters chase a deer (with nets and snares),and harass with (inappropriate) praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रय॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ सोमा॑: सु॒तास॑: सन्तु दे॒वस्य॑ । स्वे क्षये॑ सुत॒पाव्न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ santu ǀ devásya ǀsvé ǀ kṣáye ǀ suta-pā́vnaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the three libations be effused for the divineIndrain his won dwelling, (for he is) the drinker of theeffusedSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रय॒: कोशा॑सः श्चोतन्ति ति॒स्रश्च॒म्व१॒॑: सुपू॑र्णाः । स॒मा॒ने अधि॒ भार्म॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: tráyaḥ ǀ kóśāsaḥ ǀ ścotanti ǀ tisráḥ ǀ camváḥ ǀ sú-pūrṇāḥ ǀsamāné ǀ ádhi ǀ bhā́rman ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three purifying vessels drop (theSoma), three ladles are well filled (for the libation), the whole isfurnished for the common sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑रसि पुरुनि॒ष्ठाः क्षी॒रैर्म॑ध्य॒त आशी॑र्तः । द॒ध्ना मन्दि॑ष्ठ॒: शूर॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ asi ǀ puruniḥ-sthā́ḥ ǀ kṣīráiḥ ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ ā́-śīrtaḥ ǀdadhnā́ ǀ mándiṣṭhaḥ ǀ śū́rasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You (Soma) are pure, distributed in many vessels, mixed at the mid-day sacrifice with milk, and (at thethird sacrifice) with curds, the most exhilarating (Soma) of the hero (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे त॑ इन्द्र॒ सोमा॑स्ती॒व्रा अ॒स्मे सु॒तास॑: । शु॒क्रा आ॒शिरं॑ याचन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ tīvrā́ḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀśukrā́ḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǀ yācante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These dsharp and pureSomalibations effused by us for you solicit you for admixture.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताँ आ॒शिरं॑ पुरो॒ळाश॒मिन्द्रे॒मं सोमं॑ श्रीणीहि । रे॒वन्तं॒ हि त्वा॑ शृ॒णोमि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tā́n ǀ ā-śíram ǀ puroḷā́śam ǀ índra ǀ imám ǀ sómam ǀ śrīṇīhi ǀrevántam ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ śṛṇómi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mix,Indra, the milk andSoma, (add) the cake to this libation. I hear that you are possessed of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हृ॒त्सु पी॒तासो॑ युध्यन्ते दु॒र्मदा॑सो॒ न सुरा॑याम् । ऊध॒र्न न॒ग्ना ज॑रन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: hṛt-sú ǀ pītā́saḥ ǀ yudhyante ǀ duḥ-mádāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ súrāyām ǀū́dhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ nagnā́ḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The potations (ofSoma) contend in your interior (for your exhilaration) like the inebriation caused bywine; your worshippers praise you (filled full of Soma) like the udder (of a cow with milk).”

shlokas.sanskrit: रे॒वाँ इद्रे॒वत॑: स्तो॒ता स्यात्त्वाव॑तो म॒घोन॑: । प्रेदु॑ हरिवः श्रु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: revā́n ǀ ít ǀ revátaḥ ǀ stotā́ ǀ syā́t ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀprá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ śrutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the eulogist of you, who are opulent, be opulent; may he even, lord of steeds, surpass one who iswealthy and renowned, like you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्थं च॒न श॒स्यमा॑न॒मगो॑र॒रिरा चि॑केत । न गा॑य॒त्रं गी॒यमा॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ukthám ǀ caná ǀ śasyámānam ǀ ágoḥ ǀ aríḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ciketa ǀná ǀ gāyatrám ǀ gīyámānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), the enemy of the unbeliever, apprehends whatever prayer is being repeated, whatever chant isbeing chanted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॑ इन्द्र पीय॒त्नवे॒ मा शर्ध॑ते॒ परा॑ दाः । शिक्षा॑ शचीव॒: शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ pīyatnáve ǀ mā́ ǀ śárdhate ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀśíkṣa ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consign us not,Indra, to the slayer, not to an overpowering foe; doer of great deeds, enable us by youracts (to conquer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमु॑ त्वा त॒दिद॑र्था॒ इन्द्र॑ त्वा॒यन्त॒: सखा॑यः । कण्वा॑ उ॒क्थेभि॑र्जरन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ tadít-arthāḥ ǀ índra ǀ tvā-yántaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀkáṇvāḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ jarante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Friends devoted,Indra, to you we, the descendants ofKaṇva, having your praise for our object, glorifyyou with prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न घे॑म॒न्यदा प॑पन॒ वज्रि॑न्न॒पसो॒ नवि॑ष्टौ । तवेदु॒ स्तोमं॑ चिकेत
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ gha ǀ īm ǀ anyát ǀ ā́ ǀ papana ǀ vájrin ǀ apásaḥ ǀ náviṣṭau ǀtáva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stómam ǀ ciketa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Engaged), thunderer, in your recent (worship) I utter no other praise than that of you, the doer of greatdeeds, I repeat only your glorification.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒च्छन्ति॑ दे॒वाः सु॒न्वन्तं॒ न स्वप्ना॑य स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति॑ प्र॒माद॒मत॑न्द्राः
shlokas.transliteration: icchánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sunvántam ǀ ná ǀ svápnāya ǀ spṛhayanti ǀyánti ǀ pra-mā́dam ǀ átandrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods love the man who offers libations, they desire not to (let him) sleep, thence they, unslothful,obtain the inebriatingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ षु प्र या॑हि॒ वाजे॑भि॒र्मा हृ॑णीथा अ॒भ्य१॒॑स्मान् । म॒हाँ इ॑व॒ युव॑जानिः
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ yāhi ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ hṛṇīthāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ asmā́n ǀmahā́n-iva ǀ yúva-jāniḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us quickly with excellent viands, be not bashful, like the ardent husband of a new bride.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो ष्व१॒॑द्य दु॒र्हणा॑वान्त्सा॒यं क॑रदा॒रे अ॒स्मत् । अ॒श्री॒र इ॑व॒ जामा॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ adyá ǀ duḥ-hánāvān ǀ sāyám ǀ karat ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀaśrīráḥ-iva ǀ jā́mātā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let insuperable, delay (coming to us) today until the evening, like an unlucky son-in-law.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा ह्य॑स्य वी॒रस्य॑ भूरि॒दाव॑रीं सुम॒तिम् । त्रि॒षु जा॒तस्य॒ मनां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ vīrásya ǀ bhūri-dā́varīm ǀ su-matím ǀtriṣú ǀ jātásya ǀ mánāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We know the munificent genitive rosity of the hero (Indra); of the purposes of him who is manifest in thethree worlds (we are aware).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू षि॑ञ्च॒ कण्व॑मन्तं॒ न घा॑ विद्म शवसा॒नात् । य॒शस्त॑रं श॒तमू॑तेः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ siñca ǀ káṇva-mantam ǀ ná ǀ gha ǀ vidma ǀ śavasānā́t ǀyaśáḥ-taram ǀ śatám-ūteḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour out the libation to him who is associated with theKaṇva(family); we know not any one morecelebrated than the very powerful bestower of numerous protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठे॑न सोत॒रिन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमं॑ वी॒राय॑ श॒क्राय॑ । भरा॒ पिब॒न्नर्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: jyéṣṭhena ǀ sotaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śakrā́ya ǀbhára ǀ píbat ǀ náryāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer, worshipper, the libation in the first plural ce to the hero, the powerfulIndra, the benefactor of man;may he drink (of it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वेदि॑ष्ठो अव्य॒थिष्वश्वा॑वन्तं जरि॒तृभ्य॑: । वाजं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॒ गोम॑न्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ védiṣṭhaḥ ǀ avyathíṣu ǀ áśva-vantam ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀvā́jam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ gó-mantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who most recognisant of (the merit) of those who give him no annoyance, bestows upon his adorersand praisers food with horses and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पन्य॑म्पन्य॒मित्सो॑तार॒ आ धा॑वत॒ मद्या॑य । सोमं॑ वी॒राय॒ शूरा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: pányam-panyam ǀ ít ǀ sotāraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ mádyāya ǀsómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śū́rāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten, offerers of the libation, (to present) the gloriousSomato the valiant, the hero (Indra), for (his)exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पाता॑ वृत्र॒हा सु॒तमा घा॑ गम॒न्नारे अ॒स्मत् । नि य॑मते श॒तमू॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: pā́tā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ sutám ǀ ā́ ǀ gha ǀ gamat ǀ ná ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀní ǀ yamate ǀ śatám-ūtiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the drinker of theSomalibation, the slayer ofVṛtra, approach, let him not be far from us; let thegranter of many protections keep in check (our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एह हरी॑ ब्रह्म॒युजा॑ श॒ग्मा व॑क्षत॒: सखा॑यम् । गी॒र्भिः श्रु॒तं गिर्व॑णसम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ hárī íti ǀ brahma-yújā ǀ śagmā́ ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ śrutám ǀ gírvaṇasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the delightful steeds who are harnessed by prayer bring hither (our) friends (Indra), magnified bypraises, deserving of laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दव॒: सोमा॒ आ या॑हि श्री॒ताः सोमा॒ आ या॑हि । शिप्रि॒न्नृषी॑व॒: शची॑वो॒ नायमच्छा॑ सध॒माद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: svādávaḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ śrītā́ḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀśíprin ǀ ṛ́ṣi-vaḥ ǀ śácī-vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ayám ǀ áccha ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Handsome-chinned (Indra), the honoured of sages, the doer of great deeds, come, for well-flavoured isSoma; come, for the libations are ready mixed; his (your worshipper) now (invites you) to be present at this socialexhilarating rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तुत॑श्च॒ यास्त्वा॒ वर्ध॑न्ति म॒हे राध॑से नृ॒म्णाय॑ । इन्द्र॑ का॒रिणं॑ वृ॒धन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: stútaḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ tvā ǀ várdhanti ǀ mahé ǀ rā́dhase ǀ nṛmṇā́ya ǀíndra ǀ kāríṇam ǀ vṛdhántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who praising you magnify you,Indra, the instrumental tutor of rites, and those (hymns which glorify) youhave (for their object) great riches and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गिर॑श्च॒ यास्ते॑ गिर्वाह उ॒क्था च॒ तुभ्यं॒ तानि॑ । स॒त्रा द॑धि॒रे शवां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ girvāhaḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ túbhyam ǀ tā́ni ǀsatrā́ ǀ dadhire ǀ śávāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upborne by hymns, those your praises and those prayers which are addressed to you, all combined,sustain your energies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेदे॒ष तु॑विकू॒र्मिर्वाजाँ॒ एको॒ वज्र॑हस्तः । स॒नादमृ॑क्तो दयते
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ ít ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ tuvi-kūrmíḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vájra-hastaḥ ǀsanā́t ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀ dayate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily this accomplisher of many acts, the chief (among the gods), the wielder of the thunderbolt, hewho has ever been unconquered, gives food (to his votaries).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हन्ता॑ वृ॒त्रं दक्षि॑णे॒नेन्द्र॑: पु॒रू पु॑रुहू॒तः । म॒हान्म॒हीभि॒: शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ dákṣiṇena ǀ índraḥ ǀ purú ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́bhiḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the slayer ofVṛtrawith his righthand, the invoked of many in many (plural ces), the mighty by mighydeeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॑श्चर्ष॒णय॑ उ॒त च्यौ॒त्ना ज्रयां॑सि च । अनु॒ घेन्म॒न्दी म॒घोन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ carṣaṇáyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ cyautnā́ ǀ jráyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀánu ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ mandī́ ǀ maghónaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He upon whom all men depend, (in whom) overwhelming energies (abide), he verily is the delighter ofthe opulent (worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष ए॒तानि॑ चका॒रेन्द्रो॒ विश्वा॒ योऽति॑ शृ॒ण्वे । वा॒ज॒दावा॑ म॒घोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ etā́ni ǀ cakāra ǀ índraḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ áti ǀ śṛṇvé ǀvāja-dā́vā ǀ maghónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisIndrahas made all these (beings), who is thence exceedingly renowned; he is he donor of food toopulent worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रभ॑र्ता॒ रथं॑ ग॒व्यन्त॑मपा॒काच्चि॒द्यमव॑ति । इ॒नो वसु॒ स हि वोळ्हा॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá-bhartā ǀ rátham ǀ gavyántam ǀ apākā́t ǀ cit ǀ yám ǀ ávati ǀináḥ ǀ vásu ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ vóḷhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, whom, adoring, and desirous of cattle, the protector (Indra) defends against an ignorant (foe),becomes a prince, the possessor of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सनि॑ता॒ विप्रो॒ अर्व॑द्भि॒र्हन्ता॑ वृ॒त्रं नृभि॒: शूर॑: । स॒त्यो॑ऽवि॒ता वि॒धन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sánitā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ árvat-bhiḥ ǀ hántā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀsatyáḥ ǀ avitā́ ǀ vidhántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal, wise, (borne by his won) steeds, a hero, the slayer ofVṛtra, (aided) by theMaruts, truthful, heis the protector of the performer of holy rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यज॑ध्वैनं प्रियमेधा॒ इन्द्रं॑ स॒त्राचा॒ मन॑सा । यो भूत्सोमै॑: स॒त्यम॑द्वा
shlokas.transliteration: yájadhva ǀ enam ǀ priya-medhāḥ ǀ índram ǀ satrā́cā ǀ mánasā ǀyáḥ ǀ bhū́t ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ satyá-madvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship,Priyamedha, with mind intent upon him, thatIndra, who is truthful when exhilarated by theSoma potations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गा॒थश्र॑वसं॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ श्रव॑स्कामं पुरु॒त्मान॑म् । कण्वा॑सो गा॒त वा॒जिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gāthá-śravasam ǀ sát-patim ǀ śrávaḥ-kāmam ǀ puru-tmā́nam ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ gātá ǀ vājínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing,Kaṇvas, the mighty (Indra), of widely-sung renown, the protector of the good, the desirous of(sacrificial) food, present in many plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ते चि॒द्गास्प॒देभ्यो॒ दात्सखा॒ नृभ्य॒: शची॑वान् । ये अ॑स्मि॒न्काम॒मश्रि॑यन्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛté ǀ cit ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ padébhyaḥ ǀ dā́t ǀ sákhā ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ śácī-vān ǀyé ǀ asmin ǀ kā́mam ǀ áśriyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, a friend (to his worshippers), the doer of great deeds, tracing the catttle by their foot-marks,being without (other means of detection), restored them to those leaders (of rites) who willingly put their trust inhim.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒त्था धीव॑न्तमद्रिवः का॒ण्वं मेध्या॑तिथिम् । मे॒षो भू॒तो॒३॒॑ऽभि यन्नय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: itthā́ ǀ dhī́-vantam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ kāṇvám ǀ médhya-atithim ǀmeṣáḥ ǀ bhūtáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yán ǀ áyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, thunderer, approaching in the form of a ram, have come to Medhyātithi, one of the race ofKaṇva, thus propitiating you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिक्षा॑ विभिन्दो अस्मै च॒त्वार्य॒युता॒ दद॑त् । अ॒ष्टा प॒रः स॒हस्रा॑
shlokas.transliteration: śíkṣa ǀ vibhindo íti vi-bhindo ǀ asmai ǀ catvā́ri ǀ ayútā ǀ dádat ǀaṣṭá ǀ paráḥ ǀ sahásrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LiberalVibhindu, you have given to me four times ten thousand, and afterwards eight thousand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त सु त्ये प॑यो॒वृधा॑ मा॒की रण॑स्य न॒प्त्या॑ । ज॒नि॒त्व॒नाय॑ मामहे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sú ǀ tyé íti ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dhā ǀ mākī́ íti ǀ ráṇasya ǀ naptyā́ ǀjani-tvanā́ya ǀ mamahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify those two (heaven and earth), the augmenters of water, the originators (of beings), thebenefactors of the worshipper, on account of their genitive ration (of the wealth so given to me).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ र॒सिनो॒ मत्स्वा॑ न इन्द्र॒ गोम॑तः । आ॒पिर्नो॑ बोधि सध॒माद्यो॑ वृ॒धे॒३॒॑ऽस्माँ अ॑वन्तु ते॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ sutásya ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ mátsva ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀāpíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ te ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, of our sapid libation, mixed with milk, and be satisfied; regard thyself as our kinsman, to beexhilarated along with us for our welfare; may your (good) intentions protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भू॒याम॑ ते सुम॒तौ वा॒जिनो॑ व॒यं मा न॑: स्तर॒भिमा॑तये । अ॒स्माञ्चि॒त्राभि॑रवताद॒भिष्टि॑भि॒रा न॑: सु॒म्नेषु॑ यामय
shlokas.transliteration: bhūyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-matáu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ staḥ ǀ abhí-mātaye ǀasmā́n ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ avatāt ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sumnéṣu ǀ yamaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be offerers of oblations (to enjoy) your favour; harm us not for the sake of the enemy; protectus with your wondrous solicited (protections), maintain us ever in felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पुरूवसो॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्तु॒ या मम॑ । पा॒व॒कव॑र्णा॒: शुच॑यो विप॒श्चितो॒ऽभि स्तोमै॑रनूषत
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhantu ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ máma ǀpāvaká-varṇāḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), abounding in wealth, may these my praises magnify you; the brilliant pure sages glorify you withhymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स॒हस्र॒मृषि॑भि॒: सह॑स्कृतः समु॒द्र इ॑व पप्रथे । स॒त्यः सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा गृ॑णे॒ शवो॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ विप्र॒राज्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sahásram ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-kṛtaḥ ǀ samudráḥ-iva ǀ paprathe ǀsatyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ śávaḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ vipra-rā́jye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invigorated by (the praises of) a thousand ṛṣis, this (Indra) is as vast as the ocean; the true mightinessand strength of him are glorified at sacrifices, and in the realm of the devout.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मिद्दे॒वता॑तय॒ इन्द्रं॑ प्रय॒त्य॑ध्व॒रे । इन्द्रं॑ समी॒के व॒निनो॑ हवामह॒ इन्द्रं॒ धन॑स्य सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ índram ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀíndram ǀ sam-īké ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ índram ǀ dhánasya ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndrafor the worship of the gods, and when the sacrifice is proceeding; adoring him, we callupon Indra as the close of the rite; we invoke him for the acquisition of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ म॒ह्ना रोद॑सी पप्रथ॒च्छव॒ इन्द्र॒: सूर्य॑मरोचयत् । इन्द्रे॑ ह॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि येमिर॒ इन्द्रे॑ सुवा॒नास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ paprathat ǀ śávaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayat ǀíndre ǀ ha ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ yemire ǀ índre ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by the might of his strength, has spread out the heaven and earth; Indra has lighted up the sun;in Indra are all beings aggregated; the distilling drops of theSomaflow to Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॑ पू॒र्वपी॑तय॒ इन्द्र॒ स्तोमे॑भिरा॒यव॑: । स॒मी॒ची॒नास॑ ऋ॒भव॒: सम॑स्वरन्रु॒द्रा गृ॑णन्त॒ पूर्व्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ pūrvá-pītaye ǀ índra ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀsam-īcīnā́saḥ ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ gṛṇanta ǀ pū́rvyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men glorify you,Indra, with hymns that you may drink the first (of the gods); the associated Ṛbhusunite in your praise, theRudrasglorify the ancient (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदिन्द्रो॑ वावृधे॒ वृष्ण्यं॒ शवो॒ मदे॑ सु॒तस्य॒ विष्ण॑वि । अ॒द्या तम॑स्य महि॒मान॑मा॒यवोऽनु॑ ष्टुवन्ति पू॒र्वथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ śávaḥ ǀ máde ǀ sutásya ǀ víṣṇavi ǀadyá ǀ tám ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ stuvanti ǀ pūrvá-thā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraaugments the energy and the strength of this (his worshipper), when he exhilaration of the Somais diffused through his body; men celebrate in due order his might today as they did of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त्वा॑ यामि सु॒वीर्यं॒ तद्ब्रह्म॑ पू॒र्वचि॑त्तये । येना॒ यति॑भ्यो॒ भृग॑वे॒ धने॑ हि॒ते येन॒ प्रस्क॑ण्व॒मावि॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ tvā ǀ yāmi ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ tát ǀ bráhma ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀyéna ǀ yáti-bhyaḥ ǀ bhṛ́gave ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀ yéna ǀ práskaṇvam ǀ ā́vitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I solicit you,Indra, for such vigour and for such food as may be hoped for in priority (to others),wherewith you have granted toBhṛguthe wealth taken from those who had desired from sacrifices, wherewithyou have protected prakṣaṇva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येना॑ समु॒द्रमसृ॑जो म॒हीर॒पस्तदि॑न्द्र॒ वृष्णि॑ ते॒ शव॑: । स॒द्यः सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा न सं॒नशे॒ यं क्षो॒णीर॑नुचक्र॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ samudrám ǀ ásṛjaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ vṛ́ṣṇi ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́ ǀ ná ǀ sam-náśe ǀ yám ǀ kṣoṇī́ḥ ǀ anu-cakradé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wherewith you have sent the great waters tot he ocean; such as is your wish-fulfilling strength; thatmight ofIndrais not easily to be resisted which the earth obeys.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒ग्धी न॑ इन्द्र॒ यत्त्वा॑ र॒यिं यामि॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म् । श॒ग्धि वाजा॑य प्रथ॒मं सिषा॑सते श॒ग्धि स्तोमा॑य पूर्व्य
shlokas.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ rayím ǀ yā́mi ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀśagdhí ǀ vā́jāya ǀ prathamám ǀ sísāsate ǀ śagdhí ǀ stómāya ǀ pūrvya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, the wealth accompanied by vigour, which I solicit from you; give (wealth) first of all tohim desirous of gratifying you, presenting (sacrificial) food; give (wealth), you who are of old, to him who glorifiesyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒ग्धी नो॑ अ॒स्य यद्ध॑ पौ॒रमावि॑थ॒ धिय॑ इन्द्र॒ सिषा॑सतः । श॒ग्धि यथा॒ रुश॑मं॒ श्याव॑कं॒ कृप॒मिन्द्र॒ प्राव॒: स्व॑र्णरम्
shlokas.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ paurám ǀ ā́vitha ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sísāsataḥ ǀśagdhí ǀ yáthā ǀ rúśamam ǀ śyā́vakam ǀ kṛ́pam ǀ índra ǀ prá ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ sváḥ-naram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give to this our (worshipper) engaged in celebrating your sacred rites,Indra, (the wealth) whereby youhave protected the son ofPuru, grant to the man (aspiring) to heaven (the wealth wherewith) you havepreserved, O Indra,Ruśama, Śyāvaka andKṛpa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कन्नव्यो॑ अत॒सीनां॑ तु॒रो गृ॑णीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । न॒ही न्व॑स्य महि॒मान॑मिन्द्रि॒यं स्व॑र्गृ॒णन्त॑ आन॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ návyaḥ ǀ atasī́nām ǀ turáḥ ǀ gṛṇīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀnahí ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ indriyám ǀ sváḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What living mortal, the prompter of ever-rising (praises), may now glorifyIndra? No one of thoseheretofore praising him have attained the greatness of the properties of Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कदु॑ स्तु॒वन्त॑ ऋतयन्त दे॒वत॒ ऋषि॒: को विप्र॑ ओहते । क॒दा हवं॑ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्व॒तः कदु॑ स्तुव॒त आ ग॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuvántaḥ ǀ ṛta-yanta ǀ devátā ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ohate ǀkadā́ ǀ hávam ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, praising you as the deity, (ever) hoped to sacrifice to you? What saint, what sage conveys (hispraises to yo?) When, opulentIndra, have you come to the invocation of one pouring out libations, of onerepeating (your) praise?”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्ये मधु॑मत्तमा॒ गिर॒: स्तोमा॑स ईरते । स॒त्रा॒जितो॑ धन॒सा अक्षि॑तोतयो वाज॒यन्तो॒ रथा॑ इव
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ īrate ǀsatrā-jítaḥ ǀ dhana-sā́ḥ ǀ ákṣita-ūtayaḥ ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These most sweet songs, these hymns of praise ascent (to you), like triumphant chariots laden withwealth, charged with unfailing protections, intended to procure food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कण्वा॑ इव॒ भृग॑व॒: सूर्या॑ इव॒ विश्व॒मिद्धी॒तमा॑नशुः । इन्द्रं॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्म॒हय॑न्त आ॒यव॑: प्रि॒यमे॑धासो अस्वरन्
shlokas.transliteration: káṇvāḥ-iva ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ sū́ryāḥ-iva ǀ víśvam ǀ ít ǀ dhītám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀíndram ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ priyá-medhāsaḥ ǀ asvaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBhṛgus, like theKaṇvas, have verily attained to the all- pervading (Indra), on whom they havemeditated, as the sun (pervades the unverse by his rays); men of thePriyamedharace, worshipping Indra withpraises glorify him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि वृ॑त्रहन्तम॒ हरी॑ इन्द्र परा॒वत॑: । अ॒र्वा॒ची॒नो म॑घव॒न्त्सोम॑पीतय उ॒ग्र ऋ॒ष्वेभि॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ hárī íti ǀ indra ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀarvācīnáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ṛṣvébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utter destroyer ofVṛtra, harness your horses come down to us, fierceMaghavan, with your attendantsfrom afar to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे हि ते॑ का॒रवो॑ वाव॒शुर्धि॒या विप्रा॑सो मे॒धसा॑तये । स त्वं नो॑ मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वे॒नो न शृ॑णुधी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ vāvaśúḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ medhá-sātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ venáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śṛṇudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These wise celebrators (of holy rites) repeatedly propitiate you with pious praise for the acceptance ofthe sacrifice; do you, opulentIndra, who are entitled to praise, hear our invocation like one who listens to what hedesires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निरि॑न्द्र बृह॒तीभ्यो॑ वृ॒त्रं धनु॑भ्यो अस्फुरः । निरर्बु॑दस्य॒ मृग॑यस्य मा॒यिनो॒ निः पर्व॑तस्य॒ गा आ॑जः
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ indra ǀ bṛhatī́bhyaḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ dhánu-bhyaḥ ǀ asphuraḥ ǀníḥ ǀ árbudasya ǀ mṛ́gayasya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ párvatasya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ājaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have extirpatedVṛtrawith your mighty weapons; you have been the destroyer of the deceptiveArbuda and Ṃgaya; you have extricated the cattle from the mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निर॒ग्नयो॑ रुरुचु॒र्निरु॒ सूर्यो॒ निः सोम॑ इन्द्रि॒यो रस॑: । निर॒न्तरि॑क्षादधमो म॒हामहिं॑ कृ॒षे तदि॑न्द्र॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ rurucuḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indriyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀníḥ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ adhamaḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ áhim ǀ kṛṣé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you had expelled the mighty Ahi from the firmament, then the fires blazed out, the sun shoneforth, the ambrosialSomadestined forIndraflowed out, and you, Indra, did manifest your manhood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं मे॒ दुरिन्द्रो॑ म॒रुत॒: पाक॑स्थामा॒ कौर॑याणः । विश्वे॑षां॒ त्मना॒ शोभि॑ष्ठ॒मुपे॑व दि॒वि धाव॑मानम्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ me ǀ dúḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ pā́ka-sthāmā ǀ káurayāṇaḥ ǀvíśveṣām ǀ tmánā ǀ śóbhiṣṭham ǀ úpa-iva ǀ diví ǀ dhā́vamānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such wealth asIndraand theMarutshave bestowed upon me, such has Pākasthāman, the son ofKurayāṇa, bestowed, of itself the most magnificent of all, like the quick-moving (sun) in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रोहि॑तं मे॒ पाक॑स्थामा सु॒धुरं॑ कक्ष्य॒प्राम् । अदा॑द्रा॒यो वि॒बोध॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: róhitam ǀ me ǀ pā́ka-sthāmā ǀ su-dhúram ǀ kakṣya-prā́m ǀádāt ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vi-bódhanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pākasthāman has given me a tawny robust beast of burden, the means of acquiring riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॑ अ॒न्ये दश॒ प्रति॒ धुरं॒ वह॑न्ति॒ वह्न॑यः । अस्तं॒ वयो॒ न तुग्र्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ anyé ǀ dáśa ǀ práti ǀ dhúram ǀ váhanti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀástam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ túgryam ǁ
