shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose burden ten other bearers (of loads) (would be required) to convey, such as were the steeds thatboreBhujyuhome.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒त्मा पि॒तुस्त॒नूर्वास॑ ओजो॒दा अ॒भ्यञ्ज॑नम् । तु॒रीय॒मिद्रोहि॑तस्य॒ पाक॑स्थामानं भो॒जं दा॒तार॑मब्रवम्
shlokas.transliteration: ātmā́ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ tanū́ḥ ǀ vā́saḥ ǀ ojaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ abhi-áñjanam ǀturī́yam ǀ ít ǀ róhitasya ǀ pā́ka-sthāmānam ǀ bhojám ǀ dātā́ram ǀ abravam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His father's own son, the giver of dwellings, the sustainer of strength like (invigorating) unguents, Icelebrate Pākasthāman, the destroyer (of foes), the despoiler (of enemies), the donor of the tawny (horse).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ प्रागपा॒गुद॒ङ्न्य॑ग्वा हू॒यसे॒ नृभि॑: । सिमा॑ पु॒रू नृषू॑तो अ॒स्यान॒वेऽसि॑ प्रशर्ध तु॒र्वशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ prā́k ǀ ápāk ǀ údak ǀ nyák ǀ vā ǀ hūyáse ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀsíma ǀ purú ǀ nṛ́-sūtaḥ ǀ asi ǀ ā́nave ǀ ási ǀ pra-śardha ǀ turváśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as you are invoked by the people in the east, in the west, in the north, in the south, so,excellent Indra, have you been incited by men on behalf of the son of Anu; so, overcomer of foes, (have you beencalled upon) on behalf ofTurvaśa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॒ रुमे॒ रुश॑मे॒ श्याव॑के॒ कृप॒ इन्द्र॑ मा॒दय॑से॒ सचा॑ । कण्वा॑सस्त्वा॒ ब्रह्म॑भि॒: स्तोम॑वाहस॒ इन्द्रा य॑च्छ॒न्त्या ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ rúme ǀ rúśame ǀ śyā́vake ǀ kṛ́pe ǀ índra ǀ mādáyase ǀ sácā ǀkáṇvāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bráhma-bhiḥ ǀ stóma-vāhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ ā́ ǀ yacchanti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch,Indra, as you have been exhilarated in the society ofRuma,Ruśama, Śyāvaka andKṛpa,so theKaṇvas, bearers of oblations, attract you with their praises, (therefore) come here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ गौ॒रो अ॒पा कृ॒तं तृष्य॒न्नेत्यवेरि॑णम् । आ॒पि॒त्वे न॑: प्रपि॒त्वे तूय॒मा ग॑हि॒ कण्वे॑षु॒ सु सचा॒ पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ gauráḥ ǀ apā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀ tṛ́ṣyan ǀ éti ǀ áva ǀ íriṇam ǀā-pitvé ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-pitvé ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ sú ǀ sácā ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the thirstyGaurahastens to the pool filled with water in the desert, so, (Indra), our affinity beingacknowledged, come quickly, and drink freely with theKaṇvas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्द॑न्तु त्वा मघवन्नि॒न्द्रेन्द॑वो राधो॒देया॑य सुन्व॒ते । आ॒मुष्या॒ सोम॑मपिबश्च॒मू सु॒तं ज्येष्ठं॒ तद्द॑धिषे॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mándantu ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ índavaḥ ǀ rādhaḥ-déyāya ǀ sunvaté ǀā-múṣya ǀ sómam ǀ apibaḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutám ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ tát ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentIndra, may theSomadrops exhilate you, that you may bestow wealth on the donor of thelibation; for taking it by stealth (when given), you have drunk the Soma poured out into the ladle, and havethence sustained pre- eminent strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र च॑क्रे॒ सह॑सा॒ सहो॑ ब॒भञ्ज॑ म॒न्युमोज॑सा । विश्वे॑ त इन्द्र पृतना॒यवो॑ यहो॒ नि वृ॒क्षा इ॑व येमिरे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ cakre ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ babháñja ǀ manyúm ǀ ójasā ǀvíśve ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pṛtanā-yávaḥ ǀ yaho íti ǀ ní ǀ vṛkṣā́ḥ-iva ǀ yemire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By his strength he has overpowered the strength (of his foes), he has crushed thei wrath by hisprowess; all hostile armies have been arrested like trees (immoveable through fear), mightyIndra, by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रे॑णेव सचते यवी॒युधा॒ यस्त॒ आन॒ळुप॑स्तुतिम् । पु॒त्रं प्रा॑व॒र्गं कृ॑णुते सु॒वीर्ये॑ दा॒श्नोति॒ नम॑उक्तिभिः
shlokas.transliteration: sahásreṇa-iva ǀ sacate ǀ yavi-yúdhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ úpa-stutim ǀputrám ǀ prāvargám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ su-vī́rye ǀ dāśnóti ǀ náma_ukti-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has made his praise attain to you associates himself with a thousand gallant combatants; hewho offers oblations with reverence begets a valiant son, the scatterer (of enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा भे॑म॒ मा श्र॑मिष्मो॒ग्रस्य॑ स॒ख्ये तव॑ । म॒हत्ते॒ वृष्णो॑ अभि॒चक्ष्यं॑ कृ॒तं पश्ये॑म तु॒र्वशं॒ यदु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ bhema ǀ mā́ ǀ śramiṣma ǀ ugrásya ǀ sakhyé ǀ táva ǀmahát ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ abhi-cákṣyam ǀ kṛtám ǀ páśyema ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Secure) in the friendship of you who are terrible, let us not fear, let us not be harassed; great andglorious, showerer (of benefits), are your deeds, as we may behold them in the case ofTurvaśa, ofYadu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒व्यामनु॑ स्फि॒ग्यं॑ वावसे॒ वृषा॒ न दा॒नो अ॑स्य रोषति । मध्वा॒ सम्पृ॑क्ताः सार॒घेण॑ धे॒नव॒स्तूय॒मेहि॒ द्रवा॒ पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: savyā́m ǀ ánu ǀ sphigyám ǀ vavase ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ná ǀ dānáḥ ǀ asya ǀ roṣati ǀmádhvā ǀ sám-pṛktāḥ ǀ sāraghéṇa ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ dráva ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits) with his left hip covers (the world), no tearer (of it) angers him; the delightful(Somajuices) are mixed with the sweet honey of the bee; come quickly hither, hasten, drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒श्वी र॒थी सु॑रू॒प इद्गोमाँ॒ इदि॑न्द्र ते॒ सखा॑ । श्वा॒त्र॒भाजा॒ वय॑सा सचते॒ सदा॑ च॒न्द्रो या॑ति स॒भामुप॑
shlokas.transliteration: aśvī́ ǀ rathī́ ǀ su-rūpáḥ ǀ ít ǀ gó-mān ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ sákhā ǀśvātra-bhā́jā ǀ váyasā ǀ sacate ǀ sádā ǀ candráḥ ǀ yāti ǀ sabhā́m ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is your friend,Indra, is verily possessed of horses, of cars, of cattle, and is of goodly form; he isever supplied with food-comprising riches, and delighting all, he enters an assembly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋश्यो॒ न तृष्य॑न्नव॒पान॒मा ग॑हि॒ पिबा॒ सोमं॒ वशाँ॒ अनु॑ । नि॒मेघ॑मानो मघवन्दि॒वेदि॑व॒ ओजि॑ष्ठं दधिषे॒ सह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́śyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tṛ́ṣyan ǀ ava-pā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ váśān ǀ ánu ǀni-méghamānaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ divé-dive ǀ ójiṣṭham ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come like a thirsty deer to the watering plural ce, drink at will of theSoma, whence, daily driving down theclouds, you sustain,Maghavan, most vigorous strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यो द्रा॒वया॒ त्वं सोम॒मिन्द्र॑: पिपासति । उप॑ नू॒नं यु॑युजे॒ वृष॑णा॒ हरी॒ आ च॑ जगाम वृत्र॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ draváya ǀ tvám ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ pipāsati ǀúpa ǀ nūnám ǀ yuyuje ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ jagāma ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly, priest, pour forth theSoma, forIndrais thirsty; verily he has harnessed his vigorous steeds, theslayer ofVṛtra hasarrived.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒यं चि॒त्स म॑न्यते॒ दाशु॑रि॒र्जनो॒ यत्रा॒ सोम॑स्य तृ॒म्पसि॑ । इ॒दं ते॒ अन्नं॒ युज्यं॒ समु॑क्षितं॒ तस्येहि॒ प्र द्र॑वा॒ पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: svayám ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ manyate ǀ dā́śuriḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ sómasya ǀ tṛmpási ǀidám ǀ te ǀ ánnam ǀ yújyam ǀ sám-ukṣitam ǀ tásya ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ drava ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who is the donor (of the oblation), he with (the gift of whose) libation you are satisfied,possesses of himself understanding; this your appropriate food is ready; come, hasten, drink of it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒थे॒ष्ठाया॑ध्वर्यव॒: सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य सोतन । अधि॑ ब्र॒ध्नस्याद्र॑यो॒ वि च॑क्षते सु॒न्वन्तो॑ दा॒श्व॑ध्वरम्
shlokas.transliteration: rathe-sthā́ya ǀ adhvaryavaḥ ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ sotana ǀádhi ǀ bradhnásya ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀ ví ǀ cakṣate ǀ sunvántaḥ ǀ dāśú-adhvaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour our, priests, theSomalibation toIndrain his chariot; the stones, plural ced upon their bases, arebeheld effusing the Soma for the sacrifice of the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ ब्र॒ध्नं वा॒वाता॒ वृष॑णा॒ हरी॒ इन्द्र॑म॒पसु॑ वक्षतः । अ॒र्वाञ्चं॑ त्वा॒ सप्त॑योऽध्वर॒श्रियो॒ वह॑न्तु॒ सव॒नेदुप॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ bradhnám ǀ vavā́tā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀ índram ǀ apá-su ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀarvā́ñcam ǀ tvā ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ adhvara-śríyaḥ ǀ váhantu ǀ sávanā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May his vigorous horses, repeatedly traversing the firmament, bringIndrato our rites; may your steeds,glorious through sacrifice, bring you indeed to the (daily) ceremonials.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पू॒षणं॑ वृणीमहे॒ युज्या॑य पुरू॒वसु॑म् । स श॑क्र शिक्ष पुरुहूत नो धि॒या तुजे॑ रा॒ये वि॑मोचन
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ yújyāya ǀ puru-vásum ǀsáḥ ǀ śakra ǀ śikṣa ǀ puru-hūta ǀ naḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ túje ǀ rāyé ǀ vi-mocana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have recourse to the opulentPūṣanfor his alliance; do you,Śakra, the adored of many, theliberator (from iniquity), enable us to acquire by our intelligence, wealth and victory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं न॑: शिशीहि भु॒रिजो॑रिव क्षु॒रं रास्व॑ रा॒यो वि॑मोचन । त्वे तन्न॑: सु॒वेद॑मु॒स्रियं॒ वसु॒ यं त्वं हि॒नोषि॒ मर्त्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ naḥ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ bhuríjoḥ-iva ǀ kṣurám ǀ rā́sva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ vi-mocana ǀtvé íti ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ su-védam ǀ usríyam ǀ vásu ǀ yám ǀ tvám ǀ hinóṣi ǀ mártyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sharpen us like a razor in thehands(of a barber); grant us riches, liberator (from iniquity), the wealth ofcattle easily obtained by us from you, such wealth as you bestow upon the (pious) mortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेमि॑ त्वा पूषन्नृ॒ञ्जसे॒ वेमि॒ स्तोत॑व आघृणे । न तस्य॑ वे॒म्यर॑णं॒ हि तद्व॑सो स्तु॒षे प॒ज्राय॒ साम्ने॑
shlokas.transliteration: vémi ǀ tvā ǀ pūṣan ǀ ṛñjáse ǀ vémi ǀ stótave ǀ āghṛṇe ǀná ǀ tásya ǀ vemi ǀ áraṇam ǀ hí ǀ tát ǀ vaso íti ǀ stuṣé ǀ pajrā́ya ǀ sā́mne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I desire,Pūṣan, to propitiate you; I desire, illustrious deity, to glorify you; I desire not (to offer)ungracious praise to any other; (grant riches), bestower of wealth, to him who praises, eulogizes, and glorifiesyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॒ गावो॒ यव॑सं॒ कच्चि॑दाघृणे॒ नित्यं॒ रेक्णो॑ अमर्त्य । अ॒स्माकं॑ पूषन्नवि॒ता शि॒वो भ॑व॒ मंहि॑ष्ठो॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ yávasam ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ nítyam ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ amartya ǀasmā́kam ǀ pūṣan ǀ avitā́ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ bhava ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Illustrious (Pūṣan), my cattle go forth occasionally to pasture, may that wealth (of herds), immortaldeity, be permanent; being my protector, Pūṣan, be the granter of felicity, be most bountiful in bestowing food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्थू॒रं राध॑: श॒ताश्वं॑ कुरु॒ङ्गस्य॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु । राज्ञ॑स्त्वे॒षस्य॑ सु॒भग॑स्य रा॒तिषु॑ तु॒र्वशे॑ष्वमन्महि
shlokas.transliteration: sthūrám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ śatá-aśvam ǀ kuruṅgásya ǀ díviṣṭiṣu ǀrā́jñaḥ ǀ tveṣásya ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ rātíṣu ǀ turváśeṣu ǀ amanmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We acknowledge the substantial wealth (of the gift) of a hundred horses, the donation made to usamong men at the holy solemnities of the illustrious and auspiciousRājāKuruṅga.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धी॒भिः सा॒तानि॑ का॒ण्वस्य॑ वा॒जिन॑: प्रि॒यमे॑धैर॒भिद्यु॑भिः । ष॒ष्टिं स॒हस्रानु॒ निर्म॑जामजे॒ निर्यू॒थानि॒ गवा॒मृषि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dhībhíḥ ǀ sātā́ni ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ priyá-medhaiḥ ǀ abhídyu-bhiḥ ǀṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ ánu ǀ níḥ-majām ǀ aje ǀ níḥ ǀ yūthā́ni ǀ gávām ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I, the Ṛṣi (Devātithi), have received subsequently the complete donation; the sixty thousand herds ofpure cattle merited by the devotions of the pious son ofKaṇva, and by the illustriousPriyamedhas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒क्षाश्चि॑न्मे अभिपि॒त्वे अ॑रारणुः । गां भ॑जन्त मे॒हनाश्वं॑ भजन्त मे॒हना॑
shlokas.transliteration: vṛkṣā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ me ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ araraṇuḥ ǀgā́m ǀ bhajanta ǀ mehánā ǀ áśvam ǀ bhajanta ǀ mehánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon the acceptance of this donation to me, the very trees have exclaimed; (see these ṛṣis) haveacquired excellent cows excellent horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒रादि॒हेव॒ यत्स॒त्य॑रु॒णप्सु॒रशि॑श्वितत् । वि भा॒नुं वि॒श्वधा॑तनत्
shlokas.transliteration: dūrā́t ǀ ihá-iva ǀ yát ǀ satī́ ǀ aruṇá-psuḥ ǀ áśiśvitat ǀví ǀ bhānúm ǀ viśvádhā ǀ atanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the shining dawn, advancing hither from afar, whitens (all things), she spreads the light on allsides.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒वद्द॑स्रा मनो॒युजा॒ रथे॑न पृथु॒पाज॑सा । सचे॑थे अश्विनो॒षस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-vát ǀ dasrā ǀ manaḥ-yújā ǀ ráthena ǀ pṛthu-pā́jasā ǀsácethe íti ǀ aśvinā ǀ uṣásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And you,Aśvins, of goodly aspect, accompany the dawn like leader with your mighty chariot harnessedat a thought.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वाभ्यां॑ वाजिनीवसू॒ प्रति॒ स्तोमा॑ अदृक्षत । वाचं॑ दू॒तो यथो॑हिषे
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́bhyām ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ práti ǀ stómāḥ ǀ adṛkṣata ǀvā́cam ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ohiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By you, affluent in sacrifices, may our praises be severally accepted; I bear the words (of theworshipper) like a messenger (to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒प्रि॒या ण॑ ऊ॒तये॑ पुरुम॒न्द्रा पु॑रू॒वसू॑ । स्तु॒षे कण्वा॑सो अ॒श्विना॑
shlokas.transliteration: puru-priyā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ puru-mandrā́ ǀ puruvásū íti puru-vásū ǀstuṣé ǀ káṇvāsaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We,Kaṇvas, praise for our protection the many-loved, the many- delightingAśvins, abounding inwealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मंहि॑ष्ठा वाज॒सात॑मे॒षय॑न्ता शु॒भस्पती॑ । गन्ता॑रा दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ vāja-sā́tamā ǀ iṣáyantā ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀgántārā ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most adorable bestowwers of strength, distributors of food, lords of opulence, repairers to the dwellingof the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता सु॑दे॒वाय॑ दा॒शुषे॑ सुमे॒धामवि॑तारिणीम् । घृ॒तैर्गव्यू॑तिमुक्षतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ su-devā́ya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ su-medhā́m ǀ ávi-tāriṇīm ǀghṛtáiḥ ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ukṣatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sprinkle well with water the pure unfailing pasturage (of his cattle) for the devout donor (of theoblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒: स्तोम॒मुप॑ द्र॒वत्तूयं॑ श्ये॒नेभि॑रा॒शुभि॑: । या॒तमश्वे॑भिरश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ úpa ǀ dravát ǀ tū́yam ǀ śyenébhiḥ ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀyātám ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, to our adoration, hastening quickly with your rapid falcon-like horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येभि॑स्ति॒स्रः प॑रा॒वतो॑ दि॒वो विश्वा॑नि रोच॒ना । त्रीँर॒क्तून्प॑रि॒दीय॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: yébhiḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ rocanā́ ǀtrī́n ǀ aktū́n ǀ pari-dī́yathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With which in three days and three nights you traverse from afar all the brilliant (constellations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ गोम॑ती॒रिष॑ उ॒त सा॒तीर॑हर्विदा । वि प॒थः सा॒तये॑ सितम्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ utá ǀ sātī́ḥ ǀ ahaḥ-vidā ǀví ǀ patháḥ ǀ sātáye ǀ sitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bringers of the day, (bestow) upon us food with cattle, or donations of wealth, and close the path(against aggression) upon our gains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ गोम॑न्तमश्विना सु॒वीरं॑ सु॒रथं॑ र॒यिम् । वो॒ळ्हमश्वा॑वती॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ su-rátham ǀ rayím ǀvoḷhám ǀ áśva-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us,Aśvins, riches comprising cattle,maleoffspring, chariots, horses, food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒वृ॒धा॒ना शु॑भस्पती दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी । पिब॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: vavṛdhānā́ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ dásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀpíbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Magnificent lords of good fortune, handsomeAśvins, riding in a golden chariot, drink the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ वाजिनीवसू म॒घव॑द्भ्यश्च स॒प्रथ॑: । छ॒र्दिर्य॑न्त॒मदा॑भ्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀchardíḥ ǀ yantam ǀ ádābhyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent i sacrifices, grant to us who are opulent (in oblations) a spacious unassailable dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि षु ब्रह्म॒ जना॑नां॒ यावि॑ष्टं॒ तूय॒मा ग॑तम् । मो ष्व१॒॑न्याँ उपा॑रतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sú ǀ bráhma ǀ jánānām ǀ yā́ ǀ áviṣṭam ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀmó íti ǀ sú ǀ anyā́n ǀ úpa ǀ aratam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you ever carefully protect theBrahmanamong men, come quickly; tarry not with other(worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य पि॑बतमश्विना यु॒वं मद॑स्य॒ चारु॑णः । मध्वो॑ रा॒तस्य॑ धिष्ण्या
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ mádasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ rātásya ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableAśvins, drink of this exhilarating, delightful, sweetSoma, presented by us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे आ व॑हतं र॒यिं श॒तव॑न्तं सह॒स्रिण॑म् । पु॒रु॒क्षुं वि॒श्वधा॑यसम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ vahatam ǀ rayím ǀ śatá-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀpuru-kṣúm ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring unto us riches by hundreds and by thousands, desired by many, sustaining all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒त्रा चि॒द्धि वां॑ नरा वि॒ह्वय॑न्ते मनी॒षिण॑: । वा॒घद्भि॑रश्वि॒ना ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-trā́ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ vi-hváyante ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀvāghát-bhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), wise men worship you in many plural ces; come to us with your steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जना॑सो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषो ह॒विष्म॑न्तो अरं॒कृत॑: । यु॒वां ह॑वन्ते अश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: jánāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ aram-kṛ́taḥ ǀyuvā́m ǀ havante ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men bearing the clipped sacred grass, presenting oblations, and completely fulfilling (their functions),worship you,Aśvin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्य वा॑म॒यं स्तोमो॒ वाहि॑ष्ठो॒ अन्त॑मः । यु॒वाभ्यां॑ भूत्वश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ vām ǀ ayám ǀ stómaḥ ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǀyuvā́bhyām ǀ bhūtu ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this our praise today be conveyed successfully to you,Aśvins, and be most near to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ह॑ वां॒ मधु॑नो॒ दृति॒राहि॑तो रथ॒चर्ष॑णे । तत॑: पिबतमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ dṛ́tiḥ ǀ ā́-hitaḥ ǀ ratha-cárṣaṇe ǀtátaḥ ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Aśvins, from the skin (filled) with the sweet (Soma) which is suspended in view of your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेन॑ नो वाजिनीवसू॒ पश्वे॑ तो॒काय॒ शं गवे॑ । वह॑तं॒ पीव॑री॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: téna ǀ naḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ páśve ǀ tokā́ya ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀváhatam ǀ pī́varīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent in oblations, bring to us with that (chariot) abundant food, so that there may be prosperity inhorses, progeny, and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॑ दि॒व्या इष॑ उ॒त सिन्धूँ॑रहर्विदा । अप॒ द्वारे॑व वर्षथः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ utá ǀ síndhūn ǀ ahaḥ-vidā ǀápa ǀ dvā́rā-iva ǀ varṣathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bringers of the day, you rain upon us by the (open) door (of the clouds) the waters of heaven, or (withthem fill) the rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा वां॑ तौ॒ग्र्यो वि॑धत्समु॒द्रे ज॑हि॒तो न॑रा । यद्वां॒ रथो॒ विभि॒ष्पता॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ vām ǀ taugryáḥ ǀ vidhat ǀ samudré ǀ jahitáḥ ǀ narā ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ví-bhiḥ ǀ pátāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When did the son ofTugra, thrown into the ocean, glorify you, leaders (of rites)? then when yourchariot and horses descended.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं कण्वा॑य नासत्या॒ ऋपि॑रिप्ताय ह॒र्म्ये । शश्व॑दू॒तीर्द॑शस्यथः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ káṇvāya ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ápi-riptāya ǀ harmyé ǀśáśvat ǀ ūtī́ḥ ǀ daśasyathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “toKaṇvawhen blinded (by theAsuras) in his dwelling, you rendered, Na-satyās, effectual aiḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताभि॒रा या॑तमू॒तिभि॒र्नव्य॑सीभिः सुश॒स्तिभि॑: । यद्वां॑ वृषण्वसू हु॒वे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ návyasībhiḥ ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀyát ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ huvé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rich in showers, come with your newest and most excellent protections when I call upon you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ चि॒त्कण्व॒माव॑तं प्रि॒यमे॑धमुपस्तु॒तम् । अत्रिं॑ शि॒ञ्जार॑मश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ cit ǀ káṇvam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ priyá-medham ǀ upa-stutám ǀátrim ǀ śiñjā́ram ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as you protectedKaṇva,Priyamedha, Upastuta, and the praise-repeatingAtri.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथो॒त कृत्व्ये॒ धनें॒ऽशुं गोष्व॒गस्त्य॑म् । यथा॒ वाजे॑षु॒ सोभ॑रिम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ utá ǀ kṛ́tvye ǀ dháne ǀ aṃśúm ǀ góṣu ǀ agástyam ǀyáthā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ sóbharim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And in like manner as (you protected) Anshu when wealth was to be bestowed, andAgastyawhen hiscattle (were to be recovered), and Sobhari when food (was to be supplied to him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑द्वां वृषण्वसू॒ अतो॑ वा॒ भूयो॑ अश्विना । गृ॒णन्त॑: सु॒म्नमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: etā́vat ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ átaḥ ǀ vā ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀgṛṇántaḥ ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So pariasing you,Aśvins, rich in showers, we solicit of you happiness as great or greater than that(which they obtained).”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ हिर॑ण्यवन्धुरं॒ हिर॑ण्याभीशुमश्विना । आ हि स्थाथो॑ दिवि॒स्पृश॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ híraṇya-vandhuram ǀ híraṇya-abhīśum ǀ aśvinā ǀā́ ǀ hí ǀ sthā́thaḥ ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ascend,Aśvins, your sky-touching chariot with a golden seat and golden reins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒र॒ण्ययी॑ वां॒ रभि॑री॒षा अक्षो॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑: । उ॒भा च॒क्रा हि॑र॒ण्यया॑
shlokas.transliteration: hiraṇyáyīm ǀ vām ǀ rábhiḥ ǀ īṣā́ ǀ ákṣaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ cakrā́ ǀ hiraṇyáyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Golden is its supporting shaft, golden the axle, golden both the wheels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेन॑ नो वाजिनीवसू परा॒वत॑श्चि॒दा ग॑तम् । उपे॒मां सु॑ष्टु॒तिं मम॑
shlokas.transliteration: téna ǀ naḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀúpa ǀ imā́m ǀ su-stutím ǀ máma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us, affluent in sacrifices, from afar, come to this mine adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ व॑हेथे परा॒कात्पू॒र्वीर॒श्नन्ता॑वश्विना । इषो॒ दासी॑रमर्त्या
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vahethe íti ǀ parākā́t ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ aśnántau ǀ aśvinā ǀíṣaḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ amartyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImmortalAśvins, destroyers of the cities of theDāsas, you bring to us food from afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ द्यु॒म्नैरा श्रवो॑भि॒रा रा॒या या॑तमश्विना । पुरु॑श्चन्द्रा॒ नास॑त्या
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śrávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀpúru-candrā ǀ nā́satyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Aśvins, with food, with fame, with riches,Nāsatyās, delighters of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एह वां॑ प्रुषि॒तप्स॑वो॒ वयो॑ वहन्तु प॒र्णिन॑: । अच्छा॑ स्वध्व॒रं जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vām ǀ pruṣitá-psavaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ parṇínaḥ ǀáccha ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your sleek, winged, rapid (horses) bring you to the presence of the man offering holy sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॑ वा॒मनु॑गायसं॒ य इ॒षा वर्त॑ते स॒ह । न च॒क्रम॒भि बा॑धते
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ vām ǀ ánu-gāyasam ǀ yáḥ ǀ iṣā́ ǀ vártate ǀ sahá ǀná ǀ cakrám ǀ abhí ǀ bādhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No hostile force arrests that car of yours which is hymned (by the devout), and which is laden with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न॒ रथे॑न द्र॒वत्पा॑णिभि॒रश्वै॑: । धीज॑वना॒ नास॑त्या
shlokas.transliteration: hiraṇyáyena ǀ ráthena ǀ dravátpāṇi-bhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀdhī́-javanā ǀ nā́satyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rapid as thought,Nāsatyās, (come) with your golden chariot drawn by quick-footed steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं मृ॒गं जा॑गृ॒वांसं॒ स्वद॑थो वा वृषण्वसू । ता न॑: पृङ्क्तमि॒षा र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ mṛgám ǀ jāgṛ-vā́ṃsám ǀ svádathaḥ ǀ vā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pṛṅktam ǀ iṣā́ ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent in showers, taste the wakeful desirableSoma; combine for us riches with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता मे॑ अश्विना सनी॒नां वि॒द्यातं॒ नवा॑नाम् । यथा॑ चिच्चै॒द्यः क॒शुः श॒तमुष्ट्रा॑नां॒ दद॑त्स॒हस्रा॒ दश॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ me ǀ aśvinā ǀ sanīnā́m ǀ vidyā́tam ǀ návānām ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ caidyáḥ ǀ kaśúḥ ǀ śatám ǀ úṣṭrānām ǀ dádat ǀ sahásrā ǀ dáśa ǀ gónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Become appraised,Aśvins, of my recent gifts, how thatKaśu, the son ofCedi, has presented me with ahundred camels and ten thousand cows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो मे॒ हिर॑ण्यसंदृशो॒ दश॒ राज्ञो॒ अमं॑हत । अ॒ध॒स्प॒दा इच्चै॒द्यस्य॑ कृ॒ष्टय॑श्चर्म॒म्ना अ॒भितो॒ जना॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ híraṇya-sandṛśaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ ámaṃhata ǀadhaḥ-padā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ caidyásya ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ carma-mnā́ḥ ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ jánāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son ofCedi, who has given me for servants tenRājās, bright as gold, for all men are beneath hisfeet; all those around him wear cuirasses of leather.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माकि॑रे॒ना प॒था गा॒द्येने॒मे यन्ति॑ चे॒दय॑: । अ॒न्यो नेत्सू॒रिरोह॑ते भूरि॒दाव॑त्तरो॒ जन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́kiḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ pathā́ ǀ gāt ǀ yéna ǀ imé ǀ yánti ǀ cedáyaḥ ǀanyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ ít ǀ sūríḥ ǀ óhate ǀ bhūridā́vat-taraḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one proceeds by that path which theCedisfollow, no other proud man as a more liberal benefactorconfers (favour on those who praise him).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा प॒र्जन्यो॑ वृष्टि॒माँ इ॑व । स्तोमै॑र्व॒त्सस्य॑ वावृधे
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭimā́n-iva ǀstómaiḥ ǀ vatsásya ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is great in might likeParjanyathe disributor of rain, is magnified by the praises oVatsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒जामृ॒तस्य॒ पिप्र॑त॒: प्र यद्भर॑न्त॒ वह्न॑यः । विप्रा॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ वाह॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: pra-jā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ píprataḥ ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ bháranta ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀvíprāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ vā́hasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When his steeds filling (the heavens) bear onwards the progeny of the sacrifice, then the pious(magnify him) with the hymns of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कण्वा॒ इन्द्रं॒ यदक्र॑त॒ स्तोमै॑र्य॒ज्ञस्य॒ साध॑नम् । जा॒मि ब्रु॑वत॒ आयु॑धम्
shlokas.transliteration: káṇvāḥ ǀ índram ǀ yát ǀ ákrata ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀjāmí ǀ bruvate ǀ ā́yudham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theKaṇvasby their praises have madeIndrathe accomplisher of the sacrifice, they declare allweapons needless.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॑स्य म॒न्यवे॒ विशो॒ विश्वा॑ नमन्त कृ॒ष्टय॑: । स॒मु॒द्राये॑व॒ सिन्ध॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ asya ǀ manyáve ǀ víśaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ namanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀsamudrā́ya-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All people, (all) men bow down before his anger, as rivers (decline) towards the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओज॒स्तद॑स्य तित्विष उ॒भे यत्स॒मव॑र्तयत् । इन्द्र॒श्चर्मे॑व॒ रोद॑सी
shlokas.transliteration: ójaḥ ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ titviṣe ǀ ubhé íti ǀ yát ǀ sam-ávartayat ǀíndraḥ ǀ cárma-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His might is manifest, forIndrafolds and unfolds both heaven and earth, as (one spreads or rolls up) askin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि चि॑द्वृ॒त्रस्य॒ दोध॑तो॒ वज्रे॑ण श॒तप॑र्वणा । शिरो॑ बिभेद वृ॒ष्णिना॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ cit ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ dódhataḥ ǀ vájreṇa ǀ śatá-parvaṇā ǀśíraḥ ǀ bibheda ǀ vṛṣṇínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has cloven with the powerful hundred-edged thunderbolt the head of the turbulentVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा अ॒भि प्र णो॑नुमो वि॒पामग्रे॑षु धी॒तय॑: । अ॒ग्नेः शो॒चिर्न दि॒द्युत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ nonumaḥ ǀ vipā́m ǀ ágreṣu ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀagnéḥ ǀ śocíḥ ǀ ná ǀ didyútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In front of one worshipper we repeatedly utter our praises, radiant as the flame of fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गुहा॑ स॒तीरुप॒ त्मना॒ प्र यच्छोच॑न्त धी॒तय॑: । कण्वा॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: gúhā ǀ satī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tmánā ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ śócanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀkáṇvāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The praises that are offered in secret shine brightly when approaching (Indra) of their own will; theKaṇvas (combine them) with the stream of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तमि॑न्द्र नशीमहि र॒यिं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । प्र ब्रह्म॑ पू॒र्वचि॑त्तये
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tám ǀ indra ǀ naśīmahi ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀprá ǀ bráhma ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain,Indra, that wealth which comprises cattle, horses, and food, before it be known toothers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमिद्धि पि॒तुष्परि॑ मे॒धामृ॒तस्य॑ ज॒ग्रभ॑ । अ॒हं सूर्य॑ इवाजनि
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ pitúḥ ǀ pári ǀ medhā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ jagrábha ǀahám ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ ajani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have verily acquired the favour of the true protector (Indra); I have become (bright) as the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं प्र॒त्नेन॒ मन्म॑ना॒ गिर॑: शुम्भामि कण्व॒वत् । येनेन्द्र॒: शुष्म॒मिद्द॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ pratnéna ǀ mánmanā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhāmi ǀ kaṇva-vát ǀyéna ǀ índraḥ ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ít ǀ dadhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I grace my words with ancient praise, likeKaṇva; wherebyIndraassuredly enjoys vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये त्वामि॑न्द्र॒ न तु॑ष्टु॒वुॠष॑यो॒ ये च॑ तुष्टु॒वुः । ममेद्व॑र्धस्व॒ सुष्टु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ ná ǀ tustuvúḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ tustuvúḥ ǀmáma ǀ ít ǀ vardhasva ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Amid those who do not praise you,Indra, amid the Ṛṣis who do praise you, by my praise beingglorified, do you increase.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑स्य म॒न्युरध्व॑नी॒द्वि वृ॒त्रं प॑र्व॒शो रु॒जन् । अ॒पः स॑मु॒द्रमैर॑यत्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ asya ǀ manyúḥ ǀ ádhvanīt ǀ ví ǀ vṛtrám ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ ruján ǀapáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ áirayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When his wrath thundered, dividingVṛtrajoint by joint, then he drove the waters to the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि शुष्ण॑ इन्द्र धर्ण॒सिं वज्रं॑ जघन्थ॒ दस्य॑वि । वृषा॒ ह्यु॑ग्र शृण्वि॒षे
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ śúṣṇe ǀ indra ǀ dharṇasím ǀ vájram ǀ jaghantha ǀ dásyavi ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ugra ǀ śṛṇviṣé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have hurled your wielded thunderbolt upon the impiousŚuṣṇa; you are renowned, fierceIndra,as the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न द्याव॒ इन्द्र॒मोज॑सा॒ नान्तरि॑क्षाणि व॒ज्रिण॑म् । न वि॑व्यचन्त॒ भूम॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ójasā ǀ ná ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ vajríṇam ǀná ǀ vivyacanta ǀ bhū́mayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neither the heavens, nor the realms of the firmament, nor the regions of the earth, equal the thundererIndra in strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्त॑ इन्द्र म॒हीर॒पः स्त॑भू॒यमा॑न॒ आश॑यत् । नि तं पद्या॑सु शिश्नथः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ stabhu-yámānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ áśayat ǀní ǀ tám ǀ pádyāsu ǀ śiśnathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, have cast into the rushing streams him who lay obstructing your copious waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒मे रोद॑सी म॒ही स॑मी॒ची स॒मज॑ग्रभीत् । तमो॑भिरिन्द्र॒ तं गु॑हः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ sam-ájagrabhīt ǀtámaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ tám ǀ guhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have enveloped with darkness,Indra, him who had seized upon these spacious aggregated(realms of) heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॑न्द्र॒ यत॑यस्त्वा॒ भृग॑वो॒ ये च॑ तुष्टु॒वुः । ममेदु॑ग्र श्रुधी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ indra ǀ yátayaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ tustuvúḥ ǀmáma ǀ ít ǀ ugra ǀ śrudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Amid those pious sages, amid thoseBhṛgus, who have glorified you, hear also, fierceIndra, myinvocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मास्त॑ इन्द्र॒ पृश्न॑यो घृ॒तं दु॑हत आ॒शिर॑म् । ए॒नामृ॒तस्य॑ पि॒प्युषी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pṛ́śnayaḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ duhate ǀ ā-śíram ǀenā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pipyúṣīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These, your spotted cows, the nourishers of the sacrifice, yields,Indra, their butter, and this mixture (ofmilk and curds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या इ॑न्द्र प्र॒स्व॑स्त्वा॒सा गर्भ॒मच॑क्रिरन् । परि॒ धर्मे॑व॒ सूर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ indra ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ tvā ǀ āsā́ ǀ gárbham ǀ ácakriran ǀpári ǀ dhárma-iva ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These prolific cattle became pregnant, having taken into their mouths,Indra, (the products of yourvigour) like the all-sustaining sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिच्छ॑वसस्पते॒ कण्वा॑ उ॒क्थेन॑ वावृधुः । त्वां सु॒तास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ukthéna ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of strength, theKaṇvasverily invigorate you by praise; the effusedSoma(invigorates) you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवेदि॑न्द्र॒ प्रणी॑तिषू॒त प्रश॑स्तिरद्रिवः । य॒ज्ञो वि॑तन्त॒साय्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ prá-nītiṣu ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastiḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀyajñáḥ ǀ vitantasā́yyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, excellent praise (is addressed to you) on account of your goodguidance, as is a most extended sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्द्र म॒हीमिषं॒ पुरं॒ न द॑र्षि॒ गोम॑तीम् । उ॒त प्र॒जां सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ púram ǀ ná ǀ darṣi ǀ gó-matīm ǀutá ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be willing to grant us abundant food with cattle; (to grant us) protection, progeny, and vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्यदा॒श्वश्व्यं॒ यदि॑न्द्र॒ नाहु॑षी॒ष्वा । अग्रे॑ वि॒क्षु प्र॒दीद॑यत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyát ǀ āśu-áśvyam ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ nā́huṣīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀágre ǀ vikṣú ǀ pra-dī́dayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that herd of swift horses, which formerly shone among the people ofnahuṣa, (be granted),Indra,to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि व्र॒जं न त॑त्निषे॒ सूर॑ उपा॒कच॑क्षसम् । यदि॑न्द्र मृ॒ळया॑सि नः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vrajám ǀ ná ǀ tatniṣe ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ upāká-cakṣasam ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageIndra, you spread (the cattle) over the adjacent pastures when you are favourably inclined towardus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒ङ्ग त॑विषी॒यस॒ इन्द्र॑ प्र॒राज॑सि क्षि॒तीः । म॒हाँ अ॑पा॒र ओज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ taviṣī-yáse ǀ índra ǀ pra-rā́jasi ǀ kṣitī́ḥ ǀmahā́n ǀ apāráḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you put forth your might, you reign,Indra, over mankind; surpassing are you, and unlimited instrumental ength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ ह॒विष्म॑ती॒र्विश॒ उप॑ ब्रुवत ऊ॒तये॑ । उ॒रु॒ज्रय॑स॒मिन्दु॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ havíṣmatīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruvate ǀ ūtáye ǀuru-jráyasam ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The people offering oblations call upon you, the pervader of space, with libations for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒ह्व॒रे गि॑री॒णां सं॑ग॒थे च॑ न॒दीना॑म् । धि॒या विप्रो॑ अजायत
shlokas.transliteration: upa-hvaré ǀ girīṇā́m ǀ sam-gathé ǀ ca ǀ nadī́nām ǀdhiyā́ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ajāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (Indra) has been engendered by holy rites on the skirts of the mountains, at the confluence ofrivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑: समु॒द्रमु॒द्वत॑श्चिकि॒त्वाँ अव॑ पश्यति । यतो॑ विपा॒न एज॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ áva ǀ paśyati ǀyátaḥ ǀ vipānáḥ ǀ éjati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From the lofty region in which pervading he abides,Indrathe intelligent looks down upon the offeredlibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदित्प्र॒त्नस्य॒ रेत॑सो॒ ज्योति॑ष्पश्यन्ति वास॒रम् । प॒रो यदि॒ध्यते॑ दि॒वा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ pratnásya ǀ rétasaḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ paśyanti ǀ vāsarám ǀparáḥ ǀ yát ǀ idhyáte ǀ divā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then (men) behold the daily light of the ancient shedder of water, when he shines above the heaveṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: कण्वा॑स इन्द्र ते म॒तिं विश्वे॑ वर्धन्ति॒ पौंस्य॑म् । उ॒तो श॑विष्ठ॒ वृष्ण्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: káṇvāsaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ matím ǀ víśve ǀ vardhanti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀutó íti ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All theKaṇvas,Indra, magnify your wisdom, your manhood, and, most mighty one, your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां म॑ इन्द्र सुष्टु॒तिं जु॒षस्व॒ प्र सु माम॑व । उ॒त प्र व॑र्धया म॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ me ǀ indra ǀ su-stutím ǀ juṣásva ǀ prá ǀ sú ǀ mā́m ǀ ava ǀutá ǀ prá ǀ vardhaya ǀ matím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitiated,Indra, by this my praise; carefully protect me, and give increase to my understanding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त ब्र॑ह्म॒ण्या व॒यं तुभ्यं॑ प्रवृद्ध वज्रिवः । विप्रा॑ अतक्ष्म जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ brahmaṇyā́ ǀ vayám ǀ túbhyam ǀ pra-vṛddha ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀvíprāḥ ǀ atakṣma ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, magnified (by our praises), we your worshippers have offered to you theseprayers for our existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि कण्वा॑ अनूष॒तापो॒ न प्र॒वता॑ य॒तीः । इन्द्रं॒ वन॑न्वती म॒तिः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yatī́ḥ ǀíndram ǀ vánan-vatī ǀ matíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheKaṇvasglorifyIndra; like waters rushing down a declivity, praise spontaneously seeks Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑मु॒क्थानि॑ वावृधुः समु॒द्रमि॑व॒ सिन्ध॑वः । अनु॑त्तमन्युम॒जर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ samudrám-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀánutta-manyum ǀ ajáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Holy praises magnifyIndra, the imperishable, the implacable, as rivers (swell) the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ याहि परा॒वतो॒ हरि॑भ्यां हर्य॒ताभ्या॑म् । इ॒ममि॑न्द्र सु॒तं पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ haryatā́bhyām ǀimám ǀ indra ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us from afar with your beloved horses; drink,Indra, this libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृ॑त्रहन्तम॒ जना॑सो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । हव॑न्ते॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀhávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer ofVṛtra, men strewing the clipped sacred grass invoke you for the obtaining of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ त्वा॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे च॒क्रं न व॒र्त्येत॑शम् । अनु॑ सुवा॒नास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tvā ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ cakrám ǀ ná ǀ varti ǀ étaśam ǀánu ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both heaven and earth follow you as the wheels (of a car follow) the horse; the streams of the Somapoured forth (by the priests) follow (you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मन्द॑स्वा॒ सु स्व॑र्णर उ॒तेन्द्र॑ शर्य॒णाव॑ति । मत्स्वा॒ विव॑स्वतो म॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: mándasva ǀ sú ǀ sváḥ-nare ǀ utá ǀ indra ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǀmátsva ǀ vívasvataḥ ǀ matī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rejoice,Indra, at the heaven-guiding sacrifice as Śaryaṇāvat; be exhilarated by the praise of theworshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒वृ॒धा॒न उप॒ द्यवि॒ वृषा॑ व॒ज्र्य॑रोरवीत् । वृ॒त्र॒हा सो॑म॒पात॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vajrī́ ǀ aroravīt ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ soma-pā́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vast wielder of the thunderbolt, the slayer ofVṛtra, the deep quaffer of theSoma, the showerer,roars near athandin the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषि॒र्हि पू॑र्व॒जा अस्येक॒ ईशा॑न॒ ओज॑सा । इन्द्र॑ चोष्कू॒यसे॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ hí ǀ pūrva-jā́ḥ ǀ ási ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀíndra ǀ coṣkūyáse ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are a Ṛṣi, the first-born (of the gods), the chief, the ruler (over all) by your strength; you giverepeatedly,Indra, wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॑ त्वा सु॒ताँ उप॑ वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठा अ॒भि प्रय॑: । श॒तं व॑हन्तु॒ हर॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ tvā ǀ sutā́n ǀ úpa ǀ vītá-pṛṣṭhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀśatám ǀ vahantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your hundred sleek-backed horses bring you to our libations, to our (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां सु पू॒र्व्यां धियं॒ मधो॑र्घृ॒तस्य॑ पि॒प्युषी॑म् । कण्वा॑ उ॒क्थेन॑ वावृधुः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ sú ǀ pūrvyā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀkáṇvāḥ ǀ ukthéna ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheKaṇvasaugment by praise this ancient rite intended (to obtain) an abundance of sweet water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मिद्विम॑हीनां॒ मेधे॑ वृणीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । इन्द्रं॑ सनि॒ष्युरू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ ít ǀ ví-mahīnām ǀ médhe ǀ vṛṇīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀíndram ǀ saniṣyúḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mortal (adorer) selects at the sacrificeIndrafrom among the mighty (gods); he who is desirous ofwealth (worships) Indra for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चं॑ त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रि॒यमे॑धस्तुता॒ हरी॑ । सो॒म॒पेया॑य वक्षतः
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ tvā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ priyámedha-stutā ǀ hárī íti ǀsoma-péyāya ǀ vakṣataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your horses, praised by the pious priests, bring you, who are the praised of many, down to drinktheSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तम॒हं ति॒रिन्दि॑रे स॒हस्रं॒ पर्शा॒वा द॑दे । राधां॑सि॒ याद्वा॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ ahám ǀ tiríndire ǀ sahásram ǀ párśau ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀrā́dhāṃsi ǀ yā́dvānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have accepted from Tirindira, the son ofParaśu, hundreds and thousands of the treasures of meṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ श॒तान्यर्व॑तां स॒हस्रा॒ दश॒ गोना॑म् । द॒दुष्प॒ज्राय॒ साम्ने॑
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ śatā́ni ǀ árvatām ǀ sahásrā ǀ dáśa ǀ gónām ǀdadúḥ ǀ pajrā́ya ǀ sā́mne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(These princes) have given to the chanter Pajra three hundred horses, ten thousand cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदा॑नट् ककु॒हो दिव॒मुष्ट्रा॑ञ्चतु॒र्युजो॒ दद॑त् । श्रव॑सा॒ याद्वं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ānaṭ ǀ kakuháḥ ǀ dívam ǀ úṣṭrān ǀ catuḥ-yújaḥ ǀ dádat ǀśrávasā ǀ yā́dvam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exalted (prince) has been raised by fame to heaven, for he has given camels laden with four (loadsof gold), and Yādva people (as slaves).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यद्व॑स्त्रि॒ष्टुभ॒मिषं॒ मरु॑तो॒ विप्रो॒ अक्ष॑रत् । वि पर्व॑तेषु राजथ
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ tri-stúbham ǀ íṣam ǀ márutaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ákṣarat ǀví ǀ párvateṣu ǀ rājatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the pious worshipper offers you,Maruts, food at the three diurnal rites, then you havesovereignty over the mountains.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒ङ्ग त॑विषीयवो॒ यामं॑ शुभ्रा॒ अचि॑ध्वम् । नि पर्व॑ता अहासत
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ aṅgá ǀ taviṣī-yavaḥ ǀ yā́mam ǀ śubhrāḥ ǀ ácidhvam ǀní ǀ párvatāḥ ǀ ahāsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, glorious and powerful (Maruts), you fit out your chariot, the mountains depart (from their plural ces).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रयन्त वा॒युभि॑र्वा॒श्रास॒: पृश्नि॑मातरः । धु॒क्षन्त॑ पि॒प्युषी॒मिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īrayanta ǀ vāyú-bhiḥ ǀ vāśrā́saḥ ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǀdhukṣánta ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The loud-sounding sons ofPṛśnidrive with their breezes (the clouds), they milk forth nutritioussustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वप॑न्ति म॒रुतो॒ मिहं॒ प्र वे॑पयन्ति॒ पर्व॑तान् । यद्यामं॒ यान्ति॑ वा॒युभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vápanti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ míham ǀ prá ǀ vepayanti ǀ párvatān ǀyát ǀ yā́mam ǀ yā́nti ǀ vāyú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMarutsscatter the rain, they shake the mountains, when they mount their chariot, with the winds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि यद्यामा॑य वो गि॒रिर्नि सिन्ध॑वो॒ विध॑र्मणे । म॒हे शुष्मा॑य येमि॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ yát ǀ yā́māya ǀ vaḥ ǀ giríḥ ǀ ní ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ví-dharmaṇe ǀmahé ǀ śúṣmāya ǀ yemiré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mountains are curbed, the rivers are restrained at your coming, for the upholding of your greatstrength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्माँ उ॒ नक्त॑मू॒तये॑ यु॒ष्मान्दिवा॑ हवामहे । यु॒ष्मान्प्र॑य॒त्य॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmā́n ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ náktam ǀ ūtáye ǀ yuṣmā́n ǀ dívā ǀ havāmahe ǀyuṣmā́n ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you for protection by night, (we invoke) you by day, (we invoke) you when the sacrifice is inprogress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्ये अ॑रु॒णप्स॑वश्चि॒त्रा यामे॑भिरीरते । वा॒श्रा अधि॒ ष्णुना॑ दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ aruṇá-psavaḥ ǀ citrā́ḥ ǀ yā́mebhiḥ ǀ īrate ǀvāśrā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ snúnā ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truly these purple-hued, wonderful, clamorousMarutsproceed with their chariots in the height aove thesky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सृ॒जन्ति॑ र॒श्मिमोज॑सा॒ पन्थां॒ सूर्या॑य॒ यात॑वे । ते भा॒नुभि॒र्वि त॑स्थिरे
shlokas.transliteration: sṛjánti ǀ raśmím ǀ ójasā ǀ pánthām ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ yā́tave ǀté ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They, who by their might open a radiant path for the sun to travel, they pervade (the world) with lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां मे॑ मरुतो॒ गिर॑मि॒मं स्तोम॑मृभुक्षणः । इ॒मं मे॑ वनता॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ me ǀ marutaḥ ǀ gíram ǀ imám ǀ stómam ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀimám ǀ me ǀ vanata ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Maruts, this my praise, (accept), mighty ones, this my adoration, (accept) this my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॒ सरां॑सि॒ पृश्न॑यो दुदु॒ह्रे व॒ज्रिणे॒ मधु॑ । उत्सं॒ कव॑न्धमु॒द्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ pṛ́śnayaḥ ǀ duduhré ǀ vajríṇe ǀ mádhu ǀútsam ǀ kávandham ǀ udríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kine have filled for the thunderer three lakes of the sweet (Soma) from the dripping water-bearingcloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ यद्ध॑ वो दि॒वः सु॑म्ना॒यन्तो॒ हवा॑महे । आ तू न॒ उप॑ गन्तन
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ sumna-yántaḥ ǀ hávāmahe ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gantana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Maruts, desirous of felicity, we invoke you from heaven, come unto us quickly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं हि ष्ठा सु॑दानवो॒ रुद्रा॑ ऋभुक्षणो॒ दमे॑ । उ॒त प्रचे॑तसो॒ मदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ rúdrāḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáme ǀutá ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ máde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Munificent, mightyRudras, you in the sacrificial hall are wise (even) in the exhilaration (of theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ र॒यिं म॑द॒च्युतं॑ पुरु॒क्षुं वि॒श्वधा॑यसम् । इय॑र्ता मरुतो दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀíyarta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send us,Maruts, from heaven exhilarating, many lauded, all-sustaining riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधी॑व॒ यद्गि॑री॒णां यामं॑ शुभ्रा॒ अचि॑ध्वम् । सु॒वा॒नैर्म॑न्दध्व॒ इन्दु॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi-iva ǀ yát ǀ girīṇā́m ǀ yā́mam ǀ śubhrāḥ ǀ ácidhvam ǀsuvānáiḥ ǀ mandadhve ǀ índu-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, bright (Maruts), you harness your car over the mountains, then you exhilarate (yourselves) withthe effusingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑तश्चिदेषां सु॒म्नं भि॑क्षेत॒ मर्त्य॑: । अदा॑भ्यस्य॒ मन्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: etā́vataḥ ǀ cit ǀ eṣām ǀ sumnám ǀ bhikṣeta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀádābhyasya ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A man should solicit happiness of them with praises of such an unconquerable (company).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये द्र॒प्सा इ॑व॒ रोद॑सी॒ धम॒न्त्यनु॑ वृ॒ष्टिभि॑: । उत्सं॑ दु॒हन्तो॒ अक्षि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ drapsā́ḥ-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dhámanti ǀ ánu ǀ vṛṣṭí-bhiḥ ǀútsam ǀ duhántaḥ ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who, like dropping showers, inflate heaven and earth with rain, milking the inexhaustible cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑ स्वा॒नेभि॑रीरत॒ उद्रथै॒रुदु॑ वा॒युभि॑: । उत्स्तोमै॒: पृश्नि॑मातरः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svānébhiḥ ǀ īrate ǀ út ǀ ráthaiḥ ǀ út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vāyú-bhiḥ ǀút ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sons ofPṛśnirise up with shouts, with chariots, with winds, with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येना॒व तु॒र्वशं॒ यदुं॒ येन॒ कण्वं॑ धन॒स्पृत॑म् । रा॒ये सु तस्य॑ धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ āvá ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀ yéna ǀ káṇvam ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀrāyé ǀ sú ǀ tásya ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We meditate on that (genitive rosity) whereby for (the sake of granting them) riches you have protectedTurvaśa andYaduand the wealth-desiringKaṇva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा उ॑ वः सुदानवो घृ॒तं न पि॒प्युषी॒रिष॑: । वर्धा॑न्का॒ण्वस्य॒ मन्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pipyúṣīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀvárdhān ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Munificent (Maruts), may these (sacrificial) viands, nutritious as butter, together with the praises of thedescendant ofKaṇva, afford you augmentation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व॑ नू॒नं सु॑दानवो॒ मद॑था वृक्तबर्हिषः । ब्र॒ह्मा को व॑: सपर्यति
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ nūnám ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀ mádatha ǀ vṛkta-barhiṣaḥ ǀbrahmā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ saparyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Munificent (Maruts), for whom the sacred grass has been trimmed, where now are you beingexhilarated? What pious worshipper detains you as he) adores you?”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ष्म॒ यद्ध॑ वः पु॒रा स्तोमे॑भिर्वृक्तबर्हिषः । शर्धाँ॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ जिन्व॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ sma ǀ yát ǀ ha ǀ vaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ vṛkta-barhiṣaḥ ǀśárdhān ǀ ṛtásya ǀ jínvatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Maruts), for whom the sacred grass is trimmed, it cannot be (that you submit to be detained), for youhave derived strength from the sacrifice, formerly (accompanied) by our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॒ त्ये म॑ह॒तीर॒पः सं क्षो॒णी समु॒ सूर्य॑म् । सं वज्रं॑ पर्व॒शो द॑धुः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ mahatī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sám ǀ kṣoṇī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́ryam ǀsám ǀ vájram ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have concentrated the abundant waters, they have held together the heaven and earth, they havesustained the sun, they have divided (Vṛtra) joint by joint with the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि वृ॒त्रं प॑र्व॒शो य॑यु॒र्वि पर्व॑ताँ अरा॒जिन॑: । च॒क्रा॒णा वृष्णि॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ vṛtrám ǀ parva-śáḥ ǀ yayuḥ ǀ ví ǀ párvatān ǀ arājínaḥ ǀcakrāṇā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇi ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Independent of a ruler, they have dividedVṛtrajoint by joint; they have shattered the mountains,manifesting manly vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ त्रि॒तस्य॒ युध्य॑त॒: शुष्म॑मावन्नु॒त क्रतु॑म् । अन्विन्द्रं॑ वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ tritásya ǀ yúdhyataḥ ǀ śúṣmam ǀ āvan ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀánu ǀ índram ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have come to the aid of the warringTrita, invigorating his strength, and (animating) his acts; theyhave come to the aid ofIndra, for the destruction ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्युद्ध॑स्ता अ॒भिद्य॑व॒: शिप्रा॑: शी॒र्षन्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॑: । शु॒भ्रा व्य॑ञ्जत श्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: vidyút-hastāḥ ǀ abhí-dyavaḥ ǀ śíprāḥ ǀ śīrṣán ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǀśubhrā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ añjata ǀ śriyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The birlliant (Maruts), bearing the lightning in theirhands, radiant above all, gloriously display theirgolden helmets on their heads.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शना॒ यत्प॑रा॒वत॑ उ॒क्ष्णो रन्ध्र॒मया॑तन । द्यौर्न च॑क्रदद्भि॒या
shlokas.transliteration: uśánā ǀ yát ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ukṣṇáḥ ǀ rándhram ǀ áyātana ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakradat ǀ bhiyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified, (Maruts), byUśanas, when you approach from afar to the opening of the rainy (firmament),then (the dwellers on earth), like those in heaven, are clamorous through fear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ म॒खस्य॑ दा॒वनेऽश्वै॒र्हिर॑ण्यपाणिभिः । देवा॑स॒ उप॑ गन्तन
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ makhásya ǀ dāváne ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ híraṇyapāṇi-bhiḥ ǀdévāsaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ gantana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, gods, to (show your) liberality at our sacrifice with your golden-footed steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदे॑षां॒ पृष॑ती॒ रथे॒ प्रष्टि॒र्वह॑ति॒ रोहि॑तः । यान्ति॑ शु॒भ्रा रि॒णन्न॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ eṣām ǀ pṛ́ṣatīḥ ǀ ráthe ǀ práṣṭiḥ ǀ váhati ǀ róhitaḥ ǀyā́nti ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the spotted antelope or the swift tawny deer conveys them in their chariot, then the brilliant(Maruts) depart, and the rains have gone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒षोमे॑ शर्य॒णाव॑त्यार्जी॒के प॒स्त्या॑वति । य॒युर्निच॑क्रया॒ नर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-sóme ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ ārjīké ǀ pastyá-vati ǀyayúḥ ǀ ní-cakrayā ǀ náraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leaders of rites have proceeded with downward chariot-wheels to the Ṛjīka (Ārjīka) country,where lies the Śaryaṇāvat, abounding in dwellings, and whereSomais plural ntiful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा ग॑च्छाथ मरुत इ॒त्था विप्रं॒ हव॑मानम् । मा॒र्डी॒केभि॒र्नाध॑मानम्
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ gacchātha ǀ marutaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ vípram ǀ hávamānam ǀmārḍīkébhiḥ ǀ nā́dhamānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,maruts, will you go with joy-bestowing riches to the sage thus adoring you, and soliciting (you forwealth)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कद्ध॑ नू॒नं क॑धप्रियो॒ यदिन्द्र॒मज॑हातन । को व॑: सखि॒त्व ओ॑हते
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ kadha-priyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ índram ǀ ájahātana ǀkáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhi-tvé ǀ ohate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When was it,Maruts, who are gratified by praise, that you really desertedIndra? Who is there thatenjoys your friendship?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हो षु णो॒ वज्र॑हस्तै॒: कण्वा॑सो अ॒ग्निं म॒रुद्भि॑: । स्तु॒षे हिर॑ण्यवाशीभिः
shlokas.transliteration: sahó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ vájra-hastaiḥ ǀ káṇvāsaḥ ǀ agním ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀstuṣé ǀ híraṇya-vāśībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you of our race ofKaṇvapraiseAgnitogether with theMaruts, bearing the thunderbolt in theirhands, and armed with golden lances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ षु वृष्ण॒: प्रय॑ज्यू॒ना नव्य॑से सुवि॒ताय॑ । व॒वृ॒त्यां चि॒त्रवा॑जान्
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ sú ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ prá-yajyūn ǀ ā́ ǀ návyase ǀ suvitā́ya ǀvavṛtyā́m ǀ citrá-vājān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bring to my presence, for the sake of most excellent prosperity, the showerers (of desires), theadorable (Maruts), the possessors of wonderful strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रय॑श्चि॒न्नि जि॑हते॒ पर्शा॑नासो॒ मन्य॑मानाः । पर्व॑ताश्चि॒न्नि ये॑मिरे
shlokas.transliteration: giráyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ jihate ǀ párśānāsaḥ ǀ mányamānāḥ ǀpárvatāḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ yemire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hills, oppressed and agitated by them, move (from their plural ces), the mountains are restraineḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आक्ष्ण॒यावा॑नो वहन्त्य॒न्तरि॑क्षेण॒ पत॑तः । धाता॑रः स्तुव॒ते वय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ akṣṇa-yā́vānaḥ ǀ vahanti ǀ antárikṣeṇa ǀ pátataḥ ǀdhā́tāraḥ ǀ stuvaté ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Their horses), quickly traversing (space), bear them travelling through the firmament, giving food to theworshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्हि जानि॑ पू॒र्व्यश्छन्दो॒ न सूरो॑ अ॒र्चिषा॑ । ते भा॒नुभि॒र्वि त॑स्थिरे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ hí ǀ jáni ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ chándaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ arcíṣā ǀte ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ tasthire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniwas born the first among the gods, like the brilliant sun in splendour; then they (theMaruts) stoodround in their radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॒रश्वि॑ना॒ गच्छ॑तं यु॒वम् । दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी॒ पिब॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ áśvinā ǀ gácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀdásrā ǀ híraṇyavartanī íti híraṇya-vartanī ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Aśvins, with all your protections;Dasras, riders in a golden chariot, drink the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नू॒नं या॑तमश्विना॒ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । भुजी॒ हिर॑ण्यपेशसा॒ कवी॒ गम्भी॑रचेतसा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthena ǀ sū́rya-tvacā ǀbhújī íti ǀ híraṇya-peśasā ǀ kávī íti ǀ gámbhīra-cetasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvin, partakers of sacrificial food, decorated with golden ornaments, wise, and endowed with profoundintellects, come verily in your chariot, invested with solar radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑तं॒ नहु॑ष॒स्पर्यान्तरि॑क्षात्सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑: । पिबा॑थो अश्विना॒ मधु॒ कण्वा॑नां॒ सव॑ने सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀpíbāthaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ mádhu ǀ káṇvānām ǀ sávane ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come from (the world of) man, come from the firmament, (attracted) by our pious praises, drink,Aśvins,the sweetSomaoffered at the sacriice of theKaṇvas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ यातं दि॒वस्पर्यान्तरि॑क्षादधप्रिया । पु॒त्रः कण्व॑स्य वामि॒ह सु॒षाव॑ सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ adha-priyā ǀputráḥ ǀ káṇvasya ǀ vām ǀ ihá ǀ susā́va ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us from above the heaven, you who love the (world) below, (come) from the firmament; the sonofKaṇvahas been poured forth for you the sweetSomalibation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ यात॒मुप॑श्रु॒त्यश्वि॑ना॒ सोम॑पीतये । स्वाहा॒ स्तोम॑स्य वर्धना॒ प्र क॑वी धी॒तिभि॑र्नरा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ úpa-śruti ǀ áśvinā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀsvā́hā ǀ stómasya ǀ vardhanā ǀ prá ǀ kavī íti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, to drink theSomaat our sacrifice, you who are praised (by him) and honoured by hispious acts, benefactors of the worshipper, sages and leaders of rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि वां॑ पु॒र ऋष॑यो जुहू॒रेऽव॑से नरा । आ या॑तमश्वि॒ना ग॑त॒मुपे॒मां सु॑ष्टु॒तिं मम॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ purā́ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ juhūré ǀ ávase ǀ narā ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ úpa ǀ imā́m ǀ su-stutím ǀ máma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders of rites, when the Ṛṣis formerly invoked you for protection, you came; so now,Aśvins, comeat my devout praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वश्चि॑द्रोच॒नादध्या नो॑ गन्तं स्वर्विदा । धी॒भिर्व॑त्सप्रचेतसा॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्हवनश्रुता
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ cit ǀ rocanā́t ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ svaḥ-vidā ǀdhībhíḥ ǀ vatsa-pracetasā ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ havana-śrutā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Familiar with heaven, come to us from the sky, or from above the bright (firmament); favourably inclidedto the worshipper, (come), induced by his pious acts; hearers of invocations (come, induced) by our praiseṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: किम॒न्ये पर्या॑सते॒ऽस्मत्स्तोमे॑भिर॒श्विना॑ । पु॒त्रः कण्व॑स्य वा॒मृषि॑र्गी॒र्भिर्व॒त्सो अ॑वीवृधत्
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ anyé ǀ pári ǀ āsate ǀ asmát ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀputráḥ ǀ káṇvasya ǀ vām ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What others than ourselves adore theAśvinswith praises? The ṚṣiVatsa, the son ofKaṇva, hasmagnified you with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ विप्र॑ इ॒हाव॒सेऽह्व॒त्स्तोमे॑भिरश्विना । अरि॑प्रा॒ वृत्र॑हन्तमा॒ ता नो॑ भूतं मयो॒भुवा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀ áhvat ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀáriprā ǀ vṛ́trahan-tamā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise adorer invokes you hither with praise,Aśvins, for protection; sinless, utter destroyers ofenemies, be to us the sources of felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्वां॒ योष॑णा॒ रथ॒मति॑ष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू । विश्वा॑न्यश्विना यु॒वं प्र धी॒तान्य॑गच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ yóṣaṇā ǀ rátham ǀ átiṣṭhat ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀvíśvāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ prá ǀ dhītā́ni ǀ agacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent in sacrifices, when the maiden (sūrya) mounted your chariot, then,Aśvins, you obtained allyour desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑: स॒हस्र॑निर्णिजा॒ रथे॒ना या॑तमश्विना । व॒त्सो वां॒ मधु॑म॒द्वचोऽशं॑सीत्का॒व्यः क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ sahásra-nirnijā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀvatsáḥ ǀ vām ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ vácaḥ ǀ áśaṃsīt ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From wheresoever (you may be) come,Aśvins, with your thousandfold diversified chariot; the sageVatsa, the son ofKavi, has addressed you with sweet worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒म॒न्द्रा पु॑रू॒वसू॑ मनो॒तरा॑ रयी॒णाम् । स्तोमं॑ मे अ॒श्विना॑वि॒मम॒भि वह्नी॑ अनूषाताम्
shlokas.transliteration: puru-mandrā́ ǀ puruvásū íti puru-vásū ǀ manotárā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀstómam ǀ me ǀ aśvínau ǀ imám ǀ abhí ǀ váhnī íti ǀ anūṣātām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Delighters of many, abonding in wealth, bestowers of riches,Aśvins, sustainers of all, approve of thismy adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्वा॑न्यश्विना ध॒त्तं राधां॒स्यह्र॑या । कृ॒तं न॑ ऋ॒त्विया॑वतो॒ मा नो॑ रीरधतं नि॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhattám ǀ rā́dhāṃsi ǀ áhrayā ǀkṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ ṛtvíya-vataḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rīradhatam ǀ nidé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Aśvins, all riches that may not bring us shame, make us the begetters of progeny in dueseason, subject us not to reproach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्ना॑सत्या परा॒वति॒ यद्वा॒ स्थो अध्यम्ब॑रे । अत॑: स॒हस्र॑निर्णिजा॒ रथे॒ना या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ stháḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ámbare ǀátaḥ ǀ sahásra-nirnijā ǀ ráthena ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Nāsatyās, you be far off, or whether you be near, come from there wiḥ your thousandolddiversified chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॑ नासत्या॒वृषि॑र्गी॒र्भिर्व॒त्सो अवी॑वृधत् । तस्मै॑ स॒हस्र॑निर्णिज॒मिषं॑ धत्तं घृत॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ nāsatyau ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ávīvṛdhat ǀtásmai ǀ sahásra-nirnijam ǀ íṣam ǀ dhattam ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give,Nāsatyās, food of many kinds dripping with butter to him, the ṛṣiVatsa, who has magnifiedyou both with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रास्मा॒ ऊर्जं॑ घृत॒श्चुत॒मश्वि॑ना॒ यच्छ॑तं यु॒वम् । यो वां॑ सु॒म्नाय॑ तु॒ष्टव॑द्वसू॒याद्दा॑नुनस्पती
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ asmai ǀ ū́rjam ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ áśvinā ǀ yácchatam ǀ yuvám ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ tustávat ǀ vasu-yā́t ǀ dānunaḥ ǀ patī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give,Aśvins, invigorating food, dripping with butter, to him who praises you, the lords of liberality, toobtain happiness; who desires affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ गन्तं रिशादसे॒मं स्तोमं॑ पुरुभुजा । कृ॒तं न॑: सु॒श्रियो॑ नरे॒मा दा॑तम॒भिष्ट॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ riśādasā ǀ imám ǀ stómam ǀ puru-bhujā ǀkṛtám ǀ naḥ ǀ su-śríyaḥ ǀ narā ǀ imā́ ǀ dātam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Confounders of the malignant, partakers of many (oblations), come to this our adoration; render usprosperous leaders (of rites); give these (good things of earth) to our desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: प्रि॒यमे॑धा अहूषत । राज॑न्तावध्व॒राणा॒मश्वि॑ना॒ याम॑हूतिषु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ priyá-medhāḥ ǀ ahūṣata ǀrā́jantau ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ áśvinā ǀ yā́ma-hūtiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThePriyamedhasat the sacrifices to the gods invoke you,Aśvins, who rule over religious rites,together with your protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ गन्तं मयो॒भुवाश्वि॑ना श॒म्भुवा॑ यु॒वम् । यो वां॑ विपन्यू धी॒तिभि॑र्गी॒र्भिर्व॒त्सो अवी॑वृधत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gantam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvā ǀ áśvinā ǀ śam-bhúvā ǀ yuvám ǀyáḥ ǀ vām ǀ vi-panyū íti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ávīvṛdhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Aśvins, sources of happiness, sources of health; (come), adorable (Aśvins), to thatVatsa,who has magnified you with sacrifices and with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: कण्वं॒ मेधा॑तिथिं॒ याभि॒र्वशं॒ दश॑व्रजम् । याभि॒र्गोश॑र्य॒माव॑तं॒ ताभि॑र्नोऽवतं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ médha-atithim ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ váśam ǀ dáśa-vrajam ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ gó-śaryam ǀ ā́vatam ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ avatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), protect us with those protections with which you have protectedKaṇvaandMedhātithi,Viśaand Daśavraja, with which you have protected Gośarya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑र्नरा त्र॒सद॑स्यु॒माव॑तं॒ कृत्व्ये॒ धने॑ । ताभि॒: ष्व१॒॑स्माँ अ॑श्विना॒ प्राव॑तं॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ narā ǀ trasádasyum ǀ ā́vatam ǀ kṛ́tvye ǀ dháne ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ sú ǀ asmā́n ǀ aśvinā ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(And) with which, leaders (of rites), you protectedTrasadasyuwhen wealth was to be acquired; do youwith the same graciously protec tus,Aśvins, for the acquisition of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वां॒ स्तोमा॑: सुवृ॒क्तयो॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्त्वश्विना । पुरु॑त्रा॒ वृत्र॑हन्तमा॒ ता नो॑ भूतं पुरु॒स्पृहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vām ǀ stómāḥ ǀ su-vṛktáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhantu ǀ aśvinā ǀpúru-trā ǀ vṛ́trahan-tamā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūtam ǀ puru-spṛ́hā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (perfect) hymns and holy praises magnify you,Aśvins; protectors of many, exerminators of foes,greatly are you desired of us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ प॒दान्य॒श्विनो॑रा॒विः सान्ति॒ गुहा॑ प॒रः । क॒वी ऋ॒तस्य॒ पत्म॑भिर॒र्वाग्जी॒वेभ्य॒स्परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ padā́ni ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ sánti ǀ gúhā ǀ paráḥ ǀkavī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pátma-bhiḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ jīvébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The three wheels (of the chariot) of heAśvins, which were invisible, have become manifest; do youtwo, who are cognizant of the past, (come) by the paths of truth to the presence of living beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नू॒नम॑श्विना यु॒वं व॒त्सस्य॑ गन्त॒मव॑से । प्रास्मै॑ यच्छतमवृ॒कं पृ॒थु च्छ॒र्दिर्यु॑यु॒तं या अरा॑तयः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuvám ǀ vatsásya ǀ gantam ǀ ávase ǀprá ǀ asmai ǀ yacchatam ǀ avṛkám ǀ pṛthú ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yuyutám ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, without fail, for the protection of the worshipper; confer upon him a secure and spaciousdwelling; drive away those who make no offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ यद्दि॒वि यत्पञ्च॒ मानु॑षाँ॒ अनु॑ । नृ॒म्णं तद्ध॑त्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ yát ǀ diví ǀ yát ǀ páñca ǀ mā́nuṣān ǀ ánu ǀnṛmṇám ǀ tát ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever wealth may be in the firmament, in heaven, or among the five (classes) of men, bestow,Aśvins, (upon us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये वां॒ दंसां॑स्यश्विना॒ विप्रा॑सः परिमामृ॒शुः । ए॒वेत्का॒ण्वस्य॑ बोधतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ vām ǀ dáṃsāṃsi ǀ aśvinā ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ pari-mamṛśúḥ ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Recognize,Aśvins, (the devotions0 of the son ofKaṇva, as (you have recognized) those former sageswho have repeatedly addresswed pious works to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॑ घ॒र्मो अ॑श्विना॒ स्तोमे॑न॒ परि॑ षिच्यते । अ॒यं सोमो॒ मधु॑मान्वाजिनीवसू॒ येन॑ वृ॒त्रं चिके॑तथः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ gharmáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ stómena ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ yéna ǀ vṛtrám ǀ cíketathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This oblation is poured out,Aśvin, to you with praise; this sweet- savouredSomais offered to you, whoare alluent with food, (animated) by which you meditate (the destruction) of the foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒प्सु यद्वन॒स्पतौ॒ यदोष॑धीषु पुरुदंससा कृ॒तम् । तेन॑ माविष्टमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ap-sú ǀ yát ǀ vánaspátau ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ puru-daṃsasā ǀ kṛtám ǀténa ǀ mā ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Doers of many deeds,Aśvinspreserve me with that (healing virtue) deposited (by you) in the waters, inthe trees, in the herbs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्ना॑सत्या भुर॒ण्यथो॒ यद्वा॑ देव भिष॒ज्यथ॑: । अ॒यं वां॑ व॒त्सो म॒तिभि॒र्न वि॑न्धते ह॒विष्म॑न्तं॒ हि गच्छ॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ bhuraṇyáthaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ devā ǀ bhiṣajyáthaḥ ǀayám ǀ vām ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vindhate ǀ havíṣmantam ǀ hí ǀ gácchathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,Nāsatyās, you cherish (all beings), though, divinities, you heal (all disease),, yet this youradorer does not obtain you by praises (only), you go to him who offers you oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नू॒नम॒श्विनो॒ॠषि॒: स्तोमं॑ चिकेत वा॒मया॑ । आ सोमं॒ मधु॑मत्तमं घ॒र्मं सि॑ञ्चा॒दथ॑र्वणि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ stómam ǀ ciketa ǀ vāmáyā ǀā́ ǀ sómam ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ gharmám ǀ siñcāt ǀ átharvaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When verily you arrive,Aśvins, the ṛṣi understands with excellent (comprehension) the praise (to beaddressed to you); he will sprinkle the sweet- flavouredSomaand thegharma(oblation) onAtharvanfire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नू॒नं र॒घुव॑र्तनिं॒ रथं॑ तिष्ठाथो अश्विना । आ वां॒ स्तोमा॑ इ॒मे मम॒ नभो॒ न चु॑च्यवीरत
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ raghú-vartanim ǀ rátham ǀ tiṣṭhāthaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀā́ ǀ vām ǀ stómāḥ ǀ imé ǀ máma ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cucyavīrata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Abscond at once,Aśvins, your light-moving chariot; may these praises bring you down radiant as thesun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य वां॑ नासत्यो॒क्थैरा॑चुच्युवी॒महि॑ । यद्वा॒ वाणी॑भिरश्विने॒वेत्का॒ण्वस्य॑ बोधतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ vām ǀ nāsatyā ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ ā-cucyuvīmáhi ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ vā́ṇībhiḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AcknowledgeNāsatyās, that we may bring you down today by the prayers and he praises of the sonofKaṇva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वां॑ क॒क्षीवाँ॑ उ॒त यद्व्य॑श्व॒ ऋषि॒र्यद्वां॑ दी॒र्घत॑मा जु॒हाव॑ । पृथी॒ यद्वां॑ वै॒न्यः साद॑नेष्वे॒वेदतो॑ अश्विना चेतयेथाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vām ǀ kakṣī́vān ǀ utá ǀ yát ǀ ví-aśvaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ dīrghá-tamāḥ ǀ juhā́va ǀpṛ́thī ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ vainyáḥ ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ átaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ cetayethām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consider (my praises) in the same maner as (you have considered) whenKakṣīvatpraied yo, whenthe ṛṣiVyaśva, whenDīrghatamas, or Pṛthin, the son ofVena, glorified you in the chambers of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒तं छ॑र्दि॒ष्पा उ॒त न॑: पर॒स्पा भू॒तं ज॑ग॒त्पा उ॒त न॑स्तनू॒पा । व॒र्तिस्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय यातम्
shlokas.transliteration: yātám ǀ chardiḥ-páu ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ ǀ bhūtám ǀ jagat-páu ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ tanū-pā́ ǀvartíḥ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ tánayāya ǀ yātam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come (to us as) guardians of our dwelling, become our defenders, be protectors of our dependants,cherishers of our person ns; come to the dwelling for (the good of) our sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रे॑ण स॒रथं॑ या॒थो अ॑श्विना॒ यद्वा॑ वा॒युना॒ भव॑थ॒: समो॑कसा । यदा॑दि॒त्येभि॑ॠ॒भुभि॑: स॒जोष॑सा॒ यद्वा॒ विष्णो॑र्वि॒क्रम॑णेषु॒ तिष्ठ॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ índreṇa ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yātháḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ vāyúnā ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ sám-okasā ǀyát ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ ṛbhú-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ vi-krámaṇeṣu ǀ tíṣṭhathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,Aśvinsyou should be riding in the same chariot withIndra, although you should be domiciledwithVāyu, although you should be enjoying gratification along with theĀdityasandṚbhus, although you beproceeding on the tracks ofViṣṇu, (nevertheless come here).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्याश्विना॑व॒हं हु॒वेय॒ वाज॑सातये । यत्पृ॒त्सु तु॒र्वणे॒ सह॒स्तच्छ्रेष्ठ॑म॒श्विनो॒रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ aśvínau ǀ ahám ǀ huvéya ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀyát ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ turváṇe ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ tát ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as I invoke you,Aśvins, today for success in war (therefore grant it), for the triumphantprotection of the Aśvins is the most excellent for the destruction (of enemies) in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नू॒नं या॑तमश्विने॒मा ह॒व्यानि॑ वां हि॒ता । इ॒मे सोमा॑सो॒ अधि॑ तु॒र्वशे॒ यदा॑वि॒मे कण्वे॑षु वा॒मथ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ imā́ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vām ǀ hitā́ ǀimé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ imé ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ vām ǀ átha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, these libations are prepared for you; those libations which were presented you byTurvaśa andYadu, they are now offered to you byKaṇvas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्ना॑सत्या परा॒के अ॑र्वा॒के अस्ति॑ भेष॒जम् । तेन॑ नू॒नं वि॑म॒दाय॑ प्रचेतसा छ॒र्दिर्व॒त्साय॑ यच्छतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nāsatyā ǀ parāké ǀ arvāké ǀ ásti ǀ bheṣajám ǀténa ǀ nūnám ǀ vi-madā́ya ǀ pra-cetasā ǀ chardíḥ ǀ vatsā́ya ǀ yacchatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The healing drug,Nāsatyās, that is afar off or near, wherewith (you wen) to (his) dwelling for thesake ofVimada, do you who are of surpassing wisdom now grant toVatsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभु॑त्स्यु॒ प्र दे॒व्या सा॒कं वा॒चाहम॒श्विनो॑: । व्या॑वर्दे॒व्या म॒तिं वि रा॒तिं मर्त्ये॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: ábhutsi ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ devyā́ ǀ sākám ǀ vācā́ ǀ ahám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀví ǀ āvaḥ ǀ devi ǀ ā́ ǀ matím ǀ ví ǀ rātím ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I awake with the pious praise of theAśvins; scatter, goddess, (the darkness) at my eulogy; bestowwealth upon (us) mortals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र बो॑धयोषो अ॒श्विना॒ प्र दे॑वि सूनृते महि । प्र य॑ज्ञहोतरानु॒षक्प्र मदा॑य॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bodhaya ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ prá ǀ devi ǀ sūnṛte ǀ mahi ǀprá ǀ yajña-hotaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀ prá ǀ mádāya ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, truht-speaking mighty goddess, awake theAśvins; invoker of the adorable (deities, arouse them)successively; the copious sacrificial food (is prepared) for their exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदु॑षो॒ यासि॑ भा॒नुना॒ सं सूर्ये॑ण रोचसे । आ हा॒यम॒श्विनो॒ रथो॑ व॒र्तिर्या॑ति नृ॒पाय्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ bhānúnā ǀ sám ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ rocase ǀā́ ǀ ha ǀ ayám ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yāti ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, Uṣas, you move with radiance, you shine equally with the sun; and this chariot of the Aśvinsproceeds to the hall of sacrifice frequented by the leaders (of the rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदापी॑तासो अं॒शवो॒ गावो॒ न दु॒ह्र ऊध॑भिः । यद्वा॒ वाणी॒रनू॑षत॒ प्र दे॑व॒यन्तो॑ अ॒श्विना॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ā́-pītāsaḥ ǀ aṃśávaḥ ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duhré ǀ ū́dha-bhiḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ánūṣata ǀ prá ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the yellowSomastalks milk forth as cows from their udders, when the devout (priests) repeat thewords of praise, then, OAśvins, preserve us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र द्यु॒म्नाय॒ प्र शव॑से॒ प्र नृ॒षाह्या॑य॒ शर्म॑णे । प्र दक्षा॑य प्रचेतसा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dyumnā́ya ǀ prá ǀ śávase ǀ prá ǀ nṛ-sáhyāya ǀ śármaṇe ǀprá ǀ dákṣāya ǀ pra-cetasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with great wisdom, preserve us for fame, for strength, for victory, for happiness, forprosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्नू॒नं धी॒भिर॑श्विना पि॒तुर्योना॑ नि॒षीद॑थः । यद्वा॑ सु॒म्नेभि॑रुक्थ्या
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ nūnám ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pitúḥ ǀ yónā ǀ ni-sī́dathaḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ sumnébhiḥ ǀ ukthyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Although,Aśvins, you be seated in the region of the paternal (heaven engaged in) holy rites, or,glorified by us, (abide there) with plural asures, (yet come here).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्स्थो दी॒र्घप्र॑सद्मनि॒ यद्वा॒दो रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः । यद्वा॑ समु॒द्रे अध्याकृ॑ते गृ॒हेऽत॒ आ या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ stháḥ ǀ dīrghá-prasadmani ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ adáḥ ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ samudré ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́-kṛte ǀ gṛhé ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Aśvins, you are at present where the spacious halls of sacrifice (abound), whether you are inyonder bright sphere of heaven, or whether you are in a dwelling constructed above the firmament, come here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑ य॒ज्ञं मन॑वे सम्मिमि॒क्षथु॑रे॒वेत्का॒ण्वस्य॑ बोधतम् । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ विश्वा॑न्दे॒वाँ अ॒हं हु॑व॒ इन्द्रा॒विष्णू॑ अ॒श्विना॑वाशु॒हेष॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ yajñám ǀ mánave ǀ sam-mimikṣáthuḥ ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ kāṇvásya ǀ bodhatam ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ índrāvíṣṇū íti ǀ aśvínau ǀ āśu-héṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner, as you have prepared,Aśvins, the sacrifice forManu, consent (to prepare it) for the sonofKaṇva; for I invokeBṛhaspati, the universal gods,IndraandViṣṇu, and the Aśvins, with rapid steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्या न्व१॒॑श्विना॑ हुवे सु॒दंस॑सा गृ॒भे कृ॒ता । ययो॒रस्ति॒ प्र ण॑: स॒ख्यं दे॒वेष्वध्याप्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tyā́ ǀ nú ǀ aśvínā ǀ huve ǀ su-dáṃsasā ǀ gṛbhé ǀ kṛtā́ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ ásti ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ devéṣu ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́pyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke thoseAśvins, who are famed for great deeds, induced (to come here) for acceptance (of ouroblations), of whom among the gods the friendship is especially to be obtained.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ययो॒रधि॒ प्र य॒ज्ञा अ॑सू॒रे सन्ति॑ सू॒रय॑: । ता य॒ज्ञस्या॑ध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसा स्व॒धाभि॒र्या पिब॑तः सो॒म्यं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáyoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ prá ǀ yajñā́ḥ ǀ asūré ǀ sánti ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ adhvarásya ǀ prá-cetasā ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ píbataḥ ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon whom (all) sacrifices are dependent, of whom there are worshippers in a plural ce where is noworship, those two familiar with undecaying sacrifices (I invoke) with praises, that you may drink the sweetSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्याश्वि॑ना॒वपा॒ग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वा॑जिनीवसू । यद्द्रु॒ह्यव्यन॑वि तु॒र्वशे॒ यदौ॑ हु॒वे वा॒मथ॒ मा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ aśvinau ǀ ápāk ǀ yát ǀ prā́k ǀ stháḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀyát ǀ druhyávi ǀ ánavi ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ huvé ǀ vām ǀ átha ǀ mā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Aśvins, you abide today in the west, whether opulent in food, you abide in the east, whetheryou sojourn withDruhyu, Anu, Turvaśu orYadu, I invoke you, therefore, come to me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ पत॑थः पुरुभुजा॒ यद्वे॒मे रोद॑सी॒ अनु॑ । यद्वा॑ स्व॒धाभि॑रधि॒तिष्ठ॑थो॒ रथ॒मत॒ आ या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ antárikṣe ǀ pátathaḥ ǀ puru-bhujā ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ adhi-tíṣṭhathaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protectors of many, whether you traverse the firmament, or pass along earth and heaven, whether youascend your chariot with (all) your splendours, come from there,Aśvins, here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने व्रत॒पा अ॑सि दे॒व आ मर्त्ये॒ष्वा । त्वं य॒ज्ञेष्वीड्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ vrata-pā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀtvám ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are a god among mortals, (and among gods), you are the guardian of religious obligations;you are to be hymned at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑सि प्र॒शस्यो॑ वि॒दथे॑षु सहन्त्य । अग्ने॑ र॒थीर॑ध्व॒राणा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ asi ǀ pra-śásyaḥ ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ sahantya ǀágne ǀ rathī́ḥ ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Victor (over enemies), you are to be hymned at solemn rites; you,Agni, are the charioteer of sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वम॒स्मदप॒ द्विषो॑ युयो॒धि जा॑तवेदः । अदे॑वीरग्ने॒ अरा॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asmát ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ yuyodhí ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀádevīḥ ǀ agne ǀ árātīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Jātavedas, drive away from us those who hate us; (drive away),Agni, the impious hostilehosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन्ति॑ चि॒त्सन्त॒मह॑ य॒ज्ञं मर्त॑स्य रि॒पोः । नोप॑ वेषि जातवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: ánti ǀ cit ǀ sántam ǀ áha ǀ yajñám ǀ mártasya ǀ ripóḥ ǀná ǀ úpa ǀ veṣi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You desire not,Jātavedas, the sacrifice of the man who is our adversary, although plural ced before you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मर्ता॒ अम॑र्त्यस्य ते॒ भूरि॒ नाम॑ मनामहे । विप्रा॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसः
shlokas.transliteration: mártāḥ ǀ ámartyasya ǀ te ǀ bhū́ri ǀ nā́ma ǀ manāmahe ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prudent mortals, we offer abundant homage to you, who are immortal and all-knowing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विप्रं॒ विप्रा॒सोऽव॑से दे॒वं मर्ता॑स ऊ॒तये॑ । अ॒ग्निं गी॒र्भिर्ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: vípram ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ devám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀagním ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prudent mortals, we invoke the sage deityAgniwith hymns to propitiate him for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॑ व॒त्सो मनो॑ यमत्पर॒माच्चि॑त्स॒धस्था॑त् । अग्ने॒ त्वांका॑मया गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yamat ǀ paramā́t ǀ cit ǀ sadhá-sthāt ǀágne ǀ tvā́m-kāmayā ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vatsa, by the praise that seeks to propitiate you,Agni, would draw your thought from the supremeassembly (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒त्रा हि स॒दृङ्ङसि॒ विशो॒ विश्वा॒ अनु॑ प्र॒भुः । स॒मत्सु॑ त्वा हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: puru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ sa-dṛ́ṅ ǀ ási ǀ víśaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-bhúḥ ǀsamát-su ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You look upon many plural ces, you are lord over all people; we call upon you in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मत्स्व॒ग्निमव॑से वाज॒यन्तो॑ हवामहे । वाजे॑षु चि॒त्ररा॑धसम्
shlokas.transliteration: samát-su ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀvā́jeṣu ǀ citrá-rādhasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring strength, we call uponAgnifor protection in battles; upon him who is the granter of wonderfulriches (won) in conflicts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒त्नो हि क॒मीड्यो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ स॒नाच्च॒ होता॒ नव्य॑श्च॒ सत्सि॑ । स्वां चा॑ग्ने त॒न्वं॑ पि॒प्रय॑स्वा॒स्मभ्यं॑ च॒ सौभ॑ग॒मा य॑जस्व
shlokas.transliteration: pratnáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ sanā́t ǀ ca ǀ hótā ǀ návyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sátsi ǀsvā́m ǀ ca ǀ agne ǀ tanvám ǀ pipráyasva ǀ asmábhyam ǀ ca ǀ sáubhagam ǀ ā́ ǀ yajasva ǁ
