shlokas.meaning_en: “May this (our praise) take effect, so that the ever-youthful sons ofRudra, creators of the cloud,(coming) from heaven, may be plural ased with us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये चार्ह॑न्ति म॒रुत॑: सु॒दान॑व॒: स्मन्मी॒ळ्हुष॒श्चर॑न्ति॒ ये । अत॑श्चि॒दा न॒ उप॒ वस्य॑सा हृ॒दा युवा॑न॒ आ व॑वृध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ca ǀ árhanti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ smát ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ yé ǀátaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vásyasā ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ yúvānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vavṛdhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Youthful (Maruts), approaching us with benevolent hearts, grant prosperity to those liberal men whoworship you, who zealously propitiate you, the showerers of rain, with oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यून॑ ऊ॒ षु नवि॑ष्ठया॒ वृष्ण॑: पाव॒काँ अ॒भि सो॑भरे गि॒रा । गाय॒ गा इ॑व॒ चर्कृ॑षत्
shlokas.transliteration: yū́naḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ náviṣṭhayā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pāvakā́n ǀ abhí ǀ sobhare ǀ girā́ ǀgā́ya ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ cárkṛṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise, Sobhari, (and attract here) by a new song the youthful purifying showerers, as (a plural ughman)repeatedly drags his oxen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒हा ये सन्ति॑ मुष्टि॒हेव॒ हव्यो॒ विश्वा॑सु पृ॒त्सु होतृ॑षु । वृष्ण॑श्च॒न्द्रान्न सु॒श्रव॑स्तमान्गि॒रा वन्द॑स्व म॒रुतो॒ अह॑
shlokas.transliteration: sahā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ sánti ǀ muṣṭihā́-iva ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ víśvāsu ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ hótṛṣu ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ candrā́n ǀ ná ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamān ǀ girā́ ǀ vándasva ǀ marútaḥ ǀ áha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Propitiate wiḥ praise heMaruts, the senders of rain, the givers of plural asure, the liberal bestowers offood; who are ever victorious in combats, and like a boxer who has been challenged over his challengerṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: गाव॑श्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजा॒त्ये॑न मरुत॒: सब॑न्धवः । रि॒ह॒ते क॒कुभो॑ मि॒थः
shlokas.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ sa-jātyéna ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sá-bandhavaḥ ǀrihaté ǀ kakúbhaḥ ǀ mitháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, who are of like wrath, offspring of the maternal cow (Pṛśni), related by a common origin, theyseverally spread through the quarters of the horizon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मर्त॑श्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस॒ उप॑ भ्रातृ॒त्वमाय॑ति । अधि॑ नो गात मरुत॒: सदा॒ हि व॑ आपि॒त्वमस्ति॒ निध्रु॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: mártaḥ ǀ cit ǀ vaḥ ǀ nṛtavaḥ ǀ rukma-vakṣasaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bhrātṛ-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ ayati ǀádhi ǀ naḥ ǀ gāta ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ āpi-tvám ǀ ásti ǀ ní-dhruvi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, dancing (through the air), decorated with golden breast-plural tes, the mortal (who worships you)attains your brotherhood; speak favourably to us, for your affinity is ever (made known) at the regulated(sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ मारु॑तस्य न॒ आ भे॑ष॒जस्य॑ वहता सुदानवः । यू॒यं स॑खायः सप्तयः
shlokas.transliteration: márutaḥ ǀ mā́rutasya ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bheṣajásya ǀ vahata ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀyūyám ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ saptayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “genitive rous fiends,Maruts, swift gliding (through the air), bring to us (the boon) of the medicaments thatbelong to your company.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॒: सिन्धु॒मव॑थ॒ याभि॒स्तूर्व॑थ॒ याभि॑र्दश॒स्यथा॒ क्रिवि॑म् । मयो॑ नो भूतो॒तिभि॑र्मयोभुवः शि॒वाभि॑रसचद्विषः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ síndhum ǀ ávatha ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ tū́rvatha ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ daśasyátha ǀ krívim ǀmáyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhūta ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ mayaḥ-bhuvaḥ ǀ śivā́bhiḥ ǀ asaca-dviṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those auspicious protectionw with which you have guarded the ocean, with which you havedesroyed (your enemies), with which you provided the well (forGotama), do you who are he sources ofhappiness, the unconquerable by your adversaries, bestow happiness upon uṣ]The unconquerable:asasacadviṣa = śatrurahitaḥ, destitute of enemies].”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सिन्धौ॒ यदसि॑क्न्यां॒ यत्स॑मु॒द्रेषु॑ मरुतः सुबर्हिषः । यत्पर्व॑तेषु भेष॒जम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ síndhau ǀ yát ǀ ásiknyām ǀ yát ǀ samudréṣu ǀ marutaḥ ǀ su-barhiṣaḥ ǀyát ǀ párvateṣu ǀ bheṣajám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever medicament there may be in theSindhu, theAsikni, in the oceans, in the mountains,Maruts,who are gratified by sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वं॒ पश्य॑न्तो बिभृथा त॒नूष्वा तेना॑ नो॒ अधि॑ वोचत । क्ष॒मा रपो॑ मरुत॒ आतु॑रस्य न॒ इष्क॑र्ता॒ विह्रु॑तं॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvam ǀ páśyantaḥ ǀ bibhṛtha ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ téna ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀkṣamā́ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ ā́turasya ǀ naḥ ǀ íṣkarta ǀ ví-hrutam ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, beholding every sort, collect them for (the good of) our bodies, ad instrumental uct us in their (uses); letthe cure of sickness (be the portion),Maruts, of him among us who for his wickedness is sick; re-establish hisenfeebled (frame).”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमु॒ त्वाम॑पूर्व्य स्थू॒रं न कच्चि॒द्भर॑न्तोऽव॒स्यव॑: । वाजे॑ चि॒त्रं ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā́m ǀ apūrvya ǀ sthūrám ǀ ná ǀ kát ǀ cit ǀ bhárantaḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀvā́je ǀ citrám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “UnprecededIndra, cherishing you (with sacrificial food), desirous of your protection, we invoke you whoare manifold in battle, as (men call upon) some stout (person n for help).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वा॒ कर्म॑न्नू॒तये॒ स नो॒ युवो॒ग्रश्च॑क्राम॒ यो धृ॒षत् । त्वामिद्ध्य॑वि॒तारं॑ ववृ॒महे॒ सखा॑य इन्द्र सान॒सिम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ kárman ǀ ūtáye ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ ugráḥ ǀ cakrāma ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ avitā́ram ǀ vavṛmáhe ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have recourse,Indra, to you for protection at sacred rites; may he who is ever young, fierce,resolute, come to us! We, your friends, Indra, rely upon you as our protector and benefactor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ही॒म इन्द॒वोऽश्व॑पते॒ गोप॑त॒ उर्व॑रापते । सोमं॑ सोमपते पिब
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ imé ǀ índavaḥ ǀ áśva-pate ǀ gó-pate ǀ úrvarā-pate ǀsómam ǀ soma-pate ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of horses, of cattle, of corn-land, these libations (are for you); come, lord of theSoma, drink theeffused Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं हि त्वा॒ बन्धु॑मन्तमब॒न्धवो॒ विप्रा॑स इन्द्र येमि॒म । या ते॒ धामा॑नि वृषभ॒ तेभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ विश्वे॑भि॒: सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ bándhu-mantam ǀ abandhávaḥ ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ indra ǀ yemimá ǀyā́ ǀ te ǀ dhā́māni ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Intelligent, but destitute of kin, let us connect ourselves,Indra, with you, who abound with kinsmen;come, showerer (of benefits), with all your glories, to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सीद॑न्तस्ते॒ वयो॑ यथा॒ गोश्री॑ते॒ मधौ॑ मदि॒रे वि॒वक्ष॑णे । अ॒भि त्वामि॑न्द्र नोनुमः
shlokas.transliteration: sī́dantaḥ ǀ te ǀ váyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ gó-śrīte ǀ mádhau ǀ madiré ǀ vivákṣaṇe ǀabhí ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ nonumaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gathering like (a flock of) birds round your exhilarating heaven- bestowingSomamixed with curds, werepeatedly glorify you,Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ च त्वै॒ना नम॑सा॒ वदा॑मसि॒ किं मुहु॑श्चि॒द्वि दी॑धयः । सन्ति॒ कामा॑सो हरिवो द॒दिष्ट्वं स्मो व॒यं सन्ति॑ नो॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ enā́ ǀ námasā ǀ vádāmasi ǀ kím ǀ múhuḥ ǀ cit ǀ ví ǀ dīdhayaḥ ǀsánti ǀ kā́māsaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ tvám ǀ smáḥ ǀ vayám ǀ sánti ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We salute you with this adoration; why do you so often mediate (upon our requests)? Master of baysteeds, let our desires be granted. You are their bestower, we are your (suppliants) and our sacred rites are(addressed to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नूत्ना॒ इदि॑न्द्र ते व॒यमू॒ती अ॑भूम न॒हि नू ते॑ अद्रिवः । वि॒द्मा पु॒रा परी॑णसः
shlokas.transliteration: nū́tnāḥ ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ ūtī́ ǀ abhūma ǀ nahí ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀvidmá ǀ purā́ ǀ párīṇasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We verily are the most recent (objects) of your protection,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, we have notknown of old one greater than you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा स॑खि॒त्वमु॒त शू॑र भो॒ज्य१॒॑मा ते॒ ता व॑ज्रिन्नीमहे । उ॒तो स॑मस्मि॒न्ना शि॑शीहि नो वसो॒ वाजे॑ सुशिप्र॒ गोम॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ utá ǀ śūra ǀ bhojyám ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ tā́ ǀ vajrin ǀ īmahe ǀutó íti ǀ samasmin ǀ ā́ ǀ śiśīhi ǀ naḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ vā́je ǀ su-śipra ǀ gó-mati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We acknowledge, hero, your friendship, (the wealth) to be enjoyed through you, and solicit both,thunderer, of you; giver of dwellings,Indraof the handsome jaws, sustain us in all abundance and in (store of)cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॑ इ॒दमि॑दं पु॒रा प्र वस्य॑ आनि॒नाय॒ तमु॑ वः स्तुषे । सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ idám-idam ǀ purā́ ǀ prá ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ ā-ninā́ya ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ stuṣe ǀsákhāyaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify friends, for your protection, thatIndrawho has brought to us of old this or that excellent(wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हर्य॑श्वं॒ सत्प॑तिं चर्षणी॒सहं॒ स हि ष्मा॒ यो अम॑न्दत । आ तु न॒: स व॑यति॒ गव्य॒मश्व्यं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ म॒घवा॑ श॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: hári-aśvam ǀ sát-patim ǀ carṣaṇi-sáham ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ yáḥ ǀ ámandata ǀā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vayati ǀ gávyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śatám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That man glorifiesIndra, the lord of bay steeds, the protector of the good, the overcomer of enemies,who rejoices (in the fulfilment of his wishes); mayMaghavanbestow upon us, his worshippers, hundreds of cattleand horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ ह स्विद्यु॒जा व॒यं प्रति॑ श्व॒सन्तं॑ वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । सं॒स्थे जन॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ ha ǀ svit ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀ práti ǀ śvasántam ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ bruvīmahi ǀsam-sthé ǀ jánasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With you, showerer (of benefits), for our ally, we bid defiance to one assailing us in a contest (onbehalf) of a man possessing herds of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जये॑म का॒रे पु॑रुहूत का॒रिणो॒ऽभि ति॑ष्ठेम दू॒ढ्य॑: । नृभि॑र्वृ॒त्रं ह॒न्याम॑ शूशु॒याम॒ चावे॑रिन्द्र॒ प्र णो॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: jáyema ǀ kāré ǀ puru-hūta ǀ kāríṇaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tiṣṭhema ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ hanyā́ma ǀ śūśuyā́ma ǀ ca ǀ áveḥ ǀ indra ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, invoked of many, may we conquer in battle those contending against us; may we resist themalignant; may we, aided by the leaders (of rites, theMaruts), slayVṛtra; may we be prosperous, and do youprotect our pious works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्रा॒तृ॒व्यो अ॒ना त्वमना॑पिरिन्द्र ज॒नुषा॑ स॒नाद॑सि । यु॒धेदा॑पि॒त्वमि॑च्छसे
shlokas.transliteration: abhrātṛvyáḥ ǀ anā́ ǀ tvám ǀ ánāpiḥ ǀ indra ǀ janúṣā ǀ sanā́t ǀ asi ǀyudhā́ ǀ ít ǀ āpi-tvám ǀ icchase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are by your birth brotherless; from ever are you without a kinsman; the kindred you desire is(that of him) who engages in war.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकी॑ रे॒वन्तं॑ स॒ख्याय॑ विन्दसे॒ पीय॑न्ति ते सुरा॒श्व॑: । य॒दा कृ॒णोषि॑ नद॒नुं समू॑ह॒स्यादित्पि॒तेव॑ हूयसे
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ revántam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ vindase ǀ pī́yanti ǀ te ǀ surāśváḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ nadanúm ǀ sám ǀ ūhasi ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ hūyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You acknowledge no friendship for the wealthy man (who makes no offerings); those who are puffed upwith wine offered you; when you instrumental tute (the sacrifice), you expelled niggardliness, and you are invoked as aprotector.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा ते॑ अमा॒जुरो॑ यथा मू॒रास॑ इन्द्र स॒ख्ये त्वाव॑तः । नि ष॑दाम॒ सचा॑ सु॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ amā-júraḥ ǀ yathā ǀ mūrā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ sakhyé ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀní ǀ sadāma ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us not, like fools,Indra, be regardless of the friendship of such as you are; let us assemble togetherwhen the libation is effused.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा ते॑ गोदत्र॒ निर॑राम॒ राध॑स॒ इन्द्र॒ मा ते॑ गृहामहि । दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑द॒र्यः प्र मृ॑शा॒भ्या भ॑र॒ न ते॑ दा॒मान॑ आ॒दभे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ te ǀ go-datra ǀ níḥ ǀ arāma ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ índra ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ gṛhāmahi ǀdṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ prá ǀ mṛśa ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ dāmā́naḥ ǀ ā-dábhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us never,Indra, giver of cattle, cease (to benefit) from your wealth; let us not accept it (from anotherthan) you; do you, who are the lord, connfirm to us permanent (riches), bestow them upon us; your benefactionscannoe be arrested.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॑ वा॒ घेदिय॑न्म॒घं सर॑स्वती वा सु॒भगा॑ द॒दिर्वसु॑ । त्वं वा॑ चित्र दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ íyat ǀ maghám ǀ sárasvatī ǀ vā ǀ su-bhágā ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vásu ǀtvám ǀ vā ǀ citra ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Is itIndrawho has given to the donor (of the oblation) so much affluence? Is it the auspiciousSarasvatī (who has given) the treasure? Or,Citra, is it you?”

shlokas.sanskrit: चित्र॒ इद्राजा॑ राज॒का इद॑न्य॒के य॒के सर॑स्वती॒मनु॑ । प॒र्जन्य॑ इव त॒तन॒द्धि वृ॒ष्ट्या स॒हस्र॑म॒युता॒ दद॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: cítraḥ ǀ ít ǀ rā́jā ǀ rājakā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ anyaké ǀ yaké ǀ sárasvatīm ǀ ánu ǀparjányaḥ-iva ǀ tatánat ǀ hí ǀ vṛṣṭyā́ ǀ sahásram ǀ ayútā ǀ dádat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily theRājāCitra, giving his thousands and tens of thousands, has overspread (with his bounty)those other petty princes, who rules along theSarasvatī, asParjanya(overspeads the earth) with rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ त्यम॑ह्व॒ आ रथ॑म॒द्या दंसि॑ष्ठमू॒तये॑ । यम॑श्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी॒ आ सू॒र्यायै॑ त॒स्थथु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ tyám ǀ ahve ǀ ā́ ǀ rátham ǀ adyá ǀ dáṃsiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǀyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-havā ǀ rudravartanī íti rudra-vartanī ǀ ā́ ǀ sūryā́yai ǀ tastháthuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke to-day for our protection that splendid chariot, which, adorableAśvins, advancing on the pathto battle, you ascended (to go to the wwedding) ofSūrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वा॒युषं॑ सु॒हवं॑ पुरु॒स्पृहं॑ भु॒ज्युं वाजे॑षु॒ पूर्व्य॑म् । स॒च॒नाव॑न्तं सुम॒तिभि॑: सोभरे॒ विद्वे॑षसमने॒हस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pūrva-āyúṣam ǀ su-hávam ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ bhujyúm ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ pū́rvyam ǀsacanā́-vantam ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ sobhare ǀ ví-dveṣasam ǀ anehásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate, Sobhari, with praises (that chariot), the benefactor of former (encomiasts), the worthilyinvoked, the desired of many, the preserver, the foremost in battles, the relied upon by all, the scatterer ofenemies, the exempt from ill.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्या पु॑रु॒भूत॑मा दे॒वा नमो॑भिर॒श्विना॑ । अ॒र्वा॒ची॒ना स्वव॑से करामहे॒ गन्ता॑रा दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ devā́ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀarvācīnā́ ǀ sú ǀ ávase ǀ karāmahe ǀ gántārā ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We incite by our adorations on this occasion the two divineAśvins, the overcomers of foes, that theymay come down for our protection and proceed to the dwelling of the donor (of the offering).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वो रथ॑स्य॒ परि॑ च॒क्रमी॑यत ई॒र्मान्यद्वा॑मिषण्यति । अ॒स्माँ अच्छा॑ सुम॒तिर्वां॑ शुभस्पती॒ आ धे॒नुरि॑व धावतु
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ ráthasya ǀ pári ǀ cakrám ǀ īyate ǀ īrmā́ ǀ anyát ǀ vām ǀ iṣaṇyati ǀasmā́n ǀ áccha ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vām ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ dhenúḥ-iva ǀ dhāvatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of the wheels of your car moves in every direction; the other, impellers of actions, remains withyou; may your favour, lords of rain, hasten towards us as a cow (to her calf)!”

shlokas.sanskrit: रथो॒ यो वां॑ त्रिवन्धु॒रो हिर॑ण्याभीशुरश्विना । परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी भूष॑ति श्रु॒तस्तेन॑ नास॒त्या ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ráthaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ tri-vandhuráḥ ǀ híraṇya-abhīśuḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀpári ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ bhū́ṣati ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ téna ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your celebrated chariot,Aśvins, that is three-banked, and caparisoned with gold, graces heaven andearth; come with it,Nāsatyās.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒श॒स्यन्ता॒ मन॑वे पू॒र्व्यं दि॒वि यवं॒ वृके॑ण कर्षथः । ता वा॑म॒द्य सु॑म॒तिभि॑: शुभस्पती॒ अश्वि॑ना॒ प्र स्तु॑वीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: daśasyántā ǀ mánave ǀ pūrvyám ǀ diví ǀ yávam ǀ vṛ́keṇa ǀ karṣathaḥ ǀtā́ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ sumatí-bhiḥ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ áśvinā ǀ prá ǀ stuvīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestowing uponManuthe ancient (rain) from the firmament, you enabled him to cultivate (the soil) withthe plural ugh (and reap) the barley; now therefore,Aśvins, lords of rain, we glorify you both with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नो वाजिनीवसू या॒तमृ॒तस्य॑ प॒थिभि॑: । येभि॑स्तृ॒क्षिं वृ॑षणा त्रासदस्य॒वं म॒हे क्ष॒त्राय॒ जिन्व॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ yātám ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀyébhiḥ ǀ tṛkṣím ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ trāsadasyavám ǀ mahé ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ jínvathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rich in food,Aśvins, come to us by the paths of sacrifice, those by which showerers (of benefits), youwent to gratify Tṛkṣi, the son ofTrasadasyu, with vast wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वा॒मद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः सोमो॑ नरा वृषण्वसू । आ या॑तं॒ सोम॑पीतये॒ पिब॑तं दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ narā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ píbatam ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), affluent in rain, thisSomahas been expressed by the (grinding) stones for you; cometo drink the Soma, drink it in the dwelling of the donor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ हि रु॒हत॑मश्विना॒ रथे॒ कोशे॑ हिर॒ण्यये॑ वृषण्वसू । यु॒ञ्जाथां॒ पीव॑री॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ ruhátam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthe ǀ kóśe ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀyuñjā́thām ǀ pī́varīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, who are rich in rain, ascend your golden chariot, a storehouse (of weapons); bring to usfattening food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: याभि॑: प॒क्थमव॑थो॒ याभि॒रध्रि॑गुं॒ याभि॑र्ब॒भ्रुं विजो॑षसम् । ताभि॑र्नो म॒क्षू तूय॑मश्वि॒ना ग॑तं भिष॒ज्यतं॒ यदातु॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: yā́bhiḥ ǀ pakthám ǀ ávathaḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ ádhri-gum ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ babhrúm ǀ ví-joṣasam ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ tū́yam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ bhiṣajyátam ǀ yát ǀ ā́turam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With those protections with which you have defendedPaktha,Adhrigu, andBabhru, when propitiatingyou, come to us,Aśvins, quickly; administermedicineto the sick.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदध्रि॑गावो॒ अध्रि॑गू इ॒दा चि॒दह्नो॑ अ॒श्विना॒ हवा॑महे । व॒यं गी॒र्भिर्वि॑प॒न्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ádhri-gāvaḥ ǀ ádhrigū ítyadhri-gū ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ hávāmahe ǀvayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vipanyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the tiem when hurrying, devout, we invoke you both speedily going to battle, at the dawn of day, withour hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताभि॒रा या॑तं वृष॒णोप॑ मे॒ हवं॑ वि॒श्वप्सुं॑ वि॒श्ववा॑र्यम् । इ॒षा मंहि॑ष्ठा पुरु॒भूत॑मा नरा॒ याभि॒: क्रिविं॑ वावृ॒धुस्ताभि॒रा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ úpa ǀ me ǀ hávam ǀ viśvá-psum ǀ viśvá-vāryam ǀiṣā́ ǀ máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ puru-bhū́tamā ǀ narā ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ krívim ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then, showerers, come to my manifold all-propitiating invocation with those (protections), with which,leaders (of rites), you, who are gratified (by oblations), munificent (in gifts), and the overcomers of numerous(foes), gave augmentation to the well; with such (protections) come here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तावि॒दा चि॒दहा॑नां॒ ताव॒श्विना॒ वन्द॑मान॒ उप॑ ब्रुवे । ता उ॒ नमो॑भिरीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: táu ǀ idā́ ǀ cit ǀ áhānām ǀ táu ǀ aśvínā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀtáu ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I address theAśvins, glorifying them at break of day; we solicit them with oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताविद्दो॒षा ता उ॒षसि॑ शु॒भस्पती॒ ता याम॑न्रु॒द्रव॑र्तनी । मा नो॒ मर्ता॑य रि॒पवे॑ वाजिनीवसू प॒रो रु॑द्रा॒वति॑ ख्यतम्
shlokas.transliteration: táu ǀ ít ǀ doṣā́ ǀ táu ǀ uṣási ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀ tā́ ǀ yā́man ǀ rudrávartanī íti rudrá-vartanī ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ ripáve ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ paráḥ ǀ rudrau ǀ áti ǀ khyatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We adore those lords of water, leaders on the road of battle, in the evening, at dawn, and at mid-day;therefore,Rudraswho are rich in food, give us not up hereafter to a mortal adversary; rudravartanī : yuddherodanaśilamārgau stūyamānamārgau vā].”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सुग्म्या॑य॒ सुग्म्यं॑ प्रा॒ता रथे॑ना॒श्विना॑ वा स॒क्षणी॑ । हु॒वे पि॒तेव॒ सोभ॑री
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ súgmyāya ǀ súgmyam ǀ prātáríti ǀ ráthena ǀ aśvínā ǀ vā ǀ sakṣáṇī íti ǀhuvé ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ sóbharī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AdorableAśvins, bring in your chariot at early dawn happiness to me, soliciting happiness; I, Sobhari,invoke you as (did my) father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मनो॑जवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंग॒माभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । आ॒रात्ता॑च्चिद्भूतम॒स्मे अव॑से पू॒र्वीभि॑: पुरुभोजसा
shlokas.transliteration: mánaḥ-javasā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ mada-cyutā ǀ makṣum-gamā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀārā́ttāt ǀ cit ǀ bhūtam ǀ asmé íti ǀ ávase ǀ pūrvī́bhiḥ ǀ puru-bhojasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Aśvins), who are swift as thought, the showerers (of benefits), prostrators of the arrogant, the givers ofenjoyment to many, be ever near unto us, for our security, with many and prompt protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ अश्वा॑वदश्विना व॒र्तिर्या॑सिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा । गोम॑द्दस्रा॒ हिर॑ण्यवत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ áśva-vat ǀ aśvinā ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yāsiṣṭam ǀ madhu-pātamā ǀ narā ǀgó-mat ǀ dasrā ǀ híraṇya-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, of goodly aspect, leaders (of rites), deep drinkers of theSoma, come to our dwelling aboundingwith horses, with cattle, with gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प्रा॒व॒र्गं सु॒वीर्यं॑ सु॒ष्ठु वार्य॒मना॑धृष्टं रक्ष॒स्विना॑ । अ॒स्मिन्ना वा॑मा॒याने॑ वाजिनीवसू॒ विश्वा॑ वा॒मानि॑ धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: su-prāvargám ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ suṣṭhú ǀ vā́ryam ǀ ánādhṛṣṭam ǀ rakṣasvínā ǀasmín ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ ā-yā́ne ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ víśvā ǀ vāmā́ni ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain from you (wealth) spontaneously bestowed, comprising excellent strength, such as isdesired by all, and unassailable by a powerful (foe); may we obtain from you who are rich in food, upon youcoming here, all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईळि॑ष्वा॒ हि प्र॑ती॒व्यं१॒॑ यज॑स्व जा॒तवे॑दसम् । च॒रि॒ष्णुधू॑म॒मगृ॑भीतशोचिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́ḷiṣva ǀ hí ǀ pratīvyám ǀ yájasva ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀcariṣṇú-dhūmam ǀ ágṛbhīta-śociṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore him who resists (our foes), worshipJātavedasthe diffuser of smoke, of unobstructed radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒मानं॑ विश्वचर्षणे॒ऽग्निं वि॑श्वमनो गि॒रा । उ॒त स्तु॑षे॒ विष्प॑र्धसो॒ रथा॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: dāmā́nam ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀ agním ǀ viśva-manaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀutá ǀ stuṣe ǀ ví-spardhasaḥ ǀ ráthānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Commend with praise, all-beholding Viśvamanas, thatAgni, who is the giver of chariots to theunenvious (worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: येषा॑माबा॒ध ऋ॒ग्मिय॑ इ॒षः पृ॒क्षश्च॑ नि॒ग्रभे॑ । उ॒प॒विदा॒ वह्नि॑र्विन्दते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yéṣām ǀ ā-bādháḥ ǀ ṛgmíyaḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pṛkṣáḥ ǀ ca ǀ ni-grábhe ǀupa-vídā ǀ váhniḥ ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The repeller (of foes), the glorified by hyms, arrests the food and drink, and the bearer of oblationstakes away the wealth (of those) of whom he foreknows (the neglect of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑स्य शो॒चिर॑स्थाद्दीदि॒युषो॒ व्य१॒॑जर॑म् । तपु॑र्जम्भस्य सु॒द्युतो॑ गण॒श्रिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ asya ǀ śocíḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ dīdiyúṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ajáram ǀtápuḥ-jambhasya ǀ su-dyútaḥ ǀ gaṇa-śríyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The imperishable lustre rises of thatAgni, who is radiant, bright with blazing teech, resplendent, andglorious amid troops (of worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॑ तिष्ठ स्वध्वर॒ स्तवा॑नो दे॒व्या कृ॒पा । अ॒भि॒ख्या भा॒सा बृ॑ह॒ता शु॑शु॒क्वनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ su-adhvara ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ devyā́ ǀ kṛpā́ ǀabhi-khyā́ ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ śuśukvániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise up with celestial splendour, you who are radiant with great and present lustre, who are worthilyworshipped and glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ या॒हि सु॑श॒स्तिभि॑र्ह॒व्या जुह्वा॑न आनु॒षक् । यथा॑ दू॒तो ब॒भूथ॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ yāhí ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ júhvānaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀyáthā ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proceed,Agni, with pious praises, offering in due order the oblations (to the gods), for you are theirmessenger, the bearer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं व॑: पू॒र्व्यं हु॑वे॒ होता॑रं चर्षणी॒नाम् । तम॒या वा॒चा गृ॑णे॒ तमु॑ वः स्तुषे
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ huve ǀ hótāram ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀtám ǀ ayā́ ǀ vācā́ ǀ gṛṇe ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vaḥ ǀ stuṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke for you, (worshippers),Agni, the ancient ministrant priest of man, I praise him with this hymn, Iglorify him for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञेभि॒रद्भु॑तक्रतुं॒ यं कृ॒पा सू॒दय॑न्त॒ इत् । मि॒त्रं न जने॒ सुधि॑तमृ॒ताव॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: yajñébhiḥ ǀ ádbhuta-kratum ǀ yám ǀ kṛpā́ ǀ sūdáyante ǀ ít ǀmitrám ǀ ná ǀ jáne ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ ṛtá-vani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Worship him who is) of wondrous works, who, gladdened (by offerings), is present like a friend, whom(the priests) by their sacrifices, according to their power, render propitious to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑नमृतायवो य॒ज्ञस्य॒ साध॑नं गि॒रा । उपो॑ एनं जुजुषु॒र्नम॑सस्प॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānam ǀ ṛta-yavaḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀ girā́ ǀúṣaḥ ǀ enam ǀ jujuṣuḥ ǀ námasaḥ ǀ padé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pious worshippers, at the plural ce of offerings adore with praise him who is gratified by worship, thecompleter of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ नो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्तमं य॒ज्ञासो॑ यन्तु सं॒यत॑: । होता॒ यो अस्ति॑ वि॒क्ष्वा य॒शस्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ naḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamam ǀ yajñā́saḥ ǀ yantu ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀhótā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ vikṣú ǀ ā́ ǀ yaśáḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let our sacrificers, prepared (with their implements), present themselves before the chief of theAṅgirasas, who is the most renowned offerer of oblations among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तव॒ त्ये अ॑ज॒रेन्धा॑नासो बृ॒हद्भाः । अश्वा॑ इव॒ वृष॑णस्तविषी॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ táva ǀ tyé ǀ ajara ǀ índhānāsaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ bhā́ḥ ǀáśvāḥ-iva ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ taviṣī-yávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your vast blazing flames, undecayingAgni, are most powerful, vigorous as horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं न॑ ऊर्जां पते र॒यिं रा॑स्व सु॒वीर्य॑म् । प्राव॑ नस्तो॒के तन॑ये स॒मत्स्वा
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀ rayím ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀprá ǀ ava ǀ naḥ ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ samát-su ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, who are the lord of food, give us riches, withmaleoffspring; defend us, with our sons andgrandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा उ॑ वि॒श्पति॑: शि॒तः सुप्री॑तो॒ मनु॑षो वि॒शि । विश्वेद॒ग्निः प्रति॒ रक्षां॑सि सेधति
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ śitáḥ ǀ sú-prītaḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ viśí ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ práti ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sedhati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenAgni, the lord of man, sharpened (by sacrifice), and, well plural ased, is present in the abode of aman, he verily defends it against all evil spirits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒ष्ट्य॑ग्ने॒ नव॑स्य मे॒ स्तोम॑स्य वीर विश्पते । नि मा॒यिन॒स्तपु॑षा र॒क्षसो॑ दह
shlokas.transliteration: śruṣṭī́ ǀ agne ǀ návasya ǀ me ǀ stómasya ǀ vīra ǀ viśpate ǀní ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ tápuṣā ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ daha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Agni, lord of men, hearing this my present praise, consume the guilefulrākṣasasby yourflames.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तस्य॑ मा॒यया॑ च॒न रि॒पुरी॑शीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । यो अ॒ग्नये॑ द॒दाश॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिभिः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tásya ǀ māyáyā ǀ caná ǀ ripúḥ ǀ īśīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ agnáye ǀ dadā́śa ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No hostile mortal shall have power by fraud over him who by the (sacred) offerers of the oblationpresents (offerings) toAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य॑श्वस्त्वा वसु॒विद॑मुक्ष॒ण्युर॑प्रीणा॒दृषि॑: । म॒हो रा॒ये तमु॑ त्वा॒ समि॑धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ví-aśvaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ ukṣaṇyúḥ ǀ aprīṇāt ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ṛṣiVyaśva, desirous (of propitiating) the showerer (of rain), has gratified you, the bestower ofwealth; so we too kindle you for (the acquisition of) ample riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शना॑ का॒व्यस्त्वा॒ नि होता॑रमसादयत् । आ॒य॒जिं त्वा॒ मन॑वे जा॒तवे॑दसम्
shlokas.transliteration: uśánā ǀ kāvyáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ hótāram ǀ asādayat ǀā-yajím ǀ tvā ǀ mánave ǀ jātá-vedasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uśanā, the son ofKavi, has established you,Jātavedas, as the ministrant priest, you as the offererof sacrifice, forManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ हि त्वा॑ स॒जोष॑सो दे॒वासो॑ दू॒तमक्र॑त । श्रु॒ष्टी दे॑व प्रथ॒मो य॒ज्ञियो॑ भुवः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ dūtám ǀ ákrata ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ deva ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ bhuvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the consentient gods have made you their messenger, may you, divineAgni, who are the first (of thedeities), quickly become the object of their worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं घा॑ वी॒रो अ॒मृतं॑ दू॒तं कृ॑ण्वीत॒ मर्त्य॑: । पा॒व॒कं कृ॒ष्णव॑र्तनिं॒ विहा॑यसम्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ gha ǀ vīráḥ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇvīta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀpāvakám ǀ kṛṣṇá-vartanim ǀ ví-hāyasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious mortal has appointed this immortal, purifying, dark-moving, mighty (Agni), his messenger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं हु॑वेम य॒तस्रु॑चः सु॒भासं॑ शु॒क्रशो॑चिषम् । वि॒शाम॒ग्निम॒जरं॑ प्र॒त्नमीड्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ huvema ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ su-bhā́sam ǀ śukrá-śociṣam ǀviśā́m ǀ agním ǀ ajáram ǀ pratnám ǀ ī́ḍyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us with uplifted ladles invoke him, the brilliant, bright-shining, undecaying, ancientAgni, who is to beadored by men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॑स्मै ह॒व्यदा॑तिभि॒राहु॑तिं॒ मर्तोऽवि॑धत् । भूरि॒ पोषं॒ स ध॑त्ते वी॒रव॒द्यश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ havyádāti-bhiḥ ǀ ā́-hutim ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ávidhat ǀbhū́ri ǀ póṣam ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who by the (holy) presenters of oblations makes offerings to him, receives (fromAgni) amplenourishment, withmaleprogeny, and fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒मं जा॒तवे॑दसम॒ग्निं य॒ज्ञेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यम् । प्रति॒ स्रुगे॑ति॒ नम॑सा ह॒विष्म॑ती
shlokas.transliteration: prathamám ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ agním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀpráti ǀ srúk ǀ eti ǀ námasā ǀ havíṣmatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ladle charged with the oblation proceeds with reverence at sacrifices to the ancientAgni, the first(of the gods), the cognizant of all that exists.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आभि॑र्विधेमा॒ग्नये॒ ज्येष्ठा॑भिर्व्यश्व॒वत् । मंहि॑ष्ठाभिर्म॒तिभि॑: शु॒क्रशो॑चिषे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́bhiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ agnáye ǀ jyéṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀmáṃhiṣṭhābhiḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us, likeVyaśva, glorify the brilliantAgniwith these excellent and most pious praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नम॑र्च॒ विहा॑यसे॒ स्तोमे॑भिः स्थूरयूप॒वत् । ऋषे॑ वैयश्व॒ दम्या॑या॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ arca ǀ ví-hāyase ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ sthūrayūpa-vát ǀṛ́ṣe ǀ vaiyaśva ǀ dámyāya ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛṣi, son ofVyaśva, adore the far-spreading domesticAgni, with praises, like Sthūrayūpa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑थिं॒ मानु॑षाणां सू॒नुं वन॒स्पती॑नाम् । विप्रा॑ अ॒ग्निमव॑से प्र॒त्नमी॑ळते
shlokas.transliteration: átithim ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ sūnúm ǀ vánaspátīnām ǀvíprāḥ ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ pratnám ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pious men glorify the ancientAgni, the guest of men, the son of the trees, for protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो विश्वाँ॑ अ॒भि ष॒तो॒३॒॑ऽभि ह॒व्यानि॒ मानु॑षा । अग्ने॒ नि ष॑त्सि॒ नम॒साधि॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ abhí ǀ satáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ havyā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀágne ǀ ní ǀ satsi ǀ námasā ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sit down,Agni, on the sacred grass, in the presence of all those worshippers diligent (in pious works,induced) by their veneration (to accept) the oblations of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वंस्वा॑ नो॒ वार्या॑ पु॒रु वंस्व॑ रा॒यः पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑: । सु॒वीर्य॑स्य प्र॒जाव॑तो॒ यश॑स्वतः
shlokas.transliteration: váṃsva ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǀ váṃsva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀsu-vī́ryasya ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us (Agni) many desirable (things), grant us riches, envied by many, (comprehending) vigour,offspring, fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं व॑रो सु॒षाम्णेऽग्ने॒ जना॑य चोदय । सदा॑ वसो रा॒तिं य॑विष्ठ॒ शश्व॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ ágne ǀ jánāya ǀ codaya ǀsádā ǀ vaso íti ǀ rātím ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ śáśvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, (who are) the desired of all, the humbler (of foes), the youngest (of the gods), ever bestow richesupon the tranquil and constant man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि सु॑प्र॒तूरसि॒ त्वं नो॒ गोम॑ती॒रिष॑: । म॒हो रा॒यः सा॒तिम॑ग्ने॒ अपा॑ वृधि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ su-pratū́ḥ ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sātím ǀ agne ǀ ápa ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You verily are a liberal benefactor; bestow upon us,Agni, food, with cattle, and the gift of abundantriches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वं य॒शा अ॒स्या मि॒त्रावरु॑णा वह । ऋ॒तावा॑ना स॒म्राजा॑ पू॒तद॑क्षसा
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ tvám ǀ yaśā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vaha ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ pūtá-dakṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are renowned, bring hither the truthful, the purely vigorous, the resplendent deitiesMitraandVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑य॒ आ शि॑षामहि॒ ब्रह्मेन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ । स्तु॒ष ऊ॒ षु वो॒ नृत॑माय धृ॒ष्णवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śiṣāmahi ǀ bráhma ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀstuṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamāya ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us earnestly, friends, address our prayer toIndra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, for you I praise thechief leader (in battles), the resolute (opposer of foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शव॑सा॒ ह्यसि॑ श्रु॒तो वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॑न वृत्र॒हा । म॒घैर्म॒घोनो॒ अति॑ शूर दाशसि
shlokas.transliteration: śávasā ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátyena ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀmagháiḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ áti ǀ śūra ǀ dāśasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are renowned for strength; from the slaying ofVṛtra, you are (famed as) Vṛtrahan; you surpass,hero, the opulent in the donation of your riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒: स्तवा॑न॒ आ भ॑र र॒यिं चि॒त्रश्र॑वस्तमम् । नि॒रे॒के चि॒द्यो ह॑रिवो॒ वसु॑र्द॒दिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ citráśravaḥ-tamam ǀnireké ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praised by us, bestow upon us riches of wonderful variety; you, the lord of steeds, who, at the issue (ofyour weapons) put your enemies to flight, are the donor (of treasures).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नि॑रे॒कमु॒त प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॒ दर्षि॒ जना॑नाम् । धृ॒ष॒ता धृ॑ष्णो॒ स्तव॑मान॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nirekám ǀ utá ǀ priyám ǀ índra ǀ dárṣi ǀ jánānām ǀdhṛṣatā́ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ stávamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Burst open to your worshippers,Indra, the highly prized wealth; glorified by us, do you who areendowed with resolution, bring (us wealth) with a resolute (mind).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॑ स॒व्यं न दक्षि॑णं॒ हस्तं॑ वरन्त आ॒मुर॑: । न प॑रि॒बाधो॑ हरिवो॒ गवि॑ष्टिषु
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ savyám ǀ ná ǀ dákṣiṇam ǀ hástam ǀ varante ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀná ǀ pari-bā́dhaḥ ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of steeds, in the recovery of the cattle the opponents resist not your lefthandnor your right, yourenemies (resist you) not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ गोभि॑रिव व्र॒जं गी॒र्भिॠ॑णोम्यद्रिवः । आ स्मा॒ कामं॑ जरि॒तुरा मन॑: पृण
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ góbhiḥ-iva ǀ vrajám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ ṛṇomi ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀā́ ǀ sma ǀ kā́mam ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I approach you, thunderer, with praises, as (a cowherd goes) with cattle to the pasture; gratify thedesire, satisfy the mind of your adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑नि वि॒श्वम॑नसो धि॒या नो॑ वृत्रहन्तम । उग्र॑ प्रणेत॒रधि॒ षू व॑सो गहि
shlokas.transliteration: víśvāni ǀ viśvá-manasaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀúgra ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sú ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fierce destroyer ofVṛtra, bringer (of wealth to your worshippers), subduer of enemies, preside over all(the offerings) of us, Visvamanasa, with a (favourable) mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अ॒स्य वृ॑त्रहन्वि॒द्याम॑ शूर॒ नव्य॑सः । वसो॑: स्पा॒र्हस्य॑ पुरुहूत॒ राध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyá ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ śūra ǀ návyasaḥ ǀvásoḥ ǀ spārhásya ǀ puru-hūta ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, hero, slayer ofVṛtra, invoked of many become possessed of this your new, desirable, andhappiness producing wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ यथा॒ ह्यस्ति॒ तेऽप॑रीतं नृतो॒ शव॑: । अमृ॑क्ता रा॒तिः पु॑रुहूत दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ yáthā ǀ hí ǀ ásti ǀ te ǀ ápari-itam ǀ nṛto íti ǀ śávaḥ ǀámṛktā ǀ rātíḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As,Indra, inspirer (of men), your strength is irresistible, (so) invoked of many, your munificence to thedonor (of oblations) cannot be marred.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वृ॑षस्व महामह म॒हे नृ॑तम॒ राध॑से । दृ॒ळ्हश्चि॑द्दृह्य मघवन्म॒घत्त॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ mahā-maha ǀ mahé ǀ nṛ-tama ǀ rā́dhase ǀdṛḷháḥ ǀ cit ǀ dṛhya ǀ magha-van ǀ magháttaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most adorable, chief leader (of men), invigorate (yourself with theSoma) for (the conquest of) greatwealth; consume,Maghavan, the strong (cities of theasuras) for the rich spoil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू अ॒न्यत्रा॑ चिदद्रिव॒स्त्वन्नो॑ जग्मुरा॒शस॑: । मघ॑वञ्छ॒ग्धि तव॒ तन्न॑ ऊ॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ anyátra ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ tvát ǀ naḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀmágha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, our solicitations have been formerly addressed to other gods, than you; giveus,Maghavan, of your (spoil and guard it) for us with (your) protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒ह्य१॒॑ङ्ग नृ॑तो॒ त्वद॒न्यं वि॒न्दामि॒ राध॑से । रा॒ये द्यु॒म्नाय॒ शव॑से च गिर्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ aṅgá ǀ nṛto íti ǀ tvát ǀ anyám ǀ vindā́mi ǀ rā́dhase ǀrāyé ǀ dyumnā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ ca ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, impeller (of men), who are to be worshipped by praise, I apply to no other than you forsustenance, riches, reputation, and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य सिञ्चत॒ पिबा॑ति सो॒म्यं मधु॑ । प्र राध॑सा चोदयाते महित्व॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ índum ǀ índrāya ǀ siñcata ǀ píbāti ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀprá ǀ rā́dhasā ǀ codayāte ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effuse theSomaforIndra, let him quaff the Soma; he by his might rewards (the donor) with wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॒ हरी॑णां॒ पतिं॒ दक्षं॑ पृ॒ञ्चन्त॑मब्रवम् । नू॒नं श्रु॑धि स्तुव॒तो अ॒श्व्यस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ hárīṇām ǀ pátim ǀ dákṣam ǀ pṛñcántam ǀ abravam ǀnūnám ǀ śrudhi ǀ stuvatáḥ ǀ aśvyásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let me address the lord of steeds, who associates his strength (with theMaruts); now hear the words ofthe son ofVyaśvapraising you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒ह्य१॒॑ङ्ग पु॒रा च॒न ज॒ज्ञे वी॒रत॑र॒स्त्वत् । नकी॑ रा॒या नैवथा॒ न भ॒न्दना॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ aṅgá ǀ purā́ ǀ caná ǀ jajñé ǀ vīrá-taraḥ ǀ tvát ǀnákiḥ ǀ rāyā́ ǀ ná ǀ evá-thā ǀ ná ǀ bhandánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one,Indra, has ever been born more mighty than you, no one (surpassing you) in riches; no one(more powerful) in protection; no one (more entitled) to praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एदु॒ मध्वो॑ म॒दिन्त॑रं सि॒ञ्च वा॑ध्वर्यो॒ अन्ध॑सः । ए॒वा हि वी॒रः स्तव॑ते स॒दावृ॑धः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ madín-taram ǀ siñcá ǀ vā ǀ adhvaryo íti ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀevá ǀ hí ǀ vīráḥ ǀ stávate ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour out, priest, the most exhilarating (draught) of the sweet (sacrificial)Soma, for he, the ever-mightyhero, alone is praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ स्थातर्हरीणां॒ नकि॑ष्टे पू॒र्व्यस्तु॑तिम् । उदा॑नंश॒ शव॑सा॒ न भ॒न्दना॑
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǀ nákiḥ ǀ te ǀ pūrvyá-stutim ǀút ǀ ānaṃśa ǀ śávasā ǀ ná ǀ bhandánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, ruler of horses, no one surpasses your ancient praise, either for force or for fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वो॒ वाजा॑नां॒ पति॒महू॑महि श्रव॒स्यव॑: । अप्रा॑युभिर्य॒ज्ञेभि॑र्वावृ॒धेन्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vā́jānām ǀ pátim ǀ áhūmahi ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀáprāyu-bhiḥ ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ vavṛdhényam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of food, we invoke your lord of viands, who is to be magnified by sacrifices (offered) byattentive (worshipers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: एतो॒ न्विन्द्रं॒ स्तवा॑म॒ सखा॑य॒: स्तोम्यं॒ नर॑म् । कृ॒ष्टीर्यो विश्वा॑ अ॒भ्यस्त्येक॒ इत्
shlokas.transliteration: éto íti ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ stávāma ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ stómyam ǀ náram ǀkṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ásti ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, freinds, let us glorifyIndra, the leader, who is entitled to praise, who, single, overcomes allhostile hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अगो॑रुधाय ग॒विषे॑ द्यु॒क्षाय॒ दस्म्यं॒ वच॑: । घृ॒तात्स्वादी॑यो॒ मधु॑नश्च वोचत
shlokas.transliteration: ágo-rudhāya ǀ go-íṣe ǀ dyukṣā́ya ǀ dásmyam ǀ vácaḥ ǀghṛtā́t ǀ svā́dīyaḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ca ǀ vocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Recite agreeable words, sweeter than clarified butter, or thanSoma, to the illustrious (Indra), who isgratified by eulogy, who rejects not praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्यामि॑तानि वी॒र्या॒३॒॑ न राध॒: पर्ये॑तवे । ज्योति॒र्न विश्व॑म॒भ्यस्ति॒ दक्षि॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ámitāni ǀ vīryā́ ǀ ná ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ pári-etave ǀjyótiḥ ǀ ná ǀ víśvam ǀ abhí ǀ ásti ǀ dákṣiṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whose energies are unbounded, whose wealth cannot be carried away, whose bounty extends like thefirmament over all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒हीन्द्रं॑ व्यश्व॒वदनू॑र्मिं वा॒जिनं॒ यम॑म् । अ॒र्यो गयं॒ मंह॑मानं॒ वि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: stuhí ǀ índram ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀ ánūrmim ǀ vājínam ǀ yámam ǀaryáḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ máṃhamānam ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “GlorifyIndra, the unassailable, the powerful, the regulator (of man), as was done byVyaśva, he, thelord, gives a spacious dwelling to the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा नू॒नमुप॑ स्तुहि॒ वैय॑श्व दश॒मं नव॑म् । सुवि॑द्वांसं च॒र्कृत्यं॑ च॒रणी॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ nūnám ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ váiyaśva ǀ daśamám ǀ návam ǀsú-vidvāṃsam ǀ carkṛ́tyam ǀ caráṇīnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise verily at present, son ofVyaśva, praise (Indra), who is the tenth of the pervading (vitalprinciples), the adorable, the all-wise to be honoured repeatedly (by sacred rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेत्था॒ हि निॠ॑तीनां॒ वज्र॑हस्त परि॒वृज॑म् । अह॑रहः शु॒न्ध्युः प॑रि॒पदा॑मिव
shlokas.transliteration: véttha ǀ hí ǀ níḥ-ṛtīnām ǀ vájra-hasta ǀ pari-vṛ́jam ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ śundhyúḥ ǀ paripádām-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are cognizant, wielder of the thunderbolt, of the departure of evil beings, as the purifying sun dayby day (is of that) of the birds flying in all directions (from their roost).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदि॒न्द्राव॒ आ भ॑र॒ येना॑ दंसिष्ठ॒ कृत्व॑ने । द्वि॒ता कुत्सा॑य शिश्नथो॒ नि चो॑दय
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ indra ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ yéna ǀ daṃsiṣṭha ǀ kṛ́tvane ǀdvitā́ ǀ kútsāya ǀ śiśnathaḥ ǀ ní ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of goodly aspect, bring to the offerer (of the oblation) that (protection) wherewith to defend himyou have twice slain (the goe) forKutsa; show the same (care of us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा नू॒नमी॑महे॒ नव्यं॑ दंसिष्ठ॒ सन्य॑से । स त्वं नो॒ विश्वा॑ अ॒भिमा॑तीः स॒क्षणि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ nūnám ǀ īmahe ǀ návyam ǀ daṃsiṣṭha ǀ sányase ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ sakṣáṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra) of goodly aspect, we implore you who are entitled to praise, for (our) preservation; for you arethe overcomer of all our adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋक्षा॒दंह॑सो मु॒चद्यो वार्या॑त्स॒प्त सिन्धु॑षु । वध॑र्दा॒सस्य॑ तुविनृम्ण नीनमः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛ́kṣāt ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ mucát ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ ā́ryāt ǀ saptá ǀ síndhuṣu ǀvádhaḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ nīnamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(He it is) who rescues men from the wickedness of evil beings, who enriches (the dwellers) on theseven rivers; now hurl, you who abound in wealth, your weapon at theDāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ वरो सु॒षाम्णे॑ स॒निभ्य॒ आव॑हो र॒यिम् । व्य॑श्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ávahaḥ ǀ rayím ǀví-aśvebhyaḥ ǀ su-bhage ǀ vājinī-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you, Varu, have distributed vast wealth to those who have solicited (riches) on behalf ofSusāman,(so do you now distribute) to the descendants ofVyaśva; (and so too you), auspicious food-bestowing (Uṣas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ना॒र्यस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ व्य॑श्वाँ एतु सो॒मिन॑: । स्थू॒रं च॒ राध॑: श॒तव॑त्स॒हस्र॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ nāryásya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ ví-aśvān ǀ etu ǀ somínaḥ ǀsthūrám ǀ ca ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ śatá-vat ǀ sahásra-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gifts of a humane (price), when offering theSomalibation, extend to theVyaśvas, yes, andsubstantial wealthy by hundreds and thousands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्त्वा॑ पृ॒च्छादी॑जा॒नः कु॑ह॒या कु॑हयाकृते । ए॒षो अप॑श्रितो व॒लो गो॑म॒तीमव॑ तिष्ठति
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ pṛcchā́t ǀ ījānáḥ ǀ kuhayā́ ǀ kuhayā-kṛte ǀeṣáḥ ǀ ápa-śritaḥ ǀ valáḥ ǀ go-matī́m ǀ áva ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If any ask of you, (Uṣas), when anywhere present, where the sacrificer (Varu dwells), (reply) thepowerful (prince), the refuge of all, abides on (the banks of) theGomatīriver.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॒ विश्व॑स्य गो॒पा दे॒वा दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ । ऋ॒तावा॑ना यजसे पू॒तद॑क्षसा
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ víśvasya ǀ gopā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyā ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ yajase ǀ pūtá-dakṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You two are the protectors of the universe, divine and to be adored among the gods; therefore,(Viśvamanas), you sacrifice to the pair who are observant of truth and endowed with real power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रा तना॒ न र॒थ्या॒३॒॑ वरु॑णो॒ यश्च॑ सु॒क्रतु॑: । स॒नात्सु॑जा॒ता तन॑या धृ॒तव्र॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: mitrā́ ǀ tánā ǀ ná ǀ rathyā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀsanā́t ǀ su-jātā́ ǀ tánayā ǀ dhṛtá-vratā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, doers of good deeds, (diffusers of) riches, who are the charioteers (of men),well-born of old, the sons, (ofAditi), observant of vows, (you are worshipped by me).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता मा॒ता वि॒श्ववे॑दसासु॒र्या॑य॒ प्रम॑हसा । म॒ही ज॑जा॒नादि॑तिॠ॒ताव॑री
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ mātā́ ǀ viśvá-vedasā ǀ asuryā́ya ǀ prá-mahasā ǀmahī́ ǀ jajāna ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ṛtá-varī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great and truthfulAditi, the mother (of the gods), gave birth to those two who are possessed of allaffluence, and shining with great splendour, for the (destruction of the)asuras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हान्ता॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा स॒म्राजा॑ दे॒वावसु॑रा । ऋ॒तावा॑नावृ॒तमा घो॑षतो बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́ntā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ deváu ǀ ásurā ǀṛtá-vānau ǀ ṛtám ǀ ā́ ǀ ghoṣataḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The greatMitraandVaruṇa, the two sovereign and powerful deities, the observers of truth, illumine oursolemn rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नपा॑ता॒ शव॑सो म॒हः सू॒नू दक्ष॑स्य सु॒क्रतू॑ । सृ॒प्रदा॑नू इ॒षो वास्त्वधि॑ क्षितः
shlokas.transliteration: nápātā ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ sūnū́ íti ǀ dákṣasya ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀsṛprádānū íti sṛprá-dānū ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vā́stu ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grandson sof mighty strength, son sof energy, doers of good deeds, liberal benefactors, they presideover the habitation of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं या दानू॑नि ये॒मथु॑र्दि॒व्याः पार्थि॑वी॒रिष॑: । नभ॑स्वती॒रा वां॑ चरन्तु वृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yā́ ǀ dā́nūni ǀ yemáthuḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ pā́rthivīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀnábhasvatīḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vām ǀ carantu ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow (upon us) good gifts, viands, whether of heaven or earth; may the water-shedding rains attendupon you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ या बृ॑ह॒तो दि॒वो॒३॒॑ऽभि यू॒थेव॒ पश्य॑तः । ऋ॒तावा॑ना स॒म्राजा॒ नम॑से हि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ yā́ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yūthā́-iva ǀ páśyataḥ ǀṛtá-vānā ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ námase ǀ hitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(These are they) who look upon the great deities as (a bull contemplates) the herd, sovereignsobservant of truth and propitious to adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑ना॒ नि षे॑दतु॒: साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतू॑ । धृ॒तव्र॑ता क्ष॒त्रिया॑ क्ष॒त्रमा॑शतुः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānā ǀ ní ǀ sedatuḥ ǀ sā́m-rājyāya ǀ sukrátū íti su-krátū ǀdhṛtá-vratā ǀ kṣatríyā ǀ kṣatrám ǀ āśatuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Observers of truth, doers of good deeds, they sit down for the office of sovereignty; observant ofobligations, endowed with strength, they acquire vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒क्ष्णश्चि॑द्गातु॒वित्त॑रानुल्ब॒णेन॒ चक्ष॑सा । नि चि॑न्मि॒षन्ता॑ निचि॒रा नि चि॑क्यतुः
shlokas.transliteration: akṣṇáḥ ǀ cit ǀ gātuvít-tarā ǀ anulbaṇéna ǀ cákṣasā ǀní ǀ cit ǀ miṣántā ǀ ni-cirā́ ǀ ní ǀ cikyatuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through knowers of the path, even before the eye (can see), causing (alll beings) to open their eyelids,existing from of old, and shining with a mild radiance, verily they have been worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॑ दे॒व्यदि॑तिरुरु॒ष्यतां॒ नास॑त्या । उ॒रु॒ष्यन्तु॑ म॒रुतो॑ वृ॒द्धश॑वसः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ uruṣyátām ǀ nā́satyā ǀuruṣyántu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vṛddhá-śavasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divineAditi, may theNāsatyāsalso protect us; may the rapidMarutsdefend us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ ना॒वमु॑रुष्यत॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ सुदानवः । अरि॑ष्यन्तो॒ नि पा॒युभि॑: सचेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ nāvám ǀ uruṣyata ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ su-dānavaḥ ǀáriṣyantaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ sacemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Munificent and irresistible (Maruts), guard our vessel by day and night, so that we may be securethrough your protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अघ्न॑ते॒ विष्ण॑वे व॒यमरि॑ष्यन्तः सु॒दान॑वे । श्रु॒धि स्व॑यावन्त्सिन्धो पू॒र्वचि॑त्तये
shlokas.transliteration: ághnate ǀ víṣṇave ǀ vayám ǀ áriṣyantaḥ ǀ su-dā́nave ǀśrudhí ǀ sva-yāvan ǀ sindho íti ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, injured (through his protection, offer praise) to the liberalViṣṇu, who harms not (his adorers); doyou who goes by thyself alone (to combat), and cause wealth to flow (to the worshipper), hear (our prayer) inbehalf of him who has commenced the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्वार्यं॑ वृणीमहे॒ वरि॑ष्ठं गोप॒यत्य॑म् । मि॒त्रो यत्पान्ति॒ वरु॑णो॒ यद॑र्य॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vā́ryam ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ váriṣṭham ǀ gopayátyam ǀmitráḥ ǀ yát ǀ pā́nti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yát ǀ aryamā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit that ample, all-desired, all-guarding (wealth) whichMitra,VaruṇaandAryamanhold undertheir protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॒: सिन्धु॑र॒पां तन्म॒रुत॒स्तद॒श्विना॑ । इन्द्रो॒ विष्णु॑र्मी॒ढ्वांस॑: स॒जोष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ tát ǀ marútaḥ ǀ tát ǀ aśvínā ǀíndraḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yes, may he who causes the waters to flow (Parjanya), theMaruts, theAśvins,Indra,Viṣṇu, may all(these deities) together, the showerers (of benefits, protect) that wealth for us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि ष्मा॑ व॒नुषो॒ नरो॒ऽभिमा॑तिं॒ कय॑स्य चित् । ति॒ग्मं न क्षोद॑: प्रति॒घ्नन्ति॒ भूर्ण॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ abhí-mātim ǀ káyasya ǀ cit ǀtigmám ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ prati-ghnánti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those desirable leaders (of men), rapid in movement, break down the haughtiness of any (foe)whatever, as an impetuous current (sweeps away all obstacles).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यमेक॑ इ॒त्था पु॒रूरु च॑ष्टे॒ वि वि॒श्पति॑: । तस्य॑ व्र॒तान्यनु॑ वश्चरामसि
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ purú ǀ urú ǀ caṣṭe ǀ ví ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀtásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ánu ǀ vaḥ ǀ carāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This one, the lord of man (Mitra), contemplates many vast things; we follow his rites for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ पूर्वा॑ण्यो॒क्या॑ साम्रा॒ज्यस्य॑ सश्चिम । मि॒त्रस्य॑ व्र॒ता वरु॑णस्य दीर्घ॒श्रुत्
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ pū́rvāṇi ǀ okyā́ ǀ sām-rājyásya ǀ saścima ǀmitrásya ǀ vratā́ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dīrgha-śrút ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We observe the ancient rites of the imperialVaruṇaand the renownedMitra, (rites) that are good for(our) dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यो र॒श्मिना॑ दि॒वोऽन्ता॑न्म॒मे पृ॑थि॒व्याः । उ॒भे आ प॑प्रौ॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yáḥ ǀ raśmínā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀ mamé ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ paprau ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Mitrais he) who has measured with his rays the limits of both heaven and earth; who has filled bothheaven and earth with his greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य श॑र॒णे दि॒वो ज्योति॑रयंस्त॒ सूर्य॑: । अ॒ग्निर्न शु॒क्रः स॑मिधा॒न आहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ śaraṇé ǀ diváḥ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ayaṃsta ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukráḥ ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He,Sūrya, has uplifted his radiance in the region of the heaven; kindled and invoked withburnt-offerings, he is bright, likeAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वचो॑ दी॒र्घप्र॑सद्म॒नीशे॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः । ईशे॒ हि पि॒त्वो॑ऽवि॒षस्य॑ दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: vácaḥ ǀ dīrghá-prasadmani ǀ ī́śe ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀī́śe ǀ hí ǀ pitváḥ ǀ aviṣásya ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Raise your voice in the spacious hall of sacrifice (to him) who is lord over food derived from cattle, whois able to grant nutritious sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्सूर्यं॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे दो॒षा वस्तो॒रुप॑ ब्रुवे । भो॒जेष्व॒स्माँ अ॒भ्युच्च॑रा॒ सदा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀbhojéṣu ǀ asmā́n ǀ abhí ǀ út ǀ cara ǀ sádā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify by night and day that sun (MitraandVaruṇa) and both the heaven and earth; do you (Varuṇa)ever bring us to the presence of the bountiful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ज्रमु॑क्ष॒ण्याय॑ने रज॒तं हर॑याणे । रथं॑ यु॒क्तम॑सनाम सु॒षाम॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjrám ǀ ukṣaṇyā́yane ǀ rajatám ǀ hárayāṇe ǀrátham ǀ yuktám ǀ asanāma ǀ su-sā́mani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have received from the son ofSuṣāman, the descendant ofUkṣan, the overcomer (of foes), awell-going chariot of silver, yoked (with a pair of horses).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता मे॒ अश्व्या॑नां॒ हरी॑णां नि॒तोश॑ना । उ॒तो नु कृत्व्या॑नां नृ॒वाह॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ me ǀ áśvyānām ǀ hárīṇām ǀ ni-tóśanā ǀutó íti ǀ nú ǀ kṛ́tvyānām ǀ nṛ-vā́hasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Among bay horses these two are pre-eminently the destroyers (of foes), and of those eager in combat;the two strong bearers of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्मद॑भीशू॒ कशा॑वन्ता॒ विप्रा॒ नवि॑ष्ठया म॒ती । म॒हो वा॒जिना॒वर्व॑न्ता॒ सचा॑सनम्
shlokas.transliteration: smádabhīśū íti smát-abhīśū ǀ káśā-vantā ǀ víprā ǀ náviṣṭhayā ǀ matī́ ǀmaháḥ ǀ vājínau ǀ árvantā ǀ sácā ǀ asanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through this new praise (ofMitraandVaruṇa) I have obtained at the same moment of the mightyprince, two fast-going sagacious steeds, with whip and reins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोरु॒ षू रथं॑ हुवे स॒धस्तु॑त्याय सू॒रिषु॑ । अतू॑र्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ rátham ǀ huve ǀ sadhá-stutyāya ǀ sūríṣu ǀátūrta-dakṣā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Aśvins) of irresistible strength, affluent showerers (of benefits), I invoke your chariot amid the pious,who are assembled to celebrate your presence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं व॑रो सु॒षाम्णे॑ म॒हे तने॑ नासत्या । अवो॑भिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ varo íti ǀ su-sā́mne ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ nāsatyā ǀávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yāthaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Say), Varu (thus),Nāsatyās, senders of rain, affluent showerers (of benefits), as you came toSuṣāman with your protections to (grant him) great riches, (so come to me).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वा॑म॒द्य ह॑वामहे ह॒व्येभि॑र्वाजिनीवसू । पू॒र्वीरि॒ष इ॒षय॑न्ता॒वति॑ क्ष॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ adyá ǀ havāmahe ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ iṣáyantau ǀ áti ǀ kṣapáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent in nourishment, we invoke you, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food, on this occasion at dawnwith oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ वाहि॑ष्ठो अश्विना॒ रथो॑ यातु श्रु॒तो न॑रा । उप॒ स्तोमा॑न्तु॒रस्य॑ दर्शथः श्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ yātu ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ narā ǀúpa ǀ stómān ǀ turásya ǀ darśathaḥ ǀ śriyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), let your renowned all-conveying chariot come to us, and (do you) recognize thepraisers of the zealous (worshipper) for his prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒हु॒रा॒णा चि॑दश्वि॒ना म॑न्येथां वृषण्वसू । यु॒वं हि रु॑द्रा॒ पर्ष॑थो॒ अति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: juhurāṇā́ ǀ cit ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ manyethām ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀyuvám ǀ hí ǀ rudrā ǀ párṣathaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, affluent showerers (of benefits), detect the guileful, verily,Rudras, vex your adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒स्रा हि विश्व॑मानु॒षङ्म॒क्षूभि॑: परि॒दीय॑थः । धि॒यं॒जि॒न्वा मधु॑वर्णा शु॒भस्पती॑
shlokas.transliteration: dasrā́ ǀ hí ǀ víśvam ǀ ānuṣák ǀ makṣú-bhiḥ ǀ pari-dī́yathaḥ ǀdhiyam-jinvā́ ǀ mádhu-varṇā ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasras, who are gratified by sacred rites, of fascinating complexion, lords of rain, pass with your fleet(horses) completely round our entier (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ नो यातमश्विना रा॒या वि॑श्व॒पुषा॑ स॒ह । म॒घवा॑ना सु॒वीरा॒वन॑पच्युता
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ rāyā́ ǀ viśva-púṣā ǀ sahá ǀmaghá-vānā ǀ su-vī́rau ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Aśvins, with all-supporting riches, for you are opulent, heroic, overthrown of none.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मे॑ अ॒स्य प्र॑ती॒व्य१॒॑मिन्द्र॑नासत्या गतम् । दे॒वा दे॒वेभि॑र॒द्य स॒चन॑स्तमा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ pratīvyám ǀ índranāsatyā ǀ gatam ǀdevā́ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sacánaḥ-tamā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandNāsatyās, who are most accessible, come to this my sacrifice; come, gods, today with(other) divinities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं हि वां॒ हवा॑मह उक्ष॒ण्यन्तो॑ व्यश्व॒वत् । सु॒म॒तिभि॒रुप॑ विप्रावि॒हा ग॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ hávāmahe ǀ ukṣaṇyántaḥ ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀsumatí-bhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ viprau ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of you who are bestowers of wealth, we invoke you, as did (your father)Vyaśva; come,sagaciousAśvins, here with favourable intentions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॒ स्वृ॑षे स्तुहि कु॒वित्ते॒ श्रव॑तो॒ हव॑म् । नेदी॑यसः कूळयातः प॒णीँरु॒त
shlokas.transliteration: aśvínā ǀ sú ǀ ṛṣe ǀ stuhi ǀ kuvít ǀ te ǀ śrávataḥ ǀ hávam ǀnédīyasaḥ ǀ kūḷayātaḥ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ utá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise theAśvinsdevoutly, Ṛṣi, that they may repeatedly hear your invocation, and destroy thenearest (approaching enemies) and thePaṇis.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वै॒य॒श्वस्य॑ श्रुतं नरो॒तो मे॑ अ॒स्य वे॑दथः । स॒जोष॑सा॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: vaiyaśvásya ǀ śrutam ǀ narā ǀ utó íti ǀ me ǀ asyá ǀ vedathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasā ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear, leaders (of rites), (the invocation) of me the son ofVyaśva, and understand its (purport), and mayVaruṇa,MitraansAryamanconcurrently (grant me wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वाद॑त्तस्य धिष्ण्या यु॒वानी॑तस्य सू॒रिभि॑: । अह॑रहर्वृषण॒ मह्यं॑ शिक्षतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́-dattasya ǀ dhiṣṇyā ǀ yuvā́-nītasya ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ máhyam ǀ śikṣatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable showerers (of benefits), bestow daily upon me (some) of that (wealth) which is given by you,which is brought by you for the worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वां॑ य॒ज्ञेभि॒रावृ॒तोऽधि॑वस्त्रा व॒धूरि॑व । स॒प॒र्यन्ता॑ शु॒भे च॑क्राते अ॒श्विना॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ ā́-vṛtaḥ ǀ ádhi-vastrā ǀ vadhū́ḥ-iva ǀsaparyántā ǀ śubhé ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ aśvínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who is enveloped in sacrifices (offered) to you, like a woman with additional raiment,rewarding him,Aśvins, you plural ce him in prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वा॑मुरु॒व्यच॑स्तमं॒ चिके॑तति नृ॒पाय्य॑म् । व॒र्तिर॑श्विना॒ परि॑ यातमस्म॒यू
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ uruvyácaḥ-tamam ǀ cíketati ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǀvartíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ pári ǀ yātam ǀ asmayū́ ítyasma-yū́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Favourably disposed towards me, come,Aśvins, to the dwelling of him who knows (how to prepare foryou) the most copiously effused (libation) to be drunk by the leaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ सु वृ॑षण्वसू या॒तं व॒र्तिर्नृ॒पाय्य॑म् । वि॒षु॒द्रुहे॑व य॒ज्ञमू॑हथुर्गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ sú ǀ vṛṣaṇvasū íti vṛṣaṇ-vasū ǀ yātám ǀ vartíḥ ǀ nṛ-pā́yyam ǀviṣudrúhā-iva ǀ yajñám ǀ ūhathuḥ ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Affluent showerers (of benefits), come to our dwelling for (the libation) to be drunk by the leaders (ofrites), for you bring the sacrifice to completion by praise, as the fatal shaft (slays the deer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाहि॑ष्ठो वां॒ हवा॑नां॒ स्तोमो॑ दू॒तो हु॑वन्नरा । यु॒वाभ्यां॑ भूत्वश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: vā́hiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vām ǀ hávānām ǀ stómaḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ huvat ǀ narā ǀyuvā́bhyām ǀ bhūtu ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, leaders (of rites), among (all) invocations may my most earnest praise invoke you as amessenger may it be (acceptable) to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒दो दि॒वो अ॑र्ण॒व इ॒षो वा॒ मद॑थो गृ॒हे । श्रु॒तमिन्मे॑ अमर्त्या
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ arṇavé ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ vā ǀ mádathaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀśrutám ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ amartyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether, immortal (Aśvins), you rejoice in the water of the firmament, or in the dwelling of theworshipper hear this my (invocation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्या श्वे॑त॒याव॑री॒ वाहि॑ष्ठा वां न॒दीना॑म् । सिन्धु॒र्हिर॑ण्यवर्तनिः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ syā́ ǀ śveta-yā́varī ǀ vā́hiṣṭhā ǀ vām ǀ nadī́nām ǀsíndhuḥ ǀ híraṇya-vartaniḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily this Śvetayāvarī, the golden-pathed river, is of all rivers the especial bearer of your (praises).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्मदे॒तया॑ सुकी॒र्त्याश्वि॑ना श्वे॒तया॑ धि॒या । वहे॑थे शुभ्रयावाना
shlokas.transliteration: smát ǀ etáyā ǀ su-kīrtyā́ ǀ áśvinā ǀ śvetáyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀváhethe íti ǀ śubhra-yāvānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, following a brilliant course, you acquire celebrity by the white river worthily praising you theenricher (of the peole on its banks).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि त्वं र॑था॒सहा॑ यु॒वस्व॒ पोष्या॑ वसो । आन्नो॑ वायो॒ मधु॑ पिबा॒स्माकं॒ सव॒ना ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yukṣvá ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ ratha-sáhā ǀ yuvásva ǀ póṣyā ǀ vaso íti ǀā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ mádhu ǀ piba ǀ asmā́kam ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke your chariot-drawing horses,Vāyu; bring them,Vasu, encouraged (to the sacrifice); then drinkourSoma, come to our daily libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ वायवृतस्पते॒ त्वष्टु॑र्जामातरद्भुत । अवां॒स्या वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ṛtaḥ-pate ǀ tváṣṭuḥ ǀ jāmātaḥ ǀ adbhuta ǀávāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit your protection,Vāyu, lord of sacrifice wonderful son-in- law ofTvaṣṭā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टु॒र्जामा॑तरं व॒यमीशा॑नं रा॒य ई॑महे । सु॒ताव॑न्तो वा॒युं द्यु॒म्ना जना॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭuḥ ǀ jā́mātaram ǀ vayám ǀ ī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǀsutá-vantaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, the offerers ofSoma, solicit riches from the sovereign, the son- in-law ofTvaṣṭā; (may webecome) wealthy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वायो॑ या॒हि शि॒वा दि॒वो वह॑स्वा॒ सु स्वश्व्य॑म् । वह॑स्व म॒हः पृ॑थु॒पक्ष॑सा॒ रथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: vā́yo íti ǀ yāhí ǀ śiva ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ váhasva ǀ sú ǀ su-áśvyam ǀváhasva ǀ maháḥ ǀ pṛthu-pákṣasā ǀ ráthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Establish,Vāyu, happiness in heaven; bear quickly your well-horsed (chariot); do you, who are mighty,yoke the broad-flanked (horses) to the car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां हि सु॒प्सर॑स्तमं नृ॒षद॑नेषु हू॒महे॑ । ग्रावा॑णं॒ नाश्व॑पृष्ठं मं॒हना॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ supsáraḥ-tamam ǀ nṛ-sádaneṣu ǀ hūmáhe ǀgrā́vāṇam ǀ ná ǀ áśva-pṛṣṭham ǀ maṃhánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you who are of graceful form, extending through your magnitude your limbs in all directions,to our religious rites, like the stone (for bruising theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं नो॑ देव॒ मन॑सा॒ वायो॑ मन्दा॒नो अ॑ग्रि॒यः । कृ॒धि वाजाँ॑ अ॒पो धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ mánasā ǀ vā́yo íti ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀkṛdhí ǀ vā́jān ǀ apáḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineVāyu, foremost (of the gods), exulting in your won mind, cause our rites to be productive of foodand water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरु॒क्थे पु॒रोहि॑तो॒ ग्रावा॑णो ब॒र्हिर॑ध्व॒रे । ऋ॒चा या॑मि म॒रुतो॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॑ दे॒वाँ अवो॒ वरे॑ण्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ukthé ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀṛcā́ ǀ yāmi ǀ marútaḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǀ devā́n ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis thePurohitaat the sacrifice; the stones, the sacred grass (are prepared) for the ceremony. Iinvoke with the holy verse theMaruts,Brahmaṇaspati, and all the gods, for their desirable protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॒शुं गा॑सि पृथि॒वीं वन॒स्पती॑नु॒षासा॒ नक्त॒मोष॑धीः । विश्वे॑ च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धी॒नां भू॑त प्रावि॒तार॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ gāsi ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ uṣásā ǀ náktam ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀvíśve ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ bhūta ǀ pra-avitā́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You come (Agni) to the victim, to the dwelling (of the worshipper), to the touchwood, to theSoma, atdawn and at night; universal deities, givers of wealth, knowing all things, be the defenders of our pious actṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सू न॑ एत्वध्व॒रो॒३॒॑ऽग्ना दे॒वेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यः । आ॒दि॒त्येषु॒ प्र वरु॑णे धृ॒तव्र॑ते म॒रुत्सु॑ वि॒श्वभा॑नुषु
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ etu ǀ adhvaráḥ ǀ agnā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀādityéṣu ǀ prá ǀ váruṇe ǀ dhṛtá-vrate ǀ marút-su ǀ viśvá-bhānuṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the ancient sacrifice proceed first toAgni, then to the gods, -- to theĀdityas, toVaruṇa, observantof obligations, to the all-resplendentMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॒ हि ष्मा॒ मन॑वे वि॒श्ववे॑दसो॒ भुव॑न्वृ॒धे रि॒शाद॑सः । अरि॑ष्टेभिः पा॒युभि॑र्विश्ववेदसो॒ यन्ता॑ नोऽवृ॒कं छ॒र्दिः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ mánave ǀ viśvá-vedasaḥ ǀ bhúvan ǀ vṛdhé ǀ riśā́dasaḥ ǀáriṣṭebhiḥ ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ yánta ǀ naḥ ǀ avṛkám ǀ chardíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the universal deities, possessors of all opulence, destroyers of foes, be (near) toManufor hisprosperity; do you, who know all things, secure to us an abode safe from robbers through unassailableprotections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ अ॒द्य सम॑नसो॒ गन्ता॒ विश्वे॑ स॒जोष॑सः । ऋ॒चा गि॒रा मरु॑तो॒ देव्यदि॑ते॒ सद॑ने॒ पस्त्ये॑ महि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sá-manasaḥ ǀ gánta ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀṛcā́ ǀ girā́ ǀ márutaḥ ǀ dévi ǀ ádite ǀ sádane ǀ pástye ǀ mahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal deities, united together and of one mind, come this day to us, (attracted) by the sacred praiseaddressed to you; and do you,Maruts, and the mighty goddessAditi, (come) to the dwelling, (our) abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒या म॑रुतो॒ या वो॒ अश्व्या॑ ह॒व्या मि॑त्र प्रया॒थन॑ । आ ब॒र्हिरिन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णस्तु॒रा नर॑ आदि॒त्यास॑: सदन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ áśvyā ǀ havyā́ ǀ mitra ǀ pra-yāthána ǀā́ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ turā́ḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ sadantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Direct,Maruts, your beloved horses (to our rite);Mitra, (come to our) oblations; and mayIndra, andVaruṇa, and the swift leaders, theĀdityas, sit down on our sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं वो॑ वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषो हि॒तप्र॑यस आनु॒षक् । सु॒तसो॑मासो वरुण हवामहे मनु॒ष्वदि॒द्धाग्न॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀsutá-somāsaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ havāmahe ǀ manuṣvát ǀ iddhá-agnayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearing the clipped sacred grass, offering in due order the (sacrificial) food, presenting the effusedSoma, and having the fires kindled, we invoke you,Varuṇa, (and the rest), as didManus.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प्र या॑त॒ मरु॑तो॒ विष्णो॒ अश्वि॑ना॒ पूष॒न्माकी॑नया धि॒या । इन्द्र॒ आ या॑तु प्रथ॒मः स॑नि॒ष्युभि॒र्वृषा॒ यो वृ॑त्र॒हा गृ॒णे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ prá ǀ yāta ǀ márutaḥ ǀ víṣṇo íti ǀ áśvinā ǀ pū́ṣan ǀ mā́kīnayā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀíndraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ saniṣyú-bhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ gṛṇé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts,Viṣṇu,Aśvins,Pūṣan, come here (induced) by my praise; mayIndra, the first (of the gods),also come, the showerer (of benefits), he who is praised by (his) worshippers as the slayer ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि नो॑ देवासो अद्रु॒होऽच्छि॑द्रं॒ शर्म॑ यच्छत । न यद्दू॒राद्व॑सवो॒ नू चि॒दन्ति॑तो॒ वरू॑थमाद॒धर्ष॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ naḥ ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ adruhaḥ ǀ ácchidram ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀná ǀ yát ǀ dūrā́t ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ várūtham ǀ ā-dadhárṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unoppressive deities, bestow upon us a mansion without defect, so that, subduers (of foes), no onemay injure our defences, whether from afar or near.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ति॒ हि व॑: सजा॒त्यं॑ रिशादसो॒ देवा॑सो॒ अस्त्याप्य॑म् । प्र ण॒: पूर्व॑स्मै सुवि॒ताय॑ वोचत म॒क्षू सु॒म्नाय॒ नव्य॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ásti ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ sa-jātyám ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ ā́pyam ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rvasmai ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ vocata ǀ makṣú ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ návyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There is identity of race among you, deities, destroyers of foes; there is kindred (with me yourworshipper); therefore, utter at once the command for our former prosperity and for new happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दा हि व॒ उप॑स्तुतिमि॒दा वा॒मस्य॑ भ॒क्तये॑ । उप॑ वो विश्ववेदसो नम॒स्युराँ असृ॒क्ष्यन्या॑मिव
shlokas.transliteration: idā́ ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ idā́ ǀ vāmásya ǀ bhaktáye ǀúpa ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ namasyúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ásṛkṣi ǀ ányām-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deities, possessed of all wealth, I, desirous of offering worship, address to you verily unprecedentedpraise, for the sake of obtaining desired affluence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदु॒ ष्य व॑: सवि॒ता सु॑प्रणीत॒योऽस्था॑दू॒र्ध्वो वरे॑ण्यः । नि द्वि॒पाद॒श्चतु॑ष्पादो अ॒र्थिनोऽवि॑श्रन्पतयि॒ष्णव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-pranītayaḥ ǀ ásthāt ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀní ǀ dvi-pā́daḥ ǀ cátuḥ-pādaḥ ǀ arthínaḥ ǀ áviśran ǀ patayiṣṇávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoutly praised (Maruts), when the adorableSavitāhas risen above you, then bipeds andquadrupeds, and the flying birds, seeking (their objects), enter (upon their functions).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वंदे॑वं॒ वोऽव॑से दे॒वंदे॑वम॒भिष्ट॑ये । दे॒वंदे॑वं हुवेम॒ वाज॑सातये गृ॒णन्तो॑ दे॒व्या धि॒या
shlokas.transliteration: devám-devam ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ devám-devam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀdevám-devam ǀ huvema ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ devyā́ ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We would invoke each deity among you (gods) for protection, each deity for the attainment of ourdesires, each deity for the acquisition of food, glorifying you with divine praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वासो॒ हि ष्मा॒ मन॑वे॒ सम॑न्यवो॒ विश्वे॑ सा॒कं सरा॑तयः । ते नो॑ अ॒द्य ते अ॑प॒रं तु॒चे तु नो॒ भव॑न्तु वरिवो॒विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: devā́saḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ mánave ǀ sá-manyavaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ sākám ǀ sá-rātayaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ té ǀ aparám ǀ tucé ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ bhávantu ǀ varivaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the universal gods with one consent be together the givers (of riches) toManu; may they, bothtoday and hereafter, be the bestowers of wealth upon us and upon our posterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑: शंसाम्यद्रुहः सं॒स्थ उप॑स्तुतीनाम् । न तं धू॒र्तिर्व॑रुण मित्र॒ मर्त्यं॒ यो वो॒ धाम॒भ्योऽवि॑धत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ śaṃsāmi ǀ adruhaḥ ǀ sam-sthé ǀ úpa-stutīnām ǀná ǀ tám ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ mártyam ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhā́ma-bhyaḥ ǀ ávidhat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify you, inoxious deities, in the plural ce of praises; no harm befalls the man who,MitraandVaruṇa,offers (oblations) to your glories.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स क्षयं॑ तिरते॒ वि म॒हीरिषो॒ यो वो॒ वरा॑य॒ दाश॑ति । प्र प्र॒जाभि॑र्जायते॒ धर्म॑ण॒स्पर्यरि॑ष्ट॒: सर्व॑ एधते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ tirate ǀ ví ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ várāya ǀ dā́śati ǀprá ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀ áriṣṭaḥ ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ edhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He enlarges his dweling, he has abundant food who offers you (oblations) to obtain a blessing; throughhis pious acts he is born on every side in his children; all prosper (through your favour) unharmed (by enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ते स वि॑न्दते यु॒धः सु॒गेभि॑र्या॒त्यध्व॑नः । अ॒र्य॒मा मि॒त्रो वरु॑ण॒: सरा॑तयो॒ यं त्राय॑न्ते स॒जोष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛté ǀ sáḥ ǀ vindate ǀ yudháḥ ǀ su-gébhiḥ ǀ yāti ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀaryamā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sá-rātayaḥ ǀ yám ǀ trā́yante ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He gains (wealth) without war, he travels along the roads with quick (horses), whomAryaman, MitraandVaruṇa, alike munificent, and acting in concert, protect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अज्रे॑ चिदस्मै कृणुथा॒ न्यञ्च॑नं दु॒र्गे चि॒दा सु॑सर॒णम् । ए॒षा चि॑दस्माद॒शनि॑: प॒रो नु सास्रे॑धन्ती॒ वि न॑श्यतु
shlokas.transliteration: ájre ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ kṛṇutha ǀ ni-áñcanam ǀ duḥ-gé ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ su-saraṇám ǀeṣā́ ǀ cit ǀ asmāt ǀ aśániḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ nú ǀ sā́ ǀ ásredhantī ǀ ví ǀ naśyatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You enable him (Manu) to proceed by an unobstructed road; you grant him easy access to difficultpasses; may the weapon (of the foe) be far from him, and, inflicting no injury, perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य सूर्य॑ उद्य॒ति प्रिय॑क्षत्रा ऋ॒तं द॒ध । यन्नि॒म्रुचि॑ प्र॒बुधि॑ विश्ववेदसो॒ यद्वा॑ म॒ध्यंदि॑ने दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ut-yatí ǀ príya-kṣatrāḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ dadhá ǀyát ǀ ni-mrúci ǀ pra-búdhi ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ madhyándine ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divinities of benevolent vigour, since you preside over the rite today, at the rising of the sun, since,possessors of all wealth, (you are present) at his setting, or at his waking, or at the meridian of the day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑भिपि॒त्वे अ॑सुरा ऋ॒तं य॒ते छ॒र्दिर्ये॒म वि दा॒शुषे॑ । व॒यं तद्वो॑ वसवो विश्ववेदस॒ उप॑ स्थेयाम॒ मध्य॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ abhi-pitvé ǀ asurāḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀ chardíḥ ǀ yemá ǀ ví ǀ dāśúṣe ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stheyāma ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or since all-wise deities, you accept the sacrifice, bestowing on the zealous donor (of the oblation) aswelling (such as we may worship in) then, possessors of all wealth, distributors of riches, may we worshp you inthe midst (of that dwelling).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्य सूर॒ उदि॑ते॒ यन्म॒ध्यंदि॑न आ॒तुचि॑ । वा॒मं ध॒त्थ मन॑वे विश्ववेदसो॒ जुह्वा॑नाय॒ प्रचे॑तसे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ adyá ǀ sū́re ǀ út-ite ǀ yát ǀ madhyándine ǀ ā-túci ǀvāmám ǀ dhatthá ǀ mánave ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ júhvānāya ǀ prá-cetase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Gods), who are possessed of all wealth, bestow the desired (opulence) upon the intelligentManu,offering oblations to you at sunrise, mid-day and sunset.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं तद्व॑: सम्राज॒ आ वृ॑णीमहे पु॒त्रो न ब॑हु॒पाय्य॑म् । अ॒श्याम॒ तदा॑दित्या॒ जुह्व॑तो ह॒विर्येन॒ वस्यो॒ऽनशा॑महै
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ sam-rājaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ bahu-pā́yyam ǀaśyā́ma ǀ tát ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ júhvataḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ yéna ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ anáśāmahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit of you, resplendent deities, as a son (of a father), that which is to be enjoyed by many;offering oblations, may we obtain that (wealth),Ādityas, by which we may possess abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये त्रिं॒शति॒ त्रय॑स्प॒रो दे॒वासो॑ ब॒र्हिरास॑दन् । वि॒दन्नह॑ द्वि॒तास॑नन्
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the three-and-thirty divinities sit down upon the sacred grass; may they accept (our offerings), andbestow upon us both (sorts of wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा स्मद्रा॑तिषाचो अ॒ग्नय॑: । पत्नी॑वन्तो॒ वष॑ट्कृताः
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVaruṇa,Mitra,Aryamanand theAgnis, with their wives, honouring the donors (of the oblation),and addressed with the sacrificial exclamation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ गो॒पा अ॑पा॒च्यास्त उद॒क्त इ॒त्था न्य॑क् । पु॒रस्ता॒त्सर्व॑या वि॒शा
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be our protectors, whether coming with all their attendants from the west, from the north, from thesouth, from the east.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ वश॑न्ति दे॒वास्तथेद॑स॒त्तदे॑षां॒ नकि॒रा मि॑नत् । अरा॑वा च॒न मर्त्य॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever the gods desire, that assuredly comes to pass; no one can resist their (will), no mortalwithholds (their) offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्ता॒नां स॒प्त ऋ॒ष्टय॑: स॒प्त द्यु॒म्नान्ये॑षाम् । स॒प्तो अधि॒ श्रियो॑ धिरे
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seven are he lances of the seven (troops of theMaruts), seven are their ornaments, they wear sevensurpassing glories.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒भ्रुरेको॒ विषु॑णः सू॒नरो॒ युवा॒ञ्ज्य॑ङ्क्ते हिर॒ण्यय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: babhrúḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ víṣuṇaḥ ǀ sūnáraḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ añjí ǀ aṅkte ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Soma) brown of hue, all-pervading, leader of the nights, ever young, decorates (himself) withgolden ornament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: योनि॒मेक॒ आ स॑साद॒ द्योत॑नो॒ऽन्तर्दे॒वेषु॒ मेधि॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: yónim ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sasāda ǀ dyótanaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ médhiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Agni) intelligent, resplended among the gods, is seated in his plural ce (the altar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वाशी॒मेको॑ बिभर्ति॒ हस्त॑ आय॒सीम॒न्तर्दे॒वेषु॒ निध्रु॑विः
shlokas.transliteration: vā́śīm ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ āyasī́m ǀ antáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ní-dhruviḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Tvaṣṭā) immoveably stationed among the gods, holds his metal axe in hishand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वज्र॒मेको॑ बिभर्ति॒ हस्त॒ आहि॑तं॒ तेन॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जिघ्नते
shlokas.transliteration: vájram ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ ā́-hitam ǀ téna ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Indra) holds his thunderbol wielded in hishand, by which he slays theVṛtras.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒ग्ममेको॑ बिभर्ति॒ हस्त॒ आयु॑धं॒ शुचि॑रु॒ग्रो जला॑षभेषजः
shlokas.transliteration: tigmám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ háste ǀ ā́yudham ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ jálāṣa-bheṣajaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Rudra) brilliant and fierce, (yet) the distributor of healingmedicines, holds his sharp weapon in hishand.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒थ एक॑: पीपाय॒ तस्क॑रो यथाँ ए॒ष वे॑द निधी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: patháḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ pīpāya ǀ táskaraḥ ǀ yathā ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ veda ǀ ni-dhīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Pūṣan) watches the roads like a robber, and is cognizant of hidden treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीण्येक॑ उरुगा॒यो वि च॑क्रमे॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वासो॒ मद॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ ékaḥ ǀ uru-gāyáḥ ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ yátra ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ mádanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One (Viṣṇu) wide-stepping, has traversed thethree worldswhere the gods rejoice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विभि॒र्द्वा च॑रत॒ एक॑या स॒ह प्र प्र॑वा॒सेव॑ वसतः
shlokas.transliteration: ví-bhiḥ ǀ dvā́ ǀ carataḥ ǀ ékayā ǀ sahá ǀ prá ǀ pravāsā́-iva ǀ vasataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Two (theAśvins), travel with swift (horses) along with one (brideSūrya), like travellers to foreigncountries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सदो॒ द्वा च॑क्राते उप॒मा दि॒वि स॒म्राजा॑ स॒र्पिरा॑सुती
shlokas.transliteration: sádaḥ ǀ dvā́ ǀ cakrāte íti ǀ upa-mā́ ǀ diví ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ sarpírāsutī íti sarpíḥ-āsutī ǁ
