shlokas.meaning_en: “Two of like beauty and of royal rank (MitraandVaruṇa), worshipped with oblations of clarified butter,have taken their seat in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्च॑न्त॒ एके॒ महि॒ साम॑ मन्वत॒ तेन॒ सूर्य॑मरोचयन्
shlokas.transliteration: árcantaḥ ǀ éke ǀ máhi ǀ sā́ma ǀ manvata ǀ téna ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some (theAtris) when worshipping, call to mind the greatSāman, wherewith they light up the suṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि वो॒ अस्त्य॑र्भ॒को देवा॑सो॒ न कु॑मार॒कः । विश्वे॑ स॒तोम॑हान्त॒ इत्
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ arbhakáḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kumārakáḥ ǀvíśve ǀ satáḥ-mahāntaḥ ǀ ít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There is no one among you, gods, who is an infant or a youth; you verily are all of mature existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॑ स्तु॒तासो॑ असथा रिशादसो॒ ये स्थ त्रय॑श्च त्रिं॒शच्च॑ । मनो॑र्देवा यज्ञियासः
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ stutā́saḥ ǀ asatha ǀ riśādasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sthá ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ triṃśát ǀ ca ǀmánoḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyers of foes, gods, adored byManu, who are three-and-thirty, and are thus hymned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते न॑स्त्राध्वं॒ ते॑ऽवत॒ त उ॑ नो॒ अधि॑ वोचत । मा न॑: प॒थः पित्र्या॑न्मान॒वादधि॑ दू॒रं नै॑ष्ट परा॒वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ trādhvam ǀ te ǀ avata ǀ té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ pítryāt ǀ mānavā́t ǀ ádhi ǀ dūrám ǀ naiṣṭa ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you preserve us, do you protect us, do you direct us (to our good); lead us not afar from the paternalpaths ofManu, nor from those still more distant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये दे॑वास इ॒ह स्थन॒ विश्वे॑ वैश्वान॒रा उ॒त । अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथो॒ गवेऽश्वा॑य यच्छत
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ sthána ǀ víśve ǀ vaiśvānarā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀasmábhyam ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ gáve ǀ áśvāya ǀ yacchata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, who are here present, all to whom this full sacrifice is offered, bestow upon us, upon our cattleand horses, happiness far renowned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो यजा॑ति॒ यजा॑त॒ इत्सु॒नव॑च्च॒ पचा॑ति च । ब्र॒ह्मेदिन्द्र॑स्य चाकनत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ yájāti ǀ yájāte ǀ ít ǀ sunávat ǀ ca ǀ pácāti ǀ ca ǀbrahmā́ ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ cākanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who offers oblations (to the gods, again) offers them; he pours forth libations and presents (thesacred cake), he delights in reiterating the praise verily ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रो॒ळाशं॒ यो अ॑स्मै॒ सोमं॒ रर॑त आ॒शिर॑म् । पादित्तं श॒क्रो अंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: puroḷā́śam ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ sómam ǀ rárate ǀ ā-śíram ǀpā́t ǀ ít ǀ tám ǀ śakráḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraprotects from sin that man who offers him cakes and presentsSomamixed with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्य॑ द्यु॒माँ अ॑स॒द्रथो॑ दे॒वजू॑त॒: स शू॑शुवत् । विश्वा॑ व॒न्वन्न॑मि॒त्रिया॑
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ asat ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ devá-jūtaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ śūśuvat ǀvíśvā ǀ vanván ǀ amitríyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A brilliant chariot comes to him, sent by the gods, with which, baffling all hostilities, he prospers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ प्र॒जाव॑ती गृ॒हेऽस॑श्चन्ती दि॒वेदि॑वे । इळा॑ धेनु॒मती॑ दुहे
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ prajā́-vatī ǀ gṛhé ǀ ásaścantī ǀ divé-dive ǀíḷā ǀ dhenu-mátī ǀ duhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In his house perpetual abundance, accompanied by progeny, (is present), and kine are milked day byday.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या दम्प॑ती॒ सम॑नसा सुनु॒त आ च॒ धाव॑तः । देवा॑सो॒ नित्य॑या॒शिरा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ dámpatī íti dám-patī ǀ sá-manasā ǀ sunutáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhā́vataḥ ǀdévāsaḥ ǀ nítyayā ǀ ā-śírā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, may the husband and wife, who with one mind offer libations and purify them, and (propitiateyou) with theSomaever mixed with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ प्राश॒व्याँ॑ इतः स॒म्यञ्चा॑ ब॒र्हिरा॑शाते । न ता वाजे॑षु वायतः
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ prāśavyā́n ǀ itaḥ ǀ samyáñcā ǀ barhíḥ ǀ āśāte íti ǀná ǀ tā́ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vāyataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Constantly associated, may they acquire appropriate (sacrificial) viands; may they be able to offersacrifice; may the never be wanting in food (given by the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न दे॒वाना॒मपि॑ ह्नुतः सुम॒तिं न जु॑गुक्षतः । श्रवो॑ बृ॒हद्वि॑वासतः
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ hnutaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ ná ǀ jughukṣataḥ ǀśrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ vivāsataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They retract not (their promises) to the gods, they withhold not your praise, but offer abundant(sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒त्रिणा॒ ता कु॑मा॒रिणा॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्य॑श्नुतः । उ॒भा हिर॑ण्यपेशसा
shlokas.transliteration: putríṇā ǀ tā́ ǀ kumāríṇā ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnutaḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ híraṇya-peśasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Blessed with youthful and adolescent offsprin, and both having their person ns richly ornamented, theypass (happily) their whole life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒तिहो॑त्रा कृ॒तद्व॑सू दश॒स्यन्ता॒मृता॑य॒ कम् । समूधो॑ रोम॒शं ह॑तो दे॒वेषु॑ कृणुतो॒ दुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vītí-hotrā ǀ kṛtádvasū íti kṛtát-vasū ǀ daśasyántā ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ kám ǀsám ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ romaśám ǀ hataḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ kṛṇutaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offering acceptable sacrifices, obtaining the wealth they solicit, presenting gratifying (oblations to thegods), for the sake of immortality enjoying person nal union, they (wife and husband) worship the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ शर्म॒ पर्व॑तानां वृणी॒महे॑ न॒दीना॑म् । आ विष्णो॑: सचा॒भुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ śárma ǀ párvatānām ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ nadī́nām ǀā́ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit the happiness (afforded) by the mountains, the rivers, andViṣṇu, associated (with thegods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐतु॑ पू॒षा र॒यिर्भग॑: स्व॒स्ति स॑र्व॒धात॑मः । उ॒रुरध्वा॑ स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ etu ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ svastí ǀ sarva-dhā́tamaḥ ǀurúḥ ǀ ádhvā ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the adorablePūṣan, the possessor of opulence, the most benevolent patron to all, comeauspiciously; may a wide path (be open) for our prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रम॑तिरन॒र्वणो॒ विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॒ मन॑सा । आ॒दि॒त्याना॑मने॒ह इत्
shlokas.transliteration: arámatiḥ ǀ anarváṇaḥ ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ mánasā ǀādityā́nām ǀ aneháḥ ǀ ít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All men with (devout) minds are the unwearied (praisers) of the irresistible deity (Pūṣan), verily the(most) sinless of theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ नो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑ण॒: सन्ति॑ गो॒पाः । सु॒गा ऋ॒तस्य॒ पन्था॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀsu-gā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pánthāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SinceMitra,AryamanandVaruṇaare our protectors, may the paths of the sacrifice be easily traversed(by them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं व॑: पू॒र्व्यं गि॒रा दे॒वमी॑ळे॒ वसू॑नाम् । स॒प॒र्यन्त॑: पुरुप्रि॒यं मि॒त्रं न क्षे॑त्र॒साध॑सम्
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ girā́ ǀ devám ǀ īḷe ǀ vásūnām ǀsaparyántaḥ ǀ puru-priyám ǀ mitrám ǀ ná ǀ kṣetra-sā́dhasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship the divineAgni, the preceder of you, (gods), with praise, (for the sake) of riches; theworshippers (cherish him), the bountiful perfector of the sacrifice, like a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू दे॒वव॑तो॒ रथ॒: शूरो॑ वा पृ॒त्सु कासु॑ चित् । दे॒वानां॒ य इन्मनो॒ यज॑मान॒ इय॑क्षत्य॒भीदय॑ज्वनो भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ devá-vataḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ vā ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ kā́su ǀ cit ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chariot of the devout worshipper quickly (prevails), as the hero (prevails) in all combats whatever;the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are nosacrificers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न य॑जमान रिष्यसि॒ न सु॑न्वान॒ न दे॑वयो । दे॒वानां॒ य इन्मनो॒ यज॑मान॒ इय॑क्षत्य॒भीदय॑ज्वनो भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yajamāna ǀ riṣyasi ǀ ná ǀ sunvāna ǀ ná ǀ devayo íti deva-yo ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to the gods, pouring out to them libations, you, worshipper, shall not perish; the celebrator ofthe sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॒ष्टं कर्म॑णा नश॒न्न प्र यो॑ष॒न्न यो॑षति । दे॒वानां॒ य इन्मनो॒ यज॑मान॒ इय॑क्षत्य॒भीदय॑ज्वनो भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ tám ǀ kármaṇā ǀ naśat ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ yoṣat ǀ ná ǀ yoṣati ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one obstructs him by his acts, he is never driven (from his station), he is never separated (from hisfamily); the celebrator of the sacrifice, who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who areno sacrificers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॒दत्र॑ सु॒वीर्य॑मु॒त त्यदा॒श्वश्व्य॑म् । दे॒वानां॒ य इन्मनो॒ यज॑मान॒ इय॑क्षत्य॒भीदय॑ज्वनो भुवत्
shlokas.transliteration: ásat ǀ átra ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ utá ǀ tyát ǀ āśu-áśvyam ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ ít ǀ mánaḥ ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ íyakṣati ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him in this life is a valiant progeny, to him are swift herds of horses; the celebrator of the sacrifice,who desires to propitiate the mind of the gods, overcomes those who are no sacrificers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र कृ॒तान्यृ॑जी॒षिण॒: कण्वा॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ गाथ॑या । मदे॒ सोम॑स्य वोचत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ ṛjīṣíṇaḥ ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ gā́thayā ǀmáde ǀ sómasya ǀ vocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate with songs the great deeds ofIndra, the drinker of the staleSoma, when in his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सृबि॑न्द॒मन॑र्शनिं॒ पिप्रुं॑ दा॒सम॑ही॒शुव॑म् । वधी॑दु॒ग्रो रि॒णन्न॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sṛ́bindam ǀ ánarśanim ǀ píprum ǀ dāsám ǀ ahīśúvam ǀvádhīt ǀ ugráḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fierce (deity) who, liberating the waters, has slain Sṛbinda, Anarśani, Pipru,Dāsaand Ahiśuva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्यर्बु॑दस्य वि॒ष्टपं॑ व॒र्ष्माणं॑ बृह॒तस्ति॑र । कृ॒षे तदि॑न्द्र॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ árbudasya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀ varṣmā́ṇam ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ tira ǀkṛṣé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pierce the rain-holding domain of the vastArbuda; achieve,Indra, this manly exploit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ श्रु॒ताय॑ वो धृ॒षत्तूर्णा॑शं॒ न गि॒रेरधि॑ । हु॒वे सु॑शि॒प्रमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ śrutā́ya ǀ vaḥ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ tū́rṇāśam ǀ ná ǀ giréḥ ǀ ádhi ǀhuvé ǀ su-śiprám ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the victorious handsome-jawedIndrafor your protection, and to hear (your praises), as (atraveller invokes) the water from the cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स गोरश्व॑स्य॒ वि व्र॒जं म॑न्दा॒नः सो॒म्येभ्य॑: । पुरं॒ न शू॑र दर्षसि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ ví ǀ vrajám ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ somyébhyaḥ ǀpúram ǀ ná ǀ śūra ǀ darṣasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarated by theSomadraughts, you, hero, throw open the pastures of the cattle and horses like a(hostile) city.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑ मे रा॒रण॑: सु॒त उ॒क्थे वा॒ दध॑से॒ चन॑: । आ॒रादुप॑ स्व॒धा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ me ǀ raráṇaḥ ǀ suté ǀ ukthé ǀ vā ǀ dádhase ǀ cánaḥ ǀārā́t ǀ úpa ǀ svadhā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If you are propitiated by my libation and praise, and bestow food (upon me), come with viands from afar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं घा॑ ते॒ अपि॑ ष्मसि स्तो॒तार॑ इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो॑ जिन्व सोमपाः
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ jinva ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are plural ased by praise, we are your adorers; do you, therefore, who are the drinker of theSoma, be genitive rous unto us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त न॑: पि॒तुमा भ॑र संररा॒णो अवि॑क्षितम् । मघ॑व॒न्भूरि॑ ते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ pitúm ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sam-rarāṇáḥ ǀ ávi-kṣitam ǀmágha-van ǀ bhū́ri ǀ te ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratified by us, bring us undiminished food,Maghavan, for vast is your wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ गोम॑तस्कृधि॒ हिर॑ण्यवतो अ॒श्विन॑: । इळा॑भि॒: सं र॑भेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ híraṇya-vataḥ ǀ aśvínaḥ ǀíḷābhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ rabhemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make us (Indra) possessed of cattle, of gold, and of horses; may we prosper with abundant viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒बदु॑क्थं हवामहे सृ॒प्रक॑रस्नमू॒तये॑ । साधु॑ कृ॒ण्वन्त॒मव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: bṛbát-uktham ǀ havāmahe ǀ sṛprá-karasnam ǀ ūtáye ǀsā́dhu ǀ kṛṇvántam ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeIndra, who is greatly to be praised, whose arm is stretched out for the protection (of theworld), acting nobly for our defence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सं॒स्थे चि॑च्छ॒तक्र॑तु॒रादीं॑ कृ॒णोति॑ वृत्र॒हा । ज॒रि॒तृभ्य॑: पुरू॒वसु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sam-sthé ǀ cit ǀ śatá-kratuḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ īm ǀ kṛṇóti ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀjaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The slayer ofVṛtra, the accomplisher of a hundred exploits in war, achieves them that he may be thegiver of much wealth to his worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: श॒क्रश्चि॒दा श॑क॒द्दान॑वाँ अन्तराभ॒रः । इन्द्रो॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ śakat ǀ dā́na-vān ǀ antara-ābharáḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayŚakragive us strength, may the liberalIndrawith all protections be the supplier of our deficiencieṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो रा॒यो॒३॒॑ऽवनि॑र्म॒हान्त्सु॑पा॒रः सु॑न्व॒तः सखा॑ । तमिन्द्र॑म॒भि गा॑यत
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ avániḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ su-pāráḥ ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀtám ǀ índram ǀ abhí ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify thatIndrawho is the preserver of riches, the mighty, the conveyor beyond (calamity), the friendof the offerer of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒य॒न्तारं॒ महि॑ स्थि॒रं पृत॑नासु श्रवो॒जित॑म् । भूरे॒रीशा॑न॒मोज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: ā-yantā́ram ǀ máhi ǀ sthirám ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śravaḥ-jítam ǀbhū́reḥ ǀ ī́śānam ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him who comes near, the mighty, the firm in battles, the acquirer of fame, the lord of vast riches throughhis prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑रस्य॒ शची॑नां निय॒न्ता सू॒नृता॑नाम् । नकि॑र्व॒क्ता न दा॒दिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ śácīnām ǀ ni-yantā́ ǀ sūnṛ́tānām ǀnákiḥ ǀ vaktā́ ǀ ná ǀ dāt ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one puts a limit to his glorious deeds, no one asserts that he is not genitive rous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न नू॒नं ब्र॒ह्मणा॑मृ॒णं प्रा॑शू॒नाम॑स्ति सुन्व॒ताम् । न सोमो॑ अप्र॒ता प॑पे
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ nūnám ǀ brahmáṇām ǀ ṛṇám ǀ prāśūnā́m ǀ asti ǀ sunvatā́m ǀná ǀ sómaḥ ǀ apratā́ ǀ pape ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily no debt is due (to the gods) by thoseSoma-partakingbrāhmaṇasoffering libations; the Soma isnot drunk without the expenditure of boundless (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पन्य॒ इदुप॑ गायत॒ पन्य॑ उ॒क्थानि॑ शंसत । ब्रह्मा॑ कृणोत॒ पन्य॒ इत्
shlokas.transliteration: pánye ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ gāyata ǀ pánye ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ śaṃsata ǀbráhma ǀ kṛṇota ǀ pánye ǀ ít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing praises to the adorable (Indra), repeat prayers to the adorable (Indra), address hymns to theadorable (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पन्य॒ आ द॑र्दिरच्छ॒ता स॒हस्रा॑ वा॒ज्यवृ॑तः । इन्द्रो॒ यो यज्व॑नो वृ॒धः
shlokas.transliteration: pányaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dardirat ǀ śatā́ ǀ sahásrā ǀ vājī́ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ yájvanaḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerfulIndra, the discomfiter of hundreds and thousands, unchecked (by foes), is adorable; hewho is the benefactor of the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षू च॑र स्व॒धा अनु॑ कृष्टी॒नामन्वा॒हुव॑: । इन्द्र॒ पिब॑ सु॒ताना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ cara ǀ svadhā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kṛṣṭīnā́m ǀ ánu ǀ ā-húvaḥ ǀíndra ǀ píba ǀ sutā́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are to be invoked of man, come to their offered viands, drink of (their) libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिब॒ स्वधै॑नवानामु॒त यस्तुग्र्ये॒ सचा॑ । उ॒तायमि॑न्द्र॒ यस्तव॑
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ svá-dhainavānām ǀ utá ǀ yáḥ ǀ túgrye ǀ sácā ǀutá ǀ ayám ǀ indra ǀ yáḥ ǀ táva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink of the (Soma) purchased by the cow, that (Soma) which is mixed with water, that by which,Indra,is especially yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अती॑हि मन्युषा॒विणं॑ सुषु॒वांस॑मु॒पार॑णे । इ॒मं रा॒तं सु॒तं पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ ihi ǀ manyu-sāvínam ǀ susu-vā́ṃsam ǀ upa-áraṇe ǀimám ǀ rātám ǀ sutám ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, pass by the man who offers the libation in anger, him who pours it out upon a spot disapprovedof; drink this presentedSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒हि ति॒स्रः प॑रा॒वत॑ इ॒हि पञ्च॒ जनाँ॒ अति॑ । धेना॑ इन्द्राव॒चाक॑शत्
shlokas.transliteration: ihí ǀ tisráḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ ihí ǀ páñca ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǀdhénāḥ ǀ indra ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who has beheld our praises, proceed in three directions from a distance, pass beyond the fiveorders of beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्यो॑ र॒श्मिं यथा॑ सृ॒जा त्वा॑ यच्छन्तु मे॒ गिर॑: । नि॒म्नमापो॒ न स॒ध्र्य॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: sū́ryaḥ ǀ raśmím ǀ yáthā ǀ sṛja ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ yacchantu ǀ me ǀ gíraḥ ǀnimnám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ sadhryák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the sun disperses his rays, do you disperse (wealth upon me); may my praises rapidly draw you, aswaters (reach) the low ground.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्य॒वा तु हि षि॒ञ्च सोमं॑ वी॒राय॑ शि॒प्रिणे॑ । भरा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tú ǀ hí ǀ siñcá ǀ sómam ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ śipríṇe ǀbhára ǀ sutásya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adhvaryu, quickly pour forth theSomato the heroIndrawith the goodly jaws; bring the Soma for hisdrinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒द्नः फ॑लि॒गं भि॒नन्न्य१॒॑क्सिन्धूँ॑र॒वासृ॑जत् । यो गोषु॑ प॒क्वं धा॒रय॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ udnáḥ ǀ phali-gám ǀ bhinát ǀ nyák ǀ síndhūn ǀ ava-ásṛjat ǀyáḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ pakvám ǀ dhāráyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who clove the cloud for (the issue of) the rain, who sent down the waters, who plural ced the mature (milk)in the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अह॑न्वृ॒त्रमृची॑षम और्णवा॒भम॑ही॒शुव॑म् । हि॒मेना॑विध्य॒दर्बु॑दम्
shlokas.transliteration: áhan ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǀ aurṇa-vābhám ǀ ahīśúvam ǀhiména ǀ avidhyat ǀ árbudam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliantIndraslewVṛtra, Aurṇavābha, Ahiśava; he smoteArbudawith frost.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र व॑ उ॒ग्राय॑ नि॒ष्टुरेऽषा॑ळ्हाय प्रस॒क्षिणे॑ । दे॒वत्तं॒ ब्रह्म॑ गायत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ ugrā́ya ǀ niḥ-túre ǀ áṣāḷhāya ǀ pra-sakṣíṇe ǀdeváttam ǀ bráhma ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing aloud (priests) to the fierce, victorious (Indra) the overpowerer, the subduer (of foes), the praiseinspired by the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो विश्वा॑न्य॒भि व्र॒ता सोम॑स्य॒ मदे॒ अन्ध॑सः । इन्द्रो॑ दे॒वेषु॒ चेत॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ vratā́ ǀ sómasya ǀ máde ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ cétati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who, in the exhilaration of the quaffedSoma, makes known among the gods all pious rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्या स॑ध॒माद्या॒ हरी॒ हिर॑ण्यकेश्या । वो॒ळ्हाम॒भि प्रयो॑ हि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tyā́ ǀ sadha-mā́dyā ǀ hárī íti ǀ híraṇya-keśyā ǀvoḷhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyaḥ ǀ hitám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those two golden-maned steeds, together exulting, bring him here to the salutary (sacrificial) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाञ्चं॑ त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रि॒यमे॑धस्तुता॒ हरी॑ । सो॒म॒पेया॑य वक्षतः
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́ñcam ǀ tvā ǀ puru-stuta ǀ priyámedha-stutā ǀ hárī íti ǀsoma-péyāya ǀ vakṣataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the glorified of many, let your horses, praised byPriyamedha, bring you down to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं घ॑ त्वा सु॒ताव॑न्त॒ आपो॒ न वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । प॒वित्र॑स्य प्र॒स्रव॑णेषु वृत्रह॒न्परि॑ स्तो॒तार॑ आसते
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ tvā ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀpavítrasya ǀ pra-srávaṇeṣu ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ pári ǀ stotā́raḥ ǀ āsate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We are pouring forth to youSomalike water; the praisers, strewing the clipped sacred grass, worshipyou, slayer ofVṛtra, in the streams (falling) from the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वर॑न्ति त्वा सु॒ते नरो॒ वसो॑ निरे॒क उ॒क्थिन॑: । क॒दा सु॒तं तृ॑षा॒ण ओक॒ आ ग॑म॒ इन्द्र॑ स्व॒ब्दीव॒ वंस॑गः
shlokas.transliteration: sváranti ǀ tvā ǀ suté ǀ náraḥ ǀ váso íti ǀ nireké ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀkadā́ ǀ sutám ǀ tṛṣāṇáḥ ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamaḥ ǀ índra ǀ svabdī́-iva ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leaders (of rites), repeating praises, shout to you,Vasu, when the libation issues forth; when,Indra,bellowing like a bull, do you come to the dwelling thirsting fo theSoma?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कण्वे॑भिर्धृष्ण॒वा धृ॒षद्वाजं॑ दर्षि सह॒स्रिण॑म् । पि॒शङ्ग॑रूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे म॒क्षू गोम॑न्तमीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: káṇvebhiḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ vā́jam ǀ darṣi ǀ sahasríṇam ǀpiśáṅga-rūpam ǀ magha-van ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ makṣú ǀ gó-mantam ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resolute (Indra), bestow abundantly upon the descendants ofKaṇvathousands of viands; wiseMaghavan, we earnestly solicit you for (wealth) of gold and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि गायान्ध॑सो॒ मद॒ इन्द्रा॑य मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मि॑श्लो॒ हर्यो॒र्यः सु॒ते सचा॑ व॒ज्री रथो॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ gā́ya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ máde ǀ índrāya ǀ medhya-atithe ǀyáḥ ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ háryoḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ vajrī́ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink, Medhyātithi, and in the exhilaration of the draught sing toIndra, to him who has harnessed hishorses, who, when theSomais poured out, is present, the wielder of the thunderbolt, whose chariot is of golḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सु॑ष॒व्यः सु॒दक्षि॑ण इ॒नो यः सु॒क्रतु॑र्गृ॒णे । य आ॑क॒रः स॒हस्रा॒ यः श॒ताम॑घ॒ इन्द्रो॒ यः पू॒र्भिदा॑रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ su-savyáḥ ǀ su-dákṣiṇaḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ gṛṇé ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-karáḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ yáḥ ǀ śatá-maghaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀ āritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is well-handled, both left and right, who is the lord, who is wise, he performer of numerousgreat acts, the giver of vast wealth,Indra, who is the demolisher of cities, who is gratified by praise, is glorified(by us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो धृ॑षि॒तो योऽवृ॑तो॒ यो अस्ति॒ श्मश्रु॑षु श्रि॒तः । विभू॑तद्युम्न॒श्च्यव॑नः पुरुष्टु॒तः क्रत्वा॒ गौरि॑व शाकि॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣitáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásti ǀ śmáśruṣu ǀ śritáḥ ǀvíbhūta-dyumnaḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ gáuḥ-iva ǀ śākináḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is the subduer (of foes), the unresisted, practised in combats, possessed of vast wealth, thedemander of the libation, the praised of many, who by his acts (of bounty) is like a cow to the competent(worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क ईं॑ वेद सु॒ते सचा॒ पिब॑न्तं॒ कद्वयो॑ दधे । अ॒यं यः पुरो॑ विभि॒नत्त्योज॑सा मन्दा॒नः शि॒प्र्यन्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ īm ǀ veda ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ píbantam ǀ kát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ púraḥ ǀ vi-bhinátti ǀ ójasā ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ śiprī́ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who knows him drinking with (the priests) when theSomais effused? What food has he partaken of?He, the handsome-jawed, who, exhilarated by the (sacrificial) Soma, destroys cities by his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒ना मृ॒गो न वा॑र॒णः पु॑रु॒त्रा च॒रथं॑ दधे । नकि॑ष्ट्वा॒ नि य॑म॒दा सु॒ते ग॑मो म॒हाँश्च॑र॒स्योज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: dānā́ ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāraṇáḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ carátham ǀ dadhe ǀnákiḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ yamat ǀ ā́ ǀ suté ǀ gamaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ carasi ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a wild elephant emitting the dews of passion, he manifests his exhilaration in many plural ces; no onechecks you, (Indra), come to the libation; you are mighty, and goes (everywhere) through your strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒ग्रः सन्ननि॑ष्टृतः स्थि॒रो रणा॑य॒ संस्कृ॑तः । यदि॑ स्तो॒तुर्म॒घवा॑ शृ॒णव॒द्धवं॒ नेन्द्रो॑ योष॒त्या ग॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugráḥ ǀ sán ǀ áni-stṛtaḥ ǀ sthiráḥ ǀ ráṇāya ǀ sáṃskṛtaḥ ǀyádi ǀ stotúḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǀ ná ǀ índraḥ ǀ yoṣati ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is fierce, unmoved (by foes) and firm, ready equipped for battle-- ifMaghavanhears theinvocation of his adorer, he will not go apart (from us) but come here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमि॒त्था वृषेद॑सि॒ वृष॑जूति॒र्नोऽवृ॑तः । वृषा॒ ह्यु॑ग्र शृण्वि॒षे प॑रा॒वति॒ वृषो॑ अर्वा॒वति॑ श्रु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ itthā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ít ǀ asi ǀ vṛ́ṣa-jūtiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ávṛtaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ugra ǀ śṛṇviṣé ǀ parā-váti ǀ vṛ́ṣo íti ǀ arvā-váti ǀ śrutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily (Indra), in this manner you are the showerer (of benefits), brought by vigorous (steeds) to us,unresisted (by foes); fierce (Indra), you are celebrated as a showerer (of benefits) when afar; you are celebratedas a showerer (of benefits) when near.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष॑णस्ते अ॒भीश॑वो॒ वृषा॒ कशा॑ हिर॒ण्ययी॑ । वृषा॒ रथो॑ मघव॒न्वृष॑णा॒ हरी॒ वृषा॒ त्वं श॑तक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ te ǀ abhī́śavaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ káśā ǀ hiraṇyáyī ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ tvám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerers (of benefits) are your reins, such also is your golden whip, your chariot,Maghavan, is ashowerer (of benefits), so are your two horses; and you, too,Śatakratu, are the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ सोता॑ सुनोतु ते॒ वृष॑न्नृजीपि॒न्ना भ॑र । वृषा॑ दधन्वे॒ वृष॑णं न॒दीष्वा तुभ्यं॑ स्थातर्हरीणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ sótā ǀ sunotu ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣan ǀ ṛjīpin ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ dadhanve ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ túbhyam ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), may the offerer of the libation to you effuse theSomaas a showerer;straight-going (Indra), bring (us wealth); arrester of your horses, the showerer (of the oblation) has prepared thebountiful Soma to be mixed with the waters for you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑ याहि पी॒तये॒ मधु॑ शविष्ठ सो॒म्यम् । नायमच्छा॑ म॒घवा॑ शृ॒णव॒द्गिरो॒ ब्रह्मो॒क्था च॑ सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ pītáye ǀ mádhu ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ somyám ǀná ǀ ayám ǀ áccha ǀ maghá-vā ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ gíraḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ ukthā́ ǀ ca ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, most powerfulIndra, to drink of theSomaambrosia, (for without coming) thisMaghavan, theachiever of many exploits, hears not our praises, our chants, our hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वह॑न्तु त्वा रथे॒ष्ठामा हर॑यो रथ॒युज॑: । ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्यं सव॑नानि वृत्रहन्न॒न्येषां॒ या श॑तक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: váhantu ǀ tvā ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ ratha-yújaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryám ǀ sávanāni ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anyéṣām ǀ yā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śatakratu, slayer ofVṛtra, let your horses, yoked to your car, bring you, the lord, riding in your chariot,(to our sacrifices), avoiding those sacrifices (offered) by others.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्यान्त॑मं॒ स्तोमं॑ धिष्व महामह । अ॒स्माकं॑ ते॒ सव॑ना सन्तु॒ शंत॑मा॒ मदा॑य द्युक्ष सोमपाः
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ adyá ǀ ántamam ǀ stómam ǀ dhiṣva ǀ mahā-maha ǀasmā́kam ǀ te ǀ sávanā ǀ santu ǀ śám-tamā ǀ mádāya ǀ dyukṣa ǀ soma-pāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Greatest of the great, brilliant drinker of theSoma, accept today this our present praise; may oursacrifices be most sucessful in exciting your exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि षस्तव॒ नो मम॑ शा॒स्त्रे अ॒न्यस्य॒ रण्य॑ति । यो अ॒स्मान्वी॒र आन॑यत्
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ sáḥ ǀ táva ǀ naḥ ǀ máma ǀ śāstré ǀ anyásya ǀ ráṇyati ǀyáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ vīráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ánayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hero (Indra) who has (ever) guided us delights not in your punishment, nor in mine; nor in that ofany other.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्चिद्घा॒ तद॑ब्रवीत्स्त्रि॒या अ॑शा॒स्यं मन॑: । उ॒तो अह॒ क्रतुं॑ र॒घुम्
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ tát ǀ abravīt ǀ striyā́ḥ ǀ aśāsyám ǀ mánaḥ ǀutó íti ǀ áha ǀ krátum ǀ raghúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VerilyIndrasaid that the mind of a woman is not to be controlled, he declared also that her intellect wassmall.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सप्ती॑ चिद्घा मद॒च्युता॑ मिथु॒ना व॑हतो॒ रथ॑म् । ए॒वेद्धूर्वृष्ण॒ उत्त॑रा
shlokas.transliteration: sáptī íti ǀ cit ǀ gha ǀ mada-cyútā ǀ mithunā́ ǀ vahataḥ ǀ rátham ǀevá ǀ ít ǀ dhū́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ út-tarā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two horses ofIndra, hastening to the exhilaration (of theSoma), draw his chariot; the pole of theshowerer rests upon them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒धः प॑श्यस्व॒ मोपरि॑ संत॒रां पा॑द॒कौ ह॑र । मा ते॑ कशप्ल॒कौ दृ॑श॒न्त्स्त्री हि ब्र॒ह्मा ब॒भूवि॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: adháḥ ǀ paśyasva ǀ mā́ ǀ upári ǀ sam-tarā́m ǀ pādakáu ǀ hara ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ kaśa-plakáu ǀ dṛśan ǀ strī́ ǀ hí ǀ brahmā́ ǀ babhū́vitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cast your eyes (son of pluralyoga) downwards, not upwards; keep your feet close together; let not (men)behold yourankles, for from having been abrahmāyou have become a feminine le.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑ याहि॒ हरि॑भि॒रुप॒ कण्व॑स्य सुष्टु॒तिम् । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ yāhi ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ káṇvasya ǀ su-stutím ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, with your horses to receive the praise ofKaṇva; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiantwith oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ ग्रावा॒ वद॑न्नि॒ह सो॒मी घोषे॑ण यच्छतु । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ grā́vā ǀ vádan ǀ ihá ǀ somī́ ǀ ghóṣeṇa ǀ yacchatu ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the grinding stone, yielding theSomaas it utters a sound, bring you here with the noise; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्रा॒ वि ने॒मिरे॑षा॒मुरां॒ न धू॑नुते॒ वृक॑: । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: átra ǀ ví ǀ nemíḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ úrām ǀ ná ǀ dhūnute ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The circumference of these (stones) shakes (theSoma) at this (rite), as a wolf (terrifies) a sheep doyou, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ कण्वा॑ इ॒हाव॑से॒ हव॑न्ते॒ वाज॑सातये । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ káṇvāḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ávase ǀ hávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheKaṇvasinvoke you here for protection and for food; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दधा॑मि ते सु॒तानां॒ वृष्णे॒ न पू॑र्व॒पाय्य॑म् । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: dádhāmi ǀ te ǀ sutā́nām ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ ná ǀ pūrva-pā́yyam ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I make offering to you of the libations as the first drink is presented to the showerer; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्मत्पु॑रंधिर्न॒ आ ग॑हि वि॒श्वतो॑धीर्न ऊ॒तये॑ । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: smát-purandhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ viśvátaḥ-dhīḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra) master of the family of heaven, come to us; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant withoblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ याहि महेमते॒ सह॑स्रोते॒ शता॑मघ । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ mahe-mate ǀ sáhasra-ūte ǀ śáta-magha ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sagacious (Indra) bestower of numerous protections, granter of infinite wealth, come uno us; do you,ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॒ होता॒ मनु॑र्हितो देव॒त्रा व॑क्ष॒दीड्य॑: । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ hótā ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ vakṣat ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (Agni) the invoker, adorable among the gods, the benefactor of man, bring you here; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ मद॒च्युता॒ हरी॑ श्ये॒नं प॒क्षेव॑ वक्षतः । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ mada-cyútā ǀ hárī íti ǀ śyenám ǀ pakṣā́-iva ǀ vakṣataḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your two steeds, humiliators of the pride (of foes), bring you as (his) two wings (bear along) thefalcon; do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑ह्य॒र्य आ परि॒ स्वाहा॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑ । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pári ǀ svā́hā ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, lord, from whatever direction, to drink theSomaoffered withsvāhā; do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ या॒ह्युप॑श्रुत्यु॒क्थेषु॑ रणया इ॒ह । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ úpa-śruti ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ raṇaya ǀ ihá ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to listen to our praises, when they are being recited-- bestow upon us delight; do you, rulingyonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सरू॑पै॒रा सु नो॑ गहि॒ सम्भृ॑तै॒: सम्भृ॑ताश्वः । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: sá-rūpaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ gahi ǀ sám-bhṛtaiḥ ǀ sámbhṛta-aśvaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are possessed of cherished steeds, come to us with (your) well-fed and like-shaped horses;do you, ruling yonder heaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑हि॒ पर्व॑तेभ्यः समु॒द्रस्याधि॑ वि॒ष्टप॑: । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ párvatebhyaḥ ǀ samudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápaḥ ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come from the mountains, from above the region of the firmament; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ गव्या॒न्यश्व्या॑ स॒हस्रा॑ शूर दर्दृहि । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gávyāni ǀ áśvyā ǀ sahásrā ǀ śūra ǀ dardṛhi ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us, hero, thousands of herds of cattle and horses; do you, ruling yonder heaven, Oradiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: सहस्र॒शो भ॑रा॒युता॑नि श॒तानि॑ च । दि॒वो अ॒मुष्य॒ शास॑तो॒ दिवं॑ य॒य दि॑वावसो
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasra-śáḥ ǀ bhara ǀ ayútāni ǀ śatā́ni ǀ ca ǀdiváḥ ǀ amúṣya ǀ śā́sataḥ ǀ dívam ǀ yayá ǀ divāvaso íti divā-vaso ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us, by thousands, tens of thousands, and hundres (of good things); do you, ruling yonderheaven, O radiant with oblations, return here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यदिन्द्र॑श्च॒ दद्व॑हे स॒हस्रं॒ वसु॑रोचिषः । ओजि॑ष्ठ॒मश्व्यं॑ प॒शुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ dádvahe íti ǀ sahásram ǀ vásu-rociṣaḥ ǀójiṣṭham ǀ áśvyam ǀ paśúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, the thousand Vasurociṣas, andIndra(our leader), when we obtain vigorous herds of horseṣ..”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ज्रा वात॑रंहसोऽरु॒षासो॑ रघु॒ष्यद॑: । भ्राज॑न्ते॒ सूर्या॑ इव
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ṛjrā́ḥ ǀ vā́ta-raṃhasaḥ ǀ aruṣā́saḥ ǀ raghu-syádaḥ ǀbhrā́jante ǀ sū́ryāḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such as are straight-going, fleet as the wind, bright-coloured, light- footed, and shine like the suṇ..”

shlokas.sanskrit: पारा॑वतस्य रा॒तिषु॑ द्र॒वच्च॑क्रेष्वा॒शुषु॑ । तिष्ठं॒ वन॑स्य॒ मध्य॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: pā́rāvatasya ǀ rātíṣu ǀ dravát-cakreṣu ǀ āśúṣu ǀtíṣṭham ǀ vánasya ǀ mádhye ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then (having received) the horses, attached to the rolling-wheeled chariot, given from afar, we departto the middle of the forest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निनेन्द्रे॑ण॒ वरु॑णेन॒ विष्णु॑नादि॒त्यै रु॒द्रैर्वसु॑भिः सचा॒भुवा॑ । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ पिबतमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: agnínā ǀ índreṇa ǀ váruṇena ǀ víṣṇunā ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated withAgni, withIndra, withVaruṇa, withViṣṇu, with theĀdityas, theRudras, and theVasus, and united with the dawn and withSūrya, drink,Aśvins, theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑भिर्धी॒भिर्भुव॑नेन वाजिना दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्याद्रि॑भिः सचा॒भुवा॑ । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ पिबतमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: víśvābhiḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ bhúvanena ǀ vājinā ǀ divā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful (Aśvins), associated with all intelligences, with all beings, with heaven, with earth, with themountains, united with the dawn and with theSūrya, drink, Aśvins, theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैस्त्रि॒भिरे॑काद॒शैरि॒हाद्भिर्म॒रुद्भि॒र्भृगु॑भिः सचा॒भुवा॑ । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ पिबतमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: víśvaiḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ tri-bhíḥ ǀ ekādaśáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ bhṛ́gu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ pibatam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with all the thrice-eleven deities at this ceremony, with the waters, with theMaruts, with theBhṛgus, united with the dawn and withSūrya, drink,Aśvins, theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षेथां॑ य॒ज्ञं बोध॑तं॒ हव॑स्य मे॒ विश्वे॒ह दे॑वौ॒ सव॒नाव॑ गच्छतम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चेषं॑ नो वोळ्हमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ bódhatam ǀ hávasya ǀ me ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified by the sacrifice; hear my invocation; recognize, deities, all the offerings in this ceremony;united with the dawn and withSūrya, bring usAśvins, food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तोमं॑ जुषेथां युव॒शेव॑ क॒न्यनां॒ विश्वे॒ह दे॑वौ॒ सव॒नाव॑ गच्छतम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चेषं॑ नो वोळ्हमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: stómam ǀ juṣethām ǀ yuvaśā́-iva ǀ kanyánām ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified by our praise as youths are delighted (by the voices) of maidens; recognize, deities, all theofferings in this ceremony; united with the dawn adn withSūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गिरो॑ जुषेथामध्व॒रं जु॑षेथां॒ विश्वे॒ह दे॑वौ॒ सव॒नाव॑ गच्छतम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चेषं॑ नो वोळ्हमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ juṣethām ǀ adhvarám ǀ juṣethām ǀ víśvā ǀ ihá ǀ devau ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchatam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ naḥ ǀ voḷham ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be gratified, deities, by our praises, be gratified by the sacrifice, recognize, deities, all the offerings inthis ceremony; united with the dawn and withSūrya, bring us,Aśvins, food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हा॒रि॒द्र॒वेव॑ पतथो॒ वनेदुप॒ सोमं॑ सु॒तं म॑हि॒षेवाव॑ गच्छथः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ त्रिर्व॒र्तिर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: hāridravā́-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ vánā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alight upon the effusedSomaas the Hāridravā plural nges unto the water; you fall upon it like twobuffaloes (plural nging into a pool); united with the dawn and withSūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हं॒सावि॑व पतथो अध्व॒गावि॑व॒ सोमं॑ सु॒तं म॑हि॒षेवाव॑ गच्छथः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ त्रिर्व॒र्तिर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: haṃsáu-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ adhvagáu-iva ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As two geese, as two travellers, as two buffaloes (hasten to water), you alight,Aśvins, upon the effusedSoma; united with the dawn and withSūrya, come, Aśvins, by the triple path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्ये॒नावि॑व पतथो ह॒व्यदा॑तये॒ सोमं॑ सु॒तं म॑हि॒षेवाव॑ गच्छथः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ त्रिर्व॒र्तिर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: śyenáu-iva ǀ patathaḥ ǀ havyá-dātaye ǀ sómam ǀ sutám ǀ mahiṣā́-iva ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ tríḥ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You hasten like two falcons to the offerer of the libation, you alight upon the effusedSomaas twobuffaloes (hasten to water), united with the dawn and withSūrya, come,Aśvins, by the triple path.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिब॑तं च तृप्णु॒तं चा च॑ गच्छतं प्र॒जां च॑ ध॒त्तं द्रवि॑णं च धत्तम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चोर्जं॑ नो धत्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: píbatam ǀ ca ǀ tṛpṇutám ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ gacchatam ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Aśvins, theSoma, and satiate yourselves; come here; give us progeny; give us wealth; unitedwith the dawn and withSūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जय॑तं च॒ प्र स्तु॑तं च॒ प्र चा॑वतं प्र॒जां च॑ ध॒त्तं द्रवि॑णं च धत्तम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चोर्जं॑ नो धत्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: jáyatam ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ stutam ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ avatam ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conquer (Aśvins), your foes; protect and praise (your worshipper), grant progeny, give wealth, andunited with the dawn and withSūrya, give us, Aśvins, strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒तं च॒ शत्रू॒न्यत॑तं च मि॒त्रिण॑: प्र॒जां च॑ ध॒त्तं द्रवि॑णं च धत्तम् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चोर्जं॑ नो धत्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: hatám ǀ ca ǀ śátrūn ǀ yátatam ǀ ca ǀ mitríṇaḥ ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ca ǀ dhattám ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ca ǀ dhattam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ū́rjam ǀ naḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy your foes, repair to your friends, grant progeny, give wealth, and, united with the dawn and withSūrya, give us,Aśvins, strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रावरु॑णवन्ता उ॒त धर्म॑वन्ता म॒रुत्व॑न्ता जरि॒तुर्ग॑च्छथो॒ हव॑म् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण चादि॒त्यैर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: mitrā́váruṇa-vantau ǀ utá ǀ dhárma-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated withMitraandVaruṇa, withDharma, with theMaruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, withSūryaand with theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अङ्गि॑रस्वन्ता उ॒त विष्णु॑वन्ता म॒रुत्व॑न्ता जरि॒तुर्ग॑च्छथो॒ हव॑म् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण चादि॒त्यैर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: áṅgirasvantau ǀ utá ǀ víṣṇu-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with theAṅgirasas, withViṣṇu, with theMaruts, repair to the invocation of the adorer;repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, withSūrya, and with theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भु॒मन्ता॑ वृषणा॒ वाज॑वन्ता म॒रुत्व॑न्ता जरि॒तुर्ग॑च्छथो॒ हव॑म् । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण चादि॒त्यैर्या॑तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhu-mántā ǀ vṛṣaṇā ǀ vā́ja-vantā ǀ marútvantā ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ hávam ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associated with theṚbhus, and with themaruts, repair, showerers (of benefits), dispensers of food, tothe invocation of the adorer; repair (to him),Aśvins, united with the dawn, withSūrya, and with theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑ जिन्वतमु॒त जि॑न्वतं॒ धियो॑ ह॒तं रक्षां॑सि॒ सेध॑त॒ममी॑वाः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ सुन्व॒तो अ॑श्विना
shlokas.transliteration: bráhma ǀ jinvatam ǀ utá ǀ jinvatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hatám ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sédhatam ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious to prayer, be propitious to sacred rites, slay therākṣasas, remedy diseases united withthe dawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins, theSomaof the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्ष॒त्रं जि॑न्वतमु॒त जि॑न्वतं॒ नॄन्ह॒तं रक्षां॑सि॒ सेध॑त॒ममी॑वाः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ सुन्व॒तो अ॑श्विना
shlokas.transliteration: kṣatrám ǀ jinvatam ǀ utá ǀ jinvatam ǀ nṝ́n ǀ hatám ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sédhatam ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious to the strong, be propitious to men, slay therākṣasas, remedy diseases, united with thedawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins, theSomaof the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धे॒नूर्जि॑न्वतमु॒त जि॑न्वतं॒ विशो॑ ह॒तं रक्षां॑सि॒ सेध॑त॒ममी॑वाः । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण च॒ सोमं॑ सुन्व॒तो अ॑श्विना
shlokas.transliteration: dhenū́ḥ ǀ jinvatam ǀ utá ǀ jinvatam ǀ víśaḥ ǀ hatám ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sédhatam ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ sómam ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be propitious to the kine, be propitious to the people, slay therākṣasas, remedy diseases, united withthe dawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins, theSomaof the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्रे॑रिव शृणुतं पू॒र्व्यस्तु॑तिं श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य सुन्व॒तो म॑दच्युता । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चाश्वि॑ना ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: átreḥ-iva ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ pūrvyá-stutim ǀ śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ mada-cyutā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ áśvinā ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), hear the earnest praise ofŚyāvāśvaoffering libations as(you did) that ofAtri, and, united with the dawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins, (theSoma) prepared theprevious day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर्गाँ॑ इव सृजतं सुष्टु॒तीरुप॑ श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य सुन्व॒तो म॑दच्युता । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चाश्वि॑ना ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sárgān-iva ǀ sṛjatam ǀ su-stutī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ mada-cyutā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ áśvinā ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), accept the earnest praises ofŚyāvāśvaoffering youlibations as if you were accepting oblations; and, united with the dawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins, (theSoma) prepared the previous day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒श्मीँरि॑व यच्छतमध्व॒राँ उप॑ श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य सुन्व॒तो म॑दच्युता । स॒जोष॑सा उ॒षसा॒ सूर्ये॑ण॒ चाश्वि॑ना ति॒रोअ॑ह्न्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: raśmī́n-iva ǀ yacchatam ǀ adhvarā́n ǀ úpa ǀ śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ mada-cyutā ǀsa-jóṣasau ǀ uṣásā ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ ca ǀ áśvinā ǀ tiráḥ-ahnyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Humblers of the pride (of your enemies), seize the sacrifices ofŚyāvāśvaoffering libations as youseize your reins; and united with the dawn and withSūrya, (drink),Aśvins,(theSoma) prepared the previousday.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्वाग्रथं॒ नि य॑च्छतं॒ पिब॑तं सो॒म्यं मधु॑ । आ या॑तमश्वि॒ना ग॑तमव॒स्युर्वा॑म॒हं हु॑वे ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: arvā́k ǀ rátham ǀ ní ǀ yacchatam ǀ píbatam ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ dhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Direct your chariot downwards, drink theSomanectar; come,Aśvins, come (here); desirous of yourprotection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒मो॒वा॒के प्रस्थि॑ते अध्व॒रे न॑रा वि॒वक्ष॑णस्य पी॒तये॑ । आ या॑तमश्वि॒ना ग॑तमव॒स्युर्वा॑म॒हं हु॑वे ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: namaḥ-vāké ǀ prá-sthite ǀ adhvaré ǀ narā ǀ vivákṣaṇasya ǀ pītáye ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ dhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, leaders of rites, when the sacrifice, at which your adoration is cited, is commenced, to drink oftheSomaoffered by me; come,Aśvins, come (here), desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches tothe donor of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वाहा॑कृतस्य तृम्पतं सु॒तस्य॑ देवा॒वन्ध॑सः । आ या॑तमश्वि॒ना ग॑तमव॒स्युर्वा॑म॒हं हु॑वे ध॒त्तं रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: svā́hā-kṛtasya ǀ tṛmpatam ǀ sutásya ǀ devau ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ avasyúḥ ǀ vām ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ dhattám ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (Aśvins), partake to satiety of the sacrificialSoma, consecrated with the exclamationsvāhā;come, Aśvins, come (here); desirous of protection, I invoke you; give precious riches to the donor of the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वि॒तासि॑ सुन्व॒तो वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिष॒: पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: avitā́ ǀ asi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the protector of the effuser of the libation, of the strewer of he clipped sacred grass; drinkjoyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of thevirtuous, who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leaderof theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्राव॑ स्तो॒तारं॑ मघव॒न्नव॒ त्वां पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ava ǀ stotā́ram ǀ magha-van ǀ áva ǀ tvā́m ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect the worshippers,Maghavan, protect thyself; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्जा दे॒वाँ अव॒स्योज॑सा॒ त्वां पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: ūrjā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ ávasi ǀ ójasā ǀ tvā́m ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Maghavan, protect the gods with (sacrificial) food, and yourself by your might; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor your exhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of the virtuous,who are the victor over all (hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒नि॒ता दि॒वो ज॑नि॒ता पृ॑थि॒व्याः पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: janitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janitā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, are the genitive rator of heaven, the genitive rator of earth; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒नि॒ताश्वा॑नां जनि॒ता गवा॑मसि॒ पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: janitā́ ǀ áśvānām ǀ janitā́ ǀ gávām ǀ asi ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the genitive rator of horses, the genitive rator of cattle; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्री॑णां॒ स्तोम॑मद्रिवो म॒हस्कृ॑धि॒ पिबा॒ सोमं॒ मदा॑य॒ कं श॑तक्रतो । यं ते॑ भा॒गमधा॑रय॒न्विश्वा॑: सेहा॒नः पृत॑ना उ॒रु ज्रय॒: सम॑प्सु॒जिन्म॒रुत्वाँ॑ इन्द्र सत्पते
shlokas.transliteration: átrīṇām ǀ stómam ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀyám ǀ te ǀ bhāgám ǀ ádhārayan ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sehānáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǀ marútvān ǀ indra ǀ sat-pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wielder of the thunderbolt, reverence the praise of theAtris; drink joyfully,Śatakratu, theSomafor yourexhilaration-- that portion which (the gods) assigned you,Indra, lord of the virtuous, who are the victor over all(hostile) hosts, the conqueror of many, the subduer of the waters, the leader of theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य सुन्व॒तस्तथा॑ शृणु॒ यथाशृ॑णो॒रत्रे॒: कर्मा॑णि कृण्व॒तः । प्र त्र॒सद॑स्युमाविथ॒ त्वमेक॒ इन्नृ॒षाह्य॒ इन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि व॒र्धय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ táthā ǀ śṛṇu ǀ yáthā ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ átreḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀprá ǀ trasádasyum ǀ āvitha ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vardháyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear (the praises) ofŚyāvāśvaoffering the libations, as you have heard (those) ofAtriengaged inholy rites; you alone,Indra, have defendedTrasadasyuin battle, animating his prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेदं ब्रह्म॑ वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ष्वाविथ॒ प्र सु॑न्व॒तः श॑चीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ idám ǀ bráhma ǀ vṛtra-tū́ryeṣu ǀ āvitha ǀ prá ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You protect,Indra, lord of rites, with all protections in combats with enemies, this sacrifice of him whooffers you the libations; slayer ofVṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt drink of theSomaat themid-day solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: से॒हा॒न उ॑ग्र॒ पृत॑ना अ॒भि द्रुह॑: शचीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: sehānáḥ ǀ ugra ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ drúhaḥ ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FierceIndra, defeater of hostile armies, lord of rites, (you protect) with all your protections; slayer ofVṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of theSomaat the mid-day solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒क॒राळ॒स्य भुव॑नस्य राजसि शचीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: eka-rā́ṭ ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rājasi ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You shine the sole sovereign of this world,Indra, lord of rites, with all your protections; slayer ofVṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of theSomaat the mid-day solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒स्थावा॑ना यवयसि॒ त्वमेक॒ इच्छ॑चीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: sa-sthā́vānā ǀ yavayasi ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You alone,Indra, lord of rites, separate the combined worlds (heaven and earth) with all yourprotections; slayer ofVṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of theSomaat the mid-daysolemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेम॑स्य च प्र॒युज॑श्च॒ त्वमी॑शिषे शचीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: kṣémasya ǀ ca ǀ pra-yújaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, lord of rites, are sovereign over our prosperity and gains, with all your protections; slayer ofVṛtra,irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of theSomaat the mid-day solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्ष॒त्राय॑ त्व॒मव॑सि॒ न त्व॑माविथ शचीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । माध्यं॑दिनस्य॒ सव॑नस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑स्य वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: kṣatrā́ya ǀ tvam ǀ ávasi ǀ ná ǀ tvam ǀ āvitha ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀmā́dhyandinasya ǀ sávanasya ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ anedya ǀ píba ǀ sómasya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are for the strength (of the world), you protect with all your protections, but you need no defender,Indra, lord of rites; slayer ofVṛtra, irreproachable wielder of the thunderbolt, drink of theSomaat the mid- daysolemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य॒ रेभ॑त॒स्तथा॑ शृणु॒ यथाशृ॑णो॒रत्रे॒: कर्मा॑णि कृण्व॒तः । प्र त्र॒सद॑स्युमाविथ॒ त्वमेक॒ इन्नृ॒षाह्य॒ इन्द्र॑ क्ष॒त्राणि॑ व॒र्धय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ rébhataḥ ǀ táthā ǀ śṛṇu ǀ yáthā ǀ áśṛṇoḥ ǀ átreḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀprá ǀ trasádasyum ǀ āvitha ǀ tvám ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vardháyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear the praises ofŚyāvāśvaeulogizing you, as you have heard those ofAtriengaged in piousrites; you alone have protectedTrasadasyuin battle, augmenting his vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञस्य॒ हि स्थ ऋ॒त्विजा॒ सस्नी॒ वाजे॑षु॒ कर्म॑सु । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ तस्य॑ बोधतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñásya ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ ṛtvíjā ǀ sásnī íti ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ kárma-su ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IndraandAgni, you are the pure ministrants, (encouragers) in offerings and sacred rites-- hear (thepraise) of this (your worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तो॒शासा॑ रथ॒यावा॑ना वृत्र॒हणाप॑राजिता । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ तस्य॑ बोधतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tośā́sā ǀ ratha-yā́vānā ǀ vṛtra-hánā ǀ áparā-jitā ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyers (of foes), riding in one chariot, slayers ofVṛtra, invincible; hear,IndraandAgni, (the praise)of this (your worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं वां॑ मदि॒रं मध्वधु॑क्ष॒न्नद्रि॑भि॒र्नर॑: । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ तस्य॑ बोधतम्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ vām ǀ madirám ǀ mádhu ǀ ádhukṣan ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ tásya ǀ bodhatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leaders of rites have effused by the stones this sweet exhilarating (Soma) for you; hear,IndraandAgni, (the praise) of this (your worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षेथां॑ य॒ज्ञमि॒ष्टये॑ सु॒तं सोमं॑ सधस्तुती । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: juṣéthām ǀ yajñám ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ sadhastutī íti sadha-stutī ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associate in praie, accept the sacrifice; leaders of rites,IndraandAgni, come hither to the Somaeffused for this solemnity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा जु॑षेथां॒ सव॑ना॒ येभि॑र्ह॒व्यान्यू॒हथु॑: । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ juṣethām ǀ sávanā ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ ūháthuḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept these sacrifices whereby you have borne away the oblations; leaders of rites,IndraandAgni,come hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां गा॑य॒त्रव॑र्तनिं जु॒षेथां॑ सुष्टु॒तिं मम॑ । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तं नरा
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ gāyatrá-vartanim ǀ juṣéthām ǀ su-stutím ǀ máma ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept this my earnest praise, following the path of thegāyatrī; leaders of rites,IndraandAgni, comehere.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्याव॑भि॒रा ग॑तं दे॒वेभि॑र्जेन्यावसू । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: prātaryā́va-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jenyāvasū íti ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rich with the spoils of victory, come,IndraandAgni, to drink of theSoma, with the deities astir in themorning.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्या॒वाश्व॑स्य सुन्व॒तोऽत्री॑णां शृणुतं॒ हव॑म् । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: śyāvá-aśvasya ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ átrīṇām ǀ śṛṇutam ǀ hávam ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear the invocation,IndraandAgni, ofŚyāvāśvapouring out the effusedSoma, (and) theAtris, todrink of the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा वा॑मह्व ऊ॒तये॒ यथाहु॑वन्त॒ मेधि॑राः । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ सोम॑पीतये
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ vām ǀ ahve ǀ ūtáye ǀ yáthā ǀ áhuvanta ǀ médhirāḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ sóma-pītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke you both,IndraandAgni, as the sages have invoked you, for your protection (and) to drink oftheSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आहं सर॑स्वतीवतोरिन्द्रा॒ग्न्योरवो॑ वृणे । याभ्यां॑ गाय॒त्रमृ॒च्यते॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ahám ǀ sárasvatī-vatoḥ ǀ indrāgnyóḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ vṛṇe ǀyā́bhyām ǀ gāyatrám ǀ ṛcyáte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I solicit the protection ofIndraandAgni, associated withSarasvatī, to whom thisGāyatrīhymn isaddressed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॑स्तोष्यृ॒ग्मिय॑म॒ग्निमी॒ळा य॒जध्यै॑ । अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाँ अ॑नक्तु न उ॒भे हि वि॒दथे॑ क॒विर॒न्तश्चर॑ति दू॒त्यं१॒॑ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ astoṣi ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀ agním ǀ īḷā́ ǀ yajádhyai ǀagníḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ anaktu ǀ naḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ hí ǀ vidáthe íti ǀ kavíḥ ǀ antáríti ǀ cárati ǀ dūtyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify the adorableAgni, (I invite) Agni with praise to the sacrifice, may Agni brighten the gods with theoblations at our sacrifice; the sage Agni traverses both (worlds discharging his function) as messenger of thegods; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य॑ग्ने॒ नव्य॑सा॒ वच॑स्त॒नूषु॒ शंस॑मेषाम् । न्यरा॑ती॒ ररा॑व्णां॒ विश्वा॑ अ॒र्यो अरा॑तीरि॒तो यु॑च्छन्त्वा॒मुरो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ agne ǀ návyasā ǀ vácaḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ śáṃsam ǀ eṣām ǀní ǀ árātīḥ ǀ rárāvṇām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ árātīḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀ yucchantu ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Propitiated),Agni, by our new praise baffle the hostile attempts of these against our person ns, consumethe enemies of those who are liberal (at sacred rites); may all our foolish assailants depart from here, may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ मन्मा॑नि॒ तुभ्यं॒ कं घृ॒तं न जु॑ह्व आ॒सनि॑ । स दे॒वेषु॒ प्र चि॑किद्धि॒ त्वं ह्यसि॑ पू॒र्व्यः शि॒वो दू॒तो वि॒वस्व॑तो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ mánmāni ǀ túbhyam ǀ kám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ juhve ǀ āsáni ǀsáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ prá ǀ cikiddhi ǀ tvám ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ śiváḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I pour into your mouth,Agni, praises as others (fill it) with delicious butter; do you amidst the godsacknowledge (them), for you are ancient, the giver of happiness, the messenger of Vivaśvat; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्त॑द॒ग्निर्वयो॑ दधे॒ यथा॑यथा कृप॒ण्यति॑ । ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ति॒र्वसू॑नां॒ शं च॒ योश्च॒ मयो॑ दधे॒ विश्व॑स्यै दे॒वहू॑त्यै॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tát-tat ǀ agníḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ yáthā-yathā ǀ kṛpaṇyáti ǀūrjā́-āhutiḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ yóḥ ǀ ca ǀ máyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ víśvasyai ǀ devá-hūtyai ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnigrants whatever food is solicited; invoked with offerings, he bestows on the worshippershappiness springing from tranquility and the enjoyment (of objects of sense); he is requisite for all invocation ofthe gods; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स चि॑केत॒ सही॑यसा॒ग्निश्चि॒त्रेण॒ कर्म॑णा । स होता॒ शश्व॑तीनां॒ दक्षि॑णाभिर॒भीवृ॑त इ॒नोति॑ च प्रती॒व्यं१॒॑ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ciketa ǀ sáhīyasā ǀ agníḥ ǀ citréṇa ǀ kármaṇā ǀsáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ dákṣiṇābhiḥ ǀ abhí-vṛtaḥ ǀ inóti ǀ ca ǀ pratīvyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis known by his most powerful and manifold deeds; he is the invoker of the eternals; surroundedby victims, he proceeds against the foe; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्जा॒ता दे॒वाना॑म॒ग्निर्वे॑द॒ मर्ता॑नामपी॒च्य॑म् । अ॒ग्निः स द्र॑विणो॒दा अ॒ग्निर्द्वारा॒ व्यू॑र्णुते॒ स्वा॑हुतो॒ नवी॑यसा॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jātā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ agníḥ ǀ veda ǀ mártānām ǀ apīcyám ǀagníḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ dvā́rā ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇute ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀ návīyasā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniknows the birth of the gods; Agni knows the secrets of mankind; Agni is the giver of riches; Agni,duly worshipped with a new (oblation), sets open the doors (of opulence); may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वेषु॒ संव॑सु॒: स वि॒क्षु य॒ज्ञिया॒स्वा । स मु॒दा काव्या॑ पु॒रु विश्वं॒ भूमे॑व पुष्यति दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॑ य॒ज्ञियो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ sám-vasuḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ vikṣú ǀ yajñíyāsu ǀ ā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ mudā́ ǀ kā́vyā ǀ purú ǀ víśvam ǀ bhū́ma-iva ǀ puṣyati ǀ deváḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnihas his abode among the gods, he (dwells) among pious people; he cherishes with plural asure manypious acts, as the earth all (beings); a god adorable among the gods; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्निः स॒प्तमा॑नुषः श्रि॒तो विश्वे॑षु॒ सिन्धु॑षु । तमाग॑न्म त्रिप॒स्त्यं म॑न्धा॒तुर्द॑स्यु॒हन्त॑मम॒ग्निं य॒ज्ञेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यं नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ saptá-mānuṣaḥ ǀ śritáḥ ǀ víśveṣu ǀ síndhuṣu ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ aganma ǀ tri-pastyám ǀ mandhātúḥ ǀ dasyuhán-tamam ǀ agním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us approach thatAgniwho is ministered to by seven priess; who takes refuge in all rivers, whohasatriple dwelling plural ce, the slayer of theDasyuforMandhātā, who is foremost in sacrifices; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निस्त्रीणि॑ त्रि॒धातू॒न्या क्षे॑ति वि॒दथा॑ क॒विः । स त्रीँरे॑काद॒शाँ इ॒ह यक्ष॑च्च पि॒प्रय॑च्च नो॒ विप्रो॑ दू॒तः परि॑ष्कृतो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ tri-dhā́tūni ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ vidáthā ǀ kavíḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ trī́n ǀ ekādaśā́n ǀ ihá ǀ yákṣat ǀ ca ǀ pipráyat ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the sage, inhabits the three elementary regions; may he, intelligent, and richly decorated, themessenger (of the gods), here perform worship to the thrice eleven deities, and satisfy all our desires; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्न आ॒युषु॒ त्वं दे॒वेषु॑ पूर्व्य॒ वस्व॒ एक॑ इरज्यसि । त्वामाप॑: परि॒स्रुत॒: परि॑ यन्ति॒ स्वसे॑तवो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ āyúṣu ǀ tvám ǀ devéṣu ǀ pūrvya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ irajyasi ǀtvā́m ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ pari-srútaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yanti ǀ svá-setavaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, ancientAgni, among men and gods, are alone to us the lord of wealth; the flowing waters confinedwithin their own banks flow around you;may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी यु॒वं सु न॒: सह॑न्ता॒ दास॑थो र॒यिम् । येन॑ दृ॒ळ्हा स॒मत्स्वा वी॒ळु चि॑त्साहिषी॒मह्य॒ग्निर्वने॑व॒ वात॒ इन्नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: índrāgnī íti ǀ yuvám ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ sáhantā ǀ dā́sathaḥ ǀ rayím ǀyéna ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ samát-su ǀ ā́ ǀ vīḷú ǀ cit ǀ sahiṣīmáhi ǀ agníḥ ǀ vánā-iva ǀ vā́te ǀ ít ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VictoriousIndraandAgni, bestow upon us riches whereby we may destroy our powerful enemies incombats as fire fanned by the wind consumes the forests; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि वां॑ व॒व्रया॑म॒हेऽथेन्द्र॒मिद्य॑जामहे॒ शवि॑ष्ठं नृ॒णां नर॑म् । स न॑: क॒दा चि॒दर्व॑ता॒ गम॒दा वाज॑सातये॒ गम॒दा मे॒धसा॑तये॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ vām ǀ vavráyāmahe ǀ átha ǀ índram ǀ ít ǀ yajāmahe ǀ śáviṣṭham ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ náram ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ kadā́ ǀ cit ǀ árvatā ǀ gámat ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ gámat ǀ ā́ ǀ medhá-sātaye ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do we not invoke you both? We worship especiallyIndra, who is the strongest leader of men; he comesoccasionally with his horses to bestow upon us food; he comes to partake of the sacrifice; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता हि मध्यं॒ भरा॑णामिन्द्रा॒ग्नी अ॑धिक्षि॒तः । ता उ॑ कवित्व॒ना क॒वी पृ॒च्छ्यमा॑ना सखीय॒ते सं धी॒तम॑श्नुतं नरा॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ hí ǀ mádhyam ǀ bhárāṇām ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ adhi-kṣitáḥ ǀtā́ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ kavi-tvanā́ ǀ kavī́ íti ǀ pṛcchyámānā ǀ sakhi-yaté ǀ sám ǀ dhītám ǀ aśnutam ǀ narā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They two,IndraandAgni, are present in the midst of battles; do you two, leaders of rites, who are reallysages, when solicited (by the wise), accept the offering (from him) who seeks your friendship; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्च नभाक॒वदि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी य॒जसा॑ गि॒रा । ययो॒र्विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑दि॒यं द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ह्यु१॒॑पस्थे॑ बिभृ॒तो वसु॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arca ǀ nabhāka-vát ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ yajásā ǀ girā́ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ idám ǀ jágat ǀ iyám ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ bibhṛtáḥ ǀ vásu ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship, likeNabhāka,IndraandAgniwith sacrifice and praise, of whom is this universe, upon whoselap this heaven and the spacious earth deposit their treasure; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्मा॑णि नभाक॒वदि॑न्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॑मिरज्यत । या स॒प्तबु॑ध्नमर्ण॒वं जि॒ह्मबा॑रमपोर्णु॒त इन्द्र॒ ईशा॑न॒ ओज॑सा॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ nabhāka-vát ǀ indrāgní-bhyām ǀ irajyata ǀyā́ ǀ saptá-budhnam ǀ arṇavám ǀ jihmá-bāram ǀ apa-ūrṇutáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Address likeNabhākayour praises toIndraandAgni, who overspread (with their lustre) theseven-rooted ocean whose gates are hidden, and of whom Indra by his might is the lord; may all our adversariesperish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपि॑ वृश्च पुराण॒वद्व्र॒तते॑रिव गुष्पि॒तमोजो॑ दा॒सस्य॑ दम्भय । व॒यं तद॑स्य॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ वस्विन्द्रे॑ण॒ वि भ॑जेमहि॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: ápi ǀ vṛśca ǀ purāṇa-vát ǀ vratáteḥ-iva ǀ guṣpitám ǀ ójaḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ dambhaya ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ vásu ǀ índreṇa ǀ ví ǀ bhajemahi ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cut off (the foe),Indra, as and old (pruner) the protruding (branch) of a creeper, humble the strength oftheDāsa; may we divide his accusative ulated treasure (despoiled) by Indra; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी जना॑ इ॒मे वि॒ह्वय॑न्ते॒ तना॑ गि॒रा । अ॒स्माके॑भि॒र्नृभि॑र्व॒यं सा॑स॒ह्याम॑ पृतन्य॒तो व॑नु॒याम॑ वनुष्य॒तो नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ jánāḥ ǀ imé ǀ vi-hváyante ǀ tánā ǀ girā́ ǀasmā́kebhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vayám ǀ sasahyā́ma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǀ vanuyā́ma ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inasmuch as these people honourIndraandAgniwith gifts and with praises, so may we, defying hosts,overcome (our foes) with our warriors; let us praise those seeking praise; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या नु श्वे॒ताव॒वो दि॒व उ॒च्चरा॑त॒ उप॒ द्युभि॑: । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्न्योरनु॑ व्र॒तमुहा॑ना यन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ यान्त्सीं॑ ब॒न्धादमु॑ञ्चतां॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ nú ǀ śvetáu ǀ aváḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ut-cárātaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀindrāgnyóḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ úhānāḥ ǀ yanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ yā́n ǀ sīm ǀ bandhā́t ǀ ámuñcatām ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offering oblations, (the worshippers) approach to the worship ofIndraandAgni, who are of a whitecomplexion, and rise from below with bright rays to heaven; they verily have liberated the waters from bondage;may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीष्ट॑ इ॒न्द्रोप॑मातयः पू॒र्वीरु॒त प्रश॑स्तय॒: सूनो॑ हि॒न्वस्य॑ हरिवः । वस्वो॑ वी॒रस्या॒पृचो॒ या नु साध॑न्त नो॒ धियो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ úpa-mātayaḥ ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀ sū́no íti ǀ hinvásya ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀvásvaḥ ǀ vīrásya ǀ ā-pṛ́caḥ ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ nú ǀ sā́dhanta ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, instrumental gator (of acts), may the numerous merits, the many excellences ofyou, who are the bestower of affluence and ofmaleoffspring, perfect our understandings; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं शि॑शीता सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑स्त्वे॒षं सत्वा॑नमृ॒ग्मिय॑म् । उ॒तो नु चि॒द्य ओज॑सा॒ शुष्ण॑स्या॒ण्डानि॒ भेद॑ति॒ जेष॒त्स्व॑र्वतीर॒पो नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ śiśīta ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ tveṣám ǀ sátvānam ǀ ṛgmíyam ǀutó íti ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ āṇḍā́ni ǀ bhédati ǀ jéṣat ǀ sváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Animate with praises that brilliant adorableIndra, the distributor (of riches), who by hismight breaks theeggs ofŚuṣṇa; may he conquer the celestial waters; may all our enemies perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं शि॑शीता स्वध्व॒रं स॒त्यं सत्वा॑नमृ॒त्विय॑म् । उ॒तो नु चि॒द्य ओह॑त आ॒ण्डा शुष्ण॑स्य॒ भेद॒त्यजै॒: स्व॑र्वतीर॒पो नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ śiśīta ǀ su-adhvarám ǀ satyám ǀ sátvānam ǀ ṛtvíyam ǀutó íti ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ óhate ǀ āṇḍā́ ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ bhédati ǀ ájaiḥ ǀ sváḥ-vatīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Animate thatIndrato whom sacrifice is due-- sincere, bountiful, adorable; him who frequents sacrifices,who breaks the eggs ofŚuṣṇa; you have conquered the celestial waters; may all our enemies perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वेन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ पितृ॒वन्नवी॑यो मन्धातृ॒वद॑ङ्गिर॒स्वद॑वाचि । त्रि॒धातु॑ना॒ शर्म॑णा पातम॒स्मान्व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ indrāgní-bhyām ǀ pitṛ-vát ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ mandhātṛ-vát ǀ aṅgirasvát ǀ avāci ǀtri-dhā́tunā ǀ śármaṇā ǀ pātam ǀ asmā́n ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus has a new hymn been addressed toIndraandAgni, as was done by my father, byMandhātā,byAṅgirasa; cherish us with a triply defended dwelling; may we be the lords of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मा ऊ॒ षु प्रभू॑तये॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्योऽर्चा॑ वि॒दुष्ट॑रेभ्यः । यो धी॒ता मानु॑षाणां प॒श्वो गा इ॑व॒ रक्ष॑ति॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: asmái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá-bhūtaye ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀ árca ǀ vidúḥ-tarebhyaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ dhītā́ ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀ paśváḥ ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ rákṣati ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer praise to that opulentVaruṇa, and to the most sageMaruts; (Varuṇa) who protects men by hisacts, as (the herdsman guards) the cattle; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमू॒ षु स॑म॒ना गि॒रा पि॑तॄ॒णां च॒ मन्म॑भिः । ना॒भा॒कस्य॒ प्रश॑स्तिभि॒र्यः सिन्धू॑ना॒मुपो॑द॒ये स॒प्तस्व॑सा॒ स म॑ध्य॒मो नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ samanā́ ǀ girā́ ǀ pitṝṇā́m ǀ ca ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀnābhākásya ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ úpa ǀ ut-ayé ǀ saptá-svasā ǀ sáḥ ǀ madhyamáḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I praise) with a like praise, with the praises of (my) progenitors, with the eulogies ofNabhāka, thatVaruṇa who rises up in the vicinity of the rivers, and in the midst (of them) has seven sisters; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स क्षप॒: परि॑ षस्वजे॒ न्यु१॒॑स्रो मा॒यया॑ दधे॒ स विश्वं॒ परि॑ दर्श॒तः । तस्य॒ वेनी॒रनु॑ व्र॒तमु॒षस्ति॒स्रो अ॑वर्धय॒न्नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ kṣápaḥ ǀ pári ǀ sasvaje ǀ ní ǀ usráḥ ǀ māyáyā ǀ dadhe ǀ sáḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ pári ǀ darśatáḥ ǀtásya ǀ vénīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ uṣáḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ avardhayan ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He embraces the nights; of goodly aspect, and quick of movement, he encompasses the universe byhis acts; all who are desirous (of his favour) diligently offer him worship at the three diurnal rites; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः क॒कुभो॑ निधार॒यः पृ॑थि॒व्यामधि॑ दर्श॒तः । स माता॑ पू॒र्व्यं प॒दं तद्वरु॑णस्य॒ सप्त्यं॒ स हि गो॒पा इ॒वेर्यो॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ kakúbhaḥ ǀ ni-dhārayáḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ádhi ǀ darśatáḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ mā́tā ǀ pūrvyám ǀ padám ǀ tát ǀ váruṇasya ǀ sáptyam ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ gopā́ḥ-iva ǀ íryaḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, who visible above the earth sustains the points of the horizon, is the measurer (of the universe);that is the ancient abode ofVaruṇa, to which we have access; he is our lord, like the keeper of cattle; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो ध॒र्ता भुव॑नानां॒ य उ॒स्राणा॑मपी॒च्या॒३॒॑ वेद॒ नामा॑नि॒ गुह्या॑ । स क॒विः काव्या॑ पु॒रु रू॒पं द्यौरि॑व पुष्यति॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ bhúvanānām ǀ yáḥ ǀ usrā́ṇām ǀ apīcyā́ ǀ véda ǀ nā́māni ǀ gúhyā ǀsáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ kā́vyā ǀ purú ǀ rūpám ǀ dyáuḥ-iva ǀ puṣyati ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is the sustainer of the worlds, who knows the hidden and secret names of the (solar) rays, he isthe sage who cherishes the acts of sages, as the heaven cherishes numerous forms; may all our adversariesperish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑ च॒क्रे नाभि॑रिव श्रि॒ता । त्रि॒तं जू॒ती स॑पर्यत व्र॒जे गावो॒ न सं॒युजे॑ यु॒जे अश्वाँ॑ अयुक्षत॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀ cakré ǀ nā́bhiḥ-iva ǀ śritā́ ǀtritám ǀ jūtī́ ǀ saparyata ǀ vrajé ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sam-yúje ǀ yujé ǀ áśvān ǀ ayukṣata ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In whom all pious acts are concentrated, like the nave in the (centre of the) wheel, worship him quicklywho abides in thethree worlds; as men assemble the cattle in their pasture, so do (our foes) collect their horses(to assail us); may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॒स्वत्क॑ आ॒शये॒ विश्वा॑ जा॒तान्ये॑षाम् । परि॒ धामा॑नि॒ मर्मृ॑श॒द्वरु॑णस्य पु॒रो गये॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अनु॑ व्र॒तं नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ āsu ǀ átkaḥ ǀ ā-śáye ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ eṣām ǀpári ǀ dhā́māni ǀ mármṛśat ǀ váruṇasya ǀ puráḥ ǀ gáye ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, passing amid those (regions of the firmament), given refuge to all their races, and all thedeities precede the chariot ofVaruṇa, when manifesting his glories to perform his worship; may all ouradversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स स॑मु॒द्रो अ॑पी॒च्य॑स्तु॒रो द्यामि॑व रोहति॒ नि यदा॑सु॒ यजु॑र्द॒धे । स मा॒या अ॒र्चिना॑ प॒दास्तृ॑णा॒न्नाक॒मारु॑ह॒न्नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
