shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ samudráḥ ǀ apīcyáḥ ǀ turáḥ ǀ dyā́m-iva ǀ rohati ǀ ní ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ yájuḥ ǀ dadhé ǀsáḥ ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ arcínā ǀ padā́ ǀ ástṛṇāt ǀ nā́kam ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is the hidden ocean; swift he mounts (the heaven) as (the sun) the sky; when he has plural ced thesacrifice in those (regions of the firmament), he demolishes with his brilliant radiance the devices (of theasuras);he ascends to heaven; may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ श्वे॒ता वि॑चक्ष॒णा ति॒स्रो भूमी॑रधिक्षि॒तः । त्रिरुत्त॑राणि प॒प्रतु॒र्वरु॑णस्य ध्रु॒वं सद॒: स स॑प्ता॒नामि॑रज्यति॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ śvetā́ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇā́ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ bhū́mīḥ ǀ adhi-kṣitáḥ ǀtríḥ ǀ út-tarāṇi ǀ paprátuḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhruvám ǀ sádaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ saptānā́m ǀ irajyati ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of whom, present in thethree worlds, the brilliant rays pervade the three realms beyond, the eternaldwelling ofVaruṇa, he is lord of the seven (rivers); may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः श्वे॒ताँ अधि॑निर्णिजश्च॒क्रे कृ॒ष्णाँ अनु॑ व्र॒ता । स धाम॑ पू॒र्व्यं म॑मे॒ यः स्क॒म्भेन॒ वि रोद॑सी अ॒जो न द्यामधा॑रय॒न्नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śvetā́n ǀ ádhi-nirnijaḥ ǀ cakré ǀ kṛṣṇā́n ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ dhā́ma ǀ pūrvyám ǀ mame ǀ yáḥ ǀ skambhéna ǀ ví ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ajáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyā́m ǀ ádhārayat ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who in his successive functions emits his bright rays or turns them dark, first made his residence (inthe firmament), and as the unborn sun the sky, supports with the pillar (of the firmament) both heaven and earth;may all our adversaries perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्त॑भ्ना॒द्द्यामसु॑रो वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒ अमि॑मीत वरि॒माणं॑ पृथि॒व्याः । आसी॑द॒द्विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि स॒म्राड्विश्वेत्तानि॒ वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ástabhnāt ǀ dyā́m ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀ ámimīta ǀ varimā́ṇam ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀā́ ǀ asīdat ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ sam-rā́ṭ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ni ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The possessor of all wealth, the powerfulVaruṇa, has fixed the heaven; he has meted the measure ofthe earth; he presides as supreme monarch over all worlds; these all are the functions of Varuṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा व॑न्दस्व॒ वरु॑णं बृ॒हन्तं॑ नम॒स्या धीर॑म॒मृत॑स्य गो॒पाम् । स न॒: शर्म॑ त्रि॒वरू॑थं॒ वि यं॑सत्पा॒तं नो॑ द्यावापृथिवी उ॒पस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ vandasva ǀ váruṇam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ namasyá ǀ dhī́ram ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ gopā́m ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ví ǀ yaṃsat ǀ pātám ǀ naḥ ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ upá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorify then the mightyVaruṇa; reverence the wise guardian of the ambrosia; may he bestow upon usa thrice sheltering habitation; may heaven and earth preserve us abiding in their proximity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां धियं॒ शिक्ष॑माणस्य देव॒ क्रतुं॒ दक्षं॑ वरुण॒ सं शि॑शाधि । ययाति॒ विश्वा॑ दुरि॒ता तरे॑म सु॒तर्मा॑ण॒मधि॒ नावं॑ रुहेम
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ śíkṣamāṇasya ǀ deva ǀ krátum ǀ dákṣam ǀ varuṇa ǀ sám ǀ śiśādhi ǀyáyā ǀ áti ǀ víśvā ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tárema ǀ su-tármāṇam ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́vam ǀ ruhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineVaruṇa, animate the sacred acts of me engaging in this your worship; may we ascend thesafe-bearing vessel by which we may cross all difficulties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॒ ग्रावा॑णो अश्विना धी॒भिर्विप्रा॑ अचुच्यवुः । नास॑त्या॒ सोम॑पीतये॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ grā́vāṇaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ acucyavuḥ ǀnā́satyā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sacred stones,Aśvins, the pious worshipers,Nāsatyās, have fallen upon their sacred functions,(to induce you) to drink theSoma; may all our enemies perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ वा॒मत्रि॑रश्विना गी॒र्भिर्विप्रो॒ अजो॑हवीत् । नास॑त्या॒ सोम॑पीतये॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ vām ǀ átriḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ájohavīt ǀnā́satyā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as the piousAtri,Aśvins, invoked you with hymns, so (I invoke you),Nāsatyās, todrink theSoma; may all our enemies perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा वा॑मह्व ऊ॒तये॒ यथाहु॑वन्त॒ मेधि॑राः । नास॑त्या॒ सोम॑पीतये॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒के स॑मे
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ vām ǀ ahve ǀ ūtáye ǀ yáthā ǀ áhuvanta ǀ médhirāḥ ǀnā́satyā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyaké ǀ same ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In like manner as the wise invoke you for protection, so do I invoke you,Nāsatyās, to drink theSoma;may all our enemies perish.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे विप्र॑स्य वे॒धसो॒ऽग्नेरस्तृ॑तयज्वनः । गिर॒: स्तोमा॑स ईरते
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ víprasya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ástṛta-yajvanaḥ ǀgíraḥ ǀ stómāsaḥ ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These repeaters of laudations recite the praises of the wise creativeAgni, the uninterrupted sacrificeṛ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्मै॑ ते प्रति॒हर्य॑ते॒ जात॑वेदो॒ विच॑र्षणे । अग्ने॒ जना॑मि सुष्टु॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásmai ǀ te ǀ prati-háryate ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇe ǀágne ǀ jánāmi ǀ su-stutím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,Jātavedas, to you, the liberal offerer (of the oblation), the all-beholding, I repeat earnest praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒रो॒का इ॑व॒ घेदह॑ ति॒ग्मा अ॑ग्ने॒ तव॒ त्विष॑: । द॒द्भिर्वना॑नि बप्सति
shlokas.transliteration: ārokā́ḥ-iva ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ áha ǀ tigmā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ tvíṣaḥ ǀdat-bhíḥ ǀ vánāni ǀ bapsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your fierce flames,Agni, consume the forest, as wild animals destroy (the plural nts) with their teeth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हर॑यो धू॒मके॑तवो॒ वात॑जूता॒ उप॒ द्यवि॑ । यत॑न्ते॒ वृथ॑ग॒ग्नय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hárayaḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketavaḥ ǀ vā́ta-jūtāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ dyávi ǀyátante ǀ vṛ́thak ǀ agnáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The consuming smoke-bannered fires, borne by the wind, spread diversely in the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते त्ये वृथ॑ग॒ग्नय॑ इ॒द्धास॒: सम॑दृक्षत । उ॒षसा॑मिव के॒तव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ tyé ǀ vṛ́thak ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ iddhā́saḥ ǀ sám ǀ adṛkṣata ǀuṣásām-iva ǀ ketávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These fires separately kindled are beheld like the tokens of the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णा रजां॑सि पत्सु॒तः प्र॒याणे॑ जा॒तवे॑दसः । अ॒ग्निर्यद्रोध॑ति॒ क्षमि॑
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇā́ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ patsutáḥ ǀ pra-yā́ne ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ yát ǀ ródhati ǀ kṣámi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Black dust is raised by the feet ofJātavedaswhen he moves, whenAgnispreads on the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धा॒सिं कृ॑ण्वा॒न ओष॑धी॒र्बप्स॑द॒ग्निर्न वा॑यति । पुन॒र्यन्तरु॑णी॒रपि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhāsím ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ bápsat ǀ agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāyati ǀpúnaḥ ǀ yán ǀ táruṇīḥ ǀ ápi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Making the plural nts his food,Agnidevouring them is never satiated, but falls again upon the young(shrubs).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जि॒ह्वाभि॒रह॒ नन्न॑मद॒र्चिषा॑ जञ्जणा॒भव॑न् । अ॒ग्निर्वने॑षु रोचते
shlokas.transliteration: jihvā́bhiḥ ǀ áha ǀ nánnamat ǀ arcíṣā ǀ jañjaṇā-bhávan ǀagníḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ rocate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bowing down (the trees) with his tongues (of flame), and blazing with splendour,Agnishines in theforests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्स्व॑ग्ने॒ सधि॒ष्टव॒ सौष॑धी॒रनु॑ रुध्यसे । गर्भे॒ सञ्जा॑यसे॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ agne ǀ sádhiḥ ǀ táva ǀ sáḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ rudhyase ǀgárbhe ǀ sán ǀ jāyase ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your station,Agni, is in the waters; you cling to the plural nts, and becoming their embryo, are born again.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑ग्ने॒ तव॒ तद्घृ॒ताद॒र्ची रो॑चत॒ आहु॑तम् । निंसा॑नं जु॒ह्वो॒३॒॑ मुखे॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ agne ǀ táva ǀ tát ǀ ghṛtā́t ǀ arcíḥ ǀ rocate ǀ ā́-hutam ǀníṃsānam ǀ juhváḥ ǀ múkhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your lustre,Agni, lambent in the mouth of the ladle, shines when offered from (the oblation of) butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षान्ना॑य व॒शान्ना॑य॒ सोम॑पृष्ठाय वे॒धसे॑ । स्तोमै॑र्विधेमा॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣá-annāya ǀ vaśā́-annāya ǀ sóma-pṛṣṭhāya ǀ vedháse ǀstómaiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us adore with hymnsAgni, the granter (of desires), the eater of the ox, the eater of the marrow, onwhose back the libation is poured.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वा॒ नम॑सा व॒यं होत॒र्वरे॑ण्यक्रतो । अग्ने॑ स॒मिद्भि॑रीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ námasā ǀ vayám ǀ hótaḥ ǀ váreṇyakrato íti váreṇya-krato ǀágne ǀ samít-bhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit you,Agni, invoker of the gods, performer of sacred rites, with oblations and with fueḷ”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वा॑ भृगु॒वच्छु॑चे मनु॒ष्वद॑ग्न आहुत । अ॒ङ्गि॒र॒स्वद्ध॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ bhṛgu-vát ǀ śuce ǀ manuṣvát ǀ agne ǀ ā-huta ǀaṅgirasvát ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “HolyAgni, to whom oblations are offered, we worship you in like manner (as you have beenworshipped) byBhṛgu, byManus, byAṅgirasa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्य॑ग्ने अ॒ग्निना॒ विप्रो॒ विप्रे॑ण॒ सन्त्स॒ता । सखा॒ सख्या॑ समि॒ध्यसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ agnínā ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vípreṇa ǀ sán ǀ satā́ ǀsákhā ǀ sákhyā ǀ sam-idhyáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are kindled by Agni; a sage by a sage, saint by a saint, a friend by a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वं विप्रा॑य दा॒शुषे॑ र॒यिं दे॑हि सह॒स्रिण॑म् । अग्ने॑ वी॒रव॑ती॒मिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ víprāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ rayím ǀ dehi ǀ sahasríṇam ǀágne ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, bestow upon the pious donor (of the oblation) infinite riches and food withmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ भ्रात॒: सह॑स्कृत॒ रोहि॑दश्व॒ शुचि॑व्रत । इ॒मं स्तोमं॑ जुषस्व मे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ bhrā́taríti ǀ sáhaḥ-kṛta ǀ róhit-aśva ǀ śúci-vrata ǀimám ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ me ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, (our) brother, who are elicited by strength, who have red horses, and are (the performer) of purerites, be propitiated by this my praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वा॑ग्ने॒ मम॒ स्तुतो॑ वा॒श्राय॑ प्रति॒हर्य॑ते । गो॒ष्ठं गाव॑ इवाशत
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ agne ǀ máma ǀ stútaḥ ǀ vāśrā́ya ǀ prati-háryate ǀgo-sthám ǀ gā́vaḥ-iva ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praises hasten to you,Agni, as cows enter their stalls (to give milk) to the thirsting calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ ता अ॑ङ्गिरस्तम॒ विश्वा॑: सुक्षि॒तय॒: पृथ॑क् । अग्ने॒ कामा॑य येमिरे
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ-tama ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ su-kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pṛ́thak ǀágne ǀ kā́māya ǀ yemire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, who are the chief of theAṅgirasas, all people have severally recourse for the attainemntof their desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं धी॒भिर्म॑नी॒षिणो॒ मेधि॑रासो विप॒श्चित॑: । अ॒द्म॒सद्या॑य हिन्विरे
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ médhirāsaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀadma-sádyāya ǀ hinvire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise, the intelligent, the sagacious, propitiateAgniwith sacrifices for the attainment of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वामज्मे॑षु वा॒जिनं॑ तन्वा॒ना अ॑ग्ने अध्व॒रम् । वह्निं॒ होता॑रमीळते
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā́m ǀ ájmeṣu ǀ vājínam ǀ tanvānā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ adhvarám ǀváhnim ǀ hótāram ǀ īḷate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preparing the sacrifice in their mansions, (the worshippers) adore you,Agni, the powerful, the bearer(of the oblation), the invoker of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रु॒त्रा हि स॒दृङ्ङसि॒ विशो॒ विश्वा॒ अनु॑ प्र॒भुः । स॒मत्सु॑ त्वा हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: puru-trā́ ǀ hí ǀ sa-dṛ́ṅ ǀ ási ǀ víśaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pra-bhúḥ ǀsamát-su ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the lord, you behold all people alike in many plural ces; we therefore invoke you in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॑ळिष्व॒ य आहु॑तो॒ऽग्निर्वि॒भ्राज॑ते घृ॒तैः । इ॒मं न॑: शृणव॒द्धव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īḷiṣva ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vi-bhrā́jate ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀimám ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore thatAgniwho shines brightly when fed with offerings of butter, who hears this our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ व॒यं ह॑वामहे शृ॒ण्वन्तं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसम् । अग्ने॒ घ्नन्त॒मप॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǀ śṛṇvántam ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀágne ǀ ghnántam ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you,Agni, who areJātavedas, listening (to our praises), exterminating our foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒शां राजा॑न॒मद्भु॑त॒मध्य॑क्षं॒ धर्म॑णामि॒मम् । अ॒ग्निमी॑ळे॒ स उ॑ श्रवत्
shlokas.transliteration: viśā́m ǀ rā́jānam ǀ ádbhutam ǀ ádhi-akṣam ǀ dhármaṇām ǀ imám ǀagním ǀ īḷe ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śravat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise thisAgni, the sovereign of men, the wonderful, the superintendent of holy acts; may he hearme.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं वि॒श्वायु॑वेपसं॒ मर्यं॒ न वा॒जिनं॑ हि॒तम् । सप्तिं॒ न वा॑जयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ viśvā́yu-vepasam ǀ máryam ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ hitám ǀsáptim ǀ ná ǀ vājayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invigorate like a horse that (Agni) whose might is everywhere present; who is noble, strong, andbenevolent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घ्नन्मृ॒ध्राण्यप॒ द्विषो॒ दह॒न्रक्षां॑सि वि॒श्वहा॑ । अग्ने॑ ति॒ग्मेन॑ दीदिहि
shlokas.transliteration: ghnán ǀ mṛdhrā́ṇi ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ dáhan ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ viśváhā ǀágne ǀ tigména ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slaying the malignant (driving away) our enemies everywhere consuming therākṣasas, do you, Agniblaze forth with bright (radiance).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॒ जना॑स इन्ध॒ते म॑नु॒ष्वद॑ङ्गिरस्तम । अग्ने॒ स बो॑धि मे॒ वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ indhaté ǀ manuṣvát ǀ aṅgiraḥ-tama ǀágne ǀ sáḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ me ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Chief of theAṅgirasas, whose men kindle as didManus;Agni, hear my words.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑ग्ने दिवि॒जा अस्य॑प्सु॒जा वा॑ सहस्कृत । तं त्वा॑ गी॒र्भिर्ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ divi-jā́ḥ ǀ ási ǀ apsu-jā́ḥ ǀ vā ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worship with praises you,Agni, who are born in heaven or in the waters, elicited by strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ घेत्ते जना॑ इ॒मे विश्वा॑: सुक्षि॒तय॒: पृथ॑क् । धा॒सिं हि॑न्व॒न्त्यत्त॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ té ǀ jánāḥ ǀ imé ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ su-kṣitáyaḥ ǀ pṛ́thak ǀdhāsím ǀ hinvanti ǀ áttave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All these people, the inhabitants (of the earth), offer severally to you (sacrificial) food for your eatingand enjoyment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते घेद॑ग्ने स्वा॒ध्योऽहा॒ विश्वा॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सः । तर॑न्तः स्याम दु॒र्गहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ áhā ǀ víśvā ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀtárantaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ duḥ-gáhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, through you, may we, skilled in sacrifices and beholding men all our days, pass through (all)difficulties.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं म॒न्द्रं पु॑रुप्रि॒यं शी॒रं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषम् । हृ॒द्भिर्म॒न्द्रेभि॑रीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ mandrám ǀ puru-priyám ǀ śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀhṛt-bhíḥ ǀ mandrébhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke with cheerful and delightful (hymns) the gladdeningAgni, dear to many, who abides in thesacrifice with purifying brilliance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वम॑ग्ने वि॒भाव॑सुः सृ॒जन्त्सूर्यो॒ न र॒श्मिभि॑: । शर्ध॒न्तमां॑सि जिघ्नसे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ vibhā́-vasuḥ ǀ sṛján ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀśárdhan ǀ támāṃsi ǀ jighnase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shining forth,Agni, like the rising sun, displaying your strength by your beams, you destroy thedarkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्ते॑ सहस्व ईमहे दा॒त्रं यन्नोप॒दस्य॑ति । त्वद॑ग्ने॒ वार्यं॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ te ǀ sahasvaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ dātrám ǀ yát ǀ ná ǀ upa-dásyati ǀtvát ǀ agne ǀ vā́ryam ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit from you, strongAgni, that desirable wealth which is in your gift and which decays not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मिधा॒ग्निं दु॑वस्यत घृ॒तैर्बो॑धय॒ताति॑थिम् । आस्मि॑न्ह॒व्या जु॑होतन
shlokas.transliteration: sam-ídhā ǀ agním ǀ duvasyata ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ bodhayata ǀ átithim ǀā́ ǀ asmin ǀ havyā́ ǀ juhotana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “HonourAgniwith fuel, awaken him, the guest, with (libations of) butter; offer the oblations in him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ स्तोमं॑ जुषस्व मे॒ वर्ध॑स्वा॒नेन॒ मन्म॑ना । प्रति॑ सू॒क्तानि॑ हर्य नः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ stómam ǀ juṣasva ǀ me ǀ várdhasva ǀ anéna ǀ mánmanā ǀpráti ǀ su-uktā́ni ǀ harya ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, accept my praise, be invigorated by this prayer; be favourable to our hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दू॒तं पु॒रो द॑धे हव्य॒वाह॒मुप॑ ब्रुवे । दे॒वाँ आ सा॑दयादि॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ dūtám ǀ puráḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀdevā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ sādayāt ǀ ihá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I setAgniin the front as the messenger, I adore him as the bearer of the oblations; may he cause thegods to sit down here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॑ बृ॒हन्तो॑ अ॒र्चय॑: समिधा॒नस्य॑ दीदिवः । अग्ने॑ शु॒क्रास॑ ईरते
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ bṛhántaḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ sam-idhānásya ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀágne ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BrilliantAgni, as you are kindled, your great flames start blazing up.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वा जु॒ह्वो॒३॒॑ मम॑ घृ॒ताची॑र्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने॑ ह॒व्या जु॑षस्व नः
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ juhváḥ ǀ máma ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀ yantu ǀ haryata ǀágne ǀ havyā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let my ladles, filled with butter, come near you, O propitious one;Agni, receive our oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रं होता॑रमृ॒त्विजं॑ चि॒त्रभा॑नुं वि॒भाव॑सुम् । अ॒ग्निमी॑ळे॒ स उ॑ श्रवत्
shlokas.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ citrá-bhānum ǀ vibhā́-vasum ǀagním ǀ īḷe ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śravat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worshipAgni, the exhilarating invoker (of the gods), the priest, him who shines forth with various lustre,and is rich in brilliance, may he give car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒त्नं होता॑र॒मीड्यं॒ जुष्ट॑म॒ग्निं क॒विक्र॑तुम् । अ॒ध्व॒राणा॑मभि॒श्रिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pratnám ǀ hótāram ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ júṣṭam ǀ agním ǀ kaví-kratum ǀadhvarā́ṇām ǀ abhi-śríyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I worship) the belovedAgni, the ancient adorable invoker (of the gods), the wise, the frequenter ofsacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षा॒णो अ॑ङ्गिरस्तमे॒मा ह॒व्यान्या॑नु॒षक् । अग्ने॑ य॒ज्ञं न॑य ऋतु॒था
shlokas.transliteration: juṣāṇáḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ-tama ǀ imā́ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ ānuṣák ǀágne ǀ yajñám ǀ naya ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, best of theAṅgirasas, do you, continually accepting these our oblations, conduct the sacrifice atthe due seasons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मि॒धा॒न उ॑ सन्त्य॒ शुक्र॑शोच इ॒हा व॑ह । चि॒कि॒त्वान्दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ santya ǀ śúkra-śoce ǀ ihá ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀcikitvā́n ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant-flames giver of food, do you, the knower, when kindled, bring the host of the gods here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विप्रं॒ होता॑रम॒द्रुहं॑ धू॒मके॑तुं वि॒भाव॑सुम् । य॒ज्ञानां॑ के॒तुमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: vípram ǀ hótāram ǀ adrúham ǀ dhūmá-ketum ǀ vibhā́-vasum ǀyajñā́nām ǀ ketúm ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit the wise invoker (of the gods), the beneficent, the smoke- bannered, the resplendent, thebanner of the sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ नि पा॑हि न॒स्त्वं प्रति॑ ष्म देव॒ रीष॑तः । भि॒न्धि द्वेष॑: सहस्कृत
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ práti ǀ sma ǀ deva ǀ ríṣataḥ ǀbhindhí ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ sahaḥ-kṛta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, produced by strength, do you protect us from the injurer, tear asunder our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः प्र॒त्नेन॒ मन्म॑ना॒ शुम्भा॑नस्त॒न्वं१॒॑ स्वाम् । क॒विर्विप्रे॑ण वावृधे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ mánmanā ǀ śúmbhānaḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ svā́m ǀkavíḥ ǀ vípreṇa ǀ vavṛdhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wiseAgni, beautifying his body with the ancient hymn, has grown in might through the intelligenthymner.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑त॒मा हु॑वे॒ऽग्निं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषम् । अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे स्व॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: ūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀ agním ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀasmín ǀ yajñé ǀ su-adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeAgniof purifying lustre, the son of (sacrificial) food, in this inviolable sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ मित्रमह॒स्त्वमग्ने॑ शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑ । दे॒वैरा स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ágne ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OAgni, adorable to your friends, sit down with the gods on our sacred grass with your resplendentradiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्निं त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ दमे॑ दे॒वं मर्त॑: सप॒र्यति॑ । तस्मा॒ इद्दी॑दय॒द्वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agním ǀ tanváḥ ǀ dáme ǀ devám ǀ mártaḥ ǀ saparyáti ǀtásmai ǀ ít ǀ dīdayat ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatsoever mortal worships the divineAgniin his house (for the attainment) of wealth, to him he givesriches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पति॑: पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पां रेतां॑सि जिन्वति
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ mūrdhā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kakút ǀ pátiḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ayám ǀapā́m ǀ rétāṃsi ǀ jinvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the head (of the gods), the summit of heaven-- he the lord of the earth-- gladdens the seed of thewaters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उद॑ग्ने॒ शुच॑य॒स्तव॑ शु॒क्रा भ्राज॑न्त ईरते । तव॒ ज्योतीं॑ष्य॒र्चय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ agne ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ táva ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ bhrā́jantaḥ ǀ īrate ǀtáva ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ arcáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, your pure, bright, shining flames send forth your splendours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईशि॑षे॒ वार्य॑स्य॒ हि दा॒त्रस्या॑ग्ने॒ स्व॑र्पतिः । स्तो॒ता स्यां॒ तव॒ शर्म॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: ī́śiṣe ǀ vā́ryasya ǀ hí ǀ dātrásya ǀ agne ǀ sváḥ-patiḥ ǀstotā́ ǀ syām ǀ táva ǀ śármaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, lord of heaven, you preside over (all) that is to be desired or given; may I be your eulogist forhappiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने मनी॒षिण॒स्त्वां हि॑न्वन्ति॒ चित्ति॑भिः । त्वां व॑र्धन्तु नो॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ tvā́m ǀ hinvanti ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, the wise (praise), you they rejoice with (pious) rites; may our praises invigorate you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑ब्धस्य स्व॒धाव॑तो दू॒तस्य॒ रेभ॑त॒: सदा॑ । अ॒ग्नेः स॒ख्यं वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: ádabdhasya ǀ svadhā́-vataḥ ǀ dūtásya ǀ rébhataḥ ǀ sádā ǀagnéḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We ever choose the friendship ofAgni, the unharmed, the strong, the messenger, the praiser (of thegods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः शुचि॑व्रततम॒: शुचि॒र्विप्र॒: शुचि॑: क॒विः । शुची॑ रोचत॒ आहु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ śúcivrata-tamaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀśúciḥ ǀ rocate ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pureAgnishines forth when worshipped the purest offerer, the pure priest, the pure sage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वा॑ धी॒तयो॒ मम॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्तु वि॒श्वहा॑ । अग्ने॑ स॒ख्यस्य॑ बोधि नः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ máma ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vardhantu ǀ viśváhā ǀágne ǀ sakhyásya ǀ bodhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May my rites also and my praises ever invigorate youAgni, take thought of our friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑ग्ने॒ स्याम॒हं त्वं त्वं वा॑ घा॒ स्या अ॒हम् । स्युष्टे॑ स॒त्या इ॒हाशिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ syā́m ǀ ahám ǀ tvám ǀ tvám ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ syā́ḥ ǀ ahám ǀsyúḥ ǀ te ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ā-śíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, if I were you or you were I, your wishes here should come true.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसु॒र्वसु॑पति॒र्हि क॒मस्य॑ग्ने वि॒भाव॑सुः । स्याम॑ ते सुम॒तावपि॑
shlokas.transliteration: vásuḥ ǀ vásu-patiḥ ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ ási ǀ agne ǀ vibhā́-vasuḥ ǀsyā́ma ǀ te ǀ su-matáu ǀ ápi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you are rich in splendour, the lord of wealth, and the giver of dwellings; may we too abide in yourfavour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ धृ॒तव्र॑ताय ते समु॒द्राये॑व॒ सिन्ध॑वः । गिरो॑ वा॒श्रास॑ ईरते
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ dhṛtá-vratāya ǀ te ǀ samudrā́ya-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀgíraḥ ǀ vāśrā́saḥ ǀ īrate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, my loud praises proceed to you, observant of pious rites, as rivers to the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: युवा॑नं वि॒श्पतिं॑ क॒विं वि॒श्वादं॑ पुरु॒वेप॑सम् । अ॒ग्निं शु॑म्भामि॒ मन्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: yúvānam ǀ viśpátim ǀ kavím ǀ viśva-ádam ǀ puru-vépasam ǀagním ǀ śumbhāmi ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with hymns the ever-youngAgni, the lord of men, the wise, the all-devouring, the performer ofmany acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञानां॑ र॒थ्ये॑ व॒यं ति॒ग्मज॑म्भाय वी॒ळवे॑ । स्तोमै॑रिषेमा॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yajñā́nām ǀ rathyé ǀ vayám ǀ tigmá-jambhāya ǀ vīḷáve ǀstómaiḥ ǀ iṣema ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us seek with our hymnsAgni, the conductor of the sacrifices, the mighty, the sharp-jawed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॑ग्ने॒ त्वे अपि॑ जरि॒ता भू॑तु सन्त्य । तस्म॑स पावक मृळय
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ agne ǀ tvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ jaritā́ ǀ bhūtu ǀ santya ǀtásmai ǀ pāvaka ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this (my family) also be your worshippers, adorableAgni; O purifier, give them happinesṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: धीरो॒ ह्यस्य॑द्म॒सद्विप्रो॒ न जागृ॑वि॒: सदा॑ । अग्ने॑ दी॒दय॑सि॒ द्यवि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dhī́raḥ ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ adma-sát ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ná ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ sádā ǀágne ǀ dīdáyasi ǀ dyávi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You verily are wise, seated at the oblation, wakeful as the seer (for the welfare of living beings);Agni,you ever shine in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒राग्ने॑ दुरि॒तेभ्य॑: पु॒रा मृ॒ध्रेभ्य॑: कवे । प्र ण॒ आयु॑र्वसो तिर
shlokas.transliteration: purā́ ǀ agne ǀ duḥ-itébhyaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ mṛdhrébhyaḥ ǀ kave ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ tira ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WiseAgni, giver of dwellings, extend our lives,before sins or assailants (destroy us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ घा॒ ये अ॒ग्निमि॑न्ध॒ते स्तृ॒णन्ति॑ ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षक् । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gha ǀ yé ǀ agním ǀ indhaté ǀ stṛṇánti ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ānuṣák ǀyéṣām ǀ índraḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those (sages) who kindleAgni, those of whom the ever-youngIndrais the friend, continually spreadthe sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्निदि॒ध्म ए॑षां॒ भूरि॑ श॒स्तं पृ॒थुः स्वरु॑: । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhán ǀ ít ǀ idhmáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ bhū́ri ǀ śastám ǀ pṛthú ǀ sváruḥ ǀyéṣām ǀ índraḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ample is their fuel, many their hymns, broad their sacred shaving-- whose friend is the ever-youngIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑द्ध॒ इद्यु॒धा वृतं॒ शूर॒ आज॑ति॒ सत्व॑भिः । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑
shlokas.transliteration: áyuddhaḥ ǀ ít ǀ yudhā́ ǀ vṛ́tam ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ajati ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀyéṣām ǀ índraḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ sákhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Though before powerless to combat, the hero by his might now subdues one surrounded by allies, (ifhelped by those) of whom the ever-youngIndrais the friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ बु॒न्दं वृ॑त्र॒हा द॑दे जा॒तः पृ॑च्छ॒द्वि मा॒तर॑म् । क उ॒ग्राः के ह॑ शृण्विरे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ bundám ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ dade ǀ jātáḥ ǀ pṛcchat ǀ ví ǀ mātáram ǀké ǀ ugrā́ḥ ǀ ké ǀ ha ǀ śṛṇvire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The slayer ofVṛtra, as soon as he was born, seized his arrow, and asked his mother, "who are theterrible, who are renowned?"”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ त्वा शव॒सी व॑दद्गि॒रावप्सो॒ न यो॑धिषत् । यस्ते॑ शत्रु॒त्वमा॑च॒के
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ tvā ǀ śavasī́ ǀ vadat ǀ giráu ǀ ápsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yodhiṣat ǀyáḥ ǀ te ǀ śatru-tvám ǀ ā-caké ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your strong mother answered you, "he who wishes your enmity fights as the elephant in the mountain".”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वं म॑घवञ्छृणु॒ यस्ते॒ वष्टि॑ व॒वक्षि॒ तत् । यद्वी॒ळया॑सि वी॒ळु तत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvám ǀ magha-van ǀ śṛṇu ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ váṣṭi ǀ vavákṣi ǀ tát ǀyát ǀ vīḷáyāsi ǀ vīḷú ǀ tát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OMaghavan, do you hear (our praise); whosoever desires of you, you bear to him his request, whatyou fix is sure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा॒जिं यात्या॑जि॒कृदिन्द्र॑: स्वश्व॒युरुप॑ । र॒थीत॑मो र॒थीना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ājím ǀ yā́ti ǀ āji-kṛ́t ǀ índraḥ ǀ svaśva-yúḥ ǀ úpa ǀrathí-tamaḥ ǀ rathínām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhenIndra, the warrior, goes to battle, desirous of gallant steeds, he is the foremost of the lords ofchariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा॑ अभि॒युजो॒ वज्रि॒न्विष्व॒ग्यथा॑ वृह । भवा॑ नः सु॒श्रव॑स्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ vájrin ǀ víṣvak ǀ yáthā ǀ vṛha ǀbháva ǀ naḥ ǀ suśrávaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thunderer, smite all your enemies that you may be scattered-- be to us a most abundant benefactor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माकं॒ सु रथं॑ पु॒र इन्द्र॑: कृणोतु सा॒तये॑ । न यं धूर्व॑न्ति धू॒र्तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ sú ǀ rátham ǀ puráḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ sātáye ǀná ǀ yám ǀ dhū́rvanti ǀ dhūrtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, whom no foes can harm, send before us a beautiful chariot for the acquisition (of ourdesires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ज्याम॑ ते॒ परि॒ द्विषोऽरं॑ ते शक्र दा॒वने॑ । ग॒मेमेदि॑न्द्र॒ गोम॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛjyā́ma ǀ te ǀ pári ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ áram ǀ te ǀ śakra ǀ dāváne ǀgaméma ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SurroundIndra, may we escape your enemies; may we come to you abundantly for your gifts, rich incattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शनै॑श्चि॒द्यन्तो॑ अद्रि॒वोऽश्वा॑वन्तः शत॒ग्विन॑: । वि॒वक्ष॑णा अने॒हस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śánaiḥ ǀ cit ǀ yántaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ áśva-vantaḥ ǀ śata-gvínaḥ ǀvivákṣaṇāḥ ǀ anehásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(May we come), thunderer, slowly approaching you-- may we be rich in horses, possessed of abundanttreasure, ready to offer, and unharmed (by calamity).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वा हि ते॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे स॒हस्रा॑ सू॒नृता॑ श॒ता । ज॒रि॒तृभ्यो॑ वि॒मंह॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhvā́ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ divé-dive ǀ sahásrā ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ śatā́ ǀjaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vi-máṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The sacrificer) gives to your praisers day by day hundreds and thousands of excellent and auspiciousgifts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॑ धनंज॒यमिन्द्र॑ दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑दारु॒जम् । आ॒दा॒रिणं॒ यथा॒ गय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ dhanam-jayám ǀ índra ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ ā-rujám ǀādāríṇam ǀ yáthā ǀ gáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We know you,Indra, as the conqueror of wealth, the breaker of firm obstacles, the opener, and(guarding from harm) as a house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒कु॒हं चि॑त्त्वा कवे॒ मन्द॑न्तु धृष्ण॒विन्द॑वः । आ त्वा॑ प॒णिं यदीम॑हे
shlokas.transliteration: kakuhám ǀ cit ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ mándantu ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ índavaḥ ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ paṇím ǀ yát ǀ ī́mahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wise (Indra) overcomer of enemies, when we solicit you the barterer, may the drops of the Somaexhilarate you the exalted one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ रे॒वाँ अदा॑शुरिः प्रम॒मर्ष॑ म॒घत्त॑ये । तस्य॑ नो॒ वेद॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ revā́n ǀ ádāśuriḥ ǀ pra-mamárṣa ǀ magháttaye ǀtásya ǀ naḥ ǀ védaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant to us the possessions of that rich man who, through his niggardliness, reviles you as to yourbestowal of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒म उ॑ त्वा॒ वि च॑क्षते॒ सखा॑य इन्द्र सो॒मिन॑: । पु॒ष्टाव॑न्तो॒ यथा॑ प॒शुम्
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ ví ǀ cakṣate ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ indra ǀ somínaḥ ǀpuṣṭá-vantaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ paśúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These friends, effusing theSoma, look on you,Indra, as men with their fodder ready (look) on theircattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वाब॑धिरं व॒यं श्रुत्क॑र्णं॒ सन्त॑मू॒तये॑ । दू॒रादि॒ह ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā ǀ ábadhiram ǀ vayám ǀ śrút-karṇam ǀ sántam ǀ ūtáye ǀdūrā́t ǀ ihá ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you here from afar for our protection, who are never deaf, and whose ears are always opento hear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्छु॑श्रू॒या इ॒मं हवं॑ दु॒र्मर्षं॑ चक्रिया उ॒त । भवे॑रा॒पिर्नो॒ अन्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ śuśruyā́ḥ ǀ imám ǀ hávam ǀ duḥ-márṣam ǀ cakriyāḥ ǀ utá ǀbháveḥ ǀ āpíḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ántamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If you hear this our prayer, then display your invincible power and be our nearest kinsman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि ते॒ अपि॒ व्यथि॑र्जग॒न्वांसो॒ अम॑न्महि । गो॒दा इदि॑न्द्र बोधि नः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ ápi ǀ vyáthiḥ ǀ jaganvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ámanmahi ǀgo-dā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ bodhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whenever, repairing to you in our distress, we offer our praises, attend to us,Indra, as a giver of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ र॒म्भं न जिव्र॑यो रर॒भ्मा श॑वसस्पते । उ॒श्मसि॑ त्वा स॒धस्थ॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ rambhám ǀ ná ǀ jívrayaḥ ǀ rarabhmá ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǀuśmási ǀ tvā ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of might, we lean on you as the aged on a staff; we long for you in the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तो॒त्रमिन्द्रा॑य गायत पुरुनृ॒म्णाय॒ सत्व॑ने । नकि॒र्यं वृ॑ण्व॒ते यु॒धि
shlokas.transliteration: stotrám ǀ índrāya ǀ gāyata ǀ puru-nṛmṇā́ya ǀ sátvane ǀnákiḥ ǀ yám ǀ vṛṇvaté ǀ yudhí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing the praise toIndra, who is rich in wealth and bountiful, whom none can slay in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॑ वृषभा सु॒ते सु॒तं सृ॑जामि पी॒तये॑ । तृ॒म्पा व्य॑श्नुही॒ मद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ suté ǀ sutám ǀ sṛjāmi ǀ pītáye ǀtṛmpá ǀ ví ǀ aśnuhi ǀ mádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theSomais effused, I pour the libation to you, showerer (of blessings), for your drinking; satiateyourself, enjoy the exhilarating draught.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा त्वा॑ मू॒रा अ॑वि॒ष्यवो॒ मोप॒हस्वा॑न॒ आ द॑भन् । माकीं॑ ब्रह्म॒द्विषो॑ वनः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǀ aviṣyávaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ upa-hásvānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dabhan ǀmā́kīm ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ vanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let not fools, seeking protection, nor mockers trouble you; favour not the enemies of the brāhmaṇaṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह त्वा॒ गोप॑रीणसा म॒हे म॑न्दन्तु॒ राध॑से । सरो॑ गौ॒रो यथा॑ पिब
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ tvā ǀ gó-parīṇasā ǀ mahé ǀ mandantu ǀ rā́dhase ǀsáraḥ ǀ gauráḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let (the worships) gladden you here with theSomamixed with milk, for the attainment of great wealth;drink it as the buffalo a lake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या वृ॑त्र॒हा प॑रा॒वति॒ सना॒ नवा॑ च चुच्यु॒वे । ता सं॒सत्सु॒ प्र वो॑चत
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ parā-váti ǀ sánā ǀ návā ǀ ca ǀ cucyuvé ǀtā́ ǀ saṃsát-su ǀ prá ǀ vocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proclaim in our assemblies those perpetual and ever new riches which the slayer ofVṛtrasends fromafar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपि॑बत्क॒द्रुव॑: सु॒तमिन्द्र॑: स॒हस्र॑बाह्वे । अत्रा॑देदिष्ट॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ápibat ǀ kadrúvaḥ ǀ sutám ǀ índraḥ ǀ sahásra-bāhve ǀátra ǀ adediṣṭa ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indradrank theSomaoffering ofKadru, (he smote the enemies) of the thousand-armed; there did hismight shine forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यं तत्तु॒र्वशे॒ यदौ॒ विदा॑नो अह्नवा॒य्यम् । व्या॑नट् तु॒र्वणे॒ शमि॑
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ tát ǀ turváśe ǀ yádau ǀ vídānaḥ ǀ ahnavāyyám ǀví ǀ ānaṭ ǀ turváṇe ǀ śámi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-knowing those (sacrificial) deeds ofTurvaśaandYadu, he overcame Anhavāyya in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒रणिं॑ वो॒ जना॑नां त्र॒दं वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑तः । स॒मा॒नमु॒ प्र शं॑सिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: taráṇim ǀ vaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ tradám ǀ vā́jasya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀsamānám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ śaṃsiṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise our common (Indra), the deliverer of your families, the slayer (of your enemies, the bestower) ofriches in cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भु॒क्षणं॒ न वर्त॑व उ॒क्थेषु॑ तुग्र्या॒वृध॑म् । इन्द्रं॒ सोमे॒ सचा॑ सु॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhukṣáṇam ǀ ná ǀ vártave ǀ ukthéṣu ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dham ǀíndram ǀ sóme ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I praise) in hymns the mightyIndra, the augmenter of waters, for the attainment of wealth, when theSoma is effused with (song).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः कृ॒न्तदिद्वि यो॒न्यं त्रि॒शोका॑य गि॒रिं पृ॒थुम् । गोभ्यो॑ गा॒तुं निरे॑तवे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ kṛntát ǀ ít ǀ ví ǀ yonyám ǀ tri-śókāya ǀ girím ǀ pṛthúm ǀgóbhyaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ níḥ-etave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), who clove forTriśokathe broad womb-like cloud, (and made) a path for the cows to issueforth?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्द॑धि॒षे म॑न॒स्यसि॑ मन्दा॒नः प्रेदिय॑क्षसि । मा तत्क॑रिन्द्र मृ॒ळय॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ dadhiṣé ǀ manasyási ǀ mandānáḥ ǀ prá ǀ ít ǀ íyakṣasi ǀmā́ ǀ tát ǀ kaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever you undertake in your exhilaration, whatever you purpose in your mind or are thinking tobestow-- OIndra, do it not, but bless us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒भ्रं चि॒द्धि त्वाव॑तः कृ॒तं शृ॒ण्वे अधि॒ क्षमि॑ । जिगा॑त्विन्द्र ते॒ मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dabhrám ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ kṛtám ǀ śṛṇvé ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀjígātu ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the least deeds of one like you are renowned in the earth; may your care visit me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवेदु॒ ताः सु॑की॒र्तयोऽस॑न्नु॒त प्रश॑स्तयः । यदि॑न्द्र मृ॒ळया॑सि नः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ su-kīrtáyaḥ ǀ ásan ǀ utá ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀyát ǀ indra ǀ mṛḷáyāsi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yours be those ascriptions of praise, your those hymns, through which,Indra, you bless us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा न॒ एक॑स्मि॒न्नाग॑सि॒ मा द्वयो॑रु॒त त्रि॒षु । वधी॒र्मा शू॑र॒ भूरि॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ékasmin ǀ ā́gasi ǀ mā́ ǀ dváyoḥ ǀ utá ǀ triṣú ǀvádhīḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ śūra ǀ bhū́riṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slay us not for one sin, not for two, not for three; O hero, slay us not for many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बि॒भया॒ हि त्वाव॑त उ॒ग्राद॑भिप्रभ॒ङ्गिण॑: । द॒स्माद॒हमृ॑ती॒षह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bibháya ǀ hí ǀ tvā́-vataḥ ǀ ugrā́t ǀ abhi-prabhaṅgínaḥ ǀdasmā́t ǀ ahám ǀ ṛti-sáhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am afraid of one like you, terrible, the smiter of enemies, the destroyer, who endures hostie attacks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा सख्यु॒: शून॒मा वि॑दे॒ मा पु॒त्रस्य॑ प्रभूवसो । आ॒वृत्व॑द्भूतु ते॒ मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ śū́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ vide ǀ mā́ ǀ putrásya ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀā-vṛ́tvat ǀ bhūtu ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wealthy (Indra), may I never have to tell you of the destitutuion of my friend or my son; may your mindbe favourable towards me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को नु म॑र्या॒ अमि॑थित॒: सखा॒ सखा॑यमब्रवीत् । ज॒हा को अ॒स्मदी॑षते
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ nú ǀ maryāḥ ǀ ámithitaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhāyam ǀ abravīt ǀjahā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ asmát ǀ īṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “"Who, O mortals", said (Indra), "unprovoked, has ever, as a friend, slain his friend? Who fleeth fromme?"”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वारे॑ वृषभा सु॒तेऽसि॑न्व॒न्भूर्या॑वयः । श्व॒घ्नीव॑ नि॒वता॒ चर॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: evā́re ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ suté ǀ ásinvan ǀ bhū́ri ǀ āvayaḥ ǀśvaghnī́-iva ǀ ni-vátā ǀ cáran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showerer (of benefits), when the readySomawas effused, you did devour much, without stint, rushingdown like a gameste.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त॑ ए॒ता व॑चो॒युजा॒ हरी॑ गृभ्णे सु॒मद्र॑था । यदी॑न ब्र॒ह्मभ्य॒ इद्दद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ etā́ ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǀ hárī íti ǀ gṛbhṇe ǀ sumát-rathā ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ brahmá-bhyaḥ ǀ ít ǀ dádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I draw here your two steeds, harnessed to a beauiful chariot and yoked by hymns, since you givewealth to thebrāhmaṇas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भि॒न्धि विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विष॒: परि॒ बाधो॑ ज॒ही मृध॑: । वसु॑ स्पा॒र्हं तदा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: bhindhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ bā́dhaḥ ǀ jahí ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cleave asunder all the hostile hosts, frustrate their destructive attacks, and bestow on us their desirablewealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वी॒ळावि॑न्द्र॒ यत्स्थि॒रे यत्पर्शा॑ने॒ परा॑भृतम् । वसु॑ स्पा॒र्हं तदा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vīḷáu ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ sthiré ǀ yát ǀ párśāne ǀ párā-bhṛtam ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth, which is deosited in strongholds, in fastnesses, and inplaces which can stand an attack.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ ते वि॒श्वमा॑नुषो॒ भूरे॑र्द॒त्तस्य॒ वेद॑ति । वसु॑ स्पा॒र्हं तदा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ viśvá-mānuṣaḥ ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ dattásya ǀ védati ǀvásu ǀ spārhám ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow on us,Indra, that desirable wealth which all men recognize as given abundantly by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाव॑तः पुरूवसो व॒यमि॑न्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि॑ स्थातर्हरीणाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-vataḥ ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ vayám ǀ indra ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀsmási ǀ sthātaḥ ǀ harīṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O wealthyIndra, the leader (of rites), we belong to one like you, ruler of horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां हि स॒त्यम॑द्रिवो वि॒द्म दा॒तार॑मि॒षाम् । वि॒द्म दा॒तारं॑ रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ hí ǀ satyám ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ vidmá ǀ dātā́ram ǀ iṣā́m ǀvidmá ǀ dātā́ram ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, thunderer, we verily know to be giver of food, you we know to be the give of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्य॑ ते महि॒मानं॒ शत॑मूते॒ शत॑क्रतो । गी॒र्भिर्गृ॒णन्ति॑ का॒रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ śátam-ūte ǀ śátakrato íti śáta-krato ǀgīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ kārávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OŚatakratu, wielding a hundred protections, whose greatness the worshippers praise with theirhymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒नी॒थो घा॒ स मर्त्यो॒ यं म॒रुतो॒ यम॑र्य॒मा । मि॒त्रः पान्त्य॒द्रुह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-nītháḥ ǀ gha ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ yám ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yám ǀ aryamā́ ǀmitráḥ ǀ pā́nti ǀ adrúhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fortunate in sacrifice is that mortal whom the guilelessMaruts, whomAryamanandMitra, protect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दधा॑नो॒ गोम॒दश्व॑वत्सु॒वीर्य॑मादि॒त्यजू॑त एधते । सदा॑ रा॒या पु॑रु॒स्पृहा॑
shlokas.transliteration: dádhānaḥ ǀ gó-mat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ ādityá-jūtaḥ ǀ edhate ǀsádā ǀ rāyā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́hā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is directed byĀdityaever increases, possessing abundance of kine and horses and vigorouschildren; he increases in wealth longed for by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं॒ दान॑मीमहे शवसा॒नमभी॑र्वम् । ईशा॑नं रा॒य ई॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ índram ǀ dā́nam ǀ īmahe ǀ śavasānám ǀ ábhīrvam ǀī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit a gift from thisIndra, the displayer of might, the fearless; we solicit wealth from the lord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मि॒न्हि सन्त्यू॒तयो॒ विश्वा॒ अभी॑रव॒: सचा॑ । तमा व॑हन्तु॒ सप्त॑यः पुरू॒वसुं॒ मदा॑य॒ हर॑यः सु॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tásmin ǀ hí ǀ sánti ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ábhīravaḥ ǀ sácā ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ vahantu ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ puru-vásum ǀ mádāya ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ sutám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In him abide united all secure protections; lord of vast wealth, may his gliding steeds bear him to theexpressedSomafor his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ मदो॒ वरे॑ण्यो॒ य इ॑न्द्र वृत्र॒हन्त॑मः । य आ॑द॒दिः स्व१॒॑र्नृभि॒र्यः पृत॑नासु दु॒ष्टर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-dadíḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ dustáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That exhilaration of your,Indra, which is pre-eminent, which utterly desroys your enemies, which winswealth from men, and is invincible in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो दु॒ष्टरो॑ विश्ववार श्र॒वाय्यो॒ वाजे॒ष्वस्ति॑ तरु॒ता । स न॑: शविष्ठ॒ सव॒ना व॑सो गहि ग॒मेम॒ गोम॑ति व्र॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dustáraḥ ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ śravā́yyaḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ ásti ǀ tarutā́ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǀ gaméma ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Which is invincibel in contests -- O you desired by all-- well-worthy of praise and the deliverer (fromenemies); come to our oblations, most mighty one, giver of dwellings; may we obtain a stall full of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒व्यो षु णो॒ यथा॑ पु॒राश्व॒योत र॑थ॒या । व॒रि॒व॒स्य म॑हामह
shlokas.transliteration: gavyó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ purā́ ǀ aśva-yā́ ǀ utá ǀ ratha-yā́ ǀvarivasyá ǀ mahā-maha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of wealth, visit us as of old, go give us cows, horses and chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ते॑ शूर॒ राध॒सोऽन्तं॑ वि॒न्दामि॑ स॒त्रा । द॒श॒स्या नो॑ मघव॒न्नू चि॑दद्रिवो॒ धियो॒ वाजे॑भिराविथ
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ ántam ǀ vindā́mi ǀ satrā́ ǀdaśasyá ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ nú ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ āvitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, hero, I find no limit to your wealth; OMaghavan, the thunderer, bestow (your gifts) quickly uponus, and bless our offerings with (abundant) food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒ष्वः श्रा॑व॒यत्स॑खा॒ विश्वेत्स वे॑द॒ जनि॑मा पुरुष्टु॒तः । तं विश्वे॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गेन्द्रं॑ हवन्ते तवि॒षं य॒तस्रु॑चः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ śravayát-sakhā ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ jánima ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀtám ǀ víśve ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀ índram ǀ havante ǀ taviṣám ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gracefulIndra, whose friends extol him, knows, praised of many, all births; him, the mighty, all meninvoke at all times, seizing the ladles (for oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ वाजे॑ष्ववि॒ता पु॑रू॒वसु॑: पुरस्था॒ता म॒घवा॑ वृत्र॒हा भु॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ avitā́ ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ puraḥ-sthātā́ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ bhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayMaghavan, the wealthy, the slayer ofVṛtra, stand before us as our defender in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वो॑ वी॒रमन्ध॑सो॒ मदे॑षु गाय गि॒रा म॒हा विचे॑तसम् । इन्द्रं॒ नाम॒ श्रुत्यं॑ शा॒किनं॒ वचो॒ यथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vaḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ gāya ǀ girā́ ǀ mahā́ ǀ ví-cetasam ǀíndram ǀ nā́ma ǀ śrútyam ǀ śākínam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ yáthā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the time of the exhilaration of theSoma, sing, according to your hymns, with a loud voice, you wiseheroIndra, the humbler of enemies, the strong, the ever-worthy to be praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒दी रेक्ण॑स्त॒न्वे॑ द॒दिर्वसु॑ द॒दिर्वाजे॑षु पुरुहूत वा॒जिन॑म् । नू॒नमथ॑
shlokas.transliteration: dadíḥ ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ tanvé ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vásu ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vājínam ǀnūnám ǀ átha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), invoked by many, speedily give me wealth; give riches, give abundance of food in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑षामिर॒ज्यन्तं॒ वसू॑नां सास॒ह्वांसं॑ चिद॒स्य वर्प॑सः । कृ॒प॒य॒तो नू॒नमत्यथ॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ irajyántam ǀ vásūnām ǀ sasahvā́ṃsam ǀ cit ǀ asyá ǀ várpasaḥ ǀkṛpa-yatáḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ áti ǀ átha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We praise you), the lord of all riches, the subduer of this obstructor waging (attacks), -- speedily giveus abundant (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हः सु वो॒ अर॑मिषे॒ स्तवा॑महे मी॒ळ्हुषे॑ अरंग॒माय॒ जग्म॑ये । य॒ज्ञेभि॑र्गी॒र्भिर्वि॒श्वम॑नुषां म॒रुता॑मियक्षसि॒ गाये॑ त्वा॒ नम॑सा गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ sú ǀ vaḥ ǀ áram ǀ iṣe ǀ stávāmahe ǀ mīḷhúṣe ǀ aram-gamā́ya ǀ jágmaye ǀyajñébhiḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ viśvá-manuṣām ǀ marútām ǀ iyakṣasi ǀ gā́ye ǀ tvā ǀ námasā ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I desire the coming of you, the mighty one, we give praise with oblations and ymns to the showerer whohastens readily (to the sacrifice), associated with theMaruts, you are worshipped of all men; I glorify you withadoration and praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये पा॒तय॑न्ते॒ अज्म॑भिर्गिरी॒णां स्नुभि॑रेषाम् । य॒ज्ञं म॑हि॒ष्वणी॑नां सु॒म्नं तु॑वि॒ष्वणी॑नां॒ प्राध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ pātáyante ǀ ájma-bhiḥ ǀ girīṇā́m ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ eṣām ǀyajñám ǀ mahi-svánīnām ǀ sumnám ǀ tuvi-svánīnām ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We present) the oblation to those loud-sounding (Maruts) who rush along with the streaming trains ofthe clouds; may we obtain in the sacrifice the happiness which those deep-roarers bestow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒भ॒ङ्गं दु॑र्मती॒नामिन्द्र॑ शवि॒ष्ठा भ॑र । र॒यिम॒स्मभ्यं॒ युज्यं॑ चोदयन्मते॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ चोदयन्मते
shlokas.transliteration: pra-bhaṅgám ǀ duḥ-matīnā́m ǀ índra ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀrayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ yújyam ǀ codayat-mate ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ codayat-mate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We worship) the crusher of the malevolent, most powerfulIndra, bring to us suitable wealth, Oinspirer-- (bring) most excellent( wealth), O inspirer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सनि॑त॒: सुस॑नित॒रुग्र॒ चित्र॒ चेति॑ष्ठ॒ सूनृ॑त । प्रा॒सहा॑ सम्रा॒ट् सहु॑रिं॒ सह॑न्तं भु॒ज्युं वाजे॑षु॒ पूर्व्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sánitaríti ǀ sú-sanitaḥ ǀ úgra ǀ cítra ǀ cétiṣṭha ǀ sū́nṛta ǀpra-sáhā ǀ sam-rāṭ ǀ sáhurim ǀ sáhantam ǀ bhujyúm ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ pū́rvyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O bountiful, mos bountiful, mighty, wondeful, best giver of knowledge and supremely truthful, by yourprowess, universal ruler, (bring to us) in conflicts ample wealth, overpowering those who attack us, and causingenjoyment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स ए॑तु॒ य ईव॒दाँ अदे॑वः पू॒र्तमा॑द॒दे । यथा॑ चि॒द्वशो॑ अ॒श्व्यः पृ॑थु॒श्रव॑सि कानी॒ते॒३॒॑ऽस्या व्युष्या॑द॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ etu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ī́vat ǀ ā́ ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ pūrtám ǀ ā-dadé ǀyáthā ǀ cit ǀ váśaḥ ǀ aśvyáḥ ǀ pṛthu-śrávasi ǀ kā́nīté ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ vi-úṣi ǀ ā-dadé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let him draw near, who, though not a god, would receive this complete living gift-- sinceVaśa, the sonofAśva, receives it at the dawn of this (morning) at thehandsofPṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ष॒ष्टिं स॒हस्राश्व्य॑स्या॒युता॑सन॒मुष्ट्रा॑नां विंश॒तिं श॒ता । दश॒ श्यावी॑नां श॒ता दश॒ त्र्य॑रुषीणां॒ दश॒ गवां॑ स॒हस्रा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ áśvyasya ǀ ayútā ǀ asanam ǀ úṣṭrānām ǀ viṃśatím ǀ śatā́ ǀdáśa ǀ śyā́vīnām ǀ śatā́ ǀ dáśa ǀ trí-aruṣīṇām ǀ dáśa ǀ gávām ǀ sahásrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have received sixty thousand horses, and ens of housands-- a score of hundreds of camels-- athousand brown mares-- and ten times ten thousand cows with three red patches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॑ श्या॒वा ऋ॒धद्र॑यो वी॒तवा॑रास आ॒शव॑: । म॒थ्रा ने॒मिं नि वा॑वृतुः
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ śyāvā́ḥ ǀ ṛdhát-rayaḥ ǀ vītá-vārāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀmathrā́ḥ ǀ nemím ǀ ní ǀ vavṛtuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ten brown horses bear along the wheel (of my chariot), of mature vigour, of complete power, andtrampling down obstacles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दाना॑सः पृथु॒श्रव॑सः कानी॒तस्य॑ सु॒राध॑सः । रथं॑ हिर॒ण्ययं॒ दद॒न्मंहि॑ष्ठः सू॒रिर॑भू॒द्वर्षि॑ष्ठमकृत॒ श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dā́nāsaḥ ǀ pṛthu-śrávasaḥ ǀ kānītásya ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǀrátham ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ dádat ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ abhūt ǀ várṣiṣṭham ǀ akṛta ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These arehtje gifts of the wealthyPṛthuśravas, the son of Kānīta; he, bestowing a golden chariot,has proved himself most liberal and wise, he has won most abundant fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ वायो म॒हे तने॑ या॒हि म॒खाय॒ पाज॑से । व॒यं हि ते॑ चकृ॒मा भूरि॑ दा॒वने॑ स॒द्यश्चि॒न्महि॑ दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vāyo íti ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ yāhí ǀ makhā́ya ǀ pā́jase ǀvayám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ cakṛmá ǀ bhū́ri ǀ dāváne ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ cit ǀ máhi ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Vāyu, to bestow great wealth and glorious strength; we have offered (libations) to you thegiver of abundant (wealth), we have offered immediately to you the giver of great (gifts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अश्वे॑भि॒र्वह॑ते॒ वस्त॑ उ॒स्रास्त्रिः स॒प्त स॑प्तती॒नाम् । ए॒भिः सोमे॑भिः सोम॒सुद्भि॑: सोमपा दा॒नाय॑ शुक्रपूतपाः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ áśvebhiḥ ǀ váhate ǀ váste ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ saptatīnā́m ǀebhíḥ ǀ sómebhiḥ ǀ somasút-bhiḥ ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ śukrapūta-pāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is borne on horses and surrounds himself with thrice seven times seventy cows-- he comes toyou with theseSoma-libations and Soma-priests, to offer to you, drinker of the Soma, drinker of the bright pureSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो म॑ इ॒मं चि॑दु॒ त्मनाम॑न्दच्चि॒त्रं दा॒वने॑ । अ॒र॒ट्वे अक्षे॒ नहु॑षे सु॒कृत्व॑नि सु॒कृत्त॑राय सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ me ǀ imám ǀ cit ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tmánā ǀ ámandat ǀ citrám ǀ dāváne ǀaraṭvé ǀ ákṣe ǀ náhuṣe ǀ su-kṛ́tvani ǀ sukṛ́t-tarāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who of his own will has been plural ased to give me this honoured gift, he, performer of good works,(has determined) on a pre-eminently good action, amid Aratva,Nahuṣaand Sukṛtvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च॒थ्ये॒३॒॑ वपु॑षि॒ यः स्व॒राळु॒त वा॑यो घृत॒स्नाः । अश्वे॑षितं॒ रजे॑षितं॒ शुने॑षितं॒ प्राज्म॒ तदि॒दं नु तत्
shlokas.transliteration: ucathyé ǀ vápuṣi ǀ yáḥ ǀ sva-rā́ṭ ǀ utá ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ghṛta-snā́ḥ ǀáśva-iṣitam ǀ rájaḥ-iṣitam ǀ śúnā-iṣitam ǀ prá ǀ ájma ǀ tát ǀ idám ǀ nú ǀ tát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is self-resplendent in his glorious body, who is bright, OVāyu, like ghī, has given me thisfood, brought by horses, brought by camels, brought by dogs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ प्रि॒यमि॑षि॒राय॑ ष॒ष्टिं स॒हस्रा॑सनम् । अश्वा॑ना॒मिन्न वृष्णा॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ priyám ǀ iṣirā́ya ǀ ṣaṣṭím ǀ sahásrā ǀ asanam ǀáśvānām ǀ ít ǀ ná ǀ vṛ́ṣṇām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have now received (a gift) dear to the beneficent king, sixty thousand bulls vigorous like horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गावो॒ न यू॒थमुप॑ यन्ति॒ वध्र॑य॒ उप॒ मा य॑न्ति॒ वध्र॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yūthám ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ vádhrayaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ mā ǀ ā́ ǀ yanti ǀ vádhrayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the cows to the herd, so repair the oxen; so the oxen repair to me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ यच्चार॑थे ग॒णे श॒तमुष्ट्राँ॒ अचि॑क्रदत् । अध॒ श्वित्ने॑षु विंश॒तिं श॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ yát ǀ cā́rathe ǀ gaṇé ǀ śatám ǀ úṣṭrān ǀ ácikradat ǀádha ǀ śvítneṣu ǀ viṃśatím ǀ śatā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, when the herd were wandering (to the wood), he called a hundred camels (to give them to me),and two thousand from among the white herds (of cows).”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं दा॒से ब॑ल्बू॒थे विप्र॒स्तरु॑क्ष॒ आ द॑दे । ते ते॑ वायवि॒मे जना॒ मद॒न्तीन्द्र॑गोपा॒ मद॑न्ति दे॒वगो॑पाः
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ dāsé ǀ balbūthé ǀ vípraḥ ǀ tárukṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀté ǀ te ǀ vāyo íti ǀ imé ǀ jánāḥ ǀ mádanti ǀ índra-gopāḥ ǀ mádanti ǀ devá-gopāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I, the sage, accep the hundred from the slaveBalbūtha, the cowherd; we here are your, OVāyu-those who haveIndraand the gods for protectors rejoice (through your favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ स्या योष॑णा म॒ही प्र॑ती॒ची वश॑म॒श्व्यम् । अधि॑रुक्मा॒ वि नी॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ syā́ ǀ yóṣaṇā ǀ mahī́ ǀ pratīcī́ ǀ váśam ǀ aśvyám ǀádhi-rukmā ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This tall maiden, adorned with gold, is led towards me,Vaśa, the son ofAśva.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑ वो मह॒तामवो॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॑ दा॒शुषे॑ । यमा॑दित्या अ॒भि द्रु॒हो रक्ष॑था॒ नेम॒घं न॑शदने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ dāśúṣe ǀyám ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ druháḥ ǀ rákṣatha ǀ ná ǀ īm ǀ aghám ǀ naśat ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, you are great, and great is your protection to the offerer; no evil,Ādityas, harmshim whom you guard from the injurer; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒दा दे॑वा अ॒घाना॒मादि॑त्यासो अ॒पाकृ॑तिम् । प॒क्षा वयो॒ यथो॒परि॒ व्य१॒॑स्मे शर्म॑ यच्छताने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vidá ǀ devāḥ ǀ aghā́nām ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ apa-ā́kṛtim ǀpakṣā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ upári ǀ ví ǀ asmé íti ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineĀdityas, you know the averting of evils; as birds (spread) their wings over (their) young, grantus happiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य१॒॑स्मे अधि॒ शर्म॒ तत्प॒क्षा वयो॒ न य॑न्तन । विश्वा॑नि विश्ववेदसो वरू॒थ्या॑ मनामहेऽने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ asmé íti ǀ ádhi ǀ śárma ǀ tát ǀ pakṣā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yantana ǀvíśvāni ǀ viśva-vedasaḥ ǀ varūthyā́ ǀ manāmahe ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us that happiness of yours, as birds (spread) their wings; O you possessed of all wealth, wesolicit all riches suitable for our dwelling; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॒ अरा॑सत॒ क्षयं॑ जी॒वातुं॑ च॒ प्रचे॑तसः । मनो॒र्विश्व॑स्य॒ घेदि॒म आ॑दि॒त्या रा॒य ई॑शतेऽने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ árāsata ǀ kṣáyam ǀ jīvā́tum ǀ ca ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀmánoḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ imé ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īśate ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whomsoever these wiseĀdityasgran a dwelling and the means of life, (for him) they master thewealth of every man; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णो वृणजन्न॒घा दु॒र्गाणि॑ र॒थ्यो॑ यथा । स्यामेदिन्द्र॑स्य॒ शर्म॑ण्यादि॒त्याना॑मु॒ताव॑स्यने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṇajan ǀ aghā́ ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ yathā ǀsyā́ma ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ śármaṇi ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ utá ǀ ávasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our sins avoid us as charioteers inaccessible plural ce; may we abide inIndra's happiness and in theprotection of the Ādiyas; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रि॒ह्वृ॒तेद॒ना जनो॑ यु॒ष्माद॑त्तस्य वायति । देवा॒ अद॑भ्रमाश वो॒ यमा॑दित्या॒ अहे॑तनाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pari-hvṛtā́ ǀ ít ǀ anā́ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ yuṣmā́-dattasya ǀ vāyati ǀdévāḥ ǀ ádabhram ǀ āśa ǀ vaḥ ǀ yám ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ áhetana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Only by painful means does a living man obtain the wealth which you bestow; but he whom you, divineĀdityas, visit, wins great (riches); your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तं ति॒ग्मं च॒न त्यजो॒ न द्रा॑सद॒भि तं गु॒रु । यस्मा॑ उ॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॒ आदि॑त्यासो॒ अरा॑ध्वमने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ tigmám ǀ caná ǀ tyájaḥ ǀ ná ǀ drāsat ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ gurú ǀyásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ árādhvam ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him fierce wrath touches not, nor heavy (calamity), to whom,Ādityas, you have given greathappiness; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ष्मे दे॑वा॒ अपि॑ ष्मसि॒ युध्य॑न्त इव॒ वर्म॑सु । यू॒यं म॒हो न॒ एन॑सो यू॒यमर्भा॑दुरुष्यताने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuṣmé íti ǀ devāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀ yúdhyantaḥ-iva ǀ várma-su ǀyūyám ǀ maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ énasaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ árbhāt ǀ uruṣyata ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deities, may we abide in you as warriors in their armour; do you defend us from great evil, do youdefend us from litt;e your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदि॑तिर्न उरुष्य॒त्वदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतु । मा॒ता मि॒त्रस्य॑ रे॒वतो॑ऽर्य॒म्णो वरु॑णस्य चाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áditiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatu ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀmātā́ ǀ mitrásya ǀ revátaḥ ǀ aryamṇáḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ ca ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAditidefend us, may Aditi grant us happiness, the mother of the wealthyMitra,AryamaandVaruṇa; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्दे॑वा॒: शर्म॑ शर॒णं यद्भ॒द्रं यद॑नातु॒रम् । त्रि॒धातु॒ यद्व॑रू॒थ्यं१॒॑ तद॒स्मासु॒ वि य॑न्तनाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ devāḥ ǀ śárma ǀ śaraṇám ǀ yát ǀ bhadrám ǀ yát ǀ anāturám ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ yát ǀ varūthyám ǀ tát ǀ asmā́su ǀ ví ǀ yantana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant to us, deities, that happiness which is a refuge, auspicious, and free from sickness, which isthreefold and fit for a (secure) shelter; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदि॑त्या॒ अव॒ हि ख्यताधि॒ कूला॑दिव॒ स्पश॑: । सु॒ती॒र्थमर्व॑तो य॒थानु॑ नो नेषथा सु॒गम॑ने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́dityāḥ ǀ áva ǀ hí ǀ khyáta ǀ ádhi ǀ kū́lāt-iva ǀ spáśaḥ ǀsu-tīrthám ǀ árvataḥ ǀ yathā ǀ ánu ǀ naḥ ǀ neṣatha ǀ su-gám ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, look down upon us as those who look from the shore; as (men lead) their horses to a secureGhāṭa, so conduct us along a good path; your aids are void of harm, your aids are void of harm, your aids aretrue aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नेह भ॒द्रं र॑क्ष॒स्विने॒ नाव॒यै नोप॒या उ॒त । गवे॑ च भ॒द्रं धे॒नवे॑ वी॒राय॑ च श्रवस्य॒ते॑ऽने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ihá ǀ bhadrám ǀ rakṣasvíne ǀ ná ǀ ava-yái ǀ ná ǀ upa-yái ǀ utá ǀgáve ǀ ca ǀ bhadrám ǀ dhenáve ǀ vīrā́ya ǀ ca ǀ śravasyaté ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let there not be prosperit here to our powerul (foe), nor to him who threaten or assails us; but let therebe prosperity to our cattle, our kine, and ourmaleoffspring desirous of food; your aids are void of harm, your aidsare true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदा॒विर्यद॑पी॒च्यं१॒॑ देवा॑सो॒ अस्ति॑ दुष्कृ॒तम् । त्रि॒ते तद्विश्व॑मा॒प्त्य आ॒रे अ॒स्मद्द॑धातनाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ āvíḥ ǀ yát ǀ apīcyám ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ duḥ-kṛtám ǀtrité ǀ tát ǀ víśvam ǀ āptyé ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ dadhātana ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deities, whatever evil is manifest, whatever is concealed, (let it be not found) inTritaĀptya, keep it farfrom us; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्च॒ गोषु॑ दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्यं॒ यच्चा॒स्मे दु॑हितर्दिवः । त्रि॒ताय॒ तद्वि॑भावर्या॒प्त्याय॒ परा॑ वहाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ca ǀ góṣu ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ asmé íti ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀtritā́ya ǀ tát ǀ vibhā-vari ǀ āptyā́ya ǀ párā ǀ vaha ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, (Uṣas), whatever ill-omened dream threatens our cattle, keep it, O brilliant one,far fromTritaĀptya; y our aids are void of harm, your aids, are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒ष्कं वा॑ घा कृ॒णव॑ते॒ स्रजं॑ वा दुहितर्दिवः । त्रि॒ते दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्यं॒ सर्व॑मा॒प्त्ये परि॑ दद्मस्यने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: niṣkám ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ kṛṇávate ǀ srájam ǀ vā ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀtrité ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ sárvam ǀ āptyé ǀ pári ǀ dadmasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Daughter of heaven, whatever ill-omened dream threatensTritaĀptya, we transfer it to the worker ofgold ornaments or to the maker of garlands; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॑न्नाय॒ तद॑पसे॒ तं भा॒गमु॑पसे॒दुषे॑ । त्रि॒ताय॑ च द्वि॒ताय॒ चोषो॑ दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्यं॑ वहाने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát-annāya ǀ tát-apase ǀ tám ǀ bhāgám ǀ upa-sedúṣe ǀtritā́ya ǀ ca ǀ dvitā́ya ǀ ca ǀ úṣaḥ ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ vaha ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uṣas, bear (elsewhere) the ill-omened dream forTritaandDvita, who eat and do (in dreams) that(which is eaten and done amiss when awake) and who obtain that (inauspicious) portion; your aids are void ofharm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ क॒लां यथा॑ श॒फं यथ॑ ऋ॒णं सं॒नया॑मसि । ए॒वा दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्यं॒ सर्व॑मा॒प्त्ये सं न॑यामस्यने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ kalā́m ǀ yáthā ǀ śaphám ǀ yáthā ǀ ṛṇám ǀ sam-náyāmasi ǀevá ǀ duḥ-svápnyam ǀ sárvam ǀ āptyé ǀ sám ǀ nayāmasi ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As (in the sacrifice) we put severally together the proper parts and the hoofs, and as we discharge adebt, so we transfer all the ill-omened dream that rests on Āptya; your aids are void of harm, your aids are trueaids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजै॑ष्मा॒द्यास॑नाम॒ चाभू॒माना॑गसो व॒यम् । उषो॒ यस्मा॑द्दु॒ष्ष्वप्न्या॒दभै॒ष्माप॒ तदु॑च्छत्वने॒हसो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑: सु॒तयो॑ व ऊ॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ájaiṣma ǀ adyá ǀ ásanāma ǀ ca ǀ ábhūma ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ vayám ǀúṣaḥ ǀ yásmāt ǀ duḥ-svápnyāt ǀ ábhaiṣma ǀ ápa ǀ tát ǀ ucchatu ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀ su-ūtáyaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be today victorious, and obtain (happiness); may we be free from evil; Uṣas, may that ill dreamdepart, of which we were afraid; your aids are void of harm, your aids are true aids.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दोर॑भक्षि॒ वय॑सः सुमे॒धाः स्वा॒ध्यो॑ वरिवो॒वित्त॑रस्य । विश्वे॒ यं दे॒वा उ॒त मर्त्या॑सो॒ मधु॑ ब्रु॒वन्तो॑ अ॒भि सं॒चर॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: svādóḥ ǀ abhakṣi ǀ váyasaḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ varivovít-tarasya ǀvíśve ǀ yám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ bruvántaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sam-cáranti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I, the wise and devout, enjoy the delicious, abundantly honouredSomafood, which all gods andmortals, pronouncing sweet, seek to obtain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्तश्च॒ प्रागा॒ अदि॑तिर्भवास्यवया॒ता हर॑सो॒ दैव्य॑स्य । इन्द॒विन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यं जु॑षा॒णः श्रौष्टी॑व॒ धुर॒मनु॑ रा॒य ऋ॑ध्याः
shlokas.transliteration: antáríti ǀ ca ǀ prá ǀ ágāḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bhavāsi ǀ ava-yātā́ ǀ hárasaḥ ǀ dáivyasya ǀíndo íti ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ śráuṣṭī-iva ǀ dhúram ǀ ánu ǀ rāyé ǀ ṛdhyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You enter within, and unimpaired, you avert the anger of the gods;Soma, enjoying the friendship ofIndra, may you bring us to wealth as a swift (horse) its burden.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॑म॒ सोम॑म॒मृता॑ अभू॒माग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॒रवि॑दाम दे॒वान् । किं नू॒नम॒स्मान्कृ॑णव॒दरा॑ति॒: किमु॑ धू॒र्तिर॑मृत॒ मर्त्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: ápāma ǀ sómam ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ abhūma ǀ áganma ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ávidāma ǀ devā́n ǀkím ǀ nūnám ǀ asmā́n ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ árātiḥ ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dhūrtíḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ mártyasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We drink theSoma, may we become immortal; we have attained the light of (heaven), we have knownthe gods; what now could the enemy do to us, or what, O immortal, should the aggriever do to the mortal?”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ भव हृ॒द आ पी॒त इ॑न्दो पि॒तेव॑ सोम सू॒नवे॑ सु॒शेव॑: । सखे॑व॒ सख्य॑ उरुशंस॒ धीर॒: प्र ण॒ आयु॑र्जी॒वसे॑ सोम तारीः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ bhava ǀ hṛdé ǀ ā́ ǀ pītáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ soma ǀ sūnáve ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ uru-śaṃsa ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ soma ǀ tārīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Osoma, drunk by us, be bliss to our hearts, as a father is indulgent to a son or a friend to a friend; OSoma, worthy of wide praise, do you, wise one, extend our years that we may live.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे मा॑ पी॒ता य॒शस॑ उरु॒ष्यवो॒ रथं॒ न गाव॒: सम॑नाह॒ पर्व॑सु । ते मा॑ रक्षन्तु वि॒स्रस॑श्च॒रित्रा॑दु॒त मा॒ स्रामा॑द्यवय॒न्त्विन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ mā ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ uruṣyávaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ sám ǀ anāha ǀ párva-su ǀté ǀ mā ǀ rakṣantu ǀ vi-srásaḥ ǀ carítrāt ǀ utá ǀ mā ǀ srā́māt ǀ yavayantu ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these glory-conferring protectingSoma-streams knit together my joints as cows draw together achariot falling in pieces; may they keep us from a loosely-knit worship; may they deliver me from sickness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं न मा॑ मथि॒तं सं दि॑दीप॒: प्र च॑क्षय कृणु॒हि वस्य॑सो नः । अथा॒ हि ते॒ मद॒ आ सो॑म॒ मन्ये॑ रे॒वाँ इ॑व॒ प्र च॑रा पु॒ष्टिमच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ ná ǀ mā ǀ mathitám ǀ sám ǀ didīpaḥ ǀ prá ǀ cakṣaya ǀ kṛṇuhí ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀátha ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ máde ǀ ā́ ǀ soma ǀ mánye ǀ revā́n-iva ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ puṣṭím ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, kindle me like the fire ignited by attrition, brighten (our eyes) and make us rich; I praise you nowfor exhilaration; come now, full of wealth, to nourish us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒षि॒रेण॑ ते॒ मन॑सा सु॒तस्य॑ भक्षी॒महि॒ पित्र्य॑स्येव रा॒यः । सोम॑ राज॒न्प्र ण॒ आयूं॑षि तारी॒रहा॑नीव॒ सूर्यो॑ वास॒राणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: iṣiréṇa ǀ te ǀ mánasā ǀ sutásya ǀ bhakṣīmáhi ǀ pítryasya-iva ǀ rāyáḥ ǀsóma ǀ rājan ǀ prá ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ tārīḥ ǀ áhāni-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ vāsarā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we partake of you, effused, with a longing mind as (men enjoy) paternal wealth; KingSoma,prolong our lives, as the sun the world-establishing day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑ राजन्मृ॒ळया॑ नः स्व॒स्ति तव॑ स्मसि व्र॒त्या॒३॒॑स्तस्य॑ विद्धि । अल॑र्ति॒ दक्ष॑ उ॒त म॒न्युरि॑न्दो॒ मा नो॑ अ॒र्यो अ॑नुका॒मं परा॑ दाः
shlokas.transliteration: sóma ǀ rājan ǀ mṛḷáya ǀ naḥ ǀ svastí ǀ táva ǀ smasi ǀ vratyā́ḥ ǀ tásya ǀ viddhi ǀálarti ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ utá ǀ manyúḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ anu-kāmám ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “KingSoma, bless us for our welfare; we worshippers are yours, do you recognize it; the enemy goesstrong and fierce, O Soma; give us not over to him as he desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि न॑स्त॒न्व॑: सोम गो॒पा गात्रे॑गात्रे निष॒सत्था॑ नृ॒चक्षा॑: । यत्ते॑ व॒यं प्र॑मि॒नाम॑ व्र॒तानि॒ स नो॑ मृळ सुष॒खा दे॑व॒ वस्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ soma ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ gā́tre-gātre ǀ ni-sasáttha ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀyát ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ pra-minā́ma ǀ vratā́ni ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷa ǀ su-sakhā́ ǀ deva ǀ vásyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OSoma, you are the guardian of our bodies, you dwell in each limb as the beholder of man; though weimpair your rites, yet, divine one, bless us, you who are possessed of most excellent food and good friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒दू॒दरे॑ण॒ सख्या॑ सचेय॒ यो मा॒ न रिष्ये॑द्धर्यश्व पी॒तः । अ॒यं यः सोमो॒ न्यधा॑य्य॒स्मे तस्मा॒ इन्द्रं॑ प्र॒तिर॑मे॒म्यायु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛdūdáreṇa ǀ sákhyā ǀ saceya ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ ná ǀ ríṣyet ǀ hari-aśva ǀ pītáḥ ǀayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ní ǀ ádhāyi ǀ asmé íti ǀ tásmai ǀ índram ǀ pra-tíram ǀ emi ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I obtain a wholesome friend who, when quaffed, will not harm me, O lord of bay horses; I ask ofIndra a long permanence for thisSomawhich has been plural ced within us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ त्या अ॑स्थु॒रनि॑रा॒ अमी॑वा॒ निर॑त्रस॒न्तमि॑षीची॒रभै॑षुः । आ सोमो॑ अ॒स्माँ अ॑रुह॒द्विहा॑या॒ अग॑न्म॒ यत्र॑ प्रति॒रन्त॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ ánirāḥ ǀ ámīvāḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ atrasan ǀ támiṣīcīḥ ǀ ábhaiṣuḥ ǀā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ aruhat ǀ ví-hāyāḥ ǀ áganma ǀ yátra ǀ pra-tiránte ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those irremovable sicknesses depart; let those strong (pains) which have made us tremble, beafraid; the mightySomahas climbed into us, we have attained that (draught) by which men prolong life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॒ इन्दु॑: पितरो हृ॒त्सु पी॒तोऽम॑र्त्यो॒ मर्त्याँ॑ आवि॒वेश॑ । तस्मै॒ सोमा॑य ह॒विषा॑ विधेम मृळी॒के अ॑स्य सुम॒तौ स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ pītáḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ mártyān ǀ ā-vivéśa ǀtásmai ǀ sómāya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǀ mṛḷīké ǀ asya ǀ su-matáu ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatSomawhich, drunk into our hearts, has entered, immortal, into us mortals-- to him, fathers, let usdo worship with oblations; may we abide in his bliss and favour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म पि॒तृभि॑: संविदा॒नोऽनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तन्थ । तस्मै॑ त इन्दो ह॒विषा॑ विधेम व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sam-vidānáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ tatantha ǀtásmai ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, you in conjunction with the fathers do stretch our successively heaven and earth-- to you let usdo worship with oblations, may we be lords of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्राता॑रो देवा॒ अधि॑ वोचता नो॒ मा नो॑ नि॒द्रा ई॑शत॒ मोत जल्पि॑: । व॒यं सोम॑स्य वि॒श्वह॑ प्रि॒यास॑: सु॒वीरा॑सो वि॒दथ॒मा व॑देम
shlokas.transliteration: trā́tāraḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ naḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ni-drā́ ǀ īśata ǀ mā́ ǀ utá ǀ jálpiḥ ǀvayám ǀ sómasya ǀ viśváha ǀ priyā́saḥ ǀ su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vidátham ǀ ā́ ǀ vadema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Guardian gods, speak favourably to us; let no dreams nor the censurer overpower us; may we be everdear toSoma; possessed of brave offspring, may we utter our hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: सोम वि॒श्वतो॑ वयो॒धास्त्वं स्व॒र्विदा वि॑शा नृ॒चक्षा॑: । त्वं न॑ इन्द ऊ॒तिभि॑: स॒जोषा॑: पा॒हि प॒श्चाता॑दु॒त वा॑ पु॒रस्ता॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ tvám ǀ svaḥ-vít ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ purástāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, give us food from every side; you are the bestower of heaven; enter us, beholder of men; OSoma, rejoicing with your protecting powers, guard us from behind and before.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्र व॑: सु॒राध॑स॒मिन्द्र॑मर्च॒ यथा॑ वि॒दे । यो ज॑रि॒तृभ्यो॑ म॒घवा॑ पुरू॒वसु॑: स॒हस्रे॑णेव॒ शिक्ष॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ su-rā́dhasam ǀ índram ǀ arca ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǀyáḥ ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ sahásreṇa-iva ǀ śíkṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I would praise to you the bounteousIndraas is fit, the wealth- aboundingMaghavan, who loves to helpwith thousandfold treasure those who praise him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तानी॑केव॒ प्र जि॑गाति धृष्णु॒या हन्ति॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ दा॒शुषे॑ । गि॒रेरि॑व॒ प्र रसा॑ अस्य पिन्विरे॒ दत्रा॑णि पुरु॒भोज॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: śatā́nīkā-iva ǀ prá ǀ jigāti ǀ dhṛṣṇu-yā́ ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀgiréḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ rásāḥ ǀ asya ǀ pinvire ǀ dátrāṇi ǀ puru-bhójasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He rushes on boldly like a weapon with a hundred edges, he smites the enemies of his worshipper; thegifts of him who feeds many, swell like the streams of a mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ सु॒तास॒ इन्द॑वो॒ मदा॒ य इ॑न्द्र गिर्वणः । आपो॒ न व॑ज्रि॒न्नन्वो॒क्यं१॒॑ सर॑: पृ॒णन्ति॑ शूर॒ राध॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǀ yé ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ vajrin ǀ ánu ǀ okyám ǀ sáraḥ ǀ pṛṇánti ǀ śūra ǀ rā́dhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The expressed exhilarateSoma, OIndra, lover of hymns, fills you for bounty, O hero, O thunderer, asthe waters flow to their accusative tomed lake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ने॒हसं॑ प्र॒तर॑णं वि॒वक्ष॑णं॒ मध्व॒: स्वादि॑ष्ठमीं पिब । आ यथा॑ मन्दसा॒नः कि॒रासि॑ न॒: प्र क्षु॒द्रेव॒ त्मना॑ धृ॒षत्
shlokas.transliteration: anehásam ǀ pra-táraṇam ǀ vivákṣaṇam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ svā́diṣṭham ǀ īm ǀ piba ǀā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ kirā́si ǀ naḥ ǀ prá ǀ kṣudrā́-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ dhṛṣát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink the incomparable, helpful, swellingSoma, the sweet of the Soma, that in your exultation you maypour out treasure for us, just as the mill-stone pours out meal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒: स्तोम॒मुप॑ द्र॒वद्धि॑या॒नो अश्वो॒ न सोतृ॑भिः । यं ते॑ स्वधावन्त्स्व॒दय॑न्ति धे॒नव॒ इन्द्र॒ कण्वे॑षु रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ úpa ǀ dravát ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sótṛ-bhiḥ ǀyám ǀ te ǀ svadhā-van ǀ svadáyanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ índra ǀ káṇveṣu ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come quickly to our praise--urged on by theSoma-pressers like a horse- - which the kine make sweet,for you, OIndra, of independent mighty; there are gifts (for you) among theKaṇva's.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रं न वी॒रं नम॒सोप॑ सेदिम॒ विभू॑ति॒मक्षि॑तावसुम् । उ॒द्रीव॑ वज्रिन्नव॒तो न सि॑ञ्च॒ते क्षर॑न्तीन्द्र धी॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ugrám ǀ ná ǀ vīrám ǀ námasā ǀ úpa ǀ sedima ǀ ví-bhūtim ǀ ákṣita-vasum ǀudrī́-iva ǀ vajrin ǀ avatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ siñcaté ǀ kṣáranti ǀ indra ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have approached you with homage like a mighty hero, the pre-eminent one, of imperishable wealth;OIndra, thunderer, our prayers flow forth as an abundant fountain pours out its streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्ध॑ नू॒नं यद्वा॑ य॒ज्ञे यद्वा॑ पृथि॒व्यामधि॑ । अतो॑ नो य॒ज्ञमा॒शुभि॑र्महेमत उ॒ग्र उ॒ग्रेभि॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ yajñé ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ ádhi ǀátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ mahe-mate ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ugrébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you are now present at a sacrifice, or whether you are abroad on the earth, come from thencewith your swift steeds to our sacrifice, O you of lofty counsel, come, strong one, with the strong (steeds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जि॒रासो॒ हर॑यो॒ ये त॑ आ॒शवो॒ वाता॑ इव प्रस॒क्षिण॑: । येभि॒रप॑त्यं॒ मनु॑षः प॒रीय॑से॒ येभि॒र्विश्वं॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: ajirā́saḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ pra-sakṣíṇaḥ ǀyébhiḥ ǀ ápatyam ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ pari-ī́yase ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agile and swift are your steeds, overpowering like the winds; with which you encircle the race ofManus,with which he whole heaven becomes visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑तस्त ईमह॒ इन्द्र॑ सु॒म्नस्य॒ गोम॑तः । यथा॒ प्रावो॑ मघव॒न्मेध्या॑तिथिं॒ यथा॒ नीपा॑तिथिं॒ धने॑
shlokas.transliteration: etā́vataḥ ǀ te ǀ īmahe ǀ índra ǀ sumnásya ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀyáthā ǀ prá ǀ ā́vaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ médhya-atithim ǀ yáthā ǀ nī́pa-atithim ǀ dháne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndra, we long for such a bounty of yours, rich in kine; (help us),Maghavan, as you did helpMedhyātithi with wealth, as you did helpNīpātithi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ कण्वे॑ मघवन्त्र॒सद॑स्यवि॒ यथा॑ प॒क्थे दश॑व्रजे । यथा॒ गोश॑र्ये॒ अस॑नोॠ॒जिश्व॒नीन्द्र॒ गोम॒द्धिर॑ण्यवत्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ káṇve ǀ magha-van ǀ trasádasyavi ǀ yáthā ǀ pakthé ǀ dáśa-vraje ǀyáthā ǀ gó-śarye ǀ ásanoḥ ǀ ṛjíśvani ǀ índra ǀ gó-mat ǀ híraṇya-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you, Mahavan, did give abundant kine and gold toKaṇvaandTrasadasyu, toPakthaandDaśavraja; as you did give them to Gośarya and Ṛjiśvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु श्रु॒तं सु॒राध॑स॒मर्चा॑ श॒क्रम॒भिष्ट॑ये । यः सु॑न्व॒ते स्तु॑व॒ते काम्यं॒ वसु॑ स॒हस्रे॑णेव॒ मंह॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ śrutám ǀ su-rā́dhasam ǀ árca ǀ śakrám ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀyáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ stuvaté ǀ kā́myam ǀ vásu ǀ sahásreṇa-iva ǀ máṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I would praise the far-famed, the bounteousŚakra, for the sake of his protection, who gives desirablewealth by thousands to the presser of theSomaand the offerer of hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तानी॑का हे॒तयो॑ अस्य दु॒ष्टरा॒ इन्द्र॑स्य स॒मिषो॑ म॒हीः । गि॒रिर्न भु॒ज्मा म॒घव॑त्सु पिन्वते॒ यदीं॑ सु॒ता अम॑न्दिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: śatá-anīkāḥ ǀ hetáyaḥ ǀ asya ǀ dustárāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sam-íṣaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀgiríḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhujmā́ ǀ maghávat-su ǀ pinvate ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ ámandiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invincible are his hundred-edged weapons, he mighty arrows ofIndra; he pours forth blessings on hisliberal worshippers like a mountain rich in springs, when the effusedSomahas exhilarated him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदीं॑ सु॒तास॒ इन्द॑वो॒ऽभि प्रि॒यमम॑न्दिषुः । आपो॒ न धा॑यि॒ सव॑नं म॒ आ व॑सो॒ दुघा॑ इ॒वोप॑ दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ īm ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǀ ámandiṣuḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhāyi ǀ sávanam ǀ me ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ dúghāḥ-iva ǀ úpa ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the effusedSoma-drops have exhilarated the beloved one, my oblation is offered abundantly likethe waters, O graciousIndra-- it is like the kine to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ने॒हसं॑ वो॒ हव॑मानमू॒तये॒ मध्व॑: क्षरन्ति धी॒तय॑: । आ त्वा॑ वसो॒ हव॑मानास॒ इन्द॑व॒ उप॑ स्तो॒त्रेषु॑ दधिरे
shlokas.transliteration: anehásam ǀ vaḥ ǀ hávamānam ǀ ūtáye ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ kṣaranti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ vaso íti ǀ hávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ stotréṣu ǀ dadhire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prayers which consecrate theSomaflow forth to the incomparable one who calls you for hisfavour, the Soma-drops which invoke you, O gracious one, have set you in the midst of the hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒: सोमे॑ स्वध्व॒र इ॑या॒नो अत्यो॒ न तो॑शते । यं ते॑ स्वदाव॒न्त्स्वद॑न्ति गू॒र्तय॑: पौ॒रे छ॑न्दयसे॒ हव॑म्
