shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sóme ǀ su-adhvaré ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ tośate ǀyám ǀ te ǀ svadā-van ǀ svádanti ǀ gūrtáyaḥ ǀ pauré ǀ chandayase ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He rushes hurrying like a horse to theSomaoffered in our festival, which the hymns make sweet toyou, O you that love sweet viands, you approve the summons to the satisfying Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वी॒रमु॒ग्रं विवि॑चिं धन॒स्पृतं॒ विभू॑तिं॒ राध॑सो म॒हः । उ॒द्रीव॑ वज्रिन्नव॒तो व॑सुत्व॒ना सदा॑ पीपेथ दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vīrám ǀ ugrám ǀ vívicim ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ ví-bhūtim ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀudrī́-iva ǀ vajrin ǀ avatáḥ ǀ vasu-tvanā́ ǀ sádā ǀ pīpetha ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise the mighty hero, wide-grasping, spoil-harrying, who has control over vast treasure; you, Othunderer ever pour forth wealth to the worshipper like an abundan fountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्ध॑ नू॒नं प॑रा॒वति॒ यद्वा॑ पृथि॒व्यां दि॒वि । यु॒जा॒न इ॑न्द्र॒ हरि॑भिर्महेमत ऋ॒ष्व ऋ॒ष्वेभि॒रा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ parā-váti ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ diví ǀyujānáḥ ǀ indra ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ mahe-mate ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ ṛṣvébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you are in the far distance or in the earth or in heaven, OIndra, god of lofty counsel, yoke yoursteeds, come here, lofty one, with the lofty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒थि॒रासो॒ हर॑यो॒ ये ते॑ अ॒स्रिध॒ ओजो॒ वात॑स्य॒ पिप्र॑ति । येभि॒र्नि दस्युं॒ मनु॑षो नि॒घोष॑यो॒ येभि॒: स्व॑: प॒रीय॑से
shlokas.transliteration: rathirā́saḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ asrídhaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ vā́tasya ǀ píprati ǀyébhiḥ ǀ ní ǀ dásyum ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ni-ghóṣayaḥ ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ pari-ī́yase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your harmless steeds which draw your chariot, which surpass the strength of the wind, with which yousilence the enemy of man and with which you go round the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑तस्ते वसो वि॒द्याम॑ शूर॒ नव्य॑सः । यथा॒ प्राव॒ एत॑शं॒ कृत्व्ये॒ धने॒ यथा॒ वशं॒ दश॑व्रजे
shlokas.transliteration: etā́vataḥ ǀ te ǀ vaso íti ǀ vidyā́ma ǀ śūra ǀ návyasaḥ ǀyáthā ǀ pra-ā́vaḥ ǀ étaśam ǀ kṛ́tvye ǀ dháne ǀ yáthā ǀ váśam ǀ dáśa-vraje ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we once more know you as such, O gracious hero, as when you did aidEtaśain the decisivebattle, orVaśaagainst Daśavraja.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ कण्वे॑ मघव॒न्मेधे॑ अध्व॒रे दी॒र्घनी॑थे॒ दमू॑नसि । यथा॒ गोश॑र्ये॒ असि॑षासो अद्रिवो॒ मयि॑ गो॒त्रं ह॑रि॒श्रिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ káṇve ǀ magha-van ǀ médhe ǀ adhvaré ǀ dīrghá-nīthe ǀ dámūnasi ǀyáthā ǀ gó-śarye ǀ ásisāsaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ máyi ǀ gotrám ǀ hari-śríyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you were willing to give, OMaghavan, toKaṇvain the sacrificial feast, or to Dīrghanītha thefriend of the house, as you were willing to give, O slinger, to Gośarya, so give to me a herd of kine shining likegold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ मनौ॒ सांव॑रणौ॒ सोम॑मि॒न्द्रापि॑बः सु॒तम् । नीपा॑तिथौ मघव॒न्मेध्या॑तिथौ॒ पुष्टि॑गौ॒ श्रुष्टि॑गौ॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ mánau ǀ sā́m-varaṇau ǀ sómam ǀ indra ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ sutám ǀnī́pa-atithau ǀ magha-van ǀ médhya-atithau ǀ púṣṭi-gau ǀ śrúṣṭi-gau ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you did drink, OIndra, the effusedSomabesideManu, the descendant ofSaṃvaraṇa, byNīpātithi and Medhyātithi, by Puṣṭigu and Śruṣṭigu, OMaghavan(so do you drink it here).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒र्ष॒द्वा॒णः प्रस्क॑ण्वं॒ सम॑सादय॒च्छया॑नं॒ जिव्रि॒मुद्धि॑तम् । स॒हस्रा॑ण्यसिषास॒द्गवा॒मृषि॒स्त्वोतो॒ दस्य॑वे॒ वृक॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pārṣadvāṇáḥ ǀ práskaṇvam ǀ sám ǀ asādayat ǀ śáyānam ǀ jívrim ǀ úddhitam ǀsahásrāṇi ǀ asisāsat ǀ gávām ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtaḥ ǀ dásyave ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The descendant of Pṛṣadvana entertained the agedPraskaṇvawho lay rejected (by his kindred);aided by you the seer Dasyave-vṛkadesired to obtain thousands of cows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒क्थेभि॒र्न वि॒न्धते॑ चि॒किद्य ऋ॑षि॒चोद॑नः । इन्द्रं॒ तमच्छा॑ वद॒ नव्य॑स्या म॒त्यरि॑ष्यन्तं॒ न भोज॑से
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vindháte ǀ cikít ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛṣi-códanaḥ ǀíndram ǀ tám ǀ áccha ǀ vada ǀ návyasyā ǀ matī́ ǀ áviṣyantam ǀ ná ǀ bhójase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing thatIndrawith the new hymn who has no lack of praises, who is wise and the inspirer of seers,who is as it were eager to enjoy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॑ अ॒र्कं स॒प्तशी॑र्षाणमानृ॒चुस्त्रि॒धातु॑मुत्त॒मे प॒दे । स त्वि१॒॑मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि चिक्रद॒दादिज्ज॑निष्ट॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ arkám ǀ saptá-śīrṣāṇam ǀ ānṛcúḥ ǀ tri-dhā́tum ǀ ut-tamé ǀ padé ǀsáḥ ǀ tú ǀ imā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ cikradat ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ janiṣṭa ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He to whom theysangthe seven-headed hymn with its three parts in the highest region, he has madeall these worlds tremble, and has thus brought forth his power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ दा॒ता वसू॑ना॒मिन्द्रं॒ तं हू॑महे व॒यम् । वि॒द्मा ह्य॑स्य सुम॒तिं नवी॑यसीं ग॒मेम॒ गोम॑ति व्र॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dātā́ ǀ vásūnām ǀ índram ǀ tám ǀ hūmahe ǀ vayám ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ su-matím ǀ návīyasīm ǀ gaméma ǀ gó-mati ǀ vrajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke thatIndrawho gives us wealth; for we know his new favour; may we obtain a stall rich incows.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वं व॑सो दा॒नाय॒ शिक्ष॑सि॒ स रा॒यस्पोष॑मश्नुते । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं म॑घवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सु॒ताव॑न्तो हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ vaso íti ǀ dānā́ya ǀ śíkṣasi ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ aśnute ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whom you help, O gracious one, to give, obtains abundance of wealth; bringing theSomawe invokeyou,Indra,Maghavan, you that love hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि॒ नेन्द्र॑ सश्चसि दा॒शुषे॑ । उपो॒पेन्नु म॑घव॒न्भूय॒ इन्नु ते॒ दानं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ पृच्यते
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ caná ǀ starī́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ ná ǀ indra ǀ saścasi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀúpa-upa ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ magha-van ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ dā́nam ǀ devásya ǀ pṛcyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never are you niggardly,Indra, and give not to the worshipper; but your godlike gifts, OMaghavan, arepoured forth more and more.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यो न॑न॒क्षे अ॒भ्योज॑सा॒ क्रिविं॑ व॒धैः शुष्णं॑ निघो॒षय॑न् । य॒देदस्त॑म्भीत्प्र॒थय॑न्न॒मूं दिव॒मादिज्ज॑निष्ट॒ पार्थि॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yáḥ ǀ nanakṣé ǀ abhí ǀ ójasā ǀ krívim ǀ vadháiḥ ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ ni-ghoṣáyan ǀyadā́ ǀ ít ǀ ástambhīt ǀ pratháyan ǀ amū́m ǀ dívam ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ janiṣṭa ǀ pā́rthivaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who overpowered Krivi by his might and silences Suṣṇa with his weapons, when he spread abroadyonder sky and propped it up, then first the dweller on earth was born.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्या॒यं विश्व॒ आर्यो॒ दास॑: शेवधि॒पा अ॒रिः । ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्ये रुश॑मे॒ परी॑रवि॒ तुभ्येत्सो अ॑ज्यते र॒यिः
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ayám ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ ā́ryaḥ ǀ dā́saḥ ǀ śevadhi-pā́ḥ ǀ aríḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryé ǀ rúśame ǀ pávīravi ǀ túbhya ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ rayíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That wealth, which everyĀryahere covets and every miserlyDāsa, is sent direct to yo, the piousRuśama Paviru.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तु॒र॒ण्यवो॒ मधु॑मन्तं घृत॒श्चुतं॒ विप्रा॑सो अ॒र्कमा॑नृचुः । अ॒स्मे र॒यिः प॑प्रथे॒ वृष्ण्यं॒ शवो॒ऽस्मे सु॑वा॒नास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: turaṇyávaḥ ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ānṛcuḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ rayíḥ ǀ paprathe ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ śávaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The zealous seers have sung a hymn, sweet withSomaand dropping ghī; wealth and manly strengthhav espread themselves among us, and so too the expressed Soma drops.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ मनौ॒ विव॑स्वति॒ सोमं॑ श॒क्रापि॑बः सु॒तम् । यथा॑ त्रि॒ते छन्द॑ इन्द्र॒ जुजो॑षस्या॒यौ मा॑दयसे॒ सचा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ mánau ǀ vívasvati ǀ sómam ǀ śakra ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ sutám ǀyáthā ǀ trité ǀ chándaḥ ǀ indra ǀ jújoṣasi ǀ āyáu ǀ mādayase ǀ sácā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you,Śakra, did drink the effusedSomafromManuVivasvat, as you did accept the hymn fromTrita,so do you gladden yourself with Āyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृष॑ध्रे॒ मेध्ये॑ मात॒रिश्व॒नीन्द्र॑ सुवा॒ने अम॑न्दथाः । यथा॒ सोमं॒ दश॑शिप्रे॒ दशो॑ण्ये॒ स्यूम॑रश्मा॒वृजू॑नसि
shlokas.transliteration: pṛ́ṣadhre ǀ médhye ǀ mātaríśvani ǀ índra ǀ suvāné ǀ ámandathāḥ ǀyáthā ǀ sómam ǀ dáśa-śipre ǀ dáśa-oṇye ǀ syū́ma-raśmau ǀ ṛ́jūnasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You did enjoy,Indra, the effused drink withPṛṣadhra,MedhyaandMātariśvan, just as you did drinktheSomawith Daśaśipra, Daśoṇya, Syumaraśmi, and Ṛjunas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒क्था केव॑ला द॒धे यः सोमं॑ धृषि॒तापि॑बत् । यस्मै॒ विष्णु॒स्त्रीणि॑ प॒दा वि॑चक्र॒म उप॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ukthā́ ǀ kévalā ǀ dadhé ǀ yáḥ ǀ sómam ǀ dhṛṣitā́ ǀ ápibat ǀyásmai ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ padā́ ǀ vi-cakramé ǀ úpa ǀ mitrásya ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(It isIndra) who has appropriated the hymns for himself, who has bravely drunk theSoma, for whomViṣṇu strode the three steps according to the ordinances ofMitra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ स्तोमे॑षु चा॒कनो॒ वाजे॑ वाजिञ्छतक्रतो । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं सु॒दुघा॑मिव गो॒दुहो॑ जुहू॒मसि॑ श्रव॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ stómeṣu ǀ cākánaḥ ǀ vā́je ǀ vājin ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ sudúghām-iva ǀ go-dúhaḥ ǀ juhūmási ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OŚatakratu, you who are bountiful to him whose praises and oblations you delight in, we, desiringwealth, invoke you, as the milkers call a cow which bears abundant milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो नो॑ दा॒ता स न॑: पि॒ता म॒हाँ उ॒ग्र ई॑शान॒कृत् । अया॑मन्नु॒ग्रो म॒घवा॑ पुरू॒वसु॒र्गोरश्व॑स्य॒ प्र दा॑तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dātā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ ugráḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀáyāman ǀ ugráḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ puru-vásuḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ prá ǀ dātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who gives to us is our father, the mighty, the strong, he who acts as the sovereign, may he, thestrong richMaghavan, give us kine and horses, even without our asking for it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वं व॑सो दा॒नाय॒ मंह॑से॒ स रा॒यस्पोष॑मिन्वति । व॒सू॒यवो॒ वसु॑पतिं श॒तक्र॑तुं॒ स्तोमै॒रिन्द्रं॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ vaso íti ǀ dānā́ya ǀ máṃhase ǀ sáḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ invati ǀvasu-yávaḥ ǀ vásu-patim ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ índram ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He to whom you give a present that he may obtain abundance of wealth; we, desiring wealth, invokewith our praisesIndraŚatakratu, the lord of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छस्यु॒भे नि पा॑सि॒ जन्म॑नी । तुरी॑यादित्य॒ हव॑नं त इन्द्रि॒यमा त॑स्थाव॒मृतं॑ दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: kadā́ ǀ caná ǀ prá ǀ yucchasi ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ní ǀ pāsi ǀ jánmanī íti ǀtúrīya ǀ āditya ǀ hávanam ǀ te ǀ indriyám ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthau ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Never are you heedless, you guard both races, (gods and men); O fourthĀditya, to you belongs theIndra invocation, the ambrosia has risen to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मै॒ त्वं म॑घवन्निन्द्र गिर्वण॒: शिक्षो॒ शिक्ष॑सि दा॒शुषे॑ । अ॒स्माकं॒ गिर॑ उ॒त सु॑ष्टु॒तिं व॑सो कण्व॒वच्छृ॑णुधी॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmai ǀ tvám ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ śíkṣo íti ǀ śíkṣasi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀasmā́kam ǀ gíraḥ ǀ utá ǀ su-stutím ǀ vaso íti ǀ kaṇva-vát ǀ śṛṇudhi ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(As you hear) the worshipper who you favour, OIndra,Maghavan, liberal one, you that love hymns, so,gracious one, hear our hymns and our invocation of praise, likeKaṇva's.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ता॑वि॒ मन्म॑ पू॒र्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्रा॑य वोचत । पू॒र्वीॠ॒तस्य॑ बृह॒तीर॑नूषत स्तो॒तुर्मे॒धा अ॑सृक्षत
shlokas.transliteration: ástāvi ǀ mánma ǀ pūrvyám ǀ bráhma ǀ índrāya ǀ vocata ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ stotúḥ ǀ medhā́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The old hymn has been sun, you have uttered the prayer toIndra; they have shouted many bṛhatīverses of the rite, many hymns of the worshipper have they poured forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समिन्द्रो॒ रायो॑ बृह॒तीर॑धूनुत॒ सं क्षो॒णी समु॒ सूर्य॑म् । सं शु॒क्रास॒: शुच॑य॒: सं गवा॑शिर॒: सोमा॒ इन्द्र॑ममन्दिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ índraḥ ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ adhūnuta ǀ sám ǀ kṣoṇī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sū́ryam ǀsám ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ sám ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ índram ǀ amandiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrahas heaped together vast stores of wealth, the two worlds and the sun; the bright pureSoma-drink mixed with milk, has exhilarated Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒प॒मं त्वा॑ म॒घोनां॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ च वृष॒भाणा॑म् । पू॒र्भित्त॑मं मघवन्निन्द्र गो॒विद॒मीशा॑नं रा॒य ई॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: upa-mám ǀ tvā ǀ maghónām ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ ca ǀ vṛṣabhā́ṇām ǀpūrbhít-tamam ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ go-vídam ǀ ī́śānam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We come to you, OMaghavanIndra, the highest ofMaghavans, the strong of bulls, the mightiestbreakere of forts, the provider of kine, the lord of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॒युं कुत्स॑मतिथि॒ग्वमर्द॑यो वावृधा॒नो दि॒वेदि॑वे । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं हर्य॑श्वं श॒तक्र॑तुं वाज॒यन्तो॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ āyúm ǀ kútsam ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ árdayaḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ hári-aśvam ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who, waxing in might day by day, did destroy Āyu,Kutsa, andAtithigva, we invoke you,Śatakratu, with your bay horses, rousing you by our offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्वे॑षां॒ रसं॒ मध्व॑: सिञ्च॒न्त्वद्र॑यः । ये प॑रा॒वति॑ सुन्वि॒रे जने॒ष्वा ये अ॑र्वा॒वतीन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśveṣām ǀ rásam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ siñcantu ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀyé ǀ parā-váti ǀ sunviré ǀ jáneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ arvā-váti ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the stones our forth theSomafor us all, the Soma-drops which have been pressed by men afar ornear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॒ द्वेषां॑सि ज॒हि चाव॒ चा कृ॑धि॒ विश्वे॑ सन्व॒न्त्वा वसु॑ । शीष्टे॑षु चित्ते मदि॒रासो॑ अं॒शवो॒ यत्रा॒ सोम॑स्य तृ॒म्पसि॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ jahí ǀ ca ǀ áva ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ víśve ǀ sanvantu ǀ ā́ ǀ vásu ǀśī́ṣṭeṣu ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ madirā́saḥ ǀ aṃśávaḥ ǀ yátra ǀ sómasya ǀ tṛmpási ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Smite all our enemies and drive them away, may we all obtain their wealth; even amont the Śīṣṭasare you exhilaratingSoma-stalks, where you fill yourself with the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ नेदी॑य॒ एदि॑हि मि॒तमे॑धाभिरू॒तिभि॑: । आ शं॑तम॒ शंत॑माभिर॒भिष्टि॑भि॒रा स्वा॑पे स्वा॒पिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ nédīyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ít ǀ ihi ǀ mitá-medhābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ śam-tama ǀ śám-tamābhiḥ ǀ abhíṣṭi-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ su-āpe ǀ svāpí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, come very near with your firmly-wise protections; come, O most healthful, with your mos healthfulaid, come, good kinsma, with your good kinsmen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒जि॒तुरं॒ सत्प॑तिं वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिं कृ॒धि प्र॒जास्वाभ॑गम् । प्र सू ति॑रा॒ शची॑भि॒र्ये त॑ उ॒क्थिन॒: क्रतुं॑ पुन॒त आ॑नु॒षक्
shlokas.transliteration: āji-túram ǀ sát-patim ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇim ǀ kṛdhí ǀ pra-jā́su ǀ ā́-bhagam ǀprá ǀ sú ǀ tira ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ krátum ǀ punaté ǀ ānuṣák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Make rich in children that chief of all me, who is victorious in battle and a strong protector; properthoroughly with your powers your singers who cintinually purify their minds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ साधि॒ष्ठोऽव॑से॒ ते स्या॑म॒ भरे॑षु ते । व॒यं होत्रा॑भिरु॒त दे॒वहू॑तिभिः सस॒वांसो॑ मनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sā́dhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ ávase ǀ té ǀ syāma ǀ bháreṣu ǀ te ǀvayám ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ manāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be in battle as one who is the sure to gain your protection; we worship you with invocationsand prayers wen we obtain our desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं हि ते॑ हरिवो॒ ब्रह्म॑ वाज॒युरा॒जिं यामि॒ सदो॒तिभि॑: । त्वामिदे॒व तममे॒ सम॑श्व॒युर्ग॒व्युरग्र॑॑ मथी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ ājím ǀ yā́mi ǀ sádā ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ evá ǀ tám ǀ áme ǀ sám ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ ágre ǀ mathīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With your help, O lord of bay steeds, I always go into prayer and into battle, seeking spoil; it is youwhom I insist upon, when I go, longing for horses and kine, at the head of plural nders.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तत्त॑ इन्द्र वी॒र्यं॑ गी॒र्भिर्गृ॒णन्ति॑ का॒रव॑: । ते स्तोभ॑न्त॒ ऊर्ज॑मावन्घृत॒श्चुतं॑ पौ॒रासो॑ नक्षन्धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vīryám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀté ǀ stóbhantaḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ āvan ǀ ghṛta-ścútam ǀ paurā́saḥ ǀ nakṣan ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The singers with their hymns, OIndra, this might of yours; singing loudly, they have brought you sacredviands dropping withSoma; the offerers have drawn near with their prayers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नक्ष॑न्त॒ इन्द्र॒मव॑से सुकृ॒त्यया॒ येषां॑ सु॒तेषु॒ मन्द॑से । यथा॑ संव॒र्ते अम॑दो॒ यथा॑ कृ॒श ए॒वास्मे इ॑न्द्र मत्स्व
shlokas.transliteration: nákṣante ǀ índram ǀ ávase ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀ yéṣām ǀ sutéṣu ǀ mándase ǀyáthā ǀ sam-varté ǀ ámadaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ kṛśé ǀ evá ǀ asmé íti ǀ indra ǀ matsva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have drawn nearIndrawith holy rites for his protection, they in whose libations you rejoice; as youdid rejoice inSamvaraandKṛśa, so now, Indra, do you rejoice in us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॒ विश्वे॑ स॒जोष॑सो॒ देवा॑सो॒ गन्त॒नोप॑ नः । वस॑वो रु॒द्रा अव॑से न॒ आ ग॑मञ्छृ॒ण्वन्तु॑ म॒रुतो॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ gántana ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀvásavaḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ ávase ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gaman ǀ śṛṇvántu ǀ marútaḥ ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gods, come all with one accord to us; let theVasusandRudrascome for our protection, let theMaruts hear our call.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षा विष्णु॒र्हव॑नं मे॒ सर॑स्व॒त्यव॑न्तु स॒प्त सिन्ध॑वः । आपो॒ वात॒: पर्व॑तासो॒ वन॒स्पति॑: शृ॒णोतु॑ पृथि॒वी हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ hávanam ǀ me ǀ sárasvatī ǀ ávantu ǀ saptá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ śṛṇótu ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayPūṣan,Viṣṇu, Sarsvatī, and the seven rivers, favour my call; may the waters, the wind, themountains, the trees, the earth, hear my call.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ राधो॒ अस्ति॑ ते॒ माघो॑नं मघवत्तम । तेन॑ नो बोधि सध॒माद्यो॑ वृ॒धे भगो॑ दा॒नाय॑ वृत्रहन्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ ásti ǀ te ǀ mā́ghonam ǀ maghavat-tama ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ bodhi ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ vṛtra-han ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With yours own special gift, OIndra, best ofMaghavans, be you our boon-companion for good, ourliberal benefactor, O slayer ofVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आजि॑पते नृपते॒ त्वमिद्धि नो॒ वाज॒ आ व॑क्षि सुक्रतो । वी॒ती होत्रा॑भिरु॒त दे॒ववी॑तिभिः सस॒वांसो॒ वि शृ॑ण्विरे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ji-pate ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ tvám ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́je ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀvītī́ ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ devávīti-bhiḥ ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ śṛṇvire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O lord of battle, lord of men, mighty in action, do you guide us in the conflict; far-famed are those whoobtain their desires by sacrificial feasts, by invocations, and by entertaining the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सन्ति॒ ह्य१॒॑र्य आ॒शिष॒ इन्द्र॒ आयु॒र्जना॑नाम् । अ॒स्मान्न॑क्षस्व मघव॒न्नुपाव॑से धु॒क्षस्व॑ पि॒प्युषी॒मिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sánti ǀ hí ǀ aryé ǀ ā-śíṣaḥ ǀ índre ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jánānām ǀasmā́n ǀ nakṣasva ǀ magha-van ǀ úpa ǀ ávase ǀ dhukṣásva ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our prayers abide in the true one, inIndrais the life of men; draw near to us,Maghavan, for ourprotection; milk for the streaming drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं त॑ इन्द्र॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्विधेम॒ त्वम॒स्माकं॑ शतक्रतो । महि॑ स्थू॒रं श॑श॒यं राधो॒ अह्र॑यं॒ प्रस्क॑ण्वाय॒ नि तो॑शय
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ vidhema ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀmáhi ǀ sthūrám ǀ śaśayám ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ áhrayam ǀ práskaṇvāya ǀ ní ǀ tośaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndra, we would worship you with hymns; OŚatakratu, you are ours; pour down upon Praśkaṇvagreat, solid, inexhaustible, exuberant abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरीदिन्द्र॑स्य वी॒र्यं१॒॑ व्यख्य॑म॒भ्याय॑ति । राध॑स्ते दस्यवे वृक
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ vīryám ǀ ví ǀ ákhyam ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ ayati ǀrā́dhaḥ ǀ te ǀ dasyave ǀ vṛka ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great indeed isIndra's might; I have beheld it; your gift approaches, O Dasyaavevṛka”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं श्वे॒तास॑ उ॒क्षणो॑ दि॒वि तारो॒ न रो॑चन्ते । म॒ह्ना दिवं॒ न त॑स्तभुः
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ śvetā́saḥ ǀ ukṣáṇaḥ ǀ diví ǀ tā́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ rocante ǀmahnā́ ǀ dívam ǀ ná ǀ tastabhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A hundred white oxen shine like stars in the heaven, by their size they have almost held up theheavens.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं वे॒णूञ्छ॒तं शुन॑: श॒तं चर्मा॑णि म्ला॒तानि॑ । श॒तं मे॑ बल्बजस्तु॒का अरु॑षीणां॒ चतु॑:शतम्
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ veṇū́n ǀ śatám ǀ śúnaḥ ǀ śatám ǀ cármāṇi ǀ mlātā́ni ǀśatám ǀ me ǀ balbaja-stukā́ḥ ǀ áruṣīṇām ǀ cátuḥ-śatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A hundred bamboos, a hundred dogs, a hundred dressed hides, a hundred bunches ofbalbajagrass,and four hundred red mares are mine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒दे॒वाः स्थ॑ काण्वायना॒ वयो॑वयो विच॒रन्त॑: । अश्वा॑सो॒ न च॑ङ्क्रमत
shlokas.transliteration: su-devā́ḥ ǀ stha ǀ kāṇvāyanāḥ ǀ váyaḥ-vayaḥ ǀ vi-carántaḥ ǀáśvāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ caṅkramata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May youu have the gods propitious to you, O descendants ofKaṇva, living through youth on youth;step out vigorously like steed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदित्सा॒प्तस्य॑ चर्किर॒न्नानू॑नस्य॒ महि॒ श्रव॑: । श्यावी॑रतिध्व॒सन्प॒थश्चक्षु॑षा च॒न सं॒नशे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ít ǀ sāptásya ǀ carkiran ǀ ná ǀ ánūnasya ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀśyā́vīḥ ǀ ati-dhvasán ǀ patháḥ ǀ cákṣuṣā ǀ caná ǀ sam-náśe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let them praise the seven-yoked team, great is the strength of that which is not yet full-grown; thedark-brown mares have rushed along the paths so that no eye can follow them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रति॑ ते दस्यवे वृक॒ राधो॑ अद॒र्श्यह्र॑यम् । द्यौर्न प्र॑थि॒ना शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ te ǀ dasyave ǀ vṛka ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ adarśi ǀ áhrayam ǀdyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ prathinā́ ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your inexhaustible gift has appeared, O Dasyavevṛka, its fullness is in extent like the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दश॒ मह्यं॑ पौतक्र॒तः स॒हस्रा॒ दस्य॑वे॒ वृक॑: । नित्या॑द्रा॒यो अ॑मंहत
shlokas.transliteration: dáśa ǀ máhyam ǀ pauta-kratáḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ dásyave ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀnítyāt ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ amaṃhata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dasyave-vṛka, the son of Putakrata, has given to me ten thousand from his own store.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं मे॑ गर्द॒भानां॑ श॒तमूर्णा॑वतीनाम् । श॒तं दा॒साँ अति॒ स्रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ me ǀ gardabhā́nām ǀ śatám ǀ ū́rṇā-vatīnām ǀśatám ǀ dāsā́n ǀ áti ǀ srájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A hundred asses a hundred woolly sheep, a hundred slaves, beside garlands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तत्रो॒ अपि॒ प्राणी॑यत पू॒तक्र॑तायै॒ व्य॑क्ता । अश्वा॑ना॒मिन्न यू॒थ्या॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tátro íti ǀ ápi ǀ prá ǀ anīyata ǀ pūtá-kratāyai ǀ ví-aktā ǀáśvānām ǀ ít ǀ ná ǀ yūthyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There too has been brought for Putakrata a well-adorned mare, which is not one of the common horsesof the herd.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अचे॑त्य॒ग्निश्चि॑कि॒तुर्ह॑व्य॒वाट् स सु॒मद्र॑थः । अ॒ग्निः शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑ बृ॒हत्सूरो॑ अरोचत दि॒वि सूर्यो॑ अरोचत
shlokas.transliteration: áceti ǀ agníḥ ǀ cikitúḥ ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sumát-rathaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ bṛhát ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ arocata ǀ diví ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ arocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The shiningAgnihas appeared, the bearer of the oblation, with his chariot; Agni has gleamed forthbrilliantly with his bright flame asSura, he has gleamed forth in heaven asSūrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं दे॑वा॒ क्रतु॑ना पू॒र्व्येण॑ यु॒क्ता रथे॑न तवि॒षं य॑जत्रा । आग॑च्छतं नासत्या॒ शची॑भिरि॒दं तृ॒तीयं॒ सव॑नं पिबाथः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ devā ǀ krátunā ǀ pūrvyéṇa ǀ yuktā́ ǀ ráthena ǀ taviṣám ǀ yajatrā ǀā́ ǀ agacchatam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ idám ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ sávanam ǀ pibāthaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have come quickly, you two gods, with your car, endowed with ancient might, O sacredAśvins,truthful ones, with your powers, drink this third libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां दे॒वास्त्रय॑ एकाद॒शास॑: स॒त्याः स॒त्यस्य॑ ददृशे पु॒रस्ता॑त् । अ॒स्माकं॑ य॒ज्ञं सव॑नं जुषा॒णा पा॒तं सोम॑मश्विना॒ दीद्य॑ग्नी
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ ekādaśā́saḥ ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ satyásya ǀ dadṛśe ǀ purástāt ǀasmā́kam ǀ yajñám ǀ sávanam ǀ juṣāṇā́ ǀ pātám ǀ sómam ǀ aśvinā ǀ dī́dyagnī íti dī́di-agnī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The three-and-thirty truthful gods saw you before the truthful one; OAśvins, gleaming with fire, drinktheSoma, enjoying our offering, our libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒नाय्यं॒ तद॑श्विना कृ॒तं वां॑ वृष॒भो दि॒वो रज॑सः पृथि॒व्याः । स॒हस्रं॒ शंसा॑ उ॒त ये गवि॑ष्टौ॒ सर्वाँ॒ इत्ताँ उप॑ याता॒ पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: panā́yyam ǀ tát ǀ aśvinā ǀ kṛtám ǀ vām ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀsahásram ǀ śáṃsāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀ sárvān ǀ ít ǀ tā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That work of yours, OAśvins, is worthy of wonder, the bull of the heavens, the firmament and the earth;and your thousand blessings in battle, for all these come here to drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॑ भा॒गो निहि॑तो यजत्रे॒मा गिरो॑ नास॒त्योप॑ यातम् । पिब॑तं॒ सोमं॒ मधु॑मन्तम॒स्मे प्र दा॒श्वांस॑मवतं॒ शची॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ vām ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ yajatrā ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ nāsatyā ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀpíbatam ǀ sómam ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ asmé íti ǀ prá ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǀ avatam ǀ śácībhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O sacred ones, this your portion has been plural ced for you, O truthful ones, come to these your praises;drink among us the sweetSoma, succour your worshipper with your powers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमृ॒त्विजो॑ बहु॒धा क॒ल्पय॑न्त॒: सचे॑तसो य॒ज्ञमि॒मं वह॑न्ति । यो अ॑नूचा॒नो ब्रा॑ह्म॒णो यु॒क्त आ॑सी॒त्का स्वि॒त्तत्र॒ यज॑मानस्य सं॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ kalpáyantaḥ ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ imám ǀ váhanti ǀyáḥ ǀ anūcānáḥ ǀ brāhmaṇáḥ ǀ yuktáḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ kā́ ǀ svit ǀ tátra ǀ yájamānasya ǀ sam-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whom the wise priests bring, when they arrange the offering in many ways, who was employed as alearnedbrāhmaṇa, what is the offerer's knowledge regarding him?”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑ ए॒वाग्निर्ब॑हु॒धा समि॑द्ध॒ एक॒: सूर्यो॒ विश्व॒मनु॒ प्रभू॑तः । एकै॒वोषाः सर्व॑मि॒दं वि भा॒त्येकं॒ वा इ॒दं वि ब॑भूव॒ सर्व॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ékaḥ ǀ evá ǀ agníḥ ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ánu ǀ prá-bhūtaḥ ǀékā ǀ evá ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ sárvam ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ ékam ǀ vái ǀ idám ǀ ví ǀ babhūva ǀ sárvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis one, though kindled in various ways; one is the Sun, pre- eminent over all; one Dawn illuminesthis all; one is that which has become this all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्योति॑ष्मन्तं केतु॒मन्तं॑ त्रिच॒क्रं सु॒खं रथं॑ सु॒षदं॒ भूरि॑वारम् । चि॒त्राम॑घा॒ यस्य॒ योगे॑ऽधिजज्ञे॒ तं वां॑ हु॒वे अति॑ रिक्तं॒ पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: jyótiṣmantam ǀ ketu-mántam ǀ tri-cakrám ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀ su-sádam ǀ bhū́ri-vāram ǀcitrá-maghā ǀ yásya ǀ yóge ǀ adhi-jajñe ǀ tám ǀ vām ǀ huvé ǀ áti ǀ riktam ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliant chariot, diffusing splendour, rolling lightly on its three wheels, offering an easy seat, and fullof many gifts, at whose yoking the Dawn was born, rich in marvellous treasures, I invoke that your chariot (OAśvins), come you here to drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मानि॑ वां भाग॒धेया॑नि सिस्रत॒ इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ प्र म॒हे सु॒तेषु॑ वाम् । य॒ज्ञेय॑ज्ञे ह॒ सव॑ना भुर॒ण्यथो॒ यत्सु॑न्व॒ते यज॑मानाय॒ शिक्ष॑थः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ni ǀ vām ǀ bhāga-dhéyāni ǀ sisrate ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ prá ǀ mahé ǀ sutéṣu ǀ vām ǀyajñé-yajñe ǀ ha ǀ sávanā ǀ bhuraṇyáthaḥ ǀ yát ǀ sunvaté ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śíkṣathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your offered portions stream forth, OIndraandVaruṇa, to your honour in the oblations; at everysacrifice you hasten to the oblations, when you help the offerer who presses out theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒ष्षिध्व॑री॒रोष॑धी॒राप॑ आस्ता॒मिन्द्रा॑वरुणा महि॒मान॒माश॑त । या सिस्र॑तू॒ रज॑सः पा॒रे अध्व॑नो॒ ययो॒: शत्रु॒र्नकि॒रादे॑व॒ ओह॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: niḥ-sídhvarīḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ āstām ǀ índrāvaruṇā ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ āśata ǀyā́ ǀ sísratuḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pāré ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ śátruḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ádevaḥ ǀ óhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural nts and the waters were efficacious, they have attained their power, OindraandVaruṇa, youwho have gone beyond the path of the firmament, no godless man is worth being called your enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यं तदि॑न्द्रावरुणा कृ॒शस्य॑ वां॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिं दु॑हते स॒प्त वाणी॑: । ताभि॑र्दा॒श्वांस॑मवतं शुभस्पती॒ यो वा॒मद॑ब्धो अ॒भि पाति॒ चित्ति॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ tát ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ kṛśásya ǀ vām ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ duhate ǀ saptá ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ dāśvā́ṃsam ǀ avatam ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pā́ti ǀ cítti-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “True, OIndraandVaruṇa, is that saying of Kṛsa's, 'the seven sacred voices distil a stream of honey',for their sake help the worshipper, O you lords of splendour, who reverence you devoutly in his thoughts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒त॒प्रुष॒: सौम्या॑ जी॒रदा॑नवः स॒प्त स्वसा॑र॒: सद॑न ऋ॒तस्य॑ । या ह॑ वामिन्द्रावरुणा घृत॒श्चुत॒स्ताभि॑र्धत्तं॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛta-prúṣaḥ ǀ sáumyāḥ ǀ jīrá-dānavaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ sádane ǀ ṛtásya ǀyā́ḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ dhattam ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śikṣatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven sister-streams of theSoma, in the hot the offering, pour forth ghī-dripping streams of yours,OIndraVaruṇa, provide for and help the offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवो॑चाम मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय स॒त्यं त्वे॒षाभ्यां॑ महि॒मान॑मिन्द्रि॒यम् । अ॒स्मान्त्स्वि॑न्द्रावरुणा घृत॒श्चुत॒स्त्रिभि॑: सा॒प्तेभि॑रवतं शुभस्पती
shlokas.transliteration: ávocāma ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǀ satyám ǀ tveṣā́bhyām ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ indriyám ǀasmā́n ǀ sú ǀ indrāvaruṇā ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ trí-bhiḥ ǀ sāptébhiḥ ǀ avatam ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To our great happiness we hae declared to these two brilliant ones the true might ofIndra; O indra andVaruṇa, lords of splendour, help us, the offerers of ghī, with the company of thrice seven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा॒ यदृ॒षिभ्यो॑ मनी॒षां वा॒चो म॒तिं श्रु॒तम॑दत्त॒मग्रे॑ । यानि॒ स्थाना॑न्यसृजन्त॒ धीरा॑ य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒नास्तप॑सा॒भ्य॑पश्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ yát ǀ ṛṣí-bhyaḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ vācáḥ ǀ matím ǀ śrutám ǀ adattam ǀ ágre ǀyā́ni ǀ sthā́nāni ǀ asṛjanta ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ tanvānā́ḥ ǀ tápasā ǀ abhí ǀ apaśyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndraandVaruṇa, I have seen what you formerly gave to the seers, wisdom, power of song, andfame, and the plural ces which the wise have prepared for themselves, as they spread the web of the sacrifice withholy austerities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑वरुणा सौमन॒समदृ॑प्तं रा॒यस्पोषं॒ यज॑मानेषु धत्तम् । प्र॒जां पु॒ष्टिं भू॑तिम॒स्मासु॑ धत्तं दीर्घायु॒त्वाय॒ प्र ति॑रतं न॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāvaruṇā ǀ saumanasám ǀ ádṛptam ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ yájamāneṣu ǀ dhattam ǀpra-jā́m ǀ puṣṭím ǀ bhūtim ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhattam ǀ dīrghāyu-tvā́ya ǀ prá ǀ tiratam ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndraandVaruṇa, give to the offerers cheerfulness without levity, and abundance of wealth; give tous offspring, food, prosperity; prolong our lives to length of days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आ या॑ह्य॒ग्निभि॒र्होता॑रं त्वा वृणीमहे । आ त्वाम॑नक्तु॒ प्रय॑ता ह॒विष्म॑ती॒ यजि॑ष्ठं ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ hótāram ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀā́ ǀ tvā́m ǀ anaktu ǀ prá-yatā ǀ havíṣmatī ǀ yájiṣṭham ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, come here with the fires, we choose you as our invoking priest; let the presented offering anointyou, the chief sacrificer, to sit down on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒ हि त्वा॑ सहसः सूनो अङ्गिर॒: स्रुच॒श्चर॑न्त्यध्व॒रे । ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑तं घृ॒तके॑शमीमहे॒ऽग्निं य॒ज्ञेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀ srúcaḥ ǀ cáranti ǀ adhvaré ǀūrjáḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ghṛtá-keśam ǀ īmahe ǀ agním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aṅgirasa, son of strength, the ladles go to find you in the sacrifice; we praise the ancientAgniin ourofferings, the grandson of food, butter-haired.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ क॒विर्वे॒धा अ॑सि॒ होता॑ पावक॒ यक्ष्य॑: । म॒न्द्रो यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्यो॒ विप्रे॑भिः शुक्र॒ मन्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ kavíḥ ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ hótā ǀ pāvaka ǀ yákṣyaḥ ǀmandráḥ ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ śukra ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you, wise, are the creator (of consequences); O purifier, you are the involving priest, worthy ofworship; bright one, you are to be praised in our sacrifices by the priests with hymns, yourself the chief ministrantworthy to be rejoiced in.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रो॑घ॒मा व॑होश॒तो य॑विष्ठ्य दे॒वाँ अ॑जस्र वी॒तये॑ । अ॒भि प्रयां॑सि॒ सुधि॒ता व॑सो गहि॒ मन्द॑स्व धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ádrogham ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ devā́n ǀ ajasra ǀ vītáye ǀabhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ sú-dhitā ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǀ mándasva ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most youthful, eternal one, bring the longing gods to me guileless, to eat (the oblation); giver ofdwellings, approach the well-plural ced food; rejoice, being set in your plural ce with praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमित्स॒प्रथा॑ अ॒स्यग्ने॑ त्रातॠ॒तस्क॒विः । त्वां विप्रा॑सः समिधान दीदिव॒ आ वि॑वासन्ति वे॒धस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ ít ǀ sa-práthāḥ ǀ asi ǀ ágne ǀ trātaḥ ǀ ṛtáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ sam-idhāna ǀ dīdi-vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DelivererAgni, you, the truthful and the seer, are widely spread; O kindled blazing one, the wisepraisers wait on you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शोचा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदि॒हि वि॒शे मयो॒ रास्व॑ स्तो॒त्रे म॒हाँ अ॑सि । दे॒वानां॒ शर्म॒न्मम॑ सन्तु सू॒रय॑: शत्रू॒षाह॑: स्व॒ग्नय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śóca ǀ śociṣṭha ǀ dīdihí ǀ viśé ǀ máyaḥ ǀ rā́sva ǀ stotré ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀdevā́nām ǀ śárman ǀ máma ǀ santu ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀ śatru-sáhaḥ ǀ su-agnáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most resplendent (Agni), shine forth and illuminate (us); give happiness to your people, to yourworshipper, for you are great; may my priests abide in the bliss of the gods, subduing their enemies, possessingbright fires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ चिद्वृ॒द्धम॑त॒समग्ने॑ सं॒जूर्व॑सि॒ क्षमि॑ । ए॒वा द॑ह मित्रमहो॒ यो अ॑स्म॒ध्रुग्दु॒र्मन्मा॒ कश्च॒ वेन॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ cit ǀ vṛddhám ǀ atasám ǀ ágne ǀ sam-jū́rvasi ǀ kṣámi ǀevá ǀ daha ǀ mitra-mahaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ asma-dhrúk ǀ duḥ-mánmā ǀ káḥ ǀ ca ǀ vénati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As,Agni, you consume old timber on the earth, so, cherisher of friends, do you burn our injurer,whosoever evil-minded wishes (our ill).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ मर्ता॑य रि॒पवे॑ रक्ष॒स्विने॒ माघशं॑साय रीरधः । अस्रे॑धद्भिस्त॒रणि॑भिर्यविष्ठ्य शि॒वेभि॑: पाहि पा॒युभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ ripáve ǀ rakṣasvíne ǀ mā́ ǀ aghá-śaṃsāya ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀásredhat-bhiḥ ǀ taráṇi-bhiḥ ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ pāyú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Subject us not to a strong mortal enemy, nor to the malevolent; O most youthful, guard us with yourunharming delivering auspicious protections.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि नो॑ अग्न॒ एक॑या पा॒ह्यु१॒॑त द्वि॒तीय॑या । पा॒हि गी॒र्भिस्ति॒सृभि॑रूर्जां पते पा॒हि च॑त॒सृभि॑र्वसो
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ékayā ǀ pāhí ǀ utá ǀ dvitī́yayā ǀpāhí ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ tisṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ūrjām ǀ pate ǀ pāhí ǀ catasṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ vaso íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, protect us by one (rich), or protect us by a second; lord of strength, protect us by three sons;protect us, giver of dwellings, by four.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒हि विश्व॑स्माद्र॒क्षसो॒ अरा॑व्ण॒: प्र स्म॒ वाजे॑षु नोऽव । त्वामिद्धि नेदि॑ष्ठं दे॒वता॑तय आ॒पिं नक्षा॑महे वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: pāhí ǀ víśvasmāt ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀ prá ǀ sma ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ ava ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ āpím ǀ nákṣāmahe ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us from every impiousrākṣasa, shield us in battles; we approach you, our nearest neighbour,our kinsman, for sacrifice and for increase.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ अग्ने वयो॒वृधं॑ र॒यिं पा॑वक॒ शंस्य॑म् । रास्वा॑ च न उपमाते पुरु॒स्पृहं॒ सुनी॑ती॒ स्वय॑शस्तरम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ vayaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ rayím ǀ pāvaka ǀ śáṃsyam ǀrā́sva ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ upa-māte ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ sú-nītī ǀ sváyaśaḥ-taram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifyingAgni, bestow upon us food-augmenting excellent wealth; and (bring) us, O meter-out of good,by auspicious guidance, (a treasure) desired by many and bringing its own fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येन॒ वंसा॑म॒ पृत॑नासु॒ शर्ध॑त॒स्तर॑न्तो अ॒र्य आ॒दिश॑: । स त्वं नो॑ वर्ध॒ प्रय॑सा शचीवसो॒ जिन्वा॒ धियो॑ वसु॒विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ váṃsāma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śárdhataḥ ǀ tárantaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā-díśaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vardha ǀ práyasā ǀ śacīvaso íti śacī-vaso ǀ jínva ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ vasu-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By which we may escape and destroy in battles our impetuous weapon- aiming enemies; O you who bywisdom establish our rites, bless us with food, prosper our wealth-obtaining offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिशा॑नो वृष॒भो य॑था॒ग्निः शृङ्गे॒ दवि॑ध्वत् । ति॒ग्मा अ॑स्य॒ हन॑वो॒ न प्र॑ति॒धृषे॑ सु॒जम्भ॒: सह॑सो य॒हुः
shlokas.transliteration: śíśānaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yathā ǀ agníḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ dávidhvat ǀtigmā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ hánavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ prati-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ su-jámbhaḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ yahúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnitosses his horns, sharpening them as a bull; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; he is mightytoothed, this son of strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि ते॑ अग्ने वृषभ प्रति॒धृषे॒ जम्भा॑सो॒ यद्वि॒तिष्ठ॑से । स त्वं नो॑ होत॒: सुहु॑तं ह॒विष्कृ॑धि॒ वंस्वा॑ नो॒ वार्या॑ पु॒रु
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ prati-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ jámbhāsaḥ ǀ yát ǀ vi-tíṣṭhase ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ hotaríti ǀ sú-hutam ǀ havíḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ váṃsva ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ryā ǀ purú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since you spread out on all sides, your teeth, bullAgni, are not to be resisted; O offerer, do you makeour oblation rightly presented; give us many precious (gifts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शेषे॒ वने॑षु मा॒त्रोः सं त्वा॒ मर्ता॑स इन्धते । अत॑न्द्रो ह॒व्या व॑हसि हवि॒ष्कृत॒ आदिद्दे॒वेषु॑ राजसि
shlokas.transliteration: śéṣe ǀ váneṣu ǀ mātróḥ ǀ sám ǀ tvā ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ indhate ǀátandraḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ vahasi ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ devéṣu ǀ rājasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You sleep within your mothers in the woods, mortals kindle you; unwearied you bear the offerings of thesacrificer, then you shine among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त होता॑र॒स्तमिदी॑ळते॒ त्वाग्ने॑ सु॒त्यज॒मह्र॑यम् । भि॒नत्स्यद्रिं॒ तप॑सा॒ वि शो॒चिषा॒ प्राग्ने॑ तिष्ठ॒ जनाँ॒ अति॑
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ tám ǀ ít ǀ īḷate ǀ tvā ǀ ágne ǀ su-tyájam ǀ áhrayam ǀbhinátsí ǀ ádrim ǀ tápasā ǀ ví ǀ śocíṣā ǀ prá ǀ agne ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ jánān ǀ áti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven priests praise you,Agni, giver of good things and unfailing; you cleave the cloud with yourfierce splendour; go forth, having overcome our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॑ग्निं वो॒ अध्रि॑गुं हु॒वेम॑ वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । अ॒ग्निं हि॒तप्र॑यसः शश्व॒तीष्वा होता॑रं चर्षणी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: agním-agnim ǀ vaḥ ǀ ádhri-gum ǀ huvéma ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀagním ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ śaśvatī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ hótāram ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Now that we have cut the sacred grass, let us invoke for youAgni, Agni the irresistible; having plural cedthe oblations, let us invoke Agni, abiding in many (plural ces), the offerer of sacrifices for men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: केते॑न॒ शर्म॑न्त्सचते सुषा॒मण्यग्ने॒ तुभ्यं॑ चिकि॒त्वना॑ । इ॒ष॒ण्यया॑ नः पुरु॒रूप॒मा भ॑र॒ वाजं॒ नेदि॑ष्ठमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: kétena ǀ śárman ǀ sacate ǀ su-sāmáni ǀ ágne ǀ túbhyam ǀ cikitvánā ǀiṣaṇyáyā ǀ naḥ ǀ puru-rū́pam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ vā́jam ǀ nédiṣṭham ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The sacrificer) worships you by praises,Agni, with the experienced (priests) in the rite celebrated withbeautifulSāmanhymns;bring us of your own accord for our protection food of various kinds which may bealways in our reach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ जरि॑तर्वि॒श्पति॑स्तेपा॒नो दे॑व र॒क्षस॑: । अप्रो॑षिवान्गृ॒हप॑तिर्म॒हाँ अ॑सि दि॒वस्पा॒युर्दु॑रोण॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ járitaḥ ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ tepānáḥ ǀ deva ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀáproṣi-vān ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ diváḥ ǀ pāyúḥ ǀ duroṇa-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, worthy of praise, you are the guardian of men, the consumer of therākṣasas; you aregreat, you the never-absent guardian of the (worshipper's) house, the protector of heaven, ever present in thedwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॒ रक्ष॒ आ वे॑शीदाघृणीवसो॒ मा या॒तुर्या॑तु॒माव॑ताम् । प॒रो॒ग॒व्यू॒त्यनि॑रा॒मप॒ क्षुध॒मग्ने॒ सेध॑ रक्ष॒स्विन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ veśīt ǀ āghṛṇivaso ítyāghṛṇi-vaso ǀ mā́ ǀ yātúḥ ǀ yātu-mā́vatām ǀparaḥ-gavyūtí ǀ ánirām ǀ ápa ǀ kṣúdham ǀ ágne ǀ sédha ǀ rakṣasvínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O you brilliant wealth, let not therākṣasaenter us, nor the torment of the evil spirits;Agni, drive awayfurther than agavyūtifrom us poverty, hunger and the strong demons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भयं॑ शृ॒णव॑च्च न॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒र्वागि॒दं वच॑: । स॒त्राच्या॑ म॒घवा॒ सोम॑पीतये धि॒या शवि॑ष्ठ॒ आ ग॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: ubháyam ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ arvā́k ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀsatrā́cyā ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śáviṣṭhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndralisten to both these our hymns; may the mightiestMaghavancome to us, (plural ased) with ourdevoted offering, to drink theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं हि स्व॒राजं॑ वृष॒भं तमोज॑से धि॒षणे॑ निष्टत॒क्षतु॑: । उ॒तोप॒मानां॑ प्रथ॒मो नि षी॑दसि॒ सोम॑कामं॒ हि ते॒ मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ hí ǀ sva-rā́jam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ tám ǀ ójase ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ niḥ-tatakṣátuḥ ǀutá ǀ upa-mā́nām ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǀ sóma-kāmam ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him, self-resplendent, have heaven and earth formed as the showerer, him (they have formed) forstrength; therefore, you sit down first of your peers; your mind loved theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वृ॑षस्व पुरूवसो सु॒तस्ये॒न्द्रान्ध॑सः । वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॑ हरिवः पृ॒त्सु सा॑स॒हिमधृ॑ष्टं चिद्दधृ॒ष्वणि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ sutásya ǀ indra ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ sasahím ǀ ádhṛṣṭam ǀ cit ǀ dadhṛṣváṇim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, possessor of much wealth, pour the effusedSomawithin you; possessor of (bright) coursers, weknow you, the overpowerer in battles, the unconquerable, the conqueror.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप्रा॑मिसत्य मघव॒न्तथेद॑स॒दिन्द्र॒ क्रत्वा॒ यथा॒ वश॑: । स॒नेम॒ वाजं॒ तव॑ शिप्रि॒न्नव॑सा म॒क्षू चि॒द्यन्तो॑ अद्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: áprāmi-satya ǀ magha-van ǀ táthā ǀ ít ǀ asat ǀ índra ǀ krátvā ǀ yáthā ǀ váśaḥ ǀsanéma ǀ vā́jam ǀ táva ǀ śiprin ǀ ávasā ǀ makṣú ǀ cit ǀ yántaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra,Maghavanof unbroken truth, it ever comes to pass as you in your knowledge may desire, by yourprotection, O handsome-jawed, may we obtain food, speedily, O thunderer, subduing our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒ग्ध्यू॒३॒॑ षु श॑चीपत॒ इन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑: । भगं॒ न हि त्वा॑ य॒शसं॑ वसु॒विद॒मनु॑ शूर॒ चरा॑मसि
shlokas.transliteration: śagdhí ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ śacī-pate ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀbhágam ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ yaśásam ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ ánu ǀ śūra ǀ cárāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indr, lord of rites, give us (our desire) with all your helping powers; hero, we worship you as happiness,the glorious, the obtainer of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पौ॒रो अश्व॑स्य पुरु॒कृद्गवा॑म॒स्युत्सो॑ देव हिर॒ण्यय॑: । नकि॒र्हि दानं॑ परि॒मर्धि॑ष॒त्त्वे यद्य॒द्यामि॒ तदा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: pauráḥ ǀ áśvasya ǀ puru-kṛ́t ǀ gávām ǀ asi ǀ útsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ hí ǀ dā́nam ǀ pari-márdhiṣat ǀ tvé íti ǀ yát-yat ǀ yā́mi ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the increaser of horses, the multiplier of cows; you, deity, with your golden body; none canharm the gifts laid up for me in you; bring me whatever I ask.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्येहि॒ चेर॑वे वि॒दा भगं॒ वसु॑त्तये । उद्वा॑वृषस्व मघव॒न्गवि॑ष्टय॒ उदि॒न्द्राश्व॑मिष्टये
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ cérave ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ bhágam ǀ vásuttaye ǀút ǀ vavṛṣasva ǀ magha-van ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ út ǀ indra ǀ áśvam-iṣṭaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are (bounteous), come, may you obtain wealth to distribute to the worshipper; shower your bounty,Maghavan, on me desiring cows, shower it,Indra, on me desiring horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॑णि श॒तानि॑ च यू॒था दा॒नाय॑ मंहसे । आ पु॑रंद॒रं च॑कृम॒ विप्र॑वचस॒ इन्द्रं॒ गाय॒न्तोऽव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ purú ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ śatā́ni ǀ ca ǀ yūthā́ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ maṃhase ǀā́ ǀ puram-darám ǀ cakṛma ǀ vípra-vacasaḥ ǀ índram ǀ gā́yantaḥ ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You grant many hundreds and thousands of herds as a gift (to the offerer), uttering long praises, we,hymningIndra, the destroyer of cities, bring him before us for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वि॒प्रो वा॒ यदवि॑ध॒द्विप्रो॑ वेन्द्र ते॒ वच॑: । स प्र म॑मन्दत्त्वा॒या श॑तक्रतो॒ प्राचा॑मन्यो॒ अहं॑सन
shlokas.transliteration: avipráḥ ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ ávidhat ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vā ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ vácaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ prá ǀ mamandat ǀ tvā-yā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ prā́cāmanyo íti prā́cā-manyo ǀ áham-sana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, whether it be the unskilled or the skilled who celebrate your praise, each rejoices in his desire foryou, OŚatakratu, whose wrath presses ever forwards, who meet the foe, proclaiming, "It is I".”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रबा॑हुर्म्रक्ष॒कृत्वा॑ पुरंद॒रो यदि॑ मे शृ॒णव॒द्धव॑म् । व॒सू॒यवो॒ वसु॑पतिं श॒तक्र॑तुं॒ स्तोमै॒रिन्द्रं॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: ugrá-bāhuḥ ǀ mrakṣa-kṛ́tvā ǀ puram-daráḥ ǀ yádi ǀ me ǀ śṛṇávat ǀ hávam ǀvasu-yávaḥ ǀ vásu-patim ǀ śatá-kratum ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ índram ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If the strong-armed slayer of enemies, the destroyer of cities, will but hear my invocation, we, desiringwealth, will with our praises call oneIndraŚatakratu, the lord of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न पा॒पासो॑ मनामहे॒ नारा॑यासो॒ न जळ्ह॑वः । यदिन्न्विन्द्रं॒ वृष॑णं॒ सचा॑ सु॒ते सखा॑यं कृ॒णवा॑महै
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ pāpā́saḥ ǀ manāmahe ǀ ná ǀ árāyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ jáḷhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sácā ǀ suté ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛṇávāmahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We are not evil who worship him, nor too poor to offer gifts, nor destitute of sacred fires-- sinceassembled together, when theSomais effused, we makeIndra, the showerer, our friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रं यु॑युज्म॒ पृत॑नासु सास॒हिमृ॒णका॑ति॒मदा॑भ्यम् । वेदा॑ भृ॒मं चि॒त्सनि॑ता र॒थीत॑मो वा॒जिनं॒ यमिदू॒ नश॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ugrám ǀ yuyujma ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ sasahím ǀ ṛṇá-kātim ǀ ádābhyam ǀvéda ǀ bhṛmám ǀ cit ǀ sánitā ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ yám ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ náśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We join (to our rite) the mightyIndra, the subduer of enemies in battles, the inviolate, him to whompraise is due as a debt; he, the best of charioteers, knows (among steeds) the strong racer, and (among men)he, the bounteous (knows) the offerer whom he is to reach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत॑ इन्द्र॒ भया॑महे॒ ततो॑ नो॒ अभ॑यं कृधि । मघ॑वञ्छ॒ग्धि तव॒ तन्न॑ ऊ॒तिभि॒र्वि द्विषो॒ वि मृधो॑ जहि
shlokas.transliteration: yátaḥ ǀ indra ǀ bháyāmahe ǀ tátaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛdhi ǀmágha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ táva ǀ tám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, give us security from him of whom we are afraid,Maghavan, be strong for us with yourprotections; destroy our enemies, destroy those who harm us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि रा॑धस्पते॒ राध॑सो म॒हः क्षय॒स्यासि॑ विध॒तः । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं म॑घवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सु॒ताव॑न्तो हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ rādhaḥ-pate ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ kṣáyasya ǀ ási ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ sutá-vantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of wealth, you are (the bestower) of great wealth and a dwelling plural ce upon your worshipper; assuch, we invoke you, bearing theSoma, OMaghavan,Indra, who are to be honoured with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒: स्पळु॒त वृ॑त्र॒हा प॑र॒स्पा नो॒ वरे॑ण्यः । स नो॑ रक्षिषच्चर॒मं स म॑ध्य॒मं स प॒श्चात्पा॑तु नः पु॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ spáṭ ǀ utá ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ paraḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rakṣiṣat ǀ caramám ǀ sáḥ ǀ madhyamám ǀ sáḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǀ puráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the all-knower, the slayer ofVṛtra, the protector, is to be chosen by us; may he guard our (son),our last (son), our middle (son), may he protect us from behind and before.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: प॒श्चाद॑ध॒रादु॑त्त॒रात्पु॒र इन्द्र॒ नि पा॑हि वि॒श्वत॑: । आ॒रे अ॒स्मत्कृ॑णुहि॒ दैव्यं॑ भ॒यमा॒रे हे॒तीरदे॑वीः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ adharā́t ǀ uttarā́t ǀ puráḥ ǀ índra ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀāré ǀ asmát ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ dáivyam ǀ bhayám ǀ āré ǀ hetī́ḥ ǀ ádevīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, protect us from the west, from the south, from the north, from the east, protect us from every side;keep far from us supernatural alarm, keep afar the weapons of the demons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्याद्या॒ श्वःश्व॒ इन्द्र॒ त्रास्व॑ प॒रे च॑ नः । विश्वा॑ च नो जरि॒तॄन्त्स॑त्पते॒ अहा॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॑ च रक्षिषः
shlokas.transliteration: adyá-adya ǀ śváḥ-śvaḥ ǀ índra ǀ trā́sva ǀ paré ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ jaritṝ́n ǀ sat-pate ǀ áhā ǀ dívā ǀ náktam ǀ ca ǀ rakṣiṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Save us,Indra, every today, every tomorrow, and every succeeding day; lord of the good, protect us,your praisers, in all days, by day and night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒भ॒ङ्गी शूरो॑ म॒घवा॑ तु॒वीम॑घ॒: सम्मि॑श्लो वि॒र्या॑य॒ कम् । उ॒भा ते॑ बा॒हू वृष॑णा शतक्रतो॒ नि या वज्रं॑ मिमि॒क्षतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pra-bhaṅgī́ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ tuví-maghaḥ ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ kám ǀubhā́ ǀ te ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ ní ǀ yā́ ǀ vájram ǀ mimikṣátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavanis the shatterer, the hero, great in wealth, and the conductor to victory (over our enemies),Śatakratu, both your arms, which grasp the thunderbolt, are the showerers (of blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो अ॑स्मा॒ उप॑स्तुतिं॒ भर॑ता॒ यज्जुजो॑षति । उ॒क्थैरिन्द्र॑स्य॒ माहि॑नं॒ वयो॑ वर्धन्ति सो॒मिनो॑ भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ asmai ǀ úpa-stutim ǀ bhárata ǀ yát ǀ jújoṣati ǀuktháiḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ mā́hinam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ somínaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Present the offering of praise toIndra, since he enjoys it; (the priests) augment the ample food of theSoma-loving Indra with their recited hymns, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यु॒जो अस॑मो॒ नृभि॒रेक॑: कृ॒ष्टीर॒यास्य॑: । पू॒र्वीरति॒ प्र वा॑वृधे॒ विश्वा॑ जा॒तान्योज॑सा भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayujáḥ ǀ ásamaḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kṛṣṭī́ḥ ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ prá ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ ójasā ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Without a fellow and unlike the other gods, he alone, unconquerable, surpasses the men of formertimes, he surpasses in might all beings;Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अहि॑तेन चि॒दर्व॑ता जी॒रदा॑नुः सिषासति । प्र॒वाच्य॑मिन्द्र॒ तत्तव॑ वी॒र्या॑णि करिष्य॒तो भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áhitena ǀ cit ǀ árvatā ǀ jīrá-dānuḥ ǀ sisāsati ǀpra-vā́cyam ǀ indra ǀ tát ǀ táva ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ kariṣyatáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the swift giver, wishes to bestow blessings (upon us) with his unurged courser, your greatness,Indra, as you are about to display your powers, should be proclaimed, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॑हि कृ॒णवा॑म त॒ इन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि॒ वर्ध॑ना । येभि॑: शविष्ठ चा॒कनो॑ भ॒द्रमि॒ह श्र॑वस्य॒ते भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ te ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ várdhanā ǀyébhiḥ ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀ cākánaḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ ihá ǀ śravasyaté ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, come here; let us perform for you our sacred rites augmenting your vigour; by which (rites), mostmightyone, you desire to bless him who wishes for food; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धृ॒ष॒तश्चि॑द्धृ॒षन्मन॑: कृ॒णोषी॑न्द्र॒ यत्त्वम् । ती॒व्रैः सोमै॑: सपर्य॒तो नमो॑भिः प्रति॒भूष॑तो भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dhṛṣatáḥ ǀ cit ǀ dhṛṣát ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇóṣi ǀ indra ǀ yát ǀ tvám ǀtīvráiḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ saparyatáḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ prati-bhū́ṣataḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have made your mind,Indra, more resolute than the resolute, since you (wish to give the desires)of him who worships you with the intoxicatingSomaand adorns you with adorations; Indra's gifts are worthy ofpraise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ चष्ट॒ ऋची॑षमोऽव॒ताँ इ॑व॒ मानु॑षः । जु॒ष्ट्वी दक्ष॑स्य सो॒मिन॒: सखा॑यं कृणुते॒ युजं॑ भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ caṣṭe ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǀ avatā́n-iva ǀ mā́nuṣaḥ ǀjuṣṭvī́ ǀ dákṣasya ǀ somínaḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ yújam ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who is well-deserving of the hymn, looks down (with favour) upon us as a (thirsty) man (looksdown) on wells; and being well-plural ased he makes the energeticSoma-offerer his friend; Indra's gifts are worthyof praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ त इन्द्र वी॒र्यं॑ दे॒वा अनु॒ क्रतुं॑ ददुः । भुवो॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ गोप॑तिः पुरुष्टुत भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vīryám ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ daduḥ ǀbhúvaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ gó-patiḥ ǀ puru-stuta ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by the example of your power and knowledge the gods attain the same; O hymned by many, youare herdsman of the universe; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒णे तदि॑न्द्र ते॒ शव॑ उप॒मं दे॒वता॑तये । यद्धंसि॑ वृ॒त्रमोज॑सा शचीपते भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: gṛṇé ǀ tát ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀ upa-mám ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyát ǀ háṃsi ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ójasā ǀ śacī-pate ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, I laud that might of yours which isnear athandto the worshipper-- (I laud you) that you slayVṛtra,O lord of rites, by your strength; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॑नेव वपुष्य॒तः कृ॒णव॒न्मानु॑षा यु॒गा । वि॒दे तदिन्द्र॒श्चेत॑न॒मध॑ श्रु॒तो भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sámanā-iva ǀ vapuṣyatáḥ ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǀvidé ǀ tát ǀ índraḥ ǀ cétanam ǀ ádha ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a woman who shows no partiality wins her lovers to her, soIndraconfers periods of time onmankind;it is Indra who has performed that knowledge- giving achievement, therefore he is renowned; Indra's gifts areworthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उज्जा॒तमि॑न्द्र ते॒ शव॒ उत्त्वामुत्तव॒ क्रतु॑म् । भूरि॑गो॒ भूरि॑ वावृधु॒र्मघ॑व॒न्तव॒ शर्म॑णि भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ jātám ǀ indra ǀ te ǀ śávaḥ ǀ út ǀ tvā́m ǀ út ǀ táva ǀ krátum ǀbhū́rigo íti bhū́ri-go ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ mágha-van ǀ táva ǀ śármaṇi ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavan, rich in cattle, (those who abide) in your happiness have greatly augmented your might whenit was born, (they have greatly augmented) you,Indraand your knwoeldge; Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं च॒ त्वं च॑ वृत्रह॒न्त्सं यु॑ज्याव स॒निभ्य॒ आ । अ॒रा॒ती॒वा चि॑दद्रि॒वोऽनु॑ नौ शूर मंसते भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ ca ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ sám ǀ yujyāva ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀarāti-vā́ ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ nau ǀ śūra ǀ maṃsate ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May I and you, slayer ofVṛtra, be close to you united until wealth is obtained; hero, wielding thethunderbolt, even the niggard concedes (that our union gives wealth);Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमिद्वा उ॒ तं व॒यमिन्द्रं॑ स्तवाम॒ नानृ॑तम् । म॒हाँ असु॑न्वतो व॒धो भूरि॒ ज्योतीं॑षि सुन्व॒तो भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: satyám ǀ ít ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tám ǀ vayám ǀ índram ǀ stavāma ǀ ná ǀ ánṛtam ǀmahā́n ǀ ásunvataḥ ǀ vadháḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us praise thatIndrawith truth, not with untruth, great is the destruction of him who offers not but tohim who offers abundantSoma-oblations, Indra's gifts are worthy of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पू॒र्व्यो म॒हानां॑ वे॒नः क्रतु॑भिरानजे । यस्य॒ द्वारा॒ मनु॑ष्पि॒ता दे॒वेषु॒ धिय॑ आन॒जे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ mahā́nām ǀ venáḥ ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ ānaje ǀyásya ǀ dvā́rā ǀ mánuḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ānajé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, (Indra), the chief of those to be honoured, desirous of our offerings, approaches; he, the doors ofwhose favour, the sacred rites,Manu, the (universal) father, attained among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो मानं॒ नोत्स॑द॒न्त्सोम॑पृष्ठासो॒ अद्र॑यः । उ॒क्था ब्रह्म॑ च॒ शंस्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ mā́nam ǀ ná ǀ út ǀ sadan ǀ sóma-pṛṣṭhāsaḥ ǀ ádrayaḥ ǀukthā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ ca ǀ śáṃsyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the stones which press out theSomanever forsakeIndra, maker of heaven, nor the praises andhymns which are to be uttered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वि॒द्वाँ अङ्गि॑रोभ्य॒ इन्द्रो॒ गा अ॑वृणो॒दप॑ । स्तु॒षे तद॑स्य॒ पौंस्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avṛṇot ǀ ápa ǀstuṣé ǀ tát ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the wiseIndra, discovered the cows to theAṅgirasas; I glorify that his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॒त्नथा॑ कविवृ॒ध इन्द्रो॑ वा॒कस्य॑ व॒क्षणि॑: । शि॒वो अ॒र्कस्य॒ होम॑न्यस्म॒त्रा ग॒न्त्वव॑से
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratná-thā ǀ kavi-vṛdháḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vākásya ǀ vakṣáṇiḥ ǀśiváḥ ǀ arkásya ǀ hómani ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ gantu ǀ ávase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As in former times, so now too isIndrathe blesser of the worshipper and the bearer of him who praiseshim; may he come among us auspicious for our protection at the oblation of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदू॒ नु ते॒ अनु॒ क्रतुं॒ स्वाहा॒ वर॑स्य॒ यज्य॑वः । श्वा॒त्रम॒र्का अ॑नूष॒तेन्द्र॑ गो॒त्रस्य॑ दा॒वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ svā́hā ǀ várasya ǀ yájyavaḥ ǀśvātrám ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ índra ǀ gotrásya ǀ dāváne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Forthwith,Indra, as they offer toAgnithe lord ofSvāhā, the singers successively praise your deeds,for your attainment of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॒ विश्वा॑नि वी॒र्या॑ कृ॒तानि॒ कर्त्वा॑नि च । यम॒र्का अ॑ध्व॒रं वि॒दुः
shlokas.transliteration: índre ǀ víśvāni ǀ vīryā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀ kártvāni ǀ ca ǀyám ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In thatIndra, whom the singers know as the unharming, all past and future powers abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्पाञ्च॑जन्यया वि॒शेन्द्रे॒ घोषा॒ असृ॑क्षत । अस्तृ॑णाद्ब॒र्हणा॑ वि॒पो॒३॒॑ऽर्यो मान॑स्य॒ स क्षय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ pā́ñca-janyayā ǀ viśā́ ǀ índre ǀ ghóṣāḥ ǀ ásṛkṣata ǀástṛṇāt ǀ barháṇā ǀ vipáḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ mā́nasya ǀ sáḥ ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When praises are addressed toIndraby the men of the five classes, he destroys their enemies by hismight; he, the lord, is the abode of the worshipper's homage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यमु॑ ते॒ अनु॑ष्टुतिश्चकृ॒षे तानि॒ पौंस्या॑ । प्राव॑श्च॒क्रस्य॑ वर्त॒निम्
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ ánu-stutiḥ ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ tā́ni ǀ páuṃsyā ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ cakrásya ǀ vartaním ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This praise is yours, for you have achieved those exploits; you have guarded the road of ourchariot-wheel (to the sacrificial rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य वृष्णो॒ व्योद॑न उ॒रु क्र॑मिष्ट जी॒वसे॑ । यवं॒ न प॒श्व आ द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ vi-ódane ǀ urú ǀ kramiṣṭa ǀ jīváse ǀyávam ǀ ná ǀ paśváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the various sustenance, given byIndra, the showerer, is obtained, all men step over with widestrides for (dear) life; they receive it as cattle and barley.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्दधा॑ना अव॒स्यवो॑ यु॒ष्माभि॒र्दक्ष॑पितरः । स्याम॑ म॒रुत्व॑तो वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀ yuṣmā́bhiḥ ǀ dákṣa-pitaraḥ ǀsyā́ma ǀ marútvataḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Presenting our praise, and desiring protection, may we with you (O priests) be lords of food, to offersacrifice to (Indra) attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बळृ॒त्विया॑य॒ धाम्न॒ ऋक्व॑भिः शूर नोनुमः । जेषा॑मेन्द्र॒ त्वया॑ यु॒जा
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ ṛtvíyāya ǀ dhā́mne ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ śūra ǀ nonumaḥ ǀjéṣāma ǀ indra ǀ tváyā ǀ yujā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero, by our hymns we offer praise to you, who appear at the time of sacrifice, and wear auspicioussplendour; with you as our ally may we conquer (our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे रु॒द्रा मे॒हना॒ पर्व॑तासो वृत्र॒हत्ये॒ भर॑हूतौ स॒जोषा॑: । यः शंस॑ते स्तुव॒ते धायि॑ प॒ज्र इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा अ॒स्माँ अ॑वन्तु दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ mehánā ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ bhára-hūtau ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ śáṃsate ǀ stuvaté ǀ dhā́yi ǀ pajráḥ ǀ índra-jyeṣṭhāḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ avantu ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheRudras, the showering clouds, and (Indra) who rejoices with us in the battle-challenge which bringsVṛtra's destruction, and who comes in his might to the reciter and singer of his praises-- may these gods, withIndra at their head, protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्त्वा॑ मन्दन्तु॒ स्तोमा॑: कृणु॒ष्व राधो॑ अद्रिवः । अव॑ ब्रह्म॒द्विषो॑ जहि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ tvā ǀ mandantu ǀ stómāḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣvá ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀáva ǀ brahma-dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our praises exhilarate you, thunderer, make food for us, destroy the haters of thebrāhmaṇas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒दा प॒णीँर॑रा॒धसो॒ नि बा॑धस्व म॒हाँ अ॑सि । न॒हि त्वा॒ कश्च॒न प्रति॑
shlokas.transliteration: padā́ ǀ paṇī́n ǀ arādhásaḥ ǀ ní ǀ bādhasva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀnahí ǀ tvā ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ práti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Crush with your foot thepaṇiswho offer no oblations; you are mighty; there is none else like unto you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमी॑शिषे सु॒ताना॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वमसु॑तानाम् । त्वं राजा॒ जना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sutā́nām ǀ indra ǀ tvám ǀ ásutānām ǀtvám ǀ rā́jā ǀ jánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are the lord of theSomaeffused or not effused, you are the king of all men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एहि॒ प्रेहि॒ क्षयो॑ दि॒व्या॒३॒॑घोष॑ञ्चर्षणी॒नाम् । ओभे पृ॑णासि॒ रोद॑सी
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ ihi ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ diví ǀ ā-ghóṣan ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ pṛṇāsi ǀ ródasī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, here, come forth from heaven to our dwelling, shouting for the sake of men; you fill both heavenand earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॒त्पर्व॑तं गि॒रिं श॒तव॑न्तं सह॒स्रिण॑म् । वि स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ रुरोजिथ
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ párvatam ǀ girím ǀ śatá-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀví ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ rurojitha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you burst, for your worshippers, the gnarled cloud with its hundreds and thousands of showers”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमु॑ त्वा॒ दिवा॑ सु॒ते व॒यं नक्तं॑ हवामहे । अ॒स्माकं॒ काम॒मा पृ॑ण
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dívā ǀ suté ǀ vayám ǀ náktam ǀ havāmahe ǀasmā́kam ǀ kā́mam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you when theSomais effused by day, we invoke you by night; fulfil our desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व१॒॑ स्य वृ॑ष॒भो युवा॑ तुवि॒ग्रीवो॒ अना॑नतः । ब्र॒ह्मा कस्तं स॑पर्यति
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ syáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ tuvi-grī́vaḥ ǀ ánānataḥ ǀbrahmā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ tám ǀ saparyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where is that ever-youthful showerer, strong-necked and bowing to none? What hymner worships you?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कस्य॑ स्वि॒त्सव॑नं॒ वृषा॑ जुजु॒ष्वाँ अव॑ गच्छति । इन्द्रं॒ क उ॑ स्वि॒दा च॑के
shlokas.transliteration: kásya ǀ svit ǀ sávanam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ jujuṣvā́n ǀ áva ǀ gacchati ǀíndram ǀ káḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To whose offering does the showerer come down plural ased? Who can praiseIndra?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कं ते॑ दा॒ना अ॑सक्षत॒ वृत्र॑ह॒न्कं सु॒वीर्या॑ । उ॒क्थे क उ॑ स्वि॒दन्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: kám ǀ te ǀ dānā́ḥ ǀ asakṣata ǀ vṛ́tra-han ǀ kám ǀ su-vī́ryā ǀukthé ǀ káḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svit ǀ ántamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In what character, O slayer ofVṛtra, do the sacrificial offerings honour you, or the brave praises in thehymn? Who is nearest (in time of battle)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॒ मानु॑षे॒ जने॒ सोम॑: पू॒रुषु॑ सूयते । तस्येहि॒ प्र द्र॑वा॒ पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pūrúṣu ǀ sūyate ǀtásya ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ drava ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you is thisSomaeffused among men by me of mortal race; draw near, hasten, drink it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॑ शर्य॒णाव॑ति सु॒षोमा॑या॒मधि॑ प्रि॒यः । आ॒र्जी॒कीये॑ म॒दिन्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ su-sómāyām ǀ ádhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀārjīkī́ye ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is your beloved most exhilaratingSomawhich grows in the Śaryaṇāvat lake by the Suṣomāriver in the Ārjikīya country.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॒द्य राध॑से म॒हे चारुं॒ मदा॑य॒ घृष्व॑ये । एही॑मिन्द्र॒ द्रवा॒ पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ adyá ǀ rā́dhase ǀ mahé ǀ cā́rum ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀā́ ǀ ihi ǀ īm ǀ indra ǀ dráva ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come today,Indra, hasten, drink this gratefulSomafor our great wealth, and for your own foe-crushingexultation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदि॑न्द्र॒ प्रागपा॒गुद॒ङ्न्य॑ग्वा हू॒यसे॒ नृभि॑: । आ या॑हि॒ तूय॑मा॒शुभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ indra ǀ prā́k ǀ ápāk ǀ údak ǀ nyák ǀ vā ǀ hūyáse ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you are invoked by us, the leaders of rites, from the east, the west, the norh, or the south,come here quickly with your rapid steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॑ प्र॒स्रव॑णे दि॒वो मा॒दया॑से॒ स्व॑र्णरे । यद्वा॑ समु॒द्रे अन्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā ǀ pra-srávaṇe ǀ diváḥ ǀ mādáyāse ǀ sváḥ-nare ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ samudré ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether you rejoice in the ambrosia-fountain of heaven, or in some other heavenward-leading sacrifice(on earth), or in the ocean-like firmament of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ गी॒र्भिर्म॒हामु॒रुं हु॒वे गामि॑व॒ भोज॑से । इन्द्र॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ urúm ǀ huvé ǀ gā́m-iva ǀ bhójase ǀíndra ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, by my praises I invoke you, great and strong one, to drink theSomaas a bull to eat (his fodder).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त॑ इन्द्र महि॒मानं॒ हर॑यो देव ते॒ मह॑: । रथे॑ वहन्तु॒ बिभ्र॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ deva ǀ te ǀ máhaḥ ǀráthe ǀ vahantu ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your steeds,Indra, bearing you in your chariot, bring hither yourmight, (may they bring here) yoursplendour, O divine one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ गृणी॒ष उ॑ स्तु॒षे म॒हाँ उ॒ग्र ई॑शान॒कृत् । एहि॑ नः सु॒तं पिब॑
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ gṛṇīṣé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ stuṣé ǀ mahā́n ǀ ugráḥ ǀ īśāna-kṛ́t ǀā́ ǀ ihi ǀ naḥ ǀ sutám ǀ píba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, you are invoked, you are praised, the great, the strong, the wilder of sovereignty; come here anddrink our libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ताव॑न्तस्त्वा व॒यं प्रय॑स्वन्तो हवामहे । इ॒दं नो॑ ब॒र्हिरा॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sutá-vantaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀidám ǀ naḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearing the effusedSomaand the sacrificial food, we invoke you,Indra, to sit on our sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यच्चि॒द्धि शश्व॑ता॒मसीन्द्र॒ साधा॑रण॒स्त्वम् । तं त्वा॑ व॒यं ह॑वामहे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatām ǀ ási ǀ índra ǀ sā́dhāraṇaḥ ǀ tvám ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Because you are common to many worshippers, therefore,Indra, we invoke you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं ते॑ सो॒म्यं मध्वधु॑क्ष॒न्नद्रि॑भि॒र्नर॑: । जु॒षा॒ण इ॑न्द्र॒ तत्पि॑ब
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ te ǀ somyám ǀ mádhu ǀ ádhukṣan ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ indra ǀ tát ǀ piba ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests have milked for you with their stones this nectar of theSoma; drink it,Indra, well plural ased.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वाँ॑ अ॒र्यो वि॑प॒श्चितोऽति॑ ख्य॒स्तूय॒मा ग॑हि । अ॒स्मे धे॑हि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvān ǀ aryáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ áti ǀ khyaḥ ǀ tū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀasmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, the lord, pass by all other worshippers and come quickly to us, and bestow on us abundantfood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दा॒ता मे॒ पृष॑तीनां॒ राजा॑ हिरण्य॒वीना॑म् । मा दे॑वा म॒घवा॑ रिषत्
shlokas.transliteration: dātā́ ǀ me ǀ pṛ́ṣatīnām ǀ rā́jā ǀ hiraṇya-vī́nām ǀmā́ ǀ devāḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ riṣat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (Indra) the king give me cows adorned with gold; O gods, let notMaghavanbe harmed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रे॒ पृष॑तीना॒मधि॑ श्च॒न्द्रं बृ॒हत्पृ॒थु । शु॒क्रं हिर॑ण्य॒मा द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: sahásre ǀ pṛ́ṣatīnām ǀ ádhi ǀ candrám ǀ bṛhát ǀ pṛthú ǀśukrám ǀ híraṇyam ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Upon a thousand cows I obtain gold, abundant, delightful, wide-spread, and pure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नपा॑तो दु॒र्गह॑स्य मे स॒हस्रे॑ण सु॒राध॑सः । श्रवो॑ दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत
shlokas.transliteration: nápātaḥ ǀ duḥ-gáhasya ǀ me ǀ sahásreṇa ǀ su-rā́dhasaḥ ǀśrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ akrata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural nged as I am in sorrow, my children, by the favour of the gods, obtain food, and are blessed withabundance in a thousand cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तरो॑भिर्वो वि॒दद्व॑सु॒मिन्द्रं॑ स॒बाध॑ ऊ॒तये॑ । बृ॒हद्गाय॑न्तः सु॒तसो॑मे अध्व॒रे हु॒वे भरं॒ न का॒रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: táraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ vidát-vasum ǀ índram ǀ sa-bā́dhaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀbṛhát ǀ gā́yantaḥ ǀ sutá-some ǀ adhvaré ǀ huvé ǀ bháram ǀ ná ǀ kāríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thronging together, (worship) for your protectionIndrafull of might and the revealer of wealth; (worshiphim), chanting theBṛhat-sāmanat his sacrifice where theSomais effused, I invoke him as (men invoke) abeneficent master of a household.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यं दु॒ध्रा वर॑न्ते॒ न स्थि॒रा मुरो॒ मदे॑ सुशि॒प्रमन्ध॑सः । य आ॒दृत्या॑ शशमा॒नाय॑ सुन्व॒ते दाता॑ जरि॒त्र उ॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yám ǀ dudhrā́ḥ ǀ várante ǀ ná ǀ sthirā́ḥ ǀ múraḥ ǀ máde ǀ su-śiprám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ ā-dṛ́tya ǀ śaśamānā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀ dā́tā ǀ jaritré ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the handsome-jawed, whom, inthe intoxication of theSoma, the fierce (demons) withstand not, north firm gods, nor mortal (men)-- who confers glorious wealth on him who reverently praises him, offers the Somaand sings hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः श॒क्रो मृ॒क्षो अश्व्यो॒ यो वा॒ कीजो॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑: । स ऊ॒र्वस्य॑ रेजय॒त्यपा॑वृति॒मिन्द्रो॒ गव्य॑स्य वृत्र॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ śakráḥ ǀ mṛkṣáḥ ǀ áśvyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ kī́jaḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ ūrvásya ǀ rejayati ǀ ápa-vṛtim ǀ índraḥ ǀ gávyasya ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “HeŚakra, who is the purifier (of his worshippers), and well-skilled in horses, who is wonderful andgolden-bodied-- he,Indra, the slayer ofVṛtra, shakes the hiding-plural ce of the numerous herd of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निखा॑तं चि॒द्यः पु॑रुसम्भृ॒तं वसूदिद्वप॑ति दा॒शुषे॑ । व॒ज्री सु॑शि॒प्रो हर्य॑श्व॒ इत्क॑र॒दिन्द्र॒: क्रत्वा॒ यथा॒ वश॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ní-khātam ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ puru-sambhṛtám ǀ vásu ǀ út ǀ ít ǀ vápati ǀ dāśúṣe ǀvajrī́ ǀ su-śipráḥ ǀ hári-aśvaḥ ǀ ít ǀ karat ǀ índraḥ ǀ krátvā ǀ yáthā ǀ váśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who verily pours forth to the offerer the buried wealth accusative ulated by many, he,Indra, thethunderer, handsome-jawed, borne on bay steeds, does as he plural ases, (when propitiated) with sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वा॒वन्थ॑ पुरुष्टुत पु॒रा चि॑च्छूर नृ॒णाम् । व॒यं तत्त॑ इन्द्र॒ सं भ॑रामसि य॒ज्ञमु॒क्थं तु॒रं वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vavántha ǀ puru-stuta ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ śūra ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀvayám ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sám ǀ bharāmasi ǀ yajñám ǀ ukthám ǀ turám ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero, praised of many, what of old time you did desire from your votaries, that,Indra, we hasten to bringto you-- oblation and recited praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सचा॒ सोमे॑षु पुरुहूत वज्रिवो॒ मदा॑य द्युक्ष सोमपाः । त्वमिद्धि ब्र॑ह्म॒कृते॒ काम्यं॒ वसु॒ देष्ठ॑: सुन्व॒ते भुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sácā ǀ sómeṣu ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ dyukṣa ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀtvám ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ brahma-kṛ́te ǀ kā́myam ǀ vásu ǀ déṣṭhaḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ bhúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of the thunderbolt, invoked of many, radiant, drinker of theSoma, be present at our libations foryour exhilaration; for you are an abundant giver of desirable wealth to him who utters your praises and effusesthe Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमे॑नमि॒दा ह्योऽपी॑पेमे॒ह व॒ज्रिण॑म् । तस्मा॑ उ अ॒द्य स॑म॒ना सु॒तं भ॒रा नू॒नं भू॑षत श्रु॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ enam ǀ idā́ ǀ hyáḥ ǀ ápīpema ǀ ihá ǀ vajríṇam ǀtásmai ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ adyá ǀ samanā́ ǀ sutám ǀ bhara ǀ ā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ bhūṣata ǀ śruté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Today and yesterday we have here refreshed him, the thunderer; bring to him today our libation effusedfor (success in) battle; let him now hasten here on hearing our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृक॑श्चिदस्य वार॒ण उ॑रा॒मथि॒रा व॒युने॑षु भूषति । सेमं न॒: स्तोमं॑ जुजुषा॒ण आ ग॒हीन्द्र॒ प्र चि॒त्रया॑ धि॒या
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́kaḥ ǀ cit ǀ asya ǀ vāraṇáḥ ǀ urā-máthiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ bhūṣati ǀsáḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ stómam ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ índra ǀ prá ǀ citráyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The obstructing robber, the destroyer of travelling enemies, is obedient to him in hiw ways; hasten,Indra, (drawn) by our gorgeous rite, welcoming this our hymn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कदू॒ न्व१॒॑स्याकृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्यास्ति॒ पौंस्य॑म् । केनो॒ नु कं॒ श्रोम॑तेन॒ न शु॑श्रुवे ज॒नुष॒: परि॑ वृत्र॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ ákṛtam ǀ índrasya ǀ asti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀkéno íti ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ śrómatena ǀ ná ǀ śuśruve ǀ janúṣaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What act of might is there, unperformed byIndra? Who has not heard of his famous (heroism)? He, theslayer ofVṛtra, (is renowned) from his birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कदू॑ म॒हीरधृ॑ष्टा अस्य॒ तवि॑षी॒: कदु॑ वृत्र॒घ्नो अस्तृ॑तम् । इन्द्रो॒ विश्वा॑न्बेक॒नाटाँ॑ अह॒र्दृश॑ उ॒त क्रत्वा॑ प॒णीँर॒भि
shlokas.transliteration: kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ádhṛṣṭāḥ ǀ asya ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ vṛtra-ghnáḥ ǀ ástṛtam ǀíndraḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ beka-nā́ṭān ǀ ahaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ utá ǀ krátvā ǀ paṇī́n ǀ abhí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When were his mighty forces ever languid? When was aught undestroyed before the slayer ofVṛtra?Indraby his energy overpowers all the huckstering usurers who see only this world's days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं घा॑ ते॒ अपू॒र्व्येन्द्र॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि वृत्रहन् । पु॒रू॒तमा॑सः पुरुहूत वज्रिवो भृ॒तिं न प्र भ॑रामसि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ ápūrvyā ǀ índra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ vṛtra-han ǀpuru-támāsaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀ bhṛtím ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ bharāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, slayer of Vṛra, invoked of many, we, your many worshippers, offer new hymns to you, thunderer,as your wages.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒र्वीश्चि॒द्धि त्वे तु॑विकूर्मिन्ना॒शसो॒ हव॑न्त इन्द्रो॒तय॑: । ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्यः सव॒ना व॑सो गहि॒ शवि॑ष्ठ श्रु॒धि मे॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pūrvī́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvé íti ǀ tuvi-kūrmin ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǀ hávante ǀ indra ǀ ūtáyaḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ cit ǀ aryáḥ ǀ sávanā ǀ ā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ gahi ǀ śáviṣṭha ǀ śrudhí ǀ me ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, doer of many great deeds, (other worshippers) invoke the manifold hopes and protections whichabide in you; but rejecting the enemy's oblations, come to us bestower of dwellings; O mightiest, hear my appeal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं घा॑ ते॒ त्वे इद्विन्द्र॒ विप्रा॒ अपि॑ ष्मसि । न॒हि त्वद॒न्यः पु॑रुहूत॒ कश्च॒न मघ॑व॒न्नस्ति॑ मर्डि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ gha ǀ te ǀ tvé íti ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ índra ǀ víprāḥ ǀ ápi ǀ smasi ǀnahí ǀ tvát ǀ anyáḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ mágha-van ǀ ásti ǀ marḍitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, we are your, therefore we, your worshippers, depend on you; other than you,Maghavan, invokedof many, there is no giver of happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अ॒स्या अम॑तेरु॒त क्षु॒धो॒३॒॑ऽभिश॑स्ते॒रव॑ स्पृधि । त्वं न॑ ऊ॒ती तव॑ चि॒त्रया॑ धि॒या शिक्षा॑ शचिष्ठ गातु॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ ámateḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣudháḥ ǀ abhí-śasteḥ ǀ áva ǀ spṛdhi ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ táva ǀ citráyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śíkṣa ǀ śaciṣṭha ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deliver from us this poverty, hunger and calumny; give us (our desire) by your protection and wondrousworking; O mightiest, you know the right way.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॒ इद्व॑: सु॒तो अ॑स्तु॒ कल॑यो॒ मा बि॑भीतन । अपेदे॒ष ध्व॒स्माय॑ति स्व॒यं घै॒षो अपा॑यति
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ít ǀ vaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ astu ǀ kálayaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ bibhītana ǀápa ǀ ít ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ dhvasmā́ ǀ ayati ǀ svayám ǀ gha ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ayati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your effusedSomabe only (forIndra); O sons ofKali, fear not; that malignant (spirit) departs, of hisown accord he departs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यान्नु क्ष॒त्रियाँ॒ अव॑ आदि॒त्यान्या॑चिषामहे । सु॒मृ॒ळी॒काँ अ॒भिष्ट॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: tyā́n ǀ nú ǀ kṣatríyān ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ādityā́n ǀ yāciṣāmahe ǀsu-mṛḷīkā́n ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit for protection thosekṣatriyas, theĀdityaswho bless (their votaries) abundantly to theattainment of their desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्रो नो॒ अत्यं॑ह॒तिं वरु॑णः पर्षदर्य॒मा । आ॒दि॒त्यासो॒ यथा॑ वि॒दुः
shlokas.transliteration: mitráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áti ǀ aṃhatím ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ parṣat ǀ aryamā́ ǀādityā́saḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theĀdityas,Mitra,Varuṇa, andAryaman, bear us across our distress, as they know it well.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेषां॒ हि चि॒त्रमु॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ वरू॑थ॒मस्ति॑ दा॒शुषे॑ । आ॒दि॒त्याना॑मरं॒कृते॑
shlokas.transliteration: téṣām ǀ hí ǀ citrám ǀ ukthyám ǀ várūtham ǀ ásti ǀ dāśúṣe ǀādityā́nām ǀ aram-kṛ́te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thoseĀdityasbelongs wonderful wealth, worthy of all praise, (laid up) for the offerer of oblationsand the sacrificer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॑ वो मह॒तामवो॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्रार्य॑मन् । अवां॒स्या वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ ávaḥ ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀávāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are great,Varuṇa,MitraandAryaman, and great is your protection; your protections we implore.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जी॒वान्नो॑ अ॒भि धे॑त॒नादि॑त्यासः पु॒रा हथा॑त् । कद्ध॑ स्थ हवनश्रुतः
shlokas.transliteration: jīvā́n ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dhetana ǀ ā́dityāsaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ háthāt ǀkát ǀ ha ǀ stha ǀ havana-śrutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, hasten to us before our death, while we are yet alive; where are you, hearers of prayer?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्व॑: श्रा॒न्ताय॑ सुन्व॒ते वरू॑थ॒मस्ति॒ यच्छ॒र्दिः । तेना॑ नो॒ अधि॑ वोचत
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ śrāntā́ya ǀ sunvaté ǀ várūtham ǀ ásti ǀ yát ǀ chardíḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever wealh, whatever dwelling is yours (to give) to the wearied offerer of libations-- with thesespeak to us a kindly answer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ति॑ देवा अं॒होरु॒र्वस्ति॒ रत्न॒मना॑गसः । आदि॑त्या॒ अद्भु॑तैनसः
