shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ abhi-bhū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayaḥ ǀviśvá-karmā ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the conqueror,Indra; you have lighted in the sun; you are the maker of all, the lord of all thegods, the mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒भ्राज॒ञ्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्व१॒॑रग॑च्छो रोच॒नं दि॒वः । दे॒वास्त॑ इन्द्र स॒ख्याय॑ येमिरे
shlokas.transliteration: vi-bhrā́jan ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sváḥ ǀ ágacchaḥ ǀ rocanám ǀ diváḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ yemire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have pervaded the light of the sky, illumining heaven by your splendour; the gods,Indra,submissively solicit your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑ नो गधि प्रि॒यः स॑त्रा॒जिदगो॑ह्यः । गि॒रिर्न वि॒श्वत॑स्पृ॒थुः पति॑र्दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra ǀ naḥ ǀ gadhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ satrā-jít ǀ ágohyaḥ ǀgiríḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pṛthúḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come to us,Indra, beloved one, triumphant, and whom, none can conceal- - lord of heaven, vast on allsides as a mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि हि स॑त्य सोमपा उ॒भे ब॒भूथ॒ रोद॑सी । इन्द्रासि॑ सुन्व॒तो वृ॒धः पति॑र्दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ hí ǀ satya ǀ soma-pāḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ babhū́tha ǀ ródasī íti ǀíndra ǀ ási ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Truthful drinker of theSoma, you surpass heaven and earth; OIndra, you are the fosterer of him whoprepares the libation, you are the lord of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि शश्व॑तीना॒मिन्द्र॑ द॒र्ता पु॒रामसि॑ । ह॒न्ता दस्यो॒र्मनो॑र्वृ॒धः पति॑र्दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ śáśvatīnām ǀ índra ǀ dartā́ ǀ purā́m ǀ ási ǀhantā́ ǀ dásyoḥ ǀ mánoḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, are the stormer of many hostile cities, the slayer of theDasyu, the fosterer of man, the lordof heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ ही॑न्द्र गिर्वण॒ उप॑ त्वा॒ कामा॑न्म॒हः स॑सृ॒ज्महे॑ । उ॒देव॒ यन्त॑ उ॒दभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ tvā ǀ kā́mān ǀ maháḥ ǀ sasṛjmáhe ǀudā́-iva ǀ yántaḥ ǀ udá-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraworthy of hymns, we send our earnest praises to you as men going by water (splash their friends)with handfuls.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा॑ य॒व्याभि॒र्वर्ध॑न्ति शूर॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि । वा॒वृ॒ध्वांसं॑ चिदद्रिवो दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: vā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ yavyā́bhiḥ ǀ várdhanti ǀ śūra ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀvavṛdhvā́ṃsam ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the lake (swells) with the rivers, so our praises, O hero, O thunderer, augment you as you growmore and more day by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जन्ति॒ हरी॑ इषि॒रस्य॒ गाथ॑यो॒रौ रथ॑ उ॒रुयु॑गे । इ॒न्द्र॒वाहा॑ वचो॒युजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: yuñjánti ǀ hárī íti ǀ iṣirásya ǀ gā́thayā ǀ uráu ǀ ráthe ǀ urú-yuge ǀindra-vā́hā ǀ vacaḥ-yújā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) by their hymn yoke in the swift deity's yoked at a word.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑ इ॒न्द्रा भ॑रँ॒ ओजो॑ नृ॒म्णं श॑तक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वी॒रं पृ॑तना॒षह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ ójaḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀā́ ǀ vīrám ǀ pṛtanā-sáham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, all-beholdingMaghavan, bring us strength and wealth; (we solicit you) the host-overpoweringchampion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि न॑: पि॒ता व॑सो॒ त्वं मा॒ता श॑तक्रतो ब॒भूवि॑थ । अधा॑ ते सु॒म्नमी॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vaso íti ǀ tvám ǀ mātā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ babhū́vitha ǀádha ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have been our father, O giver of dwellings, you our mother OŚatakratu; we pray for thathappiness which is yours.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां शु॑ष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाज॒यन्त॒मुप॑ ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो॑ रास्व सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ śuṣmin ǀ puru-hūta ǀ vāja-yántam ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MightyŚatakratu, invoked by many, I praise you desirous of offerings; do you give us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामि॒दा ह्यो नरोऽपी॑प्यन्वज्रि॒न्भूर्ण॑यः । स इ॑न्द्र॒ स्तोम॑वाहसामि॒ह श्रु॒ध्युप॒ स्वस॑र॒मा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ idā́ ǀ hyáḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ápīpyan ǀ vajrin ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ indra ǀ stóma-vāhasām ǀ ihá ǀ śrudhi ǀ úpa ǀ svásaram ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thunderer, your worshippers, ready with their oblations, have today and yesterday made you drink (theSoma); listen,Indra, here to us who offer you praise and come you to our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मत्स्वा॑ सुशिप्र हरिव॒स्तदी॑महे॒ त्वे आ भू॑षन्ति वे॒धस॑: । तव॒ श्रवां॑स्युप॒मान्यु॒क्थ्या॑ सु॒तेष्वि॑न्द्र गिर्वणः
shlokas.transliteration: mátsva ǀ su-śipra ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ tát ǀ īmahe ǀ tvé íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhūṣanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀtáva ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ upa-mā́ni ǀ ukthyā́ ǀ sutéṣu ǀ indra ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Handsome-jawed lord of steeds, rejoice (in the libation); we pray to you, your votaries come to youIndra, worthy of praise, may your food be a pattern and excellent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्राय॑न्त इव॒ सूर्यं॒ विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य भक्षत । वसू॑नि जा॒ते जन॑मान॒ ओज॑सा॒ प्रति॑ भा॒गं न दी॑धिम
shlokas.transliteration: śrā́yantaḥ-iva ǀ sū́ryam ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ índrasya ǀ bhakṣata ǀvásūni ǀ jāté ǀ jánamāne ǀ ójasā ǀ práti ǀ bhāgám ǀ ná ǀ dīdhima ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the gathering (rays) proceed to the son, so (theMarutsproceed) toIndra, and by their power divideall his treasures among those who have been or will be born; may we meditate on our share.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन॑र्शरातिं वसु॒दामुप॑ स्तुहि भ॒द्रा इन्द्र॑स्य रा॒तय॑: । सो अ॑स्य॒ कामं॑ विध॒तो न रो॑षति॒ मनो॑ दा॒नाय॑ चो॒दय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ánarśa-rātim ǀ vasu-dā́m ǀ úpa ǀ stuhi ǀ bhadrā́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ rātáyaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ asya ǀ kā́mam ǀ vidhatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ roṣati ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ codáyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise him the bestower of wealth, whose gifts are never evil;Indra's gifts are fortunate; he directs hismind to the gift andmarsnot the desire of his worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ प्रतू॑र्तिष्व॒भि विश्वा॑ असि॒ स्पृध॑: । अ॒श॒स्ति॒हा ज॑नि॒ता वि॑श्व॒तूर॑सि॒ त्वं तू॑र्य तरुष्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ indra ǀ prá-tūrtiṣu ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ asi ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀaśasti-hā́ ǀ janitā́ ǀ viśva-tū́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ tūrya ǀ taruṣyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, you conquer in battles all opposing hosts; O opposer who beat down those who would opposeyou are the smiter of the wicked, the bringer (of evil to your enemies), and the destroyer of all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ ते॒ शुष्मं॑ तु॒रय॑न्तमीयतुः क्षो॒णी शिशुं॒ न मा॒तरा॑ । विश्वा॑स्ते॒ स्पृध॑: श्नथयन्त म॒न्यवे॑ वृ॒त्रं यदि॑न्द्र॒ तूर्व॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ te ǀ śúṣmam ǀ turáyantam ǀ īyatuḥ ǀ kṣoṇī́ íti ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ mātárā ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ te ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ śnathayanta ǀ manyáve ǀ vṛtrám ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ tū́rvasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth follow your destructive energy as mothers their child; since you smiteVṛtra, all thehostile hosts,Indra, faint at your wrath.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒त ऊ॒ती वो॑ अ॒जरं॑ प्रहे॒तार॒मप्र॑हितम् । आ॒शुं जेता॑रं॒ हेता॑रं र॒थीत॑म॒मतू॑र्तं तुग्र्या॒वृध॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: itáḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ pra-hetā́ram ǀ ápra-hitam ǀāśúm ǀ jétāram ǀ hétāram ǀ rathí-tamam ǀ átūrtam ǀ tugrya-vṛ́dham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Worshippers), summon here for protecting him who never grows old, the repeller (of enemies), himselfnever expelled, the swift conqueror, the driver, the best of charioteers, unharmed of any, the augmenter of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ष्क॒र्तार॒मनि॑ष्कृतं॒ सह॑स्कृतं श॒तमू॑तिं श॒तक्र॑तुम् । स॒मा॒नमिन्द्र॒मव॑से हवामहे॒ वस॑वानं वसू॒जुव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: iṣkartā́ram ǀ ániḥ-kṛtam ǀ sáhaḥ-kṛtam ǀ śatám-ūtim ǀ śatá-kratum ǀsamānám ǀ índram ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vásavānam ǀ vasu-júvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit for our protectionIndra, the consecrator of others but himself consecrated by none, producedby strength, possessing a hundred-fold protection, possessing hundred-fold knowledge, a common deity tomany, hiding treasures in his store-house and sending wealth (to his votaries).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं त॑ एमि त॒न्वा॑ पु॒रस्ता॒द्विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॒भि मा॑ यन्ति प॒श्चात् । य॒दा मह्यं॒ दीध॑रो भा॒गमि॒न्द्रादिन्मया॑ कृणवो वी॒र्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ emi ǀ tanvā́ ǀ purástāt ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ mā ǀ yanti ǀ paścā́t ǀyadā́ ǀ máhyam ǀ dī́dharaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ indra ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ máyā ǀ kṛṇavaḥ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I here go before you with my son, theViśve devāsfollow after me; if,Indra, you keep wealth for me,then put forth your strength on my side.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दधा॑मि ते॒ मधु॑नो भ॒क्षमग्रे॑ हि॒तस्ते॑ भा॒गः सु॒तो अ॑स्तु॒ सोम॑: । अस॑श्च॒ त्वं द॑क्षिण॒तः सखा॒ मेऽधा॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनाव॒ भूरि॑
shlokas.transliteration: dádhāmi ǀ te ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ bhakṣám ǀ ágre ǀ hitáḥ ǀ te ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ astu ǀ sómaḥ ǀásaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tvám ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ me ǀ ádha ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jaṅghanāva ǀ bhū́ri ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I offer the exhilaratingSomafirst toyou, let the effused enjoyable Soma be plural ced within you; be you afriend on my righthand, then will we two smite our many enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु स्तोमं॑ भरत वाज॒यन्त॒ इन्द्रा॑य स॒त्यं यदि॑ स॒त्यमस्ति॑ । नेन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्तीति॒ नेम॑ उ त्व आह॒ क ईं॑ ददर्श॒ कम॒भि ष्ट॑वाम
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sú ǀ stómam ǀ bharata ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ satyám ǀ yádi ǀ satyám ǀ ásti ǀná ǀ índraḥ ǀ asti ǀ íti ǀ némaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvaḥ ǀ āha ǀ káḥ ǀ īm ǀ dadarśa ǀ kám ǀ abhí ǀ stavāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer fervently, may war-loving companions, true praise toIndra, if he truly exists;Nemasays, "verilythere is no Indra", who has ever seen him? Whom shall we praise?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॑स्मि जरित॒: पश्य॑ मे॒ह विश्वा॑ जा॒तान्य॒भ्य॑स्मि म॒ह्ना । ऋ॒तस्य॑ मा प्र॒दिशो॑ वर्धयन्त्यादर्दि॒रो भुव॑ना दर्दरीमि
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ asmi ǀ jaritaríti ǀ páśya ǀ mā ǀ ihá ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ abhí ǀ asmi ǀ mahnā́ ǀṛtásya ǀ mā ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ vardhayanti ǀ ā-dardiráḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ dardarīmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indraspeaks): "here I am, worshipper, behold me here; I overpower all beings by my might; the offerersof sacrifice magnify me by their praises; I, the shatterer, shatter the worlds".”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यन्मा॑ वे॒ना अरु॑हन्नृ॒तस्यँ॒ एक॒मासी॑नं हर्य॒तस्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठे । मन॑श्चिन्मे हृ॒द आ प्रत्य॑वोच॒दचि॑क्रद॒ञ्छिशु॑मन्त॒: सखा॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ áruhan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ ékam ǀ ā́sīnam ǀ haryatásya ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀmánaḥ ǀ cit ǀ me ǀ hṛdé ǀ ā́ ǀ práti ǀ avocat ǀ ácikradan ǀ śíśu-mantaḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “"When the lovers of sacrifice ascended to me sitting alone on the back of my well-loved (formament),then my mind verily proclaimed to my heart, ' my friends with their children are crying to me' ".”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता ते॒ सव॑नेषु प्र॒वाच्या॒ या च॒कर्थ॑ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्व॒ते । पारा॑वतं॒ यत्पु॑रुसम्भृ॒तं वस्व॒पावृ॑णोः शर॒भाय॒ ऋषि॑बन्धवे
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ pra-vā́cyā ǀ yā́ ǀ cakártha ǀ magha-van ǀ indra ǀ sunvaté ǀpā́rāvatam ǀ yát ǀ puru-sambhṛtám ǀ vásu ǀ apa-ávṛṇoḥ ǀ śarabhā́ya ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bandhave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily all those deeds of yours,Maghavan, are to be proclaimed, which you have achieved for him whooffers libations in the sacrifice; that wealth of Pārāvat, collected by many; you have opened toŚarabha, thekinsman of the Ṛṣi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नू॒नं धा॑वता॒ पृथ॒ङ्नेह यो वो॒ अवा॑वरीत् । नि षीं॑ वृ॒त्रस्य॒ मर्म॑णि॒ वज्र॒मिन्द्रो॑ अपीपतत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nūnám ǀ dhāvata ǀ pṛ́thak ǀ ná ǀ ihá ǀ yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ ávāvarīt ǀní ǀ sīm ǀ vṛtrásya ǀ mármaṇi ǀ vájram ǀ índraḥ ǀ apīpatat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Haste now severally forward; he is not here who stopped your way-- has notIndralet fall histhunderbolt in the very vitals of that enemy?”

shlokas.sanskrit: मनो॑जवा॒ अय॑मान आय॒सीम॑तर॒त्पुर॑म् । दिवं॑ सुप॒र्णो ग॒त्वाय॒ सोमं॑ व॒ज्रिण॒ आभ॑रत्
shlokas.transliteration: mánaḥ-javāḥ ǀ áyamānaḥ ǀ āyasī́m ǀ atarat ǀ púram ǀdívam ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ gatvā́ya ǀ sómam ǀ vajríṇaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Suparṇa, rushing swift as thought, passed through the metal city; then having gone to heaven hebrought theSomato the thunderer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रे अ॒न्तः श॑यत उ॒द्ना वज्रो॑ अ॒भीवृ॑तः । भर॑न्त्यस्मै सं॒यत॑: पु॒रःप्र॑स्रवणा ब॒लिम्
shlokas.transliteration: samudré ǀ antáríti ǀ śayate ǀ udnā́ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ abhí-vṛtaḥ ǀbháranti ǀ asmai ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀ puráḥ-prasravaṇāḥ ǀ balím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The thunderbolt lies in the midst of the sea, covered with the waters; (the foes) flying in front of thebattle bring offerings of submission to it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वाग्वद॑न्त्यविचेत॒नानि॒ राष्ट्री॑ दे॒वानां॑ निष॒साद॑ म॒न्द्रा । चत॑स्र॒ ऊर्जं॑ दुदुहे॒ पयां॑सि॒ क्व॑ स्विदस्याः पर॒मं ज॑गाम
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ vā́k ǀ vádantī ǀ avi-cetanā́ni ǀ rā́ṣṭrī ǀ devā́nām ǀ ni-sasā́da ǀ mandrā́ ǀcátasraḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ duduhe ǀ páyāṃsi ǀ kvá ǀ svit ǀ asyāḥ ǀ paramám ǀ jagāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When Vāk, thequeen, the gladdener of the gods, sits down (in the sacrifice) uttering things not to beunderstood, she milks water and food for the four quarters (of the earth); whither now is her best portion gone?”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वीं वाच॑मजनयन्त दे॒वास्तां वि॒श्वरू॑पाः प॒शवो॑ वदन्ति । सा नो॑ म॒न्द्रेष॒मूर्जं॒ दुहा॑ना धे॒नुर्वाग॒स्मानुप॒ सुष्टु॒तैतु॑
shlokas.transliteration: devī́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ ajanayanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tā́m ǀ viśvá-rūpāḥ ǀ paśávaḥ ǀ vadanti ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ mandrā́ ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ dúhānā ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ vā́k ǀ asmā́n ǀ úpa ǀ sú-stutā ǀ ā́ ǀ etu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods produced the goddess Vāk; her do animals of every kind utter; may she, Vāk, theall-gladdening cow, yielding meat and drink, come to us, worthily praised.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखे॑ विष्णो वित॒रं वि क्र॑मस्व॒ द्यौर्दे॒हि लो॒कं वज्रा॑य वि॒ष्कभे॑ । हना॑व वृ॒त्रं रि॒णचा॑व॒ सिन्धू॒निन्द्र॑स्य यन्तु प्रस॒वे विसृ॑ष्टाः
shlokas.transliteration: sákhe ǀ viṣṇo íti ǀ vi-tarám ǀ ví ǀ kramasva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ dehí ǀ lokám ǀ vájrāya ǀ vi-skábhe ǀhánāva ǀ vṛtrám ǀ riṇácāva ǀ síndhūn ǀ índrasya ǀ yantu ǀ pra-savé ǀ ví-sṛṣṭāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OViṣṇumy friends, stride forth lustily; O heaven, give room to contain the thunderbolt; let us smiteVṛtra, let us open the rivers; let them flow, set free, at the command ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋध॑गि॒त्था स मर्त्य॑: शश॒मे दे॒वता॑तये । यो नू॒नं मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒भिष्ट॑य आच॒क्रे ह॒व्यदा॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́dhak ǀ itthā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ śaśamé ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyáḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ mitrā́váruṇau ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ ā-cakré ǀ havyá-dātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That man verily consecrates the oblation for the sacrifice, who brings quicklyMitraandVaruṇato theofferer for the attainment of his desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वर्षि॑ष्ठक्षत्रा उरु॒चक्ष॑सा॒ नरा॒ राजा॑ना दीर्घ॒श्रुत्त॑मा । ता बा॒हुता॒ न दं॒सना॑ रथर्यतः सा॒कं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: várṣiṣṭha-kṣatrau ǀ uru-cákṣasā ǀ nárā ǀ rā́jānā ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamā ǀtā́ ǀ bāhútā ǀ ná ǀ daṃsánā ǀ ratharyataḥ ǀ sākám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those two leaders of rites, great in mite, far-seeing, resplendent, and most far-hearing, perform theirdeeds like two arms, by the help of the rays of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यो वां॑ मित्रावरुणाजि॒रो दू॒तो अद्र॑वत् । अय॑:शीर्षा॒ मदे॑रघुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yáḥ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ ajiráḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ádravat ǀáyaḥ-śīrṣā ǀ máde-raghuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, he who hastens to appear before you, becomes the messenger of the gods; hewears a metal helment, he exults in his wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यः स॒म्पृच्छे॒ न पुन॒र्हवी॑तवे॒ न सं॑वा॒दाय॒ रम॑ते । तस्मा॑न्नो अ॒द्य समृ॑तेरुरुष्यतं बा॒हुभ्यां॑ न उरुष्यतम्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ sam-pṛ́cche ǀ ná ǀ púnaḥ ǀ hávītave ǀ ná ǀ sam-vādā́ya ǀ rámate ǀtásmāt ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ sám-ṛteḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǀ bāhú-bhyām ǀ naḥ ǀ uruṣyatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has no plural asure in questioning, nor in repeated calling nor in dialogue-- defend us today fromhim and from his encounter, defend us from his arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मि॒त्राय॒ प्रार्य॒म्णे स॑च॒थ्य॑मृतावसो । व॒रू॒थ्यं१॒॑ वरु॑णे॒ छन्द्यं॒ वच॑: स्तो॒त्रं राज॑सु गायत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ aryamṇé ǀ sacathyám ǀ ṛtavaso ítyṛta-vaso ǀvarūthyám ǀ váruṇe ǀ chándyam ǀ vácaḥ ǀ stotrám ǀ rā́ja-su ǀ gāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O you rich in offerings, sing toMitra, sing toAryaman, a reverential hymn produced in the sacrificialchamber; sing a propitiating address toVaruṇa; sing a hymn of praise to the kings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि॑न्विरे अरु॒णं जेन्यं॒ वस्वेकं॑ पु॒त्रं ति॑सॄ॒णाम् । ते धामा॑न्य॒मृता॒ मर्त्या॑ना॒मद॑ब्धा अ॒भि च॑क्षते
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hinvire ǀ aruṇám ǀ jényam ǀ vásu ǀ ékam ǀ putrám ǀ tisṝṇā́m ǀté ǀ dhā́māni ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ ádabdhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cakṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It was these who sent the red victory-givingVasu, the one son of the three (worlds); they, the invincible,the immortal, overlook the abodes of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मे॒ वचां॒स्युद्य॑ता द्यु॒मत्त॑मानि॒ कर्त्वा॑ । उ॒भा या॑तं नासत्या स॒जोष॑सा॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ me ǀ vácāṃsi ǀ út-yatā ǀ dyumát-tamāni ǀ kártvā ǀubhā́ ǀ yātam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ sa-jóṣasā ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O associatedNāsatyās, come both of you to my uplifted glorious praises and my rites, come topartake of my offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒तिं यद्वा॑मर॒क्षसं॒ हवा॑महे यु॒वाभ्यां॑ वाजिनीवसू । प्राचीं॒ होत्रां॑ प्रति॒रन्ता॑वितं नरा गृणा॒ना ज॒मद॑ग्निना
shlokas.transliteration: rātím ǀ yát ǀ vām ǀ arakṣásam ǀ hávāmahe ǀ yuvā́bhyām ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀprā́cīm ǀ hótrām ǀ pra-tirántau ǀ itam ǀ narā ǀ gṛṇānā́ ǀ jamát-agninā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Deities rich in food, when we solicit your bounty, that (wealth) which demons cannot thwart-- then,helping our praise directed to the east, come, leaders of rites, worshipped byJamadagni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं दि॑वि॒स्पृशं॒ वायो॑ या॒हि सु॒मन्म॑भिः । अ॒न्तः प॒वित्र॑ उ॒परि॑ श्रीणा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽयं शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ divi-spṛ́śam ǀ vā́yo íti ǀ yāhí ǀ sumánma-bhiḥ ǀantáríti ǀ pavítre ǀ upári ǀ śrīṇānáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ayāmi ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Vāyu, to our heaven-reaching sacrifice with its beautiful hymns of praise, this brightSomahasbeen kept for you, poured out upon the middle of the straining cloth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेत्य॑ध्व॒र्युः प॒थिभी॒ रजि॑ष्ठै॒: प्रति॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वी॒तये॑ । अधा॑ नियुत्व उ॒भय॑स्य नः पिब॒ शुचिं॒ सोमं॒ गवा॑शिरम्
shlokas.transliteration: véti ǀ adhvaryúḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ rájiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ práti ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vītáye ǀádha ǀ niyutvaḥ ǀ ubháyasya ǀ naḥ ǀ piba ǀ śúcim ǀ sómam ǀ gó-āśiram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ministrant priest comes by the straighter paths, he brings the oblations for your enjoyment; thenlord of theNiyutsteeds, drink of both kinds, theSomapure and that mixed with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बण्म॒हाँ अ॑सि सूर्य॒ बळा॑दित्य म॒हाँ अ॑सि । म॒हस्ते॑ स॒तो म॑हि॒मा प॑नस्यते॒ऽद्धा दे॑व म॒हाँ अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ sūrya ǀ báṭ ǀ āditya ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀmaháḥ ǀ te ǀ satáḥ ǀ mahimā́ ǀ panasyate ǀ addhā́ ǀ deva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily you are great, O Sun; verily,Āditya, you are great; the greatness of you, the greatone,ispraised; verily you are great, O god.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बट् सू॑र्य॒ श्रव॑सा म॒हाँ अ॑सि स॒त्रा दे॑व म॒हाँ अ॑सि । म॒ह्ना दे॒वाना॑मसु॒र्य॑: पु॒रोहि॑तो वि॒भु ज्योति॒रदा॑भ्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: báṭ ǀ sūrya ǀ śrávasā ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ satrā́ ǀ deva ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀmahnā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asuryáḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ vi-bhú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ádābhyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily, O sun, you are great in fame; O god, you are indeed mighty among the gods in might; you arethe slayer of theasuras, and the preceptor (of the gods); your glory is widespread and to be marred by none.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं या नीच्य॒र्किणी॑ रू॒पा रोहि॑ण्या कृ॒ता । चि॒त्रेव॒ प्रत्य॑दर्श्याय॒त्य१॒॑न्तर्द॒शसु॑ बा॒हुषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ yā́ ǀ nī́cī ǀ arkíṇī ǀ rūpā́ ǀ róhiṇyā ǀ kṛtā́ ǀcitrā́-iva ǀ práti ǀ adarśi ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ antáḥ ǀ daśá-su ǀ bāhúṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “She who was created beautiful and bright, bending downwards and receiving all praise, has been seenwithin (the world), like a bridled cow, advancing to the ten regions (spread out) like arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒जा ह॑ ति॒स्रो अ॒त्याय॑मीयु॒र्न्य१॒॑न्या अ॒र्कम॒भितो॑ विविश्रे । बृ॒हद्ध॑ तस्थौ॒ भुव॑नेष्व॒न्तः पव॑मानो ह॒रित॒ आ वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ha ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ati-ā́yam ǀ īyuḥ ǀ ní ǀ anyā́ḥ ǀ arkám ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ viviśre ǀbṛhát ǀ ha ǀ tasthau ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ antáríti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three kinds of creatures went to destruction; the others came beforeAgni; the mighty one (the Sun)stood within the worlds; (Vāyu), the purifier, entered the quarters of the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा॒ता रु॒द्राणां॑ दुहि॒ता वसू॑नां॒ स्वसा॑दि॒त्याना॑म॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑: । प्र नु वो॑चं चिकि॒तुषे॒ जना॑य॒ मा गामना॑गा॒मदि॑तिं वधिष्ट
shlokas.transliteration: mātā́ ǀ rudrā́ṇām ǀ duhitā́ ǀ vásūnām ǀ svásā ǀ ādityā́nām ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ nú ǀ vocam ǀ cikitúṣe ǀ jánāya ǀ mā́ ǀ gā́m ǀ ánāgām ǀ áditim ǀ vadhiṣṭa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(She who is) the mother of theRudras, the daughter of theVasus, the sister of theĀdityas, the homeof ambrosia-- I have spoken to men of understqanding-- kill not her, the sinless inviolate cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒चो॒विदं॒ वाच॑मुदी॒रय॑न्तीं॒ विश्वा॑भिर्धी॒भिरु॑प॒तिष्ठ॑मानाम् । दे॒वीं दे॒वेभ्य॒: पर्ये॒युषीं॒ गामा मा॑वृक्त॒ मर्त्यो॑ द॒भ्रचे॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: vacaḥ-vídam ǀ vā́cam ǀ ut-īráyantīm ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ upa-tíṣṭhamānām ǀdevī́m ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ ā-īyúṣīm ǀ gā́m ǀ ā́ ǀ mā ǀ avṛkta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ dabhrá-cetāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine cow, who herself utters, speech and gives speech to others, who comes attended by everykind of utterance, who helps me for my worship of the gods-- it is only the fool who abandons her.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्ने बृ॒हद्वयो॒ दधा॑सि देव दा॒शुषे॑ । क॒विर्गृ॒हप॑ति॒र्युवा॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhāsi ǀ deva ǀ dāśúṣe ǀkavíḥ ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ yúvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, the ever young, the wise, the protector of the household, it is you who give abundant foodto the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒ ईळा॑नया स॒ह दे॒वाँ अ॑ग्ने दुव॒स्युवा॑ । चि॒किद्वि॑भान॒वा व॑ह
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ī́ḷānayā ǀ sahá ǀ devā́n ǀ agne ǀ duvasyúvā ǀcikít ǀ vibhāno íti vi-bhāno ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Resplendent one, do you, the all-knower, bring the gods here with this our reverential hymn of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ ह स्विद्यु॒जा व॒यं चोदि॑ष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य । अ॒भि ष्मो॒ वाज॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ ha ǀ svit ǀ yujā́ ǀ vayám ǀ códiṣṭhena ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǀabhí ǀ smaḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O ever youthful one, with you as our ally, the sender of wealth, we overcome (our enemies) fo rtheattainemnt of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: औ॒र्व॒भृ॒गु॒वच्छुचि॑मप्नवान॒वदा हु॑वे । अ॒ग्निं स॑मु॒द्रवा॑ससम्
shlokas.transliteration: aurvabhṛgu-vát ǀ śúcim ǀ apnavāna-vát ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LikeAurvaBhṛguand like Apanvān, I invoke the pureAgni, dwelling in the midst of the sea.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हु॒वे वात॑स्वनं क॒विं प॒र्जन्य॑क्रन्द्यं॒ सह॑: । अ॒ग्निं स॑मु॒द्रवा॑ससम्
shlokas.transliteration: huvé ǀ vā́ta-svanam ǀ kavím ǀ parjánya-krandyam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeAgni, dwelling in the midst of the sea, the wise one, roaring like the wind, might, with a voicelikeParjanya's.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ स॒वं स॑वि॒तुर्य॑था॒ भग॑स्येव भु॒जिं हु॑वे । अ॒ग्निं स॑मु॒द्रवा॑ससम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ savám ǀ savitúḥ ǀ yathā ǀ bhágasya-iva ǀ bhujím ǀ huve ǀagním ǀ samudrá-vāsasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeAgnidwelling in th emidst of the sea, like the energy ofSavitā, like the enjoyments granted byBhaga.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं वो॑ वृ॒धन्त॑मध्व॒राणां॑ पुरू॒तम॑म् । अच्छा॒ नप्त्रे॒ सह॑स्वते
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ vaḥ ǀ vṛdhántam ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ puru-támam ǀáccha ǀ náptre ǀ sáhasvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Draw) near toAgnithe strong, the mightiest, him who expands (with his flames), the grandson of theinvincible ones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं यथा॑ न आ॒भुव॒त्त्वष्टा॑ रू॒पेव॒ तक्ष्या॑ । अ॒स्य क्रत्वा॒ यश॑स्वतः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā-bhúvat ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ rūpā́-iva ǀ tákṣyā ǀasyá ǀ krátvā ǀ yáśasvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Draw near) that he may deal with us as a carpenter (TVaṣṭā) deals with the timber he has to cut;may we become renowned by his skill.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं विश्वा॑ अ॒भि श्रियो॒ऽग्निर्दे॒वेषु॑ पत्यते । आ वाजै॒रुप॑ नो गमत्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ patyate ǀā́ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ gamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Among the godsAgnihas to do with all the successes (of men); may he come to us with abundance offood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑षामि॒ह स्तु॑हि॒ होतॄ॑णां य॒शस्त॑मम् । अ॒ग्निं य॒ज्ञेषु॑ पू॒र्व्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ ihá ǀ stuhi ǀ hótṝṇām ǀ yaśáḥ-tamam ǀagním ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ pūrvyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise at our riteAgni, the most glorious of all ministrant priests, the foremost in the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शी॒रं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषं॒ ज्येष्ठो॒ यो दमे॒ष्वा । दी॒दाय॑ दीर्घ॒श्रुत्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dámeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀdīdā́ya ǀ dīrghaśrút-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Praise him) the dweller in the sacrifice, of purifying radiance, who shines, the chief of the gods andomniscient, in the house (of the sacrificers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमर्व॑न्तं॒ न सा॑न॒सिं गृ॑णी॒हि वि॑प्र शु॒ष्मिण॑म् । मि॒त्रं न या॑त॒यज्ज॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ árvantam ǀ ná ǀ sānasím ǀ gṛṇīhí ǀ vipra ǀ śuṣmíṇam ǀmitrám ǀ ná ǀ yātayát-janam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O priest, glorify him, who is welcome and strong as a horse, and who like a friend conquers all foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्वा जा॒मयो॒ गिरो॒ देदि॑शतीर्हवि॒ष्कृत॑: । वा॒योरनी॑के अस्थिरन्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tvā ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ dédiśatīḥ ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀvāyóḥ ǀ ánīke ǀ asthiran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sister praises of the worshipper rise to you, proclaiming your glories; they stand kindling you in thepresence ofVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ त्रि॒धात्ववृ॑तं ब॒र्हिस्त॒स्थावसं॑दिनम् । आप॑श्चि॒न्नि द॑धा प॒दम्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ ávṛtam ǀ barhíḥ ǀ tastháu ǀ ásam-dinam ǀā́paḥ ǀ cit ǀ ní ǀ dadha ǀ padám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The waters find their plural ce in him, for whom the triple-jointed grass is spread unlimited and untied (inthe sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒दं दे॒वस्य॑ मी॒ळ्हुषोऽना॑धृष्टाभिरू॒तिभि॑: । भ॒द्रा सूर्य॑ इवोप॒दृक्
shlokas.transliteration: padám ǀ devásya ǀ mīḷhúṣaḥ ǀ ánādhṛṣṭābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀbhadrā́ ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ upa-dṛ́k ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Auspicious is the plural ce of the god who pours forth all desires with his inviolable protections; auspiciousis his appearance like the Sun's.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिभि॑स्तेपा॒नो दे॑व शो॒चिषा॑ । आ दे॒वान्व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ tepānáḥ ǀ deva ǀ śocíṣā ǀā́ ǀ devā́n ǀ vakṣi ǀ yákṣi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, blazing with radiance, through our oblations of ghī, bear (our sacrifice) to the gods andoffer it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑जनन्त मा॒तर॑: क॒विं दे॒वासो॑ अङ्गिरः । ह॒व्य॒वाह॒मम॑र्त्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ ajananta ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ kavím ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ aṅgiraḥ ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ámartyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods, as mothers, have borne youAṅgirasa, the seer, the immortal, the bearer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रचे॑तसं त्वा क॒वेऽग्ने॑ दू॒तं वरे॑ण्यम् । ह॒व्य॒वाहं॒ नि षे॑दिरे
shlokas.transliteration: prá-cetasam ǀ tvā ǀ kave ǀ ágne ǀ dūtám ǀ váreṇyam ǀhavya-vā́ham ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods seat you in your plural ce, O wiseAgni, the seer, the messenger, the most excellent the bearerof the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि मे॒ अस्त्यघ्न्या॒ न स्वधि॑ति॒र्वन॑न्वति । अथै॑ता॒दृग्भ॑रामि ते
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ me ǀ ásti ǀ ághnyā ǀ ná ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ vánan-vati ǀátha ǀ etādṛ́k ǀ bharāmi ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No cow is mine, and no axe is athandto cleave wood, but yet I bring both these to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑ग्ने॒ कानि॒ कानि॑ चि॒दा ते॒ दारू॑णि द॒ध्मसि॑ । ता जु॑षस्व यविष्ठ्य
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ kā́ni ǀ kā́ni ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ dā́rūṇi ǀ dadhmási ǀtā́ ǀ juṣasva ǀ yaviṣṭhya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most youthful (Agni), when we offer any kinds of timber trees to burn, you accept them all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदत्त्यु॑प॒जिह्वि॑का॒ यद्व॒म्रो अ॑ति॒सर्प॑ति । सर्वं॒ तद॑स्तु ते घृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ átti ǀ upa-jíhvikā ǀ yát ǀ vamráḥ ǀ ati-sárpati ǀsárvam ǀ tát ǀ astu ǀ te ǀ ghṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever timber the ant has gnawed, whatever the emmet has infested-- may it all be welcome to youas ghī.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमिन्धा॑नो॒ मन॑सा॒ धियं॑ सचेत॒ मर्त्य॑: । अ॒ग्निमी॑धे वि॒वस्व॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ índhānaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ dhíyam ǀ saceta ǀ mártyaḥ ǀagním ǀ īdhe ǀ vivásva-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let a man, when he kindlesAgni, perform the ceremony with a (devout) mind; he kindles him with thepriests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑र्शि गातु॒वित्त॑मो॒ यस्मि॑न्व्र॒तान्या॑द॒धुः । उपो॒ षु जा॒तमार्य॑स्य॒ वर्ध॑नम॒ग्निं न॑क्षन्त नो॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádarśi ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ā-dadhúḥ ǀúpo íti ǀ sú ǀ jātám ǀ ā́ryasya ǀ várdhanam ǀ agním ǀ nakṣanta ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, in whom they offer the sacrifices, has appeared-- he who knows all ways; our praises rise toAgni,auspiciously born, the helpeer of theĀrya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र दैवो॑दासो अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाँ अच्छा॒ न म॒ज्मना॑ । अनु॑ मा॒तरं॑ पृथि॒वीं वि वा॑वृते त॒स्थौ नाक॑स्य॒ सान॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dáivaḥ-dāsaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ ná ǀ majmánā ǀánu ǀ mātáram ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ví ǀ vavṛte ǀ tastháu ǀ nā́kasya ǀ sā́navi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, when invoked byDivodāsa, ran along the mother Earth as with might, towards the gods; he tookhis plural ce in the height of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मा॒द्रेज॑न्त कृ॒ष्टय॑श्च॒र्कृत्या॑नि कृण्व॒तः । स॒ह॒स्र॒सां मे॒धसा॑ताविव॒ त्मना॒ग्निं धी॒भिः स॑पर्यत
shlokas.transliteration: yásmāt ǀ réjanta ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ carkṛ́tyāni ǀ kṛṇvatáḥ ǀsahasra-sā́m ǀ medhásātau-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ agním ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ saparyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since men tremble before those who perform the sacred sacrifices, therefore, do you devoutly worshipin the solemn riteAgnithe bestower of thousands of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यं रा॒ये निनी॑षसि॒ मर्तो॒ यस्ते॑ वसो॒ दाश॑त् । स वी॒रं ध॑त्ते अग्न उक्थशं॒सिनं॒ त्मना॑ सहस्रपो॒षिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yám ǀ rāyé ǀ nínīṣasi ǀ mártaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ vaso íti ǀ dā́śat ǀsáḥ ǀ vīrám ǀ dhatte ǀ agne ǀ uktha-śaṃsínam ǀ tmánā ǀ sahasra-poṣíṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, bestower of dwellings, that mortal whom you wish to lead to wealth, and who gives offerings toyou possess of himself a strong son, a reciter of hymns and a lord of great wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स दृ॒ळ्हे चि॑द॒भि तृ॑णत्ति॒ वाज॒मर्व॑ता॒ स ध॑त्ते॒ अक्षि॑ति॒ श्रव॑: । त्वे दे॑व॒त्रा सदा॑ पुरूवसो॒ विश्वा॑ वा॒मानि॑ धीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ dṛḷhé ǀ cit ǀ abhí ǀ tṛṇatti ǀ vā́jam ǀ árvatā ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhatte ǀ ákṣiti ǀ śrávaḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ sádā ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ víśvā ǀ vāmā́ni ǀ dhīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of vast wealth, he (your worshipper) spoils with his steed food laid up even in strongholds, hepossesses imperishable wealth; in you divine we ever possess all desirable treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो विश्वा॒ दय॑ते॒ वसु॒ होता॑ म॒न्द्रो जना॑नाम् । मधो॒र्न पात्रा॑ प्रथ॒मान्य॑स्मै॒ प्र स्तोमा॑ यन्त्य॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dáyate ǀ vásu ǀ hótā ǀ mandráḥ ǀ jánānām ǀmádhoḥ ǀ ná ǀ pā́trā ǀ prathamā́ni ǀ asmai ǀ prá ǀ stómāḥ ǀ yanti ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To him the invoker of the gods, who ever rejoicing distributes all wealth to men-- toAgniproceed ourpraises like the principal cups of the exhilaratingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वं॒ न गी॒र्भी र॒थ्यं॑ सु॒दान॑वो मर्मृ॒ज्यन्ते॑ देव॒यव॑: । उ॒भे तो॒के तन॑ये दस्म विश्पते॒ पर्षि॒ राधो॑ म॒घोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: áśvam ǀ ná ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ rathyám ǀ su-dā́navaḥ ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ deva-yávaḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ toké íti ǀ tánaye ǀ dasma ǀ viśpate ǀ párṣi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The liberal worshippers with their hymns honour you harnessed to the car like a horse; graceful lord ofmen, grant wealth to us rich in children and grandchildren.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मंहि॑ष्ठाय गायत ऋ॒ताव्ने॑ बृह॒ते शु॒क्रशो॑चिषे । उप॑स्तुतासो अ॒ग्नये॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ máṃhiṣṭhāya ǀ gāyata ǀ ṛtá-vne ǀ bṛhaté ǀ śukrá-śociṣe ǀúpa-stutāsaḥ ǀ agnáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Singers of hymns, sing aloud to the mightyAgni, most bounteous, observant of truth an dradiant withbrightness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वं॑सते म॒घवा॑ वी॒रव॒द्यश॒: समि॑द्धो द्यु॒म्न्याहु॑तः । कु॒विन्नो॑ अस्य सुम॒तिर्नवी॑य॒स्यच्छा॒ वाजे॑भिरा॒गम॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaṃsate ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ naḥ ǀ asya ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ návīyasī ǀ áccha ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ ā-gámat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wealthy and glorious (Agni), when invoked and kindled, pours forth on his votaries abundance offood with children; may his ever fresh favour continually come to us with all kinds of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठ॑मु प्रि॒याणां॑ स्तु॒ह्या॑सा॒वाति॑थिम् । अ॒ग्निं रथा॑नां॒ यम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: préṣṭham ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ṇām ǀ stuhí ǀ āsāva ǀ átithim ǀagním ǀ ráthānām ǀ yámam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praise, singer of hymns, the guest,Agni, the dearest of the dear, the driver of chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदि॑ता॒ यो निदि॑ता॒ वेदि॑ता॒ वस्वा य॒ज्ञियो॑ व॒वर्त॑ति । दु॒ष्टरा॒ यस्य॑ प्रव॒णे नोर्मयो॑ धि॒या वाज॒ सिषा॑सतः
shlokas.transliteration: út-itā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ní-ditā ǀ véditā ǀ vásu ǀ ā́ ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ vavártati ǀdustárāḥ ǀ yásya ǀ pravaṇé ǀ ná ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ sísāsataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Praise him) the knower, worthy of the sacrifice, who brings to us treasures which have come up (fromthe depths) and are far-renowned-- whose (flames), as he hastend to wage the battle by means of our sacred riteand hard to be passed through as waves rushing down a declivity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ हृणीता॒मति॑थि॒र्वसु॑र॒ग्निः पु॑रुप्रश॒स्त ए॒षः । यः सु॒होता॑ स्वध्व॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ hṛṇītām ǀ átithiḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ puru-praśastáḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ su-hótā ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May none hinderAgnifrom coming to us, our guest, the giver of dwellings, praised by many-- (Agni)who is the excellent invoker of the gods, who offers an excellent sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो ते रि॑ष॒न्ये अच्छो॑क्तिभिर्व॒सोऽग्ने॒ केभि॑श्चि॒देवै॑: । की॒रिश्चि॒द्धि त्वामीट्टे॑ दू॒त्या॑य रा॒तह॑व्यः स्वध्व॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ té ǀ riṣan ǀ yé ǀ ácchokti-bhiḥ ǀ vaso íti ǀ ágne ǀ kébhiḥ ǀ cit ǀ évaiḥ ǀkīríḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ ī́ṭṭe ǀ dūtyā́ya ǀ rātá-havyaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, giver of dwellings, let not those come to harm, who approach you in whatever manner with hymnsof praise; the worshipper who offers his libation and duly performs the rite praises you that you may be thebearer of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग्ने॑ याहि म॒रुत्स॑खा रु॒द्रेभि॒: सोम॑पीतये । सोभ॑र्या॒ उप॑ सुष्टु॒तिं मा॒दय॑स्व॒ स्व॑र्णरे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agne ǀ yāhi ǀ marút-sakhā ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ sóma-pītaye ǀsóbharyāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ su-stutím ǀ mādáyasva ǀ sváḥ-nare ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who have theMarutsas your friends, come with theRudrasto drinkt heSoma; come to thepraises of Sobhari; delight yourself at our solemn rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वादि॑ष्ठया॒ मदि॑ष्ठया॒ पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या । इन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: svā́diṣṭhayā ǀ mádiṣṭhayā ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀíndrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, in a most sweet and exhilarating stream, effused forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒क्षो॒हा वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर॒भि योनि॒मयो॑हतम् । द्रुणा॑ स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: rakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ viśvá-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yónim ǀ áyaḥ-hatam ǀdrúṇā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-beholding destroyer ofrākṣasashas stepped upon his gold-smitten birthplace, united with the wooden cask.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒रि॒वो॒धात॑मो भव॒ मंहि॑ष्ठो वृत्र॒हन्त॑मः । पर्षि॒ राधो॑ म॒घोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: varivaḥ-dhā́tamaḥ ǀ bhava ǀ máṃhiṣṭhaḥ ǀ vṛtrahán-tamaḥ ǀpárṣi ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ maghónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be the lavish giver of wealth, most bounteous, the destroyer of enemies; bestow on us the riches of the affluent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्ष म॒हानां॑ दे॒वानां॑ वी॒तिमन्ध॑सा । अ॒भि वाज॑मु॒त श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ mahā́nām ǀ devā́nām ǀ vītím ǀ ándhasā ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come with food to the sacrifice of the mighty gods, and bring to us strength and sustenance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामच्छा॑ चरामसि॒ तदिदर्थं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे । इन्दो॒ त्वे न॑ आ॒शस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ áccha ǀ carāmasi ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ ártham ǀ divé-dive ǀíndo íti ǀ tvé íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ā-śásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you we come, O dropping (Soma); for you only is this our worship day by day, our prayers are to you, none other.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒नाति॑ ते परि॒स्रुतं॒ सोमं॒ सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒ता । वारे॑ण॒ शश्व॑ता॒ तना॑
shlokas.transliteration: punā́ti ǀ te ǀ pari-srútam ǀ sómam ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀvā́reṇa ǀ śáśvatā ǀ tánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter of the Sun purifies your gushing streams through the eternal outstretched hair.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॒मण्वी॑: सम॒र्य आ गृ॒भ्णन्ति॒ योष॑णो॒ दश॑ । स्वसा॑र॒: पार्ये॑ दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ áṇvīḥ ǀ sa-maryé ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛbhṇánti ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ pā́rye ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten sister-fingers seize you in the sacrifice, on the final day (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमीं॑ हिन्वन्त्य॒ग्रुवो॒ धम॑न्ति बाकु॒रं दृति॑म् । त्रि॒धातु॑ वार॒णं मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ dhámanti ǀ bākurám ǀ dṛ́tim ǀtri-dhā́tu ǀ vāraṇám ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fingers press theSoma, they squeeze it glittering like a water-skin; its juice becomes threefold, enemy-averting.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी॒३॒॑ममघ्न्या॑ उ॒त श्री॒णन्ति॑ धे॒नव॒: शिशु॑म् । सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ imám ǀ ághnyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ śrīṇánti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ śíśum ǀsómam ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The inviolable kine mingle this freshSomawith their milk forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदिन्द्रो॒ मदे॒ष्वा विश्वा॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ जिघ्नते । शूरो॑ म॒घा च॑ मंहते
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ jighnate ǀśū́raḥ ǀ maghā́ ǀ ca ǀ maṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the exhilaration of this draught the heroIndrasmites all his enemies and bestows wealth (on his worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व देव॒वीरति॑ प॒वित्रं॑ सोम॒ रंह्या॑ । इन्द्र॑मिन्दो॒ वृषा वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ deva-vī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ ráṃhyā ǀíndram ǀ indo íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow on,Soma, seeking the gods, hastening on in your purifying course; enterIndra, OIndu, the showerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ व॑च्यस्व॒ महि॒ प्सरो॒ वृषे॑न्दो द्यु॒म्नव॑त्तमः । आ योनिं॑ धर्ण॒सिः स॑दः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vacyasva ǀ máhi ǀ psáraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumnávat-tamaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndu, do you, the mighty showerer (of blessings) most glorious upholder, send us food, and sit down in yours own plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधु॑क्षत प्रि॒यं मधु॒ धारा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ वे॒धस॑: । अ॒पो व॑सिष्ट सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádhukṣata ǀ priyám ǀ mádhu ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ vasiṣṭa ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The stream of effused creativeSomamilks out the joy-giving ambrosia; the accomplisher of holy rites veils itself in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हान्तं॑ त्वा म॒हीरन्वापो॑ अर्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः । यद्गोभि॑र्वासयि॒ष्यसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́ntam ǀ tvā ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayiṣyáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Som), when you will veil yourself in the milk, the mighty streaming waters flow to you, the mighty one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रो अ॒प्सु मा॑मृजे विष्ट॒म्भो ध॒रुणो॑ दि॒वः । सोम॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अस्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: samudráḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mamṛje ǀ viṣṭambháḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The juice-distillingSoma, the sustainer, the supporter of heaven, is purified in the water-- favouring us, (it is poured) into the straining cloth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अचि॑क्रद॒द्वृषा॒ हरि॑र्म॒हान्मि॒त्रो न द॑र्श॒तः । सं सूर्ये॑ण रोचते
shlokas.transliteration: ácikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ darśatáḥ ǀsám ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ rocate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty golden-hued showerer of blessings utters a sound as it drops, beautiful as a friend; it shines (in the heavens) with the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गिर॑स्त इन्द॒ ओज॑सा मर्मृ॒ज्यन्ते॑ अप॒स्युव॑: । याभि॒र्मदा॑य॒ शुम्भ॑से
shlokas.transliteration: gíraḥ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ ójasā ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ śúmbhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndu, by the power the busy voices are hallowed which adorn you as you drop for our exhilaratioṇ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ मदा॑य॒ घृष्व॑य उ लोककृ॒त्नुमी॑महे । तव॒ प्रश॑स्तयो म॒हीः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loka-kṛtnúm ǀ īmahe ǀtáva ǀ prá-śastayaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We ask you for exhilaration, you the giver of the highest world to your foe-crushing worshipper-- great are your praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्य॑मिन्दविन्द्र॒युर्मध्व॑: पवस्व॒ धार॑या । प॒र्जन्यो॑ वृष्टि॒माँ इ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ indo íti ǀ indra-yúḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀparjányaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭimā́n-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, do you, longing forIndra, stream upon us with a shower of ambrosia, like a raining cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गो॒षा इ॑न्दो नृ॒षा अ॑स्यश्व॒सा वा॑ज॒सा उ॒त । आ॒त्मा य॒ज्ञस्य॑ पू॒र्व्यः
shlokas.transliteration: go-sā́ḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ nṛ-sā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ aśva-sā́ḥ ǀ vāja-sā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀātmā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, you are the giver of kine, of children, of horses, and of food; you are the primevalsoulof the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दे॒वो अम॑र्त्यः पर्ण॒वीरि॑व दीयति । अ॒भि द्रोणा॑न्या॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ parṇavī́ḥ-iva ǀ dīyati ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine immortal (Soma) hastens as a bird to settle on the sacrificial vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दे॒वो वि॒पा कृ॒तोऽति॒ ह्वरां॑सि धावति । पव॑मानो॒ अदा॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ vipā́ ǀ kṛtáḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ dhāvati ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine (Soma), expressed by the fingers, and dropping inviolable, rushes against the enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दे॒वो वि॑प॒न्युभि॒: पव॑मान ऋता॒युभि॑: । हरि॒र्वाजा॑य मृज्यते
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ vipanyú-bhiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ mṛjyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine (Soma), as it drops, is adorned (with hymns) by the sacrifice-desiring priests as a horse for battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒ शूरो॒ यन्नि॑व॒ सत्व॑भिः । पव॑मानः सिषासति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ yán-iva ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sisāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This strong one, as it drops, seems to encompass all desirable things with its power and seeks to bestow them upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दे॒वो र॑थर्यति॒ पव॑मानो दशस्यति । आ॒विष्कृ॑णोति वग्व॒नुम्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ratharyati ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ daśasyati ǀāvíḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ vagvanúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine (Soma), as it drops, prepares its chariot (to come to us); it flings us our boons, it utters a sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष विप्रै॑र॒भिष्टु॑तो॒ऽपो दे॒वो वि गा॑हते । दध॒द्रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vípraiḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀdádhat ǀ rátnāni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine (Soma), praised by the priests and giving wealth to the worshipper, plural nges into the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दिवं॒ वि धा॑वति ति॒रो रजां॑सि॒ धार॑या । पव॑मान॒: कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dívam ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Making a sound as it drops in a continued stream it rushes across the worlds into heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दिवं॒ व्यास॑रत्ति॒रो रजां॒स्यस्पृ॑तः । पव॑मानः स्वध्व॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dívam ǀ ví ǀ ā́ ǀ asarat ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájāṃsi ǀ áspṛtaḥ ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As it drops, completing the sacrifice, it passes across the worlds in inviolable to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प्र॒त्नेन॒ जन्म॑ना दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॑: सु॒तः । हरि॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ jánmanā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine and expressed for the gods by an ancient birth, the golden-hued (Soma) flows in the straining cloth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष उ॒ स्य पु॑रुव्र॒तो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो ज॒नय॒न्निष॑: । धार॑या पवते सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ puru-vratáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀdhā́rayā ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Produced at our rite and producing abundant food theSoma, efficacious in sacrifices, flows effused in a stream.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॑ च सोम॒ जेषि॑ च॒ पव॑मान॒ महि॒ श्रव॑: । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: sána ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ jéṣi ǀ ca ǀ pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure-dropping (Soma), bounteous food, welcome (the gods at our rite) and overcome (the demons); and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॒ ज्योति॒: सना॒ स्व१॒॑र्विश्वा॑ च सोम॒ सौभ॑गा । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: sána ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ sána ǀ sváḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ sáubhagā ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, give us brightness, give us heaven, give us all good things; and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सना॒ दक्ष॑मु॒त क्रतु॒मप॑ सोम॒ मृधो॑ जहि । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: sána ǀ dákṣam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀ ápa ǀ soma ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, give us strength, give us wisdom, drive away our enemies; and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पवी॑तारः पुनी॒तन॒ सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: pávitāraḥ ǀ punītána ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Priests, press out theSomaforIndrato drink; (O Soma), make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सूर्ये॑ न॒ आ भ॑ज॒ तव॒ क्रत्वा॒ तवो॒तिभि॑: । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sū́rye ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, (OSoma), by your power and your protections bring us to the sun, and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ क्रत्वा॒ तवो॒तिभि॒र्ज्योक्प॑श्येम॒ सूर्य॑म् । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ krátvā ǀ táva ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ jyók ǀ paśyema ǀ sū́ryam ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्ष स्वायुध॒ सोम॑ द्वि॒बर्ह॑सं र॒यिम् । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ su-āyudha ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright-weaponedSoma, shower upon us wealth abundant for both worlds; and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य१॒॑र्षान॑पच्युतो र॒यिं स॒मत्सु॑ सास॒हिः । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ samát-su ǀ sasahíḥ ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O you who are unvanquished in battle, smitter of enemies, shower wealth upon us, and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां य॒ज्ञैर॑वीवृध॒न्पव॑मान॒ विध॑र्मणि । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ avīvṛdhan ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure-dropping (Soma), they glorify you with the holy rites for their own upholding make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒यिं न॑श्चि॒त्रम॒श्विन॒मिन्दो॑ वि॒श्वायु॒मा भ॑र । अथा॑ नो॒ वस्य॑सस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: rayím ǀ naḥ ǀ citrám ǀ aśvínam ǀ índo íti ǀ viśvá-āyum ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ vásyasaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, bring to us varied wealth, abundant in horses and all-reaching, and make us happy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो वि॒श्वत॒स्पति॒: पव॑मानो॒ वि रा॑जति । प्री॒णन्वृषा॒ कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀprīṇán ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure-flowing (Soma) shines forth in its brightness, the universal lord, the showerer of blessings, the rejoicer, uttering a loud sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तनू॒नपा॒त्पव॑मान॒: शृङ्गे॒ शिशा॑नो अर्षति । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण॒ रार॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: tanū́-nápāt ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ rā́rajat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure-flowingTanūnapāt, rushes sharpening its splendour on the height and hastens through the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒ळेन्य॒: पव॑मानो र॒यिर्वि रा॑जति द्यु॒मान् । मधो॒र्धारा॑भि॒रोज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: īḷényaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀmádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure-flowing bright (Soma), the bounteous giver, worthy of all praise, shines forth in its might with the streams of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒र्हिः प्रा॒चीन॒मोज॑सा॒ पव॑मानः स्तृ॒णन्हरि॑: । दे॒वेषु॑ दे॒व ई॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: barhíḥ ǀ prācī́nam ǀ ójasā ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ stṛṇán ǀ háriḥ ǀdevéṣu ǀ deváḥ ǀ īyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bright golden-hued pure-flowing one rushes in its might, strewing the sacred grass in the sacrifice with its points towards the cast.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदातै॑र्जिहते बृ॒हद्द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॑: । पव॑मानेन॒ सुष्टु॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ ā́taiḥ ǀ jihate ǀ bṛhát ǀ dvā́raḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ hiraṇyáyīḥ ǀpávamānena ǀ sú-stutāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bright golden doors, praised by the priests together with theSoma, rise up from the vast horizon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒शि॒ल्पे बृ॑ह॒ती म॒ही पव॑मानो वृषण्यति । नक्तो॒षासा॒ न द॑र्श॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: suśilpé íti su-śilpé ǀ bṛhatī́ íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ vṛṣaṇyati ǀnáktoṣásā ǀ ná ǀ darśaté íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure-flowing (Soma) longs for the fair-formed wide-reaching mighty Night and Dawn not yet visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भा दे॒वा नृ॒चक्ष॑सा॒ होता॑रा॒ दैव्या॑ हुवे । पव॑मान॒ इन्द्रो॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́ ǀ devā́ ǀ nṛ-cákṣasā ǀ hótārā ǀ dáivyā ǀ huve ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I  invoke the two divine priests, the two deities who behold men-- the pure-flowing (Soma) is radiant and the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: भार॑ती॒ पव॑मानस्य॒ सर॑स्व॒तीळा॑ म॒ही । इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञमा ग॑मन्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीः सु॒पेश॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: bhā́ratī ǀ pávamānasya ǀ sárasvatī ǀ íḷā ǀ mahī́ ǀimám ǀ naḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ gaman ǀ tisráḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the three beautiful goddesses,Bhāratī,Sarasvatī, and mighty Iḷā, come to this our offering of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टा॑रमग्र॒जां गो॒पां पु॑रो॒यावा॑न॒मा हु॑वे । इन्दु॒रिन्द्रो॒ वृषा॒ हरि॒: पव॑मानः प्र॒जाप॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭāram ǀ agra-jā́m ǀ gopā́m ǀ puraḥ-yā́vānam ǀ ā́ ǀ huve ǀínduḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ prajā́-patiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invokeTvaṣṭā, the first-born, the protector, the leader; the golden-coloured pure-flowingInduisIndra, the showerer, the lord of all creatures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वन॒स्पतिं॑ पवमान॒ मध्वा॒ सम॑ङ्ग्धि॒ धार॑या । स॒हस्र॑वल्शं॒ हरि॑तं॒ भ्राज॑मानं हिर॒ण्यय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vánaspátim ǀ pavamāna ǀ mádhvā ǀ sám ǀ aṅgdhi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀsahásra-valśam ǀ háritam ǀ bhrā́jamānam ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PureSoma, consecrate with your streaming ambrosia the green bright golden-huedVanaspatiwith its thousand branches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ देवा॒: स्वाहा॑कृतिं॒ पव॑मान॒स्या ग॑त । वा॒युर्बृह॒स्पति॒: सूर्यो॒ऽग्निरिन्द्र॑: स॒जोष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ svā́hā-kṛtim ǀ pávamānasya ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀvāyúḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O all ye gods, come together to the consecration of theSoma--Vāyu,Bṛhaspati,Sūrya,AgniandIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रया॑ सोम॒ धार॑या॒ वृषा॑ पवस्व देव॒युः । अव्यो॒ वारे॑ष्वस्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: mandráyā ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ pavasva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who is the showerer (of benefits), devoted to the gods, favourable to us, flow with your exhilarating stream into the woollen sieve.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्यं मद्यं॒ मद॒मिन्द॒विन्द्र॒ इति॑ क्षर । अ॒भि वा॒जिनो॒ अर्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀ índo íti ǀ índraḥ ǀ íti ǀ kṣara ǀabhí ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu,do you, as sovereign, effuse that exhilarating juice, and pour forth vigorous steeds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्यं पू॒र्व्यं मदं॑ सुवा॒नो अ॑र्ष प॒वित्र॒ आ । अ॒भि वाज॑मु॒त श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ pūrvyám ǀ mádam ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rain out through the filter, while pressed that ancient exhilarating fluid, and pour us forth strength and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ द्र॒प्सास॒ इन्द॑व॒ आपो॒ न प्र॒वता॑सरन् । पु॒ना॒ना इन्द्र॑माशत
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ drapsā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ asaran ǀpunānā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The quickly-falling drops, as they filter, followIndraand reach him, like waters rushing down a declivity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमत्य॑मिव वा॒जिनं॑ मृ॒जन्ति॒ योष॑णो॒ दश॑ । वने॒ क्रीळ॑न्त॒मत्य॑विम्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ átyam-iva ǀ vājínam ǀ mṛjánti ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀváne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That which sporting in the wood and spurting beyond the sieve, the ten sisters press, as (men rub down) a strong horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं गोभि॒र्वृष॑णं॒ रसं॒ मदा॑य दे॒ववी॑तये । सु॒तं भरा॑य॒ सं सृ॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ devá-vītaye ǀsutám ǀ bhárāya ǀ sám ǀ sṛja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That desire-showring liquor, effused for the drink of the gods and for our exhilaration, mix with milk for prowess in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो दे॒वाय॒ धार॒येन्द्रा॑य पवते सु॒तः । पयो॒ यद॑स्य पी॒पय॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀpáyaḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ pīpáyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSoma, when effused, flows to the divineIndrain a stream, since its milk flattens him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒त्मा य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रंह्या॑ सुष्वा॒णः प॑वते सु॒तः । प्र॒त्नं नि पा॑ति॒ काव्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ātmā́ ǀ yajñásya ǀ ráṃhyā ǀ susvānáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀpratnám ǀ ní ǀ pāti ǀ kā́vyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thesoulof the sacrifice, the effusedSoma, flows; with speed bringing blessings, and maintains his ancient seer-hood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा पु॑ना॒न इ॑न्द्र॒युर्मदं॑ मदिष्ठ वी॒तये॑ । गुहा॑ चिद्दधिषे॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ punānáḥ ǀ indra-yúḥ ǀ mádam ǀ madiṣṭha ǀ vītáye ǀgúhā ǀ cit ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most exciting (Soma), devoted toIndra, as you pour forth the exhilarating juice for his drinking, you emit sounds in the secret (hall of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: असृ॑ग्र॒मिन्द॑वः प॒था धर्म॑न्नृ॒तस्य॑ सु॒श्रिय॑: । वि॒दा॒ना अ॑स्य॒ योज॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ dhárman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ su-śríyaḥ ǀvidānā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ yójanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The excellent streams (of theSoma), feeling a union withIndra, flow forth in the ceremony by the path of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र धारा॒ मध्वो॑ अग्रि॒यो म॒हीर॒पो वि गा॑हते । ह॒विर्ह॒विष्षु॒ वन्द्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dhā́rā ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀhavíḥ ǀ havíṣṣu ǀ vándyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That which is to be praised as the oblation among oblations is immersed in the great (holy) waters, the stream of honey, the pre-eminent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यु॒जो वा॒चो अ॑ग्रि॒यो वृषाव॑ चक्रद॒द्वने॑ । सद्मा॒भि स॒त्यो अ॑ध्व॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yujáḥ ǀ vācáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ áva ǀ cakradat ǀ váne ǀsádma ǀ abhí ǀ satyáḥ ǀ adhvaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pre-eminent (Soma), the showerer of benefits, the truthful, the indestructible, utters continuous sounds in the water, towards the sacrificial hall.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यत्काव्या॑ क॒विर्नृ॒म्णा वसा॑नो॒ अर्ष॑ति । स्व॑र्वा॒जी सि॑षासति
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yát ǀ kā́vyā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ árṣati ǀsváḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ sisāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the seer (Soma), wearing ample treasures, goes round the praises (of his worshippers), then the mighty (Indra) in heaven is eager to repair to the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो अ॒भि स्पृधो॒ विशो॒ राजे॑व सीदति । यदी॑मृ॒ण्वन्ति॑ वे॒धस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ sīdati ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ ṛṇvánti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the priests excite it, the flowingSomalike a king destroys opposing (demons and) men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्यो॒ वारे॒ परि॑ प्रि॒यो हरि॒र्वने॑षु सीदति । रे॒भो व॑नुष्यते म॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ sīdati ǀrebháḥ ǀ vanuṣyate ǀ matī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tinted (Soma), dear to the gods, commingled with the water, sits down upon the woollen sieve, uttering a sound it is greeted by praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॒युमिन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ सा॒कं मदे॑न गच्छति । रणा॒ यो अ॑स्य॒ धर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ índram ǀ aśvínā ǀ sākám ǀ mádena ǀ gacchati ǀráṇa ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is assiduous in the functions of (providing and preparing) theSoma, goes with exhilaration toVāyu,Indraand theAśvins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ भगं॒ मध्व॑: पवन्त ऊ॒र्मय॑: । वि॒दा॒ना अ॑स्य॒ शक्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ bhágam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ pavante ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀvidānā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ śákma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The streams of the sweetSomaflow toMitraandVaruṇaand toBhaga; the worshippers knowing its (virtues are rewarded) with happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ रोदसी र॒यिं मध्वो॒ वाज॑स्य सा॒तये॑ । श्रवो॒ वसू॑नि॒ सं जि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ rodasī íti ǀ rayím ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sātáye ǀśrávaḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ sám ǀ jitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth, for the acquisition of this exhilaratingSomafood, win for us wealth, food and treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॑ अ॒भि प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम॑मक्षरन् । वर्ध॑न्तो अस्य वी॒र्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́mam ǀ akṣaran ǀvárdhantaḥ ǀ asya ǀ vīryám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheseSomajuices distil the dear desire ofIndra, increasing his vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नास॑श्चमू॒षदो॒ गच्छ॑न्तो वा॒युम॒श्विना॑ । ते नो॑ धान्तु सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: punānā́saḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǀ gácchantaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ aśvínā ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāntu ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure-flowing, filling the ladles, and proceeding toVāyuand theAśvins, may they sustain our energy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य सोम॒ राध॑से पुना॒नो हार्दि॑ चोदय । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ soma ǀ rā́dhase ǀ punānáḥ ǀ hā́rdi ǀ codaya ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, pure-flowing, desired for the gratification ofIndra, do you impel him to sit in the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒जन्ति॑ त्वा॒ दश॒ क्षिपो॑ हि॒न्वन्ति॑ स॒प्त धी॒तय॑: । अनु॒ विप्रा॑ अमादिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: mṛjánti ǀ tvā ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ hinvánti ǀ saptá ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀánu ǀ víprāḥ ǀ amādiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers strain you, the seven priests caress you, the worshippers gladden you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा॒ मदा॑य॒ कं सृ॑जा॒नमति॑ मे॒ष्य॑: । सं गोभि॑र्वासयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ sṛjānám ǀ áti ǀ meṣyáḥ ǀsám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you stream on the water and the woollen sieve, we wrap you up with milk for the exhilaration of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नः क॒लशे॒ष्वा वस्त्रा॑ण्यरु॒षो हरि॑: । परि॒ गव्या॑न्यव्यत
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀpári ǀ gávyāni ǀ avyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified in the pitchers, radiant and green-tinted, theSomaputs on the raiment derived from the cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒घोन॒ आ प॑वस्व नो ज॒हि विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विष॑: । इन्दो॒ सखा॑य॒मा वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: maghónaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ naḥ ǀ jahí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ sákhāyam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow to us, your wealthy (worshippers); destoy all our enemies;Indu, enter your friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वः परि॑ स्रव द्यु॒म्नं पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॑ । सहो॑ नः सोम पृ॒त्सु धा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ dyumnám ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀsáhaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour down rain from heaven, and abundance upon the earth; uphold our strength,Soma, in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒चक्ष॑सं त्वा व॒यमिन्द्र॑पीतं स्व॒र्विद॑म् । भ॒क्षी॒महि॑ प्र॒जामिष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-cákṣasam ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ índra-pītam ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀbhakṣīmáhi ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ íṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Adoring) you, the contemplator of men, the beverage ofIndraand the knower of all things, may we be blessed with progeny and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ प्रि॒या दि॒वः क॒विर्वयां॑सि न॒प्त्यो॑र्हि॒तः । सु॒वा॒नो या॑ति क॒विक्र॑तुः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ váyāṃsi ǀ naptyóḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀsuvānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seer (Soma) having wise designs, when plural ced between the two boards and effused, proceeds to the stones which are most dear to heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रप्र॒ क्षया॑य॒ पन्य॑से॒ जना॑य॒ जुष्टो॑ अ॒द्रुहे॑ । वी॒त्य॑र्ष॒ चनि॑ष्ठया
shlokas.transliteration: prá-pra ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ pányase ǀ jánāya ǀ júṣṭaḥ ǀ adrúhe ǀvītī́ ǀ arṣa ǀ cániṣṭhayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go forth in a most abundant stream, ample for his sustenance, to the guileless man, your own, who praises you”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सू॒नुर्मा॒तरा॒ शुचि॑र्जा॒तो जा॒ते अ॑रोचयत् । म॒हान्म॒ही ऋ॑ता॒वृधा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ śúciḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ jāté íti ǀ arocayat ǀmahā́n ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That mighty and pure son, when born, illumines his mighty parents (heaven and earth), the progenitors (of all things), the augmenters of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स स॒प्त धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तो न॒द्यो॑ अजिन्वद॒द्रुह॑: । या एक॒मक्षि॑ वावृ॒धुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ ajinvat ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ ékam ǀ ákṣi ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused by the fingers, (Soma) gladdens the seven guileless rivers, who have magnified him one and undecaying.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॒भि सन्त॒मस्तृ॑तं म॒हे युवा॑न॒मा द॑धुः । इन्दु॑मिन्द्र॒ तव॑ व्र॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sántam ǀ ástṛtam ǀ mahé ǀ yúvānam ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǀíndum ǀ indra ǀ táva ǀ vraté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, at your worship, they (the fingers) have provided the present, indestructible, and ever-youthfulIndu, for your solemn service.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वह्नि॒रम॑र्त्यः स॒प्त प॑श्यति॒ वाव॑हिः । क्रिवि॑र्दे॒वीर॑तर्पयत्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ paśyati ǀ vā́vahiḥ ǀkríviḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ atarpayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortal bearer (of the oblation), the conveyer (of content to the gods), beholds the seven rivers, full as a well, he has satisfied the divine streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॒ कल्पे॑षु नः पुम॒स्तमां॑सि सोम॒ योध्या॑ । तानि॑ पुनान जङ्घनः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ kálpeṣu ǀ naḥ ǀ pumaḥ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ soma ǀ yódhyā ǀtā́ni ǀ punāna ǀ jaṅghanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us, manlySoma, in the days of sacrifice purifier, destroy those powers of darkness against which we must contend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नव्य॑से॒ नवी॑यसे सू॒क्ताय॑ साधया प॒थः । प्र॒त्न॒वद्रो॑चया॒ रुच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ návyase ǀ návīyase ǀ su-uktā́ya ǀ sādhaya ǀ patháḥ ǀpratna-vát ǀ rocaya ǀ rúcaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly speed on the road for our new praiseworthy hymn; as of old, display your radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ महि॒ श्रवो॒ गामश्वं॑ रासि वी॒रव॑त् । सना॑ मे॒धां सना॒ स्व॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ rāsi ǀ vīrá-vat ǀsána ǀ medhā́m ǀ sána ǀ sváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purifier (Soma), you grant us abundant food withmaleoff-spring, and cattle and horses; give us understanding, give us all (we desire).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स्वा॒नासो॒ रथा॑ इ॒वार्व॑न्तो॒ न श्र॑व॒स्यव॑: । सोमा॑सो रा॒ये अ॑क्रमुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ svānā́saḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ akramuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Longing for food theSomajuices, uttering a sound like chariots or like horses, have come for the sake of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒न्वा॒नासो॒ रथा॑ इव दधन्वि॒रे गभ॑स्त्योः । भरा॑सः का॒रिणा॑मिव
shlokas.transliteration: hinvānā́saḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ dadhanviré ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀbhárāsaḥ ǀ kāríṇām-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Coming like chariots (to the sacrifice), they are upheld in the arms (of the priests) as burdens (in the arms) of labourers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॑नो॒ न प्रश॑स्तिभि॒: सोमा॑सो॒ गोभि॑रञ्जते । य॒ज्ञो न स॒प्त धा॒तृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jānaḥ ǀ ná ǀ práśasti-bhiḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjate ǀyajñáḥ ǀ ná ǀ saptá ǀ dhātṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The libations are anointed with milk as kings with praises, and (tended) as a sacrifice by seven priests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ सुवा॒नास॒ इन्द॑वो॒ मदा॑य ब॒र्हणा॑ गि॒रा । सु॒ता अ॑र्षन्ति॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ barháṇā ǀ girā́ ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices, when poured forth, are effused with loud praise, and proceed in a stream to excite exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒पा॒नासो॑ वि॒वस्व॑तो॒ जन॑न्त उ॒षसो॒ भग॑म् । सूरा॒ अण्वं॒ वि त॑न्वते
shlokas.transliteration: āpānā́saḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ jánantaḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ bhágam ǀsū́rāḥ ǀ áṇvam ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The beverages ofVivasvatand producing the glory of the dawn, the issuing juices spread their sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ द्वारा॑ मती॒नां प्र॒त्ना ऋ॑ण्वन्ति का॒रव॑: । वृष्णो॒ हर॑स आ॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ dvā́rā ǀ matīnā́m ǀ pratnā́ḥ ǀ ṛṇvanti ǀ kārávaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ hárase ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The old makers of hymns, men the offerers of theSoma, throw open the doors (of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मी॒ची॒नास॑ आसते॒ होता॑रः स॒प्तजा॑मयः । प॒दमेक॑स्य॒ पिप्र॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: sam-īcīnā́saḥ ǀ āsate ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ saptá-jāmayaḥ ǀpadám ǀ ékasya ǀ píprataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven associated ministers like so many kinsmen filling the receptacle of the single (Soma), sit down (at the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाभा॒ नाभिं॑ न॒ आ द॑दे॒ चक्षु॑श्चि॒त्सूर्ये॒ सचा॑ । क॒वेरप॑त्य॒मा दु॑हे
shlokas.transliteration: nā́bhā ǀ nā́bhim ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ cit ǀ sū́rye ǀ sácā ǀkavéḥ ǀ ápatyam ǀ ā́ ǀ duhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I take into my navel the navel of the sacrifice, my becomes associated with the sun, I fill the offspring of the sage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒या दि॒वस्प॒दम॑ध्व॒र्युभि॒र्गुहा॑ हि॒तम् । सूर॑: पश्यति॒ चक्ष॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ padám ǀ adhvaryú-bhiḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀsū́raḥ ǀ paśyati ǀ cákṣasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerful (Indra) looks with the eye of his own resplendent self on the acceptable plural ce of theSoma, fixed by the priests in the heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपा॑स्मै गायता नर॒: पव॑माना॒येन्द॑वे । अ॒भि दे॒वाँ इय॑क्षते
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ asmai ǀ gāyata ǀ naraḥ ǀ pávamānāya ǀ índave ǀabhí ǀ devā́n ǀ íyakṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing, leaders of rites, to this pure-flowing,Indu, who is desirous of offering worship to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि ते॒ मधु॑ना॒ पयोऽथ॑र्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । दे॒वं दे॒वाय॑ देव॒यु
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ te ǀ mádhunā ǀ páyaḥ ǀ átharvāṇaḥ ǀ aśiśrayuḥ ǀdevám ǀ devā́ya ǀ deva-yú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAtharvāṇahave mixed with sweet milk for the deity (Indra) your divine and god-devoted (juice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पवस्व॒ शं गवे॒ शं जना॑य॒ शमर्व॑ते । शं रा॑ज॒न्नोष॑धीभ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀ śám ǀ jánāya ǀ śám ǀ árvate ǀśám ǀ rājan ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant (Soma), do you pour prosperity upon our cattle, upon our people, upon our horses, and upon our plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒भ्रवे॒ नु स्वत॑वसेऽरु॒णाय॑ दिवि॒स्पृशे॑ । सोमा॑य गा॒थम॑र्चत
shlokas.transliteration: babhráve ǀ nú ǀ svá-tavase ǀ aruṇā́ya ǀ divi-spṛ́śe ǀsómāya ǀ gāthám ǀ arcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Recite praises to the brown-coloured self-vigorous (at times) red heaven-touchingSoma. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: हस्त॑च्युतेभि॒रद्रि॑भिः सु॒तं सोमं॑ पुनीतन । मधा॒वा धा॑वता॒ मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: hásta-cyutebhiḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ punītana ǀmádhau ǀ ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify theSomawhich has been effused by the stones whirled by thehands; mix the sweet (milk) in the inebriating juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नम॒सेदुप॑ सीदत द॒ध्नेद॒भि श्री॑णीतन । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रे॑ दधातन
shlokas.transliteration: námasā ǀ ít ǀ úpa ǀ sīdata ǀ dadhnā́ ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ śrīṇītana ǀíndum ǀ índre ǀ dadhātana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach with reverence, mix (the libation) with the curds, offer theSomatoIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒मि॒त्र॒हा विच॑र्षणि॒: पव॑स्व सोम॒ शं गवे॑ । दे॒वेभ्यो॑ अनुकाम॒कृत्
shlokas.transliteration: amitra-hā́ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ anukāma-kṛ́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, slayer of our enemies, the wise one, the fulfiller of the desires of the gods, do you shed prosperity on our cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ पात॑वे॒ मदा॑य॒ परि॑ षिच्यसे । म॒न॒श्चिन्मन॑स॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ mádāya ǀ pári ǀ sicyase ǀmanaḥ-cít ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are cognizant of the mind, lord of the mind, you are poured forth forIndrato drink for his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान सु॒वीर्यं॑ र॒यिं सो॑म रिरीहि नः । इन्द॒विन्द्रे॑ण नो यु॒जा
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ rirīhi ǀ naḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índreṇa ǀ naḥ ǀ yujā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure-droppingSoma, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring, grant it to us,Indu, withIndraas our ally.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑ असृग्र॒मिन्द॑वः सु॒ता ऋ॒तस्य॒ साद॑ने । इन्द्रा॑य॒ मधु॑मत्तमाः
shlokas.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sádane ǀíndrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most sweet-flavouredSomalibations are poured forth toIndrain the hall of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि विप्रा॑ अनूषत॒ गावो॑ व॒त्सं न मा॒तर॑: । इन्द्रं॒ सोम॑स्य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ víprāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātáraḥ ǀíndram ǀ sómasya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (priests) call uponIndrato drink theSomaas the mother low to their calves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒द॒च्युत्क्षे॑ति॒ साद॑ने॒ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा वि॑प॒श्चित् । सोमो॑ गौ॒री अधि॑ श्रि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: mada-cyút ǀ kṣeti ǀ sádane ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ vipaḥ-cít ǀsómaḥ ǀ gaurī́ íti ǀ ádhi ǀ śritáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wisesoma, the bestower of exhilaration, dwells in the hall of (sacrifice), mixed with the waves of the river to a chant in the middle tone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो नाभा॑ विचक्ष॒णोऽव्यो॒ वारे॑ महीयते । सोमो॒ यः सु॒क्रतु॑: क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ mahīyate ǀsómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the observant, who is the wise seer, is worshipped in the navel of the sky, the woollen filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः सोम॑: क॒लशे॒ष्वाँ अ॒न्तः प॒वित्र॒ आहि॑तः । तमिन्दु॒: परि॑ षस्वजे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ antáríti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́-hitaḥ ǀtám ǀ índuḥ ǀ pári ǀ sasvaje ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induhas embraced thatSomawhich is collected in the sewers and has been passed through the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वाच॒मिन्दु॑रिष्यति समु॒द्रस्याधि॑ वि॒ष्टपि॑ । जिन्व॒न्कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́cam ǀ índuḥ ǀ iṣyati ǀ samudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀjínvan ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induemits a sound, abiding in the firmament of the sky, and delighting the nectar-shedding cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नित्य॑स्तोत्रो॒ वन॒स्पति॑र्धी॒नाम॒न्तः स॑ब॒र्दुघ॑: । हि॒न्वा॒नो मानु॑षा यु॒गा
shlokas.transliteration: nítya-stotraḥ ǀ vánaspátiḥ ǀ dhīnā́m ǀ antáríti ǀ sabaḥ-dúghaḥ ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, whose praise is eternal, the lord of forests, the shedder of nectar, and rejoicing the genitive rations of men, (is present) in the midst of our sacred rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒या दि॒वस्प॒दा सोमो॑ हिन्वा॒नो अ॑र्षति । विप्र॑स्य॒ धार॑या क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀvíprasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sageSoma, urged from heaven, flows in a stream to the beloved abodes of his devout (worshipper). ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वमान धारय र॒यिं स॒हस्र॑वर्चसम् । अ॒स्मे इ॑न्दो स्वा॒भुव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhāraya ǀ rayím ǀ sahásra-varcasam ǀasmé íti ǀ indo íti ǀ su-ābhúvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifyingIndu, bestow upon us wealth of a thousand radiances, excelent in its nature.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॑र्षति स॒हस्र॑धारो॒ अत्य॑विः । वा॒योरिन्द्र॑स्य निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ áti-aviḥ ǀvāyóḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifyingSoma, flowing in a thousand streams and passing through the woollen filter, proceeds to the prepared vessel forVāyuandIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानमवस्यवो॒ विप्र॑म॒भि प्र गा॑यत । सु॒ष्वा॒णं दे॒ववी॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānam ǀ avasyavaḥ ǀ vípram ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀsusvānám ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing aloud, you who are desirous of (divine) protection to he purifying wiseSoma, effused for the beverage of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑न्ते॒ वाज॑सातये॒ सोमा॑: स॒हस्र॑पाजसः । गृ॒णा॒ना दे॒ववी॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: pávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ sómāḥ ǀ sahásra-pājasaḥ ǀgṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices flow for the attainment of food, giving abundance of strength and hymned (to become) the beverage of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ वाज॑सातये॒ पव॑स्व बृह॒तीरिष॑: । द्यु॒मदि॑न्दो सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ pávasva ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀdyu-mát ǀ indo íti ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indu, for our attainment of food pour forth abundant streams, and splendid and excellent vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते न॑: सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं पव॑न्ता॒मा सु॒वीर्य॑म् । सु॒वा॒ना दे॒वास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ pávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsuvānā́ḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those divine libations, when effused, bring to us thousandfold wealth and excellent vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्या॑ हिया॒ना न हे॒तृभि॒रसृ॑ग्रं॒ वाज॑सातये । वि वार॒मव्य॑मा॒शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: átyāḥ ǀ hiyānā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ hetṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ásṛgram ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like horses urged to battle by their drivers, the swift-flowing juices have (flown) through the woollen fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒श्रा अ॑र्ष॒न्तीन्द॑वो॒ऽभि व॒त्सं न धे॒नव॑: । द॒ध॒न्वि॒रे गभ॑स्त्योः
shlokas.transliteration: vāśrā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ índavaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀdadhanviré ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Making a loud noise, the libations flow (to the vessel) like cows lowing to their calves; they are held in the arms (of the priests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जुष्ट॒ इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रः पव॑मान॒ कनि॑क्रदत् । विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विषो॑ जहि
shlokas.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ kánikradat ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Acceptable and giving delight toIndra, pure (Soma), do you, as you utter a sound, destroy all our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प॒घ्नन्तो॒ अरा॑व्ण॒: पव॑मानाः स्व॒र्दृश॑: । योना॑वृ॒तस्य॑ सीदत
shlokas.transliteration: apa-ghnántaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀ pávamānāḥ ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀyónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure (libations), beholding all things and destroying those who worship not, sit down in the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ प्रासि॑ष्यदत्क॒विः सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मावधि॑ श्रि॒तः । का॒रं बिभ्र॑त्पुरु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ asisyadat ǀ kavíḥ ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmáu ǀ ádhi ǀ śritáḥ ǀkārám ǀ bíbhrat ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (Soma) flows widely round, be taking itself to the waves of the river, and uttering a sound desired by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रा यदी॒ सब॑न्धव॒: पञ्च॒ व्राता॑ अप॒स्यव॑: । प॒रि॒ष्कृ॒ण्वन्ति॑ धर्ण॒सिम्
shlokas.transliteration: girā́ ǀ yádi ǀ sá-bandhavaḥ ǀ páñca ǀ vrā́tāḥ ǀ apasyávaḥ ǀpari-kṛṇvánti ǀ dharṇasím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the five kindred sacrificing races, desirous of accomplishing pious rites, honour the sustaining (Soma) with their praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आद॑स्य शु॒ष्मिणो॒ रसे॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॑मत्सत । यदी॒ गोभि॑र्वसा॒यते॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ asya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ ráse ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amatsata ǀyádi ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vasāyáte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then all the gods rejoice in the juice of this powerful (libation), when it is enveloped with milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि॒रि॒णा॒नो वि धा॑वति॒ जह॒च्छर्या॑णि॒ तान्वा॑ । अत्रा॒ सं जि॑घ्नते यु॒जा
shlokas.transliteration: ni-riṇānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀ jáhat ǀ śáryāṇi ǀ tā́nvā ǀátra ǀ sám ǀ jighnate ǀ yujā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Descending from the filters (into the vessel), and passing through the cloth's interstices, it becomes united in this (sacrifice) with its friend (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒प्तीभि॒र्यो वि॒वस्व॑तः शु॒भ्रो न मा॑मृ॒जे युवा॑ । गाः कृ॑ण्वा॒नो न नि॒र्णिज॑म्
