shlokas.transliteration: naptī́bhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ śubhráḥ ǀ ná ǀ mamṛjé ǀ yúvā ǀgā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is rubbed down by the grandchildren of the sacrificer like a handsome young (horse), and renders his form like the produce of the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ श्रि॒ती ति॑र॒श्चता॑ ग॒व्या जि॑गा॒त्यण्व्या॑ । व॒ग्नुमि॑यर्ति॒ यं वि॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ śritī́ ǀ tiraścátā ǀ gavyā́ ǀ jigāti ǀ áṇvyā ǀvagnúm ǀ iyarti ǀ yám ǀ vidé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expressed by the finger, he proceeds obliquely to the produce of the cow to mix with it; it utters a sound which (the worshipper) recognizes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि क्षिप॒: सम॑ग्मत म॒र्जय॑न्तीरि॒षस्पति॑म् । पृ॒ष्ठा गृ॑भ्णत वा॒जिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ sám ǀ agmata ǀ marjáyantīḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ pátim ǀpṛṣṭhā́ ǀ gṛbhṇata ǀ vājínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fingers combine expressing the lord of food (i.e.,Soma), and they grasp the back of the vigorous (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ मर्मृ॑श॒द्विश्वा॑नि सोम॒ पार्थि॑वा । वसू॑नि याह्यस्म॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ divyā́ni ǀ mármṛśat ǀ víśvāni ǀ soma ǀ pā́rthivā ǀvásūni ǀ yāhi ǀ asma-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who hols all the treasures of heaven and earth, come favourably disposed to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष धि॒या या॒त्यण्व्या॒ शूरो॒ रथे॑भिरा॒शुभि॑: । गच्छ॒न्निन्द्र॑स्य निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ yāti ǀ áṇvyā ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ráthebhiḥ ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀgácchan ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This heroicSomaexpressed by the fingers proceeds by the sacrifice, hastening with swift chariots toIndra's above.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष पु॒रू धि॑यायते बृह॒ते दे॒वता॑तये । यत्रा॒मृता॑स॒ आस॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ purú ǀ dhiyā-yate ǀ bṛhaté ǀ devá-tātaye ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomaengages in many holy rites for the great sacrifice where the immortals sit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष हि॒तो वि नी॑यते॒ऽन्तः शु॒भ्राव॑ता प॒था । यदी॑ तु॒ञ्जन्ति॒ भूर्ण॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǀ antáríti ǀ śubhrá-vatā ǀ pathā́ ǀyádi ǀ tuñjánti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural ced (in the cart) he is brought by a brilliant path when the offerers of the libation present him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष शृङ्गा॑णि॒ दोधु॑व॒च्छिशी॑ते यू॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ वृषा॑ । नृ॒म्णा दधा॑न॒ ओज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śṛ́ṅgāṇi ǀ dódhuvat ǀ śíśīte ǀ yūthyáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀnṛmṇā́ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He tosses his horns as a bull, the lord of the herd, sharpens his, bearing treasures (for us) by his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष रु॒क्मिभि॑रीयते वा॒जी शु॒भ्रेभि॑रं॒शुभि॑: । पति॒: सिन्धू॑नां॒ भव॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ rukmí-bhiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ vājī́ ǀ śubhrébhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀpátiḥ ǀ síndhūnām ǀ bhávan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He proceeds along impetuous with goldenbrilliant rays, the lord of streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वसू॑नि पिब्द॒ना परु॑षा ययि॒वाँ अति॑ । अव॒ शादे॑षु गच्छति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vásūni ǀ pibdanā́ ǀ páruṣā ǀ yayi-vā́n ǀ áti ǀáva ǀ śā́deṣu ǀ gacchati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Overpowering at the juncture of time the discomfited concealers (therākṣasas), he descends upon those doomed to destruction.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं मृ॑जन्ति॒ मर्ज्य॒मुप॒ द्रोणे॑ष्वा॒यव॑: । प्र॒च॒क्रा॒णं म॒हीरिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ úpa ǀ dróṇeṣu ǀ āyávaḥ ǀpra-cakrāṇám ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests express into the vessels this juice which is to be purified, the bestower of abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तमु॒ त्यं दश॒ क्षिपो॑ मृ॒जन्ति॑ स॒प्त धी॒तय॑: । स्वा॒यु॒धं म॒दिन्त॑मम्
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ mṛjánti ǀ saptá ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀsu-āyudhám ǀ madín-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers, the seven priests, express this (juice), well-weaponed, and yielding great exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ सो॒तार॑ ओ॒ण्यो॒३॒॑ रसं॒ मदा॑य॒ घृष्व॑ये । सर्गो॒ न त॒क्त्येत॑शः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ sotā́raḥ ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvaye ǀsárgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ takti ǀ étaśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who express you, the juice of heaven and earth do it for the foe-destroying exhilaration (ofIndra); your flow rushes as a swift horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य र॒थ्य॑म॒पो वसा॑न॒मन्ध॑सा । गो॒षामण्वे॑षु सश्चिम
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ dákṣasya ǀ rathyám ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānam ǀ ándhasā ǀgo-sā́m ǀ áṇveṣu ǀ saścima ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In pious rite by our fingers we mix with the milk (theSoma), the bringer of strength, the sender of kine, who envelopes the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अन॑प्तम॒प्सु दु॒ष्टरं॒ सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ सृ॑ज । पु॒नी॒हीन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ánaptam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dustáram ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛja ǀpunīhí ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cast into the filter the unassailable invincible (Soma), abiding in the waters (of the firmament) purify it for the drinking ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पु॑ना॒नस्य॒ चेत॑सा॒ सोम॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति । क्रत्वा॑ स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ punānásya ǀ cétasā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀkrátvā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaof him who is purified by worship flows upon the filter and settles in the plural ce common with the ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र त्वा॒ नमो॑भि॒रिन्द॑व॒ इन्द्र॒ सोमा॑ असृक्षत । म॒हे भरा॑य का॒रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tvā ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ índra ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀmahé ǀ bhárāya ǀ kāríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices flow to you,Indra, with praises, giving you vigour for the great conflict.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नो रू॒पे अ॒व्यये॒ विश्वा॒ अर्ष॑न्न॒भि श्रिय॑: । शूरो॒ न गोषु॑ तिष्ठति
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ rūpé ǀ avyáye ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ árṣan ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ góṣu ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified in his woollen robe, and attaining all honours he stands as a hero amidst the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न सानु॑ पि॒प्युषी॒ धारा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ वे॒धस॑: । वृथा॑ प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sā́nu ǀ pipyúṣī ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀvṛ́thā ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the lofty rain from heaven, the nutritious strream of the invogoratingSomafalls easily upon the straining cloth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म विप॒श्चितं॒ तना॑ पुना॒न आ॒युषु॑ । अव्यो॒ वारं॒ वि धा॑वसि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ tánā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ āyúṣu ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, (process) the worshipper among men, and purified by the cloth you wander through the woollen filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नि॒म्नेने॑व॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ घ्नन्तो॑ वृ॒त्राणि॒ भूर्ण॑यः । सोमा॑ असृग्रमा॒शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nimnéna-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ghnántaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like rivers falling down a steep plural ce, so that rapid foe-destroying pervadingSoma-streams hurry (to the pitcher).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि सु॑वा॒नास॒ इन्द॑वो वृ॒ष्टय॑: पृथि॒वीमि॑व । इन्द्रं॒ सोमा॑सो अक्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m-iva ǀíndram ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma-drops, as they are expressed, flow toIndralike the rains falling upon the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यू॑र्मिर्मत्स॒रो मद॒: सोम॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति । वि॒घ्नन्रक्षां॑सि देव॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: áti-ūrmiḥ ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, with swelling waves, exhilarating, inebriating, flows to the straining-cloth, destroying therākṣasas, and devoted to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ क॒लशे॑षु धावति प॒वित्रे॒ परि॑ षिच्यते । उ॒क्थैर्य॒ज्ञेषु॑ वर्धते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ dhāvati ǀ pavítre ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀuktháiḥ ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ vardhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It flows to the pitchers, it is poured out upon the straining-cloth, it is magnified at sacrifices by praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॒ त्री सो॑म रोच॒ना रोह॒न्न भ्रा॑जसे॒ दिव॑म् । इ॒ष्णन्त्सूर्यं॒ न चो॑दयः
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ trī́ ǀ soma ǀ rocanā́ ǀ róhan ǀ ná ǀ bhrājase ǀ dívam ǀiṣṇán ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ná ǀ codayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, mounting beyond thethree worlds, you illumine heaven, and moving, you urge on the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि विप्रा॑ अनूषत मू॒र्धन्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ का॒रव॑: । दधा॑ना॒श्चक्ष॑सि प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ víprāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ mūrdhán ǀ yajñásya ǀ kārávaḥ ǀdádhānāḥ ǀ cákṣasi ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage performers (of pious rites) glorify (theSoma) at the head of the sacrifice, entertaining affection for him the all-beholding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा वा॒जिनं॒ नरो॑ धी॒भिर्विप्रा॑ अव॒स्यव॑: । मृ॒जन्ति॑ दे॒वता॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ vājínam ǀ náraḥ ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀmṛjánti ǀ devá-tātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sages, leaders of rites, desirous of sustenance, purify you who are the giver of food, with pious rites for the offering.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधो॒र्धारा॒मनु॑ क्षर ती॒व्रः स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दः । चारु॑ॠ॒ताय॑ पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rām ǀ ánu ǀ kṣara ǀ tīvráḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǀcā́ruḥ ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour forth the stream of the sweet beverage; sit down, sharp-flavoured in the receptacle, alert for drinking at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ सुवा॒नो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः प॒वित्रे॒ सोमो॑ अक्षाः । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ sómaḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused while pressed between the stones, theSomaflows upon the straining cloth; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं विप्र॒स्त्वं क॒विर्मधु॒ प्र जा॒तमन्ध॑सः । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ vípraḥ ǀ tvám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ prá ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are wise, you are a seer; you bestow the sweet (beverage) produced from theSoma; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ विश्वे॑ स॒जोष॑सो दे॒वास॑: पी॒तिमा॑शत । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ víśve ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ pītím ǀ āśata ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the gods together plural ased enjoy your drinking; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒ वसू॑नि॒ हस्त॑योर्द॒धे । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ vásūni ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ dadhé ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are he) who plural ces in thehands(of the worshipper) all desirable riches, you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इ॒मे रोद॑सी म॒ही सं मा॒तरे॑व॒ दोह॑ते । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ imé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ sám ǀ mātárā-iva ǀ dóhate ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are he) who milks this great heaven and earth like two mothers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यो रोद॑सी उ॒भे स॒द्यो वाजे॑भि॒रर्ष॑ति । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yáḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ vā́jebhiḥ ǀ árṣati ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are he) who at once supplies both heaven and earth with viands; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स शु॒ष्मी क॒लशे॒ष्वा पु॑ना॒नो अ॑चिक्रदत् । मदे॑षु सर्व॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ acikradat ǀmádeṣu ǀ sarva-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This vigorousSoma, while being purified, murmurs in the pitchers; you are the giver of all things to those who praise you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सो॑म चि॒त्रमु॒क्थ्यं॑ दि॒व्यं पार्थि॑वं॒ वसु॑ । तन्न॑: पुना॒न आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ soma ǀ citrám ǀ ukthyám ǀ divyám ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ vásu ǀtát ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever wonderful glorious wealth there be in heaven or in earth, do you,Soma, being purified, bring it to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं हि स्थः स्व॑र्पती॒ इन्द्र॑श्च सोम॒ गोप॑ती । ई॒शा॒ना पि॑प्यतं॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ hí ǀ stháḥ ǀ sváḥpatī íti svaḥ-patī ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ gópatī íti gó-patī ǀīśānā́ ǀ pipyatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,SomaandIndra, are the lords of all the lords of cattle, do you, the rulers, prosper our rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ पुना॒न आ॒युषु॑ स्त॒नय॒न्नधि॑ ब॒र्हिषि॑ । हरि॒: सन्योनि॒मास॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ āyúṣu ǀ stanáyan ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀháriḥ ǀ sán ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits) being purified among men (lies) murmuring upon the sacred grass, green-tinted he sits down in his proper plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॑वशन्त धी॒तयो॑ वृष॒भस्याधि॒ रेत॑सि । सू॒नोर्व॒त्सस्य॑ मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ávāvaśanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ ádhi ǀ rétasi ǀsūnóḥ ǀ vatsásya ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mothers of themalecalf, which are sucked by him, long to cherish the bull with their strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विद्वृ॑ष॒ण्यन्ती॑भ्यः पुना॒नो गर्भ॑मा॒दध॑त् । याः शु॒क्रं दु॑ह॒ते पय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ vṛṣaṇyántībhyaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ ā-dádhat ǀyā́ḥ ǀ śukrám ǀ duhaté ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifiedSomahas implanted many a germ in those (waters) desirous of conception, which yield bright milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ शिक्षापत॒स्थुषो॑ भि॒यस॒मा धे॑हि॒ शत्रु॑षु । पव॑मान वि॒दा र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ śikṣa ǀ apa-tasthúṣaḥ ǀ bhiyásam ǀ ā́ ǀ dhehi ǀ śátruṣu ǀpávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring near to us those who stand aloof, strike terror into our fores; pure-flowing one, you do transfer to us their riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि शत्रो॑: सोम॒ वृष्ण्यं॒ नि शुष्मं॒ नि वय॑स्तिर । दू॒रे वा॑ स॒तो अन्ति॑ वा
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ śátroḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ ní ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ní ǀ váyaḥ ǀ tira ǀdūré ǀ vā ǀ satáḥ ǀ ánti ǀ vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroy,Soma, the vigour, the energy, the subsistence of our enemy, whether he be far off or nigh.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र क॒विर्दे॒ववी॑त॒येऽव्यो॒ वारे॑भिरर्षति । सा॒ह्वान्विश्वा॑ अ॒भि स्पृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kavíḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ arṣati ǀsahvā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seer passes through the woollen fleece for the beverage of the gods, triumphing over all adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि ष्मा॑ जरि॒तृभ्य॒ आ वाजं॒ गोम॑न्त॒मिन्व॑ति । पव॑मानः सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ ínvati ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily he, the pure-flowing, bestows upon his praisers thousands of victuals with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ चेत॑सा मृ॒शसे॒ पव॑से म॒ती । स न॑: सोम॒ श्रवो॑ विदः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ cétasā ǀ mṛśáse ǀ pávase ǀ matī́ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vidaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By the favour you give to us all kinds of wealth, you flow at our praise; grant us, OSoma, food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्ष बृ॒हद्यशो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो ध्रु॒वं र॒यिम् । इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ rayím ǀíṣam ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us great renown, grant durable riches to those who profuse in their libations, bring food to your praisers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं राजे॑व सुव्र॒तो गिर॑: सो॒मा वि॑वेशिथ । पु॒ना॒नो व॑ह्ने अद्भुत
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ su-vratáḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ soma ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśitha ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vahne ǀ adbhuta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified one, doer of good deeds, you,Soma, enter our praises like a king, O wonderful bearer (of our offerings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वह्नि॑र॒प्सु दु॒ष्टरो॑ मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो॒ गभ॑स्त्योः । सोम॑श्च॒मूषु॑ सीदति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ dustáraḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the bearer (of oblations), abiding in the waters of the firmament, difficult to be surpassed, being cleansed by ourhandsreposes in the vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्री॒ळुर्म॒खो न मं॑ह॒युः प॒वित्रं॑ सोम गच्छसि । दध॑त्स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: krīḷúḥ ǀ makháḥ ǀ ná ǀ maṃhayúḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ gacchasi ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, you proceed to the straining-cloth, sportive and genitive rous, like a gift, giving excellent vigour to him who praises you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते धा॑व॒न्तीन्द॑व॒: सोमा॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ घृष्व॑यः । म॒त्स॒रास॑: स्व॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ dhāvanti ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvayaḥ ǀmatsarā́saḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These flowingSoma-juices, foe-destroying, exhilarating, heaven-conferring, have gone toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वृ॒ण्वन्तो॑ अभि॒युज॒: सुष्व॑ये वरिवो॒विद॑: । स्व॒यं स्तो॒त्रे व॑य॒स्कृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pra-vṛṇvántaḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ súsvaye ǀ varivaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsvayám ǀ stotré ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Showing favour, assailing foes, giving wealth to him who rightly effuses them, and bestowing food spontaneously on their praiser.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृथा॒ क्रीळ॑न्त॒ इन्द॑वः स॒धस्थ॑म॒भ्येक॒मित् । सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा व्य॑क्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́thā ǀ krī́ḷantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ abhí ǀ ékam ǀ ít ǀsíndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ ví ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The effused juices come sporting lightly to the common receptacle, they drop into the wave of the river.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒ पव॑मानास आशत । हि॒ता न सप्त॑यो॒ रथे॑
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ āśata ǀhitā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ ráthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like horses harnessed to a car these pure juices bring (to us) all desirable blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आस्मि॑न्पि॒शङ्ग॑मिन्दवो॒ दधा॑ता वे॒नमा॒दिशे॑ । यो अ॒स्मभ्य॒मरा॑वा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ asmin ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ indavaḥ ǀ dádhāta ǀ venám ǀ ā-díśe ǀyáḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ árāvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “EffusedSoma-juices, at our indication, bestow manifold blessings on this (instrumental tutor of the sacrifice), who (at present) has given us nothing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒भुर्न रथ्यं॒ नवं॒ दधा॑ता॒ केत॑मा॒दिशे॑ । शु॒क्राः प॑वध्व॒मर्ण॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: ṛbhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthyam ǀ návam ǀ dádhāta ǀ kétam ǀ ā-díśe ǀśukrā́ḥ ǀ pavadhvam ǀ árṇasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a great man sets before him a commendable charioteer, so do you grant knowledge to our lord, and flow glistening with water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒त उ॒ त्ये अ॑वीवश॒न्काष्ठां॑ वा॒जिनो॑ अक्रत । स॒तः प्रासा॑विषुर्म॒तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ avīvaśan ǀ kā́ṣṭhām ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ akrata ǀsatáḥ ǀ prá ǀ asāviṣuḥ ǀ matím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These effused juices have desired (the sacrifice); powerful they have made for themselves an abiding-plural ce; they have animated the intellect of the pious instrumental tutor of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॑स आ॒शवो॒ रथा॑ इव॒ प्र वा॒जिन॑: । सर्गा॑: सृ॒ष्टा अ॑हेषत
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ vājínaḥ ǀsárgāḥ ǀ sṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ aheṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheseSoma-jices, when let out, neigh as they leap swiftly forth like chariots or rapid steeds let loose.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते वाता॑ इवो॒रव॑: प॒र्जन्य॑स्येव वृ॒ष्टय॑: । अ॒ग्नेरि॑व भ्र॒मा वृथा॑
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ urávaḥ ǀ parjányasya-iva ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀagnéḥ-iva ǀ bhramā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like strong winds, like the rains ofParjanya, like the swift-whiring (flames) of fire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते पू॒ता वि॑प॒श्चित॒: सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः । वि॒पा व्या॑नशु॒र्धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀvipā́ ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These pureSoma-juices, sagacious, mixed with curds, easily pervade our cermonies with their intelligence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते मृ॒ष्टा अम॑र्त्याः ससृ॒वांसो॒ न श॑श्रमुः । इय॑क्षन्तः प॒थो रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ mṛṣṭā́ḥ ǀ ámartyāḥ ǀ sasṛ-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śaśramuḥ ǀíyakṣantaḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified, immortal, issuing from the vessels, eager to traverse their (assigned) paths and the universe, they are never wearied.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते पृ॒ष्ठानि॒ रोद॑सोर्विप्र॒यन्तो॒ व्या॑नशुः । उ॒तेदमु॑त्त॒मं रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ pṛṣṭhā́ni ǀ ródasoḥ ǀ vi-prayántaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀutá ǀ idám ǀ ut-tamám ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Spreading in various directions, they pervade the surface of earth and sky, you and this highest heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्तुं॑ तन्वा॒नमु॑त्त॒ममनु॑ प्र॒वत॑ आशत । उ॒तेदमु॑त्त॒माय्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tántum ǀ tanvānám ǀ ut-tamám ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ āśata ǀutá ǀ idám ǀ uttamā́yyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Descending rivers follow this excellent (Soma) as it spreads out the sacrifice; this rits is glorified thereby.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म प॒णिभ्य॒ आ वसु॒ गव्या॑नि धारयः । त॒तं तन्तु॑मचिक्रदः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ paṇí-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vásu ǀ gávyāni ǀ dhārayaḥ ǀtatám ǀ tántum ǀ acikradaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, hold the wealth of kine which you have won from thePaṇis, you have called aloud at the outspread sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑ असृग्रमा॒शवो॒ मधो॒र्मद॑स्य॒ धार॑या । अ॒भि विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swift-flowingSoma-juices have issued in a stream of the sweet exhilarating (beverage), at (the recital of) all the praise (of the sages).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॑ प्र॒त्नास॑ आ॒यव॑: प॒दं नवी॑यो अक्रमुः । रु॒चे ज॑नन्त॒ सूर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ padám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ akramuḥ ǀrucé ǀ jananta ǀ sū́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ancient swift-going (horses), they (the juices) have traversed anew field-- they have a genitive rated a sun to give light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वमान नो भरा॒र्यो अदा॑शुषो॒ गय॑म् । कृ॒धि प्र॒जाव॑ती॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ádāśuṣaḥ ǀ gáyam ǀkṛdhí ǀ prajā́-vatīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us, purifier, the house of our enemy who presents no libations-- bestow upon us progeny-abounding food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि सोमा॑स आ॒यव॒: पव॑न्ते॒ मद्यं॒ मद॑म् । अ॒भि कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀabhí ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swift-flowingSoma-juices diffuse exhilarating wine-- they flow to the honey-shedding receptacle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ अर्षति धर्ण॒सिर्दधा॑न इन्द्रि॒यं रस॑म् । सु॒वीरो॑ अभिशस्ति॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ indriyám ǀ rásam ǀsu-vī́raḥ ǀ abhiśasti-pā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaflows, the sustainer (of the world), bearing a sense-invigorating essence-- heroic-- a protector against calumny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम पवसे दे॒वेभ्य॑: सध॒माद्य॑: । इन्दो॒ वाजं॑ सिषाससि
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pavase ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sadha-mā́dyaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ vā́jam ǀ sisāsasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are worthy of the sacrifice, you flow toIndraand to the gods; you,Indu, vouchsafe to give us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य पी॒त्वा मदा॑ना॒मिन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्राण्य॑प्र॒ति । ज॒घान॑ ज॒घन॑च्च॒ नु
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ pītvā́ ǀ mádānām ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ apratí ǀjaghā́na ǀ jaghánat ǀ ca ǀ nú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having drunk of this chief of exhilarating draughts,Indrairresistible has slain his foes, and may he ever slay them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमा॑सो अधन्विषु॒: पव॑मानास॒ इन्द॑वः । श्री॒णा॒ना अ॒प्सु मृ॑ञ्जत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ adhanviṣuḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀśrīṇānā́ḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mṛñjata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified effusedSoma-juices have flowed forth-- mixing (with curds and milk) they are cleansed in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि गावो॑ अधन्विषु॒रापो॒ न प्र॒वता॑ य॒तीः । पु॒ना॒ना इन्द्र॑माशत
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ adhanviṣuḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yatī́ḥ ǀpunānā́ḥ ǀ índram ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flowing juices rush (to the filter), like waters flowing down a declivity; purified they gratifyIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र प॑वमान धन्वसि॒ सोमेन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे । नृभि॑र्य॒तो वि नी॑यसे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhanvasi ǀ sóma ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purifier,Soma, you proceed toIndrafor his drinking-- thence are you brought by the priests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म नृ॒माद॑न॒: पव॑स्व चर्षणी॒सहे॑ । सस्नि॒र्यो अ॑नु॒माद्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ nṛ-mā́danaḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ carṣaṇi-sáhe ǀsásniḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, who are the exhilarator of men, flow to (Indra), the conqueror of enemies, you who are pure and to be worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दो॒ यदद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः प॒वित्रं॑ परि॒धाव॑सि । अर॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ धाम्ने॑
shlokas.transliteration: índo íti ǀ yát ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ pari-dhā́vasi ǀáram ǀ índrasya ǀ dhā́mne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When,Indu, effused by the stones, you have flowed to the filtering-cloth, you are an ample portion forIndra's belly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व वृत्रहन्तमो॒क्थेभि॑रनु॒माद्य॑: । शुचि॑: पाव॒को अद्भु॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǀśúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utter destroyer of enemies, flow forth, to be propitiated by praises, pure, purifying, wonderful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑: पाव॒क उ॑च्यते॒ सोम॑: सु॒तस्य॒ मध्व॑: । दे॒वा॒वीर॑घशंस॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ ucyate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, (the yielder) of the exhilarating effusion, is called the pure, the purifier, the gratifier of the gods, the slayer of the wicked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व दक्ष॒साध॑नो दे॒वेभ्य॑: पी॒तये॑ हरे । म॒रुद्भ्यो॑ वा॒यवे॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ hare ǀmarút-bhyaḥ ǀ vāyáve ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Green-tinted (Soma), do you who are the bestower of strength, the exhilarating, flow as a beverage for the gods, for theMarutsand forVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान धि॒या हि॒तो॒३॒॑ऽभि योनिं॒ कनि॑क्रदत् । धर्म॑णा वा॒युमा वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ yónim ǀ kánikradat ǀdhármaṇā ǀ vāyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purifying (Soma), plural ced suitably by the sacred rite, (enter) uttering a cry the (appointed) plural ce, enter by the sacred function intoVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं दे॒वैः शो॑भते॒ वृषा॑ क॒विर्योना॒वधि॑ प्रि॒यः । वृ॒त्र॒हा दे॑व॒वीत॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ deváiḥ ǀ śobhate ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kavíḥ ǀ yónau ǀ ádhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, the showerer (of benefits), the seer, the beloved, the destroyer of foes,t he most devout, shines in its appointed plural ce along with the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑ रू॒पाण्या॑वि॒शन्पु॑ना॒नो या॑ति हर्य॒तः । यत्रा॒मृता॑स॒ आस॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ ā-viśán ǀ punānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ haryatáḥ ǀyátra ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pervading all forms, the pure, the desirable goes to the plural ce where the immortals abide.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒रु॒षो ज॒नय॒न्गिर॒: सोम॑: पवत आयु॒षक् । इन्द्रं॒ गच्छ॑न्क॒विक्र॑तुः
shlokas.transliteration: aruṣáḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ āyuṣák ǀíndram ǀ gácchan ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Endowed with wisdom of the past, the brilliantSoma, genitive rating sounds, flows forth continually proceeding toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व मदिन्तम प॒वित्रं॒ धार॑या कवे । अ॒र्कस्य॒ योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kave ǀarkásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most exhilarating and sage (Soma), flow through the filter in a stream, to attain the station of the adorableIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑मृक्षन्त वा॒जिन॑मु॒पस्थे॒ अदि॑ते॒रधि॑ । विप्रा॑सो॒ अण्व्या॑ धि॒या
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ amṛkṣanta ǀ vājínam ǀ upá-sthe ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ádhi ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ áṇvyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests have cleansed thatSoma(swift as) horse, on the lap ofAditiwith fingers and with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं गावो॑ अ॒भ्य॑नूषत स॒हस्र॑धार॒मक्षि॑तम् । इन्दुं॑ ध॒र्तार॒मा दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ sahásra-dhāram ǀ ákṣitam ǀíndum ǀ dhartā́ram ǀ ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chants celebrate thatInduflowing in a thousand streams, inexhaustible, the supporter of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वे॒धां मे॒धया॑ह्य॒न्पव॑मान॒मधि॒ द्यवि॑ । ध॒र्ण॒सिं भूरि॑धायसम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vedhā́m ǀ medháyā ǀ ahyan ǀ pávamānam ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀdharṇasím ǀ bhū́ri-dhāyasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have elevated to heaven by their praise that creative purifying (Soma), the sustainer, the maker of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ह्यन्भु॒रिजो॑र्धि॒या सं॒वसा॑नं वि॒वस्व॑तः । पतिं॑ वा॒चो अदा॑भ्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ahyan ǀ bhuríjoḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sam-vásānam ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀpátim ǀ vācáḥ ǀ ádābhyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshippers have elevated by the fingers of their arms that unconquerable lord of praise abiding (in the vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं साना॒वधि॑ जा॒मयो॒ हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । ह॒र्य॒तं भूरि॑चक्षसम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sā́nau ǀ ádhi ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀharyatám ǀ bhū́ri-cakṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sister-fingers in a raised plural ce press out by the grinding stones that green-tinted (Soma), desirable and far-beholding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ हिन्वन्ति वे॒धस॒: पव॑मान गिरा॒वृध॑म् । इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ hinvanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ girā-vṛ́dham ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The worshippers offer you toIndra, purifier,Indu, filled with praise and bestowing exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष क॒विर॒भिष्टु॑तः प॒वित्रे॒ अधि॑ तोशते । पु॒ना॒नो घ्नन्नप॒ स्रिध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ ádhi ǀ tośate ǀpunānáḥ ǀ ghnán ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This seer, the purifying (Soma), lauded by us, passes through the filter, driving away foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॑ स्व॒र्जित्परि॑ षिच्यते । प॒वित्रे॑ दक्ष॒साध॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ svaḥ-jít ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀpavítre ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This invigorating heaven-conqueringSomais poured upon the filter forIndraandVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष नृभि॒र्वि नी॑यते दि॒वो मू॒र्धा वृषा॑ सु॒तः । सोमो॒ वने॑षु विश्व॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyate ǀ diváḥ ǀ mūrdhā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ viśva-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, the showerer (of benefits), the summit of heaven, the all-knowing, being expressed is brought by the priests into the wooden vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष ग॒व्युर॑चिक्रद॒त्पव॑मानो हिरण्य॒युः । इन्दु॑: सत्रा॒जिदस्तृ॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ acikradat ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ hiraṇya-yúḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ satrā-jít ǀ ástṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisInduresounds as it drops, yearning to give us cattle and gold, the conqueror of foes, the irresistible. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष सूर्ये॑ण हासते॒ पव॑मानो॒ अधि॒ द्यवि॑ । प॒वित्रे॑ मत्स॒रो मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ hāsate ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀpavítre ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This pure-flowing exhilaratingSomais abandoned by the sun in the filter, the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष शु॒ष्म्य॑सिष्यदद॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ वृषा॒ हरि॑: । पु॒ना॒न इन्दु॒रिन्द्र॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ asisyadat ǀ antárikṣe ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This powerful and purifying showerer (of benefits), the green-tintedIndu, flows through the firmament toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वा॒जी हि॒तो नृभि॑र्विश्व॒विन्मन॑स॒स्पति॑: । अव्यो॒ वारं॒ वि धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ viśva-vít ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This swift-flowing (Soma) plural ced (in the vessels) by the priests, all-knowing, the lord of praise, has to the woollen (filter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प॒वित्रे॑ अक्षर॒त्सोमो॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑: सु॒तः । विश्वा॒ धामा॑न्यावि॒शन्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣarat ǀ sómaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma), effused for the gods, flows into the filter, penetrating all the (divine) forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष दे॒वः शु॑भाय॒तेऽधि॒ योना॒वम॑र्त्यः । वृ॒त्र॒हा दे॑व॒वीत॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ śubhāyate ǀ ádhi ǀ yónau ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀvṛtra-hā́ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This divine immortal (Soma) is brilliant in his own plural ce, the slayer of enemies, the most devoted to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वृषा॒ कनि॑क्रदद्द॒शभि॑र्जा॒मिभि॑र्य॒तः । अ॒भि द्रोणा॑नि धावति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikradat ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This showerer (of desire), expressed by the ten fingers, has uttered a sound ot the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष सूर्य॑मरोचय॒त्पव॑मानो॒ विच॑र्षणिः । विश्वा॒ धामा॑नि विश्व॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ arocayat ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dhā́māni ǀ viśva-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This purified, all-contemplating, all-knowing (Soma) gives radiance to the sun and all the spheres (of light).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष शु॒ष्म्यदा॑भ्य॒: सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॑र्षति । दे॒वा॒वीर॑घशंस॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This powerful invincible purifyingSomaproceeds the protector of the gods, the destroyer of the wicked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रास्य॒ धारा॑ अक्षर॒न्वृष्ण॑: सु॒तस्यौज॑सा । दे॒वाँ अनु॑ प्र॒भूष॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ asya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ akṣaran ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ sutásya ǀ ójasā ǀdevā́n ǀ ánu ǀ pra-bhū́ṣataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The streams of this effused (Soma), the showerer (of benefits), flow forth, as it seeks to surpass the gods in strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सप्तिं॑ मृजन्ति वे॒धसो॑ गृ॒णन्त॑: का॒रवो॑ गि॒रा । ज्योति॑र्जज्ञा॒नमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáptim ǀ mṛjanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀjyótiḥ ǀ jajñānám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious performers (of holy rites), the utterers of praise, purify by their laudation the radiant courser (theSoma) as soon as genitive rated and meriting to be hymned.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒षहा॑ सोम॒ तानि॑ ते पुना॒नाय॑ प्रभूवसो । वर्धा॑ समु॒द्रमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: su-sáhā ǀ soma ǀ tā́ni ǀ te ǀ punānā́ya ǀ prabhuvaso íti prabhu-vaso ǀvárdha ǀ samudrám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, distributor of abundant wealth, those radiances of yours when you are purified are over-powering; fill therefore the praiseworthy ocean-like (pitcher).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॒ वसू॑नि सं॒जय॒न्पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या । इ॒नु द्वेषां॑सि स॒ध्र्य॑क्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ sam-jáyan ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀinú ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ sadhryák ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, in a full stream, conquering for us all treasures-- drive our enemies away together.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रक्षा॒ सु नो॒ अर॑रुषः स्व॒नात्स॑मस्य॒ कस्य॑ चित् । नि॒दो यत्र॑ मुमु॒च्महे॑
shlokas.transliteration: rákṣa ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ svanā́t ǀ samasya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀnidáḥ ǀ yátra ǀ mumucmáhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Preserve us from the reproach of every one who makes offerings, who utters a blame-- that we may be free.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्दो॒ पार्थि॑वं र॒यिं दि॒व्यं प॑वस्व॒ धार॑या । द्यु॒मन्तं॒ शुष्म॒मा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indo íti ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rayím ǀ divyám ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, pour to us in a stream terrestrial and celestial riches, bring brilliant vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र धारा॑ अस्य शु॒ष्मिणो॒ वृथा॑ प॒वित्रे॑ अक्षरन् । पु॒ना॒नो वाच॑मिष्यति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣaran ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The streams of this strongSomaflow without effort into the filter; purified, he excites praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑र्हिया॒नः सो॒तृभि॑र्मृ॒ज्यमा॑न॒: कनि॑क्रदत् । इय॑र्ति व॒ग्नुमि॑न्द्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǀíyarti ǀ vagnúm ǀ indriyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisIndu, urged by the priests, and purified with a sound in the filter, utters loud voice (in the oblation). ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒: शुष्मं॑ नृ॒षाह्यं॑ वी॒रव॑न्तं पुरु॒स्पृह॑म् । पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śúṣmam ǀ nṛ-sáhyam ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀpávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour upon us in a stream,Soma, foe-subduing strength, associated withmaleoffspring and desired by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमो॒ अति॒ धार॑या॒ पव॑मानो असिष्यदत् । अ॒भि द्रोणा॑न्या॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀabhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This purifiedSomaflows out in a stream to take its plural ce in the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्सु त्वा॒ मधु॑मत्तमं॒ हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ tvā ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, they press you forth by the stories, most sweet-flavoured and green-tinted, into the waters forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒नोता॒ मधु॑मत्तमं॒ सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ । चारुं॒ शर्धा॑य मत्स॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: sunóta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀcā́rum ǀ śárdhāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Priests) express the most sweet-flavoured beautiful exhilaratingSomaforIndrathe thunderer, and for our invigoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमा॑सः स्वा॒ध्य१॒॑: पव॑मानासो अक्रमुः । र॒यिं कृ॑ण्वन्ति॒ चेत॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ akramuḥ ǀrayím ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ cétanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The benevolent juices being purified flow forth, they confer intellectual wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॒ भवे॑न्दो द्युम्न॒वर्ध॑नः । भवा॒ वाजा॑नां॒ पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ bháva ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumna-várdhanaḥ ǀbháva ǀ vā́jānām ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, be (to us) the augmenter of the riches of heaven and earth, be the lord of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ वाता॑ अभि॒प्रिय॒स्तुभ्य॑मर्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः । सोम॒ वर्ध॑न्ति ते॒ मह॑:
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ abhi-príyaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀsóma ǀ várdhanti ǀ te ǀ máhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Soma, the winds are gracious, for you the rivers flow, they magnify your greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व॒ समे॑तु ते वि॒श्वत॑: सोम॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । भवा॒ वाज॑स्य संग॒थे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pyāyasva ǀ sám ǀ etu ǀ te ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ soma ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀbháva ǀ vā́jasya ǀ sam-gathé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be well nourished,Soma; may vigour come to you from all sides, be (the giver) of strength in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ गावो॑ घृ॒तं पयो॒ बभ्रो॑ दुदु॒ह्रे अक्षि॑तम् । वर्षि॑ष्ठे॒ अधि॒ सान॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: túbhyam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ bábhro íti ǀ duduhré ǀ ákṣitam ǀvárṣiṣṭhe ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tawny-tinted (Soma), the cows yield butter and milk inexhaustible for you (set) on the highest summit.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒यु॒धस्य॑ ते स॒तो भुव॑नस्य पते व॒यम् । इन्दो॑ सखि॒त्वमु॑श्मसि
shlokas.transliteration: su-āyudhásya ǀ te ǀ satáḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ pate ǀ vayám ǀíndo íti ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ uśmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, lord of beings, we desire the friendship of you, the well-armed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमा॑सो मद॒च्युत॒: श्रव॑से नो म॒घोन॑: । सु॒ता वि॒दथे॑ अक्रमुः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ mada-cyútaḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ akramuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices, diffusing exhilaration, rush forth effused at the sacrifice for the sustenance of us abounding in oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदीं॑ त्रि॒तस्य॒ योष॑णो॒ हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ tritásya ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And the fingers ofTritaexpress this green-tintedSomawith the stones forIndra's drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदीं॑ हं॒सो यथा॑ ग॒णं विश्व॑स्यावीवशन्म॒तिम् । अत्यो॒ न गोभि॑रज्यते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ haṃsáḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ gaṇám ǀ víśvasya ǀ avīvaśat ǀ matím ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ajyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And like a swan entering its own flock, theSomaexcites the praise of all, like a horse, it is bathed with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे सो॑माव॒चाक॑शन्मृ॒गो न त॒क्तो अ॑र्षसि । सीद॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ soma ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ taktáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding both worlds,Soma, you hurry, swift as a deer, taking your seat on the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि गावो॑ अनूषत॒ योषा॑ जा॒रमि॑व प्रि॒यम् । अग॑न्ना॒जिं यथा॑ हि॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ yóṣā ǀ jārám-iva ǀ priyám ǀágan ǀ ājím ǀ yáthā ǀ hitám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Praises commend you (Soma) as a woman praises a dear lover; (you hasten to the vessel) as a hero hastens to the welcome contest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे धे॑हि द्यु॒मद्यशो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यश्च॒ मह्यं॑ च । स॒निं मे॒धामु॒त श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ dyu-mát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ maghávat-bhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ máhyam ǀ ca ǀsaním ǀ medhā́m ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give to us who are affluent (in oblations), and also to me, brilliant fame, wealth, intelligence, and glory.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमा॑सो विप॒श्चितो॒ऽपां न य॑न्त्यू॒र्मय॑: । वना॑नि महि॒षा इ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ná ǀ yanti ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀvánāni ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The intelligentSomajuices rush along like waves of water, like buffaloes to the forests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्रोणा॑नि ब॒भ्रव॑: शु॒क्रा ऋ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या । वाजं॒ गोम॑न्तमक्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tawny-coloured bright juices hasten to the pitchers with a stream of ambrosia, they pour forth sustenance accompanied with cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ता इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । सोमा॑ अर्षन्ति॒ विष्ण॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The libations effused proceed toIndra, toVāyu, toVaruṇa, to theMaruts, toViṣṇu”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो वाच॒ उदी॑रते॒ गावो॑ मिमन्ति धे॒नव॑: । हरि॑रेति॒ कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ út ǀ īrate ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mimanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ eti ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests utter the three sacred texts, the kine low (on being milked),, the green-tintedSomagoes sounding (to the vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि ब्रह्मी॑रनूषत य॒ह्वीॠ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तर॑: । म॒र्मृ॒ज्यन्ते॑ दि॒वः शिशु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ bráhmīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātáraḥ ǀmarmṛjyánte ǀ diváḥ ǀ śíśum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many sacred hymns, the mothers of the sacrifice, give praise, they purify (theSoma), the infant of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यः स॑मु॒द्राँश्च॒तुरो॒ऽस्मभ्यं॑ सोम वि॒श्वत॑: । आ प॑वस्व सह॒स्रिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ samudrā́n ǀ catúraḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “From every side,Soma, pour upon us four oceans of riches, grant us thousands (of desires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑वा॒नो धार॑या॒ तनेन्दु॑र्हिन्वा॒नो अ॑र्षति । रु॒जद्दृ॒ळ्हा व्योज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ tánā ǀ índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀruját ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ ví ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, when effused and expressed (by the priests) flows in a stream to the filter, breaking down strong plural ces by its strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । सोमो॑ अर्षति॒ विष्ण॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaeffused proceeds toIndra, toVāyu, toVaruṇa, toMaruts, toViṣṇu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑णं॒ वृष॑भिर्य॒तं सु॒न्वन्ति॒ सोम॒मद्रि॑भिः । दु॒हन्ति॒ शक्म॑ना॒ पय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣāṇam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yatám ǀ sunvánti ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀduhánti ǀ śákmanā ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They press the crushedSomaas it pours forth its juice between the effusing stones, they milk out its juice by their acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुव॑त्त्रि॒तस्य॒ मर्ज्यो॒ भुव॒दिन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रः । सं रू॒पैर॑ज्यते॒ हरि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvat ǀ tritásya ǀ márjyaḥ ǀ bhúvat ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀsám ǀ rūpáiḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ háriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilaratingSomais to be cleansed (for the sacrifice) ofTrita, and for the drinking ofIndra; the green-tinted (juice) is mixed with the ingredients.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भीमृ॒तस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपं॑ दुह॒ते पृश्नि॑मातरः । चारु॑ प्रि॒यत॑मं ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀ duhaté ǀ pṛ́śni-mātaraḥ ǀcā́ru ǀ priyá-tamam ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The son fofPṛśnimilk thisSomaat the plural ce of sacrifice, the most beautiful and grateful oblation (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: समे॑न॒मह्रु॑ता इ॒मा गिरो॑ अर्षन्ति स॒स्रुत॑: । धे॒नूर्वा॒श्रो अ॑वीवशत्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ enam ǀ áhrutāḥ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ sa-srútaḥ ǀdhenū́ḥ ǀ vāśráḥ ǀ avīvaśan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our sincere smooth-flowing praises approach him, and he, uttering a sound, welcomes the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: पवस्व॒ धार॑या॒ पव॑मान र॒यिं पृ॒थुम् । यया॒ ज्योति॑र्वि॒दासि॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pávamāna ǀ rayím ǀ pṛthúm ǀyáyā ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ vidā́si ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour upon us, purifier, ample riches with that stream wherewith you bestow upon us light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दो॑ समुद्रमीङ्खय॒ पव॑स्व विश्वमेजय । रा॒यो ध॒र्ता न॒ ओज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: índo íti ǀ samudram-īṅkhaya ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvam-ejaya ǀrāyáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, impeller of the waters, confounder of all (our foes), flow forth by your power as the supporter of wealth to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ वी॒रेण॑ वीरवो॒ऽभि ष्या॑म पृतन्य॒तः । क्षरा॑ णो अ॒भि वार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vīréṇa ǀ vīra-vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǀkṣára ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With you, heroic (Soma), as our hero, may we overcome our enemies, pour upon the desirable (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वाज॒मिन्दु॑रिष्यति॒ सिषा॑सन्वाज॒सा ऋषि॑: । व्र॒ता वि॑दा॒न आयु॑धा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́jam ǀ índuḥ ǀ iṣyati ǀ sísāsan ǀ vāja-sā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀvratā́ ǀ vidānáḥ ǀ ā́yudhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, the bestower of food, the seer sends food to the worshipper, showing his favour, acquainted with sacred rites and arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं गी॒र्भिर्वा॑चमीङ्ख॒यं पु॑ना॒नं वा॑सयामसि । सोम॒ जन॑स्य॒ गोप॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vācam-īṅkhayám ǀ punānám ǀ vāsayāmasi ǀsómam ǀ jánasya ǀ gó-patim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We clothe with praise thatSomawho is the inspirer of praise, the purified, the shepherd of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वो॒ यस्य॑ व्र॒ते जनो॑ दा॒धार॒ धर्म॑ण॒स्पते॑: । पु॒ना॒नस्य॑ प्र॒भूव॑सोः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ vraté ǀ jánaḥ ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ páteḥ ǀpunānásya ǀ prabhú-vasoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “On the worship of whom all men fix their thoughts-- the lord of pious acts, the purified, the possessor of abundant wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑र्जि॒ रथ्यो॑ यथा प॒वित्रे॑ च॒म्वो॑: सु॒तः । कार्ष्म॑न्वा॒जी न्य॑क्रमीत्
shlokas.transliteration: ásarji ǀ ráthyaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ pavítre ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀkā́rṣman ǀ vājī́ ǀ ní ǀ akramīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pressed between the boards, (theSoma) has been let loose, like a chariot-horse, upon the straining-cloth-- the courser steps out on the field.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वह्नि॑: सोम॒ जागृ॑वि॒: पव॑स्व देव॒वीरति॑ । अ॒भि कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ deva-vī́ḥ ǀ áti ǀabhí ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, bearer (of oblation), vigilant, devoted to the gods, flow past the honey-dropping filter (into the vessel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ ज्योतीं॑षि पूर्व्य॒ पव॑मान॒ वि रो॑चय । क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य नो हिनु
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ pūrvya ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví ǀ rocaya ǀkrátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ naḥ ǀ hinu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ancient purifier, illume for us the luminaries (of heaven), animate us for strength-bestowing sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒म्भमा॑न ऋता॒युभि॑र्मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो॒ गभ॑स्त्योः । पव॑ते॒ वारे॑ अ॒व्यये॑
shlokas.transliteration: śumbhámānaḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀpávate ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beautified by the ministers of the rite, expressed by theirhands, (theSoma) flows through the woollen filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स विश्वा॑ दा॒शुषे॒ वसु॒ सोमो॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ पार्थि॑वा । पव॑ता॒मान्तरि॑क्ष्या
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ sómaḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀpávatām ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatSomabestow upon the donor (of the libation) all treasures, whether of heaven or earth or the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठम॑श्व॒युर्ग॑व्य॒युः सो॑म रोहसि । वी॒र॒युः श॑वसस्पते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ aśva-yúḥ ǀ gavya-yúḥ ǀ soma ǀ rohasi ǀvīra-yúḥ ǀ śavasaḥ ǀ pate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, lord of food, you ascend to the summit of the sky, desirous of horses, kine, andmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॒तः पी॒तये॒ वृषा॒ सोम॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति । वि॒घ्नन्रक्षां॑सि देव॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the showerer (of benefits), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes to the filter, destroying therākṣas, devoted to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॒वित्रे॑ विचक्ष॒णो हरि॑रर्षति धर्ण॒सिः । अ॒भि योनिं॒ कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀabhí ǀ yónim ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-beholdingSoma, green-tinted, all-sustaining rush to the filter (and thence) crying aloud to the pitcher.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॒जी रो॑च॒ना दि॒वः पव॑मानो॒ वि धा॑वति । र॒क्षो॒हा वार॑म॒व्यय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀrakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Fleet as) a horse, the pureSoma, the illume of heaven, hastens, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, past the woollen fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्रि॒तस्याधि॒ सान॑वि॒ पव॑मानो अरोचयत् । जा॒मिभि॒: सूर्यं॑ स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tritásya ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ arocayat ǀjāmí-bhiḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pureSomaupon the high plural ce (of the sacrifice) ofTrita, attended by its kindred rays, has lighted up the Sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वृ॑त्र॒हा वृषा॑ सु॒तो व॑रिवो॒विददा॑भ्यः । सोमो॒ वाज॑मिवासरत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ varivaḥ-vít ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ vā́jam-iva ǀ asarat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The slayer ofVṛtra, the showerer of benefits, the giver of wealth, the invincible, the effusedSomaproceeds (to the pitcher) as (a horse) to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स दे॒वः क॒विने॑षि॒तो॒३॒॑ऽभि द्रोणा॑नि धावति । इन्दु॒रिन्द्रा॑य मं॒हना॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ kavínā ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ dhāvati ǀínduḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ maṃhánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divineSoma, when effused by the priest, hastens in his might to the pitchers forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष उ॒ स्य वृषा॒ रथोऽव्यो॒ वारे॑भिरर्षति । गच्छ॒न्वाजं॑ सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ arṣati ǀgácchan ǀ vā́jam ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma, the showerer of benefits, the chariot, dashes through the woollen fleece, bearing (to the worshipper) thousandfold food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं त्रि॒तस्य॒ योष॑णो॒ हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ tritásya ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fingers ofTritaeffuse by the stones this green-tinted juice forIndra's drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं त्यं ह॒रितो॒ दश॑ मर्मृ॒ज्यन्ते॑ अप॒स्युव॑: । याभि॒र्मदा॑य॒ शुम्भ॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ tyám ǀ harítaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ marmṛjyánte ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀyā́bhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ śúmbhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers, eager in the work, express that (Soma), and by them it is purified for the exhilaration (ofIndra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य मानु॑षी॒ष्वा श्ये॒नो न वि॒क्षु सी॑दति । गच्छ॑ञ्जा॒रो न यो॒षित॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vikṣú ǀ sīdati ǀgácchan ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yoṣítam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatSomasits down among human beings like a falcon, hastening as a gallant to his mistress.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य मद्यो॒ रसोऽव॑ चष्टे दि॒वः शिशु॑: । य इन्दु॒र्वार॒मावि॑शत्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ mádyaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ áva ǀ caṣṭe ǀ diváḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ā́ ǀ áviśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That exhilarating juice beholds all,Indu, the child of heaven, that percolates through the fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य पी॒तये॑ सु॒तो हरि॑रर्षति धर्ण॒सिः । क्रन्द॒न्योनि॑म॒भि प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ pītáye ǀ sutáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ dharṇasíḥ ǀkrándan ǀ yónim ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That green-tinted, all-sustaining (Soma), when effused for the drinking (of the gods), rushes crying aloud to its beloved plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒शुर॑र्ष बृहन्मते॒ परि॑ प्रि॒येण॒ धाम्ना॑ । यत्र॑ दे॒वा इति॒ ब्रव॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: āśúḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ bṛhat-mate ǀ pári ǀ priyéṇa ǀ dhā́mnā ǀyátra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ íti ǀ brávan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great-mindedSoma, go swift with your body that is most dear (to the gods), saying, 'Where are the gods?'”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रि॒ष्कृ॒ण्वन्ननि॑ष्कृतं॒ जना॑य या॒तय॒न्निष॑: । वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वः परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: pari-kṛṇván ǀ ániḥ-kṛtam ǀ jánāya ǀ yātáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sanctifying the unconsecrated (worshipper) bringing food for the offerer, pour down rain from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त ए॑ति प॒वित्र॒ आ त्विषिं॒ दधा॑न॒ ओज॑सा । वि॒चक्षा॑णो विरो॒चय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ tvíṣim ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀvi-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ vi-rocáyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheSoma) when effused enters the filter with force, giving forth light, beholding and illuminating (all things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स यो दि॒वस्परि॑ रघु॒यामा॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ । सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा व्यक्ष॑रत्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ raghu-yā́mā ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsíndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ ví ǀ ákṣarat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma), who light of movement (mounts) toheaven, through the filter in a stream of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒विवा॑सन्परा॒वतो॒ अथो॑ अर्वा॒वत॑: सु॒तः । इन्द्रा॑य सिच्यते॒ मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā-vívāsan ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ átho íti ǀ arvā-vátaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ sicyate ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The effused (Soma) honouring (the gods) whether he is far off or nigh, is poured out (as)madhuforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मी॒ची॒ना अ॑नूषत॒ हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । योना॑वृ॒तस्य॑ सीदत
shlokas.transliteration: sam-īcīnā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀyónau ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The united (worshippers) praise (him), they squeeze (him) forth green-tinted with the stones; sit down (O gods) at the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नो अ॑क्रमीद॒भि विश्वा॒ मृधो॒ विच॑र्षणिः । शु॒म्भन्ति॒ विप्रं॑ धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ akramīt ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀśumbhánti ǀ vípram ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure all-seeing (Soma) has overcome all enemies; (the worshippers) grace the sage (Soma) with their praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ योनि॑मरु॒णो रु॑ह॒द्गम॒दिन्द्रं॒ वृषा॑ सु॒तः । ध्रु॒वे सद॑सि सीदति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yónim ǀ aruṇáḥ ǀ ruhat ǀ gámat ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀdhruvé ǀ sádasi ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tawny-hued showerer (of benefits) when effused ascends to his plural ce; he goes toIndra; he dwells in the fixed abode (of heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ र॒यिं म॒हामि॑न्दो॒ऽस्मभ्यं॑ सोम वि॒श्वत॑: । आ प॑वस्व सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ mahā́m ǀ indo íti ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OIndu, OSoma, quickly pour upon us from all quarters vast and infinite riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॑ सोम पवमान द्यु॒म्नानी॑न्द॒वा भ॑र । वि॒दाः स॑ह॒स्रिणी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ soma ǀ pavamāna ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀvidā́ḥ ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O purifiedSoma, OIndu, bring all sorts of wealth bestow unlimited food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पुना॒न आ भ॑र र॒यिं स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म् । ज॒रि॒तुर्व॑र्धया॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀjaritúḥ ǀ vardhaya ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OSoma, being purified, bring us your worshippers wealth withmaleoffspring, recompense the praises of him who glorifies you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्द॒वा भ॑र॒ सोम॑ द्वि॒बर्ह॑सं र॒यिम् । वृष॑न्निन्दो न उ॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ indo íti ǀ naḥ ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu,Soma, being purified, bring us wealth from both worlds; Indu, showerer (of benefits), (bring us) glorious (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ये गावो॒ न भूर्ण॑यस्त्वे॒षा अ॒यासो॒ अक्र॑मुः । घ्नन्त॑: कृ॒ष्णामप॒ त्वच॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yé ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀ tveṣā́ḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǀ ákramuḥ ǀghnántaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇā́m ǀ ápa ǀ tvácam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Praise theSoma-juices) which descend like streams of water, swift, brilliant, rapid driving off the black skinned (rākṣasa).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वि॒तस्य॑ मनाम॒हेऽति॒ सेतुं॑ दुरा॒व्य॑म् । सा॒ह्वांसो॒ दस्यु॑मव्र॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: suvitásya ǀ manāmahe ǀ áti ǀ sétum ǀ duḥ-āvyám ǀsahvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ dásyum ǀ avratám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We praise the auspiciousSoma's imprisonment (of therākṣasas) and hostile (intent against them), while we triumph over the enemy who performs no riteṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒ण्वे वृ॒ष्टेरि॑व स्व॒नः पव॑मानस्य शु॒ष्मिण॑: । चर॑न्ति वि॒द्युतो॑ दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: śṛṇvé ǀ vṛṣṭéḥ-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀ pávamānasya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǀcáranti ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sound of the purified, powerfulSomais heard like that of rain; (his) lightning moves in the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व म॒हीमिषं॒ गोम॑दिन्दो॒ हिर॑ण्यवत् । अश्वा॑व॒द्वाज॑वत्सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ gó-mat ǀ indo íti ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀáśva-vat ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When effused,Indu, pour forth much food with cows, gold, horses, and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व विचर्षण॒ आ म॒ही रोद॑सी पृण । उ॒षाः सूर्यो॒ न र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ pṛṇa ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow, all-seeing (Soma), fill the vast heaven and earth as the sun (fills) the days with his beams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णः शर्म॒यन्त्या॒ धार॑या सोम वि॒श्वत॑: । सरा॑ र॒सेव॑ वि॒ष्टप॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ śarma-yántyā ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀsára ǀ rasā́-iva ǀ viṣṭápam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow round us,Soma, on all sides in a bliss-bestowing stream, like a river down a steep plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒नय॑न्रोच॒ना दि॒वो ज॒नय॑न्न॒प्सु सूर्य॑म् । वसा॑नो॒ गा अ॒पो हरि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: janáyan ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janáyan ǀ ap-sú ǀ sū́ryam ǀvásānaḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tinted (Soma) genitive rating the luminaries of heaven, genitive rating the sun in the firmament, clothing himself with the descending water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प्र॒त्नेन॒ मन्म॑ना दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॒स्परि॑ । धार॑या पवते सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ mánmanā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀdhā́rayā ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He with ancient praise when effused flows in a stream, a god for the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒वृ॒धा॒नाय॒ तूर्व॑ये॒ पव॑न्ते॒ वाज॑सातये । सोमा॑: स॒हस्र॑पाजसः
shlokas.transliteration: vavṛdhānā́ya ǀ tū́rvaye ǀ pávante ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀsómāḥ ǀ sahásra-pājasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuices of unbounded vigour flow for the increasing, rapid acquisition of food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒हा॒नः प्र॒त्नमित्पय॑: प॒वित्रे॒ परि॑ षिच्यते । क्रन्द॑न्दे॒वाँ अ॑जीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: duhānáḥ ǀ pratnám ǀ ít ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀkrándan ǀ devā́n ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Milking forth the ancient fluid, theSomais poured into the filter and crying out genitive rates the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒भि दे॒वाँ ऋ॑ता॒वृध॑: । सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॑र्षति
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ abhí ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, being purified hastens towards all desirable (wealth), towards the gods who favour the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोम॑न्नः सोम वी॒रव॒दश्वा॑व॒द्वाज॑वत्सु॒तः । पव॑स्व बृह॒तीरिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ vā́ja-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǀpávasva ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, being effused pour down to us (wealth) consisting of kine,maleoffspring, horses, and strength, and abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अत्य॑ इव मृ॒ज्यते॒ गोभि॒र्मदा॑य हर्य॒तः । तं गी॒र्भिर्वा॑सयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ átyaḥ-iva ǀ mṛjyáte ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ haryatáḥ ǀtám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invest with praises thatSomawho, beloved, is cleansed like a horse with milk for the exhilaration (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं नो॒ विश्वा॑ अव॒स्युवो॒ गिर॑: शुम्भन्ति पू॒र्वथा॑ । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avasyúvaḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ śumbhanti ǀ pūrvá-thā ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisInduall our praises desiring protection, beautify (new) as of old forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नो या॑ति हर्य॒तः सोमो॑ गी॒र्भिः परि॑ष्कृतः । विप्र॑स्य॒ मेध्या॑तिथेः
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ yāti ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀvíprasya ǀ médhya-atitheḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pure flows the belovedSoma, beautified by the praises of the sage Medhyātithi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान वि॒दा र॒यिम॒स्मभ्यं॑ सोम सु॒श्रिय॑म् । इन्दो॑ स॒हस्र॑वर्चसम्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ su-śríyam ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-varcasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, grant us auspicious wealth, with infinite splendour, OIndu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॒रत्यो॒ न वा॑ज॒सृत्कनि॑क्रन्ति प॒वित्र॒ आ । यदक्षा॒रति॑ देव॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-sṛ́t ǀ kánikranti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀyát ǀ ákṣāḥ ǀ áti ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rushing into battle, sounds in the rough, beloved of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व॒ वाज॑सातये॒ विप्र॑स्य गृण॒तो वृ॒धे । सोम॒ रास्व॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ víprasya ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǀsóma ǀ rā́sva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow for the acquisition of food, for the prosperity of the sage who praise you; OSoma, grant (me) excellentmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ण॑ इन्दो म॒हे तन॑ ऊ॒र्मिं न बिभ्र॑दर्षसि । अ॒भि दे॒वाँ अ॒यास्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahé ǀ táne ǀ ūrmím ǀ ná ǀ bíbhrat ǀ arṣasi ǀabhí ǀ devā́n ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, you advance to give us abundant wealth;Ayāsyabearing your waves (go) towards the gods (to sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ती जु॒ष्टो धि॒या हि॒तः सोमो॑ हिन्वे परा॒वति॑ । विप्र॑स्य॒ धार॑या क॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: matī́ ǀ juṣṭáḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ hinve ǀ parā-váti ǀvíprasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kavíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sageSomagratified by the praise of the pious (worshipper) prepared for the sacrifice is sent in a stream at a distance (from the filter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं दे॒वेषु॒ जागृ॑विः सु॒त ए॑ति प॒वित्र॒ आ । सोमो॑ याति॒ विच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ devéṣu ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsómaḥ ǀ yāti ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This vigilantSomaeffused for the gods, approaches, all-beholding he goes to the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पवस्व वाज॒युश्च॑क्रा॒णश्चारु॑मध्व॒रम् । ब॒र्हिष्माँ॒ आ वि॑वासति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ cakrāṇáḥ ǀ cā́rum ǀ adhvarám ǀbarhíṣmān ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow for us food-desiring, making (our) sacrifice auspicious; (OSoma, whom) the priest with the sacred grass adores.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ भगा॑य वा॒यवे॒ विप्र॑वीरः स॒दावृ॑धः । सोमो॑ दे॒वेष्वा य॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ vípra-vīraḥ ǀ sadā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySomawho is pressed forth by the seers forBhagaandVāyu, ever prosper in, grant us (wealth plural ced) among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ अ॒द्य वसु॑त्तये क्रतु॒विद्गा॑तु॒वित्त॑मः । वाजं॑ जेषि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ vásuttaye ǀ kratu-vít ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀvā́jam ǀ jeṣi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Receiver of sacrifices, knower of (pious), give us this day abundant food and strength for the acquisition of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व॒ मदा॑य॒ कं नृ॒चक्षा॑ दे॒ववी॑तये । इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, do you the beholder of men flow plural asantly for the banquet of the gods, forIndra's drinking and exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ अर्षा॒भि दू॒त्यं१॒॑ त्वमिन्द्रा॑य तोशसे । दे॒वान्त्सखि॑भ्य॒ आ वर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ abhí ǀ dūtyám ǀ tvám ǀ índrāya ǀ tośase ǀdevā́n ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Approach the office of the messenger for us; you who are drunk forIndra, (pour) on the gods wealth for (us their) friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्वाम॑रु॒णं व॒यं गोभि॑रञ्ज्मो॒ मदा॑य॒ कम् । वि नो॑ रा॒ये दुरो॑ वृधि
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tvā́m ǀ aruṇám ǀ vayám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjmaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀví ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ dúraḥ ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And we adorn you, the purple-tinted with milk and curd for the purpose of exhilaration open the doors for our riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यू॑ प॒वित्र॑मक्रमीद्वा॒जी धुरं॒ न याम॑नि । इन्दु॑र्दे॒वेषु॑ पत्यते
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pavítram ǀ akramīt ǀ vājī́ ǀ dhúram ǀ ná ǀ yā́mani ǀínduḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ patyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indupasses the filter as a horse in going passes the shaft (of the chariot); he proceeds to the midst of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समी॒ सखा॑यो अस्वर॒न्वने॒ क्रीळ॑न्त॒मत्य॑विम् । इन्दुं॑ ना॒वा अ॑नूषत
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ īmíti ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ asvaran ǀ váne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǀíndum ǀ nāvā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His friends praiseIndusporting in the water and passing through the fleece; their hymns glorify him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तया॑ पवस्व॒ धार॑या॒ यया॑ पी॒तो वि॒चक्ष॑से । इन्दो॑ स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: táyā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ pītáḥ ǀ vi-cákṣase ǀíndo íti ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FlowIndu, with that stream wherewith when drunk you bestow much vigour on your discerning worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असृ॑ग्रन्दे॒ववी॑त॒येऽत्या॑स॒: कृत्व्या॑ इव । क्षर॑न्तः पर्वता॒वृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ásṛgran ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ átyāsaḥ ǀ kṛ́tvyāḥ-iva ǀkṣárantaḥ ǀ parvata-vṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Begotten by the stones the flowing (Soma-juices) are effused for the banquet of the gods' active horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ष्कृतास॒ इन्द॑वो॒ योषे॑व॒ पित्र्या॑वती । वा॒युं सोमा॑ असृक्षत
shlokas.transliteration: pári-kṛtāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ yóṣā-iva ǀ pítrya-vatī ǀvāyúm ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma-juices pressed (at the sacrifice), adorned like a bride who has a father, flow toVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॑स॒ इन्द॑व॒: प्रय॑स्वन्तश्च॒मू सु॒ताः । इन्द्रं॑ वर्धन्ति॒ कर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ práyasvantaḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀíndram ǀ vardhanti ǀ kárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These brilliangSoma-juices, bestowing plural asant food, expressed into the vessel, gratifyIndrawith the ceremonies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ धा॑वता सुहस्त्यः शु॒क्रा गृ॑भ्णीत म॒न्थिना॑ । गोभि॑: श्रीणीत मत्स॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dhāvata ǀ su-hastyaḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ manthínā ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ śrīṇīta ǀ matsarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dexterous (priests) have (to me), taken with the ladle the pure (Soma), mix the exhilarating (Soma) with milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व धनंजय प्रय॒न्ता राध॑सो म॒हः । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ सोम गातु॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhanam-jaya ǀ pra-yantā́ ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, conqueror of wealth, who know the way (to fulfil my desires), flow forth the bestower of vast wealth upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं मृ॑जन्ति॒ मर्ज्यं॒ पव॑मानं॒ दश॒ क्षिप॑: । इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रं मद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ pávamānam ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ matsarám ǀ mádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers purify this purifiable pure-flowing exhilarating juice forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या सोम॑: सुकृ॒त्यया॑ म॒हश्चि॑द॒भ्य॑वर्धत । म॒न्दा॒न उद्वृ॑षायते
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀ maháḥ ǀ cit ǀ abhí ǀ avardhata ǀmandānáḥ ǀ út ǀ vṛṣa-yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By this sacred solemnity theSomais magnified before the mighty (gods); exulting he moves like a bull.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒तानीद॑स्य॒ कर्त्वा॒ चेत॑न्ते दस्यु॒तर्ह॑णा । ऋ॒णा च॑ धृ॒ष्णुश्च॑यते
shlokas.transliteration: kṛtā́ni ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ kártvā ǀ cétante ǀ dasyu-tárhaṇā ǀṛṇā́ ǀ ca ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ cayate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They publish his exploits, his acts ofDasyu-crushing; resolute he acquite the debts (of the worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आत्सोम॑ इन्द्रि॒यो रसो॒ वज्र॑: सहस्र॒सा भु॑वत् । उ॒क्थं यद॑स्य॒ जाय॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indriyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ sahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ bhuvat ǀukthám ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ jā́yate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the praise ofIndrais recited, then the juice dear to him, vigorous as a thunderbolt, give us unlimited wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒यं क॒विर्वि॑ध॒र्तरि॒ विप्रा॑य॒ रत्न॑मिच्छति । यदी॑ मर्मृ॒ज्यते॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: svayám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ vi-dhartári ǀ víprāya ǀ rátnam ǀ icchati ǀyádi ǀ marmṛjyáte ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sageSomais cleansed by the fingers, he of his own accord desires wealth for the pious worshipper in (Indra), the granter of wishes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सि॒षा॒सतू॑ रयी॒णां वाजे॒ष्वर्व॑तामिव । भरे॑षु जि॒ग्युषा॑मसि
shlokas.transliteration: sisāsátuḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ árvatām-iva ǀbháreṣu ǀ jigyúṣām ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You desire to give wealth to those who conquer in combat as (men offer fodder) to horses in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ नृ॒म्णानि॒ बिभ्र॑तं स॒धस्थे॑षु म॒हो दि॒वः । चारुं॑ सुकृ॒त्यये॑महे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ nṛmṇā́ni ǀ víbhratam ǀ sadhá-stheṣu ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀcā́rum ǀ su-kṛtyáyā ǀ īmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By sacred rites we solicit (wealth) of you, auspicious, bearing wealth, abiding in the regions of the vast heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: संवृ॑क्तधृष्णुमु॒क्थ्यं॑ म॒हाम॑हिव्रतं॒ मद॑म् । श॒तं पुरो॑ रुरु॒क्षणि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáṃvṛkta-dhṛṣṇum ǀ ukthyám ǀ mahā́-mahivratam ǀ mádam ǀśatám ǀ púraḥ ǀ rurukṣáṇim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The overthrower of the resolute (foe), the praiseworthy, to whom many solemn observances are addressed, the exhilarator, the destroyer of a hundred cities (of theasuras).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑स्त्वा र॒यिम॒भि राजा॑नं सुक्रतो दि॒वः । सु॒प॒र्णो अ॑व्य॒थिर्भ॑रत्
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ rayím ǀ abhí ǀ rā́jānam ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ diváḥ ǀsu-parṇáḥ ǀ avyathíḥ ǀ bharat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O (Soma), doer of good deeds, the unwearied hawk brought you, king over riches, from this heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्मा॒ इत्स्व॑र्दृ॒शे साधा॑रणं रज॒स्तुर॑म् । गो॒पामृ॒तस्य॒ विर्भ॑रत्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasmai ǀ ít ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ sā́dhāraṇam ǀ rajaḥ-túram ǀgopā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ víḥ ǀ bharat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bird brought you, the showerer of water, the protector of the sacrifice, the common property of every god.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ हिन्वा॒न इ॑न्द्रि॒यं ज्यायो॑ महि॒त्वमा॑नशे । अ॒भि॒ष्टि॒कृद्विच॑र्षणिः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ indriyám ǀ jyā́yaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ ānaśe ǀabhiṣṭi-kṛ́t ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The contemplator of all, the granter of desires, putting forth his energy obtains superior greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व वृ॒ष्टिमा सु नो॒ऽपामू॒र्मिं दि॒वस्परि॑ । अ॒य॒क्ष्मा बृ॑ह॒तीरिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ā́ ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ūrmím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀayakṣmā́ḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour down upon us a shower from heaven, a stream of waters, wholesome and abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तया॑ पवस्व॒ धार॑या॒ यया॒ गाव॑ इ॒हागम॑न् । जन्या॑स॒ उप॑ नो गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: táyā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ ā-gáman ǀjányāsaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow in such a stream that the cattle belonging to the (enemy's) nation may come here to our dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तं प॑वस्व॒ धार॑या य॒ज्ञेषु॑ देव॒वीत॑मः । अ॒स्मभ्य॑य वृ॒ष्टिमा प॑व
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛtám ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ā́ ǀ pava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who are most dear to the gods at sacrifice, shower down water in a stream, pour your rain upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑ ऊ॒र्जे व्य१॒॑व्ययं॑ प॒वित्रं॑ धाव॒ धार॑या । दे॒वास॑: शृ॒णव॒न्हि क॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjé ǀ ví ǀ avyáyam ǀ pavítram ǀ dhāva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ śṛṇávan ǀ hí ǀ kam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you for our sustenance hasten to the woollen filter with your stream; let the gods hear your sound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो असिष्यद॒द्रक्षां॑स्यप॒जङ्घ॑नत् । प्र॒त्न॒वद्रो॒चय॒न्रुच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ apa-jáṅghanat ǀpratna-vát ǀ rocáyan ǀ rúcaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifier (theSoma) flows forth destroying therākṣasas, flashing out brilliance as of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॒ शुष्मा॑स ईरते॒ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मेरि॑व स्व॒नः । वा॒णस्य॑ चोदया प॒विम्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ īrate ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrméḥ-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀvāṇásya ǀ codaya ǀ pavím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Forth flow your mystery (streams), like the roar (issuing) from the ocean wave; emit your sound like that of a (rushing) arrow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒स॒वे त॒ उदी॑रते ति॒स्रो वाचो॑ मख॒स्युव॑: । यदव्य॒ एषि॒ सान॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: pra-savé ǀ te ǀ út ǀ īrate ǀ tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ makhasyúvaḥ ǀyát ǀ ávye ǀ éṣi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At your birth the three voices of the worshipper are uttered when you go to the summit of the fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्यो॒ वारे॒ परि॑ प्रि॒यं हरिं॑ हिन्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः । पव॑मानं मधु॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyám ǀ hárim ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀpávamānam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) effuse with the stones into the fleece the beloved green-tinted purifying honey-dropping (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व मदिन्तम प॒वित्रं॒ धार॑या कवे । अ॒र्कस्य॒ योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ kave ǀarkásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most exhilarating sage (Soma), flow in a stream to the filter to sit onIndra'slap.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व मदिन्तम॒ गोभि॑रञ्जा॒नो अ॒क्तुभि॑: । इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ madin-tama ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Most exhilaratingIndu, being anointed with the unguents of milk and curds flow forth forIndra's drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यो॒ अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तं सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ सृ॑ज । पु॒नी॒हीन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ádhvaryo íti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛja ǀpunīhí ǀ índrāya ǀ pā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adhvaryu, pour upon the filter theSomathat has been expressed with the stones, purify it forIndra's drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वः पी॒यूष॑मुत्त॒मं सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॑ । सु॒नोता॒ मधु॑मत्तमम्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ ut-tamám ǀ sómam ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀsunóta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Adhvaryus), effuse the most sweet-flavouredSoma, the best ambrosia of heaven forIndra, the wielder of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्य इ॑न्दो॒ अन्ध॑सो दे॒वा मधो॒र्व्य॑श्नते । पव॑मानस्य म॒रुत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ indo íti ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnate ǀpávamānasya ǀ marútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, the gods and theMarutspartake your sweet purifying beverage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं हि सो॑म व॒र्धय॑न्त्सु॒तो मदा॑य॒ भूर्ण॑ये । वृष॑न्त्स्तो॒तार॑मू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ soma ǀ vardháyan ǀ sutáḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ bhū́rṇaye ǀvṛ́ṣan ǀ stotā́ram ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Soma, being effused, approach the worshipper for speedy exhilaration and protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्ष विचक्षण प॒वित्रं॒ धार॑या सु॒तः । अ॒भि वाज॑मु॒त श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ pavítram ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten, sagacious (Soma), when you are effused, to the filter in a stream; bestow upon us food and fame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ द्यु॒क्षः स॒नद्र॑यि॒र्भर॒द्वाजं॑ नो॒ अन्ध॑सा । सु॒वा॒नो अ॑र्ष प॒वित्र॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ dyukṣáḥ ǀ sanát-rayiḥ ǀ bhárat ǀ vā́jam ǀ naḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀsuvānáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the glittering (Soma), the acquirer of wealth; bestow upon us strength together with food; hasten when effused to the filter.”
