shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ प्र॒त्नेभि॒रध्व॑भि॒रव्यो॒ वारे॒ परि॑ प्रि॒यः । स॒हस्र॑धारो या॒त्तना॑
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ pratnébhiḥ ǀ ádhva-bhiḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ yāt ǀ tánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your juice dear (to the gods), flowing in a thousand streams, proceeds by ancient paths to the fleecy filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒रुर्न यस्तमी॑ङ्ख॒येन्दो॒ न दान॑मीङ्खय । व॒धैर्व॑धस्नवीङ्खय
shlokas.transliteration: carúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ tám ǀ īṅkhaya ǀ índo íti ǀ ná ǀ dā́nam ǀ īṅkhaya ǀvadháiḥ ǀ vadhasno íti vadha-sno ǀ īṅkhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), send (us) him who is like a pot;Indu, send us now wealth; swift-flowing (Soma), send it with blows (of stones).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि शुष्म॑मिन्दवेषां॒ पुरु॑हूत॒ जना॑नाम् । यो अ॒स्माँ आ॒दिदे॑शति
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ śúṣmam ǀ indo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ púru-hūta ǀ jánānām ǀyáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ā-dídeśati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, the invoked of many, overthrow the strength of those people who challenge us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं न॑ इन्द ऊ॒तिभि॑: स॒हस्रं॑ वा॒ शुची॑नाम् । पव॑स्व मंह॒यद्र॑यिः
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ vā ǀ śúcīnām ǀpávasva ǀ maṃhayát-rayiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, do you who are the distributor of riches, pour forth for our protection a hundred or a thousand of your pure (streams).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॒ शुष्मा॑सो अस्थू॒ रक्षो॑ भि॒न्दन्तो॑ अद्रिवः । नु॒दस्व॒ याः प॑रि॒स्पृध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ bhindántaḥ ǀ adri-vaḥ ǀnudásva ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ pari-spṛ́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) armed with the stones, your powerful streams rise up scattering therākṣasas; drive away those who are our adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या नि॑ज॒घ्निरोज॑सा रथसं॒गे धने॑ हि॒ते । स्तवा॒ अबि॑भ्युषा हृ॒दा
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ ni-jaghníḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ ratha-saṅgé ǀ dháne ǀ hité ǀstávai ǀ ábibhyuṣā ǀ hṛdā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You are) by this strength the discomfited (of foes), I praise you with a fearless heart for the sake of (our) line of chariots ranged (against the foe) and for the sake of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ व्र॒तानि॒ नाधृषे॒ पव॑मानस्य दू॒ढ्या॑ । रु॒ज यस्त्वा॑ पृत॒न्यति॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ ná ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǀ pávamānasya ǀ duḥ-dhyā́ ǀrujá ǀ yáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ pṛtanyáti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prowess of you (Soma) as you are poured forth is irresistible against the malignant (rākṣasas); destroy him who defies you to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं हि॑न्वन्ति मद॒च्युतं॒ हरिं॑ न॒दीषु॑ वा॒जिन॑म् । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ hinvanti ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ hárim ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ vājínam ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) plural ngeIndu, honey-dropping, green-tinted, vigorous, exhilarating, into the waters forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य प्र॒त्नामनु॒ द्युतं॑ शु॒क्रं दु॑दुह्रे॒ अह्र॑यः । पय॑: सहस्र॒सामृषि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ pratnā́m ǀ ánu ǀ dyútam ǀ śukrám ǀ duduhre ǀ áhrayaḥ ǀpáyaḥ ǀ sahasra-sā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TowardsSoma's ancient body the seers milk the flashing fluid, the sage who grants a thousand boons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सूर्य॑ इवोप॒दृग॒यं सरां॑सि धावति । स॒प्त प्र॒वत॒ आ दिव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sū́ryaḥ-iva ǀ upa-dṛ́k ǀ ayám ǀ sárāṃsi ǀ dhāvati ǀsaptá ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dívam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He like the sun is the supervisor (of all acts); he hastens to the lakes, he unites with the seven down-descending rivers from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं विश्वा॑नि तिष्ठति पुना॒नो भुव॑नो॒परि॑ । सोमो॑ दे॒वो न सूर्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ víśvāni ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ punānáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ upári ǀsómaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifiedSoma, like the divine sun, abides above all regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णो दे॒ववी॑तये॒ वाजाँ॑ अर्षसि॒ गोम॑तः । पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्दविन्द्र॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vā́jān ǀ arṣasi ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ indra-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedIndu, who are devoted toIndra, pour down for our sacrifice, food with milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यवं॑यवं नो॒ अन्ध॑सा पु॒ष्टम्पु॑ष्टं॒ परि॑ स्रव । सोम॒ विश्वा॑ च॒ सौभ॑गा
shlokas.transliteration: yávam-yavam ǀ naḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀ puṣṭám-puṣṭam ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀsóma ǀ víśvā ǀ ca ǀ sáubhagā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, pour forth (in a stream of) food, abundant soft-collected (juice), and all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दो॒ यथा॒ तव॒ स्तवो॒ यथा॑ ते जा॒तमन्ध॑सः । नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒ये स॑दः
shlokas.transliteration: índo íti ǀ yáthā ǀ táva ǀ stávaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ te ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀní ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyé ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, since the praise of you as food, since your birth (has appeared), sit down upon the grass that plural ases (you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॑ गो॒विद॑श्व॒वित्पव॑स्व सो॒मान्ध॑सा । म॒क्षूत॑मेभि॒रह॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ go-vít ǀ aśva-vít ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ ándhasā ǀmakṣú-tamebhiḥ ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AndSoma, do you who are the giver of cattle, the giver of horses, flow to us in (a stream of) food as the days quickly pass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो जि॒नाति॒ न जीय॑ते॒ हन्ति॒ शत्रु॑म॒भीत्य॑ । स प॑वस्व सहस्रजित्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jinā́ti ǀ ná ǀ jī́yate ǀ hánti ǀ śátrum ǀ abhi-ítya ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasra-jit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow forth, O conqueror of thousands, who conquers and is not conquered, and attacking slays his foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ सोम॑ ऋ॒तं बृ॒हदा॒शुः प॒वित्रे॑ अर्षति । वि॒घ्नन्रक्षां॑सि देव॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀ āśúḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ arṣati ǀvi-ghnán ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ deva-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swiftSomadevoted to the gods destroying therākṣasasin the filter, bestows abundant food (on us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्सोमो॒ वाज॒मर्ष॑ति श॒तं धारा॑ अप॒स्युव॑: । इन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यमा॑वि॒शन्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ árṣati ǀ śatám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ apasyúvaḥ ǀíndrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the hundred rite-loving streams (of theSoma) obtain the friendship ofIndra, then the Soma brings us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्वा॒ योष॑णो॒ दश॑ जा॒रं न क॒न्या॑नूषत । मृ॒ज्यसे॑ सोम सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tvā ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ jārám ǀ ná ǀ kanyā́ ǀ anūṣata ǀmṛjyáse ǀ soma ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers commend you,Soma, as a maiden her lover, you are cleansed in order to bestow (wealth on us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्रा॑य॒ विष्ण॑वे स्वा॒दुरि॑न्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव । नॄन्त्स्तो॒तॄन्पा॒ह्यंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ índrāya ǀ víṣṇave ǀ svādúḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀnṝ́n ǀ stotṝ́n ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indu, who are sweet-flavoured flow forIndraandViṣṇupreserve the worshippers, your praisers, from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ धारा॑ अस॒श्चतो॑ दि॒वो न य॑न्ति वृ॒ष्टय॑: । अच्छा॒ वाजं॑ सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yanti ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀáccha ǀ vā́jam ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your unconnected streams advance towards infinite food (for us) like the showers from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒याणि॒ काव्या॒ विश्वा॒ चक्षा॑णो अर्षति । हरि॑स्तुञ्जा॒न आयु॑धा
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ kā́vyā ǀ víśvā ǀ cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀháriḥ ǀ tuñjānáḥ ǀ ā́yudhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tintedSomacontemplating all the holy acts that are plural asing to the gods rushes (to the sacrifice) brandishing his weapons (against therākṣasas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑र्मृजा॒न आ॒युभि॒रिभो॒ राजे॑व सुव्र॒तः । श्ये॒नो न वंसु॑ षीदति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀ íbhaḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ su-vratáḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ váṃsu ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the object of pious observances, cleansed by the priests, fearless as a king, sits on the waters like a hawk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ विश्वा॑ दि॒वो वसू॒तो पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॑ । पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्द॒वा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ diváḥ ǀ vásu ǀ utó íti ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, when you are purified, bring us all the treasures that are in heaven and upon earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तर॒त्स म॒न्दी धा॑वति॒ धारा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सः । तर॒त्स म॒न्दी धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: tárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin); the stream of the effused beverage (flows); he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒स्रा वे॑द॒ वसू॑नां॒ मर्त॑स्य दे॒व्यव॑सः । तर॒त्स म॒न्दी धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: usrā́ ǀ veda ǀ vásūnām ǀ mártasya ǀ devī́ ǀ ávasaḥ ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliant (stream), the bestower of riches, knows how to protect the worshipper; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ध्व॒स्रयो॑: पुरु॒षन्त्यो॒रा स॒हस्रा॑णि दद्महे । तर॒त्स म॒न्दी धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: dhvasráyoḥ ǀ puru-sántyoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ dadmahe ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have received thousands from Dhvasra andPuruṣanti; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ययो॑स्त्रिं॒शतं॒ तना॑ स॒हस्रा॑णि च॒ दद्म॑हे । तर॒त्स म॒न्दी धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ triṃśátam ǀ tánā ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ ca ǀ dádmahe ǀtárat ǀ sáḥ ǀ mandī́ ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have received from those two three hundred thousand garments; he the delighted (of the gods) flows rescuing (his worshippers from sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व गो॒जिद॑श्व॒जिद्वि॑श्व॒जित्सो॑म रण्य॒जित् । प्र॒जाव॒द्रत्न॒मा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ go-jít ǀ aśva-jít ǀ viśva-jít ǀ soma ǀ raṇya-jít ǀprajā́-vat ǀ rátnam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, conqueror of cattle, of horses, of all things, of desirable wealth; bring us riches withmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्वा॒द्भ्यो अदा॑भ्य॒: पव॒स्वौष॑धीभ्यः । पव॑स्व धि॒षणा॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀ pávasva ǀ óṣadhībhyaḥ ǀpávasva ǀ dhiṣáṇābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow with waters and with filaments, flow with herbs, flow with the stones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म॒ पव॑मानो॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता त॑र । क॒विः सी॑द॒ नि ब॒र्हिषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tara ǀkavíḥ ǀ sīda ǀ ní ǀ barhíṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, do you who are the purifier, the sage, overcome all hindrances; sit down on the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ स्व॑र्विदो॒ जाय॑मानोऽभवो म॒हान् । इन्दो॒ विश्वाँ॑ अ॒भीद॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ sváḥ ǀ vidaḥ ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀíndo íti ǀ víśvān ǀ abhí ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O purifyingSoma, grant all boons; as soon as you are born you are great;Indu, you overcome all (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र गा॑य॒त्रेण॑ गायत॒ पव॑मानं॒ विच॑र्षणिम् । इन्दुं॑ स॒हस्र॑चक्षसम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ gāyatréṇa ǀ gāyata ǀ pávamānam ǀ ví-carṣaṇim ǀíndum ǀ sahásra-cakṣasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hymn with agāyatrīhymn,Induthe purifier, the all-beholding, the thousand-eyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ स॒हस्र॑चक्षस॒मथो॑ स॒हस्र॑भर्णसम् । अति॒ वार॑मपाविषुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tvā ǀ sahásra-cakṣasam ǀ átho íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀáti ǀ vā́ram ǀ apāviṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the thousand-eyed, and the supporter of thousands, they make to flow through the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॒ वारा॒न्पव॑मानो असिष्यदत्क॒लशाँ॑ अ॒भि धा॑वति । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्द्या॑वि॒शन्
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ vā́rān ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ asisyadat ǀ kaláśān ǀ abhí ǀ dhāvati ǀíndrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ ā-viśán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifier trickles through the hairs of the filter; he hastens to the pitchers, enteringIndra's heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य सोम॒ राध॑से॒ शं प॑वस्व विचर्षणे । प्र॒जाव॒द्रेत॒ आ भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ soma ǀ rā́dhase ǀ śám ǀ pavasva ǀ vi-carṣaṇe ǀprajā́-vat ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-beholdingSoma, flow plural asantly forIndra's gratification; bring (us) food withmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या वी॒ती परि॑ स्रव॒ यस्त॑ इन्दो॒ मदे॒ष्वा । अ॒वाह॑न्नव॒तीर्नव॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ vītī́ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀava-áhan ǀ navatī́ḥ ǀ náva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Indu, for (Indra's) food with that (juice) of yours which in battles overthrow ninety and nine (cities of the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुर॑: स॒द्य इ॒त्थाधि॑ये॒ दिवो॑दासाय॒ शम्ब॑रम् । अध॒ त्यं तु॒र्वशं॒ यदु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: púraḥ ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ itthā́-dhiye ǀ dívaḥ-dāsāya ǀ śámbaram ǀádha ǀ tyám ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Which overturned) the cities in a moment, and for the sake of the devoutDivodāsa(subdued)Śambara, and then thatTurvaśaandYadu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णो॒ अश्व॑मश्व॒विद्गोम॑दिन्दो॒ हिर॑ण्यवत् । क्षरा॑ सह॒स्रिणी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ áśvam ǀ aśva-vít ǀ gó-mat ǀ indo íti ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀkṣára ǀ sahasríṇīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, conqueror of horses, shower forth horses with cattle and gold and unbounded food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानस्य ते व॒यं प॒वित्र॑मभ्युन्द॒तः । स॒खि॒त्वमा वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ pavítram ǀ abhi-undatáḥ ǀsakhi-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit your friendship as you drop flowing over the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॑ प॒वित्र॑मू॒र्मयो॑ऽभि॒क्षर॑न्ति॒ धार॑या । तेभि॑र्नः सोम मृळय
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ abhi-kṣáranti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀtébhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ mṛḷaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Delight us,Soma, with those your undulations what flow over the filter in a stream.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॑: पुना॒न आ भ॑र र॒यिं वी॒रव॑ती॒मिष॑म् । ईशा॑नः सोम वि॒श्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ rayím ǀ vīrá-vatīm ǀ íṣam ǀī́śānaḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are lord over all, the purifier, bring us riches and food withmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तमु॒ त्यं दश॒ क्षिपो॑ मृ॒जन्ति॒ सिन्धु॑मातरम् । समा॑दि॒त्येभि॑रख्यत
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ mṛjánti ǀ síndhu-mātaram ǀsám ǀ ādityébhiḥ ǀ akhyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers cleanse thisSoma, whose parents are the rivers; he is associated with theĀdityas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समिन्द्रे॑णो॒त वा॒युना॑ सु॒त ए॑ति प॒वित्र॒ आ । सं सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ índreṇa ǀ utá ǀ vāyúnā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ eti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀsám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When effused he proceeds to the filter, withIndraandVāyu, and with the sun's rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॒ भगा॑य वा॒यवे॑ पू॒ष्णे प॑वस्व॒ मधु॑मान् । चारु॑र्मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे च
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhágāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ pavasva ǀ mádhu-mān ǀcā́ruḥ ǀ mitré ǀ váruṇe ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you who are sweet-flavoured and beautiful flow (at) our (sacrifice) forBhaga,Vāyu,Pūṣaṇ,MitraandVaruṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्चा ते॑ जा॒तमन्ध॑सो दि॒वि षद्भूम्या द॑दे । उ॒ग्रं शर्म॒ महि॒ श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: uccā́ ǀ te ǀ jātám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ diví ǀ sát ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀugrám ǀ śárma ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The birth of your juice is on high; the earth has received (your) intense happiness and abundant food, though (these) exist (naturally) in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ना विश्वा॑न्य॒र्य आ द्यु॒म्नानि॒ मानु॑षाणाम् । सिषा॑सन्तो वनामहे
shlokas.transliteration: enā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dyumnā́ni ǀ mā́nuṣāṇām ǀsísāsantaḥ ǀ vanāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By this (Soma) obtaining and desiring to enjoy all the good things that belong to men we enjoy (them).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स न॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ यज्य॑वे॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । व॒रि॒वो॒वित्परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ yájyave ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀvarivaḥ-vít ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O you who are the possessor of wealth flow for us, for the adorableIndra, forVaruṇaand theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॒ षु जा॒तम॒प्तुरं॒ गोभि॑र्भ॒ङ्गं परि॑ष्कृतम् । इन्दुं॑ दे॒वा अ॑यासिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ sú ǀ jātám ǀ ap-túram ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ bhaṅgám ǀ pári-kṛtam ǀíndum ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ayāsiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods approachIndu, (who is) completely genitive rated, sent forth by the waters, the demolisher (of foes), adorned with milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमिद्व॑र्धन्तु नो॒ गिरो॑ व॒त्सं सं॒शिश्व॑रीरिव । य इन्द्र॑स्य हृदं॒सनि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ít ǀ vardhantu ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ saṃśíśvarīḥ-iva ǀyáḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ hṛdam-sániḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our praises foster him who wins the heart ofIndra, as cows who have young ones (foster) their calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्षा॑ णः सोम॒ शं गवे॑ धु॒क्षस्व॑ पि॒प्युषी॒मिष॑म् । वर्धा॑ समु॒द्रमु॒क्थ्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: árṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ śám ǀ gáve ǀ dhukṣásva ǀ pipyúṣīm ǀ íṣam ǀvárdha ǀ samudrám ǀ ukthyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, pour prosperity upon our cattle, milk forth (for us) nutritious food; augment the laudable water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो अजीजनद्दि॒वश्चि॒त्रं न त॑न्य॒तुम् । ज्योति॑र्वैश्वान॒रं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ajījanat ǀ diváḥ ǀ citrám ǀ ná ǀ tanyatúm ǀjyótiḥ ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pure (Soma) has genitive rated in heaven the greatVaiśvānaralight like the wonderful thunder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानस्य ते॒ रसो॒ मदो॑ राजन्नदुच्छु॒नः । वि वार॒मव्य॑मर्षति
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ rásaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ rājan ǀ aducchunáḥ ǀví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bright shiningSoma, the juice of you, when your flow enters the woollen filter, exhilarating free from evil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ रस॒स्तव॒ दक्षो॒ वि रा॑जति द्यु॒मान् । ज्योति॒र्विश्वं॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ rásaḥ ǀ táva ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀjyótiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, your juice as it increases shines bright; it (makes) a pervading universal light to be seen.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ मदो॒ वरे॑ण्य॒स्तेना॑ पव॒स्वान्ध॑सा । दे॒वा॒वीर॑घशंस॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ téna ǀ pavasva ǀ ándhasā ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ aghaśaṃsa-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow forth with that juice of yours which is exhilarating, the best gratifying the gods, the slayer ofrākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जघ्नि॑र्वृ॒त्रम॑मि॒त्रियं॒ सस्नि॒र्वाजं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे । गो॒षा उ॑ अश्व॒सा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: jághniḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ amitríyam ǀ sásniḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ divé-dive ǀgo-sā́ḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ aśva-sā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the slayer of the hostileVṛtra, the enjoyed of battle day by day, the giver of kine and the giver of horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम्मि॑श्लो अरु॒षो भ॑व सूप॒स्थाभि॒र्न धे॒नुभि॑: । सीद॑ञ्छ्ये॒नो न योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: sám-miślaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ bhava ǀ su-upasthā́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀsī́dan ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be now resplendent, mixed with the supporting (products of the) kine, alighting like a falcon on your plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व॒ य आवि॒थेन्द्रं॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ हन्त॑वे । व॒व्रि॒वांसं॑ म॒हीर॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́vitha ǀ índram ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀvavri-vā́ṃsam ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow you who did helpIndrato slayVṛtra, who obstructed the great waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒वीरा॑सो व॒यं धना॒ जये॑म सोम मीढ्वः । पु॒ना॒नो व॑र्ध नो॒ गिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-vī́rāsaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ dhánā ǀ jáyema ǀ soma ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vardha ǀ naḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, possessed of excellentmaleoffspring, conquer the wealth (of our enemies), OSoma, the sprinkler; being purified, accept our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वोता॑स॒स्तवाव॑सा॒ स्याम॑ व॒न्वन्त॑ आ॒मुर॑: । सोम॑ व्र॒तेषु॑ जागृहि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ táva ǀ ávasā ǀ syā́ma ǀ vanvántaḥ ǀ ā-múraḥ ǀsóma ǀ vratéṣu ǀ jāgṛhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protected by you, through your protection may we be victorious, slaying (our enemies); be vigilantSoma, at our sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प॒घ्नन्प॑वते॒ मृधोऽप॒ सोमो॒ अरा॑व्णः । गच्छ॒न्निन्द्र॑स्य निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ pavate ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ sómaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǀgácchan ǀ índrasya ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaflows, slaying the malignant, slaying the withholders (of wealth), proceeding toIndra's consecrated (station).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो नो॑ रा॒य आ भ॑र॒ पव॑मान ज॒ही मृध॑: । रास्वे॑न्दो वी॒रव॒द्यश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pávamāna ǀ jahí ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀrā́sva ǀ indo íti ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us, purifier, much wealth; conquer our foes; grant us,Indu, fame andmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न त्वा॑ श॒तं च॒न ह्रुतो॒ राधो॒ दित्स॑न्त॒मा मि॑नन् । यत्पु॑ना॒नो म॑ख॒स्यसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tvā ǀ śatám ǀ caná ǀ hrútaḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ dítsantam ǀ ā́ ǀ minan ǀyát ǀ punānáḥ ǀ makhasyáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A hundred foes harm you not, purposing to give wealth when being purified you are benevolently inclined.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्वेन्दो॒ वृषा॑ सु॒तः कृ॒धी नो॑ य॒शसो॒ जने॑ । विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विषो॑ जहि
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ indo íti ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ kṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ jáne ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indu, when effused, the showerer (of benefits) make us celebrated among men; slay all our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ ते स॒ख्ये व॒यं तवे॑न्दो द्यु॒म्न उ॑त्त॒मे । सा॒स॒ह्याम॑ पृतन्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ vayám ǀ táva ǀ indo íti ǀ dyumné ǀ ut-tamé ǀsasahyā́ma ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Enjoying) the friendship of you here and you excellent food,Indu, may we overcome our assailants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या ते॑ भी॒मान्यायु॑धा ति॒ग्मानि॒ सन्ति॒ धूर्व॑णे । रक्षा॑ समस्य नो नि॒दः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ te ǀ bhīmā́ni ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ tigmā́ni ǀ sánti ǀ dhū́rvaṇe ǀrákṣa ǀ samasya ǀ naḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With your weapons which are formidable and sharp for slaying (the foe), defend us from the scorn (of our enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते अ॑सृग्र॒मिन्द॑वस्ति॒रः प॒वित्र॑मा॒शव॑: । विश्वा॑न्य॒भि सौभ॑गा
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀvíśvāni ǀ abhí ǀ sáubhagā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These rapidSomajuices have directed through the filter (to obtain) all good things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒घ्नन्तो॑ दुरि॒ता पु॒रु सु॒गा तो॒काय॑ वा॒जिन॑: । तना॑ कृ॒ण्वन्तो॒ अर्व॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: vi-ghnántaḥ ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ purú ǀ su-gā́ ǀ tokā́ya ǀ vājínaḥ ǀtánā ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ árvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful, repelling evils, bestowing happiness and riches upon our sons and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ण्वन्तो॒ वरि॑वो॒ गवे॒ऽभ्य॑र्षन्ति सुष्टु॒तिम् । इळा॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ सं॒यत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ gáve ǀ abhí ǀ arṣanti ǀ su-stutím ǀíḷām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ sam-yátam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They advance towards our fair praise, granting to (us and) our cattle sustaining wealth and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑व्यं॒शुर्मदा॑या॒प्सु दक्षो॑ गिरि॒ष्ठाः । श्ये॒नो न योनि॒मास॑दत्
shlokas.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ ap-sú ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mountain-bornSomaflows for exhilaration, mighty in the (vasatīvarī) waters; he alights like a falcon on his own plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒भ्रमन्धो॑ दे॒ववा॑तम॒प्सु धू॒तो नृभि॑: सु॒तः । स्वद॑न्ति॒ गाव॒: पयो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: śubhrám ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ devá-vātam ǀ ap-sú ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀsvádanti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ páyaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cattle sweeten with their milk the beautiful food that is asked for by the gods; theSomawhen effused by the priests is cleansed in the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदी॒मश्वं॒ न हेता॒रोऽशू॑शुभन्न॒मृता॑य । मध्वो॒ रसं॑ सध॒मादे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ hétāraḥ ǀ áśūśubhan ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀmádhvaḥ ǀ rásam ǀ sadha-mā́de ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then the ministering priests in the assembly beautify the dice of exhilarating (Soma) like a horse, for the sake of immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यास्ते॒ धारा॑ मधु॒श्चुतोऽसृ॑ग्रमिन्द ऊ॒तये॑ । ताभि॑: प॒वित्र॒मास॑दः
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ madhu-ścútaḥ ǀ ásṛgram ǀ indo íti ǀ ūtáye ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ā́ ǀ asadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sit down,Indu, on the filter with those streams the shedders of sweet (juice), which are let fall for our protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॒र्षेन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑ ति॒रो रोमा॑ण्य॒व्यया॑ । सीद॒न्योना॒ वने॒ष्वा
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rómāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀsī́dan ǀ yónā ǀ váneṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Passing obliquely through the sheep's hairs, hasten forIndra's drinking, sitting in your plural ce in the wooden vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वमि॑न्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव॒ स्वादि॑ष्ठो॒ अङ्गि॑रोभ्यः । व॒रि॒वो॒विद्घृ॒तं पय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ svā́diṣṭhaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhyaḥ ǀvarivaḥ-vít ǀ ghṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, who are most sweet-flavoured, the bestower of riches, drop for theAṅgirasasbutter and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं विच॑र्षणिर्हि॒तः पव॑मान॒: स चे॑तति । हि॒न्वा॒न आप्यं॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ cetati ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This all-seeingPavamānaSomadeposited (in the vessels), sending forth abundant (food), the product of the waters, is known (by all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष वृषा॒ वृष॑व्रत॒: पव॑मानो अशस्ति॒हा । कर॒द्वसू॑नि दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣa-vrataḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ aśasti-hā́ ǀkárat ǀ vásūni ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisPavamānaSoma, the sprinkler (of benefits), engaged in sprinkling, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, bestows riches upon the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । पु॒रु॒श्च॒न्द्रं पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀpuru-candrám ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour forth thousand-fold wealth, together with cattle and horses, delighting many, desired by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य परि॑ षिच्यते मर्मृ॒ज्यमा॑न आ॒युभि॑: । उ॒रु॒गा॒यः क॒विक्र॑तुः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ pári ǀ sicyate ǀ marmṛjyámānaḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀuru-gāyáḥ ǀ kaví-kratuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma) the many-hymned, having wise designs being cleansed by the priests, is sprinkled forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्रो॑तिः श॒ताम॑घो वि॒मानो॒ रज॑सः क॒विः । इन्द्रा॑य पवते॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-ūtiḥ ǀ śatá-maghaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ pavate ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offering thousand-fold protection, having hundred-fold wealth, the meawsurer of the world, the sage, the exhilarating (Soma) flows forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रा जा॒त इ॒ह स्तु॒त इन्दु॒रिन्द्रा॑य धीयते । विर्योना॑ वस॒तावि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: girā́ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ihá ǀ stutáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ dhīyate ǀvíḥ ǀ yónā ǀ vasatáu-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “genitive rated and praised by song,Induat this sacrifice is deposited in his plural ce forIndra, like a bird on its nest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानः सु॒तो नृभि॒: सोमो॒ वाज॑मिवासरत् । च॒मूषु॒ शक्म॑ना॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vā́jam-iva ǀ asarat ǀcamū́ṣu ǀ śákmanā ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pureSomaeffused by the priests rushes forth as if to battle, to alight vigorously upon the ladles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्रि॑पृ॒ष्ठे त्रि॑वन्धु॒रे रथे॑ युञ्जन्ति॒ यात॑वे । ऋषी॑णां स॒प्त धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tri-pṛṣṭhé ǀ tri-vandhuré ǀ ráthe ǀ yuñjanti ǀ yā́tave ǀṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ saptá ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They attach him by seven ceremonies to the three-backed three-benched chariot of the ṛṣis to go to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं सो॑तारो धन॒स्पृत॑मा॒शुं वाजा॑य॒ यात॑वे । हरिं॑ हिनोत वा॒जिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sotāraḥ ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ āśúm ǀ vā́jāya ǀ yā́tave ǀhárim ǀ hinota ǀ vājínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused of theSoma, urge forward that wealth bestowing rapid vigorous steed to go to the battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒वि॒शन्क॒लशं॑ सु॒तो विश्वा॒ अर्ष॑न्न॒भि श्रिय॑: । शूरो॒ न गोषु॑ तिष्ठति
shlokas.transliteration: ā-viśán ǀ kaláśam ǀ sutáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ árṣan ǀ abhí ǀ śríyaḥ ǀśū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ góṣu ǀ tiṣṭhati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Entering when effused into the pitcher bringing us all success like a hero, he stands among the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त॑ इन्दो॒ मदा॑य॒ कं पयो॑ दुहन्त्या॒यव॑: । दे॒वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ mádāya ǀ kám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ duhanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The devout priests milk forth your sweet juiceIndu, for the gods for the purpose of exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॒: सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ सृ॒जता॒ मधु॑मत्तमम् । दे॒वेभ्यो॑ देव॒श्रुत्त॑मम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sómam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjáta ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ devaśrút-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour upon the filter for us for the sake of the gods the most sweet-flavouredSoma, most audible to the godṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॑ असृक्षत गृणा॒नाः श्रव॑से म॒हे । म॒दिन्त॑मस्य॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ gṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ mahé ǀmadín-tamasya ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These laudedSomajuices are let flow for the sake of abundant food in a stream for the most exhilarating (juice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि गव्या॑नि वी॒तये॑ नृ॒म्णा पु॑ना॒नो अ॑र्षसि । स॒नद्वा॑ज॒: परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ gávyāni ǀ vītáye ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀsanát-vājaḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being purified you have the treasures of the kine to enjoy (them); flow forth you who grants food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त नो॒ गोम॑ती॒रिषो॒ विश्वा॑ अर्ष परि॒ष्टुभ॑: । गृ॒णा॒नो ज॒मद॑ग्निना
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ naḥ ǀ gó-matīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pari-stúbhaḥ ǀgṛṇānáḥ ǀ jamát-agninā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And have for us towards all widely renowned food with cattle, being hymned byJamadagni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व वा॒चो अ॑ग्रि॒यः सोम॑ चि॒त्राभि॑रू॒तिभि॑: । अ॒भि विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vācáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ sóma ǀ citrā́bhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are most excellent, flow with your marvellous protection towards our praises, towards all hymns (of praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं स॑मु॒द्रिया॑ अ॒पो॑ऽग्रि॒यो वाच॑ ई॒रय॑न् । पव॑स्व विश्वमेजय
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ samudríyāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ īráyan ǀpávasva ǀ viśvam-ejaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agitator of all, do you who are the most excellent raising your voice, pour forth the waters of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तुभ्ये॒मा भुव॑ना कवे महि॒म्ने सो॑म तस्थिरे । तुभ्य॑मर्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: túbhya ǀ imā́ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ kave ǀ mahimné ǀ soma ǀ tasthire ǀtúbhyam ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O sage (Soma) in your might do these worlds stand; to you the rivers hasten.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ दि॒वो न वृ॒ष्टयो॒ धारा॑ यन्त्यस॒श्चत॑: । अ॒भि शु॒क्रामु॑प॒स्तिर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ yanti ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀabhí ǀ śukrā́m ǀ upa-stíram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your unconnected streams descend like the rian from heaven upon the white outspread (fleece).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒येन्दुं॑ पुनीतनो॒ग्रं दक्षा॑य॒ साध॑नम् । ई॒शा॒नं वी॒तिरा॑धसम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ índum ǀ punītana ǀ ugrám ǀ dákṣāya ǀ sā́dhanam ǀīśānám ǀ vītí-rādhasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify forIndrathe fierceIndu, the means of strength, the lord (of wealth), the giver of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान ऋ॒तः क॒विः सोम॑: प॒वित्र॒मास॑दत् । दध॑त्स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtáḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The truthful seer, PavamaānaSoma, sits down upon the filter, giving great energy to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं सो॑म सु॒वीर्य॑म् । अ॒स्मे श्रवां॑सि धारय
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀasmé íti ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ dhāraya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour (upon us),Soma, thousand-fold wealth, with excellentmaleprogeny, secure to us ample food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इष॒मूर्जं॑ च पिन्वस॒ इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रिन्त॑मः । च॒मूष्वा नि षी॑दसि
shlokas.transliteration: íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ ca ǀ pinvase ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀcamū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who are most exhilarating effuse food and drink forIndra; you sit on the ladles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त इन्द्रा॑य॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ सोम॑: क॒लशे॑ अक्षरत् । मधु॑माँ अस्तु वा॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ víṣṇave ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ akṣarat ǀmádhu-mān ǀ astu ǀ vāyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somaeffused forIndraandViṣṇuandVāyudrops into the pitcher; may he be sweet-flavoured.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते अ॑सृग्रमा॒शवोऽति॒ ह्वरां॑सि ब॒भ्रव॑: । सोमा॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ asṛgram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀsómāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These swift-flowing tawny-colouredSomajuices, with a stream of water are let loose upon therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ वर्ध॑न्तो अ॒प्तुर॑: कृ॒ण्वन्तो॒ विश्व॒मार्य॑म् । अ॒प॒घ्नन्तो॒ अरा॑व्णः
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ várdhantaḥ ǀ ap-túraḥ ǀ kṛṇvántaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ryam ǀapa-ghnántaḥ ǀ árāvṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AugmentingIndra, urging the waters, making all our acts prosperous, destroying the withholders (of oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ता अनु॒ स्वमा रजो॒ऽभ्य॑र्षन्ति ब॒भ्रव॑: । इन्द्रं॒ गच्छ॑न्त॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svám ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣanti ǀ babhrávaḥ ǀíndram ǀ gácchantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The effused tawny-colouredSoma-juices going toIndrahave to their own plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या प॑वस्व॒ धार॑या॒ यया॒ सूर्य॒मरो॑चयः । हि॒न्वा॒नो मानु॑षीर॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ yáyā ǀ sū́ryam ǀ árocayaḥ ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow with that stream with which you,Soma, light up the sun, urging on the waters beneficial to man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑क्त॒ सूर॒ एत॑शं॒ पव॑मानो म॒नावधि॑ । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण॒ यात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: áyukta ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ étaśam ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manáu ǀ ádhi ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ yā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (Soma) harnesses the horse of the sun to travel through the firmament to man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या ह॒रितो॒ दश॒ सूरो॑ अयुक्त॒ यात॑वे । इन्दु॒रिन्द्र॒ इति॑ ब्रु॒वन्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ harítaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ayukta ǀ yā́tave ǀínduḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ íti ǀ bruván ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AndInduexclaiming 'Indra!' harnesses the (horse of the) sun to go towards these ten regions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परी॒तो वा॒यवे॑ सु॒तं गिर॒ इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रम् । अव्यो॒ वारे॑षु सिञ्चत
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ itáḥ ǀ vāyáve ǀ sutám ǀ gíraḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ siñcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sprinkle worshipper, upon the woollen fleece the exhilarating (Soma) that has been effused in all directions forVāyuand forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान वि॒दा र॒यिम॒स्मभ्यं॑ सोम दु॒ष्टर॑म् । यो दू॒णाशो॑ वनुष्य॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ vidā́ḥ ǀ rayím ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ dustáram ǀyáḥ ǀ duḥ-náśaḥ ǀ vanuṣyatā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, grant us wealth unassailable (by our foes), and which cannot be destroyed by the enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑र्ष सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । अ॒भि वाज॑मु॒त श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us thousandfold wealth with cattle and horses; bring vigour and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ दे॒वो न सूर्योऽद्रि॑भिः पवते सु॒तः । दधा॑नः क॒लशे॒ रस॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ rásam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, like the radiant sun, when effused flows forth, depositing its juice in the pitcher.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते धामा॒न्यार्या॑ शु॒क्रा ऋ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या । वाजं॒ गोम॑न्तमक्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ā́ryā ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These brilliangSoma-juices (flowing) towards the dwellings of respectable (worshippers), effuse food and cattle in a stream of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ता इन्द्रा॑य व॒ज्रिणे॒ सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः । प॒वित्र॒मत्य॑क्षरन्
shlokas.transliteration: sutā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vajríṇe ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀpavítram ǀ áti ǀ akṣaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma-juices mixed with curds effused forIndra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, flow through the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सो॑म॒ मधु॑मत्तमो रा॒ये अ॑र्ष प॒वित्र॒ आ । मदो॒ यो दे॑व॒वीत॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀmádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, pour into the filter to bring us wealth (your juice), which is most sweet-flavoured, exhilarating and most desired by the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमी॑ मृजन्त्या॒यवो॒ हरिं॑ न॒दीषु॑ वा॒जिन॑म् । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ īmíti ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ vājínam ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ matsarám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests cleanse in the (vasatīvarī) waters the green-tinted powerful exhilaratingInduforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व॒ हिर॑ण्यव॒दश्वा॑वत्सोम वी॒रव॑त् । वाजं॒ गोम॑न्त॒मा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ soma ǀ vīrá-vat ǀvā́jam ǀ gó-mantam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, pour forth wealth of gold, horses andmaleoffspring; bring us food and cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ वाजे॒ न वा॑ज॒युमव्यो॒ वारे॑षु सिञ्चत । इन्द्रा॑य॒ मधु॑मत्तमम्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ vā́je ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúm ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́reṣu ǀ siñcata ǀíndrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sprinkle upon the woollen fleece forIndrathe most sweet (Soma), desiring battle as if in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विं मृ॑जन्ति॒ मर्ज्यं॑ धी॒भिर्विप्रा॑ अव॒स्यव॑: । वृषा॒ कनि॑क्रदर्षति
shlokas.transliteration: kavím ǀ mṛjanti ǀ márjyam ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ avasyávaḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ kánikrat ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (worshippers) desiring protection, cleanse with their fingers the purifiable (Soma) the sage; with a noise the sprinkler (of benefits) flows forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष॑णं धी॒भिर॒प्तुरं॒ सोम॑मृ॒तस्य॒ धार॑या । म॒ती विप्रा॒: सम॑स्वरन्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ ap-túram ǀ sómam ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀmatī́ ǀ víprāḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (priests) in a stream of water send forth with their fingers, and with praise the sprinkler (of benefits), the shedder of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व देवायु॒षगिन्द्रं॑ गच्छतु ते॒ मद॑: । वा॒युमा रो॑ह॒ धर्म॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ deva ǀ āyuṣák ǀ índram ǀ gacchatu ǀ te ǀ mádaḥ ǀvāyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ roha ǀ dhármaṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow, (Soma), let your exhilarating juice proceed in continuous order toIndra, rise with your supporting (juice toVāyu).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ नि तो॑शसे र॒यिं सो॑म श्र॒वाय्य॑म् । प्रि॒यः स॑मु॒द्रमा वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ ní ǀ tośase ǀ rayím ǀ soma ǀ śravā́yyam ǀpriyáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, you squeeze forth the celebrated riches (of the enemy); do you who are beloved enter the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प॒घ्नन्प॑वसे॒ मृध॑: क्रतु॒वित्सो॑म मत्स॒रः । नु॒दस्वादे॑वयुं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ pavase ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ kratu-vít ǀ soma ǀ matsaráḥ ǀnudásva ǀ ádeva-yum ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, you who are exhilarating flow defeating the enemies, bestowing knowledge (on us); drive off the people who love not the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑माना असृक्षत॒ सोमा॑: शु॒क्रास॒ इन्द॑वः । अ॒भि विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ sómāḥ ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀabhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliant purifiedSoma-juices are let fall amidst all praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानास आ॒शव॑: शु॒भ्रा अ॑सृग्र॒मिन्द॑वः । घ्नन्तो॒ विश्वा॒ अप॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ śubhrā́ḥ ǀ asṛgram ǀ índavaḥ ǀghnántaḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifiedSoma-juices flow swift and bright destroying all enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑माना दि॒वस्पर्य॒न्तरि॑क्षादसृक्षत । पृ॒थि॒व्या अधि॒ सान॑वि
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ antárikṣāt ǀ asṛkṣata ǀpṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́navi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (juices) are poured forth from heaven and from the firmament upon the summit of the ground.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नः सो॑म॒ धार॒येन्दो॒ विश्वा॒ अप॒ स्रिध॑: । ज॒हि रक्षां॑सि सुक्रतो
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ índo íti ǀ víśvā ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǀjahí ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BrilliantSoma, do you, purified in a stream, achieving great acts, destroy all foes and therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प॒घ्नन्त्सो॑म र॒क्षसो॒ऽभ्य॑र्ष॒ कनि॑क्रदत् । द्यु॒मन्तं॒ शुष्म॑मुत्त॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ soma ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ kánikradat ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ut-tamám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroying therākṣasas, pour forth,Soma, with a noise, brilliant and excellent vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे वसू॑नि धारय॒ सोम॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ पार्थि॑वा । इन्दो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ dhāraya ǀ sóma ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀíndo íti ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow upon us,Soma, celestial and terrestrial treasures; (bestow),Indu, all desirable things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ सोम द्यु॒माँ अ॑सि॒ वृषा॑ देव॒ वृष॑व्रतः । वृषा॒ धर्मा॑णि दधिषे
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ soma ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ asi ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ deva ǀ vṛ́ṣa-vrataḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ dadhiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, are the bright sprinkler; you shining (Soma) are the sprinkler whose occupation is sprinkling; you, the sprinkler, sustain the rites (of men and gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृष्ण॑स्ते॒ वृष्ण्यं॒ शवो॒ वृषा॒ वनं॒ वृषा॒ मद॑: । स॒त्यं वृ॑ष॒न्वृषेद॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ te ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyam ǀ śávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vánam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǀsatyám ǀ vṛṣan ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ít ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O sprinkler, the strengh of you the sprinkler consists in sprinkling, your worship consists in sprinkling,  your juice consists in sprinkling; you truly are always the sprinkler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वो॒ न च॑क्रदो॒ वृषा॒ सं गा इ॑न्दो॒ समर्व॑तः । वि नो॑ रा॒ये दुरो॑ वृधि
shlokas.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ cakradaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ sám ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ sám ǀ árvataḥ ǀví ǀ naḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ dúraḥ ǀ vṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, the sprinkler, you nigh like a horse; you give us cattle, you give us horses; open the doors for our wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असृ॑क्षत॒ प्र वा॒जिनो॑ ग॒व्या सोमा॑सो अश्व॒या । शु॒क्रासो॑ वीर॒याशव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ásṛkṣata ǀ prá ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ gavyā́ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ aśva-yā́ ǀśukrā́saḥ ǀ vīra-yā́ ǀ āśávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerful, brilliant, rapidSoma-juices are effused in the hope of obtaining cattle, horses, andmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒म्भमा॑ना ऋता॒युभि॑र्मृ॒ज्यमा॑ना॒ गभ॑स्त्योः । पव॑न्ते॒ वारे॑ अ॒व्यये॑
shlokas.transliteration: śumbhámānāḥ ǀ ṛtayú-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānāḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀpávante ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (Soma-juices) beautified by those desirous of sacrifice, cleansed by theirhands, flow through the woollen fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते विश्वा॑ दा॒शुषे॒ वसु॒ सोमा॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ पार्थि॑वा । पव॑न्ता॒मान्तरि॑क्ष्या
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ víśvā ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vásu ǀ sómāḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀpávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ antárikṣyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thoseSoma-juices pour forth for the offerer (of libations) all the treasures of heaven and earth and of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानस्य विश्ववि॒त्प्र ते॒ सर्गा॑ असृक्षत । सूर्य॑स्येव॒ न र॒श्मय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ viśva-vit ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀsū́ryasya-iva ǀ ná ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-beholdingSoma, your streams as you are being purified are sent forth like the rays of the sun at present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के॒तुं कृ॒ण्वन्दि॒वस्परि॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाभ्य॑र्षसि । स॒मु॒द्रः सो॑म पिन्वसे
shlokas.transliteration: ketúm ǀ kṛṇván ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣasi ǀsamudráḥ ǀ soma ǀ pinvase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, you who are the ocean, bestowing knowledge, have from heaven to all our various forms, and bestow (variouskinds of wealth on us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒न्वा॒नो वाच॑मिष्यसि॒ पव॑मान॒ विध॑र्मणि । अक्रा॑न्दे॒वो न सूर्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hinvānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyasi ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǀákrān ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, when sent forth you utter a cry (when your juice) like the sun god passed through the supporting (filter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑: पविष्ट॒ चेत॑नः प्रि॒यः क॑वी॒नां म॒ती । सृ॒जदश्वं॑ र॒थीरि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ paviṣṭa ǀ cétanaḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ matī́ ǀsṛját ǀ áśvam ǀ rathī́ḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induthe enlightener, beloved (of the gods), flows forth at the praise of the sages; he lets loose (his wave) as a charioteer his horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्मिर्यस्ते॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ दे॑वा॒वीः प॒र्यक्ष॑रत् । सीद॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: ūrmíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ deva-avī́ḥ ǀ pari-ákṣarat ǀsī́dan ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your wave which, devoted to the gods flows to the filter, alighting upon the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ अर्ष प॒वित्र॒ आ मदो॒ यो दे॑व॒वीत॑मः । इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, who are exhilarating and most devoted to the gods, hasten to the filter forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒षे प॑वस्व॒ धार॑या मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो मनी॒षिभि॑: । इन्दो॑ रु॒चाभि गा इ॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: iṣé ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ rucā́ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cleansed by the priests,Indu, flow in a stream for (our) food; approach the cattle with food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नो वरि॑वस्कृ॒ध्यूर्जं॒ जना॑य गिर्वणः । हरे॑ सृजा॒न आ॒शिर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ ū́rjam ǀ jánāya ǀ girvaṇaḥ ǀháre ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ ā-śíram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Green-tinted (Soma) lauded by hymns,being dropped into the curds and milk and being purified, bestow wealth and food upon the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नो दे॒ववी॑तय॒ इन्द्र॑स्य याहि निष्कृ॒तम् । द्यु॒ता॒नो वा॒जिभि॑र्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ índrasya ǀ yāhi ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀdyutānáḥ ǀ vājí-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified for the banquet of the gods, go toIndra's station radiant, collected together by the vigorous (worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र हि॑न्वा॒नास॒ इन्द॒वोऽच्छा॑ समु॒द्रमा॒शव॑: । धि॒या जू॒ता अ॑सृक्षत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hinvānā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ āśávaḥ ǀdhiyā́ ǀ jūtā́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rapidSoma-juices being sent towards the firmament, are poured forth expressed by the fingers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒र्मृ॒जा॒नास॑ आ॒यवो॒ वृथा॑ समु॒द्रमिन्द॑वः । अग्म॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: marmṛjānā́saḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ samudrám ǀ índavaḥ ǀágman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swiftSoma-juices being cleansed (go to) the firmament without an effort; they go to the abode of the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णो याह्यस्म॒युर्विश्वा॒ वसू॒न्योज॑सा । पा॒हि न॒: शर्म॑ वी॒रव॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ naḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ ójasā ǀpāhí ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ vīrá-vat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are devoted to us, guard all our treasures with your might; protect our home and offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मिमा॑ति॒ वह्नि॒रेत॑शः प॒दं यु॑जा॒न ऋक्व॑भिः । प्र यत्स॑मु॒द्र आहि॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: mímāti ǀ váhniḥ ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ padám ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ samudré ǀ ā́-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The horse of burden neighs, yoked to the sacrifice by the priests, when plural ced in the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑मा॒शुॠ॒तस्य॒ सीद॑ति । जहा॒त्यप्र॑चेतसः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yát ǀ yónim ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ āśúḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sī́dati ǀjáhāti ǀ ápra-cetasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the swift (Soma) takes his plural ce on the golden seat of sacrifice, he abandons (the sacrifice) of the foolish man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वे॒ना अ॑नूष॒तेय॑क्षन्ति॒ प्रचे॑तसः । मज्ज॒न्त्यवि॑चेतसः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ íyakṣanti ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀmájjanti ǀ ávi-cetasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted (worshippers) glorifySoma; the well-disposed desire to sacrifice; the perverse-minded sink (into hell).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑येन्दो म॒रुत्व॑ते॒ पव॑स्व॒ मधु॑मत्तमः । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ marútvate ǀ pávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Indu, forIndraassociated with theMaruts, you who are most sweet-flavoured, and take your seat on the plural ce of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॒ विप्रा॑ वचो॒विद॒: परि॑ ष्कृण्वन्ति वे॒धस॑: । सं त्वा॑ मृजन्त्या॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ víprāḥ ǀ vacaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kṛṇvanti ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀsám ǀ tvā ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise who are the performers of pious acts, who are acquainted with holy texts, adorn you; men purify you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रसं॑ ते मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा पिब॑न्ति॒ वरु॑णः कवे । पव॑मानस्य म॒रुत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: rásam ǀ te ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ píbanti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ kave ǀpávamānasya ǀ marútaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇaand theMarutsdrink, sage (Soma), your juice as you drop.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म विप॒श्चितं॑ पुना॒नो वाच॑मिष्यसि । इन्दो॑ स॒हस्र॑भर्णसम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ vipaḥ-cítam ǀ punānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣyasi ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BrilliantSoma, when purified you utter a sapient speech, feeding thousands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒तो स॒हस्र॑भर्णसं॒ वाचं॑ सोम मख॒स्युव॑म् । पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्द॒वा भ॑र
shlokas.transliteration: utó íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀ vā́cam ǀ soma ǀ makhasyúvam ǀpunānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BrilliantSoma, when purified bring (us) a voice, feeding thousands and desiring wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्दवेषां॒ पुरु॑हूत॒ जना॑नाम् । प्रि॒यः स॑मु॒द्रमा वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ eṣām ǀ púru-hūta ǀ jánānām ǀpriyáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, invoked by many, do you, being purified and being loved by these your worshippers, enter the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दवि॑द्युतत्या रु॒चा प॑रि॒ष्टोभ॑न्त्या कृ॒पा । सोमा॑: शु॒क्रा गवा॑शिरः
shlokas.transliteration: dávidyutatyā ǀ rucā́ ǀ pari-stóbhantyā ǀ kṛpā́ ǀsómāḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brightSoma-juices with their shining radiance and resounding stream are mixed with the milk and the curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒न्वा॒नो हे॒तृभि॑र्य॒त आ वाजं॑ वा॒ज्य॑क्रमीत् । सीद॑न्तो व॒नुषो॑ यथा
shlokas.transliteration: hinvānáḥ ǀ hetṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́jam ǀ vājī́ ǀ akramīt ǀsī́dantaḥ ǀ vanúṣaḥ ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerfulSomaurged by the urging (worshippers) goes collected to the battle like warriors entering (the battle-field).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒धक्सो॑म स्व॒स्तये॑ संजग्मा॒नो दि॒वः क॒विः । पव॑स्व॒ सूर्यो॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: ṛdhák ǀ soma ǀ svastáye ǀ sam-jagmānáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀpávasva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are a sage mighty and prospering approaching flow from heaven for our prosperity and view.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒न्वन्ति॒ सूर॒मुस्र॑य॒: स्वसा॑रो जा॒मय॒स्पति॑म् । म॒हामिन्दुं॑ मही॒युव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hinvánti ǀ sū́ram ǀ úsrayaḥ ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ pátim ǀmahā́m ǀ índum ǀ mahīyúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kindred fingers diligently operating, eager to squeeze you forth, send out the invigorating the lord (of all), the mightyIndu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान रु॒चारु॑चा दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॒स्परि॑ । विश्वा॒ वसू॒न्या वि॑श
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ rucā́-rucā ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀvíśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FilteredSoma, who with reiterated radiance shine in the presence of the gods, obtain all boons (for us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वमान सुष्टु॒तिं वृ॒ष्टिं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ दुव॑: । इ॒षे प॑वस्व सं॒यत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ su-stutím ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ dúvaḥ ǀiṣé ǀ pavasva ǀ sam-yátam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour, purified (Soma), a well-praised shower for the worship of the gods; (pour) a continual shower for our food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ ह्यसि॑ भा॒नुना॑ द्यु॒मन्तं॑ त्वा हवामहे । पव॑मान स्वा॒ध्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ hí ǀ ási ǀ bhānúnā ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ tvā ǀ havāmahe ǀpávamāna ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We who perform good works praise you, purifiedSoma, brilliant with radiance, for you are the showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व सु॒वीर्यं॒ मन्द॑मानः स्वायुध । इ॒हो ष्वि॑न्द॒वा ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ mándamānaḥ ǀ su-āyudha ǀihó íti ǀ sú ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-armed (Soma) who does exhilarate (the gods) pour forth for usmaleoffspring; come,Indu, favourably to our sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॒द्भिः प॑रिषि॒च्यसे॑ मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो॒ गभ॑स्त्योः । द्रुणा॑ स॒धस्थ॑मश्नुषे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ pari-sicyáse ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀdrúṇā ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ aśnuṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When cleansed by thehandsyou are sprinkled with the water, (taken up) with the wooden vessel you attain your abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोमा॑य व्यश्व॒वत्पव॑मानाय गायत । म॒हे स॒हस्र॑चक्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómāya ǀ vyaśva-vát ǀ pávamānāya ǀ gāyata ǀmahé ǀ sahásra-cakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing, asVyaśvadid, to the filteredSomathe great, the all-beholding.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ वर्णं॑ मधु॒श्चुतं॒ हरिं॑ हि॒न्वन्त्यद्रि॑भिः । इन्दु॒मिन्द्रा॑य पी॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ várṇam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ hárim ǀ hinvánti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndum ǀ índrāya ǀ pītáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(ThatSoma) whose juice they squeeze out with the stones, foe-repelling, honey-dropping, green-tinted, forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्य॑ ते वा॒जिनो॑ व॒यं विश्वा॒ धना॑नि जि॒ग्युष॑: । स॒खि॒त्वमा वृ॑णीमहे
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ te ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ víśvā ǀ dhánāni ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀsakhi-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, who have heaped up oblations, solicit his friendship, (the friendship) of you who have won all the riches (of the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ पवस्व॒ धार॑या म॒रुत्व॑ते च मत्स॒रः । विश्वा॒ दधा॑न॒ ओज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ marútvate ǀ ca ǀ matsaráḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow in a stream, you who are the showerer (of benefits); and (be) exhilarating to the lord of theMarutsgranting us all (wealth) by your power.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ ध॒र्तार॑मो॒ण्यो॒३॒॑: पव॑मान स्व॒र्दृश॑म् । हि॒न्वे वाजे॑षु वा॒जिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ dhartā́ram ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śam ǀhinvé ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ vājínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, the supporter of heaven and earth, O purified (Soma), the beholder of heaven, the powerful one, I send forth to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या चि॒त्तो वि॒पानया॒ हरि॑: पवस्व॒ धार॑या । युजं॒ वाजे॑षु चोदय
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ cittáḥ ǀ vipā́ ǀ anáyā ǀ háriḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ dhā́rayā ǀyújam ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expressed by these flexible fingers (of mine), do you who are green-tinted flow forth in a stream; excite (Indra) our ally to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्दो म॒हीमिषं॒ पव॑स्व वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः । अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ सोम गातु॒वित्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀasmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ gātu-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Swift-flowingSoma, who are the illuminator of the universe, pour down upon us abundant food, (and be) to us the revealer to the path (to heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ क॒लशा॑ अनूष॒तेन्दो॒ धारा॑भि॒रोज॑सा । एन्द्र॑स्य पी॒तये॑ विश
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ índo íti ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ pītáye ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, they praise the vessels together with your streams (who are endowed) with strength; enter forIndra's drinking.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ ते॒ मद्यं॒ रसं॑ ती॒व्रं दु॒हन्त्यद्रि॑भिः । स प॑वस्वाभिमाति॒हा
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ mádyam ǀ rásam ǀ tīvrám ǀ duhánti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ abhimāti-hā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you whose, sharp exhilarating juice the priests express with the stones, flow the destroyer of the evil-minded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॑ मे॒धाभि॑रीयते॒ पव॑मानो म॒नावधि॑ । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण॒ यात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jā ǀ medhā́bhiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manáu ǀ ádhi ǀantárikṣeṇa ǀ yā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The king (Soma) purified at the sacrifice is urged by the priests to pass through the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्दो शत॒ग्विनं॒ गवां॒ पोषं॒ स्वश्व्य॑म् । वहा॒ भग॑त्तिमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ śata-gvínam ǀ gávām ǀ póṣam ǀ su-áśvyam ǀváha ǀ bhágattim ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us,Indu, for our protection increase of kine with hundreds, of cattle and a gift of fortune with beautiful horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: सोम॒ सहो॒ जुवो॑ रू॒पं न वर्च॑से भर । सु॒ष्वा॒णो दे॒ववी॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ júvaḥ ǀ rūpám ǀ ná ǀ várcase ǀ bhara ǀsusvānáḥ ǀ devá-vītaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Be) expressed for the banquet of the gods;bestow on us,Soma, strength, speed and a form for brilliance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्षा॑ सोम द्यु॒मत्त॑मो॒ऽभि द्रोणा॑नि॒ रोरु॑वत् । सीद॑ञ्छ्ये॒नो न योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: árṣa ǀ soma ǀ dyumát-tamaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ dróṇāni ǀ róruvat ǀsī́dan ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten,Soma, who are most radiant, with a roar to the wooden vessels; as a hawk flying to its nest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्सा इन्द्रा॑य वा॒यवे॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्य॑: । सोमो॑ अर्षति॒ विष्ण॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: apsā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ váruṇāya ǀ marút-bhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ víṣṇave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the enjoyer of the water, hasten (to vessels) forIndra,Vāyu,Varuṇa, theMarut,Viṣṇu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इषं॑ तो॒काय॑ नो॒ दध॑द॒स्मभ्यं॑ सोम वि॒श्वत॑: । आ प॑वस्व सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: íṣam ǀ tokā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ asmábhyam ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestowing food upon our offspring,Soma, pour from all quarters thousand-fold (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये सोमा॑सः परा॒वति॒ ये अ॑र्वा॒वति॑ सुन्वि॒रे । ये वा॒दः श॑र्य॒णाव॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ parā-váti ǀ yé ǀ arvā-váti ǀ sunviré ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ adáḥ ǀ śaryaṇā́-vati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thoseSomajuices which are effused at a distance of nigh or on this Śaryaṇāvat (lake).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॑र्जी॒केषु॒ कृत्व॑सु॒ ये मध्ये॑ प॒स्त्या॑नाम् । ये वा॒ जने॑षु प॒ञ्चसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ārjīkéṣu ǀ kṛ́tva-su ǀ yé ǀ mádhye ǀ pastyā́nām ǀyé ǀ vā ǀ jáneṣu ǀ pañcá-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Or among the Ṛjikas, or the Kṛtvas, or in the neighbourhood of the riversSarasvatī, or in the five castes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॑ वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वस्परि॒ पव॑न्ता॒मा सु॒वीर्य॑म् । सु॒वा॒ना दे॒वास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ pávantām ǀ ā́ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀsuvānā́ḥ ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those brilliantSoma-juices when expressed pour down upon us from heaven rain withmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑ते हर्य॒तो हरि॑र्गृणा॒नो ज॒मद॑ग्निना । हि॒न्वा॒नो गोरधि॑ त्व॒चि
shlokas.transliteration: pávate ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ jamát-agninā ǀhinvānáḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The delightful green-tintedSoma, praised byJamadagni, urged on the cow-hide flows (to the vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र शु॒क्रासो॑ वयो॒जुवो॑ हिन्वा॒नासो॒ न सप्त॑यः । श्री॒णा॒ना अ॒प्सु मृ॑ञ्जत
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ vayaḥ-júvaḥ ǀ hinvānā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀśrīṇānā́ḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ mṛñjata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brightSoma-juices, the dispensers of food, being mixed with the curds and milk, are cleansed in the waters like horses urged (by the charioteers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ सु॒तेष्वा॒भुवो॑ हिन्वि॒रे दे॒वता॑तये । स प॑वस्वा॒नया॑ रु॒चा
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ sutéṣu ǀ ā-bhúvaḥ ǀ hinviré ǀ devá-tātaye ǀsáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ anáyā ǀ rucā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests who are present send you forth at the rites at which you are effused for the whole of the gods; do you flow with this splendour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॒ दक्षं॑ मयो॒भुवं॒ वह्नि॑म॒द्या वृ॑णीमहे । पान्त॒मा पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ dákṣam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvam ǀ váhnim ǀ adyá ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have recourse today to your strength, the source of happiness, the bearer (of good things), the defender (against foes), the desired of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ म॒न्द्रमा वरे॑ण्य॒मा विप्र॒मा म॑नी॒षिण॑म् । पान्त॒मा पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ mandrám ǀ ā́ ǀ váreṇyam ǀ ā́ ǀ vípram ǀ ā́ ǀ manīṣíṇam ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilarating, the desirable, the wise, the intelligent, the defender (of all), the desired of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ र॒यिमा सु॑चे॒तुन॒मा सु॑क्रतो त॒नूष्वा । पान्त॒मा पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rayím ǀ ā́ ǀ su-cetúnam ǀ ā́ ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀpā́ntam ǀ ā́ ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We have recourse) to your wealth and intelligence for our posterity, O you to whom fair sacrifices are offered, and to you the defender (of all), the desired of many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व विश्वचर्षणे॒ऽभि विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑ । सखा॒ सखि॑भ्य॒ ईड्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀsákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ī́ḍyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-seeing (Soma), who are the adorable friend (of the worshippers), flow for (us your) friends towards all (our) hymns of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ताभ्यां॒ विश्व॑स्य राजसि॒ ये प॑वमान॒ धाम॑नी । प्र॒ती॒ची सो॑म त॒स्थतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́bhyām ǀ víśvasya ǀ rājasi ǀ yé íti ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhā́manī íti ǀpratīcī́ íti ǀ soma ǀ tasthátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, purifiedSoma, rule the universe by those two halves (of thelunar month) which stand facing you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ धामा॑नि॒ यानि॑ ते॒ त्वं सो॑मासि वि॒श्वत॑: । पव॑मान ऋ॒तुभि॑: कवे
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ dhā́māni ǀ yā́ni ǀ te ǀ tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀpávamāna ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ kave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since your splendour abounds, you purified sage,Soma, are everywhere (associated) with the seasons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व ज॒नय॒न्निषो॒ऽभि विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॑ । सखा॒ सखि॑भ्य ऊ॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ janáyan ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀsákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are a friend, do you for the sake of all our desirable (praises) approach genitive rating food for (us your) friends for our support.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ शु॒क्रासो॑ अ॒र्चयो॑ दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठे वि त॑न्वते । प॒वित्रं॑ सोम॒ धाम॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhé ǀ ví ǀ tanvate ǀpavítram ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the shining rays of you who are accompanied by brilliance, spread the purifying (water) over the surface of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवे॒मे स॒प्त सिन्ध॑वः प्र॒शिषं॑ सोम सिस्रते । तुभ्यं॑ धावन्ति धे॒नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ imé ǀ saptá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ pra-śíṣam ǀ soma ǀ sisrate ǀtúbhyam ǀ dhāvanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These your seven rivers flow,Soma, at your command; the kine hasten to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सो॑म याहि॒ धार॑या सु॒त इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रः । दधा॑नो॒ अक्षि॑ति॒ श्रव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ yāhi ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀdádhānaḥ ǀ ákṣiti ǀ śrávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proceed,Soma, in a stream when effused, giving exhilaration toIndra, bestowing (upon us) inexhaustible food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ त्वा धी॒भिर॑स्वरन्हिन्व॒तीः स॒प्त जा॒मय॑: । विप्र॑मा॒जा वि॒वस्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ dhībhíḥ ǀ asvaran ǀ hinvatī́ḥ ǀ saptá ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀvípram ǀ ājā́ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven kindred (priests) uttering (praises) and worshipping (the gods with oblations) invoked you the sage at the sacrifice with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒जन्ति॑ त्वा॒ सम॒ग्रुवोऽव्ये॑ जी॒रावधि॒ ष्वणि॑ । रे॒भो यद॒ज्यसे॒ वने॑
shlokas.transliteration: mṛjánti ǀ tvā ǀ sám ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ ávye ǀ jīráu ǀ ádhi ǀ sváni ǀrebháḥ ǀ yát ǀ ajyáse ǀ váne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fingers cleanse you in the quickly made loud-sounding (woollen) filter, when with a noise you are sprinkled with the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानस्य ते कवे॒ वाजि॒न्त्सर्गा॑ असृक्षत । अर्व॑न्तो॒ न श्र॑व॒स्यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ te ǀ kave ǀ vā́jin ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀárvantaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageSoma, possessor of food, your food-desiring streams when you are filtered are let loose like horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒ कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॒मसृ॑ग्रं॒ वारे॑ अ॒व्यये॑ । अवा॑वशन्त धी॒तय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ ásṛgram ǀ vā́re ǀ avyáye ǀávāvaśanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They are let loose in the woollen filter (to go) towards the honey-dropping vessel; our fingers have desired them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ समु॒द्रमिन्द॒वोऽस्तं॒ गावो॒ न धे॒नव॑: । अग्म॑न्नृ॒तस्य॒ योनि॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ samudrám ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ástam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀágman ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSoma-juices go to the ocean, as kine to their stall; they go the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ण॑ इन्दो म॒हे रण॒ आपो॑ अर्षन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः । यद्गोभि॑र्वासयि॒ष्यसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ mahé ǀ ráṇe ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀyát ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vāsayiṣyáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, the flowing waters hasten to our great sacrifices when you are mixed with the curds and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्य॑ ते स॒ख्ये व॒यमिय॑क्षन्त॒स्त्वोत॑यः । इन्दो॑ सखि॒त्वमु॑श्मसि
shlokas.transliteration: ásya ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ vayám ǀ íyakṣantaḥ ǀ tvā́-ūtayaḥ ǀíndo íti ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ uśmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, we abiding in your friendship, desiring to sacrifice, depending on your protection, desire your friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व॒ गवि॑ष्टये म॒हे सो॑म नृ॒चक्ष॑से । एन्द्र॑स्य ज॒ठरे॑ विश
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ mahé ǀ soma ǀ nṛ-cákṣase ǀā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ jaṭháre ǀ viśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, for the mighty cattle-seeker, the beholder of men, enterIndra's belly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हाँ अ॑सि सोम॒ ज्येष्ठ॑ उ॒ग्राणा॑मिन्द॒ ओजि॑ष्ठः । युध्वा॒ सञ्छश्व॑ज्जिगेथ
shlokas.transliteration: mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ soma ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ ugrā́ṇām ǀ indo íti ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀyúdhvā ǀ sán ǀ śáśvat ǀ jigetha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, you are great, most worthy to be praised;Indu, (you are) the most vigorous of the mighty; engaged in battle you ever triumph.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒ग्रेभ्य॑श्चि॒दोजी॑या॒ञ्छूरे॑भ्यश्चि॒च्छूर॑तरः । भू॒रि॒दाभ्य॑श्चि॒न्मंही॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ugrébhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ ójīyān ǀ śū́rebhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ śū́ra-taraḥ ǀbhūri-dā́bhyaḥ ǀ cit ǀ máṃhīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You) who (are) mightier than the mighty, braver than the brave, more genitive rous than the genitive rous.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑म॒ सूर॒ एष॑स्तो॒कस्य॑ सा॒ता त॒नूना॑म् । वृ॒णी॒महे॑ स॒ख्याय॑ वृणी॒महे॒ युज्या॑य
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ tokásya ǀ sātā́ ǀ tanū́nām ǀvṛṇīmáhe ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ yújyāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, who are a hero (bestow) upon (us) food, (be) the giver of sons (to us); we choose you for your friendship, (we choose you) for your alliance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आयूं॑षि पवस॒ आ सु॒वोर्ज॒मिषं॑ च नः । आ॒रे बा॑धस्व दु॒च्छुना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ pavase ǀ ā́ ǀ suva ǀ ū́rjam ǀ íṣam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀāré ǀ bādhasva ǀ ducchúnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you support our lives, send us nutriment and food, drive far off therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निॠषि॒: पव॑मान॒: पाञ्च॑जन्यः पु॒रोहि॑तः । तमी॑महे महाग॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ pā́ñca-janyaḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀtám ǀ īmahe ǀ mahā-gayám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the all-beholding, who is in the form of thePavamāna, the benefactor of the five orders, the preceder at sacrifice; him we solicit, who is hymned by the great.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ पव॑स्व॒ स्वपा॑ अ॒स्मे वर्च॑: सु॒वीर्य॑म् । दध॑द्र॒यिं मयि॒ पोष॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ pávasva ǀ su-ápāḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ várcaḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀdádhat ǀ rayím ǀ máyi ǀ póṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are the doer of good, pour upon us brightness and fair-offspring; may he make me wealth and plural nty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो॒ अति॒ स्रिधो॒ऽभ्य॑र्षति सुष्टु॒तिम् । सूरो॒ न वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣati ǀ su-stutím ǀsū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (Soma) hastens past the adversaries towards the fair praise of the worshippers, visible to all like the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑र्मृजा॒न आ॒युभि॒: प्रय॑स्वा॒न्प्रय॑से हि॒तः । इन्दु॒रत्यो॑ विचक्ष॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ āyú-bhiḥ ǀ práyasvān ǀ práyase ǀ hitáḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Repeatedly purified by the priests,Indu, abounding with food, plural ced for food, the beholder of all continually goes (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान ऋ॒तं बृ॒हच्छु॒क्रं ज्योति॑रजीजनत् । कृ॒ष्णा तमां॑सि॒ जङ्घ॑नत्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀ śukrám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ajījanat ǀkṛṣṇā́ ǀ támāṃsi ǀ jáṅghanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (Soma) genitive rated the veracious all-pervading bright-shining light, destroying the black darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानस्य॒ जङ्घ्न॑तो॒ हरे॑श्च॒न्द्रा अ॑सृक्षत । जी॒रा अ॑जि॒रशो॑चिषः
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānasya ǀ jáṅghnataḥ ǀ háreḥ ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀjīrā́ḥ ǀ ajirá-śociṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gladsome swift-moving streams of the purified, green-tinted, unfadingly radiant (Soma), the destroyer (of darkness), have been let forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो र॒थीत॑मः शु॒भ्रेभि॑: शु॒भ्रश॑स्तमः । हरि॑श्चन्द्रो म॒रुद्ग॑णः
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ rathí-tamaḥ ǀ śubhrébhiḥ ǀ śubhráśaḥ-tamaḥ ǀhári-candraḥ ǀ marút-gaṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (Soma) possessing many chariots, most radiant with beauteous splendours, having green-tinted streams, attended by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो॒ व्य॑श्नवद्र॒श्मिभि॑र्वाज॒सात॑मः । दध॑त्स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ aśnavat ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ vāja-sā́tamaḥ ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the purifiedSoma, the most liberal dispenser of food, pervade (the world) with his rays, granting excellentmaleoffspring to the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑वा॒न इन्दु॑रक्षाः प॒वित्र॒मत्य॒व्यय॑म् । पु॒ना॒न इन्दु॒रिन्द्र॒मा
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ avyáyam ǀpunānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índram ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induwhen effused drops through the fleecy filter (into the vessel); being filtered Indu (enters) intoIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष सोमो॒ अधि॑ त्व॒चि गवां॑ क्रीळ॒त्यद्रि॑भिः । इन्द्रं॒ मदा॑य॒ जोहु॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ gávām ǀ krīḷati ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀíndram ǀ mádāya ǀ jóhuvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomasports with the stones upon the cowhide, callingIndrafor exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ ते द्यु॒म्नव॒त्पय॒: पव॑मा॒नाभृ॑तं दि॒वः । तेन॑ नो मृळ जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ dyumná-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ ā́-bhṛtam ǀ diváḥ ǀténa ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛḷa ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified (Soma),bless us with long life by means of that your nutritious milk which has been brought from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सो॑मासि धार॒युर्म॒न्द्र ओजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रे । पव॑स्व मंह॒यद्र॑यिः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ soma ǀ asi ǀ dhārayúḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀpávasva ǀ maṃhayát-rayiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, who are most exhilarating, most powerful, are disposed to shed your stream at our sacrifice; flow then you who are the giver or riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सु॒तो नृ॒माद॑नो दध॒न्वान्म॑त्स॒रिन्त॑मः । इन्द्रा॑य सू॒रिरन्ध॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ sutáḥ ǀ nṛ-mā́danaḥ ǀ dadhanvā́n ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ sūríḥ ǀ ándhasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who are the exhilarator o fthe priests, bestowing (wealth upon them) and intelligent, do you when effused together with food be the especial cause of exhilaration toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सु॑ष्वा॒णो अद्रि॑भिर॒भ्य॑र्ष॒ कनि॑क्रदत् । द्यु॒मन्तं॒ शुष्म॑मुत्त॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ susvānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ kánikradat ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ut-tamám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you when effused by the stones proceed resounding (to the vessel); (grant) bright excellent strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑र्हिन्वा॒नो अ॑र्षति ति॒रो वारा॑ण्य॒व्यया॑ । हरि॒र्वाज॑मचिक्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀháriḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ acikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indueffused (by the stones) passes through the woollen filter; green-tinted he roars forth food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दो॒ व्यव्य॑मर्षसि॒ वि श्रवां॑सि॒ वि सौभ॑गा । वि वाजा॑न्त्सोम॒ गोम॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: índo íti ǀ ví ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣasi ǀ ví ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ví ǀ sáubhagā ǀví ǀ vā́jān ǀ soma ǀ gó-mataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, you have flowed through the fleece, you grant us food and wealth; (therefore grant us),Soma, strength of flocks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्दो शत॒ग्विनं॑ र॒यिं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । भरा॑ सोम सह॒स्रिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ śata-gvínam ǀ rayím ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀbhára ǀ soma ǀ sahasríṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu,Soma, bring us thousand-fold wealth, consisting of hundreds of cows, having excellent cows and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानास॒ इन्द॑वस्ति॒रः प॒वित्र॑मा॒शव॑: । इन्द्रं॒ यामे॑भिराशत
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀíndram ǀ yā́mebhiḥ ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified swift-flowingSoma-juices passing hrough the filter reachIndraby their own paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒कु॒हः सो॒म्यो रस॒ इन्दु॒रिन्द्रा॑य पू॒र्व्यः । आ॒युः प॑वत आ॒यवे॑
shlokas.transliteration: kakuháḥ ǀ somyáḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀāyúḥ ǀ pavate ǀ āyáve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The excellent juice of theSomadropping (into the vessels) poured forth by men of old, the goer (toIndra), is filtered for Indra the goer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒न्वन्ति॒ सूर॒मुस्र॑य॒: पव॑मानं मधु॒श्चुत॑म् । अ॒भि गि॒रा सम॑स्वरन्
shlokas.transliteration: hinvánti ǀ sū́ram ǀ úsrayaḥ ǀ pávamānam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀabhí ǀ girā́ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fingers express the purified honey-dropping heroicSoma; (the worshippers) hail him with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒वि॒ता नो॑ अ॒जाश्व॑: पू॒षा याम॑नियामनि । आ भ॑क्षत्क॒न्या॑सु नः
shlokas.transliteration: avitā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ajá-aśvaḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ yā́mani-yāmani ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the goat-bornePūṣanin all his paths be our protector; may he bestow maidens on us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सोम॑: कप॒र्दिने॑ घृ॒तं न प॑वते॒ मधु॑ । आ भ॑क्षत्क॒न्या॑सु नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kapardíne ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pavate ǀ mádhu ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomaflows toPūṣan, who wears a beautiful tiara like exhilarating ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं त॑ आघृणे सु॒तो घृ॒तं न प॑वते॒ शुचि॑ । आ भ॑क्षत्क॒न्या॑सु नः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ te ǀ āghṛṇe ǀ sutáḥ ǀ ghṛtám ǀ ná ǀ pavate ǀ śúci ǀā́ ǀ bhakṣat ǀ kanyā́su ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomapoured for you, shining (Pūṣan) flows like pure ghī; may he bestow maidens on us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒चो ज॒न्तुः क॑वी॒नां पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या । दे॒वेषु॑ रत्न॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: vācáḥ ǀ jantúḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀdevéṣu ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ asi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, genitive rator of the praises of the wise, flow in a stream; you are the dispenser of treasure among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ क॒लशे॑षु धावति श्ये॒नो वर्म॒ वि गा॑हते । अ॒भि द्रोणा॒ कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ dhāvati ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ várma ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǀabhí ǀ dróṇā ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has flowed to the vessels as a falcon enters its nest and enters the wooden (vessels) with a cry.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ प्र सो॑म ते॒ रसोऽस॑र्जि क॒लशे॑ सु॒तः । श्ये॒नो न त॒क्तो अ॑र्षति
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ soma ǀ te ǀ rásaḥ ǀ ásarji ǀ kaláśe ǀ sutáḥ ǀśyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ taktáḥ ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your juice,Soma, spreads around when effused into the vessel as a swift falcon rushes along.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम म॒न्दय॒न्निन्द्रा॑य॒ मधु॑मत्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ mandáyan ǀ índrāya ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, who are most sweet-flavoured, giving exhilaration toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असृ॑ग्रन्दे॒ववी॑तये वाज॒यन्तो॒ रथा॑ इव
shlokas.transliteration: ásṛgran ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vāja-yántaḥ ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheSoma-juices) are let loose for the banquet of the gods like chariots desiring the wealth (of the enemy).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते सु॒तासो॑ म॒दिन्त॑माः शु॒क्रा वा॒युम॑सृक्षत
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ madín-tamāḥ ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ asṛkṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These effused (Soma-juices), brilliant and extremely exhilarating, are let forth forVāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्राव्णा॑ तु॒न्नो अ॒भिष्टु॑तः प॒वित्रं॑ सोम गच्छसि । दध॑त्स्तो॒त्रे सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: grā́vṇā ǀ tunnáḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ soma ǀ gacchasi ǀdádhat ǀ stotré ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bruised with the stones and effused (by the worshippers), you,Soma; enter the filter, bestowing upon your praiser (wealth), accompanied with excellentmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष तु॒न्नो अ॒भिष्टु॑तः प॒वित्र॒मति॑ गाहते । र॒क्षो॒हा वार॑म॒व्यय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ tunnáḥ ǀ abhí-stutaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ gāhate ǀrakṣaḥ-hā́ ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǁ
