shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma), bruised (with the stones), and praised by (all), the slayer ofrākṣasas, plural nge through the woollen filter (into the vessel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदन्ति॒ यच्च॑ दूर॒के भ॒यं वि॒न्दति॒ मामि॒ह । पव॑मान॒ वि तज्ज॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ánti ǀ yát ǀ ca ǀ dūraké ǀ bhayám ǀ vindáti ǀ mā́m ǀ ihá ǀpávamāna ǀ ví ǀ tát ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whatever fear seizes me, near, afar off, or here, purified (Soma) dispel that (fear).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒: सो अ॒द्य न॑: प॒वित्रे॑ण॒ विच॑र्षणिः । यः पो॒ता स पु॑नातु नः
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ adyá ǀ naḥ ǀ pavítreṇa ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ potā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ punātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that purifiedSoma, the beholder of all, who is the purifier, purify us now by his purifying (might).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ प॒वित्र॑म॒र्चिष्यग्ने॒ वित॑तम॒न्तरा । ब्रह्म॒ तेन॑ पुनीहि नः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ arcíṣi ǀ ágne ǀ ví-tatam ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀbráhma ǀ téna ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify,Agni, our divine (body) with your purifying (light), which is diffused in the midst of the light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ प॒वित्र॑मर्चि॒वदग्ने॒ तेन॑ पुनीहि नः । ब्र॒ह्म॒स॒वैः पु॑नीहि नः
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ pavítram ǀ arci-vát ǀ ágne ǀ téna ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǀbrahma-saváiḥ ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify us,Agni, with your purifying (light) which possesses the light; purify us with the effusion of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भाभ्यां॑ देव सवितः प॒वित्रे॑ण स॒वेन॑ च । मां पु॑नीहि वि॒श्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ubhā́bhyām ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ pavítreṇa ǀ savéna ǀ ca ǀmā́m ǀ punīhi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shining (Soma), urger of all things, purify me by both, by your purifying (light) and by the effusion (of the Soma); purify me in every way”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रि॒भिष्ट्वं दे॑व सवित॒र्वर्षि॑ष्ठैः सोम॒ धाम॑भिः । अग्ने॒ दक्षै॑: पुनीहि नः
shlokas.transliteration: tri-bhíḥ ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ savitaḥ ǀ várṣiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀágne ǀ dákṣaiḥ ǀ punīhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify us, shiningAgniPavamāna, urger of all things, with your three most mighty powerful forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒नन्तु॒ मां दे॑वज॒नाः पु॒नन्तु॒ वस॑वो धि॒या । विश्वे॑ देवाः पुनी॒त मा॒ जात॑वेदः पुनी॒हि मा॑
shlokas.transliteration: punántu ǀ mā́m ǀ deva-janā́ḥ ǀ punántu ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀvíśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ punītá ǀ mā ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ punīhí ǀ mā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the worshippers purify me, may theVasuspurify (me) by their acts; purify me, all you gods, (Agni) the intelligent purify me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र प्या॑यस्व॒ प्र स्य॑न्दस्व॒ सोम॒ विश्वे॑भिरं॒शुभि॑: । दे॒वेभ्य॑ उत्त॒मं ह॒विः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ pyāyasva ǀ prá ǀ syandasva ǀ sóma ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ aṃśú-bhiḥ ǀdevébhyaḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǀ havíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, nourish (us), pour forth for the gods with all your juices the most excellent oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ प्रि॒यं पनि॑प्नतं॒ युवा॑नमाहुती॒वृध॑म् । अग॑न्म॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ नम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ priyám ǀ pánipnatam ǀ yúvānam ǀ āhuti-vṛ́dham ǀáganma ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ námaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us approach bearing the beloved loud-sounding youthful oblation fostered by our offerings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒लाय्य॑स्य पर॒शुर्न॑नाश॒ तमा प॑वस्व देव सोम । आ॒खुं चि॑दे॒व दे॑व सोम
shlokas.transliteration: alā́yyasya ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ nanāśa ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀākhúm ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the battle-axe of the foe destroy the foe; alone flow tous, brightSoma; (slay) the villain only, bright Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः पा॑वमा॒नीर॒ध्येत्यृषि॑भि॒: सम्भृ॑तं॒ रस॑म् । सर्वं॒ स पू॒तम॑श्नाति स्वदि॒तं मा॑त॒रिश्व॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pāvamānī́ḥ ǀ adhi-éti ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ rásam ǀsárvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ pūtám ǀ aśnāti ǀ svaditám ǀ mātaríśvanā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who reads the hymns toPavamāna, the essence (of theVeda) collected by the ṛṣis, enjoys all (his food) purified, sweetened byMātariśvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒व॒मा॒नीर्यो अ॒ध्येत्यृषि॑भि॒: सम्भृ॑तं॒ रस॑म् । तस्मै॒ सर॑स्वती दुहे क्षी॒रं स॒र्पिर्मधू॑द॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: pāvamānī́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ adhi-éti ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sám-bhṛtam ǀ rásam ǀtásmai ǀ sárasvatī ǀ duhe ǀ kṣīrám ǀ sarpíḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ udakám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For him who reads the hymns toPavamāna, the essence (of theVeda) collected by the ṛṣis,Sarasvatīmilks milk,gheeand exhilaratingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र दे॒वमच्छा॒ मधु॑मन्त॒ इन्द॒वोऽसि॑ष्यदन्त॒ गाव॒ आ न धे॒नव॑: । ब॒र्हि॒षदो॑ वच॒नाव॑न्त॒ ऊध॑भिः परि॒स्रुत॑मु॒स्रिया॑ नि॒र्णिजं॑ धिरे
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ devám ǀ áccha ǀ mádhu-mantaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ ásisyadanta ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀbarhi-sádaḥ ǀ vacanā́-vantaḥ ǀ ū́dha-bhiḥ ǀ pari-srútam ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ dhire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilaratingSoma-juices flow towards the shining (Indra), as kine (have to their calves); the lowing kine sitting on thebarhisgrass hold in their udders the pure (juice) welling up.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रोरु॑वद॒भि पूर्वा॑ अचिक्रददुपा॒रुह॑: श्र॒थय॑न्त्स्वादते॒ हरि॑: । ति॒रः प॒वित्रं॑ परि॒यन्नु॒रु ज्रयो॒ नि शर्या॑णि दधते दे॒व आ वर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ róruvat ǀ abhí ǀ pū́rvāḥ ǀ acikradat ǀ upa-ārúhaḥ ǀ śratháyan ǀ svādate ǀ háriḥ ǀtiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ pari-yán ǀ urú ǀ jráyaḥ ǀ ní ǀ śáryāṇi ǀ dadhate ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He with a noise re-echoes the principal (praises), separating the growing herbs, the green-tinted (Soma) sweetens them; passing through the filter, (he exerts) great speed, he annihilates therākṣasas, the shining (Soma) bestows wealth (upon the worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यो म॒मे य॒म्या॑ संय॒ती मद॑: साकं॒वृधा॒ पय॑सा पिन्व॒दक्षि॑ता । म॒ही अ॑पा॒रे रज॑सी वि॒वेवि॑ददभि॒व्रज॒न्नक्षि॑तं॒ पाज॒ आ द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ mamé ǀ yamyā́ ǀ saṃyatī́ íti sam-yatī́ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sākam-vṛ́dhā ǀ páyasā ǀ pinvat ǀ ákṣitā ǀmahī́ íti ǀ apāré íti ǀ rájasī íti ǀ vi-vévidat ǀ abhi-vrájan ǀ ákṣitam ǀ pā́jaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilarating (Soma) who constructed the twin united (heaven and earth) does by means of his juice maintain them growing together, imperishable; he has distinguished these two great unbounded worlds, wandering everywhere, he has assumed imperishable strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मा॒तरा॑ वि॒चर॑न्वा॒जय॑न्न॒पः प्र मेधि॑रः स्व॒धया॑ पिन्वते प॒दम् । अं॒शुर्यवे॑न पिपिशे य॒तो नृभि॒: सं जा॒मिभि॒र्नस॑ते॒ रक्ष॑ते॒ शिर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ vi-cáran ǀ vājáyan ǀ apáḥ ǀ prá ǀ médhiraḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ pinvate ǀ padám ǀaṃśúḥ ǀ yávena ǀ pipiśe ǀ yatáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǀ násate ǀ rákṣate ǀ śíraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (Soma) wandering through the two worlds, sending forth the waters, flattens his station with food; the Soma-juice collected by the priests is mixed with the barley; it is united by the fingers; it protects the head.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं दक्षे॑ण॒ मन॑सा जायते क॒विॠ॒तस्य॒ गर्भो॒ निहि॑तो य॒मा प॒रः । यूना॑ ह॒ सन्ता॑ प्रथ॒मं वि ज॑ज्ञतु॒र्गुहा॑ हि॒तं जनि॑म॒ नेम॒मुद्य॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ dákṣeṇa ǀ mánasā ǀ jāyate ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ yamā́ ǀ paráḥ ǀyū́nā ǀ ha ǀ sántā ǀ prathamám ǀ ví ǀ jajñatuḥ ǀ gúhā ǀ hitám ǀ jánima ǀ némam ǀ út-yatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage (Soma) is born with developed mind; having his plural ce in the womb of the water, he is deposited (by the gods) by rule from far off; even when young these two were distinct; the birth (of one half) was plural ced in secret, the (other) half was visible.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रस्य॑ रू॒पं वि॑विदुर्मनी॒षिण॑: श्ये॒नो यदन्धो॒ अभ॑रत्परा॒वत॑: । तं म॑र्जयन्त सु॒वृधं॑ न॒दीष्वाँ उ॒शन्त॑मं॒शुं प॑रि॒यन्त॑मृ॒ग्मिय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: mandrásya ǀ rūpám ǀ vividuḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ yát ǀ ándhaḥ ǀ ábharat ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀtám ǀ marjayanta ǀ su-vṛ́dham ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ uśántam ǀ aṃśúm ǀ pari-yántam ǀ ṛgmíyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise (worshippers) know the form of the exhilaratingSoma-juice, the food that the falcon brought from afar; they cleanse in the waters the fostering (Soma) delighting (the gods), flowing around, and deserving laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां मृ॑जन्ति॒ दश॒ योष॑णः सु॒तं सोम॒ ऋषि॑भिर्म॒तिभि॑र्धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तम् । अव्यो॒ वारे॑भिरु॒त दे॒वहू॑तिभि॒र्नृभि॑र्य॒तो वाज॒मा द॑र्षि सा॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ mṛjanti ǀ dáśa ǀ yóṣaṇaḥ ǀ sutám ǀ sóma ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitám ǀávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ deváhūti-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ā́ ǀ darṣi ǀ sātáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers cleanse you,Soma, when effused and plural ced in the vessels by the ṛṣis, with praises, religious rites and woollen filters; and collected by the priests with oblations to the gods you bestow food (upon the worshippers) for a gift.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रि॒प्र॒यन्तं॑ व॒य्यं॑ सुषं॒सदं॒ सोमं॑ मनी॒षा अ॒भ्य॑नूषत॒ स्तुभ॑: । यो धार॑या॒ मधु॑माँ ऊ॒र्मिणा॑ दि॒व इय॑र्ति॒ वाचं॑ रयि॒षाळम॑र्त्यः
shlokas.transliteration: pari-prayántam ǀ vayyám ǀ su-saṃsádam ǀ sómam ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ stúbhaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ diváḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ rayiṣā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Intelligent praises celebrate the wide-flowing (god) delightingSomawho sits in good company, who exhilarating (falls) in a stream with his water from the sky (and) wealth-conquering, immortal, sends out his voice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं दि॒व इ॑यर्ति॒ विश्व॒मा रज॒: सोम॑: पुना॒नः क॒लशे॑षु सीदति । अ॒द्भिर्गोभि॑र्मृज्यते॒ अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः पु॑ना॒न इन्दु॒र्वरि॑वो विदत्प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ diváḥ ǀ iyarti ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ sīdati ǀat-bhíḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ vidat ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomasends from heaven all water; bring filtered he settles in the vessels; effused with the stones, he is cleansed with water and milk; the filteredIndubestow delightful wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑: सोम परिषि॒च्यमा॑नो॒ वयो॒ दध॑च्चि॒त्रत॑मं पवस्व । अ॒द्वे॒षे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी हु॑वेम॒ देवा॑ ध॒त्त र॒यिम॒स्मे सु॒वीर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dádhat ǀ citrá-tamam ǀ pavasva ǀadveṣé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ huvema ǀ dévāḥ ǀ dhattá ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somaoffering (wealth) as soon as you are sprinkled (with the water and milk), pour various kinds of food (upon us); let us invoke the friendly heaven and earth; do you, O gods, grant us wealth with excellentmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इषु॒र्न धन्व॒न्प्रति॑ धीयते म॒तिर्व॒त्सो न मा॒तुरुप॑ स॒र्ज्यूध॑नि । उ॒रुधा॑रेव दुहे॒ अग्र॑ आय॒त्यस्य॑ व्र॒तेष्वपि॒ सोम॑ इष्यते
shlokas.transliteration: íṣuḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhánvan ǀ práti ǀ dhīyate ǀ matíḥ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sarji ǀ ū́dhani ǀurúdhārā-iva ǀ duhe ǀ ágre ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ ásya ǀ vratéṣu ǀ ápi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ iṣyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Our) praise is attached (toIndra) as an arrow to the bow; (theSoma-juice) is let loose to (Indra) the fosterer as a calf to the udder to its mother; (Indra sheds blessings) as a cow having a copious stream of milk yields it when coming into the presence (of the calf); in Indra's sacrifices the Soma is stimulated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उपो॑ म॒तिः पृ॒च्यते॑ सि॒च्यते॒ मधु॑ म॒न्द्राज॑नी चोदते अ॒न्तरा॒सनि॑ । पव॑मानः संत॒निः प्र॑घ्न॒तामि॑व॒ मधु॑मान्द्र॒प्सः परि॒ वार॑मर्षति
shlokas.transliteration: úpo íti ǀ matíḥ ǀ pṛcyáte ǀ sicyáte ǀ mádhu ǀ mandra-ájanī ǀ codate ǀ antáḥ ǀ āsáni ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sam-taníḥ ǀ praghnatā́m-iva ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́ram ǀ arṣati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The praise is united (toIndra); the excellent (Soma) is sprinkled; (the Soma stream) emitting plural asant juice is driven into (Indra's) mouth; the filtered diffused exhilarating swift-flowing (Soma) hastens to the fleece like the arrow of the combatants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्ये॑ वधू॒युः प॑वते॒ परि॑ त्व॒चि श्र॑थ्नी॒ते न॒प्तीरदि॑तेॠ॒तं य॒ते । हरि॑रक्रान्यज॒तः सं॑य॒तो मदो॑ नृ॒म्णा शिशा॑नो महि॒षो न शो॑भते
shlokas.transliteration: ávye ǀ vadhū-yúḥ ǀ pavate ǀ pári ǀ tvací ǀ śrathnīté ǀ naptī́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ yaté ǀháriḥ ǀ akrān ǀ yajatáḥ ǀ sam-yatáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śobhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) seeking his spouse is filtered in the sheep-skin; he separates his grand-daughter on the earth for the sacrificer; green-tinted, adorable, collected (in the ladles), exhilarating, he overcomes (his foes); sharpening his vigour he shines like one of might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षा मि॑माति॒ प्रति॑ यन्ति धे॒नवो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ दे॒वीरुप॑ यन्ति निष्कृ॒तम् । अत्य॑क्रमी॒दर्जु॑नं॒ वार॑म॒व्यय॒मत्कं॒ न नि॒क्तं परि॒ सोमो॑ अव्यत
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣā́ ǀ mimāti ǀ práti ǀ yanti ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ devásya ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ úpa ǀ yanti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀáti ǀ akramīt ǀ árjunam ǀ vā́ram ǀ avyáyam ǀ átkam ǀ ná ǀ niktám ǀ pári ǀ sómaḥ ǀ avyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bull lows, the cows flow around him; the divine (praises) gather round the station of the radiant (Soma); Soma passes through the white sheep-skin; he clothes himself with it as it were a burnished armouṛ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अमृ॑क्तेन॒ रुश॑ता॒ वास॑सा॒ हरि॒रम॑र्त्यो निर्णिजा॒नः परि॑ व्यत । दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठं ब॒र्हणा॑ नि॒र्णिजे॑ कृतोप॒स्तर॑णं च॒म्वो॑र्नभ॒स्मय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ámṛktena ǀ rúśatā ǀ vā́sasā ǀ háriḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ niḥ-nijānáḥ ǀ pári ǀ vyata ǀdiváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ barháṇā ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ kṛta ǀ upa-stáraṇam ǀ camvóḥ ǀ nabhasmáyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortal green-tintedSomawhen purified is arranged in an uncleaned shining vestment; he ahs created (Āditya) who stands on the back of the sky for the destruction (of sin) and purification, (and has created) Āditya's brilliance, the cover of the two worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्य॑स्येव र॒श्मयो॑ द्रावयि॒त्नवो॑ मत्स॒रास॑: प्र॒सुप॑: सा॒कमी॑रते । तन्तुं॑ त॒तं परि॒ सर्गा॑स आ॒शवो॒ नेन्द्रा॑दृ॒ते प॑वते॒ धाम॒ किं च॒न
shlokas.transliteration: sū́ryasya-iva ǀ raśmáyaḥ ǀ dravayitnávaḥ ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ pra-súpaḥ ǀ sākám ǀ īrate ǀtántum ǀ tatám ǀ pári ǀ sárgāsaḥ ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ índrāt ǀ ṛté ǀ pavate ǀ dhā́ma ǀ kím ǀ caná ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rushing exhilarating foe-slayingSoma-juices when let loose flow together round the extended cloth like the sun's rays; they flow to no other person n exceptIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिन्धो॑रिव प्रव॒णे नि॒म्न आ॒शवो॒ वृष॑च्युता॒ मदा॑सो गा॒तुमा॑शत । शं नो॑ निवे॒शे द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे॒ऽस्मे वाजा॑: सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: síndhoḥ-iva ǀ pravaṇé ǀ nimné ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-cyutāḥ ǀ mádāsaḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ āśata ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ ni-veśé ǀ dvi-páde ǀ cátuḥ-pade ǀ asmé íti ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀ soma ǀ tiṣṭhantu ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The exhilarating (Soma-juices) poured forth by the sprinklers effect their way toIndraas in a waterfall of a river the percvading (waters find their way) to dry ground; bless on our return our two-footed and four-footed things; may food and offspring ever abide with us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: पवस्व॒ वसु॑म॒द्धिर॑ण्यव॒दश्वा॑व॒द्गोम॒द्यव॑मत्सु॒वीर्य॑म् । यू॒यं हि सो॑म पि॒तरो॒ मम॒ स्थन॑ दि॒वो मू॒र्धान॒: प्रस्थि॑ता वय॒स्कृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vásu-mat ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀ áśva-vat ǀ gó-mat ǀ yáva-mat ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀyūyám ǀ hí ǀ soma ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ máma ǀ sthána ǀ diváḥ ǀ mūrdhā́naḥ ǀ prá-sthitāḥ ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour upon us (wealth) comprising treasure, gold, horses, cattle, barley, and excellentmaleoffspring; you,Somaare my progenitors, the chiefs of heaven, plural ced (for sacrificial), the offerers of oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॒: पव॑मानास॒ इन्द्रं॒ रथा॑ इव॒ प्र य॑युः सा॒तिमच्छ॑ । सु॒ताः प॒वित्र॒मति॑ य॒न्त्यव्यं॑ हि॒त्वी व॒व्रिं ह॒रितो॑ वृ॒ष्टिमच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀ ráthāḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ yayuḥ ǀ sātím ǀ áccha ǀsutā́ḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ yanti ǀ ávyam ǀ hitvī́ ǀ vavrím ǀ harítaḥ ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These filteredSoma-juices advance toIndraworthy of honour, as (Indra's) chariots advance to battle; expressed (with the stones) they pass through the woollen filter, casting off infirmity the horses go towards the rain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द॒विन्द्रा॑य बृह॒ते प॑वस्व सुमृळी॒को अ॑नव॒द्यो रि॒शादा॑: । भरा॑ च॒न्द्राणि॑ गृण॒ते वसू॑नि दे॒वैर्द्या॑वापृथिवी॒ प्राव॑तं नः
shlokas.transliteration: índo íti ǀ índrāya ǀ bṛhaté ǀ pavasva ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ anavadyáḥ ǀ riśā́dāḥ ǀbhára ǀ candrā́ṇi ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ vásūni ǀ deváiḥ ǀ dyāvāpṛthivī íti ǀ prá ǀ avatam ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, who do make (men) very happy, the blameless one, the destroyer of foes, flow for mightyIndra; bring to (me) your worshipper gratifying riches; heaven and earth, protect us with auspicious (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिर॑स्मै स॒प्त धे॒नवो॑ दुदुह्रे स॒त्यामा॒शिरं॑ पू॒र्व्ये व्यो॑मनि । च॒त्वार्य॒न्या भुव॑नानि नि॒र्णिजे॒ चारू॑णि चक्रे॒ यदृ॒तैरव॑र्धत
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ asmai ǀ saptá ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ duduhre ǀ satyā́m ǀ ā-śíram ǀ pūrvyé ǀ ví-omani ǀcatvā́ri ǀ anyā́ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ cā́rūṇi ǀ cakre ǀ yát ǀ ṛtáiḥ ǀ ávardhata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For him in the ancient sacrifice thrice seven kine milk forth the right mixture; he makes four other beautiful waters for purification when he is nourished with the sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स भिक्ष॑माणो अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ चारु॑ण उ॒भे द्यावा॒ काव्ये॑ना॒ वि श॑श्रथे । तेजि॑ष्ठा अ॒पो मं॒हना॒ परि॑ व्यत॒ यदी॑ दे॒वस्य॒ श्रव॑सा॒ सदो॑ वि॒दुः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ bhíkṣamāṇaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ dyā́vā ǀ kā́vyena ǀ ví ǀ śaśrathe ǀtéjiṣṭhāḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ maṃhánā ǀ pári ǀ vyata ǀ yádi ǀ devásya ǀ śrávasā ǀ sádaḥ ǀ vidúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He being solicited for auspicious ambrosia opens both heaven and earth by his intelligence, he covers the lustrious waters with his greatness, when (the priests) with the oblation recognize the station of the radiant (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते अ॑स्य सन्तु के॒तवोऽमृ॑त्य॒वोऽदा॑भ्यासो ज॒नुषी॑ उ॒भे अनु॑ । येभि॑र्नृ॒म्णा च॑ दे॒व्या॑ च पुन॒त आदिद्राजा॑नं म॒नना॑ अगृभ्णत
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ asya ǀ santu ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ ámṛtyavaḥ ǀ ádābhyāsaḥ ǀ janúṣī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ánu ǀyébhiḥ ǀ nṛmṇā́ ǀ ca ǀ devyā́ ǀ ca ǀ punaté ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ rā́jānam ǀ manánāḥ ǀ agṛbhṇata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those his immortal, inviolable rays protect both classes of beings, wherewith he stimulates human (strength) and divine (food); thereupon praises reach the royal (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो द॒शभि॑: सु॒कर्म॑भि॒: प्र म॑ध्य॒मासु॑ मा॒तृषु॑ प्र॒मे सचा॑ । व्र॒तानि॑ पा॒नो अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ चारु॑ण उ॒भे नृ॒चक्षा॒ अनु॑ पश्यते॒ विशौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ madhyamā́su ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ pra-mé ǀ sácā ǀvratā́ni ǀ pānáḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ paśyate ǀ víśau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cleansed by the ten well-working (fingers), the companion (of the waters) stands among the midmost mothers to measure (the worlds); the beholder of men protecting sacred rites (for the sake) of auspicious ambrosia looks after both races.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑र्मृजा॒न इ॑न्द्रि॒याय॒ धाय॑स॒ ओभे अ॒न्ता रोद॑सी हर्षते हि॒तः । वृषा॒ शुष्मे॑ण बाधते॒ वि दु॑र्म॒तीरा॒देदि॑शानः शर्य॒हेव॑ शु॒रुध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ indriyā́ya ǀ dhā́yase ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ antáríti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ harṣate ǀ hitáḥ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ śúṣmeṇa ǀ bādhate ǀ ví ǀ duḥ-matī́ḥ ǀ ādédiśānaḥ ǀ śaryahā́-iva ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being filtered forIndra's world-supporting strength, stationed in the midst of both worlds he goes (everywhere); the showerer destroys the evil-minded by his vigour, challenging theasuraslike an archer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मा॒तरा॒ न ददृ॑शान उ॒स्रियो॒ नान॑ददेति म॒रुता॑मिव स्व॒नः । जा॒नन्नृ॒तं प्र॑थ॒मं यत्स्व॑र्णरं॒ प्रश॑स्तये॒ कम॑वृणीत सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ ná ǀ dádṛśānaḥ ǀ usríyaḥ ǀ nā́nadat ǀ eti ǀ marútām-iva ǀ svanáḥ ǀjānán ǀ ṛtám ǀ prathamám ǀ yát ǀ sváḥ-naram ǀ prá-śastaye ǀ kám ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He repeatedly beholding his parents (heaven and earth) proceeds with a loud noise, like cows (looking at their calves and lowing), and with a roar (like the troop) ofMaruts; knowing that water to be the best which is good for all men, the intelligent (pavamāna) chose man to be the offerer of his praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रु॒वति॑ भी॒मो वृ॑ष॒भस्त॑वि॒ष्यया॒ शृङ्गे॒ शिशा॑नो॒ हरि॑णी विचक्ष॒णः । आ योनिं॒ सोम॒: सुकृ॑तं॒ नि षी॑दति ग॒व्ययी॒ त्वग्भ॑वति नि॒र्णिग॒व्ययी॑
shlokas.transliteration: ruváti ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ taviṣyáyā ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ háriṇī íti ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ ní ǀ sīdati ǀ gavyáyī ǀ tvák ǀ bhavati ǀ niḥ-ník ǀ avyáyī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The formidable showerer, the contemplator of all through desire for strength roars, sharpening his green-tinted horns; theSomasettles on his well-prepared station; the cowhide is his cleanser and the sheep-skin (too).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शुचि॑: पुना॒नस्त॒न्व॑मरे॒पस॒मव्ये॒ हरि॒र्न्य॑धाविष्ट॒ सान॑वि । जुष्टो॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय वा॒यवे॑ त्रि॒धातु॒ मधु॑ क्रियते सु॒कर्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: śúciḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ arepásam ǀ ávye ǀ háriḥ ǀ ní ǀ adhāviṣṭa ǀ sā́navi ǀjúṣṭaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ mádhu ǀ kriyate ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brilliant cleansing his sinless body, the green-tinted (Soma) is plural ced on the high-plural ced fleece; sufficient forMitra,Varuṇa, andVāyuthe exhilarating (Soma) mixed with the three ingredients is prepared by the performers of good rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम दे॒ववी॑तये॒ वृषेन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्दि॑ सोम॒धान॒मा वि॑श । पु॒रा नो॑ बा॒धाद्दु॑रि॒ताति॑ पारय क्षेत्र॒विद्धि दिश॒ आहा॑ विपृच्छ॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ índrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀpurā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bādhā́t ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ áti ǀ pāraya ǀ kṣetra-vít ǀ hí ǀ díśaḥ ǀ ā́ha ǀ vi-pṛcchaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FlowSoma, the showerer, for the banquet for the gods; enter the Soma-vessel dear toIndra; bring us safe past the hostile (rākṣasas) before the oppress us; for he who knows the country tells the direction to him who asks (the way).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒तो न सप्ति॑र॒भि वाज॑म॒र्षेन्द्र॑स्येन्दो ज॒ठर॒मा प॑वस्व । ना॒वा न सिन्धु॒मति॑ पर्षि वि॒द्वाञ्छूरो॒ न युध्य॒न्नव॑ नो नि॒दः स्प॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hitáḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣa ǀ índrasya ǀ indo íti ǀ jaṭháram ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀnāvā́ ǀ ná ǀ síndhum ǀ áti ǀ parṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ yúdhyan ǀ áva ǀ naḥ ǀ nidáḥ ǀ sparíti spaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten (to the vessel) as a horse when urged (hastens) to the battle; flowInduintoIndra's belly; all knowing (Soma) bear us (safe) across, as (boatmen bear people) across a river in a boat; fighting like a hero, defend us from the reviling (of the foe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दक्षि॑णा सृज्यते शु॒ष्म्या॒३॒॑सदं॒ वेति॑ द्रु॒हो र॒क्षस॑: पाति॒ जागृ॑विः । हरि॑रोप॒शं कृ॑णुते॒ नभ॒स्पय॑ उप॒स्तिरे॑ च॒म्वो॒३॒॑र्ब्रह्म॑ नि॒र्णिजे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ sṛjyate ǀ śuṣmī́ ǀ ā-sádam ǀ véti ǀ druháḥ ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ pāti ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ opaśám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ upa-stíre ǀ camvóḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ niḥ-níje ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The donation is given; the vigorous (Soma) enters his resting-plural ce, and, vigilant, guards (his worshippers) against the malignantrākṣasas; the green-tinted (Soma) produces the all-sustaining water of the sun; (he plural ces) the mighty sun to cover the two worlds, to purify (created things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र कृ॑ष्टि॒हेव॑ शू॒ष ए॑ति॒ रोरु॑वदसु॒र्यं१॒॑ वर्णं॒ नि रि॑णीते अस्य॒ तम् । जहा॑ति व॒व्रिं पि॒तुरे॑ति निष्कृ॒तमु॑प॒प्रुतं॑ कृणुते नि॒र्णिजं॒ तना॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kṛṣṭihā́-iva ǀ śūṣáḥ ǀ eti ǀ róruvat ǀ asuryám ǀ várṇam ǀ ní ǀ riṇīte ǀ asya ǀ tám ǀjáhāti ǀ vavrím ǀ pitúḥ ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ upa-prútam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ tánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerful (Soma) advances with a roar like a slayer of men; he puts forth thatasura-slaying tint of his; he abandons bodily infirmity; the food goes to the prepared (altar); he assumes a form advancing to the outstretched (filter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः प॑वते॒ गभ॑स्त्योर्वृषा॒यते॒ नभ॑सा॒ वेप॑ते म॒ती । स मो॑दते॒ नस॑ते॒ साध॑ते गि॒रा ने॑नि॒क्ते अ॒प्सु यज॑ते॒ परी॑मणि
shlokas.transliteration: ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yáte ǀ nábhasā ǀ vépate ǀ matī́ ǀsáḥ ǀ modate ǀ násate ǀ sā́dhate ǀ girā́ ǀ nenikté ǀ ap-sú ǀ yájate ǀ párīmaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expressed with the stones by thehands(theSoma) flows; he moves like a bull; (worshipped) with praise he wanders through the firmament; he rejoices, he is embraced; (praised) with a hymn he fulfills (the desire of the worshippers), he is cleansed in the waters, he is honoured at the (god) protected (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ द्यु॒क्षं सह॑सः पर्वता॒वृधं॒ मध्व॑: सिञ्चन्ति ह॒र्म्यस्य॑ स॒क्षणि॑म् । आ यस्मि॒न्गाव॑: सुहु॒ताद॒ ऊध॑नि मू॒र्धञ्छ्री॒णन्त्य॑ग्रि॒यं वरी॑मभिः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ dyukṣám ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ parvata-vṛ́dham ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ siñcanti ǀ harmyásya ǀ sakṣáṇim ǀā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ suhuta-ádaḥ ǀ ū́dhani ǀ mūrdhán ǀ śrīṇánti ǀ agriyám ǀ várīma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerful exhilaratingSoma-juices besprinkleIndrawho dwells in heaven, the augmenter of the clouds, the destroyer of the dwelling (of the foe); in whom on account of his greatness, the cows, the eaters of the oblations, mix the best (of their milk contained) in the uplifted udder.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समी॒ रथं॒ न भु॒रिजो॑रहेषत॒ दश॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ अदि॑तेरु॒पस्थ॒ आ । जिगा॒दुप॑ ज्रयति॒ गोर॑पी॒च्यं॑ प॒दं यद॑स्य म॒तुथा॒ अजी॑जनन्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ īmíti ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ bhuríjoḥ ǀ aheṣata ǀ dáśa ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀjígāt ǀ úpa ǀ jrayati ǀ góḥ ǀ apīcyám ǀ padám ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ matúthāḥ ǀ ájījanan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers of the arms urge him near to the ground (of the sacrificial altar) like a chariot; he goes (to the vessels), he approaches the concealed (milk) of the cow when the praisers produce his resting plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्ये॒नो न योनिं॒ सद॑नं धि॒या कृ॒तं हि॑र॒ण्यय॑मा॒सदं॑ दे॒व एष॑ति । ए रि॑णन्ति ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒यं गि॒राश्वो॒ न दे॒वाँ अप्ये॑ति य॒ज्ञिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ sádanam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ kṛtám ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ ā-sádam ǀ deváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īṣati ǀā́ ǀ īmíti ǀ riṇanti ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyám ǀ girā́ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ devā́n ǀ ápi ǀ eti ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The shining (Soma) approaches the golden seat the station constructed by his holy rites, as a falcon (approaches) his nest; (the worshippers) send the well-beloved by their praise to the sacred grass; the adorable Soma proceeds to the gods like a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परा॒ व्य॑क्तो अरु॒षो दि॒वः क॒विर्वृषा॑ त्रिपृ॒ष्ठो अ॑नविष्ट॒ गा अ॒भि । स॒हस्र॑णीति॒र्यति॑: परा॒यती॑ रे॒भो न पू॒र्वीरु॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति
shlokas.transliteration: párā ǀ ví-aktaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ tri-pṛṣṭháḥ ǀ anaviṣṭa ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀsahásra-nītiḥ ǀ yátiḥ ǀ parā-yátiḥ ǀ rebháḥ ǀ ná ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Radiant, wise, flowing in separate streams, (theSomadescends) from the firmament; the shower offered at the three libations responds to the praises (of the worshippers); led in a thousand directions, coming and going, he shines at many a sunrise like one who sings praises (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे॒षं रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ वर्णो॑ अस्य॒ स यत्राश॑य॒त्समृ॑ता॒ सेध॑ति स्रि॒धः । अ॒प्सा या॑ति स्व॒धया॒ दैव्यं॒ जनं॒ सं सु॑ष्टु॒ती नस॑ते॒ सं गोअ॑ग्रया
shlokas.transliteration: tveṣám ǀ rūpám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ várṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀ sáḥ ǀ yátra ǀ áśayat ǀ sám-ṛtā ǀ sédhati ǀ sridháḥ ǀapsā́ḥ ǀ yāti ǀ svadháyā ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀ sám ǀ su-stutī́ ǀ násate ǀ sám ǀ gó-agrayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His ray creates a shining form; at whatever battle it is present, it beats down the adversaries; the giver of water goes with the oblation to the divine people, (it meets) with good praise; (Soma) is joined by (a hymn) demanding kine as the chief boon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒क्षेव॑ यू॒था प॑रि॒यन्न॑रावी॒दधि॒ त्विषी॑रधित॒ सूर्य॑स्य । दि॒व्यः सु॑प॒र्णोऽव॑ चक्षत॒ क्षां सोम॒: परि॒ क्रतु॑ना पश्यते॒ जाः
shlokas.transliteration: ukṣā́-iva ǀ yūthā́ ǀ pari-yán ǀ arāvīt ǀ ádhi ǀ tvíṣīḥ ǀ adhita ǀ sū́ryasya ǀdivyáḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ áva ǀ cakṣata ǀ kṣā́m ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pári ǀ krátunā ǀ paśyate ǀ jā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a bull approaching the herbs (Soma) roars (as he approaches the praises); he appropriates the lustre of the sun; celestial, flying gracefully he looks down upon the earth; by his wisdom Soma contemplates mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरिं॑ मृजन्त्यरु॒षो न यु॑ज्यते॒ सं धे॒नुभि॑: क॒लशे॒ सोमो॑ अज्यते । उद्वाच॑मी॒रय॑ति हि॒न्वते॑ म॒ती पु॑रुष्टु॒तस्य॒ कति॑ चित्परि॒प्रिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: hárim ǀ mṛjanti ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yujyate ǀ sám ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ajyate ǀút ǀ vā́cam ǀ īráyati ǀ hinváte ǀ matī́ ǀ puru-stutásya ǀ káti ǀ cit ǀ pari-príyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They cleanse the green-tinted (Soma); he is harnessed like a swift horse; the Soma is combined in the pitcher with the products of the kine. He utters a sound, (the worshippers) send forth praise; how many (boons) abundantly delightint the utterer of many praises (does Soma bestow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒कं व॑दन्ति ब॒हवो॑ मनी॒षिण॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ सोमं॑ ज॒ठरे॒ यदा॑दु॒हुः । यदी॑ मृ॒जन्ति॒ सुग॑भस्तयो॒ नर॒: सनी॑ळाभिर्द॒शभि॒: काम्यं॒ मधु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sākám ǀ vadanti ǀ bahávaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sómam ǀ jaṭháre ǀ yát ǀ ā-duhúḥ ǀyádi ǀ mṛjánti ǀ sú-gabhastayaḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ sá-nīḷābhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ kā́myam ǀ mádhu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Many wise men utter praise together, when they have milked theSomaintoIndra's belly, when fair-armed men cleanse the delightful exhilarating juice with their ten united (fingers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर॑ममाणो॒ अत्ये॑ति॒ गा अ॒भि सूर्य॑स्य प्रि॒यं दु॑हि॒तुस्ति॒रो रव॑म् । अन्व॑स्मै॒ जोष॑मभरद्विनंगृ॒सः सं द्व॒यीभि॒: स्वसृ॑भिः क्षेति जा॒मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áramamāṇaḥ ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ priyám ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rávam ǀánu ǀ asmai ǀ jóṣam ǀ abharat ǀ vinam-gṛsáḥ ǀ sám ǀ dvayī́bhiḥ ǀ svásṛ-bhiḥ ǀ kṣeti ǀ jāmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unceasing, theSomagoes to mix with the products of the kine, he utters a cry dear to the daughter of the sun. The praiser brings delight to him; he is united to the two kindred sisters (thehands).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृधू॑तो॒ अद्रि॑षुतो ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒यः पति॒र्गवां॑ प्र॒दिव॒ इन्दु॑ॠ॒त्विय॑: । पुरं॑धिवा॒न्मनु॑षो यज्ञ॒साध॑न॒: शुचि॑र्धि॒या प॑वते॒ सोम॑ इन्द्र ते
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ́-dhūtaḥ ǀ ádri-sutaḥ ǀ barhíṣi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ gávām ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ ṛtvíyaḥ ǀpúrandhi-vān ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ yajña-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ pavate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shaken by the men, expressed by the stones, the delight (of the gods), the lord of cattle, ancient, distilling (in the vessels) born in due season, (theSomais plural ced) on the sacrd grass; intelligent, the material of the sacrifice of man, pure, the Soma flows for you,Indra,of his own accord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृबा॒हुभ्यां॑ चोदि॒तो धार॑या सु॒तो॑ऽनुष्व॒धं प॑वते॒ सोम॑ इन्द्र ते । आप्रा॒: क्रतू॒न्त्सम॑जैरध्व॒रे म॒तीर्वेर्न द्रु॒षच्च॒म्वो॒३॒॑रास॑द॒द्धरि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nṛbāhú-bhyām ǀ coditáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ anu-svadhám ǀ pavate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ te ǀā́ ǀ aprāḥ ǀ krátūn ǀ sám ǀ ajaiḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ matī́ḥ ǀ véḥ ǀ ná ǀ dru-sát ǀ camvóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǀ háriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Urged by the arms of men, poured forth in a stream theSomaflows for you,Indra, for strength; you accomplish the rites, you overcome enemies at the sacrifice; the green-tinted Soma rests upon the cups like a bird perching on a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अं॒शुं दु॑हन्ति स्त॒नय॑न्त॒मक्षि॑तं क॒विं क॒वयो॒ऽपसो॑ मनी॒षिण॑: । समी॒ गावो॑ म॒तयो॑ यन्ति सं॒यत॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॒ सद॑ने पुन॒र्भुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: aṃśúm ǀ duhanti ǀ stanáyantam ǀ ákṣitam ǀ kavím ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ apásaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀsám ǀ īmíti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ sam-yátaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ sádane ǀ punaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seers, the experienced performers of holy acts, milk forth the seer, the loud-sounding undecayingSoma; the regenerated cattle and the praises combined repair to him at the plural ce of birth of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या ध॒रुणो॑ म॒हो दि॒वो॒३॒॑ऽपामू॒र्मौ सिन्धु॑ष्व॒न्तरु॑क्षि॒तः । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ वृष॒भो वि॒भूव॑सु॒: सोमो॑ हृ॒दे प॑वते॒ चारु॑ मत्स॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ ūrmáu ǀ síndhuṣu ǀ antáḥ ǀ ukṣitáḥ ǀíndrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vibhú-vasuḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ hṛdé ǀ pavate ǀ cā́ru ǀ matsaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The supporter of the vast heaven, (plural ced) upon the navel of the earth, moistened among the rivers in the wave of the waters, the thunderbolt ofIndra, the showerer (of benefits), the possessor of wealth,Somaauspiciously exhilarating distils into (Indra's) heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तू प॑वस्व॒ परि॒ पार्थि॑वं॒ रज॑: स्तो॒त्रे शिक्ष॑न्नाधून्व॒ते च॑ सुक्रतो । मा नो॒ निर्भा॒ग्वसु॑नः सादन॒स्पृशो॑ र॒यिं पि॒शङ्गं॑ बहु॒लं व॑सीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ pavasva ǀ pári ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ stotré ǀ śíkṣan ǀ ā-dhūnvaté ǀ ca ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀmā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ bhāk ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ sadana-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ rayím ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ bahulám ǀ vasīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performer of good deeds, flow quickly round the terrestrial region, giving (riches) to the worshipper and the shaker (of the libation); do not deprive us of the wealth that enriches our dwellings; may we be invested with abundant wealth of diverse kinds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्दो श॒तदा॒त्वश्व्यं॑ स॒हस्र॑दातु पशु॒मद्धिर॑ण्यवत् । उप॑ मास्व बृह॒ती रे॒वती॒रिषोऽधि॑ स्तो॒त्रस्य॑ पवमान नो गहि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tú ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ śatá-dātu ǀ áśvyam ǀ sahásra-dātu ǀ paśu-mát ǀ híraṇya-vat ǀúpa ǀ māsva ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ revátīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ stotrásya ǀ pavamāna ǀ naḥ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OnIndu, bring us quickly (wealth) with a hundred gifts, with horses, with a thousand gifts, with cattle and with gold; measure unto us abundant riches and food; come, purified one, to (hear) our praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्रक्वे॑ द्र॒प्सस्य॒ धम॑त॒: सम॑स्वरन्नृ॒तस्य॒ योना॒ सम॑रन्त॒ नाभ॑यः । त्रीन्त्स मू॒र्ध्नो असु॑रश्चक्र आ॒रभे॑ स॒त्यस्य॒ नाव॑: सु॒कृत॑मपीपरन्
shlokas.transliteration: srákve ǀ drapsásya ǀ dhámataḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ sám ǀ aranta ǀ nā́bhayaḥ ǀtrī́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ mūrdhnáḥ ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ cakre ǀ ā-rábhe ǀ satyásya ǀ nā́vaḥ ǀ su-kṛ́tam ǀ apīparan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The streams) of the dripping effused (Soma) sound together on the jaw (of the sacrifice), the Soma-juices flow together to the plural ce of sacrifice. The powerful (Soma) has made the three exalted worlds for the use (of men and gods); the ships of the truthful (Soma) satisfy the pious worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्यक्स॒म्यञ्चो॑ महि॒षा अ॑हेषत॒ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मावधि॑ वे॒ना अ॑वीविपन् । मधो॒र्धारा॑भिर्ज॒नय॑न्तो अ॒र्कमित्प्रि॒यामिन्द्र॑स्य त॒न्व॑मवीवृधन्
shlokas.transliteration: samyák ǀ samyáñcaḥ ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ aheṣata ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmáu ǀ ádhi ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ avīvipan ǀmádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ janáyantaḥ ǀ arkám ǀ ít ǀ priyā́m ǀ índrasya ǀ tanvám ǀ avīvṛdhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty (priests) assembled together send forth (theSoma) together; desirous (of heaven) they drive it to the wave of the river; genitive rating praise they nourish the previous body ofIndrawith the streams of the exhilarating Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒वित्र॑वन्त॒: परि॒ वाच॑मासते पि॒तैषां॑ प्र॒त्नो अ॒भि र॑क्षति व्र॒तम् । म॒हः स॑मु॒द्रं वरु॑णस्ति॒रो द॑धे॒ धीरा॒ इच्छे॑कुर्ध॒रुणे॑ष्वा॒रभ॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pavítra-vantaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́cam ǀ āsate ǀ pitā́ ǀ eṣām ǀ pratnáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣati ǀ vratám ǀmaháḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ ít ǀ śekuḥ ǀ dharúṇeṣu ǀ ā-rábham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The rays of theSoma) having the means of purification sit round the voice (of the firmament), their ancient father protects their (light-giving) work; Soma the all-developer has overspread the mighty firmament (with them); the skilful (priests) are able to conduct (the Soma) to the all-sustaining (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑धा॒रेऽव॒ ते सम॑स्वरन्दि॒वो नाके॒ मधु॑जिह्वा अस॒श्चत॑: । अस्य॒ स्पशो॒ न नि मि॑षन्ति॒ भूर्ण॑यः प॒देप॑दे पा॒शिन॑: सन्ति॒ सेत॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-dhāre ǀ áva ǀ té ǀ sám ǀ asaran ǀ diváḥ ǀ nā́ke ǀ mádhu-jihvāḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀásya ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ní ǀ miṣanti ǀ bhū́rṇayaḥ ǀ padé-pade ǀ pāśínaḥ ǀ santi ǀ sétavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheSomarays) in the firmament of a thousand streams (unite with the earth) below; in the summit of heaven, sweet-tongued, in separate drops, his rays, swiftly moving, nevershuttheir eyes; fixed each in his plural ce, they are the molesters (of sinners).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒तुर्मा॒तुरध्या ये स॒मस्व॑रन्नृ॒चा शोच॑न्तः सं॒दह॑न्तो अव्र॒तान् । इन्द्र॑द्विष्टा॒मप॑ धमन्ति मा॒यया॒ त्वच॒मसि॑क्नीं॒ भूम॑नो दि॒वस्परि॑
shlokas.transliteration: pitúḥ ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ sam-ásvaran ǀ ṛcā́ ǀ śócantaḥ ǀ sam-dáhantaḥ ǀ avratā́n ǀíndra-dviṣṭām ǀ ápa ǀ dhamanti ǀ māyáyā ǀ tvácam ǀ ásiknīm ǀ bhū́manaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The rays) which were manifested in heaven and earth, illumined by the hymn (of praise), consuming the impious (sacrificers), drive away by their wisdom from earth and heaven the black-skinned (rākṣasas) hated byIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒त्नान्माना॒दध्या ये स॒मस्व॑र॒ञ्छ्लोक॑यन्त्रासो रभ॒सस्य॒ मन्त॑वः । अपा॑न॒क्षासो॑ बधि॒रा अ॑हासत ऋ॒तस्य॒ पन्थां॒ न त॑रन्ति दु॒ष्कृत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pratnā́t ǀ mā́nāt ǀ ádhi ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ sam-ásvaran ǀ ślóka-yantrāsaḥ ǀ rabhasásya ǀ mántavaḥ ǀápa ǀ anakṣā́saḥ ǀ badhirā́ḥ ǀ ahāsata ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pánthām ǀ ná ǀ taranti ǀ duḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The rays) which regulating praise and purposing rapidity of action, were manifested from the ancient firmament, them the blind and deaf avoid; the wicked traverse not the path of truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑धारे॒ वित॑ते प॒वित्र॒ आ वाचं॑ पुनन्ति क॒वयो॑ मनी॒षिण॑: । रु॒द्रास॑ एषामिषि॒रासो॑ अ॒द्रुह॒: स्पश॒: स्वञ्च॑: सु॒दृशो॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-dhāre ǀ ví-tate ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ punanti ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀrudrā́saḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ iṣirā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ su-áñcaḥ ǀ su-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The intelligent sages extol the voice (of the firmament) in the purifying extended (Soma) with its thousand streams; theRudrasare their servants, swift-moving, inviolable, revered, of goodly aspect, the beholders of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ गो॒पा न दभा॑य सु॒क्रतु॒स्त्री ष प॒वित्रा॑ हृ॒द्य१॒॑न्तरा द॑धे । वि॒द्वान्त्स विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि प॑श्य॒त्यवाजु॑ष्टान्विध्यति क॒र्ते अ॑व्र॒तान्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ dábhāya ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ trī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ pavítrā ǀ hṛdí ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhe ǀvidvā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ paśyati ǀ áva ǀ ájuṣṭān ǀ vidhyati ǀ karté ǀ avratā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) the protector of the sacrifice, the doer of good deeds cannot be resisted; he plural ces in his heart the three purifiers; he the all-wise looks over all worlds; he censures those who are hostile in action, who sacrifice not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॒ तन्तु॒र्वित॑तः प॒वित्र॒ आ जि॒ह्वाया॒ अग्रे॒ वरु॑णस्य मा॒यया॑ । धीरा॑श्चि॒त्तत्स॒मिन॑क्षन्त आश॒तात्रा॑ क॒र्तमव॑ पदा॒त्यप्र॑भुः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ tántuḥ ǀ ví-tataḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ jihvā́yāḥ ǀ ágre ǀ váruṇasya ǀ māyáyā ǀdhī́rāḥ ǀ cit ǀ tát ǀ sam-ínakṣantaḥ ǀ āśata ǀ átra ǀ kartám ǀ áva ǀ padāti ǀ ápra-bhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The threads of the sacrifice spread over the filter extends by its act to the tip ofVaruṇa's tongue; the wise approaching reached it;but he who is incompetent for the rite sinks (to hell) even in this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिशु॒र्न जा॒तोऽव॑ चक्रद॒द्वने॒ स्व१॒॑र्यद्वा॒ज्य॑रु॒षः सिषा॑सति । दि॒वो रेत॑सा सचते पयो॒वृधा॒ तमी॑महे सुम॒ती शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Born in the water (theSoma) cries out like a child, when powerful and brilliant he wishes to enjoy heaven; he comes from the sky tomix with the water that nourish the kine; we ask him by our praises for an opulent dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो यः स्क॒म्भो ध॒रुण॒: स्वा॑तत॒ आपू॑र्णो अं॒शुः प॒र्येति॑ वि॒श्वत॑: । सेमे म॒ही रोद॑सी यक्षदा॒वृता॑ समीची॒ने दा॑धार॒ समिष॑: क॒विः
shlokas.meaning_en: “The supporter of heaven, the prop (of the earth), theSoma-juice who, widely spreading, filling (the vessels), flows in all directions-- may he unite the two great worlds by his own strength; he has upheld them combined; (may he) the sage (bestow) food upon (his worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: महि॒ प्सर॒: सुकृ॑तं सो॒म्यं मधू॒र्वी गव्यू॑ति॒रदि॑तेॠ॒तं य॒ते । ईशे॒ यो वृ॒ष्टेरि॒त उ॒स्रियो॒ वृषा॒पां ने॒ता य इ॒तऊ॑तिॠ॒ग्मिय॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “(There is) abundant food well-prepared made ofSomaand sweet for (Indra) who comes to the sacrifice; the way to earth is broad; (for Indra) who is the lord of the rain (that falls) here, the possessor of cattle, the showerer of water, the leader (of the sacrifice), whose road is hither, who is deserving of praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒त्म॒न्वन्नभो॑ दुह्यते घृ॒तं पय॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ नाभि॑र॒मृतं॒ वि जा॑यते । स॒मी॒ची॒नाः सु॒दान॑वः प्रीणन्ति॒ तं नरो॑ हि॒तमव॑ मेहन्ति॒ पेर॑वः
shlokas.meaning_en: “Full of sap the butter and milk is milked from heaven, the bond of the sacrifice, the water is genitive rated; the assembled liberal givers delight him; (theSoma-juices) the leaders, the protectors shower down the accusative ulated (water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरा॑वीदं॒शुः सच॑मान ऊ॒र्मिणा॑ देवा॒व्यं१॒॑ मनु॑षे पिन्वति॒ त्वच॑म् । दधा॑ति॒ गर्भ॒मदि॑तेरु॒पस्थ॒ आ येन॑ तो॒कं च॒ तन॑यं च॒ धाम॑हे
shlokas.meaning_en: “Combining with the wave theSomautters a cry; he sprinkles his god-protecting body for the worshipper; he plural ces the germ upon the lap of the earth, whereby we acquire sons and grandsons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑धा॒रेऽव॒ ता अ॑स॒श्चत॑स्तृ॒तीये॑ सन्तु॒ रज॑सि प्र॒जाव॑तीः । चत॑स्रो॒ नाभो॒ निहि॑ता अ॒वो दि॒वो ह॒विर्भ॑रन्त्य॒मृतं॑ घृत॒श्चुत॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those (juices) which are in the third world, the world of many streams, unconnected, bestowing progeny, descend; the four digits (of theSoma) sent down from heaven bearing water bring the oblation and the nectar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्वे॒तं रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ यत्सिषा॑सति॒ सोमो॑ मी॒ढ्वाँ असु॑रो वेद॒ भूम॑नः । धि॒या शमी॑ सचते॒ सेम॒भि प्र॒वद्दि॒वस्कव॑न्ध॒मव॑ दर्षदु॒द्रिण॑म्
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theSomaseeks to gain (heaven) he assumes a white colour; showering (benefits), powerful he knows (how to bestow) abundant wealth (upon the worshippers). He by his wisdom is associated with excellent rites; he bursts asunder the rain cloud from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ श्वे॒तं क॒लशं॒ गोभि॑र॒क्तं कार्ष्म॒न्ना वा॒ज्य॑क्रमीत्सस॒वान् । आ हि॑न्विरे॒ मन॑सा देव॒यन्त॑: क॒क्षीव॑ते श॒तहि॑माय॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus theSomasuccessfully reaches the white water besprinkled pitcher like a horse (reaching) the goal; the devout (priests) stimulate him with their praise; (he bestows) cattle uponKakṣīvatwho has seen a hundred winters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्भिः सो॑म पपृचा॒नस्य॑ ते॒ रसोऽव्यो॒ वारं॒ वि प॑वमान धावति । स मृ॒ज्यमा॑नः क॒विभि॑र्मदिन्तम॒ स्वद॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य पवमान पी॒तये॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, when you are diluted with the water your juice passes through the woollen fleece; cleansed by the sages, O exhilarating purified (Soma), be sweet-flavoured forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒याणि॑ पवते॒ चनो॑हितो॒ नामा॑नि य॒ह्वो अधि॒ येषु॒ वर्ध॑ते । आ सूर्य॑स्य बृह॒तो बृ॒हन्नधि॒ रथं॒ विष्व॑ञ्चमरुहद्विचक्ष॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ pavate ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀ nā́māni ǀ yahváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ yéṣu ǀ várdhate ǀā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ bṛhán ǀ ádhi ǀ rátham ǀ víṣvañcam ǀ aruhat ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheSoma) fit for good flows towards the delightful waters in which the mighty (Soma) is fostered; the beholder of all, the great (Soma) mounts themighty sun's chariot which go everywhere. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॑ जि॒ह्वा प॑वते॒ मधु॑ प्रि॒यं व॒क्ता पति॑र्धि॒यो अ॒स्या अदा॑भ्यः । दधा॑ति पु॒त्रः पि॒त्रोर॑पी॒च्यं१॒॑ नाम॑ तृ॒तीय॒मधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ jihvā́ ǀ pavate ǀ mádhu ǀ priyám ǀ vaktā́ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ dhiyáḥ ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀdádhāti ǀ putráḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ apīcyám ǀ nā́ma ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀ ádhi ǀ rocané ǀ diváḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tongue of the sacrifice (Soma) distils the delightful exhilarating (juice), speaking, lord of this rite, unassailable; the son (the sacrificer) assumes a third name unknown to his parents in the briliance of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ द्युता॒नः क॒लशाँ॑ अचिक्रद॒न्नृभि॑र्येमा॒नः कोश॒ आ हि॑र॒ण्यये॑ । अ॒भीमृ॒तस्य॑ दो॒हना॑ अनूष॒ताधि॑ त्रिपृ॒ष्ठ उ॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ dyutānáḥ ǀ kaláśān ǀ acikradat ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ kóśe ǀ ā́ ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀabhí ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dohánāḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ ádhi ǀ tri-pṛṣṭháḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Shining, he cries aloud (descending) into the vessels, pressed by the priests into the golden receptacle; the milk of the sacrifice glorify him; the supporter of the three sacrifices shines (most) on the days of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तो म॒तिभि॒श्चनो॑हितः प्ररो॒चय॒न्रोद॑सी मा॒तरा॒ शुचि॑: । रोमा॒ण्यव्या॑ स॒मया॒ वि धा॑वति॒ मधो॒र्धारा॒ पिन्व॑माना दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀ pra-rocáyan ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mātárā ǀ śúciḥ ǀrómāṇi ǀ ávyā ǀ samáyā ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rā ǀ pínvamānā ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused by the stones and by the praises, fit for food, illuminating heaven and earth the parents (of the universe), pure, (theSoma), flows between the sheep's hairs, diluted (with the water) the stream of the exhilarating beverage (is purified) day by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ सोम॒ प्र ध॑न्वा स्व॒स्तये॒ नृभि॑: पुना॒नो अ॒भि वा॑सया॒शिर॑म् । ये ते॒ मदा॑ आह॒नसो॒ विहा॑यस॒स्तेभि॒रिन्द्रं॑ चोदय॒ दात॑वे म॒घम्
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ soma ǀ prá ǀ dhanva ǀ svastáye ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vāsaya ǀ ā-śíram ǀyé ǀ te ǀ mádāḥ ǀ āhanásaḥ ǀ ví-hāyasaḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ índram ǀ codaya ǀ dā́tave ǀ maghám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, flow forth for our welfare; purified by the priests cloth yourself in the (milky) mixture; with the exhilarating loud-sounding mighty juices which you have, inspireIndrato bestow affluence upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ध॒र्ता दि॒वः प॑वते॒ कृत्व्यो॒ रसो॒ दक्षो॑ दे॒वाना॑मनु॒माद्यो॒ नृभि॑: । हरि॑: सृजा॒नो अत्यो॒ न सत्व॑भि॒र्वृथा॒ पाजां॑सि कृणुते न॒दीष्वा
shlokas.transliteration: dhartā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pavate ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ anu-mā́dyaḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pā́jāṃsi ǀ kṛṇute ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) the sustainer (of all) flows from the firmament, the purifiable juice, the invigorator of the gods, worthy tobe praised by the priests; green-tinted like a horse let loose by the charioteers he easily restores his vigour in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शूरो॒ न ध॑त्त॒ आयु॑धा॒ गभ॑स्त्यो॒: स्व१॒॑: सिषा॑सन्रथि॒रो गवि॑ष्टिषु । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ शुष्म॑मी॒रय॑न्नप॒स्युभि॒रिन्दु॑र्हिन्वा॒नो अ॑ज्यते मनी॒षिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhatte ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ sísāsan ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǀíndrasya ǀ śúṣmam ǀ īráyan ǀ apasyú-bhiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a hero he carries weapons in hishands, desirous of enjoying felicity, mounting his chariot in quest of the cattle (of the worshipper), animating the strength ofIndra,Indu, urged by the wise performers of pious acts, is anointed (with the milk and curds).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य सोम॒ पव॑मान ऊ॒र्मिणा॑ तवि॒ष्यमा॑णो ज॒ठरे॒ष्वा वि॑श । प्र ण॑: पिन्व वि॒द्युद॒भ्रेव॒ रोद॑सी धि॒या न वाजाँ॒ उप॑ मासि॒ शश्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ soma ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ taviṣyámāṇaḥ ǀ jaṭháreṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ pinva ǀ vi-dyút ǀ abhrā́-iva ǀ ródasī íti ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jān ǀ úpa ǀ māsi ǀ śáśvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somawho are purified, who desire strength enterIndra's belly in a mighty stream; milk heaven and earth for us as lightning (milks) the clouds; now with the rite meter (unto us) abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य॒ राजा॑ पवते स्व॒र्दृश॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिमृ॑षि॒षाळ॑वीवशत् । यः सूर्य॒स्यासि॑रेण मृ॒ज्यते॑ पि॒ता म॑ती॒नामस॑मष्टकाव्यः
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ pavate ǀ svaḥ-dṛ́śaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītím ǀ ṛṣiṣā́ṭ ǀ avīvaśat ǀyáḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ásireṇa ǀ mṛjyáte ǀ pitā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ ásamaṣṭa-kāvyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) the soverign of the universe flows forth; surpassing the ṛṣis he desire the worship of the all-seeing truthful (Indra); he who is cleansed by the ray of he sun, the father of praise, the unequalled sage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषे॑व यू॒था परि॒ कोश॑मर्षस्य॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ वृष॒भः कनि॑क्रदत् । स इन्द्रा॑य पवसे मत्स॒रिन्त॑मो॒ यथा॒ जेषा॑म समि॒थे त्वोत॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ yūthā́ ǀ pári ǀ kóśam ǀ arṣasi ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ kánikradat ǀsáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavase ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ jéṣāma ǀ sam-ithé ǀ tvā́-ūtayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a bull (entering) the herd you rush to the receptacle, on the top of the waters, showering (benefits) crying aloud; you flow forIndra, most exhilarating so that we may be victorious in battle protected by you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प्र कोशे॒ मधु॑माँ अचिक्रद॒दिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॒ वपु॑षो॒ वपु॑ष्टरः । अ॒भीमृ॒तस्य॑ सु॒दुघा॑ घृत॒श्चुतो॑ वा॒श्रा अ॑र्षन्ति॒ पय॑सेव धे॒नव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ prá ǀ kóśe ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ acikradat ǀ índrasya ǀ vájraḥ ǀ vápuṣaḥ ǀ vápuḥ-taraḥ ǀabhí ǀ īm ǀ ṛtásya ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ vāśrā́ḥ ǀ arṣanti ǀ páyasā-iva ǀ dhenávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sweet-flavoured beverage sounds in the pitcher, the thunderbolt ofIndra, more beautiful than the beautiful; (the stream) of this veracious (Soma) approach yielding much milk, dropping water, lowing like kine (laden) with milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पू॒र्व्यः प॑वते॒ यं दि॒वस्परि॑ श्ये॒नो म॑था॒यदि॑षि॒तस्ति॒रो रज॑: । स मध्व॒ आ यु॑वते॒ वेवि॑जान॒ इत्कृ॒शानो॒रस्तु॒र्मन॒साह॑ बि॒भ्युषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ yám ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ mathāyát ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yuvate ǀ vévijānaḥ ǀ ít ǀ kṛśā́noḥ ǀ ástuḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ áha ǀ bibhyúṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient (Soma) flows, which the hawk, despatched (for the purpose), brought down from heaven passing through the (third) world; he detaches the sweet-flavoured (Soma) flying downwards, with mind full of fear of the archerKṛśānu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते न॒: पूर्वा॑स॒ उप॑रास॒ इन्द॑वो म॒हे वाजा॑य धन्वन्तु॒ गोम॑ते । ई॒क्षे॒ण्या॑सो अ॒ह्यो॒३॒॑ न चार॑वो॒ ब्रह्म॑ब्रह्म॒ ये जु॑जु॒षुर्ह॒विर्ह॑विः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rvāsaḥ ǀ úparāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ dhanvantu ǀ gó-mate ǀīkṣeṇyā́saḥ ǀ ahyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ cā́ravaḥ ǀ bráhma-brahma ǀ yé ǀ jujuṣúḥ ǀ havíḥ-haviḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the former and the latterSoma-juices flow to give us abundant food and milk, plural asing to look upon like beautiful well-adorned (women), which (juices) perform every prayer and every oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं नो॑ वि॒द्वान्व॑नवद्वनुष्य॒त इन्दु॑: स॒त्राचा॒ मन॑सा पुरुष्टु॒तः । इ॒नस्य॒ यः सद॑ने॒ गर्भ॑माद॒धे गवा॑मुरु॒ब्जम॒भ्यर्ष॑ति व्र॒जम्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ naḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ vanavat ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ satrā́cā ǀ mánasā ǀ puru-stutáḥ ǀinásya ǀ yáḥ ǀ sádane ǀ gárbham ǀ ā-dadhé ǀ gávām ǀ urubjám ǀ abhí ǀ árṣati ǀ vrajám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thisIndu, praised of many, knowing those who desire to slay us, slay them with united mind; who being in the dwelling of the lord (Agni) deposits a germ (in the herds) and hastens to (our) milk-giving herd of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चक्रि॑र्दि॒वः प॑वते॒ कृत्व्यो॒ रसो॑ म॒हाँ अद॑ब्धो॒ वरु॑णो हु॒रुग्य॒ते । असा॑वि मि॒त्रो वृ॒जने॑षु य॒ज्ञियोऽत्यो॒ न यू॒थे वृ॑ष॒युः कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: cákriḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pavate ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ hurúk ǀ yaté ǀásāvi ǀ mitráḥ ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yūthé ǀ vṛṣa-yúḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The maker of all, clever in work, the juice, mighty unassailableVaruṇaflows from heaven for the sake of him who go hither and thither; the friend of the adorable (Soma) is effused in affliction uttering a sound like an ardent horse amidst a herd (of mares). [”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र राजा॒ वाचं॑ ज॒नय॑न्नसिष्यदद॒पो वसा॑नो अ॒भि गा इ॑यक्षति । गृ॒भ्णाति॑ रि॒प्रमवि॑रस्य॒ तान्वा॑ शु॒द्धो दे॒वाना॒मुप॑ याति निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ rā́jā ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáyan ǀ asisyadat ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ iyakṣati ǀgṛbhṇā́ti ǀ riprám ǀ áviḥ ǀ asya ǀ tā́nvā ǀ śuddháḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ yāti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This royal (Soma) producing a sound flows forth; clothing himself with the water he advances towards the praises (of the worshipper); the sheep with its fleece lays hold of the impure form; purified he approaches the station of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ परि॑ षिच्यसे॒ नृभि॑र्नृ॒चक्षा॑ ऊ॒र्मिः क॒विर॑ज्यसे॒ वने॑ । पू॒र्वीर्हि ते॑ स्रु॒तय॒: सन्ति॒ यात॑वे स॒हस्र॒मश्वा॒ हर॑यश्चमू॒षद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pári ǀ sicyase ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ajyase ǀ váne ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ srutáyaḥ ǀ sánti ǀ yā́tave ǀ sahásram ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are effused by the priests,Soma, forIndra; you the observer of men, stimulated, intelligent, are immersed in the water; many are the paths for you to follow, infinite are the spreading green-tinted streams alighting on the cups.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रिया॑ अप्स॒रसो॑ मनी॒षिण॒मासी॑ना अ॒न्तर॒भि सोम॑मक्षरन् । ता ईं॑ हिन्वन्ति ह॒र्म्यस्य॑ स॒क्षणिं॒ याच॑न्ते सु॒म्नं पव॑मान॒मक्षि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: samudríyāḥ ǀ apsarásaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇam ǀ ā́sīnāḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sómam ǀ akṣaran ǀtā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ harmyásya ǀ sakṣáṇim ǀ yā́cante ǀ sumnám ǀ pávamānam ǀ ákṣitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The nymphs of the firmament seated in the midst flow towards the sagaciousSoma; they cherish him the sprinkler of the hall of sacrifice; (the worshippers) solicitPavamāna(the undecaying) for a boon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गो॒जिन्न॒: सोमो॑ रथ॒जिद्धि॑रण्य॒जित्स्व॒र्जिद॒ब्जित्प॑वते सहस्र॒जित् । यं दे॒वास॑श्चक्रि॒रे पी॒तये॒ मदं॒ स्वादि॑ष्ठं द्र॒प्सम॑रु॒णं म॑यो॒भुव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: go-jít ǀ naḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ratha-jít ǀ hiraṇya-jít ǀ svaḥ-jít ǀ ap-jít ǀ pavate ǀ sahasra-jít ǀyám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ cakriré ǀ pītáye ǀ mádam ǀ svā́diṣṭham ǀ drapsám ǀ aruṇám ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somaflows for us, the conqueror of cattle, of chariots, of gold, of heaven, of water, of thousandfold (wealth), whom the gods have made for (their) drinking, exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, dropping, purple, causing happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तानि॑ सोम॒ पव॑मानो अस्म॒युः स॒त्यानि॑ कृ॒ण्वन्द्रवि॑णान्यर्षसि । ज॒हि शत्रु॑मन्ति॒के दू॑र॒के च॒ य उ॒र्वीं गव्यू॑ति॒मभ॑यं च नस्कृधि
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ni ǀ soma ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ asma-yúḥ ǀ satyā́ni ǀ kṛṇván ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ arṣasi ǀjahí ǀ śátrum ǀ antiké ǀ dūraké ǀ ca ǀ yáḥ ǀ urvī́m ǀ gávyūtim ǀ ábhayam ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestowing all these true riches, loving us you flow,Soma, purified; destroy our enemy whether he be far or nigh; grant us a free road and freedom from danger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒चो॒दसो॑ नो धन्व॒न्त्विन्द॑व॒: प्र सु॑वा॒नासो॑ बृ॒हद्दि॑वेषु॒ हर॑यः । वि च॒ नश॑न्न इ॒षो अरा॑तयो॒ऽर्यो न॑शन्त॒ सनि॑षन्त नो॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: acodásaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ dhanvantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ prá ǀ suvānā́saḥ ǀ bṛhát-diveṣu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀví ǀ ca ǀ náśan ǀ naḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ naśanta ǀ sániṣanta ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the spontaneousSoma-juices flow to us at the brilliant (sacrifices), green-tinted, effused; may they be destroyed who are the withholders of food from us; may (our) foes be destroyed; may (the gods) enjoy our pious acts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र णो॑ धन्व॒न्त्विन्द॑वो मद॒च्युतो॒ धना॑ वा॒ येभि॒रर्व॑तो जुनी॒मसि॑ । ति॒रो मर्त॑स्य॒ कस्य॑ चि॒त्परि॑ह्वृतिं व॒यं धना॑नि वि॒श्वधा॑ भरेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhanvantu ǀ índavaḥ ǀ mada-cyútaḥ ǀ dhánā ǀ vā ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ árvataḥ ǀ junīmási ǀtiráḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀ pári-hvṛtim ǀ vayám ǀ dhánāni ǀ viśvádhā ǀ bharemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they flow to us, may they bring us riches-- the honey-droppingSoma-juices by whose aid we encounter the powerful (enemy); may we overcoming the opposition of every man always bear off his wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्वस्या॒ अरा॑त्या अ॒रिर्हि ष उ॒तान्यस्या॒ अरा॑त्या॒ वृको॒ हि षः । धन्व॒न्न तृष्णा॒ सम॑रीत॒ ताँ अ॒भि सोम॑ ज॒हि प॑वमान दुरा॒ध्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ svásyāḥ ǀ árātyāḥ ǀ aríḥ ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀ utá ǀ anyásyāḥ ǀ árātyāḥ ǀ vṛ́kaḥ ǀ hí ǀ sáḥ ǀdhánvan ǀ ná ǀ tṛ́ṣṇā ǀ sám ǀ arīta ǀ tā́n ǀ abhí ǀ sóma ǀ jahí ǀ pavamāna ǀ duḥ-ādhyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For the (Soma) verily is the foe of his own enemy and the destroyer of the enemy of another; as thirst overcomes one in a desert, so purified Soma, who are irresistible, slay (both) those (adversaries).”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वि ते॒ नाभा॑ पर॒मो य आ॑द॒दे पृ॑थि॒व्यास्ते॑ रुरुहु॒: सान॑वि॒ क्षिप॑: । अद्र॑यस्त्वा बप्सति॒ गोरधि॑ त्व॒च्य१॒॑प्सु त्वा॒ हस्तै॑र्दुदुहुर्मनी॒षिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: diví ǀ te ǀ nā́bhā ǀ paramáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā-dadé ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ ruruhuḥ ǀ sā́navi ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀádrayaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ bapsati ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ ap-sú ǀ tvā ǀ hástaiḥ ǀ duduhuḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your best juice (dwells) in the navel of heaven, that which receives (the oblation); your (members) grow up thrown upon the summit of the earth; the stones devour you upon the cowhide; the wise (priests) milk you into the water with theirhands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा त॑ इन्दो सु॒भ्वं॑ सु॒पेश॑सं॒ रसं॑ तुञ्जन्ति प्रथ॒मा अ॑भि॒श्रिय॑: । निदं॑निदं पवमान॒ नि ता॑रिष आ॒विस्ते॒ शुष्मो॑ भवतु प्रि॒यो मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ indo íti ǀ su-bhvám ǀ su-péśasam ǀ rásam ǀ tuñjanti ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ abhi-śríyaḥ ǀnídam-nidam ǀ pavamāna ǀ ní ǀ tāriṣaḥ ǀ āvíḥ ǀ te ǀ śúṣmaḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus,Indu, the chief (priests) making the mixture send forth your well-lodged, well-formed juice (rasa); purifiedSoma, destroy (our) reviler; let your potent, delightful, exhilarating (juice) appoear.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य॒ धारा॑ पवते नृ॒चक्ष॑स ऋ॒तेन॑ दे॒वान्ह॑वते दि॒वस्परि॑ । बृह॒स्पते॑ र॒वथे॑ना॒ वि दि॑द्युते समु॒द्रासो॒ न सव॑नानि विव्यचुः
shlokas.transliteration: sómasya ǀ dhā́rā ǀ pavate ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ devā́n ǀ havate ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀbṛ́haspáteḥ ǀ raváthena ǀ ví ǀ didyute ǀ samudrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ sávanāni ǀ vivyacuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The stream of theSoma, the contemplator of man, flows forth; it invites by the sacrifice the gods (who dwell) above the sky; it shines forth at the voice of the sacrificer; the libations cover (the earth) like rivers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॑ वाजिन्न॒घ्न्या अ॒भ्यनू॑ष॒तायो॑हतं॒ योनि॒मा रो॑हसि द्यु॒मान् । म॒घोना॒मायु॑: प्रति॒रन्महि॒ श्रव॒ इन्द्रा॑य सोम पवसे॒ वृषा॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ vājin ǀ aghnyā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ánūṣata ǀ áyaḥ-hatam ǀ yónim ǀ ā́ ǀ rohasi ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀmaghónām ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tirán ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pavase ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Giver of food, whom the kine praise, you mount, bright-shining, your station fashioned by golden-hands; you,Soma, the health of the worshippers, increasing (their) abundant food flow forIndra, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॑स्य कु॒क्षा प॑वते म॒दिन्त॑म॒ ऊर्जं॒ वसा॑न॒: श्रव॑से सुम॒ङ्गल॑: । प्र॒त्यङ्स विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि प॑प्रथे॒ क्रीळ॒न्हरि॒रत्य॑: स्यन्दते॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ kukṣā́ ǀ pavate ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀ ū́rjam ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ śrávase ǀ su-maṅgálaḥ ǀpratyáṅ ǀ sáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ paprathe ǀ krī́ḷan ǀ háriḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ syandate ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The (Soma) flows toIndra's belly for (his) food, giving extreme exhilaration, clothed with vigour, giving good fortune he spreads forth towards all beings; sporting (on the altar), green-tinted, swift-moving, the showerer of benefits, he flows forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॒ मधु॑मत्तमं॒ नर॑: स॒हस्र॑धारं दुहते॒ दश॒ क्षिप॑: । नृभि॑: सोम॒ प्रच्यु॑तो॒ ग्राव॑भिः सु॒तो विश्वा॑न्दे॒वाँ आ प॑वस्वा सहस्रजित्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ náraḥ ǀ sahásra-dhāram ǀ duhate ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ soma ǀ prá-cyutaḥ ǀ grā́va-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ víśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasra-jit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests, the ten fingers, milk you forth for the gods, most sweet-flavoured, flowing in a thousand streams; effused by the men, expressed with the stone, do you,Soma, the winner of thousand-fold wealth, flow to all the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ ह॒स्तिनो॒ मधु॑मन्त॒मद्रि॑भिर्दु॒हन्त्य॒प्सु वृ॑ष॒भं दश॒ क्षिप॑: । इन्द्रं॑ सोम मा॒दय॒न्दैव्यं॒ जनं॒ सिन्धो॑रिवो॒र्मिः पव॑मानो अर्षसि
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ hastínaḥ ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ duhánti ǀ ap-sú ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀíndram ǀ soma ǀ mādáyan ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀ síndhoḥ-iva ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ arṣasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers of the skillful (one) milk you forth with the stones into the water most sweet-flavoured, the showerer (of benefits);Soma, exhilaratingIndra(and) the celestial people, you rush forth, when filtered, like the wave of a river.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सोम॑स्य॒ पव॑मानस्यो॒र्मय॒ इन्द्र॑स्य यन्ति ज॒ठरं॑ सु॒पेश॑सः । द॒ध्ना यदी॒मुन्नी॑ता य॒शसा॒ गवां॑ दा॒नाय॒ शूर॑मु॒दम॑न्दिषुः सु॒ताः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sómasya ǀ pávamānasya ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ yanti ǀ jaṭháram ǀ su-péśasaḥ ǀdadhnā́ ǀ yát ǀ īm ǀ út-nītāḥ ǀ yaśásā ǀ gávām ǀ dānā́ya ǀ śū́ram ǀ ut-ámandiṣuḥ ǀ sutā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The graceful waves of the purifiedSomaflow intoIndra's belly when being effused and drawn forth (together) with the potent curds of the kine, they excite the hero to bestow (gifts to the worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॒ हि सोम॑: क॒लशाँ॒ असि॑ष्यद॒दत्यो॒ न वोळ्हा॑ र॒घुव॑र्तनि॒र्वृषा॑ । अथा॑ दे॒वाना॑मु॒भय॑स्य॒ जन्म॑नो वि॒द्वाँ अ॑श्नोत्य॒मुत॑ इ॒तश्च॒ यत्
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ hí ǀ sómaḥ ǀ kaláśān ǀ ásisyadat ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vóḷhā ǀ raghú-vartaniḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀátha ǀ devā́nām ǀ ubháyasya ǀ jánmanaḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ aśnoti ǀ amútaḥ ǀ itáḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flows towards the pitchers, like a darught horse, lightly moving, the showerer; and knowing both races of gods-- those who come to (the sacrifice) from the other world and those who (come) from this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: सोम॒ पव॑मानः किरा॒ वस्विन्दो॒ भव॑ म॒घवा॒ राध॑सो म॒हः । शिक्षा॑ वयोधो॒ वस॑वे॒ सु चे॒तुना॒ मा नो॒ गय॑मा॒रे अ॒स्मत्परा॑ सिचः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ kira ǀ vásu ǀ índo íti ǀ bháva ǀ maghá-vā ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀśíkṣa ǀ vayaḥ-dhaḥ ǀ vásave ǀ sú ǀ cetúnā ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ āré ǀ asmát ǀ párā ǀ sicaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, when purified, strew upon us wealth;Indu, who are possessed of affluence, be (the donor) of ample riches; dispenser of food, grant toVasuprosperity through (your) intelligence, scatter not our riches far from us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: पू॒षा पव॑मानः सुरा॒तयो॑ मि॒त्रो ग॑च्छन्तु॒ वरु॑णः स॒जोष॑सः । बृह॒स्पति॑र्म॒रुतो॑ वा॒युर॒श्विना॒ त्वष्टा॑ सवि॒ता सु॒यमा॒ सर॑स्वती
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ su-rātáyaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ gacchantu ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀbṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ savitā́ ǀ su-yámā ǀ sárasvatī ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the genitive rous (gods) meet together to us--Pūṣan,Pavamāna,Mitra,Varuṇa,Bṛhaspati, theMaruts,Vāyu, theAśvins,Tvaṣṭā,savitā, and beautifulSarasvatī. [”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॑श्वमि॒न्वे अ॑र्य॒मा दे॒वो अदि॑तिर्विधा॒ता । भगो॒ नृशंस॑ उ॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षं॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः पव॑मानं जुषन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ viśvaminvé íti viśvam-invé ǀ aryamā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ vi-dhātā́ ǀbhágaḥ ǀ nṛ́-śáṃsaḥ ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ pávamānam ǀ juṣanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-pervading couple heaven and earth, the divineAryaman,Aditi,Vidhātā,Bhagadeserving the praise of men, the spacious firmament, all the gods honour the purified (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: असा॑वि॒ सोमो॑ अरु॒षो वृषा॒ हरी॒ राजे॑व द॒स्मो अ॒भि गा अ॑चिक्रदत् । पु॒ना॒नो वारं॒ पर्ये॑त्य॒व्ययं॑ श्ये॒नो न योनिं॑ घृ॒तव॑न्तमा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ásāvi ǀ sómaḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háriḥ ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ dasmáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ acikradat ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ pári ǀ eti ǀ avyáyam ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomahas been effused radiant, the showerer, green-inted; magnificent as a king, he cries aloud when approaching the waters; purified, he passes through the sheep's fleece, to alight on the water-moistened seat like a hawk (on its nest).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विर्वे॑ध॒स्या पर्ये॑षि॒ माहि॑न॒मत्यो॒ न मृ॒ष्टो अ॒भि वाज॑मर्षसि । अ॒प॒सेध॑न्दुरि॒ता सो॑म मृळय घृ॒तं वसा॑न॒: परि॑ यासि नि॒र्णिज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: kavíḥ ǀ vedhasyā́ ǀ pári ǀ eṣi ǀ mā́hinam ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mṛṣṭáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣasi ǀapa-sédhan ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ soma ǀ mṛḷaya ǀ ghṛtám ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yāsi ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, who are wise, pass through the adorable (filter) with a desire to perform the sacrifice; being cleansed you rush like a horse to the cattle. Driving away misfortunes be gracious (to us),Soma; clothed in water you proceed to the cleansing (vessel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒र्जन्य॑: पि॒ता म॑हि॒षस्य॑ प॒र्णिनो॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या गि॒रिषु॒ क्षयं॑ दधे । स्वसा॑र॒ आपो॑ अ॒भि गा उ॒तास॑र॒न्त्सं ग्राव॑भिर्नसते वी॒ते अ॑ध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: parjányaḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ parṇínaḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ giríṣu ǀ kṣáyam ǀ dadhe ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ asaran ǀ sám ǀ grā́va-bhiḥ ǀ nasate ǀ vīté ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mighty winged (Soma) whose father isParjanyahas plural ced his dwelling on the navel of the earth among the mountains; the sisters, the waters flow to (the produce of) the kine; he meets with the stones at the beloved sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒येव॒ पत्या॒वधि॒ शेव॑ मंहसे॒ पज्रा॑या गर्भ शृणु॒हि ब्रवी॑मि ते । अ॒न्तर्वाणी॑षु॒ प्र च॑रा॒ सु जी॒वसे॑ऽनि॒न्द्यो वृ॒जने॑ सोम जागृहि
shlokas.transliteration: jāyā́-iva ǀ pátyau ǀ ádhi ǀ śéva ǀ maṃhase ǀ pájrāyāḥ ǀ garbha ǀ śṛṇuhí ǀ brávīmi ǀ te ǀantáḥ ǀ vā́ṇīṣu ǀ prá ǀ cara ǀ sú ǀ jīváse ǀ anindyáḥ ǀ vṛjáne ǀ soma ǀ jāgṛhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a wife to her husband, so you (afford) delight to your worshipper; (Soma), offspring of Pajra, listen (to the praises) I address to you; in the midst of our adorations advance to grant us life; Soma, who are irreproachable, be vigilant against (our) foe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॒ पूर्वे॑भ्यः शत॒सा अमृ॑ध्रः सहस्र॒साः प॒र्यया॒ वाज॑मिन्दो । ए॒वा प॑वस्व सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ तव॑ व्र॒तमन्वाप॑: सचन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ pū́rvebhyaḥ ǀ śata-sā́ḥ ǀ ámṛdhraḥ ǀ sahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ pari-áyāḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ indo íti ǀevá ǀ pavasva ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ návyase ǀ táva ǀ vratám ǀ ánu ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ sacante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you,Indu, did attain strength for the ancient (ṛṣis), giving them hundred-fold (wealth), invulnerable, giving them thousand-fold (wealth); so now flow for (our) modern prosperity; the waters wait upon your functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒वित्रं॑ ते॒ वित॑तं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्र॒भुर्गात्रा॑णि॒ पर्ये॑षि वि॒श्वत॑: । अत॑प्ततनू॒र्न तदा॒मो अ॑श्नुते शृ॒तास॒ इद्वह॑न्त॒स्तत्समा॑शत
shlokas.transliteration: pavítram ǀ te ǀ ví-tatam ǀ brahmaṇaḥ ǀ pate ǀ pra-bhúḥ ǀ gā́trāṇi ǀ pári ǀ eṣi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀátapta-tanūḥ ǀ ná ǀ tát ǀ āmáḥ ǀ aśnute ǀ śṛtā́saḥ ǀ ít ǀ váhantaḥ ǀ tát ǀ sám ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord or prayer, your filter is stretched out; you who are the sovereign, enter its members from all sides; the raw (liquid) whose mass is not heated attains not this (filter); it is the boiled (liquids) bearing (the sacrifice) which attain it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तपो॑ष्प॒वित्रं॒ वित॑तं दि॒वस्प॒दे शोच॑न्तो अस्य॒ तन्त॑वो॒ व्य॑स्थिरन् । अव॑न्त्यस्य पवी॒तार॑मा॒शवो॑ दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठमधि॑ तिष्ठन्ति॒ चेत॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: tápoḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ví-tatam ǀ diváḥ ǀ padé ǀ śócantaḥ ǀ asya ǀ tántavaḥ ǀ ví ǀ asthiran ǀávanti ǀ asya ǀ pavitā́ram ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhanti ǀ cétasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The filter of the foe-scorching (Soma) is spread on the summit of heaven; his shining filaments are separated, his swift-flowing (juices) protect the purifier (the worshipper), they dwell upon the summit of the sky in their wish (to approach the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरू॑रुचदु॒षस॒: पृश्नि॑रग्रि॒य उ॒क्षा बि॑भर्ति॒ भुव॑नानि वाज॒युः । मा॒या॒विनो॑ ममिरे अस्य मा॒यया॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सः पि॒तरो॒ गर्भ॒मा द॑धुः
shlokas.transliteration: árūrucat ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ pṛ́śniḥ ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ ukṣā́ ǀ bibharti ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀmāyā-vínaḥ ǀ mamire ǀ asya ǀ māyáyā ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chief sun of the dawn (theSoma) shines forth; sprinkler (of water), he nourishes the worlds, wishing (to have them) food; by his intelligence the intelligent build, thepitṛs, the beholders of men, support the germ (of vegetation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग॒न्ध॒र्व इ॒त्था प॒दम॑स्य रक्षति॒ पाति॑ दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मा॒न्यद्भु॑तः । गृ॒भ्णाति॑ रि॒पुं नि॒धया॑ नि॒धाप॑तिः सु॒कृत्त॑मा॒ मधु॑नो भ॒क्षमा॑शत
shlokas.transliteration: gandharváḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ padám ǀ asya ǀ rakṣati ǀ pā́ti ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánimāni ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀgṛbhṇā́ti ǀ ripúm ǀ ni-dháyā ǀ nidhā́-patiḥ ǀ sukṛ́t-tamāḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ bhakṣám ǀ āśata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thegandharvaverily protects this station; the marvellous (Soma) preserves the races of the gods; the lord of cattle seizes (our enemy) with a snare, the doers of good attain the drinking of the sweet-juiced (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ह॒विर्ह॑विष्मो॒ महि॒ सद्म॒ दैव्यं॒ नभो॒ वसा॑न॒: परि॑ यास्यध्व॒रम् । राजा॑ प॒वित्र॑रथो॒ वाज॒मारु॑हः स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिर्जयसि॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: havíḥ ǀ haviṣmaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ sádma ǀ dáivyam ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ yāsi ǀ adhvarám ǀrā́jā ǀ pavítra-rathaḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhaḥ ǀ sahásra-bhṛṣṭiḥ ǀ jayasi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Possessed of water, you go clothed in the liquid water, to the great celestial abode to (take) the sacrifice; as king you ascend to the battle, mounted to your filter-chariot; armed with a thousand weapons you win (us) abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व देव॒माद॑नो॒ विच॑र्षणिर॒प्सा इन्द्रा॑य॒ वरु॑णाय वा॒यवे॑ । कृ॒धी नो॑ अ॒द्य वरि॑वः स्वस्ति॒मदु॑रुक्षि॒तौ गृ॑णीहि॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ deva-mā́danaḥ ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀ apsā́ḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀkṛdhí ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ várivaḥ ǀ svasti-mát ǀ uru-kṣitáu ǀ gṛṇīhi ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow, the exhilarator of the gods, the far-seeing, the giver of water; forIndra,VaruṇaandVāyu; grant us this day wealth and health; call the celestial people on the spacious ground (of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यस्त॒स्थौ भुव॑ना॒न्यम॑र्त्यो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ सोम॒: परि॒ तान्य॑र्षति । कृ॒ण्वन्त्सं॒चृतं॑ वि॒चृत॑म॒भिष्ट॑य॒ इन्दु॑: सिषक्त्यु॒षसं॒ न सूर्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ tastháu ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pári ǀ tā́ni ǀ arṣati ǀkṛṇván ǀ sam-cṛ́tam ǀ vi-cṛ́tam ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ índuḥ ǀ sisakti ǀ uṣásam ǀ ná ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortalSomawho is stationed upon the worlds, goes round about them all;Indu,binding and unloosing accompanies (the sacrifice) for its protection, as the sun the dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो गोभि॑: सृ॒ज्यत॒ ओष॑धी॒ष्वा दे॒वानां॑ सु॒म्न इ॒षय॒न्नुपा॑वसुः । आ वि॒द्युता॑ पवते॒ धार॑या सु॒त इन्द्रं॒ सोमो॑ मा॒दय॒न्दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ sṛjyáte ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ sumné ǀ iṣáyan ǀ úpa-vasuḥ ǀā́ ǀ vi-dyútā ǀ pavate ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ índram ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mādáyan ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomawho is created by the (sun's) rays, (and whom they plural ce) in the herbs for the gratification of the gods, desiring to go (to the gods), taking wealth from (the foe), flows when effused in a brilliant stream, exhilaratingIndra(and) the people of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य सोम॑: पवते सहस्र॒जिद्धि॑न्वा॒नो वाच॑मिषि॒रामु॑ष॒र्बुध॑म् । इन्दु॑: समु॒द्रमुदि॑यर्ति वा॒युभि॒रेन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्दि॑ क॒लशे॑षु सीदति
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sahasra-jít ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ iṣirā́m ǀ uṣaḥ-búdham ǀínduḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ vāyú-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ sīdati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is theSoma, the conqueror of thousands, who flows stimulating the rapid voice (of the priests), awakened at dawn;Indusends forth his ocean and sinks into the pitchers intoIndra's heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्यं गाव॒: पय॑सा पयो॒वृधं॒ सोमं॑ श्रीणन्ति म॒तिभि॑: स्व॒र्विद॑म् । ध॒नं॒ज॒यः प॑वते॒ कृत्व्यो॒ रसो॒ विप्र॑: क॒विः काव्ये॑ना॒ स्व॑र्चनाः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tyám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ sómam ǀ śrīṇanti ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀdhanam-jayáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ kā́vyena ǀ sváḥ-canāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kine dilute with their milk that milk augmentingSomawho bestows all things by means of praises; (the Soma) the winner of (our foes') wealth flows purified by the rite, apt for the rite, wise, experienced, the (giver of) all food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ सुषु॑त॒: परि॑ स्र॒वापामी॑वा भवतु॒ रक्ष॑सा स॒ह । मा ते॒ रस॑स्य मत्सत द्वया॒विनो॒ द्रवि॑णस्वन्त इ॒ह स॒न्त्विन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ sú-sutaḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ ápa ǀ ámīvā ǀ bhavatu ǀ rákṣasā ǀ sahá ǀmā́ ǀ te ǀ rásasya ǀ matsata ǀ dvayāvínaḥ ǀ dráviṇasvantaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ santu ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow forth,Soma, well-effused forIndra; may disease and therākṣasasbe (kept) far off; let not the double-dealers be exhilarated by your juices; may the Soma-juices be full of wealth at this (sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मान्त्स॑म॒र्ये प॑वमान चोदय॒ दक्षो॑ दे॒वाना॒मसि॒ हि प्रि॒यो मद॑: । ज॒हि शत्रूँ॑र॒भ्या भ॑न्दनाय॒तः पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोम॒मव॑ नो॒ मृधो॑ जहि
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́n ǀ sa-maryé ǀ pavamāna ǀ codaya ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ási ǀ hí ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀjahí ǀ śátrūn ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ bhandanā-yatáḥ ǀ píba ǀ indra ǀ sómam ǀ áva ǀ naḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ jahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified (Soma), animate us in battle; for you are powerful, dear to the gods, the exhilarator. Slay our foes, approach (us) who desire (to propitiate you by) praises;Indra, drink the Soma, destroy our adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद॑ब्ध इन्दो पवसे म॒दिन्त॑म आ॒त्मेन्द्र॑स्य भवसि धा॒सिरु॑त्त॒मः । अ॒भि स्व॑रन्ति ब॒हवो॑ मनी॒षिणो॒ राजा॑नम॒स्य भुव॑नस्य निंसते
shlokas.transliteration: ádabdhaḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pavase ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀ ātmā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ bhavasi ǀ dhāsíḥ ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǀabhí ǀ svaranti ǀ bahávaḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ rā́jānam ǀ asyá ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ niṃsate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You flow,Indu, the inviolable, the most exhilarating; you are yourself the best support forIndra; may sages approach and glorify you the ruler of this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑णीथः श॒तधा॑रो॒ अद्भु॑त॒ इन्द्रा॒येन्दु॑: पवते॒ काम्यं॒ मधु॑ । जय॒न्क्षेत्र॑म॒भ्य॑र्षा॒ जय॑न्न॒प उ॒रुं नो॑ गा॒तुं कृ॑णु सोम मीढ्वः
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-nīthaḥ ǀ śatá-dhāraḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ índuḥ ǀ pavate ǀ kā́myam ǀ mádhu ǀjáyan ǀ kṣétram ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ jáyan ǀ apáḥ ǀ urúm ǀ naḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ kṛṇu ǀ soma ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The guide of thousands, flowing in a hundred streams, marvellous,Induflows forth forIndra, (his) beloved beverage; approach (the filter) winning (us) land, winning water, OSoma, sprinkler, make our path broad.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कनि॑क्रदत्क॒लशे॒ गोभि॑रज्यसे॒ व्य१॒॑व्ययं॑ स॒मया॒ वार॑मर्षसि । म॒र्मृ॒ज्यमा॑नो॒ अत्यो॒ न सा॑न॒सिरिन्द्र॑स्य सोम ज॒ठरे॒ सम॑क्षरः
shlokas.transliteration: kánikradat ǀ kaláśe ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ajyase ǀ ví ǀ avyáyam ǀ samáyā ǀ vā́ram ǀ arṣasi ǀmarmṛjyámānaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sānasíḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ soma ǀ jaṭháre ǀ sám ǀ akṣaraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Crying aloud you are blended in the pitcher with curds and milk, you pass through the woollen fleece in the midst; being cleansed like a horse, distributing (gifts), you flow,Soma, intoIndra's belly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒दुः प॑वस्व दि॒व्याय॒ जन्म॑ने स्वा॒दुरिन्द्रा॑य सु॒हवी॑तुनाम्ने । स्वा॒दुर्मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय वा॒यवे॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ मधु॑माँ॒ अदा॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: svādúḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ divyā́ya ǀ jánmane ǀ svādúḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ suhávītu-nāmne ǀsvādúḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ bṛ́haspátaye ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow sweet for the celestial people, flow sweet forIndra, whose name is worthily invoked; sweet forMitra,Varuṇa,Vāyu,Bṛhaspati, you who are the sweet-flavoured, inviolable.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यं॑ मृजन्ति क॒लशे॒ दश॒ क्षिप॒: प्र विप्रा॑णां म॒तयो॒ वाच॑ ईरते । पव॑माना अ॒भ्य॑र्षन्ति सुष्टु॒तिमेन्द्रं॑ विशन्ति मदि॒रास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: átyam ǀ mṛjanti ǀ kaláśe ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ prá ǀ víprāṇām ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ īrate ǀpávamānāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣanti ǀ su-stutím ǀ ā́ ǀ índram ǀ viśanti ǀ madirā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ten fingers clean the horse in the pitcher; among theviprasthe worshippers send forth praises; the filtered (juices) hasten to the fair praise, the exhilaratingSomajuices enterIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मानो अ॒भ्य॑र्षा सु॒वीर्य॑मु॒र्वीं गव्यू॑तिं॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथ॑: । माकि॑र्नो अ॒स्य परि॑षूतिरीश॒तेन्दो॒ जये॑म॒ त्वया॒ धनं॑धनम्
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ su-vī́ryam ǀ urvī́m ǀ gávyūtim ǀ máhi ǀ śárma ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀmā́kiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pári-sūtiḥ ǀ īśata ǀ índo íti ǀ jáyema ǀ tváyā ǀ dhánam-dhanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), when filtered, bring usmaleprogeny, extensive pastures, a large and spacious mansion; let no hinderer of this (rite) be lord over us;Indu, through you may we win all wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ द्याम॑स्थाद्वृष॒भो वि॑चक्ष॒णोऽरू॑रुच॒द्वि दि॒वो रो॑च॒ना क॒विः । राजा॑ प॒वित्र॒मत्ये॑ति॒ रोरु॑वद्दि॒वः पी॒यूषं॑ दुहते नृ॒चक्ष॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ dyā́m ǀ asthāt ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ árūrucat ǀ ví ǀ diváḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀrā́jā ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ róruvat ǀ diváḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ duhate ǀ nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer, the beholder, has taken his station upon heaven, the seer has illumined the luminaries of heaven; the king passes through the filter with a shout, (theSomajuices) the beholders of men milk forth the ambrosia of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो नाके॒ मधु॑जिह्वा अस॒श्चतो॑ वे॒ना दु॑हन्त्यु॒क्षणं॑ गिरि॒ष्ठाम् । अ॒प्सु द्र॒प्सं वा॑वृधा॒नं स॑मु॒द्र आ सिन्धो॑रू॒र्मा मधु॑मन्तं प॒वित्र॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ nā́ke ǀ mádhu-jihvāḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ duhanti ǀ ukṣáṇam ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀap-sú ǀ drapsám ǀ vavṛdhānám ǀ samudré ǀ ā́ ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ūrmā́ ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǁ
