shlokas.meaning_en: “In the heaven of the bright (ssacrifice) the sweet-voicedVenasseverally milk forth the sprinkler, the mountain-haunting (Soma); (they sprinkle him) nourished in the waters, juicy, in the ocean (-like pitcher), in the wave of the river; (they sprinkle him) sweet-flavoured, in the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाके॑ सुप॒र्णमु॑पपप्ति॒वांसं॒ गिरो॑ वे॒नाना॑मकृपन्त पू॒र्वीः । शिशुं॑ रिहन्ति म॒तय॒: पनि॑प्नतं हिर॒ण्ययं॑ शकु॒नं क्षाम॑णि॒ स्थाम्
shlokas.transliteration: nā́ke ǀ su-parṇám ǀ upapapti-vā́ṃsam ǀ gíraḥ ǀ venā́nām ǀ akṛpanta ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀśíśum ǀ rihanti ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ pánipnatam ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀ śakunám ǀ kṣā́maṇi ǀ sthā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many voices of theVenaspraise (theSomawho dwells) in heaven, well-winged, falling (to earth); praises soothe the crying infant, the golden bird, reposing on the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो ग॑न्ध॒र्वो अधि॒ नाके॑ अस्था॒द्विश्वा॑ रू॒पा प्र॑ति॒चक्षा॑णो अस्य । भा॒नुः शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॒ व्य॑द्यौ॒त्प्रारू॑रुच॒द्रोद॑सी मा॒तरा॒ शुचि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ gandharváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́ke ǀ asthāt ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ ǀ prati-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ asya ǀbhānúḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ prá ǀ arūrucat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ mātárā ǀ śúciḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The elevatedgandharvaabides above the sun contemplating all its forms; the sun shines with white light, radiant he illumines the creative heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र त॑ आ॒शव॑: पवमान धी॒जवो॒ मदा॑ अर्षन्ति रघु॒जा इ॑व॒ त्मना॑ । दि॒व्याः सु॑प॒र्णा मधु॑मन्त॒ इन्द॑वो म॒दिन्त॑मास॒: परि॒ कोश॑मासते
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your (juices), purified (Soma), all-pervading, quick as thought, go of themselves like the offspring of swift (mares); the celestial well-winged sweet-flavoured juices, great exciters of exhilaration, alight upon the receptacle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ मदा॑सो मदि॒रास॑ आ॒शवोऽसृ॑क्षत॒ रथ्या॑सो॒ यथा॒ पृथ॑क् । धे॒नुर्न व॒त्सं पय॑सा॒भि व॒ज्रिण॒मिन्द्र॒मिन्द॑वो॒ मधु॑मन्त ऊ॒र्मय॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your exhilarating, all-pervading juices are let loose separately like chariot-horses; the sweet-flavoured (Soma) waves (go) toIndrathe wilder of the thunderbolt as a cow with her milk to the calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्यो॒ न हि॑या॒नो अ॒भि वाज॑मर्ष स्व॒र्वित्कोशं॑ दि॒वो अद्रि॑मातरम् । वृषा॑ प॒वित्रे॒ अधि॒ सानो॑ अ॒व्यये॒ सोम॑: पुना॒न इ॑न्द्रि॒याय॒ धाय॑से
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a horse urged on to battle, do you who are all-knowing rush from heaven to the receptacle whose mother is the cloud;Somathe showerer (of benefits) is being purified at the top upon the woollen filter forIndra's strength which supports (the world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र त॒ आश्वि॑नीः पवमान धी॒जुवो॑ दि॒व्या अ॑सृग्र॒न्पय॑सा॒ धरी॑मणि । प्रान्तॠष॑य॒: स्थावि॑रीरसृक्षत॒ ये त्वा॑ मृ॒जन्त्यृ॑षिषाण वे॒धस॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified (Soma), your celestial steed-like (streams) as quick as thought are poured along with the milk into the receptacle; the ṛṣis, the ordainers (of sacrifice), who cleanse you, O ṛṣi-enjoyed (Soma), pour your continuous (streams) into the midst (of the vessel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॒ धामा॑नि विश्वचक्ष॒ ऋभ्व॑सः प्र॒भोस्ते॑ स॒तः परि॑ यन्ति के॒तव॑: । व्या॒न॒शिः प॑वसे सोम॒ धर्म॑भि॒: पति॒र्विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य राजसि
shlokas.meaning_en: “All-seeing (Soma), the mighty rays of you, who are the lord, encompass all the sphere; pervading (all things) you flow, Soma, through your functions; you rule lord of the whole world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भ॒यत॒: पव॑मानस्य र॒श्मयो॑ ध्रु॒वस्य॑ स॒तः परि॑ यन्ति के॒तव॑: । यदी॑ प॒वित्रे॒ अधि॑ मृ॒ज्यते॒ हरि॒: सत्ता॒ नि योना॑ क॒लशे॑षु सीदति
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rays, the tokens of the extant, steady, purifiedSoma, circulate from both worlds; when the green-tinted juice is cleansed upon the filter, reposing it alights upon its station, the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुः प॑वते स्वध्व॒रः सोमो॑ दे॒वाना॒मुप॑ याति निष्कृ॒तम् । स॒हस्र॑धार॒: परि॒ कोश॑मर्षति॒ वृषा॑ प॒वित्र॒मत्ये॑ति॒ रोरु॑वत्
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the signal of sacrifice, the object of pious worship, flows filtered; it approaches the abode of the gods; the thousand-streamed rushes to the receptacle, the showerer passes roaring through the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॑ समु॒द्रं न॒द्यो॒३॒॑ वि गा॑हते॒ऽपामू॒र्मिं स॑चते॒ सिन्धु॑षु श्रि॒तः । अध्य॑स्था॒त्सानु॒ पव॑मानो अ॒व्ययं॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या ध॒रुणो॑ म॒हो दि॒वः
shlokas.meaning_en: “The royal (Soma) plural nges into the firmament, (and) the rivers (thereof), mixed with the streams, he associates with the wave of the waters; being filtered he stands upon the uplifted woollen (filter) on the navel of the earth, the upholder of the vast heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न सानु॑ स्त॒नय॑न्नचिक्रद॒द्द्यौश्च॒ यस्य॑ पृथि॒वी च॒ धर्म॑भिः । इन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यं प॑वते वि॒वेवि॑द॒त्सोम॑: पुना॒नः क॒लशे॑षु सीदति
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thundering like the summit of the sky (theSoma) roars, by whose support both heaven and earth, (are upheld); the Soma flows acquiringIndra's friendship, purified he alights upon the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज्योति॑र्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ पवते॒ मधु॑ प्रि॒यं पि॒ता दे॒वानां॑ जनि॒ता वि॒भूव॑सुः । दधा॑ति॒ रत्नं॑ स्व॒धयो॑रपी॒च्यं॑ म॒दिन्त॑मो मत्स॒र इ॑न्द्रि॒यो रस॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “The light of the sacrifice, he distils sweet (juice) delightful (to the gods), the parent of the gods, the genitive rator (of all), possessed of ample wealth; he supports the hidden wealth of heaven and earth, the most exhilarating, the exciting (Soma), the nourisher of (Indra), the juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि॒क्रन्द॑न्क॒लशं॑ वा॒ज्य॑र्षति॒ पति॑र्दि॒वः श॒तधा॑रो विचक्ष॒णः । हरि॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ सद॑नेषु सीदति मर्मृजा॒नोऽवि॑भि॒: सिन्धु॑भि॒र्वृषा॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rapid (Soma), thelord of heaven, the thousand-streamed, the beholder (of all), rushes crying aloud to the pitcher, the green-tinted one alights uponMitra's dwelling plural ce, cleansed by the sheep's hairs and the waters, the shower.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्रे॒ सिन्धू॑नां॒ पव॑मानो अर्ष॒त्यग्रे॑ वा॒चो अ॑ग्रि॒यो गोषु॑ गच्छति । अग्रे॒ वाज॑स्य भजते महाध॒नं स्वा॑यु॒धः सो॒तृभि॑: पूयते॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the front of the waters rushes the filtered (Soma), foremost (he rushes) in the front of the voice, he goes among the rays; in the front he engages in battle (to win) food; well-armed, the showerer (of benefits), he is purified by the offerers of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं म॒तवा॑ञ्छकु॒नो यथा॑ हि॒तोऽव्ये॑ ससार॒ पव॑मान ऊ॒र्मिणा॑ । तव॒ क्रत्वा॒ रोद॑सी अन्त॒रा क॑वे॒ शुचि॑र्धि॒या प॑वते॒ सोम॑ इन्द्र ते
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma) possessed of agreeable (praise) filtered, and sent forth, (quick) as a bird goes with a stream (of juice) through the fleece; by your sustaining act, by your intelligence, sageIndra, the pure Soma flows purified through both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्रा॒पिं वसा॑नो यज॒तो दि॑वि॒स्पृश॑मन्तरिक्ष॒प्रा भुव॑ने॒ष्वर्पि॑तः । स्व॑र्जज्ञा॒नो नभ॑सा॒भ्य॑क्रमीत्प्र॒त्नम॑स्य पि॒तर॒मा वि॑वासति
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wearing a coat of mail reaching to heaven, the adorableSoma, who fills the firmament (with rain), plural ced in the waters, genitive rating heaven,passes with the water, (and) worships its ancient parent (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अ॑स्य वि॒शे महि॒ शर्म॑ यच्छति॒ यो अ॑स्य॒ धाम॑ प्रथ॒मं व्या॑न॒शे । प॒दं यद॑स्य पर॒मे व्यो॑म॒न्यतो॒ विश्वा॑ अ॒भि सं या॑ति सं॒यत॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), who first reachedIndra's glorious body, gives great happiness to the entrance of Indra (that Soma), whose station is in the highest heaven, and through whom (Indra) triumphs in all contests.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो अ॑यासी॒दिन्दु॒रिन्द्र॑स्य निष्कृ॒तं सखा॒ सख्यु॒र्न प्र मि॑नाति सं॒गिर॑म् । मर्य॑ इव युव॒तिभि॒: सम॑र्षति॒ सोम॑: क॒लशे॑ श॒तया॑म्ना प॒था
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indugoes toIndra's abode, the friend leaves not the stomach of his friend; as a young man meets maidens, so theSoma(meets) the pitcher by a hundred pathṣ ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॒ धियो॑ मन्द्र॒युवो॑ विप॒न्युव॑: पन॒स्युव॑: सं॒वस॑नेष्वक्रमुः । सोमं॑ मनी॒षा अ॒भ्य॑नूषत॒ स्तुभो॒ऽभि धे॒नव॒: पय॑सेमशिश्रयुः
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your thoughtful worshippers (Soma), desiring an exhilarating sound, purposing praise, advance into the halls of sacrifice; the praisers the lords of intellect praise Soma, the kine approach him with their milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: सोम सं॒यतं॑ पि॒प्युषी॒मिष॒मिन्दो॒ पव॑स्व॒ पव॑मानो अ॒स्रिध॑म् । या नो॒ दोह॑ते॒ त्रिरह॒न्नस॑श्चुषी क्षु॒मद्वाज॑व॒न्मधु॑मत्सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.meaning_en: “RadiantSoma, when filtered, pour upon us accusative ulated unwasting nutritious food, which is milked for us three times a day, without hindrance, giving forth a sound, yielding strength and delight and fairmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॑ मती॒नां प॑वते विचक्ष॒णः सोमो॒ अह्न॑: प्रतरी॒तोषसो॑ दि॒वः । क्रा॒णा सिन्धू॑नां क॒लशाँ॑ अवीवश॒दिन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्द्या॑वि॒शन्म॑नी॒षिभि॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-obsergantSoma, the showerer (of the desires) of his eulogists, the increase of the day, the dawn, the sun; maker of rivers he desires to enter the pitchers, penetrating toIndra's heart, (praised) by the wise. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒नी॒षिभि॑: पवते पू॒र्व्यः क॒विर्नृभि॑र्य॒तः परि॒ कोशाँ॑ अचिक्रदत् । त्रि॒तस्य॒ नाम॑ ज॒नय॒न्मधु॑ क्षर॒दिन्द्र॑स्य वा॒योः स॒ख्याय॒ कर्त॑वे
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient sage (Soma) is purified by the wise, guided by the priests he roars into the receptacles; genitive rating the water of the threefold (Indra), he distils sweet juice to gain Indra's andVāyu's friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं पु॑ना॒न उ॒षसो॒ वि रो॑चयद॒यं सिन्धु॑भ्यो अभवदु लोक॒कृत् । अ॒यं त्रिः स॒प्त दु॑दुहा॒न आ॒शिरं॒ सोमो॑ हृ॒दे प॑वते॒ चारु॑ मत्स॒रः
shlokas.meaning_en: “(It is) he (who), when purified, illumines the dawn; he the maker of the world is (prosperous) for the rivers; thisSoma, having milked the thrice seven (cows) of their curds and milk, exhilarating, flows plural asantly to (go to) the heart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम दि॒व्येषु॒ धाम॑सु सृजा॒न इ॑न्दो क॒लशे॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ । सीद॒न्निन्द्र॑स्य ज॒ठरे॒ कनि॑क्रद॒न्नृभि॑र्य॒तः सूर्य॒मारो॑हयो दि॒वि
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, to the heavenly abodes; let forth, OIndu, (proceed) to the pitcher, to the filter; alighting uponIndra's belly with a noise, guided by the priests, make the sun ascend the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः प॑वसे प॒वित्र॒ आँ इन्द॒विन्द्र॑स्य ज॒ठरे॑ष्वावि॒शन् । त्वं नृ॒चक्षा॑ अभवो विचक्षण॒ सोम॑ गो॒त्रमङ्गि॑रोभ्योऽवृणो॒रप॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused with the stones, you flow,Indu, into the filter entering the belly ofIndra;Soma, the contemplator, you do look upon man (with affection); you did open the cloud for theaṅgirasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां सो॑म॒ पव॑मानं स्वा॒ध्योऽनु॒ विप्रा॑सो अमदन्नव॒स्यव॑: । त्वां सु॑प॒र्ण आभ॑रद्दि॒वस्परीन्दो॒ विश्वा॑भिर्म॒तिभि॒: परि॑ष्कृतम्
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious worshippers desirous of preservation have glorified you,Soma, when being purified; the hawk brought you from heaven,Indu, adorned with all praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्ये॑ पुना॒नं परि॒ वार॑ ऊ॒र्मिणा॒ हरिं॑ नवन्ते अ॒भि स॒प्त धे॒नव॑: । अ॒पामु॒पस्थे॒ अध्या॒यव॑: क॒विमृ॒तस्य॒ योना॑ महि॒षा अ॑हेषत
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven kine approach the green-tinted (Soma) who flows purified in a stream through the woollen fleece, mighty men urge (you) the sage on the lap of the waters to the plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑: पुना॒नो अति॑ गाहते॒ मृधो॒ विश्वा॑नि कृ॒ण्वन्त्सु॒पथा॑नि॒ यज्य॑वे । गाः कृ॑ण्वा॒नो नि॒र्णिजं॑ हर्य॒तः क॒विरत्यो॒ न क्रीळ॒न्परि॒ वार॑मर्षति
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, purified, plural nges through his foes making all things easy of access to the worshipper; making his body liquid, lovable and wise, he rishes through the filter sporting like a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स॒श्चत॑: श॒तधा॑रा अभि॒श्रियो॒ हरिं॑ नव॒न्तेऽव॒ ता उ॑द॒न्युव॑: । क्षिपो॑ मृजन्ति॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑तं तृ॒तीये॑ पृ॒ष्ठे अधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वः
shlokas.meaning_en: “Separate, hundred-streamed, commingling (with theSoma), water-desiring, (the sun's rays) approach the green-tinted (Soma); the fingers cleanse him pervaded by rays, in the third sphere illumined by the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवे॒माः प्र॒जा दि॒व्यस्य॒ रेत॑स॒स्त्वं विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य राजसि । अथे॒दं विश्वं॑ पवमान ते॒ वशे॒ त्वमि॑न्दो प्रथ॒मो धा॑म॒धा अ॑सि
shlokas.meaning_en: “All these are the offspring of your celestial effluence; you are the ruler of the whole world; so, purified (Soma) this universe is in subjection to you; you,Indu, are the foremost, the supporter of the house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं स॑मु॒द्रो अ॑सि विश्व॒वित्क॑वे॒ तवे॒माः पञ्च॑ प्र॒दिशो॒ विध॑र्मणि । त्वं द्यां च॑ पृथि॒वीं चाति॑ जभ्रिषे॒ तव॒ ज्योतीं॑षि पवमान॒ सूर्य॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, O sage, are the ocean, you are omniscient; these five regions (rest) on your support; you sustain both heaven and earth; the sun, OPavamāna(nourishes) your luminaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं प॒वित्रे॒ रज॑सो॒ विध॑र्मणि दे॒वेभ्य॑: सोम पवमान पूयसे । त्वामु॒शिज॑: प्रथ॒मा अ॑गृभ्णत॒ तुभ्ये॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि येमिरे
shlokas.meaning_en: “PurifiedSoma, you are purified for the gods in the filter the supporter of the worlds; the chief (priests) desiring (you) lay hold (of you), all these worlds offer themselves to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र रे॒भ ए॒त्यति॒ वार॑म॒व्ययं॒ वृषा॒ वने॒ष्वव॑ चक्रद॒द्धरि॑: । सं धी॒तयो॑ वावशा॒ना अ॑नूषत॒ शिशुं॑ रिहन्ति म॒तय॒: पनि॑प्नतम्
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sounding (Soma) passes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted showerer cries in the waters; the worshippers desiring (the Soma) praise him together, the laudations soothe the infant as he cries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॒: परि॑ व्यत॒ तन्तुं॑ तन्वा॒नस्त्रि॒वृतं॒ यथा॑ वि॒दे । नय॑न्नृ॒तस्य॑ प्र॒शिषो॒ नवी॑यसी॒: पति॒र्जनी॑ना॒मुप॑ याति निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.meaning_en: “He invests himself with the rays of the sun stretching out the triple thread in the way he knows; guiding the recent adorations of the truthful (worshipper), the protection of women passes to the consecrated (vessel).”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॒ सिन्धू॑नां पवते॒ पति॑र्दि॒व ऋ॒तस्य॑ याति प॒थिभि॒: कनि॑क्रदत् । स॒हस्र॑धार॒: परि॑ षिच्यते॒ हरि॑: पुना॒नो वाचं॑ ज॒नय॒न्नुपा॑वसुः
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sovereign of rivers flows pure, the lord of heaven goes with a shout by the paths of the sacrifice; the thousand-streamed green-tinted (Soma) is poured out, uttering a sound while being filtered, the bringer of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ मह्यर्णो॒ वि धा॑वसि॒ सूरो॒ न चि॒त्रो अव्य॑यानि॒ पव्य॑या । गभ॑स्तिपूतो॒ नृभि॒रद्रि॑भिः सु॒तो म॒हे वाजा॑य॒ धन्या॑य धन्वसि
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified (Soma), you pour forth abundant juice; like the wonderful sun (you approach) the fleecy filters; purified by thehandsof the priests, expressed with the stones you flow for a mighty wealth-yielding conflict.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इष॒मूर्जं॑ पवमाना॒भ्य॑र्षसि श्ये॒नो न वंसु॑ क॒लशे॑षु सीदसि । इन्द्रा॑य॒ मद्वा॒ मद्यो॒ मद॑: सु॒तो दि॒वो वि॑ष्ट॒म्भ उ॑प॒मो वि॑चक्ष॒णः
shlokas.meaning_en: “You rush,Pavamāna, to (bring) food and strength; you alight on the pitchers like a falcon on its nest; (you) the exhilarating effused juice giving exhilaration toIndra, resembling the support of heaven, beholding (all things).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त स्वसा॑रो अ॒भि मा॒तर॒: शिशुं॒ नवं॑ जज्ञा॒नं जेन्यं॑ विप॒श्चित॑म् । अ॒पां ग॑न्ध॒र्वं दि॒व्यं नृ॒चक्ष॑सं॒ सोमं॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य रा॒जसे॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven sister mothers approach the new-born, victorious sagacious infant,Soma, abiding amidst the waters, supporter of water, divine the contemplator of men to make him the ruler of the whole world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒शा॒न इ॒मा भुव॑नानि॒ वीय॑से युजा॒न इ॑न्दो ह॒रित॑: सुप॒र्ण्य॑: । तास्ते॑ क्षरन्तु॒ मधु॑मद्घृ॒तं पय॒स्तव॑ व्र॒ते सो॑म तिष्ठन्तु कृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, who are the lord, you go (through) threse worlds, harnessing (to the car) your swift-moving steeds; let them dispense the sweet-flavoured shining liquor, may all men be presentSoma, at your worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नृ॒चक्षा॑ असि सोम वि॒श्वत॒: पव॑मान वृषभ॒ ता वि धा॑वसि । स न॑: पवस्व॒ वसु॑म॒द्धिर॑ण्यवद्व॒यं स्या॑म॒ भुव॑नेषु जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, are everywhere, the contemplator of men; you,Pavamāna, the showerer, hasten to these (waters); do you pour forth upon us (wealth), comprising various treasures and gold; may we be (able) to live in the worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गो॒वित्प॑वस्व वसु॒विद्धि॑रण्य॒विद्रे॑तो॒धा इ॑न्दो॒ भुव॑ने॒ष्वर्पि॑तः । त्वं सु॒वीरो॑ असि सोम विश्व॒वित्तं त्वा॒ विप्रा॒ उप॑ गि॒रेम आ॑सते
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Indu, who are the winner of cattle, wealth, and gold, the fructifier, plural ced upon the waters; you,Soma, are a hero, omniscient; you these sages approach with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उन्मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिर्व॒नना॑ अतिष्ठिपद॒पो वसा॑नो महि॒षो वि गा॑हते । राजा॑ प॒वित्र॑रथो॒ वाज॒मारु॑हत्स॒हस्र॑भृष्टिर्जयति॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हत्
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wave of the swee-flavoured (Soma) exfites voices (of praise); clothed in water the mighty one plural nges (into the pitcher); the king whose chariot is the filter mounts for the conflict, and, armed with a thousand weapons, wins ample sustenance (for us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स भ॒न्दना॒ उदि॑यर्ति प्र॒जाव॑तीर्वि॒श्वायु॒र्विश्वा॑: सु॒भरा॒ अह॑र्दिवि । ब्रह्म॑ प्र॒जाव॑द्र॒यिमश्व॑पस्त्यं पी॒त इ॑न्द॒विन्द्र॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ याचतात्
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-pervading (Soma) exfites both day and night all praises easily borne, productive of prosperity;Indu, when drunk, solicitIndra(to give) us food productive of progeny and riches filling our homes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो अग्रे॒ अह्नां॒ हरि॑र्हर्य॒तो मद॒: प्र चेत॑सा चेतयत॒त अनु॒ द्युभि॑: । द्वा जना॑ या॒तय॑न्न॒न्तरी॑यते॒ नरा॑ च॒ शंसं॒ दैव्यं॑ च ध॒र्तरि॑
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the beginning of the day the green-tinted delightful exhilarating (Soma) is recognized by the intelligence (of the praisers) and by their praises; approaching the two men he passes in the midst (of heaven and earth, bestowing) upon the upholder (of the rite) both human and divine (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ञ्जते॒ व्य॑ञ्जते॒ सम॑ञ्जते॒ क्रतुं॑ रिहन्ति॒ मधु॑ना॒भ्य॑ञ्जते । सिन्धो॑रुच्छ्वा॒से प॒तय॑न्तमु॒क्षणं॑ हिरण्यपा॒वाः प॒शुमा॑सु गृभ्णते
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) smear and grease and anoint (theSomawith milk); (the gods) taste the invigorating (juice); they smear it over with sweet (milk). Purifying it with gold, they plural nge it into those (waters) the sprinkler, the beholder, falling into the seething torrent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒प॒श्चिते॒ पव॑मानाय गायत म॒ही न धारात्यन्धो॑ अर्षति । अहि॒र्न जू॒र्णामति॑ सर्पति॒ त्वच॒मत्यो॒ न क्रीळ॑न्नसर॒द्वृषा॒ हरि॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing (you priests) to the intelligentPavamāna; like a mighty shower he sends forth food; like a snake he glides out of his old skin, sporting like a horse he hastens forth, the showerer, green-tinted.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्रे॒गो राजाप्य॑स्तविष्यते वि॒मानो॒ अह्नां॒ भुव॑ने॒ष्वर्पि॑तः । हरि॑र्घृ॒तस्नु॑: सु॒दृशी॑को अर्ण॒वो ज्यो॒तीर॑थः पवते रा॒य ओ॒क्य॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) going foremost, radiant, sanctified by water, plural ced in the firmament as the measure of days is glorified; green-tinted, shedding water, of goodly aspect, the source of moisture, borne in a chariot of light he flows giving wealth, friendly to the house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑र्जि स्क॒म्भो दि॒व उद्य॑तो॒ मद॒: परि॑ त्रि॒धातु॒र्भुव॑नान्यर्षति । अं॒शुं रि॑हन्ति म॒तय॒: पनि॑प्नतं गि॒रा यदि॑ नि॒र्णिज॑मृ॒ग्मिणो॑ य॒युः
shlokas.meaning_en: “The supporter of heaven the prepared exhilarating (Soma) is let loose, the triple (beverage) rushes to the waters; the worshippers taste the sounding Soma juice, when the reciters of holy texts approach the embodied (beverage) with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ धारा॒ अत्यण्वा॑नि मे॒ष्य॑: पुना॒नस्य॑ सं॒यतो॑ यन्ति॒ रंह॑यः । यद्गोभि॑रिन्दो च॒म्वो॑: सम॒ज्यस॒ आ सु॑वा॒नः सो॑म क॒लशे॑षु सीदसि
shlokas.meaning_en: “The rapid streams of you when you are purified,being collected together pass through the interstices of the fleece; when you are mixed with water in the ladles, you,Soma, on being effused alight on the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम क्रतु॒विन्न॑ उ॒क्थ्योऽव्यो॒ वारे॒ परि॑ धाव॒ मधु॑ प्रि॒यम् । ज॒हि विश्वा॑न्र॒क्षस॑ इन्दो अ॒त्रिणो॑ बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow for us,Soma, cognizant of (our) worship and deserving praise; pour (your) beloved sweet-flavoured (juice) upon the woollen fleece; slay,Indu, all the voraciousrākṣasas; blessed with excellentmaleoffspring may we offer ample (praises) at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र तु द्र॑व॒ परि॒ कोशं॒ नि षी॑द॒ नृभि॑: पुना॒नो अ॒भि वाज॑मर्ष । अश्वं॒ न त्वा॑ वा॒जिनं॑ म॒र्जय॒न्तोऽच्छा॑ ब॒र्ही र॑श॒नाभि॑र्नयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tú ǀ drava ǀ pári ǀ kóśam ǀ ní ǀ sīda ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣa ǀáśvam ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ vājínam ǀ marjáyantaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ barhíḥ ǀ raśanā́bhiḥ ǀ nayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow fast (Soma), sit down on the receptacle, purified by the priests hasten (showing) food (to the sacrificer); cleansing you like a strong horse, they guide you with (their fingers for) reins to the sacred grass.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒यु॒धः प॑वते दे॒व इन्दु॑रशस्ति॒हा वृ॒जनं॒ रक्ष॑माणः । पि॒ता दे॒वानां॑ जनि॒ता सु॒दक्षो॑ विष्ट॒म्भो दि॒वो ध॒रुण॑: पृथि॒व्याः
shlokas.transliteration: su-āyudháḥ ǀ pavate ǀ deváḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ aśasti-hā́ ǀ vṛjánam ǀ rákṣamāṇaḥ ǀpitā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ janitā́ ǀ su-dákṣaḥ ǀ viṣṭambháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine,Induwell-armed flows forth, the destroyer ofrākṣasas, averting calamity, the protector of the gods, the progenitor, the powerful one, the prop of heaven, the support of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषि॒र्विप्र॑: पुरए॒ता जना॑नामृ॒भुर्धीर॑ उ॒शना॒ काव्ये॑न । स चि॑द्विवेद॒ निहि॑तं॒ यदा॑सामपी॒च्यं१॒॑ गुह्यं॒ नाम॒ गोना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ jánānām ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ uśánā ǀ kā́vyena ǀsáḥ ǀ cit ǀ viveda ǀ ní-hitam ǀ yát ǀ āsām ǀ apīcyám ǀ gúhyam ǀ nā́ma ǀ gónām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ṛṣi, the sage, the foremost of men, the far-shining intelligent Uṣanas-- he verily by his poetic gift discovered the secret milk of those cows which was hidden and concealed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य ते॒ मधु॑माँ इन्द्र॒ सोमो॒ वृषा॒ वृष्णे॒ परि॑ प॒वित्रे॑ अक्षाः । स॒ह॒स्र॒साः श॑त॒सा भू॑रि॒दावा॑ शश्वत्त॒मं ब॒र्हिरा वा॒ज्य॑स्थात्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ pári ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣāríti ǀsahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ śata-sā́ḥ ǀ bhūri-dā́vā ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vājī́ ǀ asthāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Indra, the showerer, this sweet-flavouredSomathe showerer has been poured into the filter; the giver of thousand-fold wealth, the giver of hundred-fold wealth, the giver of abundant wealth, the powerful is present at the eternal sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॑ अ॒भि ग॒व्या स॒हस्रा॑ म॒हे वाजा॑या॒मृता॑य॒ श्रवां॑सि । प॒वित्रे॑भि॒: पव॑माना असृग्रञ्छ्रव॒स्यवो॒ न पृ॑त॒नाजो॒ अत्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gavyā́ ǀ sahásrā ǀ mahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀpavítrebhiḥ ǀ pávamānāḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pṛtanā́jaḥ ǀ átyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheseSoma-juices, (going towards) the thousand viands produced by the kine, purified, by the filters, are let loose for ample food and ambrosia, desiring food like horses victorious over a host.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ हि ष्मा॑ पुरुहू॒तो जना॑नां॒ विश्वास॑र॒द्भोज॑ना पू॒यमा॑नः । अथा भ॑र श्येनभृत॒ प्रयां॑सि र॒यिं तुञ्जा॑नो अ॒भि वाज॑मर्ष
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ víśvā ǀ ásarat ǀ bhójanā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀátha ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ śyena-bhṛta ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ rayím ǀ túñjānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked by many, theSoma, undergoing purification, pours forth all food (for the sake of men); falcon-borne, bring us food, conveying wealth send forth your juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष सु॑वा॒नः परि॒ सोम॑: प॒वित्रे॒ सर्गो॒ न सृ॒ष्टो अ॑दधाव॒दर्वा॑ । ति॒ग्मे शिशा॑नो महि॒षो न शृङ्गे॒ गा ग॒व्यन्न॒भि शूरो॒ न सत्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ pári ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ sárgaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sṛṣṭáḥ ǀ adadhāvat ǀ árvā ǀtigmé íti ǀ śíśānaḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ ná ǀ śṛ́ṅge íti ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ gavyán ǀ abhí ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ sátvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When effused, this quick-flowingSomahastens to the filter like a steed let loose; while alighting he moves like a buffalo sharpening his pointed horns, like a warrior on a foray for cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒षा य॑यौ पर॒माद॒न्तरद्रे॒: कूचि॑त्स॒तीरू॒र्वे गा वि॑वेद । दि॒वो न वि॒द्युत्स्त॒नय॑न्त्य॒भ्रैः सोम॑स्य ते पवत इन्द्र॒ धारा॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ yayau ǀ paramā́t ǀ antáḥ ǀ ádreḥ ǀ kū́-cit ǀ satī́ḥ ǀ ūrvé ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ viveda ǀdiváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vi-dyút ǀ stanáyantī ǀ abhráiḥ ǀ sómasya ǀ te ǀ pavate ǀ indra ǀ dhā́rā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomastream has come from on high and has detected the cattle which were in a stall (hidden) somewhere within the mountain; the stream of the Soma flows for you,Indra, thundering like lightning emitted by the clouds from heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त स्म॑ रा॒शिं परि॑ यासि॒ गोना॒मिन्द्रे॑ण सोम स॒रथं॑ पुना॒नः । पू॒र्वीरिषो॑ बृह॒तीर्जी॑रदानो॒ शिक्षा॑ शचीव॒स्तव॒ ता उ॑प॒ष्टुत्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ sma ǀ rāśím ǀ pári ǀ yāsi ǀ gónām ǀ índreṇa ǀ soma ǀ sa-rátham ǀ punānáḥ ǀpūrvī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ jīradāno íti jīra-dāno ǀ śíkṣa ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ táva ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ upa-stút ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And being purified,Soma, you pursue the herd of (stolen) cattle in the same chariot withIndra; O you who give quickly, give (us) when invoked plural ntiful and abundant viands, for they are your (property) O you who abound in food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं सोम॑ इन्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॑ सुन्वे॒ तुभ्यं॑ पवते॒ त्वम॑स्य पाहि । त्वं ह॒ यं च॑कृ॒षे त्वं व॑वृ॒ष इन्दुं॒ मदा॑य॒ युज्या॑य॒ सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ sunve ǀ túbhyam ǀ pavate ǀ tvám ǀ asya ǀ pāhi ǀtvám ǀ ha ǀ yám ǀ cakṛṣé ǀ tvám ǀ vavṛṣé ǀ índum ǀ mádāya ǀ yújyāya ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomais expressed for you,Indra; for you is filtered; do you drink of it; it is theInduSoma which you have made, which you have chosen for your exhilaration, your companion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॒ रथो॒ न भु॑रि॒षाळ॑योजि म॒हः पु॒रूणि॑ सा॒तये॒ वसू॑नि । आदीं॒ विश्वा॑ नहु॒ष्या॑णि जा॒ता स्व॑र्षाता॒ वन॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वा न॑वन्त
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īmíti ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhuriṣā́ṭ ǀ ayoji ǀ maháḥ ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ sātáye ǀ vásūni ǀā́t ǀ īmíti ǀ víśvā ǀ nahuṣyā́ṇi ǀ jātā́ ǀ sváḥ-sātā ǀ váne ǀ ūrdhvā́ ǀ navanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It has been harnessed like a great wagon that bears heavy burdens in order to bring us many treasures; after this may all the races of men expecting our (attack) go to the desirable battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒युर्न यो नि॒युत्वाँ॑ इ॒ष्टया॑मा॒ नास॑त्येव॒ हव॒ आ शम्भ॑विष्ठः । वि॒श्ववा॑रो द्रविणो॒दा इ॑व॒ त्मन्पू॒षेव॑ धी॒जव॑नोऽसि सोम
shlokas.transliteration: vāyúḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ niyútvān ǀ iṣṭá-yāmā ǀ nā́satyā-iva ǀ háve ǀ ā́ ǀ śám-bhaviṣṭhaḥ ǀviśvá-vāraḥ ǀ draviṇodā́ḥ-iva ǀ tmán ǀ pūṣā́-iva ǀ dhī-jávanaḥ ǀ asi ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, who likeVāyuwith hisNiyutsteeds go where you list, who like theNāsatyāson hearing the invocation do grant abundant felicity, you are of yourself desired by all like the giver of wealth, you are likePūṣan, swift as thought.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ न यो म॒हा कर्मा॑णि॒ चक्रि॑र्ह॒न्ता वृ॒त्राणा॑मसि सोम पू॒र्भित् । पै॒द्वो न हि त्वमहि॑नाम्नां ह॒न्ता विश्व॑स्यासि सोम॒ दस्यो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ mahā́ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ cákriḥ ǀ hantā́ ǀ vṛtrā́ṇām ǀ asi ǀ soma ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀpaidváḥ ǀ ná ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ áhi-nāmnām ǀ hantā́ ǀ víśvasya ǀ asi ǀ soma ǀ dásyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Soma, who likeIndraperform mighty acts, are the slayer of theVṛtras, the destroyer of those who are called serpents; you are the slayer of everyDasyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्न यो वन॒ आ सृ॒ज्यमा॑नो॒ वृथा॒ पाजां॑सि कृणुते न॒दीषु॑ । जनो॒ न युध्वा॑ मह॒त उ॑प॒ब्दिरिय॑र्ति॒ सोम॒: पव॑मान ऊ॒र्मिम्
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjyámānaḥ ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pā́jāṃsi ǀ kṛṇute ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀjánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yúdhvā ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ upabdíḥ ǀ íyarti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ūrmím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somawho, likeAgnilet loose in a forest, easily manifests his might in the waters like a man who fights shouting against his mighty (foe)-- so Soma when purified urges on his wave.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते सोमा॒ अति॒ वारा॒ण्यव्या॑ दि॒व्या न कोशा॑सो अ॒भ्रव॑र्षाः । वृथा॑ समु॒द्रं सिन्ध॑वो॒ न नीची॑: सु॒तासो॑ अ॒भि क॒लशाँ॑ असृग्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ sómāḥ ǀ áti ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ ávyā ǀ divyā́ ǀ ná ǀ kóśāsaḥ ǀ abhrá-varṣāḥ ǀvṛ́thā ǀ samudrám ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ nī́cīḥ ǀ sutā́saḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kaláśān ǀ asṛgran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheseSoma-juices pass through the woollen fleece, like the rains of heaven showered by the clouds; the effused juices flow promptly to the pitchers as rivers running downwards (flow) into the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒ष्मी शर्धो॒ न मारु॑तं पव॒स्वान॑भिशस्ता दि॒व्या यथा॒ विट् । आपो॒ न म॒क्षू सु॑म॒तिर्भ॑वा नः स॒हस्रा॑प्साः पृतना॒षाण्न य॒ज्ञः
shlokas.transliteration: śuṣmī́ ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ mā́rutam ǀ pavasva ǀ ánabhi-śastā ǀ divyā́ ǀ yáthā ǀ víṭ ǀā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ makṣú ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhava ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásra-apsāḥ ǀ pṛtanāṣā́ṭ ǀ ná ǀ yajñáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow strong as the army of theMaruts, like the divine blameless folk; like waters become quickly favourable to us; (you are) of a thousand shapes, adorable like (Indra) the victor in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राज्ञो॒ नु ते॒ वरु॑णस्य व्र॒तानि॑ बृ॒हद्ग॑भी॒रं तव॑ सोम॒ धाम॑ । शुचि॒ष्ट्वम॑सि प्रि॒यो न मि॒त्रो द॒क्षाय्यो॑ अर्य॒मेवा॑सि सोम
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jñaḥ ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ váruṇasya ǀ vratā́ni ǀ bṛhát ǀ gabhīrám ǀ táva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma ǀśúciḥ ǀ tvám ǀ asi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mitráḥ ǀ dakṣā́yyaḥ ǀ aryamā́-iva ǀ asi ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your acts are (like) those of the royalVaruṇa, vast and profound,Soma, is your abode; you are pure as the belovedMitra, munificent are you, Soma, asAryaman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो स्य वह्नि॑: प॒थ्या॑भिरस्यान्दि॒वो न वृ॒ष्टिः पव॑मानो अक्षाः । स॒हस्र॑धारो असद॒न्न्य१॒॑स्मे मा॒तुरु॒पस्थे॒ वन॒ आ च॒ सोम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ syáḥ ǀ váhniḥ ǀ pathyā́bhiḥ ǀ asyān ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ asadat ǀ ní ǀ asmé íti ǀ mātúḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ váne ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ sómaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This horse of burden moves forth by the (sacrificial) paths; when purified you flow like the rain from heaven; the thousand-streamedSomasits down among us on his mother's lap in the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: राजा॒ सिन्धू॑नामवसिष्ट॒ वास॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ नाव॒मारु॑ह॒द्रजि॑ष्ठाम् । अ॒प्सु द्र॒प्सो वा॑वृधे श्ये॒नजू॑तो दु॒ह ईं॑ पि॒ता दु॒ह ईं॑ पि॒तुर्जाम्
shlokas.transliteration: rā́jā ǀ síndhūnām ǀ avasiṣṭa ǀ vā́saḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ nā́vam ǀ ā́ ǀ aruhat ǀ rájiṣṭhām ǀap-sú ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ śyená-jūtaḥ ǀ duhé ǀ īm ǀ pitā́ ǀ duhé ǀ īm ǀ pitúḥ ǀ jā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sovereignSomahas put on the vestment of the waters, he has ascended the most straight-going ship of sacrifice; the dripping juice brought by the falcon has increased in the water; the father milks him-- milks him the son of the father.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सिं॒हं न॑सन्त॒ मध्वो॑ अ॒यासं॒ हरि॑मरु॒षं दि॒वो अ॒स्य पति॑म् । शूरो॑ यु॒त्सु प्र॑थ॒मः पृ॑च्छते॒ गा अस्य॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ परि॑ पात्यु॒क्षा
shlokas.transliteration: siṃhám ǀ nasanta ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ ayā́sam ǀ hárim ǀ aruṣám ǀ diváḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pátim ǀśū́raḥ ǀ yut-sú ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ pṛcchate ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ásya ǀ cákṣasā ǀ pári ǀ pāti ǀ ukṣā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The worshippers) reach the lion-like (Soma) the dispenser of water, green-tinted, red, the protector of this heaven; a hero in battles, first (among the gods) he seeks the (stolen) cows; by his might the sprinkler (Indra) protects (the universe).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑पृष्ठं घो॒रम॒यास॒मश्वं॒ रथे॑ युञ्जन्त्युरुच॒क्र ऋ॒ष्वम् । स्वसा॑र ईं जा॒मयो॑ मर्जयन्ति॒ सना॑भयो वा॒जिन॑मूर्जयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu-pṛṣṭham ǀ ghorám ǀ ayā́sam ǀ áśvam ǀ ráthe ǀ yuñjanti ǀ uru-cakré ǀ ṛṣvám ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ īm ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ marjayanti ǀ sá-nābhayaḥ ǀ vājínam ǀ ūrjayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) attach to the broad-wheeled car the glossy-backed terrible active graceful horse; the sister fingers cleanse him; the kinsfolk invigorate the mighty (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: चत॑स्र ईं घृत॒दुह॑: सचन्ते समा॒ने अ॒न्तर्ध॒रुणे॒ निष॑त्ताः । ता ई॑मर्षन्ति॒ नम॑सा पुना॒नास्ता ईं॑ वि॒श्वत॒: परि॑ षन्ति पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: cátasraḥ ǀ īm ǀ ghṛta-dúhaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ samāné ǀ antáḥ ǀ dharúṇe ǀ ní-sattāḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ arṣanti ǀ námasā ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ pári ǀ santi ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The four yielders of butter wait upon him, stationed in a common asylum; being purified they approach him with food, they surround him in numbers on every side.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒ष्ट॒म्भो दि॒वो ध॒रुण॑: पृथि॒व्या विश्वा॑ उ॒त क्षि॒तयो॒ हस्ते॑ अस्य । अस॑त्त॒ उत्सो॑ गृण॒ते नि॒युत्वा॒न्मध्वो॑ अं॒शुः प॑वत इन्द्रि॒याय॑
shlokas.transliteration: viṣṭambháḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ háste ǀ asya ǀásat ǀ te ǀ útsaḥ ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ niyútvān ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ pavate ǀ indriyā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The prop of heaven, the support of earth-- all beings (are) in hishands; may (Soma) the fountain (of desires) be possessed of horses for you (his) adorer; the filament of the sweet-flavoured (Soma) is purified for (the sake of winning) strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒न्वन्नवा॑तो अ॒भि दे॒ववी॑ति॒मिन्द्रा॑य सोम वृत्र॒हा प॑वस्व । श॒ग्धि म॒हः पु॑रुश्च॒न्द्रस्य॑ रा॒यः सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: vanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ devá-vītim ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ pavasva ǀśagdhí ǀ maháḥ ǀ puru-candrásya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conquering (and) unconquered approach the banquet of the gods;Soma, who are the slayer ofVṛtra, flow forIndra; grant us abundant and splendid riches, may we be masters of excellentmaleoffspring. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र हि॑न्वा॒नो ज॑नि॒ता रोद॑स्यो॒ रथो॒ न वाजं॑ सनि॒ष्यन्न॑यासीत् । इन्द्रं॒ गच्छ॒न्नायु॑धा सं॒शिशा॑नो॒ विश्वा॒ वसु॒ हस्त॑योरा॒दधा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ janitā́ ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́jam ǀ saniṣyán ǀ ayāsīt ǀíndram ǀ gácchan ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ sam-śíśānaḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ vásu ǀ hástayoḥ ǀ ā-dádhānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Urged (by the priests) the genitive rator of heaven and earth advances like a chariot, wishing to distribute food; going toIndra, sharpening his weapons, holding all treasures in hishands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि त्रि॑पृ॒ष्ठं वृष॑णं वयो॒धामा॑ङ्गू॒षाणा॑मवावशन्त॒ वाणी॑: । वना॒ वसा॑नो॒ वरु॑णो॒ न सिन्धू॒न्वि र॑त्न॒धा द॑यते॒ वार्या॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ tri-pṛṣṭhám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́m ǀ āṅgūṣā́ṇām ǀ avāvaśanta ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀvánā ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhūn ǀ ví ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ dayate ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The voices of the worshippers resound about him the triple-backed, the showerer (of benefits), the giver of food; arrayed in water asVaruṇa(is arrayed) in the rivers, the giver of precious wealth he bestows desirable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शूर॑ग्राम॒: सर्व॑वीर॒: सहा॑वा॒ञ्जेता॑ पवस्व॒ सनि॑ता॒ धना॑नि । ति॒ग्मायु॑धः क्षि॒प्रध॑न्वा स॒मत्स्वषा॑ळ्हः सा॒ह्वान्पृत॑नासु॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śū́ra-grāmaḥ ǀ sárva-vīraḥ ǀ sáhāvān ǀ jétā ǀ pavasva ǀ sánitā ǀ dhánāni ǀtigmá-āyudhaḥ ǀ kṣiprá-dhanvā ǀ samát-su ǀ áṣāḷhaḥ ǀ sahvā́n ǀ pṛ́tanāsu ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow you who have a host of warriors, who have all the heroes, full of strength, victorious, the giver of riches, sharp-weaponed, rapid bowman, irresistible in battle, overthrowing the enemy (arrayed) in (hostile) armies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रुग॑व्यूति॒रभ॑यानि कृ॒ण्वन्त्स॑मीची॒ने आ प॑वस्वा॒ पुरं॑धी । अ॒पः सिषा॑सन्नु॒षस॒: स्व१॒॑र्गाः सं चि॑क्रदो म॒हो अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: urú-gavyūtiḥ ǀ ábhayāni ǀ kṛṇván ǀ samīcīné íti sam-īcīné ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ púrandhī íti púram-dhī ǀapáḥ ǀ sísāsan ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ cikradaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow you whose paths are broad, giving security (to the worshipper), uniting heaven and earth, wishing to enjoy the waters of dawn, the sun and (his) rays you cry aloud, ( to bestow upon) us ample food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मत्सि॑ सोम॒ वरु॑णं॒ मत्सि॑ मि॒त्रं मत्सीन्द्र॑मिन्दो पवमान॒ विष्णु॑म् । मत्सि॒ शर्धो॒ मारु॑तं॒ मत्सि॑ दे॒वान्मत्सि॑ म॒हामिन्द्र॑मिन्दो॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: mátsi ǀ soma ǀ váruṇam ǀ mátsi ǀ mitrám ǀ mátsi ǀ índram ǀ indo íti ǀ pavamāna ǀ víṣṇum ǀmátsi ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ mátsi ǀ devā́n ǀ mátsi ǀ mahā́m ǀ índram ǀ indo íti ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, exhilarateVaruṇa, exhilarateMitra; O SomaPavamāna, exhilarateIndraandViṣṇu, exhilarate the company of theMaruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate the mighty Indra, OIndu, for his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा राजे॑व॒ क्रतु॑माँ॒ अमे॑न॒ विश्वा॒ घनि॑घ्नद्दुरि॒ता प॑वस्व । इन्दो॑ सू॒क्ताय॒ वच॑से॒ वयो॑ धा यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ rā́jā-iva ǀ krátu-mān ǀ ámena ǀ víśvā ǀ ghánighnat ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ pavasva ǀíndo íti ǀ su-uktā́ya ǀ vácase ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus (glorified), to you (Soma) like a king, performing your functions, flow on destroying all evils by your might;Indu, give food (in answer) to (our) well-recited praise; do you (O gods) cherish us ever with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑र्जि॒ वक्वा॒ रथ्ये॒ यथा॒जौ धि॒या म॒नोता॑ प्रथ॒मो म॑नी॒षी । दश॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ अधि॒ सानो॒ अव्येऽज॑न्ति॒ वह्निं॒ सद॑ना॒न्यच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ásarji ǀ vákvā ǀ ráthye ǀ yáthā ǀ ājáu ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ manótā ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ manīṣī́ ǀdáśa ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ ájanti ǀ váhnim ǀ sádanāni ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) on whom the minds of the gods are fixed, chief (of the gods), recipient of praise, is let loose with a shout by ceremony as (a horse is let loose by the finger) in a battle of chariots; the ten sister (fingers) drive the bearer (of the oblation) on the elevated plural ce to the halls (of sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वी॒ती जन॑स्य दि॒व्यस्य॑ क॒व्यैरधि॑ सुवा॒नो न॑हु॒ष्ये॑भि॒रिन्दु॑: । प्र यो नृभि॑र॒मृतो॒ मर्त्ये॑भिर्मर्मृजा॒नोऽवि॑भि॒र्गोभि॑र॒द्भिः
shlokas.transliteration: vītī́ ǀ jánasya ǀ divyásya ǀ kavyáiḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ nahuṣyébhiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀprá ǀ yáḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyebhiḥ ǀ marmṛjānáḥ ǀ ávi-bhiḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuice effused by pious mortals (comes) down (to the sacrifice) for the food of the celestial people; which immortal (beverage) is purified by mortal (priests) with the filter, the curds and milk and the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ वृष्णे॒ रोरु॑वदं॒शुर॑स्मै॒ पव॑मानो॒ रुश॑दीर्ते॒ पयो॒ गोः । स॒हस्र॒मृक्वा॑ प॒थिभि॑र्वचो॒विद॑ध्व॒स्मभि॒: सूरो॒ अण्वं॒ वि या॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ róruvat ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ asmai ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ rúśat ǀ īrte ǀ páyaḥ ǀ góḥ ǀsahásram ǀ ṛ́kvā ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ vacaḥ-vít ǀ adhvasmá-bhiḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ áṇvam ǀ ví ǀ yāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuice the showerer (of benefits) roaring to the showerer (Indra) goes when being purified to (mix with) the glistening milk of the cow; greeted with laudation, cognizant of sacred praise, the hero passes through the filter by a thousand imperishable paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रु॒जा दृ॒ळ्हा चि॑द्र॒क्षस॒: सदां॑सि पुना॒न इ॑न्द ऊर्णुहि॒ वि वाजा॑न् । वृ॒श्चोपरि॑ष्टात्तुज॒ता व॒धेन॒ ये अन्ति॑ दू॒रादु॑पना॒यमे॑षाम्
shlokas.transliteration: rujá ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ cit ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǀ sádāṃsi ǀ punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ūrṇuhi ǀ ví ǀ vā́jān ǀvṛścá ǀ upáriṣṭāt ǀ tujatā́ ǀ vadhéna ǀ yé ǀ ánti ǀ dūrā́t ǀ upa-nāyám ǀ eṣām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Demolish the strong dwellings of therākṣasa;Indu, when purified put on his strength; cut to pieces with your destructive weapon (therākṣasas) who come from above, from nigh, or from afar and their leader.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प्र॑त्न॒वन्नव्य॑से विश्ववार सू॒क्ताय॑ प॒थः कृ॑णुहि॒ प्राच॑: । ये दु॒:षहा॑सो व॒नुषा॑ बृ॒हन्त॒स्ताँस्ते॑ अश्याम पुरुकृत्पुरुक्षो
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pratna-vát ǀ návyase ǀ viśva-vāra ǀ su-uktā́ya ǀ patháḥ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ prā́caḥ ǀyé ǀ duḥ-sáhāsaḥ ǀ vanúṣā ǀ bṛhántaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ te ǀ aśyāma ǀ puru-kṛt ǀ purukṣo íti puru-kṣo ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable (Soma), do you as of old grant the ancient paths to your new worshipper; doer of many acts, utterer of many sounds, may we obtain those (portions) of you which are difficult to defeat, inflicting injury (on foes) and mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा पु॑ना॒नो अ॒पः स्व१॒॑र्गा अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ तो॒का तन॑यानि॒ भूरि॑ । शं न॒: क्षेत्र॑मु॒रु ज्योतीं॑षि सोम॒ ज्योङ्न॒: सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शये॑ रिरीहि
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ punānáḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ tokā́ ǀ tánayāni ǀ bhū́ri ǀśám ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣétram ǀ urú ǀ jyótīṃṣi ǀ soma ǀ jyók ǀ naḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ rirīhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus, being purified, bestow upon us the firmament and heaven and earth and many sons and grandsons;make our land prosper, diffuse the luminaries widely (in the firmament) and grant us long life to see the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ सुवा॒नो हरि॑रं॒शुः प॒वित्रे॒ रथो॒ न स॑र्जि स॒नये॑ हिया॒नः । आप॒च्छ्लोक॑मिन्द्रि॒यं पू॒यमा॑न॒: प्रति॑ दे॒वाँ अ॑जुषत॒ प्रयो॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sarji ǀ sanáye ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀā́pat ǀ ślókam ǀ indriyám ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ práti ǀ devā́n ǀ ajuṣata ǀ práyaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tintedSomaeffused and sent forth (by the priests) is let loose, like a chariot upon the filter, for the acquisition (of riches); being filtered he acquires (Indra's) praise, he gratifies the gods with conciliatory (oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ नृ॒चक्षा॑ असरत्प॒वित्रे॒ नाम॒ दधा॑नः क॒विर॑स्य॒ योनौ॑ । सीद॒न्होते॑व॒ सद॑ने च॒मूषूपे॑मग्म॒न्नृष॑यः स॒प्त विप्रा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ asarat ǀ pavítre ǀ nā́ma ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ asya ǀ yónau ǀsī́dan ǀ hótā-iva ǀ sádane ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ úpa ǀ īm ǀ agman ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ víprāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage, the observer of men, retaining the water proceeds to his plural ce on the filter; like a ministrant priest sitting at the sacrifice (theSomaflows) into the cups; the seven wise ṛṣis approach him with praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑मे॒धा गा॑तु॒विद्वि॒श्वदे॑व॒: सोम॑: पुना॒नः सद॑ एति॒ नित्य॑म् । भुव॒द्विश्वे॑षु॒ काव्ये॑षु॒ रन्तानु॒ जना॑न्यतते॒ पञ्च॒ धीर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ gātu-vít ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ sádaḥ ǀ eti ǀ nítyam ǀbhúvat ǀ víśveṣu ǀ kā́vyeṣu ǀ rántā ǀ ánu ǀ jánān ǀ yatate ǀ páñca ǀ dhī́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the intelligent, the knower of the right path, accompanied by all the gods, undergoing purification goes to his constant abode; he is one who delights in all sacred praises; the sage endeavours to approach the five classes of beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये सो॑म पवमान नि॒ण्ये विश्वे॑ दे॒वास्त्रय॑ एकाद॒शास॑: । दश॑ स्व॒धाभि॒रधि॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑ मृ॒जन्ति॑ त्वा न॒द्य॑: स॒प्त य॒ह्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ soma ǀ pavamāna ǀ niṇyé ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ ekādaśā́saḥ ǀdáśa ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ mṛjánti ǀ tvā ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ saptá ǀ yahvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OSomaPavamāna, you are the thrice eleven universal gods abiding in the secret (heaven); the ten (fingers) cleanse you with the waters upon the elevated fleece, the seven great rivers (cleanse you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्नु स॒त्यं पव॑मानस्यास्तु॒ यत्र॒ विश्वे॑ का॒रव॑: सं॒नस॑न्त । ज्योति॒र्यदह्ने॒ अकृ॑णोदु लो॒कं प्राव॒न्मनुं॒ दस्य॑वे कर॒भीक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ nú ǀ satyám ǀ pávamānasya ǀ astu ǀ yátra ǀ víśve ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ sam-násanta ǀjyótiḥ ǀ yát ǀ áhne ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ mánum ǀ dásyave ǀ kaḥ ǀ abhī́kam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thatplace of the truthfulPavamānabe quickly ours, when all the worshippers assemble (to praise him) the light (of theSoma) which gave manifestation to the day protectedManu-- Soma made it triumphant over theDasyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ सद्मे॑व पशु॒मान्ति॒ होता॒ राजा॒ न स॒त्यः समि॑तीरिया॒नः । सोम॑: पुना॒नः क॒लशाँ॑ अयासी॒त्सीद॑न्मृ॒गो न म॑हि॒षो वने॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ sádma-iva ǀ paśu-mánti ǀ hótā ǀ rā́jā ǀ ná ǀ satyáḥ ǀ sám-itīḥ ǀ iyānáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kaláśān ǀ ayāsīt ǀ sī́dan ǀ mṛgáḥ ǀ ná ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ váneṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As theministrant priest proceeds to the hall where the victim is stationed, as a just king marches to battle, theSomaundergoing purification enters the pitcheers like the wild buffalo in the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒क॒मुक्षो॑ मर्जयन्त॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ दश॒ धीर॑स्य धी॒तयो॒ धनु॑त्रीः । हरि॒: पर्य॑द्रव॒ज्जाः सूर्य॑स्य॒ द्रोणं॑ ननक्षे॒ अत्यो॒ न वा॒जी
shlokas.transliteration: sākam-úkṣaḥ ǀ marjayanta ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ dhī́rasya ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ dhánutrīḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ pári ǀ adravat ǀ jā́ḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ dróṇam ǀ nanakṣe ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sister (fingers) sprinkling together cleanse (theSoma), the ten fingers (are) the efffuse of the sagacious (Soma); the green-tinted one flows round the wives of the sun, he hastens like a swift horse to the pitcher.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं मा॒तृभि॒र्न शिशु॑र्वावशा॒नो वृषा॑ दधन्वे पुरु॒वारो॑ अ॒द्भिः । मर्यो॒ न योषा॑म॒भि नि॑ष्कृ॒तं यन्त्सं ग॑च्छते क॒लश॑ उ॒स्रिया॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ dadhanve ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀmáryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣām ǀ abhí ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ yán ǀ sám ǀ gacchate ǀ kaláśe ǀ usríyābhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Longing (for the deities) the showerer (of benefits) the desired of many (theSoma) is sustained by the (consecrated) waters as the infant by its mother; going to his station like a bridegroom to his bride, hecombines in the pitcher with the curds and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त प्र पि॑प्य॒ ऊध॒रघ्न्या॑या॒ इन्दु॒र्धारा॑भिः सचते सुमे॒धाः । मू॒र्धानं॒ गाव॒: पय॑सा च॒मूष्व॒भि श्री॑णन्ति॒ वसु॑भि॒र्न नि॒क्तैः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ prá ǀ pipye ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ ághnyāyāḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ sacate ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀmūrdhā́nam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ abhí ǀ śrīṇanti ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ niktáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And he nourishes the cow's udder; the intelligentInduis associated with his stream; the cows clothe the elevatedSomain the ladles with their milk as with newly washed robes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ दे॒वेभि॑: पवमान र॒देन्दो॑ र॒यिम॒श्विनं॑ वावशा॒नः । र॒थि॒रा॒यता॑मुश॒ती पुरं॑धिरस्म॒द्र्य१॒॑गा दा॒वने॒ वसू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ pavamāna ǀ rada ǀ índo íti ǀ rayím ǀ aśvínam ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀrathirāyátām ǀ uśatī́ ǀ púram-dhiḥ ǀ asmadryák ǀ ā́ ǀ dāváne ǀ vásūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “InduPavamāna, do you with the gods, who do long for (our good) bestow upon us riches comprising horses; may your capacious mind longing for those who possess chariots (come) towards us to bestow treasures (upon us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू नो॑ र॒यिमुप॑ मास्व नृ॒वन्तं॑ पुना॒नो वा॒ताप्यं॑ वि॒श्वश्च॑न्द्रम् । प्र व॑न्दि॒तुरि॑न्दो ता॒र्यायु॑: प्रा॒तर्म॒क्षू धि॒याव॑सुर्जगम्यात्
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ rayím ǀ úpa ǀ māsva ǀ nṛ-vántam ǀ punānáḥ ǀ vātā́pyam ǀ viśvá-candram ǀprá ǀ vanditúḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ tāri ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prātáḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ dhiyā́-vasuḥ ǀ jagamyāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, when you are purified, measure out to us riches and dependents and all-gratifying water.Indu, may the life of your praiser be prolonged; may (Soma) who acquires wealth by his intelligence come quickly at dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधि॒ यद॑स्मिन्वा॒जिनी॑व॒ शुभ॒: स्पर्ध॑न्ते॒ धिय॒: सूर्ये॒ न विश॑: । अ॒पो वृ॑णा॒नः प॑वते कवी॒यन्व्र॒जं न प॑शु॒वर्ध॑नाय॒ मन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádhi ǀ yát ǀ asmin ǀ vājíni-iva ǀ śúbhaḥ ǀ spárdhante ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ ná ǀ víśaḥ ǀapáḥ ǀ vṛṇānáḥ ǀ pavate ǀ kavi-yán ǀ vrajám ǀ ná ǀ paśu-várdhanāya ǀ mánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the fingers vie with each other in this (Soma), as the trappings on a horse or the rays in the sun, clothed in the waters he flows desiring his worshippers like (a cowherd going to) a plural asant cow-stall for the nourishment of his cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वि॒ता व्यू॒र्ण्वन्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ धाम॑ स्व॒र्विदे॒ भुव॑नानि प्रथन्त । धिय॑: पिन्वा॒नाः स्वस॑रे॒ न गाव॑ ऋता॒यन्ती॑र॒भि वा॑वश्र॒ इन्दु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dvitā́ ǀ vi-ūrṇván ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ svaḥ-víde ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ prathanta ǀdhíyaḥ ǀ pinvānā́ḥ ǀ svásare ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ṛta-yántīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vāvaśre ǀ índum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Openingout the abode of the ambrosia on both sides (he passes between); for him, the omniscient, the worlds expand. Gratifying laudations eager for the sacrifice, call uponIndu, like kine (lowing) towards their stall.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ यत्क॒विः काव्या॒ भर॑ते॒ शूरो॒ न रथो॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ । दे॒वेषु॒ यशो॒ मर्ता॑य॒ भूष॒न्दक्षा॑य रा॒यः पु॑रु॒भूषु॒ नव्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ yát ǀ kavíḥ ǀ kā́vyā ǀ bhárate ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀdevéṣu ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ mártāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀ dákṣāya ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ puru-bhū́ṣu ǀ návyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the sageSomagoes round the praises (of the wise) like a hostile chariot (going round) all the regions (of the battle-field), then desirous of bestowing upon mortals the wealth that abides with the gods, he (is) tobe glorified in the many plural ces of sacrifice for the preservation of the riches he has given.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रि॒ये जा॒तः श्रि॒य आ निरि॑याय॒ श्रियं॒ वयो॑ जरि॒तृभ्यो॑ दधाति । श्रियं॒ वसा॑ना अमृत॒त्वमा॑य॒न्भव॑न्ति स॒त्या स॑मि॒था मि॒तद्रौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: śriyé ǀ jātáḥ ǀ śriyé ǀ ā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ iyāya ǀ śríyam ǀ váyaḥ ǀ jaritṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ dadhāti ǀśríyam ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ āyan ǀ bhávanti ǀ satyā́ ǀ sam-ithā́ ǀ mitá-drau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He (is) genitive rated for prosperity, for prosperity he issues forth, he gives prosperity (and) sustenance to those who praise him; clothing themselves in (his) prosperity, they obtain immortality; their conflicts are successful through the aid of (theSoma) who moves with measured tread.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒भ्य१॒॑र्षाश्वं॒ गामु॒रु ज्योति॑: कृणुहि॒ मत्सि॑ दे॒वान् । विश्वा॑नि॒ हि सु॒षहा॒ तानि॒ तुभ्यं॒ पव॑मान॒ बाध॑से सोम॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ áśvam ǀ gā́m ǀ urú ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ mátsi ǀ devā́n ǀvíśvāni ǀ hí ǀ su-sáhā ǀ tā́ni ǀ túbhyam ǀ pávamāna ǀ bā́dhase ǀ soma ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us food and drink, horses, cattle and ample light, exhilarate the gods; for all (therākṣasas) are easily subdued by you;SomaPavamāna, destroy (all) foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कनि॑क्रन्ति॒ हरि॒रा सृ॒ज्यमा॑न॒: सीद॒न्वन॑स्य ज॒ठर॑ऋ पुना॒नः । नृभि॑र्य॒तः कृ॑णुते नि॒र्णिजं॒ गा अतो॑ म॒तीर्ज॑नयत स्व॒धाभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kánikranti ǀ háriḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjyámānaḥ ǀ sī́dan ǀ vánasya ǀ jaṭháre ǀ punānáḥ ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ kṛṇute ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ matī́ḥ ǀ janayata ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tintedSomacries aloud when let loose, sitting when filtered in the belly of the pitcher; collected by the priests, he assumes his shape, (putting on) the products of the kine, therefore raise praises (to him) with oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरि॑: सृजा॒नः प॒थ्या॑मृ॒तस्येय॑र्ति॒ वाच॑मरि॒तेव॒ नाव॑म् । दे॒वो दे॒वानां॒ गुह्या॑नि॒ नामा॒विष्कृ॑णोति ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्र॒वाचे॑
shlokas.transliteration: háriḥ ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ pathyā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ íyarti ǀ vā́cam ǀ aritā́-iva ǀ nā́vam ǀdeváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ gúhyāni ǀ nā́ma ǀ āvíḥ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ barhíṣi ǀ pra-vā́ce ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tintedSomabeing let loose propels the voice that indicates the path of truth as the boatman (propels his) boat; the bright Soma reveals to his worshipper on the sacred grass the secret names of the god. [”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पामि॒वेदू॒र्मय॒स्तर्तु॑राणा॒: प्र म॑नी॒षा ई॑रते॒ सोम॒मच्छ॑ । न॒म॒स्यन्ती॒रुप॑ च॒ यन्ति॒ सं चा च॑ विशन्त्युश॒तीरु॒शन्त॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m-iva ǀ ít ǀ ūrmáyaḥ ǀ tárturāṇāḥ ǀ prá ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ īrate ǀ sómam ǀ áccha ǀnamasyántīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ ca ǀ yánti ǀ sám ǀ ca ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ viśanti ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ uśántam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests hurrying like the waves of the waters dispatch praises towardsSoma; adoring him they approach and come up together, longing for him who longs for them they enter him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं म॑र्मृजा॒नं म॑हि॒षं न साना॑वं॒शुं दु॑हन्त्यु॒क्षणं॑ गिरि॒ष्ठाम् । तं वा॑वशा॒नं म॒तय॑: सचन्ते त्रि॒तो बि॑भर्ति॒ वरु॑णं समु॒द्रे
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ marmṛjānám ǀ mahiṣám ǀ ná ǀ sā́nau ǀ aṃśúm ǀ duhanti ǀ ukṣáṇam ǀ giri-sthā́m ǀtám ǀ vāvaśānám ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ sacante ǀ tritáḥ ǀ bibharti ǀ váruṇam ǀ samudré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) milk forth theSomacleansed (dwelling) on a high plural ce like a buffalo, the sprinkler, plural ces between the grinding-stones; praises attend upon the longing Soma; (Indra) who dwells in three abodes supports him, the defeater of enemies, in the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इष्य॒न्वाच॑मुपव॒क्तेव॒ होतु॑: पुना॒न इ॑न्दो॒ वि ष्या॑ मनी॒षाम् । इन्द्र॑श्च॒ यत्क्षय॑थ॒: सौभ॑गाय सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: íṣyan ǀ vā́cam ǀ upavaktā́-iva ǀ hótuḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ví ǀ sya ǀ manīṣā́m ǀíndraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ kṣáyathaḥ ǀ sáubhagāya ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, being purified, stimulating the praise (of the worshippers) like the answer of thehotāset free the understanding; when (you) andIndraare present together (at the sacrifice) may we be prosperous, may we become the possessors of excellentmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र से॑ना॒नीः शूरो॒ अग्रे॒ रथा॑नां ग॒व्यन्ने॑ति॒ हर्ष॑ते अस्य॒ सेना॑ । भ॒द्रान्कृ॒ण्वन्नि॑न्द्रह॒वान्त्सखि॑भ्य॒ आ सोमो॒ वस्त्रा॑ रभ॒सानि॑ दत्ते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ senā-nī́ḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ ágre ǀ ráthānām ǀ gavyán ǀ eti ǀ hárṣate ǀ asya ǀ sénā ǀbhadrā́n ǀ kṛṇván ǀ indra-havā́n ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vástrā ǀ rabhasā́ni ǀ datte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The leader of the host, a hero, advances in front of the chariots intent on seizing the cattle (of the enemy); his army exults; making their oblations toIndraprosperous for the friendly (worshippers),Somaassumes the hastily made robes (of curds and milk).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सम॑स्य॒ हरिं॒ हर॑यो मृजन्त्यश्वह॒यैरनि॑शितं॒ नमो॑भिः । आ ति॑ष्ठति॒ रथ॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ सखा॑ वि॒द्वाँ ए॑ना सुम॒तिं या॒त्यच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ asya ǀ hárim ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ mṛjanti ǀ aśva-hayáiḥ ǀ áni-śitam ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ rátham ǀ índrasya ǀ sákhā ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ena ǀ su-matím ǀ yāti ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The priests express his green-tinted (juice); he mounts the chariot unyoked by the horse-driving salutations; the wiseSomathe friend ofIndragoes to meet the worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ देव दे॒वता॑ते पवस्व म॒हे सो॑म॒ प्सर॑स इन्द्र॒पान॑: । कृ॒ण्वन्न॒पो व॒र्षय॒न्द्यामु॒तेमामु॒रोरा नो॑ वरिवस्या पुना॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ deva ǀ devá-tāte ǀ pavasva ǀ mahé ǀ soma ǀ psárase ǀ indra-pā́naḥ ǀkṛṇván ǀ apáḥ ǀ varṣáyan ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ uróḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ varivasya ǀ punānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSoma, who are the beverage ofIndra, flow at our sacrifice for (his) abundant food; sending water, causing rain to fall upon heaven and upon this earth, (come) from the wide (firmament, and) being purified bestow upon us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजी॑त॒येऽह॑तये पवस्व स्व॒स्तये॑ स॒र्वता॑तये बृह॒ते । तदु॑शन्ति॒ विश्व॑ इ॒मे सखा॑य॒स्तद॒हं व॑श्मि पवमान सोम
shlokas.transliteration: ájītaye ǀ áhataye ǀ pavasva ǀ svastáye ǀ sarvá-tātaye ǀ bṛhaté ǀtát ǀ uśanti ǀ víśve ǀ imé ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ tát ǀ ahám ǀ vaśmi ǀ pavamāna ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow for our immunity from defeat and slaughter, flow for our welfare, for the great sacrifice for all the gods; all these my friends desire this; this I desire, OSomaPavamāna.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑: पवते जनि॒ता म॑ती॒नां ज॑नि॒ता दि॒वो ज॑नि॒ता पृ॑थि॒व्याः । ज॒नि॒ताग्नेर्ज॑नि॒ता सूर्य॑स्य जनि॒तेन्द्र॑स्य जनि॒तोत विष्णो॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ pavate ǀ janitā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ janitā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ janitā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀjanitā́ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ janitā́ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ janitā́ ǀ índrasya ǀ janitā́ ǀ utá ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaflows, the genitive rator of praises, the genitive rator of heaven, the genitive rator of the earth, the genitive rator ofAgni, the genitive rator of the sun, the genitive rator ofIndra, and the genitive rator ofViṣṇu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्र॒ह्मा दे॒वानां॑ पद॒वीः क॑वी॒नामृषि॒र्विप्रा॑णां महि॒षो मृ॒गाणा॑म् । श्ये॒नो गृध्रा॑णां॒ स्वधि॑ति॒र्वना॑नां॒ सोम॑: प॒वित्र॒मत्ये॑ति॒ रेभ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: brahmā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ víprāṇām ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ mṛgā́ṇām ǀśyenáḥ ǀ gṛ́dhrāṇām ǀ svá-dhitiḥ ǀ vánānām ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ rébhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheBrahmāof the gods, the guide of the sages, the ṛṣi of the pious, the buffalo of wild animals, the falcon of the vultures, the hatchet of deadly weapons, theSomapasses through the filter with a roar.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रावी॑विपद्वा॒च ऊ॒र्मिं न सिन्धु॒र्गिर॒: सोम॒: पव॑मानो मनी॒षाः । अ॒न्तः पश्य॑न्वृ॒जने॒माव॑रा॒ण्या ति॑ष्ठति वृष॒भो गोषु॑ जा॒नन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ avīvipat ǀ vācáḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ ná ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀantáríti ǀ páśyan ǀ vṛjánā ǀ imā́ ǀ ávarāṇi ǀ ā́ ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ jānán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purifiedSomaexcites gratifying praises as a river (excites) the wave of sound; the showerer (of benefits) beholding the hidden (treasure) presides over these irresistible powers, knowing about the cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स म॑त्स॒रः पृ॒त्सु व॒न्वन्नवा॑तः स॒हस्र॑रेता अ॒भि वाज॑मर्ष । इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ पव॑मानो मनी॒ष्यं१॒॑शोरू॒र्मिमी॑रय॒ गा इ॑ष॒ण्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ vanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ sahásra-retāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ arṣa ǀíndrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manīṣī́ ǀ aṃśóḥ ǀ ūrmím ǀ īraya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ iṣaṇyán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) who are the exhilarator, harming (the foe) in battles, (yourself) unharmed, who have a thousand streams, rush against the strength (of the enemy),Indu, who are being purified, the sage, uttering cries, urge on forIndrathe wave of juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ प्रि॒यः क॒लशे॑ दे॒ववा॑त॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ सोमो॒ रण्यो॒ मदा॑य । स॒हस्र॑धारः श॒तवा॑ज॒ इन्दु॑र्वा॒जी न सप्ति॒: सम॑ना जिगाति
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ devá-vātaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ráṇyaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ śatá-vājaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ sámanā ǀ jigāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural asing delightfulSomaapproached by gods (proceeds) to the pitcher to exhilarateIndra;Induthe thousand-streamed and vigorous proceeds like a strong horse to battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पू॒र्व्यो व॑सु॒विज्जाय॑मानो मृजा॒नो अ॒प्सु दु॑दुहा॒नो अद्रौ॑ । अ॒भि॒श॒स्ति॒पा भुव॑नस्य॒ राजा॑ वि॒दद्गा॒तुं ब्रह्म॑णे पू॒यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ vasu-vít ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀ mṛjānáḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ duduhānáḥ ǀ ádrau ǀabhiśasti-pā́ḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǀ vidát ǀ gātúm ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient (Soma) the finder of treasure as soon as genitive rated, cleansed in the waters milked on the stone, the defender against enemies, the sovereign of the world, purified for the sacrifice, shows (the worshipper) the right way.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॒ हि न॑: पि॒तर॑: सोम॒ पूर्वे॒ कर्मा॑णि च॒क्रुः प॑वमान॒ धीरा॑: । व॒न्वन्नवा॑तः परि॒धीँरपो॑र्णु वी॒रेभि॒रश्वै॑र्म॒घवा॑ भवा नः
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ hí ǀ naḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ soma ǀ pū́rve ǀ kármāṇi ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ pavamāna ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀvanván ǀ ávātaḥ ǀ pari-dhī́n ǀ ápa ǀ ūrṇu ǀ vīrébhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ bhava ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SomaPavamāna, by you our ancient and wise progenitors performed their religious rites; harming the foes (yourself) unharmed slay therākṣasasand be liberal in enriching us withmaleoffspring and horses.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथाप॑वथा॒ मन॑वे वयो॒धा अ॑मित्र॒हा व॑रिवो॒विद्ध॒विष्मा॑न् । ए॒वा प॑वस्व॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ दधा॑न॒ इन्द्रे॒ सं ति॑ष्ठ ज॒नयायु॑धानि
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ ápavathāḥ ǀ mánave ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ amitra-hā́ ǀ varivaḥ-vít ǀ havíṣmān ǀevá ǀ pavasva ǀ dráviṇam ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ índre ǀ sám ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ janáya ǀ ā́yudhāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you did flow toManupossessing food, slaying enemies, acquiring wealth, having oblations, so now flow bringing us riches; abide you inIndra; make manifest (your) weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम॒ मधु॑माँ ऋ॒तावा॒पो वसा॑नो॒ अधि॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑ । अव॒ द्रोणा॑नि घृ॒तवा॑न्ति सीद म॒दिन्त॑मो मत्स॒र इ॑न्द्र॒पान॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀáva ǀ dróṇāni ǀ ghṛtá-vanti ǀ sīda ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ indra-pā́naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somawho have exhilarating juice, who are connected with the sacrifice, clothed with water flow upon the elevated fleece; alight upon the water-holding pitchers, you who are most exhilarating, intoxicating, the especial beverage ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वः श॒तधा॑रः पवस्व सहस्र॒सा वा॑ज॒युर्दे॒ववी॑तौ । सं सिन्धु॑भिः क॒लशे॑ वावशा॒नः समु॒स्रिया॑भिः प्रति॒रन्न॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ śatá-dhāraḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ sahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ devá-vītau ǀsám ǀ síndhu-bhiḥ ǀ kaláśe ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ sám ǀ usríyābhiḥ ǀ pra-tirán ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), who flows in a hundred streams, pour rain from the firmament, you who are the giver of hundredfold (wealth), the bestower of food at the banquet of the gods; desirous of (the mixture) combine with the waters in the pitchers and with the curds and milk, prolonging our life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य सोमो॑ म॒तिभि॑: पुना॒नोऽत्यो॒ न वा॒जी तर॒तीदरा॑तीः । पयो॒ न दु॒ग्धमदि॑तेरिषि॒रमु॒र्वि॑व गा॒तुः सु॒यमो॒ न वोळ्हा॑
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ tárati ǀ ít ǀ árātīḥ ǀpáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dugdhám ǀ áditeḥ ǀ iṣirám ǀ urú-iva ǀ gātúḥ ǀ su-yámaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vóḷhā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSoma(is) purified with praises, like a strong horse he overthrows (his) foes; (he is purified) like the strong milk milked from the cow, (flocked to by all) like a broad road, (and guided by the praisers) like a well-trained horse of burden.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒यु॒धः सो॒तृभि॑: पू॒यमा॑नो॒ऽभ्य॑र्ष॒ गुह्यं॒ चारु॒ नाम॑ । अ॒भि वाजं॒ सप्ति॑रिव श्रव॒स्याभि वा॒युम॒भि गा दे॑व सोम
shlokas.transliteration: su-āyudháḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arṣa ǀ gúhyam ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀabhí ǀ vā́jam ǀ sáptiḥ-iva ǀ śravasyā́ ǀ abhí ǀ vāyúm ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Well-armed, purified by those who express you, send your concealed desirable form (into the pitchers); like a horse bring us food in our desire for food; divineSoma, bring us life, bring us cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिशुं॑ जज्ञा॒नं ह॑र्य॒तं मृ॑जन्ति शु॒म्भन्ति॒ वह्निं॑ म॒रुतो॑ ग॒णेन॑ । क॒विर्गी॒र्भिः काव्ये॑ना क॒विः सन्त्सोम॑: प॒वित्र॒मत्ये॑ति॒ रेभ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: śíśum ǀ jajñānám ǀ haryatám ǀ mṛjanti ǀ śumbhánti ǀ váhnim ǀ marútaḥ ǀ gaṇéna ǀkavíḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ kā́vyena ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sán ǀ sómaḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ eti ǀ rébhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They cleanse the charming infant (Soma) at his birth; theMarutsdecorate the bearer (of boons) with their troop; bring wise with songs, wise with wisdom, Soma passes clamorous through the filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषि॑मना॒ य ऋ॑षि॒कृत्स्व॒र्षाः स॒हस्र॑णीथः पद॒वीः क॑वी॒नाम् । तृ॒तीयं॒ धाम॑ महि॒षः सिषा॑स॒न्त्सोमो॑ वि॒राज॒मनु॑ राजति॒ ष्टुप्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣi-manāḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛṣi-kṛ́t ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀ sahásra-nīthaḥ ǀ pada-vī́ḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǀtṛtī́yam ǀ dhā́ma ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ sísāsan ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vi-rā́jam ǀ ánu ǀ rājati ǀ stúp ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thinking as a ṛṣi, acting as a ṛṣi, gaining heaven, praised by thousands, the guide of the wise, the mightySomadesiring to attain the third region (heaven), being praised adds lustre to the illustrious (Indra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒मू॒षच्छ्ये॒नः श॑कु॒नो वि॒भृत्वा॑ गोवि॒न्दुर्द्र॒प्स आयु॑धानि॒ बिभ्र॑त् । अ॒पामू॒र्मिं सच॑मानः समु॒द्रं तु॒रीयं॒ धाम॑ महि॒षो वि॑वक्ति
shlokas.transliteration: camū-sát ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ śakunáḥ ǀ vi-bhṛ́tvā ǀ go-vindúḥ ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ bíbhrat ǀapā́m ǀ ūrmím ǀ sácamānaḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ turī́yam ǀ dhā́ma ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ vivakti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seated on the ladles, praiseworthy, competent, supporting, acquiring cattle, flowing, bearing arms, attending upon the firmament, the sender of the waters, the mighty (Soma) attends the fourth sphere.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मर्यो॒ न शु॒भ्रस्त॒न्वं॑ मृजा॒नोऽत्यो॒ न सृत्वा॑ स॒नये॒ धना॑नाम् । वृषे॑व यू॒था परि॒ कोश॒मर्ष॒न्कनि॑क्रदच्च॒म्वो॒३॒॑रा वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: máryaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śubhráḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ mṛjānáḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sṛ́tvā ǀ sanáye ǀ dhánānām ǀvṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ yūthā́ ǀ pári ǀ kóśam ǀ árṣan ǀ kánikradat ǀ camvóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cleaning his person n like a richly-decorated man, flowing to acquire riches like a rapid (horse), rushing to the receptacle like a bull to the herd, (Soma) crying repeatedly enters the plural nks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्वेन्दो॒ पव॑मानो॒ महो॑भि॒: कनि॑क्रद॒त्परि॒ वारा॑ण्यर्ष । क्रीळ॑ञ्च॒म्वो॒३॒॑रा वि॑श पू॒यमा॑न॒ इन्द्रं॑ ते॒ रसो॑ मदि॒रो म॑मत्तु
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ indo íti ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ máhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ kánikradat ǀ pári ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ arṣa ǀkrī́ḷan ǀ camvóḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ índram ǀ te ǀ rásaḥ ǀ madiráḥ ǀ mamattu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Indu, purified by the venerable (priests), rush through the filter crying repeatedly, sporting enter the plural nks purified, let your exhilarating beverage exhilarateIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रास्य॒ धारा॑ बृह॒तीर॑सृग्रन्न॒क्तो गोभि॑: क॒लशाँ॒ आ वि॑वेश । साम॑ कृ॒ण्वन्त्सा॑म॒न्यो॑ विप॒श्चित्क्रन्द॑न्नेत्य॒भि सख्यु॒र्न जा॒मिम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ asya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ aktáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ kaláśān ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀsā́ma ǀ kṛṇván ǀ sāmanyáḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cít ǀ krándan ǀ eti ǀ abhí ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ ná ǀ jāmím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His copious streams flow forth; blended with the milk and curds he enters the pitchers; uttering chants the skilful chanter (Soma) hasten invoking (the gods) towards (the cups) like (a libertine) to the wife of a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प॒घ्नन्ने॑षि पवमान॒ शत्रू॑न्प्रि॒यां न जा॒रो अ॒भिगी॑त॒ इन्दु॑: । सीद॒न्वने॑षु शकु॒नो न पत्वा॒ सोम॑: पुना॒नः क॒लशे॑षु॒ सत्ता॑
shlokas.transliteration: apa-ghnán ǀ eṣi ǀ pavamāna ǀ śátrūn ǀ priyā́m ǀ ná ǀ jāráḥ ǀ abhí-gītaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀsī́dan ǀ váneṣu ǀ śakunáḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátvā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kaláśeṣu ǀ sáttā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OPavamāna, eulogized (by the worshippers), distilling (into the receptacles), destroying the enemies, you go like a gallant to his mistress; falling like a bird alighting on the trees theSomawhen purified alights upon the pitchers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॒ रुच॒: पव॑मानस्य सोम॒ योषे॑व यन्ति सु॒दुघा॑: सुधा॒राः । हरि॒रानी॑तः पुरु॒वारो॑ अ॒प्स्वचि॑क्रदत्क॒लशे॑ देवयू॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ rúcaḥ ǀ pávamānasya ǀ soma ǀ yóṣā-iva ǀ yanti ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ su-dhārā́ḥ ǀháriḥ ǀ ā́-nītaḥ ǀ puru-vā́raḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ ácikradat ǀ kaláśe ǀ deva-yūnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The lustres,Soma, of you when being purified, approach with abundant milk with copious streams like a woman (giving milk to her child); the green-tinted Soma, the desired of many, has been brought to the waters and cries repeatedly in the pitcher of the god-loving (worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य प्रे॒षा हे॒मना॑ पू॒यमा॑नो दे॒वो दे॒वेभि॒: सम॑पृक्त॒ रस॑म् । सु॒तः प॒वित्रं॒ पर्ये॑ति॒ रेभ॑न्मि॒तेव॒ सद्म॑ पशु॒मान्ति॒ होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ preṣā́ ǀ hemánā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ apṛkta ǀ rásam ǀsutáḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ pári ǀ eti ǀ rébhan ǀ mitā́-iva ǀ sádma ǀ paśu-mánti ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The shining Somabeing purified by the goldenhandthat urges it forth, brings its juice into contact with the gods; when effused it proceeds with a roar to the filter like the ministrant priest to the halls prepared (for sacrifice) containing victims.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रा वस्त्रा॑ सम॒न्या॒३॒॑ वसा॑नो म॒हान्क॒विर्नि॒वच॑नानि॒ शंस॑न् । आ व॑च्यस्व च॒म्वो॑: पू॒यमा॑नो विचक्ष॒णो जागृ॑विर्दे॒ववी॑तौ
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrā́ ǀ vástrā ǀ samanyā́ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ kavíḥ ǀ ni-vácanāni ǀ śáṃsan ǀā́ ǀ vacyasva ǀ camvóḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ devá-vītau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great wiseSoma, clothed in his auspicious war-vestments, the inspirer of praises-- enter into the vessle when purified, you who are sagacious and vigilant at the banquet of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ प्रि॒यो मृ॑ज्यते॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑ य॒शस्त॑रो य॒शसां॒ क्षैतो॑ अ॒स्मे । अ॒भि स्व॑र॒ धन्वा॑ पू॒यमा॑नो यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyáḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ yaśáḥ-taraḥ ǀ yaśásām ǀ kṣáitaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀabhí ǀ svara ǀ dhánva ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), the most famous of the famous, the earht-born, the conciliator, is cleansed for us in the elevated fleece; sound aloud in the firmament when purified; do you ever protect us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र गा॑यता॒भ्य॑र्चाम दे॒वान्त्सोमं॑ हिनोत मह॒ते धना॑य । स्वा॒दुः प॑वाते॒ अति॒ वार॒मव्य॒मा सी॑दाति क॒लशं॑ देव॒युर्न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ gāyata ǀ abhí ǀ arcāma ǀ devā́n ǀ sómam ǀ hinota ǀ mahaté ǀ dhánāya ǀsvādúḥ ǀ pavāte ǀ áti ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǀ ā́ ǀ sīdāti ǀ kaláśam ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sing (to theSoma), let us praise the gods; send forth the Soma for (the acquisition of) great wealth. He passes sweet-flavoured pure through the fleecy filter; our (Soma) devoted to the gods alights on the pitcher.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑र्दे॒वाना॒मुप॑ स॒ख्यमा॒यन्त्स॒हस्र॑धारः पवते॒ मदा॑य । नृभि॒: स्तवा॑नो॒ अनु॒ धाम॒ पूर्व॒मग॒न्निन्द्रं॑ मह॒ते सौभ॑गाय
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ úpa ǀ sakhyám ǀ ā-yán ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ pavate ǀ mádāya ǀnṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dhā́ma ǀ pū́rvam ǀ ágan ǀ índram ǀ mahaté ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Inducoming to obtain the friendship of the god; flows in a thousand streams for (their) exhilaration, glorified by the priests (he proceeds) to his ancient station, he proceeds toIndrafor the sake of great prosperity (to the worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तो॒त्रे रा॒ये हरि॑रर्षा पुना॒न इन्द्रं॒ मदो॑ गच्छतु ते॒ भरा॑य । दे॒वैर्या॑हि स॒रथं॒ राधो॒ अच्छा॑ यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: stotré ǀ rāyé ǀ háriḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ punānáḥ ǀ índram ǀ mádaḥ ǀ gacchatu ǀ te ǀ bhárāya ǀdeváiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ sa-rátham ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), when our praise is offered, flow green-tinted and purified, to (bring us) riches, may your exhilarating beverage animateIndrato battle. Go in the same car with the gods to (procure us) wealth; do you ever protect us with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र काव्य॑मु॒शने॑व ब्रुवा॒णो दे॒वो दे॒वानां॒ जनि॑मा विवक्ति । महि॑व्रत॒: शुचि॑बन्धुः पाव॒कः प॒दा व॑रा॒हो अ॒भ्ये॑ति॒ रेभ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ kā́vyam ǀ uśánā-iva ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ jánima ǀ vivakti ǀmáhi-vrataḥ ǀ śúci-bandhuḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ varāháḥ ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ rébhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Reciting sacred praise like Uṣanas the praiser (Vṛṣagaṇa) proclaims the births of the gods; assiduous in pious observances, of brilliant radiance, purifying (from sin), he approaches the filter making a noise (as) a wild boar (makes a noise) with its foot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र हं॒सास॑स्तृ॒पलं॑ म॒न्युमच्छा॒मादस्तं॒ वृष॑गणा अयासुः । आ॒ङ्गू॒ष्यं१॒॑ पव॑मानं॒ सखा॑यो दु॒र्मर्षं॑ सा॒कं प्र व॑दन्ति वा॒णम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ tṛpálam ǀ manyúm ǀ áccha ǀ amā́t ǀ ástam ǀ vṛ́ṣa-gaṇāḥ ǀ ayāsuḥ ǀāṅgūṣyám ǀ pávamānam ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ duḥ-márṣam ǀ sākám ǀ prá ǀ vadanti ǀ vāṇám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Vṛṣagaṇas (walking like) swans, (alarmed) at the strength (of the foe), having repaired to the house of sacrifice, to the swift-shooting foe-despising (Soma), the friends sound the flut to the praiseworthy irresistblePavamāna.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स रं॑हत उरुगा॒यस्य॑ जू॒तिं वृथा॒ क्रीळ॑न्तं मिमते॒ न गाव॑: । प॒री॒ण॒सं कृ॑णुते ति॒ग्मशृ॑ङ्गो॒ दिवा॒ हरि॒र्ददृ॑शे॒ नक्त॑मृ॒ज्रः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ raṃhate ǀ uru-gāyásya ǀ jūtím ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ mimate ǀ ná ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀparīṇasám ǀ kṛṇute ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgaḥ ǀ dívā ǀ háriḥ ǀ dádṛśe ǀ náktam ǀ ṛjráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He moves rapidly (following) the path of (him) the much-praised, (other) goers cannot overtake him (though he is) moving easily; sharp-horned he displays manifold (radiance); theSomaappears green-tinted by day, and clearly visible at night.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑र्वा॒जी प॑वते॒ गोन्यो॑घा॒ इन्द्रे॒ सोम॒: सह॒ इन्व॒न्मदा॑य । हन्ति॒ रक्षो॒ बाध॑ते॒ पर्यरा॑ती॒र्वरि॑वः कृ॒ण्वन्वृ॒जन॑स्य॒ राजा॑
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ pavate ǀ gó-nyoghāḥ ǀ índre ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ínvan ǀ mádāya ǀhánti ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ bā́dhate ǀ pári ǀ árātīḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇván ǀ vṛjánasya ǀ rā́jā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The powerful, flowingSomahaving quantities o fjuice flowing down, streams forth infusing strength intoIndrafor his exhilaration; conferring wealth the king of strength slays therākṣasasand harasses the enemy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ धार॑या॒ मध्वा॑ पृचा॒नस्ति॒रो रोम॑ पवते॒ अद्रि॑दुग्धः । इन्दु॒रिन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यं जु॑षा॒णो दे॒वो दे॒वस्य॑ मत्स॒रो मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mádhvā ǀ pṛcānáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ róma ǀ pavate ǀ ádri-dugdhaḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devásya ǀ matsaráḥ ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Milked forth by the stones theSomaflows through the (sheep's) hair coming into contact (with the gods) with its sweet-flavoured stream; the divine exhilaratingIndudesiring the friendship ofIndraflows for the exhilaration of the deity. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि प्रि॒याणि॑ पवते पुना॒नो दे॒वो दे॒वान्त्स्वेन॒ रसे॑न पृ॒ञ्चन् । इन्दु॒र्धर्मा॑ण्यृतु॒था वसा॑नो॒ दश॒ क्षिपो॑ अव्यत॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ priyā́ṇi ǀ pavate ǀ punānáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ svéna ǀ rásena ǀ pṛñcán ǀínduḥ ǀ dhármāṇi ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ avyata ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Clothed in plural asant radiance suited to the season, the sportiveInduflows purified, reaching the gods with its juice; the ten fingers guide it to the elevated fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ शोणो॑ अभि॒कनि॑क्रद॒द्गा न॒दय॑न्नेति पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् । इन्द्र॑स्येव व॒ग्नुरा शृ॑ण्व आ॒जौ प्र॑चे॒तय॑न्नर्षति॒ वाच॒मेमाम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ śóṇaḥ ǀ abhi-kánikradat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ nadáyan ǀ eti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ utá ǀ dyā́m ǀíndrasya-iva ǀ vagnúḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ śṛṇve ǀ ājáu ǀ pra-cetáyan ǀ arṣati ǀ vā́cam ǀ ā́ ǀ imā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Calling out for the praises like) a red bull bellowing after the kine; theSomagoes with a roar through heaven and earth; (his voice) is heard as the voice ofIndra, manifesting (himself) he raises this voice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒साय्य॒: पय॑सा॒ पिन्व॑मान ई॒रय॑न्नेषि॒ मधु॑मन्तमं॒शुम् । पव॑मानः संत॒निमे॑षि कृ॒ण्वन्निन्द्रा॑य सोम परिषि॒च्यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: rasā́yyaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ pínvamānaḥ ǀ īráyan ǀ eṣi ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ aṃśúm ǀpávamānaḥ ǀ sam-taním ǀ eṣi ǀ kṛṇván ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural asant to the taste, dripping with milk, you flow pouring forth the sweet-flavoured juice.Soma, when purified and sprinkled, you flow forIndrain a continuous stream.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा प॑वस्व मदि॒रो मदा॑योदग्रा॒भस्य॑ न॒मय॑न्वध॒स्नैः । परि॒ वर्णं॒ भर॑माणो॒ रुश॑न्तं ग॒व्युर्नो॑ अर्ष॒ परि॑ सोम सि॒क्तः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ pavasva ǀ madiráḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ uda-grābhásya ǀ namáyan ǀ vadha-snáiḥ ǀpári ǀ várṇam ǀ bháramāṇaḥ ǀ rúśantam ǀ gavyúḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ pári ǀ soma ǀ siktáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus flow, the exhilarator, forIndra's exhilaration bowing down the rain-holder with (your) weapons, assuming brilliant colour, desirous of our cattle, flow,Soma, sprinkled (into the filter).”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒ष्ट्वी न॑ इन्दो सु॒पथा॑ सु॒गान्यु॒रौ प॑वस्व॒ वरि॑वांसि कृ॒ण्वन् । घ॒नेव॒ विष्व॑ग्दुरि॒तानि॑ वि॒घ्नन्नधि॒ ष्णुना॑ धन्व॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: juṣṭvī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ su-páthā ǀ su-gā́ni ǀ uráu ǀ pavasva ǀ várivāṃsi ǀ kṛṇván ǀghanā́-iva ǀ víṣvak ǀ duḥ-itā́ni ǀ vi-ghnán ǀ ádhi ǀ snúnā ǀ dhanva ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gratified (with our praises),Indu, flow into the large (vessel), granting us riches coming by holy paths and easily acquired; beating down therākṣasason every side as with a club, flow in a stream upon the elevated fleece.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒ष्टिं नो॑ अर्ष दि॒व्यां जि॑ग॒त्नुमिळा॑वतीं शं॒गयीं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम् । स्तुके॑व वी॒ता ध॑न्वा विचि॒न्वन्बन्धूँ॑रि॒माँ अव॑राँ इन्दो वा॒यून्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣṭím ǀ naḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ divyā́m ǀ jigatnúm ǀ íḷā-vatīm ǀ śam-gáyīm ǀ jīrá-dānum ǀstúkā-iva ǀ vītā́ ǀ dhanva ǀ vi-cinván ǀ bándhūn ǀ imā́n ǀ ávarān ǀ indo íti ǀ vāyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sending us rain from heaven, quick-falling, food-giving, giving health to our home, promptly munificent; flow,Indu, seeking these lower winds your kinsmen as (one seeking his) beloved infants.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ग्र॒न्थिं न वि ष्य॑ ग्रथि॒तं पु॑ना॒न ऋ॒जुं च॑ गा॒तुं वृ॑जि॒नं च॑ सोम । अत्यो॒ न क्र॑दो॒ हरि॒रा सृ॑जा॒नो मर्यो॑ देव धन्व प॒स्त्या॑वान्
shlokas.transliteration: granthím ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ sya ǀ grathitám ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ṛjúm ǀ ca ǀ gātúm ǀ vṛjinám ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀátyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kradaḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ máryaḥ ǀ deva ǀ dhanva ǀ pastyá-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma), when filtered loose (me) bound (by sin) as (one loose) a knot; (grant me) a straight path and strength. You, green-tinted, neigh like a horse (when you are) let loose; proceed divine (Soma) who are friendly to man, and have a dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जुष्टो॒ मदा॑य दे॒वता॑त इन्दो॒ परि॒ ष्णुना॑ धन्व॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑ । स॒हस्र॑धारः सुर॒भिरद॑ब्ध॒: परि॑ स्रव॒ वाज॑सातौ नृ॒षह्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: júṣṭaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ devá-tāte ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ snúnā ǀ dhanva ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ su-rabhíḥ ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ nṛ-sáhye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu, who are adequate for exhilaration flow in a stream to the elevated fleece at the sacrifice; thousand- streaming, fragrant, irresistible, flow for the acquisition of food in the combat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र॒श्मानो॒ ये॑ऽर॒था अयु॑क्ता॒ अत्या॑सो॒ न स॑सृजा॒नास॑ आ॒जौ । ए॒ते शु॒क्रासो॑ धन्वन्ति॒ सोमा॒ देवा॑स॒स्ताँ उप॑ याता॒ पिब॑ध्यै
shlokas.transliteration: araśmā́naḥ ǀ yé ǀ arathā́ḥ ǀ áyuktāḥ ǀ átyāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sasṛjānā́saḥ ǀ ājáu ǀeté ǀ śukrā́saḥ ǀ dhanvanti ǀ sómāḥ ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāta ǀ píbadhyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These brilliantSomajuices flow like horses let loose inbattle without reins, without chariots, unharnessed; approach them, you gods, to drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑ इन्दो अ॒भि दे॒ववी॑तिं॒ परि॑ स्रव॒ नभो॒ अर्ण॑श्च॒मूषु॑ । सोमो॑ अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ काम्यं॑ बृ॒हन्तं॑ र॒यिं द॑दातु वी॒रव॑न्तमु॒ग्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ abhí ǀ devá-vītim ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀsómaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ kā́myam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ rayím ǀ dadātu ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ ugrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So,Indu, at our sacrifice pour the water from the firmament into the vessels; maySomabestow upon us desirable riches in abundance withmaleoffspring and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तक्ष॒द्यदी॒ मन॑सो॒ वेन॑तो॒ वाग्ज्येष्ठ॑स्य वा॒ धर्म॑णि॒ क्षोरनी॑के । आदी॑माय॒न्वर॒मा वा॑वशा॒ना जुष्टं॒ पतिं॑ क॒लशे॒ गाव॒ इन्दु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tákṣat ǀ yádi ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ vénataḥ ǀ vā́k ǀ jyéṣṭhasya ǀ vā ǀ dhármaṇi ǀ kṣóḥ ǀ ánīke ǀā́t ǀ īm ǀ āyan ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ júṣṭam ǀ pátim ǀ kaláśe ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ índum ǁ
