shlokas.meaning_en: “When the praise of the zealous worshipper sanctiies him as that of a noisy (crowd) in front (praises) a distinguished (prince) for the support (he affords); then the cows come to the excellent exhilaratingIndu, the lord (of all, abiding) in the pitcher, eager to gratify him (with their milk).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र दा॑नु॒दो दि॒व्यो दा॑नुपि॒न्व ऋ॒तमृ॒ताय॑ पवते सुमे॒धाः । ध॒र्मा भु॑वद्वृज॒न्य॑स्य॒ राजा॒ प्र र॒श्मिभि॑र्द॒शभि॑र्भारि॒ भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dānu-dáḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ dānu-pinváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ pavate ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀdharmā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ vṛjanyásya ǀ rā́jā ǀ prá ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ bhāri ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine benefactor of givers, poured (boons) on givers, the intelligent (Soma) distils his true beverage for true (Indra); the radiant (Soma) is the upholder of strength, he is entirely restrained by the ten fingers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒वित्रे॑भि॒: पव॑मानो नृ॒चक्षा॒ राजा॑ दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् । द्वि॒ता भु॑वद्रयि॒पती॑ रयी॒णामृ॒तं भ॑र॒त्सुभृ॑तं॒ चार्विन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pavítrebhiḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ devā́nām ǀ utá ǀ mártyānām ǀdvitā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ rayi-pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ ṛtám ǀ bharat ǀ sú-bhṛtam ǀ cā́ru ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified by the filters the observers of man, the sovereign of both gods and mortals, the lord of abundant wealth (Soma), is twofold;Indubears the auspicious collected water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्वाँ॑ इव॒ श्रव॑से सा॒तिमच्छेन्द्र॑स्य वा॒योर॒भि वी॒तिम॑र्ष । स न॑: स॒हस्रा॑ बृह॒तीरिषो॑ दा॒ भवा॑ सोम द्रविणो॒वित्पु॑ना॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: árvān-iva ǀ śrávase ǀ sātím ǀ áccha ǀ índrasya ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vītím ǀ arṣa ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásrā ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ dāḥ ǀ bháva ǀ soma ǀ draviṇaḥ-vít ǀ punānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten (Soma) to give food toIndraandVāyulike a horse, for (the sake of giving us) food, to acquire wealth; give us abundant thousand-fold food; Soma, when filtered become the dispenser of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वा॒व्यो॑ नः परिषि॒च्यमा॑ना॒: क्षयं॑ सु॒वीरं॑ धन्वन्त॒ सोमा॑: । आ॒य॒ज्यव॑: सुम॒तिं वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ होता॑रो॒ न दि॑वि॒यजो॑ म॒न्द्रत॑माः
shlokas.transliteration: deva-avyáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pari-sicyámānāḥ ǀ kṣáyam ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ dhanvantu ǀ sómāḥ ǀā-yajyávaḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ viśvá-vārāḥ ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ ná ǀ divi-yájaḥ ǀ mandrá-tamāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theSomajuices which are gratifying to the gods when poured around (into the vessels) bring us a dwelling andmaleoffspring-- (the juice) endeavouring to gain the favour (of the gods), desired by all offering (to the gods) in heaven like the ministrant priests, most exhilarating.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा दे॑व दे॒वता॑ते पवस्व म॒हे सो॑म॒ प्सर॑से देव॒पान॑: । म॒हश्चि॒द्धि ष्मसि॑ हि॒ताः स॑म॒र्ये कृ॒धि सु॑ष्ठा॒ने रोद॑सी पुना॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ deva ǀ devá-tāte ǀ pavasva ǀ mahé ǀ soma ǀ psárase ǀ deva-pā́naḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ smási ǀ hitā́ḥ ǀ sa-maryé ǀ kṛdhí ǀ susthāné íti su-sthāné ǀ ródasī íti ǀ punānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSoma, who are the beverage of the gods, flow at the sacrifice for (their) abundant food; urged on (by you) may we overcome even mighty (foes) in battle; purified do you render heaven and earth happy abodes (for us).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वो॒ नो क्र॑दो॒ वृष॑भिर्युजा॒नः सिं॒हो न भी॒मो मन॑सो॒ जवी॑यान् । अ॒र्वा॒चीनै॑: प॒थिभि॒र्ये रजि॑ष्ठा॒ आ प॑वस्व सौमन॒सं न॑ इन्दो
shlokas.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kradaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ yujānáḥ ǀ siṃháḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmáḥ ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀarvācī́naiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ yé ǀ rájiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ saumanasám ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoked by the priests, you neigh like a horse, (you are) terrible as a lion, swifter than thought;Indu, pour happiness upon us by those which are the most direct of the paths leading hitherward.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒तं धारा॑ दे॒वजा॑ता असृग्रन्त्स॒हस्र॑मेनाः क॒वयो॑ मृजन्ति । इन्दो॑ स॒नित्रं॑ दि॒व आ प॑वस्व पुरए॒तासि॑ मह॒तो धन॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: śatám ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ devá-jātāḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ sahásram ǀ enāḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ mṛjanti ǀíndo íti ǀ sanítram ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ asi ǀ mahatáḥ ǀ dhánasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your hundred streams manifested for the gods are loose; the sages cleanse those thousand (streams); pour wealth upon us,Indu, from heaven; you are the precursor of abundant riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो न सर्गा॑ अससृग्र॒मह्नां॒ राजा॒ न मि॒त्रं प्र मि॑नाति॒ धीर॑: । पि॒तुर्न पु॒त्रः क्रतु॑भिर्यता॒न आ प॑वस्व वि॒शे अ॒स्या अजी॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ sárgāḥ ǀ asasṛgram ǀ áhnām ǀ rā́jā ǀ ná ǀ mitrám ǀ prá ǀ mināti ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀpitúḥ ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ krátu-bhiḥ ǀ yatānáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ viśé ǀ asyái ǀ ájītim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the rays of the days of the sun are let loose (so are the streams of theSoma); a prudent king does not abandon his friend; as a son preserving in pious acts (wins) his father's (safety), do you pour upon this people immunity from defeat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॒ धारा॒ मधु॑मतीरसृग्र॒न्वारा॒न्यत्पू॒तो अ॒त्येष्यव्या॑न् । पव॑मान॒ पव॑से॒ धाम॒ गोनां॑ जज्ञा॒नः सूर्य॑मपिन्वो अ॒र्कैः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ mádhu-matīḥ ǀ asṛgran ǀ vā́rān ǀ yát ǀ pūtáḥ ǀ ati-éṣi ǀ ávyān ǀpávamāna ǀ pávase ǀ dhā́ma ǀ gónām ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ apinvaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your exhilarating streams are let loose when you pass purified through the woollen fleece;Pavamānayou flow to the supporting (milk) of the kine, as soon as genitive rated you fill the sun with your radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कनि॑क्रद॒दनु॒ पन्था॑मृ॒तस्य॑ शु॒क्रो वि भा॑स्य॒मृत॑स्य॒ धाम॑ । स इन्द्रा॑य पवसे मत्स॒रवा॑न्हिन्वा॒नो वाचं॑ म॒तिभि॑: कवी॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: kánikradat ǀ ánu ǀ pánthām ǀ ṛtásya ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāsi ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀsáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavase ǀ matsará-vān ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ kavīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheSoma) cries repeatedly upon the path of the sacrifice; you shine (being) the abode of immortality; possessing exhilaration you flow forIndra, sending forth your voice with the praises of the sages.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒व्यः सु॑प॒र्णोऽव॑ चक्षि सोम॒ पिन्व॒न्धारा॒: कर्म॑णा दे॒ववी॑तौ । एन्दो॑ विश क॒लशं॑ सोम॒धानं॒ क्रन्द॑न्निहि॒ सूर्य॒स्योप॑ र॒श्मिम्
shlokas.transliteration: divyáḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ áva ǀ cakṣi ǀ soma ǀ pínvan ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ kármaṇā ǀ devá-vītau ǀā́ ǀ indo íti ǀ viśa ǀ kaláśam ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ krándan ǀ ihi ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ úpa ǀ raśmím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are celestial, well-winged, you look down from heaven, pouring forth your streams by the pious rite at the sacrifice;Indu, enter into the pitcher the receptacle of the Soma; crying aloud approach the sun's rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो वाच॑ ईरयति॒ प्र वह्नि॑ॠ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिं ब्रह्म॑णो मनी॒षाम् । गावो॑ यन्ति॒ गोप॑तिं पृ॒च्छमा॑ना॒: सोमं॑ यन्ति म॒तयो॑ वावशा॒नाः
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ vā́caḥ ǀ īrayati ǀ prá ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītím ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀgā́vaḥ ǀ yanti ǀ gó-patim ǀ pṛcchámānāḥ ǀ sómam ǀ yanti ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearer (of the oblation) utters the three praises, the thought ofBrahmathat sustains the sacrifice; the kine come to the cowherd asking (to be milked), the praisers proceed to theSomawith eagerness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमं॒ गावो॑ धे॒नवो॑ वावशा॒नाः सोमं॒ विप्रा॑ म॒तिभि॑: पृ॒च्छमा॑नाः । सोम॑: सु॒तः पू॑यते अ॒ज्यमा॑न॒: सोमे॑ अ॒र्कास्त्रि॒ष्टुभ॒: सं न॑वन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: sómam ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ sómam ǀ víprāḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ pṛcchámānāḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ pūyate ǀ ajyámānaḥ ǀ sóme ǀ arkā́ḥ ǀ tri-stúbhaḥ ǀ sám ǀ navante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kine (are) longing for theSoma; wise men (are) inquiring for him with praises; Soma being effused is purified blended (with milk), our adorations in thetriṣṭubhmetre are united in the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा न॑: सोम परिषि॒च्यमा॑न॒ आ प॑वस्व पू॒यमा॑नः स्व॒स्ति । इन्द्र॒मा वि॑श बृह॒ता रवे॑ण व॒र्धया॒ वाचं॑ ज॒नया॒ पुरं॑धिम्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ pari-sicyámānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ svastí ǀíndram ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ráveṇa ǀ vardháya ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáya ǀ púram-dhim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus poured around (into the vessels),Soma, do you when purified flow for our welfare, enter with a great noise intoIndra, foster our praise, genitive rate abundant knowledge in us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जागृ॑वि॒र्विप्र॑ ऋ॒ता म॑ती॒नां सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॑सदच्च॒मूषु॑ । सप॑न्ति॒ यं मि॑थु॒नासो॒ निका॑मा अध्व॒र्यवो॑ रथि॒रास॑: सु॒हस्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ṛtā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ asadat ǀ camū́ṣu ǀsápanti ǀ yám ǀ mithunā́saḥ ǀ ní-kāmāḥ ǀ adhvaryávaḥ ǀ rathirā́saḥ ǀ su-hástāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vigilantSoma, the knower of true praises, being purified, has sat down in the vessels-- (the Soma) whom theadhvaryustouch, combined, emulous, leaders of the sacrifice, auspicious-handed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पु॑ना॒न उप॒ सूरे॒ न धातोभे अ॑प्रा॒ रोद॑सी॒ वि ष आ॑वः । प्रि॒या चि॒द्यस्य॑ प्रिय॒सास॑ ऊ॒ती स तू धनं॑ का॒रिणे॒ न प्र यं॑सत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sū́re ǀ ná ǀ dhā́tā ǀ ā́ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ aprāḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ví ǀ sáḥ ǀ āvarítyāvaḥ ǀpriyā́ ǀ cit ǀ yásya ǀ priyasā́saḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ dhánam ǀ kāríṇe ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ yaṃsat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The purified (Soma) approaches (Indra) as the year (approaches) the sun, he fills both heaven and earth (with his radiance), he opens (the darkness with his light); may he, the beloved (Soma), whose beloved (streams) are for (our) preservation, bestow upon us wealth like (wages given) to a labourer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स व॑र्धि॒ता वर्ध॑नः पू॒यमा॑न॒: सोमो॑ मी॒ढ्वाँ अ॒भि नो॒ ज्योति॑षावीत् । येना॑ न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: पद॒ज्ञाः स्व॒र्विदो॑ अ॒भि गा अद्रि॑मु॒ष्णन्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vardhitā́ ǀ várdhanaḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́n ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ āvīt ǀyéna ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ pada-jñā́ḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ uṣṇán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MaySomathe augmenter (of the gods), self-augmenting, being purified, the showerer (of benefits), protect us by his radiance; through whom our forefathers, tracing the footmarks, cognizant of all things, stole the cattle from the rock.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्रा॑न्त्समु॒द्रः प्र॑थ॒मे विध॑र्मञ्ज॒नय॑न्प्र॒जा भुव॑नस्य॒ राजा॑ । वृषा॑ प॒वित्रे॒ अधि॒ सानो॒ अव्ये॑ बृ॒हत्सोमो॑ वावृधे सुवा॒न इन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ákrān ǀ samudráḥ ǀ prathamé ǀ ví-dharman ǀ janáyan ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ rā́jā ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ pavítre ǀ ádhi ǀ sā́nau ǀ ávye ǀ bṛhát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ocean, the royal (Soma), genitive rating progeny in the outstretched (firmament, the) supporter of the water traverses the universe; the showerer (of benefits), the brilliant Soma when effused increases abundantly in the elevated woollen filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हत्तत्सोमो॑ महि॒षश्च॑कारा॒पां यद्गर्भोऽवृ॑णीत दे॒वान् । अद॑धा॒दिन्द्रे॒ पव॑मान॒ ओजोऽज॑नय॒त्सूर्ये॒ ज्योति॒रिन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahát ǀ tát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ cakāra ǀ apā́m ǀ yát ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ávṛṇīta ǀ devā́n ǀádadhāt ǀ índre ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ójaḥ ǀ ájanayat ǀ sū́rye ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The mightySomahas achieved this mighty (work) that, being the germ of the waters, he has nourished the gods; purified he has given strength toIndra;Induhas genitive rated the light in the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मत्सि॑ वा॒युमि॒ष्टये॒ राध॑से च॒ मत्सि॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा पू॒यमा॑नः । मत्सि॒ शर्धो॒ मारु॑तं॒ मत्सि॑ दे॒वान्मत्सि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी दे॑व सोम
shlokas.transliteration: mátsi ǀ vāyúm ǀ iṣṭáye ǀ rā́dhase ǀ ca ǀ mátsi ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀmátsi ǀ śárdhaḥ ǀ mā́rutam ǀ mátsi ǀ devā́n ǀ mátsi ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ExhilarateVāyufor (our) food and wealth, exhilarateMitraandVaruṇaas soon as you are filtered; exhilarate the company of theMaruts, exhilarate the gods, exhilarate heaven and earth, divineSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒जुः प॑वस्व वृजि॒नस्य॑ ह॒न्तापामी॑वां॒ बाध॑मानो॒ मृध॑श्च । अ॒भि॒श्री॒णन्पय॒: पय॑सा॒भि गोना॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ त्वं तव॑ व॒यं सखा॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: ṛjúḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ vṛjinásya ǀ hantā́ ǀ ápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ bā́dhamānaḥ ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ca ǀabhi-śrīṇán ǀ páyaḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ abhí ǀ gónām ǀ índrasya ǀ tvám ǀ táva ǀ vayám ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow you who are straight going, the slayer of the crooked-goer, driving away disease and enemies; mixing your juice with thejuice of the kine (you go to the cups); (you are)Indra's (friend), we (are) your friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मध्व॒: सूदं॑ पवस्व॒ वस्व॒ उत्सं॑ वी॒रं च॑ न॒ आ प॑वस्वा॒ भगं॑ च । स्वद॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य॒ पव॑मान इन्दो र॒यिं च॑ न॒ आ प॑वस्वा समु॒द्रात्
shlokas.transliteration: mádhvaḥ ǀ sū́dam ǀ pavasva ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ útsam ǀ vīrám ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ bhágam ǀ ca ǀsvádasva ǀ índrāya ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ rayím ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ samudrā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour forth a fountain of wealth distilling sweet juice, pour upon usmaleoffspring and riches; flow sweet forIndra, OIndu, when purified; and pour riches upon us from the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑: सु॒तो धार॒यात्यो॒ न हित्वा॒ सिन्धु॒र्न नि॒म्नम॒भि वा॒ज्य॑क्षाः । आ योनिं॒ वन्य॑मसदत्पुना॒नः समिन्दु॒र्गोभि॑रसर॒त्सम॒द्भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ hítvā ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ nimnám ǀ abhí ǀ vājī́ ǀ akṣāríti ǀā́ ǀ yónim ǀ ványam ǀ asadat ǀ punānáḥ ǀ sám ǀ índuḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ asarat ǀ sám ǀ at-bhíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaeffused in a stream, going like a horse flows powerful like a river down a descent; purified he alights on the wooden abode;Indumixes with the milk and curds, (mixes) with the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य ते॑ पवत इन्द्र॒ सोम॑श्च॒मूषु॒ धीर॑ उश॒ते तव॑स्वान् । स्व॑र्चक्षा रथि॒रः स॒त्यशु॑ष्म॒: कामो॒ न यो दे॑वय॒तामस॑र्जि
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ te ǀ pavate ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ uśaté ǀ távasvān ǀsváḥ-cakṣāḥ ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ satyá-śuṣmaḥ ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ deva-yatā́m ǀ ásarji ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The following sagaciousSomaflows into the cups,Indra, for you, who long (for him)--all-seeing, car-borne, of adequate vigour, who has been sent forth like the wish of the god-desiring (worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष प्र॒त्नेन॒ वय॑सा पुना॒नस्ति॒रो वर्पां॑सि दुहि॒तुर्दधा॑नः । वसा॑न॒: शर्म॑ त्रि॒वरू॑थम॒प्सु होते॑व याति॒ सम॑नेषु॒ रेभ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ pratnéna ǀ váyasā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ várpāṃsi ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀvásānaḥ ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ap-sú ǀ hótā-iva ǀ yāti ǀ sámaneṣu ǀ rébhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flowing with (his) ancient food, enveloping the forms of the earth, covering the house of sacrifice which has a threefold protection, (plural ced) in the waters he advances calling aloud at the oblations like a ministrant priest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू न॒स्त्वं र॑थि॒रो दे॑व सोम॒ परि॑ स्रव च॒म्वो॑: पू॒यमा॑नः । अ॒प्सु स्वादि॑ष्ठो॒ मधु॑माँ ऋ॒तावा॑ दे॒वो न यः स॑वि॒ता स॒त्यम॑न्मा
shlokas.transliteration: nú ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ deva ǀ soma ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ camvóḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀap-sú ǀ svā́diṣṭhaḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ satyá-manmā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSoma, who are car-borne, being filtered (at) our (sacrifice), flow quickly into the cups; most sweet-flavoured in the waters, full of delight, offered at the sacrifice, stimulator of all, who like a god are the object of true praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वा॒युं वी॒त्य॑र्षा गृणा॒नो॒३॒॑ऽभि मि॒त्रावरु॑णा पू॒यमा॑नः । अ॒भी नरं॑ धी॒जव॑नं रथे॒ष्ठाम॒भीन्द्रं॒ वृष॑णं॒ वज्र॑बाहुम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vāyúm ǀ vītī́ ǀ arṣa ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ náram ǀ dhī-jávanam ǀ rathe-sthā́m ǀ abhí ǀ índram ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vájra-bāhum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being eulogized, hasten toVāyu, for (him to) drink; being purified, hasten toMitraandVaruṇa; (hasten) to the leader, who is quick as thought, mounted on a car, toIndra, the showerer, the wielder of the thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि वस्त्रा॑ सुवस॒नान्य॑र्षा॒भि धे॒नूः सु॒दुघा॑: पू॒यमा॑नः । अ॒भि च॒न्द्रा भर्त॑वे नो॒ हिर॑ण्या॒भ्यश्वा॑न्र॒थिनो॑ देव सोम
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ vástrā ǀ su-vasanā́ni ǀ arṣa ǀ abhí ǀ dhenū́ḥ ǀ su-dúghāḥ ǀ pūyámānaḥ ǀabhí ǀ candrā́ ǀ bhártave ǀ naḥ ǀ híraṇyā ǀ abhí ǀ áśvān ǀ rathínaḥ ǀ deva ǀ soma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us handsome garments, bring us, when you are purified, cows easily milked; bring for our maintenance gratifying gold; divineSoma, bring us horses fit for chariots.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि नो॑ वाज॒सात॑मं र॒यिम॑र्ष पुरु॒स्पृह॑म् । इन्दो॑ स॒हस्र॑भर्णसं तुविद्यु॒म्नं वि॑भ्वा॒सह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ vāja-sā́tamam ǀ rayím ǀ arṣa ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀíndo íti ǀ sahásra-bharṇasam ǀ tuvi-dyumnám ǀ vibhva-sáham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us,Indu, strength-bestowing riches, desired bymany, supporting many, far-celebrated and overcoming mighty (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ ष्य सु॑वा॒नो अ॒व्ययं॒ रथे॒ न वर्मा॑व्यत । इन्दु॑र॒भि द्रुणा॑ हि॒तो हि॑या॒नो धारा॑भिरक्षाः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ syáḥ ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ avyáyam ǀ ráthe ǀ ná ǀ várma ǀ avyata ǀínduḥ ǀ abhí ǀ drúṇā ǀ hitáḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When effused theSomajuice flows to the woollen (filter) as (a warrior) in a chariot is covered in mail; fitted into the wooden (cask), hurrying forth, it flows in streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ ष्य सु॑वा॒नो अ॑क्षा॒ इन्दु॒रव्ये॒ मद॑च्युतः । धारा॒ य ऊ॒र्ध्वो अ॑ध्व॒रे भ्रा॒जा नैति॑ गव्य॒युः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ syáḥ ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ índuḥ ǀ ávye ǀ máda-cyutaḥ ǀdhā́rā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀ bhrājā́ ǀ ná ǀ éti ǀ gavya-yúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomajuice being effused flows through the fleece diffusing exhilaration; who, being exalted goes to the sacrifice in a stream desiring the milk and curds as (he goes to the firmament) with radiance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि त्वं दे॑व॒ शश्व॑ते॒ वसु॒ मर्ता॑य दा॒शुषे॑ । इन्दो॑ सह॒स्रिणं॑ र॒यिं श॒तात्मा॑नं विवाससि
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ śáśvate ǀ vásu ǀ mártāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀíndo íti ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ rayím ǀ śatá-ātmānam ǀ vivāsasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, divineIndu, grant riches to every man who offers libations, thousand-fold and hundred-fold treasure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं ते॑ अ॒स्य वृ॑त्रह॒न्वसो॒ वस्व॑: पुरु॒स्पृह॑: । नि नेदि॑ष्ठतमा इ॒षः स्याम॑ सु॒म्नस्या॑ध्रिगो
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ te ǀ asyá ǀ vṛtra-han ǀ váso íti ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀní ǀ nédiṣṭha-tamāḥ ǀ iṣáḥ ǀ syā́ma ǀ sumnásya ǀ adhrigo ítyadhri-go ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Slayer of enemies, may we by your (people);Vasu, (may we be) extremely near your much-coveted wealth; irresistible (Soma), may we be near happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च॒ स्वय॑शसं॒ स्वसा॑रो॒ अद्रि॑संहतम् । प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्यं॑ प्रस्ना॒पय॑न्त्यू॒र्मिण॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dvíḥ ǀ yám ǀ páñca ǀ svá-yaśasam ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ ádri-saṃhatam ǀpriyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀ pra-snāpáyanti ǀ ūrmíṇam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom, celebrated, expressed by the stones, dear toIndra, beloved (by all) moving in streams, the twice fiver sister (fingers) bathe (in the sacred waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ त्यं ह॑र्य॒तं हरिं॑ ब॒भ्रुं पु॑नन्ति॒ वारे॑ण । यो दे॒वान्विश्वाँ॒ इत्परि॒ मदे॑न स॒ह गच्छ॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ tyám ǀ haryatám ǀ hárim ǀ babhrúm ǀ punanti ǀ vā́reṇa ǀyáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ víśvān ǀ ít ǀ pári ǀ mádena ǀ sahá ǀ gácchati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him, coveted (by all), green-tinted, brown, they purify with the filter; who goes to all the gods with (his) exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य वो॒ ह्यव॑सा॒ पान्तो॑ दक्ष॒साध॑नम् । यः सू॒रिषु॒ श्रवो॑ बृ॒हद्द॒धे स्व१॒॑र्ण ह॑र्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ vaḥ ǀ hí ǀ ávasā ǀ pā́ntaḥ ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanam ǀyáḥ ǀ sūríṣu ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ dadhé ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ haryatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you by his protection have drunk the strengthening (juice of thatSoma) who, beloved (by all) like the sun, has bestowed abundant food upon his worshippers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वां॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ मानवी॒ इन्दु॑र्जनिष्ट रोदसी । दे॒वो दे॑वी गिरि॒ष्ठा अस्रे॑ध॒न्तं तु॑वि॒ष्वणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vām ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ mānavī íti ǀ índuḥ ǀ janiṣṭa ǀ rodasī íti ǀdeváḥ ǀ devī íti ǀ giri-sthā́ḥ ǀ ásredhan ǀ tám ǀ tuvi-sváni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine heaven and earth the progeny ofManu, theSomajuice is genitive rated at your sacrifices, radiant, abiding in the grinding stones; (the priests) bruise him at the loud-sounding ceremony.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ पात॑वे वृत्र॒घ्ने परि॑ षिच्यसे । नरे॑ च॒ दक्षि॑णावते दे॒वाय॑ सदना॒सदे॑
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ vṛtra-ghné ǀ pári ǀ sicyase ǀnáre ǀ ca ǀ dákṣiṇā-vate ǀ devā́ya ǀ sadana-sáde ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are poured forth,Soma, forIndra, the slayer ofVṛtra, to drink; and for the munificent worshipper who sits in the halls of sacrifice (to give oblations) to god.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते प्र॒त्नासो॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु॒ सोमा॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अक्षरन् । अ॒प॒प्रोथ॑न्तः सनु॒तर्हु॑र॒श्चित॑: प्रा॒तस्ताँ अप्र॑चेतसः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ pratnā́saḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ sómāḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ akṣaran ǀapa-próthantaḥ ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ huraḥ-cítaḥ ǀ prātáríti ǀ tā́n ǀ ápra-cetasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those ancientSomajuices flow into the filter at the dawn, driving away in the early morning the concealed and ignorant thieves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं स॑खायः पुरो॒रुचं॑ यू॒यं व॒यं च॑ सू॒रय॑: । अ॒श्याम॒ वाज॑गन्ध्यं स॒नेम॒ वाज॑पस्त्यम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ puraḥ-rúcam ǀ yūyám ǀ vayám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǀaśyā́ma ǀ vā́ja-gandhyam ǀ sanéma ǀ vā́ja-pastyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May you and we, intelligent friends, eat the brightSomafragrant and invigorating, may we obtain food and dwellings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ह॑र्य॒ताय॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॒ धनु॑स्तन्वन्ति॒ पौंस्य॑म् । शु॒क्रां व॑य॒न्त्यसु॑राय नि॒र्णिजं॑ वि॒पामग्रे॑ मही॒युव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ haryatā́ya ǀ dhṛṣṇáve ǀ dhánuḥ ǀ tanvanti ǀ páuṃsyam ǀśukrā́m ǀ vayanti ǀ ásurāya ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ vipā́m ǀ ágre ǀ mahīyúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They stretch the bow of manhood for the beloved courageous (Soma); (the priests) wishing to worship spread out the white filter for the mighty (Soma) in the presence of the sage (deities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॑ क्ष॒पा परि॑ष्कृतो॒ वाजाँ॑ अ॒भि प्र गा॑हते । यदी॑ वि॒वस्व॑तो॒ धियो॒ हरिं॑ हि॒न्वन्ति॒ यात॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ kṣapā́ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ vā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ prá ǀ gāhate ǀyádi ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hárim ǀ hinvánti ǀ yā́tave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Consecrated at the end of the night (theSoma) plural nges into the viands, when the fingers of the worshipper press out the green-tinted (juice) to go (to the vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑स्य मर्जयामसि॒ मदो॒ य इ॑न्द्र॒पात॑मः । यं गाव॑ आ॒सभि॑र्द॒धुः पु॒रा नू॒नं च॑ सू॒रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ asya ǀ marjayāmasi ǀ mádaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ indra-pā́tamaḥ ǀyám ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ āsá-bhiḥ ǀ dadhúḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ nūnám ǀ ca ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We purify the juice thatSomawhich is exhilarating and fit forIndra's drinking; which the approaching worshippers both now and of old take up in their mluths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं गाथ॑या पुरा॒ण्या पु॑ना॒नम॒भ्य॑नूषत । उ॒तो कृ॑पन्त धी॒तयो॑ दे॒वानां॒ नाम॒ बिभ्र॑तीः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ gā́thayā ǀ purāṇyā́ ǀ punānám ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀutó íti ǀ kṛpanta ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ nā́ma ǀ bíbhratīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They celebrate the purifiedSomajuice with an ancient hymn of praise, and the fingers exercising their pressure are able (to prepare the oblation) for the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॒क्षमा॑णम॒व्यये॒ वारे॑ पुनन्ति धर्ण॒सिम् । दू॒तं न पू॒र्वचि॑त्तय॒ आ शा॑सते मनी॒षिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ ukṣámāṇam ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ punanti ǀ dharṇasím ǀdūtám ǀ ná ǀ pūrvá-cittaye ǀ ā́ ǀ śāsate ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him sprinkled (with water) the supporter (of all things) they purify in the woollen filter; the wise (worshippers) instrumental uct him as a messenger to proclaim (their prayers) beforehand (to the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पु॑ना॒नो म॒दिन्त॑म॒: सोम॑श्च॒मूषु॑ सीदति । प॒शौ न रेत॑ आ॒दध॒त्पति॑र्वचस्यते धि॒यः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ sīdati ǀpaśáu ǀ ná ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ā-dádhat ǀ pátiḥ ǀ vacasyate ǀ dhiyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most exhilaratingSoma, being purified, alights on the vessels; putting his seed (in the vessels) as in a heifer, the protector of the rite is worshipped.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मृ॑ज्यते सु॒कर्म॑भिर्दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॑: सु॒तः । वि॒दे यदा॑सु संद॒दिर्म॒हीर॒पो वि गा॑हते
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mṛjyate ǀ sukárma-bhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvidé ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ sam-dadíḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ví ǀ gāhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused for the gods, the godSomais cleansed by the skilful (priests); when he is recognized among these (people) as the giver (of riches), he plural nges into the mighty waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त इ॑न्दो प॒वित्र॒ आ नृभि॑र्य॒तो वि नी॑यसे । इन्द्रा॑य मत्स॒रिन्त॑मश्च॒मूष्वा नि षी॑दसि
shlokas.transliteration: sutáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ pavítre ǀ ā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ ví ǀ nīyase ǀíndrāya ǀ matsarín-tamaḥ ǀ camū́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When effused,Indu, and collected by the priests, you are guided to the filter; you alight on the cups forIndra, exciting exceeding exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी न॑वन्ते अ॒द्रुह॑: प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्य॑म् । व॒त्सं न पूर्व॒ आयु॑नि जा॒तं रि॑हन्ति मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ navante ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀ priyám ǀ índrasya ǀ kā́myam ǀvatsám ǀ ná ǀ pū́rve ǀ ā́yuni ǀ jātám ǀ rihanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The innocent waters repair toSomadear toIndraand beloved (of all), as the material kine lick the new-born calf at the beginning of its life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒न इ॑न्द॒वा भ॑र॒ सोम॑ द्वि॒बर्ह॑सं र॒यिम् । त्वं वसू॑नि पुष्यसि॒ विश्वा॑नि दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ sóma ǀ dvi-bárhasam ǀ rayím ǀtvám ǀ vásūni ǀ puṣyasi ǀ víśvāni ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indu,Soma, when purified bring us the riches of both worlds; you foster all treasures in the house of the donor (of the libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं धियं॑ मनो॒युजं॑ सृ॒जा वृ॒ष्टिं न त॑न्य॒तुः । त्वं वसू॑नि॒ पार्थि॑वा दि॒व्या च॑ सोम पुष्यसि
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dhíyam ǀ manaḥ-yújam ǀ sṛjá ǀ vṛṣṭím ǀ ná ǀ tanyatúḥ ǀtvám ǀ vásūni ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ divyā́ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ puṣyasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let loose your stream which is as rapid as thought; as the cloud (let loose) the rain; youSomafoster terrestrial and celestial treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ ते जि॒ग्युषो॑ यथा॒ धारा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ धावति । रंह॑माणा॒ व्य१॒॑व्ययं॒ वारं॑ वा॒जीव॑ सान॒सिः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ te ǀ jigyúṣaḥ ǀ yathā ǀ dhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ dhāvati ǀráṃhamāṇā ǀ ví ǀ avyáyam ǀ vā́ram ǀ vājī́-iva ǀ sānasíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your stream when you are effused, swift-flowing bountiful, rushes through the sheep's hair like the horse of a victorious (hero).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य नः कवे॒ पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या । इन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे सु॒तो मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय च
shlokas.transliteration: krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ naḥ ǀ kave ǀ pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀíndrāya ǀ pā́tave ǀ sutáḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageSomaflow in a stream for our enlightenment and invigoration, poured forth forIndra,MitraandVaruṇato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व वाज॒सात॑मः प॒वित्रे॒ धार॑या सु॒तः । इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ विष्ण॑वे दे॒वेभ्यो॒ मधु॑मत्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vāja-sā́tamaḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀíndrāya ǀ soma ǀ víṣṇave ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, who are the giver of food in a stream, when effused, to the filter; (flow) Soma who are most sweet forIndra, forViṣṇu, for the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां रि॑हन्ति मा॒तरो॒ हरिं॑ प॒वित्रे॑ अ॒द्रुह॑: । व॒त्सं जा॒तं न धे॒नव॒: पव॑मान॒ विध॑र्मणि
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ rihanti ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ hárim ǀ pavítre ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀvatsám ǀ jātám ǀ ná ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ ví-dharmaṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The innocent maternal (waters) caress you, the green-tinted, upon the filter, OPavamāna, at the sacrifice, as kine caress their new-born calf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑मान॒ महि॒ श्रव॑श्चि॒त्रेभि॑र्यासि र॒श्मिभि॑: । शर्ध॒न्तमां॑सि जिघ्नसे॒ विश्वा॑नि दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: pávamāna ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ citrébhiḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀśárdhan ǀ támāṃsi ǀ jighnase ǀ víśvāni ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pavamāna, you traverse the vast firmament with various rays, hastening on you dispel allrākṣasasat the house of the donor (of the libation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं द्यां च॑ महिव्रत पृथि॒वीं चाति॑ जभ्रिषे । प्रति॑ द्रा॒पिम॑मुञ्चथा॒: पव॑मान महित्व॒ना
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dyā́m ǀ ca ǀ mahi-vrata ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ca ǀ áti ǀ jabhriṣe ǀpráti ǀ drāpím ǀ amuñcathāḥ ǀ pávamāna ǀ mahi-tvanā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Observer of manifold rites, you support both heaven and earth; OPavamāna, (who are endowed) with greatness, you put on your coat of mail.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रोजि॑ती वो॒ अन्ध॑सः सु॒ताय॑ मादयि॒त्नवे॑ । अप॒ श्वानं॑ श्नथिष्टन॒ सखा॑यो दीर्घजि॒ह्व्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: puráḥ-jitī ǀ vaḥ ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ sutā́ya ǀ mādayitnáve ǀápa ǀ śvā́nam ǀ śnathiṣṭana ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ dīrgha-jihvyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For (the drinking of) the effused exhilarating (juice) of theSomawho has plural ced victory before you, do you friends destroy the long-tongued dog.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो धार॑या पाव॒कया॑ परिप्र॒स्यन्द॑ते सु॒तः । इन्दु॒रश्वो॒ न कृत्व्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pāvakáyā ǀ pari-prasyándate ǀ sutáḥ ǀínduḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṛ́tvyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheIndugood for sacred rites which when effused flows forth in a purifying stream, (swift) as a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं दु॒रोष॑म॒भी नर॒: सोमं॑ वि॒श्वाच्या॑ धि॒या । य॒ज्ञं हि॑न्व॒न्त्यद्रि॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ duróṣam ǀ abhí ǀ náraḥ ǀ sómam ǀ viśvā́cyā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀyajñám ǀ hinvanti ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him, theSomaunassailable, adorable, the priests, with all comprehending intelligence, express with the stones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒तासो॒ मधु॑मत्तमा॒: सोमा॒ इन्द्रा॑य म॒न्दिन॑: । प॒वित्र॑वन्तो अक्षरन्दे॒वान्ग॑च्छन्तु वो॒ मदा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sutā́saḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamāḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ mandínaḥ ǀpavítra-vantaḥ ǀ akṣaran ǀ devā́n ǀ gacchantu ǀ vaḥ ǀ mádāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sweet-flavoured exhilaratingSomajuices effused (and) filtered flow forIndra; do you, exhilarating (juices) proceed to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॒रिन्द्रा॑य पवत॒ इति॑ दे॒वासो॑ अब्रुवन् । वा॒चस्पति॑र्मखस्यते॒ विश्व॒स्येशा॑न॒ ओज॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ íti ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ abruvan ǀvācáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ makhasyate ǀ víśvasya ǀ ī́śānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The devout (worshippers) say 'Induflows forth forIndra'; the lord of speech (Soma) soverign of all by his might desires (our) worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑धारः पवते समु॒द्रो वा॑चमीङ्ख॒यः । सोम॒: पती॑ रयी॒णां सखेन्द्र॑स्य दि॒वेदि॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ pavate ǀ samudráḥ ǀ vācam-īṅkhayáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ sákhā ǀ índrasya ǀ divé-dive ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The thousand-streamed ocean,Somathe stimulator of praise, the lord of riches, the friend ofIndraflows day by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं पू॒षा र॒यिर्भग॒: सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॑र्षति । पति॒र्विश्व॑स्य॒ भूम॑नो॒ व्य॑ख्य॒द्रोद॑सी उ॒भे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ rayíḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀpátiḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhū́manaḥ ǀ ví ǀ akhyat ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomabeing purified hastens (to the pitcher) fostering, wealth-giving, to be enjoyed (by all); the lord of all beings, he has illuminated both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॑ प्रि॒या अ॑नूषत॒ गावो॒ मदा॑य॒ घृष्व॑यः । सोमा॑सः कृण्वते प॒थः पव॑मानास॒ इन्द॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ ghṛ́ṣvayaḥ ǀsómāsaḥ ǀ kṛṇvate ǀ patháḥ ǀ pávamānāsaḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The affectionate emulous cows celebrate (Soma) for his exhilaration; the brilliant filtered (Soma) juices make paths (for themselves to flow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ओजि॑ष्ठ॒स्तमा भ॑र॒ पव॑मान श्र॒वाय्य॑म् । यः पञ्च॑ चर्ष॒णीर॒भि र॒यिं येन॒ वना॑महै
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ójiṣṭhaḥ ǀ tám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ pávamāna ǀ śravā́yyam ǀyáḥ ǀ páñca ǀ carṣaṇī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rayím ǀ yéna ǀ vánāmahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring to us, filtered (Soma), that celebrated (beverage) which is most potent, which (waits) upon the fiver orders of beings and by which we may obtain riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमा॑: पवन्त॒ इन्द॑वो॒ऽस्मभ्यं॑ गातु॒वित्त॑माः । मि॒त्राः सु॑वा॒ना अ॑रे॒पस॑: स्वा॒ध्य॑: स्व॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sómāḥ ǀ pavante ǀ índavaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ gātuvít-tamāḥ ǀmitrā́ḥ ǀ suvānā́ḥ ǀ arepásaḥ ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The brilliantSomajuices flow for us knowing the right path, friendly (to the gods), effused sinless, contemplative, all-knowing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ष्वा॒णासो॒ व्यद्रि॑भि॒श्चिता॑ना॒ गोरधि॑ त्व॒चि । इष॑म॒स्मभ्य॑म॒भित॒: सम॑स्वरन्वसु॒विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: susvānā́saḥ ǀ ví ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ cítānāḥ ǀ góḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀíṣam ǀ asmábhyam ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǀ vasu-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused by the stones, recognized upon the cowhide acquirers of wealth they bestow food upon us from all sides.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ते पू॒ता वि॑प॒श्चित॒: सोमा॑सो॒ दध्या॑शिरः । सूर्या॑सो॒ न द॑र्श॒तासो॑ जिग॒त्नवो॑ ध्रु॒वा घृ॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: eté ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ vipaḥ-cítaḥ ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ dádhi-āśiraḥ ǀsū́ryāsaḥ ǀ ná ǀ darśatā́saḥ ǀ jigatnávaḥ ǀ dhruvā́ḥ ǀ ghṛté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These filteredSomajuices, intelligent, mixed with curds, swift-moving, firm in the water (are) brilliant as suns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑न्वा॒नस्यान्ध॑सो॒ मर्तो॒ न वृ॑त॒ तद्वच॑: । अप॒ श्वान॑मरा॒धसं॑ ह॒ता म॒खं न भृग॑वः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ sunvānásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛta ǀ tát ǀ vácaḥ ǀápa ǀ śvā́nam ǀ arādhásam ǀ hatá ǀ makhám ǀ ná ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let no mortal hear the sound of the effusedSoma; drive off the dog that sacrifices not as theBhṛgusdrove offMakha.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जा॒मिरत्के॑ अव्यत भु॒जे न पु॒त्र ओ॒ण्यो॑: । सर॑ज्जा॒रो न योष॑णां व॒रो न योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jāmíḥ ǀ átke ǀ avyata ǀ bhujé ǀ ná ǀ putráḥ ǀ oṇyóḥ ǀsárat ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yóṣaṇām ǀ varáḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) the kinsman (of the gods) is enveloped in the investing filter like a child in the arms of its protecting parents; he hastens like a gallant to a mistress, like a bridegroom (to the bride) to sit upon his station (the pitcher).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वी॒रो द॑क्ष॒साध॑नो॒ वि यस्त॒स्तम्भ॒ रोद॑सी । हरि॑: प॒वित्रे॑ अव्यत वे॒धा न योनि॑मा॒सद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vīráḥ ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ ví ǀ yáḥ ǀ tastámbha ǀ ródasī íti ǀháriḥ ǀ pavítre ǀ avyata ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ yónim ǀ ā-sádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The green-tinted (Soma), the implement of strength, the hero, who has upheld heaven and earth, is enveloped in the filter like the sacrificer (in his house) to sit upon his station.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव्यो॒ वारे॑भिः पवते॒ सोमो॒ गव्ये॒ अधि॑ त्व॒चि । कनि॑क्रद॒द्वृषा॒ हरि॒रिन्द्र॑स्या॒भ्ये॑ति निष्कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ sómaḥ ǀ gávye ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀkánikradat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ háríḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomaflows purified by the sheep's hairs; crying aloud upon the cowhide for the showerer (of benefits), green-tinted he goes toIndra's prepared station.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रा॒णा शिशु॑र्म॒हीनां॑ हि॒न्वन्नृ॒तस्य॒ दीधि॑तिम् । विश्वा॒ परि॑ प्रि॒या भु॑व॒दध॑ द्वि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: krāṇā́ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ mahī́nām ǀ hinván ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́dhitim ǀvíśvā ǀ pári ǀ priyā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀ ádha ǀ dvitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Performing (sacred rites) the child of the great (waters) sending forth the lustre of the sacrifice (Soma) produces all acceptable (oblations) and (abides) in the two worlds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ त्रि॒तस्य॑ पा॒ष्यो॒३॒॑रभ॑क्त॒ यद्गुहा॑ प॒दम् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ स॒प्त धाम॑भि॒रध॑ प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ tritásya ǀ pāṣyóḥ ǀ ábhakta ǀ yát ǀ gúhā ǀ padám ǀyajñásya ǀ saptá ǀ dhā́ma-bhiḥ ǀ ádha ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theSomahas been taken the secret station of the grinding stones (at the sacrifice) ofTrita, then with the seven supports of the sacrifice (the priests praise) the conciliating (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ त्रि॒तस्य॒ धार॑या पृ॒ष्ठेष्वेर॑या र॒यिम् । मिमी॑ते अस्य॒ योज॑ना॒ वि सु॒क्रतु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ tritásya ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ pṛṣṭhéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ īraya ǀ rayím ǀmímīte ǀ asya ǀ yójanā ǀ ví ǀ su-krátuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Support,Soma) with your streamTrita's three (oblations); cause the giver of riches (Indra) to come to the sacred songs. The intelligent (praiser) of this (Indra) measures out hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒ज्ञा॒नं स॒प्त मा॒तरो॑ वे॒धाम॑शासत श्रि॒ये । अ॒यं ध्रु॒वो र॑यी॒णां चिके॑त॒ यत्
shlokas.transliteration: jajñānám ǀ saptá ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ vedhā́m ǀ aśāsata ǀ śriyé ǀayám ǀ dhruváḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ cíketa ǀ yát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven mothers instrumental uct the (Soma) the instrumental tutor (of the sacrifice) when born for the prosperity (of the worshippers) to that this firm Soma is cognizant of riches. [”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य व्र॒ते स॒जोष॑सो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॑ अ॒द्रुह॑: । स्पा॒र्हा भ॑वन्ति॒ रन्त॑यो जु॒षन्त॒ यत्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ vraté ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ adrúhaḥ ǀspārhā́ḥ ǀ bhavanti ǀ rántayaḥ ǀ juṣánta ǀ yát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The universal gods, devoid of malice, assembled together at his rite, are to be envied if being delighted they take plural asure (in theSoma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमी॒ गर्भ॑मृता॒वृधो॑ दृ॒शे चारु॒मजी॑जनन् । क॒विं मंहि॑ष्ठमध्व॒रे पु॑रु॒स्पृह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ īmíti ǀ gárbham ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ cā́rum ǀ ájījanan ǀkavím ǀ máṃhiṣṭham ǀ adhvaré ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The germ which the augmenters of the rite brought forth at the sacrifice lovely to look upon intelligent, most adorable, desired by many.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मी॒ची॒ने अ॒भि त्मना॑ य॒ह्वी ऋ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ । त॒न्वा॒ना य॒ज्ञमा॑नु॒षग्यद॑ञ्ज॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: samīcīné íti sam-īcīné ǀ abhí ǀ tmánā ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātárā ǀtanvānā́ḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǀ yát ǀ añjaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He of his own will approaches the great united parents of the sacrifice (heaven and earth) when (the priests) conducting the ceremony anoint him in due order with the sacred waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्रत्वा॑ शु॒क्रेभि॑र॒क्षभि॑ॠ॒णोरप॑ व्र॒जं दि॒वः । हि॒न्वन्नृ॒तस्य॒ दीधि॑तिं॒ प्राध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: krátvā ǀ śukrébhiḥ ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀ ṛṇóḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vrajám ǀ diváḥ ǀhinván ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dī́dhitim ǀ prá ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, by your act drive away with your brilliant organs the darkness from the sky, effusing into the sacrifice (your juice) the lustre of the rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र पु॑ना॒नाय॑ वे॒धसे॒ सोमा॑य॒ वच॒ उद्य॑तम् । भृ॒तिं न भ॑रा म॒तिभि॒र्जुजो॑षते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ punānā́ya ǀ vedháse ǀ sómāya ǀ vácaḥ ǀ út-yatam ǀbhṛtím ǀ ná ǀ bhara ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ jújoṣate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Raise a loud voice toSomathe instrumental tutor (of the rite), purified, gratified by praises, as (men pay) wages (to a labourer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ वारा॑ण्य॒व्यया॒ गोभि॑रञ्जा॒नो अ॑र्षति । त्री ष॒धस्था॑ पुना॒नः कृ॑णुते॒ हरि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ arṣati ǀtrī́ ǀ sadhá-sthā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ kṛṇute ǀ háriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Blending with the curds and milk theSomarushes through the woollen fleece; the green-tinted Soma being purified takes up three stations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॑म॒व्यये॒ वारे॑ अर्षति । अ॒भि वाणी॒ॠषी॑णां स॒प्त नू॑षत
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ arṣati ǀabhí ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ saptá ǀ nūṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomasends forth (its juice) through the woollen fleece to the honey-dripping receptacle; the seven metres of the ṛṣis praise (it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ णे॒ता म॑ती॒नां वि॒श्वदे॑वो॒ अदा॑भ्यः । सोम॑: पुना॒नश्च॒म्वो॑र्विश॒द्धरि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ netā́ ǀ matīnā́m ǀ viśvá-devaḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ camvóḥ ǀ viśat ǀ háriḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the leader of praises, in whom all the gods are comprehended, unassailable, green-tinted when filtered, enters the cups.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ दैवी॒रनु॑ स्व॒धा इन्द्रे॑ण याहि स॒रथ॑म् । पु॒ना॒नो वा॒घद्वा॒घद्भि॒रम॑र्त्यः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ dáivīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svadhā́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ yāhi ǀ sa-rátham ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vāghát ǀ vāghát-bhiḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Proceed in the same chariot withIndrato the celestial hosts, a priest purified by priests, immortal.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ सप्ति॒र्न वा॑ज॒युर्दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्य॑: सु॒तः । व्या॒न॒शिः पव॑मानो॒ वि धा॑वति
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀvi-ānaśíḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a charger eager for the combat the divine (Soma) effused for the gods hastens when purified spreading widely into the vessels.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सखा॑य॒ आ नि षी॑दत पुना॒नाय॒ प्र गा॑यत । शिशुं॒ न य॒ज्ञैः परि॑ भूषत श्रि॒ये
shlokas.transliteration: sákhāyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ní ǀ sīdata ǀ punānā́ya ǀ prá ǀ gāyata ǀśíśum ǀ ná ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ pári ǀ bhūṣata ǀ śriyé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sit down, friends, sing to the filteredSoma, decorate him with offerings to beautify him as (parents decorate) a child.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समी॑ व॒त्सं न मा॒तृभि॑: सृ॒जता॑ गय॒साध॑नम् । दे॒वा॒व्यं१॒॑ मद॑म॒भि द्विश॑वसम्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ īmíti ǀ vatsám ǀ ná ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sṛjáta ǀ gaya-sā́dhanam ǀdeva-avyám ǀ mádam ǀ abhí ǀ dví-śavasam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Associate him the support of the mansion with the maternal (waters) as the calf (with the mother) the protector of the gods, the exhilarator, endowed with twofold strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒नाता॑ दक्ष॒साध॑नं॒ यथा॒ शर्धा॑य वी॒तये॑ । यथा॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय॒ शंत॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: punā́ta ǀ dakṣa-sā́dhanam ǀ yáthā ǀ śárdhāya ǀ vītáye ǀyáthā ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ śám-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purify the bestower of strength so that he may make for invigoration for the banquet (of the gods) and may grant much happiness toMitraandVaruṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ त्वा वसु॒विद॑म॒भि वाणी॑रनूषत । गोभि॑ष्टे॒ वर्ण॑म॒भि वा॑सयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ tvā ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ abhí ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ te ǀ várṇam ǀ abhí ǀ vāsayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For us do the hymns glorify you the giver of wealth; we clothe your form with the (products of the) kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ मदानां पत॒ इन्दो॑ दे॒वप्स॑रा असि । सखे॑व॒ सख्ये॑ गातु॒वित्त॑मो भव
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ madānām ǀ pate ǀ índo íti ǀ devá-psarāḥ ǀ asi ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of our exhilaration,Indu, you are of brilliant form; be our true guide as a friend is to a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सने॑मि कृ॒ध्य१॒॑स्मदा र॒क्षसं॒ कं चि॑द॒त्रिण॑म् । अपादे॑वं द्व॒युमंहो॑ युयोधि नः
shlokas.transliteration: sánemi ǀ kṛdhí ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ rakṣásam ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ atríṇam ǀápa ǀ ádevam ǀ dvayúm ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ yuyodhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Show us (your) ancient (friendship); (drive off) the voraciousrākṣasa, the impious, the double dealer-- drive away our sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं व॑: सखायो॒ मदा॑य पुना॒नम॒भि गा॑यत । शिशुं॒ न य॒ज्ञैः स्व॑दयन्त गू॒र्तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ punānám ǀ abhí ǀ gāyata ǀśíśum ǀ ná ǀ yajñáiḥ ǀ svadayanta ǀ gūrtí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hymn, friends, theSomapurified for the exhilaration (of the gods), gratify him with oblations and praises as (men gratify) a child (with ornaments).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं व॒त्स इ॑व मा॒तृभि॒रिन्दु॑र्हिन्वा॒नो अ॑ज्यते । दे॒वा॒वीर्मदो॑ म॒तिभि॒: परि॑ष्कृतः
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ vatsáḥ-iva ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ ajyate ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indubeing set forth is sprinkled (with the waters) as a calf (is nourished) by its mother-- the protector of the deities, the exhilarator, graced by praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं दक्षा॑य॒ साध॑नो॒ऽयं शर्धा॑य वी॒तये॑ । अ॒यं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ मधु॑मत्तमः सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ dákṣāya ǀ sā́dhanaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ śárdhāya ǀ vītáye ǀayám ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma) is an instrumental ument for invigoration; he (is useful) for speed (and) for the banquet of your gods; he is effused most sweet-flavoured for the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोम॑न्न इन्दो॒ अश्व॑वत्सु॒तः सु॑दक्ष धन्व । शुचिं॑ ते॒ वर्ण॒मधि॒ गोषु॑ दीधरम्
shlokas.transliteration: gó-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ indo íti ǀ áśva-vat ǀ sutáḥ ǀ su-dakṣa ǀ dhanva ǀśúcim ǀ te ǀ várṇam ǀ ádhi ǀ góṣu ǀ dīdharam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PowerfulInduwho are effused, pour upon us (wealth) comprising cattle and horses; I mix the pure juice with the curds and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स नो॑ हरीणां पत॒ इन्दो॑ दे॒वप्स॑रस्तमः । सखे॑व॒ सख्ये॒ नर्यो॑ रु॒चे भ॑व
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ harīṇām ǀ pate ǀ índo íti ǀ devápsaraḥ-tamaḥ ǀsákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ náryaḥ ǀ rucé ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of our bay-coloured (cattle),Indu, who have a most brilliant form, do you who are kind to the priests be for a light to us as a friend (gives light) to a friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सने॑मि॒ त्वम॒स्मदाँ अदे॑वं॒ कं चि॑द॒त्रिण॑म् । सा॒ह्वाँ इ॑न्दो॒ परि॒ बाधो॒ अप॑ द्व॒युम्
shlokas.transliteration: sánemi ǀ tvám ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ ádevam ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ atríṇam ǀsahvā́n ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ bā́dhaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ dvayúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you (show) us your ancient (friendship), drive away the impious voracious (rākṣasa);Induwho are victorious overcome those who oppress us, (drive) off the double-dealing (rākṣas).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒मच्छ॑ सु॒ता इ॒मे वृष॑णं यन्तु॒ हर॑यः । श्रु॒ष्टी जा॒तास॒ इन्द॑वः स्व॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índram ǀ áccha ǀ sutā́ḥ ǀ imé ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ yantu ǀ hárayaḥ ǀśruṣṭī́ ǀ jātā́saḥ ǀ índavaḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these effused green-tintedSomajuices quickly genitive rated, all-knowing, proceed toIndrathe showerer (of benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं भरा॑य सान॒सिरिन्द्रा॑य पवते सु॒तः । सोमो॒ जैत्र॑स्य चेतति॒ यथा॑ वि॒दे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ bhárāya ǀ sānasíḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ sutáḥ ǀsómaḥ ǀ jáitrasya ǀ cetati ǀ yáthā ǀ vidé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This effusedSomaadorable for battle, is filtered forIndra; Soma thinks of the victorious (Indra) as he is known (in the world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्येदिन्द्रो॒ मदे॒ष्वा ग्रा॒भं गृ॑भ्णीत सान॒सिम् । वज्रं॑ च॒ वृष॑णं भर॒त्सम॑प्सु॒जित्
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ mádeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ grābhám ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ sānasím ǀvájram ǀ ca ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ bharat ǀ sám ǀ apsu-jít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In theSoma's exhilaration mayIndraseize hold of wealth to be enjoyed (by all) and conqueringVṛtrain the waters may he wield the thunderbolt the showerer (of blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ध॑न्वा सोम॒ जागृ॑वि॒रिन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव । द्यु॒मन्तं॒ शुष्म॒मा भ॑रा स्व॒र्विद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ dhanva ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀdyu-mántam ǀ śúṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “FlowSomawho are vigilant;Induspread around forIndra; bring brilliant overpowering all-obtaining (strength).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य॒ वृष॑णं॒ मदं॒ पव॑स्व वि॒श्वद॑र्शतः । स॒हस्र॑यामा पथि॒कृद्वि॑चक्ष॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ mádam ǀ pávasva ǀ viśvá-darśataḥ ǀsahásra-yāmā ǀ pathi-kṛ́t ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour forth forIndrathe exhilarating (juice) showering (benefits), you who are very beautiful, who have many paths, the finder of the (right) path, the observer (of all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ गातु॒वित्त॑मो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ मधु॑मत्तमः । स॒हस्रं॑ याहि प॒थिभि॒: कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀsahásram ǀ yāhi ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who are the best finder of paths for us, the sweet beverage for the gods, come by a thousand paths crying aloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व दे॒ववी॑तय॒ इन्दो॒ धारा॑भि॒रोज॑सा । आ क॒लशं॒ मधु॑मान्त्सोम नः सदः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ índo íti ǀ dhā́rābhiḥ ǀ ójasā ǀā́ ǀ kaláśam ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ soma ǀ naḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Indu, in your strength with your streams for the banquet of the gods; sit down,Soma, who are sweet-flavoured, in our pitcher.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ द्र॒प्सा उ॑द॒प्रुत॒ इन्द्रं॒ मदा॑य वावृधुः । त्वां दे॒वासो॑ अ॒मृता॑य॒ कं प॑पुः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ drapsā́ḥ ǀ uda-prútaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mádāya ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ kám ǀ papuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your drops, goint to the water, have exaltedIndrato exhilaration; the gods have quaffed you, the delighter, for immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑: सुतास इन्दवः पुना॒ना धा॑वता र॒यिम् । वृ॒ष्टिद्या॑वो रीत्यापः स्व॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ sutāsaḥ ǀ indavaḥ ǀ punānā́ḥ ǀ dhāvata ǀ rayím ǀvṛṣṭí-dyāvaḥ ǀ rīti-āpaḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring us wealth, brightSomajuices effused, filtered, filling the sky with rain, shedding water (upon the earth) acquiring all things.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑: पुना॒न ऊ॒र्मिणाव्यो॒ वारं॒ वि धा॑वति । अग्रे॑ वा॒चः पव॑मान॒: कनि॑क्रदत्
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́ram ǀ ví ǀ dhāvati ǀágre ǀ vācáḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ kánikradat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some being filtered flows in a stream through the woollen fleece, crying aloud when filtered in advance of the voice (of praise).”

shlokas.sanskrit: धी॒भिर्हि॑न्वन्ति वा॒जिनं॒ वने॒ क्रीळ॑न्त॒मत्य॑विम् । अ॒भि त्रि॑पृ॒ष्ठं म॒तय॒: सम॑स्वरन्
shlokas.transliteration: dhībhíḥ ǀ hinvanti ǀ vājínam ǀ váne ǀ krī́ḷantam ǀ áti-avim ǀabhí ǀ tri-pṛṣṭhám ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They send forth with their fingers the powerfulSomasporting in the water, passing through the fleece; praises celebrate him abiding in the three receptacles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑र्जि क॒लशाँ॑ अ॒भि मी॒ळ्हे सप्ति॒र्न वा॑ज॒युः । पु॒ना॒नो वाचं॑ ज॒नय॑न्नसिष्यदत्
shlokas.transliteration: ásarji ǀ kaláśān ǀ abhí ǀ mīḷhé ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀpunānáḥ ǀ vā́cam ǀ janáyan ǀ asisyadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring (to give the worshipper) food he has been let loose into the pitchers like a charger in battle; being filtered, raising a cry he flows (into the vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑ते हर्य॒तो हरि॒रति॒ ह्वरां॑सि॒ रंह्या॑ । अ॒भ्यर्ष॑न्त्स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ वी॒रव॒द्यश॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávate ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀ áti ǀ hvárāṃsi ǀ ráṃhyā ǀabhi-árṣan ǀ stotṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ vīrá-vat ǀ yáśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The delightful green-tinted (juice) flows with rapidity into the crooked (pitchers); bringing the worshippers, food andmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या प॑वस्व देव॒युर्मधो॒र्धारा॑ असृक्षत । रेभ॑न्प॒वित्रं॒ पर्ये॑षि वि॒श्वत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀrébhan ǀ pavítram ǀ pári ǀ eṣi ǀ viśvátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to the gods flow with that (stream); (your) streams of exhilarating beverage are let loose; with a roar you pass through the filter in all directions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परी॒तो षि॑ञ्चता सु॒तं सोमो॒ य उ॑त्त॒मं ह॒विः । द॒ध॒न्वाँ यो नर्यो॑ अ॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तरा सु॒षाव॒ सोम॒मद्रि॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ itáḥ ǀ siñcata ǀ sutám ǀ sómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ut-tamám ǀ havíḥ ǀdadhanvā́n ǀ yáḥ ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ susā́va ǀ sómam ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sprinkle from hence the effusedSoma-juice which is the best oblation (to the gods), and which, good for man, is going into the midst of the firmament; (the priest) has expressed the Soma with the stones.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नू॒नं पु॑ना॒नोऽवि॑भि॒: परि॑ स्र॒वाद॑ब्धः सुर॒भिन्त॑रः । सु॒ते चि॑त्त्वा॒प्सु म॑दामो॒ अन्ध॑सा श्री॒णन्तो॒ गोभि॒रुत्त॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: nūnám ǀ punānáḥ ǀ ávi-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ srava ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ surabhím-taraḥ ǀsuté ǀ cit ǀ tvā ǀ ap-sú ǀ madāmaḥ ǀ ándhasā ǀ śrīṇántaḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ út-taram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Soma) who are unassailable, who are most fragrant, flow around now being purified by the fleece; being effused we praise you eminent in the waters mixing you with food and the (products of the) kind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ सुवा॒नश्चक्ष॑से देव॒माद॑न॒: क्रतु॒रिन्दु॑र्विचक्ष॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ cákṣase ǀ deva-mā́danaḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being effused theInduflows so as to be seen (of all)-- the exhilarator of the gods, the agent (in holy acts), the observer of all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नः सो॑म॒ धार॑या॒पो वसा॑नो अर्षसि । आ र॑त्न॒धा योनि॑मृ॒तस्य॑ सीद॒स्युत्सो॑ देव हिर॒ण्यय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ arṣasi ǀā́ ǀ ratna-dhā́ḥ ǀ yónim ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sīdasi ǀ útsaḥ ǀ deva ǀ hiraṇyáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Undergoing purification you flowSomain a stream clothed in the (consecrated) waters; the giver of wealth you sit on the plural ce of sacrifice, divine (Soma), who flow forth, who are the origin of gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒हा॒न ऊध॑र्दि॒व्यं मधु॑ प्रि॒यं प्र॒त्नं स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दत् । आ॒पृच्छ्यं॑ ध॒रुणं॑ वा॒ज्य॑र्षति॒ नृभि॑र्धू॒तो वि॑चक्ष॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: duhānáḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ divyám ǀ mádhu ǀ priyám ǀ pratnám ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ ā́ ǀ asadat ǀā-pṛ́cchyam ǀ dharúṇam ǀ vājī́ ǀ arṣati ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dhūtáḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Milking the exhilarating agreeable celestial udder (theSoma) sits down on its ancient plural ce of aggregation (the firmament); food-giving, cleansed by the priests, observant it flows to the commendable worshipper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नः सो॑म॒ जागृ॑वि॒रव्यो॒ वारे॒ परि॑ प्रि॒यः । त्वं विप्रो॑ अभ॒वोऽङ्गि॑रस्तमो॒ मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्ष नः
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ soma ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pári ǀ priyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ vípraḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ mádhvā ǀ yajñám ǀ mimikṣa ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are purified, vigilant, agreeable (you flow) through the woollen fleece; you are intelligent, the chief of theAṅgirasas, sprinkle our oblation with your exhilarating juice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमो॑ मी॒ढ्वान्प॑वते गातु॒वित्त॑म॒ ऋषि॒र्विप्रो॑ विचक्ष॒णः । त्वं क॒विर॑भवो देव॒वीत॑म॒ आ सूर्यं॑ रोहयो दि॒वि
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ mīḍhvā́n ǀ pavate ǀ gātuvít-tamaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀtvám ǀ kavíḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ deva-vī́tamaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sū́ryam ǀ rohayaḥ ǀ diví ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somaflows forth the showerer of benefits, the best of path-finders, a ṛṣi, a sage, all-discriminating; you are a seer, most devoted to the gods; you have made the sun to mount the sky.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑ उ षुवा॒णः सो॒तृभि॒रधि॒ ष्णुभि॒रवी॑नाम् । अश्व॑येव ह॒रिता॑ याति॒ धार॑या म॒न्द्रया॑ याति॒ धार॑या
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ snú-bhiḥ ǀ ávīnām ǀáśvayā-iva ǀ harítā ǀ yāti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ mandráyā ǀ yāti ǀ dhā́rayā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Effused by the effusersSomais poured out upon the elevated fleeces; and proceeds with its green-tinted stream, as on a mare, proceeds with its exhilarating streams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒नू॒पे गोमा॒न्गोभि॑रक्षा॒: सोमो॑ दु॒ग्धाभि॑रक्षाः । स॒मु॒द्रं न सं॒वर॑णान्यग्मन्म॒न्दी मदा॑य तोशते
shlokas.transliteration: anūpé ǀ gó-mān ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sómaḥ ǀ dugdhā́bhiḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀsamudrám ǀ ná ǀ sam-váraṇāni ǀ agman ǀ mandī́ ǀ mádāya ǀ tośate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somacombined with the produce of the kine flows with the kine into the pitcher, he flows with the milked kine; his enjoyable juices go (to the pitcher as waters) to the ocean, the exhilarating (Soma) is expressed for the exhilaration (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सो॑म सुवा॒नो अद्रि॑भिस्ति॒रो वारा॑ण्य॒व्यया॑ । जनो॒ न पु॒रि च॒म्वो॑र्विश॒द्धरि॒: सदो॒ वने॑षु दधिषे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ soma ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ vā́rāṇi ǀ avyáyā ǀjánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ purí ǀ camvóḥ ǀ viśat ǀ háriḥ ǀ sádaḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ dadhiṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Expressed by the stones,Soma, (passing) through the sheep's hairs, green-tinted, entering the cups as a man (enters) a city, you take your seat in the wooden (vessels).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स मा॑मृजे ति॒रो अण्वा॑नि मे॒ष्यो॑ मी॒ळ्हे सप्ति॒र्न वा॑ज॒युः । अ॒नु॒माद्य॒: पव॑मानो मनी॒षिभि॒: सोमो॒ विप्रे॑भि॒ॠक्व॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ mamṛje ǀ tiráḥ ǀ áṇvāni ǀ meṣyáḥ ǀ mīḷhé ǀ sáptiḥ ǀ ná ǀ vāja-yúḥ ǀanu-mā́dyaḥ ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ manīṣí-bhiḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ víprebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desirous of (bestowing) food, passing through the interstices of the fleece theSomais adorned like a horse in the battle; thePavamāna, to be rejoiced in (by all, praised) by the intelligent, the sages, the reciters of sacred songs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सो॑म दे॒ववी॑तये॒ सिन्धु॒र्न पि॑प्ये॒ अर्ण॑सा । अं॒शोः पय॑सा मदि॒रो न जागृ॑वि॒रच्छा॒ कोशं॑ मधु॒श्चुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ devá-vītaye ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ pipye ǀ árṇasā ǀaṃśóḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ madiráḥ ǀ ná ǀ jā́gṛviḥ ǀ áccha ǀ kóśam ǀ madhu-ścútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are fed with water,Soma, like a river, for the banquet of the gods; with the juice of your filament you go to the honey-dropping receptacle, exhilarating, vigilant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ह॑र्य॒तो अर्जु॑ने॒ अत्के॑ अव्यत प्रि॒यः सू॒नुर्न मर्ज्य॑: । तमीं॑ हिन्वन्त्य॒पसो॒ यथा॒ रथं॑ न॒दीष्वा गभ॑स्त्योः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ árjune ǀ átke ǀ avyata ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ ná ǀ márjyaḥ ǀtám ǀ īm ǀ hinvanti ǀ apásaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ rátham ǀ nadī́ṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agreeable affectionate like a son about to be decorated, theSomais clad in a shining robe; they send him with thei rarms into the streams as active (warriors and their) chariot into (battle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि सोमा॑स आ॒यव॒: पव॑न्ते॒ मद्यं॒ मद॑म् । स॒मु॒द्रस्याधि॑ वि॒ष्टपि॑ मनी॒षिणो॑ मत्स॒रास॑: स्व॒र्विद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ mádyam ǀ mádam ǀsamudrásya ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǀ matsarā́saḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The swiftSomasend forth their inebriating juice upon the uplifted (filter) of the firmament, intelligent, exhilarating, all-acquiring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तर॑त्समु॒द्रं पव॑मान ऊ॒र्मिणा॒ राजा॑ दे॒व ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् । अर्ष॑न्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा॒ प्र हि॑न्वा॒न ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: tárat ǀ samudrám ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ ūrmíṇā ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǀárṣat ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ prá ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine royal (Soma) vast and true, undergoing purification traverses the firmament in a stream; vast and true, being sent forth he flows for the support ofMitraandVaruṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृभि॑र्येमा॒नो ह॑र्य॒तो वि॑चक्ष॒णो राजा॑ दे॒वः स॑मु॒द्रिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ samudríyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Regulated by the priests, the divine royalSoma, agreeable, intelligent, abiding in the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य पवते॒ मद॒: सोमो॑ म॒रुत्व॑ते सु॒तः । स॒हस्र॑धारो॒ अत्यव्य॑मर्षति॒ तमी॑ मृजन्त्या॒यव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ pavate ǀ mádaḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ marútvate ǀ sutáḥ ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ áti ǀ ávyam ǀ arṣati ǀ tám ǀ īmíti ǀ mṛjanti ǀ āyávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarating, flows, when effused, forIndraattended by theMaruts; thousand-streamed he passes through the fleece; men cleanse him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒ना॒नश्च॒मू ज॒नय॑न्म॒तिं क॒विः सोमो॑ दे॒वेषु॑ रण्यति । अ॒पो वसा॑न॒: परि॒ गोभि॒रुत्त॑र॒: सीद॒न्वने॑ष्वव्यत
shlokas.transliteration: punānáḥ ǀ camū́ íti ǀ janáyan ǀ matím ǀ kavíḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ raṇyati ǀapáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ út-taraḥ ǀ sī́dan ǀ váneṣu ǀ avyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Purified in the cups, exciting laudation, the sageSomarejoices among the gods; clothed with the waters sitting in the wooden bowls, he is surrounded with the curds and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तवा॒हं सो॑म रारण स॒ख्य इ॑न्दो दि॒वेदि॑वे । पु॒रूणि॑ बभ्रो॒ नि च॑रन्ति॒ मामव॑ परि॒धीँरति॒ ताँ इ॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ ahám ǀ soma ǀ raraṇa ǀ sakhyé ǀ indo íti ǀ divé-dive ǀpurū́ṇi ǀ babhro íti ǀ ní ǀ caranti ǀ mā́m ǀ áva ǀ pari-dhī́n ǀ áti ǀ tā́n ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In your friendship,InduSoma, I have rejoiced day by day; many (rākṣasas) assail me, tawny-coloured (Soma); overcome these who surround me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒ताहं नक्त॑मु॒त सो॑म ते॒ दिवा॑ स॒ख्याय॑ बभ्र॒ ऊध॑नि । घृ॒णा तप॑न्त॒मति॒ सूर्यं॑ प॒रः श॑कु॒ना इ॑व पप्तिम
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ ahám ǀ náktam ǀ utá ǀ soma ǀ te ǀ dívā ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ babhro íti ǀ ū́dhani ǀghṛṇā́ ǀ tápantam ǀ áti ǀ sū́ryam ǀ paráḥ ǀ śakunā́ḥ-iva ǀ paptima ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I (delight) in your presence, tawny-colouredSoma, both day and night, for the sake of your friendship may we soar like birds far beyond the sun blazing with your light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒ज्यमा॑नः सुहस्त्य समु॒द्रे वाच॑मिन्वसि । र॒यिं पि॒शङ्गं॑ बहु॒लं पु॑रु॒स्पृहं॒ पव॑माना॒भ्य॑र्षसि
shlokas.transliteration: mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ su-hastya ǀ samudré ǀ vā́cam ǀ invasi ǀrayím ǀ piśáṅgam ǀ bahulám ǀ puru-spṛ́ham ǀ pávamāna ǀ abhí ǀ arṣasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Fair-fingered (Soma) being cleansed you utter a sound in the pitcher; you bring,Pavamāna, ample golden-hued much-coveted wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒जा॒नो वारे॒ पव॑मानो अ॒व्यये॒ वृषाव॑ चक्रदो॒ वने॑ । दे॒वानां॑ सोम पवमान निष्कृ॒तं गोभि॑रञ्जा॒नो अ॑र्षसि
shlokas.transliteration: mṛjānáḥ ǀ vā́re ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ avyáye ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ áva ǀ cakradaḥ ǀ váne ǀdevā́nām ǀ soma ǀ pavamāna ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ añjānáḥ ǀ arṣasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer of benefits, cleansed and filtered in the woollen fleece, you cried aloud in the water;SomaPavamāna, mixed with the curds and milk, you go to the prepared (station) of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व॒ वाज॑सातये॒ऽभि विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑ । त्वं स॑मु॒द्रं प्र॑थ॒मो वि धा॑रयो दे॒वेभ्य॑: सोम मत्स॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ abhí ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀtvám ǀ samudrám ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ví ǀ dhārayaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ soma ǀ matsaráḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, to all praises to procure food (for us); you, the exhilarator of the gods, are the chief supporter of the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तू प॑वस्व॒ परि॒ पार्थि॑वं॒ रजो॑ दि॒व्या च॑ सोम॒ धर्म॑भिः । त्वां विप्रा॑सो म॒तिभि॑र्विचक्षण शु॒भ्रं हि॑न्वन्ति धी॒तिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ pavasva ǀ pári ǀ pā́rthivam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ divyā́ ǀ ca ǀ soma ǀ dhárma-bhiḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ vi-cakṣaṇa ǀ śubhrám ǀ hinvanti ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow quickly,Soma, with your supports, to the terrestrial and celestial worlds; the sages express you radiant, O observer of all, with praises and with their fingers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑माना असृक्षत प॒वित्र॒मति॒ धार॑या । म॒रुत्व॑न्तो मत्स॒रा इ॑न्द्रि॒या हया॑ मे॒धाम॒भि प्रयां॑सि च
shlokas.transliteration: pávamānāḥ ǀ asṛkṣata ǀ pavítram ǀ áti ǀ dhā́rayā ǀmarútvantaḥ ǀ matsarā́ḥ ǀ indriyā́ḥ ǀ háyāḥ ǀ medhā́m ǀ abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your purified juices are let flow through the filter in a stream accompanied by theMaruts, exhilarating plural asingIndra, swift-moving, bringing praise and food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पो वसा॑न॒: परि॒ कोश॑मर्ष॒तीन्दु॑र्हिया॒नः सो॒तृभि॑: । ज॒नय॒ञ्ज्योति॑र्म॒न्दना॑ अवीवश॒द्गाः कृ॑ण्वा॒नो न नि॒र्णिज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: apáḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ pári ǀ kóśam ǀ arṣati ǀ índuḥ ǀ hiyānáḥ ǀ sotṛ́-bhiḥ ǀjanáyan ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ mandánāḥ ǀ avīvaśat ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-níjam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induclothed with waters effused by the worshippers rushes to the receptacle, genitive rating light, identifying its form with the (products of the) kine, he covets now (our) praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व॒ मधु॑मत्तम॒ इन्द्रा॑य सोम क्रतु॒वित्त॑मो॒ मद॑: । महि॑ द्यु॒क्षत॑मो॒ मद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ kratuvít-tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀmáhi ǀ dyukṣá-tamaḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma,who are most sweet-flavoured, most intelligent, the exhilarator, flow forIndra, the great, the most brilliant,the exhilarator.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ ते पी॒त्वा वृ॑ष॒भो वृ॑षा॒यते॒ऽस्य पी॒ता स्व॒र्विद॑: । स सु॒प्रके॑तो अ॒भ्य॑क्रमी॒दिषोऽच्छा॒ वाजं॒ नैत॑शः
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ te ǀ pītvā́ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ vṛṣa-yáte ǀ asyá ǀ pītā́ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ su-práketaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ akramīt ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ vā́jam ǀ ná ǀ étaśaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By drinking whom the showererIndrais invigorated, by drinking you who are the beholder of everything, the intelligent (Indra) reaches the viands (of the enemy) as a horse (reaches) the battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं ह्य१॒॑ङ्ग दैव्या॒ पव॑मान॒ जनि॑मानि द्यु॒मत्त॑मः । अ॒मृ॒त॒त्वाय॑ घो॒षय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ hí ǀ aṅgá ǀ dáivyā ǀ pávamāna ǀ jánimāni ǀ dyumát-tamaḥ ǀamṛta-tvā́ya ǀ ghoṣáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you,Pavamāna, who aremost brilliant quickly shout to the races of the gods for (the sake of their) immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येना॒ नव॑ग्वो द॒ध्यङ्ङ॑पोर्णु॒ते येन॒ विप्रा॑स आपि॒रे । दे॒वानां॑ सु॒म्ने अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ चारु॑णो॒ येन॒ श्रवां॑स्यान॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ náva-gvaḥ ǀ dadhyáṅ ǀ apa-ūrṇuté ǀ yéna ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ āpiré ǀdevā́nām ǀ sumné ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You) through whom Dadhyañc tthe offerer of the nine days' rites opened (the cave), through whom the ṛṣis recovered (the stolen cows), through whom under the protection of the gods the worshippers obtained the sustenance of the delicious (ambrosial water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष स्य धार॑या सु॒तोऽव्यो॒ वारे॑भिः पवते म॒दिन्त॑मः । क्रीळ॑न्नू॒र्मिर॒पामि॑व
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ syáḥ ǀ dhā́rayā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ ávyaḥ ǀ vā́rebhiḥ ǀ pavate ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀkrī́ḷan ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ apā́m-iva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Soma) when effused flows most exhilarating through the woollen fleece, sporting like a wave of water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒स्रिया॒ अप्या॑ अ॒न्तरश्म॑नो॒ निर्गा अकृ॑न्त॒दोज॑सा । अ॒भि व्र॒जं त॑त्निषे॒ गव्य॒मश्व्यं॑ व॒र्मीव॑ धृष्ण॒वा रु॑ज
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ ápyāḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ákṛntat ǀ ójasā ǀabhí ǀ vrajám ǀ tatniṣe ǀ gávyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ varmī́-iva ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ ruja ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You who by your might extricated from the rock the quick-moving kine abiding in the waters, you have spread out a pasturage for cattle and horses; like a mailed (warrior) slay (theasuras), brave (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ सो॑ता॒ परि॑ षिञ्च॒ताश्वं॒ न स्तोम॑म॒प्तुरं॑ रज॒स्तुर॑म् । व॒न॒क्र॒क्षमु॑द॒प्रुत॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ sota ǀ pári ǀ siñcata ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ stómam ǀ ap-túram ǀ rajaḥ-túram ǀvana-krakṣám ǀ uda-prútam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour forth (theSoma), sprinkle it round like a horse, adorable, dispenser of rain, dispenser of light, showerer of fluid, swimming in water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्र॑धारं वृष॒भं प॑यो॒वृधं॑ प्रि॒यं दे॒वाय॒ जन्म॑ने । ऋ॒तेन॒ य ऋ॒तजा॑तो विवावृ॒धे राजा॑ दे॒व ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत्
shlokas.transliteration: sahásra-dhāram ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ payaḥ-vṛ́dham ǀ priyám ǀ devā́ya ǀ jánmane ǀṛténa ǀ yáḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātaḥ ǀ vi-vavṛdhé ǀ rā́jā ǀ deváḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ bṛhát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thousand-streamed, showererof benefits, augmenter of water, affectionate; (pour it forth) for the race of the gods which water-born is fostered by the water, the king, the god, the true, the great.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्यु॒म्नं बृ॒हद्यश॒ इष॑स्पते दिदी॒हि दे॑व देव॒युः । वि कोशं॑ मध्य॒मं यु॑व
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dyumnám ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ pate ǀ didīhí ǀ deva ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀví ǀ kóśam ǀ madhyamám ǀ yuva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Divine (Soma) lord of viands, who are devoted to the gods, bestow upon us brilliant and abundant food; separate the mid-aerial receptacle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ व॑च्यस्व सुदक्ष च॒म्वो॑: सु॒तो वि॒शां वह्नि॒र्न वि॒श्पति॑: । वृ॒ष्टिं दि॒वः प॑वस्व री॒तिम॒पां जिन्वा॒ गवि॑ष्टये॒ धिय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vacyasva ǀ su-dakṣa ǀ camvóḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ váhniḥ ǀ ná ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀvṛṣṭím ǀ diváḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ rītím ǀ apā́m ǀ jínva ǀ gó-iṣṭaye ǀ dhíyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come, powerful (Soma) effused into the cups, like a prince the sustainer of the people; pour the course of the waters, the rain fromheaven; accomplish the rites for the worshipper who seeks cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तमु॒ त्यं म॑द॒च्युतं॑ स॒हस्र॑धारं वृष॒भं दिवो॑ दुहुः । विश्वा॒ वसू॑नि॒ बिभ्र॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ mada-cyútam ǀ sahásra-dhāram ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ dívaḥ ǀ duhuḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ bíbhratam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Him have they milked from heaven, the shedder of exhilarating juice, the thousand-streamed, the showerer (of benefits), bearing all treasures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ वि ज॑ज्ञे ज॒नय॒न्नम॑र्त्यः प्र॒तप॒ञ्ज्योति॑षा॒ तम॑: । स सुष्टु॑तः क॒विभि॑र्नि॒र्णिजं॑ दधे त्रि॒धात्व॑स्य॒ दंस॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ ví ǀ jajñe ǀ janáyan ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ pra-tápan ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ támaḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ sú-stutaḥ ǀ kaví-bhiḥ ǀ niḥ-níjam ǀ dadhe ǀ tri-dhā́tu ǀ asya ǀ dáṃsasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of benefits) is manifested begetting (light) immortal, destroying the darkness with (his) radiance; glorified by the wise he has assumed his shining robe; the triple (oblation is supported) by his act.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स सु॑न्वे॒ यो वसू॑नां॒ यो रा॒यामा॑ने॒ता य इळा॑नाम् । सोमो॒ यः सु॑क्षिती॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ sunve ǀ yáḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ yáḥ ǀ rāyā́m ǀ ā-netā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ íḷānām ǀsómaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ su-kṣitīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomahas been effused who is the bringer of treasures, the bringer of riches, the bringer of food, the bringer of fair homes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॑ न॒ इन्द्र॒: पिबा॒द्यस्य॑ म॒रुतो॒ यस्य॑ वार्य॒मणा॒ भग॑: । आ येन॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ करा॑मह॒ एन्द्र॒मव॑से म॒हे
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ naḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ píbāt ǀ yásya ǀ marútaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ vā ǀ aryamáṇā ǀ bhágaḥ ǀā́ ǀ yéna ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ kárāmahe ǀ ā́ ǀ índram ǀ ávase ǀ mahé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our (Soma) whichIndradrinks, which theMarutsdrink andBhagawithAryaman; through which we propitiateMitraandVaruṇaand Indra, to obtain his powerful protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॑य सोम॒ पात॑वे॒ नृभि॑र्य॒तः स्वा॑यु॒धो म॒दिन्त॑मः । पव॑स्व॒ मधु॑मत्तमः
shlokas.transliteration: índrāya ǀ soma ǀ pā́tave ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ su-āyudháḥ ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǀpávasva ǀ mádhumat-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, collected by the priests, well-armed, most exhilarating, most sweet-flavoured, flow forIndrato drink.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ हार्दि॑ सोम॒धान॒मा वि॑श समु॒द्रमि॑व॒ सिन्ध॑वः । जुष्टो॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय वा॒यवे॑ दि॒वो वि॑ष्ट॒म्भ उ॑त्त॒मः
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ hā́rdi ǀ soma-dhā́nam ǀ ā́ ǀ viśa ǀ samudrám-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀjúṣṭaḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vāyáve ǀ diváḥ ǀ viṣṭambháḥ ǀ ut-tamáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, enter the Somadhāna,Indra's heart, as the rivers (enter) the sea agreeable toMitra,VaruṇaandVāyu, the chief stay of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॒ प्र ध॒न्वेन्द्रा॑य सोम स्वा॒दुर्मि॒त्राय॑ पू॒ष्णे भगा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ prá ǀ dhanva ǀ índrāya ǀ soma ǀ svādúḥ ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ pūṣṇé ǀ bhágāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Somawho are sweet-flavoured, forIndra,Mitra,Pūṣan, andBhaga.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्ते सोम सु॒तस्य॑ पेया॒: क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य॒ विश्वे॑ च दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ te ǀ soma ǀ sutásya ǀ peyāḥ ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ víśve ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, letIndraand all the gods drink of you when effused for intelligence and strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वामृता॑य म॒हे क्षया॑य॒ स शु॒क्रो अ॑र्ष दि॒व्यः पी॒यूष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ mahé ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ sáḥ ǀ śukráḥ ǀ arṣa ǀ divyáḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So do you who are pure, divine, the beverage of all the gods, flow for immortality and a spacious abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम म॒हान्त्स॑मु॒द्रः पि॒ता दे॒वानां॒ विश्वा॒भि धाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ mahā́n ǀ samudráḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ víśvā ǀ abhí ǀ dhā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, who are mighty, the shedder of juice the parent of the gods, towards all bodies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒क्रः प॑वस्व दे॒वेभ्य॑: सोम दि॒वे पृ॑थि॒व्यै शं च॑ प्र॒जायै॑
shlokas.transliteration: śukráḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ soma ǀ divé ǀ pṛthivyái ǀ śám ǀ ca ǀ pra-jā́yai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, who are brilliant, flow for the gods and (give) joy to heaven and earth and all creatures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वो ध॒र्तासि॑ शु॒क्रः पी॒यूष॑: स॒त्ये विध॑र्मन्वा॒जी प॑वस्व
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ asi ǀ śukráḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣaḥ ǀ satyé ǀ ví-dharman ǀ vājī́ ǀ pavasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the upholder of heaven, radiant and good to drink; flow you who are strong, at the truthful sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम द्यु॒म्नी सु॑धा॒रो म॒हामवी॑ना॒मनु॑ पू॒र्व्यः
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ su-dhāráḥ ǀ mahā́m ǀ ávīnām ǀ ánu ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Soma, who are possessed of food, who have a copious stream, flow through the great sheep's hairs in due succession.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृभि॑र्येमा॒नो ज॑ज्ञा॒नः पू॒तः क्षर॒द्विश्वा॑नि म॒न्द्रः स्व॒र्वित्
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ pūtáḥ ǀ kṣárat ǀ víśvāni ǀ mandráḥ ǀ svaḥ-vít ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May, theSomaregulated by the priests, engendered, purified, exhilarating, all-knowing bring us all (riches).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑: पुना॒नः प्र॒जामु॑रा॒णः कर॒द्विश्वा॑नि॒ द्रवि॑णानि नः
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ urāṇáḥ ǀ kárat ǀ víśvāni ǀ dráviṇāni ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndu, purified, extolling (the gods) bestow on us progeny and all kinds of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पव॑स्व सोम॒ क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॒याश्वो॒ न नि॒क्तो वा॒जी धना॑य
shlokas.transliteration: pávasva ǀ soma ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ niktáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ dhánāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, for intelligence, for strength, for wealth, strong and cleansed like a horse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं ते॑ सो॒तारो॒ रसं॒ मदा॑य पु॒नन्ति॒ सोमं॑ म॒हे द्यु॒म्नाय॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ te ǀ sotā́raḥ ǀ rásam ǀ mádāya ǀ punánti ǀ sómam ǀ mahé ǀ dyumnā́ya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) who press you purify your juice for exhilaration; (they purify) theSomafor abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिशुं॑ जज्ञा॒नं हरिं॑ मृजन्ति प॒वित्रे॒ सोमं॑ दे॒वेभ्य॒ इन्दु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: śíśum ǀ jajñānám ǀ hárim ǀ mṛjanti ǀ pavítre ǀ sómam ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ índum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They cleanse the new-born infant, the green-tinted shiningSoma, on the filter for the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॑: पविष्ट॒ चारु॒र्मदा॑या॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ क॒विर्भगा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ paviṣṭa ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ kavíḥ ǀ bhágāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious sageInduflows upon the lap of the waters for exhilaration and for wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बिभ॑र्ति॒ चार्विन्द्र॑स्य॒ नाम॒ येन॒ विश्वा॑नि वृ॒त्रा ज॒घान॑
shlokas.transliteration: bíbharti ǀ cā́ru ǀ índrasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ yéna ǀ víśvāni ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ jaghā́na ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The auspicious (Soma) sustainsIndra's body, by which he has slain allrākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिब॑न्त्यस्य॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॒ गोभि॑: श्री॒तस्य॒ नृभि॑: सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: píbanti ǀ asya ǀ víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ śrītásya ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The universal gods drink of it, effused by the priests, mixed with milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सु॑वा॒नो अ॑क्षाः स॒हस्र॑धारस्ति॒रः प॒वित्रं॒ वि वार॒मव्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ suvānáḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ ví ǀ vā́ram ǀ ávyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being effused theSomain a thousand streams flows through the sheep's-hair filter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वा॒ज्य॑क्षाः स॒हस्र॑रेता अ॒द्भिर्मृ॑जा॒नो गोभि॑: श्रीणा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ akṣāríti ǀ sahásra-retāḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ mṛjānáḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ śrīṇānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vigorousSomaflows in a thousand streams cleansed by the waters and mixing with the curds and milk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र सो॑म या॒हीन्द्र॑स्य कु॒क्षा नृभि॑र्येमा॒नो अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ soma ǀ yāhi ǀ índrasya ǀ kukṣā́ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ yemānáḥ ǀ ádri-bhiḥ ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Guided by the priests and effused with the stones go,Soma, toIndra's belly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑र्जि वा॒जी ति॒रः प॒वित्र॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ सोम॑: स॒हस्र॑धारः
shlokas.transliteration: ásarji ǀ vājī́ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ pavítram ǀ índrāya ǀ sómaḥ ǀ sahásra-dhāraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The vigorous thousand-streamedSomahas been sent through, the filter forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ञ्जन्त्ये॑नं॒ मध्वो॒ रसे॒नेन्द्रा॑य॒ वृष्ण॒ इन्दुं॒ मदा॑य
shlokas.transliteration: añjánti ǀ enam ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ rásena ǀ índrāya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ índum ǀ mádāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They mix theSomawith the liquid of the sweet (milk) forIndra, the showerer (of benefits) for his exhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा॒ वृथा॒ पाज॑से॒ऽपो वसा॑नं॒ हरिं॑ मृजन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ pā́jase ǀ apáḥ ǀ vásānam ǀ hárim ǀ mṛjanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They cleanse you readily, clothed with water, green-tinted, for the invigoration of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्दु॒रिन्द्रा॑य तोशते॒ नि तो॑शते श्री॒णन्नु॒ग्रो रि॒णन्न॒पः
shlokas.transliteration: índuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ tośate ǀ ní ǀ tośate ǀ śrīṇán ǀ ugráḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ apáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Induis effused forIndra's, is effused downward-- fierce, mixing (with the milk), flowing (into) the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पर्यू॒ षु प्र ध॑न्व॒ वाज॑सातये॒ परि॑ वृ॒त्राणि॑ स॒क्षणि॑: । द्वि॒षस्त॒रध्या॑ ऋण॒या न॑ ईयसे
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ dhanva ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ pári ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ sakṣáṇiḥ ǀdviṣáḥ ǀ tarádhyai ǀ ṛṇa-yā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ īyase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hasten,Soma, to bring us sustenance; gifted with endurance (attack our) foes; the acquitter of our debts, you approach to disperse our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अनु॒ हि त्वा॑ सु॒तं सो॑म॒ मदा॑मसि म॒हे स॑मर्य॒राज्ये॑ । वाजाँ॑ अ॒भि प॑वमान॒ प्र गा॑हसे
shlokas.transliteration: ánu ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ sutám ǀ soma ǀ mádāmasi ǀ mahé ǀ samarya-rā́jye ǀvā́jān ǀ abhí ǀ pavamāna ǀ prá ǀ gāhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In turn we glorify you,Soma, when effused; you attack the (hostile) forces, OPavamāna, to (defend) your great sovereignty over men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजी॑जनो॒ हि प॑वमान॒ सूर्यं॑ वि॒धारे॒ शक्म॑ना॒ पय॑: । गोजी॑रया॒ रंह॑माण॒: पुरं॑ध्या
shlokas.transliteration: ájījanaḥ ǀ hí ǀ pavamāna ǀ sū́ryam ǀ vi-dhā́re ǀ śákmanā ǀ páyaḥ ǀgó-jīrayā ǀ ráṃhamāṇaḥ ǀ púram-dhyā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pavamāna, by your might you ahve genitive rated the sun in (the firmament), the support of the water, hastening on with abundant wisdom that procures cattle (for your worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अजी॑जनो अमृत॒ मर्त्ये॒ष्वाँ ऋ॒तस्य॒ धर्म॑न्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ चारु॑णः । सदा॑सरो॒ वाज॒मच्छा॒ सनि॑ष्यदत्
