shlokas.transliteration: ájījanaḥ ǀ amṛta ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhárman ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ cā́ruṇaḥ ǀsádā ǀ asaraḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ áccha ǀ sánisyadat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImmortalSoma, you have genitive rated (the sun) among mortals in (the firmament), the suppor tof the truthful auspicious ambrosia; streaming forth you goe to battle continually.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भ्य॑भि॒ हि श्रव॑सा त॒तर्दि॒थोत्सं॒ न कं चि॑ज्जन॒पान॒मक्षि॑तम् । शर्या॑भि॒र्न भर॑माणो॒ गभ॑स्त्योः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí-abhi ǀ hí ǀ śrávasā ǀ tatárditha ǀ útsam ǀ ná ǀ kám ǀ cit ǀ jana-pā́nam ǀ ákṣitam ǀśáryābhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ bháramāṇaḥ ǀ gábhastyoḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have burst open (the filter) with (your) food as (one bursts open) an inexhaustible fountain giving drink to the nation, like one taking up (water) with the fingers of his twohands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदीं॒ के चि॒त्पश्य॑मानास॒ आप्यं॑ वसु॒रुचो॑ दि॒व्या अ॒भ्य॑नूषत । वारं॒ न दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता व्यू॑र्णुते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ īm ǀ ké ǀ cit ǀ páśyamānāsaḥ ǀ ā́pyam ǀ vasu-rúcaḥ ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀvā́ram ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ ví ǀ ūrṇute ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding him certain celestial Vasurucas praise him as a kinsman before the shiningSavitādrives away the obstructing (darkness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे सो॑म प्रथ॒मा वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषो म॒हे वाजा॑य॒ श्रव॑से॒ धियं॑ दधुः । स त्वं नो॑ वीर वी॒र्या॑य चोदय
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ soma ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ vā́jāya ǀ śrávase ǀ dhíyam ǀ dadhuḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vīra ǀ vīryā́ya ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chief (of men) having cut the sacred grass have fixed their minds,Soma, on you for abundant strength and food; do you, O hero, excite us to heroism.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वः पी॒यूषं॑ पू॒र्व्यं यदु॒क्थ्यं॑ म॒हो गा॒हाद्दि॒व आ निर॑धुक्षत । इन्द्र॑म॒भि जाय॑मानं॒ सम॑स्वरन्
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ pūrvyám ǀ yát ǀ ukthyám ǀ maháḥ ǀ gāhā́t ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ adhukṣata ǀíndram ǀ abhí ǀ jā́yamānam ǀ sám ǀ asvaran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have milked from heaven from the mighty deep the ancientSoma, the beverage (of the gods) of heaven, which is worthy of praise; they have praised it when genitive rated forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ यदि॒मे प॑वमान॒ रोद॑सी इ॒मा च॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒भि म॒ज्मना॑ । यू॒थे न नि॒ष्ठा वृ॑ष॒भो वि ति॑ष्ठसे
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ yát ǀ imé íti ǀ pavamāna ǀ ródasī íti ǀ imā́ ǀ ca ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ abhí ǀ majmánā ǀyūthé ǀ ná ǀ niḥ-sthā́ḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since,Pavamāna, you by your might are chief over these two worlds and all these living beings, as a bull is ruler in a herd of kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोम॑: पुना॒नो अ॒व्यये॒ वारे॒ शिशु॒र्न क्रीळ॒न्पव॑मानो अक्षाः । स॒हस्र॑धारः श॒तवा॑ज॒ इन्दु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sómaḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ avyáye ǀ vā́re ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ ná ǀ krī́ḷan ǀ pávamānaḥ ǀ akṣāríti ǀsahásra-dhāraḥ ǀ śatá-vājaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “PavamānaSomasporting like a child drops filtered through the woollen fleece, thousand-streamed, having the might of a hundred, radiant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ष पु॑ना॒नो मधु॑माँ ऋ॒तावेन्द्रा॒येन्दु॑: पवते स्वा॒दुरू॒र्मिः । वा॒ज॒सनि॑र्वरिवो॒विद्व॑यो॒धाः
shlokas.transliteration: eṣáḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ mádhu-mān ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ índrāya ǀ índuḥ ǀ pavate ǀ svādúḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀvāja-sániḥ ǀ varivaḥ-vít ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomajuice undergoing purification, sweet-flavoured, holy, dropping; flows forIndraa sweet stream, bestowing food, dispensing wealth and life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स प॑वस्व॒ सह॑मानः पृत॒न्यून्त्सेध॒न्रक्षां॒स्यप॑ दु॒र्गहा॑णि । स्वा॒यु॒धः सा॑स॒ह्वान्त्सो॑म॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pavasva ǀ sáhamānaḥ ǀ pṛtanyū́n ǀ sédhan ǀ rákṣāṃsi ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-gáhāni ǀsu-āyudháḥ ǀ sasahvā́n ǀ soma ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Flow,Soma, overcoming (our) enemies, driving away therākṣasaswho are difficult to approach, well-armed, triumphing over foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒या रु॒चा हरि॑ण्या पुना॒नो विश्वा॒ द्वेषां॑सि तरति स्व॒युग्व॑भि॒: सूरो॒ न स्व॒युग्व॑भिः । धारा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ रोचते पुना॒नो अ॑रु॒षो हरि॑: । विश्वा॒ यद्रू॒पा प॑रि॒यात्यृक्व॑भिः स॒प्तास्ये॑भि॒ॠक्व॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ayā́ ǀ rucā́ ǀ háriṇyā ǀ punānáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ tarati ǀ svayúgva-bhiḥ ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ná ǀ svayúgva-bhiḥ ǀdhā́rā ǀ sutásya ǀ rocate ǀ punānáḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ háriḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ yát ǀ rūpā́ ǀ pari-yā́ti ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ saptá-āsyebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With this bright green-tinted streamSomabeing filtered overcomes all enemies with the (juices) yoked to it, as the sun (overcomes the darkness) with the (rays) yoked to it; the stream of the effused (Soma) shines, the filtered green-tinted (Soma) is resplendent, which pervade all constellations, with the ṛkvans, with the seven-mouthed ṛkvans.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं त्यत्प॑णी॒नां वि॑दो॒ वसु॒ सं मा॒तृभि॑र्मर्जयसि॒ स्व आ दम॑ ऋ॒तस्य॑ धी॒तिभि॒र्दमे॑ । प॒रा॒वतो॒ न साम॒ तद्यत्रा॒ रण॑न्ति धी॒तय॑: । त्रि॒धातु॑भि॒ररु॑षीभि॒र्वयो॑ दधे॒ रोच॑मानो॒ वयो॑ दधे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyát ǀ paṇīnā́m ǀ vidaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ sám ǀ mātṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ marjayasi ǀ své ǀ ā́ ǀ dáme ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ dáme ǀparā-vátaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sā́ma ǀ tát ǀ yátra ǀ ráṇanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀtridhā́tu-bhiḥ ǀ áruṣībhiḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ rócamānaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dadhe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You did discover the wealth of thePaṇis, and are washed in your own house at the sacrifice by the mothers, the supporters of the sacrifice; as the hymn (is heard) from afar, so it (is heard by all, the hymn) in which the supporters (of the rite) rejoice; the shining (Soma) with its brilliant (waters), the supporters of the three (worlds), gives food, gives food (to the worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पूर्वा॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिशं॑ याति॒ चेकि॑त॒त्सं र॒श्मिभि॑र्यतते दर्श॒तो रथो॒ दैव्यो॑ दर्श॒तो रथ॑: । अग्म॑न्नु॒क्थानि॒ पौंस्येन्द्रं॒ जैत्रा॑य हर्षयन् । वज्र॑श्च॒ यद्भव॑थो॒ अन॑पच्युता स॒मत्स्वन॑पच्युता
shlokas.transliteration: pū́rvām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-díśam ǀ yāti ǀ cékitat ǀ sám ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǀ yatate ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ darśatáḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀágman ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ páuṃsyā ǀ índram ǀ jáitrāya ǀ harṣayan ǀvájraḥ ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ bhávathaḥ ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǀ samát-su ǀ ánapa-cyutā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The intelligentSomaproceeds to the eastern quarter; (your) beautiful chariot, (your) celestial beautiful chariot meets the sun's rays; the manly praises advance toIndraand stimulate him to victory; (his) thunderbolt too (advances to him); so that you are invincible, invincible in battle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ना॒ना॒नं वा उ॑ नो॒ धियो॒ वि व्र॒तानि॒ जना॑नाम् । तक्षा॑ रि॒ष्टं रु॒तं भि॒षग्ब्र॒ह्मा सु॒न्वन्त॑मिच्छ॒तीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: nānānám ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vratā́ni ǀ jánānām ǀtákṣā ǀ riṣṭám ǀ rutám ǀ bhiṣák ǀ brahmā́ ǀ sunvántam ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Various are our acts, (various) are the occupations of men; the carpenter desires timber, the physician disease, thebrāhmaṇaa worshipper who effusesSoma; flow,InduforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जर॑तीभि॒रोष॑धीभिः प॒र्णेभि॑: शकु॒नाना॑म् । का॒र्मा॒रो अश्म॑भि॒र्द्युभि॒र्हिर॑ण्यवन्तमिच्छ॒तीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: járatībhiḥ ǀ óṣadhībhiḥ ǀ parṇébhiḥ ǀ śakunā́nām ǀkārmāráḥ ǀ áśma-bhiḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ híraṇya-vantam ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With dried plural nts (are arrows made), with the feathers of birds (and) with glistening stones; the smith seeks a man who has gold; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: का॒रुर॒हं त॒तो भि॒षगु॑पलप्र॒क्षिणी॑ न॒ना । नाना॑धियो वसू॒यवोऽनु॒ गा इ॑व तस्थि॒मेन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: kārúḥ ǀ ahám ǀ tatáḥ ǀ bhiṣák ǀ upala-prakṣíṇī ǀ nanā́ ǀnā́nā-dhiyaḥ ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ tasthima ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am the singer;papais the physician, mamma throws the corn upon the grinding stones; having various occupations, desiring riches we remain (in the world) like cattle (in the stall); flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वो॒ वोळ्हा॑ सु॒खं रथं॑ हस॒नामु॑पम॒न्त्रिण॑: । शेपो॒ रोम॑ण्वन्तौ भे॒दौ वारिन्म॒ण्डूक॑ इच्छ॒तीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: áśvaḥ ǀ vóḷhā ǀ su-khám ǀ rátham ǀ hasanā́m ǀ upa-mantríṇaḥ ǀśépaḥ ǀ rómaṇ-vantau ǀ bhedáu ǀ vā́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ maṇḍū́kaḥ ǀ icchati ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The draught horse (desire) a cart easy (to draw); those who invite guests (desire) merriment; the frog desires water; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श॒र्य॒णाव॑ति॒ सोम॒मिन्द्र॑: पिबतु वृत्र॒हा । बलं॒ दधा॑न आ॒त्मनि॑ करि॒ष्यन्वी॒र्यं॑ म॒हदिन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: śaryaṇā́-vati ǀ sómam ǀ índraḥ ǀ pibatu ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀbálam ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ ātmáni ǀ kariṣyán ǀ vīryám ǀ mahát ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetIndra, the slayer ofVṛtra, quaff theSomaon the Śaryaṇāvat, infusing strength into himself, about to show great prowess; flow,Indu, for Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व दिशां पत आर्जी॒कात्सो॑म मीढ्वः । ऋ॒त॒वा॒केन॑ स॒त्येन॑ श्र॒द्धया॒ तप॑सा सु॒त इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ pavasva ǀ diśām ǀ pate ǀ ārjīkā́t ǀ soma ǀ mīḍhvaḥ ǀṛta-vākéna ǀ satyéna ǀ śraddháyā ǀ tápasā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, lord of the four regions, sprinkler (of benefits) flow from Ārjikā effused by a truth-speaking truthful (man) with faith and devotion; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒र्जन्य॑वृद्धं महि॒षं तं सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒ताभ॑रत् । तं ग॑न्ध॒र्वाः प्रत्य॑गृभ्ण॒न्तं सोमे॒ रस॒माद॑धु॒रिन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: parjánya-vṛddham ǀ mahiṣám ǀ tám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ duhitā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǀtám ǀ gandharvā́ḥ ǀ práti ǀ agṛbhṇan ǀ tám ǀ sóme ǀ rásam ǀ ā́ ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The daughter ofSūryabrought the vastSomalarge as a rain-cloud; thegandharvaseized upon it and plural ced the juice in the Soma; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं वद॑न्नृतद्युम्न स॒त्यं वद॑न्त्सत्यकर्मन् । श्र॒द्धां वद॑न्त्सोम राजन्धा॒त्रा सो॑म॒ परि॑ष्कृत॒ इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtám ǀ vádan ǀ ṛta-dyumna ǀ satyám ǀ vádan ǀ satya-karman ǀśraddhā́m ǀ vádan ǀ soma ǀ rājan ǀ dhātrā́ ǀ soma ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, the utterer of truth, radiant with truth, truth-speaking, truthful in act, speaking faith; lord (of worshippers), you are decorated by the upholder (of the rite); flow,InduforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒त्यमु॑ग्रस्य बृह॒तः सं स्र॑वन्ति संस्र॒वाः । सं य॑न्ति र॒सिनो॒ रसा॑: पुना॒नो ब्रह्म॑णा हर॒ इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: satyám-ugrasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ sám ǀ sravanti ǀ sam-sravā́ḥ ǀsám ǀ yanti ǀ rasínaḥ ǀ rásāḥ ǀ punānáḥ ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ hare ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The united streams of you who are vast and truly formidable flow united; the juices of you the juicy one meet together; green-tinted (Soma), purified by holy prayer,Indu, flow forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॑ ब्र॒ह्मा प॑वमान छन्द॒स्यां॒३॒॑ वाचं॒ वद॑न् । ग्राव्णा॒ सोमे॑ मही॒यते॒ सोमे॑नान॒न्दं ज॒नय॒न्निन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ brahmā́ ǀ pavamāna ǀ chandasyā́m ǀ vā́cam ǀ vádan ǀgrā́vṇā ǀ sóme ǀ mahīyáte ǀ sómena ǀ ā-nandám ǀ janáyan ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wherever theBrahman, O purified (Soma), reciting the holy rhythmical text, engendering the delight (of the gods) by the Soma (expressed) with the grinding-stone, is reverenced, flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ ज्योति॒रज॑स्रं॒ यस्मिँ॑ल्लो॒के स्व॑र्हि॒तम् । तस्मि॒न्मां धे॑हि पवमाना॒मृते॑ लो॒के अक्षि॑त॒ इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ájasram ǀ yásmin ǀ loké ǀ sváḥ ǀ hitám ǀtásmin ǀ mā́m ǀ dhehi ǀ pavamāna ǀ amṛ́te ǀ loké ǀ ákṣite ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where light is perpetual, in the world in which the sun is plural ced, in that immortal imperishable world plural ce me,Pavamāna; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ राजा॑ वैवस्व॒तो यत्रा॑व॒रोध॑नं दि॒वः । यत्रा॒मूर्य॒ह्वती॒राप॒स्तत्र॒ माम॒मृतं॑ कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ rā́jā ǀ vaivasvatáḥ ǀ yátra ǀ ava-ródhanam ǀ diváḥ ǀyátra ǀ amū́ḥ ǀ yahvátīḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhereVivasvat's son is king, where the inner chamber of the sun (is), where these great waters (are), there make me immortal; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रा॑नुका॒मं चर॑णं त्रिना॒के त्रि॑दि॒वे दि॒वः । लो॒का यत्र॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्त॒स्तत्र॒ माम॒मृतं॑ कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ anu-kāmám ǀ cáraṇam ǀ tri-nāké ǀ tri-divé ǀ diváḥ ǀlokā́ḥ ǀ yátra ǀ jyótiṣmantaḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where in the third heaven, in the third sphere, the sun wanders at will, where the regions are filled with light, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र॒ कामा॑ निका॒माश्च॒ यत्र॑ ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टप॑म् । स्व॒धा च॒ यत्र॒ तृप्ति॑श्च॒ तत्र॒ माम॒मृतं॑ कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ ni-kāmā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ bradhnásya ǀ viṣṭápam ǀsvadhā́ ǀ ca ǀ yátra ǀ tṛ́ptiḥ ǀ ca ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where wishes and desires (are), where the region of the sun (is), where food and delight (are) found, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रा॑न॒न्दाश्च॒ मोदा॑श्च॒ मुद॑: प्र॒मुद॒ आस॑ते । काम॑स्य॒ यत्रा॒प्ताः कामा॒स्तत्र॒ माम॒मृतं॑ कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ ānandā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ módāḥ ǀ ca ǀ múdaḥ ǀ pra-múdaḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀkā́masya ǀ yátra ǀ āptā́ḥ ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ tátra ǀ mā́m ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where there is happiness, plural asure, joy and enjoyment, where the wishes of the wishers are obtained, there make me immortal; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य इन्दो॒: पव॑मान॒स्यानु॒ धामा॒न्यक्र॑मीत् । तमा॑हुः सुप्र॒जा इति॒ यस्ते॑ सो॒मावि॑ध॒न्मन॒ इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ índoḥ ǀ pávamānasya ǀ ánu ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ákramīt ǀtám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ su-prajā́ḥ ǀ íti ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ soma ǀ ávidhat ǀ mánaḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Thebrāhmaṇa) who attends to the stations of the filteredSoma-juice-- him men call rich in children, who applies his mind to you, Soma; flow,InduforIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋषे॑ मन्त्र॒कृतां॒ स्तोमै॒: कश्य॑पोद्व॒र्धय॒न्गिर॑: । सोमं॑ नमस्य॒ राजा॑नं॒ यो ज॒ज्ञे वी॒रुधां॒ पति॒रिन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: ṛ́ṣe ǀ mantra-kṛ́tām ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ káśyapa ǀ ut-vardháyan ǀ gíraḥ ǀsómam ǀ namasya ǀ rā́jānam ǀ yáḥ ǀ jajñé ǀ vīrúdhām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ṚṣiKaśyapa, raising your voice with the praises of the hymn-makers, adore the royalSomawho is born the lord of the growing (vīrūdhām); flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त दिशो॒ नाना॑सूर्याः स॒प्त होता॑र ऋ॒त्विज॑: । दे॒वा आ॑दि॒त्या ये स॒प्त तेभि॑: सोमा॒भि र॑क्ष न॒ इन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ díśaḥ ǀ nā́nā-sūryāḥ ǀ saptá ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀdevā́ḥ ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ saptá ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ soma ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seven (are) the quarters of the world with different suns, seven (are) the ministrant priests, seven are the divineĀdityas-- with these,Soma, protect us; flow,Indu, forIndra. ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ राजञ्छृ॒तं ह॒विस्तेन॑ सोमा॒भि र॑क्ष नः । अ॒रा॒ती॒वा मा न॑स्तारी॒न्मो च॑ न॒: किं च॒नाम॑म॒दिन्द्रा॑येन्दो॒ परि॑ स्रव
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ rājan ǀ śṛtám ǀ havíḥ ǀ téna ǀ soma ǀ abhí ǀ rakṣa ǀ naḥ ǀarāti-vā́ ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ tārīt ǀ mó íti ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āmamat ǀ índrāya ǀ indo íti ǀ pári ǀ srava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Protect us, royalSoma, with the oblation which has been cooked for you; let no enemy assail us, or harm anything of ours; flow,Indu, forIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्रे॑ बृ॒हन्नु॒षसा॑मू॒र्ध्वो अ॑स्थान्निर्जग॒न्वान्तम॑सो॒ ज्योति॒षागा॑त् । अ॒ग्निर्भा॒नुना॒ रुश॑ता॒ स्वङ्ग॒ आ जा॒तो विश्वा॒ सद्मा॑न्यप्राः
shlokas.transliteration: ágre ǀ bṛhán ǀ uṣásām ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ asthāt ǀ niḥ-jaganvā́n ǀ támasaḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀagníḥ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ rúśatā ǀ su-áṅgaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ sádmāni ǀ aprāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great fire from beginning of dawn has sprung aloft, and coming forth from the darkness has comewith radiance.Agni, the bright-bodied, as soon as born, fills all dwellings with shining light.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स जा॒तो गर्भो॑ असि॒ रोद॑स्यो॒रग्ने॒ चारु॒र्विभृ॑त॒ ओष॑धीषु । चि॒त्रः शिशु॒: परि॒ तमां॑स्य॒क्तून्प्र मा॒तृभ्यो॒ अधि॒ कनि॑क्रदद्गाः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ asi ǀ ródasyoḥ ǀ ágne ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ ví-bhṛtaḥ ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀcitráḥ ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ pári ǀ támāṃsi ǀ aktū́n ǀ prá ǀ mātṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kánikradat ǀ gāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When born, you, OAgni, are the embryo of heaven and earth, beautiful, borne about in the plural nts;variegated, infantine, you disperse the noctural glooms; you issue roaring loudly from the maternal (sources).”

shlokas.sanskrit: विष्णु॑रि॒त्था प॑र॒मम॑स्य वि॒द्वाञ्जा॒तो बृ॒हन्न॒भि पा॑ति तृ॒तीय॑म् । आ॒सा यद॑स्य॒ पयो॒ अक्र॑त॒ स्वं सचे॑तसो अ॒भ्य॑र्च॒न्त्यत्र॑
shlokas.transliteration: víṣṇuḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ paramám ǀ asya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ jātáḥ ǀ bṛhán ǀ abhí ǀ pāti ǀ tṛtī́yam ǀāsā́ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ páyaḥ ǀ ákrata ǀ svám ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arcanti ǀ átra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he, who as soon as manifested is vast and wise, and thus (universally) pervading, defend (me),his third (manifestation); and when (the worshippers) ask with their mouths for his own water, animated by onepurpose, they praise him in this world.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत॑ उ त्वा पितु॒भृतो॒ जनि॑त्रीरन्ना॒वृधं॒ प्रति॑ चर॒न्त्यन्नै॑: । ता ईं॒ प्रत्ये॑षि॒ पुन॑र॒न्यरू॑पा॒ असि॒ त्वं वि॒क्षु मानु॑षीषु॒ होता॑
shlokas.transliteration: átaḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā ǀ pitu-bhṛ́taḥ ǀ jánitrīḥ ǀ anna-vṛ́dham ǀ práti ǀ caranti ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ práti ǀ eṣi ǀ púnaḥ ǀ anyá-rūpāḥ ǀ ási ǀ tvám ǀ vikṣú ǀ mā́nuṣīṣu ǀ hótā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Therefore, the genitive trices (of all things, the herbs), the cherishers (of all) with food, wait on you whoare the augmenter of food, with (sacrificial) viands; you visit them again, when they have assumed other forms,you among human beings the invoker (of the gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: होता॑रं चि॒त्रर॑थमध्व॒रस्य॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑यज्ञस्य के॒तुं रुश॑न्तम् । प्रत्य॑र्धिं दे॒वस्य॑देवस्य म॒ह्ना श्रि॒या त्व१॒॑ग्निमति॑थिं॒ जना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: hótāram ǀ citrá-ratham ǀ adhvarásya ǀ yajñásya-yajñasya ǀ ketúm ǀ rúśantam ǀpráti-ardhim ǀ devásya-devasya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ śriyā́ ǀ tvám ǀ agním ǀ átithim ǀ jánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We worship)Agnifor prosperity, you, who are the invoker of the gods, the many-colouredconveyance of the saacrifice, the brilliant banner of every offering, the surpasser of every other deity in might, theguest of men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स तु वस्त्रा॒ण्यध॒ पेश॑नानि॒ वसा॑नो अ॒ग्निर्नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्याः । अ॒रु॒षो जा॒तः प॒द इळा॑याः पु॒रोहि॑तो राजन्यक्षी॒ह दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tú ǀ vástrāṇi ǀ ádha ǀ péśanāni ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀaruṣáḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ padé ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ rājan ǀ yakṣi ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Arrayed in splendid garments, thatAgni(abides) on the navel of the earth; do you, royal (Agni), whoare radiant, born on the foot-mark of Iḷā, offer worship here asPurohitato the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ हि द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑ग्न उ॒भे सदा॑ पु॒त्रो न मा॒तरा॑ त॒तन्थ॑ । प्र या॒ह्यच्छो॑श॒तो य॑वि॒ष्ठाथा व॑ह सहस्ये॒ह दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ hí ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ agne ǀ ubhé íti ǀ sádā ǀ putráḥ ǀ ná ǀ mātárā ǀ tatántha ǀprá ǀ yāhi ǀ áccha ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ átha ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ sahasya ǀ ihá ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have, ever sustained,Agni, both heaven and earth, as a son (supports) his parents; come,youngest (of the gods), to the presence of those desiring (you); son of strength, bring here the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒प्री॒हि दे॒वाँ उ॑श॒तो य॑विष्ठ वि॒द्वाँ ऋ॒तूँॠ॑तुपते यजे॒ह । ये दैव्या॑ ऋ॒त्विज॒स्तेभि॑रग्ने॒ त्वं होतॄ॑णाम॒स्याय॑जिष्ठः
shlokas.transliteration: piprīhí ǀ devā́n ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ ṛtu-pate ǀ yaja ǀ ihá ǀyé ǀ dáivyāḥ ǀ ṛtvíjaḥ ǀ tébhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ hótṝṇām ǀ asi ǀ ā́-yajiṣṭhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, youngest (of the deities), propitiate the desiring gods; lord of seasons, cognizant of seasons,here offer worship; worship with those who are the priests of the celestials; among the ministrant priests you arethe best offerer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वेषि॑ हो॒त्रमु॒त पो॒त्रं जना॑नां मन्धा॒तासि॑ द्रविणो॒दा ऋ॒तावा॑ । स्वाहा॑ व॒यं कृ॒णवा॑मा ह॒वींषि॑ दे॒वो दे॒वान्य॑जत्व॒ग्निरर्ह॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: véṣi ǀ hotrám ǀ utá ǀ potrám ǀ jánānām ǀ mandhātā́ ǀ asi ǀ draviṇaḥ-dā́ḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀsvā́hā ǀ vayám ǀ kṛṇávāma ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ yajatu ǀ agníḥ ǀ árhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whether,Agni, you prefer the office ofhotāorpotāamong men, you are wise, the giver of wealth,the observer of truth, let us offer the oblations with the (sacred)svāhā, and may the most excellent and divineAgni present them to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ दे॒वाना॒मपि॒ पन्था॑मगन्म॒ यच्छ॒क्नवा॑म॒ तदनु॒ प्रवो॑ळ्हुम् । अ॒ग्निर्वि॒द्वान्त्स य॑जा॒त्सेदु॒ होता॒ सो अ॑ध्व॒रान्त्स ऋ॒तून्क॑ल्पयाति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápi ǀ pánthām ǀ aganma ǀ yát ǀ śaknávāma ǀ tát ǀ ánu ǀ prá-voḷhum ǀagníḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajāt ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hótā ǀ sáḥ ǀ adhvarā́n ǀ sáḥ ǀ ṛtū́n ǀ kalpayāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we pursue the path that leads to the gods to convey that (worship) which we may be able (tooffer). May that wiseAgniminister, for he verily is the ministrant priest, and let him prescribe the ceremonies andthe seasons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद्वो॑ व॒यं प्र॑मि॒नाम॑ व्र॒तानि॑ वि॒दुषां॑ देवा॒ अवि॑दुष्टरासः । अ॒ग्निष्टद्विश्व॒मा पृ॑णाति वि॒द्वान्येभि॑र्दे॒वाँ ऋ॒तुभि॑: क॒ल्पया॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ vayám ǀ pra-minā́ma ǀ vratā́ni ǀ vidúṣām ǀ devāḥ ǀ áviduḥ-tarāsaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛṇāti ǀ vidvā́n ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ kalpáyāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O gods, when we who are most ignorant neglect the offices addressed to you who are wise, may thewiseAgnicomplete the whole by (appointing) those seasons by which he regulates the worship of the godṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्पा॑क॒त्रा मन॑सा दी॒नद॑क्षा॒ न य॒ज्ञस्य॑ मन्व॒ते मर्त्या॑सः । अ॒ग्निष्टद्धोता॑ क्रतु॒विद्वि॑जा॒नन्यजि॑ष्ठो दे॒वाँ ऋ॑तु॒शो य॑जाति
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ pāka-trā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ dīná-dakṣāḥ ǀ ná ǀ yajñásya ǀ manvaté ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ hótā ǀ kratu-vít ǀ vi-jānán ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtu-śáḥ ǀ yajāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since men of feeble energies, with mind yet immature, are unacquainted with (the ritual of) thesacrifice, mayAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the skilled in rites, well-knowing (what is to be done), the bestofferer, offer worship according to the fit season to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑षां॒ ह्य॑ध्व॒राणा॒मनी॑कं चि॒त्रं के॒तुं जनि॑ता त्वा ज॒जान॑ । स आ य॑जस्व नृ॒वती॒रनु॒ क्षा स्पा॒र्हा इष॑: क्षु॒मती॑र्वि॒श्वज॑न्याः
shlokas.transliteration: víśveṣām ǀ hí ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀ ánīkam ǀ citrám ǀ ketúm ǀ jánitā ǀ tvā ǀ jajā́na ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yajasva ǀ nṛ-vátīḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀ spārhā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ kṣu-mátīḥ ǀ viśvá-janyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The progenitor has engendered you the chief of all sacrifices, variegated, illuminating (all); do youoffer (to the gods) the desirable all- sustaining praise-accompanied viands growing upon man-occupied earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी यं त्वाप॒स्त्वष्टा॒ यं त्वा॑ सु॒जनि॑मा ज॒जान॑ । पन्था॒मनु॑ प्रवि॒द्वान्पि॑तृ॒याणं॑ द्यु॒मद॑ग्ने समिधा॒नो वि भा॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ yám ǀ tvā ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ yám ǀ tvā ǀ su-jánimā ǀ jajā́na ǀpánthām ǀ ánu ǀ pra-vidvā́n ǀ pitṛ-yā́nam ǀ dyu-mát ǀ agne ǀ sam-idhānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, whom the earth and heaven, whom the waters, whomTvaṣṭā, the glorious creator,engendered, who are cognizant of the path, the road of thePitṛs, shine brilliantly, being kindled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒नो रा॑जन्नर॒तिः समि॑द्धो॒ रौद्रो॒ दक्षा॑य सुषु॒माँ अ॑दर्शि । चि॒किद्वि भा॑ति भा॒सा बृ॑ह॒तासि॑क्नीमेति॒ रुश॑तीम॒पाज॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: ináḥ ǀ rājan ǀ aratíḥ ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀ ráudraḥ ǀ dákṣāya ǀ susu-mā́n ǀ adarśi ǀcikít ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ bhāsā́ ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ ásiknīm ǀ eti ǀ rúśatīm ǀ apa-ájan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “RoyalAgni, (you are) the lord (of all). He who is the conveyer of the oblation, the radiant, theformidable, the recipient of theSoma, is manifested for the benefaction (of the worshipper); all-knowing, heshines forth with great lustre; he proceeds, scattering the glimmering darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णां यदेनी॑म॒भि वर्प॑सा॒ भूज्ज॒नय॒न्योषां॑ बृह॒तः पि॒तुर्जाम् । ऊ॒र्ध्वं भा॒नुं सूर्य॑स्य स्तभा॒यन्दि॒वो वसु॑भिरर॒तिर्वि भा॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇā́m ǀ yát ǀ énīm ǀ abhí ǀ várpasā ǀ bhū́t ǀ janáyan ǀ yóṣām ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ pitúḥ ǀ jā́m ǀūrdhvám ǀ bhānúm ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ stabhāyán ǀ diváḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When he has overcome the dark departing (night) by his radiance, then, begetting the damsel, thedaughter of the great father, he shines in his course with the treasures of heaven, establishing above the light ofthe sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रो भ॒द्रया॒ सच॑मान॒ आगा॒त्स्वसा॑रं जा॒रो अ॒भ्ये॑ति प॒श्चात् । सु॒प्र॒के॒तैर्द्युभि॑र॒ग्निर्वि॒तिष्ठ॒न्रुश॑द्भि॒र्वर्णै॑र॒भि रा॒मम॑स्थात्
shlokas.transliteration: bhadráḥ ǀ bhadráyā ǀ sácamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ svásāram ǀ jāráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ paścā́t ǀsu-praketáiḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ vi-tíṣṭhan ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ várṇaiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ rāmám ǀ asthāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has come auspicious, waited on by the auspicious (light); he afterwards approaches his sister(dawn) like a gallant;Agni, spreading everywhere, with omniscient rays overpowers the dark (night) the brilliantbeams.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य यामा॑सो बृह॒तो न व॒ग्नूनिन्धा॑ना अ॒ग्नेः सख्यु॑: शि॒वस्य॑ । ईड्य॑स्य॒ वृष्णो॑ बृह॒तः स्वासो॒ भामा॑सो॒ याम॑न्न॒क्तव॑श्चिकित्रे
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ yā́māsaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ vagnū́n ǀ índhānāḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ sákhyuḥ ǀ śivásya ǀī́ḍyasya ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-ā́saḥ ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ aktávaḥ ǀ cikitre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The blazing flames of that mightyAgnido not (deter) his adorers; the fierce flames of the friendlyauspicious adorable (Agni), the showerer of (benefits), the vast, the strong-mouthed, are visible in the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒ना न यस्य॒ भामा॑स॒: पव॑न्ते॒ रोच॑मानस्य बृह॒तः सु॒दिव॑: । ज्येष्ठे॑भि॒र्यस्तेजि॑ष्ठैः क्रीळु॒मद्भि॒र्वर्षि॑ष्ठेभिर्भा॒नुभि॒र्नक्ष॑ति॒ द्याम्
shlokas.transliteration: svanā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ yásya ǀ bhā́māsaḥ ǀ pávante ǀ rócamānasya ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ su-dívaḥ ǀjyéṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ téjiṣṭhaiḥ ǀ krīḷumát-bhiḥ ǀ várṣiṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ nákṣati ǀ dyā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flames of whom, radiant, vast, bright-shining, go roaring like the winds; who covers the sky withmost excellent, most lustrous, most sportive and most mighty rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य शुष्मा॑सो ददृशा॒नप॑वे॒र्जेह॑मानस्य स्वनयन्नि॒युद्भि॑: । प्र॒त्नेभि॒र्यो रुश॑द्भिर्दे॒वत॑मो॒ वि रेभ॑द्भिरर॒तिर्भाति॒ विभ्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ śúṣmāsaḥ ǀ dadṛśāná-paveḥ ǀ jéhamānasya ǀ svanayan ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀpratnébhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ rúśat-bhiḥ ǀ devá-tamaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rébhat-bhiḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ bhā́ti ǀ ví-bhvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Of him, bright-blazing and hastening (towards the gods), the fierce- burning flames roar with the horses(ofMaruts); who shines mighty in his course, most divine, with ancient, brilliant, and loud-sounding (flames).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स आ व॑क्षि॒ महि॑ न॒ आ च॑ सत्सि दि॒वस्पृ॑थि॒व्योर॑र॒तिर्यु॑व॒त्योः । अ॒ग्निः सु॒तुक॑: सु॒तुके॑भि॒रश्वै॒ रभ॑स्वद्भी॒ रभ॑स्वाँ॒ एह ग॑म्याः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣi ǀ máhi ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ satsi ǀ diváḥpṛthivyóḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ yuvatyóḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ su-túkaḥ ǀ su-túkebhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ rábhasvat-bhiḥ ǀ rábhasvān ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gamyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, greatAgni, bring the gods to our (sacrifice); do you, the messenger of the young heaven andearth, sit down (at our sacrifice). Agni, who are easily found, who are rapid in movement, do you come with yourdocile and rapid steeds (to our rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ते॑ यक्षि॒ प्र त॑ इयर्मि॒ मन्म॒ भुवो॒ यथा॒ वन्द्यो॑ नो॒ हवे॑षु । धन्व॑न्निव प्र॒पा अ॑सि॒ त्वम॑ग्न इय॒क्षवे॑ पू॒रवे॑ प्रत्न राजन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ yakṣi ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ iyarmi ǀ mánma ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vándyaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ háveṣu ǀdhánvan-iva ǀ pra-pā́ ǀ asi ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ iyakṣáve ǀ pūráve ǀ pratna ǀ rājan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, I present the oblation; you repeat praise; that you, who are deserving of laudation maybe present at our invocations; ancient sovereign Agni, you are like a well of water in a desert, to the mandesirous of offering sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॒ जना॑सो अ॒भि सं॒चर॑न्ति॒ गाव॑ उ॒ष्णमि॑व व्र॒जं य॑विष्ठ । दू॒तो दे॒वाना॑मसि॒ मर्त्या॑नाम॒न्तर्म॒हाँश्च॑रसि रोच॒नेन॑
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sam-cáranti ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ uṣṇám-iva ǀ vrajám ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀdūtáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ asi ǀ mártyānām ǀ antáḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ carasi ǀ rocanéna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have recourse to you,Agni, youngest (of the gods), as cattle hasten to the warm stall. You arethe messenger of the gods and of mortals; mighty, you proceed by the firmament between (heaven and earth). sustains you. You come, eager from above the firmament, by a downward path, and when released (after theoblation is offered), you desire to go back like cattle (to their stall).”

shlokas.sanskrit: शिशुं॒ न त्वा॒ जेन्यं॑ व॒र्धय॑न्ती मा॒ता बि॑भर्ति सचन॒स्यमा॑ना । धनो॒रधि॑ प्र॒वता॑ यासि॒ हर्य॒ञ्जिगी॑षसे प॒शुरि॒वाव॑सृष्टः
shlokas.transliteration: śíśum ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ jényam ǀ vardháyantī ǀ mātā́ ǀ bibharti ǀ sacanasyámānā ǀdhánoḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ pra-vátā ǀ yāsi ǀ háryan ǀ jígīṣase ǀ paśúḥ-iva ǀ áva-sṛṣṭaḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: मू॒रा अ॑मूर॒ न व॒यं चि॑कित्वो महि॒त्वम॑ग्ने॒ त्वम॒ङ्ग वि॑त्से । शये॑ व॒व्रिश्चर॑ति जि॒ह्वया॒दन्रे॑रि॒ह्यते॑ युव॒तिं वि॒श्पति॒: सन्
shlokas.transliteration: mūrā́ḥ ǀ amūra ǀ ná ǀ vayám ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ agne ǀ tvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ vitse ǀśáye ǀ vavríḥ ǀ cárati ǀ jihváyā ǀ adán ǀ rerihyáte ǀ yuvatím ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ sán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We, who are perplexed, know not, O unperplexed, intelligent one, your greatness; but you,Agni, verilyknow it. Wearing a form he reposes; he moves about devouring (the offering) with his tongue (of flame); beinglord of men, he licks up the mixed oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कूचि॑ज्जायते॒ सन॑यासु॒ नव्यो॒ वने॑ तस्थौ पलि॒तो धू॒मके॑तुः । अ॒स्ना॒तापो॑ वृष॒भो न प्र वे॑ति॒ सचे॑तसो॒ यं प्र॒णय॑न्त॒ मर्ता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: kū́-cit ǀ jāyate ǀ sánayāsu ǀ návyaḥ ǀ váne ǀ tasthau ǀ palitáḥ ǀ dhūmá-ketuḥ ǀasnātā́ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ná ǀ prá ǀ veti ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǀ yám ǀ pra-náyanta ǀ mártāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where is the new (Agni) born? He is present in the old (plural nt) and in the wood, grey-haired,smoke-bannered; though not needing ablution, he hastens to the water like a (thirsty) bull, he whom men withone consent propitiate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒नू॒त्यजे॑व॒ तस्क॑रा वन॒र्गू र॑श॒नाभि॑र्द॒शभि॑र॒भ्य॑धीताम् । इ॒यं ते॑ अग्ने॒ नव्य॑सी मनी॒षा यु॒क्ष्वा रथं॒ न शु॒चय॑द्भि॒रङ्गै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tanūtyájā-iva ǀ táskarā ǀ vanargū́ íti ǀ raśanā́bhiḥ ǀ daśá-bhiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ adhītām ǀiyám ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ návyasī ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ yukṣvá ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ śucáyat-bhiḥ ǀ áṅgaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As two daring robbers lurking in a forest seize (upon a traveller) with ten cords, (so the two handsseize upon the touchwood, with the ten fingers). This new praise,Agni, is addressed to you; attach thyself (to mysacrifice) with your radiant members; as (they harness horses) to a car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑ च ते जातवेदो॒ नम॑श्चे॒यं च॒ गीः सद॒मिद्वर्ध॑नी भूत् । रक्षा॑ णो अग्ने॒ तन॑यानि तो॒का रक्षो॒त न॑स्त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ अप्र॑युच्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: bráhma ǀ ca ǀ te ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ ca ǀ iyám ǀ ca ǀ gī́ḥ ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ várdhanī ǀ bhūt ǀrákṣa ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ tánayāni ǀ tokā́ ǀ rákṣa ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this oblation,Jātavedas, this reverence, this praise, ever magnify you. Protect,Agni, our sons,our grandsons, and diligently defend our person ns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑: समु॒द्रो ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णाम॒स्मद्धृ॒दो भूरि॑जन्मा॒ वि च॑ष्टे । सिष॒क्त्यूध॑र्नि॒ण्योरु॒पस्थ॒ उत्स॑स्य॒ मध्ये॒ निहि॑तं प॒दं वेः
shlokas.transliteration: ékaḥ ǀ samudráḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ asmát ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ bhū́ri-janmā ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀsísakti ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ niṇyóḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ útsasya ǀ mádhye ǀ ní-hitam ǀ padám ǀ véríti véḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the sole capacious ocean of riches who is of many births beholds our hearts; he waits on thecloud in the neighbourhood of the hidden (firmament); go, Agni, to the appointed plural ce in the midst of the waterṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नं नी॒ळं वृष॑णो॒ वसा॑ना॒: सं ज॑ग्मिरे महि॒षा अर्व॑तीभिः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒दं क॒वयो॒ नि पा॑न्ति॒ गुहा॒ नामा॑नि दधिरे॒ परा॑णि
shlokas.transliteration: samānám ǀ nīḷám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vásānāḥ ǀ sám ǀ jagmire ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ árvatībhiḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ padám ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pānti ǀ gúhā ǀ nā́māni ǀ dadhire ǀ párāṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Great (worshippers), showerers (of oblations) enveloping with their hymns the common dark (fire),have associated (him) with his horses (to come to the sacrifice). Sages preserve (by oblations) the plural ce of thewater and support the divine rains in the vault (of heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ता॒यिनी॑ मा॒यिनी॒ सं द॑धाते मि॒त्वा शिशुं॑ जज्ञतुर्व॒र्धय॑न्ती । विश्व॑स्य॒ नाभिं॒ चर॑तो ध्रु॒वस्य॑ क॒वेश्चि॒त्तन्तुं॒ मन॑सा वि॒यन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtayínī ítyṛta-yínī ǀ māyínī íti ǀ sám ǀ dadhāte íti ǀ mitvā́ ǀ śíśum ǀ jajñatuḥ ǀ vardháyantī íti ǀvíśvasya ǀ nā́bhim ǀ cárataḥ ǀ dhruvásya ǀ kavéḥ ǀ cit ǀ tántum ǀ mánasā ǀ vi-yántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two observers of truth, the two possessors of wisdom, (heaven and earth) sustain (thisAgni);measuring the time, they have brought forth and reared a son; and (men), pondering in their minds on that navelof the universe, movable and immovable, the thread of the sage (Agni, are blessed with happiness).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तस्य॒ हि व॑र्त॒नय॒: सुजा॑त॒मिषो॒ वाजा॑य प्र॒दिव॒: सच॑न्ते । अ॒धी॒वा॒सं रोद॑सी वावसा॒ने घृ॒तैरन्नै॑र्वावृधाते॒ मधू॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtásya ǀ hí ǀ vartanáyaḥ ǀ sú-jātam ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ vā́jāya ǀ pra-dívaḥ ǀ sácante ǀadhīvāsám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vavasāné íti ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ ánnaiḥ ǀ vavṛdhāte íti ǀ mádhūnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ancient celebrators of the rite desiring (boons) wait on (Agni), rightly born, for the sake of food;the all-comprising heaven and earth cherish him, who abodes above the heavens, with the sacrificial butter andfood (produced) from the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त स्वसॄ॒ररु॑षीर्वावशा॒नो वि॒द्वान्मध्व॒ उज्ज॑भारा दृ॒शे कम् । अ॒न्तर्ये॑मे अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे पुरा॒जा इ॒च्छन्व॒व्रिम॑विदत्पूष॒णस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ svásṝḥ ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ vāvaśānáḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ út ǀ jabhāra ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀantáḥ ǀ yeme ǀ antárikṣe ǀ purā-jā́ḥ ǀ icchán ǀ vavrím ǀ avidat ǀ pūṣaṇásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wiseAgniglorified (by his worshippers) has from the sacrifice raised aloft, for the readymanifestation of (all things), the seven radiant sister (flames); which when formerly engendered he restrained inthe firmament, until desirous of (adorers) he bestowed form upon the region of the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त म॒र्यादा॑: क॒वय॑स्ततक्षु॒स्तासा॒मेका॒मिद॒भ्यं॑हु॒रो गा॑त् । आ॒योर्ह॑ स्क॒म्भ उ॑प॒मस्य॑ नी॒ळे प॒थां वि॑स॒र्गे ध॒रुणे॑षु तस्थौ
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ maryā́dāḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ tā́sām ǀ ékām ǀ ít ǀ abhí ǀ aṃhuráḥ ǀ gāt ǀāyóḥ ǀ ha ǀ skambháḥ ǀ upa-másya ǀ nīḷé ǀ pathā́m ǀ vi-sargé ǀ dharúṇeṣu ǀ tasthau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ise have established seven rules of conduct; he is a sinner who deviates from any one of theṃAgni is the obstructor of (that) man, he abides in the dwelling of his neighbour, in the region of the scattering ofthe rays, and in the recipient (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑च्च॒ सच्च॑ पर॒मे व्यो॑म॒न्दक्ष॑स्य॒ जन्म॒न्नदि॑तेरु॒पस्थे॑ । अ॒ग्निर्ह॑ नः प्रथम॒जा ऋ॒तस्य॒ पूर्व॒ आयु॑नि वृष॒भश्च॑ धे॒नुः
shlokas.transliteration: ásat ǀ ca ǀ sát ǀ ca ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ dákṣasya ǀ jánman ǀ áditeḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀagníḥ ǀ ha ǀ naḥ ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ pū́rve ǀ ā́yuni ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ ca ǀ dhenúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Non-existent, and existent (isAgni) in the supreme heaven, in the birth-plural ce ofDakṣa, and in thepresence ofAditi; Agni is elder born to us (who enjoy the fruit) of the sacrifice; in the olden time he was the bulland the cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स यस्य॒ शर्म॒न्नवो॑भिर॒ग्नेरेध॑ते जरि॒ताभिष्टौ॑ । ज्येष्ठे॑भि॒र्यो भा॒नुभि॑ॠषू॒णां प॒र्येति॒ परि॑वीतो वि॒भावा॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yásya ǀ śárman ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ agnéḥ ǀ édhate ǀ jaritā́ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǀjyéṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ ṛṣūṇā́m ǀ pari-éti ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is thatAgniby whose protections the worshipper (diligent) in sacrifice prospers in his dwelling;who is radiant, travels everywhere invested with the excellent splendours of his rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो भा॒नुभि॑र्वि॒भावा॑ वि॒भात्य॒ग्निर्दे॒वेभि॑ॠ॒तावाज॑स्रः । आ यो वि॒वाय॑ स॒ख्या सखि॒भ्योऽप॑रिह्वृतो॒ अत्यो॒ न सप्ति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ bhānú-bhiḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ agníḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ṛtá-vā ǀ ájasraḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vivā́ya ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ ápari-hvṛtaḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sáptiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the observer of truth, the eternal who shines resplendent with celestial splendours, who comesuntiring like a swift horse, (bringing) friendly gifts to his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईशे॒ यो विश्व॑स्या दे॒ववी॑ते॒रीशे॑ वि॒श्वायु॑रु॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टौ । आ यस्मि॑न्म॒ना ह॒वींष्य॒ग्नावरि॑ष्टरथः स्क॒भ्नाति॑ शू॒षैः
shlokas.transliteration: ī́śe ǀ yáḥ ǀ víśvasyāḥ ǀ devá-vīteḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀā́ ǀ yásmin ǀ manā́ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ agnáu ǀ áriṣṭa-rathaḥ ǀ skabhnā́ti ǀ śūṣáiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who rules over every oblation to the gods, who all pervading rules at the opening of the dawn, and inwhom (the sacrificer), whose sacrifice is undisturbed by his foes, throws his choice oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शू॒षेभि॑र्वृ॒धो जु॑षा॒णो अ॒र्कैर्दे॒वाँ अच्छा॑ रघु॒पत्वा॑ जिगाति । म॒न्द्रो होता॒ स जु॒ह्वा॒३॒॑ यजि॑ष्ठ॒: सम्मि॑श्लो अ॒ग्निरा जि॑घर्ति दे॒वान्
shlokas.transliteration: śūṣébhiḥ ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ juṣāṇáḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ áccha ǀ raghu-pátvā ǀ jigāti ǀmandráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ sáḥ ǀ juhvā́ ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ sám-miślaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ jigharti ǀ devā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Magnified by our oblations, propitiated by our praises, swift-moving, he proceeds to the presence ofthe gods; the adorable invoker of the deities, most entitled to worship, associated (with the gods).Agnipresentsto them (the oblation) with the sacrificial ladle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तमु॒स्रामिन्द्रं॒ न रेज॑मानम॒ग्निं गी॒र्भिर्नमो॑भि॒रा कृ॑णुध्वम् । आ यं विप्रा॑सो म॒तिभि॑र्गृ॒णन्ति॑ जा॒तवे॑दसं जु॒ह्वं॑ स॒हाना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ usrā́m ǀ índram ǀ ná ǀ réjamānam ǀ agním ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀā́ ǀ yám ǀ víprāsaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ gṛṇánti ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ juhvám ǀ sahā́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring before us with praises, and with adorations, the brilliantAgni, the bestower of enjoyments, as ifhe wereIndra, him, whom wise worshippers praise with hymns asJātavedas, the sacrificer of the victoriousGods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॒ वसू॑नि ज॒ग्मुर्वाजे॒ नाश्वा॒: सप्ती॑वन्त॒ एवै॑: । अ॒स्मे ऊ॒तीरिन्द्र॑वाततमा अर्वाची॒ना अ॑ग्न॒ आ कृ॑णुष्व
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yásmin ǀ víśvā ǀ vásūni ǀ jagmúḥ ǀ vā́je ǀ ná ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ sápti-vantaḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀasmé íti ǀ ūtī́ḥ ǀ índravāta-tamāḥ ǀ arvācīnā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OAgni, in whom all treasures are brought together as fleet horses are brought together in battle;bestow upon us protections even more effective than those ofIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ ह्य॑ग्ने म॒ह्ना नि॒षद्या॑ स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो हव्यो॑ ब॒भूथ॑ । तं ते॑ दे॒वासो॒ अनु॒ केत॑माय॒न्नधा॑वर्धन्त प्रथ॒मास॒ ऊमा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ hí ǀ agne ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ hávyaḥ ǀ babhū́tha ǀtám ǀ te ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ánu ǀ kétam ǀ āyan ǀ ádha ǀ avardhanta ǀ prathamā́saḥ ǀ ū́māḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since you,Agni, born in your glory and having sat down (on the altar), are immediately entitled to theoblation; therefore, the holy (priests) come to that your ensign and the mos worthy (worshippers) prosperprotected (by you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति नो॑ दि॒वो अ॑ग्ने पृथि॒व्या वि॒श्वायु॑र्धेहि य॒जथा॑य देव । सचे॑महि॒ तव॑ दस्म प्रके॒तैरु॑रु॒ष्या ण॑ उ॒रुभि॑र्देव॒ शंसै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ agne ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ yajáthāya ǀ deva ǀsácemahi ǀ táva ǀ dasma ǀ pra-ketáiḥ ǀ uruṣyá ǀ naḥ ǀ urú-bhiḥ ǀ deva ǀ śáṃsaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineAgni, bestow upon us from earth and heaven prosperity and abundant food, that we may beable to offer sacrifices. May we be associated, beautiful (Agni), with your indications (of favour); protect us, divineAgni, on account of our many hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा अ॑ग्ने म॒तय॒स्तुभ्यं॑ जा॒ता गोभि॒रश्वै॑र॒भि गृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑: । य॒दा ते॒ मर्तो॒ अनु॒ भोग॒मान॒ड्वसो॒ दधा॑नो म॒तिभि॑: सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇanti ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ te ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ bhógam ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ váso íti ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These hymns, addressed,Agni, to you, praise you for wealth, together with cattle and horses; when amortal obtains the means of enjoyment from the, (then), opulent and well-born Agni, you, who are the granter ofbenefits, (are celebrated) by our praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं म॑न्ये पि॒तर॑म॒ग्निमा॒पिम॒ग्निं भ्रात॑रं॒ सद॒मित्सखा॑यम् । अ॒ग्नेरनी॑कं बृह॒तः स॑पर्यं दि॒वि शु॒क्रं य॑ज॒तं सूर्य॑स्य
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ manye ǀ pitáram ǀ agním ǀ āpím ǀ agním ǀ bhrā́taram ǀ sádam ǀ ít ǀ sákhāyam ǀagnéḥ ǀ ánīkam ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ saparyam ǀ diví ǀ śukrám ǀ yajatám ǀ sū́ryasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I regardAgnias a father, as a kinsman, as a brother, as a constant friend. I reverence the face of themighty Agni, radiant in heaven, adorable as the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सि॒ध्रा अ॑ग्ने॒ धियो॑ अ॒स्मे सनु॑त्री॒र्यं त्राय॑से॒ दम॒ आ नित्य॑होता । ऋ॒तावा॒ स रो॒हिद॑श्वः पुरु॒क्षुर्द्युभि॑रस्मा॒ अह॑भिर्वा॒मम॑स्तु
shlokas.transliteration: sidhrā́ḥ ǀ agne ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ sánutrīḥ ǀ yám ǀ trā́yase ǀ dáme ǀ ā́ ǀ nítya-hotā ǀṛtá-vā ǀ sáḥ ǀ rohít-aśvaḥ ǀ puru-kṣúḥ ǀ dyú-bhiḥ ǀ asmai ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ vāmám ǀ astu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, our earnest praises have been composed for you. May he whom you, the perpetual invoker ofthe gods, protect in the sacrificial chamber, be rich in sacrifices, the master of red steeds, the possessor ofabundant food; may the desirable (oblation) be granted him on shining days.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्युभि॑र्हि॒तं मि॒त्रमि॑व प्र॒योगं॑ प्र॒त्नमृ॒त्विज॑मध्व॒रस्य॑ जा॒रम् । बा॒हुभ्या॑म॒ग्निमा॒यवो॑ऽजनन्त वि॒क्षु होता॑रं॒ न्य॑सादयन्त
shlokas.transliteration: dyú-bhiḥ ǀ hitám ǀ mitrám-iva ǀ pra-yógam ǀ pratnám ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ adhvarásya ǀ jārám ǀbāhú-bhyām ǀ agním ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ ajananta ǀ vikṣú ǀ hótāram ǀ ní ǀ asādayanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have genitive rated with their armsAgni, who is decorated with rays of light, selected as a friend, theancient priest, the accomplisher of the sacrifice, and they have appointed him among people, the invoker of thegods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒यं य॑जस्व दि॒वि दे॑व दे॒वान्किं ते॒ पाक॑: कृणव॒दप्र॑चेताः । यथाय॑ज ऋ॒तुभि॑र्देव दे॒वाने॒वा य॑जस्व त॒न्वं॑ सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: svayám ǀ yajasva ǀ diví ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ kím ǀ te ǀ pā́kaḥ ǀ kṛṇavat ǀ ápra-cetāḥ ǀyáthā ǀ áyajaḥ ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ deva ǀ devā́n ǀ evá ǀ yajasva ǀ tanvám ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer sacrifice thyself, divine (Agni), to the gods in heaven; what can one who is ignorant and ofimmature understanding effect for you? As in due seasons, divine (Agni), you have sacrificed to the gods, so doyou, well- engendered (Agni), sacrifice to your won person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भवा॑ नो अग्नेऽवि॒तोत गो॒पा भवा॑ वय॒स्कृदु॒त नो॑ वयो॒धाः । रास्वा॑ च नः सुमहो ह॒व्यदा॑तिं॒ त्रास्वो॒त न॑स्त॒न्वो॒३॒॑ अप्र॑युच्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ avitā́ ǀ utá ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ bháva ǀ vayaḥ-kṛ́t ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀrā́sva ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ su-mahaḥ ǀ havyá-dātim ǀ trā́sva ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be our protector,Agni, (in obvious peril); be our preserver (in unseen danger), be the provider andgiver of sustenance; bestow upon us, nightly Agni, the donation of oblations, and ever attentive, protect ourpersons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र के॒तुना॑ बृह॒ता या॑त्य॒ग्निरा रोद॑सी वृष॒भो रो॑रवीति । दि॒वश्चि॒दन्ताँ॑ उप॒माँ उदा॑नळ॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षो व॑वर्ध
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ketúnā ǀ bṛhatā́ ǀ yāti ǀ agníḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ roravīti ǀdiváḥ ǀ cit ǀ ántān ǀ upa-mā́n ǀ út ǀ ānaṭ ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ vavardha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnitraverses heaven and earth with a vast banner; he roars (like) a bull; he spreads aloft over theremote and proximate (regions) of the sky; mighty, he increases in the lap of the water.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मु॒मोद॒ गर्भो॑ वृष॒भः क॒कुद्मा॑नस्रे॒मा व॒त्सः शिमी॑वाँ अरावीत् । स दे॒वता॒त्युद्य॑तानि कृ॒ण्वन्त्स्वेषु॒ क्षये॑षु प्रथ॒मो जि॑गाति
shlokas.transliteration: mumóda ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ vṛṣabháḥ ǀ kakút-mān ǀ asremā́ ǀ vatsáḥ ǀ śímī-vān ǀ arāvīt ǀsáḥ ǀ devá-tāti ǀ út-yatāni ǀ kṛṇván ǀ svéṣu ǀ kṣáyeṣu ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ jigāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “THe embryo (of heaven and earth), the showerer (of benefits), the glorious, rejoices; the excellentchild (of morn and eve), the celebrator of holy rites calls aloud; assiduous in exertions at the worship of the gods,he moves chief in his own abodes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ यो मू॒र्धानं॑ पि॒त्रोरर॑ब्ध॒ न्य॑ध्व॒रे द॑धिरे॒ सूरो॒ अर्ण॑: । अस्य॒ पत्म॒न्नरु॑षी॒रश्व॑बुध्ना ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ त॒न्वो॑ जुषन्त
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mūrdhā́nam ǀ pitróḥ ǀ árabdha ǀ ní ǀ adhvaré ǀ dadhire ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ árṇaḥ ǀásya ǀ pátman ǀ áruṣīḥ ǀ áśva-budhnāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀ tanváḥ ǀ juṣanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have plural ced in the sacrifice the radiance of the powerfulAgni, who seizes hold of the forehead ofhis parents, gratifying his cherished, radiant, and expanding limbs, in their course, in their chamber of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒षौ॑षो॒ हि व॑सो॒ अग्र॒मेषि॒ त्वं य॒मयो॑रभवो वि॒भावा॑ । ऋ॒ताय॑ स॒प्त द॑धिषे प॒दानि॑ ज॒नय॑न्मि॒त्रं त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ स्वायै॑
shlokas.transliteration: uṣáḥ-uṣaḥ ǀ hí ǀ vaso íti ǀ ágram ǀ éṣi ǀ tvám ǀ yamáyoḥ ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀṛtā́ya ǀ saptá ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ padā́ni ǀ janáyan ǀ mitrám ǀ tanvé ǀ svā́yai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OpulentAgni, you precede dawn after dawn. You are the illuminator of the twin (day and night);engenderingMitrafrom your own person n, you retain seven plural ces for sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुव॒श्चक्षु॑र्म॒ह ऋ॒तस्य॑ गो॒पा भुवो॒ वरु॑णो॒ यदृ॒ताय॒ वेषि॑ । भुवो॑ अ॒पां नपा॑ज्जातवेदो॒ भुवो॑ दू॒तो यस्य॑ ह॒व्यं जुजो॑षः
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ṛtā́ya ǀ véṣi ǀbhúvaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ yásya ǀ havyám ǀ jújoṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the eye, the protector of the great sacrifice; when you proceed to the rite, you areVaruṇa;you are the grandson of the waters,Jātavedas; you are the messenger (of him) whose oblation you enjoy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भि॒: सच॑से शि॒वाभि॑: । दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चकृषे हव्य॒वाह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ ca ǀ netā́ ǀ yátra ǀ niyút-bhiḥ ǀ sácase ǀ śivā́bhiḥ ǀdiví ǀ mūrdhā́nam ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ jihvā́m ǀ agne ǀ cakṛṣe ǀ havya-vā́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the leader of the sacrifice and sacrificial water to the plural ce in which you are associated withthe auspicious steeds of the wind; you sustain the all-enjoying (sun) as chief in heaven; you,Agni, make yourtongue the bearer of the oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य त्रि॒तः क्रतु॑ना व॒व्रे अ॒न्तरि॒च्छन्धी॒तिं पि॒तुरेवै॒: पर॑स्य । स॒च॒स्यमा॑नः पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॑ जा॒मि ब्रु॑वा॒ण आयु॑धानि वेति
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ tritáḥ ǀ krátunā ǀ vavré ǀ antáḥ ǀ icchán ǀ dhītím ǀ pitúḥ ǀ évaiḥ ǀ párasya ǀsacasyámānaḥ ǀ pitróḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ jāmí ǀ bruvāṇáḥ ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ veti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tritaby (his own), desiring a share (of the sacrifice), for the sake of taking part in the exploit of thesupreme protector (of the world), chose (Indraas his friend); attended (by the priests) in the proximity of theparental heaven and earth, and reciting appropriate praise, he takes up his weapons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स पित्र्या॒ण्यायु॑धानि वि॒द्वानिन्द्रे॑षित आ॒प्त्यो अ॒भ्य॑युध्यत् । त्रि॒शी॒र्षाणं॑ स॒प्तर॑श्मिं जघ॒न्वान्त्वा॒ष्ट्रस्य॑ चि॒न्निः स॑सृजे त्रि॒तो गाः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ pítryāṇi ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ índra-iṣitaḥ ǀ āptyáḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ayudhyat ǀtri-śīrṣā́ṇam ǀ saptá-raśmim ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ tvāṣṭrásya ǀ cit ǀ níḥ ǀ sasṛje ǀ tritáḥ ǀ gā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, the son of the waters, incited byIndra, skilled in his paternal weapons, fought against (the enemy),and slew the seven-rayed, three-headed (asura); thenTritaset free the cows of the son ofTvaṣṭā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरीदिन्द्र॑ उ॒दिन॑क्षन्त॒मोजोऽवा॑भिन॒त्सत्प॑ति॒र्मन्य॑मानम् । त्वा॒ष्ट्रस्य॑ चिद्वि॒श्वरू॑पस्य॒ गोना॑माचक्रा॒णस्त्रीणि॑ शी॒र्षा परा॑ वर्क्
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ ít ǀ índraḥ ǀ ut-ínakṣantam ǀ ójaḥ ǀ áva ǀ abhinat ǀ sát-patiḥ ǀ mányamānam ǀtvāṣṭrásya ǀ cit ǀ viśvá-rūpasya ǀ gónām ǀ ā-cakrāṇáḥ ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ śīrṣā́ ǀ párā ǀ vargíti várk ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the protector of the virtuous, crushed the arrogant (foe), attaining vast strenth; shouting, he cutoff the three heads of the multiform son ofTvaṣṭā(the lord) of cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॒ हि ष्ठा म॑यो॒भुव॒स्ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ hí ǀ sthá ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ūrjé ǀ dadhātana ǀmahé ǀ ráṇāya ǀ cákṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, waters, you are the sources of happiness, grant to us to enjoy abundance, and great anddelightful perception.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो व॑: शि॒वत॑मो॒ रस॒स्तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह न॑: । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ śivá-tamaḥ ǀ rásaḥ ǀ tásya ǀ bhājayata ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǀuśatī́ḥ-iva ǀ mātáraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give us to partake in this world of your most auspiciousSoma, like affectionate mothers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ अरं॑ गमाम वो॒ यस्य॒ क्षया॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ । आपो॑ ज॒नय॑था च नः
shlokas.transliteration: tásmai ǀ áram ǀ gamāma ǀ vaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jínvatha ǀā́paḥ ǀ janáyatha ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us quickly have recourse to you, for that your (faculty) of removing (sin) by which you gladden us;waters, bestow upon us progeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं नो॑ दे॒वीर॒भिष्ट॑य॒ आपो॑ भवन्तु पी॒तये॑ । शं योर॒भि स्र॑वन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ naḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ pītáye ǀśám ǀ yóḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sravantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the divine water be propitious to our worship, (may they be good) for our drinking; may they flowround us, and be our health and safety.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ईशा॑ना॒ वार्या॑णां॒ क्षय॑न्तीश्चर्षणी॒नाम् । अ॒पो या॑चामि भेष॒जम्
shlokas.transliteration: ī́śānāḥ ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀ kṣáyantīḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀapáḥ ǀ yācāmi ǀ bheṣajám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, sovereigns of precious (treasures), granters of habitations to men, I solicit of youmedicine(formy infirmities).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्सु मे॒ सोमो॑ अब्रवीद॒न्तर्विश्वा॑नि भेष॒जा । अ॒ग्निं च॑ वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवम्
shlokas.transliteration: ap-sú ǀ me ǀ sómaḥ ǀ abravīt ǀ antáḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀagním ǀ ca ǀ viśvá-śambhuvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Somahas declared to me; all medicaments, as well asAgni, the benefactor of the universe, are in thewaters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॑: पृणी॒त भे॑ष॒जं वरू॑थं त॒न्वे॒३॒॑ मम॑ । ज्योक्च॒ सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ pṛṇītá ǀ bheṣajám ǀ várūtham ǀ tanvé ǀ máma ǀjyók ǀ ca ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, bring to perfection, all disease-dispelling medicaments for the good of my body, that I maybehold the Sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दमा॑प॒: प्र व॑हत॒ यत्किं च॑ दुरि॒तं मयि॑ । यद्वा॒हम॑भिदु॒द्रोह॒ यद्वा॑ शे॒प उ॒तानृ॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ āpaḥ ǀ prá ǀ vahata ǀ yát ǀ kím ǀ ca ǀ duḥ-itám ǀ máyi ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ ahám ǀ abhi-dudróha ǀ yát ǀ vā ǀ śepé ǀ utá ǀ ánṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters, take away whatever sin has been (found) in me, whether I have (knowingly) done wrong, orhave pronounced imprecations (against holy men), or have spoken untruth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॑ अ॒द्यान्व॑चारिषं॒ रसे॑न॒ सम॑गस्महि । पय॑स्वानग्न॒ आ ग॑हि॒ तं मा॒ सं सृ॑ज॒ वर्च॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ adyá ǀ ánu ǀ acāriṣam ǀ rásena ǀ sám ǀ agasmahi ǀpáyasvān ǀ agne ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ tám ǀ mā ǀ sám ǀ sṛja ǀ várcasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have this day entered into the waters; we have mingled with their essence.Agni, abiding in thewaters approach, and fill me (thus bathed) with vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ चि॒त्सखा॑यं स॒ख्या व॑वृत्यां ति॒रः पु॒रू चि॑दर्ण॒वं ज॑ग॒न्वान् । पि॒तुर्नपा॑त॒मा द॑धीत वे॒धा अधि॒ क्षमि॑ प्रत॒रं दीध्या॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ó íti ǀ cit ǀ sákhāyam ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ vavṛtyām ǀ tiráḥ ǀ purú ǀ cit ǀ arṇavám ǀ jaganvā́n ǀpitúḥ ǀ nápātam ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhīta ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ kṣámi ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dī́dhyānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). I invite my friend to friendship, having come over the vast and desert ocean; mayVedhas, after reflecting, plural ce in the earth the offsprig (of you) the father, edowed with excellent qualities.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ते॒ सखा॑ स॒ख्यं व॑ष्ट्ये॒तत्सल॑क्ष्मा॒ यद्विषु॑रूपा॒ भवा॑ति । म॒हस्पु॒त्रासो॒ असु॑रस्य वी॒रा दि॒वो ध॒र्तार॑ उर्वि॒या परि॑ ख्यन्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ te ǀ sákhā ǀ sakhyám ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ etát ǀ sá-lakṣmā ǀ yát ǀ víṣu-rūpā ǀ bhávāti ǀmaháḥ ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ dhartā́raḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ pári ǀ khyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). Your friend desires not this friendship, for although of one origin, she is of differentform; the hero sons of the greatasura(are) the upholders of heaven, enjoying vast renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शन्ति॑ घा॒ ते अ॒मृता॑स ए॒तदेक॑स्य चित्त्य॒जसं॒ मर्त्य॑स्य । नि ते॒ मनो॒ मन॑सि धाय्य॒स्मे जन्यु॒: पति॑स्त॒न्व१॒॑मा वि॑विश्याः
shlokas.transliteration: uśánti ǀ gha ǀ té ǀ amṛ́tāsaḥ ǀ etát ǀ ékasya ǀ cit ǀ tyajásam ǀ mártyasya ǀní ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ mánasi ǀ dhāyi ǀ asmé íti ǀ jányuḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ ā́ ǀ viviśyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). The immortals take plural asure in (a union) like this which is forbidden to every mortal; letyour mind then concur with mine, and as the progenitor (of all) was the husband (of his daughter), do you enjoymy person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न यत्पु॒रा च॑कृ॒मा कद्ध॑ नू॒नमृ॒ता वद॑न्तो॒ अनृ॑तं रपेम । ग॒न्ध॒र्वो अ॒प्स्वप्या॑ च॒ योषा॒ सा नो॒ नाभि॑: पर॒मं जा॒मि तन्नौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ yát ǀ purā́ ǀ cakṛmá ǀ kát ǀ ha ǀ nūnám ǀ ṛtā́ ǀ vádantaḥ ǀ ánṛtam ǀ rapema ǀgandharváḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ ápyā ǀ ca ǀ yóṣā ǀ sā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ paramám ǀ jāmí ǀ tát ǀ nau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeak). We have not done what was done formerly; for how can we who speak truth, utter nowthat which is untrue?Gandharva(the sun) was in the watery (firmament), and the water was his bride. She is ourcommon hence our near affinity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गर्भे॒ नु नौ॑ जनि॒ता दम्प॑ती कर्दे॒वस्त्वष्टा॑ सवि॒ता वि॒श्वरू॑पः । नकि॑रस्य॒ प्र मि॑नन्ति व्र॒तानि॒ वेद॑ नाव॒स्य पृ॑थि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः
shlokas.transliteration: gárbhe ǀ nú ǀ nau ǀ janitā́ ǀ dámpatī íti dám-patī ǀ kaḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ savitā́ ǀ viśvá-rūpaḥ ǀnákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ prá ǀ minanti ǀ vratā́ni ǀ véda ǀ nau ǀ asyá ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ utá ǀ dyáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). The divine omniform genitive ratorTvaṣṭā, the progenitor, made us two husband andwife, even in the womb: none frustrate his undertaking; earth and heaven are conscious of this our (union).”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒स्य वे॑द प्रथ॒मस्याह्न॒: क ईं॑ ददर्श॒ क इ॒ह प्र वो॑चत् । बृ॒हन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ धाम॒ कदु॑ ब्रव आहनो॒ वीच्या॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ asyá ǀ veda ǀ prathamásya ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ īm ǀ dadarśa ǀ káḥ ǀ ihá ǀ prá ǀ vocat ǀbṛhát ǀ mitrásya ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ kát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bravaḥ ǀ āhanaḥ ǀ vī́cyā ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). Who knows anything of this (his) first day (of existence)? Who has beheld it? Whohas here revealed it? The dwelling ofMitraand ofVaruṇais vast. What say you, who punishes men with hell?”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒मस्य॑ मा य॒म्यं१॒॑ काम॒ आग॑न्त्समा॒ने योनौ॑ सह॒शेय्या॑य । जा॒येव॒ पत्ये॑ त॒न्वं॑ रिरिच्यां॒ वि चि॑द्वृहेव॒ रथ्ये॑व च॒क्रा
shlokas.transliteration: yamásya ǀ mā ǀ yamyám ǀ kā́maḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agan ǀ samāné ǀ yónau ǀ saha-śéyyāya ǀjāyā́-iva ǀ pátye ǀ tanvám ǀ riricyām ǀ ví ǀ cit ǀ vṛheva ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ cakrā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). The desire ofYamahas approached meYamī, to lie with him in the same bed; I willabandon my person n as a wife to her husband; let us exert ourselves in union like the two wheels of a wagon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न ति॑ष्ठन्ति॒ न नि मि॑षन्त्ये॒ते दे॒वानां॒ स्पश॑ इ॒ह ये चर॑न्ति । अ॒न्येन॒ मदा॑हनो याहि॒ तूयं॒ तेन॒ वि वृ॑ह॒ रथ्ये॑व च॒क्रा
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tiṣṭhanti ǀ ná ǀ ní ǀ miṣanti ǀ eté ǀ devā́nām ǀ spáśaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ yé ǀ cáranti ǀanyéna ǀ mát ǀ āhanaḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ tū́yam ǀ téna ǀ ví ǀ vṛheva ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ cakrā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). The spies of the gods, which wander upon earth, never stop, never close their eyeṣAssociate quickly, destructress, with some other than with me, and exert yourselves in union, like the two wheelsof a wagon.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रात्री॑भिरस्मा॒ अह॑भिर्दशस्ये॒त्सूर्य॑स्य॒ चक्षु॒र्मुहु॒रुन्मि॑मीयात् । दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या मि॑थु॒ना सब॑न्धू य॒मीर्य॒मस्य॑ बिभृया॒दजा॑मि
shlokas.transliteration: rā́trībhiḥ ǀ asmai ǀ áha-bhiḥ ǀ daśasyet ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ múhuḥ ǀ út ǀ mimīyāt ǀdivā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ mithunā́ ǀ sábandhū íti sá-bandhū ǀ yamī́ḥ ǀ yamásya ǀ bibhṛyāt ǀ ájāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). To him (Yam) let every worshipper sacrifice both day and night, on him let the eye ofthe Sun repeatedly rise; (for him may) the kindred pair (day and night unite) with heaven and earth.Yamawilladhere to the non- affinity of Yama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ घा॒ ता ग॑च्छा॒नुत्त॑रा यु॒गानि॒ यत्र॑ जा॒मय॑: कृ॒णव॒न्नजा॑मि । उप॑ बर्बृहि वृष॒भाय॑ बा॒हुम॒न्यमि॑च्छस्व सुभगे॒ पतिं॒ मत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ gha ǀ tā́ ǀ gacchān ǀ út-tarā ǀ yugā́ni ǀ yátra ǀ jāmáyaḥ ǀ kṛṇávan ǀ ájāmi ǀúpa ǀ barbṛhi ǀ vṛṣabhā́ya ǀ bāhúm ǀ anyám ǀ icchasva ǀ su-bhage ǀ pátim ǀ mát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). The subsequent ages will come, when sisters will choose one who is not a brother (asa husband); therefore, auspicious one, choose another husband than me, and make your arm a pillow for yourmate.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किं भ्राता॑स॒द्यद॑ना॒थं भवा॑ति॒ किमु॒ स्वसा॒ यन्निॠ॑तिर्नि॒गच्छा॑त् । काम॑मूता ब॒ह्वे॒३॒॑तद्र॑पामि त॒न्वा॑ मे त॒न्वं१॒॑ सं पि॑पृग्धि
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ bhrā́tā ǀ asat ǀ yát ǀ anāthám ǀ bhávāti ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svásā ǀ yát ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ ni-gácchāt ǀkā́ma-mūtā ǀ bahú ǀ etát ǀ rapāmi ǀ tanvā́ ǀ me ǀ tanvám ǀ sám ǀ pipṛgdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). Is he a brother whose sister has no lord? Is she a sister (whose brother) misfortuneapproaches? Overcome by desire, I strongly urge this one request; unite your person n with mine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वा उ॑ ते त॒न्वा॑ त॒न्वं१॒॑ सं प॑पृच्यां पा॒पमा॑हु॒र्यः स्वसा॑रं नि॒गच्छा॑त् । अ॒न्येन॒ मत्प्र॒मुद॑: कल्पयस्व॒ न ते॒ भ्राता॑ सुभगे वष्ट्ये॒तत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ tanvā́ ǀ tanvám ǀ sám ǀ papṛcyām ǀ pāpám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ svásāram ǀ ni-gácchāt ǀanyéna ǀ mát ǀ pra-múdaḥ ǀ kalpayasva ǀ ná ǀ te ǀ bhrā́tā ǀ su-bhage ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ etát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). I will not unite my person n with yours; they call him who approaches a sister, a sinneṛEnjoy plural asure with some other than me; your brother, auspicious one, has no such desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒तो ब॑तासि यम॒ नैव ते॒ मनो॒ हृद॑यं चाविदाम । अ॒न्या किल॒ त्वां क॒क्ष्ये॑व यु॒क्तं परि॑ ष्वजाते॒ लिबु॑जेव वृ॒क्षम्
shlokas.transliteration: batáḥ ǀ bata ǀ asi ǀ yama ǀ ná ǀ evá ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ hṛ́dayam ǀ ca ǀ avidāma ǀanyā́ ǀ kíla ǀ tvā́m ǀ kakṣyā́-iva ǀ yuktám ǀ pári ǀ svajāte ǀ líbujā-iva ǀ vṛkṣám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamispeaks). Alas,Yama, you are feeble; we understand not your mind or your heart. Some otherfemale embraces you as a girth a horse, or as a creeper a tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्यमू॒ षु त्वं य॑म्य॒न्य उ॒ त्वां परि॑ ष्वजाते॒ लिबु॑जेव वृ॒क्षम् । तस्य॑ वा॒ त्वं मन॑ इ॒च्छा स वा॒ तवाधा॑ कृणुष्व सं॒विदं॒ सुभ॑द्राम्
shlokas.transliteration: anyám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ tvám ǀ yami ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tvā́m ǀ pári ǀ svajāte ǀ líbujā-iva ǀ vṛkṣám ǀtásya ǀ vā ǀ tvám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ icchá ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā ǀ táva ǀ ádha ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ sam-vídam ǀ sú-bhadrām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yamaspeaks). Do you,Yamī, embrace another; and let another embrace you as a creeper a tree;seek his affection, let him seek you; and make a happy union.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ वृष्णे॑ दुदुहे॒ दोह॑सा दि॒वः पयां॑सि य॒ह्वो अदि॑ते॒रदा॑भ्यः । विश्वं॒ स वे॑द॒ वरु॑णो॒ यथा॑ धि॒या स य॒ज्ञियो॑ यजतु य॒ज्ञियाँ॑ ऋ॒तून्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ vṛ́ṣṇe ǀ duduhe ǀ dóhasā ǀ diváḥ ǀ páyāṃsi ǀ yahváḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀvíśvam ǀ sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀ yajatu ǀ yajñíyān ǀ ṛtū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great, the unconquerable (Agni), the showerer, milks openly with a (great) milking the streams (ofprosperity) from heaven for the unwearying sacrificer; likeVaruṇa, he knows everything by his understanding;may he who is skilled in sacrifice observe the sacrificial seasona.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रप॑द्गन्ध॒र्वीरप्या॑ च॒ योष॑णा न॒दस्य॑ ना॒दे परि॑ पातु मे॒ मन॑: । इ॒ष्टस्य॒ मध्ये॒ अदि॑ति॒र्नि धा॑तु नो॒ भ्राता॑ नो ज्ये॒ष्ठः प्र॑थ॒मो वि वो॑चति
shlokas.transliteration: rápat ǀ gandharvī́ḥ ǀ ápyā ǀ ca ǀ yóṣaṇā ǀ nadásya ǀ nādé ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ me ǀ mánaḥ ǀiṣṭásya ǀ mádhye ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhātu ǀ naḥ ǀ bhrā́tā ǀ naḥ ǀ jyeṣṭháḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ ví ǀ vocati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheGandharvīand the water-consecrated feminine nine oblation praiseAgni; may he be favourable tothe thought of me, raising my voice in his praise; may Agni plural ce us in the midst of the sacrifice; the chief (of theworshipers), our elder brother, repeats his various laudations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो चि॒न्नु भ॒द्रा क्षु॒मती॒ यश॑स्वत्यु॒षा उ॑वास॒ मन॑वे॒ स्व॑र्वती । यदी॑मु॒शन्त॑मुश॒तामनु॒ क्रतु॑म॒ग्निं होता॑रं वि॒दथा॑य॒ जीज॑नन्
shlokas.transliteration: só íti ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ kṣu-mátī ǀ yáśasvatī ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ uvāsa ǀ mánave ǀ sváḥ-vatī ǀyát ǀ īm ǀ uśántam ǀ uśatā́m ǀ ánu ǀ krátum ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ vidáthāya ǀ jī́janan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The very auspicious, resounding, famous Dawn, ascends bringing the sun to man; when for thesacrifice after the worship they give birth to thatAgni, the desirer, the invoker of the desiring (gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ त्यं द्र॒प्सं वि॒भ्वं॑ विचक्ष॒णं विराभ॑रदिषि॒तः श्ये॒नो अ॑ध्व॒रे । यदी॒ विशो॑ वृ॒णते॑ द॒स्ममार्या॑ अ॒ग्निं होता॑र॒मध॒ धीर॑जायत
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ tyám ǀ drapsám ǀ vi-bhvám ǀ vi-cakṣaṇám ǀ víḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharat ǀ iṣitáḥ ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀyádi ǀ víśaḥ ǀ vṛṇáte ǀ dasmám ǀ ā́ryāḥ ǀ agním ǀ hótāram ǀ ádha ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ ajāyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The hawk sent (byAgni) to the sacrifice has brought the dripping copious all-seeing (Soma) libatioṇWhen theAryapeople choose the victorious Agni as the ministrant priest, then the sacred rite is celebrateḍ”

shlokas.sanskrit: सदा॑सि र॒ण्वो यव॑सेव॒ पुष्य॑ते॒ होत्रा॑भिरग्ने॒ मनु॑षः स्वध्व॒रः । विप्र॑स्य वा॒ यच्छ॑शमा॒न उ॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ वाजं॑ सस॒वाँ उ॑प॒यासि॒ भूरि॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: sádā ǀ asi ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ yávasā-iva ǀ púṣyate ǀ hótrābhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǀvíprasya ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ śaśamānáḥ ǀ ukthyám ǀ vā́jam ǀ sasa-vā́n ǀ upa-yā́si ǀ bhū́ri-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Agni, are ever plural asing (to your worshippers), as pasture satisfies (the herds); bewell-worshipped with man's sacrifices; if commending the praise of the wise, and partaking of the (sacrificial)food, you come with many (divinities of the rite).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रय पि॒तरा॑ जा॒र आ भग॒मिय॑क्षति हर्य॒तो हृ॒त्त इ॑ष्यति । विव॑क्ति॒ वह्नि॑: स्वप॒स्यते॑ म॒खस्त॑वि॒ष्यते॒ असु॑रो॒ वेप॑ते म॒ती
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īraya ǀ pitárā ǀ jāráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ bhágam ǀ íyakṣati ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ hṛttáḥ ǀ iṣyati ǀvívakti ǀ váhniḥ ǀ su-apasyáte ǀ makháḥ ǀ taviṣyáte ǀ ásuraḥ ǀ vépate ǀ matī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wake up the parents, as the Sun his splendour; (the worshipper) desires to offer worship to (thedeities) who are plural ased by it; with all his heart he wishes (to do so); he desires to repeat (your praise); thebearer (of the oblation) is anxious to effect the good work; the sacrifice longs for augmentation, the prudent(sacrificer) trembles in his thoughts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ अग्ने सुम॒तिं मर्तो॒ अक्ष॒त्सह॑सः सूनो॒ अति॒ स प्र शृ॑ण्वे । इषं॒ दधा॑नो॒ वह॑मानो॒ अश्वै॒रा स द्यु॒माँ अम॑वान्भूषति॒ द्यून्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ su-matím ǀ mártaḥ ǀ ákṣat ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ áti ǀ sáḥ ǀ prá ǀ śṛṇve ǀíṣam ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ váhamānaḥ ǀ áśvaiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ dyu-mā́n ǀ áma-vān ǀ bhūṣati ǀ dyū́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, son of strength, the mortal who obtains your favour is widely celebrated; possessing abundantfood, and being conveyed by horses, illustrious and vigorous he graces the days of his existence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यद॑ग्न ए॒षा समि॑ति॒र्भवा॑ति दे॒वी दे॒वेषु॑ यज॒ता य॑जत्र । रत्ना॑ च॒ यद्वि॒भजा॑सि स्वधावो भा॒गं नो॒ अत्र॒ वसु॑मन्तं वीतात्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ agne ǀ eṣā́ ǀ sám-itiḥ ǀ bhávāti ǀ devī́ ǀ devéṣu ǀ yajatā́ ǀ yajatra ǀrátnā ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ vi-bhájāsi ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ vásu-mantam ǀ vītāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When, adorableAgni, this united praise is resplendent among the adorable gods, and when you,bearer of the oblatio, apportion the precious (treasures), then allot to us a valuable share. bring to us the heaven and earth, the daughters of the divine (Prajāpati), let none of the gods be absent, and doyou yourself be present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी नो॑ अग्ने॒ सद॑ने स॒धस्थे॑ यु॒क्ष्वा रथ॑म॒मृत॑स्य द्रवि॒त्नुम् । आ नो॑ वह॒ रोद॑सी दे॒वपु॑त्रे॒ माकि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मप॑ भूरि॒ह स्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sádane ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ yukṣvá ǀ rátham ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dravitnúm ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vaha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápa ǀ bhūḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावा॑ ह॒ क्षामा॑ प्रथ॒मे ऋ॒तेना॑भिश्रा॒वे भ॑वतः सत्य॒वाचा॑ । दे॒वो यन्मर्ता॑न्य॒जथा॑य कृ॒ण्वन्त्सीद॒द्धोता॑ प्र॒त्यङ्स्वमसुं॒ यन्
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ ha ǀ kṣā́mā ǀ prathamé íti ǀ ṛténa ǀ abhi-śrāvé ǀ bhavataḥ ǀ satya-vā́cā ǀdeváḥ ǀ yát ǀ mártān ǀ yajáthāya ǀ kṛṇván ǀ sī́dat ǀ hótā ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ svám ǀ ásum ǀ yán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Heaven and earth, declarers of truth, principal (of things), be present at the invocation, associatedwith the rite, when the divine (Agni), exciting mortals to sacrifice, sits down in their presence as the invoker (ofthe gods) putting forth his flame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वो दे॒वान्प॑रि॒भूॠ॒तेन॒ वहा॑ नो ह॒व्यं प्र॑थ॒मश्चि॑कि॒त्वान् । धू॒मके॑तुः स॒मिधा॒ भाऋ॑जीको म॒न्द्रो होता॒ नित्यो॑ वा॒चा यजी॑यान्
shlokas.transliteration: deváḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ pari-bhū́ḥ ǀ ṛténa ǀ váha ǀ naḥ ǀ havyám ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀdhūmá-ketuḥ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkaḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ hótā ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ vācā́ ǀ yájīyān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you, bright (Agni), surrounding the gods, carry our oblation with due rites; you, who are the chief(of the deities), the wise, the smoke-bannered, fuel-kindled, straight-flaming, adorable, the invoker, the constantsacrificer with prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वावृ॑ग्दे॒वस्या॒मृतं॒ यदी॒ गोरतो॑ जा॒तासो॑ धारयन्त उ॒र्वी । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अनु॒ तत्ते॒ यजु॑र्गुर्दु॒हे यदेनी॑ दि॒व्यं घृ॒तं वाः
shlokas.transliteration: svā́vṛk ǀ devásya ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ yádi ǀ góḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ jātā́saḥ ǀ dhārayante ǀ urvī́ íti ǀvíśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ yájuḥ ǀ guḥ ǀ duhé ǀ yát ǀ énī ǀ divyám ǀ ghṛtám ǀ vā́ríti vā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the self-aggregated ambrosia of the divineAgniis genitive rated fromhis radiance, then theproducts from it sustain both heaven and earth, all the worshippers glorify this your oblation, the celestial nutriouswater which your white lustre milks forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर्चा॑मि वां॒ वर्धा॒यापो॑ घृतस्नू॒ द्यावा॑भूमी शृणु॒तं रो॑दसी मे । अहा॒ यद्द्यावोऽसु॑नीति॒मय॒न्मध्वा॑ नो॒ अत्र॑ पि॒तरा॑ शिशीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: árcāmi ǀ vām ǀ várdhāya ǀ ápaḥ ǀ ghṛtasnū íti ghṛta-snū ǀ dyā́vābhūmī íti ǀ śṛṇutám ǀ rodasī íti ǀ me ǀáhā ǀ yát ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ ásu-nītim ǀ áyan ǀ mádhvā ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ pitárā ǀ śiśītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I worship you, waters that pour forth ghī, and you, heaven and earth, for your increase; hear me, youworlds; when worshippers at the daily or nightly rite proceed to their pious purpose, then may the parents (of all)sanctify us with ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: किं स्वि॑न्नो॒ राजा॑ जगृहे॒ कद॒स्याति॑ व्र॒तं च॑कृमा॒ को वि वे॑द । मि॒त्रश्चि॒द्धि ष्मा॑ जुहुरा॒णो दे॒वाञ्छ्लोको॒ न या॒तामपि॒ वाजो॒ अस्ति॑
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ svit ǀ naḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ jagṛhe ǀ kát ǀ asya ǀ áti ǀ vratám ǀ cakṛma ǀ káḥ ǀ ví ǀ veda ǀmitráḥ ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ juhurāṇáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yātā́m ǀ ápi ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ásti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “But will the royalAgniaccept our oblation? Have we duly performed our vows to him? Who decides?As a friend affectionately invited, so let our praise now proceed to the gods; together with the sacrificial food thatis left over.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दु॒र्मन्त्वत्रा॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाम॒ सल॑क्ष्मा॒ यद्विषु॑रूपा॒ भवा॑ति । य॒मस्य॒ यो म॒नव॑ते सु॒मन्त्वग्ने॒ तमृ॑ष्व पा॒ह्यप्र॑युच्छन्
shlokas.transliteration: duḥ-mántu ǀ átra ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ sá-lakṣmā ǀ yát ǀ víṣu-rūpā ǀ bhávāti ǀyamásya ǀ yáḥ ǀ manávate ǀ su-mántu ǀ ágne ǀ tám ǀ ṛṣva ǀ pāhi ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hard to understand is the nature of the immortal, for although of one origin, she is of a different form;cherish him diligently, greatAgni, who understandsYama's nature easy to be understood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॑न्दे॒वा वि॒दथे॑ मा॒दय॑न्ते वि॒वस्व॑त॒: सद॑ने धा॒रय॑न्ते । सूर्ये॒ ज्योति॒रद॑धुर्मा॒स्य१॒॑क्तून्परि॑ द्योत॒निं च॑रतो॒ अज॑स्रा
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vidáthe ǀ mādáyante ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ sádane ǀ dhāráyante ǀsū́rye ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ māsí ǀ aktū́n ǀ pári ǀ dyotaním ǀ carataḥ ǀ ájasrā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In him the gods find plural asure at the sacrifice; they seat themselves on the altar of the sacrificer. Theyplaced light in the sun; beams in the moon; and these untiring shed their light around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॑न्दे॒वा मन्म॑नि सं॒चर॑न्त्यपी॒च्ये॒३॒॑ न व॒यम॑स्य विद्म । मि॒त्रो नो॒ अत्रादि॑ति॒रना॑गान्त्सवि॒ता दे॒वो वरु॑णाय वोचत्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mánmani ǀ sam-cáranti ǀ apīcyé ǀ ná ǀ vayám ǀ asya ǀ vidma ǀmitráḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ átra ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ánāgān ǀ savitā́ ǀ deváḥ ǀ váruṇāya ǀ vocat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When he, the all-illumining, is there, the gods assemble; but when he is concealed, we know not (hisabode); so at this sacrifice, letMitraandAditiandSavitāproclaim us toVaruṇaas free from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी नो॑ अग्ने॒ सद॑ने स॒धस्थे॑ यु॒क्ष्वा रथ॑म॒मृत॑स्य द्रवि॒त्नुम् । आ नो॑ वह॒ रोद॑सी दे॒वपु॑त्रे॒ माकि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मप॑ भूरि॒ह स्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ sádane ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ yukṣvá ǀ rátham ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ dravitnúm ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vaha ǀ ródasī íti ǀ deváputre íti devá-putre ǀ mā́kiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ápa ǀ bhūḥ ǀ ihá ǀ syāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒जे वां॒ ब्रह्म॑ पू॒र्व्यं नमो॑भि॒र्वि श्लोक॑ एतु प॒थ्ये॑व सू॒रेः । शृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य पु॒त्रा आ ये धामा॑नि दि॒व्यानि॑ त॒स्थुः
shlokas.transliteration: yujé ǀ vām ǀ bráhma ǀ pūrvyám ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ ślókaḥ ǀ etu ǀ pathyā́-iva ǀ sūréḥ ǀśṛṇvántu ǀ víśve ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yé ǀ dhā́māni ǀ divyā́ni ǀ tasthúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I load you two with sacred offerings, repeating an ancient prayer; may the sound (of your approach)reach (the gods) like the path of the worshipper, may all the sons of the immortal (Prajāpati) who inhabit thecelestial regions hear (the sound).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒मे इ॑व॒ यत॑माने॒ यदैतं॒ प्र वां॑ भर॒न्मानु॑षा देव॒यन्त॑: । आ सी॑दतं॒ स्वमु॑ लो॒कं विदा॑ने स्वास॒स्थे भ॑वत॒मिन्द॑वे नः
shlokas.transliteration: yamé ivéti yamé-iva ǀ yátamāne íti ǀ yát ǀ áitam ǀ prá ǀ vām ǀ bharan ǀ mā́nuṣāḥ ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀā́ ǀ sīdatam ǀ svám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǀ vídāne íti ǀ svāsasthé íti su-āsasthé ǀ bhavatam ǀ índave ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you two came, like twins, busily engaged, then devout worshipper brought you forward;knowing your plural ce there abide and be fair storehouses for ourSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पञ्च॑ प॒दानि॑ रु॒पो अन्व॑रोहं॒ चतु॑ष्पदी॒मन्वे॑मि व्र॒तेन॑ । अ॒क्षरे॑ण॒ प्रति॑ मिम ए॒तामृ॒तस्य॒ नाभा॒वधि॒ सं पु॑नामि
shlokas.transliteration: páñca ǀ padā́ni ǀ rupáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ aroham ǀ cátuḥ-padīm ǀ ánu ǀ emi ǀ vraténa ǀakṣáreṇa ǀ práti ǀ mime ǀ etā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀ nā́bhau ǀ ádhi ǀ sám ǀ punāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I make the five stages of the sacrifice ascend; I take four steps by pious observances; with the sacredsyllable, I perfect this (adoration); I purify (theSoma) on the navel of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दे॒वेभ्य॒: कम॑वृणीत मृ॒त्युं प्र॒जायै॒ कम॒मृतं॒ नावृ॑णीत । बृह॒स्पतिं॑ य॒ज्ञम॑कृण्वत॒ ऋषिं॑ प्रि॒यां य॒मस्त॒न्वं१॒॑ प्रारि॑रेचीत्
shlokas.transliteration: devébhyaḥ ǀ kám ǀ avṛṇīta ǀ mṛtyúm ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ kám ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ná ǀ avṛṇīta ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ yajñám ǀ akṛṇvata ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ priyā́m ǀ yamáḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ prá ǀ arirecīt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom has he selected as the slayer of the gods? Whom has he not selected as non-slayer of theabove mentioned are necessarily present while the business of the bringing of the oblation is in progress, yamadoes not send any of hie men as the destroyer. Another translation: What death did he choose for the gods, whatimmortality did he not choose for men? i.e.,Yamaordained that gods should not die, and that men should receiveimmortality; Yama preserves our loved bodies: prārirecit = takes away (from death), mṛtyoḥsaka- śātpariharati; 'ric' is here used in the sense of taking away; the meaning is: he does not take our life away as aconsequence of a fault arising from a defect in our worship].”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त क्ष॑रन्ति॒ शिश॑वे म॒रुत्व॑ते पि॒त्रे पु॒त्रासो॒ अप्य॑वीवतन्नृ॒तम् । उ॒भे इद॑स्यो॒भय॑स्य राजत उ॒भे य॑तेते उ॒भय॑स्य पुष्यतः
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ kṣaranti ǀ śíśave ǀ marútvate ǀ pitré ǀ putrā́saḥ ǀ ápi ǀ avīvatan ǀ ṛtám ǀubhé íti ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ ubháyasya ǀ rājataḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ yatete íti ǀ ubháyasya ǀ puṣyataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven (metres) offer laudation to the glorious, the adorable parent, (theSoma), his sons (thepriests) utter his true (praise); you both are lords of both (men and gods), you both exert yourselves and are thenourishers of both (men and gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रे॒यि॒वांसं॑ प्र॒वतो॑ म॒हीरनु॑ ब॒हुभ्य॒: पन्था॑मनुपस्पशा॒नम् । वै॒व॒स्व॒तं सं॒गम॑नं॒ जना॑नां य॒मं राजा॑नं ह॒विषा॑ दुवस्य
shlokas.transliteration: pareyi-vā́ṃsam ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ bahú-bhyaḥ ǀ pánthām ǀ anu-paspaśānám ǀvaivasvatám ǀ sam-gámanam ǀ jánānām ǀ yamám ǀ rā́jānam ǀ havíṣā ǀ duvasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship with oblations fromYama, king (of thePitṛs), son ofVivasvat, the aggregation of mankind,who conducts those who are virtuous over the earth, and opens to many the path (of heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒मो नो॑ गा॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मो वि॑वेद॒ नैषा गव्यू॑ति॒रप॑भर्त॒वा उ॑ । यत्रा॑ न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: परे॒युरे॒ना ज॑ज्ञा॒नाः प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ अनु॒ स्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: yamáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ gātúm ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ viveda ǀ ná ǀ eṣā́ ǀ gávyūtiḥ ǀ ápa-bhartavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀyátra ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ parā-īyúḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ jajñānā́ḥ ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ svā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yama, the chief (of all), knows our well-being; this pasture no one can take from us; by the road bywhich our forefathers have gone, all who are born (proceed) along the paths they have made for themselveṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: मात॑ली क॒व्यैर्य॒मो अङ्गि॑रोभि॒र्बृह॒स्पति॒ॠक्व॑भिर्वावृधा॒नः । याँश्च॑ दे॒वा वा॑वृ॒धुर्ये च॑ दे॒वान्त्स्वाहा॒न्ये स्व॒धया॒न्ये म॑दन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: mā́talī ǀ kavyáiḥ ǀ yamáḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀyā́n ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vavṛdhúḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ devā́n ǀ svā́hā ǀ anyé ǀ svadháyā ǀ anyé ǀ madanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mātalin prospers with theKavyas;Yamawith theAṅgirasas;Bṛhaspatiwith the Ṛkvans; they whomthe gods augment, and they who augment the gods, these rejoice inSvāhā, those in theSvadhā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॑म प्रस्त॒रमा हि सीदाङ्गि॑रोभिः पि॒तृभि॑: संविदा॒नः । आ त्वा॒ मन्त्रा॑: कविश॒स्ता व॑हन्त्वे॒ना रा॑जन्ह॒विषा॑ मादयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yama ǀ pra-starám ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ sī́da ǀ áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sam-vidānáḥ ǀā́ ǀ tvā ǀ mántrāḥ ǀ kavi-śastā́ḥ ǀ vahantu ǀ enā́ ǀ rājan ǀ havíṣā ǀ mādayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yama, who are associated with theAṅgirasaPitṛs, sit down at this sacrifice; may the prayers recitedby the priests bring you here; be exhilarated, Sovereign, (Yam), by this oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अङ्गि॑रोभि॒रा ग॑हि य॒ज्ञिये॑भि॒र्यम॑ वैरू॒पैरि॒ह मा॑दयस्व । विव॑स्वन्तं हुवे॒ यः पि॒ता ते॒ऽस्मिन्य॒ज्ञे ब॒र्हिष्या नि॒षद्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: áṅgiraḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ yajñíyebhiḥ ǀ yáma ǀ vairūpáiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ mādayasva ǀvívasvantam ǀ huve ǀ yáḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ te ǀ asmín ǀ yajñé ǀ barhíṣi ǀ ā́ ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come here,Yama, with the venerable multiformAṅgirasas, and be exhilarated; I summonVivasvat,who is your father, to this sacrifice; be seated on the sacred grass (delight the sacrificer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अङ्गि॑रसो नः पि॒तरो॒ नव॑ग्वा॒ अथ॑र्वाणो॒ भृग॑वः सो॒म्यास॑: । तेषां॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒मपि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म
shlokas.transliteration: áṅgirasaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ átharvāṇaḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀtéṣām ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyānām ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAṅgirasas, theAtharvas, theBhṛgus, who are entitled to theSoma, are our recent progenitors;may we ever have a plural ce in the favour of these venerable (pitrṣ); may we be ever held in their auspiciousregard.”
