shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेहि॒ प्रेहि॑ प॒थिभि॑: पू॒र्व्येभि॒र्यत्रा॑ न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: परे॒युः । उ॒भा राजा॑ना स्व॒धया॒ मद॑न्ता य॒मं प॑श्यासि॒ वरु॑णं च दे॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ ihi ǀ prá ǀ ihi ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ pūrvyébhiḥ ǀ yátra ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ parā-īyúḥ ǀubhā́ ǀ rā́jānā ǀ svadháyā ǀ mádantā ǀ yamám ǀ paśyāsi ǀ váruṇam ǀ ca ǀ devám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Depart, depart, by the former paths by which our forefathers have departed; there shall you behold thetwo monarchsYamaand the divineVaruṇarejoicing in theSvadhā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं ग॑च्छस्व पि॒तृभि॒: सं य॒मेने॑ष्टापू॒र्तेन॑ पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । हि॒त्वाया॑व॒द्यं पुन॒रस्त॒मेहि॒ सं ग॑च्छस्व त॒न्वा॑ सु॒वर्चा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ gacchasva ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ yaména ǀ iṣṭāpūrténa ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀhitvā́ya ǀ avadyám ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ástam ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ sám ǀ gacchasva ǀ tanvā́ ǀ su-várcāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be united with thePitṛs, withYama, and with the fulfilment of your wishes in the highest heaven;discarding iniquity, return to your abode, and unite yourself to a luminous body.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपे॑त॒ वी॑त॒ वि च॑ सर्प॒तातो॒ऽस्मा ए॒तं पि॒तरो॑ लो॒कम॑क्रन् । अहो॑भिर॒द्भिर॒क्तुभि॒र्व्य॑क्तं य॒मो द॑दात्यव॒सान॑मस्मै
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ ita ǀ ví ǀ ita ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ sarpata ǀ átaḥ ǀ asmái ǀ etám ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ lokám ǀ akran ǀáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ ví-aktam ǀ yamáḥ ǀ dadāti ǀ ava-sā́nam ǀ asmai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Depart from hence, begone, go far off, (evil spirits); thePitṛshave assigned this plural ce to him, yamahas given him a plural ce of cremation consecrated by days, streams and nights. To him-- (the departedworshipper].”

shlokas.sanskrit: अति॑ द्रव सारमे॒यौ श्वानौ॑ चतुर॒क्षौ श॒बलौ॑ सा॒धुना॑ प॒था । अथा॑ पि॒तॄन्त्सु॑वि॒दत्राँ॒ उपे॑हि य॒मेन॒ ये स॑ध॒मादं॒ मद॑न्ति
shlokas.transliteration: áti ǀ drava ǀ sārameyáu ǀ śvā́nau ǀ catuḥ-akṣáu ǀ śabálau ǀ sādhúnā ǀ pathā́ ǀátha ǀ pitṝ́n ǀ su-vidátrān ǀ úpa ǀ ihi ǀ yaména ǀ yé ǀ sadha-mā́dam ǀ mádanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pass by a secure path beyond the two spotted four-eyed dogs, the progeny ofSaramā, and join thewisePitṛswho rejoice joyfully withYama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यौ ते॒ श्वानौ॑ यम रक्षि॒तारौ॑ चतुर॒क्षौ प॑थि॒रक्षी॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सौ । ताभ्या॑मेनं॒ परि॑ देहि राजन्त्स्व॒स्ति चा॑स्मा अनमी॒वं च॑ धेहि
shlokas.transliteration: yáu ǀ te ǀ śvā́nau ǀ yama ǀ rakṣitā́rau ǀ catuḥ-akṣáu ǀ pathirákṣī íti pathi-rákṣī ǀ nṛ-cákṣasau ǀtā́bhyām ǀ enam ǀ pári ǀ dehi ǀ rājan ǀ svastí ǀ ca ǀ asmai ǀ anamīvám ǀ ca ǀ dhehi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Entrust him, O king, to your two dogs, which are your protectors,Yama, the four-eyed guardians of theroad, renowned by men, and grant him prosperity and health.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रू॒ण॒साव॑सु॒तृपा॑ उदुम्ब॒लौ य॒मस्य॑ दू॒तौ च॑रतो॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ । ताव॒स्मभ्यं॑ दृ॒शये॒ सूर्या॑य॒ पुन॑र्दाता॒मसु॑म॒द्येह भ॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: uru-nasáu ǀ asu-tṛ́pau ǀ udumbaláu ǀ yamásya ǀ dūtáu ǀ carataḥ ǀ jánān ǀ ánu ǀtáu ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dṛśáye ǀ sū́ryāya ǀ púnaḥ ǀ dātām ǀ ásum ǀ adyá ǀ ihá ǀ bhadrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The messengers ofYama, broad-nosed, and of exceeding strength, and satiating themselves with thelife (of mortals), hunt mankind; may they allow us this day a prosperous existence here, that we may look uponthe sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒माय॒ सोमं॑ सुनुत य॒माय॑ जुहुता ह॒विः । य॒मं ह॑ य॒ज्ञो ग॑च्छत्य॒ग्निदू॑तो॒ अरं॑कृतः
shlokas.transliteration: yamā́ya ǀ sómam ǀ sunuta ǀ yamā́ya ǀ juhuta ǀ havíḥ ǀyamám ǀ ha ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ gacchati ǀ agní-dūtaḥ ǀ áram-kṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pour out theSomaforYama; to Yama offer the oblation, the decorated sacrifice of whichAgniis themessenger proceeds to Yama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒माय॑ घृ॒तव॑द्ध॒विर्जु॒होत॒ प्र च॑ तिष्ठत । स नो॑ दे॒वेष्वा य॑मद्दी॒र्घमायु॒: प्र जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yamā́ya ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ havíḥ ǀ juhóta ǀ prá ǀ ca ǀ tiṣṭhata ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yamat ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ prá ǀ jīváse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer the oblation of clarified butter toYama, and stand near (to the altar); it is he who among the godsgives us a long life to live.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒माय॒ मधु॑मत्तमं॒ राज्ञे॑ ह॒व्यं जु॑होतन । इ॒दं नम॒ ऋषि॑भ्यः पूर्व॒जेभ्य॒: पूर्वे॑भ्यः पथि॒कृद्भ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yamā́ya ǀ mádhumat-tamam ǀ rā́jñe ǀ havyám ǀ juhotana ǀidám ǀ námaḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhyaḥ ǀ pūrva-jébhyaḥ ǀ pū́rvebhyaḥ ǀ pathikṛ́t-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Offer to the royalYamathis most sweet oblation; (let) this our adoration (be addressed) to the ancientsages, the first followers of (virtuous) paths.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिक॑द्रुकेभिः पतति॒ षळु॒र्वीरेक॒मिद्बृ॒हत् । त्रि॒ष्टुब्गा॑य॒त्री छन्दां॑सि॒ सर्वा॒ ता य॒म आहि॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: trí-kadrukebhiḥ ǀ patati ǀ ṣáṭ ǀ urvī́ḥ ǀ ékam ǀ ít ǀ bṛhát ǀtri-stúp ǀ gāyatrī́ ǀ chándāṃsi ǀ sárvā ǀ tā́ ǀ yamé ǀ ā́-hitā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Yama) acquires the three trikadruka saacrifices; the six earths, the one great (moving world); thetriṣṭubh,gāyatrī, all the sacred metres converge in Yama.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑रता॒मव॑र॒ उत्परा॑स॒ उन्म॑ध्य॒माः पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यास॑: । असुं॒ य ई॒युर॑वृ॒का ऋ॑त॒ज्ञास्ते नो॑ऽवन्तु पि॒तरो॒ हवे॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īratām ǀ ávare ǀ út ǀ párāsaḥ ǀ út ǀ madhyamā́ḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀásum ǀ yé ǀ īyúḥ ǀ avṛkā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ avantu ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ háveṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the lower, the upper, the intermediatePitṛs, rise up, accepting theSomalibation; may thoseprogenitors who, unlike wolves, acknowledging our offerings, have come to preserve our lives, protect us uponour invocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं पि॒तृभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्त्व॒द्य ये पूर्वा॑सो॒ य उप॑रास ई॒युः । ये पार्थि॑वे॒ रज॒स्या निष॑त्ता॒ ये वा॑ नू॒नं सु॑वृ॒जना॑सु वि॒क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ astu ǀ adyá ǀ yé ǀ pū́rvāsaḥ ǀ yé ǀ úparāsaḥ ǀ īyúḥ ǀyé ǀ pā́rthive ǀ rájasi ǀ ā́ ǀ ní-sattāḥ ǀ yé ǀ vā ǀ nūnám ǀ su-vṛjánāsu ǀ vikṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let this our adoration be today addressed to thosePitṛsour predecessors, to those our successors,who have departed (to the world of the manes); to those who are seated in the terrestrial sphere, to those whoare present among opulent people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आहं पि॒तॄन्त्सु॑वि॒दत्राँ॑ अवित्सि॒ नपा॑तं च वि॒क्रम॑णं च॒ विष्णो॑: । ब॒र्हि॒षदो॒ ये स्व॒धया॑ सु॒तस्य॒ भज॑न्त पि॒त्वस्त इ॒हाग॑मिष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ahám ǀ pitṝ́n ǀ su-vidátrān ǀ avitsi ǀ nápātam ǀ ca ǀ vi-krámaṇam ǀ ca ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀbarhi-sádaḥ ǀ yé ǀ svadháyā ǀ sutásya ǀ bhájanta ǀ pitváḥ ǀ té ǀ ihá ǀ ā́-gamiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have brought to my presence thePitṛswho are well cognizant (of my worship), the infallibility, andfood of the effused (Soma) with the sacrificial cake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बर्हि॑षदः पितर ऊ॒त्य१॒॑र्वागि॒मा वो॑ ह॒व्या च॑कृमा जु॒षध्व॑म् । त आ ग॒ताव॑सा॒ शंत॑मे॒नाथा॑ न॒: शं योर॑र॒पो द॑धात
shlokas.transliteration: bárhi-sadaḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ arvā́k ǀ imā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ havyā́ ǀ cakṛma ǀ juṣádhvam ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ gata ǀ ávasā ǀ śám-tamena ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ arapáḥ ǀ dadhāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pitṛs,Barhiṣads, protect (us who are) in your presence; we have made these oblations for you,accept them; come with your most felicitous protection, and bestow upon us health and happiness; and pardonfrom sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑हूताः पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यासो॑ बर्हि॒ष्ये॑षु नि॒धिषु॑ प्रि॒येषु॑ । त आ ग॑मन्तु॒ त इ॒ह श्रु॑व॒न्त्वधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु॒ ते॑ऽवन्त्व॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa-hūtāḥ ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀ barhiṣyéṣu ǀ ni-dhíṣu ǀ priyéṣu ǀté ǀ ā́ ǀ gamantu ǀ té ǀ ihá ǀ śruvantu ǀ ádhi ǀ bruvantu ǀ té ǀ avantu ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thePitṛswho are entitled to theSomacome, when invoked by us, to the agreeable treasuresconnected with the sacred grass; let them here listen (to our praises), let them speak (their approbation in reply);let them protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आच्या॒ जानु॑ दक्षिण॒तो नि॒षद्ये॒मं य॒ज्ञम॒भि गृ॑णीत॒ विश्वे॑ । मा हिं॑सिष्ट पितर॒: केन॑ चिन्नो॒ यद्व॒ आग॑: पुरु॒षता॒ करा॑म
shlokas.transliteration: ā-ácya ǀ jā́nu ǀ dakṣiṇatáḥ ǀ ni-sádya ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ abhí ǀ gṛṇīta ǀ víśve ǀmā́ ǀ hiṃsiṣṭa ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ kéna ǀ cit ǀ naḥ ǀ yát ǀ vaḥ ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ puruṣátā ǀ kárāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having sat down on the right side withbended knee, do you all accept this sacrifice. Harm us notPitṛs, for any offence which through human (infirmity) we may have committed towards you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आसी॑नासो अरु॒णीना॑मु॒पस्थे॑ र॒यिं ध॑त्त दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य । पु॒त्रेभ्य॑: पितर॒स्तस्य॒ वस्व॒: प्र य॑च्छत॒ त इ॒होर्जं॑ दधात
shlokas.transliteration: ā́sīnāsaḥ ǀ aruṇī́nām ǀ upá-sthe ǀ rayím ǀ dhatta ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ mártyāya ǀputrébhyaḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ tásya ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ prá ǀ yacchata ǀ té ǀ ihá ǀ ū́rjam ǀ dadhāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seated in the proximity of the radiant (flames of the altar), bestow riches on the mortal donor (of theoblation); give wealth,Pitṛs, to his sons; do you who are present grant us vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये न॒: पूर्वे॑ पि॒तर॑: सो॒म्यासो॑ऽनूहि॒रे सो॑मपी॒थं वसि॑ष्ठाः । तेभि॑र्य॒मः सं॑ररा॒णो ह॒वींष्यु॒शन्नु॒शद्भि॑: प्रतिका॒मम॑त्तु
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ naḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀ anu-ūhiré ǀ soma-pīthám ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ yamáḥ ǀ sam-rarāṇáḥ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ uśán ǀ uśát-bhiḥ ǀ prati-kāmám ǀ attu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayYama, being propitiated, desirous (of the offering), partake at plural asure of the oblations along withthose our ancient progenitors of theSaumyas, the possessors of great wealth, who also desire it, and whoconveyed theSoma(to the gods and to thePitṛs) in order.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ता॑तृ॒षुर्दे॑व॒त्रा जेह॑माना होत्रा॒विद॒: स्तोम॑तष्टासो अ॒र्कैः । आग्ने॑ याहि सुवि॒दत्रे॑भिर॒र्वाङ्स॒त्यैः क॒व्यैः पि॒तृभि॑र्घर्म॒सद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ tatṛṣúḥ ǀ deva-trā́ ǀ jéhamānāḥ ǀ hotrā-vídaḥ ǀ stóma-taṣṭāsaḥ ǀ arkáiḥ ǀā́ ǀ agne ǀ yāhi ǀ su-vidátrebhiḥ ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ satyáiḥ ǀ kavyáiḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ gharmasát-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, to our presence with thePitṛs, who are possessed of knowledge, who having attained aseat among the gods, thirst (for theSoma), skilled in sacrifices, reciters of praises with hymns, truth-speaking,seers, frequenters of sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये स॒त्यासो॑ हवि॒रदो॑ हवि॒ष्पा इन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैः स॒रथं॒ दधा॑नाः । आग्ने॑ याहि स॒हस्रं॑ देवव॒न्दैः परै॒: पूर्वै॑: पि॒तृभि॑र्घर्म॒सद्भि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ satyā́saḥ ǀ haviḥ-ádaḥ ǀ haviḥ-pā́ḥ ǀ índreṇa ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀā́ ǀ agne ǀ yāhi ǀ sahásram ǀ deva-vandáiḥ ǀ páraiḥ ǀ pū́rvaiḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ gharmasát-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, with thousands ofPitṛs, of both past and future (time), frequenters of sacrifices, eulogistsof the gods; those who are true, who feed on oblations, and drink oblations, possessing equality withIndraandthe gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्नि॑ष्वात्ताः पितर॒ एह ग॑च्छत॒ सद॑:सदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः । अ॒त्ता ह॒वींषि॒ प्रय॑तानि ब॒र्हिष्यथा॑ र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं दधातन
shlokas.transliteration: ágni-svāttāḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ gacchata ǀ sádaḥ-sadaḥ ǀ sadata ǀ su-pranītayaḥ ǀattá ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ prá-yatāni ǀ barhíṣi ǀ átha ǀ rayím ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ dadhātana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniṣvāttaPitṛs, come to this solemnity; sit down, directors in the right way, in your appropriateplaces; eat the oblations spread on the grass, and grant us riches andmaleposterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वम॑ग्न ईळि॒तो जा॑तवे॒दोऽवा॑ड्ढ॒व्यानि॑ सुर॒भीणि॑ कृ॒त्वी । प्रादा॑: पि॒तृभ्य॑: स्व॒धया॒ ते अ॑क्षन्न॒द्धि त्वं दे॑व॒ प्रय॑ता ह॒वींषि॑
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ agne ǀ īḷitáḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ ávāṭ ǀ havyā́ni ǀ surabhī́ṇi ǀ kṛtvī́ ǀprá ǀ adāḥ ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ té ǀ akṣan ǀ addhí ǀ tvám ǀ deva ǀ prá-yatā ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AgniJātavedas, who are glorified (by us), having made our oblations fragrant, you have borne themoff, and have presented them to thePitṛs; may they partake of them with theSvadhā; and do you also, divineAgni, feed upon the offered oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये चे॒ह पि॒तरो॒ ये च॒ नेह याँश्च॑ वि॒द्म याँ उ॑ च॒ न प्र॑वि॒द्म । त्वं वे॑त्थ॒ यति॒ ते जा॑तवेदः स्व॒धाभि॑र्य॒ज्ञं सुकृ॑तं जुषस्व
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ca ǀ ihá ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ yé ǀ ca ǀ ná ǀ ihá ǀ yā́n ǀ ca ǀ vidmá ǀ yā́n ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ca ǀ ná ǀ pra-vidmá ǀtvám ǀ vettha ǀ yáti ǀ té ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You know,Jātavedas, thosePitṛs, how many they may be, who are not in this world, those whom weknow, and those whom we do not fully know; enjoy this pious sacrifice offered together withsvadhās.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॑ग्निद॒ग्धा ये अन॑ग्निदग्धा॒ मध्ये॑ दि॒वः स्व॒धया॑ मा॒दय॑न्ते । तेभि॑: स्व॒राळसु॑नीतिमे॒तां य॑थाव॒शं त॒न्वं॑ कल्पयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ agni-dagdhā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ ánagni-dagdhāḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ diváḥ ǀ svadháyā ǀ mādáyante ǀtébhiḥ ǀ sva-rā́ṭ ǀ ásu-nītim ǀ etā́m ǀ yathā-vaśám ǀ tanvám ǀ kalpayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who are agnidagdhas, and those who are not, be satisfied withsvadhāin the midst ofheaven; and do you supreme lord, associated with them, construct at your plural asure that body that is endowedwith breath.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मैन॑मग्ने॒ वि द॑हो॒ माभि शो॑चो॒ मास्य॒ त्वचं॑ चिक्षिपो॒ मा शरी॑रम् । य॒दा शृ॒तं कृ॒णवो॑ जातवे॒दोऽथे॑मेनं॒ प्र हि॑णुतात्पि॒तृभ्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ enam ǀ agne ǀ ví ǀ dahaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ abhí ǀ śocaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ asya ǀ tvácam ǀ cikṣipaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ śárīram ǀyadā́ ǀ śṛtám ǀ kṛṇávaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ átha ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ prá ǀ hiṇutāt ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, consume him not entirely; afflict him not; scatter not (here and there) his skin nor his body; whenJātavedas, you have rendered him mature, then send him to thePitṛs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शृ॒तं य॒दा कर॑सि जातवे॒दोऽथे॑मेनं॒ परि॑ दत्तात्पि॒तृभ्य॑: । य॒दा गच्छा॒त्यसु॑नीतिमे॒तामथा॑ दे॒वानां॑ वश॒नीर्भ॑वाति
shlokas.transliteration: śṛtám ǀ yadā́ ǀ kárasi ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ átha ǀ īm ǀ enam ǀ pári ǀ dattāt ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀyadā́ ǀ gácchāti ǀ ásu-nītim ǀ etā́m ǀ átha ǀ devā́nām ǀ vaśa-nī́ḥ ǀ bhavāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you have rendered him mature, then give him up,Jātavedas, to thePitṛs; when he proceedsto that world of spirits, then he becomes subject to the will of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्यं॒ चक्षु॑र्गच्छतु॒ वात॑मा॒त्मा द्यां च॑ गच्छ पृथि॒वीं च॒ धर्म॑णा । अ॒पो वा॑ गच्छ॒ यदि॒ तत्र॑ ते हि॒तमोष॑धीषु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठा॒ शरी॑रैः
shlokas.transliteration: sū́ryam ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ gacchatu ǀ vā́tam ǀ ātmā́ ǀ dyā́m ǀ ca ǀ gaccha ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ca ǀ dhármaṇā ǀapáḥ ǀ vā ǀ gaccha ǀ yádi ǀ tátra ǀ te ǀ hitám ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ práti ǀ tiṣṭha ǀ śárīraiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the eye repair to the sun; the breath to the wind; go you to the heaven or to the earth, according toyour merit; or go to the waters it it suits you (to be) there, or abide with your members in the plural nts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒जो भा॒गस्तप॑सा॒ तं त॑पस्व॒ तं ते॑ शो॒चिस्त॑पतु॒ तं ते॑ अ॒र्चिः । यास्ते॑ शि॒वास्त॒न्वो॑ जातवेद॒स्ताभि॑र्वहैनं सु॒कृता॑मु लो॒कम्
shlokas.transliteration: ajáḥ ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ tápasā ǀ tám ǀ tapasva ǀ tám ǀ te ǀ śocíḥ ǀ tapatu ǀ tám ǀ te ǀ arcíḥ ǀyā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ śivā́ḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ tā́bhiḥ ǀ vaha ǀ enam ǀ su-kṛ́tām ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The unborn portion; burn that,Agni, with your heat; let your flame, your splendour, consume it; withthose glorious members which you have given him,Jātavedas, bear him to the world (of the virtuous).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ सृज॒ पुन॑रग्ने पि॒तृभ्यो॒ यस्त॒ आहु॑त॒श्चर॑ति स्व॒धाभि॑: । आयु॒र्वसा॑न॒ उप॑ वेतु॒ शेष॒: सं ग॑च्छतां त॒न्वा॑ जातवेदः
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ sṛja ǀ púnaḥ ǀ agne ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ cárati ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀā́yuḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vetu ǀ śéṣaḥ ǀ sám ǀ gacchatām ǀ tanvā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Dismiss again to thePitṛs,Agni, him who offered on you, comes with thesvadhās; putting on(celestial) life, let the remains (of bodily life) depart; let him,Jātavedas, be associated with a body.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ कृ॒ष्णः श॑कु॒न आ॑तु॒तोद॑ पिपी॒लः स॒र्प उ॒त वा॒ श्वाप॑दः । अ॒ग्निष्टद्वि॒श्वाद॑ग॒दं कृ॑णोतु॒ सोम॑श्च॒ यो ब्रा॑ह्म॒णाँ आ॑वि॒वेश॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ kṛṣṇáḥ ǀ śakunáḥ ǀ ā-tutóda ǀ pipīláḥ ǀ sarpáḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ śvā́padaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tát ǀ viśva-át ǀ agadám ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ca ǀ yáḥ ǀ brāhmaṇā́n ǀ ā-vivéśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Should the black crow, the ant, the snake, the wild beast, harm (a limb) of you, mayAgnitheall-devourer, and theSomathat has pervaded thebrāhmaṇas, make it whole.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्वर्म॒ परि॒ गोभि॑र्व्ययस्व॒ सं प्रोर्णु॑ष्व॒ पीव॑सा॒ मेद॑सा च । नेत्त्वा॑ धृ॒ष्णुर्हर॑सा॒ जर्हृ॑षाणो द॒धृग्वि॑ध॒क्ष्यन्प॑र्य॒ङ्खया॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ várma ǀ pári ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ vyayasva ǀ sám ǀ prá ǀ ūrṇuṣva ǀ pī́vasā ǀ médasā ǀ ca ǀná ǀ ít ǀ tvā ǀ dhṛṣṇúḥ ǀ hárasā ǀ járhṛṣāṇaḥ ǀ dadhṛ́k ǀ vi-dhakṣyán ǀ pari-aṅkháyāte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enclose the mail ofAgniwith the (hide of the) cow; cover it with the fat and marrow; then will not(Agni), bold, exulting in his fierce heat, proud, embrace you roundabout to consume you (toashes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मम॑ग्ने चम॒सं मा वि जि॑ह्वरः प्रि॒यो दे॒वाना॑मु॒त सो॒म्याना॑म् । ए॒ष यश्च॑म॒सो दे॑व॒पान॒स्तस्मि॑न्दे॒वा अ॒मृता॑ मादयन्ते
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ agne ǀ camasám ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ jihvaraḥ ǀ priyáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ utá ǀ somyā́nām ǀeṣáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ camasáḥ ǀ deva-pā́naḥ ǀ tásmin ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ mādayante ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, shake not this ladle, for it is dear to the gods and to the (Pitṛs) who are worthy of theSoma; thiswhich is the drinking ladle of the ogds, in this immortal gods delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्र॒व्याद॑म॒ग्निं प्र हि॑णोमि दू॒रं य॒मरा॑ज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवा॒हः । इ॒हैवायमित॑रो जा॒तवे॑दा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन्
shlokas.transliteration: kravya-ádam ǀ agním ǀ prá ǀ hiṇomi ǀ dūrám ǀ yamá-rājñaḥ ǀ gacchatu ǀ ripra-vāháḥ ǀihá ǀ evá ǀ ayám ǀ ítaraḥ ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havyám ǀ vahatu ǀ pra-jānán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I send the flesh-devouringAgnito a distance; let him bearing away sin repair to (the realm of) kingYama; but let this otherJātavedaswho is known (by all) convey the oblation to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्निः क्र॒व्यात्प्र॑वि॒वेश॑ वो गृ॒हमि॒मं पश्य॒न्नित॑रं जा॒तवे॑दसम् । तं ह॑रामि पितृय॒ज्ञाय॑ दे॒वं स घ॒र्ममि॑न्वात्पर॒मे स॒धस्थे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ kravya-át ǀ pra-vivéśa ǀ vaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ imám ǀ páśyan ǀ ítaram ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀtám ǀ harāmi ǀ pitṛ-yajñā́ya ǀ devám ǀ sáḥ ǀ gharmám ǀ invāt ǀ paramé ǀ sadhá-sthe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The flesh-devouring deityAgni, who has entered your dwelling, I turn him out, for the worship of thePitṛs, upon beholding this other (Agni)Jātavedas; let him celebrate the sacrifice (to thePitṛs) in the mostexcellent assembly.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अ॒ग्निः क्र॑व्य॒वाह॑नः पि॒तॄन्यक्ष॑दृता॒वृध॑: । प्रेदु॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वोचति दे॒वेभ्य॑श्च पि॒तृभ्य॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ kravya-vā́hanaḥ ǀ pitṝ́n ǀ yákṣat ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀprá ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ havyā́ni ǀ vocati ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ ca ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “LetAgnithe bearer of theKavyaworship thePitṛs, who are magnified by truth, let him declare whichare the offerings to the gods, which to the Pitṛs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शन्त॑स्त्वा॒ नि धी॑मह्यु॒शन्त॒: समि॑धीमहि । उ॒शन्नु॑श॒त आ व॑ह पि॒तॄन्ह॒विषे॒ अत्त॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: uśántaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ní ǀ dhīmahi ǀ uśántaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhīmahi ǀuśán ǀ uśatáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ pitṝ́n ǀ havíṣe ǀ áttave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Longing we set you down; longing we kindle you; do you longing bring the longingPitṛsto eat of the(sacrificial) viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वम॑ग्ने स॒मद॑ह॒स्तमु॒ निर्वा॑पया॒ पुन॑: । कि॒याम्ब्वत्र॑ रोहतु पाकदू॒र्वा व्य॑ल्कशा
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ sam-ádahaḥ ǀ tám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ níḥ ǀ vāpaya ǀ púnaríti ǀkiyā́mbu ǀ átra ǀ rohatu ǀ pāka-dūrvā́ ǀ ví-alkaśā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Cool again,Agni, the spot which you have burned, there let thewater- lilygrow, and the ripe Durvawith its many stalks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शीति॑के॒ शीति॑कावति॒ ह्लादि॑के॒ ह्लादि॑कावति । म॒ण्डू॒क्या॒३॒॑ सु सं ग॑म इ॒मं स्व१॒॑ग्निं ह॑र्षय
shlokas.transliteration: śī́tike ǀ śī́tikā-vati ǀ hlā́dike ǀ hlā́dikā-vati ǀmaṇḍūkyā́ ǀ sú ǀ sám ǀ gamaḥ ǀ imám ǀ sú ǀ agním ǀ harṣaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Oh earth), cool and filled with cool (herbs), gladsome and filled with gladsome (trees), be throngedwith feminine le frogs and give joy to thisAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टा॑ दुहि॒त्रे व॑ह॒तुं कृ॑णो॒तीती॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं॒ समे॑ति । य॒मस्य॑ मा॒ता प॑र्यु॒ह्यमा॑ना म॒हो जा॒या विव॑स्वतो ननाश
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭā ǀ duhitré ǀ vahatúm ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ íti ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ sám ǀ eti ǀyamásya ǀ mātā́ ǀ pari-uhyámānā ǀ maháḥ ǀ jāyā́ ǀ vívasvataḥ ǀ nanāśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tvaṣṭācelebrates the marriage of his daughter; therefore, the whole world is assembled; but themother ofYama, the newly-married wife of the mightyVivasvat, disappeared.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपा॑गूहन्न॒मृतां॒ मर्त्ये॑भ्यः कृ॒त्वी सव॑र्णामददु॒र्विव॑स्वते । उ॒ताश्विना॑वभर॒द्यत्तदासी॒दज॑हादु॒ द्वा मि॑थु॒ना स॑र॒ण्यूः
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ agūhan ǀ amṛ́tām ǀ mártyebhyaḥ ǀ kṛtvī́ ǀ sá-varṇām ǀ adaduḥ ǀ vívasvate ǀutá ǀ aśvínau ǀ abharat ǀ yát ǀ tát ǀ ā́sīt ǀ ájahāt ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ dvā́ ǀ mithunā́ ǀ saraṇyū́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods concealing the immortal (Sarṇyū) for th esake of mortals and having formed her, gave hertoVivasvat. She bore the twoAśvinswhen this had happened and thenSaraṇyūgave birth to two twins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षा त्वे॒तश्च्या॑वयतु॒ प्र वि॒द्वानन॑ष्टपशु॒र्भुव॑नस्य गो॒पाः । स त्वै॒तेभ्य॒: परि॑ ददत्पि॒तृभ्यो॒ऽग्निर्दे॒वेभ्य॑: सुविद॒त्रिये॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ tvā ǀ itáḥ ǀ cyavayatu ǀ prá ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ánaṣṭa-paśuḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ tvā ǀ etébhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ dadat ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ su-vidatríyebhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the discriminatingPūṣan, whose cattle are never lost, the protector of all beings, transfer youhence (to a better world); may he give you to thesePitṛs; mayAgni(give) you to the beneficent gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आयु॑र्वि॒श्वायु॒: परि॑ पासति त्वा पू॒षा त्वा॑ पातु॒ प्रप॑थे पु॒रस्ता॑त् । यत्रास॑ते सु॒कृतो॒ यत्र॒ ते य॒युस्तत्र॑ त्वा दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता द॑धातु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́yuḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ pári ǀ pāsati ǀ tvā ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ tvā ǀ pātu ǀ prá-pathe ǀ purástāt ǀyátra ǀ ā́sate ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ yátra ǀ té ǀ yayúḥ ǀ tátra ǀ tvā ǀ deváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ dadhātu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the all-pervadingVāyuprotect you, mayPūṣan(preserve) you, (going) first on the excellentpath (to heaven); may the divineSavitāplural ce you, where the virtuous abide, whither they have gone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पू॒षेमा आशा॒ अनु॑ वेद॒ सर्वा॒: सो अ॒स्माँ अभ॑यतमेन नेषत् । स्व॒स्ति॒दा आघृ॑णि॒: सर्व॑वी॒रोऽप्र॑युच्छन्पु॒र ए॑तु प्रजा॒नन्
shlokas.transliteration: pūṣā́ ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ ā́śāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ veda ǀ sárvāḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ábhaya-tamena ǀ neṣat ǀsvasti-dā́ḥ ǀ ā́ghṛṇiḥ ǀ sárva-vīraḥ ǀ ápra-yucchan ǀ puráḥ ǀ etu ǀ pra-jānán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣanknows all these regions severally; met him conduct us by (the path) that is most free fromperil; let him precede us, who is the giver of prosperity, endowed with radiance, accompanied by all pious men,ever vigilant, and knowing our (deserts).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रप॑थे प॒थाम॑जनिष्ट पू॒षा प्रप॑थे दि॒वः प्रप॑थे पृथि॒व्याः । उ॒भे अ॒भि प्रि॒यत॑मे स॒धस्थे॒ आ च॒ परा॑ च चरति प्रजा॒नन्
shlokas.transliteration: prá-pathe ǀ pathā́m ǀ ajaniṣṭa ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ prá-pathe ǀ diváḥ ǀ prá-pathe ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ abhí ǀ priyátame íti priyá-tame ǀ sadhásthe íti sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀ ca ǀ párā ǀ ca ǀ carati ǀ pra-jānán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pūṣanhas been born on the best path of paths, on the best path of heaven on the best path ofearth, he goes forward and backward over both (worlds), the assemblies longed for by all, discriminating (themerits of the dead).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वतीं देव॒यन्तो॑ हवन्ते॒ सर॑स्वतीमध्व॒रे ता॒यमा॑ने । सर॑स्वतीं सु॒कृतो॑ अह्वयन्त॒ सर॑स्वती दा॒शुषे॒ वार्यं॑ दात्
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvatīm ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀ havante ǀ sárasvatīm ǀ adhvaré ǀ tāyámāne ǀsárasvatīm ǀ su-kṛ́taḥ ǀ ahvayanta ǀ sárasvatī ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́ryam ǀ dāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The devout invokeSarasvatī; they worship Sarasvatī at the strewn sacrifice; the virtuous call uponSarasvatī; may Sarasvatī bestow blessings upon the donor (of the oblation).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वति॒ या स॒रथं॑ य॒याथ॑ स्व॒धाभि॑र्देवि पि॒तृभि॒र्मद॑न्ती । आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयस्वानमी॒वा इष॒ आ धे॑ह्य॒स्मे
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvati ǀ yā́ ǀ sa-rátham ǀ yayā́tha ǀ svadhā́bhiḥ ǀ devi ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ mádantī ǀā-sádya ǀ asmín ǀ barhíṣi ǀ mādayasva ǀ anamīvā́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ dhehi ǀ asmé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “DivineSarasvatī, who rides in the same chariot with thePitṛs, and delighted (along with them) by the(sacrificial) viands, seated on the sacred grass gratified (by our offering, and grant us wholesome food. worshippers at this sacrifice a portion of food fit for thousands, and increase of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वतीं॒ यां पि॒तरो॒ हव॑न्ते दक्षि॒णा य॒ज्ञम॑भि॒नक्ष॑माणाः । स॒ह॒स्रा॒र्घमि॒ळो अत्र॑ भा॒गं रा॒यस्पोषं॒ यज॑मानेषु धेहि
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvatīm ǀ yā́m ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ hávante ǀ dakṣiṇā́ ǀ yajñám ǀ abhi-nákṣamāṇāḥ ǀsahasra-arghám ǀ iḷáḥ ǀ átra ǀ bhāgám ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ yájamāneṣu ǀ dhehi ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॑ अ॒स्मान्मा॒तर॑: शुन्धयन्तु घृ॒तेन॑ नो घृत॒प्व॑: पुनन्तु । विश्वं॒ हि रि॒प्रं प्र॒वह॑न्ति दे॒वीरुदिदा॑भ्य॒: शुचि॒रा पू॒त ए॑मि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ śundhayantu ǀ ghṛténa ǀ naḥ ǀ ghṛta-pváḥ ǀ punantu ǀvíśvam ǀ hí ǀ riprám ǀ pra-váhanti ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ út ǀ ít ǀ ābhyaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pūtáḥ ǀ emi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the maternal waters, purify us; may the shedders of water purify us with the effusion; for thedivine (waters) bear away all sin; I come away from them purified (to heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒प्सश्च॑स्कन्द प्रथ॒माँ अनु॒ द्यूनि॒मं च॒ योनि॒मनु॒ यश्च॒ पूर्व॑: । स॒मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ सं॒चर॑न्तं द्र॒प्सं जु॑हो॒म्यनु॑ स॒प्त होत्रा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: drapsáḥ ǀ caskanda ǀ prathamā́n ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ imám ǀ ca ǀ yónim ǀ ánu ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀsamānám ǀ yónim ǀ ánu ǀ sam-cárantam ǀ drapsám ǀ juhomi ǀ ánu ǀ saptá ǀ hótrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomahas risen to the earthly and heavenly (worlds), both this visible world, and that which(existed) before (it); I offer that Soma flowing through the common region (of heaven and earth) after the sacrifice(offered by the) seven (officiating priests).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ द्र॒प्सः स्कन्द॑ति॒ यस्ते॑ अं॒शुर्बा॒हुच्यु॑तो धि॒षणा॑या उ॒पस्था॑त् । अ॒ध्व॒र्योर्वा॒ परि॑ वा॒ यः प॒वित्रा॒त्तं ते॑ जुहोमि॒ मन॑सा॒ वष॑ट्कृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ skándati ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ bāhú-cyutaḥ ǀ dhiṣáṇāyāḥ ǀ upá-sthāt ǀadhvaryóḥ ǀ vā ǀ pári ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ pavítrāt ǀ tám ǀ te ǀ juhomi ǀ mánasā ǀ váṣaṭ-kṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, which escapes (from the hide), your filaments which let fall from thehands(of the priestescape) from the vicinity of the plural nks (of the press), or (from thehand) of theAdhvaryu, or from the filter; I offer itall with my mind (toAgni) with the word vaṣat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ द्र॒प्सः स्क॒न्नो यस्ते॑ अं॒शुर॒वश्च॒ यः प॒रः स्रु॒चा । अ॒यं दे॒वो बृह॒स्पति॒: सं तं सि॑ञ्चतु॒ राध॑से
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ drapsáḥ ǀ skannáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ aṃśúḥ ǀ aváḥ ǀ ca ǀ yáḥ ǀ paráḥ ǀ srucā́ ǀayám ǀ deváḥ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ sám ǀ tám ǀ siñcatu ǀ rā́dhase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your juice and your filaments, (Soma), which escape, and which fall from the ladle on this side or onthat; may this divineBṛhaspatisprinkle it for our enrichment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पय॑स्वती॒रोष॑धय॒: पय॑स्वन्माम॒कं वच॑: । अ॒पां पय॑स्व॒दित्पय॒स्तेन॑ मा स॒ह शु॑न्धत
shlokas.transliteration: páyasvatīḥ ǀ óṣadhayaḥ ǀ páyasvat ǀ māmakám ǀ vácaḥ ǀapā́m ǀ páyasvat ǀ ít ǀ páyaḥ ǀ téna ǀ mā ǀ sahá ǀ śundhata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Waters)! the plural nts flourish by means of water my prayer is effectual through water; the essence ofwater is vigorous through water; purify me with it.”

shlokas.sanskrit: परं॑ मृत्यो॒ अनु॒ परे॑हि॒ पन्थां॒ यस्ते॒ स्व इत॑रो देव॒याना॑त् । चक्षु॑ष्मते शृण्व॒ते ते॑ ब्रवीमि॒ मा न॑: प्र॒जां री॑रिषो॒ मोत वी॒रान्
shlokas.transliteration: páram ǀ mṛtyo íti ǀ ánu ǀ párā ǀ ihi ǀ pánthām ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ sváḥ ǀ ítaraḥ ǀ deva-yā́nāt ǀcákṣuṣmate ǀ śṛṇvaté ǀ te ǀ bravīmi ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ ririṣaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ utá ǀ vīrā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Depart,Mṛtyu, by a different path; by that which is your own, and distinct from the path of the gods; Ispeak to you who have eyes, who have ears; do no harm to our offspring, nor to ourmaleprogeny.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मृ॒त्योः प॒दं यो॒पय॑न्तो॒ यदैत॒ द्राघी॑य॒ आयु॑: प्रत॒रं दधा॑नाः । आ॒प्याय॑मानाः प्र॒जया॒ धने॑न शु॒द्धाः पू॒ता भ॑वत यज्ञियासः
shlokas.transliteration: mṛtyóḥ ǀ padám ǀ yopáyantaḥ ǀ yát ǀ áita ǀ drā́ghīyaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀāpyā́yamānāḥ ǀ pra-jáyā ǀ dhánena ǀ śuddhā́ḥ ǀ pūtā́ḥ ǀ bhavata ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If, avoiding the path of death, you go (on the path of he gods), assuming a longer and better life, (myfriends), then may you, (O sacrificers), diligent in sacrifice, enriched with progeny and affluence, be cleansed andpure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मे जी॒वा वि मृ॒तैराव॑वृत्र॒न्नभू॑द्भ॒द्रा दे॒वहू॑तिर्नो अ॒द्य । प्राञ्चो॑ अगाम नृ॒तये॒ हसा॑य॒ द्राघी॑य॒ आयु॑: प्रत॒रं दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: imé ǀ jīvā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ mṛtáiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ avavṛtran ǀ ábhūt ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ devá-hūtiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀprā́ñcaḥ ǀ agāma ǀ nṛtáye ǀ hásāya ǀ drā́ghīyaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who are living remain separate from the dead; may our invocation of the gods today besuccessful; let us go forward to dancing and laughter, assuming a longer and better life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं जी॒वेभ्य॑: परि॒धिं द॑धामि॒ मैषां॒ नु गा॒दप॑रो॒ अर्थ॑मे॒तम् । श॒तं जी॑वन्तु श॒रद॑: पुरू॒चीर॒न्तर्मृ॒त्युं द॑धतां॒ पर्व॑तेन
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ jīvébhyaḥ ǀ pari-dhím ǀ dadhāmi ǀ mā́ ǀ eṣām ǀ nú ǀ gāt ǀ áparaḥ ǀ ártham ǀ etám ǀśatám ǀ jīvantu ǀ śarádaḥ ǀ purūcī́ḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ mṛtyúm ǀ dadhatām ǀ párvatena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I erect this circle (of stones) for (the protection of) the living, that none other of them may approach thislimit; may they live a hundred years, occupied by many holy works, and keep death hidden by this mound.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथाहा॑न्यनुपू॒र्वं भव॑न्ति॒ यथ॑ ऋ॒तव॑ ऋ॒तुभि॒र्यन्ति॑ सा॒धु । यथा॒ न पूर्व॒मप॑रो॒ जहा॑त्ये॒वा धा॑त॒रायूं॑षि कल्पयैषाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ áhāni ǀ anu-pūrvám ǀ bhávanti ǀ yáthā ǀ ṛtávaḥ ǀ ṛtú-bhiḥ ǀ yánti ǀ sādhú ǀyáthā ǀ ná ǀ pū́rvam ǀ áparaḥ ǀ jáhāti ǀ evá ǀ dhātaḥ ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ kalpaya ǀ eṣā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As days pass along in succession; as season are duly followed by seasons; as the successor doesnot abandon his predecessor, so,Dhātā, support the lives of these (my kinsmen).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रो॑ह॒तायु॑र्ज॒रसं॑ वृणा॒ना अ॑नुपू॒र्वं यत॑माना॒ यति॒ ष्ठ । इ॒ह त्वष्टा॑ सु॒जनि॑मा स॒जोषा॑ दी॒र्घमायु॑: करति जी॒वसे॑ वः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ rohata ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jarásam ǀ vṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ anu-pūrvám ǀ yátamānāḥ ǀ yáti ǀ sthá ǀihá ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ su-jánimā ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ karati ǀ jīváse ǀ vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(You kinsmen of the dead man), choosing old age, attain length of life, striving one after the other, howmany soever you may be; mayTvaṣṭā, the creator.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा नारी॑रविध॒वाः सु॒पत्नी॒राञ्ज॑नेन स॒र्पिषा॒ सं वि॑शन्तु । अ॒न॒श्रवो॑ऽनमी॒वाः सु॒रत्ना॒ आ रो॑हन्त॒ं जन॑यो॒ योनि॒मग्रे॑
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ḥ ǀ nā́rīḥ ǀ avidhavā́ḥ ǀ su-pátnīḥ ǀ ā-áñjanena ǀ sarpíṣā ǀ sám ǀ viśantu ǀanaśrávaḥ ǀ anamīvā́ḥ ǀ su-rátnāḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ rohantu ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ yónim ǀ ágre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let these women who are not widows, who have good husbands, enter (anointed) with unguent andbutter. Let women without tears, without sorrow, and decorated with jewels, first proceed to the house.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उदी॑र्ष्व नार्य॒भि जी॑वलो॒कं ग॒तासु॑मे॒तमुप॑ शेष॒ एहि॑ । ह॒स्त॒ग्रा॒भस्य॑ दिधि॒षोस्तवे॒दं पत्यु॑र्जनि॒त्वम॒भि सं ब॑भूथ
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ īrṣva ǀ nāri ǀ abhí ǀ jīva-lokám ǀ gatá-asum ǀ etám ǀ úpa ǀ śeṣe ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀhasta-grābhásya ǀ didhiṣóḥ ǀ táva ǀ idám ǀ pátyuḥ ǀ jani-tvám ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ babhūtha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Rise, woman, (and go) to the world of living beings; come, this man near whom you sleep is lifeless;you have enjoyed this state of being the wife of your husband, the suitor who took you by the band.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धनु॒र्हस्ता॑दा॒ददा॑नो मृ॒तस्या॒स्मे क्ष॒त्राय॒ वर्च॑से॒ बला॑य । अत्रै॒व त्वमि॒ह व॒यं सु॒वीरा॒ विश्वा॒: स्पृधो॑ अ॒भिमा॑तीर्जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: dhánuḥ ǀ hástāt ǀ ā-dádānaḥ ǀ mṛtásya ǀ asmé íti ǀ kṣatrā́ya ǀ várcase ǀ bálāya ǀátra ǀ evá ǀ tvám ǀ ihá ǀ vayám ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Taking his bow from thehandof the dead man, for the sake of our vigour, energy and strength, (I say)you are there; may we (who are) here, blessed withmaleoffspring, overcome all the enemies who assail us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ सर्प मा॒तरं॒ भूमि॑मे॒तामु॑रु॒व्यच॑सं पृथि॒वीं सु॒शेवा॑म् । ऊर्ण॑म्रदा युव॒तिर्दक्षि॑णावत ए॒षा त्वा॑ पातु॒ निॠ॑तेरु॒पस्था॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ sarpa ǀ mātáram ǀ bhū́mim ǀ etā́m ǀ uru-vyácasam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ su-śévām ǀū́rṇa-mradāḥ ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ dákṣiṇā-vate ǀ eṣā́ ǀ tvā ǀ pātu ǀ níḥ-ṛteḥ ǀ upá-sthāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Go to this your mother-earth, the wide-spread, delightful earth; this virgin (earth is) as soft aswool, tothe liberal (worshipper) may she protect you from the proximity ofNirṛti.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उच्छ्व॑ञ्चस्व पृथिवि॒ मा नि बा॑धथाः सूपाय॒नास्मै॑ भव सूपवञ्च॒ना । मा॒ता पु॒त्रं यथा॑ सि॒चाभ्ये॑नं भूम ऊर्णुहि
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ śvañcasva ǀ pṛthivi ǀ mā́ ǀ ní ǀ bādhathāḥ ǀ su-upāyanā́ ǀ asmai ǀ bhava ǀ su-upavañcanā́ ǀmātā́ ǀ putrám ǀ yáthā ǀ sicā́ ǀ abhí ǀ enam ǀ bhūme ǀ ūrṇuhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Earth, rise up above him; oppress him not; be attentive to him (and) comfortable; cover him up, earth,as a mother covers her child with the skirt of her garment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒च्छ्वञ्च॑माना पृथि॒वी सु ति॑ष्ठतु स॒हस्रं॒ मित॒ उप॒ हि श्रय॑न्ताम् । ते गृ॒हासो॑ घृत॒श्चुतो॑ भवन्तु वि॒श्वाहा॑स्मै शर॒णाः स॒न्त्वत्र॑
shlokas.transliteration: ut-śváñcamānā ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ sú ǀ tiṣṭhatu ǀ sahásram ǀ mítaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ hí ǀ śráyantām ǀté ǀ gṛhā́saḥ ǀ ghṛta-ścútaḥ ǀ bhavantu ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ asmai ǀ śaraṇā́ḥ ǀ santu ǀ átra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bring them back again, render them obedient; mayIndrarestor ethem; mayAgnibring them near.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॑ स्तभ्नामि पृथि॒वीं त्वत्परी॒मं लो॒गं नि॒दध॒न्मो अ॒हं रि॑षम् । ए॒तां स्थूणां॑ पि॒तरो॑ धारयन्तु॒ तेऽत्रा॑ य॒मः साद॑ना ते मिनोतु
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ stabhnāmi ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ tvát ǀ pári ǀ imám ǀ logám ǀ ni-dádhat ǀ mó íti ǀ ahám ǀ riṣam ǀetā́m ǀ sthū́ṇām ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ dhārayantu ǀ te ǀ átra ǀ yamáḥ ǀ sádanā ǀ te ǀ minotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May they come back to me and be fostered under this (their) protector; do youAgni, keep them here;may whatever wealth (there is) remain here.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒ती॒चीने॒ मामह॒नीष्वा॑: प॒र्णमि॒वा द॑धुः । प्र॒तीची॑ध जग्रभा॒ वाच॒मश्वं॑ रश॒नया॑ यथा
shlokas.transliteration: pratīcī́ne ǀ mā́m ǀ áhani ǀ íṣvāḥ ǀ parṇám-iva ǀ ā́ ǀ dadhuḥ ǀpratī́cīm ǀ jagrabha ǀ vā́cam ǀ áśvam ǀ raśanáyā ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I invoke the knowledge of the plural ce, of their going, of their coming, of their departure, of theirwandering, of their returning; (I invoke) him who is their keeper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि व॑र्तध्वं॒ मानु॑ गाता॒स्मान्त्सि॑षक्त रेवतीः । अग्नी॑षोमा पुनर्वसू अ॒स्मे धा॑रयतं र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ vartadhvam ǀ mā́ ǀ ánu ǀ gāta ǀ asmā́n ǀ sisakta ǀ revatīḥ ǀágnīṣomā ǀ punarvasū íti punaḥ-vasū ǀ asmé íti ǀ dhārayatam ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come back; go not elsewhere; abounding in wealth, sprinkle us;AgniandSoma, you who clothe (yourworshippers) again, bestow upon us riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॑रेना॒ नि व॑र्तय॒ पुन॑रेना॒ न्या कु॑रु । इन्द्र॑ एणा॒ नि य॑च्छत्व॒ग्निरे॑ना उ॒पाज॑तु
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ enāḥ ǀ ní ǀ vartaya ǀ púnaḥ ǀ enāḥ ǀ ní ǀ ā́ ǀ kuru ǀíndraḥ ǀ enāḥ ǀ ní ǀ yacchatu ǀ agníḥ ǀ enāḥ ǀ upa-ā́jatu ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॑रे॒ता नि व॑र्तन्ताम॒स्मिन्पु॑ष्यन्तु॒ गोप॑तौ । इ॒हैवाग्ने॒ नि धा॑रये॒ह ति॑ष्ठतु॒ या र॒यिः
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ etā́ḥ ǀ ní ǀ vartantām ǀ asmín ǀ puṣyantu ǀ gó-patau ǀihá ǀ evá ǀ agne ǀ ní ǀ dhāraya ǀ ihá ǀ tiṣṭhatu ǀ yā́ ǀ rayíḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यन्नि॒यानं॒ न्यय॑नं सं॒ज्ञानं॒ यत्प॒राय॑णम् । आ॒वर्त॑नं नि॒वर्त॑नं॒ यो गो॒पा अपि॒ तं हु॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ni-yā́nam ǀ ni-áyanam ǀ sam-jñā́nam ǀ yát ǀ parā-áyanam ǀā-vártanam ǀ ni-vártanam ǀ yáḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ápi ǀ tám ǀ huve ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒दान॒ड्व्यय॑नं॒ य उ॒दान॑ट् प॒राय॑णम् । आ॒वर्त॑नं नि॒वर्त॑न॒मपि॑ गो॒पा नि व॑र्तताम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ut-ā́naṭ ǀ vi-áyanam ǀ yáḥ ǀ ut-ā́naṭ ǀ parā-áyanam ǀā-vártanam ǀ ni-vártanam ǀ ápi ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ní ǀ vartatām ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नि॑वर्त॒ नि व॑र्तय॒ पुन॑र्न इन्द्र॒ गा दे॑हि । जी॒वाभि॑र्भुनजामहै
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ni-varta ǀ ní ǀ vartaya ǀ púnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ dehi ǀjīvā́bhiḥ ǀ bhunajāmahai ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: परि॑ वो वि॒श्वतो॑ दध ऊ॒र्जा घृ॒तेन॒ पय॑सा । ये दे॒वाः के च॑ य॒ज्ञिया॒स्ते र॒य्या सं सृ॑जन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: pári ǀ vaḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ dadhe ǀ ūrjā́ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ páyasā ǀyé ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ké ǀ ca ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ té ǀ rayyā́ ǀ sám ǀ sṛjantu ǀ naḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: आ नि॑वर्तन वर्तय॒ नि नि॑वर्तन वर्तय । भूम्या॒श्चत॑स्रः प्र॒दिश॒स्ताभ्य॑ एना॒ नि व॑र्तय
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ni-vartana ǀ vartaya ǀ ní ǀ ni-vartana ǀ vartaya ǀbhū́myāḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ tā́bhyaḥ ǀ enāḥ ǀ ní ǀ vartaya ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रं नो॒ अपि॑ वातय॒ मन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ naḥ ǀ ápi ǀ vātaya ǀ mánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni), manifest towards us a favourable mind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निमी॑ळे भु॒जां यवि॑ष्ठं शा॒सा मि॒त्रं दु॒र्धरी॑तुम् । यस्य॒ धर्म॒न्त्स्व१॒॑रेनी॑: सप॒र्यन्ति॑ मा॒तुरूध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agním ǀ īḷe ǀ bhujā́m ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ śāsā́ ǀ mitrám ǀ duḥ-dhárītum ǀyásya ǀ dhárman ǀ sváḥ ǀ énīḥ ǀ saparyánti ǀ mātúḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorifyAgni, the youngest of the feeders (on oblations), friendly in counsel, difficult to resist, at whoserite the oblations seek heaven, as (calves) the udder of the mother cow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमा॒सा कृ॒पनी॑ळं भा॒साके॑तुं व॒र्धय॑न्ति । भ्राज॑ते॒ श्रेणि॑दन्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ āsā́ ǀ kṛpá-nīḷam ǀ bhāsā́-ketum ǀ vardháyanti ǀbhrā́jate ǀ śréṇi-dan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He whom (the worshippers) magnify with their mouth, the sustainer of pious works; whose banner isthe light, he shines, bestowing upon them all their desires.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्यो वि॒शां गा॒तुरे॑ति॒ प्र यदान॑ड्दि॒वो अन्ता॑न् । क॒विर॒भ्रं दीद्या॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: aryáḥ ǀ viśā́m ǀ gātúḥ ǀ eti ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ diváḥ ǀ ántān ǀkavíḥ ǀ abhrám ǀ dī́dyānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The refuge of the people, the mover, who, when he moves, penetrates to the ends of the sky; thesage illumining the firmament.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षद्ध॒व्या मानु॑षस्यो॒र्ध्वस्त॑स्था॒वृभ्वा॑ य॒ज्ञे । मि॒न्वन्त्सद्म॑ पु॒र ए॑ति
shlokas.transliteration: juṣát ǀ havyā́ ǀ mā́nuṣasya ǀ ūrdhváḥ ǀ tasthau ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀ yajñé ǀminván ǀ sádma ǀ puráḥ ǀ eti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accepting the oblations (offered) at the sacrifice of the worshipper, he blazes up, with a mighty flame;fixing his abode, he advances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स हि क्षेमो॑ ह॒विर्य॒ज्ञः श्रु॒ष्टीद॑स्य गा॒तुरे॑ति । अ॒ग्निं दे॒वा वाशी॑मन्तम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣémaḥ ǀ havíḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ śruṣṭī́ ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ gātúḥ ǀ eti ǀagním ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vā́śī-mantam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis capable (of protecting all men), he is himself the oblation, and the sacrifice; rapidly indeed doeshis spirit move, the gods come to Agni, who bears the praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञा॒साहं॒ दुव॑ इषे॒ऽग्निं पूर्व॑स्य॒ शेव॑स्य । अद्रे॑: सू॒नुमा॒युमा॑हुः
shlokas.transliteration: yajña-sáham ǀ dúvaḥ ǀ iṣe ǀ agním ǀ pū́rvasya ǀ śévasya ǀádreḥ ǀ sūnúm ǀ āyúm ǀ āhuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who goes to (summon the gods), the bearer of the oblation, whom men call the sow of the stone;him I desire to worship (for the sake) of supreme felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरो॒ ये के चा॒स्मदा विश्वेत्ते वा॒म आ स्यु॑: । अ॒ग्निं ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: náraḥ ǀ yé ǀ ké ǀ ca ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ té ǀ vāmé ǀ ā́ ǀ syuríti syuḥ ǀagním ǀ havíṣā ǀ várdhantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all the men who belong to us be (gratified) in all that is desirable, augmentingAgniwith oblationṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णः श्वे॒तो॑ऽरु॒षो यामो॑ अस्य ब्र॒ध्न ऋ॒ज्र उ॒त शोणो॒ यश॑स्वान् । हिर॑ण्यरूपं॒ जनि॑ता जजान
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇáḥ ǀ śvetáḥ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ yā́maḥ ǀ asya ǀ bradhnáḥ ǀ ṛjráḥ ǀ utá ǀ śóṇaḥ ǀ yáśasvān ǀhíraṇya-rūpam ǀ jánitā ǀ jajāna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His chariot is black, white, red, tawny, dark red, crimson, and glorious; the progenitor of all has givenhim a chariot of gold.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा ते॑ अग्ने विम॒दो म॑नी॒षामूर्जो॑ नपाद॒मृते॑भिः स॒जोषा॑: । गिर॒ आ व॑क्षत्सुम॒तीरि॑या॒न इष॒मूर्जं॑ सुक्षि॒तिं विश्व॒माभा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ vi-madáḥ ǀ manīṣā́m ǀ ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ amṛ́tebhiḥ ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀgíraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vakṣat ǀ su-matī́ḥ ǀ iyānáḥ ǀ íṣam ǀ ū́rjam ǀ su-kṣitím ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́ ǀ abhārítyabhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grandson of strength,Agni, who are gratified by the ambrosial (Viands),Vimada, (desirous of) wisdom,has recited your praises; do you, approaching with a kind intention, bestow upon us food, strength, and aprosperous abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आग्निं न स्ववृ॑क्तिभि॒र्होता॑रं त्वा वृणीमहे । य॒ज्ञाय॑ स्ती॒र्णब॑र्हिषे॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ शी॒रं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषं॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ agním ǀ ná ǀ svávṛkti-bhiḥ ǀ hótāram ǀ tvā ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǀyajñā́ya ǀ stīrṇá-barhiṣe ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ śīrám ǀ pāvaká-śociṣam ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke you now,Agni, invoker (of the gods), with our voluntary (praises) for the sacrifice, at whichthe sacred grass is spread; you, who underlying (all things), who (diffuses) purifying radiance, (we invoke) foryour exhilaration; you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामु॒ ते स्वा॒भुव॑: शु॒म्भन्त्यश्व॑राधसः । वेति॒ त्वामु॑प॒सेच॑नी॒ वि वो॒ मद॒ ऋजी॑तिरग्न॒ आहु॑ति॒र्विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ té ǀ su-ābhúvaḥ ǀ śumbhánti ǀ áśva-rādhasaḥ ǀvéti ǀ tvā́m ǀ upa-sécanī ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ ṛ́jītiḥ ǀ agne ǀ ā́-hutiḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Self-radiant, opulent in horses, they glorify you; the oblation poured out over (you) proceeds in astraight course,Agni, to you for your exhilaration; you are mighy.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे ध॒र्माण॑ आसते जु॒हूभि॑: सिञ्च॒तीरि॑व । कृ॒ष्णा रू॒पाण्यर्जु॑ना॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ विश्वा॒ अधि॒ श्रियो॑ धिषे॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ dharmā́ṇaḥ ǀ āsate ǀ juhū́bhiḥ ǀ siñcatī́ḥ-iva ǀkṛṣṇā́ ǀ rūpā́ṇi ǀ árjunā ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ dhiṣe ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The establishers (of the rite) worship you with their ladles (filled with the oblation), like (earth)sprinkling (showers); you sustain exceedingly black forms and white and all beauties for your exhilaration; youare mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने॒ मन्य॑से र॒यिं सह॑सावन्नमर्त्य । तमा नो॒ वाज॑सातये॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ चि॒त्रमा भ॑रा॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ agne ǀ mányase ǀ rayím ǀ sáhasā-van ǀ amartya ǀtám ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ citrám ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful and immortalAgni, bring to us, for our sustenance, the precious wealth which you think best;(bring it) for your exhilaration at the sacrifices; you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्जा॒तो अथ॑र्वणा वि॒दद्विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑ । भुव॑द्दू॒तो वि॒वस्व॑तो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ प्रि॒यो य॒मस्य॒ काम्यो॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ átharvaṇā ǀ vidát ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyā ǀbhúvat ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ priyáḥ ǀ yamásya ǀ kā́myaḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, genitive rated byAtharvan, is cognizant of all praises; he is the messenger ofVivasvat, the belovedfriend ofYama, for your exhilaration; you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां य॒ज्ञेष्वी॑ळ॒तेऽग्ने॑ प्रय॒त्य॑ध्व॒रे । त्वं वसू॑नि॒ काम्या॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ विश्वा॑ दधासि दा॒शुषे॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ īḷate ǀ ágne ǀ pra-yatí ǀ adhvaré ǀtvám ǀ vásūni ǀ kā́myā ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ víśvā ǀ dadhāsi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The men establish you,Agni, at sacrifices, the ministrant priest, graceful, whose face shines withbutter, radiant, most intelligent with your eyes, for your exhilaration; (hence) you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां य॒ज्ञेष्वृ॒त्विजं॒ चारु॑मग्ने॒ नि षे॑दिरे । घृ॒तप्र॑तीकं॒ मनु॑षो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ शु॒क्रं चेति॑ष्ठम॒क्षभि॒र्विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñéṣu ǀ ṛtvíjam ǀ cā́rum ǀ agne ǀ ní ǀ sedire ǀghṛtá-pratīkam ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ śukrám ǀ cétiṣṭham ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, you, the mighty one, are known far and wide by your radiant lustre; bellowing, you rush like abull, you impregnate the sister (plural nts) in your exhilaration; you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषो॒रु प्र॑थयसे बृ॒हत् । अ॒भि॒क्रन्द॑न्वृषायसे॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ गर्भं॑ दधासि जा॒मिषु॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ urú ǀ prathayase ǀ bṛhát ǀabhi-krándan ǀ vṛṣa-yase ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ gárbham ǀ dadhāsi ǀ jāmíṣu ǀ vívakṣase ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: कुह॑ श्रु॒त इन्द्र॒: कस्मि॑न्न॒द्य जने॑ मि॒त्रो न श्रू॑यते । ऋषी॑णां वा॒ यः क्षये॒ गुहा॑ वा॒ चर्कृ॑षे गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: kúha ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ kásmin ǀ adyá ǀ jáne ǀ mitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ śrūyate ǀṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ vā ǀ yáḥ ǀ kṣáye ǀ gúhā ǀ vā ǀ cárkṛṣe ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In what plural ce today isIndrarenowned? In what nation is he famed likeMitra? (Indra), who isworshipper; or in secret = or, in the forest].”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ह श्रु॒त इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मे अ॒द्य स्तवे॑ व॒ज्र्यृची॑षमः । मि॒त्रो न यो जने॒ष्वा यश॑श्च॒क्रे असा॒म्या
shlokas.transliteration: ihá ǀ śrutáḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ adyá ǀ stáve ǀ vajrī́ ǀ ṛ́cīṣamaḥ ǀmitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ yáśaḥ ǀ cakré ǀ ásāmi ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Here isIndrarenowned; today he is praised by us, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the deserving ofpraise; he who, likeMitra, bestows upon men unequalled abundance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हो यस्पति॒: शव॑सो॒ असा॒म्या म॒हो नृ॒म्णस्य॑ तूतु॒जिः । भ॒र्ता वज्र॑स्य धृ॒ष्णोः पि॒ता पु॒त्रमि॑व प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: maháḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ śávasaḥ ǀ ásāmi ǀ ā́ ǀ maháḥ ǀ nṛmṇásya ǀ tūtujíḥ ǀbhartā́ ǀ vájrasya ǀ dhṛṣṇóḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ putrám-iva ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(MayIndraprotect us) who is the lord of great strenght, of unequalled (power), the distributor of greatwealth, the cherisher of the dreadful thunderbolt as a father (cherishes) a dear son.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒जा॒नो अश्वा॒ वात॑स्य॒ धुनी॑ दे॒वो दे॒वस्य॑ वज्रिवः । स्यन्ता॑ प॒था वि॒रुक्म॑ता सृजा॒नः स्तो॒ष्यध्व॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: yujānáḥ ǀ áśvā ǀ vā́tasya ǀ dhúnī íti ǀ deváḥ ǀ devásya ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀsyántā ǀ pathā́ ǀ virúkmatā ǀ sṛjānáḥ ǀ stoṣi ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thunderer, you who are divine, yoking your horses which are swifter than the divine wind, and glidingalong the resplendent road, you, opening out the way (to battle), are glorified.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं त्या चि॒द्वात॒स्याश्वागा॑ ऋ॒ज्रा त्मना॒ वह॑ध्यै । ययो॑र्दे॒वो न मर्त्यो॑ य॒न्ता नकि॑र्वि॒दाय्य॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tyā́ ǀ cit ǀ vā́tasya ǀ áśvā ǀ ā́ ǀ agāḥ ǀ ṛjrā́ ǀ tmánā ǀ váhadhyai ǀyáyoḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ná ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ yantā́ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ vidā́yyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have come to these two horses (which have the speed) of the wind, straight-going, for them todraw you of themselves, whom no deity, no mortal is able to restrain; whose fleetness no one comprehends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ ग्मन्तो॒शना॑ पृच्छते वां॒ कद॑र्था न॒ आ गृ॒हम् । आ ज॑ग्मथुः परा॒काद्दि॒वश्च॒ ग्मश्च॒ मर्त्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ gmántā ǀ uśánā ǀ pṛcchate ǀ vām ǀ kát-arthā ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gṛhám ǀā́ ǀ jagmathuḥ ǀ parākā́t ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ mártyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Uśanasinquires of youu two as you pass, "(Why) have you come to (our dwelling) from a distance;from heaven and earth to a mortal?"”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ न॑ इन्द्र पृक्षसे॒ऽस्माकं॒ ब्रह्मोद्य॑तम् । तत्त्वा॑ याचाम॒हेऽव॒: शुष्णं॒ यद्धन्नमा॑नुषम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ pṛkṣase ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bráhma ǀ út-yatam ǀtát ǀ tvā ǀ yācāmahe ǀ ávaḥ ǀ śúṣṇam ǀ yát ǀ hán ǀ ámānuṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Indra, the oblation upraised by us; we solicit of you that protection by which you did slay thenon-human Suṣṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒क॒र्मा दस्यु॑र॒भि नो॑ अम॒न्तुर॒न्यव्र॑तो॒ अमा॑नुषः । त्वं तस्या॑मित्रह॒न्वध॑र्दा॒सस्य॑ दम्भय
shlokas.transliteration: akarmā́ ǀ dásyuḥ ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ amantúḥ ǀ anyá-vrataḥ ǀ ámānuṣaḥ ǀtvám ǀ tásya ǀ amitra-han ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ dāsásya ǀ dambhaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheDasyupractising no religious rites, not knowing as thoroughly, following other observances,obeying no human laws, baffle, destroyer of enemies, the weapon of that slave.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑ इन्द्र शूर॒ शूरै॑रु॒त त्वोता॑सो ब॒र्हणा॑ । पु॒रु॒त्रा ते॒ वि पू॒र्तयो॒ नव॑न्त क्षो॒णयो॑ यथा
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ śū́raiḥ ǀ utá ǀ tvā́-ūtāsaḥ ǀ barháṇā ǀpuru-trā́ ǀ te ǀ ví ǀ pūrtáyaḥ ǀ návanta ǀ kṣoṇáyaḥ ǀ yathā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, withh the hero (Marutsdefend) us; that protected by you (we may be able) to overcome(our enemies); your blessings are diffused among many (praisers), as men (repair to their lord).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं तान्वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॑ चोदयो॒ नॄन्का॑र्पा॒णे शू॑र वज्रिवः । गुहा॒ यदी॑ कवी॒नां वि॒शां नक्ष॑त्रशवसाम्
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ tā́n ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ codayaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ kārpāṇé ǀ śūra ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀgúhā ǀ yádi ǀ kavīnā́m ǀ viśā́m ǀ nákṣatra-śavasām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, you have animated those chiefs (theMaruts) to the slaughterofVṛtrain battle, when (you hear) the mystical (praises) of the sages, the worshippers praising the might of theconstellations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू ता त॑ इन्द्र दा॒नाप्न॑स आक्षा॒णे शू॑र वज्रिवः । यद्ध॒ शुष्ण॑स्य द॒म्भयो॑ जा॒तं विश्वं॑ स॒याव॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ dāná-apnasaḥ ǀ ākṣāṇé ǀ śūra ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǀyát ǀ ha ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ dambháyaḥ ǀ jātám ǀ víśvam ǀ sayā́va-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, (your worshippers glorify) those prompt exploits performed by you in battle, (by you whoare) ever bountiful, when with your associate (Maruts) you destroyed the whole race oŚuṣṇa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माकु॒ध्र्य॑गिन्द्र शूर॒ वस्वी॑र॒स्मे भू॑वन्न॒भिष्ट॑यः । व॒यंव॑यं त आसां सु॒म्ने स्या॑म वज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ akudhryák ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ vásvīḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhūvan ǀ abhíṣṭayaḥ ǀvayám-vayam ǀ te ǀ āsām ǀ sumné ǀ syāma ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hero,Indra, let not our manifold sacrifices be unavailing, but may we all, thunderer, (through) your(favour) continue in the fruiton of these (our desires).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे ता त॑ इन्द्र सन्तु स॒त्याहिं॑सन्तीरुप॒स्पृश॑: । वि॒द्याम॒ यासां॒ भुजो॑ धेनू॒नां न व॑ज्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: asmé íti ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ santu ǀ satyā́ ǀ áhiṃsantīḥ ǀ upa-spṛ́śaḥ ǀvidyā́ma ǀ yā́sām ǀ bhújaḥ ǀ dhenūnā́m ǀ ná ǀ vajri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May these our (praises) reaching you,Indra, be successful, doing no detriment (to you), so that,thunderer, we may obtain the benefits derivable from them, as (a cowherd enjoys those) from the kine.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ह॒स्ता यद॒पदी॒ वर्ध॑त॒ क्षाः शची॑भिर्वे॒द्याना॑म् । शुष्णं॒ परि॑ प्रदक्षि॒णिद्वि॒श्वाय॑वे॒ नि शि॑श्नथः
shlokas.transliteration: ahastā́ ǀ yát ǀ apádī ǀ várdhata ǀ kṣā́ḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ vedyā́nām ǀśúṣṇam ǀ pári ǀ pra-dakṣiṇít ǀ viśvá-āyave ǀ ní ǀ śiśnathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the earth which has neitherhandsnor feet flourished throught the acts of (devotion paid to) theadorable (deities), then you did smite downŚuṣṇa, circumambulating it on the right, for the sake ofViśvāyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॑पि॒बेदि॑न्द्र शूर॒ सोमं॒ मा रि॑षण्यो वसवान॒ वसु॒: सन् । उ॒त त्रा॑यस्व गृण॒तो म॒घोनो॑ म॒हश्च॑ रा॒यो रे॒वत॑स्कृधी नः
shlokas.transliteration: píba-piba ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ sómam ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣaṇyaḥ ǀ vasavāna ǀ vásuḥ ǀ sán ǀutá ǀ trāyasva ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ca ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ revátaḥ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink, heroIndra, drink theSoma; being excellent, harm (us) not, possessor of opulence; preservethose who praise you, and are affluent (in offerings), and render us rich with great riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यजा॑मह॒ इन्द्रं॒ वज्र॑दक्षिणं॒ हरी॑णां र॒थ्यं१॒॑ विव्र॑तानाम् । प्र श्मश्रु॒ दोधु॑वदू॒र्ध्वथा॑ भू॒द्वि सेना॑भि॒र्दय॑मानो॒ वि राध॑सा
shlokas.transliteration: yájāmahe ǀ índram ǀ vájra-dakṣiṇam ǀ hárīṇām ǀ rathyám ǀ ví-vratānām ǀprá ǀ śmáśru ǀ dódhuvat ǀ ūrdhvá-thā ǀ bhūt ǀ ví ǀ sénābhiḥ ǀ dáyamānaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rā́dhasā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We worshipIndra, being in his righthandthe thunderbolt, the driver of the bay horses which havemany functions; shaking his beard, he mounts on high, destroying (his enemies) by his armies he gives wealth (tohis worshippers).”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरी॒ न्व॑स्य॒ या वने॑ वि॒दे वस्विन्द्रो॑ म॒घैर्म॒घवा॑ वृत्र॒हा भु॑वत् । ऋ॒भुर्वाज॑ ऋभु॒क्षाः प॑त्यते॒ शवोऽव॑ क्ष्णौमि॒ दास॑स्य॒ नाम॑ चित्
shlokas.transliteration: hárī íti ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ yā́ ǀ váne ǀ vidé ǀ vásu ǀ índraḥ ǀ magháiḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ bhuvat ǀṛbhúḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ patyate ǀ śávaḥ ǀ áva ǀ kṣṇaumi ǀ dā́sasya ǀ nā́ma ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With his two bay horses which bestow riches at the sacrifice,Indra, wealthy with wealth, is the slayerofVṛtra; the brilliant, powerful, mighty Indra is the lord of strength; (through him) I cut off the head of theDāsa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒दा वज्रं॒ हिर॑ण्य॒मिदथा॒ रथं॒ हरी॒ यम॑स्य॒ वह॑तो॒ वि सू॒रिभि॑: । आ ति॑ष्ठति म॒घवा॒ सन॑श्रुत॒ इन्द्रो॒ वाज॑स्य दी॒र्घश्र॑वस॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yadā́ ǀ vájram ǀ híraṇyam ǀ ít ǀ átha ǀ rátham ǀ hárī íti ǀ yám ǀ asya ǀ váhataḥ ǀ ví ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀā́ ǀ tiṣṭhati ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sána-śrutaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ vā́jasya ǀ dīrghá-śravasaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When he grasps his golden thunderbolt, then the opulentIndraascends with his praisers, the chariotwhich his two bay horses draw, (Indra) the lord of long-celebrated and widely-renowned food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो चि॒न्नु वृ॒ष्टिर्यू॒थ्या॒३॒॑ स्वा सचाँ॒ इन्द्र॒: श्मश्रू॑णि॒ हरि॑ता॒भि प्रु॑ष्णुते । अव॑ वेति सु॒क्षयं॑ सु॒ते मधूदिद्धू॑नोति॒ वातो॒ यथा॒ वन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: só íti ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ yūthyā́ ǀ svā́ ǀ sácā ǀ índraḥ ǀ śmáśrūṇi ǀ háritā ǀ abhí ǀ pruṣṇute ǀáva ǀ veti ǀ su-kṣáyam ǀ suté ǀ mádhu ǀ út ǀ ít ǀ dhūnoti ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ vánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the rain (bedews all), so,Indra, accompanied by his troops (of theMaruts), sprinkles their beards,with the green (Soma); he repairs to the plural asant chamber (of sacrifice); (the Soma) beign effused, the sweetSoma agitates (his frame), as the breeze (shakes) the forest.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो वा॒चा विवा॑चो मृ॒ध्रवा॑चः पु॒रू स॒हस्राशि॑वा ज॒घान॑ । तत्त॒दिद॑स्य॒ पौंस्यं॑ गृणीमसि पि॒तेव॒ यस्तवि॑षीं वावृ॒धे शव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ vācā́ ǀ ví-vācaḥ ǀ mṛdhrá-vācaḥ ǀ purú ǀ sahásrā ǀ áśivā ǀ jaghā́na ǀtát-tat ǀ ít ǀ asya ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ gṛṇīmasi ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ yáḥ ǀ táviṣīm ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ śávaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We praise his manhood, who, having by his voice alone made the many- tongued speechless has slainmany thousand enemies, who supports the strength (of the world) as a father the strength (of his son).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तोमं॑ त इन्द्र विम॒दा अ॑जीजन॒न्नपू॑र्व्यं पुरु॒तम॑ा सु॒दान॑वे । वि॒द्मा ह्य॑स्य॒ भोज॑नमि॒नस्य॒ यदा प॒शुं न गो॒पाः क॑रामहे
shlokas.transliteration: stómam ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ vi-madā́ḥ ǀ ajījanan ǀ ápūrvyam ǀ puru-támam ǀ su-dā́nave ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ bhójanam ǀ inásya ǀ yát ǀ ā́ ǀ paśúm ǀ ná ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ karāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WeVimadas, have genitive rated this your unprecedented, and most varied praise,Indra, to obtain yourbounty; as we know what the opulence of that lord is, (therefore) we call it (before us), as a cowherd (calls) hiscattle. attachment, divine (Indra), to be like that of a sister (to a brother) so may the friendship between us and youprosper.”

shlokas.sanskrit: माकि॑र्न ए॒ना स॒ख्या वि यौ॑षु॒स्तव॑ चेन्द्र विम॒दस्य॑ च॒ ऋषे॑: । वि॒द्मा हि ते॒ प्रम॑तिं देव जामि॒वद॒स्मे ते॑ सन्तु स॒ख्या शि॒वानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: mā́kiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ ví ǀ yauṣuḥ ǀ táva ǀ ca ǀ indra ǀ vi-madásya ǀ ca ǀ ṛ́ṣeḥ ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ prá-matim ǀ deva ǀ jāmi-vát ǀ asmé íti ǀ te ǀ santu ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ śivā́ni ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ सोम॑मि॒मं पि॑ब॒ मधु॑मन्तं च॒मू सु॒तम् । अ॒स्मे र॒यिं नि धा॑रय॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ सह॒स्रिणं॑ पुरूवसो॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ sómam ǀ imám ǀ piba ǀ mádhu-mantam ǀ camū́ íti ǀ sutám ǀasmé íti ǀ rayím ǀ ní ǀ dhāraya ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ puruvaso íti puru-vaso ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, this most sweetSoma, expressed by the plural nks (of the Soma-press), then bestow uponus riches in your exhilaration; thousandfold (riches), lord of infinite wealth; you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां य॒ज्ञेभि॑रु॒क्थैरुप॑ ह॒व्येभि॑रीमहे । शची॑पते शचीनां॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ श्रेष्ठं॑ नो धेहि॒ वार्यं॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ yajñébhiḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ úpa ǀ havyébhiḥ ǀ īmahe ǀśácī-pate ǀ śacīnām ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ śréṣṭham ǀ naḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ vā́ryam ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We solicit you with sacrifices, with prayers, with oblations; lord of all pious acts, grant us in yourexhilaration, excellent and desirable (affluence); you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्पति॒र्वार्या॑णा॒मसि॑ र॒ध्रस्य॑ चोदि॒ता । इन्द्र॑ स्तोतॄ॒णाम॑वि॒ता वि वो॒ मदे॑ द्वि॒षो न॑: पा॒ह्यंह॑सो॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ pátim ǀ vā́ryāṇām ǀ ási ǀ radhrásya ǀ coditā́ ǀíndra ǀ stotṝṇā́m ǀ avitā́ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ dviṣáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, who are the lord of desirable (riches), the encourager of the worshipper, the protector of theeulogists, defend us, in your exhilaration, from adversaries, (guard us) from sin, you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श॑क्रा माया॒विना॑ समी॒ची निर॑मन्थतम् । वि॒म॒देन॒ यदी॑ळि॒ता नास॑त्या नि॒रम॑न्थतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śakrā ǀ māyā-vínā ǀ samīcī́ íti sam-īcī́ ǀ níḥ ǀ amanthatam ǀvi-madéna ǀ yát ǀ īḷitā́ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ niḥ-ámanthatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Powerful and sagacious (Aśvins) mutually associated, you have churned forth (the fire); when you,Nāsatyās, glorified byVimada, have churned it forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृपन्त समी॒च्योर्नि॒ष्पत॑न्त्योः । नास॑त्यावब्रुवन्दे॒वाः पुन॒रा व॑हता॒दिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛpanta ǀ sam-īcyóḥ ǀ niḥ-pátantyoḥ ǀnā́satyau ǀ abruvan ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vahatāt ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All the gods praised you as you were mutually associated, and caused (the sparks) to fly up; the godshave said to the twoNāsatyās, "let the fire again bear (us oblations)"].”

shlokas.sanskrit: मधु॑मन्मे प॒राय॑णं॒ मधु॑म॒त्पुन॒राय॑नम् । ता नो॑ देवा दे॒वत॑या यु॒वं मधु॑मतस्कृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: mádhu-mat ǀ me ǀ parā-áyanam ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ púnaḥ ǀ ā́-áyanam ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ devā ǀ devátayā ǀ yuvám ǀ mádhu-mataḥ ǀ kṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May my going forth be plural asant, may my coming back be plural asant, you two divineAśvins, render us,through your divine power, possessed of plural asure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भ॒द्रं नो॒ अपि॑ वातय॒ मनो॒ दक्ष॑मु॒त क्रतु॑म् । अधा॑ ते स॒ख्ये अन्ध॑सो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ रण॒न्गावो॒ न यव॑से॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: bhadrám ǀ naḥ ǀ ápi ǀ vātaya ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ utá ǀ krátum ǀádha ǀ te ǀ sakhyé ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ ráṇan ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yávase ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Sanctify (Soma) our mind, our heart, our intellect; and may (your worshippers) delight in yourfriendship, like cattle in fresh pasture, in your exhilaration (produced) by the (sacrificial) food; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हृ॒दि॒स्पृश॑स्त आसते॒ विश्वे॑षु सोम॒ धाम॑सु । अधा॒ कामा॑ इ॒मे मम॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ वि ति॑ष्ठन्ते वसू॒यवो॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: hṛdi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ te ǀ āsate ǀ víśveṣu ǀ soma ǀ dhā́ma-su ǀádha ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ imé ǀ máma ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhante ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They who seek to touch your heart,Soma, worship you in all plural ces; and these desires for wealth risefrom my heart at your exhilaration; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त व्र॒तानि॑ सोम ते॒ प्राहं मि॑नामि पा॒क्या॑ । अधा॑ पि॒तेव॑ सू॒नवे॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ मृ॒ळा नो॑ अ॒भि चि॑द्व॒धाद्विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vratā́ni ǀ soma ǀ te ǀ prá ǀ ahám ǀ mināmi ǀ pākyā́ ǀádha ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ sūnáve ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ mṛḷá ǀ naḥ ǀ abhí ǀ cit ǀ vadhā́t ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Soma, I practise all your observances with fullness; and as a father to his son, so do you inyour exhilaration make us happy; protect us from being killed (by our enemies); for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समु॒ प्र य॑न्ति धी॒तय॒: सर्गा॑सोऽव॒ताँ इ॑व । क्रतुं॑ नः सोम जी॒वसे॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ धा॒रया॑ चम॒साँ इ॑व॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ sárgāsaḥ ǀ avatā́n-iva ǀkrátum ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ jīváse ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ dhāráya ǀ camasā́n-iva ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our praises converge (Soma) towards you, as herds towards a well; establish our pious acts, Soma,for us to live (long), as (the priest sets up) the cups for your exhilaration; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्ये सो॑म॒ शक्ति॑भि॒र्निका॑मासो॒ व्यृ॑ण्विरे । गृत्स॑स्य॒ धीरा॑स्त॒वसो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विनं॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ soma ǀ śákti-bhiḥ ǀ ní-kāmāsaḥ ǀ ví ǀ ṛṇvire ǀgṛ́tsasya ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ tavásaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The intelligent (priests), whose desires are fixed (on the fruit of good works), with sacred rites showforth (the praises) of you,Soma, who are wise and powerful; do you, in your exhilaration, (grant us) pastures,abounding with cattle, and with horses; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒शुं न॑: सोम रक्षसि पुरु॒त्रा विष्ठि॑तं॒ जग॑त् । स॒माकृ॑णोषि जी॒वसे॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ विश्वा॑ स॒म्पश्य॒न्भुव॑ना॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: paśúm ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ rakṣasi ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ ví-sthitam ǀ jágat ǀsam-ā́kṛṇoṣi ǀ jīváse ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ víśvā ǀ sam-páśyan ǀ bhúvanā ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You protect our cattle,Soma, and the variously occupied world, contemplating all existing beings; youprepare (the world) for them to live in for your exhilaration; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: सोम वि॒श्वतो॑ गो॒पा अदा॑भ्यो भव । सेध॑ राज॒न्नप॒ स्रिधो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ मा नो॑ दु॒:शंस॑ ईशता॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǀ bhava ǀsédha ǀ rājan ǀ ápa ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-śáṃsaḥ ǀ īśata ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be on all sides our preserver,Soma, you, who are unassailable; drive away, monarch, our adversariesin your exhilaration, and let no calumniator rule over us; for you are mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं न॑: सोम सु॒क्रतु॑र्वयो॒धेया॑य जागृहि । क्षे॒त्र॒वित्त॑रो॒ मनु॑षो॒ वि वो॒ मदे॑ द्रु॒हो न॑: पा॒ह्यंह॑सो॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ vayaḥ-dhéyāya ǀ jāgṛhi ǀkṣetravít-taraḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ druháḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pāhi ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, author of good works, liberal granter of fields, be vigilant in supplying us with food; and in your”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ वृत्रहन्त॒मेन्द्र॑स्येन्दो शि॒वः सखा॑ । यत्सीं॒ हव॑न्ते समि॒थे वि वो॒ मदे॒ युध्य॑मानास्तो॒कसा॑तौ॒ विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ vṛtrahan-tama ǀ índrasya ǀ indo íti ǀ śiváḥ ǀ sákhā ǀyát ǀ sīm ǀ hávante ǀ sam-ithé ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ yúdhyamānāḥ ǀ toká-sātau ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Utter destroyer of enemies,Soma, who are the auspicious friend ofIndra, (protect us), when hostilewarriors everywhere call us to the combat that bestows offsprin; by your exhilration (preserve us); for you aremighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं घ॒ स तु॒रो मद॒ इन्द्र॑स्य वर्धत प्रि॒यः । अ॒यं क॒क्षीव॑तो म॒हो वि वो॒ मदे॑ म॒तिं विप्र॑स्य वर्धय॒द्विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ gha ǀ sáḥ ǀ turáḥ ǀ mádaḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ vardhata ǀ priyáḥ ǀayám ǀ kakṣī́vataḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ matím ǀ víprasya ǀ vardhayat ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Such is theSomawhich, swiftly moving, exhilarating, acceptable toIndra, has given increase (to ourunderstanding); it has increased the intelligence of the great and piousKakṣīvatin your exhilaration; for youare mighty.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं विप्रा॑य दा॒शुषे॒ वाजाँ॑ इयर्ति॒ गोम॑तः । अ॒यं स॒प्तभ्य॒ आ वरं॒ वि वो॒ मदे॒ प्रान्धं श्रो॒णं च॑ तारिष॒द्विव॑क्षसे
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ víprāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ vā́jān ǀ iyarti ǀ gó-mataḥ ǀayám ǀ saptá-bhyaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ váram ǀ ví ǀ vaḥ ǀ máde ǀ prá ǀ andhám ǀ śroṇám ǀ ca ǀ tāriṣat ǀ vívakṣase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisSomabestows, upon the pious donor of the libation, food with cattle; it gives wealth to the seven(priests) in the manifold exhilaration; it has restored (their faculties) to the blind, and the lame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ह्यच्छा॑ मनी॒षा स्पा॒र्हा यन्ति॑ नि॒युत॑: । प्र द॒स्रा नि॒युद्र॑थः पू॒षा अ॑विष्टु॒ माहि॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hí ǀ áccha ǀ manīṣā́ḥ ǀ spārhā́ḥ ǀ yánti ǀ ni-yútaḥ ǀprá ǀ dasrā́ ǀ niyút-rathaḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ aviṣṭu ǀ mā́hinaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since our appointed and acceptable prayers proceed to him, may the mightyPūṣan, of plural asingaspect, whose care is ever harnessed, protect us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्यन्म॑हि॒त्वं वा॒ताप्य॑म॒यं जन॑: । विप्र॒ आ वं॑सद्धी॒तिभि॒श्चिके॑त सुष्टुती॒नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tyát ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ vātā́pyam ǀ ayám ǀ jánaḥ ǀvípraḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vaṃsat ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ cíketa ǀ su-stutīnā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(May e) whose greatness (manifested as) the matured rain, this pious man celebrates with piousrites-- may he be cognizant of such excellent praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स वे॑द सुष्टुती॒नामिन्दु॒र्न पू॒षा वृषा॑ । अ॒भि प्सुर॑: प्रुषायति व्र॒जं न॒ आ प्रु॑षायति
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ veda ǀ su-stutīnā́m ǀ índuḥ ǀ ná ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀabhí ǀ psúraḥ ǀ pruṣāyati ǀ vrajám ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ pruṣāyati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He,Pūṣan, is cognizant of such excellent praises; likeSomahe is the showerer (of benefits); thegraceful deity rains down upon us, he rains upon our cow-pastures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मं॒सी॒महि॑ त्वा व॒यम॒स्माकं॑ देव पूषन् । म॒ती॒नां च॒ साध॑नं॒ विप्रा॑णां चाध॒वम्
shlokas.transliteration: maṃsīmáhi ǀ tvā ǀ vayám ǀ asmā́kam ǀ deva ǀ pūṣan ǀmatīnā́m ǀ ca ǀ sā́dhanam ǀ víprāṇām ǀ ca ǀ ā-dhavám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We glorify you, divinePūṣan, the accomplisher of our desires, who make the pious to quake.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॑र्धिर्य॒ज्ञाना॑मश्वह॒यो रथा॑नाम् । ऋषि॒: स यो मनु॑र्हितो॒ विप्र॑स्य यावयत्स॒खः
shlokas.transliteration: práti-ardhiḥ ǀ yajñā́nām ǀ aśva-hayáḥ ǀ ráthānām ǀṛ́ṣiḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ mánuḥ-hitaḥ ǀ víprasya ǀ yavayat-sakháḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒धीष॑माणाया॒: पति॑: शु॒चाया॑श्च शु॒चस्य॑ च । वा॒सो॒वा॒योऽवी॑ना॒मा वासां॑सि॒ मर्मृ॑जत्
shlokas.transliteration: ā-dhī́ṣamāṇāyāḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ śucā́yāḥ ǀ ca ǀ śucásya ǀ ca ǀvāsaḥ-vāyáḥ ǀ ávīnām ǀ ā́ ǀ vā́sāṃsi ǀ mármṛjat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord both of the pure desirable (she-goat), and of the pure (he-goat); weave3r of the cloth (of thewool) of the sheep; he has cleansed the vestments.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒नो वाजा॑नां॒ पति॑रि॒नः पु॑ष्टी॒नां सखा॑ । प्र श्मश्रु॑ हर्य॒तो दू॑धो॒द्वि वृथा॒ यो अदा॑भ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: ináḥ ǀ vā́jānām ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ puṣṭīnā́m ǀ sákhā ǀprá ǀ śmáśru ǀ haryatáḥ ǀ dūdhot ǀ ví ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ádābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The ruler, the lord of viands, the soverign, the friend of the contentment (of all); he who isunassailable, genitive ly shakes his beard (when drinking theSomaof the sacrificer), desiring (his favour).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ ते॒ रथ॑स्य पूषन्न॒जा धुरं॑ ववृत्युः । विश्व॑स्या॒र्थिन॒: सखा॑ सनो॒जा अन॑पच्युतः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ ráthasya ǀ pūṣan ǀ ajā́ḥ ǀ dhúram ǀ vavṛtyuḥ ǀvíśvasya ǀ arthínaḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sanaḥ-jā́ḥ ǀ ánapa-cyutaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “THe goats,Pūṣan, bear the burden of your car, who are the friend of every suppliant, born long ago,never-failing (in your duty).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्माक॑मू॒र्जा रथं॑ पू॒षा अ॑विष्टु॒ माहि॑नः । भुव॒द्वाजा॑नां वृ॒ध इ॒मं न॑: शृणव॒द्धव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: asmā́kam ǀ ūrjā́ ǀ rátham ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ aviṣṭu ǀ mā́hinaḥ ǀbhúvat ǀ vā́jānām ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ imám ǀ naḥ ǀ śṛṇavat ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the mightyPūṣanprotect our chariot by his might; may he be to us the augmenter of food; mayhe hear this our invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॒त्सु मे॑ जरित॒: साभि॑वे॒गो यत्सु॑न्व॒ते यज॑मानाय॒ शिक्ष॑म् । अना॑शीर्दाम॒हम॑स्मि प्रह॒न्ता स॑त्य॒ध्वृतं॑ वृजिना॒यन्त॑मा॒भुम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásat ǀ sú ǀ me ǀ jaritaríti ǀ sáḥ ǀ abhi-vegáḥ ǀ yát ǀ sunvaté ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śíkṣam ǀánāśīḥ-dām ǀ ahám ǀ asmi ǀ pra-hantā́ ǀ satya-dhvṛ́tam ǀ vṛjina-yántam ǀ ābhúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indraspeaks). Such is my plural asant disposition, worshipper, that I help the instrumental tutor of the rite, whooffers libation; but I am the punisher of him who offers not libations, who disregards the truth, the perpetrator ofsin, the malignant.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदीद॒हं यु॒धये॑ सं॒नया॒न्यदे॑वयून्त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ शूशु॑जानान् । अ॒मा ते॒ तुम्रं॑ वृष॒भं प॑चानि ती॒व्रं सु॒तं प॑ञ्चद॒शं नि षि॑ञ्चम्
shlokas.transliteration: yádi ǀ ít ǀ ahám ǀ yudháye ǀ sam-náyāni ǀ ádeva-yūn ǀ tanvā́ ǀ śū́śujānān ǀamā́ ǀ te ǀ túmram ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ pacāni ǀ tīvrám ǀ sutám ǀ pañca-daśám ǀ ní ǀ siñcam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If I encounter in combat the undevout, resplendent in their bodies, then will I cook a vigorous bull forthem, and will sprinkle (upon the fire) the exhilaratingSomathe fifteen-fold (Soma).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाहं तं वे॑द॒ य इति॒ ब्रवी॒त्यदे॑वयून्त्स॒मर॑णे जघ॒न्वान् । य॒दावाख्य॑त्स॒मर॑ण॒मृघा॑व॒दादिद्ध॑ मे वृष॒भा प्र ब्रु॑वन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ahám ǀ tám ǀ veda ǀ yáḥ ǀ íti ǀ brávīti ǀ ádeva-yūn ǀ sam-áraṇe ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀyadā́ ǀ ava-ákhyat ǀ sam-áraṇam ǀ ṛ́ghāvat ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ ha ǀ me ǀ vṛṣabhā́ ǀ prá ǀ bruvanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I know not that man who says that he is the slayer in battle of those who do not reverence the gods;but when (I behold) the fierce war commenced, then (my enemies) proclaim my prowess.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदज्ञा॑तेषु वृ॒जने॒ष्वासं॒ विश्वे॑ स॒तो म॒घवा॑नो म आसन् । जि॒नामि॒ वेत्क्षेम॒ आ सन्त॑मा॒भुं प्र तं क्षि॑णां॒ पर्व॑ते पाद॒गृह्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ájñāteṣu ǀ vṛjáneṣu ǀ ā́sam ǀ víśve ǀ satáḥ ǀ maghá-vānaḥ ǀ me ǀ āsan ǀjinā́mi ǀ vā ǀ ít ǀ kṣéme ǀ ā́ ǀ sántam ǀ ābhúm ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ kṣiṇām ǀ párvate ǀ pāda-gṛ́hya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When I enter upon unprecedented combats, then all those who are affluent in oblations approach meso engaged; I destroy the mighty and overpowering foe for the protection of the world, and, seizing him by thefeet, throw him down from the mountain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वा उ॒ मां वृ॒जने॑ वारयन्ते॒ न पर्व॑तासो॒ यद॒हं म॑न॒स्ये । मम॑ स्व॒नात्कृ॑धु॒कर्णो॑ भयात ए॒वेदनु॒ द्यून्कि॒रण॒: समे॑जात्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ mā́m ǀ vṛjáne ǀ vārayante ǀ ná ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ yát ǀ ahám ǀ manasyé ǀmáma ǀ svanā́t ǀ kṛdhu-kárṇaḥ ǀ bhayāte ǀ evá ǀ ít ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ kiráṇaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ejāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “None resist me (engaged) in combat, not even the mountains when I am resolved; at my shout the dullof hearing is alarmed, and so too even the bright- rayed (sun) trembles day by day.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दर्श॒न्न्वत्र॑ शृत॒पाँ अ॑नि॒न्द्रान्बा॑हु॒क्षद॒: शर॑वे॒ पत्य॑मानान् । घृषुं॑ वा॒ ये नि॑नि॒दुः सखा॑य॒मध्यू॒ न्वे॑षु प॒वयो॑ ववृत्युः
shlokas.transliteration: dárśan ǀ nú ǀ átra ǀ śṛta-pā́n ǀ anindrā́n ǀ bāhu-kṣádaḥ ǀ śárave ǀ pátyamānān ǀghṛ́ṣum ǀ vā ǀ yé ǀ ninidúḥ ǀ sákhāyam ǀ ádhi ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ eṣu ǀ paváyaḥ ǀ vavṛtyuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding here the drinkers of the libations who serve notIndra, who cut (the worshippers) to pieceswith theirhands, assailing them to do them harm; my shafts quickly fall upon them, as well as on those who revile(your) powerful friend. all existence; the ancient Indra verily destroys (his foe), the other does not destroy (Indra). The united two(heaven and earth) surpass not him who extends beyond the confines of the universe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अभू॒र्वौक्षी॒र्व्यु१॒॑ आयु॑रान॒ड्दर्ष॒न्नु पूर्वो॒ अप॑रो॒ नु द॑र्षत् । द्वे प॒वस्ते॒ परि॒ तं न भू॑तो॒ यो अ॒स्य पा॒रे रज॑सो वि॒वेष॑
shlokas.transliteration: ábhūḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ áukṣīḥ ǀ ví ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ānaṭ ǀ dárṣat ǀ nú ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ áparaḥ ǀ nú ǀ darṣat ǀdvé íti ǀ paváste íti ǀ pári ǀ tám ǀ ná ǀ bhūtaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ asyá ǀ pāré ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vivéṣa ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: गावो॒ यवं॒ प्रयु॑ता अ॒र्यो अ॑क्ष॒न्ता अ॑पश्यं स॒हगो॑पा॒श्चर॑न्तीः । हवा॒ इद॒र्यो अ॒भित॒: समा॑य॒न्किय॑दासु॒ स्वप॑तिश्छन्दयाते
shlokas.transliteration: gā́vaḥ ǀ yávam ǀ prá-yutāḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ akṣan ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ apaśyam ǀ sahá-gopāḥ ǀ cárantīḥ ǀhávāḥ ǀ ít ǀ aryáḥ ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ sám ǀ āyan ǀ kíyat ǀ āsu ǀ svá-patiḥ ǀ chandayāte ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The assembled cattle feed upon the barley; I their master have beheld them grazing, tended by theherdsman; when called, they collect around their lord; when they approach, how much milk does he desire (totake)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: सं यद्वयं॑ यव॒सादो॒ जना॑नाम॒हं य॒वाद॑ उ॒र्वज्रे॑ अ॒न्तः । अत्रा॑ यु॒क्तो॑ऽवसा॒तार॑मिच्छा॒दथो॒ अयु॑क्तं युनजद्वव॒न्वान्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ yát ǀ váyam ǀ yavasa-ádaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ahám ǀ yava-ádaḥ ǀ uru-ájre ǀ antáríti ǀátra ǀ yuktáḥ ǀ ava-sātā́ram ǀ icchāt ǀ átho íti ǀ áyuktam ǀ yunajat ǀ vavanvā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When we, the grass-eaters of men, (are) together, I (am) among the barley-eaters in the wide field;here he who is yoked would like one to unloose him, and the assailant would yoke him who is unyoked.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अत्रेदु॑ मे मंससे स॒त्यमु॒क्तं द्वि॒पाच्च॒ यच्चतु॑ष्पात्संसृ॒जानि॑ । स्त्री॒भिर्यो अत्र॒ वृष॑णं पृत॒न्यादयु॑द्धो अस्य॒ वि भ॑जानि॒ वेद॑:
shlokas.transliteration: átra ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ me ǀ maṃsase ǀ satyám ǀ uktám ǀ dvi-pā́t ǀ ca ǀ yát ǀ cátuḥ-pāt ǀ sam-sṛjā́ni ǀstrībhíḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ átra ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ pṛtanyā́t ǀ áyuddhaḥ ǀ asya ǀ ví ǀ bhajāni ǀ védaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indraspeaks). You know that what is said by me at this time is the truth, that I may create both bipedsand quadrupeds. I distribute without conflict (among my worshippers) the wealth (that I have taken from him), who(neglecting me), the showerer of desires), wishes to contend with women.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्या॑न॒क्षा दु॑हि॒ता जात्वास॒ कस्तां वि॒द्वाँ अ॒भि म॑न्याते अ॒न्धाम् । क॒त॒रो मे॒निं प्रति॒ तं मु॑चाते॒ य ईं॒ वहा॑ते॒ य ईं॑ वा वरे॒यात्
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ anakṣā́ ǀ duhitā́ ǀ jā́tu ǀ ā́sa ǀ káḥ ǀ tā́m ǀ vidvā́n ǀ abhí ǀ manyāte ǀ andhā́m ǀkataráḥ ǀ mením ǀ práti ǀ tám ǀ mucāte ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ váhāte ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ vā ǀ vare-yā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What (other god but me) whose eyeless daughter is ever present knows her and honours (her) theblind one; which of the two (deities) lets loose that bolt against (a foe)-- he who assails, (or) he who protects hiṃ”

shlokas.sanskrit: किय॑ती॒ योषा॑ मर्य॒तो व॑धू॒योः परि॑प्रीता॒ पन्य॑सा॒ वार्ये॑ण । भ॒द्रा व॒धूर्भ॑वति॒ यत्सु॒पेशा॑: स्व॒यं सा मि॒त्रं व॑नुते॒ जने॑ चित्
shlokas.transliteration: kíyatī ǀ yóṣā ǀ maryatáḥ ǀ vadhū-yóḥ ǀ pári-prītā ǀ pányasā ǀ vā́ryeṇa ǀbhadrā́ ǀ vadhū́ḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ yát ǀ su-péśāḥ ǀ svayám ǀ sā́ ǀ mitrám ǀ vanute ǀ jáne ǀ cit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How many a woman has been gratified by the flattering praise of man's desire, when the bride isfortunate and beautiful, she of herself chooses her husband among men.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒त्तो ज॑गार प्र॒त्यञ्च॑मत्ति शी॒र्ष्णा शिर॒: प्रति॑ दधौ॒ वरू॑थम् । आसी॑न ऊ॒र्ध्वामु॒पसि॑ क्षिणाति॒ न्य॑ङ्ङुत्ता॒नामन्वे॑ति॒ भूमि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: pattáḥ ǀ jagāra ǀ pratyáñcam ǀ atti ǀ śīrṣṇā́ ǀ śíraḥ ǀ práti ǀ dadhau ǀ várūtham ǀā́sīnaḥ ǀ ūrdhvā́m ǀ upási ǀ kṣiṇāti ǀ nyáṅ ǀ uttānā́m ǀ ánu ǀ eti ǀ bhū́mim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He seizes (it) with his feet, he swallows it when it approaches him, he plural ces the head (of heaven) asa guard around his head; seated (above) he sends (his rays) upwards to the proximate heaven; he send themdownwards, on the outspread earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्न॑च्छा॒यो अ॑पला॒शो अर्वा॑ त॒स्थौ मा॒ता विषि॑तो अत्ति॒ गर्भ॑: । अ॒न्यस्या॑ व॒त्सं रि॑ह॒ती मि॑माय॒ कया॑ भु॒वा नि द॑धे धे॒नुरूध॑:
shlokas.transliteration: bṛhán ǀ acchāyáḥ ǀ apalāśáḥ ǀ árvā ǀ tastháu ǀ mātā́ ǀ ví-sitaḥ ǀ atti ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀanyásyāḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ rihatī́ ǀ mimāya ǀ káyā ǀ bhuvā́ ǀ ní ǀ dadhe ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The great (sun), shadeless, undecaying, ever-moving, abides; the builder (of the world), who isliberated, the germ (of thethree worlds), eats (the oblations), fondling the offspring of another (mother), heconstructs (the quarters of the world); with what design has the cow offered her udder?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त वी॒रासो॑ अध॒रादुदा॑यन्न॒ष्टोत्त॒रात्ता॒त्सम॑जग्मिर॒न्ते । नव॑ प॒श्चाता॑त्स्थिवि॒मन्त॑ आय॒न्दश॒ प्राक्सानु॒ वि ति॑र॒न्त्यश्न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ vīrā́saḥ ǀ adharā́t ǀ út ǀ āyan ǀ aṣṭá ǀ uttarā́ttāt ǀ sám ǀ ajagmiran ǀ té ǀnáva ǀ paścā́tāt ǀ sthivi-mántaḥ ǀ āyan ǀ dáśa ǀ prā́k ǀ sā́nu ǀ ví ǀ tiranti ǀ áśnaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Seven sages sprang from the lower portion (ofIndraasPrajāpati); eight were born from the upperportion; nine occupants of stations came from behind, and ten, genitive rated in the front, partaking of food,eightvālakhilyas; ninebhṛgus; tenaṅgirasas; or, sevenMarutson Indra's right, eight on his left, nine behindhim, and ten in front].”

shlokas.sanskrit: द॒शा॒नामेकं॑ कपि॒लं स॑मा॒नं तं हि॑न्वन्ति॒ क्रत॑वे॒ पार्या॑य । गर्भं॑ मा॒ता सुधि॑तं व॒क्षणा॒स्ववे॑नन्तं तु॒षय॑न्ती बिभर्ति
shlokas.transliteration: daśānā́m ǀ ékam ǀ kapilám ǀ samānám ǀ tám ǀ hinvanti ǀ krátave ǀ pā́ryāya ǀgárbham ǀ mātā́ ǀ sú-dhitam ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ ávenantam ǀ tuṣáyantī ǀ bibharti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The otheraṅgirasas) despatched one of the ten,Kapila, as equal (to the task) for the completion ofthe sacrifice; the gratified mother cherishes the embryo well-deposited in the waters, and not desirous of anabiding plural ce.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पीवा॑नं मे॒षम॑पचन्त वी॒रा न्यु॑प्ता अ॒क्षा अनु॑ दी॒व आ॑सन् । द्वा धनुं॑ बृह॒तीम॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तः प॒वित्र॑वन्ता चरतः पु॒नन्ता॑
shlokas.transliteration: pī́vānam ǀ meṣám ǀ apacanta ǀ vīrā́ḥ ǀ ní-uptāḥ ǀ akṣā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dīvé ǀ āsan ǀdvā́ ǀ dhánum ǀ bṛhatī́m ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáríti ǀ pavítra-vantā ǀ carataḥ ǀ punántā ǁ
