shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, shedders of rain, you extricated Rebha when he was plural ced in a cave and was dying; youmade the heated fire-pit cool forAtri; you gave (liberty) to Saptavadhri.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं श्वे॒तं पे॒दवे॑ऽश्वि॒नाश्वं॑ न॒वभि॒र्वाजै॑र्नव॒ती च॑ वा॒जिन॑म् । च॒र्कृत्यं॑ ददथुर्द्राव॒यत्स॑खं॒ भगं॒ न नृभ्यो॒ हव्यं॑ मयो॒भुव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ śvetám ǀ pedáve ǀ aśvinā ǀ áśvam ǀ navá-bhiḥ ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ navatī́ ǀ ca ǀ vājínam ǀcarkṛ́tyam ǀ dadathuḥ ǀ dravayát-sakham ǀ bhágam ǀ ná ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ hávyam ǀ mayaḥ-bhúvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You gave,Aśvins, toPedua strong white horse with nine-and-ninety (other) steeds, (a horse), active(in combat), putting to flight the friends (of the foe), worthy to be invoked, a source of deligght, like wealth to meṇ”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तं रा॑जानावदिते॒ कुत॑श्च॒न नांहो॑ अश्नोति दुरि॒तं नकि॑र्भ॒यम् । यम॑श्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी पुरोर॒थं कृ॑णु॒थः पत्न्या॑ स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ rājānau ǀ adite ǀ kútaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ná ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ aśnoti ǀ duḥ-itám ǀ nákiḥ ǀ bhayám ǀyám ǀ aśvinā ǀ su-havā ǀ rudravartanī íti rudra-vartanī ǀ puraḥ-rathám ǀ kṛṇutháḥ ǀ pátnyā ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lofty soverigns, worthy of invocation, going on roads which are praised in hymns,Aśvins, the manwhom with his wife you plural ce in front of (your) car, encounters not from any quarter wickedness, difficulty, ordanger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तेन॑ यातं॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑यसा॒ रथं॒ यं वा॑मृ॒भव॑श्च॒क्रुर॑श्विना । यस्य॒ योगे॑ दुहि॒ता जाय॑ते दि॒व उ॒भे अह॑नी सु॒दिने॑ वि॒वस्व॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ téna ǀ yātam ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyasā ǀ rátham ǀ yám ǀ vām ǀ ṛbhávaḥ ǀ cakrúḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀyásya ǀ yóge ǀ duhitā́ ǀ jā́yate ǀ diváḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ áhanī íti ǀ sudíne íti su-díne ǀ vivásvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, with the chariot that is swifter than thought, which theRibhusmade for you; inconnection with which the daughter of heaven, (the dawn), is born and both the auspicious day and night fromVivasvat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता व॒र्तिर्या॑तं ज॒युषा॒ वि पर्व॑त॒मपि॑न्वतं श॒यवे॑ धे॒नुम॑श्विना । वृक॑स्य चि॒द्वर्ति॑काम॒न्तरा॒स्या॑द्यु॒वं शची॑भिर्ग्रसि॒ताम॑मुञ्चतम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yātam ǀ jayúṣā ǀ ví ǀ párvatam ǀ ápinvatam ǀ śayáve ǀ dhenúm ǀ aśvinā ǀvṛ́kasya ǀ cit ǀ vártikām ǀ antáḥ ǀ āsyā́t ǀ yuvám ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ grasitā́m ǀ amuñcatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you two,Aśvins, climb the path to the mountain with your triumphant chariot; you have renovatedforŚayu(barren) cow; you liberated by your acts the quail that had been seized from the jaws of the wolf.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒तं वां॒ स्तोम॑मश्विनावक॒र्मात॑क्षाम॒ भृग॑वो॒ न रथ॑म् । न्य॑मृक्षाम॒ योष॑णां॒ न मर्ये॒ नित्यं॒ न सू॒नुं तन॑यं॒ दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: etám ǀ vām ǀ stómam ǀ aśvinau ǀ akarma ǀ átakṣāma ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rátham ǀní ǀ amṛkṣāma ǀ yóṣaṇām ǀ ná ǀ márye ǀ nítyam ǀ ná ǀ sūnúm ǀ tánayam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: रथं॒ यान्तं॒ कुह॒ को ह॑ वां नरा॒ प्रति॑ द्यु॒मन्तं॑ सुवि॒ताय॑ भूषति । प्रा॒त॒र्यावा॑णं वि॒भ्वं॑ वि॒शेवि॑शे॒ वस्तो॑र्वस्तो॒र्वह॑मानं धि॒या शमि॑
shlokas.transliteration: rátham ǀ yā́ntam ǀ kúha ǀ káḥ ǀ ha ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀ práti ǀ dyu-mántam ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ bhūṣati ǀprātaḥ-yā́vānam ǀ vi-bhvám ǀ viśé-viśe ǀ vástoḥ-vastoḥ ǀ váhamānam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ śámi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What (worshipper), O leaderes of rites, and where (abiding) glorifies for his good, by his praise at therite, your radiant moving chariot, going (to the sacrifice) at dawn, all-pervading, and bearing (wealth) day afterday to one man after another?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कुह॑ स्विद्दो॒षा कुह॒ वस्तो॑र॒श्विना॒ कुहा॑भिपि॒त्वं क॑रत॒: कुहो॑षतुः । को वां॑ शयु॒त्रा वि॒धवे॑व दे॒वरं॒ मर्यं॒ न योषा॑ कृणुते स॒धस्थ॒ आ
shlokas.transliteration: kúha ǀ svit ǀ doṣā́ ǀ kúha ǀ vástoḥ ǀ aśvínā ǀ kúha ǀ abhi-pitvám ǀ karataḥ ǀ kúha ǀ ūṣatuḥ ǀkáḥ ǀ vām ǀ śayu-trā́ ǀ vidhávā-iva ǀ deváram ǀ máryam ǀ ná ǀ yóṣā ǀ kṛṇute ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where are you,Aśvins, by night? Where are you by day? Where do you sojourn? Where do youdwell? Who brings you into his presence in the same plural ce (of sacrifice) as on her couch a widow (brings) herhusband's brother, as a woman (brings) her husband (to her).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒तर्ज॑रेथे जर॒णेव॒ काप॑या॒ वस्तो॑र्वस्तोर्यज॒ता ग॑च्छथो गृ॒हम् । कस्य॑ ध्व॒स्रा भ॑वथ॒: कस्य॑ वा नरा राजपु॒त्रेव॒ सव॒नाव॑ गच्छथः
shlokas.transliteration: prātáḥ ǀ jarethe íti ǀ jaraṇā́-iva ǀ kā́payā ǀ vástoḥ-vastoḥ ǀ yajatā́ ǀ gacchathaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀkásya ǀ dhvasrā́ ǀ bhavathaḥ ǀ kásya ǀ vā ǀ narā ǀ rājaputrā́-iva ǀ sávanā ǀ áva ǀ gacchathaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), you are glorified at dawn like two ancient (monarchs) by the voice (of the caller)entitled to worship, you go day by day to the dwelling (of the worshipper); of whose (faults) are you thedestroyer? To whose oblations do you go like princes?”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां मृ॒गेव॑ वार॒णा मृ॑ग॒ण्यवो॑ दो॒षा वस्तो॑र्ह॒विषा॒ नि ह्व॑यामहे । यु॒वं होत्रा॑मृतु॒था जुह्व॑ते न॒रेषं॒ जना॑य वहथः शुभस्पती
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ mṛgā́-iva ǀ vāraṇā́ ǀ mṛgaṇyávaḥ ǀ doṣā́ ǀ vástoḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ ní ǀ hvayāmahe ǀyuvám ǀ hótrām ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ júhvate ǀ narā ǀ íṣam ǀ jánāya ǀ vahathaḥ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like perons hunting two wild elephants, we praise you,Aśvins, with oblations night and day; at all dueseasons, leaders (of rites), (the worshipper) offers you the oblation; do you, who are rulers of the shining (rain),bring food to mankind.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वां ह॒ घोषा॒ पर्य॑श्विना य॒ती राज्ञ॑ ऊचे दुहि॒ता पृ॒च्छे वां॑ नरा । भू॒तं मे॒ अह्न॑ उ॒त भू॑तम॒क्तवेऽश्वा॑वते र॒थिने॑ शक्त॒मर्व॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yuvā́m ǀ ha ǀ ghóṣā ǀ pári ǀ aśvinā ǀ yatī́ ǀ rā́jñaḥ ǀ ūce ǀ duhitā́ ǀ pṛcché ǀ vām ǀ narā ǀbhūtám ǀ me ǀ áhne ǀ utá ǀ bhūtam ǀ aktáve ǀ áśva-vate ǀ rathíne ǀ śaktam ǀ árvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Attending upon you,Aśvins, leaders (of rites), I,Ghoṣā, the daughter of king (Kakṣīvat), speak toyou and request you; be (present at) my (sacrifice) by day, and be (present) by night, be able, (to grant favour) tothe son of my brother, who has horses and a chariot.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं क॒वी ष्ठ॒: पर्य॑श्विना॒ रथं॒ विशो॒ न कुत्सो॑ जरि॒तुर्न॑शायथः । यु॒वोर्ह॒ मक्षा॒ पर्य॑श्विना॒ मध्वा॒सा भ॑रत निष्कृ॒तं न योष॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ kavī́ íti ǀ sthaḥ ǀ pári ǀ aśvinā ǀ rátham ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ná ǀ kútsaḥ ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ naśāyathaḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ ha ǀ mákṣā ǀ pári ǀ aśvinā ǀ mádhu ǀ āsā́ ǀ bharata ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ ná ǀ yóṣaṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageAśvins, stand by your chariot; make it approach (the sacrifice) of the worshipper, asKutsa(made his chariot approach) men, the fly carries your honey, Aśvins, in its mouth as a woman carries purified(honey).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं ह॑ भु॒ज्युं यु॒वम॑श्विना॒ वशं॑ यु॒वं शि॒ञ्जार॑मु॒शना॒मुपा॑रथुः । यु॒वो ररा॑वा॒ परि॑ स॒ख्यमा॑सते यु॒वोर॒हमव॑सा सु॒म्नमा च॑के
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ ha ǀ bhujyúm ǀ yuvám ǀ aśvinā ǀ váśam ǀ yuvám ǀ śiñjā́ram ǀ uśánām ǀ úpa ǀ ārathuḥ ǀyuvóḥ ǀ rárāvā ǀ pári ǀ sakhyám ǀ āsate ǀ yuvóḥ ǀ ahám ǀ ávasā ǀ sumnám ǀ ā́ ǀ cake ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You came,Aśvins, to the rescue ofBhujyu, you came to the rescue ofVaśa, you came to Śiñjārato (hear) his desirable (praise); the offerer of oblations besieges your friendship; and I desire happiness throughyour protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं ह॑ कृ॒शं यु॒वम॑श्विना श॒युं यु॒वं वि॒धन्तं॑ वि॒धवा॑मुरुष्यथः । यु॒वं स॒निभ्य॑: स्त॒नय॑न्तमश्वि॒नाप॑ व्र॒जमू॑र्णुथः स॒प्तास्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ ha ǀ kṛśám ǀ yuvám ǀ aśvinā ǀ śayúm ǀ yuvám ǀ vidhántam ǀ vidhávām ǀ uruṣyathaḥ ǀyuvám ǀ saní-bhyaḥ ǀ stanáyantam ǀ aśvinā ǀ ápa ǀ vrajám ǀ ūrṇuthaḥ ǀ saptá-āsyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Aśvins, you protect the feeble man; you protectedŚayu; you protect him who worshipsaccording to rule, and the widow, (Vadhrimati); you set open, O Aśvins, for the donors of oblations theseven-mouthed thundering cloud.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जनि॑ष्ट॒ योषा॑ प॒तय॑त्कनीन॒को वि चारु॑हन्वी॒रुधो॑ दं॒सना॒ अनु॑ । आस्मै॑ रीयन्ते निव॒नेव॒ सिन्ध॑वो॒ऽस्मा अह्ने॑ भवति॒ तत्प॑तित्व॒नम्
shlokas.transliteration: jániṣṭa ǀ yóṣā ǀ patáyat ǀ kanīnakáḥ ǀ ví ǀ ca ǀ áruhan ǀ vīrúdhaḥ ǀ daṃsánāḥ ǀ ánu ǀā́ ǀ asmai ǀ rīyante ǀ nivanā́-iva ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ asmái ǀ áhne ǀ bhavati ǀ tát ǀ pati-tvanám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bride,Aśvins, has been born, let the husband approach; may the plural nts spring up (for him) afterthe rain; for him may the streams flow as if from a declivity; may he invulnerable have the power of a husbandover her.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जी॒वं रु॑दन्ति॒ वि म॑यन्ते अध्व॒रे दी॒र्घामनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं दीधियु॒र्नर॑: । वा॒मं पि॒तृभ्यो॒ य इ॒दं स॑मेरि॒रे मय॒: पति॑भ्यो॒ जन॑यः परि॒ष्वजे॑
shlokas.transliteration: jīvám ǀ rudanti ǀ ví ǀ mayante ǀ adhvaré ǀ dīrghā́m ǀ ánu ǀ prá-sitim ǀ dīdhiyuḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀvāmám ǀ pitṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ yé ǀ idám ǀ sam-eriré ǀ máyaḥ ǀ páti-bhyaḥ ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ pari-sváje ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The husbands who weep for the life (of their wives), make them sit down at the sacrifice, hold in a longembrace, (and) send thePitṛsthis desirable offspring, upon these husbands the wives (bestow) happiness inorder to be embraced.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तस्य॑ विद्म॒ तदु॒ षु प्र वो॑चत॒ युवा॑ ह॒ यद्यु॑व॒त्याः क्षेति॒ योनि॑षु । प्रि॒योस्रि॑यस्य वृष॒भस्य॑ रे॒तिनो॑ गृ॒हं ग॑मेमाश्विना॒ तदु॑श्मसि
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tásya ǀ vidma ǀ tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ vocata ǀ yúvā ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ yuvatyā́ḥ ǀ kṣéti ǀ yóniṣu ǀpriyá-usriyasya ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ retínaḥ ǀ gṛhám ǀ gamema ǀ aśvinā ǀ tát ǀ uśmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We do not know this (happiness) of his; do you, (Aśvins), clearly explain how it is that the young(husband) dwells in the bride's house; let us, Aśvins, go the dwelling of (my) dear youthful, vigorous, and manlyhusband; this is our desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑मगन्त्सुम॒तिर्वा॑जिनीवसू॒ न्य॑श्विना हृ॒त्सु कामा॑ अयंसत । अभू॑तं गो॒पा मि॑थु॒ना शु॑भस्पती प्रि॒या अ॑र्य॒म्णो दुर्याँ॑ अशीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ agan ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ vājinīvasū íti vājinī-vasū ǀ ní ǀ aśvinā ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ ayaṃsata ǀábhūtam ǀ gopā́ ǀ mithunā́ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ aryamṇáḥ ǀ dúryān ǀ aśīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvins, rich in food, lords of water, twin (associates), may your good will devolve (upon us), may thedesires (of our hearts) be attained; you have been my protectors; may we, (being) beloved, attain the habitationof a husband.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता म॑न्दसा॒ना मनु॑षो दुरो॒ण आ ध॒त्तं र॒यिं स॒हवी॑रं वच॒स्यवे॑ । कृ॒तं ती॒र्थं सु॑प्रपा॒णं शु॑भस्पती स्था॒णुं प॑थे॒ष्ठामप॑ दुर्म॒तिं ह॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ mandasānā́ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ ā́ ǀ dhattám ǀ rayím ǀ sahá-vīram ǀ vacasyáve ǀkṛtám ǀ tīrthám ǀ su-prapānám ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ sthāṇúm ǀ pathe-sthā́m ǀ ápa ǀ duḥ-matím ǀ hatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exulting, do you bestow riches, comprehendingmaleprogeny, in the house of my husband, on me,who desire to praise you; lords of waters, make the sacred ford good to drink; remove the tree that stands in theroad and the malevolent (enemy).”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्व॑ स्विद॒द्य क॑त॒मास्व॒श्विना॑ वि॒क्षु द॒स्रा मा॑दयेते शु॒भस्पती॑ । क ईं॒ नि ये॑मे कत॒मस्य॑ जग्मतु॒र्विप्र॑स्य वा॒ यज॑मानस्य वा गृ॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: kvá ǀ svit ǀ adyá ǀ katamā́su ǀ aśvínā ǀ vikṣú ǀ dasrā́ ǀ mādayete íti ǀ śubháḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀkáḥ ǀ īm ǀ ní ǀ yeme ǀ katamásya ǀ jagmatuḥ ǀ víprasya ǀ vā ǀ yájamānasya ǀ vā ǀ gṛhám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Aśvinsof goodly aspect, lords of water, in what plural ce, among what people, do you today delight? Whonow detains you? To the house of what sage or of what sacrificer, have you gone?”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नमु॒ त्यं पु॑रुहू॒तमु॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ रथं॑ त्रिच॒क्रं सव॑ना॒ गनि॑ग्मतम् । परि॑ज्मानं विद॒थ्यं॑ सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र्व॒यं व्यु॑ष्टा उ॒षसो॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: samānám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyám ǀ puru-hūtám ǀ ukthyám ǀ rátham ǀ tri-cakrám ǀ sávanā ǀ gánigmatam ǀpári-jmānam ǀ vidathyám ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ vayám ǀ ví-uṣṭau ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At break of dawn, (Aśvins), we invoke with pious prayers your common chariot, praised of many,adorable three-wheeled, frequenting religious rites, traversing all space, suitable at sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रा॒त॒र्युजं॑ नास॒त्याधि॑ तिष्ठथः प्रात॒र्यावा॑णं मधु॒वाह॑नं॒ रथ॑म् । विशो॒ येन॒ गच्छ॑थो॒ यज्व॑रीर्नरा की॒रेश्चि॑द्य॒ज्ञं होतृ॑मन्तमश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: prātaḥ-yújam ǀ nāsatyā ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhathaḥ ǀ prātaḥ-yā́vānam ǀ madhu-vā́hanam ǀ rátham ǀvíśaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ yájvarīḥ ǀ narā ǀ kīréḥ ǀ cit ǀ yajñám ǀ hótṛ-mantam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ascend,Nāsatyās, your nectar-bearing chariot, which is harnessed at dawn, and set in motion atdawn, with which, leaders (of rites), you go to the people who are engaged in worship, to the priest-administeredsacrifice,Aśvins, of (your) adorer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ध्व॒र्युं वा॒ मधु॑पाणिं सु॒हस्त्य॑म॒ग्निधं॑ वा धृ॒तद॑क्षं॒ दमू॑नसम् । विप्र॑स्य वा॒ यत्सव॑नानि॒ गच्छ॒थोऽत॒ आ या॑तं मधु॒पेय॑मश्विना
shlokas.transliteration: adhvaryúm ǀ vā ǀ mádhu-pāṇim ǀ su-hástyam ǀ agnídham ǀ vā ǀ dhṛtá-dakṣam ǀ dámūnasam ǀvíprasya ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ sávanāni ǀ gácchathaḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yātam ǀ madhu-péyam ǀ aśvinā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Aśvins, toSuhastya, whether as the ministrant priest bearing theSomain hishand, or as thecompetent lowly-minded feeder of the sacred fire; although you go to the sacrifices of (some other) sage, (yet)come, Aśvins, from them to the Soma (which I offer).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ते॑व॒ सु प्र॑त॒रं लाय॒मस्य॒न्भूष॑न्निव॒ प्र भ॑रा॒ स्तोम॑मस्मै । वा॒चा वि॑प्रास्तरत॒ वाच॑म॒र्यो नि रा॑मय जरित॒: सोम॒ इन्द्र॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ástā-iva ǀ sú ǀ pra-tarám ǀ lā́yam ǀ ásyan ǀ bhū́ṣan-iva ǀ prá ǀ bhara ǀ stómam ǀ asmai ǀvācā́ ǀ viprāḥ ǀ tarata ǀ vā́cam ǀ aryáḥ ǀ ní ǀ ramaya ǀ jaritaríti ǀ sóme ǀ índram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Direct your laudation to him, (Indra), like an archer aiming a larger arrow (to its mark), like a decorator(applying his ornaments); surpass by your praises, sages, the praises of your adversaries; delight Indraworshipper, by the (offering of the)Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दोहे॑न॒ गामुप॑ शिक्षा॒ सखा॑यं॒ प्र बो॑धय जरितर्जा॒रमिन्द्र॑म् । कोशं॒ न पू॒र्णं वसु॑ना॒ न्यृ॑ष्ट॒मा च्या॑वय मघ॒देया॑य॒ शूर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: dóhena ǀ gā́m ǀ úpa ǀ śikṣa ǀ sákhāyam ǀ prá ǀ bodhaya ǀ jaritaḥ ǀ jārám ǀ índram ǀkóśam ǀ ná ǀ pūrṇám ǀ vásunā ǀ ní-ṛṣṭam ǀ ā́ ǀ cyavaya ǀ magha-déyāya ǀ śū́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Control, worshipper, your friend (Indra), like a cow for your milking; awake, Indra, the author of decay;bring down for the distribution of wealth the hero who is pressed down with wealth like a vessel full (of water).”

shlokas.sanskrit: किम॒ङ्ग त्वा॑ मघवन्भो॒जमा॑हुः शिशी॒हि मा॑ शिश॒यं त्वा॑ शृणोमि । अप्न॑स्वती॒ मम॒ धीर॑स्तु शक्र वसु॒विदं॒ भग॑मि॒न्द्रा भ॑रा नः
shlokas.transliteration: kím ǀ aṅgá ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ bhojám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ śiśīhí ǀ mā ǀ śiśayám ǀ tvā ǀ śṛṇomi ǀápnasvatī ǀ máma ǀ dhī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ śakra ǀ vasu-vídam ǀ bhágam ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Why, Maghavat, do (the wise) call you the nourisher (of worshippers)? Quicken me, (Indra), withwealth, (for) I hear that you are the quickener (of the worshipper); may my understanding,Śakra, be productiveof works; grant us, Indra, adestinythat brings wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वां जना॑ ममस॒त्येष्वि॑न्द्र संतस्था॒ना वि ह्व॑यन्ते समी॒के । अत्रा॒ युजं॑ कृणुते॒ यो ह॒विष्मा॒न्नासु॑न्वता स॒ख्यं व॑ष्टि॒ शूर॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ jánāḥ ǀ mama-satyéṣu ǀ indra ǀ sam-tasthānā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ hvayante ǀ sam-īké ǀátra ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇute ǀ yáḥ ǀ havíṣmān ǀ ná ǀ ásunvatā ǀ sakhyám ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ śū́raḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The people earnestly call upon you in battles,Indra, (they call upon you) when standing together inthe conflict; at this (call) Indra makes him his friend who offers oblations; the hero desires not friendship with himwho presents no libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धनं॒ न स्य॒न्द्रं ब॑हु॒लं यो अ॑स्मै ती॒व्रान्त्सोमाँ॑ आसु॒नोति॒ प्रय॑स्वान् । तस्मै॒ शत्रू॑न्त्सु॒तुका॑न्प्रा॒तरह्नो॒ नि स्वष्ट्रा॑न्यु॒वति॒ हन्ति॑ वृ॒त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: dhánam ǀ ná ǀ syandrám ǀ bahulám ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ tīvrā́n ǀ sómān ǀ ā-sunóti ǀ práyasvān ǀtásmai ǀ śátrūn ǀ su-túkān ǀ prātáḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ ní ǀ su-áṣṭrān ǀ yuváti ǀ hánti ǀ vṛtrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearer of the oblation who offers toIndrathe sharpSoma, like much moveable wealth (given tothe poor)-- for him in the fore part of the day Indra scatters his eager and well-armed (enemies), and defeats hisfoe.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॑न्व॒यं द॑धि॒मा शंस॒मिन्द्रे॒ यः शि॒श्राय॑ म॒घवा॒ काम॑म॒स्मे । आ॒राच्चि॒त्सन्भ॑यतामस्य॒ शत्रु॒र्न्य॑स्मै द्यु॒म्ना जन्या॑ नमन्ताम्
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ vayám ǀ dadhimá ǀ śáṃsam ǀ índre ǀ yáḥ ǀ śiśrā́ya ǀ maghá-vā ǀ kā́mam ǀ asmé íti ǀārā́t ǀ cit ǀ sán ǀ bhayatām ǀ asya ǀ śátruḥ ǀ ní ǀ asmai ǀ dyumnā́ ǀ jányā ǀ namantām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the enemy of thatIndraon whom we have laid our praise, the lord of affluence, who has grantedus our desires, be in the fear of him even when far off; may the food belonging to the country of the foe bowdown before him (to enjoy).”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒राच्छत्रु॒मप॑ बाधस्व दू॒रमु॒ग्रो यः शम्ब॑: पुरुहूत॒ तेन॑ । अ॒स्मे धे॑हि॒ यव॑म॒द्गोम॑दिन्द्र कृ॒धी धियं॑ जरि॒त्रे वाज॑रत्नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ārā́t ǀ śátrum ǀ ápa ǀ bādhasva ǀ dūrám ǀ ugráḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śámbaḥ ǀ puru-hūta ǀ téna ǀasmé íti ǀ dhehi ǀ yáva-mat ǀ gó-mat ǀ indra ǀ kṛdhí ǀ dhíyam ǀ jaritré ǀ vā́ja-ratnām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Invoked of many, (Indra) drive far away the enemy with that fierce thunderbolt of yours; grant to us,Indra, wealth of barley and cattle; render to the worshipper his sacrifice productive of plural asant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र यम॒न्तर्वृ॑षस॒वासो॒ अग्म॑न्ती॒व्राः सोमा॑ बहु॒लान्ता॑स॒ इन्द्र॑म् । नाह॑ दा॒मानं॑ म॒घवा॒ नि यं॑स॒न्नि सु॑न्व॒ते व॑हति॒ भूरि॑ वा॒मम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ yám ǀ antáḥ ǀ vṛṣa-savā́saḥ ǀ ágman ǀ tīvrā́ḥ ǀ sómāḥ ǀ bahulá-antāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀná ǀ áha ǀ dāmā́nam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ ní ǀ yaṃsat ǀ ní ǀ sunvaté ǀ vahati ǀ bhū́ri ǀ vāmám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheIndrainto whom the sharp abundantSomaeffused by (the priests), the showerers (of the Soma),have entered; he, Maghavat, deserts not the donor of the sacrifice, but bestows ample wealth upon him whopresents libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त प्र॒हाम॑ति॒दीव्या॑ जयाति कृ॒तं यच्छ्व॒घ्नी वि॑चि॒नोति॑ का॒ले । यो दे॒वका॑मो॒ न धना॑ रुणद्धि॒ समित्तं रा॒या सृ॑जति स्व॒धावा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ pra-hā́m ǀ ati-dī́vya ǀ jayāti ǀ kṛtám ǀ yát ǀ śva-ghnī́ ǀ vi-cinóti ǀ kālé ǀyáḥ ǀ devá-kāmaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dhánā ǀ ruṇaddhi ǀ sám ǀ ít ǀ tám ǀ rāyā́ ǀ sṛjati ǀ svadhā́-vān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having driven away the assailant, he triumphs; at the time (of battle) he selects his antagonist as doesa gambler. The man who, desirous of gratifying the gods, withholds not his riches, him the powerful Indraassociates with wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोभि॑ष्टरे॒माम॑तिं दु॒रेवां॒ यवे॑न॒ क्षुधं॑ पुरुहूत॒ विश्वा॑म् । व॒यं राज॑भिः प्रथ॒मा धना॑न्य॒स्माके॑न वृ॒जने॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ tarema ǀ ámatim ǀ duḥ-évām ǀ yávena ǀ kṣúdham ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśvām ǀvayám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ dhánāni ǀ asmā́kena ǀ vṛjánena ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पति॑र्न॒: परि॑ पातु प॒श्चादु॒तोत्त॑रस्मा॒दध॑रादघा॒योः । इन्द्र॑: पु॒रस्ता॑दु॒त म॑ध्य॒तो न॒: सखा॒ सखि॑भ्यो॒ वरि॑वः कृणोतु
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ paścā́t ǀ utá ǀ út-tarasmāt ǀ ádharāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ utá ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBṛhaspatidefend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अच्छा॑ म॒ इन्द्रं॑ म॒तय॑: स्व॒र्विद॑: स॒ध्रीची॒र्विश्वा॑ उश॒तीर॑नूषत । परि॑ ष्वजन्ते॒ जन॑यो॒ यथा॒ पतिं॒ मर्यं॒ न शु॒न्ध्युं म॒घवा॑नमू॒तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: áccha ǀ me ǀ índram ǀ matáyaḥ ǀ svaḥ-vídaḥ ǀ sadhrī́cīḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ uśatī́ḥ ǀ anūṣata ǀpári ǀ svajante ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ pátim ǀ máryam ǀ ná ǀ śundhyúm ǀ maghá-vānam ǀ ūtáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praises, all-acquiring, concentrated and eager, glorifyIndra; they embrace Maghavat as wives(embrace) a husband; as (women embrace) a man free from defect for the sake of protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न घा॑ त्व॒द्रिगप॑ वेति मे॒ मन॒स्त्वे इत्कामं॑ पुरुहूत शिश्रय । राजे॑व दस्म॒ नि ष॒दोऽधि॑ ब॒र्हिष्य॒स्मिन्त्सु सोमे॑ऽव॒पान॑मस्तु ते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ gha ǀ tvadrík ǀ ápa ǀ veti ǀ me ǀ mánaḥ ǀ tvé íti ǀ ít ǀ kā́mam ǀ puru-hūta ǀ śiśraya ǀrā́jā-iva ǀ dasma ǀ ní ǀ sadaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ barhíṣi ǀ asmín ǀ sú ǀ sóme ǀ ava-pā́nam ǀ astu ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, of godly aspect, the invoked of many, my mind intent on you wanders not from your presence, Ifix my desire on you; take your seat like a prince upon this sacred grass, and may your drinking be of thisSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒षू॒वृदिन्द्रो॒ अम॑तेरु॒त क्षु॒धः स इद्रा॒यो म॒घवा॒ वस्व॑ ईशते । तस्येदि॒मे प्र॑व॒णे स॒प्त सिन्ध॑वो॒ वयो॑ वर्धन्ति वृष॒भस्य॑ शु॒ष्मिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: viṣu-vṛ́t ǀ índraḥ ǀ ámateḥ ǀ utá ǀ kṣudháḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ vásvaḥ ǀ īśate ǀtásya ǀ ít ǀ imé ǀ pravaṇé ǀ saptá ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ vardhanti ǀ vṛṣabhásya ǀ śuṣmíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndrabe the remover of thirst and hunger, for he, Maghavat, is lord over precious riches; theseseven rivers of the powerful showerer, (Indra), flowing down a declivity, augment food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वयो॒ न वृ॒क्षं सु॑पला॒शमास॑द॒न्त्सोमा॑स॒ इन्द्रं॑ म॒न्दिन॑श्चमू॒षद॑: । प्रैषा॒मनी॑कं॒ शव॑सा॒ दवि॑द्युतद्वि॒दत्स्व१॒॑र्मन॑वे॒ ज्योति॒रार्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vṛkṣám ǀ su-palāśám ǀ ā́ ǀ asadan ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀ mandínaḥ ǀ camū-sádaḥ ǀprá ǀ eṣām ǀ ánīkam ǀ śávasā ǀ dávidyutat ǀ vidát ǀ sváḥ ǀ mánave ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ā́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As birds perch upon the leafy tree, so the exhilaratingSomafillling the ladles (go) to (Indra), thesummit of them shines through their speed, may Indra spontaneously bestow excellent light upon man.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒तं न श्व॒घ्नी वि चि॑नोति॒ देव॑ने सं॒वर्गं॒ यन्म॒घवा॒ सूर्यं॒ जय॑त् । न तत्ते॑ अ॒न्यो अनु॑ वी॒र्यं॑ शक॒न्न पु॑रा॒णो म॑घव॒न्नोत नूत॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: kṛtám ǀ ná ǀ śva-ghnī́ ǀ ví ǀ cinoti ǀ dévane ǀ sam-várgam ǀ yát ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sū́ryam ǀ jáyat ǀná ǀ tát ǀ te ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vīryám ǀ śakat ǀ ná ǀ purāṇáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ nū́tanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As a gambler at plural y selects his adversary, so does Maghavat when he overcomes the rain-bestowingsun; no one, Maghavat, ancient or modern, is able to imitate this your vigour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विशं॑विशं म॒घवा॒ पर्य॑शायत॒ जना॑नां॒ धेना॑ अव॒चाक॑श॒द्वृषा॑ । यस्याह॑ श॒क्रः सव॑नेषु॒ रण्य॑ति॒ स ती॒व्रैः सोमै॑: सहते पृतन्य॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: víśam-viśam ǀ maghá-vā ǀ pári ǀ aśāyata ǀ jánānām ǀ dhénāḥ ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀyásya ǀ áha ǀ śakráḥ ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ ráṇyati ǀ sáḥ ǀ tīvráiḥ ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ sahate ǀ pṛtanyatáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maghavat, the showerer (of benefits), encompasses all people; he contemplates the praises ofmankind; the man in whose sacrificeŚakradelights, overcomes (foes) wishing to fight by means of his pungentSoma-libations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॒ न सिन्धु॑म॒भि यत्स॒मक्ष॑र॒न्त्सोमा॑स॒ इन्द्रं॑ कु॒ल्या इ॑व ह्र॒दम् । वर्ध॑न्ति॒ विप्रा॒ महो॑ अस्य॒ साद॑ने॒ यवं॒ न वृ॒ष्टिर्दि॒व्येन॒ दानु॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhum ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ sam-ákṣaran ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ índram ǀ kulyā́ḥ-iva ǀ hradám ǀvárdhanti ǀ víprāḥ ǀ máhaḥ ǀ asya ǀ sádane ǀ yávam ǀ ná ǀ vṛṣṭíḥ ǀ divyéna ǀ dā́nunā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When theSomaflows towardsIndra, as waters to the sea, as rivers to a lake, then the piousworshippers augment his greatness in the (sacrificial) abode, as the rain by its heavenly gift, (augments) thebarley.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृषा॒ न क्रु॒द्धः प॑तय॒द्रज॒स्स्वा यो अ॒र्यप॑त्नी॒रकृ॑णोदि॒मा अ॒पः । स सु॑न्व॒ते म॒घवा॑ जी॒रदा॑न॒वेऽवि॑न्द॒ज्ज्योति॒र्मन॑वे ह॒विष्म॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: vṛ́ṣā ǀ ná ǀ kruddháḥ ǀ patayat ǀ rájaḥ-su ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ aryá-patnīḥ ǀ ákṛṇot ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ sunvaté ǀ maghá-vā ǀ jīrá-dānave ǀ ávindat ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ mánave ǀ havíṣmate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As in the world an angry bull rushes (upon another), so doesIndra, who directs (towards us) thewaters, the brides of the lord (of earth); when (theSoma) is effused, Maghavat bestows light upon the man, whogives promptly, who offers oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उज्जा॑यतां पर॒शुर्ज्योति॑षा स॒ह भू॒या ऋ॒तस्य॑ सु॒दुघा॑ पुराण॒वत् । वि रो॑चतामरु॒षो भा॒नुना॒ शुचि॒: स्व१॒॑र्ण शु॒क्रं शु॑शुचीत॒ सत्प॑तिः
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ jāyatām ǀ paraśúḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sahá ǀ bhūyā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ su-dúghā ǀ purāṇa-vát ǀví ǀ rocatām ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ bhānúnā ǀ śúciḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrám ǀ śuśucīta ǀ sát-patiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the axe (ofIndra) be put forth together with light; may the easily milked cow of truth be(manifested) as of old; may the pure and radiant Indra shine with splendour; may the lord of the virtuous shinebrightly like the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोभि॑ष्टरे॒माम॑तिं दु॒रेवां॒ यवे॑न॒ क्षुधं॑ पुरुहूत॒ विश्वा॑म् । व॒यं राज॑भिः प्रथ॒मा धना॑न्य॒स्माके॑न वृ॒जने॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ tarema ǀ ámatim ǀ duḥ-évām ǀ yávena ǀ kṣúdham ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśvām ǀvayám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ dhánāni ǀ asmā́kena ǀ vṛjánena ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पति॑र्न॒: परि॑ पातु प॒श्चादु॒तोत्त॑रस्मा॒दध॑रादघा॒योः । इन्द्र॑: पु॒रस्ता॑दु॒त म॑ध्य॒तो न॒: सखा॒ सखि॑भ्यो॒ वरि॑वः कृणोतु
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ paścā́t ǀ utá ǀ út-tarasmāt ǀ ádharāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ utá ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBṛhaspatidefend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ या॒त्विन्द्र॒: स्वप॑ति॒र्मदा॑य॒ यो धर्म॑णा तूतुजा॒नस्तुवि॑ष्मान् । प्र॒त्व॒क्षा॒णो अति॒ विश्वा॒ सहां॑स्यपा॒रेण॑ मह॒ता वृष्ण्ये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ yātu ǀ índraḥ ǀ svá-patiḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ tūtujānáḥ ǀ túviṣmān ǀpra-tvakṣāṇáḥ ǀ áti ǀ víśvā ǀ sáhāṃsi ǀ apāréṇa ǀ mahatā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, the lord of wealth, come here with his chariot for his exhilaration; he who is rapid, strong,who, overcoming all the forces (of the enemy) by his great insuperable might, (passes) through them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ष्ठामा॒ रथ॑: सु॒यमा॒ हरी॑ ते मि॒म्यक्ष॒ वज्रो॑ नृपते॒ गभ॑स्तौ । शीभं॑ राजन्त्सु॒पथा या॑ह्य॒र्वाङ्वर्धा॑म ते प॒पुषो॒ वृष्ण्या॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: su-sthā́mā ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ su-yámā ǀ hárī íti ǀ te ǀ mimyákṣa ǀ vájraḥ ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ gábhastau ǀśī́bham ǀ rājan ǀ su-páthā ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ arvā́ṅ ǀ várdhāma ǀ te ǀ papúṣaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “King of men, your chariot is well stationed; your horses are well trained; the thunderbolt is grasped inyourhands; come quickly towards us, lord of all, by a good path, we will augment your energies when you drinktheSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एन्द्र॒वाहो॑ नृ॒पतिं॒ वज्र॑बाहुमु॒ग्रमु॒ग्रास॑स्तवि॒षास॑ एनम् । प्रत्व॑क्षसं वृष॒भं स॒त्यशु॑ष्म॒मेम॑स्म॒त्रा स॑ध॒मादो॑ वहन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ indra-vā́haḥ ǀ nṛ-pátim ǀ vájra-bāhum ǀ ugrám ǀ ugrā́saḥ ǀ taviṣā́saḥ ǀ enam ǀprá-tvakṣasam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ satyá-śuṣmam ǀ ā́ ǀ īm ǀ asma-trā́ ǀ sadha-mā́daḥ ǀ vahantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the fierce, vigorous, exulting horses ofIndrabring him here to us, the king of men, armed with thethunderbolt, fierce, the reducer of foes, the showerer (of benefits), whose strength is real.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा पतिं॑ द्रोण॒साचं॒ सचे॑तसमू॒र्जः स्क॒म्भं ध॒रुण॒ आ वृ॑षायसे । ओज॑: कृष्व॒ सं गृ॑भाय॒ त्वे अप्यसो॒ यथा॑ केनि॒पाना॑मि॒नो वृ॒धे
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ pátim ǀ droṇa-sā́cam ǀ sá-cetasam ǀ ūrjáḥ ǀ skambhám ǀ dharúṇe ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣa-yase ǀójaḥ ǀ kṛṣva ǀ sám ǀ gṛbhāya ǀ tvé íti ǀ ápi ǀ ásaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ke-nipā́nām ǀ ináḥ ǀ vṛdhé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily,Indra, you pour into your capacious (stomach) the protecting (Soma), serving the woodentrough, intelligent, holding strength; bestow (upon us) vigour; take us into yourself, for you are the lord for theexaltation of the wise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गम॑न्न॒स्मे वसू॒न्या हि शंसि॑षं स्वा॒शिषं॒ भर॒मा या॑हि सो॒मिन॑: । त्वमी॑शिषे॒ सास्मिन्ना स॑त्सि ब॒र्हिष्य॑नाधृ॒ष्या तव॒ पात्रा॑णि॒ धर्म॑णा
shlokas.transliteration: gáman ǀ asmé íti ǀ vásūni ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ śáṃsiṣam ǀ su-āśíṣam ǀ bháram ǀ ā́ ǀ yāhi ǀ somínaḥ ǀtvám ǀ īśiṣe ǀ sáḥ ǀ asmín ǀ ā́ ǀ satsi ǀ barhíṣi ǀ anādhṛṣyā́ ǀ táva ǀ pā́trāṇi ǀ dhármaṇā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the wealth (to be given by you) come quickly to me, for verily I have glorified you; come to theblessed sacrifice of the offerer of theSoma; for you are the lord; sit down upon this sacred grass; these yourcups (of Soma) are not to be insulted by the act (of evil spirits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृथ॒क्प्राय॑न्प्रथ॒मा दे॒वहू॑त॒योऽकृ॑ण्वत श्रव॒स्या॑नि दु॒ष्टरा॑ । न ये शे॒कुर्य॒ज्ञियां॒ नाव॑मा॒रुह॑मी॒र्मैव ते न्य॑विशन्त॒ केप॑यः
shlokas.transliteration: pṛ́thak ǀ prá ǀ āyan ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ devá-hūtayaḥ ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀ śravasyā́ni ǀ dustárā ǀná ǀ yé ǀ śekúḥ ǀ yajñíyām ǀ nā́vam ǀ ā-rúham ǀ īrmā́ ǀ evá ǀ té ǀ ní ǀ aviśanta ǀ képayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They go separately (to the worlds of the gods); first those who offer oblations to the gods haveattained reputation difficult to surpass; those who have not been able to ascend the ship of sacrifice, have gonedown (in the world), wretches (plural nged) in debt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वैवापा॒गप॑रे सन्तु दू॒ढ्योऽश्वा॒ येषां॑ दु॒र्युज॑ आयुयु॒ज्रे । इ॒त्था ये प्रागुप॑रे॒ सन्ति॑ दा॒वने॑ पु॒रूणि॒ यत्र॑ व॒युना॑नि॒ भोज॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ evá ǀ ápāk ǀ ápare ǀ santu ǀ duḥ-dhyáḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ yéṣām ǀ duḥ-yújaḥ ǀ ā-yuyujré ǀitthā́ ǀ yé ǀ prā́k ǀ úpare ǀ sánti ǀ dāváne ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ yátra ǀ vayúnāni ǀ bhójanā ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: गि॒रीँरज्रा॒न्रेज॑मानाँ अधारय॒द्द्यौः क्र॑न्दद॒न्तरि॑क्षाणि कोपयत् । स॒मी॒ची॒ने धि॒षणे॒ वि ष्क॑भायति॒ वृष्ण॑: पी॒त्वा मद॑ उ॒क्थानि॑ शंसति
shlokas.transliteration: girī́n ǀ ájrān ǀ réjamānān ǀ adhārayat ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ krandat ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ kopayat ǀsamīcīné íti sam-īcīné ǀ dhiṣáṇe íti ǀ ví ǀ skabhāyati ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ pītvā́ ǀ máde ǀ ukthā́ni ǀ śaṃsati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra) has arrested the wandering tremulous clouds; the heaven cries out (in alarm); he agitates thefirmament; he fixes the combined heaven and earth; having drunk of the effusedSoma, he repeats praises in hisexhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं बि॑भर्मि॒ सुकृ॑तं ते अङ्कु॒शं येना॑रु॒जासि॑ मघवञ्छफा॒रुज॑: । अ॒स्मिन्त्सु ते॒ सव॑ने अस्त्वो॒क्यं॑ सु॒त इ॒ष्टौ म॑घवन्बो॒ध्याभ॑गः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ bibharmi ǀ sú-kṛtam ǀ te ǀ aṅkuśám ǀ yéna ǀ ā-rujā́si ǀ magha-van ǀ śapha-ārújaḥ ǀasmín ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ sávane ǀ astu ǀ okyám ǀ suté ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ magha-van ǀ bodhi ǀ ā́-bhagaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bear this your well-made goad, (excited) by which, Maghavat, you urge on the slayers of powerfulfoes. Let your abode be at this my sacrifice. Accept, Maghavat, who are to be adored, (my praise) at the sacrificeat which (theSoma) is effused.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गोभि॑ष्टरे॒माम॑तिं दु॒रेवां॒ यवे॑न॒ क्षुधं॑ पुरुहूत॒ विश्वा॑म् । व॒यं राज॑भिः प्रथ॒मा धना॑न्य॒स्माके॑न वृ॒जने॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: góbhiḥ ǀ tarema ǀ ámatim ǀ duḥ-évām ǀ yávena ǀ kṣúdham ǀ puru-hūta ǀ víśvām ǀvayám ǀ rā́ja-bhiḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ dhánāni ǀ asmā́kena ǀ vṛjánena ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, invoked of many, may we escape all ignorance caused by poverty by means of our cattle; (maywe escape) all hunger by means of our barley; (may we acquire) the chief riches through the princes (of wealth);may we conquer by our valour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बृह॒स्पति॑र्न॒: परि॑ पातु प॒श्चादु॒तोत्त॑रस्मा॒दध॑रादघा॒योः । इन्द्र॑: पु॒रस्ता॑दु॒त म॑ध्य॒तो न॒: सखा॒ सखि॑भ्यो॒ वरि॑वः कृणोतु
shlokas.transliteration: bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ paścā́t ǀ utá ǀ út-tarasmāt ǀ ádharāt ǀ agha-yóḥ ǀíndraḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ utá ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ sákhi-bhyaḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kṛṇotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayBṛhaspatidefend us from a malignant (foe) coming from behind, from above, or from below; mayIndra defend us from foes in front and in the middle; may he, our friend, bestow wealth upon (us) his friends.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वस्परि॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॑ज्ञे अ॒ग्निर॒स्मद्द्वि॒तीयं॒ परि॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः । तृ॒तीय॑म॒प्सु नृ॒मणा॒ अज॑स्र॒मिन्धा॑न एनं जरते स्वा॒धीः
shlokas.transliteration: diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ prathamám ǀ jajñe ǀ agníḥ ǀ asmát ǀ dvitī́yam ǀ pári ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀtṛtī́yam ǀ ap-sú ǀ nṛ-mánāḥ ǀ ájasram ǀ índhānaḥ ǀ enam ǀ jarate ǀ su-ādhī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniwas first born above the sky; as Ja-tavedas he was born the second time among us; the friend ofman, he was born the third time in the watters; the sage kindlin him eternally praises him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒द्मा ते॑ अग्ने त्रे॒धा त्र॒याणि॑ वि॒द्मा ते॒ धाम॒ विभृ॑ता पुरु॒त्रा । वि॒द्मा ते॒ नाम॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यद्वि॒द्मा तमुत्सं॒ यत॑ आज॒गन्थ॑
shlokas.transliteration: vidmá ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ tredhā́ ǀ trayā́ṇi ǀ vidmá ǀ te ǀ dhā́ma ǀ ví-bhṛtā ǀ puru-trā́ ǀvidmá ǀ te ǀ nā́ma ǀ paramám ǀ gúhā ǀ yát ǀ vidmá ǀ tám ǀ útsam ǀ yátaḥ ǀ ā-jagántha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We recognize your threefold station,Agni, and your three (forms); we recognize the many stationsoccupied by you; we know what your supreme secret appellation (is); we know the source, whence you haveproceeded.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रे त्वा॑ नृ॒मणा॑ अ॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर्नृ॒चक्षा॑ ईधे दि॒वो अ॑ग्न॒ ऊध॑न् । तृ॒तीये॑ त्वा॒ रज॑सि तस्थि॒वांस॑म॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षा अ॑वर्धन्
shlokas.transliteration: samudré ǀ tvā ǀ nṛ-mánāḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ īdhe ǀ diváḥ ǀ agne ǀ ū́dhan ǀtṛtī́ye ǀ tvā ǀ rájasi ǀ tasthi-vā́ṃsam ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀ mahiṣā́ḥ ǀ avardhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who is well disposed towards men illumines theAgniin the ocean (as submarine fire), in the midstof the waters; the beholder of men (illumines) you in the centre of the sky; the mighty (maruts) magnify youabiding in the third region (the firmament), on the lap of the waters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्निः स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौः क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुध॑: सम॒ञ्जन् । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: ákrandat ǀ agníḥ ǀ stanáyan-iva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ kṣā́ma ǀ rérihat ǀ vīrúdhaḥ ǀ sam-añján ǀsadyáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ īm ǀ iddháḥ ǀ ákhyat ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ bhānúnā ǀ bhāti ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agnicries aloud like the thundering heaven; he licks the earth burning the plural nts; as soon asgenerated, he contemplates this (conflagration); when kindled he blazes with his (own) radiance between heavenand earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्री॒णामु॑दा॒रो ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णां म॑नी॒षाणां॒ प्रार्प॑ण॒: सोम॑गोपाः । वसु॑: सू॒नुः सह॑सो अ॒प्सु राजा॒ वि भा॒त्यग्र॑ उ॒षसा॑मिधा॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: śrīṇā́m ǀ ut-āráḥ ǀ dharúṇaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ manīṣā́ṇām ǀ pra-árpaṇaḥ ǀ sóma-gopāḥ ǀvásuḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ rā́jā ǀ ví ǀ bhāti ǀ ágre ǀ uṣásām ǀ idhānáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Liberal, exciter of splendours, depositary of riches, granter of desires, preserver of theSoma, theinhabiter (of the world), the son of strength, (plural ced) in the waters, the king (Agni) blazes, kindled at thecommencement of dawn.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्व॑स्य के॒तुर्भुव॑नस्य॒ गर्भ॒ आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ज्जाय॑मानः । वी॒ळुं चि॒दद्रि॑मभिनत्परा॒यञ्जना॒ यद॒ग्निमय॑जन्त॒ पञ्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśvasya ǀ ketúḥ ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāt ǀ jā́yamānaḥ ǀvīḷúm ǀ cit ǀ ádrim ǀ abhinat ǀ parā-yán ǀ jánāḥ ǀ yát ǀ agním ǀ áyajanta ǀ páñca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The manifester of all, the germ of the world,Agni, as soon as born fills heaven and earth (with light);he fractures as he advances the solid cloud, for which the classes of men praise him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒शिक्पा॑व॒को अ॑र॒तिः सु॑मे॒धा मर्ते॑ष्व॒ग्निर॒मृतो॒ नि धा॑यि । इय॑र्ति धू॒मम॑रु॒षं भरि॑भ्र॒दुच्छु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॒ द्यामिन॑क्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: uśík ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ su-medhā́ḥ ǀ márteṣu ǀ agníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhāyi ǀíyarti ǀ dhūmám ǀ aruṣám ǀ bháribhrat ǀ út ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ dyā́m ǀ ínakṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Desiring (oblations), purifying, moving quickly, sagacious, immortal,Agnihas been stationed amongmortals; he sends forth the smoke, and goes wearing a radiant (form), and percading the heaven with brilliantlustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दृ॒शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॑र्वि॒या व्य॑द्यौद्दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायु॑: श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः । अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं॒ द्यौर्ज॒नय॑त्सु॒रेता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dṛśānáḥ ǀ rukmáḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ duḥ-márṣam ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ śriyé ǀ rucānáḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ abhavat ǀ váyaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ yát ǀ enam ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ janáyat ǀ su-rétāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conspicuous, glorious,Agnishines with great splendour, moving everywhere, and blazingunsurpassingly with glory; Agni became immortal through the food (of sacrifice) when the prolific heavenengendered him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ अ॒द्य कृ॒णव॑द्भद्रशोचेऽपू॒पं दे॑व घृ॒तव॑न्तमग्ने । प्र तं न॑य प्रत॒रं वस्यो॒ अच्छा॒भि सु॒म्नं दे॒वभ॑क्तं यविष्ठ
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ adyá ǀ kṛṇávat ǀ bhadra-śoce ǀ apūpám ǀ deva ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ agne ǀprá ǀ tám ǀ naya ǀ pra-tarám ǀ vásyaḥ ǀ áccha ǀ abhí ǀ sumnám ǀ devá-bhaktam ǀ yaviṣṭha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Auspiciously radiant and divineAgni, youngest (of the gods), grant ample wealth to the eminent(worshipper), who presents to you today cakes dressed with butter, and confer happiness upon one devoted tothe gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ तं भ॑ज सौश्रव॒सेष्व॑ग्न उ॒क्थौ॑क्थ॒ आ भ॑ज श॒स्यमा॑ने । प्रि॒यः सूर्ये॑ प्रि॒यो अ॒ग्ना भ॑वा॒त्युज्जा॒तेन॑ भि॒नद॒दुज्जनि॑त्वैः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tám ǀ bhaja ǀ sauśravaséṣu ǀ agne ǀ ukthé-ukthe ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ śasyámāne ǀpriyáḥ ǀ sū́rye ǀ priyáḥ ǀ agnā́ ǀ bhavāti ǀ út ǀ jāténa ǀ bhinádat ǀ út ǀ jáni-tvaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prosper the worshipper,Agni, when beautiful sacrificial viands (are being offered), when sacredpraises are being recited (by him). May he be dear toSūrya, dear to Agni; may he by a son born, or sons to beborn, overcome (his foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ यज॑माना॒ अनु॒ द्यून्विश्वा॒ वसु॑ दधिरे॒ वार्या॑णि । त्वया॑ स॒ह द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑ना व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ yájamānāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǀ víśvā ǀ vásu ǀ dadhire ǀ vā́ryāṇi ǀtváyā ǀ sahá ǀ dráviṇam ǀ icchámānāḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ ví ǀ vavruḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Agni, the worshippers offer daily all desirable treasures; (abiding) with you, desirous of wealth,the sages have set open the pasturage frequented by cattle.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस्ता॑व्य॒ग्निर्न॒रां सु॒शेवो॑ वैश्वान॒र ऋषि॑भि॒: सोम॑गोपाः । अ॒द्वे॒षे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी हु॑वेम॒ देवा॑ ध॒त्त र॒यिम॒स्मे सु॒वीर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ástāvi ǀ agníḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ su-śévaḥ ǀ vaiśvānaráḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣi-bhiḥ ǀ sóma-gopāḥ ǀadveṣé íti ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ huvema ǀ dévāḥ ǀ dhattá ǀ rayím ǀ asmé íti ǀ su-vī́ram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are very dear to men,Vaiśvānara, the guardian of theSoma, has been glorified by the”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र होता॑ जा॒तो म॒हान्न॑भो॒विन्नृ॒षद्वा॑ सीदद॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ । दधि॒र्यो धायि॒ स ते॒ वयां॑सि य॒न्ता वसू॑नि विध॒ते त॑नू॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ hótā ǀ jātáḥ ǀ mahā́n ǀ nabhaḥ-vít ǀ nṛ-sádvā ǀ sīdat ǀ apā́m ǀ upá-sthe ǀdádhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhā́yi ǀ sáḥ ǀ te ǀ váyāṃsi ǀ yantā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ vidhaté ǀ tanū-pā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “A mighty ministrant priest, one cognizant of heaven, though abiding with men, having been born, isseated on the lap of the waters; may he, the upholder (of sacrifice), who has been stationed (on the altar), be toyou when offering worship, the giver of food and riches, the protector of your person n.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं वि॒धन्तो॑ अ॒पां स॒धस्थे॑ प॒शुं न न॒ष्टं प॒दैरनु॑ ग्मन् । गुहा॒ चत॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ नमो॑भिरि॒च्छन्तो॒ धीरा॒ भृग॑वोऽविन्दन्
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ vidhántaḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ paśúm ǀ ná ǀ naṣṭám ǀ padáiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ gman ǀgúhā ǀ cátantam ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ icchántaḥ ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ avindan ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं त्रि॒तो भूर्य॑विन्ददि॒च्छन्वै॑भूव॒सो मू॒र्धन्यघ्न्या॑याः । स शेवृ॑धो जा॒त आ ह॒र्म्येषु॒ नाभि॒र्युवा॑ भवति रोच॒नस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ tritáḥ ǀ bhū́ri ǀ avindat ǀ icchán ǀ vaibhu-vasáḥ ǀ mūrdháni ǀ ághnyāyāḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ śé-vṛdhaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ harmyéṣu ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ yúvā ǀ bhavati ǀ rocanásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Trita, the son of Vibhuvas, searching (for him), found mightyAgnion the head of the cow; he theaugmenter of happiness manifested in the dwellings (of the pious), the youthful (connecting) bond of theresplendent (Sun).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒न्द्रं होता॑रमु॒शिजो॒ नमो॑भि॒: प्राञ्चं॑ य॒ज्ञं ने॒तार॑मध्व॒राणा॑म् । वि॒शाम॑कृण्वन्नर॒तिं पा॑व॒कं ह॑व्य॒वाहं॒ दध॑तो॒ मानु॑षेषु
shlokas.transliteration: mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ uśíjaḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ yajñám ǀ netā́ram ǀ adhvarā́ṇām ǀviśā́m ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ aratím ǀ pāvakám ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ dádhataḥ ǀ mā́nuṣeṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The priests) desirous (to propitiate him), detaining him among men, have by their adoration made himlord over all people, him the exhilarator, the presenteer of burnt offerings, the migrator, the object of sacrifice, theleader of rites, the purifier, the bearer of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र भू॒र्जय॑न्तं म॒हां वि॑पो॒धां मू॒रा अमू॑रं पु॒रां द॒र्माण॑म् । नय॑न्तो॒ गर्भं॑ व॒नां धियं॑ धु॒र्हिरि॑श्मश्रुं॒ नार्वा॑णं॒ धन॑र्चम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ bhūḥ ǀ jáyantam ǀ mahā́n ǀ vipaḥ-dhā́m ǀ mūrā́ḥ ǀ ámūram ǀ purā́m ǀ darmā́ṇam ǀnáyantaḥ ǀ gárbham ǀ vanā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ dhuḥ ǀ híri-śmaśrum ǀ ná ǀ árvāṇam ǀ dhána-arcam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Be competent, (priest, to glorify) the victorious mightyAgni, the sustainer of the wise, (even) fools(adore) him, the exempt from folly, the demolisher of cities; conducting the embryo of touchwood, (Agni). Like agolden- haired, swift-moving (horse), loving praise and wealth, they bring him to the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि प॒स्त्या॑सु त्रि॒तः स्त॑भू॒यन्परि॑वीतो॒ योनौ॑ सीदद॒न्तः । अत॑: सं॒गृभ्या॑ वि॒शां दमू॑ना॒ विध॑र्मणाय॒न्त्रैरी॑यते॒ नॄन्
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ pastyā́su ǀ tritáḥ ǀ stabhu-yán ǀ pári-vītaḥ ǀ yónau ǀ sīdat ǀ antáríti ǀátaḥ ǀ sam-gṛ́bhya ǀ viśā́m ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ ví-dharmaṇā ǀ ayantráiḥ ǀ īyate ǀ nṝ́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Occupying three (satations), consolidation (the dwelling of the worshipper), surrounded (by flames),he sits down upon the altar in the chambers (of sacrifice); from there, having accepted (the oblations) of thepeople, with intent to give (them to the gods), in various ways, he (Agni) goes to the gods holding (his foes) incheck.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्याजरा॑सो द॒माम॒रित्रा॑ अ॒र्चद्धू॑मासो अ॒ग्नय॑: पाव॒काः । श्वि॒ती॒चय॑: श्वा॒त्रासो॑ भुर॒ण्यवो॑ वन॒र्षदो॑ वा॒यवो॒ न सोमा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ ajárāsaḥ ǀ damā́m ǀ arítrāḥ ǀ arcát-dhūmāsaḥ ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ pāvakā́ḥ ǀśvitīcáyaḥ ǀ śvātrā́saḥ ǀ bhuraṇyávaḥ ǀ vana-sádaḥ ǀ vāyávaḥ ǀ ná ǀ sómāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The undecaying fires of the worshipper, the rescuers from the humiliated (spirits of ill), havingadorable smoke, purifying, becoming white, swift, bearing (the oblation), sitting in the wood, (are) like thefast-flowingSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र जि॒ह्वया॑ भरते॒ वेपो॑ अ॒ग्निः प्र व॒युना॑नि॒ चेत॑सा पृथि॒व्याः । तमा॒यव॑: शु॒चय॑न्तं पाव॒कं म॒न्द्रं होता॑रं दधिरे॒ यजि॑ष्ठम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ jihváyā ǀ bharate ǀ vépaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ prá ǀ vayúnāni ǀ cétasā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀtám ǀ āyávaḥ ǀ śucáyantam ǀ pāvakám ǀ mandrám ǀ hótāram ǀ dadhire ǀ yájiṣṭham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who bears off (the oblation) with his tongue (of flames), who bears off the hymns of praise with(favourable) mind (for the preservation) of the earth; him men appointed as the shining, purifying, exultinghotā,the most entitled to worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्यावा॒ यम॒ग्निं पृ॑थि॒वी जनि॑ष्टा॒माप॒स्त्वष्टा॒ भृग॑वो॒ यं सहो॑भिः । ई॒ळेन्यं॑ प्रथ॒मं मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दे॒वास्त॑तक्षु॒र्मन॑वे॒ यज॑त्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: dyā́vā ǀ yám ǀ agním ǀ pṛthivī́ íti ǀ jániṣṭām ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ yám ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀīḷényam ǀ prathamám ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ mánave ǀ yájatram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, whom heaven and earth engendered, (whom) the waters andTvaṣṭā, and the Bṛghus by theirpowers (begot),; the adorable one, whomMātariśvanfirst, and the gods fabricated as the object of worship ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं त्वा॑ दे॒वा द॑धि॒रे ह॑व्य॒वाहं॑ पुरु॒स्पृहो॒ मानु॑षासो॒ यज॑त्रम् । स याम॑न्नग्ने स्तुव॒ते वयो॑ धा॒: प्र दे॑व॒यन्य॒शस॒: सं हि पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ tvā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ puru-spṛ́haḥ ǀ mā́nuṣāsaḥ ǀ yájatram ǀsáḥ ǀ yā́man ǀ agne ǀ stuvaté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ prá ǀ deva-yán ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, whom the gods appointed as the bearer of oblations, whom men, desiring manifold blessings,regard as the object of worship; do you,Agni, bestow food upon him who praises you at the sacrifice; for thedevout worshipper verily obtains great renown.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒गृ॒भ्मा ते॒ दक्षि॑णमिन्द्र॒ हस्तं॑ वसू॒यवो॑ वसुपते॒ वसू॑नाम् । वि॒द्मा हि त्वा॒ गोप॑तिं शूर॒ गोना॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: jagṛbhmá ǀ te ǀ dákṣiṇam ǀ indra ǀ hástam ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ vasu-pate ǀ vásūnām ǀvidmá ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ gó-patim ǀ śūra ǀ gónām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, lord of abundant wealth, we, desiring wealth, seize hold of your righthand; we know you, hero,lord of abundant cattle, give us various fertilizing riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्वा॒यु॒धं स्वव॑सं सुनी॒थं चतु॑:समुद्रं ध॒रुणं॑ रयी॒णाम् । च॒र्कृत्यं॒ शंस्यं॒ भूरि॑वारम॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-āyudhám ǀ su-ávasam ǀ su-nīthám ǀ cátuḥ-samudram ǀ dharúṇam ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀcarkṛ́tyam ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ bhū́ri-vāram ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We know you to be) well armed, a sure protector, a safe guide, (renowned throughout) the fouroceans, the depositary of riches, deserving of repeated worship, adorable, the preventer of many (ills); grant usvarious fertilizing riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ब्रह्मा॑णं दे॒वव॑न्तं बृ॒हन्त॑मु॒रुं ग॑भी॒रं पृ॒थुबु॑ध्नमिन्द्र । श्रु॒तऋ॑षिमु॒ग्रम॑भिमाति॒षाह॑म॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: su-bráhmāṇam ǀ devá-vantam ǀ bṛhántam ǀ urúm ǀ gabhīrám ǀ pṛthú-budhnam ǀ indra ǀśrutá-ṛṣim ǀ ugrám ǀ abhimāti-sáham ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, various fertilizing riches, the fit object of prayer, honoured by the gods, large, vast,”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒नद्वा॑जं॒ विप्र॑वीरं॒ तरु॑त्रं धन॒स्पृतं॑ शूशु॒वांसं॑ सु॒दक्ष॑म् । द॒स्यु॒हनं॑ पू॒र्भिद॑मिन्द्र स॒त्यम॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sanát-vājam ǀ vípra-vīram ǀ tárutram ǀ dhana-spṛ́tam ǀ śūśu-vā́ṃsam ǀ su-dákṣam ǀdasyuhánam ǀ pūḥ-bhídam ǀ indra ǀ satyám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, various fertilizing riches, dispensing food, comprising intelligentmaleoffspring, theprotector, filling men with wealth, the granter of increase, the very powerful, the slayer of theDasyus, thedestroyer of cities, the observer of truth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्वा॑वन्तं र॒थिनं॑ वी॒रव॑न्तं सह॒स्रिणं॑ श॒तिनं॒ वाज॑मिन्द्र । भ॒द्रव्रा॑तं॒ विप्र॑वीरं स्व॒र्षाम॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áśva-vantam ǀ rathínam ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ sahasríṇam ǀ śatínam ǀ vā́jam ǀ indra ǀbhadrá-vrātam ǀ vípra-vīram ǀ svaḥ-sā́m ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Grant us,Indra, various fettilizing wealth, consisting of horses, of chariots, of valiant followers, ofthousands, of hundreds (of cattle), surrounded by beautiful attendants, endowed with sages and heroes, theenjoyer of all (benefits).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र स॒प्तगु॑मृ॒तधी॑तिं सुमे॒धां बृह॒स्पतिं॑ म॒तिरच्छा॑ जिगाति । य आ॑ङ्गिर॒सो नम॑सोप॒सद्यो॒ऽस्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ saptá-gum ǀ ṛtá-dhītim ǀ su-medhā́m ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ matíḥ ǀ áccha ǀ jigāti ǀyáḥ ǀ āṅgirasáḥ ǀ námasā ǀ upa-sádyaḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The praise (addressed to the gods) comes to the presence of Saptagu, the observer of the truth, theintelligent, the lord of much (praise), who, being of the family ofAṅgirasa, has approached (the gods) withoblations; do you, (Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वनी॑वानो॒ मम॑ दू॒तास॒ इन्द्रं॒ स्तोमा॑श्चरन्ति सुम॒तीरि॑या॒नाः । हृ॒दि॒स्पृशो॒ मन॑सा व॒च्यमा॑ना अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: vánīvānaḥ ǀ máma ǀ dūtā́saḥ ǀ índram ǀ sómāḥ ǀ caranti ǀ su-matī́ḥ ǀ iyānā́ḥ ǀhṛdi-spṛ́śaḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ vacyámānāḥ ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praises, (my) messengers soliciting ((audience), come toIndra, praying (his) favourable (thoughts),heart-touching, spoken from thesoul; (therefore, Indra) grant me various fertilizing riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्त्वा॒ यामि॑ द॒द्धि तन्न॑ इन्द्र बृ॒हन्तं॒ क्षय॒मस॑मं॒ जना॑नाम् । अ॒भि तद्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी गृ॑णीताम॒स्मभ्यं॑ चि॒त्रं वृष॑णं र॒यिं दा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ tvā ǀ yā́mi ǀ daddhí ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ bṛhántam ǀ kṣáyam ǀ ásamam ǀ jánānām ǀabhí ǀ tát ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ gṛṇītām ǀ asmábhyam ǀ citrám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ rayím ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bestow,Indra, that which I solicit of you; a large mansion, not held in common with other men; andmay heaven and earth approve of it; grant us, (Indra), various fertilizing riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं भु॑वं॒ वसु॑नः पू॒र्व्यस्पति॑र॒हं धना॑नि॒ सं ज॑यामि॒ शश्व॑तः । मां ह॑वन्ते पि॒तरं॒ न ज॒न्तवो॒ऽहं दा॒शुषे॒ वि भ॑जामि॒ भोज॑नम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ahám ǀ dhánāni ǀ sám ǀ jayāmi ǀ śáśvataḥ ǀmā́m ǀ havante ǀ pitáram ǀ ná ǀ jantávaḥ ǀ ahám ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ ví ǀ bhajāmi ǀ bhójanam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am the principal lord of wealth; I conquer the treasure of many (adversaries); living beings call uponme as (sons call upon) a father; I bestow food on the donor of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमिन्द्रो॒ रोधो॒ वक्षो॒ अथ॑र्वणस्त्रि॒ताय॒ गा अ॑जनय॒महे॒रधि॑ । अ॒हं दस्यु॑भ्य॒: परि॑ नृ॒म्णमा द॑दे गो॒त्रा शिक्ष॑न्दधी॒चे मा॑त॒रिश्व॑ने
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ródhaḥ ǀ vákṣaḥ ǀ átharvaṇaḥ ǀ tritā́ya ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ ajanayam ǀ áheḥ ǀ ádhi ǀahám ǀ dásyu-bhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ gotrā́ ǀ śíkṣan ǀ dadhīcé ǀ mātaríśvane ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I,Indra, amd the strtiker off of the head of the son ofAtharvan, I genitive rated the waters from above thecloud for the sake ofTrita. I carried off their wealth from theDasyus; taming the clouds for Dadhyañc, the son ofMātariśvan.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मह्यं॒ त्वष्टा॒ वज्र॑मतक्षदाय॒सं मयि॑ दे॒वासो॑ऽवृज॒न्नपि॒ क्रतु॑म् । ममानी॑कं॒ सूर्य॑स्येव दु॒ष्टरं॒ मामार्य॑न्ति कृ॒तेन॒ कर्त्वे॑न च
shlokas.transliteration: máhyam ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ vájram ǀ atakṣat ǀ āyasám ǀ máyi ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ avṛjan ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀmáma ǀ ánīkam ǀ sū́ryasya-iva ǀ dustáram ǀ mā́m ǀ ā́ryanti ǀ kṛténa ǀ kártvena ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For meTvaṣṭāfabricated the metal thunderbolt; in me the gods have concentrated pious acts; mylustre is insurmountable, like that of the Sun; men acknowledge me as lord in consequence of what I have done,and of what I shall do.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमे॒तं ग॒व्यय॒मश्व्यं॑ प॒शुं पु॑री॒षिणं॒ साय॑केना हिर॒ण्यय॑म् । पु॒रू स॒हस्रा॒ नि शि॑शामि दा॒शुषे॒ यन्मा॒ सोमा॑स उ॒क्थिनो॒ अम॑न्दिषुः
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ etám ǀ gavyáyam ǀ áśvyam ǀ paśúm ǀ purīṣíṇam ǀ sā́yakena ǀ hiraṇyáyam ǀpurú ǀ sahásrā ǀ ní ǀ śiśāmi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ sómāsaḥ ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ ámandiṣuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I conquered) by my shaft this (wealth) comprehending kine, horses, herds, water, and gold; I givemany thousands to the donor (of the oblation) when libations and praises have afforded me delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमिन्द्रो॒ न परा॑ जिग्य॒ इद्धनं॒ न मृ॒त्यवेऽव॑ तस्थे॒ कदा॑ च॒न । सोम॒मिन्मा॑ सु॒न्वन्तो॑ याचता॒ वसु॒ न मे॑ पूरवः स॒ख्ये रि॑षाथन
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ párā ǀ jigye ǀ ít ǀ dhánam ǀ ná ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ áva ǀ tasthe ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǀsómam ǀ ít ǀ mā ǀ sunvántaḥ ǀ yācata ǀ vásu ǀ ná ǀ me ǀ pūravaḥ ǀ sakhyé ǀ riṣāthana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I,Indra, am not surpassed in affluence; I never yield to death; pouring forth theSomalibation, ask ofme wealth; O men, forfeit not my friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमे॒ताञ्छाश्व॑सतो॒ द्वाद्वेन्द्रं॒ ये वज्रं॑ यु॒धयेऽकृ॑ण्वत । आ॒ह्वय॑मानाँ॒ अव॒ हन्म॑नाहनं दृ॒ळ्हा वद॒न्नन॑मस्युर्नम॒स्विन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ etā́n ǀ śā́śvasataḥ ǀ dvā́-dvā ǀ índram ǀ yé ǀ vájram ǀ yudháye ǀ ákṛṇvata ǀā-hváyamānān ǀ áva ǀ hánmanā ǀ ahanam ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ vádan ǀ ánamasyuḥ ǀ namasvínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I destroy those powerful (enemies) two by two who defy the (wielder of the) thunderbolt,Indra, tobattle, I slew them challenging (me to fight) with (great) slaughter, the unbending (slaying) the bending, theuttering stern (menaces).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी॒३॒॑दमेक॒मेको॑ अस्मि नि॒ष्षाळ॒भी द्वा किमु॒ त्रय॑: करन्ति । खले॒ न प॒र्षान्प्रति॑ हन्मि॒ भूरि॒ किं मा॑ निन्दन्ति॒ शत्र॑वोऽनि॒न्द्राः
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ idám ǀ ékam ǀ ékaḥ ǀ asmi ǀ niṣṣā́ṭ ǀ abhí ǀ dvā́ ǀ kím ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tráyaḥ ǀ karanti ǀkhále ǀ ná ǀ parṣā́n ǀ práti ǀ hanmi ǀ bhū́ri ǀ kím ǀ mā ǀ nindanti ǀ śátravaḥ ǀ anindrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Single, I overcome my single (adversary); (over-powering them) I overcome two foes; what can threeenemies who know notIndrarevile me?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं गु॒ङ्गुभ्यो॑ अतिथि॒ग्वमिष्क॑र॒मिषं॒ न वृ॑त्र॒तुरं॑ वि॒क्षु धा॑रयम् । यत्प॑र्णय॒घ्न उ॒त वा॑ करञ्ज॒हे प्राहं म॒हे वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॒ अशु॑श्रवि
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ guṅgú-bhyaḥ ǀ atithi-gvám ǀ íṣkaram ǀ íṣam ǀ ná ǀ vṛtra-túram ǀ vikṣú ǀ dhārayam ǀyát ǀ parṇaya-ghné ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ karañja-hé ǀ prá ǀ ahám ǀ mahé ǀ vṛtra-hátye ǀ áśuśravi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I preparedAtithigvafor (the protection of) the Guṅgus, I upheld him, the destroyer of enemies, assustenance among the people; when I gained renown in the greatVṛtra-battle, in whichParṇayaandKarañja= hospitable; guṅgus = name of a people; parṇaya and karañja = names ofasuras].”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र मे॒ नमी॑ सा॒प्य इ॒षे भु॒जे भू॒द्गवा॒मेषे॑ स॒ख्या कृ॑णुत द्वि॒ता । दि॒द्युं यद॑स्य समि॒थेषु॑ मं॒हय॒मादिदे॑नं॒ शंस्य॑मु॒क्थ्यं॑ करम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ me ǀ námī ǀ sāpyáḥ ǀ iṣé ǀ bhujé ǀ bhūt ǀ gávām ǀ éṣe ǀ sakhyā́ ǀ kṛṇuta ǀ dvitā́ ǀdidyúm ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ maṃháyam ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ enam ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ ukthyám ǀ karam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “My praiser, the refuge (of all), was food to enjoy; (him, men) use in two ways, to search for their cattle,and to be their freiend, when I bestow upon him a weapon in his battles, and make him worthy of celebrity andpraise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नेम॑स्मिन्ददृशे॒ सोमो॑ अ॒न्तर्गो॒पा नेम॑मा॒विर॒स्था कृ॑णोति । स ति॒ग्मशृ॑ङ्गं वृष॒भं युयु॑त्सन्द्रु॒हस्त॑स्थौ बहु॒ले ब॒द्धो अ॒न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ némasmin ǀ dadṛśe ǀ sómaḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ némam ǀ āvíḥ ǀ asthā́ ǀ kṛṇoti ǀsáḥ ǀ tigmá-śṛṅgam ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ yúyutsan ǀ druháḥ ǀ tasthau ǀ bahulé ǀ baddháḥ ǀ antáríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheSomais seen in one of the two (combatants); the cowherd (Indra) manifests the other with histhunderbolt; the latter warring against the sharp- horned bull, remains in great (darkness) bound by the victoṛ”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्यानां॒ वसू॑नां रु॒द्रिया॑णां दे॒वो दे॒वानां॒ न मि॑नामि॒ धाम॑ । ते मा॑ भ॒द्राय॒ शव॑से ततक्षु॒रप॑राजित॒मस्तृ॑त॒मषा॑ळ्हम्
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́nām ǀ vásūnām ǀ rudríyāṇām ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ná ǀ mināmi ǀ dhā́ma ǀté ǀ mā ǀ bhadrā́ya ǀ śávase ǀ tatakṣuḥ ǀ áparā-jitam ǀ ástṛtam ǀ áṣāḷham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine (Indra) abandons not the abode of the deities, theĀdityas, theVasus, and the Rudriyas;may they fashion me for auspicious vigour, undefeated, unharmed, unconquered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं दां॑ गृण॒ते पूर्व्यं॒ वस्व॒हं ब्रह्म॑ कृणवं॒ मह्यं॒ वर्ध॑नम् । अ॒हं भु॑वं॒ यज॑मानस्य चोदि॒ताय॑ज्वनः साक्षि॒ विश्व॑स्मि॒न्भरे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ dām ǀ gṛṇaté ǀ pū́rvyam ǀ vásu ǀ ahám ǀ bráhma ǀ kṛṇavam ǀ máhyam ǀ várdhanam ǀahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ coditā́ ǀ áyajvanaḥ ǀ sākṣi ǀ víśvasmin ǀ bháre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I give excellent treasure to him who praises me, I render sacred prayer (a source) of greatness tomyself, I am the instrumental gator of the worshipper; I am the discomfiter in every battle of him who does not worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मां धु॒रिन्द्रं॒ नाम॑ दे॒वता॑ दि॒वश्च॒ ग्मश्चा॒पां च॑ ज॒न्तव॑: । अ॒हं हरी॒ वृष॑णा॒ विव्र॑ता र॒घू अ॒हं वज्रं॒ शव॑से धृ॒ष्ण्वा द॑दे
shlokas.transliteration: mā́m ǀ dhuḥ ǀ índram ǀ nā́ma ǀ devátā ǀ diváḥ ǀ ca ǀ gmáḥ ǀ ca ǀ apā́m ǀ ca ǀ jantávaḥ ǀahám ǀ hárī íti ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ ví-vratā ǀ raghū́ íti ǀ ahám ǀ vájram ǀ śávase ǀ dhṛṣṇú ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those born in heaven, in earth, and in the firmament, support me, whose name isIndraamong thedeities (by their offerings). I (harness to my car) two bay steeds vigorous, many-functioned, rapid; I wield for mystrength the fearful thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमत्कं॑ क॒वये॑ शिश्नथं॒ हथै॑र॒हं कुत्स॑मावमा॒भिरू॒तिभि॑: । अ॒हं शुष्ण॑स्य॒ श्नथि॑ता॒ वध॑र्यमं॒ न यो र॒र आर्यं॒ नाम॒ दस्य॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ átkam ǀ kaváye ǀ śiśnatham ǀ háthaiḥ ǀ ahám ǀ kútsam ǀ āvam ǀ ābhíḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀahám ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ śnáthitā ǀ vádhaḥ ǀ yamam ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ raré ǀ ā́ryam ǀ nā́ma ǀ dásyave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I smote Atka with many weapons for the defence of the sage; with those protections I preservedKutsa;I am the slayer ofŚuṣṇa; I grasped the thunderbolt I who have not given the water (nāma) of theĀryasto theDasyu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं पि॒तेव॑ वेत॒सूँर॒भिष्ट॑ये॒ तुग्रं॒ कुत्सा॑य॒ स्मदि॑भं च रन्धयम् । अ॒हं भु॑वं॒ यज॑मानस्य रा॒जनि॒ प्र यद्भरे॒ तुज॑ये॒ न प्रि॒याधृषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ pitā́-iva ǀ vetasū́n ǀ abhíṣṭaye ǀ túgram ǀ kútsāya ǀ smát-ibham ǀ ca ǀ randhayam ǀahám ǀ bhuvam ǀ yájamānasya ǀ rājáni ǀ prá ǀ yát ǀ bhare ǀ tújaye ǀ ná ǀ priyā́ ǀ ā-dhṛ́ṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like a father (for a son), I brought under subjection toKutsa, at his desire, the Vetasūs and Tugraand Smadibha I have been in plural ce of a sovereign to the worshipper when I bring (to him) as to a son acceptable(gifts) for assailing (his enemies).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं र॑न्धयं॒ मृग॑यं श्रु॒तर्व॑णे॒ यन्माजि॑हीत व॒युना॑ च॒नानु॒षक् । अ॒हं वे॒शं न॒म्रमा॒यवे॑ऽकरम॒हं सव्या॑य॒ पड्गृ॑भिमरन्धयम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ randhayam ǀ mṛ́gayam ǀ śrutárvaṇe ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ ájihīta ǀ vayúnā ǀ caná ǀ ānuṣák ǀahám ǀ veśám ǀ namrám ǀ āyáve ǀ akaram ǀ ahám ǀ sávyāya ǀ páṭ-gṛbhim ǀ arandhayam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have broughtMṛgayaunder subjection to Śrutarvan; when he came to me, (he was) earnestlyengaged in supplication. I humiliatedVeśafor Āyu; I subjugated Padgṛbhi forSavya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं स यो नव॑वास्त्वं बृ॒हद्र॑थं॒ सं वृ॒त्रेव॒ दासं॑ वृत्र॒हारु॑जम् । यद्व॒र्धय॑न्तं प्र॒थय॑न्तमानु॒षग्दू॒रे पा॒रे रज॑सो रोच॒नाक॑रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ bṛhát-ratham ǀ sám ǀ vṛtrā́-iva ǀ dā́sam ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ árujam ǀyát ǀ vardháyantam ǀ pratháyantam ǀ ānuṣák ǀ dūré ǀ pāré ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ ákaram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I, the slayer ofVṛtra, am he who crushed Navavāstva andBṛhadratha, (who crushed)Dāsalike aVṛtra, when I drove to the distant shore of the shining world, (both) my augmenting and outstretched (foes) oneafter the other.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं सूर्य॑स्य॒ परि॑ याम्या॒शुभि॒: प्रैत॒शेभि॒र्वह॑मान॒ ओज॑सा । यन्मा॑ सा॒वो मनु॑ष॒ आह॑ नि॒र्णिज॒ ऋध॑क्कृषे॒ दासं॒ कृत्व्यं॒ हथै॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ pári ǀ yāmi ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ etaśébhiḥ ǀ váhamānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀyát ǀ mā ǀ sāváḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ā́ha ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ kṛṣe ǀ dā́sam ǀ kṛ́tvyam ǀ háthaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Conveyed by the swift white horses ofSūrya, I hasten forth by my power; when the effused libation ofa man invokes me to the brilliant form of the sacrifice, I drive off with my weapons the destroyer who is to beslain.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं स॑प्त॒हा नहु॑षो॒ नहु॑ष्टर॒: प्राश्रा॑वयं॒ शव॑सा तु॒र्वशं॒ यदु॑म् । अ॒हं न्य१॒॑न्यं सह॑सा॒ सह॑स्करं॒ नव॒ व्राध॑तो नव॒तिं च॑ वक्षयम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ sapta-hā́ ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ náhuḥ-taraḥ ǀ prá ǀ aśravayam ǀ śávasā ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀahám ǀ ní ǀ anyám ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ karam ǀ náva ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ vakṣayam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am the slayer of seven (asuras); I am the especial bond of bonds; I have madeTurvaśaand Yadufamous through prowess; I have strengthened another (worshipper) with strength; I have demolished ninety andnine powerful (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं स॒प्त स्र॒वतो॑ धारयं॒ वृषा॑ द्रवि॒त्न्व॑: पृथि॒व्यां सी॒रा अधि॑ । अ॒हमर्णां॑सि॒ वि ति॑रामि सु॒क्रतु॑र्यु॒धा वि॑दं॒ मन॑वे गा॒तुमि॒ष्टये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ saptá ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ dhārayam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ dravitnváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀahám ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ ví ǀ tirāmi ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ vidam ǀ mánave ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The showerer (of rain), I supported the seven rivers flowing and meandering over the earth; doer ofgood deeds, I spread out the waters; I found by war a path for man to go in.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं तदा॑सु धारयं॒ यदा॑सु॒ न दे॒वश्च॒न त्वष्टाधा॑रय॒द्रुश॑त् । स्पा॒र्हं गवा॒मूध॑स्सु व॒क्षणा॒स्वा मधो॒र्मधु॒ श्वात्र्यं॒ सोम॑मा॒शिर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ tát ǀ āsu ǀ dhārayam ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ caná ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ádhārayat ǀ rúśat ǀspārhám ǀ gávām ǀ ū́dhaḥ-su ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ ā́ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ śvā́tryam ǀ sómam ǀ ā-śíram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have kept up in them that which no deity, not evenTvaṣṭā, has maintained, bright, desirable,(contained) in the udders of the cows; in the rivers (I uphold) the water up to the (source of the) water, thedelightfulSomaand the milk and curds.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा दे॒वाँ इन्द्रो॑ विव्ये॒ नॄन्प्र च्यौ॒त्नेन॑ म॒घवा॑ स॒त्यरा॑धाः । विश्वेत्ता ते॑ हरिवः शचीवो॒ऽभि तु॒रास॑: स्वयशो गृणन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ devā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ vivye ǀ nṝ́n ǀ prá ǀ cyautnéna ǀ maghá-vā ǀ satyá-rādhāḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ turā́saḥ ǀ sva-yaśaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ म॒हे मन्द॑माना॒यान्ध॒सोऽर्चा॑ वि॒श्वान॑राय विश्वा॒भुवे॑ । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ यस्य॒ सुम॑खं॒ सहो॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॒ रोद॑सी सप॒र्यत॑:
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ mándamānāya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ árca ǀ viśvā́narāya ǀ viśva-bhúve ǀíndrasya ǀ yásya ǀ sú-makham ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ca ǀ ródasī íti ǀ saparyátaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship him who is exhilarated by the sacrificiial food, the mightyIndra; the leader of all men, thecreator of all, whose venerable strength and abundant food and wealth, heaven and earth adore.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सो चि॒न्नु सख्या॒ नर्य॑ इ॒नः स्तु॒तश्च॒र्कृत्य॒ इन्द्रो॒ माव॑ते॒ नरे॑ । विश्वा॑सु धू॒र्षु वा॑ज॒कृत्ये॑षु सत्पते वृ॒त्रे वा॒प्स्व१॒॑भि शू॑र मन्दसे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ sákhyā ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ carkṛ́tyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ mā́-vate ǀ náre ǀvíśvāsu ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ vāja-kṛ́tyeṣu ǀ sat-pate ǀ vṛtré ǀ vā ǀ ap-sú ǀ abhí ǀ śūra ǀ mandase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatIndra, kind to man, the lord of all, who is praised by his friend, is to be repeatedly honoured bymen like me; you, hero, protector of the good, are glorified in the all-sustaining food-producing cloud-imprisonedwaters.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के ते नर॑ इन्द्र॒ ये त॑ इ॒षे ये ते॑ सु॒म्नं स॑ध॒न्य१॒॑मिय॑क्षान् । के ते॒ वाजा॑यासु॒र्या॑य हिन्विरे॒ के अ॒प्सु स्वासू॒र्वरा॑सु॒ पौंस्ये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ té ǀ náraḥ ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ iṣé ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ sa-dhanyám ǀ íyakṣān ǀké ǀ te ǀ vā́jāya ǀ asuryā́ya ǀ hinvire ǀ ké ǀ ap-sú ǀ svā́su ǀ urvárāsu ǀ páuṃsye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What men,Indra, are they who (are eminent in offering food to you, who are desirous of obtaining fromthe happiness and opulence, who send you (oblations) for the sake of strength (to fight) theasura, who (sentoblations) for the sake of obtaining spontaneously-flowing waters and cultivable lands, and manly vigour?”

shlokas.sanskrit: भुव॒स्त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ ब्रह्म॑णा म॒हान्भुवो॒ विश्वे॑षु॒ सव॑नेषु य॒ज्ञिय॑: । भुवो॒ नॄँश्च्यौ॒त्नो विश्व॑स्मि॒न्भरे॒ ज्येष्ठ॑श्च॒ मन्त्रो॑ विश्वचर्षणे
shlokas.transliteration: bhúvaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ mahā́n ǀ bhúvaḥ ǀ víśveṣu ǀ sávaneṣu ǀ yajñíyaḥ ǀbhúvaḥ ǀ nṝ́n ǀ cyautnáḥ ǀ víśvasmin ǀ bháre ǀ jyéṣṭhaḥ ǀ ca ǀ mántraḥ ǀ viśva-carṣaṇe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, you have become mighty through our praise; you have have become adorable at all sacrifices,in every combat you are the caster down of the leaders (of hosts); beholder of all, you are the best, mostexcellent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॒ नु कं॒ ज्याया॑न्य॒ज्ञव॑नसो म॒हीं त॒ ओमा॑त्रां कृ॒ष्टयो॑ विदुः । असो॒ नु क॑म॒जरो॒ वर्धा॑श्च॒ विश्वेदे॒ता सव॑ना तूतु॒मा कृ॑षे
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ jyā́yān ǀ yajñá-vanasaḥ ǀ mahī́m ǀ te ǀ ómātrām ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀ viduḥ ǀásaḥ ǀ nú ǀ kam ǀ ajáraḥ ǀ várdhāḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśvā ǀ ít ǀ etā́ ǀ sávanā ǀ tūtumā́ ǀ kṛṣe ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता विश्वा॒ सव॑ना तूतु॒मा कृ॑षे स्व॒यं सू॑नो सहसो॒ यानि॑ दधि॒षे । वरा॑य ते॒ पात्रं॒ धर्म॑णे॒ तना॑ य॒ज्ञो मन्त्रो॒ ब्रह्मोद्य॑तं॒ वच॑:
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ sávanā ǀ tūtumā́ ǀ kṛṣe ǀ svayám ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ yā́ni ǀ dadhiṣé ǀvárāya ǀ te ǀ pā́tram ǀ dhármaṇe ǀ tánā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ mántraḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ út-yatam ǀ vácaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You make swift all those sacrifices which, son of strength, you yourself support; may your protectionbe granted for the repulse (of enemies, may) wealth (be granted) for our support; the sacrifice, the hymn, thesacred text, the voice (is) raised (to you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये ते॑ विप्र ब्रह्म॒कृत॑: सु॒ते सचा॒ वसू॑नां च॒ वसु॑नश्च दा॒वने॑ । प्र ते सु॒म्नस्य॒ मन॑सा प॒था भु॑व॒न्मदे॑ सु॒तस्य॑ सो॒म्यस्यान्ध॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ te ǀ vipra ǀ brahma-kṛ́taḥ ǀ suté ǀ sácā ǀ vásūnām ǀ ca ǀ vásunaḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāváne ǀprá ǀ té ǀ sumnásya ǀ mánasā ǀ pathā́ ǀ bhuvan ǀ máde ǀ sutásya ǀ somyásya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “SageIndra, the reciters of pious hymns to you who assembled together when (theSoma) is effused,(worship you) for the donation of riches and treasures; may they be competent (to acquire) you felicity by thepathway of the mind; when you are exhilarated with the effused Soma food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हत्तदुल्बं॒ स्थवि॑रं॒ तदा॑सी॒द्येनावि॑ष्टितः प्रवि॒वेशि॑था॒पः । विश्वा॑ अपश्यद्बहु॒धा ते॑ अग्ने॒ जात॑वेदस्त॒न्वो॑ दे॒व एक॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahát ǀ tát ǀ úlbam ǀ stháviram ǀ tát ǀ āsīt ǀ yéna ǀ ā́-viṣṭitaḥ ǀ pra-vivéśitha ǀ apáḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ apaśyat ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods speak). Great and very dense is the covering enveloped by which,Agni, you have enteredinto the waters. AgniJātavedas, one deity has beheld all your manifold forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को मा॑ ददर्श कत॒मः स दे॒वो यो मे॑ त॒न्वो॑ बहु॒धा प॒र्यप॑श्यत् । क्वाह॑ मित्रावरुणा क्षियन्त्य॒ग्नेर्विश्वा॑: स॒मिधो॑ देव॒यानी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ mā ǀ dadarśa ǀ katamáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ me ǀ tanváḥ ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ pari-ápaśyat ǀkvá ǀ áha ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ kṣiyanti ǀ agnéḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sam-ídhaḥ ǀ deva-yā́nīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agnispeaks). Who has beheld me? Which is it of the deities who has fully seen my manifold forms?WhereMitraandVaruṇa, do Agni's luminous vehicles of the gods abide?”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐच्छा॑म त्वा बहु॒धा जा॑तवेद॒: प्रवि॑ष्टमग्ने अ॒प्स्वोष॑धीषु । तं त्वा॑ य॒मो अ॑चिकेच्चित्रभानो दशान्तरु॒ष्याद॑ति॒रोच॑मानम्
shlokas.transliteration: áicchāma ǀ tvā ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ prá-viṣṭam ǀ agne ǀ ap-sú ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ yamáḥ ǀ aciket ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ daśa-antaruṣyā́t ǀ ati-rócamānam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods). We sought for you,AgniJātavedas, who had entered in many ways into the waters, intothe plural nts;Yamarecognized you, who have adorable rays, blazing from your ten hiding-plural ces.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हो॒त्राद॒हं व॑रुण॒ बिभ्य॑दायं॒ नेदे॒व मा॑ यु॒नज॒न्नत्र॑ दे॒वाः । तस्य॑ मे त॒न्वो॑ बहु॒धा निवि॑ष्टा ए॒तमर्थं॒ न चि॑केता॒हम॒ग्निः
shlokas.transliteration: hotrā́t ǀ ahám ǀ varuṇa ǀ bíbhyat ǀ āyam ǀ ná ǀ ít ǀ evá ǀ mā ǀ yunájan ǀ átra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀtásya ǀ me ǀ tanváḥ ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ ní-viṣṭāḥ ǀ etám ǀ ártham ǀ ná ǀ ciketa ǀ ahám ǀ agníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni). DivineVaruṇa, I have come hither, being afraid ofhotā, lest the gods should again associateme with him; my forms have therefore entered (into the waters) in various plural ces. I, Agni, do not consent (toundertake) that office.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एहि॒ मनु॑र्देव॒युर्य॒ज्ञका॑मोऽरं॒कृत्या॒ तम॑सि क्षेष्यग्ने । सु॒गान्प॒थः कृ॑णुहि देव॒याना॒न्वह॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ सुमन॒स्यमा॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ mánuḥ ǀ deva-yúḥ ǀ yajñá-kāmaḥ ǀ aram-kṛ́tya ǀ támasi ǀ kṣeṣi ǀ agne ǀsu-gā́n ǀ patháḥ ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ deva-yā́nān ǀ váha ǀ havyā́ni ǀ su-manasyámānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods). Come,Agni, the devoutManu(is) desirous of offering sacrifice; adorning yourself, youabide in darkness; make straight the paths traversed by the gods, and with a benevolent mind convey ouroblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेः पूर्वे॒ भ्रात॑रो॒ अर्थ॑मे॒तं र॒थीवाध्वा॑न॒मन्वाव॑रीवुः । तस्मा॑द्भि॒या व॑रुण दू॒रमा॑यं गौ॒रो न क्षे॒प्नोर॑विजे॒ ज्याया॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ bhrā́taraḥ ǀ ártham ǀ etám ǀ rathī́-iva ǀ ádhvānam ǀ ánu ǀ ā́ ǀ avarīvuríti ǀtásmāt ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ varuṇa ǀ dūrám ǀ āyam ǀ gauráḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣepnóḥ ǀ avije ǀ jyā́yāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni). The elder brothers of Agni performed that duty, as the driver of a chariot covers the roaḍ(They were slain), and therefore,Varuṇa, I fled afar through fear. I trembled as a wild ox (tembles) at thebowstring of the archer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒र्मस्त॒ आयु॑र॒जरं॒ यद॑ग्ने॒ यथा॑ यु॒क्तो जा॑तवेदो॒ न रिष्या॑: । अथा॑ वहासि सुमन॒स्यमा॑नो भा॒गं दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒विष॑: सुजात
shlokas.transliteration: kurmáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ajáram ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ yáthā ǀ yuktáḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ríṣyāḥ ǀátha ǀ vahāsi ǀ su-manasyámānaḥ ǀ bhāgám ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ su-jāta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods). We grant you life,Agni, which (is) exempt from decay, so that thus endowed,Jātavedas,you will not die; so, becoming conciliated, well- born, Agni, bear their portion of the oblation to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒या॒जान्मे॑ अनुया॒जाँश्च॒ केव॑ला॒नूर्ज॑स्वन्तं ह॒विषो॑ दत्त भा॒गम् । घृ॒तं चा॒पां पुरु॑षं॒ चौष॑धीनाम॒ग्नेश्च॑ दी॒र्घमायु॑रस्तु देवाः
shlokas.transliteration: pra-yājā́n ǀ me ǀ anu-yājā́n ǀ ca ǀ kévalān ǀ ū́rjasvantam ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ datta ǀ bhāgám ǀghṛtám ǀ ca ǀ apā́m ǀ púruṣam ǀ ca ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ca ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ astu ǀ devāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agni). Only grant to me, deities, the concentrated portion of the oblation the Prayājas and Anuyājasexclusively; (give me) the butter (the essence) of the waters, and man (the essence) of the plural nts; and let the lifeof Agni be long.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॑ प्रया॒जा अ॑नुया॒जाश्च॒ केव॑ल॒ ऊर्ज॑स्वन्तो ह॒विष॑: सन्तु भा॒गाः । तवा॑ग्ने य॒ज्ञो॒३॒॑ऽयम॑स्तु॒ सर्व॒स्तुभ्यं॑ नमन्तां प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ pra-yājā́ḥ ǀ anu-yājā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ kévale ǀ ū́rjasvantaḥ ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ santu ǀ bhāgā́ḥ ǀtáva ǀ agne ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ astu ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ túbhyam ǀ namantām ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods). Yours,Agni, be the Prayājas and Anuyājas exclusively; yours be the concentrated portions of the oblations; let this sacrifice; Agni, be all yours, and let the four quarters of space bow down beforeyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ देवाः शा॒स्तन॑ मा॒ यथे॒ह होता॑ वृ॒तो म॒नवै॒ यन्नि॒षद्य॑ । प्र मे॑ ब्रूत भाग॒धेयं॒ यथा॑ वो॒ येन॑ प॒था ह॒व्यमा वो॒ वहा॑नि
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devāḥ ǀ śāstána ǀ mā ǀ yáthā ǀ ihá ǀ hótā ǀ vṛtáḥ ǀ manávai ǀ yát ǀ ni-sádya ǀprá ǀ me ǀ brūta ǀ bhāga-dhéyam ǀ yáthā ǀ vaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ pathā́ ǀ havyám ǀ ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ váhāni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “instrumental uct me,Viśvedevās, since I am appointedHotā, how sitting here I ought to praise you; declareto me your portion; how you have acquired it, and by what path I may convey the oblation to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं होता॒ न्य॑सीदं॒ यजी॑या॒न्विश्वे॑ दे॒वा म॒रुतो॑ मा जुनन्ति । अह॑रहरश्वि॒नाध्व॑र्यवं वां ब्र॒ह्मा स॒मिद्भ॑वति॒ साहु॑तिर्वाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ hótā ǀ ní ǀ asīdam ǀ yájīyān ǀ víśve ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ mā ǀ junanti ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ ā́dhvaryavam ǀ vām ǀ brahmā́ ǀ sam-ít ǀ bhavati ǀ sā́ ǀ ā́-hutiḥ ǀ vām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Best entitled to the sacrifice, I have sat down as theHotā; all the divineMarutsurge me( to bear theoblation); the office of theAdhvaryuis to be discharged daily,Aśvins, by you; let the moon be thebrahman, andlet it be also your oblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं यो होता॒ किरु॒ स य॒मस्य॒ कमप्यू॑हे॒ यत्स॑म॒ञ्जन्ति॑ दे॒वाः । अह॑रहर्जायते मा॒सिमा॒स्यथा॑ दे॒वा द॑धिरे हव्य॒वाह॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ yáḥ ǀ hótā ǀ kíḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sáḥ ǀ yamásya ǀ kám ǀ ápi ǀ ūhe ǀ yát ǀ sam-añjánti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀáhaḥ-ahaḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ māsí-māsi ǀ átha ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ havya-vā́ham ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who is this, who is theHotā? (Afraid) ofYama, what offering does he bear that the gods accept?Agniis born day by day, and month by month, and so the gods have made for themselves a bearer of oblationṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: मां दे॒वा द॑धिरे हव्य॒वाह॒मप॑म्लुक्तं ब॒हु कृ॒च्छ्रा चर॑न्तम् । अ॒ग्निर्वि॒द्वान्य॒ज्ञं न॑: कल्पयाति॒ पञ्च॑यामं त्रि॒वृतं॑ स॒प्तत॑न्तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: mā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhire ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ ápa-mluktam ǀ bahú ǀ kṛcchrā́ ǀ cárantam ǀagníḥ ǀ vidvā́n ǀ yajñám ǀ naḥ ǀ kalpayāti ǀ páñca-yāmam ǀ tri-vṛ́tam ǀ saptá-tantum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have made me the bearer of oblations returning after departure, and passing many difficultplaces; (saying) thisAgniis wise; he will accomplish the sacrifice for us, whether it be that of the five ways, thethree kinds, or the seven threads.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वो॑ यक्ष्यमृत॒त्वं सु॒वीरं॒ यथा॑ वो देवा॒ वरि॑व॒: करा॑णि । आ बा॒ह्वोर्वज्र॒मिन्द्र॑स्य धेया॒मथे॒मा विश्वा॒: पृत॑ना जयाति
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vaḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ su-vī́ram ǀ yáthā ǀ vaḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ várivaḥ ǀ kárāṇi ǀā́ ǀ bāhvóḥ ǀ vájram ǀ índrasya ǀ dheyām ǀ átha ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ jayāti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, I solicit of you immortality and excellentmaleoffspring, that I may offer you adoration. I causeIndra to take the thunderbolt in hishands, wherewith he may overcome all these hostile hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ श॒ता त्री स॒हस्रा॑ण्य॒ग्निं त्रिं॒शच्च॑ दे॒वा नव॑ चासपर्यन् । औक्ष॑न्घृ॒तैरस्तृ॑णन्ब॒र्हिर॑स्मा॒ आदिद्धोता॑रं॒ न्य॑सादयन्त
shlokas.transliteration: trī́ṇi ǀ śatā́ ǀ trī́ ǀ sahásrāṇi ǀ agním ǀ triṃśát ǀ ca ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ náva ǀ ca ǀ asaparyan ǀáukṣan ǀ ghṛtáiḥ ǀ ástṛṇan ǀ barhíḥ ǀ asmai ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ hótāram ǀ ní ǀ asādayanta ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Three thousand three hundred and thirty-and-nine deities worshippedAgni, they sprinkled (me) withbutter, they strewed the sacred grass, and then made the invoker of the gods sit down.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यमैच्छा॑म॒ मन॑सा॒ सो॒३॒॑ऽयमागा॑द्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ वि॒द्वान्परु॑षश्चिकि॒त्वान् । स नो॑ यक्षद्दे॒वता॑ता॒ यजी॑या॒न्नि हि षत्स॒दन्त॑र॒: पूर्वो॑ अ॒स्मत्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ áicchāma ǀ mánasā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ayám ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ yajñásya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ páruṣaḥ ǀ cikitvā́n ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yakṣat ǀ devá-tātā ǀ yájīyān ǀ ní ǀ hí ǀ satsat ǀ ántaraḥ ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ asmát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods). He whom we sought with (anxious) minds has arrived; he who understands the sacrificeand is acquainted with its different parts; may he who is most skilled in worship, sacrifice for us at the worship ofthe gods, being seated (at the altar), taking plural ce among (the priests), and preceding us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरा॑धि॒ होता॑ नि॒षदा॒ यजी॑यान॒भि प्रयां॑सि॒ सुधि॑तानि॒ हि ख्यत् । यजा॑महै य॒ज्ञिया॒न्हन्त॑ दे॒वाँ ईळा॑महा॒ ईड्याँ॒ आज्ये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: árādhi ǀ hótā ǀ ni-sádā ǀ yájīyān ǀ abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ sú-dhitāni ǀ hí ǀ khyát ǀyájāmahai ǀ yajñíyān ǀ hánta ǀ devā́n ǀ ī́ḷāmahai ǀ ī́ḍyān ǀ ā́jyena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thehotā, most skilled in worship, has been sanctified by his seat (at the altar); he contemplates thesacred offerings reverently plural ced (before him); let us speedily worship with ghī the gods to whom worship isdue; let us praise those who are entitled to praise.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा॒ध्वीम॑कर्दे॒ववी॑तिं नो अ॒द्य य॒ज्ञस्य॑ जि॒ह्वाम॑विदाम॒ गुह्या॑म् । स आयु॒रागा॑त्सुर॒भिर्वसा॑नो भ॒द्राम॑कर्दे॒वहू॑तिं नो अ॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: sādhvī́m ǀ akaḥ ǀ devá-vītim ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ yajñásya ǀ jihvā́m ǀ avidāma ǀ gúhyām ǀsáḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agāt ǀ surabhíḥ ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ bhadrā́m ǀ akaḥ ǀ devá-hūtim ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has today made our banquet to the gods efficacious; we have obtained the mysterious tongue ofsacrifice; he has come, fragrant, clothed with life; he makes our oblation to the gods today auspicious.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद॒द्य वा॒चः प्र॑थ॒मं म॑सीय॒ येनासु॑राँ अ॒भि दे॒वा असा॑म । ऊर्जा॑द उ॒त य॑ज्ञियास॒: पञ्च॑ जना॒ मम॑ हो॒त्रं जु॑षध्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ adyá ǀ vācáḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ masīya ǀ yéna ǀ ásurān ǀ abhí ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ásāma ǀū́rja-adaḥ ǀ utá ǀ yajñiyāsaḥ ǀ páñca ǀ janāḥ ǀ máma ǀ hotrám ǀ juṣadhvam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agnispeaks). I communicate today the best advice by which we gods may overcome theasuras; doyou who are the eaters of sacrificial food, who are entitled to worship, and you five orders of men, be plural ased bymy (discharge of) the office ofhotā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पञ्च॒ जना॒ मम॑ हो॒त्रं जु॑षन्तां॒ गोजा॑ता उ॒त ये य॒ज्ञिया॑सः । पृ॒थि॒वी न॒: पार्थि॑वात्पा॒त्वंह॑सो॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षं दि॒व्यात्पा॑त्व॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: páñca ǀ jánāḥ ǀ máma ǀ hotrám ǀ juṣantām ǀ gó-jātāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yé ǀ yajñíyāsaḥ ǀpṛthivī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ pā́rthivāt ǀ pātu ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀ divyā́t ǀ pātu ǀ asmā́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the fiver orders of men, may those who were born for the sake of ghī, may those who areentitled to worship be plural ased by my (discharge of) the office ofhotā; may earth preserve us from all earthly sin;may the firmament preserve us from heavenly (sin).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तन्तुं॑ त॒न्वन्रज॑सो भा॒नुमन्वि॑हि॒ ज्योति॑ष्मतः प॒थो र॑क्ष धि॒या कृ॒तान् । अ॒नु॒ल्ब॒णं व॑यत॒ जोगु॑वा॒मपो॒ मनु॑र्भव ज॒नया॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म्
