shlokas.transliteration: tántum ǀ tanván ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ bhānúm ǀ ánu ǀ ihi ǀ jyótiṣmataḥ ǀ patháḥ ǀ rakṣa ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ kṛtā́n ǀanulbaṇám ǀ vayata ǀ jóguvām ǀ ápaḥ ǀ mánuḥ ǀ bhava ǀ janáya ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods) spreading out the sacrifice, follow the illuminator of the world (the sun); protect theluminous paths (of the gods) constructed by sacred acts; mayAgnirender the pious works of the worshipper freefrom defect; becomeManu, genitive rate the people of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒क्षा॒नहो॑ नह्यतनो॒त सो॑म्या॒ इष्कृ॑णुध्वं रश॒ना ओत पिं॑शत । अ॒ष्टाव॑न्धुरं वहता॒भितो॒ रथं॒ येन॑ दे॒वासो॒ अन॑यन्न॒भि प्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: akṣa-náhaḥ ǀ nahyatana ǀ utá ǀ somyāḥ ǀ íṣkṛṇudhvam ǀ raśanā́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ piṃśata ǀaṣṭā́-vandhuram ǀ vahata ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ yéna ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ánayan ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The gods to one another). Drinkers of theSoma, bind (the horses) that are to be fastened to the pole;prepare the reins; caparison (the steeds); accompany everywhere (in your cars) the chariot which has eightseats with which the gods bring us acceptable (wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अश्म॑न्वती रीयते॒ सं र॑भध्व॒मुत्ति॑ष्ठत॒ प्र त॑रता सखायः । अत्रा॑ जहाम॒ ये अस॒न्नशे॑वाः शि॒वान्व॒यमुत्त॑रेमा॒भि वाजा॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: áśman-vatī ǀ rīyate ǀ sám ǀ rabhadhvam ǀ út ǀ tiṣṭhata ǀ prá ǀ tarata ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀátra ǀ jahāma ǀ yé ǀ ásan ǀ áśevāḥ ǀ śivā́n ǀ vayám ǀ út ǀ tarema ǀ abhí ǀ vā́jān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The aśmanvatī flows along; be alert; rise up, cross over, may friends; here let us leave those whoare unhappy, so that we may cross over to auspicious sacrificial viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वष्टा॑ मा॒या वे॑द॒पसा॑म॒पस्त॑मो॒ बिभ्र॒त्पात्रा॑ देव॒पाना॑नि॒ शंत॑मा । शिशी॑ते नू॒नं प॑र॒शुं स्वा॑य॒सं येन॑ वृ॒श्चादेत॑शो॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tváṣṭā ǀ māyā́ ǀ vet ǀ apásām ǀ apáḥ-tamaḥ ǀ bíbhrat ǀ pā́trā ǀ deva-pā́nāni ǀ śám-tamā ǀśíśīte ǀ nūnám ǀ paraśúm ǀ su-āyasám ǀ yéna ǀ vṛścā́t ǀ étaśaḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Tvaṣṭāknows the arts of fabricating (drinking vessels), the most skilful of artificers bearing thesacred drinking cups out of which the gods drink-- verily he sharpens his axe of good metal, wherewith thewhite- complexionedbrahmaṇaspaticuts them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒तो नू॒नं क॑वय॒: सं शि॑शीत॒ वाशी॑भि॒र्याभि॑र॒मृता॑य॒ तक्ष॑थ । वि॒द्वांस॑: प॒दा गुह्या॑नि कर्तन॒ येन॑ दे॒वासो॑ अमृत॒त्वमा॑न॒शुः
shlokas.transliteration: satáḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ kavayaḥ ǀ sám ǀ śiśīta ǀ vā́śībhiḥ ǀ yā́bhiḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ tákṣatha ǀvidvā́ṃsaḥ ǀ padā́ ǀ gúhyāni ǀ kartana ǀ yéna ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily being sages, (Ṛbhus) sharpen the instrumental uments with which you fabricate the cups for the nectaṛDo you, who are wise, prepare the mysterious paths whereby tte gods have attained to immortality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गर्भे॒ योषा॒मद॑धुर्व॒त्समा॒सन्य॑पी॒च्ये॑न॒ मन॑सो॒त जि॒ह्वया॑ । स वि॒श्वाहा॑ सु॒मना॑ यो॒ग्या अ॒भि सि॑षा॒सनि॑र्वनते का॒र इज्जिति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: gárbhe ǀ yóṣām ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ āsáni ǀ apīcyéna ǀ mánasā ǀ utá ǀ jihváyā ǀsáḥ ǀ viśvā́hā ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ yogyā́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sisāsániḥ ǀ vanate ǀ kāráḥ ǀ ít ǀ jítim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(TheMaruts) plural ced a feminine le in the enveloping hide (of a dead cow), and a calf in the mouth (of adead cow), with mind and tongue, aiming (at deification); daily the genitive rous (fraternity of theṚbhus) offerssuitable praises (to the gods), granting victory over our foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तां सु ते॑ की॒र्तिं म॑घवन्महि॒त्वा यत्त्वा॑ भी॒ते रोद॑सी॒ अह्व॑येताम् । प्रावो॑ दे॒वाँ आति॑रो॒ दास॒मोज॑: प्र॒जायै॑ त्वस्यै॒ यदशि॑क्ष इन्द्र
shlokas.transliteration: tā́m ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ kīrtím ǀ magha-van ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ bhīté íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ áhvayetām ǀprá ǀ āvaḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ atiraḥ ǀ dā́sam ǀ ójaḥ ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ tvasyai ǀ yát ǀ áśikṣaḥ ǀ indra ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I celebrate), Maghavat, the great glory (you have acquired) by your might; when heaven and earthalarmed called upon you, you did defend the gods, and destroy (their) adversary; (I celebrate your glory),Indra,in that you gave strength to one person n (the worshipper).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदच॑रस्त॒न्वा॑ वावृधा॒नो बला॑नीन्द्र प्रब्रुवा॒णो जने॑षु । मा॒येत्सा ते॒ यानि॑ यु॒द्धान्या॒हुर्नाद्य शत्रुं॑ न॒नु पु॒रा वि॑वित्से
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ácaraḥ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ bálāni ǀ indra ǀ pra-bruvāṇáḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀmāyā́ ǀ ít ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ yā́ni ǀ yuddhā́ni ǀ āhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ adyá ǀ śátrum ǀ nanú ǀ purā́ ǀ vivitse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you proceed,Indra, increasing in form, and proclaiming your prowess among mankind, false isthat your (wandering), false the combats which you have narrated; you (find) now no enemy (to attack), did youformerly find one? person n you have genitive rated at once both mother and father (or earth and heaven)?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क उ॒ नु ते॑ महि॒मन॑: समस्या॒स्मत्पूर्व॒ ऋष॒योऽन्त॑मापुः । यन्मा॒तरं॑ च पि॒तरं॑ च सा॒कमज॑नयथास्त॒न्व१॒॑: स्वाया॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ké ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀ te ǀ mahimánaḥ ǀ samasya ǀ asmát ǀ pū́rve ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ ántam ǀ āpuḥ ǀyát ǀ mātáram ǀ ca ǀ pitáram ǀ ca ǀ sākám ǀ ájanayathāḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ svā́yāḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: च॒त्वारि॑ ते असु॒र्या॑णि॒ नामादा॑भ्यानि महि॒षस्य॑ सन्ति । त्वम॒ङ्ग तानि॒ विश्वा॑नि वित्से॒ येभि॒: कर्मा॑णि मघवञ्च॒कर्थ॑
shlokas.transliteration: catvā́ri ǀ te ǀ asuryā́ṇi ǀ nā́ma ǀ ádābhyāni ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ santi ǀtvám ǀ aṅgá ǀ tā́ni ǀ víśvāni ǀ vitse ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ magha-van ǀ cakártha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Four are theasura-slaying uninjurable forms of you the mighty one: you know them all wherewith,Maghavat, you have achieved your exploits.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं विश्वा॑ दधिषे॒ केव॑लानि॒ यान्या॒विर्या च॒ गुहा॒ वसू॑नि । काम॒मिन्मे॑ मघव॒न्मा वि ता॑री॒स्त्वमा॑ज्ञा॒ता त्वमि॑न्द्रासि दा॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ víśvā ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ kévalāni ǀ yā́ni ǀ āvíḥ ǀ yā́ ǀ ca ǀ gúhā ǀ vásūni ǀkā́mam ǀ ít ǀ me ǀ magha-van ǀ mā́ ǀ ví ǀ tārīḥ ǀ tvám ǀ ā-jñātā́ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ asi ǀ dātā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have in your keeping all treasures, which are yours exclusively, whether they be manifest orhidden; thwart not, therefore, Maghavat, my desire (for wealth); for you are cognizant (of my desire), you are thedonor.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो अद॑धा॒ज्ज्योति॑षि॒ ज्योति॑र॒न्तर्यो असृ॑ज॒न्मधु॑ना॒ सं मधू॑नि । अध॑ प्रि॒यं शू॒षमिन्द्रा॑य॒ मन्म॑ ब्रह्म॒कृतो॑ बृ॒हदु॑क्थादवाचि
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ádadhāt ǀ jyótiṣi ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ antáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ásṛjat ǀ mádhunā ǀ sám ǀ mádhūni ǀádha ǀ priyám ǀ śūṣám ǀ índrāya ǀ mánma ǀ brahma-kṛ́taḥ ǀ bṛhát-ukthāt ǀ avāci ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To thatIndra, who has deposited the light in luminous bodies, who has flavoured sweet things withsweetness, this acceptable invigorating praise has been recited byBṛhaduktha, the author of the prayer.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒रे तन्नाम॒ गुह्यं॑ परा॒चैर्यत्त्वा॑ भी॒ते अह्व॑येतां वयो॒धै । उद॑स्तभ्नाः पृथि॒वीं द्याम॒भीके॒ भ्रातु॑: पु॒त्रान्म॑घवन्तित्विषा॒णः
shlokas.transliteration: dūré ǀ tát ǀ nā́ma ǀ gúhyam ǀ parācáiḥ ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ bhīté íti ǀ áhvayetām ǀ vayaḥ-dhái ǀút ǀ astabhnāḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ abhī́ke ǀ bhrā́tuḥ ǀ putrā́n ǀ magha-van ǀ titviṣāṇáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your form held secret (by men) with averted faces, is far from here; when (heaven and earth) alarmed,called upon you for the sustenance (of the world), then you did fix in their proximity the heaven and earth,illumining, Maghavat, the sons, of (your) brother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हत्तन्नाम॒ गुह्यं॑ पुरु॒स्पृग्येन॑ भू॒तं ज॒नयो॒ येन॒ भव्य॑म् । प्र॒त्नं जा॒तं ज्योति॒र्यद॑स्य प्रि॒यं प्रि॒याः सम॑विशन्त॒ पञ्च॑
shlokas.transliteration: mahát ǀ tát ǀ nā́ma ǀ gúhyam ǀ puru-spṛ́k ǀ yéna ǀ bhūtám ǀ janáyaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ bhávyam ǀpratnám ǀ jātám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ priyám ǀ priyā́ḥ ǀ sám ǀ aviśanta ǀ páñca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That mighty mysterious form, desired of many, wherewith you have engendered the past, and(engender) the future, the ancient manifested light, the beloved ofIndra, into which the five (orders of beings)delighted enter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒दोत मध्यं॒ पञ्च॑ दे॒वाँ ऋ॑तु॒शः स॒प्तस॑प्त । चतु॑स्त्रिंशता पुरु॒धा वि च॑ष्टे॒ सरू॑पेण॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ विव्र॑तेन
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ apṛṇāt ǀ ā́ ǀ utá ǀ mádhyam ǀ páñca ǀ devā́n ǀ ṛtu-śáḥ ǀ saptá-sapta ǀcátuḥ-triṃśatā ǀ purudhā́ ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀ sá-rūpeṇa ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ ví-vratena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He has filled heaven and earth (with his ethereal form) as well as the mid-heaven; he contemplates invarious aspects the five orders of beings, the classes of seven in their seasons, with the thirty-four (deities),(endowed) with light of like nature, and with various functions.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदु॑ष॒ औच्छ॑: प्रथ॒मा वि॒भाना॒मज॑नयो॒ येन॑ पु॒ष्टस्य॑ पु॒ष्टम् । यत्ते॑ जामि॒त्वमव॑रं॒ पर॑स्या म॒हन्म॑ह॒त्या अ॑सुर॒त्वमेक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ uṣaḥ ǀ áucchaḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ vi-bhā́nām ǀ ájanayaḥ ǀ yéna ǀ puṣṭásya ǀ puṣṭám ǀyát ǀ te ǀ jāmi-tvám ǀ ávaram ǀ párasyāḥ ǀ mahát ǀ mahatyā́ḥ ǀ asura-tvám ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since you, Uṣas, did shine forth the first of luminaries, whereby you did beget the nourishment ofnourishment (the Sun); unequalled is the mighty greatness of you who are mighty, since your relationship isdownwards (towards us), though you are stationed on high.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒धुं द॑द्रा॒णं सम॑ने बहू॒नां युवा॑नं॒ सन्तं॑ पलि॒तो ज॑गार । दे॒वस्य॑ पश्य॒ काव्यं॑ महि॒त्वाद्या म॒मार॒ स ह्यः समा॑न
shlokas.transliteration: vi-dhúm ǀ dadrāṇám ǀ sámane ǀ bahūnā́m ǀ yúvānam ǀ sántam ǀ palitáḥ ǀ jagāra ǀdevásya ǀ paśya ǀ kā́vyam ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ adyá ǀ mamā́ra ǀ sáḥ ǀ hyáḥ ǀ sám ǀ āna ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The grey-haired has swallowed the warlike (man) the scatterer of many foes, in battle being young;behold the power of the deity (endowed) with might; he dies today, he is alive tomorrow.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शाक्म॑ना शा॒को अ॑रु॒णः सु॑प॒र्ण आ यो म॒हः शूर॑: स॒नादनी॑ळः । यच्चि॒केत॑ स॒त्यमित्तन्न मोघं॒ वसु॑ स्पा॒र्हमु॒त जेतो॒त दाता॑
shlokas.transliteration: śā́kmanā ǀ śākáḥ ǀ aruṇáḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ sanā́t ǀ ánīḷaḥ ǀyát ǀ cikéta ǀ satyám ǀ ít ǀ tát ǀ ná ǀ mógham ǀ vásu ǀ spārhám ǀ utá ǀ jétā ǀ utá ǀ dā́tā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vigorous with (innate) vigour, (comes) a purple-coloured bird, mighty, heroic, ancient, having no nest;that which he knows is truth, and is not vain; (he is) the conqueror and distributor of desirable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐभि॑र्ददे॒ वृष्ण्या॒ पौंस्या॑नि॒ येभि॒रौक्ष॑द्वृत्र॒हत्या॑य व॒ज्री । ये कर्म॑णः क्रि॒यमा॑णस्य म॒ह्न ऋ॑तेक॒र्ममु॒दजा॑यन्त दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ ebhiḥ ǀ dade ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyā ǀ páuṃsyāni ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ áukṣat ǀ vṛtra-hátyāya ǀ vajrī́ ǀyé ǀ kármaṇaḥ ǀ kriyámāṇasya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ ṛte-karmám ǀ ut-ájāyanta ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indrabestows fertilizing energies (accompanied by theseMarutsin whose company the thunderersends down showers in order to destroy sin; the deities who were born for giving rain (to assist) in the actperformed be great Indra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒जा कर्मा॑णि ज॒नय॑न्वि॒श्वौजा॑ अशस्ति॒हा वि॒श्वम॑नास्तुरा॒षाट् । पी॒त्वी सोम॑स्य दि॒व आ वृ॑धा॒नः शूरो॒ निर्यु॒धाध॑म॒द्दस्यू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: yujā́ ǀ kármāṇi ǀ janáyan ǀ viśvá-ojāḥ ǀ aśasti-hā́ ǀ viśvá-manāḥ ǀ turāṣā́ṭ ǀpītvī́ ǀ sómasya ǀ diváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛdhānáḥ ǀ śū́raḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ adhamat ǀ dásyūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accomplishing his duty with their assistance, the all-powerfulIndra, the destroyer of the wicked, theall-wise, the quick subduer of foes, descending from heaven, and quaffing theSoma, invogirated and a hero, hedemolishes theDasyuswith his thunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं त॒ एकं॑ प॒र ऊ॑ त॒ एकं॑ तृ॒तीये॑न॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ सं वि॑शस्व । सं॒वेश॑ने त॒न्व१॒॑श्चारु॑रेधि प्रि॒यो दे॒वानां॑ पर॒मे ज॒नित्रे॑
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ te ǀ ékam ǀ paráḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ te ǀ ékam ǀ tṛtī́yena ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ sám ǀ viśasva ǀsam-véśane ǀ tanváḥ ǀ cā́ruḥ ǀ edhi ǀ priyáḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ paramé ǀ janítre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (light) is one (portion) of you, and this other is one (portion); with your third light enter into (outerradiance); on the entrance of the body into (the sun), the supreme birthplace of the gods, become lovely andbeloved.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त॒नूष्टे॑ वाजिन्त॒न्वं१॒॑ नय॑न्ती वा॒मम॒स्मभ्यं॒ धातु॒ शर्म॒ तुभ्य॑म् । अह्रु॑तो म॒हो ध॒रुणा॑य दे॒वान्दि॒वी॑व॒ ज्योति॒: स्वमा मि॑मीयाः
shlokas.transliteration: tanū́ḥ ǀ te ǀ vājin ǀ tanvám ǀ náyantī ǀ vāmám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dhā́tu ǀ śárma ǀ túbhyam ǀáhrutaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ dharúṇāya ǀ devā́n ǀ diví-iva ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ svám ǀ ā́ ǀ mimīyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May this body (the earth) conveying your body,Vājin, give precious wealth to us and happiness toyou; an ddo you, without stumbling, enter among the great gods for their support; and the light that is in heaven(the sun) and your own (light).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒ज्य॑सि॒ वाजि॑नेना सुवे॒नीः सु॑वि॒तः स्तोमं॑ सुवि॒तो दिवं॑ गाः । सु॒वि॒तो धर्म॑ प्रथ॒मानु॑ स॒त्या सु॑वि॒तो दे॒वान्त्सु॑वि॒तोऽनु॒ पत्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: vājī́ ǀ asi ǀ vā́jinena ǀ su-venī́ḥ ǀ suvitáḥ ǀ stómam ǀ suvitáḥ ǀ dívam ǀ gāḥ ǀsuvitáḥ ǀ dhárma ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ánu ǀ satyā́ ǀ suvitáḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ suvitáḥ ǀ ánu ǀ pátma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are,Vājin, (strong) through food; you (are) well-beloved; urged thereto follow (the object of your)praise; urged thereto proceed to heaven; urged thereto pursue the duties that are the most important and sure ofreward; urged thereto follow the gods; urged thereto follow (the light), descending (from heaven).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒हि॒म्न ए॑षां पि॒तर॑श्च॒नेशि॑रे दे॒वा दे॒वेष्व॑दधु॒रपि॒ क्रतु॑म् । सम॑विव्यचुरु॒त यान्यत्वि॑षु॒रैषां॑ त॒नूषु॒ नि वि॑विशु॒: पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: mahimnáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ caná ǀ īśire ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ ápi ǀ krátum ǀsám ǀ avivyacuḥ ǀ utá ǀ yā́ni ǀ átviṣuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ eṣām ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ní ǀ viviśuḥ ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Our progenitors (theAṅgirasas) were lords over the might of those (divinities), they having becomegods imposed their will upon the gods; they attained also (the radiances) which shone forth, and they againentered the bodies of those (gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सहो॑भि॒र्विश्वं॒ परि॑ चक्रमू॒ रज॒: पूर्वा॒ धामा॒न्यमि॑ता॒ मिमा॑नाः । त॒नूषु॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒ नि ये॑मिरे॒ प्रासा॑रयन्त पुरु॒ध प्र॒जा अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ pári ǀ cakramuḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ pū́rvā ǀ dhā́māni ǀ ámitā ǀ mímānāḥ ǀtanū́ṣu ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ní ǀ yemire ǀ prá ǀ asārayanta ǀ purudhá ǀ pra-jā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By their powers they traversed the whole world, measuring the ancient divisions (till then)unmeasured; they restricted all existent beings to their proper forms; they distributed in many directions (light)among the people.”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्विधा॑ सू॒नवोऽसु॑रं स्व॒र्विद॒मास्था॑पयन्त तृ॒तीये॑न॒ कर्म॑णा । स्वां प्र॒जां पि॒तर॒: पित्र्यं॒ सह॒ आव॑रेष्वदधु॒स्तन्तु॒मात॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: dvídhā ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ ásuram ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀ ā́ ǀ asthāpayanta ǀ tṛtī́yena ǀ kármaṇā ǀsvā́m ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ pítryam ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ávareṣu ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ tántum ǀ ā́-tatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sons (ofĀditya, theAṅgirasas), established by the third act of duty, the mighty, all-wise (sun) inhis two-fold (condition of rising and setting); our progenitors (having begotten) their own progeny, deposited inthe best (of them) the paternal strength, (making) an extended line (of progeny).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ना॒वा न क्षोद॑: प्र॒दिश॑: पृथि॒व्याः स्व॒स्तिभि॒रति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ । स्वां प्र॒जां बृ॒हदु॑क्थो महि॒त्वाव॑रेष्वदधा॒दा परे॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: nāvā́ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ áti ǀ duḥ-gā́ni ǀ víśvā ǀsvā́m ǀ pra-jā́m ǀ bṛhát-ukthaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ ávareṣu ǀ adadhāt ǀ ā́ ǀ páreṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As men pass over the water to the several quarters of the earth in a ship; (as they pass over) alldifficulties by the blessings (of fortune),Bṛhadukthaby his might has committed his own offspring to those onthis side, and to those on the other side.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा प्र गा॑म प॒थो व॒यं मा य॒ज्ञादि॑न्द्र सो॒मिन॑: । मान्त स्थु॑र्नो॒ अरा॑तयः
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ prá ǀ gāma ǀ patháḥ ǀ vayám ǀ mā́ ǀ yajñā́t ǀ indra ǀ somínaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ antáríti ǀ sthuḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ árātayaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let us not depart,Indra, from the path; let us not (depart) from the sacrifice of the offerer of thelibation; let not our adversaries remain (in our plural ce).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो य॒ज्ञस्य॑ प्र॒साध॑न॒स्तन्तु॑र्दे॒वेष्वात॑तः । तमाहु॑तं नशीमहि
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pra-sā́dhanaḥ ǀ tántuḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ā́-tataḥ ǀtám ǀ ā́-hutam ǀ naśīmahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we obtain (the favour of) him to whom burnt offerings are presented, (Agni), who is the thread, theperfecter of sacrifice, drawn out (by the priests) to the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मनो॒ न्वा हु॑वामहे नाराशं॒सेन॒ सोमे॑न । पि॒तॄ॒णां च॒ मन्म॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: mánaḥ ǀ nú ǀ ā́ ǀ huvāmahe ǀ nārāśaṃséna ǀ sómena ǀpitṝṇā́m ǀ ca ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We call upon the spirit (ofSubandhu) with theSomaappropriated to the progenitors, with the praisesepithet of the Soma.Yajus. 3.53 reads stomena: praise is of to kinds, that of gods and men, the latter isnārāśamsaḥ, whence the epithet narāśaṃsa means, suited to man; that is, to deified men orpitṛs].”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त॑ एतु॒ मन॒: पुन॒: क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य जी॒वसे॑ । ज्योक्च॒ सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ te ǀ etu ǀ mánaḥ ǀ púnaríti ǀ krátve ǀ dákṣāya ǀ jīváse ǀjyók ǀ ca ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (your) spirit (Subandhu) come back again to perform pious acts; to exercise strength; to live; andlong to see the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॑र्नः पितरो॒ मनो॒ ददा॑तु॒ दैव्यो॒ जन॑: । जी॒वं व्रातं॑ सचेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pitaraḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ dádātu ǀ dáivyaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀjīvám ǀ vrā́tam ǀ sacemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May our progenitors, may the host of the gods, restore (your) spirit; may we obtain (for you) theaggregate of the functions of life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यं सो॑म व्र॒ते तव॒ मन॑स्त॒नूषु॒ बिभ्र॑तः । प्र॒जाव॑न्तः सचेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ soma ǀ vraté ǀ táva ǀ mánaḥ ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀprajā́-vantaḥ ǀ sacemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Soma, fixing our minds, on your worship and its details, may we, blessed with progeny, obtain (theaggreagate of the functions of life)”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ य॒मं वै॑वस्व॒तं मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ yamám ǀ vaivasvatám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ दिवं॒ यत्पृ॑थि॒वीं मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ dívam ǀ yát ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ भूमिं॒ चतु॑र्भृष्टिं॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ bhū́mim ǀ cátuḥ-bhṛṣṭim ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ चत॑स्रः प्र॒दिशो॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ समु॒द्रम॑र्ण॒वं मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ samudrám ǀ arṇavám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ मरी॑चीः प्र॒वतो॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ márīcīḥ ǀ pra-vátaḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ अ॒पो यदोष॑धी॒र्मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ apáḥ ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ सूर्यं॒ यदु॒षसं॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ sū́ryam ǀ yát ǀ uṣásam ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ पर्व॑तान्बृह॒तो मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ párvatān ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॒न्मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ víśvam ǀ idám ǀ jágat ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॒ परा॑: परा॒वतो॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ párāḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ भू॒तं च॒ भव्यं॑ च॒ मनो॑ ज॒गाम॑ दूर॒कम् । तत्त॒ आ व॑र्तयामसी॒ह क्षया॑य जी॒वसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ te ǀ bhūtám ǀ ca ǀ bhávyam ǀ ca ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jagā́ma ǀ dū́rakám ǀtát ǀ te ǀ ā́ ǀ vartayāmasi ǀ ihá ǀ kṣáyāya ǀ jīváse ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र ता॒र्यायु॑: प्रत॒रं नवी॑य॒ स्थाता॑रेव॒ क्रतु॑मता॒ रथ॑स्य । अध॒ च्यवा॑न॒ उत्त॑वी॒त्यर्थं॑ परात॒रं सु निॠ॑तिर्जिहीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ tāri ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ sthā́tārā-iva ǀ krátu-matā ǀ ráthasya ǀádha ǀ cyávānaḥ ǀ út ǀ tavīti ǀ ártham ǀ parā-tarám ǀ sú ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jihītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the life ofSubandhube augmented so as to be more lasting and newer, as men conveyed in acar (are carried on) by a skilful (driver); he who falls from life, increases (his) desire to live; mayNirṛtidepart faroff.”

shlokas.sanskrit: साम॒न्नु रा॒ये नि॑धि॒मन्न्वन्नं॒ करा॑महे॒ सु पु॑रु॒ध श्रवां॑सि । ता नो॒ विश्वा॑नि जरि॒ता म॑मत्तु परात॒रं सु निॠ॑तिर्जिहीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: sā́man ǀ nú ǀ rāyé ǀ nidhi-mát ǀ nú ǀ ánnam ǀ kárāmahe ǀ sú ǀ purudhá ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ jaritā́ ǀ mamattu ǀ parā-tarám ǀ sú ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jihītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(When) the hymn (is being sung) let us offer (sacrificial) food, like a treasure (toNirṛti) for the sake ofriches, and many kinds of sacrificial viands; may she, being praised, partake of all these our (offerings); mayNiṛrti depart far off.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भी ष्व१॒॑र्यः पौंस्यै॑र्भवेम॒ द्यौर्न भूमिं॑ गि॒रयो॒ नाज्रा॑न् । ता नो॒ विश्वा॑नि जरि॒ता चि॑केत परात॒रं सु निॠ॑तिर्जिहीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ sú ǀ aryáḥ ǀ páuṃsyaiḥ ǀ bhavema ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́mim ǀ giráyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ ájrān ǀtā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ jaritā́ ǀ ciketa ǀ parā-tarám ǀ sú ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jihītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, by our manly exertions, overcome our enemies, as the Sun the earth, as thunderbolts theclouds; she, being praised, knows all these our (exploits); mayNirṛtidepart far off.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मो षु ण॑: सोम मृ॒त्यवे॒ परा॑ दा॒: पश्ये॑म॒ नु सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्तम् । द्युभि॑र्हि॒तो ज॑रि॒मा सू नो॑ अस्तु परात॒रं सु निॠ॑तिर्जिहीताम्
shlokas.transliteration: mó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ soma ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǀ páśyema ǀ nú ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǀdyú-bhiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀ jarimā́ ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ parā-tarám ǀ sú ǀ níḥ-ṛtiḥ ǀ jihītām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give us not up,Soma, to death; may we (long) behold the rising sun; may our old age brought on by(passing) days be happy; mayNirṛtidepart far off.”

shlokas.sanskrit: असु॑नीते॒ मनो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धारय जी॒वात॑वे॒ सु प्र ति॑रा न॒ आयु॑: । रा॒र॒न्धि न॒: सूर्य॑स्य सं॒दृशि॑ घृ॒तेन॒ त्वं त॒न्वं॑ वर्धयस्व
shlokas.transliteration: ásu-nīte ǀ mánaḥ ǀ asmā́su ǀ dhāraya ǀ jīvā́tave ǀ sú ǀ prá ǀ tira ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀrarandhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ sam-dṛ́śi ǀ ghṛténa ǀ tvám ǀ tanvám ǀ vardhayasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Asunīti, give us back the (departed) spirit; extend our life that we may live (long); establish us that wemay (long) behold the sun; do you cherish the body with the ghī (that we have offered).”

shlokas.sanskrit: असु॑नीते॒ पुन॑र॒स्मासु॒ चक्षु॒: पुन॑: प्रा॒णमि॒ह नो॑ धेहि॒ भोग॑म् । ज्योक्प॑श्येम॒ सूर्य॑मु॒च्चर॑न्त॒मनु॑मते मृ॒ळया॑ नः स्व॒स्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ásu-nīte ǀ púnaḥ ǀ asmā́su ǀ cákṣuḥ ǀ púnaríti ǀ prāṇám ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǀ dhehi ǀ bhógam ǀjyók ǀ paśyema ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ut-cárantam ǀ ánu-mate ǀ mṛḷáya ǀ naḥ ǀ svastí ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Restore to us, Asunīti, sight and breath, and enjoyment in this world; long may we behold the risingsun; make us happy, gracious (goddess), with prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुन॑र्नो॒ असुं॑ पृथि॒वी द॑दातु॒ पुन॒र्द्यौर्दे॒वी पुन॑र॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । पुन॑र्न॒: सोम॑स्त॒न्वं॑ ददातु॒ पुन॑: पू॒षा प॒थ्यां॒३॒॑ या स्व॒स्तिः
shlokas.transliteration: púnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ásum ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ dadātu ǀ púnaḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ púnaḥ ǀ antárikṣam ǀpúnaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ dadātu ǀ púnaríti ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ pathyā́m ǀ yā́ ǀ svastíḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May earth restore the (departed)soulto us; may the divine heaven, may the firmament (restore it);maySomarestore body to us; mayPūṣanrestore to us speech, which is prosperity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शं रोद॑सी सु॒बन्ध॑वे य॒ह्वी ऋ॒तस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ । भर॑ता॒मप॒ यद्रपो॒ द्यौः पृ॑थिवि क्ष॒मा रपो॒ मो षु ते॒ किं च॒नाम॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: śám ǀ ródasī íti ǀ su-bándhave ǀ yahvī́ íti ǀ ṛtásya ǀ mātárā ǀbháratām ǀ ápa ǀ yát ǀ rápaḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivi ǀ kṣamā́ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ mó íti ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āmamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the great heaven and earth, the parents of sacrifice, (grant) happiness toSubandhu; heaven andearth, remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ द्व॒के अव॑ त्रि॒का दि॒वश्च॑रन्ति भेष॒जा । क्ष॒मा च॑रि॒ष्ण्वे॑क॒कं भर॑ता॒मप॒ यद्रपो॒ द्यौः पृ॑थिवि क्ष॒मा रपो॒ मो षु ते॒ किं च॒नाम॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ dvaké íti ǀ áva ǀ trikā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ caranti ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀkṣamā́ ǀ cariṣṇú ǀ ekakám ǀ bháratām ǀ ápa ǀ yát ǀ rápaḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivi ǀ kṣamā́ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ mó íti ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āmamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Remedies come down from heaven by two and threes; one wanders singly in heaven; heaven andearth remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑न्द्रेरय॒ गाम॑न॒ड्वाहं॒ य आव॑हदुशी॒नरा॑ण्या॒ अन॑: । भर॑ता॒मप॒ यद्रपो॒ द्यौः पृ॑थिवि क्ष॒मा रपो॒ मो षु ते॒ किं च॒नाम॑मत्
shlokas.transliteration: sám ǀ indra ǀ īraya ǀ gā́m ǀ anaḍvā́ham ǀ yáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ávahat ǀ uśīnárāṇyāḥ ǀ ánaḥ ǀbháratām ǀ ápa ǀ yát ǀ rápaḥ ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ pṛthivi ǀ kṣamā́ ǀ rápaḥ ǀ mó íti ǀ sú ǀ te ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āmamat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Send,Indra, the active ox, who may bring the cart (laden with) the uśīnarāṇi grass; heaven andearth, remove all iniquity; let heaven (take away) iniquity; may no ill ever approach you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ जनं॑ त्वे॒षसं॑दृशं॒ माही॑नाना॒मुप॑स्तुतम् । अग॑न्म॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ नम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ jánam ǀ tveṣá-sandṛśam ǀ mā́hīnānām ǀ úpa-stutam ǀáganma ǀ bíbhrataḥ ǀ námaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We have come to the person n of splendid appearance, the honoured of the mighty, bringing himreverential homage.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अस॑मातिं नि॒तोश॑नं त्वे॒षं नि॑य॒यिनं॒ रथ॑म् । भ॒जेर॑थस्य॒ सत्प॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: ásamātim ǀ ni-tóśanam ǀ tveṣám ǀ ni-yayínam ǀ rátham ǀbhajé-rathasya ǀ sát-patim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To Asamāti, the destroyer (of foes), radiant, a quick-moving chariot, (for the bringing of benefits),(the descendant) of Bhajeratha, the protector of the good.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो जना॑न्महि॒षाँ इ॑वातित॒स्थौ पवी॑रवान् । उ॒ताप॑वीरवान्यु॒धा
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ jánān ǀ mahiṣā́n-iva ǀ ati-tastháu ǀ pávīravān ǀutá ǀ ápavīravān ǀ yudhā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who, whether armed or unarmed with a sword, overcomes adversaries in fight, as (a lion destroys)buffaloes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ये॑क्ष्वा॒कुरुप॑ व्र॒ते रे॒वान्म॑रा॒य्येध॑ते । दि॒वी॑व॒ पञ्च॑ कृ॒ष्टय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ ikṣvākúḥ ǀ úpa ǀ vraté ǀ revā́n ǀ marāyī́ ǀ édhate ǀdiví-iva ǀ páñca ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the good government of whose (realm) the opunlent and victoriousIkṣvākuprospers (so that) thefive orders of men (are as happy) as if they were in heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑ क्ष॒त्रास॑मातिषु॒ रथ॑प्रोष्ठेषु धारय । दि॒वी॑व॒ सूर्यं॑ दृ॒शे
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ kṣatrā́ ǀ ásamātiṣu ǀ rátha-proṣṭheṣu ǀ dhāraya ǀdiví-iva ǀ sū́ryam ǀ dṛśé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maintain,Indra, vigour in the Rathaproṣṭha Asamātis, as (you maintain) the sun in heaven for thesight (of all).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒गस्त्य॑स्य॒ नद्भ्य॒: सप्ती॑ युनक्षि॒ रोहि॑ता । प॒णीन्न्य॑क्रमीर॒भि विश्वा॑न्राजन्नरा॒धस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agástyasya ǀ nát-bhyaḥ ǀ sáptī íti ǀ yunakṣi ǀ róhitā ǀpaṇī́n ǀ ní ǀ akramīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ víśvān ǀ rājan ǀ arādhásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Yoke the two red horses to your chariot, for the nephews ofAgastya, and overcome,rājā, all theniggard withholders of oblations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं मा॒तायं पि॒तायं जी॒वातु॒राग॑मत् । इ॒दं तव॑ प्र॒सर्प॑णं॒ सुब॑न्ध॒वेहि॒ निरि॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ mātā́ ǀ ayám ǀ pitā́ ǀ ayám ǀ jīvā́tuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ agamat ǀidám ǀ táva ǀ pra-sárpaṇam ǀ súbandho íti sú-bandho ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ níḥ ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Agni) your mother, this your father, this the giver of life to you, has arrived; come back,Subandhu, to this your (body) that is capable of motion. Come forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ यु॒गं व॑र॒त्रया॒ नह्य॑न्ति ध॒रुणा॑य॒ कम् । ए॒वा दा॑धार ते॒ मनो॑ जी॒वात॑वे॒ न मृ॒त्यवेऽथो॑ अरि॒ष्टता॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ yugám ǀ varatráyā ǀ náhyanti ǀ dharúṇāya ǀ kám ǀevá ǀ dādhāra ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jīvā́tave ǀ ná ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ átho íti ǀ ariṣṭá-tātaye ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यथे॒यं पृ॑थि॒वी म॒ही दा॒धारे॒मान्वन॒स्पती॑न् । ए॒वा दा॑धार ते॒ मनो॑ जी॒वात॑वे॒ न मृ॒त्यवेऽथो॑ अरि॒ष्टता॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ iyám ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ mahī́ ǀ dādhā́ra ǀ imā́n ǀ vánaspátīn ǀevá ǀ dādhāra ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ jīvā́tave ǀ ná ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ átho íti ǀ ariṣṭá-tātaye ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒माद॒हं वै॑वस्व॒तात्सु॒बन्धो॒र्मन॒ आभ॑रम् । जी॒वात॑वे॒ न मृ॒त्यवेऽथो॑ अरि॒ष्टता॑तये
shlokas.transliteration: yamā́t ǀ ahám ǀ vaivasvatā́t ǀ su-bándhoḥ ǀ mánaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ abharam ǀjīvā́tave ǀ ná ǀ mṛtyáve ǀ átho íti ǀ ariṣṭá-tātaye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agnispeaks). I bring the spirit of ASubandhu fromYama, the son ofVivasvat, for life, not for death,but for security.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न्य१॒॑ग्वातोऽव॑ वाति॒ न्य॑क्तपति॒ सूर्य॑: । नी॒चीन॑म॒घ्न्या दु॑हे॒ न्य॑ग्भवतु ते॒ रप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nyák ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ áva ǀ vāti ǀ nyák ǀ tapati ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀnīcī́nam ǀ aghnyā́ ǀ duhe ǀ nyák ǀ bhavatu ǀ te ǀ rápaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wind blows downwards, the sun burns downwards, the cow yields her milk downwards, so be(hand) has all medicaments; this has a blessed touch.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं मे॒ हस्तो॒ भग॑वान॒यं मे॒ भग॑वत्तरः । अ॒यं मे॑ वि॒श्वभे॑षजो॒ऽयं शि॒वाभि॑मर्शनः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ me ǀ hástaḥ ǀ bhága-vān ǀ ayám ǀ me ǀ bhágavat-taraḥ ǀayám ǀ me ǀ viśvá-bheṣajaḥ ǀ ayám ǀ śivá-abhimarśanaḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दमि॒त्था रौद्रं॑ गू॒र्तव॑चा॒ ब्रह्म॒ क्रत्वा॒ शच्या॑म॒न्तरा॒जौ । क्रा॒णा यद॑स्य पि॒तरा॑ मंहने॒ष्ठाः पर्ष॑त्प॒क्थे अह॒न्ना स॒प्त होतॄ॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ itthā́ ǀ ráudram ǀ gūrtá-vacāḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ krátvā ǀ śácyām ǀ antáḥ ǀ ājáu ǀkrāṇā́ ǀ yát ǀ asya ǀ pitárā ǀ maṃhane-sthā́ḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ pakthé ǀ áhan ǀ ā́ ǀ saptá ǀ hótṝn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fierce-voiced (Nābhānediṣṭha repeated) through his intelligence this praise ofRudra, in themidst of the ceremony at the assembly (of theAṅgirasas), which (praise) his parents, making (the partition) andhis brothers engaged in giving (the shares accomplished); he perfected the seven priests (therewith) on the dayon which the rite was to be matured.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इद्दा॒नाय॒ दभ्या॑य व॒न्वञ्च्यवा॑न॒: सूदै॑रमिमीत॒ वेदि॑म् । तूर्व॑याणो गू॒र्तव॑चस्तम॒: क्षोदो॒ न रेत॑ इ॒तऊ॑ति सिञ्चत्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ dānā́ya ǀ dábhyāya ǀ vanván ǀ cyávānaḥ ǀ sū́daiḥ ǀ amimīta ǀ védim ǀtū́rvayāṇaḥ ǀ gūrtávacaḥ-tamaḥ ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rétaḥ ǀ itáḥ-ūti ǀ siñcat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He (Rudra) bestowing on his worshippers the gift (of wealth) and the defeat (of their foes),castingdown (therākṣasas) with his weapons, has constructed the altar; rapid in movement, most fierce in speech,and shedding the procreative fluid like water around.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मनो॒ न येषु॒ हव॑नेषु ति॒ग्मं विप॒: शच्या॑ वनु॒थो द्रव॑न्ता । आ यः शर्या॑भिस्तुविनृ॒म्णो अ॒स्याश्री॑णीता॒दिशं॒ गभ॑स्तौ
shlokas.transliteration: mánaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yéṣu ǀ hávaneṣu ǀ tigmám ǀ vípaḥ ǀ śácyā ǀ vanutháḥ ǀ drávantā ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ śáryābhiḥ ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇáḥ ǀ asya ǀ áśrīṇīta ǀ ā-díśam ǀ gábhastau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(I call you to these) oblations, to which hastening, (Aśvins), swift as thought at the invitation of theworshipper, you rejoice my (worshipper) who, affluent in the wealth of sacrifice, mixes (the oblation) with hisfingers in your presence, (holding) in hishandthe sacrifice intended (for you).”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णा यद्गोष्व॑रु॒णीषु॒ सीद॑द्दि॒वो नपा॑ताश्विना हुवे वाम् । वी॒तं मे॑ य॒ज्ञमा ग॑तं मे॒ अन्नं॑ वव॒न्वांसा॒ नेष॒मस्मृ॑तध्रू
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣṇā́ ǀ yát ǀ góṣu ǀ aruṇī́ṣu ǀ sī́dat ǀ diváḥ ǀ nápātā ǀ aśvinā ǀ huve ǀ vām ǀvītám ǀ me ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ me ǀ ánnam ǀ vavanvā́ṃsā ǀ ná ǀ íṣam ǀ ásmṛtadhrū ítyasmṛta-dhrū ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the dark night rettires before the purple oxen (of the chariot of the dawn), I invoke you,Aśvinschildren of heaven; be desirous of my sacrifice; come to my food and to my viands like (two horses) eatingtogether, oblivious of offence.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रथि॑ष्ट॒ यस्य॑ वी॒रक॑र्ममि॒ष्णदनु॑ष्ठितं॒ नु नर्यो॒ अपौ॑हत् । पुन॒स्तदा वृ॑हति॒ यत्क॒नाया॑ दुहि॒तुरा अनु॑भृतमन॒र्वा
shlokas.transliteration: práthiṣṭa ǀ yásya ǀ vīrá-karmam ǀ iṣṇát ǀ ánu-sthitam ǀ nú ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ auhat ǀpúnaríti ǀ tát ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛhati ǀ yát ǀ kanā́yāḥ ǀ duhitúḥ ǀ ā́ḥ ǀ ánu-bhṛtam ǀ anarvā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Rudra), the benefactor of man, whose eager, virile energy was developed, drew it back whendisseminated (for the genitive ration of offfspring); again the irresistible (Rudra) concentrates (the energy) which wascommunicated to his maiden daughter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒ध्या यत्कर्त्व॒मभ॑वद॒भीके॒ कामं॑ कृण्वा॒ने पि॒तरि॑ युव॒त्याम् । म॒ना॒नग्रेतो॑ जहतुर्वि॒यन्ता॒ सानौ॒ निषि॑क्तं सुकृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: madhyā́ ǀ yát ǀ kártvam ǀ ábhavat ǀ abhī́ke ǀ kā́mam ǀ kṛṇvāné ǀ pitári ǀ yuvatyā́m ǀmanānák ǀ rétaḥ ǀ jahatuḥ ǀ vi-yántā ǀ sā́nau ǀ ní-siktam ǀ su-kṛtásya ǀ yónau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the deed was done in mid-heaven in the proximity of the father working his will, and thedaughter coming together, they let the seed fall slightly; it was poured upon the high plural ce of sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पि॒ता यत्स्वां दु॑हि॒तर॑मधि॒ष्कन्क्ष्म॒या रेत॑: संजग्मा॒नो नि षि॑ञ्चत् । स्वा॒ध्यो॑ऽजनय॒न्ब्रह्म॑ दे॒वा वास्तो॒ष्पतिं॑ व्रत॒पां निर॑तक्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: pitā́ ǀ yát ǀ svā́m ǀ duhitáram ǀ adhi-skán ǀ kṣmayā́ ǀ rétaḥ ǀ sam-jagmānáḥ ǀ ní ǀ siñcat ǀsu-ādhyáḥ ǀ ajanayan ǀ bráhma ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vā́stoḥ ǀ pátim ǀ vrata-pā́m ǀ níḥ ǀ atakṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the father united with the daughter, then associating with the earth, he sprinkled it with theeffusion; then the thoughtful gods begotBrahma; they fabricated the lord of the hearth (of sacrifice); the defenderof sacred rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स ईं॒ वृषा॒ न फेन॑मस्यदा॒जौ स्मदा परै॒दप॑ द॒भ्रचे॑ताः । सर॑त्प॒दा न दक्षि॑णा परा॒वृङ्न ता नु मे॑ पृश॒न्यो॑ जगृभ्रे
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ īm ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ ná ǀ phénam ǀ asyat ǀ ājáu ǀ smát ǀ ā́ ǀ párā ǀ ait ǀ ápa ǀ dabhrá-cetāḥ ǀsárat ǀ padā́ ǀ ná ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ parā-vṛ́k ǀ ná ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ nú ǀ me ǀ pṛśanyáḥ ǀ jagṛbhre ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He, like the showerer (Indra), cast foam around in the combat, and came away from us with a niggardmind; he advances not a step, relinquishing the donations; though skilled in rapine, he seizes not these my(cows).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू न वह्नि॑: प्र॒जाया॑ उप॒ब्दिर॒ग्निं न न॒ग्न उप॑ सीद॒दूध॑: । सनि॑ते॒ध्मं सनि॑तो॒त वाजं॒ स ध॒र्ता ज॑ज्ञे॒ सह॑सा यवी॒युत्
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ ná ǀ váhniḥ ǀ pra-jā́yāḥ ǀ upabdíḥ ǀ agním ǀ ná ǀ nagnáḥ ǀ úpa ǀ sīdat ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀsánitā ǀ idhmám ǀ sánitā ǀ utá ǀ vā́jam ǀ sáḥ ǀ dhartā́ ǀ jajñe ǀ sáhasā ǀ yavi-yút ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fire, harming the people, does not approach quickly (by day); the naked (rākṣasasapproach)notAgniby night; the giver of fuel, and the giver of food, he, the upholder (of the rite), is born, overcomingenemies by his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू क॒नाया॑: स॒ख्यं नव॑ग्वा ऋ॒तं वद॑न्त ऋ॒तयु॑क्तिमग्मन् । द्वि॒बर्ह॑सो॒ य उप॑ गो॒पमागु॑रदक्षि॒णासो॒ अच्यु॑ता दुदुक्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ kanā́yāḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ náva-gvāḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ vádantaḥ ǀ ṛtá-yuktim ǀ agman ǀdvi-bárhasaḥ ǀ yé ǀ úpa ǀ gopám ǀ ā́ ǀ águḥ ǀ adakṣiṇā́saḥ ǀ ácyutā ǀ dudhukṣan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheAṅgirasas, who were engaged in the nine months;' ceremonial, reciting the praise suited to therite, quickly attained the friendship of the maiden; those who seated in the two seats (heaven and earth) came totheir protector, as they had no donation, milked forth the inexhaustible (waters).”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒क्षू क॒नाया॑: स॒ख्यं नवी॑यो॒ राधो॒ न रेत॑ ऋ॒तमित्तु॑रण्यन् । शुचि॒ यत्ते॒ रेक्ण॒ आय॑जन्त सब॒र्दुघा॑या॒: पय॑ उ॒स्रिया॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: makṣú ǀ kanā́yāḥ ǀ sakhyám ǀ návīyaḥ ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rétaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ ít ǀ turaṇyan ǀśúci ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ ā-áyajanta ǀ sabaḥ-dúghāyāḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ usríyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Quickly (obtaining) the friendship of the maiden, they poured forth water like new wealth, when theyoffered to you (Indra) the pure riches, the milk of the cow, that yields ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒श्वा यत्प॒श्चा वियु॑ता बु॒धन्तेति॑ ब्रवीति व॒क्तरी॒ ररा॑णः । वसो॑र्वसु॒त्वा का॒रवो॑ऽने॒हा विश्वं॑ विवेष्टि॒ द्रवि॑ण॒मुप॒ क्षु
shlokas.transliteration: paśvā́ ǀ yát ǀ paścā́ ǀ ví-yutā ǀ budhánta ǀ íti ǀ bravīti ǀ vaktári ǀ rárāṇaḥ ǀvásoḥ ǀ vasu-tvā́ ǀ kārávaḥ ǀ anehā́ ǀ víśvam ǀ viveṣṭi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ úpa ǀ kṣú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “"When (the worshippers) find (the stalls deserted) by the cattle" (then the performer of the rite)exclaims, "(Indra), plural asing to his adorer, the affluent lord of affluence, the compassionate, the sinless, quicklyrecovers all the wealth (that has been carried off)."”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिन्न्व॑स्य परि॒षद्वा॑नो अग्मन्पु॒रू सद॑न्तो नार्ष॒दं बि॑भित्सन् । वि शुष्ण॑स्य॒ संग्र॑थितमन॒र्वा वि॒दत्पु॑रुप्रजा॒तस्य॒ गुहा॒ यत्
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ pari-sádvānaḥ ǀ agman ǀ purú ǀ sádantaḥ ǀ nārsadám ǀ bibhitsán ǀví ǀ śúṣṇasya ǀ sám-grathitam ǀ anarvā́ ǀ vidát ǀ puru-prajātásya ǀ gúhā ǀ yát ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then the attendant (rays of light) quickly gathered round him, and (theasuras) dwelling in manyregions sought to destroy the son ofNṛṣad, but the irresistible (Indra) found the well-knit mail ofŚuṣṇa, whoseoffspring was numerous, which was hidden in the cave.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भर्गो॑ ह॒ नामो॒त यस्य॑ दे॒वाः स्व१॒॑र्ण ये त्रि॑षध॒स्थे नि॑षे॒दुः । अ॒ग्निर्ह॒ नामो॒त जा॒तवे॑दाः श्रु॒धी नो॑ होतॠ॒तस्य॒ होता॒ध्रुक्
shlokas.transliteration: bhárgaḥ ǀ ha ǀ nā́ma ǀ utá ǀ yásya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ tri-sadhasthé ǀ ni-sedúḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ ha ǀ nā́ma ǀ utá ǀ jātá-vedāḥ ǀ śrudhí ǀ naḥ ǀ hotaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ hótā ǀ adhrúk ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “WhetherBhargais the name of that radiance, on the triple seat of which those who are gods areseated, as if in heaven, or whether it beAgni, orJātavedas; invoker (of the gods), who are the ministrant priestof the sacrifice, hear our guileless invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त त्या मे॒ रौद्रा॑वर्चि॒मन्ता॒ नास॑त्याविन्द्र गू॒र्तये॒ यज॑ध्यै । म॒नु॒ष्वद्वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषे॒ ररा॑णा म॒न्दू हि॒तप्र॑यसा वि॒क्षु यज्यू॑
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ tyā́ ǀ me ǀ ráudrau ǀ arci-mántā ǀ nā́satyau ǀ indra ǀ gūrtáye ǀ yájadhyai ǀmanuṣvát ǀ vṛktá-barhiṣe ǀ rárāṇā ǀ mandū́ íti ǀ hitá-prayasā ǀ vikṣú ǀ yájyū íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And,Indra, let those two brilliant sons ofRudra, theNāsatyās, (be present) at my praise andsacrifice; being propitious to (me seated) on the strewn grass, as (at the sacrifice of)Manu, cheerful, liberal ofwealth to the people, deserving of adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं स्तु॒तो राजा॑ वन्दि वे॒धा अ॒पश्च॒ विप्र॑स्तरति॒ स्वसे॑तुः । स क॒क्षीव॑न्तं रेजय॒त्सो अ॒ग्निं ने॒मिं न च॒क्रमर्व॑तो रघु॒द्रु
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ stutáḥ ǀ rā́jā ǀ vandi ǀ vedhā́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ca ǀ vípraḥ ǀ tarati ǀ svá-setuḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ kakṣī́vantam ǀ rejayat ǀ sáḥ ǀ agním ǀ nemím ǀ ná ǀ cakrám ǀ árvataḥ ǀ raghu-drú ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This royal (Soma), this glorified creator, is praised (by all), and, like a sage, constituting his owncause-way, he traverses the firmament; he madeKakṣīvattremble, he (made)Agni(shake) as horses (agitate)the light- whirling, revolving-wheel (of a chariot).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स द्वि॒बन्धु॑र्वैतर॒णो यष्टा॑ सब॒र्धुं धे॒नुम॒स्वं॑ दु॒हध्यै॑ । सं यन्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा वृ॒ञ्ज उ॒क्थैर्ज्येष्ठे॑भिरर्य॒मणं॒ वरू॑थैः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ dvi-bándhuḥ ǀ vaitaraṇáḥ ǀ yáṣṭā ǀ sabaḥ-dhúm ǀ dhenúm ǀ asvám ǀ duhádhyai ǀsám ǀ yát ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ vṛñjé ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ jyéṣṭhebhiḥ ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ várūthaiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kinsman of the two (worlds,Agni), the conveyer (of all), the sacrificer, (made) theambrosia-yielding cow, which had not given birth, to yield milk (forŚayu), when he praisesMitra,VaruṇaandAryaman, with most excellent and choice hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्ब॑न्धुः सू॒रिर्दि॒वि ते॑ धियं॒धा नाभा॒नेदि॑ष्ठो रपति॒ प्र वेन॑न् । सा नो॒ नाभि॑: पर॒मास्य वा॑ घा॒हं तत्प॒श्चा क॑ति॒थश्चि॑दास
shlokas.transliteration: tát-bandhuḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ diví ǀ te ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ nā́bhānédiṣṭhaḥ ǀ rapati ǀ prá ǀ vénan ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ paramā́ ǀ asyá ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ ahám ǀ tát ǀ paścā́ ǀ katitháḥ ǀ cit ǀ āsa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The kinsman of the earth, the utterer of praise (belonging) to you (who abides) in heaven,Nābhānediṣṭha, the supporter of the rite, desiring (the recompense), repeats (this praise); the (heaven) ourmost excellent bound (is the site) of the (sun), and I was after many (degrees) descended from hiṃ”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं मे॒ नाभि॑रि॒ह मे॑ स॒धस्थ॑मि॒मे मे॑ दे॒वा अ॒यम॑स्मि॒ सर्व॑: । द्वि॒जा अह॑ प्रथम॒जा ऋ॒तस्ये॒दं धे॒नुर॑दुह॒ज्जाय॑माना
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ me ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ me ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ imé ǀ me ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ayám ǀ asmi ǀ sárvaḥ ǀdvi-jā́ḥ ǀ áha ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ idám ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ aduhat ǀ jā́yamānā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (aerial voice) is my bond of affinity; here, (in the solar orb) is my abiding-plural ce; these are myresplendent (rays); I am this all; I am the twice-born; the first-born of truth; the cow, as soon as born, milked forthidentical withĀditya; sā yā vāg asau saādityaḥ, that which is vāk is that Ādityaḥ:ŚatapathaBrāhmaṇa10.5.1.4]. the forests, terminates (in the fire of sacrifice), who upward rising, like a line, adorable, quickly subdues (hisfoes). him, unchangeable, the augmenter of happiness, his mother has brought forth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑सु म॒न्द्रो अ॑र॒तिर्वि॒भावाव॑ स्यति द्विवर्त॒निर्व॑ने॒षाट् । ऊ॒र्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणि॒र्न शिशु॒र्दन्म॒क्षू स्थि॒रं शे॑वृ॒धं सू॑त मा॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ āsu ǀ mandráḥ ǀ aratíḥ ǀ vibhā́-vā ǀ áva ǀ syati ǀ dvi-vartaníḥ ǀ vaneṣā́ṭ ǀūrdhvā́ ǀ yát ǀ śréṇiḥ ǀ ná ǀ śíśuḥ ǀ dán ǀ makṣú ǀ sthirám ǀ śe-vṛdhám ǀ sūta ǀ mātā́ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ गाव॒ उप॑मातिं क॒नाया॒ अनु॑ श्वा॒न्तस्य॒ कस्य॑ चि॒त्परे॑युः । श्रु॒धि त्वं सु॑द्रविणो न॒स्त्वं या॑ळाश्व॒घ्नस्य॑ वावृधे सू॒नृता॑भिः
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ úpa-mātim ǀ kanā́yāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śvāntásya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀ párā ǀ īyuḥ ǀśrudhí ǀ tvám ǀ su-draviṇaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ yāṭ ǀ āśva-ghnásya ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The words of the desirable (praise), of a certain tranquil person n (Nābhānediṣṭha), attain theprototype (Indra). Do you, who are the giver of wealth (Agni), hear us; offer sacrifice, you are magnified by thesincere eulogies ofAśvaghna.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ त्वमि॑न्द्र वि॒द्ध्य१॒॑स्मान्म॒हो रा॒ये नृ॑पते॒ वज्र॑बाहुः । रक्षा॑ च नो म॒घोन॑: पा॒हि सू॒रीन॑ने॒हस॑स्ते हरिवो अ॒भिष्टौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ viddhí ǀ asmā́n ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀrákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ sūrī́n ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, king of men, who are the bearer of the thunderbolt, regard us now to (give us) greatriches, and protect us who are affluent in (oblations), who utter (your) praise; may we, lord of bay steeds, (be)free from blame on your approach.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अध॒ यद्रा॑जाना॒ गवि॑ष्टौ॒ सर॑त्सर॒ण्युः का॒रवे॑ जर॒ण्युः । विप्र॒: प्रेष्ठ॒: स ह्ये॑षां ब॒भूव॒ परा॑ च॒ वक्ष॑दु॒त प॑र्षदेनान्
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ yát ǀ rājānā ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀ sárat ǀ saraṇyúḥ ǀ kāráve ǀ jaraṇyúḥ ǀvípraḥ ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ babhū́va ǀ párā ǀ ca ǀ vákṣat ǀ utá ǀ parṣat ǀ enān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Since, royal (MitraandVaruṇa), the impetuous (Yama) now approaches in expectation of (the gift of)cattle, and desiring praise for the sacrificing (band of theAṅgirasas); the sage (Nābhānediṣṭha) has beenheld most dear by them; may he accomplish (what has to be effected), and make them successful.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॒ न्व॑स्य॒ जेन्य॑स्य पु॒ष्टौ वृथा॒ रेभ॑न्त ईमहे॒ तदू॒ नु । स॒र॒ण्युर॑स्य सू॒नुरश्वो॒ विप्र॑श्चासि॒ श्रव॑सश्च सा॒तौ
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ jényasya ǀ puṣṭáu ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ rébhantaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀsaraṇyúḥ ǀ asya ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ca ǀ asi ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sātáu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “And for the contentment of this victorious (Varuṇa), praising (him) without an effort, we solicit this (ofhim), (that) his progeny, a swift horse, (may be ours), and you, (Varuṇa), are wise, and (are occupied) inprocuring us food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोर्यदि॑ स॒ख्याया॒स्मे शर्धा॑य॒ स्तोमं॑ जुजु॒षे नम॑स्वान् । वि॒श्वत्र॒ यस्मि॒न्ना गिर॑: समी॒चीः पू॒र्वीव॑ गा॒तुर्दाश॑त्सू॒नृता॑यै
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ yádi ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ asmé íti ǀ śárdhāya ǀ stómam ǀ jujuṣé ǀ námasvān ǀviśvátra ǀ yásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ pūrvī́-iva ǀ gātúḥ ǀ dā́śat ǀ sūnṛ́tāyai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “If the priest offers homage to you two (MitraandVaruṇa) for the sake of your friendship and ourinvigoration, on (the formation of) which (friendship) the praises (of theAṅgirasasgo) everywhere in a commondirection; may he give (plural asure) to the utterer of praise like an ancient road.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स गृ॑णा॒नो अ॒द्भिर्दे॒ववा॒निति॑ सु॒बन्धु॒र्नम॑सा सू॒क्तैः । वर्ध॑दु॒क्थैर्वचो॑भि॒रा हि नू॒नं व्यध्वै॑ति॒ पय॑स उ॒स्रिया॑याः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ devá-vān ǀ íti ǀ su-bándhuḥ ǀ námasā ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀvárdhat ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ nūnám ǀ ví ǀ ádhvā ǀ eti ǀ páyasaḥ ǀ usríyāyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being praised with reverence and hymns thus, "the god-accompanied (Varuṇa) of good lineage,together with the waters"; may he be magnified; (attracted) by hymns and prayers (may he) now (approach); thepath of the milk of the cow is open (for his worship).”

shlokas.sanskrit: त ऊ॒ षु णो॑ म॒हो य॑जत्रा भू॒त दे॑वास ऊ॒तये॑ स॒जोषा॑: । ये वाजाँ॒ अन॑यता वि॒यन्तो॒ ये स्था नि॑चे॒तारो॒ अमू॑राः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ bhūtá ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀyé ǀ vā́jān ǀ ánayata ǀ vi-yántaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sthá ǀ ni-cetā́raḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable divinities, be consentient for our great preservation, both you who, going in variousdirections, are the bringers of food, and you who, being no longer perplexed, are the discoverers (of the cattle).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये य॒ज्ञेन॒ दक्षि॑णया॒ सम॑क्ता॒ इन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यम॑मृत॒त्वमा॑न॒श । तेभ्यो॑ भ॒द्रम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ yajñéna ǀ dákṣiṇayā ǀ sám-aktāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśá ǀtébhyaḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, who associated with sacrifice and pious donations, have acquired the friendship ofIndraandimmortality; upon you,Aṅgirasas, may good fortune attend; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य उ॒दाज॑न्पि॒तरो॑ गो॒मयं॒ वस्वृ॒तेनाभि॑न्दन्परिवत्स॒रे व॒लम् । दी॒र्घा॒यु॒त्वम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ut-ā́jan ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ go-máyam ǀ vásu ǀ ṛténa ǀ ábhindan ǀ parivatsaré ǀ valám ǀdīrghāyu-tvám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May length of life be yours,Aṅgirasas, our progenitors, who drove forth the wealth of cattle, and bymeans of your sacrifice when the year was ended, demolished (theasura)Bala; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ऋ॒तेन॒ सूर्य॒मारो॑हयन्दि॒व्यप्र॑थयन्पृथि॒वीं मा॒तरं॒ वि । सु॒प्र॒जा॒स्त्वम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ṛténa ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ árohayan ǀ diví ǀ áprathayan ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mātáram ǀ ví ǀsuprajāḥ-tvám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the possession of posterity be yours,Aṅgirasas, who elevated by the (power) of sacrifice theSun in heaven, and made the maternal earth renowned; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं नाभा॑ वदति व॒ल्गु वो॑ गृ॒हे देव॑पुत्रा ऋषय॒स्तच्छृ॑णोतन । सु॒ब्र॒ह्म॒ण्यम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ nā́bhā ǀ vadati ǀ valgú ǀ vaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ déva-putrāḥ ǀ ṛṣayaḥ ǀ tát ǀ śṛṇotana ǀsu-brahmaṇyám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ṛṣis, sons of the gods, this (Nābhānediṣṭha) addresses to you in the house of (sacrifice) hisbenediction, hear it; may divine splendour,Aṅgirasas, be yours; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विरू॑पास॒ इदृष॑य॒स्त इद्ग॑म्भी॒रवे॑पसः । ते अङ्गि॑रसः सू॒नव॒स्ते अ॒ग्नेः परि॑ जज्ञिरे
shlokas.transliteration: ví-rūpāsaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ té ǀ ít ǀ gambhīrá-vepasaḥ ǀté ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ té ǀ agnéḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñire ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These Ṛṣis, however different in form, were verily of profound piety; they are theAṅgirasaswhohave been born as the sons ofAgni.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये अ॒ग्नेः परि॑ जज्ञि॒रे विरू॑पासो दि॒वस्परि॑ । नव॑ग्वो॒ नु दश॑ग्वो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्तमो॒ सचा॑ दे॒वेषु॑ मंहते
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ agnéḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñiré ǀ ví-rūpāsaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀnáva-gvaḥ ǀ nú ǀ dáśa-gvaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sácā ǀ devéṣu ǀ maṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Among those who have sprung fromAgniin many forms, (and spring) from heaven, the chiefAṅgirasa, the celebrator of the nine-month rite, the celebrator of the ten-month rite, accompanied by the godsbestows (upon me wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा निः सृ॑जन्त वा॒घतो॑ व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । स॒हस्रं॑ मे॒ दद॑तो अष्टक॒र्ण्य१॒॑: श्रवो॑ दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत
shlokas.transliteration: índreṇa ǀ yujā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ sṛjanta ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀsahásram ǀ me ǀ dádataḥ ǀ aṣṭa-karṇyáḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ akrata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The acceptors of oblations, withIndrafor their associate, have emptied pastures crowded with cows,and horses, giving me a thousand full-grown (cattle), they have gained renown among the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नू॒नं जा॑यताम॒यं मनु॒स्तोक्मे॑व रोहतु । यः स॒हस्रं॑ श॒ताश्वं॑ स॒द्यो दा॒नाय॒ मंह॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ nūnám ǀ jāyatām ǀ ayám ǀ mánuḥ ǀ tókma-iva ǀ rohatu ǀyáḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ śatá-aśvam ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ dānā́ya ǀ máṃhate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thisManu(Sāvarṇi) quickly be born, may he increase like (well- watered) seed, who sends meat once a thousand and a hundred horses for a present.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तम॑श्नोति॒ कश्च॒न दि॒व इ॑व॒ सान्वा॒रभ॑म् । सा॒व॒र्ण्यस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ वि सिन्धु॑रिव पप्रथे
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ aśnoti ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ diváḥ-iva ǀ sā́nu ǀ ā-rábham ǀsāvarṇyásya ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀ ví ǀ síndhuḥ-iva ǀ paprathe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No one succeeds in reaching him; (elevated) like the summit of heaven, the liberality ofSāvarṇihasbroadened out like a river.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दा॒सा प॑रि॒विषे॒ स्मद्दि॑ष्टी॒ गोप॑रीणसा । यदु॑स्तु॒र्वश्च॑ मामहे
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ dāsā́ ǀ pari-víṣe ǀ smáddiṣṭī íti smát-diṣṭī ǀ gó-parīṇasā ǀyáduḥ ǀ turváḥ ǀ ca ǀ mamahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “YaduandIndraspeaking auspiciously, and possessed of numerous cattle, gave them like (appointed)servants, for the enjoyment (ofManuSāvarṇi).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ह॒स्र॒दा ग्रा॑म॒णीर्मा रि॑ष॒न्मनु॒: सूर्ये॑णास्य॒ यत॑मानैतु॒ दक्षि॑णा । साव॑र्णेर्दे॒वाः प्र ति॑र॒न्त्वायु॒र्यस्मि॒न्नश्रा॑न्ता॒ अस॑नाम॒ वाज॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sahasra-dā́ḥ ǀ grāma-nī́ḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣat ǀ mánuḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ asya ǀ yátamānā ǀ etu ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀsā́varṇeḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ tirantu ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ áśrāntāḥ ǀ ásanāma ǀ vā́jam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the donor of a thousand (cows), the head of the district, theManu, never suffer wrong, may hisliberality go spreading (in glory) with the sun; may the gods prolong the life ofSāvarṇi(from whom) unwearied(in his service) we enjoy abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रा॒वतो॒ ये दिधि॑षन्त॒ आप्यं॒ मनु॑प्रीतासो॒ जनि॑मा वि॒वस्व॑तः । य॒याते॒र्ये न॑हु॒ष्य॑स्य ब॒र्हिषि॑ दे॒वा आस॑ते॒ ते अधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु नः
shlokas.transliteration: parā-vátaḥ ǀ yé ǀ dídhiṣante ǀ ā́pyam ǀ mánu-prītāsaḥ ǀ jánima ǀ vivásvataḥ ǀyayā́teḥ ǀ yé ǀ nahuṣyásya ǀ barhíṣi ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ā́sate ǀ té ǀ ádhi ǀ bruvantu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gods who, (coming) from afar proclaim their affinity (with men), and beloved by men, (support)the genitive rations of (Manu, the son of)Vivasvat; may they who are seated on the sacred grass ofYayāti, the sonofNahuṣa, speak favourably unto us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वा॒ हि वो॑ नम॒स्या॑नि॒ वन्द्या॒ नामा॑नि देवा उ॒त य॒ज्ञिया॑नि वः । ये स्थ जा॒ता अदि॑तेर॒द्भ्यस्परि॒ ये पृ॑थि॒व्यास्ते म॑ इ॒ह श्रु॑ता॒ हव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: víśvā ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ namasyā́ni ǀ vándyā ǀ nā́māni ǀ devāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ vaḥ ǀyé ǀ sthá ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ pári ǀ yé ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ té ǀ me ǀ ihá ǀ śruta ǀ hávam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “All your appellations, gods, are to be revered and praised, and worshipped, and whether you aresprung from heaven, or from the firmament, or from earth, hear at this (solemnity) my invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येभ्यो॑ मा॒ता मधु॑म॒त्पिन्व॑ते॒ पय॑: पी॒यूषं॒ द्यौरदि॑ति॒रद्रि॑बर्हाः । उ॒क्थशु॑ष्मान्वृषभ॒रान्त्स्वप्न॑स॒स्ताँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ अनु॑ मदा स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yébhyaḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pínvate ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ádri-barhāḥ ǀukthá-śuṣmān ǀ vṛṣa-bharā́n ǀ su-ápnasaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ánu ǀ mada ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To (these dieties) to whom the maternal (earth) yields the sweet- flavoured milk, and thecloud-invested, undepressed heaven (yields) ambrosia, to thoseĀdityaswhose strength is sacred praise, whoare bringers of rain, the doers of good actions, offer for your welfare laudation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒चक्ष॑सो॒ अनि॑मिषन्तो अ॒र्हणा॑ बृ॒हद्दे॒वासो॑ अमृत॒त्वमा॑नशुः । ज्यो॒तीर॑था॒ अहि॑माया॒ अना॑गसो दि॒वो व॒र्ष्माणं॑ वसते स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀ áni-miṣantaḥ ǀ arháṇā ǀ bṛhát ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀjyotíḥ-rathāḥ ǀ áhi-māyāḥ ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ varṣmā́ṇam ǀ vasate ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods, the never-slumbering beholders of mankind, and entitled (to their adoration), have obtainedgreat immortality; conveyed in chariots of light, possessed of unsurpassable wisdom, devoid of sin, they inhabitthe exalted station of heaven for the well-being (of the world).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒म्राजो॒ ये सु॒वृधो॑ य॒ज्ञमा॑य॒युरप॑रिह्वृता दधि॒रे दि॒वि क्षय॑म् । ताँ आ वि॑वास॒ नम॑सा सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र्म॒हो आ॑दि॒त्याँ अदि॑तिं स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ yé ǀ su-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā-yayúḥ ǀ ápari-hvṛtāḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ diví ǀ kṣáyam ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsa ǀ námasā ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ādityā́n ǀ áditim ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods, who, kings over all, and most exalted, have come to the sacrifice, who, unassailable, abidein heaven; them, the mightyĀdityas, (the sage) worships with reverence, and with praises, and alsoAditifor hiswell- being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को व॒: स्तोमं॑ राधति॒ यं जुजो॑षथ॒ विश्वे॑ देवासो मनुषो॒ यति॒ ष्ठन॑ । को वो॑ऽध्व॒रं तु॑विजाता॒ अरं॑ कर॒द्यो न॒: पर्ष॒दत्यंह॑: स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ stómam ǀ rādhati ǀ yám ǀ jújoṣatha ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ manuṣaḥ ǀ yáti ǀ sthána ǀkáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ tuvi-jātāḥ ǀ áram ǀ karat ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ áti ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who offers you the praise which you like, you wise universal deities, however many you may be?Deities from whom many are born, who can prepare for you such worship as may bear the safe beyond iniquityfor our well-being?”

shlokas.sanskrit: येभ्यो॒ होत्रां॑ प्रथ॒मामा॑ये॒जे मनु॒: समि॑द्धाग्नि॒र्मन॑सा स॒प्त होतृ॑भिः । त आ॑दित्या॒ अभ॑यं॒ शर्म॑ यच्छत सु॒गा न॑: कर्त सु॒पथा॑ स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yébhyaḥ ǀ hótrām ǀ prathamā́m ǀ ā-yejé ǀ mánuḥ ǀ sámiddha-agniḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ saptá ǀ hótṛ-bhiḥ ǀté ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ su-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ karta ǀ su-páthā ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Ādityas, to whom,Manu, having kindled the fire, offered the first sacrifice with (reverent) mind,(aided) by the seven ministrant priests, do you bestow upon us prosperity, free from peril; provide for us plural asantpaths easy to travel for our well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य ईशि॑रे॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसो॒ विश्व॑स्य स्था॒तुर्जग॑तश्च॒ मन्त॑वः । ते न॑: कृ॒तादकृ॑ता॒देन॑स॒स्पर्य॒द्या दे॑वासः पिपृता स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ ī́śire ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ca ǀ mántavaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛtā́t ǀ ákṛtāt ǀ énasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ adyá ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ pipṛta ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the wise and omniscient deities, who rule over the whole world both stationary and moveable,deliver us today from committed and uncommitted sin, for our well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भरे॒ष्विन्द्रं॑ सु॒हवं॑ हवामहेंऽहो॒मुचं॑ सु॒कृतं॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म् । अ॒ग्निं मि॒त्रं वरु॑णं सा॒तये॒ भगं॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी म॒रुत॑: स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: bháreṣu ǀ índram ǀ su-hávam ǀ havāmahe ǀ aṃhaḥ-múcam ǀ su-kṛ́tam ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀagním ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ sātáye ǀ bhágam ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We call in battles upon the well-invokedIndra, the liberator from sin, and upon the virtuous folk ofheaven,Agni,Mitra,Varuṇa,Bhaga, Heaven and Earth, theMaruts, for the acquisition (of food), for well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒त्रामा॑णं पृथि॒वीं द्याम॑ने॒हसं॑ सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑तिं सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् । दैवीं॒ नावं॑ स्वरि॒त्रामना॑गस॒मस्र॑वन्ती॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: su-trā́māṇam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ anehásam ǀ su-śármāṇam ǀ áditim ǀ su-pránītim ǀdáivīm ǀ nā́vam ǀ su-aritrā́m ǀ ánāgasam ǀ ásravantīm ǀ ā́ ǀ ruhema ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we for our well-being ascend the well-oared, defectless, unyielding, divine vessel, thesafe-sheltering expansive heaven, exempt from evil, replete with happiness, exalted and right-directing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ यजत्रा॒ अधि॑ वोचतो॒तये॒ त्राय॑ध्वं नो दु॒रेवा॑या अभि॒ह्रुत॑: । स॒त्यया॑ वो दे॒वहू॑त्या हुवेम शृण्व॒तो दे॑वा॒ अव॑से स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ ūtáye ǀ trā́yadhvam ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-évāyāḥ ǀ abhi-hrútaḥ ǀsatyáyā ǀ vaḥ ǀ devá-hūtyā ǀ huvema ǀ śṛṇvatáḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adorable, universal gods, advocate our cause for our protection; preserve us from malignant adversity,may we with since invocation invoke you, gods, who listen (to our praise) for our protection, for our well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अपामी॑वा॒मप॒ विश्वा॒मना॑हुति॒मपारा॑तिं दुर्वि॒दत्रा॑मघाय॒तः । आ॒रे दे॑वा॒ द्वेषो॑ अ॒स्मद्यु॑योतनो॒रु ण॒: शर्म॑ यच्छता स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ ámīvām ǀ ápa ǀ víśvām ǀ ánāhutim ǀ ápa ǀ árātim ǀ duḥ-vidátrām ǀ agha-yatáḥ ǀāré ǀ devāḥ ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ asmát ǀ yuyotana ǀ urú ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Remove far) from us disease, remove all neglect of oblations, remove illiberality, the malevolence ofthose who wish to do us harm; remove far from us, gods, those who hate us; grant us ample happiness for ourwell-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अरि॑ष्ट॒: स मर्तो॒ विश्व॑ एधते॒ प्र प्र॒जाभि॑र्जायते॒ धर्म॑ण॒स्परि॑ । यमा॑दित्यासो॒ नय॑था सुनी॒तिभि॒रति॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: áriṣṭaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ mártaḥ ǀ víśvaḥ ǀ edhate ǀ prá ǀ pra-jā́bhiḥ ǀ jāyate ǀ dhármaṇaḥ ǀ pári ǀyám ǀ ādityāsaḥ ǀ náyatha ǀ sunītí-bhiḥ ǀ áti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Unharmed prospers every mortal, after performing his duties, he flourishes with posterity, whom youĀdityas guide with good counsels safe over all misfortunes to well-being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं दे॑वा॒सोऽव॑थ॒ वाज॑सातौ॒ यं शूर॑साता मरुतो हि॒ते धने॑ । प्रा॒त॒र्यावा॑णं॒ रथ॑मिन्द्र सान॒सिमरि॑ष्यन्त॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ávatha ǀ vā́ja-sātau ǀ yám ǀ śū́ra-sātā ǀ marutaḥ ǀ hité ǀ dháne ǀprātaḥ-yā́vānam ǀ rátham ǀ indra ǀ sānasím ǀ áriṣyantam ǀ ā́ ǀ ruhema ǀ svastáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The chariot) which, deities, you protect for the supply of food; that which,Maruts, (you protect) inbattle for the sake of the deposited spoil; may we mount,Indra, the early-moving desirable irresistible chariot forour well- being.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति न॑: प॒थ्या॑सु॒ धन्व॑सु स्व॒स्त्य१॒॑प्सु वृ॒जने॒ स्व॑र्वति । स्व॒स्ति न॑: पुत्रकृ॒थेषु॒ योनि॑षु स्व॒स्ति रा॒ये म॑रुतो दधातन
shlokas.transliteration: svastí ǀ naḥ ǀ pathyā́su ǀ dhánva-su ǀ svastí ǀ ap-sú ǀ vṛjáne ǀ sváḥ-vati ǀsvastí ǀ naḥ ǀ putra-kṛthéṣu ǀ yóniṣu ǀ svastí ǀ rāyé ǀ marutaḥ ǀ dadhātana ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, secure to us well-being on roads, in deserts, well-being in waters, midst the might of assailinghosts; well-being in the son-bearing wombs (of our wives); well-being for (the acquisition of) riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्तिरिद्धि प्रप॑थे॒ श्रेष्ठा॒ रेक्ण॑स्वत्य॒भि या वा॒ममेति॑ । सा नो॑ अ॒मा सो अर॑णे॒ नि पा॑तु स्वावे॒शा भ॑वतु दे॒वगो॑पा
shlokas.transliteration: svastíḥ ǀ ít ǀ hí ǀ prá-pathe ǀ śréṣṭhā ǀ rékṇasvatī ǀ abhí ǀ yā́ ǀ vāmám ǀ éti ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ amā́ ǀ só íti ǀ áraṇe ǀ ní ǀ pātu ǀ su-āveśā́ ǀ bhavatu ǀ devá-gopā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (pṛthivī), who secures well-being to the excellent path, who, abounding with wealth, goes to thedesirable (plural ce of sacrifice), preserve our home, may she protect us on the path we have to travel; cherished bythe gods, may she be to us a plural asant abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा प्ल॒तेः सू॒नुर॑वीवृधद्वो॒ विश्व॑ आदित्या अदिते मनी॒षी । ई॒शा॒नासो॒ नरो॒ अम॑र्त्ये॒नास्ता॑वि॒ जनो॑ दि॒व्यो गये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ platéḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǀ vaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ manīṣī́ ǀīśānā́saḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ámartyena ǀ ástāvi ǀ jánaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ gáyena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal deities andAditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the lords (of wealth) have beengloried byGaya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था दे॒वानां॑ कत॒मस्य॒ याम॑नि सु॒मन्तु॒ नाम॑ शृण्व॒तां म॑नामहे । को मृ॑ळाति कत॒मो नो॒ मय॑स्करत्कत॒म ऊ॒ती अ॒भ्या व॑वर्तति
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ katamásya ǀ yā́mani ǀ su-mántu ǀ nā́ma ǀ śṛṇvatā́m ǀ manāmahe ǀkáḥ ǀ mṛḷāti ǀ katamáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ máyaḥ ǀ karat ǀ katamáḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǀ abhí ǀ ā́ ǀ vavartati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In what manner, and of which of the gods, who hear (our praises) at the sacrifice, may we enunciatethe venerable name? Who will show us compassion? Which of them will grant us happiness? Which of themcomes for our protection?”

shlokas.sanskrit: क्र॒तू॒यन्ति॒ क्रत॑वो हृ॒त्सु धी॒तयो॒ वेन॑न्ति वे॒नाः प॒तय॒न्त्या दिश॑: । न म॑र्डि॒ता वि॑द्यते अ॒न्य ए॑भ्यो दे॒वेषु॑ मे॒ अधि॒ कामा॑ अयंसत
shlokas.transliteration: kratu-yánti ǀ krátavaḥ ǀ hṛt-sú ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀ vénanti ǀ venā́ḥ ǀ patáyanti ǀ ā́ ǀ díśaḥ ǀná ǀ marḍitā́ ǀ vidyate ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ me ǀ ádhi ǀ kā́māḥ ǀ ayaṃsata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The desires cherished in my heart strive to offer worship; (our) wishes long for (the gods) andexpressed (by us) go forth to (the gods); no other bestower of happiness exists except them; upon the gods aremy desire concentrated.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॑ वा॒ शंसं॑ पू॒षण॒मगो॑ह्यम॒ग्निं दे॒वेद्ध॑म॒भ्य॑र्चसे गि॒रा । सूर्या॒मासा॑ च॒न्द्रम॑सा य॒मं दि॒वि त्रि॒तं वात॑मु॒षस॑म॒क्तुम॒श्विना॑
shlokas.transliteration: nárāśáṃsam ǀ vā ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ ágohyam ǀ agním ǀ devá-iddham ǀ abhí ǀ arcase ǀ girā́ ǀsū́ryāmā́sā ǀ candrámasā ǀ yamám ǀ diví ǀ tritám ǀ vā́tam ǀ uṣásam ǀ aktúm ǀ aśvínā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore with praises Nārāśaṃsa andPūṣan, and the unapproachableAgnikindled by the devoutAśvins.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒था क॒विस्तु॑वी॒रवा॒न्कया॑ गि॒रा बृह॒स्पति॑र्वावृधते सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑: । अ॒ज एक॑पात्सु॒हवे॑भि॒ॠक्व॑भि॒रहि॑: शृणोतु बु॒ध्न्यो॒३॒॑ हवी॑मनि
shlokas.transliteration: kathā́ ǀ kavíḥ ǀ tuvi-rávān ǀ káyā ǀ girā́ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ vavṛdhate ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀajáḥ ǀ éka-pāt ǀ su-hávebhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ áhiḥ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ budhnyáḥ ǀ hávīmani ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “How is the sage(Agni) adored by multitudes, and by what praises?Bṛhaspatiis magnified with sacredhymns; Aja, walking alone, is magnified with solemn invocations and prayers; mayAhirbudhnyahear us at theseason of invocation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दक्ष॑स्य वादिते॒ जन्म॑नि व्र॒ते राजा॑ना मि॒त्रावरु॒णा वि॑वाससि । अतू॑र्तपन्थाः पुरु॒रथो॑ अर्य॒मा स॒प्तहो॑ता॒ विषु॑रूपेषु॒ जन्म॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: dákṣasya ǀ vā ǀ adite ǀ jánmani ǀ vraté ǀ rā́jānā ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsasi ǀátūrta-panthāḥ ǀ puru-ráthaḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ saptá-hotā ǀ víṣu-rūpeṣu ǀ jánma-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “At the birth ofDakṣa, at his sacred rite, you,Aditi, worshipped the royalMitraandVaruṇaat thesacred rite.Aryaman, whose course is not hurried, the giver of delight to many, having seven ministering (rays),(proceeds) in his multiform births.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नो॒ अर्व॑न्तो हवन॒श्रुतो॒ हवं॒ विश्वे॑ शृण्वन्तु वा॒जिनो॑ मि॒तद्र॑वः । स॒ह॒स्र॒सा मे॒धसा॑ताविव॒ त्मना॑ म॒हो ये धनं॑ समि॒थेषु॑ जभ्रि॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ naḥ ǀ árvantaḥ ǀ havana-śrútaḥ ǀ hávam ǀ víśve ǀ śṛṇvantu ǀ vājínaḥ ǀ mitá-dravaḥ ǀsahasra-sā́ḥ ǀ medhásātau-iva ǀ tmánā ǀ maháḥ ǀ yé ǀ dhánam ǀ sam-ithéṣu ǀ jabhriré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those universal horses (of the deities), who listen to invocations, who are vigorous, swiftroadsters, hear our summons; they who spontaneously are the givers of thousands, as if at sacrifice; they whohave won great wealth in battles.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वो॑ वा॒युं र॑थ॒युजं॒ पुरं॑धिं॒ स्तोमै॑: कृणुध्वं स॒ख्याय॑ पू॒षण॑म् । ते हि दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः सवी॑मनि॒ क्रतुं॒ सच॑न्ते स॒चित॒: सचे॑तसः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ vāyúm ǀ ratha-yújam ǀ púram-dhim ǀ stómaiḥ ǀ kṛṇudhvam ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀté ǀ hí ǀ devásya ǀ savitúḥ ǀ sávīmani ǀ krátum ǀ sácante ǀ sa-cítaḥ ǀ sá-cetasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Importune, (worshippers), with praises,Vāyu, harnessing his chariot, and Purandhi andPūṣanfortheir friendship, for these considerate and consentient deities, attend the sacrifice upon the birth ofSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिः स॒प्त स॒स्रा न॒द्यो॑ म॒हीर॒पो वन॒स्पती॒न्पर्व॑ताँ अ॒ग्निमू॒तये॑ । कृ॒शानु॒मस्तॄ॑न्ति॒ष्यं॑ स॒धस्थ॒ आ रु॒द्रं रु॒द्रेषु॑ रु॒द्रियं॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: tríḥ ǀ saptá ǀ sasrā́ḥ ǀ nadyáḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ vánaspátīn ǀ párvatān ǀ agním ǀ ūtáye ǀkṛśā́num ǀ ástṝn ǀ tiṣyám ǀ sadhá-sthe ǀ ā́ ǀ rudrám ǀ rudréṣu ǀ rudríyam ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for protection the thrice seven flowing rivers, (their) great waters, the trees, the mountains,Agni,Kṛśānu, the archers, andTiṣya, to the assembly; (we invoke)Rudra, worthy of the praise of theRudras,for the good of the praisers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सर॑स्वती स॒रयु॒: सिन्धु॑रू॒र्मिभि॑र्म॒हो म॒हीरव॒सा य॑न्तु॒ वक्ष॑णीः । दे॒वीरापो॑ मा॒तर॑: सूदयि॒त्न्वो॑ घृ॒तव॒त्पयो॒ मधु॑मन्नो अर्चत
shlokas.transliteration: sárasvatī ǀ saráyuḥ ǀ síndhuḥ ǀ ūrmí-bhiḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ mahī́ḥ ǀ ávasā ǀ ā́ ǀ yantu ǀ vákṣaṇīḥ ǀdevī́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ sūdayitnváḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ naḥ ǀ arcata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the very great rivers,Sarasvatī,Sarayu,Sindhu, come with their waves for (our) protection; maythe divine maternal animating waters grant us their water mixed with butter and honey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त मा॒ता बृ॑हद्दि॒वा शृ॑णोतु न॒स्त्वष्टा॑ दे॒वेभि॒र्जनि॑भिः पि॒ता वच॑: । ऋ॒भु॒क्षा वाजो॒ रथ॒स्पति॒र्भगो॑ र॒ण्वः शंस॑: शशमा॒नस्य॑ पातु नः
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ mātā́ ǀ bṛhat-divā́ ǀ śṛṇotu ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ jáni-bhiḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ vácaḥ ǀṛbhukṣā́ḥ ǀ vā́jaḥ ǀ ráthaḥpátiḥ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ raṇváḥ ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the bright shining mother (of the gods) hear us; may fatherTvaṣṭā, with the gods, and theirwives, (hear our) words; may Ṛbhukṣan,Vāja, Rathaspati,Bhaga, may the joyous adorable (company of theMaruts) protect us their praisers.”

shlokas.sanskrit: र॒ण्वः संदृ॑ष्टौ पितु॒माँ इ॑व॒ क्षयो॑ भ॒द्रा रु॒द्राणां॑ म॒रुता॒मुप॑स्तुतिः । गोभि॑: ष्याम य॒शसो॒ जने॒ष्वा सदा॑ देवास॒ इळ॑या सचेमहि
shlokas.transliteration: raṇváḥ ǀ sám-dṛṣṭau ǀ pitumā́n-iva ǀ kṣáyaḥ ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ rudrā́ṇām ǀ marútām ǀ úpa-stutiḥ ǀgóbhiḥ ǀ syāma ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ jáneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀ sádā ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ íḷayā ǀ sacemahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “plural asant of aspect (is troop ofMaruts), like a house well stored with provisions; fortunate is the favourof the Maruts, the sons ofRudra; may we (thereby) be famed among men for cattle, and so, gods, ever approach(you) with sacrificial food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यां मे॒ धियं॒ मरु॑त॒ इन्द्र॒ देवा॒ अद॑दात वरुण मित्र यू॒यम् । तां पी॑पयत॒ पय॑सेव धे॒नुं कु॒विद्गिरो॒ अधि॒ रथे॒ वहा॑थ
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ me ǀ dhíyam ǀ márutaḥ ǀ índra ǀ dévāḥ ǀ ádadāta ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ yūyám ǀtā́m ǀ pīpayata ǀ páyasā-iva ǀ dhenúm ǀ kuvít ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ ráthe ǀ váhātha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts,Indra, gods,VaruṇaandMitra, reward the worship, which you have given as (men fatten) the(newly-delivered) cow with milk, you have repeatedly put my praises on your car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विद॒ङ्ग प्रति॒ यथा॑ चिद॒स्य न॑: सजा॒त्य॑स्य मरुतो॒ बुबो॑धथ । नाभा॒ यत्र॑ प्रथ॒मं सं॒नसा॑महे॒ तत्र॑ जामि॒त्वमदि॑तिर्दधातु नः
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ práti ǀ yáthā ǀ cit ǀ asyá ǀ naḥ ǀ sa-jātyásya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ búbodhatha ǀnā́bhā ǀ yátra ǀ prathamám ǀ sam-násāmahe ǀ tátra ǀ jāmi-tvám ǀ áditiḥ ǀ dadhātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Maruts, repeatedly acknowledge us, so that (you may make us the objects) of this relationship; andmayAditigrant us affinity (with men) on the navel of the earth, where we first assemble (to offer oblations).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते हि द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी मा॒तरा॑ म॒ही दे॒वी दे॒वाञ्जन्म॑ना य॒ज्ञिये॑ इ॒तः । उ॒भे बि॑भृत उ॒भयं॒ भरी॑मभिः पु॒रू रेतां॑सि पि॒तृभि॑श्च सिञ्चतः
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ hí ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ mātárā ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ devā́n ǀ jánmanā ǀ yajñíye íti ǀ itáḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ bibhṛtaḥ ǀ ubháyam ǀ bhárīma-bhiḥ ǀ purú ǀ rétāṃsi ǀ pitṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ siñcataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They, two, the maternal heaven and earth, mighty, divine, adorable, attain to the gods upon their birth;they both cherish the two (races, human and divine) (gods), they shed abundant moisture.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षा होत्रा॒ विश्व॑मश्नोति॒ वार्यं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒रम॑ति॒: पनी॑यसी । ग्रावा॒ यत्र॑ मधु॒षुदु॒च्यते॑ बृ॒हदवी॑वशन्त म॒तिभि॑र्मनी॒षिण॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sā́ ǀ hótrā ǀ víśvam ǀ aśnoti ǀ vā́ryam ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ pánīyasī ǀgrā́vā ǀ yátra ǀ madhu-sút ǀ ucyáte ǀ bṛhát ǀ ávīvaśanta ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That voice of invocation, the protectress of the mighty, never ceasing, the panegyrist (of the gods),the pious, by their praises, make the god desirous (of the sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा क॒विस्तु॑वी॒रवाँ॑ ऋत॒ज्ञा द्र॑विण॒स्युर्द्रवि॑णसश्चका॒नः । उ॒क्थेभि॒रत्र॑ म॒तिभि॑श्च॒ विप्रोऽपी॑पय॒द्गयो॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ जन्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ kavíḥ ǀ tuvi-rávān ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ draviṇasyúḥ ǀ dráviṇasaḥ ǀ cakānáḥ ǀukthébhiḥ ǀ átra ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ ca ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ápīpayat ǀ gáyaḥ ǀ divyā́ni ǀ jánma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious sage,Gaya, eloquent in laudation, conversant with sacred rites, wishing for wealth, eagerfor wealth, propitiates the celestial people with prayers and praises.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा प्ल॒तेः सू॒नुर॑वीवृधद्वो॒ विश्व॑ आदित्या अदिते मनी॒षी । ई॒शा॒नासो॒ नरो॒ अम॑र्त्ये॒नास्ता॑वि॒ जनो॑ दि॒व्यो गये॑न
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ platéḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ avīvṛdhat ǀ vaḥ ǀ víśve ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ adite ǀ manīṣī́ ǀīśānā́saḥ ǀ náraḥ ǀ ámartyena ǀ ástāvi ǀ jánaḥ ǀ divyáḥ ǀ gáyena ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Universal deities andAditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the bonds (of wealth), have beenglorified byGaya.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरिन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वा॒युः पू॒षा सर॑स्वती स॒जोष॑सः । आ॒दि॒त्या विष्णु॑र्म॒रुत॒: स्व॑र्बृ॒हत्सोमो॑ रु॒द्रो अदि॑ति॒र्ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ vāyúḥ ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ sa-jóṣasaḥ ǀādityā́ḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sváḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ sómaḥ ǀ rudráḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni,Inda,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,Vāyu,Pūṣan,Sarasvatī, theĀdityas,Viṣṇu, theMaruts,the mighty heaven,Soma,Rudra,Aditi,Brahmaṇaspatiwith one consent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॑षु॒ सत्प॑ती मि॒थो हि॑न्वा॒ना त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ समो॑कसा । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मह्या प॑प्रु॒रोज॑सा॒ सोमो॑ घृत॒श्रीर्म॑हि॒मान॑मी॒रय॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: indrāgnī́ íti ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀ mitháḥ ǀ hinvānā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sám-okasā ǀantárikṣam ǀ máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ papruḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ghṛta-śrī́ḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ īráyan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, andAgni, the lords of the virtuous, standing in the same plural ce, mutually invigorating each otherwith might in theVṛtra-slaying battles, and the ghī-glorifiedSomaputting forth his greatness have filled the vastfirmament with their strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तेषां॒ हि म॒ह्ना म॑ह॒ताम॑न॒र्वणां॒ स्तोमाँ॒ इय॑र्म्यृत॒ज्ञा ऋ॑ता॒वृधा॑म् । ये अ॑प्स॒वम॑र्ण॒वं चि॒त्ररा॑धस॒स्ते नो॑ रासन्तां म॒हये॑ सुमि॒त्र्याः
shlokas.transliteration: téṣām ǀ hí ǀ mahnā́ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ anarváṇām ǀ stómān ǀ íyarmi ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhām ǀyé ǀ apsavám ǀ arṇavám ǀ citrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ maháye ǀ su-mitryā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Skilled in pious rites, I recite the praises of these (deities), mighty through (their own) might,unassailable, exalted by sacrifice; may those (gods) who possessed of various wealth, (rain down) the beautifulwater-cloud, acting in friendly wise, grant us (wealth) for our honour (among men).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॑र्णरम॒न्तरि॑क्षाणि रोच॒ना द्यावा॒भूमी॑ पृथि॒वीं स्क॑म्भु॒रोज॑सा । पृ॒क्षा इ॑व म॒हय॑न्तः सुरा॒तयो॑ दे॒वाः स्त॑वन्ते॒ मनु॑षाय सू॒रय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sváḥ-naram ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀ dyā́vābhū́mī íti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ skambhuḥ ǀ ójasā ǀpṛkṣā́ḥ-iva ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ su-rātáyaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ stavante ǀ mánuṣāya ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They have sustained by their strength the leader of all (the sun), the luminaries of the firmament,heaven and earth, the outstretched (firmament), honouring (their worshippers) like those who give food (to thepoor), the genitive rous gods bestowing wealth on man are glorified (at this sacrifice).”

shlokas.sanskrit: मि॒त्राय॑ शिक्ष॒ वरु॑णाय दा॒शुषे॒ या स॒म्राजा॒ मन॑सा॒ न प्र॒युच्छ॑तः । ययो॒र्धाम॒ धर्म॑णा॒ रोच॑ते बृ॒हद्ययो॑रु॒भे रोद॑सी॒ नाध॑सी॒ वृतौ॑
shlokas.transliteration: mitrā́ya ǀ śikṣa ǀ váruṇāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ yā́ ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ mánasā ǀ ná ǀ pra-yúcchataḥ ǀyáyoḥ ǀ dhā́ma ǀ dhármaṇā ǀ rócate ǀ bṛhát ǀ yáyoḥ ǀ ubhé íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ nā́dhasī íti ǀ vṛ́tau ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Worship the liberalMitraandVaruṇa, the two royal deities who are never negligent in their thoughts,whose vast body is resplendent through their functions, upon whom the two solicitous worlds (heaven and earth)remain (dependent).”

shlokas.sanskrit: या गौर्व॑र्त॒निं प॒र्येति॑ निष्कृ॒तं पयो॒ दुहा॑ना व्रत॒नीर॑वा॒रत॑: । सा प्र॑ब्रुवा॒णा वरु॑णाय दा॒शुषे॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ दाशद्ध॒विषा॑ वि॒वस्व॑ते
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ gáuḥ ǀ vartaním ǀ pari-éti ǀ niḥ-kṛtám ǀ páyaḥ ǀ dúhānā ǀ vrata-nī́ḥ ǀ avārátaḥ ǀsā́ ǀ pra-bruvāṇā́ ǀ váruṇāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ dāśat ǀ havíṣā ǀ vivásvate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May that cow, the leader of the rite, which yielding her milk proceeds uncalled to the consecratedplace (of sacrifice), may she, propitiated by me, yield her milk to (me), the offerer of oblations to liberal Varuṇaand the (other) gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वक्ष॑सो अग्निजि॒ह्वा ऋ॑ता॒वृध॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनिं॑ विमृ॒शन्त॑ आसते । द्यां स्क॑भि॒त्व्य१॒॑प आ च॑क्रु॒रोज॑सा य॒ज्ञं ज॑नि॒त्वी त॒न्वी॒३॒॑ नि मा॑मृजुः
shlokas.transliteration: divákṣasaḥ ǀ agni-jihvā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónim ǀ vi-mṛśántaḥ ǀ āsate ǀdyā́m ǀ skabhitvī́ ǀ apáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ cakruḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ yajñám ǀ janitvī́ ǀ tanví ǀ ní ǀ mamṛjuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Pervading heaven (with their radiance), havingAgnias their tongue, the augmenters of sacrifice,(these deities) sit contemplating the plural ce of sacrifice; sustaining heaven they have produced the waters by theirpower; having genitive rated sacrifice, they have decorated their person ns (with it).”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒रि॒क्षिता॑ पि॒तरा॑ पूर्व॒जाव॑री ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑ क्षयत॒: समो॑कसा । द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वरु॑णाय॒ सव्र॑ते घृ॒तव॒त्पयो॑ महि॒षाय॑ पिन्वतः
shlokas.transliteration: pari-kṣítā ǀ pitárā ǀ pūrvajā́varī íti pūrva-jā́varī ǀ ṛtásya ǀ yónā ǀ kṣayataḥ ǀ sám-okasā ǀdyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ váruṇāya ǀ sávrate íti sá-vrate ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ páyaḥ ǀ mahiṣā́ya ǀ pinvataḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The encompassing parents (heaven and earth), born of old, having a common dwelling, sit down uponthe plural ce of sacrifice; engaged in a common observance they sprinkle upon the adorableVaruṇawater mixedwith butter.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒र्जन्या॒वाता॑ वृष॒भा पु॑री॒षिणे॑न्द्रवा॒यू वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । दे॒वाँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ अदि॑तिं हवामहे॒ ये पार्थि॑वासो दि॒व्यासो॑ अ॒प्सु ये
shlokas.transliteration: parjányāvā́tā ǀ vṛṣabhā́ ǀ purīṣíṇā ǀ indravāyū́ íti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀdevā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ áditim ǀ havāmahe ǀ yé ǀ pā́rthivāsaḥ ǀ divyā́saḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ yé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two showerers (of desires),ParjanyaandVāta, the two senders of water,IndraandVāyu,Varuṇa,mMitra,Aryaman; we invoke the divineĀdityas,Aditi, and the gods, who dwell on the earth, or inheaven, or in the waters.”
