shlokas.sanskrit: सच॑न्त॒ यदु॒षस॒: सूर्ये॑ण चि॒त्राम॑स्य के॒तवो॒ राम॑विन्दन् । आ यन्नक्ष॑त्रं॒ ददृ॑शे दि॒वो न पुन॑र्य॒तो नकि॑र॒द्धा नु वे॑द
shlokas.transliteration: sácanta ǀ yát ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ citrā́m ǀ asya ǀ ketávaḥ ǀ rā́m ǀ avindan ǀā́ ǀ yát ǀ nákṣatram ǀ dádṛśe ǀ diváḥ ǀ ná ǀ púnaḥ ǀ yatáḥ ǀ nákiḥ ǀ addhā́ ǀ nú ǀ veda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the dawns are associated with the sun, his rays acquire wonderful beauty; but when theconstellation of heaven is not seen, no one really knows (his rays) as he moves.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दू॒रं किल॑ प्रथ॒मा ज॑ग्मुरासा॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ याः प्र॑स॒वे स॒स्रुराप॑: । क्व॑ स्वि॒दग्रं॒ क्व॑ बु॒ध्न आ॑सा॒मापो॒ मध्यं॒ क्व॑ वो नू॒नमन्त॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dūrám ǀ kíla ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ āsām ǀ índrasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ pra-savé ǀ sasrúḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀkvá ǀ svit ǀ ágram ǀ kvá ǀ budhnáḥ ǀ āsām ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mádhyam ǀ kvá ǀ vaḥ ǀ nūnám ǀ ántaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The first of those waters, which issued forth atIndra's sending, went very far. Where, waters, is yourbeginning, where your root, where is your centre, where indeed is your termination?”

shlokas.sanskrit: सृ॒जः सिन्धूँ॒रहि॑ना जग्रसा॒नाँ आदिदे॒ताः प्र वि॑विज्रे ज॒वेन॑ । मुमु॑क्षमाणा उ॒त या मु॑मु॒च्रेऽधेदे॒ता न र॑मन्ते॒ निति॑क्ताः
shlokas.transliteration: sṛjáḥ ǀ síndhūn ǀ áhinā ǀ jagrasānā́n ǀ ā́t ǀ ít ǀ etā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ vivijre ǀ javéna ǀmúmukṣamāṇāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ mumucré ǀ ádha ǀ ít ǀ etā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ ramante ǀ ní-tiktāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have set at liberty the streams which had been swallowed by Ahi; they rushed forth with rapidity;the waters which longed to be liberated were set free and now the pure (streams) never stop.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ध्रीची॒: सिन्धु॑मुश॒तीरि॑वायन्त्स॒नाज्जा॒र आ॑रि॒तः पू॒र्भिदा॑साम् । अस्त॒मा ते॒ पार्थि॑वा॒ वसू॑न्य॒स्मे ज॑ग्मुः सू॒नृता॑ इन्द्र पू॒र्वीः
shlokas.transliteration: sadhrī́cīḥ ǀ síndhum ǀ uśatī́ḥ-iva ǀ āyan ǀ sanā́t ǀ jāráḥ ǀ āritáḥ ǀ pūḥ-bhít ǀ āsām ǀástam ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ pā́rthivā ǀ vásūni ǀ asmé íti ǀ jagmuḥ ǀ sūnṛ́tāḥ ǀ indra ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They hasten associated together to the ocean, like loving wives (to a husband); (Indra), the witherer offoes, the demolisher of cities, is their impeller of old; may our oblations, the treasures of earth, and our copiouspraises, proceed, Indra, to your dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒ पिब॑ प्रतिका॒मं सु॒तस्य॑ प्रातःसा॒वस्तव॒ हि पू॒र्वपी॑तिः । हर्ष॑स्व॒ हन्त॑वे शूर॒ शत्रू॑नु॒क्थेभि॑ष्टे वी॒र्या॒३॒॑ प्र ब्र॑वाम
shlokas.transliteration: índra ǀ píba ǀ prati-kāmám ǀ sutásya ǀ prātaḥ-sāváḥ ǀ táva ǀ hí ǀ pūrvá-pītiḥ ǀhárṣasva ǀ hántave ǀ śūra ǀ śátrūn ǀ ukthébhiḥ ǀ te ǀ vīryā́ ǀ prá ǀ bravāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, at will of the effused libation, for it is poured out at the morning sacrifice, and is first drunkby you; exult, hero, in slaying your foes, we will glorify your heroic exploits with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ रथो॒ मन॑सो॒ जवी॑या॒नेन्द्र॒ तेन॑ सोम॒पेया॑य याहि । तूय॒मा ते॒ हर॑य॒: प्र द्र॑वन्तु॒ येभि॒र्यासि॒ वृष॑भि॒र्मन्द॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ jávīyān ǀ ā́ ǀ indra ǀ téna ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ yāhi ǀtū́yam ǀ ā́ ǀ te ǀ hárayaḥ ǀ prá ǀ dravantu ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ vṛ́ṣa-bhiḥ ǀ mándamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Indra, to theSoma-drinking with your chariot, which is swifter than thought; let your bays, thevigorous steeds with which you go along rejoicing quickly, hasten hither.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हरि॑त्वता॒ वर्च॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ श्रेष्ठै॑ रू॒पैस्त॒न्वं॑ स्पर्शयस्व । अ॒स्माभि॑रिन्द्र॒ सखि॑भिर्हुवा॒नः स॑ध्रीची॒नो मा॑दयस्वा नि॒षद्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: háritvatā ǀ várcasā ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ śréṣṭhaiḥ ǀ rūpáiḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ sparśayasva ǀasmā́bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ huvānáḥ ǀ sadhrīcīnáḥ ǀ mādayasva ǀ ni-sádya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Decorate your person n with most beautiful forms with the golden radiance of the sun; invoked by usyour friends,Indra, sit down and be exhilarated, accompanied by theMaruts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ त्यत्ते॑ महि॒मानं॒ मदे॑ष्वि॒मे म॒ही रोद॑सी॒ नावि॑विक्ताम् । तदोक॒ आ हरि॑भिरिन्द्र यु॒क्तैः प्रि॒येभि॑र्याहि प्रि॒यमन्न॒मच्छ॑
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ tyát ǀ te ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ mádeṣu ǀ imé íti ǀ mahī́ íti ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ná ǀ áviviktām ǀtát ǀ ókaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hári-bhiḥ ǀ indra ǀ yuktáiḥ ǀ priyébhiḥ ǀ yāhi ǀ priyám ǀ ánnam ǀ áccha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You whose greatness (manifested) in your exhilarations the vast heaven and earth, do not separate;come,Indra, with your beloved bay horses harnessed to your chariot, come to our dwelling to (partake of) the(sacrificial) food that is agreeable to you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्य॒ शश्व॑त्पपि॒वाँ इ॑न्द्र॒ शत्रू॑ननानुकृ॒त्या रण्या॑ च॒कर्थ॑ । स ते॒ पुरं॑धिं॒ तवि॑षीमियर्ति॒ स ते॒ मदा॑य सु॒त इ॑न्द्र॒ सोम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ śáśvat ǀ papi-vā́n ǀ indra ǀ śátrūn ǀ ananu-kṛtyā́ ǀ ráṇyā ǀ cakártha ǀsáḥ ǀ te ǀ púram-dhim ǀ táviṣīm ǀ iyarti ǀ sáḥ ǀ te ǀ mádāya ǀ sutáḥ ǀ indra ǀ sómaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThatSoma, drinking constantly of which,Indrayou have destroyed the enemies (of the worshipper)with an inimitable weapon-- that Soma prompts your powerful, abundant (laudation), it is effused Indra, for yourexhilaration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं ते॒ पात्रं॒ सन॑वित्तमिन्द्र॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑मे॒ना श॑तक्रतो । पू॒र्ण आ॑हा॒वो म॑दि॒रस्य॒ मध्वो॒ यं विश्व॒ इद॑भि॒हर्य॑न्ति दे॒वाः
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ te ǀ pā́tram ǀ sána-vittam ǀ indra ǀ píba ǀ sómam ǀ enā́ ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀpūrṇáḥ ǀ ā-hāváḥ ǀ madirásya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ yám ǀ víśve ǀ ít ǀ abhi-háryanti ǀ devā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This your cup,Indra, has been long since provided by us, drink theSomafrom it,Śatakratu; thegoblet is full of the sweet Soma, which all the gods desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि हि त्वामि॑न्द्र पुरु॒धा जना॑सो हि॒तप्र॑यसो वृषभ॒ ह्वय॑न्ते । अ॒स्माकं॑ ते॒ मधु॑मत्तमानी॒मा भु॑व॒न्त्सव॑ना॒ तेषु॑ हर्य
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ hí ǀ tvā́m ǀ indra ǀ purudhā́ ǀ jánāsaḥ ǀ hitá-prayasaḥ ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ hváyante ǀasmā́kam ǀ te ǀ mádhumat-tamāni ǀ imā́ ǀ bhuvan ǀ sávanā ǀ téṣu ǀ harya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, showerer of benefits, men in several plural ces, offering acceptable food, invoke you; these oursacrifices to you are most full of the sweet (Soma); take plural asure in them.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र त॑ इन्द्र पू॒र्व्याणि॒ प्र नू॒नं वी॒र्या॑ वोचं प्रथ॒मा कृ॒तानि॑ । स॒ती॒नम॑न्युरश्रथायो॒ अद्रिं॑ सुवेद॒नाम॑कृणो॒र्ब्रह्म॑णे॒ गाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ pūrvyā́ṇi ǀ prá ǀ nūnám ǀ vīryā́ ǀ vocam ǀ prathamā́ ǀ kṛtā́ni ǀsatīná-manyuḥ ǀ aśrathayaḥ ǀ ádrim ǀ su-vedanā́m ǀ akṛṇoḥ ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ gā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I will proclaim now,Indra, your ancient first-achieved exploits; resolved to sent rain, you did cleave thecloud, you made the cow easily discoverable for theBrāhmaṇa”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि षु सी॑द गणपते ग॒णेषु॒ त्वामा॑हु॒र्विप्र॑तमं कवी॒नाम् । न ऋ॒ते त्वत्क्रि॑यते॒ किं च॒नारे म॒हाम॒र्कं म॑घवञ्चि॒त्रम॑र्च
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ sú ǀ sīda ǀ gaṇa-pate ǀ gaṇéṣu ǀ tvā́m ǀ āhuḥ ǀ vípra-tamam ǀ kavīnā́m ǀná ǀ ṛté ǀ tvát ǀ kriyate ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āré ǀ mahā́m ǀ arkám ǀ magha-van ǀ citrám ǀ arca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lord of the companies (of theMaruts), sit down among the companies (of the worshippers), they callyou the most sage of sages; without you nothing is done in the distance; have in honour,Maghavan, our greatand various adoration. of wealth, (the wishes of) your friends; make war (for us), you warrior endowed with real strength, give us a sharein the undivided riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि॒ख्या नो॑ मघव॒न्नाध॑माना॒न्त्सखे॑ बो॒धि व॑सुपते॒ सखी॑नाम् । रणं॑ कृधि रणकृत्सत्यशु॒ष्माभ॑क्ते चि॒दा भ॑जा रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्
shlokas.transliteration: abhi-khyā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ nā́dhamānān ǀ sákhe ǀ bodhí ǀ vasu-pate ǀ sákhīnām ǀráṇam ǀ kṛdhi ǀ raṇa-kṛt ǀ satya-śuṣma ǀ ábhakte ǀ cit ǀ ā́ ǀ bhaja ǀ rāyé ǀ asmā́n ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑स्य॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी सचे॑तसा॒ विश्वे॑भिर्दे॒वैरनु॒ शुष्म॑मावताम् । यदैत्कृ॑ण्वा॒नो म॑हि॒मान॑मिन्द्रि॒यं पी॒त्वी सोम॑स्य॒ क्रतु॑माँ अवर्धत
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ asya ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ sá-cetasā ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ deváiḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śúṣmam ǀ āvatām ǀyát ǀ áit ǀ kṛṇvānáḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ indriyám ǀ pītvī́ ǀ sómasya ǀ krátu-mān ǀ avardhata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the concurring heaven and earth, together with all the gods, preserve that strength ofIndra,where by achieving (great deeds), he obtained the greatness that is appropriate to him, and having drunk theSoma, he, eminent for his prowess, increased (in strength).”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑स्य॒ विष्णु॑र्महि॒मान॒मोज॑सां॒शुं द॑ध॒न्वान्मधु॑नो॒ वि र॑प्शते । दे॒वेभि॒रिन्द्रो॑ म॒घवा॑ स॒याव॑भिर्वृ॒त्रं ज॑घ॒न्वाँ अ॑भव॒द्वरे॑ण्यः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ asya ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ ójasā ǀ aṃśúm ǀ dadhanvā́n ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rapśate ǀdevébhiḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ sayā́va-bhiḥ ǀ vṛtrám ǀ jaghanvā́n ǀ abhavat ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Viṣṇuoffering the portion of theSoma, glorified by his own vigour that greatness of his.Indra, thelord of wealth, with the associated gods having slainVṛtra, became deserving of honour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒त्रेण॒ यदहि॑ना॒ बिभ्र॒दायु॑धा स॒मस्थि॑था यु॒धये॒ शंस॑मा॒विदे॑ । विश्वे॑ ते॒ अत्र॑ म॒रुत॑: स॒ह त्मनाव॑र्धन्नुग्र महि॒मान॑मिन्द्रि॒यम्
shlokas.transliteration: vṛtréṇa ǀ yát ǀ áhinā ǀ bíbhrat ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ sam-ásthithāḥ ǀ yudháye ǀ śáṃsam ǀ ā-víde ǀvíśve ǀ te ǀ átra ǀ marútaḥ ǀ sahá ǀ tmánā ǀ ávardhan ǀ ugra ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ indriyám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you did encounter the indestructibleVṛtra, wielding your weapons for combat, you acquirerenown; all the associatedMarutsof their own accord magnified your great might appropriate toIndra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ज॒ज्ञा॒न ए॒व व्य॑बाधत॒ स्पृध॒: प्राप॑श्यद्वी॒रो अ॒भि पौंस्यं॒ रण॑म् । अवृ॑श्च॒दद्रि॒मव॑ स॒स्यद॑: सृज॒दस्त॑भ्ना॒न्नाकं॑ स्वप॒स्यया॑ पृ॒थुम्
shlokas.transliteration: jajñānáḥ ǀ evá ǀ ví ǀ abādhata ǀ spṛ́dhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ apaśyat ǀ vīráḥ ǀ abhí ǀ páuṃsyam ǀ ráṇam ǀávṛścat ǀ ádrim ǀ áva ǀ sa-syádaḥ ǀ sṛjat ǀ ástabhnāt ǀ nā́kam ǀ su-apasyáyā ǀ pṛthúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As soon as born he discomfited his assailants; the hero contemplated his own manly prowess in war;he divided the cloud, sent forth the flowing waters, and with the determination to do a good deed, upheld the vastheaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आदिन्द्र॑: स॒त्रा तवि॑षीरपत्यत॒ वरी॑यो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑बाधत । अवा॑भरद्धृषि॒तो वज्र॑माय॒सं शेवं॑ मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय दा॒शुषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́t ǀ índraḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ táviṣīḥ ǀ apatyata ǀ várīyaḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ abādhata ǀáva ǀ abharat ǀ dhṛṣitáḥ ǀ vájram ǀ āyasám ǀ śévam ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ váruṇāya ǀ dāśúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indraadvanced with vast (armies); he overcame with his might (his foed stationed between) heavenand earth; confident, he wielded his metal thunderbolt (to do) good toMitra,Varuṇa, and the donor (of theoblation). when fierce he cutVṛtrato pieces by his strength-- (Vṛtra who) obstructed the waters, and was encompassed bydarkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॒स्यात्र॒ तवि॑षीभ्यो विर॒प्शिन॑ ऋघाय॒तो अ॑रंहयन्त म॒न्यवे॑ । वृ॒त्रं यदु॒ग्रो व्यवृ॑श्च॒दोज॑सा॒पो बिभ्र॑तं॒ तम॑सा॒ परी॑वृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: índrasya ǀ átra ǀ táviṣībhyaḥ ǀ vi-rapśínaḥ ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ araṃhayanta ǀ manyáve ǀvṛtrám ǀ yát ǀ ugráḥ ǀ ví ǀ ávṛścat ǀ ójasā ǀ apáḥ ǀ bíbhratam ǀ támasā ǀ pári-vṛtam ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: या वी॒र्या॑णि प्रथ॒मानि॒ कर्त्वा॑ महि॒त्वेभि॒र्यत॑मानौ समी॒यतु॑: । ध्वा॒न्तं तमोऽव॑ दध्वसे ह॒त इन्द्रो॑ म॒ह्ना पू॒र्वहू॑तावपत्यत
shlokas.transliteration: yā́ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ prathamā́ni ǀ kártvā ǀ mahi-tvébhiḥ ǀ yátamānau ǀ sam-īyátuḥ ǀdhvāntám ǀ támaḥ ǀ áva ǀ dadhvase ǀ haté ǀ índraḥ ǀ mahnā́ ǀ pūrvá-hūtau ǀ apatyata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(In the midst of) the first exploits to be performed by them which (IndraandVṛtra) achieved strivingwith their utmost might, Vṛtra being slain, the thick darkness was destroyed, and Indra in his might came at thefirst challenge.”

shlokas.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वासो॒ अध॒ वृष्ण्या॑नि॒ तेऽव॑र्धय॒न्त्सोम॑वत्या वच॒स्यया॑ । र॒द्धं वृ॒त्रमहि॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ हन्म॑ना॒ग्निर्न जम्भै॑स्तृ॒ष्वन्न॑मावयत्
shlokas.transliteration: víśve ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ádha ǀ vṛ́ṣṇyāni ǀ te ǀ ávardhayan ǀ sóma-vatyā ǀ vacasyáyā ǀraddhám ǀ vṛtrám ǀ áhim ǀ índrasya ǀ hánmanā ǀ agníḥ ǀ ná ǀ jámbhaiḥ ǀ tṛṣú ǀ ánnam ǀ āvayat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Then all the gods magnified your exploits with praise, accompanied with libations ofSoma; (andpeople) quickly devouredVṛtra, the obstructer of water, wounded byIndra's slaughtering (weapon), as Agnidevours food with his teeth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूरि॒ दक्षे॑भिर्वच॒नेभि॒ॠक्व॑भिः स॒ख्येभि॑: स॒ख्यानि॒ प्र वो॑चत । इन्द्रो॒ धुनिं॑ च॒ चुमु॑रिं च द॒म्भय॑ञ्छ्रद्धामन॒स्या शृ॑णुते द॒भीत॑ये
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́ri ǀ dákṣebhiḥ ǀ vacanébhiḥ ǀ ṛ́kva-bhiḥ ǀ sakhyébhiḥ ǀ sakhyā́ni ǀ prá ǀ vocata ǀíndraḥ ǀ dhúnim ǀ ca ǀ cúmurim ǀ ca ǀ dambháyan ǀ śraddhā-manasyā́ ǀ śṛṇute ǀ dabhī́taye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Celebrate the numerous benevolent (acts ofIndra) with clever affectionate praises, together with texts;for adoration.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं पु॒रूण्या भ॑रा॒ स्वश्व्या॒ येभि॒र्मंसै॑ नि॒वच॑नानि॒ शंस॑न् । सु॒गेभि॒र्विश्वा॑ दुरि॒ता त॑रेम वि॒दो षु ण॑ उर्वि॒या गा॒धम॒द्य
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ purū́ṇi ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ su-áśvyā ǀ yébhiḥ ǀ máṃsai ǀ ni-vácanāni ǀ śáṃsan ǀsu-gébhiḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ tarema ǀ vidó íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ gādhám ǀ adyá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Indra, grant me ample riches and excellent horses with which I may honour (the gods)proffering praises; with well-acquired (riches) let us cross over all iniquity, accept our praise today with the mighṭto cross over with ease].”

shlokas.sanskrit: घ॒र्मा सम॑न्ता त्रि॒वृतं॒ व्या॑पतु॒स्तयो॒र्जुष्टिं॑ मात॒रिश्वा॑ जगाम । दि॒वस्पयो॒ दिधि॑षाणा अवेषन्वि॒दुर्दे॒वाः स॒हसा॑मानम॒र्कम्
shlokas.transliteration: gharmā́ ǀ sám-antā ǀ tri-vṛ́tam ǀ ví ǀ āpatuḥ ǀ táyoḥ ǀ júṣṭim ǀ mātaríśvā ǀ jagāma ǀdiváḥ ǀ páyaḥ ǀ dídhiṣāṇāḥ ǀ aveṣan ǀ vidúḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ sahá-sāmānam ǀ arkám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The two sources of heat (AgniandĀditya) spreading to the limit (of the horizon), have pervaded thethreefold (universe);Mātariśvanhas come to give them plural asure; (when) the shining (rays) reached theadorable (sun), having the brilliancy of theSāman, sustaining (the universe), they attained the water of heaven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒स्रो दे॒ष्ट्राय॒ निॠ॑ती॒रुपा॑सते दीर्घ॒श्रुतो॒ वि हि जा॒नन्ति॒ वह्न॑यः । तासां॒ नि चि॑क्युः क॒वयो॑ नि॒दानं॒ परे॑षु॒ या गुह्ये॑षु व्र॒तेषु॑
shlokas.transliteration: tisráḥ ǀ deṣṭrā́ya ǀ níḥ-ṛtīḥ ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀ dīrgha-śrútaḥ ǀ ví ǀ hí ǀ jānánti ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀtā́sām ǀ ní ǀ cikyuḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ ni-dā́nam ǀ páreṣu ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ gúhyeṣu ǀ vratéṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The threeNirṛtisdo obeisance for the gist (of oblations), for (the gods), the far-famed sustainers (ofthe universe), know (their obeisance); the wise have ascertained the primary cause of these (divinities) who(exist) in the conspicuous (or) in the hidden observances.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चतु॑ष्कपर्दा युव॒तिः सु॒पेशा॑ घृ॒तप्र॑तीका व॒युना॑नि वस्ते । तस्यां॑ सुप॒र्णा वृष॑णा॒ नि षे॑दतु॒र्यत्र॑ दे॒वा द॑धि॒रे भा॑ग॒धेय॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: cátuḥ-kapardā ǀ yuvatíḥ ǀ su-péśāḥ ǀ ghṛtá-pratīkā ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vaste ǀtásyām ǀ su-parṇā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ ní ǀ sedatuḥ ǀ yátra ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ bhāga-dhéyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The quadrangular (altar) youthful, handsomely decorated, bright with oblation, clothes herself in piousrites; the two birds, the showerers of oblations, have sat down thereon where the gods receive their share.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑: सुप॒र्णः स स॑मु॒द्रमा वि॑वेश॒ स इ॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं॒ वि च॑ष्टे । तं पाके॑न॒ मन॑सापश्य॒मन्ति॑त॒स्तं मा॒ता रे॑ळ्हि॒ स उ॑ रेळ्हि मा॒तर॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ékaḥ ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀ sáḥ ǀ idám ǀ víśvam ǀ bhúvanam ǀ ví ǀ caṣṭe ǀtám ǀ pā́kena ǀ mánasā ǀ apaśyam ǀ ántitaḥ ǀ tám ǀ mātā́ ǀ reḷhi ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ reḷhi ǀ mātáram ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of the birds has entered the firmament; he contemplates this whole world; with mind mature Ibeheld him night athand; him the mother licks, he licks themother.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒प॒र्णं विप्रा॑: क॒वयो॒ वचो॑भि॒रेकं॒ सन्तं॑ बहु॒धा क॑ल्पयन्ति । छन्दां॑सि च॒ दध॑तो अध्व॒रेषु॒ ग्रहा॒न्त्सोम॑स्य मिमते॒ द्वाद॑श
shlokas.transliteration: su-parṇám ǀ víprā ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ékam ǀ sántam ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ kalpayanti ǀchándāṃsi ǀ ca ǀ dádhataḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǀ gráhān ǀ sómasya ǀ mimate ǀ dvā́daśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The wise seers through their praise make into many forms the bird which is (only) one; and holding the(seven) metres at the sacrifices, they measure twelve bowls ofSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ष॒ट्त्रिं॒शाँश्च॑ च॒तुर॑: क॒ल्पय॑न्त॒श्छन्दां॑सि च॒ दध॑त आद्वाद॒शम् । य॒ज्ञं वि॒माय॑ क॒वयो॑ मनी॒ष ऋ॑क्सा॒माभ्यां॒ प्र रथं॑ वर्तयन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ṣaṭ-triṃśā́n ǀ ca ǀ catúraḥ ǀ kalpáyantaḥ ǀ chándāṃsi ǀ ca ǀ dádhataḥ ǀ ā-dvādaśám ǀyajñám ǀ vi-mā́ya ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǀ ṛk-sāmā́bhyām ǀ prá ǀ rátham ǀ vartayanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Filling thirty-six and four vessels, and holding the metres as far as twelve, measuring out the rite bytheir intelligence, the sages complete the sacrifice with the ṛk and thesāman.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चतु॑र्दशा॒न्ये म॑हि॒मानो॑ अस्य॒ तं धीरा॑ वा॒चा प्र ण॑यन्ति स॒प्त । आप्ना॑नं ती॒र्थं क इ॒ह प्र वो॑च॒द्येन॑ प॒था प्र॒पिब॑न्ते सु॒तस्य॑
shlokas.transliteration: cátuḥ-daśa ǀ anyé ǀ mahimā́naḥ ǀ asya ǀ tám ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ vācā́ ǀ prá ǀ nayanti ǀ saptá ǀā́pnānam ǀ tīrthám ǀ káḥ ǀ ihá ǀ prá ǀ vocat ǀ yéna ǀ pathā́ ǀ pra-píbante ǀ sutásya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There are fourteen other great developments of him, seven sages conduct him by prayer; who maydeclare the expanded plural ce of sanctity at this (rite), the path by which they drink of the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒ह॒स्र॒धा प॑ञ्चद॒शान्यु॒क्था याव॒द्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ताव॒दित्तत् । स॒ह॒स्र॒धा म॑हि॒मान॑: स॒हस्रं॒ याव॒द्ब्रह्म॒ विष्ठि॑तं॒ ताव॑ती॒ वाक्
shlokas.transliteration: sahasradhā́ ǀ pañca-daśā́ni ǀ ukthā́ ǀ yā́vat ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ tā́vat ǀ ít ǀ tát ǀsahasradhā́ ǀ mahimā́naḥ ǀ sahásram ǀ yā́vat ǀ bráhma ǀ ví-sthitam ǀ tā́vatī ǀ vā́k ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The fifteen chief forms (are found) in a thousand plural ces; as heaven and earth are, so verily in that; thethousand great (functions) are in a thousand plural ces; asBrahmāis variably developed, so is Speech.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कश्छन्द॑सां॒ योग॒मा वे॑द॒ धीर॒: को धिष्ण्यां॒ प्रति॒ वाचं॑ पपाद । कमृ॒त्विजा॑मष्ट॒मं शूर॑माहु॒र्हरी॒ इन्द्र॑स्य॒ नि चि॑काय॒ कः स्वि॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ chándasām ǀ yógam ǀ ā́ ǀ veda ǀ dhī́raḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ dhíṣṇyām ǀ práti ǀ vā́cam ǀ papāda ǀkám ǀ ṛtvíjām ǀ aṣṭamám ǀ śū́ram ǀ āhuḥ ǀ hárī íti ǀ índrasya ǀ ní ǀ cikāya ǀ káḥ ǀ svit ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What grave person n knows the application of the metres? Who utters the words appropriate to thefunctions (of the) different priests? Whom do they call the eighth of the priests, the independent? Who has donehonour to the two bay horses ofIndra?”

shlokas.sanskrit: भूम्या॒ अन्तं॒ पर्येके॑ चरन्ति॒ रथ॑स्य धू॒र्षु यु॒क्तासो॑ अस्थुः । श्रम॑स्य दा॒यं वि भ॑जन्त्येभ्यो य॒दा य॒मो भव॑ति ह॒र्म्ये हि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: bhū́myāḥ ǀ ántam ǀ pári ǀ éke ǀ caranti ǀ ráthasya ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ yuktā́saḥ ǀ asthuḥ ǀśrámasya ǀ dāyám ǀ ví ǀ bhajanti ǀ ebhyaḥ ǀ yadā́ ǀ yamáḥ ǀ bhávati ǀ harmyé ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Some (horses) proceed to the limit of the earth; they stand still harnessed to the yoke of the chariot;(the gods) apportion among them the alleviation of fatigue, when the charioteer is plural ced (ready to drive them) totheir dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒त्र इच्छिशो॒स्तरु॑णस्य व॒क्षथो॒ न यो मा॒तरा॑व॒प्येति॒ धात॑वे । अ॒नू॒धा यदि॒ जीज॑न॒दधा॑ च॒ नु व॒वक्ष॑ स॒द्यो महि॑ दू॒त्यं१॒॑ चर॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: citráḥ ǀ ít ǀ śíśoḥ ǀ táruṇasya ǀ vakṣáthaḥ ǀ ná ǀ yáḥ ǀ mātárau ǀ api-éti ǀ dhā́tave ǀanūdhā́ḥ ǀ yádi ǀ jī́janat ǀ ádha ǀ ca ǀ nú ǀ vavákṣa ǀ sadyáḥ ǀ máhi ǀ dūtyám ǀ cáran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wonderful is the conveyance of (the oblation by) the tender infant, who does not come to his parentsto drink, although the udderless (world) gave him birth; he immediately bears (the oblation to the gods) fulfillingthe important office of their messenger.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्ह॒ नाम॑ धायि॒ दन्न॒पस्त॑म॒: सं यो वना॑ यु॒वते॒ भस्म॑ना द॒ता । अ॒भि॒प्र॒मुरा॑ जु॒ह्वा॑ स्वध्व॒र इ॒नो न प्रोथ॑मानो॒ यव॑से॒ वृषा॑
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ ha ǀ nā́ma ǀ dhāyi ǀ dán ǀ apáḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sám ǀ yáḥ ǀ vánā ǀ yuváte ǀ bhásmanā ǀ datā́ ǀabhi-pramúrā ǀ juhvā́ ǀ su-adhvaráḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ ná ǀ próthamānaḥ ǀ yávase ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The most activeAgni, the giver of wealth, is nourished with ghī (by the worshippers), he who withflaming tooth devours the forests; devoutly worshipped with the uplifted goblet (he is, nourished) like a lordlywell-fed bull amidst (fresh) pasture.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं वो॒ विं न द्रु॒षदं॑ दे॒वमन्ध॑स॒ इन्दुं॒ प्रोथ॑न्तं प्र॒वप॑न्तमर्ण॒वम् । आ॒सा वह्निं॒ न शो॒चिषा॑ विर॒प्शिनं॒ महि॑व्रतं॒ न स॒रज॑न्त॒मध्व॑नः
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ vím ǀ ná ǀ dru-sádam ǀ devám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ índum ǀ próthantam ǀ pra-vápantam ǀ arṇavám ǀāsā́ ǀ váhnim ǀ ná ǀ śocíṣā ǀ vi-rapśínam ǀ máhi-vratam ǀ ná ǀ sarájantam ǀ ádhvanaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Glorify) him, (worshippers), the divine, like a bird seated upon a tree, demanding sacrificial food,clamorous, wood-consuming, water-shedding, like one bearing (the oblation) in his mouth, mighty with radiance,simultaneously illuminating the paths, like the great functionary (the sun).”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि यस्य॑ ते ज्रयसा॒नस्या॑जर॒ धक्षो॒र्न वाता॒: परि॒ सन्त्यच्यु॑ताः । आ र॒ण्वासो॒ युयु॑धयो॒ न स॑त्व॒नं त्रि॒तं न॑शन्त॒ प्र शि॒षन्त॑ इ॒ष्टये॑
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ yásya ǀ te ǀ jrayasānásya ǀ ajara ǀ dhákṣoḥ ǀ ná ǀ vā́tāḥ ǀ pári ǀ sánti ǀ ácyutāḥ ǀā́ ǀ raṇvā́saḥ ǀ yúyudhayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ satvanám ǀ tritám ǀ naśanta ǀ prá ǀ śiṣántaḥ ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O imperishableAgni, the invincible winds spread around you (who are) rapid in movement, anddesirous of consuming (the forest), like combatants( the priests) calling aloud, anxious to bestow (the oblation),glorify you, the mighty, stationed in the three (altars).”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इद॒ग्निः कण्व॑तम॒: कण्व॑सखा॒र्यः पर॒स्यान्त॑रस्य॒ तरु॑षः । अ॒ग्निः पा॑तु गृण॒तो अ॒ग्निः सू॒रीन॒ग्निर्द॑दातु॒ तेषा॒मवो॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ káṇva-tamaḥ ǀ káṇva-sakhā ǀ aryáḥ ǀ párasya ǀ ántarasya ǀ táruṣaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ pātu ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ sūrī́n ǀ agníḥ ǀ dadātu ǀ téṣām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, the most earnest of eulogists, the friend of those who praise the lord, the destroyer of enemies,whether far off or near, may Agni protect those who adore him, may Agni (protect) those who offer oblation, mayAgni give to us who are both these protection.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒जिन्त॑माय॒ सह्य॑से सुपित्र्य तृ॒षु च्यवा॑नो॒ अनु॑ जा॒तवे॑दसे । अ॒नु॒द्रे चि॒द्यो धृ॑ष॒ता वरं॑ स॒ते म॒हिन्त॑माय॒ धन्व॒नेद॑विष्य॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: vājín-tamāya ǀ sáhyase ǀ su-pitrya ǀ tṛṣú ǀ cyávānaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ jātá-vedase ǀanudré ǀ cit ǀ yáḥ ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ váram ǀ saté ǀ mahín-tamāya ǀ dhánvanā ǀ ít ǀ aviṣyaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “OAgni, who has fair ancestors, (I have) arrived quickly to (praise) you, the most bountiful bestower offood, the overcomer (of foes), theJātavedas, (I who offer) the best to you, the most mighty being, the protectorin calamity, with your capable (bow).”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वाग्निर्मर्तै॑: स॒ह सू॒रिभि॒र्वसु॑: ष्टवे॒ सह॑सः सू॒नरो॒ नृभि॑: । मि॒त्रासो॒ न ये सुधि॑ता ऋता॒यवो॒ द्यावो॒ न द्यु॒म्नैर॒भि सन्ति॒ मानु॑षान्
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ agníḥ ǀ mártaiḥ ǀ sahá ǀ sūrí-bhiḥ ǀ vásuḥ ǀ stave ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūnáraḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀmitrā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ yé ǀ sú-dhitāḥ ǀ ṛta-yávaḥ ǀ dyā́vaḥ ǀ ná ǀ dyumnáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ sánti ǀ mā́nuṣān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In this manner,Agni, the son of strength, is glorified by (us his) worshippers, together with piousmortals, for the sake of wealth-- (his worshippers) who, like delighted friends, desiring the sacrifice, like shining(ones), overcome (hostile) men through his might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊर्जो॑ नपात्सहसाव॒न्निति॑ त्वोपस्तु॒तस्य॑ वन्दते॒ वृषा॒ वाक् । त्वां स्तो॑षाम॒ त्वया॑ सु॒वीरा॒ द्राघी॑य॒ आयु॑: प्रत॒रं दधा॑नाः
shlokas.transliteration: ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ sahasā-van ǀ íti ǀ tvā ǀ upa-stutásya ǀ vandate ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ vā́k ǀtvā́m ǀ stoṣāma ǀ tváyā ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǀ drā́ghīyaḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ pra-tarám ǀ dádhānāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “"Offspring of food! vigorous (Agni)", thus the praise of Upastuta, showering forth oblations, glorifiesyou. "Let us praise you; through you let us obtain excellentmaleprogeny, enjoying long protracted life". them and the pious, worshippers. With uplifted faces, calling outvaṣaṭ! vaṣaṭ! they reached you; with upliftedfaces they reached you, calling outnamas! namas!”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॑ त्वाग्ने वृष्टि॒हव्य॑स्य पु॒त्रा उ॑पस्तु॒तास॒ ऋष॑योऽवोचन् । ताँश्च॑ पा॒हि गृ॑ण॒तश्च॑ सू॒रीन्वष॒ड्वष॒ळित्यू॒र्ध्वासो॑ अनक्ष॒न्नमो॒ नम॒ इत्यू॒र्ध्वासो॑ अनक्षन्
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ tvā ǀ agne ǀ vṛṣṭi-hávyasya ǀ putrā́ḥ ǀ upa-stutā́saḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ avocan ǀtā́n ǀ ca ǀ pāhí ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ ca ǀ sūrī́n ǀ váṣaṭ ǀ váṣaṭ ǀ íti ǀ ūrdhvā́saḥ ǀ anakṣan ǀ námaḥ ǀ námaḥ ǀ íti ǀ ūrdhvā́saḥ ǀ anakṣan ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: पिबा॒ सोमं॑ मह॒त इ॑न्द्रि॒याय॒ पिबा॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ हन्त॑वे शविष्ठ । पिब॑ रा॒ये शव॑से हू॒यमा॑न॒: पिब॒ मध्व॑स्तृ॒पदि॒न्द्रा वृ॑षस्व
shlokas.transliteration: píba ǀ sómam ǀ mahaté ǀ indriyā́ya ǀ píba ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ hántave ǀ śaviṣṭha ǀpíba ǀ rāyé ǀ śávase ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǀ píba ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ tṛpát ǀ indra ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink (Indra) theSomafor the invigoration of your organs, drink, most mighhty one, for the death ofVṛtra; drink when invoked for wealth, for strength; drink of the exhilarating Soma, and being satisfied, Indra,shower down (blessings).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्य पि॑ब क्षु॒मत॒: प्रस्थि॑त॒स्येन्द्र॒ सोम॑स्य॒ वर॒मा सु॒तस्य॑ । स्व॒स्ति॒दा मन॑सा मादयस्वार्वाची॒नो रे॒वते॒ सौभ॑गाय
shlokas.transliteration: asyá ǀ piba ǀ kṣu-mátaḥ ǀ prá-sthitasya ǀ índra ǀ sómasya ǀ váram ǀ ā́ ǀ sutásya ǀsvasti-dā́ḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ mādayasva ǀ arvācīnáḥ ǀ reváte ǀ sáubhagāya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Drink,Indra, your excellent portion of this renownedSomaeffused and poured forth; the giver ofprosperity, be delighted in your mind, (be) turned towards us to bestow riches and happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: म॒मत्तु॑ त्वा दि॒व्यः सोम॑ इन्द्र म॒मत्तु॒ यः सू॒यते॒ पार्थि॑वेषु । म॒मत्तु॒ येन॒ वरि॑वश्च॒कर्थ॑ म॒मत्तु॒ येन॑ निरि॒णासि॒ शत्रू॑न्
shlokas.transliteration: mamáttu ǀ tvā ǀ divyáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ indra ǀ mamáttu ǀ yáḥ ǀ sūyáte ǀ pā́rthiveṣu ǀmamáttu ǀ yéna ǀ várivaḥ ǀ cakártha ǀ mamáttu ǀ yéna ǀ ni-riṇā́si ǀ śátrūn ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the celestialSomaexhilarate you,Indra; may that which is effused at terrestrial rites exhilarateyou; may that exhilarate you through the influence of which you have bestowed wealth; may that exhilarate youwhereby you scatter foes.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ द्वि॒बर्हा॑ अमि॒नो या॒त्विन्द्रो॒ वृषा॒ हरि॑भ्यां॒ परि॑षिक्त॒मन्ध॑: । गव्या सु॒तस्य॒ प्रभृ॑तस्य॒ मध्व॑: स॒त्रा खेदा॑मरुश॒हा वृ॑षस्व
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ dvi-bárhāḥ ǀ amináḥ ǀ yātu ǀ índraḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ hári-bhyām ǀ pári-siktam ǀ ándhaḥ ǀgávi ǀ ā́ ǀ sutásya ǀ prá-bhṛtasya ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ satrā́ ǀ khédām ǀ aruśa-hā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, who deserves the twofold adoration, (of praise and prayer), who goes everywhere, theshowerer of benefits, come to the offered sacrificial food with his two bay horses; O slayer of enemies,(exhilarated) at our sacrifice (by drinking) of theSomaeffused upon the cow-hide and poured (into the cups),rush like a bull upon the dispirited (foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ति॒ग्मानि॑ भ्रा॒शय॒न्भ्राश्या॒न्यव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि यातु॒जूना॑म् । उ॒ग्राय॑ ते॒ सहो॒ बलं॑ ददामि प्र॒तीत्या॒ शत्रू॑न्विग॒देषु॑ वृश्च
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tigmā́ni ǀ bhrāśáyan ǀ bhrā́śyāni ǀ áva ǀ sthirā́ ǀ tanuhi ǀ yātu-jū́nām ǀugrā́ya ǀ te ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ bálam ǀ dadāmi ǀ prati-ítya ǀ śátrūn ǀ vi-gadéṣu ǀ vṛśca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Brandishing your sharp, shining weapons, pierce the solid bodies of the evil spirits. I give to you whoare fierce, foe-subduing strength; having assailed the enemies, cut them to pieces in the midst of their clamour.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व्य१॒॑र्य इ॑न्द्र तनुहि॒ श्रवां॒स्योज॑: स्थि॒रेव॒ धन्व॑नो॒ऽभिमा॑तीः । अ॒स्म॒द्र्य॑ग्वावृधा॒नः सहो॑भि॒रनि॑भृष्टस्त॒न्वं॑ वावृधस्व
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ aryáḥ ǀ indra ǀ tanuhi ǀ śrávāṃsi ǀ ójaḥ ǀ sthirā́-iva ǀ dhánvanaḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀasmadryák ǀ vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ sáhaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ áni-bhṛṣṭaḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ vavṛdhasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stretch out for us, lordIndra, varied food, (stretch out) your strength like strong bows against ourenemies; mighty in our presence by your vigour and irresistible still augment your form.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं ह॒विर्म॑घव॒न्तुभ्यं॑ रा॒तं प्रति॑ सम्रा॒ळहृ॑णानो गृभाय । तुभ्यं॑ सु॒तो म॑घव॒न्तुभ्यं॑ प॒क्वो॒३॒॑ऽद्धी॑न्द्र॒ पिब॑ च॒ प्रस्थि॑तस्य
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ havíḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ rātám ǀ práti ǀ sam-rāṭ ǀ áhṛṇānaḥ ǀ gṛbhāya ǀtúbhyam ǀ sutáḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ túbhyam ǀ pakváḥ ǀ addhí ǀ indra ǀ píba ǀ ca ǀ prá-sthitasya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ImperialMaghavan, to you this oblation is offered; accept it, not displeased; for you, Maghavan, thelibation is effused, for you (the cake is) toasted; eat it,Indra, and drink the libation poured (upon the altar).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒द्धीदि॑न्द्र॒ प्रस्थि॑ते॒मा ह॒वींषि॒ चनो॑ दधिष्व पच॒तोत सोम॑म् । प्रय॑स्वन्त॒: प्रति॑ हर्यामसि त्वा स॒त्याः स॑न्तु॒ यज॑मानस्य॒ कामा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: addhí ǀ ít ǀ indra ǀ prá-sthitā ǀ imā́ ǀ havī́ṃṣi ǀ cánaḥ ǀ dadhiṣva ǀ pacatā́ ǀ utá ǀ sómam ǀpráyasvantaḥ ǀ práti ǀ haryāmasi ǀ tvā ǀ satyā́ḥ ǀ santu ǀ yájamānasya ǀ kā́māḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Eat,Indra, these oblations plural ced (upon the altar); accept the food, the toasted (cakes), and theSoma. Provided with sacrificial viands we delight you; let the desires of the instrumental tutor of the rite be fulfilled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रेन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ सुवच॒स्यामि॑यर्मि॒ सिन्धा॑विव॒ प्रेर॑यं॒ नाव॑म॒र्कैः । अया॑ इव॒ परि॑ चरन्ति दे॒वा ये अ॒स्मभ्यं॑ धन॒दा उ॒द्भिद॑श्च
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ indrāgní-bhyām ǀ su-vacasyā́m ǀ iyarmi ǀ síndhau-iva ǀ prá ǀ īrayam ǀ nā́vam ǀ arkáiḥ ǀáyāḥ-iva ǀ pári ǀ caranti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yé ǀ asmábhyam ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ ut-bhídaḥ ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I direct my eulogy ofIndraandAgni; with sacred prayers I directed (my praise) like a vessel (launched)upon the ocean; like holy priests, the gods themselves reverence us, being the donors (to us) of wealth and theextirpators (of our foes).”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वा उ॑ दे॒वाः क्षुध॒मिद्व॒धं द॑दुरु॒ताशि॑त॒मुप॑ गच्छन्ति मृ॒त्यव॑: । उ॒तो र॒यिः पृ॑ण॒तो नोप॑ दस्यत्यु॒तापृ॑णन्मर्डि॒तारं॒ न वि॑न्दते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ kṣúdham ǀ ít ǀ vadhám ǀ daduḥ ǀ utá ǀ ā́śitam ǀ úpa ǀ gacchanti ǀ mṛtyávaḥ ǀutó íti ǀ rayíḥ ǀ pṛṇatáḥ ǀ ná ǀ úpa ǀ dasyati ǀ utá ǀ ápṛṇan ǀ marḍitā́ram ǀ ná ǀ vindate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The gods have not assigned hunger as (the cause of) death, for deaths approach the man who haseaten; the riches of one who gives do not diminish, he who gives not finds no consoler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॒ध्राय॑ चकमा॒नाय॑ पि॒त्वोऽन्न॑वा॒न्त्सन्र॑फि॒तायो॑पज॒ग्मुषे॑ । स्थि॒रं मन॑: कृणु॒ते सेव॑ते पु॒रोतो चि॒त्स म॑र्डि॒तारं॒ न वि॑न्दते
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ādhrā́ya ǀ cakamānā́ya ǀ pitváḥ ǀ ánna-vān ǀ sán ǀ raphitā́ya ǀ upa-jagmúṣe ǀsthirám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ sévate ǀ purā́ ǀ utó íti ǀ cit ǀ sáḥ ǀ marḍitā́ram ǀ ná ǀ vindate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who, possessed of food, hardens his heart against the feeble man craving nourishment, againstthe sufferer coming to him (for help), and pursues (his won enjoyment even) before him, that man finds noconsoler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इद्भो॒जो यो गृ॒हवे॒ ददा॒त्यन्न॑कामाय॒ चर॑ते कृ॒शाय॑ । अर॑मस्मै भवति॒ याम॑हूता उ॒ताप॒रीषु॑ कृणुते॒ सखा॑यम्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhojáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ gṛháve ǀ dádāti ǀ ánna-kāmāya ǀ cárate ǀ kṛśā́ya ǀáram ǀ asmai ǀ bhavati ǀ yā́ma-hūtau ǀ utá ǀ aparī́ṣu ǀ kṛṇute ǀ sákhāyam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is liberal who gives to the suppliant desiring food, wandering about distressed; to him there is anample (recompense), and he contracts friendship with his adversaries.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न स सखा॒ यो न ददा॑ति॒ सख्ये॑ सचा॒भुवे॒ सच॑मानाय पि॒त्वः । अपा॑स्मा॒त्प्रेया॒न्न तदोको॑ अस्ति पृ॒णन्त॑म॒न्यमर॑णं चिदिच्छेत्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ sáḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ yáḥ ǀ ná ǀ dádāti ǀ sákhye ǀ sacā-bhúve ǀ sácamānāya ǀ pitváḥ ǀápa ǀ asmāt ǀ prá ǀ iyāt ǀ ná ǀ tát ǀ ókaḥ ǀ asti ǀ pṛṇántam ǀ anyám ǀ áraṇam ǀ cit ǀ icchet ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He is not a friend who gives not food to a friend, to an associate, to a companion; let him turn awayfrom him, that is not a (fitting) dwelling; let him seek another more liberal lord.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पृ॒णी॒यादिन्नाध॑मानाय॒ तव्या॒न्द्राघी॑यांस॒मनु॑ पश्येत॒ पन्था॑म् । ओ हि वर्त॑न्ते॒ रथ्ये॑व च॒क्रान्यम॑न्य॒मुप॑ तिष्ठन्त॒ राय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: pṛṇīyā́t ǀ ít ǀ nā́dhamānāya ǀ távyān ǀ drā́ghīyāṃsam ǀ ánu ǀ paśyeta ǀ pánthām ǀó íti ǀ hí ǀ vártante ǀ ráthyā-iva ǀ cakrā́ ǀ anyám-anyam ǀ úpa ǀ tiṣṭhanta ǀ rā́yaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let the very rich man satisfy his suitor, let him look forward to a more protracted route, for richesrevolve from one man to another, as the wheels of a chariot turn round.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मोघ॒मन्नं॑ विन्दते॒ अप्र॑चेताः स॒त्यं ब्र॑वीमि व॒ध इत्स तस्य॑ । नार्य॒मणं॒ पुष्य॑ति॒ नो सखा॑यं॒ केव॑लाघो भवति केवला॒दी
shlokas.transliteration: mógham ǀ ánnam ǀ vindate ǀ ápra-cetāḥ ǀ satyám ǀ bravīmi ǀ vadháḥ ǀ ít ǀ sáḥ ǀ tásya ǀná ǀ aryamáṇam ǀ púṣyati ǀ nó íti ǀ sákhāyam ǀ kévala-aghaḥ ǀ bhavati ǀ kevala-ādī́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The inhospitable man acquires food in vain. I speak the truth-- it verily is his death. He cherishes notAryaman nor a friend; he who eats alone is nothing but a sinner.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कृ॒षन्नित्फाल॒ आशि॑तं कृणोति॒ यन्नध्वा॑न॒मप॑ वृङ्क्ते च॒रित्रै॑: । वद॑न्ब्र॒ह्माव॑दतो॒ वनी॑यान्पृ॒णन्ना॒पिरपृ॑णन्तम॒भि ष्या॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: kṛṣán ǀ ít ǀ phā́laḥ ǀ ā́śitam ǀ kṛṇoti ǀ yán ǀ ádhvānam ǀ ápa ǀ vṛṅkte ǀ carítraiḥ ǀvádan ǀ brahmā́ ǀ ávadataḥ ǀ vánīyān ǀ pṛṇán ǀ āpíḥ ǀ ápṛṇantam ǀ abhí ǀ syāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The plural ughshare furrowing (the field) provides food (for the plural ughman); a man travelling along a roadacquires (wealth for his master) by his movements; aBrāhmaṇaexpounding (theVeda) is better than one notexpounding it; (so) let the man who gives become a kinsman to the man who gives not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: एक॑पा॒द्भूयो॑ द्वि॒पदो॒ वि च॑क्रमे द्वि॒पात्त्रि॒पाद॑म॒भ्ये॑ति प॒श्चात् । चतु॑ष्पादेति द्वि॒पदा॑मभिस्व॒रे स॒म्पश्य॑न्प॒ङ्क्तीरु॑प॒तिष्ठ॑मानः
shlokas.transliteration: éka-pāt ǀ bhū́yaḥ ǀ dvi-pádaḥ ǀ ví ǀ cakrame ǀ dvi-pā́t ǀ tri-pā́dam ǀ abhí ǀ eti ǀ paścā́t ǀcátuḥ-pāt ǀ eti ǀ dvi-pádām ǀ abhi-svaré ǀ sam-páśyan ǀ paṅktī́ḥ ǀ upa-tíṣṭhamānaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who has but one foot takes a longer time on a journey than he who has two; he who has two feetcomes after him who has three; he who has four feet comes up overtaking the two-footed (and three-footed),beholding their traces as he passes by.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मौ चि॒द्धस्तौ॒ न स॒मं वि॑विष्टः सम्मा॒तरा॑ चि॒न्न स॒मं दु॑हाते । य॒मयो॑श्चि॒न्न स॒मा वी॒र्या॑णि ज्ञा॒ती चि॒त्सन्तौ॒ न स॒मं पृ॑णीतः
shlokas.transliteration: samáu ǀ cit ǀ hástau ǀ ná ǀ samám ǀ viviṣṭaḥ ǀ sam-mātárā ǀ cit ǀ ná ǀ samám ǀ duhāte íti ǀyamáyoḥ ǀ cit ǀ ná ǀ samā́ ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ jñātī́ íti ǀ cit ǀ sántau ǀ ná ǀ samám ǀ pṛṇītaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The twohandsare alike, but they do not perform the same work; two cows calving at the same timedo not yield the same milk; two twins have not the same strength; two person ns of the same family do not displayequal liberality.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ हंसि॒ न्य१॒॑त्रिणं॒ दीद्य॒न्मर्त्ये॒ष्वा । स्वे क्षये॑ शुचिव्रत
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ háṃsi ǀ ní ǀ atríṇam ǀ dī́dyat ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ ā́ ǀsvé ǀ kṣáye ǀ śuci-vrata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, observer of purity, you destroy the devouring (gloom), shining among men in your won dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ति॑ष्ठसि॒ स्वा॑हुतो घृ॒तानि॒ प्रति॑ मोदसे । यत्त्वा॒ स्रुच॑: स॒मस्थि॑रन्
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǀ sú-āhutaḥ ǀ ghṛtā́ni ǀ práti ǀ modase ǀyát ǀ tvā ǀ srúcaḥ ǀ sam-ásthiran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You spring up when piously invoked, you delight in the oblations when the ladles are brought nearyou.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स आहु॑तो॒ वि रो॑चते॒ऽग्निरी॒ळेन्यो॑ गि॒रा । स्रु॒चा प्रती॑कमज्यते
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rocate ǀ agníḥ ǀ īḷényaḥ ǀ girā́ ǀsrucā́ ǀ prátīkam ǀ ajyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who is to be glorified with the voice (of praise), blazes up when invoked, he is sprinkled with theladle before (the other gods).”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृ॒तेना॒ग्निः सम॑ज्यते॒ मधु॑प्रतीक॒ आहु॑तः । रोच॑मानो वि॒भाव॑सुः
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛténa ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajyate ǀ mádhu-pratīkaḥ ǀ ā́-hutaḥ ǀrócamānaḥ ǀ vibhā́-vasuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis anointed with butter, having a face of honey, invoked, radiant, irradiating all.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जर॑माण॒: समि॑ध्यसे दे॒वेभ्यो॑ हव्यवाहन । तं त्वा॑ हवन्त॒ मर्त्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: járamāṇaḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vāhana ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ havanta ǀ mártyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of oblations, glorified by the worshippers, you are kindled for the gods; as such do mortalsinvoke you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं म॑र्ता॒ अम॑र्त्यं घृ॒तेना॒ग्निं स॑पर्यत । अदा॑भ्यं गृ॒हप॑तिम्
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ martāḥ ǀ ámartyam ǀ ghṛténa ǀ agním ǀ saparyata ǀádābhyam ǀ gṛhá-patim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Mortals, worship with ghī the immortalAgni, the indestructible, the master of the mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदा॑भ्येन शो॒चिषाग्ने॒ रक्ष॒स्त्वं द॑ह । गो॒पा ऋ॒तस्य॑ दीदिहि
shlokas.transliteration: ádābhyena ǀ śocíṣā ǀ ágne ǀ rákṣaḥ ǀ tvám ǀ daha ǀgopā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dīdihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “With your indestructible flame,Agni, do you consume theRākṣasas; shine, the defender of thesacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स त्वम॑ग्ने॒ प्रती॑केन॒ प्रत्यो॑ष यातुधा॒न्य॑: । उ॒रु॒क्षये॑षु॒ दीद्य॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ prátīkena ǀ práti ǀ oṣa ǀ yātu-dhānyáḥ ǀuru-kṣáyeṣu ǀ dī́dyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Do you,Agni, with your brightness, consume the feminine le fiends, shining in your outspread dwelllingṣurukṣayaḥ = occupying many mansions, i.e. theyajamānas].”

shlokas.sanskrit: तं त्वा॑ गी॒र्भिरु॑रु॒क्षया॑ हव्य॒वाहं॒ समी॑धिरे । यजि॑ष्ठं॒ मानु॑षे॒ जने॑
shlokas.transliteration: tám ǀ tvā ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ uru-kṣáyāḥ ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀyájiṣṭham ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ jáne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The masters of many mansions have, by their praises, kindled you,Agni, the bearer of oblations, whoare most adorable among human beings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॒ वा इति॑ मे॒ मनो॒ गामश्वं॑ सनुया॒मिति॑ । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ vái ǀ íti ǀ me ǀ mánaḥ ǀ gā́m ǀ áśvam ǀ sanuyām ǀ íti ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus, indeed, thus my mind (resolved): " I will give cows and horses to my worshippers", for I haveoften drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र वाता॑ इव॒ दोध॑त॒ उन्मा॑ पी॒ता अ॑यंसत । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ vā́tāḥ-iva ǀ dódhataḥ ǀ út ǀ mā ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ ayaṃsata ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Like the winds violently shaking (the trees), the draughts (ofSoma) have lifted me up, for I have oftendrunk of the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उन्मा॑ पी॒ता अ॑यंसत॒ रथ॒मश्वा॑ इवा॒शव॑: । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ mā ǀ pītā́ḥ ǀ ayaṃsata ǀ rátham ǀ áśvāḥ-iva ǀ āśávaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The draughts (ofSoma) have lifted me up like swift horses (drawing) a chariot, for I have often drunkof the Soma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ मा म॒तिर॑स्थित वा॒श्रा पु॒त्रमि॑व प्रि॒यम् । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ mā ǀ matíḥ ǀ asthita ǀ vāśrā́ ǀ putrám-iva ǀ priyám ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Praise (of the pious) has come to me like a lowing cow to her beloved calf, for I have often drunkof theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं तष्टे॑व व॒न्धुरं॒ पर्य॑चामि हृ॒दा म॒तिम् । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ táṣṭā-iva ǀ vandhúram ǀ pári ǀ acāmi ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ matím ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I revolve the song of praise in my heart as a carpenter (making) a charioteer's seat, for I have oftendrunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि मे॑ अक्षि॒पच्च॒नाच्छा॑न्त्सु॒: पञ्च॑ कृ॒ष्टय॑: । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ me ǀ akṣi-pát ǀ caná ǀ ácchāntsuḥ ǀ páñca ǀ kṛṣṭáyaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The five castes have not eluded the gloance of my eye, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि मे॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे अ॒न्यं प॒क्षं च॒न प्रति॑ । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ me ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǀ anyám ǀ pakṣám ǀ caná ǀ práti ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both heaven and earth (are) not equal to one half of me, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒भि द्यां म॑हि॒ना भु॑वम॒भी॒३॒॑मां पृ॑थि॒वीं म॒हीम् । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: abhí ǀ dyā́m ǀ mahinā́ ǀ bhuvam ǀ abhí ǀ imā́m ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mahī́m ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I excel the sky in greatness, (I excel) this great earth, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हन्ता॒हं पृ॑थि॒वीमि॒मां नि द॑धानी॒ह वे॒ह वा॑ । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: hánta ǀ ahám ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ imā́m ǀ ní ǀ dadhāni ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Lo! I will plural ce this earth (where I will), either here or there, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओ॒षमित्पृ॑थि॒वीम॒हं ज॒ङ्घना॑नी॒ह वे॒ह वा॑ । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: oṣám ǀ ít ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ ahám ǀ jaṅghánāni ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀ ihá ǀ vā ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I will drive the scorching (sun) either here or there, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दि॒वि मे॑ अ॒न्यः प॒क्षो॒३॒॑ऽधो अ॒न्यम॑चीकृषम् । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: diví ǀ me ǀ anyáḥ ǀ pakṣáḥ ǀ adháḥ ǀ anyám ǀ acīkṛṣam ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “One of my wings is in the sky; the other I dragged below, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हम॑स्मि महाम॒हो॑ऽभिन॒भ्यमुदी॑षितः । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ asmi ǀ mahā-maháḥ ǀ abhi-nabhyám ǀ út-īṣitaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am (the sun), the greatest of the great, raised to the firmament, for I have often drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गृ॒हो या॒म्यरं॑कृतो दे॒वेभ्यो॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नः । कु॒वित्सोम॒स्यापा॒मिति॑
shlokas.transliteration: gṛháḥ ǀ yāmi ǀ áram-kṛtaḥ ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vā́hanaḥ ǀkuvít ǀ sómasya ǀ ápām ǀ íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Receiving the offering I go, graced (by the worshippers), bearing the oblation to the gods, for I haveoften drunk of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तदिदा॑स॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यतो॑ ज॒ज्ञ उ॒ग्रस्त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो नि रि॑णाति॒ शत्रू॒ननु॒ यं विश्वे॒ मद॒न्त्यूमा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ ít ǀ āsa ǀ bhúvaneṣu ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ yátaḥ ǀ jajñé ǀ ugráḥ ǀ tveṣá-nṛmṇaḥ ǀsadyáḥ ǀ jajñānáḥ ǀ ní ǀ riṇāti ǀ śátrūn ǀ ánu ǀ yám ǀ víśve ǀ mádanti ǀ ū́māḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “That was the chiefest in all worlds, from whence the fierce one, the rich in radiance, was born; assoon as born, he destroys the foes, he in whom all living beings delight.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒वृ॒धा॒नः शव॑सा॒ भूर्यो॑जा॒: शत्रु॑र्दा॒साय॑ भि॒यसं॑ दधाति । अव्य॑नच्च व्य॒नच्च॒ सस्नि॒ सं ते॑ नवन्त॒ प्रभृ॑ता॒ मदे॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: vavṛdhānáḥ ǀ śávasā ǀ bhū́ri-ojāḥ ǀ śátruḥ ǀ dāsā́ya ǀ bhiyásam ǀ dadhāti ǀávi-anat ǀ ca ǀ vi-anát ǀ ca ǀ sásni ǀ sám ǀ te ǀ navanta ǀ prá-bhṛtā ǀ mádeṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waxing in strength, the very powerful, destructive (Indra), implants fear in theDāsa; both theinanimate and the animate (world) is purified by him. Nourished in your exhilaration (all creatures) are assembled.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वे क्रतु॒मपि॑ वृञ्जन्ति॒ विश्वे॒ द्विर्यदे॒ते त्रिर्भव॒न्त्यूमा॑: । स्वा॒दोः स्वादी॑यः स्वा॒दुना॑ सृजा॒ सम॒दः सु मधु॒ मधु॑ना॒भि यो॑धीः
shlokas.transliteration: tvé íti ǀ krátum ǀ ápi ǀ vṛñjanti ǀ víśve ǀ dvíḥ ǀ yát ǀ eté ǀ tríḥ ǀ bhávanti ǀ ū́māḥ ǀsvādóḥ ǀ svā́dīyaḥ ǀ svādúnā ǀ sṛja ǀ sám ǀ adáḥ ǀ sú ǀ mádhu ǀ mádhunā ǀ abhí ǀ yodhīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you all (worshippers) offer adoration, whether those propitiators be two or three. Combine thatwhich is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness, unite that honey with honey.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इति॑ चि॒द्धि त्वा॒ धना॒ जय॑न्तं॒ मदे॑मदे अनु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्रा॑: । ओजी॑यो धृष्णो स्थि॒रमा त॑नुष्व॒ मा त्वा॑ दभन्यातु॒धाना॑ दु॒रेवा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: íti ǀ cit ǀ hí ǀ tvā ǀ dhánā ǀ jáyantam ǀ máde-made ǀ anu-mádanti ǀ víprāḥ ǀójīyaḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇo íti ǀ sthirám ǀ ā́ ǀ tanuṣva ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ dabhan ǀ yātu-dhā́nāḥ ǀ duḥ-évāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Verily the pious praise you, (Indra), the giver of wealth in your repeated exhilaration; spread out for usresolute Indra, great and durable (affluence); may the malignantyātudhānasnever harm you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वया॑ व॒यं शा॑शद्महे॒ रणे॑षु प्र॒पश्य॑न्तो यु॒धेन्या॑नि॒ भूरि॑ । चो॒दया॑मि त॒ आयु॑धा॒ वचो॑भि॒: सं ते॑ शिशामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वयां॑सि
shlokas.transliteration: tváyā ǀ vayám ǀ śāśadmahe ǀ ráṇeṣu ǀ pra-páśyantaḥ ǀ yudhényāni ǀ bhū́ri ǀcodáyāmi ǀ te ǀ ā́yudhā ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ sám ǀ te ǀ śiśāmi ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ váyāṃsi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through you we destroy (our foes) in battles, beholding the numerous (hosts) which we have to fight; Iurge your weapons with words (of praise), I prepare your viands with a sacred verse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्तु॒षेय्यं॑ पुरु॒वर्प॑स॒मृभ्व॑मि॒नत॑ममा॒प्त्यमा॒प्त्याना॑म् । आ द॑र्षते॒ शव॑सा स॒प्त दानू॒न्प्र सा॑क्षते प्रति॒माना॑नि॒ भूरि॑
shlokas.transliteration: stuṣéyyam ǀ puru-várpasam ǀ ṛ́bhvam ǀ iná-tamam ǀ āptyám ǀ āptyā́nām ǀā́ ǀ darṣate ǀ śávasā ǀ saptá ǀ dā́nūn ǀ prá ǀ sākṣate ǀ prati-mā́nāni ǀ bhū́ri ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise (Indra) who is worthy of praise, multiform vast, supreme, most accessible of the accessible; heassails with might the sevenDānavas, he overpowers many opposing hosts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि तद्द॑धि॒षेऽव॑रं॒ परं॑ च॒ यस्मि॒न्नावि॒थाव॑सा दुरो॒णे । आ मा॒तरा॑ स्थापयसे जिग॒त्नू अत॑ इनोषि॒ कर्व॑रा पु॒रूणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tát ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ ávaram ǀ páram ǀ ca ǀ yásmin ǀ ā́vitha ǀ ávasā ǀ duroṇé ǀā́ ǀ mātárā ǀ sthāpayase ǀ jigatnū́ íti ǀ átaḥ ǀ inoṣi ǀ kárvarā ǀ purū́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You deposit the lesser and the greater wealth in the mansion in which you are satisfied with food; youfix the two wandering mothers, you accomplish many works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ बृ॒हद्दि॑वो विव॒क्तीन्द्रा॑य शू॒षम॑ग्रि॒यः स्व॒र्षाः । म॒हो गो॒त्रस्य॑ क्षयति स्व॒राजो॒ दुर॑श्च॒ विश्वा॑ अवृणो॒दप॒ स्वाः
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ bṛhát-divaḥ ǀ vivakti ǀ índrāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ agriyáḥ ǀ svaḥ-sā́ḥ ǀmaháḥ ǀ gotrásya ǀ kṣayati ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ dúraḥ ǀ ca ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ avṛṇot ǀ ápa ǀ svā́ḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा म॒हान्बृ॒हद्दि॑वो॒ अथ॒र्वावो॑च॒त्स्वां त॒न्व१॒॑मिन्द्र॑मे॒व । स्वसा॑रो मात॒रिभ्व॑रीररि॒प्रा हि॒न्वन्ति॑ च॒ शव॑सा व॒र्धय॑न्ति च
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ mahā́n ǀ bṛhát-divaḥ ǀ átharvā ǀ ávocat ǀ svā́m ǀ tanvám ǀ índram ǀ evá ǀsvásāraḥ ǀ mātaríbhvarīḥ ǀ ariprā́ḥ ǀ hinvánti ǀ ca ǀ śávasā ǀ vardháyanti ǀ ca ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Thus the greatBṛhaddiva, son ofAtharvan, repeated his diffused (praise) toIndra. The unsulliedsiister (streams) abiding in the mother (earth), to Indra, and augment him with strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् । स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: hiraṇya-garbháḥ ǀ sám ǀ avartata ǀ ágre ǀ bhūtásya ǀ jātáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ āsīt ǀsáḥ ǀ dādhāra ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ utá ǀ imā́m ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hiraṇyagarbhawas present at the beginning; when born, he was the sole lord of created beings; heupheld this earth and heaven-- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: य आ॑त्म॒दा ब॑ल॒दा यस्य॒ विश्व॑ उ॒पास॑ते प्र॒शिषं॒ यस्य॑ दे॒वाः । यस्य॑ छा॒यामृतं॒ यस्य॑ मृ॒त्युः कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ ātma-dā́ḥ ǀ bala-dā́ḥ ǀ yásya ǀ víśve ǀ upa-ā́sate ǀ pra-śíṣam ǀ yásya ǀ devā́ḥ ǀyásya ǀ chāyā́ ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ yásya ǀ mṛtyúḥ ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(To him) who is the giver ofsoul, the giver of strength, whose commands all (beings), even the godsobey, whose shadow is immortality, whose (shadow) is death-- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यः प्रा॑ण॒तो नि॑मिष॒तो म॑हि॒त्वैक॒ इद्राजा॒ जग॑तो ब॒भूव॑ । य ईशे॑ अ॒स्य द्वि॒पद॒श्चतु॑ष्पद॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ prāṇatáḥ ǀ ni-miṣatáḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ít ǀ rā́jā ǀ jágataḥ ǀ babhū́va ǀyáḥ ǀ ī́śe ǀ asyá ǀ dvi-pádaḥ ǀ cátuḥ-padaḥ ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(To him) who, by his greatness, has verily become the sole king of the breathing and seeing world,who rules over this aggregate of two-footed and four- footed beings -- let us offer worship with an oblation to thedivine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्ये॒मे हि॒मव॑न्तो महि॒त्वा यस्य॑ समु॒द्रं र॒सया॑ स॒हाहुः । यस्ये॒माः प्र॒दिशो॒ यस्य॑ बा॒हू कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yásya ǀ imé ǀ himá-vantaḥ ǀ mahi-tvā́ ǀ yásya ǀ samudrám ǀ rasáyā ǀ sahá ǀ āhúḥ ǀyásya ǀ imā́ḥ ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ yásya ǀ bāhū́ íti ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Through whose greatness these snow-clad (mountains exist), whose property men call the ocean withthe rivers, whose are these quarters of space, who are the two arms -- let us offer worship with an oblation to thedivine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: येन॒ द्यौरु॒ग्रा पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ दृ॒ळ्हा येन॒ स्व॑ स्तभि॒तं येन॒ नाक॑: । यो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ रज॑सो वि॒मान॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yéna ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ugrā́ ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ ca ǀ dṛḷhā́ ǀ yéna ǀ sváríti sváḥ ǀ stabhitám ǀ yéna ǀ nā́kaḥ ǀyáḥ ǀ antárikṣe ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “By whom the sky was made profound and the earth solid, by whom heaven and the solar sphere werefixed, who was the measure of the water in the firmament -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं क्रन्द॑सी॒ अव॑सा तस्तभा॒ने अ॒भ्यैक्षे॑तां॒ मन॑सा॒ रेज॑माने । यत्राधि॒ सूर॒ उदि॑तो वि॒भाति॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ krándasī íti ǀ ávasā ǀ tastabhāné íti ǀ abhí ǀ áikṣetām ǀ mánasā ǀ réjamāne íti ǀyátra ǀ ádhi ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ út-itaḥ ǀ vi-bhā́ti ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom heaven and earth established by his protection, and shining brightly, regarded with their mind,in whom the risen sun shines forth -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आपो॑ ह॒ यद्बृ॑ह॒तीर्विश्व॒माय॒न्गर्भं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर॒ग्निम् । ततो॑ दे॒वानां॒ सम॑वर्त॒तासु॒रेक॒: कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ ha ǀ yát ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ā́yan ǀ gárbham ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ janáyantīḥ ǀ agním ǀtátaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ sám ǀ avartata ǀ ásuḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the vast waters overspread the universe containing the germ and giving birth toAgni, then wasproduced the one breath of the gods -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divine Ka.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यश्चि॒दापो॑ महि॒ना प॒र्यप॑श्य॒द्दक्षं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर्य॒ज्ञम् । यो दे॒वेष्वधि॑ दे॒व एक॒ आसी॒त्कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ cit ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ mahinā́ ǀ pari-ápaśyat ǀ dákṣam ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀ janáyantīḥ ǀ yajñám ǀyáḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ ádhi ǀ deváḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ā́sīt ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who by his might beheld the waters all around containing the creative power and giving birth tosacrifice, he who among the gods was the one supreme god -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मा नो॑ हिंसीज्जनि॒ता यः पृ॑थि॒व्या यो वा॒ दिवं॑ स॒त्यध॑र्मा ज॒जान॑ । यश्चा॒पश्च॒न्द्रा बृ॑ह॒तीर्ज॒जान॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम
shlokas.transliteration: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ hiṃsīt ǀ janitā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ vā ǀ dívam ǀ satyá-dharmā ǀ jajā́na ǀyáḥ ǀ ca ǀ apáḥ ǀ candrā́ḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ jajā́na ǀ kásmai ǀ devā́ya ǀ havíṣā ǀ vidhema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May he do us no harm who is the parent of the earth, or who the unerring support (of the world) begatthe heaven, and who genitive rated the vast and delightful waters -- let us offer worship with an oblation to the divineKa.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रजा॑पते॒ न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ जा॒तानि॒ परि॒ ता ब॑भूव । यत्का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्तु व॒यं स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम्
shlokas.transliteration: prájā-pate ǀ ná ǀ tvát ǀ etā́ni ǀ anyáḥ ǀ víśvā ǀ jātā́ni ǀ pári ǀ tā́ ǀ babhūva ǀyát-kāmāḥ ǀ te ǀ juhumáḥ ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ astu ǀ vayám ǀ syāma ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ rayīṇā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “No other than you,Prajāpati, has given existence to all these beings; may that object of our desiresfor which we sacrifice to you be ours, may we be the possessors of riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वसुं॒ न चि॒त्रम॑हसं गृणीषे वा॒मं शेव॒मति॑थिमद्विषे॒ण्यम् । स रा॑सते शु॒रुधो॑ वि॒श्वधा॑यसो॒ऽग्निर्होता॑ गृ॒हप॑तिः सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: vásum ǀ ná ǀ citrá-mahasam ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ vāmám ǀ śévam ǀ átithim ǀ adviṣeṇyám ǀsáḥ ǀ rāsate ǀ śurúdhaḥ ǀ viśvá-dhāyasaḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ gṛhá-patiḥ ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify him who is of wonderful radiance like the sun, the desirable, the giver of happiness, the guest(of man), the benevolent. He bestows vigour (upon the worshippers);Agni, the remover of sorrow, the sustaineerof all, the invoker (of the gods), the lord of the mansion.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जु॒षा॒णो अ॑ग्ने॒ प्रति॑ हर्य मे॒ वचो॒ विश्वा॑नि वि॒द्वान्व॒युना॑नि सुक्रतो । घृत॑निर्णि॒ग्ब्रह्म॑णे गा॒तुमेर॑य॒ तव॑ दे॒वा अ॑जनय॒न्ननु॑ व्र॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: juṣāṇáḥ ǀ agne ǀ práti ǀ harya ǀ me ǀ vácaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀ vayúnāni ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀghṛ́ta-nirnik ǀ bráhmaṇe ǀ gātúm ǀ ā́ ǀ īraya ǀ táva ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ajanayan ǀ ánu ǀ vratám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Accept,Agni, being well plural ased, my praises, author of great deeds, (you are) cognizant of all objectsof knowledge; anointed with butter, stimulate the movements of theBrāhmaṇa; the gods produce (rewards)after your worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒प्त धामा॑नि परि॒यन्नम॑र्त्यो॒ दाश॑द्दा॒शुषे॑ सु॒कृते॑ मामहस्व । सु॒वीरे॑ण र॒यिणा॑ग्ने स्वा॒भुवा॒ यस्त॒ आन॑ट् स॒मिधा॒ तं जु॑षस्व
shlokas.transliteration: saptá ǀ dhā́māni ǀ pari-yán ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ dā́śat ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ su-kṛ́te ǀ mamahasva ǀsu-vī́reṇa ǀ rayíṇā ǀ agne ǀ su-ābhúvā ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ ā́naṭ ǀ sam-ídhā ǀ tám ǀ juṣasva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Traversing the seven regions (of the universe), immortalAgni, bestow wealth, giving liberally to thepious liberal giver. Gratify with easily obtainable riches, together with fair offspring, him who feeds you with fueḷ”

shlokas.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रोहि॑तं ह॒विष्म॑न्त ईळते स॒प्त वा॒जिन॑म् । शृ॒ण्वन्त॑म॒ग्निं घृ॒तपृ॑ष्ठमु॒क्षणं॑ पृ॒णन्तं॑ दे॒वं पृ॑ण॒ते सु॒वीर्य॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: yajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ prathamám ǀ puráḥ-hitam ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ īḷate ǀ saptá ǀ vājínam ǀśṛṇvántam ǀ agním ǀ ghṛtá-pṛṣṭham ǀ ukṣáṇam ǀ pṛṇántam ǀ devám ǀ pṛṇaté ǀ su-vī́ryam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The seven (priests) bearing oblations worshipAgni, the emblem of sacrifice, the first of the gods, thefamily priest, the possessor of food, the hearer (of our prayers), the anointed with butter, the shedder of moisture,propitiating the worshipper who propitiates him, divine, endowed with excellent might.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं दू॒तः प्र॑थ॒मो वरे॑ण्य॒: स हू॒यमा॑नो अ॒मृता॑य मत्स्व । त्वां म॑र्जयन्म॒रुतो॑ दा॒शुषो॑ गृ॒हे त्वां स्तोमे॑भि॒र्भृग॑वो॒ वि रु॑रुचुः
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ váreṇyaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hūyámānaḥ ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ matsva ǀtvā́m ǀ marjayan ǀ marútaḥ ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ tvā́m ǀ stómebhiḥ ǀ bhṛ́gavaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rurucuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You are the chief and most excellent messenger; do you, invoked by us to partake of the ambrosia,become exhilarated; theMarutsdecorated you in the dwelling of the donor of the oblation; theBhṛgushaveglorified you with hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इषं॑ दु॒हन्त्सु॒दुघां॑ वि॒श्वधा॑यसं यज्ञ॒प्रिये॒ यज॑मानाय सुक्रतो । अग्ने॑ घृ॒तस्नु॒स्त्रिॠ॒तानि॒ दीद्य॑द्व॒र्तिर्य॒ज्ञं प॑रि॒यन्त्सु॑क्रतूयसे
shlokas.transliteration: íṣam ǀ duhán ǀ su-dúghām ǀ viśvá-dhāyasam ǀ yajña-príye ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀágre ǀ ghṛtá-snuḥ ǀ tríḥ ǀ ṛtā́ni ǀ dī́dyat ǀ vartíḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ pari-yán ǀ sukratu-yase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Milking the easily milked cow (of sacrifice) of her all-sustaining food, for the benefit of the piousinstitutor of the rite, OAgni, doer of good deeds, anointed with butter, illumining the three regions, presiding(over the hall of sacrifice), going round the sacrifice, you accomplish each holy rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामिद॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु दू॒तं कृ॑ण्वा॒ना अ॑यजन्त॒ मानु॑षाः । त्वां दे॒वा म॑ह॒याय्या॑य वावृधु॒राज्य॑मग्ने निमृ॒जन्तो॑ अध्व॒रे
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ít ǀ asyā́ḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀ dūtám ǀ kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ ayajanta ǀ mā́nuṣāḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ mahayā́yyāya ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀ ā́jyam ǀ agne ǀ ni-mṛjántaḥ ǀ adhvaré ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men worshipped you,Agni, at the opening of the present dawn, appointing you their messenger to thegods; the gods have magnified you for their adoration, sprinkling butter upon you at the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि त्वा॒ वसि॑ष्ठा अह्वन्त वा॒जिनं॑ गृ॒णन्तो॑ अग्ने वि॒दथे॑षु वे॒धस॑: । रा॒यस्पोषं॒ यज॑मानेषु धारय यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभि॒: सदा॑ नः
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ tvā ǀ vásiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ahvanta ǀ vājínam ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ agne ǀ vidátheṣu ǀ vedhásaḥ ǀrāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ yájamāneṣu ǀ dhāraya ǀ yūyám ǀ pāta ǀ svastí-bhiḥ ǀ sádā ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The piousVasiṣṭhainvoked you,Agni, at the sacrificial meetings, praising you, the mighty one;continue the sustenance of riches among the instrumental tutors of the rite, and do you (gods) ever cherish us withblessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं वे॒नश्चो॑दय॒त्पृश्नि॑गर्भा॒ ज्योति॑र्जरायू॒ रज॑सो वि॒माने॑ । इ॒मम॒पां सं॑ग॒मे सूर्य॑स्य॒ शिशुं॒ न विप्रा॑ म॒तिभी॑ रिहन्ति
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ venáḥ ǀ codayat ǀ pṛ́śni-garbhāḥ ǀ jyótiḥ-jarāyuḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́ne ǀimám ǀ apā́m ǀ sam-gamé ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ śíśum ǀ ná ǀ víprāḥ ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ rihanti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisVena, enfolded in the membrane of light, urges on (the waters) the germs of the Sun in thefirmament of the water; the sages cherish him at the confluence of the waters, and the sun with endearments likea child.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रादू॒र्मिमुदि॑यर्ति वे॒नो न॑भो॒जाः पृ॒ष्ठं ह॑र्य॒तस्य॑ दर्शि । ऋ॒तस्य॒ साना॒वधि॑ वि॒ष्टपि॒ भ्राट् स॑मा॒नं योनि॑म॒भ्य॑नूषत॒ व्राः
shlokas.transliteration: samudrā́t ǀ ūrmím ǀ út ǀ iyarti ǀ venáḥ ǀ nabhaḥ-jā́ḥ ǀ pṛṣṭhám ǀ haryatásya ǀ darśi ǀṛtásya ǀ sā́nau ǀ ádhi ǀ viṣṭápi ǀ bhrā́ṭ ǀ samānám ǀ yónim ǀ abhí ǀ anūṣata ǀ vrā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cloud-bornVenasend the water from the firmament; the back of the azure (sky) is beheld. Heshone on the summit of the water in heaven; the troops praised their common abode.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒मा॒नं पू॒र्वीर॒भि वा॑वशा॒नास्तिष्ठ॑न्व॒त्सस्य॑ मा॒तर॒: सनी॑ळाः । ऋ॒तस्य॒ साना॒वधि॑ चक्रमा॒णा रि॒हन्ति॒ मध्वो॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ वाणी॑:
shlokas.transliteration: samānám ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vāvaśānā́ḥ ǀ tíṣṭhan ǀ vatsásya ǀ mātáraḥ ǀ sá-nīḷāḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ sā́nau ǀ ádhi ǀ cakramāṇā́ḥ ǀ rihánti ǀ mádhvaḥ ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ vā́ṇīḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The many waters occupy a common station, clamouring around like the assembled mothers of the calf;wandering above the summit of the water they utter the praises of the sweet-flavoured ambrosia.”

shlokas.sanskrit: जा॒नन्तो॑ रू॒पम॑कृपन्त॒ विप्रा॑ मृ॒गस्य॒ घोषं॑ महि॒षस्य॒ हि ग्मन् । ऋ॒तेन॒ यन्तो॒ अधि॒ सिन्धु॑मस्थुर्वि॒दद्ग॑न्ध॒र्वो अ॒मृता॑नि॒ नाम॑
shlokas.transliteration: jānántaḥ ǀ rūpám ǀ akṛpanta ǀ víprāḥ ǀ mṛgásya ǀ ghóṣam ǀ mahiṣásya ǀ hí ǀ gmán ǀṛténa ǀ yántaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ síndhum ǀ asthuḥ ǀ vidát ǀ gandharváḥ ǀ amṛ́tāni ǀ nā́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The pious, knowing his form, praised him, for they followed the city of the great deer; approaching hmwith sacrifice, they reached the flowing (water), for the sustainer of the waters knows the ambrosial (fluids).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्स॒रा जा॒रमु॑पसिष्मिया॒णा योषा॑ बिभर्ति पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । चर॑त्प्रि॒यस्य॒ योनि॑षु प्रि॒यः सन्त्सीद॑त्प॒क्षे हि॑र॒ण्यये॒ स वे॒नः
shlokas.transliteration: apsarā́ḥ ǀ jārám ǀ upa-siṣmiyāṇā́ ǀ yóṣā ǀ bibharti ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀcárat ǀ priyásya ǀ yóniṣu ǀ priyáḥ ǀ sán ǀ sī́dat ǀ pakṣé ǀ hiraṇyáye ǀ sáḥ ǀ venáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheApsaras, smiling affectionately like a wife at her lover, cherishes him in the highest heaven; shewanders in the abodes of her beloved; he,Vena, being loved, sits, down on his golden wing.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नाके॑ सुप॒र्णमुप॒ यत्पत॑न्तं हृ॒दा वेन॑न्तो अ॒भ्यच॑क्षत त्वा । हिर॑ण्यपक्षं॒ वरु॑णस्य दू॒तं य॒मस्य॒ योनौ॑ शकु॒नं भु॑र॒ण्युम्
shlokas.transliteration: nā́ke ǀ su-parṇám ǀ úpa ǀ yát ǀ pátantam ǀ hṛdā́ ǀ vénantaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ ácakṣata ǀ tvā ǀhíraṇya-pakṣam ǀ váruṇasya ǀ dūtám ǀ yamásya ǀ yónau ǀ śakunám ǀ bhuraṇyúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Those desiring you in their hearts contemplated you travelling as a strong-winged bird in the sky, thegolden-winged messenger ofVaruṇa, the bird which nourishes (the world) inYama's dwelling.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वो ग॑न्ध॒र्वो अधि॒ नाके॑ अस्थात्प्र॒त्यङ्चि॒त्रा बिभ्र॑द॒स्यायु॑धानि । वसा॑नो॒ अत्कं॑ सुर॒भिं दृ॒शे कं स्व१॒॑र्ण नाम॑ जनत प्रि॒याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ūrdhváḥ ǀ gandharváḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́ke ǀ asthāt ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ citrā́ ǀ bíbhrat ǀ asya ǀ ā́yudhāni ǀvásānaḥ ǀ átkam ǀ surabhím ǀ dṛśé ǀ kám ǀ sváḥ ǀ ná ǀ nā́ma ǀ janata ǀ priyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheGandharvāstood erect upon the firmament, brandishing towards us his wonderful weapons,investing all in his beautiful diffusive (form), they make them visible, like the sun he genitive rated the precious(rains).”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्र॒प्सः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भि यज्जिगा॑ति॒ पश्य॒न्गृध्र॑स्य॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ विध॑र्मन् । भा॒नुः शु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॑ चका॒नस्तृ॒तीये॑ चक्रे॒ रज॑सि प्रि॒याणि॑
shlokas.transliteration: drapsáḥ ǀ samudrám ǀ abhí ǀ yát ǀ jígāti ǀ páśyan ǀ gṛ́dhrasya ǀ cákṣasā ǀ ví-dharman ǀbhānúḥ ǀ śukréṇa ǀ śocíṣā ǀ cakānáḥ ǀ tṛtī́ye ǀ cakre ǀ rájasi ǀ priyā́ṇi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When (Venaas) the drop of rain approaches the firmament, contemplating (all things) with the eye ofthe hawk in the supporting (firmament), then the sun, shining with brilliant radiance, makes the precious(showers) in the third sphere.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं नो॑ अग्न॒ उप॑ य॒ज्ञमेहि॒ पञ्च॑यामं त्रि॒वृतं॑ स॒प्तत॑न्तुम् । असो॑ हव्य॒वाळु॒त न॑: पुरो॒गा ज्योगे॒व दी॒र्घं तम॒ आश॑यिष्ठाः
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ úpa ǀ yajñám ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǀ páñca-yāmam ǀ tri-vṛ́tam ǀ saptá-tantum ǀásaḥ ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ utá ǀ naḥ ǀ puraḥ-gā́ḥ ǀ jyók ǀ evá ǀ dīrghám ǀ támaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ aśayiṣṭhāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Come,Agni, to this our sacrifice, which has five oblations, three- fold, spread out by seven (priests); bethe bearer of our oblations, be our preceder, you have long been sleeping in profound darkness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अदे॑वाद्दे॒वः प्र॒चता॒ गुहा॒ यन्प्र॒पश्य॑मानो अमृत॒त्वमे॑मि । शि॒वं यत्सन्त॒मशि॑वो॒ जहा॑मि॒ स्वात्स॒ख्यादर॑णीं॒ नाभि॑मेमि
shlokas.transliteration: ádevāt ǀ deváḥ ǀ pra-cátā ǀ gúhā ǀ yán ǀ pra-páśyamānaḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ emi ǀśivám ǀ yát ǀ sántam ǀ áśivaḥ ǀ jáhāmi ǀ svā́t ǀ sakhyā́t ǀ áraṇīm ǀ nā́bhim ǀ emi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Agnispeaks). From being no divinity I issue a divninty from the cave at the solicitation (of the gods),and being manifest I attain immortality; when being inauspicious I abandon the sacrifice as it becomesauspicious, through my (old) friendship I come to the binding touch-wood.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पश्य॑न्न॒न्यस्या॒ अति॑थिं व॒याया॑ ऋ॒तस्य॒ धाम॒ वि मि॑मे पु॒रूणि॑ । शंसा॑मि पि॒त्रे असु॑राय॒ शेव॑मयज्ञि॒याद्य॒ज्ञियं॑ भा॒गमे॑मि
shlokas.transliteration: páśyan ǀ anyásyāḥ ǀ átithim ǀ vayā́yāḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ dhā́ma ǀ ví ǀ mime ǀ purū́ṇi ǀśáṃsāmi ǀ pitré ǀ ásurāya ǀ śévam ǀ ayajñiyā́t ǀ yajñíyam ǀ bhāgám ǀ emi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding the guest of another family, I have created the manifold abodes of sacrifice; I repeatpraises, (wishing) good luck to the paternal foe- destroying (race of deities), I pass from a plural ce unfit for sacrificeto a plural ce where sacrifice can be offered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ब॒ह्वीः समा॑ अकरम॒न्तर॑स्मि॒न्निन्द्रं॑ वृणा॒नः पि॒तरं॑ जहामि । अ॒ग्निः सोमो॒ वरु॑ण॒स्ते च्य॑वन्ते प॒र्याव॑र्द्रा॒ष्ट्रं तद॑वाम्या॒यन्
shlokas.transliteration: bahvī́ḥ ǀ sámāḥ ǀ akaram ǀ antáḥ ǀ asmin ǀ índram ǀ vṛṇānáḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ jahāmi ǀagníḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ té ǀ cyavante ǀ pari-ā́vart ǀ rāṣṭrám ǀ tát ǀ avāmi ǀ ā-yán ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I spent many years within this (altar), preferringIndraI abandon the progenitor;Agni,Soma,Varuṇa,fall (from their power); returning, I protect that kingdom which awaits me.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निर्मा॑या उ॒ त्ये असु॑रा अभूव॒न्त्वं च॑ मा वरुण का॒मया॑से । ऋ॒तेन॑ राज॒न्ननृ॑तं विवि॒ञ्चन्मम॑ रा॒ष्ट्रस्याधि॑पत्य॒मेहि॑
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ-māyāḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ tyé ǀ ásurāḥ ǀ abhūvan ǀ tvám ǀ ca ǀ mā ǀ varuṇa ǀ kāmáyāse ǀṛténa ǀ rājan ǀ ánṛtam ǀ vi-viñcán ǀ máma ǀ rāṣṭrásya ǀ ádhi-patyam ǀ ā́ ǀ ihi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Theseasuraswere deprived of their magical power; if you,Varuṇa, desire me, (then), O king,separating truth from falsehood, come and enjoy sovereignty over my realm.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं स्व॑रि॒दमिदा॑स वा॒मम॒यं प्र॑का॒श उ॒र्व१॒॑न्तरि॑क्षम् । हना॑व वृ॒त्रं नि॒रेहि॑ सोम ह॒विष्ट्वा॒ सन्तं॑ ह॒विषा॑ यजाम
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ sváḥ ǀ idám ǀ ít ǀ āsa ǀ vāmám ǀ ayám ǀ pra-kāśáḥ ǀ urú ǀ antárikṣam ǀhánāva ǀ vṛtrám ǀ niḥ-éhi ǀ soma ǀ havíḥ ǀ tvā ǀ sántam ǀ havíṣā ǀ yajāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(AgniorVaruṇaspeak). This, OSoma, is heaven; this verily was beautiful this (was) the light, thebroad firmament; let us together slayVṛtra; come forth; we worship with an oblation you who are yourselfoblation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: क॒विः क॑वि॒त्वा दि॒वि रू॒पमास॑ज॒दप्र॑भूती॒ वरु॑णो॒ निर॒पः सृ॑जत् । क्षेमं॑ कृण्वा॒ना जन॑यो॒ न सिन्ध॑व॒स्ता अ॑स्य॒ वर्णं॒ शुच॑यो भरिभ्रति
shlokas.transliteration: kavíḥ ǀ kavi-tvā́ ǀ diví ǀ rūpám ǀ ā́ ǀ asajat ǀ ápra-bhūtī ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀ sṛjat ǀkṣémam ǀ kṛṇvānā́ḥ ǀ jánayaḥ ǀ ná ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ várṇam ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ bharibhrati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage (Mitra) by his wisdom fixed his body in the sky;Varuṇawith but a wslight effort let loose thewaters, conferring happiness, like wives, the pure rivers assume his (white) tint.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य॒ ज्येष्ठ॑मिन्द्रि॒यं स॑चन्ते॒ ता ई॒मा क्षे॑ति स्व॒धया॒ मद॑न्तीः । ता ईं॒ विशो॒ न राजा॑नं वृणा॒ना बी॑भ॒त्सुवो॒ अप॑ वृ॒त्राद॑तिष्ठन्
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ḥ ǀ asya ǀ jyéṣṭham ǀ indriyám ǀ sacante ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ svadháyā ǀ mádantīḥ ǀtā́ḥ ǀ īm ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ná ǀ rā́jānam ǀ vṛṇānā́ḥ ǀ bībhatsúvaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ vṛtrā́t ǀ atiṣṭhan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “They sustain his most excellent energy, he approaches them delighting him with (sacrificial) food; likesubject choosing a king, they, smitten with fear fled fromVṛtra.”

shlokas.sanskrit: बी॒भ॒त्सूनां॑ स॒युजं॑ हं॒समा॑हुर॒पां दि॒व्यानां॑ स॒ख्ये चर॑न्तम् । अ॒नु॒ष्टुभ॒मनु॑ चर्चू॒र्यमा॑ण॒मिन्द्रं॒ नि चि॑क्युः क॒वयो॑ मनी॒षा
shlokas.transliteration: bībhatsū́nām ǀ sa-yújam ǀ haṃsám ǀ āhuḥ ǀ apā́m ǀ divyā́nām ǀ sakhyé ǀ cárantam ǀanu-stúbham ǀ ánu ǀ carcūryámāṇam ǀ índram ǀ ní ǀ cikyuḥ ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sage called the sun the ally of those who are frightened, abiding in the friendship of the waters ofheaven; the wise have honoured with their praiseIndra, who ceaselessly moves after theAnuṣṭup.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं रु॒द्रेभि॒र्वसु॑भिश्चराम्य॒हमा॑दि॒त्यैरु॒त वि॒श्वदे॑वैः । अ॒हं मि॒त्रावरु॑णो॒भा बि॑भर्म्य॒हमि॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी अ॒हम॒श्विनो॒भा
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ carāmi ǀ ahám ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ utá ǀ viśvá-devaiḥ ǀahám ǀ mitrā́váruṇā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ bibharmi ǀ ahám ǀ indrāgnī́ íti ǀ ahám ǀ aśvínā ǀ ubhā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I proceed with theRudras, with theVasus, with theĀdityas, and with theViśvedevās; I support bothMitra andVaruṇa,AgniandIndra, and the two Aśvinṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं सोम॑माह॒नसं॑ बिभर्म्य॒हं त्वष्टा॑रमु॒त पू॒षणं॒ भग॑म् । अ॒हं द॑धामि॒ द्रवि॑णं ह॒विष्म॑ते सुप्रा॒व्ये॒३॒॑ यज॑मानाय सुन्व॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ sómam ǀ āhanásam ǀ bibharmi ǀ ahám ǀ tváṣṭāram ǀ utá ǀ pūṣáṇam ǀ bhágam ǀahám ǀ dadhāmi ǀ dráviṇam ǀ havíṣmate ǀ supra-avyé ǀ yájamānāya ǀ sunvaté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I support the foe-destroyingSoma,Tvaṣṭā,PūṣanandBhaga; I bestow wealth upon the instrumental tutorof the rite offering the oblation, deserving of careful protection, pouring forth the libation.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं राष्ट्री॑ सं॒गम॑नी॒ वसू॑नां चिकि॒तुषी॑ प्रथ॒मा य॒ज्ञिया॑नाम् । तां मा॑ दे॒वा व्य॑दधुः पुरु॒त्रा भूरि॑स्थात्रां॒ भूर्या॑वे॒शय॑न्तीम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ rā́ṣṭrī ǀ sam-gámanī ǀ vásūnām ǀ cikitúṣī ǀ prathamā́ ǀ yajñíyānām ǀtā́m ǀ mā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ adadhuḥ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ bhū́ri-sthātrām ǀ bhū́ri ǀ ā-veśáyantīm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am the sovereignqueen, the collectress of treasures, cognizant (of the Supreme Being), the chief ofobjects of worship; as such the gods have put me in many plural ces, abiding in manifold conditions, entering intonumerous (forms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मया॒ सो अन्न॑मत्ति॒ यो वि॒पश्य॑ति॒ यः प्राणि॑ति॒ य ईं॑ शृ॒णोत्यु॒क्तम् । अ॒म॒न्तवो॒ मां त उप॑ क्षियन्ति श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त श्रद्धि॒वं ते॑ वदामि
shlokas.transliteration: máyā ǀ sáḥ ǀ ánnam ǀ atti ǀ yáḥ ǀ vi-páśyati ǀ yáḥ ǀ prā́ṇiti ǀ yáḥ ǀ īm ǀ śṛṇóti ǀ uktám ǀamantávaḥ ǀ mā́m ǀ té ǀ úpa ǀ kṣiyanti ǀ śrudhí ǀ śruta ǀ śraddhi-vám ǀ te ǀ vadāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who eats food (eats) through me; he who sees, who breathes, who hears what is spoken, does sothrough me; those who are ignorant of me perish; hear you who have hearing, I tell that which is deserving ofbelief.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमे॒व स्व॒यमि॒दं व॑दामि॒ जुष्टं॑ दे॒वेभि॑रु॒त मानु॑षेभिः । यं का॒मये॒ तंत॑मु॒ग्रं कृ॑णोमि॒ तं ब्र॒ह्माणं॒ तमृषिं॒ तं सु॑मे॒धाम्
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ evá ǀ svayám ǀ idám ǀ vadāmi ǀ júṣṭam ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ utá ǀ mā́nuṣebhiḥ ǀyám ǀ kāmáye ǀ tám-tam ǀ ugrám ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ tám ǀ brahmā́ṇam ǀ tám ǀ ṛ́ṣim ǀ tám ǀ su-medhā́m ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I verily of myself declare this which is approved of by both gods and men; whomsoever I will, I render”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं रु॒द्राय॒ धनु॒रा त॑नोमि ब्रह्म॒द्विषे॒ शर॑वे॒ हन्त॒वा उ॑ । अ॒हं जना॑य स॒मदं॑ कृणोम्य॒हं द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ वि॑वेश
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ rudrā́ya ǀ dhánuḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tanomi ǀ brahma-dvíṣe ǀ śárave ǀ hántavái ǀ ūṃ íti ǀahám ǀ jánāya ǀ sa-mádam ǀ kṛṇomi ǀ ahám ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bend the bow ofRudra, to slay the destructive enemy of theBrāhmaṇas, I wage war with (hostile)men. I pervade heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हं सु॑वे पि॒तर॑मस्य मू॒र्धन्मम॒ योनि॑र॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे । ततो॒ वि ति॑ष्ठे॒ भुव॒नानु॒ विश्वो॒तामूं द्यां व॒र्ष्मणोप॑ स्पृशामि
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ suve ǀ pitáram ǀ asya ǀ mūrdhán ǀ máma ǀ yóniḥ ǀ ap-sú ǀ antáríti ǀ samudré ǀtátaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tiṣṭhe ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ánu ǀ víśvā ǀ utá ǀ amū́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ varṣmáṇā ǀ úpa ǀ spṛśāmi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I bring forth the paternal (heaven) upon the brow of this (Supreme Being), my birthplace is in the midstof the waters; from thence I spread through all beings, and touch this heaven with my body.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हमे॒व वात॑ इव॒ प्र वा॑म्या॒रभ॑माणा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ । प॒रो दि॒वा प॒र ए॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्यैताव॑ती महि॒ना सं ब॑भूव
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ evá ǀ vā́taḥ-iva ǀ prá ǀ vāmi ǀ ā-rábhamāṇā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ víśvā ǀparáḥ ǀ divā́ ǀ paráḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ ǀ etā́vatī ǀ mahinā́ ǀ sám ǀ babhūva ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I breathe forth like the wind giving form to all created worlds; beyond the heaven, beyond this earth(am I), so vast am I in greatness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न तमंहो॒ न दु॑रि॒तं देवा॑सो अष्ट॒ मर्त्य॑म् । स॒जोष॑सो॒ यम॑र्य॒मा मि॒त्रो नय॑न्ति॒ वरु॑णो॒ अति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ tám ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ ná ǀ duḥ-itám ǀ dévāsaḥ ǀ aṣṭa ǀ mártyam ǀsa-jóṣasaḥ ǀ yám ǀ aryamā́ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ náyanti ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Neither sin nor sorrow, O gods, affect the man whomAryaman,MitraandVaruṇa, being alike plural asedby him, conduct beyond (the reach of) his enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तद्धि व॒यं वृ॑णी॒महे॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्रार्य॑मन् । येना॒ निरंह॑सो यू॒यं पा॒थ ने॒था च॒ मर्त्य॒मति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tát ǀ hí ǀ vayám ǀ vṛṇīmáhe ǀ váruṇa ǀ mítra ǀ áryaman ǀyéna ǀ níḥ ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ yūyám ǀ pāthá ǀ nethá ǀ ca ǀ mártyam ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We implore that (protection) of yours,Varuṇa,Mitra, andAryaman, whereby you preserve a man fromsin, and lead him beyond (the reach of) his enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ते नू॒नं नो॒ऽयमू॒तये॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । नयि॑ष्ठा उ नो ने॒षणि॒ पर्षि॑ष्ठा उ नः प॒र्षण्यति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: té ǀ nūnám ǀ naḥ ǀ ayám ǀ ūtáye ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀnáyiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ neṣáṇi ǀ párṣiṣṭhāḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ naḥ ǀ parṣáṇi ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May thisVaruṇaandMitraandAryamanbe our protection, may they lead us to the spot to which weshould be led, and make us cross over to the spot to which we should cross over beyond (the reach of) ourenemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यू॒यं विश्वं॒ परि॑ पाथ॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । यु॒ष्माकं॒ शर्म॑णि प्रि॒ये स्याम॑ सुप्रणीत॒योऽति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yūyám ǀ víśvam ǀ pári ǀ pātha ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀyuṣmā́kam ǀ śármaṇi ǀ priyé ǀ syā́ma ǀ su-pranītayaḥ ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, protect the universe; may we abide in your blessed felicity, O excellentleaders, beyond (the reach of) our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ॒दि॒त्यासो॒ अति॒ स्रिधो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । उ॒ग्रं म॒रुद्भी॑ रु॒द्रं हु॑वे॒मेन्द्र॑म॒ग्निं स्व॒स्तयेऽति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ādityā́saḥ ǀ áti ǀ srídhaḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀugrám ǀ marút-bhiḥ ǀ rudrám ǀ huvema ǀ índram ǀ agním ǀ svastáye ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May theĀdityas,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, (lead us) beyond (the reach of) the malignant; let usinvoke the fierceRudrawith theMaruts, andIndraandAgnifor our welfare, (that they may plural ce us) beyond (thereach of) our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नेता॑र ऊ॒ षु ण॑स्ति॒रो वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । अति॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता राजा॑नश्चर्षणी॒नामति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: nétāraḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ tiráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀáti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ rā́jānaḥ ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the leadersVaruṇa,Mitra,Aryaman, (lead) us apart (from wickedness), may the kings of menlead us beyond all calamities, beyond (the reach of) our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शु॒नम॒स्मभ्य॑मू॒तये॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । शर्म॑ यच्छन्तु स॒प्रथ॑ आदि॒त्यासो॒ यदीम॑हे॒ अति॒ द्विष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śunám ǀ asmábhyam ǀ ūtáye ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀśárma ǀ yacchantu ǀ sa-práthaḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ yát ǀ ī́mahe ǀ áti ǀ dvíṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayVaruṇa,Mitra,Aryaman(bestow) upon us felicity for our protection; may theĀdityasgrant usthat abundant happiness which we solicit, (and lead us) beyond (the reach of) our enemies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ ह॒ त्यद्व॑सवो गौ॒र्यं॑ चित्प॒दि षि॒ताममु॑ञ्चता यजत्राः । ए॒वो ष्व१॒॑स्मन्मु॑ञ्चता॒ व्यंह॒: प्र ता॑र्यग्ने प्रत॒रं न॒ आयु॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ ha ǀ tyát ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ gauryám ǀ cit ǀ padí ǀ sitā́m ǀ ámuñcata ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀevó íti ǀ sú ǀ asmát ǀ muñcata ǀ ví ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ prá ǀ tāri ǀ agne ǀ pra-tarám ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́yuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As you, adorableVasus, set free the cow fastened by her foot, even so remove sin away from us, andprolong,Agni, our protracted life.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रात्री॒ व्य॑ख्यदाय॒ती पु॑रु॒त्रा दे॒व्य१॒॑क्षभि॑: । विश्वा॒ अधि॒ श्रियो॑ऽधित
shlokas.transliteration: rā́trī ǀ ví ǀ akhyat ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀ puru-trā́ ǀ devī́ ǀ akṣá-bhiḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ śríyaḥ ǀ adhita ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The divine Night approaching looked upon many plural ces with her eyes, she has assumed all beautieṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: ओर्व॑प्रा॒ अम॑र्त्या नि॒वतो॑ दे॒व्यु१॒॑द्वत॑: । ज्योति॑षा बाधते॒ तम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ urú ǀ aprāḥ ǀ ámartyā ǀ ni-vátaḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀjyótiṣā ǀ bādhate ǀ támaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The immortal goddess has filled the expandeed (formament), the low plural ces and the high plural ces, shefights the darkness with lustre.”

shlokas.sanskrit: निरु॒ स्वसा॑रमस्कृतो॒षसं॑ दे॒व्या॑य॒ती । अपेदु॑ हासते॒ तम॑:
shlokas.transliteration: níḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ svásāram ǀ akṛta ǀ uṣásam ǀ devī́ ǀ ā-yatī́ ǀápa ǀ ít ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ hāsate ǀ támaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The advancing goddess prepared (the way for) her sister Dawn, and then the darkness departs.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सा नो॑ अ॒द्य यस्या॑ व॒यं नि ते॒ याम॒न्नवि॑क्ष्महि । वृ॒क्षे न व॑स॒तिं वय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ adyá ǀ yásyāḥ ǀ vayám ǀ ní ǀ te ǀ yā́man ǀ ávikṣmahi ǀvṛkṣé ǀ ná ǀ vasatím ǀ váyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May she be favourable to us today upon whose approach we re-enter (our dwellings), as birds(re-enter) their nest upon the tree.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नि ग्रामा॑सो अविक्षत॒ नि प॒द्वन्तो॒ नि प॒क्षिण॑: । नि श्ये॒नास॑श्चिद॒र्थिन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ní ǀ grā́māsaḥ ǀ avikṣata ǀ ní ǀ pat-vántaḥ ǀ ní ǀ pakṣíṇaḥ ǀní ǀ śyenā́saḥ ǀ cit ǀ arthínaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men have re-entered (their dwellings), and beasts and birds and the swift hawks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: या॒वया॑ वृ॒क्यं१॒॑ वृकं॑ य॒वय॑ स्ते॒नमू॑र्म्ये । अथा॑ नः सु॒तरा॑ भव
shlokas.transliteration: yaváya ǀ vṛkyám ǀ vṛ́kam ǀ yaváya ǀ stenám ǀ ūrmye ǀátha ǀ naḥ ǀ su-tárā ǀ bhava ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Keep off, O Ūrmya, the she-wolf, keep off the wolf and the robber, and be safely passed by us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ मा॒ पेपि॑श॒त्तम॑: कृ॒ष्णं व्य॑क्तमस्थित । उष॑ ऋ॒णेव॑ यातय
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ mā ǀ pépiśat ǀ támaḥ ǀ kṛṣṇám ǀ ví-aktam ǀ asthita ǀúṣaḥ ǀ ṛṇā́-iva ǀ yātaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The all-embracing black diffused darkness has approached me, discharge it, Uṣas, as if it were adebt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ ते॒ गा इ॒वाक॑रं वृणी॒ष्व दु॑हितर्दिवः । रात्रि॒ स्तोमं॒ न जि॒ग्युषे॑
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ te ǀ gā́ḥ-iva ǀ ā́ ǀ akaram ǀ vṛṇīṣvá ǀ duhitaḥ ǀ divaḥ ǀrā́tri ǀ stómam ǀ ná ǀ jigyúṣe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have brought (these verses) before you like kine; accept, O Night, daughter of the sky, (my oblation)as the eulogy of one about to conquer.”
