shlokas.sanskrit: ममा॑ग्ने॒ वर्चो॑ विह॒वेष्व॑स्तु व॒यं त्वेन्धा॑नास्त॒न्वं॑ पुषेम । मह्यं॑ नमन्तां प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्र॒स्त्वयाध्य॑क्षेण॒ पृत॑ना जयेम
shlokas.transliteration: máma ǀ agne ǀ várcaḥ ǀ vi-havéṣu ǀ astu ǀ vayám ǀ tvā ǀ índhānāḥ ǀ tanvám ǀ puṣema ǀmáhyam ǀ namantām ǀ pra-díśaḥ ǀ cátasraḥ ǀ tváyā ǀ ádhi-akṣeṇa ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ jayema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May gloryAgni, be mine in battle, may we, kindling you, cherish your person n, may the (inhabitants ofthe) four quarters bow down before me, may we with you for our leader overcome (hostile) armies.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मम॑ दे॒वा वि॑ह॒वे स॑न्तु॒ सर्व॒ इन्द्र॑वन्तो म॒रुतो॒ विष्णु॑र॒ग्निः । ममा॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒रुलो॑कमस्तु॒ मह्यं॒ वात॑: पवतां॒ कामे॑ अ॒स्मिन्
shlokas.transliteration: máma ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vi-havé ǀ santu ǀ sárve ǀ índra-vantaḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ víṣṇuḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀmáma ǀ antárikṣam ǀ urú-lokam ǀ astu ǀ máhyam ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ pavatām ǀ kā́me ǀ asmín ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all the gods be on my side in battle, theMarutswithIndra,ViṣṇuandAgni; may the expandedfirmament be mine, may the wind blow (propitiously) to this my desire.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मयि॑ दे॒वा द्रवि॑ण॒मा य॑जन्तां॒ मय्या॒शीर॑स्तु॒ मयि॑ दे॒वहू॑तिः । दैव्या॒ होता॑रो वनुषन्त॒ पूर्वेऽरि॑ष्टाः स्याम त॒न्वा॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: máyi ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ dráviṇam ǀ ā́ ǀ yajantām ǀ máyi ǀ ā-śī́ḥ ǀ astu ǀ máyi ǀ devá-hūtiḥ ǀdáivyāḥ ǀ hótāraḥ ǀ vanuṣanta ǀ pū́rve ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ syāma ǀ tanvā́ ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gods bestow wealth upon me, may (their) blessing be upon me, may the sacrifice in which thegods are invoked be (beneficial) to me, may my invokers of the gods be the first to propitiate them; may we beunharmed in body and blessed withmaleoffspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मह्यं॑ यजन्तु॒ मम॒ यानि॑ ह॒व्याकू॑तिः स॒त्या मन॑सो मे अस्तु । एनो॒ मा नि गां॑ कत॒मच्च॒नाहं विश्वे॑ देवासो॒ अधि॑ वोचता नः
shlokas.transliteration: máhyam ǀ yajantu ǀ máma ǀ yā́ni ǀ havyā́ ǀ ā́-kūtiḥ ǀ satyā́ ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ me ǀ astu ǀénaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ ní ǀ gām ǀ katamát ǀ caná ǀ ahám ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May (my priests) offer for me whatever oblations of mine (there may be); may the purpose of my mindbe sincere; may I not fall into any kind of sin; universal gods, bless us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: देवी॑: षळुर्वीरु॒रु न॑: कृणोत॒ विश्वे॑ देवास इ॒ह वी॑रयध्वम् । मा हा॑स्महि प्र॒जया॒ मा त॒नूभि॒र्मा र॑धाम द्विष॒ते सो॑म राजन्
shlokas.transliteration: dévīḥ ǀ ṣaṭ ǀ urvīḥ ǀ urú ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛṇota ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ihá ǀ vīrayadhvam ǀmā́ ǀ hāsmahi ǀ pra-jáyā ǀ mā́ ǀ tanū́bhiḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ radhāma ǀ dviṣaté ǀ soma ǀ rājan ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You six mighty goddesses, bestow upon us ample (wealth); universal gods, display prowess here; letus not be bereft of our offspring, or be harmed in our bodies, may we not become subject to our enemy, royalSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ म॒न्युं प्र॑तिनु॒दन्परे॑षा॒मद॑ब्धो गो॒पाः परि॑ पाहि न॒स्त्वम् । प्र॒त्यञ्चो॑ यन्तु नि॒गुत॒: पुन॒स्ते॒३॒॑ऽमैषां॑ चि॒त्तं प्र॒बुधां॒ वि ने॑शत्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ manyúm ǀ prati-nudán ǀ páreṣām ǀ ádabdhaḥ ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ pári ǀ pāhi ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀpratyáñcaḥ ǀ yantu ǀ ni-gútaḥ ǀ púnaríti ǀ té ǀ amā́ ǀ eṣām ǀ cittám ǀ pra-búdhām ǀ ví ǀ neśat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are an invincible protector, do you defend us, baffling the wrath of our enemies; let themreturn grumbling to their homes, may the intelligence of those watchful (foes) be at once destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: धा॒ता धा॑तॄ॒णां भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पति॑र्दे॒वं त्रा॒तार॑मभिमातिषा॒हम् । इ॒मं य॒ज्ञम॒श्विनो॒भा बृह॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वाः पा॑न्तु॒ यज॑मानं न्य॒र्थात्
shlokas.transliteration: dhātā́ ǀ dhātṝṇā́m ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ yáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ devám ǀ trātā́ram ǀ abhimāti-sahám ǀimám ǀ yajñám ǀ aśvínā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ pāntu ǀ yájamānam ǀ ni-arthā́t ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The creator of creators, he who is the protector of the universe, (him I praise), the divine defender, thedestroyer of enemies; may the twoAśvins,Bṛhaspati, and the gods, protect this sacrifice, and save the sacrificerfrom disappointment.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒रु॒व्यचा॑ नो महि॒षः शर्म॑ यंसद॒स्मिन्हवे॑ पुरुहू॒तः पु॑रु॒क्षुः । स न॑: प्र॒जायै॑ हर्यश्व मृळ॒येन्द्र॒ मा नो॑ रीरिषो॒ मा परा॑ दाः
shlokas.transliteration: uru-vyácāḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ mahiṣáḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yaṃsat ǀ asmín ǀ háve ǀ puru-hūtáḥ ǀ puru-kṣúḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ pra-jā́yai ǀ hari-aśva ǀ mṛḷaya ǀ índra ǀ mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ ririṣaḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ párā ǀ dāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the omnipresent (Indra), the mighty one, who is invoked by many, and lauded by many, bestow ablessing on this our sacrifice; be gracious to our offspring, Indra, lord of bay horses; harm us not, desert us not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ये न॑: स॒पत्ना॒ अप॒ ते भ॑वन्त्विन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॒मव॑ बाधामहे॒ तान् । वस॑वो रु॒द्रा आ॑दि॒त्या उ॑परि॒स्पृशं॑ मो॒ग्रं चेत्ता॑रमधिरा॒जम॑क्रन्
shlokas.transliteration: yé ǀ naḥ ǀ sa-pátnāḥ ǀ ápa ǀ té ǀ bhavantu ǀ indrāgní-bhyām ǀ áva ǀ bādhāmahe ǀ tā́n ǀvásavaḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ ādityā́ḥ ǀ upari-spṛ́śam ǀ mā ǀ ugrám ǀ céttāram ǀ adhi-rājám ǀ akran ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May those who are our foes be driven off; may we throughIndraandAgnidestroy them; may theVasus, theRudras, and theĀdityasmake me the high- reaching, fierce, intelligent, supreme ruler.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नास॑दासी॒न्नो सदा॑सीत्त॒दानीं॒ नासी॒द्रजो॒ नो व्यो॑मा प॒रो यत् । किमाव॑रीव॒: कुह॒ कस्य॒ शर्म॒न्नम्भ॒: किमा॑सी॒द्गह॑नं गभी॒रम्
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ ásat ǀ āsīt ǀ nó íti ǀ sát ǀ āsīt ǀ tadā́nīm ǀ ná ǀ āsīt ǀ rájaḥ ǀ nó íti ǀ ví-oma ǀ paráḥ ǀ yát ǀkím ǀ ā́ ǀ avarīvaríti ǀ kúha ǀ kásya ǀ śárman ǀ ámbhaḥ ǀ kím ǀ āsīt ǀ gáhanam ǀ gabhīrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The non-existent was not, the existent was not; then the world was not, not the firmament, nor thatwhich is above (the firmament). How could there by any investing envelope, and where? Of what (could there be)felicity? How (could there be) the deep unfathomable water?”

shlokas.sanskrit: न मृ॒त्युरा॑सीद॒मृतं॒ न तर्हि॒ न रात्र्या॒ अह्न॑ आसीत्प्रके॒तः । आनी॑दवा॒तं स्व॒धया॒ तदेकं॒ तस्मा॑द्धा॒न्यन्न प॒रः किं च॒नास॑
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ mṛtyúḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ ná ǀ tárhi ǀ ná ǀ rā́tryāḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǀā́nīt ǀ avātám ǀ svadháyā ǀ tát ǀ ékam ǀ tásmāt ǀ ha ǀ anyát ǀ ná ǀ paráḥ ǀ kím ǀ caná ǀ āsa ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Death was not nor at that period immortality, there was no indication of day, of night; That Oneunbreathed upon breathed of his own strength, other than That there was nothing else whatever.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तम॑ आसी॒त्तम॑सा गू॒ळ्हमग्रे॑ऽप्रके॒तं स॑लि॒लं सर्व॑मा इ॒दम् । तु॒च्छ्येना॒भ्वपि॑हितं॒ यदासी॒त्तप॑स॒स्तन्म॑हि॒नाजा॑य॒तैक॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: támaḥ ǀ āsīt ǀ támasā ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ágre ǀ apra-ketám ǀ salilám ǀ sárvam ǀ āḥ ǀ idám ǀtucchyéna ǀ ābhú ǀ ápi-hitam ǀ yát ǀ ā́sīt ǀ tápasaḥ ǀ tát ǀ mahinā́ ǀ ajāyata ǀ ékam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “There was darkness covered by darkness in the beginning, all this (world) was undistinguishablewater; that empty united (world) which was covered by a mere nothing, was produced through the power ofausterity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: काम॒स्तदग्रे॒ सम॑वर्त॒ताधि॒ मन॑सो॒ रेत॑: प्रथ॒मं यदासी॑त् । स॒तो बन्धु॒मस॑ति॒ निर॑विन्दन्हृ॒दि प्र॒तीष्या॑ क॒वयो॑ मनी॒षा
shlokas.transliteration: kā́maḥ ǀ tát ǀ ágre ǀ sám ǀ avartata ǀ ádhi ǀ mánasaḥ ǀ rétaḥ ǀ prathamám ǀ yát ǀ ā́sīt ǀsatáḥ ǀ bándhum ǀ ásati ǀ níḥ ǀ avindan ǀ hṛdí ǀ prati-íṣya ǀ kaváyaḥ ǀ manīṣā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In the beginning there was desire, which was the first seed of mind; sages having meditated in theirhearts have discovered by their wisdom the connexion of the existent with te non-existent.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ति॒र॒श्चीनो॒ वित॑तो र॒श्मिरे॑षाम॒धः स्वि॑दा॒सी३दु॒परि॑ स्विदासी३त् । रे॒तो॒धा आ॑सन्महि॒मान॑ आसन्त्स्व॒धा अ॒वस्ता॒त्प्रय॑तिः प॒रस्ता॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: tiraścī́naḥ ǀ ví-tataḥ ǀ raśmíḥ ǀ eṣām ǀ adháḥ ǀ svit ǀ āsī́t ǀ upári ǀ svit ǀ āsī́t ǀretaḥ-dhā́ḥ ǀ āsan ǀ mahimā́naḥ ǀ āsan ǀ svadhā́ ǀ avástāt ǀ prá-yatiḥ ǀ parástāt ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Their ray was stretched out, whether across, or below, or above; (some) were shedders of seed,(others) were mighty; food was inferior; the eater was superior.”

shlokas.sanskrit: को अ॒द्धा वे॑द॒ क इ॒ह प्र वो॑च॒त्कुत॒ आजा॑ता॒ कुत॑ इ॒यं विसृ॑ष्टिः । अ॒र्वाग्दे॒वा अ॒स्य वि॒सर्ज॑ने॒नाथा॒ को वे॑द॒ यत॑ आब॒भूव॑
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ addhā́ ǀ veda ǀ káḥ ǀ ihá ǀ prá ǀ vocat ǀ kútaḥ ǀ ā́-jātā ǀ kútaḥ ǀ iyám ǀ ví-sṛṣṭiḥ ǀarvā́k ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ asyá ǀ vi-sárjanena ǀ átha ǀ káḥ ǀ veda ǀ yátaḥ ǀ ā-babhū́va ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Who really knows? Who in this world may declare it! whence was this creation, whence was itengendered? The gods (were) subsequent to the (world's) creation; so who knows whence it arose?”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒यं विसृ॑ष्टि॒र्यत॑ आब॒भूव॒ यदि॑ वा द॒धे यदि॑ वा॒ न । यो अ॒स्याध्य॑क्षः पर॒मे व्यो॑म॒न्त्सो अ॒ङ्ग वे॑द॒ यदि॑ वा॒ न वेद॑
shlokas.transliteration: iyám ǀ ví-sṛṣṭiḥ ǀ yátaḥ ǀ ā-babhū́va ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ dadhé ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ ná ǀyáḥ ǀ asya ǀ ádhi-akṣaḥ ǀ paramé ǀ ví-oman ǀ sáḥ ǀ aṅgá ǀ veda ǀ yádi ǀ vā ǀ ná ǀ véda ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He from whom this creation arose, he may uphold it, or he may not (no one else can); he who is itssuperintendent in the highest heaven, he assuredly knows, or if he knows not (no one else does).”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो य॒ज्ञो वि॒श्वत॒स्तन्तु॑भिस्त॒त एक॑शतं देवक॒र्मेभि॒राय॑तः । इ॒मे व॑यन्ति पि॒तरो॒ य आ॑य॒युः प्र व॒याप॑ व॒येत्या॑सते त॒ते
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ tántu-bhiḥ ǀ tatáḥ ǀ éka-śatam ǀ deva-karmébhiḥ ǀ ā́-yataḥ ǀimé ǀ vayanti ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ yé ǀ ā-yayúḥ ǀ prá ǀ vaya ǀ ápa ǀ vaya ǀ íti ǀ āsate ǀ taté ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sacrifice which is extended on every side by the threads (of created things) spread out by theworship of the gods for a hundred and one (years), these our progenitors, who have preceded us, weave it,weaving forwards, weaving backwards, they worship (Prajāpati) when (the world) is woven.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पुमाँ॑ एनं तनुत॒ उत्कृ॑णत्ति॒ पुमा॒न्वि त॑त्ने॒ अधि॒ नाके॑ अ॒स्मिन् । इ॒मे म॒यूखा॒ उप॑ सेदुरू॒ सद॒: सामा॑नि चक्रु॒स्तस॑रा॒ण्योत॑वे
shlokas.transliteration: púmān ǀ enam ǀ tanute ǀ út ǀ kṛṇatti ǀ púmān ǀ ví ǀ tatne ǀ ádhi ǀ nā́ke ǀ asmín ǀimé ǀ mayū́khāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ seduḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sádaḥ ǀ sā́māni ǀ cakruḥ ǀ tásarāṇi ǀ ótave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The first man spreads out this (web), the first man rolls it up, he spread it above in this heaven; thesehis rays have sat down on the seat (of sacrifice), they have made the prayers serve as shuttles for weaving.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कासी॑त्प्र॒मा प्र॑ति॒मा किं नि॒दान॒माज्यं॒ किमा॑सीत्परि॒धिः क आ॑सीत् । छन्द॒: किमा॑सी॒त्प्रउ॑गं॒ किमु॒क्थं यद्दे॒वा दे॒वमय॑जन्त॒ विश्वे॑
shlokas.transliteration: kā́ ǀ āsīt ǀ pra-mā́ ǀ prati-mā́ ǀ kím ǀ ni-dā́nam ǀ ā́jyam ǀ kím ǀ āsīt ǀ pari-dhíḥ ǀ káḥ ǀ āsīt ǀchándaḥ ǀ kím ǀ āsīt ǀ prá_ugam ǀ kím ǀ ukthám ǀ yát ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ devám ǀ áyajanta ǀ víśve ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “What was the authority (of the sacrifice), what was thelimitation, what was the first cause, what wasthe clarified butter, what was the enclosure, what was the metre, what was pra-uga text, when the universal godsoffered worship to the gods?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्गा॑य॒त्र्य॑भवत्स॒युग्वो॒ष्णिह॑या सवि॒ता सं ब॑भूव । अ॒नु॒ष्टुभा॒ सोम॑ उ॒क्थैर्मह॑स्वा॒न्बृह॒स्पते॑र्बृह॒ती वाच॑मावत्
shlokas.transliteration: agnéḥ ǀ gāyatrī́ ǀ abhavat ǀ sa-yúgvā ǀ uṣṇíhayā ǀ savitā́ ǀ sám ǀ babhūva ǀanu-stúbhā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ máhasvān ǀ bṛ́haspáteḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ ǀ vā́cam ǀ āvat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gāyatrībecame the associate ofAgni,Savitābecame combined withUṣṇik,Somaradiant withsacred praises (was united) withAnuṣṭup,Bṛhatīgave efficacy to the words ofBṛhaspati.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒राण्मि॒त्रावरु॑णयोरभि॒श्रीरिन्द्र॑स्य त्रि॒ष्टुबि॒ह भा॒गो अह्न॑: । विश्वा॑न्दे॒वाञ्जग॒त्या वि॑वेश॒ तेन॑ चाकॢप्र॒ ऋष॑यो मनु॒ष्या॑:
shlokas.transliteration: virā́ṭ ǀ mitrā́váruṇayoḥ ǀ abhi-śrī́ḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ tri-stúp ǀ ihá ǀ bhāgáḥ ǀ áhnaḥ ǀvíśvān ǀ devā́n ǀ jágatī́ ǀ ā́ ǀ viveśa ǀ téna ǀ cākḽpre ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Virāt. was the glory ofMitraandVaruṇa;TriṣṭubhwasIndra's portion of the midday (oblation) atand 5 answer the question, what was the metre? Two of the other questions- those relating to the butter (ājya)and the enclosure (paridhi)-- have been answered, in thePuruṣa sūkta, 10.90; cf.TaittirīyaBrāhmaṇa3.12.9]. beholding them with the eye of the mind, I glorify those who of old celebrated this sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: चा॒कॢ॒प्रे तेन॒ ऋष॑यो मनु॒ष्या॑ य॒ज्ञे जा॒ते पि॒तरो॑ नः पुरा॒णे । पश्य॑न्मन्ये॒ मन॑सा॒ चक्ष॑सा॒ तान्य इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमय॑जन्त॒ पूर्वे॑
shlokas.transliteration: cākḽpré ǀ téna ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǀ yajñé ǀ jāté ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ purāṇé ǀpáśyan ǀ manye ǀ mánasā ǀ cákṣasā ǀ tā́n ǀ yé ǀ imám ǀ yajñám ǀ áyajanta ǀ pū́rve ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒हस्तो॑माः स॒हछ॑न्दस आ॒वृत॑: स॒हप्र॑मा॒ ऋष॑यः स॒प्त दैव्या॑: । पूर्वे॑षां॒ पन्था॑मनु॒दृश्य॒ धीरा॑ अ॒न्वाले॑भिरे र॒थ्यो॒३॒॑ न र॒श्मीन्
shlokas.transliteration: sahá-stomāḥ ǀ sahá-chandasaḥ ǀ ā-vṛ́taḥ ǀ sahá-pramāḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ saptá ǀ dáivyāḥ ǀpū́rveṣām ǀ pánthām ǀ anu-dṛ́śya ǀ dhī́rāḥ ǀ anu-ā́lebhire ǀ rathyáḥ ǀ ná ǀ raśmī́n ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अप॒ प्राच॑ इन्द्र॒ विश्वाँ॑ अ॒मित्रा॒नपापा॑चो अभिभूते नुदस्व । अपोदी॑चो॒ अप॑ शूराध॒राच॑ उ॒रौ यथा॒ तव॒ शर्म॒न्मदे॑म
shlokas.transliteration: ápa ǀ prā́caḥ ǀ indra ǀ víśvān ǀ amítrān ǀ ápa ǀ ápācaḥ ǀ abhi-bhūte ǀ nudasva ǀápa ǀ údīcaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ śūra ǀ adharā́caḥ ǀ uráu ǀ yáthā ǀ táva ǀ śárman ǀ mádema ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “VictoriousIndra, drive off all our foes, those who dwell in the east, and those who dwell in the west,(drive) off, O hero, those who dwell in the north, and those who dwell in the south, that we may rejoice in yourexceeding felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो॒ यवं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ । इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नमो॑वृक्तिं॒ न ज॒ग्मुः
shlokas.transliteration: kuvít ǀ aṅgá ǀ yáva-mantaḥ ǀ yávam ǀ cit ǀ yáthā ǀ dā́nti ǀ anu-pūrvám ǀ vi-yū́ya ǀihá-iha ǀ eṣām ǀ kṛṇuhi ǀ bhójanāni ǀ yé ǀ barhíṣaḥ ǀ námaḥ-vṛktim ǀ ná ǀ jagmúḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the growers of barley often cut the barley, separating it uin due order, so do you, (OIndra), bestowhere and there nourishment upon those who have not neglected the performance of the sacrifice.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒हि स्थूर्यृ॑तु॒था या॒तमस्ति॒ नोत श्रवो॑ विविदे संग॒मेषु॑ । ग॒व्यन्त॒ इन्द्रं॑ स॒ख्याय॒ विप्रा॑ अश्वा॒यन्तो॒ वृष॑णं वा॒जय॑न्तः
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ sthū́ri ǀ ṛtu-thā́ ǀ yātám ǀ ásti ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ vivide ǀ sam-gaméṣu ǀgavyántaḥ ǀ índram ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ víprāḥ ǀ aśva-yántaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ vājáyantaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The cart has not arrived in due season, nor does he acquire fame in battles, (let us), the sages,desiring cattle, desiring horses, desiring food, (solicit)Indra, the showerer, for his friendship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं सु॒राम॑मश्विना॒ नमु॑चावासु॒रे सचा॑ । वि॒पि॒पा॒ना शु॑भस्पती॒ इन्द्रं॒ कर्म॑स्वावतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ surā́mam ǀ aśvinā ǀ námucau ǀ āsuré ǀ sácā ǀvi-pipānā́ ǀ śubhaḥ ǀ patī íti ǀ índram ǀ kárma-su ǀ āvatam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You, OAśvins, lords of light, having drunk the grateful (libation), jointly preservedIndrain battleagainst theAsuraNamuci.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒त्रमि॑व पि॒तरा॑व॒श्विनो॒भेन्द्रा॒वथु॒: काव्यै॑र्दं॒सना॑भिः । यत्सु॒रामं॒ व्यपि॑ब॒: शची॑भि॒: सर॑स्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक्
shlokas.transliteration: putrám-iva ǀ pitárau ǀ aśvínā ǀ ubhā́ ǀ índra ǀ āváthuḥ ǀ kā́vyaiḥ ǀ daṃsánābhiḥ ǀyát ǀ surā́mam ǀ ví ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀ sárasvatī ǀ tvā ǀ magha-van ǀ abhiṣṇak ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both theAśvinsdefended (you),Indra, like two fathers (defending) a son with glorious exploits; when(triumphing) through the deeds of valour, you drank the grateful libation,Sarasvatīapproached you, OMaghavat.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑: सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ अवो॑भिः सुमृळी॒को भ॑वतु वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । बाध॑तां॒ द्वेषो॒ अभ॑यं कृणोतु सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम
shlokas.transliteration: índraḥ ǀ su-trā́mā ǀ svá-vān ǀ ávaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ su-mṛḷīkáḥ ǀ bhavatu ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀbā́dhatām ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ kṛṇotu ǀ su-vī́ryasya ǀ pátayaḥ ǀ syāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayIndra, the protector, the possessor of treat wealth, the all- knowing, be favourable (to us) with hisprotections; may he confound our enemies, may he make us free from fear, may we be the parents of excellentmale offspring.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तस्य॑ व॒यं सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म । स सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मे आ॒राच्चि॒द्द्वेष॑: सनु॒तर्यु॑योतु
shlokas.transliteration: tásya ǀ vayám ǀ su-matáu ǀ yajñíyasya ǀ ápi ǀ bhadré ǀ saumanasé ǀ syāma ǀsáḥ ǀ su-trā́mā ǀ svá-vān ǀ índraḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ ārā́t ǀ cit ǀ dvéṣaḥ ǀ sanutáḥ ǀ yuyotu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we be ever in (the enjoyment of) the favour of that adorable divinity (retained) in his favourablethoughts, and may the protecting and opulentIndradrive away far off us those who hate us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ई॒जा॒नमिद्द्यौर्गू॒र्ताव॑सुरीजा॒नं भूमि॑र॒भि प्र॑भू॒षणि॑ । ई॒जा॒नं दे॒वाव॒श्विना॑व॒भि सु॒म्नैर॑वर्धताम्
shlokas.transliteration: ījānám ǀ ít ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ gūrtá-vasuḥ ǀ ījānám ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ abhí ǀ pra-bhūṣáṇi ǀījānám ǀ deváu ǀ aśvínau ǀ abhí ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ avardhatām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The Heaven liberal of treasure (prospers) the sacrificer, the Earth (prospers) the sacrificer because ofthe ornament, the divineAśvinsprospered the sacrificer with blessings.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ता वां॑ मित्रावरुणा धार॒यत्क्षि॑ती सुषु॒म्नेषि॑त॒त्वता॑ यजामसि । यु॒वोः क्रा॒णाय॑ स॒ख्यैर॒भि ष्या॑म र॒क्षस॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tā́ ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ dhārayátkṣitī íti dhārayát-kṣitī ǀ su-sumnā́ ǀ iṣitatvátā ǀ yajāmasi ǀyuvóḥ ǀ krāṇā́ya ǀ sakhyáiḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ rakṣásaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MitraandVaruṇa, who sustain the earth, we worship you, the givers of felicity, for the sake ofattaining our desires; may we, through your favour for the performer (of the sacrifice), overcome therākṣasas.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अधा॑ चि॒न्नु यद्दिधि॑षामहे वाम॒भि प्रि॒यं रेक्ण॒: पत्य॑मानाः । द॒द्वाँ वा॒ यत्पुष्य॑ति॒ रेक्ण॒: सम्वा॑र॒न्नकि॑रस्य म॒घानि॑
shlokas.transliteration: ádha ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ yát ǀ dídhiṣāmahe ǀ vām ǀ abhí ǀ priyám ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ pátyamānāḥ ǀdadvā́n ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ púṣyati ǀ rékṇaḥ ǀ sám ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ āran ǀ nákiḥ ǀ asya ǀ maghā́ni ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May we, when we present to you (oblations), quickly alight upon desirable wealth, and the genitive rousman who fosters his wealth, may his riches not depart from him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒साव॒न्यो अ॑सुर सूयत॒ द्यौस्त्वं विश्वे॑षां वरुणासि॒ राजा॑ । मू॒र्धा रथ॑स्य चाक॒न्नैताव॒तैन॑सान्तक॒ध्रुक्
shlokas.transliteration: asáu ǀ anyáḥ ǀ asura ǀ sūyata ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ tvám ǀ víśveṣām ǀ varuṇa ǀ asi ǀ rā́jā ǀmūrdhā́ ǀ ráthasya ǀ cākan ǀ ná ǀ etā́vatā ǀ énasā ǀ antaka-dhrúk ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Mitra), scatterer of darkness, the Heaven gave birth to you the other; you,Varuṇa, are sovereignover all. The head of (your) chariot desired (this sacrifice); opposing the destroyer, (the rite) is not (vitiated) bythe smallest defect.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मिन्त्स्वे॒३॒॑तच्छक॑पूत॒ एनो॑ हि॒ते मि॒त्रे निग॑तान्हन्ति वी॒रान् । अ॒वोर्वा॒ यद्धात्त॒नूष्वव॑: प्रि॒यासु॑ य॒ज्ञिया॒स्वर्वा॑
shlokas.transliteration: asmín ǀ sú ǀ etát ǀ śáka-pūte ǀ énaḥ ǀ hité ǀ mitré ǀ ní-gatān ǀ hanti ǀ vīrā́n ǀavóḥ ǀ vā ǀ yát ǀ dhā́t ǀ tanū́ṣu ǀ ávaḥ ǀ priyā́su ǀ yajñíyāsu ǀ árvā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This iniquity (found) in this Śakapūta, whenMitrais propitious, destroys opposing heroes, when thei.e., Mitra orVaruṇa; avaḥ = food; when the approaching Mitra (or Varuṇa) gives protection to the sacrificial ritesand bodies of the worshipper who delights him with oblations].”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वोर्हि मा॒तादि॑तिर्विचेतसा॒ द्यौर्न भूमि॒: पय॑सा पुपू॒तनि॑ । अव॑ प्रि॒या दि॑दिष्टन॒ सूरो॑ निनिक्त र॒श्मिभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: yuvóḥ ǀ hí ǀ mātā́ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ vi-cetasā ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhū́miḥ ǀ páyasā ǀ pupūtáni ǀáva ǀ priyā́ ǀ didiṣṭana ǀ sū́raḥ ǀ ninikta ǀ raśmí-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O (MitraandVaruṇa), endowed with various wisdom, your motherAditi, the earth, (is) for thepurification (of all things) by its libations, as the heaven (purifies by its rain); you display before us precious(treasures), and wash us with the sun's rays.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं ह्य॑प्न॒राजा॒वसी॑दतं॒ तिष्ठ॒द्रथं॒ न धू॒र्षदं॑ वन॒र्षद॑म् । ता न॑: कणूक॒यन्ती॑र्नृ॒मेध॑स्तत्रे॒ अंह॑सः सु॒मेध॑स्तत्रे॒ अंह॑सः
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ hí ǀ apna-rā́jau ǀ ásīdatam ǀ tíṣṭhat ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ dhūḥ-sádam ǀ vana-sádam ǀtā́ḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ kaṇūka-yántīḥ ǀ nṛ-médhaḥ ǀ tatre ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ su-médhaḥ ǀ tatre ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, brilliant through your functions, have sat down; now mount, (each of you, his) chariot, whichrests on the yoke, which abides in the forests, (to overcome) those (people) who clamour against us; Nṛmedhawas preserved (by you) from sin, the pious worshipper was preserved from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रो ष्व॑स्मै पुरोर॒थमिन्द्रा॑य शू॒षम॑र्चत । अ॒भीके॑ चिदु लोक॒कृत्सं॒गे स॒मत्सु॑ वृत्र॒हास्माकं॑ बोधि चोदि॒ता नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: pró íti ǀ sú ǀ asmai ǀ puraḥ-rathám ǀ índrāya ǀ śūṣám ǀ arcata ǀabhī́ke ǀ cit ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loka-kṛ́t ǀ sam-gé ǀ samát-su ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ asmā́kam ǀ bodhi ǀ coditā́ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Adore fervently the might of thatIndrawhich goes before his chariot; he who makes room for us in the(the adoration paid by us); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं सिन्धूँ॒रवा॑सृजोऽध॒राचो॒ अह॒न्नहि॑म् । अ॒श॒त्रुरि॑न्द्र जज्ञिषे॒ विश्वं॑ पुष्यसि॒ वार्यं॒ तं त्वा॒ परि॑ ष्वजामहे॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ síndhūn ǀ áva ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ adharā́caḥ ǀ áhan ǀ áhim ǀaśatrúḥ ǀ indra ǀ jajñiṣe ǀ víśvam ǀ puṣyasi ǀ vā́ryam ǀ tám ǀ tvā ǀ pári ǀ svajāmahe ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have sent the rivers away downwards, you have slain Ahi; you are born,Indra, without an enemy,you grant all that is desirable, as such we embrace you; may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies bedestroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा॒ अरा॑तयो॒ऽर्यो न॑शन्त नो॒ धिय॑: । अस्ता॑सि॒ शत्र॑वे व॒धं यो न॑ इन्द्र॒ जिघां॑सति॒ या ते॑ रा॒तिर्द॒दिर्वसु॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sú ǀ víśvā ǀ árātayaḥ ǀ aryáḥ ǀ naśanta ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀástā ǀ asi ǀ śátrave ǀ vadhám ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ jíghāṃsati ǀ yā́ ǀ te ǀ rātíḥ ǀ dadíḥ ǀ vásu ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May all our assailants, who make no offerings, quickly perish, may our praises (be successful); you,Indra, hurl the weapon at the foe who seeks to slay us, may that liberal (hand) of yours be the giver of wealth (tous); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॑ इन्द्रा॒भितो॒ जनो॑ वृका॒युरा॒दिदे॑शति । अ॒ध॒स्प॒दं तमीं॑ कृधि विबा॒धो अ॑सि सास॒हिर्नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ jánaḥ ǀ vṛka-yúḥ ǀ ā-dídeśati ǀadhaḥ-padám ǀ tám ǀ īm ǀ kṛdhi ǀ vi-bādháḥ ǀ asi ǀ sasahíḥ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The man who, like a wolf, prowls around us, OIndra, cast him beneath our feet, for you are theresister, the overcomer (of foes); may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यो न॑ इन्द्राभि॒दास॑ति॒ सना॑भि॒र्यश्च॒ निष्ट्य॑: । अव॒ तस्य॒ बलं॑ तिर म॒हीव॒ द्यौरध॒ त्मना॒ नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ indra ǀ abhi-dā́sati ǀ sá-nābhiḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ níṣṭyaḥ ǀáva ǀ tásya ǀ bálam ǀ tira ǀ mahī́-iva ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ ádha ǀ tmánā ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He who assails us,Indra, whether he be of the same caste or of degraded caste-- scatter of yourselfhis host, (though it be vast) as the wide heaven; may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: व॒यमि॑न्द्र त्वा॒यव॑: सखि॒त्वमा र॑भामहे । ऋ॒तस्य॑ नः प॒था न॒याति॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता नभ॑न्तामन्य॒केषां॑ ज्या॒का अधि॒ धन्व॑सु
shlokas.transliteration: vayám ǀ indra ǀ tvā-yávaḥ ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ ā́ ǀ rabhāmahe ǀṛtásya ǀ naḥ ǀ pathā́ ǀ naya ǀ áti ǀ víśvāni ǀ duḥ-itā́ ǀ nábhantām ǀ anyakéṣām ǀ jyākā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dhánva-su ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Devoted to you,Indra, we strive after your friendship; lea\d us by the path of sacrifice beyond all evils;may the bowstrings on the bows of our enemies be destroyed.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ सु त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ तां शि॑क्ष॒ या दोह॑ते॒ प्रति॒ वरं॑ जरि॒त्रे । अच्छि॑द्रोध्नी पी॒पय॒द्यथा॑ नः स॒हस्र॑धारा॒ पय॑सा म॒ही गौः
shlokas.transliteration: asmábhyam ǀ sú ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ tā́m ǀ śikṣa ǀ yā́ ǀ dóhate ǀ práti ǀ váram ǀ jaritré ǀácchidra-ūdhnī ǀ pīpáyat ǀ yáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ sahásra-dhārā ǀ páyasā ǀ mahī́ ǀ gáuḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Give to us,Indra, (the cow) who gives milk to the worshipper according to his desire, so that themighty cow, possessed of an unfailing udder, the shedder of a thousand streams, may supply us plural ntifully withmilk.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒भे यदि॑न्द्र॒ रोद॑सी आप॒प्राथो॒षा इ॑व । म॒हान्तं॑ त्वा म॒हीनां॑ स॒म्राजं॑ चर्षणी॒नां दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: ubhé íti ǀ yát ǀ indra ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ā-paprā́tha ǀ uṣā́ḥ-iva ǀmahā́ntam ǀ tvā ǀ mahī́nām ǀ sam-rā́jam ǀ carṣaṇīnā́m ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You,Indra, who will both heaven and earth (with light) like the dawn- - the divine progenitress hasgiven birth to you, the mighty (gods), the sovereign of man; the auspicious progenitress has given you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॑ स्म दुर्हणाय॒तो मर्त॑स्य तनुहि स्थि॒रम् । अ॒ध॒स्प॒दं तमीं॑ कृधि॒ यो अ॒स्माँ आ॒दिदे॑शति दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ sma ǀ duḥ-hanāyatáḥ ǀ mártasya ǀ tanuhi ǀ sthirám ǀadhaḥ-padám ǀ tám ǀ īm ǀ kṛdhi ǀ yáḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ā-dídeśati ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Enfeeble the strength of the malicious man, cast under foot him who tries to kill us; the divineprogenitress has given you birth, the auspicious progenitress has given you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ त्या बृ॑ह॒तीरिषो॑ वि॒श्वश्च॑न्द्रा अमित्रहन् । शची॑भिः शक्र धूनु॒हीन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभि॑र्दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ tyā́ḥ ǀ bṛhatī́ḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ viśvá-candrāḥ ǀ amitra-han ǀśácībhiḥ ǀ śakra ǀ dhūnuhi ǀ índra ǀ víśvābhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Destroyer of enemies,Indra,Śakra, shake down upon us by your exploits those abundant, all-shiningviands, (accompanied) with all your protections; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspiciousprogrenitress has given you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ यत्त्वं श॑तक्रत॒विन्द्र॒ विश्वा॑नि धूनु॒षे । र॒यिं न सु॑न्व॒ते सचा॑ सह॒स्रिणी॑भिरू॒तिभि॑र्दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ yát ǀ tvám ǀ śatakrato íti śata-krato ǀ índra ǀ víśvāni ǀ dhūnuṣé ǀrayím ǀ ná ǀ sunvaté ǀ sácā ǀ sahasríṇībhiḥ ǀ ūtí-bhiḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you,Indra,Śatakratu, shake down (upon us) all blessings, (then bestow) upon the offerer of thelibation wealth also, together with your thousandfold protections; the divine progenitress has given you birth, theauspicious progrenitress has given you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अव॒ स्वेदा॑ इवा॒भितो॒ विष्व॑क्पतन्तु दि॒द्यव॑: । दूर्वा॑या इव॒ तन्त॑वो॒ व्य१॒॑स्मदे॑तु दुर्म॒तिर्दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ svédāḥ-iva ǀ abhítaḥ ǀ víṣvak ǀ patantu ǀ didyávaḥ ǀdū́rvāyāḥ-iva ǀ tántavaḥ ǀ ví ǀ asmát ǀ etu ǀ duḥ-matíḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Let your radiant (weapons) fall down everywhere round about like drops of person iration; let the enemydepart from us like the stems of thedūrvagrass; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspiciousprogrenitress has given you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: दी॒र्घं ह्य॑ङ्कु॒शं य॑था॒ शक्तिं॒ बिभ॑र्षि मन्तुमः । पूर्वे॑ण मघवन्प॒दाजो व॒यां यथा॑ यमो दे॒वी जनि॑त्र्यजीजनद्भ॒द्रा जनि॑त्र्यजीजनत्
shlokas.transliteration: dīrghám ǀ hí ǀ aṅkuśám ǀ yathā ǀ śáktim ǀ bíbharṣi ǀ mantu-maḥ ǀpū́rveṇa ǀ magha-van ǀ padā́ ǀ ajáḥ ǀ vayā́m ǀ yáthā ǀ yamaḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǀ bhadrā́ ǀ jánitrī ǀ ajījanat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “For you, sapient (Indra), wield your might like a long hook; you drag (your foes),Maghavan, as a goatwith its fore-foot (drags) a branch; the divine progenitress has given you birth, the auspicious progrenitress hasgiven you birth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नकि॑र्देवा मिनीमसि॒ नकि॒रा यो॑पयामसि मन्त्र॒श्रुत्यं॑ चरामसि । प॒क्षेभि॑रपिक॒क्षेभि॒रत्रा॒भि सं र॑भामहे
shlokas.transliteration: nákiḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ minīmasi ǀ nákiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ yopayāmasi ǀ mantra-śrútyam ǀ carāmasi ǀpakṣébhiḥ ǀ api-kakṣébhiḥ ǀ átra ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ rabhāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O gods, we never injure (you), we never inflict annoyance (on you), we follow the teaching of themantra; we take hold of you at this (sacrifice) with wings and arms.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यस्मि॑न्वृ॒क्षे सु॑पला॒शे दे॒वैः स॒म्पिब॑ते य॒मः । अत्रा॑ नो वि॒श्पति॑: पि॒ता पु॑रा॒णाँ अनु॑ वेनति
shlokas.transliteration: yásmin ǀ vṛkṣé ǀ su-palāśé ǀ deváiḥ ǀ sam-píbate ǀ yamáḥ ǀátra ǀ naḥ ǀ viśpátiḥ ǀ pitā́ ǀ purāṇā́n ǀ ánu ǀ venati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “In that leafy tree whereYamadrinks with the gods, there the progenitor, the lord of the house, invitesus to join themen of old.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पु॒रा॒णाँ अ॑नु॒वेन॑न्तं॒ चर॑न्तं पा॒पया॑मु॒या । अ॒सू॒यन्न॒भ्य॑चाकशं॒ तस्मा॑ अस्पृहयं॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: purāṇā́n ǀ anu-vénantam ǀ cárantam ǀ pāpáyā ǀ amuyā́ ǀasūyán ǀ abhí ǀ acākaśam ǀ tásmai ǀ aspṛhayam ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(At first) I beheld him with anguish inviting me to join the men of olden times, and walking with that felldesign; but afterwards I longed for him.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं कु॑मार॒ नवं॒ रथ॑मच॒क्रं मन॒साकृ॑णोः । एके॑षं वि॒श्वत॒: प्राञ्च॒मप॑श्य॒न्नधि॑ तिष्ठसि
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ kumāra ǀ návam ǀ rátham ǀ acakrám ǀ mánasā ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀéka-īṣam ǀ viśvátaḥ ǀ prā́ñcam ǀ ápaśyan ǀ ádhi ǀ tiṣṭhasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The new chariot, wheelless, single-poled, but turning everywhere, which you, my child, mentallyformed-- you stand thereon though you see it not.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं कु॑मार॒ प्राव॑र्तयो॒ रथं॒ विप्रे॑भ्य॒स्परि॑ । तं सामानु॒ प्राव॑र्तत॒ समि॒तो ना॒व्याहि॑तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ kumāra ǀ prá ǀ ávartayaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ víprebhyaḥ ǀ pári ǀtám ǀ sā́ma ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ avartata ǀ sám ǀ itáḥ ǀ nāví ǀ ā́-hitam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The chariot which you, my child, have driven down to me from the sages above, theSāmanhasdriven it back again from hence plural ced on a ship. made?”

shlokas.sanskrit: कः कु॑मा॒रम॑जनय॒द्रथं॒ को निर॑वर्तयत् । कः स्वि॒त्तद॒द्य नो॑ ब्रूयादनु॒देयी॒ यथाभ॑वत्
shlokas.transliteration: káḥ ǀ kumārám ǀ ajanayat ǀ rátham ǀ káḥ ǀ níḥ ǀ avartayat ǀkáḥ ǀ svit ǀ tát ǀ adyá ǀ naḥ ǀ brūyāt ǀ anu-déyī ǀ yáthā ǀ ábhavat ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: यथाभ॑वदनु॒देयी॒ ततो॒ अग्र॑मजायत । पु॒रस्ता॑द्बु॒ध्न आत॑तः प॒श्चान्नि॒रय॑णं कृ॒तम्
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ ábhavat ǀ anu-déyī ǀ tátaḥ ǀ ágram ǀ ajāyata ǀpurástāt ǀ budhnáḥ ǀ ā́-tataḥ ǀ paścā́t ǀ niḥ-áyanam ǀ kṛtám ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒दं य॒मस्य॒ साद॑नं देवमा॒नं यदु॒च्यते॑ । इ॒यम॑स्य धम्यते ना॒ळीर॒यं गी॒र्भिः परि॑ष्कृतः
shlokas.transliteration: idám ǀ yamásya ǀ sádanam ǀ deva-mānám ǀ yát ǀ ucyáte ǀiyám ǀ asya ǀ dhamyate ǀ nāḷī́ḥ ǀ ayám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ pári-kṛtaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is the dwelling ofYama, which is called the fabric of the gods; this pipe is sounded for his(gratification), he is propitiated by hymns.”

shlokas.sanskrit: के॒श्य१॒॑ग्निं के॒शी वि॒षं के॒शी बि॑भर्ति॒ रोद॑सी । के॒शी विश्वं॒ स्व॑र्दृ॒शे के॒शीदं ज्योति॑रुच्यते
shlokas.transliteration: keśī́ ǀ agním ǀ keśī́ ǀ viṣám ǀ keśī́ ǀ bibharti ǀ ródasī íti ǀkeśī́ ǀ víśvam ǀ sváḥ ǀ dṛśé ǀ keśī́ ǀ idám ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ ucyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The radiant (Sun supports)Agni, the radiant one (supports) water, the radiant one supports theheaven and earth, the radiant one is for the visibility of the whole diffused (universe)-- this light is called theradiant one.”

shlokas.sanskrit: मुन॑यो॒ वात॑रशनाः पि॒शङ्गा॑ वसते॒ मला॑ । वात॒स्यानु॒ ध्राजिं॑ यन्ति॒ यद्दे॒वासो॒ अवि॑क्षत
shlokas.transliteration: múnayaḥ ǀ vā́ta-raśanāḥ ǀ piśáṅgā ǀ vasate ǀ málā ǀvā́tasya ǀ ánu ǀ dhrā́jim ǀ yanti ǀ yát ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ávikṣata ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMunis, the sons ofVātaraśana, wear the yellow dirty (vestments of bark), they follow the courseof the wind, when they have assumed the (power of) gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उन्म॑दिता॒ मौने॑येन॒ वाताँ॒ आ त॑स्थिमा व॒यम् । शरी॒रेद॒स्माकं॑ यू॒यं मर्ता॑सो अ॒भि प॑श्यथ
shlokas.transliteration: út-maditāḥ ǀ máuneyena ǀ vā́tān ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthima ǀ vayám ǀśárīrā ǀ ít ǀ asmā́kam ǀ yūyám ǀ mártāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ paśyatha ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exhilarated by the sanctity of theMuniwe have mounted upon the winds; behold, mortals, (in them)our forms!”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒न्तरि॑क्षेण पतति॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाव॒चाक॑शत् । मुनि॑र्दे॒वस्य॑देवस्य॒ सौकृ॑त्याय॒ सखा॑ हि॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: antárikṣeṇa ǀ patati ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ ǀ ava-cā́kaśat ǀmúniḥ ǀ devásya-devasya ǀ sáukṛtyāya ǀ sákhā ǀ hitáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “TheMuniflies through the firmament, illumining all objects, the friend of each deity, appointed forpious works.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वात॒स्याश्वो॑ वा॒योः सखाथो॑ दे॒वेषि॑तो॒ मुनि॑: । उ॒भौ स॑मु॒द्रावा क्षे॑ति॒ यश्च॒ पूर्व॑ उ॒ताप॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: vā́tasya ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ vāyóḥ ǀ sákhā ǀ átho íti ǀ devá-iṣitaḥ ǀ múniḥ ǀubháu ǀ samudráu ǀ ā́ ǀ kṣeti ǀ yáḥ ǀ ca ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ utá ǀ áparaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The steed of the wind, the friend ofVāyu, theMuni, who is instrumental gated by the deity, repairs to bothoceans, the eastern and the western.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒प्स॒रसां॑ गन्ध॒र्वाणां॑ मृ॒गाणां॒ चर॑णे॒ चर॑न् । के॒शी केत॑स्य वि॒द्वान्त्सखा॑ स्वा॒दुर्म॒दिन्त॑मः
shlokas.transliteration: apsarásām ǀ gandharvā́ṇām ǀ mṛgā́ṇām ǀ cáraṇe ǀ cáran ǀkeśī́ ǀ kétasya ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sákhā ǀ svādúḥ ǀ madín-tamaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Wandering in the track of theApsarasasand theGandharvas, and the wild beasts, the radiant (Sun),cognizant of all that is knowable, (is my) sweet and most delightful friend.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वा॒युर॑स्मा॒ उपा॑मन्थत्पि॒नष्टि॑ स्मा कुनन्न॒मा । के॒शी वि॒षस्य॒ पात्रे॑ण॒ यद्रु॒द्रेणापि॑बत्स॒ह
shlokas.transliteration: vāyúḥ ǀ asmai ǀ úpa ǀ amanthat ǀ pináṣṭi ǀ sma ǀ kunannamā́ ǀkeśī́ ǀ viṣásya ǀ pā́treṇa ǀ yát ǀ rudréṇa ǀ ápibat ǀ sahá ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Vāyuchurned for him, the inflexible (thunder) ground it when the radiant (Sun), along withRudra,drank the water with his cup.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त दे॑वा॒ अव॑हितं॒ देवा॒ उन्न॑यथा॒ पुन॑: । उ॒ताग॑श्च॒क्रुषं॑ देवा॒ देवा॑ जी॒वय॑था॒ पुन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ devāḥ ǀ áva-hitam ǀ dévāḥ ǀ út ǀ nayatha ǀ púnaríti ǀutá ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ cakrúṣam ǀ devāḥ ǀ dévāḥ ǀ jīváyatha ǀ púnaríti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O gods, raise again the man, O gods, who has sunk; O gods, give life again to the man, O gods, who”

shlokas.sanskrit: द्वावि॒मौ वातौ॑ वात॒ आ सिन्धो॒रा प॑रा॒वत॑: । दक्षं॑ ते अ॒न्य आ वा॑तु॒ परा॒न्यो वा॑तु॒ यद्रप॑:
shlokas.transliteration: dváu ǀ imáu ǀ vā́tau ǀ vātaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ síndhoḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀdákṣam ǀ te ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vātu ǀ párā ǀ anyáḥ ǀ vātu ǀ yát ǀ rápaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These two winds blow to the regions which are far beyond the ocean; may the one bring you vigour,may the other blow away all evil.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वा॑त वाहि भेष॒जं वि वा॑त वाहि॒ यद्रप॑: । त्वं हि वि॒श्वभे॑षजो दे॒वानां॑ दू॒त ईय॑से
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vāta ǀ vāhi ǀ bheṣajám ǀ ví ǀ vāta ǀ vāhi ǀ yát ǀ rápaḥ ǀtvám ǀ hí ǀ viśvá-bheṣajaḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ ī́yase ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Breathe, wind, medicinal balm; blow away, wind, all evil; for you are the universalmedicine, you moveas the messenger of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑गमं॒ शंता॑तिभि॒रथो॑ अरि॒ष्टता॑तिभिः । दक्षं॑ ते भ॒द्रमाभा॑र्षं॒ परा॒ यक्ष्मं॑ सुवामि ते
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ agamam ǀ śántāti-bhiḥ ǀ átho íti ǀ ariṣṭátāti-bhiḥ ǀdákṣam ǀ te ǀ bhadrám ǀ ā́ ǀ abhārṣam ǀ párā ǀ yákṣmam ǀ suvāmi ǀ te ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(The wind speaks). I have come to you with plural asures and with protections; I have brought youfortunate vigour, I drive away your disease.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्राय॑न्तामि॒ह दे॒वास्त्राय॑तां म॒रुतां॑ ग॒णः । त्राय॑न्ता्॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॒ यथा॒यम॑र॒पा अस॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: trā́yantām ǀ ihá ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ trā́yatām ǀ marútām ǀ gaṇáḥ ǀtrā́yantām ǀ víśvā ǀ bhūtā́ni ǀ yáthā ǀ ayám ǀ arapā́ḥ ǀ ásat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the gods give (us) protection in this world, may the company of theMarutsprotect us, may allbeings grant protection so that this (person n) may be free from sin.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आप॒ इद्वा उ॑ भेष॒जीरापो॑ अमीव॒चात॑नीः । आप॒: सर्व॑स्य भेष॒जीस्तास्ते॑ कृण्वन्तु भेष॒जम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́paḥ ǀ ít ǀ vā ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ bheṣajī́ḥ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ amīva-cā́tanīḥ ǀā́paḥ ǀ sárvasya ǀ bheṣajī́ḥ ǀ tā́ḥ ǀ te ǀ kṛṇvantu ǀ bheṣajám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Waters verily are medicinal; waters are the dissipators of disease; waters are themedicinesforeverything; may they act asmedicineto you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हस्ता॑भ्यां॒ दश॑शाखाभ्यां जि॒ह्वा वा॒चः पु॑रोग॒वी । अ॒ना॒म॒यि॒त्नुभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ ताभ्यां॒ त्वोप॑ स्पृशामसि
shlokas.transliteration: hástābhyām ǀ dáśa-śākhābhyām ǀ jihvā́ ǀ vācáḥ ǀ puraḥ-gavī́ ǀanāmayitnú-bhyām ǀ tvā ǀ tā́bhyām ǀ tvā ǀ úpa ǀ spṛśāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The tongue (being cleansed) by the ten-branchedhands(ofPrajāpatiis) the forerunner of speech;with those (hands) the removers of disease we touch you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: तव॒ त्य इ॑न्द्र स॒ख्येषु॒ वह्न॑य ऋ॒तं म॑न्वा॒ना व्य॑दर्दिरुर्व॒लम् । यत्रा॑ दश॒स्यन्नु॒षसो॑ रि॒णन्न॒पः कुत्सा॑य॒ मन्म॑न्न॒ह्य॑श्च दं॒सय॑:
shlokas.transliteration: táva ǀ tyé ǀ indra ǀ sakhyéṣu ǀ váhnayaḥ ǀ ṛtám ǀ manvānā́ḥ ǀ ví ǀ adardiruḥ ǀ valám ǀyátra ǀ daśasyán ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ riṇán ǀ āpáḥ ǀ kútsāya ǀ mánman ǀ ahyáḥ ǀ ca ǀ daṃsáyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The bearers of oblations (theAṅgirasas),Indrahonouring the sacrifice, have through your friendshiptornValato pieces, when praise (being offered) desiring to give the dawns toKutsa(you were engaged in)freeing the waters, and Ahi's exploits (were foiled).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अवा॑सृजः प्र॒स्व॑: श्व॒ञ्चयो॑ गि॒रीनुदा॑ज उ॒स्रा अपि॑बो॒ मधु॑ प्रि॒यम् । अव॑र्धयो व॒निनो॑ अस्य॒ दंस॑सा शु॒शोच॒ सूर्य॑ ऋ॒तजा॑तया गि॒रा
shlokas.transliteration: áva ǀ asṛjaḥ ǀ pra-sváḥ ǀ śvañcáyaḥ ǀ girī́n ǀ út ǀ ājaḥ ǀ usrā́ḥ ǀ ápibaḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ priyám ǀávardhayaḥ ǀ vanínaḥ ǀ asya ǀ dáṃsasā ǀ śuśóca ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ ṛtá-jātayā ǀ girā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You have sent forth the genitive rative (waters), you have cleft the mountains, you have fetched forth thecows, you have quaffed the deliciousSoma, you have caused the trees of the forest to grow; through his exploitsby means of the voice produced for the sacrifice the sun has shone bright.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि सूर्यो॒ मध्ये॑ अमुच॒द्रथं॑ दि॒वो वि॒दद्दा॒साय॑ प्रति॒मान॒मार्य॑: । दृ॒ळ्हानि॒ पिप्रो॒रसु॑रस्य मा॒यिन॒ इन्द्रो॒ व्या॑स्यच्चकृ॒वाँ ऋ॒जिश्व॑ना
shlokas.transliteration: ví ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ amucat ǀ rátham ǀ diváḥ ǀ vidát ǀ dāsā́ya ǀ prati-mā́nam ǀ ā́ryaḥ ǀdṛḷhā́ni ǀ píproḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ māyínaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ ví ǀ āsyat ǀ cakṛ-vā́n ǀ ṛjíśvanā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The sun unyoked his chariot in the midst of the sky, (when) theĀrya(Indra) encountered the Dāsaassociated with Ṛjiśvan, Indra destroyed the stronghold of the guilefulasura, Pipru.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अना॑धृष्टानि धृषि॒तो व्या॑स्यन्नि॒धीँरदे॑वाँ अमृणद॒यास्य॑: । मा॒सेव॒ सूर्यो॒ वसु॒ पुर्य॒मा द॑दे गृणा॒नः शत्रूँ॑रशृणाद्वि॒रुक्म॑ता
shlokas.transliteration: ánādhṛṣṭāni ǀ dhṛṣitáḥ ǀ ví ǀ āsyat ǀ ni-dhī́n ǀ ádevān ǀ amṛṇat ǀ ayā́syaḥ ǀmāsā́-iva ǀ sū́ryaḥ ǀ vásu ǀ púryam ǀ ā́ ǀ dade ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ śátrūn ǀ aśṛṇāt ǀ virúkmatā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bold (Indra) has annihilated the (hitherto) unbaffled (hosts of theasura), the objects ofAyasya'sadoration has despoiled the impious of their treasures; the sun as if with the (aid of the) moon has seized uponthe wealth of the cities (of theasuras), glorified (by his worshippers), he has demolished the foe with his blazing(thunderbolt).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अयु॑द्धसेनो वि॒भ्वा॑ विभिन्द॒ता दाश॑द्वृत्र॒हा तुज्या॑नि तेजते । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रा॑दबिभेदभि॒श्नथ॒: प्राक्रा॑मच्छु॒न्ध्यूरज॑हादु॒षा अन॑:
shlokas.transliteration: áyuddha-senaḥ ǀ vi-bhvā́ ǀ vi-bhindatā́ ǀ dā́śat ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ tújyāni ǀ tejate ǀíndrasya ǀ vájrāt ǀ abibhet ǀ abhi-śnáthaḥ ǀ prá ǀ akrāmat ǀ śundhyū́ḥ ǀ ájahāt ǀ uṣā́ḥ ǀ ánaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra), leading an irresistible army, slayingVṛtrawith the pervading piercing (bolt), gives (wealth tohis worshippers), thins the (hosts of theasuras) which have to be attacked; (the whole host of the enemy) wasafraid of Indra's wide-destroying thunderbolt, the purifying (sun) came forth, Uṣas left her cart.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒ता त्या ते॒ श्रुत्या॑नि॒ केव॑ला॒ यदेक॒ एक॒मकृ॑णोरय॒ज्ञम् । मा॒सां वि॒धान॑मदधा॒ अधि॒ द्यवि॒ त्वया॒ विभि॑न्नं भरति प्र॒धिं पि॒ता
shlokas.transliteration: etā́ ǀ tyā́ ǀ te ǀ śrútyāni ǀ kévalā ǀ yát ǀ ékaḥ ǀ ékam ǀ ákṛṇoḥ ǀ ayajñám ǀmāsā́m ǀ vi-dhā́nam ǀ adadhāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ dyávi ǀ tváyā ǀ ví-bhinnam ǀ bharati ǀ pra-dhím ǀ pitā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “These wondrous exploits are yours alone, in that you unaided have injured the chief neglector ofsacrifice; you have plural ced in the sky the regulator of the months through your aid the paternal (heaven) upholdsthe circumference of the wheel (of the Sun's car) which has been shattered (byVṛtra).”

shlokas.sanskrit: सूर्य॑रश्मि॒र्हरि॑केशः पु॒रस्ता॑त्सवि॒ता ज्योति॒रुद॑याँ॒ अज॑स्रम् । तस्य॑ पू॒षा प्र॑स॒वे या॑ति वि॒द्वान्त्स॒म्पश्य॒न्विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि गो॒पाः
shlokas.transliteration: sūryá-raśmiḥ ǀ hári-keśaḥ ǀ purástāt ǀ savitā́ ǀ jyótiḥ ǀ út ǀ ayān ǀ ájasram ǀtásya ǀ pūṣā́ ǀ pra-savé ǀ yāti ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sam-páśyan ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanāni ǀ gopā́ḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savitā, the solar-rayed, the yellow-haired, sent up the undying light from the east; at his commandthe wisePūṣan, the preserver, follows, looking upon all creatures.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नृ॒चक्षा॑ ए॒ष दि॒वो मध्य॑ आस्त आपप्रि॒वान्रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स वि॒श्वाची॑र॒भि च॑ष्टे घृ॒ताची॑रन्त॒रा पूर्व॒मप॑रं च के॒तुम्
shlokas.transliteration: nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ mádhye ǀ āste ǀ āpapri-vā́n ǀ ródasī íti ǀ antárikṣam ǀsáḥ ǀ viśvā́cīḥ ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ ghṛtā́cīḥ ǀ antarā́ ǀ pū́rvam ǀ áparam ǀ ca ǀ ketúm ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Beholding mankind he sits in the midst of the sky, filling (with light) the heaven and earth and thefirmament; he illumines the all-pervading (quarters of space), the bright-pervading (intermediate points), and thehindmost, the foremost, and the hindmost mark.”

shlokas.sanskrit: रा॒यो बु॒ध्नः सं॒गम॑नो॒ वसू॑नां॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाभि च॑ष्टे॒ शची॑भिः । दे॒व इ॑व सवि॒ता स॒त्यध॒र्मेन्द्रो॒ न त॑स्थौ सम॒रे धना॑नाम्
shlokas.transliteration: rāyáḥ ǀ budhnáḥ ǀ sam-gámanaḥ ǀ vásūnām ǀ víśvā ǀ rūpā́ ǀ abhí ǀ caṣṭe ǀ śácībhiḥ ǀdeváḥ-iva ǀ savitā́ ǀ satyá-dharmā ǀ índraḥ ǀ ná ǀ tasthau ǀ sam-aré ǀ dhánānām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The root of riches, the acquirer of treasure illumines by his functions all (visible) forms;Savitā, like agod, whose attribute is truth, stands likeIndrain the battle for riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्वाव॑सुं सोम गन्ध॒र्वमापो॑ ददृ॒शुषी॒स्तदृ॒तेना॒ व्या॑यन् । तद॒न्ववै॒दिन्द्रो॑ रारहा॒ण आ॑सां॒ परि॒ सूर्य॑स्य परि॒धीँर॑पश्यत्
shlokas.transliteration: viśvá-vasum ǀ soma ǀ gandharvám ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ dadṛśúṣīḥ ǀ tát ǀ ṛténa ǀ ví ǀ āyan ǀtát ǀ anu-ávait ǀ índraḥ ǀ rarahāṇáḥ ǀ āsām ǀ pári ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ pari-dhī́n ǀ apaśyat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BeholdingSoma, theGandharvaViśvāvasu, the waters have come forth by means of the sacrifice;Indraimpelling them knew of this (their approach), and looked round the rims of the sun.”

shlokas.sanskrit: वि॒श्वाव॑सुर॒भि तन्नो॑ गृणातु दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वो रज॑सो वि॒मान॑: । यद्वा॑ घा स॒त्यमु॒त यन्न वि॒द्म धियो॑ हिन्वा॒नो धिय॒ इन्नो॑ अव्याः
shlokas.transliteration: viśvá-vasuḥ ǀ abhí ǀ tát ǀ naḥ ǀ gṛṇātu ǀ divyáḥ ǀ gandharváḥ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ vi-mā́naḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ satyám ǀ utá ǀ yát ǀ ná ǀ vidmá ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ hinvānáḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ ít ǀ naḥ ǀ avyāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the celestialGandharvaViśvāvasu, the measurer of the water, declare to us that which is thetruth, and that which we do not know; accepting our praises. (Viśvāvasu), protect our sacrifices.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सस्नि॑मविन्द॒च्चर॑णे न॒दीना॒मपा॑वृणो॒द्दुरो॒ अश्म॑व्रजानाम् । प्रासां॑ गन्ध॒र्वो अ॒मृता॑नि वोच॒दिन्द्रो॒ दक्षं॒ परि॑ जानाद॒हीना॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sásnim ǀ avindat ǀ cáraṇe ǀ nadī́nām ǀ ápa ǀ avṛṇot ǀ dúraḥ ǀ áśma-vrajānām ǀprá ǀ āsām ǀ gandharváḥ ǀ amṛ́tāni ǀ vocat ǀ índraḥ ǀ dákṣam ǀ pári ǀ jānāt ǀ ahī́nām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(Indra) discovered the cloud in the region of the rivers, he set open the portals of (the waters) whosedwelling is in the clouds; Indra, (in the form of) theGandharva(viśvāvasu), proclaimed the ambrosial (waters),he knew the strength of the dragons.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तव॒ श्रवो॒ वयो॒ महि॑ भ्राजन्ते अ॒र्चयो॑ विभावसो । बृह॑द्भानो॒ शव॑सा॒ वाज॑मु॒क्थ्यं१॒॑ दधा॑सि दा॒शुषे॑ कवे
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ táva ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ bhrājante ǀ arcáyaḥ ǀ vibhāvaso íti vibhā-vaso ǀbṛ́hadbhāno íti bṛ́hat-bhāno ǀ śávasā ǀ vā́jam ǀ ukthyám ǀ dádhāsi ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ kave ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Your,Agni, is the most excellent sacrificial food; your flames, O opulent in radiance, blaze fiercely;wise and widely luminous (Agni), you bestow upon the donor (of the oblation) the choicest food with strength.”

shlokas.sanskrit: पा॒व॒कव॑र्चाः शु॒क्रव॑र्चा॒ अनू॑नवर्चा॒ उदि॑यर्षि भा॒नुना॑ । पु॒त्रो मा॒तरा॑ वि॒चर॒न्नुपा॑वसि पृ॒णक्षि॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे
shlokas.transliteration: pāvaká-varcāḥ ǀ śukrá-varcāḥ ǀ ánūna-varcāḥ ǀ út ǀ iyarṣi ǀ bhānúnā ǀputráḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ vi-cáran ǀ úpa ǀ avasi ǀ pṛṇákṣi ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ubhé íti ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, who are of purifying radiance, of unsullied lustre, of full brightness, you issue forth withsplendour; visiting your parents (like) a son, you protect (the worshippers), you unite both heaven and earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऊर्जो॑ नपाज्जातवेदः सुश॒स्तिभि॒र्मन्द॑स्व धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तः । त्वे इष॒: सं द॑धु॒र्भूरि॑वर्पसश्चि॒त्रोत॑यो वा॒मजा॑ताः
shlokas.transliteration: ū́rjaḥ ǀ napāt ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ suśastí-bhiḥ ǀ mándasva ǀ dhītí-bhiḥ ǀ hitáḥ ǀtvé íti ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ sám ǀ dadhuḥ ǀ bhū́ri-varpasaḥ ǀ citrá-ūtayaḥ ǀ vāmá-jātāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Son of strength,Jātavedas, rejoice in our adorations, (be) satisfied by our offerings, (theworshippers) have plural ced before you viands of many sorts of wonderful efficacy, of excellent origin. {Son ofstrength: ūrjonapāt= grandson of waters; or, non-injurer; or, food].”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒र॒ज्यन्न॑ग्ने प्रथयस्व ज॒न्तुभि॑र॒स्मे रायो॑ अमर्त्य । स द॑र्श॒तस्य॒ वपु॑षो॒ वि रा॑जसि पृ॒णक्षि॑ सान॒सिं क्रतु॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: irajyán ǀ agne ǀ prathayasva ǀ jantú-bhiḥ ǀ asmé íti ǀ rā́yaḥ ǀ amartya ǀsáḥ ǀ darśatásya ǀ vápuṣaḥ ǀ ví ǀ rājasi ǀ pṛṇákṣi ǀ sānasím ǀ krátum ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Contending with enemies, bestow upon us, immortalAgni, riches; you shine with a graceful person n,you fulfil (the purpose of) the enjoyable rite.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒ष्क॒र्तार॑मध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ क्षय॑न्तं॒ राध॑सो म॒हः । रा॒तिं वा॒मस्य॑ सु॒भगां॑ म॒हीमिषं॒ दधा॑सि सान॒सिं र॒यिम्
shlokas.transliteration: iṣkartā́ram ǀ adhvarásya ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ kṣáyantam ǀ rā́dhasaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀrātím ǀ vāmásya ǀ su-bhágām ǀ mahī́m ǀ íṣam ǀ dádhāsi ǀ sānasím ǀ rayím ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “(We praise you), the perfecter of the sacrifice, the sage, the lord of great wealth, the giver of what isdesirable; you bestow auspicious and abundant food, and enjoyable riches.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒तावा॑नं महि॒षं वि॒श्वद॑र्शतम॒ग्निं सु॒म्नाय॑ दधिरे पु॒रो जना॑: । श्रुत्क॑र्णं स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं त्वा गि॒रा दैव्यं॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गा
shlokas.transliteration: ṛtá-vānam ǀ mahiṣám ǀ viśvá-darśatam ǀ agním ǀ sumnā́ya ǀ dadhire ǀ puráḥ ǀ jánāḥ ǀśrút-karṇam ǀ sapráthaḥ-tamam ǀ tvā ǀ girā́ ǀ dáivyam ǀ mā́nuṣā ǀ yugā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Men for the sake of happiness plural ce before themAgni, the speaker of truth, the mighty, thecontemplator of all; the posterity ofManuin pairs (propitiate) with praises you, whose ears are open (to praises)who are most renowned, and the (minister) of the gods.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ अच्छा॑ वदे॒ह न॑: प्र॒त्यङ्न॑: सु॒मना॑ भव । प्र नो॑ यच्छ विशस्पते धन॒दा अ॑सि न॒स्त्वम्
shlokas.transliteration: ágne ǀ áccha ǀ vada ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǀ pratyáṅ ǀ naḥ ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ bhava ǀprá ǀ naḥ ǀ yaccha ǀ viśaḥ ǀ pate ǀ dhana-dā́ḥ ǀ asi ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agni, speak to us here, be favourably disposed towards us; bestow upon us (riches), lord of men, foryou are the giver of wealth to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र नो॑ यच्छत्वर्य॒मा प्र भग॒: प्र बृह॒स्पति॑: । प्र दे॒वाः प्रोत सू॒नृता॑ रा॒यो दे॒वी द॑दातु नः
shlokas.transliteration: prá ǀ naḥ ǀ yacchatu ǀ aryamā́ ǀ prá ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ prá ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀprá ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ utá ǀ sūnṛ́tā ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ devī́ ǀ dadātu ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAryaman, mayBhaga, mayBṛhaspati, may the gods give liberally to us; may the truth-speakinggoddess (Sarasvatī) bestow riches upon us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सोमं॒ राजा॑न॒मव॑से॒ऽग्निं गी॒र्भिर्ह॑वामहे । आ॒दि॒त्यान्विष्णुं॒ सूर्यं॑ ब्र॒ह्माणं॑ च॒ बृह॒स्पति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: sómam ǀ rā́jānam ǀ ávase ǀ agním ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀādityā́n ǀ víṣṇum ǀ sū́ryam ǀ brahmā́ṇam ǀ ca ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke for our protection the royalSoma, (we invoke)Agniwith praises, (we invoke) theĀdityas,Viṣṇu,Sūrya,BrahmāandBṛhaspati.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू बृह॒स्पतिं॑ सु॒हवे॒ह ह॑वामहे । यथा॑ न॒: सर्व॒ इज्जन॒: संग॑त्यां सु॒मना॒ अस॑त्
shlokas.transliteration: indravāyū́ íti ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ su-hávā ǀ ihá ǀ havāmahe ǀyáthā ǀ naḥ ǀ sárvaḥ ǀ ít ǀ jánaḥ ǀ sám-gatyām ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ ásat ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invoke the adorableIndraandVāyuandBṛhaspation this occasion, that all our race may befavourably inclined to us in the acquisition (of wealth).”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ बृह॒स्पति॒मिन्द्रं॒ दाना॑य चोदय । वातं॒ विष्णुं॒ सर॑स्वतीं सवि॒तारं॑ च वा॒जिन॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: aryamáṇam ǀ bṛ́haspátim ǀ índram ǀ dā́nāya ǀ codaya ǀvā́tam ǀ víṣṇum ǀ sárasvatīm ǀ savitā́ram ǀ ca ǀ vājínam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Stimulate to liberalityAryaman,Bṛhaspati,Indra,Vāta,Viṣṇu,Sarasvatī, and the food-bestowingSavitā.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने अ॒ग्निभि॒र्ब्रह्म॑ य॒ज्ञं च॑ वर्धय । त्वं नो॑ दे॒वता॑तये रा॒यो दाना॑य चोदय
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ bráhma ǀ yajñám ǀ ca ǀ vardhaya ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ dā́nāya ǀ codaya ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Augment our prayer and sacrifice,Agni, with your fires; do you at our sacrifice stimulate (the gods) togive us wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॑ग्ने जरि॒ता त्वे अ॑भू॒दपि॒ सह॑सः सूनो न॒ह्य१॒॑न्यदस्त्याप्य॑म् । भ॒द्रं हि शर्म॑ त्रि॒वरू॑थ॒मस्ति॑ त आ॒रे हिंसा॑ना॒मप॑ दि॒द्युमा कृ॑धि
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ agne ǀ jaritā́ ǀ tvé íti ǀ abhūt ǀ ápi ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ nahí ǀ anyát ǀ ásti ǀ ā́pyam ǀbhadrám ǀ hí ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ásti ǀ te ǀ āré ǀ híṃsānām ǀ ápa ǀ didyúm ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This person n,Agni, was your praiser, for there is nothing else attainable, O son of strength; holy is thehappiness derived from you, a triple defence; remove far from us, who are susceptible of harm, your scorchingflame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्र॒वत्ते॑ अग्ने॒ जनि॑मा पितूय॒तः सा॒चीव॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना॒ न्यृ॑ञ्जसे । प्र सप्त॑य॒: प्र स॑निषन्त नो॒ धिय॑: पु॒रश्च॑रन्ति पशु॒पा इ॑व॒ त्मना॑
shlokas.transliteration: pra-vát ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ jánima ǀ pitu-yatáḥ ǀ sācī́-iva ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ ní ǀ ṛñjase ǀprá ǀ sáptayaḥ ǀ prá ǀ saniṣanta ǀ naḥ ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ caranti ǀ paśupā́ḥ-iva ǀ tmánā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Exalted is the birth of you,Agni, who are desirous of (sacrificial) food; you preside like a councillorover all created beings; our praises flowing smoothly proceed to you, as herdsmen of their own will (go slowly)before (their flocks).”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त वा उ॒ परि॑ वृणक्षि॒ बप्स॑द्ब॒होर॑ग्न॒ उल॑पस्य स्वधावः । उ॒त खि॒ल्या उ॒र्वरा॑णां भवन्ति॒ मा ते॑ हे॒तिं तवि॑षीं चुक्रुधाम
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ vā ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ pári ǀ vṛṇakṣi ǀ bápsat ǀ bahóḥ ǀ agne ǀ úlapasya ǀ svadhā-vaḥ ǀutá ǀ khilyā́ḥ ǀ urvárāṇām ǀ bhavanti ǀ mā́ ǀ te ǀ hetím ǀ táviṣīm ǀ cukrudhāma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “BlazingAgni, you destroy many a shrub, as you burn; and (the sites) of the tilled fields are laid waste,may we never rouse to anger your terrible flame.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यदु॒द्वतो॑ नि॒वतो॒ यासि॒ बप्स॒त्पृथ॑गेषि प्रग॒र्धिनी॑व॒ सेना॑ । य॒दा ते॒ वातो॑ अनु॒वाति॑ शो॒चिर्वप्ते॑व॒ श्मश्रु॑ वपसि॒ प्र भूम॑
shlokas.transliteration: yát ǀ ut-vátaḥ ǀ ni-vátaḥ ǀ yā́si ǀ bápsat ǀ pṛ́thak ǀ eṣi ǀ pragardhínī-iva ǀ sénā ǀyadā́ ǀ te ǀ vā́taḥ ǀ anu-vā́ti ǀ śocíḥ ǀ váptā-iva ǀ śmáśru ǀ vapasi ǀ prá ǀ bhū́ma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When you move burning above and burning below, you scatter yourself like a devastating host; whenthe wind fans your flame, you shave the earth as a barber shaves a beard.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रत्य॑स्य॒ श्रेण॑यो ददृश्र॒ एकं॑ नि॒यानं॑ ब॒हवो॒ रथा॑सः । बा॒हू यद॑ग्ने अनु॒मर्मृ॑जानो॒ न्य॑ङ्ङुत्ता॒नाम॒न्वेषि॒ भूमि॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: práti ǀ asya ǀ śréṇayaḥ ǀ dadṛśre ǀ ékam ǀ ni-yā́nam ǀ bahávaḥ ǀ ráthāsaḥ ǀbāhū́ íti ǀ yát ǀ agne ǀ anu-mármṛjānaḥ ǀ nyáṅ ǀ uttānā́m ǀ anu-éṣi ǀ bhū́mim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “His lines (of flame) are visible, like one array of many chariots, when clearing away (the forests) withyour arms (of flame) you march,Agni, over the prostrate earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ते॒ शुष्मा॑ जिहता॒मुत्ते॑ अ॒र्चिरुत्ते॑ अग्ने शशमा॒नस्य॒ वाजा॑: । उच्छ्व॑ञ्चस्व॒ नि न॑म॒ वर्ध॑मान॒ आ त्वा॒द्य विश्वे॒ वस॑वः सदन्तु
shlokas.transliteration: út ǀ te ǀ śúṣmāḥ ǀ jihatām ǀ út ǀ te ǀ arcíḥ ǀ út ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ śaśamānásya ǀ vā́jāḥ ǀút ǀ śvañcasva ǀ ní ǀ nama ǀ várdhamānaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tvā ǀ adyá ǀ víśve ǀ vásavaḥ ǀ sadantu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May your withering flames,Agni, arise; may your light (arise), and the swift movements of you whenyou are praised; rise up, stoop down, increasing in might; may all theVasusthis day attend upon you.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नं समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम् । अ॒न्यं कृ॑णुष्वे॒तः पन्थां॒ तेन॑ याहि॒ वशाँ॒ अनु॑
shlokas.transliteration: apā́m ǀ idám ǀ ni-áyanam ǀ samudrásya ǀ ni-véśanam ǀanyám ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ itáḥ ǀ pánthām ǀ téna ǀ yāhi ǀ váśān ǀ ánu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This is the abode of the waters, the dwelling of the ocean; pursue,Agni, a different path from this; goby this (path) according to your plural asure.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आय॑ने ते प॒राय॑णे॒ दूर्वा॑ रोहन्तु पु॒ष्पिणी॑: । ह्र॒दाश्च॑ पु॒ण्डरी॑काणि समु॒द्रस्य॑ गृ॒हा इ॒मे
shlokas.transliteration: ā-áyane ǀ te ǀ parā-áyane ǀ dū́rvāḥ ǀ rohantu ǀ puṣpíṇīḥ ǀhradā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ puṇḍárīkāṇi ǀ samudrásya ǀ gṛhā́ḥ ǀ imé ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Both at your arrival,Agni, and at your departure, may the floweringdūrvagrasses spring up; maylakes (be formed) and lotuses (therein); may these be the dwellings of the ocean.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॒दत्रि॑मृत॒जुर॒मर्थ॒मश्वं॒ न यात॑वे । क॒क्षीव॑न्तं॒ यदी॒ पुना॒ रथं॒ न कृ॑णु॒थो नव॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ átrim ǀ ṛta-júram ǀ ártham ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ yā́tave ǀkakṣī́vantam ǀ yádi ǀ púnaríti ǀ rátham ǀ ná ǀ kṛṇutháḥ ǀ návam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You made thisAtri, ever diligent in worship, (swift) to run to the goal like a horse, and you renewedKakṣīvat as (a wheelwright renews) a car.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्यं चि॒दश्वं॒ न वा॒जिन॑मरे॒णवो॒ यमत्न॑त । दृ॒ळ्हं ग्र॒न्थिं न वि ष्य॑त॒मत्रिं॒ यवि॑ष्ठ॒मा रज॑:
shlokas.transliteration: tyám ǀ cit ǀ áśvam ǀ ná ǀ vājínam ǀ areṇávaḥ ǀ yám ǀ átnata ǀdṛḷhám ǀ granthím ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ syatam ǀ átrim ǀ yáviṣṭham ǀ ā́ ǀ rájaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ThisAtri, whom the irresistible (asuras) dragged bound like a swift horse, you unloosed like a strongknot, (setting him) the youngest born upon the earth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: नरा॒ दंसि॑ष्ठा॒वत्र॑ये॒ शुभ्रा॒ सिषा॑सतं॒ धिय॑: । अथा॒ हि वां॑ दि॒वो न॑रा॒ पुन॒ स्तोमो॒ न वि॒शसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: nárā ǀ dáṃsiṣṭhau ǀ átraye ǀ śúbhrā ǀ sísāsatam ǀ dhíyaḥ ǀátha ǀ hí ǀ vām ǀ diváḥ ǀ narā ǀ púnaríti ǀ stómaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vi-śáse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Leaders (of rites), of goodly aspect and radiant, design to acceptAtri's praises, and so the praise ofyour worshipper (is) to be sung again to you leaders (of rites).”

shlokas.sanskrit: चि॒ते तद्वां॑ सुराधसा रा॒तिः सु॑म॒तिर॑श्विना । आ यन्न॒: सद॑ने पृ॒थौ सम॑ने॒ पर्ष॑थो नरा
shlokas.transliteration: cité ǀ tát ǀ vām ǀ su-rādhasā ǀ rātíḥ ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀā́ ǀ yát ǀ naḥ ǀ sádane ǀ pṛtháu ǀ sámane ǀ párṣathaḥ ǀ narā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MunificentAśvins, my offering and praise (is) for your recognition, because, leaders (of rites), youprotect us at the sacrifice in the spacious sacrificial hall.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यु॒वं भु॒ज्युं स॑मु॒द्र आ रज॑सः पा॒र ई॑ङ्खि॒तम् । या॒तमच्छा॑ पत॒त्रिभि॒र्नास॑त्या सा॒तये॑ कृतम्
shlokas.transliteration: yuvám ǀ bhujyúm ǀ samudré ǀ ā́ ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ pāré ǀ īṅkhitám ǀyātám ǀ áccha ǀ patatrí-bhiḥ ǀ nā́satyā ǀ sātáye ǀ kṛtam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “You came with winged (steeds) toBhujyu(immersed) in the ocean, at the world's end, perturbed; and,leaders, of truth, you restored him to your worship.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आ वां॑ सु॒म्नैः शं॒यू इ॑व॒ मंहि॑ष्ठा॒ विश्व॑वेदसा । सम॒स्मे भू॑षतं न॒रोत्सं॒ न पि॒प्युषी॒रिष॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ vām ǀ sumnáiḥ ǀ śamyū́ ivéti śamyū́-iva ǀ máṃhiṣṭhā ǀ víśva-vedasā ǀsám ǀ asmé íti ǀ bhūṣatam ǀ narā ǀ útsam ǀ ná ǀ pipyúṣīḥ ǀ íṣaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Prosperous,, most adorable, all-knowing, come to us and decorate us with blessings, as a (cow's)udder is adorned with abundant food.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यं हि ते॒ अम॑र्त्य॒ इन्दु॒रत्यो॒ न पत्य॑ते । दक्षो॑ वि॒श्वायु॑र्वे॒धसे॑
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ hí ǀ te ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ índuḥ ǀ átyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ pátyate ǀdákṣaḥ ǀ viśvá-āyuḥ ǀ vedháse ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This immortalSoma, the giver of strength, the giver of long life to all, hastens like a swift horse to you(Indra), the creator.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒यम॒स्मासु॒ काव्य॑ ऋ॒भुर्वज्रो॒ दास्व॑ते । अ॒यं बि॑भर्त्यू॒र्ध्वकृ॑शनं॒ मद॑मृ॒भुर्न कृत्व्यं॒ मद॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ayám ǀ asmā́su ǀ kā́vyaḥ ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ vájraḥ ǀ dā́svate ǀayám ǀ bibharti ǀ ūrdhvá-kṛśanam ǀ mádam ǀ ṛbhúḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṛ́tvyam ǀ mádam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This (Indra), adorable among us and brilliant, is a thunderbolt for the donor (of the oblation against hisfoes); he cherishes the exhilarating (worshipper) ūrdhvakṛśana, asṚbhu(cherishes) the exhilaratingcelebrator of holy rites.”

shlokas.sanskrit: घृषु॑: श्ये॒नाय॒ कृत्व॑न आ॒सु स्वासु॒ वंस॑गः । अव॑ दीधेदही॒शुव॑:
shlokas.transliteration: ghṛ́ṣuḥ ǀ śyenā́ya ǀ kṛ́tvane ǀ āsú ǀ svā́su ǀ váṃsagaḥ ǀáva ǀ dīdhet ǀ ahīśúvaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “May the brilliant, (Indra), who is a benefactor among thwese his own (people), for the sake ofthe hymn;Suparṇa, the son of the Tārk.sya. ahiśuvaḥ = name of anasura; the subject of the verb may beSoma and not Indra].”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं सु॑प॒र्णः प॑रा॒वत॑: श्ये॒नस्य॑ पु॒त्र आभ॑रत् । श॒तच॑क्रं॒ यो॒३॒॑ऽह्यो॑ वर्त॒निः
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ su-parṇáḥ ǀ parā-vátaḥ ǀ śyenásya ǀ putráḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ ábharat ǀśatá-cakram ǀ yáḥ ǀ ahyáḥ ǀ vartaníḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “The som whomSuparṇa, the son of the falcon, brought from afar, the bestower of many boons, whois the stimulator of Ahi.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यं ते॑ श्ये॒नश्चारु॑मवृ॒कं प॒दाभ॑रदरु॒णं मा॒नमन्ध॑सः । ए॒ना वयो॒ वि ता॒र्यायु॑र्जी॒वस॑ ए॒ना जा॑गार ब॒न्धुता॑
shlokas.transliteration: yám ǀ te ǀ śyenáḥ ǀ cā́rum ǀ avṛkám ǀ padā́ ǀ ā́ ǀ ábharat ǀ aruṇám ǀ mānám ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀenā́ ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tāri ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ enā́ ǀ jāgāra ǀ bandhútā ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Whom the falcon brought to you (Indra) with his claw, beautiful, unassailable, purple-tinted, themeasurer of food-- by it, food and old age was prolonged for living, by it affinity was awakened.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ए॒वा तदिन्द्र॒ इन्दु॑ना दे॒वेषु॑ चिद्धारयाते॒ महि॒ त्यज॑: । क्रत्वा॒ वयो॒ वि ता॒र्यायु॑: सुक्रतो॒ क्रत्वा॒यम॒स्मदा सु॒तः
shlokas.transliteration: evá ǀ tát ǀ índraḥ ǀ índunā ǀ devéṣu ǀ cit ǀ dhārayāte ǀ máhi ǀ tyájaḥ ǀkrátvā ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ví ǀ tāri ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ sukrato íti su-krato ǀ krátvā ǀ ayám ǀ asmát ǀ ā́ ǀ sutáḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “So then byIndu,Indraobtains among the gods great brilliancy; by your sacrifice, O doer of gooddeeds, food and old age is prolonged, by our sacrifice this (Soma) is poured out by us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मां ख॑ना॒म्योष॑धिं वी॒रुधं॒ बल॑वत्तमाम् । यया॑ स॒पत्नीं॒ बाध॑ते॒ यया॑ संवि॒न्दते॒ पति॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́m ǀ khanāmi ǀ óṣadhim ǀ vīrúdham ǀ bálavat-tamām ǀyáyā ǀ sa-pátnīm ǀ bā́dhate ǀ yáyā ǀ sam-vindáte ǀ pátim ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I dig up this most potent medicinal creeper, by which (a wife) destroys a rival wife, by which shesecures to herself her husband.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्ता॑नपर्णे॒ सुभ॑गे॒ देव॑जूते॒ सह॑स्वति । स॒पत्नीं॑ मे॒ परा॑ धम॒ पतिं॑ मे॒ केव॑लं कुरु
shlokas.transliteration: úttāna-parṇe ǀ sú-bhage ǀ déva-jūte ǀ sáhasvati ǀsa-pátnīm ǀ me ǀ párā ǀ dhama ǀ pátim ǀ me ǀ kévalam ǀ kuru ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O (plural nt) with upturned leaves, auspicious, sent by the gods, powerful, remove my rival and make myhusband mine alone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उत्त॑रा॒हमु॑त्तर॒ उत्त॒रेदुत्त॑राभ्यः । अथा॑ स॒पत्नी॒ या ममाध॑रा॒ साध॑राभ्यः
shlokas.transliteration: út-tarā ǀ ahám ǀ ut-tare ǀ út-tarā ǀ ít ǀ út-tarābhyaḥ ǀátha ǀ sa-pátnī ǀ yā́ ǀ máma ǀ ádharā ǀ sā́ ǀ ádharābhyaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Excellent (plural nt), may I too be excellent, excellent among the excellent, and may she who is my rival bevile among the vile.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न॒ह्य॑स्या॒ नाम॑ गृ॒भ्णामि॒ नो अ॒स्मिन्र॑मते॒ जने॑ । परा॑मे॒व प॑रा॒वतं॑ स॒पत्नीं॑ गमयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: nahí ǀ asyāḥ ǀ nā́ma ǀ gṛbhṇā́mi ǀ nó íti ǀ asmín ǀ ramate ǀ jáne ǀpárām ǀ evá ǀ parā-vátam ǀ sa-pátnīm ǀ gamayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I will not even utter her name, no (woman) takes plural asure in that person n; may we remove the otherrival wife to a distance.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒हम॑स्मि॒ सह॑मा॒नाथ॒ त्वम॑सि सास॒हिः । उ॒भे सह॑स्वती भू॒त्वी स॒पत्नीं॑ मे सहावहै
shlokas.transliteration: ahám ǀ asmi ǀ sáhamānā ǀ átha ǀ tvám ǀ asi ǀ sasahíḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ sáhasvatī íti ǀ bhūtvī́ ǀ sa-pátnīm ǀ me ǀ sahāvahai ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I am triumphing, you are triumphant; we two being powerful will triumph over my rival.”

shlokas.sanskrit: उप॑ तेऽधां॒ सह॑मानाम॒भि त्वा॑धां॒ सही॑यसा । मामनु॒ प्र ते॒ मनो॑ व॒त्सं गौरि॑व धावतु प॒था वारि॑व धावतु
shlokas.transliteration: úpa ǀ te ǀ adhām ǀ sáhamānām ǀ abhí ǀ tvā ǀ adhām ǀ sáhīyasā ǀmā́m ǀ ánu ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ mánaḥ ǀ vatsám ǀ gáuḥ-iva ǀ dhāvatu ǀ pathā́ ǀ vā́ḥ-iva ǀ dhāvatu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I make you the triumphant (herb) my pillow, I support you with that more triumphant (pillow); let yourmind hasten to me as a cow to her calf, let it speed on its way like water. not fear assail you?”

shlokas.sanskrit: अर॑ण्या॒न्यर॑ण्यान्य॒सौ या प्रेव॒ नश्य॑सि । क॒था ग्रामं॒ न पृ॑च्छसि॒ न त्वा॒ भीरि॑व विन्दती३ँ
shlokas.transliteration: áraṇyāni ǀ áraṇyāni ǀ asáu ǀ yā́ ǀ prá-iva ǀ náśyasi ǀkathā́ ǀ grā́mam ǀ ná ǀ pṛcchasi ǀ ná ǀ tvā ǀ bhī́ḥ-iva ǀ vindatī́m̐ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: वृ॒षा॒र॒वाय॒ वद॑ते॒ यदु॒पाव॑ति चिच्चि॒कः । आ॒घा॒टिभि॑रिव धा॒वय॑न्नरण्या॒निर्म॑हीयते
shlokas.transliteration: vṛṣa-ravā́ya ǀ vádate ǀ yát ǀ upa-ávati ǀ ciccikáḥ ǀāghāṭíbhiḥ-iva ǀ dhāváyan ǀ araṇyāníḥ ǀ mahīyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “When the ciccika replies to the crying vṛṣārava,Araṇyāniis exalted, resonant, as with cymbalṣ”

shlokas.sanskrit: उ॒त गाव॑ इवादन्त्यु॒त वेश्मे॑व दृश्यते । उ॒तो अ॑रण्या॒निः सा॒यं श॑क॒टीरि॑व सर्जति
shlokas.transliteration: utá ǀ gā́vaḥ-iva ǀ adanti ǀ utá ǀ véśma-iva ǀ dṛśyate ǀutó íti ǀ araṇyāníḥ ǀ sāyám ǀ śakaṭī́ḥ-iva ǀ sarjati ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “It is as if cows are grazing, and it looks like a dwelling, and Aranyāni at eventide, indeed, dismissedthe carts.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गाम॒ङ्गैष आ ह्व॑यति॒ दार्व॒ङ्गैषो अपा॑वधीत् । वस॑न्नरण्या॒न्यां सा॒यमक्रु॑क्ष॒दिति॑ मन्यते
shlokas.transliteration: gā́m ǀ aṅgá ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hvayati ǀ dā́ru ǀ aṅgá ǀ eṣáḥ ǀ ápa ǀ avadhīt ǀvásan ǀ araṇyānyā́m ǀ sāyám ǀ ákrukṣat ǀ íti ǀ manyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “This man calls his cow, another cuts down the timber; tarrying in the forest eventide, one thinks thereis a cry.”

shlokas.sanskrit: न वा अ॑रण्या॒निर्ह॑न्त्य॒न्यश्चेन्नाभि॒गच्छ॑ति । स्वा॒दोः फल॑स्य ज॒ग्ध्वाय॑ यथा॒कामं॒ नि प॑द्यते
shlokas.transliteration: ná ǀ vái ǀ araṇyāníḥ ǀ hanti ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ca ǀ ít ǀ ná ǀ abhi-gácchati ǀsvādóḥ ǀ phálasya ǀ jagdhvā́ya ǀ yathā-kā́mam ǀ ní ǀ padyate ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “ButAraṇyāniinjures no one unless some other assail him; feeding upon the sweet fruit, hepenetrates at will.”

shlokas.sanskrit: आञ्ज॑नगन्धिं सुर॒भिं ब॑ह्व॒न्नामकृ॑षीवलाम् । प्राहं मृ॒गाणां॑ मा॒तर॑मरण्या॒निम॑शंसिषम्
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ñjana-gandhim ǀ surabhím ǀ bahu-annā́m ǀ ákṛṣi-valām ǀprá ǀ ahám ǀ mṛgā́ṇām ǀ mātáram ǀ araṇyāním ǀ aśaṃsiṣam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I praise the musk-scented, fragrant, fertile, uncultivatedAraṇyāni, the mother of wild animals.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रत्ते॑ दधामि प्रथ॒माय॑ म॒न्यवेऽह॒न्यद्वृ॒त्रं नर्यं॑ वि॒वेर॒पः । उ॒भे यत्त्वा॒ भव॑तो॒ रोद॑सी॒ अनु॒ रेज॑ते॒ शुष्मा॑त्पृथि॒वी चि॑दद्रिवः
shlokas.transliteration: śrát ǀ te ǀ dadhāmi ǀ prathamā́ya ǀ manyáve ǀ áhan ǀ yát ǀ vṛtrám ǀ náryam ǀ vivéḥ ǀ apáḥ ǀubhé íti ǀ yát ǀ tvā ǀ bhávataḥ ǀ ródasī íti ǀ ánu ǀ réjate ǀ śúṣmāt ǀ pṛthivī́ ǀ cit ǀ adri-vaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I have faith,Indra, in your first wrath, whereby you did slayVṛtra, and did undertake a work friendly toman; when both heaven and earth were inferior to you, the firmament trembled at your might, O wielder of thethunderbolt.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं मा॒याभि॑रनवद्य मा॒यिनं॑ श्रवस्य॒ता मन॑सा वृ॒त्रम॑र्दयः । त्वामिन्नरो॑ वृणते॒ गवि॑ष्टिषु॒ त्वां विश्वा॑सु॒ हव्या॒स्विष्टि॑षु
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ māyā́bhiḥ ǀ anavadya ǀ māyínam ǀ śravasyatā́ ǀ mánasā ǀ vṛtrám ǀ ardayaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ ít ǀ náraḥ ǀ vṛṇate ǀ gó-iṣṭiṣu ǀ tvā́m ǀ víśvāsu ǀ hávyāsu ǀ íṣṭiṣu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “IrreproachableIndra, with mind intent on glory you have your deceptions slain the deceptiveVṛtra.The worshipper chooses you when he seeks for his (stolen) cattle, and in all sacrifices accompanied withinvocations.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऐषु॑ चाकन्धि पुरुहूत सू॒रिषु॑ वृ॒धासो॒ ये म॑घवन्नान॒शुर्म॒घम् । अर्च॑न्ति तो॒के तन॑ये॒ परि॑ष्टिषु मे॒धसा॑ता वा॒जिन॒मह्र॑ये॒ धने॑
shlokas.transliteration: ā́ ǀ eṣu ǀ cākandhi ǀ puru-hūta ǀ sūríṣu ǀ vṛdhā́saḥ ǀ yé ǀ magha-van ǀ ānaśúḥ ǀ maghám ǀárcanti ǀ toké ǀ tánaye ǀ páriṣṭiṣu ǀ medhá-sātā ǀ vājínam ǀ áhraye ǀ dháne ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Indra, the invoked of many, be gracious to theseSuris, who thereby prospering attain, OMaghavan, toopulence; (who) adore the powerful one at the sacrifice for (the sake of obtaining) a son, a grandson, thefulfilment of their desires, and honourable wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स इन्नु रा॒यः सुभृ॑तस्य चाकन॒न्मदं॒ यो अ॑स्य॒ रंह्यं॒ चिके॑तति । त्वावृ॑धो मघवन्दा॒श्व॑ध्वरो म॒क्षू स वाजं॑ भरते॒ धना॒ नृभि॑:
shlokas.transliteration: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ sú-bhṛtasya ǀ cākanat ǀ mádam ǀ yáḥ ǀ asya ǀ ráṃhyam ǀ cíketati ǀtvā́-vṛdhaḥ ǀ magha-van ǀ dāśú-adhvaraḥ ǀ makṣú ǀ sáḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharate ǀ dhánā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “He obtains well-procured riches, who studies to promoteIndra's rapid exhilaration. Exalted by (yourfavour), OMaghavan, (the worshipper), celebrating the sacrifice, speedily obtains through the officiating priestsfood and wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वं शर्धा॑य महि॒ना गृ॑णा॒न उ॒रु कृ॑धि मघवञ्छ॒ग्धि रा॒यः । त्वं नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो॒ न मा॒यी पि॒त्वो न द॑स्म दयसे विभ॒क्ता
shlokas.transliteration: tvám ǀ śárdhāya ǀ mahinā́ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ urú ǀ kṛdhi ǀ magha-van ǀ śagdhí ǀ rāyáḥ ǀtvám ǀ naḥ ǀ mitráḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ ná ǀ māyī́ ǀ pitváḥ ǀ ná ǀ dasma ǀ dayase ǀ vi-bhaktā́ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Glorified by great (praise),Maghavan, spread forth your might, bestow riches (upon us); beautifulIndra who are wise likeMitraandVaruṇathe distributer (of riches), you give us food now.”

shlokas.sanskrit: सु॒ष्वा॒णास॑ इन्द्र स्तु॒मसि॑ त्वा सस॒वांस॑श्च तुविनृम्ण॒ वाज॑म् । आ नो॑ भर सुवि॒तं यस्य॑ चा॒कन्त्मना॒ तना॑ सनुयाम॒ त्वोता॑:
shlokas.transliteration: susvānā́saḥ ǀ indra ǀ stumási ǀ tvā ǀ sasa-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀ ca ǀ tuvi-nṛmṇa ǀ vā́jam ǀā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bhara ǀ suvitám ǀ yásya ǀ cākán ǀ tmánā ǀ tánā ǀ sanuyāma ǀ tvā́-ūtāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Having poured out the libation, we praise you,Indra; having presented the sacrificial food, we (praiseyou), granter of abundant wealth; bring us the wealth which one longs for; protected by you may we acquireriches through yourself alone.”

shlokas.sanskrit: ऋ॒ष्वस्त्वमि॑न्द्र शूर जा॒तो दासी॒र्विश॒: सूर्ये॑ण सह्याः । गुहा॑ हि॒तं गुह्यं॑ गू॒ळ्हम॒प्सु बि॑भृ॒मसि॑ प्र॒स्रव॑णे॒ न सोम॑म्
shlokas.transliteration: ṛṣváḥ ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ jātáḥ ǀ dā́sīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ sahyāḥ ǀgúhā ǀ hitám ǀ gúhyam ǀ gūḷhám ǀ ap-sú ǀ bibhṛmási ǀ pra-srávaṇe ǀ ná ǀ sómam ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “HeroIndra, who are mighty, may you as soon as you are born overcome withSūryathe races of theDāsas, and the fugitive (Vala) lurking in secrecy, hidden in the waters; we now present to you theSomain acopious stream. your praisers; may we be of those who gratify (you) with Soma libations; to you, O car-borne indra, these(praises are offered) with sacrificial viands.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒र्यो वा॒ गिरो॑ अ॒भ्य॑र्च वि॒द्वानृषी॑णां॒ विप्र॑: सुम॒तिं च॑का॒नः । ते स्या॑म॒ ये र॒णय॑न्त॒ सोमै॑रे॒नोत तुभ्यं॑ रथोळ्ह भ॒क्षैः
shlokas.transliteration: aryáḥ ǀ vā ǀ gíraḥ ǀ abhí ǀ arca ǀ vidvā́n ǀ ṛ́ṣīṇām ǀ vípraḥ ǀ su-matím ǀ cakānáḥ ǀté ǀ syāma ǀ yé ǀ raṇáyanta ǀ sómaiḥ ǀ enā́ ǀ utá ǀ túbhyam ǀ ratha-oḷha ǀ bhakṣáiḥ ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मा ब्रह्मे॑न्द्र॒ तुभ्यं॑ शंसि॒ दा नृभ्यो॑ नृ॒णां शू॑र॒ शव॑: । तेभि॑र्भव॒ सक्र॑तु॒र्येषु॑ चा॒कन्नु॒त त्रा॑यस्व गृण॒त उ॒त स्तीन्
shlokas.transliteration: imā́ ǀ bráhma ǀ indra ǀ túbhyam ǀ śaṃsi ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ nṛ́-bhyaḥ ǀ nṛṇā́m ǀ śūra ǀ śávaḥ ǀtébhiḥ ǀ bhava ǀ sá-kratuḥ ǀ yéṣu ǀ cākán ǀ utá ǀ trāyasva ǀ gṛṇatáḥ ǀ utá ǀ stī́n ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “To you,Indra, have these prayers been addressed grant, O hero, strength to the leaders of men; be ofone mind with those in whom you delight, and protect those who praise you, and the worshippers who standround about.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्रु॒धी हव॑मिन्द्र शूर॒ पृथ्या॑ उ॒त स्त॑वसे वे॒न्यस्या॒र्कैः । आ यस्ते॒ योनिं॑ घृ॒तव॑न्त॒मस्वा॑रू॒र्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्र॑वयन्त॒ वक्वा॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śrudhí ǀ hávam ǀ indra ǀ śūra ǀ pṛ́thyāḥ ǀ utá ǀ stavase ǀ venyásya ǀ arkáiḥ ǀā́ ǀ yáḥ ǀ te ǀ yónim ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ ásvāḥ ǀ ūrmíḥ ǀ ná ǀ nimnáiḥ ǀ dravayanta ǀ vákvāḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Hear, heroIndra, the invocation ofPṛthu; you are glorified by the praises of the son ofVena, whocelebrated your hall of sacrifice, full of ghī; your praisers rush to you like a torrent through precipitous banks.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स॒वि॒ता य॒न्त्रैः पृ॑थि॒वीम॑रम्णादस्कम्भ॒ने स॑वि॒ता द्याम॑दृंहत् । अश्व॑मिवाधुक्ष॒द्धुनि॑म॒न्तरि॑क्षम॒तूर्ते॑ ब॒द्धं स॑वि॒ता स॑मु॒द्रम्
shlokas.transliteration: savitā́ ǀ yantráiḥ ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ aramṇāt ǀ askambhané ǀ savitā́ ǀ dyā́m ǀ adṛṃhat ǀáśvam-iva ǀ adhukṣat ǀ dhúnim ǀ antárikṣam ǀ atū́rte ǀ baddhám ǀ savitā́ ǀ samudrám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Savitāhas fixed the earth with fetters; Savitā has made the heaven firm in a plural ce where there wasno support; Savitā has milked the cloud of the firmament bound to the indestructible (ether) like a tremblinghorse.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यत्रा॑ समु॒द्रः स्क॑भि॒तो व्यौन॒दपां॑ नपात्सवि॒ता तस्य॑ वेद । अतो॒ भूरत॑ आ॒ उत्थि॑तं॒ रजोऽतो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑प्रथेताम्
shlokas.transliteration: yátra ǀ samudráḥ ǀ skabhitáḥ ǀ ví ǀ áunat ǀ ápām ǀ napāt ǀ savitā́ ǀ tásya ǀ veda ǀátaḥ ǀ bhū́ḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ āḥ ǀ útthitam ǀ rájaḥ ǀ átaḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ aprathetām ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Where the cloud thus arrested shed moisture (on the earth)Savitā, O grandson of the waters, knewthat (plural ce); from thence proceeded the earth, thence arose the firmament, thence the heaven and earth werespread out.”

shlokas.sanskrit: प॒श्चेदम॒न्यद॑भव॒द्यज॑त्र॒मम॑र्त्यस्य॒ भुव॑नस्य भू॒ना । सु॒प॒र्णो अ॒ङ्ग स॑वि॒तुर्ग॒रुत्मा॒न्पूर्वो॑ जा॒तः स उ॑ अ॒स्यानु॒ धर्म॑
shlokas.transliteration: paścā́ ǀ idám ǀ anyát ǀ abhavat ǀ yájatram ǀ ámartyasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ bhūnā́ ǀsu-parṇáḥ ǀ aṅgá ǀ savitúḥ ǀ garútmān ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ jātáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ asya ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Afterwards arose this other adorable (deity), together with the host of the immortal world, thebrightwingedGarutmat, born beforeSavitāobeyed his law.”

shlokas.sanskrit: गाव॑ इव॒ ग्रामं॒ यूयु॑धिरि॒वाश्वा॑न्वा॒श्रेव॑ व॒त्सं सु॒मना॒ दुहा॑ना । पति॑रिव जा॒याम॒भि नो॒ न्ये॑तु ध॒र्ता दि॒वः स॑वि॒ता वि॒श्ववा॑रः
shlokas.transliteration: gā́vaḥ-iva ǀ grā́mam ǀ yúyudhiḥ-iva ǀ áśvān ǀ vāśrā́-iva ǀ vatsám ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ dúhānā ǀpátiḥ-iva ǀ jāyā́m ǀ abhí ǀ naḥ ǀ ní ǀ etu ǀ dhartā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ savitā́ ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As cattle hasten to the village, as the warrior to his horses, as affectionate milk-giving cows to the calf,as a husband to his wife, so maySavitā, the upholder of the sky, the desired of all, hasten to us.”

shlokas.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यस्तूपः सवित॒र्यथा॑ त्वाङ्गिर॒सो जु॒ह्वे वाजे॑ अ॒स्मिन् । ए॒वा त्वार्च॒न्नव॑से॒ वन्द॑मान॒: सोम॑स्येवां॒शुं प्रति॑ जागरा॒हम्
shlokas.transliteration: híraṇya-stūpaḥ ǀ savitaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ tvā ǀ āṅgirasáḥ ǀ juhvé ǀ vā́je ǀ asmín ǀevá ǀ tvā ǀ árcan ǀ ávase ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ sómasya-iva ǀ aṃśúm ǀ práti ǀ jāgara ǀ ahám ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “AsHiraṇyastūpa, theAṅgirasa, summoned you to this food, so I, praising you for your protection,watch before you as (worshippers) watch before the filament of theSoma.”

shlokas.sanskrit: समि॑द्धश्चि॒त्समि॑ध्यसे दे॒वेभ्यो॑ हव्यवाहन । आ॒दि॒त्यै रु॒द्रैर्वसु॑भिर्न॒ आ ग॑हि मृळी॒काय॑ न॒ आ ग॑हि
shlokas.transliteration: sám-iddhaḥ ǀ cit ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ devébhyaḥ ǀ havya-vāhana ǀādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ naḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Bearer of oblations, being kindled you burn for the gods; come to us with theĀdityas, theRudras, the”

shlokas.sanskrit: इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒दं वचो॑ जुजुषा॒ण उ॒पाग॑हि । मर्ता॑सस्त्वा समिधान हवामहे मृळी॒काय॑ हवामहे
shlokas.transliteration: imám ǀ yajñám ǀ idám ǀ vácaḥ ǀ jujuṣāṇáḥ ǀ upa-ā́gahi ǀmártāsaḥ ǀ tvā ǀ sam-idhāna ǀ havāmahe ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ havāmahe ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Being gratified by this sacrifice, this praise, approach; we mortals invoke you, blazing (Agni), weinvoke you for felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: त्वामु॑ जा॒तवे॑दसं वि॒श्ववा॑रं गृणे धि॒या । अग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ आ व॑ह नः प्रि॒यव्र॑तान्मृळी॒काय॑ प्रि॒यव्र॑तान्
shlokas.transliteration: tvā́m ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀ viśvá-vāram ǀ gṛṇe ǀ dhiyā́ ǀágne ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vaha ǀ naḥ ǀ priyá-vratān ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ priyá-vratān ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “I glorify with my praise you,Jātavedas, desired by akll; bring hither,Agni, to us the gods who aregratified by offerings, (bring) those gratified by offerings for our felicity. invoke Agni for the acquisition of abundant wealth, (may he make me) happy for the acquisition of wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वो दे॒वाना॑मभवत्पु॒रोहि॑तो॒ऽग्निं म॑नु॒ष्या॒३॒॑ ऋष॑य॒: समी॑धिरे । अ॒ग्निं म॒हो धन॑साताव॒हं हु॑वे मृळी॒कं धन॑सातये
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavat ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ agním ǀ manuṣyā́ḥ ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǀagním ǀ maháḥ ǀ dhána-sātau ǀ ahám ǀ huve ǀ mṛḷīkám ǀ dhána-sātaye ǁ

shlokas.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निरत्रिं॑ भ॒रद्वा॑जं॒ गवि॑ष्ठिरं॒ प्राव॑न्न॒: कण्वं॑ त्र॒सद॑स्युमाह॒वे । अ॒ग्निं वसि॑ष्ठो हवते पु॒रोहि॑तो मृळी॒काय॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः
shlokas.transliteration: agníḥ ǀ átrim ǀ bharát-vājam ǀ gáviṣṭhiram ǀ prá ǀ āvat ǀ naḥ ǀ káṇvam ǀ trasádasyum ǀ ā-havé ǀagním ǀ vásiṣṭhaḥ ǀ havate ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ mṛḷīkā́ya ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “MayAgniprotect in warAtri,Bhāradvāja,Gaviṣṭhira, ourselves,Kaṇva, andTrasadasyu;Vasiṣṭhaas thepurohitainvokes Agni, the Purohita for our felicity.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्र॒द्धया॒ग्निः समि॑ध्यते श्र॒द्धया॑ हूयते ह॒विः । श्र॒द्धां भग॑स्य मू॒र्धनि॒ वच॒सा वे॑दयामसि
shlokas.transliteration: śraddháyā ǀ agníḥ ǀ sám ǀ idhyate ǀ śraddháyā ǀ hūyate ǀ havíḥ ǀśraddhā́m ǀ bhágasya ǀ mūrdháni ǀ vácasā ǀ ā́ ǀ vedayāmasi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Agniis kindled byŚraddhā, by Śraddhā is the oblation offered; with our praise we glorifyFaith, of the family of Love; cf.Nirukta9.31].”

shlokas.sanskrit: प्रि॒यं श्र॑द्धे॒ दद॑तः प्रि॒यं श्र॑द्धे॒ दिदा॑सतः । प्रि॒यं भो॒जेषु॒ यज्व॑स्वि॒दं म॑ उदि॒तं कृ॑धि
shlokas.transliteration: priyám ǀ śraddhe ǀ dádataḥ ǀ priyám ǀ śraddhe ǀ dídāsataḥ ǀpriyám ǀ bhojéṣu ǀ yájva-su ǀ idám ǀ me ǀ uditám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “O Śraddhā_, grant the desire of the donor (of the oblation), grant, OŚraddhā, the desire of himwho wishes to give, grant this boon which I have mentioned to my sacrificers who solicit happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: यथा॑ दे॒वा असु॑रेषु श्र॒द्धामु॒ग्रेषु॑ चक्रि॒रे । ए॒वं भो॒जेषु॒ यज्व॑स्व॒स्माक॑मुदि॒तं कृ॑धि
shlokas.transliteration: yáthā ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ásureṣu ǀ śraddhā́m ǀ ugréṣu ǀ cakriré ǀevám ǀ bhojéṣu ǀ yájva-su ǀ asmā́kam ǀ uditám ǀ kṛdhi ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “As the gods had faith in (their fight with) theAsuras, so grant the boon which has been asked for toour sacrificers who solicit happiness.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्र॒द्धां दे॒वा यज॑माना वा॒युगो॑पा॒ उपा॑सते । श्र॒द्धां हृ॑द॒य्य१॒॑याकू॑त्या श्र॒द्धया॑ विन्दते॒ वसु॑
shlokas.transliteration: śraddhā́m ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ yájamānāḥ ǀ vāyú-gopāḥ ǀ úpa ǀ āsate ǀśraddhā́m ǀ hṛdayyáyā ǀ ā́-kūtyā ǀ śraddháyā ǀ vindate ǀ vásu ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Gods, worshippers, and those who are protected byVāyu, solicitŚraddhā, (they cherish) Śraddhāwith heartfelt desire, through Śraddhā a man acquires wealth.”

shlokas.sanskrit: श्र॒द्धां प्रा॒तर्ह॑वामहे श्र॒द्धां म॒ध्यंदि॑नं॒ परि॑ । श्र॒द्धां सूर्य॑स्य नि॒म्रुचि॒ श्रद्धे॒ श्रद्धा॑पये॒ह न॑:
shlokas.transliteration: śraddhā́m ǀ prātáḥ ǀ havāmahe ǀ śraddhā́m ǀ madhyándinam ǀ pári ǀśraddhā́m ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ ni-mrúci ǀ śráddhe ǀ śrát ǀ dhāpaya ǀ ihá ǀ naḥ ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “We invokeŚraddhāat dawn, and again at midday, and also at the setting of the sun; inspire us inthis world, Śraddhā, with faith.”

shlokas.sanskrit: शा॒स इ॒त्था म॒हाँ अ॑स्यमित्रखा॒दो अद्भु॑तः । न यस्य॑ ह॒न्यते॒ सखा॒ न जीय॑ते॒ कदा॑ च॒न
shlokas.transliteration: śāsáḥ ǀ itthā́ ǀ mahā́n ǀ asi ǀ amitra-khādáḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǀná ǀ yásya ǀ hanyáte ǀ sákhā ǀ ná ǀ jī́yate ǀ kádā ǀ caná ǁ
shlokas.meaning_en: “Śāsathus (praiseIndra); you are mighty, the destroyer of foes, the wonderful, (he) whose friend isnot killed nor ever overpowered.”

shlokas.sanskrit: स्व॒स्ति॒दा वि॒शस्पति॑र्वृत्र॒हा वि॑मृ॒धो व॒शी । वृषेन्द्र॑: पु॒र ए॑तु नः सोम॒पा अ॑भयंक॒रः
shlokas.transliteration: svasti-dā́ḥ ǀ viśáḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ vi-mṛdháḥ ǀ vaśī́ ǀvṛ́ṣā ǀ índraḥ ǀ puráḥ ǀ etu ǀ naḥ ǀ soma-pā́ḥ ǀ abhayam-karáḥ ǁ
